english_verse: But if something happens to the animal while the owner is present, you do not have to replace it. If you had leased the animal, the money you paid the owner will cover any harm done to it. Laws for Everyday Life The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nsu si ebuo ɔlati ɔkya asa na ebuo ɔmmɔ úkpi ni, útalɛka ebuo ɔdane ɔmmɔ ɔƒɔ kayu kadi ute ebuo ɔlati. Na si bádi ebuo ɔdi kuye ka utábla kabla kadi ute-nwu asa na ebuo ɔmmɔ úkpi ni, kuye kɔni bádi mmɔ kani na ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ. Ɔda Bubo Na Ngba Bulie Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Suppose a young woman has never had sex and isn't engaged. If a man talks her into having sex, he must pay the bride price and marry her.
translation_verse: “Si ɔnana ɔ́tɔlɔ adagyaa ɔdi na anwu ku-nwu bátɛ ni, ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ-nwu elila. Na ɔmmɔ kama uti uleku ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: But if her father refuses to let her marry the man, the bride price must still be paid.
translation_verse: Nsu si uleku ɔmmɔ ɔti útenu kalɔ ka ɔnana ɔmmɔ uti-nwu ni, ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ kayu kani námanku uleku buti ute ɔti ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for witchcraft.
translation_verse: “Na uleku biala matɛya kalɛ beebó like ni, bɔdu ɔlɛka badu-nwu.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for having sex with an animal.
translation_verse: “Ukyuli biala na anwu ku ebuo ɔdi bátɛ ni, ɔlɛka badu ukyuli ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for offering sacrifices to any god except me.
translation_verse: “Ukyuli biala matábla akpala mete unwoti ɔdi ɔni na ɔɔɔdi Katɔti ni, ɔlɛka badu-nwu.

english_verse: Do not mistreat or abuse foreigners who live among you. Remember, you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: “Na ukyuli ɔdi utabla ɔƒɔ ɔdi kalala, ɔsika binyimo ka amii lɛnɔ bɛ́bla baƒɔ dii na Egyipte.

english_verse: If you do, they will beg for my help, and I will come to their rescue.
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi ɔ́kya unyeƒi na béwulo bákpali-mi ni, ndubunu bana bɔkpali.

english_verse: In fact, I will get so angry that I will kill your men and make widows of their wives and orphans of their children.
translation_verse: Na ndubuti kɔnyi lɛkya-mii, na lɛdu-mii ku kewii, na bina beleku benwini bekpinele, na bina bebi lɛnɔ babla bekpinebi.

english_verse: Don't charge interest when you lend money to any of my people who are in need.
translation_verse: “Na si bívo egulabi adi bíte mina bekyuli ni, bitabla lɛlɔ aani bekyuli bani muuvó egulabi teete bekyuli bamba kalɛ. Bitaƒɔ kuvonsia bitasia-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Before sunset you must return any coat taken as security for a loan,
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi ɔ́ƒɔ ɔkpanadi kɔdi ɔkpa ni, na ɔsɔku-ku ute-nwu asa na ɔƒɛ ɔnu.

english_verse: because that is the only cover the poor have when they sleep at night. I am a merciful God, and when they call out to me, I will come to help them.
translation_verse: Ɔsika aku kani na ubo na uuti taabɛ kɔyɔ. Na si éteti étete-nwu ni, bi na uti ubi lɛlɔ usien? Na si áyu atuɔkplu na úwulo ɔ́kpali-mi ni, ndubunu-nwu bɔkpali. Ɔsika ndi Katɔti ɔni mbo kaƒɔ bɔkywi.

english_verse: Don't speak evil of me or of the ruler of your people.
translation_verse: “Na bitetemi enyekpi na bina Katɔti lɛlɔ. Na ɔdi utewida bina batɔnkune.

english_verse: Don't fail to give me the offerings of grain and wine that belong to me. Dedicate to me your first-born sons
translation_verse: “Na biteni-mi bina edula ku ntɛ akpala buboku. “Na biti bina bebi bananabi bedeedi bani bɛ́wɔ bite-mi.

english_verse: and the first-born of your cattle and sheep. Let the animals stay with their mothers for seven days, then on the eighth day give them to me, your God.
translation_verse: “Na bina ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku baƒonu bebi bedeedi bani bawɔ ni, biti-ma bite-mi. Nsu bɛya na basɔ bakya bana beni kudɔ emeyi maatɛ. Na limeyi maanedi lɛlɔ asa biti-ma biboku-mi.

english_verse: You are my chosen people, so don't eat the meat of any of your livestock that was killed by a wild animal. Instead, feed the meat to dogs.
translation_verse: “Bise likpo ka bɛdi mina bekyuli kedee, anwuɔsu bitakun lɛla lɛni na eƒiebuo náduli-nwu ɔ́du. Mmomu biti ebuo ɔmmɔ bite bakpewe na bakun.”

english_verse: Always tell the truth in court, even if everyone else is dishonest and stands in the way of justice.
translation_verse: “Na tasiaku bekyuli bumomo kama na atábla likpidi. Na si eedie lɛla lɛdi kenye na litemi katɛkɔ ni, tanu bekyuli bumomo anumi na enwini litemi geen lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: And don't favor the poor, simply because they are poor.
translation_verse: Tanu ɔwabane anumi tatɛ litemi na litemi katɛkɔ.

english_verse: If you find an ox or a donkey that has wandered off, take it back where it belongs, even if the owner is your enemy.
translation_verse: “Na si ánu ebuo ala utine ɔni na ɔdi ƒula ukisine ɔdi ka úkulo kabuli ni, na asɔku-nwu esienku-nwu.

english_verse: If a donkey is overloaded and falls down, you must do what you can to help, even if it belongs to someone who doesn't like you.
translation_verse: Na si etila na ánu ka étulo-nwu na úbuli ni, na ebunku-nwu na ɔta.

english_verse: Make sure that the poor are given equal justice in court.
translation_verse: “Tebulo ɔwabane litemi bɔtɛ siin na litemi katɛkɔ.

english_verse: Don't bring false charges against anyone or sentence an innocent person to death. I won't forgive you if you do.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ kenye kani na báda básia ukyuli ɔdi ni, teti litemi lɛmmɔ tabla kabla na adu ukyuli buni kɔtɔ anii badu-nwu, ɔsika lɛɛɛdubo litemi ɔtɛne ukpidi ɔmɛni ubo bute na ɔlɛ kɔtu bɔni kemmo.

english_verse: Don't accept bribes. Judges are blinded and justice is twisted by bribes.
translation_verse: “Na ɔdi utaƒɔ egulabi na bɔbɛ kemmo, ɔsika ala ammɔ udu aabwɛ bekyuli bani mɔɔnu anumi na balátɛ litemi siin.

english_verse: Don't mistreat foreigners. You were foreigners in Egypt, and you know what it is like. Laws for the Sabbath The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Na bitabla ɔƒɔ kalala, ɔsika amii alati bɛgyi ɔlɛ bunu bɔni nkya kaƒɔ bulie kemmo uwi ɔni na bɛ́kya Egyipte. Lɛnwunameyi Lɛlɔ Ɔda Bubo

english_verse: Plant and harvest your crops for six years,
translation_verse: “Biti akwa aku bɛtuma na bɛva bina edula, na bide bina lɛla biala na bɛ́va.

english_verse: but let the land rest during the seventh year. The poor are to eat what they want from your fields, vineyards, and olive trees during that year, and when they have all they want from your fields, leave the rest for wild animals.
translation_verse: Na lɛkwa maatɛdi lɛlɔ ni, bɛya na kalɔ kammɔ kanwuna. Na ɔdi utede lɛla lɛni nákwɛ-ka kemmo. Nsu bawabane bebo kuƒi ka badi lɛla biala na lɛ́kwɛ mmɔ. Na bebuo lɛnɔ bebo kuƒi ka badi edula ani nébu-ka kemmo. Lɛni kani na ɔlɛka bɛbla bina adingyii ku ebo mmo lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Work the first six days of the week, but rest and relax on the seventh day. This law is not only for you, but for your oxen, donkeys, and slaves, as well as for any foreigners among you.
translation_verse: “Biti emeyi aku bɛbla bina kabla na bɛnwuna limeyi maatɛdi lɛlɔ. Kalɛ na bina baƒɔ ku bekyuli bani mɔɔbla kabla teete-mii ku bina bebuo muedi lɛnɔ bakɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: Make certain that you obey everything I have said. Don't pray to other gods or even mention their names. Three Annual Festivals (Exodus
translation_verse: “Bɛsia anumi na bɛdi ɔda biala na líbo-mii lɛlɔ. Bitakpali baƒiɔ biala bitawia bana kebunku, na bitalɔ ɔdi lɛnyi muedi. Bɛdi Limeyi Kɔtɛ Na Lɛkwa Kemmo

english_verse: Do not offer bread made with yeast when you sacrifice an animal to me. And make sure that the fat of the animal is burned that same day.
translation_verse: “Biteti lɛla biala kemmo na bɔnyii bɔkya bitebunku ubugya akpala ani na bíti biite-mi lɛlɔ. “Na bebuo bani akpala na bɛ́bla bíte-mi na emeyi atɛ amɛni kemmo ni, bɛnu ka kadi kétegye ɔdi lɛmwi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Your women will give birth to healthy children, and everyone will live a long life.
translation_verse: Na uleku biala ulénwini udinkɔ na bina akɔ iye ubile kaƒɔ. Na bɛdubo ngba bulie na bɛbi lɛlɔ geen asa na bikpi.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: “Bɛdi Edula Bɔƒɛ Limeyi ku edula edeedi ani na bɛ́ƒɛ bɛ́siku bina mmo bɔni na bɛ́tuma. “Na si uwi ɔni na bɛɛsála-nya teewi unwu ku kesekɔ bamba lidu ƒui kemmo ni, na bɛdi Edula Bɔsala Limeyi.

english_verse: Your men must come to these three festivals each year to worship me.
translation_verse: “Ɔlɛka banana ƒui bebenye Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui anumi kɔtɛ na lɛkwa kemmo.

english_verse: Celebrate three festivals each year in my honor.
translation_verse: “Kɔtɛ na ɔlɛka bɛdi limeyi na lɛkwa kemmo bite-mi.

english_verse: Celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread by eating bread made without yeast, just as I have commanded. Do this at the proper time during the month of Abib, because it is the month when you left Egypt. And make certain that everyone brings the proper offerings.
translation_verse: “Bɛdi Bodobodo Ɔni Néteƒu Limeyi emeyi maatɛ. Na bɔnyii butakya bodobodo ɔmmɔ kemmo aani kalɛ na líbo-mii ɔda. Na bɛdi limeyi lɛmmɔ na Abib kɔbuli kɔni kemmo lɛ́lɛ ugyii lite-mi kemmo, ɔsika kuna kemmo na bɛ́tɔlɔ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. “Ɔdi biala utebenye-mi anumi ku enukplu.

english_verse: Each year bring the best part of your first harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. A Promise and a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Biti edula edeedi abuni ƒui ani bɛ́kɛ na kalɔ kammɔ kemmo biboku ami, bina Unwoti Katɔti kakpakɔ. “Biteƒulo ese ubi ɔdi lɛna na uni anyi ntu kemmo. Katɔti Ɔtu Ɔdubo Bɔklibi Ulu Ute-mii

english_verse: I am sending an angel to protect you and to lead you into the land I have ready for you.
translation_verse: “Bɛnu! Ndubo bɔtala mina ɔtu na ɔgyu ɔtɔ-mii, na anwu ndubo-mii bɔgyumana na ulu lɛlɔ, na uti-mii utéduoku kesii kani lɛ́klibi líse-mii.

english_verse: Carefully obey everything the angel says, because I am giving him complete authority, and he won't tolerate rebellion.
translation_verse: Binu ɔtu ɔmmɔ litemi biala lɛni na ɔdubo-mii bɔsu. Na ɔdi utata utenye-nwu lɛlɔ, ɔsika ami nátala-nwu. Na si ɔdi ɔ́ta únye-nwu lɛlɔ ni, uleti ulakyiɛ-nwu, ɔsika mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ na ɔkɛ.

english_verse: If you faithfully obey him, I will be a fierce enemy of your enemies.
translation_verse: Nsu si bínu ɔtu ɔmmɔ litemi na bɛ́di mina ɔda ɔni líbo-mii lɛlɔ ni, ndubo bina bekisine bukpoku bute-mii.

english_verse: My angel will lead you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.
translation_verse: Na mina ɔtu ɔdubo bɔgyu bɔtɔ-mii, na ɔtɔnku-mii utéduoku Amoriƒuɔ ku Hetiƒuɔ ku Perisiƒuɔ ku Kanaanƒuɔ ku Hewiƒuɔ ku Yebusiƒuɔ kalɔ kemmo. Na ndubo-ma bɔbɔku budie mmɔ.

english_verse: Don't worship their gods or follow their customs. Instead, destroy their idols and shatter their stone images.
translation_verse: Na bitakya lili kalɔ bitete bana baƒiɔ na bitaabla-ma kabla, na bitasiaku bana ɔbladu kama lɛnɔ. Ɔlɛka bɛbwɛ bana baƒiɔ ku bana atabi kedee ammɔ ƒui kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: Worship only me, the Lord your God! I will bless you with plenty of food and water and keep you strong.
translation_verse: Bɛkpa ami bina Unwoti Katɔti lɛti pɛ, na mina kusɛ kusɛ ɔdubo-mii bɔsiaku na bɛkɛ bɛdi na bɛkɛ bɛni. Na ndubo ɔlɛ biala bɔda budie bina akɔ.

english_verse: I will make the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites panic as you approach.
translation_verse: Na ndubo bɔya na bebweyi bani mɔɔta geen batɔ-mii anumi na batábɔku Hewiƒuɔ ku Kanaanƒuɔ ku Hetiƒuɔ ɔlɛku bina ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But I won't do all this in the first year, because the land would become poor, and wild animals would be everywhere.
translation_verse: Na lɛɛɛdubo ɔmɛni bɔbla na lɛkwa linwi kemmo si ɔɔɔdi lɛni kalɔ kammɔ kadubo bɔsɔ buwi ukpludi na beƒiebuo bemomo-ka kemmo bavili.

english_verse: Instead, I will force out your enemies little by little and give your nation time to grow strong enough to take over the land.
translation_verse: Mmomu ndubo-ma butaabɔku blii blii úti útédu ka bímomo bɛ́ƒɔ kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will see that your borders reach from the Red Sea to the Euphrates River and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert. I will let you defeat the people who live there, and you will force them out of the land.
translation_verse: “Na ndubo bɔya na bina lɛmii lise kalɔ lɛsiku Ɛpugyie kɔtu útédu Mediterenia Ɛpu kenye. Na ɔsɔ ɔsi ketele kemmo útédu Euƒrate Ketu kenye. Na ndubuti bekyuli bani nli kalɔ kammɔ kemmo lɛkya-mii enu kemmo, na bɛbɔku-ma bɛlɛku bina anumi.

english_verse: But you must not make any agreements with them or with their gods.
translation_verse: Na amii ku bekyuli bammɔ iye bana baƒiɔ ni, bitenyimi lɛla lɛdi bitete lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't let them stay in your land. They will trap you into sinning against me and worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Bitete kuƒi na bekyuli bammɔ belie-mii kudɔ, si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, badubo bɔya na bɛbla likpidi na mina anumi, ɔsika si bɛ́kpa bana baƒiɔ ni, ɔdubunwini kakpagyuɛ na kedie-mii.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up to me on this mountain. Bring along Aaron, as well as his two sons Nadab and Abihu, and
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Awɔ ku Aaron ku Nadab ku Abihu ku Israel benengu liti ku aavlanyɔ bammɔ bɛkɔ bibo kɔbi katɔ mɛni na bebenye kɔƒɛlɛ kesii kadi na bakpa-mi.

english_verse: but you are to come near. Don't let anyone else come up.”
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ Mose lɛti pɛ mɔɔní ede ami Unwoti kudɔ mɛni, ama batakpɛ betebo.”

english_verse: Then Moses wrote down what the Lord had said. The next morning Moses got up early. He built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up a large stone for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama Mose únweni Unwoti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛla biala úse. Mose ɔ́ta ɔtanta tutuutu na ɔ́tu lɛkpabi ɔ́lɛ kɔbi kɔmmɔ kaƒɔna, na úti atakpɛ leevu-anyɔ úse lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ kudɔ. Na lɛkpabi linwi biala linye lite Israel adua leevu-anyɔ ammɔ.

english_verse: He also sent some young men to burn offerings and to sacrifice bulls as special offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Mose ɔ́tala bakloƒu badi na bádu ɔmantɛ bakɔ bakɔdi badi bákyula bábla unwi bɔbla akpala béte Unwoti.

english_verse: Moses put half of the blood from the animals into bowls and sprinkled the rest on the altar.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose úle bebuo bammɔ ubugya kemmo inyɔ na úti kakɛ úwi lɛkyami kemmo. Na ɔ́kuna kakɛ kakladi lɛnɔ úwi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then he read aloud the Lord's commands and promises, and the people shouted, “We will obey the Lord and do everything he has commanded!”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ɔ́ka Unwoti Bunyimi Kedee Ɔku kemmo etemila úte bekyuli bammɔ. Amu na bekyuli bammɔ básu banii, “Bɔdubo lɛla biala na Unwoti ɔ́su-bu bɔbla bɔsiaku lɛni kani, na bunu-nwu litemi.”

english_verse: Moses took the blood from the bowls and sprinkled it on the people. Next, he told them, “With this blood the Lord makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Amu na Mose úti ubugya ɔni nwi lɛkyami kemmo mmɔ na ɔ́kuna uwi bekyuli bammɔ. Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɔmɛni ndi ubugya ɔni mɔɔbala bunyimi bɔni na Unwoti unyimiku-mii uwi ɔni na úti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ úte-mii.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with Nadab and Abihu and the
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ku Aaron ku Nadab ku Abihu ku Israel benengu liti ku aavlanyɔ bammɔ bésie kɔbi kɔmmɔ lili,

english_verse: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something that looked like a pavement made out of sapphire, and it was as bright as the sky.
translation_verse: na bánu Israelƒuɔ Katɔti. Na kesii kani na nwuna lɛgba lɛnya ni, use aani ulu ɔni na béti sika atabi ani baalɔ Saƒaya bákya bávi na uukeye aani kayaa.

english_verse: Even though these leaders of Israel saw God, he did not punish them. So they ate and drank. Moses on Mount Sinai
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti útabla Israel batɔnkune bamɛni lɛla lɛdi, mmomu bánu Katɔti, na bádi na báni.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up on the mountain and stay here for a while. I will give you the two flat stones on which I have written the laws that my people must obey.”
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Kɔ bo, na ebelie-mi kudɔ na kɔbi lili mɛni, na ndubo atabi ani lɛlɔ na línweni ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛ́sia buti bute-ɔ ka eti atina-ma.”

english_verse: Moses and Joshua his assistant got ready, then Moses started up the mountain to meet with God.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Mose ku nwuna ubunkune Yosua báyu ulu na Mose ɔ́kɔ úsie Katɔti kɔbi lili mmɔ.

english_verse: Moses had told the leaders, “Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur will be with you, and they can settle any arguments while we are away.”
translation_verse: Asa na Mose watɔlɔ ni, ɔ́su benengu bammɔ ɔnini, “Bɛsɔ bilie mɛni útédu ka búnwini búbo. Na si ɔdi ku ɔdi bakɛ litemi lɛdi ni, Aaron ku Hur bakya-mii kudɔ mɛni. Bebo kuƒi ka batɛ-ni bete-mii.”

english_verse: When Moses went up on Mount Sinai, a cloud covered it,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Mose ɔ́kɔ úsie Sinai kɔbi kɔmmɔ lili ni, liƒlukutu lɛ́ƒɔ kɔbi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: and the bright glory of the Lord came down and stayed there. The cloud covered the mountain for six days, and on the seventh day the Lord told Moses to come into the cloud.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti bukeye bonwu búbaƒɔ Sinai kɔbi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na emeyi aku sɔɔn na liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ lɛ́kya kɔbi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ. Na limeyi maatɛdi ni, Unwoti ɔ́kpali Mose ɔ́siku liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Tell everyone in Israel who wants to give gifts that they must bring them to you.
translation_verse: “Kɔ lɛsa te Israelƒuɔ na asu-ma na beti akpala beboku-mi. Na aƒɔ akpala ammɔ ɔdi biala kudɔ eboku-mi kalɛ na ɔ́si-nwu kayi kemmo kalɛ.

english_verse: Here is a list of what you are to collect: Gold, silver, and bronze;
translation_verse: Na akpala ani na adubo bɔƒɔ mmɔ ndi sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ku abuala egyiedi,

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices to mix with the incense and with the oil for dedicating the tent and ordaining the priests;
translation_verse: ku asogya nnɔmii, ku ugyulo ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni na baakya likpose nnɔmii kemmo ku oloƒui ƒɛƒɛɛ,

english_verse: and onyx stones and other gems for the sacred vest and the breastpiece.
translation_verse: ku sika atabi udu ɔdi na baalɔ onis ku ana lidu bamba ani na baamana ɔkpane lɛwuku ku lɛdiku lɛni muubi-nwu kayi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I also want them to build a special place where I can live among my people.
translation_verse: “Na aya na batu kevo kedee bete-mi na lilie-ma akɔ.

english_verse: The lamp on the top and those at the end of each of its six branches must be made so as to shine toward the front of the lampstand.
translation_verse: “Lɛ asogya maatɛ ɔmmɔ ligyii lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ kalɛ na liteekeye taatina kuƒi kɔni nwi úsie anumi kakɛ.

english_verse: Cover it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the lid.
translation_verse: Na beti sika ugyiedi kede kede banwamana bewi-nwu kama ku kemmo ƒui. Na beti sika ugyiedi babla aani lɛduni bamana libila lɛmmɔ atu.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Beti sika ugyiedi babla kɔkwɛnimi bakya adaka ɔmmɔ lɛgba ine bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔƒɛnyi ɔni ku ɔni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Make two poles of acacia wood. Cover them with gold
translation_verse: Na babwi akasia ligyii gyɔlɔɔ gyɔlɔɔ na bákwa-ni ku sika ugyiedi.

english_verse: and put them through the rings, so the chest can be carried by the poles.
translation_verse: Na béti ligyii lɛmmɔ bákya kɔkwɛnimi kɔmmɔ eƒi ammɔ kemmo na adaka ɔmmɔ ɔvi ɔni ku ɔni, kalɛ na ɔdia na bataagyu-nwu taasia amangba.

english_verse: Don't ever remove the poles from the rings.
translation_verse: Na ligyii lɛmmɔ litaakya adaka ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ lɛni kani batada betedie.

english_verse: Then hammer out two winged creatures of pure gold and fasten them to the lid at the ends of the chest.
translation_verse: Na unwi ɔlɛ ɔƒɛnyi unwi na ɔkladi lɛnɔ ɔlɛ ɔƒɛnyi ɔkladi lɛlɔ. Nwi libila lɛmmɔ ku Kerub bebweyi bammɔ danku lɛlɔ na ɔsala unwi na benye lɛƒɛnyi inyɔ bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Inside it place the two flat stones with the Ten Commandments on them and put the gold lid on top of the chest.
translation_verse: Ti ɔda bubo etemila ani na líte-ɔ na asia atabi ammɔ lɛlɔ kya adaka ɔmmɔ kemmo na eti libila lɛmmɔ ebi-nwu kenye.

english_verse: I will meet you there between the two creatures and tell you what my people must do and what they must not do. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: Na libila lɛmmɔ katɔ mmɔ kesii kani na bebweyi inyɔ bammɔ balɛ ntɛ ni, mmɔ na ndubo-ɔ butaasiaku na litemi lite-ɔ na asu Israelƒuɔ ɔda ɔni mebo-ma.

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: Kana ugyii aani lɛkɔkɔ bɔbɛbɛ mana-nwu atu ka mana aani lɛka na eti sika ugyiedi amana-nwu lɛlɔ amana lɛni kani.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Na abla kɔkwɛnimi ine ada ala kasiakɔ ekpo ene kesii kani na lɛgba lɛmmɔ linye mmɔ.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table are to be placed through these rings and are to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Ti akasia ligyii nwi ligyii lɛmmɔ na eti sika ugyiedi amana-ni lɛlɔ ƒui na beti bataagyu ala kasiakɔ kammɔ.

english_verse: The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered pure gold.
translation_verse: Na kesii kani mɔɔta mmɔ ku amangba kɔgba kɔmmɔ ɔlɛka ɔdanku lɛlɔ ɔbla ugyii unwi ku asogya ugyii ɔmmɔ, na ɔdi sika ugyiedi kede kede ƒui.

english_verse: The tongs and trays for taking care of the lamps are to be made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Asogya kɔbuli ku nnɔmii kewikɔ ku kabuli kammɔ linyenela ƒui ɔdi ka ɔbla sika ugyiedi kede kede.

english_verse: and they must be made according to the pattern I showed you on the mountain.
translation_verse: Sia anumi na anu ka bábla-nwu na udu ɔni na ánu na kɔbi lili mɛni kani lɛlɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, use a piece of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: “Na kevo kammɔ kayakun ni, ti unwo buluu ku ugyiedi ɔni náƒɔ kuye na udine údi bla kayakun kɔdi.

english_verse: As the material for protecting the tent, use goat hair to weave eleven sections of cloth
translation_verse: Na aduni ammɔ ƒui bune bɔbla unwi ɔni ndi lɛgba aavlene-ɛlɔ na bɔbɛbɛ bɔdi lɛgba ɛku.

english_verse: The top of the sacred tent must be made from ten pieces of the finest linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: “Biti aduni abuni kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ani náƒɔ kuye geen na bámii-nya ku kɔbuli buluu ku kugyiedi kɔni náƒɔ kuye na ukyuli ɔni ngyi budi geen údi Kerub bebweyi ɔ́kya-nya kemmo na biti bɛbla Adi Kevo kammɔ.

english_verse: and sew them together into two panels with five sections each.
translation_verse: Ya na baka aduni alɔ basala kakɛ kenwi na baka alɔ basala kakɛ kanyɔdi.

english_verse: The panel of goat hair will be a meter longer than the tent itself, so fold
translation_verse: Kevo aduni ammɔ adubo bune ɔgba bɔkɔku kakɛ butulo kevo kammɔ, na ɔmmɔ ɔdubo bɔyɔlɔ na kana lɛƒɛnyi lɛmmɔ kalɛ na utile kevo kammɔ.

english_verse: Sew five of the sections together to make one panel. Then sew the other six together to make a second panel, and fold the sixth section double over the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Ka aduni alɔ sala ɔvi unwi na aka aku asala ɔvi unyɔdi, na aƒɛ lɛduni lɛkundi asia ɔkpanadi lɛlɔ na kevo kammɔ kayakun kenye.

english_verse: Make two more coverings—one with tanned ram skins and the other with fine leather. The Framework for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Na awia baƒonu lɛku lɛni na békpeyi na bákya-ni kuvo na lígyie kaduɛ abla kevo kammɔ katɔ libila, asa na eti ketu bebuo benengudi lɛku ebi ɔmmɔ katɔ.

english_verse: Inside the most holy place, put the sacred chest that has the place of mercy on its lid.
translation_verse: Na eti likpidi bɔkyiɛ liboku libila lɛmmɔ asia Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na kesii kani nse kedee ketulo ƒui mmɔ.

english_verse: Build a framework of acacia wood for the walls of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: “Ti akasia kugyiikɛ sa eku eku gyi kevo kaduli ɔban.

english_verse: Place two silver stands under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so the frames can be joined together. Put
translation_verse: Na abla sika ɔƒualadi agbanvuo aavlene akya-ni kalɔ, na liku biala lɛda inyɔ.

english_verse: For the back wall along the west side use six frames
translation_verse: Na asa eku aku akya ɔƒɛ kanukɔ na kevo kaduli kammɔ kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. Make certain that these corner frames are joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: Na lɛkɔkɔ inyɔ lɛmɛni ni, sala ligyii lɛmmɔ inyɔ ɔ́si kalɔ útédu katɔ, na lɛgba inyɔ bɔmmɔ buduo ɔgbanvuo unwi kemmo. Na lɛkɔkɔ lɛkladi lɛnɔ lɛni kani.

english_verse: Altogether, this back wall will have eight frames with two silver stands under each one.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu eku ammɔ adubo bɔbla maane ku nina kalɔ sika ɔƒualadi agbanvuo leevu-ɛku ɔni na liku biala lɛda inyɔ.

english_verse: with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.
translation_verse: Na ɔtagyii ɔni na ntɛntɛ ɔlɛka une ɔsi ligyii lɛni nnye ntɛ mmɔ ɔvi unwi úsie ɔkladi.

english_verse: Cover the frames and the crossbars with gold and attach gold rings to the frames to run the crossbars through.
translation_verse: Na eti sika ugyiedi akwa ligyii lɛni nnye mmɔ lɛlɔ ƒui na eti sika ugyiedi kɔkwɛnimi ada lɛtagyii lɛmmɔ na akwa ani lɛnɔ ku sika ugyiedi.

english_verse: Then set up the tent in the way I showed you on the mountain. The Curtain inside the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: “Lɛ kevo kammɔ kalɛ kani na bédie bátina-a na kɔbi lɛlɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Outside the most holy place, as you face the curtain, put the table for the sacred bread on the right side and the gold lampstand on the left.
translation_verse: Na edie ala kasiakɔ kammɔ alɛ aduni ammɔ kama na kevo kammɔ kada kakɛ na eti asogya kasiakɔ kammɔ alɛ-nwu anumi na kada kakɛ mmɔ.

english_verse: Make a curtain to separate the holy place from the most holy place. Use fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. Cover four acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a silver stand. Then fasten gold hooks to the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Kɔdi kɔmmɔ kutaaƒa sika ugyiedi kɔkwɛnimi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ lɛni na eti Bunyimi Adaka ɔni kemmo na atabi anyɔ akya mmɔ ese kɔdi kɔmmɔ kama. Na kɔdi kɔmmɔ ndubule kakpakɔ kammɔ kedeedikɔ bɔsiku kesii kani nse kedee ketulo ƒui kudɔ.

english_verse: Cover five acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a bronze stand. Then put gold hooks on the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Na awia kɔkwɛnimi kɔbaladi kɔni ndubo kayakun kɔdi kammɔ butaada, ku akasia ligyii ɛlɔ lɛni bákwa ku sika ugyiedi na eti abuala egyiedi abla agbanvuo ete-ni.

english_verse: Cover two acacia wood poles with bronze and put them through the rings for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Na eti ligyii lɛmmɔ akya kɔkwɛnimi kɔmmɔ kemmo na lɛkya lɛƒɛnyi lɛmmɔ si bágyu béti.

english_verse: All the equipment for the altar must also be made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the sprinkling bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans.
translation_verse: Na eti abuala egyiedi avɔ oloƒui bɔkyula lɛlɔ ala aani ntɔ kewikɔ ebui ku ogya budie kalɛkɛ ku soƒi ku oloƒui uyɔ bubo lɛkyami ku kɔbwɛlɛmii kɔni mɔɔda agyabi ku ɔni baatu lɛna ƒui.

english_verse: Construct the altar in the shape of an open box, just as you were shown on the mountain. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Bo kugyiikɛ kɔmmɔ danku lɛlɔ mana bla adaka ɔmmɔ na katɔ ku kalɔ keteewi. Na abla-nwu asiaku kalɛ na lídie lɛ́tina-a na kɔbi lɛlɔ mɛni kani. Adi Kevo Kaduli

english_verse: Command the people of Israel to supply you with the purest olive oil. Do this so the lamp will keep burning
translation_verse: “Su Israelƒuɔ na beboku nnɔ bɔni na bédie básiku nnɔ egyii kemmo na buse kede kede ute asogya ɔmmɔ kalɛ na utaada uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: for the west. Then hang a curtain of fine linen on the posts along each of these three sides by using silver hooks and rods. Place three bronze posts on each side of the entrance at the east and hang a curtain
translation_verse: Na aduni ammɔ adubo bɔƒa ligyii aavlanyɔ lɛlɔ na abuala egyiedi ɔka ɔkya-ni kalɔ na kɔkwɛnimi kɔni ndubo aduni ammɔ bɔbala kɔbla sika ɔƒualadi na sika ɔƒualadi aduni wɛlɛ wɛlɛ adubo bɔka bɔmana ligyii lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Use four more of these posts for the entrance way, then hang on them an embroidered curtain of fine linen nine meters long and woven with blue, purple, and red wool.
translation_verse: “Na kaduli kammɔ kayakun ni, ya na udine uti aduni buluu ku egyiedi ani náƒɔ kuye na udi-nya kaduɛ bune lɛgba avlaatɛ na eti aƒala ligyii ine bɔni na adubo buti bunyene ɔka ine lɛlɔ na mmɔ.

english_verse: Make the rest of the equipment for the sacred tent of bronze, including the pegs for the tent and for the curtain surrounding the courtyard. The Oil for the Lamp in the Holy Place (Leviticus
translation_verse: Na kevo kammɔ lɛlɔ ala bamba biala ku ewele ani nda kevo kammɔ ku kaduli kammɔ lɛlɔ ala ƒui abla abuala egyiedi sɔɔn. Asogya Ugyii Lɛlɔ Nnɔ

english_verse: in front of the curtain that separates the holy place from the most holy place, where the sacred chest is kept. Aaron and his sons are responsible for keeping the lamp burning every night in the sacred tent. The Israelites must always obey this command.
translation_verse: Na beti asogya ɔmmɔ balɛ Adi Kevo kemmo kesii kani na mɔɔsiáku-mii mmɔ ku aduni ani nƒa mmɔ anumi asa na adubuduo adaka ɔmmɔ kudɔ. Na Aaron ku nwuna bebi banu ka lɛsogya lɛmmɔ ƒui lɛɛda na Unwoti anumi mmɔ ɔ́si useyi uwi útálɛ kadi bugye. Ɔmɛni ɔdi bunyimi bɔni na Israelƒuɔ ɔdi ka bese likpo na bataadi-mu lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi.”

english_verse: Send for your brother Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. They are the ones I have chosen from Israel to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Ƒ'ɔnwani Aaron ku nwuna bebi bani ndi Nadab ku Abihu ku Eleasar ku Itamar ni, lɔ-ma lɛku Israelƒuɔ bammɔ akɔ na bebo-ɔ kudɔ. Ɔsika ama ndi bekyuli bani na lɛ́ƒuna lɛ́lɛku Israelƒuɔ akɔ ka babla mina bakpane.

english_verse: Aaron is to be dedicated as my high priest, and his clothes must be made only by persons who possess skills that I have given them.
translation_verse: Su lɛwu bakane babuni bani na líte-ma lɛnunda ka bakana awu ɔmmɔ udu bɔka kani na baka awu ɔmmɔ bete Aaron kalɛ na bedie-nwu bese sɛsɛɛ bete ka ɔbla ɔkpane kabla ute-mi.

english_verse: Here are the items that need to be made: a breastpiece, a priestly vest, a robe, an embroidered shirt, a turban, and a sash. These sacred clothes are to be made for your brother Aaron and his sons who will be my priests.
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na ɔ́lɛka báka lɛwu lɛmmɔ bavinku ndi ka baka kayi lɛbalala lɛdiku ku bakpane awu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ kedee ku awu ɔtɔdi akɔnkɔ bune ku awu gyɔlɔɔ ku lili dukuu ku kavobi lɛduni. Na si baaka lɛwu lɛmɛni bete ƒ'ɔnwani Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi ka babla-mi kabla aani bakpane kalɛ ni,

english_verse: Use only gold and fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool, for making these clothes. The Vest for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: na biti adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ku linwo lidu lɛni mɔɔdia bɔnu na lígyie na lise buluu na lɛ́ƒɔ kuye geen bɛka lɛwu lɛmmɔ na beti sika ugyiedi bakya-ni bɔdia. Ɔkpane Awu Kpɛtɛ Kpɛtɛ Kedee

english_verse: and engrave on each of them the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka atabi ammɔ abla leevu-inyɔ na enye ete Israel bebi leevu-inyɔ bammɔ anyi kenye. Na atabi ammɔ adubɔbla aani ekposela atabi, na adubɔnwi bana anyi asia unwi unwi.

english_verse: From the same costly material make a breastpiece for the high priest to use in finding out what I want my people to do.
translation_verse: “Sia bedine babuni lɛlɔ na abla litemi siin bɔtɛ kayi lɛbalala lɛdiku aani bakpane awu kedee ɔmmɔ kalɛ. Na eti kɔdi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ku linwo buluu ku ligyiedi lɛni náƒɔ kuye geen edi-ku na akya-ku bɔdia ku sika ugyiedi.

english_verse: with four rows of three precious stones: In the first row put a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;
translation_verse: Na eti atabi ani náƒɔ kuye aka amana lɛdiku lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na lɛgaala ine kemmo. Na ɔgaala udeedi kemmo ni, kya atabi ani baalɔ sardis ku topas ku beril.

english_verse: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
translation_verse: Na ɔgaala unyɔdi kemmo ni, kya atabi ani baalɔ banii torkis ku sapir ku smardo.

english_verse: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
translation_verse: Na ɔgaala ɔtɛdi kemmo ni, kya atabi ani baalɔ yiakint ku agate ku ametist.

english_verse: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount the stones in delicate gold settings
translation_verse: Na ɔgaala unedi kemmo ni, kya atabi ani baalɔ krisolit ku oniks ku yaspa. Na edie eƒi na sika ugyiedi asɛɛ ebi kemmo, na eti atabi ammɔ akya-nya kemmo unwi unwi, asa na aka amana lɛdiku lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Attach two gold rings to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fasten them with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: Na kuna eli anyɔ akladi ni, ti-nya bo da awu kedee ɔmmɔ amangba kesii kani na sika ugyiedi ɔ́bala atabi ammɔ.

english_verse: Then take a blue cord and tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. This will keep the breastpiece in place.
translation_verse: Unwo buluu kadii na badubo lɛdiku lɛmmɔ kɔkwɛnimii bɔbala butádanku awu kedee ɔmmɔ kɔkwɛnimii lɛlɔ. Na kadii kammɔ kadubɔsia awu ɔmmɔ kavobi lɛduni lɛni bédi bákya-ni bɔdia mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Under his vest Aaron must wear a robe of blue wool
translation_verse: “Na awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔni lɛlɔ na bakpane awu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ kedee ɔmmɔ ɔɔsia ni, ɔlɛka ɔdi kɔdi buluu.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for his head. Be sure to bind the material around the collar to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: Na edie liƒi kesii kani na lili lɛɛví na kɔdi kɔmmɔ ntɛntɛ na edie liƒi lɛmmɔ bekpo atu kalɛ na uleyile bɔbwɛ.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe weave pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a gold bell between each of them.
translation_verse: Na egyiibi ammɔ ku sika ugyiedi lɛdɔn lɛmmɔ litaavumanaku lɛlɔ ɔmana awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔmmɔ atu.

english_verse: If Aaron wears these clothes when he enters the holy place as my high priest, the sound of the bells will be heard, and his life will not be in danger.
translation_verse: Na si Aaron ɔ́kya lɛwu lɛmmɔ na úduo kesii kani nse kedee mmɔ ni, lɛdɔn lɛmmɔ lɛdubo buteebo. Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na nwuna ngba buleduo ɔgbankpi kemmo.

english_verse: On a narrow strip of pure gold engrave the words: “Dedicated to the Lord.”
translation_verse: “Na eti sika ugyiedi na abla kalɛkɛ blii kadi na anwi-nwu kemmo enweni asia anii, ‘Ɔmɛni use sɛsɛɛ ute Unwoti.’

english_verse: Fasten it to the front of Aaron's turban with a blue cord,
translation_verse: Na eti kadii buluu ada-nwu lɛlɔ adanku dukuu kabwa kammɔ lɛlɔ na anumi kakɛ.

english_verse: so he can wear it on his forehead. This will show that he will take on himself the guilt for any sins the people of Israel commit in offering their gifts to me, and I will forgive them.
translation_verse: Kalɛkɛ kammɔ kadubɔma Aaron lɛtɛntɛ kalɛ na ɔƒɔ Israelƒuɔ likpidi biala na bábla na kakpakɔ mmɔ ɔsia lɛlɔ si bébo baabla akpala bete-mi.

english_verse: Since Aaron's sons are priests, they should also look dignified. So make robes, sashes, and special caps for them.
translation_verse: “Na Aaron bebi lɛnɔ ni, ɔlɛka abla lɛwu lɛtɔdi akɔnkɔ bune ku kavobi aduni ku atɛntɛ aduni ani mɔɔdia bɔnu na eekeye ete-ma.

english_verse: Then dress Aaron and his sons in these clothes, pour olive oil on their heads, and ordain them as my priests.
translation_verse: Na adubuti lɛwu lɛmmɔ akya ƒ'ɔnwani Aaron ku nwuna bebi na ewi-ma lili nnɔmii ese-ma likpo na edie-ma ese sɛsɛɛ na babla-mi kabla aani mina bakpane.

english_verse: Make linen shorts for them that reach from the waist down to the thigh, so they won't expose themselves.
translation_verse: “Na eti unwo ɔbunidi na edi lɛwu gyɔlɔɔ kalɔ lɛwuku lɛni nási bana kavobi útédu bana ebuli ete-ma na bana ɔlɔna kesii kadi katatina.

english_verse: Whenever they enter the sacred tent or serve at the altar or enter the holy place, they must wear these shorts, or else they will be guilty and die. This same rule applies to any of their descendants who serve as priests.
translation_verse: Na uwi biala na beeduo Adi Kevo kammɔ kemmo iye bébo bababla ɔkpane kabla na mina lɛkpabi kudɔ ni, na baláni lɛtuni beleboku lɛlɔ na ɔdi wekpi. “Na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni bɔdubuse bute anwu ku nwuna kaba bebi úsela uwi ƒui.”

english_verse: Each day you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for sin and as a way of purifying the altar. In addition, you must smear the altar with olive oil to make it completely holy.
translation_verse: Na limeyi biala ɔlɛka adu ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani unwi na eti abla alaekpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala. Na ɔmɛni ndubɔya na mina lɛkpabi lɛbla kedee. Na asɔ akuna likpose nnɔmii ewi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na lɛbla kedee lɛwɔlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Then from your finest flour make three batches of dough without yeast. Shape some of it into larger loaves, some into smaller loaves mixed with olive oil, and the rest into thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Na eti edula ebi ɔlaaƒɔ buni ɔni na bɔnyii buuubo-nwu kemmo, na abla bodobodo unengudi ku ubliidi na asala-nwu ku nnɔ ku bodobodo bɛɛbɛɛ na esusu-nwu nnɔ.

english_verse: Put all of this bread in a basket and bring it when you come to sacrifice the three animals to me.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na adubo ebeti bebuo bammɔ akpa ete-mi ni, na ala bodobodo ɔmmɔ ƒui ewi kagyigyɛ kemmo na eti ada.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the sacred tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Na akpanku Aaron ku nwuna bebi eboku Adi Kevo kammɔ kayakun kenye na abla-ma ntu bɔkpila ɔdi.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly shirt, the robe that goes under the sacred vest, the vest itself, the breastpiece, and the sash.
translation_verse: Na adubuti bakpane lɛwu lɛmmɔ akya Aaron awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔmmɔ ku ɔtɔdi akɔnkɔ bune ku bakpane awu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ kedee ɔmmɔ ku kayi lɛbalala lɛdiku ku kavobi lɛduni buni lɛni bédi kaduɛ mmɔ.

english_verse: and then ordain him by pouring olive oil on his head.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama na eti likpose nnɔmii bɔmmɔ ewi-nwu lili na ese-nwu likpo.

english_verse: Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Na akpanku ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani ɔmmɔ esienku Adi Kevo kammɔ kayakun. Na aya na Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi beti bana enu basia ebuo ɔmmɔ kuli.

english_verse: Kill the bull near my altar in front of the tent.
translation_verse: Na adu ebuo ɔmmɔ na mina lɛkpabi lɛni nlɛ mina Adi Kevo kammɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: Use a finger to smear some of its blood on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest of the blood on the ground next to the altar.
translation_verse: Na eti lɛnimi akya ubugya ɔmmɔ kemmo na eti esusu bebuo ese ani nlɛ lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na ewilimi ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔkladi ewi kalɔ na lɛkpabi lɛni kudɔ bɛ́du ebuo ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: But the meat, the skin, and the food still in the bull's stomach must be burned outside the camp as an offering to ask forgiveness for the sins of the priests.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani ɔmmɔ ɔku ɔni bédie-nwu ku lɛna lɛmmɔ ku ala ani béwilimi-nwu kaƒɔ kemmo ƒui ni, béti-nya bátákyula na keyi na bana keliekɔ kammɔ kama beti bevele likpidi buti taakyiɛ.

english_verse: Bring one of the rams to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Na akpanku koƒonu kɔgyani kunwi eboku na Aaron ku bebi beti enu basia-ku kuli.

english_verse: Kill the ram and splatter its blood against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na adu koƒonu kɔmmɔ na akuna ubugya ɔmmɔ ewi lɛkpabi ekpo ene ammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Cut up the ram, wash its insides and legs, and lay all of its parts on the altar, including the head.
translation_verse: Na ekulo-ku na aƒɔ kuna aƒɔla ku lɛgba na eti ebuo ɔmmɔ ƒui ku nwuna lili asia lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then make sure that the whole animal goes up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na akyula koƒonu kɔmmɔ ƒui na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔdubɔbla akpala bɔkyula ƒui uyɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ami Unwoti kaƒɔ.

english_verse: Bring the other ram to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Na akpanku koƒonu kɔgyani kɔkladi eboku na Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi beti enu basia-ku lili.

english_verse: Kill the ram and place some of its blood on Aaron's right ear lobe, his right thumb, and the big toe of his right foot. Do the same for each of his sons and splatter the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na adu ebuo ɔmmɔ. Na eti ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔdi esusu Aaron kɔdianu kɔtu kawɔlɔkɔ ku nwuna kɔdianu kɔnu ku ɔgba animigya. Na abla lɛni kani ete nwuna bebi lɛnɔ. Na akuna ubugya ewi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ekpo ene ammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Then take some of the blood from the altar, mix it with the oil used for ordination, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his clothes, and also on his sons and their clothes. This will show that they and their clothes have been dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Na eti ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔdi na eti nnɔmii bɔni na eti éwi Aaron lili mmɔ ɔdi ewi ubugya ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na akuna ewi Aaron ku lɛwu lɛni na ɔkya mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na asɔ akuna ɔdi ewi nwuna bebi ku bana lɛwu lɛlɔ. Na ɔmɛni ndubɔtina ka bése-ma bakpane bete-mi.

english_verse: This ram is part of the ordination service. So remove its right hind leg, its fat tail, the fat on its insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: “Koƒonu kɔmɛni kubunku bakpane buse kabla kammɔ kadi. Anwuɔsu ti lɛmwi lɛni nkya ebuo ɔmmɔ ɔka kakɛ ku kaƒɔ kemmo ku akɔ ammɔ kawɔlɔkɔ kakɛ ku nwuna akabi anyɔ ku kuna kɔdianu libuli lɛmmɔ se sɛsɛɛ.

english_verse: Take one loaf of each kind of bread from the basket,
translation_verse: Na edie bodobodo ɔni kemmo na bɔnyii buuubo-nwu kemmo na use Unwoti anumi mmɔ. Die unengudi ku ubliidi ku ɔni nse bɛɛbɛɛ.

english_verse: and put this bread, together with the meat, into the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then they will lift it all up to show that it is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Na eti bodobodo ɔmmɔ ku lɛna lɛmmɔ akya Aaron ku bebi enu kemmo na bakɔliku-nya katɔ batina-mi bebo akpala ammɔ kudu.

english_verse: After this, put the meat and bread on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama na aƒɔ akpala ammɔ asiku bana enu kemmo akyula na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ete-mi, na nwuna uyɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔdubɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ.

english_verse: You may eat the choice ribs from this second ram, but you must first lift them up to show that this meat is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́wawa lɛna linyɔdi lɛmɛni bíte Aaron ɔkpane buse kabla ni, bɛkɔliku kayi lɛna lɛmmɔ katɔ bɛtina-mi na bibo akpala ammɔ kudu. Na ɔmmɔ kama lɛna lɛmmɔ lɛdubunwini ƒula kadikɔ.

english_verse: After Aaron's death, his priestly clothes are to be handed down to each descendant who succeeds him as high priest, and these clothes must be worn during the seven-day ceremony of ordination.
translation_verse: Na si Aaron úkpi ni, ɔlɛka beti nwuna ɔkpane lɛwu bete nwuna bebi bani mɔɔdi nwuna ala aani ɔkpane unegudi kalɛ. Na ɔlɛka ala ɔdine ɔmmɔ ɔkya lɛwu lɛmmɔ emeyi maatɛ ani kemmo na beesé-nwu ɔkpane mmɔ.

english_verse: Boil the meat of the ordination ram in a sacred place,
translation_verse: “Ebuo ɔni bɛ́du bíte bakpane bammɔ buse ni, biƒulo-nwu na Adi Kevo kayakun kenye mmɔ.

english_verse: then Aaron and his sons are to eat it together with the three kinds of bread at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na aya na Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi beti bodobodo lidu ɛtɛ lɛmmɔ na badi ku lɛna lɛmmɔ na mina kevo kayakun kenye.

english_verse: At their ordination, a ceremony of forgiveness was performed for them with this sacred food, and only they have the right to eat it.
translation_verse: Na Aaron ku bebi bananabi lɛti badi adila kedee ammɔ. Na beti babla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie lɛkpa limeyi bɔdi. Na taya na ukyuli ɔdi ɔdi adila ammɔ adi ubunku-ma.

english_verse: If any of the sacred food is left until morning, it must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Na si adila kedee ammɔ ébu úti útédu lɛdigye ni, na bakyula-nya.

english_verse: Repeat this ordination ceremony for Aaron and his sons seven days in a row, just as I have instructed you.
translation_verse: “Na eti emeyi maatɛ ese Aaron ku bebi mina bakpane aani kalɛ kani libo-ɔ ɔda pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Do this for seven days, and the altar will become so holy that anyone who touches it will become holy. Daily Sacrifices (Leviticus
translation_verse: Na abla ala amɛni asia kama emeyi maatɛ. Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛbla kedee. Na si ukyuli ɔdi útuku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔdubɔbla kedee.” Lɛkpa Lɛni Ɔlɛka Abla Limeyi Ndi Limeyi

english_verse: Each day you must sacrifice two lambs a year old,
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Limeyi ndi limeyi ɔlɛka adu baƒonu bagyani inyɔ bani nákɛ lɛkwa linwi.

english_verse: one in the morning and one in the evening.
translation_verse: Na adu unwi ɔtanta na adu unwi useyi uwi.

english_verse: With each lamb offer one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of pure olive oil, and also pour out a liter of wine as an offering. The smell of this sacrifice on the fires of the altar will be pleasing to me.
translation_verse: Na adu kunyɔdi useyi uwi na ebunku ɔlaaƒɔ ku ntɛ aani ɔtanta ɔdi kalɛ kani na ɔbla ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ akpala bɔkyula ute ami Unwoti.

english_verse: Because of who I am, the tent will become sacred, and Aaron and his sons will become worthy to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: “Na ndubo kevo kammɔ ku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ budie buse sɛsɛɛ bute ami Unwoti na lidie Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi lɛnɔ lise sɛsɛɛ na benwini bakpane bataabla-mi kabla.

english_verse: I will live among you as your God,
translation_verse: Na ami Unwoti ndubɔkya-mii akɔ aani bina Katɔti kalɛ.

english_verse: and you will know that I am the Lord your God, the one who rescued you from Egypt, so that I could live among you.
translation_verse: Na mmɔ na bɛdubɔnu bɔti ka ami ɔni ndi bina Katɔti nédie-mii lɛ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: It is truly holy because it is dedicated to me, so don't ever make any for yourselves.
translation_verse: Na sɔsɔ use kedee ute ami Unwoti. Tasu anii aabla ɔdi ese ete lɛlɔ kudii.

english_verse: Mix four liters of olive oil with the following costly spices: six kilograms of myrrh, three kilograms of cinnamon, three kilograms of cane, and six kilograms of cassia. Measure these according to the official standards. Then use this sacred mixture
translation_verse: “Wia nnɔmii bɔni nse kede kede lɛkyami linwi ku ala ani muunwenyi ƒɛƒɛɛ te ukyuli ɔni ngyi bɔsala kabla kaduɛ, na uti mira ɔɔƒɛɛ unwi ku sinamon ɔɔƒɛɛ kakɛ ku kalamus ɔɔƒɛɛ kakɛ ku kasia ɔɔƒɛɛ unwi ɔsala-mu. Nnɔmii bɔmɛni bɔdubɔbla likposela nnɔmii sɛsɛɛ.

english_verse: the altar for sacrifices, and the large bowl with its stand.
translation_verse: ku bebuo bɔkyula lɛkpabi ku nwuna lɛlɔ ala, ku ntu lɛkyami ku nwuna ɔka ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Build an altar of acacia wood where you can burn incense.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Ti akasia kugyii na eti abla oloƒui bɔkyula lɛbi ete-mi.

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it.
translation_verse: Na eti sika ugyiedi akwaa ligyii lɛmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ ku nwuna katɔ. Na eti sika ugyiedi ada-nwu atu amana aani ɔmii.

english_verse: Then below the edging on opposite sides attach two gold rings through which you can put the poles for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Na eti sika ugyiedi abla kɔkwɛnimii inyɔ ada-nwu atu anyɔ na kada kakɛ blii ku kakɛ kanyɔdi lɛnɔ. Na ɔdubɔdia na beti ligyii lɛdi bavinku-nwu kemmo, na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛdia butaagyu.

english_verse: These poles are also to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Na ligyii lɛni ndubɔvi kɔkwɛnimii kɔmmɔ kemmo lɛnɔ ni, kwaa ku sika ugyiedi.

english_verse: Put the altar in front of the inside curtain of the sacred tent. The chest with the place of mercy is kept behind that curtain, and I will talk with you there.
translation_verse: Ti lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛ kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔni néle kevo kammɔ kemmo mmɔ anumi kakɛ mɛni. Na Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ ɔlɛ kakpakɔ bule kɔdi lɛmmɔ kama ku nwuna likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie libila kesii kani na ndubo-mii butaasiaku mmɔ.

english_verse: Burn only the proper incense on the altar and never use it for grain sacrifices or animal sacrifices or drink offerings.
translation_verse: Na bɛnu ka bɛ́kyula oloƒui ɔni muunwenyi ƒɛƒɛɛ kani. Na biteti oloƒui ɔmmɔ ɔdi bitabla edula ebi iye ebuo iye ntɛ akpala.

english_verse: Once a year Aaron must purify the altar by smearing on its four corners the blood of an animal sacrificed for sin, and this practice must always be followed. The altar is sacred because it is dedicated to me. The Money for the Sacred Tent
translation_verse: Na kunwi na lɛkwa kemmo ni, Aaron ɔdu ebuo ɔbla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala ɔdi na kesii kani na ese ammɔ alɛ. Na ebuo ɔni na badubo bɔdu mmɔ ubugya na badubuti babla buvele ɔdi ɔmɛni bete kaba bekyuli bani mebo ƒui. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdi akpala ani nse kedee ƒui ute ami Unwoti.” Kakpakɔ Egulabi Bute

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔsu Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: Find out how many grown men there are in Israel and require each of them to pay me to keep him safe from danger while you are counting them.
translation_verse: “Ka bananabi bani náalɛ lili na Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ na aya ɔdi biala ɔƒɔ kayu kadi ute-mi. Kalɛ na ɔgbankpi ɔdi ulásiaku bana ɔdi na bekyuli bɔka bɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: This money is to be used for the upkeep of the sacred tent, and because of it, I will never forget my people. The Large Bronze Bowl (Exodus
translation_verse: Ƒɔ ekpidi lili buvele egulabi ammɔ na eti ataabla kakpakɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ala. Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na Israelƒuɔ beteenyimo ka ami Unwoti ndubɔƒɔ bana ekpidi lili kayu si bébo-mi kudɔ.” Lɛkyami Lɛni Kemmo Baaƒɔ Kɔnu

english_verse: If you ever make any of it to use as perfume, you will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi ɔ́bla ɔdi ɔ́kyula ute lɛlɔ ni, ndubo-nwu bɔda budie mina bekyuli akɔ.”

english_verse: Make a large bronze bowl and a bronze stand for it. Then put them between the altar for sacrifice and the sacred tent, so the priests can wash their hands and feet before entering the tent or offering a sacrifice on the altar. Each priest in every generation must wash himself in this way, or else he will die right there. The Oil for Dedication and Ordination (Exodus
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Wia abuala egyiedi na abla lɛkyami lɛdi ku nwuna ɔka. Na eti lɛkyami lɛmmɔ alɛ lɛkpabi ku kevo kammɔ ntɛ. Mmɔ na bakpane bammɔ badubɔƒɔ bana enu ku lɛgba asa babla akpala na mina lɛkpabi lɛlɔ iye beduo kevo kammɔ kemmo. Na si ɔdi úni ɔmmɔ ni, ɔdubo bukpi. Na ɔmɛni ndi bunyimi ute Aaron ku nwuna bebi úsela uwi ƒui.” Likpose Nnɔmii

english_verse: By dedicating them in this way, you will make them so holy that anyone who even touches them will become holy.
translation_verse: Na si ábla ala amɛni ƒui lɛni ni, ɔdubɔya na ala ammɔ ƒui abla kedee. Na si ukyuli ɔdi úti kɔnu útuku-nya muedi ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔdubɔbla kedee.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: for dedicating the tent and chest,
translation_verse: Na adubo-mu buti esusu Adi Kevo kammɔ ku Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: the table with its equipment, the lampstand with its equipment, the incense altar with all its utensils,
translation_verse: Na nnɔmii bɔmmɔ kani na adubuti esusu ala kasiakɔ ku ala ani nlɛ-nwu lɛlɔ, ku asogya kasiakɔ ku ala ani ndaku-nwu, ku oloƒui bɔkyula lɛbi ku akyami ani ndaku-nwu,

english_verse: When you ordain Aaron and his sons as my priests, sprinkle them with some of this oil,
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Uwi ɔni na eesé Aaron ku bebi mina bakpane ni, na ewi-ma nnɔmii bɔmmɔ bɔdi lili.

english_verse: So treat it as holy! Don't ever use it for everyday purposes or mix any for yourselves.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bada-mu aani lɛla lɛni nse kedee. Na ɔdi uteti-nwu utaabla limeyi ndi limeyi kabla. Iye ɔdi utaƒɛ bɔdi utasala nwuna nnɔmii bɔni na ɔɔwɛɛ kemmo kudii.

english_verse: If you do, you will no longer belong to the Lord's people.” The Sweet-Smelling Incense
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi ɔ́bla-mu lɛlɔ kabla na ɔɔɔdi ɔkpane ni, ndubo-nwu bɔda budie mina bekyuli akɔ.’ ” Oloƒui

english_verse: Mix equal amounts of the costly spices stacte, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense, then add salt to make the mixture pure and holy.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Wia ala ani muunwenyi ƒɛƒɛɛ na abla oloƒui. Ti mira ku klobo ku onika ku galbanum te ukyuli ɔni ngyi-nwu kabla kaduɛ, na ubunku mma uti ɔbla oloƒui sɛsɛɛ kedee ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Pound some of it into powder and sprinkle it in front of the sacred chest, where I meet with you. Be sure to treat this incense as something very holy.
translation_verse: Na awɔ ala ammɔ adi abla ɔlaaƒɔ na akuna ɔlaaƒɔ ɔmmɔ ewi Unwoti unyimi adaka ɔmmɔ anumi, kesii kani munye taatɛmiku-mii. Oloƒui ɔmɛni ɔbla lɛla lɛni nse kedee utulo ƒui ute-mii.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: I have chosen Bezalel from the Judah tribe to make the sacred tent and its furnishings.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́ƒuna Besaleel ɔni ndi Uri ubidi na ɔdi Hur uwɔ. Na ɔ́si Yuda kaba kemmo ka udi Adi Kevo ku ala ani ɔlɛka banwi bakya ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Not only have I filled him with my Spirit, but I have given him wisdom and made him a skilled craftsman who can create objects of art with gold, silver, bronze, precious stones, and wood.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́ya na mina kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui na líte-nwu lɛnunda ku lɛlati bonwu lɛni na ɔkana uti sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ku abuala egyiedi ɔvɔ ala lidu lidu. Na uti kugyii lɛnɔ ɔnwi ala lidu lidu.

english_verse: I have appointed Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to work with him, and I have also given skills to those who will help them make everything exactly as I have commanded you:
translation_verse: Na lɛ́ƒuna Oholiab ɔni nási Dan kaba kemmo lɛnɔ ka uteete-nwu kebunku. Na líti lɛnunda ku lɛlati lɛ́kya bekyuli bamba bani ndubɔbla lɛla biala aani kalɛ na líbo-ɔ ɔda.

english_verse: Moses told the Israelites that the Lord had said: The Sabbath belongs to me. Now I command you and your descendants to always obey the laws of the Sabbath. By doing this, you will know that I have chosen you as my own.
translation_verse: “Su Israelƒuɔ anii, ‘Bɛdi lɛnwunameyi lɛni ndi mina limeyi lɛlɔ. Ɔsika limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdi likposela lite ami Unwoti ku amii Israelƒuɔ ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui. Na ɔmɛni ndubɔtina ka ami Unwoti náƒuna-mii lɛ́bla mina bekyuli.

english_verse: Keep the Sabbath holy. You have six days to do your work, but the Sabbath is mine, and it must remain a day of rest. If you work on the Sabbath, you will no longer be part of my people, and you will be put to death.
translation_verse: Su-ma anii beti emeyi aku babla kabla bete lɛlɔ, nsu limeyi maatɛdi lɛdi lɛnwunameyi lɛni lídie líse líte lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli ɔni mabla kabla kadi limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔlɛka badu-nwu.

english_verse: Every generation of Israelites must respect the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Na Israelƒuɔ ɔlɛka basia limeyi lɛmɛni anu na bataadi-ni aani bunyimi bɔni nse nte uwi ƒui.

english_verse: This day will always serve as a reminder, both to me and to the Israelites, that I made the heavens and the earth in six days, then on the seventh day I rested and relaxed.
translation_verse: Na bunyimi bɔmɛni bɔdi bunyimi bɔni ndubɔkya ami ku Israelƒuɔ ƒui ntɛ ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui. Ɔsika ami Unwoti líti emeyi aku lídie katɔ ku kalɔ. Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛlɔ ni, lɛ́da kabla lɛ́ya na lɛ́nwuna.”

english_verse: When God had finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two flat stones on which he had written all his laws with his own hand.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́tɛmi-ku Mose ɔ́wɔlɔ na Sinai kɔbi lɛlɔ ni, úti nwuna bunyimi kɔlɛkɛ kɔni na Katɔti ɔlatidi únweni ɔda bubo ɔ́sia úte-nwu.

english_verse: Moses, I have seen how stubborn these people are,
translation_verse: “Na ami Unwoti ngyi kalɛ na bekyuli bamɛni bese.

english_verse: The people got up early the next morning and killed some animals to be used for sacrifices and others to be eaten. Then everyone ate and drank so much that they began to carry on like wild people.
translation_verse: Na nwuna lɛdigye uwi ni, béti bebuo badi na béti bábla bɔkyula akpala na badi lɛnɔ bábla unwi bɔbla akpala. Mmɔ na bekyuli bamɛni bése kalɔ baadi na baaní ntɛ teekpi na baabla lɛyalɛ ala.

english_verse: Moses said to them, “You obeyed the Lord and did what was right, and so you will serve as his priests for the people of Israel. It was hard for you to kill your own sons and brothers, but the Lord has blessed you and made you his priests today.”
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ɔ́su Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ ɔnini, “Ɔmwi kadi ni, bɛ́bla lɛlɔ sɛɛn aani bakpane na bíte Unwoti ɔkɛnku kalɛ na bɛ́du bina bebi ku banwani ɔsu.”

english_verse: After the people saw that Moses had been on the mountain for a long time, they went to Aaron and said, “Make us an image of a god who will lead and protect us. Moses brought us out of Egypt, but nobody knows what has happened to him.”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Israelƒuɔ bammɔ bánu ka Mose úsie ɔkya kɔbi lili na ulébo ni, bekyuli bammɔ básala lɛlɔ lisu na bésie Aaron kudɔ na bátásu-nwu banini, “Bɔɔɔgyi lɛla lɛni nálɛku Mose ɔni nákpanku-bu ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu bla unwoti ɔdi te-bu na ɔkpanku-bu.”

english_verse: Aaron told them, “Bring me the gold earrings that your wives and sons and daughters are wearing.”
translation_verse: Amu na Aaron ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bidie sika ugyiedi asɛɛ ani na bina bebi bananabi ku belekubi ku bina beleku bakya biboku-mi.”

english_verse: then he melted them and made an idol in the shape of a young bull. All the people said to one another, “This is the god who brought us out of Egypt!”
translation_verse: Na Aaron lɛnɔ úti sika ugyiedi ɔmmɔ ɔ́kya ogya kemmo na ɔ́nwamana-nwu na úwilimi uwi lɛla lɛdi kemmo na ɔ́nwi-nwu ɔ́bla sika ugyiedi ɔmantɛ akɔ ubi udu. Amu na bekyuli bammɔ básu banini, “Israelƒuɔ, bɛɛnu bina katɔti ɔni natɔku-mii na bɛ́lɛ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: When Aaron saw what was happening, he built an altar in front of the idol and said, “Tomorrow we will celebrate in honor of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Amu na Aaron ɔ́tu lɛkpabi na ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔni bávɔ mmɔ kudɔ. Na mmɔ na ɔ́kɔ lɛsa ɔ́su Israelƒuɔ ɔnini, “Kɔnaadi bɔdubo limeyi bɔdi buti bumwi bula Unwoti.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: Hurry back down! Those people you led out of Egypt are acting like fools.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Babla, na ayu kɔbi eteesie. Ɔsika ƒula bekyuli bani na ákpanku álɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ bábla likpidi na béni-mi.

english_verse: They have already stopped obeying me and have made themselves an idol in the shape of a young bull. They have bowed down to it, offered sacrifices, and said that it is the god who brought them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Báyila ulu geen ɔni na líbo-ma ɔda nnii basia mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na béti sika ugyiedi bávɔ ɔmantɛ akɔ na baakpá-nwu na baabla akpala teete-nwu. Na baasu banini, ‘Ɔmɛni ndi bula Katɔti ɔni nákpanku-bu ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: and I'm angry enough to destroy them, so don't try to stop me. But I will make your descendants into a great nation.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu mɔɔsu awɔ Mose nnii tedie-ma kenye, ɔsika líti kɔnyi geen lɛ́kya-ma, na lɛ́bla kasusu ka lɛyila-ma udu. Na ɔmmɔ kama ndubɔbla awɔ Mose ku ƒula kaba bekyuli kadi kani náƒɔ kuye.”

english_verse: Moses tried to get the Lord God to change his mind: Our Lord, you used your mighty power to bring these people out of Egypt. Now don't become angry and destroy them.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose úvele kɔnyana bɔnu na Unwoti Katɔti kudɔ ɔnini, “Unwoti, bi ɔsu na éti kɔnyi ákya ƒula bekyuli lɛni? Ƒula bekyuli badi, na éti ƒula ɔyikun bonwu na áda-ma édie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you do, the Egyptians will say that you brought your people out here into the mountains just to get rid of them. Please don't be angry with your people. Don't destroy them!
translation_verse: Na bi ɔsu na ɔdi ka Egyipteƒuɔ basu banii kasusu na ábla ka akpanku ƒula bekyuli esienku abi lɛlɔ na atádu-ma na ayila-ma udu. Anwuɔsu ya na kaƒɔ kayɔ-ɔ na avumana ƒula kasusu, na taya na ɔgbankpi ɔmɛni udu ubo ƒula bekyuli lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Remember the solemn promise you made to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You promised that someday they would have as many descendants as there are stars in the sky and that you would give them land.
translation_verse: Na enyimo ƒula linyese lɛni na éte ƒula kabla bablane Abraham ku Isak ku Yakob ka adubɔya na bana kaba bekyuli bemomo aani katɔ ayabi. Na adubute-ma kalɔ kani na ése kenye ka badubuti-ka babla bana kadikɔ.”

english_verse: So even though the Lord had threatened to destroy the people, he changed his mind and let them live.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu Unwoti kasusu kávumana, na útaya na ɔgbankpi ɔni na ɔ́su ka webo nwuna bekyuli lɛlɔ ubo-nwu kemmo lɛni.

english_verse: Moses went back down the mountain with the two flat stones on which God had written all of his laws with his own hand, using both sides of the stones.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose únwini ɔ́yu kɔbi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔdanku bunyimi atabi anyɔ ani na Unwoti ɔ́nwi na únweni ɔda bubo ɔ́sia-nya lɛlɔ mmɔ úboku.

english_verse: When Joshua heard the noisy shouts of the people, he said to Moses, “A battle must be going on down in the camp.”
translation_verse: Ka Yosua únu ka bekyuli bammɔ beete kudu ni, ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Kekpo kakya kesii kani na belie mmɔ.”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “It doesn't sound like they are shouting because they have won or lost a battle. It sounds more like a wild party!”
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ɔ́su ɔnini, “Kudu kɔmmɔ kulátina ka bekyuli badi nékpo bádi lɛlɔ. Na kulátina lɛnɔ ka badi muuwulo ka bádi-ma lɛlɔ ɔsu. Mmomu kuse aani ɔnu na baatu.”

english_verse: As Moses got closer to the camp, he saw the idol, and he also saw the people dancing around. This made him so angry that he threw down the stones and broke them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Mose ɔdaku bɔni bude kesii kani Israelƒuɔ básala belie na ɔ́nu ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔni bávɔ ku kalɛ bekyuli bammɔ bakya baatɔ́ taamana akɔ ɔni bávɔ mmɔ ni, kɔnyi kɔ́ƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo na kɔbi kaƒɔna mmɔ na úƒwimi atabi anyɔ ani na Unwoti úti úte-nwu mmɔ ɔ́va kalɔ na ábwɛ kɔkɛ kɔkɛ.

english_verse: He melted the idol the people had made, and he ground it into powder. He scattered it in their water and made them drink it.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́kyula ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔni na bávɔ mmɔ na ɔ́kɔ-nwu únwini ntɔ uti úwi ntu kemmo na úti úte Israelƒuɔ bammɔ na báni.

english_verse: Moses asked Aaron, “What did these people do to harm you? Why did you make them sin in this terrible way?”
translation_verse: Amu na Mose úye Aaron ɔnini, “Bi na bekyuli bamɛni bábla-a ɔsu na áya na bábla likpidi bonwu lɛmɛni udu?”

english_verse: Aaron answered: Don't be angry with me. You know as well as I do that they are determined to do evil.
translation_verse: Amu na Aaron údie kenye ɔnini, “Teti kɔnyi takya-mi, ɔsika agyi kalɛ na likpidi bɔbla bɔɔyu bekyuli bamɛni emini.

english_verse: Then I asked them to bring me their gold earrings. They took them off and gave them to me. I threw the gold into a fire, and out came this bull.
translation_verse: Amu na lɛ́su-ma nnii beti bana sika ugyiedi asɛɛ bébo beboku. Na ama lɛnɔ béti béte-mi na líti lɛ́kya ogya kemmo, na kɔnakunwi ni, akɔ ubi ɔmɛni nálɛ!”

english_verse: Moses knew that the people were out of control and that it was Aaron's fault. And now they had made fools of themselves in front of their enemies.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Mose ɔ́nu ɔ́ti ka Aaron nébile bekyuli bamɛni ɔsu na bábla adɔlɔla amɛni na bana bekisine anumi.

english_verse: So Moses stood at the gate of the camp and shouted, “Everyone who is on the Lord's side come over here!” Then the men of the Levi tribe gathered around Moses,
translation_verse: Amu na Mose úténye kayakun kani bekyuli bammɔ básala belie mmɔ kenye na údie lɛdi momoomo ɔnini, “Ukyuli biala ɔni nkya Unwoti kakɛ ni, ɔlɛ na ubenye-mi kudɔ mɛni!” Ɔmɛni ɔsu Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ ƒui báka bámana-nwu.

english_verse: and he said to them, “The Lord God of Israel commands you to strap on your swords and go through the camp, killing your relatives, your friends, and your neighbors.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Israel Unwoti Katɔti uubó-mii ɔda ɔnini, ‘Bina akɔ ɔdi biala uti nwuna kewii na bisie kesii kani na Israelƒuɔ básala beli na bɛdu bina banwani bananabi ku bina bakpana ku bina liku bekyuli ƒui.’ ”

english_verse: The men of the Levi tribe followed his orders, and that day they killed about
translation_verse: Amu na Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ bábla kalɛ bébo-ma ɔda mmɔ na bádu bekyuli aani mpim ɛtɛ limeyi lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: The next day Moses told the people, “This is a terrible thing you have done. But I will go back to the Lord to see if I can do something to keep this sin from being held against you.”
translation_verse: Ka kadi kégye ni, Mose ɔ́su bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini, “Bɛ́bla likpidi bonwu. Nsu nsɔ ndubusie kɔbi kɔmmɔ lili ntévele Unwoti likpidi lɛni bɛ́bla mɛni lili kayu lite-mii. Ɔƒɛni kalɛ ɔdubɔnu-mii kɔnyana na uti likpidi lɛmmɔ ɔkyiɛ-mii.”

english_verse: Moses returned to the Lord and said, “The people have committed a terrible sin. They have made a gold idol to be their god.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie-nwu kudɔ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Bekyuli bamɛni bábla likpidi bonwu, ɔsika béti sika ugyiedi bávɔ ɔti bamba ɔdi béte lɛlɔ na bákpa-nwu.

english_verse: But I beg you to forgive them. If you don't, please wipe my name out of your book.”
translation_verse: Nsu buvele na nda-a nnii ti bana ekpidi kyiɛ-ma. Mmomu si éni-ma buti bɔkyiɛ bɔdi ni, na akpa ada-mi lɛnyi edie ƒula ɔku kemmo.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “I will wipe out of my book the name of everyone who has sinned against me.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti údie kenye ɔnini, “Bekyuli bani náƒiɔ-mi anyi na ndubo bɔda budie mina ɔku ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Now take my people to the place I told you about, and my angel will lead you. But when the time comes, I will punish them for this sin.”
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒaani ni, teesie na atákpanku bekyuli bammɔ esienku kesii kani lɛ́su-ɔ líse. Na enyimo ka mina ɔtu ɔdubo-ɔ bɔgyumana. Nsu uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ɔni na ndubo bekyuli bamɛni kɔtu bɔni ɔkɛnku likpidi lɛni bábla ɔsu.”

english_verse: So the Lord punished the people of Israel with a terrible disease for talking Aaron into making the gold idol.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Unwoti ɔ́ya na ɔlɛ úbada bekyuli bammɔ ka báya na Aaron úti bana sika ugyiedi na ɔ́vɔ ɔmantɛ akɔ úte-ma ɔsu.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: You led the people of Israel out of Egypt. Now get ready to lead them to the land I promised their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Awɔ ku bekyuli bani na ákpanku álɛku Egyipte mmɔ bɛta kesii kani bilie mɛni. Na biteesie kalɔ kani líse kenye ka mete Abraham ku Isak ku Yakob ku bana bawɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: It is a land rich with milk and honey, and I will send an angel to force out those people who live there—the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. But I will not go with my people. They are so rebellious that I would destroy them before they get there.
translation_verse: Kalɔ kani lɛlɔ bísela mmɔ egyiibi ntu bɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii. Nsu ami Unwoti lɛɛɛdubo-mii bɔkpanku. Ɔsika bɛdi bekyuli bani atu mbo ɔkplu geen, na ɔƒɛni kalɛ ndubɔyila-mii udu na ulu lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Even before the Lord said these harsh things, he had told Moses, “These people really are rebellious, and I would kill them at once, if I went with them. But tell them to take off their fancy jewelry, then I'll decide what to do with them.” So the people started mourning,
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti ɔ́su Mose na úbasu-ma ɔnini, “Bɛdi bekyuli bani atu mbo ɔkplu geen, na ɔƒɛni kalɛ si ami ku-mii bɔsiaku lɛlɔ uwi klukwii ɔdi muedi ni, ndubɔyila-mii udu kede kede. Ɔƒɛni ɔdi biala ɔda nwuna sika ugyiedi ala udie, na ndubɔnu kalɛ maabla-mii.”

english_verse: and after leaving Mount Sinai, they stopped wearing fancy jewelry. The Lord Is with His People
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka bátɔlɔ Sinai kɔbi lɛlɔ mmɔ ni, básɔ bátada sika ugyiedi ala. Katɔti Adi Kevo Kasakɔ

english_verse: Moses used to set up a tent far from camp. He called it the “meeting tent,” and whoever needed some message from the Lord would go there.
translation_verse: Na kesi kesii Israelƒuɔ badubɔda keliekɔ kadi ni, Mose uuti Katɔti Adi Kevo taatálɛ keliekɔ kammɔ kabanye. Na ɔsia-nwu lɛnyi ɔnii Katɔti Kevo Kasakɔ. Na ukyuli biala mɔɔwia lɛla lɛdi ɔsiku Katɔti kudɔ uusié mmɔ.

english_verse: Each time Moses went out to this tent, everyone would stand at the entrance to their own tents and watch him enter.
translation_verse: Na uwi biala na Mose úsie kevo kammɔ kudɔ ni, Israelƒuɔ ƒui baalɛ́ teenye bana nvo kɔyakun taanu Mose utédu ka úduo-ka kemmo.

english_verse: Then they would bow down because a thick cloud would come down in front of the tent, and the Lord would speak to Moses face to face, just like a friend. Afterwards, Moses would return to camp, but his young assistant Joshua would stay at the tent. The Lord Promises To Be with His People
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔɔtɛmi-ku Mose anumi ku anumi aani kalɛ na bakpana baatɛmi. Na Mose ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie nwuna keliekɔ. Nsu okloƒu ɔni muubunku Mose na baalɔ-nwu banii Yosua na ɔdi Nun ubidi ni, anwu ɔɔƒɔ́ lɛlɔ taakya Katɔti kevo kammɔ kemmo. Unwoti Ɔ́lɛ Ugyii Ka Ɔdubulieku Nwuna Bekyuli

english_verse: Moses said to the Lord, “I know that you have told me to lead these people to the land you promised them. But you have not said who will go along to help me. You have said that you are my friend and that you are pleased with me.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ɔ́su Unwoti ɔnini, “Ɔdi sɔsɔ ka awɔ násu-mi anii nkpanku bekyuli bamɛni nsienku kalɔ kani kenye na ése-ma lɛlɔ. Nsu átasu-mi ukyuli ɔni na ndubo-mi bubunku.

english_verse: If this is true, let me know what your plans are, then I can obey and continue to please you. And don't forget that you have chosen this nation to be your own.”
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ɔni lɛ́ɛti-ɔ mɛni ni, ya na lɛti ƒula kasusu kani na ada, kalɛ na makana na mesie anumi na mabla ƒula lɛyɔla. Na enyimo lɛnɔ ka awɔ náƒuna bekyuli bamɛni ábla ƒula badi.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “I will go with you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Ndubɔkpanku-mii, na ndubɔya na bikpo bɛdi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Then Moses replied, “If you aren't going with us, please don't make us leave this place.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose údie kenye ɔnini, “Si agyi ka aaadubo-bu bɔkpanku bɔdi ni, ya na bɔsɔ bɔkya kesii kani bulie mɛni.

english_verse: But if you do go with us, everyone will know that you are pleased with your people and with me. That way, we will be different from the rest of the people on earth.”
translation_verse: Na dɛ na ɔdubɔbla na bekyuli banu bati ka kaƒɔ kaayɔ́-ɔ na ƒula bekyuli lɛlɔ ku ami lɛnɔ si átatɔnku-bu? Si akya-bu akɔ ni, kayawi bekyuli ƒui badubɔnu kavumana kebendi na abu ku-ma ntɛ.”

english_verse: So the Lord told him, “I will do what you have asked, because I am your friend and I am pleased with you.”
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Kalɛ na aayɔ́ ka lɛbla lite-ɔ ni, lɛni kani ndubo bɔbla. Ɔsika ngyi-ɔ kaduɛ na ƒula ala ƒui aayɔ́-mi kaƒɔ.”

english_verse: Then Moses said, “I pray that you will let me see you in all of your glory.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Mose ɔ́su Unwoti ɔnini, “Amu buvele nda-a, ya na lɛnu ƒula bukeye.”

english_verse: The Lord answered: All right. I am the Lord, and I show mercy and kindness to anyone I choose. I will let you see my glory and hear my holy name,
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti údie kenye ɔnini, “Ndubɔya na mina bukeye bɔvi ƒula anumi. Na si mɔɔví ni, ndubɔlɔ mina lɛnyi kedee nnii Unwoti. Na ukyuli ɔni litemi mɔɔyɔ́ ni, ndubɔnu-nwu kɔnyana. Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ lɛnɔ ni, ndubɔbla-nwu lɛƒɔndia.

english_verse: but I won't let you see my face, because anyone who sees my face will die.
translation_verse: Na aaadubo mina anumi bɔnu. Ɔsika ukyuli biala ulanu-mi anumi na welie ngba.”

english_verse: There is a rock not far from me. Stand beside it,
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Aanu kesii kadi na kede-mi na mmɔ akana akɔ etéduo lɛtakpɛ ɔkɔkɔ ɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: and before I pass by in all of my shining glory, I will put you in a large crack in the rock. I will cover your eyes with my hand until I have passed by.
translation_verse: Na si mina bukeye bɔ́si bɔɔví ni, ndubɔya na anu-mi asiku ɔkɔkɔ mmɔ. Na ndubuti mina enu libiɔ-ɔ lɛlɔ uti utédu ka lɛ́vi lɛ́wɔlɔ.

english_verse: Then I will take my hand away, and you will see my back. You will not see my face.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama ndubɔda mina enu lidie-ɔ lɛlɔ, na adubɔnu mina kama, nsu ɔɔɔdi mina anumi.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I promise to perform miracles for you that have never been seen anywhere on earth. Neighboring nations will stand in fear and know that I was the one who did these marvelous things.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Ndubo bunyimi bɔwɔdi bunyimiku-ɔ na Israelƒuɔ ƒui anumi. Na bana anumi ndubo ala ebendi ani ukyuli ɔdi utabla kudii na kalɔ lɛlɔ bɔbla. Na ɔyawine biala ɔdubɔnu lɛla lɛni na ami ɔni ndi Unwoti ndubɔkana bɔbla. Ɔsika ndubo liƒu ala bɔbla bɔtina-a.

english_verse: Be ready tomorrow morning to come up Mount Sinai and meet me at the top.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu klibi lɛlɔ se na lɛdigye na ata abasiaku-mi na Sinai kɔbi lili.

english_verse: No one is to come with you or to be on the mountain at all. Don't even let the sheep and cattle graze at the foot of the mountain.”
translation_verse: Na si adubo ni, taya na ukyuli ɔdi ɔsiaku-ɔ. Ɔsika naaayɔ ka lɛnu ukyuli ɔdi na amadɔ mmɔ. Na taya na koƒonu iye ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔdi usie kɔbi kaƒɔna mmɔ utáwia adila adi.”

english_verse: So Moses cut two flat stones like the first ones, and early the next morning he carried them to the top of Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Mose ɔ́nwi atabi anyɔ awɔdi na lɛdigye úti atabi ammɔ na ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie Sinai kɔbi lili aani kalɛ kani Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda.

english_verse: Then he passed in front of Moses and called out, “I am the Lord God. I am merciful and very patient with my people. I show great love, and I can be trusted.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti úsie ɔ́vi Mose anumi na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ami Unwoti ndi Katɔti ɔni mɔɔnu kɔnyana, na mɔɔbla lɛƒɔndia uwi ƒui, na neeeti kɔnyi pla pla. Mmomu mɔɔyɔ́ mina bekyuli na mɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ teete-ma.

english_verse: Moses quickly bowed down to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose úboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na úmwi Unwoti.

english_verse: He prayed, “Lord, if you really are pleased with me, I pray that you will go with us. It is true that these people are sinful and rebellious, but forgive our sin and let us be your people.” A Promise and Its Demands (Exodus
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnii, “Unwoti, si mina lɛlɔ lɛ́da-a kubiti sɔsɔ geen ni, muuvele-ɔ nnii kpanku-bu ina ka bekyuli bamɛni bébo atu ɔkplu geen. Ti bula ekpidi kyiɛ-bu na aƒɔ-bu aani ƒula bebi.” Katɔti Ɔ́sɔ Únyimi Bunyimi Bɔwɔdi Ku Israel

english_verse: Your men must come to worship me three times a year, because I am the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Kɔtɛ na eteebo mina anumi taabakpa ami Unwoti ɔni ndi Israelƒuɔ Katɔti.

english_verse: I demand your complete loyalty—you must not worship any other god!
translation_verse: Na takpa ɔti ɔdi tebunku ami Unwoti lɛti pɛ. Ɔsika ami Unwoti muukpó kogyulo.

english_verse: The first-born males of your families and of your flocks and herds belong to me.
translation_verse: “Na ubi ɔnanabi udeedi ku ɔmantɛ ebuo ɔgyani ubi udeedi biala ɔdi ami Unwoti ɔdi.

english_verse: Your men will even marry their women and be influenced to worship their gods.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bina bebi badubusie betéti bana beleku na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔkpanku-ma na balɛ-mi kama na besie batákpa bana baƒiɔ.

english_verse: Don't make metal images of gods.
translation_verse: “Teti lɛbuala tabla baƒiɔ badi na ataakpa.

english_verse: I will force out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, but you must do what I command you today.
translation_verse: Di ɔda ɔni muubó-ɔ ɔmwi mɛni lɛlɔ. Na ndubo Amoriƒuɔ ku Kanaanƒuɔ ku Hitiƒuɔ ku Perisiƒuɔ ku Hewiƒuɔ ku Yebusiƒuɔ bɔbɔku na ƒula anumi.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with any of those people. If you do, it will be like falling into a trap.
translation_verse: Na awɔ ku kadi bamba bekyuli badi bitenyimi bunyimi bɔdi na kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na ésela mmɔ.

english_verse: Instead, you must destroy their altars and tear down the sacred poles they use in the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Mmomu bo bana akpabi ƒui bwɛ na ayila bana baƒiɔ bani baalɔ banii Asera ligyii lɛni bálɛ ƒui udu.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with the people there, or you will soon find yourselves worshiping their gods and taking part in their sacrificial meals.
translation_verse: “Na awɔ ku kadi bamba bekyuli badi bitenyimi bunyimi bɔdi. Ɔsika si baakpá bana baƒiɔ na baabla akpala teete-nwu ni, badubo-ɔ bɔlɔ na ɔmɛni ɔdubunwini ala ani ndubo-ɔ bukpoku na adubɔdi bana adila.

english_verse: Don't fail to observe the Festival of Thin Bread in the month of Abib. Obey me and eat bread without yeast for seven days during Abib, because that is the month you left Egypt.
translation_verse: “Di Bodobodo Ɔni Néteƒu Limeyi. Na adi bodobodo ɔni kemmo na bɔnyii buuubo emeyi maatɛ aani kalɛ na líbo-ɔ ɔda. Na abla ɔmɛni na Abib kɔbuli kɔni na líse líse kemmo, ɔsika kɔbuli kɔmmɔ kemmo na álɛ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You can save the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must save every first-born son. Bring an offering every time you come to worship.
translation_verse: Nsu ebo kuƒi ka aƒɔ ƒula ɔpɔnkɔ ɔgyani ubi udeedi ɔni na éti éte-mi na aƒɔ-nwu lili kayu ku koƒonu kɔkɔdi. Na si átabla lɛni ni, ɔlɛka aƒɛ-nwu limɔ. Na aƒɔ ƒula ubi ɔnanabi udeedi lili kayu ete Unwoti. “Na tebo-mi anumi ku enu kplu.
