translation_verse: Ɔda ɔmɛni na Unwoti úbo ɔkɛnku ebuo bɔdu taakyula akpala ku edula ebi akpala ku likpidi lili buvele akpala ku kɔtɔ bukpi akpala ku ɔkpane buse akpala ku unwi bɔbla akpala ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni lɛlɔ ɔda na Unwoti úbo Mose na Sinai kɔbi lɛlɔ na limeyi lɛni lɛlɔ na Unwoti úbo Israel kadi bekyuli ɔda ka beteeti akpala teeboku-nwu na Sinai ketele kemmo mmɔ.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Mose úti ebuo ɔmmɔ kayi ɔvu lɛnɔ ɔ́kɔliku katɔ ɔ́tina Unwoti úbo akpala ammɔ kudu. Na ɔmmɔ ndi Mose kadikɔ na ɔkpane buse akpala ani na ɔ́bla kemmo aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Sie na etétiku Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi eboku ku lɛwu gyɔlɔɔ lɛni baakya mmɔ. Na eti likpose nnɔmii ku ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani ɔni na badubuti bakyula babla likpidi lili buvele akpala ku baƒonu inyɔ. Na eti kagyigyɛ ku bodobodo ɔni kemmo na bɔnyii buuubo ada.

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na asala kadi bekyuli bammɔ ƒui na beténye Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kaduli kayakun kenye.”

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord, and when everyone had come together,
translation_verse: Amu na Mose lɛnɔ ɔ́bla kalɛ kani na Unwoti ɔ́tina-nwu mmɔ. Na bátása na mmɔ.

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: Mose ɔ́su kasalakɔ bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini, “Binu lɛla lɛni na Unwoti úbo ɔda ka bɛbla.”

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Mose ɔ́ya na Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi bálɛ bébo anumi na ɔ́bla-ma ntu bɔkpila ɔdi.

english_verse: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.
translation_verse: Úti awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔmmɔ ɔ́kya Aaron, na úti lɛduni lɛdi ɔ́bala-nwu ɔ́mana, na úti awu ɔtɔdi akɔnkɔ bune ɔ́kya-nwu, na úti bakpane awu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ kedee ɔ́kya-nwu, na úbo awu ɔmmɔ kavobi lɛduni buni lɛni bédi kaduɛ mmɔ ɔ́bala-nwu kavobi.

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama úti kayi lɛbalala lɛdiku lɛdi lɛnɔ ɔ́bala-nwu kayi. Na úti Katɔti lɛyɔla bɔti atabi ani baalɔ Urim ku Tumim ɔ́kya kayi lɛdiku lɛmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: Úti dukuu kabwa úbi Aaron lili, na úti sika ugyiedi likpose kalɛkɛ úbo ɔ́da kabwa kammɔ anumi kakɛ aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama Mose úti likpose nnɔmii bɔmmɔ na ɔ́bla úsusu Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ ku kana lɛlɔ ala ani nkya kevo kammɔ kemmo ƒui lɛlɔ na ɔ́bla-nya kedee.

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́kuna nnɔmii bɔmmɔ bɔdi úwi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ maatɛ. Na ɔ́kwaa lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ku anwabui ammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na ɔ́kuna-mu úwi lɛkyami bonwu lɛni nlɛ mmɔ ku lɛkyami lɛmmɔ ɔka lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na úti likpose nnɔmii bɔmmɔ úwi Aaron lili na úse-nwu likpo na ɔ́bla-nwu kedee.

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Nwuna kama ni, Mose ɔ́lɔ Aaron bebi bananabi bammɔ úboku lɛlɔ kudɔ na ɔ́kya-ma lɛwu lɛtɔdi akɔnkɔ bune lɛmmɔ na úti aduni ɔ́da-ma kavobi. Na úti aduni adi úbo ɔ́da-ma eli aani kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda mmɔ.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama úti ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani ɔni na badubuti babla likpidi lili buvele akpala ammɔ úboku. Na Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi béti bana enu básia ebuo ɔmmɔ lili bátina ka ɔmmɔ na béti bényene bana kenye ka beti babla akpala ammɔ.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama Mose ɔ́du ebuo ɔmmɔ, na úti lɛnimi ɔ́kya ubugya ɔmmɔ kemmo na úti úsusu bebuo ese ani ƒui nlɛ lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔ́bla lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ sɛɛn. Na úti ubugya ɔkladi úwi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ kalɔ na ɔ́bla lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ kedee na lise sɛsɛɛ úte Unwoti kalɛ na udie kɔtu bɔni biala nina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Na úti lɛmwi lɛni ƒui nkya ebuo ɔmmɔ kaƒɔ kemmo ku akɔ ammɔ ku akabi anyɔ ammɔ ku ana lɛmwi ɔ́sia ogya lɛlɔ na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔ́kyula-ni ƒui.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani ɔmmɔ ɔku ɔni bédie-nwu ku lɛna lɛmmɔ ku ala ani béwilimi-nwu kaƒɔ kemmo ƒui ni, béti-nya bátákyula na keyi na bana keliekɔ kammɔ kama kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama béti koƒonu kɔgyani kɔni na badubuti babla akpala bɔkyula mmɔ béboku na Aaron ku bebi béti enu básia-ku lili.

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Mose ɔ́du-ku, na úti ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔ́kuna uwi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔ́mana.

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ƒɔ aƒɔla ammɔ ku agyobi ammɔ ƒui na úti koƒonu kɔmmɔ ɔ́kyula ɔ́bla akpala bɔkyula ƒui uyɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ami Unwoti kaƒɔ aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Amu na úti koƒonu kunyɔdi lɛnɔ úboku, na aku ndi ɔkpane buse ebuo, na Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi béti enu básia-ku lili.

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: Mose ɔ́du-ku na úti ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔdi úsusu Aaron kɔdianu kɔtu kawɔlɔkɔ mmɔ ku nwuna kɔdianu kɔnu ku nwuna kɔdianu ɔgba animigya.

english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Mose ɔ́ya na Aaron bebi bananabi bammɔ lɛnɔ báni béde-nwu na úti ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔdi úsusu-ma kɔdianu atu kawɔlɔkɔ ku bana kɔdianu animigya ku bana kɔdianu lɛgba animigya. Na Mose úti ubugya ɔkladi ɔ́kuna úwi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔ́mana.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Na úti lɛmwi lɛmmɔ ku lɛmwi lɛni ndanku ɔka ku lɛmwi lɛni nkya ebuo ɔmmɔ kaƒɔ kemmo ƒui ku akɔ ammɔ kenye munu munu kammɔ ku akabi anyɔ ammɔ ƒui ku ana lɛmwi úbunku kɔdianu libuli.

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni kagyigyɛ kadi kese Unwoti anumi mmɔ, na udie bodobodo ɔni na bɔnyii buuubo-nwu kemmo ku bodobodo udu bamba ɔni nse bɛbɛɛbɛ ku ɔbambadi ɔni na básala ku nnɔ, na úti amɛni ƒui úbunku lɛmwi ku ebuo libuli lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni ƒui na úti ɔ́sia Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi enu lɛlɔ, na bákɔliku-nya katɔ bátina Unwoti bébo akpala ammɔ kudu.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama Mose ɔ́sɔ ɔ́ƒɔ-nya ɔ́siku bana enu kemmo ɔ́kyula na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ úbunku akpala akladi ammɔ úte Unwoti. Na adi ɔkpane buse akpala bɔkyula ƒui uyɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ Unwoti kaƒɔ.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Mose úti nnɔmii bɔni na ɔdubuti use Aaron likpo mmɔ ku ubugya ɔni nsia lɛkpabi lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔdi na ɔ́kuna-nwu úwi Aaron lɛlɔ ku nwuna lɛkpa lɛwu gyɔlɔɔ lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ku nwuna bebi bananabi bammɔ. Na ɔ́ƒuna-nwu úse sɛsɛɛ na ɔ́bla-nwu kedee ku nwuna lɛwu ku nwuna bebi bananabi lɛwu ƒui lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ɔ́su Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi ɔnini, “Biti lɛna lɛmmɔ na biƒulo-ni na Unwoti Adi Kevo kayakun kenye mmɔ. Na biti bodobodo ɔni béti bábla ɔkpane buse akpala ammɔ na ɔkya kagyigyɛ kemmo mmɔ na amii kani bɛdi ku lɛna lɛmmɔ aani kalɛ na líbo-mii ɔda.

english_verse: Burn what is left over
translation_verse: Na lɛna ku bodobodo ɔni mebu ni, ɔlɛka bɛkyula-nwu ƒui.

english_verse: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.
translation_verse: Na bitavi bitalɛ Unwoti Adi Kevo kaduli kayakun na emeyi maatɛ kemmo úti útédu uwi ɔni na bina ɔkpane buse kabla kammɔ kása bɔbla, ɔsika emeyi maatɛ na baabla kabla kammɔ.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ala ani ƒui na bɔ́bla ɔmwi mɛni adi akpala ani ɔda na Unwoti úbo ka bɔbla na udie kɔtu bɔni biala na bina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Na ɔlɛka bɛsɔ bɛkya Unwoti Adi Kevo kaduli kammɔ kayakun kenye emeyi maatɛ usien ku ɔƒɛ. Na bɛbla ala ani ƒui na Unwoti ɔɔwia ka bɛbla kalɛ na bilekpi, ɔsika lɛni na Unwoti ɔɔwia.”

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi bábla lɛla biala aani kalɛ na Unwoti ɔkɛnku Mose lɛlɔ úbo-ma ɔda.

english_verse: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.
translation_verse: Na limeyi maanedi lɛlɔ ni, Mose ɔ́lɔ Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi ku Israel kadi benengu ɔ́sala.

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́su Aaron ɔnini, “Ti ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani ɔkɔdi na eti abla likpidi lili buvele akpala. Na eti koƒonu kɔgyani kunengudi abla akpala bɔkyula. Na anu ka bebuo bammɔ ƒui bese sɛɛn na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-ma. Na eti-ma eboku Unwoti anumi.”

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord. The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Su Israelƒuɔ anini ‘Biti ketukpa bɛbla alaekpidi bɔkyiɛ akpala. Na biti ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔkɔdi ku koƒonu kɔkɔdi bani maƒɔ aani lɛkwa linwi linwi kani, na bese sɛɛn, na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-ma, na biti bɛbla akpala bɔkyula.

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: Na biti ɔmantɛ akɔ unengudi ku koƒonu kunengudi ku edula ebi akpala ani na básala ku nnɔ bɛbla akpala bite Unwoti, ɔsika ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ni, Unwoti ɔdubudie lɛlɔ ɔtina-mii.’ ”

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu béti ala ani na Mose úbo-ma ɔda mmɔ béboku Unwoti Adi Kevo kaduli kammɔ anumi, na Israel kadi bekyuli bammɔ bábasa mmɔ na Unwoti anumi.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Na Mose ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bɛsia anu na bɛnu lɛla lɛni Unwoti ɔɔwia ka bɛbla asa na nwuna bukeye bubo bubewi-mii lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ɔ́kpali Aaron na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Kpɛ de lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ na abla ƒula likpidi lili buvele akpala ku akpala bɔkyula ɔdi ɔmmɔ. Na Unwoti udie kɔtu bɔni biala na awɔ ku ƒula kadi bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo ɔda.”

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Amu na Aaron ɔ́ni úde lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ, na ɔ́du ɔmantɛ akɔ ubi ɔni na ɔdubuti ɔbla nwuna likpidi lili buvele akpala ute lɛlɔ.

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: Na nwuna bebi bananabi béti ubugya ɔmmɔ béte-nwu. Na ɔ́kya-nwu lɛnimi na úti úsusu bebuo ese ani nlɛ lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na úti ɔkladi úwi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ebuo ɔmmɔ lɛmwi ku akabi ku akɔ ammɔ kenye kani na ɔlɛka beti babla likpidi lili buvele akpala ammɔ ni, úti ɔ́kyula na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔ́da.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: Na ebuo ɔmmɔ ɔku ku lɛna lɛkladi lɛmmɔ ƒui ni, Aaron ɔ́kyula-ni na bana keliekɔ kammɔ kama.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, ɔ́du ebuo ɔni na badubuti babla akpala bɔkyula ammɔ lɛnɔ na nwuna bebi bananabi béti ubugya ɔmmɔ béte-nwu na ɔ́kuna-nwu úwi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔ́mana.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Na béti ebuo ɔni báwawa badubo bɔkyula mmɔ béboku-nwu ku nwuna lili. Na úti lɛna lɛmmɔ ku nwuna lili na ɔ́kyula na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ƒɔ aƒɔla ammɔ ku agyobi ammɔ na ntu kemmo kaduɛ na úti-nya ɔ́sia akpala ammɔ lɛlɔ ɔ́kyula na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Amu na Aaron úti bekyuli bammɔ akpala úboku Unwoti anumi. Na úƒie ketukpa kani ndi bekyuli bammɔ likpidi bɔkyiɛ akpala ebuo na ɔ́du-ka na úti ɔ́bla likpidi bɔkyiɛ akpala ɔdi na bekyuli bammɔ lili aani udeedi kalɛ.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: Aaron úti bɔkyula akpala ammɔ úboku Unwoti anumi na úti anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́kpa kalɛ na ulu ɔmmɔ ɔ́tina.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: Nwuna kama úboku edula ebi akpala ammɔ lɛnɔ. Na ɔ́ma-nya lɛkɔkɔ keyile na úti ɔ́kyula na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ úbunku akpala ani na ɔ́kyula na ɔtanta ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, ɔ́du ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani unengudi ɔmmɔ ku koƒonu kɔni na badubuti babla unwi bɔbla akpala mmɔ úte bekyuli bammɔ ƒui. Na Aaron bebi bananabi bammɔ béti ubugya ɔmmɔ béte-nwu na ɔ́kuna úwi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔ́mana.

english_verse: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver
translation_verse: Na ɔmantɛ akɔ bonwu ɔmmɔ lɛmwi ku koƒonu kɔmmɔ kesii kani bene nélie lɛmwi na lɛdanku nwuna ɔka ku akabi ammɔ ku ákɔ ammɔ lɛmwi lɛni mma-nwu lɛlɔ ƒui ni,

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: Na kayi ɔvu ɔmmɔ geen ku kɔdianu libuli ni, Aaron ɔ́kɔliku-nwu katɔ ɔ́tina Unwoti úbo-ni kudu aani kalɛ kani na Mose úbo ɔda ka babla.

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔni na Aaron ɔ́wɔlɔ likpidi lili buvele akpala ku bɔkyula ƒui akpala ammɔ ku unwi bɔbla akpala ammɔ ƒui kama ni, ɔ́kɔliku enu katɔ na úte bekyuli bammɔ kusɛ kusɛ asa na ɔ́gyu mmɔ.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Mose ku Aaron bénwini bétéduo Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kemmo. Na ka bálɛ bébete bekyuli bammɔ kusɛ kusɛ kama ni, Unwoti úkeye úbewi bekyuli bammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ogya ɔ́bwɛ ɔ́lɛ ɔ́si Unwoti Adi Kevo kemmo mmɔ úbakyula lɛla biala údie na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ kede kede. Na ka bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bánu ɔmɛni ni, báva momoomo ku lɛlɔyɔ na béti anumi bébi kalɔ.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Aaron bebi bananabi inyɔ bani ndi Nadab ku Abihu béti bana kɔlɛkɛ kɔni lɛlɔ na beedie ogya teewi na bédie ogya béwi-ku lɛlɔ. Béti oloƒui béwi ogya ɔmɛni lɛlɔ banii baakyula bete Unwoti na ɔmɛni ɔ́ta únye ɔda bubo bɔni na úte-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Unwoti ɔ́ya na ogya unyemi bonwu ɔdi úbo na úbakyula-ma na békpi kɔnakunwi na nwuna anumi mmɔ.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Mose ɔ́su Aaron ɔnini, “Lɛla lɛmɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su uwi ɔni na ɔ́su ɔnini, ‘Bekyuli bani muubo-mi kudɔ ƒui ɔlɛka babla-mi lɛla biala kedee aani kalɛ kani na nse kedee. Na kadi bekyuli ƒui beti ɔbu bete-mi.’ ” Na bunye kani na Aaron unye kpoo uunú na útebimi kenye.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ɔ́kpali Misael ku Elsaƒan bani ndi Aaron ɔti ɔnwani ɔnanabi Usiel bebi bananabi ɔnini, “Bɛlɛ bibo na bibetiku bina banwani bekpine bɛtɔlɔku Katɔti Kevo Kedee anumi mɛni bɛlɛku bula keliekɔ bisienku kama.”

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ɔ́su Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi Eleasar ku Itamar ɔnini, “Amii amu ni, bitanyonu bina lili linwini bitewi na lɛbla kalɛ kalɛ iye bɛni bina adala bɛbwɛ bɛtina ka likpidi lɛdi lɛ́lɛku-mii si ɔɔɔdi lɛni bɛdubo bukpi, na Unwoti ɔ́kɛku bina kadi kammɔ bekyuli ƒui kɔnyi. Na bina lɛlɔ bekyuli ku kadi ƒui ama bakana na bewulo bani ƒui na Unwoti ɔ́ya na ogya ɔ́yila-ma udu mmɔ.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Bitavi tɔ bitalɛ Unwoti Adi Kevo kayakun kammɔ, na uwi ɔni na úwi-mii lili nnɔmii na úse-mii likpo, si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, bɛdubo bukpi.” Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bábla kalɛ kani na Mose úbo-ma ɔda.

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama Unwoti ɔ́su Aaron ɔnini,

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: “Ɔkpane ɔdi biala, awɔ ku ƒula bebi bananabi ɔdi utani ntɛ bubulodi bɔni kemmo na bɔnyii bɔkya iye bɔbambadi bɔdi biala udu na uduo Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kemmo, si ɔɔɔdi lɛni bɛdubo bukpi. Na bunyimi bɔmɛni lɛlɔ na bɛdubɔdi úti úsela uwi ƒui amii ku bina kaba kaba ƒui bekyuli.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka kavumana kakya lɛla lɛni nse kedee ku lɛni neeese kedee ntɛ. Na ɔlɛka kavumana kakya lɛla lɛni báƒuna bése sɛsɛɛ ku lɛla lɛni na baaƒuƒwɛ ntɛ.

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: Na ɔlɛka atina Israelƒuɔ ƒui ala ani ƒui na línyimiku-ma ɔkɛnku Mose lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ɔ́su Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi bani nébu, Eleasar ku Itamar ɔnini, “Biti edula ebi akpala ani bákyula lɛkpabi lɛlɔ béte Unwoti na ébu mmɔ bɛnwa bɛdi na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ kɔmadɔ, ɔsika ese kedee ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Bɛdi-nya na kesii kani nse kedee mmɔ, ɔsika ɔmmɔ ndi awɔ ku ƒula bebi bananabi kadikɔ, na akpala ani na bákyula lɛkpabi lɛlɔ béte Unwoti mmɔ kemmo. Na ɔmmɔ ndi ɔda ɔni na Unwoti úbo-mi,

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ka beti ebuo libuli ku kayi ɔvu ɔni béte mmɔ béboku na bákɔliku katɔ bátina-mi uwi ɔni na béti ekpo ani nélie lɛmwi mmɔ bábla enyimo adila bɔsia akpala. Na ɔmmɔ ndubo ƒula kadikɔ bunwini ku ƒula bebi aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo-mii ɔda.”

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Mose úye ekpidi bɔkyiɛ ese ɔni na bádu na básu-nwu ka béti anwu lɛnɔ bákyula ni, úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya Eleasar ku Itamar Aaron bebi bani nébu na úye-ma ɔnini,

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Bi ɔsu na bítakun likpidi lili buvele akpala ammɔ na Kevo kammɔ kaduli? Ɔdi lɛla lɛni na lise kedee ƒui, na buti na béti-nwu béte-ɔ ka edie ekpidi na bekyuli ƒui lili aani kɔtɔ bukpi akpala na Unwoti anumi.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Na ka bíteti nwuna ubugya bíteduoku Katɔma Kedee kemmo ɔsu ni, ɔdi ka nka bɛkun lɛna lɛmmɔ na Katɔma Kevo kaduli aani kalɛ na líbo-mii ɔda.”

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Amu na Aaron údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɔmwi na bábla bana likpidi buvele ku akpala bɔkyula na Unwoti anumi, nsu lɛla lɛmɛni udu lɛ́ɛlɛku-mi, na muuye-ɔ ni, si bɔdi na lɛ́di likpidi lili buvele akpala ammɔ ɔmwi ni, nka ɔdubo Unwoti kaƒɔ bɔyɔ ntuu?”

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Mose únu kenye kamɛni kani na ɔ́bla-nwu buɛɛ.

english_verse: any animal that has divided hoofs and chews the cud.
translation_verse: Bibo kuƒi ka bɛkun ebuo biala ɔni muukpó taalɛku ɔkwɛ kemmo taakun, na nwuna lɛgba agbanvuo kemmo ábwɛ inyɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ku Aaron ɔnini,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat
translation_verse: “Bɛkɔ lɛsa na bɛsu Israelƒuɔ bɛnini, ‘Bebuo bani ƒui nkya kalɔ lɛlɔ na bámanku ka bakun ama ndi bamɛni.

english_verse: Eagles, vultures, buzzards, crows, ostriches, hawks, sea gulls, owls, pelicans, storks, herons, hoopoes, and bats are also disgusting, and you are forbidden to eat any of them.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na baasɛ bani anyi ndubo bɔlɔ mɛni ni, bitakun-ma. Kɔdigbo aasɛ, okum ku nwuna lidu, ɔsansa, kasangbii ku nwuna lidu, soholi, lɛkpaƒɛɛlɛ, ligbini, kwakwadabi, ɛpu kemmo kwakwadabi, likuku ku nwuna lidu ƒui, ntu kemmo kɔdigbo aasɛ, aasɛ ku limɔ gyɔlɔɔ ku nwuna lidu lidu, lɛpan ku baƒelelee.

english_verse: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.
translation_verse: Nsu kubweyi kɔkladi kɔni mɔɔkpɛ́ kalɔ na bebo avwi ku lɛgba ine ni, ɔdi utakun.

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: kadɔdɔ ku ɔtɔlati ku ugunti

english_verse: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.
translation_verse: ku bana udu bani mɔɔkpɛ́ kalɔ ƒui beesé lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli biala metuku bana ukpine ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi asa na ɔdubɔbla sɛɛn.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si ebuo ɔmmɔ ɔdi úkpi úduo lɛvɔbui lɛdi kemmo ni, ɔlɛka babwɛ libui lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: If you pour water from this pot on any food, that food becomes unclean, and anything drinkable in the pot becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Na adila biala ndia bɔdi na libui lɛmmɔ kemmo ntu bútuku-nya ni, adila ammɔ eesé lɛlɔ. Na si ntu bɔnidi bɔdi nwi-ni kemmo lɛnɔ ni, bɔsɔ bɔɔɔdia bɔni ɔsika buusé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Na lɛla biala na bebuo bammɔ ɔdi ukpine úkpi ɔ́yu ni, ɔdi lɛla lɛni na liisé lɛlɔ. Ina bodobodo lɛyu iye anwabui na adi ni, ɔdi ka babwɛ-nya lɛni kani ɔsika eesé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Nsu libiɔ iye lɛba lɛni kemmo na beedú ntu bɔnidi asa na ebuo ɔmmɔ úkpi ɔ́kya-nwu kemmo ni, ntu bɔmmɔ amu buse sɛɛn. Nsu ukyuli biala metuku nwuna ukpine ɔdubuse lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Na si ebuo ɔmmɔ ukpine ɔdi útuku edula ebi ani báklibi bése béte bɔva ni, ebi ammɔ ese sɛɛn.

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: Nsu si bíwi ebi ammɔ ntu asa na ebuo ɔmmɔ ukpine útuku ebi ammɔ ni, adubuse lɛlɔ na uuuse sɛɛn uuute-mii.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si bebuo bani lɛlɔ na béte-mii kuƒi ka bɛkun ɔdi úkpi ni, ukyuli biala metuku nwuna ukpine ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi.

english_verse: If you eat any of its meat or carry its body away, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala makun lɛna lɛmmɔ lɛdi ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adi na useyi uwi asa na ɔdubɔbla sɛɛn. Na ukyuli biala magyu nwuna ukpine lɛnɔ ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala asa na ɔdubɔbla sɛɛn.

english_verse: Don't eat any of those disgusting little creatures that crawl or walk close to the ground.
translation_verse: Bitakun kebweyi biala mɔɔkpɛ́ taavi kalɔ ku kaƒɔ iye ku lɛgba ine iye bani lɛgba mmomo. Badi kubweyi kɔni muusé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
translation_verse: Bitaya na bina lɛlɔ lise lɛlɔ ɔkɛnku kubweyi kɔmɛni ɔsu. Bɛbla lɛlɔ sɛɛn na bilásɔ na ulu biala lɛlɔ na bana ɔdi ɔsu.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti. Bidie lɛlɔ bise sɛsɛɛ na bɛbla lɛlɔ kedee ɔsika nse Kedee. Na bitabla na bina lɛlɔ liteese lɛlɔ ɔkɛnku kubweyi kɔni mɔɔkpɛ́ kalɔ mɛni ɔsu.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Ami ndi Unwoti ɔni nákpanku-mii lɛ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ kalɛ na lɛbla bina Katɔti. Ɔmɛni ɔsu bɛbla lɛlɔ kedee ɔsika nse kedee.

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: Na ɔlɛka bɛnu kavumana kani na kakya bebuo bani nse sɛɛn ku bani neeese sɛɛn ntɛ. Na bɛnu bɛti kubweyi kɔni na bɛkana na bɛkun ku bani na útalɛka bɛkun.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: “Su Israelƒuɔ anini, ‘Si uleku ɔ́da kaƒɔ na ɔ́wɔ ubi ɔnanabi ni, uwele ɔmmɔ uuuse sɛɛn wetédu emeyi maatɛ. Na úlieku kalɛ kani na si ɔ́ƒɛ kɔnu na uusé sɛɛn wetédu emeyi maatɛ.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Na limeyi maanedi lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka bekulo ubiwɔ ɔmmɔ lego.

english_verse: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another
translation_verse: Na si ulekubi na uleku ɔmmɔ ɔ́wɔ ni, uwele ɔmmɔ uuuse sɛɛn wetédu kwasida inyɔ. Na ɔlɛka ulie emeyi liti ku leevu-ɛku na ɔbla sɛɛn ɔsiku nwuna ubugya buwi kemmo.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn emeyi ammɔ édu na ubi ɔnanabi iye ulekubi bɔwɔ kama ni, ɔlɛka uwele ɔmmɔ ɔwia koƒonu ubi ɔni náakɛ lɛkwa uboku ɔkpane na Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kayakun na uti ɔbla akpala bɔkyula ku mangbɛ iye abloduma na uti ɔbla likpidi lili buvele akpala ute Unwoti.

english_verse: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.
translation_verse: Na ɔlɛka uti ala ammɔ ƒui usienku Unwoti anumi mmɔ na babla lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ bete-nwu. Na ɔmmɔ kama ɔdubɔbla sɛɛn na ɔlɛ ɔsiku nwuna ubugya buwi kemmo. Na amɛni ndi ɔda bubo bute uleku ɔni na ɔ́wɔ ɔnanabi iye ulekubi.

english_verse: If she cannot afford a lamb, she can offer two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice to please me and the other as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si uleku ɔmmɔ ulakana koƒonu ubi bute ni, ɔkana na ɔwia bamangbɛ inyɔ iye babloduma inyɔ na uti unwi ɔbla akpala bɔkyula. Na uti unyɔdi ɔbla likpidi lili buvele akpala Na ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na ɔkpane ɔdubɔbla lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ ute-nwu na ɔbla sɛɛn.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ku Aaron ɔnini,

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: “Si ala adi álɛ éwi ukyuli lɛlɔ iye nwuna ɔlɔna ɔɔtina aani kalɛ na ɔkpaala ɔɔsia lɛla lɛdi lɛlɔ iye eƒula adi na ɔɔtina aani ɔlɛgyie ni, ɔlɛka beti-nwu beboku Aaron ɔni ndi ɔkpane iye nwuna bebi bananabi ɔdi ɔni ndi ɔkpane kudɔ.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔsia alɛbi ammɔ anu kaduɛ. Na si alɛbi ammɔ kemmo linwini lɛ́bla ƒututuu na use aani kalɛ na alɛbi aagyú ɔlɔna taabla ubu ni, na alɛbi ammɔ adi ɔlɛgyie. Na ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ute bɔti ka ukyuli ɔmmɔ uuuse sɛɛn.

english_verse: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: “Nsu si alɛbi ani na ɔlɔna lɛlɔ use ƒututuu, nsu útebo útanu aani kalɛ na lɛna lɛɛgyú ɔlɛ kemmo na linwini lɛmmɔ lítabla ƒututuu ni, ɔkpane ɔmmɔ udie ɔlɛne ɔmmɔ lɛti utákya kesii kadi emeyi maatɛ.

english_verse: If the disease hasn't spread by that time, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔsɔ ɔsia-nwu anu. Na si ɔ́nu-nwu na alɛbi ammɔ átavumana ni, ɔlɛka ɔsɔku-nwu usienku kesii kani nse sɛsɛɛ.

english_verse: Then if the disease hasn't become any worse or spread, the priest will say, “You are clean. It is only a sore. After you wash your clothes, you may go home.”
translation_verse: Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔsɔ usie utásia-nwu anu. Na si ɔ́nu-nwu na alɛbi ammɔ aƒana na étegyingya na ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, na ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔsu-nwu ka use sɛɛn na lɛla bamba lɛdi lɛɛɛda-nwu, na akpaabi kani na adi. Na ɔmmɔ kama na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔbla sɛɛn.

english_verse: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Na si ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔ́sɔ ɔ́sia-nwu anu na únwini ka ɔlɛ ukpidi ɔni mɔɔví ɔdi na ɔdi ni, na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubute bɔti ka uuuse sɛɛn.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: “Si ukyuli ɔdi uuuƒi ɔlɛgyie ɔni mɔɔví ni, ɔlɛka beti-nwu batátina ɔkpane.

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔnu ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ. Na si ɔkpaala ƒututuu ɔmmɔ ɔsu nwuna linwini lɛ́bla ƒututuu, nsu ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ ɔ́lɛ ɔlɛ ɔwɔdi ni,

english_verse: But if the disease has run its course and only the scars remain, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔsia-nwu anumi kaduɛ na si ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́ƒɔ-nwu ɔlɔna kesii biala ni, ɔlɛka ɔsu ka ukyuli ɔmmɔ use sɛɛn. Ɔsika ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ƒui lɛ́bla ƒututuu, ɔmmɔ ɔsu use sɛɛn.

english_verse: If the sores come back and turn white again, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Si ɔkpane ɔ́nu nwuna ɔlɔna lɛlɔ ɔlɛ ɔwɔdi ɔmmɔ ni, ɔlɛka ɔsu-nwu ka ɔ́sɔ na uuuse sɛɛn. Ɔsika ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔdi ɔlɛ ukpidi ɔni mɔɔví.

english_verse: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔnu-nwu. Na si alɛbi ammɔ énwini ábla ƒututuu ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔsu ɔlɛne ɔmmɔ ka ɔ́bla sɛɛn. Na ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdi ukyuli ɔni na ɔ́sɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: na kesii kani na lɛla lɛmmɔ líƒu ukyuli ɔmmɔ kásɔ kéƒu kábla ƒututuu iye ɔ́bla ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ni, ɔlɛka uti lɛlɔ utátina ɔkpane.

english_verse: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔlɛka ɔsia-nwu anu na si ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́lɛ aani ɔlɛ bonwu nágyu-nwu ɔlɔna na linwini lɛni nákwɛ mmɔ lɛ́bla ƒututuu ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔsu-nwu ka ɔ́sɔ na uuuse sɛɛn. Ɔsika ɔlɛgyie ɔni mɔɔví na ɔdi nálɛ úwi-nwu kesii kani na liƒula lɛmmɔ lɛ́sia-nwu mmɔ.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Nsu si ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔ́sia-nwu anu na linwini ƒututuu lɛdi lítakwɛ na kesii kani liƒula lɛmmɔ lɛ́sia-nwu mmɔ, na ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ útagyu ɔlɔna ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ uti ɔlɛne ɔmmɔ utákya kesii kadi sɛsɛɛ emeyi maatɛ.

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: Nsu si alɛbi ammɔ égyingya áƒɔ ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔsu-nwu ka ɔ́sɔ na uuuse sɛɛn. Ɔsika ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔdi ɔlɛgyie ɔni mɔɔví.

english_verse: But if it doesn't spread, and only a scar remains, he will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Nsu si kesii kammɔ kátavumana na lɛni kani na ɔtaala ɔmmɔ use na ulégyingya ni, ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubute kati ka use sɛɛn. Ɔsika liƒula ɔtaala na ɔdi na ɔɔɔdi lɛla bamba lɛdi.

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔsia lɛla lɛmmɔ anumi. Na si nwuna ɔlɔna linwini lɛ́bla ɔƒualadi na ɔlɛ ɔwɔdi ɔmmɔ ɔ́gyu-nwu ɔlɔna kemmo ni, na ɔlɛgyie ɔni mɔɔví néwi-nwu. Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔlɛka ute bɔti ka ɔ́sɔ na uuuse sɛɛn.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Nsu si ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔ́sia-nwu anu na linwini lɛƒualadi liiibo ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ kemmo na ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ útagyu-nwu ɔlɔna kemmo mmomu bɔsa na ɔɔsá ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ uti ɔlɛne ɔmmɔ utákya kesii kani nse sɛsɛɛ emeyi maatɛ.

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔ́sɔ ɔsia-nwu anu. Na si ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ uugyingya taakya ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ute bɔti ka ɔ́sɔ na uuuse sɛɛn, ɔsika ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔdi ɔlɛ ukpidi ɔni mɔɔví.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Nsu si kesii kani na ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́lɛ úwi-nwu kátavumana, na útegyingya, mmomu bɔyii na ɔɔyii taakya ni, na liƒula lɛmmɔ kasiakɔ nákɔ kálɛ ɔ́bla ɔtaala ni, ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubute kati ka ukyuli ɔmmɔ útasɔ na use sɛɛn.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: “Na si ɔnana iye uleku ɔdi na ɔlɛ ɔdi ɔ́bla-nwu kuli iye keduo lɛlɔ ni,

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔnu ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ. Na si ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́gyu-nwu ɔlɔna na nwuna linwini lɛ́ƒuala lɛ́bla aani akɔkɔ lɛmwi ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ute bɔti ka ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔ́sɔ na uuuse sɛɛn, ɔsika bɔƒɛni bɔmmɔ bɔɔtina ka ɔlɛgyie ɔni ɔɔví na ɔdi nwi-nwu kuli iye keduo mmɔ.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Nsu si ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔ́sia ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ anu na útagyu-nwu ɔlɔna kemmo na linwini lɛtondi lɛnɔ liiibo ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, na ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ uti ɔlɛne ɔmmɔ utákya kesii kani nse sɛsɛɛ emeyi maatɛ.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep,
translation_verse: Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔsɔ utánu ɔlɛne ɔmmɔ. Na si ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ uláƒɛni-nwu na útegyingya na linwini lɛmmɔ lítaƒuala lítabla aani akɔkɔ lɛmwi na ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ útagyu-nwu ɔlɔna kemmo lɛnɔ ni,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: ɔlɛka bekpeyi mmɔ na bada ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ anumi bese na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔsɔ uti-nwu utákya kesii kani sɛsɛɛ emeyi maatɛ bamba.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread and seems no more than skin deep, he will say, “You are clean; now you must wash your clothes.”
translation_verse: “Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔ́sɔ utánu-nwu na si ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ útegyingya ɔlɔna lɛlɔ na útagyu-nwu ɔlɔna kemmo lɛnɔ ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔsu ka use sɛɛn. Na ɔlɛne ɔmmɔ ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔ́bla sɛɛn sɔsɔ.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: “Si ɔnana iye uleku ɔdi ɔkya na ala aƒualadi adi alɛ éwi-nwu lɛlɔ ni,

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔsia ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ anu. Nsu si ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ uuuse ƒututuu ƒui, ni, na ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔɔɔdi ɔlɛ ɔni muukpóku ukyuli nálɛ úwi ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔsu útasɔ mmomu use sɛɛn.

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na si lɛtɛntɛ nápa ukyuli ni, anwu lɛnɔ use sɛɛn na lɛtɛntɛ kani nápa-nwu.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Na ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔsia-nwu anumi kaduɛ ɔnu. Na si alɛbi ani nákɔ álɛ-nwu ketikɔ ku lɛtɛntɛ mmɔ adi ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ɔ́sala aani ɔlɛgyie ɔni mɔɔví ni,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: “Na ukyuli ɔni na ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ udu ɔda ni, ɔlɛka ɔda adala ani nábwɛ na ulegyeli nwuna kuli linwini na uti lɛla lɛdi ubi nwuna anumi na utaava momoomo taasu ɔnini, ‘Lɛ́sɔ o-o, lɛ́sɔ na liiise sɛɛn!’

english_verse: As long as you have the disease, you are unclean and must live alone outside the camp.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni kemmo ƒui na alɛbi ammɔ asia-nwu lɛlɔ mmɔ ni, na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔ́sɔ na uuuse sɛɛn. Na ɔlɛka bedie-nwu sɛsɛɛ. Ɔda Bubo Bɔni Ndanku Ala Butili Lɛlɔ

english_verse: If a greenish or reddish spot appears anywhere on any of your clothing or on anything made of leather, you must let the priest examine the clothing or the leather. He will put it aside for seven days,
translation_verse: Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔlɛka ɔsia ala ammɔ anu na udie ala ani kemmo na butili bɔmmɔ bɔ́ƒɔ mmɔ use kɔmadɔ sɛsɛɛ emeyi maatɛ.

english_verse: because the mildew has spread.” Then he will burn the clothing or the piece of leather.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔlɛka bakyula lɛdala lɛmmɔ iye awu iye kɔdi iye ebuo ɔku ɔmmɔ, ɔsika butili kuyii kɔni muubile ala kɔ́ƒɔ lɛla lɛmmɔ kemmo na ɔlɛka bakya-nwu ogya.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the mildew hasn't spread,
translation_verse: “Nsu si ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔ́nu na butili bɔmmɔ bútegyingya bútakya awu iye kɔdi iye lɛla lɛmmɔ kemmo ni,

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: na ɔkpane adubɔsu-ma ka baƒɔ awu ɔni na butili bɔmmɔ búduo. Na ɔsɔ ɔda lɛla lɛmmɔ use emeyi maatɛ bamba.

english_verse: after which he will examine it again. If the spot hasn't spread, but is still greenish or reddish, the clothing or leather is unclean and must be burned.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́ƒɔ lɛdiku iye awu iye lɛla lɛmmɔ kama ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔsɔ ɔnu lɛla lɛmmɔ na nwuna bɔƒɔ kama. Na si butili bɔmmɔ bɔ́sɔ bɔ́tina kesii kadi ni, na lɛla lɛmmɔ liisé lɛlɔ. Na ɔlɛka bakyula-ni.

english_verse: Later, if the spot reappears elsewhere on the clothing or the leather, you must burn it.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama si butili bɔmmɔ bɔ́sɔ búduo awu iye kɔdi iye lɛla lɛmmɔ kemmo ni, na ɔɔtina ka ɔlɛ na ɔdi. Anwuɔsu ɔlɛka bakyula lɛla limodi lɛmmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.

english_verse: These are the rules for deciding if clothing is clean or unclean after a spot appears on it.
translation_verse: Amɛni ndi ɔda bubo bute kedi ala aani awu iye kɔdi iye ala ani na bátu ku bebuo lɛku ala lɛlɔ kalɛ na ɔkpane ɔnu ɔsu si lɛla lɛmmɔ lise sɛɛn iye liiise sɛɛn.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔsu ukyuli ɔmmɔ na beti baasɛ babuni inyɔ bani neeese lɛlɔ ku kegyikɛ ku lɛdiku ligyiedi ku hisope na beti babla-nwu sɛɛn bɔbla ɔdi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.
translation_verse: Na mmɔ na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔya na badu baasɛ bammɔ kemmo unwi na kayaa na ntu buni ku ketubui kemmo eli.

english_verse: Then he will dip the other bird, the cedar, the red yarn, and the hyssop in the blood of the dead bird.
translation_verse: Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ uti aasɛ unyɔdi ɔni bátadu mmɔ ku sida kegyikɛ ku kɔdi kugyiedi kɔmmɔ ku hisope ɔnyina ɔkya ketubui kani kemmo na ntu ku ubugya ɔmmɔ uwi mmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, “You are now clean.” Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.
translation_verse: Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔkuna ntu bɔmmɔ uwi ukyuli ɔni na ɔɔbla lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ teete mmɔ maatɛ na ubo kudu ute bɔti ka ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́sa na ɔƒɛni amu use sɛɛn. Na ɔmmɔ kama na ɔnyonu aasɛ ku ngba ɔmmɔ na uveyi ɔtɔlɔ uteesie alakpi akɔ.

english_verse: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.
translation_verse: “Na ukyuli ɔni na baabla lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ teete ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ukpeyi lili na ɔkpi ntu na ɔmmɔ ɔɔtina ka ɔ́bla sɛɛn. Na ɔmmɔ kama ɔkana utéduo nwuna badi akɔ. Nsu ɔdi ka ɔka kevoma bulie emeyi maatɛ asa.

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔlɛka ukpeyi lili ku nwuna ukwi ku nwuna lɛnungya ku linwini biala na nwuna ɔlɔna kesii biala. Na ɔmmɔ kama ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi na ɔbla sɛɛn.

english_verse: On the eighth day you must bring to the priest two rams and a year-old female lamb that have nothing wrong with them; also bring
translation_verse: “Na limeyi maanedi lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka ɔwia baƒonu bagyani inyɔ ku koƒonu kuledi kunwi kɔni náƒɔ lɛkwa linwi na kútasɔ kesii kadi ku ɔlaaƒɔ lɛɛƒɛɛ klo klo ɛku ku kakɛ ɔni básala ku nnɔ ku nnɔ ɔsii bamba unwi.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔlɛka ɔdu koƒonu kɔmmɔ na kesii kani nse kedee na baadú likpidi bɔkyiɛ akpala ku akpala bɔkyula ƒui ebuo. Na aani likpidi lili buvele akpala kalɛ ni, kɔtɔ bukpi akpala lɛnɔ adi ɔkpane ɔmmɔ adi na ese kedee geen.

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Na kɔtɔ bukpi ebuo ɔmmɔ ubugya ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔbla-nwu ɔdi utu ukyuli ɔni na baabla sɛɛn bɔbla ɔdi ɔmmɔ teete mmɔ kɔdianu kɔtu kawɔlɔkɔ ku nwuna kɔdianu kɔnu ku kɔdianu ɔgba animigya.

translation_verse: Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubuti nnɔmii bɔmmɔ bɔdi uwi anwu ɔlati nwuna kɔmiinu kɔnu lɛkɔkɔ

translation_verse: Na nnɔmii bɔkladi bɔni nwi ɔkpane ɔmmɔ lɛkɔkɔ ni, ɔbla-mu utu ukyuli ɔni na ɔɔbla sɛɛn bɔbla ɔdi ɔmmɔ teete kɔdianu kɔtu kawɔlɔkɔ ku kɔdianu kɔnu lɛnimigya ku kɔdianu ɔgba lɛnimigya na kesii kani na úsusu kɔtɔ bukpi ebuo ɔmmɔ ubugya mmɔ kani.

english_verse: If you are poor and cannot afford to offer this much, you may offer a ram as a sacrifice to make things right, together with
translation_verse: “Nsu si ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔdi ɔwabane na ulákɛ ala ammɔ ni, na uti koƒonu kɔgyani kunwi uboku na beti bakɔliku katɔ batina-mi aani likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala ubunku ɔlaaƒɔ lɛɛƒɛɛ inyɔ na basala-nwu ku nnɔ ute edula ebi akpala ku nnɔ ɔsii unwi

english_verse: The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.
translation_verse: “Na si emeyi maane édu ni, na beti akpala ammɔ beboku na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ uti ɔbla-nwu lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ na Unwoti Adi Kevo kayakun kenye mmɔ na Unwoti anumi.

english_verse: The priest will kill this ram for the sacrifice to make things right, and he will lift it up with the olive oil in dedication to me. Then he will smear some of the blood on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔdu kɔtɔ bukpi akpala koƒonu kɔmmɔ na uti ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔdi utu ukyuli ɔmmɔ kɔdianu kɔtu ku kɔdianu kɔnu lɛnimigya ku kɔdianu ɔgba lɛnimigya.

english_verse: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Na ɔkpane ɔƒɛ nnɔ bɔmmɔ bɔdi uwi anwu ɔlati kɔmiinu kɔnu lɛkɔkɔ.

english_verse: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na uti nwuna kɔdianu lɛnimi lideedi lɛni nsiaku lɛnimigya utu nnɔ bɔni nwi-nwu kɔmiinu lɛkɔkɔ mmɔ na ɔta-mu uwi kayaa maatɛ na Unwoti anumi mmɔ.

translation_verse: Na uti nnɔ bɔmmɔ bɔdi utu ukyuli ɔni baabla sɛɛn mmɔ kɔdianu kɔtu ku nwuna kɔdianu lɛnimigya ku nwuna kɔdianu ɔgba lɛnimigya na kesii kani na bétu-nwu kɔtɔ bukpi ebuo ɔmmɔ ubugya kani.

translation_verse: Ala amɛni ndi ɔda bubo bute ukyuli ɔni na ɔlɛgyie ɔni mɔɔví ɔda-nwu, nsu kɔnu kuledu-nwu akpala ammɔ lɛlɔ ute nwuna lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ. Ala Ani Butili Kuyi Kɔ́ƒɔ Bɔbla Sɛɛn

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ku Aaron ɔnini,

english_verse: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.
translation_verse: “Si bítéduo Kanaan kalɔ kani lɛ́su líse ka mete-mii na biti binwini bina kadikɔ mmɔ kemmo na bɛ́nu ka lɛ́ya na butili kuyi kɔƒɔ ɔtɔ ɔdi kemmo ni,

english_verse: First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
translation_verse: na kaduli ɔlati ɔmmɔ usie na utásu ɔkpane ka lɛla lɛdi lɛ́lɛ lɛsia kaduli lɛwoduku lɛlɔ aani butili kuyi.

english_verse: If the priest discovers greenish or reddish spots that go deeper than the surface of the walls,
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔdubɔsia anumi ɔnu lɛla lɛni nsia awodu ammɔ lɛlɔ. Na si mmɔ kánu kéduo na úgyie iye use evete awɔdi ni,

english_verse: he will have the house closed for seven days.
translation_verse: na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔvi ɔlɛ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo na ɔkalɛ-nwu unyene emeyi maatɛ.

english_verse: Then he will return and check to see if the mildew has spread.
translation_verse: Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛlɔ ni, ɔsɔ ɔdubusie na utásia ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ anu ɔnu si butili bɔmmɔ bɔ́sɔ búsie kama búbu na awodu ammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama badubo ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo awodu ƒui lɛlɔ bukpeyi na beti lɛti lɛmmɔ betéwiakun kesii kani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Afterwards the wall must be repaired with new stones and fresh plaster.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama na beti atabi abambadi ku lɛti lɛbambadi baklibi ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: the priest will come and say, “This house is unclean. It's covered with mildew that can't be removed.”
translation_verse: na ɔkpane ɔsɔ usie na utásia kaduli kammɔ anu. Na si ɔ́nu na sɔsɔ na lɛla lɛmmɔ lɛ́sɔ lígyingya lɛ́ƒɔ awodu ammɔ lɛlɔ ni, na ɔdi ɔlɛ ɔni muubile ala ɔsu kaduli kammɔ keesé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Na ɔlɛka baƒɛ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ na babuma nwuna lɛti ku atabi ku egyii ani ƒui béti bébi ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ na betébo-nya bewiakun ɔma ɔmmɔ kɔmadɔ kesii kani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “Ukyuli ɔni ndubusie kaduli kammɔ na uwi ɔni na bákalɛ-ka bényene mmɔ ɔdubuse lɛlɔ limeyi limodi utálɛ useyi uwi.

english_verse: And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala madi iye matɛ kaduli kammɔ kemmo ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala.

english_verse: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.”
translation_verse: “Nsu si ɔkpane ɔmmɔ úbanu kaduli kammɔ na butili bɔmmɔ bɔ́sɔ bútegyingya bútaƒɔ kaduli kani awodu básɔku bákwa mmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔkpane ɔdubute kati ka kaduli kammɔ kabla sɛɛn, ɔsika butili bɔmmɔ bɔ́sa.

english_verse: He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔdu aasɛ unwi na kayaa na ketubui ku ntu bɔbuni bɔmmɔ eli.

english_verse: and let its blood drain into the pot. Then he will dip the cedar, the hyssop, the yarn, and the other bird into the mixture of blood and water. Next, he will sprinkle the house seven times with the mixture, then the house will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Lɛni na ɔdubuti aasɛ ubugya ku ntu bɔni nwi libui kemmo mmɔ ku aasɛ ku ngba ku ngba ku sida kegyikɛ ku hisope ku lɛduni ligyiedi lɛmmɔ ɔbla kaduli kammɔ sɛɛn bɔbla ɔdi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away, ending the ceremony for purifying the house.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ɔdubɔlɛ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo na utányonu aasɛ ɔmmɔ na uveyi ɔtɔlɔ utéduo alakpi akɔ. Lɛni na ɔdubudie bɔsɔ biala na kɔduli kammɔ lɛlɔ na kɔbla sɛɛn.”

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.

english_verse: After having sex, both the man and the woman must take a bath, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na si ɔnana ɔdi ku ulekudi bátɛ ni, ɔlɛka bana inyɔ ƒui bakpi na bamu badubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi.

english_verse: When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days, and if you touch her, you must take a bath, but you remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si uleku ɔ́lɛ ɔtɔ ni, emeyi maatɛ kemmo ƒui na uuuse sɛɛn. Na ukyuli biala metuku-nwu lɛnɔ uuuse sɛɛn na ɔɔɔdubo buse sɛɛn wetédu useyi uwi.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nwuna atɛla na adi o-o, kesi kesii na úlie na ɔdi útuku ala ammɔ o-o ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi.

english_verse: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si uleku ɔ́lɛ ɔtɔ na anwu ku ɔnana ɔdi bátɛ na uleku ɔmmɔ ɔtɔ bɔlɛ bútuku ɔnana ɔmmɔ ni, ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔdubuse lɛlɔ emeyi maatɛ. Na atɛla biala lɛlɔ watɛ lɛnɔ adubuse lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Any woman who has a flow of blood outside her regular monthly period is unclean until it stops, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si uleku ɔtɔ bɔlɛ butulo kalɛ na ɔɔyɔ́ bɔlɛ ni, iye uwi bamba ɔdi kemmo na ubugya uuwi-nwu ni, ɔdubuse lɛlɔ aani kalɛ kani na si ɔ́lɛ ɔtɔ na uusé lɛlɔ emeyi bumomo bɔni na ubugya ɔmmɔ uuwi-nwu.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on during this time is also unclean, just as it would be during her period.
translation_verse: Na atɛla biala lɛlɔ watɛ iye lɛla biala lɛlɔ welie na nwuna ubugya buwi bɔmmɔ kemmo ni, adubuse lɛlɔ aani kalɛ kani na si ɔ́lɛ ɔtɔ na ala ammɔ eesé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala meti kɔnu metuku ala ammɔ adi ɔdubuse lɛlɔ. Na ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi na ɔmu ɔdubuse lɛlɔ utédu useyi uwi.

english_verse: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Na limeyi maanedi lɛlɔ ɔlɛka ɔwia babloduma iye bamangbɛ inyɔ na uti-ma usienku ɔkpane na Unwoti Adi Kevo anumi.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
translation_verse: Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubuti baasɛ bammɔ unwi ɔbla likpidi lili buvele akpala na uti ɔkladi ɔbla akpala bɔkyula. Na lɛni na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla akpala ammɔ na Unwoti udie kɔtu bɔni biala na uleku ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɔdi ka aya na Israelƒuɔ bada lɛlɔ bedie ala ani muusé lɛlɔ kudɔ kalɛ na beléteese lɛlɔ na bekpi na ɔmmɔ ɔsu ka badubɔya na mina keliekɔ kani nkya-ma akɔ keteese lɛlɔ ɔsu.’ ”

english_verse: Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron: I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
translation_verse: Ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ya na ƒ'ɔnwani Aaron ɔti anii utata kalɛ kalɛ uwi ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́ na ubalɛ-mi lɛlɔ na Katɔma Kedee kemmo kesii kani na likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie libila libi Bunyimi Adaka lɛlɔ na kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔmmɔ kama, si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ɔdubo bukpi, ɔsika ami Unwoti mɔɔdá taalɛ libila lɛmmɔ katɔ na liƒlukutu kemmo.

english_verse: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: “Ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔdubɔsia uduo Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kaduli ndi ɔmɛni, si úsela ni, ɔlɛka uti ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani ɔkɔdi ku koƒonu kɔgyani na uti akɔ ɔmmɔ ɔbla likpidi lili buvele akpala, na uti koƒonu kɔgyani kɔmmɔ ɔbla akpala bɔkyula ƒui ɔdi.

english_verse: Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɔ betukpa inyɔ ku koƒonu kɔgyani kunwi ɔsiku Israelƒuɔ bammɔ kudɔ. Na uti betukpa inyɔ bammɔ ɔbla likpidi lili buvele akpala na uti ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔmmɔ ɔbla bɔkyula akpala.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: “Aaron ɔdubuti akɔ ɔmmɔ ɔbla nwuna likpidi lili buvele akpala na Unwoti udie likpidi kɔtu bɔni biala na anwu ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Na uti betukpa inyɔ bammɔ uboku Unwoti na Kevo Kasakɔ kayakun.

english_verse: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔtu egulabi ɔnu na betukpa bammɔ lɛlɔ na ɔnu lɛni ndi Unwoti ɔdi ku ɔni ndi bukeli ketukpa lɛdi.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Na ketukpa kani na Unwoti ligulabi lɛ́tina ni, Aaron ɔdubɔdu-ka ɔbla likpidi lili buvele akpala.

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Na bukeli ketukpa kani na ligulabi linyɔdi lɛ́tina ni, badubuti-ka beboku Unwoti anumi ngba ngba na babla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie ɔdi na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ na babɔku-ka na ukeli usie ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo aani bukeli ketukpa.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: “Ɔmmɔ kama Aaron ɔdububoku ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔni nnye ute nwuna ekpidi na ɔdubuti ɔbla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala na anwu ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli lili. Na ɔdubɔdu ebuo ɔmmɔ ute anwu ɔlati ekpidi bɔkyiɛ akpala.

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ɔdubuti oloƒui bɔkyula libui lɛni na ɔdubuyile ku agyabi bɔsiku Unwoti lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ku oloƒui ɔni bákɔ kaduɛ akɔkɔ anyɔ na uti uduoku kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔmmɔ kama.

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: Na uti oloƒui ɔmmɔ uwi ogya ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na Unwoti anumi mmɔ na uyɔ ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔƒɔ likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie libila lɛni na Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ katɔ mmɔ ƒui suu na ɔbɛla libila lɛmmɔ kalɛ na ulekpi.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubuti akɔ ɔni na ɔ́du mmɔ ubugya ɔdi na uti nwuna lɛnimi ɔkya ubugya ɔmmɔ kemmo na ɔkuna ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔdi uwi likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie libila lɛmmɔ anumi. Na ɔmmɔ kama ɔsɔ uti lɛnimi ɔkya ubugya ɔmmɔ kemmo na ɔkuna ubugya ɔmmɔ libila lɛmmɔ lɛtɔtɔ maatɛ.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: “Ɔmmɔ kama ni, ɔdubɔlɛ utádu likpidi lili buvele akpala ketukpa kammɔ na Israelƒuɔ lili, na uti ebuo ɔmmɔ ubugya uduoku kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔmmɔ kama na ɔblaku-nwu kalɛ kani na ɔ́blaku ebuo udeedi ubugya. Ɔdubɔkuna ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔdi uwi libila lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ku nina anumi.

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: Lɛni na ɔdubɔbla na udie likpidi kɔtu bɔni bɔni nkɛnku Katɔma Kedee kammɔ lɛlɔ ala bɔbla na Israelƒuɔ ala ani muusé lɛlɔ bɔbla ku kalɛ na bénwini kama bákya Unwoti ɔsu ina bi ekpidi na bábla. Lɛni kani na ɔdubɔbla ute Kasakɔ Kevo kani nkya-ma ntɛ na bana ɔbladu ɔni muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: “Ɔmmɔ kama ɔdubɔlɛ ubo Unwoti lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ kudɔ na uti akɔ ɔmmɔ ubugya ku ketukpa kammɔ ubugya ɔdi ususu bebuo ese ani nlɛ lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ƒui na ɔbla-ni ɔdi ɔmmɔ kalɛ kani na ɔ́bla Kevo kammɔ.

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Na uti nwuna lɛnimi ɔkya ubugya ɔmmɔ kemmo na ɔkuna-nwu uwi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ maatɛ na ɔbla-ni sɛsɛɛ ɔsiku Israelƒuɔ ala ani muusé lɛlɔ bɔbla kudɔ.

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: “Si Aaron ɔ́wɔlɔ sɛɛn bɔbla akpala ɔdi ɔmmɔ bɔbla bute Katɔma Kedee kammɔ ku Kevo Kasakɔ kammɔ ku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ni, mmɔ na ɔdubuti ketukpa kani ku ngba mmɔ uboku.

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubuti nwuna enu anyɔ ɔsia ese ɔmmɔ kuli na ɔka Israelƒuɔ ekpidi lidu lidu udie ɔsu na bana ulikplu ala bɔbla ku kalɛ na baalɛ́ bana Unwoti kama ku bana ekpidi lidu bamba lɛni ƒui na baabla. Na ekpidi ammɔ ƒui adubɔsia ese ɔmmɔ kuli. Na ɔkɛnku ukyuli ɔni na báalɛ lɛnimi bése lɛlɔ ni, na ɔbɔku ese ɔmmɔ utákya alakpi akɔ na ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo.

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: Na ese ɔmmɔ ndubuti Israelƒuɔ bammɔ ekpidi ƒui utákya ketele kemmo kesii kani na ukyuli ɔmmɔ úsela utányonu-nwu ɔkya na ukyuli ɔdi uuubo mmɔ.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubusie kesii kani na kese sɛsɛɛ na utákpi ntu na uti nwuna lɛkpa adala geen ɔkya na ɔlɛ ubo ubabla akpala bɔkyula ƒui ute ɛlɔ ku Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui na Unwoti udie likpidi kɔtu bɔni biala na bana lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Na ɔkyula lɛmwi lɛmmɔ ƒui lɛnɔ na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ aani likpidi lili buvele akpala.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: “Na ɔnana ɔni ndubutiku bukeli ketukpa kammɔ utákya alakpi akɔ na ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ lɛnɔ ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala ƒui na ɔkpi ntu asa na ɔsɔ unwini utéduo bana keliekɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni makyula bebuo bammɔ ɔdubɔƒɔ nwuna lɛwu na ɔkpi ntu asa na unwini usie bana keliekɔ.

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: “Na bunyimi bɔni lɛlɔ na bɛdubo butaadi ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui ndi ka kɔbuli maatɛdi limeyi leevudi biala lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka bikisi lɛlɔ na bilie kɔka na bilabla kabla kadi amii ku kadi bamba bekyuli bani nkya-mii akɔ na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: Ɔsika limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na badubo likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie ɔdi bɔbla na bina lɛlɔ na bɛbla sɛɛn bɛsiku bina ekpidi ƒui kudɔ.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdi lɛnwunameyi lite-mii na ɔdi ka bikisi lɛlɔ na bilie kɔka. Na ɔmɛni ɔdi bunyimi bɔni ndubunye bute uwi ƒui.

english_verse: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.
translation_verse: Ɔkpane ɔni báƒuna na béwi-nwu lili nnɔmii bése-nwu likpo ka unye ɔti kabla kenye aani ɔkpane unengudi kalɛ ndubo likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie ɔdi ɔmɛni bɔbla na ɔlɛka ɔkya ɔkpane lɛwu gyɔlɔɔ kedee lɛmmɔ

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: asa na ɔbla ɔdi ɔmmɔ ɔkɛnku Katɔma Kedee kammɔ ku Kasakɔ Kevo kammɔ ku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ablala kalɛ na lɛla biala lise sɛɛn ku bakpane bammɔ ku Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: “Na bunyimi bɔmɛni bɔdubuse bute-mii uwi ƒui. Na ɔlɛka babla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala ɔdi ɔmɛni kunwi na lɛkwa kemmo ute Israelƒuɔ ƒui ekpidi lili.” Na bábla básia kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini

english_verse: to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:
translation_verse: “Tasu Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi ku Israelƒuɔ bananabi ƒui anini, ‘Lɛni na Unwoti uubó-mii ɔda ka

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: na úteboku-nwu Unwoti anumi na Kasakɔ Kevo mmɔ ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ úwi ubugya kalɔ. Na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔlɛka bedie-nwu lɛti basiku mina bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: And so, when you sacrifice an animal to ask my blessing, it must not be done out in a field,
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni na ɔmɛni ɔdanku ndi ka akpala ani na Israelƒuɔ bátaabla na kesi kesii ni, beti-nya beboku ɔkpane na Unwoti anumi ɔƒɛni amu na Kevo Kasakɔ kayakun kenye na beti babla unwi bɔbla akpala.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔkuna ubugya ɔmmɔ uwi Unwoti lɛkpabi lɛni nlɛ Kevo Kasakɔ kayakun kenye mmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔkyula lɛmwi lɛmmɔ na uyɔ ɔmmɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ.

english_verse: Remember! No one in Israel, including foreigners, is to offer a sacrifice anywhere
translation_verse: “Na bɛsu Israelƒuɔ ku kadi bamba bekyuli bani nli-mii akɔ ka si ɔdi ɔ́sɔ ɔ́bla akpala bɔkyula adi iye úti etela adi úsienku kesii bamba kadi

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: na úteti akpala ammɔ úteboku Kevo Kasakɔ kayakun kenye mɛni na mina anumi ni, badubɔda ukyuli ɔmmɔ bedie mina bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɔƒɛni lɛnɔ ukyuli biala na ɔ́si Israel kaba kemmo iye ɔƒɔ ɔni nli-mii akɔ na ɔdi ɔ́di ubugya ni, ndubuti mina lɛnimi lɛlɛ ukyuli ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na lɛda-nwu lidie mina bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: Life is in the blood, and I have given you the blood of animals to sacrifice in place of your own.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛla lidiedi biala ngba ndi nwuna ubugya, na líti ubugya ɔmmɔ líte-mii ka biti bidie likpidi kɔtu bɔni biala na bina ekpidi lili. Na ubugya ndi lɛla lɛni muudie likpidi kayu na ukyuli lɛlɔ.

english_verse: That's also why I have forbidden you to eat blood.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na lɛ́su Israelƒuɔ ku baƒɔ bani nkya-mii akɔ ka ɔdi biala utadi ubugya.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: “ ‘Anwuɔsu si Israelni ɔdi iye ɔƒɔ ɔni ɔkya-mii akɔ ɔdi úsie kabuikɔ na útádu ebuo iye aasɛ ɔdi ka bakun-nwu ni, ukulo-nwu ɔkwɛ na ubugya ɔmmɔ uwi kalɔ na uku lɛti ubi ubugya ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ,

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: ɔsika lɛla lidiedi biala ngba ndi nwuna ubugya. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na lɛ́su Israelƒuɔ nnini, “Bina akɔ ɔdi utadi lɛla lidiedi biala ubugya, ɔsika lɛla lidiedi biala ngba ndi nwuna ubugya. Na ukyuli biala madi ubugya ɔmmɔ ni, ɔlɛka bidie-nwu bina akɔ.”

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́kun ebuo ukpine lɛna iye ɔ́kun lɛna lɛni na eƒiebuo bamba náduli-nwu kɔkɛ kɔkɛ ɔ́va na ɔdi Israelni iye ɔƒɔ ni, ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ nwuna adala na ɔkpi ntu na ulie utédu useyi uwi asa na nwuna lɛlɔ lɛdubɔbla sɛɛn.

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: Nsu si úni na útaƒɔ nwuna adala na útakpi ntu ni, anwu ɔlati nwuna etila na adi.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: “Kɔ lɛsa te Israelƒuɔ na ásu-ma anini, ‘Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka bɛsia mina bunyimi ƒui anu na bɛdi mina ɔda bubo ƒui lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.

english_verse: Don't have sex with any of your close relatives,
translation_verse: “ ‘Ukyuli ɔdi ku uleku ɔni na bede na kɔnwa kemmo batatɛnku lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: “ ‘Tatɛnku ƒ'ɔti ulekudi ɔdi, ɔmmɔ ɔdubudie ɔbu na nwuna lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your sister or stepsister, whether you grew up together or not.
translation_verse: “ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ku ɔnwani ulekubi bani nási bawɔne benwi kudɔ batɛ ina kaduli mmɔ na báwɔ-nwu iye kesii bamba.

english_verse: Don't disgrace yourself by having sex with your granddaughter
translation_verse: “ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ku nwuna uwɔ batɛ, ɔsika kɔƒa na kɔdi-ɔ.

english_verse: or a sister of your father or mother.
translation_verse: “ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ku uni ɔnwani batɛ, ɔsika ƒula uni kani na ɔdi.

english_verse: Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife.
translation_verse: “ ‘Tedie ɔbu na ƒ'ɔti ɔnwani ɔnanabi lɛlɔ na awɔ ku ulekudi bɛtɛ, ɔsika úlieku ƒ'ɔti ulekudi kani na ɔdi.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: “ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ɔtɛnku ubi ku uni iye ɔtɛnku uleku ɔmmɔ uwɔ ulekubi ɔdi, ɔsika nwuna lɛlɔ bekyuli geen na badi. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdi likyulikpi ala bɔbla.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: “ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi uti ulekudi ɔnwani ulekubi na ɔtɛnku-nwu na benwini bagyulo uwi ɔni na ɔnwani udeedi ɔni na uti mmɔ uli ngba.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: “ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ku uleku ɔni náƒɛ kɔnu batɛ uwi ɔni na ubugya ɔmmɔ útekulo tɔ na uuuse sɛɛn mmɔ.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: “ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ɔtɛnku nwuna ukyulikpana ulekudi na ubile lɛlɔ na ɔmmɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi uti ubidi iye uwɔ ute na beti bakpa bete Molek baƒiɔ na ɔya na balabu Katɔti lɛnyi na liteese lɛlɔ, ɔsika ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: “ ‘Útalɛka ɔnana ku ɔnana batɛ aani kalɛ na uleku ku ɔnana baatɛ. Ɔmɛni ɔdi lɛla lɛni muusé Unwoti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: “ ‘Na ɔdi biala utabla ala ani muusé lɛlɔ mɛni udu, ɔsika ana udu na kadi bekyuli bani na ndubo bɔbɔku budie bina anumi bábla bébile lɛlɔ na beesé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: Kalɔ kammɔ muedi bébile-ka, anwuɔsu mina lɛtuni líbo-ka lɛlɔ na lɛ́bɔku lɛla biala lídie aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔdala lɛla biala teedie.

english_verse: Now don't do these sickening things that make the land filthy. Instead, obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ala amɛni udu na bekyuli bani nágyu batɔ bélie kalɔ kamɛni kemmo bábla na bébile kalɔ kammɔ na keesé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si amii lɛnɔ bíbile kalɔ kammɔ ni, ndubo-mii bɔbɔku budie kalɛ na lɛ́bɔku-ma aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔdala lɛla biala teedie kaƒɔ kemmo.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu bɛnu ka bɛ́di mina litemi lɛlɔ kalɛ na ɔdi ulabla ala ani bekyuli bani nélie mɛni bátaabla na beesé lɛlɔ mmɔ na bitasiaku bana ɔdi ala bɔbla kama na bibile lɛlɔ na biteese lɛlɔ bana kalɛ. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔsu Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: “Su Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui anini, ‘Bɛbla lɛlɔ kedee, ɔsika ami Unwoti bina Katɔti nse kedee.
