english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɔdi utesie utatákpa baƒiɔ badi iye ɔvɔ baƒiɔ badi use lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si bina ɔdi ɔɔbla unwi bɔbla akpala ute-mi ni, ɔnu ka akpala ammɔ adubɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Bibo kuƒi ka bɛkun lɛna lɛni bíti bɛɛbla akpala ammɔ bite-mi limeyi lɛmmɔ ku kadi kégye. Nsu lɛna lɛni mebu limeyi lɛtɛdi lɛlɔ ni, bɛkyula-ni.

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Si bɛ́kun lɛdi limeyi lɛtɛdi ni, ala ammɔ eeese sɛɛn, anwuɔsu lɛɛɛdubo akpala ammɔ bɔƒɔ bute-mii.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni makun lɛna lɛmmɔ ɔdubɔkɛ nwuna kɔtu bɔni. Ɔsika úbile Unwoti lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla kedee. Na ɔlɛka bedie ukyuli ɔmmɔ udu bina akɔ.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɔƒɛni si bísie bina mmo bɛnii bitáƒɛ bina edula ni, bitaƒɛ-nya ƒui kede kede. Mmomu bibu adi bɛkya bina mmo amadɔ iye bitaƒɛ edula wɛlɛ wɛlɛ ani nkya bina mmo mmɔ.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ɔdi utasia kama utetéde nwuna adingyii ani na úude úbavi na utala ebi ani nánu ewi kalɔ. Mmomu ɔda-nya uwi bawabane ku baƒɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɔdi uteyu. “ ‘Na ɔdi utanyi ɔkɔ. “ ‘Na bitataanyi ɔkɔ taatɔlɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɔdi utakpali-mi lɛnyi keeke na ubile ami bina Katɔti lɛnyi. Ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɔdi utanya nwuna ɔkpana utakya iye uyu-nwu na ulu ɔdi lɛlɔ. “ ‘Teni ƒula kabla ɔblane nwuna kayu bɔƒɔ na kadi kegye kasia egulabi ammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɔdi utewida ɔmumu iye eti lɛla lɛdi etile ɔnumbwɛne ulu mmomu bɛyia bina Katɔti. Ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: Be fair, no matter who is on trial—don't favor either the poor or the rich.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bitatɛ litemi likpidi na bɛnya ɔwabane ɔdi bɛkya iye binye ɔlakɛne ɔdi kama mmomu bɛtɛ bina bakpana litemi ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bitataalɔ bina bakpana anyikpi taavi. “ ‘Na ɔdi utabla lɛla lɛni maya na nwuna ɔkpanadi ngba buduo ɔgbankpi kemmo. Ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɔdi uteti ɔnwani litemi utakya kayi kemmo na uteekisi-nwu. Dɔnku ƒula ɔkpana ulu lɛlɔ nwaa kalɛ na nwuna likpidi lɛdi lilasia-a lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: “ ‘Tedie likpidi kasi iye ukyuli litemi litakya-a kayi kemmo ku kɔnyi. Mmomu yɔ ƒula ukyulikpana aani ƒula kalɛ.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɛdi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kaduɛ. “ ‘Bitaya na bebuo lidu bun bun inyɔ bakɔ lɛlɔ. “ ‘Bitava edula ebi lidu inyɔ bitasala na kemo kenwi kemmo. “ ‘Bitakya lɛwu lɛni na bédi ku unwo lɛbuli udu bun bun.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi ɔ́tɛnku ulekubi kabla ɔblane ɔni na béevele béte ukyuli ɔdi, nsu útalɛ tɔ ɔkpa na kesii kani na ɔkya iye bátaƒɔ-nwu tɔ lili kayu ni, ɔlɛka bani-ma kɔtɔ kɔni námanku. Nsu batadu-ma, ɔsika bátaƒɔ-nwu tɔ lili kayu na ɔkɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Na ɔkpane ɔdubuti kɔtɔ bukpi ebuo ɔmmɔ na ɔbla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala ute Unwoti na ɔnana ɔmmɔ likpidi lili. Na Unwoti ɔdubuti nwuna likpidi lɛni ɔ́bla mmɔ ɔ́kyiɛ-nwu.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si bitéduo kalɔ kammɔ kemmo na bɛ́va egyiibi ni, ɔdi utede egyiibi ammɔ adi utadi na akwa atɛ edeedi kemmo si ése kalɔ ku bɔnwu. Na bɛnu egyiibi ammɔ aani lɛla lɛni baládi.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Na lɛkwa linedi kemmo bɛnu egyiibi ammɔ aani egyiibi kedee. Na egyiibi ammɔ adubɔbla bumwi akpala ete Unwoti.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Nsu lɛkwa lɛlɔndi bɛkana na bɛdi egyiibi ammɔ adi kalɛ na egyiibi ammɔ adubutaanwu ebi pii teete-mi. Ɔsika Ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ukyuli ɔdi biala utadi lɛna lɛni na ubugya ɔmu ɔkya-ni kemmo. “ ‘Bitebo like iye bɛbla evo ala.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ukyuli ɔdi utakpɛ nwuna lɛlɔ akpanabi na ukpine ɔdi ɔsu iye uti lɛla lɛdi use lɛlɔ likpo. Ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ukyuli ɔdi utedie ɔbu ubidi ulekubi lɛlɔ na uti lɛlɔ ɔbla ɔyalɛ amu lɛyalɛ ala adubɔƒɔ kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ na uboku kɔnyi ku ulikplu ala bɔbla.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na bɛdi mina lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ na biti ɔbu bite mina Kevo Kasakɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɔdi utatálɔ ayu iye bekpine badi uteye lɛla lɛdi utenu ɔmmɔ ɔdububile-mii na biteese lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si bɛ́nu benengu bani náabi lɛlɔ ni, bɛta binye na bite bina batɔnkune ɔbu na biti ɔbu geen bite ami bina Katɔti. Ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ɔƒɔ ɔdi ulie-ɔ kudɔ na ƒula kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, tabla-nwu ukpidi ɔdi.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɔƒɔ ɔni nkya-a kudɔ ni, nu-nwu aani ƒula lɛlɔ ukyuli kani na ayɔ-nwu aani ƒula lɛlɔ kalɛ, ɔsika amii lɛnɔ bɛ́bla baƒɔ na Egyipte kalɔ dii. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: “ ‘Biti akyami akɔkula ku unu akɔkula ani námanku bitaakɔku ala. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti ɔni nákpanku-mii ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnii,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: “Su Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui anini, ‘Ɔnana biala na ɔdi Israelni iye baƒɔ bani nkya-mii akɔ na ɔdi úti ubidi ɔdi úte ɔnii bakpa bete Molek baƒiɔ ni, ɔlɛka bebo-nwu atabi badu.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Ndubuti mina lɛnumi lɛlɛ ukyuli ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na likulo-nwu lidie nwuna badi akɔ, ɔsika ubidi ɔni úti úte Molek mmɔ ɔ́ya na mina Adi Kevo keesé lɛlɔ na úbile-mi lɛnyi kedee.

english_verse: Some of you may let them get away with human sacrifice,
translation_verse: Na si úbebo úte ka bíni na bítadu ukyuli ɔni néti ubidi ɔ́kpa úte Molek baƒiɔ bammɔ ni,

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: na ami Unwoti ɔlati ndubuti mina lɛnumi lɛlɛ ukyuli ɔmmɔ ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli lɛlɔ na likulo-ma lidie bina akɔ. Ndubukulo ukyuli ɔmmɔ lidie-mii akɔ ku bani ƒui nsiaku-nwu na béti lɛlɔ bénwini aani bayalɛ na básiaku Molek baƒiɔ bammɔ.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ukyuli ɔni ndubusie bekyuli bani muubó like iye baakpali bekpine teeye ala teenu kudɔ na ama ku bekyuli bammɔ baabla lɛyalɛ ala ni, ndubo mina anumi budie bɔlɛ ukyuli ɔmmɔ. Na ndubɔda-nwu lidie nwuna badi akɔ.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bidie lɛlɔ sɛsɛɛ na bɛbla lɛlɔ kedee, ɔsika ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Bɛdi mina ɔda bubo ƒui lɛlɔ na bɛbla bɛsiaku-mu lɛlɔ, ɔsika ami ndi Unwoti ɔni mɔɔbla-mii kedee.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ukyuli ɔdi úwida uni iye ɔti ɔlɛka badu ukyuli ɔmmɔ. Na nwuna ubugya ɔdubɔsia anwu ɔlati lili ka úwida ɔti iye uni ɔsu.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ukyuli ɔdi ku nwuna ɔkpana ulekudi bátɛ ni, ɔlɛka badu bana inyɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi ku ɔti ulekudi bátɛ ni, ɔlɛka badu bana inyɔ bani nátɛ mmɔ, ɔsika ubi ɔmmɔ údie ɔbu na ɔti lɛlɔ. Na bana ubugya ɔdubɔsia ama alati lili.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ukyuli ɔdi ku ubidi ule bátɛ ni, ɔlɛka badu-ma na bana ubugya ɔdubɔsia-ma lili, ɔsika bábla likisila.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ɔnana ku ɔnana batɛ aani kalɛ na uleku ku ɔnana baatɛ ni, ɔlɛka badu-ma na bana ubugya ɔdubɔsia-ma lili.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi úti ubi ku uni ni, ɔlɛka bakyula-ma na likpidi lɛmmɔ udu lɛyii udu na lilakya-mii akɔ.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si uleku ɔdi ɔ́ni úde ebuo ɔdi ku kasusu ka batɛ ni, ɔlɛka badu uleku ɔmmɔ ku ebuo ɔmmɔ ƒui na bana ubugya ɔdubɔsia-ma lili.

english_verse: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi úti ɔnwani ulekubi, ɔti ubidi na ɔdi o-o, uni ubidi na ɔdi o-o ni, ɔdi kɔƒa ala bɔbla na ɔlɛka bedie-ma bana badi akɔ.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi ku uleku ɔni náƒɛ kɔnu iye ɔ́lɛ ɔtɔ bátɛ ni, údie-nwu kasɔngya na ɔ́nu-nwu uwi ɔni na uuuse sɛɛn, anwuɔsu ɔlɛka bedie-ma bana badi akɔ.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ukyuli ɔdi ku uni ɔnwani ulekubi iye ɔti ɔnwani ulekubi batatɛ, ɔsika ɔmmɔ ɔdubudie ɔbu na ƒula ɔtɔ iye kaduli bekyuli lɛlɔ na ɔlɛka bani bana inyɔ ƒui kɔtu.

english_verse: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi ku ɔti ɔnwani uleku bátɛ ni, údie ɔbu na ɔti ɔnwani lɛlɔ na bana inyɔ bebo lɛtuni, na bɔdubukpi na bana kaba kadi kelelie-ma kama.

english_verse: And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi úƒie ɔnwani ulekudi ɔƒɔ úti ni, bábla lɛla lɛni muusé lɛlɔ, na badubulie tawɔ tawɔ.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: “ ‘Anwuɔsu bɛnu ka bɛ́di mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ na bɛsiaku-mu siin kalɛ na kalɔ kani na líte-mii na bísela bulie keletuo-mii keledie aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔdala teedie lɛla biala.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Kadi bani bekyuli na ndubo bɔbɔku bɔlɛku kalɔ kani kemmo na bísela bulie mɛni ni, bitasiaku bana ɔbladu ukpidi kama, ɔsika ala ani muusé-mi lɛlɔ na nkisi mɛni udu na bátaabla.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: Nsu lɛ́su-mii nnini, “Bɛdubuti bekyuli bammɔ kalɔ, na ami ndubo-ka buti bute-mii na kenwini bina kadikɔ. Kalɔ kani egyiibi ntu mɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii.” Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti ɔni nédie-mii úse sɛsɛɛ úte lɛlɔ ɔ́siku kadi bamba bekyuli kudɔ.

english_verse: That's why you must make a difference between animals and birds that I have said are clean and unclean—this will keep you from becoming disgusting to me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Anwuɔsu bɛnu kaduɛ na bise bebuo bani nse sɛɛn ku bani neeese sɛɛn likpo. Na ɔdi biala ɔnu kaduɛ na utakun ebuo iye aasɛ iye bebweyi bani mɔɔkpɛ́ kalɔ na lɛ́su ka beeese sɛɛn mmɔ ɔdi na ubile lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: Bɛbla lɛlɔ kedee bite-mi, ɔsika ami Unwoti nse kedee na ami náƒuna-mii lɛ́lɛku kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ na líti-mii lɛ́bla mina bekyuli.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ɔnana iye uleku ɔdi ɔkya-mii akɔ na uubó like iye uuye bekpine ala teenu ni, ɔlɛka bibo-nwu atabi bɛdu. Na bana ubugya ɔdubɔsia ama alati lili.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Su Aaron bebi bani ndi bakpane anini, ‘Ɔdi biala utaƒuƒwɛ nwuna lɛlɔ bekyuli bani nékpi iye ɔni ude ukpine biala kalɛ kalɛ na ɔya na ɔsɔ na nwuna lɛlɔ lilabla sɛɛn,

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: iye ɔnwani ulekubi ɔni nételie tɔ kɔgya na ɔkya-nwu kalɔ, bana kukpi kemmo kani na ɔdubɔkana na ubile lɛlɔ lɛni.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Útalɛka ubile lɛlɔ na anwu ku ulekudi lɛlɔ bekyuli kɔna kɔdi kukpi ɔsu.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na bakpane betekpeyi bana eli iye ukwi amadɔ iye bekulo bana ɔlɔna kesii kadi na kukpi kɔdi ɔsu.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka babla lɛlɔ kedee bete Katɔti na balabla lɛla lɛdi belebile bana Katɔti lɛnyi, ɔsika ama muuti akpala ani na bákyula teete Unwoti ani ndi Katɔti adila. Anwuɔsu ɔlɛka babla kedee.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: “ ‘Útalɛka bakpane beti beleku bani nébile lɛlɔ na badi bayalɛ iye beti beleku bani nányonu bana bagya, ɔsika bakpane badi bekyuli kedee bete bana Katɔti.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka bekyuli banu bakpane ka badi bekyuli kedee, ɔsika ama muuti bina Katɔti adila teete-nwu. Biti-ma ka badi bekyuli kedee, ɔsika ami Unwoti ɔni nédie-mii líse sɛsɛɛ ka bise kedee nse kedee.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si ɔkpane ɔdi ubidi ulekubi úbile lɛlɔ na úti lɛlɔ ɔ́bla ɔyalɛ ni, úwi ɔti anumi kalɔ, anwuɔsu ɔlɛka bakya-nwu ogya kemmo bakyula.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɔkpane unengudi ɔni na béwi-nwu lili nnɔmii bése-nwu likpo na nwuna banwani akɔ ka ɔkya ɔkpane lɛwu lɛmmɔ utalɛ ka ɔnyonu nwuna kuli linwini uwi kalɛ kalɛ iye ɔni nwuna awu ɔbwɛ ka kekwa kada-nwu ɔsu.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.
translation_verse: Útalɛ ka uduo kesii kani na ukpine ɔtɛ na ubile lɛlɔ na ulése sɛɛn ina ɔti iye uni na ɔdi,

english_verse: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
translation_verse: iye ɔvi ɔlɛ Unwoti Adi Kevo kammɔ kemmo uteesie kekwa kalɔ na ɔya na ubile lɛlɔ ku Kevo kammɔ, ɔsika bédie-nwu bése sɛsɛɛ béte Unwoti na nnɔmii lili buwi bɔmmɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: “ ‘Ugblebi adagyaa na ɔlɛka uti.

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi ukpinele iye uleku ɔni béti bányonu iye uleku ɔyalɛ. Ɔnu ka adagyaa ɔni na ɔdubo buti mmɔ ɔ́si nwuna kaba kemmo

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: kalɛ na nwuna bebi balásɔ na bana kenyekɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti ɔni náƒuna-nwu úse sɛsɛɛ ka ɔbla kedee.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda ɔnini,

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Ɔnana biala na anumi ábwɛ-nwu iye ɔ́ƒɛ uwi kalɔ iye nwuna kakɛ kadi kásɔ uteti akpala utakpa utete-mi.

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: Na naaawia ukyuli ɔni na kɔnu iye ɔgba ɔ́gogolo-nwu ka uti akpala ute-mi,

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: iye ubo keƒu iye use klukwii iye lɛnumi linwi lɛɛɛdia-nwu iye ɔlɔna ɔlɛ ɔdi uukpóku-nwu iye agobɛɛ ébie-nwu.

english_verse: These men may not serve as my priests and burn sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Ɔkpane Aaron uwɔ biala na nwuna kakɛ kadi kásɔ utabla akpala bɔkyula ɔdi utete-mi.

english_verse: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: nsu ka nwuna kakɛ kadi kásɔ ɔsu ni, utakpɛ utede kakpakɔ bule kɔdi kɔmmɔ iye lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ na waya na mina Kevo kammɔ kese lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti ɔni mɔɔbla ala ammɔ ƒui kedee.’ ”

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Etemila amɛni na Mose ɔ́su Aaron ku nwuna bebi ku Israelƒuɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Katɔti úbo Mose ɔda ɔnini,

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: “Su Aaron ku nwuna bebi anii beti ɔbu geen bete ala kedee ani na Israelƒuɔ béboku na bábla-nya sɛsɛɛ béte-mi kalɛ na belebile-mi lɛnyi kedee. Ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: If any of you are unclean when you accept an offering for me, I will no longer let you serve as a priest.
translation_verse: “Su-ma anini, ‘Ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ni, bina bawɔ bani na ɔdi ɔ́sɔ ɔsu na beeese kedee batani betede etela ani na Israelƒuɔ béboku-mi na bábla-nya sɛsɛɛ béte Unwoti si ɔɔɔdi lɛni badubɔyila ukyuli ɔmmɔ udu. Ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ɔlɔna ɔlɛgyie uukpóku Aaron bawɔ ɔdi iye ɔdi ubo kanɔkɔ ɔlɛ ni, utalɛka ɔdi akpala adila adi útédu ka nwuna lɛlɔ lɛ́bla sɛɛn. Nwuna lɛlɔ lɛdubuse lɛlɔ lɛnɔ si útuku lɛla lɛni nétuku ukpine na liisé lɛlɔ iye si útuku ɔnana ɔni na lɛlɔ líbo-nwu,

english_verse: or if you have touched an unclean creature of any sort, including an unclean person.
translation_verse: iye útuku bebuo udu ɔni neeese sɛɛn ɔdi iye ukyuli ɔni neeese sɛɛn ɔ́ya na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ uusé lɛlɔ ni, ɔɔɔdi ka ɔdi adila ammɔ adi.

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛ bɔnu kama asa na ɔdubɔbla sɛɛn na ɔkana na ɔdi adila kedee ammɔ, ɔsika anwu ɔdi adidi na adi.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Utakun ebuo ukpine iye ebuo ɔni beƒiebuo nádu-nwu báva na ɔya na uteese lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bakpane ƒui ɔlɛka badi ɔda bubo bɔni líti muute-ma mɛni lɛlɔ kalɛ na baláƒiɔ na bekpi si bátanu ala ammɔ bátabu. Ami ndi Unwoti ɔni nédie-ma úse sɛsɛɛ líte lɛlɔ ka bese kedee.

english_verse: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɔƒɔ iye ukyuli ɔni naaadi ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔtɔ ukyuli iye ɔɔbla kabla teete ɔkpane ɔdi utadi adila kedee ammɔ.

english_verse: However, any slave that you own, including those born into your household, may eat this food.
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli uyedi ɔni na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ úti nwuna egulabi úye iye báwɔ-nwu na ɔkpane kaduli ɔkana na ɔdi nwuna adila.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Ɔkpane ubi ulekubi ɔni nlieku ɔnana ɔni na útasi ɔkpane kaba kemmo utadi adila kedee ammɔ.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Nsu si ɔdi ukpinele iye ɔ́lɛ kɔgya na uuubo bebi badi na ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie ulie ɔti kesii aani nwuna ligblebi uwi ni, ubo kuƒi ka ɔdi adila ammɔ adi biala. Ukyuli keeke ɔdi biala uuubo kuƒi ka ɔdi adila ammɔ.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Akpala etela ani na Israelƒuɔ bammɔ béboku Unwoti ni, bakpane bammɔ batabla na eteese lɛlɔ

english_verse: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy. Acceptable Sacrifices
translation_verse: na baya na ukyuli ɔni na útalɛka ɔdi adila ammɔ adi ɔdi nya na ɔƒiɔ na uti kɔtu bɔni uboku lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti ɔni nábla akpala ammɔ kedee.’ ” Akpala Ani Nátamanku

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar
translation_verse: “Bo Aaron ku nwuna bebi bananabi ku Israelƒuɔ bammɔ ƒui ɔda anini, ‘Si Israelni ɔdi iye ɔƒɔ ɔni nli Israelƒuɔ akɔ úti etela adi úboku ka babla akpala bɔkyula ƒui ɔdi uti udie lili na kenye kani na úse ɔsu iye kaƒɔ ƒaa akpala ni,

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ɔdi úti ebuo ɔ́siku nwuna bebuo akɔ ɔduboku ubabla unwi bɔbla akpala na kenye kani na úse ka udie lili iye kaƒɔ ƒaa akpala ni, uboku ebuo ɔni nátasɔ kalɛ na Unwoti ɔƒɔ ute-nwu.

english_verse: Don't offer an animal that is blind or injured or that has an infection or a skin disease.
translation_verse: Ɔdi uteboku ebuo ɔni na anumi ábwɛ-nwu iye ulesie kaduɛ iye ebuo ɔlɛne udu biala ɔnii beti basia lɛkpabi lɛlɔ bakyula bete Unwoti.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Si ɔdi ɔnii ɔɔbla kaƒɔ ƒaa akpala ni, ɔkana na uboku ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani iye uledi iye koƒonu kɔni na ɔ́si-nwu bɔwɔ kemmo na kesii kadi kásɔ, nsu ɔɔɔdia uuute lili budie na kenye kani na ɔdi úse ɔsu.

english_verse: As long as you live in this land, don't offer an animal with injured testicles.
translation_verse: Ɔdi uteti ebuo ɔni na nwuna agobɛɛ ábwɛ iye ása iye békulo-nya bédie uteboku ɔnii ubakpa ute Unwoti. Kuƒi kuuubo na ƒula kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni ka abla lɛni,

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: na bitaƒɔ ɔmmɔ udu bitasiku ɔƒɔ ɔdi lɛnɔ kudɔ ka biti bɛkpa aani lɛdila bite Katɔti. Unwoti ɔɔɔdubo-ma bɔƒɔ, ɔsika bétedu na bɔsɔ bɔkya-ma lɛlɔ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: “Si ebuo ɔdi ɔ́wɔ ɔmantɛ akɔ ubi iye koƒonu ubi ni, ɔlɛka ɔkya uni kudɔ emeyi maatɛ na ɔmmɔ kama ɔ́si limeyi maanedi úsela ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔƒɔ-nwu aani akpala bɔkyula ebuo.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Ɔdi utadu ɔmantɛ akɔ iye koƒonu ku ubidi limeyi linwi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: “Si ɔdi ébo ka ababla linugya akpala ni, bla akpala ammɔ kalɛ na Unwoti ɔƒɔ-nya ute-ɔ.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka badi adila ammɔ limeyi lɛmmɔ kani na lɛla lɛdi litebu utédu kadi bugye. Ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord.
translation_verse: “Bɛda mina ɔda bubo kaduɛ na bɛsiaku-mu kama. Ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
translation_verse: “Kɔ lɛsa na asu Israelƒuɔ anini, ‘Unwoti emeyi ani na údie úse ka Israelƒuɔ badubo butaasa ndi amɛni. Lɛnwunameyi

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: “ ‘Emeyi aku na bɛdubuti bɛbla bina kabla, nsu limeyi maatɛdi ni, lɛdi bɔsa kedee limeyi lite-mii. Na ɔdi utalɛka ɔbla kabla kadi na kesi kesii na bilie, ɔsika ɔdi Lɛnwunameyi ute Unwoti. Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi Bɔdi

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi biala utabla kabla kadi, ɔsika limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdi Likpidi Kɔtu Bɔni Budie Limeyi lɛni na báƒɔ bina lili likpidi kayu biala na bina Unwoti Katɔti anumi.

english_verse: Passover is another time when you must come together to worship me, and it must be celebrated on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: Kɔbuli kudeedi kɔni ndi Abib limeyi leevu-linedi lɛlɔ useyi uwi si ɔƒɛ úsela kanukɔ ni, na bise kalɔ bitaadi Unwoti Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Nsu na emeyi maatɛ ammɔ ƒui kemmo ni, na bitaabla akpala bɔkyula teete Unwoti. Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛlɔ ni, bɛsa bɔsa kedee na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ na ɔdi utabla limeyi ndi limeyi kabla kadi.’ ” Edula Edeedi

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: “Kɔ lɛsa na asu Israelƒuɔ anini, ‘Si bísie bítéduo kalɔ kani na líti muute-mii kemmo na bɛ́ƒɛ bina edula edeedi ni, na biti-nya bisienku ɔkpane.

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: Na biti edula ebi lɛkyami linwi lɛni béti bákɔ ɔlaaƒɔ na uukeye na biti nnɔ bɛsala-nwu kemmo na biti bɛbla akpala bɔkyula ammɔ bite Unwoti úbunku ntɛ akpala ɔsii unwi. Na akpala ammɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔdubɔyɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Ɔdi utadi bodobodo biala iye edula ebi ani na béƒi iye awɔdi úti útédu limeyi lɛni bíti akpala ammɔ bíbabla akpala bíte bina Katɔti. Na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni buse bute amii ku bina bawɔ ƒui na kesi kesii na bɛdubulie. Edula Bɔƒɛ Limeyi Bɔdi

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛmmɔ kani ndi ka ukyuli ɔdi utabla kabla kadi munu munu. Na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni ndubo bɔtɛ buteesie uwi ƒui ku bina bawɔ bawɔ na kesi kesii bɛdubo bulie.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɛka kwasida maatɛ ɔ́si lɛnwunameyi lɛni lɛlɔ na bíti bina edula ebi aboyo bíbakɔliku katɔ bɛ́tina Unwoti bíbo-nya kudu mmɔ.

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Na kesi kesii na bilie ni, kaduli biala basiku bodobodo inyɔ inyɔ ɔni na béƒi ku ɔlaaƒɔ ɔni muukeye na bɔnyii bɔkya-nwu kemmo biboku bibakɔliku katɔ bɛtina Unwoti bibo kudu aani edula ebi edeedi akpala.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Na biti baƒonu bebi maatɛ bani na ɔdi biala ɔ́ƒɔ lɛkwa linwi na bɔsɔ bɔdi buuubo-ma lɛlɔ ku ɔmantɛ akɔ unwi ku baƒonu bagyani inyɔ bibunku bodobodo ɔmmɔ. Ala amɛni na bɛdubuti bɛkyula ƒui úbunku edula ebi ku nwuna lɛlɔ ntɛ aani akpala bɔkyula na ana uyɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Bɛdu ketukpa bɛbla likpidi lili buvele akpala na bɛdu baƒonu inyɔ bani na báaƒɔ lɛkwa linwi linwi biti bɛbla unwi bɔbla akpala.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubuti baƒonu inyɔ bammɔ ɔkɔliku katɔ ɔtina Unwoti ubo kudu ku edula ebi edeedi bodobodo ɔmmɔ. Na adi Unwoti akpala kedee ani ndi ɔkpane ɔmmɔ adi.

english_verse: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na limeyi lɛmmɔ kani lɛlɔ ni, kɔ lɛsa na bɛsa bɔsa kedee na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ na ɔdi utabla limeyi ndi limeyi kabla kadi. Ɔda bubo bɔmɛni buse bute amii ku bina bawɔ na kesi kesii na bɛdubulie.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si bɛɛƒɛ bina edula ni, bitaƒɛ ana ƒui mmomu bibu adi bɛkya bina mmo amadɔ iye bibu adi bise bina kakpa kemmo bite bawabane ku baƒɔ bani nnkya-mii akɔ. Ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti.’ ” Kɔkpɛɛ Bɔvwi Limeyi Bɔdi

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: “Su Israelƒuɔ ka kɔbuli maatɛdi limeyi leevudi lɛlɔ ni, ɔdi Likpidi Kɔtu Bɔni Budie Limeyi. Bikisi lɛlɔ bɛsa bɔsa kedee na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ na bɛkyula akpala.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdi lɛnwunameyi lite-mii, anwuɔsu na ɔlɛka bikisi lɛlɔ. Na úti ɔ́si kɔbuli kɔmmɔ limeyi yaalenwidi useyi uwi úti útédu kadi kegye useyi uwi na ɔlɛka bɛdi Lɛnwunameyi lɛmmɔ.” Kevo Kemmo Bulie Emeyi Bɔdi

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lideedi lɛlɔ ni, na bɛƒɛ like ku kugyii kɔgba kɔni mbo evete na bɛdi limeyi lɛmmɔ ku lɛlɔyɔ na Unwoti Katɔti anumi emeyi maatɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: “Kɔ lɛsa na asu Israelƒuɔ anini, ‘Na kɔbuli maatɛdi limeyi leevu-lɛlɔndi lɛlɔ ni, Kevo Kemmo Bulie Emeyi bɔdi buusé kalɔ, na ɔdi emeyi maatɛ limeyi bɔdi.

english_verse: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.
translation_verse: Limeyi lideedi ni, bɛsa bɔsa kedee na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ na ɔdi utabla limeyi ndi limeyi kabla kadi.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Na emeyi maatɛ ammɔ kemmo ni, bitaabla ogya akpala bɔkyula. Na limeyi maanedi lɛlɔ bina ƒui bɛsa bɔsa kedee na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ na bɛbla ogya akpala bɔkyula bite Unwoti. Ka limeyi lɛmmɔ na bɛɛdi-ni bɛwɔlɔ ɔsu ni, ukyuli ɔdi utabla kabla kadi.

english_verse: I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days.
translation_verse: “ ‘Emeyi amɛni ndi Unwoti emeyi bɔdi ani na ɔ́lɛ ugyii úse na ɔlɛka akɔ-nya lɛsa ka adi emeyi kedee ani na ɔlɛka beboku akpala ani ƒui na badubɔkyula bete Unwoti ku ntɛ akpala ani bálɛ ugyii bése úte mina emeyi bɔdi.

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: Na emeyi bɔdi bɔmmɔ kemmo biti bina lɛnwuna emeyi bɔdi ku bina etela akpala ku bina kenye kani bise Unwoti ku bina kayi ƒaa etela bɛda bibunku.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: “ ‘Anwuɔsu ɔsi limeyi leevu-lɛlɔndi na kɔbuli maatɛdi lɛlɔ uwi ɔni bɛ́ƒɛ bina edula bɛ́wɔlɔ ni, na bɛdi limeyi lɛmmɔ emeyi maatɛ bite Unwoti. Na biti limeyi lideedi ku limeyi maanedi bɛbla lɛnwuna emeyi.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Na bitaadi Edula Bɔƒɛ Limeyi lɛmɛni lɛkwa biala na biteeti emeyi maatɛ taadi-ni. Na bitaadi-ni kɔbuli maatɛdi lɛlɔ. Na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni buse bute amii ku bina bawɔ.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo Israelni biala ɔlɛka ulie kevo kemmo.

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Babla lɛni kalɛ na bina bawɔ banu bati ka uwi ɔni na Israelƒuɔ bákya Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, ami Unwoti lɛ́ya na bílie nvo kemmo. Ami Ndi Bina Unwoti Katɔti.’ ”

english_verse: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Mose ɔ́kɔ lɛsa úte Israelƒuɔ na ɔ́su-ma uwi ɔni na beti bataadi Unwoti Emeyi.

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔdu ɔdi ebuo na ɔwia ɔbamba ɔsia-nwu kenye. Nsu si ɔdu ukyulikpana na badu-nwu anwu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔsu Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: “Su Israelƒuɔ na beboku nnɔ bɔni na bédie básiku nnɔ egyii kemmo na buse kede kede ute asogya ɔmmɔ kalɛ na utaada uwi biala.

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: “Ti akyami leevu-inyɔ ɔni na ana ƒui ese unwi na eti ɔlaaƒɔ na anwu bodobodo akya-nya kemmo na eƒi.

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: Na eti bodobodo atásia ala kasiakɔ kani béti sika ugyiedi bakwa-nwu lɛlɔ. Na atɛ-nwu ɔgaala inyɔ na ɔgaala biala ɔbla ɛku.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Na ɔgaala biala kudɔ na atu oloƒui alɛ-nwu kudɔ na uti ɔtina ka Unwoti adila adi mmɔ.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Lɛnwunameyi biala ni, ɔlɛka bodobodo ɔmmɔ ɔdi use Unwoti anumi aani lɛla lɛni Unwoti únyimi úte Israelƒuɔ ka bataabla.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Na bodobodo ɔmmɔ ɔdi Aaron ku nwuna kaba ɔdi. Na ɔlɛka badi bodobodo ɔmmɔ na kesii kani nse kedee. Ɔsika bodobodo ɔmɛni ɔdi adila ani nse kedee na beti bete Unwoti ka bakpane badi.” Ukyuli Ɔdi Útemi Úwi Katɔti Na Bébo-nwu Atabi

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛdi ni, kadɔ kadi kalɛ ɔnana ɔni ɔti ndi Egyipteni na unyɔdi ɔni ndi Israelni geen ntɛ. Na Egyipteni ubi ɔmɛni ɔ́tɛmi úwi Unwoti na ewida kemmo. Anwuɔsu béti-nwu besienku Mose kudɔ. Na ɔnana ɔmmɔ uni baalɔ banii Selomit na ɔ́si Dibri na Dan kaba kemmo.

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ɔ́su-ma ka beti-nwu batákya ɔtɔ na benye bagya Unwoti utédu ka wasu-ma lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔsu Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: “Biti ɔnana ɔni nétemi anyikpi mmɔ bɛlɛku bina kakyakɔ. Na bekyuli bani ƒui nénu nwuna enyekpi etemila ammɔ beti bana enu basia-nwu kuli na Israelƒuɔ ƒui bebo-nwu atabi badu.”

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Na si ukyuli ɔdi ɔtɛmi enyekpi na Unwoti lɛlɔ ɔlɛka badu-nwu. Na Israelƒuɔ ƒui bebo-nwu atabi badu. Si ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔdi ɔƒɔ o-o iye Israelni geen o-o ni, si útemi enyekpi na Unwoti lɛlɔ ɔlɛka badu-nwu.

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́du nwuna ukyulikpana ɔlɛka badu-nwu anwu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́du nwuna ɔkpanadi ebuo ɔdi ni, ɔlɛka ɔwia ebuo ɔmmɔ udu ute ɔlati. Lɛla lɛni ndi ngba ku ngba.

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́pila ɔkpanadi kalɛ kani na ɔpila-nwu mmɔ lɛni kani na ɔlɛka beti babla ukyuli ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni buse bute Israelƒuɔ ƒui ku baƒɔ bani nkya-mii akɔ. Ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti.’ ”

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Mose ɔ́su Israelƒuɔ na beti ɔnana ɔni nátɛmi enyekpi na bétébo-nwu atabi bádu. Na Israelƒuɔ bábla básia aani kalɛ kani na Unwoti úbo-ma ɔda.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Si ɔdi ɔɔyɔ́ ka uti kalɔ uye iye awɔ aayɔ́ ka eye kalɔ asiku ƒula ɔkpana kudɔ ni, bɛbu bɛnu akwa ani ntɛ anumi asa na wedu buti taakyiɛ lɛkwa ku edula ani na badubudie bɔlɛku mmɔ.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose uwi ɔni bákya Sinai kɔbi lɛlɔ ɔnini,

english_verse: This is a year of complete celebration, so don't plant any seed or harvest what your fields or vineyards produce.
translation_verse: Na lɛkwa lɛmmɔ kemmo utalɛka ukyuli ɔdi ɔva lɛla lɛdi na nwuna kemo iye ɔƒɛ edula ani na anya alati nánwu ebi na ɔdi utaƒɛ adingyii ani kɔgba kemmo na útedie.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: “Kɔ lɛsa na asu Israelƒuɔ anini, ‘Si uwi ɔni bítéduo kalɔ kani lɛ́su ka méti méte-mii kemmo ni, ɔlɛka bɛya na kalɔ kammɔ kakɛ bɔnwuna uwi ɔdi ɔsiku bina katuma kudɔ na ɔkɛnku amii ɔsu na kalɔ kammɔ kete Unwoti ɔbu.

english_verse: but the seventh year you must let your fields and vineyards rest in honor of me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Nsu lɛkwa maatɛdi lɛdi bɔnwuna lɛkwa ute kalɔ kammɔ aani lɛnwunameyi kalɛ ɔ́siku katuma kabla biala kudɔ. Na ɔdi bɔnwuna lɛkwa ute Unwoti. Na ukyuli ɔdi utava lɛla lɛdi iye udie nwuna adingyii ammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: This is to be a time of complete rest for your fields and vineyards, so don't harvest anything they produce.
translation_verse: Na edula ani nánu na anya alati ákwɛ na ákya ebi ku adingyii ani kemmo na bítedie ni, bɛsɔ bitesie bitatáƒɛ-nya iye bide-nya bɛkya ɔsa. Kalɔ kammɔ ɔlɛka kakɛ bɔnwuna lɛkwa lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na bina bebuo bani na bɛɛnyuɛ ku alakpi akɔ bebuo ƒui bakana na badi-nya. Kayu Buti Taakyiɛ Lɛkwa Limeyi Bɔdi

english_verse: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom
translation_verse: iye nwuna uni ɔnwani ɔnanabi iye benibi iye batibi iye nwuna ɔnwa ɔni nde-nwu ubo kuƒi ka ɔƒɔ kayu kammɔ na ɔlɛ ɔkpa kemmo iye si anwu ubakɛ lɛkɛ lɛdi ɔkana na anwu ɔlati ɔƒɔ kayu na ɔkɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Na aya na bavwi kakpɛɛ kammɔ bavi kesi kesii na kɔbuli maatɛdi limeyi leevudi lɛlɔ. Na limeyi lɛni ndi Likpidi Kɔtu Bɔni Budie Limeyi bɔdi mmɔ lɛlɔ ni, anwu ndi kakpɛɛ kammɔ bɔku limeyi.

english_verse: This fiftieth year is sacred—it is a time of freedom and of celebration when everyone will receive back their original property, and slaves will return home to their families.
translation_verse: Na lɛkwa lɛni na ɔ́sa akwa liti mmɔ ni, biti lɛkwa lɛmmɔ bɛbla lɛkwa kedee na bɛkɔ-ni lɛsa bɛsu ka lɛkwa lɛmmɔ lɛdi bɔnwuna lɛkwa. Na si ukyuli ɔdi úye ɔdi kalɔ ɔlɛka ɔsɔku kalɔ kammɔ ute ɔlati iye nwuna kaba kemmo ukyuli. Na ukyuli uyedi biala ɔlɛka unwini usie nwuna bawɔne kudɔ.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Lɛkwa lɛmmɔ ƒui lɛdi lɛkwa kedee ute-mii. Anwuɔsu bɛdi edula ani kani na anya alati nakwɛ na ákya ebi mmɔ.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: “ ‘Lɛkwa lɛni na ɔ́sa akwa liti mmɔ ni, si ukyuli ɔdi úye ɔkpanadi akɛla adi, na ɔsɔku ute ɔlati.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Na si akwa ani nebu emomo ni, ɔlɛka kuye kɔmmɔ kɔkɔ katɔ. Na si akwa ammɔ eeemomo ni, na ɔlɛka kuye kɔmmɔ kubo kalɔ. Ɔsika kalɔ kani na uuyé ute-ɔ mmɔ adanku edula bumomo bɔni na ɔdubo bɔkɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi utanya ɔkpanadi utamana ka ɔkɛ ɔkpanadi lɛlɔ kɔsia kɔni nátamanku. Mmomu biti ɔbu ku bɔyia geen bite Katɔti. Ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti.

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na kalɔ kammɔ kadubɔdia-mii edula na bɛdi bimo na bilie mmɔ ƒaa ku atu bɔyɔ.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: Na ngyi ka bɛdubo lɛlɔ buye bɛnii, “Bi adila na bɔdubo bɔdi lɛkwa maatɛdi lɛlɔ si bútava edula adi na bútaƒɛ adi lɛnɔ?”

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: Ami ndubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ lɛkwa lɛkundi kemmo ɔni na bina edula adubo bɔnwu geen ute akwa atɛ sɔɔn bɔdi.

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubo bina edula akukudi bɔdi ɔ́si uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo útédu ka bíse kalɔ bɛɛkya bina lɛkwa maanedi edula kalɔ. Na bɛdi edula akukudi ammɔ utédu lɛkwa yaalenwidi uwi ɔni bíse kalɔ bɛɛƒɛ bina edula.

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ukyuli biala uuubo kuƒi ka uti kalɔ kadi uye ute ukyuli bamba kusɛ kusɛ. Ɔsika kalɔ kammɔ ƒui kadi ami Unwoti kadi. Na baƒɔ na bɛdi na líte-mii mmɔ na bilie.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: Na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui kemmo ni, ɔlɛka bunyimi bɔdi bɔkya ka ukyuli ɔni néye kalɔ kadi úte ɔkpanadi ɔkɛ kuƒi na ɔsɔ ɔƒɔ nwuna kalɔ kammɔ uye ute lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: “ ‘Si kɔwaba kúƒie bina kadi ukyuli ɔdi na úti nwuna kalɔ kadi iye lɛkɛ lɛdi úye ni, ɔnwani ɔlɛka ubaƒɔ lɛla lɛni na úti uuyé mmɔ kayu ute-nwu.

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: ɔlɛka ɔbu ɔnu akwa bumomo bɔni návi uwi ɔni na úti nwuna lɛkɛ lɛmmɔ úye. Na ɔsɔku kabwɛkɔ kammɔ ute ukyuli ɔni néye lɛla lɛmmɔ ɔsiku-nwu kudɔ. Na ɔkana ɔsɔ ɔƒɔ nwuna lɛkɛ lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Nsu si uuubo egulabi adi na ɔƒɔ kayu kammɔ ni, lɛla lɛni na úti úye mmɔ ɔdi ukyuli ɔni néye mmɔ ɔdi úti útédu Kayu Buti Taakyiɛ Lɛkwa. Na lɛkwa lɛmmɔ lɛla biala na ukyuli ɔmmɔ úye mmɔ ɔlɛka ɔsɔku-ni ute ɔlati. Na ɔlati ɔsɔ utéti nwuna lɛkɛ.

english_verse: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ukyuli ɔdi úti nwuna ɔtɔ úye na ɔma unengudi ɔni na bátu awodu bámana kemmo ni, ubo kuƒi ka ɔsɔ ɔƒɔ nwuna ɔtɔ uye na lɛkwa limodi lɛmmɔ kani kemmo uwi biala.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Nsu si ɔtɔlati ɔmmɔ utakana kayu bɔƒɔ na ɔsɔ ɔƒɔ nwuna ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ lɛkwa lɛmmɔ kani ni, ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ únwini ukyuli ɔni néye ɔdi ku nwuna bawɔ uwi ƒui na utalɛka ɔsɔku ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ute ɔlatidi Kayu Buti Taakyiɛ Lɛkwa kemmo lɛnɔ.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Nsu akpaklɔ lɛtɔ lɛni na bátatu awodu bátakya lílieku alakpi akɔ ala iye mmo. Na bakana na baƒɔ kayu na ɔmmɔ lili na ɔlati ɔsɔ ɔƒɔ nwuna lɛla iye unwini usie ɔlati kudɔ na buti taakyiɛ lɛkwa.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: “ ‘Nsu Lewiƒuɔ ama bebo kuƒi uwi biala ka basɔ beye bana lɛtɔ lɛni bete-ma na lɛma lɛni bele bete-ma kemmo.

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔlɛka basɔku Lewiƒuɔ lɛkɛ lɛni ndi lɛtɔ lɛni béti béye béte-ma na Kayu Buti Taakyiɛ Lɛkwa uwi, ɔsika Lewiƒuɔ lɛtɔ lɛni bebo na lɛma lɛmmɔ kemmo kani ndi bana kese iye lɛkɛ.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nsu bebuo kadikɔ kɔlɔ kɔni bebo na bana lɛma utalɛka beti ɔdi beye. Ɔsika ɔdi Lewiƒuɔ kadikɔ úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si Israelni ɔdi ulie ude-ɔ na úbenwini ɔwabane na ulakana nwuna lɛlɔ bɔnu ni, na awɔ ɔni nlie ede-nwu ete-nwu kebunku aani kalɛ na adubute ukyuli ɔni na ɔɔbla kabla teete-ɔ kebunku kalɛ na anwu lɛnɔ ɔkana bina akɔ bulie.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Tevo-nwu egulabi adi na aƒɔ-nwu kuvonsia kɔdi iye teye adila adi tete-nwu na akɛ kɔsia kɔdi.

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti ɔni nédie-mii ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ na bísie bítélie Kanaanƒuɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ na lɛbla bina Katɔti.

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si bina kadi ukyuli ɔdi úbenwini ɔwabane na bina akɔ na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu úti lɛlɔ úye úte ɔdi ni, taya na ɔbla-a kabla aani ƒula kabla ɔblane bamba kalɛ.

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: Mmomu bla-nwu aani ukyuli ɔni néti ka ubabla kabla ute-ɔ na kayu kenye iye ukyuli ɔni nébo ubakya-a kudɔ uwi ɔdi na ɔbla kabla ute-ɔ uti utédu Kayu Buti Taakyiɛ Lɛkwa uwi.

english_verse: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ɔlɛka banyonu ɔwabane ɔmmɔ ku nwuna bebi na basɔ benwini besie betéduo bana ɔtɔ bekyuli akɔ na basɔ betéti bana bati akɛla.

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Israelƒuɔ badi mina kabla bablane bani na lídie lɛ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ, anwuɔsu utalɛka beti bana ɔdi beye bete ukyuli ɔdi na unwini-nwu kabla ɔblane.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi utasia ulikplu ulu lɛlɔ utadi-ma lɛlɔ, mmomu biti bɔyia bite bina Katɔti.

english_verse: or from the foreigners who live in your own country, and make them your property.
translation_verse: Na bibo kuƒi lɛnɔ ka biye bekyuli bani nási kaƒɔ bébo bakya-mii kudɔ ku bana ɔtɔ bekyuli bani na báwɔ na Israel na benwini bina kese.

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: Bibo kuƒi ka bɛbla bekyuli bammɔ na benwini bina bebi kese na bina kama na bɛbla-ma bina kabla bablane bana ƒui. Nsu ƒula Israelni ɔkpana anwu ni, tanya-nwu takya kalɛ biala.

english_verse: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɛya buti-nwu bɔnii ɔƒɔ ɔni nkya-a kudɔ úbenwini ɔlakɛne na ƒula Israelni ɔkpana úbenwini ɔwabane na úti lɛlɔ ɔ́bla kabla ɔblane úte ɔƒɔ ɔmmɔ iye ɔƒɔ ɔmmɔ kaduli ukyuli ɔdi.

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: Ina ka kabla ɔblane na ɔdi ni, ubo kuƒi ka nwuna ɔnwani

english_verse: by paying your owner for the number of years you would still be a slave before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni béye mmɔ ku ukyuli ɔni néye-nwu mmɔ ɔlɛka babu bɔnwuna kayu kani na ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ basi uwi ɔni béye-nwu útédu buti taakyiɛ lɛkwa. Na babu-nwu basiaku ukyuli ɔni na béti-nwu ka ɔbla kabla na lɛyuƒɔla kenye na akwa ammɔ kenye.

english_verse: The longer the time until then, the more you will have to pay.
translation_verse: Nsu si akwa ani nébu eeemomo asa wedu Kayu Buti Taakyiɛ Lɛkwa ni, ukyuli ɔni mɔɔƒɔ kayu mmɔ ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ kayu kani nébo kalɔ.

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka bada ukyuli ɔmmɔ aani ukyuli ɔni na buti na béti-nwu ka ɔbla kabla na kayu kenye ɔ́si lɛkwa útédu lɛkwa. Anwuɔsu bɛnu ka nwuna ɔlati uuunye-nwu lɛlɔ ulésusu-nwu kalɛ kalɛ.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na ina ukyuli uyedi ɔmmɔ útakɛ ukyuli ɔni na ɔƒɔ-nwu lili kayu ni, si Kayu Buti Taakyiɛ Lɛkwa lídu ni, ɔlɛka banyonu anwu ku nwuna bebi na betesie,

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: ɔsika kabla bablane na Israelƒuɔ badi-mi. Badi mina kabla bablane bani na lidie lɛ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti.’ ”

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɛdi mina lɛnwunameyi ƒui lɛlɔ na biti ɔbu bite mina kakyakɔ. Ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: ndubɔya na ɔnantu utaana nwuna uwi lɛlɔ na edula ataadia, na bina egyiibi lɛnɔ ataanwu ebi teete-mii kaduɛ.

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ndubɔya na bɛkɛ atu bɔyɔ na kalɔ kammɔ kemmo na bɛtɛ bɛlɛɛ ƒaa na ɔdi ulakya-mii liƒu lɛdi. Na ndubɔbɔku bebuo bekpidi lɛlɛku kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ. Na kewii kadi kelékpoku-mii na kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Bɛdubo bina bekisine bɔbɔku útédu ka bɛ́du-ma ku bina kuwii.

english_verse: Your barns will overflow with grain each year.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubo lɛkwa lɛni návi edula butaadi útédu ka bɛwia-nya kesekɔ kalɛ na bɛkɛ awɔdi kakyakɔ.

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ndubɔnu-mii ku lɛƒɔndia na lɛya na bɛwɔ na bimomo na lɛdi mina bunyimi lɛlɔ lite-mii.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔbla mina keliekɔ na bina akɔ na lɛɛɛdubo-mii buni ƒui.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔkya-mii akɔ na lɛbla bina Katɔti na amii lɛnɔ bɛbla mina bekyuli.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔni nédie-mii ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ kalɛ na bɛsɔ bilénwini kabla bablane bilete Egyipteƒuɔ. Na ami náƒɛ kɔgba kɔni nda-mii ƒui kalɛ na ɔdia-mii na bɛkɔliku bina eli katɔ na bisie bɛvi kaduɛ. Badubɔni Bani Naaadi Ɔda Bubo Lɛlɔ Kɔtu

english_verse: If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement,
translation_verse: iye bíni mina ɔda bubo na biikisi mina bunyimi na bɛ́ta bínye-mu lɛlɔ na bínwini kama bɛ́kya-mu ni,

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: ala ani ndubo mɛni na ndubo-mii bɔbla. Ndubɔya na liƒu ala ada alɛ-mii lɛlɔ kɔnakunwi na lɛya na lɛlɛ buɛ lidu ku lɛlɔ ogya bɔƒɔ buteekpoku-mii na anumi abwɛ-mii na biteekpi. Bɛdubo bina edula bɔva keeke, ɔsika adubunwini bina bekisine adi.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: Mina anumi adubɔlɛ-mii lɛlɔ na lɛya na bina bekisine badi-mii lɛlɔ. Na ama bani muukisi-mii mmɔ kalɔ na bɛdubo bɔkya na biteekeli uwi ɔni na ɔdi ulábɔku-mii.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si ɔmɛni ƒui kama bíni na biládi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni, bina kɔtu bɔni bɔdubo katɔ bɔkɔ akpa maatɛ bubu.

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔyila bina ɔyikun ɔni bɛ́kɛ ɔsu bɛɛtina lɛlɔ mmɔ kalɔ ƒui. Na lɛkalɛ kayaa kpakplaa na ɔnantu ɔsɔ ulana na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu na kalɔ kakwii kpakplaa aani lɛbuala ligyiedi.

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubo lɛlɔ bususu na bibile bina ɔyikun keeke, ɔsika kalɔ kammɔ kasɔ kaaadubo lɛla lɛdi bɔdia, na bina adingyii lɛnɔ asɔ aaadubo bɔnwu.

english_verse: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si bíni na bilenu-mi litemi mmomu mina lɛlɔ bɔta teenye ɔmmɔ kani na bísie anumi biidie taatina-mi ni, ndubɔya na bina lɛbibo lɛkɔ katɔ libu akpa maatɛ kalɛ na bina ekpidi aatina.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: Na ndubudie beƒiebuo lɛkya-mii na beƒie bina bebi, na bayila bina bebuo ƒui udu kede kede, na bina bumomo bubo kalɔ geen, na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bina lilu lɛtɛ kɔka ukpludi na bekyuli basɔ balasia-ni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: Na lɛya na bina bekisine beduo-mii lɛlɔ ku kuwii na bedie-mii kasi ka bítadi bunyimi bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu. Na si uwi ɔni na bísie bitáwia kabɛkɔ na bina lɛma linengudi kemmo ni, ndubudie lɛlɛ likpidi lɛkya-mii na lɛya na biduo bina bekisine enu kemmo.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: Na si líkulo bina adila bumomo kenye kɔnakunwi ni, beleku leevu badubo bɔkana na beƒi bodobodo bete bina kɔduli ƒui bekyuli na lɛyu linwi kemmo. Na badubo-nwu bule bute-mii wɛlɛ wɛlɛ lɛni na nwuna unu kenye, na si bɛ́di bilémo.

english_verse: I'll really get furious and punish you terribly for your sins!
translation_verse: ndubuti kɔnyi geen lɛkya-mii na lɛya na bina kɔtu bɔni bɔkɔ katɔ bubu akpa maatɛ.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubɔdu bina bebi bananabi ku belekubi muedi bɛkun.

english_verse: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Na bina kɔkpakɔ kɔni nkya abi ƒui eli ndubɔyila-ku udu na ligyingya bina oloƒui akpabi ammɔ na lɛsala bina bekpine liwi ala ekuku ani neeebo ngba mmɔ lɛlɔ na lini-mii ƒui kede kede.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔyila bina lɛma linengudi udu ku ekpo ani na biisié taatákpa na lini ala ani na bɛɛkyula mmɔ ɔnyi.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: Ndubo bina kalɔ bubile na kasɔ kaladia lɛla lɛdi bɔbla na si bina bekisine bánu na ɔbla-ma kɔnyana ku ɔtɔtɔ bɔgyu geen.

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Ndubo-mii bugyingya bɔkya kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ na liti mina kewii lɛbɔku-mii. Na lɛya na bina kalɔ ku bina lɛma linengudi ƒui lɛsɔ lɛtɛ ukpludi.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na katɛ ukpludi mmɔ na bɛsɔ bilábla-ka lɛla lɛdi mmɔ ni, kalɔ kammɔ kadubɔkɛ bɔnwuna bɔni na bítete-ka uwi ɔni na bɛ́kya-ka kemmo.

english_verse: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
translation_verse: Na bɛdubo bukpi bɔkya bina bekisine kalɔ mmɔ na kalɔ kammɔ kebweli-mii.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Na ama bani mebu lɛnɔ badubo bɔbla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ na bekisine bammɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔ́si bana ekpidi bɔbla ku bana bati ekpidi ani na bábla ɔsu.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: ɔsu na ami lɛnɔ lɛ́ta línye-ma lɛlɔ na líti-ma ńtákya bana bekisine kalɔ lɛlɔ, na si bana kayi kani lɛlɔ na bétekulo ekpidi bétedie mmɔ kébo kalɔ buɛɛ ku udu buni na báƒɔ bana ekpidi lili kayu ni,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: ndubunyimo lɛla lɛni na línyimi líse ɔ́siaku Yakob ku Isak ku Abraham lɛlɔ, na linyimo kalɔ kammɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Ɔsika badubɔda kalɔ kammɔ bewi na kakɛ kana bɔnwuna akwa ka basɔ balábla-ka lɛlɔ kabla kadi ɔsu. Na badubɔƒɔ bana ekpidi kayu, ɔsika béni mina ɔda bubo na bátadi mina litemi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: “ ‘Nsu ina amu ni, lɛɛɛdubo-ma atu budie uwi ɔni na bakya bekisine kalɔ mmɔ na lini-ma na bayii udu ƒui na lɛla lɛni na línyimiku-ma libie. Ami ndi Unwoti bana Katɔti.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Nsu na ama ɔsu ni, ndubo bunyimo bunyimi bɔni línyimi ku bana bati kuuku bani na lídie lɛ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ na kadi bamba pii anumi ka lɛbla bana Katɔti. Ami ndi Unwoti.’ ”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔda bubo ku bunyimi ku etemila ani na ɔ́lɛ ugyii na Sinai Kɔbi lɛlɔ úse ɔ́siaku Mose lɛlɔ ndi ani ndubo mɛni.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: “Kɔ lɛsa na asu Israelƒuɔ anini, ‘Si ɔdi úti ukyuli úte Unwoti ɔkɛnku kenye kani na úse ɔsu ni, ɔkana ɔsɔ ɔƒɔ-nwu uye ku kayu kani námanku.

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: “ ‘Lɛla lɛkpa leevudi biala na básiku kalɔ kemmo na ɔdi kalɔ kemmo edula iye adingyii ebi ƒui adi Unwoti ɔdi. Na ese kedee ete Unwoti.

english_verse: If you try to substitute any other animal, no matter how good, for the one you promised, they will both become holy and must be sacrificed.
translation_verse: Na utalɛka ɔvumana ebuo ɔmmɔ iye uti ebuo ɔbuni ɔvumana ebuo ɔlɛne iye uti ebuo ɔlɛne ɔvumana ebuo ɔbuni. Si ɔ́bla lɛni ni, bebuo bammɔ ƒui bese sɛsɛɛ bete Unwoti na bana ƒui bénwini nwuna badi.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Nsu si ukyuli ɔni nése kenye mmɔ ɔdi ɔwabane geen ni, na ɔkpanku ukyuli ɔni na úti úse kenye mmɔ usienku ɔkpane kudɔ na ɔsɔku kayu kani na ɔwabane ɔmmɔ wakana bɔƒɔ ɔkya-nwu.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si ukyuli ɔmmɔ kenye kani úse ɔdi ebuo ɔni námanku úte akpala buti bɔbla bute Unwoti ni, ebuo ɔni na úti uute Unwoti mmɔ use sɛsɛɛ.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Nsu si ebuo ɔni na úti úse kenye mmɔ útamanku ka beti bakpa bete Unwoti ni, ɔlɛka uti ebuo ɔmmɔ usieku ɔkpane

english_verse: But if you want to buy it back, you must pay an additional
translation_verse: Na si ɔlati ɔmmɔ ɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔƒɔ ebuo ɔmmɔ lili kayu na ɔsɔ ɔƒɔ-nwu ni, ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ kuye kɔmmɔ lɛkpa lɛlɔndi ɔsia-nwu lɛlɔ.

translation_verse: “ ‘Si ukyuli ɔdi úti nwuna kaduli úse sɛsɛɛ úte Unwoti ka kese kedee ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpane ɔnu-ka bɔdia ku tadia na kuye biala na wakya na kana lili ni, lɛni kani na ɔdubuse.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
