english_verse: The animals must have nothing wrong with them and are to be sacrificed along with the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Bitaabla ala amɛni ku ana lɛlɔ ntɛ akpala úbunku limeyi ndi limeyi akpala bɔkyula ku edula ebi akpala ammɔ lɛlɔ. Na bɛnu ka bebuo bani biiti teeboku ɔdi útasɔ.’ ”

english_verse: On the first day of the seventh month, you must rest from your work and come together to celebrate at the sound of the trumpets.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na kɔbuli maatɛdi limeyi lideedi lɛlɔ ni, bɛsa bɔsa kedee na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ na ɔdi utabla limeyi ndi limeyi kabla kadi. Limeyi lɛmmɔ ndi limeyi lɛni lɛlɔ bɛdubɔvwi kɔkpɛɛ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with the bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Na si bíti akɔ bɛɛbla akpala ni, na bɛwia edula ebi ɔlaaƒɔ akyami aku ɔni básala ku nnɔ na koƒonu kɔgyani akpala ni, bɛwia edula ebi ɔlaaƒɔ akyami ene

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: na baƒonu bakɔdi maatɛ bammɔ ni, bɛwia edula ebi akyami anyɔ bite koƒonu biala.

english_verse: You must also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Lɛnɔ ni, bite ketukpa kenwi na bɛti babla likpidi lili buvele akpala na Unwoti udie likpidi kɔtu bɔni bina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: These sacrifices will be made in addition to the regular daily sacrifices and the sacrifices for the first day of the month. The smoke from these sacrifices will please me. The Sacrifices on the Great Day of Forgiveness (Leviticus
translation_verse: Na bɛdubo akpala amɛni bɔbla bubunku abuli ku emeyi edula ebi akpala ku ntɛ akpala ani bɛɛbla aani kalɛ libo-mii ɔda ḿbavi. Na uyɔ ɔmmɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ. Likpidi Kɔtu Bɔni Budie Limeyi Buni

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. On that day you must rest from all work and come together for worship. Show sorrow for your sins by going without food,
translation_verse: “ ‘Na limeyi leevudi na kɔbuli maatɛdi lɛlɔ ni, bɛsala Israelƒuɔ ƒui na bɛsa bɔsa kedee na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ. Na bikisi lɛlɔ na bitabla kabla kadi limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and bring to the altar one young bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Biti akɔ unwi ku koƒonu kɔgyani kunwi ku baƒonu bagyani bakɔdi maatɛ bani nákɛ lɛkwa linwi na bɔsɔ bɔdi buuubo-ma lɛlɔ bɛbla akpala bite Unwoti na uyɔ ɔmmɔ ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔyɔ-nwu kaƒɔ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with the bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Na akɔ akpala ni, bɛwia edula ebi akpala ɔni ndi ɔlaaƒɔ akyami aku na bɛsala-nwu ku nnɔ. Na koƒonu kɔgyani kɔmmɔ ni, bɛwia ɔlaaƒɔ akyami ene.

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: Na baƒonu maatɛ bammɔ ni, bɛwia akyami anyɔ bite koƒonubi biala.

english_verse: A goat must also be sacrificed for the sins of the people. You will offer these sacrifices in addition to the sacrifice to ask forgiveness and the regular daily sacrifices. The Sacrifices during the Festival of Shelters (Leviticus
translation_verse: Na biti ketukpa kenwi bɛbla likpidi lili buvele akpala úte likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie úbunku limeyi ndi limeyi akpala ku ana edula ebi akpala ku ntɛ akpala. Kevo Kemmo Bulie Limeyi Bɔdi

english_verse: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na limeyi leevu-lɛlɔndi na kɔbuli maatɛdi kemmo ni, bɛsa bɔsa kedee na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ na ɔdi utabla limeyi ndi limeyi kabla kadi. Na bɛdi limeyi bonwu bite Unwoti emeyi maatɛ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the rams,
translation_verse: Na bakɔ leevu-ɛtɛ bammɔ ɔdi biala ni, biti edula ebi ɔlaaƒɔ akyami aku ani básala ku nnɔ bɛbla akpala ammɔ. Na koƒonu kɔgyani biala ni, biti edula ebi ɔlaaƒɔ akyami ene.

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: Na baƒonu bakɔdi leevu-ine bammɔ ɔdi biala ni, biti edula ebi ɔlaaƒɔ akyami anyɔ.

english_verse: You must also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin. These are to be offered in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na biti ketukpa kenwi bɛbla likpidi lili buvele akpala. Na bɛdubo akpala amɛni bɔbla bubunku bɔkyula akpala ku edula ebi akpala ku ntɛ akpala ani bɛɛbla limeyi ndi limeyi.

english_verse: For the next six days of the festival, you will sacrifice one less bull than the day before, so that on the seventh day, seven bulls will be sacrificed. The other sacrifices and offerings must remain the same for each of these days.
translation_verse: Na biti ketukpa kenwi bɛbla likpidi lili buvele akpala. Na bɛdubo akpala amɛni bɔbla bubunku bɔkyula akpala ku edula ebi akpala ku ntɛ akpala ani bɛɛbla limeyi ndi limeyi.

english_verse: On the eighth day, you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na limeyi maanedi ni, bɛsa bɔsa kedee na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ na ɔdi utabla limeyi ndi limeyi kabla kadi.

english_verse: Bring to the altar one bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Na biti akɔ unwi ku koƒonu kɔgyani kunwi ku baƒonu bakɔdi maatɛ bani nákɛ lɛkwa na bɔsɔ bɔdi buuubo-ma lɛlɔ bɛbla akpala na ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ ɔyɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ.

english_verse: You must also offer the proper grain sacrifices and drink offerings of wine with each animal.
translation_verse: Na akɔ ɔmmɔ ku koƒonu kɔgyani kɔmmɔ ku baƒonu bakɔdi bammɔ ni, biti edula ebi ɔlaaƒɔ akpala ku ntɛ akpala ani na bálɛ ugyii bése bibunku.

english_verse: And offer a goat as the sacrifice to ask forgiveness for the people. These sacrifices are made in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na biti ketukpa kenwi bɛbla likpidi lili buvele akpala. Na bɛdubo akpala amɛni bɔbla bubunku bɔkyula akpala ku edula ebi akpala ku ntɛ akpala ani bɛɛbla limeyi ndi limeyi.

english_verse: You must offer all these sacrifices to me at the appointed times of worship, together with any offerings that are voluntarily given or given because of a promise.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɛbla akpala bɔkyula amɛni ku edula ebi akpala ku ntɛ akpala ku unwi bɔbla akpala amɛni bite Unwoti na emeyi bɔdi ani na bédie bése lɛlɔ úbunku bina kenye kani bíse ku bina kaƒɔ ƒaa etela.’ ”

english_verse: Moses told the people of Israel everything the Lord had told him about the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na Mose ɔ́kɔ lɛsa ɔ́su Israelƒuɔ ala ani ƒui na Unwoti úbo-nwu ɔda.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to Israel's tribal leaders:
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ɔ́su Israelƒuɔ kaba batɔnkune ƒui ɔnini, “Unwoti uubó-mii ɔnii,

english_verse: Suppose a young woman who is still living with her parents makes a promise to the Lord.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si ugblebi ɔni na uli ɔti kaduli úse Unwoti kenye kadi iye ɔ́kpali ala ɔ́su lɛla lɛdi únyimi lɛlɔ na lɛla lɛdi lɛlɔ

english_verse: If her father hears about it and says nothing, she must keep her promise.
translation_verse: na ɔti únu-nwu linyese iye ala bɔkpali bɔmmɔ na útabala-nwu iye ɔsu-nwu lɛla lɛdi ni, linyese iye lɛla biala na ɔ́kpali ala ɔ́su lɛdubunye lɛni kani.

english_verse: But if he hears about it and objects, then she no longer has to keep her promise. The Lord will forgive her, because her father did not agree with the promise.
translation_verse: Nsu si ɔti úbulo lɛla lɛmmɔ úte-nwu ni, ugblebi ɔmmɔ linyese iye ala bɔkpali bulebo-nwu kemmo bulete-nwu lɛni na Unwoti lɛnɔ ulásia-nya kɔnu, ɔsika ɔti úbulo lɛla lɛmmɔ úte-nwu.

english_verse: But if her husband hears about the promise and objects, she no longer has to keep it, and the Lord will forgive her.
translation_verse: Nsu si uwi ɔni na ɔgyani únu ala amɛni na úbulo úte-nwu ni, úbile linyese ku ala ani na ɔ́kpali únyimi lɛlɔ mmɔ ƒui kemmo na Unwoti lɛnɔ ɔsɔ ulasia-nya kɔnu.

english_verse: Widows and divorced women must keep every promise they make to the Lord.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na kenye biala na ukpinele iye uleku ɔni na ɔgyani ɔ́nyonu-nwu ɔdubuse ni, lɛla lɛmmɔ lɛdubo-nwu bunyimi lɛni kani.

english_verse: Suppose a married woman makes a promise to the Lord.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si uleku ɔni na uliku ɔgyani úse kenye iye ɔ́kpali ala ɔ́su lɛla lɛdi,

english_verse: If her husband hears about the promise and says nothing, she must do what she said.
translation_verse: na ɔgyani únu kenye kani na úse mmɔ nsu útasu-nwu lɛla lɛdi iye ubulo ute-nwu ni, na kenye kani na úse mmɔ ku ala ani ndanku-nya adububo-nwu kemmo.

english_verse: But if he hears about the promise and does object, she no longer has to keep it. The Lord will forgive her, because her husband would not allow her to keep the promise.
translation_verse: Nsu si ɔgyani únu linyese lɛmmɔ ku ala ani na ɔ́kpali únyimi lɛlɔ mmɔ na úni-nya úte-nwu ni, úbile kenye kammɔ na Unwoti lɛnɔ ulasia-nya kɔnu.

english_verse: Her husband has the final say about any promises she makes to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɔgyani ubo kenyekɔ biala na ubile linyese lɛmmɔ kemmo iye ɔsia-ni kɔnu.

english_verse: If her husband hears about a promise and says nothing about it for a whole day, she must do what she said—since he did not object, the promise must be kept.
translation_verse: Nsu si ɔgyani útasu-nwu lɛla lɛdi limeyi limodi lɛmmɔ útalɛ kadi bugye ni, na ɔɔtina ka anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́sia linyese ku ala bɔkpali bɔmmɔ kɔnu ka ulekudi linyese lɛmmɔ linye sɔsɔ ka únu na útasu lɛla lɛdi ɔsu.

english_verse: But if he waits until the next day to stop her from keeping her promise, he is the one who must be punished.
translation_verse: Nsu si unu kenye kammɔ na uwi ɔdi kama asa na úbeni-ka ni, na uleku bɔƒiɔ bɔmmɔ bɔkɛ-nwu.’ ”

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave Moses about husbands and wives, and about young daughters who still live at home.
translation_verse: Ɔda bubo bɔmɛni na Unwoti úte Mose ɔkɛnku kɔna kɔni na ɔlɛ ka kɔkya ɔnana ku ulekudi ku ɔnana ku ubidi ulekubi ɔni na ɔmu ulie-nwu kudɔ ntɛ.

english_verse: “Before you die, make sure that the Midianites are punished for what they did to Israel.”
translation_verse: “Ta na atáni Midianƒuɔ kɔtu na lɛla lɛni bábla Israelƒuɔ ɔsu. Na ɔmmɔ kama adubo bukpi.”

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “The Lord wants to punish the Midianites. So tell our men to prepare for battle.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Mose ɔ́su Israelƒuɔ bammɔ ɔnini, “Bɛta na bɛtu akpagya na bɛklibi lɛlɔ na bitékpoku Midianƒuɔ. Na bɛni-ma kɔtu na lɛla lɛni bábla Unwoti ɔsu.

english_verse: Twelve thousand men were picked from the tribes of Israel, and after they were prepared for battle,
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bédie nkyuli apim unwi bálɛku kaba biala kemmo. Na nkyuli mpim leevu-inyɔ bátu akpagya bétékpo.

english_verse: Moses sent them off to war. Phinehas the son of Eleazar went with them and took along some things from the sacred tent and the trumpets for sounding the battle signal.
translation_verse: Mose ɔ́tala-ma na bésie bétékpo, na ɔkpane Eleasar ubidi Pinehas nákpanku-ma. Na anwu néti Unwoti Kevo kemmo ala kedee ku kɔkpɛɛ kɔni baavwi teete kati kadi ɔ́da.

english_verse: The Israelites fought against the Midianites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. They killed all the men,
translation_verse: Na bétékpoku Midianƒuɔ bamɛni aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo Mose ɔda. Na bádu banana bani ƒui nkya mmɔ.

english_verse: including Balaam son of Beor and the five Midianite kings, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba.
translation_verse: Na bádu Midianƒuɔ baga ɛlɔ na bani bádu mmɔ ndi Ewi ku Rekem ku Sur ku Hur ku Reba. Na bádu Beor ubidi Bileam lɛnɔ.

english_verse: The Israelites captured every woman and child, then led away the Midianites' cattle and sheep, and took everything else that belonged to them.
translation_verse: Na Israelƒuɔ béti Midianƒuɔ beleku ku banamu ku bana bakɔ ku bebuo ku bana akɛla bátɔlɔku

english_verse: They also burned down the Midianite towns and villages.
translation_verse: na bátu ogya bákya bana lɛma linengudi ku bana kuliekɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Israel's soldiers gathered together everything they had taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals.
translation_verse: Na béti-ma ala ani ƒui na béƒie báƒɔ ku bekyuli beƒiedi bammɔ ku bebuo bátɔlɔku.

english_verse: and said, “I can't believe you let the women live!
translation_verse: Úye-ma ɔnini, “Bi ɔsu na bítadu beleku bammɔ ƒui?

english_verse: You must put to death every boy and all the women who have ever had sex.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu bɛdu banana bammɔ ƒui ku beleku bani na ama ku ɔnana báatɛ dii.

english_verse: But do not kill the young women who have never had sex. You may keep them for yourselves.”

english_verse: The eastern border will begin at Hazar-Enan in the north, then run south to Shepham,
translation_verse: “ ‘Na ɔƒɛ kanukɔ ɔmii ɔdubɔsi Hasar-Enan utédu Seƒan.

english_verse: and on down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there, it will go south to the eastern hills of Lake Galilee,
translation_verse: Na ɔmii ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔsia ɔyu ɔsi Seƒan mmɔ utédu Ribla na Ain ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ na uti ɔsia abi kɔƒɔna na Kineret Ɛpu ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ.

english_verse: then follow the Jordan River down to the north end of the Dead Sea. The land within those four borders will belong to you.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ɔmii ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔyu ɔsia Yordan Ketu kɔmadɔ kɔmadɔ na útáwɔ Ɛpugyie. Na ɔmɛni ndubɔbla bina kalɔ ku lɛmii na lɛƒɛnyi lɛmmɔ ƒui.’ ”

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “You will receive the land inside these borders. It will be yours, but the Lord has commanded you to divide it among the nine and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Mose úbo Israelƒuɔ ɔda ɔnini, “Bɛtu egulabi bɛnu kalɔ kammɔ bule na bile-ka lɛni kani bite kaba yaalenwi ku kakɛ bekyuli bammɔ,

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have already been given their land
translation_verse: ɔsika Ruben ku Gad kaba bekyuli ku Manase kaba kakɛ bekyuli na Israelƒuɔ akɔ ama béete-ma bana kadikɔ kukuuku.

english_verse: across from Jericho, east of the Jordan River.” The Leaders Who Will Divide the Land
translation_verse: Na Yordan Ketu ɔƒɛ katukɔ na Yeriko ɔvi úti úsie ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ na kaba akpa anyɔ ku kakɛ bamɛni báƒɔ bana kadikɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: “Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun will divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: “Bekyuli bani anyi ndubo bɔlɔ mɛni ndubo kalɔ kammɔ bule bute-mii aani bina kadikɔ. Na ama ndi ɔkpane Eleasar ku Nun ubidi Yosua.

english_verse: One leader from each tribe will help them,
translation_verse: Na alɛ ɔtɔnkune unwi lɛnimi asiku kaba biala kemmo na ubunku kalɔ kammɔ bule kabla kammɔ.

english_verse: These are the men the Lord commanded to help Eleazar and Joshua divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bamɛni na Unwoti úbo ɔda ka bele Kanaan kalɔ kammɔ bete Israelƒuɔ.

english_verse: That way, the Levites will have towns to live in and pastures for their animals.
translation_verse: Na mmɔ na badubo bulie na beti kalɔ kammɔ babla bana bebuo kadikɔ.

english_verse: The pasture around each of these towns must be in the shape of a square, with the town itself in the center. The pasture is to measure
translation_verse: Na akɔku lɛgba mpim ɛtɛ asi ɔma ɔmmɔ keyi kakɛ na ɔƒɛ katukɔ mpim ɛtɛ na ɔƒɛ kanukɔ mpim ɛtɛ na katɔ kakɛ mpim ɛtɛ na kada kakɛ lɛnɔ na ɔma ɔmmɔ ɔkya ntɛ. Na ɔmmɔ ndubɔbla lɛma lɛmmɔ bebuo kadikɔ. Katamikukɔ Lɛma

english_verse: Six of the towns you give them will be Safe Towns where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection. But you will also give the Levites
translation_verse: “Lɛma ɛku na lɛma lɛni na adubute Lewiƒuɔ kemmo lɛdubɔbla katamikukɔ lɛma lite-ma kalɛ na ukyuli ɔni na ɔ́du ukyuli ɔdi na tati tati kemmo ukeli utábɛ nina ɔdi kemmo. Na asɔ ete-ma lɛma aavlene-inyɔ bamba ebunku.

english_verse: so they will have a total of
translation_verse: Na Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ lɛma lɛdubɔbla aavlene-maane ku bana bebuo kadikɔ kɔlɔ.

english_verse: Since the towns for the Levites must come from Israel's own tribal lands, the larger tribes will give more towns than the smaller ones. The Safe Towns (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Na lɛma lɛni bɛdubo Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ bute bɛsiku kalɔ kani na Israelƒuɔ badubo bule kemmo ni, bile-ka bite Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ kalɛ kaba biala bumomo buse. Na bidie lɛma pii bɛlɛku kaba kani bekyuli na bana lɛma limomo kemmo. Na bidie lɛma blii bɛlɛku kaba kani na lɛma blii suɛ na bebo kemmo.”

english_verse: by one of the victim's relatives. He will take revengefor his relative's death as soon as he finds you.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni bádu mmɔ lɛlɔ ukyuli ubo kuƒi ka ɔdu ukyuli ɔni nádu ɔkpanadi mmɔ udie-nwu kasi. Anwuɔsu si ɔ́nu-nwu ɔlɛka ɔdu-nwu.

english_verse: There are to be six of these Safe Towns,
translation_verse: Na lɛma ɛku lɛni bídie bísie mɛni ndubɔbla bina katamikukɔ lɛma.

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su Mose ɔnini,

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: After you have crossed the Jordan River and are settled in Canaan,
translation_verse: “Kɔ lɛsa na asu Israelƒuɔ anini, ‘Si bɛ́via Yordan Ketu na bítéduo Kanaan kalɔ lɛlɔ ni,

english_verse: choose Safe Towns, where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection.
translation_verse: na bidie lɛma lɛdi bise kalɛ na si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́du ɔkpanadi nsu útati útese asa na úbo lɛni ni, ɔkana ukeli usie nina ɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: If the victim's relatives think it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of these Safe Towns for protection and not be killed before a trial is held.
translation_verse: Lɛma lɛmmɔ lɛdubɔbla katamikukɔ ute ukyuli ɔni mɔɔwia ukeli bani mɔɔwia ka bedie kasi kudɔ, kalɛ na ukyuli ɔni nádu ɔkpanadi ɔmmɔ ulekpi asa na batɛku-nwu litemi.

english_verse: They will be places of protection for anyone who lives in Israel and accidentally kills someone. Laws about Murder and Accidental Killing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na lɛma ɛku lɛmɛni ndubɔbla katamikukɔ ute Israelƒuɔ ku baƒɔ ku ukyuli biala na ɔkya-mii akɔ kalɛ na si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́du ɔkpanadi ɔni na útati útese na ɔkana na ukeli usie mmɔ utátamiku.

english_verse: Suppose you hit someone with a piece of iron or a large stone or a dangerous wooden tool. If that person dies, then you are a murderer and must be put to death
translation_verse: Iye si ukyuli ɔdi úti kegyiikɛ kani na kakana kadu ukyuli na úti-ka ɔ́ƒiɛmi ukyuli ɔdi na ukpi ni, ɔdi ukyuli ɔdune na ɔlɛka badu anwu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Or suppose you get angry and kill someone by pushing or hitting or by throwing something. You are a murderer and must be put to death by one of the victim's relatives.
translation_verse: iye ɔ́ƒiɛmi-nwu kɔnu ku uukisi-nwu ɔsu na úkpi ni, ɔlɛka badu ukyuli ɔmmɔ. Na ukyuli ɔni bádu mmɔ lɛlɔ ukyuli ɔni nde-nwu ubo kuƒi ka udie ukyuli ɔdune ɔmmɔ kasi ɔnu-nwu.

english_verse: But if you are not angry and accidentally kill someone in any of these ways, the townspeople must hold a trial and decide if you are guilty.
translation_verse: ɔlɛka kadi batɛ ukyuli ɔni nádu ɔkpanadi ku ɔni nékpi mmɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli ntɛ litemi na ɔda bubo ulu ɔni ntɛ nse lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If they decide that you are innocent, you will be protected from the victim's relative and sent to stay in one of the Safe Towns until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Na ɔlɛka kadi bagyumana ukyuli ɔni nátati na ɔ́du ukyuli mmɔ na ukyuli ɔni bádu mmɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli kudɔ, na basɔku-nwu batákya katamikukɔ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na ɔdubɔkya mmɔ utédu ka ɔkpane unengudi ɔni na béwi-nwu lili nnɔmii bése-nwu likpo úkpi.

english_verse: and are killed by the victim's relative, he cannot be punished for killing you.
translation_verse: na ukyuli ɔni na ɔ́du mmɔ lɛlɔ ukyuli ɔ́nu-nwu na ɔ́du-nwu ni, kasi kadi na údie-nwu na útalɛ ka babu-nwu ka ɔdi ukyuli ɔdune.

english_verse: You must stay inside the town until the high priest dies; only then can you go back home.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdune ɔni nékeli útábɛ katamikukɔ ɔlɛka ɔsɔ ɔkya mmɔ utédu ka ɔkpane unengudi úkpi na ɔmmɔ kama ubo kuƒi na unwini usie nwuna ɔma ku nwuna kaduli.

english_verse: The community of Israel must always obey these laws.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni buse bute amii ku bina kaba ƒui na kesi kesii bɛdubo bulie.

english_verse: Death is the penalty for murder. But no one accused of murder can be put to death unless there are at least two witnesses to the crime.
translation_verse: “ ‘Si nkyuli inyɔ ku kama bédie kenye ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́du ɔkpanadi ni, ɔlɛka badu anwu lɛnɔ Nsu utalɛka badu ukyuli ɔdune ɔdi na ukyuli unwi kenye budie lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You cannot give someone money to escape the death penalty; you must pay with your own life!
translation_verse: “ ‘Ukyuli ɔdune ɔlɛka anwu lɛnɔ ukpi na kuƒi kɔdi kuuubo ka bete egulabi adi beti baƒɔ kukpi kɔmmɔ kayu.

english_verse: And if you have been proven innocent of murder and are living in a Safe Town, you cannot pay to go back home; you must stay there until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na si ukyuli ɔdi úkeli úsie katamikukɔ ɔma ɔdi kemmo utalɛka bete kuƒi kɔdi na ɔƒɔ egulabi adi uti uye ulu na ɔsɔ unwini uteesie nwuna ɔma uwi ɔni na ɔkpane unengudi ɔni nkya mmɔ útekpi tɔ.

english_verse: One day the family leaders from the Gilead clan of the Manasseh tribe went to Moses and the other family leaders of Israel
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdi ni, kɔduli batɔnkune bani nási Gilead ɔni ndi Makir ubidi na ɔdi Manase uwɔ kɔdua bekyuli bani nási Yoseƒ kaba kemmo bésie na bátánu Mose ku Israelƒuɔ batɔnkune na básu-ma banii,

english_verse: and said, “Sir, the Lord has said that he will show what land each tribe will receive as their own. And the Lord has commanded you to give the daughters of our relative Zelophehad the land that he would have received.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔni na Unwoti úbo-mii ɔda ɔnii bɛtu egulabi na bile kalɔ kammɔ bite Israelƒuɔ ni, ɔ́su kpakplaa ka beti bula ɔnwani Seloƒehad kadikɔ bete nwuna bebi belekubi.

english_verse: But if they marry men from other tribes of Israel, the land they receive will become part of that tribe's inheritance and will no longer belong to us.
translation_verse: Na si ɔƒɛni kalɛ bésie bétélieku Israel kaba bamba bekyuli ni, bana kadikɔ kadubo bunwini kaba kammɔ kadi na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu bula kadikɔ kani béti béte-bu mmɔ kadubo bɔƒana.

english_verse: Even when land is returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration, we will not get back Zelophehad's land—it will belong to the tribe into which his daughters married.”
translation_verse: Na si Israelƒuɔ kayu bɔkyiɛ lɛkwa limeyi bɔdi lídu ni, na badubuti bana kadikɔ kammɔ bebunku kɔdua kɔni kemmo na bélie kɔgya mmɔ na abu bula ɔtɔ kemmo bati kalɔ kalɛ-bu enu.”

english_verse: So Moses told the people that the Lord had said: These men from the Manasseh tribe are right.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Mose úbo Israelƒuɔ ɔda ɔni na ɔ́ƒɔ ɔsiku Unwoti kudɔ ɔnini, “Lɛla lɛni na Manase kaba bekyuli baasu mmɔ ɔdi ulu lɛlɔ geen.

english_verse: I will allow Zelophehad's daughters to marry anyone, as long as those men belong to one of the clans of the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔ́su Unwoti ɔɔsu ɔnini, Seloƒehad bebi belekubi bebo kuƒi ka belieku ukyuli biala na baayɔ́ si bana kaba kammɔ kemmo na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔ́si.

english_verse: Tribal land must not be given to another tribe—it will remain the property of the tribe that received it.
translation_verse: Na Israelni ɔtɔ ɔdi bati kadikɔ utalɛka kenwini ɔtɔ bamba bekyuli kadikɔ kalɛ na ɔtɔ biala bati kalɔ kadikɔ keteese teete ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ bekyuli kani.

english_verse: In the future, any daughter who inherits land must marry someone from her own tribe. Israel's tribal land is never to be passed from one tribe to another.
translation_verse: Na utalɛka kadikɔ kadi kasi kaba kadi kemmo kesie kaba bamba kemmo. Na kaba biala kadikɔ kadi bana ɔdi kani úsela ƒui.”

english_verse: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah the daughters of Zelophehad obeyed the Lord and married their uncles' sons
translation_verse: Na Seloƒehad belekubi bani ndi Mahla ku Tirsa ku Hogla ku Milka ku Noa bélieku bana ɔti banwani bebi na bana ɔti kaduli.

english_verse: and remained part of the Manasseh tribe. So their land stayed in their father's clan.
translation_verse: Na bana ƒui bélie agya na Manase ɔni ndi Yoseƒ ubidi ɔtɔ kemmo. Na bana ɔti kadikɔ kammɔ kasɔ kakya bana ɔtɔ ku kaba kani bási mmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave to Moses and the Israelites while they were camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Na ɔda bubo ku ala bamba amɛni na Unwoti úte Mose ka ɔkɔ lɛsa ɔ́su Israelƒuɔ na Moab kalɔ kani kewi ƒiaa lɛlɔ na Yordan Ketu kakɛ kani kede Yeriko.

english_verse: Now, turn around and go back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: Nsu amii ni, binwini kama na bɛsia Ɛpugyie ulu ɔni ntɔ-mii anumi mmɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: People of Israel, when we were in our camp at Mount Sinai, the Lord our God told us: You have stayed here long enough.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni kemmo na bɔ́kya Sinai kɔbi lɛlɔ ni, bula Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su-bu ɔnini, “Bíilie kɔbi kɔmɛni lɛlɔ bítu uwi bɛ́gya.

english_verse: Leave this place and go into the land that belongs to the Amorites and their neighbors the Canaanites. This land includes the Jordan River valley, the hill country, the western foothills, the Southern Desert, the Mediterranean seacoast, the Lebanon Mountains, and all the territory as far as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛta mɛni na biteesie Amoriƒuɔ abi lɛlɔ kɔlɔ kɔni nkya amadɔ mmɔ ƒui ku Yordan Ketu kɔwɛ kemmo ku abi lɛlɔ ku ɔkwalɛ ɔmmɔ kemmo ku kada kakɛ ku Mediterenia kalɔ ƒia lɛlɔ. Na bisie Kanaanƒuɔ kalɔ ku nwuna kama kakɛ útédu Lebanon abi lɛlɔ útédu Euƒrate Ketu bonwu kɔtu.

english_verse: I give you this land, just as I promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Now you must go and take the land. Leaders Were Appointed (Exodus
translation_verse: Bɛnu bɛti ka kalɔ kamɛni ƒui na líti muute-mii. Biteesie na bitéti-ka binwini bina kadikɔ. Kalɔ kammɔ na Lɛ́su líse ka ndubuti lite bina bati kuuku bani ndi Abraham ku Isak ku Yakob ku nwuna bawɔ.” Mose Údie Litemi Batɛne

english_verse: After I gave these instructions to the judges, I taught you the Lord's commands. Men Were Sent To Explore the Hill Country (Numbers
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo lɛ́su-mii lɛla biala na ɔlɛka bɛbla. Mose Údie Bekyuli Badi Ka Babɛ Besie Batánu Kades-Barnea

english_verse: You stayed in your tents and grumbled, “The Lord must hate us—he brought us out of Egypt, just so he could hand us over to the Amorites and get rid of us.
translation_verse: Lɛnɔ ni, bɛ́kya bina nvo kemmo bítaatɛmi taakya enwu kemmo. Na bɛ́su bɛnii, “Katɔti uukisi-bu, anwuɔsu na ɔ́ya na bɔ́ta bɔ́lɛ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ kalɛ na uti-bu ute Amoriƒuɔ na bebo-bu badu.”

english_verse: Right after the Lord commanded us to leave Mount Sinai, I told you: Israel, being your leader is too big a job for one person.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, ami Mose lɛ́su-mii ḿbavi uwi ɔni na bɔ́kya Sinai kɔbi lɛlɔ ka bina bɔtɔnku kabla kétulo-mi. Na ami lɛti naaakana kabla kamɛni bɔbla.

english_verse: God has even promised to bless us a thousand times more, and I pray that he will.
translation_verse: Na muuvele nnii Katɔti ɔni ndi bina bati kuuku Unwoti ɔya na bɛsɔ bimomo mpim mpim bibu na ute-mii kusɛ kusɛ na lɛla biala kemmo aani kalɛ na ɔ́su úse.

english_verse: But I cannot take care of all your problems and settle all your arguments alone.
translation_verse: Nsu dɛ na wabla na ami lɛti mataatɛ bina ala ani muukpóku-mii ku unyeƒi si ɔdi ɔlɛku ɔdi?

english_verse: Then I took these men, who were already wise and respected leaders, and I appointed them as your official leaders. Some of them became military officers in charge of groups of
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bekyuli bani náda anu na bebo ɔbu bani na amii alati bídie mɛni ni, lɛ́ya badi baanu bekyuli apim lɛlɔ na badi lɛnɔ baanu bekyuli eti anyɔ lɛlɔ na badi lɛnɔ baanu bekyuli liti lɛlɔ na badi lɛnɔ baanu bekyuli leevu lɛlɔ. Na ami lɛnɔ lɛ́sia-ma kɔnu ka batɔnku-mii.

english_verse: and others became judges. I gave these judges the following instructions: When you settle legal cases, your decisions must be fair. It doesn't matter if the case is between two Israelites, or between an Israelite and a foreigner living in your community.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, líbo-ma ɔda ka litemi biala na ɔdi weti weboku na badi Israelƒuɔ banwa lɛti lɛti iye Israelni ku ɔƒɔ ntɛ na ɔƒɔ ɔmmɔ ɔkya-mii akɔ ni, batɛ-ni ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: And it doesn't matter if one is helpless and the other is powerful. Don't be afraid of anyone! No matter who shows up in your court, God will help you make a fair decision. If any case is too hard for you, bring the people to me, and I will make the decision.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi utanu anumi utatɛ litemi lɛdi. Mmomu batɛ-ni ulu lɛlɔ. Ɔlakɛne na ɔdi o-o, ɔwabane na ɔdi o-o ni, batayia ɔdi biala. Batɛku ɔdi biala litemi kalɛ kani na ɔ́manku-nwu. Na mɔɔsu-mii nnii kalɛ biala na litemi lɛmmɔ lise ni, Katɔti ɔdubute-ma kasusu na batɛ-ni ulu lɛlɔ. Na lɛ́su-ma ka si litemi bɔtɛ bɔdi bútulo-ma ni, beti litemi lɛmmɔ beboku-mi na lɛtɛ lite-ma.

english_verse: even though he had always been with us in the desert. During the daytime, the Lord was in the cloud, leading us in the right direction and showing us where to camp. And at night, he was there in the fire.
translation_verse: ina ka anwu nágyu ɔtɔ-mii na útáwia ekpo ani na bɛdubulie na bɛnwuna úte-mii. Na anwu kani nátaawia ulu teete-mii. Anwu néteete-mii ogya na ɔɔtɔnku-mii usien na ɔɔyá na liƒlukutu lɛɛtɔnku-mii na limeyi kemmo. Katɔti Ɔ́ni Israelƒuɔ Kɔtu

english_verse: The Lord had commanded us to leave Mount Sinai and go to the hill country that belonged to the Amorites, so we started out into the huge desert. You remember how frightening it was, but soon we were at Kadesh-Barnea,
translation_verse: Na bitayiƒala kalɛ na bɔ́ta Sinai kɔbi lɛlɔ na bɔkɛ kalɔ kakwiidi bonwu kani mɔɔda liƒu kemmo na bɔkɛ ulu búsela Amoriƒuɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na Katɔti úbo-bu ɔda, na bútédu Kades-Barnea.

english_verse: and I told you, “We have reached the hill country. It belongs to the Amorites now, but the Lord our God is giving it to us. He is the same God our ancestors worshiped, and he has told us to go in and take this land, so don't hesitate and be afraid.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛɛnu kalɔ kammɔ ka kewi mmɔ. Biteesie na bitéti-ka aani kalɛ na Unwoti ɔni ndi bina bati kuuku Katɔti ɔ́su-mii. Na bitayia ukyuli ɔdi, na enu ataƒɛ-mii lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Then all of you came to me and said, “Before we go into the land, let's send some men to explore it. When they come back, they can tell us about the towns we will find and what roads we should take to get there.”
translation_verse: Nsu bínwini bíbo-mi kudɔ na bɛ́su-mi bɛnini, “Ya na bɔtala bekyuli badi na bagyu batɔ na betéyu kalɔ kammɔ banu. Na babasu-bu ulu ɔni ndia ntulo ka bɔsia, na basu-bu lɛnɔ lɛma libendi lɛni nkya amadɔ mmɔ.”

english_verse: It seemed like a good idea, so I chose twelve men, one from each tribe.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́nu ka lɛla lɛbuni na bɛ́su. Anwuɔsu lídie nkyuli leevu-inyɔ lɛ́siku kɔdua biala kemmo.

english_verse: and even brought back some of the fruit. They said, “The Lord our God is giving us good land.” Israel Refused To Obey the Lord (Numbers
translation_verse: Na béti edula ani nkya mmɔ adi bábatina-bu, na básu-bu ka bula Unwoti Katɔti kalɔ kani na úti úte-bu mmɔ ni, kaadia edula geen.

english_verse: You did not want to go into the land, and you refused to obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nsu bɛ́ta bínye nwuna ɔda ɔni na úbo-bu lɛlɔ, anwuɔsu kɔnu kútetuku-mii kalɔ kammɔ.

english_verse: We are afraid, because the men who explored the land told us that the cities are large, with walls that reach to the sky. The people who live there are taller and stronger than we are, and some of them are Anakim. We have nowhere to go.”
translation_verse: Na bɛ́sɔ bɛ́su bɛnii, “Wɛ bɔdubusie ɔƒɛni? Ɔsika bekyuli bani na bɔ́tala mmɔ básu-bu ka bekyuli bani nkya mmɔ bebo ɔlɔkplu na bákuku betulo-bu. Na belie lɛma libendi lɛni nina awodu ákuku ésie kayaa. Na bɔ́nu bekyuli bani na baalɔ-ma Anakƒuɔ lɛnɔ ka bakya mmɔ.”

english_verse: Then I said, “Don't worry!
translation_verse: Nsu lɛ́su-mii nnii, “Bitayia bekyuli bammɔ.

english_verse: The Lord our God will lead the way. He will fight on our side, just as he did when we saw him do all those things to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bina Unwoti ndubo-mii bɔtɔnku, na ɔdubo bina kekpo ƒui bukpo bute-mii aani kalɛ na bɛ́nu kalɛ na úkpo úte-mii na Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ

english_verse: And you know that the Lord has taken care of us the whole time we've been in the desert, just as you might carry one of your children.”
translation_verse: ku kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo. Na bɛ́nu kalɛ na ɔ́da-mii na úti-mii úbedu kesii kani bɔkya mɛni aani kalɛ na ubi ɔti ɔɔda ubidi.”

english_verse: But you still would not trust the Lord,
translation_verse: Nsu ɔmɛni kama ƒui ni, bítaƒɔ bina Unwoti Katɔti bítadi,

english_verse: You people of this generation are evil, and I refuse to let you go into the good land that I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: “Bina kaba kekpidi kamɛni kadi biala ɔgba ɔɔɔdubo bɔnya kalɔ kabuni kani na lɛ́su líse ka meti mete bina bati kuuku mmɔ lɛlɔ

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh is the only one of your generation that I will allow to go in. He obeyed me completely, so I will give him and his descendants the land he explored.
translation_verse: amu ntu Yeƒune ubidi ɔnanabi Kaleb lɛti. Anwu kani nwuna lɛgba ndubo kalɔ kammɔ bɔnya. Na anwu ku nwuna bawɔ lɛti ndubo kalɔ kammɔ bɔdi. Ɔsika ɔ́ƒɔ Katɔti ɔ́di ku nwuna kayi ƒui.”

english_verse: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, “Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.
translation_verse: Na ami Mose lɛnɔ mɔɔsu-mii nnii ɔ́si amii ɔsu na Katɔti úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya-mi na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ina awɔ Mose muedi ni, ƒula ɔgba ɔɔɔdubo kalɔ kammɔ bɔnya.

english_verse: Instead, I will let Joshua your assistant lead Israel to conquer the land. So encourage him.”
translation_verse: Nsu Nun ubidi ɔni baalɔ Yosua na unye-ɔ anumi mmɔ anwu ni, nwuna ɔgba ɔdubo kalɔ kammɔ bɔnya. Anwuɔsu kya-nwu ogya, ɔsika anwu ndubo Israelƒuɔ bɔtɔnku na betélie kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.
translation_verse: Amu na Katɔti ɔ́su bula ƒui ɔnini, “Bina bebi bani nátabi tɔ lɛlɔ kalɛ banu lɛbuni ku likpidi bati ni, bana lɛgba ndubɔnya kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ. Bebi bani bɛ́kya bítaasu bɛnii bina bekisine badubukpo bɔƒɔ ni, ama ndubo kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ bulie.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: Amu na amii ɔlati bídie kenye bɛnii, “Mose, sɔsɔ bɔ́ta búnye bula Unwoti Katɔti ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, bɔdubɔdi nwuna ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Na bɔdubɔta busie abi ammɔ lɛlɔ na butékpo ku bekyuli bammɔ aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔ́su-bu mmɔ.” Anwuɔsu bɛ́ta na bíti bina ekpola adala bɛ́kya na bɛ́tu akpagya. Amii bɛ́kali ka abi kalɔ lɛlɔ bɔkɔ busie bɔtɛ kalɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Bo-ma ɔda ka ɔdi biala utata utetékpo. Ɔsika lɛɛɛdubo-mii kama bunye. Na bina bekisine badubɔdi-mii lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: Lɛ́su-mii ala ani na Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ka nsu-mii. Nsu bina ɔdi biala úteti nwuna litemi. Mmomu bɔta na bɛ́ta bínye nwuna litemi lɛlɔ. Na amii alati bíti bina ekpola na bɛ́ta na bina lɛkantakpi kemmo bísie abi lɛlɔ kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ka bitékpo.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔ́ya na Amoriƒuɔ bani nli abi lɛlɔ kalɔ kammɔ amadɔ báta bábabi básiaku-mii aani kalɛ banwɛnwɛ lisu bonwu lɛɛta. Na bábi básiaku-mii na bádu-mii kaduɛ básiku Edom abi lɛlɔ kalɔ mmɔ laa útédu Horma.

english_verse: until the Lord said: Moses,
translation_verse: Amu na Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: Israel has wandered in these hills long enough. Turn and go north.
translation_verse: “Bɛ́ɛka bɛ́mana abi amɛni lɛlɔ bítu uwi bɛ́gya. Anwuɔsu bɛta na biti bina anumi bɛtina kɔmii kakɛ.”

english_verse: And give the people these orders: “Be very careful, because you will soon go through the land that belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They are afraid of you,
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-mi ka mbo-mii ɔda ɔmɛni ɔnini, “Kásɔ kébu blii na biduo bina banwani bani nási Esau kaba kemmo na beli Edom abi lɛlɔ kalɔ akɔ. Badubɔyia-mii, nsu mɔɔsú-mii nnii bɛ́nu kaduɛ na bana lɛlɔ.

english_verse: but don't start a war with them. I have given them the hill country of Seir, so I won't give any of it to you, not even enough to set a foot on.
translation_verse: Bitakya-ma kɔnyi kalɛ na bata bekpoku-mii. Ɔsika lɛɛɛdubo bana kalɔ kadi muedi buti bute-mii. Ɔsika ami líti Edom abi lɛlɔ kalɔ ku kana amadɔ ƒui líte Esau na úti ɔ́bla nwuna kadikɔ.

english_verse: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.”
translation_verse: Na si bídu Edom abi lɛlɔ kalɔ mmɔ ni, biti sika ɔƒualadi bɛƒɔ adila ku ntu bɔni na bɛdubɔdi na bɛni mmɔ kayu.”

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka bɔ́vi Edom abi lɛlɔ kalɔ kesii kani na bula banwani bani ndi Esau kaba béli mmɔ bɔ́wɔlɔ ni, búnwini anumi bɔ́tina Yordan Ketu kɔwɛ kada kakɛ ulu ɔni ntɛ Elat na Esion-Geber na bɔ́vi bɔkɛ kalɔ kakwiidi ulu ɔni ntɛ úsie Moab kalɔ kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Lɛ́su-mi ka ɔdi biala útakya Moabƒuɔ bani nkya mmɔ kɔnyi na bata bekpoku-mii. Si bɛ́bla lɛni ni, lɛɛɛdubo bana kalɔ kadi buti bute-mii. Ɔsika ami néti Ar ɔma ɔmmɔ líte Lot bawɔ ka beti mmɔ babla bana kadikɔ.”

english_verse: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdi kemmo ni, nka bekyuli bani baalɔ banii Emiƒuɔ nli Ar ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo. Bekyuli bammɔ bákuku na bemomo na bebo ɔlɔkplu lɛnɔ aani Anakƒuɔ.

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: Na Anakƒuɔ bamɛni ni, Moabƒuɔ bátaalɔ-ma banii Emiƒuɔ. Na kadi bamba baalɔ Emiƒuɔ bamɛni ku Anakƒuɔ bamɛni banii Raƒaƒuɔ.

english_verse: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them. Israel Crossed the Zered Gorge Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na nka Horiƒuɔ nli Edom abi lɛlɔ kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ asa na Esau bawɔ bábabɔku-ma na báyila-ma udu na béti kalɔ kammɔ beli aani kalɛ kani na Israelƒuɔ badubo bana bekisine bɔbɔku budie kalɔ kani na Katɔti úti úte-ma kemmo na bayila-ma udu.

english_verse: When we came to the Zered Gorge along the southern border of Moab, the Lord told us to cross the gorge into Moab, and we did.
translation_verse: Amu na Katɔti ɔ́su-bu ɔnini, “Bɛta na bɛvia Sered Ketu.” Na abu lɛnɔ bɔ́bla lɛni.

english_verse: The Lord kept getting rid of them until finally none of them were left.
translation_verse: Amu uwi ɔni bekyuli bani nédu kekpo busie mɛni békpi bása ƒui basa ni,

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: “Moses, now go past the town of Ar and cross Moab's northern border
translation_verse: “Ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni bɛdubɔsia Ar na Moab kalɔ kemmo na bitávia ɔmii na katɔ kakɛ.

english_verse: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.” More Nations That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́vi mmɔ bɛ́wɔlɔ ni, bɛdubudu Arnonƒuɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na si bíduo mmɔ ni, bitakya-ma kɔnyi na bata bekpoku-mii. Na si bɛ́bla lɛni lɛɛɛdubo Arnonƒuɔ kalɔ kammɔ kadi buti bute-mii. Ɔsika líti-ka líte Lot bawɔ ka beti-ka babla bana kadikɔ.”

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.
translation_verse: Asa na Arnonƒuɔ badubukpo baƒɔ kalɔ kani na Katɔti úti úte-ma mmɔ ni, na nka Reƒateƒuɔ nli mmɔ. Na ama na Arnonƒuɔ bátaalɔ banii Samsumƒuɔ.

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na Katɔti ɔ́bla úte Esau bawɔ bani nli Edom abi lɛlɔ kalɔ. Lɛni kani na ɔ́yila Horiƒuɔ udu na bana anumi, na úti kalɔ kani lɛlɔ beli ɔmwi mɛni úte-ma.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:
translation_verse: Na Awiƒuɔ bani nli akpaklɔ ani nsiaku lɛlɔ úti útédu Gasa ni, Kaƒtorƒuɔ bani nási Kaƒtor bébo bábadu-ma na béti bana kɔlɔ na belie mmɔ.

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: Amu na Katɔti ɔ́su-bu ɔnini, “Bɛklibi lɛlɔ na bítávia Arnon Kɔwɛ. Ɔsika líti Hesbon Ɔga Sihon ɔni ndi Amorini kalɔ lɛ́kya-mii enu kemmo. Bise kalɔ bitaadi kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ na biteekpoku-ma.

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-mii nnii ɔ́si ɔmwi ni, ndubuse kalɔ liti liƒu ntaakya kadi biala nkya ɔƒɛ kalɔ lɛlɔ kemmo na amii ɔsu. Badubuteenu bina lɛlɔ litemi na liƒu libendi lɛdubo-ma bɔda na amii ɔsu.” Israelƒuɔ Bádi Amoriƒuɔ Ɔga Sihon Lɛlɔ

english_verse: After we had crossed the Arnon and had set up camp in the Kedemoth Desert, I sent messengers to King Sihon of Heshbon, telling him that his nation and ours could be at peace. I said:
translation_verse: Amu ka búdu Kedemot kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo ni, mmɔ na lɛ́tala batu badi ku keyi buɛɛ kenye kadi ka batásu Ɔga Sihon ɔni nási Hesbon ka mɔɔsu nnini,

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: “Buvele na nda-a, ya na Israelƒuɔ bavi bina kalɔ lɛlɔ. Bɔdubusie siin bɔvia ɔni na buledie ulu bamba ɔdi.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: Lɛni na Esau bawɔ bani nli Edom abi lɛlɔ kalɔ ku Moabƒuɔ bani nli Ar bénu kalɔ na bɔ́via bana lɛmii ku Yordan Ketu asa na búduo kalɔ kani na Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka weti wete-bu kemmo.”

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: Amu na Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Bɛta na bitékpoku Ɔga Sihon ku nwuna bekyuli na bɛdi-ma lɛlɔ na biti bana kɔlɔ.”

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Amu na Ɔga Sihon ɔ́ta ku nwuna bekyuli ka bebekpoku-bu na ɔma ɔni baalɔ banii Yahas.

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Nsu bula Unwoti Katɔti uti Ɔga Sihon ku nwuna bebi ku nwuna bekyuli ƒui ɔ́kya-bu enu kemmo na bɔ́du bana ƒui kede kede.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Na bebuo bani nkya ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo ku bana ala ƒui ni, bɔ́da-nya búti búnwini abu adi.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Na ɔdanku ɔ́si Aroer ɔni ntɛ Arnon Kɔwɛ kenye ku lɛma lɛni nkya mmɔ ƒui úti útédu Gilead. Ɔma biala uuubo ɔni bútadi-ma lɛlɔ. Bula Unwoti Katɔti úti lɛma lɛmmɔ ƒui ɔ́kya-bu enu kemmo.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Nsu bútani bútede Arnonƒuɔ kɔlɔ ku Yabok Ketudɔ ku abinkpo kalɔ lɛma lɛni na bula Unwoti Katɔti úbo-bu ɔda ɔnii butesie. Mmɔ kani na bútesie.

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Tayia ɔga ɔmmɔ. Ɔsika líti Ɔga ɔmmɔ ku nwuna bekpone ƒui ku nwuna kɔlɔ lɛ́kya-a enu kemmo. Anwuɔsu kalɛ na ábla Amoriƒuɔ Ɔga Sihon ɔni nádi lɛga na Hesbon na kekpo kemmo ni, lɛni kani na adubɔbla Ɔga Og.”

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Bɔ́yila-ma udu ƒui na lɛma ku akpaklɔ ammɔ kemmo. Na bɔ́du banana ku beleku ku banamu bammɔ ƒui aani kalɛ na bɔ́bla Ɔga Sihon ɔni mɔɔdi lɛlɔ na Hesbon.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Nsu bana ɔmantɛ bebuo ama ni, bútadu-ma. Mmomu búti-ma ku bana ala ƒui búnwini bula adi.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, búkpo bɔ́ƒɔ lɛmii lɛni nkya Yordan Ketu ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ bɔ́lɛku Amoriƒuɔ baga inyɔ bammɔ enu kemmo. Úti ɔ́si Arnon Kɔwɛ ɔvi útédu Hermon Kɔbi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Mount Hermon is called Mount Sirion by the people of Sidon, and it is called Mount Senir by the Amorites.
translation_verse: Hermon Kɔbi kɔmɛni na Sidomƒuɔ bátaalɔ banii Sirion. Na Amoriƒuɔ bátaalɔ-ku banii Senir.

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: Búkpo bɔ́ƒɔ lɛma lɛni ƒui nwi ɔtantɛ ku Gilead kalɛkɛ ku Basan úti útédu Salka ku Edrei. Na lɛma lɛmɛni ni, nka Basanƒuɔ Ɔga Og útaadi-ni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: King Og was the last of the Rephaim, and his coffin is in the town of Rabbah in Ammon. It is made of hard black rock and is four meters long and almost two meters wide. The Land East of the Jordan River Is Divided (Numbers
translation_verse: Na Raƒa bekyuli ƒui kemmo ni, Ɔga Og lɛti pɛ nébu. Na binu! Nwuna lɛla lɛni lɛlɔ na ɔɔtɛ ni, nwuna bune butulo lɛgba leevu-ɛtɛ. Na nwuna bɔbɛbɛ bɔbla aani lɛgba ɛku. Na abuala lɛti lɛti na béti bábla lɛla lɛmmɔ. Na kamu kese Arnonƒuɔ ɔma ubendi ɔni baalɔ banii Raba ɔmwi kadi. Béle Kalɔ Kammɔ Béte Kaba Biala

english_verse: The Lord will let them defeat the enemy nations on the west side of the Jordan and take their land. Afterwards, you can come back here to the land I gave you.
translation_verse: Binye ku bina banwani na bikpo bɛƒɔ kɔlɔ kɔni na Katɔti ɔ́su ka wete ama lɛnɔ na Yordan Ketu ɔvi ɔmmɔ útédu ka ama lɛnɔ bákɛ bana kadikɔ aani kalɛ na amii lɛnɔ bɛ́kɛ kɔdikɔ kɔni na líti líte-mii asa na bɛsɔ binwini bibo bina keliekɔ.”

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, lɛ́kpali katɔ na lívele Unwoti kpakplaa nnii,

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: “O Ɔyikune Ƒui Katɔti, awɔ nése kalɔ eedie ƒula ɔyikun bonwu taatina ami ƒula kabla ɔblane ku ƒula akɔla budie taatina. Na ɔyikun ɔdi uuubo na katɔ iye kalɔ na ɔkana akɔla ebendi ani na aabla mɛni bɔbla.

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu muuvele-ɔ nnii ya na lɛvia lisie kalɔ kabunidi kani nwi Yordan Ketu ɔvi ngye na ntánu abi lɛlɔ kɔlɔ kɔbunidi kɔni nkya mmɔ ku Lebanon abi kalɔ kabuni kammɔ.”

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔ́si amii ɔsu ni, Katɔti úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya-mi na útakpete-mi. Mmomu úbo-mi ɔda ɔnini, “Da bɔtɛmi ya! Takpali-mi na ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ lɛnɔ!

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Kɔ sie na eténye Pisga Kɔbi lili na asia kalɔ kammɔ anu amana kaduɛ. Ɔsika aaadubo Yordan Ketu kamɛni bɔvia.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Mmomu lɔ Yosua na ebo-nwu ɔda na bekyuli bammɔ anumi na akya-nwu ogya, ɔsika kalɔ kani na ánu mmɔ ni, anwu ndubɔkpanku bekyuli bammɔ ɔvia Yordan Ketu na betéti mmɔ babla bana kadikɔ.”

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɔ́sɔ búlie kɔwɛ kɔni nde Bet-Peor ɔma kakɛ.

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: Bɛdi ɔda bubo bɔni ƒui mɔɔtina-mii mɛni lɛlɔ kalɛ na bɛdubɔkana na bilie kalɔ kani na Katɔti ɔni ndi Bina Bati Kuuku Katɔti úti uute-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Na biteti ɔda bubo bɔbambadi bɔdi bitebunku ɔda bubo bɔmɛni lɛlɔ. Iye bitada ɔdi bitedie lɛnɔ. Mmomu bɛdi Unwoti ɔni ndi bina Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔni líti muute-mii mɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.
translation_verse: Nsu amii bani nsiaku Katɔti kama kpakplaa bɛmu bilie ngba úti úbedu ɔmwi kadi.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔni na bilie ngba mɛni ni, binye kagyumana uwi biala kemmo kalɛ na bilayiƒala ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ. Na ala ani ƒui na bíti bina anumi bɛ́nu ni, biti bɛsu bina bebi ku bina bawɔ.

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: Na binyimo limeyi lɛni na bíbasiaku bina Unwoti Katɔti na Sinai kɔbi kaƒɔna. Mmɔ na Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Sala-ma lisu. Ɔsika mɔɔyɔ́ ka binu lɛla lɛni na mbo nte-mii kalɛ na bitaayia-mi na bitaabu-mi lɛnɔ uwi ɔni na bilie ngba mɛni. Na biti etemila ani bínu mmɔ bɛtina bina bebi na babla basiaku-nya lɛlɔ lɛni kani.”

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: Bíbo bíbenye kɔbi kɔmmɔ kaƒɔna na liƒlukutu bili bili bonwu lɛ́ƒɔ-ku lɛlɔ ƒui na ɔ́bla suu geen na ogya ɔɔda taasi-ku lɛlɔ teetédu katɔ ƒui na ɔ́bla suu geen.

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́tɛmi úte-mii ɔ́siku ogya ɔmɛni kemmo. Na bínu-nwu lɛdi bɛ́siku ogya ɔmmɔ kemmo, nsu bítanu-nwu udu biala bítati.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́tɛmi úte-mii ɔ́siku ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na bɛdubɔsia na bɛdi nwuna lɛla lɛni na únyimiku-mii lɛlɔ na bitaadi Ɔda Bubo Leevu bɔni na únweni ɔ́sia atabi bɛbɛ anyɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ka ntina-mii ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ ƒui kalɛ na bɛdi-mu lɛlɔ si bɛ́via Yordan Ketu bísela bitéti kalɔ kammɔ binwini bina kadikɔ. Katɔti Úbo Israelƒuɔ Ɔda Na Ala Avɔdi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: When God spoke to you from the fire, he was invisible. So be careful
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́tɛmi úte-mii ɔ́siku ogya kemmo na Sinai Kɔbi lɛlɔ ni, bítanu nwuna udu biala bítati. Anwuɔsu bɛnu lɛlɔ kemmo kaduɛ.

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: Na bitabla likpidi na bɛvɔ iye bɛnwi lɛla lɛni udu na lɛ́lɛ ɔnana iye uleku,

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: Na bitaya na lɛla lɛdi lɛkɔku-mii na bɛta bitákpa ala ani nkya kayaa na bina anumi aanu aani ɔƒɛ ku kɔbuli ku ayabi. Ɔsika anya na Unwoti Katɔti údie úte kayawi bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's people, because he rescued you from Egypt, that fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Nsu amii amu ni, Katɔti nékpo údie-mii ɔ́lɛku lɛbibo lɛni mɔɔda aani ogya gaganga kemmo na Egyipte kalɔ ka bɛbla nwuna bekyuli bani na bɛdi ɔmwi mɛni.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si amii ɔsu ni, bina Unwoti Katɔti úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya-mi na úse kenye ka ami Mose mina ɔgba ɔɔɔdubo bɔvia Yordan Ketu na liduo kalɔ kabuni kani na úti uute-mii na kenwini bina kadikɔ mɛni kemmo.

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: Mmomu ndubukpi bɔtɛ kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ ɔni na mina ɔgba ulavia Yordan Ketu kani na bɛdubo bɔvia ɔƒɛni busie kalɔ kabuni kani na bísela bitéti binwini bina kadikɔ mɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Na bɛnu kaduɛ na bitayiƒala lɛla lɛni na Katɔti únyimiku-mii mmɔ. Na bɛdi nwuna ɔda bubo lɛlɔ bɔni násu-mii ka bitavɔ iye bitanwi lɛla lɛdi bitese bitete lɛlɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si bɛ́bla lɛni ni, bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubuti kɔnyi. Ɔsika uukpó kogyulo na use aani Ogya na ɔkana na ɔkyula-mii.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-mii lɛnɔ nnii, Katɔti ɔdubo-mii bugyingya bɔkya kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ ɔni na bina ɛlɛɛ badi kani ndubo bubu na bana akɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: Na mmɔ na bɛdubo ala ani na bekyuli béti egyii ku atabi bánwi na bávɔ bɔkpa. Na kugyikɛ ku atabi ala ammɔ ebo anumi, nsu alákana bɔnu. Na ebo atu, nsu alákana lɛla lɛdi bunu. Na alákana adila adi bɔdi, iye enwenyi lɛla lɛdi enu.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Na si bíduo bukpoku bɔdi kemmo na ala amɛni aalɛ́ku-mii ni, mmɔ na bɛdubunwini bisie Unwoti kudɔ na binu nwuna litemi.

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti ubo lɛƒɔndia na ulada-mii ulanyonu iye ɔyila-mii udu na ulayiƒala bunyimi bɔni na anwu ɔlati únyimi ku bina bati kuuku.

english_verse: When the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt, you saw how he fought for you and showed his great power by performing terrifying miracles. You became his people, and at Mount Sinai you heard him talking to you out of fiery flames. And yet you are still alive! Has anything like this ever happened since the time God created humans? No matter where you go or who you ask, you will get the same answer. No one has ever heard of another god even trying to do such things as the Lord your God has done for you.
translation_verse: Na muuye-mii nnii baƒiɔ badi bésie kalɔ kadi lɛlɔ dii na bétédie bekyuli bálɛku kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ na béti-ma bábla nwuna bekyuli aani kalɛ na bina Unwoti Katɔti údie-mii ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ? Na bina anumi lɛlɔ ni, údie nwuna ɔyikun ɔ́tina-mii na ɔ́ya na lɛlɛ lidu lidu líbo bekyuli lɛlɔ, na údie akɔla lidu lidu ku ala ani mɔɔda liƒu geen ɔ́tina.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ya na bínu nwuna lɛdi bɛ́siku katɔ kalɛ na ɔda-mii kpakplaa na ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔdi ka bɛsia lɛlɔ. Na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ lɛnɔ ni, ɔ́ya na bɛ́nu nwuna ogya ɔni mɔɔda bonwu na ɔ́tɛmi ɔ́siku ogya ɔmmɔ kemmo úte-mii.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ka ɔɔyɔ́ bina bati kuuku ɔsu ni, ɔ́ƒuna-mii ka binwini nwuna badi. Na anwu ɔlati úbo úbedie-mii ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ku nwuna ɔyikun bonwu.

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: Na ɔni na bíti bísela ni, ɔ́bɔku kɔlɔ kɔni bekyuli mbo ɔyikun betulo-mii kalɛ na amii bɛkɛ kuƒi na biti kɔlɔ kɔmmɔ binwini bina kadikɔ aani kalɛ na use ɔmwi. Na aka ndi kalɔ kani lɛlɔ bilie mɛni.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛti nwaa ka Unwoti lɛti ndi katɔ ku kalɔ Ɔti. Na ɔdi biala ɔsɔ uuubo.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Na nwuna ɔda bubo bɔni ƒui líti líte-mii ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ni, bɛdi-mu ƒui lɛlɔ. Na lɛla biala na bɛɛbla ni, lɛdubɔtɛ lite-mii kaduɛ ku bina bawɔ ƒui. Na ɔmɛni ndubɔya na bilie kalɔ kani na bina Unwoti Katɔti úti uute-mii mɛni ka biti-ka bɛbla bina kadikɔ uwi ƒui. Báda Lɛma Libendi Béte Kabɛkɔ

english_verse: Moses said, “People of Israel, you must set aside the following three towns east of the Jordan River as Safe Towns: Bezer in the desert highlands belonging to the Reuben tribe; Ramoth in Gilead, belonging to the Gad tribe; and Golan in Bashan, belonging to the Manasseh tribe. If you kill a neighbor without meaning to, and if you had not been angry with that person, you can run to one of these towns and find safety.” The Second Speech: Moses Tells What the Lord Demands Israel at Beth-Peor
translation_verse: Na lɛma lɛmmɔ ndi Beser ku Romot ku Golum. Na Beser ɔdi Ruben kɔdua bekyuli ɔma ɔni ndi abi lɛlɔ kalɔ kakwiidi ɔma ɔni nsia ɔtantɛ. Na Romot ɔma ɔni nkya Gilead kalɔ kemmo ni, ɔdi Gad kɔdua bekyuli ɔdi. Na Golum na Basan kalɔ lɛlɔ ɔdi Manase kɔdua bekyuli ɔdi. Mose Údie Katɔti Ɔda Bubo Keyi

english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ na bébo beli kɔwɛ kɔni nde ɔma ɔni baalɔ Bet-Peor na Yordan Ketu ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ. Na kalɔ kammɔ kadi Ɔga Sihon ɔni ndi Amoriƒuɔ ɔga na uli Hesbon ɔma kemmo. Mose ku Israelƒuɔ békpo bádi ɔga ɔmɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: Na báƒɔ-nwu kalɔ bénwini bana kadikɔ. Békpo Ɔga Og ɔni ndi Amoriƒuɔ ɔga unyɔdi ɔni mɔɔdi lɛga na Basan kalɔ lɛlɔ na báƒɔ anwu kadi lɛnɔ. Baga inyɔ bamɛni mɔɔdi lɛlɔ na Yordan Ketu ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ na ɔvi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Na kalɔ kamɛni kadanku ɔ́si Aroer ɔni ntɛ Aron Kɔwɛ kenye úti útédu Sion Kɔbi kɔni baalɔ banii Hermon

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: ku kɔwɛ kakɛ kani nkya Yordan Ketu ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ úti útédu Mma Ɛpu si éti ésela Pisga Kɔbi kaƒɔna ƒui kadi bana ɔdi.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ɔ́lɔ Israelƒuɔ bammɔ ƒui ɔ́sala na ɔ́su-ma ala amɛni. Israel kadi bekyuli, binu ɔda bubo bɔni ƒui líti muute-mii ɔmwi mɛni. Bɛtɛya ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ na bɛnu ka bɛdi-mu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Do not murder.
translation_verse: Tadu ukyuli.

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Bula Unwoti Katɔti ku abu búnyimi linyese lɛdi na Sinai Kɔbi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi bula bati kuuku ku Katɔti nényimi linyese lɛmɛni. Mmomu abu bani nli ngba mɛni ɔsu na únyimi linyese lɛmɛni.

english_verse: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire,
translation_verse: Na kɔbi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, amii alati binu ka Katɔti ɔ́tɛmiku-mii ɔ́siku lɛgyavonku lɛni mɔɔda kemmo.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: Nsu ka bɛɛyia lɛgyavonku lɛmmɔ na bilayɔ ka bɛkɔ bisie kɔbi kɔmmɔ lili ɔsu ni, ami nénye amii ku Katɔti ntɛ na lɛ́su-mii ala ani na Katɔti ɔ́su. Na ami nénye Katɔti ku bina ntɛ uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo na lɛ́su-mii ala ani Katɔti ɔ́su.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔni nédie-mii ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ kesii kani nka bénye-mii lɛlɔ na bɛɛbla bana kabla.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: Bitese benwoti badi bitebunku-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: Bitavɔ iye bɛnwi lɛla lɛni nálɛ ala ani nkya kayaa iye kalɔ lɛlɔ iye ntu bɔni na kalɔ kemmo na bitaakpa.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Na tebo kalɔ takya baƒiɔ badi lili kalɔ iye akpa ɔdi. Ɔsika ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔni muukpó kɔgyulo. Na mɔɔní bekyuli bani muukisi-mii kɔtu ɔ́si bati ku bebi lɛlɔ útédu kaba katɛdi ku kenedi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: Nsu mɔɔbla lɛƒɔndia teete nkyuli ɛlɛ ɛlɛ bani mɔɔyɔ́-mi na baadi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: Takpali Unwoti ƒula Katɔti lɛnyi keeke. Ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubɔni ukyuli ɔni mɔɔlɔ-nwu lɛnyi keeke kɔtu.

english_verse: Show respect for the Sabbath Day—it belongs to me.
translation_verse: Se lɛnwunameyi likpo na abla-ni kedee, aani kalɛ na ami ɔni ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti líbo-mii ɔda.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Emeyi aku na ɔlɛka eti abla ƒula kabla.

english_verse: but the seventh day of the week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your oxen or donkeys or any other animal, not even those foreigners who live in your towns. And don't make your slaves do any work.
translation_verse: Nsu limeyi maatɛdi ndi ami Unwoti ƒula Katɔti Lɛnwunameyi lɛni kemmo na útalɛ ka abla kabla kadi, awɔ iye ƒula bebi iye ƒula kabla bablane iye ƒula bebuo iye baƒɔ bani nkya-a kudɔ babla kabla kadi. Na útalɛka bekyuli bani mɔɔbla kabla teete-ɔ babla kabla kadi lɛnwunameyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na awɔ lɛnɔ alábla kabla kadi.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: Bu ƒula ɔti ku ƒ'ini aani kalɛ na ami bina Unwoti líbo-mii ɔda na adubulie ngba gyɔlɔɔ na keyi kadubɔyɔku-ɔ na kalɔ kani na líti muute-ɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: Ɔda bubo bɔmɛni na Unwoti úti úte-mii uwi ɔni bɛ́sala binye kɔbi kɔmmɔ kaƒɔna. Na mmɔ bínu-nwu lɛdi bonwu bɛ́siku lɛgyavonku kemmo ku liƒlukutu bili bili kemmo na mmɔ use suu geen. Na únweni ala ammɔ ɔ́sia atabi anyɔ lɛlɔ na úti úte-mii. Na ɔ́sɔ útasu lɛla lɛdi útebunku ɔmmɔ. Liƒu Lɛ́da Israelƒuɔ

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bínu Unwoti lɛdi bɛ́siku kasuudikɔ mmɔ uwi ɔni na kɔbi kɔmmɔ kɔɔda mmɔ ni, bina benengu ku bina adua benengu ku baduɔti bébo-mi kudɔ na básu-mi banini,

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: “Bɔ́nu bula Unwoti Katɔti ɔyikun ku bukeye uwi ɔni na búnu-nwu lɛdi bɔ́siku lɛgyavonku lɛmmɔ kemmo. Na ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni na bɔ́nu bɔ́ti geen ka ukyuli ɔkana ulie ngba ina Katɔti ɔ́tɛmiku-nwu.

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Nsu buuye bɔnii bi ɔsu na buuti bula ngba butákya ɔgbankpi kemmo? Ɔsika lɛgyavonku lɛmmɔ lɛdubo-bu ngba bɔyila. Na bɔɔtí nwaa ka bɔdubo bukpi si bɔ́sɔ búnu bula Unwoti Katɔti lɛdi.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Na buuye bɔnii ukyuli ɔdi uulie ngba dii ka únu Katɔti ɔni nlie ngba lɛdi ɔ́siku lɛgyavonku kemmo?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Mose, awɔ kani teesie na eteenu lɛla biala na bula Unwoti Katɔti ɔsu-bu. Na enwini abasu-bu. Na lɛla biala ɔdubo-bu bɔsu ni, bɔdubo-ni lɛlɔ bɔdi.”

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Línu lɛla lɛni na bekyuli bamɛni básu-ɔ. Na lɛla lɛmmɔ lɛdia.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: Si lɛni na bekyuli bamɛni badubutaabla na beteeti ɔbu teete-mi na bataadi mina ɔda bubo ƒui lɛlɔ ni, lɛla biala lɛdubuteesie kaduɛ teete-ma, ama ku bana kaba bekyuli ƒui, ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui.”

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Teesie na atásu bekyuli bammɔ na benwini beteesie bana kɔkyakɔ.

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ Mose amu adubɔsɔ bɔkya-mi kudɔ mɛni na ndubuti mina ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ ƒui lite-ɔ. Na atina bekyuli bammɔ ɔda bubo etemila ammɔ kalɛ badi-nya lɛlɔ na kalɔ kani lɛlɔ bésela betélie mmɔ.”

english_verse: Israel, you must carefully obey the Lord's commands.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Israelƒuɔ, bɛnu kaduɛ na bɛdi ɔda ɔni na bina Unwoti Katɔti úbo mɛni ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: Bɛdi-mu lɛlɔ ƒui kalɛ na lɛla biala bɛdubɔbla lɛtɛ lite-mii na keyi kadubɔyɔku-mii na bilie ngba gyɔlɔɔ na kalɔ kani lɛlɔ bísela bitélie mmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: Ɔda bubo bɔmɛni na bina Unwoti Katɔti úti úte-mi ka ntina-mii. Na bɛdi-mu lɛlɔ na kalɔ kani na bɛdubo Yordan Ketu bɔvia na bitéti binwini bina kadikɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: And if you and your descendants want to live a long time, you must always worship the Lord and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Na bina ngba bulie uwi ƒui ni, bɛnu ka amii ku bina bebi ku bawɔ bíti ɔbu bíte bina Unwoti Katɔti. Na bɛ́di nwuna ɔda bubo bɔni ƒui líti muute-mii mɛni, lɛlɔ kalɛ na bilie kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ bitu uwi.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Israelƒuɔ, binu! Bɛnu kaduɛ na bɛdi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na ɔmɛni ndubɔya na lɛla biala lisieku-mii kaduɛ. Na bɛdubo bumomo bubu na kalɔ kani egyiibi ntu mɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii na bísela bitélie mmɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na Unwoti ɔni ndi Bula Bati Kuuku Katɔti ɔ́su úse.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: Israelƒuɔ, binu kaduɛ! Unwoti ndi bula Katɔti, na anwu lɛti pɛ kani nkya.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔlɛka bɛyɔ-nwu ku bina kayi ƒui ku bina kɔyu ƒui ku bina ɔyikun ƒui.

english_verse: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Biti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bitaatina bina bebi kaduɛ uwi ndi uwi. Na bitaatɛmi-mu lɛlɔ si bɛkya kaduli iye bɛkɛ bísela kesii kadi iye si bilie bɛɛnwuna iye si bɛkya bina kabla akɔ.

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Binweni-mu bɛsia lɛla lɛdi lɛlɔ na binyimi-mu bɛda bina enu ku atɛntɛ lɛlɔ aani linyimola.

english_verse: Write these laws on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates. Worship Only the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na binweni-mu bɛmana bina lɛtɔ kɔyaku eli ku kɔduli ɔban kɔyakun. Lɛla Lɛni Ndubɔlɛku-mii Si Bítadi Ɔda Bubo Bɔmmɔ Lɛlɔ

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: Bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubuti-mii ubeduoku kalɔ kani na ɔ́su úse ka weti wete bina bati kuuku bani ndi Abraham ku Isak ku Yakob ku amii lɛnɔ. Kalɔ kammɔ ni, lɛma libendi lɛkya-ka kemmo ku ala ani náƒɔ kuye na ɔɔɔdi amii alati náda lɛma lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: Na ala abuni éyi lɛtɔ lɛmmɔ kemmo ɔni na ɔɔɔdi amii náwia ala ammɔ bɛ́kya-ni kemmo ku abiɔ ani na ɔɔɔdi amii néku ku mmo bɔni na ɔɔɔdi amii nátuma-mu ku nnɔ egyii ani na ɔɔɔdi amii nálɛ-nya. Na si bɛ́di na bímo ni,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: bɛnu kaduɛ kalɛ na bina kasusu kalálɛ bina Unwoti ɔni náda-mii údie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ kesii kani nka bénye-mii lɛlɔ na bɛɛbla-ma kabla mmɔ.

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: Bɛyia bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔmmɔ na bɛkpa anwu lɛti. Na si biisé kenye kadi ni, bise-ka na anwu lɛti lɛnyi kemmo.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: Na bitakpa bekyuli bani nli amadɔ mmɔ baƒiɔ badi betebunku-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́yu atuɔkplu na bɛkya bɛɛkpá baƒiɔ bammɔ badi ni, Katɔti kɔnyi kɔdubo-mii lɛlɔ aani ogya na ɔdubɔkyula-mii na ɔyila bina udu ƒui ɔlɛku kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika Bina Katɔti ɔdi Katɔti ɔni muukpó kogyulo.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi utakɔku bina Unwoti Katɔti utanu aani kalɛ na bɛ́kɔku-nwu bɛnu na kesii kani baalɔ banii Masa mmɔ.

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: Na bɛnu kaduɛ na bɛdi nwuna ɔda bubo bɔni ƒui na úti úte-mii mmɔ lɛlɔ na bɛsiaku-mu kama.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ɔni na bina bebi badubo-mii buye banii, “Bi ɔsu na bula Unwoti Katɔti úbo-bu ɔda ka bɔdi nwuna ɔda bubo bɔmɛni ƒui lɛlɔ?”

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: Na bɛsu-ma bɛnini, “Uwi ɔdi nábavi ni, nka bɔdi bekyuli bani na Egyipteƒuɔ bénye-bu lɛlɔ na bɔɔbla-ma kabla. Na Unwoti néti nwuna ɔyikun unengudi úkpo ɔ́ƒɔ-bu ɔ́lɛku nwuna enu kemmo.

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Bɔ́nu ku bula anumi lɛlɔ kalɛ na Katɔti ɔ́bla akɔla budie taatina enengudi lidu lidu ku ala ani mɔɔda liƒu úti úkpoku Egyipteƒuɔ ku Ɔga Ƒarao ku nwuna kabla bablane benengu.

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Na údie-bu úboku mɛni kalɛ na uti kalɔ kani na ɔ́su bula bati kuuku úse ka wete-ma ute-bu.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: Na si bɔ́sia anu na bɔɔdi ɔda bubo biala na Katɔti úbo-bu lɛlɔ ni, ɔdubɔnu-bu aani bekyuli bani nse siin.”

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛsia anu na bitaadi nwuna ɔda bubo ku ala ani mɔɔtina-mii ɔmwi kadi mɛni lɛlɔ. Katɔti Ɔdubute-mii Kusɛ Kusɛ Si Bɛ́di Nwuna Ɔda Bubo Lɛlɔ

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Si Unwoti Katɔti úbunku-mii na bíkpo bɛ́di bina bekisine lɛlɔ ni, bɛnu ka bɛ́yila lɛla biala udu. Na bitanu ukyuli biala kɔnyana. Na bɛnu kaduɛ kalɛ na ɔdi uleduo bukpoku taanu bɔdi kemmo na ɔkpa bana baƒiɔ bammɔ badi.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubo-ma budie bute-mii na bɛbɔku-ma bɛlɛku kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ. Na mmɔ na ɔlɛka bɛyila-ma udu ƒui na bitanu ɔdi biala kɔnyana lɛnɔ. Amii ku-ma bitenyimi lɛla biala bitete lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́ya na bábla lɛni ni, bekyuli bammɔ badubɔkpanku bina bebi na batátaakpa baƒiɔ na benwini kama bakya bana Unwoti. Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na Katɔti uti kɔnyi ɔkya-mii na ɔyila-mii udu kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, bibo bana akpabi ƒui bɛbwɛ. Na bibo bana atabi ani baalɔ banii atabi kedee lɛnɔ bɛbwɛ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. Na bɛƒɛ bana lɛƒiɔgyii lɛni na bálɛ béte bana baƒiɔ beledi bani baalɔ Asera baƒiɔ. Na bibo bana baƒiɔ ƒui bɛkya ogya kemmo. Amii Ndi Katɔti Bekyuli Baƒunadi

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
