translation_verse: Bɛdi Unwoti Katɔti bekyuli kedee bani na ɔ́ƒuna ɔ́bla nwuna badi na kayawi bekyuli ƒui akɔ. Na bɛ́ƒɔ-nwu kuye geen.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna-mii, ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-mii litemi na úse bina bati kuuku kenye úse ɔsu. Na ɔkɛnku nwuna ɔyikun bonwu kenye na úkpo ɔ́ƒɔ-mii ɔ́lɛku Egyipteƒuɔ ɔga enu kemmo kesii kani na nka únye-mii lɛlɔ na bɛ́kya bɛɛbla kabla teete-nwu.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Na bɛti nwaa ka bina Unwoti Katɔti kani ndi Katɔti ɔni nkya na ɔɔdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi na ulalɛ-ni kama. Na ɔɔdi nwuna bunyimi lɛlɔ na uudie nwuna bɔyɔ taatina bekyuli bani mɔɔyɔ́-nwu na baadi nwuna ɔda bubo lɛlɔ útédu kaba apim apim.

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: Nsu bani muukisi-nwu ni, ulenye taanu-ma gyɔlɔɔ mmomu uudie taalɛ-ma anumi ku anumi na ɔyila-ma udu kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔdubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ utulo kadi bamba bekyuli biala. Na uláya na udinkɔ ɔdi wakya amii iye bina bebuo akɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na ɔyɔ-mii litemi na bimomo na ute amii ku bina bebi kusɛ kusɛ na bɛkɛ edula pii na bina adingyii ku nnɔ egyii mmo bɔbla kaduɛ. Na bina ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku baƒonu lɛnɔ bawɔ pii na kalɔ kani na ɔ́su bina bati kuuku úse ka wete-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Si bɛ́di ɔda bubo bɔmɛni ƒui lɛlɔ kaduɛ ni, bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubɔdi nwuna linyese lɛlɔ na utaayɔ-mii uwi ndi uwi aani kalɛ na ɔ́su bula bati kuuku úse.

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔɔɔdubo bɔya na ɔlɛ ɔdi ubo-mii lɛlɔ. Na uláya na lɛlɛ buɛ lɛni nébo na Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔdi webo-mii lɛlɔ. Mmomu kadi biala mekisi-mii ni, ɔdubɔya lɛlɛ lɛmmɔ udu libo bekyuli bammɔ lɛlɔ. Bɛyila Ɔma Biala Ku Bana Baƒiɔ Udu

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: Na ɔdi utéye lɛlɔ ɔnii, “Dɛ na wabla asa na bɔkana bekyuli bamɛni udu bɔyila? Ɔsika bebo ɔyikun bétulo-bu.”

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: Biteti kasusu kammɔ udu bitekpoku lɛlɔ. Mmomu binyimo kaduɛ lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́bla Egyipteƒuɔ ku bana ɔga.

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: Na bɛ́nu kalɛ na ɔkɛnku Unwoti Katɔti ɔyikun bonwu ku akɔla lidu lidu budie taatina lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔ́da-mii údie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na lɛni kani na ɔdubɔbla akɔla na bina akɔ si bɛ́siaku bina bekisine bani mɔɔda-mii liƒu mmɔ.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Na bekisine bani mekeli matábɛ ku bani ƒui mekeli kukpi ni, Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubɔya na ɔtɔtɔ bonwu ɔgyu-ma na bekpi kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si bɛ́da bɛ́lɛ-ma lɛlɔ na kekpo kemmo ni, bitaya bana lɛlɔ liƒu lɛda-mii. Ɔsika bina Unwoti Katɔti údu na ɔkya-mii akɔ na ɔɔda liƒu, na anwu ndubukpo ute-mii.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́ ka bitaayila kadi bamba bekyuli bammɔ udu blii blii, na ɔɔɔdi kɔnakunwi. Ɔsika si bítabla lɛni ni, beƒiebuo badubumomo betulo-mii.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubɔdi baga bammɔ lɛlɔ na ɔdi ɔsɔ ulenyimo si bélie ngba dii. Na ɔdi ulakana-mii bunye bɔsiaku lɛnɔ.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́di kadi bekyuli badi lɛlɔ ni, bɛkyula bana baƒiɔ bani na bátu bálɛ. Nsu ɔdi biala ɔnu kaduɛ na anumi etegyie-nwu na bana sika ugyiedi iye ɔƒualadi ɔni na béti bámana bana baƒiɔ bammɔ lɛlɔ na ɔdi ɔsu ɔnii uuti ɔdi. Ɔsika Katɔti ukisi ala ammɔ na adi kakpagyuɛ ete-mii.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: Si bɛ́sia anu na bɛɛdi ɔda bubo bɔni muute-mii ɔmwi mɛni ƒui lɛlɔ ni, bɛdubusie na bitélie kalɔ kani na Unwoti úse kenye ka weti wete bina bati kuuku mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na bɛdubulie mmɔ na bimomo na biti kalɔ kammɔ binwini bina ɔdi.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔ́ya na kɔka kɔ́da-mii na úte-mii adila ani baalɔ banii manna ɔ́siku Katɔ na bɛ́di. Na adila ammɔ udu ni, bina bati kuuku iye amii bina ɔdi útanu-nya kudii. Ɔ́bla ɔmɛni ɔ́tina-mii na biti bɛtɛya ala ka ɔɔɔdi lɛdila lɛti pɛ muute ukyuli ngba. Mmomu litemi biala na lɛ́si Katɔti kudɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi muute ngba geen bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛya na ɔbla-mii kasusu ka kalɛ kani na si bina bebi bábla ala ani naaadia na bɛɛdɔnku-ma ni, lɛni kani na si amii lɛnɔ bɛ́bla ala ani naaadia Unwoti Katɔti lɛnɔ na ɔdubɔdɔnku-mii.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Bɛdi ɔda bubo bɔni na bina Unwoti Katɔti úti úte-mii mɛni lɛlɔ, na bɛsia-mu kama na biti ɔbu bite-nwu.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubuti-mii ubeduoku kalɔ kani na kadia kemmo. Ntukpa búyi-ka, na aba ntu lɛnɔ bɔkya mmɔ, na abiɔ ntu aalɛ́ abinkpo lɛlɔ ku awɛ kemmo.

english_verse: You can dig for copper in those hills, and the stones are made of iron ore. And you won't go hungry. Wheat and barley fields are everywhere, and so are vineyards and orchards full of fig, pomegranate, and olive trees, and there is plenty of honey. Don't Forget the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na si bílie kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ni, kɔka kulada-mii kudii iye bilayaki lɛla lɛdi. Na atakpɛ ammɔ kemmo ni, bɛdubɔkɛ abuala ani na beeti taakywɛ kɔlɛmii. Na abuala kpakplaa ku ani nse kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ lɛnɔ akya abi ammɔ kemmo. Bitedie Atu Na Nwuna Ɔda Bubo Lɛlɔ

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Si bɛ́di na bímo ni, binyimo na biti linugya bite bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔkɛnku kalɔ kabuni kani na úti úte-mii ɔsu.

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: Na bise likpo na bitayiƒala Unwoti Katɔti. Na bitedie atu na nwuna ɔda bubo ku nwuna ala bɔtina bɔni líti muute-mii ɔmwi mɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́di bímo na bɛ́tu lɛtɔ lɛbuni na bilie-ni kemmo

english_verse: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.
translation_verse: na bina ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku baƒonu báwɔ pii na sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi ku akɛla bamba émomo ni,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: bɛnu kaduɛ na bilatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ na bɛyiƒala bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔni nébedie-mii na Egyipteƒuɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ kesii kani na bénye-mii lɛlɔ na bɛɛbla bana kabla.

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: Na binyimo kalɛ na ɔ́tɔnku-mii na kalɔ kakwiidi bonwu kamɛni kemmo, kesii kani na balakpi bekpidi ku batamlukpa bakya. Ntu bútakya mmɔ, nsu Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́ya na ntu bɔ́bwɛ bɔ́lɛ lɛtakpɛ kemmo na bɛ́ni.

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: Na úte-mii adila ani ndi manna na kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo. Na adila ɔmmɔ udu ni, bina bati kuuku muedi bátati-nya kudii. Na Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́bla ɔmɛni ɔnii ɔɔnu si bɛdubɔti ka anwu nda-mii, na ɔkɔku bina bɔƒɔtaadi ɔnu kalɛ na weti ala abuni wete-mii na kawɔlɔkɔ ku kaƒɔ ƒaa.

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́kɛ akɛla amɛni udu ni, ɔdi utasu ɔnini, “Akɛla pii ani na mbo mɛni ni, ami ɔlati ɔyikun ku ɔlɔkplu na líti lɛ́kɛ-nya.”

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: Mmomu binyimo ka bina Unwoti Katɔti néte-mii ɔyikun ɔmmɔ asa na bɛ́bla akɛla ammɔ na úti ɔɔtina ka ɔ́di kenye kani na úse ku bina bati kuuku úse lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na use ɔmwi mɛni.

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na ɔ́yila kadi bamba bekyuli bani nákya bina ulu lɛlɔ ni, lɛni kani na ɔdubo-mii udu bɔyila si bítadi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.
translation_verse: Bise atu na binu! Ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ni, bɛdubo Yordan Ketu bɔvia na bisie bitáƒɔ kalɔ kani na kana bekyuli bemomo na bebo ɔyikun betulo-mii binwini bina kadikɔ. Na bana lɛma linengudi líbomo kaduɛ na lɛma lɛmmɔ awodu ákuku ésie kayaa geen.

english_verse: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bammɔ alati bákuku na bebo ɔyikun na baalɔ-ma Anakƒuɔ. Na bínu ka básu dii ka bekyuli badi beeebo na bakana bunye bɔsiaku-ma.

english_verse: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni amii ɔlati bɛdubo bɔnu ka bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubo bɔgyu bɔtɔ-mii anumi aani ogya ɔni mɔɔkyula ala kalɛ. Na ɔdubo-ma udu bɔyila na ɔdi-ma lɛlɔ uwi ɔni na bɛ́kpɛ bíde-ma kalɛ na bɛkɛ kuƒi na bɛbɔku-ma bɛlɛku bana lɛma. Na ɔdia na bɛyila-ma udu pla aani kalɛ úse kenye úse.

english_verse: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.
translation_verse: Bitayiƒala kalɛ na bɛ́ya na Unwoti úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya-mii na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo. Úti ɔ́si limeyi lɛni lɛlɔ na bɛ́ta Egyipte kalɔ úti úbedu limeyi lɛni bíbeduo mɛni ni, lɛni kani na bɛkya bɛɛta teenye Unwoti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Na bɛ́kya Unwoti kɔnyi geen na Sinai Kɔbi lɛlɔ ɔni na úbu blii nka ɔyila-mii udu ƒui.

english_verse: he said: Moses, hurry down the mountain to those people you led out of Egypt. They have already disobeyed me and committed the terrible sin of making an idol.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Yu teesie kɔbi kɔmmɔ kalɔ kɔnakunwi. Ɔsika bekyuli bani na ákpanku álɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ báƒiɔ-mi geen. Na bálɛ ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na lɛ́su-ma ka basia na bávɔ baƒiɔ mmomu bese lɛlɔ lɛlɔ baakpá.”

english_verse: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ami Unwoti ngyi ka bekyuli bamɛni bebo atuɔkplu geen.

english_verse: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel. Moses said:
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu te-mi kuƒi na lɛyila bekyuli bamɛni udu. Na linine bana anyi lidie na ɔƒɛ kalɔ. Na ndubudie kadi bekyuli bani ndubɔyu ɔyikun geen na bimomo bitulo-ma lɛsiku-ɔ kemmo.”

english_verse: Fire was raging on the mountaintop as I went back down, carrying the two stones with the commandments on them.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu líti atabi anyɔ bɛbɛ ani na Katɔti únweni kenye kani na únyimiku-mii ɔ́sia mmɔ na lɛ́yu kɔbi kɔni mɔɔda ku ogya bonwu mmɔ líbo.

english_verse: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.
translation_verse: Na ka mɔɔnu ni, lɛ́nu ka bɛ́bla likpidi bɛ́ƒiɔ bina Unwoti Katɔti. Ɔsika bɛ́vɔ ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔkɔdi ɔgyani udu na bɛɛkpá-nwu aani baƒiɔ na bínwini kama bɛ́kya Katɔti ɔƒɛni kani ɔdi ɔmɛni.

english_verse: So I threw down the two stones and smashed them before your very eyes.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu líƒwimi atabi anyɔ ammɔ lɛ́va na ábwɛ kɔkɛ kɔkɛ na bina anumi.

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na Unwoti úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya Aaron na ɔ́yɔ ka ɔdu-nwu, na lívele líte-nwu uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo kani.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: Amu na líti lɛla likpidi lɛni bɛ́vɔ mmɔ aani ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔgyani ɔkɔdi na líƒwimi lɛ́kya ogya kemmo. Na lídie-nwu na lɛ́ƒɛ-nwu eku eku, na lɛ́kɔ-nwu na únwini ntɔ, na líbo ntɔ bɔmmɔ líwi ketu kani mɔɔgbá taayu kɔbi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na bílie kesii kani baalɔ Tabera ku Masa ku Kibrot-Hataawa ni, lɛni kani na bɛ́kya bina Unwoti Katɔti kɔnyi.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ́kya Kades Barnea ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mii ɔnii, “Biteesie na bitéti kalɔ kani na líti muute-mii mmɔ binwini bina kadikɔ.” Nsu bítaƒɔ-nwu bítadi na bítabu nwuna litemi lɛni na ɔ́su-mii mmɔ. Mmomu bɔta na bɛ́ta binye-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si uwi ɔni na ami Mose lɛ́ti-mii ni, bɔta kani na bɛɛta teenye Unwoti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu lɛ́yu lɛ́tɛ kalɔ na línwini anumi libi kalɔ na Unwoti anumi emeyi aavlene ammɔ kemmo usien ku ɔƒɛ. Ɔsika línu ka Unwoti ɔ́su ka ɔdubɔyila-mii udu.

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́kpali-nwu lívele-nwu nnii, “O Ɔyikune Ƒui Katɔti, tayila ƒula bekyuli bani na ɔkɛnku ƒula ɔyikun ku ɔlɔkplu na édie-ma álɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ udu.

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Na enyimo ƒula kabla bablane bani ndi Abraham ku Isak ku Yakob, na alakpete bekyuli bamɛni atuɔkplu ku likyulikpi ku bana ekpidi ani bábla.

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, Egyipteƒuɔ badubɔsu banii átakana na akpanku ƒula bekyuli bammɔ esienku kalɔ kani ásu ése ka éti-ma éselaku mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na badubɔsu lɛnɔ banii bɔkpanku na ákpanku ƒula bekyuli bammɔ esienku kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo na átadu-ma. Ɔsika eekisi-ma.

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ƒui kama ni, bekyuli bamɛni na áƒuna na éti-ma ábla ƒula badi. Na ama na édie álɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ɔkɛnku ƒula ɔyikun bonwu ku ɔlɔkplu ɔsu.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Sɔ nwi atabi anyɔ bamba aani edeedi kalɛ. Na anwi ugyii adaka ɔdi na eti atabi ammɔ na akɔ. Na eti adaka ɔmmɔ na akɔ ebo-mi kudɔ na kɔbi lɛlɔ mɛni.

english_verse: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.
translation_verse: Na nsɔ ndubo ala edeedi ani na línweni lɛ́sia atabi ani na ébo ábwɛ mmɔ lɛlɔ bunweni bɔsia awɔdi amɛni lɛlɔ. Na si línweni lɛ́wɔlɔ ni, na eti atabi ammɔ akya adaka ɔmmɔ kemmo.”

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu líti Akasia kugyii na lɛ́nwi adaka ɔni na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi mmɔ na lɛ́nwi atabi awɔdi aani kalɛ kani na atabi edeedi ammɔ ese pɛpɛɛpɛ na líti-nya lísienku kɔbi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me,
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́sɔ únweni ɔda bubo etemila leevu ɔ́sia atabi ammɔ lɛlɔ. Etemila ani kani na únweni ɔ́sia atabi edeedi ammɔ lɛlɔ. Na adi ɔda bubo etemila ani kani na ɔ́kɔ lɛsa úte-mii ɔ́siku ogya bonwu ɔmmɔ kemmo ɔni na bɛ́sala binye kɔbi kɔmmɔ kaƒɔna mmɔ.

english_verse: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there. Aaron Died (Numbers
translation_verse: Amu ka Unwoti úti atabi ammɔ úte-mi ni, líti-nya líboku kɔbi kada na líti-nya lɛ́kya adaka ɔmmɔ kemmo aani kalɛ na ɔ́su-mi na akya mmɔ úbedu ɔmwi kadi.

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: Na biti ɔbu bite bina Unwoti Katɔti na bitaakpa anwu lɛti pɛ. Bɛsiaku-nwu kama kpakplaa.

english_verse: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Israelƒuɔ bákya kesii kani na Yaakan kadi bekyuli abiɔ ákya. Na báta mmɔ bésie Mosera. Na mmɔ na Aaron úkpi na báva-nwu. Nwuna kama ni, ubidi ɔnanabi ɔni baalɔ banii Eleasar úti-nwu keliekɔ aani Katɔti Ɔkpane.

english_verse: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams. The Levites Were Appointed To Carry the Chest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na ka bási Mosera ni, báta bétélie Gudgod. Na ka bási Gudgod ni, bésie Yotba kesii kani na ntukpa bɔkya kaduɛ.

english_verse: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na líti atabi ammɔ lɛ́yulaku kɔbi ḿbakya Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Unwoti údie Lewi kɔdua bekyuli ka ama nteeti adaka ɔmmɔ. Na bénwini Unwoti Bakpane. Na ama ndubo kusɛ kusɛ buteeti teete Israelƒuɔ na Unwoti lɛnyi kemmo. Na bataabla-nwu kabla aani kalɛ na use ɔmwi.

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ta na atɔnku ƒula bekyuli na betélie kalɔ kani na lɛ́su líse ka meti mete bina bati kuuku mmɔ lɛlɔ.” Katɔti Ɔɔwia Lɛla Lɛdi Ɔsiku Israelƒuɔ Kudɔ

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔɔwia ɔsiku bina kudɔ ndi ka biti ɔbu bite-nwu na bɛsia nwuna ulu ɔni na ɔ́tina-mii na bɛyɔ-nwu ku bina kayi ƒui ku bina kɔyu ƒui.

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Na bɛdi nwuna ɔda bubo bɔni na líti muute-mii mɛni ƒui lɛlɔ. Na si bɛ́bla lɛni ni, lɛla biala lɛdubɔtɛ lite-mii.

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Bɛti nwaa ka ala ani ƒui nkya kayawi kemmo ni, adi bina Unwoti Katɔti adi. Na kayaa ku ala ani ƒui nkya-ka kemmo lɛnɔ adi nwuna adi.

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: Nsu ka Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́ bina bati kuuku geen ɔsu na amii kani na úti ɔ́bla nwuna bekyuli. Na bɛmu bɛdi nwuna bekyuli.

english_verse: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛda likpidi biala bidie bina kayi kemmo na bɛda atuɔkplu bɔbla bɛya.

english_verse: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bina Unwoti Katɔti ubo ɔyikun utulo ɔyikun biala na ɔlɛka buti ɔbu bute-nwu geen. Na ɔdi Unwoti ɔni na ulánu anumi taabla lɛla lɛdi na ulabɛ taaƒɔ lɛla lɛdi ukyuli kudɔ.

english_verse: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi-nwu lɛyɔla ka bekpinebi ku bekpinele baakɛ́ bana kadikɔ. Na ɔɔyɔ́ baƒɔ litemi na uute-ma adila ku adala.

english_verse: And you should also care for them, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu amii lɛnɔ bidie bina bɔyɔ bɛtina baƒɔ bammɔ. Ɔsika amii lɛnɔ bɛ́ɛbla baƒɔ dii na Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.
translation_verse: Biteemwi-nwu uwi ndi uwi, ɔsika ɔdi bina Unwoti Katɔti. Na bina ɔdi biala ɔ́nu ku nwuna lɛnumi ala ebendi ani na ɔ́bla úte-mii ku ani mɔɔda liƒu.

english_verse: The Lord is your God, so you must always love him and obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Bɛyɔ bina Unwoti Katɔti na bitaadi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Remember, he corrected you and not your children. You are the ones who saw the Lord use his great power
translation_verse: Na binyimo kalɛ na ɔ́ni-mii kɔtu ku kalɛ na údie nwuna ɔyikun kpakplaa ɔ́tina-mii. Nsu bina bebi ama ni, Katɔti útani-ma kɔtu kɔdi.

english_verse: when he worked miracles in Egypt, making terrible things happen to the king and all his people.
translation_verse: Bebi bammɔ bátanu akɔla budie taatina lidu lɛni na ɔ́bla ɔ́tina Egyipteƒuɔ ku bana ɔga na Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: And when the Egyptian army chased you in their chariots, you saw the Lord drown them and their horses in the Red Sea. Egypt still suffers from that defeat!
translation_verse: Na bátanu kalɛ na Unwoti ɔ́yila Egyipteƒuɔ bekpone ku bana bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ ɔni mɔɔní-ma udu. Na ɔ́ya na Ɛpugyie úti-ma uwi ɔni na bábi básiaku-mii mmɔ.

english_verse: You saw what the Lord did for you while you were in the desert, right up to the time you arrived here.
translation_verse: Na baaagyi lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́bla úte-mii na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo asa na bíbedu mɛni.

english_verse: And you saw how the Lord made the ground open up in the middle of our camp underneath the tents of Dathan and Abiram, who were swallowed up along with their families, their animals, and their tents.
translation_verse: Binyimo lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́bla Datan ku Abiram bani ndi Eliab bebi bani nási Ruben kɔdua kemmo. Na bina ƒui anumi ni, Unwoti ɔ́ya na kalɔ kébimi kenye na kébweli-ma ku bana kaduli bekyuli ku bana adi kevo kani bátu ku bana bebuo ƒui.

english_verse: With your own eyes, you saw the Lord's mighty power do all these things.
translation_verse: Na amii ndi bekyuli bani nánu ala ebendi ani na Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́bla mɛni. Katɔti Úse Kenye Ka Wete Israelƒuɔ Kusɛ Kusɛ Si Béduo Kalɔ Kawɔdi Kammɔ Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River, and if you obey the laws and teachings I'm giving you today, you will be strong enough to conquer the land
translation_verse: Bɛnu kaduɛ na bɛdi ɔda bubo ku ala ani na lɛ́tina-mii ɔmwi kadi mɛni lɛlɔ ƒui kalɛ na bɛkɛ ɔyikun na bɛvia Yordan Ketu na bitélie kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: that the Lord promised your ancestors and their descendants. It's rich with milk and honey, and you will live there and enjoy it for a long time.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ ndubɔya na bilie bitu uwi na kakɔ kani egyiibi ntu mɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii mmɔ lɛlɔ. Kalɔ kammɔ na Unwoti Katɔti úse kenye ka wete bina bati kuuku ku bana bawɔ.

english_verse: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven,
translation_verse: Nsu kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na bísela mɛni aka ni, kadi abi ku ɔkwalɛ kalɔ na ɔnantu ntu mɔɔdia edula na mmɔ.

english_verse: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔnu kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ lɛkwa limodi.

english_verse: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛdi ɔda bubo bɔni mɔɔsu-mii ɔmwi kadi mɛni lɛlɔ nnii bɛyɔ bina Unwoti Katɔti na biti bina kayi ƒui bitaakpa-nwu.

english_verse: he will send rain at the right seasons, so you will have more than enough food, wine, and olive oil, and there will be plenty of grass for your cattle.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔya na livo litaakwɛ pii kalɛ na bina ɔmantɛ bebuo bataakɛ-nya taakun. Na amii lɛnɔ kɔka kulada-mii.

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Na bitaya na ukyuli ɔdi ɔtɔlɔ-mii na bɛlɛ bina Unwoti kama na bitákpa baƒiɔ badi.

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si bɛ́lɛ-nwu kama ni, ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔya na uti kɔnyi ɔkya-mii geen na ɔya na ɔnantu ɔda bɔna ɔya na kalɔ kabuni kani na úte-mii mmɔ lɛlɔ na kakwii. Na si bɛ́va edula adi ni, alakana bɔkwɛ. Na ɔmɛni ndubɔya na bikpi bɛkya kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Bɛtɛya ɔda bubo etemila ammɔ bɛkya bina lili kemmo na biteeti-nya lɛlɔ kasusu. Na binweni-nya bɛsia kɔkunkɛ lɛlɔ na bibo bɛda bina enu ku atɛntɛ. Na si bɛ́bla lɛni ni, ɔdububunku-mii na bitaadi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Na bɛya na bina bebi batɛya ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ. Na si bɛkya kaduli iye bɛkɛ ulu bísela kesii kadi iye bilie bɛɛnwuna iye bɛkya bɛɛbla kabla kadi ni, biti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ binwini bina kɔtɛ kɔni na bɛɛtɛmi.

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: Na binweni ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɛmana bina lɛtɔ kɔyakun ku kɔduli kɔyakun anumi.

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ndubɔya na kalɔ kani na bina Unwoti Katɔti úse kenye ka weti wete bina bati kuuku ni, amii ku bina bebi bɛdubulie-ka lɛlɔ bítu uwi aani kalɛ na kayaa kammɔ kebi kalɔ lɛlɔ késela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: Bɛdi ɔda bubo bɔni ƒui na bina Unwoti Katɔti úti úte-mii mɛni lɛlɔ kaduɛ na bɛyɔ-nwu. Na bɛbla lɛla biala na wasu-mii. Na bɛda-nwu kpakplaa.

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: Na si bɛɛsia nwuna ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ anu ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔbɔku kadi bamba bekyuli ƒui udie bana kɔlɔ lɛlɔ na amii bitéti kɔlɔ kɔmmɔ ina ka bekyuli bammɔ bemomo na bebo ɔyikun bétulo-mii.

english_verse: You will capture the land everywhere you go, from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains, and from the Euphrates River west to the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Na kesi kesii na bina lɛgba lɛɛnya ni, kalɔ kammɔ kadubɔbla bina kadi ɔ́si kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo na kada kakɛ úti útédu Lebanon na katɔ kakɛ na ɔ́si Euƒrate Ketudɔ na ɔƒɛ katukɔ úti utédu Mediterenia Ɛpu na ɔƒɛ kanukɔ.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Na kesi kesii bísela ni, bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubɔya na bekyuli bani nlie kɔlɔ kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ bayia-mii geen aani kalɛ na ɔ́su úse. Na uláya na ukyuli ɔdi unye utile-mii ulu.

english_verse: You have a choice—do you want the Lord to bless you, or do you want him to put a curse on you?
translation_verse: Bɛnu! Nda kusɛ kusɛ ku ewida mɔɔvá-mi anumi ɔmwi kadi. Bidie ɔni na bɛɛyɔ́.

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: Kusɛ kusɛ ɔdubɔsiaku-mii si bɛɛdi bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔni na líti muute-mii ɔmwi kadi mɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Nsu ewida adubɔsiaku-mii si bɛ́lɛ-nwu kama na bísie bɛɛkpá baƒiɔ bani na bɛɛɛgyi kudii.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na Unwoti ɔ́ya na bíduo kalɔ kani na ɔ́su úse ka wete-mii mmɔ lɛlɔ ni, na bɛkɔ kusɛ kusɛ ɔmɛni lɛsa na Gerisim Kɔbi lɛlɔ. Na bɛkɔ ewida amɛni lɛsa na Ebal Kɔbi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You know that these two mountains are west of the Jordan River in land now controlled by the Canaanites living in the Jordan River valley. The mountains are west of the road near the sacred trees of Moreh on the other side of Gilgal.
translation_verse: Bɛgyi ka abi anyɔ amɛni ede ɔma ɔni baalɔ banii Gilgal na Araba Kɔwɛ kemmo na Yordan kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na mmɔ ɔkya Yordan Ketu ɔƒɛ kanukɔ kesii kani baalɔ More na egyii enengudi enye mmɔ.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, bɛdubo Yordan Ketu bɔvia na biteesie bitélie kalɔ kani na bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka wete-mii lɛlɔ. Na si bísie bítélie mmɔ ni,

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: bɛnu ka bɛɛdi ɔda bubo bɔni ƒui na líti muute-mii ɔmwi kadi mɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: Ɔni na bísela bitélie kalɔ kani na bina bati kuuku Unwoti Katɔti úti uute-mii mɛni lɛlɔ ni, ɔmɛni ndi ɔda bubo bɔni lɛlɔ na ɔlɛka bɛdi uwi ɔni na bilie-ka lɛlɔ mmɔ. Anwuɔsu bise atu na binu ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kaduɛ!

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Na kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na bísela bitélie mmɔ ni, bɛnu ka bɛyila baƒiɔ biala udu bani na bekyuli baakpá na kesi kesii na abi ku abinkpo lɛlɔ ku egyii ani mbo ɔyuli mmɔ ƒui kalɔ kede kede.

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: Bibo bana akpabi ƒui bɛbwɛ. Na bibo bana atabi ani baalɔ atabi kedee lɛnɔ bɛbwɛ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. Na bɛƒɛ bana lɛƒiɔgyii lɛni na bálɛ béte bana baƒiɔ beledi bani baalɔ Asera baƒiɔ. Na bibo bana baƒiɔ ƒui bɛkya ogya kemmo kalɛ na ukyuli ɔdi ulenyimo ka báakpa baƒiɔ badi na mmɔ kudii.

english_verse: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi utakpa bina Unwoti Katɔti na ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na kadi bammɔ bekyuli baakpá bana baƒiɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́nu ka kesii kani na bilie kágyunku nwuna kakpakɔ kani na ɔ́tina-mii mmɔ ni, bibo kuƒi ka bɛdu bina ɔmantɛ bakɔ iye baƒonu ku bese bani na bina Unwoti úte-mii mmɔ badi bɛkun na bina kɔduli aani kalɛ kani na lɛ́su-mii ḿbavi.

english_verse: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.
translation_verse: Na si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́bla lɛlɔ kedee ɔdi iye útabla ni, ubo kuƒi ka ɔkun lɛna lɛmmɔ aani kalɛ kani na bɛɛkun baƒɛ ku lɛku kemmo bakɔ ɔƒɛni.

english_verse: But don't eat the blood. It is the life of the animal, so let it drain out on the ground before you eat the meat.
translation_verse: Nsu bitadi bana ubugya. Ubugya ɔmmɔ ndi bana ngba. Anwuɔsu biwilimi ubugya ɔmmɔ ƒui biwiakun asa bɛkun lɛna lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: Na si bɛɛdi ɔda bubo bɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni, kaƒɔ kadubɔyɔ Unwoti na ɔdubɔya na amii ku bina bawɔ keyi kayɔ.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: Na biti bina akpala ani na ese ete ka bɛkyula ku lɛna ku ubugya bisienku Unwoti lɛkpabi lɛni na ɔ́tina-mii lɛlɔ na bɛbla akpala ammɔ mmɔ. Bibo kuƒi ka bɛkun lɛna lɛmmɔ, nsu ubugya ɔmmɔ anwu ni, biwilimi biwi bina Unwoti Katɔti lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ɔƒɛnyi.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Na si bɛɛdi ɔda bubo bɔni na bina Unwoti Katɔti úte-mi mɛni lɛlɔ ni, ɔmɛni ndubɔya na uteebunku amii ku bina bawɔ na lɛla biala na bɛɛbla lɛtɛ lite-mii. Katɔti Úbo Israelƒuɔ Ɔda Na Lɛƒiɔkpa Lɛlɔ

english_verse: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na bitakpa bina Unwoti Katɔti na ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na baakpá bana baƒiɔ. Ɔsika ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na baakpá bana baƒiɔ ni, ɔdi lɛla lɛni muusé Katɔti lɛlɔ na uláwia ulanu. Ɔsika baakana na beeti bana bebi taakpa lɛgyavonku kemmo na bana akpabi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Obey all the laws and teachings I am giving you. Don't add any, and don't take any away.
translation_verse: Na bɛnu ka bɛ́bla lɛla biala na líbo-mii ɔda nnii bɛbla. Na bitada ɔdi bitedie iye biteti ɔdi bitebunku.

english_verse: Someday a prophet may come along who is able to perform miracles or tell what will happen in the future. Then the prophet may say, “Let's start worshiping some new gods—some gods that we know nothing about.”
translation_verse: nsu kasusu kani na ɔda ndi ka ɔtɔlɔ-mii kalɛ na bitákpa baƒiɔ bani bítakpa kudii. Ina ka kenye kani na úse mmɔ kébo kéte lɛni ni,

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: bitenu-nwu litemi. Ɔsika bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔsia-mii anu geen na ɔɔkɔ́ku-mii taanu si bɛɛyɔ́-nwu ku kayi ƒui.

english_verse: You must be completely faithful to the Lord. Worship and obey only the Lord and do this with fear and trembling,
translation_verse: Bɛsiaku bina Unwoti lɛti pɛ kama na biti ɔbu bite-nwu. Na bɛdi nwuna etemila ku ɔda bubo bɔni ƒui na úte-mii lɛlɔ. Na bɛkpa-nwu na ulu ɔni na ɔɔwia lɛlɔ na bɛda-nwu kpakplaa.

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ndubɔya na Israelƒuɔ ƒui benu lɛla lɛni nálɛ mɛni na liƒu lɛda ukyuli biala. Na ɔdi biala uleti lɛlɔ ulakya udu ukpidi ɔmmɔ kemmo kudii.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.
translation_verse: Na si bínu bɛ́siku lɛma lɛni na bina Unwoti Katɔti úti uute-mii ka bitélie-ni kemmo mmɔ

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: ka bekyuli bekpidi badi báta na bina akɔ na bátɔlɔ ama ɔlati ɔma bekyuli ka bitákpa baƒiɔ bani bítakpa kudii ni, bi na bɛdubo bɔbla?

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: Si bínu etemila ammɔ bene udu ni, biwi lɛlɔ na bɛwia-nya kemmo bɛti kaduɛ. Na si bɛ́wia bɛ́ti ka sɔsɔ na etemila ammɔ adi ni,

english_verse: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.
translation_verse: bɛdu bekyuli bani ƒui nlie ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na bɛdu bana bebuo ƒui lɛnɔ. Na bɛnu ka bɛ́yila ɔma ɔmmɔ udu ƒui.

english_verse: Gather all the possessions of the people who lived there, and pile them up in the marketplace, without keeping anything for yourself. Set the pile and the whole town on fire, and don't ever rebuild the town. The whole town will be a sacrifice to the Lord your God. Then he won't be angry anymore, and he will have mercy on you and make your nation stronger, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi uteti ala ani na ɔ́su-mii ka bɛkyula mmɔ adi utese lɛlɔ. Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na nwuna kɔnyi kati kati kɔyɔ na ɔnu-mii kɔnyana. Ɔdubɔnu-mii kɔnyana na ɔya na bimomo bibu aani kalɛ na ɔ́su bina bati kuuku úse.

english_verse: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.
translation_verse: Ɔsika biinú bina Unwoti Katɔti litemi na bɛɛdi nwuna ɔda bubo bɔni na uute-mii ɔmwi mɛni lɛlɔ. Na bɛɛbla ala ani nse siin na nwuna anumi ɔsu.

english_verse: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord, so don't behave like those who worship other gods. Animals That Can Be Eaten (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ɔsika amii bɛdi Unwoti Katɔti ɔdi na anwu náƒuna-mii ɔ́lɛku kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ na kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui ka bɛbla nwuna ɔdi. Mose Ɔ́tina-ma Bebuo Bani Udu Na Bakun

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: Bɛkana na bɛkun aasɛ biala ɔni neeese lɛlɔ.

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: Ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku baƒonu ku bete ku bese ku baƒɛ ku bana udu biala na lɛku kemmo bani muukpó taalɛku ɔkwɛ kemmo taakun na bana lɛgba agbanvuo kemmo kábwɛ inyɔ lɛnɔ bibo kuƒi ka bɛdu bebuo bammɔ bɛkun.

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: Na bitakun ɔplakuo. Ɔsika bebuo bamɛni beesé lɛlɔ. Bebo agbanvuo ani kemmo nábwɛ inyɔ, nsu belekpo taakun. Na ɔdi utakun bebuo bamɛni iye biteti bina enu bitetuku bana ukpine.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: Na lɛna biala na lɛkya ntukpa ku ɛpu kemmo na libo atula ku akpa ni, bibo kuƒi ka bɛkun-ni.

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Nsu lɛna biala na lɛkya ketu kemmo na liiibo akpa ku lɛƒɛnyi atula ni, bitakun. Ɔsika lɛna lɛmmɔ liisé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But don't eat the meat of any of the following birds: eagles, vultures, falcons, kites, ravens, ostriches, owls, sea gulls, hawks, pelicans, ospreys, cormorants, storks, herons, and hoopoes. You must not eat bats.
translation_verse: Nsu baasɛ bani anyi ndubo bɔlɔ mɛni ni, bitakun-ma. Kɔdigbo aasɛ, likuku, okum ku nwuna lidu lidu, ɔsansa, kasangbii ku nwuna lidu soholi, lɛkpaƒɛɛlɛ, ligbini, kwakwadabi, ɛpu kemmo kwakwadabi, likuku ku nwuna lidu lidu, ntu kemmo kɔdigbo aasɛ, aasɛ ku limɔ gyɔlɔɔ ku nwuna lidu lidu, lɛpan ku baƒelelee.

english_verse: Swarming insects are unclean, so don't eat them.
translation_verse: Na kubweyi pii kɔkya na kuuveyi na lisu kemmo ni, bitakun-ku, ɔsika beesé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Na kɔni muuveyi na kulese lɛlɔ aku ni, bɛkana na bɛkun aku.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: Na bitakun ebuo biala na úkpi ɔtɛ. Mmomu bɛkana na biti ebuo ɔmmɔ bite baƒɔ bani nli-mii akɔ iye biti biye bite baƒɔ bani nási baaví. Ɔsika amii bɛdi bekyuli bani na Katɔti údie úse sɛsɛɛ úte lɛlɔ. Na biteti ese uni lɛnyi ntu biteƒulo nwuna ubi lɛna. Ɔda Bubo Na Etela Lɛkpa Leevudi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Lɛkwa ndi lɛkwa ni, ɔdi biala udie nwuna edula ani ƒui na ɔ́kɛ lɛkpa leevudi use sɛsɛɛ ute Katɔti.

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́bla ɔmɛni bɛ́wɔlɔ ni, na bisie kesii kani bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna úse ka bitaakpa-nwu mmɔ. Na si bíduo mmɔ ni, ɔdi biala uti nwuna ala lɛkpa leevudi ani ndi edula ku ntɛ bɔwɔdi ku nnɔ bɔni na bídie ku bina ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku bina baƒonu ku bese bebi bedeedi bani na báwɔ na bɛdu-ma na bɛkun lɛna lɛmmɔ ku ala akladi ammɔ na Katɔti anumi. Na si bɛ́bla lɛni ni, ala amɛni ndubɔya na bɛtɛya kalɛ na biteeti ɔbu teete bina Unwoti Katɔti uwi biala.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Na si úte-mii kusɛ kusɛ na bɛ́kɛ ala pii na bilakana ala lɛkpa leevudi lɛmmɔ ƒui buti busienku mmɔ ka mmɔ kágyunku-mii ɔsu ni,

english_verse: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.
translation_verse: Na si bíduo mmɔ ni, biti egulabi ani bɛ́kɛ mmɔ biye lɛla biala na bɛɛyɔ́, aani ɔmantɛ bakɔ iye baƒonu iye ntɛ na amii ku bina kaduli bekyuli bɛni na bɛdi ala ammɔ na bina Unwoti Katɔti anumi mmɔ.

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: Na bitedie Lewiƒuɔ bani nkya bina lɛma mmɔ atu. Mmomu bite-ma ala ammɔ adi. Ɔsika ama beeebo kadikɔ kadi na kese kete-ma.

english_verse: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.
translation_verse: Na lɛkwa lɛtɛdi biala lɛlɔ ni, biti bina edula lɛkpa leevudi biboku na bɛkya-nya unwu kemmo bise bina lɛma.

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Na edula ammɔ adi Lewiƒuɔ ku baƒɔ ku bekpinebi ku bekpinele bani nkya bina lɛma ɔdi. Na badubuteebo taabaƒɔ ala ani na baawia na badi bemo. Na si bɛɛbla ɔmɛni ni, bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubuteete-mi kusɛ kusɛ na bina kabla biala kemmo.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.
translation_verse: Na si bina Unwoti Katɔti úti kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na bísela bitélie mmɔ úte-mii na bísie bilie-ka lɛlɔ na bina ɔnwa ɔdi ɔɔyaki lɛla lɛdi na lɛma lɛmmɔ ɔdi kemmo ni, bitabla-nwu lili ɔkplu.

english_verse: Every seven years you must announce, “The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back.” Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.
translation_verse: Ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na ɔlɛka bɛbla ala amɛni bɛsiaku. Ukyuli biala ɔni névo egulabi úte nwuna Israelnikpana ni, uti kayu kammɔ ɔkyiɛ-nwu. Na utenye ukyuli ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ka ɔɔwia nwuna lɛla lɛni na ɔda-nwu mmɔ. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔlati nése uwi ɔni na bekulo kayu biala nkya úse.

english_verse: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.
translation_verse: Nsu si ukyuli ɔni naaadi Israelni ɔda ɔdi kayu kadi ni, ubo kuƒi ka ɔƒɔ lɛla lɛni na ɔda-nwu mmɔ ɔsiku-nwu kudɔ. Nsu ƒula Israelni ɔkpana anwu ni, ti kayu kammɔ kyiɛ-nwu lɛkwa maatɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔdubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ aani kalɛ kani na úse kenye úse. Na bɛdubuvo egulabi bite kadi kadi bekyuli, nsu amii ni, bilésie bana kudɔ biletévo egulabi adi. Na bɛdubɔdi kadi kadi bekyuli lɛlɔ, nsu ɔdi biala ulakana-mii lɛlɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and lend them what they need.
translation_verse: Mmomu ute-nwu kebunku kani na ɔɔwia ku kayi ƒaa.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Na utasu ɔnii kayu butitaakyiɛ lɛkwa lɛdaku budu ɔsu, ulete ukyuli ɔmmɔ kebunku kani na ɔɔwia. Ɔdi utaya na kasusu kekpidi kammɔ udu keduo-nwu lili kemmo. Na si ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔ́bla nwuna ɔnwani ulikplu na útete-nwu kevonkɔ kani na ɔɔwia mmɔ na ukyuli ɔmmɔ úwulo na ɔ́kpali Katɔti ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔni ulikplune ɔmmɔ kɔtu geen.

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Na bɛnu ka biite lɛlɔ ala ku kayi ƒaa ɔni na kasusu kekpidi kadi keeebo-nwu kemmo. Na si bɛɛbla lɛni ni, Katɔti ɔdubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ na lɛla biala bɛɛbla kemmo.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nsu si ebuo ɔmmɔ ɔdi ɔ́ƒɛ uwi kalɔ iye anumi abwɛ-nwu ni, iye lɛla bamba lɛdi lɛda-nwu ni, biteti ebuo ɔmmɔ udu bitakpa bitete bina Unwoti Katɔti.

english_verse: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.
translation_verse: Mmomu te-nwu lɛla lɛdi siku ala ani ƒui na Katɔti ɔ́ya na ákɛ ɔkɛnku kusɛ kusɛ ɔni na úte-ɔ ɔsu ku kaƒɔ ƒaa. Bite-ma baƒonu ku bese ku edula ani bɛ́ƒɛ ku ntɛ bɔni bídie bíse kalɛ na ɔ́manku.

english_verse: But one of your slaves may say, “I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.”
translation_verse: Nsu si lɛkwa maatɛdi lɛmmɔ lídu na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla ukyuli bamba kabla mmɔ ɔ́bla kasusu ka wasɔ wakya nwuna unwoti kudɔ ka ɔɔyɔ́-nwu ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-nwu ka ɔsɔ ɔkya ɔsu ni, kuƒi kɔtɛ.

english_verse: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.
translation_verse: Na asa na wasɔ wakya ni, da ukyuli ɔmmɔ kɔtu tamana ƒula kayakun ɔpunu lɛlɔ na awia lɛla lɛdi eti aƒuaala-nwu kɔtu. Na si ábla ɔmɛni áwɔlɔ ni, na ukyuli ɔmmɔ únwini ukyuli ɔni ndubutaabla kabla teete-ɔ nwuna akwa ƒui. Lɛni kani na bɛdubɔbla beleku bani mɔɔyɔ́ ka basɔ bakya bana benwoti kudɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: Na bina ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku baƒonu ku bese ubi ɔgyani udeedi biala ni, bidie-nwu bise sɛsɛɛ bite Katɔti. Na biteti bakɔ bitesienku na batábla kabla kadi iye bikulo baƒonu bammɔ linwini bɛbla unwo uwi ɔdi.

english_verse: Instead, each year you must take the first-born of these animals to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped. You and your family will sacrifice them to the Lord and then eat them as part of a sacred meal.
translation_verse: Mmomu lɛkwa ndi lɛkwa ni, amii ku bina kaduli bekyuli biti bebuo bammɔ bisienku liku linwi pɛ lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́su-mii ka bitaakpa-nwu mmɔ. Na bitádu-ma bɛkpa bite-nwu na bɛkun-ma na Katɔti anumi mmɔ.

english_verse: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.
translation_verse: Na bibo kuƒi ka bɛdu ebuo ɔmmɔ udu bɛkun na bina kɔduli. Na si ukyuli ɔdi úkisi lɛlɔ iye útekisi lɛlɔ ni, ubo kuƒi ka ɔkun lɛna lɛmmɔ aani kalɛ kani na bɛɛkun bete ku baƒɛ.

english_verse: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.
translation_verse: Nsu biteti bana ubugya bitabla adila na bɛdi. Mmomu biwilimi bana ubugya biwi kalɔ aani kalɛ na beebó ntu teewiakun.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must celebrate Passover in the month of Abib, because one night in that month years ago, the Lord your God rescued you from Egypt.
translation_verse: Bise kɔbuli kɔni baalɔ Abib likpo na bataadi Kukpi Lili Bɔvia limeyi teete bina Unwoti Katɔti. Ɔsika Abib kɔbuli kɔmmɔ kemmo na ɔ́da-mii údie Egyipteƒuɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ usien unwi.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you. Don't Set Up Sacred Poles or Stones Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na bɛnu ka litemi lɛlɔ bɔdi ulu lɛlɔ bɔ́ƒɔ bina ƒui akɔ. Na si bɛbla lɛni ni, anwu ndubɔya na bilie kalɔ kani na bina Unwoti Katɔti úti uute-mii lɛlɔ. Úbo-ma Ɔda Na Lɛƒiɔkpa Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Eat thin bread for the next six days. Then on the seventh day, don't do any work. Instead, come together and worship the Lord. The Harvest Festival (Exodus
translation_verse: Na emeyi aku ani nébu ni, bitaadi bodobodo ɔni néteƒu kani. Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛlɔ ni, bɛsala lɛlɔ na bimwi bina Unwoti Katɔti, na ɔdi utabla kabla kadi limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Úbo-ma Ɔda Na Edula Ebi Bɔƒɛ Limeyi Bɔdi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: The Passover sacrifice must be a cow, a sheep, or a goat, and you must offer it at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Na Kukpi Lili Bɔvia limeyi bɔdi bɔmmɔ ni, bɛdu bina ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku baƒonu ku bese na biti-ma bɛkpa bite bina Unwoti na kesii kani na ɔdubudie use ute lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Then cook it and eat it there at the place of worship, returning to your tents the next morning.
translation_verse: Na biƒulo lɛna lɛmmɔ ƒui na kesii kani na Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka bitaakpa-nwu mmɔ. Na bɛkun-ni ƒui na mmɔ. Na bɛtɔlɔ nwuna lɛdigye bisie kɔduli.

english_verse: And don't set up a sacred stone! The Lord hates these things.
translation_verse: Na biteti lɛtabi lɛdi bitabla baƒiɔ na bitaakpa-ni. Ɔsika Katɔti ukisi ala ammɔ bene.

english_verse: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Si bɛɛtú lɛkpabi lɛdi bite bina Unwoti Katɔti ni, biteti baƒiɔ beledi bani baalɔ banii Asera ɔƒiɔgyii bitalɛ Katɔti lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped and celebrate the Harvest Festival in honor of the Lord your God. Bring him an offering as large as you can afford, depending on how big a harvest he has given you. Be sure to take along your sons and daughters and all your servants. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Na si bísela ni, biti bina bebi ku bina kabla bablane banana ku beleku ku baƒɔ bani nkya-mii akɔ ku Lewiƒuɔ ku bekpinebi ku bekpinele bani nkya bina lɛma kemmo ƒui bɛda. Na biti kubiti bɛdi limeyi lɛmmɔ na Katɔti anumi.

english_verse: The bigger the harvest the Lord gives you, the bigger your gift should be. Treat Everyone with Justice Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na si ɔnana biala ɔdubo ni, uti etela uboku bina Unwoti Katɔti aani kalɛ na úte-mii kusɛ kusɛ na ɔ́kɛ edula ammɔ kenye. Na ukyuli ɔdi utebo Katɔti anumi mmɔ ku enukplu. Israelƒuɔ Bédie Litemi Batɛne

english_verse: Each year there are three festivals when all Israelite men must go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. These are the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters. And don't forget to take along a gift for the Lord.
translation_verse: Na lɛkwa biala kemmo ni, Israelƒuɔ ƒui banana ɔlɛka bebo Unwoti anumi kɔtɛ babakpa-nwu na kesii kani na ɔ́su úse ka bitaakpa-nwu mmɔ. Na emeyi ani badubɔdi mmɔ ndi Bodobodo Ɔni Néteƒu Limeyi ku Edula Bɔƒɛ Limeyi ku Kevo Kemmo Bulie Emeyi. Na ukyuli ɔdi utebo Katɔti anumi mmɔ ku enukplu.

english_verse: If an ox or a sheep has something wrong with it, don't offer it as a sacrifice to the Lord your God—he will be disgusted! Put To Death People Who Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Biteti ɔmantɛ bakɔ iye koƒonu kɔni na kɔ́sɔ bitakpa bitete bina Unwoti Katɔti. Ɔsika Katɔti ukisi ala ammɔ bene.

english_verse: So when you hear that someone in your town is committing this disgusting sin, you must carefully find out if that person really is guilty.
translation_verse: na bínu litemi lɛmmɔ ni, biwi lɛlɔ na bɛwia-ni kemmo kaduɛ. Na si bɛ́wia-ni kemmo na litemi lɛmmɔ lɛdi sɔsɔ ka ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔ́bla likyulikpi lɛla lɛmmɔ udu na Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ ni,

english_verse: But you will need two or three witnesses—one witness isn't enough to prove a person guilty. Get rid of those who are guilty of such evil. Take them outside your town gates and everyone must stone them to death. But the witnesses must be the first to throw stones. Difficult Cases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na asa na bɛdububo ukyuli ɔmmɔ atabi ni, bɛya na bekyuli bani nnye litemi lɛmmɔ kama baka-nwu atabi bubo asa na bekyuli bakladi beteebo-nwu atabi. Ɔmɛni ndi kalɛ na bɛda likpidi lɛmɛni udu bidie bina akɔ.

english_verse: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court. The King Moses said:
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ndubɔya na ukyuli biala unu lɛla lɛni nálɛ mɛni, na ɔya na ukyuli biala ɔyia na basɔ balata belenye litemi ɔtɛne litemi lɛlɔ. Úbo-ma Ɔda Na Lɛga Bɔdi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, “We want a king, just like the nations around us.”
translation_verse: Si bísie na bitélie kalɔ kani na bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka wete-mii mmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔmmɔ kama bíti kasusu na bɛ́nu ka bɛɛwia ɔga ɔdi na utaadi Israelƒuɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na kɔlɔ bamba bebo bagadine ni,

english_verse: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.
translation_verse: na bɛnu kaduɛ na bidie ɔga ɔni na Unwoti lɛnɔ ɔ́ƒuna. Ɔlɛka ɔbla ukyuli ɔni nási bina kadi bekyuli akɔ. Na biteti kadi bamba ukyuli ɔni naaadi Israelni ɔdi bitese lɛga.

english_verse: The king should not have many horses, especially those from Egypt. The Lord has said never to go back there again.
translation_verse: Na ɔga ɔni na bɛdubuse ni, utalɛka ɔwia bapɔnkɔ pii ute lɛlɔ. Na utalɛka ukyuli ɔdi use Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ utéye bapɔnkɔ badi ɔ́siku mmɔ uboku-nwu. Ɔsika Unwoti ɔ́su-mii ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ utesie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord. Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Na ɔga ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ utawia beleku pii uteti, ɔsika si ɔ́bla lɛni ni, nwuna kasusu kadubɔlɛ nwuna Unwoti lɛlɔ. Na ɔga ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ utawia sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi pii utese lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The official copy of God's laws will be kept by the priests of the Levi tribe. So, as soon as anyone becomes king, he must go to the priests and write out a copy of these laws while they watch.
translation_verse: Na si ɔga ɔmmɔ úbo úbelie nwuna liboku lɛlɔ ni, ɔƒɔ Ɔda Bubo Ɔku Kedee ɔmmɔ na Katɔti bakpane bani ndi Lewiƒuɔ kudɔ na anwu lɛnɔ unweni etemila ammɔ ɔkya ɔku kemmo ute lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling
translation_verse: Na uti ɔku ɔmmɔ na utaaka-nwu teenu Katɔti ɔda bubo etemila teeti taada nwuna ngba emeyi ƒui. Mmɔ na ɔdubuteeti ɔbu teete Katɔti na ɔkana na uteemwi-nwu na ulu lɛlɔ. Na utaadi nwuna ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and not think that he's better than everyone else. If the king completely obeys the Lord's commands, he and his descendants will rule Israel for many years.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ndubɔya na ulátaakɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ teetulo nwuna banwa Israelƒuɔ bakladi. Na ɔdububunku-nwu lɛnɔ na ulénwini kama ulakya Katɔti ɔda bubo. Na si ɔ́bla lɛni ni, ɔdubɔya na anwu ku nwuna kaba bekyuli belie liboku lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ badi lɛga na Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ bétu uwi.

english_verse: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Ami Katɔti ndubumene kenye udiene ɔdi aani awɔ Mose kalɛ lɛkya-ma. Na kenye udiene ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔsi ama alati kadi bekyuli akɔ. Na lɛla biala na líbo-nwu ɔda ni, anwu ndubɔsu-ma ana ƒui.

english_verse: Some Levites may have money from selling family possessions, and others may not. But all Levites serving at the place of worship will receive the same amount of food from the sacrifices and gifts brought by the people. Don't Do Disgusting Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na ɔlɛka bete-nwu adila aani kalɛ na beete bakpane bani nlie mmɔ adila ina ka nwuna kaduli bekyuli béte-nwu egulabi adi. Bitasiaku Bayawine Ala Kama

english_verse: The people of the Levi tribe, including the priests, will not receive any land. Instead, they will receive part of the sacrifices that are offered to the Lord,
translation_verse: Katɔti bakpane bani ndi Lewiƒuɔ beeebo kadikɔ kadi na Israelƒuɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ. Mmomu bana kadikɔ ndi etela ku akpala ani na bekyuli beeboku-ma ka bakyula bete Unwoti.

english_verse: When you sacrifice a bull or sheep, the priests will be given the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.
translation_verse: Na uwi biala na Israelƒuɔ badubɔdu ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku baƒonu beti bakpa bete Unwoti ni, bedie bebuo bammɔ enu ku ɔnungla ku bana kaƒɔ ala bete Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ.

english_verse: In addition, they will receive the first part of your grain harvest and part of your first batches of wine and olive oil. You must also give them the first wool that is cut from your sheep each year.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ni, bina edula edeedi ani na bɛ́ƒɛ ku ntɛ ku nnɔ ku bina baƒonu linwini lɛni na bíti bɛ́bla unwo ni, biti ala ammɔ bite Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ.

english_verse: Give these gifts to the priests, because the Lord has chosen them and their descendants out of all the tribes of Israel to be his special servants at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Ɔsika na bina adua kemmo ni, Unwoti nédie kɔdua kunwi na ama ndi Lewiƒuɔ bamɛni ka benwini bakpane bete-nwu uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Any Levite can leave his hometown, and go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: Na Lewini biala ɔni nlie Israel ɔma biala kemmo na ɔ́bla kasusu ka use utélie kesii kani na Unwoti ɔ́su úse ka bataakpa-nwu mmɔ, ubo kuƒi ka utélie mmɔ.

english_verse: and then be a special servant of the Lord there, just like all the other Levites.
translation_verse: Na ɔkana na utaabla nwuna ɔkpane kabla na Katɔti anumi mmɔ aani Lewiƒuɔ bakladi bani nlie mmɔ kalɛ.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. The nations that live there do things that are disgusting to the Lord, and you must not follow their example.
translation_verse: Si bísie bítéduo kalɔ kani na bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka wete-mii mmɔ kemmo ni, ɔdi utasiaku kadi bamba bekyuli bani nde-mii mmɔ ala ani muusé Katɔti lɛlɔ mmɔ kama.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your son or daughter. And don't try to use any kind of magic or witchcraft to tell fortunes or to cast spells or to talk with spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: bekyuli bani mɔɔwia ala bati na ayu bamba kudɔ iye bitesie bekpine kudɔ ka bitéye-ma ala binu.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with anyone who does these things, and that's why he will help you destroy the nations that are in the land.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala na meti lɛlɔ mete ala amɛni udu bɔbla ni, ɔdubuse Katɔti lɛlɔ, ɔsika ala ammɔ udu adi ekisila ete bina Unwoti Katɔti. Na ɔmɛni ɔsu na ɔdubɔku kadi bammɔ bekyuli na bina anumi.

english_verse: Never be guilty of doing any of these disgusting things! A Prophet like Moses Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na bɛnu kaduɛ kalɛ na lɛla lɛdi lilada-mii na bina Unwoti anumi. Katɔti Úse Kenye Ka Weti Kenye Udiene Ɔdi Wemene

english_verse: You will go in and take the land from nations that practice magic and witchcraft. But the Lord your God won't allow you to do those things.
translation_verse: Na kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na bísela bitélie ni, bekyuli basiaku bekyuli bani muubó like kama na baawia ama bani ndubɔsu-ma ala ani ndubo bɔlɛ. Nsu ami amu ni, bina Unwoti Katɔti ulayɔ ka bɛbla lɛni.

english_verse: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.
translation_verse: Mmomu ɔdubuti kenye udiene ɔdi umene aani ami Mose kalɛ. Na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔsi bina kadi bekyuli akɔ. Na si úbo ni, na ɔdi biala unu-nwu litemi.

english_verse: You were asking for a prophet the day you were gathered at Mount Sinai and said to the Lord, “Please don't let us hear your voice or see this terrible fire again—if we do, we will die!”
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛni na amii Israelƒuɔ bɛ́sa na Sinai kɔbi kaƒɔna ni, bívele-mi bɛnii bɛsɔ bilayɔ ka bɛsɔ binu bina Unwoti lɛdi iye bɛnu kalɛ na ogya bonwu ɔmmɔ ɔɔda lɛnɔ. Ɔsika bɛkya bɛyia ka bɛdubukpi.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Béti lɛnunda béye lɛla lɛbuni.

english_verse: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.
translation_verse: Na si ubo ni, lɛla biala wasu-ma ni, ɔdubɔsu-ni na mina lɛnyi kemmo. Na ukyuli biala na ulénu-nwu litemi ni, Ami Katɔti ndubɔni-nwu kɔtu.

english_verse: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god. Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nsu si kenye udiene ɔdi ɔ́su-ma litemi lɛdi na mina lɛnyi kemmo uwi ɔni na ɔɔɔdi Ami Katɔti nátala-nwu iye kenye udiene ɔdi ɔda baƒiɔ kɔyu ɔɔsu-ma lɛla lɛdi ni, na bayila bekyuli bammɔ udu.”

english_verse: You may be asking yourselves, “How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord?”
translation_verse: Bɛdubuye lɛlɔ bɛnii, “Dɛ na wabla asa bɔnu bɔti ka kenye udiene ɔmɛni litemi lɛni na ɔɔsu mɛni lítasi Unwoti kudɔ?”

english_verse: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord. Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord.
translation_verse: Binu kalɛ na bɛdubuti bɛnu ka litemi lɛmmɔ lɛ́si iye lítasi Katɔti kudɔ. Si kenye udiene ɔdi úti Katɔti lɛnyi na ɔ́su lɛla lɛdi na lɛla lɛmmɔ lítebo-nwu kemmo ni, na kenye udiene ɔmmɔ kenye kátasi Katɔti kudɔ. Mmomu kenye udiene ɔmmɔ ɔlati néti nwuna kasusu ɔ́su lɛla lɛmmɔ. Anwuɔsu bitayia ukyuli ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord your God has promised that if you obey his laws and teachings I'm giving you, and if you always love him, then he will give you the land he promised your ancestors. When that happens, you must name three more Safe Towns in the new territory.
translation_verse: na bidie lɛma ɛtɛ bibunku lideedi lɛmmɔ. Na si bɛɛdi ɔda bubo bɔni ƒui na líti muute-mii ɔmwi na bɛɛyɔ́ bina Unwoti Katɔti ni, ɔdubɔbla ɔmɛni ute-mii.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land and attack the nations. The Lord your God will destroy them and give you their lands, towns, and homes. Then after you are settled,
translation_verse: Si uwi ɔni na bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́yila bekyuli bani nli kɔlɔ kɔni bɛdubo bulie mmɔ udu ɔ́wɔlɔ na bɛ́bɔku-ma na bɛ́ƒɔ-ma lɛma ku kɔduli bilie ni,

english_verse: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.
translation_verse: Bɛya na buti-nwu bɔnii nkyuli inyɔ bésie lɛku kemmo na bésie baadá egyii. Na ka bakya baadá egyii ammɔ ni, ukyuli unwi kadadi ubi ɔ́lɛ ugyii ɔmmɔ kemmo na ɔ́vi útádu ɔkpanadi. Ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔkana na ukeli usie lɛma lɛmmɔ unwi kemmo kalɛ na baládu-nwu.

english_verse: You don't deserve to die, since you did not mean to harm your friend. But he did get killed, and his relatives might be very angry. They might even choose one of the men from their family to track you down and kill you. If it is too far to one of the Safe Towns, the victim's relative might be able to catch you and kill you.
translation_verse: Na si ɔma unwi pɛ kani nkya na ɔgbankpi ɔ́siaku ɔdi na kesii kani nágyu ni, bekyuli bakana beƒie ukyuli ɔni na ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ ɔ́siaku na badu-nwu na kɔnyi kɔni bákɛ ɔsu. Nsu ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔɔɔgyi uuuse asa na ɔ́du ukyuli ɔni naaadi nwuna ukisine mmɔ.

english_verse: That's why I said there must be three Safe Towns.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na líbo-mii ɔda ka bidie lɛma ɛtɛ bise lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You will need them, so innocent people won't be killed on your land while they are trying to reach a Safe Town that is too far away. You will be guilty of murder, if innocent people lose their lives because you didn't name enough Safe Towns in the land the Lord your God will give you.
translation_verse: Bɛbla ɔmɛni kalɛ na biládu bekyuli bani nátaƒiɔ. Na bilákɛ kɔtɔ bɔdu bɔdi na kukpi kɔmɛni udu lɛlɔ na kalɔ kani na bina Unwoti úti uute-mii mɛni kemmo.

english_verse: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.
translation_verse: Nsu si ukyuli ɔdi uukisi nwuna ukyuli ɔkpana na útábɛ ɔɔtú-nwu na ɔ́du-nwu na úkeli úsie lɛma lɛmmɔ lɛdi biala kemmo utátamiku-ma ni,

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: benengu bani nkya ɔma ɔni kemmo na ukyuli ɔdune ɔmmɔ ɔ́si ɔlɛka batala na betétiku-nwu beboku, na beti-nwu bete ukyuli ɔni na ɔ́du mmɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli, na ama lɛnɔ badu-nwu.

english_verse: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer! Property Lines Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Bitanu ukyuli ɔmmɔ udu kɔnyana. Na bɛnu ka bɛ́da bekyuli badune bídie Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ kalɛ na lɛla biala lisieku-mii kaduɛ. Bitavumana Ɔmii Ɔkukudi Ɔdi

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na ɔdi utavumana ɔmii ɔkukudi ɔni na básia bése na kalɔ kani na bina Unwoti Katɔti úti uute-mii mɛni lɛlɔ. Nkyuli Inyɔ Iye Ɛtɛ Bedie Lɛla Kenye

english_verse: Before you are convicted of a crime, at least two witnesses must be able to testify that you did it.
translation_verse: Útalɛka ukyuli unwi kani udie lɛla likpidi lɛni na ɔdi ɔ́bla kenye. Bɛya na nkyuli inyɔ iye ɛtɛ benye-nwu litemi kama.

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Na si ukyuli ɔ́nyi ɔkɔ ɔ́sia ukyuli ɔdi ni,

english_verse: then both you and the accused must be taken to the court at the place where the Lord is worshiped. There the priests and judges will find out if you are lying or telling the truth. If you are lying and the accused is innocent,
translation_verse: Na litemi batɛne bammɔ badubuduo etemila ammɔ kemmo kaduɛ na si bánu báti ka ɔkɔ na kenye udiene ɔmmɔ ɔ́nyi ɔ́sia nwuna ɔkpana Israelni ni,

english_verse: then you will be punished without mercy. You will receive the same punishment the accused would have received if found guilty, whether it means losing an eye, a tooth, a hand, a foot, or even your life. Israel, the crime of telling lies in court must be punished. And when people hear what happens to witnesses that lie, everyone else who testifies in court will tell the truth.
translation_verse: Na etemila ammɔ bene lɛlɔ ni, bitanu ɔdi kɔnyana. Na kɔtu kɔni na ɔlɛka bani-nwu ndi ka si ukyuli ɔ́du ni, ɔlɛka badu anwu lɛnɔ. Si ukyuli lɛnumi na ɔ́bwɛ ni, ɔlɛka babwɛ anwu lɛdi lɛnɔ. Na si lɛnyi na ɔ́kpa ni, ɔlɛka bakpa nwuna lɛdi lɛnɔ. Na si nwuna kɔnu na úkulo ni, ɔlɛka bekulo nwuna kɔdi lɛnɔ. Na si ɔgba na úkulo ni, ɔlɛka bekulo nwuna ɔdi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.
translation_verse: Si bísela bitékpoku bina bekisine badi na bɛ́nu ka bekyuli bammɔ belie bapɔnkɔ ku kɛɛkɛ ɔni na bapɔnkɔ baaní lɛlɔ ni, na bɛ́nu bekyuli bumomo bɔni ntulo amii ni, bitanu-ma bitayia. Ɔsika bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔni náda-mii údie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, anwu ndubukpo ute-mii.

english_verse: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army
translation_verse: Na asa na bɛdubuse kalɔ ku bukpo ni, ɔlɛka Katɔti ɔkpane ɔdi ɔlɛ ubo ubenye bina anumi na ɔsu bekpone bammɔ ɔnini,

english_verse: and say, “Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.
translation_verse: “Israel bananabi, bise atu na binu. Ɔmwi kadi ni, bísela bitékpo. Bitayia bina bekisine bammɔ na enu ataƒɛ-mii na ɔtɔtɔ utagyu-mii.

english_verse: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔkya-mii akɔ na ɔdubɔya na bɛdi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.
translation_verse: Na baduɔti bammɔ lɛnɔ badubɔlɛ bebo na betemi bete bekpone bammɔ na beye-ma banini, “Ɔnana ɔdi ɔkya-mii akɔ mɛni na ɔ́tu ɔtɔ ɔwɔdi na útesie útetélie-nwu kemmo tɔ?” Na si ɔdi údie kenye ka “Ɛɛn” ni, na unwini uteesie kaduli. Na si ɔɔɔdi lɛni na ɔ́ta na útékpi na kekpo kammɔ kemmo ni, ukyuli ɔbambadi ndubo kaduli kammɔ kemmo bulie.

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Na basɔ beye bekpone bammɔ benu si ɔnana ɔdi ɔkya-ma akɔ na ɔ́tuma adingyii kemo kadi, nsu útakɛ kɔnu útaƒɛ edula ammɔ tɔ? Na si ɔdi ɔtuna ka “Ɛɛn” ni, bɛya na unwini usie kaduli. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni na ɔ́ta úsie kekpo kammɔ na útékpi ni, ukyuli bamba ndubɔni kɔdingyii kɔmmɔ ntɛ bute-nwu.

english_verse: If any of you are engaged to be married, you may go back home and get married. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to marry the woman you are engaged to.
translation_verse: Na basɔ beye bekpone bammɔ si ɔnana ɔdi ɔkya-ma akɔ na ɔ́bla uleku lili ala use, nsu útawɛɛ-nwu tɔ. Si ɔdi ɔ́tuna ka “Ɛɛn” ni, na bɛya na unwini usie kaduli. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, ukyuli bamba ndubuti uleku ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Finally, if any of you are afraid, you may go home. We don't want you to discourage the other soldiers.
translation_verse: Na basɔ beye bekpone bammɔ kɔkladi banini, “Bina akɔ ɔdi ɔkya na ɔtɔtɔ ɔɔgyú-nwu iye enu áƒɛ-nwu?” Na si badi bátuna banii “Ɛɛn” ni, na bɛya na benwini kalɛ na lɛlɔ lilawiɛ bekpone bakladi.

english_verse: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.
translation_verse: Na si baduɔti bammɔ bátɛmiku-ma báwɔlɔ ni, na bedie bekpone baƒanti bete bekpone bammɔ.

english_verse: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.
translation_verse: Nsu si bɛ́di lɛma lɛni nkya kalɔ kani na bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka wete-mii mmɔ lɛlɔ ni, na bɛyila lɛla biala nkya ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo udu.

english_verse: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Na lɛma lɛmmɔ ndi Hetiƒuɔ ku Amoriƒuɔ ku Kanaanƒuɔ ku Perisiƒuɔ ku Hewiƒuɔ ku Yebusiƒuɔ lɛma aani kalɛ na Unwoti úbo-mii ɔda úse ka bɛbla-ma mmɔ.

english_verse: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛyila-ma udu kalɛ na balátɔlɔ-mii na bitaabla ala ani muusé-nwu lɛlɔ ɔkɛnku bana lɛƒiɔkpa ablala lɛlɔ. Na ɔdi uláƒiɔ bina Unwoti Katɔti.

english_verse: When you are attacking a town, don't chop down its fruit trees, not even if you have had the town surrounded for a long time. Fruit trees aren't your enemies, and they produce food that you can eat, so don't cut them down.
translation_verse: Na si bítáka ɔma ɔdi bɛ́kya ka bikpoku-ma na kekpo kammɔ keetu uwi ni, bitada adingyii ammɔ. Ɔsika bɛkana na bɛdi ebi ani na aanwu mmɔ adi. Ɔsika egyii ammɔ aaadi bekyuli bani na bítáka bɛ́kya ka bikpo.

english_verse: You may need wood to make ladders and towers to help you get over the walls and capture the town. But use only trees that you know are not fruit trees.
translation_verse: Nsu bɛkana bɛda egyii ani naaadi adingyii bɛbla ala ani ndubɔya na bɛkɛ kenyekɔ bɛka bɛmana ɔmmɔ na biƒie-ma enu enu.

english_verse: Suppose the body of a murder victim is found in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you, and no one knows who the murderer is.
translation_verse: Si bɛ́nu ka ukyuli ɔdi úkpi ɔtɛ kemo na kalɔ kani kemmo na bina Unwoti ɔ́su ka wete-mii mmɔ lɛlɔ na bɛɛɛgyi ukyuli ɔni nádu-nwu ni,

english_verse: The judges and other leaders from the towns around there must find out what town is the closest to where the body was found.
translation_verse: lɛla lɛni na ɔdi ka bɛbla ndi ka bina benengu ku litemi batɛne besie kemo kani na ukyuli ɔmmɔ úkpi ɔtɛ na batákɔku eluku ani nkya mmɔ bɔgyu ɔ́si kemo kammɔ útédu lɛma lɛni nde mmɔ banu.

english_verse: The leaders from that town will go to their cattle herds and choose a young cow that has never been put to work.
