translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni kama ni, ɔma ɔni nde kesii kani na ukpine ɔtɛ benengu bawia ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔkɔdi ɔni na béteti-nwu bátabla kabla kadi kudii.

english_verse: They and some of the priests will take this cow to a nearby valley where there is a stream, but no crops. Once they reach the valley, the leaders will break the cow's neck. The priests must be there, because the Lord your God has chosen them to be his special servants at the place of worship. The Lord has chosen them to bless the people in his name and to be judges in all legal cases, whether property or injury is involved.
translation_verse: Na bɛya na Katɔti bakpane bani ndi Lewiƒuɔ badi basiaku-ma uwi ɔni na bésela batábla ala ammɔ. Ɔsika ama na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna ka bakpa-nwu na benye-nwu lɛnyi kenye bete bekyuli kusɛ kusɛ na batɛ etemila aani kalɔ etemila ku ukyuli bubo bɔkya ɔlɛ etemila.

english_verse: The town leaders will wash their hands over the body of the dead cow
translation_verse: Na si bekyuli bamɛni ƒui bása báwɔlɔ ni, na benengu bani nde ɔma ɔni na ukyuli ɔmmɔ úkpi ɔtɛ mmɔ baƒɔ bana enu bewi ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔmmɔ kama.

english_verse: and say, “We had no part in this murder, and we don't know who did it.
translation_verse: Na si baaƒɔ bana enu ammɔ ni, na basu banini, “Ɔɔɔdi abu nádu ukyuli ɔni nékpi mmɔ. Na bɔɔɔgyi ukyuli ɔni nádu-nwu.

english_verse: But since an innocent person was murdered, we beg you, our Lord, to accept this sacrifice and forgive Israel. We are your people, and you rescued us. Please don't hold this crime against us.” If you obey the Lord and do these things, he will forgive Israel. Marrying a Woman Taken Prisoner in War Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́bla lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su-mii mɛni ni, uleti ukyuli ɔni nékpi mmɔ kɔtɔ bɔdu ulasia bina kadi bekyuli lɛlɔ. Katɔti Úbo Israelƒuɔ Ɔda Na Beleku Bani Na Béƒie-ma Kekpo Kemmo Lɛlɔ

english_verse: From time to time, you men will serve as soldiers and go off to war. The Lord your God will help you defeat your enemies, and you will take many prisoners.
translation_verse: Si bísie kekpo kadi na bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́ya na bɛ́di-ma lɛlɔ na bíƒie bekyuli badi

english_verse: Later on, if you are not happy with the woman, you can divorce her, and she can go free. But you have slept with her as your wife, so you cannot sell her as a slave or make her into your own slave. Rights of a First-Born Son Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na si éti-nwu na ánu ka asɔ alayɔ-nwu ni, eeebo kuƒi ka anu-nwu aani ukyuli uyedi na eti-nwu eye. Ɔsika awɔ ku-nwu bɛ́tɛ na ébile-nwu. Anwuɔsu nyonu-nwu na uteesie ƒaa. Katɔti Úbo Israelƒuɔ Ɔda Na Bananabi Bedeedi Ala Bɔdi Kuƒi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Suppose a man has two wives and loves one more than the other. The first son of either wife is the man's first-born son, even if the boy's mother is the wife the man doesn't love. Later, when the man is near death and is dividing up his property, he must give a double share to his first-born son, simply because he was the first to be born. A Son Who Rebels Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Mmomu ɔdi ka ule nwuna akɛla kemmo akpa atɛ na uti akpa anyɔ ute ubidi ɔnanabi udeedi ɔmmɔ. Ɔsika ubidi ɔmmɔ nédie ɔti lɛnanabi keyi. Na anwu mbo ɔnanabi udeedi ala bɔdi kuƒi ina ka ɔti ulayɔ uni. Katɔti Úbo Israelƒuɔ Ɔda Na Bebi Bani Mbo Atuɔkplu Lɛlɔ

english_verse: A father and a mother may have a stubborn and rebellious son who refuses to obey them even after he has been punished.
translation_verse: Na lɛnɔ ni, bɛya na buti-nwu bɔnii ɔnana ɔdi ɔkya-mii akɔ na ubo ubi atuɔkplune na ɔɔta teenye nwuna bawɔne lɛlɔ. Na ubi ɔmmɔ ulenu bawɔne litemi ina báni-nwu kɔtu.

english_verse: If a son is like that, his parents must drag him to the town gate, where the leaders of the town hold their meetings.
translation_verse: Ubi ɔmmɔ udu bawɔne ni, ɔlɛka beti ubi ɔmmɔ besienku ɔma ɔni kemmo bakya mmɔ benengu anumi na kabanye kesii kani na benengu bammɔ beelie na beye-nwu kenye litemi.

english_verse: The parents will tell the leaders, “This son of ours is stubborn and never obeys. He spends all his time drinking and partying.”
translation_verse: Na si bawɔne bammɔ béti-nwu bésienku-ma anumi ni, lɛla lɛni na ɔdi ka bawɔne bammɔ basu ndi ɔnini, “Bula ubi ɔmɛni ubo atuɔkplu na ɔɔta teenye-bu lɛlɔ na si bɔ́su-nwu lɛla lɛdi uléti na ubo lɛkantakpi na ɔdi ntɛkpine ubendi.”

english_verse: The men of the town will stone that son to death, because they must get rid of the evil he brought into the community. Everyone in Israel will be afraid when they hear how he was punished. The Body of a Criminal Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na si bawɔne bammɔ básu ɔmɛni báwɔlɔ ni, ɔma ɔmmɔ bekyuli bebo-nwu atabi bádu. Na ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na bɛdubɔda bekyuli bekpidi bidie bina akɔ. Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na Israelƒuɔ kadi ƒui benu lɛla lɛmɛni, na ukyuli biala ɔdubɔyia na ɔti lɛlɔ bɔda. Úbo-ma Ɔda Na Ala Bamba Lɛlɔ

english_verse: If a criminal is put to death, and you hang the dead body on a tree,
translation_verse: Si bébo ukyuli bádu ɔkɛnku likpidi lɛni na ɔ́bla na béti ukpine ɔmmɔ báƒala ugyii lɛlɔ ni,

english_verse: you must not leave it there overnight. Bury it the same day, because the dead body of a criminal hanging on a tree will bring God's curse on the land. The Lord your God is giving this land to you, so don't make it unclean by leaving the bodies of executed criminals on display.
translation_verse: utalɛka ukpine ɔmmɔ ɔƒa mmɔ ugye kadi. Ɔlɛka bava-nwu limeyi lɛmmɔ kani. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, bɛdububile kalɔ kani na bina Unwoti Katɔti úti uute-mii mmɔ. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni na báƒala-nwu ugyii lɛlɔ ɔdanku Katɔti ewida.

english_verse: If you see a cow or sheep wandering around lost, take the animal back to its owner.
translation_verse: Si bina kemmo ɔdi ɔ́nu ka ɔnwani ɔmantɛ akɔ iye koƒonu kɔdi ka kɔkɛ kɔɔví na kulati kaduli ulu ni, utanyonu ebuo ɔmmɔ. Mmomu uti-nwu usienku ɔlati.

english_verse: If the owner lives too far away, or if you don't know who the owner is, take the animal home with you and take care of it. The owner will come looking for the animal, and then you can give it back.
translation_verse: Nsu si ebuo ɔmmɔ ɔlati kaduli kágyunku kesii kani na awɔ elie mmɔ iye alanu ebuo ɔmmɔ ɔlati ni, awɔ ɔni nánu ebuo ɔmmɔ ti ebuo ɔmmɔ sienku ƒula kaduli. Na si ebuo ɔlati úbanu ebuo ɔmmɔ na ƒula kaduli ni, na eti nwuna ebuo ete-nwu.

english_verse: That's what you should do if you find anything that belongs to someone else. Do whatever you can to help, whether you find a cow or sheep or donkey or some clothing.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na ɔlɛka bɛbla si bɛ́nu ukyuli ɔdi ɔƒlumu iye kɔdi iye lɛla bamba biala lɛni na ƒula ukyulikpana ɔ́yila. Na bitedie ala ammɔ atu.

english_verse: Women must not pretend to be men, and men must not pretend to be women. The Lord your God is disgusted with people who do that. Don't Take a Mother Bird Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Uleku utakya ɔnana awu. Lɛni kani na ɔnana lɛnɔ utakya uleku awu. Na bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubukisi ukyuli ɔni ndubɔbla ala ammɔ bene udu.

english_verse: If you build a house, make sure to put a low wall around the edge of the flat roof. Then if someone falls off the roof and is killed, it won't be your fault. Laws against Mixing Different Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi ɔ́tu lɛsa ɔtɔ ɔwɔdi ni, ɔnu ka ɔ́tu lɛsa ɔsangya na ɔ́kuku kalɛ na ɔdi ulánu na lɛsa lili na wekpi na básu banii anwu nádu-nwu.

english_verse: If you plant a vineyard, don't plant any other fruit tree or crop in it. If you do plant something else there, you must bring to the place of worship everything you harvest from the vineyard.
translation_verse: Ɔdi utava edula lidu inyɔ utakya nwuna adingyii kemo kani na ɔ́tuma kemmo. Si ɔdi ɔ́bla lɛni ni, uuubo kuƒi ka ɔƒɛ edula ammɔ adi iye ude ebi ammɔ adi.

english_verse: Don't hitch an ox and a donkey to your plow at the same time.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi utabala ɔpɔnkɔ ku ɔmantɛ akɔ anwami kɔgba utasala na begulu kalɔ bete-nwu.

english_verse: When you weave cloth for clothing, you can use thread made of flax or wool, but not both together.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi utakya awu ɔni béti unwo ku koƒonu linwini bédi básala.

english_verse: And when you make a coat, sew a tassel on each of the four corners. When a Husband Accuses His Wife Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Biti linwo lɛni na bébo-ni ekpo wɛlɛ wɛlɛ básala bɛkya bina adi avwi ene ammɔ atu akya. Úbo-ma Ɔda Na Kɔgya Ku Ule Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Suppose a man starts hating his wife soon after they are married.
translation_verse: Na bɛya na buti-nwu bɔnii ɔnana ɔdi úti uleku na kama ɔ́nu ka ɔsɔ ulayɔ uleku ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: If this happens, the bride's father and mother must go to the town gate to show the town leaders the proof that the woman was a virgin.
translation_verse: Si ɔ́lɛ lɛni ni, uleku ɔmmɔ bawɔne besie ɔma ɔmmɔ benengu kudɔ na ɔma ɔmmɔ kabanye kesii kani na beelie mmɔ na betédie bana ubi kenye ka uleku ɔmmɔ ɔdi adagyaa asa na ɔnana ɔmmɔ úti-nwu.

english_verse: and accusing her of not being a virgin. But he is wrong, because here is proof that she was a virgin!” Then the bride's parents will show them the bed sheet from the woman's wedding night.
translation_verse: Na kenye kani na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔɔdá-nwu ndi ka úti-nwu na ɔɔɔdi adagyaa. Nsu bɛɛnu lɛdiku lɛni lɛlɔ na báka bɔtɛ. Bɛɛnu ubugya ɔni néduo-nwu kemmo mɛni. Ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka ɔdi adagyaa asa na ɔnana ɔmmɔ úti-nwu.”

english_verse: The town leaders will beat the man with a whip
translation_verse: Si ɔ́lɛ lɛni ni, na ɔma ɔmmɔ benengu bata na bebo ɔnana ɔmmɔ kugyiimi kaduɛ!

english_verse: But if the man was right and there is no proof that his bride was a virgin,
translation_verse: Nsu si kenye kani na ɔgyani ɔmmɔ údie ɔdi sɔsɔ ka ulekubi ɔmmɔ ɔɔɔdi adagyaa asa na úti-nwu ni,

english_verse: the men of the town will take the woman to the door of her father's house and stone her to death. This woman brought evil into your community by sleeping with someone before she got married, and you must get rid of that evil by killing her. Laws about Illegal Sex Moses said:
translation_verse: na bakpanku ulekubi ɔmmɔ besienku ɔti kaduli na ɔma ɔmmɔ bananabi bebo-nwu atabi badu na ɔti kaduli kayakun kenye. Ɔsika ulekubi ɔmmɔ ɔ́di kɔsɔnɔ uwi ɔni na úlie ɔti kesii na útelie tɔ kɔgya. Na ɔmɛni ɔdi kɔƒa litemi. Na ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na bɛdubɔsia na bɛda likpidi lɛmmɔ udu bidie bina akɔ.

english_verse: People of Israel, if a man is caught having sex with someone else's wife, you must put them both to death. That way, you will get rid of the evil they have done in Israel.
translation_verse: Na si bíƒie ɔnana ɔdi ka úsie ɔɔtɛnku ukyuli ɔdi ulekudi ni, bibo ɔnana ku uleku ɔmmɔ bɛdu. Na ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na bɛdubɔsia na bɛda likpidi lɛmmɔ udu bidie bina akɔ.

english_verse: If a man is caught in town having sex with an engaged woman who isn't screaming for help, they both must be put to death. The man is guilty of having sex with a married woman. And the woman is guilty because she didn't call for help, even though she was inside a town and people were nearby. Take them both to the town gate and stone them to death. You must get rid of the evil they brought into your community.
translation_verse: na bɛkpanku ɔnana ku uleku ɔmmɔ bisienku ɔma kabanye na bibo bana inyɔ atabi bɛdu. Ɔlɛka badu uleku ɔmmɔ, ɔsika úni na útava útakpali ka babaƒɔ-nwu ina ka ɔma kemmo na bakya uwi ɔni na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔnii anwu ku-nwu baatɛ. Na lɛla lɛni ɔsu na ɔlɛka badu ɔnana ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ndi ka úsie ɔɔtɛnku uleku ɔni bévele béte ukyuli bamba. Na ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na bɛdubɔsia na bɛda likpidi lɛmmɔ udu bidie bina akɔ.

english_verse: If an engaged woman is raped out in the country, only the man will be put to death.
translation_verse: Na si ɔnana ɔdi útéƒie uleku ɔni na bévele-nwu béte ɔnana bamba na ɔ́yɔ-nwu na alakpiakɔ ni, ɔnana ɔmmɔ kani na ɔlɛka badu.

english_verse: Do not punish the woman at all; she has done nothing wrong, and certainly nothing deserving death. This crime is like murder,
translation_verse: Nsu ulekubi ɔmmɔ útalɛka badu-nwu, ɔsika útabla likpidi lɛni námanku kukpi. Na litemi lɛmɛni lise aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔsiáku nwuna ukyulikpana na ɔnii uubó-nwu ɔdu.

english_verse: because the woman was alone out in the country when the man attacked her. She screamed, but there was no one to help her.
translation_verse: Ɔsika uwi ɔni na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔkya ɔɔtɛnku-nwu mmɔ ni, ɔ́va ka ukyuli ɔdi úbaƒɔ-nwu. Nsu útakɛ ɔdi.

english_verse: Suppose a woman isn't engaged to be married, and a man forces her to have sex with him. If he is caught,
translation_verse: Na si ɔnana ɔdi ɔ́nu adagyaa ɔni bétete tɔ kɔgya na úƒie-nwu ɔkya ɔɔtɛnku na bánu-nwu ni,

english_verse: A man must not marry a woman who was married to his father. This would be a disgrace to his father.
translation_verse: Na ɔnana biala ku nwuna ɔti ulekudi ɔdi biala batatɛ. Na si ɔdi ɔ́bla lɛni ni, ɔdi kɔƒa kubendi kute-nwu.

english_verse: If a man's private parts have been crushed or cut off, he cannot fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni ndi ɔsaɛ ni, bitaya na uduo Unwoti bebi kasalakɔ.

english_verse: No one born outside of a legal marriage, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Na ubi ɔni na kɔsɔnɔ badi báwɔ-nwu ni, bitaya na utéduo Unwoti bebi kasalakɔ ɔ́si nwuna lɛlɔ útédu bana kaba leevudi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: No Ammonites or Moabites, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can become part of Israel, the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Bitaka Amonni iye Moabni iye bana kaba kadi utédu bana kaba leevudi lɛlɔ bitakya Unwoti bebi akɔ.

english_verse: This is because when you came out of Egypt, they refused to provide you with food and water. And besides, they hired Balaam to put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Ɔsika uwi ɔni bɛ́lɛ Egyipteƒuɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ na bíbedu bana lɛma ni, ɔdi utéte-mii adila adi na bɛdi iye ntu na bɛni. Mmomu buti na bététi Bileam ɔni ndi Boer ubidi ɔni nási ɔma ɔni baalɔ banii Petor na Mesopotamia kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ ka ubewida-mii.

english_verse: But the Lord your God loves you, so he refused to listen to Balaam and turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: Nsu bina Unwoti Katɔti útakpete Bileam ewida ammɔ. Mmomu búti na úti ewida ammɔ únwini kusɛ kusɛ úte-mii. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-mii litemi.

english_verse: Don't even think of signing a peace treaty with Moab or Ammon.
translation_verse: Na bitabla unwi ku Arnonƒuɔ ku Moabƒuɔ bamɛni na bitawia-ma bɔdia lɛnɔ kudii.

english_verse: But Edomites are your relatives, and you lived as foreigners in the country of Egypt. Now you must be kind to Edomites and Egyptians
translation_verse: Nsu Edomƒuɔ ama ni, bɛƒɔ-ma, ɔsika badi bina bekyuli. Na biteni Egyipteƒuɔ, ɔsika bíilie bana kalɔ lɛlɔ dii aani baƒɔ.

english_verse: and let their great-grandchildren become part of Israel, the Lord's people. Keep the Army Camp Acceptable Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si bana kaba katɛdi lɛlɔ úsela ni, bɛkana na bɛka bana bebi bibunku Unwoti bebi akɔ. Kalɛ Na Ɔlɛka Bekpone Bada Lɛlɔ

english_verse: When you men go off to fight your enemies, make sure your camp is acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́sala lisu bɛɛklibi lɛlɔ bite kekpo kadi ni, ɔdi utabla lɛla lɛni ndubɔya na nwuna lɛlɔ lilabla sɛɛn.

english_verse: For example, if something happens at night that makes a man unclean and unfit for worship, he must go outside the camp and stay there
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi úgye kɔna na lɛlɔ líbo-nwu na ɔmmɔ ɔsu na uuuse sɛɛn ni, ɔlɛka ɔlɛ kesii kani na bekpone bammɔ básala lisu bakya mmɔ na utákya kesii bamba.

english_verse: until late afternoon. Then he must take a bath, and at sunset he can go back into camp.
translation_verse: Na si úsela useyi uwi ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpi na ɔsɔ unwini ubo bekpone kakyakɔ mmɔ uwi ɔni na ɔƒɛ ɔ́nu.

english_verse: Set up a place outside the camp to be used as a toilet area.
translation_verse: Na bɛwia kesii bamba na bina kakyakɔ kama na biti bɛbla bina kuvodɔ kesekɔ.

english_verse: And make sure that you have a small shovel in your equipment. When you go out to the toilet area, use the shovel to dig a hole. Then, after you relieve yourself, bury the waste in the hole.
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi úsela kuvodɔ ni, ɔwia lɛnwami blii lɛdi ɔda na uku ubu asa na use kuvodɔ. Na uwi-ku lɛti si ɔ́wɔlɔ.

english_verse: You must keep your camp clean of filthy and disgusting things. The Lord is always present in your camp, ready to rescue you and give you victory over your enemies. But if he sees something disgusting in your camp, he may turn around and leave. Runaway Slaves from Other Countries Moses said:
translation_verse: Ka Katɔti ɔkya-mii akɔ uusié taasɔ na kesii kani na bɛkya na ɔɔgyumana-mii kalɛ na bɛdi bina bekisine lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, bɛbla bina keliekɔ sɛɛn kalɛ na ulanu lɛla lɛni maya na wenwini kama wakya-mii. Úte-ma Ɔda Bubo Bɔbambadi

english_verse: When runaway slaves from other countries come to Israel and ask for protection, you must not hand them back to their owners.
translation_verse: Si kabla ɔblane ɔdi úkeli nwuna unwoti kudɔ na úbo úbawia kabɛkɔ na bina ɔdi kudɔ ni, bɛƒɔ ukyuli ɔmmɔ na bitasɔku-nwu bitemene nwuna unwoti.

english_verse: Instead, you must let them choose which one of your towns they want to live in. Don't be cruel to runaway slaves. Temple Prostitutes Moses said:
translation_verse: Na bite ukyuli ɔmmɔ kuƒi na ɔkya-mii akɔ na ɔma ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́. Na bitenye-nwu lɛlɔ bɛnii ɔbla lɛla lɛdi ulikplu kemmo.

english_verse: People of Israel, don't any of you ever be temple prostitutes.
translation_verse: Na Israelni ɔnana iye uleku ɔdi utenwini ɔyalɛ na koƒiodu kɔdi.

english_verse: The Lord your God is disgusted with men and women who are prostitutes of any kind, and he will not accept a gift from them, even if it had been promised to him. Interest on Loans Moses said:
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni egulabi biala na ukyuli ɔmɛni udu ɔdubɔkɛ na kabla kani na ɔɔbla mɛni kemmo ni, uteti egulabi ammɔ adi uteboku bina Unwoti Katɔti kakpakɔ ɔnii ubedie lili na kenye kani na úse ɔsu. Ɔsika Katɔti bayalɛ beesé Katɔti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When you lend money, food, or anything else to another Israelite, you are not allowed to charge interest.
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi úvo egulabi iye adila iye lɛla bamba lɛdi úte nwuna Israelni ɔkpana ni, utaƒɔ-nwu kuvonsia kɔdi.

english_verse: You can charge a foreigner interest. But if you charge other Israelites interest, the Lord your God will not let you be successful in the land you are about to take. Sacred Promises to the Lord Moses said:
translation_verse: Nsu si úvo lɛla lɛdi úte ɔƒɔ ɔni nkya-mii akɔ ni, ɔkana na ɔƒɔ-nwu kuvonsia. Nsu Israelni ɔkpana anwu ni, bitaƒɔ kuvonsia kɔdi kalɛ na bina Unwoti Katɔti wete-mii kusɛ kusɛ na lɛla biala bíti bina enu bɛ́bla na kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na bísela bitélie mmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you make a sacred promise to give a gift to the Lord, then do it as soon as you can. If the Lord has to come looking for the gift you promised, you will be guilty of breaking that promise.
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi úse kenye kadi úte nwuna Unwoti Katɔti ni, ɔnu ka ɔ́ƒɔ kayu kammɔ. Na utabla atuɔkplu na kenye kani úse mmɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ɔdi likpidi ka ése kenye na aladi-ka lɛlɔ, ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubo-ɔ buye.

english_verse: On the other hand, if you never make a sacred promise, you can't be guilty of breaking it.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi likpidi lɛdi si étese kenye kadi étete Unwoti.

english_verse: You must keep whatever promises you make to the Lord. After all, you are the one who chose to make the promises. Eating Someone Else's Produce
translation_verse: Nsu lɛla lɛni na awɔ ɔlati néti ƒula bɔyɔ kemmo ásu na ése Katɔti kenye kadi bɔdi ni, nu ka ádi kenye kammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you go into a vineyard that belongs to someone else, you are allowed to eat as many grapes as you want while you are there. But don't take any with you when you leave.
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi ɔkɛ ɔɔví na útáda ɔ́lɛ ɔkpanadi adingyii kemo na ɔ́nu ka ebi ammɔ adi égyie ni, ɔkana na ude ɔdi na ɔdi umo. Nsu uuubo kuƒi ka uti kɔdingyii kɔmmɔ ebi adi uwi lɛla lɛdi kemmo usienku kaduli.

english_verse: In the same way, if you are in a grain field that belongs to someone else, you can pick heads of grain and eat the kernels. But don't cut down the stalks of grain and take them with you.
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi ɔ́kɛ ɔɔví na útáda ɔ́lɛ ɔkpanadi edula kemo ni, ubo kuƒi ka uti kɔnu na ukpeli edula ammɔ adi na ɔdi kalɛ na ɔkana. Nsu uuubo kuƒi ka ukulo adi ɔtɔlɔku.

english_verse: Suppose a woman was divorced by her first husband because he found something disgraceful about her. He wrote out divorce papers, gave them to her, and sent her away.
translation_verse: Bɛya na buti-nwu bɔnii ɔnana ɔdi úti uleku, na buti bɔmmɔ kama ɔ́nu lɛla lɛdi ɔ́siku uleku ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔsɔ ulayɔ-nwu. Anwuɔsu ɔnana ɔmmɔ úte uleku ɔmmɔ kakunkɛ ka ɔ́nyonu-nwu na údie-nwu ulu na ɔ́tɔlɔ-nwu kaduli.

english_verse: Later she married another man,
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama ɔnana bamba ɔ́nu uleku ɔmɛni na úti-nwu,

english_verse: Since she has slept with her second husband, she cannot marry her first husband again. Their marriage would pollute the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and he would be disgusted. Newlyweds Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: ɔnana udeedi ɔmmɔ ɔsɔ uuubo kuƒi ka utéti uleku ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ. Ɔlɛka ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔnu uleku ɔmmɔ aani ukyuli ɔni na béwi-nwu anumi kalɔ. Na si ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔ́sɔ úti-nwu ni, ɔdi lɛla lɛni muusé Unwoti lɛlɔ. Na ɔdi utatábla lɛla lɛni udu muusé bina Unwoti Katɔti mmɔ na kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na bísela bitélie mmɔ. Úbo-ma Ɔda Ɔbambadi

english_verse: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na si ɔnana ɔdi úti uleku ɔwɔdi ni, batakpanku ɔnana ɔmmɔ betesienku kekpo iye kabla kadi kemmo. Ɔlɛka bete-nwu kuƒi lɛkwa linwi na anwu ku ulekudi bakɛ kubiti.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that they will pay back the loan. But don't take one or both of their millstones, or else they may starve. They need these stones for grinding grain into flour to make bread. Kidnapping Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi úvo lɛla lɛdi úte ɔkpanadi ni, utaƒɔ nwuna kukɔ iye lɛklɔyi lɛni na uuti taakɔ ɔlaaƒɔ utése ɔkpa. Si ɔdi ɔ́bla lɛni ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ údie nwuna ɔkpanadi ɔmmɔ lɛdila ɔ́lɛku ɔnwani kenye kemmo. Ɔsika kukɔ kɔmmɔ na uuti taakɔ ɔlaaƒɔ na anwu ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli baadi.

english_verse: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community. Skin Diseases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi úƒie nwuna Israelni ɔkpana na úti ukyuli uƒiedi ɔmmɔ únwini ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla kabla teete-nwu iye úti-nwu uuyé ni, ɔlɛka bebo ukyuli ɔni néƒie ɔkpanadi uuyé mmɔ badu. Na ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na bɛdubo likpidi lɛmmɔ udu bɔda budie bina akɔ.

english_verse: I have told the priests what to do if any of you have leprosy, so do exactly what they say.
translation_verse: Na si ukyuli ɔdi uuƒi ɔlɛ buɛ ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔsia anu kaduɛ na ɔbla ɔsiaku lɛla lɛni na bakpane bani ndi Lewiƒuɔ badubɔsu-nwu ka ɔbla lɛlɔ. Na bɛnu ka bɛ́di ɔda ɔni líbo-mii mɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: And remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam after you left Egypt. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na binyimo lɛla lɛni na bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́bla Miriam uwi ɔni na bɛ́si bɛɛlɛ́ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that the money will be paid back. But you must not go into their house to get it.
translation_verse: Na si bina ɔdi évo lɛla lɛdi éte ƒula ɔkpanadi na úti nwuna kɔdi úse ɔkpa úte-ɔ ni, tesie tetéduo ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔtɔ kemmo na etéti kɔdi kɔmmɔ awɔ ɔlati.

english_verse: Wait outside, and they will bring out the item you have agreed on.
translation_verse: Mmomu sɔ nye keyi na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔlati utéti kɔdi kɔmmɔ uboku-ɔ.

english_verse: Suppose someone is so poor that a coat is the only thing that can be offered as a guarantee on a loan. Don't keep the coat overnight.
translation_verse: Na si ɔwabane névo lɛla lɛmmɔ na kɔdi na úti úse ɔkpa úte-ɔ ni, taƒɔ kɔdi kɔmmɔ tese lɛlɔ tetédu useyi uwi.

english_verse: Instead, give it back before sunset, so the owner can keep warm and sleep and ask the Lord to bless you. Then the Lord your God will notice that you have done the right thing. Poor People's Wages Moses said:
translation_verse: Mmomu useyi uwi ni, ti ɔwabane ɔmmɔ kɔdi boku-nwu na ubi lɛlɔ ɔtɛ. Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔda-nwu kubiti na kaƒɔ kadubɔyɔ bina Unwoti Katɔti.

english_verse: If you hire poor people to work for you, don't hold back their pay, whether they are Israelites or foreigners who live in your town.
translation_verse: Tanya Israelni ɔwabane iye ɔƒɔ ɔwabane ɔni nkya-mii akɔ takya si éti-nwu anii ubabla kabla na limeyi lɛyuƒɔla kenye ute-ɔ.

english_verse: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord, and he will punish you. The Death Penalty Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nu ka áƒɔ-nwu nwuna limeyi kabla kenye kayu asa na ɔƒɛ ɔ́nu. Ɔsika bɔwia na ɔwabane ɔmmɔ ɔɔwia egulabi ammɔ ɔbla lɛla lɛdi. Na si átaƒɔ-nwu kayu kammɔ na úwulo ɔ́kpali Unwoti na lɛla lɛni na ábla-nwu mmɔ ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔdu awɔ unwoti ɔmmɔ likpidi kɔtɔ.

english_verse: Parents must not be put to death for crimes committed by their children, and children must not be put to death for crimes committed by their parents. Don't put anyone to death for someone else's crime. Don't Mistreat the Powerless Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kuƒi kuuubo ka badu bawɔne na likpidi lɛni na bana bebi bábla ɔsu, na batadu bebi na likpidi lɛni na bana bawɔne bábla ɔsu. Mmomu ɔdi biala ɔ́manku ka badu-nwu na anwu ɔlati likpidi lɛni na ɔ́bla ɔsu.

english_verse: Make sure that orphans and foreigners are treated fairly. And if you lend money to a widow and want to keep something of hers to guarantee that she will pay you back, don't take any of her clothes.
translation_verse: Bɛsi litemi lɛlɔ siin bite baƒɔ bani nkya-mii akɔ ku bekpinebi. Na ɔdi utaƒɔ ukpinele ɔdi kɔdi utese ɔkpa si ɔɔwia kevonkɔ kadi.

english_verse: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws. Leave Some of Your Harvest for the Poor Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na binyimo ka dii uwi ɔdi kemmo ni, Egyipteƒuɔ bénye-mii lɛlɔ na bítaabla kabla teete-ma asa na bina Unwoti Katɔti úbaƒɔ-mii ɔ́lɛku bana enu kemmo. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na muubó-mii ɔda amɛni udu.

english_verse: If you forget to bring in a stack of harvested grain, don't go back in the field to get it. Leave it for the poor, including foreigners, orphans, and widows, and the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Na si bísie bitáƒɛ bina edula adi na bɛ́yiƒala adi bíse ni, bɛsɔ bitenwini bitetéti-nya. Mmomu bɛda biwi baƒɔ bani nkya-mii akɔ ku bekpinebi ku bekpinele. Na bitesie bitetéti edula ammɔ. Na si bɛɛbla lɛni ni, bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubuteete-mii kusɛ kuse na lɛla biala bɛɛbla kemmo.

english_verse: When you harvest your olives, don't try to get them all for yourself, but leave some for the poor.
translation_verse: Kunwi pɛ kani na ɔlɛka bisie bitála bina adingyii ebi na bɛsɔ bitesie bitatála ɔdi lɛnɔ. Bɛda ɔkladi bise bite bekyuli bani naaadi Israelƒuɔ ku bekpinebi ku bekpinele.

english_verse: And when you pick your grapes, go over the vines only once, then let the poor have what is left.
translation_verse: Na si bísie bítála bina adingyii ebi ni, bɛsɔ bitesie kunyɔdi lɛnɔ. Na bɛda ɔkladi biwi bise bite bekyuli bani naaadi Israelƒuɔ ku bekpinebi ku bekpinele.

english_verse: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.
translation_verse: Na bitaya na ɔlɛ-mii kasusu kemmo ka uwi ɔdi kemmo ni, bɛdi bekyuli bani na bénye-mii lɛlɔ na bɛɛbla kabla teete Egyipteƒuɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na líbo-mii ɔda ɔmɛni.

english_verse: Suppose you and someone else each accuse the other of doing something wrong, and you go to court, where the judges decide you are guilty. If your punishment is to be beaten with a whip, one of the judges will order you to lie down, and you will receive the number of lashes you deserve.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni bádu kɔtɔ mmɔ nwuna kɔtu bɔni ndi ka bebo-nwu kugyiimi. Na asa na badububo-nwu kugyiimi kɔmmɔ ni, litemi ɔtɛne ɔmmɔ ɔlɛka unwini ukyuli ɔmmɔ anumi ubi kalɔ asa na beteewi-nwu kugyiimi kɔmmɔ. Na likpidi lɛni udu na ɔ́bla ndubɔtina kugyiimi bumomo bɔni na ɔlɛka bebo-nwu.

english_verse: Forty lashes is the most that you can be given, because more than that might make other Israelites think you are worthless. Don't Muzzle an Ox Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Bakana na bebo-nwu kugyiimi aavlene. Na ɔmmɔ kama basɔ betebo-nwu lɛnɔ. Si útulo lɛni ni, badubo-nwu kɔƒa bɔkya na bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: Don't muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain. A Son for a Dead Brother Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na si ukyuli ɔdi ɔmantɛ akɔ unye ɔɔbla kabla teete-nwu ni, utenyimi-nwu kenye. Úbo-ma Ɔda Na Ukpinele Litemi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Suppose two brothers are living on the same property, when one of them dies without having a son to carry on his name. If this happens, his widow must not marry anyone outside the family. Instead, she must marry her late husband's brother, and their first son will be the legal son of the dead man.
translation_verse: Na si anwu ku uleku ɔmmɔ báwɔ ubi udeedi ni, na ubi ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla ɔnwani ɔni nékpi mmɔ ubi. Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na ɔnwani ɔni nékpi mmɔ lɛnyi lilayi na Israel.

english_verse: But suppose the brother refuses to marry the widow. She must go to a meeting of the town leaders at the town gate and say, “My husband died without having a son to carry on his name. And my husband's brother refuses to marry me so I can have a son.”
translation_verse: Nsu si uleku ɔmmɔ ɔgyani ɔnwani úni ɔnii uleti-nwu ni, uleku ɔmmɔ usie ɔma benengu anumi na ɔsu ɔnini, “Mina ɔgyani ɔnwani ɔnii ulayɔ-mii. Na ulayɔ ka ɔnwani ɔni nékpi ɔkɛ kaba kadi ɔkya Israel kaba kemmo.”

english_verse: The leaders will call the living brother to the town gate and try to persuade him to marry the widow. But if he doesn't change his mind and marry her,
translation_verse: Na si uleku ɔmɛni ɔ́su lɛni ni, ɔlɛka ɔma benengu bamɛni balɔ ɔnana ɔmmɔ na bakɛ lɛla lɛdi basu-nwu. Na si básu-nwu na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔ́mu unye ɔɔsu ka ulayɔ uleku ɔmmɔ ɔsu uleti-nwu ni,

english_verse: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, “That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.”
translation_verse: na ukpinele ɔmmɔ ɔta usie ɔma benengu bammɔ anumi na ɔda ɔnana ɔmmɔ lɛgbanvuo udie-nwu lɛgba na ɔbwɛ lisuo uwi-nwu anumi na ɔsu ɔnini, “Ati bene, ukyuli ɔmɛni néni ka ɔnwani utakɛ kaba kadi.”

english_verse: From then on, that man's family will be known as “the family of the man whose sandal was pulled off.” When Two Men Fight Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔsu ukyuli biala ɔdubɔnu bɔti kalɛ na ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ use. Na bekyuli basu banii ɔtɔ ɔmɛni kemmo na ɔnana ɔni bedie-nwu lɛgbanvuo ɔ́si. Úte-ma Ɔda Bubo Bɔbambadi

english_verse: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one man tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the other man's private parts,
translation_verse: Na si banana inyɔ badi beekpó na unwi ulekudi ɔ́lɛ ɔnii utáƒɔ ɔgyani na úse kalɔ ɔɔda ɔnana ɔkladi ɔmmɔ agobɛɛ taani ni, ɔlɛka beƒie uleku ɔmmɔ kɔnu bekulo.

english_verse: Don't try to cheat people by having two sets of weights or measures, one to get more when you are buying, and the other to give less when you are selling.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na bitawia akyami ani baakɔ́ku ala ɔgya ku ule bitese lɛlɔ biti bitaanya bekyuli taakya.

english_verse: If you weigh and measure things honestly, the Lord your God will let you enjoy a long life in the land he is giving you.
translation_verse: Bɛnu ka lɛbuala lɛni na bɛɛkɔ́ku ala unu ku akyami ani na bɛɛkya ala bumomo ƒui adi akɔkula ani námanku.

english_verse: But the Lord is disgusted with anyone who cheats or is dishonest. Wipe Out Amalek Moses said:
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti ulayɔ ukyuli ɔni mbo kasisi na ɔɔnu ukyuli anumi ƒui na ɔɔnya-nwu taakya. Katɔti Úbo Israelƒuɔ Ɔda Ka Badu Amalekƒuɔ

english_verse: People of Israel, do you remember what the Amalekites did to you after you came out of Egypt?
translation_verse: Na bitayiƒala lɛla lɛni na Amalekƒuɔ bábla-mii uwi ɔni na bɛ́si Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ bɛkɛ ulu bísela.

english_verse: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.
translation_verse: Bátina ka beeebo Katɔti bɔyia biala na bana kemmo. Anwuɔsu ka bánu báti ka lɛlɔ líitu-mii na bina ulu busie kemmo ɔsu ni, báta na békpoku-mii na bádu bani nábla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si bítéduo kalɔ kani na bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka wete-mii mmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔ́ya na bɛ́kɛ bɔnwuna bɛ́siku bina bekisine enu kemmo ni, bɛnu ka bɛ́du Amalekƒuɔ ƒui kalɛ na ukyuli ɔdi ulenyimo-ma muedi. Ɔmɛni ɔsu bise litemi lɛmɛni likpo na bitayiƒala!

english_verse: The Lord is giving you the land, and soon you will conquer it, settle down,
translation_verse: Si bísie bítéduo kalɔ kani na bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka wete-mii mmɔ lɛlɔ ni, na bɛ́bla bina keliekɔ bɛ́wɔlɔ ni,

english_verse: and plant crops. And when you begin harvesting each of your crops, the very first things you pick must be put in a basket. Take them to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: ɔdi biala na ɔ́bla edula edeedi na ɔ́ƒɛ-nya ni, uti edula edeedi ammɔ adi uwi kagyigyɛ kemmo na uti-nya usienku kesii kani na Katɔti kakpakɔ kakya.

english_verse: and tell the priest, “Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.”
translation_verse: Na utánu Katɔti ɔkpane ɔni mɔɔbla-nwu kabla uwi ɔmmɔ na ɔsu-nwu ɔnini, “Ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni líti edula amɛni líboku na líti mɔɔtina ka líduo kalɔ kani na mina Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka weti wete bula bati kuuku kemmo.”

english_verse: The priest will take the basket and set it in front of the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: Si ásu lɛni áwɔlɔ ni, Katɔti ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔƒɔ kagyigyɛ kammɔ na uti-ka utásia bina Katɔti lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ anumi.

english_verse: Then, standing there in front of the place of worship, you must pray: My ancestor was homeless, an Aramean who went to live in Egypt. There were only a few in his family then, but they became great and powerful, a nation of many people.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama bɛdubɔsu etemila amɛni na Unwoti anumi bɛnini, “Kuuku ni, mina ɔti ndi Aramni ɔni neeebo keliekɔ kadi. Bulie kani na uulie taata. Na útélie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na asa na ɔdubusie utélie mmɔ ni, nwuna badi beeemomo. Nsu ɔƒɛni búmomo na búnwini bekyuli bani mbo ɔyikun.

english_verse: The Egyptians were cruel and had no pity on us. They mistreated our people and forced us into slavery.
translation_verse: Ka búsie bútélie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ ni, Egyipteƒuɔ bammɔ bábla-bu kalala na bénye-bu lɛlɔ ka butaabla kabla teete-ma.

english_verse: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.
translation_verse: Amu na búwulo bɔ́kpali Unwoti ɔni ndi bula bati kuuku Katɔti ka ubo ubebunku-bu. Na sɔsɔ ni, únu bula bɔkpali na ɔ́nu bula lɛbibo ku kalala kani kemmo bɔkya.

english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́ya na búbo búlie kalɔ kani egyiibi ntu mɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii mɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu líti mina edula edeedi ani na Katɔti úti úte-mi mɛni muuboku-nwu.” Na si ásu lɛni áwɔlɔ ni, na eti kagyigyɛ kammɔ ese bula Unwoti Katɔti anumi na emwi-nwu.

english_verse: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town. Ten Percent of the Harvest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, awɔ ku Lewiƒuɔ ku bekyuli bani naaadi Israelƒuɔ bɛkɛ ebiti na lɛla libendi lɛni na bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́bla úte awɔ ku ƒula kaduli bekyuli ɔsu.

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: Na lɛkwa lɛtɛdi biala kemmo ni, biti bina edula lɛkpa leevudi bite Lewiƒuɔ ku bekyuli bani naaadi Israelƒuɔ ku bekpinebi ku bekpinele kalɛ na bakɛ badi na bemo na bina lɛma kemmo.

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama na asu anini, “Mina ala lɛkpa leevudi lɛni na lídie líse sɛsɛɛ líte awɔ mina Katɔti ni, ntada ntese mina kaduli. Mmomu líti ala ammɔ ƒui líboku Lewiƒuɔ ku bani naaadi Israelƒuɔ ku bekpinebi ku bekpinele aani kalɛ na ébo-mii ɔda anii mbla. Na ntata ntenye iye lɛ́yiƒala ƒula ɔda bubo bɔni ndanku ala lɛkpa leevudi bute lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: Na asɔ asu anini, “Ńtadi ala ammɔ adi uwi ɔni mɔɔbla kekwa iye lídie ɔdi uwi ɔni na liiise sɛɛn iye líti ɔdi líte ukpine ɔdi. Mmomu lɛ́di mina Unwoti Katɔti litemi lɛlɔ. Na lɛ́bla lɛ́siaku ala ani ƒui na ásu-mi anii mbla na ala lɛkpa leevudi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu, Katɔti, nwini anumi na anu-mi asiku katɔ ƒula keliekɔ kedee kesii kani na elie mmɔ. Na ete ƒula bekyuli Israelƒuɔ kusɛ kusɛ na ete kalɔ kani na éti éte-bu mmɔ lɛnɔ kusɛ kusɛ aani kalɛ na ése kenye éte bula bati kuuku, kalɔ kani egyiibi ntu mɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii mmɔ.” Bɛdi Katɔti Bekyuli Geen

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: Ɔmwi kadi ni, bina Unwoti Katɔti uubó-mii ɔda ɔnii bɛdi nwuna ɔda bubo ƒui lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu biti bina kɔyu ku kayi ƒui bɛdi-mu lɛlɔ sɔsɔ.

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Na ɔmwi ni, bɛ́lɛ ugyii ka Unwoti ndi bina Katɔti, na bíse kenye ka bɛdubunu-nwu litemi na bɛdubɔdi nwuna ɔda bubo ƒui lɛlɔ, na lɛla biala wasu-mii ni, bɛdubuti-ni.

english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Na ɔmwi kadi ni, Unwoti lɛnɔ ɔ́lɛ ugyii ka bɛdi nwuna bekyuli aani kalɛ na ɔ́su úse. Na ɔɔsu-mii ɔnii bɛdi nwuna ɔda bubo ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔya na bɛyu ɔkplu bitulo bekyuli bani ƒui nkya kayawi. Na amii ndubuti ɔbu ku bumwi bite nwuna lɛnyi. Na bɛdubɔbla bekyuli kedee bite bina Unwoti Katɔti aani kalɛ na ɔ́su úse.

english_verse: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ku Israelƒuɔ ɔma batɔnkune bammɔ ƒui básu bekyuli bammɔ banini, “Bɛdi ɔda bubo etemila ani búti buute-mii ɔmwi mɛni ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Soon you will enter the land that the Lord your God is giving to you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped, and he has promised that this land is rich with milk and honey. After you cross the Jordan River, go to Mount Ebal. Set up large slabs of stone, then cover them with white plaster and write on them a copy of these laws.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na bɛ́via Yordan Ketu kammɔ ni, na bɛtɛ atabi ammɔ bise Ebal Kɔbi lɛlɔ aani kalɛ kani na buubó-mii ɔda ɔmwi mɛni. Na bɛnu ka bɛ́kwaa atabi ammɔ lɛlɔ ku uƒi.

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.
translation_verse: Na bɛtu Katɔti lɛkpabi bɛlɛ mmɔ bite bina Unwoti Katɔti, na biti atabi bɛtu lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ. Na biteti lɛbuala lɛdi bitamana-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.
translation_verse: Biti atabi ani na bátanwi na bɛtu lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ bite bina Unwoti Katɔti, na bitaabla akpala teete-nwu.

english_verse: Next, offer sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing, and serve the meat at a sacred meal where you will celebrate in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Na bitaabla unwi bɔbla akpala na mmɔ na bitaadi unwi bɔbla akpala adila na bitaakɛ kubiti na bina Unwoti Katɔti anumi na mmɔ.

english_verse: Don't forget to write out a copy of these laws on the stone slabs that you are going to set up. Make sure that the writing is easy to read. Curses on Those Who Disobey
translation_verse: Na binweni etemila ani ƒui na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔdanku bɛsia atabi ani na bɛ́tɛ mmɔ lɛlɔ nwaa.” Ewida Adi Adubɔsi Ebal Kɔbi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Moses stood together with the priests and said, “Israel, be quiet and listen to me! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ku Katɔti bakpane bani ndi Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ básu Israelƒuɔ banini, “Bɛba lɛsɛ na bise atu! Ɔƒɛni ni, bínwini bina Unwoti Katɔti bekyuli.

english_verse: So you must obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu binu-nwu litemi na bɛdi nwuna ɔda bubo bɔni ƒui na úti uute-mii ɔmwi mɛni lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛmmɔ kani na Mose úbo bekyuli bammɔ ɔda ɔnini,

english_verse: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubutemi-mii kusɛ kusɛ na bina lɛma ku bina mmo.

english_verse: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ na bɛwɔ bebi pii na bɛkɛ edula pii lɛnɔ. Na ɔdubɔya na bɛkɛ ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku baƒonu pii.

english_verse: The Lord will make you successful in your daily work.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ na lɛla biala na bɛɛbla kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord will help you defeat your enemies and make them scatter in all directions.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubɔdi bina bekisine lɛlɔ ute-mii si bata banii bebekpoku-mii. Bekisine bammɔ badubɔsia ulu unwi bebo, nsu badubɔsia lilu maatɛ lɛlɔ bekeli.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ na bina kabla kani bɛɛbla kemmo. Na ɔdubɔya na bina linwu liyi ku bina edula ani na bɛdubɔƒɛ. Na ɔdubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ na kalɔ kani na úti uute-mii mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you follow and obey the Lord, he will make you his own special people, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Si biinú bina Unwoti Katɔti litemi na bɛɛdi nwuna ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ƒui ni, ɔdubuti-mii ɔbla nwuna bekyuli aani kalɛ na ɔ́su.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
translation_verse: Na kayawi bekyuli ƒui badubɔnu bɔti ka Unwoti náƒuna-mii ɔ́bla anwu ɔlati bekyuli. Ɔmɛni ɔsu badubutaayia-mii.

english_verse: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubɔya na bɛwɔ bebi pii na bɛkɛ ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku edula pii na kalɔ kani na úti uute-mii mɛni lɛlɔ. Na aka na ɔ́su úse ka weti wete bina bati kuuku.

english_verse: The Lord will open the storehouses of the skies where he keeps the rain, and he will send rain on your land at just the right times. He will make you successful in everything you do. You will have plenty of money to lend to other nations, but you won't need to borrow any yourself.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubɔlɛmi Katɔ kesii kani na ntu bɔ́bu bɔkya na ɔya na ɔnantu utaana teewi bina kalɔ lɛlɔ na nwuna uwi lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ na bina kabla kadia. Na amii bɛdubute kadi pii kevonkɔ. Nsu amii bilésie bilatáwia kevonkɔ kadi na bana kudɔ.

english_verse: Obey the laws and teachings that I'm giving you today, and the Lord your God will make Israel a leader among the nations, and not a follower. Israel will be wealthy and powerful, not poor and weak.
translation_verse: Si bɛɛdi Unwoti ɔda ɔni na úbo-mii mɛni lɛlɔ na bɛɛsia-mu anu kaduɛ ni, ɔdubɔya na bɛdi lili na biladi ɔka kudii. Na lɛla biala kemmo bɛdubo bɔbla udeedi na bilabla ukplodi.

english_verse: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Na si bíkpi ni, baasɛ ku bebuo ndubo bina lɛna bɔkun. Na lɛla biala liiibo na lɛbɔku-ma.

english_verse: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.
translation_verse: Na ɔgbankpi ɔmɛni ndubɔbla likposela ku akɔla budie taatina bɔni ndubo buse bute amii ku bina bawɔ.

english_verse: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.
translation_verse: Nsu si bítadi ɔda bubo bɔni na muute-mii ɔmwi mɛni lɛlɔ na bítasia nwuna ala ani na ɔ́tina-mii anu kpakplaa ni, ewida amɛni ndubo-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Your businesses and farms will fail.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubo bina lɛma ku bina mmo buwida.

english_verse: You won't have enough bread to eat.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubo bina edula ani bɛ́va ku adila ani bɛ́nwa bise buwida.

english_verse: You'll have only a few children, your crops will be small, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats won't produce many young.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubo-mii buwida na bilawɔ bebi pii, na bina edula lɛnɔ aaadubo bɔdia, na bina ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku baƒonu belemomo.

english_verse: The Lord will make you fail in everything you do.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubo bina lɛla biala na bɛdubɔbla buwida.

english_verse: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́bla likpidi na bíni bina Unwoti ni, ɔdubuti ala ani na aadu kɔnyana geen na ese basa basa uboku-mii lɛlɔ. Na ala ani muukpóku ukyuli kani ndubo buteebo-mii lɛlɔ úti útédu ka ɔ́yila-mii udu ƒui.

english_verse: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na binye bɛɛnu ɔnantu anumi ni, Unwoti ɔdubuti ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ku kɔnwinimi uyile kayaa uti utédu ka ɔyila-mii udu ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord will let you be defeated by your enemies, and you will scatter in all directions. You will be a horrible sight for the other nations to see,
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubɔya na bina bekisine badi-mii lɛlɔ. Na bɛdubɔsia ulu unwi bɛnii bitékpoku-ma, nsu bɛdubɔsia lilu maatɛ lɛlɔ bikeli bɛtɔlɔ. Na si ɔmɛni udu ɔ́lɛ lɛni ni, ɔdubɔbla kayawi bekyuli ƒui kalɛ kadi. Na badubuye lɛlɔ ka bi mɔɔlɛ́ na bina lɛlɔ mɛni.

english_verse: The Lord will make you suffer with diseases that will cause oozing sores or crusty itchy patches on your skin or boils like the ones that are common in Egypt. And there will be no cure for you!
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubɔya na eƒula eteeƒu-mii aani kalɛ na ɔ́ya na éƒu Egyipteƒuɔ úbavi. Na ɔdubɔya na bina ɔlɔna utaabla alɛbi na ulie ntu na utaadu-mii. Nsu kuvo kɔdi kuuubo kɔni mabwi-mii.

english_verse: You will become insane and go blind. The Lord will make you so confused,
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubɔya na biteekpi libuo na kasusu keteeƒu-mii na anumi ataabuɛ-mii.

english_verse: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒiiwi bɛduti bina enu bitaawia ala taanɔ aani banumbwɛne kalɛ. Na lɛla biala bɛdubɔbla limeyi ndi limeyi ni, lilatɛ lilete-mii. Bɛdubo abi bubo na bekyuli beteekpeli bina ala taaƒɔ, nsu ukyuli biala uuubo na ukpo ute-mii.

english_verse: A man will be engaged to a woman, but before they can get married, she will be raped by enemy soldiers. Some of you will build houses, but never get to live in them. If you plant a vineyard, you won't be around long enough to enjoy the first harvest.
translation_verse: Bɛdubɔnu beleku na bɛbla-ma elila, nsu banana bamba ndubukpeli-ma bɔƒɔ na beti-ma beti. Bɛdubɔtu lɛtɔ, nsu bilelie-ni kemmo. Bɛdubɔbla adingyii mmo, nsu bilákɛ egyiibi ammɔ biladi.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badubɔdu bina ɔmantɛ bakɔ na bina anumi, nsu bilákɛ bana lɛna lɛmmɔ lɛdi bilakun. Na bekyuli badubuti bina bapɔnkɔ wɛlɛ wɛlɛ batɔlɔku na bina anumi. Nu basɔ beleti-ma beleboku. Na bina bekisine badubo bebeti bina baƒonu batɔlɔku, nsu ukyuli biala uuubo na ukpo ute-mii.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ badubo bebeti bina bebi bananabi ku belekubi batɔlɔku na bina anumi na batátaabla-ma kabla. Na limeyi ndi limeyi ni, bɛdubɔnu-ma anumi ka benwini bebo, nsu keeke.

english_verse: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Na ɔgyu kakaaka kadi bekyuli badubo na babaƒɛ bina edula ani bíbo abi bɛ́va batɔlɔku, nsu baaadubo-mii kayu kadi bɔƒɔ. Lɛbibo kama lɛbibo na bɛdubɔnu.

english_verse: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane,
translation_verse: Na lɛbibo lɛdubɔya na bina kasusu keƒu-mii.

english_verse: and the Lord will punish you from head to toe with boils that never heal.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na ekpegyiibi alɛ-mii lɛgba, nsu bilákɛ-nya kuvo. Na alɛbi ku eƒula adubɔsia-mii ɔ́si bina lili úti útédu bina lɛgba lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na bekyuli bani naaadi Israelƒuɔ beƒie amii ku bina ɔga batɔlɔku besienku kalɔ bamba lɛlɔ kesii kani na amii iye bina bati kuuku bételie kudii na bitélie mmɔ. Na mmɔ na bɛdubɔkpa baƒiɔ bani béti ligyii ku atabi bánwi.

english_verse: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubugyingya-mii ɔkya kɔlɔ kɔmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubɔbla kɔlɔ kɔmmɔ bekyuli dɛye dɛye na beye banii bi ɔsu na ɔ́lɛku-mii lɛni. Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu badubɔma-mii.

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubɔva edula pii, nsu blii suɛ kani na bɛdubo bɔƒɛ. Ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubɔya na baalɔlɔ bebebile-nya evete ammɔ.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubɔtuma adingyii mmo na biwi lɛlɔ bɛnu-nya lɛlɔ kaduɛ. Nsu bilákɛ-nya ebi bilala iye bɛkɛ ebi ammɔ adi bɛbla ntɛ. Ɔsika beklubi badubuduo egyiibi ammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Nnɔ egyii adubɔkwɛ bina kalɔ kesi kesii, nsu bɛɛɛdubo nnɔ biala bɔkɛ bɔsiku-ni kemmo. Ɔsika nnɔ ebi ammɔ adubɔnu ebie ewi kalɔ.

english_verse: Even your children will be taken as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Bɛdubɔkɛ bebi bananabi ku belekubi pii, nsu bilákɛ-ma kɔsia kɔdi. Ɔsika bekyuli bamba badubo bebekpoku-mii na beƒie-ma batɔlɔku.

english_verse: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.
translation_verse: Na baalɔlɔ yuu badubo bina egyii ku edula bubile.

english_verse: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani naaadi Israelƒuɔ na bakya-mii akɔ badubo katɔ butaakɔ, nsu amii bɛdubo kalɔ butaayu.

english_verse: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers. More Curses for Disobedience Moses said:
translation_verse: Na ama ndubo-mii kevonkɔ bute, nsu ama belévo lɛla lɛdi na bina kudɔ. Na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, ama ndubo-mii lɛlɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: Lɛbibo lɛmɛni ndubo-mii lɛlɔ buteebo na eteekpoku-mii úti útédu ka bina ƒui bɛ́yii udu. Ɔsika bítenu bina Unwoti Katɔti litemi na bítadi nwuna ala bɔtina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him,
translation_verse: Ɔsika bítemwi bina Unwoti Katɔti ku ebiti ku lɛlɔyɔ na bina lɛkɛ kemmo.

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu kɔka ku utukwɛ ku kɔwaba bonwu kɔdubɔda-mii na bɛkɛ ku kasɔngya bitaabla kabla teete bina bekisine bani enu kemmo na Unwoti ɔdubuti-mii ɔ́kya. Na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na bibo abi laa wetédu ka bina ƒui bíkpi bɛ́yii udu.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na kadi bamba bekyuli bani na si bátɛmi na bilénu kalɔ basi ɔgyu kakaaka bada balɛ-mii lɛlɔ kɔnakunwi aani kalɛ na kasangbii kaayu teeƒie lɛkɔkɔbi kalɛ.

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bammɔ badubɔbla lili ɔkplu na balanu ukyuli biala kɔnyana, unengu ɔdi o-o iye ɔnamu ɔdi o-o, balanu-nwu kɔnyana.

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bammɔ badubo bebekpoku bina lɛma lɛni ƒui bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubo buti bute-mii. Na bina awodu ani na bɛ́tu bínyene ƒui na anya na bɛ́sia anu na kekpo uwi adubo bɔƒɛ.

english_verse: while you wait in horror. Finally, you will get so hungry that you will eat the sons and daughters that the Lord gave you.
translation_verse: Na kalala kani na bina bekisine bammɔ badubo-mii bɔbla si báda-mii bákya uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ɔsu ni, bɛdubo bina bebi bananabi ku belekubi bani na bina Unwoti Katɔti úte-mii bɔdu bɔkun.

english_verse: Because of hunger, a man who had been gentle and kind will eat his own children and refuse to share the meal with his brother or wife or with his other children.
translation_verse: Na ubidi lɛna lɛni na ɔ́kɛ ɔɔkun mmɔ ni, ulete bana akɔ bani nébu lɛna lɛmmɔ lɛdi ɔnii ɔkun.

english_verse: A woman may have grown up in such luxury that she never had to put a foot on the ground. But times will be so bad that she will secretly eat both her newborn baby and the afterbirth, without sharing any with her husband or her other children. Disobedience Brings Destruction Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na uleku ɔni nse buɛɛ na ubo kasusu geen na ubo akɛla ɔsu na ulesie kesi kesii muedi ni, si bina bekisine bammɔ báda bálɛ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, anumi adubugyie uleku ɔmmɔ na adila lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubo bɔbɛ na ɔdu ubidi ɔni na ɔ́wɔ ɔkun ku awɔla ammɔ. Na ulete ɔgyani ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́ iye ubidi bamba lɛna lɛmmɔ lɛdi ɔnii ɔkun.

english_verse: You must obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Because if you don't respect the Lord,
translation_verse: Na si bítewi lɛlɔ na bɛdi ɔda bubo ala bɔtina bɔni bénweni bákya ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo na biti ɔbu unengudi ɔni na bɔyia bɔkya-nwu kemmo bite bina Unwoti Katɔti ni,

english_verse: he will punish you and your descendants with incurable diseases,
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubuti lɛlɛ lidu lidu lɛni mɔɔví bekyuli na ukyuli biala ulakana-ni bɔbwi uboku amii ku bina bawɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔya na lɛlɛ lidu lidu lɛni mɔɔví bekyuli na batalɔ-ni anyi bátakya Katɔti ɔda bubo ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo libo-mii lɛlɔ na bikpi bɛyii udu.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: Na ina ka bimomo aani katɔ ayabi kalɛ ni, bɛdubɔsa bɛbla blii suɛ, ɔsika bítenu bina Unwoti Katɔti litemi.

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: Kalɛ kani na ɔ́yɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ na ɔbla-mii lɛƒɔndia na bímomo bíbu ni, lɛni kani na ɔdubɔyɔ-nwu kaƒɔ ka ɔyila-mii udu na bina lɛma lɛbla kuliekɔ kukpludi. Na ɔda-mii udie kalɔ kani na nka bísela bitéti binwini bina kadikɔ na bilie mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: Bina Unwoti ɔdubɔya na bigyingya bɛkya kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui. Mmɔ na bɛdubo baƒiɔ bani na béti egyii ku atabi bánwi bɔkpa, baƒiɔ bani na bina bati kuuku bátakpa kudii.

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Bina kayi kadubo buyi ku liƒu. Na lɛla biala bɛdubɔnu ni, lɛdubo-mii liƒu bɔda. Na si kadi kégye ni, bɛdubuye bɛnii uwi ɔmani na kadi kadubɔsa. Na si kása lɛnɔ ni, bɛdubuye bɛnii uwi ɔmani na kadubugye.

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: Na bina Unwoti ɔdubuti lɛkɔlɔ libendi libendi na uti-mii ɔkya-ni kemmo na unwini-mii usienku Egyipte kalɔ kesii kani na ɔ́su ka bɛsɔ bilésie kudii. Na si bíduo mmɔ ni, bɛdubuti lɛlɔ biye bite Egyipte kalɔƒuɔ bammɔ na bitaabla kabla teete-ma. Nsu ukyuli biala uláyɔ ka uye-mii.

english_verse: So Moses finished telling the Israelites what they had to do in order to keep the agreement the Lord was making with them in Moab, which was in addition to the one the Lord had made with them at Mount Sinai. The Third Speech: Israel Must Keep Its Agreement with the Lord The Lord Is Your God
translation_verse: Bunyimi bɔmɛni na Katɔti úbo Mose ɔda ka unyimi ku Israelƒuɔ na uwi ɔni bákya Moabƒuɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na úti-mu úbunku bunyimi bɔni na únyimiku-ma uwi ɔni na bákya Sinai kɔbi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Moses called the nation of Israel together and told them: When you were in Egypt, you saw the Lord perform great miracles that caused trouble for the king, his officials, and everyone else in the country.
translation_verse: Na bɛ́nu Unwoti ɔyikun bonwu ɔni na údie keyi na ala ebendi ku akɔla budie taatina lidu lidu ani na ɔ́bla úti úkpoku-ma.

english_verse: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni búbedu kesii kani bɔkya mɛni ni, Ɔga Sihon ɔni nási Hesbon ku Ɔga Og ɔni nási Basan báta bébekpoku-bu. Nsu bɔ́di-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. Keep the Agreement Moses said:
translation_verse: Na búti bana kɔlɔ na búle kɔlɔ kɔmmɔ búte Ruben ku Gad kaba, na búti kakɛ lɛnɔ búte Manase kaba.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛdi bunyimi bɔmɛni lɛlɔ kaduɛ kalɛ na lɛla biala bɛdubɔbla lɛtɛ lite-mii.

english_verse: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Na bɛ́nu kalɛ na baakpá ala ani muusé lɛlɔ ku ala ani na béti egyii ku atabi bánwi ku ala ani na béti sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi bávɔ.

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛnu kaduɛ kalɛ na bina akɔ ɔdi ɔnana iye uleku iye ɔtɔ iye kɔdua kɔdi kayi kelénwini kama kalakya bula Unwoti Katɔti na usie utákpa bana baƒiɔ bammɔ badi. Bɛnu kaduɛ na ɔdi utebile ɔdi kasusu aani kugyii kɔni ntu mbo ɔdu ukpidi ɔdi na bina akɔ.

english_verse: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.
translation_verse: Na bɛnu kaduɛ na bina akɔ ɔdi ɔni muunú bunyimi bɔmɛni ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni ulátɔlɔ lɛlɔ na anwu lɛti ɔsia ulu ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́ lɛlɔ na ɔsu lɛlɔ ɔnini, “Ɔdubɔdia bute-mi na ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na nkɛ mɛni.” Si ɔdi ɔ́bla lɛni ni, ɔdubɔya na bina ƒui bɛkywi bɛsa.

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubudie-nwu na Israel adua ammɔ ƒui kemmo na ɔya na ewida ala ani na bénweni bákya Unwoti Bunyimi Ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo ebo-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will strike your country with diseases and disasters. Your descendants and foreigners from distant countries will see that your land
translation_verse: Na dii limeyi lɛdi bina bebi ku bawɔ badubɔta ku bekyuli bani naaadi Israelƒuɔ na bási ɔgyu kakaaka babanu ɔgbankpi ku lɛbibo libendi lɛni na Unwoti úti úboku bina kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: has become a scorching desert of salt and sulfur, where nothing is planted, nothing sprouts, and nothing grows. It will be as lifeless as the land around the cities of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, after the Lord became angry and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Bina kɔlɔ ƒui kɔdubɔkywi na kabla aani mma ku kɔnu. Na si bɛkya edula adi biala ni, aaadubo bɔdia. Na livo muedi lɛɛɛdubo-nya lɛlɔ bɔkwɛ. Na bina kɔlɔ kɔdubɔbla aani Sodom ku Gomora ku Adma ku Sebiom lɛma lɛni na Unwoti úti kɔnyi na ɔ́kyula mmɔ.

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: Na mmɔ na kayawi ƒui bekyuli badubuye banini, “Bi mɔɔlɛ́ ɔsu na Unwoti úbile kalɔ kammɔ lɛni? Na bi bɛ́bla ɔsu na úti kɔnyi kati kati ɔ́kya-mii lɛni?”

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: Na kenye kani na bekyuli bammɔ badubudie ndi ɔnii, “Bekyuli bamɛni báta béni bunyimi bɔni na Unwoti únyimiku-ma uwi ɔni na ɔ́da-ma údie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Unwoti ndi bana bati kuuku Katɔti.

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: Bésie bakya baakpá ala bamba ani udu bátakpa kudii na Katɔti úbo-ma ɔda ɔnii ɔdi utakpa kudii.

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku livo lɛni néƒi-nwu ku nwuna kɔnyi kati kati kɔni na úti ɔsu na Unwoti ɔ́gya-ma ɔ́lɛku bana kalɔ lɛlɔ na úƒwimi-ma utáva kɔlɔ bamba lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu mmɔ belie ɔmwi kadi.”

english_verse: The Lord our God hasn't explained the present or the future, but he has commanded us to obey the laws he gave to us and our descendants.
translation_verse: Ala adi bene akya ani na bula Unwoti Katɔti úti ɔ́bɛla-bu. Nsu ɔda bubo etemila ese ete abu ku bula bebi ka bɔdi-nya lɛlɔ ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: Bɛya na buti-nwu bɔnii ala akpa anyɔ amɛni ƒui ébo-mii lɛlɔ, kusɛ kusɛ ku ewida. Na ɔ́si bina atuɔkplu ɔsu ni, bɛkya kesii kani na bina Unwoti Katɔti úgyingya-mii ɔ́kya na kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ. Mmɔ na bɛdubunyimo alakpa anyɔ ani na lɛ́da lɛ́va-mii anumi ka bidie.

english_verse: return to him with all your heart and soul and start obeying the commands I have given to you today.
translation_verse: Si amii ku bina bawɔ bɛdubunwini kayi bibo Unwoti kudɔ na bɛdi ɔda bubo bɔni líti muute-mii ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ku bina kayi ƒui ni,

english_verse: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back
translation_verse: Ina si bígyingya bɛ́kya kayawi ɔ́gyu kakaaka lɛkɔkɔ muedi ni, bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔsɔ ɔdubɔsala-mii na ɔsɔku-mii uboku kesii kani na úti úte-mii.

english_verse: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.
translation_verse: Na kɔnu kɔdubɔsɔ kutuku-mii kalɔ kani na bina bati kuuku bélie bávi. Na ɔdubɔya na ɔsɔ ɔtɛ ute-mii na bɛsɔ bimomo bibu bitulo kalɛ na bina bati kuuku bábla.

english_verse: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.
translation_verse: Bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubɔya na binu lɛlɔ kalɔ na bina kayi kemmo amii ku bina bawɔ kalɛ na biteenu-nwu litemi na bitaayɔ-nwu ku bina kayi ƒui. Na ɔmɛni ndubɔya na bilie kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ bítu uwi.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: Na ewida ani na ɔ́su ka adubo-mii lɛlɔ ni, adubunwini busie bina bekisine bani mɔɔwia-mii babla kalala kudɔ.

english_verse: You will again obey the laws and teachings of the Lord,
translation_verse: Na bɛsɔ bitaadi nwuna litemi ku ɔda ɔni na úbo-mii ɔmwi mɛni ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na ɔdia ute-mii na lɛla biala bɛɛbla kemmo. Na ɔdubɔya na bɛkɛ bebi ku bebuo pii. Na Unwoti ɔsɔ ɔdubɔyɔ-mii litemi na ɔdia ute-mii aani kalɛ na ɔ́yɔ bina bati kuuku litemi na ɔdia úte-ma.

english_verse: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Choose Life, Not Death Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nsu ɔlɛka binu nwuna litemi na bɛdi ala ani ƒui na únweni ɔkya nwuna ɔda bubo ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo lɛlɔ. Na ɔlɛka binwini bisie-nwu kudɔ ku bina kayi ƒui.

english_verse: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.
translation_verse: Na ɔda bubo bɔni líti muute-mii ɔmwi mɛni ni, buuubo ɔkplu buuute-mii na bɛsu bɛnii bilakana-mu lɛlɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: His commands aren't in heaven, so you can't excuse yourselves by saying, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are in heaven, and no one can go up to get them, then bring them down and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Na bɔɔɔkya katɔ katɔ na bɛsu bɛnii, “Ɔma ndubusie katɔ katɔ mmɔ utéti-mu uboku-bu kalɛ na bunu ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ na bɔdi-mu lɛlɔ?”

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Iye bɛsu bɛnii, “Ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔkya ɛpu kama kama ngye. Na ɔma ndubusie ɛpu kama kama mmɔ na utéti-mu uboku-bu kalɛ na bunu-mu na bɔdi-mu lɛlɔ?”

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Oowo! Uuuse lɛni. Mmomu ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bude-mii. Na bɛgyi-mu ku kesii kani na ɔkya. Anwuɔsu bɛkana bɛdi-mu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.
translation_verse: Na ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ni, lɛ́da ala adi mɔɔvá-mii anumi na bɛƒuna lɛni na bɛɛyɔ́. Na anya ndi ngba ku lɛkɛ, kukpi ku udu bɔyii. Bi na bɛɛwia, ngba munuu kukpi?

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: Na ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni líti ala amɛni líte-mii nnii bidie. Na anya ndi kukpi ku ngba! Ewida ku kusɛ kusɛ! Na mɔɔsu katɔ ku kalɔ ka benye ala ani mɔɔsu-mii mɛni kama. Nsu mɔɔsu-mii nnii bidie ngba kalɛ amii ku bina bebi beele ngba gyɔlɔɔ.

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛyɔ bina Unwoti Katɔti na binu-nwu litemi, na biti bina anu bɛsia-nwu lɛlɔ kaduɛ. Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na amii ku bina bawɔ belie ngba gyɔlɔɔ na kalɔ kani na Unwoti ɔ́su úse ka wete bina bati kuuku bani ndi Abraham ku Isak ku Yakob.

english_verse: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ɔ́ta na ɔ́su Israelƒuɔ ɔnini,

english_verse: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.
translation_verse: Bɛya na anumi egyie-mii na binye kpakplaa. Bitayia-ma. Na bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔlati ɔdubɔkya-mii akɔ. Na ulénwini kama ulakya-mii iye ɔda-mii ɔnyonu.”

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Amu na Mose ɔ́lɔ Yosua úbenyene Israelƒuɔ bammɔ ƒui anumi, na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Nye kpakplaa na taya na enu áƒɛ-ɔ, ɔsika awɔ ndi ukyuli ɔni ndubo bekyuli bamɛni bɔtɔnku na bitéduo kalɔ kani kemmo na Unwoti ɔ́su úse ka weti wete bina bati kuuku.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔlati ɔdubɔtɔnku-ɔ. Na ulálɛ-ɔ kama iye ɔnyonu-ɔ. Anwuɔsu taya na enu áƒɛ-ɔ iye liƒu lɛda-a.” Ɔlɛka Bitaaka Ɔda Bubo Ɔku Etemila Ammɔ Na Kadi Akɔ

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Mose únweni ɔda bubo etemila ammɔ úse na úti-nya úte Israelƒuɔ benengu ku Lewiƒuɔ bakpane bani nti Katɔti Bunyimi Adaka.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: Na ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na bina bawɔ bani nétenu tɔ bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔda bubo etemila amɛni udu kudii benu-nya. Na ɔmɛni ndubɔya na batɛya kalɛ na ɔlɛka beti ɔbu bete-nwu uwi ɔni na bɛ́via Yordan Ketu na bísie bilie kalɔ kani na ɔ́su-mii ɔni bitélie mmɔ lɛlɔ.” Ɔda Bubo Bukplodi Bɔni Na Unwoti Úti Úte Mose

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Ƒula kukpi uwi úudu. Anwuɔsu lɔ Yosua na bibenye kɔdi ɔtɔ ɔmɛni anumi na lɛtina-nwu lɛla lɛni na ɔlɛka ɔbla.” Anwuɔsu Mose ku Yosua bálɛ bébenye kɔdi ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ anumi.

english_verse: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔ́buɛ ɔ́lɛ-ma akɔ aani liƒlukutu kalɛ, na liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ líbenye kɔdi ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ anumi.

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Adubo bukpi. Na ƒula kekpima ni, bekyuli bamɛni badubo-mi kama bɔlɛ na bata benye ɔda ɔni na líbo-ma lɛlɔ. Badubo-mi bɔda buse na besie batátaakpa kadi bamba baƒiɔ na kalɔ kani lɛlɔ bésela betélie mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: Na si ɔ́lɛ lɛni ni, ndubo kɔnyi buti bɔkya-ma geen. Na ndubo-ma bɔda bɔnyonu na bayila-ma udu. Na ndubɔya ɔgbankpi lidu lidu libo-ma lɛlɔ. Na si ala amɛni udu eebo-ma lɛlɔ ni, mmɔ na badubɔnu bɔti ka Ami ɔni ndi bana Katɔti nsɔ liiibo-ma akɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Na ndubuni ka libunku-ma, ɔsika bénwini bésie bakya baakpá baƒiɔ ɔ́si bana likyulikpi ɔsu.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: Na ndubuti-ma busienku kalɔ kani egyiibi ntu mɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii mmɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na líse kenye líte bana bati kuuku. Na adila biala na baawia ni, ndubo-ma bute, na badi bemo ku ebiti. Nsu ɔmɛni kama ƒui badubo kama bunwini bɔkya-mi na batákpa kadi bamba baƒiɔ. Na badubo-mi buni na bata benye mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔya na ɔgbankpi lidu lidu libo-ma lɛlɔ na batu ɔnu ɔmɛni beti benyimene lɛlɔ kalɛ na báƒiɔ-mi. Ɔsika bana bawɔ muedi ƒui kani na bakya beeti balayiƒala-nwu. Ɔƒɛni ngyi-ma kasusu ƒui asa na ndubɔsu ka líiti-ma líselaku kalɔ kani na lɛ́su líse ka ndubute-ma lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛmmɔ kani lɛlɔ ni, Mose únweni ɔnu ɔmmɔ úse na úti ɔ́tina Israelƒuɔ ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Be brave and strong! I will help you lead the people of Israel into the land that I have promised them.”
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Yosua ɔni ndi Nun ubidi ɔnini, “Nye kpakplaa na akya ɔkplu. Ɔsika awɔ ndubo Israelƒuɔ bamɛni bɔkpanku busienku kalɔ kani lɛ́su líse ka meti mete-ma lɛlɔ. Na ndubulieku-ɔ.”

english_verse: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book,
translation_verse: Na Mose úwi lɛlɔ na únweni Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ ɔkya ɔku kemmo na ɔ́nu kaduɛ ka útada lɛla lɛdi útakya.

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: Ka únweni ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔ́su Lewiƒuɔ bakpane bani mɔɔnu Unwoti Bunyimi Adaka lɛlɔ ɔnini,

english_verse: This is The Book of God's Law. Keep it beside the sacred chest that holds the agreement the Lord your God made with Israel. This book is proof that you know what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: “Biti Katɔti ɔda bubo ɔku ɔmɛni bɛkya bina Unwoti Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ kakɛ kenwi kalɛ na wenwini likposela wete nwuna bekyuli.

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ngyi kalɛ na baatá teenye ala lɛlɔ na bebo atuɔkplu. Na baata teenye Unwoti lɛlɔ uwi ɔni na ami Mose nlie ngba na nkya-ma kudɔ. Na ngyi ka badubo bɔbla butulo lɛni na mina kekpima.”

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
