translation_verse: Amu na Yesaia ɔ́kpali katɔ, na Unwoti ɔ́ya na ɔyuli ɔmmɔ úti ɔ́kɔ katɔ lɛgba leevu. Na ɔmɛni úbo úte lɛni na Ɔga Ahas ɔtɔ kanyakɔ ubili ɔni na ɔ́tu lɛlɔ. Batalane Badi Bási Babilon Bébo

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah had been sick, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kani kemmo ni, Babilonƒuɔ ɔga ɔni ndi Baladan ubidi Merodak-Baladan únu ka Ɔga Hesekia uuƒi. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔ́tala bekyuli na úti kakunkɛ ku etela adi úte-ma ka béti béteesienku-nwu.

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Amu na Hesekia ɔ́ƒɔ baƒɔ bammɔ na úti-ma ɔ́vinku nwuna ɔtɔ ɔni kemmo na uusé nwuna ala. Na ɔ́tina-ma nwuna akɛla ƒui ku nwuna sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi ku nwuna akyala ku awɛɛla ani muunwenyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ku nwuna ekpola ƒui, na lɛla biala lítebu ɔni na úteti útatina-ma.

english_verse: Isaiah asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama kenye udiene Yesaia úsie Ɔga Hesekia kudɔ na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Wɛ na bekyuli bamɛni bási, na bi na básu-ɔ?” Na Hesekia údie kenye ɔnini, “Bekyuli bammɔ bási ɔgyu kakaaka na Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Then Isaiah told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesaia ɔ́su Hesekia ɔnini, “Se atu na enu lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔɔsu-ɔ.

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: ‘Uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ɔni na lɛla biala lɛni nse ɔga kaduli mmɔ ku ala ani na ƒula baga bani na bélie bávi báwia bése úbedu ɔmwi kadi badubo-nya buti busienku Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ ɔni na belébu lɛla lɛdi belése.

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Na badubo awɔ ɔlati bawɔ badi buti bɔtɔlɔku busienku Babilon na bedie-ma agobɛɛ. Na badubunwini Babilonƒuɔ ɔga kabla bablane.’ ”

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told Isaiah, “The message you brought me from the Lord is good.” Hezekiah Dies (
translation_verse: Na Hesekia únu kalɔ ka ɔdubo atu bɔyɔ bɔkɛ na ɔkɛ Unwoti kagyumana na nwuna ngba uwi ƒui. Anwuɔsu údie kenye ɔnini, “Kenye kani nási Unwoti kudɔ kébo-mi kudɔ mɛni kadia.” Hesekia Lɛga Bɔdi Kawɔlɔkɔ

english_verse: Everything else Hezekiah did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he made the upper pool and tunnel bring water into Jerusalem, is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Na lɛla biala na Ɔga Hesekia ɔ́bla ku nwuna kayi buse ablala ku kalɛ na ɔ́bla asa na ɔ́tu ntu kewikɔ na úku libu na ntu buubo teebewi ɔma kemmo ni, bénweni-nya bákya Yudaƒuɔ baga lɛlɔ kɔtɛ ɔku kemmo.

english_verse: Amon disobeyed the Lord, just as his father Manasseh had done.
translation_verse: Na aani kalɛ na ɔti Manase ɔ́bla ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́bla likpidi na Unwoti anumi.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord God of Israel, will destroy both Jerusalem and Judah! People will hear about it but won't believe it.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ami Unwoti ɔni ndi Israelƒuɔ Katɔti ndubuti ɔgbankpi ɔmɛni liboku Israelƒuɔ ku Yerusalemƒuɔ lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli biala ɔni menu litemi lɛmɛni ni, nwuna atu kemmo adubɔbla-nwu yaa.

english_verse: He rebuilt the local shrines that his father Hezekiah had torn down. He built altars for the god Baal and set up a sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah, just as King Ahab of Israel had done. And he faithfully worshiped the stars in heaven.
translation_verse: Na ɔti Hesekia akpabi ani na úbo ɔ́ƒɛ ni, ɔ́sɔku-nya ɔ́tu. Na ɔ́tu akpabi úte Baal baƒiɔ bɔkpa. Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́sɔku Asera baƒiɔ ɔ́tu aani kalɛ na Ɔga Ahab ɔ́bla ɔ́vi. Na Ɔga Manase lɛnɔ ɔ́kpa ayabi.

english_verse: In the temple, where only the Lord was supposed to be worshiped, Manasseh built altars for the worship of pagan gods
translation_verse: Na kakpakɔ kani na Unwoti ɔ́su ka bataakpa-nwu ni, ɔ́tu akpabi ɔ́lɛ mmɔ.

english_verse: and the stars. He placed these altars in both courts of the temple,
translation_verse: Na Unwoti kakpakɔ kɔduli inyɔ bɔmmɔ kemmo ni, ɔ́tu akpabi ani baakpá ayabi ɔ́lɛ-nya kemmo.

english_verse: and even set up the pole for Asherah there. Manasseh practiced magic and witchcraft; he asked fortunetellers for advice and sacrificed his own son. He did many sinful things and made the Lord very angry. Years ago the Lord had told David and his son Solomon: Jerusalem is the place I prefer above all others in Israel. It belongs to me, and there I will be worshiped forever.
translation_verse: Manase ɔ́tu Asera ɔƒiɔgyii ɔ́lɛ Katɔti kakpakɔ kesii kani na Unwoti ɔ́su Dawid ku ubidi Salomo ɔnini, “Na Yerusalem mɛni na kakpakɔ kamɛni kemmo ni, lɛ́ƒuna Israel lɛ́lɛku kaba kammɔ ƒui kemmo ka bataakpa-mi.

english_verse: If my people will faithfully obey all the commands in the Law of my servant Moses, I will never make them leave the land I gave to their ancestors.
translation_verse: Na si Israelƒuɔ badubɔdi mina ɔda bubo bɔni mina kabla ɔblane Mose úti úte-ma ƒui kaduɛ ni, lɛɛɛdubo kuƒi bute na bekyuli badi babɔku-ma balɛku kalɔ kani líti líte bana bati kuuku mmɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: But the people of Judah disobeyed the Lord. They listened to Manasseh and did even more sinful things than the nations the Lord had wiped out.
translation_verse: Nsu Yudaƒuɔ bétenu Unwoti litemi. Na báya na Manase ɔ́kpanku-ma na bakya baabla likpidi lɛni ntulo kadi bamba bekyuli bani na Unwoti ɔ́bɔku uwi ɔni na Israelƒuɔ békpo bésela anumi mmɔ.

english_verse: One day the Lord said to some of his prophets:
translation_verse: Na Unwoti úti ɔ́siaku nwuna kenye bediene lɛlɔ na ɔ́su ɔnini,

english_verse: King Manasseh has done more disgusting things than the Amorites, and he has led my people to sin by forcing them to worship his idols.
translation_verse: “Ɔga Manase ɔ́bla ala ani muusé lɛlɔ teetulo Amoriƒuɔ lɛdi ƒui. Na ɔ́kɛnku nwuna lɛƒiɔkpa ɔsu na ɔ́kpanku Yudaƒuɔ útákya likpidi kemmo.

english_verse: Jerusalem is as sinful as Ahab and the people of Samaria were. So I will wipe out Jerusalem and be done with it, just as someone wipes water off a plate and turns it over to dry.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔni Yerusalem kɔtu aani kalɛ na lɛ́ni Samaria kɔtu. Na aani kalɛ na lɛ́bla Israelƒuɔ Ɔga Ahab ku nwuna kaba bekyuli ni, lɛni kani na ndubo Israel bɔƒɔ aani kalɛ na baaƒɔ akyami na benwini-nya teebi.

english_verse: I will even get rid of my people who survive. They will be defeated and robbed by their enemies.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mebu ni, ndubudie-ma atu. Na lɛnyonu-ma lɛkya bana bekisine enu kemmo na bekpo badi-ma lɛlɔ na batuma mmo bete-ma na ama alati kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My people have done what I hate and have not stopped making me angry since their ancestors left Egypt.
translation_verse: Ndubɔbla mina bekyuli kalala kamɛni, ɔsika bábla likpidi na mina anumi na bákya-mi kɔnyi. Úti ɔ́si uwi ɔni na bana bati kuuku bálɛ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ubedu ɔmwi kadi.”

english_verse: Manasseh was guilty of causing the people of Judah to sin and disobey the Lord. He also refused to protect innocent people—he even let so many of them be killed that their blood filled the streets of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Manase ɔ́du bekyuli pii bani nátaƒiɔ na Yerusalem lɛblɔnu lɛgba ku ubugya. Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́kpanku Yudaƒuɔ úbunku ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ útákya lɛƒiɔkpa kemmo. Na ɔ́ya na bábla likpidi na Unwoti anumi.

english_verse: Everything else Manasseh did while he was king, including his terrible sins, is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Na ala bamba ani ƒui na Manase ɔ́bla ku ekpidi ani ƒui ɔbla bénweni-nya bákya Yudaƒuɔ baga lɛlɔ kɔtɛ ɔku kemmo.

english_verse: He died and was buried in Uzza Garden near his palace, and his son Amon became king. King Amon of Judah (
translation_verse: Na Manase úkpi na báva-nwu ɔga kaduli kevomadɔ kani Usa ɔ́bla. Na ubidi Amon úti-nwu keliekɔ aani ɔga kalɛ. Amon Ɔ́di Lɛga Na Yuda

english_verse: Amon worshiped the idols Manasseh had made and
translation_verse: Na ɔ́siaku ɔti ɔbladu ukpidi kama. Na baƒiɔ bani na ɔti ɔ́kpa ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́kpa-ma.

english_verse: refused to be faithful to the Lord, the God his ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Na úni Unwoti ɔni ndi bana bati kuuku Katɔti ku nwuna ɔda bubo.

english_verse: Some of Amon's officials plotted against him and killed him in his palace.
translation_verse: Na Amon kabla bablane béti-nwu lɛlɔ kasusu kekpidi. Na bábɛ bádu-nwu na ɔga kaduli mmɔ.

english_verse: While Shaphan was at the temple, Hilkiah handed him a book and said, “Look what I found here in the temple—The Book of God's Law.” Shaphan read it,

english_verse: and ask Hilkiah the high priest to collect from the guards all the money that the people have donated.
translation_verse: “Nu ɔkpane ɔni muunye kakpakɔ kayakun taaƒɔ bekyuli egulabi. Na eye-nwu enu egulabi ani na ɔ́ɔkɛ.

english_verse: Tell Hilkiah to give it to the men supervising the repairs to the temple. They can use some of the money to pay
translation_verse: Na asu-nwu na uti egulabi ammɔ ƒui ute bekyuli bani mɔɔklibi kakpakɔ kammɔ.

english_verse: the workers, and with the rest of it they can buy wood and stone for the repair work.

english_verse: They are honest, so we won't ask them to keep track of the money.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔbla kakpakɔ kabla kammɔ ni, baabla ala ulu lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu útamanku ka babu egulabi ammɔ akunta adi.”

english_verse: then went back to Josiah and reported, “Your officials collected the money in the temple and gave it to the men supervising the repairs.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama Saƒan únwini úsie Ɔga Yosia kudɔ na útásu-nwu ɔnini, “Ƒula benengu béti kakpakɔ egulabi ammɔ bésienku bekyuli bani nkya mɔɔklibi kakpakɔ kammɔ.”

english_verse: But there's something else, Your Majesty. The priest Hilkiah gave me this book.” Then Shaphan read it out loud.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Aanu ɔku ɔni na ɔkpane Hilkia úti úte-mi.” Amu na Saƒan ɔ́ka ɔku ɔmmɔ kemmo etemila úte ɔga.

english_verse: When Josiah heard what was in The Book of God's Law, he tore his clothes in sorrow.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Ɔga Yosia únu etemila ammɔ ni, ɔ́ta na ɔ́ni nwuna adala ɔ́bwɛ.

english_verse: At once he called together Hilkiah, Shaphan, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Achbor son of Micaiah, and his own servant Asaiah. He said,
translation_verse: Na ɔga úbo ɔda úte ɔkpane Hilkia ku Ahikam ubidi Saƒan ku Mikaia ubidi Akbor ku ɔku unwenine Saƒan ku kabla ɔblane Asaia ɔda ɔnini,

english_verse: “The Lord must be furious with me and everyone else in Judah, because our ancestors did not obey the laws written in this book. Go find out what the Lord wants us to do.”
translation_verse: “Bisie na bitánu Unwoti bite ami ku Yudaƒuɔ ƒui lili ku ala ani na ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo etemila aasu. Ɔsika Unwoti úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya-bu ka bula bati kuuku bátabla bátasiaku ala ani na ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo etemila aasu ka bɔbla.”

english_verse: The five men left at once and went to talk with Huldah the prophet. Her husband was Shallum, who was in charge of the king's clothes. Huldah lived in the northern part of Jerusalem, and when they met in her home,
translation_verse: Na ɔkpane Hilkia ku Ahikam ku Akbor ku Saƒan ku Asaia bésie uleku Kenye Udiene Hulda ɔni nli Yerusalem ɔvi unyɔdi kudɔ. Na ɔgyani baalɔ banii Salum, na ɔti baalɔ Tikwa. english_verse: “Josiah, I am the Lord! And I will see to it that this country and everyone living in it will be destroyed. It will happen just as this book says.
translation_verse: ɔsika lɛni na Unwoti ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Ndubo Yerusalem ku bekyuli bani nkya mmɔ bɔkyula aani kalɛ na bénweni bákya ɔku ɔni na ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔ́ka kemmo.

english_verse: The people of Judah have rejected me. They have offered sacrifices to foreign gods and have worshiped their own idols. I cannot stand it any longer. I am furious.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bammɔ béni-mi na bábla akpala béte benwoti babambadi. Na ɔkɛnku ala ani bábla mmɔ ɔsu bákya-mi kɔnyi. Na lɛ́kɛ kɔnyi kɔni na kulebo kalɔ na Yerusalemƒuɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I noticed how sad you were when you read that this country and its people would be completely wiped out. You even tore your clothes in sorrow, and I heard you cry.
translation_verse: Na ávumana kayi na éboku lɛlɔ kalɔ éte-mi. Na áni ƒula adala ábwɛ na akya eewulo uwi ɔni na énu ásiku ɔku ɔmmɔ kemmo ka ndubo Yerusalem ku bekyuli bammɔ ƒui kɔtu bɔni na lɛbla-ma aani ewida lɛla. Anwuɔsu línu ƒula katɔ bɔkpali.

english_verse: So I will let you die in peace, before I destroy this place.” The men left and took Huldah's answer back to Josiah.
translation_verse: Na kɔtu kɔni ndubo Yerusalem bɔni mmɔ ni, kɔdububo ƒula kekpima. Na ndubɔya na ekpi ku atubɔyɔ.’ ” Amu na bekyuli bammɔ bénwini bésie Ɔga Yosia kudɔ na bátásu-nwu kenye kammɔ.

translation_verse: Na Ɔga Neko ɔ́ya na Yosia ubidi Eliakim ɔbla ɔga na Yuda, na ɔ́ya na úlie ɔti keliekɔ. Na ɔ́vumana-nwu lɛnyi ɔ́bla Yehoiakim. Na Ɔga Neko úti Yehoahas útákya Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ, na mmɔ na útékpi. Bése Yehoiakim Lɛga Na Yuda

translation_verse: Uwi ɔni Yosia ɔɔdi lɛga ni, Egyipteƒuɔ ɔga ɔ́kpanku nwuna bekpone na béténye Euƒrate Ketudɔ ka ubunku Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga kekpo. Na Ɔga Yosia ɔ́kya ɔkplu ka unye utile Egyipteƒuɔ bekpone bammɔ na Megido. Nsu úkpi na kekpo kammɔ kemmo.

translation_verse: Na nwuna lɛgadi líbo kawɔlɔkɔ uwi ɔni na Egyipteƒuɔ Ɔga Neko úti-nwu útákya aban ɔtɔ na Ribla na Hamat kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na Egyipteƒuɔ ɔga ɔ́ya na Yudaƒuɔ baaƒɔ sika ɔƒualadi mpim maatɛ eti leevu (

translation_verse: Na ɔ́da Asera ɔƒiɔgyii údie kakpakɔ mmɔ úsienku Kidron Kɔwɛ na útákyula-nya. Na úti ntu ɔ́nwu ntɔ bɔmmɔ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ na útakuna-nwu úwi bekyuli kavakɔ.

english_verse: Those local priests could not serve at the Lord's altar in Jerusalem, but they were allowed to eat sacred bread, just like the priests from Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na kuƒi kuuubo bakpane bammɔ ka babla bakpane kabla na kakpakɔ mmɔ. Nsu bebo kuƒi ka badi bodobodo ɔni néteƒu ɔni béti béte bana bakpane kpana.

english_verse: Josiah sent some men to Hinnom Valley just outside Jerusalem with orders to make the altar there unfit for worship. That way, people could no longer use it for sacrificing their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: Na Ɔga Yosia ɔ́sɔ úbie Toƒet ɔni nnkya Hinom Kɔwɛ kalɛ na ukyuli biala ɔ́sɔ ulákɛ kuƒi na uti ubidi ulekubi iye ɔnanabi utábla bɔkyula akpala ute Molek baƒiɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Some of the kings of Judah, especially Manasseh, had built altars in the two courts of the temple and in the room that Ahaz had built on the palace roof. Josiah had these altars torn down and smashed to pieces, and he had the pieces thrown into Kidron Valley, just outside Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na akpabi ani na Yudaƒuɔ baga bátu bálɛ Ɔga Ahas ɔtɔ eli ni, Ɔga Yosia ɔ́ƒɛ-nya ɔ́salaku akpabi ani na Ɔga Manase ɔ́tu. Na úgyingya akpabi ammɔ na úƒwimi-nya útákya Kidron Kɔwɛ kemmo.

english_verse: After that, he closed down the shrines that Solomon had built east of Jerusalem and south of Spoil Hill to honor Astarte the disgusting goddess of Sidon, Chemosh the disgusting god of Moab, and Milcom the disgusting god of Ammon.
translation_verse: Na Ɔga Yosia úbile akpabi ani na Ɔga Salomo ɔ́tu ɔ́lɛ ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ na Oliƒ Kɔbi kada kakɛ. Nka akpabi ammɔ lɛlɔ na bátaakpa Sidon baƒiɔ bani baalɔ banii Astarot, ku Moab baƒiɔ Kemos, ku Amon baƒiɔ Molek.

english_verse: He tore down the stone images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred pole used in the worship of Asherah. Then he had the whole area covered with human bones.
translation_verse: Na Ɔga Yosia ɔ́kɔ atabi ammɔ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ɔ́bla ɔtumu, na ɔ́gyu Asera liƒiɔgyii lɛmmɔ údie. Na kesii kani na ɔ́gyu ligyii lɛmmɔ údie ni, úti bekyuli ekubi útébile bana ekisila na mmɔ.

english_verse: But Josiah was not finished yet. At Bethel he destroyed the shrine and the altar that Jeroboam son of Nebat had built and that had caused the Israelites to sin. Josiah had the shrine and the Asherah pole burned and ground into dust.
translation_verse: Na Ɔga Yosia ɔ́sɔ úgyingya akpabi ani lɛlɔ na baakpá na Betel na Nebat ubidi Ɔga Yerobeam ɔ́tu ɔ́lɛ mmɔ uwi ɔni na ɔ́kpanku Israelƒuɔ útákya likpidi kemmo. Ɔga Yosia ɔ́ƒɛ lɛkpa lɛmmɔ na ɔ́bwɛ atabi ammɔ na ɔ́kɔ-nya ɔ́bla ntɔ. Na ɔ́kyula Asera baƒiɔ bani bávɔ bálɛ mmɔ.

english_verse: As he looked around, he saw graves on the hillside. He had the bones in them dug up and burned on the altar, so that it could no longer be used. This happened just as God's prophet had said when Jeroboam was standing at the altar, celebrating a festival. Then Josiah saw the grave of the prophet who had said this would happen
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Ɔga Yosia ɔ́tɛ anu ɔ́mana na ɔ́nu kɔƒiɔtɔ kɔdi na abi lɛlɔ na ɔ́ya bétéku ekubi ani nkya kɔƒiɔtɔ kɔmmɔ kemmo béboku. Na ɔ́ya bákyula-nya béwi akpabi ammɔ lɛlɔ. Na lɛni na úti úbile lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ekisila aani kalɛ na kenye udiene ɔdi ɔ́su kukuuku úbavi uwi ɔni na Ɔga Yerobeam únye lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ kudɔ ɔɔbla akpala. Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Ɔga Yosia ɔ́sɔ ɔ́tɛ anu ɔ́mana na ɔ́nu kaƒiɔtɔ kani báva kenye udiene ɔni násu litemi lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: and he asked, “Whose grave is that?” Some people who lived nearby answered, “It belongs to the prophet from Judah who told what would happen to this altar.”
translation_verse: Amu na Ɔga Yosia úye ɔnini, “Ɔma kaƒiɔtɔ kadi ngye?” Amu na Betel bakyuli bammɔ bédie kenye banini, “Kenye udiene ɔdi ɔni nási Yuda kadi na kadi. Anwu násu úse lɛla lɛni na ábla na lɛkpabi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Josiah replied, “Then leave it alone. Don't dig up his bones.” So they did not disturb his bones or the bones of the old prophet from Israel who had also been buried there.
translation_verse: Amu na Ɔga Yosia úbo-ma ɔda ɔnini, “Biteku nwuna likubi. Mmomu bɛnyonu-nya na eteese kalɛ kani na ese.” Ɔmmɔ ɔsu, béteku nwuna likubi iye kenye udiene ɔni nási Samaria ɔdi.

english_verse: Jehoiakim forced the people of Judah to pay higher taxes, so he could give Neco the silver and gold he demanded. King Jehoiakim of Judah (

english_verse: Josiah told the people of Judah, “Celebrate Passover in honor of the Lord your God, just as it says in The Book of God's Law.”
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, Ɔga Yosia úbo bekyuli bammɔ ɔda ka badi Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi bete Unwoti aani kalɛ na bénweni bákya ɔda bubo ɔku kemmo mmɔ.

english_verse: Josiah got rid of every disgusting person and thing in Judah and Jerusalem—including magicians, fortunetellers, and idols. He did his best to obey every law written in the book that the priest Hilkiah found in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na ɔda bubo ɔku ɔni na ɔkpane Hilkia ɔ́nu na kakpakɔ mmɔ ɔ́su kpakplaa ɔsu ni, Ɔga Yosia ɔ́bɔku bekyuli bani muubó like ku bekyuli bani muuye ala teenu ɔ́lɛku Yerusalem ku Yuda lɛma lɛkladi kemmo. Na úbile kɔduli baƒiɔ ku baƒiɔ lɛtɔ ka ala ani ƒui muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord was still furious with the people of Judah because Manasseh had done so many things to make him angry.

english_verse: A few of Josiah's servants put his body in a chariot and took it back to Jerusalem, where they buried it in his own tomb. Then the people of Judah found his son Jehoahaz and poured olive oil on his head to show that he was their new king. King Jehoahaz of Judah (
translation_verse: Na nwuna kabla bablane béti nwuna ukpine básia ɔpɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ lɛlɔ bésienku Yerusalem. Na bátáva-nwu na baga kavakɔ. Na Yudaƒuɔ báƒuna Yosia ubidi Yehoahas na béti-nwu bése lɛga. Yehoahas Ɔ́di Lɛga Na Yuda

translation_verse: Na ala ani ƒui na Yehoiakim ɔ́bla ni, bénweni-nya bákya Yudaƒuɔ baga lɛlɔ kɔtɛ ɔku kemmo.

english_verse: Jehoiakim died, and his son Jehoiachin became king.
translation_verse: Na Yehoiakim úkpi na ubidi Yekonia úti-nwu keliekɔ aani ɔga kalɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiachin disobeyed the Lord, just as his father Jehoiakim had done.

english_verse: The Lord had warned that someday the treasures would be taken from the royal palace and from the temple, including the gold objects that Solomon had made for the temple. And that's exactly what Nebuchadnezzar ordered his soldiers to do.
translation_verse: úti Yekonia úsienku Babilon na útákya-nwu ɔtɔ. Na ɔ́buma egulabi ani ƒui nse Unwoti kakpakɔ ku ɔga kaduli ɔda aani kalɛ na Unwoti ɔ́su úse. Na Ɔga Nebukadnesar ɔ́ti sika ugyiedi akyami ani ƒui na Ɔga Salomo ɔ́vɔ úse ka beteeti taabla kakpakɔ kabla ɔ́tɔlɔku.

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin to Babylon, along with his mother, his wives, his officials, and the most important leaders of Judah.
translation_verse: Na Nebukadnesar úti Yekonia ku uni ku nwuna beleku ku nwuna kabla bablane ku batɔnkune úsienku Babilon na útákya-ma ɔtɔ na mmɔ.

translation_verse: Na Nebukadnesar ɔ́ya Yekonia uni ɔnwani ɔnanabi ɔni baalɔ banii Matania ɔ́bla Yudaƒuɔ ɔga na ɔ́vumana-nwu lɛnyi ɔ́bla Sedekia. Sedekia Ɔ́bla Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga

translation_verse: Na Ɔga Sedekia ɔ́bla likpidi na Unwoti anumi aani kalɛ na Ɔga Yekonia ɔ́bla kalɛ.

english_verse: It was Zedekiah who finally rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar. The people of Judah and Jerusalem had made the Lord so angry that he turned his back on them. That's why these horrible things were happening.
translation_verse: Na kɔnyi kɔni na Unwoti úti ɔ́kya Yerusalemƒuɔ ku Yudaƒuɔ ɔsu ni, ala amɛni ƒui álɛ lɛni. Na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, ɔ́bɔku-ma údie nwuna anumi. Na ɔƒɛni ni, Sedekia ɔ́ta únye Babilonƒuɔ ɔga lɛlɔ.

translation_verse: Na Hamat ɔmii ni, mmɔ na ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔ́ya na bébo benengu bammɔ bádu. Anwuɔsu béƒie Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ bálɛku bana kalɔ lɛlɔ bátákya kalɔ bamba lɛlɔ. Béti Gedalia Bábla Yudaƒuɔ Lɛlɔ Ɔnune

translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ka bekpone báƒɛ awodu ammɔ ni, Yudaƒuɔ ɔga ku nwuna bekpone báwia kasiakɔ na békeli bátɔlɔ usien ɔmmɔ. english_verse: but the Babylonian troops caught up with them near Jericho. They arrested Zedekiah, but his soldiers scattered in every direction.
translation_verse: Nsu Babilonƒuɔ bekpone básia-ma kama na bétéƒie Sedekia na Yeriko, ɔsika nwuna bekpone ama békeli-nwu kudɔ bátɔlɔ bégyingya bákya amadɔ mmɔ bene.

english_verse: About a month later, in Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king, Nebuzaradan, who was his official in charge of the guards, arrived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na lɛkwa leevu-yaalenwi na kɔbuli kɔlɔndi na limeyi maatɛdi na Babilonƒuɔ Ɔga Nebukadnesar lɛga bɔdi kemmo ni, Nebusaradan ɔni ndi Ɔga Nebukadnesar kasusu ɔkyane ku bekpone ɔtɔnkune útéduo Yerusalem.

english_verse: Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na Nebusaradan ɔmɛni ɔ́kpanku Babilonƒuɔ bekpone ƒui na bátáƒɛ Yerusalem awodu ɔba.

english_verse: He led away as prisoners the people left in the city, including those who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama bekpone unengu ɔmɛni úti bekyuli bani nébu na ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo ku bani nkya akpakɔlɔ lɛma ku bani na bátuna ka babla Babilonƒuɔ Ɔga kabla ɔ́tɔlɔku úsienku Babilon.

english_verse: Only some of the poorest people were left behind to work the vineyards and the fields.
translation_verse: Na bawabane bani na ayaki ada geen kani nébu bákya na bataanu egyiibi mmo ku mmo geen bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Babylonian soldiers took the two bronze columns that stood in front of the temple, the ten movable bronze stands, and the large bronze bowl called the Sea. They broke them into pieces so they could take the bronze to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Na Babilonƒuɔ bábwɛ bédie abuala egyiedi ani na bátɛ na kakpakɔ mmɔ ku ala kasiakɔ ku abuala egyiedi ntu kewikɔ kani bátu bálɛ kakpakɔ mmɔ. Na bábuma abuala egyiedi ani ƒui nse kakpakɔ mmɔ bésienku Babilon.

english_verse: They carried off the bronze things used for worship at the temple, including the pans for hot ashes, and the shovels, snuffers, and also the dishes for incense,
translation_verse: Na béti ebui ku lɛsoƒi ku lɛsogya kɔbuli linyenela ku akyami ku abualagyie ala ani ƒui lɛlɔ kabla na baabla na kakpakɔ mmɔ bátɔlɔku.

english_verse: as well as the fire pans and the sprinkling bowls. Nebuzaradan ordered his soldiers to take everything made of gold or silver.
translation_verse: Bekpone unengu bagadine ɔgyumanane ɔmmɔ úti oloƒui ebui ammɔ ku ntu akyami gbion ani na bábla ku sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ƒui ɔ́tɔlɔku.

english_verse: The pile of bronze from the columns, the stands, and the large bowl that Solomon had made for the temple was too large to be weighed.
translation_verse: Na abuala egyiedi ala ani na Ɔga Salomo ɔ́bla ku ani na ɔ́tɛ úse mmɔ ku ala kasiakɔ kammɔ ku ntu kewikɔ bonwu kammɔ ni, ala ammɔ ebo unu etulo bɔkɔku muedi.

english_verse: Then he arrested one of the army commanders, the king's five personal advisors, and the officer in charge of gathering the troops for battle. He also found
translation_verse: Na ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, úti ukpone ɔni mɔɔnu bekpone lɛlɔ ku ɔga ɔmmɔ kasusu bakyane ɛlɔ ku bekpone unengu ɔmansiane ɔni mɔɔnu bekpone kɔkunkɛ lɛlɔ ku bekyuli bani náƒɔ lɛnyi nkyuli liti ku leevu lɛnɔ ɔ́tɔlɔku.

translation_verse: Na bekpone unengu Nebusaradan úti bekyuli bammɔ úsienku Babilonƒuɔ ɔga na Ribla.

translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na Yudaƒuɔ kabla benengu ku benengu bani na béteti lɛlɔ bétete Nebukadnesar bénu ka béti Gedalia bábla bana lɛlɔ ɔnune ni, básala lɛlɔ na bátánu Gedalia na Mispa. english_verse: Gedaliah said to them, “Everything will be fine, I promise. We don't need to be afraid of the Babylonian rulers, if we live here peacefully and do what Nebuchadnezzar says.”
translation_verse: Na Gedalia ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Líti mina litemi muute-mii ɔni na utalɛka bɛyia Babilonƒuɔ kabla bablane bammɔ. Mmomu bɛsɔ bɛkya kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ na bɛsiaku Babilonƒuɔ Ɔga Nebukadnesar kama, na lɛla biala lɛdubusie kaduɛ lite-mii.”

english_verse: Ishmael was from the royal family. And about two months after Gedaliah began his rule, Ishmael and ten other men went to Mizpah. They killed Gedaliah and his officials, including those from Judah and those from Babylonia.

translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Israelƒuɔ bani ndi bawabane ku balakɛne ƒui ku bekpone benengu békeli bésie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika baayia Babilonƒuɔ bammɔ. Báda Yekonia Bédie Aban Ɔtɔ

translation_verse: Na Misraim bebi ndi, Lud kadi bekyuli ku Anamiƒuɔ ku Lehabiƒuɔ ku Naƒtuhiƒuɔ

english_verse: Gomer was the ancestor of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
translation_verse: Na Gomer bebi ndi Askenas ku Riƒat ku Togarma.

english_verse: Javan was the ancestor of Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
translation_verse: Na Yawan bebi ndi Elisa ku Tarsis ku Kiti kadi bekyuli ku Dodan kadi bekyuli. Hamƒuɔ

english_verse: Ethiopia was the ancestor of Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. Raamah was the ancestor of Sheba and Dedan.
translation_verse: Na Kus bebi ndi Seba ku Hawila ku Sabta ku Raama ku Sabteka. Na Raama bebi ndi Seba ku Dedan.

english_verse: Canaan's oldest son was Sidon; his other son was Heth.
translation_verse: Na Kanaan ubidi udeedi ndi Sidon ku nwuna kaba kemmo bebi babambadi bani ndi Hetiƒuɔ

english_verse: Shem was the ancestor of Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech; they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.
translation_verse: Na Sem bebi ndi Elam ku Asur ku Arƒaksad ku Lud ku Aram. Na Aram ɔ́ta ɔ́wɔ Us ku Hul ku Geter ku Mesek.

english_verse: Arpachshad was Shelah's father and Eber's grandfather.
translation_verse: Na Arƒaksad ɔ́ta ɔ́wɔ Sela. Na Sela ɔ́wɔ Eber.

english_verse: Eber named his first son Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided into tribal regions. Eber's second son was Joktan,
translation_verse: Uleku ɔni na Eber úti ni, ɔ́wɔ bebi bananabi inyɔ úte-nwu. Na unwi baalɔ banii Peleg, ɔni kalɔ ndi bule, ɔsika nwuna uwi na Katɔti úle kayawi kammɔ. Na ɔnwani baalɔ banii Yoktan.

english_verse: the ancestor of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah, Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah, Ebal, Abimael, Sheba, Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́wɔ Oƒir ku Hawila ku Yobeb. Anwuɔsu bebi bamɛni ƒui badi Yoktan bebi.

english_verse: Abraham was the father of Isaac and Ishmael.
translation_verse: Na Abraham bebi ndi Isak ku Ismael.

english_verse: Midian was the father of Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. Esau's Family (Genesis
translation_verse: Na Midian bebi ndi Eƒa ku Eƒer ku Hanok ku Abida ku Eldaa. Na bebi bamɛni ƒui badi Ketura bawɔ.

english_verse: Abraham's son Isaac was the father of Esau and Jacob.
translation_verse: Na Abraham ɔ́wɔ Isak. Na Isak bebi ndi Esau ku Israel. Esau Kaba Bekyuli Anyi

english_verse: Esau was the father of Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
translation_verse: Esau bebi ndi Eliƒas ku Reuel ku Yeus ku Yalam ku Kora.

english_verse: Reuel was the father of Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. The First Edomites and Their Kings (Genesis
translation_verse: Na Reuel bebi ndi Nahat ku Serah ku Sama ku Misa.

english_verse: Before kings ruled in Israel, Bela son of Beor ruled the country of Edom from its capital of Dinhabah.
translation_verse: Asa na Israelƒuɔ lɛgabɔdi ulu úse kalɔ ni, bekyuli bamɛni nádi lɛga na Edom kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na ama ndi Beor ubidi ɔnanabi ɔni baalɔ Bela, na nwuna ɔma unengudi ndi Dinhaba.

english_verse: Seir was the father of Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
translation_verse: Na Seir bebi ndi Lotan ku Sobal ku Sibeon ku Ana ku Dison ku Eser ku Disan.

english_verse: Lotan was the father of Hori and Homam; Lotan's sister was Timna.
translation_verse: Na Lotan bebi ndi Hori ku Homam. Na Timna ndi Lotan ɔnwani ulekubi.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. Zibeon was the father of Aiah and Anah.
translation_verse: Na Sobal bebi ndi Alian ku Manahat ku Ebal ku Seƒo ku Onam. Na Sibeon bebi ndi Aya ku Ana.

english_verse: Anah was the father of Dishon and the grandfather of Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
translation_verse: Na Ana ubi ndi Dison. Na Dison bebi ndi Hamram ku Esban ku Itran ku Keran.

english_verse: Ezer was the father of Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. Dishan was the father of Uz and Aran.
translation_verse: Na Eser bebi ndi Bilhan ku Saawan ku Yaakan. Na Disan bebi ndi Us ku Aran. Edom Batɔnkune

english_verse: After Bela's death, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Bela úkpi ni, Serah ubidi Yobab ɔni nási Bosra nélie-nwu kenye ɔ́di lɛga.

english_verse: After Jobab's death, Husham from the land of Teman became king.
translation_verse: Ka Yabab úkpi ni, Husam ɔni nási Teman nélie-nwu kenye ɔ́di lɛga.

english_verse: After Husham's death, Hadad son of Bedad became king and ruled from Avith. Earlier, Bedad had defeated the Midianites in the territory of Moab.
translation_verse: Ka Husam úkpi ni, Hadad nébelie-nwu kenye na ɔti ndi Bedad. Na Hadad ɔmɛni nékpo na ɔ́di Midianƒuɔ lɛlɔ na Moab kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na ɔma unengudi ɔni kemmo na ɔ́kya baalɔ Awit.

english_verse: After Hadad's death, Samlah from Masrekah became king;
translation_verse: Na Hadad kukpi kama Samla ɔni nási Masreka nébelie-nwu kenye.

english_verse: after Samlah's death, Shaul from the town of Rehoboth on the Euphrates River became king;
translation_verse: Ka Samla úkpi ni, Saul ɔni nási ketu kudɔ ɔma ɔni baalɔ Rehobot nébelie-nwu kenye.

english_verse: and after Shaul's death, Baal Hanan son of Achbor became king.
translation_verse: Ka Saul úkpi ni, Akbor ubidi ɔni baalɔ Baal-Hanan nébelie-nwu kenye.

english_verse: After Baal Hanan's death, Hadad ruled from Pai. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Baal-Hanan úkpi ni, Hadad nélie-nwu kenye ɔ́di lɛga. Na ɔma ɔni na úlie baalɔ Pai. Na ulekudi ndi Matred ubidi ulekubi Mehetabel na ɔdi Me-Sahab uwɔ.

english_verse: The Edomite clans were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
translation_verse: Na Hadad lɛnɔ úbekpi. Edom baga ndi Timna ku Ahoa ku Yetet

english_verse: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
translation_verse: ku Oholibama ku Ela ku Pinon

english_verse: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
translation_verse: ku Kenas ku Teman ku Mibsar

english_verse: Jacob was the father of twelve sons: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
translation_verse: ku Dan ku Yoseƒ ku Benyamin ku Naƒtali ku Gad ku Aser.

english_verse: Judah and his Canaanite wife Bathshua had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord had Er put to death, because he disobeyed and did what the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Na Yuda bebi ndi Er ku Onan ku Sela ku Baasa. Ama na Sua ubidi ulekubi ɔ́wɔ úte-nwu na ɔdi Kanaanni. Na Er ndi Yuda ubidi udeedi. Na ɔ́bla likyulikpi na Unwoti anumi, anwuɔsu Unwoti ɔ́du-nwu.

english_verse: Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar also had two sons: Perez and Zerah.
translation_verse: Kama Yuda ku ubidi ukpinele ɔni baalɔ banii Tamar báwɔ Peres ku Serah. Anwuɔsu Yuda bebi bebo bananabi ɛlɔ.

english_verse: Perez was the father of Hezron and Hamul.
translation_verse: Peres bebi ndi Hesron ku Hamul.

english_verse: Zerah was the father of Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda.
translation_verse: Na Serah bebi ndi Simri ku Etan ku Heman ku Kalkol ku Dara. Na bana ƒui bebo ɛlɔ.

english_verse: Achan, who was a descendant of Zerah and the son of Carmi, caused trouble for Israel, because he kept for himself things that belonged only to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Karmi bebi ndi Akar ɔni néti lɛsɛ úboku Israelƒuɔ lɛlɔ na útéti Katɔti ala ani útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi uti.

english_verse: Ethan's son was Azariah. The Ancestors of King David
translation_verse: Na Etan ubi ndi Asaria.

english_verse: Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
translation_verse: Na bebi bani na Hesron ɔ́wɔ úte-nwu ndi Yerahmeel ku Ram ku Kelubai.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah.
translation_verse: Na Ram ɔ́wɔ Aminadab, na Aminadab ɔ́wɔ Nahson ɔni nábla Yudaƒuɔ ɔtɔnkune.

english_verse: Nahshon's descendants included Salma, Boaz,
translation_verse: Na Nahson ɔ́wɔ Salma, na Salma ɔ́wɔ Boas

english_verse: Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
translation_verse: Na bana banwani belekubi ndi Seruia ku Abigail. Na Seruia bebi ndi Abisai ku Yoab ku Asa-El. Na bana ƒui badi bebi ɛtɛ.

english_verse: Abigail's husband was Jether, who was a descendant of Ishmael, and their son was Amasa. The Descendants of Hezron
translation_verse: Na Abigail ɔ́wɔ Amasa na Amasa ɔti ɔdi Ismaelni Yeter. Hesron Ubidi Kaleb Kaba Kemmo Bebi

english_verse: Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translation_verse: Na Hesron ubidi Kaleb ku ulekudi Asuba ku uleku bamba ɔni ndi Yeriot báwɔ. Na nwuna bebi ndi Yeser ku Sobab ku Ardon.

english_verse: After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur
translation_verse: Ka Asuba úkpi ni, Kaleb úti Eƒrat na anwu ku-nwu báwɔ Hur.

english_verse: was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
translation_verse: Na Hur ɔ́wɔ Uri na Uri ɔ́wɔ Besaleel.

english_verse: was the father of Jair, who ruled
translation_verse: Na Segub ɔ́wɔ Yair ɔni nánu Gilead lɛma aavlanyɔ-ɛtɛ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa. The Descendants of Jerahmeel
translation_verse: Ka Hesron úkpi na Kaleb-Eƒrata uwi klukwii ɔdi kama ni, ulekudi ɔ́wɔ Aser úte-nwu ɔni ndi Tekoa ɔti.

english_verse: Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
translation_verse: Hesron ubidi udeedi Yerahmeel bebi ndi Ram ɔni ndi udeedi ku Buna ku Oren ku Osem ku Ahia.

english_verse: Jerahmeel had a second wife, Atarah, who gave birth to Onam.
translation_verse: Na Yerahmeel ɔ́sɔ úti uleku ɔbambadi ɔni baalɔ banii Atara ɔni náwɔ Onam.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
translation_verse: Na Yerahmeel ubidi udeedi Ram bebi ndi Maas ku Yamin ku Eker.

english_verse: Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada. Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur.
translation_verse: Na Onam bebi ndi Semai ku Yada. Na Samai bebi ndi Nadab ku Abisur.

english_verse: Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid.
translation_verse: Na Abisur ulekudi baalɔ banii Abihail ɔni náwɔ Ahban ku Molid úte-nwu.

english_verse: Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children;
translation_verse: Nadab bebi ndi Seled ku Apaim. Na Seled úkpi, nsu útawɔ bebi badi.

english_verse: Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
translation_verse: Na Apaim bebi ndi Ishi ɔni ɔti ndi Sesan. Na Sesan ɔ́wɔ Ahlai.

english_verse: Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children,
translation_verse: Na Samai ɔnwani Yada bebi ndi Yeter ku Yonatan. Na Yeter útawɔ asa na úkpi.

english_verse: but Jonathan had two sons: Peleth and Zaza.
translation_verse: Na Yonatan bebi ndi Pelet ku Sasa. Na bamɛni ndi Yerahmeel kaba bebi.

english_verse: Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai,
translation_verse: Na Sesan úti ubidi ulekubi úte nwuna kabla ɔblane Yarha na úti-nwu na ɔ́wɔ Atai úte-nwu.

english_verse: the father of Nathan and the grandfather of Zabad.
translation_verse: Na Atai ɔ́wɔ Natan. Na Natan ɔ́wɔ Sabad.

english_verse: Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, had the following descendants: Mesha, Ziph, Mareshah, Hebron,
translation_verse: Na Yerahmeel ɔnwani Kaleb bebi ndi Mesa ubidi udeedi ɔni ndi Siƒ ɔti ku Hebron ɔti Maresa bebi.

english_verse: and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
translation_verse: Na Hebron bebi ndi Kora ku Tapua ku Rekem ku Sem.

english_verse: Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai,
translation_verse: Na Sema ɔ́wɔ Raham na Raham ɔ́wɔ Yorkeam. Na Rekem ɔ́wɔ Samai.

english_verse: the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
translation_verse: Na Samai ubidi ndi Maon. Na Maon ndi Bet-Sur ɔti.

english_verse: Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez.
translation_verse: Na Kaleb ɔsɔnɔ Eƒa ɔ́wɔ Haran ku Mosa ku Gases. Na Haran lɛnɔ ɔ́wɔ ubi ɔnanabi ɔni baalɔ Gases.

english_verse: Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.
translation_verse: Na Yahdai bebi ndi Regem ku Yotam ku Gesan ku Pelet ku Eƒa ku Saaƒ.

english_verse: Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah.
translation_verse: Na Kaleb ɔsɔnɔ Maaka ɔ́wɔ Seber ku Tirhana.

english_verse: Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́wɔ Saaƒ ɔni ndi Makbena ɔti ku Giba ɔti. Na Kaleb ubidi ulekubi baalɔ banii Aksa.

english_verse: All of these were Caleb's descendants. Hur, the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath, had three sons: Shobal, Salma, and Hareph, who settled the town of Beth-Gader.
translation_verse: ku Sabal ɔni náwɔ Betlehem kadi bekyuli ku Hareƒ ɔni náwɔ Bet-Gader kadi bekyuli.

english_verse: Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan,
translation_verse: Na Sobal ɔni náwɔ Kiriat-Yearim kadi bekyuli bawɔ ndi Haroe ku Menuhotƒuɔ kakɛ.

english_verse: and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
translation_verse: Na Kiriat-Yearim kaba ku Yitriƒuɔ kaba ku Putiƒuɔ kaba ku Sumatiƒuɔ kaba ku Misraiƒuɔ kaba bási Soraƒuɔ ku Estaolƒuɔ kaba kemmo.

english_verse: Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites.
translation_verse: Na Salma bebi ndi Betlehem ku Netoƒaƒuɔ ku Atrot-Bet-Yoab ku Manahatƒuɔ kakɛ ku Soriƒuɔ

english_verse: Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_verse: ku lɛku benwenine kaba kani nli Yabes. Na ama ndi Tiraƒuɔ ku Simeaƒuɔ ku Sukaƒuɔ. Na ama nási Hamat bébo na badi Rekab ɔtɔ kemmo bekyuli.

english_verse: David's other sons included Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: ku Elisama ku Eliada ku Eliƒelet. Na bana bumomo bɔdi bebi yaalenwi.

english_verse: David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter. The Descendants of King Solomon
translation_verse: Na bebi bamɛni ƒui badi Dawid bebi asa na ɔsɔ ubo basɔnɔbi bamba lɛnɔ ku ubi ulekubi unwi ɔni baalɔ Tamar. Ɔga Salomo Kaba Kemmo Bebi

english_verse: Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Na Yosia bebi ndi Yohanan ɔni ndi ubidi udeedi na Yehoiakim ɔdi unyɔdi. Na Sedekia ɔdi ɔtɛdi. Na Salum ɔdi unedi.

english_verse: Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Na Yehoiakim bebi ndi Yekonia ku Sedekia.

english_verse: Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel,
translation_verse: Na Yekonia bebi ndi Asir ku Sealtiel

english_verse: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
translation_verse: ku Malkiram ku Pedaia ku Senasar ku Yekamia ku Hosama ku Nedabia.

english_verse: Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.
translation_verse: Na Pedaia bebi ndi Serubabel ku Simei. Na Serubabel bebi ndi Mesulam ku Hanania ku bana ɔnwani ulekubi Selomit.

english_verse: He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔ ubo bebi ɛlɔ babambadi badi na ama ndi Hasuba ku Ohel ku Berekia ku Hasadia ku Yusab-Hesed.

english_verse: the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Na Sekania ubo ubi unwi ɔni ndi Samaia. Na ubo bawɔ ɛlɔ na ama ndi Hatus ku Yigal ku Baria ku Nearia ku Saƒat.

english_verse: Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
translation_verse: Na Nearia bebi ndi Elioenai ku Hiskia ku Asrikam na badi bebi ɛtɛ.

english_verse: Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_verse: Na Elioenai ubo bebi maatɛ. Na ama ndi Hodawia ku Eliasib ku Pelaia ku Akub ku Yohanan ku Delaia ku Anani.

english_verse: Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
translation_verse: Na Yuda bebi ndi Peres ku Hesron ku Karmi ku Hur ku Sobal.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
translation_verse: Na Sobal ubidi Reaia ɔ́wɔ Yahat. Na Yahat ɔ́wɔ Ahumai ku Lahad. Na bamɛni ndi Soraƒuɔ kaba bebi.

english_verse: Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
translation_verse: Na Aser ɔni ndi Tekoa ɔti úti beleku inyɔ. Na ama ndi Hela ku Naara.

english_verse: daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Na Naara ɔ́wɔ Ahusam ku Heƒer ku Temeni ku Ahastari. Na bamɛni ndi Naara bebi.

english_verse: Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
translation_verse: Na Hela bebi ndi, Seret ku Yesohar ku Etnan

english_verse: Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
translation_verse: ku Kos ɔni ndi Ahus ku Hasobeba ɔti ku Harum ubidi Aharhel adua bekyuli.

english_verse: Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family.
translation_verse: Yabes lɛlɔ libo ɔbu litulo nwuna banwani. Na uni ɔ́sia-nwu lɛnyi ɔnii Yabes ɔ́tina ka únu ɔlɛ geen na nwuna kɔwɔ kemmo.

english_verse: One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yabes ɔ́kpali Israel Katɔti ɔnii, “O Unwoti, te-mi kusɛ kusɛ na aya na mina lɛmii lɛbɛbɛ lisie kama libu na ƒula kɔnu kɔsia-mi lɛlɔ. Na edie-mi na ɔgbankpi kemmo kalɛ na likpidi lɛdi lilékpoku-mi na menu ɔlɛ ɔdi.” Na Katɔti ɔ́bla nwuna lɛyɔla úte-nwu.

english_verse: Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton,
translation_verse: Na Kelub ɔni ndi Suha ɔnwani ɔnanabi ɔ́wɔ Mehiri ɔni náwɔ Eston.

english_verse: whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
translation_verse: Na Eston ɔ́wɔ Bet-Raƒa ku Pasea ku Tehina ɔni náda Ir-Nahas ɔma na badi Reka kadi bekyuli.

english_verse: Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai,
translation_verse: Na Kenas bebi ndi Otniel ku Seraia. Na Otniel bebi ndi Hatat ku Meonotai.

english_verse: who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
translation_verse: Na Meonotai ɔ́wɔ Oƒra. Na Seraia ɔ́wɔ Yoab ɔni ndi Ge-Harasim ɔti. Na baalɔ-ma lɛni ɔsika badi ala banwine.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
translation_verse: Na Yeƒune ubidi Kaleb bebi ndi Iru ku Ela ku Naam. Na Ela ubi ɔnanabi ndi Kenas.

english_verse: A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
translation_verse: Na Naham ɔnwani ulekubi ɔni ndi Hodia ulekudi bebi bananabi bani na ɔ́wɔ ni, ama náwɔ Garmiƒuɔ bani nélie Keila ɔma ku Maakaniƒuɔ bani nélie Estemoa ɔma.

english_verse: Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
translation_verse: Na Simon bebi ndi Amnon ku Rina ku Ben-Hanan ku Tilon. Na Yisi kaba bebi ndi Sohet ku Ben-Sohet.

english_verse: The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king. The Descendants of Simeon
translation_verse: Na badi ebui bavɔne na beli Netaim ku Gedera baabla kabla teete mmɔ ɔga. Simeon Kaba Bebi

english_verse: Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Na Simeon bebi ndi, Nemuel ku Yamin ku Yarib ku Serah ku Saul.

english_verse: The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma.
translation_verse: Na Saul ubidi ndi Salum ɔni ubi ndi Mibsam ɔni ubi ndi Misma.

english_verse: The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei.
translation_verse: Na Misma bebi ndi, Hamuel ɔni ubi ndi Sakur ɔni ubi ndi Simei.

english_verse: Before David became king, the people of the Simeon tribe lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim.
translation_verse: ku Bet-Markabot ku Hasar-Susim ku Bet-Biri ku Saaraim. Na lɛma lɛmɛni na belie útédu Ɔga Dawid lɛga bɔdi uwi.

english_verse: They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan,
translation_verse: Na lɛma lɛni nkya lɛma lɛmmɔ amadɔ ndi Etam ku Ain ku Rimon ku Token ku Asan. Na lɛdi lɛma ɛlɔ.

english_verse: as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
translation_verse: Na lɛdanku akpaklɔ ani nkya lɛma lɛmmɔ amadɔ útédu Baal. Na mmɔ ndi bana kuliekɔ. Na bebo ɔku ɔni mɔɔtina bana bɔwɔ ku kalɛ na báda bana kuliekɔ ƒui.

english_verse: When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located,
translation_verse: Na bálɛ bésie Gedor ɔma kɔmadɔ na kɔwɛ kɔmmɔ ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ ka batáwia bana bebuo kadikɔ.

english_verse: and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites,
translation_verse: Na bákɛ kalɔ kabuni bonwu kani na atu bɔyɔ lɛnɔ bɔkya-ka kemmo. Na Hamƒuɔ béelie mmɔ báta dii.

english_verse: but when Hezekiah was king of Judah, the descendants of Simeon attacked and forced the Hamites and Meunites off the land, then settled there.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani anyi bénweni bébo mmɔ na Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga Hesekia uwi na bébekpoku Hamƒuɔ bammɔ ku Maonƒuɔ bani nkya mmɔ na báyila-ma udu kede kede aani kalɛ na mmɔ kaatina ɔmwi kadi. Na béti bana kɔkyakɔ bábla bana kuliekɔ. Ɔsika, bebuo kadikɔ kakya kete bana bebuo ɔsu.

english_verse: Some time later,
translation_verse: Na Simeon bebi eti leevu (

english_verse: men from the Simeon tribe went into Edom under the command of Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel the sons of Ishi.
translation_verse: ) béti bésie Seir Kɔbi lɛlɔ na Pelatia ku Nearia ku Reƒaia ku Usiel bani ndi Yisi bebi batɔnku-ma na bétékpoku kɔbi katɔ badi bammɔ.

english_verse: They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_verse: Na bádu Amalekƒuɔ bani nékeli na bésie béli mmɔ úbedu ɔmwi.

english_verse: Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph,
translation_verse: Bamɛni ndi Ruben ɔni ndi Israel ubidi udeedi bebi. Ɔdi ubi udeedi geen, nsu uwi ɔni na úbile ɔti katɛnkɔ na ɔ́ya na keesé lɛlɔ ni, nwuna kenyekɔ aani ubi udeedi kalɛ béti-ka béte Yoseƒ ɔni ndi Israel ubidi. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bátakana na béte-nwu lɛnyi bakya bebi bedeedi bɔwɔ ɔku kemmo aani ubi udeedi ɔni báka bɔ́wɔ kalɛ.

english_verse: Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
translation_verse: Na Ruben ɔni ndi Israel ubi udeedi bebi ndi Hanok ku Palu ku Hesron ku Karmi.

english_verse: and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛ kanukɔ kakɛ ni, bélie bétédu ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kɔmadɔ na útédu Euƒrate Ketudɔ. Ɔsika bana bebuo bémomo bébu na Gilead kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
translation_verse: Na Saul lɛga bɔdi uwi ni, békpo bádi Hagarƒuɔ lɛlɔ. Na béti Hagarƒuɔ kakyakɔ kani ƒui na kewi Gilead ɔ́ƒɛ katukɔ. Gad Bebi

english_verse: Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Na Yoel ndi bana ɔtɔnkune na Saƒam ɔsia asa na Yanai ku Saƒat na Basan mmɔ.

english_verse: They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz.
translation_verse: Na bamɛni ndi Abihail kaba bebi, Huri náwɔ Abihail ɔni náwɔ Yaroa ɔni náwɔ Gilead ɔni náwɔ Mikael ɔni náwɔ Yesisai ɔni náwɔ Yahdo ɔni náwɔ Bus.

english_verse: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
translation_verse: Na Ahi ɔdi Abdiel ubidi ɔni ndi Guni ubidi na ɔdi bana ɔtɔ unengu.

english_verse: The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon.
translation_verse: Na Gadƒuɔ bélie Gilead ɔni nkya Basan ku nwuna akpaklɔ ani nasiaku lɛlɔ ku bebuo kadikɔ kalɔ ƒiaa kani na kewi Saron mmɔ útédu kana lɛmii ƒui.

english_verse: Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
translation_verse: Na bénweni ala amɛni ƒui bákya atɔƒi ku kaba kemmo bɔwɔ ɔku kemmo. Na Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga Yotam ku Israelƒuɔ Ɔga Yerobeam lɛga bɔdi uwi.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh had
translation_verse: Na Ruben ku Gadƒuɔ ku Manase kaba kakɛ bebo bekpone mpim aavlene-ine eti leevu-alɔ ku leevu (

english_verse: soldiers trained to fight in battle with shields, swords, bows, and arrows.
translation_verse: ) na bédu kalɛ na beti kɔtaminta ku agyumanala besie kekpo. Na bátina-ma kalɛ na beekpó lɛnɔ.

english_verse: They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
translation_verse: Na bétékpoku Hagarƒuɔ ku Yetur ku Neƒis ku Nodab.

english_verse: Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies.
translation_verse: Na béti bana anu básia Katɔti lɛlɔ. Na bákpali-nwu ka ute-ma kebunku. Na Katɔti lɛnɔ únu-ma bɔkpali. Na békpo bádi Hagarƒuɔ bammɔ ku bakladi bammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria. The Tribe of East Manasseh
translation_verse: Na bádu bekisine bammɔ kaduɛ. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔlati muukpó kekpo kammɔ. Na kaba bekyuli bammɔ bamu beli ɔmii ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ útédu ka kekpo kéƒie-ma katɔlɔku. Manase Kaba Kakɛ Bekyuli

english_verse: East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Na Manase kaba kakɛ bekyuli bamɛni bemomo geen. Na belie básiku Basan útédu Baal-Hermon ku Senir ku Hermon Kɔbi eli.

english_verse: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers. The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bamɛni ndi bana atɔƒi benengu, Eƒer ku Yisi ku Eliel ku Asriel ku Yeremia ku Hodawia ku Yahdiel. Na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bebo kayi na badi bekpone geen. Na báƒɔ lɛnyi na bana lɛtɔ kemmo.

english_verse: The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bammɔ bátasiaku bana bati kuuku Katɔti kama. Na béni-nwu na bésie bákya baakpá benwoti bani Katɔti ɔ́bɔku ɔ́lɛku kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Katɔti ɔ́ya na Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga ɔni baalɔ banii Tiglat-Pileser úteduo bana kalɔ kammɔ kemmo. Na ɔ́bɔku Ruben kaba ku Gad kaba ku Manase kaba kakɛ kani nli ɔƒɛ katukɔ ɔ́lɛku kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ. Na úte-ma keliekɔ na Hala ku Habor ku Hara ku Gosan Ketudɔ na belie mmɔ ubedu ɔmwi kadi.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Na Kehat bebi ndi Amram ku Yasar ku Hebron ku Usiel.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Na Amram bebi ndi Aaron ku Mose ku Miriam. Na Aaron bebi ndi Nadab ku Abihu ku Eleasar ku Itamar.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́ya na Ɔga Nebukadnesar úƒie Yudaƒuɔ ku Yerusalemƒuɔ ɔ́tɔlɔku ni, béƒie Yosadak lɛnɔ bátɔlɔku.

english_verse: Levi's three sons had sons of their own.
translation_verse: Na Lewi bebi ndi Gerson ku Kehat ku Merari.

english_verse: Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Na Gerson bebi anyi ndi Libni ku Simei.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Na Kehat bebi ndi Amram ku Yasar ku Hebron ku Usiel.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
translation_verse: Na Merari bebi ndi Mahli ku Musi. Na bamɛni ndi Lewiƒuɔ ɔtɔ bebi ku bati bani náwɔ-ma.

english_verse: Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: ku Tahat ku Uriel ku Usia ku Saul.

english_verse: Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth.
translation_verse: Na Elkana bebi ndi Amasia ku Ahimot

english_verse: Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
translation_verse: ku Eliab ku Yeroham ku Elkana.

english_verse: Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
translation_verse: Na Samuel ubi udeedi ndi Wasni ku Abia.

english_verse: Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah. The Temple Musicians
translation_verse: ku Sima ku Hagia ku Asaia. Katɔti Kakpakɔ Lɛnu Batune

english_verse: After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Banana bamɛni na Ɔga Dawid úti útákya Katɔti kakpakɔ na Yerusalem ka bataanu lɛnu batune bani nkya mmɔ lɛlɔ uwi ɔni na béti Bunyimi Adaka bétése kakpakɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: These musicians served at the sacred tent and later at the Lord's temple that King Solomon built.
translation_verse: Na beedie lɛnu uwi biala na Unwoti Adi Kevo kesii kani na baasa mmɔ anumi útédu ka Ɔga Salomo ɔ́tu Unwoti kakpakɔ na Yerusalem.

english_verse: The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent. The Descendants of Aaron
translation_verse: Na báya na Lewiƒuɔ bakya baabla kabla kani ƒui nkya Katɔti kaduli.

english_verse: Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
translation_verse: Nsu Aaron ku nwuna kaba bebi ama ni, ama mɔɔbla akpala na Unwoti lɛkpabi lɛlɔ. Na baakyula oloƒui lɛnɔ na kesii kani nse kedee ƒui teeti taabla likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala teete Israelƒuɔ. Aani kalɛ na Mose ɔni ndi Katɔti kabla ɔblane úbo ɔda.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in.
translation_verse: Kɔlɔ kɔmɛni ndi kesii kani béti béte Aaron kaba bani nási Kehat ɔtɔ kemmo. Ɔsika ka bátu egulabi ni, bana ɔdi náka búnwini búwi.

english_verse: They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it.
translation_verse: Na kesii kani béte-ma ndi Hebron ɔni nkya Yuda ku nwuna bebuo kadikɔ kani nkya amadɔ mmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translation_verse: Nsu mmo ku akpaklɔ ani nde ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ ni, béti béte Yeƒune ubidi Kaleb.

english_verse: So Aaron's descendants received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Hebron, Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth-Shemesh.
translation_verse: ku Asan ku nwuna bebuo kadikɔ kalɔ ku Bet-Semes ku nwuna bebuo kadikɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Na Benyamin kaba bekyuli ni, béti Geba ku Alemet ku Anatot ku nwuna bebuo kadikɔ kalɔ béte-ma. Na lɛma lɛni béle béte Kehat ɔtɔ bekyuli mɛni lɛdi lɛma leevu-ɛtɛ.

english_verse: The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
translation_verse: Na Kehat kaba bekyuli bakladi bani nási Manase kaba kakɛ béte-ma lɛma leevu.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani nási Gerson kaba kemmo ni, béte-ma lɛma leevu-ɛtɛ. Na bási Isakar ku Aser ku Naƒtali kaba ku Manase kaba kakɛ kani nási Basan kemmo.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Na Merari kaba na bana adua kenye ni, béte-ma lɛma leevu-inyɔ na kadanku Ruben ku Gad ku Sebulon kaba.

english_verse: So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Israelƒuɔ béte Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ lɛma lɛmɛni ku bana bebuo kɔdikɔ.

english_verse: All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
translation_verse: Na egulabi kani na bátu asa na béte Yuda ku Simeon ku Benyamin kaba bekyuli lɛma lɛni anyi na bɔ́lɔ búbavi.

english_verse: Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Na Kehat kaba bekyuli bammɔ badi ni, béte-ma lɛma ku bebuo kɔdikɔ kɔlɔ kɔni nkya Eƒraim ɔmii.

english_verse: And from West Manasseh they received Aner and Bileam, together with their pastureland.
translation_verse: Na Manase kaba kakɛ ni, Israelƒuɔ béte-ma Aner ku Bileam ku bana bebuo kadikɔ kɔlɔ. Na ama ndi Kehat ɔtɔ bekyuli bekplodi.

english_verse: The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Na Gersonƒuɔ lɛma lɛni nédu-ma ni, báƒɔ-ni básiku Manase kɔdua kaba bekyuli kakɛ kudɔ, na ani ndi Golan na Basan kalɛkɛ ku Astarot ku nina bebuo kadikɔ kɔlɔ.

english_verse: Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Na Naƒtali kaba ni, béte-ma Kedes ɔni nkya Galilea ku Hamon ku Kiriataim ku nina bebuo kadikɔ kɔlɔ.

english_verse: The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun.
translation_verse: Na Merariƒuɔ bakladi ni, béte-ma lɛma básiku Sebulon kaba bekyuli kalɛkɛ lɛma lɛma lɛni ndi Rimono ku Tabor ku nina bebuo kɔdikɔ kɔlɔ.

english_verse: Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
translation_verse: Na Isakar bebi ndi Tola ku Pua ku Yasub ku Simron. Na bana ƒui badi bebi ine.

english_verse: Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were
translation_verse: Na Tola bebi ndi Usi ku Reƒaia ku Yeriel ku Yahmai ku Yibsam ku Samuel. Na bamɛni ndi Tola bebi bani nédu kekpo busie na Ɔga Dawid lɛga bɔdi uwi. Na bana bumomo bɔdi mpim aavlanyɔ-inyɔ ku eti leevu anyɔ (

english_verse: Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.
translation_verse: Na bana ɔti Eƒraim úwulo-ma emeyi pii. Na nwuna lɛlɔ bekyuli bébo bábasia-nwu kɔnu.

english_verse: Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders.
translation_verse: Na Usi ubidi ndi Yisrahia. Na Yisrahia bebi ndi Mikael ku Obadia ku Yoel ku Yisia. Na bebi ɛlɔ bamɛni ƒui badi baga.

english_verse: Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
translation_verse: Na Soƒa bebi ndi Suah ku Harneƒer ku Sual ku Beri ku Yimra

english_verse: In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of
translation_verse: Na Isakar kaba bekyuli bani nédu kekpo busie na bénweni-ma anyi bákya bana kaba anyi ɔku kemmo ni, badi nkyuli mpim liti ku avlaatɛ maatɛ (

english_verse: Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
translation_verse: Benyamin ɔ́wɔ bebi ɛtɛ na ama ndi Bela ku Beker ku Yediael.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was
translation_verse: Na Bela bebi ndi Esbon ku Usi ku Usiel ku Yerimot ku Iri na atɔƒi benengu bammɔ badi ɛlɔ. Na bani nédu kekpo busie na bénweni-ma anyi bákya bana kaba anyi ɔku kemmo badi mpim aavlanyɔ-inyɔ ku avlaatɛ-ine (

english_verse: Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
translation_verse: Na Beker bebi ndi Simra ku Yoas ku Elieser ku Elioenai ku Omri ku Yeremot ku Abia ku Anatot ku Alamet. Na bamɛni ƒui badi Beker bebi.

english_verse: Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,
translation_verse: Na Eƒraim kaba bebi ndi Sutela ɔni náwɔ Bered ɔni náwɔ Tahat ɔni náwɔ Elada ɔni náwɔ Tahat

english_verse: Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
translation_verse: Na Yediael ubi ndi Bilhan. Na Bilhan bebi ndi Yeus ku Benyamin ku Ehud ku Kenaana ku Setan ku Tarsis ku Ahisahar.

english_verse: Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Na Ulam ubidi ndi Bedan. Na bamɛni ndi Gilead bebi ɔni ndi Makir ubi ɔni ndi Manase ubidi.

english_verse: Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan. Dan was the father of Hushim. The Descendants of Naphtali
translation_verse: Na Supimƒuɔ ku Hupimƒuɔ badi Ir kaba bebi. Na Husimƒuɔ badi Aher kaba bebi. Naƒtali Kaba Bekyuli Anyi

english_verse: Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum. The Descendants of Manasseh
translation_verse: Naƒtali bebi anyi ndi Yahsiel ku Guni ku Yeser ku Salum na bana ƒui bási Bilha kaba kemmo. Manase Kaba Bekyuli Anyi

english_verse: Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead.
translation_verse: Na Manase kaba ndi kamɛni. Asriel ɔdi nwuna kaba ubi. Na ɔ́kɛ-nwu ɔ́siku Aramni ɔsɔnɔ ɔdi kudɔ. Na ɔ́wɔ Makir ɔni ndi Gilead ɔti.

english_verse: Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah. Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
translation_verse: Na Makir úti uleku ɔ́siku Hupimƒuɔ ku Supimƒuɔ kudɔ. Na ɔnwani ulekubi baalɔ banii Maaka. Na nwuna kaba bamba lɛnɔ ndi Seloƒehad ɔni náwɔ beleku lɛti lɛti.

english_verse: Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem.
translation_verse: Na Makir ulekudi Maaka ɔ́wɔ bananabi inyɔ na ɔ́sia udeedi lɛnyi ɔnii Peres na ɔ́sia inyɔdi ɔnii Seres. Na nwuna bebi bananabi ndi Ulam ku Rakem.

english_verse: Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
translation_verse: Na ɔnwani ulekubi ɔni baalɔ banii Moleket ɔ́wɔ Is-Dod ku Abieser ku Mahla.

english_verse: Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam. The Descendants of Ephraim
translation_verse: Na Semida bebi ndi Ahian ku Sekem ku Likhi ku Aniam. Eƒraim Kaba Bebi Anyi

english_verse: Zabad, and Shuthelah. Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath.
translation_verse: ɔni náwɔ Sabad ɔni náwɔ Sutela. Na Eƒraim ubo bebi inyɔ bamba bani ndi Eser ku Elad bani na Gatƒuɔ bádu uwi ɔni na bésie betéƒie Gatƒuɔ bammɔ bebuo baƒɔ.

english_verse: Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama anwu ku ulekudi básɔ bátɛ na ulekudi ɔmmɔ ɔ́da kaƒɔ na ɔ́wɔ ubi ɔnanabi na ɔ́sia-nwu lɛnyi ɔnii Beria. Ɔsika ɔ́siaku ɔgbankpi na nwuna bebi akɔ.

english_verse: Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
translation_verse: Na ubidi ulekubi Seera náda lɛma lɛni ndi Bet-Horon katɔ ku kada ku Usen-Seera ɔma.

english_verse: Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan,
translation_verse: Na Reƒa ɔ́wɔ Reseƒ ɔni náwɔ Tela ɔni náwɔ Tahan ɔni náwɔ

english_verse: Nun, and Joshua.
translation_verse: Nun ɔni náwɔ Yosua.

english_verse: The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Na bana kɔlɔ ku kuliekɔ ndi Betel ku nina akpaklɔ ku Naaran útédu ɔƒɛ katukɔ ku Gasa ku nina akpaklɔ útédu ɔƒɛ kanukɔ ku Sekem ku nina akpaklɔ. Na ɔvi útédu Gasa ku nina akpaklɔ.

english_verse: The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages. The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages. The Descendants of Asher
translation_verse: Na Manase lɛmii lɛ́kɛ Bet-San ku Tanak ku Megido ku Dor ku nina akpaklɔ. Na mmɔ na Israel ubidi Yoseƒ kaba bekyuli bélie. Aser Kaba Bebi Anyi

english_verse: Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
translation_verse: Na Aser bebi ndi Yimna ku Yiswa ku Yiswi ku Beria ku bana ɔnwani ulekubi ɔni baalɔ Serah.

english_verse: Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith.
translation_verse: Na Beria bebi ndi Heber ku Malkiel ɔni ndi Birsait ɔti.

english_verse: Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua.
translation_verse: Na Heber ɔ́wɔ Yaƒlet ku Somer ku Hotam ku bana ɔnwani ulekubi ɔni baalɔ banii Sua.

english_verse: Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
translation_verse: Na Yaƒlet bebi ndi Pasak ku Bimhal ku Aswat.

english_verse: Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
translation_verse: Na Semer bebi ndi Ahi ku Rohga ku Yehuba ku Aram.

english_verse: And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
translation_verse: Na nwuna ɔnwani Helem bebi ndi Soƒa ku Yimna ku Seles ku Amal.

english_verse: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
translation_verse: ku Beser ku Hod ku Sama ku Silsa ku Yitran ku Beera.

english_verse: Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
translation_verse: Na Yeter bebi ndi Yeƒune ku Pispa ku Ara.

english_verse: Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
translation_verse: Na Ula bebi ndi Arah ku Haniel ku Risia.

english_verse: These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of
translation_verse: Na bamɛni ƒui badi Aser kaba bebi ku lɛtɔ benengu ku bekyuli bani na bana lɛlɔ libo ɔbu ku bekpone ku batɔnkune. Na bekyuli bani na bédu kekpo busie na bénweni-ma anyi bákya bana kaba bekyuli anyi ɔku badi mpim aavlanyɔ ɛku (

english_verse: Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah,
translation_verse: Benyamin ɔ́wɔ Bela ɔni ndi-nwu ubi udeedi. Na Asbel ɔdi unyɔdi na Ahara ɔdi ɔtɛdi.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud,
translation_verse: Na Bela bebi ndi Adar ku Gera ku Abihud

english_verse: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
translation_verse: ku Abisua ku Naaman ku Ahoa

english_verse: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
translation_verse: ku Gera ku Seƒuƒan ku Huram.

english_verse: Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Na Elpaal bebi ndi Eber ku Misam ku Semed ɔni náda Ono ku Lod lɛma ku nina akpaklɔ ani nkya amadɔ mmɔ,

english_verse: Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath.
translation_verse: ku Beria ku Sema bani ndi ɔtɔ benengu bani nélie Ayalon, na ama nábɔku bekyuli bani nli Gat.

english_verse: Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha.
translation_verse: ku Mikael ku Yispa ku Yoha badi Beria bebi.

english_verse: Elpaal's descendants included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab.
translation_verse: ku Ismerai ku Yislia ku Yobab ama lɛnɔ ndi Elpaal bebi.

english_verse: Shimei's descendants included Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi, Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel, Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath.
translation_verse: ku Adaia ku Beraia ku Simrat ama ndi Simei bebi.

english_verse: Shashak's descendants included Ishpan, Eber, Eliel, Abdon, Zichri, Hanan, Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah, Iphdeiah, and Penuel.
translation_verse: ku Yiƒdeia ku Penuel ama ndi Sasak bebi.

english_verse: Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri.
translation_verse: ku Yaaresia ku Elia ku Sikri ama ndi Yeroham kaba bebi.

english_verse: These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni ƒui badi atɔƒi benengu ku baga aani kalɛ na bénweni-ma anyi bákya bana kaba anyi ɔku kemmo, na ama nélie Yerusalem.

english_verse: Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there
translation_verse: Yeiel ɔni ɔti ndi Gibeon úlie Gibeon ɔma kemmo, na ulekudi baalɔ banii Maaka.

english_verse: along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: Na ubidi udeedi ndi Abdon ku Sur ku Kis ku Baal ku Ner ku Nadab

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
translation_verse: ku Gedor ku Ahio ku Seker.

english_verse: and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives. The Descendants of King Saul
translation_verse: Na Miklot ɔ́wɔ Simea na bana kaba bélie Yerusalem. Na bélie béde bana lɛtɔ bekyuli.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Na Ner ɔ́wɔ Kis, na Kis ɔ́wɔ Saul na Saul ɔ́wɔ Yonatan ku Malki-Saul ku Abinadab ku Esbaal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah,
translation_verse: Na Yonatan ubidi ndi Merib-Baal ɔni náwɔ Mika.

english_verse: and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Na Mika bebi ndi Piton ku Melek ku Tarea ku Ahas.

english_verse: Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza,
translation_verse: Na Ahas ɔ́wɔ Yehoada, na Yehoada ɔ́wɔ Alemet ku Asmawet ku Simri. Na Simri ɔ́wɔ Mosa.

english_verse: as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Na Asel ɔ́wɔ bananabi ɛku na bana anyi ndi Asrikam ku Bokeru ku Ismael ku Searia ku Obadia ku Hanan. Na bammɔ ndi Asel bebi.

english_verse: Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: Na ɔnwani Esek bebi ndi Ulam ubidi udeedi, na Yeus ɔdi unyɔdi na Eliƒelet ɔdi ɔtɛdi.

english_verse: Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of
translation_verse: Ulam bebi badi bekpone bani na bebo kayi na baakana kɔtaminta bubo geen. Bebo bebi ku bawɔ na babla nkyuli eti atɛ. Bamɛni ƒui badi Benyamin kaba kemmo bebi.

english_verse: And the first people to return to their towns included priests, Levites, temple workers, and other Israelites.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bedeedi bani nénwini bébo ama alati lɛma na bététi bana kɔlɔ badi Israelƒuɔ ku bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ ku kakpakɔ kabla bablane badi.

english_verse: People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani nási Yuda ku Benyamin ku Eƒraim ku Manase kaba kemmo bésie bétélie Yerusalem.

english_verse: Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
translation_verse: ku Malkia ɔni ubidi ndi Pashur ɔni ubidi ndi Yeroham ɔni ubidi ndi Adaia ku Immer ɔni ubidi ndi Mesilemit ɔni ubidi ndi Mesulam ɔni ubidi ndi Yahsera ɔni ubidi ndi Adiel ɔni ubidi ndi Masai.

english_verse: priests, all of them family leaders in their clan and trained in the work at the temple. The Levites Who Settled in Jerusalem
translation_verse: ) Na badi bekyuli bani na bámanku na bagyi kabla kani ƒui na babla na Unwoti kakpakɔ mmɔ kaduɛ. Lewiƒuɔ Kaba Bekyuli Anyi

english_verse: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan,
translation_verse: Na kakpakɔ bagyumanane ndi Salum ku Akub ku Talmon ku Ahiman ku bana banwani na Salum ndi bana ɔtɔnkune.

english_verse: and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
translation_verse: Na ama na mɔɔgyumana bana keliekɔ ku ɔga kayakun kani nkya ɔƒɛ katukɔ úti úbedu ɔƒaani. Na ama ndi kayakun bagyumane bani nási Lewiƒuɔ akɔ.

english_verse: Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Salum ɔni ɔti ndi Kore ɔni ɔti ndi Ebiasaƒ ɔni ɔti ndi Kora ku nwuna banwani bani na bási Kora ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo mɔɔnu Katɔti kakpakɔ kammɔ kayakun lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na bana bati bátaagyumana Unwoti Adi Kevo kayakun kammɔ.

english_verse: Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Na kalɔ kesekɔ ni, Eleasar ubidi Pinehas nátaanu kɔyakun bagyumanane lɛlɔ. Na Unwoti uliku-nwu.

english_verse: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
translation_verse: Na Sakaria ɔni ndi Meselemia ubidi nánu kayakun kani na baasia teeduo Unwoti kɔdi ɔtɔ kemmo.

english_verse: guards, all of them listed in the family records in their towns. Their ancestors had been chosen by King David and by Samuel the prophet to be responsible for this work,
translation_verse: ) Na bénweni-ma anyi bákya anyi ɔku kemmo na akpaklɔ ani beli. Na Ɔga Dawid ku Kenye Udiene Samuel néti bagyumanane kabla kammɔ bákya-ma enu kemmo.

english_verse: and now they guarded the temple gates.
translation_verse: Na ama ku bana kaba nátaagyumana Unwoti Kɔkpakɔ kɔyakun kɔmmɔ.

english_verse: There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple.
translation_verse: Na kayakun kákya ɔƒɛ katukɔ ku katɔ ku kada. Na kayakun biala kebo nwuna unengu.

english_verse: Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty.
