translation_verse: Na Dawid ɔ́kpali Unwoti úvele ɔnini, “Mina bɔƒiɔ na bɔdi! Lɛ́bla likpidi na uwi ɔni na lɛ́su nnii baka bekyuli bammɔ. Ɔɔɔdi ama nábla likpidi lɛdi bese aani koƒonu kɔni naaakɛ ku lɛla. Unwoti Katɔti, buvele ya na lɛtuni lɛmɛni líbo ami ku mina kaduli bekyuli lɛlɔ. Ta ya na ɔlɛ buɛ ɔmɛni ɔdu ƒula kadi bekyuli ƒui udie.”

english_verse: David's order to count the people made God angry, and he punished Israel.
translation_verse: Dawid ɔda ɔni na úbo ɔnii baka bekyuli mmɔ ɔ́kya Katɔti kɔnyi geen na ɔ́ni Israel kɔtu.

english_verse: David prayed, “I am your servant. But what I did was stupid and terribly wrong. Please forgive me.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Dawid ɔ́kpali Katɔti úvele-nwu ɔnini, “Ƒula kabla ɔblane na ndi. Nsu lɛ́bla kɔdɔlɔ lɛla lɛni náya na lɛ́ƒiɔ-ɔ geen. Buvele ti kyiɛ-mi.”

english_verse: Gad went to David and told him: You must choose how the Lord will punish you:
translation_verse: Amu na Gad úsie Dawid kudɔ na útásu-nwu lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́tala-nwu na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ ɔlati ƒuna lɛla lɛni na aayɔ́.

english_verse: Will there be three years when the land won't grow enough food for its people? Or will your enemies constantly defeat you for three months? Or will the Lord send a horrible disease to strike your land for three days? Think about it and decide, because I have to give your answer to God who sent me.
translation_verse: Aayɔ́ ka kɔka kubo kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ ɔsiaku lɛlɔ akwa atɛ ɔni na edula adi biala aladia na kalɔ kammɔ kemmo? Munuu aayɔ́ ka ƒula bekisine bebekpo-ɔ basiaku lɛlɔ abuli atɛ na bataadi-ɔ lɛlɔ? Munuu aayɔ́ ka Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi uboku ɔlɛ buɛ ɔdi na ubadu bekyuli na kalɔ kammɔ kemmo ɔka ɔmana? Bla kasusu na edie kenye kadi na ntásu Unwoti ɔni nátala-mi.”

english_verse: David was miserable and said, “It's a terrible choice to make! But the Lord is kind, and I'd rather be punished by him than by anyone else.”
translation_verse: Kɔnyana kúƒie Dawid geen na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Lɛla lɛdi bɔƒuna na amɛni kemmo ubo ɔkplu geen! Nsu Unwoti ɔɔnu kɔnyana na si anwu ɔlati ɔ́ni-mi kɔtu ni, ɔdia utulo ɔni na ukyuli bamba ɔdi wani-mi kɔtu.”

english_verse: Then he sent an angel to destroy the city of Jerusalem. But just as the angel was about to do that, the Lord felt sorry for all the suffering he had caused the people, and he told the angel, “Stop! They have suffered enough.” This happened at the threshing place that belonged to Araunah the Jebusite.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, ɔ́ya na nwuna ɔtu ɔdi úbo kalɛ na ubayila Yerusalem udu ƒui. Nsu uwi ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́klibi lɛlɔ ka use kabla kammɔ kalɔ kani na bekyuli bammɔ lɛlɔ lɛ́bla Unwoti kɔnyana na ala ani néebo-ma lɛlɔ ɔsu na ɔ́bala ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Sɔ nye! Bana lɛbibo lɛ́bɔ.” Na ala amɛni álɛ na Yebusini ɔnana ɔni baalɔ banii Arauna kakpa kesii kani na uuwiile nwuna edula ebi mmɔ.

english_verse: David saw the Lord's angel in the air, holding a sword over Jerusalem. He and the leaders of Israel, who were all wearing sackcloth, bowed with their faces to the ground,
translation_verse: Dawid ɔ́nu Unwoti ɔtu ɔmmɔ na kayaa ka ɔda kewii kadi na Yerusalem eli. Na anwu ku nwuna benengu báda adala ani mɔɔtina ka beewulo kɔnyana geen na béboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na béti anumi bébi kalɔ.

english_verse: The Lord's angel told the prophet Gad to tell David that he must go to Araunah's threshing place and build an altar in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su Gad ɔnii usie na utásu Dawid na utátu lɛkpabi lɛdi na Arauna kakpa mmɔ ute Unwoti.

english_verse: Araunah and his four sons were threshing wheat at the time, and when they saw the angel, the four sons ran to hide.
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Arauna ku nwuna bebi ine bákya bétewiile edula ebi. Na ka bánu ɔtu ɔmmɔ ni, békeli bátábɛ.

english_verse: Just then, David arrived, and when Araunah saw him, he stopped his work and bowed down.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kani na Dawid ɔ́da úbalɛ mmɔ. Na ka Arauna ɔ́nu-nwu ni, ɔ́da nwuna kabla bɔbla ɔ́ya na úboku lɛlɔ kalɔ úte Dawid.

english_verse: David said, “Would you sell me your threshing place, so I can build an altar on it to the Lord? Then this disease will stop killing the people. I'm willing to pay whatever you say it's worth.”
translation_verse: Amu na Dawid úye-nwu ɔnini, “Abu buye ƒula kakpa kamɛni ete-mi na lɛtu lɛkpabi lite Unwoti? Ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na ɔlɛ buɛ ɔmɛni kenye kekulo. Na kayu biala na adubɔkya-mi ni, ndubɔƒɔ lite-ɔ.”

english_verse: Araunah answered, “Take it, Your Majesty, and do whatever you want with it. I'll even give you the oxen for the sacrifice and the wheat for the grain sacrifice. And you can use the threshing-boards for the fire. It's all yours!”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Arauna údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɔga Ɔbune, ti kakpa kammɔ na eti abla lɛla biala na aayɔ́ abla. Na ndubute-ɔ ɔmantɛ bakɔ bani na adubɔkyula akpa ku edula ebi ani na adubuti abla etela akpala ammɔ. Na akana na eti kudenkɛ kɔmmɔ abla ƒula ekyweni.”

english_verse: David built an altar and offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. David prayed, and the Lord answered him by sending fire down on the altar.
translation_verse: Dawid ɔ́tu lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ na ɔ́bla bɔkyula ƒui akpala ani mɔɔyɔ́ Unwoti kaƒɔ úte-nwu ku unwi bɔbla akpala. Na Unwoti únu Dawid buvele na ɔ́ya na ogya ɔ́si katɔ úbo úbayu lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord commanded the angel to put the sword away.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti úbo nwuna ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔda ɔnii ɔbɛla nwuna kewii kammɔ.

english_verse: When David saw that the Lord had answered his prayer, he offered more sacrifices there at the threshing place,
translation_verse: Na ka Dawid ɔ́nu ka Unwoti únu-nwu bɔkpali ɔsu ni, ɔ́bla akpala bɔkyula bamba na mmɔ úte Unwoti

english_verse: because he was afraid of the angel's sword and did not want to go all the way to Gibeon. That's where the sacred tent that Moses had made in the desert was kept, as well as the altar where sacrifices were offered to the Lord.
translation_verse: ɔsika ɔɔyia Unwoti ɔtu ɔmmɔ kewii kammɔ na ulayɔ ka use usie Gibeon kesii kani na Unwoti Adi Kevo kani na Mose ɔ́bla na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ kalɛ ku nwuna lɛkpabi.

english_verse: David said, “The temple of the Lord God must be built right here at this threshing place. And the altar for offering sacrifices will also be here.” David Prepares To Build the Temple
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Dawid ɔ́su ɔnini, “Kesii kani na kakpa kamɛni kakya na ɔlɛka batu Unwoti Katɔti kakpakɔ kammɔ. Na mɛni kani na badubɔtu nwuna lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ.” Dawid Ɔ́klibi Lɛlɔ Ka Ɔtu Kakpakɔ

english_verse: David ordered the foreigners living in Israel to come to Jerusalem. Then he assigned some to cut blocks of stone for building the temple.
translation_verse: Amu na Dawid úbo ɔda ɔnii baƒɔ bani ƒui na bakya Yerusalem bebo. Na úte-ma kabla ka bekulo atabi atimbɔ ani a badubuti batu kakpakɔ kammɔ.

english_verse: He also brought an endless supply of cedar logs from the cities of Sidon and Tyre.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́wia egyii kpakplaa ani ndi sida na békulo-nya eku eku básiku Sidon ku Tiro béboku.

english_verse: He said, “The temple for the Lord must be great, so that everyone in the world will know about it. But since my son Solomon is young and has no experience, I will make sure that everything is ready for the temple to be built.” That's why David did all these things before he died. David Instructs Solomon To Build the Temple
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɔlɛka batu Unwoti kakpakɔ kamɛni na kebomo na kataadia bɔnu na kaƒɔ lɛnyi na kesii biala na bekyuli ƒui anumi. Nsu ka mina ubi Salomo ɔdi ɔnamu na nwuna kasusu kétebimi tɔ na ala amɛni lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, ɔlɛka lɛnu ka atula ammɔ ƒui ása ese kalɛ na beti batu ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ.” Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na Dawid ɔ́bla ala amɛni asa na úkpi. Dawid Ɔ́tina Salomo Kalɛ Na Ɔtu Kakpakɔ Kammɔ

english_verse: David sent for his son Solomon and told him to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Dawid ɔ́ya na bátálɔ ubidi Salomo béboku na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnii ɔtu kakpakɔ ute Unwoti Israel Katɔti.

english_verse: He said: My son, I wanted to build a temple where the Lord my God would be worshiped.
translation_verse: Ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Mina ubi, lɛ́yɔ ka nka lɛtu kakpakɔ lite Unwoti mina Katɔti kesii kani na badubutaakpa-nwu.

english_verse: But some time ago, he told me, “David, you have killed too many people and have fought too many battles. That's why you are not the one to build my temple.
translation_verse: Nsu na uwi ɔdi návi kemmo ni, ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, ‘Dawid, áadu bekyuli ágya na éekpo kekpo lɛnɔ ágya. Anwuɔsu ɔɔɔdi awɔ na ɔdi ka atu mina kakpakɔ.

english_verse: But when your son becomes king, I will give him peace throughout his kingdom. His name will be Solomon, because during his rule I will keep Israel safe and peaceful.
translation_verse: Nsu si uwi ɔni na ƒ'ubidi úbenwini ɔga ni, ndubo bɔya na ɔkɛ keyi buɛɛ na nwuna lɛga kadikɔ ƒui kemmo. Na ƒ'ubidi ɔni ndubo lɛga lɛmmɔ bɔdi ndi Salomo. Ɔsika na nwuna lɛga bɔdi uwi ni, ndubɔya na keyi buɛɛ kakya nwuna lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ kemmo na Israel ƒui.

english_verse: Solomon will build my temple. He will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him. In fact, one of his descendants will always rule in Israel.”
translation_verse: Salomo ndubo mina kakpakɔ kammɔ bɔtu. Na ɔdubɔbla aani ubi ute-mi na ami lɛbla aani ɔti lite-nwu. Na geen ni, nwuna kaba kemmo ubi ndubo Israel lɛga butaadi uwi biala.’

english_verse: Solomon, my son, I now pray that the Lord your God will be with you and keep his promise to help you build a temple for him.
translation_verse: “Mina ubi Salomo, muuvele nnii Unwoti, ƒula Katɔti, ɔsiaku-ɔ na ɔdi nwuna linyese lɛlɔ na ubunku-ɔ na atu kakpakɔ kammɔ ete-nwu.

english_verse: May he give you wisdom and knowledge, so that you can rule Israel according to his Law.
translation_verse: Ute-ɔ lɛnunda ku lɛlati kalɛ na adi Israelƒuɔ lɛlɔ asiaku nwuna ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you obey the laws and teachings that the Lord gave Moses, you will be successful. Be strong and brave and don't get discouraged or be afraid of anything.
translation_verse: Si ádi ɔda bubo bɔni na Unwoti úte Mose lɛlɔ ni, ala adubɔtɛ ete-ɔ. Nye kpakplaa na akya kayi na taya na enu áƒɛ-ɔ uwi ɔdi iye ayia lɛla lɛdi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I have also assigned men who will cut and lay the stone. And there are carpenters and people who are experts in working with
translation_verse: Na líiti atabi bɔnwi ku bɔtu kabla kammɔ lɛ́kya bekyuli badi kɔnu. Na banwine ku bekyuli bani na bagyi

english_verse: gold, silver, bronze, and iron. You have plenty of workers to do the job. Now get started, and I pray that the Lord will be with you in your work.
translation_verse: sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ku abuala egyiedi ku abuala kpakplaa lɛlɔ kabla kaduɛɛ ƒui ni, bemomo na benye kagyumana ka babla kabla kammɔ. Anwuɔsu ɔkya-a kudɔ bo lɛlɔ na ese kabla kalɔ. Muuvele Unwoti nnii ɔsiaku-ɔ na ƒula kabla kammɔ bɔbla kemmo.”

english_verse: David then gave orders for the leaders of Israel to help Solomon.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Dawid úbo Israel batɔnkune bammɔ ɔda ka bebunku Salomo.

english_verse: David said: The Lord our God has helped me defeat all the people who lived here before us, and he has given you peace from all your enemies. Now this land belongs to the Lord and his people.
translation_verse: Na Dawid ɔ́su ɔnini, “Unwoti bula Katɔti úbunku-mi na lɛ́di bekyuli bani ƒui na nka belie mɛni asa búbo ƒui lɛlɔ. Na ɔƒaani ni, úte-ɔ keyi buɛɛ ku atu bɔyɔ ɔ́siku ƒula bekisine ƒui kudɔ. Na kalɔ kamɛni ku bénwini Unwoti ku nwuna bekyuli kadi.

english_verse: Obey the Lord your God with your heart and soul. Begin work on the temple to honor him, so that the sacred chest and the things used for worship can be kept there.
translation_verse: Nu Unwoti ƒula Katɔti litemi na adi-ni lɛlɔ ku ƒula kayi ƒui ku kɔyu ƒui lɛnɔ. Na ese kabla kalɔ na kakpakɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ na eti abu nwuna lɛnyi kalɛ na Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ ku ala ani lɛlɔ kabla na baabla na kakpakɔ mmɔ ƒui ni, akɛ-nya kesekɔ.”

english_verse: David was old when he chose his son Solomon to be king of Israel.
translation_verse: Dawid ɔ́ɔbi lɛlɔ geen asa na ɔ́ƒuna ubidi Salomo ka ɔdi Israel ɔga.

english_verse: Some time later, David called together all of Israel's leaders, priests, and Levites.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔdi kama ni, Dawid ɔ́lɔ Israelƒuɔ batɔnkune bammɔ ku bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ ɔ́sala.

english_verse: He then counted the Levite men who were at least
translation_verse: Ɔ́ka Lewiƒuɔ banana bani náaƒɔ áani akwa avlaatɛ na bana bumomo bɔbla nkyuli mpim avlaatɛ-maane.

english_verse: Every morning and evening, the Levites are to give thanks to the Lord and sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ɔtanta ku useyi uwi biala ni, Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ na ɔdi ka bagya Unwoti enu na bedie lɛnu bemwi-nwu.

english_verse: David then divided the Levites into three groups according to the clans of Levi's sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Dawid úle Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ ɔ́kya esu atɛ kemmo na bana adua kenye. Na ama ndi Gerson ku Kohat ku Merari.

english_verse: Gershon had two sons: Ladan and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gerson ɔ́wɔ bebi bananabi inyɔ bani ndi Ladan ku Simei.

english_verse: Ladan was the father of Jehiel, Zetham, and Joel.
translation_verse: Ladan ɔ́wɔ Yehiel ku Setam ku Yoel.

english_verse: They were all family leaders among their father's descendants. Shimei was the father of Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran.
translation_verse: Na bebi bamɛni ƒui bénwini lɛtɔ benengu na bana ɔti Ladan bebi ku bawɔ kemmo. Simei ɔ́wɔ Selomot ku Hasiel ku Haran.

english_verse: Later, Shimei had four more sons, in the following order: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah. But Jeush and Beriah didn't have many children, so their descendants were counted as one family.
translation_verse: Kama ƒui ni, Simei ɔ́sɔ úbawɔ bebi bananabi ine bamba. Na ama ndi Yahat ku Sina ku Yeus ku Beria. Na Yeus ku Beria bátawɔ na bemomo. Anwuɔsu ama ku bana bebi ku bawɔ ƒui ni, ɔtɔ unwi bekyuli kani na béti-ma.

english_verse: Kohath had four sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohat ɔ́wɔ bebi ine bani ndi Amram ku Isa ku Hebron ku Usiel.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were chosen to be in charge of all the sacred things. They served the Lord by offering sacrifices to him and by blessing the people in his name.
translation_verse: Na Amram ɔmɛni náwɔ Aaron ku Mose. Na Aaron ku nwuna kaba kemmo bebi na báƒuna ka bataanu kakpakɔ ala kedee ammɔ lɛlɔ. Na bataabla Unwoti kabla na akpala bɔkyula kemmo na ama ndubo buteete bekyuli kusɛ kusɛ na Unwoti lɛnyi kemmo.

english_verse: Moses, the man of God, was the father of Gershom and Eliezer, and their descendants were considered Levites.
translation_verse: Na Mose ɔni ndi Katɔti ukyuli ɔƒunadi bebi bani na ɔ́wɔ ndi Gersom ku Eliese na bana kaba kemmo bebi na baanu aani Lewiƒuɔ.

english_verse: Gershom's oldest son was Shebuel.
translation_verse: Gersom ubi ɔnanabi unengudi ndi Sebuel.

english_verse: Rehabiah, who was Eliezer's only son, had many children.
translation_verse: Eliese ɔ́wɔ ubi unwi pɛ ɔni ndi Rehabia. Na Rehabia ɔmɛni ɔ́wɔ bebi pii geen.

english_verse: Hebron, the third son of Kohath, was the father of Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: Na Hebron bebi atɔ asia ndi Yeria ku Amaria ku Yahasiel ku Yekameam.

english_verse: Merari had two sons: Mahli and Mushi. Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish.
translation_verse: Na Merari bebi inyɔ bani na ɔ́wɔ ndi Mali ku Musi. Na Mali ɔ́wɔ Eleasa ku Kis.

english_verse: Eleazar had no sons, only daughters, and they married their uncle's sons.
translation_verse: Eleasa úkpi na uuubo ubi ɔnanabi uuutulo belekubi bani na ɔ́wɔ. Na bana ɔti ɔnwani ɔni baalɔ Kis bebi bananabi néti-ma.

english_verse: Mushi the second son of Merari, was the father of Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.
translation_verse: Musi ɔ́wɔ Mali ku Ede ku Yerimot na bebo bebi bananabi ɛtɛ.

english_verse: These were the clans and families of the tribe of Levi. Those who were
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ ndi Lewiƒuɔ adua ku atɔƒi ammɔ. Na bani na báƒɔ akwa aavlanyɔ iye betulo ni, ama na béte kabla na Unwoti kakpakɔ.

english_verse: David said: The Lord God of Israel has given his people peace, and he will live in Jerusalem forever.
translation_verse: Amu na Dawid ɔ́su ɔnini, “Unwoti Israel Katɔti úte nwuna bekyuli keyi buɛɛ na badubo Yerusalem bulie uwi ƒui.

english_verse: And so, the Levites won't need to move the sacred tent and the things used for worship from place to place.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔsɔ uuubo banii Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ basɔ beteeti Unwoti kevo kammɔ ku ala ani na beeti taabla akpala bɔkyula mmɔ taavinku ɔ́si kesii kadi usie kesii bamba.”

english_verse: From now on, all Levites at least
translation_verse: Ka ɔ́si ɔƒaani ni, Lewiƒuɔ bani na báƒɔ ɔ́si akwa aavlanyɔ ku kama ni,

english_verse: will serve the Lord by helping Aaron's descendants do their work at the temple, by keeping the courtyards and rooms of the temple clean, and by making sure that everything used in worship stays pure.
translation_verse: badubo Unwoti kabla bɔbla na beteebunku Aaron kaba kemmo bebi. Na bada kakpakɔ kaduli ku kakpakɔ kammɔ kemmo ƒui sɛɛn na banu ka ala ani na beeti taabla akpala lɛlɔ kabla mmɔ ƒui ese sɛɛn.

english_verse: They will also be in charge of the sacred loaves of bread, the flour for the grain sacrifices, the thin wafers, any offerings to be baked, and the flour mixed with olive oil. These Levites will weigh and measure these offerings.
translation_verse: Na ama ndubo adila kedee ammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ butaanu. Edula ebi ɔlaaƒɔ ɔni na beeti taabla adila akpala ku bodobodo vɛɛvɛɛ ku adila etela biala buƒi ku ɔlaaƒɔ ɔni na básala ku nnɔ mmɔ ni, bana kabla na kadi ka banu-nya kaduɛ.

english_verse: They must also give thanks and sing praises when sacrifices are offered on each Sabbath, as well as during New Moon Festivals and other religious feasts. There must always be enough Levites on duty at the temple to do everything that needs to be done.
translation_verse: Na Lɛnwunameyi biala lɛlɔ lɛnɔ si bábla akpala bɔkyula béte Unwoti ni, ɔdi ka bagya Unwoti enu na bedie lɛnu bemwi-nwu. Na lɛni kani ɔdubuse na kɔbuli kɔwɔdi bɔlɛ kemmo ku emeyi buni biala bɔdi kemmo lɛnɔ. Anwuɔsu ɔlɛka Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ bemomo na kakpakɔ mmɔ uwi biala kalɛ na ala ani ƒui na ɔdi ka babla ni, banu ka bábla-nya lɛni kani.

english_verse: They were once in charge of taking care of the sacred tent; now they are responsible for the temple and for helping Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdi návi ni, bana kabla kadi ka beteeti Unwoti kevo kedee kammɔ na bataanu-ka lɛlɔ. Na ɔƒaani ni, bana kabla ndi ka banu kakpakɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ na beteebunku Aaron kaba kemmo bebi bammɔ.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants were then divided into work groups. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, béle Aaron kaba kemmo bebi bammɔ bákya esu esu kemmo na bana kabla kenye. Na bebi ine na Aaron ɔ́wɔ. Na ama ndi Nadab ku Abihu ku Eleasa ku Itamar.

english_verse: But Nadab and Abihu died long before their father, without having any sons. That's why Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
translation_verse: Nsu Nadab ku Abihu báka bana ɔti bukpi kukuuku ƒui asa na anwu úbekpi ɔni na bátawɔ. Anwuɔsu na Eleasa ku Itamar nábla kabla aani bakpane.

english_verse: David divided Aaron's descendants into groups, according to their assigned work. Zadok, one of Eleazar's descendants, and Ahimelech, one of Ithamar's descendants, helped David.
translation_verse: Amu na Dawid úle Aaron kaba kemmo bebi ɔ́kya esu esu kemmo na bana kabla kani na béte-ma ka babla kenye. Na Sadok ɔni na ɔdi Eleasa kaba kemmo ubi ku Ahimelek ɔni na anwu lɛnɔ ɔdi Itamar kaba kemmo ubi ni, ama nébunku Dawid.

english_verse: However, both families included temple officials and priests, and so to make sure the work was divided fairly, David asked God what to do.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ni, kakpakɔ benengu ku bakpane bammɔ alati ƒui bakya atɔƒi anyɔ ammɔ kemmo, nsu ɔdi bele kabla kammɔ na anumi bɔnu bɔbla lɛla lɛdi bulakya-nwu kemmo. Anwuɔsu Dawid úvele Unwoti na ɔtina-nwu lɛla lɛni na wabla.

english_verse: As each group was assigned their duties, Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the Levite wrote down the name of the family leader in charge of that group. The witnesses were David and his officials, as well as Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the family leaders from the clans of the priests and the Levites.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na beele kabla kammɔ teete-ma ni, lɛni kani na Semaia Lewini ɔni ndi Netanel ubidi mmɔ lɛnɔ uunweni atɔƒi benengu bani ntɔnku esu ammɔ anyi teese. Na bamanyene bani nénye bánu bule kabla kammɔ lɛlɔ ndi Dawid ku nwuna benengu úbunku ɔkpane Sadok ku Ahimelek ɔni ndi Abiatar ubidi ku atɔƒi benengu bani nási bakpane bammɔ ku Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ adua kemmo.

english_verse: Each group of priests went by the name of its family leader, and they were assigned their duties in the following order: Jehoiarib, Jedaiah, Harim, Seorim, Malchijah, Mijamin, Hakkoz, Abijah, Jeshua, Shecaniah, Eliashib, Jakim, Huppah, Jeshebeab, Bilgah, Immer, Hezir, Happizzez, Pethahiah, Jehezkel, Jachin, Gamul, Delaiah, Maaziah.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bakpane lisu biala baadi bana lɛtɔƒi unengu lɛnyi. Na kalɛ na béle kabla kammɔ atɔ asia ndi kalɛ na ɔdubo mɛni. Yehoiarib asa na Yedaia asa na Harim asa na Seorim asa na Malkiya asa na Miyamin asa na Hakos asa na Abiya asa na Yesua asa na Sekania asa na Eliasib asa na Yakim asa na Hupa asa na Yesebeab asa na Bilga asa na Imer asa na Hesir asa na Hapises asa na Petahia asa na Yeheskel sa na Yakin asa na Gamul asa na Delaia asa na Maasia.

english_verse: These men were assigned their duties at the temple, just as the Lord God of Israel had commanded their ancestor Aaron. The Rest of the Levites Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni na béte kabla bɔbla na kakpakɔ kammɔ kemmo aani kalɛ na Unwoti Israel Katɔti úbo ɔda úte bana nana ati Aaron. Béle Kabla Béte Lewiƒuɔ Bakladi

english_verse: Here is a list of the other descendants of Levi: Amram was the ancestor of Shubael and Jehdeiah.
translation_verse: Na Lewiƒuɔ bakladi anyi na bana kaba kemmo anyi ndubo mɛni. Amram ndi Subael ku Yedeia nana ati.

english_verse: Rehabiah was the ancestor of Isshiah, the oldest son in his family.
translation_verse: Na Rehabia ndi Isia ɔni ndi nwuna ɔtɔ kemmo ubi unengudi nana ati.

english_verse: Izhar was the father of Shelomoth and the grandfather of Jahath.
translation_verse: Isaa ndi Selomo ɔti na nwuna uwɔ ndi Yahat.

english_verse: Hebron had four sons, in the following order: Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: Hebron ɔ́wɔ bebi ine na atɔ asia ɔmmɔ ndi Yeria ku Amaria ku Yahasiel ku Yekameam.

english_verse: Uzziel was the father of Micah and the grandfather of Shamir.
translation_verse: Usiel ɔ́wɔ Mika na nwuna uwɔ ndi Samir.

english_verse: Isshiah, Micah's brother, was the father of Zechariah.
translation_verse: Na Isaa ɔni ndi Mika ɔnwani ɔnanabi ni, anwu náwɔ Sekaria.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli, Mushi, and Jaaziah.
translation_verse: Merari náwɔ Mali ku Musi ku Yaasia.

english_verse: Jaaziah had three sons: Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
translation_verse: Yaasia ɔ́wɔ bebi ɛtɛ na ama ndi Soam ku Sakur ku Ibri.

english_verse: Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish. Eleazar had no sons, but Kish was the father of Jerahmeel.
translation_verse: Mali ɔ́wɔ Eleasa ku Kis na Eleasa útawɔ, nsu Kis ɔ́wɔ Yerameel.

english_verse: Mushi had three sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the descendants of Levi, according to their clans.
translation_verse: Musi ɔ́wɔ bebi ɛtɛ na ama ndi Mali ku Ede ku Yerimot. Bamɛni ndi Lewiƒuɔ kaba kemmo bebi anyi na banana adua kenye.

english_verse: Each one was assigned his duties in the same way that their relatives the priests had been assigned their duties. David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites were the witnesses.
translation_verse: Na bana ƒui ɔdi biala ɔ́ƒɔ nwuna kabla kani na béte-nwu aani kalɛ na béle bana banwani bakpane bammɔ kabla béte-ma. Na Dawid ku Sadok ku Ahimelek ku atɔƒi benengu bammɔ nénye bánu kabla bule ala ammɔ lɛlɔ aani bamanyene kalɛ.

english_verse: David and the temple officials chose the descendants of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to be in charge of music. They were to praise the Lord by playing cymbals, harps and other stringed instruments. Here is a list of the musicians and their duties:
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Dawid ku kakpakɔ benengu bammɔ báƒuna Asaƒ ku Heman ku Yedutum kaba kemmo bebi ka benye lɛnu ku agyala ala kenye. Na ama ndubo Unwoti buteemwi ku bana agyala ani ndi enukpɛ agyala ku lɛbentaa lidu ƒui. Na lɛnu bɔtu ku bagyane bammɔ anyi ndubo mɛni ku bana kabla lidu.

english_verse: Asaph's four sons, Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah, were under the direction of their father and played music whenever the king told them to.
translation_verse: Asaƒ ku nwuna bebi ine bani ndi Sakur ku Yoseƒ ku Netania ku Asarela ni, bakya bana ɔti kalɔ na beedie agya uwi biala na Unwoti wasu-ma ɔnii bagya.

english_verse: Heman was one of the king's prophets, and God honored Heman by giving him
translation_verse: Na Heman ɔmɛni ɔdi ɔga kenye bediene akɔ unwi. Katɔti ɔ́kɔliku-nwu katɔ geen na uwi ɔni na ɔ́ya na ɔ́wɔ bebi bananabi leevu-ine ku belekubi ɛtɛ ɔsu.

english_verse: His sons were under his direction and played cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments during times of worship at the temple. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman took their orders directly from the king.
translation_verse: Anwu lɛnɔ nwuna bebi bákya-nwu kalɔ na baagyá lɛbentaa ku enukpɛ agyala ku lɛbentaa lidu bamba na kakpakɔ si uwi ɔni na baabla lɛkpa. Anwuɔsu Asaƒ ku Yedutun ku Heman ƒui ni, bákya ɔga ɔmmɔ kalɔ na anwu muudie lɛdi teete-ma.

english_verse: David assigned them their duties by asking the Lord what he wanted. Everyone was responsible for something, whether young or old, teacher or student.
translation_verse: Na bani ƒui na Dawid úle kabla úte mmɔ na badi banamu iye benengu iye batinane iye batɛyane ni, ɔ́ka Unwoti buye bunu lɛla lɛni na ɔɔwia asa na úte-ma bana kabla.

english_verse: Elam, Jehohanan, and Eliehoenai.
translation_verse: Elam ku Yehohanan ku Eliehienai.

english_verse: Obed-Edom had been blessed with eight sons: Shemaiah, Jehozabad, Joah, Sachar, Nethanel, Ammiel, Issachar, and Peullethai.
translation_verse: Kusɛ kusɛ ɔ́siaku Obed-Edom na ɔ́wɔ bebi maane. Na ama ndi Semaia ku Yehosabad ku Yoa ku Saka ku Netanel ku Amiel ku Isakar ku Peuletai.

english_verse: Shemaiah was the father of Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu, and Semachiah. They were all respected leaders in their clan.
translation_verse: Semaia náwɔ Otni ku Reƒael ku Obed ku Elsabad. Na Elihu ku Semakia bani ndi Semaia lɛlɔ bekyuli ni, bana ƒui badi atɔƒi benengu bani na baabu geen na bana kɔdua.

english_verse: Eighteen descendants of Meshelemiah were chosen for this work.
translation_verse: Na Meselemia kaba kemmo bebi bɔdi nkyuli leevu-maane. Na badi bekyuli bani mbo ɔlɔkplu.

english_verse: Hosah, from the Merari clan, was the father of Shimri, Hilkiah, Tebaliah, and Zechariah. Hosah had made Shimri the family leader, even though he was not the oldest son. Thirteen men from Hosah's family were chosen to be temple guards.
translation_verse: Na Hosa ɔni nási Merari kɔdua kemmo ni, anwu náwɔ Simri ku Hilkia ku Tebalia ku Sekaria. Hosa úti Simri ɔ́bla lɛtɔƒi unengu ina ka ɔɔɔdi anwu ndi ubi unengudi ƒui. Na nkyuli leevu-ɛtɛ na báƒuna básiku Hosa ɔtɔ kemmo ka babla bagyumanane kabla na kakpakɔ kemmo.

english_verse: The guards were divided into groups, according to their family leaders, and they were assigned duties at the temple, just like the other Levites.
translation_verse: Na bagyumanane bamɛni ni, béle-ma esu esu na bana atɔƒi benengu kenye na béte-ma kabla na kakpakɔ aani Lewiƒuɔ bakladi kalɛ.

english_verse: Shelemiah was chosen to guard the East Gate. Zechariah his son was a wise man and was chosen to guard the North Gate.
translation_verse: Maselemia na báƒuna ka utaagyumana kayakun kani nísie ɔƒɛ katukɔ. Na ubidi Sekaria ni, ɔdi ɔnundane geen, anwuɔsu anwu na báƒuna ka ɔgyumana kayakun kani nkya késie katɔ kakɛ.

english_verse: Obed-Edom was then chosen to guard the South Gate, and his sons were chosen to guard the storerooms.
translation_verse: Na Obed-Edom na báƒuna ka ɔgyumana kayakun kani nésie kada kakɛ na báƒuna nwuna bebi ka bataagyumana ala kesekɔ.

english_verse: Shuppim and Hosah were chosen to guard the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the upper road. The guards were assigned the following work schedule:
translation_verse: Ɔ́ƒɛni ɔban kayakun kani nésie ɔƒɛ kanukɔ ku ɔban kayakun kani na baalɔ banii Saleket ɔban kayakun na kakya ulu ɔtɔdi kenye ni, Supim ku Hosa na báƒuna ka bataagyumana mmɔ. Na ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na béteeti taagyumana na bɔdubo bunu mɛni.

english_verse: Each day six guards were on duty on the east side of the temple, four were on duty on the north side, and four were on duty on the south side. Two guards were stationed at each of the two storerooms,
translation_verse: Limeyi ndi limeyi ni, bagyumanane ɛku beenye kakpakɔ kammɔ ɔƒɛ katukɔ na ine beenye katɔ kakɛ na ine beenye kada kakɛ na ala kusekɔ inyɔ bɔni na nkya kakpakɔ mmɔ ni, bagyumanane inyɔ inyɔ muunye mmɔ taagyumana.

english_verse: four were stationed along the road leading to the west courtyard, and two guards stayed in the court itself.
translation_verse: Na ulu ɔni ntɛ úsela kakpakɔ kaduli kani nkya ɔƒɛ kanukɔ ni, bagyumanane ine muunye ulu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na inyɔ bamba baakya kaduli kemmo geen.

english_verse: These were the guard duties assigned to the men from the clans of Korah and Merari. Guards Are Assigned to the Treasury
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ ndi bagyumanane kabla kani na bákya Kora ku Merari kɔdua banana enu kemmo. Báƒuna Egulabi Kesekɔ Bagyumanane

english_verse: The Levites who were relatives of the Korahites and the Merarites were in charge of guarding the temple treasury and the gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Amu na báƒuna bana lɛlɔ bekyuli bani ndi Lewiƒuɔ bamba ka bataanu kakpakɔ kammɔ egulabi kesekɔ lɛlɔ ku etela ani bédie bése sɛsɛɛ béte Katɔti mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Ladan was from the Gershon clan and was the father of Jehieli. Many of his other descendants were family leaders in the clan.
translation_verse: Na Ladan ɔ́si Gerson kɔdua kemmo na anwu náwɔ Yehieli. Na nwuna kaba bebi pii badi atɔƒi benengu na kɔdua kɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Jehieli was the father of Zetham and Joel, and they were responsible for guarding the treasury.
translation_verse: Na Yehieli ɔmɛni náwɔ Setam ku Yoel na ama mɔɔgyumana egulabi kesekɔ kammɔ.

english_verse: Other guards at the treasury were from the Kohathite clans of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamba bani lɛnɔ mɔɔgyumana kakpakɔ egulabi kesekɔ kammɔ bási Kohat adua ani ndi Amram ku Isehar ku Hebron ku Usiel kemmo.

english_verse: Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom the son of Moses. He was the chief official in charge of the temple treasury.
translation_verse: Sebuel ɔdi Gersom kaba kemmo ukyuli. Na Mose náwɔ Gersom. Na Sebuel ɔmɛni ndi kakpakɔ egulabi kesekɔ bagyumanane ƒui unengu.

english_verse: The descendants of Gershom's brother Eliezer included Rehabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zichri, and Shelomoth.
translation_verse: Na Gersom ɔnwani Eliese bawɔ badi ndi Rehabia ku Yesaia ku Yoram ku Sikri ku Selomot.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the gifts that were dedicated to the Lord. These included the gifts that King David had dedicated, as well as those dedicated by the family leaders, army officers, and army commanders.
translation_verse: Selomot ɔmɛni ku nwuna lɛlɔ bekyuli mɔɔnu etela ani na bédie sɛsɛɛ béte Unwoti mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na ala amɛni adanku Ɔga Dawid ku atɔƒi benengu ku bekpone benengu ku bekpone kenye benyene etela ani bédie bése sɛsɛɛ béte Unwoti.

english_verse: And whenever valuable things were captured in battle, these men brought back some of them to make repairs to the temple.
translation_verse: Na si béƒie ala ani na áƒɔ kuye adi na kekpokɔ ni, bekyuli bamɛni beeti ana adi teeboku kakpakɔ.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were responsible for any gifts that had been given to the temple, including those from Samuel the prophet, King Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah. Other Officers Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Na etela biala na béti béboku kakpakɔ mmɔ ni, Selomot ku nwuna lɛlɔ bekyuli bammɔ mɔɔnu-nya lɛlɔ. Na ala amɛni adanku ani na ási Kenye Udiene Samuel uwi ku Ɔga Saul ɔni ndi Kis ubidi ku Ner ubidi Abner ku Seruia ubidi Yoab adi ƒui. Béti Kabla Bákya Benengu Bamba Kɔnu

english_verse: Chenaniah from the Izhar clan and his sons were government officials and judges. They did not work at the temple.
translation_verse: Kenania ɔni na ɔ́si Isehar kɔdua ku nwuna banwani ndi aban benengu ku litemi batɛne na ama balábla kabla na kakpakɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Each month a group of
translation_verse: Kɔbuli biala kemmo ni, kasala bekyuli mpim aavlanyɔ-ine (

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah had begun to count the people, but he stopped when the Lord began punishing Israel. So the total number was never included in David's official records. Officials in Charge of the King's Property
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Seruia ubidi Yoab úse kalɔ ku bekyuli bammɔ bɔka, nsu uwi ɔni na Unwoti úse kalɔ ɔɔní Israelƒuɔ kɔtu ni, ɔ́da-ma bɔka ɔ́ya. Na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, bétenweni bekyuli bammɔ bumomo geen bátakya Dawid ala alɛdi ɔku unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo. Báƒuna Benengu Bani Mɔɔnu Ɔga Ala Lɛlɔ

english_verse: men served as soldiers in Israel's army. These men, which included the family leaders, army commanders, and officials of the king, were under the command of the following men, arranged by the month of their service:
translation_verse: ) mɔɔbla bekpone kabla na Israel bekpone lisu lɛmmɔ kemmo. Kasala lisu lɛmɛni lɛdi atɔƒi benengu ku kekpo kenye benyene ku ɔga ɔmmɔ benengu. Na béle abuli kabla béte ɔga benengu bammɔ na kasala lisu lɛmmɔ baabla kabla na bana kalɔ.

english_verse: In the first month, Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu kɔbuli kudeedi kemmo ni, Yasobeam ɔni ndi Sabdiel ubidi kalɔ na lisu lideedi lɛmmɔ bekyuli baabla kabla.

english_verse: a descendant of Perez;
translation_verse: Na ɔnana ɔmɛni ɔdi Peres kaba kemmo ubi.

english_verse: in the second month, Dodai the Ahohite, whose assistant was Mikloth;
translation_verse: Na kɔbuli kunyɔdi kemmo ni, Dodai ɔni ndi Ahohini na nwuna ubunkune ndi Miklot kalɔ na lisu bamba baabla kabla.

english_verse: in the third month, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada the priest,
translation_verse: Na kɔbuli kɔtɛdi kemmo ni, ɔkpane Yehoada ubidi Benaia kalɔ na lisu bamba baabla kabla.

english_verse: who was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and whose son Ammizabad was also an army commander;
translation_verse: Na anwu ndi bekpone benengu avlaatɛ ɔtɔnkune na ubidi Amisabad lɛnɔ ɔdi bekpone ɔtɔnkune.

english_verse: in the fourth month, Asahel the brother of Joab, whose son Zebadiah took over command after him;
translation_verse: Na kɔbuli kunedi kemmo ni, Yoab ɔnwani Asahel kalɔ na lisu bamba baabla kabla. Na kama ƒui ni, ubidi ɔni baalɔ Sebadia nébo úbenye-nwu kenye na ɔɔtɔnku bekpone lisu lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: in the fifth month, Shamhuth from the Izrah clan;
translation_verse: Na kɔbuli kɔlɔndi kemmo ni, Samhut ɔni nási Isra kɔdua kemmo kalɔ na lisu bamba baabla kabla.

english_verse: in the sixth month, Ira the son of Ikkesh from Tekoa;
translation_verse: Na kɔbuli kɔkundi kemmo ni, Tekoani ɔni baalɔ Ikes ubidi Ira kalɔ na lisu bamba baabla kabla.

english_verse: in the seventh month, Helez from Pelon in the territory of Ephraim;
translation_verse: Na kɔbuli maatɛdi kemmo ni, Heles ɔni nási Pelon na Eƒraim kalɛkɛ mmɔ kalɔ na lisu bamba baabla kabla.

english_verse: in the eighth month, Sibbecai from Hushah of the Zerah clan;
translation_verse: Na kɔbuli maanedi kemmo ni, Husani ɔni ndi Sebekai na ɔ́si Sera kɔdua kemmo ni, nwuna kalɔ na lisu bamba baabla kabla.

english_verse: in the ninth month, Abiezer from Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin;
translation_verse: Na kɔbuli yaalenwidi ni, Abieser ɔni nási Anatot na Benyamin kalɛkɛ kemmo ni, nwuna kalɔ na lisu bamba baabla kabla.

english_verse: in the tenth month, Maharai from Netophah of the Zerah clan;
translation_verse: Na kɔbuli leevudi kemmo ni, Maharai ɔni nási Netoƒa na badi Sera kɔdua bekyuli ni, bana kalɔ na lisu bamba baabla kabla.

english_verse: in the eleventh month, Benaiah from Pirathon in the territory of Ephraim;
translation_verse: Na kɔbuli leevu-kunwidi kemmo ni, Benaia ɔni nási Piraton na Eƒraim kalɛkɛ kemmo ni, nwuna kalɔ na lisu bamba baabla kabla.

english_verse: in the twelfth month, Heldai from Netophah, who was a descendant of Othniel. David Assigns Tribal Leaders
translation_verse: Na kɔbuli leevu-kunyɔdi kemmo ni, Heldai ɔni nási Netoƒa na ɔdi Otniel kaba kemmo ubi ni, nwuna kalɔ na lisu lɛmmɔ baabla kabla. Dawid Úse Adua Benengu

english_verse: Here is a list of the leaders of each tribe in Israel: Eliezer son of Zichri was over Reuben; Shephatiah son of Maacah was over Simeon; Hashabiah son of Kemuel was over the Levites, and Zadok the priest was over the descendants of Aaron; Elihu the brother of David was over Judah; Omri son of Michael was over Issachar; Ishmaiah son of Obadiah was over Zebulun; Jerimoth son of Azriel was over Naphtali; Hoshea son of Azaziah was over Ephraim; Joel son of Pedaiah was over West Manasseh; Iddo son of Zechariah was over East Manasseh; Jaasiel son of Abner was over Benjamin; Azarel son of Jeroham was over Dan.
translation_verse: Anyi ani na bɔdubo bunu mɛni ndi Israel adua ammɔ batɔnkune. Sikri ubidi Eliese anwu mɔɔtɔnku Ruben kɔdua bekyuli. Na Seƒatia ɔni ndi Maaka ubidi mɔɔtɔnku Simeon kɔdua bekyuli. Na Hasabia ɔni ndi Kemuel ubidi mɔɔtɔnku Lewiƒuɔ kɔdua. Na Sadok mɔɔtɔnku Aaron kɔdua bekyuli. Na Elihu ɔni ndi Dawid ɔnwani mɔɔtɔnku Yuda kɔdua bekyuli. Na Omri ɔni ndi Mikael ubidi mɔɔtɔnku Isakar kɔdua bekyuli. Na Ismaia ɔni ndi Obadia ubidi mɔɔtɔnku Sebulon kɔdua bekyuli. Na Yerumot Asriel ubidi mɔɔtɔnku Naƒtali. Na Hosea ɔni ndi Asasia ubidi mɔɔtɔnku Eƒraim kɔdua bekyuli. Na Yoel ɔni ndi Pedaia ubidi mɔɔtɔnku Manase kɔdua bekyuli bani nkya bésie ɔƒɛ kanukɔ kakɛ. Na Ido ɔni ndi Sekaria ubidi mɔɔtɔnku Manase kɔdua bekyuli bani nésie ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ. Na Yaasiel ɔni ndi Abner ubidi mɔɔtɔnku Benyamin kɔdua bekyuli. Na Asarel ɔni ndi Yeroham ubidi ni, anwu mɔɔtɔnku Dan kɔdua bekyuli.

english_verse: Azmaveth the son of Adiel was in charge of the king's personal storage rooms. Jonathan the son of Uzziah was in charge of the king's other storerooms that were in the towns, the villages, and the defense towers in Israel.
translation_verse: Adiel ubidi Asmavet na báƒuna na ɔɔnu ala kesekɔ kani na kadi ɔga ɔmmɔ alati kadi geen lɛlɔ. Na Yonatan ɔni ndi Usia ubidi na báƒuna ka utaanu ɔga ala kusekɔ bamba kɔni na kɔkya lɛma ku akpaklɔ bamba ku kɔgyumanakɔ kɔni na kɔkya Israel ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Ezri the son of Chelub was in charge of the workers who farmed the king's land.
translation_verse: Na Esri ɔni ndi Kelub ubidi mɔɔnu kabla bablane bani mɔɔtuma na ɔga kalɔ lɛlɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Shimei from Ramah was in charge of the vineyards, and Zabdi from Shepham was in charge of storing the wine.
translation_verse: Na Simei ɔni nádi Rama mɔɔnu egyiibi mmo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na Sabdi ɔni nási Seƒam mɔɔklibi ntɛ bɔni na beedie taasiku mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Baal Hanan from Geder was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the western foothills, and Joash was in charge of storing the olive oil.
translation_verse: Na Baal Hanan ɔni nási Geder mɔɔnu nnɔ egyii ku egyii bamba ani na akya abi kaƒɔna na ɔƒɛ kanukɔ kakɛ mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na Yoas mɔɔklibi nnɔ bɔni na bédie básiku mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Shitrai from Sharon was responsible for the cattle that were kept in Sharon Plain, and Shaphat son of Adlai was responsible for those kept in the valleys.
translation_verse: Sitrai ɔni nási Saron mɔɔnu ɔmantɛ bakɔ bani mɔɔdi na Saron ketele kemmo mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na Saƒat ɔni ndi Adlai ubidi mɔɔnu bebuo bani na bakya ɔkwalɛ kemmo mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels, Jehdeiah from Meronoth was in charge of the donkeys, and Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the sheep and goats.
translation_verse: Na Obil ɔni ndi Ismael kaba kemmo ubi mmɔ mɔɔnu bebuo ala betine bani mbo keƒu mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na Yedeia ɔni nási Meronot mɔɔnu bebuo ala betine bebliidi lɛlɔ. Na Yasis ɔni ndi Hagritni mɔɔnu baƒonu ku bese lɛlɔ.

english_verse: These were the men in charge of David's royal property. David's Personal Advisors
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bammɔ ndi bekyuli bani mɔɔnu Dawid lɛgadi ala ani na ubo lɛlɔ. Dawid Ɔ́ƒuna Nwuna Kasusu Bakyane

english_verse: David's uncle Jonathan was a wise and intelligent advisor. He and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni taught David's sons.
translation_verse: Dawid ɔnwani ubidi ɔni ndi Yonatan ɔdi ɔnundane geen na nwuna lɛlati ɔsu uute Dawid kasusu geen. Na Yehiel ɔni ndi Hakmoni ubidi nátaatina Dawid bebi bananabi ala.

english_verse: Ahithophel and Hushai the Archite were two of David's advisors.
translation_verse: Na Ahitoƒel ku Husai ɔni ndi Arkini lɛnɔ badi nwuna kasusu bakyane akɔ inyɔ badi.

english_verse: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah was the king's advisor after Ahithophel, and later, Abiathar was his advisor. Joab was commander of Israel's army.
translation_verse: Yehoiada ɔni ndi Benaia ubidi nsia Ahitoƒel kama aani Dawid kasusu ɔkyane. Kama asa na Abiatar lɛnɔ úbenwini nwuna kasusu ɔkyane. Na Yoab nádi nwuna bekpone ɔtɔnkune.

english_verse: David called a meeting in Jerusalem for all of Israel's leaders, including the tribal leaders, the government officials, the army commanders, the officials in charge of the royal property and livestock, the palace officials, and the brave warriors.
translation_verse: Dawid ɔ́lɔ kelisa kadi na Yerusalem. Na Israel benengu ku adua benengu ku aban bagadine benengu ku bekpone batɔnkune ku benengu bani mɔɔnu lɛga kadikɔ ala ammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ ku bani mɔɔnu bebuo lidu ƒui lɛlɔ ku lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ lɛku batine ku bekpone bani na bebo ogya geen na bébo.

english_verse: After everyone was there, David stood up and said: Listen to me, my people. I wanted to build a place where the sacred chest would be kept, so we could go there and worship the Lord our God. I have prepared all the supplies for building a temple,
translation_verse: Amu Dawid ɔ́ta únye na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Mina kadi bekyuli, bise atu na binu, lɛ́wia ka lɛtu kesii kani na bɔdubuti Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ buse na buteesie mmɔ lɛnɔ taatákpa Unwoti bula Katɔti. Na lɛ́ɛklibi ala ani na nka ndubuti lɛtu kakpakɔ kammɔ líse.

english_verse: but the Lord has refused to let me build it, because he said I have killed too many people in battle.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti úni na útete-mi kuƒi ka ami lɛtu ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ lite-nwu, ɔsika ɔ́su ɔnii lɛ́ɛdu bekyuli pii na kekpokɔ lɛ́gya.

english_verse: The Lord God chose Judah to be the leading tribe in Israel. Then from Judah, he chose my father's family, and from that family, he chose me to be the king of Israel, and he promised that my descendants will also rule as kings.
translation_verse: “Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna Yuda ka nwuna kɔdua kɔbla lili na Israel ƒui. Na ɔ́si Yuda ɔmmɔ kemmo na ɔ́ƒuna mina ɔti kaduli. Na mmɔ na ɔ́ƒuna-mi ka linwini Israel ɔga. Na úse kenye lɛnɔ ka mina kaba kemmo bebi badubo lɛlɔ butaadi aani baga kalɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed me with many sons, but he chose my son Solomon to be the next king of Israel.
translation_verse: Unwoti kusɛ kusɛ ɔ́siaku-mi na lɛ́wɔ bebi pii. Nsu Salomo na ɔ́ƒuna ka ɔdi lɛga na Israel na mina kama.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Your son Solomon will build my temple, and it will honor me. Solomon will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, ‘Ƒula ubi Salomo ndubo mina kakpakɔ bɔtu buti bute-mi ɔbu. Na Salomo ɔdubɔbla mina ubi na ami lɛbla nwuna ɔti.

english_verse: If he continues to obey my laws and commands, his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: Na si útenwini kama útakya-mi na ɔsiaku-mi kama siin ɔɔdi mina litemi lɛlɔ ni, nwuna lɛga kadikɔ kaaadubo bɔsa bɔyii udu kudii.’

english_verse: My friends, you are the Lord's people. And now, with God as your witness, I want you to promise that you will do your best to obey everything the Lord God has commanded us. Then this land will always belong to you and your descendants.
translation_verse: “Mina banwa, amii ndi Unwoti bekyuli. Na uwi ɔni na Katɔti ulie-bu akɔ aani bina ɔmanyene kalɛ ni, mɔɔwia ka bise kenye ka bɛdubɔsia ulu biala lɛlɔ na bɛsiaku-nwu kama siin na bɛdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ. Na biti kalɔ kamɛni binwini amii ku bina kaba kemmo bebi kadi na bilie mmɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Solomon, my son, worship God and obey him with all your heart and mind, just as I have done. He knows all your thoughts and your reasons for doing things, and so if you turn to him, he will hear your prayers. But if you ignore him, he will reject you forever.
translation_verse: “Mina ubi Salomo, mɔɔsu-ɔ kpakplaa ka kya Unwoti lili kalɔ uwi biala na asiaku-nwu kama siin na adi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ ku ƒula kayi ku kasusu ƒui aani kalɛ na lɛ́bla. Ɔgyi ƒula lili kemmo kasusu ku kakali biala na ada aabla ala. Anwuɔsu si énwini ésie-nwu kudɔ ku kayi ƒui ni, ɔdubunu ƒula buvele. Nsu si énwini kama ákya-nwu ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔdubuni-ɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen you to build a temple for worshiping him. Be confident and do the work you have been assigned.
translation_verse: Awɔ na Unwoti ɔ́ƒuna ka atu kakpakɔ na bekyuli bataakpa-nwu. Nye kpakplaa na abla kabla kani na bákya-a kɔnu.”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, he gave Solomon the plans for building the main rooms of the temple, including the porch, the storerooms, the rooms upstairs and downstairs, as well as the most holy place.
translation_verse: Amu ka Dawid ɔ́tɛmi ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, úti kakpakɔ bɔtaa bɔmmɔ úte Salomo. Na ɔdanku kakpakɔ lɛtɔ geen lɛmmɔ ku kakpakɔ lɛgbanya ku ala kesekɔ ku kalɔ lɛtɔ ku katu taasia lɛtɔ ku katɔma kedee kammɔ ku likpidi kɔtu bɔni budie akpala kablakɔ.

english_verse: He gave Solomon his plans for the courtyards and the open areas around the temple, and for the rooms to store the temple treasures and gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Na Dawid úti kakpakɔ kaduli kammɔ bɔtaa lɛnɔ úte Salomo na kadanku kalɔ ƒia kani na kewi kámana kakpakɔ kammɔ ku lɛtɔ lɛni kemmo na badubuse kakpakɔ egulabi ku ala ani náƒɔ kuye mmɔ ku etela ani bédie bése sɛsɛɛ béte Katɔti.

english_verse: David also gave Solomon his plans for dividing the priests and the Levites into groups, as well as for the work that needed to be done at the temple and for taking care of the objects used for worship.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Dawidi úti ulu ɔni na ɔdubuti ule bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ ɔkya kasala esu esu kemmo ku kabla kani lɛnɔ na ɔdi ka babla na kakpakɔ kammɔ kemmo ku kalɛ na bada ala ani na beeti taabla lɛkpa lɛlɔ kabla mmɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: He told Solomon how much gold and silver was to be used in making the sacred objects,
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su Salomo sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi bumomo bɔni na badubuti babla akpala lɛlɔ ala kedee ammɔ.

english_verse: including the lampstands and lamps,
translation_verse: Na adanku lɛsogya ku lɛsogya lɛmmɔ kasiakɔ ƒui lɛnɔ.

english_verse: the gold table which held the sacred loaves of bread, the tables made of silver,
translation_verse: Na abambadi ndi sika ugyiedi ala kasiakɔ ɔni lɛlɔ na baasia bodobodo kedee ɔmmɔ ku sika ɔƒualadi ala kasiakɔ

english_verse: the meat forks, the bowls and cups,
translation_verse: ku kɔvili kɔni na baatu lɛna ku akyami ku lɛɛƒɛɛ

english_verse: the gold incense altar, and the gold statue of a chariot for the winged creatures which were on the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: ku sika ugyiedi lɛbi lɛni lɛlɔ na baasia oloƒui taakyula ku sika ugyiedi kɛɛkɛ ɔni bávɔ na bebweyi bani na bebo avwi na baalɔ-ma Kerub mmɔ benye-nwu lɛlɔ na anwu ndi kebila kani mbi Bunyimi Adaka kedee ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: David then said to Solomon: The Lord showed me how his temple is to be built.
translation_verse: Amu na Dawid ɔ́su Salomo ɔnini, “Unwoti údie ɔ́tina-mi kalɛ na ɔɔwia ka batu nwuna kakpakɔ kammɔ.

english_verse: But you must see that everything is done according to these plans. Be confident, and never be afraid of anything or get discouraged. The Lord my God will help you do everything needed to finish the temple, so it can be used for worshiping him.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu sia anu na akya kayi na abla lɛla biala aani kalɛ na bɔtaa bɔmɛni bɔɔtina. Na tayia na enu lɛnɔ ataƒɛ-ɔ, ɔsika Unwoti mina Katɔti ɔdubo-ɔ bubunku na abla lɛla biala lɛni na ɔdi ka abla na eti awɔlɔ kakpakɔ kammɔ bɔtu kalɛ na bekyuli beteesie mmɔ taatákpa-nwu.

english_verse: The priests and Levites have been assigned their duties, and all the skilled workers are prepared to do their work. The people and their leaders will do anything you tell them.
translation_verse: Bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ ƒui béete-ma bana kabla na kabla bablane bani na bagyi bana kabla lɛlɔ ala kaduɛ mmɔ ƒui benye kagyumana bete bana kabla na bekyuli bammɔ ku bana batɔnkune ƒui badubɔbla lɛla biala na básu-ma.”

english_verse: That's why I have done my best to get everything Solomon will need to build it—gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, onyx, turquoise, colored gems, all kinds of precious stones, and marble.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na lɛ́sia ulu biala lɛlɔ na lɛ́wia atula ani na Salomo ɔdubuti ɔtu ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ líse. Na anya ndi sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ku abuala egyiedi ku ligyii ku asɛɛ ebi ani muukeye na áƒɔ kuye geen ku asogya ku atabi lidu lɛni náƒɔ kuye na liikeye ku atabi kpakplaa ku akunkpa lidu.

english_verse: and to make the gold and silver objects. Now, who else will show their dedication to the Lord by giving gifts for building his temple?
translation_verse: Na badubuti ɔdi babla ala ani na badubuti bataabla lɛkpa lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ala lɛnɔ. Na muuye-mi si ukyuli bamba ɔdi lɛnɔ ɔkya bina akɔ na anwu lɛnɔ ɔdubudie nwuna ala adi use sɛsɛɛ ute Unwoti na beti bebunku kakpakɔ kamɛni bɔtu?”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, the family leaders, the tribal leaders, the army commanders, and the government officials voluntarily gave gifts
translation_verse: Amu ka Dawid ɔ́wɔlɔ bɔtɛmi ni, atɔƒi benengu bammɔ ku baduɔti ku bekpone benengu ku aban bagadine benengu bammɔ ƒui béte ala ku kaƒɔ ƒaa.

english_verse: Everyone who owned precious stones also donated them to the temple treasury, where Jehiel from the Levite clan of Gershon guarded them.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni na ubo atabi ani na áƒɔ kuye mmɔ ni, úte adi na béti bákya kakpakɔ egulabi ku ala ani na áƒɔ kuye mmɔ kesekɔ na Yehiel ɔni nási Gerson kaba kemmo na Lewi kɔdua kemmo mmɔ ɔɔnu-nya lɛlɔ.

english_verse: David and the people were very happy that so much had been given to the Lord, and they all celebrated. David Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Na béte ala pii geen na lɛlɔ lɛ́yɔ-ma ku ebiti geen. Dawid Úmwi Unwoti

english_verse: Then, in front of everyone, David sang praises to the Lord: I praise you forever, Lord! You are the God our ancestor Jacob worshiped.
translation_verse: Amu na Dawid údie ɔnu na úmwi Unwoti na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui anumi na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Mina Unwoti, muumwi-ɔ uwi ƒui! Ɔsika awɔ ndi Katɔti ɔni na nana ati Yakob ɔ́kpa.

english_verse: Your power is great, and your glory is seen everywhere in heaven and on earth. You are king of the entire world,
translation_verse: Ebo ɔyikun bonwu geen na bekyuli baanu kalɛ na eekeye na kesii biala na katɔ mmɔ ku kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni ƒui. Awɔ ndi kayawi kammɔ ƒui ɔga.

english_verse: and you rule with strength and power. You make people rich and powerful and famous.
translation_verse: Enye ƒula kenyekɔ na aadi lɛlɔ ku ɔyikun. Awɔ mɔɔyá na bekyuli beenwíni balakɛne ku bayikune na baaƒɔ́ lɛnyi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: We thank you, our God, and praise you.
translation_verse: “Bɔɔgyá-a enu, bula Katɔti, na buumwi-ɔ.

english_verse: But why should we be happy that we have given you these gifts? They belong to you, and we have only given back what is already yours.
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka butaakɛ ebiti ka búti ala amɛni búboku-ɔ ɔsu? Awɔ adi na adi na ƒula ala kani na bɔ́sɔku búboku-ɔ.

english_verse: We are only foreigners living here on earth for a while, just as our ancestors were. And we will soon be gone, like a shadow that suddenly disappears.
translation_verse: Baƒɔ na bɔdi na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ na uwi klukwii ɔdi kani na bɔdubo mɛni bulie aani bula bati kuuku kalɛ. Ɔmmɔ kama bɔdubo bɔyii bɔkya aani kalɛ na lɛla lɛdi ɔyuli ɔɔyii taakya.

english_verse: Our Lord God, we have brought all these things for building a temple to honor you. They belong to you, and you gave them to us.
translation_verse: “Bula Unwoti Katɔti, buti na búti ala amɛni búboku na beti batu ƒula kakpakɔ na buti bute-ɔ ɔbu. Awɔ adi na adi na éti éte-bu.

english_verse: But we are happy, because everyone has voluntarily given you these things. You know what is in everyone's heart, and you are pleased when people are honest.
translation_verse: Nsu lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-bu, ɔsika ukyuli biala úti ala ammɔ úboku-ɔ ku kaƒɔ ƒaa. Agyi lɛla biala na lɛkya ɔdi biala kayi kemmo na ɔɔyɔ́-ɔ kaƒɔ si ukyuli ɔdi biala ɔɔdi litemi lɛlɔ siin teete-ɔ.

english_verse: Always make us eager to give, and help us be faithful to you, just as our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob faithfully worshiped you.
translation_verse: “Ya na utaada-bu kubiti uwi biala ka buteeboku-ɔ ala. Na ebunku-bu na bɔkana na bɔsiaku-ɔ kama siin butaadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na bula bati kuuku Abraham ku Isak ku Yakob bákpa-a.

english_verse: And give Solomon the desire to completely obey your laws and teachings, and the desire to build the temple for which I have provided these gifts.
translation_verse: Na aya na Salomo utaayɔ-ɔ na ɔdi ƒula etemila ku ƒula ala bɔtina ƒui lɛlɔ siin. Na ƒula kakpakɔ kamɛni bɔtu bɔyɔ bɔda-nwu kayi kpakplaa ɔni ɔsu na líti ala amɛni muute-nwu.”

english_verse: David then said to the people, “Now it's your turn to praise the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped!” So everyone praised the Lord, and they bowed down to honor him and David their king. Solomon Is Crowned King
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Dawid ɔ́su bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini, “Ɔƒaani bina uwi údu ka bimwi Unwoti Katɔti ɔni na bula bati kuuku bákpa!” Anwuɔsu ukyuli biala úse kalɔ na bana ƒui beemwi Unwoti na béboku lɛlɔ kalɔ béte Unwoti ku ɔga ɔmmɔ. Bése Salomo Lɛga Na Bébi-nwu Kagabwa

english_verse: The people were very happy, and they ate and drank there at the Lord's altar. That same day, Solomon was again crowned king. The people celebrated and poured olive oil on Solomon's head to show that he would be their next king. They also poured oil on Zadok's head to show that he was their priest.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ bákɛ ebiti geen na bádi na báni na Unwoti lɛkpabi kudɔ mmɔ. Amu na limeyi lɛmmɔ kani lɛlɔ ni, bése Salomo lɛga na bébi-nwu kagabwa. Bádi limeyi ku lɛlɔyɔ na béti nnɔmii béwi Salomo lili béti bátina ka anwu ndubɔdi lɛga na ɔti kenye. Na Sadok lɛnɔ béwi-nwu nnɔmii lili bátina ka anwu ndi bana ɔkpane.

english_verse: So Solomon became king after David his father. Solomon was successful, and everyone in Israel obeyed him.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Salomo úbenwini ɔga na úlie ɔti Dawid kenye. Ala átɛku Salomo na ukyuli biala na Israel mmɔ únu-nwu litemi na ɔ́di-ni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Every official and every soldier, as well as all of David's other sons, were loyal to him.
translation_verse: Lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ benengu ku bekpone bammɔ ku Dawid bebi bakladi ƒui bénu-nwu litemi na ɔdi útalɛ-nwu kama.

english_verse: The Lord made Solomon a great king, and the whole nation was amazed at how famous he was. In fact, no other king of Israel was as great as Solomon. David Dies
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔ́bla Salomo na únwini ɔga ɔyikune geen na ɔ́bla kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli ƒui kalɛ kadi na kalɛ na ɔ́ƒɔ lɛnyi lɛni ɔsu. Na geen ni, ɔga ɔdi ɔ́sɔ útaƒɔ lɛnyi na ɔkɛ ɔyikun ɔmmɔ udu na Israel ƒui kudii lɛnɔ. Dawid Úkpi

english_verse: David the son of Jesse was king of Israel
translation_verse: Yese ubidi Dawidi ɔ́di lɛga na Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: David was rich and respected and lived to be an old man. Then he died, and his son Solomon became king.
translation_verse: Dawid únwini ɔlakɛne ɔni na bekyuli baabu-nwu geen na úlie ɔ́bi lɛlɔ geen asa na úkpi. Na ɔmmɔ kama béti ubidi Salomo bése lɛga na nwuna kenye.

english_verse: Everything David did while he was king is included in the history written by the prophets Samuel, Nathan, and Gad.
translation_verse: Na lɛla biala na Dawid ɔ́bla uwi ɔni na ɔdi ɔga ni, kenye bediene Samuel ku Natan ku Gad bénweni-nya bákya kasikɔ etemila ku ala alɛdi ɔku kemmo.

english_verse: They wrote about his powerful rule and about the things that happened not only to him, but also to Israel and the other nations.
translation_verse: Bénweni kalɛ na ɔ́di lɛga ku ɔyikun ku ala ani nálɛku-nwu ku Israel ƒui ku kɔlɔ bamba lɛlɔ lɛnɔ bése.

english_verse: While Solomon was king of Israel, there was silver and gold everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as ordinary sycamore trees in the foothills.
translation_verse: Na Salomo lɛgadi uwi ni, ɔ́ya na sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi ɔ́bu na Yerusalem aani atabi. Na ɔ́ya na bálɛ sida egyii na émomo geen aani kɔnwingyie egyii ani nábu akya Yuda abi kaƒɔna mmɔ.

english_verse: and there at the bronze altar, Solomon offered a thousand animals as sacrifices to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Na abuala egyiedi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ kudɔ ni, Salomo ɔ́du bebuo apim unwi ɔ́bla akpala bɔkyula ƒui ɔdi úte Katɔti na mmɔ.

english_verse: God appeared to Solomon that night in a dream and said, “Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.”
translation_verse: Na usien ɔmmɔ ni, Katɔti údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina Salomo na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Salomo, vele-mi lɛla biala na aayɔ́ na ndubuti-ni lite-ɔ.”

english_verse: Solomon answered: Lord God, you were always loyal to my father David, and now you have made me king of Israel.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Salomo údie kenye ɔnini, “Unwoti Katɔti, édie ƒula lɛƒɔndia bonwu átina mina ɔti Dawid uwi biala kemmo, na ami na ásɔ éti énwini Israelƒuɔ ƒui ɔga.

english_verse: I am supposed to rule these people, but there are as many of them as there are specks of dust on the ground. So keep the promise you made to my father
translation_verse: Ábla-mi na ndi bana ɔga, nsu nu kalɛ na bemomo aani kɔnwinimi kɔni nwi kalɔ. Anwuɔsu ni, sia anu na adi ƒula kenye kani na ése mina ɔti lɛlɔ

english_verse: God replied: Solomon, you could have asked me to make you rich or famous or to let you live a long time. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom and knowledge to rule my people.
translation_verse: Amu na Katɔti ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Salomo, akana na nka eye-mi anii nte-ɔ lɛkɛ iye aƒɔ lɛnyi iye elie ngba gyɔlɔɔ iye ƒula bekisine bayii udu. Nsu na ala amɛni ƒui kenye ni, lɛnunda ku lɛlati na éye-mi kalɛ na eti atɔnku mina kadi bekyuli.

english_verse: Solomon then left Gibeon and returned to Jerusalem, the capital city of Israel. Solomon's Wealth (
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Salomo ɔ́tɔlɔ Gibeon mmɔ únwini úbo Yerusalem Israel ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: horses that he kept in Jerusalem and other towns.
translation_verse: ) bani na úle ɔ́kya lɛma linengudi lɛdi kemmo ku Yerusalem.

english_verse: Solomon decided to build a temple where the Lord would be worshiped, and also to build a palace for himself.
translation_verse: Salomo ɔ́lɛ ugyii ka ɔtu kakpakɔ kani na bataakpa Unwoti na ɔtu ɔga kesii lɛnɔ ute lɛlɔ.

english_verse: This will be a great temple, because our God is greater than all other gods.
translation_verse: “Na kakpakɔ kamɛni kadubɔbla kakpakɔ kenengudi geen, ɔsika bula Katɔti úbomo utulo baƒiɔ lidu ƒui.

english_verse: Praise the Lord God of Israel who made heaven and earth! He has given David a son who isn't only wise and smart, but who has the knowledge to build a temple for the Lord and a palace for himself.
translation_verse: Bekyuli ƒui bemwi Israel Unwoti Katɔti ɔni nédie katɔ ku kalɔ! Úte Dawid ɔnanabi ɔni na ɔ́da anu na ɔɔsia ala anu taabla-nya uwi lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔɔdi ɔmmɔ lɛti mmomu kasusu kásɔ kebo-nwu ka ɔtu kakpakɔ ute Unwoti na ɔtu ɔga kesii lɛnɔ ute lɛlɔ.

english_verse: of them to cut stone from the hills. He chose
translation_verse: ) bataanwi atabi na kɔbi lɛlɔ. Na ɔ́ƒuna nkyuli mpim ɛtɛ ku eti leevu-anyɔ (

translation_verse: ) kabataanu kabla kammɔ lɛlɔ na banu ka báwɔlɔ kabla kammɔ bɔbla lɛnɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: I am building a temple where the Lord my God will be worshiped. Sweet-smelling incense will be burned there, and sacred bread will be offered to him. Worshipers will offer sacrifices to the Lord every morning and evening, every Sabbath, and on the first day of each month, as well as during all our religious festivals. These things will be done for all time, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Nnye mɔɔtú kakpakɔ lite Unwoti Katɔti kesii kani na bekyuli bataakpa-nwu. Na badubɔkyula oloƒui ƒɛƒɛɛ na mmɔ na beti bodobodo ɔni nse kedee lɛnɔ bete-nwu na mmɔ. Na bekyuli bani nébo babakpa-nwu badubuti bana akpala beboku-nwu na mmɔ ɔtanta biala ku useyi uwi biala ku Lɛnwunameyi biala ku kɔbuli biala limeyi lideedi lɛlɔ ku Katɔti emeyi buni aƒunadi biala bɔdi lɛlɔ. english_verse: No one can ever build a temple large enough for God—even the heavens are too small a place for him to live in! All I can do is build a place where we can offer sacrifices to him.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔɔdubo bɔkana na ɔtu ɔtɔ bonwu ɔmmɔ udu ute Katɔti na ulie-nwu kemmo. Ɔ́si katɔ útédu katɔ kakaaka ƒui muedi kalakana-a bɔda. Na lɛla lɛni kani na mɔɔwia ka lɛbla ndi ka lɛtu kesii kani na buteeti bula akpala teete-nwu.

english_verse: Send me a worker who can not only carve, but who can work with gold, silver, bronze, and iron, as well as make brightly colored cloth. The person you send will work here in Judah and Jerusalem with the skilled workers that my father has already hired.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu mene-mi ukyuli ɔni na ɔɔɔdi kanwi kani na ɔgyi mmomu ɔni mɔɔkana na ɔɔbla sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ku abuala egyiedi ku kalɔ kemmo abuala ku adi ani muukeye geen lɛnɔ lɛlɔ kabla. english_verse: I know that you have workers who are experts at cutting lumber in Lebanon. So would you please send me some cedar, pine, and juniper logs? My workers will be there to help them,
translation_verse: “Ngyi ka ebo kabla bablane bani na bagyi ligyii bukulo ku bɔbwɛ kabla kemmo kaduɛ geen na Lebanon. Anwuɔsu muuvele-ɔ nnii mene-mi ligyii kpakplaa lidu lidu lɛmmɔ. Na ndubuti mina kabla bablane limene na bebebunku-ma,

english_verse: Hiram sent his answer back to Solomon: I know that the Lord must love his people, because he has chosen you to be their king.
translation_verse: Amu na Hiram lɛnɔ ɔ́sɔku kenye ɔ́sia úmene Salomo ɔnini, “Ngyi ka Unwoti ubo bɔyɔ geen ute nwuna kadi bekyuli, ɔsika ɔ́ƒuna-a ka enwini bana ɔga.

english_verse: I am sending Huram Abi to you. He is wise and very skillful.
translation_verse: “Na líti Huram-Abi ɔni na anu ese-nwu nwaa mɛni muumene-ɔ.

english_verse: His mother was from the Israelite tribe of Dan, and his father was from Tyre. Not only is Huram an expert at working with gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone, and wood, but he can also make colored cloth and fine linen. And he can carve anything if you give him a pattern to follow. He can help your workers and those hired by your father King David.
translation_verse: Uni ɔdi uleku ɔni na ɔ́si Israelni ɔni baalɔ Dan kɔdua kemmo na ɔti ɔ́si Tiro. Huram ɔmɛni ɔgyi sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ku abuala egyiedi ku kalɔ kemmo abuala kpakplaa ku atabi ƒui lɛlɔ kabla kaduɛ na ɔɔɔdi ɔmmɔ lɛti mmomu ɔgyi adi budulo ku egyii kama evuo adi kabla lɛnɔ kaduɛ. Na ɔɔnwí ala geen taasiaku udu biala na átina-nwu lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubɔkana na ubunku ƒula kabla bablane ku bekyuli bani na ƒula ɔti Ɔga Dawid ɔ́ƒɔ ka bababla kabla na kayu kenye mmɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: Go ahead and send the wheat, barley, olive oil, and wine you promised to pay my workers.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu téti ƒula kakpa ku atoti ku nnɔ ku ntɛ bɔni na ése kenye ka adubuti aƒɔ mina kabla bablane kayu mene.

english_verse: I will tell them to start cutting down trees in Lebanon. They will cut as many as you need, then tie them together into rafts, and float them down along the coast to Joppa. Your workers can take them to Jerusalem from there. Solomon's Work Force
translation_verse: Ndubo-ma bɔsu na bese kalɔ ku ligyii lɛmmɔ bukulo na Lebanon. Na bekyuli bumomo bɔni na aawia na beti basia ntu anumi lɛlɔ bemene-ɔ na Yopa na ƒula kabla bablane bala-ni basiku mmɔ besienku Yerusalem.” Salomo Ɔ́ka Nwuna Kabla Bablane Bumomo

translation_verse: Na úti atabi ani náƒɔ kuye geen ɔ́kya ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ bɔdia na úti sika ugyiedi ɔni ɔ́kada ɔ́siku kalɔ kani baalɔ banii Parvaim

english_verse: Five hundred and seventy grams of gold was used to cover the heads of the nails. The walls of the small storage rooms were also covered with gold.
translation_verse: Na kɔbuɛlɛ kɔmmɔ eli ni, anta akɔkɔ leevu sika ugyiedi unu na béti béwi-ku eli. Na lɛtɔ wɛlɛwɛlɛ lɛni kemmo na beesé ala lɛnɔ ni, bákwaa awodu ammɔ ƒui ku sika ugyiedi ntu.

english_verse: Solomon had the inside walls of the temple's main room paneled first with pine and then with a layer of gold, and he had them decorated with carvings of palm trees and designs that looked like chains.
translation_verse: Salomo ɔ́ya na bánwi ligyii bákana bámana kakpakɔ kammɔ keliekɔ geen kemmo awodu lɛlɔ ƒui asa na béti sika ugyiedi ntu bákwaa-ni lɛlɔ bávi ƒui. Na bánwi ala adi bényene aani ebo udu ku kɔgba béti bákya-nwu bɔdia bámana.

english_verse: Solomon had two statues of winged creatures made to put in the most holy place, and he covered them with gold.
translation_verse: Salomo ɔ́ya na bátu bebweyi ku avwi kavɔ inyɔ badi bényene kesii kani na nse kedee ntulo ƒui mmɔ, na ɔ́ya na béti sika ugyiedi bákwaa-ma lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Each creature had two wings and was four and a half meters from the tip of one wing to the tip of the other wing. Solomon set them next to each other in the most holy place, facing the doorway. Their wings were spread out and reached all the way across the nine-meter room.
translation_verse: Bebweyi inyɔ bamɛni ɔdi biala ubo avwi anyɔ. Na ɔ́si kɔvwi kunwi kenye úsie kɔvwi kunyɔdi kenye ubo lɛgba leevu-ɛlɔ bɔbɛbɛ. english_verse: A curtain was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with designs of winged creatures. The Two Columns (

english_verse: The top of each column was decorated with designs that looked like chains and with
translation_verse: Na akpa amɛni eli ƒui ni, bábla ala adi báda aani kɔgba béti bákya akpa ammɔ bɔdia na bánwi egyiibi adi udu aani eti anyɔ lɛnɔ básia-nya lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Solomon had one of the columns placed on the south side of the temple's entrance; it was called Jachin. The other one was placed on the north side of the entrance; it was called Boaz.
translation_verse: Salomo ɔ́ya na lɛkpa linwi linye kada kakɛ na baalɔ-ni banii Yakin. Na ɔ́ya na linwi linye katɔ kakɛ na baalɔ-ni banii Boas.

english_verse: Solomon had a bronze altar made that was nine meters square and four and a half meters high.
translation_verse: Salomo ɔ́ya na béti abuala egyiedi bábla lɛkpabi lɛdi na lɛ́kuku lɛgba leevu-ɛlɔ na nina bɔbɛbɛ ku bune ƒui bɔdi bɔkɔku bunwi na ɔdi lɛgba avlaatɛ.

english_verse: Ten gold lampstands were also made according to the plans. Solomon placed these lampstands inside the temple, five on each side of the main room.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́bla sika ugyiedi asogya ligyii leevu na udu ɔni na bátina-nwu kenye. Na Salomo úti-ni únyene kakpakɔ kammɔ ɔtɔ unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na ɛlɔ bunye kakɛ kenwi na ɛlɔ lɛnɔ bunye kakɛ kakladi.

translation_verse: Ɔmantɛ bakɔ bavɔdi badi benye ntu kewikɔ kammɔ kalɔ bámana na lɛgaala inyɔ kemmo na lɛdanku lɛkyami lɛmmɔ na bebo leevu na lɛgba bɔka ine ku kakɛ bɔka biala kemmo.

english_verse: He also made ten small bowls and put five on each side of the large bowl. The small bowls were used to wash the animals that were burned on the altar as sacrifices, and the priests used the water in the large bowl to wash their hands.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́bla akyami wɛlɛ wɛlɛ leevu bamba na úti ɛlɔ únyene lɛkyami linengudi lɛmmɔ ɔƒɛnyi unwi na úti ɛlɔ únyene ɔƒɛni unyɔdi. english_verse: He also made ten tables and placed them in the main room, five on each side. And he made
translation_verse: Na ɔ́nwi ala kasiakɔ leevu úse ɔtɔ unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na ɛlɔ bunye kakɛ kenwi na ɛlɔ lɛnɔ bunye kakɛ kanyɔdi. Na ɔ́bla sika ugyiedi ntu kuwikɔ kesii kani na beewi ntu taakuna teewi bekyuli lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Solomon gave orders to build two courtyards: a smaller one that only priests could use and a larger one. The doors to these courtyards were covered with bronze.
translation_verse: Salomo ɔ́ya na békulo kɔduli inyɔ, kenengudi kenwi ku kebliidi kenwi. Na bakpane kani muuduo kebliidi kammɔ kemmo. Na kɔyakun kɔmmɔ ƒui eli ni, abuala egyiedi na béti bébi-ku.

english_verse: The large bowl called the Sea was placed near the southeast corner of the temple.
translation_verse: Na lɛkyami linengudi lɛni baalɔ banii ɛpu mmɔ ni, béti-ni bése kakpakɔ kammɔ kada kakɛ na ɔƒɛ katukɔ.

translation_verse: Na Huram ɔ́sɔ ɔ́bla ebui ku kɔlɛkɛ kɔni na beedie ogya ku akyami lidu ku kesii kani na beewi ntu taakuna. Anwuɔsu Huram ɔ́wɔlɔ Katɔti kakpakɔ kabla kani ƒui na Ɔga Salomo úte-nwu ka ɔbla.

english_verse: the stands and the small bowls,

english_verse: The priests of every group had gone through the ceremony to make themselves clean and acceptable to the Lord. The Levite musicians, including Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and relatives, were wearing robes of fine linen. They were standing on the east side of the altar, playing cymbals, small harps, and other stringed instruments. They were praising the Lord by playing music and singing: “The Lord is good, and his love never ends.” Suddenly a cloud filled the temple as the priests were leaving the holy place.
translation_verse: Na bakpane bammɔ na bana kasala kasala kemmo bábla lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi ɔmmɔ kalɛ na baƒɔ Katɔti anu. english_verse: Then the priests and the Levites picked up the sacred chest, the sacred tent, and the objects used for worship, and they carried them to the temple.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama bakpane bammɔ ku Lewiƒuɔ bammɔ bágyu Adaka ɔmmɔ ku Katɔti kevo kammɔ ku ala ani na beeti taabla akpala mmɔ ƒui na béti béboku kakpakɔ kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Solomon and a crowd of people stood in front of the chest and sacrificed more sheep and cattle than could be counted.
translation_verse: Salomo ku bekyuli lisu bonwu badi batɔ Adaka ɔmmɔ anumi. Na ka bakɛ ulu ni, bádu baƒonu ku ɔmantɛ bakɔ pii bákpa ɔni na balakana bɔka.

english_verse: The priests carried the chest into the most holy place and put it under the winged creatures,
translation_verse: Amu na bakpane bammɔ béti adaka ɔmmɔ bétése Katɔti katɔma kedee kammɔ kemmo na kesii kani na bebweyi ku avwi bammɔ benye mmɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: The poles were so long that they could be seen from just outside the most holy place, but not from anywhere else. And they stayed there from then on.
translation_verse: Na ligyii lɛmmɔ lɛ́kuku ɔni na akana na anu-ni si enye katɔma kammɔ anumi na ɔɔɔdi kesi kesii. Na mmɔ na ala ammɔ ese ɔ́si uwi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ úbedu ɔmwi.

english_verse: The only things kept in the chest were the two flat stones Moses had put there when the Lord made his agreement with the people of Israel at Mount Sinai, after bringing them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Na ala ani kani nkya adaka ɔmmɔ kemmo ndi atabi bɛbɛɛbɛ anyɔ ani na Mose úti ɔ́kya mmɔ uwi ɔni na Katɔti únyimiku Israel bekyuli bammɔ bunyimi bɔmɛni na Sinai Kɔbi lɛlɔ uwi ɔni na ɔ́kpanku-ma ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord's glory was in that cloud, and the light from it was so bright that the priests could not stay inside to do their work.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti uukeye na liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ kemmo geen. Na kalɛ na uukeye mmɔ ɔɔtu anumi, anwuɔsu bakpane bammɔ bátakana ɔtɔ kemmo mmɔ bunye bɔbla bana kabla.

english_verse: Now I've built a glorious temple where you can live forever.” Solomon Speaks to the People (
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani ni, lɛ́tu kakpakɔ kani muukeye kesii kani na adubɔkana na elie uwi ƒui.” Salomo Ɔ́tɛmi Úte Bekyuli Bammɔ

english_verse: and prayed: Lord God of Israel, no other god in heaven or on earth is like you! You never forget the agreement you made with your people, and you are loyal to anyone who faithfully obeys your teachings.
translation_verse: na ɔ́kpali Katɔti ɔnini, “Unwoti Israel Katɔti, ɔyikune ƒui, ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo na katɔ iye kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni na use aani ƒula kalɛ! Átayiƒala lɛla lɛni na ényimi ku ƒula kadi bekyuli kudii. Na aasia ƒula litemi kama siin taadi-ni lɛlɔ teete ukyuli biala ɔni na mɔɔsia ƒula ala bɔtina kama siin taadi-ni lɛlɔ na ulalɛ-ɔ kama.

english_verse: I am your servant, and the people of Israel belong to you, and so whenever any of us look toward this temple and pray, answer from your home in heaven and forgive our sins.
translation_verse: Ƒula kabla ɔblane na ndi na Israel kadi bekyuli bammɔ ƒui awɔ mbo-ma. Anwuɔsu uwi biala na bekyuli bamɛni akɔ ɔdi únwini ɔ́nu kakpakɔ kamɛni na ɔ́kpali-ɔ ni, na enu-nwu bɔkpali asiku katɔ kesii kani na eli mmɔ na eti bula alaekpidi akyiɛ-bu.

english_verse: Solomon turned toward the people standing there. Then he blessed them
translation_verse: Salomo únwini lɛlɔ ɔ́tina bekyuli bani nnye mmɔ na úte-ma kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: and said: Praise the Lord God of Israel! He brought his people out of Egypt long ago and later kept his promise to make my father David the king of Israel. The Lord also promised him that Jerusalem would be the city where his temple will be built, and now that promise has come true.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bemwi Unwoti Israel Katɔti! Kuuku ƒui ni, anwu nákpanku nwuna bekyuli ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na nwuna kama ni, ɔ́di nwuna linyese lɛlɔ ka wabla mina ɔti Dawid Israelƒuɔ ɔga. Na úse-nwu kenye lɛnɔ ka Yerusalem ndubɔbla nwuna ɔma unengudi kesii kani na badubɔtu nwuna kakpakɔ benyene. Na ɔƒaani ni, linyese lɛmmɔ líbo líte lɛni sɔsɔ.

english_verse: When my father wanted to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel,
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔni na mina ɔti ɔ́wia ka ɔtu kakpakɔ ute Unwoti Israel Katɔti ni,

english_verse: But you're not the one to do it. Your son will build the temple to honor me.”
translation_verse: Nsu ɔɔɔdi awɔ ndubo-ka bɔkana bɔtu mmomu ƒ'ubidi ndubo kakpakɔ kammɔ bɔtu bute-mi na bakyuli bete-mi ɔbu.’

english_verse: The Lord has done what he promised. I am now the king of Israel, and I've built a temple for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: “Na Unwoti ɔ́di kenye kani na úse lɛlɔ na ami ndi Israelƒuɔ ɔga ɔƒaani. Na lɛ́tu kakpakɔ líte Unwoti bula Katɔti.

english_verse: I've also put the sacred chest in the temple. And in that chest are the two flat stones on which is written the solemn agreement the Lord made with our ancestors when he rescued them from Egypt. Solomon Prays at the Temple (
translation_verse: Líti Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ líse kakpakɔ kammɔ kemmo. Na adaka ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, atabi bɛbɛɛbɛ anyɔ ani lɛlɔ na Unwoti únweni lɛla lɛni na únyimiku bula bati kuuku ɔ́sia uwi ɔni na ɔ́kpanku-ma ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ akya-nwu kemmo.” Salomo Ɔ́kpali Katɔti Na Kakpakɔ Kemmo Mmɔ

english_verse: Suppose someone accuses a person of a crime, and the accused has to stand in front of the altar in your temple and say, “I swear I am innocent!”
translation_verse: “Si banii ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́da ɔkpanadi kenye ka ɔ́bla likpidi bonwu lɛdi na úbo úte ka ukyuli ɔni kenye na báda mmɔ unye lɛkpabi lɛmɛni anumi na ƒula kakpakɔ kamɛni kemmo na ɔ́su ɔnii, ‘Lɛ́kanku ka lɛɛɛgyi lɛla lɛdi’ ni,

english_verse: Earlier, Solomon had a bronze platform made that was about two meters square and over a meter high, and he put it in the center of the outer courtyard near the altar. Solomon stood on the platform facing the altar with everyone standing behind him. Then he lifted his arms toward heaven; he knelt down
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Salomo ɔ́ɔgyu ɔ́tɔ ɔ́ya na bábla kenyekɔ ubili ɔdi ku abuala egyiedi. Na kenyekɔ kamɛni kadi lɛgba maane maane lɛƒɛnyi ine bɔmmɔ ƒui na ɔ́kuku lɛgba ɛlɔ na kaduli kenengudi kammɔ ntɛntɛ na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ kudɔ. Na Salomo ɔ́kɔ únye ubili ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na úti nwuna anumi ɔ́tina lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ. Na bekyuli bakladi ƒui benye-nwu kama. Mmɔ na ɔ́kɔliku enu katɔ na ɔ́lɛ akɔnkɔ kalɔ,

english_verse: My father David was your servant, and today you have kept every promise you made to him.
translation_verse: Mina ɔti Dawidi ɔ́bla ƒula kabla. Na ɔmwi ni, ádi ƒula kenye biala na ése-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You promised that someone from his family would always be king of Israel, if they do their best to obey you, just as he did.
translation_verse: “Ése-nwu kenye ka nwuna ɔtɔ kemmo na ukyuli ɔdubɔsi uwi biala kemmo na ɔdi lɛga na Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ si bákya ɔkplu na bábla básia ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́bla.

english_verse: Please keep this promise you made to your servant David.
translation_verse: Muuvele nnii sia anu kenye kani na ése ƒula kabla ɔblane Dawid mɛni kaduɛ lɛni kani.

english_verse: There's not enough room in all of heaven for you, Lord God. How could you possibly live on earth in this temple I have built?
translation_verse: “Nsu ni, bulie na Katɔti, ɔdubulie kayawi kamɛni kemmo geen geen? Ɔ́si katɔ útédu katɔ kakaaka ƒui muedi kalakana-a bɔda. Amu bátaka kakpakɔ kani na lɛ́tu lite-ɔ na kétedu lɛla lɛdi mɛni kemmo?

english_verse: But I ask you to answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Nsu muuvele-ɔ ka enu-mi bɔkpali, na anu-mi kɔnyana, ƒula kabla ɔblane kalɛ.

english_verse: This is the temple where you have chosen to be worshiped. Please watch over it day and night and listen when I turn toward it and pray.
translation_verse: Aanu ƒula kakpakɔ kani na áƒuna ka bekyuli bataakpa-a na kana kemmo. Muuvele nnii nu-ka lɛlɔ usien ku ɔƒɛ na enu-mi bɔkpali si uwi biala na línwini mɔɔnu-ka na lɛ́kpali-ɔ.

english_verse: Listen from heaven and decide who is right. Then punish the guilty person and let the innocent one go free.
translation_verse: na enu-nwu bɔkpali asiku katɔ mmɔ na edie ukyuli ɔni náƒiɔ atina. Na ani ukyuli ɔni náƒiɔ mmɔ kɔtu na ukyuli ɔni nátaƒiɔ uteesie ƒaa.

english_verse: Suppose your people Israel sin against you, and then an enemy defeats them. If they come to this temple and beg for forgiveness,
translation_verse: “Na si ɔƒɛni kalɛ ƒula kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ báƒiɔ-ɔ, na bana bekisine bádi-ma lɛlɔ na bábla kasusu ka bebo bebevele-ɔ na eti bana ekpidi akyiɛ-ma ni,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven. Forgive them and bring them back to the land you gave their ancestors.
translation_verse: si bébo na enu ete-ma asiku ƒula keliekɔ na katɔ mmɔ. Na eti bana ekpidi akyiɛ-ma na asɔku-ma eboku kalɔ kani na éti éte bana bati kuuku mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Suppose your people sin against you, and you punish them by holding back the rain. If they stop sinning and turn toward this temple to pray in your name,
