translation_verse: “Si bunweni na badubunweni mina etemila bakya ɔku ɔdi kemmo bese ni, nka ɔdia!

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: Ngyi ka mina Udiene ɔkya ɔni na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, ɔdubo ubenye kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: Na ina dɛ na ɔlɛ ɔmɛni úsusu-mi ɔlɔna ɔku úbile ni, ɔlɔna ɔmɛni kemmo kani na ndubo Katɔti bɔnu anumi ku anumi.

english_verse: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
translation_verse: Ami ɔmɛni ɔlati ndubo-nwu bɔnu ku mina anumi na ɔɔɔdi ukyuli bamba. Na nnye ngya uwi ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: “Ngyi ka binye bɛɛwia ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na bɛsia na bikpoku-mi, ɔsika bɛɛsu bɛnii ala amɛni ƒui kakwɛkɔ kási ami ɔlati.

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Soƒar ɔni nási Naama mmɔ ɔ́su Hiob ɔnini,

english_verse: Your words are disturbing; now I must speak.
translation_verse: “Ƒula etemila aatu-mi kayi, anwuɔsu ɔlɛka lɛkya-a kenye.

english_verse: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
translation_verse: Átɛmi édumi-mi na aadú-mi kɔtɔ lɛnɔ, na ɔlɛka lidie kenye na enu.

english_verse: Since the time of creation, everyone has known
translation_verse: “Ɔ́si kayawi kalɔ kesekɔ ƒui ni, ukyuli biala ɔgyi ka

english_verse: that sinful people are happy for only a while.
translation_verse: alaekpidi ɔblane biala ni, uwi klukwii ɔdi kani na ɔɔkɛ́ ebiti teetédu.

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Ina dɛ na bana lɛmɛnɛ bɔkun ku bana ɔyikun ɔɔkɔ́ teesie kayaa ni,

english_verse: They will be forgotten like a dream
translation_verse: Bekyuli badubɔyiƒala-ma aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔyiƒala kɔna kɔni na úgye.

english_verse: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
translation_verse: Na bana lɛlɔ bekyuli ku bakpana lɛnɔ basɔ balanu-ma.

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: Na ala ani na béƒie báƒɔ na bawabane kudɔ ni, bana bebi badubɔƒɔ kɔyu kɔmmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Geen geen ni, balalane badubo bukpi na batátɛ bana kɔƒiɔtɔ kemmo ku bana lɛkloƒu ɔyikun ƒui.

english_verse: and swallow it slowly.
translation_verse: Na lɛɛkya-ma kenye na baatu-ni teenwini.

english_verse: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
translation_verse: Nsu adila ammɔ adubunwini ɔdu ku likpila na bana kaƒɔ kemmo aani kɔlakpi ugyulo na ɔkya-ma ɔlɛ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔdubɔya na badala lɛkɛ lɛni na bánwanɛ báƒɔ bekyuli kudɔ bému bébweli mmɔ.

english_verse: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
translation_verse: Na ala ammɔ adubunwini aani kɔlakpi ugyulo na bana kaƒɔ kemmo na ɔdu-ma.

english_verse: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Na baaadubo bulie na bakɛ Katɔti kusɛ kusɛ ku ala abuni ani na ɔdubute bekyuli.

english_verse: Their hard work will result in nothing gained,
translation_verse: Na katuma kani na bábla kpakplaa ƒui ni, baaadubo bulie bɔdi kana ebi.

english_verse: Greedy people want everything and are never satisfied.
translation_verse: “Na ka ala elemo-ma ɔsu ni, baaadubo-nya bɔda bɔwia bɔya. Na balakana-nya bɔklibi buse lɛnɔ.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ka bɔnwanɛ na baanwanɛ teemu taadi ɔsu ni, si ala ani na bánwanɛ mmɔ ása ni, na beenwíni bekyuli bekpludi.

english_verse: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down,
translation_verse: Na ala pii ani na bánwanɛ kama ni, lɛbibo ku ɔgbankpi muubó-ma taaƒiɛmi kalɔ.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Na si beekeli kɔtaminta kɔbuɛlɛmii atula ni, atula ani mbo ɔkplu etulo edeedi ndubo-ma bɔtu.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Na ana nnye bɔni mbo ɔkplu mmɔ ndubo-ma ɔlɔna bɔtu bɔƒuaala. Na liƒu bonwu lɛdubuƒie-ma.

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: Na ala ani na baayɔ́ na anya mɔɔda-ma kubiti geen mmɔ adubɔyii akya uyɔ kemmo. Na Katɔti ɔdubɔya na ogya ɔdi ɔsi ubakyula-ma na bana nvo kemmo ku bana akɛla ƒui.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Katɔ ku kalɔ ƒui badubo-ma keyi budie na badu-ma kɔtɔ.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na beti-ma ala batɔlɔku si uwi ɔni na ɔ́kɛ kɔnyi na ɔɔtɛku-ma litemi, aani kalɛ na ketu keeyi taagbala ala taatɔlɔku.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛmɛni na Katɔti ɔ́lɛ ugyii úse úte bekyuli bekpidi.”

english_verse: If you want to offer comfort, then listen to me.
translation_verse: “Si kɔnu na anii aasia-mi bɔdi ni, amu se atu na enu lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu-ɔ awɔlɔ.

english_verse: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
translation_verse: Na si lɛ́tɛmi lɛ́wɔlɔ ni, akana na asɔ ese ƒula edumi kalɔ ƒaa.

english_verse: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.
translation_verse: “Katɔti na líti mina litemi muute, nsu naaakɛ kebunku kani mɔɔwia!

english_verse: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
translation_verse: Na mina bɔnukplu muedi ni, kaƒɔ kadubɔdu-ɔ na ebimi kenye ewi.

english_verse: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
translation_verse: Na si mɔɔbla kasusu taasiku lɛla lɛni nálɛku-mi mɛni lɛlɔ ni, na mɔɔyia na lɛlɔ ƒui lɛɛtɔ́-mi.

english_verse: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na bekyuli bekpidi beelie teetu uwi na baakɛ́ ɔyikun lɛni?

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na beelie taanu bana bebi na babi lɛlɔ?

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛdi lilekpoku-ma na bana kɔduli, na Katɔti ulani-ma kɔtu kɔdi.

english_verse: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
translation_verse: Bana ɔmantɛ bakɔ baawɔ bebi na beemomo na bana ɔdi ulékpi.

english_verse: their children play and dance safely by themselves.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ bana bebi na ama lɛti baatɔ́ taavi ku ebiti.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: Baatɔ́ taasia lɛbentaa ku atoloyii ku akasaa kɔku lɛlɔ ku lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: Beelie taadi ngba ku ebiti kalɛ na baayɔ́ asa na bekpi besie kekpine ku keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: Nsu baasu Katɔti banini, ‘Nyonu-bu! Buláwia ƒula lilu lɛdi bɔnii bɔɔnu bɔti.

english_verse: What do we gain from praying and worshiping you?
translation_verse: Ɔma ndi Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔmmɔ na butaabla-nwu kabla? Na bi na bɔdubo bɔkɛ na butaakya lili kalɔ taakpali-nwu?

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Ala ani ƒui na bubo ni, abu alati néti bula ɔyikun kemmo bɔ́kɛ-nya.’ Na bana ala bɔsu bɔmɛni ɔsu ni, lɛ́da lɛlɔ lɛ́mami ama ku bana kɔkwɛ kɔni na baakya lɛlɔ.

english_verse: How often does God become angry and send disaster and darkness to punish sinners?
translation_verse: “Áanu dii ka Katɔti ɔ́ni bekyuli bamɛni udu kɔtu? Na kɔlɛ na ɔɔyá na ɔgbankpi uubo-ma lɛlɔ na nwuna kɔnyi ɔsu? Kudii!

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: Kɔlɛ na ɔɔní-ma kɔtu aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uuduo keti kemmo teebo-ka teegyingya?

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: Na aasu-mi ɔƒɛni anini, ‘Katɔti ɔɔní alaekpidi bablane bammɔ bebi kɔtu na bana bawɔne kenye.’ Bɔsu na ami nda nnini, ‘Ɔlɛka ɔni alaekpidi bablane bammɔ kɔtu ama alati utédu kesii kani na wayu-ma ɔlɛ kaduɛ.’

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔmmɔ unye-ma lɛlɔ na bani ama alati ekpidi lɛbibo lɛtuni lɛni na ɔdubute-ma na nwuna kɔnyi kemmo aani kalɛ na baaní lɛla lɛdi teedie ɔɔƒɛɛ kemmo.

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: Ɔsika si békpi ni, basɔ baaagyi lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ku bana bebi na bana kama.

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: “Ɔma ndubɔtina Katɔti lɛla lɛni na ɔlɛka ɔbla? Anwu mɔɔtɛku lɛlɔ badine bayikune ƒui litemi.

english_verse: Some of us die prosperous,
translation_verse: Bekyuli beelie ƒaa kalɛ na baayɔ́ asa na bekpi.

english_verse: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
translation_verse: Na badi ama beekpi ku lɛbibo na kɔwaba kemmo.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Nsu bula ƒui kukpi kunwi kɔmmɔ kani na buukpi, na beklubi baatu taada-bu aani kɔdi na bébi-bu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
translation_verse: “Ngyi lili likpidi lɛni udu na bɛɛsa na mina lɛlɔ na biti bibile-mi.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na biiye bɛnini, ‘Wɛ na ukyuli unengudi ɔni náƒɔ lɛnyi, nsu alaekpidi kani na úlie útaabla mmɔ kaduli kávi tɔ?’

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: si ɔgbankpi ɔdi ɔ́lɛ ni, bekyuli bekpidi mmomu na lɛla lɛdi lilábla?

english_verse: No one points out their sin or punishes them.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ulátɛmi taasiku bana ekpidi lɛlɔ iye bani-ma kɔtu muedi.

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: Na bana kekwa mɔɔyu, na bekyuli beemwi-ma.

english_verse: the earth welcomes them home, while crowds mourn.
translation_verse: Bana kavakɔ na baaklibi kaduɛ na bekyuli lisu bonwu muutiku-ma taatáva.

english_verse: But empty, meaningless words are the comfort you offer me.
translation_verse: “Nsu kenyekplu etemila ani neeebo kɔsia kɔdi mmomu na amii bɛda bɛɛsia-mi kɔnu.”

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: “Bi kɔsia geen na abu bekyuli bubo bute Katɔti ku abu bani ƒui mɔɔnu lɛlɔ banundane?

english_verse: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Na ina likpidi lɛdi lɛɛɛma-a lɛlɔ munu munu muedi ni, bi na aabu anii ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla Katɔti?

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: Oowo! Mmomu ƒula likyulikpi ku ekpidi lidu lɛni na enye aabla ɔsu na úbo úte lɛni.

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Áƒɔ bekyuli bamba ku bawabane ala ése ɔkpa na kayu kani na bada-a kenye na éƒie-ma adala áƒɔ na bakɛ kasɔngya.

english_verse: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
translation_verse: Na bani na kɔka ku utukwɛ ɔɔda ni, éni-ma adila ku ntu bute,

english_verse: although you were rich, respected, and powerful.
translation_verse: ina ka ɔyikune na adi na ebo ala pii, na bekyuli lɛnɔ baabu-ɔ.

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi buni kani na éni bekpinele bubunku, mmomu ábla bekpinebi lɛnɔ ulikplu na éƒie-ma ala áƒɔ.

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: Na akya lɛdisa kemmo na use aani kalɛ na ketu keeti ukyuli.

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: “Katɔ ƒui na Katɔti uli na úbo ɔ́vi ayabi ƒui, na ɔɔnu lɛla biala taasiku mmɔ.

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: Liƒlukutu bonwu lɛmmɔ lítile Katɔti anumi uwi ɔni na ɔkɛ kayaa ɔɔví na kalɔ kammɔ katɔ.’

english_verse: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners,
translation_verse: Da kasusu kani nákya bati kukuuku alaekpidi bablane taƒɔ tadi mmɔ die ƒula ngba kemmo.

english_verse: They rejected God All-Powerful, feeling he was helpless,
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ néni Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui na bákali banii uuubo ɔyikun ɔdi bana lɛlɔ.

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Nsu ina amu ni, Katɔti ɔmmɔ náya na bákɛ akɛla pii. Na bana kasusu kekpidi kamɛni ɔsu na lɛ́mami-ma lɛlɔ na ami ku-ma bulábla kasusu taasala.

english_verse: When God's people see the godless swept away, they celebrate,
translation_verse: “Bekyuli bani nse siin bánu bana kawɔlɔkɔ, na lɛlɔ lɛ́yɔ-ma na báma-ma básu banini,

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: ‘Bula bekisine báyii udu, na ogya ɔ́kyula bana ala ani na bebo ƒui.’

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: Nu-nwu ala bɔtina na eti-nya akya kayi.

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Geen ni, sɔku lɛlɔ te Katɔti ku lɛlɔ kalɔ buboku na ƒula keyi kayɔ na ala adianku-ɔ. Die ƒula lɛlɔ ƒui atu.

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: Na sika ugyiedi ɔni náƒɔ-ɔ kuye utulo ƒui mmɔ ni, die-nwu atu aani kalɛ na beebó ala teewiakun ɔtumu ɔkɔ na utukwalɛ.

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Na si ákpali-nwu ni, ɔdubunu ute-ɔ na ɔbla ƒula lɛyɔla. Na kenye kani na ése-nwu lɛnɔ ni, adubɔdi-ka lɛlɔ.

english_verse: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
translation_verse: Adubɔnu ulu nwaa asia na ƒula ngba kemmo. Na lɛla biala na ásu-nwu anii ɔbla ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔbla-ni lɛni kani.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ katɔ bɔkɔliku ɔsu na Katɔti uuboku ukyuli kalɔ. Na anwu Katɔti ɔmmɔ kani mɔɔkɔliku ukyuli katɔ si úboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na ɔ́kpali-nwu.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Katɔti uudie alaekpidi bablane na bakɛ bɔƒɔ si ɔ́nu ka báda ekpidi ammɔ bɔbla báya na baabla ala siin.”

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: “Ɔmwi lɛnɔ ni, nsɔ ndubo bɔdɔ geen, ɔsika Katɔti unye ɔɔní-mi kɔtu kpakplaa geen ina ɔni na muudumo momoomo mɛni.

english_verse: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
translation_verse: Si bɔti na nka lɛti kesii kani na ɔkya na lɛkana-nwu kudɔ busie ni, nka ndubusie,

english_verse: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ndubɔti lɛla lɛni geen na ɔ́yɔ ka ɔsu-mi.

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: Bɔbɔku na ɔdubo-mi na nwuna ɔyikun ɔsu na lɛgyu lɛtɔlɔ? Ńtaƒɔ ńtadi, mmomu ɔdubuwiku-mi lɛlɔ na unu kenye kani na ndanku.

english_verse: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
translation_verse: Ɔsika nse siin na ɔdubɔsu-mi ɔnini, ‘Líwi-ɔ uƒi, teesie ƒaa, ɔsika álɛ litemi kemmo.’

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: “Naaanu Katɔti kesii biala na mina anumi ku kama ƒui,

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: iye mina kɔdianu ku kɔmiinu lɛnɔ. Nsu unye ɔɔbla nwuna kabla uwi biala ina ka naaanu-nwu uwi ɔdi.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Nsu ɔgyi lɛla biala na mɔɔbla, na si banii ɔ́kɔku-mi ɔ́nu ni, ndubo buse sɛɛn aani sika ugyiedi ɔni ndia utulo ƒui.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: Nsiaku-nwu kama siin ɔni na ńtedeyi ńtatásia kesii bamba kadi.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: “Nsu anwu lɛti pɛ kani ndi Katɔti na ulávumana, na ukyuli ɔdi ulakana-nwu lɛlɔ bɔta bunye lɛnɔ.

english_verse: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
translation_verse: Na nwuna kasusu kadanku ala abɛdi pii. Na lɛla lɛni na ɔɔyɔ́ ni, ani kani na ɔdubo-mi bɔbla.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́ya na ɔƒɛ ɔ́sa ɔ́kya-mi, nsu ina use-mi suu lɛni aani ɔnumbwɛne ni, neeebile mina kenye na lɛsɔ lilie kpoo.”

english_verse: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
translation_verse: “Bi ɔsu na Katɔti ulese litemi bɔtɛ limeyi ulete bekyuli? Na bi ɔsu na ɔ́ya na nwuna bekyuli benye baanu-nwu anumi taanɔ ka ubatɛ bana litemi ute-ma?

english_verse: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.
translation_verse: Alaekpidi bablane benye baavumana lɛmingyii, na béyu bekyuli baƒonu bada baanyuɛ.

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Na béƒie bekpinebi ku bekpinele bebuo ala betine ku ɔmantɛ bakɔ bagyani báƒɔ na kayu kenye.

english_verse: The poor are trampled and forced to hide
translation_verse: Na baanya bawabane taakya, na baabɔku-ma taalɛku bana kɔlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
translation_verse: Na bawabane bamɛni baakɛ taavi kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo taawia ama ku bana bebi lɛdila aani bebuo ala betine bani mɔɔkɛ taavi kalɛ kalɛ.

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na útulo-ma ni, belikplune bamɛni mmo na beesié taatála amukɔ ku egyiibi asa na bakɛ lɛla lɛni na badi.

english_verse: They sleep naked in the cold, because they have no cover,
translation_verse: Kɔyɔ lɛlɔ na baatɛ, ɔsika beeebo adala ani na bebi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Na si ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ku ɔnantu ɔɔna ni, atakpɛ abi kaƒɔna ku libu kemmo na beesié taatábɛ.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: Bebi bani na bana bati békpi ni, beeyé-ma taasiku bana beni kudɔ na bana bati kayu kenye.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Ina kɔka kɔɔda-ma ni, beenye-ma lɛlɔ ka batuma. Na bakɛ kasɔngya ɔsika beeebo adala.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Ama mɔɔmana egyiibi teedie-nya ntu teete bana benwoti. Nsu bakɛ ku utukwɛ.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Na ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kesii biala ni, adubɔnu bekyuli bani na ala étulo na baayɔ́ bekpi mɛni ka batɛ beedumo. Na beevele ka ɔdi ubebunku-ma, nsu Katɔti ulákpete na ɔbla lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛ bɔnu kani na benye bagya, na badu bawabane ku bani ƒui mɔɔyaki ala. Na usien ɔmmɔ kani na beeyú ala lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Na basɔnɔdine lɛnɔ benye bagya usien, kalɛ na besie ukyuli bamba uleku iye ɔgya kudɔ na batátɛ, na baakali ka ukyuli ɔdi ulanu-ma.

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Alánu beyune kadi nwaa, nsu ya na ɔƒɛ ɔsa, badubɔbwɛ beduo bekyuli lɛtɔ na beyu ala, ɔsika balayɔ bukeye.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Baayɔ́ usien teetulo ɔƒiiwi kadi nwaa. Ɔsika likyulikpi ku liƒu ala bɔbla ndi bana bakpana.

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: “Bese aani ntu avlɔvɔ ani muusé lɛlɔ na asia ntu anumi. Na bana ablala ɔsu Katɔti úwida bana mmo ku kɔlɔ, na kɔsɔ kuládia edula adi.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na kaƒɛndi etubankɛ aayii taakya na liwulu ɔsu ni, lɛni kani na kalɔ keebweli bekyuli bekpidi bamɛni udu.

english_verse: Forgotten here on earth, and with their power broken, they taste sweet to worms.
translation_verse: Si bana ɔyikun ɔ́sa na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ na bekyuli báyiƒala-ma ni, beklubi baakɛ́ adila ani na ebo-ma emini na kalɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.
translation_verse: Alaekpidi bablane baakɛ́ kɔsia na bekpinele ku bedinkɔ bani neeebo kablakɔ kadi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Si ina bekyuli bekpidi bamɛni belie ngba na uwi uutu na ala aatɛ-ma muedi ni, Katɔti ɔɔda-ma teedie na baayii udu ɔkɛnku nwuna ɔyikun lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔkana na unye ɔnu-ma, na ɔbla-ma aani lɛla biala lɛ́ɛtɛ lɛ́wɔlɔ, nsu ɔɔɔdi ɔni na basu banii ulánu-ma ɔsu.

english_verse: Great for a while; gone forever! Sinners are mowed down like weeds, then they wither and die.
translation_verse: Beelie taaƒɔ lɛnyi uwi klukwii ɔdi kemmo, na si békpi ni, ɔ́sa ƒui kede kede! Use aani kalɛ na baamɛnɛ livo teewi kalɔ na lɛyɛyɛ likpi lɛyii udu.

english_verse: If I haven't spoken the truth, then prove me wrong.
translation_verse: “Na si mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ na lɛla lɛni na lɛ́su mɛni kemmo ni, na edie-mi bɔƒiɔ.”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Bildad ɔni nási Suhi ɔ́su Hiob ɔnini,

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: “Katɔti na ɔlɛka bekyuli bayia, ɔsika anwu nli katɔ uubó ɔda na ɔɔdi lɛla biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Ɔma ndubɔkana na ɔka nwuna bekpone esu esu ani nkya katɔ? Na ɔma lɛlɔ na Katɔti bukeye bulátu teewi?

english_verse: How can anyone be innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: Ɔma ndubɔkana na ɔlɛ sɛɛn na Katɔti anumi, na likpidi lɛdi lilama-nwu lɛlɔ?

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Katɔti ulánu kɔbuli ku ayabi ƒui muedi ɔnii eekeye.

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: Amu na dɛ na bɔdubɔsu ka ukyuli ɔyawine uukeye ɔni na liklubi kani na ɔdi mɛni?”

english_verse: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́nu kalɛ na agyi ukyuli ɔni na lɛla lɛdi lítulo-nwu na ɔ́nɔ bubunku geen, na ɔ́lɛ-mi kɔsia sɔsɔ.

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: Na ƒula kasusu kenengudi ku lɛnunda lɛni na éte ami ɔni nse aani ɔdɔlɔdi ni, lɛ́nu-ka lɛ́ti geen!

english_verse: How can anyone possibly speak with such understanding?
translation_verse: Wɛ na ákɛ lɛlati lɛmɛni ásiku? Na ɔma néte-ɔ kasusu bonwu kamɛni udu?

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: “Nsu tayiƒala ɔlɛ bunu ku lɛlɔ lɛni mɔɔtɔ́ bekyuli bani ntɛ kekpine ku ɛpu kalɔ.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Lɛla biala lítabɛ Katɔti na mmɔ, kesii kani na ala ƒui aayii udu.

english_verse: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
translation_verse: Anwu nli nwuna keliekɔ kakaaka na úbimi kayaa ɔ́ƒala katɔ, na ɔ́ya na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛnɔ kaƒa na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-ka.

english_verse: God stores water in clouds, but they don't burst,
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́sala ntu ɔ́kya liƒlukutu kemmo aani obo, nsu bulábwɛ na buwiakun.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́bɛla kɔbuli ɔ́kya liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ kama.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: Ɔ́sia ɔmii na ɛpu kawɔkɔ úte usien ku kadi nwaa kasakɔ.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Na si údie lɛdi ni, kayaa ala ƒui aakunku.

english_verse: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Nwuna ɔyikun ɔɔtu ɛpu teenwini ku liƒu kebweyi kekpidi kani nkya-mu kemmo.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔlɛ́-nwu enwu kemmo mɔɔyá na kayawi kammɔ ƒui keekeye nwaa. Na anwu ɔlati néti nwuna kɔnu úƒie kɔlakpi bonwu kɔni muukeli mmɔ.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔyikun ɔni na údie keyi mɛni ƒui ni, buse kani na use aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔɔnwuna. Na si uwi ɔni na údie nwuna ɔyikun bonwu keyi ku katɔ budu ni, ɔma ndubo-nwu kalɔ bunu?”

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: “Ndubunye Katɔti ɔni nli uwi ƒui anumi na lɛtɛmi lɛlɛku. Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔni néni ɔnii ulábla lɛla lɛni ndi ulu ulete-mi, na ɔ́ya na nnye muubó abi ku ɔdu.

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: Lɛɛɛdubo bɔtuna kudi kudii nnii lɛla lɛni na ábla lɛdia wetédu mina kukpi limeyi. Na lɛɛɛdubo mina litemi geen lɛni na mɔɔsu mɛni lɛnɔ bɔda bɔsu bɔya.

english_verse: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
translation_verse: “Muuvele nnii bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔta teenye-mi lɛlɔ na beekpóku-mi ni, Katɔti ɔni-ma kɔtu aani bekyuli bekpidi bamba kalɛ.

english_verse: Such people are hopeless, and God All-Powerful will cut them down,
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bammɔ beeebo kɔsia kɔdi. Anwuɔsu na Katɔti ɔdubo-ma bɔda budie ngba bɔmmɔ kemmo, na bana ngba bɔda liku.

english_verse: without listening when they beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdubo-ma bɔkpete ina beekpi-nwu kɔtɔ banii ɔnu-ma kɔnyana.

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: Na lɛni geen na ɔlɛka Katɔti ɔbla, ɔsika bekyuli bammɔ balayɔ-nwu na bátakpali-nwu bétevele lɛla lɛdi kudii.

english_verse: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.
translation_verse: “Ɔƒaani ni, ndubo kalɔ budie búte-mii nwaa lɛla lɛni na Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔɔbla, ku kalɛ na nwuna ɔyikun úbomo.

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Na bina ƒui bɛ́ɛnu ala amɛni bɛ́ti, anwuɔsu biiibo kenye kadi na biidie.

english_verse: Here is how God All-Powerful treats those who are wicked and brutal.
translation_verse: “Binu kalɛ na Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔɔbla belikplune ku balalane.

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: Badubɔkana na bawɔ bebi pii, nsu kɔka sɔɔn ndubo-ma butaada. Na ogya ogya kukpi ndubo bana pii bɔdu.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Na ɔlɛ na badi lɛnɔ badubo buƒi bukpi, na bana bekpinele muedi belewulo-ma.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Ina bi akɛla na bákɛ na bátɛ sika ɔƒualadi ku adala pii bése béte lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na beekú lɛti taalɛ lisu ni,

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: bekyuli bani nse siin na bátabla likpidi lɛdi ndubo-ma ala ammɔ bule bɔdi.

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Na kɔduli kɔni na békulo ƒui kuuubo udu bɔyii aani anasi ɔkpaala, iye nvo bɔni na bagyumane bálɛ na bábɛ-nwu kalɔ.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: Balalane bamɛni badubɔnu ala ani nse-ma aani balakɛne asa na bayu batɛ. Nsu badubɔta na banu ka ala ammɔ ƒui áyii-ma anumi kɔnakunwi, na benwini bawabane.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: Ɔgbankpi ɔdubɔsiaku-ma aani kalɛ na ketu keeƒie ukyuli, iye ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa uukpó teeti ala taatɔlɔku usien.

english_verse: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ kudu ku kɔku kɔdubɔtina kalɛ na ɔ́gya enukpɛ ɔ́bɔku-ma.”

english_verse: the same is done with iron and copper.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na beekú abuala kpakplaa, na beedie abuala egyiedi taalɛku atabi kpakplaa ammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Miners carry lanterns deep into the darkness to search for these metals.
translation_verse: Bekyuli baada asogya teeduoku kalɔ kemmo ɔgyu ɔgyu kesii kani nse suu geen, Mmɔ na baawia abuala ammɔ na lɛkɔkɔ lɛmmɔ ƒui kemmo taavi.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Na kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na bekyuli beli baatuma edula taadi ni, kana kemmo kani na bekyuli baatu ogya taakya kalɛ na ukeye na banu atabi ammɔ.

english_verse: that have jewels or gold.
translation_verse: Na mmɔ na baakɛ́ bana abuala ku sika ugyiedi teedie.

english_verse: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;
translation_verse: Na basangbii ku baasɛ bamba bani ƒui muuƒie ala badi lɛnumi lítanu mmɔ kudii.

english_verse: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na bagyata bani mɔɔnya kalɔ taavi ku ɔyikun ɔdi ɔgba útanya mmɔ kudii.

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: Bekyuli beeti bana enu taani atabi yayaaya taakpa. Na beekú abi enengudi kalɔ ƒui kede kede.

english_verse: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
translation_verse: Baatu libu na bakɛ kavikɔ na atakpɛ ammɔ kemmo. Mmɔ na baanu atabi ani kemmo na sika ɔni náƒɔ-ma kuye mmɔ ɔkya ƒui teedie.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: Na beesié teetédu ntukpa kɔlɛkɔ ƒui. Na ala ani nkya mmɔ ni, beedie-nya keyi.

english_verse: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
translation_verse: Bɔgyi ka ubu gbion ku ɛpu kemmo ɔɔɔdi kesii kani na lɛnunda ku ala kalɔ bunu bɔkya.

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ɔni na beekú taalɛku kalɔ kemmo uleye lɛnunda lɛmɛni.

english_verse: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.
translation_verse: Na alakana ala amɛni ɔdi buti bɔmanku lɛnunda iye eti eye-ni lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.
translation_verse: Lɛnunda lɛ́ƒɔ kuye litulo atabi ani baalɔ Yaspa ku Koral ku ana lidu biala.

english_verse: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
translation_verse: Kus kalɔ kemmo atabi ani baalɔ Topas ku sika ugyiedi ɔni muukeye teetulo muedi ni, beleti-nwu beleye lɛnunda.

english_verse: Where then is wisdom?
translation_verse: “Na wɛ na lɛnunda lɛmmɔ lɛkya nɔɔ?

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Kekpine kesii kani na ala aayii udu mmɔ muedi ni, búnu banii bénu lɛnunda kɔku atu atu.

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: Katɔti lɛti pɛ kani ngyi ulu ku kesii kani na lɛnunda lɛkya.

english_verse: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
translation_verse: Anwu nébo ɔda úte ɔnantu bɔna, na ɔ́tina kesii kani na ɔnantu ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ukpo ɔvi.

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su ukyuli ɔyawine ɔnini, ‘Awɔ ɔni mɔɔyia Katɔti na aabu-nwu ni, aadá anu. Na awɔ ɔni muukeli likpidi ni, aakɛ́ ala kalɔ bunu.’ ”

english_verse: I long for the past, when God took care of me,
translation_verse: “Muunyimo uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́da-mi kaduɛ mmɔ, na mɔɔwia ka nka emeyi ammɔ asɔ enwini ebo-mi.

english_verse: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, nwuna bukeye búteewi-mi na mɔɔnu taavi kesii kani na kese suu!

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ na ala ádianku-mi na ami ku Katɔti keliela kése kaduɛ, na útaagyumana-mi ku mina kaduli bekyuli ƒui geen.

english_verse: and all of my children were nearby.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ na Katɔti ɔmu úlieku-mi, na mina bebi ƒui báka bámana-mi.

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ na mbo ala geen, na bebuo bákya-mi kaduɛ. Na mbo nnɔ ntulo kalɛ na mɔɔwia muedi.

english_verse: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council,
translation_verse: “Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, ńtalɛ teetélie ɔma ɔban kenye na ɔma kasakɔ.

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: Na baabla ɔmɛni ɔsika muudie bawabane ku bekpinebi bani muuwulo kɔnyana ka baawia kebunku na beeebo katamikukɔ kadi ɔsu.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani na ala étulo na nka bukpi na bada muedi ni, lídie-ma na beete-mi kusɛ kusɛ. Na bekpinele kayi káyɔ-ma ƒaa na bédie lɛlɔyɔ lɛnu.

english_verse: Kindness and justice were my coat and hat;
translation_verse: “Kɔnyana bɔnu ku ala bɔbla ulu lɛlɔ siin teete bekyuli ndi mina ngba bɔni na lílie.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: Na línwini ɔti líte bani ƒui mɔɔyaki ala. Na baƒɔ muedi mɔɔƒɔ́-ma etemila taasia lɛlɔ na litemi katɛkɔ si lɛla lɛdi líbo-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: Lɛ́ƒɛ balalane avwi, na líƒie bekyuli bani na baayɔ́ ka nka babla kalala lɛ́ƒɔ-ma enu kemmo na bákɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: “Na nka lɛ́sia anu ka ndubulie ngba gyɔlɔɔ na baláti-mi emeyi muedi baláka, asa na likpi buɛɛ na mina kaduli.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, na nka línye kpakplaa aani kugyii kɔni mɔɔkɛ́ ntu uwi biala, na amii muedi alákwii kuna evete lɛlɔ usien umodi ƒui.

english_verse: Everyone listened in silence to my welcome advice,
translation_verse: “Bekyuli bése atu bénu-mi butemi uwi biala, na báwia ka benu mina bɔlɛ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: and when I finished speaking, nothing needed to be said.
translation_verse: Na sɔsɔ si lɛ́su-ma lɛla lɛdi ni, basɔ balákya unyeƒi ɔdi, mmomu baaƒɔ́-ni kpoo.

english_verse: My words were eagerly accepted like the showers of spring,
translation_verse: Bátaaƒɔ-mi etemila aani kalɛ na baawia ketudi ɔnantu.

english_verse: and the smile on my face renewed everyone's hopes.
translation_verse: Na si bánu-mi ka mɔɔmɔsi ni, lɛlɔyɔ sɔɔn mɔɔƒɔ́-ma lɛlɔ kemmo, na beesé kayi ku lɛnunsia.

english_verse: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
translation_verse: Líti lɛ́sia lɛlɔ aani bana ɔtɔnkune kalɛ na ńtaatina-ma kasiakɔ kabuni aani kalɛ na bekpone unengu ɔɔtɔnku nwuna bekpone. Na mɔɔyala-ma kɔƒɔ na mɔɔkya-ma ogya si enu áƒɛ-ma.”

english_verse: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
translation_verse: “Ɔmwi ni, bakloƒu bákɛ-mi benye beedumi ɔni na nka bana bati muedi ni, bátamanku mina bakpewe bani mɔɔnu-mi baƒonu lɛlɔ na babla kabla basala.

english_verse: And those who insult me are helpless themselves.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani muudumi-mi mmɔ alati beeebo kablakɔ kadi.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Na baabɔku-ma taalɛku lɛma kemmo aani beyune ku ayoli.

english_verse: Their only homes are ditches or holes between rocks,
translation_verse: Awɛ ku lɛbonka kemmo na bábla bana kuliekɔ na atakpɛ akɔ.

english_verse: where they bray like donkeys gathering around shrubs.
translation_verse: Na baabla kudu mmɔ aani bebuo ala betine nánu livo lɛni baakun.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Na si bátásala lisu ni, baabɔku-ma taatɔlɔku mmɔ aani bebuo ala betine bani neeebo kasusu.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: “Nsu ɔmwi ni, ami mmomu nénwini ɔkungyii líte bekyuli bamɛni udu, na bada-mi lɛnyi baatu ɔnu taavinku kesi kesii.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Muusé-ma lɛlɔ, na beenye taabwɛ lisuo muedi teewi-mi

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Na ka Katɔti ɔ́yila-mi udu na nsɔ liiibo kablakɔ kadi ɔsu ni, baakana na babla lɛla lɛni na baayɔ́ ƒaa na ɔɔɔkɛ-ma.

english_verse: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
translation_verse: Báda-mi ulu na báka-mi bákya lɛƒɛnyi ƒui lɛlɔ kalɛ na bayila-mi udu, na ukyuli ɔdi uuubo na ɔbala-ma.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Liƒu sɔɔn náka lɛ́mana-mi ɔƒɛni amu. Na mina lɛkɛ o-o, mina lɛnyi lɛni na lɛ́ƒɔ o-o, ana ƒui áyii ákya-mi, aani kalɛ na liƒlukutu lɛɛyii taakya kayaa.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: “Na bɔsa kani na mina ngba bɔ́sa búsela, ɔsika mina lɛbibo liiibo kawɔkɔ kadi.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Katɔti úsusu-mi ɔlɔna aani kalɛ na baaƒɛ kɔdi. Únyimi-mi limɔ na mɔɔyɔ́ likpi muedi.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: Na úbo-mi útákya aba kemmo ɔni na ami ɔlati ɔmmɔ utulo ka aba ammɔ na línwini.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: “O Unwoti, lɛ́kpali-ɔ, nsu éni na átakpete-mi. Na lɛ́ta línye, nsu ébulo na bunye kani na enye aanu-mi ɔnusɛ.

english_verse: God has turned brutal,
translation_verse: Ɔƒaani ulikplu ala geen na enye aabla-mi.

english_verse: stirring up a windstorm to toss me about.
translation_verse: Na édie ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ákya-mi na uubó-mi taavinku.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: Ngyi nwaa ka kekpine kammɔ na éti-mi éselaku, ɔsika kesiekɔ na kadi kete ukyuli ɔyawine biala.

english_verse: No one refuses help to others, when disaster strikes.
translation_verse: “Nsu ni, nka ukyuli ɔni na ala étulo na uuvele kebunku ni, basɔ belekpoku-nwu.

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Nsu ka ami muuvele kebunku na lɛkɛ bɔnwuna ni, ɔgbankpi kani na lɛ́siaku na ɔƒɛ ɔ́sa ɔ́kya-mi na mina ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: Lɛƒɛda lɛ́ƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui na nnye muususu lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi. Na lɛbibo kani náƒɔ-mi ngba emeyi ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: Lɛbibo línwini aani ɔƒɛ na ɔ́kyula-mi ɔlɔna ɔ́bla tonwu tonwu. Na bekyuli kasakɔ na muunye taakpali-ɔ teevele nnii bo bebunku-mi.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: Na muuwulo kɔnyana keku aani beƒukutu iye bekuku.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: Mina ɔlɔna ɔ́kywi ɔ́bla tonwu na ɔɔvumi. Na lɛlɔ kemmo kaadu-mi teetéduoku-mi ekubi kemmo kemmo.

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: “Líse kenye ka lɛɛɛdubo ugblebi ɔdi ɔnusɛ bɔnu na ɔda-mi ɔkwɛ.

english_verse: God All-Powerful punishes men who do that.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ulátunaku bekyuli bammɔ udu, mmomu ɔɔní-ma kɔtu.

english_verse: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
translation_verse: Geen ni, Unwoti ɔɔyá na ɔgbankpi ɔɔsiáku bekyuli bani mɔɔbla ekpidi.

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔgyi mina kasiakɔ ƒui ku kalɛ na mɔɔbla ala taavinku.

english_verse: I am not dishonest or deceitful,
translation_verse: “Na ɔgyi ka mɔɔdi nwuna etemila ƒui lɛlɔ na naaanyi ɔkɔ.

english_verse: If I have disobeyed him or even wanted to,
translation_verse: Na si lɛ́bla atuɔkplu na línwini kama lɛ́kya-nwu iye lɛ́bla kasusu muedi na likpidi lɛdi lɛlɔ ni,

english_verse: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her,
translation_verse: “Si ukyuli bamba uleku ɔdi úgyie-mi anumi na lɛ́wia nnii mɔɔƒɔ́-nwu linwini mina ɔdi ni,

english_verse: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
translation_verse: na ukyuli bamba uƒie mina uleku lɛnɔ ɔƒɔ-mi kudɔ.

english_verse: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
translation_verse: Ɔsika si líƒie ukyuli ɔdi uleku lɛ́ƒɔ ni, agyi anii ɔdi-mi likpidi bonwu geen lɛni ndanku kɔtu bɔni.

english_verse: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ ɔdi ogya ɔni mɔɔkyula ala na kekpine na ɔɔkyula ukyuli ala ƒui taatálɛ kalɔ kemmo edula lɛnɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When my servants complained against me, I was fair to them.
translation_verse: “Si mina kabla ɔblane ɔnanabi iye ulekubi ɔdi úti lɛla lɛni muukpóku-nwu úboku-mi ni, mɔɔtɛ-ni teete-nwu ulu lɛlɔ na naaanyi ɔkɔ.

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Ɔdi litemi geen ka Katɔti néte bula ƒui ngba asa na badubɔwɔ-bu beboku kayawi kamɛni kemmo.

english_verse: I have never cheated widows or others in need,
translation_verse: “Na ńtanya bekpinele ńtakya iye bani mɔɔyaki lɛla lɛdi na belie beteebo abi.

english_verse: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
translation_verse: Na líle mina adila líte bani na kɔka kɔɔda ku bekpinebi.

english_verse: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si-mi lɛnamu uwi ƒui na muubunku bekpinebi ku bekpinele.

english_verse: I provided clothes for the poor,
translation_verse: Muute bawabane adala,

english_verse: and I was praised for supplying woolen garments to keep them warm.
translation_verse: ɔni na béteemwi-mi kalɛ na ńteete-ma lɛkuntu na baabɛ́ kɔyɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: Na ńtasia ulu ɔdi lɛlɔ na lɛyila ukpenebi ɔdi iye lɛnya-nwu lɛkya, ka mbo ɔyikun iye kenyekɔ ɔsu na litemi katɛkɔ.

english_verse: I hope that arm will fall from its socket.
translation_verse: Na si lɛ́bla ala amɛni ɔdi ni, na baya na bekulo mina enu bedie mina amangba lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
translation_verse: Ka mɔɔyia Katɔti kɔtu kɔni na ɔdubɔni-mi si lɛ́bla lɛla lɛmmɔ udu ku kalɛ na uukeye ɔsu ni, naaabla kasusu muedi na lɛla lɛni na lise lɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I have never trusted the power of wealth,
translation_verse: “Ńteti mina anu biala ńtasia lɛkɛ udu ɔdi lɛlɔ aani mina kama kekpokɔ.

english_verse: or taken pride in owning many possessions. *
translation_verse: Na ńtakun lɛmɛnɛ lɛnɔ na lɛkɛ lɛmmɔ lɛdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I have never openly or secretly
translation_verse: Na ńtanu ɔƒɛ iye kɔbuli bukeye na lɛkya lili kalɔ lite ɔdi.

english_verse: worshiped the sun or moon.
translation_verse: Na ńtabɛ na liti lɛla lɛdi ńtákpa lite ɔdi.

english_verse: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.
translation_verse: “Lɛlɔ lítayɔ-mi kudii si lɛ́nu ka mina ukisine ɔdi uubó abi iye úduo ɔgbankpi ɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
translation_verse: Na ńtevele Katɔti kudii lɛnɔ nnii ɔya na ɔgbankpi iye ewida adi asiaku-ma na bekpi.

english_verse: No one ever went hungry at my house,
translation_verse: Na ńteni mina kaduli bekyuli ku kabla bablane ɔdi adila ku lɛna bute kudii.

english_verse: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
translation_verse: Ńteti mina ekpidi adi ńtabɛla bekyuli kalɛ na badi baabɛla bana ekpidi taakya kayi kemmo banii ɔdi utati.

english_verse: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
translation_verse: Na lɛɛɛdaku lɛla lɛni na bekyuli badubɔsu basiku-mi lɛlɔ iye bana edumi. Na ńtabɛla lɛlɔ ńtakya kaduli na mina ɔbladu ɔdi ɔsu.

english_verse: Then I would wear his charges on my clothes and forehead.
translation_verse: Na ndubuti bɔƒiɔ bɔmmɔ lɛsia lɛmangba na liti libi lili aani kagabwa na ukyuli biala ɔnu-mu nwaa.

english_verse: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
translation_verse: Na lɛla biala na lɛ́bla ni, ndubuse anumi na linye Katɔti anumi na lɛsu-nwu ana ƒui kede kede aani ɔga ubi kalɛ.

english_verse: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
translation_verse: “Na mina kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na mɔɔtuma ni, keléwulo taakya-mi ka buƒie na líƒie-ka lɛ́ƒɔ ukyuli ɔdi kudɔ.

english_verse: Nor have I cheated my workers and caused them pain.
translation_verse: Na ńtedie kana edula lɛnɔ ńtadi kalɛ na mina kabla bablane bani geen nátuma-ka bakɛ ku kɔka.

english_verse: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
translation_verse: Mmomu si lɛ́bla ala amɛni ɔdi ni, na aya na antabi ku kakpa ku edula ani ƒui na lɛ́kya ayii akya, na liyu ku alakpi ekpidi aƒɔ kemmo kammɔ ƒui.”

english_verse: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
translation_verse: Na ala amɛni ƒui kawɔlɔkɔ ni, Hiob bakpana ɛtɛ bammɔ báda unyeƒi bɔkya ku Hiob báya, ɔsika úni ɔnii ulenu kalɔ ɔnii anwu nábla lɛla likpidi lɛdi.

english_verse: Elihu from Buz was there, and he had become upset with Job for blaming God instead of himself.
translation_verse: Nsu Barakel ubidi Elihu ɔni ndi Busini na ɔ́si Ram ɔtɔ kemmo mɛni úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya Hiob geen na ɔni na uni ɔnii ulaƒɔ enu ka ɔ́ƒiɔ, na Katɔti mmomu na ɔɔdú kɔtɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́kɛku nwuna bakpana bakladi lɛnɔ kɔnyi ka bátakana na bati lɛla lɛdi basu Hiob na ɔnu ɔti ka ɔ́ƒiɔ. Nsu kɔtɔ kani na benye baadú-nwu banii útati bɔbla.

english_verse: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
translation_verse: Elihu ndi Hiob bakpana bammɔ akɔ ɔnamudi ƒui, anwuɔsu úte kuƒi na nwuna batɔnkune báka bɔtɛmi.

english_verse: But he became irritated when they could not answer Job,
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔni na ɔ́nu ka nwuna batɔnkune bátakana na bedie batina Hiob ka anwu náƒiɔ Katɔti ni, ɔ́kɛku-ma kɔnyi.

english_verse: I once believed age was the source of wisdom;
translation_verse: Na lɛ́su mina lɛlɔ nnii muute-mii kuƒi na amii bani ndi mina batɔnkune bɛtɛmi bina lɛnunda kɔtɛ.

english_verse: now I truly realize wisdom comes from God.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒaani ni, lɛ́nu lɛ́ti ka lɛnunda ni, Katɔti muuti-ni teete ukyuli.

english_verse: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
translation_verse: “Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na mɔɔsu-mii nnii bise atu na ami lɛnɔ lɛsu-mii lɛla lɛni na ngyi.

english_verse: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
translation_verse: “Hiob útasu lɛla lɛdi na ɔta unye-mi lɛlɔ iye ɔtu-mi kenye kadi. Na lɛnɔ ni, lɛɛɛdubo bina unyeƒi ɔni na bɛɛkya mmɔ etemila buti budie-nwu lɛla lɛdi kenye.

english_verse: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
translation_verse: “Hiob, bana kenye kékpi na basɔ baaagyi lɛla lɛni na basu-ɔ, ɔsika etemila ása-ma kenye.

english_verse: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
translation_verse: Etemila emomo-mi kenye na lɛsu, na Katɔti Kɔyu néti ala amɛni ɔ́kya-mi kenye. Na unye-mi lɛlɔ uudí-mi ka lɛsu-nya lɛlɛku.

english_verse: I am like a swollen wineskin, and I will burst
translation_verse: Aanu, ami ukyuli umodi ɔmmɔ nse aani ntɛ ku ɔsii ɔni na bétile-nwu kenye na úƒu na ɔɔyɔ́ utulo ɔbwɛ.

english_verse: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
translation_verse: Na lɛɛɛdubo ɔdi anumi bɔnu bɔnyi ɔkɔ bɔtɔlɔ-mii.

english_verse: Job, listen to me! Pay close attention. *
translation_verse: “Na ɔƒaani ni, Hiob, se atu kaduɛ na enu lɛla lɛni na ndubo-ɔ bɔsu.

english_verse: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.
translation_verse: Katɔti Kɔyu návɔ-mi na kúte-mi ngba ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni na ɔkya-mi lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites,
translation_verse: Lɛti na béti bávɔ bula ƒui, na Katɔti ulánu ukyuli ɔdi anumi taabla lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do. I Have Heard You Argue
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu tayia-mi iye lɛla lɛni na ndubo bɔbla.

english_verse: I have heard you argue
translation_verse: “Línu unyeƒi ɔni ƒui na enye aakya.

english_verse: that you are innocent, guilty of nothing.
translation_verse: Aasu anii awɔ ni, lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-a na átaƒiɔ lɛnɔ, na átabla likpidi lɛdi.

english_verse: You claim that God has made you his enemy,
translation_verse: Na aasu taatina ka Unwoti Katɔti úti-ɔ únwini nwuna ukisine.

english_verse: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.
translation_verse: Na úbo kɔgba ɔ́bala-a lɛgba, na unye ɔɔtú-ɔ na ƒula kasiakɔ ƒui.

english_verse: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.
translation_verse: “Nsu mɔɔsu-ɔ geen nnii ƒula litemi liiibo ubo, ɔsika Katɔti utulo ukyuli biala.

english_verse: So why do you challenge God to answer you?
translation_verse: Na bi ɔsu na aakyaku-nwu unyeƒi anii ulákpete-ɔ, na ulédie lɛla lɛni na eeye-nwu kenye ulete-ɔ?

english_verse: God does this to make us turn from sin and pride
translation_verse: “Ɔɔwia ka bekyuli benwini na bada bana udu ukpidi ku lɛlɔ katɔ bɔkɔliku baya.

english_verse: and to protect us from being swept away to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔwia ka bakɛ ngba bɔƒɔ kalɛ na balayii udu ƒui asa na betéduo kekpine.

english_verse: Merely the thought of our favorite food makes our stomachs sick,
translation_verse: Na ɔlɛ ɔmɛni udu ɔɔdu ukyuli teetédu ka uni adila muedi. Na lɛla lɛni mɔɔda-nwu kubiti geen ni, ɔsɔ ulayɔ-ni.

english_verse: and we become so skinny that our bones stick out.
translation_verse: Na ɔlɔgyii ɔni nátaadia bɔnu dii mmɔ ɔsa ɔyii udu, na anu ka ekubi ekubi kani nébu.

english_verse: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.
translation_verse: Na kukpi kɔɔní teede-nwu, na kaƒiɔtɔ kenye kagyumana ka keƒie-nwu kebweli.

english_verse: One of a thousand angels then comes to our rescue by saying we are innocent.
translation_verse: “Nsu Katɔti batu pii bammɔ akɔ unwi ɔdubo na ubedie ɔtina-nwu lɛla lɛni ndi lɛbuni lɛni na ɔlɛka ɔbla.

english_verse: The angel shows kindness, commanding death to release us, because the price was paid.
translation_verse: Na ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔɔnu ukyuli ɔmmɔ ku lɛƒɔndia na ɔbɔku kukpi ku kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ ƒui ɔnii betebo-nwu lɛkpu, ɔsika báaƒɔ kayu biala na nwuna lili.

english_verse: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔɔkpali Katɔti, na ɔɔnu-nwu kɔnyana. Na ka ɔɔnu Katɔti anumi ɔsu ni, uubó lɛlɔyɔ kudu. Na Katɔti ɔɔsɔku ukyuli ɔmmɔ teenyene nwuna kenyekɔ kani nse siin.

english_verse: When that happens, we tell everyone, “I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me
translation_verse: Na si úbo ute lɛni ni, ɔɔsu na kadi ƒui anumi ɔnini, ‘Lɛ́bla likpidi na mina ɔdi útatɛ. Nsu Katɔti útani-mi kɔtu kɔni na nka ɔ́manku ka ɔni-mi.

english_verse: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.”
translation_verse: Údie-mi ɔ́siku kukpi enu kemmo na ńteduo kekpine. Mmomu ɔ́ya na nsɔ nlie ngba.’

english_verse: God gives each of us chance after chance
translation_verse: “Katɔti ɔɔbla ɔmɛni teete ukyuli kunyɔ ku kɔtɛ taasia kama.

english_verse: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.
translation_verse: Ɔɔwia ka udie-nwu kɔyu na kukpi kemmo ƒui uduoku bukeye bɔni ndubɔya na ulie ngba ku lɛlɔyɔ kemmo.

english_verse: though I would gladly listen to anything you say that proves you are right.
translation_verse: ina ka ndubɔyɔ ka linu ala ani ƒui na ebo na asu atina ka átaƒiɔ.

english_verse: You men think you are wise, but just listen to me!
translation_verse: “Bise atu na binu-mi litemi, amii banundane ku bakutine benengudi.

english_verse: Think about my words, as you would taste food.
translation_verse: Ɔsika atu na beeti teenu etemila taati-nya unu aani kalɛ na unyemi uutú adila kenye taati-nya emini.

english_verse: Then we can decide the case and give a just verdict.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔya na buduo etemila ammɔ kemmo bɔnu kaduɛ asa na budie lɛni ndia litulo.

english_verse: Job claims he is innocent and God is guilty of mistreating him.
translation_verse: “Hiob ɔɔsu ɔnini, ‘Mbo ubo, ɔsika ńtaƒiɔ. Nsu Katɔti ulátɛ-mi litemi na ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Job also argues that God considers him a liar and that he is suffering severely in spite of his innocence.
translation_verse: Na ina ka nse siin ni, Katɔti úti-mi únwini ɔkɔ ɔnyine, na ɔ́ya na muunú ɔlɛ geen na mina lɛlɔ kemmo ɔni na ńtabla lɛla lɛdi.’

english_verse: He spends his time with sinners,
translation_verse: Na úti lɛlɔ ɔ́bla alaekpidi bablane ɔkpana, ɔsika ɔ́su lɛnɔ ɔnini,

english_verse: because he has said, “It doesn't pay to please God.” If Any of You Are Smart
translation_verse: ‘Kɔsia kɔdi kuuubo-nwu kemmo ka ukyuli unye utaabla Katɔti lɛƒɔyɔ.’

english_verse: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.
translation_verse: “Ɔmmɔ ɔsu, amii banwa bani mbo kasusu na biinú ala kalɔ ni, bise atu. Katɔti ulábla lɛla lɛdi na lɛdi likpidi!

english_verse: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si lɛla biala kalɔ kesekɔ ƒui ni, Katɔti kani mɔɔdi kayawi kamɛni ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us,
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́nwuna ɔ́kya-bu lɛlɔ kemmo ni, si ɔ́sɔ ɔ́ƒɔ nwuna ala ɔ́lɛku-bu lɛlɔ kemmo ni,

english_verse: we humans would die and return to the soil.
translation_verse: bukpi kani na bula ƒui bɔdubo na bɔsɔ bunwini lɛti.

english_verse: So be smart and listen!
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu bɛda anu na bise atu na binu!

english_verse: The mighty God is the one who brings about justice, and you are condemning him.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔni ntulo lɛla biala mɔɔtɛ litemi biala siin kalɛ na ɔ́manku, nsu anwu na awɔ enye aadú kɔtɔ ɔƒaani.

english_verse: Indeed, God is the one who condemns unfair rulers.
translation_verse: Geen ni, lɛlɔ badine bani na balábla ala ulu lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti mɔɔdú-ma kɔtɔ.

english_verse: And God created us all; he has no favorites, whether rich or poor.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti nédie abu bekyuli ƒui. Ɔlakɛne na adi o-o, ɔwabane na adi o-o ni, ulánu bana ɔdi anumi taabla lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
translation_verse: Kukpi kuuyú bekyuli taatu usien ntɛ ɔni na baaagyi beeese na bekpi. Na lɛlɔ badine bayikune ngba bɔɔdá liku, na ɔmmɔ uuubo Katɔti ɔkplu munu munu.

english_verse: God watches everything we do.
translation_verse: “Ɔsika ɔɔnu bekyuli ƒui ablala na lɛla lɛdi lítabɛ-nwu.

english_verse: No evil person can hide in the deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ukpidi ɔdi ulakana bɔbɛ bɔkya kasuudikɔ kani na Katɔti ulakana-nwu bɔnu.

english_verse: And so, God doesn't need to set a time for judgment.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na Katɔti ulése limeyi ulete bekyuli ka beténye litemi katɛkɔ na kesii kadi.

english_verse: Without asking for advice, God removes mighty leaders and puts others in their place.
translation_verse: Katɔti uléye ukyuli ɔdi kasusu asa na ɔɔbɔku lɛlɔ badine bayikune teedie bana kunyekɔ, na uuti bekyuli bamba teenyene mmɔ.

english_verse: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔgyi-ma ɔbladu biala, anwuɔsu usien unwi kani na ɔɔyila-ma udu ƒui kede kede.

english_verse: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil
translation_verse: Na kadi ƒui anumi na Katɔti ɔɔní alaekpidi bablane kɔtu.

english_verse: The persons they mistreated had prayed for help, until God answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Na báya na bawabane kɔvanu kúbedu Katɔti kudɔ na ulikplu ala ani na baabla-ma ɔsu, na ɔ́bla bana lɛƒɔyɔ úte-ma.

english_verse: But still, he punishes rulers who abuse their people.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli baaadubo lɛla lɛdi bɔkana bɔbla, na belikplune bada-ma lɛlɔ bɔdi baya.

english_verse: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.
translation_verse: “Hiob, bɔsu na ɔlɛka asu Katɔti anii áƒiɔ, na eekpi-nwu kɔtɔ. Na ɔmɛni kama ni, adubo lɛla lɛni mayɔ-nwu kaƒɔ butaabla.

english_verse: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.
translation_verse: Na ɔlɛka evele-nwu na udie ƒula bɔƒiɔ ɔtina-a, kalɛ na asɔ alabla lɛla lɛmɛni alasia kama.

english_verse: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
translation_verse: Awɔ muute ɔda bubo, munuu Katɔti? Awɔ ɔlati die lɛmmɔ kenye, na ɔɔɔdi ami masu mete-ɔ. Anwuɔsu die ƒula kasusu tina.

english_verse: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
translation_verse: ‘Hiob ulábla kasusu na ɔnu ala kemmo siin asa na ɔtɛmi, anwuɔsu na kɔdɔlɔ kɔ́ƒɔ-nwu atɛ kemmo.’

english_verse: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubɔyɔ ka ebo abi ammɔ etédu kesii kani na ɔ́manku, ɔsika aatɛmi enyekpi aani alaekpidi ɔblane.

english_verse: You have rebelled against God, time after time, and have even insulted us.
translation_verse: Ƒula ɔbladu ƒui ɔ́ta únye Katɔti lɛlɔ. Na ɔmmɔ kama muedi budumi na asɔ eedumi-nwu.”

english_verse: Elihu said:
translation_verse: Elihu úye Hiob ɔnini,

english_verse: Job, are you really innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: “Hiob, aabu anii ese siin áwɔlɔ na Katɔti anumi, na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-a?

english_verse: Don't you honestly believe it pays to obey him?
translation_verse: Na eeye anii bi kɔsia geen na ákɛ ɔni na ádi Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
translation_verse: “Ya na lidie litemi lɛmmɔ kenye lite-ɔ, na ƒula bakpana lɛnɔ benu.

english_verse: Look up to the heavens
translation_verse: Nwini nu liƒlukutu lɛni nƒa-a eli katɔ katɔ mmɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?
translation_verse: Na si bɔda na áda lɛlɔ siin na átabla likpidi lɛdi lɛnɔ ni, bi na éte Katɔti iye bi kɔsia na ɔ́kɛ ɔ́siku-ɔ kudɔ?

english_verse: The evil or good you do only affects other humans.
translation_verse: Ƒula ekpidi ku abuni ani na aabla ni, bekyuli kani na adanku.

english_verse: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
translation_verse: Nsu si uwi ɔni na Katɔti údie-ma ɔ́lɛku bana lɛbibo lɛmmɔ kemmo ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, basɔ belényimo teeye banii wɛ na bana Udiene ɔmmɔ ɔkya,

english_verse: though he makes us wiser than animals or birds.
translation_verse: ina ka anwu nábla-bu na bɔ́da anu butulo bebuo iye baasɛ.

english_verse: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.
translation_verse: Katɔti ulákpete bekyuli bani mɔɔta teenye-nwu lɛlɔ, na bebo ulikplu na baatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ.

english_verse: If God All-Powerful refuses to answer their empty prayers,
translation_verse: Kekeeke na beenye taakpali Katɔti, ɔsika ɔɔɔdubo-ma bɔkpete ku bana kenyekplu etemila ammɔ.

english_verse: he will surely deny your impatient request to face him in court.
translation_verse: Na awɔ anii alánu Katɔti ɔmmɔ, nsu ƒula litemi lɛkya-nwu kudɔ na bɛdubo bunye bɔtɛ. Ɔɔɔdubo-ɔ bɔkpete, na bɛdubɔsa na litemi katɛkɔ.

english_verse: Job, you were wrong to say God doesn't punish sin.
translation_verse: Hiob, kenye kani na ásu anii Katɔti ulani likpidi kɔtu ni, naaabu nnii ɔdi sɔsɔ.

english_verse: Everything you have said adds up to nonsense.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ala ani ƒui na ásu adi atɛ keeke.”

english_verse: Elihu said:
translation_verse: Elihu ɔnini,

english_verse: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
translation_verse: “Kɛku-mi kayi blii bu, ɔsika mbo lɛla lɛdi na lɛsu lidie Katɔti kenye.

english_verse: God always does right— and this knowledge comes straight from God.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔɔbla ala kaduɛ uwi biala. Na Katɔti ɔmmɔ kudɔ kani na lɛ́ti ɔmɛni lɛ́siku.

english_verse: You can rest assured that what I say is true.
translation_verse: Na akana na aƒɔ adi geen ka lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu mɛni lɛdi sɔsɔ.

english_verse: Although God is mighty, he cares about everyone and makes fair decisions.
translation_verse: “Na ina ka Katɔti ɔdi Ɔyikune Ƒui ni, uleni ukyuli ɔdi, mmomu ɔɔnu lɛla biala kemmo kaduɛ.

english_verse: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
translation_verse: Ulaya na balalane beelie teetu uwi, na ɔɔtɛ bawabane etemila teete-ma ulu lɛlɔ siin.

english_verse: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli babuni ama ni, Katɔti ɔɔnu-ma lɛlɔ kaduɛ, na uuti-ma teenyene kesii kani na káƒɔ kuye, na baakɛ́ ɔyikun taadi bekyuli lɛlɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Nsu si lɛbibo ku lɛlɔ ɔlɛ bunu búnyimi bekyuli aani batɔntɛne na bana ɔbladu ɔsu ni,

english_verse: God points out their sin and their pride,
translation_verse: Katɔti uudie bana ekpidi ku ablala ani mɔɔta teenye-nwu lɛlɔ taatina-ma.

english_verse: then he warns them to turn back to him.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔyá na beenú-nwu bɔlɛ, na bana ekpidi eduo-ma, na benwini kama bakya-nya.

english_verse: And if they obey, they will be successful and happy from then on.
translation_verse: Na si bádi Katɔti litemi lɛlɔ na baabla-nwu kabla na bana uwi ɔkladi kemmo ni, keyi kaayɔ́ku-ma, na ala aatɛ-ma na beelie ƒaa.

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Nsu si béni na bétenu-nwu litemi ni, badubo bukpi na kuwii kenye, na bayii udu ɔni na baaagyi beeese.

english_verse: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.
translation_verse: “Bekyuli bani na baaagyi Katɔti ni, beeti kɔnyi kukpidi taavili. Na baaagyi kalɛ na bevele Katɔti na ubunku-ma si uwi ɔni na ɔɔní-ma kɔtu.

english_verse: So they die young in shameful disgrace.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na balábi lɛlɔ asa na beekpi ku kɔƒa.

english_verse: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
translation_verse: “Na uwi ɔmɛni lɛlɔ geen na Katɔti ɔɔwia ka ɔda-a udie lɛbibo lɛmɛni kemmo na use-ɔ adila kadikɔ ku ala abuni geen ani mɔɔyɔ́-ɔ kaƒɔ.

english_verse: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒaani ni, unye ɔɔní-ɔ kɔtu kɔni námanku-ɔ na ƒula ekpidi ani na ábla ɔsu.

english_verse: don't let your anger and the pain you endured make you sneer at God.
translation_verse: Sia lɛlɔ anu, na taya na lɛkɛ iye ala bɔbɛ teete ukyuli bɔtɔlɔ-ɔ na ayila ulu geen ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Your reputation and riches cannot protect you from distress,
translation_verse: Ƒula kenyekɔ ku lɛkɛ iye lɛnyi lɛni na ebo lilakana-a bɔƒɔ na alɛ lɛbibo lɛmɛni kemmo.

english_verse: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.
translation_verse: Sia lɛlɔ anu na enye kagyumana, na eleti ƒula lɛlɔ alatákya likpidi bɔbla kemmo anii aasia mmɔ na ekeli alɛ lɛbibo lɛmɛni kemmo.

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: Awɔ lɛnɔ se likpo na ebunku bekyuli bamba bani nánu ala ani na Katɔti ɔ́bla ɔsu na beedie lɛnu teemwi-nwu, na awɔ lɛnɔ emwi-nwu.

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Bekyuli ƒui bánu ɔmɛni báti básiku ɔgyu kakaaka kesii kani na benye baanu teemene.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Katɔti úbomo utulo bula bekyuli bayawine kasusu ala kalɔ bunu! Lɛni kani na bula ɔdi ulakana-nwu akwa bɔka.

english_verse: God gathers moisture into the clouds
translation_verse: “Katɔti mɔɔyá na kayaa liƒlukutu lɛɛƒɔ́ ntu, na uunwíni ɔnantu.

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔɔyá na katɔ kaabwɛ ogya na kayaa ƒui kekeye, nsu ɔɔbala ɛpu na nwuna kalɔ kemmo ƒui kabla suu.

english_verse: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
translation_verse: Ulu ɔmɛni kani udu lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔɔsia, na ɔɔnu kayawi bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ na baakɛ́ taadi teemo.

english_verse: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target,
translation_verse: Na kayaa kani mɔɔbwɛ ogya kese aani atula ani nkya Katɔti kɔnu, na uubó taalɛ lɛva lɛni lɛlɔ na ɔ́lɛ lɛnumi.

english_verse: I am frightened and tremble all over,
translation_verse: “Liƒu líƒie-mi na lɛlɔ ƒui lɛɛtɔ́-mi,

english_verse: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder,
translation_verse: uwi ɔni na línu Katɔti lɛdi kalɛ na ɔɔkwanyi na katɔ budu bɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.
translation_verse: Nwuna bukeye bɔ́bwɛ ogya bɔ́vi kayaa kammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: creating miracles too marvelous for us to understand.
translation_verse: Na akɔla budie taatina lidu lidu lɛɛlɛ́ na kayaa, ɔni na bula ɔdi ulakana-nya kalɔ bunu.

english_verse: and they force animals to seek shelter.
translation_verse: Bebuo ƒui lɛnɔ baabɛ́ taakya bana libu kemmo ku kɔkyakɔ.

english_verse: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni na ɔɔnwuna teewi ntukpa bonwu lɛlɔ ni, ɔɔyá na ntu bɔmmɔ buunwíni etubankɛ.

english_verse: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command,
translation_verse: Ɔɔyá na liƒlukutu lɛɛdanku ntu na lɛɛbwɛ ogya na kayaa kammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: to release their cargo— sometimes as punishment for sin, sometimes as kindness. Consider Carefully
translation_verse: Na ɔɔyá na ɔnantu ɔɔna na uuti taaní bekyuli kɔtu na bana ablala ɔsu, iye ɔya na ɔna uwi kalɔ kalɛ na edula adia.

english_verse: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.
translation_verse: “Hiob, wi lɛlɔ buɛɛ na asɔku kasusu abla asiku Katɔti akɔla ala budie taatina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Can you explain why lightning flashes at the orders
translation_verse: Bɔgyi na agyi kalɛ na Katɔti ɔɔdanku liƒlukutu taavinku kayaa, na ɔɔyá na kayaa kaabwɛ ogya?

english_verse: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
translation_verse: Na bɔgyi na agyi kalɛ Katɔti ɔni ngyi ala ƒui ɔ́bla liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ na lɛƒa kayaa ɔsu na lilanu?

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: Si liwulu ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔ́si kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ úbo na lɛƒɔ kayawi ni, kayaa kégyie aani abuala egyiedi na use aani bɔyɛɛlɛ na ukyuli ɔdubo.

english_verse: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
translation_verse: Bɔkana na adubɔkana na ebunku Katɔti na bibimi kayaa bɛƒala katɔ aani lɛbuala ligyiedi kɔɔlɛ kɔni békuo kede kede na kuukeye aani asogya?

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: “Tina-bu lɛla lɛni na bɔdubɔsu Katɔti, ɔsika bula kasusu kese-bu suu, na bɔɔɔgyi lɛla lɛni na bɔsu bɔsiku lɛla lɛmɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
translation_verse: Buti na muuti mina ngba lɛtu ugyii na lise kayi lɛsu Katɔti nnii mɔɔyɔ́ lɛtɛmiku-nwu na mina ngba bɔyii udu?

english_verse: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ulakana ɔƒɛ bɔnu ku anumi nwaa si ɔƒɛƒɛɛ úbo liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ ƒui ɔ́timi-nwu anumi na uukeye.

english_verse: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti bukeye bɔni muudie lɛlɔ taasiku kalɔ kammɔ katɔ kakɛ na buuwi lɛla biala lɛlɔ ni, buukeye teetulo ɔƒɛ bukeye ƒui.

english_verse: God cannot be seen— but his power is great, and he is always fair.
translation_verse: Bulakana Katɔti bɔnu, nsu nwuna ɔyikun úbomo geen, na ɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ kaduɛ uwi biala.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na abu bekyuli bɔɔyia Katɔti, ɔsika bekyuli bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ na baakali ka báda anu ni, Katɔti ulánu-ma ɔnii badi lɛla lɛdi na nwuna anumi.”

english_verse: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́tɛmiku Hiob ɔ́siku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa kemmo ɔnini,

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: “Bi ɔsu na aatɛmi pii lɛni ka ɔɔɔdi lɛla lɛdi na agyi?

english_verse: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
translation_verse: Ɔƒaani ni, klibi lɛlɔ na ami ku-ɔ bɔsa! Áƒɔ ádi ka adubɔkana ala ani na ndubo-ɔ buye kenye budie?

english_verse: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
translation_verse: “Dɛ na lɛ́kya kayawi awodu ɔka kalɔ? Na wɛ na akya uwi ɔmmɔ?

english_verse: Doubtless you know who decided its length and width.
translation_verse: Ngyi ka agyi ukyuli ɔni nákɔku kayawi kammɔ bɔbɛbɛ ku bune na ati asu-mi!

english_verse: What supports the foundation? Who placed the cornerstone,
translation_verse: Kayawi kammɔ kalɔ ɔka ni, akpa amani nda-nwu? Na ɔma nékpo awodu ammɔ atu,

english_verse: while morning stars sang, and angels rejoiced?
translation_verse: asa na únwini lɛlɔyɔ lɛnu na ɔtanta lɛyabi ku katɔ batu beete yiiduu?

english_verse: and wrapped it in blankets of thickest fog.
translation_verse: Ɔma néti liƒlukutu bonwu lɛni nse aani kuntu ɔtondi ɔ́ka ɔ́mana-nwu?

english_verse: Then I built a wall around it, locked the gates,
translation_verse: Ɔma násia ubili úte-nwu aani kalɛ na baakalɛ lɛla lɛdi taakya ɔban kemmo?

english_verse: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
translation_verse: Ɔma nátina-nwu kesii kani na uyi ɔwɔ, na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnii nwuna ɔvɔlɔvɔ ani mɔɔta teebo atavia mmɔ?

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: “Hiob, na ƒula ngba emeyi kemmo ni, éebo ɔda éte limeyi lɛdi dii anii kadi kegye na ɔƒɛ ɔtu?

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: Na áaya na bukeye bɔmmɔ búsie bútéwi kayawi kammɔ ekpo ƒui, na ábɔku bekyuli bekpidi bani naaawia bukeye na békeli bátɔlɔ?

english_verse: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.
translation_verse: Kadi nwaa bukeye bɔɔyá na abi ƒui lɛlɔ aatina ku ala ani nkya-nya lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Na ka balalane balayɔ bukeye bɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, basɔ balakana na bataabla bana likyulikpi ala.

english_verse: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ɔban kayakun kani nákalɛ kekpine ni, ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́ɔtina-a kayakun kammɔ dii?

english_verse: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
translation_verse: Agyi kalɛ na kayawi kammɔ kébomo, na asu-mi?

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: “Agyi bukeye kaduli, na agyi kesii kani na lɛdisa lɛnɔ lilie?

english_verse: Can you lead them home?
translation_verse: Adubɔti-ma kɔkyakɔ na akpanku-ma etése?

english_verse: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
translation_verse: Lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di ka adubɔti ɔmɛni ƒui asu-mi, ɔsika báwɔ-ɔ uwi útu, na áabi lɛlɔ geen, na akya muedi asa na bédie kayawi kammɔ.

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: “Éesie kesii kani na lɛ́klibi etubankɛ atunkuli ku ani mɔɔna na ɔnantu kemmo líse?

english_verse: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
translation_verse: Lɛ́da-nya líse mmɔ líte ɔgbankpi limeyi kalɛ na liti lɛni bekyuli kɔtu na kekpokɔ.

english_verse: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
translation_verse: Ɔma námɛnɛ kuƒi úse úte ɔnantu ɔni mɔɔna ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔni muukpó ku kudu,

english_verse: on empty deserts where no one lives?
translation_verse: na uubo teebewi kalɔ kakwiidi kani lɛlɔ na ukyuli ɔdi uuulie lɛlɔ?

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: Na ɔma muute kalɔ kammɔ udu ntu na kaayɔ́ lɛlɔ, na livo lɛɛsɔ taakwɛ?

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: Bubo na ɔnantu ku amii ani mɔɔna bebo ɔti ɔni mɔɔtɔnku-ma?

english_verse: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost
translation_verse: Ɔma ndi ubi uni ɔni mɔɔwɔ kɔyɔ uwi ntu bɔni mɔɔba taavili na ɔɔbla etubankɛ,

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: na ɔɔyá na ntukpa ku ɛpu ntu ƒui buunyími taabla atabi atabi?

english_verse: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
translation_verse: Na adubɔkana na atɔnku ayabi esu ku ani mɔɔtina aani akɔkɔ ku bebi na alɛ ana uwi lɛlɔ?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: Ɔda bubo bɔni ndanku kayaa katɔ ala ni, adubɔkana na eti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ eboku na badi-mu lɛlɔ na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ?

english_verse: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
translation_verse: “Adubɔkana na ebo liƒlukutu ɔda anii uboku ɔnantu na aya na ɔna?

english_verse: or will lightning flash at your command?
translation_verse: Munuu kayaa na adubɔkana bɔya na kabwɛ ogya si édie lɛdi ákya-ka?

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Na awɔ ndubo baasɛ bɔtina uwi ɔni na ketudi kadubo iye ntukpa bɔdubo buyi?

english_verse: Can you count the clouds or pour out their water
translation_verse: Adubɔkana na ati liƒlukutu bumomo na ada-ni aani ntu libui na ewilimi ntu bɔmmɔ

english_verse: on the dry, lumpy soil?
translation_verse: ewi kalɔ kani nákwii na kaƒɔ ntu?

english_verse: Do you send an animal into their den?
translation_verse: uwi ɔni na batɛ bana atakpɛ libu kemmo iye bebi baatú lɛla lɛdi beƒie?

english_verse: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_verse: Na baasɛ bani nkɛ kayaa mɔɔví ni, awɔ muute-ma bebi adila si beewulo kɔka taakya-mi?”

english_verse: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
translation_verse: “Adubɔti asu uwi ɔni na alakpi akɔ bese bani na abi lɛlɔ ku bakwa baawɔ? Na éenye ánu-ma kawɔkɔ dii?

english_verse: How long are they pregnant
translation_verse: Agyi abuli ani na beeti taada kaƒɔ?

english_verse: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
translation_verse: Uwi ulétu asa na bebi bammɔ baabi lɛlɔ, na anu ka ama alati bakɛ baaví.

english_verse: I alone help them survive in salty desert sand.
translation_verse: Ami néte-ma bana kakyakɔ na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo kesii kani na kadi mma kalɔ.

english_verse: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.
translation_verse: Balátuna ka belie bede lɛma linengudi, kesii kani na lɛsɛ lɛkya. Na balátuna ka batumini-ma.

english_verse: Instead, they roam the hills, searching for pastureland.
translation_verse: Mmomu baakɛ taavi abi ƒui lɛlɔ taawia livo lɛni na bakun.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: “Bunu na akɔ ɔgyani ɔni na alakpi akɔ na ɔ́si ɔdubunu kalɔ ɔkya-a lɛyu kemmo na unye utaabla kabla kadi teete-ɔ?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Adubunye-nwu lɛlɔ na abala-nwu kɔgba anii ugulu kalɔ iye ugyingya lɛti uwi kesii kadi ute-ɔ?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: Áƒɔ ádi ka ɔdi ebuo ɔni na asia lɛnu anii ɔdubuti nwuna ɔyikun unengudi ɔmmɔ na ɔbla kabla kpakplaa kadi ute-ɔ?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: Na adubɔsia-nwu anu ka uti kamu ubewi-ɔ kakpa na ebo, na ɔni-ka ku kɛɛkɛ utése-ɔ unwu kudɔ?

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: “Aasɛ bonwu ɔdi ɔkya ɔni neeeveyi na nwuna unu ɔsu. Uubimi nwuna avwi na lɛlɔtina kani ɔsu. Nsu beleti-nwu balákɔku kasangbii.

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: Aasɛ bonwu ɔmmɔ uudie nwuna avala atu taakya lɛti akɔ na kalɔ kabla gugungu kada-nya.

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdaku si ebuo ɔdi ɔdububo ubanya-nya ɔbwɛ.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: Ɔɔbla nwuna avala aani si ɔɔɔdi anwu ɔlati náva-nya. Na ulábla-nwu aani nwuna lɛbibo lɛdubɔbla ukpludi.
