english_verse: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
translation_verse: Ami ɔlati nábla-nwu na ɔ́dɔlɔ lɛni, na uuubo kasusu kadi.

english_verse: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
translation_verse: Nsu si ánu ka úse kalɔ ku usi bukeli ni, ukyuli ɔni na uli ɔpɔnkɔ ɔni muukeli teetulo muedi ni, bɔma na ɔɔmá-nwu.

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: “Awɔ néte bapɔnkɔ ɔyikun ɔni na bebo ku bana amɔ linwini gyɔlɔɔ lɛni nwi-ma amɔ lɛ́ka lɛ́mana?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: Awɔ náya na baakana bɔƒulu aani bakpɔtilikpɔ, na beekpeyi enwu momoomo ku kudu kɔni mɔɔyila bekyuli?

english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: Asa na bapɔnkɔ bammɔ badubukeli bátásiaku bekisine bammɔ ni, beetú lɛgba kalɔ taatina bana ɔyikun.

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ na bekpone bani nli-ma lɛlɔ mmɔ beeƒwimi bana kuwii ku atula taavinku kayaa, na kuukeye na ɔƒɛ kemmo.

english_verse: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Balakana na benye liku linwi si bénu ka bávwi kekpo lise, mmomu bɔbla na baabla gyegyengye.

english_verse: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
translation_verse: Kekpo kammɔ ɔnyi ɔɔkya-ma ogya lɛlɔ kemmo si bénu-ka kɔku kakaaka muedi, na beekpeyi enwu kemmo ku kudu teedie kekpo ese ani na baavwi kenye.

english_verse: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
translation_verse: “Si kɔyɔ uwi ɔdubo ni, awɔ mɔɔtina basangbii kalɛ na beveyi bakɔ katɔ katɔ na batɔlɔ beteesie kɔlɔ kɔni nkya kada kakɛ?

english_verse: their nests on rocky cliffs,
translation_verse: Abi ammɔ eli ndi-nwu kama kekpokɔ kpakplaa kani na ɔɔkya.

english_verse: where they can look down to spot their next meal?
translation_verse: Mmɔ na uunye taanu nwuna lɛdila teemene ɔgyu kakaaka, na ɔɔsia-nya kama.

english_verse: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.
translation_verse: Nwuna bebi baakun lɛna ku ubugya. Na kesii kani na lɛla lɛdi líkpi lɛtɛ ni, mmɔ na ɔɔkya.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful,
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su Hiob ɔnini,

english_verse: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, nsu ákyaku-mi unyeƒi anii lɛla lɛni na ábla ndi lɛbuni. Na ɔƒaani ni, bo na ebedie kenye na linu.”

english_verse: Job said to the Lord:
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Hiob údie kenye ɔnini,

english_verse: Who am I to answer you?
translation_verse: “Ami ndi ɔma na muudie mina litemi kenye?

english_verse: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
translation_verse: Lɛ́ɛtɛmi lɛsia kama kɔlɛ kɔlɛ na nsɔ liiibo lɛla lɛdi na mɔɔsu.”

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Amu na Katɔti ɔ́tɛmiku Hiob ɔ́siku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔmmɔ kemmo ɔnini,

english_verse: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
translation_verse: “Ya na ami ku-ɔ butaanu lɛlɔ anumi, na edie etemila ani na ndubo-ɔ buye mɛni kenye!

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: “Bɔtina na ada-mi kalɛ na ese siin, na ami mmomu naaatɛ etemila siin na ulu lɛlɔ?

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: Bɔbla na ƒula kɔnu kɔɔbla ɔyikun ala, na ƒula lɛdi lɛnɔ libo ogya mina kalɛ?

english_verse: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
translation_verse: Si lɛni na aasu bɔdi ni, ya na bukeye bɔni mɔɔtina ƒula lɛgadi bɔka bɔmana-a!

english_verse: Show your furious anger! Throw down and crush
translation_verse: Die ƒula kɔnyi keyi, na eboku bekyuli bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: all who are proud and evil.
translation_verse: Sia bana ƒui anumi, na ayila balalane bammɔ ƒui udu.

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: Ya na benyimi-ma ku bekpine kɔvadi, na bava-ma basala na ɔtumu akɔ.

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: Bla ɔmɛni na lɛnu lɛti ka sɔsɔ ákyaku-mi unyeƒi na ádi ubo.

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: “Ami nédie awɔ ku ketu kemmo atu ɔni baalɔ etuntu, na ɔɔkun livo aani ɔmantɛ akɔ.

english_verse: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
translation_verse: Na ubo ɔyikun geen ɔ́si nwuna lɛgba útédu nwuna kaƒɔna.

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: Nwuna ɔka ɔɔkunku aani kugyii kagba. Na nwuna ebuli lɛnɔ émini geen.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: Na nwuna lɛgba ekubi ese aani abuala.

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: Lɛ́bla-nwu na ubo ɔkplu geen utulo bebuo bamba, nsu ami ɔni nédie-nwu kani ndubɔkana na lɛni lide-nwu ku mina kewii.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: Abi lɛlɔ na nwuna livo lɛkundi lɛkya, na uunye taadi mmɔ, na beƒiebuo bamba baaƒia taavi-nwu amadɔ na baabu-nwu.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: Ketudɔ alakpi kalɔ ku lɛba livo lɛmmɔ akɔ na ɔɔbɛ́ taakya.

english_verse: or hides among reeds in the swamp.
translation_verse: Na egyii ani nnye ketudɔ mmɔ mɔɔkya-nwu ɔyuli ka áka amana-nwu ɔsu.

english_verse: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
translation_verse: Si ina dɛ na Yordan Ketu kammɔ kéyi na kaagbá taasiaku-nwu na ɔ́kɔ úbedu-nwu anumi muedi ni, ɔtɔtɔ biala ulagyu-nwu.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Na alakana ulu ɔdi lɛlɔ bɔsia na eƒie etuntu ku kakpagyuɛ na akya-nwu kakwɛnimi enwu na akpanku-nwu.”

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: “Adubɔkana odenge ubendi buƒie ku ɔdaliwa, munuu kabuli na adubuti enyimi-nwu kenye na akalɛ-ka?

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: Adubɔkya-nwu kakwɛnimi enwu iye akya-nwu unungla kabuli na ada-nwu ataavinku?

english_verse: Will it beg for mercy?
translation_verse: Na áƒɔ ádi ka ɔdubuvele-ɔ ɔnii nu-nwu kɔnyana?

english_verse: Will it surrender as a slave for life?
translation_verse: Ɔdubɔnyonu lɛlɔ ute-ɔ lɛni aani ƒula kabla ɔblane úsela uwi ƒui?

english_verse: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
translation_verse: Adubɔkana-nwu lɛgba bunyimi aani kaduli ebuo ɔdi ete belekubi anii bataaƒianku aani aasɛ kalɛ?

english_verse: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
translation_verse: Ebuo ɔni na badubɔkana badi-nwu kuye na ɔdi? Bɔdu na badubɔdu-nwu na bekulo-nwu lɛna basia kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ beteeye?

english_verse: Can it be killed with harpoons or spears?
translation_verse: Atula biala udu ɔdi ulabla nwuna ɔlɔna ɔku iye lili lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Wrestle it just once— that will be the end.
translation_verse: Na si aaagyi na ébo kɔnu áda-nwu na ɔ́kunku-ɔ ni, asɔ alasu anii aabla anu kudii!

english_verse: Merely a glimpse of this monster makes all courage melt.
translation_verse: Ɔtɔtɔ ɔni lɛti ndubo-ɔ bɔgyu si éti lɛnumi ánu-nwu muedi ni, alasu anii eeƒie-nwu ataanyuɛ.

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: Na si ebuo ɔmɛni lɛlɔ libo liƒu ɔni na ukyuli ɔdi ulakana bɔsu ɔnii utékpoku-nwu ni, ɔma geen ndubɔkana bɔsu ɔnii uunye ɔsiaku ami?

english_verse: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
translation_verse: Ami mɔɔdi kayawi kemodi kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ kalɛ na mɔɔyɔ́, na ɔdi uuubo kayu kadi na uuye-mi.

english_verse: What powerful legs, what a stout body this monster possesses!
translation_verse: “Nu ɔyikun ɔni udu na liƒu kebweyi kamɛni kebo na nwuna lɛgba ku ɔlɔna ɔsu!

english_verse: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
translation_verse: Na ɔma ndubɔkana na unye ɔsiaku-nwu na ɔdi ɔyikun ɔmɛni udu lɛlɔ, iye ubo-nwu lɛkpu ɔkya kɔgba kɔdi kemmo?

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: Ɔma ndubuse kayi ubimi-nwu kenye na ɔnu-nwu kenye kemmo anyi ani mɔɔda liƒu mmɔ?

english_verse: Its back is covered with shield after shield,
translation_verse: Nwuna kama kémini, na kese ekpobi ekpobi aani lɛgyumanala.

english_verse: firmly bound and closer together
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ muedi ulakana kasakɔ mmɔ ntɛ bɔvi.

english_verse: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
translation_verse: Na ka budi na bédi ekpobi ammɔ ɔsu ni, ulámamiku lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
translation_verse: “Si liƒu kebweyi kammɔ kékpeyi enwu ni, ogya ɔɔbwɛ taalɛ, na nwuna anumi eekeye aani kadi négye kadubo.

english_verse: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
translation_verse: Na agyakpabi ku ogya aalɛ́-nwu kenye kemmo.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: Na uyɔ ɔɔlɛ́-nwu enwu kemmo aani kalɛ na liwulu lɛɛlɛ́ libui lɛni nsia ogya kemmo.

english_verse: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔnwuna ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni náƒɔ ogya geen, na uukeyi lɛla biala na nwuna anumi na lɛɛyɛyɛ.

english_verse: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
translation_verse: “Nwuna limɔ límini geen na ɔɔda ukyuli biala liƒu.

english_verse: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
translation_verse: Nwuna lɛlɔ kɔsakɔ kɔni na adubɔnu ka kuse kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ƒui ni, kubo ɔkplu kutulo abuala.

english_verse: and its heart is stone.
translation_verse: Na nwuna kayi kebo ɔkplu ketulo lɛtakpɛ.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na liƒu kebweyi kani mbo kudu mɛni káda kálɛ ni, bayikune geen muedi beenwíni kama taatɔlɔ ku liƒu.

english_verse: No sword or spear can harm it,
translation_verse: Kewii iye lɛtula lɛdi liiibo na wakana-nwu lɛla lɛdi bɔbla.

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
translation_verse: Na atula ani na béti abuala geen ku abuala egyiedi bétu ƒui ni, aaadi lɛla lɛdi na nwuna kudɔ, mmomu buse na ese aani ligyii lɛni nébun.

english_verse: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
translation_verse: Na buse na atabi ani na béƒwimi na kavwinvwi kemmo bálɛ-nwu ese aani kamu ligyɔ. Na kebweyi kammɔ geen ni, kalayia lɛtula biala.

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
translation_verse: Si ɔ́nu lɛtula ni, bɔma na ɔɔmá. Na si ugyii lɛnɔ na béti báƒiɛmi-nwu ni, buse na use-nwu aani livete na lɛdi.

english_verse: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
translation_verse: Si ɔ́kpɛ aba kemmo úsela ni, nwuna lɛlɔ ɔku ɔni nse yayaaya mmɔ ɔɔbwɛ kalɔ teegyingya-ka teewi.

english_verse: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
translation_verse: “Na si ɔ́tu úduo ntu kalɔ ni, ntu bɔmmɔ ƒui bɔɔnwanɛ lɛlɔ aani nnɔ bɔni muuƒuƒuo.

english_verse: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
translation_verse: Na kesii kani na ɔ́sia úsela ƒui kaabla ƒututuu ku avlɔvɔ.

english_verse: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
translation_verse: Kebweyi bamba kadi kasɔ keeebo kalɔ lɛlɔ na kaada liƒu lɛni.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔsɔ ulánu kebweyi bamba ɔnii kadi lɛla lɛdi na nwuna anumi.”

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: “Ukyuli biala ulakana na wata wenye-ɔ lɛlɔ, ɔsika awɔ mbo ɔyikun na akana na abla lɛla biala na aayɔ́.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: Éye-mi anini, ‘Ɔma mɔɔtɛmi taasiku ala ani na lɛ́lɛ ugyii lɛlɔ lɛni na lɛla tati kemmo?’ Na sɔsɔ ni, lɛ́tɛmi lɛ́siku ala ani na mina kasusu kétenu kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na ana lɛlɔ ala ku kalɔ bunu ese-mi kalɛ kadi.

english_verse: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
translation_verse: “Na ásu-mi anii nse atu na lidie ala ani na adubuye-mi kenye.

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Bekyuli kenye na línu ƒula lɛlɔ litemi. Nsu ɔƒaani ni, ami ɔlati lɛ́nu-ɔ ku mina anumi.

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Katɔti ɔ́su Eliƒas ɔnini, “Livo liiƒí-mi na awɔ ku ƒula bakpana inyɔ bakladi lɛlɔ, ɔsika bítasu litemi geen na mina lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na mina kabla ɔblane Hiob ɔ́su ɔ́siku-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu biti ɔmantɛ bakɔ maatɛ ku baƒonu maatɛ na bisie Hiob kudɔ na bitákyula akpala na lɛkpabi lɛlɔ na bina lili. Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, Hiob ɔdubɔkpali-mi uvele, na ndubuti bina ekpidi lɛkyiɛ-mii, na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-mii kɔtu bɔni na bina adɔlɔla bɔbla ɔsu.”

english_verse: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer. A Happy Ending
translation_verse: Eliƒas ku Bildad ku Soƒar bádi litemi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na Katɔti únu Hiob buvele.

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Ka Hiob ɔ́kpali Katɔti na úvele úte nwuna bakpana ɔ́wɔlɔ lɛni ni, Katɔti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́bla na Hiob únwini ɔlakɛne na ɔ́kɛ ala ani nése-nwu akpa anyɔ.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Hiob ɔ́ya na bánwa adila na ɔ́lɔ nwuna banwani bananabi ku belekubi ku nwuna bakpana na bádi limeyi. Na nwuna bakpana béwulo-nwu kɔnyana na lɛbibo lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́ya na líbo-nwu lɛlɔ ɔsu. Na bana akɔ ɔdi biala úte-nwu sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi kɔkwɛnimi.

english_verse: whose names were Jemimah, Keziah, and Keren Happuch.
translation_verse: Na belekubi bammɔ anyi ndi Yemima ku Kesia ku Keren Hapuk.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: Hiob ɔ́sɔ ɔ́wɔ bebi bananabi maatɛ ku belekubi ɛtɛ.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Belekubi bammɔ mɔɔdia bɔnu teetulo na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ, na Hiob úte-ma kadikɔ aani kalɛ na úte bananabi bammɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Hiob ɔ́bi geen na ngba búmo-nwu asa na úkpi.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔdubɔya na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ bekyuli bani naaabla taasiaku bekyuli bekpidi kasusu kani na baakya bekyuli lɛlɔ. Na balásiaku alaekpidi bablane ɔbladu kama. Na baládiku-ma kɔkpana na bataama anwu Katɔti lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: Mmomu lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-ma ka bataadi Unwoti ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Na beteeduo ɔda bubo litemi lɛmmɔ kemmo usien ku ɔƒɛ.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ udu bese aani egyii ani nnye ketudɔ. Na aanwu ebi na uwi lɛlɔ. Na egyii ammɔ eléwiile evete. Na bana ablala ƒui aatɛ teete-ma.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bekpidi ama ni, uuuse uuute-ma lɛni. Buse bese aani aƒaaƒa ani na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uubó taavinku uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Alaekpidi bablane beeebo kenye kadi na bedie na limeyi lɛni na Katɔti ɔdubɔtɛku-ma litemi lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubudie-ma use lɛti bɔsiku nwuna bekyuli kudɔ.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Unwoti anu asia bekyuli bani mɔɔsia nwuna ulu lɛlɔ siin, na ɔɔgyumana-ma. Nsu bekyuli bani naaasia nwuna ulu lɛlɔ ni, badubɔyii udu.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na bayawine beenyimi ala, na bekyuli baasa lili keeke?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Kayawi baga bábla unwi na benye beekpóku awɔ ku ƒula Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi.

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: Na baasu banini, “Bɛya buni-ma na bukulo bana kɔbuli kɔni nda-bu ƒui budie lɛlɔ na bɔlɛ bana lɛlɔ bɔdi kalɔ.”

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti ɔni nli nwuna lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na katɔ kaaka ɔ́ma bana kakali.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: Amu na livo líƒi Unwoti na ɔ́dɔnku-ma. Na ɔ́kya-ma liƒu geen. Na ɔ́su na nwuna kɔnyi kemmo ɔnini,

english_verse: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
translation_verse: “Sion Kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ na líse mina Ɔga Ɔƒunadi líse.”

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Ɔga Ɔƒunadi ɔmɛni ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ndubɔkɔ lɛsa na Unwoti lɛla lɛni na úse kenye úte-mi lɛlɔ ɔnini, ‘Awɔ ndi mina ubi. Na ɔmwi ni, línwini-ɔ ɔti.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Awɔ, vele-mi na ndubuti kayawi kadi bekyuli ƒui lite-ɔ na eti kayawi ƒui abla ƒula kadikɔ.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Na adubuti lɛbuala ɔgagyii adi-ma lɛlɔ ku ɔyikun kpakplaa na abwɛ-ma ewi kalɔ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ aani ebwi kalɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: Na bitaakpa Unwoti ku ɔbu geen ku lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: Na biboku eli kalɔ bite-nwu. Na si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔkɛku-mii kɔnyi geen na ɔyila-mii udu kɔnakunwi. Nsu lɛlɔ litaayɔ bekyuli bani muukeli teesie-nwu kudɔ ka ɔgyumana-ma.

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: O Unwoti, agyi kalɛ na mina bekisine bemomo na bana ƒui báta beekpóku-mi.

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: Na baasu banini, “Katɔti ulakana-nwu bukpo bɔƒɔ.”

english_verse: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
translation_verse: Mɔɔkpali awɔ Unwoti teevele nnii nu-mi bɔkpali na ebebunku-mi ɔ́si ƒula kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: Mɔɔtɛ taalɛɛ usien umodi ƒui. Na aayá na mɔɔta ku ɔlɔkplu.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Na liƒu biala lítada-mi na bekisine mpim liti bani náka bámana-mi ɔsu.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
translation_verse: Unwoti mina Katɔti, bo na abaƒɔ-mi! Ƒɛ mina bekisine ƒui anyi ku linungla kalɛ na basɔ balákɛ ɔyikun ɔdi mina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: because you protect and bless your people.
translation_verse: Unwoti, awɔ mɔɔyá na ukyuli ɔɔdi nwuna bekisine lɛlɔ. Na awɔ kani mɔɔbla-nwu lɛƒɔndia.

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: Mina Unwoti Katɔti ɔni muunye-mi kama, si mɔɔkpali-ɔ ni, nu te-mi! Uwi ɔni na ala ékpoku-mi ni, awɔ nédie-mi. Bla-mi lɛƒɔndia na enu ala ani muuvele-ɔ!

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: Amii bekyuli, uwi ɛlɛ sɔɔn na bɛdubo-mi lɛnyi bubile butálɛ? Na uwi ɛlɛ na bɛdubɔyɔ adɔlɔla ku ala ani neeebo kɔsia?

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Bitayiƒala ka Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔda bekyuli bani nsiaku-nwu kama siin aani anwu badi. Uunú-mi bɔkpali si muuvele-nwu lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Si bíti kɔnyi ni, bitaya na bina kɔnyi kɔya na bɛbla likpidi. Na si bɛ́yu bɛ́tɛ ni, na biduo lɛlɔ ku ala amɛni kemmo bɛnu kaduɛ na bɛbla kpoo.

english_verse: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛbla akpala ani na Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́ bite-nwu. Na biti bina kayi bɛsia-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Bekyuli pii bakya baasu banini, “Bɔɔyɔ́ ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔbla-bu lɛbuni lɛdi. Unwoti, ya na ƒula lɛƒɔndia limomo-bu lɛlɔ libu!”

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Áya na mina kayi kéyi ku ebiti geen útulo bana ebiti ani baakɛ́ si bákɛ edula pii aani antabi ku egyiibi ntɛ bɔwɔdi.

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Si lɛ́yu lɛ́tɛ ni, mɔɔlɛɛ ƒaa, ɔsika awɔ kani ndi mina Unwoti ɔni mɔɔgyumana-mi.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, se atu na enu lɛla lɛni na muuvele-ɔ! Na enu-mi lɛnwuna lɛni na muubó taakpali-ɔ.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Mina Ɔga ku Katɔti, nu-mi keku kani muuwulo na mɔɔkpali-ɔ nnii bunku-mi.

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: Mina Unwoti, ɔtanta tutuutu biala ni, mɔɔda mina etemila taava-a anumi na muuti mina lɛlɔ ku ala ani muuvele-ɔ taakya-a enu kemmo kalɛ na abla-nya ete-mi.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: Ɔsika adi Unwoti Katɔti ɔni na alayɔ likpidi. Na alátuna ka alaekpidi bablane benye-ɔ anumi bevele-ɔ lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ ni, alawia-ma alanu. Na ekisi bekyuli bani mɔɔbla likpidi.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔ banyine ƒui ni, adubo-ma udu bɔyila. Na bani muuwi ubugya kalɔ ku bani muudie bekyuli teete ni, ekisi-ma.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
translation_verse: Nsu ami ni, Ati, ɔ́si bɔyɔ bɔni na aayɔ́-mi geen ɔsu ni, ndubɔkana na liduo lisie ƒula ɔtɔ kemmo na liboku lɛlɔ kalɔ lite-ɔ ku ɔbu. Na ndubɔkana na lɛ́kpa-a na ƒula kakpakɔ kedee mmɔ.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, tɔnku-mi vinku ƒula lilu lɛni nse siin lɛlɔ ɔsi mina bekisine pii ɔsu! Na aya na lɛnu ƒula ulu lɛti nwaa.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Mina bekisine balásu litemi geen lɛni lɛlɔ na ukyuli uti anu ɔsia. Na bana kayi kemmo geen ni, baayɔ́ ka batɔlɔ bekyuli batákya ɔgbankpi kemmo na bekpi. Bana inye buse aani kɔƒiɔtɔ kɔni nálɛmi kuwi.

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, du-ma kɔtɔ na ani-ma kɔtu! Na aya na bana likpidi lɛni baakali linwini kakpagyuɛ na udie ama alati. Bɔku-ma na bekeli ƒula anumi na ekpidi pii ani na baabla ɔsu ku kalɛ na baata teenye-ɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani néti-ɔ bénwini katamikukɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma na beteedie ebiti lɛnu uwi ƒui. Gyumana bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔyɔ́-ɔ, ɔsika awɔ ɔsu na bana ebiti eedú taawɔlɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: Unwoti, bekyuli bani mɔɔsiaku-ɔ kama siin ni, eete-ma kusɛ kusɛ. Gyumana-ma ku ƒula lɛƒɔndia aani kalɛ na kekpo lɛgyumanala lɛɛgyumana ukyuli.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, teti kɔnyi na adɔnku-mi! Na tani-mi kɔtu si livo liiƒí-ɔ!

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: Unwoti, nu-mi kɔnyana! Kya-mi ɔkplu, ɔsika ɔyikun ina blii suɛ ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo-mi.

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: Muunú ɔlɛ geen na mina lɛlɔ ƒui kemmo. Unwoti, buvele tetu uwi. Bo na ababwi-mi.

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: Unwoti, bo na ebedie-mi! Na ƒula lɛƒɔndia ɔsu ni, nu-mi kɔnyana na edie-mi na kukpi kemmo!

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli baayiƒala-a si békpi. Na kekpine mmɔ ni, basɔ baaadubo-ɔ bɔkpali bumwi.

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Líiwulo kɔnyana laa na lɛ́yii udu. Na mina atɛla ku lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsia lili ƒui aaƒɔ́ mmii usien biala na mina keku kani muuwulo ɔsu.

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Ɔkplu kemmo na mɔɔkana bɔnu, ɔsika mina anumi éƒu kede kede. Na mina bekisine keku kani na baakya-mi ɔsu.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Amii alaekpidi bablane, bɛkpɛ bɛlɛ-mi lɛlɔ! Unwoti Katɔti uunú-mi buwulo.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: Uunú ka muuwulo taakpali-nwu nnii ubunku-mi. Na ɔdubɔbla ute-mi lɛni kani.

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Kɔƒa kɔdubo mina bekisine ƒui bukpo, na liƒu lɛda-ma geen, na benwini bekeli batɔlɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, mina Katɔti, awɔ na líkeli líbo ḿbatamiku. Die-mi lɛku bekyuli bani nsiaku-mi na baawia ka bayila-mi ngba enu kemmo.

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, badubo-mi buƒie bɔtɔlɔku aani gyata kalɛ na baduli-mi kɔkɛ kɔkɛ.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: Mina ɔkpana ɔmani na lídie líte iye mina ukisine ɔmani lɛlɔ na lɛ́ta línye na ulu ukpidi ɔdi lɛlɔ?

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Na si lɛ́bla ala amɛni adi ni, na aya na mina bekisine babi basiaku-mi na beƒie-mi, na banya-mi badu bava kalɔ.

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ta ku kɔnyi na enye ada mina bekisine bani nsiaku-mi ku kɔnyi geen! Ta na ebunku-mi! Ɔsika awɔ mɔɔtɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu sala kadi bekyuli ƒui lisu na elie ƒula lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na katɔ na adi-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: Awɔ ndi bayawine ƒui litemi ɔtɛne. Unwoti Katɔti, tɛ litemi lɛmɛni te-mi na lɛdi ubo. Ɔsika agyi ka ala amɛni ƒui adi aaada-mi.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: Awɔ ndi Unwoti Katɔti ɔni nse siin na agyi bula lili kemmo kakali ku bula kayi kemmo ayɔla ƒui. Nye tile alaekpidi bablane ala bɔbla ulu! Na ada bekyuli bani nsiaku-ɔ kama siin na benye kpakplaa.

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti mɔɔgyumana-mi. Na bekyuli bani ƒui muunú-nwu litemi ni, ɔɔƒɔ́-ma ngba.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔtɛ litemi siin na ɔɔdú bekyuli bekpidi kɔtɔ limeyi ndi limeyi.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Si bekyuli bekpidi bátavumana udu ni, Katɔti ɔdubo nwuna kewii bɔdɔ buse bute-ma. Ɔ́ɔni nwuna kataminta úse unye kagyumana.

english_verse: Your deadly arrows are ready with flaming tips.
translation_verse: Ɔ́klibi nwuna ekpola ɔda unye. Na ɔda nwuna atula ani mɔɔda ogya unye ka ɔkyula-ma.

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi baada likpidi kaƒɔ. Na baawɔ ɔkɔ bɔnyi ku lɛsɛ bɔkya ku kalala bɔbla.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Nsu kɔkpagyuɛ kɔni na baakywɛ bekyuli bammɔ ni, aku kani muudie-ma.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, ama alati bana ekpidi ndubo-ma kɔtu bɔni. Na bana likyulikpi kasusu keenwíni teebo-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: Mɔɔgyá Unwoti Katɔti enu ka ɔɔtɛ litemi siin ɔsu. Na mɔɔtu enugya lɛnu teete Unwoti Katɔti ɔni ntulo ƒui.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: O Unwoti ɔni ndi bula Katɔti, kayawi bekyuli ƒui baanu ƒula lɛgadi bukeye na kesii biala. Na aayá na ƒula bukeye buugyingya teetédu katɔ kakaaka ƒui.

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: Ábla banamu ku bebiwɔ anii beti bumwi bɔni náƒɔ kuye geen bete-ɔ. Elie kalɔ kpi ɔni na ƒula ukisine ɔdi ulakana-a bɔni bude kudii. Na bekyuli bani mɔɔta teenye-ɔ lɛlɔ ƒui aayila-ma udu.

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: Si mɔɔnu kalɛ na édie kayaa na mɔɔnu kɔbuli ku ayabi ani na áya na enye ana kunyenkɔ ni,

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: na muuye lɛlɔ nnii bi na ukyuli ɔdi, ɔsu na aasia-nwu anu lɛni? Na bi na Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ɔdi, ɔsu na aanu-nwu lɛlɔ lɛni?

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Na áya na úbo úbenye kenyekɔ kani náyu kalɔ blii kétulo na awɔ kadi kudɔ. Na áya na uukeye na bekyuli baabu-nwu.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: Na áya na ɔɔdi ala ani ƒui na édie lɛlɔ. Na éti ala ammɔ ƒui ákya-nwu lɛgba kalɔ.

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: Baƒonu ku ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku lɛku kemmo bebuo ƒui lɛnɔ bakya-nwu kalɔ.

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔdi baasɛ ku kɔbɛ ku bebweyi bani nkya ɛpu kemmo ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: O Unwoti Katɔti, kayawi ala ƒui aanu ƒula lɛgadi bukeye.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ndubo-ɔ enu butaagya na limwi-ɔ uwi biala ku mina kayi ƒui. Na ndubɔsu akɔla budie taatina ala ani ƒui na ábla.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Ndubɔtu lɛlɔyɔ kɔgya na awɔ ɔsu. O Katɔti ɔni ntulo ƒui, ndubɔtu kɔgya limwi-ɔ lɛnyi.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: Mina bekisine beekeli si áda álɛ. Na balákana-a bunye bɔsiaku, mmomu baayii udu.

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: Eli ƒula lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na aatɛ etemila siin. Na ékulo mina litemi kemmo ka mina litemi libo ubo.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ádu kadi bamba bekyuli ƒui kɔtɔ na áyila bani na bebo kalala udu. Na áya na bana anyi álɛ bekyuli ƒui kasusu kemmo úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: Bekisine bammɔ béduo ɔgbankpi ɔni kemmo na basɔ balakana bɔlɛ kudii. Na ábwɛ-ma kuliekɔ ƒui. Na ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ ulakali ɔnii bákya mmɔ dii muedi.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔtɛku kayawi bekyuli ƒui litemi na ulu siin lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubɔdi-ma lɛlɔ na ulu ɔbuni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdi katamikukɔ ute bekyuli bani lɛlɔ na bekyuli bamba baadi kpakplaa. Na anwu ndi kama kekpokɔ ute bani na ala eekpóku.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: Na bani ngyi kalɛ na ƒula lɛnyi libo ɔyikun badubo bana anu buti bɔsia-a lɛlɔ. Ɔsika bútenu kudii ka ɔdi ɔ́kpali-ɔ ɔnii bunku-nwu na átakpete-nwu.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Bidie lɛnu bimwi Unwoti ɔni nli mɔɔdi lɛga na Sion. Na bibo nwuna ala ani na ɔ́bla kudu na kadi ƒui bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti ulayiƒala kalɛ na ɔni bekyuli bani néwi bekyuli ubugya kalɔ kɔtu. Na uleni bekyuli bani muuwulo taakpali-nwu keku na kalɛ na beekpóku-ma ɔsu.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: O Unwoti, nu kalɛ na mina bekisine benye beekpóku-mi! Nu-mi kɔnyana na aƒɔ-mi ngba alɛku kekpine kayakun kani na líidu lɛ́wɔlɔ mmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Ya lɛ́sɔ línwini ḿbedu Sion ɔba kenye na lidie lɛnu limwi-ɔ. Na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mi na kalɛ na áƒɔ-mi ngba ɔsu.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: Kadi bamba bekyuli bani néku-mi ubu ka lɛnu-nwu kemmo ni, ama alati bánu ubu ɔmmɔ. Na kakpagyuɛ kani na bábɛ bákywɛ-mi ni, kédie ama alati.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Unwoti, bekyuli ƒui bagyi-ɔ ka aabla ala ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Nsu balalane ni, bana ablala eenwíni kakpagyuɛ teedie-ma.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo na balalane beenwíni teetéduo ama ku kadi bekyuli bani mɔɔyiƒala ka Unwoti ɔkya.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ta na edie lɛlɔ. Na taya na kadi bamba bekyuli badi lɛlɔ. Mmomu ya na bekyuli bamɛni ƒui bada balɛ-ɔ anumi na atɛku-ma litemi.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: O mina Unwoti, ya na liƒu ala bonwu ada alɛ-ma lɛlɔ. Na bati nwaa ka kayawi bekyuli keeke kani na badi.

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: O Unwoti, bi ɔsu na ágyunku-bu lɛni, na si uwi ɔni na ala eekpóku-bu ni, na eeti ƒula lɛlɔ taabɛla-bu?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi baatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ na beekpóku bawabane. Anwuɔsu ya na ama alati kɔkpagyuɛ kɔni bákywɛ kudie-ma.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ukpidi ɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na ala ani na ɔɔwia lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli ɔni muugyele anumi taasia lilu likpidi lɛlɔ taaƒɔ bekyuli ala ni, uuwida Unwoti na uuní-nwu.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ukpidi ɔɔɔdaku Unwoti lɛda na ɔɔkali ka Unwoti uuubo kenyekɔ kadi na nwuna keliela kemmo.

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ukpidi ablala biala aalɛ́-nwu kɔsia uwi ƒui, nsu ɔɔɔgyi ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na Unwoti ɔɔsia taatɛku bekyuli litemi. Na ɔɔmá nwuna bekisine muedi.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: Na ɔɔsu lɛlɔ ɔnini, “Lɛla biala lilakana-mi bukpoku. Na lɛɛɛdubo buduo ɔgbankpi ɔdi kemmo lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Ewida ku ɔkɔ ku likyulikpi etemila sɔɔn néyi-nwu kemmo. Na likpidi ku kalala etemila amɛni kani na ɔɔsu.

english_verse: They hide outside villages, waiting to strike and murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Ɔɔbɛ́ teebi akpaklɔ ulu lɛlɔ na ɔɔtú bekyuli bani naaadubo bɔkana na bekpo baƒɔ lɛlɔ na ɔdu-ma.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔsɔ teebi nwuna kabɛkɔ mmɔ kpoo aani kalɛ na gyata ɔni na kɔka kɔɔda ɔɔbla. Na ɔɔtú bawabane. Na uƒie-ma kɔnakunwi na ɔkpɛ-ma ɔtɔlɔku aani ebuo ɔni nánu kakpagyuɛ.

english_verse: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani béƒie mmɔ bese aani bebuo bani neeebo kekelikɔ kadi na ɔyikune ɔmmɔ aƒiɔ akɔ.

english_verse: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
translation_verse: Ukyuli ukpidi ɔɔsu lɛlɔ ɔnini, “Unwoti ɔɔɔdaku-ni. Úbile nwuna anumi ɔ́kya-mi ɔsu ulanu-mi.”

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, kali nu bekyuli bani nnye muubó abi na ani bekyuli bekpidi bamɛni kɔtu.

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka ukyuli ukpidi uni Katɔti na ɔsu ɔnini, “Katɔti uláni-mi kɔtu kɔdi.”

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: Nsu geen geen ni, awɔ Katɔti aanu na agyi kɔnyana ku abi ani na ƒula bekyuli beebó. Na agyi kalɛ na eekpó teete-ma. Na ka ɔwabane uuubo lɛla lɛdi na ɔɔbla ɔsu ni, uuti lɛlɔ teete-ɔ. Na eebunku-nwu aani kalɛ na eebunku bekpinebi.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Balalane ku ekpidi lidu bamba bablane ni, yila bana ɔyikun. Na ani-ma kɔtu na alaekpidi ani na bábla kenye úti útédu ka báda-nya bɔbla báya.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: Unwoti ndi ɔga ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui. Na kadi bamba bekyuli badubɔyii ƒui kede kede na nwuna kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, bekyuli bani muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na beevele-ɔ bana kayi lɛyɔla ni, eenú-ma bɔkpali na aakya-ma kayi ogya, na eenú-ma lɛdi lɛnɔ si baakpali-ɔ.

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: Na bekpinebi ku bani na baanya taakya ni, adubɔtɛ bana litemi ete-ma na badi ubo kalɛ na likpidi bablane basɔ balákɛ ɔyikun ɔdi na bataabla-ma kalala na bataayila-ma lɛnɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
translation_verse: Unwoti ndi mina katamikukɔ. Bi ɔsu na aasu-mi anii nkeli nteesie abi lɛlɔ ntábɛ aani aasɛ kalɛ?

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: Ɔsika balalane bákɔliku bana kɔtaminta ku atula bálɛ bekyuli bani nsia Unwoti kama siin banii beebó-ma basiku kasuudikɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti uli lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na nwuna kakpakɔ kedee kemmo na Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma. Na nwuna anumi aanu ala ani ƒui na bekyuli baabla na kesi kesii.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔkɔ́ku bekyuli bani nsiaku-nwu kama siin taanu bana ablala kemmo. Na uukisi bakantankpine ku bani mɔɔta teenye nwuna ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na aƒɛ ku ogya ku ɔnyi kpatii ɔdi ɔna aani ɔnantu uwi balalane bammɔ lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubɔya na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni na ɔ́ƒɔ ogya geen uteekpo teebile bana ala uwi biala.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti use siin na ɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ. Na bani nsiaku-nwu kama siin ndubɔkana na benye-nwu anumi.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Unwoti, buvele bɔda-a, bunku-bu, ɔsika ukyuli ɔbuni ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo. Na bekyuli bani mɔɔdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ lɛnɔ bása na kayawi.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: O Unwoti, kalɛ-ma kenye na bada lɛmɛnɛ bɔkun baya.

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti ɔnini, “Ɔƒɛni amu ndubɔta lɛda lɛlɛ bekyuli bamɛni lɛlɔ, ɔsika bawabane beebó abi. Na bekyuli bani na baanya taakya lɛnɔ beedumo. Na ndubute-ma kagyumana kani na baasia anu.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Unwoti litemi lise sɛɛn aani sika ɔƒualadi ɔni bákya ogya kemmo báƒɔ-nwu maatɛ na uukeye geen.

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: Unwoti, buuvele-ɔ bɔnii gyumana-bu na ada-bu edie kaba buɛ kamɛni akɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi bakɛ kesi kesii beesié taasɔ, na ukyuli biala ɔɔkya bana likyulikpi lɛmmɔ ogya.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, uwi ɛlɛ na adubo-mi atu budie butálɛ? Bi ɔsu na ábɛla-mi ƒula lɛlɔ?

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Úti útédu uwi ɔmani lɛlɔ asa na mina kasusu kadubɔbla-mi nwaa? Mina kayi keenú ɔlɛ limeyi ndi limeyi. Na mina bekisine baanya-mi taakya.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: O mina Unwoti Katɔti, nwini nu-mi na akya-mi ɔyikun kalɛ na neeekpi.

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, mina bekisine bɔdubɔsu banini, “Bɔ́nya-nwu bɔ́kya!” Na badubɔkɛ lɛlɔyɔ ka bádi-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Nsu ƒula lɛlɔ kani na mina anu asia, ɔsika ƒula bɔyɔ buuubo kawɔlɔkɔ. Na mina kayi lɛnɔ kákɛ lɛlɔyɔ ka áƒɔ-mi ɔsu.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: Mina Unwoti, ndubudie lɛnu limwi-ɔ, ɔsika aabla-mi lɛƒɔndia uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔlɔdi mɔɔsu na nwuna kayi kemmo ɔnini, “Katɔti uuubo.” Likyulikpi lɛ́ƒɔ-ma keliela kemmo ɔsu balábla lɛbuni lɛdi.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́sia bayawine ƒui anu ɔ́siku katɔ si ɔdi kasusu kálɛmi na ɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔsiaku-nwu kama.

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Amii alaekpidi bablane bamɛni, bíni bɛnii bɛɛɛdubo lɛla lɛdi bɔtɛya! Bi ɔsu na bɛ́yila mina bekyuli udu aani kalɛ na baadi adila, na bíni bɛnii bilakpali Unwoti lɛnyi?

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Liƒu bonwu lɛdubo-mii bɔda. Nsu bani nse siin ni, Unwoti uliku-ma.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: Alaekpidi bablane bénye bétile bawabane lɛbuni lɛni na baayɔ́ ka babla. Nsu Unwoti ndi bana ɔgyumanane.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Muuvele kpakplaa nnii Unwoti ɔya na bɔƒɔ bɔsi Sion bubo bute Israel. Na si ɔ́sɔku nwuna bekyuli lɛkɛ úte-ma ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma geen.

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, ɔma ndubɔkɛ kuƒi na ɔkɔ ubo ƒula Sion Kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ na uduo ƒula kakpakɔ?

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi Katɔti etemila ƒui lɛlɔ na nwuna ablala lɛnɔ ese siin ni, anwu kani ndubɔkɛ kuƒi kɔmmɔ. Nwuna etemila adi sɔsɔ na ɔkɔ ɔdi uuubo-nya kemmo.

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔmmɔ ulalɔ bekyuli anyikpi. Na ulabla nwuna ɔkpana likpidi lɛdi. Na ulewi-nwu anumi kalɔ na kadi akɔ.

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔɔnu ka badi alaekpidi bablane ni, ɔɔɔdaku-ma lɛda. Mmomu bani mɔɔyia Unwoti na baadi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ ni, ɔɔbu-ma. Ukyuli ɔmmɔ udu ɔɔdi lɛla biala na ɔ́su úse lɛlɔ ina dɛ na lɛla lɛmmɔ liikpóku-nwu.

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: Uuvó egulabi teete bekyuli na ulaƒɔ kuvonsia. Na ulabɛ taaƒɔ egulabi na ɔdu ukyuli ɔni na útabla likpidi lɛdi kɔtɔ. Ukyuli ɔni na ɔɔsia ala amɛni anu taabla taasiaku-nya lɛlɔ ni, ɔtɔtɔ ɔɔɔdubo-nwu bɔgyu kudii.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: O Katɔti, gyumana-mi! Ɔsika awɔ ndubudie-mi na ɔgbankpi kemmo.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu nwaa nnini, “Awɔ lɛti ndi mina Unwoti. Na ala abuni ani ƒui na mbo ni, awɔ néte-mi ala ammɔ.”

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Na bani nsiaku ala bamba kama aani bana unwoti kalɛ ni, badubo abi bubo geen. Na lɛɛɛdubo ubugya buti bɔbla lɛkpa lɛdi bute ala ammɔ. Na lɛɛɛdubo-ma anyi bɔlɔ muedi!

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Awɔ kani némo-mi, ɔsika awɔ ndi mina kadikɔ. Na eete-mi kusɛ kusɛ na eete-mi ala ani mɔɔwia na aada-mi kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: Kadikɔ kani nédu-mi ƒui kadi kabuni. Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka lɛ́kɛ kese kabuni.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: Ndubɔkɔliku mina Unwoti lɛnyi katɔ, ɔsika anwu nákya-mi kasusu. Na si ntɛ usien muedi ni, nwuna litemi lɛ́ƒɔ mina kasusu kemmo.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: Nnye mɔɔnu-nwu anumi uwi ƒui. Na ka unye-mi kɔdianu aani mina lɛkpa kalɛ ɔsu ni, lɛɛɛdubo bɔgbanta.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, mina kayi kemmo kéyi ku lɛlɔyɔ, na ndubuti kenye nteemwi-ɔ uwi ƒui! Ina ka ɔlɔna ndi muedi ni, adubɔda-mi kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: Na alanyonu mina kɔyu alakya kekpine. Na lɛnɔ ni, alaya ƒula Ubi Kedee ɔlɔna webu.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Átina-mi ƒula ngba ulu, na ƒula kudɔ bɔkya bɔ́ya na mɔɔkɛ́ ebiti geen ku lɛlɔyɔ úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: Unwoti, nu-mi buvele na atɛ mina litemi siin. Nu-mi keku kani na muuwulo taakpali-ɔ, ɔsika ɔkɔ etemila eeebo-mi kenye kemmo.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Awɔ ndubɔtɛ-mi litemi na ete-mi ubo. Ɔsika awɔ kani ngyi litemi geen lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Agyi kalɛ mina kayi kemmo kese sɛɛn. Ɔsika ébo-mi kudɔ usien na ákɔku-mi lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui ánu ka ntabla likpidi. Na lɛ́lɛ ugyii ka lɛɛɛdubo mina kenye bubimi bɔsu lɛla likpidi lɛdi.

english_verse: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
translation_verse: Liiise aani bekyuli bamba, ami mɔɔdi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi. Na lɛɛɛkɛ bekyuli bani mbo lɛkantakpi kavinkɔ.

english_verse: I have followed you, without ever stumbling.
translation_verse: Mɔɔsiaku-ɔ kama siin uwi ndi uwi kalɛ neeedeyi kesii bamba.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: O mina Unwoti, awɔ na mɔɔkpali! Buvele se atu na enu-mi bɔkpali.

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: Bla-mi ƒula lɛƒɔndia lɛni neeebo lɛkala. Awɔ muudie bekyuli bani nékeli bábatamiku-ɔ na bana bekisine enu kemmo ɔkɛnku ƒula ɔyikun bonwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Da-mi kɔkɔɔkɔ aani ƒula lɛnumi kalɛ, na abɛla-mi aani kalɛ na akɔkɔ ɔɔbɛla nwuna bebi na avwi akɔ.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
translation_verse: Die-mi lɛku mina bekisine bani náka-mi bákya ka bayila-mi ngba enu kemmo.

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bammɔ udu balanu bekyuli kɔnyana, mmomu baatɛmi taakun lɛmɛnɛ.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Béti anumi bálɛ-mi lɛlɔ na báka-mi bákya kalɛ na bebo-mi bava kalɔ.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, muuvele-ɔ, ta kɔnakunwi na enye asiaku-ma. Na eti ƒula kewii na aƒɔ-mi alɛku balalane bamɛni enu kemmo.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ƒɔ-mi na bekyuli bekpidi bani kasusu ndi ka basala kayawi ala bese bete lɛlɔ mɛni enu kemmo. Awɔ muute bekyuli bani na aayɔ́ adila na baadi. Na bana bebi baakɛ́ taadi teemo. Bana bawɔ baakɛ́ ala teetulo kalɛ na baawia.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Nsu ami ndubɔnu-ɔ anumi, ɔsika ntabla lɛla likpidi lɛdi. Na si lɛ́ta mina kalɛɛkɔ ni, ndubɔnu kalɛ na ese na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mi.

english_verse: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
translation_verse: O Unwoti Katɔti, mɔɔyɔ́-ɔ, ɔsika awɔ muute-mi ɔyikun.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
translation_verse: Unwoti unye ute-mi aani lɛtakpɛ ku katamikukɔ kani lɛlɔ na líkpo kama. Ɔɔgyumana-mi aani ukyuli ɔni muunye teetile-mi na ɔɔƒɔ́-mi na ɔɔyá na mɔɔkɛ́ ɔyikun.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, awɔ námanku bumwi. Lɛ́kpali-ɔ na édie-mi álɛku mina bekisine enu kemmo.

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Kukpi kabuli kényimi-mi. Na útiku-mi úselaku aani kalɛ ketu kani néyi keeminime.

english_verse: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
translation_verse: Kukpi abuli ényimi-mi. Na kunye-mi anumi kɔɔkya-mi liƒu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Na mina lɛbibo lɛmɛni kemmo ni, lɛ́kpali mina Unwoti Katɔti na líwulo lɛ́kya-nwu nnii ubunku-mi. Na únu-mi lɛdi ɔ́siku nwuna kakpakɔ na úbunku-mi.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Kalɔ kemodi kaagyú taawɔ na kaatɔ́ kpakpaakpa. Na abi ƒui ákunku, ɔsika Unwoti úti kɔnyi.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: Uyɔ ɔ́lɛ-nwu enwu kemmo, na ogya lɛnɔ ɔ́lɛ-nwu kenye kemmo ɔ́kyula ala. Na ogya agyabi ani náƒɔ ogya geen sɔsɔ aasí taabayu.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́lɛmi katɔ na ɔ́yu úbo kalɔ na liƒlukutu lɛ́ƒɔ-nwu lɛgba kalɔ ƒui na ɔ́bla suu.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Na ulie ɔtu udu ɔdi mbo avwi na baalɔ-nwu Kerub lɛlɔ na úveyi ɔ́yu úbo.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: Na lɛdisa libi-nwu lɛlɔ aani awu. Na liƒlukutu lɛni némini na lise suu lɛ́ka lɛ́mana-nwu na lɛ́bɛla-nwu.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti uudie lɛdi ku kudu bonwu na kayaa aani kalɛ na katɔ keedu. Na anwu ɔni ntulo ƒui mmɔ lɛdi lɛɛku taasi katɔ katɔ ƒui teebewi kalɔ.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: Ɔ́bɔku ɛpu na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔlɛ́-nwu enwu ɔ́ya na ɛpu ɔmmɔ kalɔ kátina nwaa na kalɔ kemmo atabi ɔka údie lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku nwuna ɔyikun lɛlɔ na úbedie-mi ɔ́lɛku ligyu ntu bɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: Údie-mi ɔ́lɛku mina bekisine kpakplaa bani muukisi-mi enu kemmo na ɔ́ƒɔ-mi na bani nábi básiaku-mi na bebo ɔkplu betulo-mi kudɔ.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Mina bekisine bénye báda-mi ka nkya ɔgbankpi kemmo ɔsu. Nsu Unwoti údie-mi, ɔsika nwuna lɛlɔ na líkpo kama.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: Údie-mi bana akɔ únyene kanwaadikɔ na lɛ́kɛ bɔnwuna, ɔsika mina lɛlɔ lɛɛda-nwu ebiti.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́bla-mi lɛƒɔndia, ɔsika nsiaku-nwu kama siin na úse-mi kɔdɛ, ɔsika likpidi lɛdi lɛɛɛda-mi.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: Mɔɔdi Unwoti ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Na ńtedeyi ńtalɛ nwuna ulu lɛlɔ na lɛ́ƒiɔ-nwu.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: Ngyi nwuna ɔda bubo ƒui na ńtedie ɔdi atu.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: Ɔgyi kalɛ na nda lɛlɔ siin na ńtabla likpidi lɛdi.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Unwoti úse-mi kɔdɛ, ɔsika mɔɔbla ala siin na ɔgyi ka likpidi liiibo-mi kayi.

english_verse: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ ni, awɔ lɛnɔ aabla-nya ulu lɛlɔ teete-ma. Na bani mɔɔdi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ ni, aabla-ma lɛƒɔndia uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Na bani mɔɔsia bana ablala anu ni, awɔ lɛnɔ aasia ala anu teete-ma. Na bani na balásia bana ablala anu ni, aaní-ma kɔtu na bana ablala kenye.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: Aaƒɔ́ bekyuli bani muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ. Na eeboku bekyuli bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: O Blɔti, awɔ nda-mi ukpo na uléni. Na kesii kani nse-mi suu ƒui kékeye.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Katɔti lilu ƒui lise kede kede. Na ɔkɔ biala uuubo-nwu kemmo. Ɔdi lɛgyumanala ute bekyuli bani nátamiku-nwu.

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Na ɔma lɛnɔ ndi Katɔti ɔmmɔ si ɔɔɔdi Blɔti? Ɔsika anwu kani ndi lɛtakpɛ lɛni lɛlɔ na bula kama kekpo.

english_verse: You give me strength and guide me right.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti mɔɔtu-mi akpagya ɔkɛnku nwuna ɔyikun lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔmɛnɛ kuƒi siin teete-bu.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na mina lɛgba lɛ́yu ɔkplu aani akwa. Na ɔɔtɔnku-mi taavinku ulu siin lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: Na anwu mɔɔtina-mi kekpo kɔkwɛ ƒui kalɛ lɛkana lɛda kataminta kani mbo ɔkplu geen.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, awɔ mɔɔgyumana-mi na aaƒɔ́-mi ngba. Na kalɛ na eebo teebebunku-mi ɔsu ni, áya na lɛ́ƒɔ lɛnyi ɔkɛnku ƒula ɔyikun bonwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Ábwɛ mina kasiakɔ éte-mi na kábɛbɛ na ńtagbanta ńteduo mina bekisine enu.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Lɛ́bi lɛ́siaku-ma kama úti útédu ka lɛ́siaku-ma. Na ńtenwini kama útédu uwi ɔni na lɛ́yila-ma udu.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: Líbo-ma líwi kalɔ ɔni na basɔ balákana bɔta na kesii kani na batɛ na mina lɛgba akɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Átu-mi akpagya ku ƒula ɔyikun na lísie kekpokɔ. Na áya na lɛ́di mina bekisine ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: Na áya na lɛ́bɔku mina bekisine na békeli bátɔlɔ. Na bekyuli bani muukisi-mi ƒui áya na lɛ́yila-ma udu.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Báva bákpali ka ukyuli ɔdi ubaƒɔ-ma, nsu ɔdi uuubo na ɔƒɔ-ma. Na bákpali Unwoti muedi, nsu útakpete-ma.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́kɔ-ma lɛ́bla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ aani ɔtumu ɔni na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uuti taatɔlɔku. Na lɛ́tu-ma lídie aani aba ntéwi ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Áƒɔ-mi álɛku batuɔkplune enu kemmo. Na áya na línwini kadi bekyuli ƒui ɔtɔnkune. Na kadi bekyuli bani na lɛɛɛgyi kudii mɛni muedi ni, awɔ Unwoti áya na bakya-mi kalɔ.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Na bálɛ bási bana kɔbɛkɔ bébo ku liƒu, ɔsika básɔ beeebo lɛnunsia lɛdi.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Bɛya bumwi Unwoti ɔni nli uwi ndi uwi. Anwu ndi mina lɛtakpɛ lɛni lɛlɔ na nkpo. Ndubo-nwu lɛnyi katɔ bɔkɔliku, ɔsika anwu mɔɔƒɔ́-mi.

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Anwu muudie mina bekisine kasi teete-mi. Na anwu mɔɔyá na kadi bamba bekyuli baakya eli kalɔ teete-mi.

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: Unwoti udie-mi ɔ́lɛku mina bekisine enu kemmo. Na úti-ma ɔ́kya-mi lɛgba kalɔ. Na ɔ́gyumana-mi ɔ́siku bakantankpine kudɔ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, O mina Unwoti, ndubumwi-ɔ lɛnyi na kadi bekyuli ƒui akɔ. Na ndubudie agya lɛkɔliku-ɔ lɛnyi katɔ.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Awɔ náya na Dawid ƒula ɔga ɔƒunadi ɔɔdi nwuna bekisine lɛlɔ geen. Na éti ƒula bɔyɔ bɔni naaavumana kudii éte anwu ɔni na ése likpo mmɔ ku nwuna bawɔ úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Si bɔ́nu kayaa na bɔ́nu ala ani na Katɔti ɔ́bla ni, bɔɔnu kalɛ na úbomo.

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Usien ku ɔƒɛ ƒui ni, kayaa ala amɛni aatina kalɛ na Unwoti lɛlati kemmo kágyu

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: Bénu-ma kɔku na kayawi ekpo ƒui, na bana etemila égyingya ésie kayawi kawɔlɔkɔ ƒui. Na kayaa mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́bla kakyakɔ úte ɔƒɛ aani adi kevo kalɛ.

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛ use aani ɔnana ɔni na bévele uleku béte na ɔ́si ɔɔlɛ́ nwuna ɔtɔ. Na ɔsɔ use aani okloƒu ɔyikune ɔni nésela usi kekelikɔ ku lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
translation_verse: Ɔɔtu taasi kayaa ɔvi unwi teesie taatánu ɔvi ɔkladi. Na nwuna liwulu liiwi lɛla biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔda bubo bɔdia ƒui bɔ́wɔlɔ na ɔɔyá na bɔɔkɛ́ ɔlɔkplu ɔwɔdi. Na ala ani na úbo ɔda ka bɔbla adi ani buti anu bɔsia geen. Na nwuna ɔda bubo bɔdi etemila aani baaƒɔ́ taadi sɔsɔ. Na ɔɔyá na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyáki lɛnunda ɔɔkɛ́-ni.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ buse kede kede na ɔɔbla ukyuli lili kemmo nwaa na ɔɔtí Unwoti lɛƒɔyɔ.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Ɔdia ka bekyuli beti ɔbu bete Unwoti na badubo butaabla lɛni uwi ndi uwi. Na kalɛ na Unwoti ɔɔtɛ etemila ni, use siin.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka bɔwia nwuna ɔda bubo butulo sika ugyiedi ɔni nse sɛɛn utulo ƒui iye uwɔ ɔni na bátasa ntu.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku ƒula ala bɔtina bɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni, aalɛ-mi, ƒula kabla ɔblane kpakplaa, na mɔɔkɛ́ kɔsia na litemi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi ɔsu.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ulánu anwu ɔlati ekpidi ƒui taati. Unwoti, die-mi lɛku ala ani na lɛ́bla na lɛɛɛgyi ka bɔƒiɔ na bɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: Na ada-mi edie ekpidi ani ngyi ka adi bɔƒiɔ asa na mɔɔbla lɛnɔ kemmo. Taya na ekpidi ammɔ adi-mi lɛlɔ kalɛ na kɔtɔ bɔdu bɔdi bulakya-mi lɛlɔ na lɛbla siin.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, awɔ ndi mina Lɛtakpɛ lɛni lɛlɔ na nkpo ku mina Udiene. Ya na mina kenye etemila ku mina kayi kemmo kakali kaƒɔ-ɔ anu.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔni na bula nana Yakob ɔ́kpa unu ƒula bɔkpali na ɔgbankpi limeyi na ɔgyumana-a.

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Na ubunku-ɔ na ute-ɔ ɔyikun ɔsiku nwuna kakpakɔ na Sion Kɔbi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: Na unyimo akpala ani na ábla éte-nwu ku ala ani na ákyula éte-nwu na aƒɔ-nwu anu.

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: Na ɔbla ƒula kayi lɛyɔla ute-ɔ. Na ɔya na ƒula kasusu kani na éti kebo kete lɛni.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Na bɔdububo kudu ku lɛlɔyɔ ka ádi lɛlɔ. Na nwuna lɛnyi kemmo na bɔdubɔkɔliku bula aƒlaga katɔ katɔ. Unwoti Katɔti ɔbla ala ani na eevele-nwu ƒui ute-ɔ.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni na ɔ́bla-mi nwaa ka Unwoti uubunku nwuna Ɔga Ɔƒunadi. Na uunú-nwu bɔkpali taasiku nwuna keliekɔ kedee na katɔ. Na ɔɔƒɔ́-nwu ɔkɛnku nwuna ɔyikun bonwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Na kekpokɔ ni, badi béti bana anu básia bapɔnkɔ ku bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ ɔyikun lɛlɔ. Nsu abu búti bula anu bɔ́sia Unwoti Katɔti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Bani anumi nsia ala ammɔ lɛlɔ ni, badubo kalɔ bubo na bebuli. Nsu abu ni, Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubo-bu katɔ bɔkɔliku na bunye kpakplaa.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ya na ƒula Ɔga ɔdi lɛlɔ. Na si bɔ́kpali-ɔ ni, na enu ete-bu.

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ ƒula ɔga na ƒula ɔyikun ala ani na aabla ɔsu. Na aayá na ebiti aada-nwu geen kalɛ na aayá na ɔɔdi lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Awɔ nábla nwuna kayi lɛyɔla éte-nwu na éte-nwu ala ani na úvele-ɔ.

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: Awɔ nébete-nwu kusɛ kusɛ pii. Na ébi-nwu sika ugyiedi kagabwa.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: Úvele-ɔ ngba, na éte-nwu ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: Ka áya na ɔ́di lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, nwuna ɔbu ɔ́kɔ katɔ geen. Na ɔ́ƒɔ lɛnyi na nwuna lɛgadi lɛ́kɛ ɔyikun na liikeye.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Ƒula kusɛ kusɛ ɔsiaku-nwu uwi ƒui. Na áya na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-nwu geen na ƒula anumi.

english_verse: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune lɛlɔ na bula ɔga ɔsia anu. Na ɔkɛnku Unwoti bɔyɔ bɔni naaavumana ɔsu ɔɔɔdubo bɔgbanta kudii.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔka nwuna bekisine ƒui ɔkya. Na ɔkɛnku nwuna ɔyikun lɛlɔ na uƒie ama bani muukisi-nwu mmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Si uwi ɔni na Unwoti ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ ku kɔnyi ni, ɔdubɔyila-ma udu aani kalɛ na lɛgyavonku lɛɛkyula ala.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: Ɔdubo-ma kaba kemmo bebi udu bɔyila na ɔdu-ma udie kede kede na ɔdi ɔsɔ ulébu.

english_verse: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
translation_verse: Ina béti kasusu ka babla-a likpidi ni, ulebo-nwu kemmo ulete-ma lɛni.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: Badubɔtu kama benwini na bekeli si áda álɛ-ma anumi ku ƒula kataminta ku atula ka ebo alɛ-ma.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: Unwoti, buumwi-ɔ na ƒula ɔyikun bonwu ɔsu. Na bɔdubɔtu kɔgya budie ƒula ablala keyi.

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: Mina Unwoti, mina Unwoti, bi ɔsu na áda-mi ányonu? Bi ɔsu na ágyunku-mi na elébo na ebedie-mi? Ina mɔɔva momoomo muedi neeenu kɔku kɔdi taasiku-ɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: O mina Unwoti Katɔti, mɔɔva laa limeyi limodi nsu alakpete-mi. Usien lɛnɔ muuwulo taalɔ-ɔ na liiibo bɔnwuna nsu neeenu kɔku kɔdi.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ ɔnii nse kedee eli ƒula lɛgaboku lɛlɔ aadi lɛlɔ. Na awɔ na Israel bebi ƒui baakpali teemwi.

english_verse: Our ancestors trusted you, and you rescued them.
translation_verse: Awɔ na bula bati kuuku báƒɔ bádi, ɔsika bana anu ƒui ásia-a lɛlɔ na áƒɔ-ma sɔsɔ.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: Bákpali-ɔ na édie-ma álɛku bana ɔgbankpi kemmo. Ɔsika ƒula lɛlɔ na bana anu asia ɔsu kɔƒa kulékpo-ma.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Nsu ami ni, liklubi na ndi. Nsɔ lɛɛɛdi ukyuli muedi. Na ukyuli biala ulayɔ-mi, baatɛmi enyekpi na mina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Na bani ƒui mɔɔnu-mi baamá-mi. Na baamɔsi taakunku bana eli taasu banini,

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: “Ka ɔnii nwuna lɛlɔ lɛɛda Unwoti Katɔti kubiti na ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di ka wedie-nwu ni, Unwoti udie-nwu na bɔnu.”

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ náƒɔ mina uni kɔwɔ uwi ɔni baawɔ-mi. Na ɔ́si uwi ɔni na mmu ndi ubiwɔ na mɔɔnyimi lɛnyii ni, étedie-mi atu.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si limeyi lɛni na báwɔ-mi kani na mina lɛlɔ bɔnu bɔkya-a enu kemmo. Na awɔ kani ndi mina Katɔti úti úbedu ɔƒɛni.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu tagyunku-mi, ɔsika ɔgbankpi ɔdubo-mi lɛlɔ na ɔdi uuubo na ubunku-mi.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: Bekisine pii benye kesi kesii bámana-mi aani bakɔ. Na bebo ɔkplu geen aani bakɔ bani nási Basan kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
translation_verse: Mina bekisine bébimi bana inye voo aani gyata ɔni muubó lɛdi ka babaduli-mi kɔkɛ kɔkɛ aani kalɛ na gyata ɔɔduli ebuo ɔni na úƒie.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: Mina ekubi ányonu lɛlɔ. Mina ɔlɔkplu ɔ́tɔlɔ na línwini aani kalɛ na beewilimi ntu teewi kalɔ. Na mina utu ɔɔyɛlɛ aani banwɛnwɛ lɛyu.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: Mina ɔyikun ɔ́sa aani libui lɛni nábwɛ kɔkɛ kɔkɛ. Na mina unyemi ɔ́du ɔ́ma-mi kenye kemmo. Na áya na bébi-mi kukpi ɔtumu.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bekpidi lisu badi bábla lɛlɔ aani bakpewe báka bámana-mi na bádu-mi enu ku lɛgba.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: Mina ekubi álɛ ewi keyi na mina bekisine bédie ɔnusɛ baanu-mi.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: Beele-mi lɛlɔ ala teete lɛlɔ. Na baatu egulabi na mina awu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: O mina Unwoti, awɔ mɔɔkya-mi ɔyikun. Tagyunku-mi bo na ebebunku-mi.

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Die-mi ngba siku bekisine bani nse aani bakpewe bani mɔɔwia-mi badu kudɔ.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Mina Unwoti Katɔti, die-mi lɛku mina bekisine bani nse aani bagyata mɛni enu kemmo aani kalɛ na édie-mi na bakɔ bani mbo ɔkplu mmɔ ese kenye.

english_verse: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ndubo ƒula lɛnyi kudu bubo bute mina banwa. Na ndubumwi-ɔ lɛnyi kedee na baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa ƒui akɔ.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Amii bani mɔɔyia Unwoti ƒui, bimwi-nwu lɛnyi. Na amii Yakob bebi ku bawɔ ƒui, bɛbu Unwoti Katɔti. Na amii Israel bebi ku bawɔ ƒui, bɛkya-nwu eli kalɔ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Unwoti ulenwini kama taakya bawabane iye bani muubó abi. Mmomu uunú si bákpali-nwu bévele-nwu kebunku.

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Ndubumwi-ɔ na kadi kasalakɔ na lɛla lɛni na ábla ɔsu. Na lɛla lɛni na líse kenye ka makpa mete-ɔ ni, ndubute-ni na bani mɔɔyia-a kasalakɔ anumi.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Bawabane badubo bɔdi bumo. Na bani mɔɔwia Unwoti Katɔti ni, badubo-nwu buteemwi uwi ndi uwi na ɔdubɔtɛ ute-ma uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Kayawi kadi bekyuli ƒui badubo bunyimo na benwini batásiaku Unwoti. Na kayawi bekyuli ƒui badubo-nwu bɔkpa.

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛga kadikɔ ƒui kadi Unwoti kadi. Na anwu mɔɔdi kadi bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
translation_verse: Balakɛne bani mɔɔdi taani kalɛ kalɛ ƒui badubɔkya lili kalɔ bete Unwoti. Na bani ƒui nkɛ na baayɔ́ bekpi na basɔ balákana lɛla lɛla bɔbla bute lɛlɔ ƒui badubɔkya lili kalɔ bete-nwu.
