english_verse: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Bekyuli ƒui badubo Unwoti bɔbu. Na kaba bekyuli bani masia ƒui badubo Unwoti lɛlɔ kɔtɛ bɔtɛmi bute-ma.

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Na bani na bátawɔ tɔ muedi badubo-nwu lɛlɔ litemi bunu ka Unwoti ɔ́ƒɔ nwuna bekyuli ngba.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
translation_verse: Unwoti ndi mina lɛlɔ ɔnune aani baƒonu ɔdane. Anwuɔsu naaayaki lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: Ɔɔkpanku-mi aani koƒonu teesienku kesii kani na livo lɛwɔdi lɛkya na lɛkun. Na ɔɔtɔnku-mi teesienku kesii kani abiɔ abuni ani ntu nába bɔkya na lɛni.

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: Ɔɔyá na mɔɔkɛ́ ɔyikun ɔwɔdi. Na ɔɔkpanku-mi na lɛsiaku-nwu kama siin kalɛ na babu-nwu.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Si ina nkɛ ntédu kasuudikɔ kani nse aani kekpine muedi ni, naaayia ɔgbankpi ɔdi. Ɔsika ngyi ka awɔ na nsiaku. Na ƒula ɔgagyii ku ugyii ɔdadi muusé-mi kayi.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: Aayá muuwi lɛlɔ buɛɛ taadi adila abuni teemo uwi ɔni na mina bekisine benye baanu. Eewi-mi nnɔmii lili na aanu-mi lɛlɔ geen aani kalɛ na baabla lɛƒɔ teete ɔbune. Na áya na mina ɔɔƒɛɛ úyi ku atu.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔnu lɛti kalɛ na ƒula lɛƒɔndia ku lɛbuni ku ƒula bɔyɔ bɔdubɔsiaku-mi na mina ngba emeyi ƒui kemmo, na ndubulie-ɔ kaduli uwi ƒui.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Kalɔ ku kana ala ani nkya-nya kemmo ƒui ni, adi Unwoti adi. Na kalɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli ƒui badi anwu badi.

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: Ɛpu bonwu ku ntukpa bɔni nkya kalɔ kemmo mmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔ́tu kayawi kammɔ ɔ́sia.

english_verse: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
translation_verse: Ɔma mbo kuƒi kɔni na ɔdubɔkana na ɔkɔ usie Unwoti kɔbi lɛlɔ na uduo nwuna kakpakɔ mmɔ?

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ udu ndi bani enu ku kayi kemmo nse sɛɛn na béteti bana anu bátasia lɛƒiɔkpa lɛlɔ iye bataanyi ɔkɔ taakpali ala.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubute-ma kusɛ kusɛ na ɔƒɔ-ma na ute-ma ubo ka likpidi lɛdi lɛɛɛma-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: because they worship and serve the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Bana udu mɔɔwia ulu ka bakpɛ bede Katɔti ɔni na bula Nana Yakob ɔ́kpa.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Bidi kuuku uwi kɔyakun kɔmmɔ bɛlɛmi biwi na Ɔga Unengudi ɔni muukeye mmɔ ubeduo.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Na ɔma ndi Ɔga Unengudi ɔni muukeye mmɔ? Anwu ndi Unwoti ɔyikune ɔni mɔɔdi nwuna bekisine ƒui lɛlɔ na kekpokɔ.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Bidi kuuku uwi kɔyakun kɔmmɔ bɛlɛmi biwi na Ɔga Unengudi ɔni muukeye mmɔ ubeduo.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Na ɔma ndi Ɔga Unengudi ɔni muukeye mmɔ? Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ndi Ɔga Unengudi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: Unwoti, líti mina lɛlɔ ƒui muute-ɔ bɔda.

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: O mina Katɔti, awɔ kani ndi mina lɛnunsia. Bunku-mi kalɛ na lɛlɔ liláyɔ mina bekisine ka bádi-mi lɛlɔ na kɔƒa kukpo-mi.

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: Unwoti, tina-mi ƒula ulu na lɛti kalɛ na lɛsiaku-ɔ kama na ɔyɔ-ɔ kaƒɔ.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Tɔnku-mi na atina-mi ƒula litemi geen lɛmmɔ. Ɔsika awɔ ndi mina Unwoti ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mi ngba, na ƒula lɛlɔ na mina anu asia uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, kali nu ƒula lɛƒɔndia ku bɔyɔ bɔni naaavumana kudii. Ɔsika lɛni na aabla teete-mi ɔ́si kukuuku.

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: Na takali tánu mina lɛkloƒu uwi ekpidi ani na lɛ́bla. Mmomu kali nu ƒula lɛƒɔndia ku bɔyɔ bɔni na átina-mi.

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: Ka Unwoti use siin na ɔdia ɔsu ni, ɔɔtina alaekpidi bablane ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔlɛka basia.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔtɔnku bekyuli bani muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ taasiaku ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔɔtina-ma kalɛ na babla nwuna lɛƒɔyɔ.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ na ɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli bani mɔɔdi nwuna ɔda bubo lɛlɔ na baasia nwuna bunyimi anu.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛnyi ɔsu ni, ti mina bɔƒiɔ ƒui kyiɛ-mi ina ka bumomo na babu-ɔ.

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔyia Unwoti ni, ama na ɔɔtina ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na badubɔsia.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: Na badubo ngba bulie ku keyi buɛɛ. Na bana kaba kemmo bebi badubɔdi kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ ala.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔɔdiku bekyuli bani mɔɔbu-nwu kɔkpana na uunyimene-ma bunyimi bɔni nkya anwu ku-ma ntɛ.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: Ndubunye ntaanu Unwoti ulu uwi ndi uwi. Ɔsika anwu ndubɔtɔnku-mi kalɛ na neeeduo ɔgbankpi ɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: Unwoti, lisienti lɛɛdu-mi na mɔɔkywí kaƒɔ na ala étulo-mi. Anwuɔsu nwini nu-mi na anu-mi kɔnyana, ɔsika ɔyikun ɔ́sa-mi.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Ala ani muukpóku-mi kayi emomo etulo-mi. Anwuɔsu die-mi lɛku kɔnyana bonwu kɔmɛni kemmo.

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Nu ala ani muukpóku-mi ku kalɛ na muunú ɔlɛ na mina lɛlɔ kemmo, na eti mina alaekpidi akyiɛ-mi.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Kali nu kalɛ na mina bekisine beemomo na bana anumi égyie-mi lɛlɔ geen ku bukisi.

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Gyumana-mi na edie-mi na ɔgbankpi kemmo. Na taya na kɔƒa kukpo-mi. Ɔsika ƒula lɛlɔ kani na mina anu asia.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: Unwoti agyi ka mɔɔbla lɛbuni na nsiaku-ɔ kama siin. Anwuɔsu muuvele-ɔ, bo na ebedie-mi, ɔsika mɔɔnu-ɔ ulu.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: Unwoti, muuvele-ɔ nnii die Israel lɛku nwuna lɛbibo ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: Unwoti, tina ka lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-mi na ete-mi ubo. Ɔsika lɛ́da lɛlɔ lídie likpidi ulu biala lɛlɔ na nsiku-ɔ kama siin na ntedeyi kesii bamba.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: Unwoti, duo-mi kayi ku kasusu kemmo nu, na akɔku-mi anu kalɛ na nse.

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: Ngyi ka ebo bɔyɔ bɔni na bulavumana na aadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi, anwuɔsu na nsiaku-ɔ kama.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: Naaadiku ɔkɔ banyine ku anumi lɛlɔ bekyuli kɔkpana.

english_verse: or go with evil crowds.
translation_verse: Nkisi alaekpidi bablane ku balalane na neeese liboku bana kudɔ.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: Lídie mina enu katɔ mɔɔtina ka nse sɛɛn na mɔɔkpá-a taaka taamana ƒula lɛkpabi.

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula kakpakɔ kamɛni geen, ɔsika mmɔ na ƒula ɔbu ku bukeye bɔkya.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na adubɔyila alaekpidi bablane ku bekyuli badune udu ni, teti-mi tasalaku-ma.

english_verse: or full of meanness or who bribe others.
translation_verse: Bebo kalala kɔkwɛ na baabɛ́ taaƒɔ sika taadi.

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Nsu ami ni, mɔɔbla ala ani na ese siin. Nu-mi kɔnyana na edie-mi na ɔgbankpi biala kemmo.

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔƒaani ni, nnye kenyekɔ kabuni kani na lɛɛɛdubo bɔgbanta. Na uwi ɔni na ƒula bekyuli bása ni, ndubo-ɔ lɛnyi kudu bubo.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: Unwoti ndi mina bukeye na anwu muudie-mi lɛbibo biala kemmo. Ɔdi mina katamikukɔ kani muukeli teesie na ɔɔgyumana-mi ɔsu naaayia.

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Si balalane ku mina bekisine báta banii babadu-mi muedi ni, badubo butulo na bebuli.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Si ina bekpone otogyi ɔdi náka bana-mi muedi ni, ɔtɔtɔ biala ɔɔɔdubo-mi bɔgyu. Ina kekpo na báta-mi lɛlɔ muedi ni, ndubuti mina anu bɔsia Unwoti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: Mmomu lɛla linwi pɛ kani na muuvele mina Unwoti kpakplaa nnii ɔya na lɛkɛ keliekɔ na nwuna ɔtɔ kemmo. Na lɛsɔ lilie mmɔ mina ngba emeyi ƒui kemmo na ntaanu Unwoti bɔdia na nteevele-nwu kasusu taasiku nwuna kakpakɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Na ɔgbankpi limeyi ni, ɔdubo-mi bɔgyumana na mmɔ. Na uti-mi utábɛla na lɛtakpɛ lɛni nákuku lili na kesii kani na ulie.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Na ka ɔ́ya na lɛ́di mina bekisine bani náka báma-mi lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, ndubuti mina akpala liboku-nwu na libo kudu ku lɛlɔyɔ na lidie lɛnu limwi-nwu.

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: Unwoti, mina kayi kaasu-mi ka lɛni lide-ɔ. Anwuɔsu na líbo-ɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, O mina Unwoti Katɔti, awɔ lɛnɔ tada ƒula anumi tedie-mi lɛlɔ. Na teti kɔnyi takya ƒula kabla ɔblane na abɔku-nwu. Ɔsika awɔ ndi mina ɔƒɔne ɔni muubunku-mi.

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Si ina mina bawɔne béni-mi muedi ni, ngyi ka awɔ adubɔnu-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Tina-mi kalɛ na lɛbla ƒula lɛyɔla. Da-mi kɔkɔɔkɔ siaku ulu ɔbuni lɛlɔ na mina bekisine ɔsu.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Tanyonu-mi takya mina bekisine enu kemmo. Ɔsika ɔkɔ banyine báta ku lɛnungyie kemmo na baanyi ɔkɔ taasia-mi na baawia ka badu-mi.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: Mmu muusé kayi ka ndubulie ngba na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ na lɛnu lɛti kalɛ na Unwoti lɛƒɔndia lɛsiaku-mi.

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Kya ɔkplu na ataanu Unwoti ulu. Enu ataƒɛ-ɔ taanu-nwu anumi.

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: Unwoti, awɔ ndi mina lɛtakpɛ lɛni lɛlɔ na lɛ́kada líkpo ɔsu na mɔɔkpali-ɔ. Nu mina kɔvanu! Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, agyi anii ami lɛnɔ ndubukpi ntéduo bekpine akɔ.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Unwoti, mɔɔva taakpali-ɔ. Lɛ́kɔliku mina enu katɔ mɔɔtina ƒula kakpakɔ kedee kesii kani na elie, na muuvele-ɔ nnii bunku-mi.

english_verse: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
translation_verse: Taka-mi takya alaekpidi bablane akɔ na ani-bu esienku litemi katɛkɔ. Badi bekyuli bani muute bana bakpana keyi buɛɛ, nsu likpidi sɔɔn nkya-ma kayi kemmo.

english_verse: Treat them as they deserve! Punish them for their sins.
translation_verse: Ƒɔ-ma kayu kani námanku-ma na eti ani-ma na ekpidi ani na bábla kenye.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Balábu ala ani na Unwoti údie ku ani na ɔ́bla. Anwuɔsu ɔdubɔni-ma kɔtu na ɔyila-ma udu uwi ƒui.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: Bɛya bumwi Unwoti, ɔsika únu mina kɔvanu na úbunku-mi.

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Unwoti mɔɔgyumana-mi na uute-mi ɔyikun. Nwuna lɛlɔ na mina kayi kasia na úbunku-mi sɔsɔ. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na kayi kaayɔ́-mi geen. Na ndubɔtu enugya ɔnu lite-nwu.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Unwoti muute nwuna bekyuli ɔyikun na ɔdi katamikukɔ ute Ɔga Ɔƒunadi.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: Unwoti, gyumana bekyuli bani na áƒuna na badi awɔ badi na eete-ma kusɛ kusɛ na ada-ma aani kalɛ na baƒonu ɔdane ɔɔda nwuna baƒonu ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Amii Katɔti batu ƒui bimwi Unwoti Katɔti, na bɛtina kalɛ na uukeye na ubo ɔyikun.

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Bimwi Unwoti ɔni nse kedee ƒui na biboku eli kalɔ bite-nwu. Ubo ɔyikun na nwuna lɛgadi liikeye.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Unwoti uukeye na uudie lɛdi momoomo aani kalɛ na katɔ keedu. Na nwuna lɛdi kɔku kɔ́ƒɔ ɛpu ntu bɔmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
translation_verse: Unwoti lɛdi libo ogya geen na lɛɛtina nwuna lɛgadi ɔyikun.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: Na egyii enengudi ani mbo ɔkplu na enye Lebanon abi lɛlɔ ni, Unwoti lɛdi lɛɛƒɛ-nya ƒui kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: Ɔɔyá na Lebanon abi aaƒulu aani ɔmantɛ bakɔ bebi. Na ɔɔyá na Hermon Kɔbi kɔɔƒulu aani lɛku kemmo akɔ ubi.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Na Unwoti lɛdi lɛɛyá na kayaa kaabwɛ ogya.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: Na Kades kalɔ kakwiidi kemodi ƒui kaakunku na kaakya ɔƒɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: Unwoti lɛdi lɛɛyá egyii enengudi ammɔ eelii lɛlɔ na evete eewile-nya eli ƒui na lɛku lɛ́bla ƒue. Na bani ƒui nkya nwuna ɔtɔ mmɔ beemwi kalɛ na úbomo na uukeye.

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Unwoti uli kalɔ kpli ɔɔdi ɛpu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔdi ala ƒui muedi lɛlɔ úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti uute nwuna kadi bekyuli ɔyikun. Na uute-ma kusɛ kusɛ na keyi kaayɔ́ku-ma.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: O mina Unwoti, muubó-ɔ kudu na mɔɔkɔliku-ɔ lɛnyi katɔ, ɔsika awɔ nédie-mi na átaya na mina bekisine badi-mi lɛlɔ na bakɛ ebiti.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: Ka líwulo lɛ́kpali-ɔ ni, énu-mi bɔkpali na ébebunku-mi na ábwi-mi.

english_verse: saving me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: O mina Unwoti, édie-mi na kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo na línwini líbo nli ngba.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: Amii bani nsiaku Unwoti kama siin ni, bidie lɛnu bimwi-nwu na bitaakali kalɛ na use kedee.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: Uléti kɔnyi taakya ukyuli uwi gyɔlɔɔ. Mmomu nwuna lɛƒɔndia lise lísela uwi ƒui. Si ina keku sɔɔn na buuwulo usien umodi ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-bu ɔtanta.

english_verse: I felt secure and thought, “I'll never be shaken!”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ala átɛnku-mi ni, lɛ́kali na lɛ́su nnii, “Lɛla biala lɛsɔ lilékpoku-mi ɔƒɛni amu.”

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, uwi ɔni na ábla-mi lɛƒɔndia ni, mina kenyekɔ káda kalɔ kpakplaa aani kɔbi. Nsu uwi ɔni na édie ƒula anumi na mina lɛlɔ blii ni, lɛ́yia geen.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: O Unwoti, líwulo lɛ́kpali-ɔ nnii bunku-mi.

english_verse: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
translation_verse: Lɛ́nu lɛ́ti ka aaadubo kɔsia kɔdi bɔkɛ si líkpi. Ɔsika si línwini lɛti ni, dɛ na ndubɔkana na limwi-ɔ iye libo-ɔ kudu na ƒula lɛƒɔndia lɛni naaavumana kudii lɛlɔ?

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! Help!”
translation_verse: Unwoti, nu-mi bɔkpali na anu-mi kɔnyana na ebunku-mi.

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: Áya na mina kɔnyana kúnwini ebiti katɔ. Na use aani kalɛ na baalɛ́ adi atonwudi kemmo na beenyimi aƒualadi.

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na nkya kɔnyana kemmo ni, ntakana na limwi-ɔ. Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, lɛɛɛdubo mina kenye bubile mmomu ndubo-ɔ enu butaagya uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
translation_verse: Unwoti, awɔ na líkeli ḿbatamiku. Taya na kɔƒa kukpo-mi. Muuvele-ɔ nnii die-mi, ɔsika ese siin.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Nu-mi bɔkpali na ebo pla ebedie-mi. Na enwini katamikukɔ lɛtakpɛ bonwu ete-mi na lɛgyumana-mi.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Ka awɔ ndi mina lɛtakpɛ ku katamikukɔ ɔsu ni, tɔnku-mi na bete-ɔ lɛnyi ɔbu.

english_verse: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Die-mi lɛku kakpagyuɛ kani na mina bekisine bákywɛ-mi kemmo. Ɔsika awɔ ndi mina kama kekpokɔ.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, líti mina kɔyu lɛ́kya-a enu kemmo. Anwuɔsu die-mi, ɔsika aadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔkpá baƒiɔ ku ala keeke ni, nkisi-ma. Na ami ni, awɔ Unwoti lɛlɔ na líti mina anu ƒui lɛ́sia.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: Ebiti adubɔda-mi na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mi na ƒula lɛƒɔndia ɔsu. Ɔsika ánu ala ani muukpóku-mi áti ku abi ani muubó.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Átanyonu-mi átakya mina bekisine enu kemmo, mmomu édie-mi bana ntɛ étényene kalɔ ƒiaa lɛlɔ na lɛ́kɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Mina ngba ƒui bɔdi ɔlɛ bunu sɔɔn ku kɔnyana uwi ɔni ƒui. Na mina ɔlɔna lɛnɔ ɔ́bla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ na mina ekpidi ɔsu. Na mina ekubi áyɔ lɛlɔ na asɔ alákana-mi bɔda.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: Mina bekisine báya na mina badukɛne muedi baanu-mi anumi taalɔ-mi anyikpi. Na línwini liƒu lɛla líte bekyuli na beekeli-mi si bánu-mi na ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: Báyiƒala-mi aani kalɛ na baayiƒala ukpine. Na lɛ́ta línwini aani kubuikɛ kɔni na bébo béwiakun.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: Baalɔ-mi anyikpi na anumi ani na baakywɛ-mi lɛƒɛnyi ƒui aakya-mi liƒu. Na baasa lili kalɛ na babla na badu-mi.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ Unwoti lɛlɔ kani na mina anu asia, ɔsika lɛ́lɛ ugyii ka awɔ ndi mina Katɔti.

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: Mina ngba ƒui bɔkya-a enu kemmo. Anwuɔsu die-mi na mina bekisine enu kemmo ku bekyuli bani nábi basiaku-mi beekpóku-mi kudɔ.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ƒɛnimi anumi kya ami ƒula kabla ɔblane na aƒɔ-mi, ɔsika ƒula bɔyɔ bulávumana.

english_verse: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
translation_verse: O mina Unwoti, taya na kɔƒa kukpo-mi, ɔsika ƒula lɛnyi kani mɔɔlɔ. Nsu balalane ama ni, ya na kɔƒa kukpo-ma na batátɛ kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo kpoo.

english_verse: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
translation_verse: Bala ɔkɔ banyine bammɔ ƒui kenye, ɔsika baakun lɛmɛnɛ na baatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ. Na baalɔ bekyuli bani nsiaku-ɔ kama siin anyikpi.

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: Áklibi ala abuni geen ése bekyuli bani mɔɔbu-ɔ na békeli bábatamiku-ɔ. Na adubuti-nya ete-ma na bekyuli ƒui anumi.

english_verse: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.
translation_verse: Aabɛla-ma na ƒula kudɔ kalɛ na ukyuli ɔdi ulakana-ma kakpagyuɛ kadi bɔkywɛ. Adubɔkya-ma ƒula lɛgbanya kemmo kalɛ na bana bekisine basɔ balanu ɔdi beledumi.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: Bimwi Unwoti, ɔsika údie nwuna lɛƒɔndia bonwu ɔ́tina-mi uwi ɔni na mina bekisine báka bámana-mi aani kalɛ na baaka ɔma taakya.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Ɔsika uwi ɔni na ala étulo-mi ni, lɛ́su ka asɔ aaadaku-mi lɛda. Nsu énu-mi kɔnyana buwulo uwi ɔni na lɛ́kpali-ɔ nnii bunku-mi.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Amii bekyuli bani mɔɔdi Unwoti litemi lɛlɔ ƒui bɛyɔ-nwu. Ɔsika ɔɔgyumana nwuna badi bani mɔɔdi nwuna etemila lɛlɔ kpakplaa. Na bani mɔɔkɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ ni, Unwoti ɔɔƒɔ-ma kayu kani néduku-ma.

english_verse: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu amii bani ƒui néti anu bɛ́sia Unwoti lɛlɔ ni, bise kayi na bɛkya ɔkplu.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni na Katɔti úti nwuna bɔƒiɔ ɔ́kyiɛ-nwu na údie ekpidi nwuna lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Na lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni ekpidi na Blɔti ulábu teese-nwu na ɔkɔ ala bɔbla bɔdi buuubo-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ntedie tɔ mina ekpidi kalɔ ni, mina kayi kemmo kémii na muuwulo momoomo limeyi limodi ɔsu mina ekubi átɔ na ɔlɔna kemmo.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Unwoti, usien ku ɔƒɛ ƒui ni, aaní-mi kɔtu na mina ɔyikun ɔ́sa na lɛ́ta lɛ́bla aani kalɛ na ntu bɔ́kwii taasa kaƒɛndi uwi kalɔ.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Amu na lɛ́nu mina alaekpidi lɛ́ti na lɛ́su nnini, “Ndubudie mina bɔƒiɔ ƒui kalɔ lite awɔ Unwoti.” Lídie-nya kalɔ líte-ɔ sɔsɔ na nteti ɔdi ntabɛla-a. Anwuɔsu awɔ lɛnɔ ti kyiɛ-mi.

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ukyuli biala mɔɔdi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ ɔsia anu na ɔkpali-ɔ uwi ndi uwi na adubunu ete-nwu. Na si ina ɔgbankpi ɔdi na ɔdi aani ketu néyi na kaanwanɛ lɛlɔ kalɛ kalɛ muedi, ntu bɔmmɔ bɔɔɔdubo bɔni bude-nwu na buƒie-nwu kudii.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Awɔ ndi mina kabɛkɔ. Na adubɔgyumana-mi na ɔgbankpi uwi. Na ndubudie lɛnu lɛtina kalɛ na éti áƒɔ-mi.

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Ndubɔtina-a kesii kani ɔlɛka asia ku lɛla lɛni na ɔlɛka abla. Na ami ɔlati ndubutaanu-ɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Bitabla aani bapɔnkɔ iye bebuo ala betine kalɛ. Ɔsika kabuli na baabala-ma kenye taatina-ma bana kavinkɔ ka beeebo kasusu ɔsu.

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Balalane badubo abi bubo geen. Nsu bekyuli bani meti bana anu masia Unwoti lɛlɔ ni, nwuna bɔyɔ bɔni naaavumana kudii bɔdubɔka bɔmana-ma.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
translation_verse: Amii bani nsiaku-nwu kama siin bibo lɛlɔyɔ kudu na bɛsu lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́bla úte-mii. Na amii bani muunú-nwu litemi ni, bimwi-nwu lɛnyi.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Bimwi Unwoti ku bina lɛbentaa. Na bɛgya asiwa na bidie lɛnu bimwi Unwoti.

english_verse: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti Katɔti litemi lise siin. Na nwuna ablala ƒui adi ulu geen ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ɔɔtɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ na ɔɔyɔ́ lɛla biala lɛni nse siin. Na nwuna bɔyɔ bɔni naaavumana bɔ́ƒɔ kayawi ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti údie lɛdi. Na ɔkɛnku nwuna kenye butemi lɛlɔ údie katɔ ku ɔƒɛ ku kɔbuli ku ayabi.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Amii kayawi ala ƒui, bɛyia Unwoti Katɔti. Na amii bekyuli bani nkya kayawi kammɔ kemmo ni, bɛbu-nwu.

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ka údie lɛdi ni, lɛla biala lɛ́da lɛ́lɛ. Na ɔkɛnku nwuna kenye butemi kemmo na lɛla biala linye nina kenyekɔ.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
translation_verse: Unwoti úbile kadi bekyuli kasusu ku kɔkwɛ biala na baakya kemmo. Na ɔɔyá na kulalɛ ɔbuni.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Nsu nwuna kasusu aka kalávumana na nwuna kayi lɛyɔla kani ndubunye ute kaba bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ kadi bekyuli bani mɔɔbu Unwoti kani, ama bani na ɔ́ƒuna aani nwuna bebi!

english_verse: The Lord looks at the world
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔnu bayawine ƒui taasiku katɔ.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: Ɔɔnu-ma taasiku kesii kani na ulie ɔɔdi lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Anwu návɔ bana ƒui kɔyi. Na ɔgyi bana ablala ƒui ɔni na lɛla lɛdi lilábɛ-nwu.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: Ɔga ɔdi uládi lɛlɔ na nwuna bekpone bumomo ɔyikun ɔsu. Lɛni kani na ukpone lɛnɔ uládi lɛlɔ, ɔsika ubo ɔyikun unengudi ɔdi ɔsu.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Kekpo bapɔnkɔ baaadi lɛla lɛni na basia anu bete kekpo lɛlɔ bɔdi. Na bana ɔyikun bonwu ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ulakana na waƒɔ-nwu na kekpokɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti anumi asia bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔbu-nwu na bana anu asia nwuna bɔyɔ bɔni naaavumana kudii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: He protects them from death and starvation.
translation_verse: Uudie-ma taalɛku kukpi kemmo na uute-ma adila na kɔka uwi.

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Abu ni, Unwoti lɛlɔ na bula anu asia. Na ɔdi bula ɔgyumanane ku bula ubunkune.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Ɔsika nwuna lɛlɔ na bula kayi kaakɛ́ ebiti. Na nwuna lɛnyi kedee lɛlɔ kani na bula anu asia.

english_verse: Be kind and bless us! We depend on you.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ya na ƒula bɔyɔ bɔni naaavumana kudii bɔsiaku-bu, ɔsika ƒula lɛlɔ kani na bɔsia anu.

english_verse: I will always praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Ndubuteemwi Unwoti uwi biala kemmo. Na lɛɛɛdubo-nwu enu bɔda bɔgya bɔya kudii.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: Na mina lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui kadubuyi ku lɛlɔyɔ na nwuna lɛlɔ. Bekyuli bani na ala eekpóku benu ɔmɛni na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-ma.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: Bibunku-mi na bumwi Unwoti lɛnyi na bɔkɔli-nwu lɛnyi katɔ bɔsala.

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: Lɛ́kpali Unwoti na únu úte-mi na údie-mi ɔ́lɛku ala ani ƒui mɔɔkya-mi liƒu kemmo.

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: Bani ƒui na bana anu asia Unwoti lɛlɔ ni, bana anumi adubukeye na kɔƒa kulékpo-ma.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nánu báti ka básɔ ni, bákpali-nwu na únu úte-ma na údie-ma lɛbibo ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔtu ɔɔnu taamana bekyuli bani mɔɔyia Unwoti na uudie-ma.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Bɛni bide Unwoti na bɛnu kalɛ na ɔdia. Ukyuli ɔni néti Unwoti ɔ́bla nwuna katamikukɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubo-nwu bɔyɔ.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: Bɛyia Unwoti amii bekyuli bani mɔɔdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ. Ɔsika bani ƒui mɔɔyia-nwu ni, baláyaki lɛla lɛbuni lɛdi.

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Bagyata ɔyikun ɔɔyii udu na baayaki lɛdila na baatɛ kɔka. Nsu bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔwia Unwoti kama ulu ni, balayaki lɛla lɛbuni lɛdi kudii.

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Amii mina bebi, bibo na binu lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu-mii. Ndubɔtina-mii kalɛ na baayia Unwoti.

english_verse: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔwia ka ulie ngba gyɔlɔɔ na keyi kayɔku-nwu ni,

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: ɔlɛka ɔda nwuna unyemi kaduɛ na ulatɛmi enyekpi iye utaanyi ɔkɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Ɔda likpidi bɔbla ɔya na utaabla lɛbuni, na ɔsia ulu biala lɛlɔ na nwuna kayi kabla ƒaa ku bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔnu bekyuli bani nse siin lɛlɔ, na uunú bana bɔkpali.

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bekpidi ni, Unwoti uléti anumi abuni taanu-ma. Mmomu si békpi ni, bana anyi ayii.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti bekyuli bani nsiaku-nwu siin ama ni, baava taalɔ-nwu na uunú teete-ma kɔnakunwi. Na uudie-ma na ala ani nda-ma kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: Unwoti ude bani na enu áƒɛ-ma na ala étulo-ma. Na ɔɔƒɔ́ bani na bana lɛnunsia ƒui lɛ́sa.

english_verse: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni nsiaku-nwu siin ni, ala lidu lidu akana na ekpoku-nwu nsu Unwoti ɔdubudie-nwu kede kede.

english_verse: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
translation_verse: Ɔdubo-nwu bɔgyumana ɔni na nwuna kesii kadi kaláƒɔ ɔlɛ.

english_verse: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
translation_verse: Alaekpidi ani na ukyuli ɔɔbla ni, anya kani ndubo-nwu bɔdu. Na ukyuli ɔni muukisi ukyuli ɔni nsiaku Unwoti kama siin ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔdu-nwu kɔtɔ.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Unwoti uudie nwuna kabla bablane ngba na ɔgbankpi kemmo. Na bani ƒui muukeli taatamiku-nwu ni, uládu-ma kɔtɔ.

english_verse: Shield me and help me.
translation_verse: Ti ƒula likpola ku lɛgyumanala na enye ete-mi.

english_verse: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
translation_verse: Na edie ƒula atula gyɔlɔɔ keyi na enye etile bani ƒui nékeli badubo-mi lɛlɔ. Na ese-mi kayi ka adubɔƒɔ-mi na ekpo ete-mi.

english_verse: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
translation_verse: Ya na kɔƒa kukpo bekyuli bani na bana anumi égyie na mina lɛlɔ. Na aya na bani nábla kɔkwɛ ƒui na mina lɛlɔ kasusu keƒu.

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: Ya na benwini aƒaƒaa ani na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uubó taavinku. Na ƒula ɔtu ubabɔku-ma usienku kama.

english_verse: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
translation_verse: Ya na bana kɔvinkɔ ƒui kɔbla suu na kuteegyiile uwi ɔni na ƒula batu beekpóku-ma na baabɔku-ma.

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: Ńtabla-ma lɛla lɛdi, nsu baabɛ́ taakywɛ-mi kɔkpagyuɛ ka bedie-mi. Na béku libu bonwu bonwu bése-mi ka lɛnu liduo-ni kemmo.

english_verse: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
translation_verse: Ya na ɔgbankpi uyu-ma ɔtu ɔni na baaagyi beeese. Na aya na kɔkpagyuɛ kɔni na bákywɛ-mi kudie-ma. Na banu beduo libu lɛni na ama alati béku bése-mi kemmo na bayii udu na mmɔ.

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Na mina lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui kayɔ ku ebiti na mina Unwoti Katɔti lɛlɔ ka ɔ́ƒɔ-mi ɔsu.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔsu ku mina kayi ƒui nnini, “Ukyuli ɔdi uuuse aani Unwoti kalɛ.” Ɔsika anwu muudie bekyuli bani nse kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ taalɛku bayikune bani ntulo-ma enu kemmo. Na uudie bawabane taalɛku bayikune bani ntulo-ma na baanya-ma taakya enu kemmo.

english_verse: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ banyine báta na bánwi etemila ani lɛlɔ na lɛɛɛgyi básia-mi ka ami nábla-nya.

english_verse: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
translation_verse: Na béti likpidi báƒɔ-mi na lɛbuni lɛni na lɛ́bla kayu kalɛ na bedie-mi lɛti ku kɔnyana.

english_verse: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔni na ama beeƒi ni, línyimi kenye na líti kɔnyana adala lɛ́da na lɛ́kpali katɔ lívele líte-ma. Nsu mina buvele ƒui bɔ́sɔ búnwini búbo-mi lɛgba akɔ.

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: Kaƒɔ kákywi-mi aani si mina ɔnwani iye ɔkpana geen ɔdi nékpi. Na nkɛ mɔɔví ku kɔnyana kemmo teewulo aani si mina uni nékpi.

english_verse: I have stumbled, and worthless liars I don't even know surround me and sneer.
translation_verse: Nsu ka líduo ɔgbankpi kemmo ni, lɛlɔ mɔɔyɔ́-ma. Na bása lili mina lɛlɔ na baabla-mi kalala ɔni na lɛɛɛgyi-ma muedi.

english_verse: Worthless people make fun and never stop laughing.
translation_verse: Na anumi lɛlɔ bekyuli béese kalɔ baakun lɛmɛnɛ na baadu anyi na ami ɔsu teedumi-mi.

english_verse: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, buvele tenye tanu ɔmɛni gyɔlɔɔ. Die-mi lɛku bekyuli bani nsiaku-mi beekpóku-mi kpakplaa aani bagyata mɛni enu kemmo.

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: Ndubɔgya-a enu uwi ɔni na ƒula kadi bekyuli bása. Na limwi-ɔ lɛnyi na bana anumi.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, taya na bekyuli bani muukisi-mi keeke mɛni bakɛ ebiti na mina lɛbibo ɔsu. Na taya na bataamana bana anumi taakya-mi ka bákɛ lɛla lɛni na baawia ɔsu. Nsu ɔɔɔdi lɛla lɛdi na lɛ́bla-ma.

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bamɛni balátina keyi buɛɛ lɛla lɛdi na bana atɛ kemmo. Mmomu ɔkɔ ala kani na baanwí taasia bekyuli bani nse buɛɛ na kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: Na baadú-mi kɔtɔ teebo kɔnu kenye taasu banini, “Abu alati bɔ́nu lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla.”

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ala amɛni ƒui adi biala átabɛ-ɔ. Anwuɔsu buvele tagyunku-mi na asɔ elie kpoo ataanu.

english_verse: Fight to defend me, Lord God,
translation_verse: Mina Unwoti Katɔti, buvele ta na ekpo aƒɔ-mi.

english_verse: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
translation_verse: Ka ese sin ɔsu ni, tɛ litemi lɛmɛni na ete-mi ubo. Na taya na bakɛ ebiti ekpludi adi na mina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
translation_verse: Taya na basu na bana kayi kemmo banini, “Lɛni geen na bɔɔwia ka ɔlɛku-nwu. Na ɔƒɛni amu bɔ́wɔlɔ-nwu.”

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: Mmomu ya na kɔƒa kukpo bani ƒui mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na mina lɛlɔ na mina ɔgbankpi ɔsu. Na aya beƒu na bana ablala kemmo. Na kɔƒa kunwini awu na bakya na bana anumi ewi kalɔ.

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ƒui na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ ka éte-mi ubo ni, bava momoomo ku ebiti. Na bataasu uwi biala banini, “Unwoti Katɔti ɔni mɔɔwia nwuna kabla ɔblane kadia ni, nwuna lɛnyi lɛkɔ katɔ kesii biala.”

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: Na ndububo-ɔ kudu na nteemwi-ɔ limeyi limodi ɔ́si kalɛ na ese siin ɔsu.

english_verse: Sinners don't respect God; sin is all they think about.
translation_verse: Alaekpidi bablane ɔbladu ulátina ka baayia Katɔti. Mɔɔnu ka likyulikpi kasusu kani na beeti.

english_verse: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na baanu lɛlɔ katɔ katɔ ɔsu ni, bana likyulikpi líse-ma lisusu na balánu alaekpidi ani na baabla taati na beni-nya.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: Alaekpidi ku ɔkɔ ala sɔɔn na baatɛmi. Na bédeyi bálɛ lɛnunda ulu lɛlɔ na basɔ balábla lɛbuni lɛdi.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: Balásia lɛbuni bɔbla ulu biala lɛlɔ. Na si batɛ bana atɛla lɛlɔ muedi likpidi lɛlɔ kasusu kani na baatɛ teeti. Anwuɔsu lɛnɔ na béni ka bada bana alaekpidi bɔbla baya.

english_verse: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ƒula bɔyɔ bɔni naaavumana kudii ku kalɛ na aadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ ulu lɛlɔ úbomo geen aani kalɛ na bɔɔnu kalɛ na kayaa kébomo.

english_verse: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na ese siin ɔ́da lidu kalɔ utulo abi ani nnye na bɔɔnu. Na kalɛ na aatɛ litemi taasiaku ulu lɛlɔ utulo kalɛ na ɛpu kemmo kágyu. Na awɔ kani mɔɔnu bekyuli ku bebuo ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Ƒula bɔyɔ bɔni naaavumana kudii bɔ́ƒɔ kuye butulo lɛla biala. Na ƒula avwi akɔ na bekyuli ƒui baakɛ́ kabɛkɔ.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: Eete-bu adila taasiku ala pii ani néyi-ɔ kaduli mmɔ na bɔɔdi teemo. Na áya na bɔɔní ntu taasiku ƒula ketu kani ntu mɔɔyu kayi buɛɛ kemmo.

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: Awɔ muute lɛla biala ngba. Na ƒula bukeye mɔɔyá na bɔɔnu nwaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: Unwoti, buuvele-ɔ bɔnii taatina bekyuli bani ngyi-ɔ ƒula bɔyɔ bɔni naaavumana kudii mmɔ. Na eteete bani ƒui mɔɔbla ƒula lɛƒɔyɔ ku kayi sɛɛn ala abuni.

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Taya na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ ɔdi ubekpoku-mi. Na ukyuli ukpidi ɔdi utabɔku-mi.

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Aanu kesii kani na alaekpidi bablane bébuli batɛ ɔni na basɔ balakana bɔta!

english_verse: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
translation_verse: Kayi ketekpoku-ɔ si ala aatɛku ukyuli ukpidi. Na anumi étegyie-ɔ na nwuna kabla lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Ti ƒula anu sia Unwoti lɛlɔ na ataabla lɛbuni na adubulie ngba ku kubiti na kalɔ lɛlɔ na lɛla lɛdi lilékpoku-ɔ.

english_verse: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
translation_verse: Ya na ebiti ataada-a na Unwoti lɛlɔ na ɔdubɔbla ƒula kayi ayɔla ute-ɔ.

english_verse: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
translation_verse: Ti ƒula ala ƒui siaku Unwoti Katɔti lɛlɔ na aƒɔ-nwu adi, na ɔdubɔbla lɛla lɛni námanku ute-ɔ.

english_verse: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
translation_verse: Ɔdubɔya na ƒula ala ani na aabla siin eteekeye aani lɛdigye. Na ɔtɛ ƒula litemi na ɔbla nwaa aani ɔƒiiwi.

english_verse: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
translation_verse: Kɛ bɔnwuna na Unwoti lɛlɔ na akɛ kayi na enye ataanu-nwu anumi. Kayi ketekpoku-ɔ na ala ani mɔɔtɛku ukyuli ɔdi ɔsu, iye ka ukyuli ukpidi kɔkwɛ kɔni na ɔɔkya kɔɔtɛ-nwu ɔsu.

english_verse: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Ɔsika likpidi bablane ƒui ni, Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubo-ma ngba udu bɔyila. Nsu bekyuli bani néti bana anu básia Unwoti lɛlɔ ni, ama ndubo kalɔ kammɔ ala bɔdi.

english_verse: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bani néboku lɛlɔ kalɔ ama badubɔdi kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ala na bana keyi kayɔ buɛɛ.

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi beeti kasusu kekpidi na bekyuli babuni lɛlɔ na baadu anyi kpakplaa na bana lɛlɔ.

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔmá bekyuli bekpidi bammɔ. Ɔsika ɔgyi ka bana emeyi asia ulu adubo na badubo-ma udu bɔyila.

english_verse: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
translation_verse: Balalane bédie bana kuwii bada na báni bana kɔtaminta benye ka bebo bawabane ku bani mɔɔyaki ala ku bani ƒui na bana lilu lise siin badu.

english_verse: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
translation_verse: Nsu ama alati bana kuwii na badubuti badu-ma na bana kɔtaminta lɛnɔ kɔƒɛ kuwi kalɔ.

english_verse: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
translation_verse: Lɛla blii suɛ lɛni na ukyuli ɔni nse siin ubo ni, ɔdia utulo balalane akɛla pii ani na bebo.

english_verse: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubɔya na balalane ɔyikun ɔyii udu. Na bekyuli bani nse siin bakɛ ɔyikun.

english_verse: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-ma ni, Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubɔnu-ma lɛlɔ bana ngba emeyi ƒui. Na bana kadikɔ kadubuse úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
translation_verse: Si uwi ɔni na ɔgbankpi ɔdi úbo ni, ɔtɔtɔ ɔɔɔdubo-ma bɔgyu. Lɛni kani na si kɔka lɛnɔ kúbo ni, ama badubɔkɛ badi na bemo.

english_verse: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bekpidi ama ni, badi Unwoti Katɔti bekisine. Anwuɔsu badubɔyii aani kalɛ kugyii anwula aanu taayii udu. Na badubɔyii ku udu aani kalɛ uyɔ ɔyii takya kayaa kemmo.

english_verse: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
translation_verse: Balalane beevó ala na balásɔku teesienku. Nsu bekyuli bani nse siin baanu kɔnyana na beete taasia kama.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bani na Unwoti Katɔti úte kusɛ kusɛ ni, ama badubɔdi kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ala. Na bani na úwida ama ni, ɔdubɔyila-ma udu na ngba bɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla Unwoti Katɔti lɛyɔla ni, Unwoti ɔɔtina-nwu nwuna kanyakɔ na nwuna ablala ƒui aayɔ́-nwu kaƒɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
translation_verse: Na si ɔ́gbanta ni, ulebuli, ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubɔda-nwu na unye ligeen.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si mina lɛnamu uwi úti úbedu ɔni na lɛ́ɛbi lɛlɔ mɛni ni, ńtanu ka Unwoti Katɔti údie ukyuli ɔni nse siin ɔdi atu kudii. Na ńtanu ka nwuna bebi bakɛ beteevele asa na badi.

english_verse: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔɔnu kɔnyana uwi biala. Uute ala lɛnɔ na uuvó teete bekyuli na kusɛ kusɛ ɔɔsiaku nwuna bebi.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: Keli likpidi bɔbla na ataabla lɛbuni na ƒula bawɔ badubulie kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́ ala ani na baabla ulu lɛlɔ. Na ulalɛ bekyuli bani mɔɔbla taasiaku nwuna litemi lɛlɔ kama kudii. Mmomu ɔɔgyumana-ma uwi ndi uwi. Nsu bekyuli bekpidi bebi ama ni, badubɔyii udu.

english_verse: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nsiaku Unwoti kama siin badubulie kalɔ lɛlɔ na badi-ka ala uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni nsiaku Unwoti kama siin ɔɔtɛmi lɛnunda ku etemila ani nse sɔsɔ.

english_verse: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
translation_verse: Uunyimo Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔni náƒɔ-nwu kayi mmɔ uwi ndi uwi kalɛ na ulegyiile.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Ukyuli ukpidi ɔɔtú ukyuli ɔni nsiaku Unwoti kama siin taawia ulu biala kalɛ na ɔdu-nwu.

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔɔdubo-nwu bɔnyonu bɔkya-nwu enu kemmo na ɔɔɔdubo ukyuli ɔbuni ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ kɔtɔ bɔdu si ɔɔtɛku-nwu litemi.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
translation_verse: Taanu Unwoti anumi uwi ndi uwi na asia nwuna ulu lɛlɔ. Ɔdubɔkɔliku-ɔ katɔ na adi kalɔ kammɔ ala. Na uwi ɔni na baayila bekyuli bekpidi udu ni, adubunye anu.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: Lɛ́ɛnu dii kalɛ na ukyuli ukpidi ɔni mbo kalala ɔ́kɛ lɛlɔ aani kugyii kɔni nákɛ kenyekɔ buni na kalɔ buni lɛlɔ na kuudie kɔgba.

english_verse: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
translation_verse: Nsu uwi útetu asa na úkpi. Na báyiƒala-nwu. Ka lɛ́wia nnii mɔɔnu ukyuli ɔmɛni ni, nwuna lɛla ndi lɛla lítebu.

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: Se ukyuli ɔbuni ɔni ablala nkɛ ulu lɛlɔ likpo kaduɛ. Ukyuli ɔmɛni keyi kadanku lɛlɔyɔ ku keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Nsu alaekpidi bablane badubɔyii udu, na bana keyi kadubɔda liku.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nsiaku Unwoti kama siin ni, Unwoti Katɔti ɔlati mɔɔgyumana-ma na anwu kani na baatámiku si ala eekpóku-ma.

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubo-ma bubunku na udie-ma na balɛ ukyuli ukpidi enu kemmo na bakɛ bɔnwuna. Ɔsika Unwoti ndi bana katamikukɔ.

english_verse: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, tadɔnku-mi na ƒula kɔnyi kemmo.

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔlɔna kemmo kaadu-mi aani si ƒula atula na ébo álɛ-mi. Na ƒula enusɛ lɛnɔ aayu-mi ɔlɛ geen.

english_verse: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
translation_verse: Naaakɛ bɔnwuna bɔdi na mina ɔlɔna kemmo na ƒula kɔnyi ɔsu. Na muunú ɔlɛ teetéduo mina ekubi kemmo ɔ́si mina ekpidi ɔsu.

english_verse: are so heavy that I am crushed.
translation_verse: Ɔsika mina ekpidi énwini etila asia-mi lili. Na ebo-mi unu geen na étulo-mi muedi.

english_verse: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku mina kɔdɔlɔ ɔsu ni, mina alɛbi ébun na eenwenyi.

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: Lɛ́goglo nkɛ na muunú ɔlɛ geen na muuwulo kɔnyana limeyi limodi ƒui.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛ ukpidi ɔ́ƒɔ-mi ɔlɔna kemmo ƒui na lɛlɔ kemmo káƒɔ-mi ogya.

english_verse: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
translation_verse: Lɛ́bla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ aani ukyuli ɔni náƒɛ uwi kalɔ na edumo kani nda, na muubó abi na mina kayi kemmo.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, lɛla lɛni mɔɔwia lítabɛ-ɔ na eenú lɛnɔ kalɛ na muudumo.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: Mina bɔnwuna buláyu-mi. Na ɔlɔkplu ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo-mi. Na mina anumi asɔ alánu nwaa.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: Mina bakpana ku badukɛne ƒui békeli-mi na mina alɛbi ɔsu. Na bédie-mi atu.

english_verse: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
translation_verse: Bani mɔɔwia-mi ngba bayila lɛnɔ baakywɛ bana kɔkpagyuɛ uwi ndi uwi. Na bani mɔɔwia ka babla-mi kalala lɛnɔ benye kagyumana baasa lili likpidi mina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I am not able to hear or speak a word;
translation_verse: Nse aani ukyuli ɔni na atu éti-nwu ƒui na neeenu. Na unyemi lɛnɔ ɔ́ƒɛ ɔ́kya-nwu kenye kemmo na naaakana bɔtɛmi.

english_verse: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Atu ése éti-mi kpa na kenye lɛnɔ naaakana bubimi bɔsu lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
translation_verse: O mina Unwoti, ƒula lɛlɔ kani na mina anu asia. Na awɔ kani ndubunu ete-mi.

english_verse: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika lívele-ɔ nnini, “Taya na mina bekisine bama-mi na bakun lɛmɛnɛ ka lígyile nnii muubuli ɔsu.”

english_verse: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔlɛ bunu bɔmmɔ bútulo-mi na buláƒana na mɔɔyɔ́ libuli.

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: Lídie mina alaekpidi kalɔ, ɔsika éduo-mi.

english_verse: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.
translation_verse: Beeti likpidi taaƒɔ-mi lɛbuni kayu na báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ ka mɔɔsia lɛbuni bɔbla kama ɔsu.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: Unwoti, tada-mi tese. Mina Katɔti, tenwini kama takya-mi.

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: O mina Unwoti ku Ɔƒɔne, yile bubo na ebebunku-mi!

english_verse: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
translation_verse: Líbo lɛlɔ ɔda lɛ́su nnini, “Ndubɔnu kaduɛ na lɛda mina unyemi na enyekpi adi alálɛ-mi kenye. Na lɛɛɛdubo bɔtɛmi lɛnɔ uwi ɔni na bekyuli bekpidi báka bámana-mi mɛni.”

english_verse: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.
translation_verse: Nsu ina ka líbo limu na naaatɛmi ina lɛbuni na lɛ́nu muedi ni, mina ɔlɛ ɔni muunú ni, katɔ kani na ɔɔkɔ́.

english_verse: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
translation_verse: Kayi kaakpulu-mi geen. Na si nli mɔɔbla kasusu ni, na mina kayi keekpóku-mi. Anwuɔsu na lɛ́su na kawɔlɔkɔ nnini,

english_verse: “Please, Lord, show me my future. Will I soon be gone?
translation_verse: “O Unwoti, ya na lɛti mina emeyi ani nébu-mi. Na lɛti kalɛ na mina ngba búkeli búsela kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
translation_verse: Ati, ábla na mina ngba emeyi ese klukui. Na mina akwa ƒui aaadi lɛla lɛdi na ƒula anumi. Na ukyuli ɔyawine biala ngba buse aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔlɛ́ ukyuli enwu.

english_verse: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
translation_verse: Geen ni, ukyuli ngba buuubo bɔyii taakya aani ukyuli kɔyu kɔni muuwi kalɔ. Na keeke na uutú lɛlɔ ɔnii ɔɔsála ala ute lɛlɔ. Nsu ɔɔɔgyi ukyuli ɔni ndubo ala ammɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
translation_verse: “Unwoti, bi lɛnɔ na nsɔ nsia anu ɔƒɛni? Ƒula lɛlɔ kani na mina anu asia.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: Die-mi na mina alaekpidi ƒui kemmo. Na taya na linwini ukyuli ɔni na badɔlɔdi bánu báwɔlɔ na bada-nwu lɛnyi.

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: Lɛ́bla kpoo na neeebimi kenye, ɔsika awɔ náya na úbo úte lɛni.

english_verse: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
translation_verse: Muuvele-ɔ, da-mi kɔtu bɔni ya, ɔsika lɛlɔ líitu-mi lɛ́vili na kɔtu bɔni bɔmmɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
translation_verse: Aaní-bu kɔtu kpakplaa na bula ekpidi ɔsu. Na ala ani na bɔɔsia anu geen eebie aani kalɛ na kubweyi kuubile bula akɛla ani na áƒɔ kuye. Na sɔsɔ ukyuli use kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔlɛ́ ukyuli enwu kemmo.

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: “Nu-mi buvele, O Unwoti, na abla ete-mi na keku kani muuwulo taakya-a ɔsu. Tetile atu na mina mmii pii bɔmɛni kama. Ɔsika nse aani ƒula ɔƒɔ ɔni nálɛlɛ-ɔ aani mina bati kuuku kalɛ kani.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Da kɔnyi buti na mina lɛlɔ ya, na aya na lɛsɔ lɛkɛ ebiti asa likpi lɛlɛ kayawi kamɛni kemmo.”

english_verse: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
translation_verse: Lɛ́kɛ kayi na nnye mɔɔnu mina Unwoti Katɔti anumi. Na únu-mi bɔkpali na únwini úbanu-mi.

english_verse: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
translation_verse: Ɔ́nu-mi na lɛba ubu bonwu ɔni kemmo na ami lɛti nkya. Na údie-mi úbenyene lɛtakpɛ lɛlɔ kesii kani na lɛɛɛdubo bɔgbanta. Na lɛ́kɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́tina-mi kɔgya kɔwɔdi kɔni lidie limwi-nwu. Bekyuli pii badubunu ɔmɛni na bayia, na baƒɔ-nwu badi.

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bekyuli bani néti bana anu básia Unwoti lɛlɔ. Na belesie baƒiɔ ku ala bamba adi kudɔ iye ama ku bani mɔɔkpá baƒiɔ ku ala ammɔ baládi kɔkpana.

english_verse: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
translation_verse: O Unwoti Katɔti, ábla ala ebendi pii geen. Na ebo kasusu buni geen ete-bu. Ukyuli ɔdi uuubo ƒula kalɛ. Na naaakana ƒula ablala bɔka bɔtina, ɔsika emomo!

english_verse: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
translation_verse: Akpala ku etela alaƒɔ-ɔ anu. Na aláwia anii bekyuli beboku akpala ani bákyula ku ekpidi lili buvele akpala. Mmomu anii nse atu na linu ƒula litemi.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́su nnini, “Ati, aanu-mi. Líbo nnii mbabla ƒula lɛƒɔyɔ aani kalɛ na bénweni básiku-mi lɛlɔ na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo.

english_verse: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
translation_verse: O mina Unwoti Katɔti, ƒula ɔda bubo bɔkya-mi kayi kemmo.”

english_verse: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na aaƒɔ́-bu ngba lɛnɔ ni, nteti ntabɛla na mina kayi kemmo. Na kalɛ na ebo bɔyɔ na aadi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ na eebunku-bu ƒui lɛ́ya na báti ɔmɛni na ƒula kadi bekyuli kasalakɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
translation_verse: Unwoti, taya na ƒula lɛƒɔndia kenye kekulo na mina lɛlɔ. Ya na ƒula bɔyɔ ku litemi geen lɛmmɔ lɛgyumana-mi uwi biala.

english_verse: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔgbankpi lidu lidu pii ku mina alaekpidi áka ámana-mi na nsɔ naaanu kesii kani na lɛsia. Emomo etulo mina lili linwini ɔmmɔ ɔsu na enu áƒɛ-mi ƒui.

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: O Unwoti Katɔti, ya na kaƒɔ kayɔ-ɔ na edie-mi. O Unwoti, yile bubo na ekpo ete-mi.

english_verse: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔwia-mi ngba bebile ni, ya na beƒu. Na bekyuli bani mɔɔwia-mi badu ni, kɔƒa kukpo-ma na babla susuusu. Na bani ƒui mɔɔwia ka babla-mi kalala ni, bɔku-ma na benwini-mi kama.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame everyone who says, “Just look at you now!”
translation_verse: Na bani mɔɔsu-mi banii útakɛ-mi na mina ɔgbankpi kemmo ni, liƒu bonwu líƒie-ma na kɔƒa kɔni muukpó-ma ɔsu.

english_verse: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔwia-a kama ulu ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma si bánu-ɔ na ebiti ada-ma. Na bani mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ngba bɔƒɔ basu uwi ndi uwi banini, “Bɛya na Unwoti lɛnyi lɛkɔ katɔ.”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Na ami amu ni, ɔwabane na ndi na mɔɔyáki ala pii. Anwuɔsu ya na ƒula anu asia-mi lɛlɔ. Awɔ muubunku-mi na aaƒɔ́-mi. O Katɔti, tetu uwi.

english_verse: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni muulie taabla kasusu na bekyuli bani nse kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ lɛlɔ ka ubunku-ma. Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubudie-nwu si úduo lɛbibo lɛdi kemmo.

english_verse: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubo-nwu bɔgyumana na ɔda-nwu ngba kɔkɔɔkɔ. Kusɛ kusɛ ɔdubɔsiaku-nwu na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ. Na Unwoti uleti-nwu ulakya nwuna bekisine enu kemmo.

english_verse: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
translation_verse: Na si ɔtɛ ɔlɛ kemmo lɛnɔ ni, ɔdubɔkya-nwu ɔyikun na ɔbwi-nwu.

english_verse: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
translation_verse: O Unwoti Katɔti, lívele-ɔ nnini, “Nu-mi kɔnyana na abwi-mi, ɔsika lɛ́bla likpidi lɛ́ƒiɔ-ɔ.”

english_verse: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
translation_verse: Mina bekisine baatɛmi enyekpi na mina lɛlɔ na beeye lɛlɔ banini, “Lɛmameyi na ɔdubukpi na bɔyiƒala-nwu?”

english_verse: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi úbo úbanu-mi ni, kasusu kekpidi na uuti na mina lɛlɔ na baagyingya ɔkɔ etemila taavi.

english_verse: My enemies whisper about me. They think the worst,
translation_verse: Kabɛnsɛ sɔɔn na mina bekisine baatɛmi na mina lɛlɔ na baawia ka likpidi lɛlɛku-mi.

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: Baasu banini, “Ɔlɛ ɔni nébo-nwu ɔ́va kalɔ ni, ɔ́ɔnyi-nwu útédu kesii kani na ɔsɔ ulata lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
translation_verse: Mina ɔtɔ kemmo ɔkpana geen ɔni lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di na ami ku-nwu bɔɔdi na lɛkyami linwi kemmo muedi ni, anwu nénwini únye-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ ni, mina Unwoti, nu-mi kɔnyana na aya na lɛta ɔlɛ ɔmɛni kemmo na lɛƒɔ mina bekisine kayu.

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: Na baládi-mi lɛlɔ mmomu na manu mati ka aabla-mi lɛƒɔndia sɔsɔ.

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: Na ami ni, awɔ kani ndubo-mi bubunku. Na éti-mi enyene ƒula anumi uwi ƒui, ɔsika ánu ka lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-mi.

english_verse: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti ɔni ndi Israel Katɔti. Bɛya na bumwi-nwu ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ƒui. Ɔsia lɛni na ɔsɔ ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na anumi eegyie akwa ɔni na utukwɛ ɔɔda na ɔkɛ gyoli gyoli ɔɔwia abiɔ ani kemmo na ɔni ntu ni, lɛni kani na mina kɔyu kɔɔwia Katɔti.

english_verse: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔni nlie ngba uwi ƒui, ƒula tanu kɔka kɔɔda-mi. Lɛmameyi na ndububo mbada lɛlɛ-ɔ anumi na lɛnu-ɔ?

english_verse: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Keku kani nénwini aani adila úte-mi usien ku ɔƒɛ. Na mina bekisine benye beeye-mi uwi ndi uwi banini, “Wɛ na nwuna Katɔti ɔmmɔ ɔkya?”

english_verse: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.
translation_verse: Si muunyimo ala adi bene ni, kayi kaakpulu-mi geen. Muunyimo uwi ɔni na ntaatɔnku ƒula bekyuli lisu na bútaasala teesie ƒula kakpakɔ taatátu lɛnu teemwi-ɔ ku lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na naaakɛ́ bɔnwuna na mina lɛlɔ ƒui kemmo na enu áƒɛ-mi lɛni? Líti mina anu lɛ́sia-a lɛlɔ. Na ngyi ka nsɔ ndubo awɔ mina Ɔƒɔne ku mina Katɔti bumwi lɛnɔ, ɔsika awɔ muubunku-mi.

english_verse: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.
translation_verse: Enu áƒɛ-mi si mɔɔkali taanu ƒula lɛƒɔndia na Yordan Ketu kalɛkɔ na Hermon ku Misar abi lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.
translation_verse: Ƒula kɔnyi kúbo-mi lɛlɔ aani ketu kani néyi na use aani ɛpu ɔni mɔɔnwanɛ lɛlɔ na ɔ́bwɛ ɔ́vi-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
translation_verse: Nsu muuvele nnii Unwoti ɔbla-mi lɛƒɔndia limeyi limodi kemmo kalɛ na usien ni, lɛtu kɔgya lite-nwu. Na anwu na ndubɔkɔliku mina enu katɔ lɛkpali, ɔsika anwu muute-mi ngba.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Ndubɔkpali mina Unwoti Katɔti ɔni nse aani lɛtakpɛ lɛni mɔɔgyumana-mi. Na ndubuye-nwu nnini, “Bi ɔsu na áyiƒala-mi na áya na nkɛ muuwulo kɔnyana, na mina bekisine benye beekpóku-mi lɛni?”

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Edumi ani udu na beedumi-mi etulo si kewii na bada baatu-mi ɔƒɛnyi bétédu ku ekubi kemmo. Na beeye-mi limeyi ndi limeyi banini, “Wɛ na ƒula Unwoti Katɔti ɔmmɔ ɔkya geen?”

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na naaakɛ́ bɔnwuna na mina lɛlɔ ƒui kemmo na enu-mi lɛni? Ndubuti mina anu lɛsia Katɔti lɛlɔ na lɛsɔ limwi-nwu, ɔsika anwu ndi mina Ɔƒɔne ku mina Katɔti.

english_verse: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, tɛ ami ku kadi kani bekyuli naaagyi-ɔ mɛni ntɛ litemi na ete-mi ubo. Na edie-mi alɛku ɔkɔ banyine ku balalane bamɛni akɔ.

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Ɔsika awɔ Katɔti ndi mina katamikukɔ. Bi ɔsu na édie-mi atu na nkɛ muuwulo kɔnyana uwi ndi uwi lɛni na mina bekisine bukpoku ɔsu?

english_verse: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, ya na ƒula bukeye bubewi-mi lɛlɔ na ƒula litemi geen lɛmmɔ lɛtɔnku-mi na bɔkpanku-mi bubedu ƒula kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ na kesii kani na elie.

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: Ndubusie ƒula lɛkpabi kudɔ mmɔ ntákpa-a, ɔsika awɔ mɔɔyá na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi. Na ndubuti ɔbentaa na lɛgya lidie kɔgya limwi-ɔ, O mina Katɔti.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na naaakɛ́ bɔnwuna na mina lɛlɔ ƒui kemmo na enu áƒɛ-mi lɛni? Ndubuti mina anu lɛsia Katɔti lɛlɔ, ɔsika ɔdubɔya na lɛsɔ limwi-nwu aani mina Katɔti ku mina Ɔƒɔne kalɛ.

english_verse: Our God, our ancestors told us what wonders you worked and we listened carefully.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, bula bati básu-bu na búnu ku bula atu ala ani udu na ábla na bana kuuku uwi.

english_verse: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
translation_verse: Ékpoku kadi bamba bekyuli ku ƒula ɔyikun na ábɔku-ma édie bana kalɔ lɛlɔ na áyila-ma udu. Áya na bula bati bétélie mmɔ na ala átɛ éte-ma.

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi bula bati bamɛni nékpo ku bana kuwii asa báƒɔ kalɔ kamɛni bése iye bana enu kabla kadi na béti badi-ma lɛlɔ. Mmomu awɔ nnye mmɔ na ábla ala ebendi ku ƒula ɔyikun na átina ka aayɔ́-ma.

english_verse: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
translation_verse: Awɔ ndi mina Katɔti ku mina ɔga ɔni mɔɔyá na ƒula bekyuli baadi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Ƒula lɛlɔ na bɔ́sia na búdi bula bekisine búsienku kama. Na ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛnyi lɛlɔ na buususu-ma taakya bula lɛgba kalɔ.

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: Ɔsika neeeti mina anu taasia mina kataminta lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔɔdi mina kewii lɛnɔ muukpó teete-mi na mɔɔdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ mɔɔyá na bɔɔdi bula bekisine lɛlɔ. Na áya na kɔƒa kúkpo ama bani ƒui muukisi-bu kpakplaa mmɔ.

english_verse: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
translation_verse: Bula Unwoti Katɔti lɛlɔ na bɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ limeyi limodi na bɔdubumwi-nwu lɛnyi uwi ƒui.

english_verse: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, éni-bu na ákya-bu kɔƒa. Na asɔ alásiaku bula bekpone na kekpokɔ.

english_verse: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
translation_verse: Na áya na abu mmomu násɔ búnwini buukeli bula bekisine. Na ama bani muukisi-bu mmomu néƒie-bu ala báƒɔ.

english_verse: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
translation_verse: Na ányonu-bu éte-ma aani baƒonu na báduli-bu kɔkɛ kɔkɛ bébweli. Na búgyingya bɔkya kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: Na éti-bu éye éte bekyuli bamba ku kuye blii kani na átakɛ kɔsia kɔdi na kuye bɔdi bɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: Áya na bula liku bekyuli baatɛmi teewi-bu na beedumi-bu lɛnɔ ɔni na bɔ́sɔ bútaƒɔ kuye kɔdi na bana anumi.

english_verse: Foreigners joke about us and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Búnwini lɛmala búte baƒɔ na bapii-bu.

english_verse: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu kɔƒa kɔsiaku-mi uwi biala na kɔƒa kúnwini lɛdiku libi-mi anumi.

english_verse: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
translation_verse: Na mina bekisine beedumi-mi na béti-mi bénwini lɛmala aani kalɛ beedie ukyuli kasi.

english_verse: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni ƒui ébo-bu lɛlɔ lɛni ina ka bútayiƒala-a iye búnwini ƒula bunyimi kama.

english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: Bútalɛ-ɔ kama. Na bula kanyakɔ lɛnɔ kasia ƒula ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
translation_verse: Nsu áya na búbo kalɔ na búduo lɛdisa bonwu kemmo na kesii kani na beƒiebuo bakya.

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: Na si bɔ́yiƒala bula Katɔti lɛnyi iye búnwini kama búsie bɔɔkpá kadi bamba baƒiɔ badi ni,

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: awɔ Katɔti adubɔnu ati. Ɔsika agyi abɛla ani nkya bekyuli kayi kemmo.

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ na awɔ ɔsu ni, bɔkya kukpi ɔgbankpi kemmo limeyi ndi limeyi. Na baabla-bu aani kalɛ na baabla baƒonu bani na béti-ma bésela batádu.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
translation_verse: Unwoti, buuvele-ɔ, ta na ebo ebebunku-bu. Tedie-bu atu ƒui lɛni.

english_verse: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na áda anumi édie-bu lɛlɔ lɛni na ƒula kasusu kálɛ bula lɛbibo ku budumo bɔni kemmo bɔkya lɛlɔ?

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Bɔ́ƒɛ buwi kalɔ ɔni na bɔtɛ ɔtumu akɔ.

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Buvele ta pla na ebebunku-bu na edie-bu, ɔsika ƒula bɔyɔ bulávumana kudii.

english_verse: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
translation_verse: Etemila abuni sɔɔn néyi-mi lili kemmo na ndubudie keyi na lɛtu kɔgya lite ɔga ɔmmɔ. Na mina unyemi na ndubuti lɛbla aani unwenigyii ɔni na ɔkutine ɔbuni ɔdi ɔda uunweni ala teese.

english_verse: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
translation_verse: Awɔ mɔɔdia bɔnu teetulo bayawine bebi ƒui akɔ. Na lɛƒɔndia etemila akya-a kenye kemmo geen, anwuɔsu na Unwoti Katɔti úte-ɔ kusɛ kusɛ úsela uwi ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: Mighty king, glorious ruler, strap on your sword
translation_verse: O Ɔga ɔni ntulo ƒui, ti ƒula kewii bala ƒula kavobi. Na ada agala ani muukeye.

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Tu akpagya na esie asɔ lɛlɔ ɔdine kalɛ. Gyumana litemi geen lɛmmɔ ku bekyuli bani muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ. Na bekyuli bataabla ala ulu lɛlɔ. Ti ƒula kɔdianu na abla ala enengudi na bani lɛlɔ na ádi anumi.

english_verse: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
translation_verse: Na aya na ƒula atula ani nse yayaaya geen mmɔ atu ƒula bekisine kayi. Na kadi bekyuli ƒui bayu batɛ ƒula lɛgba kalɔ.

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Ati, awɔ ni, ƒula lɛga kadikɔ kadubo buse uwi ƒui. Na adubɔdi ƒula bekyuli lɛlɔ na litemi bɔtɛ ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
