translation_verse: Aayɔ́ lɛla lɛni nse siin, na eekisi ala ani naaakɛ ulu lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu ni, ami ƒula Katɔti lɛ́ƒuna awɔ, Ati, ka akɛ kenyekɔ etulo na bakladi ƒui akɔ. Na lɛ́ya-a na ákɛ lɛlɔyɔ na uwi ɔni na líti nnɔmii líwi-ɔ aani likposela.

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: Ƒula awu ɔni na akya ni, ugyulo ƒɛƒɛɛ lidu lidu ɔnyi ɔ́ƒɔ-nwu kemmo. Na ɔtunkpɛ sɔɔn na béti bákya ƒula lɛgbanya lɛmmɔ bɔdia. Na lɛbentaa na baagyá taakya-a lɛga ebiti.

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: Beleku baƒunadi bani mɔɔkpanku-ɔ ni, baga bebi belekubi bakya-ma akɔ. Na ƒula kɔdianu kakɛ ni, ƒula uleku ɔga unye na ɔda sika ugyiedi adala abuni ƒui.

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: O Ɔga ule ɔbuni, se atu kaduɛ na enu litemi lɛmɛni. Yiƒala ƒula lɛlɔ bekyuli ƒui ku ƒ'ɔti kaduli bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
translation_verse: Na aya na ƒula bɔdia ƒui bɔda ɔga ebiti. Ɔsika anwu ndi ƒula Unwoti. Boku lɛlɔ kalɔ na ete-nwu ɔbu.

english_verse: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
translation_verse: Tire kadi bekyuli badubo bebete-ɔ ala abuni. Na balakɛne pii badubɔwia ka ayɔ-ma litemi.

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: Bula kadi, bɛnu kalɛ na ɔga ule ɔni nkya nwuna ɔtɔ kemmo mmɔ ɔɔdia bɔnu! Awu ɔni na ɔkya ni, sika ugyiedi kabuli na béti báka-nwu.

english_verse: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
translation_verse: Na únyimi kɔdi kɔni mɔɔdia bɔnu kalɛ na bakpanku anwu ku nwuna bakpana ku begblebi beboku-ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: Na ebiti ku lɛlɔyɔ kemmo na badubuti bebeduo ɔga lɛgbanya mmɔ.

english_verse: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O Ɔga, ƒula bebi bananabi ndubunye ƒula bati kuuku kenyekɔ. Na adubɔbla-ma baga na kɔlɔ bamba ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ndubuteebo ƒula lɛnyi kudu ɔ́si kaba úsie kaba bekyuli akɔ, na badubuteemwi-ɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Unwoti ndi bula katamikukɔ na anwu muute-bu ɔyikun. Unye-bu kudɔ uubunku-bu uwi ndi uwi na ala ani muukpóku-bu ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na bɔɔɔdubo bɔyia. Si kalɔ kákunku na abi ágyu ana kenyekɔ étéduo ɛpu kemmo muedi ni, abu bɔɔɔdubo bɔyia.

english_verse: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
translation_verse: Ina ɛpu ɔmmɔ ƒui mɔɔnwanɛ lɛlɔ na ɔɔta teebo na ɔɔkunku abi ammɔ dɛ muedi ni, liƒu lɛɛɛdubo-bu bɔda

english_verse: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
translation_verse: Ketu kadi katɛ Katɔti ɔma. Na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ Katɔti Ɔga ɔma bekyuli bani nlieku-nwu na mmɔ.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔlati ulie ɔma ɔmmɔ ntɛntɛ, ɔni na lɛla lɛdi lilakana ɔma ɔmmɔ bubile. Katɔti ɔdubo-nwu bubunku limeyi lɛni na lɛla lɛdi lɛdubɔlɛ.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Liƒu lɛɛda kadi bekyuli ƒui. Na baga ku bana lɛga kɔdikɔ kɔɔbwɛ. Katɔti údie lɛdi na kayawi ƒui kaakunku.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔsiaku-bu. Anwu ɔni na bula Nana Yakob ɔ́kpa ndi bula katamikukɔ.

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Bibo na bibanu Unwoti ablala na bɛnu kalɛ na úgyingya lɛla biala na úbile kayawi kemodi kammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
translation_verse: Ɔɔyá na kekpo biala kenye kaayɔ́ na kayawi kesii biala. Na ɔɔƒɛ kɔtaminta kɔmmɔ ku atula ƒui na ɔɔkyula ala ani ƒui na beeti teesienku kekpokɔ taatágyumana lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
translation_verse: “Bɛbla kpoo na bɛnu bɛti ka ami ndi Katɔti. Badubo-mi lɛnyi katɔ bakɔliku na kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni na kadi bekyuli ƒui akɔ. Na lɛni kani na mina lɛnyi lɛdubo katɔ bɔkɔ na kayawi ƒui.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔkya-bu akɔ. Yakob Unwoti Katɔti ɔni na ɔ́kpa ndi bula katamikukɔ.

english_verse: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
translation_verse: Amii kadi bekyuli ƒui, bɛgya enukpɛ ku lɛlɔyɔ. Na bɛva ku adi momoomo biti bimwi Katɔti.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti ɔni ntulo ƒui lɛlɔ libo liƒu. Na anwu mɔɔdi kayawi ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God has put every nation under our power,
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na bɔ́di kadi bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ na bakya-bu lɛgba kalɔ.

english_verse: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
translation_verse: Na anwu náƒuna kalɔ kani lɛlɔ bulie mɛni úte abu Yakob kaba kemmo bebi bani na ɔɔyɔ́.

english_verse: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́kɔ úsie uli nwuna lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na katɔ na lɛlɔyɔ kɔvanu kɔda momoomo. Na kɔkpɛɛ lɛnɔ kɔda ka ɔ́kɔ úsela katɔ.

english_verse: Sing praises to God our King,
translation_verse: Bidie lɛnu bimwi bula Ɔga ku Katɔti.

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Katɔti mɔɔdi kayawi ƒui lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu bidie lɛnu bimwi-nwu.

english_verse: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
translation_verse: Katɔti ulie nwuna lɛgaboku lɛni nse kedee lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔdi kadi bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
translation_verse: Kayawi bagadine ƒui ku bana benengu básala ku Abraham bekyuli, na Katɔti ɔdi bana ɔga. Na báda ekpola béwi na bédie kekpo atu kalɛ na bakɔli Unwoti katɔ na bemwi-nwu.

english_verse: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
translation_verse: Bula Unwoti Katɔti úbomo geen. Anwuɔsu ɔlɛka bɔkɔliku-nwu lɛnyi katɔ na nwuna ɔma unengudi kemmo na nwuna kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ.

english_verse: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
translation_verse: Sion Kɔbi kɔdi bula Katɔti kɔbi kɔni lɛlɔ na uli. Na kɔbi kɔmmɔ kɔ́kuku na kɔɔdia bɔnu sɔsɔ. Na ɔdi bula ɔga ɔma unengudi. Kesii kamɛni mɔɔyɔ́ kayawi bekyuli ƒui kaƒɔ.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́tina ka nwuna kaduli kadi katamikɔ kabuni geen kesii kani na ɔdubɔgyumana-bu.

english_verse: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
translation_verse: Baga badi básala lɛlɔ banii betékpoku Sion Kɔbi kɔmmɔ.

english_verse: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
translation_verse: Nsu ka béduo mmɔ ni, ɔ́bla-ma kalɛ kadi na liƒu lɛ́da-ma amu na békeli batɔlɔ.

english_verse: They trembled all over like women giving birth
translation_verse: Na lɛlɔ lɛɛtɔ́-ma aani uleku ɔni ntɛ kɔwɔ.

english_verse: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na búnu ni, ani kani na bɔ́nu ku bula anumi na bula Katɔti ɔni ndi Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔma ɔni ntulo kemmo. Na ɔdubɔgyumana ɔma ɔmɛni uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
translation_verse: O Unwoti Katɔti, bɔɔkali taanu ƒula bɔyɔ bɔni naaavumana kudii na ƒula kakpakɔ mɛni.

english_verse: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na ƒula lɛnyi líbomo ni, lɛni kani na buumwi-ɔ na kayawi kesi kesii. Édie ƒula kɔdianu kɔnu na ábla ɔyikun ala ala ani nse siin.

english_verse: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
translation_verse: Amii bani nkya Sion Kɔbi bɛya ebiti ada-mii. Na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ amii bani nkya Yuda lɛma. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔɔtɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ geen.

english_verse: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
translation_verse: Bɛka bɛmana Sion ɔma ɔmmɔ na bɛka nwuna kɔgyumanakɔ kɔmmɔ.

english_verse: “Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti Katɔti ɔmɛni ndi bula Unwoti ɔsi ɔƒɛni úsela ƒui. Na anwu ndubɔtɔnku-bu uwi biala.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Amii bayawine ƒui bise atu na binu.

english_verse: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
translation_verse: Amii bani nnye kunyekɔ kunengudi ku kɔnamudi ku balakɛne ku bawabane bina ƒui na nda.

english_verse: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
translation_verse: Lɛnunda etemila na ndubo-mii bɔsu. Na ala ani ndubɔsi mina kayi kemmo mmɔ ebo kalɔ bunu.

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Agba na adi na ndubo bubo. Na ɔbentaa na ndubo bɔgya budie-nya kalɔ.

english_verse: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka lɛyia si uwi ukpidi ɔdi ɔ́siaku-mi iye balalane ku belikplune báka-mi bákya?

english_verse: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
translation_verse: Kayawi lɛkɛ lɛlɔ na bana anu asia na baakun lɛmɛnɛ na ala pii ani na bebo ɔsu.

english_verse: You cannot buy back your life or pay off God!
translation_verse: Nsu ɔdi biala ulakana ɔnwani ngba bɔƒɔ iye ɔƒɔ-nwu lili kayu kadi ute Katɔti na udie-nwu.

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: Ukyuli ngba bɔƒɔ lili kayu ɔdi lɛla lɛni na lɛ́ƒɔ kuye geen. Na ukyuli ɔdi ulakana kayu kammɔ bɔƒɔ na kedu

english_verse: to stay alive forever and safe from death.
translation_verse: na ulie ngba uwi ƒui ɔni na ɔsɔ ulekpi kudii.

english_verse: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
translation_verse: Bɔɔnu kalɛ na banundane beekpi na badɔlɔdi ku besusu lɛnɔ beekpi taada bana lɛkɛ teese na linwini bekyuli bamba lɛdi.

english_verse: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
translation_verse: Kɔƒiɔtɔ ndubunwini bana kɔduli uteesie uwi ƒui. Na mmɔ na badubɔkya ɔ́si kaba útédu kaba ina béti bana anyi básia kɔlɔ kɔdi na baalɔ-ku taamana-ma.

english_verse: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani néti anu básia bana lɛkɛ ku bekyuli bani mɔɔkya-ma ablala ogya lɛlɔ ni, bɛsia-ma kawɔlɔkɔ anu.

english_verse: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
translation_verse: Bese aani baƒonu bani na kukpi ndanku-ma utádu ɔkya kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo. Na benwini adila bete-nwu. Na bekyuli bani nse siin badubo busie bɔvi-ma lɛlɔ. Na bana bɔdia bɔyii udu na kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo na bana kɔduli bonwu bonwu kɔmmɔ kɔsɔ kuwi ukpludi.

english_verse: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti ɔdubudie ami na kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo na ɔƒɔ-mi utése lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
translation_verse: Kayi ketekpoku-ɔ si ɔdi lɛkɛ liimomo teebu na ɔɔkɛ́ kayawi kamɛni ngba ebiti.

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si úkpi ni, uleti ala ammɔ adi ulatɔlɔku. Na ala ani muukeye mmɔ lɛnɔ beleti-nya balakya-nwu.

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: Ina dɛ na akɛla aakɔ́ ukyuli katɔ na ala aatɛku-nwu na beemwi-nwu ni,

english_verse: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
translation_verse: ɔdubunwini utákya nwuna bati kuuku kudɔ na kekpine na kesii kani nse suu uwi ƒui na ɔsɔ ulanu bukeye.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Ɔlakɛne ɔni neeebo ala kalɔ bunu lɛkɛ lɛyii udu na uukpi taayii udu aani eƒiebuo kalɛ.

english_verse: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔni ndi Unwoti mɔɔlɔ lɛla biala lɛni nkya kayawi ƒui ɔ́si ɔƒɛ katukɔ útédu kanukɔ ɔnii babasala na benu.

english_verse: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.
translation_verse: Katɔti uukeye taasiku Sion ɔma unengudi ɔni ndia ntulo ƒui mmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
translation_verse: Bula Katɔti ɔdubo ubabla lɛla lɛdi na ɔɔɔdubo buse buɛɛ. Ɔkɛ ku kudu ku ogya ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa na ɔɔka taamana-nwu.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: Údie lɛdi na ɔ́lɔ katɔ ku kalɔ ala ƒui ka bebo na ɔtɛku nwuna bekyuli litemi.

english_verse: “Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bɛsala mina bekyuli bani mɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ bite-mi. Bákyula akpala béte-mi na búnyimi bunyimi bɔdi.”

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Kayaa ƒui ala aatina kalɛ na Katɔti use siin. Ɔsika anwu ɔlati ndi litemi ɔtɛne ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: Mina kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ, binu. Ami ndi Katɔti bina Unwoti na ndubo-mii litemi bɔtɛku na lidie bina ala ani bɛ́bla bɛ́ƒiɔ ƒui lɛtina.

english_verse: Although you offer sacrifices and always bring gifts,
translation_verse: Naaadɔnku-mii na bina etela ku akpala ani bɛɛkyula uwi ndi uwi na mina anumi ɔsu.

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
translation_verse: Na naaawia nnii biƒie ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔkɔdi ɔdi iye betukpa bɛsiku bina ayu kemmo biboku-mi.

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛku kemmo kebweyi biala kadi ami ɔdi. Na bakɔ bani na nkya abi mpim mpim lɛlɔ ƒui badi ami badi.

english_verse: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
translation_verse: Ngyi baasɛ lidu lidu bani nkya abi lɛlɔ mmɔ ƒui ku beƒiebuo bammɔ ƒui bumomo. Na beƒiebuo bammɔ ƒui ni, ami mbo-ma.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: Si kɔka kɔɔda-mi ni, ɔɔɔdi amii na ndubuye lɛdila. Ɔsika ami mbo kayawi ƒui ku ala ani nkya-nya kemmo.

english_verse: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
translation_verse: Naaakun bakɔ lɛna. Na naaani bese ubugya lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui anwuɔsu biti enugya binwini aani akpala bite-mi. Na ala ani na bíse kenye ka bɛdubɔbla ni, bɛbla bɛsiaku-nya lɛlɔ lɛni bite-mi.

english_verse: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́bla ɔmɛni na bɛ́kpali-mi na ɔgbankpi ɔdi uwi ni, ndubɔtuna bute-mii, na bɛya na mina lɛnyi lɛƒɔ kuye.

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Na amii bekyuli bekpidi ni, Katɔti ɔnini, “Biiibo kuƒi kɔni na bɛkɔ-mi ɔda bubo lɛsa bite bekyuli. Na bɛda bɔsu bɛya bɛnii bɛɛdi mina bunyimi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
translation_verse: Bikisi ka lidie-mii bɔƒiɔ na bɛda bɛya. Na bíni mina etemila.

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: Si bɛ́nu uyune ni, na amii ku-nwu bɛbla unwi. Na amii ku basɔnɔdine mɔɔví taabla ala taasala.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: Atɛ ekpidi sɔɔn néyi-mii kenye na bina linyemi lɛɛta na ɔkɔ ala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
translation_verse: Na bɛɛtɛmi enyekpi na bina banwani lɛlɔ. Na bɛɛlɔ bina benibi muedi anyikpi.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni udu na bɛɛbla, nsu ntebimi tɔ kenye úbalɛ ɔƒɛni. Anwuɔsu na bɛɛkali bɛnii nse aani bina kalɛ. Nsu ndubudie bina bɔƒiɔ lɛtina-mii na lɛtɛku-mii litemi.

english_verse: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
translation_verse: Bɛkali ala amɛni lɛlɔ bɛnu kaduɛ amii bani náyiƒala-mi. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, ndubo-mii udu bɔyila ɔni na ɔdi ulakana-mii bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni muuti enugya teenwini akpala teete-mi ni, uuti ɔbu teete-mi na ndubɔƒɔ-nwu ngba.

english_verse: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, nu-mi kɔnyana, ɔsika ƒula bɔyɔ bulávumana. Na ƒula kɔnyana pii kɔni na aanu abu bekyuli ɔsu ni, ƒɔ mina ekpidi ƒui die-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Kpila-mi kede kede na mina ekpidi ɔsu na lɛlɛ sɛɛn na mina bɔƒiɔ ƒui kudɔ.

english_verse: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛ́nu mina alaekpidi lɛ́ti. Na ekpidi ammɔ eeduo-mi uwi biala.

english_verse: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
translation_verse: Awɔ kani na lɛ́bla alaekpidi amɛni lɛ́ƒiɔ. Lɛla biala lɛɛtina ka ƒula kenye etemila adi litemi geen. Na aatɛku bekyuli ƒui litemi ulu siin lɛlɔ

english_verse: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
translation_verse: Na sɔsɔ ni, likpidi udu ɔkya-mi lɛlɔ kemmo ɔ́si uwi ɔni na mina uni ɔ́da-mi kaƒɔ. Na mɔɔbla-nya ɔ́si ɔni na ɔ́wɔ-mi.

english_verse: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
translation_verse: Kpila-mi na edie ekpidi ƒui mina lɛlɔ sɛɛn na nteekeye teetulo etubankɛ.

english_verse: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na áƒɛ-mi na nwi kalɔ ni, na asɔ atala-mi enyene ku lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
translation_verse: Veli mina alaekpidi ƒui die-mi lɛlɔ na edie-nya atu.

english_verse: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
translation_verse: Katɔti, bla-mi ukyuli ɔwɔdi na linye kpakplaa uwi ndi uwi na ntaabla ala siin.

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: Tabɔku-mi tatɔlɔku na ƒula anumi. Na taya na ƒula Kɔyu ɔyikun ɔlɛ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Mmomu na asɔku mina ngba bɔƒɔ lɛlɔyɔ lɛni na éte-mi mmɔ akya-mi lɛlɔ kemmo. Na aya na lɛkana bunye kpakplaa na ntaadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
translation_verse: Ndubɔtina alaekpidi bablane ƒula lilu kalɛ na basɔ benwini bebo-ɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, die-mi na ubugya kalɔ buwi lɛtuni kemmo. Na ndubɔsu kalɛ na aaƒɔ́ bekyuli ngba.

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, ya libimi kenye na lɛtu lɛnu limwi-ɔ na bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
translation_verse: Mmomu akpala ani mɔɔƒɔ́-ɔ anu ndi ka ukyuli ekpidi eduo-nwu geen na nwuna kayi kemmo, na eleni ɔmɛni.

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, ya na kaƒɔ kayɔ-ɔ na abla Sion lɛƒɔndia na asɔku Yerusalem ɔma ɔmmɔ awodu atu.

english_verse: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama akpala siin ani na bɔdubɔkyula bute-ɔ ƒui adubɔda-a ebiti. Na bɔdubuti ɔmantɛ bakɔ bakɔdi bɔkpa bute-ɔ na ƒula lɛkpabi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
translation_verse: Bakantankpine benengudi, bilie bɛɛkun lɛmɛnɛ na likpidi lɛlɔ. Nsu Katɔti ɔda nwuna bekyuli ɔkɛnku nwuna bɔyɔ bɔni naaavumana kudii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ ɔnyine, éti ƒula unyemi énwini aani kewii yayaaya blii suɛ eebile ala na ada aakya likpidi kɔkwɛ.

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: Na aayɔ́ likpidi teetulo lɛbuni. Na aayɔ́ ɔkɔ teetulo ka asu ala ani nse sɔsɔ.

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: Awɔ ɔkɔ ɔnyine! Aayɔ́ etemila ani muubile ukyuli na ɔɔyá na ɔyii udu.

english_verse: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔdubo-ɔ bɔda na ɔkpɛ-ɔ ɔlɛku ƒula keliekɔ na ɔyila-a udu ƒui kede kede. Ɔdubo-ɔ bɔgyu budie ku ligyiitu aani kugyii na ekpi alɛ bayawine akɔ na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nse siin badubo ɔmɛni bɔnu na bayia. Na badubo-ɔ bɔma na basu banini,

english_verse: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
translation_verse: “Aanu lɛla lɛni nálɛku-ɔ ka éni anii alasia Unwoti anu na aakun lɛmɛnɛ na ƒula akɛla lɛlɔ na ákɛ ɔyikun elie aabla likpidi.”

english_verse: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
translation_verse: Nsu ami ni, nse aani kɔdingyii kɔni evete neeewile kudii na nnye Katɔti kaduli. Na mina anu asia-nwu bɔyɔ bɔni naaavumana kudii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
translation_verse: Ndubumwi-ɔ uwi biala ɔ́si lɛla lɛni na ábla ɔsu. Ƒula lɛlɔ mina anu adubɔsia uwi ƒui. Ɔsika bekyuli baalɔ-ɔ lɛnyi buni. Na ndubumwi-ɔ na kesi kesii na ƒula bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔlɔdi mɔɔsu na nwuna kayi kemmo ɔnini, “Katɔti uuubo.” Likyulikpi lɛ́ƒɔ-ma keliela kemmo ɔsu balábla lɛbuni lɛdi.

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́sia bayawine ƒui anu ɔ́siku katɔ si ɔdi kasusu kálɛmi na ɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔsiaku-nwu kama.

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Nsu bana ƒui ɔdi uláwia-mi kama ulu ɔ́si bana ekpidi ɔsu. Ukyuli ɔdi uuubo ɔni mɔɔbla lɛbuni. Ina unwi pɛ muedi!

english_verse: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
translation_verse: Amii alaekpidi bablane bamɛni, bíni bɛnii bɛɛɛdubo lɛla lɛdi bɔtɛya! Bi ɔsu na bɛ́yila mina bekyuli udu aani kalɛ na baadi adila, na bíni bɛnii bilakpali Unwoti lɛnyi?

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: Liƒu bonwu líbo-mii lɛlɔ lɛni udu nétebo tɔ kudii. Ɔsika Katɔti úbo amii mina bekisine ekubi úgyingya. Na kɔƒa kúkpo geen, ɔsika Katɔti úni-mii.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Muuvele kpakplaa nnii Katɔti ɔya na bɔƒɔ bɔsi Sion bubo bute Israel. Na si Katɔti ɔ́sɔku nwuna bekyuli lɛkɛ úte-ma ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma geen.

english_verse: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
translation_verse: Katɔti, ƒɔ-mi ngba ɔkɛnku ƒula ɔyikun lɛlɔ na atina ka lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-mi.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: Nu mina bɔkpali ku lɛla lɛni na muuvele-ɔ.

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Baƒɔ bekpidi bani mbo ulikplu báta beekpóku-mi na baawia-mi badu. Na badi bekyuli bani naaadaku-ɔ lɛda.

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, awɔ ndubo-mi bubunku kalɛ na neeebuli.

english_verse: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
translation_verse: Adubo mina bekisine kɔtu bɔni na bana ablala ɔsu. Na adubɔdi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ ete-mi na ayila-ma udu.

english_verse: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
translation_verse: Unwoti ndubuti kaƒɔ ƒaa etela liboku-ɔ. Na ndubunwi-ɔ lɛnyi, ɔsika adia geen.

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: Awɔ nédie-mi na mina ɔgbankpi ƒui kemmo. Na áya lɛ́nu kalɛ na ébo mina bekisine kalɔ.

english_verse: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
translation_verse: Katɔti, buvele se atu na enu mina bɔkpali. Na teni ala ani muuvele-ɔ.

english_verse: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
translation_verse: Nu-mi bɔkpali, ɔsika etemila pii eekpóku-mi na lɛ́ta líƒu

english_verse: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.
translation_verse: na mina bekisine kɔvanu ku kalɛ na baabla-mi kalala ɔsu. Na béti kɔnyi bákya-mi kati kati.

english_verse: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
translation_verse: Kayi kaakpulu-mi na muunú ɔlɛ geen na use aani bukpi muedi na ndubo.

english_verse: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
translation_verse: Liƒu ku bɔyia bonwu búƒie-mi na lɛlɔ lɛɛtɔ́-mi kpakpaakpa.

english_verse: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́su nnii si avwi na nka mbo aani abloduma ni, nka ndubuveyi lɛtɔlɔ ntélie kesii kadi ntaanwuna.

english_verse: I would go and live in some distant desert.
translation_verse: Ndubusie na ntélie kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo na ɔgyu kakaaka.

english_verse: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
translation_verse: Ndubo bɔbabla na lɛwia kabɛkɔ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ku ɔnantu ɔni mɔɔna ɔsu.

english_verse: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
translation_verse: Unwoti, ya na mina bekisine bammɔ beƒu. Na ebile bana kɔkwɛ kɔni na baakya kemmo ku kadɔ ku kekpo ku bekyuli ala bubile bɔni na mɔɔnu na ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
translation_verse: Bakɛ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo baaví usien ku ɔƒɛ. Na bakɛ awodu ammɔ lɛlɔ aani bagyumanane. Na baabla udunkpi ala amɛni.

english_verse: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔ banyine ku ala bebilene ku bani mɔɔta teenye bekyuli lɛlɔ ɔkplu bɔdi báƒɔ-nwu lɛblɔnu lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
translation_verse: Si nka mina bekisine muudumi-mi muedi na báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ ni, nka naaasu lɛla lɛdi na ndubɔbɛ mmomu.

english_verse: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
translation_verse: Nsu mina ɔvinkpana geen ɔni lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di lítulo mɔɔbla-mi ɔmɛni udu.

english_verse: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
translation_verse: Ami ku-nwu bɔ́vi ku kubiti aani bakpana na bɔ́sala lɛlɔ ku bekyuli bamba na bútákpa na Katɔti kakpakɔ.

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Unwoti, bekyuli bani ƒui na báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ ni, ya na kukpi kuyu-ma kɔtu na bayu kekpine ulu kɔnakunwi. Ɔsika kalala bɔbla bɔ́ƒɔ-ma kaduli ku bana kɔyi kemmo.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Nsu ami amu ni, Unwoti Katɔti, mɔɔkpali-ɔ nnii ƒɔ-mi, na adubɔƒɔ-mi sɔsɔ!

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
translation_verse: Ɔtanta ku ɔƒiiwi ku usien ƒui ndubɔkpali Katɔti, na liwulo lɛkya-nwu na ala ani muukpóku-mi ɔsu. Na ɔdubunu ute-mi.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔƒɔ-mi na kekpo kani na ami ku mina bekisine bani na mina lɛƒɛnyi ƒui buukpó, na naaaƒɔ ɔlɛ ɔdi.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔni mɔɔdi lɛla biala lɛlɔ úsela uwi ƒui ni, ɔdubunu-mi bɔkpali na ɔni-ma kɔtu. Ɔsika baláyia Katɔti na béni lɛnɔ banii balavumana kudi kudii na bataabu-nwu.

english_verse: My friend turned against me and broke his promise.
translation_verse: Mina ɔvinkpana ɔ́ta únye-mi lɛlɔ ɔmmɔ ɔsu úbile ami ku-nwu kɔkpana.

english_verse: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
translation_verse: Nwuna kenye kemmo etemila ebo emini aani nnɔ eku. Nsu kekpo kasusu nkya-nwu kayi. Na nwuna etemila ese ƒɛƒɛɛ aani nnɔmii. Nsu eekúlo aani kewii.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: Ti ƒula ala ani muukpóku-ɔ kya Unwoti enu kemmo. Na ɔdubo-ɔ bubunku na ɔda-a kpakplaa, ɔsika ulaya na bekyuli bani nsiaku-nwu kama siin baasɔ taakya lɛbibo kemmo.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: Nsu ni, O Katɔti, adubɔya na bekyuli badune ku ɔkɔ banyine bamɛni bekpi na bakya-ma kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo na bayii udu ɔni na bana ngba bulene. Nsu ami ni, mina anu ƒui adubɔsia-a lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Have pity, God Most High! My enemies chase me all day.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, nu-mi kɔnyana, ɔsika bekisine basiaku-mi beekpóku-mi geen. Na mina bekisine baanya-mi taakya uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Many of them are pursuing and attacking me,
translation_verse: Básala lɛlɔ otogyi na basiaku-mi beekpóku-mi ƒui.

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: O Unwoti Katɔti, si uwi ɔni na liƒu lítulo-mi muedi ni, ƒula lɛlɔ kani na mina anu asia.

english_verse: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Katɔti ƒula lɛlɔ na mina anu asia, anwuɔsu na naaayia. Na muumwi-ɔ na ƒula kenye kani na ásu ése ɔsu. Ukyuli ɔyawine ulakana-mi lɛla lɛdi bɔbla.

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: Mina bekisine baayɔ́ ka bataada-mi kenye banii lɛ́bla likpidi na beeti-mi lɛlɔ kasusu uwi ndi uwi kalɛ na babla-mi kalala.

english_verse: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
translation_verse: Baasa lili na mina lɛlɔ uwi biala na baabɛ́ taatu-mi kasiakɔ uwi biala kalɛ na bakɛ-mi badu.

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, taya na bekeli bana kɔtu bɔni na ɔbladu ɔmɛni ɔsu. O Katɔti, sie na átáyila-ma udu na ƒula kɔnyi kemmo.

english_verse: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
translation_verse: Agyi abi ani udu na muubó. Na agyi mina mmii kalɛ na bumomo.

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛni na makpali-ɔ ni, na abɔku mina bekisine na badubusie kama. Ɔsika ngyi ka Unwoti unyeku-mi.

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Nwuna lɛlɔ na líkpo kama na naaayia lɛla lɛdi, ɔsika ukyuli ɔdi ulakana-mi lɛla lɛdi bɔbla.

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, ala ani na líse kenye ka ndubɔbla lite-ɔ ni, ndubɔnu ka lɛ́bla-nya ƒui na liti mina enugya etela liboku-ɔ.

english_verse: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
translation_verse: Ɔsika awɔ nédie-mi kɔyu ásiku kukpi kemmo. Na ƒula bukeye bɔɔtina-mi kanyankɔ na ƒula anumi na ntagbanta.

english_verse: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
translation_verse: Nu-mi kɔnyana, O Katɔti, nu-mi kɔnyana, ɔsika awɔ na líkeli lɛ́tamiku. Na ƒula avwi ɔyuli kalɔ na ndubɔkɛ kabɛkɔ úti útédu uwi ɔni na ɔgbankpi kpakplaa ɔni mɔɔlɛ́ mmɔ kenye kadubɔvi.

english_verse: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
translation_verse: Na adubo-mi bubunku bɔsiku katɔ mmɔ. Na adubo bekyuli bani nábi basiaku-mi beekpóku-mi mmɔ bɔbɔku. Na atina ka aadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ na aayɔ́-mi.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
translation_verse: Mina bekisine báka bámana-mi aani bagyata bani muuƒie bekyuli taaduli-ma teebweli. Na bana anyi ese aani abuala ku ligyii atula. Na bana linyemi libo ɔbi aani kuwii.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, ya na bekyuli ƒui bakɔliku ƒula lɛnyi katɔ besienku ɔgyu kakaaka. Na banu kalɛ na eekeye na kesi kesii na kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
translation_verse: Mina bekisine bákywɛ-mi kɔkpagyuɛ na bédie libu béwi-mi kalɛ na lɛnu liduo na mina ngba bɔkya ɔgbankpi kemmo, nsu ama alati bánu béduo-ni kemmo.

english_verse: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
translation_verse: Mina kayi kélie-mi kalɔ na awɔ ɔsu, O Katɔti, na ndubudie kɔgya ku lɛdi mini mini limwi-ɔ.

english_verse: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
translation_verse: Ndubɔta ku mina kayi ƒui na liti ɔbentaa ku agyala ɔtanta tutuutu ntágyila ɔƒɛ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ndubɔgya-a enu na bekyuli ƒui benu. Na ndubudie lɛnu limwi-ɔ na kadi biala bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Unwoti, kalɛ na aayɔ́ bekyuli uwi biala ku kalɛ na aadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ úbomo geen aani kalɛ na bɔɔnu ka kayaa kébomo.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, ya na bekyuli ƒui bakɔliku ƒula lɛnyi katɔ besienku ɔgyu kakaaka. Na banu kalɛ na eekeye na kesi kesii na kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
translation_verse: Amii kalɔ lɛlɔ bayikune, bɛɛtɛmi taasiaku ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ? Na bɛɛtɛ bekyuli etemila na ulu siin lɛlɔ?

english_verse: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi ni, likpidi kani na beelie taabla uwi biala. Na baanyi ɔkɔ lɛnɔ ɔ́si bana bɔwɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
translation_verse: Ugyulo ukpidi ɔkya-ma kenye aani balakpi kalɛ. Na atu éti-ma aani kalɛ na avan atu eeti.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, mina bekisine bese aani bagyata bani na bana anumi égyie anwuɔsu na muuvele-ɔ nnii ƒɛ-ma anyi.

english_verse: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
translation_verse: Ya na babla aani ɔkɔɔkɔ evuo ani kemmo na lɛna liiibo. Na babla aani kaƒɔ kani nébie na kelenwini ubi ɔni muulie ngba taanu ɔƒɛ.

english_verse: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na libui lɛni na básia liyu ogya lɛlɔ liiibo ogya bɔƒɔ ni, Katɔti ɔyila-ma udu na ɔbabla utulo lɛni.

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Na lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bekyuli bani nse siin si bánu kalɛ na baaní belikplune bamɛni kɔtu. Na bana ubugya ɔni nwi kalɔ ɔɔgbá ni, bekyuli babuni badubɔkya lɛgba bavi-nwu kemmo.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Na bekyuli badubɔsu banini, “Sɔsɔ ni, báƒɔ bekyuli babuni kayu. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔni mɔɔtɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ mɔɔdi kayawi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
translation_verse: Na edie-mi na bekyuli bani nli beeti-mi likpidi kasusu uwi biala ka badu-mi enu kemmo.

english_verse: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ni, Ati, bábɛ belie-mi ulu lɛlɔ ka badu-mi. Na bayikune bála lɛlɔ básala baawia-mi ngba bebile. Nsu ntabla-ma lɛla likpidi lɛdi.

english_verse: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi mina likpidi lɛdi ɔsu na bakɛ beekeli taada-mi. O Katɔti, nu lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ na ata ku kɔnyi na ebo ebedie-mi.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui, awɔ ndi Israel Katɔti. Ta na ani kadi bamba bekyuli ƒui kɔtu. Na tada bani muulie taakya bekyuli kakya tese.

english_verse: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Na useyi uwi biala ni, mina bekisine beenwíni teebo na beebó adi aani bakpewe na baakɛ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo ƒui baaví.

english_verse: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
translation_verse: Eenú-ma enyekpi ku edumi. Na bana linyemi lise aani kuwii na bana inye kemmo. Nsu baakali banii ukyuli ɔdi ulenu lɛla lɛni na baasu.

english_verse: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ Unwoti, agyi ka kadi bamba bekyuli ƒui ni, badi-ɔ lɛmala.

english_verse: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Mina Katɔti, ngyi ka adubo ebebunku-mi, ɔsika aayɔ́-mi uwi biala. Na adubɔya na lɛnu mina bekisine kebulikɔ.

english_verse: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, taya na bekpi na bekyuli bayiƒala lɛla lɛni na ábla! Mmomu ƒɛ-ma avwi na bakɛ bataavi taakya kani, ɔsika awɔ mɔɔgyumana-bu.

english_verse: My enemies are liars! So let them be trapped by their boastful lies.
translation_verse: Na bana enyekpi ku edumi ku ewida ku ɔkɔ ala ani na básu ƒui enwini kɔkpagyuɛ kudie-ma na kalɛ na baatina lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Na useyi uwi biala ni, mina bekisine beenwíni teebo na beebó adi aani bakpewe na bakɛ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo ƒui baaví.

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: Baawia lɛla lɛni na badi. Na si bátakɛ lɛla lɛdi ni, livo liiƒí-ma na beesié taatátɛ ku kɔka na beebó adi.

english_verse: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Nsu ami ndubudie ɔnu na libo kudu ka ebo ɔyikun geen. Na ɔtanta biala ni, ndubudie ɔnu na limwi-ɔ, ɔsika ƒula bɔyɔ bulávumana na awɔ ndi mina kabɛkɔ kesii kani na aagyumana-mi na ɔgbankpi uwi.

english_verse: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.
translation_verse: O mina Unwoti, ndubudie ɔnu limwi-ɔ, ɔsika awɔ mɔɔkya-mi ɔyikun na awɔ ndi mina kama kekpokɔ na aayɔ́-mi uwi biala.

english_verse: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
translation_verse: O Katɔti, éni-bu na ábwɛ ɔban ɔni na ágyi ákya-bu. Éti kɔnyi geen ákya-bu, nsu sɔku-bu nyene ƒula anumi

english_verse: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
translation_verse: Awɔ náya na kalɔ kákunku na kábwɛ ntɛ. Nsu buuvele-ɔ bɔnii tile kɔka kɔmmɔ kalɛ na kalɔ kammɔ kelébo kalánu.

english_verse: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
translation_verse: Áya na ƒula bekyuli beebó abi ani naaadia bɔnu. Na lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ku-bu únwini aani si ntɛ kpakplaa na éte-bu na bɔ́ni na bɔɔda-bu.

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Álɛ aƒlaga éte bekyuli bani mɔɔbu-ɔ kalɛ na ɔtina-ma uwi ɔni na bana bekisine badubo.

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Unwoti awɔ ɔlati ti ƒula kɔdianu kɔnu na ekpo ete-bu ku ƒula ɔyikun kalɛ na ƒula bekyuli bani na aayɔ́ mmɔ bakɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́tɛmi ɔsiku nwuna kakpakɔ Katɔma kedee kemmo ɔnini, “Lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi ka lile Sekem ɔma ku Sukot Ɔkwalɛ ɔmmɔ lite mina bekyuli.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Ami mbo Gilead ku Manase. Nda Eƒraim aani mina kagabwa. Na nda Yuda aani mina ɔgagyii.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Na Moab use aani lɛkyami lɛni kemmo na mɔɔƒɔ mina enu. Na Edom lɛlɔ na mɔɔnya lɛgba. Na Ƒilistia na muunye teebo kudu ka lɛ́di lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Buvele, kpo-ma te-bu, ɔsika ukyuli ɔyawine kebunku keeebo kɔsia kɔdi.

english_verse: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku Katɔti lɛlɔ ni, bɔdubɔdi lɛlɔ. Ɔsika anwu ndubɔnya bula bekisine ususu kalɔ.

english_verse: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Katɔti, buvele, nu-mi kɔvanu na abla ete-mi kalɛ na muuvele-ɔ.

english_verse: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
translation_verse: Ina ka nsɔ liiibo lɛnunsia ni, mɔɔkpali-ɔ lɛsiku ɔgyu kakaaka kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni. Kpanku-mi na libo-ɔ kudɔ, ɔsika awɔ ndi mina lɛtakpɛ lɛni na lɛ́kuku.

english_verse: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
translation_verse: Adi mina kabɛkɔ na ese aani katu taasia kagyumanakɔ ɔtɔ kpakplaa éte-mi, kesii kani na muunye taanu mina bekisine eli.

english_verse: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
translation_verse: Na aya na lɛsɔ lɛkya-a kudɔ úsela uwi ƒui. Na ƒula avwi ebi-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
translation_verse: Énu ala ani lɛ́kpali-ɔ líse kenye ka mabla, O Unwoti. Na kadikɔ kani na eete bekyuli bani mɔɔyia-a ni, aka na éte ami lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
translation_verse: Na aya na ɔga emeyi emomo ebu na nwuna lɛgadi litu uwi.

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: Unwoti, siaku-nwu na nwuna lɛga bɔdi uwi ƒui. Na aya na ƒula bɔyɔ bɔni naaavumana ku ƒula litemi geen lɛgyumana-nwu.

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔtu ɔnu limwi-ɔ lɛnyi uwi biala. Na ala ani lɛ́kpali-ɔ líse kenye ka mabla ni, ndubɔbla-nya limeyi ndi limeyi.

english_verse: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
translation_verse: Katɔti ƒula anumi kani na nnye mɔɔnu kpoo ka linu lɛla lɛdi. Na mɔɔnu ulu ka aƒɔ-mi.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: Awɔ lɛti ndi mina lɛtakpɛ lɛni lɛlɔ na nkpo kalɛ na lɛkɛ bɔƒɔ. Na awɔ ndi mina katamikukɔ kpakplaa ɔsu ɔdi biala uladi-mi lɛlɔ kudii.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Kɔlɛ sɔɔn na amii mina bekisine bɛdubɔta bibekpoku-mi na bɛkya-mi ɔlɛ lɛlɔ, ɔsika nse aani ɔban ɔni nsɔ neeebo ɔkplu iye kowodu kɔni mɔɔnyonu lɛlɔ?

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: Baawia ka batu-mi bedie mina kenyekɔ na bayila-mi lɛnyi lɛni na lɛ́ƒɔ. Ɔkɔ bɔnyi bɔɔda-ma kubiti. Na baatɛmi minimini nsu ɔdu ukpidi sɔɔn náƒɔ-ma kayi kemmo.

english_verse: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
translation_verse: Katɔti lɛti pɛ kani ndi mina kakyakɔ. Ami nnye mɔɔnu ulu teete, ɔsika nwuna lɛlɔ na mina anu ƒui asia.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: Anwu lɛti pɛ kani ndi mina lɛtakpɛ lɛni lɛlɔ na líkpo kama ka ɔdubɔƒɔ-mi. Na anwu ndi mina katamikukɔ kpakplaa, anwuɔsu lɛla lɛdi liladi-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Katɔti kani ndubudie-mi ɔgbankpi biala kemmo. Na anwu kani mɔɔyá na mɔɔƒɔ́ lɛnyi. Anwu ndi lɛtakpɛ lɛni lɛlɔ na líkpo kama, na ɔdi mina katamikukɔ.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: Amii bekyuli ƒui, biti bina kayi ƒui bɛsia Katɔti lɛlɔ uwi biala. Na biteevele-nwu ala ani ƒui na bɛɛyaki. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔdi katamikukɔ.

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔɔɔdi ku lɛla. Na use aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni nékpo ɔ́vi kani. Bani mɔɔnu ka bebo kenyekɔ ku bani nkya-ma kalɔ ƒui lɛkooƒo bana ƒui badi. Baakali ka bebo unu si bákɔku-ma bánu. Nsu ɔƒɛƒɛɛ muedi ubo unu utulo-ma.

english_verse: Don't trust in violence or depend on dishonesty or rely on great wealth.
translation_verse: Bitatɛya ɔdikplu iye bekyuli buyu taakɛ lɛkɛ. Si lɛkɛ lɛɛkɔ́-mii katɔ ni, biteti bina kayi bitasia ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I heard God say two things: “I am powerful,
translation_verse: Líinu ɔbla kunyɔ ka Katɔti ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Ami Katɔti kani mbo ɔyikun.

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: Na ami kani mɔɔyɔ́ ukyuli uwi ndi uwi. Na mɔɔƒɔ kayu kani námanku ukyuli biala na nwuna kabla kenye teete-nwu.”

english_verse: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, awɔ ndi mina Katɔti ɔni kama ulu na mɔɔwia kpakplaa aani kalɛ na utukwɛ ɔɔda ukyuli na kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ya na mina anumi anu-ɔ na ƒula kakpakɔ na lɛnu kalɛ na ebo ɔyikun na eekeye.

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na aayɔ́-mi uwi ndi uwi ni, ɔɔyu-mi kayi teetulo ngba bɔni alati na nli. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na ndubumwi-ɔ.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
translation_verse: Na ndubo-ɔ enu butaagya uwi biala na nli ngba. Na ndubɔtala enu katɔ na lɛkpali-ɔ.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: Ndubudie lɛnu ku ebiti limwi-ɔ na kayi kayɔ-mi buɛɛ aani ukyuli ɔni na bálɔ bésienku limeyi kadikɔ na ɔ́kɛ ala abuni ƒui ɔ́di na émo-nwu kaduɛ.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: Na si ntɛ mina lɛtɛla lɛlɔ ni, naaayiƒala-a mmomu mɔɔkali taanu-ɔ usien umodi.

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Ɔsika awɔ kani muubunku-mi uwi biala na ƒula avwi ɔyuli kalɔ na muudie ɔnu na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: Awɔ na líƒie nda kpakplaa, na awɔ lɛnɔ ada-mi kpakplaa ku ƒula kɔdianu kɔni mɔɔtina ƒula ɔyikun.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bani mɔɔwia-mi ngba bayila ni, ama ndubo kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo buduo.

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: Kekpo kadubo-ma buƒie. Na kuwii kenye na badubo bɔtɛ. Na beƒiebuo ndubo-ma ɔlɔna bɔkun.

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Nsu lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ɔga ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́ya na ɔ́di lɛlɔ. Na bani ƒui nése kenye ɔkɛnku Katɔti lɛnyi lɛlɔ ni, badubo-nwu lɛnyi bumwi. Nsu ɔkɔ banyine ama balakana kenye bubimi.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, muuvele-ɔ nnii nwini nu-mi na anu lɛla lɛni muukpóku-mi. Na enye etile mina bekisine bani mɔɔkya-mi liƒu.

english_verse: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
translation_verse: Gyumana-mi kalɛ na mina bekisine lili lɛni baasa na mina lɛlɔ lilebo-nwu kemmo lilete-ma. Na balalane bani náta ku otogyi baládi-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Bádɔ bana linyemi aani kuwii na bana kenye ɔdu etemila na baatu taalɛ-mi aani kataminta atula.

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: Na likyulikpi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ kani na benye kpakplaa na baasu ka badubɔbɛ bakywɛ-mi kɔkpagyuɛ na baasu banini, “Ukyuɛdi ulanu-bu.”

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Beeti kasusu kekpidi na baasu banini, “Bɔdubɔbla likpidi lɛmɛni na ukyuli ɔdi ulanu-bu kasusu uláti.”

english_verse: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti ɔdubo nwuna atula bubo bɔlɛ-ma na baƒɔ lɛlɛ kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Bana enyekpi ɔsu ni, ɔdubo bana ƒui udu bɔyila. Na ukyuli biala manu-ma ɔdubo lili buƒwimi na ɔpii-ma.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Na liƒu lɛdubɔda bekyuli ƒui na basu lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́bla. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔlɛmi-ma kasusu na bati lɛlɔ bɔda.

english_verse: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Amii bani nsiaku Unwoti kama siin ni, lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii na Unwoti lɛlɔ na bikeli bɛtamiku-nwu na bimwi-nwu.

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, ɔ́manku ka bekyuli ƒui bemwi-ɔ na Sion. Na babla basia kenye kani na bése béte-ɔ ƒui lɛlɔ na mmɔ.

english_verse: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na bula alaekpidi aayu-bu unu taagya ni, awɔ muuti-nya taakyie-bu.

english_verse: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bekyuli bani na awɔ ɔlati áƒuna ka bebelie-ɔ kudɔ na ƒula kakpakɔ kedee kaduli. Na badubɔkɛ ebiti geen na ƒula kudɔ bulie kemmo na mmɔ.

english_verse: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, bula ɔƒɔne, eenú-bu bɔkpali na eebunku-bu ɔkɛnku ƒula akɔla budie taatina lɛlɔ. Kayawi bekyuli ƒui anu asia-a lɛlɔ ku bani na beli ɛpu ɔvi.

english_verse: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
translation_verse: Ebo ɔyikun, na ƒula ɔyikun ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na áya na abi ƒui enye ana kenyekɔ.

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani nli ɔgyu kalɔ bénu ƒula akɔla budie taatina ammɔ na baayia. Na bekyuli beebó ƒula ablala amɛni kudu ku lɛlɔyɔ ɔ́si ɔtanta útédu ku useyi uwi.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: Aanu kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ kaduɛ. Na aaya na ɔnantu ɔɔna teewi-ka lɛlɔ na kaadia edula. Na ntukpa buubo ntu na aayá na edula lidu lidu aalɛ́.

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: Aayá na bula mmo bɔɔƒɔ́ ntu na kalɔ kaayɔ́ teete alakpi ku egyii lidu na aalɛ́ lili.

english_verse: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
translation_verse: Lɛkwa lɛɛdianku bekyuli na baaƒɛ edula pii. Na bekyuli baalɛ́ku-nya taasiku lɛƒɛnyi ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Baƒonu báƒɔ abi lɛlɔ ƒui. Na anta ku edula bamba áƒɔ ɔkwalɛ ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ na use aani ebiti mɔɔda lɛla biala na beebó kudu ku lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Amii kayawi bekyuli ƒui, bibo Katɔti kudu ku lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: Na bidie lɛnu bimwi nwuna lɛnyi na bɛtina kalɛ na uukeye.

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Bɛsu Katɔti bɛnini, “Ƒula ablala adi akɔla budie taatina. Na ƒula ɔyikun bonwu ɔni na ebo ɔsu ni, ƒula bekisine béboku lɛlɔ kalɔ béte-ɔ ku bɔyia.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Kayawi bekyuli ƒui beeboku lɛlɔ kalɔ teete-ɔ na beedie lɛnu teemwi-ɔ.”

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Bibo na bibanu akɔla budie taatina ani na Katɔti ɔ́bla na bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na bula nana bene bábwɛ bávi Ɛpugyie ntɛ na bakɛ lɛgba básia kalɔkplu bávia. Bibo na bɔkɛ ebiti na lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla ɔsu.

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: Nwuna ɔyikun unengudi kemmo na ɔɔdi kayawi bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ úsela uwi ƒui kemmo. Na nwuna anumi aanu kadi ƒui bekyuli ablala na lɛdi lítabɛ-nwu. Kayi katatɔlɔ batuɔkplune na bata benye-nwu lɛlɔ kudii.

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Amii kadi bekyuli ƒui, bimwi Katɔti ku kudu momoomo.

english_verse: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
translation_verse: Anwu nda-bu na bɔmu buli ngba na bunye bute-nwu na bútebuli.

english_verse: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
translation_verse: Katɔti, ákɔku-bu ánu aani kalɛ na baakya sika ɔƒualadi ɔgya kemmo taabla-nwu sɛɛn kalɛ na ɔdia bɔnu.

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: Áya na búduo lɛbibo kemmo aani kalɛ baanú kakpagyuɛ. Na bɔ́nɔ aani kalɛ na beeti etila ku unu bonwu ɔdi.

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: Áya na bekisine bákɔ bánya-bu lili na use aani ntukpa bɔni néyi kemmo ku ogya kemmo na bɔkɛ. Nsu kawɔlɔkɔ ni, bɔ́da bɔ́lɛ kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na ala abuni pii akya.

english_verse: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
translation_verse: Ndubuti akpala liboku mbakyula lite-ɔ na ƒula kakpakɔ. Na ndubuti ala ani kenye na líse liboku-ɔ.

english_verse: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.
translation_verse: Ndubɔkyula bebuo bani nélie lɛmwi aani akpala lite-ɔ. Na baƒonu bagyani bani makyula mmɔ uyɔ ɔkɔ ubo-ɔ kudɔ. Ndubuti ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku bese lɛnɔ lɛkpa-a.

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Bibo na bibenu, amii bani mɔɔyia Katɔti, na ndubɔsu-mii ala ani na ɔ́bla úte-mi.

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: Lɛ́kpali-nwu momoomo nnii ubunku-mi. Na lɛni kani na muumwi-nwu lɛnyi kedee.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: Na si likpidi nkya-mi kayi iye kasusu kemmo ni, nka Unwoti útakpete-mi.

english_verse: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Nsu geen geen ni, Katɔti únu-mi bɔkpali na ɔ́bla lɛla lɛni na muuvele-nwu úte-mi.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Muumwi Katɔti, ɔsika úteni ɔnii ɔsɔ ulabla-mi lɛƒɔndia aani kalɛ kani na ɔɔbla teete-mi uwi biala ka lɛ́kpali-nwu.

english_verse: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
translation_verse: Katɔti, nu-bu kɔnyana na ete-bu kusɛ kusɛ. Bla-bu lɛƒɔndia na ekeye na bula akɔ.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: Na aya na bekyuli ƒui banu ƒula lɛƒɔyɔ bati. Na banu bati lɛnɔ kalɛ na aaƒɔ́ teete bekyuli na kayawi ƒui.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Amii bekyuli ƒui, bimwi Unwoti! O Katɔti, ya na bekyuli ƒui bemwi-ɔ.

english_verse: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.
translation_verse: Ya na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ kadi bekyuli ƒui na bedie ebiti lɛnu. Ɔsika awɔ mɔɔtɛku bayawine ƒui litemi na ulu siin lɛlɔ. Na awɔ mɔɔtɔnku kadi bekyuli ƒui na kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Ya na bekyuli bakpali-ɔ lɛnyi bemwi. O Katɔti, ya na kadi ƒui bemwi-ɔ.

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Na kalɔ kete kuƒi na bekyuli báƒɛ edula geen. Unwoti ɔni ndi bula Katɔti ndubute-bu kusɛ kusɛ lɛni.

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Buuvele bɔnii Katɔti ute-bu kusɛ kusɛ ubu na ukyuli biala ɔbu-nwu na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
translation_verse: Katɔti, ta na ƒula bekisine begyingya. Na bekyuli bani muukisi-ɔ bekeli batɔlɔ ƒula anumi.

english_verse: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
translation_verse: Bɔku-ma lɛku ƒula anumi aani kalɛ na uyɔ ɔɔyii taakya. Ya na belikplune bayii ku udu aani kalɛ na kɔma kɔɔnani na ogya lɛlɔ si áda álɛ-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
translation_verse: Bidie lɛnu bite Katɔti, na bidie bumwi lɛnu bɛkɔliku-nwu lɛnyi katɔ. Bidie bumwi lɛnu momoomo bite anwu ɔni nli katɔ liƒlukutu lɛlɔ ɔɔví. Nwuna lɛnyi ndi Unwoti. Bɛkɛ lɛlɔyɔ na nwuna anumi!

english_verse: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
translation_verse: Awɔ Katɔti, bekpinebi ɔti, awɔ mɔɔnu bekpinele lɛlɔ ɔ́si ƒula keliekɔ kedee kesii kani na elie.

english_verse: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔɔyá na bekyuli bani na bédie lɛti basɔ baasála ku bana bekyuli. Na bani na bákya aban ɔtɔ ni, ɔ́ya na bédie-ma ku lɛnu budie na bánwuna. Nsu bani náta bénye nwuna litemi lɛlɔ ni, kalɔ kakwiidi kani na káƒɔ ogya kemmo na bɔdubo bɔkya.

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na átɔnku bula nana bene na kukuuku uwi ɔmmɔ na básia kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo bálɛ na bánwuna.

english_verse: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, kalɔ kákunku na kayaa kálɛmi na ɔnantu ɔ́na, ɔsika Sinai kɔbi Katɔti ɔdubo. Na anwu ndi Israel Katɔti.

english_verse: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
translation_verse: Áya na ɔnantu úwi na kalɔ kani nákwii mmɔ kásɔ kábla ɔwɔdi.

english_verse: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
translation_verse: Na ƒula bekyuli bákɛ keliekɔ. Na ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛƒɔndia ɔsu ni, bani ƒui mɔɔyáki ala bémo.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: Katɔti údie lɛdi, na beleku pii badi básu lɛla lɛni nálɛ mmɔ na bégyingya-ni, banini,

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: “Baga ku bana bekpone békeli bátalɔ na Israelƒuɔ beleku béle ala ani báda béwi ka kekpo kéƒie-ma.”

english_verse: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
translation_verse: Na beleku bani na nka bakya baƒonu akɔ baanu-ma lɛlɔ na bétesie kekpo ni, bákɛ sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi ɔni na bánwamana bámana babloduma bani na bánwi avi lɛlɔ na eekeye na ɔƒɛ kemmo mmɔ.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́bɔku baga bammɔ lɛni ni, etubankɛ atakpɛ bonwu bonwu adi áyu éwi Salmon Kɔbi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: Basa Kɔbi, adi kɔbi kunengudi kɔni mɔɔdia bɔnu na ƒula eli ébo ánu na ákɔ álɛ kangyaa.

english_verse: Why is it jealous of Zion, the mountain you chose as your home forever?
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na anumi asɔ eegyie-ɔ na Sion Kɔbi kɔni na ami Katɔti lɛ́ƒuna ka lilie lɛlɔ úsela uwi ƒui lɛlɔ?

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́yu úbo nwuna bekyuli kudɔ na Sinai kɔbi lɛlɔ ni, ɔkɛ ku nwuna bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ linengudi mpim mpim lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ákɔ ésie katɔ ƒui ni, éti bekyuli bani na ékpo áƒɔ ƒui átɔlɔku. Na éte-ma etela. Na ƒula bekisine bani naaayɔ ka elie mmɔ muedi lɛnɔ béte-ɔ ala.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Bɛya bumwi Katɔti, ɔsika anwu muubunku-bu limeyi ndi limeyi. Na anwu ndi bula Katɔti ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-bu ngba.

english_verse: You always protect us and save us from death.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔni ntulo ƒui ndi bula Katɔti ɔni muubunku-bu na uudie-bu kukpi kemmo.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔdubɔbwɛ nwuna bekisine bani nnye likpidi bɔbla lɛlɔ uwi ƒui eli.

english_verse: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ndubunwini ku bina bekisine liboku-mii lɛsiku Basan kalɔ lɛlɔ ku ɛpu kalɔ kemmo kesii kani na bábɛ bakya.

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubusie bɛvi bana ubugya ɔni bɛdubuwi kalɔ kemmo. Na bina bakpewɛ lɛnɔ badubɔyalɛ-ma ubugya.”

english_verse: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
translation_verse: O bula ɔga ku Katɔti, bɔ́nu kalɛ na bekyuli lisu bonwu lɛdi bakɛ badubo babasiaku-ɔ na ƒula kakpakɔ kedee.

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Na lɛnu bediene batɔ anumi, na bagyane bakpɛ kama. Na belekubi bani nda akasaa bakya-ma ntɛ.

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: Amii kasalakɔ kammɔ bekyuli ƒui, bimwi Katɔti. Na amii Yakobo kɔdua kemmo bebi ƒui, bimwi Unwoti lɛnyi!

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Na Benyamin kɔdua kɔni nse blii suɛ ntulo ƒui ntɔ-ma anumi. Na Yuda ku nwuna benengu basia. Na bani nsia ndi Sebulon ku Neƒtali benengu.

english_verse: Our God, show your strength! Show us once again.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, die ƒula ɔyikun keyi tina ƒula bekisine bammɔ. Ɔyikun ɔni kani na éti ékpo éte-bu.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na édie-nwu keyi ásiku ƒula kakpakɔ kedee, kesii kani na baga beeti etela teeboku-ɔ.

english_verse: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
translation_verse: Bɔku bula bekisine bani nse aani beƒiebuo na ketudɔ alakpi akɔ. Bese aani bakɔ ku bebi. Bɔku-ma tédu ka béboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na béti bana sika ɔƒualadi béboku-ɔ. Na egyingya bekyuli bani na kekpo ogya kani na beli baakya.

english_verse: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
translation_verse: Bagabi badubɔsi Egyipte bebo. Na Etiopia kadi bekyuli badubo enu katɔ bɔkɔliku na bakpali awɔ Katɔti.

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: Amii kayawi lɛga kadikɔ ƒui bekyuli, bidie lɛnu bimwi Katɔti bula Unwoti.

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: Anwu nli kayaa liƒlukutu lɛlɔ ɔɔví na katɔ ɔ́si kukuuku. Mmɔ na uudie nwuna lɛdi lɛni mbo ogya taasiku.

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: Bibo Katɔti ɔyikun kudu, ɔsika nwuna lɛgadi lɛka lɛ́mana Israel kalɔ ƒui. Na nwuna ɔyikun uudie lɛlɔ taatina nwaa na kayaa.

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: Katɔti lɛlɔ libo líƒu na nwuna keliekɔ kedee kemmo. Na anwu ndi Israel Katɔti. Anwu muute nwuna bekyuli ɔyikun na ɔ́ya na bebo kenyekɔ. Bimwi Katɔti!

english_verse: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, die-mi, ɔsika ala eekpóku-mi aani si ketu néyi kábadanku-mi limɔ.

english_verse: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Na lɛba lɛɛyɔ́ liƒie-mi, ɔsika mina lɛgba lilakɛ kenyekɔ. Ligyu kemmo na ḿbedu na ntu bɔni mɔɔgbá momoomo mmɔ bɔɔyɔ́ butiku-mi.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: Lɛ́ɛkpali lɛ́nɔ na ɔkwɛ ɔ́kwii-mi. Na anumi aanwú-mi ɔni na líinye mɔɔnu-ɔ anumi taanɔ.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: Na mina bekisine bani muukisi-mi keeke bemomo betulo mina lili linwini. Na bani mɔɔwia-mi ngba bayila lɛnɔ bebo ɔkplu, na ɔkɔ ala sɔɔn na baasu taasiku-mi lɛlɔ. Na béƒie-mi ala ani na ɔɔɔdi buyu na líyu-nya baƒɔ-mi kudɔ.

english_verse: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, agyi alaekpidi ani na lɛ́bla na kɔdɔlɔ kemmo lɛ́ƒiɔ-ɔ, na átabɛ-ɔ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, ruler of Israel, don't let me embarrass anyone who trusts and worships you.
translation_verse: O Israelƒuɔ Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui, taya na kɔƒa kukpo bekyuli bani na bana anu asia-a lɛlɔ na ami ɔsu.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Ɔsika awɔ ɔsu na bekyuli beedumi-mi na kɔƒa kɔ́ƒɔ-mi anumi.

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: Línwini ɔƒɔ na ami ɔlati bekyuli akɔ. Na mina benibi baanu-mi sɛsɛɛ.

english_verse: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
translation_verse: Ƒula ɔtɔ lɛlɔ bɔnu anumi adubo-mi bugyie aani ogya ɔni mɔɔda na mina lɛlɔ kemmo. Na edumi ani na bekyuli bédumi-ɔ ni, ana ƒui ébo ábasia-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na línyimi kenye na muuwulo na líboku lɛlɔ kalɔ líte-ɔ ni, bekyuli bákɛ-mi lɛlɔ edumi.

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: Na ka líni mina ɔlɔna adala abuni na línyimi adikpi ni, línwini lɛmala líte-ma.

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Mina lɛlɔ litemi kani na litemi batɛne ku benengu bada baasu.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Nsu ami ni, awɔ kani mɔɔkpali teevele, O Unwoti. Na uwi ɔni na awɔ ɔlati ánu ka ɔ́manku ni, enu-mi bɔkpali na ƒula lɛƒɔndia bonwu kemmo. Na ka aadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ na eebunku ukyuli ɔsu ni,

english_verse: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
translation_verse: die-mi ngba lɛku lɛba bonwu lɛmɛni kemmo. Na edie-mi na mina bekisine enu kemmo na ketu keleƒie-mi.

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Taya na ketu keyi kavi-mi lili na ligyu lɛmmɔ lɛnyina-mi, iye liduo kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: O mina Unwoti, nu-mi bɔkpali na kalɛ na aayɔ́ bekyuli uwi ndi uwi na aanu kɔnyana pii lɛnɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Teti ƒula lɛlɔ tabɛla ami ƒula kabla ɔblane, ɔsika nkya lɛbibo bonwu kemmo. Anwuɔsu yile-mi bubebunku.

english_verse: Come and save me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Ni de-mi, na aƒɔ ete-mi na lɛkɛ bɔnwuna lɛsiku mina bekisine enu kemmo!

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: Awɔ ɔlati agyi kalɛ na beedumi-mi na baakya-mi kɔƒa na nsɔ ntaƒɔ kuye kɔdi na bekyuli anumi. Na agyi mina bekisine ƒui.

english_verse: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
translation_verse: Edumi émo-mi na kayi kaakpulu-mi, na nsɔ liiibo lɛnunsia lɛdi. Lɛ́nu ulu ka ukyuli ɔdi wabanu-mi kɔnyana, nsu keeke. Na lɛ́nu ulu ka ukyuli ɔdi ubasia-mi kɔnu, nsu anwu lɛnɔ keeke.

english_verse: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
translation_verse: Béti likpila béte-mi banii adila. Na béti ntɛ bɔnani béte-mi banii ndu utukwɛ.

english_verse: Make their table a trap for them and their friends.
translation_verse: Ya na bana limeyi kadikɔ kani báklibi bése kenwini kubu kubi-ma lɛlɔ na betulo na bebuli beduo ɔgbankpi kemmo.

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: Ya na ƒula kɔnyi kubo-ma lɛlɔ. Na bebo abi na kalɛ na éti kɔnyi ákya-ma kenye.

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Bɛsia bana liku kɔnu bise, na ɔdi biala utelie mmɔ.

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni na áani kɔtu ni, ama basɔ benye beekpóku-nwu. Na alɛbi ani na ɔ́ƒɔ ku ɔlɛ ɔni na uunú únwini-ma agyolo na baatu taama.

english_verse: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.
translation_verse: Ya na bebo abi basia kama, na batakɛ ƒula bɔƒɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
translation_verse: Nine bana anyi die ƒula ngba ɔku kemmo. Na taƒɔ-ma takya ƒula bekyuli babuni akɔ.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: O Katɔti, kɔliku-mi tényene kesii kani na lɛkɛ bɔnwuna na aƒɔ-mi, ɔsika muubó abi na lɛ́yila lɛnunsia ƒui.

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Ndubudie ɔnu limwi Katɔti, na lɛgya-nwu enu, na libo-nwu kudu lite kadi ƒui kalɛ na ubo ɔyikun.

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔƒɔ-nwu anu utulo ka liti bebuo iye akɔ ku ese kangya lɛkpa lite-nwu.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Na si bekyuli bani muubó abi na bekyuli enu kemmo bánu ɔmɛni ni, kubiti kɔdubɔda-ma.

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti uunú bawabane bɔkpali na ulédie nwuna badi atu na basɔ bakya lɛbibo kemmo.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Katɔ ku kalɔ ala ƒui bimwi Katɔti, ku ɛpu ku ala ani ƒui nkya-nwu kemmo.

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ Sion na ɔsɔku Yuda lɛma linengudi lɛmmɔ ƒui ɔtu. Na nwuna kabla bablane ƒui badubɔkya mmɔ na beti mmɔ benwini bana ɔdi.

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: Nwuna kabla bablane bebi ndubo mmɔ buti bɔbla bana ɔdi. Na bani mɔɔyɔ́-nwu lɛnyi ƒui badubulie ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Katɔti, tetu uwi buvele bo bedie-mi, O Unwoti, yile bubo na ekpo ete-mi.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔwia-mi badu ni, kɔƒa kukpo-ma na babla susuusu. Na bani ƒui mɔɔwia ka babla-mi kalala ni, bɔku-ma na benwini-mi kama.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Na bani mɔɔsu banii útakɛ-mi ni, ya na kɔƒa kɔdi-ma lɛlɔ na babla gyugyuugyu.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔwia-a kama ulu ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma si bánu-ɔ na ebiti ada-ma. Na bani mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ngba bɔƒɔ basu uwi ndi uwi banini, “Bemwi Katɔti Lɛnyi.”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Na ami amu ni, ɔwabane na ndi na mɔɔyáki ala pii. Anwuɔsu yile-mi kudɔ bubo, O Katɔti! Awɔ muubunku-mi na aaƒɔ́-mi. Unwoti, tetu uwi!

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Katɔti, tetu uwi buvele bo bedie-mi, O Unwoti, yile bubo na ekpo ete-mi.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔwia-mi badu ni, kɔƒa kukpo-ma na babla susuusu. Na bani ƒui mɔɔwia ka babla-mi kalala ni, bɔku-ma na benwini-mi kama.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Na bani mɔɔsu banii útakɛ-mi ni, ya na kɔƒa kɔdi-ma lɛlɔ na babla gyugyuugyu.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔwia-a kama ulu ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma si bánu-ɔ na ebiti ada-ma. Na bani mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ngba bɔƒɔ basu uwi ndi uwi banini, “Bemwi Katɔti Lɛnyi.”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Na ami amu ni, ɔwabane na ndi na mɔɔyáki ala pii. Anwuɔsu yile-mi kudɔ bubo, O Katɔti! Awɔ muubunku-mi na aaƒɔ́-mi. Unwoti, tetu uwi!

english_verse: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Unwoti, awɔ na líkeli ḿbatamiku. Taya na linwini ku kɔƒa uwi ƒui!

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ka ese siin ɔsu ni, die-mi na enu-mi buvele na aƒɔ-mi.

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: Nwini mina katamikukɔ lɛtakpɛ bonwu lɛni lɛlɔ na ndubukpo kama. Na aƒɔ-mi, ɔsika enye kpakplaa uwi ndi uwi ka aƒɔ-mi.
