english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: O Katɔti, die-mi na balalane ku belikplune ku bani na baládi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ enu kemmo.

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔ́si mina lɛnamu uwi ƒui ni, Unwoti, ƒula lɛlɔ na mina anu asia na líti mina ala ƒui lɛ́kya-a enu kemmo.

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si ɔni na báwɔ-mi ni, ƒula lɛlɔ na lɛ́kada líkpo. Na awɔ nédie-mi álɛku mina uni kaƒɔ kemmo. Na awɔ na ndubo buteemwi uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: Lɛ́ta línwini ukyuli ɔni na bekyuli pii baanu teedie lili nsu awɔ mɔɔgyumana-mi.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: Muumwi-ɔ na mɔɔkɔliku-ɔ katɔ taatina kalɛ na ƒula lɛgadi liikeye.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: Tedie-mi atu si uwi ɔni na lɛ́bi lɛlɔ. Na si mina ɔyikun ɔɔsá ni, tanyonu-mi.

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: Na baasu banini, “Katɔti údie-nwu atu, anwuɔsu bɛya bɔbi bɔsiaku-nwu na buƒie-nwu, ɔsika ɔsɔ uuubo ukyuli ɔdi na waƒɔ-nwu.”

english_verse: Come closer, God! Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, tagyunku-mi, mmomu yile-mi bubebunku.

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔwia-mi babla kalala na badu-mi ni, kɔƒa kukpo-ma na babla susuusu.

english_verse: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
translation_verse: Nsu ami ni, ƒula lɛlɔ kani na ndubɔsia anu uwi ndi uwi. Na ndubumwi-ɔ libu ƒui.

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: Ndubɔka lɛsu bekyuli mina ngba emeyi kemmo ƒui kalɛ na aabla ala siin na aaƒɔ́ bekyuli na lɛƒɔndia lɛmmɔ liiibo lɛkala.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, ndubumwi-ɔ na ƒula ablala enengudi ɔsu. Na lɛsu bekyuli kalɛ na aabla-bu lɛƒɔndia lɛni udu nsɔ neeebo kesii bamba.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, awɔ mɔɔtina-mi ala ɔ́si lɛnamu uwi ƒui. Na ńtada ƒula akɔla ala budie taatina kudu bubo ńtaya.

english_verse: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
translation_verse: Ina lɛ́bi na lili lɛ́ƒuala-mi muedi ni, tedie-mi atu wetédu ka lɛ́ya na kaba bekyuli bani mebo kama báti ɔyikun ala ani na ábla.

english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: Na banu bati kalɛ na ébomo na ese siin aani kalɛ na baanu ka kayaa kébomo kalɛ. Ábla ala ebendi, na ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo ƒula kalɛ.

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: Aya na líbo abi geen na ala ékpoku-mi, nsu awɔ kani ndubudie-mi na lɛlɛ kesii kani nkya aani ubu kemmo na naaasɔ naaakya mmɔ. Mmomu adubɔya na lɛsɔ lɛlɛ libo mbelie kanwaadikɔ na lɛsɔ lɛkɛ ɔyikun.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: Na adubɔya na lɛsɔ lɛƒɔ lɛnyi litulo kudeedi na ayala-mi kaƒɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, ndubɔgya ɔbentaa limwi-ɔ, ɔsika aabla ala ƒui ulu lɛlɔ. Na lidie bumwi lɛnu lite awɔ, Israel Katɔti Kedee.

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Awɔ nédie-mi, anwuɔsu ndububo kudu ku lɛlɔyɔ na lidie ɔnu ku mina kaƒɔ ƒui limwi-ɔ.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔsu uwi ndi uwi kalɛ na ese siin na édie-mi ku ƒula ɔyikun. Ɔsika bekyuli bani ƒui nákali ka babla-mi kalala ni, éboku-ma kalɔ na kɔƒa kúkpo-ma.

english_verse: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, tina ƒula ɔga kalɛ na ɔtɛ litemi ɔsiaku ƒula ulu siin lɛlɔ kalɛ kani na awɔ aabla.

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: Na ɔtɛ ƒula kadi bekyuli etemila na ulu siin lɛlɔ. Na ɔdi litemi geen lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ute bekyuli bani nse kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: Na unye kpakplaa ute bawabane na ubunku bani mɔɔyaki ala na ɔyila bani mɔɔnya bekyuli taakya ulikplu kemmo udu!

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: Na aya na ƒula ɔga bekyuli bɔtɔnku bɔbla aani kalɛ na ɔnantu ɔɔna teewi kemmo edula lɛlɔ iye uuwi na kalɔ kaayɔ́.

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Ya na ala bɔbla siin bɔƒɔ kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ na nwuna lɛga bɔdi butu uwi. Na atu bɔyɔ ku keyi buɛɛ kaƒɔ-bu akɔ wetédu ka kɔbuli kɔ́da bɔtu teewi-bu lɛlɔ kɔ́ya.

english_verse: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
translation_verse: Ɔdi lɛlɔ ɔsi ɛpu ɔvi unwi útédu ɔkladi. Na ɔsi Euƒrate Ketu bonwu kɔtu útédu kalɔ kesii biala.

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nli kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ ƒui badubo babakya lili kalɔ bete-nwu na ɔdi-ma lɛlɔ. Na nwuna bekisine ƒui bayu bebi kalɔ na ɔtumu akɔ na nwuna anumi.

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Tarsis ɔga ku ntuntɛ kɔlɔ baga ƒui bataaƒɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi kayu teete ƒula ɔga. Na Sieba ku Seba baga lɛnɔ beti etela beboku ɔga ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Na baga ƒui bakya lili kalɔ bete-nwu. Na kadi ƒui babla-nwu kabla.

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: Ɔsika uudie bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔyaki lɛla lɛdi na bana lɛbibo kemmo ku bani nse kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ku bani neeebo bebunkune.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: Ɔɔnu bani nse kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ kɔnyana na uudie bana ngba na ɔgbankpi kemmo.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: Na bani na beekpóku na baanya-ma taakya ni, uudie bana ngba na lɛbibo ku kukpi kemmo.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: Ya na Ɔga ulie ngba gyɔlɔɔ na beti sika ugyiedi basiku Seba beboku-nwu. Na bekyuli bataakpali Katɔti uwi ndi uwi na nwuna lili. Na beteete-nwu kusɛ kusɛ limeyi ndi limeyi.

english_verse: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
translation_verse: Ya na kalɔ kammɔ kadia edula pii. Na edula ammɔ aƒɔ abi lɛlɔ. Na adingyii ammɔ alɛ lili abla aani Lebanon lɛku egyii. Na bekyuli bemomo na lɛma linengudi lɛmmɔ kemmo aani kalɛ na livo lɛɛƒɔ́ kemo.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Ya na ƒula ɔga ɔƒɔ lɛnyi na lisie ɔgyu lɛkya bekyuli akɔ uwi ƒui kalɛ kani na ɔƒɛ ɔɔtu teekeye. Ala atɛnku kadi ƒui bekyuli na beteete ɔga kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Bimwi Unwoti Israel Katɔti, ɔsika anwu kani mɔɔbla akɔla ala budie taatina amɛni udu.

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Bemwi-nwu lɛnyi lɛni muukeye úsela uwi ƒui. Na nwuna bukeye bɔƒɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui. Ɔsia lɛni! Na ɔsɔ ɔsia lɛni!

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: Lɛni na Yese ubidi Ɔga Dawid ɔ́wɔlɔ Katɔti bɔkpali.

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Geen geen ni, Katɔti ubo lɛƒɔndia ute Israel kadi bekyuli bani nse sɛɛn na bana kayi kemmo.

english_verse: But I almost stumbled and fell,
translation_verse: Nsu ami ni, lɛ́ya bugyiile bubuli.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: Ɔsika anumi égyie-mi na bekyuli bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ ku bani na bebo kalala lɛlɔ ka ala aatɛku-ma ɔsu.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: Belebo abi adi, anwuɔsu bebo ɔlɔkplu na lɛla lɛdi lilekpoku-ma.

english_verse: and they don't have troubles like everyone else.
translation_verse: Ɔgbankpi ɔdi ulasiaku-ma aani bekyuli bamba.

english_verse: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu baakun lɛmɛnɛ na baatina lɛlɔ. Na kalɛ baatú bekyuli na baanu-ma anumi únwini awu na bakya.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Anumi élie-ma lɛmwi na alaekpidi kabla ku kasusu káƒɔ-ma kayi kemmo. Na likpidi kɔkwɛ sɔɔn na baakya.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: Baamá bekyuli na baanu-ma kalɔ kalɔ na baanya-ma taakya.

english_verse: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.
translation_verse: Baatɛmi enyekpi na Katɔti lɛlɔ na baabɔku bekyuli taavinku kalɛ kalɛ na kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu Katɔti bekyuli bammɔ lɛnɔ beenwíni teewi na balánu bana bɔƒiɔ taati mmomu baaƒɔ́ lɛla lɛni na básu mmɔ aani litemi geen.

english_verse: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
translation_verse: Na baabla ɔtɔtɔ ukpidi taasu ka Katɔti ɔɔɔdubo ala ani baabla bɔnu bɔti.

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Na lɛni geen na belikplune bamɛni bese. Bebo ala pii, nsu bétemo tɔ na baawia abambadi teebu.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Na kalɛ mɔɔkya ɔkplu nnii mɔɔbla lɛlɔ sɛɛn kalɛ na naaabla likpidi ni, keeke na ami mɔɔbla ɔmɛni.

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, enye aanu na muubó abi limeyi limodi. Na aaní-mi kɔtu ɔtanta biala.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Si enyekpi ammɔ udu na mɔɔtɛmi ni, na naaabla ala aani ƒula bekyuli akɔ unwi.

english_verse: It was hard for me to understand all this!
translation_verse: Na muuti kasusu na lɛla lɛmɛni lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi, nsu neeenu-ni kalɔ

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: úti útédu ka líduo ƒula kakpakɔ kedee kemmo. Mmɔ na ntánu lɛ́ti lɛla lɛni ndubo balalane bammɔ bɔbla.

english_verse: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Adubo-ma buti buse kesii kani na kegyiile na begyiile betéduo kesii kani na badubɔyii udu.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Liƒu ala bonwu aadá taalɛ bekyuli bammɔ udu lɛlɔ na baayii kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.
translation_verse: Na bana uwi use aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔtɛ teegye kɔna na si ɔ́ta ni, ɔ́sa lɛla biala lɛ́vi.

english_verse: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni návi ni, ntaanu ala amɛni na éteekpoku-mi na aatu-mi kayi.

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: Nsu kɔdɔlɔ ku lɛla tati ala na lɛ́bla. Na lílieku ebuo na ƒula anumi.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: Nsu ina amu ni, nsiaku-ɔ kama uwi ndi uwi na ada-mi kɔnu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: Awɔ mɔɔtɔnku-mi ɔkɛnku kasusu kani na aakya-mi kemmo. Na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, adubɔƒɔ-mi na liduo ƒula bukeye kemmo.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: Liiibo ukyuli bamba ɔdi na katɔ liiitulo awɔ. Na lɛla lɛdi lɛnɔ liiibo kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ na mɔɔwia teetulo awɔ.

english_verse: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
translation_verse: Mina kasusu ku ɔlɔna ɔdubɔyuɛ, nsu Katɔti ndi mina ɔyikun na anwu kani ndi lɛla lɛni na mɔɔwia uwi ƒui.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔlɛ́-ɔ kama ni, ɔkɔ uuubo-nwu kemmo ka badubo bɔyii ku udu.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Nsu ami ni, ɔdia ute-mi geen ka lɛ́ni líde Katɔti. Na ndubɔkɛ katamikukɔ na Ɔyikune Ƒui Katɔti kudɔ. Na libo ala ani ƒui na ɔ́bla kudu lite bekyuli.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: O Katɔti, bi ɔsu na éni-bu ƒui lɛni? Na éti ƒula kɔnyi ákya abu bani na ada aani baƒonu lɛni?

english_verse: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
translation_verse: Tayiƒala ƒula kadi bekyuli bani na awɔ ɔlati áƒuna na édie-ma ése aani kaba bekyuli bani ndubɔdi ƒula ala. Kali nu Sion Kɔbi kesii kani na ábla na ɔdi ƒula keliekɔ dii.

english_verse: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
translation_verse: Bo na abanu ala ani ƒui na bekisine bébile na áyii udu na ƒula kakpakɔ.

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: Bekisine béduo ƒula keliekɔ kedee na benye mmɔ baayoli momoomo. Na bábla ekposela bényene mmɔ baatina ka bádi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
translation_verse: Na benye beebile ala aani egyii ɔdane ɔni nda kadadi ɔɔƒɛ egyii teewi kalɔ.

english_verse: They burned down your temple and badly disgraced it.
translation_verse: Na bákyula ƒula kakpakɔ kammɔ ƒui. Na bébile kesii kani na eelie mmɔ ekisila.

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: Básu lɛnɔ ka badubo-bu bususu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ na bɔyii udu. Na kesii kani na aasála-bu na ƒula anumi ni, bákyula mmɔ bene ƒui na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Na bɔsɔ bulánu akɔla ala budie taatina adi, na ƒula kenye bediene badi lɛnɔ basɔ beeebo. Na bula akɔ ɔdi ɔɔɔgyi uwi ɛlɛ ɔni na ɔmɛni ɔdubuse lɛni utédu.

english_verse: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
translation_verse: Katɔti, adubunye ataanu na bula bekisine bataama-a na beteebile-ɔ lɛnyi uwi ƒui?

english_verse: Why don't you punish them? Why are you holding back?
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na éni anii alani-ma kɔtu na éti enu ákya lɛgba akɔ.

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Katɔti, awɔ ndi bula ɔga ɔ́si kukuuku ƒui na awɔ kani mɔɔƒɔ́ teete-bu uwi ndi uwi na kalɔ mɛni kesi kesii.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: Awɔ náya na ɛpu úle lɛlɔ akpa anyɔ ku ƒula ɔyikun. Na ketu kemmo beƒiebuo bammɔ ƒui ábwɛ-ma eli.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Na liƒu kebweyi kani nkya ɛpu kemmo na ubo kɔlakpi udu mmɔ ni, ábwɛ-nwu lili na éti nwuna lɛna éte bebuo bamba bani nkya kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo aani bana lɛdila.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: Áya na abiɔ ku ntukpa ƒui bɔ́ƒɔ ntu na bɔɔgbá. Na ntukpa bonwu bɔ́kwii.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Awɔ nédie usien ku ɔƒɛ. Na áya na ɔƒɛ ku kɔbuli benye bana kunyekɔ.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Na ásia kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛmii. Na ábla ewulu ku kɔyɔ uwi.

english_verse: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, kali nu kalɛ na bekisine badɔlɔdi bamɛni baama-a na baalɔ-ɔ lɛnyikpi.

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Tanyonu ƒula kadi bekyuli bani na ada aani abloduma ɔni na aláƒianku takya bekisine enu kemmo na bunwini adila bute-ma baduli aani beƒiebuo.

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Tayiƒala bunyimi bɔni na ényimiku-bu. Ɔsika balalane bábɛ bákya kesi kesii ka bekpoku-bu.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Taya na kɔƒa kukpo bekyuli bani na baanya taakya ku lɛbibo. Mmomu ya na bawabane bammɔ ku bani mɔɔyáki ala mmɔ bemwi-ɔ.

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, ta na edie lɛlɔ kenye na bekyuli benu. Na tayiƒala kalɛ na badɔlɔdi bamɛni baamá-a uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Don't forget the loud shouts of your enemies.
translation_verse: Nwini nu kalɛ na ƒula bekisine baakwanyi ku kɔnyi na bana kudu kɔda momoomo ƒui.

english_verse: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Bɔɔgyá-a enu, O Katɔti, na buumwi-ɔ, ɔsika ede-bu! Na bɔɔká ƒula akɔla ala budie taatina taasu bekyuli.

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: Na ndubɔsu bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ mmɔ ka bada bana lɛmɛnɛ bɔkun baya.

english_verse: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
translation_verse: Na lɛya na bada lɛlɔ katɔ bɔkɔliku baya.”

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Litemi ɔtɛne ɔdi ɔɔɔdubo bɔsi ɔƒɛ katukɔ iye kanukɔ. Na ɔdi lɛnɔ ulási kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ ulebo.

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: Mmomu Katɔti ɔmmɔ ɔlati ndubɔtɛ litemi na ɔkɔliku badi katɔ na uboku badi kalɔ.

english_verse: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti ɔdubɔda ntɛ bɔni na básala ku ala bamba ɔɔƒɛɛ keyile bɔni na nwuna kɔnyi kɔ́ya na buuƒuƒuo. Na Katɔti ɔdubo ntɛ bɔmmɔ buwilimi bute balalane na kayawi ƒui na bani utédu eku.

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Nsu ami ni, lɛɛɛdubo ebiti bɔda bɔkɛ bɔya. Mmomu ndubudie bumwi lɛnu lite Katɔti ɔni na bula nana Yakob ɔ́kpa.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: Na ɔdububile balalane ɔyikun ƒui. Na bekyuli bani na bese siin ni, bana ɔyikun ɔdubɔkɔ katɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: Yudaƒuɔ bagyi Katɔti geen na bana kalɔ. Na Israelƒuɔ baasu kalɛ na Katɔti ubo ɔyikun.

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla nwuna keliekɔ na Yerusalem na Sion Kɔbi lili.

english_verse: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́ƒɛ bekisine bammɔ atula ku abuala kɔlɛkɛ ku kuwii ku bana ekpola ƒui.

english_verse: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
translation_verse: Éƒie bekpone bayikune ekpola aƒɔ. Na bekpone bammɔ alati békpi ƒui ɔni na basɔ balakana lɛla lɛdi bɔbla.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔni na bula nana Yakob ɔ́kpa, uwi ɔni na ákwanyiku-ma ni, bekpone bammɔ ku bana bapɔnkɔ ku kɛɛkɛ ƒui bébuli na bágyini batɛ kpoo.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ƒula lɛlɔ kani mbo liƒu na ɔdi ulakana-a anumi bunye si éti kɔnyi.

english_verse: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
translation_verse: Ébo ƒula litemi bɔtɛ kudu ásiku ƒula keliekɔ na katɔ. Na liƒu lɛ́da kalɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli na bébile kenye kpoo

english_verse: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
translation_verse: uwi ɔni na awɔ Katɔti áta anii aatɛ litemi na edie bani na ala eekpóku.

english_verse: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
translation_verse: Geen geen ni, kɔnyi kati kati kɔni na bekyuli bákɛ kɔdubunwini enugya ku bumwi ute-ɔ. Na si éti kɔnyi muedi ákya-ma ni, badubumwi-ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Bise Katɔti kenye, na bɛbla bɛsiaku lɛni kani. Na amii kadi bekyuli bani na amadɔ ƒui biti bina etela biboku Katɔti ɔni kani na ɔlɛka bayia ku ɔbu.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: Uuboku bagabi bani mɔɔkɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ kalɔ. Na ɔɔyá na baga benengudi ƒui baayia-nwu.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: Líwulo lɛ́kpali Katɔti momoomo kalɛ na ubunku-mi.

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na muubó abi ni, lɛ́kpali-nwu. Na usien umodi ƒui lɛ́kɔliku enu katɔ na mɔɔkpali-nwu, na neeete kuƒi kɔdi.

english_verse: When I think of you, I feel restless and weak.
translation_verse: Mina kasusu kasia Katɔti lɛlɔ na muudumo taakpali-nwu na mɔɔva momoomo ɔni na mina ɔyikun ɔ́sa na lɛ́bla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: Áya na mina anumi ewi usien umodi na naaakana bɔlɛɛ. Na kayi kaakpulu-mi geen ɔni na naaakana na lɛtɛmi muedi.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: Mɔɔkali taanu kuuku uwi akwa akwa ani návi mmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Each night my mind is flooded with questions:
translation_verse: Kasusu kani na muulie teeti usien umodi. Na muuye lɛlɔ ala pii nnini,

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: “Buni na Katɔti úni-bu uwi ƒui na kaƒɔ kasɔ kaaadubo-nwu bɔyɔ na bula lɛlɔ?

english_verse: Is this the end of your love and your promises?
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi mmɔ lɛnɔ kenye kékulo? Munuu nwuna kenye kani na úse lɛnɔ kása?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Bɔyiƒala na Katɔti ɔ́yiƒala kalɛ na ɔnu-bu kɔnyana na nwuna kɔnyi kɔ́ƒɔ nwuna lɛƒɔndia kenye?

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: Ndubɔkali Unwoti ablala lɛnu. Na geen geen ni, ndubunyimo ƒula akɔla budie taatina ani na ábla kuuku uwi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.
translation_verse: Mina kasusu kadubɔsia ƒula ablala lɛlɔ na nteeduo ala ebendi ani na ábla kemmo taanu.

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: Katɔti, ƒula kasiakɔ ƒui kese kedee. Na beleti baƒiɔ badi balákɔku-ɔ.

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔni mɔɔbla akɔla ala budie taatina na adi. Na édie ƒula ɔyikun keyi átina na bekyuli bammɔ bánu.

english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: Na awɔ ɔlati néti ƒula kɔnu na édie abu ƒula kadi bekyuli bani ndi Yakob ku Yoseƒ bebi.

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na áda álɛ ni, ntu bɔmmɔ bɔ́nwanɛ lɛlɔ ku liƒu útálɛ ligyu kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Na ntu bɔɔyu taasi ulɔyɔ ɔni nkya kayaa mmɔ kemmo. Na kayaa keedu na kaabwɛ ogya na uudie atula teesienku lɛƒɛnyi ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Kayaa budu bɔmmɔ bɔɔlɛ́ taasi ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔni mɔɔkya ligede kemmo. Na kalɛ na kayaa kaabwɛ ogya ni, uukeye teewi kayawi ƒui. Na kalɔ kemodi kaakunku momoomo.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: Édie ulu ávinku ɛpu kemmo na ƒula kasiakɔ kakɛ ketu bonwu kammɔ kemmo kalɛ. Nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui ni, ukyuli ɔyawine útanu-ɔ lɛgba kanyakɔ.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: Áƒuna Mose ku Aaron na bátɔnku ƒula kadi bekyuli aani baƒonu ɔdane kalɛ ɔkɛnku ƒula ɔyikun lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
translation_verse: Bise atu na binu ala ani mɔɔtina-mii, bula kadi bekyuli.

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: Agba kemmo na ndubuti lidie ala abɛdi ani nébo ábavi kalɔ lite-mii.

english_verse: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɔɔɔdubo-nya buti bɔbɛla bana bebi. Mmomu bɔdubudie Katɔti ablala ani muukeye ku kalɛ na ubo ɔyikun keyi bute kaba kemmo bebi bani ndubo. Na bɔsu-ma akɔla ala budie taatina ani na ɔ́bla.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: Úti ɔda bubo úte Yakob kaba kemmo bebi Israel bekyuli. Na ɔ́su bula bati kuuku ɔnii beti batina bana bebi.

english_verse: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.
translation_verse: Si bábla ɔmɛni ni, badubuti bana anu ƒui basia Katɔti lɛlɔ na balayiƒala ala ani na ɔ́bla, mmomu na badi nwuna ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: Eƒraim kadi bekpone bátu akpagya báwɔlɔ na bada bana kɔtaminta ku atula, nsu bénwini kama na békeli kekpo na bana bekisine kudɔ.

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: Bátadi lɛla lɛni na Katɔti únyimiku-ma lɛlɔ. Na bétenu kalɔ ka basia ulu ɔni na Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔ́tina-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
translation_verse: Ala ani na Katɔti ɔ́bla ku nwuna akɔla ala budie taatina ni, báyiƒala-nya.

english_verse: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
translation_verse: Úle ɛpu ɔmmɔ kemmo na ɔ́ya nwuna bekyuli básia bálɛ uwi ɔni na ntu bɔmmɔ bunye aani kɔbi na ɔvi ɔni ku ɔni.

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Kadi nwaa ni, ɔ́ya na ulɔyɔ lisu bonwu lɛ́tɔnku-ma. Na usien ni, ogya unyemi bukeye bonwu bɔdi nátɔnku-ma.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na ntu bɔ́bwɛ bɔlɛ atakpɛ kemmo na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ na báni na údu-ma ɔkwɛ aani si abiɔ na adi.

english_verse: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na ntukpa bɔ́lɛ bɔ́si atakpɛ kemmo na bɔɔgbá aani ketu geen.

english_verse: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui kama ni, bɔƒiɔ kani na báƒiɔ Katɔti bébu. Na báta bénye Katɔti Ɔyikune ƒui lɛlɔ na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: Békpoku Katɔti lilu pii lɛlɔ na béye-nwu banii ute-ma adila ani na ama baayɔ́.

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: Bátɛmi enyenkpi bákya Katɔti na béye muedi banini, “Katɔti ɔdubɔkana na ute-bu adila na bɔdi na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mɛni?”

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: Nsu sɔsɔ ni, ɔ́ya na báƒiɛmi lɛtakpɛ ugyii na ntu bɔɔtu taalɛ na bɔɔgbá aani ketu. Ɔmɛni ƒui kama ni, básɔ béye banini, “Na adila nɔɔ? Ɔdubɔkana-bu adi bute ku lɛna?”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni ƒui áya na livo líƒi Katɔti ka únu-nya. Anwuɔsu ɔ́ya na ogya úbo úbakyula-ma na katɔ kani na nwuna kɔnyi kɔɔkɔ́ teebu na bana lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni úbo lɛni, ɔsika bátaƒɔ-nwu bátadi na béteti kayi bátasia-nwu lɛlɔ lɛnɔ ka ɔdubɔkana na ɔƒɔ-ma ɔsu.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui ni, Katɔti údie lɛdi na kayaa kálɛmi aani kayakun kalɛ.

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, Katɔti batu adila na Katɔti úmene-ma pii na bádi bemo.

english_verse: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku nwuna ɔyikun lɛlɔ ni, ɔ́ya na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔ́si katɔ na úkpo ɔ́si ɔƒɛ katukɔ ku kada kakɛ.

english_verse: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ya na baasɛ yuu badi aani ɔtumu kalɛ ɔ́na úbewi kalɔ aani ɛpu kɔnwinimi.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: Na baasɛ bammɔ báyu na bana kɔduli geen na kesii kani báda keliekɔ na beli mmɔ.

english_verse: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
translation_verse: Bádi adila ammɔ na bémo, ɔsika lɛla lɛni geen na baawia na ɔ́bla úte-ma.

english_verse: But before they had swallowed the last bite,
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔni na bamu beli baadi adila ani báwia kpakplaa mmɔ ni,

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: Katɔti úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya-ma geen na ɔ́ya bádu bana bakloƒu bayikune.

english_verse: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na ɔ́ya na ɔgbankpi úbo-ma lɛlɔ na bana ngba bɔ́da liku na búbo kawɔlɔkɔ kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Na uwi biala na ɔ́ya na badi békpi lɛni ni, bakladi baata ku usi na babawia-nwu kama ulu, Na benwini bebo-nwu kudɔ ku bana kayi ƒui.

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: Bényimo ka Katɔti ndi bana katamikukɔ lɛtakpɛ. Na Katɔti Ɔni Ntulo Ƒui ndi bana Ɔƒɔne.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Nsu baabla kenyemini uwi ndi uwi taanyi ɔkɔ taatɔlɔ Katɔti.

english_verse: they were unfaithful and broke their promises.
translation_verse: Balásiaku-nwu kama siin uwi ndi uwi na badi nwuna bunyimi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Ina amu ni, ɔ́nu-ma kɔnyana na úti bana alaekpidi ɔ́kyiɛ-ma na útayila bana ƒui udu. Katɔti uuƒie nwuna kɔnyi kenye pla pla na ulábla ala teetédu kalɛ na úti kɔnyi kenye.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́kali ɔ́nu ka bekyuli keeke kani na bayawine badi na bana uwi use aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni muukpó taabavi mɔɔnwuna taavi na ɔsɔ ulenwini teebo.

english_verse: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni báta bénye-nwu lɛlɔ kɔlɛ kɔlɛ na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ, na báya na kayi kaakpulu-nwu geen.

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Bákɔku-nwu bánu kɔlɛ kɔlɛ na bákya anwu Israel Katɔti ɔni nse kedee ƒui kɔnyi.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Bétenyimo Katɔti ɔyikun ɔni na ubo lɛlɔ iye limeyi lɛni na údie-ma ɔ́lɛku bana bekisine enu kemmo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: Na bétenyimo akɔla ala budie taatina ani na ɔ́bla na Saan kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ na Egyipte kalɔ kemmo.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na bana ntukpa búnwini ubugya ɔni na ntu bɔmmɔ bɔsɔ buládia bɔni.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na kubweyi kɔni muuveyi lidu pii bébekpoku-ma geen ku bapɔtɔlɔ na bébile-ma ala.

english_verse: God let worms and grasshoppers eat their crops.
translation_verse: Na úte kuƒi na baalɔlɔ ku kubweyi kɔni muubile edula bébebile bana edula ƒui.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na etubankɛ ku ɔnantu ɔ́na abɔ abɔ na úbile bana adingyii mmo ƒui.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na katɔ kábwɛ ogya na etubankɛ ána ébewi bana ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku baƒonu ku bese lɛlɔ na békpi báyii udu.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́ya nwuna kɔnyi kúbo Egyipte kadi bekyuli lɛlɔ kpakplaa ɔkɛnku nwuna batu bani na údie ulu ka bani bekyuli kɔtu kɔmɛni udu.

english_verse: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya bana kaƒɔ bebi bananabi bedeedi ƒui békpi na kaduli biala kemmo na Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Katɔti ɔ́kpanku nwuna kadi bekyuli ɔ́lɛku mmɔ na ɔ́tɔnku-ma aani baƒonu ɔdane kalɛ ɔ́siaku kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́tɔnku-ma ɔni na lɛla lɛdi lítabla-ma na liƒu lɛdi lɛnɔ lítada-ma. Na bana bekisine ama ni, ɛpu ɔmmɔ ɔ́nyina-ma ƒui.

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu úti-ma úboku nwuna kalɔ kedee kemmo na kɔbi kɔni lɛlɔ na ɔ́di mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: Ɔ́bɔku kadi bamba bekyuli ɔ́lɛku bana anumi. Na úti bana kɔlɔ ku kuliekɔ úle úte-ma aani bana kadikɔ na bélie mmɔ.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui kama ni, bákɔku Ɔyikune Ƒui bánu na báta bénye-nwu lɛlɔ na bátadi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
translation_verse: Mmomu bálɛ-nwu kama aani bana bati kani na bese aani kataminta kani nélii.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bákya-nwu kɔnyi geen na baƒiɔ akpabi ani na bátu bényene abi eli ɔsu. Na báya na uukpó kogyulo ka baakpá-ma.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́nu mɛni ɔ́ya na úni nwuna kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ kede kede ƒui na kɔnyi kpakplaa kemmo.

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: Na ka úni Silo kevo kani kemmo na uli na bula akɔ ni,

english_verse: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́ya na bekisine béti Bunyimi Adaka ɔni muudie nwuna ɔyikun ku kalɛ na uukeye keyi bátɔlɔku.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku kɔnyi kpakplaa kɔni na úti ɔ́kya-ma mmɔ ɔsu ni, ɔ́ya na bekisine bammɔ bádu nwuna kadi bekyuli baƒunadi bammɔ ku kuwii.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: Ogya ɔ́kyula bana bakloƒu ɔni na bana belekubi basɔ bátakɛ agya na belie.

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na bana bakpane lɛnɔ ni, kuwii kenye na békpi ɔni na bétete bana bekpinele kuƒi na bewulo-ma.

english_verse: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti úbata únye aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔta na kalɛɛkɔ. Na ɔ́bla aani kalɛ na ntɛ bɔɔyá na ɔyikune ɔdi ɔɔta taabla ala.

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́bɔku nwuna bekisine ɔ́lɛku nwuna anumi. Na ɔ́di-ma lɛlɔ na kɔƒa kúkpo-ma uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: Nsu Yoseƒ kaba kemmo bebi ni, Katɔti úni-ma. Na útaƒuna Eƒraim kaba lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: Mmomu Yuda kaba na ɔ́ƒuna ku Sion Kɔbi kɔni lɛlɔ mɔɔda-nwu ebiti geen.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́tu nwuna kakpakɔ kede únyene na kákuku aani abi. Na ɔ́tu-ka na kenye kalɔ kpi aani kayawi kamɛni kalɛ. Na kadubunye uwi ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔƒuna Ɔga Dawid ka unwini nwuna kabla ɔblane na ɔda baƒonu lɛlɔ bɔnu ɔya,

english_verse: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
translation_verse: na ubataanu Yakob kaba bebi bani ndi Israel nwuna bekyuli baƒunadi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
translation_verse: Ɔga Dawid úti nwuna kayi ku ɔyikun ƒui ɔ́tɔnku bekyuli bammɔ ɔ́siaku ulu siin lɛlɔ na lɛnunda ku lɛlati kemmo.

english_verse: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, kadi bamba bekyuli bébo bébeduo ƒula kalɔ kemmo. Na bébile ƒula kakpakɔ kedee kammɔ ekisila na bábwɛ Yerusalem ɔma.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: Na báda ƒula kadi bekyuli ɔlɔna béwi na begbini ku beƒiebuo bamba lɛnɔ baaduli teebweli.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: Na bana ubugya ɔni na beewiakun aani ntu mmɔ ɔ́ƒɔ Yerusalem ɔma ku amadɔ mmɔ ƒui. Na ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo na ɔva bekpine bammɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
translation_verse: O Unwoti, adubuti kɔnyi akya-bu ƒui na ɔ́sa? Na eteekpo-bu lɛlɔ kogyulo lɛni?

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Ya na ƒula kɔnyi kunwini kusie kadi bamba bekyuli bani naagyi-ɔ ku baga bani naaakpali-ɔ lɛnyi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bádu ƒula kadi bekyuli na báyila kalɔ kammɔ udu.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Teti bula bati kuuku ekpidi tani-bu kɔtu. Mmomu bo pla na abanu-bu kɔnyana, ɔsika bɔsɔ buuubo lɛnunsia lɛdi na bɔɔɔgyi lɛla lɛni na bɔbla.

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, bula Ɔƒɔne, bunku-bu. Die-bu ɔgbankpi kemmo. Na eti bula bɔƒiɔ ƒui akyiɛ-bu na ƒula lɛnyi likeye.

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na kadi bamba bekyuli beeye-bu banini, “Wɛ na bina Katɔti ɔkya?” Buuvele-ɔ bɔnii die-ma kasi na kalɛ na béwi ƒula kadi bekyuli ubugya kalɔ kalala kemmo kenye na abu ku bekyuli ƒui bɔnu.

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Nu batɔntɛne edumo. Na edie bani na báadu-ma kukpi kɔtɔ na ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ kemmo ɔkɛnku ƒula ɔyikun bonwu ɔni na ebo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: Unwoti, die kadi bekyuli bamɛni kasi akpa maatɛ na kalɛ na beedumi-ɔ kenye.

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: Na abu ƒula kadi bekyuli bani nse aani ƒula baƒonu na kadikɔ ni, bɔdubɔgya-a enu uwi ndi uwi ɔ́si kaba úsie kaba.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: O baƒonu ɔdane, awɔ ɔni mɔɔtɔnku Israel Yoseƒ kaba kemmo bebi aani baƒonu kalɛ. Eli ƒula lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na ƒula batu bani mbo avwi na baalɔ-ma Kerub eli. Buuvele-ɔ, ya na bɔnu kalɛ na eekeye.

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: Bo abalɛmi Eƒraim ku Benyamin ku Manase adua kemmo bebi anumi, na atina-bu ƒula ɔyikun na aƒɔ-bu.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Sɔku-bu bése bula uwi ɔbuni ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na aƒɛnimi anumi akya-bu na bɔkɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
translation_verse: O Unwoti, kadi ƒui Katɔti, uwi ɛlɛ na adubuti kɔnyi akya-bu na eni-bu bɔkpali etédu?

english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: Keku ndi adila ani na éte-bu. Na mmii ndi ntu bɔni na éte-bu na bɔ́ni na údu-bu ɔkwɛ.

english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: Áya na búnwini bekyuli bani muuboku lɛsɛ na bula liku bekyuli akɔ na basɔ balánu-bu taakya lɛla lɛdi kemmo. Anwuɔsu bɔ́ta búnwini bana lɛmala.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: O Ɔyikune Ƒui Katɔti, sɔku-bu bese bula uwi ɔbuni ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na aƒɛnimi anumi akya-bu na bɔkɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
translation_verse: Buse aani kɔdingyii kɔni na ágyu ásiku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na ábɔku kadi bamba bekyuli álɛku kalɔ kani nwi-bu anumi na éti-bu atálɛ bana kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: Átuma kɔdingyii kɔmɛni kalɔ kalɛ na kɔbi lɛlɔ. Kuna ligyiitu líduo kalɔ kemmo lísie ɔgyu kakaaka na kúdie kɔgba kɔ́ƒɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: Na kɔdingyii kɔmmɔ ɔyuli ɔ́ƒɔ abi ammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui. Na kúbimi kúbi egyii enengudi kpakplaa bamba ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: Kɔ́ta evete na kúdie kɔgba kútédu Mediterenia Ɛpu ku Euƒrate Ketu.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Na bi ɔsu na ɔban ɔni na ágyi ámana-ku ni, ábwɛ-nwu, na ukyuli ndi ukyuli ɔni mɔɔsia mɛni uudie kɔnu na ude egyiibi ammɔ.

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Na babɔtɔ ku beƒiebuo bamba lidu beebo teebesusu egyiibi kemmo kammɔ na baakun ebi ammɔ?

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: O kadi ƒui Katɔti, sɔ nwini nu-bu, siku ƒula keliekɔ kedee na katɔ mmɔ na anu ƒula kugyii kɔmɛni ku lɛƒɔndia.

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: Awɔ ɔlati éti ƒula kɔnu álɛ kugyii kɔmmɔ, na ánu-ku lɛlɔ na kɔ́lɛ lili.

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: Bekisine bámɛnɛ kugyii kɔmɛni béwi kalɔ na bátu ogya bákya-ku. Nsu buuvele-ɔ bɔnii kwanyiku-ma na ƒula kɔnyi kemmo na bayii udu.

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Buuvele-ɔ bɔnii gyumana kadi bekyuli bani na áƒuna éte lɛlɔ na áya na bebo ɔyikun.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Bɔsɔ bulénwini kama bulakya-a lɛnɔ kudii. Ya na bulie ngba na butaakpa-a.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: O Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui, sɔku-bu beese bula uwi ɔbuni ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na aƒɛnimi anumi akya-bu na bɔkɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Bidie lɛnu bimwi Katɔti, ɔni na bula nana Yakob ɔ́kpa. Ɔsika anwu mɔɔyá na bɔɔkɛ́ ɔyikun.

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Bina adi akɔ katɔ. Na bɛgya bina lɛbentaa ku agyala lidu ƒui momoomo bite Katɔti.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Bɛvwi lise na bɛdi limeyi ka kɔbuli kɔwɔdi kɔ́lɛ. Na bɛbla lɛni kani si kɔbuli kúdi libi.

english_verse: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti nébo ɔda ɔmɛni úte Israel kadi bekyuli na ɔdi lɛla lɛni na ɔlɛka Yakob kaba bebi basia anu na bataabla.

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: Ɔdi ɔda bubo úte Yoseƒ kadi bekyuli uwi ɔni na ɔ́kpanku-ma ɔ́lɛku Egyipteƒuɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na línu na lɛdi bamba kemmo ka baasu banini,

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́ya na etila átimi-mii lɛlɔ na bina enu ánwuna ásiku kabla kpakplaa kani na bítaabla kemmo.

english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: Ka biibó abi na bɛ́kpali-mi ni, línu líte-mii na lɛ́si kesii kani nábɛ-mii na liƒlukutu ku katɔ budu kemmo na líbo ḿbedie-mii. Na lɛ́kɔku-mii lɛ́nu na Meriba kesii kani na ntu bɔ́lɛ.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: “O mina kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ, binu mina bɔlɛ. O Israel kadi bekyuli, mɔɔyɔ́ ka binu-mi litemi.

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Bitetétiku baƒiɔ badi bitasiku kesii kadi betebese lɛlɔ bɛnii bitaakpa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔni nákpanku-mii ɔ́siku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Ndubɔya na bimo ku ala abuni ƒui si bɛ́nyonu lɛlɔ ƒui bíte-mi.

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: “Nsu mina kadi bekyuli béni ɔmɛni na balaƒɔ-mi litemi na badi-ni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu lídie-ma atu na baabla bana likyulikpi ala ani baayɔ́.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: “Na si bunu na amii Israel bekyuli bínu-mi litemi na bɛbla bɛsiaku-ni lɛlɔ ni, nka ɔdia.

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: Na ndububoku bina bekisine kalɔ na uwi klukui kemmo na lɛni-ma kɔtu.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: Na bani muukisi-mi ƒui badubɔkya lili kalɔ bete-mi na bataayia-mi na bana kɔtu bɔni lɛnɔ buse bute-ma uwi ƒui.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Nsu amii ni, ndubute-mii adila ani ndia ntulo ƒui ku alakpi akɔ uwɔ na bɛdi bimo.”

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́yu úlie kayaa bayikune ntɛ na ɔ́tɛku-ma litemi na katɔ mmɔ ɔnini,

english_verse: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
translation_verse: “Bi ɔsu na bilásia ulu lɛlɔ taatɛ litemi na biinye likpidi kama taaƒɔ́ balalane?

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Bikpo bite bani neeebo kablakɔ kadi ku bekpinebi. Na bɛbla ala ulu lɛlɔ bite bani muubó abi na baayaki ala.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Bibunku bani neeebo kablakɔ kadi ku bani mɔɔyaki ala, na bidie-ma na balalane enu kemmo.

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: “Balalane bamɛni baaagyi lɛla lɛni na baabla na belenu lɛla lɛdi lɛnɔ kalɔ. Lɛdisa kemmo kani na bakɛ bésela. Na lɛlɔ lɛɛtɔ́ kalɔ kemodi kammɔ.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́ɛsu-mii nnini, ‘Bise aani Katɔti na bina ƒui bɛdi ami Ɔyikune Ƒui bebi.’

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, ta na atɛku kalɔ kammɔ ƒui litemi, ɔsika kadi bekyuli bammɔ ƒui ndi awɔ ɔdi.

english_verse: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
translation_verse: O Katɔti, tedie-bu atu na asɔ enye ataanu-bu lɛni na alasu iye abla lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Nu kalɛ na ƒula bekisine bani náta bénye-ɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ báta yuu ku lɛsɛ badubo.

english_verse: They are sly, and they plot against those you treasure.
translation_verse: Na básala ku bekyuli bamba na baakya kɔkwɛ kukpidi na ƒula bekyuli bani na ada aanu lɛlɔ geen mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: Na baasu lɛlɔ banini, “Bibo na bɔyila kadi bamɛni budie mɛni, na ɔdi ɔsɔ ulenyimo ka baalɔ kadi badi banii Israelƒuɔ.”

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ geen na ɔdi ka lɛni na bábla kasusu kenwi na bényimi kpakplaa na ƒula lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.
translation_verse: Gebal ku Amon ku Amalek ku Ƒilistia ku Tire kadi bekyuli.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na buuvele-ɔ ka ani-ma kɔtu kalɛ na áni Midian kadi bekyuli kɔtu na ádu Gisera ku Ɔga Yabin lɛnɔ na Kisai Ketu kɔtu

english_verse: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
translation_verse: Bla bana batɔnkune aani kalɛ na ábla Oreb ku Seeb. Na abla bana bagadine aani kalɛ na ábla Seba ku Salmuna.

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, bla-ma aani ɔtumu ku aƒaaƒa ani na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uubó taavinku.

english_verse: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
translation_verse: Na aya na bayii udu aani kalɛ na ogya ɔɔkyula lɛku na abi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: pursue and terrify them with storms of your own.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, Katɔti, bɔku-ma na akya-ma liƒu geen ku ƒula ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔni muubile ala.

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Ya na kɔƒa kukpo-ma geen utédu ka bánu-ɔ báti na benwini babataakpa-a.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Ya na kɔƒa kukpo-ma na babla gyugyuugyu na bekpi na kɔƒa kɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Ya na bati ka awɔ ɔni ndi Unwoti ni, awɔ kani ndi Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔni mɔɔdi kayawi ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: O Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui, ƒula kakpakɔ kaadia bɔnu geen.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔwia geen ka lɛkya ƒula kaduli mmɔ. Na muudie ebiti lɛnu ku mina kayi ƒui teete awɔ Katɔti ɔni nli ngba uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: O kadi ƒui Unwoti, mina Ɔga ku Katɔti, baasɛ wɛlɛ wɛlɛ muedi bebo kakyakɔ ku ayu ani kemmo na baatɛ na ede ƒula akpabi kesii kani na baatumini bana bebi.

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Adubɔya na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ bekyuli bani nli ƒula kakpakɔ na beedie lɛnu teemwi-ɔ uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bekyuli bani mɔɔƒɔ́ bana ɔyikun taasiku-ɔ kudɔ na baawia na bana kayi kemmo geen ka besie ƒula kakpakɔ.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Na ɔni bakɛ Baka Obonka ɔmmɔ kemmo bésela ni, abiɔ álɛ. Na ɔnantu udeedi ɔni mɔɔna únye ekpo ekpo ɔ́bla egyu.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Na baakɛ́ ɔyikun teebu limeyi ndi limeyi. Na badubɔnu benwoti ƒui Unwoti ɔni ndi Katɔti na Sion Kɔbi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: O Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, ɔni na bula nana Yakob ɔ́kpa, muuvele-ɔ, kywɛ-mi atu na enu-mi bɔkpali.

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: O Katɔti, awɔ ɔni mɔɔgyumana-bu, nwini nu ami ƒula ukyuli ɔƒunadi na aƒɛnimi anumi akya-mi.

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ƒula kudɔ bulie limeyi linwi na ƒula kakpakɔ ɔdia utulo ka ukyuli ulie kesii bamba emeyi apim unwi. Na ndubɔyɔ ka lɛbla Katɔti kayakun kenye unyene litulo ka liduo lilie ɔlalane ɔdi kevo kemmo.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti Katɔti uukeye aani ɔƒɛ na anwu mɔɔgyumana-bu. Anwuɔsu na uute-bu kusɛ kusɛ na ɔɔbla-bu lɛƒɔndia na ɔɔyá na bɔɔƒɔ́ lɛnyi na ulaya na bekyuli bani nse siin baayaki lɛla lɛbuni lɛdi uwi ɔdi.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
translation_verse: O Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, ukyuli ɔni mbo lɛnunsia na ƒula lɛlɔ ni, anwu na lɛlɔ lɛdubo bɔyɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ábla-bu lɛƒɔndia na ánu abu Yakob kaba bebi bani ndi kalɔ kamɛni bekyuli kɔnyana. Na ala ásɔ atɛnku-bu.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: Éti ƒula bekyuli ekpidi ákyiɛ-ma na ásɔ elényimo-nya.

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: Áya na ƒula kɔnyi kenye kékulo na kaƒɔ kába-a.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, awɔ ndi bula ngba bɔƒɔ. Buuvele-ɔ ka ada-bu kɔnyi buti bɔkya aya na asɔku-bu eboku bula uwi ɔbuni kemmo.

english_verse: Will you always be angry with us and our families?
translation_verse: Munuu adubuti kɔnyi akya-bu uwi ƒui, na kɔnyi kɔmmɔ kɔvi bula kaba bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ?

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Aaadubo ngba bɔwɔdi bɔsɔku bute-bu na ƒula kadi bekyuli basɔ bakɛ lɛlɔyɔ na ƒula lɛlɔ?

english_verse: Show us your love and save us!
translation_verse: O Katɔti, tina-bu kalɛ na aayɔ́-bu uwi biala na aƒɔ-bu ngba.

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: Ndubuse atu na linu lɛla lɛni na Unwoti Katɔti ubo na wasu-mi. Ɔsika ɔ́su úse ka ɔdubute nwuna kadi bekyuli keyi buɛɛ si bátasɔ bétenwini bétesie bana kɔdɔlɔ ngba bulie kemmo.

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Geen ni, unye ka ɔƒɔ bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔkpá-nwu kalɛ na ukeye na bula akɔ na kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na bekyuli basiaku Unwoti etemila kama siin na kalɔ lɛlɔ na Unwoti ɔbla ala siin ute bekyuli ɔ́siku nwuna keliekɔ na katɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka Katɔti ɔdubute-bu ala abuni na ɔya na kalɔ kammɔ kadia edula pii kete-bu.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Ala bɔbla siin ndi bukeye bɔni ntɔ Katɔti anumi na nwuna kavinkɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: Unwoti, buvele se atu na enu mina bɔkpali, ɔsika kɔwaba kɔda-mi na naaakana lɛla lɛdi bɔbla bute lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Gyumana-mi na aƒɔ-mi ngba, ɔsika awɔ ndi mina Katɔti ɔni lɛlɔ na mina anu asia na nsiaku kama siin ƒula kabla ɔblane kalɛ.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: Nu-mi kɔnyana, ɔsika awɔ na muuwulo taakpali uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Ya-mi lɛkɛ lɛlɔyɔ, ɔsika ƒula kabla na mɔɔbla na mɔɔkpali-ɔ ku mina kayi ƒui.

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: Aabla-bu lɛƒɔndia, na eeti ekpidi taakyiɛ na bani ƒui mɔɔkpali-ɔ ni, aayɔ́-ma uwi ndi uwi geen.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
translation_verse: Unwoti, buvele se atu na enu kalɛ na mɔɔkpali-ɔ ku keku nnii bunku-mi.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: Ɔsika uwi biala na ala eekpóku-mi ni, awɔ na mɔɔkpali na eebunku-mi.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Kadi bekyuli bani ƒui na édie badubo babalɛ akɔnkɔ kalɔ bakpa-a batina kalɛ na eekeye.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Ɔsika awɔ lɛti kani ndi Katɔti na ébomo na aabla akɔla ala budie taatina.

english_verse: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
translation_verse: Unwoti, tina-mi ƒula ulu geen ɔmmɔ na lɛsia-nwu lɛlɔ, kalɛ na naaalɛ-ɔ kama. Na aya na ntaayɔ-ɔ geen ku mina kayi ƒui.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Ndubɔgya-a enu ku mina kayi ƒui na nteemwi-ɔ lɛnyi lɛni muukeye uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, bekyuli bani mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ ku balalane bani naaanu ukyuli kɔnyana badubo bebekpoku-mi na badu-mi.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ ni, Katɔti ɔni mɔɔnu kɔnyana na aayɔ́-bu geen na adi. Eléti kɔnyi buti buti mmomu aayɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi na alalɛ ƒula litemi kama lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Nwini nu-mi na anu-mi kɔnyana ƒula kabla ɔblane kalɛ. Na ete-mi ɔyikun na aƒɔ-mi aani ƒula kabla ɔblane ubidi.

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: Bla lɛla lɛdi te-mi na bekyuli banu. Na si mina bekisine bánu na kɔƒa kukpo-ma. Ɔsika badubɔnu ka ébunku-mi na áyala-mi kaƒɔ.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́da nwuna ɔma unengudi ɔ́sia Sion Kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔyɔ́ ɔma unengudi ɔmɛni teetulo kesi kesii na Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́su ala abuni ɔ́siku awɔ Sion ɔni ndi nwuna ɔma lɛlɔ ɔnini,

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: “Ndubɔka Egyipte ku Babilon libunku kadi bekyuli bani nánu-mi báti akɔ. Na Ƒilistia kalɔ ku Tiro ɔma ku Etiopia kalɔ lɛnɔ bebunku. Na badubɔsu banini, ‘Sion na báwɔ-bu.’ ”

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔdubɔkya ɔma ɔmmɔ bekyuli ɔyikun. Na ɔdi biala ɔdubɔsu ɔnii, “Mɛni na báwɔ abu lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔlati ndubo bekyuli bani ƒui na báwɔ na Sion mmɔ anyi bunweni bɔkya nwuna ɔku kemmo.

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bammɔ badubo lɛnu buteedie na bataatɔ taasu ka Sion na bula kasikɔ kákwɛ kási.

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: O Unwoti Katɔti ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mi ngba, ƒula anumi na muunye taakpali usien ku ɔƒɛ.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: Ya na mina kɔvanu kudu-ɔ kudɔ na enu lɛla lɛni na muuvele-ɔ.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: Ɔsika ala eekpóku-mi ɔni na mina ngba bɔ́sɔ bútagyunku kekpine.

english_verse: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.
translation_verse: Na baaká-mi taakya bani ngba néedu kaƒiɔtɔ kɔtu akɔ, ɔsika ɔyikun ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo-mi lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.
translation_verse: Na nse aani ukyuli ɔni na bédie atu ka úkpi na ubunku bani na bádu-ma béwi kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo. Na áyiƒala-mi na asɔ elébunku-mi.

english_verse: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
translation_verse: Éti-mi ákya kalɔ kemmo kesii kani nse suu na kágyu voo mmɔ.

english_verse: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
translation_verse: Éti kɔnyi ákya-mi kpakplaa aani kalɛ na ketu keeyi teeƒie ukyuli.

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: Na áya mina bakpana bágyunku-mi na bédie-mi atu lɛnɔ. Na línwini liƒu lɛla lɛni bébo lɛkpu na kekelikɔ kadi keeebo-mi.

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Mina bɔnu buse-mi ƒluƒlu na kalɛ na ɔƒɛ ɔɔdá-mi ɔsu. Na enu kani na lɛ́kɔliku katɔ nnye mɔɔkpali-ɔ uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Bekpine na adubo ƒula akɔla ala budie bɔtina? Munuu bekpine bammɔ ndubo bɔta na bemwi-ɔ?

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: Bamanvine bammɔ ndubo ƒula akɔla ala budie taatina bɔnu bɔti? Munuu ama bani na báyiƒala na kasuudikɔ mmɔ ndubo bɔsu kalɛ na aaƒɔ́ bekyuli ngba?

english_verse: Each morning I pray to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Unwoti, mɔɔkpali-ɔ teevele ɔtanta biala ka ebunku-mi.

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: O Unwoti, bi ɔsu na éni-mi na ábɛla-mi ƒula anumi lɛni?

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si-mi lɛnamu uwi ƒui na ala eekpóku-mi na ukpiwi muedi néedu-mi. Ƒula kɔnyi kɔɔda-mi liƒu na lɛ́yii udu.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Ƒula livoƒi lɛ́ka-mi lɛ́kya. Na kɔtu kɔni na aaní-mi kɔdaku-mi bɔyila ku udu.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Áya na mina bakpana ku bayɔne ƒui bédie-mi atu. Na ami ku kadi suu mɔɔdi kɔkpana.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ndubudie ɔnu libo kudu kalɛ na aayɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi. Na kaba bekyuli ƒui badububo bebenu lɛsa bɔkɔ bɔmɛni kalɛ na asia ƒula litemi kama geen.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: Ndububo kudu ka ƒula bɔyɔ bɔmmɔ ku kalɛ na aasia ƒula litemi kama use úsela uwi ƒui kalɛ kani na bɔɔnu ka kayaa kese na uuubo kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Awɔ násu anini, “Línyimi lɛla lɛdi ku mina ukyuli ɔƒunadi. Na líse kenye líte mina kabla ɔblane Ɔga Dawid nnini,

english_verse: David, one of your descendants will always be king.”
translation_verse: ‘Ndubɔnu ka ƒula kaba kemmo ubi mɔɔdi lɛga uwi ndi uwi. Na lɛgadi lɛmmɔ lilása mmɔ kudii.’ ”

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ƒula kayaa ala ediedi ƒui beedie ɔnu na beebó kudu ƒula akɔla ala budie taatina. Na kayaa bayikune kedee bammɔ beedie ɔnu taasu kalɛ na aadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ siin.

english_verse: None who live in the heavens can compare with you.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kayaa ɔyikune ɔdi uuubo na beti bakɔku-ɔ. Na ɔyikune ɔdi lɛnɔ uuubo mmɔ na use aani ƒula kalɛ.

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: Adi Katɔti ɔni na kayaa bayikune kede bammɔ ƒui baayia uwi ɔni na bɛ́sa. Ɔsika ébomo na ebo ɔyikun étulo bani náka bámana-a.

english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: Awɔ ndi Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui, na ɔdi uuubo ɔyikun na ɔɔsia nwuna litemi kama ƒula kalɛ.

english_verse: You rule the roaring sea and calm its waves.
translation_verse: Awɔ muuboku ɛpu bonwu ku nwuna lɛlɔ bɔnwanɛ ƒui kalɔ. Na aayala nwuna avlɔvɔ ammɔ buɛɛ.

english_verse: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
translation_verse: Áyila ɛpu kemmo liƒu kebweyi kani ndi Rahab udu. Na édie ƒula kɔnu na ábla ɔyikun ala na égyingya ƒula bekisine.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Kayaa ku kalɔ ƒui kadi awɔ kadi, na kayawi ku kana ala ƒui ni, awɔ nédie-nya.

english_verse: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
translation_verse: Kayawi kemodi ɔ́si ɔƒɛnyi unwi útédu ɔkladi ƒui awɔ nédie-ka. Lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ Tabor ku Hermon abi na eedie ƒula bumwi keyi.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bekyuli bani nánu-ɔ báti lɛni na beedie lɛnu teemwi-ɔ O Unwoti, ɔsika kalɛ na eekeye na bula akɔ mɔɔyá baanu teesie.

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: Baakɛ́ lɛlɔyɔ na awɔ ɔsu na beemwi-ɔ na ƒula lɛƒɔndia ɔsu.

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: Ɔsika awɔ mɔɔyá na beekeye na baakɛ́ ɔyikun. Na ƒula lɛƒɔndia ɔsu na bɔɔdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
translation_verse: Awɔ Unwoti Israel Katɔti Kedee ndi bula ɔga ku lɛgyumanala éte-bu.

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Kuuku ni, édie átina ƒula kabla ɔblane na kɔyu kemmo na ásu anini, “Liti ɔyikun líte ukpone ɔdi. Na lɛ́ƒuna-nwu lɛ́siku bina akɔ na líse-nwu likpo ka ɔdi lɛga.

english_verse: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king,
translation_verse: Lɛ́ƒuna mina kabla ɔblane Dawid na líse-nwu likpo ku nnɔmii kedee bɔni na líwi-nwu lili.

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: Na ndubo-nwu buteebunku na lɛkya-nwu ɔyikun.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: Na nwuna ukisine ɔdi uletulo-nwu na ulu ɔdi lɛlɔ. Na balalane badi lɛnɔ baladi-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
translation_verse: Nwuna bekisine bani ƒui muukpóku-nwu kpakplaa mmɔ ni, ndubo-ma bubo bɔƒiɛmi kalɔ.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: Ndubɔyɔ-nwu uwi biala na naaalɛ-nwu kama. Na ndubɔya na ɔkɛ ɔyikun na ɔdi nwuna bekisine ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
translation_verse: Ndubɔya na ɔdi kɔlɔ kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔ́si ɛpu ɔmmɔ utédu Euƒrate Ketu.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: Ɔdubɔkpali-mi na ɔsu ɔnini, ‘Awɔ ndi mina Ati ku Katɔti, ɔni ndi mina lɛtakpɛ lɛni mɔɔyá na mɔɔkɛ́ ngba bɔƒɔ.’

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔbla-nwu mina ubi ɔnanabi udeedi ɔni ndubɔbla baga ƒui ɔga na kayawi ƒui.

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: Na kenye kani na líse ka ndubo-nwu butaayɔ uwi ndi uwi use úsela uwi ƒui. Na lɛla lɛni na línyimiku-nwu ni, ɔdi ulebile-ni.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: Na nwuna kaba kemmo ubi ndubo lɛga butaadi uwi ƒui aani kalɛ na kayaa kese késela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: “Nsu si nwuna kaba kemmo bebi béni mina ɔda bubo,

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: na balásiaku mina ala bɔtina kama ni,

english_verse: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
translation_verse: ndubo-ma kɔtu bɔni na bana ekpidi ɔsu.

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: Nsu lɛɛɛdubo-ma bɔda bɔyɔ bɔya na lɛɛɛdubo mina litemi kama bɔlɛ lɛnɔ kudii.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: Ka nse kedee ɔsu ni, líse kenye ka naaakana Dawid bɔtɔlɔ.

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: Na nwuna kaba kemmo bebi lɛgadi lɛdubuse úsela uwi ƒui. Na kalɛ kani na ɔƒɛ ɔɔtu ni, lɛni kani na nwuna lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ kadubunye na mina anumi.

english_verse: and moon appear in the sky.”
translation_verse: Na kadubuse aani kalɛ kani na kɔbuli kɔɔtu na kayaa.”

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, Unwoti Katɔti, éti kɔnyi geen ákya ɔga ɔni na awɔ ɔlati áƒuna na éni-nwu.

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: Ébile lɛla lɛni na ényimiku-nwu na átu-nwu lɛga lɛmmɔ na ɔsɔ uuubo ɔyikun ɔdi na ƒula anumi.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Na áƒɛ ɔban awodu ani náka ámana ɔ́ma ɔmmɔ ku nwuna kagyumanakɔ ƒui éwi kalɔ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
translation_verse: Na belusiene bani mɔɔsia mmɔ taavi béyu ala lidu lidu bátɔlɔku. Na ntɛ mmɔ bekyuli bammɔ baamá-nwu.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Áya na nwuna bekisine mmomu enu náta katɔ na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-ma

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: Áya na nwuna ekpola ƒui énwini kekuma na útakana na unye ɔsiaku nwuna bekisine.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ékpeli-nwu ɔgagyii áƒɔ na édi-nwu ébo nwuna lɛgaboku lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: Áya na ɔ́bi lɛlɔ kɔnakunwi na ɔ́yila nwuna lɛkloƒu bɔdia na kɔƒa kuukpó-nwu.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
translation_verse: O Unwoti, uwi ɛlɛ na adubudie-mi atu atálɛ na aya na ƒula kɔnyi kutaakɔ katɔ na bula lɛlɔ lɛni aani kalɛ na ogya ɔɔda taakyula ala?

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: O Unwoti, kali nu ka mina ngba emeyi étedu ku lɛla na mmomu édie-bu na bɔdi bayawine ku ɔlɔna ɔni muukpi.

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: Unwoti, wɛ na bɔyɔ bɔni na aayɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi ɔ́si kukuuku mmɔ bɔ́vi? Bɔyɔ bɔni kenye na ése Dawid ka alálɛ ƒula litemi kama mmɔ nɔɔ?

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, kali nu kalɛ na baamá ƒula kabla ɔblane ku edumi ani udu na baakpila-mi.

english_verse: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
translation_verse: Ƒula bekisine beedumi-mi kesi kesii na nkɛ, Ami ƒula kabla ɔblane ɔni ndi ɔga ɔni na áƒuna.

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Bete Unwoti Katɔti kusɛ kusɛ ubo-nwu kemmo lɛni. Na ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ƒula kudɔ ndi bula kaba bekyuli keliekɔ ɔ́si kukuuku ƒui.

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Asa na adubudie abi ku kayawi kammɔ ala ƒui ni, awɔ ndi Katɔti ɔni nli uwi ƒui ɔ́si kukuuku.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: Awɔ mɔɔyá na ukyuli uukpi na aasu anii ɔsɔ unwini lɛti.

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Ɔsika akwa apim unwi use awɔ aani kaama kadi kani návi iye uwi klukui na usien kemmo.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: Aayá na bula ngba uwi ɔɔví na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na kɔna bugye buse. Na búlieku kalɛ na ɔtanta livo lise.

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: Aalɛ́ wɔwɔɔwɔ na eebimi. Na useyi uwi ni, aayɛyɛ na aayii udu.

english_verse: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
translation_verse: Ɔsika ƒula kɔnyi kpakplaa kɔɔyá na liƒu bonwu lɛɛda-bu na bɔyii udu.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: Na bula alaekpidi ku ala ani na bɔ́bla bɔ́bɛ ƒui ni, agyi-nya kede kede.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
