translation_verse: Bula ngba emeyi aadá liku na ƒula kɔnyi ɔsu aani kalɛ na ukyuli uubó lɛnwuna kani na ɔyula.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Na bula ngba emeyi ƒui adubɔbla aani akwa liti ku aavlanyɔ kani. Na si ɔlɔkplu ɔkya ukyuli ɔdi ni, na ɔdubulie utédu akwa liti ku avlaatɛ. Na ɔmmɔ muedi aatí ka bɔnɔ ku lɛbibo lɛti kani na ɔdi-nwu. Ngba buuubo bɔsa na abu ɔdi ɔvi.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Ɔma ngyi kalɛ udu na awɔ Katɔti áani ukyuli kɔtu teetédu si éti kɔnyi? Lɛni ɔsu na liƒu bonwu lɛɛda-bu si livo liiƒí-ɔ.

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Ya na bɔti ka bula uwi útene na kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni na bɔda anu na bɔbla-a kabla.

english_verse: Help us, Lord! Don't wait! Pity your servants.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, buuvele-ɔ bɔnii kaƒɔ kayɔ-ɔ. Buuvele na anu ƒula kabla bablane kɔnyana.

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Buuvele bɔnii ya na bɔnu bɔti kalɛ na aayɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi, kadi biala négye na budie lɛnu ku lɛlɔyɔ na bɔkɛ ebiti bula ngba emeyi ƒui.

english_verse: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
translation_verse: Na aya na ebiti ada-bu na kɔnyana kɔni néƒie-bu kúbavi kenye.

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Ya na abu ƒula kabla bablane bɔnu ƒula akɔla ala budie taatina na bula akɔ. Na bula bawɔ banu kalɛ na ebo ɔyikun na eekeye.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, ya na ƒula kusɛ kusɛ ɔsiaku-bu na aya na ala ani na bɔɔbla ƒui alɛ-bu kɔsia.

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni nli Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui kudɔ na ɔɔgyumana-nwu na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔmmɔ ɔ́kya-nwu ɔyuli ni,

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: anwu ndubɔsu Unwoti ɔnini, “Awɔ ndi mina kagyumanakɔ kpakplaa kesii kani na mɔɔbɛ́. Na adi-mi Katɔti ɔni lɛlɔ na mina anu asia.”

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔdubɔtɔnku-ɔ na eleduo kɔkpagyuɛ kɔni na bekyuli bábɛ bákywɛ-ɔ kemmo. Na lɛlɛ buɛ lɛni mɔɔví lɛnɔ ɔdi ulébo-ɔ.

english_verse: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
translation_verse: Ɔdububi-ɔ ala aani kalɛ na akɔkɔ uubi nwuna bebi avwi na akɛ kabɛkɔ. Na kalɛ na ɔɔsia nwuna litemi kama siin ɔsu ni, ɔdubo-ɔ bɔgyumana na ukpo ute-ɔ.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Aaadubo ɔgbankpi ɔdi bɔyia na usien iye ekpola adi na limeyi kemmo.

english_verse: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
translation_verse: Na alayia lɛlɛ lɛni muubó ukyuli usien iye ɔgbankpi ɔni muubo ukyuli lɛlɔ kɔnakunwi na ɔƒiiwi.

english_verse: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
translation_verse: Nkyuli mpim mpim badubo bukpi bamana-a nsu ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ uláni uléde-ɔ.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ƒula anumi nwaa na adubo bɔnu kalɛ na Unwoti ɔdubo balalane kɔtu bɔni.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Ka ƒula anu asia Unwoti lɛlɔ na eli-nwu kudɔ na áya na ɔ́bɛla-a ɔsu ni,

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: ɔgbankpi iye likpidi bamba lɛdi lɛɛɛdubo-ɔ bɔlɛku na ƒula kaduli.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔdubɔtala nwuna batu na bagyumana-a na ƒula kasiakɔ ƒui

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: Badubɔgyu-ɔ bada enu kemmo ɔni na ƒula ɔgba muedi uletulo atabi adi.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: Adubɔdi bagyata ku balakpi bekpidi ƒui lɛlɔ na balakana-a lɛla lɛdi bɔbla.

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyɔ́-mi na ɔ́nu-mi ɔ́ti ni, ndubɔgyumana-nwu na lɛƒɔ-nwu ngba.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: Na si lɛla lɛdi liikpóku-nwu na ɔ́kpali-mi ni, ndubunu na lidie-nwu na lɛya na ɔƒɔ lɛnyi.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: Ndubɔya-nwu na ulie ngba gyɔlɔɔ na udu-nwu ɔkwɛ na lɛƒɔ-nwu ngba.”

english_verse: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
translation_verse: Ɔdia ka butaagya awɔ Katɔti enu na budie lɛnu bumwi awɔ Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui.

english_verse: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Na ɔdia ka buteebo-ɔ kudu ɔtanta biala, kalɛ na aayɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi. Na usien ni, bɔkɔ lɛsa lɛnɔ kalɛ na asia ƒula litemi kama.

english_verse: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
translation_verse: Na bumwi-ɔ ku bula lɛbentaa ku agyala abambadi.

english_verse: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, áya na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi na ƒula ablala ebendi ɔsu. Na anya ɔsu na muudie ebiti lɛnu.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: Unwoti, ƒula ablala ébomo na ƒula kasusu kemmo kágyu.

english_verse: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
translation_verse: Ususu ɔdi ulakana-ka bɔnu bɔti na ɔdɔlɔdi lɛnɔ ulénu-ka kalɔ.

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na si balalane ku ekpidi bablane bálɛ lili aani livo wɔwɔɔwɔ dɛ ni, badubo udu bɔyii ƒui kede kede.

english_verse: But you will rule over all of us forever,
translation_verse: Ɔsika awɔ Unwoti ƒula lɛnyi lɛ́kɔ katɔ úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
translation_verse: Na geen ni, bani muukisi-ɔ kpakplaa mmɔ ƒui badubo udu bɔyii. Na likyulikpi ala bablane lɛnɔ adubo-ma bɔbɔku na egyingya-ma.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: Awɔ náya na mbo ɔyikun aani akɔ ɔgyani. Na áƒuna-mi na ndi awɔ ɔdi.

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: Na ami ɔlati lɛ́nu na línu kalɛ na ádi mina bekisine balalane lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nse siin beebimi aani kubo na baalɛ́ lili aani Lebanon kalɔ egyii enengudi.

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: Bese aani egyii ani bálɛ na Katɔti kaduli na baalɛ́ lili na mmɔ.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: Na ina ábi lɛlɔ muedi adubo butaanwu, ɔsika ebo ntu na eedie evete wɔwɔɔwɔ.

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka Katɔti ndi mina katamikukɔ lɛtakpɛ lɛni nse siin na ulábla likpidi lɛdi.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ndi ɔga ɔni mɔɔdi kayawi ƒui lɛlɔ. Na ɔda ala aani ɔga na ubo ɔyikun na ɔ́ƒɔ lɛnyi geen. Na lɛla lɛdi lilakana ka bɔkunku.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: Anwu mɔɔdi lɛga uwi ƒui na uuubo kalɔ kesekɔ iye kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ɛpu ɔmmɔ ɔɔnwanɛ lɛlɔ ɔ́si nwuna ligyu kemmo na uubó taabla kudu geen.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui mɔɔdi ala ƒui lɛlɔ na ébomo etulo ɛpu bɔnwanɛ bɔmmɔ ku avlɔvɔ ani na uubó mmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: Ƒula ɔda bubo bunye ligeen kpakplaa. Na ƒula kakpakɔ kadubo butaadia bɔnu na kese kedee uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: O Unwoti Katɔti, awɔ ani muudie alaekpidi bablane kasi, ta na ani-ma kɔtu.

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Awɔ mɔɔtɛku bayawine ƒui litemi. Bo na ebedie bekyuli bani mɔɔkɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ kasi kani námanku-ma.

english_verse: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?
translation_verse: Uwi ɛlɛ na balalane bamɛni badubulie bataakun lɛmɛnɛ ku lɛlɔyɔ betédu?

english_verse: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
translation_verse: Baanya ƒula bekyuli baƒunadi taakya na beekpóku-ma.

english_verse: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.
translation_verse: Baadú bekpinele ku baƒɔ ku bekpinebi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: Na baasu banini, “Unwoti Katɔti na bula nana Yakob ɔ́kpa ɔɔɔgyi na ulánu ala amɛni.”

english_verse: Can't you fools see? Won't you ever learn?
translation_verse: Amii badɔlɔdi, uwi ɔmani geen na bɛdubo anu bɔda?

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔni námana ukyuli kɔtu na úte-nwu anumi ni, uunú na ɔɔnu kede kede.

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: Katɔti dɔnku kadi bekyuli ƒui Lɛni kani na ɔdubɔni-ba kɔtu. Na ubo lɛnunda na ɔɔtina bekyuli ala.

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔgyi ukyuli ɔyawine ka nwuna kasusu kaaadi lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: Unwoti, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni na áni kɔtu na édie ƒula ɔda bubo átina-nwu.

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: Na adubɔya na bakɛ bɔnwuna bɔsiku bana bekisine kudɔ si beekpóku-ma wetédu uwi ɔni na bekisine bammɔ békpi.

english_verse: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti ɔɔɔdubo kama bunwini bɔkya nwuna bekyuli baƒunadi.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔya na litemi batɛne basɔ bataatɛ etemila ulu siin lɛlɔ na bani nse siin ƒui basia-ma kama.

english_verse: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
translation_verse: Ɔma ndubo-mi bubunku na ukpo balalane bammɔ ute-mi?

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Si ɔɔɔdi Unwoti nébunku-mi ni, nka líkpi na ami ɔdi ɔ́sa.

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na lɛ́nu lɛ́ti ka nsɔ liiinye mina lɛgba lɛlɔ na muubuli ni, awɔ Unwoti ɔni mɔɔyɔ́-mi uwi ndi uwi náda-mi.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ala étulo-mi na kayi kaakpulu-mi ni, awɔ násia-mi kɔnu na mina kayi kákɛ ebiti.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti ndi mina kagyumanakɔ kpakplaa ku lɛtakpɛ lɛni kudɔ na mɔɔbɛ́.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubudie mina bekisine kasi ute-mi na ɔyila-ma udu.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Bibo na budie lɛlɔyɔ lɛnu bute Unwoti. Na bubo-nwu kudu, ɔsika anwu ndi bula lɛtakpɛ ku ngba bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bɔgya-nwu enu na bumwi-nwu ku ebiti lɛnu momoomo.

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti ɔdi Katɔti ɔni na úbomo, na ɔdi ɔga unengudi ɔni na utulo baƒiɔ ƒui.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: Anwu mɔɔdi kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na ɔ́si kalɔ kemmo ɔgyu ƒui útédu abi ammɔ eli ƒui ɔyikun ɔkya-nwu lɛkɔkɔ.

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: Anwu nédie ɛpu na ɔɔdi-nwu lɛlɔ. Na anwu néti nwuna enu ɔ́bla kalɔ kammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Anwu ndi bula Katɔti, na abu ndi nwuna kadi bekyuli bani na ɔɔnu lɛlɔ. Buse aani nwuna baƒonu bani na ɔɔkpanku teesienku kadikɔ. Si bínu Katɔti lɛdi ɔmwi ni,

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: bitabla atuɔkplu aani kalɛ na badi bábla na Meriba ku Masa kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ lɛlɔ limeyi lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bina bati kuuku bákɔku-mi bánu banii baanu ɔyikun ɔni na mbo na ala ebendi ani na lɛ́bla na bánu kama.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu akwa aavlene sɔɔn na líti kɔnyi lɛ́kya-ma geen na lɛ́su nnini, “Badi likyulikpi ala bablane bani naaasia mina ulu lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na lɛ́kpali lɛlɔ lɛ́su na mina kɔnyi kemmo nnii, “Baláni beléde-mi na bakɛ bɔnwuna kudii.”

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Amii kadi ƒui bekyuli, bɛtu ɔnu ɔwɔdi bite Unwoti.

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Bidie ɔnu bimwi-nwu na bɛsu bekyuli limeyi ndi limeyi kalɛ na ɔ́ƒɔ-bu ngba.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Bɛkɔ lɛsa bite bekyuli kalɛ na uukeye na kadi ƒui akɔ. Na bɛsu akɔla ala budie taatina ani na ɔ́bla na bekyuli ƒui akɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bula Unwoti úbomo na nwuna lɛnyi lɛ́kɔ katɔ, anwuɔsu na ɔlɛka bumwi-nwu na bɔyia-nwu butulo baƒiɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Unwoti úbomo geen na nwuna bukeye bɔ́ka bɔ́mana-nwu. Na nwuna ɔyikun uudie lɛlɔ keyi kalɛ na ɔɔdia bɔnu na nwuna kakpakɔ

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Amii kadi ƒui bekyuli, bidie Unwoti kenyekɔ kani muukeye bɛtina ku kalɛ na ubo ɔyikun.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Bimwi Unwoti lɛnyi lɛni muukeye! Na biti etela biboku-nwu na nwuna kakpakɔ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
translation_verse: Amii kalɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli ƒui biboku eli kalɔ na bimwi Unwoti ɔni nébomo na use kedee. Na lɛlɔ litaatɔ-mii ku liƒu na nwuna anumi.

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Na bɛsu na kadi ƒui bekyuli akɔ bɛnini, “Unwoti Katɔti mɔɔdi lɛga.” Na kalɔ kemodi kammɔ kenye kana lɛgba lɛlɔ kpi na kalákunku kudii. Ɔdubɔtɛku bekyuli ƒui litemi na ulu siin lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Na ebiti ataada awɔ, kalɔ ku kana ala ƒui. Na ɛpu ɔmmɔ uteedie lɛdi momoomo ku ala ani ƒui nkya-nwu kemmo.

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: Na egyii ku livo ku mmo bɔmmɔ ƒui, bidie lɛnu ku lɛlɔyɔ bite yiiduu ku ala ani nkya aku ammɔ kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: Bidie lɛnu na bibo kudu na Unwoti ɔni ndubo anumi. Ɔsika ɔdubo ubatɛku kayawi bekyuli litemi na ulu siin lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubɔsia nwuna litemi geen lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔtɛ litemi lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔdi lɛga! Amii kayawi bekyuli ƒui, lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii. Na amii bani nli ntuntɛ kɔlɔ ƒui, lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii.

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Ulɔyɔ litigbli suu lɛdi lɛ́ka lɛ́mana-nwu. Na nwuna lɛga kadikɔ kenye kete ka ɔbla ala siin, na ɔtɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: Ogya bonwu ɔdi ɔtɔ-nwu anumi na ɔɔkyula nwuna bekisine ƒui taamana-nwu.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: Na nwuna kɔnyi kɔ́ya na kayaa kaabwɛ ogya teewi kayawi, na liƒu bonwu líƒie bayawine.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Na abi ammɔ aabwɛ na Unwoti anumi aani kalɛ na kɔma kɔɔnani. Na Unwoti ɔni mɔɔdi kayawi ƒui lɛlɔ anumi na ala ammɔ aalɛ́.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Kayaa ku kana ala eebó kudu na kalɛ na Katɔti use siin lɛlɔ. Na bayawine ƒui baanu kalɛ na uukeye.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na kɔƒa kuukpó bani ƒui mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na baakpá baƒiɔ. Amii baƒiɔ bammɔ ƒui, bɛkya lili kalɔ bite Unwoti.

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nkya Sion ku Yuda lɛma ƒui bénu ka Unwoti ɔ́tɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ na lɛlɔ lɛ́yɔ-ma.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, awɔ mɔɔdi kayawi ƒui lɛlɔ na ƒula lɛnyi lɛ́kɔ katɔ litulo baƒiɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli bani nkisi likpidi. Na ɔɔgyumana bekyuli bani nsiaku-nwu kama siin. Na uudie-ma taalɛku balalane enu kemmo.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔdi Katɔti litemi lɛlɔ na baabla ala ulu siin lɛlɔ ni bana kasiakɔ keekeye na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-ma.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
translation_verse: Amii bani mɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii na Unwoti ɔni nse kedee lɛlɔ na bɛgya-nwu enu.

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Bidie ɔnu ɔwɔdi bite Unwoti ɔsika ɔ́bla akɔla ala budie taatina. Na anwu ɔni nse kedee údie nwuna kɔnu na ɔ́bla ɔyikun ala na ɔ́di nwuna bekisine lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Unwoti údie ɔ́tina bekyuli ƒui ka ubo ɔyikun na ɔƒɔ bekyuli ngba na ɔtɛ litemi ulu siin lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ɔ́sia nwuna litemi kama siin úte Israel kadi bekyuli na ɔɔyɔ́-ma uwi ndi uwi. Na kayawi bekyuli ƒui bánu na kesi kesii kalɛ ubo ɔyikun na ɔɔƒɔ́ bekyuli.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Amii bekyuli ƒui bedie lɛlɔyɔ ku kudu momoomo, ku ebiti bimwi Unwoti.

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Bɛgya bina lɛbentaa ku agyala bamba na bidie lɛnu ku kɔku minimini bite Unwoti.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: Bɛvwi kɔkpɛɛ ku ese momoomo ku lɛlɔyɔ na Unwoti ɔni ndi bula ɔga anumi.

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Bidie lɛdi bite, ɛpu ku ala ani ƒui nkya-nwu kemmo na bebo kudu momoomo. Na kayawi ku kana ala ediedi ƒui bɛkɛ lɛlɔyɔ ku kɔvanu.

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Na ntukpa ƒui bɔbla kɔku aani enukpɛ bɔgya. Na kɔku kɔsi abi ƒui lɛlɔ aani lɛlɔyɔ lɛnu ubasala na Unwoti anumi.

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: Bidie lɛnu na bibo kudu na Unwoti ɔni ndubo anumi. Ɔsika ɔdubo ubatɛku kayawi bekyuli litemi na ulu siin lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubɔsia nwuna litemi geen lɛlɔ ɔtɛ litemi lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔdi lɛga, liƒu litaada kadi bekyuli. Uli nwuna lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na batu udu bani mbo avwi na baalɔ-ma kerub ntɛ na kayawi kemodi kammɔ ƒui kaakunku.

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Unwoti, awɔ ntulo ƒui na Sion na ƒula lɛnyi lɛ́kɔ katɔ na kadi bekyuli ƒui akɔ.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Bɛya na ɔdi biala umwi Unwoti lɛnyi lɛni ntulo na lɛɛda liƒu mmɔ, ɔsika anwu kani nse kedee.

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Awɔ ndi bula ɔga unengudi ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ala bɔbla siin. Áya na litemi bɔtɛ ulu lɛlɔ siin unye kpakplaa na Israel kadi bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Bimwi Unwoti bula Katɔti! Bibo na bibakya-nwu lili kalɔ na nwuna lɛgaboku anumi, ɔsika anwu kani nse kedee.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Bula bati kuuku Mose ku Aaron bakya Katɔti bakpane akɔ. Na bula Nana Samuel lɛnɔ ubunku-ma na bákpali Unwoti na úbunku-ma.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́tɛmiku-ma ɔ́siku liƒlukutu bonwu aani lɛkpa lɛdi kemmo. Na ama bénu na bádi nwuna ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, bula Katɔti, uwi ɔni na ƒula kadi bekyuli bábla likpidi ni, áni-ma kɔtu nsu ka bákpali-ɔ ni, énu na éti bana ekpidi ákyiɛ-ma.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Bimwi Unwoti bula Katɔti na bɛkpa-nwu na nwuna kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ, ɔsika Unwoti, bula Katɔti, use kedee.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Amii kayawi bekyuli ƒui, bɛtu kɔgya bimwi Unwoti.

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Bitiku ebiti lɛnu na bɛda bɛlɛ Unwoti anumi ku lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Bɛnu bɛti ka Unwoti ndi Katɔti! Anwu nábla-bu na bɔdi nwuna badi bani na ɔɔnu lɛlɔ aani nwuna baƒonu kalɛ na kadikɔ.

english_verse: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
translation_verse: Bɛsia kakpakɔ kayakun na biduo Unwoti kudɔ ku linugya ku bumwi lɛnu.

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti ɔdia, na ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi. Ɔɔsia nwuna litemi kama ulu siin lɛlɔ úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: O Unwoti! Ndubudie ɔnu limwi-ɔ na kalɛ na aayɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi na aatɛ litemi ulu siin lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: Bo na ebebunku-mi. Mmɔ na ndubɔkana lɛlɔ bɔda kaduɛ ntaabla lɛbuni kalɛ na naaaƒiɔ-ɔ na mina kaduli.

english_verse: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.
translation_verse: Na lɛɛɛdubo bɔtuna ku kenwini ku ɔkɔ ala bɔbla bɔdi.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbɛla lɛlɔ taalɔ bekyuli anyikpi ni, ndubɔyila-nwu udu. Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtina lɛlɔ na ɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ ni, lɛɛɛdubo bɔtunaku-nwu.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: Ndubɔsia anu na bekyuli bani mɔɔdi Katɔti litemi lɛlɔ na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ na ami ku-ma bulie. Na bekyuli bani mɔɔbla ala ulu geen lɛlɔ ni, ama ndubɔbla-mi kabla.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani na ɔkɔ ala bɔbla bɔkya-ma ngba kemmo ni, baaadubo-mi kaduli bulie. Na bekyuli bani mɔɔbla ala anumi lɛlɔ lɛnɔ baaadubo-mi anumi bunye.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Limeyi ndi limeyi ndubɔyila balalane udu ƒui na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ. Na ndubɔbɔku-ma lidie Unwoti ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen.
translation_verse: Nu-mi bɔkpali, O Unwoti, na aya na mina kɔvanu kudu-ɔ kudɔ na ebebunku-mi.

english_verse: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
translation_verse: Tabɛla-mi ƒula anumi si líduo ɔgbankpi kemmo. Mmomu se atu na enu-mi bɔkpali. Na ababla na ebo ebebunku-mi.

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Ɔsika mina emeyi áasa áwɔlɔ aani kalɛ na uyɔ ɔɔyii taakya. Na mina ɔlɔna lɛnɔ ɔɔkywí aani lɛgyavonku.

english_verse: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
translation_verse: Utu ɔɔyɔ́ lɛlɔ na mina kayi kemmo aani kalɛ livo lɛɛyɛyɛ. Na adila bɔdi muedi búkpi-mi ɔkwɛ.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si kalɛ na muudumo ɔsu ni, mina ɔlɔna ɔ́kwii na ekubi ekubi na aanu.

english_verse: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.
translation_verse: Naaatɛ taalɛɛ uwi ɔdi, na lɛ́ta lɛ́bla aani aasɛ ɔni nlie lɛsa lili anwu lɛti.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: Lɛnyinkpi kani na mina bekisine baalɔ-mi usien ku ɔƒɛ teewida bekyuli ka ɔdubɔlɛku-ma aani ami.

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: Ntɔ bɔni kemmo muulie búnwini mina adila ani mɔɔdi. Na mina mmii lɛnɔ búnwini ntu bɔni mɔɔní.

english_verse: because you are furious and have thrown me aside.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku ƒula livoƒi ku kɔnyi kɔni na éti akya-mi ɔsu ni, ágyu-mi ébo évaakun.

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: Mina ngba emeyi aasá aani kalɛ lɛdisa lɛɛƒɔ́ limeyi bukeye. Na buse aani livo lɛni mɔɔyɛyɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, O Unwoti, awɔ adi ɔga úsela uwi ƒui. Na adubɔƒɔ lɛnyi na bekyuli ƒui akɔ ɔ́si kaba útédu kaba.

english_verse: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.
translation_verse: Adubɔnu Sion kɔnyana ɔƒɛni amu. Ɔsika uwi ɔmmɔ údu na anwu na ɔdi mɛni.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: Atabi ammɔ muedi áƒɔ abu ƒula kabla bablane kuye nsu kalɛ na bébo-nya bábwɛ bébile na ɔtumu ɔ́ƒɔ-nya lɛlɔ ɔɔdu-bu kaƒɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, kadi bekyuli badubo Unwoti lɛnyi butaayia. Na kalɔ lɛlɔ baga ƒui badubo-nwu butaabu na banu kalɛ na uukeye.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubɔsɔku Sion ɔma ɔtu na bekyuli banu kalɛ na uukeye.

english_verse: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubunu bawabane ƒui bɔkpali na ɔbla ala ani beevele-nwu ute-ma.

english_verse: Future generations must also praise the Lord, so write this for them:
translation_verse: Binweni ɔmɛni bise kaba bekyuli bani na bátawɔ-ma tɔ, ɔsika ɔlɛka ama lɛnɔ bebemwi Unwoti.

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́nu ɔ́siku nwuna keliekɔ kedee kani na ulie mmɔ. Na ɔ́nu kalɔ kammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: Na únu bekyuli bani na bákya ɔtɔ budumo ku bani na bádu-ma kukpi kɔtɔ ƒui kalɛ na udie-ma.

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, baga ku lɛga kɔdikɔ ƒui badubɔsa lisu na bakya Unwoti lili kalɔ.

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́ya na mina ɔyikun ɔ́yuɛ uwi ɔni na lɛ́si mɔɔkɔ́ na ɔ́ya mina ngba emeyi lɛnɔ áƒana.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́su Unwoti nnini, “Awɔ eli ngba úsela uwi ƒui, tada-mi ngba likuku na uwi ɔni na mina emeyi étedu tɔ.

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Na kalɔ kesekɔ ni, awɔ nédie kayawi kamɛni ƒui, na éti ƒula enu ábla kayaa.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni ƒui adubɔyii udu. Nsu awɔ ni, adubulie uwi ƒui. Ala ammɔ ƒui adubɔtɔ aani adala kuuku kalɛ. Na adubo-nya budie buwi aani kalɛ na baavumana ala kuuku teedie-nya atu.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Nsu kalɛ kani na awɔ ese ni, lɛni na adubo buse. Na ƒula akwa alása kudii.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Ƒula bekyuli bani mɔɔbla ƒula kabla ulu lɛlɔ ni, bana bebi badubulie-ɔ anumi. Na agyumana bana kaba bebi lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: Ndubumwi Unwoti! Na naaayiƒala ala abuni ani na ɔ́bla úte-mi.

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: Anwu muuti mina alaekpidi ƒui taakyiɛ-mi. Na ɔɔbwi-mi lɛlɛ lɛni ƒui na muuƒi.

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: Anwu muudie-mi ngba na kukpi kemmo, na ɔɔyɔ́-mi, na ɔɔnu-mi kɔnyana uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: Uute-mi ala abuni ani mɔɔwia na mina ngba emeyi kemmo na eedú-mi. Na ɔɔyá na mina ɔyikun ɔɔbla ɔwɔdi aani kɔdigbo aasɛ kalɛ.

english_verse: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔtɛ litemi na ulu lɛlɔ siin teete bekyuli bani na balalane baanya taakya.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: Údie nwuna kasusu ɔ́tina Mose. Na ɔ́ya Israelƒuɔ bánu nwuna ala ebendi ani na ɔ́bla.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔnu kɔnyana na ɔɔbla lɛƒɔndia. Uléti kɔnyi pla pla na ɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli geen.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: Uládɔnku ukyuli uwi ndi uwi na uléti kɔnyi taakya ukyuli uwi ƒui.

english_verse: he doesn't punish us as our sins deserve.
translation_verse: Ulani-bu kɔtu aani kalɛ bula ekpidi ese iye ɔƒɔ-bu kayu kani námanku bula ɔbladu.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na kayaa kágyunku kalɔ ni, lɛni kani na nwuna bɔyɔ bɔni neeebo kawɔkɔ búbomo búte bekyuli buni bani mɔɔyia-nwu ku ɔbu.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na ɔƒɛ katukɔ kágyunku ɔƒɛ kanukɔ ni, lɛni na ɔɔda-bu ekpidi teedie teevaakun na bula lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Kalɛ na bebi lɛlɔ lɛɛbla bana bawɔne kɔnyana ni, lɛni na Unwoti lɛnɔ bekyuli bani mɔɔyia-nwu lɛlɔ lɛɛbla-nwu kɔnyana.

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔgyi ka lɛti na úti ɔvɔ-bu na lɛti kani na bɔdubɔsɔ bunwini.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔyawine anwu ni, nwuna ngba emeyi ese aani livo. Na aalɛ́ lili taabla anwula na alakpi akɔ.

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: Na si ɔƒɛƒɛɛ úkpo ɔ́vi-nya eli kani na anu ewiakun. Na ɔdi ɔsɔ uláti-nya kalɛkɔ muedi.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bani mɔɔyia Unwoti ni, ama na ɔɔyɔ́ úsela uwi ƒui. Na nwuna lɛƒɔndia ku ala bɔbla ulu lɛlɔ siin use ute bana bawɔ bawɔ

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔlati nése nwuna lɛgaboku úse katɔ. Na nwuna lɛga kadikɔ mɔɔdi kayawi ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Amii Katɔti batu bayikune ƒui bani muunú-nwu litemi bibo na bibemwi Unwoti.

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Amii nwuna katɔ kabla bablane lisu bani mɔɔbla-nwu kabla, bimwi-nwu.

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Amii ala ediedi ƒui ku bani lɛlɔ na ɔɔdi, biti bumwi bite Unwoti. Ami ndubumwi Unwoti ku mina kayi ƒui.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: O Katɔti, ndubumwi-ɔ ku mina kayi ƒui, ɔsika ébomo geen na eekeye ku ɔbu. Na bukeye bɔmmɔ bɔ́ka bɔ́mana-a aani kɔdi kalɛ.

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na eekeye use aani awu na akya. Na ébimi katɔ áƒala kayaa aani kevo kɔdi kpakplaa kalɛ.

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: Na átu ƒula keliekɔ ásia ntu bɔni nƒa katɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na ábla liƒlukutu na ɔdi kɛɛkɛ ɔni lɛlɔ na eelie. Na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ avwi lɛlɔ na eelie taavi.

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: Na éti ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ábla ƒula batalane. Na éti ogya linyemi ƒula kabla bablane.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: Awɔ nákya kalɔ kamɛni ƒui awodu ɔka kalɔ ɔni na lɛla biala likana-ka bɔkunku.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: Áya na ntu buwi-ka anumi aani kɔdi, na abi muedi alátina.

english_verse: Then your voice thundered! And the water flowed
translation_verse: Nsu ka édie lɛdi momoomo ni, ntu bɔmmɔ búse kalɔ bɔɔgbá

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: taayu abi ammɔ lɛlɔ na bútéduo kɔwɛ kemmo kesii kani na áƒuna éte-mu.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: Ásia ubili éte-mu kesii kani na bulakana buyi bɔvia. Na bɔsɔ buláƒɔ kalɔ ƒui lɛlɔ kudii.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: Aayá na ntukpa wɛlɛ wɛlɛ bɔni mɔɔlɛ́ kalɔ kemmo bɔɔgbá taavi ɔkwalɛ kemmo ku abi ntɛ awɛ kemmo.

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na aayá na bebuo ala betine ku bakumbweyi bamba ƒui baaní ntu na baadú bana utukwɛ.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: Aayá na ɔnantu ɔɔna teewi abi lɛlɔ. Na kalɔ kaaƒɔ́ ntu.

english_verse: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
translation_verse: Na aayá na livo lɛɛkwɛ́ teete bebuo kalɛ na bakun. Na edula aakwɛ́ teete bekyuli kalɛ bakɛ adila.

english_verse: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
translation_verse: Ɔɔkɛ́ ntɛ bɔni mɔɔkya-nwu kayi ebiti ku nnɔmii bɔni mɔɔyá nwuna anumi ekeye ku adila ani muute-nwu ɔlɔkplu.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: Na egyii enengudi kpakplaa ani na Katɔti ɔ́lɛ na Lebanon abi lɛlɔ aakɛ́ ntu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Na egyii amɛni lili na baasɛ baabla bana ayu. Na baasɛ benengudi ama baabla bana ayu na egyii akɔdi bamba ani nde mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Abi enengudi ani nákuku adi kabɛkɔ kete alakpi akɔ bese. Na atakpɛ akɔ adi besi ku betukpɛɛ ku atakpɛ akɔ bebweyi bamba keliekɔ.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: Awɔ nédie kɔbuli ka kutaatina abuli bɔka. Na ɔƒɛ lɛnɔ ɔgyi uwi ɔni na ɔɔnú.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: Awɔ nábla lɛdisa kalɛ na beƒiebuo butaalɛ taatáwia bana lɛdila usien.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Bagyata baakwanyi si baawia bebuo badi beƒie. Na baanu Unwoti anumi ka ute-ma lɛla lɛmi badi.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Na si ɔƒɛ ɔ́tu ni, beenwíni teesie teetéduo bana kɔbɛkɔ.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli lɛnɔ baayu ulu teesie bana kabla lidu akɔ na beenye bana kabla kammɔ lɛlɔ teetédu useyi uwi.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: O Unwoti ábla ala pii ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛnunda lɛlɔ. Na áya na ƒula ala ediedi áƒɔ kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Édie ɛpu na ɔ́bɛbɛ uwi bonwu na kubweyi kunengudi ku kubliidi ƒui lidu lidu pii kɔ́ƒɔ-nwu kemmo.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛkɔlɔ libendi lɛɛsia taavi. Na liƒu bebweyi bebendi lɛnɔ bakya-nwu kemmo beesié taasɔ.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Ƒula anumi kani na ala amɛni ƒui aanu ka ete-nya bana lɛdila na uwi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni na éte-ma ni, ani kani na baadi teemo.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Si áda anumi édie-ma lɛlɔ blii ni, liƒu lɛɛda-ma. Na si áda ƒula ɔƒɛƒɛɛ édie-ma lɛlɔ kemmo ni, beekpi na basɔ benwini lɛti.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: Édie ala ƒui ɔkɛnku ƒula Kɔyu lɛlɔ. Na aasɔku kalɔ kemodi taabla ɔwɔdi.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: Buuvele bɔnii Unwoti uteekeye uwi ƒui. Na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-nwu na ala ani ƒui na údie lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: Unwoti úti nwuna anumi ɔ́nu kayawi na kaakunku. Na úti kɔnu útuku abi lɛnɔ, na aalɛ́ uyɔ.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na mmu nli ngba mɛni ni, ndubo lɛnu buteedie teemwi Unwoti.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: Mbo lɛnunsia ka mina kasusu kani muuti kadubɔƒɔ-nwu anu. Ɔsika Unwoti mɔɔyá na mɔɔkɛ́ lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Buuvele ka ayila alaekpidi bablane udu na kalɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na bana udu ɔsɔ utalɛ kudii. O Katɔti, ndubumwi-ɔ ku mina kayi ƒui. Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Bɛgya Unwoti enu. Na bitaakpali-nwu lɛnyi. Bɛsu kadi bekyuli ƒui ala ani na ɔ́bla.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Bidie bumwi lɛnu bite-nwu, na bibo nwuna akɔla ala budie taatina kudu.

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Amii bani ƒui mɔɔwia Unwoti ni, lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii na bimwi-nwu lɛnyi kedee na bɛkɔliku-nwu katɔ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
translation_verse: Biti bina anu bɛsia Unwoti ku nwuna ɔyikun lɛlɔ na bitaanu-nwu anumi uwi biala.

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Binyimo nwuna akɔla ala budie taatina ani na ɔ́bla ku kalɛ na ɔ́tɛ litemi na ulu siin lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Nwuna kabla ɔblane Abraham kaba bebi na bɛdi. Na bɛdi-nwu bekyuli baƒunadi bani ndi Yakob bebi.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Unwoti ndi bula Katɔti. Na anwu mɔɔtɛku kayawi ƒui litemi.

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Nwuna anu asia lɛla lɛni na únyimi lɛlɔ uwi ƒui. Na nwuna linyese lise lite kaba mpim mpim bekyuli.

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: Ɔ́su ɔnini, “Amii na ndubuti Kanaan kalɔ ƒui lite na kana ƒui kenwini bina kadikɔ.”

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, beeemomo. Na lɛnɔ ni, baƒɔ na badi na kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: Na busie kani bakɛ beesié taavi kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ ɔ́si lɛga kadikɔ úsie lɛga kadikɔ.

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: Na ɔ́gyumana-ma ɔni na ukyuli ina unwi útanya-ma útakya. Mmomu ɔ́tɛmiku baga baga bammɔ kpakplaa na ama ɔsu.

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɔdi biala utetuku mina kadi bekyuli bani na lɛ́ƒuna. Na ɔdi utabla mina kenye bediene badi likpidi lɛdi.”

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ya na kɔka kúbo Kanaan kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ na adila ása-ma ƒui.

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: Nsu ɔ́tala ukyuli na ɔtɔ-ma anumi na Egyipte. Na anwu ndi Yoseƒ ɔni béti béye ka unwini bekyuli bamba kabla ɔblane.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: Bebo-nwu kɔgba na bákya-nwu abuala lɛgba ku limɔ.

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: Ɔ́kya kɔgba kɔmmɔ kemmo útédu ka Egyipteƒuɔ Ɔga Ƒarao kɔna kɔni kalɔ na údie úbo-nwu kemmo.

english_verse: Then the king of Egypt set Joseph free
translation_verse: Egyipteƒuɔ ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔ́ya na bédie-nwu abuala ammɔ na ɔ́ya bányonu-nwu na ɔ́kɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: Ɔga ɔmmɔ úti Yoseƒ ɔ́bla ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnu nwuna akɛla ƒui ku kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: Na úte-nwu ɔyikun ka ɔdi batɔnkune bammɔ lɛlɔ na ɔtina benengu bammɔ lɛnunda ala.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Na Yakob útélie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ aani ɔƒɔ kalɛ na kalɛkɛ kani baalɔ banii Ham.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Na mmɔ ni, Unwoti ɔ́ya na Israelƒuɔ báwɔ na bémomo geen na bákɛ ɔyikun kaduɛ bétulo bana bekisine.

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya Egyipteƒuɔ beekisi nwuna kadi bekyuli. Na bákya kɔkwɛ kukpidi bana lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Unwoti ɔ́tala Mose nwuna kabla ɔblane ku Aaron ɔni na ɔ́ƒuna.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Na bábla Katɔti akɔla ala budie taatina lidu lidu bátina-ma na Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́ya na lɛdisa lɛ́ƒɔ kalɔ kammɔ ƒui. Nsu Egyipteƒuɔ bétenu-nwu litemi.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na ntukpa bɔni nkya mmɔ ƒui búnwini ubugya, na kɔbɛ kɔmmɔ ƒui lɛnɔ kúkpi.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Unwoti údie lɛdi na bebweyi lidu lidu bani muuveyi na baata báƒɔ bana kalɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: Na ɔnantu bɔna kenye ni, Unwoti ɔ́ya na etubankɛ aayu aani ɔnantu. Na kayaa kaabwɛ ogya teebewi kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ya na bana adingyii mmo bɔni bése ƒui búbie na egyii bamba ƒui lɛnɔ áƒɛ éwi kalɔ.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti údie lɛdi na ɔ́ya na baalɔlɔ báyu esu esu na bébile bana edula.

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Na bebweyi bamɛni báyalɛ evete ƒui na bébile edula ani ƒui nkya kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ya na Egyipteƒuɔ bebi bananabi bedeedi bani ƒui nkya kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui békpi.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́kpanku Israelƒuɔ ɔ́lɛku kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ, Na béti Egyipteƒuɔ sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ƒui bátɔlɔku. Na ɔlɛne ɔdi uuubo-ma akɔ.

english_verse: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.
translation_verse: Ebiti áda Egyipteƒuɔ geen ka Israelƒuɔ bátɔlɔ-ma kalɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika bana lɛlɔ lɛ́da-ma liƒu.

english_verse: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́ya ulɔyɔ liƒlukutu bonwu lɛdi lɛ́ka lɛ́mana-ma ka bakɛ. Na ogya bonwu ɔdi lɛnɔ ɔɔda usien na anwu na baanu teesie.

english_verse: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
translation_verse: Belusiene bamɛni béye Unwoti adila na úte-ma baasɛ ku bodobodo ɔ́siku katɔ na bádi bémo.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na atakpɛ ébimi na ntu bɔ́lɛ-nwu kemmo na báni. Na ntu bɔmmɔ bɔɔgbá aani ketu na káƒɔ kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: Ɔsika únyimo linyese kedee lɛni na úse úte Abraham ɔni ndi nwuna kabla ɔblane.

english_verse: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na ɔ́tɔnku nwuna bekyuli baƒunadi ɔ́lɛku kalɔ kammɔ kemmo na beedie lɛlɔyɔ lɛnu ka bakɛ ulu.

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: Na úti bekyuli bamba kɔlɔ úte-ma. Na mmo bɔni kadi bamba bekyuli bése ku bana akɛla ƒui énwini bana ɔdi.

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla ɔmɛni úte-ma kalɛ na basia anu na badi nwuna etemila ku ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti. Bɛgya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔdia na ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ulakana na wedie kenye na Unwoti ala enengudi ani na ɔ́bla lɛlɔ. Na ɔdi lɛnɔ ulakana na wemwi-nwu lɛnɔ na wedu wawɔlɔ.

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bekyuli bani mɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ. Na baabla ala ani nse siin uwi biala kemmo.

english_verse: Remember me, Lord, when you show kindness by saving your people.
translation_verse: Unwoti, tayiƒala-mi uwi ɔni na adubɔbla lɛbuni ete bekyuli bani na áƒuna. Nyimo-mi uwi ɔni na adubɔƒɔ-ma.

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: Ya na ami lɛnɔ makɛ ebiti na kɔsia kɔni na ƒula badi bani na áƒuna badubɔkɛ kemmo. Na lɛlɔ lɛni ndubɔyɔ ƒula kadi bekyuli ni, ami lɛnɔ lɛlɔ lɛmmɔ lɛyɔ-mi.

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bula bati kuuku bákya Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, bétenu ƒula akɔla ala budie taatina kalɔ. Na bétenyimo ƒula lɛƒɔndia pii lɛni na ábla-ma lɛnɔ. Mmomu báta bénye-ɔ lɛlɔ na Ɛpugyie ɔmmɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: Nsu na ƒula lɛnyi ɔsu ni, áƒɔ-ma ngba kalɛ na bekyuli banu ƒula ɔyikun bati.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: Údie lɛdi na Ɛpugyie ɔmmɔ ɔ́kwii kɔnakunwi. Na ɔkpanku-ma na bávi-nwu kemmo aani kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ na bakɛ.

english_verse: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na báƒɔ linyese lɛni na Unwoti úse-ma úse mmɔ bádi. Na bémwi-nwu.

english_verse: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
translation_verse: Nsu útaƒɔ uwi ɔdi asa na báyiƒala ala ani na Unwoti ɔ́bla. Na bétenye bátanu-nwu anumi na banu lɛla lɛni na ɔdubo-ma bɔsu.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Mmomu ala ani mɔɔda-ma ɔkwɛ kama kani na basia na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ. Na mmɔ kani na bákɔku Katɔti bánu.

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu úte-ma lɛla lɛni na béye-nwu. Nsu ɔ́ya na ɔlɛ ukpidi ɔdi úbeduo-ma akɔ.

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: Kalɔ kébimi na kébweli Datan ku Abiram ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: Ogya ɔ́bwɛ úbayu bekyuli bani ƒui nsiaku Abiram kama na ɔ́kyula balalane bammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
translation_verse: Na béti sika ugyiedi ɔdi bábla ɔmantɛ akɔ ubi ɔdi udu na Sinai kɔbi kaƒɔna na baakpá-nwu.

english_verse: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu uwi ɔni na ɔ́bla kasusu ka ɔyila-nwuna bekyuli udu ni, Mose ɔni ndi nwuna kabla ɔblane ɔƒunadi unye ɔda-ma na úvele Katɔti ka nwuna kɔnyi kɔyɔ-nwu na ɔda-ma bɔkyula ɔya.

english_verse: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
translation_verse: Ka bátaƒɔ Katɔti linyese bátadi ɔsu ni, kalɔ kammɔ kátada-ma ebiti.

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: Na bakya bana adi nvo kemmo baabla unyeƒi na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ɔni na bétenu Unwoti lɛdi na badi-ni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Unwoti úbo-ma lɛnimi enwu na ɔsu-ma ka si bátanu kaduɛ ni, ɔdubɔyila-ma udu ƒui na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ.

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Na Peor mmɔ ni, muna kadi bekyuli béti bana lɛlɔ bátámana baƒiɔ bani baalɔ banii Baal lɛlɔ. Na baadú bebuo taakpa lɛla lɛni neeebo ngba.

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: Na bákya Unwoti kɔnyi na bana ɔbladu ɔmɛni ɔsu. Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔlɛ buɛ ɔdi ubeduo-ma akɔ.

english_verse: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
translation_verse: Na Meriba kɔtu mmɔ na Israel kadi bekyuli bákya Unwoti kɔnyi. Na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu na Mose ɔ́kɛ nwuna ɔgbankpi.

english_verse: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
translation_verse: Israelƒuɔ bétékpo kadi kadi bekyuli nsu béni na bátayila-ma udu aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔ́su-ma.

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: Mmomu básalaku-ma na basiaku bana ɔbladu kama na baabla lɛla linwi.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti bekyuli bébenwini baƒiɔ bakpane. Na ɔmmɔ geen náya na Katɔti ɔ́yila-ma udu.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: Na beeƒie ama alati bebi bananabi ku belekubi muedi taadu teeti taakpa Kanaan baƒiɔ.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: Bebi bani naaagyi lɛla lɛdi ubugya na beewi kalɔ. Na báya na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui keesé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.
translation_verse: Na bana ɔbladu ɔmmɔ ɔsu ama alati lɛnɔ beesé lɛlɔ. Na ɔmɛni ɔ́tina ka bálɛ Katɔti kama.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔ́ya na Unwoti Katɔti kɔnyi kɔ́kɔ katɔ kúbu na nwuna bekyuli lɛlɔ na bana lɛlɔ lɛsɔ liláda-nwu kubiti.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti údie-ma atu na kadi bamba bekyuli bada-ma beesusu kalɛ biala na baayɔ́. Na bana bekisine mmomu mɔɔdi-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
translation_verse: Bana bekisine bamɛni baanya-ma taakya uwi biala kemmo ɔni na beeebo lɛla lɛdi na babla.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: Unwoti uudie nwuna bekyuli bamɛni kɔlɛ kɔlɛ. Nsu bɔta kani baata teenye-nwu lɛlɔ. Na ekpidi ammɔ áya na badaku udu bɔyii ƒui.

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti uunú-ma keku si ala étulo-ma na baakpali-nwu.

english_verse: You kept your agreement and were so merciful
translation_verse: Ɔ́si nwuna lɛƒɔndia ɔsu ni, na kaƒɔ kasɔ kaakywí-nwu. Na únyimo bunyimi bɔni na únyimiku-ma.

english_verse: that their enemies had pity on them.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ya na bana bekisine baanu-ma kɔnyana.

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Bula Unwoti Katɔti, ƒɔ-bu ngba! Na asiku-bu kɔlɔ bamba lɛlɔ asɔku abásala. Ya na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-bu na bumwi ƒula lɛnyi kedee ku kudu.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Bimwi Unwoti ɔni ndi Israelƒuɔ Katɔti lɛnyi. Bimwi-nwu ɔsi ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui. Bɛya na ukyuli biala ɔsu ɔnini, “Ɔsia lɛni!” Bimwi Unwoti.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛgya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔdia na ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord has rescued from trouble should praise him,
translation_verse: Na amii bani ƒui na ɔ́ƒɔ-mii ngba na údie-mii ɔ́lɛku bina bekisine enu kemmo ni, biti bumwi bite-nwu.

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: Ɔsika anwu násɔku-mii úbasala na bina kalɔ lɛlɔ ɔ́siku kaƒɔ na ɔƒɛ katukɔ ku kanukɔ. Na ɔ́si katɔ kakɛ úsie kada kakɛ lɛnɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.
translation_verse: Badi bábwɛ béduo kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo bakɛ baaví na baaagyi kesii kani na basia beduo ɔma unengudi ɔdi kemmo na belie mmɔ.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Kɔka ku utukwɛ kani mɔɔda-ma ɔni na basɔ beeebo lɛnunsia lɛdi ka badubo ngba bulie.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na báva bákpali Unwoti na bana lɛbibo kemmo. Na údie-ma sɔsɔ.

english_verse: At once he brought you to a town.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́tɔnku-ma ɔ́siaku ulu ligeen lɛlɔ útéduoku ɔma ɔni kemmo na bákɛ keliekɔ.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ka bekyuli bamɛni ƒui bágya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔ́yɔ-ma na ɔ́bla ala ebendi úte-ma.

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: Bani na utukwɛ ɔɔda ni, uute-ma ntu na baaní. Na bani na kɔka mɔɔda-ma ni, uute ama lɛnɔ adila abuni na baadi teemo.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Kasuudikɔ na badi beli na lɛla biala lise-ma suu. Na badi lɛnɔ ni, béƒie-ma bákya ɔtɔ na beebó abi na batɛ kɔgba kemmo.

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: Ɔsika báta bénye Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui lɛlɔ na béni nwuna bɔlɛ.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lítu-ma na kabla kpakplaa kani na baabla ɔsu. Na badubo bubuli ɔni na ɔdi uuubo na webunku-ma muedi.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na báva bákpali Unwoti na bana lɛbibo kemmo. Na údie-ma sɔsɔ.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na bálɛ kasuudikɔ bonwu kani kemmo na bakya mmɔ. Na bana kɔgba kɔ́ƒɛ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ka bekyuli bamɛni ƒui bágya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔ́yɔ-ma na ɔ́bla ala ebendi úte-ma.

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: Kɔyakun kɔni bákalɛ ku abuala lidu ku kɔbuɛlɛ ni, ɔ́ƒɛ-ku ƒui kede kede.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Badi badi badɔlɔdi ɔ́si bana likyulikpi ala bɔbla ɔsu. Na badi lɛnɔ bana ekpidi ani baabla ɔsu beebó abi pii.

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: Adila adi asɔ aláda-ma ɔkwɛ na básɔ bátagyunku kaƒiɔtɔ.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na báva bákpali Unwoti na lɛbibo kemmo na údie-ma.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: Ɔ́bɔku ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ na ɔ́ba-ma na básɔ bétekpi.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ka bekyuli bamɛni ƒui bágya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔ́yɔ-ma na ɔ́bla ala ebendi úte-ma.

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka babla enugya akpala bete-nwu. Na bedie lɛlɔyɔ lɛnu bebo ala ebendi ani na ɔ́bla kudu batina kadi ƒui.

english_verse: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Badi bábla kabla na lɛkɔlɔ libendi kemmo na ɛpu anumi. Na ɔmmɔ kemmo na bákɛ bana limeyi lɛdila.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: Bánu Unwoti ablala ebendi lidu lidu lɛni na ɔ́bla na ntu bɔmmɔ anumi.

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: Ɔsika uudie lɛdi na ntu bɔmmɔ bɔɔnwanɛ lɛlɔ na bɔɔta ku avlɔvɔ bonwu taakɔ katɔ.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Lɛkɔlɔ lɛmɛni lɛɛkɔ́ avlɔvɔ bonwu amɛni lɛlɔ aani abi bonwu teesie katɔ katɔ. Na lɛɛsɔ taabayu teeduo kalɔ kalɔ aani kɔwɛ kemmo. Na liƒu bonwu lɛni mɔɔda-ma ɔ́ya na báyila bana lɛnunsia biala na ɔgbankpi ɔni kemmo béduo ɔsu.

english_verse: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uubó-ma taavinku na baagbánta aani ntɛ bekpine ɔni na bana kɔkwɛ ƒui kɔ́sa.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na báva bákpali Unwoti na bana lɛbibo kemmo na údie-ma sɔsɔ.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ya na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔmmɔ ɔ́da búkpo ɔ́ya na avlɔvɔ ku lɛla biala lɛ́bla buɛɛ.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛ́yɔ-ma ka lɛla biala lɛ́bla buɛɛ ɔsu. Na ɔ́kpanku-ma úbeduo kalɛlɛkɔ buɛɛ na kesii kani baayɔ́.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ka bekyuli bamɛni ƒui bágya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔ́yɔ-ma na ɔ́bla ala ebendi úte-ma.

english_verse: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bemwi-nwu na bakɔliku-nwu lɛnyi bonwu lɛmmɔ katɔ na batɔnkune ƒui ku bekyuli ƒui akɔ.

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔbla na ntukpa bɔɔkwii teenwini kalɔ kakwiidi. Na ɔɔbla na abiɔ aakwii na kalɔ kammɔ kaayaki ntu.

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔbla kalɔ kani mɔɔdia adila lɛnɔ na keenwíni kalɔ kagyani kani mbo mma na kaládia edula. Ɔsika kalɔ kammɔ bekyuli badi bekyuli bekpidi.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na Unwoti ɔɔkana na kalɔ kakwiidi keenwíni ntu kalɔ. Na kalɔ kani mɔɔyaki ntu lɛnɔ ɔɔbla na abiɔ aalɛ́ mmɔ.

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔyá na bekyuli bani na kɔka kɔɔda baadá bana kuliekɔ na mmɔ na beelie taakɛ lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: Na baatuma mmo na baalɛ adingyii na baakɛ́ edula pii na mmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: Na uute nwuna badi kusɛ kusɛ na baawɔ taasia kama. Na bana bebuo lɛnɔ baláƒana kudii.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Bekisine baakana na beekpóku Katɔti bekyuli na banya-ma bakya lɛbibo kemmo.

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti uuti kɔnyi taakya-ma na lɛla lɛni baabla ɔsu. Na ɔɔbɔku-ma taatákya kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo na bakɛ baaví ɔni na baaagyi kesii kani bésela.

english_verse: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
translation_verse: Nsu bani muubó abi na baayaki ala ni, uudie-ma taalɛku bana lɛbibo kemmo na baasɔ taawɔ teeyile bana kɔduli aani baƒonu kalɛ.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli babuni ƒui baanu ɔmɛni na ebiti aada-ma. Na balalane ama kɔƒa ndubo-ma bukpo.

english_verse: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala na ɔ́da anu ni, use atu na unu etemila amɛni. Na ɔnu ɔti kalɛ na Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli uwi biala.

english_verse: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
translation_verse: Mina kayi kélie-mi kalɔ na awɔ ɔsu, O Katɔti, na ndubudie kɔgya ku lɛdi mini mini limwi-ɔ.

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: Ndubɔta ɔtanta tutuutu ku mina kayi ƒui na liti ɔbentaa ku agyala ntágyila ɔƒɛ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ndubɔgya-a enu na bekyuli ƒui benu. Na ndubudie lɛnu limwi-ɔ na kadi biala bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Unwoti, kalɛ na aayɔ́ bekyuli uwi biala ku kalɛ na aadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ úbomo geen aani kalɛ na bɔɔnu kalɛ na kayaa kébomo.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, ya na bekyuli ƒui bakɔliku ƒula lɛnyi katɔ besienku ɔgyu kakaaka. Na banu kalɛ na eekeye na kesi kesii na kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Unwoti, awɔ ɔlati ti ƒula kɔdianu na ekpo ete-bu ku ƒula ɔyikun kalɛ na ƒula bekyuli bani na aayɔ́ mmɔ bakɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Katɔti úse kenye ɔsiku nwuna kakpakɔ Katɔma kede kemmo ɔnini, “Lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi ka lile Sekem ɔma ku Sukot Ɔkwalɛ ɔmmɔ lite mina bekyuli.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Ami mbo Gilead ku Manase. Nda Eƒraim aani mina kagabwa. Na nda Yuda aani mina ɔgagyii.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Na Moab use aani lɛkyami lɛni kemmo na mɔɔƒɔ mina enu. Na Edom lɛlɔ na mɔɔnya lɛgba. Na Ƒilistia na muunye teebo kudu ka lɛ́di lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, geen geen na anii éni-bu na aaadubo-bu bɔtɔnku na kekpokɔ na ekpo bula bekisine ete-bu?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Buvele kpo-ma te-bu, ɔsika ukyuli ɔyawine kebunku keeebo kɔsia kɔdi.

english_verse: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku Katɔti lɛlɔ ni, bɔdubɔdi lɛlɔ. Ɔsika anwu ndubɔnya bula bekisine ususu kalɔ.

english_verse: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
translation_verse: Katɔti, mɔɔkɔliku-ɔ lɛnyi katɔ, anwuɔsu tetile atu na alakpete-mi.

english_verse: Destructive and deceitful lies are told about me,
translation_verse: Ɔsika balalane ku ɔkɔ banyine báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ. Na baasu ɔkɔ ala na mina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and hateful things are said for no reason.
translation_verse: Báda-mi ulu ku bana enyekpi na beekpóku-mi ɔni na ńtabla-ma lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyɔ́-ma ku kaƒɔ nwaa na mɔɔkpali katɔ na bana lili ina ka baláwia-mi kadia.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ƒui kama ni, likpidi na béti bágya-mi enu na lɛbuni lɛni lɛ́bla-ma kenye. Na bukisi lɛnɔ béti básiaku-mi na mina bɔyɔ kenye.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: Na baasu muedi banini, “Ya na bekyuli bekpidi badi bada-nwu kenye ka ɔɔbla likpidi. Na bana ɔdi ɔni-nwu uboku litemi katɛkɔ.

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Na si bátɛku-nwu litemi ni, na badu-nwu kɔtɔ. Na bedie batina-nwu ka nwuna katɔ bɔkpali bɔdi likpidi.

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: Bɛya na ukyuli bamba unye nwuna kalabla kenye na nwuna ngba bɔda liku.

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: Na nwuna bebi benwini bekpinebi na ulekudi lɛnɔ unwini ukpinele.

english_verse: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
translation_verse: Na nwuna bebi benwini ala bevelene bani mɔɔví teevele ala. Na bagya-ma balɛku atɔnku ani kemmo na béte-ma na bakya kemmo.

english_verse: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani na ɔda kayu ƒui beƒie lɛla biala na ubo baƒɔ. Na baƒɔ bekpeli kabla biala na ɔ́bla úse baƒɔ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala utabla-nwu lɛƒɔndia lɛdi iye ɔdi ɔnu nwuna bebi bani nénwini bekpinebi mmɔ kɔnyana.

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: Na nwuna kaba kani na údie ƒui bekpi basa. Na ɔdi ɔsɔ utenyimo nwuna lɛnyi na kaba bekyuli bani ndubɔsia kama kemmo.

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: Unwoti unyimo nwuna bati kuuku ekpidi na uteti uni ekpidi utakyiɛ-nwu.

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: Ɔya na beteebo abi uwi ƒui na bana udu ɔyii ƒui na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ. Na ɔdi ɔsɔ uleti-ma lɛlɔ kasusu.

english_verse: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
translation_verse: “Ɔsika ukyuli ɔmɛni útabla ukyuli ɔdi lɛƒɔndia lɛdi kudii. Mmomu ɔ́bla bawabane ku bani na ala eekpóku kalala úti útédu ka békpi muedi.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: Ewida etemila sɔɔn nátaalɛ-nwu kenye. Anwuɔsu ewida ammɔ ebo anwu lɛnɔ lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔɔgyi kalɛ na beete ukyuli kusɛ kusɛ. Anwuɔsu kusɛ kusɛ utasiaku anwu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: Bekyuli buwida bɔdi-nwu udu na ɔkya aani awu. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu anwu ɔlati ewida eteekpoku-nwu aani kalɛ na ntu bɔɔƒɔ́ ukyuli adala ƒui. Na uduo-nwu ekubi kemmo aani kalɛ na nnɔmii buuduo ukyuli ɔlɔna kemmo.

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Na ewida ammɔ enwini enyimi-nwu aani kɔdi kalɛ na ada-nwu aani kabuli kani ndubɔda-nwu kavobi úselaku ƒui.”

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ya na ala ani ƒui na mina bekisine baawia mɛni ebo-ma lɛlɔ lɛni kani ku bani ƒui mɔɔsu ala ammɔ bene udu na mina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Unwoti Katɔti, ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛnyi kedee ɔsu ni, kpo te-mi, ɔsika aayɔ́ bekyuli uwi biala.

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Ɔwabane ɔni mɔɔyaki ala uwi biala kemmo na ndi. Na nsɔ liiibo lɛnunsia lɛdi na mina kayi kemmo.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na kɔyu kɔɔyii taakya si kadi kaayu ni, lɛni na ami ukyuli umodi ɔmmɔ mɔɔyii taakya. Na nse aani kebweyi blii kani na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ úbo útáva kɔmadɔ.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: Lílie kɔka laa na mina akɔnkɔ aatɔ́-mi, na mina ɔlɔna ɔ́kwii útálɛ ku ekubi.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Na si bekyuli bánu-mi na baamá-mi. Na uwi biala na bánu-mi ni, lili kani na baakunku taama.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, mina Katɔti, bunku-mi na edie-mi ɔkɛnku ƒula bɔyɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: Ya na mina bekisine banu bati geen ka awɔ ɔlati néti ƒula enu edie-mi.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Si ina beewida-mi ni, lɛɛɛdubo bɔkpete. Na si báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ ni, na aya na kɔƒa kukpo-ma. Nsu ya na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ ƒula kabla ɔblane.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Ya na kɔƒa kukpo mina bekisine, na kɔƒa kɔmmɔ kɔbla aani kɔdi kɔni na benyimi.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: Ndubɔgya Unwoti enu ku kudu. Na ndubo-nwu bumwi na nwuna kadi bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
translation_verse: Ɔsika úkpo úte ɔwabane na údie-nwu ɔ́lɛku bekyuli bani nádu-nwu kukpi kɔtɔ enu kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su mina Unwoti ɔnini, “Sɔ lie-mi kɔdianu wetédu uwi ɔni na meti ƒula bekisine makya-a lɛgba kalɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubɔya na adi lɛga asi Sion avia ƒula bekisine kalɔ lɛlɔ muedi.

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, adubulie ƒula lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na ada ƒula agala. Na ama bani na ásɔku ábla ɔwɔdi aani ɔtanta amii ƒui badubɔda balɛ ƒula keliekɔ kedee mmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Unwoti úse kenye na uláda ulavia kenye kammɔ. Ɔ́su ɔnini, “Adi ɔkpane úsela uwi ƒui na Melkisedek ɔkpane bɔdi ulu lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: Unwoti unye-ɔ kɔdianu kakɛ, na limeyi lɛni na ɔdubɔkɛ kɔnyi ni, ɔdubɔyila baga udu.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔtɛku kayawi bekyuli ƒui litemi. Na ɔdu kayawi lɛlɔ badine ƒui. Na bekpine sɔɔn ndubɔƒɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔni ntu na ntukpa biala kemmo na ɔɔyɔ́ uwi ɔni na uukpó taadi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti. Amii kadi ƒui bekyuli, bimwi Unwoti lɛnyi. Ami ndubɔgya-nwu enu lɛsiku mina kayi kemmo ƒui na kesii kani na nwuna bekyuli bása beli.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Unwoti ablala ébomo geen. Na bekyuli bani nwuna ablala ammɔ aayɔ́-ma kaƒɔ ni, baawia-nya kalɔ benu.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: Nwuna lɛla biala na ɔɔbla liikeye na uudie nwuna lɛgadi keyi. Na nwuna ala bɔbla buse siin úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na nwuna ablala ammɔ ébomo ɔsu ni, ɔ́ya na bulayiƒala-nya kudii. Unwoti ubo lɛƒɔndia na ɔɔnu kɔnyana lɛnɔ.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔkpali-nwu na baabu-nwu ni, uute-ma bana lɛdila uwi biala. Na ulayiƒala nwuna bunyimi bɔni na únyimi.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
