translation_verse: Unwoti údie ɔ́tina nwuna bekyuli kalɛ na ubo ɔyikun na ala ani na ɔ́bla úte-bu ɔsu. Ɔsi kalɛ na ɔ́ya na kadi bamba bekyuli kɔlɔ ƒui kúnwini abu kɔdi ɔsu.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: Na lɛla biala na ɔ́bla ni, bɔƒiɔ bɔdi buuubo-nwu kemmo. Na nwuna ɔda bubo bɔdi kama kekpokɔ.

english_verse: They are true and right and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Bɔdi litemi geen lɛni ndubunye siin bute uwi ƒui.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: Unwoti uukpó taaƒɔ nwuna bekyuli. Na ulalɛ bunyimi bɔni na únyimi ku nwuna bekyuli kama kudii. Use kedee na ɔlɛka bɔyia-nwu.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyia Unwoti uusé kalɔ taada anu. Na bani ƒui mɔɔsia nwuna ɔda bubo anu ni, beenú ala abuni kalɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na ɔlɛka buteemwi-nwu uwi biala kemmo.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti. Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyia Unwoti na ɔɔdi nwuna ɔda bubo etemila ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: Nwuna bawɔ badubɔkɛ ɔyikun geen na bana kadi bekyuli akɔ. Na kaba kani bekyuli nse siin na Katɔti anumi ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma geen.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Na badubumo ku akɛla lidu lidu na bana kaduli. Na kalɛ baabla ala siin ɔsu badubulie kpi uwi biala.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: Na bani ƒui mɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ ni, badubɔnu bukeye na kesii kani na lɛdisa lɛkya. Ɔsika baabla lɛƒɔndia na baanu bekyuli kɔnyana na bese siin.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni muuvó ala teete bekyuli ku kaƒɔ ƒaa na ɔɔbla nwuna ala ƒui ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni na use siin ulébo kalɔ kudii. Mmomu bekyuli badubo-nwu butaakali uwi biala.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɔtɔtɔ ɔdi lɛnɔ ulágyu-nwu ina bi mɔɔlɛ́. Ɔsika nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi bubo ɔkplu na Unwoti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Kayi biala kelékpoku-nwu iye liƒu lɛdi lilada-nwu, ɔsika ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di ka nwuna bekisine ƒui badubɔkya-nwu lili kalɔ.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: Uute bekyuli bani mɔɔyaki ala ku kaƒɔ ƒaa, na uláda lɛbuni bɔbla taaya kudii. Na bekyuli badububo-nwu kudu ka ubo ɔyikun sɔsɔ.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Na balalane badubɔnu ɔmɛni na ɔƒɛ ɔda-ma. Badubɔdu anyi bada na babla lɛla biala. Nsu kɔnu kulétuku-ma lɛla lɛni baawia kudii.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti. Amii Unwoti kabla bablane ƒui, bimwi-nwu lɛnyi.

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Bimwi Unwoti ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si ɔƒɛ katukɔ útédu kanukɔ ni, bibo Unwoti lɛnyi kudu bimwi-nwu.

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Unwoti mɔɔdi kadi ƒui bekyuli lɛlɔ. Na nwuna bukeye bɔ́kɔ bɔ́via kayaa ƒui.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Ɔma nse aani bula Unwoti Katɔti ɔni nli nwuna lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na katɔ katɔ ƒui?

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: Uli mmɔ ɔɔnu katɔ ku kalɔ ala ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: Anwu mɔɔda bawabane teedie bana kɔwaba kemmo. Na bani mɔɔyaki ala ƒui ɔɔda-ma teedie bana ala kevelekɔ.

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔyá na ama ku lɛlɔ badine ku bekyuli bani náƒɔ lɛnyi ƒui baabla unwi.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɔɔyá na bedinkɔ baawɔ na lɛlɔyɔ lɛɛkya kaduli kemmo. Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Israel kadi bekyuli bávi bálɛ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ kesii kani na ama Yakob kaba kemmo bebi badi baƒɔ ni,

english_verse: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́bla Yuda nwuna kakpakɔ kedee na ɔɔdi Israelƒuɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Ɛpugyie ɔ́nu ɔmɛni na ɔ́bwɛ lɛlɔ ntɛ. Na Yordan Ketu kédi kénye na kasɔ kalagba.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: O Ɛpugyie, bi mɔɔlɛ́ku-ɔ na ábwɛ lɛlɔ ntɛ lɛni? Na Yordan, bi ɔsu na édi énye kɔnakunwi lɛni, na ásɔ alagba?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: O amii kalɔ ku kana lɛlɔ ala, lɛlɔ litaatɔ-mii ku bɔyia ka Unwoti ɔni ndi Yakob Katɔti ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ ɔsu.

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: Anwu mɔɔyá na ntu bɔɔbwɛ taalɛ atakpɛ kemmo. Na agyasu eenwíni abiɔ ani mɔɔyu.

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, awɔ na ɔdi ka bumwi, na ɔɔɔdi abu. Awɔ kani na ɔ́manku ka buti bumwi bute, ɔsika aayɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi na asia ƒula litemi kama lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka kadi bamba bekyuli beye-bu banii, “Wɛ na bina Katɔti ɔkya?”

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: Bula Katɔti ɔkya katɔ na ɔɔbla lɛla lɛni mɔɔyɔ́-nwu kaƒɔ.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Bávɔ-nya na ebo kenye, nsu belétemi. Na bebo anumi, nsu balanu.

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: Bebo atu, nsu belenu. Bebo enwu, nsu balaƒɔ ala ɔnyi.

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Bebo enu, nsu beletuku lɛla lɛdi taanu. Bebo lɛgba, nsu belesie. Na belédie lɛdi taasiku ɔkwɛ kemmo.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani návɔ ala ammɔ udu bélieku ala ani na bávɔ mmɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Na lɛni kani na bani néti bana anu basia-nya na báƒɔ-nya bádi mmɔ lɛnɔ bese.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: O Israel kadi, bise kayi na Unwoti lɛlɔ. Anwu muubunku-mii na ɔɔgyumana-mii.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Aaron ku bakpane kasala, bise kayi na Unwoti lɛlɔ. Anwu muubunku-mii na ɔɔgyumana-mii.

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Amii bani mɔɔkya lili kalɔ teete Unwoti ƒui bise kayi na Unwoti lɛlɔ. Anwu muubunku-mii na ɔɔgyumana-mii.

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Unwoti uuti-bu lɛlɔ kasusu uwi ndi uwi na ɔdubute-bu kusɛ kusɛ. Ɔdubute Israel kaba bebi kusɛ kusɛ. Na ɔdubute Aaron ku nwuna bakpane kasala kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: Na bani ƒui na beeti ɔbu teete Unwoti ni, Unwoti ɔdubute-ma kusɛ kusɛ ama bani mbo kenyekɔ ku bani neeebo kenyekɔ na bekyuli akɔ ƒui.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔya na bɛwɔ na bimomo amii ku bina bebi ƒui.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔni nédie katɔ ku kalɔ ute-mii kusɛ kusɛ!

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Unwoti mɔɔdi lɛlɔ na katɔ kakaaka ƒui. Na úti kalɔ kammɔ ɔ́kya bayawine lɛlɔ bɔnu kalɔ.

english_verse: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Bekpine belemwi Unwoti. Ama bani ƒui na bébi ala na kalɔ kemmo mmɔ belémwi Unwoti.

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Nsu abu amu bɔdubumwi Unwoti ka ɔsi ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui. Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_verse: I love you, Lord! You answered my prayers.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyɔ́ Unwoti, ɔsika únu-mi lɛla lɛni na muuwulo teevele-nwu.

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: Na ka uusé atu na uunú-mi bɔkpali ɔsu ni, ndubo-nwu butaakpali uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Kukpi ɔgbankpi abuli ényimi-mi. Na kekpine kénwini aani liƒu kakpagyuɛ kani ndubo-mi budie.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́kpali Unwoti lɛnyi nnii, “O Unwoti, die-mi!”

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔnu kɔnyana na use siin. Bula Katɔti ɔɔnu kɔnyana.

english_verse: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani neeebo kablakɔ kadi ni, Unwoti ɔɔda-ma kɔkɔɔkɔ. Na uwi ɔni na líduo ɔgbankpi kemmo ni, anwu nédie-mi.

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: Ndubɔkɛ kayi na lilie ƒaa, ɔsika Unwoti ɔ́bla-mi lɛƒɔndia lɛni ƒui na mɔɔwia.

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: Ɔsika awɔ Unwoti édie-mi ásiku kukpi kemmo. Na áya na lɛ́da buwulo lɛ́ya. Na áda-mi na ńtebuli.

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: Na nli mɔɔdi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ geen na bayawine akɔ.

english_verse: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
translation_verse: Lɛ́ƒɔ Katɔti lɛ́di, anwuɔsu na mɔɔsu ka ala eekpóku-mi na mɔɔyɔ́ likpi muedi.

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: Ina uwi ɔni na kayi kaakpulu-mi na ɔ́bla-mi dɛye dɛye ni, lɛ́su nnini, “Ɔkɔ banyine kani na bekyuli ƒui badi.”

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: Bi na ndubɔkana na lite Unwoti na ala abuni ani ƒui na ɔ́bla úte-mi ɔsu?

english_verse: I will pour out an offering of wine to you, and I will pray in your name because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Ndubuti ɔɔƒɛɛ ku ntɛ minimini etela mbakpa lite Unwoti na lɛgya-nwu enu ka ɔ́ƒɔ-mi ngba ɔsu.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
translation_verse: Na ala ani kenye na líse ka meboku Unwoti ni, ndubuti-nya liboku na kadi ƒui anumi.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: Kaƒɔ kalayɔ-ɔ ka lɛla lɛdi lɛya na ƒula ukyuli kedee ɔdi ukpi.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ƒula kabla ɔblane na ndi na mɔɔbla kabla aani mina uni kalɛ. Áƒɛ kɔgba kɔni nda-mi.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people
translation_verse: Na ala ani kenye na líse-ɔ ni, ndubuti-nya liboku-ɔ na kadi bekyuli anumi.

english_verse: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Unwoti kaduli na ndubuti-nya liboku na awɔ Yerusalem bekyuli anumi. Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Amii kadi ƒui bekyuli, bimwi Unwoti lɛnyi. Amii bekyuli ƒui, bimwi-nwu.

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔɔbla-bu lɛƒɔndia, na ɔɔdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ teete nwuna bekyuli uwi ƒui. Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Bɛgya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔdia na ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui bɛsu bɛnii “Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.”

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Bɛya na Aaron ku nwuna bakpane kasala basu banini “Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.”

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔyia Unwoti basu banini, “Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.”

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ala eekpóku-mi geen ni, lɛ́kpali Unwoti na únu úte-mi na údie-mi na mina lɛbibo kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: Unwoti unyeku-mi, anwuɔsu lɛɛɛdubo bɔyia. Bi na ukyuli ɔdubɔkana-mi bɔbla?

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Unwoti unye-mi kama ka ubunku-mi anwuɔsu bekyuli bani muukisi-mi ƒui ni, mɔɔnu-ma aani bekyuli bani lɛlɔ na lɛ́ɛdi.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: Ɔdia ka ukyuli ukeli utátamiku Unwoti utulo ka asia ukyuli ɔdi lɛnu.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kadi ƒui bekyuli bani muukisi-mi báka bámana-mi nsu lɛ́bɔku-ma ƒui na Unwoti lɛnyi kemmo!

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Báka bámana-mi ƒui na benye lɛƒɛnyi ƒui lɛlɔ, nsu lɛ́bɔku-ma ƒui na Unwoti lɛnyi kemmo.

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: Báka bámana-mi aani banwɛnwɛ na bana anumi égyie na mina lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na lɛnyɛ ogya ɔɔda. Nsu lɛ́bɔku-ma ƒui na Unwoti lɛnyi kemmo.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: Bénye-mi lɛlɔ kpakplaa ɔni na kébu blii na badi-mi lɛlɔ. Nsu Unwoti úbunku-mi.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: Katɔti mɔɔkya-mi ɔyikun, na nwuna lɛnyi kani ndi mina kekpo ɔnu ɔni muudie. Na anwu kani náƒɔ-mi ngba.

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: Unwoti nédie nwuna kɔnu na ɔ́tina nwuna ɔyikun geen mmɔ na ɔ́di lɛlɔ. Unwoti ɔmmɔ ndi ɔyikune!”

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Lɛɛɛdubo bukpi, mmomu ndubulie ngba na lɛka Unwoti ablala lɛsu bekyuli.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́ni-mi kɔtu kpakplaa, nsu útaya na likpi.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Lɛmi ƒula kakpakɔ kayakun kani na áklibi ése éte bekyuli bani nse siin, na lɛsia-ka kemmo liduo mbagya-a enu.

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: Aanu Unwoti kakpakɔ ɔban kayakun kani kemmo na bekyuli bani nse siin badubɔsia beduo.

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: Mɔɔgyá-a enu ka énu-mi bɔkpali na áya na lɛ́di mina bekisine lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Lɛtabi lɛni na batune béni báva ni, ani nébenwini lɛtabi lɛni náƒɔ kuye lítulo na atabi ƒui akɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: Unwoti nábla lɛla bonwu lɛmɛni. Na lɛ́ƒɔ-bu anu geen.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛmɛni na Unwoti údie úte-bu ka bɔdi lɛlɔ. Bɛya bɔkɛ lɛlɔyɔ na ebiti ada-bu na limeyi lɛmmɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: Ƒɔ-bu ngba, O Unwoti, buvele bɔda-a! Ya na bula kabla ƒui katɛ kete-bu.

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: Bimwi anwu ɔni ndubo na Unwoti lɛnyi kemmo. Kusɛ kusɛ ɔsiaku-ɔ ɔsiku Unwoti kakpakɔ mɛni.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: Unwoti ndi Katɔti ɔni náya na bula anumi ékeye ka bɔ́di lɛlɔ. Bɛƒɛ kugyii kɔgba ku evete bɛda na bɛkɛ lisu ku ɔbu na bɛka bɛmana lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ bitédu kesii kani nse kedee mmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Awɔ ndi mina Katɔti na ndubɔgya-a enu. Na ndubɔkɔliku-ɔ lɛnyi katɔ, ɔsika awɔ ndi mina Katɔti.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Bɛgya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔdia na ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bekyuli bani na likpidi bɔbla buuubo-ma keliela kemmo. Mmomu beelie ngba na Unwoti ɔda bubo kenye.

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: Na lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bani ƒui mɔɔsia nwuna ɔda bubo anu na baadi-mu lɛlɔ ku bana kayi ƒui.

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: Na balábla likpidi lɛdi, mmomu baasia Unwoti kama uwi biala.

english_verse: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
translation_verse: Unwoti, awɔ néti ƒula ɔda bubo éte-bu na ásu-bu ka bɔdi-mu lɛlɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: Mɔɔwia kpakplaa geen ka lɛdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: Na si lɛ́kana na lɛ́di ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ƒui kaduɛ ni, kɔƒa kulékpo-mi.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: Ndubɔtɛya kalɛ na ƒula litemi lɛɛnu ala kemmo siin. Na limwi-ɔ ku kayi kani nse sɛɛn.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Ndubɔdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ geen na lɛɛɛdubo-mu kama bɔlɛ kudii.

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: Mɔɔkya ɔkplu ka liti mina ɔyikun ƒui lɛbla ƒula kabla. Anwuɔsu gyumana-mi kalɛ na neeenwini kama naaakya ƒula ɔda bubo kudii.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: Lɛ́klibi ƒula litemi lɛ́kya mina kayi kemmo kalɛ na naaabla likpidi lɛdi naaaƒiɔ-ɔ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Unwoti, muumwi ƒula lɛnyi. Tina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: Na ɔda bubo bɔni na éte-bu ni, ndubɔkɔ-mu lɛsa lite bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔsia ƒula ɔda bubo kama ku ebiti litulo kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔsiaku lɛkɛ bonwu kama ku ebiti.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: Ndubo-mu kemmo buteeduo, na mina anumi adubɔsia-mu lɛlɔ uwi biala.

english_verse: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubo-mi butaayɔ na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni lɛlɔ. Na lɛɛɛdubo ƒula etemila amɛni bɔyiƒala kudii.

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Da-mi kɔkɔɔkɔ ƒula kabla ɔblane kalɛ na lɛdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Ya na mina anumi ebimi na lɛnu etemila geen ani nkya ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kemmo lɛti.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɔ na ndi na ntebo kayawi bulie gyɔlɔɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu tabɛla-mi ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Mina kayi kaada ogya uwi biala ka mɔɔwia lɛti ƒula ɔda bubo ɔsu.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: Aadɔnku bekyuli bekpidi bani naaadaku ƒula ɔda bubo lɛda. Na ewida aasiaku bekyuli bani naaadi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Da-mi die bana kavinkɔ kalɛ na beléteedumi-mi na bataakya-mi lɛlɔ lɛma. Ɔsika nsia ƒula ɔda bubo anu uwi biala.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Ina ka bagadine baasa lili na mina lɛlɔ ni, lɛɛɛdubo ƒula etemila kemmo buduo bɔda bɔya.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: Ƒula ala ani na aatina-mi mɔɔyɔ́-mi kaƒɔ. Na anya mɔɔlɛ-mi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: Aanu kalɛ na líbuli ntɛ kalɔ ɔtumu akɔ na nsɔ liiibo ngba geen bɔdi. Ya na ƒula litemi lɛsɔku-mi liboku ngba.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ka lídie mina alaekpidi kalɔ ni, ánu-mi kɔnyana. Anwuɔsu tina-mi ƒula ulu.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Na aya na linu ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kalɔ. Na ndubuduo kasusu kemmo ɔ́si ala ani na átina-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: Líduo kɔnyana geen. Kya-mi ɔkplu aani kalɛ na ásu-mi ése kpakplaa ka adubɔbla.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Na ada-mi kɔkɔɔkɔ kalɛ na naaasia ulu ukpidi ɔdi lɛlɔ. Bla-mi lɛƒɔndia na atina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: Lɛ́ƒuna ka lɛdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Na ɔmmɔ ntɔ-mi anumi na mɔɔnu.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: Mina Unwoti, ƒula ala ani na átina-mi kama na nsia kpakplaa. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu taya na kɔƒa kukpo-mi.

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: Ndubugyele anumi lɛsia ƒula ɔda bubo kama, ɔsika adubɔya na linu ala kalɔ libu.

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, Unwoti, tina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ. Na ndubɔdi-mu lɛlɔ uwi biala.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Die-mu kalɔ te-mi na lɛsiaku-mu kama. Na madi-mu lɛlɔ lɛnɔ ku mina kayi ƒui.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Tɔnku-mi siaku ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika amu ndubɔya na lɛkɛ ebiti.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Ya na ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ bɔdi butaada-mi ɔkwɛ teetulo kalɛ na lɛkɛ lɛkɛ.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Da-mi na lɛda atu lidie ala keeke ani neeebo kɔsia kɔdi lɛlɔ. Na aya na lilie ngba lɛsiaku ƒula ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Muuvele nnii di ƒula linyese lɛlɔ te-mi aani kalɛ na aabla teete ƒula kabla ɔblane biala ɔni mɔɔbu-ɔ ku bɔyia.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Taya na mina bekisine bakɛ-mi bedumi ku bana enyekpi. Ɔsika adubɔtɛ ami ku-ma litemi na ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: Mɔɔwia kpakplaa ka lɛdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu ya-mi na lilie ngba bɔwɔdi ɔkɛnku kalɛ na ese siin lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, tina-mi ka aayɔ́-mi geen uwi biala. Na aƒɔ-mi aani kalɛ na ése-mi kenye.

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: Na lɛkɛ lɛla lɛdi lɛsu bekyuli bani mɔɔtu-mi akpɛlɛ. Ɔsika ƒula litemi lɛlɔ kani na mina anu asia.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Ya na ntaatɛmi ƒula etemila geen uwi biala. Ɔsika ƒula litemi bɔtɛ kani na nnye mɔɔnu ulu teete.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: Na ndubulie ku kayi ƒaa, ɔsika mɔɔkya ɔkplu ka lɛdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: Ndubunye baga anumi na lidie ƒula ɔda bubo keyi lɛtina-ma na kɔƒa kulékpo-mi.

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: Ɔsika mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula litemi na si mɔɔdi-ni lɛlɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ɔda bubo na mɔɔbu-mu lɛnɔ. Na ndubuduo ƒula ala ani na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔɔtina-mi kemmo uwi biala.

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Tayiƒala ƒula kenye kani na ásu ami ƒula kabla ɔblane ése, ɔsika kana lɛlɔ na mbo lɛnunsia.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ ɔɔsia-mi kɔnu si ina lɛla lɛdi liikpóku-mi. Ɔsika ƒula linyese lɛmmɔ lɛɛsɔku-mi ngba taabla ɔwɔdi.

english_verse: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani na baláyia-a beenye teedumi-mi. Nsu ɔmmɔ útaya-mi na linwini na ƒula ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: Unwoti, si línyimo kalɛ na aatɛ etemila ɔ́si kukuuku ƒui ni, na mina kayi keelie kalɔ.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: Livo geen liiƒí-mi si mɔɔnu kalɛ na belikplune baládi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: Na uwi klukui ɔni na líbo ngba bulie mɛni kemmo ni, lɛ́nwi lɛnu lɛ́siku ƒula ɔda bubo etemila lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Unwoti, muunyimo-ɔ usien. Na muuduo mina kasusu kemmo taanu ɔ́siku ƒula etemila lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Na ebiti aada-mi si mɔɔdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: Unwoti, awɔ ndi mina kese. Na mɔɔsu kpakplaa ka ndubɔdi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Na muuvele-ɔ ku mina kayi ƒui ka abla ƒula linyese lɛlɔ ete-mi na abla-mi lɛƒɔndia.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: Líduo mina ngba kemmo lɛ́nu laa na lɛ́lɛ ugyii ka ndubɔsiaku ƒula ala ani na aatina-mi kama.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: Nsɔ naaakpɛ kama, mmomu ndubɔbabla na lɛdi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Bekisine baakywɛ-mi kɔkpagyuɛ nsu lɛɛɛdubo ƒula ɔda bubo bɔyiƒala kudii.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Usientɛ muedi mɔɔta teemwi-ɔ, ɔsika aatɛ litemi ulu siin lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani na baabu-ɔ na baadi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni, ama na mɔɔdiku kɔkpana.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Unwoti, aayɔ́ kayawi bekyuli ƒui ku kaƒɔ nwaa uwi biala kemmo. Tina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ádi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ na ábla ami ƒula kabla ɔblane lɛƒɔndia.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Ya-mi na lɛda anu na lɛti lɛla, ɔsika ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kani na líkpo kama.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: Lídeyi ƒula ɔda bubo ulu lɛlɔ, anwuɔsu na áni-mi kɔtu. Na ɔƒaani ni, nda ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kpakplaa.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Awɔ ndi Unwoti buni na aabla lɛƒɔndia uwi biala. Tina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔtina lɛlɔ bakɛ baasu ɔkɔ etemila na mina lɛlɔ taavi. Nsu ami líti mina kayi ƒui mɔɔdi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Bana kasusu kaalɛɛ aani ebuo lɛmwi na belenu lɛla lɛdi kalɔ. Nsu ami ni, lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi geen na ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: Na kɔtu kɔni na áni-mi ɔ́ya na lili lɛ́dia-mi geen, ɔsika ɔ́ya na muuduo ƒula etemila kemmo kaduɛ.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Na ƒula ɔda bubo bubo-mi kɔsia utulo lɛla biala ku sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ƒui.

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Awɔ néti ƒula enu ávɔ-mi na ada-mi lɛnɔ. Ya na nteenu ala kalɔ na lɛtɛya ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔbu-ɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma si bánu-mi. Ɔsika ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kani na mina ánu asia.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: Ngyi ka ƒula litemi bɔtɛ buse siin. Na ɔkɛnku kalɛ na asia ƒula litemi kama ɔsu na áni-mi kɔtu.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Ya na mina kayi kabla buɛɛ na kalɛ na aayɔ́-mi ɔsu, aani kalɛ na ásu ami ƒula kabla ɔblane ése.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Nu-mi kɔnyana na aya na lilie ngba. Ɔsika ƒula ɔda bubo bɔ́ya na mɔɔkɛ lɛlɔyɔ geen.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani ƒui na balábu-ɔ ni, ya na kɔƒa kukpo-ma. Ama mɔɔtina lɛlɔ na baadá-mi kenye keeke. Na ami amu ni, mina kasusu kadubo butaasia ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔyia-a na baabu-ɔ ni, bana anu enwini asia-mi lɛlɔ ku ama bani mɔɔdi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Ya na mina kayi kasia ulu siin lɛlɔ na ntasia ƒula litemi kama kalɛ na kɔƒa kulékpo-mi.

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Nnye mɔɔnu ulu taanɔ kpakplaa ka ebo abaƒɔ-mi, nsu mina anu asia ƒula litemi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: Mina anumi ákpa atu na nnye mɔɔnu ulu lite ƒula linyese. Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu na líye muedi nnini, “Uwi ɔmani na adubo-mi kɔnu bɔsia?”

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Mina ngba bɔɔyii udu aani ntɛ lɛbo lɛni na liyɔda líƒie. Ina amu ni, nnye mɔɔnu ulu na ńtayiƒala ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: Uwi ɛlɛ na ndubunye ntaanu ulu ntédu. Na lɛmameyi na adubɔtɛku bekyuli bani muukpóku-mi litemi na ani-ma kɔtu?

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔtina lɛlɔ na baládi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ benye beekú-mi kalɔ uwi biala taakywɛ-mi kɔkpagyuɛ.

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: Benye-mi lɛlɔ kpakplaa na kébu blii kani na badu-mi. Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui kama ńtenwini kama ńtakya ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku ƒula bɔyɔ bɔni naaayii udu ɔsu ni, ƒɔ-mi ngba na lilie ntaadi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ƒula litemi lɛdi litemi geen lɛni nnye kpakplaa na Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma uwi ƒui.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: Na aadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ siin teete kaba bekyuli ƒui. Édie kayawi na kenye kana kenyekɔ kpakplaa.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Ƒula ala ediedi ƒui akya ábalɛ ku ɔmwi limeyi, ɔsika ana ƒui aabla ƒula kabla.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Na si ɔɔɔdi ɔni na ƒula ɔda bubo bɔdi mina lɛlɔyɔ ɔsu ni, nka lɛ́ɛyii udu na kalɛ na mina ala eekpóku-mi ɔsu.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: Lɛɛɛdubo ƒula ɔda bubo bɔda bɔnyonu kudii, ɔsika ɔkɛnku-mu lɛlɔ na éti ada-mi na mmu nli ngba.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ƒɔ-mi ngba, ɔsika awɔdi na ndi na mɔɔsia ƒula ɔda bubo kama uwi biala.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Belikplune benye baatú-mi uwi biala ka bebile-mi ngba. Nsu ƒula etemila lɛlɔ kani na mɔɔbla mina kasusu uwi biala.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: Nu kalɛ sɔɔn na mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula litemi. Na mɔɔbla kasusu taasiku-ni lɛlɔ uwi biala.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: Ƒula ɔda bubo nkɛnku-mi uwi biala na bɔɔyá na mɔɔdá anu teetulo mina bekisine.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: Na muunú-mu kalɔ teetulo bani mɔɔtina-mi ala ammɔ muedi. Ɔsika muuduo-mu kemmo uwi biala.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Na ngyi enengula ntulo benengu geen bammɔ alati, ɔsika nda ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ geen.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: Na muunwíni na ekpidi lilu biala kama kalɛ na liti ƒula etemila lɛda.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: Na ala ani na ényimi ni, naaada-nya taava ɔƒɛnyi, ɔsika lɛni na átina-mi na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Your teachings are sweeter than honey.
translation_verse: Ƒula etemila aayu-mi geen teetulo kalɛ na uwɔ ɔɔyu kenye emini.

english_verse: They give me understanding and make me hate all lies.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ɔsu na mina kasusu kese nwaa. Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu na nkisi likpidi ulu biala.

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: Ƒula litemi lɛdi asogya ute mina lɛgba. Na uukeye teewi mina kasiakɔ.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: Líse kenye na lɛ́su ka ndubɔdi ƒula ɔda bubo bɔni nse siin lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Ala benye eekpóku-mi kpakplaa, anwuɔsu die-mi O Unwoti, ɔkɛnku ƒula linyese lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ƒɔ mina enu ani na mɔɔgyá-a ku mina kayi ƒui na atina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: Mina ngba bɔtu ugyii kenye uwi biala na bekisine bammɔ ɔsu. Nsu naaayiƒala ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Belikplune bákywɛ-mi kakpagyuɛ. Nsu ńtedeyi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: Ƒula ɔda bubo bɔɔyɔ́-mi kaƒɔ na bɔdi mina kese uwi ƒui.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: Lɛ́lɛ ugyii ku mina kaƒɔ nwaa ka ndubɔbla lɛsiaku ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ uwi ƒui utédu kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani na bana kasusu kese inyɔ inyɔ na ƒula lɛlɔ ni, nkisi-ma. Na ami ni, mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Awɔ ndi mina katamikukɔ ku ukyuli ɔni na ɔɔgyumana-mi. Na ƒula linyese lɛlɔ kani na mbo lɛnunsia.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Bɛgyu lɛgba bɛtɔlɔ-mi kudɔ amii alaekpidi bablane. Mina Katɔti ɔda bubo lɛlɔ kani na ndubɔdi.

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Da-mi kɔkɔɔkɔ ɔkɛnku ƒula linyese lɛlɔ na lilie ngba. Na taya na kɔƒa kukpo-mi na mina lɛnunsia ƒui kama!

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Da-mi, na makɛ bɔƒɔ! Na ntaadi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ uwi biala kemmo.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Na belikplune bammɔ ni, aanu-ma aani kebu alakpi. Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu na ami mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: Ɔsika mɔɔyia-a. Na mɔɔyia kalɛ na aatɛ litemi taasiaku.

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: Lɛ́bla lɛla lɛni ndia na lɛdi ulu lɛlɔ lɛnɔ. Anwuɔsu tanyonu-mi ete mina bekisine.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Su-mi se kpakplaa ka adubo-mi bubunku aani ƒula kabla ɔblane kalɛ. Na taya na bekyuli bani mɔɔtina lɛlɔ banya-mi bakya.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: Bɔkpa na mina anumi ada ɔni na nnye mɔɔnu ulu ka abaƒɔ-mi ngba, na ƒula linyese lɛnɔ libo-nwu kemmo.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Da-mi kɔkɔɔkɔ aani ƒula kabla ɔblane ɔkɛnku kalɛ na aayɔ́-mi uwi ƒui ɔsu, na atina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
translation_verse: Ƒula kabla ɔblane na ndi, ya na nteenu ala kalɔ na lɛti ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: Ami mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ɔda bubo teetulo sika ugyiedi.

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu nkɛnku ƒula litemi lɛlɔ na mɔɔnu mina kanyakɔ, na naaayɔ ka lɛsia ulu ukpidi ɔdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: Ƒula ɔda bubo ƒui bɔdia kaduɛ ɔmɔ ɔsu na mina kɔyu lɛnɔ kunye-mu lɛlɔ geen.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: Ala ani kalɔ na ƒula etemila eedie adi bukeye, na ɔɔyá na bekyuli bani naaagyi lɛla lɛdi baadá anu.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: Líbimi kenye líwi aani ukyuli ɔni na ɔƒɛ ɔɔdá-nwu na kalɛ mɔɔwia ƒula litemi ɔsu.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Nwini nu-mi na abla-mi lɛƒɔndia aani kalɛ na aabla teete bekyuli bani mɔɔyɔ́-ɔ.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Da-mi kalɛ na neeebuli aani kalɛ na ásu ése. Na taya na likpidi lɛdi-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Die-mi na bekyuli bani mɔɔnyá-mi taakya enu kemmo, na lɛkana ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Die ƒula bɔyɔ tina ami ƒula kabla ɔblane. Na atina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: When anyone disobeys you, my eyes overflow with tears.
translation_verse: Naaada buwulo taaya uwi ɔdi na ɔni na bekyuli baládi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: Unwoti, awɔ nse siin na aatɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
translation_verse: Na ƒula ɔda bubo bɔni na éte lɛnɔ bɔdi ulu na buse siin.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: Anumi eegyie-mi, ɔsika mina bekisine baládi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Ami ƒula kabla ɔblane líduo ƒula linyese kemmo na lɛ́kɔku-mu lɛ́nu na mɔɔyɔ́-mu geen.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: Ndi ukyuli ɔni neeebo kenyekɔ kadi. Béni-mi bése, nsu ƒula ɔda bubo amu naaada-mu teese.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na aabla ala ulu lɛlɔ use siin úsela ƒui. Na ƒula ɔda bubo bɔdi litemi geen lɛmmɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Bukpoku ku bɔnɔ bɔ́ƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ ƒui. Nsu ƒula ɔda bubo bɔɔyá na mɔɔkɛ́ lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: Ƒula etemila ese siin uwi biala. Ya-mi na nteenu ala kalɔ na melie ngba.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Unwoti, nu-mi bɔkpali, ɔsika mina kayi kemmo ɔkwalɛ ƒui na muuwulo taasiku. Ndubɔdi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Awɔ na muuwulo taakpali! Ƒɔ-mi kalɛ na makana ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: Mɔɔta ɔtanta tutuutu asa na ɔƒɛ ɔɔtu. Na muuwulo teevele-ɔ nnii bunku-mi, ɔsika ƒula litemi lɛlɔ na mina anu asia.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: Mina anumi ewi aanu nwaa usien umodi na muuti kasusu na ƒula etemila lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Nu-mi bɔkpali, ɔsika aayɔ́-mi uwi biala. O Unwoti, da-mi ngba kɔkɔɔkɔ, ɔsika asia ƒula litemi kama

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muukpóku-mi baaní teede-mi ku bana kasusu kekpidi. Na bágyunku ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Unwoti, awɔ ede-mi. Na ƒula ɔda bubo ƒui bɔdi etemila geen.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si kukuuku ni, ngyi ƒula etemila ka awɔ nése-nya ése éte uwi ƒui.

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Nu kalɛ na muubó abi na edie-mi. Ɔsika naaayiƒala ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Kpo na edie-mi kenye, na aƒɔ ete-mi aani kalɛ na ásu ése.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Belikplune beeebo bɔƒɔ bɔdi. Bɔ́gyunku-ma geen. Ɔsika baláwia ka badi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ uwi ɔdi.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Kɔnyana kɔni na aanu-bu kúbomo O Unwoti. Na ka asia ƒula litemi kama ɔsu ni, te-mi ngba.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Mina bekisine ku bekyuli bani muukpóku-mi bemomo. Nsu neeedeyi ƒula ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani naaadi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni, bana lɛlɔ liiƒí-mi livo.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Kali nu kalɛ na mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ɔda bubo. Na ada-mi ngba kɔkɔɔkɔ, ɔsika aayɔ́-mi uwi biala.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: Ƒula ɔda bubo bɔdi litemi geen lɛni nse siin na bunye bute uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Bagadine benye beekpóku-mi uwi biala keeke. Nsu ami ni, ƒula litemi bɔtɛ kani na mɔɔbu taanu mina kayi kemmo.

english_verse: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi na ƒula etemila lɛlɔ aani ukyuli ɔni na ɔ́kɛ lɛkɛ libendi lɛdi.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Nkisi na líni ɔkɔ ala bɔbla. Nsu mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: Maatɛ sɔɔn na mɔɔkpali-ɔ teemwi na limeyi linwi kemmo na ƒula ɔda bubo bɔni nse siin ɔsu.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔyɔ́ ƒula ɔda bubo ni, baakɛ́ keyi buɛɛ. Na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na bagbanta.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: Unwoti, mina anu asia ka aƒɔ-mi, na mɔɔdi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: Mina kɔyu kɔda ƒula ɔda bubo bɔni na éte-mi, ɔsika mɔɔyɔ́-mu teetulo lɛla biala.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: Mɔɔdi ƒula ɔda bubo ku etemila ƒui lɛlɔ, ɔsika mina kasiakɔ ƒui ni, awɔ Unwoti agyi-mu.

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ya na mina keku kedu-ɔ kudɔ. Na aya na nteenu ala kalɔ ɔkɛnku ƒula litemi lɛlɔ!

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Na aya na mina kɔtɔ bukpi budu-ɔ kudɔ. Na edie-mi ɔkɛnku ƒula litemi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Ndubo mina kenye bubimi na limwi-ɔ, ka awɔ nátina-mi ƒula ɔda bubo ɔsu.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Na ndububimi kenye na lidie ɔnu na lɛka ƒula litemi ku ɔda bubo ƒui lɛtina ka bɔdia.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Tani tesie kama, mmomu die ƒula kɔnu na ebunku-mi, ɔsika ƒula ɔda bubo na lɛ́ƒuna.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: Unwoti, nnye ngya-a ka abáƒɔ-mi. Ɔsika ƒula ɔda bubo mɔɔyɔ́-mi kaƒɔ.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Ya na lilie ngba na memwi-ɔ. Na aya na ƒula ɔda bubo bubunku-mi.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Lɛ́yii ulu aani koƒonu kɔni náyii. Wia-mi ƒula kabla ɔblane kama ulu, ɔsika ntayiƒala ƒula ɔda bubo.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ala étulo-mi ni, líwulo lɛ́kpali Unwoti Katɔti na únu úte-mi.

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, die-mi na ɔkɔ banyine ku bekyuli bani mɔɔtɔ́lɔ bekyuli kudɔ.

english_verse: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
translation_verse: Bɛnu kaduɛ na lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔdubo-mii bɔbla lɛlɔ, ɔsika ɔɔɔdubo-mii buse buɛɛ.

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ na ɔdi ka bete-mi ka líbo nli-mi akɔ na Mesek na buuduo Kedar nvo kemmo taalɛ.

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani naaayɔ keyi buɛɛ akɔ na líti mina lɛlɔ ḿbakya.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyɔ́ ka atu ayɔ-mi nsu si lítemi banii lɛ́tɛ kekpo lɛbɛɛ.

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: Nnye mɔɔnu abi lɛlɔ teemene. Wɛ na bɔƒɔ bɔdubɔsi bubo-mi?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔni nábla katɔ ku kalɔ ni, anwu ndububo ubaƒɔ ute-mi.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: Anwu ɔni mɔɔgyumana ukyuli ni, ulenye ulanu-ɔ na ayii kanyankɔ. Ɔsika ɔda-a ngba, na lɛlɛɛ liléti-nwu.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: Israel, nu! Unwoti Katɔti ɔni mɔɔgyumana-a ni, lɛlɛɛ liléti-nwu iye ɔtɛ ɔlɛɛ uwi ɔdi.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Anwu mɔɔnu-ɔ lɛlɔ na ɔkɛ-ɔ kɔdianu kakɛ uute-ɔ ɔyuli.

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛ uléƒi-ɔ na limeyi kemmo, na kɔbuli lɛnɔ kulékpoku-ɔ si kɔsia.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubɔgyumana-a na udie-ɔ kɔyu na ɔgbankpi biala kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: Na ƒula busie teebo ƒui ni, Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubɔnu-ɔ lɛlɔ ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛ́yɔ-mi ka básu-mi banii, “Ya na buteesie Unwoti kaduli.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Na adi ɔma unengudi ɔni básɔku-nwu bátu na ɔ́sala ɔdanku lɛlɔ na ɔɔdia bɔnu geen.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Mɛni na Israel atɔƒi bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bási. Bébo ka beti enugya bete Unwoti aani kalɛ na úbo-ma ɔda.

english_verse: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
translation_verse: Mɛni na Dawid kaba kemmo baga básala na baatɛku bana bekyuli litemi.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Bivele Unwoti bɛnii keyi buɛɛ kebo Yerusalem ɔma kemmo. Na bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔyɔ́-ɔ ni, enu ku akɔkɔ eyi-ma.

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: O Yerusalem, atu bɔyɔ bɔkya awodu ani na áka ámana-a ƒui kemmo. Na keyi katɛku ƒula baga na bana lɛgbanya kemmo.

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: Na nnye mina bakpana ku banwa ƒui kenye muuvele nnii, “Keyi buɛɛ kaƒɔ Yerusalem.”

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Na bula Unwoti Katɔti kaduli ɔsu ni, muuvele nnii anumi busie bubo ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, awɔ na lɛ́kɔliku anumi katɔ mɔɔnu ulu teete na ƒula lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na katɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: Nu-bu kɔnyana, O Unwoti, nu-bu kɔnyana, ɔsika ala ani muukpóku-bu édu-bu ɔkwɛ ɔƒɛni amu.

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Bɔma bɔni na lɛlɔ bakɛne baamá-bu búmomo bɔ́gya. Na lɛni kani na bani mɔɔnya-bu taamana lɛnɔ ablala étulo-bu kayi.

english_verse: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Unwoti, si ɔɔɔdi awɔ nnye éte-bu ni, nka dɛ na ɔdubo buse? Israelƒuɔ, bɛsu bɛnini,

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: “Si ɔɔɔdi Unwoti nnye úte-bu uwi ɔni na beekpóku-bu ni,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: nka uwi ɔni na bekisine báta ku kɔnyi mmɔ ni, bébweli-bu ngba ngba.

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: Nka ketu káda-bu kákya na kéti-bu kátɔlɔku.

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: “Bɛya bumwi Unwoti ɔni nátanyonu-bu útete na baduli-bu bakun.

english_verse: and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.
translation_verse: Búkeli aani kalɛ na aasɛ uukeli taalɛ kakpagyuɛ kani na bákywɛ-nwu kemmo. Kakpagyuɛ kammɔ kébie na bɔ́lɛ-ka kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: “Unwoti ɔni nédie katɔ ku kalɔ ni, anwu nédie-bu.”

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani néti bana anu básia Unwoti lɛlɔ ni, bese aani Sion Kɔbi kɔni naadubo bɔta kesii kani na kɔlɛ kudii. Ɔsika mmɔ kani na kɔdubɔlɛ uwi biala kemmo.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na abi áka ámana Yerusalem ɔma ni, lɛni na Unwoti lɛnɔ ɔ́ka ɔ́mana nwuna bekyuli ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
translation_verse: Katɔti uláya na bekyuli bekpidi badi nwuna bekyuli kedee lɛlɔ. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, badubɔya na Katɔti bekyuli babla likpidi.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, bla lɛbuni te bekyuli babuni ku bani kayi kemmo ablala nkɛ ulu siin lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Nsu bani nénwini básia ulu gontii lɛlɔ ni, Unwoti ɔdubuti-ma utásalaku alaekpidi bablane na ɔni-ma kɔtu. Nsu Israel anwu ni, ɔkɛ atu bɔyɔ ku keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Unwoti ɔ́sɔku nwuna bekyuli úboku Yerusalem ni, ɔ́bla-bu aani kɔna na buugyé.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: Na lɛma ku bumwi lɛnu sɔɔn néyi-bu akpu na buudie. Mmɔ na kadi bamba bekyuli básu banini, “Unwoti ɔ́bla ala bonwu úte-ma.”

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka Unwoti ɔ́bla ala bonwu úte-bu, ɔmmɔ ɔsu na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-bu.

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Unwoti, bla-bu na ɔsɔ ɔtɛ ute-bu ubu aani kalɛ na ɔkwalɛ ɔni nákwii ɔɔsɔ taaƒɔ́ ntu.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bani nákya edula ku lɛbibo ku keku ni, ama mɔɔƒɛ ku ebiti ku lɛma.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nda keku baakya edula adi ni, badubo bunwini ku ebiti ku lɛnu bɔtu uwi ɔni beti bana edula ani báƒɛ badububoku kaduli.

english_verse: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
translation_verse: Si Unwoti Katɔti kɔnu kɔɔɔkya ɔtɔ ɔni na batune benye baatú kemmo ni, kekeeke na beebó abi. Na si Unwoti Katɔti útagyumana ɔma ɔni na bagyumanane benye baanu ni, kekeeke na belie benye baagyumana.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Ina éyile bɔta na ékpoku lɛlɔ ába kadi ka aawia lɛla lɛdi adi ni, aaadubo-ɔ budu na adi na edu-ɔ ɔkwɛ. Ɔsika bekyuli bani néti lɛlɔ béte Unwoti Katɔti ni, Unwoti uute-ma ala uwi ɔni na batɛ balɛɛ muedi.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Nu! Unwoti Katɔti muute bebi na baawɔ. Na bani mɔɔlɛ́ taasi uwele kaƒɔ kemmo ni, ɔdi nwuna lɛƒɔndia.

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na kɔtaminta atula ani nkya ɔyikune ɔdi koƒo kemmo ese ete ukyuli ɔmmɔ ni, lɛni kani na bebi lɛnɔ beekpó teete bana bawɔne.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni mbo-ma na bemomo. Ɔsika ɔdubɔkana na unye ɔsiaku ukisine biala udu na ɔban kenye ɔni na kɔƒa kulékpo-nwu.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔyia Unwoti Katɔti ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-nwu ka ɔɔsia ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔdubɔdi nwuna enu kemmo kabla na ɔdubɔbla-nwu lɛlɔyɔ sɔsɔ ka keyi kadubɔyɔku-nwu ɔsu.

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: Ulekudi ɔdubɔkya-nwu kaduli aani kɔdingyii kɔni mɔɔnwu ebi geen. Na nwuna bebi badubo bɔdia bɔnu geen na baka bamana-nwu kadikɔ aani nnɔ egyii akɔdi kalɛ.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Bɛnu bɛti geen ka ɔmɛni ndi lɛƒɔndia lɛni na Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubɔbla ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyia-nwu.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ bɔsiku Sion. Na Yerusalem ɔdubo bɔdia na amii alati bɛnu na bina ngba emeyi kemmo.

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ geen ni, bɛdubɔnu bina bebi ku bawɔ. Na atu ayɔ-mii ƒui na Yerusalem.

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: “Kadi bamba bekyuli békpoku-mi ɔ́si mina lɛkloƒu uwi.” Mɔɔwia ka amii Israel kadi bɛsu ɔmɛni bɛnini,

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: “Ina ka kadi bamba bekyuli békpoku-mi ɔ́si mina lɛkloƒu uwi ni, bátakana na badi-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Béku-mi aani kalɛ na beeti lɛnwami taatu kalɔ teenwini, nsu batakana-mi.”

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti use siin ɔsu ni, kɔbuli kɔni na balalane bammɔ béti banii beenyimi-mi ni, úkulo-ku ƒui úwi kalɔ.

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Bani ƒui na muukisi Sion ni, anumi éwi-ma kalɔ na bénwini-mi kama.

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: Na bábla aani kamu kani nákwɛ lɛsa lili na káyuɛ ka kátakɛ ntu ɔsu.

english_verse: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnwa-ka ni, ulékulo-ka na kedu ɔmukɔ. Na ɔni muunyimi-ka lɛnɔ ulenyimi-ka na kedu ketila,

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Unwoti, mina kaƒɔ kemmo ƒui na muuwulo taakpali-ɔ.

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: Nu-mi lɛdi na ese atu na enu mina keku kani muuwulo teevele kebunku.

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: Si ásia ukyuli alaekpidi kama ni, Unwoti, ɔma ndubɔkana ƒula litemi bɔtɛ kenye bunye?

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, awɔ muuti alaekpidi taakyiɛ-bu, anwuɔsu na ɔlɛka bɔyia-a na bɔbu-ɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: Awɔ Unwoti anumi kani na nnye mɔɔnu. Na mina anu ƒui ku kayi kasia-a lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
translation_verse: Nnye mɔɔnu-ɔ ulu kpakplaa geen teetulo kalɛ na bekyuli bani nnye baagyumana usien baanu ulu teete ka kadi kegye kukuuku ƒui.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui, biti bina anu bɛsia Unwoti lɛlɔ. Ɔsika Unwoti kani mbo lɛƒɔndia uwi ndi uwi, na ɔɔƒɔ́ ukyuli ngba.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Na anwu ɔlati ɔdubɔƒɔ Israel ɔlɛku bana ekpidi ani ƒui na baabla kemmo.

english_verse: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, likyulikpi ala bɔbla buuubo-mi kayi kemmo. Na mina anumi lɛnɔ alánu ala teetuloku lɛlɔ. Na lɛɛɛsiaku ala enengudi iye ala ani na etulo-mi kama.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ ni, nda lɛlɔ aani ubi ɔni na uni ɔ́nyuɛ-nwu na nwuna lɛgba lɛlɔ. Na mina kayi kese buɛɛ na mɔɔsia ala ammɔ anu.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: Unwoti, nyimo Dawid lɛbibo lɛni kenye na unye kpakplaa.

english_verse: Mighty God of Jacob, remember how he promised:
translation_verse: Na ɔ́kpali Katɔti úse kenye úte Unwoti ɔni ndi Yakob Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔnini,

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: “Lɛɛɛdubo mina ɔtɔ buduo. Na lɛɛɛdubo busie butátɛ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: úti útédu ka lɛ́ka kesii kadi bɔwia bute mina Unwoti ɔni ndi Yakob Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui.”

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Búnu ka nwuna Bunyimi Adaka ɔkya Eƒrata na bɔ́nu-nwu na Yearim alakpi akɔ.

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: Na bɔ́su bɔnii bɛya na buteesie Unwoti kakpakɔ butákpa-nwu na katɔma kedee kammɔ kemmo na nwuna lɛgba akɔ.

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ta ku ƒula Bunyimi Adaka na atina ƒula ɔyikun. Na esie etélie ƒula keliekɔ.

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Ya na ƒula bakpane bataabla ala ani nse siin uwi biala. Na aya na ƒula bekyuli kedee bebo kudu ku lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si ƒula kenye kani nése éte ƒula kabla ɔblane Dawid ɔsu ni, teni ƒula Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti úse kenye úte Dawid, na ulénwini kama ulakya nwuna linyese lɛmmɔ kudii. Ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ƒula kaba kemmo ubi ɔdi na ndubɔya na ɔdi lɛga na ƒula lɛga kadikɔ.

english_verse: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
translation_verse: Si ƒula bebi básia mina ɔda bubo anu kpakplaa na bábla básia ɔda ɔni líbo-ma lɛlɔ ni, bana bebi lɛnɔ badubo butaadi lɛga lɛmmɔ uwi biala.”

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti ɔ́ƒuna Sion na ɔdi-nwu lɛyɔla ka uti mmɔ ɔbla nwuna keliekɔ.

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: Mɛni na ndubulie ntaadi lɛga ɔsi ɔƒɛni úsela ƒui. Na mɛni na ndubo bulie uwi ƒui, ɔsika mɛni kadia-mi.

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: Ndubute Sion lɛla biala baawia kaduɛ. Na ndubɔya na nwuna bawabane badi bemo.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔya nwuna bakpane bataabla ala ani nse siin uwi biala, na lɛya nwuna bekyuli kedee bebo kudu ku lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: “Mɛni na ndubuse Dawid kaba kemmo ubi likpo na ɔdi lɛga linengudi. Na mina Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmɛni ni, lɛ́ɛklibi-nwu líse aani bukeye ute mina bekyuli.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: Na nwuna bekisine ƒui ni, kɔƒa kɔdubɔƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ ƒui aani awu. Nsu anwu nwuna lɛga kadikɔ kagabwa kadubukeye busie ɔgyu.”

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Bɛnu kalɛ na ɔɔdia bɔnu si banwani bábla unwi na bása beli liku linwi.

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: Use aani nnɔmii ƒɛƒɛɛ bɔni na béti béwi Ɔkpane Aaron lili, na ɔɔsia teeduo nwuna ukwi kemmo ku nwuna awu atu ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: Use aani amii ani mɔɔyu taasi Hermon abi lɛlɔ teewi Sion abi lɛlɔ. Ɔsika mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su úse ka wete kusɛ kusɛ ɔmmɔ, na ɔdanku ngba bɔni naaadubo bɔsa kudii.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Amii Unwoti kabla bablane, bɛtu kɔgya bimwi Unwoti. Na amii bani mɔɔkpá-nwu na nwuna ɔtɔ kemmo usien ni,

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: bɛkɔliku bina enu katɔ na nwuna kakpakɔ na bimwi Unwoti Katɔti.

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: Na anwu Unwoti ɔni nédie katɔ ku kalɔ ni, ute-mii kusɛ kusɛ ɔ́siku Sion.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti. Amii Unwoti kabla bablane ƒui, bimwi Blɔti! Bɛkɔliku-nwu lɛnyi katɔ na bimwi-nwu lɛnyi kedee.

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: Amii bani muuduo nwuna ɔtɔ kemmo ku bani muunye nwuna kaduli ƒui.

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Bimwi Unwoti, ɔsika ɔdia. Bidie lɛnu bimwi-nwu lɛnyi, ɔsika ubo lɛƒɔndia.

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔlati náƒuna Yakob úte lɛlɔ. Na ɔ́ƒuna Israel kadi ka babla nwuna bekyuli.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: Na ngyi ka bula Unwoti úbomo na ɔ́ƒɔ lɛnyi útulo kalɔ benwoti bamba ƒui.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni mɔɔyɔ́-nwu kaƒɔ ni, ani na Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔbla na katɔ mmɔ ku kalɔ lɛlɔ ku ɛpu kemmo ku kalɔ kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: Ɔɔyá na liƒlukutu lɛɛsí kalɔ ekpo ƒui taakɔ katɔ. Na ɔɔyá na katɔ kaabwɛ ogya na ɔnantu ɔɔna. Na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔɔsí kesii kani na ɔ́bala-nwu ɔ́kya na uubo teebekpo.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Anwu naya na Egyipte bebi bedeedi bani na bekyuli ku bebuo ƒui báwɔ ƒui békpi.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: Anwu nábla akɔla ala budie taatina lidu lidu ku ala bamba na bɛ́nu na Egyipte na Ɔga Ƒarao ku nwuna kabla bablane ƒui anumi.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: Na ɔ́yila kadi bamba bekyuli pii bani náƒɔ kuye ku baga benengudi udu.

english_verse: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
translation_verse: Ama badi ndi Amoriƒuɔ ɔga ɔni baalɔ Sihon ku Basan ɔga ɔni baalɔ Og ku Kanaanƒuɔ baga ƒui. Ɔ́yila-ma udu.

english_verse: and gave their property to his people Israel.
translation_verse: Na bana kalɔ kénwini Israelƒuɔ bani na ɔ́ƒuna úte lɛlɔ kadi.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ƒula lɛnyi liláyi kudii. Na kadi ƒui bekyuli badubo butaakali ƒula ala ani na ábla uwi biala.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubɔtɛku nwuna bekyuli litemi. Na ka bekyuli baakywí-nwu kaƒɔ ɔsu ni, ɔdubɔƒɔ-ma ngba.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Ala ani na kadi bamba bekyuli baakpá ni, adi ala ani béti sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi bávɔ na ammɔ ƒui adi bekyuli enu kabla.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Bávɔ-nya na ebo kenye, nsu belétemi. Na bebo anumi, nsu balánu.

english_verse: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
translation_verse: Bebo atu, nsu belenu, na balánwuna lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani návɔ ala ammɔ udu bélieku ala ani na bávɔ mmɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Na lɛni kani na bani néti bana anu basia-nya na báƒɔ-nya bádi mmɔ lɛnɔ bese.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: O Israel kɔduli bekyuli ƒui, bimwi Unwoti! Na amii Aaron kaduli bekyuli ƒui lɛnɔ, bimwi Unwoti!

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Lewi kaduli bekyuli ƒui, bimwi Unwoti. Na amii bani ƒui mɔɔyia Unwoti, bimwi-nwu!

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Bimwi Unwoti ɔ́siku Sion. Na bimwi-nwu amii bani nkya Yerusalem kesii kani ndi Unwoti keliekɔ. Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛgya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔdia. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛgya benwoti ƒui Unwoti enu. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛgya Unwoti ɔni ntulo ƒui enu. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛgya anwu ɔni mɔɔbla akɔla ala budie taatina enu. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛgya anwu ɔni násala ntu bɔni náƒɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui na kénwini kalɔ kakwiidi enu. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛgya anwu ɔni nédie ala ani muukeye ƒui ɔ́kya katɔ enu. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛgya anwu ɔni náya na ɔƒɛ ɔɔdi limeyi lɛlɔ enu. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛgya anwu ɔni náya na kɔbuli ku ayabi aadi usien lɛlɔ enu. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛgya anwu ɔni náya na bebi bedeedi bani na Egyipteƒuɔ báwɔ ku bana bebuo bebi bedeedi ƒui békpi enu. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui bávi bálɛ Egyipte kalɔ kammɔ kemmo. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Údie nwuna kɔnu na ɔ́bla ɔyikun ala úte-bu. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛgya anwu ɔni náya na Ɛpugyie ntu bɔ́bwɛ ntɛ enu. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na Israel kadi bekyuli básia ntu bɔmmɔ ntɛ. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔ́nyina Ƒarao ku nwuna badi ƒui ama ɔ́kya ntu bɔmmɔ kemmo. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛgya anwu ɔni nátɔnku nwuna kadi bekyuli ɔ́siaku kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo enu. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛgya anwu ɔni náya na búkpo bɔ́di baga bayikune lɛlɔ enu. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na baga bani náƒɔ lɛnyi békpi. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Baga bammɔ akɔ ɔdi ndi Sihon ɔni ndi Amoriƒuɔ ɔga. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔbambadi lɛnɔ ndi Basan ɔga ɔni ndi Og. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Na bana kɔlɔ ni, ɔ́ya na kúnwini bula kese. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔdi kese ute Israel, nwuna kabla ɔblane. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Únyimo-bu uwi ɔni bɔkya lɛbibo kemmo. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Na údie-bu ɔ́lɛku bula bekisine enu kemmo. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Na uute nwuna ala ediedi ƒui adila na baadi. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛgya Katɔti ɔni nkya katɔ enu. Ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na búlie Babilon etukpa atu na búnyimo Sion ni, mmɔ na búlie búwulo keku.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Na egyii ammɔ akɔ na búti bula lɛbentaa bɔ́ƒala.

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bekyuli bani néƒie-bu bátɔlɔku básu-bu ka budie bula lɛnu lɛdi bute-ma. Bula kalala bablane baasu-bu banii “Bidie lɛlɔyɔ lɛnu lɛni bɛɛyɔ́ bɔtu na Sion mmɔ biti bɛkya-bu ebiti!”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bɔ́su-ma ka bulakana bula Unwoti ɔnu ɔdi budie na kesii kani naaadi bula kalɔ mɛni.

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: O Yerusalem si lɛyiƒala-a ni, mina kɔdianu kɔnu kɔsɔ kutata-mi na kabla kɔkwɛ kɔni na kɔgyi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: Na si lɛ́yiƒala-a iye ńteti awɔ Yerusalem ńtenwini mina lɛla lideedi lɛni mɔɔyá mɔɔkɛ́ lɛlɔyɔ ni, unyemi ɔsɔ utata-mi na mina kenye kemmo.
