english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: O Unwoti, nyimo lɛla lɛni na Edomƒuɔ bábla na limeyi lɛni na Yerusalem ɔ́yu kalɔ. Báva básu banini, “Bigyingya ɔma ɔmmɔ! Bɛƒɛ lɛtɔ lɛmmɔ ku ana atabi ani bakya kalɔ ƒui kede kede!”

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: Awɔ Babilon, ámanku ka bayila-a udu. Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni medie-ɔ kasi aani kalɛ na éti ábla-bu.

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Na lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni mada ƒula bebi lɛgba na waƒiɛmi-ma atabi lɛlɔ ni.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: O mina Unwoti, ndubɔgya-a enu na limwi-ɔ ku mina kayi ƒui na lɛlɔ badine ku bayikune bamba bani náka bámana-a anumi.

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: Ndububoku lɛlɔ kalɔ na liti mina anumi lɛtina ƒula kakpakɔ kedee na limwi-ɔ lɛnyi, ɔsika aayɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi na asia ƒula litemi kama. Na édie átina ka ƒula lɛnyi ku ƒula ɔda bubo bɔ́kɔ katɔ ƒui butulo lɛla ndi lɛla.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛni na líwulo lɛkpali-ɔ ni, énu-mi bɔkpali na ákya-mi kayi na áya na mina kɔyu kɔ́kɛ ɔyikun.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: Kalɔ lɛlɔ baga ƒui badubumwi-ɔ lɛnyi, O Unwoti, ɔsika bénu ƒula kenye etemila.

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: Na badubudie lɛnu bete-ɔ na ala ani na ábla ɔsu. Ɔsika eekeye geen.

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ina ka eli katɔ katɔ mmɔ muedi ni, aanu bani muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ kɔnyana. Na bani mɔɔkɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ ni, bana ablala lɛnɔ átabɛ-ɔ.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ina ka ala ani muukpóku-mi áka ámana-mi ni, amu ada mina ngba. Na adubudie ƒula kɔnu atina mina bekisine ƒui. Na ƒula kɔdianu kɔnu kɔdubɔƒɔ-mi ngba.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: Na ngyi ka kasusu kani na Unwoti ubo ute-mi kadubo-nwu kemmo lɛni. Ɔsika aayɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi. Na buuvele ka awɔlɔ ƒula kabla kani kalɔ na ése na bula akɔ.

english_verse: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
translation_verse: Unwoti, éduo-mi kayi ku lɛlɔ kemmo ánu ƒui na agyi kalɛ na nse.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: Na agyi-mi ablala ku kɔvinkɔ ƒui. Na mina lili kemmo kakali ƒui kátabɛ-ɔ na kesii kani na eli mmɔ.

english_verse: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
translation_verse: Ákɔku mina busie taavi ku mina bɔtɛ ánu. Na agyi mina ablala kemmo ƒui kede kede.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: O Unwoti, asa litemi lɛdi lɛdubɔlɛ-mi kenye kemmo ni, agyi lɛla lɛni na ndubo bɔsu kukuuku.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: Áaka ámana-mi kesi kesii na ƒula kɔnu mɔɔgyumana-mi.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na éti agyi-mi kemmo kágyu geen ɔni utulo ami ɔlati kalɔ bunu.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: Lɛɛɛdubo bɔkana bukeli ƒula anumi busie kesii kadi. Na naaakana lɛlɔ bɔbala ƒula anumi lɛnɔ bɔkya kesii kadi.

english_verse: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
translation_verse: Si lɛ́kɔ lísie katɔ ni, akya mmɔ. Si ubu kemmo na líduo ńtátɛ lɛnɔ akya mmɔ.

english_verse: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
translation_verse: Si lɛ́kwɛ avwi na líveyi lísie ɔgyu kakaaka na ɛpu ɔvi ngye muedi ni,

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: mmɔ geen ƒula kɔnu kɔdubo-mi bɔkpanku. Na ƒula kɔdianu kɔdubɔtɔnku-mi na ebunku-mi.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: Na si masu nnii lɛdisa lɛdubɔbala-mi na ɔƒiiwi unwini usien ute-mi muedi ni,

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: ɔɔɔdubo bɔtɛ, ɔsika lɛdisa lɛdi bukeye na ƒula anumi. Na lɛdisa ku bukeye bɔdi unwi na ƒula kudɔ.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Ɔsika awɔ návɔ-mi lɛlɔ ekpo ƒui na ásala-nya ákya mina uni kaƒɔ kemmo.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: Ndubumwi-ɔ, ɔsika kalɛ na éti ávɔ-mi ni, ubo liƒu. Na ƒula ablala ébomo na mina kayi kagyi ɔmɛni nwaa.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ákya aavɔ́ mina ekubi na aasála-nya na mina uni kaƒɔ kemmo na mɔɔlɛ lili na bɔbɛ kemmo ni, awɔ ágyi ka nkya mmɔ.

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: Mina bɔvɔ kesii kadi kátabɛ-ɔ asa na báwɔ-mi. Na énweni mina ngba bulie emeyi bumomo ése na ƒula ɔku kemmo asa na mina lɛlɔ kakɛ kadi kadubuse kalɔ na kaƒɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, ƒula kakali káƒɔ kuye geen na kana kemmo lɛnɔ kágyu geen na kemomo.

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: Na si banii baka ƒula kasusu ni, ketulo ɛpu kɔnwinimi. Na si lɛ́gyinya na nkɛ ni, ƒula kudɔ kani na nli.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ ni, O Katɔti Kedee, ɔdubɔda-mi kubiti si banii ádu balalane. Ya na bekyuli bani mbo likyulikpi banyonu-mi!

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ baatɛmi ala ekpidi taasiku-ɔ lɛlɔ, na bada ƒula lɛnyi lɛnɔ na ulu ɔni nátamanaku lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, bekyuli bani muukisi-ɔ ni, ami lɛnɔ muukisi-ma. Na bani ƒui mɔɔta tenye-ɔ lɛlɔ ni, uukpóku-mi na muukisi-ma geen.

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: Naaanu-ma bɔdia munu munu, ɔsika mɔɔnu-ma aani-mina bekisine.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: O Katɔti, awɔ ɔlati kɔku-mi na ati kalɛ na nse.

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Sia-mi anu na si nkɛ ulu ukpidi ɔdi lɛlɔ na eti-mi asiaku ngba ƒui ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: O Unwoti, die-mi na bekyuli bekpidi enu kemmo. Na agyumana-mi na lɛlɛ kalala bablane enu kemmo.

english_verse: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
translation_verse: Likpidi bɔbla kakali kani na bekyuli bammɔ beeti. Na baakya kekpo uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: Bágyu bana inye beti yayaaya aani balakpi. Na bana inye bɔɔdú bekyuli aani kɔlakpi bɔdu kalɛ.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, da-mi die bekyuli bekpidi bamɛni enu kemmo. Na agyumana-mi na lɛlɛ balalane bani mɔɔwia ka bekpeli-mi lɛgba na bayila-mi udu mɛni kudɔ.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bekpidi bákywɛ-mi kɔkpagyuɛ bése. Na béwi bana lɛsawu lɛnɔ bése-mi kɔvinkɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, mɔɔkpali-ɔ, awɔ ndi mina Katɔti. Nu-mi bɔkpali.

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: O Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, awɔ ndi mina ɔƒɔne ɔni mɔɔgyumana-mi kpakplaa. Na awɔ nékpo éte-mi na kekpokɔ.

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, taya na kakali kani na mina bekisine bábla mina lɛlɔ ubo-nwu kemmo. Amu badubɔkɛ-mi lɛlɔ ɔyikun na benye beteekpoku-mi uwi ƒui.

english_verse: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
translation_verse: Taya na bani náka-mi bákya na baawia-mi likpidi badi-mi lɛlɔ. Ya na ɔgbankpi ɔni baawia ka ubo-mi lɛlɔ unwini usie-ma kudɔ.

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Na aya na agyabi ani náƒɔ ogya ewi-ma lɛlɔ. Na ebo-ma atákya lɛgyavonku kemmo na ubu voo kemmo kalɛ na basɔ balálɛ kudii!

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ngyi nwaa ka eekpó teete bawabane na ɔgbankpi kemmo. Na aanu bani mɔɔyaki ala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ geen ni, bekyuli bani nse siin badubo-ɔ enu bɔgya, ɔsika badubo bulie na ƒula anumi uwi biala.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, awɔ na muuwulo taakpali. Se atu na enu-mi bɔkpali na ebo pla.

english_verse: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ya na mina katɔ bɔkpali bunwini aani oloƒui ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni baakyula na ƒula anumi. Na si lɛ́kɔliku mina enu katɔ ni, na ɔbla aani useyi uwi akpala ani na baabla teete-ɔ.

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ya na lɛti mina kenye bɔda na lɛkɔsi bɔtɛmi!

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Taya na mina kayi kasia likpidi lɛdi bɔbla lɛlɔ. Na taya na liti lɛlɔ lɛkya bekyuli bekpidi ablala kemmo. Na taya na bana adila adi ada-mi ɔkwɛ.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Taya na lini ka ukyuli ɔni nse siin ɔni-mi kɔtu iye ɔdɔnku-mi. Ɔsika ɔmmɔ ɔdubunwini lɛƒɔndia mmomu ute-mi. Taya na lɛƒɔ bumwi bɔdi lɛsiku bekyuli bekpidi kudɔ aani kalɛ na beewi ukyuli lili nnɔmii, ɔsika mɔɔkpali katɔ uwi biala nnii utatɛ utete bekyuli bani mbo likyulikpi.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Si uwi ɔni na béƒwimi bana lɛlɔ badine básiku atakpɛ eli bátáva kalɔ ni, uwi ɔmmɔ na bekyuli bammɔ badubɔnu bɔti ka mina etemila adi sɔsɔ.

english_verse: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
translation_verse: Na badubo bana ekubi bugyingya buwi kɔƒiɔtɔ atu aani atakpɛ kɔkɛ, kalɛ kalɛ.

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: Nsu mina anu asia awɔ mina Unwoti Katɔti lɛlɔ kani. Gyumana-mi na lɛkɛ kabɛkɔ na ƒula kudɔ kalɛ na neeeduo ɔgbankpi ɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
translation_verse: Kɔkpagyuɛ kɔni na mina bekisine bákywɛ-mi ƒui ni, da-mi die-ku kemmo.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Na aya na balalane banu beduo ama alati bana kɔkpagyuɛ kɔmmɔ kemmo uwi ɔni na áya-mi na lɛ́lɛ sɛɛn na bana enu kemmo.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Líwulo keku lɛ́kya mina Unwoti. Na lɛ́talaku mina lɛdi katɔ lívele-nwu ka ɔnu-mi kɔnyana.

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: Lɛ́ka mina etemila ƒui lɛ́tina-nwu. Na lɛ́da ala ani muukpóku-mi ƒui lɛ́va-nwu anumi.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: Si uwi ɔni na enu áƒɛ-mi na lɛ́yila lɛnunsia ni, awɔ agyi ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na eti-mi asiaku. Bekisine bábɛ bákywɛ-mi kakpagyuɛ na mina kɔvinkɔ.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: Si lɛ́nu lɛ́mana ni, mɔɔnu ka ukyuli ɔdi uuubo na ute-mi kebunku kadi. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ńtakɛ katamikukɔ kadi. Na ukyuli ɔdi lɛnɔ ɔɔɔdaku mina ngba lɛda.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: Lɛ́kpali awɔ, mina Unwoti Katɔti, na lɛ́su-ɔ nnini, “Awɔ ndi mina katamikukɔ. Na awɔ kani mɔɔwia na mina ngba ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Die-mi lɛku ɔgbankpi bonwu ɔni kemmo na nkya aani ɔtɔntɛne kalɛ na lɛkɛ bɔnwuna. “Na ndubumwi-ɔ lɛnyi na ƒula bekyuli kedee kasalakɔ ɔkɛnku lɛƒɔndia lɛni na ábla-mi ɔsu.”

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, ka ese siin na asia ƒula litemi kama ɔsu ni, se atu na enu mina bɔkpali ku mina buvele. Na aya na linu lɛla lɛdi lɛsiku-ɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Na tatɛku ami ƒula kabla ɔblane litemi. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔyawine biala na uli ngba na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ uuuse siin na ƒula anumi.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Mina ukisine ɔbi ɔsiaku-mi na uukpóku-mi. Úbo-mi ɔ́va kalɔ na ɔ́di-mi lɛlɔ. Na úti-mi ɔ́kya lɛdisa kemmo aani ukyuli ɔni nékpi kukuuku.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu enu adaku-mi bɔƒɛ na nsɔ liiibo lɛnunsia lɛdi.

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: Lɛ́kali lɛ́nu uwi ɔni návi na líduo lɛlɔ kemmo lísie ɔgyu na lɛ́nu akɔla ala budie taatina ani na ƒula enu ábla.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: Lɛ́kɔliku mina enu katɔ mɔɔkpali-ɔ aani kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na ntu bɔ́kwii bɔ́sa ƒui.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: Unwoti, nu-mi bɔkpali. Mina lɛnunsia lɛ́sa. Na téti lɛlɔ tabɛla-mi, si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, ndubo bukpi aani bamanvine bani ntɔ kalɛ.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Teenyimene-mi ɔtanta biala ka aayɔ́-mi uwi ndi uwi. Ɔsika ƒula lɛlɔ kani na mina anu asia. Tina-mi mina kasiakɔ, ɔsika awɔ kani na mɔɔkpali ku mina kɔyu ƒui.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: Die-mi lɛku mina bekisine enu kemmo O Unwoti. Ɔsika awɔ na líkeli ḿbatamiku.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Tina-mi kalɛ na lɛbla ƒula lɛƒɔyɔ, ɔsika awɔ ndi mina Katɔti. Na aya na ƒula lɛƒɔndia lɛtɔnku-mi na lɛsia ngba ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, die-mi lɛku mina lɛbibo kemmo ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛnyi kedee lɛlɔ ku ƒula ɔyikun ɔsu na lɛkɛ ngba bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku kalɛ na aayɔ́-mi uwi biala ɔsu ni, yila mina bekisine ƒui udu. Ɔsika ƒula kabla ɔblane na ndi.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Muute Unwoti kusɛ kusɛ. Anwu ndi mina Lɛtakpɛ. Ɔsika anwu mɔɔtina-mi kalɛ na liti mina enu likpo kekpo. Na anwu mɔɔyá na mina animi aata na mina ekpola lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: Awɔ ndi mina lɛtakpɛ ku katamikukɔ kesii kani mɔɔkɛ́ bɔƒɔ. Ƒula lɛlɔ na mina anu asia, ɔsika adi mina ɔgyumanane ɔni muuboku mina bekisine eli kalɔ teete-mi na mɔɔdi-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: O Unwoti, bi na abu bekyuli bayawine bɔdi bute-ɔ ɔsu na bɔ́ƒɔ-ɔ kuye lɛni? Na bi ɔsu na eeti-bu lɛlɔ kasusu uwi ndi uwi lɛni?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Buse aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ. Na bula emeyi ese aani ɔƒɛ ɔyuli ɔni mɔɔyii taakya kani na ɔ́sa.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, bwɛ kayaa na ebeduo-bu lɛlɔ mɛni. Na etuku abi ammɔ na uyɔ utaalɛ-nya kemmo.

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Na aya na kayaa kataabwɛ ogya na ugyingya ƒula bekisine bammɔ ƒui. Bo ƒula atula lɛ-ma na ayila-ma udu.

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Die ƒula kɔnu si katɔ na ada-mi edie-ma akɔ, na lɛlɛ ketu bonwu kani náka-mi kákya mɛni kemmo na kadi bamba bekyuli bamɛni enu akɔ.

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ ala sɔɔn na bagyi bɔsu na bana ablala ƒui ɔkɔ na adi.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Ndubɔtu ɔnu ɔwɔdi lite-ɔ na mina ɔbentaa lɛlɔ liti limwi

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: awɔ ɔni mɔɔyá baga baadi kekpo lɛlɔ. Awɔ muukpó teete ƒula kabla ɔblane Dawid na aaƒɔ́-nwu na nwuna bekisine ekpola aladi-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: Die-mi lɛku kadi bamba bekyuli bani mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ uwi biala ku ala bɔkpali muedi mɛni akɔ.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: Ya na bula bebi bakɔdi babla aani egyii ani mbo ɔkplu. Na bula belekubi beteekeye aani atabi ani na béti bátu ɔga lɛgbanya na bákwaa-nya na eekeye kalɛ.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Ya na bula linwu liyi ku edula lidu lidu na bula baƒonu lɛnɔ bawɔ na bemomo mpim mpim.

english_verse: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
translation_verse: Na bebuo bani mɔɔtuma teete-bu bataawɔ pii na betebile kaƒɔ na aya kukpi kusie kama. Na taya keku iye kɔnu kenye kɔdi kɔlɛ bula lɛblɔnu lɛlɔ!

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani na bana Unwoti ndi Katɔti ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma, ɔsika ama na kusɛ kusɛ ɔmɛni udu ɔɔsiaku.

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Ndububo-ɔ lɛnyi kudu lɛkɔliku-ɔ katɔ. Na nteemwi-ɔ lɛnyi kedee úti úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Limeyi ndi limeyi ndubumwi-ɔ lɛnyi na lɛtalaku ƒula lɛnyi katɔ uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti úbomo geen, na ɔ́manku bumwi. Na nwuna ɔyikun ni, ukyuli ɔdi ulénu-nwu kalɔ kudii.

english_verse: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
translation_verse: Ƒula ablala ɔsu ni, badubo-ɔ bumwi ɔ́si kaba útédu kaba. Na badubo ƒula ala enengudi lidu lidu ani na ábla lɛsa bɔkɔ.

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: Badubɔsu kalɛ na ƒula lɛgadi liikeye, na ndubulie kalɔ na liduo lɛlɔ kemmo lɛnu ƒula akɔla ala budie taatina lidu lidu lɛni na aabla.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli badubɔsu ala enengudi ani na ábla, na lidie ƒula ɔyikun bonwu keyi lɛtina.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Badubo lɛbuni bonwu lɛni na ábla-bu butaasu ku lɛlɔyɔ, na bedie agya basu kalɛ na ese siin na ebo lɛƒɔndia.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: Unwoti ubo lɛƒɔndia na ɔɔnu kɔnyana na uléti kɔnyi pla pla, na ɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔdia ute ukyuli biala. Na ala ani ƒui na údie ni, ɔɔnu ana ƒui kɔnyana.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ala ani ƒui na édie adubumwi ƒula lɛnyi. Na ƒula bekyuli kedee ƒui badubo-ɔ lɛnyi katɔ bɔtalaku.

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Badubɔsu kalɛ na ƒula lɛga kadikɔ keekeye ku kalɛ na ebo ɔyikun.

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na ukyuli biala ɔnu ƒula ablala bonwu ɔti ku kalɛ na ƒula Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma lɛgadi liikeye.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: Na ƒula lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ keeebo kawɔlɔkɔ na awɔ kani ndubɔdi lɛga buteesie uwi ƒui. Unwoti ɔɔdi nwuna linyese lɛlɔ na ubo lɛƒɔndia na nwuna ablala ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Ƒula ala ediedi ƒui aanu-ɔ anumi. Na awɔ muute-ma bana lɛdila na uwi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: Awɔ muubimi ƒula enu na lɛla biala nli ngba lɛɛkɛ́ nina lɛla lɛni na ɔɔwia.

english_verse: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
translation_verse: Unwoti use siin na ulu biala lɛlɔ, na ubo lɛƒɔndia na nwuna ablala ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Unwoti ude bekyuli bani mɔɔkpali-nwu ulu lɛlɔ ku ɔbu geen.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔyia-nwu ku ɔbu ni, ɔɔbla bana lɛyɔla teete-ma. Na uunú bana kɔvanu na uubo taabaƒɔ-ma si bévele-nwu.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Na bani ƒui mɔɔyɔ́-nwu ni, ɔɔgyumana-ma. Nsu balalane ama ni, ɔdubɔyila-ma udu.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: Ndubumwi Unwoti uwi biala. Amii nwuna ala ediedi ƒui bimwi-nwu lɛnyi kedee ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all that I am, I will shout his praises.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti. O Unwoti, ndubɔkpali-ɔ limwi ku mina kɔyu ƒui!

english_verse: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na mmu nli ngba mɛni ku mina ɔlɔna ni, ndubumwi Unwoti Katɔti.

english_verse: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.
translation_verse: Biteti anu bitasia bagadine lɛlɔ iye bayawine bebi badi lɛlɔ, ɔsika ɔdi ulakana-mi bubunku.

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Si ɔdi ɔ́yula ni, ɔ́sa únwini lɛla likpine na bɔva na badubo-nwu. Na nwuna kasusu ku kakwɛ kawɔlɔkɔ kadi mmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni néti nwuna anu ɔ́sia Yakob Unwoti Katɔti lɛlɔ ka ubunku-nwu, ɔsika úti Unwoti ɔ́bla nwuna Katɔti.

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: Anwu nédie kalɔ kammɔ ƒui ku ɛpu ku ala ani ƒui nkya-nya kemmo, na ɔɔdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ uwi biala.

english_verse: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
translation_verse: Anwu mɔɔtɛ litemi teete bekyuli bani na beekpóku. Na bani na kɔka kɔɔda ni, uute-ma adila. Na bani na bákya-ma ɔtɔ lɛnɔ ni, uudie-ma na baakɛ́ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti uubimi banumbwɛne anumi. Na bani na bekyuli béboku-ma kalɔ ni, ɔɔkɔliku-ma katɔ, na ɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli bani na bese siin.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: Ɔɔnu baƒɔ lɛlɔ, na uudie bekpinebi ku bekpinele. Nsu balalane ama ni, Unwoti Katɔti uubile bana ablala ku kɔkwɛ ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubo lɛga bɔdi uwi ƒui. O Sion, ƒula Unwoti ɔdubɔdi lɛga na kaba bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ. Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti! Ɔsika ɔdia ka bumwi bula Katɔti. Ɔdi lɛla lɛbuni, na ɔ́manku lɛnɔ.

english_verse: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́sɔku Yerusalem ɔ́tu, na ɔ́sala bani na béƒie bátɔlɔku ƒui ɔ́sɔku-ma úboku ɔma.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: Ɔgyi ayabi ani ƒui na udie kalɛ na emomo. Na ubo ɔ́di biala ku nwuna lɛnyi.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔkɔliku bekyuli bani muubo-ku lɛlɔ kalɔ katɔ. Na bekyuli bani mɔɔkɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ ni, uuboku-ma kalɔ.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Bidie enugya lɛnu bimwi Unwoti. Na bɛgya lɛbentaa bidie bumwi lɛnu bite bula Katɔti.

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: Anwu náya na ulɔyɔ ɔ́ƒɔ kayaa ƒui. Na ɔɔyá na ɔnantu ɔɔna teewi kalɔ, na livo lɛɛkwɛ́ abi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Uute beƒiebuo adila na baadi, na ɔɔnyuɛ baasɛ bebi bani muuwulo kɔka lɛnɔ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani néti bana anu básia bapɔnkɔ ɔyikun iye bekpone bani nkɛ lɛgba lɛlɔ ka wedie-ma, balayɔ Unwoti Katɔti kaƒɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
translation_verse: Na bani mɔɔyia Katɔti na benye baanu ulu teete nwuna bɔyɔ bɔni naaasa kudii ni, bana lɛlɔ mɔɔda Katɔti kubiti.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Amii Yerusalem kadi bekyuli ƒui, bimwi Unwoti Katɔti na bɛkɔliku-nwu lɛnyi katɔ,

english_verse: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
translation_verse: ɔsika abuala na úti ɔ́kalɛ bina ɔba kenye kpakplaa. Na úte ƒula ɔma kemmo bebi kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya bɛ́kɛ atu bɔyɔ ɔ́ka ɔ́mana ƒula ntɛ mmɔ. Na anta ku kamu káƒɔ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
translation_verse: Na lɛla biala na Unwoti ɔ́su ni, liigyingya teesie kesi kesii kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
translation_verse: Ɔɔyá na etubankɛ aayu taaƒɔ kalɔ ƒui na eekeye ƒututuu aani bebuo linwini. Na nwuna kɔkɛ wɛlɛ wɛlɛ kɔɔƒɔ́ kalɔ ƒui aani ntɔ kalɛ.

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: Na ɔdi ɔɔyu aani abanta bonwu bonwu. Na ɔdi biala ulakana kɔyɔ kɔmmɔ kenye bunye.

english_verse: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
translation_verse: Ɔɔyɛɛlɛ abanta amɛni ƒui si údie lɛdi, na eenwíni ketu taagba si ɔƒɛƒɛɛ úkpo ɔ́vi-nya lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: Unwoti úti nwuna ɔda bubo ku ala bɔtina ƒui úte Yakob kaba kemmo bebi bani ndi Israelƒuɔ.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Útabla ɔmɛni útete kadi bamba bekyuli badi kudii. Na baaagyi kalɛ na ɔɔtɛ litemi lɛnɔ. Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti. Bimwi Unwoti Katɔti na bibo-nwu kudu bɛsiku katɔ ku kayaa kakaaka ƒui!

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Amii Katɔti batu ku amii nwuna kabla bablane lisu ƒui, bimwi-nwu!

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛ ku kɔbuli ku ayabi ku ala ani ƒui muukeye na kayaa ƒui, bimwi-nwu.

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Amii kayaa ala ku ntu bɔni nƒa katɔ kakaaka ƒui, bimwi Unwoti Katɔti.

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Bimwi-nwu, ɔsika Unwoti Katɔti údie lɛdi na údie lɛla biala ku nwuna kenye litemi.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na ala ammɔ enye ana kunyekɔ úti úsela uwi ƒui. Na lɛla lɛdi lilakana ala ani na ɔ́bla úse mɛni bɔvumana uwi ɔdi kudii.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Amii ala ani ƒui na údie ɔ́kya kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui, bimwi-nwu lɛnyi! Na amii bani ƒui nkya ɛpu kemmo lɛnɔ bimwi-nwu lɛnyi!

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Ogya ku etubankɛ ku ulɔyɔ ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔni muukpó na biinú-nwu lɛdi ƒui bimwi-nwu.

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: Abi ku abinkpo ku adingyii ku egyii enengudi ƒui

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: ku beƒiebuo ku bebuo bamba ƒui na aku kemmo bani mɔɔkpɛ́ kaƒɔ lɛlɔ ku kayaa baasɛ bani muunú-nwu litemi ƒui, bimwi-nwu.

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: Kalɔ lɛlɔ baga ku bekyuli ƒui ku lɛlɔ badine ku kalɔ lɛlɔ litemi batɛne

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: ku bakloƒu ku begblebi, banana ku beleku ku banamu ƒui, bimwi Unwoti Katɔti lɛnyi.

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Bina ƒui bɛya na bemwi Blɔti, ɔsika anwu lɛti kani nse kede kede ƒui. Na nwuna bukeye bɔ́ƒɔ kayawi ƒui, na bɔ́kɔ búbo bɔ́vi kalɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na nwuna kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ bani mma-nwu lɛlɔ bálɛ lili, ɔsika ɔɔgyumana-ma kpakplaa aani akɔ ɔni mbo ɔyikun ku ese kangyaa. Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti. Bidie ɔnu ɔwɔdi bite-nwu. Na bimwi-nwu na bekyuli kedee ƒui akɔ.

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Israel, lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii, amii bani na Unwoti Katɔti údie. Na amii Sion bebi ku bawɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii na bina ɔga lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Bɛtɔ katɔ na biti bimwi-nwu lɛnyi. Na biti enukpɛ agyala ku lɛbentaa bidie lɛnu bimwi-nwu.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ Unwoti Katɔti na nwuna bekyuli lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubɔya na bani nse buɛɛ ƒui balɛ lili, ɔsika ɔdubɔƒɔ-ma.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bekyuli kedee ƒui bakɛ lɛlɔyɔ na bekeye na bana kɔtɛnkɔ. Na bedie lɛnu momoomo!

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Bɛya na buteenu bana bumwi lɛnu kɔku na bana inye kemmo. Na beti kuwii kɔni bádɔ-ku lɛvi inyɔ bada.

english_verse: Take revenge and punish the nations.
translation_verse: Na beti bedie baƒiɔkpane kasi na bani bekyuli kɔtu.

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Na bana baga ku batɔnkune ni, bebo-ma kɔgba.

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Na batɛku-ma litemi na badu-ma kɔtɔ aani kalɛ na bénweni bése. Kenyekɔ ku ɔbu ɔmmɔ udu na béti béte bekyuli kedee bamɛni. Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti. Amii kadi bekyuli ƒui, bimwi Unwoti Katɔti na nwuna kakpakɔ kedee kemmo! Bimwi anwu ɔni nédie kayaa na uli-ka lɛlɔ mmɔ ku ɔyikun.

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Bimwi-nwu na nwuna ala ebendi ani na ɔ́bla ɔsu. Na nwuna bumwi bɔkɔ katɔ butédu kalɛ na ɔ́bla ala abuni útédu kenye.

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Bɛvwi kɔkpɛɛ biti bimwi-nwu. Na bɛgya agyangba ku lɛbentaa biti bimwi-nwu.

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: Bɛgya agyala ani mɔɔku na bɛtɔ biti bimwi-nwu. Biti agyala ani na bédi ku kɔbuli bimwi-nwu ku atoloyii.

english_verse: Praise God with cymbals, with clashing cymbals.
translation_verse: Bimwi-nwu ku enukpɛ agyala ani mɔɔku ku agyala ani muusié ɔgyu.

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Bɛya na Unwoti Katɔti ala ediedi ani ƒui mbo ngba emwi-nwu. Bɛya na bumwi Unwoti.

english_verse: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
translation_verse: Agba amɛni na Dawid ubidi Salomo ɔni ndi Israelƒuɔ Ɔga úbo.

english_verse: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni na agba amɛni adanku ndi ka atina bekyuli na bakana badi lɛlɔ lɛlɔ na benu asugba kalɔ.

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: Agba amɛni ndubɔya na bani na bana kasusu kásɔ bati lɛla. Na begblebi ku bakloƒu bati lɛla na babla kasusu na bana keliela lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: Na bani na báda anu ni, bana lɛnunda lɛɛkɔ́ katɔ teebu. Na bani mɔɔnu ala kemmo taati lɛnɔ bati bana kasiakɔ.

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: Na benu agba ku kenwini etemila kalɔ na benu banundane agyolo ku kekuma atɛ kalɔ.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: Unwoti bɔyia ndi ukyuli lɛlati kalɔ kesekɔ. Nsu badɔlɔdi beení lɛnunda etemila ku kalɛ na badi lɛlɔ lɛlɔ kaduɛ. Da Anu Ɔkɛnku Kalɛ Na Ƒ'ɔti Ɔɔlɛ-ɔ Kpakplaa Lɛlɔ

english_verse: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
translation_verse: Ubi, se atu na enu ƒ'ɔti ɔda bubo. Na teni ƒ'ini lɛla lɛni na ɔɔtina-a.

english_verse: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na átɛya bana kudɔ ɔdubunwini kagabwa kebi-ɔ lili. Na unwini asɛɛ abuni akya-a limɔ.

english_verse: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
translation_verse: Mina ubi, si bekyuli bekpidi baadɔ́dɔ-ɔ ni, nwini kama kya-ma!

english_verse: when they say, “Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!
translation_verse: Badubɔkana na basu-ɔ banini, “Bo, basiaku-bu. Na aya na bɔbɛ na bɔdu ukyuli ɔdi! Na bubi kesii kadi butaatu bekyuli bani nátabla-bu lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
translation_verse: Ya na bubweli-ma ngba ngba aani kaƒiɔtɔ, na bɔyila-ma udu ƒui aani bekyuli bani nánu béduo ubu kemmo.

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: Na bana ala abuni ani na búƒie bɔ́ƒɔ ni, bɔdubuyile bula lɛtɔ ku-nya!

english_verse: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
translation_verse: Bo na ebenyeku-bu kpakplaa, na abu ku-ɔ bɔdubule ala ani na búƒie bɔ́ƒɔ mmɔ.”

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: Ubi, tesie ku bekyuli bammɔ udu! Tani tede bana kɔvinkɔ munu munu!

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: Baababla ku usi taatábla ekpidi. Na baababla teewi ubugya kalɔ.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: Keeke na aakywɛɛ kakpagyuɛ si baasɛ benye baanu!

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Nsu uuuse lɛni ku bekyuli bammɔ udu. Ama alati lɛlɔ na bebi baatú, na kubu na baasia ama alati lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life. Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ƒui na anumi eegyie-ma na lɛkɛ likpidi lɛlɔ ni, lɛni na bana kawɔlɔkɔ kaabla. Bɔlɛ Ute Bekyuli Bani Muuní Lɛnunda

english_verse: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
translation_verse: Lɛnunda lise aani ukyuli ɔni muubó kudu na lilu lɛlɔ. Na uute kenye na kɔsalakɔ ƒui.

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: Na ɔɔkpali bani ƒui nkɛ ulu unengudi ɔni lɛlɔ baaní lɛsɛ, na uubó kudu taasiku awodu eli. Na ɔɔsu nwuna kenye na ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ awoduku kɔyakun kenye.

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: Na ka bíni mina bɔlɛ na bilátuna bɛnii ndɔnku-mii ɔsu ni,

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: na ese aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa uwi ɔni na ɔgbankpi ɔda-mii ɔɔvínku aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔkya ligede na ala ani nétulo-mii áya na kayi kaakpulu-mii.

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, bɛdubɔkpali ami Lɛnunda, nsu naaakpete-mii. Na bɛdubɔwia-mi na bilanu-mi.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bíkisi lɛlati na bítaƒuna ka bitaayia Unwoti ku ɔbu.

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: Bíni mina bɔlɛ na bíveli atu na mina bɔdɔnku ɔsu

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: na ngba bɔni udu na bilie ni, nwuna ebi na bɛdubo bɔdi. Na ulu ɔni na bɛ́ƒuna ka bɛsia ni, nwuna ala emo-mii.

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: Nsu bani ƒui muunú-mi litemi ni, badubulie ngba na atu bɔyɔ kemmo, na lɛla lɛdi lilékpoku-ma na balayia ka ukpidi ɔdi walɛku-ma lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: Mina ubi, si áƒɔ mina etemila, na áklibi mina ɔda bubo ése éte lɛlɔ,

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: na ƒula kɔtu kɔsia lɛnunda etemila lɛlɔ na áya na ƒula kayi kasia ala kalɔ bunu lɛlɔ

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: na eevele ala kemmo bɔnu taati na eevele ala kalɔ bunu kpakplaa

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: na aawia-nya aani kalɛ baawia sika ɔƒualadi na asia-nya kama aani akɛla abɛladi ni,

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: na ɔdubɔya na enu kalɛ na baayia Unwoti kalɔ na ati-nwu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti muute lɛnunda! Na nwuna etemila aayá na ukyuli ɔɔtí lɛla na ɔɔdá anu.

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nse siin ni, uusé-ma kama ka badi lɛlɔ. Na ɔdi lɛgyumanala ute bekyuli bani na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-ma na bana kasiakɔ.

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ siin ni, ɔɔgyumana-ma na bana kasiakɔ. Na ɔɔda bani nsiaku-nwu kama siin taasiaku bana kɔvinkɔ.

english_verse: With wisdom you will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Na adubunu lɛla lɛni ndia na lɛdi ulu lɛlɔ siin kalɔ na ulu buni biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛnunda lɛdubuduo-ɔ kayi kemmo na lɛlati lɛƒɔ-ɔ kɔyu kemmo ku ebiti.

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: Na ala anu bɔsia taabla-nya ulu lɛlɔ ɔdubɔgyumana-a na ala kalɔ bunu bɔda-a kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: Lɛnunda lɛmmɔ lɛdubɔƒɔ-ɔ lɛsiku bekyuli bekpidi kasiakɔ, na alásala lɛlɔ ku bani mɔɔtɛmi enyekpi.

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni udu baada ulu geen ɔmmɔ taava na beeti ulu ukpidi ɔni néti-ma úselaku kasuudikɔ.

english_verse: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.
translation_verse: Na ebiti aada-ma ka bataabla likpidi na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-ma na bana likyulikpi ala bɔbla lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: Bana ala bɔbla ƒui buse gontii na bana ablala adi likyulikpi sɔɔn.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: Lɛnunda lɛdubɔda-a lidie uleku ɔsɔnɔdine unyemi kudɔ, uleku ɔmmɔ ɔdi ɔgya uliene ɔni mɔɔlɛ́ ɔgyani kama katɔlɔ.

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: Ɔ́lɛ nwuna ligblebi uwi kɔgya kɔni na úlie na údie lɛla lɛni na únyimiku-nwu na Unwoti anumi atu.

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: Nwuna ɔtɔ kemmo buduo ɔdi ulu ɔni néti úsela kekpine, na nwuna kavinkɔ ƒui kadi bekpine kakyakɔ ulu.

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: Ɔdi uleduo-nwu kudɔ taasɔ teenwini iye ɔsɔ ɔnu ngba ulu geen ɔmmɔ ɔsia.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: Sia bekyuli babuni kasiakɔ mmomu, na asia bekyuli bani nse siin kavinkɔ.

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: Nsu belikplune ama ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔda-ma udie kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ. Na bani mɔɔlɛ́-nwu kama ni, na ɔkpɛ-ma ɔlɛku-ka kemmo.

english_verse: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
translation_verse: Mina ubi, tayiƒala ala ani na lɛ́tina-a. Mmomu da mina ɔda bubo kya ƒula kayi kemmo.

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔmmɔ ndubɔya na elie ngba gyɔlɔɔ na ala adianku-ɔ na keyi kayɔku-ɔ.

english_verse: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Tanyonu lɛƒɔndia bɔbla ku litemi kama bɔsiaku siin. Ti ala amɛni bo bala ƒula limɔ na aya na akɛ keliekɔ na ƒula kayi kemmo.

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na aƒɔ lɛnyi na adia na Unwoti ku bekyuli ƒui anumi.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Ti ƒula anu ku kayi ƒui sia Unwoti lɛlɔ. Na teti anu tasia awɔ ɔlati ƒula ala kalɔ bunu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: Nu-nwu ti na ƒula lilu ƒui lɛlɔ, na ɔdubɔtɔnku-ɔ na ƒula kasiakɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Ƒula anumi atatɔlɔ-ɔ na anu lɛlɔ ɔnundane. Mmomu yia Unwoti na enwini kama akya likpidi.

english_verse: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na akɛ ɔlɔkplu na ɔlɔna kemmo na lɛlɔ ekubi asa-a kpakplaa.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: Ti ƒula lɛkɛ teemwi Unwoti. Na eti ƒula edula biala ebi edeedi ete-nwu.

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: Ɔdubɔya na ƒula linwu liyi ku edula abuni na akpambui lɛnɔ eyi ku ntɛ mini mini.

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: Mina ubi, teni si Unwoti ɔɔní-ɔ kɔtu ka ɔklibi-ɔ. Na utekpoku-ɔ si ɔɔdɔnku-ɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bani na Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́ ni, ama na ɔɔlɛ kpakplaa aani kalɛ na ubi ɔti ɔdi ɔɔní ubidi ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́ kɔtu.

english_verse: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni nákɛ lɛnunda na uunú ala kalɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ubo kɔsia utulo sika ɔƒualadi. Na nwuna lɛkɛ litulo sika ugyiedi.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Lɛnunda lɛ́ƒɔ kuye litulo asɛɛ ebi ani náƒɔ kuye geen muedi. Na lɛla bamba lɛni na ukyuli ɔɔwia lɛdi lítaƒɔ kuye liiitulo ɔmɛni.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: Lɛnunda lɛdanku ngba gyɔlɔɔ na nwuna kɔdianu. Na nwuna kɔmiinu lɛnɔ kɔdanku lɛkɛ ku ɔbu.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: Nwuna lilu lɛdi kasiakɔ kabuni. Na lɛdi keyi buɛɛ lilu.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: Ngba kugyii ndi lɛnunda ute bani nda-nwu kpakplaa. Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bani nébo enu báda-nwu.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Lɛnunda na Unwoti úti ɔ́kya kalɔ kammɔ ɔka kalɔ. Na ala kalɔ bunu na úti údie katɔ ɔ́ƒala kayaa.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku nwuna lɛlati lɛlɔ na úle ntu bonwu bɔmmɔ akpa akpa. Na ɔɔyá na liƒlukutu lɛnɔ lɛɛyu amii.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Mina ubi, sia ala bɔnu taati anu ku etemila kemmo bɔƒuna kaduɛ na tada ɔdi tava.

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔmmɔ ndi ƒula ngba. Na ɔdubunwini aani sika asɛɛ na ƒula limɔ ani ndubɔkya-a bɔdia.

english_verse: You will walk safely and never stumble;
translation_verse: Na adubusie ƒula ngba ulu kɔkɔɔkɔ. Na ƒula ɔgba uletulo iye agbanta.

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: Si áyu átɛ ni, liƒu biala lilada-a, mmomu adubɔlɛɛ na lɛlɛɛ lɛyu-ɔ.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Tayia ɔgbankpi ɔni muuyú bekyuli taatu iye ala ani muubieku balalane.

english_verse: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti lɛlɔ na ése kayi na anwu ndubudie-ɔ na alakya kakpagyuɛ kadi ɔgba.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: Teni lɛbuni bɔbla bute ukyuli ɔni mɔɔwia-a kebunku si ánu ka ébo ɔyikun ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
translation_verse: Tasu ƒula ukyulikpana anini, “Teesie, kɔnaadi na ebo abaƒɔ,” si lɛla lɛni na uuvele-ɔ lise-ɔ ɔmwi.

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Awɔ ku ukyuli ɔdi bitasa lili likpidi na ƒula liku ɔkpana lɛlɔ, ka bilie bide ku ebiti.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Tada ƒula ɔkpana kenye kekeeke si útabla-a lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Anumi etegyie-ɔ na bekyuli bekpidi bani mɔɔkya lɛsɛ lɛlɔ. Na tasiaku bana ɔbladu kama.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi bammɔ ala eesé Unwoti lɛlɔ geen. Nsu bekyuli bani nse siin ni, ulábɛla-ma nwuna kasusu.

english_verse: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
translation_verse: Unwoti uuwida bekyuli bekpidi kɔduli. Nsu nwuna kusɛ kusɛ ɔɔsiaku bekyuli bani nse siin.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔpii bekyuli bani mɔɔpii bekyuli ka baatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ ɔsu. Mmomu uubunku bani muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Banundane baakɛ́ ɔbu kese. Nsu badɔlɔdi ama ni, kɔƒa na beli bete.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: Mina bebi, bise atu na binu ami bina ɔti ɔda bubo. Bise atu na bɛkɛ ala kalɔ bunu.

english_verse: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
translation_verse: Ala ani ndi etemila geen na áƒɔ kuye na mɔɔtina-mii. Anwuɔsu bitenwini kama bitakya-nya.

english_verse: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ndi ɔnamu na lɛ́kya mina ɔti kaduli, na ami kani ndi mina uni ubi ɔnanabi ni,

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: Ɔ́tina-mi ala na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ƒie mina etemila da kpakplaa ku ƒula kayi ƒui. Di mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ na adubulie ngba.

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Nu ka ebo lɛnunda ku ala kalɔ bunu. Na tayiƒala mina etemila iye edeyi-nya kudɔ esie kesii bamba.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Tenwini kama takya lɛnunda, na lɛdubo-ɔ bɔgyumana. Yɔ lɛnunda na lɛdubo-ɔ lɛlɔ bɔnu.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Lɛla linengudi ƒui lɛni na ɔlɛka awia ndi lɛnunda. Ina ka ɔdanku ƒula lɛla biala ni, nu ka ebo ala kalɔ bunu na lɛla biala na aabla kemmo.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Ya lɛnunda lɛ́ƒɔ-ɔ kuye geen na lɛdubɔkɔliku-ɔ katɔ. Kya-nwu kɔgbu na ɔbu ɔdubɔkya-a lɛlɔ.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: Ɔdubudi lɛka lɛni mɔɔdia bɔnu ɔsia-a lili na akɛ kagabwa kani muukeye.”

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Ubi, nu-mi litemi na aƒɔ lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu-ɔ. Ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔya na elie ngba na akwa emomo-ɔ.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: Lɛnunda lilu na mɔɔtina-a. Na lɛtɔnku-ɔ lɛsiaku lilu lɛbuni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Na si akɛ eesié ni, elekpuulo. Na si usi lɛnɔ na akɛ eekeli ni, alatutu.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Da mina ala ani na lɛ́tina-a na tanyonu-mu Da-mu kaduɛ, ɔsika ala ammɔ ndi ƒula ngba.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Tasiaku balalane lɛgba kanyakɔ. Na tasia lilu lɛni na bekyuli bekpidi bakɛ.

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bekpidi balátuna bɔtɛ talɛɛ útédu ka bábla likpidi. Likyulikpi bɔbla liiyú-ma lɛlɛlɛ wetédu ka bebile ukyuli ɔdi ngba.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Ulikplu bɔbla búnwini-ma adila, na kalala bɔbla ndi bana ntu bɔni na baaní!

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni nse siin kavinkɔ keekeye aani ɔtanta kadi kani négye kadubo na keekeye teebu utédu ka ɔbla nwaa ƒui.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bekpidi kavinkɔ aka kese aani ubu ɔni nse suu geen. Na balati lɛla lɛni mɔɔyá na beetulo taagbanta.

english_verse: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
translation_verse: Ubi, nu lɛla lɛni mɔɔsu-ɔ kaduɛ. Na ƒula kasusu kasia litemi biala lɛlɔ geen.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: Taya na mina etemila avi-ɔ anu. Mmomu ya na eduo-ɔ kayi kemmo geen.

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: Ɔsika adi ngba ete ukyuli ɔni nákɛ-nya, na aayá na awɔ ukyuli umodi ɔmmɔ aakɛ́ ɔlɔkplu.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni ntulo ƒui ni, da ƒula kayi kemodi kammɔ kaduɛ, ɔsika ngba libiɔ lɛni mɔɔyu ntu kadi.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Ya na kɔyalɛtɛ kusie kama ƒui na ƒula kudɔ Na etemila ani muusé lɛlɔ ƒui atalɛ-ɔ kenye.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Sia ƒula kasiakɔ anu kaduɛ ka kese-ɔ siin asa na ánya ésela. Nu ka ɔdi ulu kpakplaa na ulegyiileku-ɔ.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Tedeyi tesie kɔmii iye kɔdianu. Na edie ƒula ɔgba na likpidi bɔbla kemmo.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: Ubi, nu mina lɛnunda etemila kaduɛ. Na enu-mi lɛlati etemila ani mɔɔsu-ɔ.

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na adubɔtɛya kalɛ na baabla ala ulu lɛlɔ, na ƒula enyekuli aklibi lɛlati ala ese lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Uleku ɔsɔnɔ ɔdine ni, nwuna enyekuli aatɛmi ala mini mini aani uwɔ. Na etemila ani mɔɔlɛ́-nwu kenye aayu kayi buɛɛ aani nnɔmii.

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: Nsu lɛla lɛni mɔɔsia kama teebo lɛɛyu ɔdu kati kati na use yayaaya aani kewii kani bádɔ-ka lɛvi inyɔ.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Kekpine ulu na nwuna lɛgba lɛtɔ lísela. Na kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo kani na ɔdubo buduo.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔɔɔda ngba lɛda munu munu. Lilu gonti lɛlɔ kani na ɔkɛ úsela na anwu ɔlati ɔɔɔgyi.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Sia ulu ɔni nse sɛsɛɛ na ɔ́gyunku uleku ɔmɛni udu kakyakɔ. Na tani tede nwuna ɔtɔ kayakun,

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, adubɔda ƒula ɔyikun ala abuni ƒui ewi bekyuli bamba. Na ɔlalane ɔdi enu kemmo na ƒula ngba bɔdubɔwɔlɔ.

english_verse: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
translation_verse: Na baƒɔ ndubo ƒula lɛkɛ bɔƒɔ bunwini bana lɛdi. Na ƒula lɛbibo ƒui ebi enwini bekyuli bamba kaduli lɛkɛ kese.

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ƒui kama ni, ɔlɛ kemmo na adubo bɔtɛ buteedumo uwi ɔni na éesusu ƒula ɔlɔna ku ɔlɔgyii ɔmmɔ ébile áwɔlɔ.

english_verse: I paid no attention to my teachers,
translation_verse: Ńtadi mina ala batinane litemi lɛlɔ. Na ńtaƒɔ bekyuli bani mɔɔtina-mi ulu buni bɔlɛ.

english_verse: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
translation_verse: Líibo ḿbedu ubu kɔtu kesii kani na mina ngba bɔyii udu ƒui, na kadi bekyuli ƒui anumi.”

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: Du ntu na awɔ ɔlati ƒula libiɔ kemmo ni, ntu buni bɔni mɔɔgbá taasi ƒula libiɔ kemmo.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Bɔda na aada ƒula libiɔ ntu buni ese na buyi bɔgba butéwi lilu lɛlɔ? Na aya na ƒula ntukpa buni ntu bamamba bɔgba butéwi ɔma kemmo kadi ƒui kasakɔ?

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Ya na ala amɛni ƒui ese ete awɔ lɛti kani. Na tele-nya tete baƒɔ.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: Use aani akwa ubi ɔkɔdi ɔni mɔɔdia bɔnu ku lɛlɔyɔ. Ya na nwuna anyii ani nlɛ-nwu kayi emo-ɔ uwi ndi uwi. Na nwuna bɔyɔ butaada-a kayi uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: Mina ubi, bi ɔsu na ɔyalɛ mmomu ala na ɔlɛka ada-a kayi, na ataaƒuƒuɛ ukyuli bamba uleku anyii?

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti ɔɔnu ukyuli biala lɛla lɛni na ɔɔbla, na ɔɔkɔ́ku nwuna kasiakɔ biala taanu.

english_verse: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ukpidi ni, nwuna ekpidi lɛlɔ na baasia teeƒie-nwu. Na nwuna ablala muunwíni kɔbuli kɔni muudie-nwu.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Na nwuna lɛlɔ lɛlɔ takana bɔdi ɔsu na ɔdubo bukpi. Na nwuna kɔdɔlɔ pii ɔsu na ɔdubo bɔyii.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: Mina ubi, si ákya ɔku ɔdi kɔnu éte ƒula ɔkpana iye enye-nwu kama na nwuna kayu kadi ɔsu, nsu aaagyi-nwu kaduɛ,

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: babla na awia ulu na edie lɛlɔ! Use aani ka éti lɛlɔ ése ɔkpa éte-nwu. Anwuɔsu sie-nwu kudɔ na etéboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na evele ƒula ɔkpana ɔmmɔ kpakplaa!

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Tatɛ litemi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ talɛɛ na lɛlɛɛ biala litasia-a anumi.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Keli ɔgbankpi aani kalɛ na akwa uukeli ɔgbini iye aasɛ uukeli kakpagyuɛ kani na bákywɛ-nwu.

english_verse: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
translation_verse: Amii bakɔsɔne bɛnu balalɛ na bɛtɛya lɛla. Bɛnu bana ablala na bɛda anu!

english_verse: but they store up food during harvest season.
translation_verse: Nsu baaklibi edula buse kaƒɛndi uwi, na baasála-nya na edula ɔƒɛwi.

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: Na amii bakɔsɔne ni, uwi ɛlɛ sɔɔn na bɛdubɔtɛ butaalɛɛ butédu? Na uwi ɔmani na bɛdubɔta bina kalɛɛkɔ?

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Si ánu ka átɛ ávili, iye eli aalɛɛ teesie taasɔ, iye eti enu ényimi kayi eli aanwuna ukpludi ni,

english_verse: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
translation_verse: kɔwaba kɔdubo-ɔ buyu bɔtu aani uyune kalɛ. Na ayaki adubo-ɔ bukpoku aani kekpo ukpone kalɛ.

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Bana kayi kemmo kasusu kekpidi kaayá na likpidi kɔkwɛ kani na baakya. Na baakya lɛsɛ uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔgbankpi ɔdubɔsiaku-ma kɔnakunwi. Na badubɔyii udu ɔni na baaagyi beeese, na kakwɛ kadi keeebo.

english_verse: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
translation_verse: Alakpa aku adi akya na Unwoti ukisi geen. Na maatɛ adi eesé-nwu lɛlɔ,

english_verse: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
translation_verse: ku kayi kani muulie taakya likpidi kakwɛ, ku lɛgba lɛni mɔɔta pla pla na likpidi lɛlɔ,

english_verse: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
translation_verse: ɔkɔ kenye litemi bediene bani mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ taaka ala. Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔkya bekyuli ntɛ taabla ala ani na ubile banwani ntɛ. Bɔlɛ Na Lɛsɔnɔdi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
translation_verse: Bo-nya da ƒula kayi lɛlɔ uwi ƒui. Na ebo-nya ada ƒula limɔ.

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Na ala ammɔ adubɔtina-a ulu kesi kesii na akɛ. Si atɛ alɛɛ ni, adubɔgyumana-a. Na si áta katɛnkɔ ni, adubɔtɛmiku-ɔ.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔda bubo bɔmɛni bɔdi asogya, na ala bɔtina bɔmɛni bɔdi-ɔ bukeye. Na kalɛ na etemila amɛni aaklibi-ɔ na ati lɛlɔ bɔda ni, adi ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na adubɔsia na akɛ ngba.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Ɔdubɔda-a udie uleku ɔyalɛ enu kemmo ku uleku ɔsɔnɔdine kenyemini etemila kudɔ.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Ƒula kayi ketenwini katasia nwuna bɔdia lɛlɔ na ɔda-a limɔ. Taya na uti nwuna anumi ani na uusé ɔtɔlɔ-ɔ na uƒu-ɔ kasusu.

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔyalɛ ɔdubɔyila-a udu butédu ƒula limeyi bodobodo muedi. Na ngba bumodi bɔmmɔ geen na uleku ɔsɔnɔdine ɔɔtú-ɔ uƒie aani eƒiebuo.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Si ukyuli édie ogya ku agyabi ásia lɛlɔ ni, webulo-ɔ bɔkyula ku ƒula adala?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Na si ésie ávi ogya ku agyabi lɛlɔ ni, lɛgba lɛdubo bubulo-ɔ bɔnani?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: Lɛni geen na use ute ukyuli ɔni matɛ nwuna ɔkpana ulekudi kudɔ. Na ukyuli ɔni makya ɔkpana uleku kɔgbu ni, badubɔni-nwu kɔtu.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Bekyuli beleni uyune si úyu ɔsika kɔka mɔɔdú-nwu ɔsu na úyu ɔnii ɔɔdi umo.

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: Nsu si béƒie-nwu ni, ɔdubɔƒɔ eyula ammɔ kayu akpa maatɛ ina nwuna ɔtɔ kemmo ala ƒui na ɔdi ka uti uye asa waƒɔ kayu kammɔ.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Na ɔnana ɔni nádi kɔsɔnɔ ni, ɔdɔlɔdi geen na ɔdi, ɔsika ɔɔyila nwuna lɛlɔ udu ƒui.

english_verse: You will be beaten and forever disgraced,
translation_verse: Anwu ku alɛlɛbi ku kɔƒa. Na kɔƒa kɔmmɔ kulása-nwu lɛlɔ kudii.

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
translation_verse: Ɔsika uleku ɔmmɔ ɔgyani kogyulo kɔdubɔya na kɔnyi kutaakɔ-nwu. Anwuɔsu ɔɔɔdubo kɔnyana bɔnu si uudie-nwu kasi.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: Na kɔnu bɔsia ku etela biala aaadubo-nwu kaƒɔ bɔyɔ si ina dɛ na etela ammɔ emomo.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: Ubi, ƒie mina ɔda bubo da kaduɛ, na aklibi-mu ese na bɔƒɔ-ɔ lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
translation_verse: Da-mu kaduɛ na adubulie ngba. Gyumana-mu aani kalɛ na adubɔgyumana ƒula lɛnumi.

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Nyimi-mu da ƒula animi lɛlɔ, Na enweni-mu akya ƒula kayi kemmo.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Su lɛnunda anini, “Awɔ ndi mina ɔnwani ulekubi.” Na alɔ ala kalɔ bunu anii ƒula lɛlɔ ukyuli.

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Nnye mina ƒansili kudɔ dii, na lɛ́nu lɛ́vinku kalɛmikɔ liƒi lɛdi.

english_verse: One of these young men turned the corner and was walking by the house of an unfaithful wife.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ɔbla kadi buɛɛ na use susuusu uwi ɔni na keyi kadaku buti.

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Uleku ɔdi ɔ́lɛ úbasiaku-nwu na ɔ́da lɛlɔ aani ɔyalɛ kalɛ na ɔda ɔnana ɔkwɛ.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: Ɔsika uleku ɔni mbo kudu na kɔƒa kulekpo na ɔdi. Na ulélie kaduli uwi ɔdi.

english_verse: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
translation_verse: Ɔgbami ku eyeya kani na adubɔnu-nwu Na ɔkɛ amadɔ amadɔ ɔɔƒulu taavi.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: Uleku ɔmɛni ɔ́kya okloƒu ɔmmɔ kɔgbu na ɔ́ƒiɔ-nwu kenye. Na úƒi anumi ɔ́kun na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini,

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́bla mina unwi bɔbla akpala. Na ɔmwi lɛ́wɔlɔ lɛla biala ɔkɛnku kenye kani na líse lɛlɔ.

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na lɛ́lɛ líbo mbasiaku-ɔ Lɛ́sia-a anu geen na ḿbanu-ɔ sɔsɔ!

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: Lɛ́ɛva mina atɛla líse. Adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ abuni ani nási Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ku kunweni lidu na adi.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́ya na ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔ́ƒɔ mina atɛla ammɔ. Nnɔmii bɔni baalɔ mira ku lidu bamba na lɛ́kuna líwi-nya lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: Mina ɔgyani uuubo kaduli. Úsie ulugyuɔ ɔdi.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: Úyile nwuna egulabi kavumi ku egulabi na úti ɔda ulu. Na ɔɔɔdubo tɔ wetédu kɔbuli kumodi ƒui!”

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu uleku ɔmmɔ ɔ́tɔlɔ-nwu útásiaku ulu bamba lɛlɔ ku nwuna atɛ mini mini ammɔ. Na nwuna katɔlɔ ɔsu úƒie-nwu kayi.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Na únwini ɔ́siaku-nwu kɔnakunwi aani ebuo ɔni bésela batádu iye akwa ɔni nánu kakpagyuɛ,

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: na unye ɔgya ka lɛtula lɛƒuala-nwu kayi. Na útavumanaku aasɛ ɔni muuveyi taatánu kamia na ɔɔɔgyi ɔnii ɔgbankpi kemmo na úsela.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Mina bebi, binu ala ani mɔɔsu-mii Na bise atu na ala ani mɔɔsu eduo-nya kemmo kaduɛ.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Bitaya na bina kayi katɔlɔ-mii na bɛsiaku-nwu kama. Na bitayii ulu na bɛsiaku ulu ukpidi ɔni lɛlɔ na úti-mii ɔɔsiaku lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: Ɔsika anwuɔsu na banana pii báyii udu, na bani na ɔ́ɔdu lɛnɔ bemomo.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Uleku ɔmɛni ɔtɔ ni, kaƒiɔtɔ ulu unengudi na ɔdi. Na ɔtɛ úsie kekpine ubu kalɔ kemmo lɛtɔ lɛmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: Unye lilu lɛlɔ na kesii kani nákuku ƒui. Na uudí teenye elukpo ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: Unye lɛban lɛni ƒui na baasia teeduo ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo kenye na ɔɔkɔ́ lɛsa na kɔyakun kɔmmɔ ƒui ɔnini,

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: “O amii bekyuli na mɔɔkpali. Amii kadi ƒui bekyuli na mɔɔtalaku lɛdi katɔ kalɛ na binu.

english_verse: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
translation_verse: Bina kasusu kásɔ bibo na lite-mii lɛnunda. Bɛ́dɔlɔ bibo na lite-mii ala kalɔ bunu.

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni ndi litemi geen lɛmmɔ na mina kenye kaasu. Na mina enyekuli ekisi ulikplu ala.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Mina kenye etemila adi etemila geen. Na lɛla biala líteƒu lítakya iye lɛbla gontii na etemila ammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Mina etemila ese nwaa ete ukyuli ɔni muunú ala kalɔ. Na bani na bagyi lɛla badubɔnu ka bɔƒiɔ bɔdi buuubo-nya kemmo.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Ƒuna mina ala bɔtina utulo sika ɔƒualadi. Na aƒuna lɛlati etulo sika ugyiedi.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛnunda lɛ́ƒɔ kuye litulo sika asɛɛ ani náƒɔ kuye geen. Na lɛla lɛdi liiibo na ukyuli ɔɔwia na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ na bakana-ni buti bɔkɔku lɛnunda.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi lɛnunda, na nli na unwi bɔbla kemmo ku litemi bɔtɛ na ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Mbo lɛlati ku ala kemmo bɔnu taati.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Unwoti bɔyia ndi likpidi bukisi. Nkisi lɛlɔ katɔ bɔtalaku ku bekyuli lɛlɔ bɔta teenye. Na nkisi likyulikpi ala bɔbla ku enyekpi bɔtɛmi.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Ami mɔɔlɛ ukyuli na mɔɔtɛ etemila siin. Ami mbo ɔyikun na muunú ala kemmo nwaa.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: Mina lɛlɔ na baga baasia taadi bekyuli lɛlɔ. Na lɛlɔ badine beeti ɔda bubo bɔbuni teete bekyuli.

english_verse: Every honest leader rules with help from me.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku-mi lɛlɔ na bagadine baadi bekyuli lɛlɔ ku babune bani mɔɔtɔnku bekyuli ulu lɛlɔ siin.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: “Bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔyɔ́-mi ni, ami lɛnɔ mɔɔyɔ́-ma. Na bani mɔɔwia-mi kama ulu baanu-mi.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Mina kudɔ na lɛkɛ ku ɔbu ɔɔsí. Na ɔdi lɛkɛ lɛni muutu uwi na ala aatɛku ukyuli.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Na ala ani muute mmɔ eekeye teetulo sika ugyiedi. Na kayu kani mɔɔƒɔ bekyuli ɔdia utulo sika ɔƒualadi buni ƒui.

english_verse: I always do what is right,
translation_verse: Ulu ɔni nse siin lɛlɔ na mɔɔsia, na mɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔyɔ́-mi ni, lɛkɛ na muusé-ma kama, na muuyile bana egulabi kɔvumi.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: “Ami na Unwoti ɔdanku asa na ɔdubuse kalɔ ku lɛla biala budie ku kuuku ala ani ƒui nákya.

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: Únyene-mi mina kenyekɔ asa na lɛla biala lɛdubuse kalɔ. Na nli asa na ɔdubudie kayawi.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Báawɔ-mi asa na Unwoti údie ɛpu, na nli uwi ɔni na abiɔ ku ntukpa ƒui bútebo tɔ.

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: Asa na abi adubɔkɛ kenyekɔ na abinkpo akɔ alɛ ni, báawɔ-mi kukuuku.

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: Asa na Unwoti wedie kalɔ kamɛni ku egyii ku livo iye lɛti lɛni lɛlɔ na ákwɛ enye ni, nkya kukuuku.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: “Nnye mɔɔnu asa na údie kayaa na ɔ́bla-ka aani ligegu útébi ɛpu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: Na nnye mɔɔnu asa na ɔ́bla ulɔyɔ ɔ́ƒala kayaa ku uwi ɔni na ɔ́bla ntukpa bonwu bɔni nágyu voo mmɔ ɔ́kya kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔnu asa na ɔ́sia kalɔ ubili aani ɔmii úte ɛpu ɔmmɔ ƒui kalɛ na uleyi ulavia mmɔ. Na kalɛ na úse kalɔ kammɔ ɔka kalɔ ni, nnye mɔɔnu.

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: Geen ni, ami ndi-nwu kabla kammɔ kakwɛ ɔkyane na nwuna kɔmadɔ. Na mɔɔkɛ́ ebiti limeyi ndi limeyi na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi na nwuna anumi uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: “Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, mina bebi, binu-mi litemi, ɔsika lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔsia-mi kasiakɔ.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Binu mina ala bɔtina na bɛda anu na biteni-mu.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: “Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bekyuli bani muunú-mi litemi na baanu-mi ulu limeyi ndi limeyi na benye bagya-mi na mina kayakun kenye.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli biala nánu-mi ɔti ni, ɔ́kɛ ngba, na nwuna lɛlɔ lɛdubɔda Unwoti ebiti.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bani na báyii ulu na bátanu-mi ni, bábla lɛlɔ kalala. Na bani muukisi-mi ni, bati ka kukpi na baayɔ́.”

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Lɛnunda lɛ́tu ɔtɔ, na nwuna kemmo kéwi. Na ɔtɔ ntɛ akpa maatɛ ada-nwu.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: Ɔ́nwa adila na úse kadikɔ bonwu ku ntɛ lidu lidu úse ka bekyuli babadi.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: Na ɔ́tala nwuna kabla bablane ka batálɔ bekyuli ƒui bavi na bebo. Unye kesii kani nákuku na ɔɔnu ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: “Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́kpali ɔ́su bani na bana kasusu kásɔ na baaagyi bana kɔmii iye kɔdianu ɔnini,

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: “Bibo na bibadi mina adila na bɛni mina ntɛ bɔni na lɛ́sala líse.

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Na bɛda bina adɔlɔla bɔbla bɛya na bise kalɔ ku ngba geen bulie na bɛda anu lɛnɔ.”
