english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu tekpoku lɛlɔ ka adɔnku ukyuli ɔmmɔ udu. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, badubo-ɔ bukisi. Nsu si ádɔnku banundane ama ni, badubo-ɔ bɔyɔ bubu.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Tina banundane ala na badubɔda anu bebu. Na atina ama bani nlie siin ala na badubɔti ala bebu.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Si aayia Unwoti ni, ese kalɔ aadá anu. Na si ánu Unwoti Kedee ɔmmɔ áti ni, agyi anii ése kalɔ adubo lɛla bɔti.

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Lɛnunda lɛdubɔya na ƒula emeyi emomo ebu. Na akwa asia-a akwa lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Na si áda anu ni, awɔ ndubɔkɛ kɔsia. Na si apii lɛnunda ni, awɔ ndubo abi bubo.

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: Uulie nwuna kayakun na kesii kani náta kákɔ, na ɔɔnu ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ taamana.

english_verse: She shouts to everyone who passes by,
translation_verse: Ɔɔkpali banana bani nkɛ bésela bana kabla kadi akɔ unwi unwi teemene ɔnini,

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: “Bo-mi kudɔ na abanu lɛla lɛdi na mina kaduli!” Na bani neeebo kasusu ni, ɔɔsu-ma ɔnini,

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: “Ntu bɔni na éyu kesii kadi áni ni, amu mɔɔyu kayi geen. Na adila ani na ábɛ átádi ni, anya mɔɔyu emini geen!”

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui ni, banana bammɔ baaagyi ka bana bani na uleku ɔmɛni ɔ́ɔka bɔkpali lɛni na bésie ni, kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo na bátáwɔlɔ.

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Salomo agba bamba ndi amɛni. Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bawɔne bani bebi mɔɔdá anu. Nsu ubi ɔdɔlɔdi bawɔne ni, badubuwulo ku kɔnyana.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Lɛkɛ lɛni na ukyuli ɔ́sia ulu ukpidi ɔdi lɛlɔ ɔ́kɛ ni, liiibo kɔsia. Nsu si elie ngba na ulu ɔbuni lɛlɔ ni, adubɔkɛ ngba bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔɔdubo bɔya na kɔka kɔdu nwuna ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla nwuna lɛƒɔyɔ. Na bekyuli bekpidi ama ni, Unwoti ulenu-ma ala ani na beevele-nwu.

english_verse: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.
translation_verse: Bakɔsɔne beeebo bawabane bunwini. Mmomu bagyoklone mɔɔkɛ́ lɛkɛ.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Kusɛ kusɛ ɔɔsiaku bekyuli bani mɔɔbu Unwoti. Na bekyuli bekpidi baabɛla bana kasusu kekpidi kɔkwɛ.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Bekyuli kasusu kaasia bekyuli babuni lɛlɔ, nsu balalane anyi muedi aayii kede kede.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Ebiti aada banundane si baalɛ-ma. Nsu katɛ batɛne badɔlɔdi ni, beebuli teeti anumi teebi kalɔ.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔdi litemi lɛlɔ ulu lɛlɔ ni, balánya teegyiile. Nsu bani kasiakɔ nse gontii ni, badubo bugyiile bubuli.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni etemila aakpanku ukyuli teesienku ngba kemmo. Nsu bekyuli bekpidi beeti ala teebi bana kasusu kekpidi.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Ukyuli bukisi bɔɔkya kadɔ ɔgya. Nsu bɔyɔ bɔsɔ bulánu likpidi na ukyuli lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muunú ala kalɔ ni, baatɛmi lɛnunda etemila. Nsu badɔlɔdi ama ni, kegyiimi na badubuti bani-ma kɔtu.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
translation_verse: Lɛlati lɛ́ƒɔ banundane kuye, nsu badɔlɔdi adɔlɔtɛ eeboku lɛlɔ bukpoku.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Balakɛne baanu bana lɛlakɛ aani kɔbi bonwu kɔni na ukyuli ɔdi ulakana bɔƒuaala. Na bawabane kɔwaba ndi bana ɔgbankpi.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni lɛyuƒɔla muubunku bana keliela. Nsu bekyuli bekpidi ama ni, likyulikpi ala bɔbla lɛlɔ beewiakun bana egulabi.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔtuna na baalɛ-ma ni, baasia ngba ulu lɛlɔ. Nsu bani muuní ɔmɛni ni, baakpanku bekyuli bamba lɛnɔ taatáyila.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni muukisi ukyuli na ɔɔbɛla-mu ɔdi ɔkɔ ɔnyine. Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔlɔ bekyuli anyikpi ɔdi ɔdɔlɔdi.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Sɔ tatɛmi pii, ɔsika atɛ pii aadanku likpidi. Da anu na akɔsi atɛ bumomo!

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni etemila ese aani sika ɔƒualadi ɔni bekyuli bánu ka ɔdia. Nsu ukyuli ukpidi kayi kemmo ni, kɔsia kɔdi kulalɛ.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni baalɛ ukyuli ulu ɔbuni lɛlɔ. Nsu bekyuli bekpidi ama baayii udu na bana lɛla tati ɔsu.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Unwoti kusɛ kusɛ mɔɔyá na ukyuli uunwíni ɔlakɛne, na kɔnyana kɔdi kulásia ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Badɔlɔdi ebiti ndi ka belie bataabla likpidi. Nsu banundane ebiti ndi ka bada udu buɛɛ na babla ala lɛnunda kemmo.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Ala ani na balalane baayia ka atalɛku-ma ni, anya geen ndubɔlɛku-ma. Na lɛni kani na bekyuli babuni ala ani lɛlɔ na bebo lɛnunsia adububo ete-ma.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Ɔgbankpi uubo bekyuli bekpidi lɛlɔ aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔkya ligede, na uuti-ma ƒui. Nsu bekyuli babuni kɔwodu kalɔ ɔka ɔni bákya uunye teetu uwi.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Bakɔsɔne baakya bekyuli bani kabla na baabla ɔlɛ. Na bese aani uyɔ ɔni muuduo ukyuli anumi iye ntɛ bɔnani bɔni mɔɔyá na kenye anyi aanyi.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: Si aayia Unwoti ni, ngba buune-ɔ. Nsu balalane ngba bɔɔdá likuku.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni lɛnunsia liiboku ebiti, nsu ala ani na bekyuli bekpidi baasia anu eenwíni lɛƒua.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔgyumana bekyuli bani nse siin, na ɔɔyila balalane udu.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Lɛla biala lɛɛɛdubo bekyuli babuni bukpoku. Nsu balalane ni, badubudie-ma bana kunyekɔ na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Kasusu buni na ukyuli ɔbuni uute ukyuli. Nsu unyemi ɔnii mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ badubo-nwu bukulo budie.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Etemila ani mebunku ukyuli na ukyuli ɔbuni ɔɔtɛmi. Nsu etemila ani muusé lɛlɔ na balalane baatɛmi.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Unwoti ukisi uyedine mɔɔnya ukyuli akya. Nsu lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-nwu si ɔɔkɔ́ku ala teete-ma.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Si aatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ ni, kɔƒa bɔdi nsia. Nsu si eeboku lɛlɔ kalɔ ni, na aadá anu.

english_verse: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni ni, bana litemi lɛni lɛlɔ baadi ulu lɛlɔ mɔɔtina-ma kasiakɔ. Na balalane ama ni, bana litemi lɛlɔ tadi mɔɔyila-ma udu.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Ukyuli lɛkɛ lɛɛɛdubo-nwu bubunku Unwoti litemi bɔtɛ limeyi. Nsu ngba buni bulie muudie ukyuli na kukpi kemmo.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni ni, bana litemi lɛlɔ bɔdi ulu lɛlɔ mɔɔtina-ma kasiakɔ. Na balalane ama ni, bana ekpidi unu mɔɔsia-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Ngba buni bɔni na bekyuli babuni belie muudie-ma ɔgbankpi kemmo. Na lɛla lɛni lɛlɔ na balalane anumi eegyie ni, ani muunwíni kakpagyuɛ teedie-ma.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Unwoti uudie bekyuli babuni na ɔgbankpi kemmo. Na balalane ama uunye taanu na beesié taatátua ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Enyekpi aayila ukyuli ɔkpana udu. Na ala bɔnu bɔti na lɛnunda kemmo uudie bekyuli babuni.

english_verse: When honest people prosper and the wicked disappear, the whole city celebrates.
translation_verse: Si ala aatɛ teete ukyuli ɔbuni ni, ɔma ɔmmɔ bekyuli baakɛ́ lɛlɔyɔ. Lɛni kani si ukyuli ukpidi úkpi ni, kaƒɔ kaayɔ́-ma.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nse siin beete ɔma kusɛ kusɛ na ɔɔlɛ́ lili. Nsu balalane etemila eele bekyuli ntɛ na balakana bɔsala.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Si eedie ukyuli kalɔ ni, kɔdɔlɔ kɔdi. Na ukyuli ɔni na ɔ́da anu ni, uubile nwuna kenye kpoo.

english_verse: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
translation_verse: Katɛ ɔtɛne keeke mɔɔví teebo abɛla kudu. Nsu ukyuli ɔni báƒɔ bádi ka ulátɛmi kalɛ kalɛ ni, baasu-nwu kɔbɛtɛ.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Si kadi badi bekyuli beeebo ɔtɔnkune ɔnundane ni, ɔma ulábla ɔma. Nsu si bébo kasusu betine pii ni, ɔma ɔmmɔ uusié kaduɛ.

english_verse: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
translation_verse: Aawia ɔgbankpi teete lɛlɔ si éténye ɔƒɔ ɔdi kama na nwuna kayu ɔsu. Si ébulo ni, ɔdia utulo ka ebeteebo abi adi kama.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Beleku bani mbo lɛƒɔndia baakɛ́ ɔbu teetulo banana bani mbo ulikplu na baakɛ́ egulabi.

english_verse: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
translation_verse: Si aabla lɛƒɔndia ni, awɔ ɔlati ƒula kɔyu mɔɔlɛ́ lili. Nsu si aabla kalala ni, aayila lɛlɔ udu.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni baakɛ́ ngba. Na bekyuli bekpidi baasiáku kukpi.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
translation_verse: Unwoti ukisi bekyuli bani na bana kayi kaaakɛ ulu unwi. Nsu bani mɔɔdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ ulu lɛlɔ baayɔ́-nwu kaƒɔ.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Ɔbla-a nwaa ka Unwoti ɔdubɔni bekyuli bekpidi kɔtu. Nsu bekyuli babuni bebi ni, badubɔlɛ sɛɛn ɔni na lɛla lɛdi lilabla-ma.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Uleku ɔni mɔɔdia bɔnu na ɔɔɔgyi lɛbuni ku likpidi kavumana ni, nwuna ablala ese aani sika kakwɛnimi kani nda ɔplakuo enwu kemmo.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni mɔɔsia anu ka badubɔkɛ ebiti. Na bekyuli bekpidi ama ni, kɔtu bɔni kani na badubɔnu ulu bete.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badi bakya na beete bekyuli ala ku kaƒɔ, nsu bana lɛkɛ limomo teebu. Nsu babambadi lɛnɔ baabla lɛnumi, nsu baayila lɛla biala na bebo.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muute bekyuli ala ƒaa ni, ala aadianku-ma na eedú-ma ɔkwɛ. Lɛni kani na bekyuli bani muubunku bekyuli kalɛ na belie ku kayi ƒaa ni, ama alati lɛnɔ badubulie ku kayi ƒaa.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Beyedine bani mɔɔbɛla ala teese na basɔku beye kuye kpakplaa ni, bekyuli beewida-ma. Na bani muuyé ala teete-ma uwi ɔni na baayaki ala ammɔ ni, bekyuli beete-ma kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Si aawia lɛbuni teete bekyuli ni, bekyuli badubɔnu-ɔ kɔnyana. Nsu si aawia-ma likpidi ni, ɔgbankpi ndubo-ɔ bɔsiaku.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Si éti anu ásia ƒula egulabi lɛlɔ ni, adubo bɔyii udu! Nsu bekyuli babuni badubɔlɛ lili aani ketudi evete wɔwɔɔwɔ.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔkya lɛsɛ na beeti kayu teeboku kaduli ni, lɛƒua na beesé-ma kama. Na badɔlɔdi ni, ama muunwíni banundane kabla bablane.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni bese aani egyii ani mɔɔnwu ebi buni ani baadi teelie ngba. Na bani muudie bekyuli na ɔgbankpi kemmo ni, báda anu.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Si ɔdubɔyu bekyuli babuni muedi ɔkplu na kalɔ kamɛni kemmo ni, bi malɛku ala ekpidi bablane ama?

english_verse: To accept correction is wise, to reject it is stupid.
translation_verse: Si aayɔ́ atɛya ala ni, ɔlɛka atuna na batumini-ɔ. Kɔdɔlɔ kɔdi-ɔ si alayɔ anii bedie-ɔ bɔƒiɔ.

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ Unwoti na bekyuli babuni lɛlɔ. Nsu ulátunaku balalane kɔkwɛ kukpidi kɔni na baakya.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Ulikplu ala bɔbla buléboku keliela buni ku atu bɔyɔ. Mmomu bekyuli babuni muudie lidu teesie ɔgyu.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Uleku ɔbuni ɔni lɛlɔ basia kayi ni, anwu ndi ɔgyani lɛlɔyɔ na use aani kagabwa na kebi ɔnana ɔmmɔ lili. Nsu uleku ɔni mɔɔbla kɔƒa ala ni, ɔɔƒɛ ɔgyani enu, na ɔyikun ɔɔsá-nwu.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Kɔkwɛ kɔni na ukyuli ɔbuni ɔɔkya kɔɔsia ulu lɛlɔ. Nsu ɔlalane bɔlɛ bɔdanku ɔgbankpi.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Ɔlalane etemila ese aani kalɛ na ebuo ukpidi ɔɔbɛ́ taatɛ kuludɔ kalɛ na uƒie lɛla lɛdi. Nsu ukyuli ɔbuni etemila aaƒɔ́ ukyuli ngba.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi beekpi taayii udu ƒui, nsu bekyuli babuni bebi ama beenye kpakplaa uwi biala.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni na ubo kasusu kabuni lɛlɔ lɛɛda bekyuli ƒui ebiti, na beení bani nsiaku kalala ulu.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Si bekyuli balanu-ɔ banii adi ukyuli nsu ebo kabla bablane ni, ɔdia utulo ukyuli ɔni mɔɔkɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ ɔnii ɔƒɔ kuye, nsu uuubo lɛla lɛni na ɔdi muedi.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni ni, baawia bana bebuo bani na baatumini muedi bɔdia. Nsu lɛƒɔndia lɛni na ulikplune ɔɔbla ukyuli ni, lɛdanku kasusu kekpidi.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔbla kabla kpakplaa bebo adila pii na badi bemo. Nsu si éni kabla na akɛ eebile uwi taavi ni, ɔdi kɔdɔlɔ.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Beyune ni, bana lɛlɔ ala ani na buyu na bétéyu-nya muedi eegyie bana lɛlɔ anumi. Nsu bekyuli babuni ni, ama alati mɔɔnwu bana ebi.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi ni, bana kenye etemila muudie-ma teete. Nsu bekyuli babuni ama baalɛ́ ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Badɔlɔdi mɔɔkali banii baláwia ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔkya-ma kasusu. Nsu banundane beesé atu teenu bekyuli bamba bɔlɛ.

english_verse: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔlɔdi uuubo kɔnyi buti. Nsu ukyuli ɔni náda anu ni, si ina bédumi-nwu muedi ɔɔkɛ́ kayi buɛɛ.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni muudie lɛla lɛni na ɔ́nu kenye ulu lɛlɔ ni, ɔɔsu litemi geen lɛmmɔ. Nsu ukyuli ɔni muudie lɛla lɛni na útanu kenye ni, ɔdi ɔkɔ ɔnyine.

english_verse: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badi beedie ala taalɛ bekyuli na aatu kayi. Nsu banundane etemila aabwi bekyuli bani kayi muunú ɔlɛ.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Litemi geen liláyii udu uwi ɔdi kudii. Na likpidi lɛnɔ liiibo keyi bɔlɛ.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Ɔgbankpi kpakplaa ɔdi ulébo bekyuli babuni lɛlɔ. Nsu balalane ni, ɔgbankpi ulalɛ-ma ɔtɔ kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Unwoti ukisi bekyuli bani naaadi bana linyese lɛlɔ. Na bani mɔɔbla taasiaku-mu lɛlɔ baayɔ́-nwu kaƒɔ.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Banundane belebo bana lɛlati kudu. Nsu badɔlɔdi ama beedie bana kɔdɔlɔ keyi.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Si aabla kabla kpakplaa ni, adubɔtɔnku bekyuli. Na si aabla kɔkɔsɔ ni, adubunwini kabla ɔblane ete bekyuli bamba.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ulalɛ lili si kasusu keekpóku-nwu. Na etemila ani muusé kayi aayá na lɛlɔ lɛɛƒɛnimi-nwu.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni baakya bana bakpana kasusu kabuni. Nsu bekyuli bekpidi ama baatɔ́lɔ bana bakpana taatáyila.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Kɔkɔsɔ kɔɔdi bekyuli lɛlɔ ɔni na ebuo ɔni bádu muedi ukyuli bamba muuƒulo-nwu teete-ma. Nsu bani mɔɔsia bana kabla anu ni, baada-ka kaduɛ.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni kasiakɔ kaakpanku-ma teesienku ngba kemmo, na ɔɔɔdi kekpine.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Ubi ɔni na ɔ́da anu ni, ɔɔtuna na nwuna bawɔne baatumini-nwu kalɛ na ɔ́manku. Na ɔnamu ɔni muuti lɛla biala taakya bɔƒia ni, ulenu litemi.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni baadi kɔsia kɔni na kɔ́lɛ kɔ́si kasusu kabuni kani bákya bekyuli kemmo. Nsu bekyuli bekpidi ni, ama kadɔ ku unyeƒi kani baanu ulu teete.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ngyi kalɛ baada bana unyemi ni, beelie ngba gyɔlɔɔ. Na kenye bɔtu bɔlɛ ukyuli ɔɔkana na uubile lɛla biala.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Bakɔsɔne baawia ala pii, nsu ɛlɛɛ muutúku-ma kɔnu. Nsu bekyuli bani mɔɔbla kabla kpakplaa ni, bana kabla kadubɔtɛ na badi bemo.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni bekisi ɔkɔ ala. Na balalane ama ni, kɔƒa muubo-ma lɛlɔ na anumi eewi-ma kalɔ.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Ngba buni bulie buubunku ukyuli nwuna ngba emeyi kemmo ƒui. Nsu bekyuli bekpidi ama ni, bana kalala ndubɔya na bayii udu.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Bawabane badi baabla lɛlɔ aani balakɛne. Na babambadi bani ndi balakɛne lɛnɔ baabla lɛlɔ aani bawabane.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Balakɛne baakana na baƒɔ kayu biala na beti baƒɔ bana lili ngba. Nsu bawabane ama ni, bana lɛlɔ lilégyie anumi na beduo ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ udu kemmo muedi.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni ni, lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-ma na bana keliela keekeye uwi ndi uwi. Nsu ɔƒɛ ɔɔsá taakya alaekpidi bablane na ɔɔbla-ma suu.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ baakya unyeƒi pii. Na bekyuli bani muunú bɔlɛ baadá anu.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Lɛkɛ lɛni baasia ulu gontii lɛlɔ taakɛ liiibo bɔyii. Nsu lɛla lɛni na aakɛ́ blii blii na ulu lɛlɔ lɛɛwɔ teebu.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔ́yila lɛnunsia ni, kayi keekpóku-nwu. Nsu si ƒula ala ani na eegyé kɔna taanu aasia-a ni, eenú ngba emini na lɛlɔ lɛnɔ lɛɛyɔ́-ɔ.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muuní ka bekyuli balɛ-ma ni, ɔgbankpi kemmo kani na badubo buduo. Na bani mɔɔbu bekyuli bɔlɛ ni, badubo bukpo bɔlɛ.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Banundane bɔlɛ buse aani libiɔ lɛni mɔɔyu ntu na baaní teelie ngba ute-ɔ. Na ɔɔyá na ekeli liƒu lɛni na kukpi kɔɔkya-bu.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla kasusu buni na ala lɛlɔ ni, bekyuli baabu-nwu. Na ukyuli ukpidi anwu ni, nwuna kasiakɔ atakpɛ lɛlɔ na kaasia.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Banundane baaka kasusu bɔbla asa na baabla ala. Uuuse lɛni ku badɔlɔdi, na baakun lɛmɛnɛ lɛnɔ taasia ɔmmɔ kama.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni na alayɔ ka bedie-ɔ bɔƒiɔ ni, kɔwaba ku kɔƒa ndubo-ɔ buƒie. Nsu si átuna anii bédie-ɔ bɔƒiɔ ni, bekyuli ƒui badubo-ɔ bɔbu.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Ebiti aada ukyuli si ƒula ayɔla ani na aawia ébo-nwu kemmo lɛni. Nsu badɔlɔdi belenu kalɔ teenwini bana ekpidi kama kalɛ na ubo-nwu kemmo ute-ma lɛni.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdiku banundane kɔkpana ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔɔdá anu. Lɛni kani na ukyuli ɔni na badɔlɔdi na ɔɔdiku kɔkpana ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔɔdɔlɔ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Alaekpidi bablane ni, ɔgbankpi mɔɔbi taasiaku-ma. Na kusɛ kusɛ ɔɔsia bekyuli babuni kama uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni ni, ama muusé bana bebi ku bawɔ kama. Nsu bekyuli bekpidi lɛkɛ ni, liinwíni bekyuli babuni lɛdi.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Ina ɔwabane ɔ́kya edula pii ni, ama bani naaabla ala ulu lɛlɔ baakana na baƒɔ kɔsia kɔmmɔ baatɔlɔku.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Si éni na átatumini ƒula bebi ni, ɔɔtina ka alayɔ-ma. Na si aayɔ́-ma bɔdi ni, ɔlɛka enye kpakplaa na ada-ma kalɛ na ɔ́manku.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni ni, ala ani bebo eemó-ma. Nsu bekyuli bekpidi ni, bana ala elemo-ma.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Uleku ɔnundane ɔgyi kalɛ na baada ɔtɔ na uunye. Nsu uleku ɔdɔlɔdi anwu ɔlati mɔɔbwɛ nwuna ɔtɔ.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔsia ulu ɔbuni lɛlɔ ni, baayia Unwoti. Na bani mɔɔsia ulu ukpidi lɛlɔ beení Unwoti.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Badɔlɔdi enyekpi muunwíni kugyiimi kɔni mɔɔsia-ma kama. Nsu banundane ala ani na baasu ni, eedie-ma na ɔgbankpi kemmo.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: Bebuo lɛyu lɛni kemmo na ebuo ɔdi uuubo ni, liisé sɛɛn. Nsu kɔsia kɔdi kulasi lɛyu likpludi lɛmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni nánu lɛla lɛdi na uudie litemi geen lɛmmɔ kenye ni, ulanyi ɔkɔ. Nsu ukyuli ɔni na útanu lɛla lɛmmɔ ɔɔnyi ɔkɔ.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni na uuti lɛla biala taakya bɔƒia ni, si ina ɔɔwia lɛnunda muedi ulákɛ-ni. Nsu bekyuli bani muunú ala kalɔ ni, baatí lɛla.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Da lɛlɔ mami badɔlɔdi lɛlɔ, ɔsika aaadubo lɛla lɛdi bɔti bana kudɔ.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Banundane ni, baanu uwi ɔni ntɔ anumi ɔdubo ƒui taati lɛla lɛni ndubo libalɛ. Nsu badɔlɔdi ama bana lɛlɔ kani na baatɔ́lɔ.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Badɔlɔdi beeti bana bɔƒiɔ taabla lɛmala. Nsu bekyuli babuni baanu bana bɔƒiɔ taati na beevele ka basɔ babla unwi ku ukyuli ɔni na báƒiɔ.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ku kalɛ na lɛla lɛdi liikpóku-nwu kayi. Na ukyuli uláti kalɛ geen na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ ukyuli bamba na nwuna kayi kemmo.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Balalane kaduli kadubo bɔbwɛ. Nsu ukyuli ɔbuni kevo kadubɔlɛ lili na bemomo.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔɔnu kasiakɔ kadi na nwuna ngba kemmo ka nka kadia, nsu nwuna kawɔlɔkɔ ni, kekpine kani na ɔɔdá taalɛ.

english_verse: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muunwíni ulu ɔbuni ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, baakɛ́ bana lɛyuƒɔla. Na bekyuli babuni baakɛ bana lɛbuni kɔsia.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani kasusu násɔ ni, ama mɔɔƒɔ́ lɛla biala taadi. Nsu bani mɔɔsia lɛlɔ anu kaduɛ ni, baabu lɛla biala lɛlɔ taanu asa na beedie ɔgba.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Banundane baatí lɛlɔ kalɛ na beekeli ɔgbankpi. Badɔlɔdi ama baatu lili taakya lɛla biala kemmo ku kayi kekpidi.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muuti kɔnyi pla pla ni, baabla adɔlɔla. Na bekyuli bani mɔɔbɛ́ taabla ala kalɔ kalɔ ni, bekyuli beekisi-ma.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Bawabane ni, ama alati bana bekyuli muedi balánu-ma taakya lɛla lɛdi akɔ. Nsu balakɛne ama ni, balakana-ma bakpana bɔka.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Si eekisi ƒula ɔkpana ni, likpidi lɛdi-ɔ. Kusɛ kusɛ ɔdubɔsiaku bekyuli bani muubunku bawabane.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Si aawia ukyuli likpidi ni, adubo bɔyii. Nsu si lɛbuni na aawia ukyuli ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔyɔ-ɔ uwi ndi uwi na ɔdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ ute-ɔ.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Kabla keeboku kɔsia. Nsu atɛ keeke adanku kɔwaba.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Lɛlakɛ lɛdi kagabwa kete banundane. Na badɔlɔdi kogyoklo ƒui ni, adɔlɔla ebi na aanwu.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnu litemi geen teedie-ni kenye ɔɔƒɔ́ bekyuli ngba. Nsu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ teedie litemi kenye ni, uudie bekyuli teete.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛdi lilekpoku bekyuli bani mɔɔyia Unwoti. Ɔsika Unwoti ɔdi katamikukɔ ute bana bebi.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Si aayia Unwoti ni, ɔdi libiɔ lɛni mɔɔyu ntu baaní teelie ngba ute-ɔ. Na ɔɔyá na ekeli liƒu lɛni na kukpi kɔɔkya-bu.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Si kadi kadi bekyuli beemomo ni, lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ ɔga ɔmmɔ. Nsu si baasá ni, baayii udu.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔkana bana kɔnyi bɔbala ni, bebo lɛlati. Na bani muuti kɔnyi pla pla ni, badubo bɔƒiɔ.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Si áda kayi áva kalɔ buɛɛ ni, ngba buune-ɔ. Nsu kogyulo lɛnungyie lɛɛdú ukyuli.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muukpóku bawabane ni, beedumi Unwoti. Nsu bani muubunku-ma ni, baabu Unwoti.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi ni, bana alaekpidi mɔɔyila-ma udu. Nsu bekyuli babuni bebo katamikukɔ si békpi.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni muunú ala kalɔ ni, ubo lɛnunda na lɛ́ƒɔ-nwu kuye geen na nwuna kayi kemmo. Nsu badɔlɔdi balánu lɛnunda kɔsia.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Kadi bani mɔɔyia Unwoti ni, baalɛ́ lili ku ɔyikun. Nsu likpidi lɛdi kɔƒa ala ute kadi biala.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Kɔnyi kulakɔ ukyuli si éboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na édie litemi kenye buɛɛ. Nsu etemila bɔtu taalɛ ukyuli ɔɔyá kɔnyi kuubo.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Ɔnundane ni, ala bɔtɛya bɔdi-nwu ebiti. Na badɔlɔdi ni, bágyu kenye beti beedie kɔdɔlɔ keyi.

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔnu kesi kesii, na nwuna lɛnumi lɛsia bekyuli bekpidi ku babuni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
translation_verse: Etemila ani mɔɔyu buɛɛ aayá na ukyuli uulie ngba na ɔɔkɛ́ ɔyikun. Na unyemi ɔni mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ ɔɔdú ukyuli kɔyu.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔlɔdi kani muuní ka nwuna bawɔne batumini-nwu. Ukyuli biala ɔni matɛya lɛla lɛdi wasiku bɔƒiɔ bɔni bédie-nwu lɛlɔ ni, ɔ́da anu.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Lɛlakɛ lɛbuni liisé bekyuli babuni kesii. Nsu bekyuli bekpidi ala ani na baakɛ́ adanku ɔgbankpi.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Banundane kani mɔɔkana na baakya ukyuli kasusu buni. Na badɔlɔdi balakana ɔmɛni bɔbla.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi akpala ni, Unwoti ukisi-nya. Nsu lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-nwu si bekyuli bani nse siin baakpali-nwu.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi kɔsiakɔ ƒui kulayɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ. Nsu bekyuli bani mɔɔwia kpakplaa ka belie ngba bɔbuni ni, Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́-ma.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala na únwini kama ɔ́kya ulu geen ɔmmɔ ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔni-nwu kɔtu kpakplaa. Na ukyuli ɔni nkisi ka bedie-nwu bɔƒiɔ ni, ɔdubo bukpi.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔgyi kukpi kalɔ ku kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔkywí taayii udu. Anwuɔsu ukyuli kayi kemmo lɛla lɛdi lilábɛ-nwu!

english_verse: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muuti lɛla biala taabla lɛmala ni, balayɔ bekyuli bani mɔɔdɔnku-ma. Anwuɔsu na balani teede banundane.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Ɔnundane ni, litemi geen kama bɔsia kɔka mɔɔda-nwu. Na ɔdɔlɔdi ni, ala ani neeebo kɔsia lɛlɔ na ɔɔkɛ́ ebiti.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Ɔwabane ni, limeyi biala ala eekpóku-nwu. Nsu bani na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ ni, ngba bumodi bɔdi limeyi bɔdi bute-ma.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: Ɔdia si aayia Unwoti ina eeebo ala pii utulo si ebo lɛlakɛ na bɔnwuna buuubo-ɔ kaduli.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: Si awɔ ku ƒula ɔkpana ɔdi bɛ́sa na kutukplu lɛkyami kalɔ ni, ɔdia utulo si awɔ ku ƒula ukisine bɛ́sa na ɔkyimu kalɔ.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni na uuubo kayi buɛɛ ɔɔkya kekpo. Nsu ukyuli ɔni na ɔ́da kayi ɔ́va kalɔ buɛɛ ni, ɔɔyala kekpo kammɔ.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔsɔne ni, ala aláda-nwu bukpoku taaya nwuna ngba kemmo ƒui. Nsu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔsia nwuna kabla anu ni, nwuna keyi kaabla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Bebi bani kasusu nse nwaa baayá lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ bana ɔti. Na bebi badɔlɔdi muuní bana uni.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Badɔlɔdi ni, ama na kubiti kɔɔda si baanu adɔlɔla. Na ɔnundane ɔɔsia ulu ɔbuni lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: Ukyuli kabla kɔkwɛ kɔni na ɔɔkya kuubie-nwu si ulaƒɔ kasusu na bekyuli kudɔ. Nsu si eeye bekyuli pii kasusu ni, ƒula ala aatɛ.

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Ɔnundane kasiakɔ kási mɛni késela ngba ƒui kemmo na katɔ, ɔsika kaƒiɔtɔ kelénwini-ma keliekɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔkɔli lɛlɔ katɔ ni, Unwoti ɔɔbwɛ-ma kɔduli na baayii udu. Nsu ɔɔgyumana bekpinele ala ani na bebo.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Unwoti ulayɔ bekyuli bekpidi kasusu kani beeti. Nsu lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-nwu si bekyuli baatɛmi etemila ani mɔɔdia bunu.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni baaka kasusu buti asa na baasu lɛla lɛdi. Nsu bekyuli bekpidi ama bɔtu kani na baatu etemila teebewi.

english_verse: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́gyunku bekyuli bekpidi kudɔ ƒui. Nsu uunú bekyuli babuni kenye si baakpali-nwu.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Si áƒɛnimi anumi ákya ukyuli ni, kayi kaayɔ́-nwu. Na si énu kenye buni ni, ɔɔkya ɔlɔna ɔkplu.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli údie-ɔ bɔƒiɔ na ɔ́tina-a kasiakɔ ni, adubɔkɛ kelie na banundane akɔ.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Si éni anii ukyuli utedie-ɔ bɔƒiɔ ni, awɔ ɔlati lɛlɔ na aabla kalala. Nsu si áda lɛlɔ na bédie ƒula bɔƒiɔ bátina-a ni, adubɔkɛ lɛlati na eteenu ala kalɔ.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Si aayia Unwoti ni, ɔɔtina kalɛ na áda anu. Na lɛlɔ kalɔ buboku mɔɔtɔ asa na ɔbu ɔɔsia.

english_verse: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
translation_verse: Bɔɔkana bɔɔsála kasusu lidu lidu, nsu Unwoti mɔɔtina lɛla lɛni geen ndi litemi geen lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Bekyuli baanu ka bana ablala akɛ ulu ɔbuni lɛlɔ. Nsu Unwoti mɔɔkɔ́ku lɛla biala taanu kalɛ na lɛdia.

english_verse: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
translation_verse: Ti ƒula kabla biala kya Unwoti kɔnu na kadubɔtɛ-ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: Unwoti nábla lɛla biala ɔkɛnku nwuna kasusu kani kenye na ɔɔwia lɛla lɛmmɔ. Na bekyuli bekpidi muedi benye bete ka bani-ma kɔtu.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Unwoti ukisi ka ukyuli ɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ. Anwuɔsu ɔbla ukyuli biala nwaa ka bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔni-ma kɔtu.

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Bɔyɔ bɔni neeebo kawɔkɔ ku litemi lɛlɔ bɔdi uwi ndi uwi uuti ala teebi likpidi. Na si aayia Unwoti ni, eekeli likpidi.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Si bekyuli ablala aayɔ́ Unwoti kaƒɔ ni, ɔɔyá na ama ku bana bekisine muedi beelie na atu bɔyɔ kemmo.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: Si adi ɔwabane na aabu Unwoti ni, ɔdia utulo si ebo lɛlakɛ na aládi litemi geen lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Bɔɔkana na bɔɔbla kasusu ku kɔkwɛ na lɛla lɛdi lɛlɔ, nsu Unwoti mɔɔtina bula kasiakɔ.

english_verse: Rulers speak with authority and are never wrong.
translation_verse: Ɔga ɔɔtɛmi lɛnunda etemila ku Unwoti ɔyikun, na utalɛka ɔnu anumi ɔtɛ litemi.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔwia ka bɔbla lɛla biala siin na liyedi kemmo, na ɔ́tina ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔlɛka bɔsia lɛnɔ úse.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Ɔga kɔnyi kenye kelenu bunye kuubile ala. Na banundane baasia ulu biala lɛlɔ ka bayala-nwu kaƒɔ.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Si ɔga ɔɔmɔsi ni, agyi anii bibo ngba, na nwuna lɛƒɔndia lise aani ɔnantu ɔni mɔɔna na lɛla biala lɛɛsɔ taabla ɔwɔdi.

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔsia nwuna ablala anu kaduɛ ni, nwuna ulu ulásia likpidi kavinkɔ. Na ukyuli biala nda nwuna ngba lɛni ni, ubo bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: Ɔdia si awɔ ku bawabane bilie na bɛɛdi lɛla lɛni na bɛ́kɛ utulo si awɔ ku belikplune bilie na bɛɛdi ala ani na béƒie báƒɔ bekyuli kudɔ.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muunú bɔlɛ ni, ala adubɔtɛku-ma. Na bekyuli bani na bana anu asia Unwoti lɛlɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Banundane ni, baanu-ma taati ɔkɛnku kalɛ na beenú ala kalɔ kenye. Si ásia ulu ɔbuni lɛlɔ átina ukyuli ala ni, anwu mɔɔyá na ɔɔƒɔ́-ɔ litemi ku ebiti.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Ɔnundane ni, lɛnunda etemila na ɔɔtɛmi. Na nwuna etemila aatu ukyuli teenwini.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Etemila ani mɔɔyu kayi ni, ese aani uwɔ. Aayu kɔyu emini na ɔlɔna ɔɔkɛ́ ɔlɔkplu.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Balalane beenye taawia kuƒi kɔni na babla likyulikpi, na bana etemila adi ogya bonwu ɔni mɔɔkywí teebile ala.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔwia ka bekyuli beteekpoku lɛlɔ ni, lɛsɛ ogya na ɔɔkya bekyuli akɔ. Na bekyuli anyikpi bɔlɔ ni, uugyingya bakpana babuni muedi ntɛ.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Likyulikpi ala bablane baatɔ́lɔ bana bakpana na baasia ulu ukpidi lɛlɔ teetéduo ɔgbankpi kemmo.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Bébile anumi, nsu baanu taavi ukyuli kalɔ. Belébimi kenye taatɛmi, nsu baabla bana likyulikpi kɔkwɛ.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Liliƒuala lɛdi kagabwa kani muukeye. Na Unwoti uuti-ka teete bekyuli bani muulie ngba buni.

english_verse: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
translation_verse: Kayi buɛɛ kadia ketulo kenyekɔ ɔyikun. Si aakana ƒula lɛlɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi ni, ɔdia utulo si ékpo ádi ɔma unengudi ɔdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Adubɔkana na ebo egulabi akɔliku katɔ, nsu Unwoti mɔɔtina ɔƒɛnyi ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔdubo bɔyu.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Si ákɛ lɛla lɛni uwi utu-ni lɛlɔ ádi ku kayi ƒaa ni, ɔdia utulo si ésie kadikɔ bonwu ku ala lidu lidu na kadɔ kakya mmɔ.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Kabla ɔblane ɔni na ɔ́da anu ni, ɔɔdi ɔtɔlati bebi bani mɔɔbla kɔƒa ala lɛlɔ, na anwu ku bebi bammɔ muule bana ɔti ala.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Ogya kemmo baakya sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi taanu-nwu bɔdia. Nsu Unwoti ni, ukyuli kayi na ɔɔkɔ́ku taanu-nwu bɔdia.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muudumi bawabane taama ni, bana Unwoti ɔni nédie-ma na beedumi. Na bani mɔɔmá bekyuli na bana ɔgbankpi kemmo ni, Unwoti ɔdubo-ma kɔtu bɔni.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Bawɔ bani na ukyuli ɔ́bi lɛlɔ ɔ́ƒɔ ni, ama ndi-nwu kagabwa kani muukeye. Na bebi bani mbo bawɔne babune ni, kɔƒa kulekpo-ma na bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Kɔtɛ bɔtɛmi pii ni, útamanku ɔdɔlɔdi. Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi bekyuli lɛlɔ lɛnɔ ni, ɔkɔ bɔnyi bútamanku-nwu.

english_verse: A bribe works miracles like a magic charm that brings good luck.
translation_verse: Ala ani beete ukyuli na bɔbɛ kemmo ni, etulo kuvo ete bani mɔɔbla udu ɔmmɔ. Baasia ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na ala aatɛ teete-ma.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Si alásia ukyuli bamba alaekpidi anu ni, bɔyɔ buláyii udu. Na si aaká ukyuli bamba ekpidi taasu bekyuli ni, eegyingya bakpana babuni muedi ntɛ.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: Si ádɔnku ukyuli ɔni muunú ala kalɔ kunwi pɛ ni, uubunku-nwu teetulo si ébo ɔdɔlɔdi kugyiimi eti anyɔ.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi baawia bata benye lɛlɔ badine lɛlɔ, nsu badubo-ma kɔtu bɔni geen.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Si awɔ ku ebuo ukpidi ɔni na lɛla lɛdi líƒie-nwu bebi bɛ́sa ni, ebo bɔƒɔ utulo ka enwini ɔdɔlɔdi kasusu na nwuna kɔdɔlɔ ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: Si éti likpidi áƒɔ lɛbuni lɛni na ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́bla-a kayu ni, ɔgbankpi ulása-a kaduli kudii.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Si ése kadɔ kalɔ ni, use aani kalɛ na baalɛmi kuƒi teete ketu kani báda-ka kavinkɔ ulu na kéyi.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Unwoti ulayɔ bekyuli bani mɔɔyá na baanyonu bekyuli bani litemi neeebo ubo na baadú bekyuli babuni kɔtɔ.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Si ɔdɔlɔdi ulásia lɛnunda ulu ni, ɔɔɔdi kasusu buni ka ebile egulabi anii ɔtɛya lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Ɔkpana buni ɔɔdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi. Na ukyuli ɔnwani ni, bɔwɔ na báwɔ-nwu ka ute kebunku uwi ɔni na ɔnwani ɔɔwia lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala mɔɔyɔ́ kadɔ ni, ɔɔyɔ́ likpidi. Na ukyuli biala mɔɔtɛmi taakun lɛmɛnɛ ni, ɔgbankpi na ɔɔwia.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Kayi kani naaasia ulu unwi lɛlɔ ni, ala alátɛku-nwu. Na unyemi ɔni mɔɔtu ala teenwini ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔɔbla gyoli gyoli teetéduo lɛbibo kemmo.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Si áwɔ ɔdɔlɔdi ni, ɔdi lɛla lɛni muukpóku ukyuli. Na lɛlɔ lilayɔ ubi ɔti ɔni ubi mɔɔta teenye bekyuli lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Ebiti bɔkɛ na kayi kemmo ɔdi kuvo ute ukyuli ɔmmɔ. Nsu kɔyu kɔni nsɔ neeebo lɛnunsia ɔɔyá na ɔyikun ɔɔsá ukyuli ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi baabɛ́ taaƒɔ ala bekyuli kudɔ kalɛ na batu litemi benwini.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Ubi ɔdɔlɔdi ni, ɔɔyá na ɔti uunú ɔlɛ na kayi kemmo. Na ngba bɔɔyu uni ɔdu.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdia munu munu ka ebo ukyuli ɔbuni kayu ka ɔsiaku lɛbuni ɔsu, iye ani ɔyikune kɔtu ka ɔ́di nwuna litemi lɛlɔ geen ɔsu!

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni náda anu geen ni, ɔɔkɔ́si bɔtɛmi. Na ukyuli ɔni mbo lɛlati na uunú ala kalɔ ni, nwuna kɔnyi kuse buɛɛ.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni muudie lɛlɔ lɛti ni, nwuna lɛla biala lɛ́ƒɔ-nwu anu. Na ngba ulu buni bamba biala kasusu na baakya-nwu ni, ulátunaku-mu munu munu!

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Ala kalɔ bunu ogya ɔdi ulákya badɔlɔdi kudi kudii! Ama bana kasusu kani na beebó kudu.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Ukyuli etemila akana na enwini ntu bɔnidi bɔni nete ukyuli ngba. Na lɛnunda etemila aayu kayi buɛɛ aani libiɔ ntu bamamba bɔni mɔɔyu.

english_verse: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdia ka litemi ɔtɛne unye ukyuli ɔni na nwuna litemi liiibo ubo kama iye ɔdu ukyuli ɔbuni kɔtɔ.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Badɔlɔdi beeebo kadɔ bɔdɔ, na bana kama ku ugyii.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Badɔlɔdi kenye muubó-ma kalɔ, na bana enyekpi mɔɔkya-ma lɛbibo kemmo.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ etemila ani nse aani lɛna wɛlɛ wɛlɛ ebo emini na anya mɔɔyu teduo ukyuli kayi kemmo.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔsɔne ɔdi ukyuli ukpidi aani ukyuli ɔni muubile bekyuli ala.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: Unwoti lɛnyi lɛdi lɛtakpɛ bonwu lɛni na ukyuli ukpo kama. Na nwuna kudɔ na bekyuli babuni beekeli teesie na baakɛ́ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
translation_verse: Baláka ukyuli bɔlɛ asa na enu lɛla lɛni nébo, amu kɔƒa kɔdubo-ɔ bukpo na abla lɛlɔ ɔdɔlɔdi.

english_verse: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
translation_verse: Ukyuli kɔyu kɔɔkya ɔlɔna ɔni muuƒi kemmo. Nsu ni, ɔma na si nwuna kɔyu kɔ́yii udu na nwuna ɔlɔna ɔdubɔkana bunye?

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ala bute bɔdanku ala enengudi. Ɔkana na uti-ɔ usienku benengu bani mbo kenyekɔ geen anumi.

english_verse: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
translation_verse: Kenye biala na ukyuli ɔsu ni, bekyuli beenú-ka aani litemi geen, wetédu uwi ɔni na lɛla lɛni geen nálɛ ni, básɔku-ni básu kaduɛ.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Baakana na baatu egulabi taanu na bayikune inyɔ bani mɔɔkya unyeƒi ɔdi lɛlɔ na unyeƒi ɔsa.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani na atɛ aayu emini ku lɛla lɛni mɔɔsiáku akpanabi, ɔsika unyemi ɔɔkana na ɔdu ukyuli iye ubunku ukyuli ulu ɔbuni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni nákɛ uleku ɔ́kɛ lɛlakɛ, na lɛƒɔndia lɛmmɔ lɛ́si Unwoti kudɔ.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Ɔwabane muuvele ka banu-nwu kɔnyana, na ɔlakɛne uudie kenye ku edumi.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Bakpana badi bakya bani ɔbladu mɔɔyila lɛlɔ udu. Nsu badi beebó taada lɛlɔ geen utulo banwa muedi.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Ɔdia si adi ɔwabane na aadi litemi geen lɛlɔ utulo si adi ɔdɔlɔdi na aanyi ɔkɔ.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Si anumi égyie-ɔ kabla lɛlɔ na eeebo lɛlati ni, ɔɔɔdia. Na si eesié pla pla taagya ni, adubɔkana na ayii ulu.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Bekyuli beebile bana ngba na bana kɔdɔlɔ ɔsu, na beeti kɔnyi taakya Unwoti.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Lɛlakɛ liiboku bakpana pii, nsu kɔwaba kɔɔgyá-ma.

english_verse: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
translation_verse: Bekyuli pii beevele ɔga ubi ka ɔbla-ma lɛƒɔndia lɛdi. Lɛni kani na ukyuli biala uudie ukyuli ɔni muute bekyuli ala kɔkpana.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Si ɔwabane lɛlɔ bekyuli beení-nwu ni, bi ɔsu na nwuna bakpana beléni-nwu? Ɔwabane ɔmmɔ ɔdubo bɔkpali-ma, nsu bana ƒui badubukeli-nwu.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Si ákɛ lɛnunda ni, ɔɔtina ka aayɔ́ lɛlɔ. Na bekyuli bani muunye kpakplaa ka bakɛ lɛlati na beteenu ala kalɔ ni, enu ku akɔkɔ adubuyi-ma.

english_verse: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
translation_verse: Utalɛ ka ɔdɔlɔdi ulie kesii kani muukeye na utaadi ngba iye kabla ɔblane ɔdi utaadi baga bebi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mbo kasusu buni baabala bana kɔnyi. Na bekyuli badubo-ma bɔbu na baƒɔ lɛnyi si bédie bekyuli ekpidi atu.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Si ɔga úti kɔnyi ni, use aani kalɛ na gyata uubó lɛdi. Nsu nwuna lɛƒɔndia lise aani amii na livo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Ubi ɔdɔlɔdi ɔdi ɔgbankpi ute ɔti. Na uleku ɔni mɔɔkya unyeƒi use aani ɔtɔ ɔni muudú.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Lɛlakɛ ku kaduli kani na bawɔne badubɔkana na bese bana bebi kama. Nsu uleku ɔbuni ɔni muunú ala kalɔ bɔkɛ buti ni, Unwoti kudɔ na ɔɔsí.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔsɔne mɔɔtɛ teesie ɔgyu, na anwu lɛnɔ kɔka kɔɔda.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Si ádi Unwoti ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni, adubɔkɛ ngba. Nsu si éni-mu ni, adubo bukpi.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Si ébunku bawabane ni, Unwoti na eevó ala teete, na ɔdubɔƒɔ kayu kammɔ ɔsɔku ute-ɔ.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: Tumini ƒula bebi kpakplaa na uwi ɔni amu ebo-ma lɛlɔ ɔyikun. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, adubo-ma ngba bubile.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muuti kɔnyi pla pla ni, badubɔƒɔ ama alati lɛtuni kayu. Si áƒɔ-ma kunwi ni, agyi anii asɔ adubo-ma bɔƒɔ kunyɔdi.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Bɔlɛ ku ala ani ƒui na badubɔtina-a ni, ƒɔ-mu kalɛ na adubɔkana, na adubɔda anu ƒula ngba emeyi akladi ƒui.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Adubɔkana na eti kasusu kɔkwɛ pii, nsu Unwoti lɛƒɔyɔ kani ndubo bunye.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Ukyuli lɛlɔ lɛɛda kubiti si aadi ƒula linyese lɛlɔ. Si adi ɔwabane ni, ɔdia utulo ka ataatuala na ataasu inye inyɔ inyɔ.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Si aayia Unwoti ni, ɔɔyá na eelie ngba na ɔɔgyumana-a kalɛ na ɔgbankpi ulálɛku-ɔ.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Kɔkɔsɔ kɔɔdi ɔkɔsɔne lɛlɔ geen ɔni na kalɛ na ɔmini adila ɔkya kenye muedi ɔɔda-nwu kɔkɔsɔ.

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni muudumi bekyuli taakya-ma lɛlɔ lɛma, si áni-nwu kɔtu ni, bekyuli bani na bana kasusu kásɔ badubɔtɛya lɛla lɛdi. Na si ádɔnku ɔnundane ni, ɔdubo anu bɔda bubu.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: Ubi, si éni anii ukyuli utatina-a lɛla ni, énwini kama ákya lɛlati.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ teedie litemi kenye ni, uudumi na ɔɔmá litemi bɔtɛ ulu ɔni ntɛ nse. Na balalane baaƒɔ́ likpidi teebweli aani adila.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muudumi bekyuli taama ni, Unwoti ɔdubo-ma kɔtu bɔni. Na badɔlɔdi kama kadubo kugyiimi butaaƒɔ.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Ntɛ muuboku budumi taama. Na muna bɔda lɛnɔ muuboku kekpo. Anwuɔsu si ukyuli ɔ́ya na ntɛ bɔ́di-nwu lɛlɔ ni, ɔɔɔdubo anu bɔda.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Ɔga kɔnyi kuse aani gyata bɔkwanyi. Si ákya-nwu kɔnyi ni, ƒula ngba na ákya ɔgbankpi kemmo.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔda kekpo ni, ɔbu likpose lɛdi nsia-nwu lɛlɔ. Badɔlɔdi kani mɔɔkya ka ogya.

english_verse: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
translation_verse: Si kɔkɔsɔ kɔ́da-a kɔ́gya na átakana na aƒɔ ɔƒɔwi ni, aaadubo edula adi bɔkɛ na edula ɔƒɛwi.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Etemila buni ani beeti taalɛ ukyuli ni, kayi ɔkwalɛ kemmo na ábɛ akya, nsu banundane baaní-nya taalɛku mmɔ.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Bakpana pii baasu ka badi bakpana buni bani naaalɛ bana bakpana kama, nsu ɛlɛɛ na badubɔnu na bana akɔ ka baadi bana litemi lɛlɔ sɔsɔ.

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni beedie lɛgba lɛni mɔɔtina ka baadi bana litemi lɛlɔ geen. Na bana bebi bani nsia-ma kama ni, bekyuli badubute-ma kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Ɔma ndubɔkana bɔsu ɔnini, “Ɔƒɛni amu lɛ́bla mina kayi sɛɛn, na nse kedee ɔsu likpidi lɛdi lɛsɔ lɛɛɛma-mi lɛlɔ?”

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: Unwoti ukisi beyedine bani mɔɔkɔ́ku ala ulu biala lɛlɔ taanya bekyuli taakya.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Lɛnamu uwi ƒui na baanu bebi taati si udu ɔbuni iye ukpidi ndubo-ma bɔkya na bana udu ɔni na béti baakɔ́ kenye.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni na aayɔ́ lɛlɛɛ ni, kɔwaba ndubo-ɔ bɔda. Nu nwaa na abla lɛla lɛdi na adubɔkɛ adila pii na adi emo.

english_verse: Sensible words are better than gold or jewels.
translation_verse: Lɛnunda etemila aaabɔ na áƒɔ kuye lɛnɔ etulo sika ugyiedi ku asɛɛ ani náƒɔ kuye geen.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Nu ka áƒɔ lɛla lɛdi ényene kama ásiku ukyuli ɔni muunye ɔƒɔ kama na nwuna kayu ɔsu. Ya na baka kayu kadi bɔƒɔ bute-ɔ na ɔƒɔ ɔni kayu kenye na ɔdi uunye lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: Bodobodo uyudi ɔɔyu emini geen si étu-nwu kenye, nsu uunwíni atabi si uwi ɔni na adaku bɔnwanta.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Ukyuli kɔkwɛ kɔni na ɔɔkya kabla kadi lɛlɔ kaatɛ si úye kasusu. Tata kekpo si bátaka-a kasusu bute.

english_verse: Stay away from gossips— they tell everything.
translation_verse: Kɔtɛ keeke ɔtɛmine uugyingya kɔbɛtɛ. Anwuɔsu tadiku ukyuli ɔmmɔ udu kɔkpana.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni muuwida ɔti iye uni ni, nwuna ngba ogya uuni.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Si ɔnamu úyile nwuna kadikɔ kani na ɔti úse-nwu bɔƒɔ ni, kusɛ kusɛ ulásiaku-nwu taatáwɔlɔ.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Tasu ukyuli ɔdi anini, “Ndubɔƒɔ-ɔ likpidi lɛni na ábla-mi kayu.” Ya na Unwoti ɔtɛ-ni ute-ɔ.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Unwoti mɔɔtɔnku bekyuli na bana ngba ulu busie kemmo. Na ukyuli ulakana nwuna ngba ulu ɔni na uusié kalɔ bunu bɔwɔlɔ.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
translation_verse: Si átaka lɛla lɛdi lɛlɔ bɔbu bɔnu ni, tababla tese Unwoti kenye kadi. Ɔsika si átakana-ni bɔbla ni, ɔgbankpi ɔkya-nwu kemmo.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Bukeye bɔni na Unwoti uuti taanu ukyuli kalɛ na use ni, uukeye teeduo-nwu kɔyu kemmo na uudie abɛla ƒui na kagyudikɔ keyi.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na ɔga ɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli uwi ndi uwi na ɔɔdi nwuna etemila lɛlɔ lɛnɔ ɔɔgyumana-nwu na ɔɔyá na nwuna lɛga kadikɔ keenye kpakplaa na bɔyɔ bɔmmɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Bakloƒu ɔyikun ndi bana bukeye. Na benengu liliƒuala mɔɔtina bana lɛnunda bukeye na ala ani bánu dii ɔsu.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Ɔlɔna kɔtu bɔni buudie likpidi na ukyuli lɛlɔ. Na kɔtu bɔni bɔmmɔ bɔɔyá na ukyuli kayi kaabla sɛɛn.

english_verse: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
translation_verse: Ɔga ɔni mɔɔdi lɛlɔ kayi kese aani ketu kani mɔɔgbá. Na Unwoti mɔɔtɔnku-ka na kaagbá taavi kesii kani na ɔɔyɔ́.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔɔnu ka ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔkɛ ɔdia geen, nsu Unwoti mɔɔnu-nwu kayi kemmo taati kalɛ na kese.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ Unwoti si bɔɔbla ala ani mɔɔyɔ́-nwu kaƒɔ teetulo si búti akpala búboku-nwu.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Anumi ani mɔɔnu ɔnusɛ ku kayi kani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ ku likyulikpi ala bɔbla ƒui adi likpidi.

english_verse: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
translation_verse: Kabla lɛlɔ bɔbu bɔnu na enye-ka lɛlɔ kpakplaa uute kɔsia. Nsu ulu klukui lɛlɔ bɔsia anii aakɛ́ lɛkɛ ɔɔyá na kɔwaba kuuƒie ukyuli.

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Lɛkɛ lɛni na ukyuli ɔ́sia ɔkɔ ulu lɛlɔ ɔ́kɛ ni, lɛɛyii taakya aani ulɔyɔ na lɛdi kakpagyuɛ kekpidi kani muudie ukyuli.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Ka belikplune balayɔ ka babla ala ulu lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, bana likyulikpi ala adubo-ma buyu bɔtu na ayila-ma udu.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Si awɔ lɛti elie ƒula lɛyu lɛdi kemmo kpoo ni, ɔdia-a utulo ka awɔ ku uleku ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ɔgyani kenye ɔdi bɛkya lɛgbanya lɛdi kemmo.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Balalane ebiti ndi ka babla bana bakpana kalala. Na bekyuli beeebo bɔnwuna bɔdi na bana enu kemmo.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nse siin baatí ala ani mɔɔlɛ́ku bekyuli bekpidi na bana kɔduli. Na belikplune bammɔ badubɔsiaku ɔgbankpi.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muutile atu si bawabane beewulo kɔnyana ni, ama lɛnɔ belénu belete-ma si baayaki lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
translation_verse: Etela ani baabɛla teete ukyuli aayá na kɔnyi kɔɔyɔ́ ukyuli. Na etela ammɔ udu aayala kayi.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Ala bɔbla ulu lɛlɔ bɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli bani mɔɔyia Unwoti kaƒɔ. Na ɔɔyá na liƒu lɛɛda alaekpidi bablane.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni naaasiaku kasusu kabuni kani na baakya-nwu lɛlɔ ni, anwu ku bekpine ndubo kɔkpana bɔdi.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani na ebiti keeke kama bɔsiaku bɔdia-ma ni, bawabane na beenwíni. Ntɛ ku adikpi lɛlɔyɔ alaya na ukyuli ɔɔkɛ́ lɛkɛ.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdi ɔkya na baaní balalane kɔtu kalɛ na bekyuli bani mɔɔyia Unwoti banwuna. Lɛni kani baabla belikplune na bekyuli bani nse siin ɔsu.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Ɔdia si awɔ lɛti akya ketele ntɛ utulo awɔ ku uleku ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ɔgyani kenye.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Banundane bebo lɛkɛ ku ala ani mɔɔdia bɔnu. Nsu badɔlɔdi baadi lɛla ndi lɛla teedie ku udu.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni anumi muugyie na Unwoti lɛƒɔyɔ bɔbla lɛlɔ na Unwoti utaayɔ-nwu ni, ɔdubulie ngba ku udu buni, na bekyuli badubo-nwu butaabu.

english_verse: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
translation_verse: Banundane baadi bayikune lɛlɔ na beeƒie bana ala taaƒɔ, na baaƒɛ-ma awodu ani lɛlɔ na békpo kama ƒui teewi kalɔ.

english_verse: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Si áti ƒula kenye bɔda kpoo ni, eleti lɛlɔ alatákya litemi lɛdi kemmo.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na baatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ na baanu ka ama kani ntulo ni, baata teenye bekyuli lɛlɔ uwi biala.

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni kani na bakɔsɔne badubɔsia anu ndi ka badubɔyii ku udu, ɔsika béni banii balabla kabla kadi.

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: Unwoti ukisi ukyuli ukpidi akpala. Na ɔni nsɔ ntulo ƒui ndi ka ute-nya ku kasusu kekpidi ka ɔkɛ nwuna lɛla lɛdi ɔsu.

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ teedie litemi kenye ni, badubutile-nwu kuƒi. Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔsu lɛla lɛni nálɛ geen ni, anwu na badubɔya na udie ala kenye.

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Ulikplune ɔɔƒwɛ anumi momoomo. Nsu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla ala siin ni, ɔɔnu kaduɛ na nwuna ablala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɔkwɛ kɔni na bekyuli baakya ƒui si ina dɛ na béti lɛnunda kemmo bákya-ku ni, kulakana Unwoti lɛlɔ bɔdi kudii.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: Si ina dɛ báklibi bapɔnkɔ béte kekpo ni, Unwoti kani mɔɔyá na baadi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: Tina ƒula bebi kasiakɔ kabuni na si bábi lɛlɔ ni, na balasia kesii bamba.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na balakɛne baadi bawabane lɛlɔ ni, lɛni na bekyuli bani muuvó ala bekyuli kudɔ beenwíni kabla bablane teete-ma.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mbo lɛƒɔndia na beete bawabane ala ni, kusɛ kusɛ ɔdubɔsiaku-ma.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔku bekyuli bani muudumi bekyuli taama bɛlɛku bina akɔ, na kekpo ku kadɔ ku bekyuli budumi bɔdubɔyii ƒui.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔwia ka nwuna kayi kemmo kese sɛɛn na ɔɔtɛmi lɛƒɔndia etemila ni, ɔdi ɔga ɔkpana.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔɔgyumana ukyuli ɔni mbo lɛlati, na uubile ɔkɔ ɔnyine kɔkwɛ kɔni na ɔɔkya.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Ɔkɔsɔne ubo kɔkɔsɔ kɔkwɛ pii na uuti teete lɛlɔ kuƒi na ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Ɔƒɛni kalɛ si lɛ́lɛ lísie ntábla lɛla lɛdi ni, ndubo gyata bɔsiaku na ulu lɛlɔ na ɔdu-mi!”

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Uleku ɔyalɛ kenye kemmo kágyu voo aani ubu bonwu ɔdi. Na bekyuli bani naaabla Unwoti lɛyɔla ni, ama ndubo bɔnu buduo ubu ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Ɔnamu ɔni na ɔƒɛni na ɔ́si ɔɔkɔ́ ni, adɔlɔla éyi-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo tɛɛ. Nsu si átumini-nwu kaduɛ ni, ɔmmɔ ƒui ɔɔlɛ́-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni na bawabane na ɔɔnya taakya asa na ɔɔkɛ́ taadi iye balakɛne na uute ala kalɛ na ɔkɛ lɛla lɛdi bana kudɔ ni, kɔwaba ndubo-ma buƒie. Banundane Básu Ala Avlaatɛ Adi

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: Se atu na enu banundane butemi. Ya na ƒula kayi kasia mina ala ani mɔɔtina-a lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔdia geen ka aya na etemila amɛni eduo-ɔ kayi kemmo ƒui na asia-a unyemi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɔɔtina-a ala ɔmwi. Geen ni, awɔ mɔɔtina lɛla lɛdi kalɛ na ƒula anu ƒui asia Unwoti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
translation_verse: Línweni ala avlaatɛ adi líte-ɔ, na bɔlɛ ku lɛlati ala sɔɔn na adi.

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: Na ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na adubɔsia na ati litemi geen lɛmmɔ. Na adubɔkana na edie lɛla biala kenye ulu lɛlɔ atɔ asia ete bekyuli bani nákya-a kabla kadi kɔnu. –

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti uukpó teete-ma. Na ukyuli ɔni makya-ma ɔlɛ ni, Unwoti lɛnɔ ɔdubɔkya-nwu ɔlɛ. –

english_verse: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
translation_verse: Da lɛlɔ mami na bekyuli bani muuti kɔnyi pla pla lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: Na si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, awɔ lɛnɔ adubɔtɛya-ma na eti ƒula kɔyu akya ɔgbankpi kemmo. –

english_verse: Don't guarantee to pay someone else's debt.
translation_verse: Tatákyaku ukyuli ɔdi ɔku kɔnu anii eenye-nwu kama na kayu kadi ɔsu.

english_verse: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
translation_verse: Si átakana kayu kammɔ bɔƒɔ ni, ƒula atɛla muedi badubɔni-nya bedie-ɔ kalɔ. –

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Teyu ƒula ɔdɔsane ɔdi lɛlakɛ anii aavumana ɔmii ugyii ɔnii na ati bene bálɛ kenyekɔ. –

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani na ánu ka bebo kogyoklo geen ni, baga kabla na baabla na ɔɔɔdi bekyuli keeke.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani na bebo lɛnumi ni, awɔ ku-ma bitelie bitadi. Na bana adila mini mini atada-a ɔkwɛ.

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Si awɔ ku lɛlɔ ɔdine bɛ́sala bɛɛdi ni, taanu kaduɛ na lɛla lɛni na uusé-ɔ anumi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: Na si aayɔ́ bɔdi pii ni, na akɔsi bɔdi!

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Na ala mini mini ani na ɔɔla teebese-ɔ anumi akɔsi-ɔ ɔkwɛ bɔda. Ɔsika ɔƒɛni kalɛ katɔlɔ lɛkwɛ lɛdi lɛkya-nwu kemmo. –

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Badubɔsu-ɔ banini, “Di na ani,” nsu ɔɔɔdi ku bana kaƒɔ ƒaa. Benye baabu ala ani na aadi akunta kalɛ na édu.

english_verse: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
translation_verse: Tetu lɛlɔ anii eenwíni ɔlakɛne. Bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka eteebile lɛlɔ uwi?

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛlakɛ lɛɛyii na ukyuli anumi, na lɛɛtɔlɔ aani kalɛ na aasɛ uuveyi taatɔlɔ! –

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: Na adubo ala abuni ani na béte-ɔ mmɔ ƒui bɔdala budie. Na adubɔyɔ ka nka átagya-ma enu na lɛƒɔndia lɛni na banii bábla-a mmɔ ɔsu. –

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Tebile ƒula uwi na badɔlɔdi lɛlɔ anii aalɛ-ma, ɔsika lɛnunda litemi lɛdi biala lɛɛɛdubo-ma anu bɔƒɔ. –

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Tagyu bati ɔmii ugyii ɔdi na eƒie bekpinebi kalɔ aƒɔ anii beeebo ubunkune ɔdi ɔsu.

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: Ubi, se kɔtu na enu litemi na ada anu. Na aya ƒula kayi kasia ulu ɔbuni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
translation_verse: Tasiaku ntɛ bekpine ku adikpi badine ɔbladu kama!

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: Ɔsika kɔwaba ulu lɛlɔ na bakɛ bésela. Lɛlɛɛ bɔlɛɛ pii mɔɔyá na beenyimi adikpi. –

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
