translation_verse: Ƒɔ litemi geen bɛla se lɛlɔ, na teti-ni teye. Na ada anu na aya batumini-ɔ kalɛ na anu ala ati kaduɛ.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: O mina ubi, ti ƒula kayi te-mi. Na ƒula anu asia lɛnunda ulu ɔni mɔɔtina-a lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: Uleku ɔyalɛ ni, ubu voo na ɔdi. Na uleku ɔsɔnɔdine ni, ɔgbankpi na ɔdanku.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: Bɔbɛ na ɔɔbɛ́ teenye taagya bekyuli aani uyune. Na ɔɔnu ulu teete ɔnana ɔni malɛ ulekudi kama. –

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔmani udu na kayi kaakpulu? Na ɔmani muukpóku lɛlɔ na ɔkɛ ɔɔdɔ anwu lɛti uwi biala? Na ɔma mɔɔƒɔ́ lɛlɛ lidu lidu na anumi égyie-nwu kɔɔ?

english_verse: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔmmɔ ulata ntɛ bɔdi kalɔ kudii, ɔsika bɔdi biala bɔdia-nwu.

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Taya na kalɛ na ntɛ avlɔvɔ eeƒuƒuo na aadia bɔnu na bɔɔyu emini lɛnɔ atɔlɔ-ɔ.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: Adubo ana buteegye taanu liƒu ala, na ataatɛmi aani ubuokpine.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: Na adubo butaagbanta aani ukyuli ɔni nnye ɔkɔlɔ kemmo na ɛpu anumi, na úƒie ɔkɔlɔ kemmo lɛbuli lɛmmɔ ɔda.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: Na adubo bɔsu anini, “Báƒiɛmi-mi ugyii, nsu útabla-mi lɛla lɛdi. Na uwi ɔni beebó-mi muedi ńtati. Uwi ɔmani na ndubɔta na lɛsɔ ntáni bɔdi?”

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Tekpoku lɛlɔ ulu biala lɛlɔ na alaekpidi bablane lilidia lɛdi lɛlɔ. Na balalane lɛlɔ litegyie-ɔ anumi.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi lɛlɔ litegyie-ɔ anumi. Na tawia anii aakya-ma kasala kemmo lɛnɔ.

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli kalɔ bɔvi na bebile-ma ngba na bataakya kekpo ku etemila ani mɔɔkya lɛsɛ ogya kasusu kani na beelie taabla. –

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bekpidi beeebo lɛnunsia na ngba bɔni ndubo kemmo, ɔsika bana asogya ɔdubo buni. –

english_verse: Use wisdom and understanding to establish your home;
translation_verse: Lɛnunda na beeti taatu ɔtɔ. Na kasusu kabuni lɛlɔ na uunye kpakplaa.

english_verse: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku lɛnunda lɛlɔ na adubɔkana na eyile lɛtɔ lɛmmɔ ku ala abuni lidu lidu ku akɛla lɛnɔ. –

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: Ubi, yia Unwoti ku ɔga ɔni mɔɔdi-mii lɛlɔ. Na bekyuli bani náta bénye lɛlɔ badine lɛlɔ ni, tadiku-ma kɔkpana.

english_verse: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu tata kekpo si átaƒɔ kasusu na banundane kudɔ. Asa na adubɔdi lɛlɔ ni, ɔ́si kasusu bakyane pii bani na ebo ɔsu. –

english_verse: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
translation_verse: Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, awɔ ku-ma ƒui ndubo ɔgbankpi kemmo bɔyu butéduo, na bɛyii udu ƒui. Banundane Básu Ala Bébu

english_verse: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
translation_verse: Ɔdɔlɔdi ɔɔnu lɛnunda kakaaka. Na si batɔnkune bása beli ni, ɔdɔlɔdi ulakɛ lɛla lɛni na ɔsu. –

english_verse: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
translation_verse: Binu ala bamba ani na banundane básɔ básu. Ɔɔɔdia ka banu ukyuli anumi batɛ litemi na batu litemi geen lɛmmɔ benwini.

english_verse: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni muulie taabla likpidi kasusu ni, lɛsɛ ɔkyane lɛnyi na ɔɔƒɔ́.

english_verse: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
translation_verse: Na ɔdɔlɔdi kɔkwɛ ni, ekpidi sɔɔn na adi. Na ukyuli ɔni muudumi bekyuli taama ni, ɔdi balayɔ-nwu. –

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni masu alaekpidi ɔblane ɔdi ɔnini, “Adi ukyuli ɔni nse siin” ni, bekyuli badubo-ɔ buwida na kadi bekyuli ƒui badubukisi-ɔ.

english_verse: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
translation_verse: Si ánu ka átakana lɛla lɛdi bɔbla na bukpoku bɔdi ɔsu ni, agyi anii ƒula ɔyikun ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ɔ́sɔ. –

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: Nsu bani mɔɔdú bani litemi neeebo ubo kɔtɔ belikplune na bana ablala ɔsu ni, bana lɛlɔ lɛɛda bekyuli ebiti na kusɛ kusɛ lɛnɔ ɔdubɔsiaku-ma.

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: Tekeli kabla kadi na akya kakwɛ anii átati anii awɔ na ɔlɛka abla-ka. Ɔsika Unwoti ɔgyi ukyuli biala kayi kemmo na ɔɔnu awɔ lɛnɔ. Anwu mɔɔnu ƒula kɔyu lɛlɔ na ɔgyi ka áti kabla kammɔ lɛlɔ litemi. Na ɔdubɔtɛku bekyuli ƒui litemi na lɛla lɛni na bábla lɛlɔ. –

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: Si bédie litemi lɛdi kenye béte-ɔ ulu lɛlɔ ni, ɔbu na béte-ɔ.

english_verse: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
translation_verse: Nu ka ƒula kabla kélie kalɔ asa na atu ɔtɔ.

english_verse: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
translation_verse: Tatábɛ tebi bekyuli babuni badi kaduli ulu aani ukyuli ukpidi. Na tetéyu-ma tatu ekpoku-ma na eti-ma ala lɛnɔ!

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: Ɔsika si ina bébuli maatɛ muedi badubɔsɔ bata. Nsu si ɔgbankpi ɔ́siaku bekyuli bekpidi ama ni, ɔɔyila-ma ku udu kɔnakunwi. –

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Tanyi ɔkɔ tedie kenye ada ƒula ukyulikpana ɔni nátabla lɛla lɛdi kenye.

english_verse: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ litayɔ-ɔ si ánu ka ƒula bekisine bébuli. Na ebiti atada-a na kayi kemmo si bétulo.

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔmmɔ udu uláyɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ, na ɔdubɔda-ma kɔtu bɔni ɔya. –

english_verse: or say to someone, “I'll get even with you!”
translation_verse: Na tasu anini, “Lɛ́kɛ kasiakɔ na lɛbla lɛla lɛni na bábla-mi dii lɛsia-ma!”

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: Dii ni, nkɛ lɛ́vi ɔkɔsɔne ɔdi kemo.

english_verse: Thorns and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall had fallen down.
translation_verse: Lɛ́nu ka liyu lɛ́kwɛ lɛ́ƒɔ-ka ƒui. Livo bamba lɛnɔ limomo na awodu ammɔ lɛnɔ ábwɛ éwi kalɔ.

english_verse: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:
translation_verse: Na ka lɛ́nu-ka na lɛ́bla kasusu ni, lɛ́tɛya lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Na ani ndi ka si álɛɛ ávili na átɛ lɛnɔ ágya anii aanwuna blii ni,

english_verse: Suddenly poverty hits you and everything is gone!
translation_verse: kɔwaba kɔdubo-ɔ buyu bɔtu aani uyune kalɛ. Na ayaki adubo-ɔ bukpoku aani kekpo ukpone kalɛ.

english_verse: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
translation_verse: Salomo ɔ́sɔ úbo agba bamba, na Ɔga Hesekia kasusu bakyane bani nkya Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ bénweni-nya bése.

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔɔgyi kalɛ na katɔ kákuku kétédu, iye kesii kani na kalɔ lɛnɔ kágyu kétédu, iye ɔti lɛla lɛni nkya ɔga ɔdi kasusu kemmo.

english_verse: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right
translation_verse: Nye na bakpali-ɔ bene banii, “Ni de kenengudikɔ mɛni,” utulo ka babɔku-ɔ batɔlɔku keliekɔ kenengudi kani na aanwanɛ ka elie ku kɔƒa. Tanu lɛla biala,

english_verse: before you sue someone, or you might lose your case and be embarrassed.
translation_verse: na eti litemi lɛmmɔ esienku litemi katɛkɔ, ɔsika kɔƒa kɔdubo-ɔ bukpo si útádi-ɔ ubo.

english_verse: When you and someone else can't get along, don't gossip about it.
translation_verse: Si ƒula ɔkpana ɔ́ƒiɔ-ɔ ni, awɔ ku-nwu bɛsu-ni kani na ɔwɔ mmɔ. Tatásu ukyuli bamba na edie lɛbɛla lɛmmɔ keyi.

english_verse: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.
translation_verse: Kasusu kani beete ukyuli na uwi ɔbuni lɛlɔ use aani adingyii ebi ani négyie kaduɛ na bátɛ-nya bákya sika ɔƒualadi lɛkyami kemmo.

english_verse: Broken promises are worse than rain clouds that don't bring rain.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni muusé kenye kekpludi na ulábla taasia lɛni ni, use aani ulɔyɔ ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni naaakana ɔnantu bɔna.

english_verse: Patience and gentle talk can convince a ruler and overcome any problem.
translation_verse: Kayi buɛɛ kadubɔkana na kenwini ɔgabi ɔdi kasusu. Na lɛdi buɛɛ butemi bɔdubɔkana na bɔdi ukyuli ɔni mɔɔkyaku-ɔ unyeƒi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Eating too much honey can make you sick.
translation_verse: Si ákɛ uwɔ ni, tadi-nwu taavili amu ɔdububo-ɔ ɔlɛ.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: Si eesié ƒula ɔkpana kudɔ busie busie ni, ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdubo bɔdia na bete-ɔ éduo.

english_verse: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ bɔnyi taasia bekyuli uuduo teetulo ka eti kadadi iye kewii iye lɛtula atu ukyuli.

english_verse: A friend you can't trust in times of trouble is like having a toothache or a sore foot.
translation_verse: Si éti ƒula kayi ásia ukyuli ɔni na balaƒɔ taadi lɛlɔ ni, use aani si lɛnyi lɛɛkunku-ɔ na ada-ni aanwánta iye akɛ eesié ɔgba ɔni násɔ-ɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.
translation_verse: Si kɔka kɔɔda ƒula ukisine ni, te-nwu adila na ɔdi. Si utukwɛ mɔɔda-nwu ni, te-nwu ntu na ɔni.

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si ábla lɛni ni, édie ogya ku agyabi éwi-nwu lili. Na Unwoti ɔdubɔƒɔ-ɔ kayu.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni muukpó taasi katɔ taayu uuboku ɔnantu ni, lɛni kani na katɛ ɔtɛne keeke ɔɔkya ukyuli kɔnyi.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Si awɔ lɛti elie ƒula lɛyu lɛdi kemmo kpoo ni, ɔdia-a utulo ka awɔ ku uleku ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ɔgyani kenye ɔdi bɛkya lɛgbanya lɛdi kemmo.

english_verse: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.
translation_verse: Kenye buni kani mɔɔsí ɔgyu teebo ukyuli kese aani ntu bamamba bɔni mɔɔdú utukwɛ.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Si bekyuli babuni ku bekpidi básala lɛlɔ na ɔbladu buɛ ɔdi lɛlɔ ni, use aani kalɛ na beebwiiile ntu bɔdi iye beti aba taakya libiɔ lɛdi kemmo.

english_verse: Losing self-control leaves you as helpless as a city without a wall.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni na ulakana lɛlɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi ni, use aani ɔma ɔni na awodu ani mɔɔgyumana-nwu ábwɛ.

english_verse: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.
translation_verse: Ɔbu ɔdi ulásiaku badɔlɔdi kalɛ kani na etubankɛ aláyu kaƒɛndi iye ɔnantu ɔna edula ɔƒɛwi.

english_verse: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na lɛsɛɛmɛɛ liibó avwi na lɛkpaƒɛɛlɛ liiveyi taatɔlɔ ni, lɛni na si éwida ukyuli kekeeke, nsu útabla lɛla lɛdi na eewida ammɔ eeveyi taatɔlɔ-nwu kudɔ.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: Si awɔ ku badɔlɔdi bɛɛní lɛla lɛdi teenene ni, die bana ala ani na beeye-ɔ kenye na aya basɔ bakya bana kɔdɔlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.
translation_verse: Si áƒɔ ɔdɔlɔdi ádi anii watásu kenye kalɛ na ásia-ka ni, ɔdi kɔdɔlɔ kakali kani nse aani kalɛ na ekulo awɔ ɔlati ɔgba edie iye ani kuvo kukpidi.

english_verse: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.
translation_verse: Si ɔdɔlɔdi ɔnii uubó lɛgba ni, úlieku aani kalɛ na ɔgba uukpi ukyuli gbinigbini.

english_verse: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?
translation_verse: Si émwi ɔdɔlɔdi na ákɔliku-nwu lɛnyi katɔ ni, use aani kalɛ na baabala lɛtabi taakya kavwinvwi kemmo kalɛ na lilálɛ.

english_verse: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔlɔdi lɛgba bubo buse aani kalɛ na ntɛ ukpine ɔɔgyú liyu kagba taada kɔnu teeƒwimi.

english_verse: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mbo kabla na úti-ka ɔ́kya ɔdɔlɔdi lɛkɔkɔ ni, use aani ukyuli ɔni muubó kataminta taakya kayaa lɛla lɛdi tanu tanu.

english_verse: Dogs return to eat their vomit, just as fools repeat their foolishness.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na akpewe ɔsɔ uuti nwuna kɔdala ni, lɛni na ɔdɔlɔdi ɔɔsɔ teenwini teesie nwuna kɔdɔlɔ ala bɔbla kudɔ.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: Badɔlɔdi lɛnunsia na ala lɛlɔ ni, ɔdia utulo bekyuli bani mɔɔkali ka báda anu, nsu bátada anu.

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na ɔpunu ɔɔlɛmi teesie teebo ni, lɛni na ɔkɔsɔne ɔɔtɛ nwuna atɛla lɛlɔ teebo teeminime.

english_verse: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.
translation_verse: Kɔkɔsɔ kɔɔdi ɔkɔsɔne lɛlɔ geen ɔni na kalɛ na ɔmini adila ɔkya kenye muedi ɔɔda-nwu kɔkɔsɔ.

english_verse: A lazy person says, “I am smarter than everyone else.”
translation_verse: Bakɔsɔne baanu lɛlɔ ka ama mmomu náda anu betulo banundane kasusu betine maatɛ.

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Si ákya ukyuli kɔtɛ kenye na aaagyi-ku lɛlɔ lɛla lɛdi ni, ɔdi kɔdɔlɔ ala bɔbla. Na use aani si áda akpewe ɔni na aaagyi kɔtu aaní.

english_verse: It's no crazier to shoot sharp and flaming arrows
translation_verse: Kalɛ na si ubuokpine ɔda lɛtula lɛni mɔɔkana na liibile ala na ɔɔda liƒu ni,

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Si ekyweni aakywí laa na ása ni, buni na ogya uuni. Lɛni kani na si kɔtɛ keeke kɔ́sa bɔtɛmi ni, kadɔ lɛnɔ kása.

english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ etemila ani nse aani lɛna wɛlɛ wɛlɛ ebo emini na anya mɔɔyu teduo ukyuli kayi kemmo.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Kɔtɛ kɔni baakya emini aabɛla kasusu kekpidi kani nkya ukyuli ɔdi kayi kemmo aani kalɛ baanwamana sika ugyiedi ntu taakwaa libui.

english_verse: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani na bekyuli litemi lɛkya-ma kayi ni, uwi ɔdi baatina ka badia geen, nsu taƒɔ-ma tadi.

english_verse: than can be counted— so don't believe a word!
translation_verse: Ina ka bekyuli bamɛni baabla lɛlɔ aani bebo lɛƒɔndia ni, likpidi lɛ́ƒɔ-ma kayi kemmo tɛɛ.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: Si ákywɛ ƒula ɔkpana kakpagyuɛ ni, awɔ ɔlati ndubo-ka kemmo bɔnu buduo. Na si éminime lɛtakpɛ bonwu lɛdi anii litásia bekyuli lɛlɔ ni, lɛdubɔsɔ linwini libasia-a.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Unyemi ɔni mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ taasia ukyuli ni, uláwia ukyuli ɔmmɔ bɔdia. Na katɔlɔ kaadú ukyuli.

english_verse: Don't brag about tomorrow! Each day brings its own surprises.
translation_verse: Takun lɛmɛnɛ na kɔnaadi kadi kani mebo lɛlɔ, ɔsika aaagyi lɛla lɛni mebo kɔnaadi.

english_verse: Don't brag about yourself— let others praise you.
translation_verse: Temwi lɛlɔ. Ya na bekyuli bemwi-ɔ mmomu.

english_verse: Stones and sand are heavy, but trouble caused by a fool is a much heavier load.
translation_verse: Lɛtabi libo unu na kɔnwinimi kuse gbɛn, nsu kayi kemmo ɔlɛ ɔni na ɔdɔlɔdi ɔɔkya ukyuli kayi ni, ubo unu utulo alakpa anyɔ ammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Kɔnyi kɔdanku ulikplu na livoƒi lise aani ketu buyi. Nsu ala ani na kogyulo kuubile ni, ɔdi ulakana-ku kenye bunye.

english_verse: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Si ƒula ɔkpana ɔ́kya-a ɔlɛ lɛlɔ ni, ɔdia utulo ɔni na ƒula ukisine úbakya-a kɔgbu ɔnii bɔƒianku na ɔda-a.

english_verse: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli úmo ni, uwɔ muedi ɔsɔ ulati-nwu emini. Nsu ukyuli ɔni na kɔka kɔɔda momoomo ni, ina dɛ na lɛla lɛdi libo ɔdu muedi ni, lɛɛyu-nwu emini.

english_verse: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni náyii ɔtɔ ulu ni, use aani aasɛ ɔni náyii nwuna lɛyu ulu.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Bɔlɛ bɔni na ƒula ɔkpana ɔ́lɛ-ɔ na bɔ́ƒɔ-ɔ anu ni, buse aani ugyulo ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni baakyula iye nnɔmii ƒɛƒɛɛ bɔni baawɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: Tenwini kama takya ƒula bakpana ku ƒ'ɔti bakpana na adubɔkɛ bebunkune uwi ɔni na ala étulo-ɔ, na elésie ƒula ɔtɔ kemmo bekyuli kudɔ. Ɔsika ɔdia ka esie ƒula ɔkpana ɔni nde-ɔ kudɔ utulo ka esie ƒula ɔtɔ kemmo ukyuli ɔni nkya ɔgyu kudɔ.

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: Ubi, ɔɔɔdi ebiti blii ndubo-mi bɔda si ákana na énwini ɔnundane. Ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔya na lɛkana linye lɛsiaku bekyuli bani mɔɔtu-mi kenye na beedie-mi bɔƒiɔ.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Sia anumi na aƒɔ lɛla lɛdi enyene kama asiku ukyuli ɔni muunye ɔƒɔ ɔdi kayu kenye kudɔ. Na si uleku ɔsɔnɔdine kayu kenye na ukyuli ɔdi ɔnii uunye ni, ya na ɔka kayu kadi bɔƒɔ buse.

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Si áta ɔtanta tutuutu na aakpali ƒula ɔdukɛne na aava teegyele-nwu ni, ɔdubuti-nwu kɔnyi mmomu.

english_verse: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.
translation_verse: Uleku unyeyɔne lɛlɔ liiƒí livo teetulo ɔnantu wɛɛwɛɛ ɔni náƒɔ kadi limeyi limodi.

english_verse: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Na si anii aabala-nwu ni, ubo ɔkplu utulo ka abala ɔƒɛƒɛɛ na ɔda bukpo ɔya, iye eti kɔnu edu nnɔ ada.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na lɛbuala lɛɛdɔ́ lɛbuala ni, lɛni kani na ɔkpana ɔɔklibi ɔkpana.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Kabla bablane bani mɔɔnu kɔdingyii kɔdi lɛlɔ bebo kuƒi ka badi-ku ebi. Lɛni kani na kabla bablane bani mɔɔgyumana kabla ɔlati ɔdi kabla ka katɛ ni, badubo lɛyuƒɔla bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na ukyuli ɔkana na ɔnu nwuna anumi na ntu kemmo ni, lɛni kani na ukyuli kayi keedie ukyuli umodi ɔmmɔ udu taatina.

english_verse: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.
translation_verse: Kukpi ku lɛla lɛni mɔɔyila lɛla lɛdi udu belemo. Lɛni kani na kayawi ala ani mɔɔda ukyuli ɔkwɛ elemo-nwu.

english_verse: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.
translation_verse: Ogya kemmo baakya sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi taanu-nwu bɔdia. Lɛni kani na ukyuli bumwi buudie nwuna udu taatina.

english_verse: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.
translation_verse: Si éti badɔlɔdi éwi kaawɛ kemmo na égyuo-ma muedi ni, alakana bana kɔdɔlɔ bule bɔsiku bana kɔdɔlɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Sia ƒula bebuo anumi kaduɛ na eti ƒula kayi ƒui anu-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Si ékulo bebuo livo aklibi ese kama ni, anwu asa adubɔkɛ adila ete-ma,

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: na ƒula baƒonu badubɔbla linwini yuu na bedi adi. Na adubuye ƒula bese lɛnɔ na eti eye katumalɔ.

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: Na bese bammɔ badubɔyu anyi ntu pii bete awɔ ku ƒula kaduli bekyuli ku kabla bablane.

english_verse: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ulábɔku bekyuli bekpidi asa na ama alati beekeli. Nsu bekyuli babuni baakya kayi aani bagyata.

english_verse: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.
translation_verse: Si ala bɔbla kalɛ kalɛ bɔ́ƒɔ kalɔ kadi aban lɛgadi kemmo ni, baavumana lɛlɔ badine uwi ndi uwi. Nsu batɔnkune bani náda anu na bebo lɛlati ni, baayá na lɛla biala lɛɛbla siin.

english_verse: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ ɔdine ɔni mɔɔnya bawabane taakya ni, use aani ɔnantu ɔni mɔɔna taavili na uubile edula.

english_verse: Lawbreakers praise criminals, but law-abiding citizens always oppose them.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muuní ɔda bubo ni, ama muumwi bekyuli bekpidi. Nsu bekyuli bani mɔɔdi ɔda bubo lɛlɔ balátunaku-ma.

english_verse: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi belenu ala bɔbla ulu lɛlɔ kalɔ. Nsu bani mɔɔsiaku Unwoti kama geen ni, beenú ɔmɛni kalɔ nwaa.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.
translation_verse: Ɔdia si adi ɔwabane na aabla ala ulu lɛlɔ siin, utulo si adi ɔlakɛne na udunkpi ɔ́ƒɔ-ɔ keliela kemmo.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ɔdi ubi ɔni mɔɔdá anu. Nsu ubi ɔni mɔɔdiku bakpana bekpidi ku badivone kɔkpana ni, ɔɔkya ɔti kɔƒa.

english_verse: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla egulabi na bekyuli bamba lɛlɔ ɔkɛnku kuvonsia bonwu ɔsu ni, lɛkɛ lɛmmɔ lɛdubɔyii-nwu kɔnu lisie ukyuli ɔni mbo lɛƒɔndia ute bawabane kudɔ.

english_verse: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.
translation_verse: Unwoti ulenu bekyuli bani naaadi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ina baakpali-nwu.

english_verse: By leading good people to sin, you dig a pit for yourself, but all who live right will have a bright future.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔtɔ́lɔ bekyuli bani nse siin taatákya likpidi kemmo ni, ama alati bana kakpagyuɛ ndubo-ma budie.

english_verse: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.
translation_verse: Balakɛne baanu lɛlɔ aani banundane kalɛ, nsu bawabane baanu bana ayaki taati nwaa.

english_verse: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.
translation_verse: Si ala aadianku bekyuli babuni ni, lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ ukyuli biala. Nsu si bekyuli bekpidi benye ala kenye ni, ukyuli biala ɔɔbɛ́.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muuti ala teebi bana ekpidi ni, ala aládianku-ma. Nsu si bédie-nya kalɔ na béni-nya ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔnu-ma kɔnyana.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.
translation_verse: Kusɛ kusɛ ɔsiaku bekyuli bani na bana kasusu kese siin. Nsu belikplune bésela betéduo ɔgbankpi bonwu kemmo.

english_verse: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ukpidi ɔni mɔɔdi bekyuli lɛlɔ ni, ɔdanku ɔgbankpi bonwu ute bawabane aani kalɛ na ebuo ukpidi uuƒie bekyuli.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Ɔgadine ɔni na ɔ́dɔlɔ kani mɔɔnya nwuna bekyuli taakya. Nsu ɔga ɔni na ukisi si ukyuli uládi litemi geen lɛlɔ iye ɔɔbɛ́ taaƒɔ ala bekyuli kudɔ ni, uulie ngba gyɔlɔɔ.

english_verse: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Bekyuli ɔdune ɔni kasusu muukpóku-nwu ni, kaakpanku-nwu teetéduo kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo. Tada-nwu ulu!

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni ni, Unwoti ɔdubudie-ma, na lɛla lɛdi lilabla-ma. Nsu bani na bana kasiakɔ kese gontii ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔyila-ma udu.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔbla kabla kpakplaa bebo adila pii na badi bemo. Nsu si éni kabla na akɛ eebile uwi taavi ni, ayaki adubɔda-a.

english_verse: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔsia ala anu taabla-nya ulu lɛlɔ ni, ɔdubɔkɛ lɛyuƒɔla bonwu. Nsu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔwia ka unwini ɔlakɛne kɔnakunwi ni, ɔdubuduo ɔgbankpi kemmo.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: Bekyuli anumi bɔnu taatu ala teenwini ɔɔɔdia munu munu. Nsu badi baaadaku-ni ka baƒɔ bodobodo kakɛ blii suɛ na batuna babla likpidi.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mbo sika lɛnungyie mɔɔwia ka ɔkɛ lɛkɛ pla, nsu ɔɔɔgyi ka kɔwaba kemmo na úsela utéduo.

english_verse: Honest correction is appreciated more than flattery.
translation_verse: Na lɛla biala kawɔlɔkɔ ni, bekyuli baayɔ́ lɛla bɔsu bɔlɛku nwaa utulo katɔlɔ bumwi.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Bawɔne buyu na asu anini, “Ɔmmɔ útebile lɛla lɛdi” ni, use aani ukyuli bɔdu.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Sika lɛnungyie muuboku kekpo. Na anu buti bɔsia Unwoti lɛlɔ mɔɔyá na keyi kaadianku ukyuli.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Kɔdɔlɔ kɔdi ukyuli ɔni mɔɔkali ɔnii uláwia bɔlɛ. Nsu bani mɔɔda lɛlɔ na lɛnunda kemmo ni, keliela kaatɛ-ma.

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni muute bawabane ala ulayaki lɛla lɛdi. Nsu ewida adubɔsiaku bekyuli bani mɔɔnu bawabane teedie lili.

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Si belikplune baadi bekyuli lɛlɔ ni, bɔbɛ na bekyuli baabɛ́. Nsu si belikplune básiaku ɔgbankpi ni, bekyuli bani nse siin beemomo.

english_verse: If you keep being stubborn after many warnings, you will suddenly discover you have gone too far.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla atuɔkplu na úni ɔnii ukyuli ɔdi utedie-nwu bɔƒiɔ ni, ɔdubo lɛlɔ udu bɔyila na ɔdi ɔsɔ ulakana-nwu bɔbwi.

english_verse: When justice rules a nation, everyone is glad; when injustice rules, everyone groans.
translation_verse: Si ala aatɛku bekyuli babuni ni, bekyuli baakɛ́ lɛlɔyɔ. Nsu si bekyuli bekpidi mɔɔdi bekyuli lɛlɔ ni, bekyuli beedumo.

english_verse: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ lɛnunda ni, lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ ɔti. Nsu si anwu ku beleku bayalɛ mɔɔví ni, nwuna lɛlakɛ lilélie.

english_verse: Flattery is nothing less than setting a trap.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ teemwi ukyuli ni, kakpagyuɛ na ɔɔkywɛ-nwu ka ɔnu-ka kemmo.

english_verse: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi ni, bana likpidi kakpagyuɛ muudie-ma. Nsu bekyuli bani nse siin ni, baakɛ́ lɛlɔyɔ ku kudu.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni baasia anu ka babla ala ulu lɛlɔ siin bete bawabane, nsu bekyuli bekpidi baaadaku ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Sneering at others is a spark that sets a city on fire; using good sense can put out the flames of anger.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muudumi bekyuli taama baakya ɔma lɛsɛ. Nsu banundane ama ni, baayila kɔnyi ala ƒui.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Si ɔnundane úti ɔdɔlɔdi úsienku litemi katɛkɔ ni, kɔvanu kukpludi ku kɔdɔlɔ ala kani na mɔɔlɛ́ ɔdɔlɔdi ɔmmɔ kenye na uléboku keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔlɔdi uuti kɔnyi taayila kalɔ na ulanu kama. Nsu ɔnundane anwu ɔɔda lɛlɔ na ɔɔbɛla nwuna kɔnyi.

english_verse: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.
translation_verse: Si lɛlɔ ɔdine ɔdi ɔɔbu ɔkɔ banyine ni, nwuna kasusu bakyane ƒui badubunwini belikplune.

english_verse: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.
translation_verse: Bawabane ku bekyuli bani mɔɔnya-ma taakya ƒui ni, badanku lɛla linwi lɛdi lɛni ndi ka Unwoti úti anumi ani mɔɔnu bukeye úte bana inyɔ.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Ɔga ɔni mɔɔtɛ bawabane litemi ulu siin lɛlɔ ni, nwuna lɛgadi liinye kpakplaa teetu uwi.

english_verse: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.
translation_verse: Si ada kegyimi aatumini ubi na aadɔnku-nwu kpakplaa ni, ɔɔdá anu. Nsu ubi ɔni na bédie atu na ulie úte nwuna lɛlɔ ni, ɔɔyá na kɔƒa kuukpó uni.

english_verse: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.
translation_verse: Si bekyuli bekpidi baalɛ́ lili ni, lɛni kani na likpidi bɔbla bɔɔkɔ́ katɔ. Nsu bekyuli bani nse siin badubulie na banu kalɛ na belikplune bammɔ beebó kalɔ.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: Tumini ƒula bebi kaduɛ na badubɔya na akɛ atu bɔyɔ. Na badubɔya ƒula kɔyu lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: Without guidance from God law and order disappear, but God blesses everyone who obeys his Law.
translation_verse: Si bekyuli bátanu budie bɔtina bɔdi ni, beení ka bunyimi bɔdi bɔdi-ma lɛlɔ. Nsu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-nwu.

english_verse: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.
translation_verse: Kabla ɔblane ni, ɔɔɔdi kenye etemila kani na beeti taaklibi-nwu, ɔsika ina ka uunú-nya kalɔ ni, ulábla taasiaku lɛni.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: Áasia anu ánu kenye ɔkplu ukyuli ɔdi dii? Baakana na baasia ɔdɔlɔdi muedi lɛnu teetulo ukyuli ɔmmɔ udu.

english_verse: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.
translation_verse: Si ákya kabla ɔblane ásiku lɛnamu uwi ni, ɔdubo ubaya na kɔnyana kuƒie-ɔ kama.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni muuti kɔnyi pla pla ni, ɔɔkya kekpo. Na kɔnyi kɔmmɔ kɔɔyá na ɔɔbla ekpidi lidu lidu.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni nébunku uyune ni, anwu ɔlati muukisi lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ulakana kenye buse na ɔsu lɛla lɛni nálɛ.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Si ada lɛlɔ na bekyuli lɛlɔ liƒu ɔsu ni, akya ɔgbankpi bonwu ɔdi kemmo. Nsu ukyuli ɔni néti anu ásia Unwoti lɛlɔ ni, lɛla biala lilékpoku-nwu

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Bekyuli pii baawia ka bada bana litemi bava lɛlɔ ɔdine ɔdi anumi. Nsu litemi bɔtɛ ulu siin lɛlɔ ni, Unwoti kudɔ na ɔɔsí.

english_verse: Good people and criminals can't stand each other.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni balayɔ bekyuli bekpidi. Na bekyuli bekpidi lɛnɔ balayɔ bekyuli babuni.

english_verse: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, “I am completely worn out! How can I last?
translation_verse: Yake ubidi Agur ɔ́su kenye kadi úse. Ɔ́su Itiel lɛla lɛdi. Na ɔ́su Itiel ku Ukal ɔnini, “Lɛlɔ lítu-mi, O Katɔti, na lɛ́bla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: Ńtatɛya lɛnunda lɛla lɛdi, iye lɛlati lɛdi na anwu ɔni nse kedee mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back down? Has anyone grabbed hold of the wind? Has anyone wrapped up the sea or marked out boundaries for the earth? If you know of any who have done such things, then tell me their names and their children's names.
translation_verse: Ɔma nákɔ úsie katɔ na ɔ́sɔ únwini úbo? Na ɔma násala ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔ́kya nwuna lɛkɔkɔ kemmo? Ɔma násala ntu ƒui ɔ́kya nwuna awu bonwu ɔni mbi-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo? Na ɔma nátu kalɔ kammɔ lɛvi ƒui únyene kalɔ útédu kana kawɔlɔkɔ? Dɛ na baalɔ anwu ku ubidi? Su-mi si agyi!

english_verse: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.
translation_verse: “Lɛla biala na Unwoti ɔ́su ni, ɔkɔ uuubo-nwu kemmo. Ɔdi lɛgyumanala ute bani nátamiku-nwu.

english_verse: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.
translation_verse: Teti lɛla bamba lɛdi tebunku nwuna etemila lɛlɔ. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, ɔdubɔdɔnku-ɔ na enwini ɔkɔ ɔnyine.

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: “O Unwoti, alakpa anyɔ adi kani na muuvele-ɔ. Na teni-mi ala ammɔ bute asa likpi.

english_verse: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.
translation_verse: Die katuala ku ɔkɔ bɔnyi mina lɛlɔ ƒui. Tete-mi kɔwaba, na tete-mi lɛkɛ lɛnɔ. Mmomu te-mi mina limeyi adila kani.

english_verse: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔƒɛni kalɛ lɛ́kɛ lɛmmɔ lɛdubumo-mi lɛvili na lini-ɔ, na ndubuye nnini, ‘Ɔma ndi Unwoti?’ Na si kɔwaba lɛnɔ nda-mi kɔ́vili ni, ɔƒɛni kalɛ ndubo buyu na bekyuli balabu mina Katɔti lɛnyi kedee.

english_verse: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.
translation_verse: “Tebile kabla ɔblane ɔdi tete nwuna ɔtɔlati. Si ábla lɛni ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔdubo-ɔ buwida na adubɔƒɔ lɛla lɛmmɔ kayu.

english_verse: Some people curse their father and even their mother;
translation_verse: “Bekyuli badi beewida bana bati, na belete bana beni kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.
translation_verse: Baanu lɛlɔ ka badia bagya nsu geen ni, beesé lɛlɔ geen na bátalɛ bɔkpi.

english_verse: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;
translation_verse: Baakɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ teetuloku lɛlɔ na baanu lɛla biala tapii.

english_verse: Greed has twins, each named “Give me!” There are three or four things that are never satisfied:
translation_verse: “Ntu kebweyi kadi kakya na kebo bebi belekubi inyɔ. Ama bana keku kani ndi ‘Te-mi! Te-mi!’ “Alakpa atɛ adi akya na elemo kudii. Na ene adi aaagyi bɔsu anii, ‘Ɔ́bɔ!’

english_verse: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Kaƒiɔtɔ ku udinkɔ ku kalɔ kani na ntu bulaƒɔ-ka kudii ku ogya ɔni mɔɔkywí teebile ala na ulásu ɔnii, ‘Ɔ́bɔ!’

english_verse: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.
translation_verse: “Anumi ani mɔɔnu ɔti ɔnusɛ teedumi na ulánu ɔnii ɔ́manku ka unu uni litemi ni, baasɛ bekpidi bani nkya kɔwɛ kemmo ndubo bebedie-ma anumi na livuo kemmo na begbini baduli-ma bebweli ƒui.

english_verse: There are three or four things I cannot understand:
translation_verse: “Na alakpa atɛ adi akya na ana lɛlɔ lɛɛbla-mi dɛye dɛye. Na ene adi anya neeenu-nya kalɔ.

english_verse: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na kɔdigbo aasɛ uuveyi taavi kayaa, ku kalɛ na kɔlakpi kuusié taavi lɛtakpɛ lɛlɔ, ku kalɛ na ɔkɔlɔ bonwu ɔɔkɛ́ kasiakɔ na ntu anumi, ku kalɛ na ɔnana kayi kaayɔ́ uleku.

english_verse: An unfaithful wife says, “Sleeping with another man is as natural as eating.”
translation_verse: “Na ɔni nsɔ mɔɔbla-mi yaa ndi kalɛ na uleku ɔsɔnɔdine ɔɔbla ala. Kalɛ na ɔɔdi teeni kenye na ɔsu ɔnii, ‘Ńtabla lɛla likpidi lɛdi.’

english_verse: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:
translation_verse: “Alakpa atɛ adi aakya kalɔ liƒu kpakpaakpa, na ene kalɔ na ulakana lɛlɔ budie.

english_verse: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much,
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi kabla ɔblane ɔni nénwini kadi ɔga ku ɔdɔlɔdi ɔni mbo adila pii geen

english_verse: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na uleku ɔni na bekyuli balayɔ ɔɔkɛ́ kɔgya. Kalɛ na ulekubi kabla ɔblane ɔɔƒɔ́ nwuna kɔduni ɔgya teelieku.

english_verse: On this earth four things are small but very wise:
translation_verse: “Alakpa ene adi akya kayawi na ese blii suɛ, nsu ana lɛnunda lísie ɔgyu geen.

english_verse: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;
translation_verse: Balalɛ badi bebuo bani neeebo ɔlɔkplu, nsu baaklibi adila teese lɛlɔ na kaƒɛndi.

english_verse: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;
translation_verse: Besi udu bebuo badi bakya na beeebo ɔyikun, nsu beedie libu na atakpɛ kemmo na baakɛ́ keliekɔ.

english_verse: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;
translation_verse: Baalɔlɔ beeebo ɔga, nsu baakɛ otogyi buni kemmo atɔ asia.

english_verse: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.
translation_verse: Basamuda belede buƒie, nsu adubɔnu-ma na baga lɛgbanya.

english_verse: Those fearless lions who rule the jungle,
translation_verse: Gyata, bebuo ƒui ɔga ɔni na lɛla biala lilagyila-nwu ɔtɔtɔ na usie kama.

english_verse: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.
translation_verse: Akɔkɔ ɔgyani ku ketukpa ku ɔga ɔni na nwuna bekpone báka bámana-nwu.

english_verse: If you are foolishly bragging or planning something evil, then stop it now!
translation_verse: “Si ábla adɔlɔla na ákun lɛmɛnɛ iye eeti likpidi kasusu ni, tebo kɔnu kayi! Ti enu bi kenye ku kɔƒa.

english_verse: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na si eebó akɔ lɛnyi ntu na uumi taayu ɔkplu, na si lɛla lɛdi lɛ́wɔ-ɔ enwu na ɔɔdá ni, lɛni kani na kɔnyi kuuboku kadɔ.”

english_verse: These are the sayings that King Lemuel of Massa was taught by his mother.
translation_verse: Ala ani bɔdubo bunu mɛni ndi lɛsuse na Masa Ɔga Lemuel lɛlɔ lɛni na uni ɔ́tina-nwu.

english_verse: My son Lemuel, you were born in answer to my prayers, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: “O mina ubi, mina kaƒɔ ubi, ubi ɔni lɛlɔ na líse kenye,

english_verse: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.
translation_verse: tebile ƒula ɔyikun na beleku lɛlɔ na ayila ƒula ɔlɔkplu na ama bani muubó baga muedi kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Kings and leaders should not get drunk or even want to drink.
translation_verse: “Lɛla lɛdi lɛkya na lɛɛɛdia liiite baga. Lemuel, ɔɔɔdia uuute baga ka bataani ntɛ. Útalɛka ntɛ butaada batɔnkune ɔkwɛ.

english_verse: Beer and wine are only for the dying or for those who have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Nyonu ntɛ te bani néedu kaƒiɔtɔ kɔtu, ama mɔɔní ntɛ ku bani na kayi kaakpulu-ma geen.

english_verse: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.
translation_verse: Ya na bekyuli bammɔ udu bani ntɛ na bayiƒala bana kɔwaba na basɔ beléteenyimo ala ani muukpóku-ma.

english_verse: But you must defend those who are helpless and have no hope.
translation_verse: “Nye bani naaakana bɔtɛmi kenye na atɛmi ete-ma. Na bawabane bani neeebo lɛla lɛdi bɔbla bakɛ bana kuƒi ƒaa.

english_verse: Be fair and give justice to the poor and homeless. In Praise of a Good Wife
translation_verse: Geen ni, tɛmi na atɛ litemi na ulu siin lɛlɔ, na edie bawabane ku bani neeebo bebunkune.” Uleku Ɔni Mbo Udu Buni Mɔɔbla Uleku Ɔbuni

english_verse: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!
translation_verse: Ɔma ndubɔkɛ uleku ɔbuni? Uleku ɔmmɔ udu ɔ́ƒɔ kuye utulo sika asɛɛ ani náƒɔ kuye geen.

english_verse: Her husband depends on her, and she never lets him down.
translation_verse: Ɔgyani ɔdubuti nwuna anu ƒui ɔsia-nwu lɛlɔ. Na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ulayaki lɛla lɛbuni lɛdi.

english_verse: She is good to him every day of her life,
translation_verse: Ɔdubɔya na ɔgyani ɔkɛ lɛbuni na ulabla-nwu ukpidi ɔdi nwuna ngba uwi ƒui.

english_verse: and with her own hands she gladly makes clothes.
translation_verse: Ɔɔƒuna bebuo linwini ku unwo ɔbuni na nwuna enu alanɔ ala budi uwi ɔdi.

english_verse: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.
translation_verse: Use aani beyedine ɔkɔlɔ ɔni mɔɔsíku edula ɔgyu teeboku kaduli.

english_verse: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.
translation_verse: Ɔɔta ɔtanta tutuutu uwi ɔni na kadi kátada tɔ na ɔɔbla lɛdila teete nwuna kaduli bekyuli, na uute nwuna kaduli kabla bablane belekubi bana limeyi kabla.

english_verse: She knows how to buy land and how to plant a vineyard,
translation_verse: Uusié taatávi taanu mmo na uye bɔni ndia. Na kɔsia bamba kɔni na ɔɔkɛ́ ni, uuti-ku teese kemo.

english_verse: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.
translation_verse: Ɔɔsia nwuna kabla kani mete-nwu kɔsia anu kaduɛ. Na nwuna asogya uleni usien uwi ɔdi.

english_verse: and she helps the poor and the needy.
translation_verse: Ɔɔnu bawabane kɔnyana na bekyuli bani mɔɔyaki lɛla lɛdi ni, uute-ma ala.

english_verse: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.
translation_verse: Liƒu liláda-nwu si kɔyɔ uwi ɔdubo, ɔsika ubo kɔyɔ adala ute nwuna kaduli bekyuli.

english_verse: She does her own sewing, and everything she wears is beautiful.
translation_verse: Uudí ala ani na ɔɔvá nwuna katɛnkɔ. Na ɔɔda lɛlɔ ku adi ani na áƒɔ kuye geen.

english_verse: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.
translation_verse: Ɔɔtɛmi lɛnunda etemila, na ɔɔlɛ ukyuli ku lɛƒɔndia na ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔsia lɛla biala mɔɔlɛ́ na nwuna kaduli anu kaduɛ, na ulákya enu lɛgba akɔ taakɛ nwuna lɛdila.

english_verse: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says,
translation_verse: Nwuna bebi baalɔ-nwu lɛnyi teete kusɛ kusɛ. Lɛni kani na ɔgyani ɔɔtɛmi-nwu lɛlɔ kɔtɛ na uumwi-nwu ɔnini,

english_verse: “There are many good women, but you are the best!”
translation_verse: “Beleku babuni bakya kayawi na baada kaduli, nsu awɔ ƒula udu ɔɔɔbɔ!”

english_verse: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Ala ani mɔɔda kayi aatɔ́lɔ ukyuli. Na uleku bɔdia bɔnu bulétu uwi. Nsu uleku ɔni mɔɔyia Unwoti ni, ɔlɛka bemwi-nwu.

english_verse: Show her respect— praise her in public for what she has done.
translation_verse: Ƒɔ uleku ɔmmɔ udu kayu na ala ani na ɔ́bla kenye. Na nwuna kabla alati kebo-nwu kudu na ɔma bekyuli ƒui akɔ.

english_verse: When the son of David was king in Jerusalem, he was known to be very wise, and he said:
translation_verse: Ala ɔtinane ɔni ndi Ɔga Dawid ubidi ɔni nádi lɛga na Yerusalem etemila ani na ɔ́su ndi ani na bɔdubo bunu mɛni. Lɛla Biala Liiibo Na Ukyuli Adubɔkana-ni Kalɔ Budie Geen Bɔwɔlɔ

english_verse: Nothing makes sense! Everything is nonsense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense!
translation_verse: Ala ɔtinane ɔmɛni ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Lɛla biala liiibo kalɔ budie geen bɔdi, mmomu ala ƒui ese-bu suu geen!”

english_verse: What is there to show for all of our hard work here on this earth?
translation_verse: Bi ndi ukyuli kɔsia na nwuna lɛbibo kanaa kama?

english_verse: People come, and people go, but still the world never changes.
translation_verse: Kaba kaba béebo bátɔlɔ, nsu alanu lɛla lɛdi bɔvumana geen lɛni.

english_verse: The wind blows south, the wind blows north; round and round it blows over and over again.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uukpó teesie katɔ ku kada ku ɔƒɛnyi ɔni ku ɔni, na ɔɔkya ligede teesie teebo nsu ulesie kesii kadi.

english_verse: All rivers empty into the sea, but it never spills over; one by one the rivers return to their source.
translation_verse: Ntukpa bɔɔgbá teetéduo ɛpu kemmo nsu ɛpu uleyi kudii. Ɔmmɔ kama ntu bɔmmɔ bɔsɔ buunwíni teesie taatágba taasi ntukpa bɔni kemmo na bɔ́si teebeduo ɛpu kemmo.

english_verse: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.
translation_verse: Lɛla biala ni, bɔnɔ ku lɛlɔ butu kani na bɔdi! Ina bi na bɔ́nu ni, uledu bula anumi ɔkwɛ. Na ina bi etemila na búnu lɛnɔ ni, bula atu eléyii na bɔnɔ bunu.

english_verse: Someone might say, “Here is something new!” But it happened before, long before we were born.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛdi lɛkya na ukyuli ɔdi ɔdubɔkana na ɔsu ɔnini, “Bɛnu! Aanu lɛla lɛwɔdi mɛni?” Lɛkya ɔ́si kukuuku, na líitu uwi asa na bula uwi úbo.

english_verse: No one who lived in the past is remembered anymore, and everyone yet to be born will be forgotten too. It Is Senseless To Be Wise
translation_verse: Bula ɔdi ɔsɔ ulenyimo kuuku uwi ala ani nébo ábavi. Lɛni kani na bula bawɔ bawɔ bani mebo dii limeyi lɛdi basɔ belenyimo bula ala ani na bɔ́bla. Ukyuli Lɛnunda Lɛ́sɔ Na Lítedu Lítawɔlɔ

english_verse: I said these things when I lived in Jerusalem as king of Israel.
translation_verse: Ami ndi ala ɔtinane ɔni nélie Yerusalem, na lɛ́di lɛga na Israel ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I tried to understand everything that happens here on earth. And God has made this so hard for us humans to do.
translation_verse: Líti mina uwi líte ka lɛwia ala kalɔ linu na liti lɛnunda kemmo liduo ala ani mɔɔlɛ́ kayawi kamɛni kemmo ƒui lɛti. Ńtesie ɔgyu asa na lɛ́nu lɛ́ti ka bɔnɔ etila lɛka na Katɔti údi ɔ́sia bayawine kaba bekyuli ƒui lili.

english_verse: I have seen it all, and everything is just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Lɛla biala na lɛkya ɔƒɛ ɔmɛni kalɔ liiibo ukyuli kalɔ budie geen bɔdi. Buse na use aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔbi taasiaku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ.

english_verse: If something is crooked, it can't be made straight; if something isn't there, it can't be counted.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na líbie ni, ukyuli ulakana-ni bɔklibi. Na lɛla lɛni na lɛ́yii lɛ́kya-nwu lɛnɔ ni, ɔsɔ ulanu-ni.

english_verse: I said to myself, “You are by far the wisest person who has ever lived in Jerusalem. You are eager to learn, and you have learned a lot.”
translation_verse: Lɛ́kali ala adi lɛ́nu na lɛ́su lɛlɔ nnini, “Nu, mbo lɛnunda ntulo ɔga bamba biala nélie Yerusalem asa na líbo. Lɛ́da anu na ngyi lɛla ntulo bana ƒui.

english_verse: Then I decided to find out all I could about wisdom and foolishness. Soon I realized that this too was as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu líkpoku lɛlɔ nnii muudie kavumana kani nkya lɛnunda ku kɔdɔlɔ ntɛ keyi. Nsu ɔƒɛni mɔɔnu taati ka ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ úlieku ka ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kani na lɛ́bi nsiaku.”

english_verse: The more you know, the more you hurt; the more you understand, the more you suffer.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kalɛ mɔɔnu ka mina lɛnunda líisie ɔgyu ni, lɛni kani na mina bɔnɔ lɛnɔ bɔɔkɔ́ katɔ. Na si ukyuli ɔnii ɔ́da anu ni, kɔnyana ku lɛbibo mɔɔkɔ́ katɔ teebu.

english_verse: Laughing and having fun is crazy. What good does it do?
translation_verse: Kaƒɛgya na kadi ka ukyuli elie ataama uwi ndi uwi. Lɛbuni lɛmani na ukyuli adubɔkɛ si enye aawia ebiti sɔɔn?

english_verse: I wanted to find out what was best for us during the short time we have on this earth. So I decided to make myself happy with wine and find out what it means to be foolish, without really being foolish myself.
translation_verse: Lɛ́bla kasusu laa na lɛ́kali ka muuti ntɛ lɛkya lɛlɔ ebiti blii. Nsu na mina lɛnunda lɛni na ndanku ƒui ni, kɔdɔlɔ lɛlɔ na ńtálɛ. Na lɛ́kali ka mɔɔsia ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na lɛti lɛbuni lɛni geen nse nte ukyuli, na uwi klukui ɔni na úbo kalɔ kamɛni kemmo bulie na nwuna ngba kemmo.

english_verse: I did some great things. I built houses and planted vineyards.
translation_verse: Lɛ́tu lɛtɔ bonwu líte lɛlɔ nnii mɔɔnu lɛlɔyɔ lɛni ndubɔkya-nwu kemmo ute-mi. Na líse adingyii mmo bɔbuni.

english_verse: I had flower gardens and orchards full of fruit trees.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́bla kevoma mmo ku lɛlɔ ebiti kɔkyakɔ kɔbuni ku adingyii abuni lidu lidu.

english_verse: And I had pools where I could get water for the trees.
translation_verse: Lɛ́tu ntu kewikɔ bonwu na ńtaaƒɔ ɔnantu ntu teewi edula mmo ku egyii bamba mmo bɔmmɔ na bɔ́lɛ lili kaduɛ.

english_verse: I owned slaves, and their sons and daughters became my slaves. I had more sheep and goats than anyone who had ever lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Líye banana ku beleku kabla bablane, na báwɔ bebi bamba udu lɛnɔ bákya-mi kaduli. Na mbo bebuo pii geen, ntulo baga bani náka-mi bulie ƒui akɔ ɔdi biala na Yerusalem.

english_verse: Foreign rulers brought me silver, gold, and precious treasures. Men and women sang for me, and I had many wives who gave me great pleasure.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́ƒɔ sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi pii lɛ́siku baga ku bana kɔlɛkɛ egulabi kɔvumi kemmo. Na lɛ́ƒɔ banana ku beleku lɛnu bediene babuni ɔkpa. Na mbo basɔnɔ pii bani mɔɔdia bɔnu geen. Na lɛla biala na lɛkana lɛda ɔnana ɔkwɛ ni, líse-mi.

english_verse: Then I thought about everything I had done, including the hard work, and it was simply chasing the wind. Nothing on earth is worth the trouble. Wisdom Comes from God
translation_verse: Na lɛ́nu ka úlieku kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔbi taasiaku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔnii uuƒie-nwu. Na geen ni, lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛdi lɛla geen lɛni nnye kaduɛ. Kavumana Keeebo Lɛnunda Ku Kɔdɔlɔ Ntɛ

english_verse: I asked myself, “What can the next king do that I haven't done?” Then I decided to compare wisdom with foolishness and stupidity.
translation_verse: Lɛ́bla kasusu ka liti lɛnunda ku kɔdɔlɔ lɛ́kɔku lɛlɔ, na mɔɔkali ka lɛla linwi pɛ kani na ukyuli biala ɔdubɔsu aani mina kalɛ.

english_verse: And I discovered that wisdom is better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.
translation_verse: Lɛnunda lɛ́ƒɔ kuye ƒui litulo kɔdɔlɔ kalɛ kani na bukeye bɔdia butulo lɛdisa.

english_verse: Wisdom is like having two good eyes; foolishness leaves you in the dark. But wise or foolish, we all end up the same.
translation_verse: Na ɔnundane ɔɔnu nwaa, nsu ɔdɔlɔdi anwu ɔɔnya-nwu taakya gyuma gyuma lɛnumbwɛ kemmo. Nsu lɛ́nu lɛ́ti ka banundane ku badɔlɔdi ƒui ni, kawɔlɔkɔ kenwi kani nse nte bana ƒui.

english_verse: Finally, I said to myself, “Being wise got me nowhere! The same thing will happen to me that happens to fools. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Bana inyɔ ƒui beekpi. Na kalɛ kani na ɔdɔlɔdi ɔdubo bukpi ni, lɛni na ami lɛnɔ ndubo bukpi. Na bi ndi mina lɛnunda kɔsia? Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na lɛ́su lɛlɔ nnini, “Ɔmɛni ƒui uuubo kalɔ budie bɔdi!”

english_verse: This made me hate life. Everything we do is painful; it's just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu muukisi ngba bumodi bɔmmɔ, ɔsika lɛlɔ lɛni na ukyuli uutú na ɔƒɛ kemmo bɔdi etila geen. Na ɔmɛni ƒui uuubo kalɔ budie. Mmomu use aani kalɛ na beekeli taasiaku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that others would someday get everything I had worked for so hard, then I started hating it all.
translation_verse: Ala ani ƒui na lítu lɛlɔ na ɔƒɛ kemmo na lɛ́kɛ ni, álɛ-mi kayi na naaayɔ-nya, ɔsika ndubo-nya bɔda búwi ukyuli bamba ɔni masia-mi kama.

english_verse: Who knows if those people will be sensible or stupid? Either way, they will own everything I have earned by hard work and wisdom. It doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Na ɔma ngyi si ɔnundane na ukyuli ɔmmɔ wabla iye ɔdɔlɔdi? Nsu ala ani ƒui na lítu lɛlɔ ku mina lɛlati ku lɛnunda na lɛ́bla ku lɛbibo na ɔƒɛ kemmo ni, anwu ndubo-nya lɛlɔ ɔyikun bɔkɛ. Na uuubo kalɔ budie bɔdi.

english_verse: I thought about all my hard work, and I felt depressed.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na kayi kaakpulu-mi na mina lɛlɔtu ɔsu.

english_verse: When we use our wisdom, knowledge, and skill to get what we own, why do we have to leave it to someone who didn't work for it? This is senseless and wrong.
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na nka ukyuli uti nwuna lɛlati ku lɛnunda ku ɔyikun ɔbla kabla na ɔnyonu nwuna lɛlakɛ lɛmmɔ use ukyuli bamba ɔni na útetu lɛlɔ lɛdi? Alánu ka uuubo kalɔ kadi?

english_verse: What do we really gain from all of our hard work?
translation_verse: Na bi kɔsia geen na ukyuli ubo na lɛbibo kanaa bɔmɛni kama.

english_verse: Our bodies ache during the day, and work is torture. Then at night our thoughts are troubled. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Uuubo bɔnwuna bɔdi limeyi kemmo. Nwuna emeyi ƒui adi lɛlɔ bususu ku ɔlɛ bunu na lɛlɔ lɛɛdu-nwu. Na si ɔtɛ usien lɛnɔ uláda kasusu buti taaya. Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui uuubo kalɔ budie bɔdi.

english_verse: The best thing we can do is to enjoy eating, drinking, and working. I believe these are God's gifts to us,
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni mɔɔnu ka ukyuli ɔkana bɔbla ndi ka unye nwuna kabla lɛlɔ, na ɔdi adila na ɔni na ɔkya lɛlɔ kubiti aani lɛla lɛni na Katɔti úte-bu.

english_verse: and no one enjoys eating and living more than I do.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si anwu ulete-bu lɛla lɛdi ni, ɔma ndubɔkɛ adila ɔdi iye ɔkɛ lɛlɔyɔ?

english_verse: If we please God, he will make us wise, understanding, and happy. But if we sin, God will make us struggle for a living, then he will give all we own to someone who pleases him. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla Katɔti lɛƒɔyɔ ni, anwu na Katɔti ɔɔyá na ɔɔdá anu na uunú ala kalɔ na ɔɔyá na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ ukyuli ɔmmɔ. Nsu si bɔɔbla likpidi ni, bɔdubo lɛlɔ bususu geen bute bula lɛdila, nsu Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ bula akɛla ute ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla-nwu lɛƒɔyɔ. Na nwuna kalɔ budie bɔbambadi bɔdi buuubo buuutulo ka ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kama bɔbi taasiaku kani na ɔdi.

english_verse: Everything on earth has its own time and its own season.
translation_verse: Lɛla biala libo nina uwi na kabla biala lɛnɔ kebo kana uwi.

english_verse: There is a time for birth and death, planting and reaping,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bawɔ ubi ɔkya, na uwi ɔni na ukyuli ukpi lɛnɔ ɔkya. Edula ɔkyawi ɔkya, na ana ɔƒɛwi lɛnɔ ɔkya.

english_verse: There is also a time for love and hate, for war and peace. What God Has Given Us To Do
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na baayɔ́ lɛlɔ ɔkya, na uwi ɔni na beekisi lɛlɔ lɛnɔ ɔkya. Na uwi ɔni na beekpó kekpo ɔkya, na uwi ɔni na beewi kenye ntu taabla unwi lɛnɔ ɔkya.

english_verse: What do we gain by all our hard work?
translation_verse: Bi kɔsia na ukyuli ɔni na unye nwuna kabla lɛlɔ ɔɔkɛ́ taasiku nwuna lɛlɔ bususu kemmo?

english_verse: I have seen what difficult things God demands of us.
translation_verse: Lɛ́nu etila ani na Katɔti úti ɔ́sia bekyuli lili.

english_verse: God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔɔyá na lɛla biala lɛɛlɛ́ na uwi lɛlɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nsu bula ɔdi biala ulenu ala ani ƒui na ɔ́bla kalɔ taawɔlɔ geen. Na ɔɔyá na bula kasusu keekpóku-bu, na buuye lɛlɔ ala ɔ́siku ala ani na Katɔti ɔ́bla, ɔ́si uwi ɔni náavi úti úsela uwi ɔni ndubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I know the best thing we can do is to always enjoy life,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu lɛla lɛbuni ƒui lɛni na ɔlɛka bɔbla ndi ka ɔdi biala unye nwuna kabla lɛlɔ ku kubiti, na utaabla lɛbuni na nwuna ngba kemmo.

english_verse: because God's gift to us is the happiness we get from our food and drink and from the work we do.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛla lɛni na Katɔti úte-bu ndi ka bunye bula kabla lɛlɔ na bɔkɛ adila bɔdi, na bɔni, na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-bu.

english_verse: Everything God has done will last forever; nothing he does can ever be changed. God has done all this, so that we will worship him.
translation_verse: Ngyi nwaa ka lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́bla ni, ani kani ndubo bunye uwi ƒui. Na ɔdi ulakana lɛla lɛdi buti bubunku iye ɔda ɔdi udie. Na Katɔti ɔ́bla ɔmɛni kalɛ na bekyuli beti ɔbu ku bɔyia bete-nwu.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before, and all that will be has already been— God does everything over and over again. The Future Is Known Only to God
translation_verse: Ala ani ƒui mɔɔlɛ́ ɔƒɛni ni, áalɛ ábavi. Na ani ndubo abálɛ lɛnɔ áakya dii. Katɔti ɔɔyá na ala ani náalɛ dii aasɔ teebo taabalɛ.

english_verse: Everywhere on earth I saw violence and injustice instead of fairness and justice.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́nu lɛla bamba lɛnɔ ka na kesi kesii. Kekpo ku ala tabla ulu lɛlɔ siin kani nkya na lɛbuni kenye mmomu.

english_verse: So I told myself that God has set a time and a place for everything. He will judge everyone, both the wicked and the good.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu mina kasusu kátina-mi ka Katɔti ɔdubɔtɛku bekyuli babuni ku bekpidi ƒui litemi, ɔsika uwi ɔdubo ute lɛla biala na ukyuli ɔ́bla na kesii biala.

english_verse: I know God is testing us to show us that we are merely animals.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́nu lɛ́ti ka bɔkɔku na Katɔti ɔɔkɔ́ku abu bekyuli bayawine ƒui taanu na bɔnu bɔti ka bútavumanaku bebuo.

english_verse: Like animals we breathe and die, and we are no better off than they are. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ngba bulie ku nwuna kawɔlɔkɔ kátavumanaku ebuo ɔdi. Ɔƒɛƒɛɛ unwi na bɔɔnwuna aani bana kalɛ. Anwuɔsu ukyuli uuubo kenyekɔ kadi na kadia ketulo ebuo kadi.

english_verse: All living creatures go to the same place. We are made from earth, and we return to earth.
translation_verse: Ala ani na Katɔti údie na ebo ngba ni, likpo linwi na bana ƒui baasɔ teenwini teesie. Ɔsika lɛti kemmo na bédie bula ƒui bálɛku na lɛti kani na bɔdubɔsɔ bunwini.

english_verse: Who really knows if our spirits go up and the spirits of animals go down into the earth?
translation_verse: Ɔma geen ngyi si ukyuli kɔyu aku katɔ na kɔɔkɔ́ teesie, na ebuo kɔyu aku kalɔ kemmo na kɔɔyu teeduo?

english_verse: We were meant to enjoy our work, and that's the best thing we can do. We can never know the future.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu lɛla bamba lɛdi liiibo liiite ukyuli uuutulo ka lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-nwu na nwuna kabla lɛlɔ, ɔsika ɔɔɔdubo lɛla lɛni malɛ bɔti na nwuna kama.

english_verse: I looked again and saw people being mistreated everywhere on earth. They were crying, but no one was there to offer comfort, and those who mistreated them were powerful.
translation_verse: Lɛ́nu lɛla bamba lɛnɔ lɛ́ka lɛ́mana na lɛ́nu ulikplu ku kalala kani udu na bekyuli baabla bekyuli na kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na keku buwulo sɔɔn kani nda, nsu kɔnu ɔsiane ɔdi uuubo. Na bani mɔɔbla udu ɔmɛni lɛnɔ bebo ɔkplu geen.

english_verse: I said to myself, “The dead are better off than the living.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na lɛ́su kɔnakunwi nnini, “Bekpine bebo bɔnwuna betulo bayawine.

english_verse: But those who have never been born are better off than anyone else, because they have never seen the terrible things that happen on this earth.”
translation_verse: Na bani na bétemonku-ma bɔwɔ ni, bana ɔdi ɔsɔ ɔdia utulo ƒui, ɔsika ama bátanu likyulikpi ala ani mɔɔlɛ́ na kayawi mɛni kudii.”

english_verse: Then I realized that we work and do wonderful things just because we are jealous of others. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́nu kabla kani lɛlɔ na bekyuli benye ku ala enengudi ani na baabla na bɔɔnu ƒui kási lɛlɔ kogyulo bukpo ku lɛnungyie lɛni nkya bekyuli ɔsu. Na ɔmmɔ ƒui uuubo kalɔ kadi, ɔsika use aani kalɛ na baabi taasiaku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ.

english_verse: Fools will fold their hands and starve to death.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔlɔdi muuti enu taasia nwuna kayi na anu ka ɔkɛ ɔɔví, na anwuɔsu lɛnɔ na kɔka kɔɔdú-nwu.

english_verse: Yet a very little food eaten in peace is better than twice as much earned from overwork and chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Lɛdilabɔ blii lɛni na ákɛ ádi ku atu bɔyɔ ni, ɔdia utulo si étésusu lɛlɔ na ému-nya ada na use aani kalɛ na baabi taasiaku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ.

english_verse: Once again I saw that nothing on earth makes sense.
translation_verse: Lɛ́nu lɛla bamba lɛnɔ na liiibo kalɔ bunu bɔdi na kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: For example, some people don't have friends or family. But they are never satisfied with what they own, and they never stop working to get more. They should ask themselves, “Why am I always working to have more? Who will get what I leave behind?” What a senseless and miserable life! It Is Better To Have a Friend
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́kya ɔni na uuubo ubi ɔnanabi iye ɔnwani ɔdi, nsu ulada lɛlɔ butu taaya, na nwuna akɛla ani na ubo lɛnɔ elemo-nwu. Amu na úye lɛlɔ ɔnini, “Ɔma geen ɔsu na muubó abi, na líni lɛla lɛbuni biala líte lɛlɔ ku kalɛ na lɛkya lɛlɔ ebiti muedi?” Bi keyi udu na kadi mɛni na ukyuli ulenu lɛla lɛdi kalɔ?

english_verse: You are better having a friend than to be all alone, because then you will get more enjoyment out of what you earn.
translation_verse: Nkyuli inyɔ kelie kadia ketulo ukyuli unwi. Ɔsika lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma si bása baadi lɛla lɛni na bákɛ.

english_verse: If you fall, your friend can help you up. But if you fall without having a friend nearby, you are really in trouble.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni si ɔdi nébuli ni, ɔkpanadi ɔdubo-nwu bubunku na ɔta. Nsu si anwu lɛti kani na ɔdi ni, nwuna bɔta bɔdubo-nwu bude.

english_verse: If you sleep alone, you won't have anyone to keep you warm on a cold night.
translation_verse: Na si badi inyɔ na báyu bátɛ ni, bana lɛlɔ ogya ɔdubɔƒɔ ɔda-ma gugungu. Nsu si awɔ ukyuli unwi na ɔdi ntɛ ni, dɛ na adubɔƒɔ ogya ada lɛlɔ gugungu?

english_verse: Someone might be able to beat up one of you, but not both of you. As the saying goes, “A rope made from three strands of cord is hard to break.”
translation_verse: Baakana na badi ukyuli unwi lɛlɔ si biikpó. Nsu si bibo inyɔ ni, bɛdubɔsala na bɛdi lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu baasu banii kabuli kani na bámii básala ɛtɛ ni, kalatuna bukulo pla.

english_verse: You may be poor and young, but if you are wise, you are better off than a foolish old king who won't listen to advice.
translation_verse: Si adi okloƒu ɔwabane na áda anu ni, ɔdia ƒui utulo ɔga ɔdɔlɔdi ɔni na ulie na ulaƒɔ bekyuli kasusu.

english_verse: Even if you were not born into the royal family and have been a prisoner and poor, you can still be king.
translation_verse: Na okloƒu ɔmmɔ udu ni, ina aban ɔtɔ katɛkɔ na ɔ́si úbo iye bawabane kaduli na báwɔ-nwu bákya na baaadi baga liku bekyuli muedi ni, ɔkana na unwini ɔga.

english_verse: I once saw everyone in the world follow a young leader who came to power after the king was gone.
translation_verse: Lɛ́ɛnu dii ka kayawi bekyuli ƒui básiaku okloƒu ɔmmɔ udu na ɔga ɔdi kukpi kama.

english_verse: His followers could not even be counted. But years from now, no one will praise him—this makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi ulakana nwuna basiakune bɔka. Nsu na uwi ɛlɛɛ kama ni, bekyuli bani na bébebo kama ɔdi ulayɔ-nwu litemi. Na ɔmɛni ƒui úlieku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kama bukeli taasia.

english_verse: Be careful what you do when you enter the house of God. Fools go there to offer sacrifices, because all they do is sin. But it's best just to listen when you go to worship.
translation_verse: Ti lɛlɔ bɔda si éduo Katɔti kakpakɔ. Na esie atábla kpoo na ese atu enu ala na tababla asu ka atábla akpala aani ɔdɔlɔdi kalɛ na alati anii adaku Katɔti bɔƒiɔ.

english_verse: Don't talk before you think or make promises to God without thinking them through. God is in heaven, and you are on earth, so don't talk too much.
translation_verse: Da ƒula kenye na ati bɔtɛmi na Katɔti anumi. Na tese-nwu kenye kadi asa na abla kasusu asiku lɛla lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika katɔ na Katɔti ulie na awɔ akya kalɔ mɛni anwuɔsu na akɔsi bɔtɛmi.

english_verse: If you keep thinking about something, you will dream about it. If you talk too much, you will say the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Si lɛla lɛdi lɛkya-a kasusu uwi ndi uwi ni, eeti-ni teegye kɔna. Lɛni kani na si ɔdɔlɔdi ɔɔtɛmi uwi ndi uwi na ɔɔƒiɔ́.

english_verse: God doesn't like fools. So don't be slow to keep your promises to God.
translation_verse: Si ánu ka ése Katɔti kenye kadi ni, taya na uwi utu-ka lɛlɔ. Babla na abla linyese lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ete-nwu, ɔsika kaƒɔ kalayɔ-nwu na kɔdɔlɔ ala bɔbla lɛlɔ.

english_verse: It's better not to make a promise at all than to make one and not keep it.
translation_verse: Ɔdia si étese Katɔti kenye kadi utulo ka ese-nwu kenye na aladi-ka lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't let your mouth get you in trouble! And don't say to the worship leader, “I didn't mean what I said.” God can destroy everything you have worked for, so don't say something that makes God angry.
translation_verse: Taya na ƒula kenye keti-ɔ katákya likpidi kemmo. Na tasu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnu lɛkpa lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ anii kenye kani na ése ni, ɔɔɔdi litemi geen na ada na bɔsu kani na ásu. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔkana na ubile ƒula kabla ƒui na kayii udu. Anwuɔsu tabla lɛla lɛni makya-nwu kɔnyi.

english_verse: Respect and obey God! Daydreaming leads to a lot of senseless talk.
translation_verse: Taayia Katɔti ku ɔbu na tataabla kasusu na ala ani na étulo-ɔ lɛlɔ si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, adɔlɔtɛ kani na adubo butaatɛmi.

english_verse: Don't be surprised if the poor of your country are abused, and injustice takes the place of justice. After all, the lower officials must do what the higher ones order them to do.
translation_verse: Si ánu ka baanya bekyuli bani na bese kpɛtɛ taakya na ƒula kalɔ lɛlɔ, na ala tabla ulu lɛlɔ búti ala bɔbla siin kenye ni, utabla-a dɛye dɛye, ɔsika bekyuli bani nkya lɛlɔ badine kalɔ ni, ɔlɛka benu bana batɔnkune litemi.

english_verse: And since the king is the highest official, he benefits most from the taxes paid on the land.
translation_verse: Na ka ɔga ndi ukyuli ɔni na utulo ƒui na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, kalɔ kammɔ kuyii kɔni na báda béte bekyuli na baaƒɔ ni, anwu ndubɔdi kenengudikɔ.

english_verse: If you love money and wealth, you will never be satisfied with what you have. This doesn't make a bit of sense.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mbo egulabi ku akɛla bɔyɔ ni, sika ulemo-nwu na akɛla lɛnɔ alabɔ-nwu. Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui use aani kalɛ na baabi taasiaku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ.

english_verse: The more you have, the more everyone expects from you. Your money won't do you any good—others will just spend it for you.
translation_verse: Si akɛla eemomo ukyuli ni, lɛni kani na badine lɛnɔ beemomo. Na akɛla ammɔ elebunku-ɔ úti útulo ka enye aanu na bekyuli badi-nya bete-ɔ.

english_verse: If you have to work hard for a living, you can rest well at night, even if you don't have much to eat. But if you are rich, you can't even sleep.
translation_verse: Ukyuli bamba kabla ɔblane ni, lɛlɛɛ lɛɛyu-nwu ina útakɛ lɛla bonwu lɛdi útadi. Nsu ɔlakɛne ala pii ani na ubo ɔsu ni, lɛlɛɛ línwini-nwu etila.

english_verse: I have seen something terribly unfair. People get rich, but it does them no good.
translation_verse: Lɛ́ɛnu likyulikpi ala enengudi geen na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ ɔni na akɛla ani na ɔlakɛne ɔ́tɛ úse lɛlɔ énwini-nwu ɔgbankpi.

english_verse: Suddenly they lose everything in a bad business deal, then have nothing to leave for their children.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́nu kalɛ na akɛla ammɔ udu lɛnɔ aayii ɔkɛnku lilikpi lɛla lɛni nálɛ ɔsu. Na si ukyuli ɔmmɔ ubo ubi ɔnanabi ni, na lɛla biala lɛ́sɔ lítebu liiise-nwu.

english_verse: They came into this world naked, and when they die, they will be just as naked. They can't take anything with them, and they won't have anything to show for all their work.
translation_verse: Kasɔngya na ukyuli ɔɔlɛ́ taasi uni kaƒɔ kemmo. Na kalɛ na ɔkɛ úbo ni, lɛni kani na ɔdubɔsɔ unwini ɔtɔlɔ. Na ɔɔɔdubo lɛla lɛdi buti bɔda bɔtɔlɔku.

english_verse: That's terribly unfair. They leave the world just as they came. They gained nothing from running after the wind.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔdi kɔnyana litemi lɛni naaadia bɔnu na ɔdi ɔƒɛƒɛɛ bɔbi taasiaku.

english_verse: Besides all this, they are always gloomy at mealtime, and they are troubled, sick, and bitter.
translation_verse: Na nwuna ngba emeyi ƒui ni, ulátuna bulie taadi nwaa ku ebiti mmomu úmii na nwuna kayi ku kasusu kemmo ku ɔdu kati kati.

english_verse: What is the best thing to do in the short life God has given us? I think we should enjoy eating, drinking, and working hard. This is what God intends for us to do.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni kani na mɔɔnu ka ukyuli ɔlɛka ɔbla ndi ka bɔdi adila na bɔni lɛnɔ na ebiti ataada-bu na bula kabla lɛlɔ. Ɔmmɔ kani ndi lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔɔwia ka butaabla.

english_verse: Suppose you are very rich and able to enjoy everything you own. Then go ahead and enjoy working hard—this is God's gift to you.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni si ukyuli ɔdi ubo lɛlakɛ na limomo-nwu, na ɔɔdi na ɔɔní taakɛ lɛlɔyɔ ni, unye nwuna kabla lɛlɔ ku ebiti, ɔsika Katɔti néte-nwu-ni.

english_verse: God will keep you so happy that you won't have time to worry about each day.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔda-nwu na nwuna kayi kayɔ ɔni na ulenye uléteekpoku lɛlɔ kasusu na nwuna ngba emeyi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: There is something else terribly unfair, and it troubles everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Lɛla bamba lɛnɔ lɛkya na lɛɛɛdia munu munu lɛni na muukpóku bekyuli kasusu.

english_verse: God may give you everything you want—money, property, and wealth. Then God doesn't let you enjoy it, and someone you don't even know gets it all. That's senseless and terribly unfair!
translation_verse: Katɔti uute ukyuli egulabi ku lɛlakɛ bonwu na ɔɔyá na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔƒɔ lɛnyi ɔni na ɔsɔ uláyaki lɛla lɛdi mmomu kayi kaayɔ́-nwu buɛɛ. Nsu Katɔti ulaya na uulie taadi ala ammɔ mmomu ɔƒɔ muubo taabadi-nya. Na ɔdi kɔnyana litemi lɛni ndi ɔgbankpi na uuubo kalɔ bunu.

english_verse: You may live a long time and have a hundred children. But a child born dead is better off than you, unless you enjoy life and have a decent burial.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔkana na ulie ngba ɔƒɔ akwa pii na ɔwɔ bebi ina eti anyɔ muedi. Nsu si lɛlɔ lítayɔ-nwu na nwuna ngba kemmo na uwi ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ukpi na bátava-nwu kaduɛ ni, ubi ɔni nékpi na ntu kemmo muedi ɔ́ƒɔ kuye utulo-nwu.

english_verse: That child will never live to see the sun or to have a name, and it will go straight to the world of darkness. But it will still find more rest than you,
translation_verse: Ina ka útanu ɔƒɛ iye ɔti lɛla lɛdi ni, ubi ɔmmɔ ubo bɔnwuna utulo bebi pii ɔti ɔni nélie útu uwi mmɔ.

english_verse: even if you live two thousand years and don't enjoy life. As you know, we all end up in the same place.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si ina akwa mpim inyɔ na úlie na lɛlɔ lítayɔ-nwu na nwuna ngba bulie ku kabla kani na ɔ́bla lɛlɔ ni, bi na ɔ́kɛ ka likpo linwi kani na bana inyɔ ƒui bátáyii bákya?

english_verse: We struggle just to have enough to eat, but we are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Kenye bɔdi kani na ukyuli ulie uususu lɛlɔ teete nsu ala eledu-nwu ɔkwɛ kudii.

english_verse: We may be sensible, yet we are no better off than a fool. And if we are poor, it still doesn't do us any good to try to live right.
translation_verse: Kenyekɔ kamani na ɔnundane ubo utulo ɔdɔlɔdi? Na ɔwabane lɛnɔ ni, dɛ na ɔdubɔkana ngba bulie na ɔti lɛlɔ bɔda utulo bakladi na ayaki ani nda-nwu kemmo?

english_verse: It's better to enjoy what we have than to always want something else, because that makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Si bɔ́di lɛla lɛni nse-bu ku kubiti ni, ɔdia utulo ka butaasia lɛla bamba anu. Ɔsika uuubo kalɔ bunu bɔdi na buse kani na use aani kalɛ na baabi taasiaku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ.

english_verse: Everything that happens was decided long ago. We humans know what we are like, and we can't argue with God, because he is too strong for us.
translation_verse: Lɛla biala mɔɔlɛ́ ni, lɛdi lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́ɔlɛ ugyii úse kukuuku. Na abu bekyuli bɔgyi kalɛ na buse ɔsu ni, buuubo unyeƒi ɔdi na bɔɔkyaku Katɔti, ɔsika ubo ɔyikun utulo-bu ƒui.

english_verse: The more we talk, the less sense we make, so what good does it do to talk?
translation_verse: Si bɔnii butaatɛmi pii ni, lɛni kani na bɔdubo kɔdɔlɔ keyi buteedie. Anwuɔsu kɔsia kɔdi kuuubo-nwu kemmo ka bunye butaaka ala.

english_verse: Life is short and meaningless, and it fades away like a shadow. Who knows what is best for us? Who knows what will happen after we are gone?
translation_verse: Ngba buse klukui geen na buuubo kalɔ bunu bɔdi. Na bɔɔyii taakya aani ɔƒɛ kɔyu. Ɔma ndubɔti lɛla lɛni ndia lite-bu utulo ƒui? Na ɔma ndubɔti lɛla lɛni ndubo bɔlɛ uwi ɔni na abu bɔsɔ buuubo?

english_verse: A good reputation at the time of death is better than loving care at the time of birth.
translation_verse: Lɛnyi buni bɔƒɔ bɔdia butulo nnɔmii ku ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ. Na likpimeyi lɛdia litulo lɛwɔmeyi.

english_verse: It's better to go to a funeral than to attend a feast; funerals remind us that we all must die.
translation_verse: Na kekwa kalɔ busie bɔdia butulo ka esie limeyi buni kadikɔ. Ɔsika kukpi ndi ukyuli biala kawɔlɔkɔ ku kesiekɔ.

english_verse: Choose sorrow over laughter because a sad face may hide a happy heart.
translation_verse: Kɔnyana kɔdia kutulo lɛma. Ɔsika anumi ani muuwulo kɔnyana aayá na ukyuli kayi kemmo ablala eeboku ukyuli kubiti.

english_verse: Correction from someone wise is better by far than praise from fools.
translation_verse: Ukyuli bɔdɔnku kpakplaa bɔdia butulo si badɔlɔdi beedie lɛnu teemwi-ɔ.

english_verse: Something completed is better than something just begun; patience is better than too much pride.
translation_verse: Litemi kawɔlɔkɔ kadia ketulo litemi kalɔ kesekɔ. Na kayi buɛɛ kadia ketulo lɛlɔ bɔtina.

english_verse: Only fools get angry quickly and hold a grudge.
translation_verse: Tataababla ku kɔnyi buti na ƒula lɛlɔ kemmo. Ɔsika badɔlɔdi lɛgba akɔ na kúti-ɔ kúsela kutálɛlɛ.

english_verse: It isn't wise to ask, “Why is everything worse than it used to be?”
translation_verse: Teye anii bi ɔsu kuuku uwi ɔdia utulo uwi ɔni kemmo na bɔkya mɛni. Ɔsika kɔdɔlɔ litemi na lɛdi.

english_verse: Having wisdom is better than an inheritance.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ebo lɛnunda ni, ɔdia utulo kese bamba biala ƒui.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you just like money; knowledge with good sense will lead you to life.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛnunda lɛdubudie-ɔ na lɛla biala kemmo aani egulabi. Na lɛlati ku kasusu buni kadubo-ɔ bɔgyumana ngba uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Think of what God has done! If God makes something crooked, can you make it straight?
translation_verse: Bla kasusu na Katɔti ala ani ƒui na ɔ́bla lɛlɔ na anu anii adubɔkana lɛdi bunyene si ánu ka lɛdi lɛ́bu?

english_verse: When times are good, you should be cheerful; when times are bad, think about what it means. God makes them both to keep us from knowing what will happen next. Some of Life's Questions
translation_verse: Si ala aatɛku ukyuli ɔdi ni, lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-nwu. Na si bubie na ala eebieku-nwu ni, na ulie kalɔ na uye lɛlɔ lɛla lɛni kudɔ na ɔ́si. Ɔsika Katɔti nábla alakpa anyɔ ammɔ kalɛ na ukyuli ɔsia lɛlɔ anu ka ɔɔɔgyi lɛla lɛni nsɔ ndubo bɔlɛ ɔsu.

english_verse: I have seen everything during this senseless life of mine. I have seen good citizens die for doing the right thing, while criminals live and prosper.
translation_verse: Na mina ngba bɔni neeebo-mi kalɔ mɛni kemmo ni, lɛ́nu kalɛ na ukyuli ɔni nsiaku Katɔti kama siin ɔɔkana na uukpi taayii udu. Na lɛ́nu kalɛ na ukyuli ukpidi lɛnɔ ɔɔkana na uulie ngba taabi lɛlɔ geen na nwuna likyulikpi ala bɔbla kemmo.

english_verse: So don't destroy yourself by being too good or acting too smart!
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu tabla lɛlɔ aani ukyuli kedee tagya, na tabla lɛlɔ ukyuli ɔni na ɔ́da anu ɔ́gya lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Don't die before your time by being too evil or acting like a fool.
translation_verse: Telie tabla ulikplu tavili na ekulo ƒula ngba liku iye tadɔlɔ, na ƒula kɔdɔlɔ kɔya na ƒula ngba bɔda liku.

english_verse: Keep to the middle of the road. You can do this if you truly respect God.
translation_verse: Nu ka akɛ ulu ntɛntɛ na étedeyi étésie kakɛ kadi átavili. Na ɔmɛni bɔbla ulayu-ɔ ɔkplu ulavili si aabu Katɔti.

english_verse: Wisdom will make you stronger than the ten most powerful leaders in your city.
translation_verse: Lɛnunda lɛɛyá na ukyuli unwi ɔɔkɛ́ ɔyikun teetulo lɛlɔ badine leevu na ɔma unengudi ɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: Don't listen to everything that everyone says, or you might hear your servant cursing you.
translation_verse: Tese atu anii eenú lɛla biala na ukyuli ɔɔsu, si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, ésela eténu ka ƒula kabla ɔblane unye uudumi teewida-a.

english_verse: Haven't you cursed many others?
translation_verse: Ɔsika awɔ ɔlati agyi nwaa ka áabla lɛni kɔlɛ kɔlɛ.
