english_verse: In place of perfume, there will be a stink; in place of belts, there will be ropes; in place of fancy hairdos, they will have bald heads. Instead of expensive clothes, they will wear sackcloth; instead of beauty, they will have ugly scars.
translation_verse: Na bana ugyulo ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ ɔdububie. Na bana agblinti aduni buni enwini lɛbuli lɛbuli. Na bana eli linwini lɛni báklibi ƒui lɛdubɔyii udu. Na benyimi adikpi na lɛwu buni gyɔlɔɔ lɛmmɔ kenye. Na bayila bana bɔdia ƒui, na beti kɔƒa kani bataavi.

english_verse: The fighting men of Jerusalem will be killed in battle.
translation_verse: Bana banana badubukpi kekpokɔ na kuwii kenye, na bekpone batɛ kekpo.

english_verse: When this happens, seven women will grab the same man, and each of them will say, “I'll buy my own food and clothes! Just marry me and take away my disgrace.” The Lord Will Bless His People Who Survive
translation_verse: Na emeyi ammɔ kemmo ni, beleku maatɛ ndubo ɔnana unwi bɔnwanɛ, na basu-nwu banini, “Ya na bulieku-ɔ, abu alati bɔdubɔwia bula lɛdila ku adala, na bekyuli badubɔnu-bu bamana-a aani ƒula beleku na baláma-bu aani bakinsi. Die kɔƒa kɔmmɔ lɛti lɛti na bula lɛlɔ.” Unwoti Kugyii Kagba

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will make his land fruitful and glorious again, and the people of Israel who survive will take great pride in what the land produces.
translation_verse: Nsu na uwi ɔni mebo kemmo ni, bekyuli bani na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na balɛ sɛɛn babla aani kugyii kagba kawɔdi kani mɔɔdia bɔnu na keekeye na kana ebi ndubɔya na Israelƒuɔ bani nébu mmɔ baƒɔ lɛnyi na beteekeye.

english_verse: Everyone who is left alive in Jerusalem will be called special,
translation_verse: Na bani ƒui nébu na Sion na bése-ma likpo na Yerusalem mmɔ ka belie ngba ni, badubɔlɔ-ma bekyuli kedee.

english_verse: after the Lord sends a fiery judgment to clean the city and its people of their violent deeds.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubɔkpila Yerusalem beleku bammɔ ƒui sɛɛn na bana ekpidi ɔsu. Na udie ubugya ɔni na ɔ́dɔli Yerusalem ƒui na nwuna lɛlɔ, ku kɔyu kɔni mɔɔtɛ litemi siin na kuse aani ogya ɔni mɔɔkyula ala.

english_verse: Then the Lord will cover the whole city and its meeting places with a thick cloud each day and with a flaming fire each night. God's own glory will be like a huge tent that covers everything.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔya na liƒlukutu bonwu lɛdi lɛƒɔ Yerusalem ku bani ƒui na básala lɛlɔ na mmɔ na limeyi kemmo. Na usien ni, na ogya bonwu ɔdi utaada teekeye teewi kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na Unwoti bukeye bubi-ma eli aani lɛkpɔtɔ.

english_verse: It will provide shade from the heat of the sun and a place of shelter and protection from storms and rain.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔbla kabɛkɔ ute-ma na limeyi liwulu ɔsu ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ku ɔnantu lɛnɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: I will sing a song about my friend's vineyard that was on the side of a fertile hill.
translation_verse: Ndubudie ɔnu lite mina ɔyɔne ɔsiku nwuna adingyii kemo lɛlɔ. Mina ɔyɔne ubo adingyii kemo kadi na kɔbi kaƒɔna kalɔ buni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My friend dug the ground, removed the stones, and planted the best vines. He built a watchtower and dug a pit in rocky ground for pressing the grapes. He hoped they would be sweet, but bitter grapes were all it produced.
translation_verse: Ɔ́tu kalɔ kammɔ únwini na údie atabi ammɔ ƒui. Na ɔ́va adingyii ebi abuni ani ndia geen. Na ɔ́tu bagyumanane kenyekɔ únyene-ka ntɛ. Na údie egyiibi ammɔ ntu kewikɔ ubu. Na unye ɔgya egyiibi ammɔ bugyie na bede. Nsu ebi ani na adingyii ammɔ ánwu ni, ana ntu ese nyanyaanya na aaadia.

english_verse: Listen, people of Jerusalem and of Judah! You be the judge of me and my vineyard.
translation_verse: “Na ɔƒɛni ni, amii Yerusalem ku Yudaƒuɔ, bɛtɛ ami ku mina kemo ntɛ litemi lɛmɛni na bɔnu.

english_verse: What more could I have done for my vineyard? I hoped for sweet grapes, but bitter grapes were all that grew.
translation_verse: Bi na nka ɔlɛka lɛsɔ lɛbla na mina kemo kamɛni lɛlɔ litulo kalɛ na lɛ́bla mɛni? Ka nka ebi buni na mɔɔsia anu ka lide ni, bi ɔsu na ebi ani nse nyanyaanya sɔɔn na kánwu?

english_verse: Now I will let you know what I am going to do. I will cut down the hedge and tear down the wall. My vineyard will be trampled and left in ruins.
translation_verse: “Bɛya na lɛsu-mii lɛla lɛni na ndubo mina adingyii kemo bɔbla. Ndububile ɔban ɔni na lɛ́gyi lɛ́kya-ka na kayii udu. Na ndubɔƒɛ awodu ammɔ ƒui liwi kalɔ na bataanya-ka teesusu.

english_verse: It will turn into a desert, neither pruned nor hoed; it will be covered with thorns and briars. I will command the clouds not to send rain.
translation_verse: Ndubo-ka atu budie na uyi ɔbla lɛku. Na nsɔ neeedie adingyii ammɔ kɔgba akɔ iye lidie livo kana kemmo. Liyu ku alakpi bamba ndubɔƒɔ-ka kemmo. Ndubutile liƒlukutu kuƒi na ɔnantu ɔsɔ ulana ulewi-ka.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! Israel is the vineyard, and Judah is the garden I tended with care. I had hoped for honesty and for justice, but dishonesty and cries for mercy were all I found. Isaiah Condemns Social Injustice
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui adingyii kemo ndi nwuna bekyuli Israelƒuɔ, na Yudaƒuɔ badi nwuna kevomadɔ kemo kani mɔɔyɔ́-nwu kaƒɔ. Ɔsia anu ka batɛ bekyuli etemila ulu lɛlɔ siin Nsu ubugya kani na beewi kalɔ. Na ɔɔwia ka bekyuli babla ala siin. Nsu bekyuli keku kani na uunú ka ala étulo-ma na baanya-ma taakya ɔsu. Yuda Kadi Bekyuli Báƒiɔ Na Unwoti Ɔ́ni-ma Kɔtu

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You take over house after house and field after field, until there is no room left for anyone else in all the land.
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ ute amii bani muuyé lɛtɔ taasia kama na bɛ́bɛbɛ bina kɔlɔ kuyedi bísela anumi ƒui. Bekyuli bamba basɔ beeebo keliekɔ kana kemmo mmomu kénwini amii lɛti keliekɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful has made this promise to me: Those large and beautiful homes will be left empty, with no one to take care of them.
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́su na ami ɔlati línu ku mina atu ɔnini, “Lɛtɔ pii ku katu taasia lɛtɔ buni lɛmmɔ lɛdubo buse ukpludi ɔni na basɔ balákɛ bekyuli bani nelie-ni kemmo.

english_verse: None of them are tired. They don't sleep or get drowsy, and they run without stumbling. Their belts don't come loose; their sandal straps don't break.
translation_verse: Na lɛlɔ liletu ɔdi iye ɔgbanta lɛnɔ. Lɛlɛɛ liléti ɔdi iye ɔtɛ ɔlɛɛ lɛnɔ. Bana akɔ ɔdi kadii iye lɛgbanvuo kabuli kaláƒɛnimi.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! The lies you tell are like ropes by which you drag along sin and evil.
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ ute amii bani nda ɔkɔ etemila na bɛ́ni ekpidi bɛdanku bɛkɛ aani kɔbuli, na bina ulikplu ala bɔbla ese aani kɔbuli kɔni mɔɔní kɛɛkɛ taavinku.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You get up early to start drinking, and you keep it up late into the night.
translation_verse: Na amii bani mɔɔta ɔtanta tutuutu teelie ntɛ bɔni lɛlɔ teetédu usien lɛdiba ni, Unwoti uwi úudu ka ɔkyula-mii.

english_verse: At your drinking parties you have the music of stringed instruments, tambourines, and flutes. But you never even think about all the Lord has done,
translation_verse: Biiti lɛnu lɛni mɔɔdia bunu ku ntɛ bɔbuni teesienku bina emeyi kadikɔ ku lɛbentaa ku ese ku atoloyii ku kɔkpɛɛ lidu lidu. Nsu bina kasusu kadi biala kelesie Unwoti ku nwuna ablala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and so his people know nothing about him. That's why many of you will be dragged off to foreign lands. Your leaders will starve to death, and everyone else will suffer from thirst.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ndubɔya na mina bekyuli benwini bekeline na lɛma bamba ala kalɔ tenu ɔsu. Benengu bani nnye kunyekɔ kunengudi ku babune ƒui kɔka kɔdubo-ma bɔdu. Na utukwɛ ɔdu bekyuli lisu bakladi.

english_verse: The world of the dead has opened its mouth wide and is eagerly waiting for the leaders of Jerusalem and for its noisy crowds, especially for those who take pride in that city.
translation_verse: Kaƒiɔtɔ kadaku akpu bɔta na adila abuni ani na ɔdubɔkɛ bɔsiku Yerusalem lɛlɔ ɔsu. Babune ku bekyuli keeke ƒui badubo-ma bubweli ku bana ntɛ bekpine ƒui.

english_verse: Its citizens have been put down, and its proud people have been brought to shame.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ ƒui badubo bubuli bɔkpi ɔtumu. Na bani mɔɔnu lɛlɔ katɔ katɔ ƒui beboku-ma kalɔ.

english_verse: But the holy Lord God All-Powerful is praised, because he has shown who he is by bringing justice.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti lɛnyi likeye na lɛkɔ katɔ ka ɔɔtɛ litemi siin ɔsu. Na banu kalɛ na Unwoti use kedee, na kalɛ na ɔɔbla ala siin ɔsu.

english_verse: His people will be like sheep grazing in their own pasture, and they will take off what was left by others.
translation_verse: Na kesii kani na Unwoti úbile ala mmɔ ni, mmɔ na baƒonu badubo bɔdi. Na baƒonubi ku besebi ƒui badubɔkɛ kadikɔ.

english_verse: And you say, “Let the holy God of Israel hurry up and do what he has promised, so we can see it for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Amii bani mɔɔpii Israel Unwoti Kedee bɛnini, “Babla na abla lɛla lɛdi bɔnu! Bo lɛlɔ na atina-bu lɛla lɛni na adubɔkana bɔbla.”

english_verse: You think you are clever and smart.
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ beete bekyuli bani mɔɔnu lɛlɔ banundane na baakali ka bagyi lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: And you are great at drinking and mixing drinks. But you are in for trouble.
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ beete bani na ntɛ kanikɔ na badi bayikune na ama ntulo ƒui ka baasála-mu lidu lidu taani ɔsu.

english_verse: You accept bribes to let the guilty go free, and you cheat the innocent out of a fair trial.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔbɛ́ taaƒɔ ala, na beete balalane ubo ka bekeli bana kɔtu bɔni, na baaní bekyuli babuni mmomu kɔtu ni, bɔbuɛ beete-ma.

english_verse: You will go up in flames like straw and hay! You have rejected the teaching of the holy Lord God All-Powerful of Israel. Now your roots will rot, and your blossoms will turn to dust.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bana ƒui badubo bɔkywi bɔyii udu aani kalɛ na ogya ɔɔkyula livo ku keti. Bana ligyiitu lɛdubo bubun na bana anwula awiɛ. Ɔsika bekyuli bamɛni béni Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔda bubo. Na béni banii belenu Israel Unwoti Kedee litemi.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people, but you made him terribly angry, and he struck you with his mighty arm. Mountains shook, and dead bodies covered the streets like garbage. The Lord is still angry, and he is ready to strike you again. Foreign Nations Will Attack
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na Unwoti uuti kɔnyi kpakplaa taakya nwuna bekyuli. Na ɔ́talaku kɔnu katɔ ka ɔƒiɛmi-ma ɔva kalɔ. Abi ƒui ákunku, na bani nékpi ƒui ɔlɔna uwi lilu lɛlɔ aani alakpi. Nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui útayɔ tɔ Unwoti kaƒɔ. Ɔsika ɔ́mu ɔ́tala kɔnu unye.

english_verse: The Lord has signaled for the foreign nations to come and attack you. He has already whistled, and they are coming as fast as they can.
translation_verse: Ɔ́kɔliku aƒlaga úte kadi bani na ɔgyu kakaaka. Na ɔ́vwi uƒiomu ɔ́kpali bani na kayawi kawɔlɔkɔ ƒui. Aanu-ma ka bakɛ ku usi badubo.

english_verse: Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready. The hoofs of their horses are hard as flint; the wheels of their war chariots turn as fast as a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Bana atula inye bubo ɔbi yayaaya, na báni bana kɔtaminta benye bete kekpo. Na bana bapɔnkɔ lɛgbanvuo libo ɔkplu litulo abuala na bana kɛɛkɛ kagba kuunwíni teetulo ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔkya ligede.

english_verse: They roar and growl like fierce young lions as they grab their victims and drag them off where no one can rescue them.
translation_verse: Na baakwanyi aani bagyata, na beebó adi si béƒie lɛla lɛdi, na beti-ni batɔlɔku ɔni na ukyuli ɔdi uuubo na ɔkana-ni bɔƒɔ na bana kudɔ.

english_verse: On the day they attack, they will roar like the ocean. And across the land you will see nothing but darkness and trouble, because the light of day will be covered by thick clouds.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛmmɔ ni, badubɔnwini bakya-ma, aani kalɛ na ɛpu ɔɔnwini. Na liƒlukutu suu lɛdi ku kɔnyana kɔdubɔƒɔ Israel ƒui, na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu basɔ balanu bukeye bɔdi.

english_verse: In the year that King Uzziah died, I had a vision of the Lord. He was on his throne high above, and his robe filled the temple.
translation_verse: Lɛkwa lɛni kemmo na Ɔga Usia úkpi na lɛ́nu Unwoti. Na uli lɛgaboku kangyaa lɛdi lɛlɔ. Na nwuna awu gyɔlɔɔ bonwu ɔni na ɔkya atu áƒɔ Katɔti kakpakɔ mmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Flaming creatures with six wings each were flying over him. They covered their faces with two of their wings and their bodies with two more. They used the other two wings for flying,
translation_verse: Na Katɔti batu benengudi badi muukeye na bebo avwi aku aku na baalɔ-ma Seraƒim benye bámana-nwu. Ɔdi biala avwi anyɔ ebi-nwu anumi na anyɔ ebi-nwu lɛgba asa na ɔda anyɔ akladi uuveyi.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Holy, holy, holy, Lord All-Powerful! The earth is filled with your glory.”
translation_verse: Na bana ƒui baatu kɔgya ku lɛdi linwi momoomo banini, “Unwoti Katɔti, ese kedee, kedee, kedee! Katɔ ku kalɔ kéyi ku ƒula lɛlɔyɔ tɛɛ!”

english_verse: As they shouted, the doorposts of the temple shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.
translation_verse: Na ebiti lɛnu lɛni na beedie lɛ́kunku Katɔti kakpakɔ kammɔ útéduoku kalɔ kemmo ƒui na uyɔ ɔ́ƒɔ Katɔti kakpakɔ kammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Then I cried out, “I'm doomed! Everything I say is sinful, and so are the words of everyone around me. Yet I have seen the King, the Lord All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Amu na lɛ́su nnini, “Mina bɔkywi uwi údu, ɔsika alaekpidi ɔblane na ndi na alaekpidi bablane kaba kemmo na lɛ́si, nsu mina anumi ánu Ɔga ɔni ndi Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui!”

english_verse: One of the flaming creatures flew over to me with a burning coal that it had taken from the altar with a pair of metal tongs.
translation_verse: Batu bamɛni akɔ unwi úveyi ɔ́vi lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ eli na údie lɛgyabi gaganga lɛdi ku lɛbuala lɛdi ɔ́siku ogya kemmo.

english_verse: It touched my lips with the hot coal and said, “This has touched your lips. Your sins are forgiven, and you are no longer guilty.”
translation_verse: Na úti útuku-mi enyekuli na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Nu, líti ogya lɛƒɛ lɛmɛni lítuku-ɔ enyekuli lɛlɔ. Na ɔƒɛni ni, Katɔti údie ekpidi ƒui na ƒula lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the Lord ask, “Is there anyone I can send? Will someone speak for us?” “I'll go,” I answered. “Send me!”
translation_verse: Amu na línu ka Unwoti uuye ɔnini, “Ɔma na ndubɔtala aani mina ɔtu kalɛ lɛkya mina bekyuli na ɔma ndubusie ute-bu?” Mmɔ na lɛ́su nnini, “Ami ndubo busie! Tala-mi!”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to go and speak this message to the people: “You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.” The Lord also said,
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɛɛn, awɔ sie! Tásu mina bekyuli anini, “ ‘Bɛdubunu mina etemila, nsu bɛɛɛdubo-nya kalɔ bunu. Na bɛdubɔnu ala ani mɔɔbla nsu bɛɛɛdubo-nya bɔnu bɔti na binu kalɔ.’

english_verse: “Make these people stubborn! Make them stop up their ears, cover their eyes, and fail to understand. Don't let them turn to me and be healed.”
translation_verse: Geen ni, bana kɔyi kútili na bana atu áyu ɔkplu na bana anumi lɛnɔ ábwɛ. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, nka bana anumi adubɔnu nwaa na bana atu lɛnɔ adubunu na benu kalɔ na benwini bebo-mi kudɔ na lɛbwi-ma.”

english_verse: Then I asked the Lord, “How long will this last?” The Lord answered: Until their towns are destroyed and their houses are deserted, until their fields are empty,
translation_verse: Mmɔ na líye Unwoti Katɔti nnini, “Uwi ɛlɛ kemmo na ndubuti lɛbla lɛla lɛmɛni?” Amu na údie kenye ɔnini, “Úti útédu uwi ɔni na ndubɔya na lɛma linengudi ƒui lɛbwɛ lɛyii udu, na bekyuli basɔ balakya-ni kemmo, na lɛtɔ lɛsɔ linye ukpludi, na kalɔ kemodi kammɔ ƒui kebie.

english_verse: and I have sent them far away, leaving their land in ruins.
translation_verse: Na ndubo bekyuli ƒui bɔbɔku budie kalɔ kammɔ kemmo na libile kalɔ kammɔ.

english_verse: If only a tenth of the people are left, even they will be destroyed. But just as stumps remain after trees have been cut down, some of my chosen ones will be left.
translation_verse: Na ina bekyuli bammɔ lɛkpa leevudi kani nébu ni, ama lɛnɔ ndubɔyila-ma udu. Nsu kalɛ na egyukwii eebú teenye si báda egyii báwɔlɔ ni, lɛni na mina badi bani na lɛ́ƒuna badi badubo bubu bulie kama.”

english_verse: When news reached the royal palace that Syria had joined forces with Israel, King Ahaz and everyone in Judah were so terrified that they shook like trees in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Kenye kébedu Ahas kudɔ banini, “Ɔga Resin ku Ɔga Peka bása lili na ama ku bana bekyuli báta ka bebékpo-bu.” Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔtɔtɔ ɔ́gyu Ɔga Ahas ku nwuna bekyuli na baatɔ́ kpakpaakpa aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uukpó taavi egyii akɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to me: Take your son Shearjashub and go see King Ahaz. You will find him on the road near the cloth makers' shops at the end of the canal that brings water from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su Yesaia ɔnini, “Awɔ ku ƒ'ubidi Sea-Yasub, ɔni kalɔ ndi Badi Badubo Bubu, bisie na bitásiaku Ɔga Ahas na ketu kammɔ kawɔlɔkɔ kesii kani muuduo ligyu kemmo mmɔ. Mmɔ kedenku ulu ɔni néti úsela kesii kani na baakya adi kuvo mmɔ.

english_verse: Tell Ahaz to stop worrying. There's no need for him to be afraid of King Rezin and King Pekah. They are very angry, but they are nothing more than a dying fire. Ahaz doesn't need to fear
translation_verse: Na asu-nwu anii, ‘Da kayi bukpoku ya, na utalɛka ayia Ɔga Resin ku Ɔga Peka, ku bana bekpone kɔnyi momoomo kɔni na béti. Ɔsika bese aani ogya egyukwii ani mɔɔkywí na adubo bɔsa.

english_verse: to invade and defeat Judah and Jerusalem and to let the son of Tabeel be king in his place.
translation_verse: “Bɛya na bukpoku Yuda na bɔgyingya ɔma ɔmmɔ na bule-nwu bɔkya lɛlɔ. Na bɔdubɔbwɛ buduo Yerusalem na buti Tabeel ubidi buse lɛga aani Yudaƒuɔ ɔga.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that this will never happen.
translation_verse: Nsu ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui mɔɔsu nnii, “ ‘Ulebo ulete lɛni, na balakana-mii lɛlɔ bɔdi kudii,

english_verse: Damascus is just the capital of Syria, and King Rezin rules only in Damascus. Samaria is just the capital of Israel, and King Pekah rules only in Samaria. But in less than
translation_verse: Israel ɔma unengudi ƒui ndi Samaria. Na ɔma ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔdine kani ndi Ramalia ubidi Peka. Na si eeenye mina bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo kpakplaa ni, agyi anii eeebo kenyekɔ kadi.’ ”

english_verse: “Ask me for proof that my promise will come true. Ask for something to happen deep in the world of the dead or high in the heavens above.”
translation_verse: “Vele ami Unwoti ƒula Katɔti na lɛtina-a likposela lɛdi ɔ́si kalɔ kemmo ƒui útédu katɔ kakaaka.”

english_verse: “No, Lord,” Ahaz answered. “I won't test you!”
translation_verse: Nsu Ahas úbulo na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Oowo, lɛɛɛdubo mina Unwoti bɔkɔku bɔnu.”

english_verse: Then I said: Listen, every one of you in the royal family of David. You have already tried my patience. Now you are trying God's patience by refusing to ask for proof.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesaia ɔ́su ɔnini, “Binu kaduɛ, amii Dawid kaba bebi! Kalɛ na biléte bekyuli lɛlɔ buwi útabɔ? Ɔlɛka biti ɔmɛni bɛlɛku Katɔti lɛnɔ?

english_verse: But the Lord will still give you proof. A virgin is pregnant; she will have a son and will name him Immanuel.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, Unwoti ɔlati ɔdubute-mii likposela lɛdi. Bɛnu! Adagyaa ɔdi ɔdubɔda kaƒɔ na ɔwɔ ubi ɔnanabi. Na badubɔlɔ-nwu banii Imanuel.

english_verse: Even before the boy is old enough to know how to choose between right and wrong, he will eat yogurt and honey, and the countries of the two kings you fear will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nsu asa na ɔdubɔti likpidi ku lɛbuni kavumana ni, baga inyɔ bani na aayia geen na badi Israel ku Aram baga mmɔ béekpi bábavi.

english_verse: But the Lord will make more trouble for your people and your kingdom than any of you have known since Israel broke away from Judah. He will even bring the king of Assyria to attack you. The Threat of an Invasion
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubɔya na uwi kpakplaa ɔni nétebo tɔ dii ɔ́si uwi ɔni na béle Salomo lɛga kadikɔ na kénwini Yuda ku Israel ubasiaku-mii, awɔ ku ƒula kadi bekyuli ku ƒula ɔtɔ kemmo bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ, na ɔya na Asiria ɔga ubo ubekpoku-mii.”

english_verse: When that time comes, the Lord will whistle, and armies will come from Egypt like flies and from Assyria like bees.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔvwi lise ɔkpali bekpone ɔkya-mii, na bana bumomo bɔdubɔbla aani baalɔlɔ ku banwɛnwɛ ɔsiku Egyipte ntukpa ɔvi na katɔ kakɛ ƒui ku Asiria kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They will settle everywhere—in the deep valleys and between the rocks, on every thornbush and all over the pastureland.
translation_verse: Badububo na babaƒɔ bina awɛ ƒui kemmo ku atakpɛ libu ku ana kɔka ƒui kemmo ku liyu akunkpo ku abiɔ ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord will pay the king of Assyria to bring a razor from across the Euphrates River and shave your head and every hair on your body, including your beard.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na Asiria ɔga ku anwu badi bekpeyi-mii eli ku bina lɛlɔ linwini ku bina likwi lɛnɔ na bakya-mii kɔƒa.

english_verse: Anyone who is able to save only one young cow and two sheep,
translation_verse: Na bebuo bani na badubuƒie bebu akɔ ni, ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔkɔdi ku koƒonu kɔkɔdi ku ese ɔkɔdi unwi unwi ɔdubo bubu kaduli biala.

english_verse: will have enough milk to make yogurt. In fact, everyone left in the land will eat yogurt and honey.
translation_verse: Na lɛnyi ntu pii lɛni na bebuo bammɔ badubo butaayu ɔsu ni, nkyuli ɛlɛɛ bani ndubo bubu mmɔ badubɔkɛ lɛnyi ntu pii na udu-ma bɔni.

english_verse: You will go there to hunt with your bow and arrows, because the whole country will be covered with thornbushes.
translation_verse: Na bina atula ku kɔtaminta na bɛdubuteeti teesie taatábui na mmɔ ka mmɔ kasɔ kaaadia bɔtuma ɔsu.

english_verse: The hills where you once planted crops will be overgrown with thorns and thistles. You will be afraid to go there, and your cattle, sheep, and goats will be turned loose on those hills.
translation_verse: Kalɔ kani na nka bɛ́kya-ka anwami bɛ́tuma dii ni, kadubunwini liyu yayaaya aku ani nsɔ naaadubo bɔdia bɔmɛnɛ buduo na bɛtuma. Mmomu ɔdubunwini kesii kani na bina bebuo badubuteesie taatávi taawia bana alakpi ani na bakun.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Isaiah, get something to write on. Then write in big clear letters the name, MAHER-SHALAL-HASH-BAZ.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔdi kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ti ebuo ɔku kakunkɛ na eti unwenigyii na enweni lɛnyi lɛni kalɔ ndi Békpo-ma Béƒie-ma Ala Báƒɔ asia-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will tell Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah to serve as witnesses to this.”
translation_verse: Na ndubɔlɔ ɔkpane Uria ku Yeberekia ubidi ɔnanabi ɔni baalɔ Sakaria bani muudie-mi litemi kenye ulu lɛlɔ geen na bebo.”

english_verse: Sometime later, my wife and I had a son, and the Lord said, “Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.
translation_verse: Amu na lísie mina uleku kudɔ na ɔ́da kaƒɔ na úbawɔ ɔnanabi. Na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Sia-nwu lɛnyi anii Békpo-ma Béƒie-ma Ala Báƒɔ.

english_verse: Because before he can say ‘Mommy’ or ‘Daddy,’ the king of Assyria will attack and take everything of value from Damascus and Samaria.”
translation_verse: Na asa na ubi ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔti bɔsu ɔnii, ‘Mina Ati’ iye ‘Nna’ ni, Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga úuti Damasko lɛlakɛ ku ala ani na ɔdubuƒie ɔƒɔ na Samaria ɔ́tɔlɔku uwi ɔmmɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-mi na uwi bamba ɔdi ɔnini,

english_verse: These people have refused the gentle waters of Shiloah and have gladly gone over to the side of King Rezin and King Pekah.
translation_verse: “Ka kadi kamɛni béni kalɛ na nda-ma aani Siloa Ketu kani mɔɔgbá buɛɛ, na Resin lɛlɔ mɔɔyɔ́-ma kaƒɔ mmomu ku Remalia ubidi ɔnanabi ɔsu ni,

english_verse: Now I will send the king of Assyria against them with his powerful army, which will attack like the mighty Euphrates River overflowing its banks.
translation_verse: Ami bana Unwoti Katɔti ndubɔya na Asiria ɔga ku nwuna bekpone balɛ na bana limomo ku ɔyikun kemmo bebo aani Euƒrate Ketu kani néyi ku atu, na kagbala-ma kavia utubli ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers will cover Judah like a flood reaching up to your neck. But God is with us. He will spread his wings and protect our land.
translation_verse: Na kadubɔgbala ala laa ketédu Yuda, na kabuala kavi na keyi kadanku-ma amɔ. Na kana avwi ani na úgyingya adubo bɔbɛbɛ bubi ƒula kalɔ kammɔ ƒui, O Imanuel!”

english_verse: All of you foreign nations, go ahead and prepare for war, but you will be crushed.
translation_verse: Bibo kekpo kudu amii kadi bekyuli, na bibile ala kalɛ na bɛkana na bɛdubo bɔyii udu! Binu amii ɔlɔgyu kadi ƒui bekyuli. Bɛklibi lɛlɔ bite kekpo, nsu bɛdubo bukpi!

english_verse: Get together and make plans, but you will fail because God is with us.
translation_verse: Bisie kelisa na bɛkya bina kekpo kɔkwɛ ƒui, na bɛtaa kasiakɔ biala bite lɛlɔ, nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui ɔdubɔbla keeke, ɔsika Unwoti Katɔti ulieku-bu. Bɛyia Katɔti

english_verse: The Lord took hold of me with his powerful hand and said: I'm warning you! Don't act like these people.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔyikun ɔ́ƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo na ɔ́su-mi kpakplaa ka ntasiaku bekyuli bɔmmɔ ɔbladu kama ɔnini,

english_verse: Don't call something a rebellious plot, just because they do, and don't be afraid of something, just because they are.
translation_verse: “Lɛla lɛni na badubɔlɔ kelisa kekpidi ni, tasiaku-ma anii kelisa kekpidi kadi. Na uwi ɔni badubɔlɔ unwi bɔbla kasala ni, tenuku-ma kalɔ na asiaku-ma lɛni. Tayia lɛla lɛni na baayia, na liƒu lɛnɔ litada-a.

english_verse: I am the one you should fear and respect. I am the holy God, the Lord All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ndi ukyuli ɔni kani na ɔdi ka anu ka use kedee, na anwu kani na ɔdi ka ayia, na nwuna lɛlɔ liƒu lɛkya-a kemmo,

english_verse: My message and my teachings are to be sealed and given to my followers.
translation_verse: Kono bunyimi ku ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ na abala-mu kenye ku kɔma ese mina basiakune.

english_verse: Meanwhile, I patiently trust the Lord, even though he is no longer pleased with Israel.
translation_verse: Ndubunye ntaanu mina Unwoti anumi, ɔni nábɛla nwuna anumi ɔ́siku Yakob kaduli bebi kudɔ. Ndubuti mina anu ƒui lɛsia Katɔti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My children and I are warning signs to Israel from the Lord All-Powerful, who lives on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Aanu ami ku bebi bani na Unwoti úti úte-mi. Abu ndi bɔnu bɔti ku likposela na Israel bani nási Unwoti Ɔyikune ɔni nli Sion Kɔbi lɛlɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: Someone may say to you, “Go to the fortunetellers who make soft chirping sounds or ask the spirits of the dead. After all, a nation ought to be able to ask its own gods
translation_verse: Si bekyuli baasu-mii banii bitébo like na biye bekpine ku ayu ani mɔɔtɛmi kabɛnsɛ na baatɛmi linwubwɛ ala binu ni, ɔɔɔdi Katɔti mmomu na biye ala kalɔ binu? Bi ɔsu na bekpine na biiye ala binu bɛsiku bayawine lɛlɔ?

english_verse: what it should do.” None of those who talk like that will live to see the light of day!
translation_verse: Bɛnu bɛti ka si bana ala aaakɛnku mina litemi lɛni ndanku ɔda bubo ku bunyimi bɔmɛni ni, na bukeye bɔdi buuubo-ma kemmo.

english_verse: They will go around in great pain and will become so hungry that they will angrily curse their king and their gods. And when they try to find help in heaven
translation_verse: Ala adubo-ma bukpoku na kɔka lɛnɔ kutaada-ma na bakɛ bataavi kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na si kɔka kɔmmɔ kútulo-ma ni, badubo kɔnyi buti geen na bataanu katɔ teewida bana ɔga ku bana Katɔti.

english_verse: and on earth, they will find only trouble and darkness, terrible trouble and deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Na si báyula anumi kalɔ lɛnɔ ni, lɛƒɛda lɛmmɔ kani na badubo bɔnu na ɔbla-ma suu na liƒu geen lɛƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui na basɔ bakya lɛdisa suu lɛmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: But those who have suffered will no longer be in pain. The territories of Zebulun and Naphtali in Galilee were once hated. But this land of the Gentiles across the Jordan River and along the Mediterranean Sea will be greatly respected. War Is Over
translation_verse: Nsu kalɛ na báyila lɛnunsia na beli lɛdisa kemmo mmɔ ni, ulése lɛni uwi ƒui. Uwi ɔni návi ni, bátabu Sebulon ku Naƒtali bátakya lɛla lɛdi kemmo. Nsu uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ɔni na Katɔti ɔdubuti bukeye ute kadi bamba bekyuli bani nlie Galilea na Yordan Ketu ulu lɛlɔ úti útédu ɛpu kɔtu.

english_verse: Those who walked in the dark have seen a bright light. And it shines upon everyone who lives in the land of darkest shadows.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani na nka beli baabla ala na lɛdisa kemmo badubɔnu bukeye. Na bani na belie kukpi ɔgbankpi kemmo ni, Katɔti bukeye bɔdubuwi-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have made your nation stronger. Because of you, its people are glad and celebrate like workers at harvest time or like soldiers dividing up what they have taken.
translation_verse: Na Israel kadi badubɔsɔ balɛ lili na baƒɔ lɛnyi na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-ma aani kalɛ na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ bekyuli si báƒɛ edula awɔdi. Na badubo kudu bubo geen ku lɛlɔyɔ aani bekpone muule ala ani na béƒie báƒɔ bana bekisine kudɔ.

english_verse: You have broken the power of those who abused and enslaved your people. You have rescued them just as you saved your people from Midian.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛbibo ku ukyuli kalala bɔbla bɔni nénwini lɛbibo kɔgba na kɔda ƒula bekyuli ni, adubo-ku bɔƒɛ ƒui, aani kalɛ na áyila Midianƒuɔ bekpone udu ƒui.

english_verse: The boots of marching warriors and the blood-stained uniforms have been fed to flames and eaten by fire. A Child Has Been Born
translation_verse: Na bekpone adala ku agbanvuo ani nákpi ubugya na kekpo ni, ala ammɔ bene ƒui adubunwini ala ani na badubo ogya bɔkya.

english_verse: A child has been born for us. We have been given a son who will be our ruler. His names will be Wonderful Advisor and Mighty God, Eternal Father and Prince of Peace.
translation_verse: Ɔsika báwɔ ubi ɔnanabi béte-bu. Na bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ bɔdi lɛdubɔsia-nwu lɛlɔ. Na badubɔlɔ-nwu banii Kasusu Buni Ɔkyane ku Katɔti Ɔyikune ku Ati Ɔni Nli Uwi Ƒui ku Keyi Buɛɛ Ɔga Ubi.

english_verse: His power will never end; peace will last forever. He will rule David's kingdom and make it grow strong. He will always rule with honesty and justice. The Lord All-Powerful will make certain that all of this is done. God Will Punish Israel
translation_verse: Na nwuna lɛga kadikɔ kadubo katɔ butaakɔ ku keyi buɛɛ, na kaaadubo ulu bɔwɔ kudii. Na ɔdubulie Dawid lɛgaboku lɛlɔ utaadi lɛga lɛmmɔ, na nwuna lɛgadi lɛdubunye uwi ƒui. Na ɔdubɔtɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ, na nwuna ablala ƒui adubuse siin. Na Katɔti ɔdubɔya na ɔmɛni ubo-nwu kemmo ɔkɛnku nwuna ɔyikun lɛlɔ!

english_verse: The Lord had warned the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdanku linyesia kpakplaa ute Yakob kaduli bekyuli, na lɛla lɛmmɔ lɛdubo Israel lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and all of them knew it, including everyone in the capital city of Samaria. But they were proud and stubborn and said,
translation_verse: Na bekyuli ƒui badubo-ni bɔnu bɔti, Eƒraim ku Samaria kalɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli ƒui. Ama mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na baakɔliku lɛkɔ katɔ taasu banii,

english_verse: He sent the Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they swallowed up Israel. But even this did not stop him from being angry, so he kept on punishing them.
translation_verse: Na Siriaƒuɔ badubɔsi ɔƒɛ katukɔ, na Ƒilistiƒuɔ basi ɔƒɛ kanukɔ na bebebweli-ma aani eƒiebuo kalɛ. Nsu ina ɔmmɔ ƒui ni, Unwoti kɔnyi kútayɔ tɔ, mmomu ɔ́mu únene kɔnu unye ka ɔƒiɛmi-ma.

english_verse: The people of Israel still did not turn back to the Lord All-Powerful and worship him.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bamɛni belenu kalɔ ka benwini bebo ukyuli ɔni mɔɔní-ma kɔtu kudɔ, bana Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui kudɔ.

english_verse: In one day he cut off their head and tail, their leaves and branches.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu limeyi linwi kani na Unwoti ɔdubɔyila Israel kadi bekyuli udu ɔ́si lili útédu lɛgba, aani kalɛ baamɛnɛ kubo kɔɔƒɛkɛ ku livo alakpi ƒui teewi kalɔ limeyi linwi.

english_verse: Their rulers and leaders were the head, and the lying prophets were the tail.
translation_verse: Ɔma benengu ku batɔnkune ndi lili. Na ɔkɔ kenye bediene ndi lɛgba lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: They had led the nation down the wrong path, and the people were confused.
translation_verse: Batɔnkune bamɛni baatɔnku-ma taatáyila, na bani batɔnku mmɔ lɛnɔ baayii ulu.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with his people and kept punishing them, because they had turned against him. They were evil and spoke foolishly. That's why he did not have pity on their young people or on their widows and orphans.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na lɛlɔ lilayɔ Unwoti Katɔti na bana bakɔdi lɛlɔ munu munu, na bekpinebi ku bekpinele basɔ baládu-nwu kaƒɔ, ɔsika bana ƒui basɔ balábla Unwoti lɛyɔla, na baabla kalala na baanyi ɔkɔ. Nsu ina ɔmmɔ ƒui Unwoti kɔnyi kútayɔ tɔ, mmomu ɔ́mu únene kɔnu unye ka ɔƒiɛmi-ma.

english_verse: Evil had spread like a raging forest fire sending thornbushes up in smoke.
translation_verse: Geen ni, kalala bɔbla buse aani lɛku kemmo ogya. Ɔɔkyula liyu ku alakpi bamba, na lɛku limodi lɛmmɔ lɛɛkywí, na uudie uyɔ litigbli taakɔliku kayaa.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful was angry and used the people as fuel for a fire that scorched the land. They turned against each other
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui kɔnyi kpakplaa ɔsu ni, kalɔ kammɔ kadubɔkula lɛlɔ geen, na bekyuli bénwini ekyweni bete ogya ɔmmɔ, na ɔkpanadi kɔnyana bɔnu buuubo.

english_verse: like wild animals attacking and eating everyone around them, even their own relatives. But still they were not satisfied.
translation_verse: Benye kesi kesii beemú taadi, nsu belemo na kɔka kɔsa. Ama alati bebi na badubo bɔkun ɔƒɛni amu.

english_verse: The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh turned against each other, then joined forces to attack Judah. But the Lord was still angry and ready to punish the nation even more.
translation_verse: Manase ɔdubo Eƒraim badi bɔkun, na Eƒraim ɔ́kun Manase badi aani beƒiebuo kalɛ. Na bana inyɔ benwini benye Yuda lɛlɔ. Nsu ina ɔmmɔ ƒui Unwoti kɔnyi kútayɔ tɔ, mmomu ɔ́mu únene kɔnu unye ka ɔƒiɛmi-ma.

english_verse: You people are in for trouble! You have made cruel and unfair laws
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ beete bekyuli, ama bani muunyimi ɔda bubo bukpidi kalɛ na bataanya bekyuli taakya.

english_verse: that let you cheat the poor and needy and rob widows and orphans.
translation_verse: Na balátɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ teete bawabane ku bekpinele ku bekpinebi kalɛ kɔnu kutuku-ma bana ala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But what will you do when you are fiercely attacked and punished by foreigners? Where will you run for help? Where will you hide your valuables?
translation_verse: Bi na bɛdubo bɔbla ɔgbankpi uwi, uwi ɔni na ndubɔya na ɔsi kalɔ kakaaka ubo ubalɛ-mii lɛlɔ? Ɔma na bɛdubo bukeli bɔtamiku? Na ɔma na bɛdubo bina akɛla bɔda buse?

english_verse: How will you escape being captured or killed? The Lord is still angry, and he isn't through with you yet! The Lord's Purpose and the King of Assyria
translation_verse: Badubɔni-mii batɔlɔku na abuli kemmo ku bekyuli beƒiedi bakladi na biiibo lɛla lɛdi bɔbla, iye badu-mii bebunku bani na báadu béwi. Nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui Katɔti kɔnyi kɔɔɔdubo-nwu bɔyɔ tɔ. Katɔti Ɔ́tɛku Asiriaƒuɔ Litemi

english_verse: The Lord says: I am furious! And I will use the king of Assyria as a club
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ beete Asiria, mina ugyii ɔni nda ku kɔnyi. Bana enu kemmo na mina kɔnyi ligyiiku lɛkya!

english_verse: to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔtala-ma ka betékpoku mina bekyuli bani naaadi mina etemila lɛlɔ. Lídie-ma ulu nnii betékpo mina kadi bekyuli, bekyuli bani mɔɔkya-mi kɔnyi, na beƒie-ma ala baƒɔ na besusu-ma kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: The king of Assyria says: My army commanders are kings!
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na Asiria ɔga ɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ ɔnini, ‘Mina kekpo batɔnkune ƒui badi baga.

english_verse: They have already captured the cities of Calno, Carchemish, Hamath, Arpad, Samaria, and Damascus.
translation_verse: Na bádi Kalno ɔma lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na bádi Karkemis ku Hamat ku Arpad ku Samaria ku Damasko lɛnɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: who says: I did these things by my own power because I am smart and clever. I attacked kings like a wild bull, and I took the land and the treasures of their nations.
translation_verse: Ɔɔtina lɛlɔ ku enyekpi taasu ɔnini, “ ‘Ami ɔlati mina ɔyikun ku lɛlati ku lɛnunda kemmo na líkpo bekyuli bamɛni na lɛ́di-ma lɛlɔ na líƒie kɔlɔ pii ku bana akɛla lɛ́ƒɔ na lɛ́di baga bammɔ lɛlɔ na lɛ́yila-ma udu ƒui.

english_verse: King of Assyria, can an ax or a saw overpower the one who uses it? Can a wooden pole lift whoever holds it?
translation_verse: Bɔkana na kadadi kadubɔkana lɛlɔ katɔ bɔkɔli butulo ukyuli ɔni nda-ka? Munuu lɛbuala lɛni bada baabwɛ kugyii ndubɔkana kayi butu bɔkya ukyuli ɔni nda-nwu? Aani si lɛbuala mɔɔgyú ukyuli teeƒwimi iye ligyiiku mɔɔda ukyuli taaƒiɛmi lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, ɔdubɔya na ɔlɛ kpakplaa ubo Asiria ɔga ku nwuna bekpone bani mɔɔtina lɛlɔ lɛlɔ, na bana ɔlɔna kemmo keteenu ɔlɛ aani ogya mɔɔkyula-ma.

english_verse: The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔni ndi Israel bukeye ɔdubunwini ogya na udie ogya unyemi na ɔkyula-ma limeyi linwi pɛ na bakywi aani liyu ku alakpigya kalɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will make your beautiful forests and fertile fields slowly rot.
translation_verse: Na bana akumiɔ ani nábi ku kɔlɔ kɔni nélie lɛmwi mmɔ ƒui ndubo-ku bɔkyula na kɔyii udu aani kalɛ na ɔlɛne uuƒi taayii udu.

english_verse: There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them. Only a Few Will Come Back
translation_verse: Na egyii alɛɛ geen ndubo bubu na ɔnamu blii muedi adubɔka-nya! Israelƒuɔ Ɛlɛɛ Badi Badubo Bubu

english_verse: A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Israelƒuɔ ɛlɛɛ bani mebu na badi Yakob kaba kemmo bebi ni, basɔ beleti bana anu balasia bekyuli bani nékpo-ma na bádi-ma lɛlɔ banii ama ndubo-ma bubunku. Mmomu Unwoti Israel Katɔti Kedee na badubuti bana kayi ƒui basia.

english_verse: There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: O Israel, ina ka bina kadi bekyuli bemomo aani ɛpu kɔnwinimi muedi ni, bina ɛlɛɛ kani ndubunwini bibo kama. Katɔti ɔ́lɛ ugyii na nwuna ulu siin lɛlɔ úse ka ɔkyula-mii na ɔyila-mii udu.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised that everyone on this earth will be punished.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔni ndi Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔdubo kalɔ kammɔ ƒui kɔtu kɔmɛni bɔni sɔsɔ.

english_verse: Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem: The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu binu lɛla lɛni na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔmmɔ ɔ́su, “Mina kadi bekyuli bani nkya Yerusalem, bise kayi na bitayia Asiriaƒuɔ si beekpóku-mii na baanya-mii taakya aani kalɛ kani na Egyipte kadi bekyuli bábla kuuku dii bábavi.

english_verse: Soon I will stop being angry with you, and I will punish them for their crimes.
translation_verse: Bana bukpoku bɔmmɔ buletu uwi. Na uwi klukwii kemmo ni, kɔnyi kɔni na líti lɛ́kya-mii kɔdubo-mi bɔyɔ na bana lɛlɔ mmomu na kɔnyi kɔdubo-mi bɔkɔ kalɛ na lɛkyula-ma.”

english_verse: I will beat the Assyrians with a whip, as I did the people of Midian near the rock at Oreb. And I will show the same mighty power that I used when I made a path through the sea in Egypt.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔdubo-ma bubo bɔƒiɛmi kalɔ na ebola eduo-ma lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na ɔkɛnku Gideon lɛlɔ, na ɔ́di Midian kadi bekyuli lɛlɔ na kesii kani baalɔ banii Oreb lɛtakpɛ. Iye uwi ɔni na Mose ɔ́talaku Unwoti ugyii katɔ na ɛpu úle ntɛ na ɔ́nyina Egyipteƒuɔ bekpone bammɔ ƒui na ntu kemmo.

english_verse: Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na kalɛ na nwuna kadi bekyuli bakya bekyuli bamba kalɔ baabla-ma kabla ɔdubɔwɔ. Na ɔƒɛ bana lɛlɔ bɔdi kɔgba kɔni nda-mii amɔ ku amangba udie-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Enemy troops have reached the town of Aiath. They have gone through Migron, and they stored their supplies at Michmash,
translation_verse: Bɛnu! Báasi bébedu Aiat ɔma, na básia bálɛ Migron ɔma kemmo. Na baaklibi bana ala buse na Mikmas.

english_verse: before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away.
translation_verse: Bávia ketu na utukwalɛ bonwu ɔdi, na bátáƒɔ lɛlɔ bátɛ Geba ɔma kemmo. Na liƒu lɛ́ya na lɛlɔ lɛɛtɔ́ Rama ɔma bekyuli. Na Saul ɔma Gibea kadi bekyuli beekeli ka baƒɔ bana lili ngba.

english_verse: Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth.
translation_verse: Amii Galim ɔma bekyuli, bibo kɔnu kenye! Na amii Laisa ɔma bekyuli, binu kudu kɔni nda O Anatos ɔma bekyuli, bíduo kɔnyana.

english_verse: No one is left in Madmenah or Gebim.
translation_verse: Madmena ɔma bekyuli bakɛ usi baawia kabɛkɔ. Na Gebim kadi bekyuli bábɛ beeduo ala kalɔ.

english_verse: Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɔmwi ni, bekisine bammɔ badubɔƒɔ lɛlɔ bakya Nob ɔma na bataadu anyi teekene lɛvu taayila Sion teemene kɔbi kɔmmɔ na Yerusalem.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful will use his fearsome might to bring down the tallest trees and chop off every branch.
translation_verse: Nsu bɛnu! Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔdubo kugyii bonwu ku kuna kɔgba bonwu bɔmɛnɛ buwi kalɔ ku nwuna ɔyikun bonwu. Egyii enengudi ani nákuku mmɔ na ɔdubo bɔƒɛ na uboku-nya kalɔ.

english_verse: With an ax, the glorious Lord will destroy every tree in the forests of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Ɔdubɔda lɛkumiɔ egyii ammɔ ku kadadi. Na Lebanon egyii mmɔ ewi kalɔ na nwuna anumi na ayii udu.

english_verse: Like a branch that sprouts from a stump, someone from David's family will someday be king.
translation_verse: Yese kaba kemmo ligyukui lɛdi lɛdubɔta, na nwuna ugyitu ɔdubudie kagba na kanwu ebi.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord will be with him to give him understanding, wisdom, and insight. He will be powerful, and he will know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔdubɔƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui, kɔyu kɔni ndanku lɛnunda ku ala kalɔ bunu kakwɛ ku ɔyikun ku lɛlati ku Katɔti bɔyia.

english_verse: His greatest joy will be to obey the Lord. This king won't judge by appearances or listen to rumors.
translation_verse: Nwuna lɛƒɔyɔ ndi ka bekyuli ƒui beti ɔbu ku bɔyia bete Unwoti. Na ɔɔɔdubo anumi bɔnu bɔtɛ litemi, iye unu bekyuli litemi ɔtɛ lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will be treated with fairness and with justice. His word will be law everywhere in the land, and criminals will be put to death.
translation_verse: Mmomu ɔdubɔtɛ litemi siin bute bawabane na ukulo litemi kemmo ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ute kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ bawabane. Nwuna kenye litemi na ɔdubuti ɔni bekyuli kɔtu aani lɛbuala na ɔyila-ma udu.

english_verse: Leopards will lie down with young goats, and wolves will rest with lambs. Calves and lions will eat together and be cared for by little children.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, kegidi ku koƒonu badubɔtɛ liku linwi, na ebuoƒuala ku ese besie bavi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. Na ɔmantɛ bakɔ bebi ku bebuo bamba bani bebi nétedu tɔ lɛkwa linwi badubusie bavi bagyata ntɛ. Na ɔnamu blii kani ndubɔtɔnku bana ƒui.

english_verse: Cows and bears will share the same pasture; their young will rest side by side. Lions and oxen will both eat straw.
translation_verse: Na ɔmantɛ bakɔ bebi badubɔdi na begidi akɔ, na bebuo inyɔ bammɔ batɛ liku linwi basala, na gyata ɔkun livo aani ɔmantɛ akɔ kalɛ.

english_verse: Little children will play near snake holes. They will stick their hands into dens of poisonous snakes and never be hurt.
translation_verse: Ubiwɔ ɔni na anyi ntu amu akya-nwu akpu ɔdubɔƒia na balakpi bani mbo ugyulo ukpidi libu kenye, na ɔkya-ma kɔnu libu, nsu lɛla lɛdi lilabla-nwu.

english_verse: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord. God's People Will Come Back Home
translation_verse: Ɔdi ɔsɔ ulabla ɔkpanadi kalala, na basɔ baládu lɛlɔ lɛnɔ na mina kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ na Sion mmɔ, ɔsika kayawi bekyuli badubɔƒɔ-mi na bati ami bana Unwoti geen aani kalɛ na ntu bɔɔƒɔ́ ɛpu kemmo tɛtɛɛtɛ.

english_verse: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Yese kugyii ugyiitu ɔdubɔlɛ unye aani ngba bɔƒɔ aƒlaga ute kayawi bekyuli ƒui. Na kadi ƒui bekyuli badubukeli bebo-nwu kudɔ na kesii kani na uli, ɔsika mmɔ kadubɔbla kesii kani muukeye na bekyuli baakɛ́ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni na limeyi lɛni na Unwoti ɔlati úse úse lɛlɔ ni, ɔdubɔsɔ ɔkɔliku aƒlaga katɔ ute-ma na ɔsɔku nwuna kadi nkyuli ɛlɛɛ bani mebu ubasala ɔsiku Asiria ku Egyipte ku Patros ku Elam lɛnɔ.

english_verse: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.
translation_verse: Ɔdubo bunyene aƒlaga ɔdi ute kadi ƒui bekyuli, na ɔkpanku Israel kadi bekyuli bani na béƒie bésienku kɔlɔ bamba ku Yudaƒuɔ bani na bégyingya bakya ƒui ɔsiku kayawi lɛƒɛnyi ine bɔmmɔ ƒui ubasala.

english_verse: Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel.
translation_verse: Eƒraim ɔsɔ ulékpo kogyulo, na bekisine Yudaƒuɔ bukpoku kenye kadubo buklo. Na Yuda kadi bekyuli lɛnɔ basɔ belékpoku Eƒraim.

english_verse: Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.
translation_verse: Mmomu badubɔsala lɛlɔ na babwɛ bayu Ƒilistiƒuɔ besie ɔƒɛ kanukɔ. Na basi mmɔ betékpoku kadi kani bekyuli nkya bésie ɔƒɛ katukɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na Ɛpugyie kaviakɔ kani nédie utukwalɛ aani lɛba mmɔ kakwii. Na ɔtalaku nwuna kɔnu ɔsia Euƒrate Ketu na utiku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔkula ala na ukpo ɔvi-ka anumi na ule-ka ɔbla ntukpa wɛlɛ wɛlɛ maatɛ na ɔdia bɔvia ku lɛgba.

english_verse: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na ulu bɛbɛɛbɛ ɔdi ɔsia mmɔ ɔvi ute nwuna kadi bekyuli bani na bébu bakya Asiria, aani kalɛ na ɔ́bla úte-ma uwi ɔni na bávi baalɛ́ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “I thank you, Lord! You were angry with me, but you stopped being angry and gave me comfort.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, bɛdubo ɔnu budie bɛnini, “Bemwi-ɔ, O Unwoti! Ina ka éti kɔnyi ákya-bu ni, kɔnyi kɔmmɔ kɔ́yɔ-ɔ na ásɔ énwini aayala-bu kaƒɔ mmomu.

english_verse: I trust you to save me, Lord God, and I won't be afraid. My power and my strength come from you, and you have saved me.”
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ geen na ɔdi ka Unwoti úbo ɔnii ubaƒɔ-mi ngba. Ndubuti mina anu ƒui bɔsia-nwu lɛlɔ na lɛɛɛdubo bɔyia. Unwoti Katɔti ndi ukyuli ɔni mɔɔkya-mi ɔyikun, na anwu ndi ɔnu ɔni ndubɔkya-mi kenye uwi ƒui ka anwu ndi-mi ngba bɔƒɔ.”

english_verse: With great joy, you people will get water from the well of victory.
translation_verse: Ebiti kemmo na bɛdubo ntu budu bɔni bɔsiku ngba bɔƒɔ libiɔ lɛmɛni kemmo.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “Our Lord, we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, bɛdubɔsu bɛnii, “Bimwi Unwoti lɛnyi na bɛkpali-nwu lɛnyi bivele ala. Na bibo nwuna ala ebendi ani na ɔ́bla kudu bite kadi ƒui, na bati ka Unwoti lɛnyi lɛ́kɔ katɔ katɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Bidie ɔnu bimwi Unwoti, ɔsika ɔ́bla ala ebendi ani muukeye. Bɛya na kayawi bekyuli ƒui bati kalɛ na biimwi-nwu.

english_verse: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.
translation_verse: Amii bani nkya Sion ƒui bidie ɔnu ku kudu momoomo, ɔsika Israel Unwoti Kedee úbomo na bina akɔ.”

english_verse: This is the message that I was given about Babylon:
translation_verse: Amos ubidi Yesaia ɔ́nu budie taatina bɔdi na Babel kalɔ bɔkyula lɛlɔ.

english_verse: From high on a barren hill give a signal, shout the orders, and point the way to enter the gates of Babylon's proud rulers.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Tálɛ aƒlaga ɔdi na kɔbi goolo kɔdi ɔtantɛ kesii kani badubɔnu-nwaa, na akpali-ma emene momoomo na ebo-ma kɔnu anii bavi ɔma ɔban ɔmmɔ kenye na beduo bayikune bammɔ lɛlɔ na mmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has commanded his very best warriors and his proud heroes to show how angry he is.
translation_verse: Ami nébo ɔda líte bani na lɛ́ƒuna líse sɛsɛɛ, bekpone bani lɛ́tala ka babla mina kɔnyi kabla, ama ndi bekyuli bani mɔɔyɔ́ ka bakɔliku-mi katɔ.

english_verse: Listen to the noisy crowds on the mountains! Kingdoms and nations are joining forces. The Lord All-Powerful is bringing together an army for battle.
translation_verse: “Binu kɔku kɔni nda na abi lɛlɔ aani bekyuli lisu bonwu lɛdi! Na binu kalɛ na kadi ƒui bekyuli lɛga kɔdikɔ bála lɛlɔ bébo baasála na beedie adi. Kadi bekyuli ƒui Unwoti mɔɔsála-ma ka bebo babasala babla bekpone lisu linwi.

english_verse: From a distant land the Lord is coming fierce and furious— he brings his weapons to destroy the whole earth.
translation_verse: Bási ɔgyu bun bun nsu badi Unwoti ekpola, na badanku nwuna kɔnyi kɔni na ɔdubuti ɔkyula kalɔ kana ƒui.

english_verse: Cry and weep! The day is coming when the mighty Lord will bring destruction. *
translation_verse: “Biwulo momoomo ku kɔnyana, ɔsika Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui limeyi lɛni na ɔdubo bekyuli bɔkyula lɛsia ulu líibo líbedu suɛlɛ suɛlɛ.

english_verse: All people will be terrified. Hands will grow limp; courage will melt away.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu enu adubɔƒɛ ukyuli biala na ɔtɔtɔ buɛ ɔ́gyu bana ƒui

english_verse: Everyone will tremble with pain like a woman giving birth; they will stare at each other with horror on their faces. There Will Be No Mercy
translation_verse: na liƒu bonwu lɛdubuƒie-ma. Ɔsika badubuduo kɔnyana ku ɔlɛ bunu kemmo aani uleku ɔni ntɛ kɔwɔ uukpóku lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubɔbwɛ ogya uwi-ma anumi, na bana ƒui benye bataanu lɛlɔ kalɛ kadi.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will show no mercy or pity when that time comes. In my anger I will destroy the earth and every sinner who lives on it.
translation_verse: “Bɛnu! Unwoti limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛsia ulu, nwuna kɔnyi limeyi likpidi lɛmmɔ ku ɔdu kati kati ka ubakyula kayawi ku kana alaekpidi bablane bammɔ ɔni na kalɔ kammɔ kasɔ kalabla keliekɔ kabuni.

english_verse: Light will disappear from the stars in the sky; the dawning sun will turn dark, and the moon will lose its brightness.
translation_verse: Na kayaa ayabi lidu ƒui asɔ elekeye. Na ɔƒɛ ɔni nátu ɔdubo lɛnɔ adubɔbla suu. Lɛni kani na kɔbuli lɛnɔ kɔsɔ kɔɔɔdubo bukeye.

english_verse: I will punish this evil world and its people because of their sins. I will crush the horrible pride of those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Ndubɔni bayawine kɔtu na bana likyulikpi ɔsu, na lɛni balalane kɔtu na bana ekpidi ɔsu. Na bani mɔɔnu lɛlɔ katɔ katɔ ni, ndubɔya na bana lɛla tabu kenye kekulo, na liboku bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: Survivors will be harder to find than the purest gold.
translation_verse: Ndubɔya na bekyuli basa na kebu ɛlɛɛ geen utulo kalɛ na Oƒir sika ugyiedi ɔbuni ƒui use ɛlɛɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am terribly angry— I will make the sky tremble and the earth shake loose.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubɔya na katɔ ku kalɔ ƒui kakunku geen na kana kenyekɔ, na ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui kɔnyi ɔsu.

english_verse: Everyone will run to their homelands, just as hunted deer run, and sheep scatter when they have no shepherd.
translation_verse: “Kalɛ na akwa uukeli ɔgbini si ɔsiaku-nwu iye baƒonu bani neeebo ɔdane baagyingya ni, ukyuli biala ɔdubo bunwini na ukeli usie nwuna ɔma na nwuna badi kudɔ.

english_verse: Those men who are captured will be killed by a sword.
translation_verse: Na bani ƒui béƒie badubɔtu-ma baƒuaala, na batɛ kuwii kenye.

english_verse: They will see their children beaten against rocks, their homes robbed, and their wives abused.
translation_verse: Bana anumi lɛlɔ na badubɔƒiɛmi bana bebi atakpɛ lɛlɔ babwɛ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. Na badubɔla-ma ɔtɔ kemmo ala ƒui batɔlɔku. Na beƒie bana beleku batɛnku-ma ɔkplu kemmo.

english_verse: The Medes can't be bought off with silver or gold, and I'm sending them to attack Babylonia.
translation_verse: “Ndubo Medes kadi bekyuli budie bɔkya-mii Na bilátɔlɔ-ma ku sika ugyiedi iye ɔƒualadi ɔni na baaadaku lɛda.

english_verse: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children. The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
translation_verse: Na bekpone bani ndubo-mii bukpo badubo bina bakloƒu atula bubo bɔdu. Na balanu bebi bani naaagyi lɛla lɛdi muedi kɔnyana.”

english_verse: The city of Babylon is glorious and powerful, the pride of the nation. But it will be like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah after I, the Lord, destroyed them.
translation_verse: Babel lɛgakadikɔ, lɛkɛ lɛni muukeye ƒui kesekɔ, kesii kani lɛlɔ lɛmɛnɛ baakun, Unwoti ɔdubo-nwu bunwini bubi na ɔyila-nwu udu aani Sodom ku Gomora.

english_verse: No one will live in Babylon. Even nomads won't camp nearby, and shepherds won't let their sheep rest there.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdubo bekyuli keliekɔ bunwini úsela kaba kaba kemmo ƒui. Belusiene ɔdi kevo kasɔ kelenye mmɔ, na baƒonu ɔdane ɔdi ɔsɔ ulawia nwuna bebuo katɛnkɔ na mmɔ.

english_verse: Only desert creatures, hoot owls, and ostriches will live in its ruins, and goats will leap about.
translation_verse: Bakumbuo kani ndubɔƒɔ mmɔ belie ku bekuku ku baasɛ bonwu lidu.

english_verse: Hyenas and wolves will howl from Babylon's fortresses and beautiful palaces. Its time is almost up!
translation_verse: Na bebuoƒuala ndubo adi buteebo na bana ala abuni kesekɔ, na beƒukutu bataatɛ bana kuliekɔ kɔbuni kɔni baaƒɔ́ baƒɔ. Na uwi ɔmmɔ úude geen, na ɔsɔ ulésie kama lɛnɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubo Israelƒuɔ kɔnyana bɔnu, na ɔsɔ ɔƒuna-ma, na ɔsɔku-ma utésie bana keliekɔ na bana kalɔ lɛlɔ. Baƒɔ badubɔsalaku-ma na bablaku Israelƒuɔ unwi.

english_verse: Other nations will lead them home, and Israel will make slaves of them in the land that belongs to the Lord. Israel will rule over those who once governed and mistreated them. Death to the King of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Na kadi bamba bekyuli ndubo-ma butiku na beti-ma besienku bana kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na Israelƒuɔ beti-ma benwini bana banana ku beleku kabla bablane na Unwoti kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ. Na kadi bani néƒie-ma bátɔlɔku na bénye-ma lɛlɔ na baabla bana kabla ni, Israelƒuɔ mmomu badubo bunwini bunye-ma lɛlɔ na bataabla-ma kabla.

english_verse: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.
translation_verse: bɛdubo ɔnu bɔnwi bɔsia Babel ɔga na bɛsu bɛnini, “Báyila ɔyikune ɔmmɔ udu! Na nwuna kɔnyi kpakplaa ku lɛlɔ bɔtina bɔmmɔ kenye kékulo!

english_verse: The Lord has crushed the power of those evil kings,
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́ƒɛ balalane ɔgagyii, lɛlɔ badine bammɔ likposela,

english_verse: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Kayawi ƒui kábla buɛɛ na ukyuli biala atu áyɔ na békeyi lɛnu na benye beedie.

english_verse: King of Babylonia, even the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon celebrate and say, “Since you were put down, no one comes along to chop us down.”
translation_verse: Egyii enengudi gyɛnglɛɛ ammɔ muedi, lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-nya na Lebanon kalɔ banini, ‘Ɔni na bébo-ɔ kalɔ ɔƒɛni amu ni, ala ɔnwine ɔdi ɔsɔ ulebo ulabada-bu uláva kalɔ.’ ”

english_verse: The world of the dead eagerly waits for you. With great excitement, the spirits of ancient rulers hear about your coming.
translation_verse: Kekpine muedi owogyo úwi, na lɛlɔ badine bani lɛnɔ néesie kekpine mmɔ báta babasiaku-ɔ ka bánu-ɔ ka ási adubo.

english_verse: Each one of them will say, “Now you are just as weak as any of us!
translation_verse: Na baasu ku lɛdi linwi banini, “Abu ku-ɔ búlie, ɔsika kablakɔ kása awɔ lɛnɔ aani abu.”

english_verse: Your pride and your music have ended here in the world of the dead. Worms are your blanket, maggots are your bed.”
translation_verse: Ƒula kenyekɔ ku ɔyikun ɔ́sa, ɔsika báva awɔ ku ƒula lɛbentaa ku lɛnu ƒui, na atɛ beklubi lɛlɔ, na bani bewi-ɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You, the bright morning star, have fallen from the sky! You brought down other nations; now you are brought down.
translation_verse: O ukyuli ɔni muukeye aani ɔtanta lɛyabi na ese aani ɔtanta kadi bugye! Nu kalɛ báya-a na ánu ási katɔ katɔ kesii kani na élie ábayu kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni, Awɔ ɔni na nka ákɔ kayawi ƒui bekyuli ásɔ!

english_verse: You said to yourself, “I'll climb to heaven and place my throne above the highest stars. I'll sit there with the gods far away in the north.
translation_verse: Awɔ mɔɔsu na ƒula kayi kemmo anii, “Ndubɔkɔ lisie katɔ katɔ ntése mina liboku na mmɔ na keliekɔ kammɔ kebo kavi Katɔti ayabi, na ndubulie kɔbi kedee kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ katɔ ƒui, ntaadi katɔ bayikune bani ƒui mɔɔsála mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I'll be above the clouds, just like God Most High.”
translation_verse: Na ndubɔkɔ lisie katɔ katɔ ƒui, na ami ku Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui bɔdubɔbla likeke.”

english_verse: But now you are deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Nsu aanu-ɔ mɛni na báayula kalɔ na ébeduo kekpine na ubu kemmo mɛni.

english_verse: Those who see you will stare and wonder, “Is this the man who made the world tremble and shook up kingdoms?
translation_verse: Na bekyuli ƒui bágyu anumi bálɛ-ɔ baanu-ɔ kaduɛ, na béye banini, “Awɔ ndi nkyuli ɔni nágyu kayawi éti átaatanyi-ka dii mmɔ?

english_verse: Did he capture every city and make earth a desert? Is he the one who refused to let prisoners go home?”
translation_verse: Na awɔ nésusu kayawi kammɔ na kénwini kalɔ kakwiidi, na ábwɛ lɛma linengudi na étete kuƒi ka bekyuli bani na éƒie basɔ benwini besie bana lɛma?”

english_verse: When kings die, they are buried in glorious tombs.
translation_verse: Baga bani na békpi mmɔ ƒui batɛ bana kɔƒiɔtɔ kemmo ku bana agala.

english_verse: But you will be left unburied, just another dead body lying underfoot like a broken branch. You will be one of many killed in battle and gone down to the deep rocky pit.
translation_verse: Nsu aanu-ɔ na béƒwimi bábava mɛni aani kalɛ na baavá kaƒɔ kebiledi, na bekyuli bani na áya na bátu kuwii bádu ubugya ɔ́ƒɔ-ɔ lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: You won't be buried with kings; you ruined your country and murdered your people. You evil monster! We hope that your family will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Na baaadubo-ɔ bɔva bubunku bakladi kalɛ na báva ama, ɔsika ébile ƒula kalɔ na ádu ƒula bekyuli. Ukyuli ukpidi bebi ni, basɔ baaadubo-ma anyi bɔkpali kudii.

english_verse: We will slaughter your sons to make them pay for the crimes of their ancestors. They won't take over the world or build cities anywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Bɛklibi kesii kadi na bɛdu alaekpidi ɔblane ɔmɛni bebi, na bana bati ekpidi ɔsu. Na ɔdi ɔsɔ utakɔ utetédu ka ɔɔkɛ́ ɔyikun na ɔsɔ utaadi kayawi lɛlɔ, na ɔtu lɛma linengudi uyile kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised to attack Babylonia and destroy everyone there, so that none of them will ever be remembered again.
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔnini, “Ndubunye litile Babelƒuɔ kuƒi, na bana lɛnyi lɛmmɔ lɛyii udu. Na bana ɛlɛɛ bani mebu ku bana bawɔ ƒui ndubo-ma bɔkyula.

english_verse: The Lord will sweep out the people, and the land will become a swamp for wild animals. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Ndubɔya na mmɔ kenwini bekuku keliekɔ ku ntu ku lɛba sɔɔn. Ndubɔyila-ma ƒui na lɛkpala-ma aani uƒiɔ kalɛ lɛkyula.” Básu Kenye Kadi Na Asiria Lɛlɔ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has made this promise: Everything I have planned will happen just as I said.
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui úse kenye ɔnini, “Kasusu biala na lɛ́bla líse ni, ndubɔya na kebo-nwu kemmo lɛni kani na mina bɔyɔ kenye.

english_verse: I will wipe out every Assyrian in my country, and I will crush those on my mountains. I will free my people from slavery to the Assyrians.
translation_verse: Ndubo Asiriaƒuɔ udu bɔyila na mina kalɔ, na lɛkɔ-ma lɛbwɛ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ na mina kɔbi lɛlɔ, ama bani nákɔ belie mina bekyuli lɛlɔ, na lidie bana lɛbibo kɔgba kɔni nda Israelƒuɔ, na bana etila atimi mina bekyuli lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́bla kasusu kadi úse úte kayawi kemodi kammɔ ƒui, ɔsika nwuna ɔyikun unengudi ɔmmɔ ɔ́ƒɔ kayawi kammɔ kesii biala,

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have made these plans. No one can stop me now! The Philistines Will Be Punished
translation_verse: na úudie kɔnu úse na kɔnyi kemmo ka ɔni kayawi kɔtu na ɔdi uletile-nwu kuƒi. Básu Kenye Kadi Na Ƒilistiƒuɔ Lɛlɔ

english_verse: This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:
translation_verse: Lɛkwa lɛni na Ɔga Ahas úkpi ni, anwu na Unwoti úti kenye kamɛni úte-mi.

english_verse: Philistines, don't be happy just because the rod that punished you is broken. That rod will become a poisonous snake, and then a flying fiery dragon.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni amii Ƒilistiƒuɔ ni, lɛlɔ litayɔ-mii tɔ bɛnii bina ugyii ɔdadi ɔni ndi ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔ́ƒɛ. Ɔsika kɔlakpi kukpidi ubi ni, use aani kugyii ugyiitu ukpidi bɔta. Kuna ebi adi avan ɔni mɔɔtu ku ugyulo ukpidi.

english_verse: The poor and needy will find pastures for their sheep and will live in safety. But I will starve some of you, and others will be killed.
translation_verse: Ndubute bawabane geen ƒui na badi aani baƒonu ɔdane buni kalɛ na bani mɔɔyaki ƒui batɛ ku banwuna. Nsu amii ni, ndubɔya na kɔka kɔdu-mii ƒui na bɛyii udu ku ligyiitu.

english_verse: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: “The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.”
translation_verse: Bi kenye na bɔdubudie bute bekisine bammɔ si banii bana batu badi bébeye lɛla lɛdi? Bɔdubɔsu-ma bɔnini, “Unwoti úse katamikukɔ úse Sion, na nwuna bekyuli bani ƒui na baanya taakya badubɔkɛ katamikukɔ.”

english_verse: This is a message about Moab: The towns of Ar and Kir were destroyed in a night. Moab is left in ruins!
translation_verse: Kenye kamɛni kaatina lɛla lɛdi na Ar ku Kir Moab lɛma linengudi lɛlɔ. Usien unwi kani na bábwɛ lɛma lɛmmɔ na lɛ́yii udu ƒui!

english_verse: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.
translation_verse: Dibon ɔma bekyuli bákɔ bésie kɔbi lɛlɔ, na bana baƒiɔ kɔdu, na Moab kalɔ bekyuli ƒui béwulo na Medeba ɔma lili. Békpeyi bana eli ku kuduo ƒui.

english_verse: I pity Moab! Its people are running to Zoar and to Eglath-Shelishiyah. They cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they tell of disasters.
translation_verse: Mina kayi keenú ɔlɛ teete Moab kadi bekyuli, ka bana bekyuli beekeli kekpo béti bésela Soa ku Eglat-Selesia lɛma kakaaka ƒui. Béti Luhit ɔma ulu na bákɔ bésela na beewulo. Na bakɛ baaká bana ɔgbankpi ala ku kɔnyana na Horonaim ɔma ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.
translation_verse: Nimrim ntukpa bɔ́kwii! Na ɔƒɛ ɔ́du utubili livo lɛmmɔ ƒui, na livo lɛdi lɛsɔ liiide mmɔ.

english_verse: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu akɛla ani na bábla na báklibi bese lɛlɔ ni, béti-nya na bávia utukwalɛ ketudɔ egyii gyɛnglɛɛ ammɔ kemmo bátɔlɔku.

english_verse: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.
translation_verse: Na kɔku kɔni na Moab kalɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli baabla ni, kɔvanu kɔmmɔ ku kɔnyana etemila aaku teetéwi Eglaim na ɔkɛ mmɔ útédu Ber-Elim na kalɔ kammɔ ɔmii lɛlɔ muedi.

english_verse: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.
translation_verse: Dibon ketu ntu bɔ́ƒɔ ubugya, nsu ubugya ɔni nsɔ ndubo kama uuuse buɛɛ. Na Moabƒuɔ bani na banii bukeli na bada ni, gyata na ndubo budie bɔkya-ma ku bana ɛlɛɛ bani nébu ƒui.

english_verse: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Moabƒuɔ, biti baƒonu bɛsiku Sela ɔma aani lɛlɔ bɔdi kayu bitéte kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ɔdine na bɛsia kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ bisie Sion Kɔbi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The women of Moab crossing the Arnon River are like a flock of birds scattered from their nests.
translation_verse: Moabƒuɔ beleku bese aani baasɛ bani na bábɔku bálɛku ayu kemmo na batɛ Arnon Ketu kaviakɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Moab's messengers say to the people of Judah, “Be kind and help us! Shade us from the heat of the noonday sun. Hide our refugees! Don't turn them away.
translation_verse: “Bɛbla kasusu kabuni kadi bɛsiku-bu lɛlɔ, na bɛlɛ ugyii ka bɛdubɔgyumana-bu bula bekisine ɔsu aani kugyii ɔyuli ɔni nse aani usien si kadi kábi yayaaya, na bɛbɛla abu bani na baabɔku.

english_verse: Let our people live in your country and find safety here.” Moab, your cruel enemies will disappear; they will no longer attack and destroy your land.
translation_verse: Bɛya na abu Moabƒuɔ bekeline bɔkɛ kakyakɔ na bina kudɔ, na binwini katamikukɔ bite-bu na bula bekisine ɔsu.” Bekyuli bekpidi uwi ɔdubo bɔsa, na bekyuli udu bɔyila bɔwɔ ulu. Na bekyuli bani nkɛ mɔɔbɔku bekyuli bamba na baayila-ma udu uwi ku ɔyikun ɔsa, na bayii udu na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then a kingdom of love will be set up, and someone from David's family will rule with fairness. He will do what is right and quickly bring justice. Moab's Pride Is Destroyed
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, badubuse lɛga kadikɔ kadi bese, na kadanku bɔyɔ ute bekyuli ƒui. Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi litemi lɛlɔ ulu lɛlɔ ndubo lɛga lɛmmɔ bɔdi. Na ɔ́si Dawid ɔtɔ kemmo. Na anwu mɔɔtɛ litemi na ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔbabla taasia anu taabla lɛla biala siin.

english_verse: We have heard of Moab's pride. Its people strut and boast, but without reason.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ama básu banini, “Búnu Moab kadi bekyuli lɛlɔtina. Na bɔ́ti kalɛ na beekú lɛlɔ na balábu, ku kalɛ na baakɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ ukpludi.”

english_verse: Tell everyone in Moab to mourn for their nation. Tell them to cry and weep for those fancy raisins of Kir-Hareseth.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛya na Moab kadi bekyuli bakɛ beteewulo kɔnyana taavi, na bana lɛlɔ lɛni mɔɔkywí-ma ɔsu. Na badubo buwulo na emini ani bádi ɔsu, na bana ɔma unengudi na Kirhaset.

english_verse: Vineyards near Heshbon and Sibmah have turned brown. The rulers of nations used to get drunk on wine from those vineyards that spread to Jazer, then across the desert and beyond the sea.
translation_verse: Edula mmo bɔni na Hesbon bɔ́yɛyɛ, na adingyii mmo bɔni na Sibma lɛnɔ bɔ́yɛyɛ. Na egyiibi ani lɛbuli nébimi lísie Yaser muedi kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ badine bésusu-ku bébile.

english_verse: Now I mourn like Jazer for the vineyards of Sibmah. I shed tears for Heshbon and for Elealeh. There will be no more harvest celebrations
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na muuwulo ku Yaser, na egyiibi ani náyii udu na Sibma ɔsu. O Hesbon, muuwulo teete awɔ ku Eleale ƒui. Ɔsika bɛsɔ bɛɛɛdubo egyiibi bɔkɛ bude ana udewi na ebiti ada-mii ku lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.
translation_verse: Egyiibi mmo bɔmmɔ bɔsɔ buláda kubiti, na elénu ka ɔdi ɔɔtu ɔnu ɔdi iye lɛlɔyɔ kɔvanu kɔdi, na ɔdi uuubo ntɛ kebulokɔ uláka egyiibi adi ntu, ɔsika lɛlɔyɔ ƒui kenye kékulo.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I hurt for Moab and Kir-Heres.
translation_verse: Mina kayi keewulo ku Moabƒuɔ kɔnyana aani si ɔbentaa na nda muudie kɔnyana lɛnu, na Kirhaset litemi liikpóku-mii geen.

english_verse: It's useless for Moab's people to wear themselves out by going to their altars to worship and pray.
translation_verse: Moabƒuɔ béetu lɛlɔ bésie bana baƒiɔ kɔdu na bátákpali na abi lɛlɔ, nsu kekeeke.

english_verse: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.
translation_verse: Geen ni, ala amɛni udu na Unwoti ɔ́su úse na Moab kadi bekyuli lɛlɔ úbavi kukuuku.

english_verse: Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, Unwoti ɔnini, “Na akwa atɛ kemmo pɛpɛɛpɛ aani kalɛ na kabla ɔblane ɔɔká nwuna emeyi ani nébu na nwuna ɔtɔlati kudɔ na ɔbla-nwu kabla ni, Moab kalɔ kemodi ku nwuna akɛla ku nwuna bumomo ku lɛnyi lɛni na ɔ́ƒɔ na uukeye mmɔ lɛdubo bɔyii ku udu. Na bana ɛlɛɛ kani mebu na basɔ balákɛ ɔyikun ɔdi lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: This is a message about Damascus: Damascus is doomed! It will end up in ruins.
translation_verse: Damasko lɛlɔ kɔtɛ. “Bɛnu! Damasko ɔma unengudi ɔdubɔyii udu na ɔƒaamu ɔdubunwini alakpi kebu bonwu kadi.

english_verse: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.
translation_verse: Na lɛma linengudi lɛni na nwuna amadɔ ƒui lɛdubunwini baƒonu katɛnkɔ, na ukyuli ɔdi ulabɔku-ma.

english_verse: Israel will lose its fortresses. The kingdom of Damascus will be destroyed; its survivors will suffer the same fate as Israel. The Lord All-Powerful has promised this. Sin and Suffering
translation_verse: Eƒraim ɔma unengudi, ɔni na awodu bonwu aagyumana ɔdubɔyii udu na ɔsɔ ulakya, na Damasko lɛga kadikɔ kabwɛ ƒui, na Aram kadi nkyuli ɛlɛɛ bani mebu badubɔyila bana bukeye aani Israelƒuɔ.” Lɛni na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́su.

english_verse: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.
translation_verse: “Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ala ani ƒui na Israel ubo ɔsu na uukeye adubɔyii udu, ɔsika ayaki adubo kalɔ kammɔ bɔda geen.

english_verse: It will be like an olive tree beaten with a stick, leaving two or three olives or maybe four or five on the highest or most fruitful branches. The Lord God of Israel has promised this.
translation_verse: Nsu bana ɛlɛɛ badi badubo bubu aani kalɛ na beeti ugyii ku asɔsɔ teede kɔdingyii ebi ƒui na kebu ɛlɛɛ na kayɔlɔ kɔgba akɔ. Lɛni na Unwoti Israel Katɔti ɔ́su.”

english_verse: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, bekyuli badubunwini banu bana Udiene Israel Katɔti ɔni nse kedee.

english_verse: They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.
translation_verse: Na basɔ belésie bana akpabi ani na béti bana enu bávɔ béte lɛlɔ kudɔ, na basɔ beleti anu balasia Asera ɔƒiɔgyii ku nwuna lɛlɔ ala ku oloƒui bɔkyula akpabi ani na ama alati bátu mmɔ.

english_verse: Israel captured powerful cities and chased out the people who lived there. But these cities will lie in ruins, covered over with weeds and underbrush.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, bana lɛma lɛni na baagyumana kpakplaa na Israelƒuɔ bábɔku-ma bédie mmɔ lɛdubo bɔbwɛ na línwini aku.

english_verse: Israel, you have forgotten the God who saves you, the one who is the mighty rock where you find protection. You plant the finest flowers to honor a foreign god.
translation_verse: Bɛ́yiƒala bina Katɔti ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mii ngba, na bítenyimo bina kagyumanakɔ kpakplaa kani ndi lɛtakpɛ lɛni lɛlɔ na bíkpo kama. Ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, ina ka bɛ́lɛ egyii abuni, na bíye adingyii abuni bɛ́siku kaƒɔ bíbalɛ,

english_verse: The plants may sprout and blossom that very same morning, but it will do you no good, because you will suffer endless agony. God Defends His People
translation_verse: na bɛ́nu-nya lɛlɔ ɔ́si ɔnta na áta álɛ lili kaduɛ ni, bilákɛ-nya biléde ɔsika bɛdubuduo lɛbibo ku bɔnɔ geen kemmo na nwuna kenye kelékulo.

english_verse: But even if they roar like a fearsome flood, God will give the command to turn them back. They will be like dust, or like a tumbleweed blowing across the hills in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Nsu ina ka bábla kudu ku kɔnyi badubo lɛni ni, Unwoti ɔdubo-ma bɔbɔku busienku kama, aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uuƒwi aƒata taayulaku abi, iye kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uuduo kɔnwinimi kemmo taakya ligede.

english_verse: In the evening their attack is fierce, but by morning they are destroyed. This is what happens to those who raid and rob us.
translation_verse: Bekisine bákya-bu liƒu ku bɔyia geen useyi uwi, nsu kadi bugye ni, bana ƒui báyii bákya. Bekyuli bani muukpóku-bu lɛyuƒɔla lɛdi mmɔ.

english_verse: Downstream from Ethiopia lies the country of Egypt, swarming with insects.
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ beete kɔlɔ kɔni lɛlɔ na baalɔlɔ bani avwi mɔɔbla kɔku mɛni bakya, na Kus kalɔ kemmo ntukpa adɔ,

english_verse: Egypt sends messengers up the Nile River on ships made of reeds. Send them fast to Ethiopia, whose people are tall and have smooth skin. Their land is divided by rivers; they are strong and brutal, feared all over the world.
translation_verse: ama bani nátala batu na bakɛ ɛpu lɛlɔ badubo, na beli lɛkɔlɔ lɛni bánwi ku ketu kemmo ligyii kemmo. Biti usi momoomo na bisie kalɔ kani bekyuli nákuku na bana ɔlɔgyii use suɛlɛ suɛlɛ na ɔɔdia bɔnu kudɔ. Bekyuli bebo-ma lɛlɔ liƒu úsie ɔgyu ɔ́mana na bana kɔnyi ku kalala kani na baabla bekyuli ɔsu, bekyuli bani na ntukpa búle-ma kalɔ kemmo ƒui bɔ́vi.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, listen with care! A signal will be given on the mountains, and you will hear a trumpet.
translation_verse: Amii bayawine ƒui, ku amii bani na bilie kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni, bɛdubo bɔnu aƒlaga ɔdi si bákɔliku-nwu katɔ na abi lɛlɔ, na binu kakpɛɛ kadi kɔku si bávwi-ka.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “I will calmly look down from my home above— as calmly as the sun at noon or clouds in the heat of harvest season.”
translation_verse: Lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ndubulie mina keliekɔ ntaanu kpoo, aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛ ɔɔyá na kadi kaabi, iye edula ɔƒɛwi liwulu lɛɛyá na amii aayu.”

english_verse: Before the blossoms can turn into grapes, God will cut off the sprouts and hack off the branches.
translation_verse: Ɔsika asa na badubɔƒɛ edula ammɔ, kugyii kɔni anwula nénwini ebi na égyie na édu bɔƒɛ mmɔ ni, Katɔti ɔdubuti kewii na udie kɔgba wɛlɛ wɛlɛ kɔmmɔ, na ɔmɛnɛ kɔgba kunengudi kɔmmɔ uwi kalɔ.

english_verse: Ethiopians will be food for mountain vultures during the summer and for wild animals during the winter.
translation_verse: Lɛni na bekpone bammɔ ɔlɔna ɔdubuwi ɔmana ute baasɛ bani muuƒie na abi lɛlɔ ku bakumbuo, na baasɛ bammɔ babaduli-ma kaƒɛndi na bakumbuo bammɔ bɔduli-ma kɔyɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Those Ethiopians are tall and their skin is smooth. They are feared all over the world, because they are strong and brutal. But at that time they will come from their land divided by rivers, and they will bring gifts to the Lord All-Powerful, who is worshiped on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, bekyuli bani nákuku ku ɔlɔna suɛlɛ suɛlɛ mɛni, na bana lɛlɔ libo liƒu úsie ɔgyu ɔ́mana mmɔ, na bana kɔnyi ku kalala kani na baabla bekyuli ɔsu, na ntukpa búle-ma kalɔ kemmo bɔ́vi ƒui, badubuti etela beboku Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui. Na etela ammɔ adubuse Sion Kɔbi lɛlɔ kesii kani na baakpá Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui.

english_verse: This is a message about Egypt: The Lord comes to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The people are weak from fear. Their idols tremble as he approaches and says,
translation_verse: Linyesia lɛmɛni lɛdanku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Bɛnu! Unwoti uli liƒlukutu bonwu lɛdi lɛlɔ, na ɔkɛ ku usi momoomo úsela Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ, na lɛlɔ lɛɛtɔ́ Egyipteƒuɔ baƒiɔ ku liƒu bonwu. Na Egyipteƒuɔ bammɔ alati báyɛyɛ, na enu áƒɛ-ma na bɔyia ɔsu.

english_verse: “Egypt will be discouraged when I confuse their plans. They will try to get advice from their idols, from the spirits of the dead, and from fortunetellers.
translation_verse: Na enu adubɔƒɛ Egyipteƒuɔ. Na libile bana kɔkwɛ ƒui, na beye kasiakɔ basiku bana baƒiɔ ku bekpine, ku bekebone ku bevone kudɔ banɔ.

english_verse: I will put the Egyptians under the power of a cruel, heartless king. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have promised this.” Trouble along the Nile
translation_verse: Na ndubuti Egyipteƒuɔ lɛkya ɔga lɛlɔ ɔdine ulikplune kalɔ, na ɔlalane ɔdi-ma lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: The Nile River will dry up and become parched land.
translation_verse: Nil Ketu kadubo bɔkwii kede kede, na ntu bɔdi bɔsɔ bulakya-ka kemmo, na kana kavikɔ kenwini kalɔkplu.

english_verse: Its streams will stink, Egypt will have no water, and the reeds and tall grass will dry up.
translation_verse: Ntukpa bɔni nákya kenye Nil kemmo ƒui bɔdubo bɔda na buteenwenyi buɛ buɛ. Na Egyipte ntukpa bɔmmɔ butaakpɛ na bɔkwii ƒui, na ketu kemmo egyii mmɔ ƒui ekpi ayii udu na akwii enye,

english_verse: Fields along the Nile will be completely barren; every plant will disappear.
translation_verse: Na mmo bɔni na bése mmɔ ƒui bɔyii udu ku ketu kenye ku amadɔ egyii ammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Those who fish in the Nile will be discouraged and mourn.
translation_verse: Kɔbɛ bediene badubo kɔnyana buteewulo, na bani mɔɔtu lɛdaa ku lɛsawu bewine ƒui badubo enu butaaƒɛ ku kɔnyana.

english_verse: None of the cloth makers will know what to do, and they will turn pale.
translation_verse: Lɛbuli lidu adi bedine badubɔyila lɛnunsia, na bani mɔɔbla adi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ basɔ baláti kalɛ babla.

english_verse: Weavers will be confused; paid workers will cry and mourn. Egypt's Helpless Leaders
