translation_verse: Kayi kadubo bedine butaakpulu na kayu kenye kabla bablane beƒu.

english_verse: The king's officials in Zoan are foolish themselves and give stupid advice. How can they say to him, “We are very wise, and our families go back to kings of long ago?”
translation_verse: Kɔdɔlɔ kútulo amii Soan ɔma kasusu betine, na amii bani ndi Ƒarao kelisa benengu kasusu kasɔ kalalɛ bekyuli kɔsia kɔdi. Dɛ na ɔdi ɔdubɔkana na ɔsu Ƒarao ɔnii, “Ami ndi banundane bammɔ akɔ unwi na kuuku baga bammɔ kudɔ na lɛ́tɛya ala?”

english_verse: Where are those wise men now? If they can, let them say what the Lord All-Powerful intends for Egypt.
translation_verse: Wɛ na bina banundane bammɔ bávi ɔƒɛni amu? Bɛya na basu-mii na binu kasusu kani na Unwoti ubo na Egyipte lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The royal officials in Zoan and in Memphis are foolish and deceived. The leaders in every state have given bad advice to the nation.
translation_verse: Soan ɔma kasusu betine bénwini badɔlɔdi. Na Memƒis ɔma benengu béƒu ku ɔkɔ etemila, na bekyuli bani lɛlɔ na Egyipte úkpo kama bákpanku-ma bésela batáyila.

english_verse: The Lord has confused Egypt; its leaders have made it stagger and vomit like a drunkard.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́ya na lɛlɛɛ kɔyu kɔni mɔɔbla ukyuli gyuma gyuma mɔɔdi Egyipteƒuɔ lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu na baagbánta na bana lɛla biala na baabla kemmo, aani kalɛ na ntɛkpine ɔɔdada na nwuna kɔdala akɔ.

english_verse: No one in Egypt can do a thing, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Egyipteƒuɔ basɔ beeebo lɛla lɛdi bɔbla, bati o-o, beni o-o, bebi o-o, ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo lɛla lɛdi bɔbla lɛnɔ.

english_verse: When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Egyipteƒuɔ badubɔta babla aani beleku, na lɛlɔ litaatɔ-ma geen ku bɔyia na Unwoti Katɔti kɔnu kɔni na ɔ́talaku katɔ ɔnii ɔɔƒiɛmi-ma ɔsu.

english_verse: They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt. The Lord Will Bless Egypt, Assyria, and Israel
translation_verse: Na si bénu ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́lɔ Israel lɛnyi muedi ni, liƒu lɛdubuƒie-ma na kayi kemmo na lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́ɔklibi lɛlɔ úse ka ɔbla Egyipteƒuɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord. One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Egyipteƒuɔ lɛma linengudi ɛlɔ badubɔtɛmi Kanaan lɛdi na badubuse kenye ka béti lɛlɔ béte Unwoti Katɔti kadi ƒui Unwoti. Na lɛma lɛmmɔ akɔ unwi baalɔ banii Ɔƒɛ ɔma unengudi.

english_verse: In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him.
translation_verse: Na batu lɛkpabi na Egyipte kalɔ kemmo ntɛntɛ, na balɛ likpose lɛkpa lɛdi na lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ kɔmadɔ na ɔmii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Likposela lɛmɛni muudie kenye ka Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubo butaanu na Egyipte kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ na si báva bákpali-nwu na bekisine bukpoku ɔsu ni, na Katɔti uti ɔƒɔne ɔdi umene-ma na ubebunku-ma na bakɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.
translation_verse: Na mmɔ na Egyipteƒuɔ badubɔnu bɔti ukyuli ɔni na Unwoti ɔdi na bataakpa-nwu na bataakyula akpala ku etela bamba lɛnɔ teete-nwu. Badubuse kenye bete-nwu na badi linyese lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubo Egyipteƒuɔ bubo bɔkya ɔlɛ, nsu anwu kani ndubo-ma lɛlɛ lɛmmɔ bunyimi na ɔbwi-ma. Ɔsika ɔdububo-ma kalɛ na benwini bebo-nwu kudɔ, na si békpi-nwu kɔtɔ ni, na unu-ma buvele na ɔbla lɛla lɛni na bévele-nwu ute-ma na ɔbwi-ma.

english_verse: At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, ulu unengudi ɔdi ɔdubo bɔtɛ bɔsi Egyipte usie Asiria na Asiria ku Egyipte kadi bekyuli besie basɔ betenku lɛlɔ. Na kalɔ akpa anyɔ amɛni bekyuli bakpa Unwoti basala.

english_verse: Israel will join with these two countries. They will be a blessing to everyone on earth,
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Israel ku Egyipte ku Asiria kalɔ bekyuli badubɔbla kadi akpa atɛ bani ndubo bɔsala na benwini kusɛ kusɛ bete bayawine ƒui.

english_verse: then the Lord All-Powerful will bless them by saying, “The Egyptians are my people. I created the Assyrians and chose the Israelites.”
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubute-ma kusɛ kusɛ na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Kusɛ kusɛ ɔdubɔsiaku Egyipte mina kadi bekyuli ku Asiriaƒuɔ bani ndi mina enu kabla ku badi mina bekyuli na Asiria kadi bekyuli ku Israel kadi bani bekyuli na lɛ́ƒuna líte lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni kemmo na Asiria Ɔga Sagon ɔ́tala nwuna bekpone ɔtɔnkune ƒui kekpo ka usie útékpo na ɔ́ƒɔ Ƒilistiƒuɔ ɔma unengudi ɔni baalɔ Asdod ni,

english_verse: About this same time the Lord had told me, “Isaiah, take off everything, including your sandals!” I did this and went around naked and barefoot
translation_verse: uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo na Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su Amos ubidi Yesaia kenye kadi ɔnini, “Da ƒula lɛgbanvuo ku lɛla lɛni na asabla die.” Na Yesaia lɛnɔ ɔ́bla lɛni ɔni na ɔsɔ ɔɔɔkya lɛgbanvuo iye adala adi.

english_verse: for three years. Then the Lord said: What Isaiah has done is a warning to Egypt and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Kalɛ na mina kabla ɔblane Yesaia úsie ɔ́vi akwa atɛ na ɔɔɔda lɛla lɛdi na ɔɔɔkya lɛgbanvuo lɛnɔ úti ɔ́tina lɛla lɛni ndubo bɔlɛku Egyipte ku Kus lɛlɔ ni,

english_verse: Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced.
translation_verse: lɛni na Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga ɔdubo Egyipteƒuɔ ku Kusƒuɔ benengu ku banamu ƒui buƒie bɔtɔlɔku ku kasɔngya na balada adala iye bakya lɛgbanvuo lɛdi, na ɔdubɔbla Egyipteƒuɔ kɔƒa geen.

english_verse: They will be confused and frustrated, because they depended on Ethiopia and bragged about Egypt.
translation_verse: Kadi bani mɔɔsia Kusƒuɔ anu na baakun lɛmɛnɛ na Egyipte lɛlɔ ni, badubɔnu ɔmɛni na bayia geen na kɔƒa lɛnɔ kukpo-ma.

english_verse: When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, “Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.”
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, kadi bani nli Ƒilistia ɛpu kɔtɔ badubɔsu banii, ‘Bɛnu lɛla lɛni nálɛku kadi bani bekyuli na bɔɔkali ka bukeli butátamiku na bebunku-bu na bɔlɛ Asiriaƒuɔ enu kemmo. Bi na badubo bɔbla ɔƒɛni? Na wɛ na bɔdubɔsɔ bukeli busie?’ ”

english_verse: What a horrible vision was shown to me— a vision of betrayal and destruction. Tell Elam and Media to surround and attack the Babylonians. The Lord has sworn to end the suffering they caused.
translation_verse: Katɔti údie liƒu lɛla bonwu lɛdi ɔ́tina-mi. Na lɛ́nu ulikplu ku kalala ala bɔbla ani na aládia bɔnu, bekyuli beedie bana bakpana teete, na babambadi beeƒie bekyuli ala taaƒɔ. Na kɔvanu kɔda, Elamƒuɔ bikpo-ma! Na amii Mediaƒuɔ, bɛka lɛma linengudi lɛmmɔ bɛkya! Na keku ku kɔnyana buwulo bɔni na ɔ́kya bekyuli ndubukulo-nwu kenye.

english_verse: I'm in terrible pain like a woman giving birth. I'm shocked and hurt so much that I can't hear or see.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛmɛni lɛ́ya na mina kaƒɔna kádu-mi momoomo aani uleku ɔni ntɛ kɔwɔ, na ɔ́bla-mi aani bɔyila na nda ka línu lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔɔwia ka ɔbla. Lɛni na anumi ábla-mi suu na ɔ́bla-mi dɛye dɛye.

english_verse: In Babylon the high officials were having a feast. They were eating and drinking, when someone shouted, “Officers, take your places! Grab your shields.”
translation_verse: Báklibi kadikɔ ku kuliekɔ kabuni bése, na badubo bɔdi na bani! Amii batɔnkune bammɔ, bɛta kɔnakunwi biti bina agyumanala na bísusu-ku nnɔmii!

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Send guards to find out what's going on.
translation_verse: Lɛla bamba lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ndi ɔnini, “Wia ɔgyumanane ɔdi nyene kesii kadi, na utaanu ala ani mɔɔlɛ́ taasu-ɔ.

english_verse: When they see cavalry troops and columns of soldiers on donkeys and camels, tell them to be ready!”
translation_verse: Na si ɔ́nu bekyuli bani nlie bapɔnkɔ lɛlɔ, ku bani nlie bebuo ala betine geen ku benengudi bani mbo keƒu lɛlɔ ni, ɔsia-ma anu kaduɛ na ɔsu-ɔ lɛla biala.”

english_verse: Then a guard said, “I have stood day and night on this watchtower, Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɔgyumanane ɔmɛni ɔdubɔkpali ɔsu ɔnini, “O Unwoti, nnye mina bagyumanane ɔsangya na katɔ mɛni, kesii kani na ése-mi usien ku ɔƒɛ umodi ƒui, limeyi ndi limeyi.

english_verse: Now I see column after column of cavalry troops.” At once someone shouted, “Babylon has fallen! Every idol in the city lies broken on the ground.”
translation_verse: Bɛnu! Aanu kɛɛkɛ ku ukyuli ɔdi na bapɔnkɔ báni badububoku na bekpone lisu lɛdi belie bapɔnkɔ lɛlɔ na báda baalɛ́! Mmɔ ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ údie lɛdi na ɔɔsu ɔnini, ‘Úbuli o-o, Babel úbuli na nwuna baƒiɔ bani na ɔ́nwi ku bani na ɔ́vɔ ƒui ni, bábwɛ-ma béwi kalɔ!’ ”

english_verse: Then I said, “My people, you have suffered terribly, but I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.” How Much Longer?
translation_verse: O amii, mina bekyuli, bésusu-mii aani kalɛ na beewiile edula ebi teewi kakpa, na mɔɔsu-mii lɛla lɛni na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, ɔ́su-mi ɔnii mbasu-mii. Yesaia Ɔ́tɛmi Ɔ́siku Edom Ku Duma Lɛlɔ

english_verse: This is a message about Dumah: From the country of Seir, someone shouts to me, “Guard, how much longer before daylight?”
translation_verse: Unwoti údie lɛla lɛdi ɔ́tina na Duma kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na línu ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́kpali-mi ɔ́siku Seir abi lɛlɔ ɔnini, “Ɔgyumanane, usien uwi ɔmani kemmo na bɔkya mɛni? Na uwi ɛlɛ asa na kadi kadubugye?”

english_verse: From my guard post, I answered, “Morning will soon be here, but night will return. If you want to know more, come back later.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔgyumanane ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Kadi aka kéegye káwɔlɔ, nsu ɔƒɛ ɔsɔ ɔdubo bɔsa. Na si aayɔ́ enu lɛla lɛmɛni kalɔ ebu ni, na asɔ enwini ebo ebeye-mi kaduɛ.”

english_verse: This is a message for Arabs who live in the barren desert in the region of Dedan: You must order your caravans
translation_verse: Unwoti údie lɛla lɛdi ɔ́tina Arabia kalɔ lɛlɔ. O amii bekyuli lisu bonwu bani nékeli bɛ́si Dedan kalɔ lɛlɔ na bíbo bíbawia kabɛkɔ na Arabia kalɔ alakpi akɔ,

english_verse: to bring water for those who are thirsty. You people of Tema must bring food for the hungry refugees.
translation_verse: amii Tema ɔma bekyuli, biti adila ku ntu biboku baƒɔ bani na utukwɛ ɔɔda, baƒɔ bani nékeli bana ɔma mɛni.

english_verse: They are worn out and weary from being chased by enemies with swords and arrows.
translation_verse: Kuwii ku kɔtaminta atula yayaaya kenye na békeli bási, na kekpo kani nányi anyi mmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ala bamba lɛnɔ ɔnini, “Na lɛkwa linwi kemmo pɛpɛɛpɛ kalɛ kani na ukyuli ɔni na bése ɔkpa ɔɔká nwuna emeyi ani na ɔdubɔbla kabla ute nwuna ɔtɔlati ni, Kedar kadi bekyuli badubɔyila bana ala ani ƒui na bebo ɔsu na bebo ɔyikun na báƒɔ lɛnyi.

english_verse: Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.
translation_verse: Na bayikune pii bani náƒɔ lɛnyi na Kedar bekpone akɔ bani mɔɔní kɔtaminta teebo atula teetulo ni, bana ɛlɛɛ kani mebu. Ami, Unwoti Israel Katɔti, násu!”

english_verse: This is a message about Vision Valley: Why are you celebrating on the flat roofs of your houses?
translation_verse: Unwoti údie lɛla lɛdi ɔ́tina na Ala Bɔnu Kɔwɛ kemmo lɛlɔ. Bi mɔɔlɛ́ku-mii ɔsu na bina ƒui bíkeli bɛ́kɔ lɛtɔ eli na owogyo ɔda lɛni?

english_verse: Your city is filled with noisy shouts. Those who lie drunk in your streets were not killed in battle.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔyɔ kudu kani nda ɔma umodi ɔmmɔ ƒui ku lɛsɛ. Na bani na békpi ni, ɔɔɔdi kuwii kenye na békpi, na ɔɔɔdi kekpokɔ lɛnɔ na bésie.

english_verse: Your leaders ran away, but they were captured without a fight. No matter how far they ran, they were found and caught.
translation_verse: Bina batɔnkune ƒui básala na békeli, nsu béƒie-ma enu ku enu na ɔɔɔdi kuwii kenye, ina ka béesie ɔgyu kakaaka. Na bani ƒui na béƒie bénwini batɔntɛne.

english_verse: Then I said, “Leave me alone! Let me cry bitter tears. My people have been destroyed, so don't try to comfort me.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na lɛ́su nnini, “Bɛkpɛ bɛlɛ-mi lɛlɔ na liwulo, na ɔdi utasia-mi kɔnu na mina bekyuli bani náyii udu ɔsu.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful had chosen a time for noisy shouts and confusion to fill Vision Valley, and for everyone to beg the mountains for help.
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui limeyi lɛni na liƒu bonwu lɛdubuƒie bekyuli na bakɛ beteetu lɛgba kalɔ taakɔ taayu ku bɔyia geen na baaagyi lɛla lɛni na baabla ni, ani na bɔɔnu na Ala Bɔnu Kɔwɔ kɔmɛni kemmo. Na badubɔƒɛ awodu bewi kalɔ na bekyuli bataava taakpali abi ka bebebunku-ma.

english_verse: Your most beautiful valleys were covered with chariots; your cities were surrounded by cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Bekpone bani nlie bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ kemmo ku bani nlie bapɔnkɔ lɛlɔ báƒɔ ɔkwalɛ ɔmmɔ ƒui. Na bapɔnkɔ beliene bammɔ benye kagyumana na bina ɔma lɛban kenye.

english_verse: Judah was left defenseless. At that time you trusted in the weapons you had stored in Forest Palace.
translation_verse: Báƒɛ ɔban ɔni na bágyi bákya Yuda kalɔ ƒui mmɔ béwi kalɔ. Na bina anu ásia ekpola ani nse kesii kani na baalɔ Baga Kesii Lɛku mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You saw the holes in the outer wall of Jerusalem, and you brought water from the lower pool.
translation_verse: Bɛ́nu Yerusalem, Dawid ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ awodu kalɛ na áƒuaala ábla eƒi eƒi. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bɛ́ƒɔ ntu bíwi libiɔ lɛni na kada kakɛ mmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: You counted the houses in Jerusalem and tore down some of them, so you could get stones to repair the city wall.
translation_verse: Na bɛ́sia lɛtɔ lɛdi anu na bɛ́bwɛ-ni bíwi kalɔ kalɛ na biti atabi ammɔ bɛsɔku bɛtu awodu ani náaƒɛ áwɔlɔ ƒui mmɔ na asɔ enye kpakplaa.

english_verse: Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen. A Time To Weep
translation_verse: Bɛ́bla ntu kaƒɔkɔ aani akpambui bɛ́kya kalɔ kemmo na ɔban awodu ammɔ ntɛ kalɛ na bitaaƒɔ libiɔ lɛkukudi lɛmmɔ ntu teewi, nsu bɛ́yiƒala Katɔti ɔni nábla lɛla lɛmɛni iye anwu ɔni nákya kasusu kammɔ úse ɔ́si kukuuku ƒui.

english_verse: When all of this happened, the Lord All-Powerful told you to weep and mourn, to shave your heads, and wear sackcloth.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́lɔ-mii ɔnii biwulo keku ku kɔnyana geen, na bikpeyi bina eli na biti adikpi binyimi,

english_verse: But instead, you celebrated by feasting on beef and lamb and by drinking wine, because you said, “Let's eat and drink today! Tomorrow we may die.”
translation_verse: Nsu bɛɛnu ka lɛlɔ mmomu mɔɔyɔ́-mii, na bɛɛtɔ́ taaƒia taadi limeyi, na bɛɛdú bebuo taakun na bɛɛdi na bɛɛní ntɛ! Na bɛɛsu bɛnini, “Bɛya bɔdi na bɔni, ɔsika kɔnaadi bɔdubo bukpi.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has spoken to me this solemn promise: “I won't forgive them for this, not as long as they live.” Selfish Officials Are Doomed
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́su-mi ku mina atu nwaa ɔnini, “Bɛdubo likpidi lɛmɛni kayu butaaƒɔ laa útédu bina likpimeyi, na lɛɛɛdubo kɔtu bɔni bɔmmɔ budie bina lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is sending me with this message for Shebna, the prime minister:
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́tala-mi ɔ́kya Sebna ɔga kesii lɛlɔ ɔnune ɔnii ntéye-nwu ɔnini,

english_verse: Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here.
translation_verse: “Sebna, bi na aabla mɛni? Na ɔma néte-ɔ kuƒi ɔsu na aanwí kaƒiɔtɔ ete lɛlɔ, na aakya-ka bɔdia lɛni na katɔ mmɔ na lɛtakpɛ lɛmmɔ kemmo?

english_verse: You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away.
translation_verse: “Nu kaduɛ, ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubo ubada-a kpakplaa na uƒuimi-ɔ utáva kalɔ momoomo ina ɔni na aanu lɛlɔ ka ebo ɔyikun mɛni!

english_verse: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubo-ɔ bɔmana bɔkono kunu kunu na ubo-ɔ utáva kalɔ bɛbɛɛbɛ kadi lɛlɔ na eminime esié etékpi na mmɔ. Na bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ buni ɔni kemmo na éteelie ɔsu na áƒɔ lɛnyi ni, nwuna kawɔlɔkɔ kadi mmɔ. Na ɔga ɔni kesii lɛlɔ na átaanu mmɔ anumi ewi kalɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is going to take away your job!
translation_verse: Ndubukpeli-ɔ libo ƒula kabla kablakɔ, na lɛƒɔ ƒula kenyekɔ lɛlɛku-ɔ enu kemmo.

english_verse: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.
translation_verse: Ndubuti ƒula awu gyɔlɔɔ lɛkya-nwu, na liti ƒula kadii lɛbala-nwu kavobi, na liti ƒula lɛlɔ bɔdi ɔyikun ugyii lɛkya-nwu lɛkɔkɔ. Na anwu ndubunwini Yerusalem kadi bekyuli ku Yuda ɔtɔ kemmo bekyuli ƒui ɔti.

english_verse: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.
translation_verse: Na ndubuti ɔtɔ lɛlɛmila ɔyikun likposela lɛsia-nwu lɛmangba, na ɔdubuti-ni ɔlɛmi Dawid lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ ɔtɔ biala. Na si ɔ́lɛmi ni, ukyuli biala ulakana bɔkalɛ. Na si ɔ́kalɛ lɛnɔ ni, ukyuli biala ulakana bɔlɛmi.

english_verse: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
translation_verse: Na ndubo-nwu bubo bɔlɛ kalɔ kpakplaa aani liwele. Na use aani lɛgaboku lɛni mbo lɛnyi ku ɔbu ute ɔti kaduli.

english_verse: His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall.
translation_verse: Na anwu ndubɔya na nwuna ɔtɔ kemmo bekyuli ƒui bekeye ɔ́si bebi útédu bawɔ aani kalɛ na baaklibi kanwakɔ ala ƒui teese sɛɛn, ɔ́si ani na baaƒuƒwɛ útédu ani náƒɔ kuye lɛlɔ.

english_verse: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
translation_verse: “Ɔƒɛni si limeyi lɛni na lɛ́su líse mmɔ lídu ni, liwele lɛni na líbo lɛ́lɛ kalɔ mmɔ lɛdubo bɔkpa na ala ani nda-nwu lɛlɔ ku kɔbuli mmɔ adubukulo alɛ-nwu lɛlɔ. Unwoti násu.”

english_verse: Mourn in silence, you shop owners of Sidon, you people on the coast. Your sailors crossed oceans, making your city rich.
translation_verse: Bɛbla kpoo ku kɔnyana, amii bani nli ɛpu kalɔ ƒiaa lɛlɔ, ku amii Sidon beyedine lɛnɔ ƒui, na lɛla lɛni nébo ɔsu. Bina batalane bávia ɛpu anumi ekpo ekpo

english_verse: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.
translation_verse: na bakɛ ntukpa lidu lidu lɛlɔ. Bésie bétédu Sihor ku Nil ntukpa bonwu lɛlɔ, na beeyé edula lidu lidu ebi teeboku-mii. Na Tiro mmɔ kénwini kuye kadikɔ bonwu kéte bayawine ƒui.

english_verse: Sidon, you are a mighty fortress built along the sea. But you will be disgraced like a married woman who never had children.
translation_verse: Kɔƒa kukpo-mii, amii Sidon beyedine bani náƒɔ ɛpu ɔmmɔ ƒui anumi bilie-nwu lɛlɔ kpi, nsu kɔsia kɔdi kútalɛ-nwu kemmo, ɔsika ɛpu ɔmmɔ ɔlati mɔɔsu taatina ɔnini, “Nse aani ukyuli ɔni na kawɔƒɔ kátadu-nwu kudii iye útawɔ kudii. Na ńtada bakloƒu iye begblebi lɛnɔ dii.”

english_verse: When Egypt hears about Tyre, it will tremble.
translation_verse: Na si kenye kamɛni kétédu Egyipte ka lɛni nébo Tiro lɛlɔ ni, kɔnyana kɔdubo-ma buƒie.

english_verse: All of you along the coast had better cry and sail far across the ocean.
translation_verse: Bikeli beteesie Tarsis, na amii ntuntɛ kalɔ bekyuli beteewulo!

english_verse: Can this be the happy city that has stood for centuries? Its people have spread to distant lands;
translation_verse: Lɛlɔyɔ ku emeyi bɔdi ɔma ɔkukudi ɔmmɔ na ɔdi mɛni? Ɔma ɔni bekyuli návi bésie ɔgyu geen náyii udu lɛni?

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui nábla lɛla lɛmɛni udu, kalɛ na ala ani lɛlɔ lɛmɛne bekyuli baakun ka eekeye ayii udu. Na bani na báƒɔ lɛnyi na kalɔ lɛnɔ mɛni uboku-ma kalɔ.

english_verse: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians. Tyre Will Be Forgotten
translation_verse: Amii Tarsis kadi bekyuli bɛtuma bina kalɔ kalɛ biala na bɛdubɔkana ina Nil bune, ɔsika ásɔ eeebo beyedine lɛkɔlɔ kalɛlɛkɔ.

english_verse: The Lord's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Katɔti údie kɔnu na ɔ́tina nwuna ɔyikun ɔni mɔɔdi ɛpu lɛlɔ, na ɔɔkunku kayawi lɛga kɔdikɔ ƒui. Úbo ɔda ɔnii bekisine babwɛ Tiro ɔma kɔgyumanakɔ kpakplaa ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, “Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ƒula lɛlɔyɔ ku emeyi bɔdi kenye kékulo. Awɔ Sidon ɔma ɔbuni ɔni nse aani adagyaa, ɔƒɛni amu áyii udu! “Bɛta na bɛvia bisie Kipro, nsu mmɔ muedi bɛɛɛdubo bɔkɛ bɔnwuna bɔdi.”

english_verse: Look what the Assyrians have done to Babylonia! They have attacked, destroying every palace in the land. Now wild animals live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Amii binwini bɛnu Babel. Mmɔ kasɔ kaaadi keliekɔ buni kadi Asiriaƒuɔ békpo-ma, na mmɔ kénwini bakumbweyi keliekɔ. Bátu kunyekɔ bámana awodu ammɔ na bénye báƒɛ bana kɔgyumanakɔ kɔmmɔ ku awodu ammɔ ƒui, na báyila lɛla biala udu na mmɔ.

english_verse: Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.
translation_verse: Na amii Tarsis lɛkɔlɔ beyedine biteewulo keku ku kɔnyana, ɔsika bábwɛ bina kɔgyumanakɔ kpakplaa kɔmmɔ na kɔ́yii udu!

english_verse: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.
translation_verse: Na batu kɔgya banini, “Ɔyalɛ ɔni nákɔ ligblebi dii, sɔ ti ƒula ɔbentaa na asɔ atu ƒula lɛnu mini mini lɛmmɔ avi ɔma, na bekyuli kayi kasɔ kenwini kasia-a lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na úse kuuku.”

english_verse: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Nsu na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, kɔsia kɔni na Tiro kadi bekyuli bamɛni bákɛ na bana kuye bɔdi kemmo ni, belému-nya belése lɛlɔ kani. Mmomu badubudie-ku bese sɛsɛɛ bete Unwoti na beti babla kabla na beye adala ku adila abuni bete bekyuli bani mɔɔbla Katɔti kabla.

english_verse: The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered,
translation_verse: Bɛnu, Katɔti ɔdubo kalɔ kammɔ ƒui bubile na kana anumi kasɔ kaladia lɛla lɛla. Na ɔdubɔbɔku bekyuli bammɔ ƒui ɔkya kalɔ kammɔ ekpo ekpo.

english_verse: The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.
translation_verse: Kayawi kemodi kammɔ kadubo bubie ƒui kede kede na lɛla lɛla lɛsɔ lilésie siin. Lɛni na Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su.

english_verse: The earth wilts away; its mighty leaders melt to nothing.
translation_verse: Kalɔ kammɔ kadubɔkwii na lɛla biala lɛyɛyɛ, na kɔnyana kuƒie lɛla biala na lɛyii udu.

english_verse: The earth is polluted because its people disobeyed the laws of God, breaking their agreement that was to last forever.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bébile kayawi kammɔ na keesé lɛlɔ. Bátadi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ, na báta bénye litemi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ, na bébile Katɔti bunyimi bɔni nnye nte uwi ƒui mmɔ.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up: wine is almost gone— mournful sounds are heard instead of joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Kɔbuli kɔni ebi muudie ntɛ kɔ́yɛyɛ na bekyuli basɔ bebo ntɛ. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bani na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ ƒui béduo kɔnyana na beedumo.

english_verse: No one plays tambourines or stringed instruments; all noisy celebrating has come to an end.
translation_verse: Agyala kɔku kúkulo na lɛlɔyɔ kudu kɔ́ba diin.

english_verse: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.
translation_verse: Ntɛ kalɔ lɛnu lɛsɔ liiibo na beedie, ɔsika butudi bɔni na banine baakya lɛlɔ ogya bubo ɔdu butulo lɛla biala.

english_verse: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, “We're out of wine!”
translation_verse: Na kɔnyana keku ku kɔvanu kani nda na ɔma kemmo lilu lɛlɔ ƒui ka ntɛ bɔni na basɔ bani bataakɛ lɛlɔyɔ bɔsɔ buuubo ɔsu. Na kayawi ebiti biala áyii ákya kede kede.

english_verse: Nations will be stripped bare, like olive trees or vineyards after the harvest season. Praise the God of Justice
translation_verse: Lɛni udu ndubɔƒɔ kayawi kemodi ku kadi ƒui bekyuli akɔ aani kalɛ na edula udewi ɔɔví na baƒiɛmi adingyii ammɔ ligyii kalɛ na ebi ani nábɛ akya kɔgba akɔ lɛnɔ anu ewi kalɔ na bala.

english_verse: People in the west shout; they joyfully praise the majesty of the Lord.
translation_verse: Na nkyuli ɛlɛɛ bani nébu mmɔ báva momoomo ku lɛlɔyɔ básiku ɔƒɛ kanukɔ na bédie Unwoti Katɔti lɛgadi ɔyikun keyi.

english_verse: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛkɔliku Unwoti lɛnyi katɔ, na bimwi-nwu bɛsiku ɔƒɛ katukɔ ku ɛpu ntuntɛ kɔlɔ ƒui. Bibo Israel Unwoti Katɔti kudu.

english_verse: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous! There's No Escape
translation_verse: Binu bumwi lɛnu lɛni nda ɔ́siku kayawi kawɔlɔkɔ ekpo ekpo ƒui, úte Unwoti ɔni muukeye na use siin. Nsu bɔbuɛ muute lɛlɔ, ɔsika lɛlɔ kemmo kaanwá-mi ku kɔnyana, na bani na bátaƒɔ bátadi bana taƒɔ tadi ku ulikplu ala bɔbla ɔsu.

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; if you crawl out of the pit, you will get caught in a trap. The sky has split apart like a window thrown open. The foundations of the earth have been shaken;
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni menu liƒu lɛla lɛdi kɔku na ɔnii uukeli ɔdubɔnu uduo ubu kemmo. Na si ɔnii ɔɔkɔ́ ɔlɛ ubu ɔmmɔ kemmo lɛnɔ kakpagyuɛ kadubo-nwu budie. Kayaa kálɛmi kɔnakunwi ku ntu yoo aani kalɛ na baalɛmi ntu kayakun na kalɔ kammɔ ɔka ɔni nkya-nwu kalɔ ɔ́kunku.

english_verse: It staggers and shakes like a drunkard or a hut in a windstorm. It is burdened down with sin; the earth will fall, never again to get up.
translation_verse: Kayawi kemodi kammɔ ƒui kágbanta késela aani ntɛ ukpine. Na use aani kabwa kani na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔdanku ɔɔvínku, na nwuna atuɔkplu ku litemi lɛlɔ tadi únwini etila asia-nwu lɛlɔ, na ánya-nwu ámana na ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdubo bɔkana bɔta.

english_verse: On that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens and the kings of the earth.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔni kayaa bayikune kɔtu na katɔ mmɔ, na ɔni kalɔ lɛlɔ baga lɛnɔ kɔtu na kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni.

english_verse: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.
translation_verse: Na badubuƒie batuɔkplune bammɔ ƒui na bakya-ma ɔtɔ na bebo-ma lɛkpu bese na ubu kemmo utédu ka bátɛku-ma litemi na bani-ma kɔtu na emeyi pii adi kama.

english_verse: Both the moon and sun will be embarrassed and ashamed. The Lord All-Powerful will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, where he will show its rulers his wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Na kadi ƒui Unwoti ɔdubɔdi lɛga na Sion Kɔbi lɛlɔ ku Yerusalem ku bana benengu ƒui anumi na udie nwuna lɛgadi bukeye keyi. Na nwuna bukeye bɔya na kɔbuli ku ɔƒɛ bukeye bɔbla suu aani kalɛ na kɔƒa kuukpó ukyuli.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! I will praise you for doing the wonderful things you had planned and promised since ancient times.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, awɔ ndi mina Katɔti, ndubumwi-ɔ na lɛkɔliku ƒula lɛnyi katɔ, ɔsika ádi ƒula etemila lɛlɔ na ábla ala ebendi geen ani ndi ulu ɔni na áta ése ɔ́si kukuuku.

english_verse: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.
translation_verse: Katamikukɔ kpakplaa na adi ete bawabane ku bani mɔɔyaki ala na baanya-ma taakya. Na adi kabɛkɔ ku ɔyuli ete-ma si kadi kaabi éte bani na ala eekpóku-ma geen. Ɔsika balalane bammɔ kɔnyi kuse aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa uuƒwimi ala taatáƒiɛni kowodu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory. The Lord Has Saved Us
translation_verse: Na úlie ku kɔnwinimi kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ liwulu. Na baƒɔ bani ndi Israelƒuɔ bekisine mmɔ ni, aabala-ma bɔkwanyi ku lɛsɛ lɛni na baakya aani kalɛ na liƒlukutu ɔyuli ɔɔyala liwulu biala kenye na babla kpoo.

english_verse: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.
translation_verse: Na Sion Kɔbi kɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔdubɔlɔ bekyuli ƒui limeyi buni kadikɔ. Na use adila abuni geen ute-ma ku lɛna ku ntɛ bɔbuni ƒui geen.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will destroy the power of death and wipe away all tears. No longer will his people be insulted everywhere. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Ɔdubɔyila kukpi aani kalɛ na beebweli lɛla lɛdi na kɔsɔ kulakya lɛnɔ kudii. Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubuni imii udie ukyuli biala anumi na kɔƒa kɔni muukpó nwuna bekyuli kɔdubukeli ƒui kede kede na kayawi kemodi kammɔ kemmo, ɔsika Unwoti ɔlati násu ɔmɛni úse.

english_verse: At that time, people will say, “The Lord has saved us! Let's celebrate. We waited and hoped— now our God is here.”
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na bekyuli ƒui badubɔsu banini, “Sɔsɔ geen ni, bula Unwoti Katɔti ɔmmɔ na ɔdi mɛni. Anwu na bunye bɔɔnu ulu teete ka ubaƒɔ-bu. Bɛɛnu Unwoti ɔmmɔ, bɛya na lɛlɔ litaayɔ-bu na bɔkɛ ebiti geen na kalɛ na úbo ubaƒɔ ɔsu.”

english_verse: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔlati kɔnu kɔdubɔgyumana kɔbi kɔmɛni. Nsu badubɔnya Moab kadi bekyuli ama bakya aani kalɛ na bebuo baanya keti taakya libi akɔ.

english_verse: The walls of their fortresses will be knocked down and scattered in the dirt.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔƒɔ bana awodu ani na bátu bámana bana kalɔ na atɛ kalɔ na utu-nya ɔ́bwɛ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ unwini ɔtumu.

english_verse: Open the city gates for a law-abiding nation that is faithful to God.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛmi ɔban kɔyakun kɔmmɔ, na kadi bani bekyuli nse siin beduo. Ama bani náƒɔ bádi na bada bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: So always trust the Lord because he is forever our mighty rock.
translation_verse: Ti ƒula anu ƒui sia Unwoti lɛlɔ uwi ƒui, ɔsika anwu ndi kama kekpokɔ lɛtakpɛ lɛni nnye uwi ƒui.

english_verse: God has put down our enemies in their mountain city and rubbed it in the dirt.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔkɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ ni, uuboku-ma kalɔ. Na lɛma linengudi lɛni bekyuli mɔɔnu lɛlɔ katɔ katɔ ni, uutú-ni teegyingya na lɛɛbla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ teenwini ɔtumu.

english_verse: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.” The Lord Can Be Trusted
translation_verse: Lɛgba na badubɔnya mmɔ bavi na bawabane ku bekyuli bani mmomu na baanya taakya ndubɔkɔ-ma lɛlɔ bavi.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.
translation_verse: O Ati ɔni nse kedee, bekyuli bani ablala nse siin ni, bana kasiakɔ biala kaatɛ kalɔ ƒiaa. Na bana kɔvinkɔ ni, aayá na kɔɔbla suɛlɛ suɛlɛ.

english_verse: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ka aatɛ litemi siin ɔsu ni, bunye bɔɔnu-ɔ ulu, ɔsika bɔɔwia ka buteemwi-ɔ lɛnyi kedee na butaabla-a lɛyɔla uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Throughout the night, my heart searches for you, because your decisions show everyone on this earth how to live right.
translation_verse: Mɔɔwia-a kpakplaa usien umodi, na ɔtanta ni, ƒula kɔka kɔɔda mina kɔyu. Ɔsika si átɛku bayawine litemi ni, kayawi bekyuli baatɛya kalɛ na babla ƒula lɛyɔla.

english_verse: Even when the wicked are treated with mercy in this land of justice, they do wrong and are blind to your glory, our Lord.
translation_verse: Si ina bi lɛƒɔndia na ábla belikplune ni, baaadubo bɔti kalɛ na baabla ala siin. Kesii kani na siin bɔbla bɔkya muedi ni, ama likpidi bɔbla lilu lɛlɔ kani na baasia uwi ndi uwi na balánu kalɛ na Unwoti úbomo na uukeye lɛnɔ taati.

english_verse: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, áakɔliku ƒula kɔnu ése ka ebo-ma na ani-ma kɔtu, nsu balánu taati. Unwoti, ya na bekyuli bamɛni banu bati kalɛ na anumi égyie-ɔ ka agyumana ƒula kadi bekyuli na kɔƒa kukpo-ma. Na aya na ogya ɔni na áklibi ése ka ɔkyula ƒula bekisine ubakyula-ma.

english_verse: You will give us peace, Lord, because everything we have done was by your power.
translation_verse: O Unwoti ya na bulie na atu bɔyɔ kemmo, ɔsika ɔkɛnku ƒula ɔyikun kemmo na bɔ́kana na bɔ́bla ala ani na bɔ́bla.

english_verse: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.
translation_verse: O Unwoti bula Katɔti, benwoti bamba báadi-bu lɛlɔ na ƒula kama nsu awɔ ƒula lɛnyi kani na buudie kenye teemwi.

english_verse: Those enemies are now dead and can never live again. You have punished them— they are destroyed, completely forgotten.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani kabla na bɔ́bla ƒui béekpi báyii udu na basɔ baaadubo bɔta bubo mɛni! Awɔ nékpo-ma na áyila-ma udu ƒui na bekyuli báyiƒala-ma.

english_verse: Our nation has grown because of you, our Lord. We have more land than before, and you are honored. The Lord Gives Life to the Dead
translation_verse: Nsu abu ni, Unwoti, áya na búmomo búbu na ƒula lɛnyi líkeye. Bula kalɔ lɛmii lísie kama líbu na bula kalɔ kábɛbɛ kébu.

english_verse: When you punished our people, they turned and prayed to you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Unwoti, uwi ɔni na lɛbibo lɛ́siaku-bu na bɔ́ɔnɔ na bula lɛtuni kemmo ni, bɔ́wia-a kama ulu.

english_verse: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Búse aani uleku ɔni na ɔtɛ kɔwɔ na uubó adi ka kawɔƒɔ kaadu-nwu. Na lɛni na bɔ́da bɔ́lɛ awɔ Unwoti anumi.

english_verse: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.
translation_verse: Bɔ́kali bɔnii bula lɛbibo lɛdubɔlɛ-bu kɔsia aani kalɛ na ɔƒɔndane ɔni na ɔtɛ kɔwɔ ɔɔwɔ ubi, nsu únwini lɛƒua. Bútakana na bukpo bɔƒɔ kalɔ na bekisine kudɔ. Na bútakana kayawi kadi bekyuli bammɔ lɛnɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: Your people will rise to life! Tell them to leave their graves and celebrate with shouts. You refresh the earth like morning dew; you give life to the dead.
translation_verse: Nsu bani na badi awɔ badi ina ka békpi ni, badubɔsɔ bata ku bana ɔlɔna na belie ngba. O amii bani nkya kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo, bɛta na bidie lɛnu ku lɛlɔyɔ! Ɔsika ɔtanta amii na adi muuwi-mii lɛlɔ. Na kalɔ kammɔ kadubo kana bekpine bammɔ bɔwɔ bɔlɛku mmɔ.

english_verse: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry. The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Mina bekyuli, bɛgyu lɛgba na bitákalɛ lɛlɔ bɛkya lɛtɔ wetédu ka Unwoti kɔnyi kɔni ala na ɔdubo bina bekisine bɔbla kɔ́vi.

english_verse: The Lord will come out to punish everyone on earth for their sins. And when he does, those who did violent crimes will be known and punished.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti ɔ́si ɔdubo na ubani kayawi bekyuli ƒui kɔtu na bana ekpidi ɔsu. Na kalɔ kammɔ kadubɔsu ubugya ɔni na bekyuli bádu béwi-ka lɛlɔ. Na ɔsɔ ulakana ɔdi bɔbɛla lɛnɔ.

english_verse: On that day, Leviathan, the sea monster, will squirm and try to escape, but the Lord will kill him with a cruel, sharp sword. Protection and Forgiveness The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na kɔnyi limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Unwoti ɔdubo ku nwuna kewii bonwu kani mbo ɔkplu na kebo ɔbi yayaaya, na ɔni bayikune bani ntulo ƒui mmɔ kɔtu. Ada bonwu ɔni muukeli, na ɔɔkono lɛlɔ taatu teetéwi, ku liƒu kebweyi bonwu kani na ɛpu kemmo, na badi bayikune mmɔ na ɔdubo bɔdu ƒui.

english_verse: At that time you must sing about a fruitful vineyard.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔsu ɔnini, “Bidie ɔnu na egyiibi kemo kani mɔɔnwu kaduɛ mɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will protect it and always keep it watered. I will guard it day and night to keep it from harm.
translation_verse: Bɛsu ka ami Unwoti mɔɔnu kemo kammɔ lɛlɔ. Na muuwi-ka ntu uwi ndi uwi na mɔɔgyumana-ka lɛnɔ usien ku ɔƒɛ kalɛ na ukyuli ɔdi ulésie uletébile-ka.

english_verse: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.
translation_verse: Ńtakɛ kɔnyi na kemo kammɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika si bekisine badi-mi aani liyu ku alakpigya ni, nka ndubuduo-ma lɛlɔ mmɔ na lɛkyula-ma ƒui.

english_verse: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.
translation_verse: Na si use lɛni na békeli bébekpi-mi kɔtɔ na báwia ka buwi kenye ntu na bɔbla unwi ni, ɔdia-ma utulo.”

english_verse: Someday Israel will take root like a vine. It will blossom and bear fruit that covers the earth.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdubo ɔni mina kadi bekyuli badubo ligyiitu budie na Israel kadi bamɛni badubo bɔta na bedie evete na banwu ebi pii beyile kayawi.

english_verse: I, the Lord, didn't punish and kill the people of Israel as fiercely as I punished and killed their enemies.
translation_verse: Bɔni na Unwoti ɔ́ni Israelƒuɔ kɔtu kalɛ na ɔ́ni bana bekisine kɔtu? Munuu ɔ́du-ma kalɛ na ɔ́du bekyuli bani nádu Israelƒuɔ?

english_verse: I carefully measured out Israel's punishment and sent the scorching heat to chase them far away.
translation_verse: Kekpo ku bana bɔbɔku taatákya kɔlɔ bamba kemmo ndi lɛla lɛni na éti ékpoku-ma aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔni muukpó taasi ɔƒɛ katukɔ na uubó ala taatɔlɔku.

english_verse: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship. The Lord Will Bring His People Together
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na ndubudie kɔtu bɔni bana lɛlɔ na bana ekpidi ammɔ alɛ-ma lɛlɔ ƒui. Na lɛnɔ ni, ntu bábwɛ akpabi ani na bátu ku atabi mmɔ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. Na babwɛ Asera baƒiɔ na bagyu-ma ku lɛƒiɔgyii lɛmmɔ na abi lɛlɔ kesii kani na baakyula oloƒui teete-ma mmɔ ƒui na basɔ balanu ka ɔdi unye.

english_verse: When broken branches fall to the ground, women pick them up to feed the fire. But these people are so stupid that the God who created them will show them no mercy.
translation_verse: Na si egyii ammɔ kɔgba kɔ́kwii ni, kɔɔƒɛ na beleku babayɔ-ku basala ogya. Ɔsika lɛni na Israel kadi bekyuli bamɛni bese na belenu na balanu ala taati. Anwuɔsu na bana udiene lɛnɔ ɔɔɔdubo-ma kɔnyana bɔnu.

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ɔni na Unwoti ɔdubo-mii bubo kedenkɛ lɛlɔ na ɔla-mii unwi unwi ɔsiku Euƒrate Ketu kɔtu na ɔƒɛ katukɔ útédu Egyipte utukwalɛ kalɔ na ɔƒɛ kanukɔ aani kalɛ na beebó kamu na kedenkɛ lɛlɔ teewiile-ka ebi.

english_verse: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na badubɔvwi lise bete bani na báyii bakya Asiria kalɔ lɛlɔ ku bani na bábɔku bálɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na bebo bebemwi Unwoti na kɔbi kedee kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na Yerusalem.

english_verse: The city of Samaria above a fertile valley is in for trouble! Its leaders are drunkards, who stuff themselves with food and wine. But they will be like flowers that dry up and wilt.
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ beete Eƒraim ntɛ banine bani nti lɛlɔtina lɛka aani kagabwa, na lɛkɛ ku ala abuni ani na baanu ka Israel ubo ɔsu. Baasíku ala amɛni na ɔkwalɛ ɔni nélie lɛmwi na kesii kani na baabla-nya mmɔ, na baaní ntɛ bɔmmɔ teekpi. Nsu ala ammɔ aayii udu, aani kalɛ na egyii anwula aayɛyɛ kalɛ.

english_verse: Only the Lord is strong and powerful! His mighty hand will strike them down with the force of a hailstorm or a mighty whirlwind or an overwhelming flood.
translation_verse: Bɛnu, Unwoti ɔdanku ukyuli ɔni na úbomo, na ubo ɔyikun ku ɔlɔkplu, aani etubankɛ ku ɔnantu ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔni muubile ala, na ɔdubo ubetiku-ma ku kɔnyi.

english_verse: Every drunkard in Ephraim takes pride in Samaria, but it will be crushed.
translation_verse: Na lɛlɔtina lɛka kagabwa kani na beti ni, bekyuli badubɔkɔ banya-ka lɛlɔ bavi.

english_verse: Samaria above a fertile valley will quickly lose its glory. It will be gobbled up like the first ripe fig at harvest season.
translation_verse: Na nwuna bɔdia bɔni muukeye nsu uuubo bɔyɛyɛ na ɔkwalɛ ɔni nélie lɛmwi mmɔ ni, útavumana ku kɔnwingyie ebi ani mɔɔka bugyie. Na si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́nu-nya na ɔɔkpɔɔlɔ-nya ɔdi udie kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: When this time comes, the Lord All-Powerful will be a glorious crown for his people who survive.
translation_verse: Si uwi ɔni na ala amɛni álɛ lɛni áwɔlɔ ni, Unwoti ɔni ndi kadi ƒui Unwoti ɔdubunwini kagabwa kani muukeye ku lɛka lɛni bédi na lɛɛdia bɔnu na nwuna nkyuli ɛlɛɛ bani mebu lili.

english_verse: He will see that justice rules and that his people are able to defend their cities. Corrupt Leaders Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Na ɔdubunwini kɔyu kɔni mɔɔtɛ litemi siin ute bani mɔɔtɛ bekyuli etemila. Na anwu ɔmmɔ ndubɔbla ɔlɔkplu ku ɔyikun ute bani nnye ɔban kenye ka babɔku kekpo biala.

english_verse: Priests and prophets stumble because they are drunk. Their minds are too confused to receive God's messages or give honest decisions.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti bakpane ku Katɔti kenye bediene ƒui benye baabla ntɛ ekpila na ntɛ kpakplaa bɔni ɔsu. Na baagbánta si baanu kɔyu kemmo ala iye baadi kasusu kpakplaa kadi na lɛla lɛdi lɛlɔ. Na ntɛ bɔ́ya na béƒu bakɛ.

english_verse: Their tables are covered, completely covered, with their stinking vomit.
translation_verse: Bana ala kasiakɔ ƒui kɔdala sɔɔn náƒɔ-ku na kesii kadi kétebu na kɔbɔ ala ani muusé lɛlɔ átaƒɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: You drunken leaders are like babies! How can you possibly understand or teach the Lord's message?
translation_verse: “Na ɔma bene na ɔdubo ala bɔtina? Na ɔma bene na uudie ala kalɔ taatina? Bani mɔɔnyimi lɛnyii munuu bani na basia lɛgba?

english_verse: You don't even listen— all you hear is senseless sound after senseless sound.
translation_verse: Unye ɔɔká ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ taasia kama egyu egyu kɔlɛ kɔlɛ.”

english_verse: So, the Lord will speak to his people in strange sounds and foreign languages.
translation_verse: Na ka banii belénu litemi ɔsu ni, kadi bamba bekyuli na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na babatɛmi bete-ma.

english_verse: He promised you perfect peace and rest, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: Ɔsika anwu ɔlati ɔ́su-ma ka bekyuli bani ƒui na lɛla lɛdi liikpóku ni, bebo-nwu kudɔ na badubɔkɛ bɔnwuna, nsu béni na belenu.

english_verse: Now his message to you will be senseless sound after senseless sound. Then you will fall backwards, injured and trapped. False Security Is Fatal
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu béti Unwoti ɔda bubo aani litemi keeke ku ala bɔka taasia kama egyu egyu banii bla lɛmɛni ku lɛni ngyie kani.

english_verse: You rulers of Jerusalem do nothing but sneer; now you must listen to what the Lord says.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu binu, amii bani mɔɔdi bekyuli lɛlɔ, na bɛda Katɔti litemi bɛɛƒianku na Yerusalem.

english_verse: Do you think you have an agreement with death and the world of the dead? Why do you trust in your lies to keep you safe from danger and the mighty flood?
translation_verse: Bɛɛkun lɛmɛnɛ taasu bɛnini, “Abu ku kukpi bínyimi ka kɔsɔ kuládu-bu, na bɔsɔ buleduo kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo iye si lɛbibo ku kawɔlɔkɔ lɛbibo kpakplaa lɛmmɔ lídu ni, ɔdubɔvia-bu lili, ɔsika búti ɔkɔ bɔ́nyi búnwini katamikukɔ na búti katuala bɔ́bla kabɛkɔ.”

english_verse: And so the Lord says, “I'm laying a firm foundation for the city of Zion. It's a valuable cornerstone proven to be trustworthy; no one who trusts it will ever be disappointed.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Binu! Lɛ́ƒuna lɛtabi lɛni náƒɔ kuye na Sion, na ɔdi lɛtabi kpakplaa lɛni mabala kowodu likpo. Na ukyuli biala ɔni maƒɔ madi ni, enu alaƒɛ-nwu kudii.

english_verse: Your agreement with death and the world of the dead will be broken. Then angry, roaring waves will sweep over you.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni na bínyimi ku kukpi ku kaƒiɔtɔ mmɔ ƒui ɔbla kekeeke. Na si kawɔlɔkɔ lɛbibo kpakplaa lɛmmɔ lídu ni, lɛdubo-mii bubo bɔva kalɔ.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night an overwhelming flood will wash you away. The terrible things that happen will teach you this lesson:
translation_verse: Na kɔlɛ kɔlɛ kɔni na lɛbibo lɛmɛni lɛdububo ni, lɛni kani na lɛdubo-mii buteetiku lɛdigye ku ɔƒiiwi ku usien lɛnɔ.” Na si uwi ɔni na bɛdubunu kenye kamɛni kalɔ ni, ɔdubɔya na liƒu libendi lɛda-mii geen.

english_verse: The Lord will fiercely attack as he did at Mount Perazim and in Gibeon Valley. But this time the Lord will do something surprising, not what you expect.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubɔta kɔnakunwi ku kɔnyi aani kalɛ na ɔ́bla dii na Persim Kɔbi lɛlɔ ɔni na úsie Gibeon Kɔwɛ kemmo. Na ɔdububo ubabla nwuna kabla, na bɛgyi ka kaaatɛ kalɔ! Na bɛgyi lɛnɔ ka nwuna ablala udu bamba uuubo.

english_verse: So you had better stop sneering or you will be in worse shape than ever before. I heard the Lord All-Powerful threaten the whole country with destruction. All Wisdom Comes from the Lord
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛda bina edumi ku lɛma bɛya si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, bina lɛbuli lɛni nényimi-mii lɛdubo bɔbi bubu, ɔsika línu kadi ƒui Unwoti Katɔti lɛla lɛni na únyimi úse ɔ́si kalɛ na ɔdubɔkyula kalɔ kana ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Pay close attention to what I am saying.
translation_verse: Bise atu na binu lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu-mii, na bɛƒɔ mina etemila ani ndanku nte-mii.

english_verse: When a field is ready, they scatter the seeds of dill and cumin; they plant the seeds of wheat and barley in the proper places and sow other grains around the edges.
translation_verse: Si ɔ́klibi kalɔ ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔɔɔdi edula lidu lidu ku kutu akyala edula lidu na ɔɔkya adi biala ku ana kakyakɔ?

english_verse: They learn this from their God.
translation_verse: Unwoti nátina umonsene ulu ɔbuni ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔkya edula.

english_verse: Wheat and barley are pounded, but not beaten to pulp; they are run over with a wagon, but not ground to dust.
translation_verse: Bɔkɔ na baakɔ́ edula ebi ɔlaaƒɔ taabla bodobodo Anwuɔsu belebo-nya kedenkɛ lɛlɔ taabwɛ na ɔbla ɔlaaƒɔ na kewiilekɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: This wonderful knowledge comes from the Lord All-Powerful, who has such great wisdom.
translation_verse: Ala ɔtinane unengudi geen na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔdi na úti lɛnunda bonwu úte umonsene.

english_verse: Jerusalem, city of David, the place of my altar, you are in for trouble! Celebrate your festivals year after year.
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ beete awɔ Dawid ɔma unengudi, kesii kani básia lɛnyi banii Ariel, ɔsika eeti ƒula akpala teeboku lɛkwa ndi lɛkwa taabakpa.

english_verse: I will still make you suffer, and your people will cry when I make an altar of you.
translation_verse: Nsu ina amu ndubɔya na ɔgbankpi ɔsiaku-ɔ na adubo keku ku kɔnyana buwulo. Na Yerusalem ɔdubo ubese aani Ariel ɔni kalɔ ndi lɛkpabi lɛni na ubugya ɔ́ƒɔ-ni lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: From deep in the earth, you will call out for help with only a faint whisper.
translation_verse: Na kaƒiɔtɔ kani kemmo na badubo-ɔ bɔva ni, mmɔ na adubo kabɛnsɛ butaatɛmi taasiku aani ukpine kɔyu na kalɔ kemmo mmɔ na ɔtumu akɔ.

english_verse: Then your cruel enemies will suddenly be swept away like dust in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔdubo ƒula bekisine bubo bɔtɔlɔku kɔnakunwi aani ɔtumu ku aƒaƒaa.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will come to your rescue with a thundering earthquake and a fiery whirlwind.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔdububo, na bɛdubunu ka katɔ keedu momoomo, na kalɔ kaakunku, na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa uukpó, na ogya ɔni mɔɔkyula ala uudie unyemi.

english_verse: Every brutal nation that attacks Jerusalem and makes it suffer will disappear like a dream when night is over.
translation_verse: Na kadi balalane bani ƒui muukpó Yerusalem na baayá na uubó abi ni, badubo bɔyii udu aani kalɛ na baatɛ teegye kɔna na kɔyi-ɔ si kadi kégye.

english_verse: Those nations that attack Mount Zion will suffer from hunger and thirst. They will dream of food and drink but wake up weary and hungry and thirsty as ever. Prophets Who Fool Themselves
translation_verse: Kɔka ku utukwɛ ɔdubo kadi bekyuli bani ndubo bɔta bukpo Yerusalem bɔda geen. Na badubugye kɔna na ɔbla-ma aani bɔdi na bada nsu badubɔta na banu ka kɔna kani na bégye na kɔka ku utukwɛ ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔkɔ katɔ ubu.

english_verse: Be shocked and stunned, you prophets! Refuse to see. Get drunk and stagger, but not from wine.
translation_verse: Amii bibulo bɔƒɔdi na bibile bina anumi na bibulo bɔnu. Na bɛkɛ bitaagbanta ina ka ɔɔɔdi ntɛ na bɛ́ni! Na bɛdubɔnu liƒu lɛla lɛni ndubo libalɛ-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has made you drowsy; he put you into a deep sleep and covered your head.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́ya na lɛlɛɛ lɛ́ƒɔ-mii anumi susuusu na bɛ́lɛɛ bísie ɔgyu. Na úti ala úbi bina lili ku anumi amii bani ndi nwuna kenye bediene ku bekyuli bani mɔɔnu ala taasu bekyuli.

english_verse: Now his message is like a sealed letter to you. Some of you say, “We can't read it, because it's sealed.”
translation_verse: Na kenye kani na budie taatina bɔmɛni bɔdanku ƒui bɔdi lɛbɛla lɛni na Katɔti útile-mu kenye. Na si ɔdi ɔgyi bɔka muedi ni, ɔdubɔsu ɔnini, “Bétile bunweni bɔmmɔ kenye ɔsu bulakana bɔka.”

english_verse: Others say, “We can't read it, because we don't know how to read.”
translation_verse: Na bani na baaagyi bɔka lɛnɔ badubɔsu banini, “Bɔɔɔdubo bɔkana bɔka.”

english_verse: The Lord has said: “These people praise me with their words, but they never really think about me. They worship me by repeating rules made up by humans.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bekyuli bamɛni bada bana kenye kani baabu-mi, nsu balayɔ-mi na bana kayi kemmo. Keeke kani na baabla-mi kabla. Baatina kayawi lɛlɔ ala aani si mina ɔda bubo bɔdi.

english_verse: So once again I will do things that shock and amaze them, and I will destroy the wisdom of those who claim to know and understand.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu nsɔ ndubo-ma buyu bɔtu ku liƒu ala ani ndubɔbla-ma kalɛ kadi. Ndubo banundane lɛnunda udu bɔyila. Na lídie lɛ́tina ka bakutine lɛnunda lɛɛɛdi lɛla lɛdi.”

english_verse: You are in for trouble, if you try to hide your plans from the Lord! Or if you think what you do in the dark can't be seen.
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ beete bekyuli bani mɔɔbla ala bɔbɛ kemmo na baakali ka Unwoti ɔɔɔgyi, na baabla ala lɛdisa kemmo na beeye banini, “Ɔma mɔɔnu-bu? Na ɔma ndubo bɔti?”

english_verse: You have it all backwards. A clay dish doesn't say to the potter, “You didn't make me. You don't even know how.” Hope for the Future
translation_verse: Bínwini ala bɛ́lɛ kekuma, aani si lɛvɔti náƒɔ kuye litulo ɔvɔne, munuu lɛkyami lɛni na bávɔ mmɔ lɛdubɔkana na lɛsu ɔvɔne ɔnii, “Ɔɔɔdi awɔ návɔ-mi?”

english_verse: Soon the forest of Lebanon will become a field with crops, thick as a forest.
translation_verse: Na uwi klukwii ɔdi kama ni, Lebanon akumiɔ ƒui adubunwini edula mmo, na edula ammɔ adubɔlɛ enye kemo na ana bɔdia adubɔbla aani lɛku na nnye.

english_verse: The deaf will be able to hear whatever is read to them; the blind will be freed from a life of darkness.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, batutine muedi badubo buteenu ala ani na baaká teete-ma taasiku ɔku ɔdi kemmo. Na ɔbla banumbwɛne nwaa ɔni na ɔsɔ ulése-ma suu aani lɛdisa kemmo na bakya.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will celebrate and shout because of the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Na bawabane ku bani mɔɔyaki ala ƒui ni, badubɔdi limeyi ku kɔvanu na bebo kudu momoomo na Israel Unwoti Katɔti ɔni nse kedee ɔsu.

english_verse: All who are cruel and arrogant will be gone forever. Those who live by crime will disappear,
translation_verse: Na balalane ku belikplune ƒui badubo udu bɔyii. Na bani mɔɔsa lili likpidi na lɛsɛ ala bɔbla lɛlɔ badubo bɔyii kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: together with everyone who tells lies in court and keeps innocent people from getting a fair trial.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔ kenye bediene bani mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ teedie ala kenye kalɛ na badu bekyuli bani na nka bátaƒiɔ kɔtɔ lɛ́nɔ badubo bɔyii ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord who rescued Abraham has this to say about Jacob's descendants: “They will no longer be ashamed and disgraced.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na Unwoti ɔni nédie Abraham ɔ́su Israel kadi bekyuli ɔnini, “Liƒu lɛsɔ lɛɛɛdubo mina kadi bekyuli bɔda na kɔƒa lɛnɔ kɔsɔ kulékpo-ma.

english_verse: When they see how great I have made their nation, they will praise and honor me, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si bánu bana bebi pii bani na bebo ku kalɛ na líte-ma kusɛ kusɛ na bákɛ ala pii ni, badubo ami Israel Katɔti kedee butaabu na beteemwi-mi.

english_verse: This is the Lord's message for his rebellious people: “You follow your own plans instead of mine; you make treaties without asking me, and you keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Bɔbuɛ ute mina bekyuli bani mɔɔta teenye-mi lɛlɔ. Ama bani mɔɔkya kɔkwɛ na ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na basia babla ala na ɔɔɔdi mina ulu. Biinyimi ala teete lɛlɔ kalɛ na bitaadi-nya lɛlɔ na uwi ɔni na bíteye-mi bítenu. Anwuɔsu na ala ekpidi kani na bili bɛɛbla.

english_verse: You trust Egypt for protection. So you refuse my advice and send messengers to Egypt to beg their king for help.
translation_verse: Na bíti bina anu ƒui bɛ́sia Egyipteƒuɔ lɛlɔ ka ama ndubɔgyumana-mii. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bíni mina bɔlɛ na Egyipte mmomu na bɛ́tala batu bɛ́kya bɛnii bete-mii kebunku. Na Ƒarao na bíti bina kayi bɛ́sia.

english_verse: The king's power reaches from the city of Zoan as far south as Hanes.
translation_verse: Ƒarao ubo ɔyikun na ɔɔdi lɛlɔ ɔ́si Soan ɔma unengudi na kalɔ kammɔ katɔ kakɛ útédu Hanes ɔma unengudi na kada kakɛ.

english_verse: But Egypt can't protect you, and to trust that nation is useless and foolish.”
translation_verse: Nsu Egyipteƒuɔ baaadubo-mii bɔkana bubunku anwuɔsu kɔsia kɔdi kuuubo-nwu kemmo ka biti bina anu bɛsia-ma lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: This is a message about the animals of the Southern Desert: “You people carry treasures on donkeys and camels. You travel to a feeble nation through a troublesome desert filled with lions and flying fiery dragons.
translation_verse: Unwoti údie lɛla lɛdi ɔ́tina na kalɔ kakwiidi bebuo lɛlɔ ɔnini, “Kalɔ kani kemmo na bɔnɔ ku lɛbibo lɛkya, na bagyata bagyani ku beledi ku balakpi bekpidi baakya, na bebuo ala betine bebliidi ku benengudi bani mbo keƒu beti batu bammɔ akɛla na bésela kalɔ kani neeebo kɔsia kɔdi kuuute-ma kemmo.

english_verse: Egypt can't help you! That's why I call that nation a helpless monster.” Israel Refuses To Listen
translation_verse: Bésela Egyipteƒuɔ kudɔ bani kebunku naaadubo-ma kɔsia kɔdi bɔlɛ anwuɔsu mɔɔlɔ-ma Rahab, kebweyi kani neeebo kɔsia.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to write down his message for his people, so that it would be there forever.
translation_verse: Unwoti úsie anumi ɔnini, “Sie na eténweni kenye kadi asia lɛtabi lɛlɔ ete-ma ku bebuo lɛku lɛlɔ na unwini likposela kenye budie use ute-ma uwi ƒui.”

english_verse: They have turned against the Lord and can't be trusted. They have refused his teaching
translation_verse: Báta bénye Unwoti lɛlɔ na bénwini kama bákya-nwu ku ɔkɔ ala bɔbla. Anwuɔsu baaadi bekyuli bani na muunú-nwu bɔlɛ.

english_verse: and have said to his messengers and prophets: Don't tell us what God has shown you and don't preach the truth. Just say what we want to hear, even if it's false.
translation_verse: Amii mɔɔsu Katɔti kenye bediene ku nwuna batalane bɛnii, “Bitakɔ litemi buni lɛdi lɛsa bitete-bu, na bitasu-bu kenye kabuni kadi kani na Unwoti úbo-mii ɔda ɔnii bɛsu-bu lɛnɔ. Mmomu bɛsu-bu bula kayi lɛyɔla ku ala abuni ani ana na buugyé.

english_verse: Stop telling us what God has said! We don't want to hear any more about the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Na bɛda-bu bɛnyonu na bɛwia kasiakɔ. Ɔsika bɔsɔ buláwia ka bunu lɛla lɛdi bɔsiku Israel Katɔti Kedee ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ lɛnɔ!”

english_verse: Now this is the answer of the holy One of Israel: “You rejected my message, and you trust in violence and lies.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Israel Unwoti Kedee ɔnini, “Ka bíni mina litemi na likyulikpi ala bɔbla ku ɔkɔ ala mmomu mɔɔda-mii kubiti ɔsu ni,

english_verse: This sin is like a crack that makes a high wall quickly crumble
translation_verse: likpidi lɛmɛni línwini aani kowodu kɔka kɔni muubimi wetédu ka kowodu kɔmmɔ kɔ́lɛ kúbayu kalɔ.

english_verse: and shatter like a crushed bowl. There's not a piece left big enough to carry hot coals or to dip out water.” Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na bɛdubo bɔbwɛ aani ebui kɔkɛ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ɔni na kakɛ kadi muedi kaladia ina ogya buti butédie bɔsiku asi bamba kemmo.”

english_verse: The holy Lord God of Israel had told all of you, “I will keep you safe if you turn back to me and calm down. I will make you strong if you quietly trust me.” Then you stubbornly
translation_verse: Israel Unwoti Kedee Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔnini, “Ndubudie-mii na bina ɔgbankpi biala kemmo si bíti bina anu ku kayi ƒui bɛ́sia-mii lɛlɔ na bínwini bíbo-mi kudɔ na bíboku lɛlɔ kalɔ kpoo.

english_verse: said, “No! We will safely escape on speedy horses.” But those who chase you will be even faster.
translation_verse: Nsu bíni na bɛ́su bɛnini, ‘Oowo! Bɔdubo bukeli ku bula bapɔnkɔ na bɔtɔlɔ bula bekisine kudɔ.’ Na bɛdubo bukeli sɔsɔ! Nsu bina bekisine bammɔ mmomu ndubo bukeli butulo-mii.

english_verse: As few as five of them, or even one, will be enough to chase a thousand of you. Finally, all that will be left will be a few survivors as lonely as a flag pole on a barren hill. The Lord Will Show Mercy
translation_verse: Na ukisine unwi ɔdubo bina nkyuli eti leevu bɔbɔku. Na bana ɛlɔ muedi badubɔbɔku bina ƒui batɔlɔku. Na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, bina ɛlɛɛ kani ndubo bubu na bɛbla kɔnyana aani kalɛ na beekú lɛkpa linwi pɛ teenyene kɔbi kɔdi lili.” Katɔti Ɔdubɔnu Nwuna Kadi Bekyuli Kɔnyana

english_verse: The Lord God is waiting to show how kind he is and to have pity on you. The Lord always does right; he blesses those who trust him.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́ geen ka ɔnu-mi kɔnyana ku lɛƒɔndia, ɔsika Unwoti ɔdi Katɔti ɔni mɔɔtɛ litemi na ulu siin lɛlɔ. Na bekyuli bani ƒui muunye taanu-nwu anumi ni, uute-ma kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, you don't need to cry anymore. The Lord is kind, and as soon as he hears your cries for help, he will come.
translation_verse: O amii Sion kadi bekyuli bani nli Yerusalem ɔma, útalɛ ka bɛsɔ bilie biteewulo. Unwoti ubo lɛƒɔndia geen na si bɛ́va bɛ́kpali-nwu ɔdubunu na nanu-mii kɔnyana.

english_verse: The Lord has given you trouble and sorrow as your food and drink. But now you will again see the Lord, your teacher, and he will guide you.
translation_verse: Ina ka Unwoti úte-mii lɛbibo adila na bɛ́di na úte-mii bukpoku ntu na bɛ́ni ni, ɔdubɔya na bɛnu-nwu aani bina Unwoti ku ala ɔtinane na ɔtɔnku-mii.

english_verse: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, you will hear a voice saying, “This is the road! Now follow it.”
translation_verse: Na si kɔdianu na bídeyi bésie o-o, kɔmii na bídeyi bísie o-o ni, bɛdubunu ka lɛdi lɛdi lɛɛtɛmiku-mii na kama lɛnini, “Aanu kasiakɔ mɛni! Bo na abasia-nwu lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Then you will treat your idols of silver and gold like garbage; you will throw them away like filthy rags.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, bɛdubɔnu bina baƒiɔ bani na bɛ́vɔ, ku bani na bɛ́nwi na bɛ́kwaa-nya ku sika ugyiedi aani kebu alakpi ani muusé lɛlɔ na bibo-nya biwiakun.

english_verse: The Lord will send rain to water the seeds you have planted—your fields will produce more crops than you need, and your cattle will graze in open pastures.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔya na ɔnantu ɔna uwi ɔbuni lɛlɔ na bina edula ani na bɛ́va adia na emomo geen. Na bina bebuo lɛnɔ bakɛ kadikɔ kabuni na kalɔ ƒiaa lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Even the oxen and donkeys that plow your fields will be fed the finest grain.
translation_verse: Na bebuo bani na bíbo anwami kɔgba bɛ́da na benye beegúlu kalɔ teete-mii muedi bɛdubute-ma antabi abuni ani na bígyuo bídie akpa na bakun.

english_verse: On that day people will be slaughtered and towers destroyed, but streams of water will flow from high hills and towering mountains.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, bekyuli bɔdu bɔdubo bumomo, na lɛtɔ libendi lɛƒɛ liwi kalɔ, na Katɔti ɔdubɔya na ntukpa bɔlɛ abi enengudi ku ani na ákuku mmɔ eli na ataagba taayu ɔkwalɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord will bandage his people's injuries and heal the wounds he has caused. The moon will shine as bright as the sun, and the sun will shine seven times brighter than usual. It will be like the light of seven days all at once. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Kɔbuli kɔdubo buteekeye nwaa aani ɔƒɛ, na ɔƒɛ bukeye bɔdubo katɔ bɔkɔ geen akpa maatɛ aani emeyi maatɛ ɔƒɛ bukeye na básala. Katɔti ɔdubɔmana nwuna bekyuli alɛbi ani na báƒɔ na ekpi, na udie ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ bana lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is coming from far away with his fiery anger and thick clouds of smoke. His angry words flame up like a destructive fire;
translation_verse: Bɛɛnu ka Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́si ɔdubo agyu kakaaka na ɔkɛ ku kɔnyi kɔni nse aani ogya ku uyɔ ɔni mɔɔda na ɔ́kɔ úsela katɔ ƒui. Na etemila ani na mɔɔlɛ́-nwu kenye kemmo ese aani ogya unyemi ɔni mɔɔkyula ala.

english_verse: he breathes out a flood that comes up to the neck. He sifts the nations and destroys them. Then he puts a bridle in every foreigner's mouth and leads them to doom.
translation_verse: Nwuna kɔnyi kuse aani ketu kani néyi kábada ukyuli limɔ na ɔɔtanyi kadi bekyuli ƒui taaƒuna-ma akɔ na ɔɔkyula bani na útaƒuna.

english_verse: The Lord's people will sing as they do when they celebrate a religious festival at night. The Lord is Israel's mighty rock, and his people will be as happy as they are when they follow the sound of flutes to the mountain where he is worshiped.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti bekyuli badubo ɔnu budie aani kalɛ na beedie ɔnu si baadi limeyi kedee na usien. Unwoti ndi lɛtakpɛ lɛni lɛlɔ na Israel kadi bekyuli békpo bana kama. Na lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ nwuna kadi bekyuli geen aani kalɛ na baakɛ lisu ku atoloyii bɔvwi si bákɔ bésela abi lɛlɔ kesii kani na beesié taatákpa-nwu mmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will get furious. His fearsome voice will be heard, his arm will be seen ready to strike, and his anger will be like a destructive fire, followed by thunderstorms and hailstones.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔdubo kɔnyi buti geen na benu-nwu lɛdi lɛni mɔɔda liƒu na nwuna livoƒi ɔsu. Na ogya ɔni ndubo butaada ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔni muukpó ku ɔnantu ku etubankɛ ani mɔɔna ndubɔtina ka Katɔti nédie nwuna kɔnu ka ubile ala.

english_verse: When the Assyrians hear the Lord's voice and see him striking with his iron rod, they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Na si Asiriaƒuɔ bénu Katɔti lɛdi ku ala ani na ɔdubo nwuna kɔnu budie na ɔbla mɛni ni, liƒu bonwu lɛdubo-ma bɔda.

english_verse: He will attack them in battle, and each time he strikes them, it will be to the music of tambourines and harps.
translation_verse: Na lɛtuni biala nébo-ma lɛlɔ aani ebola ani na Katɔti ɔɔyula-ma kalɛ ni, nwuna kadi bekyuli badubo kɔku ku agyala lidu butaagya taasiaku-nwu lɛlɔ ku lɛnu budie.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord got a place ready for burning the body of the dead king. The place for the fire is deep and wide, the wood is piled high, and the Lord will start the fire by breathing out flaming sulfur.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si kukuuku ni, Katɔti ɔ́ɔklibi kesii kadi úse úte Asiriaƒuɔ baƒiɔ bani na baatu lili aani ɔga ɔni ndubo bukpi. Na ogya ɔmɛni kasalakɔ kadi ubu voo ɔni na nwuna kemmo kábɛbɛ na bátɛ ekyweni bése béte-nwu. Na ogya agyabi ku ɔnyi ɔni na Katɔti ɔdubɔnwuna ɔlɛku nwuna lɛlɔ kemmo na ɔdubuti ɔtu ɔkya ekyweni ammɔ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you go to Egypt for help, or if you depend on an army of chariots or a powerful cavalry. Instead you should depend on and trust the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ ute amii bani muusié Egyipteƒuɔ kudɔ ka bebunku-mii. Amii muuti bina anu taasia bana bapɔnkɔ beliene lɛlɔ ku bana bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ lɛlɔ ka bemomo na bebo ɔyikun ɔsu. Bɛnu bɛti ka Israel Katɔti Kedee mmomu lɛlɔ na ɔlɛka biti bina anumi bɛsia.

english_verse: The Lord isn't stupid! He does what he promises, and he can bring doom. If you are cruel yourself, or help those who are evil, you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Unwoti útadɔlɔ! Ɔɔdi kenye kani na úse lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔkana na ɔya na kɔtu bɔni bubo ukyuli lɛlɔ na ɔyii udu. Na ama ndi balalane ku bani muunye teebunku likyulikpi ala bablane

english_verse: The Egyptians are mere humans. They aren't God. Their horses are made of flesh; they can't live forever. When the Lord shows his power, he will destroy the Egyptians and all who depend on them. Together they will fall.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bayawine kani na Egyipteƒuɔ badi, ama bani na bɛɛkali ka badubo-mii bubunku, na ɔɔɔdi ama ndi Katɔti. Na bana bapɔnkɔ lɛnɔ ni, bebuo ku ɔlɔna kani na badi na baaadi kɔyu kemmo lɛla lɛni muulie uwi ƒui. Si Unwoti Katɔti údie nwuna ɔyikun keyi ni, ɔdubɔyila Egyipteƒuɔ ƒui udu ku bani ƒui na béti bana anu básia-ma lɛlɔ na bakywi basa.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me, “I will roar and attack like a fearless lion not frightened by the shouts of shepherds trying to protect their sheep. That's how I will come down and fight on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Lɛni na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ndubo bɔkwanyi na libo lɛdi aani gyata ɔni na ulayia lɛla ndi lɛla, na lɛtu ntébi kebweyi kani na mɔɔwia liƒie lɛlɔ. Na baƒonu badane kɔvanu kɔdi kulakana-mi bɔbɔku bɔtɔlɔku na neeeƒie lɛla lɛni na mɔɔwia. Udu ɔmmɔ ɔnwa na ndubuti libo mbekpo na Sion Kɔbi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will protect Jerusalem like a mother bird circling over her nest.” Come Back to the Lord
translation_verse: Kalɛ na aasɛ uuveyi taaka taamana nwuna lɛyu taagyumana nwuna bebi ni, lɛni kani na ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ndubo Yerusalem bɔgyumana na lidie-nwu.”

english_verse: People of Israel, come back! You have completely turned from the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Amii Israelƒuɔ, bɛsɔ binwini bibo ami ɔni lɛlɔ na bɛ́ta bínye kpakplaa mmɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: The time is coming when you will throw away your idols of silver and gold, made by your sinful hands.
translation_verse: Ɔsika limeyi lɛdi lɛdubo lɛni na bɛdubuti bina sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi baƒiɔ bani na bíti bina enu ani likpidi bɔbla bɔ́ƒɔ na bɛ́vɔ mmɔ ƒui biwiakun.

english_verse: The Assyrians will be killed, but not by the swords of humans. Their young men will try to escape, but they will be captured and forced into slavery.
translation_verse: “Na badubɔyila Asiriaƒuɔ ƒui udu na kewii kenye, ɔni na ɔɔɔdi ukyuli ndubo-ma bɔdu. Na bana bakloƒu badubɔwia ulu ka bekeli nsu badubuƒie-ma ƒui, na bani néƒie-ma mmɔ benye-ma lɛlɔ na bataabla-ma kabla.

english_verse: Their fortress will fall when terror strikes; their army officers will be frightened and run from the battle. This is what the Lord has said, the Lord whose fiery furnace is built on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Bana kɔgyumanakɔ kpakplaa kɔni na bátu bényene mmɔ ƒui kɔdubɔƒɛ kuwi kalɔ, uwi ɔni na ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔda ɔlɛ-ma lɛlɔ ɔni na baaagyi beeese. Na bana bekpone benengu ƒui badubɔyia na bekeli na kekpokɔ mmɔ.” Lɛni na Unwoti ɔni násala lɛgyavonku lɛyu bonwu ɔ́lɛ Sion Kɔbi lɛlɔ ɔ́su.

english_verse: They will be a place of safety from stormy winds, a stream in the desert, and a rock that gives shade from the heat of the sun.
translation_verse: Na badubunwini kabɛkɔ bete bekyuli si uwi ɔni na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa uukpó. Na badubunwini libiɔ bete bekyuli na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo ku lɛtakpɛ lɛni ndubɔkya bekyuli ɔyuli si ɔƒɛ ɔɔbi.

english_verse: Then everyone who has eyes will open them and see, and those who have ears will pay attention.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala na ubo anumi ɔdubo-nya bubimi na ɔnu, na bani na bebo atu lɛnɔ badubuse atu na benu.

english_verse: All who are impatient will take time to think; everyone who stutters will talk clearly.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani na beeebo lɛlɔ buwi na bana lɛlɔ kemmo lɛnɔ badubɔkɛ kayi na babla kasusu. Na bani mɔɔtɛmi taawalɛ lɛnɔ badubɔtɛmi siin.

english_verse: Fools will no longer be highly respected, and crooks won't be given positions of honor.
translation_verse: Basɔ balakya lili kalɔ belete badɔlɔdi ɔƒɛni amu. Na bekyuli bekpidi basɔ balákɛ kenyekɔ kadi na bekyuli akɔ aani babune.

english_verse: Fools talk foolishness. They always make plans to do sinful things, to lie about the Lord, to let the hungry starve, and to keep water from those who are thirsty.
translation_verse: Adɔlɔtɛ na badɔlɔdi baatɛmi, na likpidi bɔbla kɔkwɛ kani na baakya. Na baasu ɔkɔ ala teedumi Unwoti na baayá na kɔka ku utukwɛ ɔɔdú bekyuli na beekpi.

english_verse: Cruel people tell lies— they do evil things, and make cruel plans to destroy the poor and needy, even when they beg for justice.
translation_verse: Balalane ni, ɔkɔ na baanyi taasu ala, na baabla likyulikpi ala na baakya likpidi kɔkwɛ kalɛ na badu bekyuli bani nse kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ na baayaki ala na belenu-ma buvele ina dɛ na beekpi-ma kɔtɔ banii banu-ma kɔnyana.

english_verse: But helpful people can always be trusted to make helpful plans. Punishment for the Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Na bekyuli babuni ama baawia ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na basia beteebunku bekyuli. Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu na badubɔkɛ kusɛsɛ na benye kpakplaa uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Listen to what I say, you women who are carefree and careless!
translation_verse: Amii beleku bani nédie lɛlɔ atu na bɛɛɛdaku lɛla biala lɛda ni, bise atu na binu lɛla lɛni na ndubo-mii bɔsu!

english_verse: You may not have worries now, but in about a year, the grape harvest will fail, and you will tremble.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛdubo-mii tɔ bukpoku ɔƒɛni nsu asa na lɛkwa liteedu ni, bɛdubɔti kalɛ na use. Akutu udewi ɔɔɔdubo kɔtɛ bɔbla, na mmɔ na lɛlɔ lɛdubo-mii bɔtɔ.

english_verse: Slap your breasts in sorrow because of what happened to the fruitful fields and vineyards,
translation_verse: Biti enu biwi kayi ku kɔnyana na ala ani ndubo bɔlɛku bina adingyii mmo ku mmo bamba lɛnɔ ƒui ɔsu, ku ala ani ndubɔlɛku Yerusalem lɛnɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: and to the happy homes in Jerusalem. The land of my people is covered with thorns.
translation_verse: Mina kadi bekyuli kalɔ ƒui kadubunwini liyu kalɔ sɔɔn.

english_verse: The palace will be deserted, the crowded city empty. Fortresses and towers will forever become playgrounds for wild donkeys and pastures for sheep. God's Spirit Makes the Difference
translation_verse: Baga kesii kadubɔƒɔ lɛlɔ kese ukpludi na ɔma ɔni kemmo na nka bekyuli báƒɔ-nwu kemmo tɛtɛɛtɛ dii ɔdubɔsa ɔbla ukpludi. Na bekpone kɔgyumakɔ kpakplaa ku lɛma kɔgyumanakɔ ƒui kɔdubunwini alakpi akɔ bebuo kaƒiakɔ na kunwini baƒonu kadikɔ.

english_verse: When the Spirit is given to us from heaven, deserts will become orchards thick as fertile forests.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Unwoti ɔdubɔsɔku nwuna kɔyu ute-bu ɔsiku katɔ ni, kɔlɔ kɔkwiidi ƒui kɔdubunwini adingyii mmo bɔni adingyii ndubɔlɛ lili abla aani aku, na kalɔ kammɔ kadia geen.

english_verse: Honesty and justice will prosper there,
translation_verse: Na litemi lɛlɔ bɔdi ku ala bɔbla ulu lɛlɔ siin ndubɔkya mmɔ.

english_verse: You, the Lord's people, will live in peace, calm and secure,
translation_verse: Amii Unwoti bekyuli bɛdubulie kpoo ku keyi buɛɛ na atu ayɔ-mii na bina kɔkyakɔ ƒui.

english_verse: You will have God's blessing, as you plant your crops beside streams, while your donkeys and cattle roam freely about.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ uwi ɔni na bɛɛvá bina edula na ketu kɔtu na bina bebuo ala betine ku bebuo bamba badubusie bavi ƒaa na lɛla lɛdi lilabla-ma.

english_verse: You defeated my people. Now you're in for trouble! You've never been destroyed, but you will be destroyed; you've never been betrayed, but you will be betrayed. When you have finished destroying and betraying, you will be destroyed and betrayed in return.
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ ute awɔ ala ubilene, nsu ɔdi útebile-ɔ lɛla lɛdi kudii! Bɔbuɛ ute awɔ ɔni mɔɔví bekyuli kalɔ, nsu ɔdi útavi-ɔ kalɔ kudii! Si uwi ɔni na áda bekyuli ala bubile áya ni, badububile awɔ adi lɛnɔ. Na si uwi ɔni na áda bekyuli kalɔ bɔvi áya ni, badubɔvi-ɔ kalɔ awɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Please, Lord, be kind to us! We depend on you. Make us strong each morning, and come to save us when we are in trouble.
translation_verse: Unwoti, buvele na bɔda-a, tina-bu ƒula lɛƒɔndia! Ƒula lɛlɔ na bɔsia anu. Ya na bɔkɛ ɔyikun ɔtanta biala, na ebo na ebedie-bu si uwi ɔni na búduo ɔgbankpi kemmo.

english_verse: Nations scatter when you roar and show your greatness.
translation_verse: Kadi bekyuli beegyingya si édie lɛdi na átina kalɛ na ébomo.

english_verse: We attack our enemies like swarms of locusts; we take everything that belongs to them.
translation_verse: Buukpóku bula bekisine aani baalɔlɔ, na buuƒie bana ala ƒui taaƒɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are above all others, and you live in the heavens. You have brought justice and fairness to Jerusalem;
translation_verse: Awɔ Unwoti eli katɔ na etulo ukyuli biala. Áya na litemi lɛlɔ bɔdi ulu lɛlɔ ku ala bɔbla siin bɔ́ƒɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: you are the foundation on which we stand today. You always save us and give true wisdom and knowledge. Nothing means more to us than obeying you. The Lord Will Do Something
translation_verse: Awɔ ndi kowodu kalɔ ɔka ɔni lɛlɔ na bunye ɔmwi. Ɔsika aaƒɔ́-bu ngba uwi biala na eete-bu lɛnunda ku lɛlati. Na lɛla bamba biala lɛ́sɔ lítaƒɔ-bu kuye lítetulo ka butaadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Listen! Our bravest soldiers are running through the streets, screaming for help. Our messengers hoped for peace, but came home crying.
translation_verse: Bɛnu! Bukeli na bula bekpone benengudi ƒui bakɛ beekeli na lɛblɔnu ƒui lɛlɔ taakpali banii bebebunku-ma. Na bula batu bani nésie betéwi kenye ntu na beboku keyi buɛɛ bénwini bébo ɔma ku keku.

english_verse: No one travels anymore; every road is empty. Treaties are broken, and no respect is shown to any who keep promises.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ɔsɔ ulakana ulu bɔyu busie kesii kadi anwuɔsu alanu ukyuli ɔdi na ulu ɔdi lɛlɔ. Bébile ala ani na búnyimi búse. Na si ina ɔdi anii ataadi linyese lɛdi lɛlɔ muedi ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ ulábu-ɔ.

english_verse: Fields are dry and barren; Mount Lebanon wilts with shame. Sharon Valley is a desert; the forests of Bashan and Carmel have lost their leaves.
translation_verse: Mmo bɔ́kywi bunye na lɛla lɛla liiibo-mu kemmo. Na Lebanon lɛku lɛ́yɛyɛ linye aani ukyuli ɔni na kɔƒa kúƒie. Na Saron Ɔkwalɛ únwini kalɔ kakwiidi. Na Basan ku Karmel aku ƒui éwiile evete.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Now I will do something and be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti ɔnini, “Ɔƒɛni na ndubo lɛla lɛdi bɔbla na bekyuli banu na bemwi-mi geen.

english_verse: Your deeds are straw that will be set on fire by your very own breath.
translation_verse: Bina ablala ƒui ese aani keti kani na amii alati bina ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni na bɛɛnwuna na bɛdubuti bɛkya ablala ammɔ ogya.

english_verse: You will be burned to ashes like thorns in a fire.
translation_verse: Bɛdubo bɔkywi bunwini ntɔ aani liyu alakpi na bákya ogya.

english_verse: Everyone, both far and near, come look at what I have done. See my mighty power!” Punishment and Rewards
translation_verse: “Amii bani nde ku bani nási ɔlɔgyu ƒui, bɛlɛ bibo na bibanu lɛla lɛni na lɛ́bla, na bɛnu ɔyikun bonwu ɔni na mbo!”

english_verse: Those terrible sinners on Mount Zion tremble as they ask in fear, “How can we possibly live where a raging fire never stops burning?”
translation_verse: Liƒu líƒie alaekpidi bablane benengudi bani nkya Sion Kɔbi lɛlɔ na lɛlɔ lɛɛtɔ́-ma kpakpaakpa na béye banini, “Dɛ na bɔdubɔkana kesii kani na ogya ɔni mɔɔkywí teebile ala uwi ƒui na uléni mɛni bulie?”

english_verse: But there will be rewards for those who live right and tell the truth, for those who refuse to take money by force or accept bribes, for all who hate murder and violent crimes.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bani nli ngba siin na baasu litemi geen lɛmmɔ ni, badubo bana lɛyuƒɔla bɔƒɔ ku bani na balayɔ ka baƒɔ egulabi adi na bɔbɛ kemmo iye benye ukyuli ɔdi lɛlɔ na beƒie-nwu lɛla lɛdi baƒɔ ku bani nkisi ka bewi ukyuli ubugya kalɔ na balayɔ lɛsɛ ku udunkpi bamba ƒui lɛnɔ ni,

english_verse: They will live in a fortress high on a rocky cliff, where they will have food and plenty of water. The Lord Is Our King
translation_verse: badubulie bekpone kagyumakɔ kpakplaa kemmo na lɛtakpɛ lili na bakɛ adila badi kaduɛ na bani lɛnɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: With your own eyes you will see the glorious King; you will see his kingdom reaching far and wide.
translation_verse: Amii alati bɛdubɔnu Ɔga ɔni muukeye mmɔ, ku kalɛ na nwuna lɛga kadikɔ kadubo bɔbɛbɛ busie amadɔ ku ɔgyu kakaaka.

english_verse: Then you will ask yourself, “Where are those officials who terrified us and forced us to pay such heavy taxes?”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na amii alati bɛdubuye bɛnini, “Wɛ na benengu bani muunye-bu lɛlɔ na baayila-bu banii buteete kuyii bonwu bonwu mmɔ bávi?”

english_verse: You will never again have to see the proud people who spoke a strange and foreign language you could not understand.
translation_verse: Na bɛsɔ bɛɛɛdubo baƒɔ bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ, bani lɛdi na bilenu na bilatɛmi mmɔ bɔnu na bina akɔ.

english_verse: Look to Mount Zion where we celebrate our religious festivals. You will see Jerusalem, secure as a tent with pegs that cannot be pulled up and fastened with ropes that can never be broken.
