translation_verse: Bɛkɔliku anumi bɛnu Sion Kɔbi kesii kani na bɔɔdi bula emeyi buni. Bɛdubɔnu kalɛ na Yerusalem unye kalɔ kpi aani kevo kani na bédi kpakplaa na nwuna kɔbuli kpakplaa kɔda ewele na alɛ kalɔ na lɛla lɛdi lilakana-ka bɔgyu.

english_verse: Our wonderful Lord will be with us! There will be deep rivers and wide streams safe from enemy ships. The Lord Is Our Judge
translation_verse: Bula Unwoti Ɔyikune ɔni muukeye ɔdubɔsiaku-bu, na ntukpa bɔni nábɛbɛ na bɔ́gyu bɔdubɔka bɔmana-bu, na bekisine lɛkɔlɔ libendi lɛdi lilakana-mu lɛlɔ bɔsia bɔvi.

english_verse: The Lord is our judge and our ruler; the Lord is our king and will keep us safe.
translation_verse: Unwoti ndubɔtɛ bula litemi ute-bu, na ɔdi-bu lɛlɔ. Unwoti ndi bula ɔga ɔni ndubɔda-bu, na lɛla lɛdi lilékpoku-bu.

english_verse: But your nation is a ship with its rigging loose, its mast shaky, and its sail not spread. Someday even you that are lame will take everything you want from your enemies.
translation_verse: Nsu ƒula kadi bekyuli ni, bese aani ɔkɔlɔ ubendi ɔni na nwuna lɛta ku adi ƒui adaku bugyingya na bátakɔliku adi ani mɔɔƒɔ́ ɔƒɛƒɛɛ na uutiku ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ. Limeyi lɛdubo ɔni na bina bekyuli bani náƒɛ bewi kalɔ muedi badubɔkɛ kekpo ala ani na beƒie báƒɔ bekisine kudɔ mmɔ adi.

english_verse: The Lord will forgive your sins, and none of you will say, “I feel sick.”
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubuti bina ekpidi ɔkyiɛ-mii, na ɔdi ulasu ɔnii uuƒi.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation, the entire earth, and all its creatures, come here and listen!
translation_verse: Bɛlɛ bibo, amii kadi ƒui bekyuli, na amii bayawine ku kalɔ lɛlɔ ala ediedi ƒui, bɛni bide, na bise atu, na binu kenye kadi!

english_verse: The Lord is terribly angry with the nations; he has condemned them to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Unwoti úti kɔnyi kpakplaa ɔ́kya kadi bekyuli ƒui geen, na ɔ́ɔdu-ma kɔtɔ ka bakyula-ma na bayii udu.

english_verse: Their dead bodies will be left to rot and stink; their blood will flow down the mountains.
translation_verse: Na baaadubo ɔdi bɔva, mmomu bekpine bammɔ badubuwi mmɔ na bebun beteenwenyi, na bana ubugya ɔdubɔƒɔ abi lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Each star will disappear— the sky will roll up like a scroll. Everything in the sky will dry up and wilt like leaves on a vine or fruit on a tree. Trouble for Edom
translation_verse: Ayabi ƒui adubɔyii akya, na kayaa kemodi kammɔ kakono aani kalɛ na baakono ɔku. Na ɔƒɛ ku kɔbuli kɔdubɔnu aani kalɛ na evete ku egyiibi aanú egyii lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: After the sword of the Lord has done what it wants to the skies above, it will come down on Edom, the nation that the Lord has doomed for destruction.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na Unwoti úti nwuna kewii na ɔ́bla lɛla lɛni na ɔɔyɔ́ ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔdubɔyu uduo Edom kadi bekyuli bani na ɔ́ɔdu kɔtɔ úse ka ɔkyula lɛnɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The sword of the Lord is covered with blood from lambs and goats, together with fat from kidneys of rams. This is because the Lord will slaughter many people and make a sacrifice of them in the city of Bozrah and everywhere else in Edom.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti kewii lɛlɔ ƒui kadubɔƒɔ ubugya ku lɛmwi, na kalɛ na ɔ́tu-ma aani baƒonu ku bese bammɔ útálɛ bana akabi lɛlɔ ɔsu. Ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubo akpala bɔbla na Bosra ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo, na ɔdu bekyuli pii geen na Edom.

english_verse: Edom's leaders are wild oxen. They are powerful bulls, but they will die with the others. Their country will be soaked with their own blood, and its soil made fertile with their own fat.
translation_verse: Edom bekyuli bese aani ɔmantɛ ku lɛku kemmo bakɔ bagyani bani na bebo ɔkplu geen sɔsɔ, nsu ama lɛnɔ badubo bukpi aani bakladi kani. Na kalɔ kemodi kammɔ kadubɔƒɔ bekyuli ubugya na bana lɛmwi lɛsala ku lɛti lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen the year and the day, when he will take revenge and come to Zion's defense.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔlati ɔ́ɔƒuna uwi ku lɛkwa lɛni na ɔdububo ubedie bekyuli kasi ute Sion.

english_verse: Edom's streams will turn into tar and its soil into sulfur— then the whole country will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Na Edom ntukpa ƒui bɔdubunwini nnɔ tonwu bɔni na beewi ulu lɛlɔ, na kalɔ kammɔ lɛti lɛta linwini kɔnu aƒɛ. Na kalɔ kammɔ kaƒɔ ogya na kataada.

english_verse: It will burn night and day and never stop smoking. Edom will be a desert, generation after generation; no one will ever travel through that land.
translation_verse: Na ogya ɔmmɔ ɔdubo butaada usien ku ɔƒɛ na ulada uyɔ bɔlɛ uláya uwi ɔdi. Edom kalɔ kammɔ ƒui kadubɔkywi na kɔsa kaladi lɛla lɛdi bɔbla ɔ́si kaba útédu kaba. Na ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔɔdubo bɔkana na usie ulu ɔdi na ɔsia kalɔ kammɔ kemmo ɔlɛ.

english_verse: Owls, hawks, and wild animals will make it their home. God will leave it in ruins, merely a pile of rocks. The End of Edom
translation_verse: Bekuku ku basangbii ku lɛku kemmo bebuo bamba badubuti mmɔ babla bana kuliekɔ. Na Katɔti ɔdubɔkɔku kalɔ kammɔ ƒui ɔnu ka bubile kani na ɔdi ka bebile-ka na bayila bekyuli bammɔ ƒui udu.

english_verse: Edom will be called “Kingdom of Nothing.” Its rulers will also be nothing.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli badubɔlɔ mmɔ bani lɛga kadikɔ kani na lɛƒua liiibo na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ badine lɛnɔ beeebo kenyekɔ kadi.

english_verse: Its palaces and fortresses will be covered with thorns; only wolves and ostriches will make their home there.
translation_verse: Baga kesii ku kɔgyumanakɔ kɔni na bátu bényene ƒui kɔdubunwini liyu alakpi sɔɔn ɔni na beƒukutu ku bekuku ndubo mmɔ bulie.

english_verse: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo bebweyi ku bebuoƒuala ndubo butaadi taasa na mmɔ. Na alakpi akɔ bese badubo butaava taalɔ lɛlɔ. Na usien bebweyi lɛnɔ badubɔƒɔ mmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Owls will nest there to raise their young among its shadows, while families of vultures circle around.
translation_verse: Bekuku badubo bana ayu bɔbla na mmɔ, na bava bevuo banyuɛ bana bebi na bana avwi kalɔ. Na basangbii badubo ɔƒɛɛlɛ butaakya na kayaa mmɔ ɔdi biala ku ɔgyani.

english_verse: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, “The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.”
translation_verse: Na Unwoti bunweni kedee ɔku kemmo ni, bénweni ka Unwoti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ami násala bebweyi bamɛni ƒui ɔkɛnku mina Kɔyu ɔyikun lɛlɔ, na bana akɔ ina unwi ɔɔɔdubo bɔyii, na ɔdi lɛnɔ ulayila ɔgyani iye uledi.”

english_verse: The Lord has decided where they each should live; they will be there forever, generation after generation.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔlati nálɛ ugyii úse úte bana keliekɔ na mmɔ, na badubo bulie uwi ƒui ɔ́si kaba úsie kaba.

english_verse: Thirsty deserts will be glad; barren lands will celebrate and blossom with flowers.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ kalɔ kakwiidi kani mɔɔwia ntu na kaládia lɛla lɛdi, ɔsika egyiibi lidu lɛdubɔlɛ linye-ka lɛlɔ ƒui na alɛ anwula ku ebiti.

english_verse: Deserts will bloom everywhere and sing joyful songs. They will be as majestic as Mount Lebanon, as glorious as Mount Carmel or Sharon Valley. Everyone will see the wonderful splendor of the Lord our God. God Changes Everything *
translation_verse: Kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ ala ƒui adubɔlɛ anwula ani mɔɔtina ka lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-ka, na beteebo kudu ku lɛlɔyɔ kɔvanu. Na kalɔ kammɔ ala ƒui adubɔlɛ enye ataanwami aani Lebanon abi akumiɔ. Na eteekeye aani Karmel Kɔbi iye Saron Ɔkwalɛ. Na banu kalɛ na Unwoti Katɔti lɛgadi liikeye.

english_verse: Here is a message for all who are weak, trembling, and worried:
translation_verse: Bɛkya bekyuli bani na enu áƒɛ-ma na bábla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ogya, na bani na bana akɔnkɔ áyɔ na aatɔ́ ayu ɔkplu.

english_verse: “Cheer up! Don't be afraid. Your God is coming to punish your enemies. God will take revenge on them and rescue you.”
translation_verse: Na bɛsu bani na ɔtɔtɔ ɔɔgyú-ma bɛnini, “Bise kayi na bɛda bɔyia bɛya, ɔsika bina Katɔti ɔdubo na ubedie-mii na udie bina bekisine kasi ute-mii.”

english_verse: The blind will see, and the ears of the deaf will be healed.
translation_verse: Na mmɔ ni, banumbwɛne badubɔnu na batutine benu.

english_verse: Those who were lame will leap around like deer; tongues once silent will shout for joy. Water will rush through the desert.
translation_verse: Na bani na báƒɛ bewi kalɔ badubɔta na baƒulu ku lɛlɔyɔ aani bakwa. Na bamumu linyemi kɔbuli kɔƒɛnimi na bebo kudu ku lɛlɔyɔ. Na ntukpa bɔlɛ bɔsia bɔvi kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Scorching sand will turn into a lake, and thirsty ground will flow with fountains. Grass will grow in deserts, where packs of wild dogs once made their home. God's Sacred Highway
translation_verse: Kɔnwinimi kɔni náƒɔ ogya mmɔ kɔdubunwini lɛba na abiɔ alɛ kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo ekpo ekpo. Na kesii kani na beƒukutu bátaatɛ kadubunwini kesii kani na livo ku ketudɔ alakpi lidu lɛdubɔkwɛ.

english_verse: A good road will be there, and it will be named “God's Sacred Highway.” It will be for God's people; no one unfit to worship God will walk on that road. And no fools can travel on that highway.
translation_verse: Ulu unengudi ɔdubɔsia kalɔ kammɔ kemmo, na badubɔlɔ-nwu banii Ulu Kedee. Na bekyuli bani neeese sɛɛn baaadubo ulu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ basia. Na badɔlɔdi ku belikplune balasia-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: No lions or other wild animals will come near that road; only those the Lord has saved will travel there.
translation_verse: Gyata ɔdi ɔɔɔdubo mmɔ bɔkya na eƒiebuo ɔdi lɛnɔ ulasia mmɔ. Mmomu bekyuli bani kani na Unwoti ɔ́ya na bákɛ bɔƒɔ kani ndubɔsia mmɔ betéduo ɔma.

english_verse: The people the Lord has rescued will come back singing as they enter Zion. Happiness will be a crown everyone will always wear. They will celebrate and shout because all sorrows and worries will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Na bani na Unwoti ɔ́ƒɔ mmɔ kani ndubɔsia mmɔ na beteedie lɛnu na betéduo Yerusalem. Na lɛlɔyɔ ebiti ndubɔbla bana kagabwa kani na badububi lili. Na badubɔdi limeyi na bakɛ lɛlɔyɔ, ɔsika ala ani muukpóku-ma ku ɔlɛ bunu biala kenye kadubukulo.

english_verse: Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him. Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: “Bitenu Hesekia litemi ɔsika bɔkpanku na ɔda-mii utáyila si ɔɔsu ɔnii, ‘Unwoti ɔdubo-mii budie.’ Bíinu dii ka kalɔ kadi baƒiɔ báaƒɔ bana bekyuli básiku Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga enu kemmo?

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted out in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Amu na unengu ɔmmɔ ɔ́ta únye na údie lɛdi momoomo na Yudaƒuɔ lɛdi kemmo, lɛni baalɔ Hebri, na ɔ́su ɔ́nini,

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath, Arpad, and Sepharvaim? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Wɛ na Hamat ku Arpad ku Seƒarwaim baƒiɔ bakya? Na wɛ na Hamat ku Arpad baƒiɔ bakya? Na wɛ lɛnɔ na Seƒarwaim ku Hera ku Iwa baƒiɔ bakya? Na ɔdi úukpo ɔ́ƒɔ Samaria ɔ́lɛku-mi enu dii?

english_verse: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah. He can't save you.
translation_verse: “Binu ɔga ɔyikune kenye. Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga ɔnini,

english_verse: Three of the king's highest officials came out of Jerusalem to meet him. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, ɔga kesii kabla bablane benengu ɛtɛ bábasiaku ukpone unengu ɔmmɔ. Na unwi ndi Hilkia ubidi Eliakim, ɔni ndi aban unengu kenye unyene, ku nwuna ubunkune ɔni ndi Sebna. Na ɔtɛdi ndi Asaƒ ubidi Yoa, ɔku unwenine unengudi na ɔga kesii mmɔ.

english_verse: The Assyrian commander told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Amu na ukpone unengu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Asiria ɔga ɔyikune nátala-mi ɔnii mbeye Hesekia nnini, “ ‘Bi ndi lɛla lɛni lɛlɔ na ƒula anu asia ɔsu na eesé lɛlɔ kayi lɛni?

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Kekpo ɔyikun ku kɔkwɛ ni, ɔɔɔdi banii kenye kani na kadi. Na ɔma na aanu ɔsu na aawia ata enye Asiria ɔga ɔyikune lɛlɔ?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Nu! Mɔɔsu-ɔ ka Egyipteƒuɔ lɛlɔ na ékpo kama. Nsu mɔɔyá-a na ati ka ugyii kakɛ kani ndubo bɔƒɛ bɔtu-ɔ kɔnu si éti ƒula unu ƒui ásia-nwu lɛlɔ na ɔdi! Ɔyikun ɔmmɔ udu na Ƒarao Egyipteƒuɔ ɔga ubo ute bani ƒui néti bana anu básia-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord, your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Na si bɔsu na ada-mi lɛnɔ anii, “Bula Unwoti Katɔti lɛlɔ na búkpo kama” ni, ɔɔɔdi Unwoti ɔmɛni na Hesekia ɔ́ya báƒɛ nwuna akpabi. Na ɔ́su Israelƒuɔ ku Yudaƒuɔ ka bataakpa Unwoti ɔmmɔ na lɛkpabi lɛni nlɛ Yerusalem lɛlɔ kani?

english_verse: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people! He will give you
translation_verse: “ ‘Bo na awɔ ku mina unengu Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga binyimi lɛla lɛdi. Na ndubute-ɔ bapɔnkɔ mpim inyɔ si adubɔkɛ bekyuli bani melie-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-ɔ ka alakana Asiriani ukpone ɔnamudi ƒui muedi lɛlɔ bɔdi ina ka éti anu ásia Egyipteƒuɔ bapɔnkɔ beliene ku bana bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!
translation_verse: Munuu aakali ka bɔta kani na lɛ́ta mbekpoku-mii keeke ɔni na ɔɔɔdi Unwoti násu-mi lɛla lɛdi? Mɔɔsu-mii nwa ka ni, Unwoti ɔlati násu-mi ka mbekpoku kalɔ kamɛni ƒui na lɛyila-mii udu.’ ”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Amu na Eliakim ku Sebna ku Yoa básu bekpone unengu ɔmmɔ banini, “Awɔ ku ƒula bekpone bammɔ bɛtɛmiku-bu na Asiria lɛdi kemmo na bɔdubunu kalɔ. Na bitatɛmi Yuda lɛdi bitete-bu. Ɔsika bekyuli bani ƒui bákɔ bénye awodu amɛni lɛlɔ ni, bákya beenú ɔdi.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you!”
translation_verse: Amu na bekpone benengu bammɔ bédie kenye banini, “Bɛɛkali ka ami ku ɔga ɔmmɔ kani na bula ɔga ɔ́tala-bu ɔ́kya ka búbasu-mii etemila amɛni? Oowo! Bekyuli bani na bákɔ benye awodu lɛlɔ lɛnɔ badubunu ɔdi. Ɔsika ama lɛnɔ badubɔdi bana kuvodɔ na bani bana kɔnɔ aani bina kalɛ.”

english_verse: Stop listening to Hezekiah. Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns
translation_verse: “Bitenu lɛla lɛni na Hesekia ɔ́su mmɔ. Mmomu bɔsu na Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga ɔyikune ɔda ɔnini, ‘Bɛbabla na bibo bibablaku-mi unwi na buwi kenye ntu. Na bɛdubɔkɛ bɔnwuna na ɔdi biala ɔdi nwuna kemo edula ku egyiibi, na udu ntu na nwuna libiɔ kemmo ɔni,

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards and raise your own grain.
translation_verse: uti utédu ka bula ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔ́wia-mii kɔkyakɔ kɔni nse aani amii alati kɔdi. Na kesii kani bɛdubɔkɛ edula ku ntɛ bɔbuni na bɛkɛ adila ku adingyii abuni ku nnɔ egyii ku uwɔ.’

english_verse: None of those gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord, your God, can do any better?
translation_verse: Na kalɔ kamani geen baƒiɔ néekpo bɔƒɔ bana kalɔ bekyuli básiku-mi enu kemmo? Na dɛ na Unwoti anwu ɔdubɔkana na ɔƒɔ Yerusalem na mina enu kemmo?”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama Hilkia ubidi Eliakim ɔni ndi ɔga kesii lɛlɔ ɔnune ku ɔku unwenine Sebna ku Asaƒ ubidi Yoa ekposela ala unwenine báni bana lɛwu bábwɛ na bénwini bésie Ɔga Hesekia kudɔ na bátásɔku ala ani na básu-ma ƒui básu-nwu.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Hesekia ɔnya únu bekyuli bammɔ kenye kani na ɔ́ni nwuna adala ɔ́duli na lɛƒɛda kemmo, na úti adikpi ɔ́da lɛlɔ na ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie Unwoti kakpakɔ.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (
translation_verse: Na wɛ na Hamat ku Arpad ku Seƒarwaim ku Hena ku Iwa baga bakya ɔmwi?” Hesekia Ɔ́kpali Katɔti

english_verse: Isaiah, these are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: Na kenye kani na Hesekia ɔ́su-ma ɔnii batásu-nwu ndi ɔnini, “Ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni lɛdi kɔnyana limeyi geen ɔni na bédumi-bu na béwi-bu anumi kalɔ. Na buunú ɔlɛ aani uwi ɔni na kawɔƒɔ ubi údu bɔwɔ, nsu ɔyikun ɔ́sa ɔƒɔndane ɔmmɔ na ukyuli ɔni na ɔƒɔ ute-nwu uuubo.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni kalɛ Unwoti ƒula Katɔti únu ala ani na Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga ɔ́tala nwuna bekpone benengu na bábasu-bu na bédumi Katɔti ɔni na uli ngba. Na muuvele nnii ƒula Unwoti Katɔti unu edumi ammɔ na ɔni bani nédumi-nwu mmɔ kɔtu. Anwuɔsu kpali Katɔti na evele ete bula bekyuli ku abu bani nli ngba.”

english_verse: When these leaders came to me,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesaia únu Ɔga Hesekia kenye kammɔ ni,

english_verse: I told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Yesaia ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bitásu bina ɔtɔlati ɔga bɛnini, ‘Unwoti ɔnii bitakpete edumi ani na Asiriani kebii kammɔ kátala nwuna benengu na bábasu-mii úti údumi-mi.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubɔya Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga ɔmmɔ unu etemila adi ɔsiku nwuna ɔma na ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔya na unwini usie nwuna ɔma. Na si útéduo ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔya na badu-nwu na mmɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Meanwhile the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Asiriaƒuɔ unengu ɔmmɔ únu ka bana ɔga ɔ́tɔlɔ Lakis na úsie ɔ́kya Libna amadɔ uukpó ni, úsie mmɔ na útánu-nwu.

english_verse: About this same time, the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, kenye kédu Asiriaƒuɔ Ɔga Sanaherib ka Egyipteƒuɔ bekpone báklibi lɛlɔ na bana Ɔga Tirhaka ɔ́tɔnku-ma ka bébekpoku-ma. Anwuɔsu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́tala batu ɔ́kya Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga Hesekia ɔnini,

english_verse: Don't trust your God or be fooled by his promise to defend Jerusalem against me.
translation_verse: “Kayi katatɔlɔ-ɔ na aƒɔ ƒula baƒiɔ bani na aakpá adi anii ɔ́su-ɔ ɔnii, ‘Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga ulakana Yerusalem ɔma lɛlɔ bɔdi.’

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Ngyi nwaa ka énu kalɛ na Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga ɔ́bla kɔlɔ kɔni na amadɔ ƒui ku kalɛ na ɔ́yila-ku udu kede kede. Na aabu ka awɔ adubɔkana na alɛ-mi enu kemmo?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: Na mina bati kuuku báyila Gosan ku Haran ku Reseƒ na báyila bana lɛma udu. Na bádu bekyuli bani nli Eden na Telasar. Nsu bana baƒiɔ badi biala bátakana-ma bukpo bɔ́ƒɔ.

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Ka Ɔga Hesekia ɔ́ƒɔ ɔku ɔmɛni ɔ́siku batu bammɔ kudɔ na ɔ́ka ni, úti ɔku ɔmmɔ úsienku Katɔti kakpakɔ na útébi-nwu úwi Unwoti anumi.

english_verse: Then he prayed:
translation_verse: Na ɔ́kpali Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini,

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: “O Unwoti ɔni ndi Israelƒuɔ Katɔti, awɔ nli ƒula lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na katɔ katɔ na kesii kani na Kerub ngba bebweyi bammɔ begyingya bana avwi bámana. Na awɔ lɛti ndi Katɔti ɔni mɔɔdi kayawi kamɛni lɛgakɔdikɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na awɔ nédie katɔ ku kalɔ.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: “Unwoti, ɔdi litemi geen ka Asiriaƒuɔ baga béekpo kadi bekyuli bamɛni ƒui na bébile bana kɔlɔ.

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔkɛ úbo na ɔdubɔsɔ ɔsia ɔtɔlɔ. Ɔɔɔdubo ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo buduo. Lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su.

english_verse: Sennacherib, you cursed, shouted and sneered at me, the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔma na akya eedumi taama? Na ɔma na aakwanyi taakya ku lɛdi momoomo? Na ɔma na aanu ɔnusɛ ku bɔpii? Ɔɔɔdi Israel Katɔti Kedee ɔmmɔ!

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Átala bekyuli ákya Unwoti, na bákpila-nwu edumi. Na ásu anini, “Nkɛnku mina bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ lɛlɔ na lɛ́ɛkɔ abi ani na ákuku ƒui eli lɛ́vi ku Lebanon kesii kani bene na kákuku ketulo ƒui. Na egyii kpakplaa ammɔ ƒui líkulo-nya líwi kalɔ, ku egyii abuni ani nálɛ enye salaa ƒui. Na kesii kani na kadi kabɛkɔ ƒui líduo mmɔ bene lɛ́lɛ, kesii kani na kadi lɛkumiɔ geen.

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: Na líku abiɔ lɛ́kya kesii kani na kadi baƒɔ kɔlɔ kemmo, na lɛ́ni ntu na mmɔ. Mina lɛgba kalɔ geen na líti lɛ́nya Egyipte ntukpa bɔni nákwii mmɔ.” ’

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bunu na étenu ɔmɛni kudii? Ami nábla ala amɛni líse kukuuku. Na lɛ́tina kalɛ na adubo buse na uwi ɔni návi ƒui kemmo. Na ɔƒɛni lɛ́ya na ébo-nwu kemmo. Na ákana na énwini lɛma linengudi lɛni na bátu bámana ábla aani atabi ani na bála básala lisu.

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or like tender young grass growing on a flat roof or like a field of grain before it matures.
translation_verse: Ami náya na kadi bani bekyuli nli mmɔ ɔyikun ɔ́sa na bese aani livo lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ ɔwɔdi na bɛ́kana-ma lɛlɔ bɔdi na bɛ́kya-ma kɔƒa. Na bénwini aani lɛsa katɔ livo lɛni na ɔƒɛ ɔ́kyula asa na lɛdubɔlɛ lili.

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Nsu ngyi kesii kani na elie, ku uwi ɔni na eebo taatɔlɔ, ku kalɛ na aata ku kɔnyi taasiaku-mi.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: Na ka áta ásiaku-mi ku kɔnyi, ku ƒula ukyuli tabu bɔni na línu ku mina atu ɔsu ni, ndubɔkya-a ɔdaliwa enwu, na liti kenye kabuli lɛbala-a kenye, na lɛya na enwini asia ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na ásia ébo.

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: “ ‘O Hesekia, ɔmɛni ndubɔbla ƒula likposela. “ ‘Na lɛkwa lɛmɛni kemmo ni, edula ani na anya alati nákwɛ na adubo bɔdi. Na lɛkwa bamba ni, edula akukudi ani násɔ áta ebi na adubo bɔdi. Nsu lɛkwa lɛtɛdi ni, awɔ ɔlati kya edula na aƒɛ-nya, na ese adingyii mmo na ede ebi ammɔ adi.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Na Yudaƒuɔ ɛlɛɛ bani nébu badubɔsɔ bedie ligyiitu aani kugyii kalɛ besie kalɔ kemmo ɔgyu na banwu ebi na kayaa.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli ɔdi ɔdubɔlɛ ɔsi Yerusalem. Na bani ndubɔkɛ ngba lɛnɔ basi Sion Kɔbi. Ɔsika kalɛ na anumi égyie ɔsu ɔdubɔya na ɔmɛni ubo-nwu kemmo lɛni.’

english_verse: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu lɛni na Unwoti ɔɔsu taasiku Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga lɛlɔ ɔnii, “ ‘Ɔɔɔdubo ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo buduo iye ubo nwuna kataminta kunwi muedi na mɛni. Na ulebo mmɔ ku lɛgyumanala, iye ubatu kesii kani na ɔdubunye ukpoku ɔma ɔmmɔ ɔmana.

english_verse: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ Asiriaƒuɔ Ɔga Sanaherib ɔ́ya na báta mmɔ na bénwini bésie Niniwe na bétélie mmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord sent an angel to the camp of the Assyrians, and he killed
translation_verse: Na usien ɔmmɔ ni, Unwoti ɔtu ɔdi ɔda úduo Asiriaƒuɔ bekpone kakyakɔ na ɔ́du bekpone mpim eti atɛ ku avlaatɛ-ɛlɔ (

english_verse: of them all in one night. The next morning, the camp was full of dead bodies.
translation_verse: ). Na ka kadi kegye ni, békpi batɛ mmɔ.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛdi ni, ka Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga ɔkya ɔɔkpá nwuna baƒiɔ Nisrok na nwuna kakpakɔ ni, ɔga ɔmmɔ bebi inyɔ bani ndi Adramelek ku Sareser béti bana kuwii na bétébeyi-nwu bádu na békeli bésie Ararat kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na ubidi bamba ɔni baalɔ bani Esarhadon úti-nwu keliekɔ aani ɔga kalɛ.

english_verse: Hezekiah turned toward the wall and prayed,
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Hesekia úti nwuna anumi ɔ́tina kowodu na ɔ́kpali Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini,

english_verse: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
translation_verse: “Awɔ Unwoti ndubudie-mi, na bɔdubo-ɔ buteemwi limeyi ndi limeyi lɛni na buli ngba na ƒula kakpakɔ kedee ku lɛbentaa.”

english_verse: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, “The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Ɔga Hesekia úbo uuƒi ɔlɛ kpakplaa ɔdi ɔni na ubu bli na ukpi. Amu na Amos ubidi Kenye Udiene Yesaia úsie utánu-nwu, na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Unwoti ɔnii klibi ƒula kaduli ala ƒui se, ɔsika adubo bukpi na aaadubo bɔta ɔlɛ ɔni na eeƒi.”

english_verse: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́su nnii nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo Unwoti ɔni nli ngba bɔnu na bayawine bani nli ngba akɔ. Na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo bekyuli bayawine badi lɛnɔ bɔnu, ɔsika nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-ma akɔ bɔkya na kayawi kamɛni kemmo.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried hard.
translation_verse: “Unwoti, nyimo ka lɛ́bla ala siin na ulu lɛlɔ na ƒula anumi. Na líti mina kayi lɛnɔ lɛ́sia awɔ lɛti lɛlɔ. Na lɛ́kya ɔkplu ka lɛ́bla lɛla lɛni na aayɔ́.” Ɔmmɔ kama úsie kalɔ uuwulo momoomo.

english_verse: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
translation_verse: “Sie na atásu Hesekia anini, ‘Lɛni na Unwoti ɔni ndi ƒula ɔti Dawid Katɔti ɔɔsu. Línu ƒula bɔkpali ku keku kani na éwulo ku imii. Na ndubuti akwa leevu-alɔ libunku ƒula ngba emeyi.

english_verse: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.
translation_verse: Bi na mbo na masu ka Unwoti ɔlati nábla ɔmɛni. Bɔkɛ kani na ndubɔkɛ nteekpuulo ku ɔlɛ bunu wetédu mina kawɔlɔkɔ, na mina kɔnyana kɔmɛni ɔsu.

english_verse: while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Na ndubukpo lɛƒɔ awɔ ku Yerusalem ɔma unengudi ɔmɛni lɛlɛku Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga enu kemmo.’

english_verse: Now I will prove to you that I will keep my promise.
translation_verse: “Na likposela lɛni na adubuti anu ati ka Unwoti ɔdubo lɛla lɛni na ɔ́su bɔbla ni, ani ndi lɛla lɛni na ɔ́su ɔnini,

english_verse: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
translation_verse: “ ‘Ɔyuli ɔni na ɔƒɛ ɔmmɔ bulii buuboku na Ɔga Ahas kakɔkɔ ubili ɔni na ɔ́tu mmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ndubɔya na ɔyuli ɔmmɔ udi usie kama lɛgba leevu.’ ” Na mmɔ mmɔ ni, ɔyuli ɔmmɔ údi úsie kama lɛgba leevu lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Ɔga Hesekia ɔ́ta nwuna ɔlɛ ɔni na uuƒi ni, únweni bumwi etemila adi ɔnini,

english_verse: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́kali ka uwi ɔni na mina ngba búle ntɛ ni, líduo kekpine lɛ́wɔlɔ na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo mina ngba emeyi akladi bɔnu.

english_verse: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
translation_verse: Lɛ́nu ka mina ngba bɔdubo liku bɔda aani kevo kani na báda bágyu na báƒɛ kevo adi ammɔ, iye aani kɔdi kɔni na békulo bédie bedine kevo. Na ɔ́bla-mi aani Unwoti bɔwɔlɔ na ɔdaku-mi.

english_verse: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
translation_verse: Líwulo usien umodi na muunú ɔlɛ aani gyata mɔɔbwɛ-mi lɛlɔ ekubi. Na ɔ́bla-mi aani Unwoti náda-mi ngba uudie.

english_verse: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
translation_verse: Mina lɛdi lɛ́sani, na lɛsɔ lilalɛ aani lɛsɛɛmɛɛ mɔɔva, na muudumo aani abloduma. Mina anumi asɔ alanu kaduɛ, anwuɔsu lɛ́kɔliku anumi mɔɔnu katɔ. Ala eekpóku-mi, O Unwoti, bo na ebebunku-mi.

english_verse: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, ƒula ablala ku kenye litemi kemmo na ukyuli ɔɔkɛ́ ngba. Na mmɔ kani na ami lɛnɔ ndubɔkɛ mina kɔyu kemmo ngba. Anwuɔsu muuvele-ɔ nnii bwi-mi na ásɔku ɔlɔkplu éte-mi.

english_verse: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
translation_verse: Geen ni, ami mina bɔdia ɔsu na lɛbibo lɛmɛni líbo-mi lɛlɔ. Nsu na ƒula lɛƒɔndia ɔsu ni, ánu-mi lɛlɔ, na áda-mi édie kaƒiɔtɔ kani mɔɔyila ukyuli udu kemmo. Na énwini kama ákya mina alaekpidi.

english_verse: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli ɔdi ulakana kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo bɔkya na wemwi-ɔ. Na baaadubo kekpine mmɔ bɔkya na bakɛ lɛnunsia lɛdi na kalɛ na aadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ teete bekyuli lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Bayawine kani ndubɔkana-a bumwi aani kalɛ na ndaku bɔbla ɔƒɛni. Na bebi bati mɔɔsu bana bebi kalɛ na aadi ƒula litemi lɛlɔ teete bekyuli.

english_verse: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesaia ɔ́su Ɔga Hesekia kabla bablane ɔnini, “Biti kɔnwingyie ebi bodobodo ɔdi na bɛnwu bɛsia-nwu liƒula lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔdubɔba-nwu.”

english_verse: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Hesekia úye ɔnini, “Bi ndi likposela lɛni na ndubɔtina ka ndubɔkana na lisie Katɔti kakpakɔ?”

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Hesekia ɔ́ƒɔ baƒɔ bammɔ ku ebiti na úti-ma ɔ́vinku nwuna ɔtɔ ɔni kemmo na uusé nwuna ala. Na ɔ́tina-ma nwuna akɛla ƒui ku nwuna sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi ku nwuna kutu akyala ku awɛɛla ani muunwenyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ku nwuna ekpola ƒui na lɛla biala lítebu ɔni na úteti útatina-ma.

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kani kemmo ni, Babilonƒuɔ ɔga ɔni ndi Baladan ubidi Merodak-Baladan únu ka Ɔga Hesekia úƒi na ɔ́ta ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ. Anwuɔsu ɔ́tala bekyuli na úti kakunkɛ ku etela adi úte-ma ka béti béteesienku-nwu.

english_verse: I asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama kenye udiene Yesaia úsie Ɔga Hesekia kudɔ na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Wɛ na bekyuli bamɛni bási na bi na básu-ɔ?” Na Hesekia údie kenye ɔnini, “Bekyuli bammɔ bási ɔgyu kakaaka na Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesaia ɔ́su Hesekia ɔnini, “Se atu na enu lɛla lɛni na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔnii mbasu-ɔ.

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: ‘Uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ɔni na lɛla biala lɛni nse ɔga kaduli mmɔ ku ala ani na ƒula baga bani na bélie bávi báwia bése úbedu ɔmwi kadi badubo-nya buti busienku Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ ɔni na belébu lɛla lɛdi belése.

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Na badubo awɔ ɔlati bawɔ badi buti bɔtɔlɔku busienku Babilon na bedie-ma agobɛɛ. Na badubunwini Babilonƒuɔ ɔga kabla bablane.’ ”

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
translation_verse: Na Hesekia únu kalɔ ka ɔdubo atu bɔyɔ bɔkɛ na ɔkɛ Unwoti kagyumana na nwuna ngba uwi ƒui. Anwuɔsu údie kenye ɔnini, “Kenye kani nási Unwoti kudɔ kébo-mi kudɔ mɛni kadia.”

english_verse: Our God has said: “Encourage my people! Give them comfort.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔnini, “Sia mina bekyuli kɔnu.

english_verse: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
translation_verse: Na atɛmiku Yerusalem ku lɛdi buɛɛ ku bɔyɔ, na aya na bati ka bana kabla ku lɛbibo lɛ́sa. Na báƒɔ bana ekpidi lili kayu, ɔsika Unwoti ɔ́ni-ma kɔtu ɔ́sia kama kunyɔ kunyɔ na bana ekpidi ɔsu.

english_verse: Someone is shouting: “Clear a path in the desert! Make a straight road for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ɔkɛ ɔɔva na ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo ɔnini, ‘Bɛklibi ulu bise bite Blɔti, na binyene ulu ɔmmɔ na kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo, na bɛbla ulu unengudi bite Katɔti.

english_verse: Fill in the valleys; flatten every hill and mountain. Level the rough and rugged ground.
translation_verse: Biyile lɛbonka na bɛbwɛ abinkpo ƒui na atɛ kalɔ. Na kesii kani nse kpukplo kpukplo ni, bɛbla na ɔbla suɛlɛ suɛlɛ.

english_verse: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔni muukeye ni, ɔdubɔda ɔlɛ kayaa na ukyuli biala ɔdubɔnu-nwu nwaa.’ ” Lɛni na Unwoti ɔlati ɔ́su!

english_verse: Someone told me to shout, and I asked, “What should I shout?” We humans are merely grass, and we last no longer than wild flowers.
translation_verse: Lɛdi lɛdi lɛ́su-mi lɛnini, “Va momoomo na atɛmi.” Amu na líye nnini, “Bi na nva nsu?” Lɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛ́su lɛnini, “Su anii, ‘Bekyuli ƒui bese aani lɛku kemmo alakpi, na ukyuli bɔdia buse aani alakpi anwula.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, flowers and grass disappear, and so do we.
translation_verse: Alakpi aayɛyɛ na anwula aanú. Ɔsika Unwoti ɔ́ya na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ úkpo ɔ́vi-ni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
translation_verse: Livo lɛɛyɛyɛ na anwula aanú, nsu Katɔti litemi ani lise lite uwi ƒui.’ ”

english_verse: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
translation_verse: Awɔ ɔni nda litemi buni éboku Sion ni, kɔ sie abi kangyaa ammɔ eli. Na awɔ ɔni nda litemi buni éboku Yerusalem ni, kɔliku ƒula lɛdi katɔ momoomo. Va momoomo, na tayia! Su Yuda lɛma lɛmmɔ anini, “Aanu ƒula Katɔti!”

english_verse: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
translation_verse: Bɛnu, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́si ɔdubo ubadi bekyuli lɛlɔ ku nwuna ɔyikun bonwu. Bɛnu, ɔdanku lɛyuƒɔla ku kɔnu bɔsia etela úboku bekyuli.

english_verse: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
translation_verse: Ɔɔtɔnku nwuna badi aani baƒonu ɔdane buni, na ɔɔgyu baƒonubi bammɔ taada enu. Na ɔɔda-ma taamana nwuna kayi. Na bani nda bebi ni, ɔɔkpanku-ma buɛɛ.

english_verse: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
translation_verse: Ɔma ndubɔkana na ɔkɔku ɛpu ntu bumomo ku bɔgyu na nwuna lɛkɔkɔ iye unene kayaa ku nwuna enu na ɔti kana bune? Ɔma ndubɔkana na ɔsala kalɔ kamɛni lɛti uwi kagyigyɛ kemmo? Na ɔma ndubɔkana na uti abi ku abinkpo ɔsia unu lɛkɔkula lɛlɔ, na ɔti-nya unu?

english_verse: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
translation_verse: Ɔma nénu Unwoti kasusu kalɔ dii iye ɔma ndi nwuna kasusu utene ɔni nákya-nwu kakwɛ?

english_verse: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
translation_verse: Ɔma na Unwoti úye ɔnii ɔtina-nwu lɛla lɛdi asa na ɔ́ti. Na ɔma nátina-nwu kesii kani na ɔsia? Ɔma néte-nwu lɛlati iye ɔ́tina-nwu ulu ɔni na ɔsia unu ala kalɔ?

english_verse: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
translation_verse: Geen ni, bekyuli bayawine baaadi lɛla lɛdi na Unwoti anumi. Mmomu buse bese aani kalɛ na ntu buudú teebo lɛkpibui kemmo kani iye aani ɔtumu na unu lɛnila lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔnu ntuntɛkɔlɔ ƒui aani ɔtumu na nwuna lɛkɔkɔ.

english_verse: The cattle on the mountains of Lebanon would not be enough to offer as a sacrifice to God, and the trees would not be enough for the fire.
translation_verse: Lebanon egyii ƒui étedu ka basala-nya ogya babla lɛkpa. Na bebuo bani nkya Lebanon abi lɛlɔ mmɔ ƒui bétedu ka beti-ma bakyula babla akpala bete Unwoti.

english_verse: God thinks of the nations as far less than nothing.
translation_verse: Kayawi kadi bekyuli ƒui baaadi Unwoti lɛla lɛdi na ulánu-ma taakya lɛla lɛdi kemmo munu munu.

english_verse: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
translation_verse: Katɔti uuuse aani lɛla lɛni na bakywɛɛne bánwamana sika ugyiedi bámana na béti sika ɔƒualadi asɛɛ bákya-nwu bɔdia.

english_verse: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
translation_verse: Na bekyuli beeti ugyii kpakplaa ɔni na bánu ka ulebun. Na bawia ɔnwine ɔni ndubɔnwi lɛla lɛmmɔ unyene na ulálɛ ulébo.

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?
translation_verse: Bɔgyi na bɛɛɛgyi tɔ ukyuli ɔni na Katɔti ɔdi? Munuu bítenu tɔ? Na ɔdi lɛnɔ útasu-mii tɔ ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ? Bítenu tɔ ɔmɛni kalɔ ɔ́si ɔni na údie kayawi?

english_verse: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
translation_verse: Anwu ɔni nédie kayawi ni, uli nwuna lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na ɔɔdi kayawi bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ ɔ́ka ɔ́mana ɔ́si kayaa katɔ katɔ ƒui. Údie kayaa kammɔ na kebi bekyuli lɛlɔ na bakya-nwu kemmo aani kɔdi kevo bonwu, na ɔɔnu-ma teemene aani bakpɔtilikpɔ.

english_verse: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
translation_verse: Bese aani egyiibi akɔdi ani na bágyu bátálɛ, na uwi útetu tɔ ana lɛlɔ na bedie ligyiitu, asa na Unwoti ɔ́ya na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ úkpo ɔ́vi-nya lɛlɔ, na áyɛyɛ na ákwii ábla aani lɛtɔ lɛni na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uuti taavinku.

english_verse: The holy God asks, “Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal?”
translation_verse: Ɔma na bɛdubuti Unwoti Kedee bɔkɔku? Buse na ukyuli ɔdi use aani nwuna kalɛ?

english_verse: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
translation_verse: Bɛkɔliku bina anumi katɔ na bɛnu kayaa, na biye lɛlɔ bɛnii ɔma nédie ala ammɔ ƒui? Anwu mɔɔlɛ́ku ayabi keyi unwi unwi na ɔ́sia ɔdi biala lɛnyi. Na ɔkɛnku nwuna ɔyikun bonwu ɔsu ni, lɛyabi lɛdi liláyii nina kenyekɔ.

english_verse: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
translation_verse: O Israel, bi ala na bɛɛká taasu ka Unwoti ulánu bina ala ani muukpóku-mii taati, na ɔɔɔdaku-mii lɛda lɛnɔ?

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Bɛɛɛgyi na bítenu dii lɛnɔ ka Unwoti ndi Katɔti ɔni nli usela uwi ƒui, na anwu nédie kayawi ku kana kemmo ala ƒui? Lɛlɔ liletu-nwu kudii na ukyuli ɔdi lɛnɔ ulakana-nwu kasusu bɔkɔku bɔnu kalɛ na kese.

english_verse: The Lord gives strength to those who are weary.
translation_verse: Anwu mɔɔsɔku ɔlɔkplu teete bekyuli bani na lɛlɔ lítu na bese kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Bakloƒu ku begblebi muedi lɛlɔ liitú-ma na baabla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ na baagbánta teebuli.

english_verse: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
translation_verse: Nsu bani néti bana anu básia Unwoti lɛlɔ ni, bana ɔyikun ɔdubɔsɔ ɔbla ɔwɔdi. Na bana ɔyikun ɔdubuse aani kalɛ na kɔdigbo aasɛ uuveyi taavi kayaa. Na badubo usi bukeli na balanɔ bukeli. Na badubusie lɛgba na lɛgba lilakpulu-ma.

english_verse: Be silent and listen, every island in the sea. Have courage and come near, every one of you nations. Let's settle this matter!
translation_verse: “Amii ntuntɛ kɔlɔ ƒui bɛbla kpoo na mina anumi! Bise kayi na bɛni bide-mi ku bina etemila amii kadi kadi bekyuli ƒui. Na bɛya na bɔsa na litemi katɛkɔ.

english_verse: Who appointed this ruler from the east? Who puts nations and kings in his power? His sword and his arrows turn them to dust blown by the wind.
translation_verse: “Ɔma náƒuna lɛlɔ ɔdine ɔmɛni ɔ́siku ɔƒɛ katukɔ ɔnii ubabla-nwu kabla na ulu siin ɔmɛni lɛlɔ? Na ɔma náya na ɔɔdi kadi bekyuli ƒui ku baga baga lɛlɔ na uuboku-ma kalɔ? Na nwuna kewii ku atula eesusu-ma na beenwíni ɔtumu ɔni na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uubó taavinku?

english_verse: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
translation_verse: Ɔɔbɔku-ma ku usi ɔni na alati si nwuna lɛgba muedi lɛsɔ liitúku kalɔ. Na lɛla lɛdi lɛnɔ lilatu-nwu na ɔƒɔ ɔlɛ ɔdi.

english_verse: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
translation_verse: Ɔma mɔɔyá na ala amɛni aalɛ́ na ɔɔnu ana bɔlɛ lɛlɔ na kaba kaba bekyuli akɔ ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ útédu kawɔlɔkɔ? Ami Unwoti na ɔdi! Ami nli asa na lɛla biala lɛdubuse kalɔ na ndubo bulie na lɛla biala libo kawɔlɔkɔ.”

english_verse: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near. What Can Idols Do?
translation_verse: Ntuntɛ kɔlɔ bekyuli ƒui útédu kalɔ kammɔ kawɔlɔkɔ bánu lɛla lɛni na lɛ́bla na liƒu líƒie-ma na baatɔ́ kpakpaakpa ɔni na bási badubo.

english_verse: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Na ɔdi biala uubunku ɔkpanadi na beesé lɛlɔ kayi taasu banini, “Bitaya na ɔmmɔ ukpoku-mii, binye momoomo!”

english_verse: Woodcarvers, goldsmiths, and other workers encourage one another and say, “We've done a great job!” Then they nail the idol down, so it won't fall over. The Lord's Chosen Servant
translation_verse: Na banwine ku bakywɛne ku baƒiɔ bammɔ kabla bablane bamba bákya lɛlɔ ogya na béte lɛlɔ adaku ka ama ndaku kabla. Na béku baƒiɔ bani na bávɔ mmɔ bálɛ kalɔ kalɛ na balálɛ belébo.

english_verse: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.
translation_verse: “Nsu awɔ Israel, Yakob kaba, adi mina kabla ɔblane. Lɛ́ƒuna-mii na bɛdi mina ɔkpana Abraham kaba kemmo bebi.

english_verse: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, “You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.”
translation_verse: Lɛ́kpanku-mii lɛ́siku kalɔ ɔgyu na kana kɔkunɔ ƒui líboku mɛni na lɛ́su-mii nnini, ‘Amii ndi mina kabla bablane baƒunadi na ńteni-mii.’

english_verse: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
translation_verse: Bitayia, nliku-mii. Liƒu lɛsɔ litada-mi na bitaatɔ kpakpaakpa. Ami ndi bina Katɔti. Ndubɔya na bɛkɛ ɔyikun, na libunku-mii. Ndubɔtalaku-mii katɔ ku mina ɔyikun ablala ani nse siin.

english_verse: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.
translation_verse: “Ukyuli biala na uukisi-mii na ɔ́ta unye-mii lɛlɔ ka ukpo-mii ni, kɔƒa kɔdubo-nwu bukpo na ɔyii udu.

english_verse: You will look around for those brutal enemies, but you won't find them— they will be gone.
translation_verse: Na bɛsɔ bilanu bina bekisine badi na kesii kadi, ɔsika badubɔyii udu ƒui na basa na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
translation_verse: Ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔni nda-mii kɔnu anwuɔsu bitayia, ɔsika nnye-mii kudɔ ka libunku-mii.

english_verse: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
translation_verse: Amii Israel kadi bekyuli, bɛda lɛlɔ bukpoku bɛya ina bekyuli baanu-mii aani liklubi iye biiimomo na bɛɛɛdi lɛla lɛdi. Amii ndi Israel Katɔti kedee ɔni mɔɔgyumana-mii na mɔɔƒɔ́-mii ngba.

english_verse: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
translation_verse: Bɛnu! Ndubo-mii bɔbla aani kukɔ kɔni anyi mbo ɔbi kaduɛ na bɛdubɔkɔ bɛvi abi ƒui lɛlɔ bɔbla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ aani ɔtumu.

english_verse: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor
translation_verse: Na bibo-nya bitéwi aani kalɛ na baaƒɛ́ lɛla lɛdi, na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uti lɛla biala ɔtɔlɔku. Nsu amii ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubo-mii bɔyɔ na bimwi ami bina Unwoti Israel Katɔti kedee.

english_verse: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔni na bawabane ku bani na bese kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ beekpi utukwɛ na balakɛ ntu na bani ni, ami Unwoti Israel Katɔti ndubo na mbedie-ma na naaayiƒala-ma kudii.

english_verse: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
translation_verse: Ndubɔya na ntukpa bɔlɛ bɔsi abi eli na bɔgba butéyi ɔkwalɛ ɔmmɔ ƒui. Na kalɔ kakwiidi kani na kaládia lɛla lɛdi kadubɔlɛ abiɔ na unwini lɛba muedi.

english_verse: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔya na egyii enengudi ani na ebo ɔkplu lidu lidu aƒɔ ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo ƒui aani Sida ku akasia ku abambadi udu.

english_verse: Everyone will see this and know that I, the holy Lord God of Israel, created it all. Idols Are Useless
translation_verse: Na bekyuli ƒui badubɔnu ɔmɛni na bati na ɔbla-ma nwaa ka ami Israel Unwoti Katɔti kedee nédie ala amɛni ƒui.”

english_verse: I am the Lord, the King of Israel! Come argue your case with me. Present your evidence.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ami ndi Unwoti Israel Ɔga! Biti bina litemi biboku na bɔtɛ bɔnu na bidie lɛlɔ kenye.

english_verse: Come near me, you idols. Tell us about the past, and we will think about it. Tell us about the future, so we will know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Na bɛlɛku bina baƒiɔ biboku na basu ala ani nálɛ ábavi ɔ́si kukuuku na bunu. Na basu ala ani ndubo abálɛ uwi ɔni mebo lɛnɔ na bɔti-nya buse ku uwi ɔni lɛnɔ na adubo bɔlɛ.

english_verse: Prove that you are gods by making your predictions come true. Do something good or evil, so we can be amazed and terrified.
translation_verse: Na bɛsu-bu lɛla lɛni na uwi ɔni mebo mmɔ ɔdanku ɔduboku, na bɔti ka bɛdi baƒiɔ bayikune. Bɛbla akɔla budie taatina bɔdi na bɔnu, likpidi lɛdi o-o, lɛbuni lɛdi o-o ni, na bɔnu bɔyia ku liƒu, na bina ala abla-bu yaa.

english_verse: You idols are nothing, and you are powerless. To worship you would be disgusting.
translation_verse: Nsu amii ku bina ablala ƒui bɛdi lɛƒua na biiibo kɔsia kɔdi. Lɛni kani na ukyuli ɔni maƒuna-mii ɔnii bɛdi-nwu lɛla lɛdi ɔdi ukyuli ɔni muusé lɛlɔ geen.

english_verse: I, the Lord, appointed a ruler in the north; now he comes from the east to honor my name. He tramples kings like mud, as potters trample clay.
translation_verse: “Líitiku ukyuli ɔni ndubo ubadi-ɔ lɛlɔ lɛ́siku katɔ kakɛ na ɔdubɔsia ɔƒɛ katukɔ uteebo kalɛ na ubeti ɔbu ute mina lɛnyi. Na ɔɔkɔ́ taavi lɛlɔ badine lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na baawɔ́ lɛvɔti na kaawɛ kemmo.

english_verse: Did any of you idols predict what would happen? Did any of you get it right? None of you told about this or even spoke a word.
translation_verse: Bina akɔ ɔmani násu lɛla lɛmɛni udu úse na bekyuli bati batualaku lɛtɔtɔ na básu lɛnɔ ka lɛla lɛni na ɔ́su lɛdi sɔsɔ? Baƒiɔ badi bátasu ɔmɛni bétese dii. Na ukyuli ɔdi lɛnɔ uuubo na ɔsu ɔnii únu kenye kammɔ udu kudii.

english_verse: I was the first to tell the people of Jerusalem, “Look, it's happening!” I was the one who announced this good news to Zion.
translation_verse: Ami náka Yerusalem kadi bekyuli lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ mɛni bɔsu. Na ami néti litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛ́kya ɔtu ɔdi kenye.

english_verse: None of these idols are able to give advice or answer questions.
translation_verse: Baƒiɔ bamɛni akɔ ɔdi uuubo na uute kasusu iye udie lɛla lɛdi kenye si líye-nwu lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: They are nothing, and they can do nothing— they are merely a passing breeze.
translation_verse: Baaadi lɛla lɛdi na balákana lɛla lɛdi lɛnɔ bɔbla. Mmomu buse na bese aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔnwuna taavi kani.”

english_verse: Here is my servant! I have made him strong. He is my chosen one; I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Aanu mina kabla ɔblane ɔni na lɛ́ƒuna, mɔɔyɔ́-nwu geen na nnye-nwu kama kpakplaa lɛnɔ. Líti mina Kɔyu lɛ́kya-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo, na ɔdubuti ala bɔbla ulu lɛlɔ siin buboku kayawi kadi bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.
translation_verse: Ulakyaku ukyuli ɔdi unyeƒi iye bɔva. Na ɔdi ulénu-nwu lɛdi na kuyeya ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: He won't break off a bent reed or put out a dying flame, but he will make sure that justice is done.
translation_verse: Ugyii ɔni na ɔ́bu unye ni, ulaƒɛ-nwu uledie. Na ogya ɔni mɔɔyuɛ ni, ulenine-nwu uledie. Mmomu ɔdubɔdi litemi lɛlɔ, na uti ala bɔbla ulu lɛlɔ siin uboku bekyuli akɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: He won't quit or give up until he brings justice everywhere on earth, and people in foreign nations long for his teaching.
translation_verse: Ulayila nwuna lɛnunsia, na enu lɛnɔ alaƒɛ-nwu úti útédu uwi ɔni na ɔ́ya na ala bɔbla ulu lɛlɔ siin bɔ́ƒɔ kalɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na kadi bamba kɔlɔ bekyuli ƒui báƒɔ nwuna ala ani na ɔɔtina.

english_verse: I am the Lord God. I created the heavens like an open tent above. I made the earth and everything that grows on it. I am the source of life for all who live on this earth, so listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti ɔni nédie katɔ lɛ́ƒala kayaa. Na ami nédie kalɔ ku ala ani na akya-ka kemmo ƒui. Na bekyuli bani ƒui nli kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, ami muute-ma ngba ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni na baanwuna.

english_verse: I chose you to bring justice, and I am here at your side. I selected you and sent you to bring light and my promise of hope to the nations.
translation_verse: Lɛ́ƒuna-a ka eti ala bɔbla ulu siin lɛlɔ eboku bekyuli akɔ. Na anwuɔsu na nnye-ɔ kudɔ. Lɛ́ƒuna-a na lɛ́tala-a ka enwini bukeye ku mina bunyimi kenye kani na líse ete kayawi kadi bekyuli.

english_verse: You will give sight to the blind; you will set prisoners free from dark dungeons.
translation_verse: Na adubɔya na banumbwɛne basɔ bataanu na aya na bekyuli bani na likpidi líbo-ma lɛkpu na bakya kasuudikɔ aani batɔntɛne bakɛ bɔnwuna na balɛ bana ekpidi kemmo.

english_verse: My name is the Lord! I won't let idols or humans share my glory and praise.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi Unwoti na lɛɛɛdubo bunye bɔnu na baƒiɔ iye ukyuli ɔyawine ɔdi ɔta unye ɔnii ami ku-nwu buule mina bukeye ku bumwi bɔni na ɔlɛka bekyuli beti bete-mi.

english_verse: Everything has happened just as I said it would; now I will announce what will happen next. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Bɛnu! Ala ani ƒui na lɛ́su ka adubo abálɛ ni, álɛ lɛni sɔsɔ kalɛ kani na lɛ́su. Na ɔƒɛni ni, ndubo-mii ala ani nsɔ ndubo abálɛ bɔsu.

english_verse: Tell the whole world to sing a new song to the Lord! Tell those who sail the ocean and those who live far away to join in the praise.
translation_verse: “Bɛsu kayawi ƒui na bedie ɔnu ɔwɔdi bete ami Unwoti. Na bɛsu bani ƒui nkɛ ɛpu anumi baaví ku bani nli kalɔ ɔgyu kakaaka ƒui bɛnii basalaku-mii na beti bumwi bete-mi.

english_verse: Tell the tribes of the desert and everyone in the mountains to celebrate and sing.
translation_verse: Bɛsu adua ani bekyuli nli kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ ku bani na abi lɛlɔ ƒui bɛnii batɔ na badi limeyi na bedie lɛnu.

english_verse: Let them announce his praises everywhere.
translation_verse: Na bebo kudu kenye kani na ɔ́su úse na kesi kesii.

english_verse: The Lord is marching out like an angry soldier, shouting with all his might while attacking his enemies. The Lord Will Help His People
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́nya kalɔ ɔɔví aani ukpone, na uudie lɛdi ku kɔnyi momoomo uwi ɔni na uubó nwuna bekisine teewi kalɔ.”

english_verse: For a long time, I, the Lord, have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Nnye mɔɔnu-mii kpoo, na naaakpete-mii uwi gyɔlɔɔ mɛni. Nsu ɔƒɛni amu ni, ndubo bɔva na nteedumo aani uleku ɔni ntɛ kɔwɔ.

english_verse: I will destroy the mountains and what grows on them; I will dry up rivers and ponds.
translation_verse: Ndubo bɔya na abi ku abinkpo ƒui ayii udu, na livo ku lɛku kemmo egyii ammɔ ƒui akwii. Na lɛya na ntukpa ku abiɔ ƒui akwii.

english_verse: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔtɔnku mina banumbwɛne bɔsiaku ulu ɔni na baaagyi kudii lɛlɔ. Na lɛkpanku-ma lɛsiaku ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na bátasia kudii lɛlɔ. Na ndubɔya na kasuudikɔ kani na bakya kenwini bukeye. Na kesii kani na kese kpukplo kpukplo kabla suɛlɛ suɛlɛ. Na ndubo ala amɛni bɔbla ɔni na lɛɛɛdubo-nya bɔda buse.

english_verse: Everyone who worships idols as though they were gods will be terribly ashamed. God's People Won't Obey
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bani na baƒiɔ bani na bekyuli bávɔ na basia anu na baalɔ-ma baƒiɔ bayikune ni, badubo bunwini ku kɔƒa.

english_verse: No one is as blind or deaf as his messenger, his chosen servant,
translation_verse: Ɔma bene ndi banumbwɛne ku batutine bammɔ si ɔɔɔdi amii mina kabla bablane bani na lɛ́ƒuna na bɛdi mina batu?

english_verse: who sees and hears so much, but pays no attention.
translation_verse: Bɛ́ɛnu mina ala bɔbla, nsu bɛɛdaku-ni, na bina atu ewi, nsu bɛnii bilénu lɛla lɛdi kalɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and so he wanted his Law to be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Ka Katɔti use siin na ɔɔbla lɛla biala kaduɛ ɔsu ni, ɔdi-nwu lɛƒɔyɔ ka bekyuli banu kalɛ na nwuna ɔda bubo buukeye na bemwi-nwu.

english_verse: But his people were trapped and imprisoned in holes with no one to rescue them. All they owned had been taken, and no one was willing to give it back.
translation_verse: Nsu nwuna bekyuli bamɛni na béƒie bátɔlɔku na bákya-ma lɛtɔ ku libu kemmo na ukyuli ɔdi uuubo na udie-ma. Na béƒie bana akɛla ƒui báƒɔ na bekyuli bammɔ belenu kalɔ ka basɔku-nya bete-ma.

english_verse: Why won't his people ever learn to listen?
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na bekyuli bamɛni balatɛya kalɛ beenú litemi?

english_verse: Israel sinned and refused to obey the Lord or follow his instructions. So the Lord let us be robbed of everything we owned.
translation_verse: Israelƒuɔ bábla likpidi na béni banii belenu Unwoti litemi iye basiaku nwuna ala bɔtina kama. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na Unwoti ɔ́ya na béƒie-ma ala ƒui báƒɔ.

english_verse: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.
translation_verse: Úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya-ma, anwuɔsu na ɔ́ni-ma kɔtu na kekpo kénwini ogya na ɔɔda na bana kɔlɔ lɛlɔ. Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui útabla-ma lɛla lɛdi na benu-nwu litemi. Na baaadaku-ni ina dɛ na ogya ɔmmɔ ɔ́ka ɔ́mana-ma na uuƒí-ma muedi.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I, the Lord, created you and formed your nation. Israel, don't be afraid. I have rescued you. I have called you by name; now you belong to me.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Ami nédie amii Yakob kaba kemmo bebi na lɛ́bla-mii na bɛdi Israel kadi. Bɛda bɔyia bɛya, ɔsika ami nédie-mii. Lɛ́sia-mii lɛnyi lɛni na mɔɔlɔ-mii na ɔƒaani bɛdi mina badi.

english_verse: When you cross deep rivers, I will be with you, and you won't drown. When you walk through fire, you won't be burned or scorched by the flames.
translation_verse: Na si bɛɛvia ketu bonwu kani nágyu dɛ muedi ni, nliku-mii na bilánu-ka. Na si ogya kemmo na bɛkɛ muedi ulakyula-mii. Na ogya unyemi ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ulekeyi-mii.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your God, the Holy One of Israel, the God who saves you. I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia, and the region of Seba in exchange for you.
translation_verse: Ami ndi bina Unwoti Israel Katɔti Kedee ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mii ngba. Na kalɛ na amii bɛkɛ bɔnwuna ɔsu ni, lídie Egyipte ku Kus ku Seeba kadi bekyuli ƒui atu.

english_verse: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.
translation_verse: Bɛ́ƒɔ-mi kuye geen na mɔɔyɔ́-mii. Anwuɔsu na lídie kɔlɔ bamba ku bana bekyuli atu kalɛ na lɛƒɔ-mii.

english_verse: Don't be afraid! I am with you. From both east and west I will bring you together.
translation_verse: Bitayia, ɔsika nliku-mii. Na ndubɔsala-mii lɛsiku ɔƒɛ katukɔ ku kanukɔ ƒui liboku liku linwi.

english_verse: I will say to the north and to the south, “Free my sons and daughters! Let them return from distant lands.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔsu kɔlɔ kɔni na katɔ ku kada kakɛ bekyuli nnini, ‘Bɛnyonu mina bebi bananabi ku belekubi na benwini basi kalɔ ɔgyu ɔgyu mmɔ bebo.

english_verse: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.” The Lord Alone Is God The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɔsika mina bekyuli na badi, na lídie-ma kalɛ na beti ɔbu bete mina lɛnyi.’

english_verse: Bring my people together. They have eyes and ears, but they can't see or hear.
translation_verse: Bɛsala mina bekyuli bite-mi. Bebo anumi ku atu, nsu belenu na balanu.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation to gather around. None of them can honestly say, “We told you so!” If someone heard them say this, then tell us about it now.
translation_verse: Bɛsala lisu amii kadi ƒui bekyuli. Bina ɔdi biala ulakana kɔnu kayi bubo bɔsu ɔnii lɛla lɛni na bina akɔ ɔdi ɔ́su nébo líte mɛni. Na si ɔdi ɔkya-mii akɔ na wakana bɔsu ɔnii bina ɔdi ɔ́su lɛla lɛdi úse na líbo lɛni sɔsɔ ni, na ubedie kenye na bunu.

english_verse: My people, you are my witnesses and my chosen servant. I want you to know me, to trust me, and understand that I alone am God. I have always been God; there can be no others.
translation_verse: Mina bekyuli, amii ndi mina kabla bablane ku litemi lɛmɛni kenye bediene. Na mɔɔwia ka bɛti-mi na biti bina kayi bɛsia-mi lɛlɔ na binu kalɔ ka ami lɛti ndi Katɔti. Ami kani nákya uwi ɔni návi na ami kani ndubo bɔkya uwi ɔni lɛnɔ mebo, ɔsika ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo mina kalɛ.

english_verse: I alone am the Lord; only I can rescue you.
translation_verse: Ami lɛti kani ndi Unwoti ɔmmɔ, na ami ndubɔƒɔ-mii ngba.

english_verse: I promised to save you, and I kept my promise. You are my witnesses that no other god did this. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Lɛ́su-mii líse ka ndubudie-mii, na lɛ́di mina linyese lɛlɔ sɔsɔ. Amii ndi mina kenye bediene ka ɔdi ɔ́sɔ útabla ɔmɛni udu kudii. Na bɛti ka ami Unwoti mɔɔtɛmi.

english_verse: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way. The Lord Will Prepare the Way
translation_verse: Ami ndi Katɔti ɔƒɛni ku uwi ɔni mebo lɛnɔ úsela ƒui. Ukyuli ɔdi ulakana-mii buƒie bɔƒɔ mina kudɔ na ɔdi lɛnɔ ulakana bunye bɔda-mi ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will rescue you! I am Israel's holy God, and this is my promise: For your sake, I will send an army against Babylon to drag its people away, crying as they go.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi Unwoti Israel Katɔti Kedee. Na mɔɔwia ka binu kenye kani na muusé-mii. Na amii ɔsu ni, ndubɔtala bekpone badi na Babel kalɔ lɛlɔ na batákpɛ-ma balɛku mmɔ ku keku uwi ɔni na baatɔlɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your holy God, Israel's Creator and King.
translation_verse: Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti Kedee ɔni nédie Israel na ndi-nwu ɔga.

english_verse: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: “Ami nékulo kuƒi lɛ́va ɛpu bonwu ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out. Forget the Past The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ami kani nédie bekpone badi ulu na báta básia-mii kama na belie bapɔnkɔ lɛlɔ ku kɛɛkɛ kemmo. Nsu ɔƒaani ni, bana ƒui békpi ɔni na bɔsɔ bɔta buuubo ɔdi lɛlɔ. Na bélieku asogya ɔni kabuli mɔɔda na báni-ka bédie-nwu kemmo kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: Forget what happened long ago! Don't think about the past.
translation_verse: Bɛyiƒala uwi ɔni návi, na bɛda kuuku uwi etemila bidie kasusu, na ɔdi ɔsɔ uteti ɔmmɔ utada.

english_verse: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.
translation_verse: Bɛnu, lɛla lɛwɔdi na muudie keyi ɔƒɛni! Munuu bina anumi alanu ka lɛ́kɔ lɛɛlɛ́? Lídie lilu lɛ́siaku kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo na ntukpa bɔ́lɛ kalɔ kakwiidi kani mɔɔwia ntu geen kemmo.

english_verse: Every wild animal honors me, even jackals and owls. I provide water in deserts— streams in thirsty lands for my chosen people.
translation_verse: Beƒiebuo ƒui baabu-mi ku bekuku ku beƒukutu na ntu bɔni na líte mina kadi bekyuli baƒunadi ka bani na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo ɔsu.

english_verse: I made them my own nation, so they would praise me.
translation_verse: Lɛ́bla-ma na badi mina kadi bekyuli kalɛ na beti ɔbu bete-mi.

english_verse: I, the Lord, said to Israel: You have become weary of me, but not from worshiping me.
translation_verse: “Ami Unwoti lɛ́su amii Israelƒuɔ nnii bíitu lɛlɔ geen, nsu ɔɔɔdi ami na bɛɛkpali.

english_verse: You have not brought delicious spices for me or given me the best part of your sacrificed animals. Instead, you burden me down with your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Bíteboku-mi kutu akyala ƒɛƒɛɛ adi iye bɛƒuna bina bebuo bani na bɛ́du kabunikɔ ƒui biboku-mi. Mmomu ami na binye biikpóku ku bina ekpidi bonwu bonwu pii ani na bɛɛbla.

english_verse: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
translation_verse: “Nsu na ukyuli ɔni na ndi ɔsu ni, mɔɔƒɔ bina ekpidi teedie-mii lɛlɔ uwi biala. Anwuɔsu ndubo bina ekpidi ani ƒui na bɛ́bla bɛ́ƒiɔ-mi bɔyiƒala.

english_verse: Meet me in court! State your case and prove that you are right.
translation_verse: Bibo bibasiaku-mi na litemi katɛkɔ na bidie lɛlɔ kenye ka amii ɔdi ɔ́tɛ na bítaƒiɔ.

english_verse: Your earliest ancestor and all your leaders rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Bina bati kuuku ku bina batɔnkune ƒui báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu nsɔ ńtete kuƒi ka bina bakpane babla-mi kabla. Mmomu lɛ́ya na bákyula Israel kadi na bákya bina bekyuli kɔƒa.”

english_verse: People of Israel, I have chosen you as my servant.
translation_verse: “Israelƒuɔ, binu, ami náƒuna-mii aani mina kabla bablane.

english_verse: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.
translation_verse: Ami ndi bina Udiene. Na ami návɔ-mii na kaƒɔ kemmo na ami kani ndubo-mii lɛlɔ bɔnu. Liƒu litada-mii, mina kabla bablane baƒunadi na bɛdi na mina kayi kasia-mii lɛlɔ geen.

english_verse: I will bless the thirsty land by sending streams of water; I will bless your descendants by giving them my Spirit.
translation_verse: Ndubɔya na ɔnantu ɔna uwi kalɔ kani mɔɔwia ntu na ntukpa bɔlɛ kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo. Na ndubuti mina Kɔyu lite bina bawɔ na mina kusɛ kusɛ ɔsiaku bina kaba kemmo bebi.

english_verse: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.
translation_verse: Na badubɔlɛ lili aani livo ku ketudɔ egyii ani mɔɔlɛ́ lili gyɛnglɛɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, udeedi ku ukplodi, Israel Katɔti unwi ɔni kani nkya, na ndi bina Ɔga ɔni náƒɔ-mii ngba.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Ɔma na ɔnii anwu use aani mina kalɛ? Ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔlɛ ubo na ubedie lɛlɔ kenye. Ɔda ɔlɛ-mi anumi na ɔsu ala ani ƒui na lɛ́su líse ɔ́si mina kuuku uwi bekyuli lɛlɔ ku ani nsɔ masia ɔmmɔ kama, na ubimi ana ƒui kemmo na bunu.

english_verse: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Lɛ́ɛsu-mii ɔ́si kukuuku nnii, bɛsɔ bitayia na bitaatɔ kpakpaakpa ku liƒu munu munu na bítenu? Ami lɛti kani ndi Katɔti na ɔdi ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdi katamikukɔ kpakplaa aani lɛtakpɛ bonwu mina kalɛ.”

english_verse: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?
translation_verse: Dɛ na baanwí lɛla iye baavɔ́ lɛla teese lɛlɔ anii ataakpa nsu kɔsia kuuubo-nwu kemmo ka ulakana lɛla lɛdi bɔbla ɔsu?

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified. Idols and Firewood
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔnwí baƒiɔ bamɛni ku bani mɔɔkpá-ma badi bekyuli keeke bani na bana kawɔlɔkɔ kadubɔbla kɔnyana geen. Nnye ngya-ma na litemi katɛkɔ na badubo babasiaku-mi na ulése-ma buɛɛ.

english_verse: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.
translation_verse: Ala ɔkywɛne ni, ogya liwulu ku lɛbuala lɛni na uuti teebo ala na uuti taakywɛ baƒiɔ bamɛni. Ɔyikun ɔni nkya-nwu kɔnu na uuti teetu lɛbuala bamba na ɔɔkywɛɛ baƒiɔ bammɔ udu ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́. Nsu si kɔka ku utukwɛ use kalɔ ɔɔda-nwu ni, ɔyikun ɔmmɔ ɔɔsá na lɛlɔ lɛɛbla-nwu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: Some woodcarver measures a piece of wood, then draws an outline. The idol is carefully carved with each detail exact. At last it looks like a person and is placed in a temple.
translation_verse: Na ligyii ɔnwine ni, ugyii likuku na ɔɔkɔ́ku na ɔta ukyuli ɔni udu na ɔɔwia ɔnwi ɔsia-nwu lɛlɔ. Ɔmmɔ kama na ubeyi ugyii ɔmmɔ na ɔnwi ukyuli udu ɔni na ɔɔwia na beti-nwu batálɛ bana kakpakɔ na ɔƒiɔtɔ.

english_verse: Either cedar, cypress, oak, or any tree from the forest may be chosen. Or even a pine tree planted by the woodcarver and watered by the rain.
translation_verse: Na lɛku kemmo egyii kpakplaa lidu kemmo na ɔnwine ɔɔƒuna teeti taanwi ala ammɔ udu. Na uwi pii banwine bammɔ alati baalɛ egyii ammɔ na ɔnantu ɔna ubo-nya asa na abi lɛlɔ na ɔdia bɔnwi.

english_verse: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
translation_verse: Egyii ammɔ kakɛ kadi na beeti taakya ogya na eete liwulu iye baanwá adila. Na likuku lɛkladi na ɔnwine uuti taanwi baƒiɔ bani na ɔɔkya lili kalɔ teete ɔnii ɔɔbu.

english_verse: He enjoys the warm fire and the meat that was roasted over the burning coals.
translation_verse: Kugyii kɔmmɔ kakɛ kadi nkya ogya ɔɔda, na uute ukyuli ɔmmɔ liwulu na lɛlɔ lɛɛbla-nwu gugungu. Na agyabi ammɔ lɛlɔ na úƒi lɛna ɔɔkun na lɛɛyu-nwu emini.

english_verse: Afterwards, he bows down to worship the wooden idol. “Protect me!” he says. “You are my god.”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ƒui kama ni, na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔlɛ akɔnkɔ ute ligyiiku lɛkladi lɛni na ɔ́nwi ɔnii ɔɔbu taasu ɔnini, “Gyumana-mi! Awɔ ndi mina baƒiɔ bayikune.”

english_verse: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
translation_verse: Beeebo kasusu kani na bati beye lɛlɔ banini, “Ligyiiku lɛmɛni kakɛ kani na líti lɛ́kya ogya líƒulo adila ku lɛna na kakɛ kakladi na líti lɛ́nwi lɛla lɛni neeebo kalɔ na lɛɛɛdi lɛla lɛdi mɛni. Bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka ntaabu ligyiiku?”

english_verse: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka ukyuli ɔdɔlɔ laa lɛni utédu ka unye utaabu lɛla lɛni na bakana bakyula benwini ntɔ na ulanu taati ka ɔkɔ ala bɔbla na adi mmɔ, na ɔmmɔ uláƒɔ-ma ngba ka baaadi baƒiɔ bayikune ɔsu?

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.
translation_verse: O Israel kadi bekyuli, bitaakali ala amɛni taanu, ɔsika mina kabla bablane na bɛdi, na budie na lídie-mii nnii bitaabla mina kabla. Anwuɔsu lɛɛɛdubo-mii bɔyiƒala kudii.

english_verse: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Binwini bibo-mi kudɔ, ɔsika lɛ́ƒɔ-mii ngba na lídie bina ekpidi ƒui bina lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na liƒlukutu lɛɛyii takya kayaa.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
translation_verse: Bidie lɛnu ku ebiti, amii bani nkya katɔ ƒui ku bani nkya kalɔ lɛlɔ, ɔsika Unwoti nábla ala amɛni. Na abi ku lɛku kemmo egyii ƒui asalaku-mii na lɛlɔyɔ lɛnu lɛmɛni kemmo. Unwoti údie nwuna kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ, na ɔ́tina kalɛ na uukeye na badubo-nwu bɔbu.

english_verse: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
translation_verse: “Israel, bɛnu bɛti ka ami ndi Unwoti, na mina kudɔ na ngba ƒui bɔɔlɛ́ taasi. “Ami náƒɔ-mii ngba, na ami nédie lɛla biala na lɛkya katɔ úbalɛ kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
translation_verse: “Ami muubile ɔkɔ kenye bediene ala bɔsu na mɔɔyá na bekebone baadɔlɔ na banundane lɛlati liinwíni kɔdɔlɔ lɛla lɛni kemmo na kasusu keeebo.

english_verse: I will make the message of my prophets come true. They are saying, “Jerusalem will be filled with people, and the Lord will rebuild the towns of Judah.”
translation_verse: Ndubɔya na mina kenye bediene ala ani básu banini, ‘Bekyuli badubo bumomo na baƒɔ Yerusalem ƒui na Unwoti ɔsɔku ɔma ɔmmɔ ɔda ubo-nwu kemmo.’

english_verse: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
translation_verse: “Ami muudie lɛdi taakya ɛpu ku ntukpa ƒui na bɔɔkwii.

english_verse: I am also the one who says, “Cyrus will lead my people and obey my orders. Jerusalem and the temple will be rebuilt.”
translation_verse: Ami násu nnii, ‘Kores ndubɔtɔnku mina bekyuli aani baƒonu ɔdane kalɛ na babla lɛla lɛni mɔɔyɔ́-mi kaƒɔ. Na badubɔsɔku Yerusalem ku kakpakɔ kammɔ batu.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su nwuna ukyuli ɔƒunadi Kores ɔnini, “Ami nda-a kɔdianu kɔnu kalɛ na libunku-ɔ na adi kadi bekyuli pii lɛlɔ. Na abɔku baga pii alɛku bana lɛga kadikɔ. Badubɔlɛmi lɛma linengudi lɛban kenye bewi-ɔ na balakalɛ ɔdi belenyene.

english_verse: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.
translation_verse: Ɔni na ntɔnku-ɔ mɛni ni, ndubo abi ƒui bɔbwɛ na ebo kalɔ. Na ndubɔƒɛ abuala ani na béti bábala abuala kɔyakun kɔlɛmikɔ na lɛma linengudi lɛban ƒui kenye.

english_verse: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.
translation_verse: Ndubuti akɛla ani nkya kabɛkɔ ku kasuudikɔ ƒui lite-ɔ. Na adubɔnu ati ka ami Unwoti Israel Katɔti nákpali-ɔ na ébo-mi kudɔ ku lɛnyi lɛni na lɛ́sia-a.

english_verse: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
translation_verse: Kores, ina ka aaagyi-mi ni, lɛ́kpali-ɔ ku lɛnyi lɛni na lɛ́sia-a na líti ɔbu líte-ɔ geen na mina kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ bani na lɛ́ƒuna na badi mina kabla bablane ɔsu.

english_verse: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
translation_verse: Ami lɛti kani ndi Unwoti! Na ɔbambadi ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo mina kalɛ. Ami nábla-mii na bibo ɔyikun ina ka bɛɛɛgyi-mi.

english_verse: Now everyone from east to west will learn that I am the Lord. No other gods are real.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani ni, ukyuli biala ɔ́si ɔƒɛ katukɔ útédu ɔƒɛ kanukɔ ɔdubɔti ka ami ndi Unwoti ɔmmɔ na baƒiɔ badi beeebo na badi lɛla lɛdi geen mina kalɛ.

english_verse: I create light and darkness, happiness and sorrow. I, the Lord, do all this.
translation_verse: Ami nédie bukeye ku lɛdisa, na ami muute kusɛ kusɛ na ɔgbankpi lɛnɔ ɔɔsiáku ukyuli. Ami Unwoti mɔɔbla ɔmɛni ƒui.

english_verse: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Ndubɔya na ala bɔbla siin bɔsi katɔ na liƒlukutu kemmo bubo aani kalɛ na ɔnantu ɔɔna. Na ngba bɔƒɔ ku ala bɔbla siin bɔkwɛ aani livo na bɔƒɔ kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui kalɛ na ami Unwoti lídie-ka nnii use kalɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
translation_verse: “Libui lɛvɔdi lilákyaku nwuna ɔvɔne unyeƒi. Anwuɔsu ni, Israel, eeebo kuƒi kɔdi ka awɔ ku ƒula Udiene bɛkya unyeƒi ɔdi, ɔsika lɛvɔbui kani na adi na ɔvɔne ɔ́vɔ-ɔ kalɛ na ɔɔyɔ́. Na lɛvɔbui liléye nwuna ɔvɔne ɔnini, ‘Bi ɔsu na ávɔ-mi lɛni iye átati-mi bɔvɔ na átabla-mi lɛmɛni ku lɛni ngye?’

english_verse: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
translation_verse: Bebi beeebo kuƒi ka beye bana bawɔne banini, ‘Dɛ na bɛ́bla na bɛ́wɔ-bu na bɔdi bekyuli bani na bɔdi?’ ”

english_verse: I am the Lord, the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?
translation_verse: Unwoti Israel Katɔti Kedee ɔni ndi bana Udiene ɔnini, “Buye na ukyuli ɔdi ɔdubɔkana na use kayi uye-mi lɛla lɛdi ɔ́siku mina kadi bekyuli lɛlɔ iye lɛla lɛni ndubo libalɛ uwi ɔni mebo lɛlɔ?

english_verse: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
translation_verse: Ami nédie kayawi na lɛ́bla ukyuli lɛ́kya-ka kemmo. Ami ɔlati néti mina enu na línene kayaa lɛ́ƒala katɔ ku ala ekeyedi ani ƒui nkya kayaa mmɔ.

english_verse: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
