translation_verse: Ndubɔya na Kores únwini ɔyikune ɔni mɔɔdi lɛlɔ na ulu siin lɛlɔ. Na ndubɔya na nwuna kasiakɔ ƒui kabla-nwu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. Ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui! Na Kores na lɛ́ya na ɔdubɔsɔku Yerusalem mina ɔma unengudi bɔtu na ɔya na mina bekyuli bakɛ bɔnwuna na belie ku atu bɔyɔ. Nsu ɔɔɔdi lɛyuƒɔla lɛdi kenye. Lɛla lɛni na ami Unwoti lɛ́su na lɛdi mmɔ.

english_verse: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
translation_verse: “Egyipteƒuɔ ku Kusƒuɔ ku Sebaƒuɔ bani nákuku kangya kangya mmɔ akɛla adubunwini amii adi. Na badubunwini bina kabla bablane na bibo-ma kɔgba bɛda bitaavinku na basiaku-mii kama. Badubɔkya lili kalɔ bete-mii na bevele-mii basu banini, ‘Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka Katɔti ɔsiaku-mii na anwu lɛti lɛnɔ ndi Katɔti ɔmmɔ.’ ”

english_verse: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
translation_verse: Awɔ ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́ Israelƒuɔ ngba ni, sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka adi Katɔti ɔni mɔɔbɛla lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔvɔ́ baƒiɔ ni, badubo-ma kɔƒa bɔkya na anumi ewi-ma kalɔ.

english_verse: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti ɔdubudie Israel na bakɛ ngba uwi ƒui ɔni na kɔƒa kulékpo-ma iye anumi ewi-ma kalɔ kudii.

english_verse: The Lord alone is God! He created the heavens and made a world where people can live, instead of creating an empty desert. The Lord alone is God; there are no others.
translation_verse: Unwoti lɛti kani ndi Katɔti! Anwu nédie katɔ ku kalɔ kesii kani na bekyuli bakana bulie, utulo ka udie ketele kalɔ kakwiidi sɔɔn kani kemmo na lɛla lɛdi liiibo. Unwoti lɛti kani ndi Katɔti, na ɔbambadi ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo.

english_verse: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
translation_verse: Unwoti útatɛmi útasiku kasuudikɔ iye ɔsu Yakob kaba kemmo bebi ɔnii bawia-nwu kama ulu kekeeke. Mmomu litemi geen na Unwoti ɔɔsu ɔnini,

english_verse: to every survivor from every nation: “Gather around me! Learn how senseless it is to worship wooden idols or pray to helpless gods.
translation_verse: “Bɛsala-mi kudɔ amii bani nébu na kadi biala bekyuli akɔ na kɔlɔ kɔmmɔ kemmo! Na bɛnu bɛti kalɛ na ɔdi kɔdɔlɔ ka binye bitaabu baƒiɔ iye ala anwidi na bitaakpali-ma bɛnii ama mebunku-mii aani bina Unwoti, nsu balakana-mii bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
translation_verse: Bɛta na bɔsa na litemi katɛkɔ, munuu ńtasu-mii ɔ́si kukuuku lɛla lɛni ndubo libalɛ? Ami lɛti kani ndi Katɔti ɔmmɔ! Na ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubunku-mi. Ami kani mɔɔƒɔ́ bekyuli ngba na ami kani mɔɔbla ala ulu siin lɛlɔ.

english_verse: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
translation_verse: “Bɛlɔ kayawi bekyuli ƒui na bebo-mi kudɔ na bakɛ ngba bɔƒɔ. Ami lɛti kani ndi Katɔti! Na badi baasɔ baaadi lɛla geen lɛdi.

english_verse: I have made a solemn promise, one that won't be broken: Everyone will bow down and worship me.
translation_verse: Líse kenye kpakplaa kani na kalavumana kudii, na ukyuli biala ɔdubo lili kalɔ bɔkya bɔbu-mi.

english_verse: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
translation_verse: Na bana ƒui badubɔtuna ka sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka ami lɛti kani mɔɔbla ala ulu siin lɛlɔ. Na ɔdi biala na úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya-mi ni, kɔƒa kɔdubo-nwu bukpo geen na unwini ubo-mi kudɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ami Unwoti ndubo bɔya na Israelƒuɔ badi lɛlɔ na lɛya na baƒɔ lɛnyi geen.”

english_verse: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
translation_verse: Babelƒuɔ baƒiɔ bani ndi Bel ku Nebo ɔdi ɔ́sa. Bana baƒiɔ egyiiku na bála básia bebuo ala betine lɛlɔ bésela. Na ɔdi etila úte bebuo bani náanɔ geen mmɔ.

english_verse: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Aanu baƒiɔ bammɔ enu ku akɔnkɔ nlɛ kalɔ, na bátakana na báƒɔ bekyuli bammɔ ngba na bana ɔgbankpi kemmo. Nsu básɔ bágyu-ma béti baatɔlɔku, ɔni na kekpo kéƒie-ma na bésela kalɔ bamba lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
translation_verse: “Amii bani nébu na Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ binu ami Unwoti lɛdi. Ɔsika ɔ́si limeyi lɛni na báwɔ-mii kani na líse kalɔ mɔɔnu-mii lɛlɔ, na nda-mii mɔɔvínku.

english_verse: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
translation_verse: Na ami ni, kalɛ nse lɛni kani na ndubo buse uwi ɔni na amii bɛ́ɛbi lɛlɔ na eli áƒuala-mii, na ami ndi ukyuli ɔni nda-mii mɔɔnu lɛlɔ. Ami nédie-mii na ami kani ndubo-mii lɛlɔ butaanu na lidie-mii na lɛda-mii kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? Is anyone my equal?
translation_verse: “Ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔɔdi-mi ligye na ɔdi lɛnɔ ulakana na weti lɛlɔ wakɔku-mi.

english_verse: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badi beesié taatáƒɔ ala bakywɛne na kayu kenye, na bete-ma sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi, na betu-nwu babla baƒiɔ bete-ma na bataakpa.

english_verse: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
translation_verse: Baagyú baƒiɔ bammɔ taasia lɛmangba taatáwia-ma kesekɔ, nsu ama alati balákana busie. Na si uwi ɔni na lɛla lɛdi lítulo bekyuli bammɔ ni, na besie batákpali-ma banii baƒiɔ bammɔ bebunku-ma nsu balákpete-ma na bedie kenye kadi na balákana-ma bubunku lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
translation_verse: “Ɔƒaani ni, mɔɔyɔ́ ka biƒie ɔmɛni bɛkya lili, amii alaekpidi bablane na bɛsɔ bitayiƒala.

english_verse: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
translation_verse: Bɛbla kasusu bɛsiku ala ani nálɛ akwa pii ábavi lɛlɔ. Ami lɛti kani ndi Katɔti! Na ɔbambadi ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo uuubunku-mi mina kalɛ.

english_verse: From the very beginning, I told what would happen long before it took place. I kept my word
translation_verse: Lɛla biala kalɔ kesekɔ ƒui na lɛ́su líse ala ani ndubo abálɛ asa na aalɛ́ ɔmwi na bɛɛnu. Na ɔɔtina ka lɛ́di mina litemi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
translation_verse: Lɛ́kpaku ukyuli ɔdi lɛ́siku kalɔ na ɔgyu ƒui, na úbo úbabla lɛla lɛni na mɔɔwia ka ɔbla ute-mi. Úkpo bekyuli ɔ́si ɔƒɛ katukɔ aani kalɛ na kasangbii kaatu taayu teeƒie lɛla lɛdi. Na ɔƒaani ni, ndubo mina litemi lɛlɔ bɔdi na lɛbla lɛla lɛni na lɛ́su líse.

english_verse: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
translation_verse: Bise atu na binu, bina atu ebo ɔkplu geen, na kalɛ na bɛkana na bilie ƒaa ku atu bɔyɔ bɔ́gyunku-mii.

english_verse: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ndubo mbaƒɔ-mii, na uwi ɔsɔ uletu. Ńtagyunku-mii, ɔsu lɛɛɛdubo uwi ɔdi bubile. Ndubo Yerusalem budie na mina lɛnyi likeye na Israel.”

english_verse: City of Babylon, You are delicate and untouched, but that will change. Surrender your royal power and sit in the dirt.
translation_verse: “Babel, awɔ ɔni nse aani ugblebi adagyaa, ta ƒula lɛgadi liboku lɛlɔ, na etélie ɔtumu akɔ, ɔsika ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdubo-ɔ bɔlɔ ɔnii ukyuli ɔni náƒɔ kuye na baabu-nwu.

english_verse: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badubo-ɔ kasɔngya bɔnu na kɔƒa kukpo-ɔ, ɔsika adubo bɔvi ku kasɔngya. Na ndubo kasi budie na ɔdi ulébu iye ukeli.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
translation_verse: Ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, Kedee. Na ami mɔɔƒɔ́-ma ngba.

english_verse: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
translation_verse: “Babel, bile kenye kpoo na asɔ elie kasuudikɔ mmɔ, ɔsika kadi kadi bekyuli basɔ baaadubo-ɔ bɔnu aani bana uleku ɔga.

english_verse: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
translation_verse: Kɔnyi na líti lɛ́kya mina bekyuli anwuɔsu na lɛ́ya na bíƒie-ma kalɔ bɛ́ƒɔ, na bɛ́ya na kɔƒa kúkpo-ma na anumi éwi-ma kalɔ. Bítanu-ma kɔnyana munu munu, mmomu bɛ́bla-ma kalala útédu bana benengu ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla-mii aani bɛdubo lɛga lɛmmɔ bɔdi buteesie uwi ƒui. Na bɛ́sɔ bítabu ala ani na bɛɛbla lɛlɔ bítanu, na ubo-mii kasusu kemmo ka lɛla lɛdi lɛdubo amii lɛnɔ bɔbla.

english_verse: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Bɛ́bu bɛnii amii kani ndi bayikune ntulo ƒui, na amii bilénwini bekpinele, na bina bebi lɛnɔ belekpi. Mmomu lɛla lɛni kani lɛlɔ na bina anu asia ndi, bɔdi ku bɔni ngba emini. Nsu binu lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu-mii ɔƒɛni.

english_verse: Your magic powers and charms will suddenly fail, then you will be a widow and lose your children.
translation_verse: Bina evo ku bɔkanti ƒui kenye kadubo bukulo na binwini bekpinele, na bina bebi lɛnɔ bekpi kɔnakunwi ɔni na kama bɔnu buuubo.

english_verse: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
translation_verse: Bɛ́bɛ binye bina ekpidi pii ani na bɛɛbla kama aani kekpo lɛgyumanala na bíse kayi bɛɛsu bɛnini, ‘Ukyuli ɔdi ulanu-bu!’ Nsu bina lɛlati ku lɛnunda líse-mii lisusu, na bɛ́kali ka amii kani ndi bayikune bani mɔɔdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But without warning, disaster will strike— and your magic charms won't help at all.
translation_verse: Nsu na bina tati tese kemmo ni, ɔgbankpi ɔdubo-mii bɔlɛku, na bina evo ammɔ ƒui aaadubo-mii bubunku munu munu.

english_verse: Keep using your magic powers and your charms as you have always done. Maybe—just maybe— you will frighten somebody!
translation_verse: “Amii binye bitaabla bina evo, na bitaakanti kalɛ kani na bítaabla, ɔƒɛni kalɛ bina evo ammɔ adubɔkya ukyuli ɔdi liƒu! Bɛya na buti-nwu lɛni.

english_verse: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
translation_verse: Bíitu lɛlɔ bɛ́vi bɛɛwia kasusu na bekebone ku bani mɔɔnu kɔbuli taasu-mii ala kudɔ uwi gyɔlɔɔ mɛni. Bɛsɔ binwini bisie na bitéye-ma ala ani ndubo bɔlɛ ku kalɛ na bɛdubɔkɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani néti bana anu básia bekyuli bani mɔɔnu ayabi taasu-ma ala lɛlɔ ni, bana lɛlɔ libo kɔnyana geen utulo lɛtɔ lɛni na bákya ogya kemmo na lɛɛkywí. Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔwa-a ogya ɔmmɔ udu muedi lɛlɔ lilábla gugungu.

english_verse: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani na bɛ́bi bɛsiaku usien ku ɔƒɛ bina ngba emeyi ƒui ni, ɔmmɔ ndi bana kawɔlɔkɔ kebunku kani na bakana-mii bute, na ama alati baaagyi kesii kani na bésela na balakana-mii bɔƒɔ lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.
translation_verse: “Israelƒuɔ, Yakob ɔtɔ kemmo bebi na bɛdi na bɛ́si Yuda kɔdua. Bɛɛsu taatina bɛnii ami Unwoti Israel Katɔti na bɛɛbu, nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui ɔkɔ na ɔdi.

english_verse: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Bɛnii Yerusalem ndi bina ɔma na bina anu ƒui asia ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
translation_verse: Lɛ́su-mii ala ani ndubo abálɛ ɔ́si kukuuku na lɛ́kɔ-nya lɛsa líte-mii ku mina kenye na lɛ́bla lɛni sɔsɔ kɔnakunwi na ébo éte lɛni.

english_verse: I knew you were stubborn and hardheaded.
translation_verse: Ngyi ka bibo atu ɔkplu ku lili ɔkplu.

english_verse: And I told you these things, so that when they happened you would not say, “The idols we worship did this.”
translation_verse: Na lɛ́su-mii ɔmɛni ƒui líse kalɛ na si uwi ɔni na ébo aalɛ́ ni, na bilasu bɛnini, ‘Baƒiɔ bani na bɔɔkpá nábla ala ammɔ.’

english_verse: You heard what I said, and you have seen it happen. Now admit it's true! I will show you secrets you have never known.
translation_verse: Bínu ala ani na lɛ́su na bɛ́nu kalɛ na álɛ lɛnɔ. Na amii na ɔdi ka bɛsu ka sɔsɔ na ɔdi. “Na ɔ́si ɔƒɛni ni, ndubudie abɛla ani na bɛɛɛgyi tɔ kudii lɛtina-mii

english_verse: Today I am doing something new, something you cannot say you have heard before.
translation_verse: Na adi ala awɔdi ani na átakya kuuku aani ɔmwi ɔdi ɔni na biinú-nya kɔku mɛni. Anwuɔsu ɔdi ulakana bɔsu ɔnii ‘Ngyi-nya na líinu-nya kɔku dii.’

english_verse: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
translation_verse: Ɔ́si kukuuku ƒui bina atu étebimi tɔ na binu lɛla lɛdi kalɔ. Na ɔ́si uwi ɔni na báwɔ-mii ni, ngyi-mii kalɛ na bɛ́lɛ-mi kama na bɛ́ta binye-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni na ndi ku kalɛ na bekyuli bemwi-mi ku ɔbu ɔsu ni, muuwi lɛlɔ ku mina kɔnyi ablala kalɛ na naaayila bekyuli udu.

english_verse: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
translation_verse: Lɛ́kɔku-mii lɛ́nu na lɛbibo kemmo aani kalɛ na baakya sika ɔƒualadi ogya kemmo taabla-nwu kede kede.

english_verse: I did this because of who I am. I refuse to be dishonored or share my praise with any other god.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́bla ɔmɛni na ami ɔlati lɛƒɔyɔ kenye ku ukyuli ɔni na ndi ɔsu. Ɔsika lɛɛɛdubo bɔtuna na mina lɛnyi lɛyii udu, iye ukyuli ɔdi ule mina ɔbu ku bukeye bɔni na bekyuli beete-mi.

english_verse: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
translation_verse: “Israel, mina kadi bekyuli baƒunadi, bise atu na binu. Ami lɛti kani ndi Unwoti udeedi ku ukplodi.

english_verse: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
translation_verse: Ami ɔlati néti mina enu na lídie kalɔ na líbimi kayaa lɛ́ƒala katɔ na beenú-mi lɛdi uwi biala na lɛ́kpali-ma.

english_verse: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
translation_verse: Bina ƒui bɛsala lɛlɔ na bibo-mi kudɔ, na binu lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu. Bina baƒiɔ badi básu banii ala amɛni adi adubɔlɛ? Munuu básu-mii na bínu si ukyuli ɔdi ɔdubɔbla lɛla lɛmɛni udu ku Babelƒuɔ?

english_verse: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
translation_verse: Ami náƒuna-nwu na lɛ́ɛtɔnku-nwu ḿbedu kesii kani na bɛɛnu mɛni. Na ɔdubo lɛlɔ bɔdi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
translation_verse: “Bɛni bide-mi bibu na binu! “Ala ani ƒui na lɛ́ɛka bɔsu ni, ńtasu-nya ńtabɛ na ɔdi útenu-nya. Na uwi ɔni na ala ammɔ aalɛ́ lɛnɔ ni, nli mmɔ.” Unwoti Katɔti ɔkɛnku nwuna Kɔyu ɔyikun lɛlɔ na ɔ́tala-mi.

english_verse: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Israel kadi bekyuli, ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti ɔni muudie-mii. Na kalɛ na ɔdianku-mii ɔsu na mɔɔtina-mii ala, na mɔɔkpanku-mii taasiaku ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.
translation_verse: Si bunu na nka bínu-mi litemi ni, nka bíilie kalɔ kpi ku atu bɔyɔ aani kalɛ na ketu kaatɛ taagba buɛɛ na bɛbla siin aani kalɛ na ɛpu ntu bɔɔta ku bukeye.

english_verse: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bemomo bina kalɔ lɛlɔ utulo ɛpu kɔnwinimi. Na nka lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na kadi badi badi-mii lɛlɔ na bayila-mii udu.”

english_verse: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔƒaani ni, bɛtɔlɔ Babel! Na si bɛ́yu ulu bísela ni, na biteedie lɛnu taatɔ ku ebiti. Na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii na biteebo kudu na ukyuli biala unu-mii kɔku bɛnini, “Unwoti údie nwuna kabla ɔblane Yakob.”

english_verse: He led us through the desert and made water flow from a rock to satisfy our thirst.
translation_verse: Ɔ́kpanku-bu ɔ́sia kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo na ɔ́ya na ntu bɔ́bwɛ bɔ́lɛ lɛtakpɛ kemmo na bɔ́ni na bɔ́du bula utukwɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti úse kenye ɔnii, “Ukyuli ukpidi biala ulákɛ atu bɔyɔ.”

english_verse: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala use kɔtu na unu, amii ɔgyu kadi bamba bekyuli ƒui bani nkya ɛpu ɔvi. Unwoti ɔ́ƒuna-mi na ɔ́sia-mi lɛnyi asa na báwɔ-mi.

english_verse: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na mina kenye etemila aatu bekyuli aani kewii kani mbo ɔbi geen iye lɛtula lɛni kenye nse ƒiolu ƒiolu na use yayaaya na atula koƒo kemmo. Ɔda-mi kɔkɔɔkɔ na ɔ́bɛla-mi na nwuna lɛkɔkɔ kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Israel, awɔ ndi mina kabla ɔblane ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔkɛnku na bekyuli badubo-mi bumwi.”

english_verse: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
translation_verse: Nsu lɛ́su nnini, “Lɛ́bla kabla lítu lɛlɔ na ńtanu kɔsia kɔdi. Na líbile mina ɔyikun lɛnɔ keeke na ńtanu lɛla lɛdi. Nsu lɛla lɛni ndi mina lɛdi ni, Unwoti lɛkɔkɔ na lɛkya. Ɔsika anwu ndubo-mi kayu bɔƒɔ na lɛla lɛni na lɛ́bla kenye.”

english_verse: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔni návɔ-mi na mina uni kaƒɔ kemmo ɔnii nnwini-nwu kabla ɔblane asa na badubɔwɔ-mi ni, anwu nátala-mi ɔnii nkpanku Yakob ku nwuna kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ mboku-nwu kudɔ, ɔsika Unwoti ɔɔbu-mi geen na anwu kani mɔɔkya-mi ɔyikun asa na mɔɔbla lɛla biala.

english_verse: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ndubo-ɔ kabla kenengudi kɔnu bɔkya butulo ka akpanku Yakob adua ammɔ ƒui ku Israelƒuɔ bani nébu eboku-mi kani. Mmomu ndubɔbla-a na enwini bukeye ete kadi bamba bekyuli ƒui kalɛ na bayawine ƒui bakɛ ngba bɔƒɔ.”

english_verse: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔni ndi Israel Katɔti Kedee ɔni lɛnɔ ndi bana ngba ɔƒɔne ɔ́su nwuna kabla ɔblane ɔni na bekyuli béni na beekisi-nwu kpakplaa ɔsu na únwini ɔɔbla-ma kabla ɔnini, “Baga badubɔnu-ɔ na bata benye na bagabi badubɔnu-ɔ na bakya-a lili kalɔ, ɔsika ami Israel Unwoti Kede ɔni náƒuna-a mɔɔdi mina litemi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
translation_verse: “Si mina uwi údu ka lɛƒɔ-mii ngba ni, ndubunu bina bɔkpali na libunku-mii. Na ndubɔgyumana-mii na lɛda-mii kɔkɔɔkɔ. Na ɔkɛnku amii ɔsu ni, ndubo bunyimiku kadi bekyuli ƒui bunyimi bɔdi. Na ndubɔya na bɛsɔ bilie kalɔ kpi na bina kalɔ kani nwi na lɛla biala líbie-ka kemmo ɔƒɛni mɛni kemmo.

english_verse: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔsu bani na béƒie bátɔlɔku nnii ‘Bɛlɛ-ma lɛlɔ bɔdi kalɔ na bɛkɛ bɔnwuna. Na amii bani nkya kasuudikɔ ni, bɛlɛ bibo bukeye kemmo!’ “Na badubɔbla aani baƒonu bani nnye kɔbi lɛlɔ baakun livo.

english_verse: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
translation_verse: Na kɔka iye utukwɛ ulada-ma. Na ɔƒɛ ku kalɔ kakwiidi liwulu lilekeyi-ma. Mmomu anwu ɔni mɔɔnu-ma kɔnyana na ɔɔgyumana-ma ɔdubɔtɔnku-ma usienku kesii kani na abiɔ ntu bɔbuni bɔkya.

english_verse: I will level the mountains and make roads.
translation_verse: Ndubɔbwɛ abi ammɔ na lidie ulu unengudi lɛva-ma kalɛ na basia-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
translation_verse: Mina kadi bekyuli badubɔsi ɔlɔgyu na katɔ kakɛ ku ɔƒɛ kanukɔ bebo na basi Siniƒuɔ kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ lɛnɔ bebo.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
translation_verse: Bɛsu katɔ ku kalɔ bɛnii beteedie lɛnu na bataatɔ ku ebiti. Na bibo ɔda bite abi ammɔ lɛnɔ ƒui bɛnii ama lɛnɔ bebunku na beteedie lɛnu. Ɔsika Unwoti bekyuli bébo abi nsu ɔƒɛni amu ɔ́nu-ma kɔnyana na ɔ́yala-ma kɔƒɔ.

english_verse: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
translation_verse: Sion kadi bekyuli básu banini, “Unwoti únwini kama ɔ́kya-bu na ɔ́yiƒala-bu.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti údie kenye ɔnini, “Ubi uni ɔdi ɔdubɔkana na ɔyiƒala ubi ɔni nányimi-nwu lɛnyii? Munuu ɔdubuni na uláyɔ ubi ɔni nálɛ ɔ́si-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo? Ina ubi uni ɔdi ɔdubɔbla lɛni ni, ami lɛɛɛdubo-mii bɔyiƒala kudii.

english_verse: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
translation_verse: Lɛ́ta-mii lɛ́sia mina lɛkɔkɔ na bina ala akya-mi kasusu kemmo uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
translation_verse: Bina bebi badubo ɔma ɔmmɔ bɔsɔku bɔtu kɔnakunwi butulo kalɛ na béti bébile-nwu. Na bina bekisine bammɔ badubɔlɛ-nwu kemmo batɔlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
translation_verse: Kɔliku anumi katɔ na anu amana, na anu ka ƒula bebi básala lɛlɔ na basi badubo. Na ka ami Unwoti ɔni nli uwi ƒui na ɔdi ɔsu ni, muusé-ɔ kenye nnii ƒula ɔma unengudi ɔmɛni ku nwuna bekyuli ƒui badubɔlɛ lili na badia bɔnu aani uleku ɔni na báwɛɛ-nwu ku sika ugyiedi asɛɛ abuni.”

english_verse: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Ɔƒaani ni, buse na Yerusalem use aani ɔma ɔni na ɔ́bwɛ na lɛla lɛdi lɛsɔ liiibo-nwu kemmo. Nsu badubɔsɔku-nwu batu na bekyuli baƒɔ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo tɛtɛɛtɛ. Na bekisine balalane bani nkya ɔma ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ama badubusie ɔgyu kakaaka na ɔma ɔmmɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
translation_verse: Yerusalem use aani uleku ukpinele ɔni nsɔ naaanu nwuna bebi ɔsu únwini udinkɔ na uuwulo kɔnyana ka ɔ́yila nwuna bebi ku ɔgyani ɔsu. Nsu nwuna bebi bammɔ kani ndubo babasu-nwu banini, “Búmi na kesii kani na bɔkya na bɔɔwia ka abla keliekɔ bamba ete-bu na ɔma unengudi ɔni na bekyuli báƒɔ-nwu kemmo mmɔ.”

english_verse: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yerusalem aani uleku ɔmmɔ kalɛ ɔdubuye ɔnini, “Ɔma náwɔ bebi bamɛni ama. Lɛ́yila mina bebi na nsɔ naaanu-ma. Wɛ na bamɛni bási? Béti-mi bésienku kaƒɔ na liiibo ɔma nanyuɛ bebi bamɛni? Ami lɛti kani nebu nli. Na wɛ na bebi bamɛni bási?”

english_verse: The Lord God says: “I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛmɛni geen na Unwoti ɔ́su nwuna bekyuli ɔnini, “Líbo kadi bamba bekyuli kɔnu na ndubɔkɔliku mina aƒlaga katɔ lɛtina bekyuli bammɔ ƒui. Na badubɔkpanku ƒula bebi bananabi bada kɔnu, na bagyu ƒula belekubi basia amangba beboku-ɔ.

english_verse: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
translation_verse: Na kadi bani akɔ na bákya mmɔ baga ku beleku baga badububo babataanu-mii lɛlɔ aani bina kabla bablane bani nnye bati ku beni kenyekɔ bete-mii. Na badubɔkya lili kalɔ bete-mii. Na bɛdubɔnu bɔti ka ami ndi Unwoti ɔmmɔ. Na anumi elewi-mii kalɔ si bíti bina anu bɛ́sia-mi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Is it possible to rescue victims from someone strong and cruel?
translation_verse: Uuuse kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ka esie na etékpo aƒɔ ukyuli ɔdi na ɔlalane ɔni na ubo ɔkplu geen enu kemmo.

english_verse: But the Lord has promised to fight on our side and to rescue our children from those strong and violent enemies.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti úse-bu kenye ka ɔdubukpo ute-bu na ɔƒɔ bula bebi ɔsiku bekyuli bekpidi bani ndi bula bekisine bayikune bani mbo kalala mmɔ enu kemmo.

english_verse: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔya na bekyuli bekpidi bammɔ bakun ama alati bana ɔlɔna aani lɛna na bani bana ubugya bekpi aani kalɛ na baaní ntɛ teekpi. “Na ukyuli biala ɔdubɔnu ɔti ka ami ndi Unwoti Israel Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mii ngba na ɔɔyá na bɛɛkɛ́ bɔnwuna.”

english_verse: I came and called out, but you didn't answer. Have I lost my power to rescue and save? At my command oceans and rivers turn into deserts; fish rot and stink for lack of water.
translation_verse: Líbo ḿbawia-mii na ńtanu ɔdi, na lɛ́kpali-mii, nsu ńtenu bina ɔdi kɔku lɛnɔ. Bɛɛbu bɛnii mina ɔyikun ɔni na liti lɛƒɔ-mii ɔ́sa iye ɔ́yii udu na naaakana na maƒɔ-mii ngba? Ami muudie lɛdi na ɛpu ku ntukpa ƒui bɔɔkwii teenwini kalɔ kakwiidi na kɔkpaku kuukpi na kuubun teenwenyi ka básɔ bátakɛ ntu ɔsu.

english_verse: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
translation_verse: Ami mɔɔyá na kayaa kaabla suu aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔda kekwa uwi kɔnyana adala si uuwulo kɔnyana.”

english_verse: The Lord God gives me the right words to encourage the weary. Each morning he awakens me eager to learn his teaching;
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́tina-mi lɛla lɛni na libimi kenye lɛsu na lɛkya ukyuli ɔni na lɛlɔ lɛ́bla-nwu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ogya. Ɔɔgyila-mi ɔtanta biala na ɔɔlɛmi-mi atu na muunú ala ani na ɔɔtina-mi.

english_verse: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na muusé atu teenu-nwu litemi na naaabla atu ɔkplu iye linwini kama lɛkya-nwu.

english_verse: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
translation_verse: Mɔɔda mina kama teese na beebó kugyiimi na baagyɔ-mi keduo linwini. Na ina ka bédumi-mi na bétuo lisuo béwi-mi anumi muedi ni, ńtedeyi ńtesie kɔmadɔ kesii bamba kadi.

english_verse: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui ni, Unwoti ɔɔɔdubo bɔya na mina anumi ewi kalɔ, anwuɔsu na ami lɛnɔ nnii lɛɛɛdubo lɛlɔ atu budie, ɔsika ngyi nnii Unwoti ɔɔɔdubo-mi bɔnyonu bɔkya-ma enu kemmo na kɔƒa kukpo-mi.

english_verse: My protector is nearby; no one can stand here to accuse me of wrong.
translation_verse: Mina ɔgyumanane unye-mi kudɔ mɛni, anwuɔsu ɔdi ɔɔɔdubo-mi kudɔ bubo bubadu-mi likpidi lɛdi kɔtɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubo-mi bubunku na udie ɔtina ka lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-mi. Na bani ƒui mɔɔdá-mi kenye badubo udu bɔyii aani kalɛ na kubweyi kɔɔkun adi teebile.

english_verse: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Bina ɔdi biala ulábu Unwoti litemi, na bilenu nwuna kabla ɔblane litemi lɛnɔ. Na lɛdisa akɔ ala bɔbla na bɛɛyɔ́ teetulo ka bɛvi na bukeye kemmo. Na bítaƒɔ Unwoti bina Katɔti litemi lɛnɔ bítadi.

english_verse: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
translation_verse: Ukpo ɔni na amii alati bɛ́tu bɛda ni, bɛda-nwu na uteekeye teete-mii, na bitaanu teesie. Nsu bɛti nwaa ka Unwoti ɔlati ndubo nwuna kɔnu budie bɔni-mii kɔtu na bibo abi geen.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey the Lord, follow Abraham's example. He was the rock from which you were chipped.
translation_verse: Si bɛɛyɔ́ ka bitaabla ala siin na biteenu Unwoti litemi ni, na bilie ngba na bɛlɛ lɛtakpɛ lɛni lɛlɔ na bámami-mii básiku.

english_verse: God chose Abraham and Sarah to be your ancestors. The Lord blessed Abraham, and from that one man came many descendants.
translation_verse: Abraham ku Sara na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna ka babla bina nana ati bene. Na Unwoti úte Abraham ɔmɛni kusɛ kusɛ na ɔkɛnku anwu ɔnana unwi pɛ ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na kaba bekyuli lidu lidu báƒɔ kayawi.

english_verse: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
translation_verse: Ina ka bébile Sion na lɛla biala lɛsɔ liiise kaduɛ na ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo ɔƒɛni ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔya na kaƒɔ bɔyala ku ebiti ebo ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo, na ɔsɔ ɔdia bɔnu aani Eden ɔban ɔni na Unwoti ɔ́bla. Na mmɔ na lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ Sion na udie lɛnu na ɔtɔ ku ebiti uti ɔgya Unwoti enu.

english_verse: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Amii ndi mina kadi bekyuli, anwuɔsu binu-mi litemi. Na ala ani na mɔɔtina kadi ƒui bekyuli ɔdubɔya na mina ɔda bubo buti ala bɔbla ulu siin lɛlɔ uboku-ma na unwini bukeye ute-ma na bana keliela kemmo.

english_verse: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔsɔ uletu asa na ndubɔda bɔlɛ na bɛnu kalɛ na nse siin. Ɔsika mina bekyuli bɔƒɔ uwi údu na ndubɔtɛku bekyuli ƒui litemi. Kadi bekyuli bani na ketu ɔvi ƒui benye baanu-mi ulu ka libo mbedie-ma.

english_verse: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔliku anumi katɔ na bɛnu kayaa, na binwini bɛnu kalɔ lɛnɔ. Kayaa kammɔ kadubɔyii kakya aani kalɛ na uyɔ ɔɔyii taakya, na kalɔ lɛnɔ kayii udu aani kalɛ na kɔdi kɔɔtɔ taayii udu. Na ukyuli biala na kayawi kammɔ kemmo ɔdubukpi aani balɔlɔ. Nsu mina ngba bɔƒɔ bulebo kawɔlɔkɔ kudii na mina ala bɔbla siin lɛnɔ bulayii udu.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu amii bani ngyi lɛbuni lɛni na ɔdi ka bɛbla na bɛda mina ɔda bubo ku kayi ƒui ni, bise atu. Enu ataƒɛ-mii si bekyuli beedumi-mii na baatɛmi enyekpi na bina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
translation_verse: Badubo udu bɔyii aani kalɛ na kubweyi kɔɔkun adala teebile. Nsu mina ngba bɔƒɔ ku ala bɔbla ulu lɛlɔ siin ute bekyuli ƒui bulebo kawɔlɔkɔ kudii.”

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord. Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?
translation_verse: Unwoti, buvele ta! Ta na ada alɛ ku ƒula ɔyikun na edie kɔnu na abla ɔyikun ala aani kalɛ kani na ábla dii na kuuku uwi ɔni na bula bati kuuku bélie. Bɔgyi ka awɔ nádu Rahab, ɛpu kemmo liƒu kebweyi bonwu kammɔ ékulo eku eku.

english_verse: Didn't you dry up the deep sea and make a road for your people to follow safely across?
translation_verse: Na awɔ kani náya na ɛpu ntu bɔ́kwii na kalɔ kekpludi kálɛ na ƒula kadi bekyuli bani na édie bákɛ ulu básia mmɔ bálɛ.

english_verse: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
translation_verse: Unwoti, ƒula bekyuli bani ngba na áƒɔ badubɔsɔ benwini na besie Yerusalem ku bumwi lɛnu si bakɛ ulu bésela. Na ebiti adubunwini aani kagabwa kebi-ma lili, ɔni na lɛbibo ku bukpoku bɔdi bɔsɔ bulebo-ma lɛlɔ, na beduo kɔnyana kemmo kudii.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi Unwoti ɔni nése-mii kayi Na bi na bekyuli keeke badi? Bekyuli bani nse aani livo lɛni mɔɔyɛyɛ na ɔlɛka bitaayia-ma?

english_verse: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
translation_verse: Ami nébimi kayaa lɛ́ƒala katɔ na lɛ́kya kowodu kalɔ ɔka líte kalɔ kammɔ ƒui. Nsu amii bɛ́yiƒala ami bina Unwoti ku Udiene, na bekyuli bani néti kɔnyi bákya-mii na baawia ka badumi-mii mmomu na bilie bɛɛyia uwi ndi uwi, nsu wɛ na bakya ɔƒɛni?

english_verse: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala na béƒie, na ulie uuwulo keku na uunú ɔlɛ ɔƒaani ni, uwi uletu ɔdubɔkɛ bɔnwuna, na lidie-nwu na kukpi abuli ani nda-nwu mmɔ kemmo na ɔsɔ ulénu kɔka kɔdi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
translation_verse: Ndubo bana ƒui bubunku, ɔsika ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui. Na ami mɔɔyá na ɛpu uubó lɛdi ku kɔku.

english_verse: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Lɛ́tina-mii lɛla lɛni na bɛsu na nda-mii na mina lɛkɔkɔ kemmo kɔkɔɔ. Ami nébimi kayaa lɛ́ƒala katɔ na lɛ́kya kowodu kalɔ ɔka líte kalɔ kammɔ ƒui. Na mɔɔsu ɔƒaani nnini, ‘Yerusalem bekyuli ni, ami ɔdi na badi.’ ”

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
translation_verse: Yerusalem kadi bekyuli, bɛta! Bɛta binye, ɔsika Unwoti lɛtuni lɛni na úte-mii na bɛ́ni aani ntu na ɔɔƒɛɛ kemmo límo-mii lɛ́vili ɔƒaamu. Bɛ́ni lɛla biala útédu eku ekplodi na bɛsɔ bilakana na bisie ligeen.

english_verse: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
translation_verse: Na bina bebi pii bani na bɛ́wɔ mmɔ ɔdi uuubo na ɔtɔnku-mii iye udie kɔnu ɔda-mii lɛnɔ.

english_verse: You have been destroyed by war and by famine; I cannot comfort you.
translation_verse: Kɔka ku kekpo kɔ́du-mii ƒui. Na nsɔ naaakana-mii kɔnu kɔdi bɔsia lɛnɔ.

english_verse: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
translation_verse: Bina Unwoti Katɔti úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya-mii, na ɔkɛ ɔmmɔ ɔsu bina bebi ƒui bewi lilu lɛlɔ bávi kesii biala na kablakɔ kadi kasɔ keeebo-ma aani akwa ɔni na kakpagyuɛ kéƒie na ɔsɔ ulakana lɛlɔ bunene na abuli ammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
translation_verse: Bɛkya ɔgbankpi kemmo na ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ ɔɔda-mii nsu ɔɔɔdi ntɛ na bɛ́ni, anwuɔsu bise atu na binu kaduɛ.

english_verse: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
translation_verse: Bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔni muubunku-mii na ɔɔgyumana-mii ɔnini, “Lɛ́ƒɔ mina kɔnyi kɔni nse aani ntɛ ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔni kemmo na bɛ́ni lɛbibo bíkpi aani ntɛ mmɔ. Na basɔ belenye-mii lɛlɔ banii bɛni lɛbibo lɛmmɔ udu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Instead I will give it to your brutal enemies, who treated you like dirt and walked all over you.”
translation_verse: Mmomu ɔdubunwini usie bina bekisine bani nésusu-mii bákya bana lɛgba kalɔ aani ɔtumu kudɔ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, ta nye! Sion ɔma kedee, nye lɛgba lɛlɔ kpakplaa na ada lɛlɔ ku ƒula adala abuni ƒui. Ɔsika baƒɔ bani nébo bébebile ɔma kedee ɔmmɔ kemmo basɔ baaadubo keliekɔ kadi bɔkɛ na ƒula kemmo ɔƒɛni amu.

english_verse: Zion, rise from the dirt! Free yourself from the rope around your neck. Suffering Will End
translation_verse: Sion, ta na ɔtumu akɔ kesii kani na elie! Na ada ukyuli kalɔ bɔkya kabuli kani nda-a ɔkwɛ mmɔ edie.

english_verse: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you,
translation_verse: Kuuku ni, bísie bítélie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ aani baƒɔ. Mmɔ na Asiriaƒuɔ bábla-mii kalala ku ulikplu ala.

english_verse: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
translation_verse: “Na kadi bamba béƒie-mii bátɔlɔku ɔni na nka bítabla lɛla lɛdi. Bina batɔnkune bédumo geen na ɔlɛ bunu ɔsu. Na limeyi ndi limeyi ni, baakpali-mi lɛnyi teewida.

english_verse: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
translation_verse: Mina kadi bekyuli, bɛdubo-mi bɔnu bɔti ukyuli ɔni udu na ndi ku ami ɔni mɔɔtɛmiku-mii ɔni na nkya-mii akɔ mɛni.”

english_verse: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
translation_verse: Bi mɔɔdia bɔnu lɛni! Bɛnu abi lɛlɔ na binu bekyuli bani ndubo babakɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa kalɛ na bana bubo kɔku kɔɔda kubiti. Baakɔ́ keyi buɛɛ ku ngba bɔƒɔ lɛsa banini, “O Sion, ɔƒɛni amu ƒula Katɔti ndi bina ɔga.”

english_verse: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
translation_verse: Bise atu na binu ka bina bagyumanane beedie ebiti lɛnu ku lɛlɔyɔ. Na badubɔnu ku bana anumi uwi ɔni na Unwoti únwini ɔdubo Sion.

english_verse: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, awɔ ɔni na bábwɛ béwi kalɔ, ta na awɔ lɛnɔ atu kɔgya ku ebiti, ɔsika Unwoti ɔ́yala nwuna bekyuli kaƒɔ na úbo ɔnii ubedie Yerusalem.

english_verse: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
translation_verse: Unwoti údie nwuna ɔyikun bonwu keyi ɔ́tina kadi bekyuli ƒui. Na ɔƒaani ni, ukyuli biala ɔdubɔnu ɔti bula Unwoti Katɔti ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́ ukyuli ngba.

english_verse: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛda Babel ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ biwi na bɛlɛ-nwu kemmo! Na bitetuku lɛla lɛni muusé lɛlɔ lɛdi. Na bɛƒɔ bina adala ƒui amii bani nti Unwoti lɛlɔ ala ani nse kedee.

english_verse: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
translation_verse: Bitasu bɛnii biikeli, ɔsika ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔɔdubo-mii kama bɔsia. Israel Unwoti Katɔti ɔlati ɔdubo-mii bɔtɔnku na ɔgyumana-mii anumi ku kama ƒui ɔsiku bina bekisine bukpoku biala kudɔ.

english_verse: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Mina kabla ɔblane ɔdubo lɛlɔ bɔdi! Na bekyuli badubo-nwu bumwi ku ɔbu unengudi ƒui.

english_verse: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
translation_verse: Liƒu bonwu lɛ́da bekyuli pii na lɛla lɛni nálɛku-nwu ɔsu. Na bani ƒui nánu-nwu ni, liƒu lɛ́da-ma lítulo, ɔsika úbo abi na nwuna bɔnu bɔsɔ bulátina aani si ukyuli na ɔsɔ ɔdi muedi.

english_verse: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
translation_verse: Mina kabla ɔblane ɔmɛni ndubɔya na kadi bekyuli bamanku kalɛ na bakpa-mi. Na ɔdubɔbla baga kalɛ kadi na babla kpoo, na beboku eli kalɔ. Na lɛla lɛni na bétenu iye banu kudii ni, badubɔbla kasusu basiku-nya lɛlɔ na ɔbla-ma nwaa.”

english_verse: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
translation_verse: Ɔma náƒɔ-bu ɔ́di? Na ɔma bene na Blɔti údie nwuna ɔyikun ɔ́tina?

english_verse: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
translation_verse: Unwoti kabla ɔblane ɔmɛni ɔɔlɛ́ lili na Unwoti anumi aani kugyii kebi kani nákwɛ na keedie evete iye kugyii ugyitu ɔni muutulo taalɛ kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo. Na ɔɔɔdi ɔga ɔni mɔɔdia bekyuli bɔnu. Nwuna lɛla lɛdi liiise ɔni basu banii ani mɔɔda bekyuli kayi.

english_verse: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
translation_verse: Bekyuli békisi-nwu na béni-nwu ɔni na nwuna ngba ƒui bɔdi kɔnyana ku lɛbibo sɔɔn. Ukyuli ɔdi uláwia-nwu ulánu na búdie-nwu atu na bɔɔɔdaku-nwu lɛda!

english_verse: He suffered and endured great pain for us, but we thought his suffering was punishment from God.
translation_verse: Anwu ɔlati ɔ́bwi-bu lɛlɛ na únu ɔlɛ pii na abu ɔsu. Na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, bɔsu na bɔ́su bɔnii anwu ɔlati ekpidi ɔsu na Katɔti ɔ́ni-nwu kɔtu lɛni.

english_verse: He was wounded and crushed because of our sins; by taking our punishment, he made us completely well.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔkɛnku bula ekpidi ɔsu na bébo-nwu ulikplu kemmo bákya-nwu ɔlɛ lɛlɔ na báƒɛ-nwu lɛlɔ ekpo ƒui kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. Na lɛbibo lɛmɛni kemmo na ɔ́sia na ɔ́ƒɔ ngba úte abu na bɔ́kɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
translation_verse: Bula ƒui buse na buse aani baƒonu bani náyii ulu, na ɔdi biala úti nwuna ulu úsela kesii kani na ɔɔyɔ́. Na lɛtuni lɛni na nka ɔlɛka bɔƒɔ ni, ani na Unwoti úti úte-nwu na bula lili.

english_verse: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bédumi-nwu na básupa-nwu ɔni na nka ɔɔɔdi anwu na babla lɛni, nsu útakpete na ɔsu lɛla lɛdi. Mmomu úbile kenye kpoo na bada-nwu béselaku aani koƒonu kɔni béti batádu. Na ɔkɛ aani koƒonu kɔni naaadaku-ni si beekúlo-nwu linwini na útebimi kenye.

english_verse: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
translation_verse: Bákya-nwu kɔƒa na útakɛ ukyuli ɔni náƒɔ-nwu kenye. Údie kaba kadi? Bi na ɔ́bla úse asa baadú-nwu na kayawi kamɛni kemmo? Alaekpidi ani na mina bekyuli bábla ɔsu na bádu-nwu lɛni.

english_verse: He wasn't dishonest or violent, but he was buried in a tomb among cruel, rich people.
translation_verse: Útanyi ɔkɔ ɔdi iye ɔta unye ukyuli ɔdi lɛlɔ, nsu báva-nwu básalaku balakɛne ku bekyuli bekpidi.

english_verse: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti ɔlati nése ɔmɛni úse lɛni ɔnii nwuna kabla ɔblane ubo abi amɛni udu na badu-nwu, na ɔƒɔ kayu na bekyuli ƒui lili na bana ekpidi ɔsu. Na ina ka úbo lɛni muedi ni, ɔdubulie na ɔnu nwuna bawɔ bawɔ. Na ɔkɛnku nwuna lɛlɔ ni, lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́lɛ ugyii úse lɛdububo-nwu kemmo.

english_verse: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
translation_verse: Ɔdubɔnu lɛla lɛni ndubɔlɛ lɛsi kɔyu kemmo abi ani na úbo, na kaƒɔ kaba-nwu. Ka mina kabla ɔblane ɔni nse siin ɔgyi mina lɛyɔla ɔsu ni, ɔdubɔya na bekyuli pii ku Unwoti ntɛ bɔdia. Na anwu ɔlati ɔdubɔƒɔ-ma ekpidi uti.

english_verse: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubɔƒɔ kayu kabuni bute-nwu na ute-nwu kenyekɔ kenengudi ku ɔyikun na kalɛ na úbo abi útédu ku kukpi kemmo na ɔ́ƒɔ kayu na bekyuli ƒui lili ɔsu. Báka-nwu bákya bekyuli bekpidi akɔ. Ɔsika bekyuli pii ekpidi na ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́sia lɛlɔ, na úti lɛlɔ ɔ́kpa na bana lili, na ɔ́ƒɔ-ma ngba.

english_verse: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
translation_verse: “Die lɛnu ku kɔvanu momoomo, awɔ udinkɔ, ina ka átawɔ kudii, ɔsika uleku ɔni na ɔgyani údie-nwu atu ni, anwu ndubo bɔwɔ butulo.

english_verse: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
translation_verse: Amii ku bina bawɔ ndubɔƒɔ kadi bamba bekyuli bammɔ kɔlɔ, na kunwini bina kɔdi. Na bana lɛma lɛni nábwɛ mmɔ linwini bina kuliekɔ.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
translation_verse: “Bitayia, na kɔƒa lɛnɔ kutekpo-mii, na enu lɛnɔ ataƒɛ-mii, ɔsika lɛɛɛdubo-mii kɔƒa bɔkya. Bɛyiƒala bina lɛnamu uwi ekpidi ani na bɛ́bla. Na kalɛ na bɛ́ƒɔ lɛlɔ bɛkya aani bekpinele lɛnɔ ɔsɔ utekpo-mii kɔƒa.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
translation_verse: “Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, mɔɔdi kayawi ƒui lɛlɔ. Anwu ndi bina Udiene ku bina ɔgya na ɔdubudie-mii.

english_verse: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
translation_verse: Bina ala álɛ uleku ɔkɔdi ɔni na ɔgyani údie ɔda na úduo kɔnyana, na uuwulo keku ka úni-nwu ɔsu. Nsu Unwoti bina Katɔti ɔnii ndubɔya na bɛsɔ binwini bibo!

english_verse: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
translation_verse: Uwi klukwii ɔdi kani na lídie-mii ɔda, nsu ndubɔsɔ lɛƒɔ-mii na lɛkya-mii kɔgbu ku bɔyɔ geen.

english_verse: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
translation_verse: Uwi klukwii ɔdi kani na línwini kama lɛ́kya-mii ku kɔnyi kati kati. Nsu ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui ni, ndubɔnu-mii kɔnyana! Ami ɔni ndi bina ɔgyumanane ku Unwoti muusé-mii kenye kamɛni.

english_verse: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
translation_verse: “Líse Noa kenye kamɛni udu dii nnii, nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo ntu buti bɔkyula kayawi kudii. Na ɔƒaani ni, líse kenye ka nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-mii kɔnyi buti bɔkya na lɛni-mii kɔtu kudii.

english_verse: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Abi ku abinkpo ƒui adubɔkana na ayii nsu ami ndubo-mii kɔnya butaanu uwi ƒui na lɛbla-mii lɛƒɔndia. Na kenye kani na líse ka ndubɔya na keyi buɛɛ kebo bina kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, neeebile linyese lɛmmɔ kudii.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
translation_verse: “Yerusalem, mɔɔnu ka eewulo kɔnyana na enu áƒɛ-ɔ, na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔɔda-a uubó taavinku. Nsu ami Unwoti ndubɔsɔku ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ lɛtu ku atabi ani na áƒɔ kuye geen. Na sika atabi kpakplaa ani náƒɔ kuye na baalɔ-nya Saƒir na ndubuti lɛkya ɔma ɔmmɔ kowodu ɔka kalɔ.

english_verse: I will teach your children and make them successful.
translation_verse: Ndubɔtina bina bebi ala na bakɔ katɔ ku keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
translation_verse: Ndubɔya na bɛbla bekyuli bani nse siin, na baabla lɛla biala taasiaku ulu lɛlɔ, na bilie kalɔ kpi ɔni na bɛsɔ biláyia lɛla lɛdi, na ala ani muukpóku-mii ƒui adubusie kama ƒui na bina kudɔ.

english_verse: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
translation_verse: Nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na bekyuli badi bebekpoku-mii. Na bani mabla lɛni muedi ni, bɛdubuƒie-ma binwini bina kabla bablane.

english_verse: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
translation_verse: “Na bitayiƒala ka ami nédie bakywɛne bani muuti abuala taakywɛ ekpola na aƒɛ agyabi lɛlɔ. Na bekpone bani mɔɔkana na baabwɛ lɛma na beebile ala ni, ami nédie ama lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
translation_verse: Ekpola ani na bákywɛɛ ka beti bekpo-mii aladi-mii lɛlɔ. Na enyekpi ani na bekyuli badubɔsu basiku-mii lɛlɔ alabla-mii lɛla lɛdi. Yerusalem ɔdi bina ɔdi na ndubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ na bɛdi lɛlɔ. Ami Unwoti násu.”

english_verse: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
translation_verse: “Amii bani ƒui na utukwɛ ɔɔda ni, bibo na bibani ntu! Na amii bani na kɔka kɔɔda na biiibo egulabi adi ni, bibo na bibeye bɛdi ƒaa kayu taƒɔ taƒɔ! Bɛni ntɛ bɔbuni ku anyi ntu ƒaa nsu bitaƒɔ kayu kadi.

english_verse: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na biibile egulabi na lɛla lɛni naaadi adila geen lɛlɔ na binye biitú lɛlɔ na lɛla lɛni neeemo ukyuli lɛlɔ? Bise atu na binu-mi litemi kaduɛ, na bɛdubɔdi emini biala na bɛɛyɔ́, na bɛkɛ adila abuni ƒui bɛdi bimo.

english_verse: Pay close attention! Come to me and live. I will promise you the eternal love and loyalty that I promised David.
translation_verse: “Bise atu kaduɛ na bibo-mi kudɔ, na bɛkɛ ngba bilie. Na kenye kani na lɛ́su Dawid líse ni, ndubuse amii lɛnɔ kenye kammɔ, na lɛyɔ-mii uwi ƒui na bɛnu kalɛ na mɔɔdi mina litemi lɛlɔ uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
translation_verse: Lɛ́bla-nwu na ɔdi kadi bekyuli ƒui ɔtɔnkune na anwu nádi mina kenye udiene úte-ma.

english_verse: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
translation_verse: Na kadi bekyuli bani na nka bɛɛɛgyi-ma dii iye ama bati-mii ni, bɛdubɔlɔ-ma biboku bina kudɔ na benu kalɔ na bɛnu ka bakɛ ku usi. Na ami Unwoti bina Katɔti ndubo ɔmɛni bɔbla, ɔsika línyene-mii kenyekɔ kenengudi na biikeye.”

english_verse: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
translation_verse: Bɛwia Unwoti ɔƒɛni, ɔsika bɛdubɔkana na bɛnu-nwu. Na bɛkpali-nwu, ɔsika ude-mii na ɔdubunu-mii bɔkpali.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Bɛda bina kalala ku likyulikpi ala bɔbla bɛya, na binwini kama bɛkya-nya na Unwoti ɔdubuti-nya ƒui ɔkyiɛ-mii.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My thoughts and my ways are not like yours.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔlati násu ɔnini, “Mina kasusu ku kasiakɔ ƒui kávumana ku amii bɔdi.

english_verse: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na kayaa kágyunku kalɔ kakaaka ni, lɛni na mina kasusu kágyu kakaaka kásiku bina ɔdi kudɔ.

english_verse: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
translation_verse: Ɔnantu ku etubankɛ aana taasi kayaa taayu kalɔ. Na ɔdi ulásɔ teenwini taakɔ katɔ na ulete kalɔ kammɔ bɔba na ɔya na bɛkɛ edula ebi pii ani na bɛkya na bɛkɛ adila bɛdi bimo.

english_verse: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
translation_verse: Lɛni na mina etemila ese na si lɛ́su lɛla lɛdi ni, etemila ammɔ alásɔ teenwini teebo-mi kudɔ na lɛla lɛmmɔ lilebo-nwu kemmo kalɛ na lɛ́su-ni.

english_verse: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubɔkɛ ebiti na bɛdi limeyi na binwini bisie ɔma ku keyi buɛɛ. Na bina lɛlɔyɔ lɛdubɔya na ɔbla aani abi ku abinkpo ammɔ muudie ɔnu si bɛɛví, na ɔbla aani enukpɛ na egyii ammɔ aagyá.

english_verse: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Na egyii abuni enengudi ani mɔɔdia ala buti taabla adubɔkwɛ enye kesii kani na nka liyu alakpi nákya mmɔ. Na egyii ammɔ ndubunye mmɔ uwi ƒui, na atina kalɛ na Unwoti uukeye na ubo ɔbu.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: “Bɛbla ala bɛsiaku ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ, ɔsika ndubo uwi klukwii mbaƒɔ-mii ngba. Na bekyuli ƒui badubɔnu mina ɔyikun ɔni na mbo na lɛƒɔ ukyuli ngba na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ kesi kesii.

english_verse: I will bless everyone who respects the Sabbath and refuses to do wrong.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala na ɔɔbu lɛnwunameyi lɛmmɔ na uláwia ka ɔbla likpidi ni, ndubute-nwu kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
translation_verse: “Na kadi bamba bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔbu-mi na baakya-mi lili kalɔ ni, batasu banini, ‘Unwoti ɔɔɔdubo-bu buti bubunku nwuna bekyuli lɛlɔ.’ Na banana bani nsɔ naaadubo bɔkana bɔwɔ ni, basɔ batasu banini, ‘Abu búnwini ekyweni akwiidi bunye.’ ”

english_verse: To them, I, the Lord, say: Respect the Sabbath, obey me completely, and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Amii bɛdi lɛnwunameyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ku mina litemi lɛlɔ kaduɛ kani, na bɛsia mina bunyimi bɔmmɔ anu.

english_verse: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔtu likpose atabi bɔlɛ mina kakpakɔ na linweni bina anyi lɛsia-nya lɛlɔ. Na ɔmmɔ lɛti ɔdia utulo si bɛ́wɔ bebi, ɔsika atabi ammɔ adubunye mmɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Kadi bamba bekyuli badubɔsiaku-mi kama na bayɔ-mi na bakpa na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ. Badubɔbu mina lɛnwunameyi na badi mina bunyimi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
translation_verse: Na ndubo-ma bɔkpanku buboku mina kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ na badubɔkɛ lɛlɔyɔ na mina kaduli kani kemmo na baakpali-mi kemmo. Na bana etela ku akpala ani na badubuti beboku-mi na mina lɛkpabi lɛlɔ adubɔƒɔ-mi anu. Badubɔlɔ mina kesii banii kaduli kani kemmo na bayawine ƒui baakpali katɔ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others. God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔni mɔɔkpanku nwuna kadi bekyuli beƒiedi taabasala úse kenye kadi ɔnini, “Ndubɔkpanku mina bekyuli bani na béƒie bátɔlɔku lɛsiku kesii biala na béti-ma bésienku, na babasala ku bana banwani.” Katɔti Ɔ́tɛku Balane Litemi

english_verse: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.
translation_verse: Amii beƒiebuo ƒui bɛlɛ bibo na bibaduli bina bebuo beƒiedi bibweli.

english_verse: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
translation_verse: Amii Israel kadi benengu, amii na nka ɔlɛka binye bitaagyumana mina bekyuli aani bakpewe bani mɔɔgyumana kaduli. Nsu biiinye bilasia lɛla biala anu na bilebo-ma ɔda ɔdi lɛnɔ. Mmomu bulie kani na bilie biisié taasɔ na bɛɛlɛɛ.

english_verse: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
translation_verse: Batɔnkune badɔlɔdi, bítavumanaku bakpewe bani na bɔdi kani na bagyi na lɛla lɛla lilemo-ma kudii. Baƒonu badane bekpidi bani muulie taabla bana bebuo ulikplu na bɛdi, na amii lɛti bɔdia kani na bilie bite.

english_verse: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_verse: Na bɔsu kani na bɛɛsu lɛlɔ bɛnini, “Bɛya na bɔni-mu na bukpi-mu! Na kɔnaadi lɛnɔ ɔsia-nwu lɛlɔ lɛni kani, na bɔkya lɛlɔ ebiti.”

english_verse: God's faithful people are dragged off and killed, and no one even cares. Evil sweeps them away,
translation_verse: Bekyuli beenye taanu na beetiku bekyuli babuni taatádu ɔni na balasu lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
translation_verse: Nsu si ina bekyuli siin bamɛni békpi ni, baatɛ kekpine mmɔ buɛɛ na bana keyi kaayɔ́ na kalɛ na bénu Unwoti litemi ɔsu.

english_verse: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
translation_verse: “Nsu amii ni, bilenu litemi munu munu. Bɛkɛ bekebone ku baƒiɔkpane lɛlɔ bɛɛkɔ́ taayu. Na ɔƒaani ni, bise atu na binu!

english_verse: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Ɔma lɛlɔ na bɛɛkya lɛma na bɛɛpii-nwu? Bɛnu kalɛ na bina ekpidi ése-mii lisusu na bɛ́dɔlɔ.

english_verse: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.
translation_verse: Lɛyalɛ ala ku lɛlɔ kudɔ bɔtɛ na baƒiɔ bani na bɛɛkpá mmɔ anumi na egyii enengudi ammɔ kalɔ. Na biiti bina bebi taakpa na akpabi ani na bɛ́tu bínyene ɔkwalɛ na atakpɛ ani nƒa mmɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: You have chosen to worship idols made of stone; you have given them offerings of wine and grain. Should I be pleased?
translation_verse: Bɛɛkali ka kaƒɔ kadubɔyɔ-mi ka bɛ́ƒuna ka bitaakpa atabi suɛlɛ suɛlɛ ani na bɛ́sala bɛlɛ esu mmɔ aani baƒiɔ ku bina lɛla biala, na biiti akpala ku ntɛ ku antabi etela teetéte-nya?

english_verse: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
translation_verse: Biiti bina akpala teesienku abi ani nákuku eli taatákpa teete bina baƒiɔ. Na mmɔ na bɛɛvá atɛla teesie lɛlɔ kudɔ ɔnana ku uleku kalɛ.

english_verse: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.
translation_verse: Na bina kɔduli kesi kesii ni, bɛ́ta baƒiɔ bammɔ udu bɛ́sia kɔyakun ku bina kɔtɛnkɔ bonwu bonwu kɔni bɛ́lɛ mmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na bíni ami, na bíti lɛlɔ bíte ama. Na bɛɛkɔ́ taatátɛ ku bina bayɔne bammɔ na bidie lɛlɔ kasɔngya ƒui, na bɛɛɛdaku-ni útédu uwi ɔni na údu-mii ɔkwɛ.

english_verse: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: Bɛɛkpí taawɛɛ ligyulo ƒɛƒɛɛ lidu lidu na biisié taatákpa Molek baƒiɔ. Na bɛɛtala batu na ɔlɔgyu na beesié taatálɔ ku bekpine ayu muedi teeye ala teenu.

english_verse: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.
translation_verse: Bíitu lɛlɔ kalɛ na bɛdubɔkana, nsu bítanu tɔ bítati bɛnii kɔsia kuuubo ɔmɛni ƒui kemmo na bɛda bɛya. Nwuna lɛlɔ kani binye, na bíkeli bɛkɛ bɛsia-ma kama na kesi kesii, ka bana ala akya-mii kayi kemmo kpakplaa ɔsu.

english_verse: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
translation_verse: “Bi ndi baƒiɔ bani kama na bɛsiaku, na ama na bɛɛyia teetulo ami ɔsu na bɛ́yiƒala-mi ku mina ala ani na lɛ́bla, na bɛsɔ binyimo adi na bina kayi kemmo? Munuu ɔni na líbile kenye mɔɔnu-mii kpoo ɔsu na mina lɛlɔ liƒu lɛsɔ liiibo-mii lɛlɔ kemmo?

english_verse: You think you're so good, but I'll point out the truth.
translation_verse: Bɛɛkali ka bɛdaku lɛla lɛbuni lɛdi bɔbla taagya, nsu ndubo-mii keyi budie ku bina ablala na bɛnu bina kenyekɔ bɛti.

english_verse: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na lɛla lɛdi lítulo-mii na bɛɛwia ubunkune ni, na bɛkpali bina baƒiɔ lidu lidu lɛni nkya-mii na bebunku-mi. Nsu bitayiƒala ka ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ndubo ubébo-ma ugyingya mmɔ. Na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔlɛ́ enwu kemmo kani ndubo-ma udu bɔyila. Na si bíbo-mi kudɔ ka lɛgyumana-mii ni, kalɔ kamɛni ku mina kɔbi kedee kɔmmɔ ƒui kɔdubunwini bina ɔdi uteesie uwi ƒui.”

english_verse: The Lord says, “Clear the road! Get it ready for my people.”
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubɔsu ɔnini, “Bɛbwɛ lilu ƒui bise kaduɛ bite mina kadi bekyuli na babasia-nwu lɛlɔ!”

english_verse: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
translation_verse: Bula Katɔti ɔni nse kedee uli katɔ kakaaka ƒui úsela uwi ƒui, na anwu mɔɔsu ɔnini, “Ina ka katɔ kakaaka kesii kani nse kedee na nli ni, nkya-mii akɔ mɛni ka libunku bani ƒui néboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na béti bana anu ƒui básia-mi lɛlɔ na baanu-mi anumi.

english_verse: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
translation_verse: Mina kadi bekyuli, lɛɛɛdubo kɔnyi buti bɔsɔ bulie butaadu-mii kɔtɔ kani. Ɔ́bla bi ɔ́bla dɛ ni, ami nédie-mii líboku kayawi. Anwuɔsu lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na enu aƒɛ-mii na bɛyila lɛnunsia ƒui.

english_verse: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
translation_verse: Bina ɔdivo náya na líti kɔnyi lɛ́kya-mii na lɛ́ni-mii kɔtu na lɛ́bɛla-mii mina lɛlɔ na bɛsɔ bilanu-mi. Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui ni, bɛmu bibo atu ɔkplu na binye bina alaekpidi bɔbla lɛlɔ ku ɔƒɛni.

english_verse: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
translation_verse: Ngyi-mii kalɛ na bise! Nsu ndubo-mi ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ bɔbwi ƒui na lɛtɔnku-mii na lɛya na kaƒɔ kayɔ-mii ku bani ƒui muuwulo kɔnyana.

english_verse: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
translation_verse: Na lɛya na bese kalɔ beteedie lɛnu teemwi-mi. Na mɔɔsu kpakplaa nnii wɛ na ɔdi ulie iye wɛ na uuulie ni, ami Unwoti ndubɔbwi ɔdi biala na ɔkɛ keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: The wicked are a restless sea tossing up mud.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi bese aani ɛpu ɔni mɔɔnwanɛ lɛlɔ na ɔɔtala nwuna kalɔ eku ku aba uwi biala.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
translation_verse: Nsu ami Unwoti líse kenye nnii ukyuli ukpidi biala ɔdi ɔɔɔdubo bulie ku keyi buɛɛ.”

english_verse: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
translation_verse: “Kɔ litemi lɛmmɔ lɛsa na tebile kenye tasɔ telie. Na asu mina kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ bana ekpidi ku kalɛ na báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Baakɔ́ taayu limeyi ndi limeyi banii ami na baasiaku. Na beekpóku lɛlɔ aani si mina litemi na baawia batɛya. Na baatina lɛlɔ aani kadi bani bekyuli mɔɔwia ka babla lɛbuni na baadi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Baawia ka lɛni lide-ma suɛlɛ suɛlɛ na lɛtɛ litemi na ulu lɛlɔ siin lite-ma, na baasu ka lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-ma ka bataasiaku-mi.

english_verse: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.
translation_verse: Beeye banii, ‘Bi ɔsu na búnyimi kenye na átakpete-bu? Na búboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na átanu átati?’ “Nsu uwi ɔni na bɛnii kenye na biinyimi mmɔ ni, na binye bina ala ani mɔɔyɔ́-mii kaƒɔ bɔbla lɛlɔ na bɛɛwia amii lɛti bɔdia na bɛɛnya bina kabla bablane ama taakya.

english_verse: You even get angry and ready to fight. No wonder God won't listen to your prayers!
translation_verse: Bɛɛkɛ́ ku kɔnyi muedi na binye kagyumana ka bikpo. Nsu utabla-mii dɛye dɛye, ɔsika Unwoti ulakana na wenu-mii bɔkpali na ɔbladu ɔmɛni kemmo!

english_verse: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?
translation_verse: Bɔkali na bɛɛkali bɛnii kalɛ na binyimi kenye, na bini adila bite lɛlɔ, na bɛkya lili kalɔ buɛɛ bite Unwoti aani livo lɛni na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ku ɔnantu ntu búbo bɔ́kya kalɔ mɔɔda-nwu ebiti? Munuu kalɛ na bɛda kɔnyana ala, na bɛkpi ntɔ na bɛɛlɔ kenye bunyimi bɔni ndi Unwoti limeyi lɛni mɔɔda-nwu kubiti?

english_verse: Share your food with everyone who is hungry; share your home with the poor and homeless. Give clothes to those in need; don't turn away your relatives.
translation_verse: Na bile bina adila bite ukyuli biala na kɔka kɔɔda. Na bɛya na bawabane ku bani neeebo kuduokɔ bakɛ kuduokɔ bina kudɔ na bakɛ kɔtɛnkɔ. Na bani mɔɔyaki adala lɛnɔ na bite-ma adala na babɛ kɔyɔ. Na bilénwini kama bilakya bina lɛlɔ bekyuli.

english_verse: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.
translation_verse: Si bɛ́bla ɔmɛni ni, bɛdubɔnu kalɛ na muukeye na ɔya na bɛkɛ ɔlɛ bɔbwi. Na bina ala bɔbla siin bɔmɛni bɔdubɔgyumana-mii na bina keliela kemmo na Unwoti bukeye bɔgyumana-mii bɔsiku bina kama.

english_verse: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́kpali Unwoti ni, ɔdubɔtuna ute-mii kɔnakunwi ɔnini, ‘Bɛɛnu-mi nnye-mii kudɔ mɛni!’ “Bitabla bina bakpana kalala na bitanyi ɔkɔ na bɛdu-ma kɔtɔ iye bɛda litemi bɛsia-ma lɛlɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubɔtɔnku-mii na ute-mii ala ani ƒui námanku-mii na kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo na ute-mii ɔlɔkplu. Na bɛdubɔbla aani kevoma kemo kani edula mɔɔkɛ́ ntu uwi biala iye ketu kani ntu naaakwii uwi ɔdi.

english_verse: You will rebuild those houses left in ruins for years; you will be known as a builder and repairer of city walls and streets.
translation_verse: Bɛdubɔsɔku bina atɔnku ani nábwɛ uwi gyɔlɔɔ aani akwa akwa mɛni bɔtu. Na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu bekyuli badubɔlɔ-mii banii bekyuli bani mɔɔsɔku atɔnku ku lɛma linengudi awodu taatala na basɔku lɛblɔnu bedie.

english_verse: But first, you must start respecting the Sabbath as a joyful day of worship. You must stop doing and saying whatever you please on this special day.
translation_verse: “Nsu ɔlɛka bɛka mina Lɛnwunameyi bɔbu aani lɛlɔyɔ lɛkpa limeyi na bɛda enyekpi bɔtɛmi kalɛ kalɛ bɛya ku ala basa basa bɔbla bɛya na limeyi linengudi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Na bɛdubɔnu lɛlɔyɔ lɛni nkya mina bɔsiaku kemmo na lɛya na ɔbu ɔkya-mii lɛlɔ na kayawi kadi bekyuli ƒui anumi na bɛdi-ma lɛlɔ útédu abi eli ƒui. Na Unwoti ɔdubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ na bile bɛdi bina nana ati Yakob kalɔ kammɔ uwi ƒui.” Lɛni na Unwoti ɔlati ɔ́su!

english_verse: The Lord hasn't lost his powerful strength; he can still hear and answer prayers.
translation_verse: Bitakali bɛnii Unwoti ɔyikun ɔ́sɔ na ulakana kɔnu bunene bɔƒɔ-mii iye atu éti-nwu na ulakana na wenu bina bɔkpali.

english_verse: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
translation_verse: Mmomu bina alaekpidi náda-mii ntɛ ɔsu na údie anumi bina lɛlɔ na ɔsɔ ulenu-mii bɔkpali.

english_verse: Your talk is filled with lies and plans for violence; every finger on your hands is covered with blood.
translation_verse: Bina ɔkɔ bɔnyi ku bekyuli bɔdu ku bekyuli lɛlɔ bɔta teenye ɔ́ya na bɛ́dɔli ku ekpidi ammɔ na Unwoti anumi.

english_verse: You falsely accuse others and tell lies in court; sin and trouble are the names of your children.
translation_verse: Biiti lɛlɔ teesienku litemi katɛkɔ nsu bilátɛ etemila ulu siin lɛlɔ. Mmomu unyeƒi ukpludi ku kenye ogya ku ɔkɔ ala sɔɔn na bɛɛsu. Na biilie taabla kasusu kekpidi uwi biala anwuɔsu lɛnɔ na bɛɛwɔ likpidi.

english_verse: You eat the deadly eggs of poisonous snakes, and more snakes crawl out from the eggs left to hatch. You weave spider webs,
translation_verse: Bina ablala eevuo balakpi bekpidi avala, na ɔdi biala makun bina avala ammɔ ɔdubo bukpi. Na kakwɛ biala na bɛdubudie keyi aani avala akladi ani nébu buvuo ni, balakpi bekpidi bammɔ kani ndubo bɔlɛ pii.

english_verse: but you can't make clothes with those webs or hide behind them. You're sinful and brutal.
translation_verse: Anasi kɔgbu na biidí, na ɔɔɔdi adi ani na bebi lɛlɔ. Likyulikpi bɔbla ku kalala bɔ́ƒɔ-mii enu ƒui.

english_verse: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
translation_verse: Bɛkɛ usi uwi biala ka bitábla likpidi, na bɛdu bekyuli bani na bátabla-mii lɛla lɛdi, ku ekpidi bamba lidu lɛnɔ. Likpidi kasusu kani na biilie taabla uwi biala na ala bubile kani na baanu na bina kasiakɔ ƒui.

english_verse: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
translation_verse: Bina ablala aaadanku keyi buɛɛ kadi, anwuɔsu bekyuli bani nsiaku-mii kama ƒui beeebo bɔnwuna bɔdi biala ku keyi buɛɛ kadi.

english_verse: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.
translation_verse: Ka bénu ala amɛni ni, básu banini, “Ukyuli biala útebo ɔnii ubekpo ute-bu iye ubatɛ bula etemila ute-bu na ulu siin lɛlɔ. Nka bula anu asia bukeye nwaa lɛlɔ, nsu lɛdisa kemmo na bɔkɛ susuusu.

english_verse: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
translation_verse: Na enu kani na bɔkɛ buubó aani banumbwɛne. Na ɔƒiiwi nwaa muedi bɔkɛ buutulo aani si usien na bɔkɛ iye kekpine na bɔkya.

english_verse: We growl like bears and mourn like doves. We hope for justice and victory, but they escape us.
translation_verse: Buubó adi aani eƒiebuo na buudumo aani babloduma teewulo kɔnyana. Bɔɔwia ka batɛ-bu litemi siin na bɔdi lɛlɔ, nsu ɔmɛni ƒui ɔ́vi-bu lɛgya.”

english_verse: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
translation_verse: O Unwoti Katɔti, bɔ́ɔƒiɔ-ɔ kɔlɛ kɔlɛ, na bɔ́ta búnye-ɔ lɛlɔ. Na bula ekpidi aadú-bu kɔtɔ ka bɔ́bla likpidi!

english_verse: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
translation_verse: Bɔ́ta búnye-ɔ lɛlɔ na búni bɔnii bulasiaku-ɔ kama. Ɔkɔ etemila sɔɔn néyi-bu kayi kemmo anwuɔsu na ɔkɔ ɔmmɔ kani na bɔɔnyi na bɔɔnya bula bakpana taakya.

english_verse: Injustice is everywhere; justice seems far away. Truth is chased out of court; honesty is shoved aside.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ etemila bɔtɛ kani náƒɔ kesii biala. Na ala bɔbla siin bɔdi bɔsɔ buuubo, na litemi geen ani lɛ́sa ƒui aani kalɛ na baabɔku lɛla lɛdi teedie kesii kadi.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
translation_verse: Litemi lɛlɔ bɔdi siin bɔdi bɔsɔ buuubo anwuɔsu ukyuli ɔni muuní likpidi bɔbla ni, bekyuli beeti anumi taalɛ-nwu ɔni na kawɔlɔkɔ bɔdu kani na baadú-nwu teedie. Na ka Unwoti ɔ́nu litemi tatɛ ulu lɛlɔ bɔmɛni ni, kaƒɔ kátayɔ-nwu.

english_verse: It disgusted him even more to learn that no one would do a thing about it. So with his own powerful arm, he won victories for truth.
translation_verse: Ɔ́nu ka ukyuli ina unwi pɛ muedi uuubo ɔni mɔɔwia ka litemi bɔtɛ ulu siin lɛlɔ bɔmɛni bɔƒɔ bekyuli akɔ, anwuɔsu anwu ɔlati údie nwuna kɔnu na ɔ́bla ɔyikun ala na ɔ́ya na nwuna litemi geen lɛmmɔ lɛ́di lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubo kɔnyi buti geen na udie nwuna bekisine kasi, bekisine bani nde ku bani nkya ɔlɔgyu ƒui, na udie kasi na ekpidi ani na bábla kenye.

english_verse: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si ɔƒɛ katukɔ útédu kanukɔ ƒui bekyuli badubo butaayia-nwu na bemwi-nwu kalɛ na uukeye. Ɔsika ɔdubɔda ɔlɛ-ma lɛlɔ aani ketu kani néyi na kadanku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa na ɔbɔku-ma ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Udiene ɔdubo Sion na udie Yakob kaba kemmo bebi bani ndubunwini kama bakya bana ekpidi.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My people, I promise to give you my Spirit and my message. These will be my gifts to you and your families forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
translation_verse: “Líse-ma kenye ka ndubuti mina Kɔyu ku linyesia lite-ma. Na ɔmɛni ndi mina etela ani na ndubuti lite-ma ku bina kɔduli bekyuli úsela uwi ƒui.” Lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su.

english_verse: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.
translation_verse: “Yerusalem kadi bekyuli, bɛta na bikeye! Ɔsika Unwoti bukeye bɔ́tu aani ɔƒɛ na buuwi-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.
translation_verse: Kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui ku kana kadi bekyuli ƒui báƒɔ lɛlɔ bakya lɛdisa kemmo, nsu amii ni, Unwoti úbo-mii kudɔ, na nwuna bukeye búbewi-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na kalɔ kadi bekyuli ku bana baga badubo-ɔ kudɔ babanu ƒula bukeye kadi kawɔdi kani négye-ɔ.

english_verse: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.
