translation_verse: “Bibimi bina anumi na bɛnu! Bɛnu bɛmana na bɛnu bekyuli lisu bonwu bani nási badubo-mii kudɔ. Bina bebi bananabi basia ulu bási ɔlɔgyu, na bakwɛni bina bebi belekubi badububoku aani banamu.

english_verse: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́nu ɔmɛni ni, bina anumi adubukeye, na kayi lɛnɔ kata-mii na bɛtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ ku lɛmɛnɛ. Na badubɔsiku ala abuni ku lɛkɛ lɛni na lɛ́si ketu ɔvi ku kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ ƒui beboku-mii.

english_verse: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Na bina kalɔ ƒui kadubuyi ku kɛɛkɛ lɛni na bebuo ala betine bani bási Midia ku Eƒa ku ala abuni pii bebeyile ɔma ɔmmɔ. Na Seeba kadi bekyuli badubɔsiku bana sika ugyiedi ku oloƒui beboku na adubunu ka beemwi Unwoti lɛnyi.

english_verse: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.
translation_verse: Kedar baƒonu ƒui badubo-ɔ kudɔ. Na Nebaot baƒonu bagyani bammɔ ƒui lɛnɔ benwini awɔ badi. Ndubɔƒɔ-ma aani etela na bekyuli beti ɔbu bete mina kakpakɔ kammɔ.

english_verse: What is that sailing by like clouds or like doves flying home?
translation_verse: “Bi nkɛ kayaa mɔɔví mmɔ aani liƒlukutu? Na use aani babloduma néveyi bésela bana kakyakɔ?

english_verse: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ƒula bekyuli benye bagya ami Unwoti na ntuntɛ kɔlɔ kɔni nkya ɔgyu kakaaka mmɔ. Na ɛpu lɛkɔlɔ bonwu lɛmmɔ lɛ́ɛgyu lɛtɔ kalɛ na litéti-ma liboku ɔma, ku bana sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ƒui. Ami Unwoti nábla ɔmɛni líte ƒula bekyuli kalɛ na bekyuli beti ɔbu bete ami bina Unwoti Israel Katɔti Kedee na bataanu kalɛ na biikeye.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
translation_verse: “Yerusalem, ƒula ɔma unengudi awodu ani náka ámana-nwu ni, baƒɔ ndubo-nya bɔsɔku bɔtu. Na bana baga benwini bina kabla bablane. Lɛ́ni-mii kɔtu na mina livoƒi kemmo nsu ɔƒɛni amu ndubɔnu-mii kɔnyana ku mina lɛƒɔndia.

english_verse: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.
translation_verse: Bɛdubɔlɛmi bina lɛban kayakun kenye biwi usien ku ɔƒɛ na kadi bamba batɔnkune bakpanku bana bekyuli beboku-mii ku bana akɛla ani na bebo ƒui.

english_verse: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Na lɛga kadikɔ iye kadi bani néni banii balakya-mii kalɔ na babla-mii kabla ni, badubɔyii udu na ɔdi ɔsɔ ulénu-ma kɔku.

english_verse: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
translation_verse: “Na Lebanon egyii kpakplaa enengudi lidu lɛni nkya-ma ƒui ni, badubɔlɛku-ni beboku. Na badubuti-ni banwi ala beti bakya mina kakpakɔ bɔdia kesii kani na mina lɛgba lɛɛnya.

english_verse: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, “You are Zion, the city of the Lord, the holy One of Israel.”
translation_verse: Na bekisine bani nékpoku-mii ni, bana bawɔ badubɔlɛ akɔnkɔ kalɔ na bina lɛgba akɔ na basu-mii banii, ‘Sion ɔdi Unwoti Israel Katɔti Kedee ɔma unengudi.’

english_verse: You were hated and deserted, rejected by everyone. But I will make you beautiful, a city to be proud of for all time to come.
translation_verse: “Bekyuli békisi-mii na béni-mii uwi ɔni návi nsu ndubɔbla-a ɔma unengudi ɔni mɔɔdia bɔnu geen na bataakun lɛmɛnɛ na ƒula lɛlɔ úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
translation_verse: Na adubɔkpala kadi bamba ku bana baga akɛla asiku-ma kudɔ ƒui kede kede na bɛnu bɛti ka ami Unwoti Israel Katɔti nédie-mii na lɛ́ƒɔ-mii ngba.

english_verse: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
translation_verse: Na ndububoku-mii sika ugyiedi na abualagyie kenye, na liboku-mii sika ɔƒualadi na kalɔ kemmo abuala kpakplaa kenye. Na liboku-mii abualagyie na ligyii kenye na liboku-mii abuala kpakplaa na atabi kenye Na keyi buɛɛ ku litemi bɔtɛ ulu siin lɛlɔ na ndubɔya na utaadi-mii lɛlɔ aani bina batɔnkune kalɛ.

english_verse: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
translation_verse: Na basɔ belénu kekpo ku ala bubile kɔku na ƒula liku. Na ndubo-mii bɔgyumana aani kalɛ na awodu aaka taamana lɛla lɛdi na bimwi-mi ka lɛ́ƒɔ-mii ngba ɔsu.

english_verse: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.
translation_verse: Na bɛ́sɔ bilawia ɔƒɛ iye kɔbuli bukeye bɔdi na ɔƒiiwi iye usien, ɔsika ami Unwoti ɔlati bukeye ndubo-mii buteewi úsela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
translation_verse: Bina ɔƒɛ iye kɔbuli kɔsɔ kɔɔɔdubo bɔnu kudii. Ɔsika ami bina Unwoti ndubunwini bina bukeye uwi ƒui. Na bina keku ku kɔnyana buwulo emeyi ƒui adububo kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.
translation_verse: Bina kadi bekyuli badubulie siin na kalɔ kammɔ kabla bana ɔdi. Bese aani egyii ani na lɛ́lɛ na áta kalɛ na bedie mina bukeye keyi.

english_verse: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
translation_verse: Kaduli kani bekyuli nse blii suɛ ƒui muedi badubunwini kadi bekyuli bani mbo ɔyikun geen. Ami ndi Unwoti na ndubo ala amɛni ƒui bɔbla kɔnakunwi si uwi na ana ɔblawi údu.”

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo! Ɔsika ɔ́tala-mi ɔnii nkɔ litemi buni lɛsa nte bawabane. Na lɛbwi bani muunú ɔlɛ na bana kayi kemmo na basɔ beeebo lɛnunsia, na libo kudu lite bani na béƒie na bébo-ma lɛkpu ka badubɔkɛ bɔnwuna na balɛ kasuudikɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: This is the year when the Lord God will show kindness to us and punish our enemies. The Lord has sent me to comfort those who mourn,
translation_verse: Lɛkwa lɛmɛni na Unwoti Katɔti úse ka wabla-bu lɛƒɔndia, na ɔni bula bekisine kɔtu, na lɛsia bani muuwulo kɔnyana kɔnu.

english_verse: especially in Jerusalem. He sent me to give them flowers in place of their sorrow, olive oil in place of tears, and joyous praise in place of broken hearts. They will be called “Trees of Justice,” planted by the Lord to honor his name.
translation_verse: Na lɛƒɔ lite bani nkya Yerusalem, na lɛya na bana anumi eteekeye ku lɛlɔyɔ ku lɛma na bana kɔnyana buwulo kenye. Na beteedie bumwi lɛnu, na kɔnyana lɛnu kenye. Na babla aani egyii ani na Unwoti ɔlati ɔ́lɛ, na aalɛ́ lili siin, na batina kalɛ na Unwoti uukeye.

english_verse: Then they will rebuild cities that have been in ruins for many generations.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na badubɔsɔku lɛma lɛkukudi lɛni nábwɛ ku kuliekɔ kɔni na báda béwi ƒui batu.

english_verse: They will hire foreigners to take care of their sheep and their vineyards.
translation_verse: Na badubɔƒɔ kadi bamba bekyuli na banu bana baƒonu lɛlɔ ku bana adingyii mmo bete-ma na kayu kenye.

english_verse: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
translation_verse: Nsu ama alati ama badubunwini bakpane ku kabla bablane bete bula Unwoti. Kadi bamba bekyuli akɛla ƒui adubunwini bana ɔdi na baƒɔ lɛnyi.

english_verse: They were terribly insulted and horribly mistreated; now they will be greatly blessed and joyful forever. The Lord Loves Justice
translation_verse: Na bana kɔƒa kenye ni, mina kadi bekyuli akɛla adubɔkɔ katɔ akpa anyɔ. Na kalɛ na béwi-ma anumi kalɔ kenye ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma, na bana kadikɔ kani ndubo-ma budu ɔsu, na lɛlɔyɔ lɛmmɔ lɛdubuse buteesie uwi ƒui.

english_verse: I, the Lord, love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.
translation_verse: “Ɔsika ami Unwoti ni, litemi bɔtɛ ulu siin lɛlɔ na mɔɔyɔ́. Na nkisi kuyu ku ɔkɔ etemila bɔtɛ ku ekpidi lidu bamba ƒui. Na kalɛ na mɔɔdi mina litemi lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, ndubɔƒɔ-ma kayu na linyimiku-ma bunyimi bɔni ndubɔkya ami ku-ma ntɛ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
translation_verse: Badubɔƒɔ lɛnyi na kadi bekyuli ƒui akɔ na ukyuli biala ɔni nánu-ma ɔnu ɔti ka badi kadi bani na Unwoti úte-ma kusɛ kusɛ.”

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi na Unwoti lɛlɔ na ebiti aada mina kɔyu na lɛla lɛni na mina Katɔti ɔ́bla úte-mi ɔsu. Kalɛ na ɔ́ƒɔ-mi ngba use aani kalɛ na baaklibi uleku teesienku kawɛɛkɔ. Na lɛduni lɛni mɔɔtina ka ɔ́bla-mi siin lɛma-mi lili aani ɔkpane lɛduni lɛni na uubi lili.

english_verse: The Lord will bring about justice and praise in every nation on earth, like flowers blooming in a garden.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na edula ebi aakwɛ́ taalɛ kalɔ kemmo na aalɛ́ lili ni, lɛni na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔdubɔya na kadi bekyuli ƒui balɛ lili na babla siin na beti bumwi bete-nwu.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will speak up for your good. I will never be silent till you are safe and secure, sparkling like a flame.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, ndubɔtɛmi lidie-ɔ kenye, na ƒula bɔdia ɔsu na lɛɛɛdubo kenye bubile bɔsɔ bulie kpoo wetédu uwi ɔni na lɛ́ƒɔ-ɔ na élie kalɔ na ebo bɔnwuna na eekeye aani ogya unyemi.

english_verse: Your great victory will be seen by every nation and king; the Lord will even give you a new name.
translation_verse: Na kadi ƒui bekyuli ku bana baga badubɔnu kalɛ na ádi lɛlɔ na Unwoti muedi ɔdubute-ɔ lɛnyi lɛwɔdi.

english_verse: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Na adubɔbla aani kagabwa kani muukeye na ƒula Unwoti Katɔti lɛkɔkɔ.

english_verse: Your name will no longer be “Deserted and Childless,” but “Happily Married.” You will please the Lord; your country will be his bride.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli basɔ baaadubo ƒula kalɔ kammɔ lɛnyi bɔsia banii, “Udinkɔ ɔni na béni bése.” Mmomu badubɔlɔ-ka banii, “Uleku ɔni na báwɛɛ-nwu kaduɛ.” Ɔsika ƒula lɛlɔ lɛdubɔda Unwoti ebiti na ɔdubɔbla aani uleku ogya ute-ɔ.

english_verse: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na ebiti aada okloƒu ɔni néti adagyaa na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-nwu na ɔɔda-nwu ni, lɛni na ƒula bebi badubɔda-kalɔ kammɔ. Na kalɛ na uleku ɔgya ku ulekudi beelie ku ebiti ni, lɛni na ebiti adubɔda Unwoti na ƒula lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
translation_verse: Yerusalem ƒula ɔma awodu lɛlɔ na ndubunyene bagyumanane bani ndubo-mi buteenyimene usien ku ɔƒɛ na belebile kenye

english_verse: and not let him rest till he makes Jerusalem strong and famous everywhere.
translation_verse: ka lɛbla na Yerusalem ɔkɛ ɔlɔkplu na ɔƒɔ lɛnyi na kesi kesii.

english_verse: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
translation_verse: Unwoti úse kenye kpakplaa ɔnini, “Nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo bina edula buti bute bina bekisine na badi. Na kadi bamba bekyuli basɔ baaadubo bina ntɛ bɔwɔdi bɔni lɛnɔ na bíbo abi bídie bɔni kudii.

english_verse: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na amii alati néti bina enu bɛ́bla bina edula mmo ni, bɛdubo bina adila bɔdi ku lɛlɔyɔ. Na ntɛ bɔni na bídie ni, bɛdubɔni-mu na mina kaduli ku ebiti na bɛgya-mi enu na mina kakpakɔ.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.
translation_verse: Yerusalem kadi bekyuli, bɛlɛ na bitábwɛ ulu kaduɛ bibeduoku ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo bite bina bekyuli bani nási badubo na bidie atabi ƒui na ulu lɛlɔ. Bɛlɛ aƒlaga bite kadi bekyuli na banu.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
translation_verse: Na bati ka Unwoti muute-ma bɔti ɔnini, “Yerusalem bebi bɛnu, bina Ɔƒɔne ɔ́si ɔdubo! Na ɔda lɛyuƒɔla ɔduboku-mii.

english_verse: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama badubɔlɔ-mii banii, ‘Unwoti ɔlati bekyuli bani na ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́lɛku bubie kemmo!’ Na bekyuli badubɔtɛmi bɔsiku ƒula ɔma ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ banii kesii kabuni kani na bekyuli bilie ku ɔma ɔni na bekyuli báƒɔ-nwu kemmo geen.”

english_verse: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
translation_verse: Ɔma na ɔdi nási Bosra na Edom kalɛkɛ ɔdubo ku awu ugyiedi na mɔɔnu mɛni? Lɛlɔ ɔdine ɔmani nánya kalɔ ɔdubo ku ɔyikun ku adala ani muukeye lɛni? “Ami Unwoti na ɔdi! Lɛ́di lɛlɔ na kekpokɔ na ndubɔkana-mii bɔƒɔ!”

english_verse: “I alone trampled the grapes! None of the nations helped. I trampled nations in my anger and stained my clothes with their blood.
translation_verse: “Ami lɛti nákɔ-ma ƒui lɛ́bwɛ lɛni aani egyiibi na mina kɔnyi kemmo! Kadi badi bétebunku-mi. Na mmɔ na bana ubugya úduo-mi awu.

english_verse: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
translation_verse: Na kasi na mɔɔwia lidie-ma ɔsu na lɛ́bla lɛni, ɔsika uwi údu ka lidie mina kadi bekyuli.

english_verse: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi uuubo mmɔ na ubunku-mi nsu na kɔnyi kɔni na lɛ́kɛ ɔsu ni, lídie mina kɔnu na lɛ́bla ɔyikun ala útédu ka lɛ́di lɛlɔ.

english_verse: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
translation_verse: Na mina kɔnyi kemmo ni, lítu kadi bekyuli lɛ́bwɛ na lɛ́ya na báni bana ubugya ɔni néwi kalɔ na ɔɔgbá na kalɔ lɛlɔ kesi kesii mmɔ.”

english_verse: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
translation_verse: Ndubɔsu lɛƒɔndia ala ani na Unwoti ɔ́bla, ɔsika ala ammɔ ámanku ka bemwi-nwu! Unwoti ɔ́nu nwuna kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ kɔnyana na ɔɔbla-ma lɛƒɔndia uwi ndi uwi na ɔɔtina kalɛ na ɔdia.

english_verse: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
translation_verse: Anwu nédie-ma ɔ́lɛku bana bubie kemmo na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ami mbo-ma na baaadubo-mi kama bɔlɛ.”

english_verse: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
translation_verse: Na si ɔ́nu ka béduo lɛbibo lɛdi kemmo ni, uukpóku Unwoti geen na ɔɔyá na nwuna katɔ ɔtu uusié taatáƒɔ teete-ma. Unwoti ɔ́nu kɔnyana geen anwuɔsu na údie nwuna bekyuli ɔ́lɛku bana bubie kemmo. Ɔ́nu-ma lɛlɔ akwa ammɔ kemmo ƒui na use aani bɔgyu na ɔ́gyu-ma ɔda nwuna enu kemmo.

english_verse: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
translation_verse: Nsu ina amu béni na báta bénye nwuna Kɔyu Kedee lɛlɔ ka kɔdi-ma lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu na ɔ́sɔ-ma kama na únwini bana ukisine na anwu ɔlati úkpoku-ma geen.

english_verse: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, nwuna bekyuli bammɔ bákali bánu kuuku uwi ɔni na Mose ɔ́tɔnku nwuna bekyuli. Na béye lɛlɔ banii wɛ na ukyuli ɔni nétiku-ma ɔ́siaku ɛpu kemmo mmɔ ku bana lɛlɔ ɔnune aani baƒonu ɔdane buni mmɔ bávi? Na ukyuli ɔni náya na nwuna Kɔyu Kedee kuli-ma akɔ nɔɔ, wɛ na ɔ́vi?

english_verse: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.
translation_verse: Ɔma muudie kɔnu taabla ɔyikun ala ani muukeye si Mose ɔ́talaku kɔnu katɔ, na úle ɛpu kemmo inyɔ na bana anumi, na nwuna lɛnyi lise lísela uwi ƒui?

english_verse: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
translation_verse: Kalɛ na bebuo baayu teesie ɔkwalɛ kesii kani nse-ma kpoo ni, lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́ya na bákɛ bɔnwuna ɔkɛnku nwuna Kɔyu kɔni mɔɔtɔnku-ma lɛlɔ na ɔ́ƒɔ lɛnyi lɛni muukeye geen.

english_verse: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
translation_verse: Unwoti, nwini anumi na anu-bu na kalɔ mɛni asiku ƒula keliekɔ kedee na katɔ kakaaka kesii kani muukeye mmɔ. Wɛ na ƒula bɔyɔ ku ɔyikun ala ani na aabla teete-bu mmɔ bɔ́vi? Éni na asɔ aaada-bu kɔkɔɔkɔ ku kɔnyana bɔnu.

english_verse: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ ndi-bu Katɔti, ina ka Abraham ku Yakob ƒui basɔ baaagyi-bu aani bana bebi ni, awɔ Unwoti ndi bula ɔti, na Udiene na adi ete-bu ɔ́si kukuuku.

english_verse: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
translation_verse: Unwoti, bi ɔsu na áya na bɔɔyii ƒula ulu, na áya na bula kɔyi kɔ́bla na bubo atu ɔkplu na bulabu-ɔ? Sɔ nwini bo na abu ƒula kabla bablane ɔsu, abu bani ndi ƒula bekyuli bani na áƒuna ése éte lɛlɔ.

english_verse: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
translation_verse: Keliekɔ kedee kani na éte-bu ni, uwi klukwii ɔdi kani na búlie mmɔ asa na bekisine bébebile mmɔ báyila-ka udu.

english_verse: We act as though you had never ruled us or called us your people.
translation_verse: Awɔ badi na bɔdi ɔ́si kukuuku, nsu ɔƒaani buse aani ɔɔɔdi awɔ mɔɔdi-bu lɛlɔ, na use lɛnɔ aani si ɔɔɔdi ƒula lɛnyi na bɔɔdi.

english_verse: Rip the heavens apart! Come down, Lord; make the mountains tremble.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, bɔɔyɔ́ ka aya na kayaa kabwɛ kemmo na ayu ebo kalɔ. Na abi ƒui ataakunku na ƒula anumi!

english_verse: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
translation_verse: Na lɛla biala lɛbla aani kalɛ na baatu ogya taakya alakpi na aada. Na aya na ntu ƒui buteeƒuƒuo. Yu bo na aya na ƒula bekisine ƒui banu kalɛ na ƒula lɛnyi lɛɛda liƒu. Na aya na kadi bekyuli ƒui bayia-a, na benye-ɔ anumi bataatɔ kpakpaakpa!

english_verse: Your fearsome deeds have completely amazed us; even the mountains shake when you come down.
translation_verse: Ɔsika uwi ɔni na ábla liƒu ala ani na bɔɔɔsia anu muedi ni, bɔyu na áyu ébo na abi ammɔ ƒui ákunku na ƒula anumi.

english_verse: You help all who gladly obey and do what you want, but sin makes you angry. Only by your help can we ever be saved.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ƒui na béti bana kayi ƒaa baabla lɛbuni na beenyimo taasia ƒula lilu lɛlɔ ni, aayu teebo teebebunku-ma. Nsu uwi ɔni na búsie anumi na bɔɔbla alaekpidi na bɔɔta teenye ƒula lilu lɛlɔ ni, éti kɔnyi ákya-bu. Na dɛ na bɔdubɔsɔ bɔbla na bɔkɛ bɔƒɔ?

english_verse: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
translation_verse: Bula ƒui bɔ́ƒiɔ na buuuse sɛɛn. Na lɛla lɛbuni lɛni na bɔɔnu ka bɔɔbla muedi ni, lɛ́dɔli aani adikpi ani muusé lɛlɔ. Bula ƒui bɔ́yɛyɛ aani livete lɛnudi. Na bula alaekpidi énwini aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ na ada-bu eebó taavinku.

english_verse: No one worships in your name or remains faithful. You have turned your back on us and let our sins melt us away.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ndi ukyuli ɔsɔ ulákpali-ɔ lɛnyi iye unye kpakplaa ute-ɔ, ɔsika ábɛla-bu ƒula anumi. Na bubie kani náƒɔ-bu keliela ƒui na bɔɔyii udu na bula alaekpidi ammɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: You, Lord, are our Father. We are nothing but clay, but you are the potter who molded us.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Unwoti awɔ ndi bula ɔti. Lɛvɔti na abu bɔdi na awɔ ndi ɔvɔne ɔmmɔ. Ɔsika bula ƒui ƒula enu kabla na bɔdi.

english_verse: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.
translation_verse: Unwoti, teti kɔnyi takya-bu tetulo kalɛ na ɔ́manku. Na sɔ tenyimo bula ekpidi eteesienku ƒui. Mmomu ni, Ati, bɔɔkpali-ɔ ka anu-bu kɔnyana, ɔsika awɔ ɔdi kani na bula ƒui bɔdi.

english_verse: Zion's glorious and holy temple where our ancestors praised you has been destroyed by fire. Our beautiful buildings are now a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Na bula kakpakɔ kedee kani muukeye na bula bati kuuku bátaakpa-a ni, bákya-ka ogya bákyula. Na ala ani náƒɔ-bu kuye geen ƒui áyii udu atɛ kalɔ na asɔ eeebo lɛblakula.

english_verse: When you see these things, how can you just sit there and make us suffer more?
translation_verse: Ati, ala ani ƒui na awɔ ɔlati aanu mɛni kama ni, bulie na adubɔsɔ elie kpoo ataanu na alakya-bu kenye? Na ani-bu kɔtu mmomu avili?

english_verse: I, the Lord, was ready to answer even those who were not asking and to be found by those who were not searching. To a nation that refused to worship me, I said, “Here I am!”
translation_verse: “Lídie lɛlɔ lɛ́tina bekyuli bani na béteye-mi lili. Na bekyuli bani na bátawia-mi kama ulu bánu-mi. Na kadi bani bekyuli nátakpali-mi lɛnyi kudii ni, lɛ́su-ma nnini, ‘Bɛɛnu-mi mɛni, nnye mɛni.’

english_verse: All day long I have reached out to stubborn and sinful people going their own way.
translation_verse: Lídie mina enu nnye limeyi limodi ngya bekyuli bani na báta bénye mina lilu lɛlɔ na bakɛ ulu ukpidi lɛlɔ bésela na basia bana kasusu kama kani.

english_verse: They keep making me angry by sneering at me, while offering sacrifices to idols in gardens and burning incense to them on bricks.
translation_verse: Na baakya-mi kɔnyi uwi ndi uwi anumi ku anumi. Na bakɛ mmo ku atabi akpabi lidu lidu ƒui lɛlɔ baakyula akpala ku oloƒui.

english_verse: They spend their nights hiding in burial caves; they eat the meat of pigs, cooked in sauces made of stuff unfit to eat.
translation_verse: Bakɛ bekpine kɔvakɔ na kɔƒiɔtɔ akɔ usien umodi lɛlɛɛ talɛɛ talɛɛ banii baakpali ala. Na baadú baplakuo taakun na béƒulo lɛna lidu lɛni muusé lɛlɔ béyile kutu lɛtata.

english_verse: And then they say to others, “Don't come near us! We're dedicated to God.” Such people are like smoke, irritating my nose all day.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni mɔɔsu bekyuli bamba banii batani betede-ma, ɔsika ama bese sɛɛn na belese lɛlɔ aani bana bakpana. Nsu geen ni, bekyuli bamɛni bese aani uyɔ na mina enwu kemmo na bese aani ogya ɔni mɔɔda limeyi limodi.

english_verse: I have written this down; I won't keep silent. I'll pay them back just as their sins deserve.
translation_verse: Bɛnu, mɔɔnu bunweni bɔdi na mina anumi bɔni na Unwoti ɔɔsu ɔnini, ‘Lɛɛɛdubo mina kenye bubile bɔsɔ bulie kpoo mmomu ndubɔƒɔ kayu keyile bute ɔdi biala.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make them pay for their sins and for those of their ancestors— they have disgraced me by burning incense on mountains.
translation_verse: Bana ekpidi ani na bábla ku bana bati ekpidi lɛnɔ. Ɔsika bákyula akpala na abi lɛlɔ na bése kayi báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ na abi lɛlɔ mmɔ. Anwuɔsu ndubo bana lɛyuƒɔla keyile kani námanku bana ablala ani návi ƒui bɔƒɔ bute-ma.’ ”

english_verse: I have chosen the people of Israel and Judah, and I will bless them with many descendants. They will settle here in this land of mountains, and it will be theirs.
translation_verse: Ndubo Yakob kaba kemmo bawɔ bɔƒuna ku Yuda lɛnɔ. Na ama na ndubɔya na beti mina abi ammɔ ƒui benwini bana ɔdi. Na mina bekyuli baƒunadi bamɛni na ndubɔya na beti bana kalɔ kammɔ na belie-ka lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My people will worship me. Then the coastlands of Sharon and the land as far as Achor Valley will turn into pastureland where cattle and sheep will feed and rest.
translation_verse: Na Saron ɔdubunwini bebuo kadikɔ kabuni ute bana bebuo. Na Akor Ɔkwalɛ bonwu ɔmmɔ ɔdubunwini kesii kani na bebuo bammɔ badubo butaatɛ taanwuna ute mina bekyuli bani mɔɔwia-mi kama ulu.

english_verse: What will I, the Lord, do if any of you reject me and my holy mountain? What will happen to you for offering food and wine to the gods you call “Good Luck” and “Fate”?
translation_verse: “Nsu amii bani néni ami Unwoti na bɛ́yiƒala mina kɔbi kedee kɔmmɔ na biisé kadikɔ na bɛɛsála ntɛ na bɛɛdi taani teemwi baƒiɔ bɛnii ama mɔɔyá na lili lɛɛdia-mii na ama mɔɔgyumana-mii kasikɔ ni,

english_verse: Your luck will end! I will see to it that you are slaughtered with swords. You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong.
translation_verse: ndubo-mii bɔnyonu bute na bɛkya eli kalɔ na bina bekisine badu-mii ƒui. Ɔsika lɛ́kpali-mii na bítatuna bítete-mi. Na lɛ́tɛmiku-mii na bítenu. Mmomu bɛ́bla likpidi na mina anumi na ala ani na alayɔ-mi kaƒɔ mmomu na bɛ́ƒuna ka bitaabla.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will give food and drink to my servants, and they will celebrate. But all of you sinners will go hungry and thirsty, overcome with disgrace.
translation_verse: “Binu! Ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui mɔɔsu-mii nwaa ka mina kabla bablane badubo bɔdi, nsu kɔka kɔdubo amii alaekpidi bablane butaada uwi biala. Na badubo bɔni, nsu ntukwɛ ɔdubo-mii butaada uwi ndi uwi. Na lɛlɔ lɛdubo-ma bɔyɔ, nsu kɔƒa kɔdubo-mii bukpo.

english_verse: My servants will laugh and sing, but you will be sad and cry out in pain.
translation_verse: Mina kabla bablane badubo lɛnu budie ku kubiti bɔsiku bana kayi kemmo nsu amii bɛdubo kɔnyana buwulo na kayi kakpulu-mii na bɛyila lɛnunsia biala.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.
translation_verse: Mina kabla bablane bammɔ badubɔkpali bina anyi bewida bekyuli banii badubɔnuku-ni aani bina kalɛ. Nsu ama ni, ndubute-ma anyi awɔdi.

english_verse: I am God! I can be trusted. Your past troubles are gone; I no longer think of them. When you pray for someone to receive a blessing, or when you make a promise, you must do it in my name. I alone am the God who can be trusted. The Lord's New Creation
translation_verse: Ami kani ndi Katɔti ɔni lɛlɔ na ukyuli ɔdubɔkana na ɔsia lɛnu. Ala ani na ékpoku-mii dii ƒui ávi ni, ami nsɔ neeeti-nya lɛlɔ kasusu. Si biivele kusɛ kusɛ teete ukyuli ɔdi iye biisé kenye kadi ni, bɛbla lɛla biala na mina lɛnyi kemmo. Ami lɛti kani ndi Katɔti ɔni kani na ukyuli ɔsia lɛnu.

english_verse: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.
translation_verse: “Ndubo katɔ kawɔdi ku kalɔ kawɔdi budie na bekyuli bayiƒala ala ani na ávi ƒui.

english_verse: Celebrate and be glad forever! I am creating a Jerusalem, full of happy people.
translation_verse: Bɛdi limeyi ku ebiti na lɛlɔ litaayɔ-mii uselaku uwi ƒui! Muudie Yerusalem ɔwɔdi ɔni kemmo na lɛlɔyɔ bekyuli sɔɔn ndubɔƒɔ-nwu kemmo.

english_verse: I will celebrate with Jerusalem and all its people; there will be no more crying or sorrow in that city.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔdiku Yerusalem bekyuli bammɔ ƒui limeyi ɔni na kɔnyana buwulo iye keku kadi kasɔ kalakya ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.
translation_verse: “Na ubi ɔdi ɔsɔ ulekpi lɛnamu uwi mmomu badubulie babi lɛlɔ babla benengu geen. Na ukyuli biala na ɔ́ƒɔ akwa eti anyɔ ni, badubɔnu-nwu ɔnamu ɔni na si úkpi na útaƒɔ tɔ akwa eti anyɔ ni, na ewida na adi-nwu.

english_verse: My people will live in the houses they build; they will enjoy grapes from their own vineyards.
translation_verse: Mina bekyuli badubulie lɛtɔ lɛni na ama alati bátu kemmo. Na badubɔdi egyiibi mmo bɔni na bése ebi.

english_verse: No one will take away their homes or vineyards. My chosen people will live to be as old as trees, and they will enjoy what they have earned.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi uláƒɔ bana lɛtɔ lɛni bátu iye bana mmo bɔni na bése. Na mina kadi bekyuli baƒunadi bamɛni badubulie babi lɛlɔ aani egyii na badi ala ani na ama alati béti bana enu bábla.

english_verse: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.
translation_verse: Bana kabla kalayii udu na ɔlɛ ukpidi ɔdi uládu bana bebi mmomu ndubute bana bebi ku bawɔ lɛnɔ kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: I will answer their prayers before they finish praying.
translation_verse: Ndubute-ma lɛla lɛni baawia asa na bakpali-mi muedi nsu si baakpali lɛnɔ ni, ndubunu lɛla lɛni na beevele-mi.

english_verse: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Begidi ku baƒonubi badubɔdi basala na bagyata ku bakɔ ƒui badubɔkun keti. Na balakpi badubɔkun lɛti kani! Na baladu iye babla ɔdi lɛla lɛdi na mina kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ mmɔ. Lɛni na ami Unwoti mɔɔsu!”

english_verse: The Lord said: Heaven is my throne; the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Katɔ na líse mina lɛgaboku. Na kalɔ lɛlɔ mina lɛgba lɛnya. Na ɔtɔ ɔmani udu na bɛdubɔtu bite-mi? Na wɛ na ndubulie lɛnwuna?

english_verse: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord, have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.
translation_verse: Mina kɔnu nábla ani bɛɛnu mɛni ƒui na ébo éte kalɛ na ese. Ami Unwoti násu. “Bekyuli bani mɔɔyɔ́-mi kaƒɔ ni, ama ndi bani muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na bana ekpidi eeduo-ma, na lɛlɔ lɛɛtɔ́-ma ku bɔyia si bénu-mi lɛdi, na mina lɛlɔ kani na bana anu asia.

english_verse: You sacrifice oxen to me, and you commit murder; you sacrifice lambs to me and dogs to other gods; you offer grain to me and pigs' blood to idols; you burn incense to me and praise your idols. You have made your own choice to do these disgusting things that you enjoy so much.
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli biala nádu ɔmantɛ akɔ ka ɔkpa ute-mi ni, use aani ukyuli ɔni nádu nwuna ukyuli ɔkpana. Na ɔdi biala nádu koƒonubi ka ɔkpa ute-mi ni, use aani ukyuli ɔni náƒɛ akpewe limɔ. Na ɔdi biala néti kakpa edula ebi ka ubakpa ute-mi ni, use aani ukyuli ɔni néti ɔplakuo ubugya uboku-mi. Na ɔdi biala makyula oloƒui mete-mi use aani ukyuli ɔni mɔɔkpá baƒiɔ. Amii alati bɛ́ƒuna ala ani na bɛɛyɔ́ bíte lɛlɔ na binye bɛɛbla ala ani muusé lɛlɔ mɛni, ka anya mɔɔda-mii kubiti ɔsu.

english_verse: You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong. Now I will punish you in a way you dread the most. The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
translation_verse: Bíni bɛnii bilákpete-mii ɔni na mɔɔkpali-mii na bilásia mina ala ani na mɔɔtina-mi kama. Mmomu ala ani na nkisi ni, anya na binye bɛɛbla, nsu bɛgyi nwaa ka bɛɛƒiɔ́-mi. Anwuɔsu lɛtuni lɛni na bɛɛyia geen na ndubɔya na libo-mii lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: If you tremble when the Lord speaks, listen to what he says: “Some of your own people hate and reject you because of me. They make fun and say, ‘Let the Lord show his power! Let us see him make you truly happy.’ But those who say these things will be terribly ashamed.”
translation_verse: Amii bani mɔɔyia Katɔti na bɛɛbu-nwu si ɔɔtɛmi ni, binu-nwu litemi. “Na bina banwa bani muudie-mii lɛti na beekisi-mii na mina lɛnyi ɔsu baasu banii, ‘Unwoti udie nwuna ɔyikun keyi na bɔnu! Na udie-mii na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii bɔnu.’ Nsu bani ƒui mɔɔsu ala amɛni udu ni, badubo bunwini ku kɔƒa kɔni naaadia bɔnu.”

english_verse: Do you hear that noise in the city and those shouts coming from the temple? It is the Lord shouting as he punishes his enemies.
translation_verse: Bise atu na binu kɔku ku kudu kɔni nda na ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo ku kakpakɔ kammɔ kemmo. Unwoti ablala na adi. Anwu mɔɔƒɔ nwuna bekisine kayu kani ƒui námanku-ma.

english_verse: Have you ever heard of a woman who gave birth to a child before having labor pains?
translation_verse: “Bíinu dii ka nka uleku ɔwɔ asa na kawɔƒɔ kadu-nwu?

english_verse: Who ever heard of such a thing or imagined it could happen? Can a nation be born in a day or come to life in a second? Jerusalem is like a mother who gave birth to her children as soon as she was in labor.
translation_verse: Ɔma na ɔnii anwu únu lɛni dii iye ɔbla kasusu ka ɔlɛ lɛni? Baawɔ kadi ƒui bekyuli limeyi linwi iye anumi bubo kunwi kemmo? Nsu Yerusalem anwu ni, útenu tɔ kawɔƒɔ bɔdu asa na ɔ́wɔ nwuna bebi.

english_verse: The Lord is the one who makes birth possible. And he will see that Zion has many more children. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Ami Unwoti lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na kaƒɔ kedu bɔwɔ na balawɔ-ka. Na neeetile kawɔƒɔ kenye si ubi údu bɔwɔ.

english_verse: If you love Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! If you were in sorrow because of the city, you can now be glad.
translation_verse: Bɛkɛ lɛlɔyɔ ku Yerusalem na ebiti ada amii bani mɔɔyɔ́-nwu. Bibo lɛlɔyɔ kudu momoomo amii bani néwulo-nwu kɔnyana.

english_verse: She will nurse and comfort you, just like your own mother, until you are satisfied. You will fully enjoy her wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bɛdubo bɔdi bumo bɔsia kama na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii aani kalɛ na bebiwɔ baanyimi anyii ntu teemo na bana bawɔne lɛgba lɛlɔ na baada-ma taamana kayi na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-ma.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised: “I will flood Jerusalem with the wealth of nations and make the city prosper. Zion will nurse you at her breast, carry you in her arms, and hold you in her lap.
translation_verse: Unwoti úse kenye úse ɔnini, “Ndubɔya na keyi buɛɛ kaƒɔ Yerusalem ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ ƒui na akɛla pii asi kadi kadi bekyuli kɔlɔ lɛlɔ ebo na abábu na Yerusalem aani ketu kani mɔɔgbá na kalákwii. Na ɔdubɔbla aani ubi ɔni na uni ɔɔgyú taada nwuna enu kemmo na ɔɔƒianku-nwu ku ebiti.

english_verse: I will comfort you there like a mother comforting her child.”
translation_verse: Ndubɔyala-a kaƒɔ, Yerusalem, aani kalɛ na ubi uni ɔɔbla ubidi.”

english_verse: When you see this happen, you will celebrate; your strength will return faster than grass can sprout. Then everyone will know that the Lord provides help for his servants, but he is angry with his enemies.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bɛdubɔnu ka ala amɛni aalɛ́ lɛni ni, bina kayi kadubɔyɔ buɛɛ na bɛlɛ lili aani kalɛ na livo lɛɛlɛ́ lili. Na bɛdubɔnu kalɛ na Unwoti ɔɔƒɛnimi kɔnu taakya nwuna kabla bablane bani mɔɔbu-nwu. Nsu nwuna bekisine bani mɔɔta teenye-nwu lɛlɔ ama ni, nwuna kɔnyi muubo-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will come down like a whirlwind with his flaming chariots. He will be furiously angry and punish his enemies with fire.
translation_verse: Bɛnu! Unwoti uli nwuna kɛɛkɛ kemmo ɔdubo ku ogya na use aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔkya ligede. Ɔkɛnku kɔnyi kati kati ɔdubo na ɔdubo bekyuli bɔbɔku ku ogya unyemi ɔni mɔɔda gaganga.

english_verse: The Lord's fiery sword will bring justice everywhere on this earth and execute many people. A Threat and a Promise
translation_verse: Ɔsika ogya ku kewii na Unwoti ɔda ɔdubo ubatɛku bekyuli litemi na Unwoti kewii kammɔ kadubo bekyuli pii bɔdu.

english_verse: Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord, will destroy you for this.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Bekyuli banii muukisi lɛlɔ na baasiaku lɛlɔ lisu teesie alakpi akɔ taatákpa baƒiɔ na baakun baplakuo ku besi ku bayikpɛ ku ala bamba ani muusé lɛlɔ ni, bana ƒui badubɔnuku-ni na bana kɔwɔlɔkɔ kamɛni.

english_verse: I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory
translation_verse: “Ngyi bina ablala ku kakali ƒui. Na uwi údu ka libo na ndubɔsala kadi ƒui bekyuli ku adi lidu batɛmine ƒui na lɛya na banu kalɛ na muukeye.

english_verse: by proving what I can do. I will send the survivors to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Meshech, Tubal, Javan, and to the distant islands. I will send them to announce my wonderful glory to nations that have never heard about me.
translation_verse: “Ndubo akɔla budie taatina ala bɔbla na lɛtina-ma mina ɔyikun ɔni na mbo na bani nébu beli na bana akɔ ni, ndubuti-ma limene Tarsis ku Pul ku Lud ku Mesek ku Tubal ku Yavan ku ntuntɛ kalɔ na ɔgyu kakaaka na lɛya na besie batákɔ lɛsa bete kadi bani bekyuli nétenu-mi tɔ kɔku kalɛ na muukeye.

english_verse: They will bring your relatives from the nations as an offering to me, the Lord. They will come to Jerusalem, my holy mountain, on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels. It will be like the people of Israel bringing the right offering to my temple.
translation_verse: Na badubɔlɛku bina banwani bɔsiku kadi bekyuli ƒui kɔlɔ lɛlɔ beboku ami Unwoti aani akpala kalɛ na Yerusalem. Na badubulie bapɔnkɔ ku bebuo ala betine ku kɛɛkɛ lidu lidu ku bebuo ala betine ku keƒu lɛlɔ bebo. Badubo-ma bɔkpanku buboku aani kalɛ na Israelƒuɔ beeti bana kakpa edula etela taakya akyami ani na bédie bése sɛsɛɛ úte emeyi amɛni udu kemmo teeboku-mi na mina kakpakɔ.

english_verse: I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na bana akɔ na ndubɔƒuna badi na benwini bakpane ku Lewiƒuɔ.

english_verse: I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever.
translation_verse: “Kalɛ na katɔ kawɔdi ku kalɔ kawɔdi kani na ndubɔbla kadubɔkya uwi ƒui ni, lɛni kani na ndubɔya na ƒula lɛnyi ku bɔwɔ basɔ balása kudii.

english_verse: On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni na ami Unwoti mɔɔyá na bɛti ni, limeyi lideedi biala na kɔbuli kemmo ku lɛnwunameyi biala lɛlɔ ni, ɔdi biala ubo na ubakya-mi lili kalɔ.

english_verse: My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
translation_verse: Mina bekyuli badubusie na batánu bekyuli bani náta bénye-mi lɛlɔ kalɛ na beklubi baakun-ma ɔlɔna na beklubi bammɔ belekpi kudii. Na ogya ɔni mɔɔkyula-ma mmɔ lɛnɔ uleni kudii na lɛla lɛni na badubɔnu mmɔ ɔdi lɛla lɛni muusé lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: My name is Jeremiah. I am a priest, and my father Hilkiah and everyone else in my family are from Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. This book contains the things that the Lord told me to say.
translation_verse: Hilkia ubidi Yeremia ɔni ndi Katɔti bakpane akɔ unwi na ɔ́si Anatos ɔma kemmo na Benyamin kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ etemila na adi mɛni.

english_verse: The Lord first spoke to me in the thirteenth year that Josiah was king of Judah,
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ƒɔ Unwoti linyesia lɛmɛni uwi ɔni na Amon ubidi Yosaia ɔɔdi lɛga na Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ lɛkwa leevu-lɛtɛdi kemmo.

english_verse: and he continued to speak to me during the rule of Josiah's son Jehoiakim. The last time the Lord spoke to me was in the fifth month of the eleventh year that Josiah's son Zedekiah was king. That was also when the people of Jerusalem were taken away as prisoners. The Lord Chooses Jeremiah
translation_verse: Na linyesia lɛmɛni lɛdanku lɛla lɛni útálɛku uwi ɔni na Yosaia ubidi ɔnanabi Yehoiakim lɛnɔ úbo ɔɔdi lɛga laa útálɛ Sedekaia ɔni ndi Yuda Ɔga Yosaia ubidi ɔnanabi lɛga bɔdi uwi lɛkwa leevu-linwidi kemmo. Uwi ɔmmɔ na békpo bádi Yerusalemƒuɔ lɛlɔ na béƒie-ma bátɔlɔku na lɛkwa lɛmmɔ kɔbuli kɔlɔndi kemmo. Unwoti Ɔ́ƒuna Yeremia

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: “Jeremiah, I am your Creator, and before you were born, I chose you to speak for me to the nations.”
translation_verse: “Yeremia, asa na ndubɔvɔ-ɔ lɛkya kaƒɔ kemmo na bawɔ-ɔ ni, lɛ́ƒuna-a líse ka ebo ebenwini kenye udiene ete kadi bekyuli ƒui.”

english_verse: I replied, “I'm not a good speaker, Lord, and I'm too young.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lídie kenye nnini, “Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, lɛɛɛgyi bɔtɛmi na ńtabi lɛlɔ lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: “Don't say you're too young,” the Lord answered. “If I tell you to go and speak to someone, then go! And when I tell you what to say, don't leave out a word!
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Tasu anini, ‘Ńtabi lɛlɔ.’ Mmomu si lɛ́tala-a nnii tásu ukyuli ɔdi lɛla lɛdi ni, sie! Na asu-nwu lɛla lɛni na líbo-ɔ ɔda mmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord reached out his hand, then he touched my mouth and said, “I am giving you the words to say,
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti údie nwuna kɔnu na útuku-mi kenye na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Líti etemila ani na adubo bɔsu mɔɔkya-a kenye.

english_verse: and I am sending you with authority to speak to the nations for me. You will tell them of doom and destruction, and of rising and rebuilding again.”
translation_verse: Nu, líti ɔyikun muute-ɔ ɔmwi na kadi bekyuli ku lɛgakɔdikɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na ekpeli-ma ebo na ebile-ma ɔyikun. Na ayila-ma udu na adi-ma lɛlɔ. Na asɔku kɔbamba atu enyene.”

english_verse: The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I answered, “A branch of almonds that ripen early.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti údie lɛla lɛdi ɔ́tina-mi na úye-mi ɔnini, “Yeremia, bi na aanu?” Amu na lidie kenye nnini, “Mɔɔnu kɔdingyii kagba kadi.”

english_verse: “That's right,” the Lord replied, “and I always rise early to keep a promise.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔnini, “Ásu na ɔ́tɛ, na lɛni na nnye mɔɔsia mina litemi anu kpakplaa ka lɛya na libo-nwu kemmo kalɛ na lɛ́su.”

english_verse: Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, “What do you see now?” I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́sɔ údie lɛla bamba lɛdi ɔ́tina-mi na úye-mi ɔnini, “Bi na aanu?” Amu na lídie kenye nnini, “Mɔɔnu libui lɛdi ku ntu bɔni muuƒuƒuo na katɔ kakɛ na bɔɔyɔ́ buwiakun bubo-bu kudɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will pour out destruction all over the land.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ndubo bɔya na ɔgbankpi ɔsi kɔlɔ kɔni na katɔ kakɛ ubo bekyuli bani nli kalɔ kamɛni ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Just watch while I send for the kings of the north. They will attack and capture Jerusalem and other towns, then set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na badubo bebese bana agaboku na Yerusalem ɔban kenye na benye bamana awodu ammɔ ƒui ku Yuda lɛma linengudi bamba lɛnɔ ƒui.

english_verse: I will punish my people, because they are guilty of turning from me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Na ndubo mina bekyuli ƒui litemi bɔtɛku na lɛdu-ma kɔtɔ, ɔsika béni-mi na bénwini kama bákya-mi na baakyula oloƒui teete baƒiɔ bamba.

english_verse: Jeremiah, get ready! Go and tell the people what I command you to say. Don't be frightened by them, or I will make you terrified while they watch.
translation_verse: “Yeremia, klibi lɛlɔ se! Sie na atásu bekyuli bammɔ lɛla lɛni na líti mɔɔkya-a kɔnu mɛni. Taya na bana lɛlɔ lɛbla-a liƒu si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, ndubɔya na liƒu ala adi abla-a na lɛya na ama benye bataanu-ɔ.

english_verse: My power will make you strong like a fortress or a column of iron or a wall of bronze. You will oppose all of Judah, including its kings and leaders, its priests and people.
translation_verse: Ɔmwi ni, lɛ́gyi ɔban lɛ́kya-a aani ɔma unengudi kagyumanakɔ kpakplaa. Na lɛ́bla-a aani lɛbuala lɛkpa ku abuala egyiedi kowodu kalɛ na enye asiaku Yudaƒuɔ ku bana baga ku batɔnkune ku bakpane ku bekyuli bammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: They will fight back, but they won't win. I, the Lord, give my word— I won't let them harm you.
translation_verse: Badubo bunwini bunye banii beekpóku-ɔ, nsu balakana-a lɛlɔ bɔdi. Ɔsika ami Unwoti muusé-ɔ kenye ka lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na babla-a likpidi lɛdi.”

english_verse: The Lord told me
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii

english_verse: to go to Jerusalem and tell everyone that he had said: When you were my young bride, you loved me and followed me through the barren desert.
translation_verse: nsie Yerusalem na ntákɔ lɛsa nte ukyuli biala na mmɔ ka anwu Unwoti násu ɔnini, “Uwi ɔni na adi uleku ɔni na líti ɔwɔdi ni, áyɔ-mi na ásiaku-mi kama siin, na bɔkɛ kalɔ kakwiidi kani naaadia edula mmɔ kemmo ɔni na átalɛ-mi kama.

english_verse: You belonged to me alone, like the first part of the harvest, and I severely punished those who mistreated you.
translation_verse: Israel, ami lɛti pɛ ɔdi na ádi aani mina edula edeedi ani na lɛ́ƒɛ lɛ́siku mina kemo. Na ukyuli biala ɔni nákali ɔnii ɔɔƒɛ-ɔ ɔdi ni, ɔgbankpi ɔ́siaku-nwu.

english_verse: and I, the Lord, will speak. I was never unfair to your ancestors, but they left me and became worthless by following worthless idols.
translation_verse: Lɛni na ami Unwoti muuye-mii nnini, “Bi likpidi na bina bati kuuku bánu-mi lɛlɔ ɔsu na bénwini-mi kama na bésie basiaku ala bamba ani neeebo kɔsia ɔsu na ama alati lɛnɔ básɔ beeebo-mi kɔsia kɔdi?

english_verse: Your ancestors refused to ask for my help, though I had rescued them from Egypt and led them through a treacherous, barren desert, where no one lives or dares to travel.
translation_verse: Bátakana na beye banii, ‘Nte Unwoti ɔni nákpanku-bu ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ, na ɔ́tɔnku-bu ɔ́siaku ketele kemmo kalɔ kakwiidi kani kemmo na libu lɛ́ƒɔ tɛɛ mmɔ, kalɔ kani kemmo na ntu buuubo na kese suu geen, na ukyuli ɔdi ulásia mmɔ taavi kudii, na ukyuli ɔdi uuulie mmɔ lɛnɔ?’

english_verse: I brought you here to my land, where food is abundant, but you made my land filthy with your sins.
translation_verse: Lɛ́kpanku-mii líboku kalɔ kani na ala abuni áƒɔ-ka pii mɛni lɛlɔ, kesii kani na egyiibi abuni ku ala abuni akya na bɛkɛ bɛdi, nsu bɛ́bla na kalɔ kammɔ keesé lɛlɔ na bina ekpidi bɔbla ɔsu.

english_verse: The priests who teach my laws don't care to know me. Your leaders rebel against me; your prophets give messages from Baal and worship false gods. The Lord Accuses His People
translation_verse: Bakpane béteye banii, ‘Nte Unwoti?’ Ama bani mɔɔtina ɔda bubo ala bátanu-mi bátati. Lɛlɔ badine aani baƒonu badane kalɛ báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ. Kenye bediene básu ala bése na Baal baƒiɔ lɛnyi kemmo, na bakɛ basiaku ala bamba aani neeebo kɔsia kama.

english_verse: I will take you to court and accuse you and your descendants *
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu nsɔ ndubo-mii kɔtɔ bɔdu. Lɛni na ami Unwoti mɔɔsu. Na ndubɔdu bina bawɔ bawɔ lɛnɔ kɔtɔ.

english_verse: of a crime that no nation has ever committed before. Just ask anyone, anywhere, from the eastern deserts to the islands in the west.
translation_verse: Bɛvia bisie Kitiƒuɔ ketu kɔtu na bitánu, na bɛtala bekyuli na Kedar na bátásia anu kaduɛ, na banu si lɛla lɛmɛni udu lɛ́ɛlɛ dii.

english_verse: You will find that no nation has ever abandoned its gods even though they were false. I am the true and glorious God, but you have rejected me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Kadi bekyuli badi bávumana bana baƒiɔ dii ina ka baƒiɔ badi beeebo ɔyikun? Nsu mina kadi bekyuli bávumana mina bukeye ku ɔbu béte ala keeke ani neeebo kɔsia.

english_verse: Tell the heavens to tremble with fear!
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ litaatɔ kayaa ala ƒui, na liƒu bonwu litaada-mii! Lɛni na ami Unwoti mɔɔsu.

english_verse: You, my people, have sinned in two ways— you have rejected me, the source of life-giving water, and you've tried to collect water in cracked and leaking pits dug in the ground.
translation_verse: “Mina bekyuli, bɛ́ƒiɔ-mi na lilu inyɔ lɛlɔ. Bíni ami ɔni ndi libiɔ lɛni mɔɔyu ntu buni, na biidú ntu teewi abiɔ ani na bíku na bɛ́tu bɛ́kya kalɔ kemmo na ásia kɔka na ntu bulakana-nya kemmo buwi.

english_verse: People of Israel, you weren't born slaves; you were captured in war.
translation_verse: “Israel kadi bekyuli, nka bátawɔ-mii na bɛdi bekyuli bamba kabla bablane nɔɔ? Bi ɔsu na bina bekisine békpo-mii na béƒie-mii bátɔlɔku lɛni?

english_verse: Enemies roared like lions and destroyed your land; towns lie burned and empty.
translation_verse: Bina bekisine baakwanyi aani bagyata, na báyila-mii udu, na bébile-mii kalɔ, na bákyula lɛma béwi ukpludi na bekyuli basɔ beeebo-ni kemmo.

english_verse: Soldiers from the Egyptian towns of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skulls.
translation_verse: Na ɔni na utulo ndi ka Memƒis ku Taƒanes lɛma bekyuli békpeyi-mii eli útálɛ opokuo.

english_verse: It's all your own fault! You stopped following me, the Lord your God,
translation_verse: Na amii alati kudɔ na ɔmɛni ƒui ɔ́si! Anwuɔsu na ɔdi ka bɛdu lɛlɔ kɔtɔ. Ɔsika bɛ́da ami Unwoti ɔni ndi bina Katɔti kama bɔsiaku bɛ́ya.

english_verse: Your own sins will punish you, because it was a bitter mistake for you to reject me without fear of punishment. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.
translation_verse: Bina likyulikpi ndubo bunwini bina lɛtuni. Na kalɛ na bɛ́ta bínye-mi lɛlɔ na bíni-mi mɔɔdú-mii kɔtɔ. Ɔdi likpidi ku kɔtɔ bɔdu kati kati ka eni ami Unwoti Katɔti ɔsika ɔɔtina ka biláyia-mi munu munu. Ami Unwoti kadi ƒui Katɔti násu.

english_verse: Long ago you left me and broke all ties between us, refusing to be my servant. Now you worship other gods by having sex on hilltops or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: “Na kuuku uwi ɔni návi kemmo ni, bídie-mi atu na bíni ka lɛdi-mii lɛlɔ, na bɛnii bɛsɔ bilabla-mi kabla. Na ɔƒaani ni, baƒiɔ bammɔ na bɛɛkpá na biisié lɛlɔ kudɔ ɔnana ku uleku na egyii bonwu ammɔ ɔyuli kalɔ na abi eli.

english_verse: You were a choice grapevine, but you have become a wild, useless vine. Israel Is Stained with Guilt
translation_verse: Na nka bɔƒuna na lɛ́ƒuna-mii lɛ́lɛ aani kɔdingyii kɔni na naaaƒianku nsu ɔƒɛni amu bíbulo ebi buni bɔnwu. Israel Ekpidi Ádɔli-ma Na Aadú-ma Kɔtɔ

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Israel, you are stained with guilt, and no soap or bleach can wash it away.
translation_verse: “Bina ekpidi áya na bɛ́dɔli geen na ina bi ɔkwayɛ na bíti bɛ́kpi bikuo lɛlɔ kalɛ kalɛ muedi ni, bɔdɔli bɔmmɔ bulálɛ-mii lɛlɔ na mina anumi. Lɛni na ami Unwoti Katɔti mɔɔsu.

english_verse: You deny your sins and say, “We aren't unclean. We haven't worshiped Baal.” But think about what you do in Hinnom Valley. You run back and forth like young camels, as you rush to worship one idol after another.
translation_verse: “Dɛ na bɛdubɔkana na bɛsu bɛnini, ‘Bulese lɛlɔ na bútakpa Baal baƒiɔ lɛnɔ’? Amii alati bɛnu ala ani na bɛ́bla na Hinom Kɔwɛ kemmo, kalɛ na bɛkɛ biikeli teesie taasɔ aani baƒlumu bakɔdi bani náƒɛ kɔnu.

english_verse: You are a female donkey sniffing the desert air, wanting to mate with just anyone. You are an easy catch!
translation_verse: Bise aani bebuo ala betine beledi bani nkɛ kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo ƒaa, na bana enwu eti kayaa beenwenyi ɔƒɛƒɛɛ teenu, na bani mɔɔwia-ma bakɔ belebo abi asa baanu-ma.

english_verse: Your shoes are worn out, and your throat is parched from running here and there to worship foreign gods. “Stop!” I shouted, but you replied, “No! I love those gods too much.”
translation_verse: Bina lɛgbanvuo lɛni bɛkya lɛ́ɛsa lɛ́wɔlɔ, na bina ɔkwɛ kemmo kákwii ɔni na bɛkɛ bɛɛkɔ́ taayu aƒiodu. Lɛ́va lɛ́kpali-mii nnini, ‘Bɛsɔ binwini.’ Nsu bídie kenye bɛnini, ‘Oowo! Bɔɔyɔ́ baƒiɔ taagya.’

english_verse: You and your leaders are more disgraceful than thieves— you and your kings, your priests and prophets
translation_verse: “Kalɛ na kɔƒa kuukpó uyune si béƒie-nwu ni, lɛni na kɔƒa kɔdubo Israelƒuɔ bukpo, amii ku bina baga ku bakpane ku kenye bediene ƒui.

english_verse: worship stone idols and sacred poles as if they had created you and had given you life. You have rejected me, but when you're in trouble, you cry to me for help.
translation_verse: Amii bani mɔɔsu egyii bɛnii, ‘Amii ndi bula bati,’ na bɛɛsu atabi bɛnii, ‘Amii náwɔ-bu.’ Ɔsika bina kama na bínwini bɛɛtina-mi na ɔɔɔdi bina anumi. Nsu ka ala eekpóku-mii ni, bɛ́kpali bɛnini, ‘Bo na ebebunku-bu!’

english_verse: Go cry to the gods you made! There should be enough of them to save you, because Judah has as many gods as it has towns. Israel Rebels against the Lord
translation_verse: Biteesie bitéwulo bɛkya baƒiɔ bani na bɛ́bla bíte lɛlɔ mmɔ si badubɔkana-mii bubunku. Bémomo aani kalɛ kani na bina lɛma limomo. Israel Ɔ́ta Únye Unwoti Lɛlɔ

english_verse: The Lord said to Israel: You accuse me of not saving you, but I say you have rebelled.
translation_verse: “Bi ɔsu na bɛɛdú-mi kɔtɔ ka bina ƒui bɛ́ta bínye-mi lɛlɔ? Lɛni na ami Unwoti mɔɔsu.

english_verse: I tried punishing you, but you refused to come back to me, and like fierce lions you killed my prophets.
translation_verse: Lɛ́du bina bebi líti lɛ́ni-mii kɔtu nsu bíni na bítenwini bítebo-mii kudɔ. Bina kuwii na amii alati bíti bɛ́du bina kenye bediene aani bagyata bani néti kɔnyi.

english_verse: Now listen to what I say! Did I abandon you in the desert or surround you with darkness? You are my people, yet you have told me, “We'll do what we want, and we refuse to worship you!”
translation_verse: “Bise atu na binu lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu. Budie na lídie-mii atu na kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo na bɛ́sɔ bɛkya lɛdisa kemmo? Mina bekyuli na bɛdi, nsu bɛ́kana na bɛ́su-mi bɛnini, ‘Lɛla lɛni na abu bɔɔyɔ́ na bɔdubo bɔbla, na bɔɔɔdubo-ɔ lili kalɔ bɔkya.’

english_verse: A bride could not forget to wear her jewelry to her wedding, but you have forgotten me day after day.
translation_verse: Uleku utidi uláyiƒala nwuna asɛɛ bɔkya si uwi ɔni na bésela-nwu kawɛɛkɔ. Nsu amii bɛɛyiƒala-mi limeyi ndi limeyi.

english_verse: You are so clever at finding lovers that you could give lessons to a prostitute.
translation_verse: Bɛgyi ulu biala lɛlɔ na bɛkana na bɛsia na bɛkɛ bayɔne ɔni na bɛsɔ bɛɛtina beleku bekpidi bammɔ lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: You killed innocent people for no reason at all. And even though their blood can be seen on your clothes,
translation_verse: Bɛ́du bekyuli bani nátabla-mii lɛla lɛdi kekeeke. Na ina ka bana ubugya ɔ́ƒɔ-mii adala lɛlɔ muedi ni,

english_verse: you claim to be innocent, and you want me to stop being angry with you. So I'll take you to court, and we'll see who is right.
translation_verse: bɛ́mu binye bɛɛsu kpakplaa ka likpidi lɛdi lɛɛɛma-mii lɛlɔ. Na bɛɛwia ka lɛda kɔnyi buti taakya-mii lɛya. Anwuɔsu ami ku-mii bɔdubo litemi katɛkɔ bulie na bɔnu ukyuli ɔni ɔdi nátɛ.

english_verse: When Assyria let you down, you quickly ran to Egypt, but you'll find no help there,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Asiriaƒuɔ bákya-mii kakya na bátakana-mii bubunku ni, bíkeli bísie Egyipte. Nsu bɛɛɛdubo kebunku kadi bɔkɛ na mmɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: and you will leave in great sadness. I won't let you find help from those you trust.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubo lɛlɔ bɔƒɔ bɔkya kɔnyana bonwu kɔdi kemmo, ɔsika lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na bɛkɛ katamikukɔ kadi na bana kudɔ kesii kani na bina anu asia mmɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to the people of Israel: If a divorced woman marries, can her first husband ever marry her again? No, because this would pollute the land. But you have more gods than a prostitute has lovers. Why should I take you back?
translation_verse: “Si ɔnana ɔdi ɔ́nyonu ulekudi na uleku ɔmmɔ úsie útélie kɔgya bamba ni, buti na ɔgyani udeedi ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔsɔ ɔkana-nwu buti? Oowo, ɔsika ɔmmɔ ɔdububile kalɔ kammɔ. Nsu bise aani bayalɛ na bibo basɔnɔ bayɔne pii na bɔlɛ na ɔ́lɛ ka bɛsɔ binwini bibo-mi kudɔ ɔƒɛni amu? Lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su.

english_verse: Just try to find one hilltop where you haven't gone to worship other gods by having sex. You sat beside the road like a robber in ambush, except you offered yourself to every passerby. Your sins of unfaithfulness have polluted the land.
translation_verse: “Bɛkya ɔkplu na bɛtina kɔbi kɔnii lili na bítesie tɔ bítatákpa tɔ baƒiɔ badi na bɛtɛ lɛlɔ kudɔ ɔnana ku uleku kalɛ na mmɔ? Biinye ulu amadɔ taakywɛ bekyuli bani na biti lɛlɔ bite, na bɛbla bina lɛsɔnɔdi ala aani beyune bani mɔɔbɛ́ teenye kuludɔ taatu bekyuli. Ekpidi ani udu na bɛɛlɛ́-mi kama taabla úubile kalɔ kemodi kammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, refused to let the spring rains fall. But just like a prostitute, you still have no shame for what you have done.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na ami Unwoti lítile kayaa na ketudi ɔnantu úbulo bɔna bute-mii. Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui muedi kɔƒa kulekpo-mii na bina ɔbladu ɔsu aani kalɛ na kɔƒa kulekpo ɔyalɛ na nwuna lɛsɔnɔdi ablala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You call me your father or your long-lost friend;
translation_verse: Bɛɛlɔ-mi bina ɔti na bɛɛtina ka ɔ́si bina lɛnamu uwi ƒui na bɛɛyɔ́-mi.

english_verse: you beg me to stop being angry, but you won't stop sinning. The Lord Asks Israel To Come Back to Him
translation_verse: Na biivele-mi bɛnii nda kɔnyi buti taakya-mi lɛya, nsu bíni bɛnii bilada bina ekpidi anya bɔbla biláya.” Unwoti Ɔ́su Israel Kadi Bekyuli Ka Benwini Bebo-nwu Kudɔ

english_verse: When Josiah was king, the Lord said: Jeremiah, the kingdom of Israel was like an unfaithful wife who became a prostitute on the hilltops and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yosaia ɔdi ɔga ni, Unwoti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Yeremia, Israel lɛga kadikɔ ƒui káta kénye-mi lɛlɔ aani uleku utidi ɔni nálɛ ɔgyani kama na únwini ɔyalɛ na ɔkɛ abi ƒui eli ku egyii enengudi ɔyuli kalɔ ɔɔtɛ taavi.

english_verse: I knew that the kingdom of Israel had been unfaithful and committed many sins, yet I still hoped she might come back to me. But she didn't, so I divorced her and sent her away. Her sister, the kingdom of Judah, saw what happened, but she wasn't worried in the least, and I watched her become unfaithful like her sister.
translation_verse: Lɛ́nu ɔmɛni lɛ́ti ka Israel lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ ƒui bálɛ-mi kama na bábla ekpidi pii, nsu ina amu mina anu asia ka badubunwini na bana ɔbladu buɛ kama bebo-mi kudɔ na bébulo, anwuɔsu ami lɛnɔ lɛ́nyonu-nwu na lídie-nwu ulu na ɔ́lɛ-mi kesii. “Na ɔnwani ulekubi Yuda lɛnɔ ɔ́nu ɔmɛni, nsu útabla-nwu lɛla lɛdi iye ukpoku-nwu muedi. Mmomu mɔɔnu ka anwu lɛnɔ úse kalɔ uulie ngba bukpidi bɔmɛni na ɔɔlɛ́-mi kama.

english_verse: The kingdom of Judah wasn't sorry for being a prostitute, and she didn't care that she had made both herself and the land unclean by worshiping idols of stone and wood.
translation_verse: Útekpoku Yuda lɛga kadikɔ munu munu ka úti lɛlɔ únwini ɔyalɛ. Na úbile lɛlɔ ku kalɔ kammɔ ƒui, na beesé lɛlɔ na lɛƒiɔkpa kpakplaa lɛni kemmo na béti lɛlɔ bákya na baakpá atabi ku egyii ɔsu.

english_verse: And worst of all, the people of Judah pretended to come back to me.
translation_verse: Na ɔni násɔ úbie útulo ƒui ndi ɔni na Yuda ɔ́nyi ɔkɔ ɔ́bla lɛlɔ aani si bunwini na ɔ́sɔ únwini úbo-mi kudɔ.

english_verse: Even the people of Israel were honest enough not to pretend.
translation_verse: “Ɛbɔ Israel kadi bekyuli ɔdi, ɔsika ama básɔ bátanyi ɔkɔ bamba ɔdi banii beesé-mi lisusu lɛdi.

english_verse: Jeremiah, shout toward the north: Israel, I am your Lord— come back to me! You were unfaithful and made me furious, but I am merciful, and so I will forgive you.
translation_verse: Yeremia, nwini kenye sienku kalɔ kammɔ katɔ kakɛ na ebo kudu momoomo anini, ‘Israel, ami ndi bina Unwoti binwini bibo-mi kudɔ! Bɛ́lɛ-mi kama na bɛkya-mi kɔnyi geen. Nsu mɔɔnu kɔnyana ɔsu ni, ndubuti lɛkyiɛ-mii.

english_verse: Just admit that you rebelled and worshiped foreign gods under large trees everywhere.
translation_verse: Bɛtuna ka bɛ́ta bínye-mi lɛlɔ, na bɛkpa baƒiɔ bamba na egyii enengudi ƒui kalɔ na kesi kesii.

english_verse: You are unfaithful children, but you belong to me. Come home! I'll take one or two of you from each town and clan and bring you to Zion.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɛdi bebi bani naaasiaku-mi kama siin, nsu ami mbo-mii. Binwini bibo ɔma! Ndubuti bina akɔ unwi iye inyɔ bɔsiku bina lɛma ɔdi biala kemmo ku adua ammɔ kemmo buboku Sion.

english_verse: Then I'll appoint wise rulers who will obey me, and they will care for you like shepherds.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔƒuna batɔnkune bani náda anu na baabu-mii lite-mii na banu-mii lɛlɔ aani baƒonu badane babuni kalɛ.

english_verse: You will increase in numbers, and there will be no need to remember the sacred chest or to make a new one.
translation_verse: Bɛdubo bɔwɔ na bimomo na ɔ́sɔ útalɛka bitaakali Bunyimi Adaka ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ iye bɛsu bɛnii bɛɛnwí ɔwɔdi ɔdi.

english_verse: The whole city of Jerusalem will be my throne. All nations will come here to worship me, and they will no longer follow their stubborn, evil hearts.
translation_verse: Yerusalem ɔma ɔmmɔ ɔdubunwini mina lɛga kadikɔ liboku lɛni lɛlɔ na nlie. Na kadi bekyuli ƒui badubo-mi butaabu. Na basɔ balasiaku bana likyulikpi ɔbladu ɔni na bana kɔyi kɔɔtina-ma kama.

english_verse: Then, in countries to the north, you people of Judah and Israel will be reunited, and you will return to the land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Na Yudaƒuɔ ku Israelƒuɔ badubɔsɔ basala babla unwi na kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na bésie bakya na katɔ kakɛ mmɔ. Na basiaku lɛlɔ benwini bebo kalɔ kani líti líte bana bati kuuku mmɔ lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: I have always wanted to treat you as my children and give you the best land, the most beautiful on earth. I wanted you to call me “Father” and not turn from me.
translation_verse: “Ami ɔlati násu nnini, ‘Lɛ́yɔ ka lɛbla-mii mina bebi na lite-mii kalɔ kabunidikɔ ƒui kani mɔɔdia bɔnu teetulo na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.’ Na lɛ́yɔ ka bɛnu-mi bɛti na bɛlɔ-mii bɛnii Ati, na bɛsɔ bilatɔlɔ-mi kudɔ.

english_verse: But instead, you are like a wife who broke her wedding vows. You have been unfaithful to me. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People Confess Their Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nsu bɛ́bla lɛlɔ aani uleku utidi ɔni néni lɛla lɛni na únyimi ku ɔgyani na anwu ku-nwu békulo. Ami Unwoti násu ka bɛ́lɛ-mi kama.” Israelƒuɔ Bédie Bana Alaekpidi Kalɔ

english_verse: Listen to the noise on the hilltops! It's the people of Israel, weeping and begging me to answer their prayers. They forgot about me and chose the wrong path.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Binu lɛsɛ lɛni nda na abi ammɔ eli! Israelƒuɔ na badi na muuwulo taakpali-mii banii nnu-ma bɔkpali. Báyiƒala-mi na béti ulu ukpidi.

english_verse: I will tell them, “Come back, and I will cure you of your unfaithfulness.” They will answer, “We will come back, because you are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: “Ndubo-ma bɔsu nnini, ‘Binwini bibo na lɛbwi-mii, na kalɛ na bɛ́lɛ-mii kama ɔsu.’ “Na mmɔ na badubɔsu banini, ‘Bɔdubunwini bubo, ɔsika awɔ ndi Unwoti bula Katɔti.

english_verse: On hilltops, we worshiped idols and made loud noises, but it was all for nothing— only you can save us.
translation_verse: Bɔ́kpa baƒiɔ na abi ammɔ eli ku kɔvanu momoomo, nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui ukpludi na ɔdi, ɔsika awɔ lɛti kani ndubɔkana ka aƒɔ-bu ngba.

english_verse: Since the days of our ancestors when our nation was young, that shameful god Baal has taken our crops and livestock, our sons and daughters.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si bula bati kuuku uwi ɔni na bɔmu bɔdi banamu ni, Baal baƒiɔ bani na bɔ́kpa na ɔdi kɔƒa ala bɔbla áya na bula edula áyii udu ku bebuo ku bebi bananabi ku belekubi ƒui.

english_verse: We have rebelled against you just like our ancestors, and we are ashamed of our sins.”
translation_verse: Bɔ́ta búnye-ɔ lɛlɔ aani bula bati kuuku kalɛ kani. Na bula alaekpidi eekpó-bu kɔƒa.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, if you really want to come back to me, get rid of those disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Israel kadi bekyuli, si bɛɛyɔ́ ka bɛsɔ binwini bibo-mi kudɔ ni, bɛda atu bidie baƒiɔ bani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ na bibo ala ammɔ biwiakun.

english_verse: Make promises only in my name, and do what you promise! Then all nations will praise me, and I will bless them.
translation_verse: Na bise kenye biala na mina lɛnyi kemmo! Na bɛdi lɛla lɛni kenye na bíse lɛnɔ lɛlɔ! Na kadi bekyuli ƒui badubo-mii buteemwi na lite-mii kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem and Judah, don't be so stubborn! Your hearts have become hard, like unplowed ground where thornbushes grow.
translation_verse: “Amii Yerusalem ku Yuda kadi bekyuli ƒui, bɛda atu ɔkplu ani udu na bɛɛbla mmɔ bɛ́ya! Bina atu kpakplakpa ammɔ áya na bina kayi lɛnɔ kábla kpakplakpa aani kalɔ kani na bétegulu-ka kudii na liyu alakpi sɔɔn áƒɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: With all your hearts, keep the agreement I made with you. But if you are stubborn and keep on sinning, my anger will burn like a fire that cannot be put out. Disaster Is Coming The Lord said: *
translation_verse: Biti bina kayi ƒui biƒie lɛla lɛna na línyimiku-mii ƒui bɛda. Nsu si bítada bina atuɔkplu bítaya na bɛmu binye bɛɛbla ekpidi ni, mina kɔnyi kɔdubo-mii lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na ogya ɔɔkyula lɛla lɛdi na balakana-nwu bunine.” Ɔgbankpi Ɔsia Ulu Ɔdubo

english_verse: Head for Jerusalem or another walled town!’ “Jeremiah, tell them I'm sending disaster from the north.
translation_verse: Biti anumi bɛtina Yerusalem iye ɔma bamba ɔni na bátu bámana-nwu kemmo! Yeremia, aya na bati ka ndubɔya na ɔgbankpi ɔsi kalɔ kammɔ katɔ kakɛ ubo-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: An army will come out, like a lion from its den. It will destroy nations and leave your towns empty and in ruins.”
translation_verse: “Bekpone badi badubɔda babalɛ-mii lɛlɔ aani gyata ɔni nási ɔ́lɛ nwuna lɛtabi ubu kemmo na babakyula kadi bekyuli pii na ɔbwɛ bina lɛma na lɛsɔ liwi ukpludi.

english_verse: Then I told the people of Israel, “Put on sackcloth! Mourn and cry out, ‘The Lord is still angry with us.’ ”
translation_verse: Na Israelƒuɔ ama ni, lɛ́su-ma nnini, ‘Biti kɔnyana ala bɛda! Na biteewulo kanyana ku keku momoomo.’ Ami mɔɔnu ka Unwoti ɔ́mu úti kɔnyi ɔ́kya-bu geen.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “When all this happens, the king and his officials, the prophets and the priests will be shocked and terrified.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Si uwi ɔni na ala amɛni ƒui álɛ lɛni ni, ɔga ku nwuna bakutine ku kenye bediene ku bakpana ƒui badubo butaayia ku liƒu bonwu geen.”

english_verse: I said, “You are the Lord God. So why have you fooled everyone, especially the people of Jerusalem? Why did you promise peace, when a knife is at our throats?” The Coming Disaster
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́su nnini, “Awɔ ndi Unwoti Katɔti. Na bi ɔsu na ése ukyuli biala lisusu, na ɔni ntulo ƒui ndi ƒula kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ lɛnɔ lɛni? Bi ɔsu na ése-bu kenye ka bɔdubɔkɛ keyi buɛɛ na uwi ɔni na kewii nsia-bu ɔkwɛ na badubo-bu bukulo?” Unwoti Ɔ́su Ɔgbankpi Ɔni Ndubo Bɔlɛ

english_verse: When disaster comes, the Lord will tell you people of Jerusalem, “I am sending a windstorm from the desert— not a welcome breeze. And it will sweep you away as punishment for your sins.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ ɔdubo bɔlɛ ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔsu amii Yerusalemƒuɔ ɔnini, “Ndubɔya na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ukpo ɔsi kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ na ɔɔɔdi ƒɛƒɛɛ buɛɛ ɔni muuƒwi aƒata teedie bina kamu kemmo na kakpa. Mmomu ɔdubɔkpala-mii ɔtɔlɔku aani kɔtu bɔni na bina ekpidi ɔsu.

translation_verse: Bɛnu! Aanu bina bekisine bekpone ka bási baayu aani kalɛ na kɔdigbo kɔɔtu taayu lɛla lɛni na uƒie lɛlɔ. Bana bapɔnkɔ ku kɛɛkɛ uukeli usi momoomo teetulo kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa uuminime liƒlukutu na kayaa. Na mmɔ na bɛdubɔsu ku kɔnyana bɛnini, ‘Abu ɔdi ɔ́sa!’

english_verse: But Jerusalem, there is still time for you to be saved. Wash the evil from your hearts and stop making sinful plans,
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Yerusalem, uwi ɔmu ɔkya-mii ka bɛkɛ bɔƒɔ. Bɛƒɔ bina ekpidi ƒui bidie lɛlɔ ku kayi kemmo na bɛda likpidi kakwɛ biala bɔkya bɛya,

english_verse: The Lord said, “Tell the nations that my people have rebelled against me. And so an army will come from far away to surround Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Su kalɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli ka mina kadi bekyuli báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu ndubo bɔya na bekpone basi ɔgyu kakaaka babaka bamana Yerusalem ku Yuda lɛma lɛmmɔ. Ami Unwoti násu.

english_verse: “People of Judah, your hearts will be in pain, but it's your own fault that you will be punished.” Jeremiah's Vision of the Coming Punishment
translation_verse: “Na amii Yudaƒuɔ ni, bɛdubo ɔlɛ bunu geen na kayi kataakpulu-mii, nsu amii alati na ɔ́si ɔsu na badubo-mii kɔtu bɔni lɛni.”

english_verse: I can't stand the pain! My heart pounds, as I twist and turn in agony. I hear the signal trumpet and the battle cry of the enemy, and I cannot be silent.
translation_verse: Naaakana lɛbibo lɛmɛni kenye bunye! Mina utu uubó momoomo geen, na muususu lɛlɔ ku kɔnyana bonwu. Muunú ka bekisine bekpone baavwi kekpo kati bute lise na naaakana kenye bubile bɔsɔ bulie kpoo.

english_verse: I see the enemy defeating us time after time, leaving everything in ruins. Even my own home is destroyed in a moment.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔnu teemene kalɛ na bekisine baadi-bu lɛlɔ taasia kama na beebile lɛla biala. Na mina kaduli muedi bébo-ka bábwɛ ɔni na útaƒɔ uwi ɔdi.

english_verse: How long will I see enemy flags and hear their trumpets?
translation_verse: Uwi ɛlɛ sɔɔn na ndubunye ntaanu bekisi aƒlaga ku bana ese ani na bada baavwi?

english_verse: I heard the Lord say, “My people ignore me. They are foolish children who do not understand that they will be punished. All they know is how to sin.”
translation_verse: Línu ka Unwoti ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Mina bekyuli béni-mi. Bebi badɔlɔdi na badi na baaagyi banii kɔtu bɔni bɔdubo-ma lɛlɔ. Lɛla lɛni kani na bagyi ndi ka belie bataabla ekpidi.”

english_verse: After this, I looked around. The earth was barren, with no form of life. The sun, moon, and stars had disappeared.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama ni, lɛ́nu lɛ́mana kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ na lɛ́nu ka kese ƒue, na alanu ngba lɛla lɛdi na kesii kadi. Ɔƒɛ ku kɔbuli ku ayabi ƒui áyii.

english_verse: The mountains were shaking;
translation_verse: Abi ammɔ aakunku na eesié taasɔ.

translation_verse: Na alánu bekyuli badi na kesii kadi. Na baasɛ bammɔ lɛnɔ ƒui béveyi bátɔlɔ.

english_verse: Farmland had become a desert, and towns were in ruins. The Lord's fierce anger had done all of this. The Death of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Katumalɔ ƒui kénwini kalɔ kakwiidi na lɛma ƒui líbie liwi ukpludi. Kɔnyi kpakplaa kɔni na Unwoti úti ɔsu na ɔmɛni ƒui ɔ́lɛ lɛni. Unwoti Ɔ́ya Na Bádu Yerusalemƒuɔ

english_verse: The Lord said: I have made my decision, and I won't change my mind. This land will be destroyed, although not completely. The sky will turn dark, and the earth will mourn.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Lɛ́ɛbla mina kasusu lɛ́wɔlɔ na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-ka bɔvumana. Kalɔ kamɛni kadubo udu bɔyii, nsu lɛɛɛdubo-ka udu bɔyila ƒui kede kede. Kayaa kadubo bɔbla suu na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui kabla kɔnyana na ɔmmɔ ɔsu.”

english_verse: Enemy cavalry and archers shout their battle cry. People run for their lives and try to find safety among trees and rocks. Every town is empty.
translation_verse: Bekisine bekpone bani muulie bapɔnkɔ ku bani muubó atula beedie bana kekpo lɛnu na bekyuli beekeli taatábɛ na egyii ku atakpɛ kalɔ na báda lɛma béwi ukpludi.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your land has been wiped out. But you act like a prostitute and try to win back your lovers, who now hate you. You can put on a red dress, gold jewelry, and eye shadow, but it's no use— your lovers are out to kill you!
translation_verse: Yerusalem, bákpala lɛla biala bédie ƒula kalɔ lɛlɔ, nsu bɔkɛ kani na akɛ aaví taabla ala aani ɔyalɛ na aawia ka ƒula basɔnɔ kuuku bani muukisi-ɔ ɔƒaamu basɔ benwini bebo-ɔ kudɔ. english_verse: I heard groaning and crying. Was it a woman giving birth to her first child? No, it was Jerusalem, gasping for breath and begging for help. “I'm dying!” she said. “They have murdered me.”
translation_verse: Muunú aani si ukyuli muudumo ku keku. Uleku ɔdi ntɛ kɔkwalawɔ? Oowo, Yerusalem na ɔdi mɔɔnwuna taanɔ na ɔtɛ uuvele ka banu-nwu kɔnyana na ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Bukpi na nda! Bádu-mi.”

english_verse: “Search Jerusalem for honest people who try to be faithful. If you can find even one, I'll forgive the whole city.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Sie na atáwia Yerusalem ƒui na anu si bekyuli badi bakya na baasu litemi geen na baawia ka basiaku-mi kama siin. Na si ákana na ákɛ ukyuli ina unwi ni, ndubuti kɔtu bɔni bɔmmɔ lɛkyiɛ ɔma umodi ɔmmɔ.

translation_verse: Ukyuli biala nése kenye kadi na mina lɛnyi kemmo ni, uládi-ka lɛlɔ.”

translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́su nnini, “Geen ni, ngyi ka awɔ Unwoti aawia ka butaasu litemi geen. Na ɔkɔ bɔnyi bɔmmɔ ɔsu na áni ƒula bekyuli kɔtu, nsu ɔmɛni ƒui atu ɔkplu kani na baabla teebu na bébulo ka bani bede-ɔ.”

english_verse: Then I thought to myself, “These common people act like fools, and they have never learned what the Lord their God demands of them.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́bla kasusu nnini, “Bekyuli keeke bani mɔɔyaki ala na bádɔlɔ badi. Na balanu lɛla lɛni na bana Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔwia taasiku-ma kudɔ bati.

translation_verse: Ndubusie ntátɛmiku batɔnkune bammɔ, ɔsika ama bagyi lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔɔwia ka babla, nsu ama muedi béni na bálɛ ugyii ka belénu Unwoti litemi.

translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ báta bénye Unwoti lɛlɔ na béni-nwu kɔlɛ kɔlɛ na ɔ́ɔvi ntu. english_verse: People of Judah, how can I forgive you? I gave you everything, but you abandoned me and worshiped idols. You men go to prostitutes and are unfaithful to your wives.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Amii Yudaƒuɔ, dɛ na ndubɔkana na liti bina kɔtu bɔni lɛkyie-mii? Líte-mii lɛla biala na bɛɛwia, nsu bíni-mi na bísie bɛɛkpá baƒiɔ. Amii banana bɛ́lɛ bina beleku kama na bísie bɛsiaku bayalɛ.

english_verse: You are no better than animals, and you always want sex with someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Bítavumana ku bebuo, ɔsika lɛlɔ bɔtɛnku bɔmmɔ kani kasusu nkya-mii na biisié bekyuli bamba beleku kudɔ.

translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na útalɛka lɛni Yuda kadi bekyuli kɔtu?

translation_verse: Yuda ku Israel bálɛ-mi kama ulu biala lɛlɔ.’

translation_verse: “Bana kenye bediene baanyi ɔkɔ taasu banini, ‘Unwoti ɔɔɔdubo-bu kɔtu bɔni. Na bɔdubo bulie na atu bɔyɔ kemmo na bulayaki adila lɛnɔ.’

english_verse: They tell these lies in my name, so now they will be killed in war or starve to death.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ ɔmɛni udu na baanyi taatɔlɔ bekyuli na mina lɛnyi kemmo. Anwuɔsu ɔƒaamu badubo bukpi na kekpokɔ iye kɔka kɔdu-ma.

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful. Jeremiah, I will tell you exactly what to say. Your words will be a fire; Israel and Judah will be the fuel.
translation_verse: “Yeremia, ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui, na lɛla lɛni geen na mɔɔwia ka asu ni, ndubo-ɔ lɛla lɛmmɔ bɔsu. Ƒula etemila adubo buse aani ogya kalɛ na Yuda ku Israel badubo buse aani ekyweni.

english_verse: People of Israel, I have made my decision. An army from a distant country will attack you. I've chosen an ancient nation, and you won't understand their language.
translation_verse: Binu amii Israel kadi bekyuli, lɛ́ɛbla mina kasusu líse. Na bekpone badubo bɔsi kalɔ ɔgyu kakaaka bebo na bebekpo-mii. Na bekyuli bammɔ badi bekyuli bani lɛdi na bilenu na bakya ɔ́si kukuuku.

english_verse: All of them are warriors, and their arrows bring death.

translation_verse: Na bani ndubo bubu bulie ngba badubuye banini, ‘Bi ɔsu na Unwoti, bula Katɔti, ɔ́bla lɛla linengudi lɛni muukpóku-bu mɛni udu?’ Na adubudie-mi kenye asu anini, ‘Ami ndi Unwoti, nsu bíni-mi na bísie bítétiku baƒiɔ bamba bíbo bɛɛkpá na amii alati bina kalɔ. english_verse: Tell these things to each other, you people of Judah, you descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: “Amii Yudaƒuɔ bani ɔti kuuku ndi Yakob bibo ɔmɛni kudu bite lɛlɔ na ukyuli biala unu.

english_verse: You fools! Why don't you listen when I speak? Why can't you understand
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na bilenu ala kalɔ si mɔɔtɛmiku-mii, amii badɔlɔdi?

english_verse: You stubborn people have rebelled and turned your backs on me.
translation_verse: Amii batuɔkplune bɛ́ta bínye-mi lɛlɔ na bínwini kama bɛ́kya-mi.

english_verse: You refuse to say, “Let's worship the Lord! He's the one who sends rain in spring and autumn and gives us a good harvest.”
translation_verse: Bíbulo bɔsu bɛnini, ‘Bɛya na bɔbu Unwoti! Anwu ndi ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyá na ketudi ɔnantu ku kaƒɛndi ɔnantu ɔɔna teete-bu. Na ɔɔyá na edula aadia-bu na bɔƒɛ.’

translation_verse: Bibo likyulikpi na bɛɛnyi ɔkɔ na bɛɛnya bekyuli taakya kalɛ na amii binwini balakɛne na bɛɛdi-ma lɛlɔ ku ɔyikun

translation_verse: Ƒula kɔnyi kɔni na ákɛku Yudaƒuɔ ɔ́ya na mina lɛlɔ kemmo kaada aani ogya, na nsɔ naaakana ɔkplu bɔkya, na ɔmmɔ ɔsɔ ɔkya-mi lɛlɔ kemmo lɛni.” Unwoti Kɔnyi Kɔdubo Ukyuli Biala Lɛlɔ Unwoti ɔnini, “Tetile-mi kɔnyi ulu! Ya na kubo bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ, banamu bani nli kaƒiakɔ ku benengu ku bakɔdi ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I'll punish the people of Judah and give to others their houses and fields, as well as their wives. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ndubo Yudaƒuɔ kɔtu bɔni na liti bana kɔduli ku mmo lite bekyuli bamba ku bana beleku ƒui. Ami Unwoti násu.

english_verse: Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: “Bawabane ku balakɛne ƒui ɔdivo bɔdi ku litemi geen tasu kani náƒɔ bana ƒui lɛlɔ kemmo. Na kenye bediene ku bakpane muedi baaadi bekyuli bani na basɔ beti kayi basia.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Na kayi kekpludi kani na beesé mina bekyuli bani muunú ɔlɛ geen ka keyi kadubɔyɔku-ma.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of their disgusting sins, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Rejected God's Way of Life
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka kɔƒa kuteekpo-ma na bana ekpidi ani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔsu. Nsu bana anumi aláƒalɛ lɛla lɛdi munu munu. Anwuɔsu si nnii mɔɔní Yudaƒuɔ kɔtu ni, bana kɔwɔlɔkɔ ndi kukpi na bana ƒui badubo bubuli bɔtɛ kalɔ na bekpi ƒui aani bekyuli bamba kalɛ. Ami Unwoti násu.” Yudaƒuɔ Béni Katɔti Ulu Ɔni Na Ɔɔtina
