english_verse: The Lord said: My people, when you stood at the crossroads, I told you, “Follow the road your ancestors took, and you will find peace.” But you refused.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Uwi ɔni na bísie bítédu elukpo ni, lɛ́su-mii nnii, ‘Bɛsia ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na bina bati kuuku básia na bɛdubulie ku keyi buɛɛ.’ Nsu bíni.

english_verse: I also sent prophets to warn you of danger, but when they sounded the alarm, you paid no attention.
translation_verse: Na lɛnɔ ni, lɛ́tala kenye bediene lɛ́kya-mii nnii babalɛ-mii kpakplaa na ɔgbankpi ɔni ndububo-mii lɛlɔ lɛlɔ. Nsu uwi ɔni na beebó kudu ka binu-ma kenye kani na badanku ni, bítese atu.

english_verse: So I tell all nations on earth, “Watch what I will do!
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu lɛ́su kadi bekyuli ƒui nnini, ‘Bitaanu lɛla lɛni na ndubo bɔbla!

english_verse: My people ignored me and rejected my laws. They planned to do evil, and now the evil they planned will happen to them.”
translation_verse: Mina bekyuli bédie-mi atu na béni mina ɔda bubo. Bábla kasusu ka bataabla likpidi. Na ɔƒaani ni, likpidi kɔkwɛ ala ani na bábla ala ndubo-ma bɔlɛku.

english_verse: People of Judah, you bring me incense from Sheba and spices from distant lands. You offer sacrifices of all kinds. But why bother? I hate these gifts of yours!
translation_verse: Amii Yudaƒuɔ, bɛda oloƒui bɛ́siku Seeba kalɔ lɛlɔ bíboku-mi ku kutu akyala ƒɛƒɛɛ ani na bɛ́siku kalɔ ɔgyu kakaaka bíboku-mi. Na bɛɛbla akpala lidu lidu lɛnɔ. Nsu bi ɔsu na binye biikpóku lɛlɔ lɛni? Bina etela ammɔ ƒui adi ala ani muusé-mi lɛlɔ na muukisi-nya geen!

english_verse: So I will put stumbling blocks in your path, and everyone will die, including parents and children, neighbors and friends. An Army from the North
translation_verse: “ ‘Anwuɔsu ndubo ala buti bɔda-mii ulu lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli biala ɔdubo bukpi amii bawɔne ku bebi ƒui ku badukɛne ku bakpana ƒui.’ ” Bekpone Bási Kalɔ Kammɔ Katɔ Kakɛ Bébo

english_verse: The Lord said, “Look toward the north, where a powerful nation has prepared for war.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Ɔ́si ɔgyu kakaaka na kalɔ kammɔ katɔ kakɛ ni, kadi bekyuli bayikune badi báata bátu akpagya na benye kagyumana ka bebekpo.

english_verse: Its well-armed troops are cruel and never show mercy. Their galloping horses sound like ocean waves pounding on the shore. This army will attack you, lovely Jerusalem.”
translation_verse: Bátu akpagya kaduɛ na bebo kalala na balánu kɔnyana. Na bana bapɔnkɔ bani mɔɔƒulu kɔku kuse aani kalɛ na ɛpu uubó ku kɔku teebewi utubli. Yerusalem ɔbuni, bekpone bamɛni badubo-ɔ bukpoku.”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Just hearing about them makes us tremble with fear, and we twist and turn in pain like a woman giving birth.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bekyuli bammɔ básu banini, “Ɔni na búnu-ma kɔku kani na bula lɛlɔ kemmo kése kalɔ kaatɔ́ ku liƒu na bunye buuliiku lɛlɔ aani uleku ɔni ntɛ kɔwɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Don't work in your fields or walk along the roads. It's too dangerous. The enemy is well armed
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Bitesie bina mmo bɛnii bitátuma iye bɛkɛ ulu lɛlɔ bitaavi muedi, amu bɛdubuduo ɔgbankpi kemmo ɔƒɛni kani. Bina bekisine bátu akpagya geen bakɛ kesi kesii.

english_verse: and attacks without warning. So mourn, my people, as though your only child had died. Wear clothes made of sackcloth and roll in the ash pile.” The Lord's People Must Be Tested The Lord said:
translation_verse: Beeyú bekyuli teekpoku-ma ɔni na baaagyi beeese. Anwuɔsu ni, mina bekyuli, bise kalɔ biteewulo kɔnyana ku keku aani si bina ubi unwi pɛ ɔdi nékpi. Na bɛda lɛlɔ ku ala ani mɔɔtina ka biiwulo kɔnyana na bɛtɛ biteebo teeminime ntɔ akɔ.” Unwoti Ɔdubɔkɔku Nwuna Bekyuli Ɔnu

english_verse: Jeremiah, test my people as though they were metal.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Yeremia, tákɔku mina bekyuli nu aani kalɛ na baanu lɛbuala bɔdia.

english_verse: And you'll find they are hard like bronze and iron. They are stubborn rebels, always spreading lies. *
translation_verse: Na adubɔnu ka bebo ɔkplu geen aani abuala egyiedi ku atonwudi. Na badi bekyuli bani mɔɔta teenye-mi lɛlɔ na ɔkɔ kani na baanyi uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Silver can be purified in a fiery furnace, but my people are too wicked to be made pure, and so I have rejected them.
translation_verse: Nsu mina bekyuli bebo kalala geen ɔni na basɔ balakana bɔbla sɛɛn. Anwuɔsu líni-ma.”

english_verse: But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were! Slaughter Valley The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nsu béni-mi na bébenwini batuɔkplune ku ekpidi bablane bétulo bana bati kuuku bammɔ muedi!” Bekyuli Badubo Bukpi Buwi Kɔwɛ Kemmo

english_verse: Stop taking advantage of foreigners, orphans, and widows. Don't kill innocent people. And stop worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Bɛda kasiakɔ bɔkɛ na baƒɔ ku bekpinebi ku bekpinele lɛlɔ bɛya. Na bɛda bekyuli bani na bátabla-mii lɛla lɛdi bɔdu bɛya. Na bɛda baƒiɔ bɔkpa bɛya.

english_verse: The Lord told me to stand by the gate of the temple and tell the people who were going in that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: Pay attention, people of Judah! Change your ways and start living right, then I will let you keep on living in your own country.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nsɔ nnye nwuna kakpakɔ kayakun kenye na lɛsu bekyuli bani muuduo ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo ka anwu Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui Israel Katɔti ɔnini, “Bise atu na binu, amii Yudaƒuɔ! Bɛvumana bina ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na bɛɛsia taabla ala. Na bise kalɔ biteelie ngba bɔbuni. Ɔmmɔ ndubɔya-mi na lɛya bɛsɔ bilie bina kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ biteesie.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! My temple is here in Jerusalem, but that doesn't mean I will protect you.
translation_verse: Bitese lɛlɔ lisusu! Ina ka Yerusalem mɛni na mina ɔtɔ unye ni, ɔɔɔdi ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bitaakali bɛnii ndubo-mii bɔgyumana.

english_verse: I will keep you safe only if you change your ways and are fair and honest with each other.
translation_verse: Ndubɔya na bɛkɛ bɔƒɔ si bɛvumana udu na bɛɛnu bina lɛlɔ kɔnyana na bɛɛbla ala ulu lɛlɔ siin na bɛɛtɛmi litemi geen.

english_verse: Then I will let you enjoy a long life in this land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔya na bilie ngba gyɔlɔɔ na kalɔ na líti líte bina bati kuuku mɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But just look at what is happening! You put your trust in worthless lies.
translation_verse: Nsu amii alati bɛnu lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ ɔƒɛni! Bíti bina kayi ƒui bɛ́sia ɔkɔ bɔnyi ku ala ani neeebo kɔsia kɔdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You steal and murder; you lie in court and are unfaithful in marriage. You worship idols and offer incense to Baal, when these gods have never done anything for you.
translation_verse: “Biiyú ala na bɛɛdú bekyuli na bɛɛnyi ɔkɔ na litemi katɛkɔ na bɛɛlɛ́ lɛlɔ kama na bina kɔgya ku ule ngba kemmo. Bɛɛkpá Baal baƒiɔ na bɛɛkyula oloƒui teete-nwu na uwi ɔni na baƒiɔ bamɛni ɔdi útabla lɛla lɛdi útete-mii kudii.

english_verse: And then you come into my temple and worship me! Do you think I will protect you so that you can go on sinning?
translation_verse: Na nwuna kama na bɛsɔ bibeduo mina kakpakɔ kemmo bɛnii ami na bíbo bibakpa! Bɛɛkali ndubo-mii bɔgyumana na binye bitaabla ekpidi amɛni udu?

english_verse: You are thieves, and you have made my temple your hideout. But I've seen everything you have done.
translation_verse: Beyu na bɛdi na bíti mina kakpakɔ bínwini bina kabɛkɔ. Nsu lɛ́nu ala ani ƒui na bɛ́bla.

english_verse: Go to Shiloh, where my sacred tent once stood. Take a look at what I did there. My people Israel sinned, and so I destroyed Shiloh!
translation_verse: “Bisie Silo kesii kani na mina Adi Kevo kedee kénye dii na bɛsia ala ani na lɛ́bla mmɔ anu. Mina kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ báƒiɔ-mi, anwuɔsu lɛ́kyula Silo ɔma ɔmmɔ ƒui!

english_verse: While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔni ƒui na bɛ́kya bitaabla ekpidi ni, mɔɔsia ulu biala lɛlɔ taatɛmiku-mii. Nsu bíni na bítenu-mi litemi.

english_verse: Don't think this temple will protect you. Long ago I told your ancestors to build it and worship me here, but now I have decided to tear it down, just as I destroyed Shiloh.
translation_verse: Bitakali bɛnii kakpakɔ kamɛni kadubo-mii bɔgyumana. Bina bati kuuku uwi ƒui na lɛ́su-ma nnii batu-ka na bataakpa-mi na mɛni. Nsu ɔƒaani ni, lɛ́bla kasusu ka lɛbwɛ kakpakɔ kammɔ na kayii udu aani kalɔ na lɛ́yila Silo ɔma udu.

english_verse: And as for you, people of Judah, I'm going to send you away from my land, just as I sent away the people of Ephraim and the other northern tribes. Punishment for Worshiping Other Gods
translation_verse: Na amii Yudaƒuɔ amii ni, ndubo-mii bɔbɔku bɔlɛku mina kalɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na lɛ́bɔku Eƒraim kɔdua bekyuli ku adua bamba ani na akya kalɔ kammɔ katɔ kakɛ mmɔ. Báni Israel Ku Yuda Kɔtu Na Lɛƒiɔkpa Ɔsu

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people! I, the Lord, would refuse to listen.
translation_verse: “Yeremia, takpali-mi tevele na bekyuli bamɛni lili! Ami Unwoti lɛɛɛdubo bunu.

english_verse: Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translation_verse: Alánu ala ani na Yudaƒuɔ baabla na bana lɛma kemmo ku Yerusalem lɛblɔnu lɛlɔ?

english_verse: Children gather firewood, their fathers build fires, and their mothers mix dough to bake bread for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They even offer wine sacrifices to other gods, just to insult me.
translation_verse: Bebi baayɔ́ ekyweni na bana bati baasala ogya na bana beni baanwu ɔlaaƒɔ ɔni na beeti teeƒi bodobodo ɔni na beeti taatákpa bana baƒiɔ beledi bani na baalɔ bani Katɔ Uleku Ɔga. Na beeti ntɛ taatákpa baƒiɔ bamba lɛnɔ kalɛ kani na beti bedumi-mi.

english_verse: But they are not only insulting me; they are also harming themselves by doing these shameful things.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔɔɔdi ami lɛti na beedumi mmomu beedumi ama alati lɛlɔ lɛnɔ na kɔƒa ala ani na baabla mɛni ɔsu.

english_verse: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops. It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
translation_verse: “Na ɔƒaani ni, ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ndubɔya na mina kɔnyi kubo-ma lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na ketu keeyi teedie ukyuli útédu uwi ɔni na bekyuli o-o, bebuo o-o, egyii o-o, edula o-o ni, lɛla biala lɛsɔ lilébu lilakya kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ.” Kɔsia Kuuubo Akpala Bɔbla Kemmo

english_verse: The Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, but I won't accept sacrifices from you. So don't even bother bringing them to me. You might as well just cook the meat for yourselves.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii ntásu Yudaƒuɔ ɔnini, “Ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, nsu lɛɛɛdubo akpala adi bɔƒɔ bɔsiku-mii kudɔ. Anwuɔsu bitekpoku lɛlɔ muedi bɛnii biiti adi biboku-mi. Amii alati biƒulo bina lɛna bɛkun.

english_verse: At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔni na lɛ́kpanku bina bati kuuku lɛ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, ńtebo-ma ɔda ɔdi nnii babla akpala adi bete-mi lɛti.

english_verse: Instead, I told them, “If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.”
translation_verse: Mmomu bɔsu na lɛ́su-ma lɛnɔ ndi, ‘Si bínu-mi litemi na bɛ́bla bɛ́siaku ala ani na lɛ́su-mii lɛlɔ ni, ndubɔbla bina Katɔti na amii bɛbla mina bekyuli, na lɛla biala lɛdubɔtɛ lite-mii.’

english_verse: But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other.
translation_verse: Nsu bina bati kuuku béni na bétenu-mi litemi. Bábla atuɔkplu. Na si ami líti-ma mɔɔsiaku ulu ɔdi ni, na ama beti ɔbambadi.

english_verse: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si uwi ɔni ƒui na bina bati kuuku bátɔlɔ Egyipte ni, uwi ɔmmɔ kani lɛlɔ na mɔɔtala mina kabla bablane kenye bediene taakya-ma nnii babatɛmiku-ma.

english_verse: Jeremiah, no matter what you do, the people won't listen.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Yeremia, ina bi na ábla ni, bekyuli bammɔ baaadubo litemi bunu.

english_verse: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu su-ma anini, ‘Yuda kadi bekyuli, ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti, nsu bíni na bítadi mina litemi lɛlɔ. Na ɔni na lɛ́ni-mii kɔtu muedi bíbulo na bítavumana udu. Na bilábla taatina na anumi kemmo muedi ka bɛsiaku-mi kama siin.

english_verse: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.
translation_verse: Bikpeyi bina eli ƒui na bibo linwini lɛmmɔ biwiakun. Na bɛkɔ bisie abi ani nwi ukpludi mmɔ eli ɔtantɛ ƒui na biteedie lɛkwanu. Ɔsika bɛ́kya-mi kɔnyi na líni-mii ƒui.

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bítadi mina litemi lɛlɔ na uwi ɔni na bíti bina baƒiɔ bani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ bíbese-mi kakpakɔ na bɛ́ya na kakpakɔ kemodi kammɔ keesé-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.
translation_verse: Bɛ́tu akpabi bɛ́lɛ Toƒet na Hinom Kɔwɛ kemmo kesii kani na bɛɛdú bina bebi taakyula taabla akpala teete baƒiɔ. Na ami lɛɛɛdubo kasusu bɔbla nnii mɔɔsu-mii na bɛbla lɛla lɛmɛni udu.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu binye kagyumana na bitaanu ulu ka Limeyi lɛdi lɛdubo ɔni na bɛsɔ bɛɛɛdubo mmɔ bɔlɔ bɛnii Toƒet iye Ben-Hinom Kɔwɛ mmomu Bekpine Kɔwɛ. Ɔsika bɛdubo bina bekpine bɔva mmɔ laa butédu ka kesii kani na bɛkɛ bɛva bekyuli bakladi muedi bɛsɔ bilákɛ.

english_verse: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.
translation_verse: Na buwi kani na bekpine badubo buwi kalɔkplu bɔka bɔmana. Na baasɛ ku beƒiebuo badubo babakun bana lɛna lɛmmɔ na ukyuli biala ulenye mmɔ na ɔbɔku-ma ɔtɔlɔku.

english_verse: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na lɛ́wɔlɔku bina kalɔ lɛni lɛ́wɔlɔ ni, mmɔ kadubo bɔba mana mana aani kekpine na kesii kani na líbile lɛla biala na Yerusalem mmɔ ku Yuda lɛma lɛmmɔ ƒui kemmo. Na lɛlɔyɔ kɔku kɔdi kɔsɔ kulakya mmɔ iye limeyi bɔdi ku beleku buti ablala adi lɛnɔ asɔ alakya mmɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem
translation_verse: “Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, badubuku Yudaƒuɔ baga ekubi ku bana lɛku batine ku bakpane ku kenye bediene bedie kalɔ kemmo mmɔ ku bekyuli bamba ƒui bani nkya Yerusalem.

english_verse: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
translation_verse: Na badubugyingya bana ekubi ammɔ bewi kalɔ mmɔ bamana na kesii kani na ɔƒɛ ku kɔbuli ku ayabi ammɔ ataalɛ teewi-nya, ɔsika anya na bátaakpa.

english_verse: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken. The People Took the Wrong Road
translation_verse: “Amii Yudaƒuɔ kadi bekyuli badi bɛdubo bubu bulie ngba, nsu ndubunye-mii lɛlɔ na beƒie-mii besienku baƒɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui násu kenye kamɛni.” Bekyuli Bammɔ Basia Ulu Ukpidi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Jerusalem, when you stumble and fall, you get back up, and if you take a wrong road, you turn around and go back.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Amii Yerusalemƒuɔ, si ukyuli útulo na úbuli ni, bɔta na ɔsɔ ɔɔta. Na si ulu ukpidi lɛlɔ na ɔ́sia úsela ni, bunwini na uunwíni kama.

english_verse: So why do you refuse to come back to me? Why do you hold so tightly to your false gods?
translation_verse: Na bi ɔsu na amii bíni bɛnii bilasɔ bilénwini bilebo-mi kudɔ? Na bɛmu bɛsiaku bina baƒiɔ kpakplaa lɛni?

english_verse: I listen carefully, but none of you admit that you've done wrong. Without a second thought, you run down the wrong road like horses running blindly into battle.
translation_verse: Mɔɔsia-mii atu geen na ɔdi biala ulaƒɔ enu ɔnii bɛ́bla likpidi. Na bɛ́sɔ bítabla kasusu biala bítasia kama asa na bínwini bɛ́sia ulu ukpidi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ bísela aani bekpone bani nlie ɔpɔnkɔ lɛlɔ na bábi basiaku bana bekisine na kekpokɔ.

english_verse: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.
translation_verse: Betusɛ ku babloduma ku bakpaƒɛɛlɛ ku baasɛ bamba bagyi uwi ɔni na beeveyi taatɔlɔ na beekeli kɔyɔ uwi ku uwi na bɔsɔ benwini bebo. Nsu amii mina bekyuli bɛɛɛgyi lɛla lɛni mɔɔwia ka bɛbla.

english_verse: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
translation_verse: “Bɛɛsu bɛnini, ‘Bɔ́da anu, ɔsika bula enu kemmo na Unwoti ala ani na ɔɔtina ku nwuna ɔda bubo ƒui bɔkya.’ Nsu mɔɔyá na bɛti ka bina ala batinane ƒui bátu mina etemila bénwini ɔkɔ ala!

english_verse: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.
translation_verse: Bina banundane béni mina etemila ani na lɛ́su, anwuɔsu basɔ beeebo lɛnunda lɛdi. Na ala ényimi-ma na kɔƒa kuukpó-ma na basɔ baaagyi lɛla lɛni na babla.

english_verse: I'll give their wives and fields to strangers. Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: Ndubo bana beleku ku mmo ƒui buti bute baƒɔ. Balakɛne ku bawabane, na kenye bediene ku bakpane ƒui basɔ baaadi bekyuli bani lɛlɔ na beti anumi basia. Bana ƒui bénwini badivone ku ɔkɔ banyine.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni kani na baakana mina bekyuli bani na ala eekpóku bɔsu ndi ka bese-ma kayi kekpludi ka badubɔkɛ keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka nka kɔƒa kukpo-ma na bana alaekpidi ani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔsu, nsu bana anumi aláƒalɛ muedi. Anwuɔsu si lɛ́ni Yuda kɔtu ama ɔdi ɔdubo bɔsa na bekpi aani kalɛ na bekyuli bamba lɛnɔ beekpi na beduo kubiɔ.

english_verse: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
translation_verse: “Ndubo-ma udu bɔyila budie kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui. Ɔsika bese aani egyiibi kɔbuli kɔni lɛlɔ na egyiibi aaasia iye kɔnwingyie kɔni lɛlɔ na ebi iye evete aaasia. Na ala ani na lɛ́su-ma ƒui bátabla ɔdi! Ami Unwoti násu lɛni.” Unwoti Ɔ́ni Bekyuli Bammɔ Kɔtu

english_verse: The people of Judah say to each other, “What are we waiting for? Let's run to a town with walls and die there. We rebelled against the Lord, and we were sentenced to die by drinking poison.
translation_verse: Yudaƒuɔ básu lɛlɔ banini, “Bi ɔsu na bɔ́sɔ bunye bɔɔnu? Bɛya na bukeli buteesie lɛma lɛni na bátu bámana-ni kemmo na butékpi na mmɔ. Bɔ́ta búnye Unwoti lɛlɔ na bádu-bu kɔtɔ banii bɔni ugyulo ukpidi na bukpi.

english_verse: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Bula anu asia ka bɔdubɔkɛ keyi buɛɛ na bɔnwanya bɔsiku lɛlɛ lɛni na buuƒi kudɔ. Nsu liƒu ku agyala kani mɔɔsiáku-bu.

english_verse: Our enemies have reached the town of Dan in the north, and the snorting of their horses makes us tremble with fear. The enemy will destroy Jerusalem and our entire nation. No one will survive.”
translation_verse: Bula bekisine béedu ɔma ɔnii baalɔ Dan na kalɔ kammɔ katɔ kakɛ na buunú kalɛ na bana bapɔnkɔ beeƒwi ala taalɛku bana enwu kemmo ku kɔnyi na baayá na bɔɔyia geen. Bekisine bammɔ badubo Yerusalem bɔbwɛ na bebile kalɔ kammɔ ƒui na ɔdi ɔsɔ ulébu ulelie ngba.”

english_verse: “Watch out!” the Lord says. “I'm sending poisonous snakes to attack you, and no one can stop them.” Jeremiah Mourns for His People
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Binye kagyumana, ɔsika ndubo bɔya na balakpi bekpidi bebo babadu-mii na ɔdi ulakana-ma kuƒi butile.” Yeremia Úwulo Kɔnyana Na Nwuna Bekyuli Lili

english_verse: I'm burdened with sorrow and feel like giving up.
translation_verse: Kayi kaakpulu-mi geen aani ala na nti mɔɔnɔ na mɔɔyɔ́ lite lili.

english_verse: In a foreign land my people are crying. Listen! You'll hear them say, “Has the Lord deserted Zion? Is he no longer its king?” I hear the Lord reply, “Why did you make me angry by worshiping useless idols?”
translation_verse: Mina bekyuli bakya kaƒɔ lɛma beewulo keku. Nu kalɛ na beewulo teeye banini, “Buni na Unwoti úni Sion na ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdi nwuna ɔga?” Na muunú ka Unwoti uudie kenye ɔnini, “Bi ɔsu na bɛ́kya-mi kɔnyi na uwi na bina baƒiɔ bani neeebo kɔsia bɔkpa ɔsu?”

english_verse: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni baadɔ taasu banini, “Edula ɔkyawi ku liwulu uwi úubo úbavi, na Unwoti útedie-bu.”

english_verse: My people are crushed, and so is my heart. I am horrified and mourn.
translation_verse: Mina bekyuli lɛnunsia ƒui líbie. Na lɛni kani na use ami lɛnɔ na mina kayi kemmo. Na liƒu líduo-mi na muuwulo kɔnyana.

english_verse: If medicine and doctors may be found in Gilead, why aren't my people healed?
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na balábwi mina bekyuli si evogyii ku ana bablane bakya Gilead?

english_verse: I wish that my eyes were fountains of tears, so I could cry day and night for my people who were killed.
translation_verse: Si bunwini na mina anumi enwini imii ku libiɔ na nteewulo usien ku ɔƒɛ na mina bekyuli bani na bádu ɔsu nka ɔdia-mi.

english_verse: I wish I could go into the desert and find a hiding place from all who are treacherous and unfaithful to God. The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Na si busie na ndubɔkana na lisie kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ ntábɛ, na lɛlɛ bekyuli bekpidi bamɛni akɔ ɔkɔ banyine bani naaasiaku Katɔti kama siin kudɔ nka ndubɔyɔ. Unwoti Údie Yeremia Lɛla Lɛni Na Ɔ́su Kenye

english_verse: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Ɔkɔ etemila aalɛ́ mina bekyuli kenye aani kalɛ na beebó atula taalɛku kataminta kemmo. Na ɔkɔ ala bɔbla ɔyikun kani mɔɔkɔ́-ma katɔ na ɔdi ulaƒɔ enu taasu ɔnii ami ndi Katɔti.

english_verse: Jeremiah, all your friends and relatives tell lies about you, so don't trust them.
translation_verse: “Yeremia, ɔkɔ etemila kani na ƒula bakpana ku lɛlɔ bekyuli ƒui baasu taasiku-ɔ lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu teti ƒula anu tasia-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They wear themselves out, always looking for a new way to cheat their friends.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ kani na bakɛ beetú taavi uwi ƒui taawia ulu bamba ɔni lɛlɔ na basia banya bana bakpana bakya.

english_verse: Everyone takes advantage of everyone else, and no one will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔɔwia ka ɔkɛ ɔkpanadi lɛlɔ kɔsia. Na ɔdi biala uláwia ka ɔƒɔ enu ɔnii ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: And so I will purify the hearts of my people just as gold is purified in a furnace. I have no other choice.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu ndubo mina bekyuli kɔnyi bukpo na lɛƒɔ-ku lɛbla sɛɛn aani kalɛ na baakya sika ugyiedi ogya kemmo taaƒɔ-nwu na ɔɔbla sɛɛn. Nsɔ liiibo ulu bamba ɔdi lɛlɔ na ndubo bɔsia.

english_verse: They say they want peace, but this lie is deadly, like an arrow that strikes when you least expect it.
translation_verse: Bani baawia keyi buɛɛ, nsu bana ɔkɔ ɔni na baanyi kenye kebo ɔbi na ɔɔdú ukyuli teetulo lɛtula lɛni na beebó taalɛ ukyuli na ɔɔɔgyi uuuse.

english_verse: Give me one good reason not to punish them as they deserve. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah Weeps for His People
translation_verse: Lɛ lɛla lɛdi lɛnumi te-mi na ɔdi kasusu kabuni kani ɔsu na bekyuli bamɛni bátamanku kɔtu bɔni? Ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui nátɛmi. Yeremia Úwulo Na Nwuna Bekyuli Lili

english_verse: I weep for the pastureland in the hill country. It's so barren and scorched that no one travels there. No cattle can be found there, and birds and wild animals have all disappeared.
translation_verse: “Muuwulo teete bebuo kadikɔ kani na kakya abi lɛlɔ. Likpo lɛmmɔ lɛ́kwii na livo lɛbuni lɛdi lɛsɔ liiibo mmɔ, ɔsika ɔƒɛ ɔ́kyula lɛla biala na belusiene muedi basɔ balásia mmɔ. Na Ɔmantɛ bebuo ku alakpi akɔ bebuo ku baasɛ ƒui báyii na badi basɔ beeebo mmɔ.”

english_verse: I heard the Lord reply, “When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.” Why the Land Was Destroyed
translation_verse: Línu ka Unwoti uudie kenye ɔnini, “Si uwi ɔni na lɛ́wɔlɔ ku Yerusalem ku Yuda lɛma ƒui ni, mmɔ kadubɔsɔ kewi ukpludi aani alakpi lisu kesii kani na beƒukutu kani ndubo mmɔ bulie.” Unwoti Ɔ́kyula Nwuna Kadi Bekyuli Kalɔ Na Bana Ekpidi Ɔsu

english_verse: I said to the Lord, “None of us can understand why the land has become like an uncrossable desert. Won't you explain why?”
translation_verse: Lɛ́su Unwoti nnini, “Bula ɔdi ulénu kalɔ lɛla lɛni ɔsu na kalɔ kammɔ kénwini kesii kani na ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ ulásia taavi lɛnɔ. Ɔdubɔkana na edie kalɔ ete-bu?”

english_verse: The Lord said: I destroyed the land because the people disobeyed me and rejected my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔnini, “Líbile kalɔ kammɔ na káyii udu, ɔsika bekyuli bammɔ bátadi mina litemi lɛlɔ na béni mina ɔda bubo ku ala ani na mɔɔtina-ma.

english_verse: They were stubborn and worshiped Baal, just as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: Bábla atuɔkplu na bakya baakpá Baal baƒiɔ aani kalɛ na bana bati kuuku bábla.

english_verse: So I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, promise them poison to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, líse kenye ka ndubo-a ugyulo ukpidi bute na bani na libile adila lite-ma na badi likpila.

english_verse: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them. The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
translation_verse: Na ndubo-ma bugyingya bɔkya na lɛbɔku-ma ntákya kaƒɔ kakaaka kesii kani kɔku na ama ku bana bati kuuku bétenu kudii. Na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, ndubo bɔya na bana bekisine bekpone bebo babadu bana bekplodi ɛlɛɛ bani mebu.” Beleku Badi Benye Bete Kekwa Kalɔ Keku Buwulone Na Baƒɔ-ma Kayu

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said, “Make arrangements now for the women who are paid to weep at funerals, especially the women who can cry the loudest.”
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔnini, “Bɛtala na betétiku beleku bani mɔɔtu lɛkwanu teewulo keku na baƒɔ-ma kayu na bebo. Na bɛwia bani geen na ngyi-nwu kemmo kaduɛ mmɔ.

english_verse: The people answered, “Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bammɔ lɛnɔ bátuna kɔnakunwi banini, ‘Bɛya na beyile bubo na bebewulo bete-bu utédu uwi ɔni na abu lɛnɔ bula anumi adubɔƒɔ imii.’

english_verse: Now those of us on Zion cry, ‘We are ruined! We can't stand the shame. Our homes have been destroyed, and we must leave our land.’
translation_verse: Bɛya na abu bani nkya Sion buteewulo momoomo na bɔsu bɔnii, ‘Bɔ́yii udu ɔƒaamu! Na bulakana kɔƒa kɔmɛni udu kenye bunye. Ɔsika bábwɛ-bu kɔduli ƒui na bábɔku-bu bálɛku bula kalɔ lɛlɔ.’ ”

english_verse: “We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:
translation_verse: Na buuvele amii beleku bani muudie lɛnu lɛmmɔ bɔnii bɛsia lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su anu kaduɛ. Na bɔdubɔtina-mii ɔkwanu ɔni na bɛdubuti bɛtina bina bebi belekubi ku bakpana.

english_verse: ‘We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.’
translation_verse: Bɔkya bula kɔgyumanakɔ kpakplaa kɔni na bɔ́tu kemmo, nsu kukpi kúyu kɔ́sia kúduo-bu lɛlɔ na kɔ́du bula banamu bani nli mɔɔƒia muedi ku bula bakloƒu bani mbo ɔyikun betulo ƒui.

english_verse: “The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.” What the Lord Likes Best
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-bu ka bula bekyuli badubo bukpi buwi kalɔ ƒui bɔka bɔmana aani kalɛ na kamu kaayɛɛlɛ teewi kalɔ na bátanwa-ka iye alakpi ani na bébo béwi kalɔ na ute-ka lɛmwi. Ɔlɛka Bekyuli Babla Lɛla Lɛni Na Unwoti Ɔɔyɔ́ Teetulo

english_verse: The Lord says: Don't brag about your wisdom or strength or wealth.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Ɔdi biala utakun lɛmɛnɛ na nwuna lɛnunda iye ɔyikun iye lɛkɛ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you feel you must brag, then have enough sense to brag about worshiping me, the Lord. What I like best is showing kindness, justice, and mercy to everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ ni, ɔnu ka nwuna kasusu kese-nwu nwaa na ɔsiaku ami Unwoti. Na lɛla lɛni na mɔɔyɔ́ teetulo ƒui ndi lɛƒɔndia bɔbla ku etemila bɔtɛ siin ku bekyuli kɔnyana bɔnu na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Someday I will punish the nations of Egypt, Edom, Ammon, and Moab, and the tribes of the desert. The men of these nations are circumcised, but they don't worship me. And it's the same with you people of Judah. Your bodies are circumcised, but your hearts are unchanged.
translation_verse: “Limeyi lɛdubo na ndubo Egyipteƒuɔ ku Edomƒuɔ ku Amonƒuɔ ku Moabƒuɔ kɔtu bɔni ku adua ani bekyuli nkya abi lɛlɔ mmɔ ƒui. Bekyuli bamɛni ƒui békulo ago, nsu ɔɔɔdi ami na baasiaku. Na lɛni kani na use amii Yudaƒuɔ lɛnɔ. Bina ɔlɔna kani na bíkulo na ɔɔɔdi bina kɔyi na bíti bíte-mi na bɛ́vumana udu na bɛsiaku-mi kama siin.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Listen to me, you people of Israel. Don't follow the customs of those nations who become frightened when they see something strange happen in the sky.
translation_verse: “Bitasiaku kadi bani bekyuli na liƒu lɛɛda si bánu ka lɛla lɛni na bátanu kudii lɛdi lɛɛlɛ́ na kayaa.

english_verse: Their religion is worthless! They chop down a tree, carve the wood into an idol,
translation_verse: Bana bɔƒɔtaadi ulu uuubo kɔsia kɔdi. Kugyii na baadá taava kalɔ na banwi-ku babla baƒiɔ.

english_verse: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.
translation_verse: Na beti sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi bakwa-nwu lɛlɔ na bakana-nwu bada kalɔ kalɛ na ulebuli ulatáyu kalɔ.

english_verse: An idol is no better than a scarecrow. It can't speak, and it has to be carried, because it can't walk. Why worship an idol that can't help or harm you? Jeremiah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Baƒiɔ bani na bánwi bátavumanaku ala ani na baabla taalɛ kemo taagya baasɛ ku bebweyi bamba bani muubile edula. Lɛla lɛnwidi lɛmɛni lilátɛmi na lilákana busie lɛnɔ, anwuɔsu bɔgyu na baagyú-ni teeti teetése mmɔ. Na bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka ukyuli ataayia baƒiɔ bani naaadubo-ɔ kebunku kadi bɔkana bute na balakana-a lɛla lɛdi lɛnɔ bɔbla?” Yeremia Úmwi Unwoti

english_verse: Our Lord, great and powerful, you alone are God.
translation_verse: Bula Unwoti ɔni nébomo na ebo ɔyikun geen, awɔ lɛti kani ndi Katɔti.

english_verse: You are King of the nations. Everyone should worship you. No human anywhere on earth is wiser than you.
translation_verse: Awɔ ndi kadi bekyuli ƒui ɔga. Na awɔ na ɔlɛka ukyuli biala ɔbu. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔyawine ɔdi uuubo kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ kesii kadi na ɔ́da anu utulo-ɔ.

english_verse: Idols are worthless, and anyone who worships them is a fool!
translation_verse: Ala ani na bánwi iye bávɔ bábla baƒiɔ baaadi lɛla lɛdi. Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔkpá-ma ɔdi ɔdɔlɔdi!

english_verse: Idols are made by humans. A carver shapes the wood. A metalworker hammers out a covering of gold from Uphaz or of silver from Tarshish. Then the idol is dressed in blue and purple clothes.
translation_verse: Bekyuli nánwi na bávɔ ala amɛni bábla baƒiɔ. Ligyii banwine baanwí ligyii na udu ɔdi kenye. Na abuala betune lɛnɔ baakywɛɛ ala ku sika ugyiedi ɔni na béku básiku Uƒas ku sika ɔƒualadi ɔni nási Tarsis na benyimi-nwu adala ani náƒɔ kuye geen.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.
translation_verse: Awɔ Unwoti kani ndi Katɔti geen ɔni nli ngba. Na aadi lɛlɔ uwi ƒui. Na si éti kɔnyi ni, kalɔ kaakunku na kadi bekyuli baayii udu.

english_verse: You told me to say that idols did not create the heavens and the earth, and that you, the Lord, will destroy every idol.
translation_verse: Awɔ násu-mi anii nsu-ma ka ɔɔɔdi baƒiɔ nédie kalɔ kammɔ na adubo baƒiɔ ƒui udu bɔyila.

english_verse: With your wisdom and power you created the earth and spread out the heavens.
translation_verse: Ƒula lɛnunda ku ɔyikun na éti édie kalɔ ku kayaa ala ƒui.

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at your command. You make clouds appear— you send the winds from your storehouse and make lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: Eedie lɛdi teete ntu bɔni na áya na bɔƒa kayaa na buudu ku kɔku bonwu. Na liƒlukutu lɛɛdá taalɛ kayaa. Aayá na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔɔsí ƒula kesii kani na áklibi ala ése teebekpo. Na kayaa kemodi kaabwɛ ogya si ɔnantu ɔɔna.

english_verse: People who make idols are so stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods are not alive.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔnwí na baavɔ́ ala teese lɛlɔ aani baƒiɔ bádɔlɔ! Badubo bana lɛnunsia bɔyila na enu aƒɛ-ma, ɔsika bana ɔkɔ bɔnyi baƒiɔ bammɔ balakana bɔnwuna.

english_verse: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Baƒiɔ badi aƒiankula ku amala na si uwi ɔbuni úbo úbedu ni, badubo-ma udu bɔyila ƒui.

english_verse: But you, Israel's God, created all things, and you chose Israel to be your very own. Your name is the Lord All-Powerful. Judah Will Be Thrown from Its Land
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ Israel Katɔti ni, eeese lɛni, awɔ nédie ala ƒui na áƒuna Israel kadi bekyuli na badi awɔ badi geen. Ƒula lɛnyi ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui. Unwoti Ɔdubo Yuda Bɔbɔku Bɔlɛku Nwuna Kalɔ Lɛlɔ

english_verse: I said to the people of Judah, “Gather your things; you are surrounded.
translation_verse: Lɛ́su Yudaƒuɔ nnini, “Bɛsala bina ala, ɔsika báaka bámana-mii.

english_verse: The Lord said these troubles will lead to your capture, and he will throw you from this land like a rock from a sling.”
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnii lɛbibo lɛmɛni ndubo bɔgyu bɔtɔ bina buƒie na bɛlɛ bina kalɔ lɛlɔ na bɛda-ka biwi. Ɔsika ndubo-mii bɔbɔku budie kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na beeƒwimi lɛtabi taalɛku kavwinvwi kemmo.”

english_verse: The people answered, “We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bekyuli bammɔ básu banini, “Bɔ́ƒɔ ɔlɛ na bukpi kani na bɔdubo bukpi. Bi náya na bɔ́su bɔnii bɔdubɔkana lɛbibo lɛmmɔ kenye bunye?

english_verse: Our homes are destroyed; our children are dead. No one is left to help us find shelter.”
translation_verse: Bábwɛ-bu kɔduli na bádu-bu bebi. Na ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́sɔ útebu na ubunku-bu na bɔkɛ kesii kani na bulie.”

english_verse: But I told them, “Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord. And so we've been scattered like sheep.
translation_verse: Nsu lɛ́su-ma nnini, “Bula batɔnkune badi badɔlɔdi bani nátakana lɛla lɛdi bɔbla, ɔsika béni na bétenu Unwoti litemi. Anwuɔsu na bégyingya-bu aani baƒonu kalɛ.

english_verse: “Sounds of destruction rumble from the north like distant thunder. Soon our towns will be ruins where only jackals live.” Jeremiah Prays
translation_verse: Buunú lɛsɛ lɛni ndanku ala bubile kɔku ɔ́siku kalɔ kammɔ katɔ kakɛ aani kayaa budu na ɔgyu kakaaka. Na blii nébu ɔƒɛni na bababwɛ-bu lɛma na bula kuliekɔ kunwini beƒukutu kuliekɔ.” Yeremia Ɔ́kpali Katɔti Na Úvele-nwu

english_verse: I know, Lord, that we humans are not in control of our own lives.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ngyi ka ɔɔɔdi abu bekyuli alati nda bula ngba.

english_verse: Correct me, as I deserve, but not in your anger, or I will be dead.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ti-mi siaku ulu ɔbuni lɛlɔ kalɛ na ɔ́manku, nsu ɔɔɔdi ƒula kɔnyi kemmo. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, ndubo bukpi.

english_verse: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!
translation_verse: Bula bekisine béni na balátuna banii awɔ ndi Katɔti na babu-ɔ. Bábɔku bula bekyuli bálɛku bula ɔma na ɔma ɔmmɔ ɔƒɔ lɛlɔ uwi ukpludi aani alakpi. Anwuɔsu ti kɔnyi kya-ma na abɔku ama lɛnɔ atɔlɔku!

english_verse: The Lord God told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord, am warning you that I will put a curse on anyone who doesn't keep the agreement I made with Israel. So pay attention to what it says.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nte Yudaƒuɔ ku Yerusalemƒuɔ bɔti ɔnini, “Ami Unwoti mɔɔsu-mii kpakplaa ka ndubɔya na ewida asiaku ukyuli ɔni ndubuni na uláda mina bunyimi bɔni na línyimiku Israel. Anwuɔsu bise atu kaduɛɛ na binu lɛla lɛni na bunyimi bɔmmɔ bɔɔsu.

english_verse: My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people.
translation_verse: Mina ɔda bubo bútavumana kudii ɔ́si uwi ɔni na lɛ́kpanku bina bati kuuku lɛ́siku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Kadi bani bekyuli nse aani lɛyu ogya ɔni mɔɔda bonwu na nwuna kemmo na baanwamana abuala. Ama na lɛ́su nnii si bádi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni, ndubɔbla bana Katɔti na ama babla mina kadi bekyuli.

english_verse: Then I did what I had promised and gave them this wonderful land, where you now live. “Yes, Lord,” I replied, “that's true.”
translation_verse: Ami lɛ́di mina lɛsuse lɛlɔ, anwuɔsu na líti kalɔ kani kana egyiibi ntu bɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii na bilie-ka lɛlɔ mɛni líte-ma.” Amu na lídie kenye nnini, “Sɔsɔ na ɔdi Unwoti.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nte ukyuli biala bɔti na Yerusalem lɛblɔnu lɛlɔ ku Yuda lɛma kemmo ɔnini, “Ɔda bubo bɔni nkya bunyimi bɔni na línyimiku-mii kemmo ni, bɛdi-mu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors
translation_verse: Lɛ́siku-mii bɔtɛmiku ɔ́si uwi ɔni na lɛ́kpanku bina bati kuuku lɛ́siku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ nnii bɛdi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Nsu amii ku bina bati kuuku ƒui,

english_verse: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
translation_verse: atuɔkplu kani na binye bɛɛbla uwi ndi uwi na bíni bɛnii bilenu lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu-mii. Na lɛla lɛni na bina likyulikpi kayi kani nkya-mii ni, kana bɔlɛ ku lɛyɔla na biinú taabla ala mmomu. Bítadi lɛla lɛni na búnyimi ɔdi lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu ndubo bɔya na ewida asiaku-mii na bibo abi biala na ámanku-mii na bina ɔbladu kenye.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Yeremia, Yudaƒuɔ ku Yerusalem kadi bekyuli bakya baabla kasusu kekpidi na mina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
translation_verse: Ekpidi ani na bana bati kuuku bábla ni, ana lɛlɔ kani na ama lɛnɔ benye kpakplaa na ɔni na béni-mi na bésie baakpá baƒiɔ ɔsu. Lɛga kadikɔ kani nkya katɔ kakɛ na Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, bébile bunyimi bɔni na línyimiku bina bati kuuku. Na ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kani na Yuda lɛga kadikɔ kani na kalɔ kammɔ kada kakɛ badaku ɔƒɛni.

english_verse: Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers.
translation_verse: Ndubo bɔya na Yuda ku Yerusalem kadi bekyuli bebo abi geen ɔni na ɔdi ulakana na wekeli lɛbibo lɛmmɔ. Lɛla lɛni na lɛ́lɛ ugyii ɔƒɛni na lɛdi mmɔ. Na badubuvele-mi banii mbunku-ma, nsu lɛɛɛdubo bunu bute-ma.

english_verse: Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
translation_verse: Na bakana na beti bana akpala bete bana baƒiɔ bani na baakpali na bebunku-ma. Ɔsika ɔkɔ ɔdi uuubo-nwu kemmo ka Yudaƒuɔ bebo bɔƒiɔ na bemomo betulo lɛma lɛni na lɛkya Yuda kalɔ kemodi kammɔ lɛlɔ. Na bátu akpabi béte Baal baƒiɔ na emomo etulo lɛblɔnu lɛni nkya Yerusalem ɔma kemmo, nsu bana ƒui baaadubo bɔkana na bedie-ma na ɔgbankpi ɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
translation_verse: “Yeremia, takpali tevele na bekyuli bamɛni lili iye asu-mi anii ndie-ma. Ɔsika lɛɛɛdubo bunu ina ákpali-mi na lɛɛɛdubo bana buvele lɛnɔ bunu!”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nte Yudaƒuɔ bɔti ɔnini, “Amii ndi mina kadi bekyuli, nsu biiibo kuƒi ka biduo mina kakpakɔ bitaabla ala ani muukpóku-mi kayi mɛni udu. Na akpala ani na bɛɛbla teete-mi mɛni aaadubo-mii bɔgyumana bɔsiku ɔgbankpi ɔdi kemmo. Anwuɔsu bɛda lɛlɔyɔ lɛmmɔ bɛya.

english_verse: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔdi kemmo ni, nka bise aani kɔdingyii kɔni na egyiibi áƒɔ-ku kemmo kaduɛ. Nsu ni, uwi ɔsɔ uletu asa ndubo bɔya na bekyuli lisu bonwu badi ku lɛsɛ bebo babaƒɛ ƒula kɔgba kɔmmɔ ƒui na batu ogya bakya-a.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
translation_verse: Ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui. Na amii Yudaƒuɔ bise aani kugyii kɔni na ami ɔlati lɛ́lɛ. Nsu bɛ́kya-mi kɔnyi na akpala ani na bɛɛbla teete Baal baƒiɔ aani kalɛ na lɛga kadikɔ kani nkya katɔ kakɛ baabla ɔsu. Na ɔƒaani ni, ndubo-mii bɔgyu budie bina kenyekɔ ku ligyiitu.” Bása Lili Ka Badu Yeremia

english_verse: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badi bása lili ka badu-mi. Na aani kalɛ na baakpanku koƒonu teesienku kadukɔ ni, lɛni na badanku-mi na lɛɛɛgyi bana kasusu.

english_verse: But then the Lord told me that they had planned to chop me down like a tree— fruit and all— so that no one would ever remember me again.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti údie bana kasusu ɔ́tina-mi ka lɛni na baawia badu-mi aani kalɛ na baadá kugyii taakyula ku ligyiitu ku ebi ƒui kalɛ na ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ ulenyimo-mi kudii lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I prayed, “Lord All-Powerful, you always do what is right, and you know every thought. So I trust you to help me and to take revenge.”
translation_verse: Lɛ́kpali Unwoti na lívele-nwu nnini, “Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, lɛla lɛni na ndia na aabla uwi ndi uwi na agyi ukyuli biala kasusu lɛnɔ. Anwuɔsu bunku-mi na edie bekyuli bamɛni kasi.”

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Yeremia, bekyuli badi bási ƒula ɔma Anatos bani násu ka badubo-ɔ bɔdu si amu enye eedie-mi kenye.

english_verse: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
translation_verse: Nsu ndubo-ma kɔtu bɔni na lɛya na bana bakloƒu bekpi na kekpokɔ. Na kɔka kɔdubo bana bebi bɔdu na bekpi.

english_verse: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na lɛ́wɔlɔ lɛla lɛni na mɔɔbla ni, ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ ulébu ulelie ngba na bana atɔƒi kemmo.”

english_verse: Whenever I complain to you, Lord, you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?
translation_verse: Unwoti, uwi biala na lɛ́su-ɔ ala ani muukpóku-mi ni, eenú na aabla lɛla biala na ulu siin lɛlɔ. Nsu ɔƒaani ni, mbo ala adi na liye-ɔ ɔ́siku kalɛ na aatɛ etemila lɛlɔ. Bi ɔsu na mɔɔnu aani ka ngba buse buɛɛ bute alaekpidi bablane? Na bi ɔsu na bana ala ƒui aatɛ teete-ma?

english_verse: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Eenyene-ma kunyekɔ kɔbuni aani egyii ani na álɛ na aalɛ́ lili kaduɛ taanwu ebi. Na si ina beemwi-ɔ lɛnɔ ni, aanu taati ka ɔɔɔdi ku bana kaƒɔ nwaa na baabla ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: But you know, Lord, how faithful I've always been, even in my thoughts. So drag my enemies away and butcher them like sheep!
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Unwoti agyi kalɛ na nsiaku-ɔ kama na ńtalɛ-ɔ kama kudii iye mina kasusu muedi katimi ƒula lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu ni, bekisine bamɛni lɛku na ebeyi-ma adu aani baƒonu kalɛ.

english_verse: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, “God can't see the sins we commit.” The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Uwi ɛlɛ na adubɔya na kalɔ kamɛni kayaku ntu na kakwii lɛni ketédu? Na uwi ɛlɛ na livo lɛdubɔyɛyɛ linye bebuo kadikɔ lɛni utédu? Bebuo ku baasɛ bammɔ ƒui békpi na ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo. Na bekyuli bamɛni alaekpidi ani na baabla ɔsu na ala amɛni ƒui aalɛ́ lɛni. Nsu bamu benye baakun lɛmɛnɛ taasu banini, “Katɔti ulánu alaekpidi ani na bɔɔbla.” Unwoti Údie Yeremia Litemi Kenye

english_verse: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Yeremia, si anii eekeli ada bekyuli na lɛlɔ líitu-ɔ lɛni ni, dɛ na aakali ka adubɔkana bukeli bɔda bapɔnkɔ? Na si kalɔ ntɛ nwaa mɛni na adaku bubuli ni, bi ndubo bɔlɛ na lɛku kemmo na Yordan Ketu kɔtu?

english_verse: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
translation_verse: Awɔ ɔlati ƒula lɛlɔ bekyuli muedi báta bénye-ɔ lɛlɔ. Baabla ala anumi kemmo aani bɔyɔ na bada-a, nsu tanyonu lɛlɔ tete-ma lo. Ulu na baawia kalɛ na bakɛ-ɔ aani kalɛ kani na bekyuli bamba benye baawia kuƒi kɔmmɔ. Unwoti Úti Kɔnyi Kpakplaa Ɔ́kya Nwuna Bekyuli

english_verse: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́yɔ mina bekyuli na lɛ́ƒuna-ma línwini mina badi geen. Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, ndubo-ma buni na liti-ma lɛkya bana bekisine enu kemmo.

english_verse: My people have turned against me and roar at me like lions. That's why I hate them.
translation_verse: Mina bekyuli báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ na baakwanyiku-mi aani bagyata, anwuɔsu na muukisi-ma.

english_verse: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
translation_verse: Mina bekyuli bese aani aasɛ ɔni na basangbii básala beebó na lɛƒɛnyi ƒui lɛlɔ. Bɛsu beƒiebuo bammɔ na bebo na babakun na badi bemo.

english_verse: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.
translation_verse: “Mina kalɔ kabuni kammɔ kébie aani kalɛ na baƒonu badane baakpanku bana bebuo na besusu kemo kadi ku kana edula ƒui na asɔ alanu lɛdila lɛdi.

english_verse: Every field I see lies barren, and no one cares.
translation_verse: Na kadubɔƒɔ lɛlɔ katɛ ukpludi na mina anumi, na kasɔ kaladia lɛla lɛdi bɔbla ɔsika ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔɔdaku-ka lɛda.

english_verse: A destroying army marches along desert roads and attacks everywhere. They are my deadly sword; no one is safe from them.
translation_verse: Bekpone bani muubile ala badanku lɛlɔ badubo na kalɔ kakwiidi ulu lɛlɔ na beekpó kesi kesii. Na ama ndi mina kewii kekpidi kani nda muukpó na ɔdi biala uuubo bɔnwuna iye ɔkɛ bɔƒɔ bɔdi na bana enu kemmo.

english_verse: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
translation_verse: Mina bekyuli, kamu na bɛ́kya, nsu ka líti kɔnyi lɛ́kya-mii ɔsu ni, livo kani na lɛya na lɛ́kwɛ. Anwuɔsu bíbo abi ekpludi na bítakɛ ku lɛla!” Unwoti Ɔdubɔnu Kadi Bamba Bekyuli Kɔnyana

english_verse: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Mina bekyuli Israelƒuɔ na líti kalɔ kamɛni líte. Nsu bekisine bani náka bámana-ka bekpo na béyu-ka ƒui. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ndubo-ma bɔgyu budie bana kɔlɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na ndubo Yuda bɔgyu budie nwuna kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands.
translation_verse: Nsu kama ƒui ni, ndubo kɔlɔ kɔmɛni bekyuli kɔnyana bɔnu na lɛsɔku-ma liboku bana kɔlɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
translation_verse: Ama nátina mina bekyuli kalɛ na baakpá Baal baƒiɔ uwi ɔdi návi kemmo. Nsu si bánu-mi báti ka ami lɛti kani ndi Katɔti geen ɔmmɔ na bátuna na mina bekyuli bátina-ma kalɛ na bakpa-mi ni, ndubɔƒɔ ama lɛnɔ na babla mina bekyuli.

english_verse: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mmomu si bétenu-mi litemi ni, ndubo-ma bɔgyu budie bana kalɔ lɛlɔ na lɛyila-ma udu ƒui kede kede.”

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.”
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Sie na etéye lɛwuku kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ lɛdi na akya-ni uwi klukwii ɔdi, nsu taƒɔ-ni.”

english_verse: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu lísie ntéye lɛwuku lɛmmɔ lɛ́kya kalɛ na ɔ́su-mi.

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: Nwuna kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
translation_verse: “Die lɛwuku lɛmmɔ na esie Euƒrate Ketu na eti-ni atábɛla mmɔ na atakpɛ bonwu kɔka kɔdi kemmo.”

english_verse: And that's what I did.
translation_verse: Na ami lɛnɔ lísie ńtábla lɛni kani.

english_verse: Some time later the Lord said, “Go back and get the shorts.”
translation_verse: Ka uwi klukwii ɔdi úbavi ni, Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Sɔ nwini sie na etéti lɛwuku lɛmmɔ.”

english_verse: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
translation_verse: Línwini lísie na ńtéku lɛwuku lɛmmɔ lídie kesii kani na líti-ni lɛ́kya mmɔ. Nsu kɔdi kɔmmɔ kɔ́tɔ na lɛwuku lɛmmɔ líkulo.

english_verse: Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Yeremia, ndubo Babilonƒuɔ butiku na bayila Yuda ku Yerusalemƒuɔ lɛlɔ katɔ bɔtalaku.

english_verse: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
translation_verse: Yuda kadi bekyuli badi bekyuli bekpidi na bebo atuɔkplu na belenu litemi. Na baabla lɛla biala na ama baayɔ́ na baakpá baƒiɔ na mina litemi bunu kenye. Na si uwi ɔni na lɛ́wɔlɔ lɛla lɛni na nnii mɔɔblaku-ma ni, basɔ baaadubo lɛla lɛdi bɔdia bɔbla, ɔsika lɛni na badubo buse aani kalɛ na lɛwuku lɛmmɔ lise na aanu.

english_verse: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na átaakya lɛwuku lɛmɛni ni, líƒie-ɔ na lɛ́da-a kavobi kaduɛ. Lɛni kani na lɛ́da Israel ku Yuda lɛga kɔdikɔ kɔmmɔ. Lɛ́da-ma lɛ́kya kpakplaa na lɛ́yɔ ka lɛbla-ma mina kadi bekyuli na baƒɔ lɛnyi kalɛ na kadi bekyuli bamba bataabu-mi na bemwi-mi lɛnyi, nsu béni banii belénu-mi litemi.” Bɛdubuyile Bina Nte Ebui Ku Ntɛ Bɔbuni

english_verse: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Yeremia, su Yudaƒuɔ anini, ‘Unwoti, Israel Katɔti, údie lɛdi úte-mii ɔnii biyile bina ntɛ ebui ku ntɛ.’ Na ama badubudie kenye banini, ‘Buuyile bula ntɛ ebui ku ntɛ! Na bi ɔsu na awɔ nsɔ mɔɔsu-bu lɛla lɛni na bɔgyi buse na bɔɔbla?’

english_verse: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
translation_verse: Si básu lɛni ni, na edie kenye anini, ‘Ami ndi Unwoti na lɛla lɛni na ndubo bɔbla lɛdubo bɔya na ukyuli biala na Yuda ku Yerusalem babla aani ntɛ na báni bémo. Na bani ɔdi ndubo butulo ndi baga bani nási Dawid ɔtɔ kemmo ku bakpane ku kenye bediene.

english_verse: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
translation_verse: Na ndubo-ma buti bubonku lɛlɔ aani ebui ammɔ kalɛ. Na lɛɛɛdubo bakloƒu ku begblebi ku benengu bammɔ ƒui kɔnyana bɔnu, mmomu ndubo bana ƒui udu bɔyila. Ami Unwoti násu.’ ” Badubo Yuda Kadi Bekyuli Buti Bɔtɔlɔku

english_verse: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Amii Yudaƒuɔ, bitatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ lɛni bitetuloku ka binu lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su.

english_verse: You hope for light, but God is sending darkness. Evening shadows already deepen in the hills. So return to God and confess your sins to him before you trip and fall.
translation_verse: Binye bɛɛsia bukeye anu, nsu lɛdisa na Unwoti úti uumene-mii. Bɛɛnu ka ɔyuli kɔyu kɔ́ɔƒɔ abi ammɔ lɛlɔ suu ɔdubo. Anwuɔsu binwini bibo Katɔti kudɔ na bidie bina alaekpidi kalɔ bite-nwu asa na bigyiile bibuli.

english_verse: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord's people are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́talaku lɛlɔ katɔ na bítenu-nwu litemi ni, ami lɛti ndubo buwulo uwi ɔni na badubuti Katɔti bekyuli batɔlɔku aani bekyuli batɔntɛne.

english_verse: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnii nsu-mii ka ɔga ɔmmɔ ku uni ƒui badubɔta bana kuliekɔ na bebimi bana kɔgabwa.

english_verse: The cities in the Southern Desert are surrounded; no one can get in or out. Everyone in Judah will be taken away.
translation_verse: Báaka bámana lɛma linengudi lɛni nkya kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo na kada kakɛ. Na ukyuli ɔdi ulakana na weduo iye ɔdi ɔkana bɔlɛ lɛnɔ. Na badubuti ukyuli biala na Yuda batɔlɔku.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, awɔ nátaatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ ka aadi Yudaƒuɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu. Nsu wɛ na bakya ɔƒɛni? Nwini nu katɔ kakɛ na adubɔnu ƒula bekisine ka badubo.

english_verse: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Ama bana lɛlɔ na éti anu ási dii ka badubo-ɔ bubunku. Nsu ɔƒaani ndubɔya na badi-ɔ lɛlɔ. Bi ndi-ɔ kasusu na ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ? Adubo lɛbibo kemmo bɔkya aani uleku ɔni ntɛ kɔwɔ na uunú ɔlɛ.

english_verse: Do you know why your clothes were torn off and you were abused? It was because of your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Agyi lɛla lɛni ɔsu na ƒula adala ábwɛ-ɔ lɛlɔ na bekyuli beedumi-ɔ? Ɔkɛnku ƒula ekpidi bonwu bonwu ani na aabla ɔsu.

english_verse: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
translation_verse: “Ndubo-mii bubo bugyingya aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni muukpó na kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ uubo aƒaaƒa teedie kamu ebi kemmo si baaƒɛ́-nya.

english_verse: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord, have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *
translation_verse: Ami Unwoti násu lɛni na lɛɛɛdubo mina kasusu bɔvumana. Ɔsika bíni-mi na bísie bɛɛkpá baƒiɔ bani naaasu litemi geen.

english_verse: You were married to me, but you were unfaithful. You even became a prostitute by worshiping disgusting gods on hilltops and in fields.
translation_verse: Búlie aani ɔgya ku ule, nsu bɛ́lɛ-mi kama na bítasiaku-mi kama siin. Na bínwini bayalɛ muedi na uwi ɔni na bɛkɛ abi eli ku mmo ƒui bɛɛkpá baƒiɔ bani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: So I'll rip off your clothes and leave you naked and ashamed for everyone to see. You are doomed! Will you ever be worthy to worship me again?
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubo bina adala bɔni budie-mii lɛlɔ na bɛsɔ bɛkɛ kasɔngya ku kɔƒa kɔƒa na ukyuli biala utaanu-mii. Amii ɔdi ɔ́sa na bɛ́yii udu! Bɛɛƒɔ́ taadi ka bɛdubɔsɔ bɛbla bekyuli bani mamanku ka bɛsɔ bɛkpali-mi?”

english_verse: When there had been no rain for a long time, the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ɔ́ɔƒɔ uwi gyɔlɔɔ na ɔnantu ɔsɔ ulána ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nsu bekyuli bammɔ nnini,

english_verse: Judah and Jerusalem weep as the land dries up.
translation_verse: “Yuda ku Yerusalem, biteewulo na kalɔ kammɔ bɔkwii ɔsu.

english_verse: There has been no rain, and farmers feel sick as they watch cracks appear in the dry ground.
translation_verse: Na ɔnantu tana tana ɔmɛni únwini ɔlɛ na bemonsene beeƒi ka baanu kalɛ na kalɔ kammɔ kaasia kɔka taabwɛ na kana bɔkwii ɔsu.

english_verse: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.
translation_verse: Akwa ɔɔwɔ ubi na ɔda-nwu ɔva alakpi akɔ mmɔ na utátaavi taawia livo lɛni na ɔkun.

english_verse: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass. The Lord's People Pray
translation_verse: Bebuo ala betine anumi ábwɛ na bakɛ baaví na kɔka ɔsu. Na abi ani na lili na livo liiibo eli na beenye teenwenyi kayaa teenu aani beƒukutu si badubɔƒɔ livo lɛwɔdi ɔnyi na kesii kadi.” Katɔti Bekyuli Bákpali Katɔti Bévele

english_verse: We rejected you and did evil, so we deserve to be punished. But if you rescue us, Lord, everyone will see how great you are.
translation_verse: Ɔdi litemi geen ka bula alaekpidi bonwu ani bɔɔbla adubɔkana na aya na ani-bu kɔtu. Nsu si édie-bu ni, Unwoti, ukyuli biala ɔdubo bɔnu kalɛ na ébo.

english_verse: You're our only hope; you alone can save us now. You help us one day, but you're gone the next.
translation_verse: Awɔ kani ndi bula lɛnunsia na awɔ kani ndubɔkana na aƒɔ-bu ngba ɔƒɛni. Ébunku-bu uwi ɔdi na uwi bamba áda-bu ése.

english_verse: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us! The Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Bɔsu na ada anii aaagyi eeese asa na ɔgbankpi ɔmɛni ɔ́lɛku-bu? Munuu ukpone ɔni na bényimi-nwu enu na adi? Awɔ náƒuna-bu na ƒula kakpakɔ kakya-bu kudɔ mɛni, anwuɔsu teni-bu! Unwoti Údie Kenye Kadi

english_verse: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord, have spoken. Lying Prophets
translation_verse: “Mina bekyuli, bɛɛyɔ́ ka bitaagyú lɛgba taatɔlɔ-mi kudɔ uwi ndi uwi na bilakya ɔkplu ka bɛni bide-mi. Anwuɔsu ɔƒɛni ni, ami lɛnɔ ndubo-mii atu budie. Na lɛni-mii kɔtu na bina ekpidi ani na bɛ́bla ɔsu. Ami Unwoti násu.” Ɔkɔ Kenye Bediene

english_verse: The Lord said, “Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Yeremia, tevele-mi anii nnu bekyuli bamɛni kɔnyana.

english_verse: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Bakana na bakɛ bataavi ku kɔka na bakyula akpala bayala-mi kaƒɔ na beti edula akpala babagya-mi enu. Nsu si béwulo bákpali-mi ni, lɛɛɛdubo-ma bɔkpete na lɛɛɛdubo-ma akpala ammɔ lɛnɔ bɔƒɔ. Mmomu ndubɔya na kekpo ku kɔka ku lɛlɛ lidu libadu-ma na lɛyila-ma udu ƒui.”

english_verse: I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
translation_verse: Amu na lídie kenye nnini, “Ƒula kenye bediene bamba bakya baasu-ma banini, ‘Aaadubo bɔya na kɔka iye kekpo kebo-bu lɛlɔ mmomu adubute-bu keyi buɛɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord answered: They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti údie kenye ɔnini, “Ama alati mɔɔsu taatina ka ami mina kenye na beedie, nsu ɔkɔ na baanyi! Ɔsika ńtasu-ma lɛla lɛdi muedi útédu ka mɔɔƒuna-ma nnii benwini mina kenye bediene. Kenye kani baasu kási ana ekpludi ani na beegyé ku like lɛni na beebó ku ama alati ala ani na baakali taanu kemmo.

english_verse: Those lying prophets say there will be peace and plenty of food. But I say that those same prophets will die from war and hunger.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ kenye bediene bammɔ baasu taatina ka bekyuli badubɔkɛ keyi buɛɛ na bakɛ adila pii lɛnɔ. Nsu ami mɔɔsu ka kekpo ku kɔka ndubo kenye bediene bammɔ alati bɔdu.

english_verse: And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔƒɔ́-ma litemi aani litemi geen ni, badubo bukpi kalɛ na ɔ́manku úte-ma. Na badubo bana ɔlɔna bubo butáva Yerusalem lɛblɔnu lɛlɔ, ɔsika bana lɛlɔ bekyuli lɛnɔ badubo bukpi na ɔdi ɔsɔ ulakya na wava-ma.

english_verse: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: “Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.
translation_verse: “Yeremia, sie na atásu-ma ala amɛni ƒui ku kalɛ na ƒula lɛlɔ kemmo kaabla-a taasiku ala amɛni lɛlɔ.” Anwuɔsu lɛ́su-ma nnini, “Imii bɔdubɔƒɔ-mi anumi usien ku ɔƒɛ, ɔsika mina kadi bekyuli badubo ɔlɛ ukpidi bɔƒɔ ɔni ndubo-ma bɔdu.

english_verse: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.” Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Mɔɔnu kalɛ na bani bádu na kekpokɔ bewi alakpi akɔ. Na mɔɔnu kalɛ na kɔka kɔɔdú bekyuli lisu bani nkya lɛma kemmo lɛnɔ. Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui kenye bediene bammɔ ku bakpane bewi bana kabla lɛlɔ na belenu lɛla lɛdi kalɔ ɔ́si lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ lɛlɔ.” Yeremia Ɔ́kpali Katɔti

english_verse: Have you rejected Judah, Lord? Do you hate Jerusalem? Why did you strike down Judah with a fatal wound? We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Unwoti, buni na éni Yuda? Na eekisi Yerusalem? Bi ɔsu na ébo Yuda áva kalɔ na áya na ɔ́ƒɔ ɔlɛ bonwu lɛni? Bula lɛnunsia ndi ka badubɔkɛ keyi buɛɛ na abwi-bu, nsu liƒu bonwu lɛmɛni na áya na líbo-bu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: We and our ancestors are guilty of rebelling against you.
translation_verse: Abu ku bula bati kuuku ƒui bɔ́ƒiɔ-ɔ na ɔni na bɔ́ta búnye-ɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: If you save us, it will show how great you are. Don't let our enemies disgrace your temple, your beautiful throne. Don't forget that you promised to rescue us.
translation_verse: Nsu si áƒɔ-bu ngba ni, ɔdubɔtina kalɛ na ébomo. Taya na bula bekisine bakya ƒula kakpakɔ kani mɔɔdia bɔnu na eli aadi lɛga kɔƒa. Na tayiƒala lɛnɔ ka ese-bu kenye ka adubudie-bu.

english_verse: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Baƒiɔ belete-bu ɔnantu na baya na amii lɛnɔ ayu anya alati. Awɔ lɛti pɛ kani nda ɔnantu ɔmmɔ na aadi-nwu lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu na búti bula anu bɔ́sia-a lɛlɔ, bula Unwoti ku Katɔti.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel were here, praying with you, I wouldn't change my mind. So send the people of Judah away.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ina Mose ku Samuel nnye mɛni bebunku-ɔ na bɛɛkpali-mi teevele ni, lɛɛɛdubo bunu, anwuɔsu ya na Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ benwini batɔlɔ.

english_verse: And when they ask where they are going, tell them that I, the Lord, have said: Some of you are going to die of horrible diseases. Others are going to die in war or from starvation. The rest will be led away to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Na si béye-ɔ banii wɛ na bésela ni, na asu-ma anii ami Unwoti násu nnini, ‘Ɔlɛ ukpidi ɔdubo bina badi bubo na bikpi. Na babambadi ni, kekpokɔ iye kɔka ndubo-mii bɔdu. Na bakladi ni, badubo-mii bɔkpanku bɔtɔlɔku busienku kaƒɔ.’

english_verse: I will punish you in four different ways: You will be killed in war and your bodies dragged off by dogs, your flesh will be eaten by birds, and your bones will be chewed on by wild animals.
translation_verse: “Ndubo-mi kɔtu bɔni na lilu ine bun bun lɛlɔ. Badubo-mii bɔdu na kekpokɔ na bakpewe bani bina ɔlɔna ukpine batɔlɔku. Na baasɛ baduli-mii lɛna bebweli. Na bakumbweyi bababwɛ-mii ekubi.

english_verse: This punishment will happen because of the horrible things your King Manasseh did. And you will be disgusting to all nations on earth.
translation_verse: Na ndubo-mii kɔtu kɔmmɔ bɔni na ala ekpidi bonwu ani udu na bina Ɔga Hesekia ubidi Manase ɔ́bla ɔsu. Na kɔtu bɔni bɔmmɔ bɔdubɔya na liƒu bonwu lɛda kalɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, who will feel sorry for you? Will anyone bother to ask if you are well?
translation_verse: “Ɔma na amii Yerusalemƒuɔ lɛlɔ lɛdubo kɔnyana bɔbla? Ukyuli ɔdubuti ɔsia lɛlɔ na uye unu si dɛ na use-mii?

english_verse: My people, you abandoned me and walked away. I am tired of showing mercy; that's why I'll destroy you
translation_verse: Amii mina bekyuli bíni-mi na bɛ́gyu bɛ́tɔlɔ-mi kudɔ. Lɛ́ɛnɔ-mii kɔnyana bɔnu, anwuɔsu na ndubo-mii udu bɔyila

english_verse: by scattering you like straw blown by the wind. I will punish you with sorrow and death, because you refuse to change your ways.
translation_verse: na uwi ɔni na ndubo-mii bugyingya aani keti kani na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uubó taavinku. Ndubo-mii kɔtu bɔni na kɔnyana kuƒie-mii na bikpi lɛnɔ ɔsika bíni bɛnii bɛɛɛdubo bunwini na ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na bɛsia.

english_verse: There will be more widows in Judah than grains of sand on a beach. A surprise attack at noon! And the mothers in Jerusalem mourn for their children.
translation_verse: Bekpinele badubo bumomo na Yuda butulo kalɛ na ɛpu kɔnwinimi kuse na ɛpu kɔtu. Bekisine badubo-mii buyu bɔtu na bekpo-mii na ɔƒiiwi na bebi beni beteewulo bana bebi.

english_verse: A mother is in deep despair and struggles for breath. Her daylight has turned to darkness— she has suffered the loss of her seven sons. I will kill anyone who survives. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jeremiah Complains
translation_verse: Enu áƒɛ ubi uni ɔni na nwuna bebi maatɛ békpi na ɔƒɛ ɔɔdá-nwu momoomo, ɔsika kadi nwaa kani na ɔɔnu kénwini-nwu lɛdisa. Na ndubɔdu ukyuli biala ɔni nébu uli ngba. Ami Unwoti násu.” Yeremia Ɔ́su Ala Ani Muukpóku-nwu

english_verse: I wish I had never been born! I'm always in trouble with everyone in Judah. I never lend or borrow money, but everyone curses me just the same.
translation_verse: Si bɔwɔ na bátawɔ-mii muedi nka mɔɔyɔ́ ɔmmɔ teetulo ƒui! Lɛsɛ lɛkya ami ku ukyuli biala ntɛ na Yuda na nkya lɛbibo kemmo uwi ndi uwi. Neeevo sika ukyuli ɔdi kudɔ iye ami livo sika lite ukyuli ɔdi. Nsu ewida enwi pɛ kani, na ukyuli biala uuwida-mi.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “I promise to protect you, and when disaster comes, even your enemies will beg you for help.” The Enemy Cannot Be Defeated The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti údie kenye ɔnini, “Líse kenye ka ndubo-ɔ bɔgyumana. Na si ɔgbankpi ɔdi ɔ́lɛ muedi ni, ƒula bekisine muedi badubo-ɔ buvele banii bunku-ma. Bilakana Bekisine Bammɔ Lɛlɔ Bɔdi

english_verse: People of Judah, just as you can't break iron mixed with bronze, you can't defeat the enemies that will attack from the north.
translation_verse: “Kalɛ na bilakana lɛbuala lɛtondi ku ligyiedi lɛni na básala bɔƒɛ ni, lɛni kani na amii Yudaƒuɔ bɛɛɛdubo bɔkana bina bekisine bani ndubo bɔsi kalɔ kammɔ katɔ kakɛ bebekpo-mii lɛlɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: I will give them everything you own, because you have sinned everywhere in your country.
translation_verse: Ala ani ƒui na bibo ni, ndubɔƒɔ-nya lite-ma, ɔsika bɛ́bla alaekpidi na kalɔ kammɔ kesi kesii.

english_verse: My anger is a fire that cannot be put out, so I will make you slaves of your enemies in a foreign land. Jeremiah Complains Again
translation_verse: Kɔnyi kɔni na líti lɛ́kya-mii kuse aani ogya ɔni na balakana bunine. Anwuɔsu ndubuti-mii lite bina bekisine na beti-mii benwini bana kabla bablane na kaƒɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ kesii kani na bɛɛɛgyi.” Yeremia Ɔ́sɔ Ɔ́su Ala Ani Muukpóku-nwu

english_verse: You can see how I suffer insult after insult, all because of you, Lord. Don't be so patient with my enemies; take revenge on them before they kill me.
translation_verse: Unwoti, eenú kalɛ na bekyuli benye beedumi-mi taasia kama na awɔ ɔsu. Anwuɔsu takɛ kayi ku mina bekisine lɛni. Die bana ƒui kasi asa na bakɛ-mi badu.

english_verse: When you spoke to me, I was glad to obey, because I belong to you, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na átɛmiku-mi ni, ebiti áda-mi geen ka lɛbla lɛsiaku lɛni kani, ɔsika awɔ Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔdi na ndi.

english_verse: I don't go to parties and have a good time. Instead, I keep to myself, because you have filled me with your anger.
translation_verse: Neeesie emeyi kadikɔ taatádi taaní ku lɛlɔyɔ. Mmomu ami lɛti kani muulie, ɔsika kɔnyi kɔni na ákɛ kɔdi-mi etila.

english_verse: I am badly injured and in constant pain. Are you going to disappoint me, like a stream that goes dry in the heat of summer? The Lord Replies
translation_verse: Úbile ala mina lɛlɔ na ɔ́ya na kayi kaakpulu-mi uwi biala. Adubo bɔya na mina lɛnunsia lɛyii aani ketu kani mɔɔkwii si kaƒɛndi kédu na liwulu sɔɔn nkya? Unwoti Údie Litemi Lɛmmɔ Kenye

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Stop talking like a fool! If you turn back to me and speak my message, I will let you be my prophet once again. I hope the people of Judah will accept what you say. But you can ignore their threats, *
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Da bɔtɛmi aani ɔdɔlɔdi lɛni ya! Si ƒula kasusu kénwini kébo-mi kudɔ na ákɔ mina litemi lɛsa ni, ndubɔya na asɔ ataabla mina kenye udiene kabla. Na mɔɔnu ulu ka Yudaƒuɔ baƒɔ kenye kani na aasu-ma. Nsu tabu anii baaadubo-ɔ butaayila na bataakya-a liƒu.

english_verse: because I am making you strong, like a bronze wall. They are evil and violent, but when they attack,
translation_verse: Ndubo bɔya na ayu ɔkplu aani kowodu kɔni na béti lɛbuala ligyiedi bátu bényene. Bebo likyulikpi na bebo kalala, nsu si bébo bebekpoku-ɔ ni,

english_verse: I will be there to rescue you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: ndubunye-ɔ kudɔ na lɛgyumana-a, ɔsika mɔɔkya-a ɔyikun.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family.
translation_verse: “Yeremia, teti uleku na bɛwɔ bebi, ɔsika Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ kaaadi kesii kani na bawɔ bebi bɔnyuɛ.

english_verse: I'll tell you what's going to happen to children and their parents here.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni ndubo bawɔne bammɔ ku bebi bammɔ bɔbla ni, ndubo-ɔ bɔsu.

english_verse: They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛ ukpidi ɔdubo-ma bubo na bekpi. Na kekpo kadubo-ma bukpo na kɔka kɔda-ma geen. Ukyuli biala ɔɔɔdubo bɔkya na ɔva-ma iye ɔbla-ma kekwa. Mmomu bana ɔlɔna ɔdubunwini adila ute baasɛ ku bebuo. Na lɛla lɛni mebu lɛdubunwini adila lɛkya kalɔ kammɔ lɛmwi.

english_verse: When someone dies, don't visit the family or show any sorrow. I will no longer love or bless or have any pity on the people of Judah.
translation_verse: “Si ukyuli ɔdi úkpi ni, sɔ tesie anii atákya-ma kenye na ewuloku-ma kɔnyana. Nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo Yudaƒuɔ bɔyɔ iye lite-ma kusɛ kusɛ na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-ma kɔnyana lɛnɔ bɔnu.

english_verse: Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.
translation_verse: Balakɛne ku bawabane ƒui badubukpi bewi na ɔdi uláva-ma. Na ɔdi ulewulo-ma keku iye kɔnyana na ukulo lɛlɔ kesii kadi iye ukpeyi kuli.

english_verse: No one will bring food and wine to help comfort those who are mourning the death of their father or mother.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi uleti adila iye ntɛ bɔdi uleboku ulabasia kekwa bablane badi kɔnu na bana ɔti iye uni ɔdi kukpi kemmo.

english_verse: Don't even set foot in a house where there is eating and drinking and celebrating.
translation_verse: “Na kesii kani na bekyuli belie baadi iye baaní taakɛ ebiti adi ni, ƒula ɔgba utanya mmɔ.

english_verse: Warn the people of Judah that I, the Lord All-Powerful, will put an end to all their parties and wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Bo Yudaƒuɔ ɔda kpakplaa se anii ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, ndubo bɔya na bana ebiti emeyi bɔdi ku uleku buti lɛlɔyɔ ƒui kenye kekulo.

english_verse: They will ask, “Why has the Lord our God threatened us with so many disasters? Have we done something wrong or sinned against him?”
translation_verse: “Na badubuye banini, ‘Bi ɔsu na Unwoti ɔ́kya-bu ngba liƒu lɛni ku ɔgbankpi pii ɔmɛni udu? Likpidi iye lɛla lɛdi na bɔ́bla-nwu?’

english_verse: Then tell them I have said: People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: “Mmɔ ni, na asu-ma anini, ‘Amii Yuda kadi bekyuli, bina bati kuuku bénwini kama bákya-mi na béni mina ɔda bubo ku mina ala ani na mɔɔtina-ma na bése kalɔ baakpá baƒiɔ.

english_verse: And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind.
translation_verse: Na bɛ́bla ala ani na ásɔ ébie etulo amɛni! Bɛɛbla atuɔkplu kpakplakpa na ɔni na binu-mi litemi na bedi-ni lɛlɔ ni, ala ekpidi ani nébo-mii kasusu kani na bɛɛbla.

english_verse: So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubo-mii bɔbɔku butákya kalɔ kani kemmo na amii ku bina bati kuuku ƒui bɛɛɛgyi. Kesii kani na bɛdubutaakpa bina baƒiɔ lidu usien ku ɔƒɛ na naaakpete-mii na bina lɛla biala lɛsɔ lilékpoku-mi ina blii suɛ lɛnɔ.’

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔdubo ɔni na bɛdubɔsɔ bibo bibakya-mi lili kalɔ, nsu bɛsɔ bilalɔ-mi bɛnii Ngba Ƒui Katɔti ɔni nédie Israel ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living Lord who rescued you from that country in the north and from the other countries where I had forced you to go. Someday I will bring you back to this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Mmomu bɛdubɔlɔ-mi bɛnii Ngba Ƒui Katɔti ɔni nédie-bu ɔlɛku kalɔ kani na katɔ kakɛ kesii kani na lɛ́bɔku-mii ńtákya mmɔ bekyuli enu kemmo. Na ndubɔsɔku-mii liboku kalɔ kani na líte bina bati kuuku mɛni kemmo dii limeyi lɛdi.

english_verse: But for now, I am sending enemies who will catch you like fish and hunt you down like wild animals in the hills and the caves.
translation_verse: “Nsu ɔƒaani ni, ndubuti bekisine bani ndubo-mii buƒie limene-mii na beƒie-mii aani kɔbɛ na ketu na babwi-mii na badu-mii aani alakpi akɔ bebuo na abi eli ku atakpɛ libu kemmo.

english_verse: I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me.
translation_verse: Mɔɔkana taanu lɛla biala lɛni na bɛɛbla ina dɛ na bɛnii bɛɛbɛla-mi bina ekpidi ani na bɛɛbla.

english_verse: I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies. The Lord Gives Strength I prayed to the Lord:
translation_verse: Ndubo-mii kɔtu bɔni bɔsia kama kunyɔ kunyɔ na bina ekpidi ɔsu, ɔsika bɛ́ya na mina kalɔ kammɔ keesé lɛlɔ. Na bítágyu ala ani neeebo ngba bíbalɛ bɛnii baƒiɔ na si mɔɔnu-nya ni, buse na bese-mi aani bekpine.” Unwoti Muute Ɔyikun

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the one who gives me strength and protects me like a fortress when I am in trouble. People will come to you from distant nations and say, “Our ancestors worshiped false and useless gods,
