translation_verse: Lɛ́kpali Katɔti lívele nnini, “Bula Ɔti, awɔ ndi ukyuli ɔni muute-mi ɔyikun na aagyumana-mi kpakplaa si líduo lɛbibo kemmo. Bekyuli badubɔsi ɔlɔgyu bebo-ɔ kudɔ na babasu-ɔ banini, ‘Bula bati kuuku bákpa baƒiɔ bani neeebo kɔsia kɔdi na balásu litemi geen lɛdi lɛnɔ,

english_verse: worthless idols made by human hands.”
translation_verse: baƒiɔ bekpludi bani na bekyuli béti enu bábla.’ ”

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “That's why I will teach them about my power, and they will know that I truly am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɔmmɔ ɔsu geen na ndubo-ma lɛnunda bɔtina na banu kalɛ na mbo ɔyikun. Na badubɔnu bati ka sɔsɔ ni, ami ndi Katɔti geen ɔmmɔ.”

english_verse: People of Judah, your sins cannot be erased. They are written on your hearts like words chiseled in stone or carved on the corners of your altars. *
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔdi ulakana amii Yuda kadi bekyuli bina ekpidi ani na bɛ́bla bunine budie. Bénweni-nya básia bina kɔyi lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na beebeyi lɛtabi teenweni lɛla lɛdi taasia-ni lɛlɔ iye ala ani na bɛɛnwí taasia bebuo ese ani nlɛ bina akpabi lɛlɔ na akpabi ammɔ ekpo ammɔ.

english_verse: One generation after another has set up pagan altars and worshiped the goddess Asherah everywhere in your country— on hills and mountains, and under large trees.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kaba biala atɔ asia bina ƒui bɛ́lɛ baƒiɔ akpabi bíte lɛlɔ na bɛɛkpá Asera baƒiɔ beledi bammɔ na bina kalɔ kesii biala na abi ku abinkpo lɛlɔ ku egyii enengudi kalɔ.

english_verse: So I'll take everything you own, including your altars, and give it all to your enemies.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubo bina ala ani ƒui na bibo ku bina akpabi ammɔ ƒui bɔƒɔ bute bina bekisine.

english_verse: You will lose the land that I gave you, and I will make you slaves in a foreign country, because you have made my anger blaze up like a fire that won't stop burning. Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Bina kalɔ kani na líte-mii kadubɔlɛ-mii enu na líti-mii lɛbla bekyuli bamba kabla bablane na kaƒɔ, ɔsika bɛ́ya na mina kɔnyi kɔ́kɔ geen aani kalɛ na ogya ɔɔda na ukyuli ɔdi ulakana bunine. Biti Bina Kayi Ƒui Bɛsia Unwoti Lɛlɔ

english_verse: I, the Lord, have put a curse on those who turn from me and trust in human strength.
translation_verse: “Bekyuli bani ƒui nénwini kama bákya-mi na béti bana anu básia bekyuli bayawine ɔyikun lɛlɔ ni, ami Unwoti líwida-ma.

english_verse: They will dry up like a bush in salty desert soil, where nothing can grow.
translation_verse: Badubo bɔkwii bunye aani lɛku kemmo alakpi aani kalɔ kakwiidi kalɔ kani na mma bɔ́ƒɔ-ka lɛlɔ na lɛla biala lilakana bɔkwɛ na lɛlɛ lili na mmɔ.

english_verse: But I will bless those who trust me, the Lord.
translation_verse: “Na bani néti bana anu básia-mi lɛlɔ ni, ndubute-ma kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: They will be like trees growing beside a stream— trees with roots that reach down to the water, and with leaves that are always green. They bear fruit every year and are never worried by a lack of rain.
translation_verse: Na badubɔbla aani egyii ani nákwɛ enye kutudɔ na ana ligyiitu líduo lísie kalɔ ƒui na lɛɛkɛ́ ntu na evete asia-ku lili bili bili uwi biala. Egyii ani nákwɛ enye ketudɔ ina ɔnantu ulána muedi baaadaku-ni.

english_verse: You people of Judah are so deceitful that you even fool yourselves, and you can't change.
translation_verse: “Bibo ɔkɔ geen, amii Yuda kadi bekyuli, na bɛɛtɔ́lɔ amii alati bina lɛlɔ muedi, na bilakana bɔvumana.

english_verse: But I know your deeds and your thoughts, and I will make sure you get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Nsu ngyi bina ablala ku kasusu ƒui, na ndubo bɔnu ka bɛ́kɛ lɛla lɛni na lɛ́manku-mii.

english_verse: You cheated others, but everything you gained will fly away, like birds hatched from stolen eggs. Then you will discover what fools you are. Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Bɛ́nya bina bakpana bɛ́kya, nsu ala ani ƒui na bɛ́kɛ na ese-mii ni, adubo bɔtɔlɔ-mii kudɔ aani baasɛ avala ani na béyu bákya aasɛ bamba kalɔ na évuo. Na mmɔ na bɛdubɔnu bɔti badɔlɔdi bani udu na bɛdi.” Yeremia Ɔ́kpali Katɔti Úvele-nwu

english_verse: Our Lord, your temple is a glorious throne that has stood on a mountain from the beginning.
translation_verse: Bula Unwoti, ƒula kakpakɔ kani na ƒula lɛgadi keliekɔ kani muukeye. Na ényene-ka kɔbi lili ɔ́si ala kalɔ kesekɔ ƒui.

english_verse: You are a spring of water giving Israel life and hope. But if the people reject what you have told me, they will be swept away like words written in dust.
translation_verse: Ese aani libiɔ lɛni mɔɔyu na eete Israelƒuɔ ngba na bebo lɛnunsia na ƒula lɛlɔ. Nsu si bekyuli bammɔ béni lɛla lɛni na ásu-mi ni, adubo-ma bɔkpala bɔtɔlɔ aani lɛla lɛni na bénweni básia ɔtumu akɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the one I praise. So heal me and rescue me! Then I will be completely well and perfectly safe.
translation_verse: Awɔ Unwoti kani na muumwi. Anwuɔsu bwi-mi na edie-mi! Na ndubɔkɛ ɔlɔkplu na lɛkɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: The people of Judah say to me, “Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us what the Lord has said. So why hasn't it come true?”
translation_verse: Yudaƒuɔ baamá-mi taasu-mi banini, “Yeremia, aasu-bu anii Unwoti nákya-a litemi kenye na aasu-bu. Bi ɔsu na ala ani ƒui na aasu elebo-nwu kemmo?”

english_verse: Our Lord, you chose me to care for your people, and that's what I have done. You know everything I have said, and I have never once asked you to punish them.
translation_verse: Unwoti, awɔ náƒuna-mi anii ntaanu ƒula bekyuli lɛlɔ na ɔmmɔ na nnye mɔɔbla. Na lɛla biala na lɛ́su ni, agyi-ni. Na ńtasu-ɔ ina limeyi lɛdi nnii ni-ma kɔtu kɔdi dii.

english_verse: I trust you for protection in times of trouble, so don't frighten me.
translation_verse: Mina kayi ƒui kasia-a lɛlɔ ka adubudie-mi na ɔgbankpi uwi. Anwuɔsu sɔ takya-mi bɔyia.

english_verse: Keep me from failure and disgrace, but make my enemies fail and be disgraced. Send destruction to make their worst fears come true. Resting on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Die-mi na lɛla lɛdi takana bɔbla ku kɔƒa kudɔ. Na aya na mina bekisine mmomu batakana lɛla lɛdi bɔbla na kɔƒa kukpo-ma. Ya na ɔgbankpi ɔlɛku-ma na ala ani na baayia teetulo alɛku-ma. Bɛnwuna Na Lɛnwunameyi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said: I am the Lord, so pay attention.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Yeremia, sie ténye Yerusalem ɔban kayakun biala kenye ku kani na ɔga ɔɔsia mmɔ kenye na atɛmiku ɔga ɔmmɔ ku bekyuli bammɔ ƒui anii ami ndi Unwoti, anwuɔsu bise atu na binu.

english_verse: If you value your lives, don't do any work on the Sabbath. Don't carry anything through the city gates or through the door of your house, or anywhere else. Keep the Sabbath day sacred! I gave this command to your ancestors, but they were stubborn and refused to obey or to be corrected. But if you obey,
translation_verse: Si bɛɛwia bina ngba na bɔ́ƒɔ-mii kuye ni, amu bitabla kabla kadi na Lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ. Na biteti lɛla lɛdi bɛsia lili na bɛsia bɛlɛ ɔban kayakun kadi kenye iye bina kɔduli kayakun iye kesii bamba kadi. “Bɛbla Lɛnwunameyi kedee na bɛda-ni kaduɛ! Ɔda ɔmɛni kani na líbo bina bati kuuku, nsu béni na bátadi-mu lɛlɔ na bétenu kalɔ lɛnɔ banii ukyuli ɔdi ɔlɛ-ma na bada baya. Nsu si amii bɛdubunu na bɛdi ɔda bubo bɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni,

english_verse: then Judah and Jerusalem will always be ruled by kings from David's family. The king and his officials will ride through these gates on horses or in chariots, and the people of Judah and Jerusalem will be with them. There will always be people living in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Dawid ɔtɔ kemmo na ukyuli ɔdubɔsi uwi biala kemmo na ɔdi lɛga na Yuda ku Yerusalem ƒui. Na ɔga ɔmmɔ ku nwuna lɛku batine ƒui badubulie bapɔnkɔ ku bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ na basia beduo lɛban lɛmmɔ kɔyakun na Yuda ku Yerusalem kadi bekyuli lɛnɔ badubɔsiaku-ma. Bekyuli badubɔkya mmɔ tɛɛ uwi biala kemmo.

english_verse: and others will come here from the nearby villages, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the hill country and the foothills to the west, and from the Southern Desert. They will bring sacrifices to please me and to give me thanks, as well as offerings of grain and incense.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli badubɔsi abi lɛlɔ ku abi kaƒɔna lɛma wɛlɛ wɛlɛ bamba lɛni na amadɔ na Yuda ku Benyamin kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ úti úsie ɔƒɛ kanukɔ bebo. Na beti akpala ku edula etela ku oloƒui beboku-ma babagya-mi enu na bakɔ-mi adɛ.

english_verse: But if you keep on carrying things through the city gates on the Sabbath and keep treating it as any other day, I will set fire to these gates and burn down the whole city, including the fortresses.
translation_verse: Nsu si bɛɛgyú ala teeti taasia kɔyakun kɔmɛni taalɛ na Lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ na bɛɛla ala nina lɛlɔ aani limeyi keeke bamba biala ni, ndubo ogya bɔtu bɔkya kɔyakun kɔmmɔ na lɛkyula ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ ƒui ku kɔgyumanakɔ kɔmmɔ ƒui.”

english_verse: The Lord told me,
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: “Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop, and when you get there, I will tell you what to say to the people.”
translation_verse: “Sie kesii kani na baavɔ́ ala. Na si édu mmɔ ni, ndubɔsu-ɔ lɛla lɛni na adubɔsu bekyuli bammɔ.”

english_verse: I went there and saw the potter making clay pots on his pottery wheel.
translation_verse: Amu na lísie mmɔ na ńtánu ka ala ɔvɔne ɔdi ka unye ɔɔvɔ́ ebui na nwuna kavɔ kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.
translation_verse: Na uwi biala na ɔ́nu ka kavɔ kammɔ kalátɛ-nwu kalɛ na ɔɔwia ni, na ɔvumana kɔnu na ute libui lɛmmɔ udu bamba.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nsu-ma nnini,

english_verse: People of Israel, I, the Lord, have power over you, just as a potter has power over clay.
translation_verse: “Amii Israel kadi bekyuli, ami Unwoti mbo ɔyikun na bina lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na ala ɔvɔne ɔmɛni ubo ɔyikun na nwuna lɛvɔti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If I threaten to uproot and shatter an evil nation,
translation_verse: Si lɛ́kya-mii ngba liƒu ka ndubɔyila kadi bekyuli bani na bebo likyulikpi udu badi

english_verse: and that nation turns from its evil, I will change my mind.
translation_verse: na kadi kammɔ bekyuli bávumana bana udu na baabla lɛbuni ni, ndubɔvumana mina kasusu na kɔtu kɔni na nnii mɔɔní-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If I promise to make a nation strong,
translation_verse: “Si líse kenye ka mabla kadi bekyuli badi na bakɛ ɔyikun

english_verse: but its people start disobeying me and doing evil, then I will change my mind and not help them at all.
translation_verse: nsu bekyuli bammɔ bése kalɔ baabla atu ɔkplu ku likyulikpi ala na belenu-mi litemi ni, ndubɔvumana mina kasusu na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-ma bubunku munu munu.

english_verse: So listen to me, people of Judah and Jerusalem! I have decided to strike you with disaster, and I won't change my mind unless you stop sinning and start living right.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na mɔɔsu amii Yudaƒuɔ ku Yerusalemƒuɔ nnii binu-mi lɛdi! Lɛ́ɛbla kasusu ka lɛya na ɔgbankpi ɔdi ɔsiaku-mii momoomo na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo mina kasusu bunwini amu ntu bínwini bina kasusu na bíse kalɔ bɛɛbla ala abuni.

english_verse: But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, “We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please!”
translation_verse: “Nsu ngyi ka bɛɛɛdubo ɔmɛni bunu na bɛvumana. Na bɛdubɔkana na bɛsu muedi bɛnini, ‘Ala ani na aasu ƒui ni, lɛdi lɛɛɛkɛ-bu. Bɔ́ɔbla bula kasusu ka butaabla atu ɔkplu ammɔ na lɛla lɛni na bɔɔyɔ́ na bɔdubo bɔbla.’

english_verse: So I, the Lord, command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu na ami Unwoti lídie-mii lɛdi nnii biye kadi bekyuli bammɔ ƒui binu si badi báabla likpidi bonwu lɛni udu na bɛ́bla mɛni na bínu dii.

english_verse: The snow on Lebanon's mountains never melts away, and the streams there never run dry.
translation_verse: Ɔnantu kɔtakɛ ƒuala ƒuala kɔni mɔɔna teewi Lebanon abi lɛlɔ ni, alanyi taasa. Na ntukpa wɛlɛ wɛlɛ bɔni na bɔkya amadɔ mmɔ lɛnɔ ni, ntu bulákwii-nya kemmo kudii.

english_verse: But you, my people, have turned from me to burn incense to worthless idols. You have left the ancient road to follow an unknown path where you stumble over idols.
translation_verse: Nsu amii mina bekyuli bínwini kama bɛ́kya-mi na bísie bɛɛkyula oloƒui teete baƒiɔ bani neeebo kɔsia kɔdi. Na bɛ́da ulu kuuku ɔni lɛlɔ na bɛkɛ bɛ́va na bítéti ulu ɔwɔdi ɔni na bɛɛɛgyi na bɛkɛ biitulo baƒiɔ lidu lidu.

english_verse: Your land will be ruined, and every passerby will look at it with horror and make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Bina kalɔ kemodi ƒui kadubo udu bɔyii na belusiene bani mɔɔsia mmɔ badubɔnu na liƒu lɛda-ma na bataapii-mii ku edumi.

english_verse: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you. The Plot against Jeremiah
translation_verse: Si bina bekisine báta beekpó-mii ni, ndubo-mii bugyingya bɔkya aani ɔtumu ɔni na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni nási ɔƒɛ katukɔ uubó taavinku. Na ɔgbankpi limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ndubunwini kama lɛkya-mii.” Bása Lili Likpidi Na Yeremia Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.” Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ badi básu banini, “Bɛya na bɔyila Yeremia udu! Na bakpane badubɔkya-bu kudɔ uwi ndi uwi na batina-bu Unwoti ɔda bubo. Na bɔdubɔkɛ banundane na balɛ-bu. Na bɔkɛ kenye bediene bani ndubɔsu-bu Unwoti kenye kani na ubo ute-bu. Anwuɔsu si ɔni na bɔsɔ buteenu Yeremia etemila bɔsu ɔsu ni, bɛya na bɔda-nwu kenye ka ɔ́bla likpidi bonwu lɛdi.” Yeremia Ɔ́kpali Katɔti Úvele Nwuna Bekisine Lili

english_verse: Please, Lord, answer my prayer. Make my enemies stop accusing me of evil.
translation_verse: Unwoti, buvele nda-a nu-mi bɔkpali na aya na mina bekisine bada-mi kɔtɔ bɔdu baya banii lɛ́bla likpidi lɛdi.

english_verse: I tried to help them, but they are paying me back by digging a pit to trap me. I even begged you not to punish them.
translation_verse: Lɛ́sia ulu biala lɛlɔ ka libunku-ma, nsu kayu kani na ama baaƒɔ-mi ndi ka bakɛ beekú-mi kalɔ ka lɛnu liduo bana kakpagyuɛ ubu ɔni na béku báva-mi kemmo. Na lívele-ɔ muedi nnii tani-ma kɔtu.

english_verse: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒaani anwu útulo-mi na muuvele-ɔ nnii ya na kɔka kɔdu bana bebi na bekpi iye badu-ma na kekpokɔ. Na aya na banana bekpi na bana beleku kudɔ na ɔlɛ ɔdu bana bebi na babla-ma kalala na bekpi.

english_verse: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord. Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.
translation_verse: Unwoti bekyuli bamɛni bédie libu bákya mina kavikɔ na bákywɛ-mi kɔkpagyuɛ. Ya na liƒu ala alɛku-ma na beteebo kɔnu kenye uwi ɔni na adubuti bana bekisine emene-ma na betékpo-ma na bana kɔduli kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: You know they plan to kill me. So get angry and punish them! Don't ever forgive their terrible crimes.
translation_verse: Agyi ka bábla kasusu ka badu-mi. Anwuɔsu ti kɔnyi kya-ma na ani-ma kɔtu! Na teti bɔƒiɔ bonwu bɔmɛni takyiɛ-ma kudii.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Yeremia, sie ebui ɔvɔne ala kavɔkɔ na etéye libui lɛdi. Na akpanku ɔma ɔmmɔ bakutine ku bakpane benengu ada.

english_verse: and go to Hinnom Valley, just outside Potsherd Gate. Tell the people that I have said:
translation_verse: Na bisie Hinom Kɔwɛ kemmo na kesii kani baalɔ banii kavɔ abwɛdi ɔban kenye na asu bekyuli bammɔ anii ami nnini,

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
translation_verse: ‘Ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, na mɔɔyá na amii Yudaƒuɔ baga ku Yerusalem bekyuli ƒui bɛti ka ɔlɛka bise atu na binu lɛla lɛni mɔɔsu-mii na ɔdia-mii utulo. Ɔsika ndubo bɔya na ɔgbankpi bonwu lidu lidu libo libalɛ na kɔwɛ kɔmɛni kemmo ɔni na ukyuli biala menu kɔku kɔmmɔ ɔdubo bɔyia geen.

english_verse: The people of Judah stopped worshiping me and made this valley into a place of worship for Baal and other gods that have never helped them or their ancestors or their kings. And they have committed murder here, burning their young, innocent children as sacrifices to Baal. I have never even thought of telling you to do that.
translation_verse: Yuda kadi bekyuli béni na basɔ balakpa-mi na béti kɔwɛ kɔmɛni kemmo bénwini Baal baƒiɔ ku baƒiɔ lidu bamba bani nétebunku ama ku bana bati kuuku iye bana baga badi kudii kakpakɔ. Na bádu bekyuli na mɛni na baakyula bana bebi bani naaagyi lɛla lɛdi na bátabla lɛla lɛdi lɛnɔ teeti taakpa baƒiɔ bammɔ. Na ami ńtakali kudii nnii mɔɔsu-mii na bɛbla lɛla lɛmɛni udu bite-mi.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu binye kagyumana! Limeyi lɛdi lɛdubo ɔni na basɔ baaadubo mɛni bɔlɔ banii Toƒet iye Hinom Kɔwɛ. Mmomu badubɔlɔ mɛni banii Bekyuli Kadukɔ Kɔwɛ!

english_verse: You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: “ ‘Amii Yuda ku Yerusalemƒuɔ bɛdubɔbla kasusu bɛsiku ala enengudi lɛlɔ, nsu mɛni na ndubo kɔsusu kɔmmɔ ƒui kemmo bubile na lɛya na bina bekisine badu-mii na baasɛ baduli-mii ɔlɔna bebweli ƒui kede kede.

english_verse: I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Ndubɔya na ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ únwini aani kebu alakpi ku lɛmala na ɔbla bekyuli bammɔ kalɛ kadi na ukyuli biala ɔni násia mmɔ ɔɔví ɔpii-mii na udumi-mii lɛnɔ na bina ɔgbankpi ɔsu.

english_verse: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni kani na bina bekisine badubɔbwɛ beduo-mii lɛlɔ na beteekpoku-mii mmɔ lɛlɔ kani na bina adila adubo bɔsa ƒui. Na kɔka kɔdubo-mii bɔda ɔni na bɛdubo bina bakpana ku bebi muedi ɔlɔna bɔkun aani lɛna.’

english_verse: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.
translation_verse: “Na si uwi ɔni na ásu ɔmɛni ni, Yeremia, na ebo libui lɛmmɔ abwɛ na bekyuli bammɔ anumi mmɔ kani.

english_verse: Then tell them that I have also said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
translation_verse: Na asu-ma ka lɛ́su lɛnɔ nnini, ‘Ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui na mɔɔsu-mii kpakplaa ka ndubo Yuda ku Yerusalem kadi ku kalɔ kammɔ bɔbwɛ aani kalɛ na libui lɛmɛni lɛ́bwɛ na bɔsa bɔsɔ buuubo-ni lɛlɔ. Na Toƒet mɛni na bɛdubo bina bekpine bɔva. Na bina akɔ pii bɛdubo bukpi ɔni na kalɔ kasɔ kaaadubo bɔkya na bava bina ƒui.

english_verse: I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods. Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
translation_verse: Ndubo bɔya na Yerusalem uteese lɛlɔ aani Toƒet kalɛ na uwi ɔni na bekpine badubɔƒɔ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo ƒui ɔsu. Na lɛla lɛni ɔsu na ndubo ɔmɛni bɔbla ndi ka bɛ́kɔ bísie bina lɛtɔ eli na lɛsa na bítákyula oloƒui bíte ayabi ani nƒa kayaa aani baƒiɔ kalɛ na bíti ntɛ bɛ́bla akpala bíte kadi bamba baƒiɔ.’ ” Yeremia Únye Kakpakɔ Kaduli Kemmo Na Ɔ́tɛmi

english_verse: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people,
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, lɛ́gyu lísie Toƒet kesii kani na ńtásu bekyuli bammɔ lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su. Na lɛ́vi lísie kakpakɔ kaduli kemmo na ńtákɔ lɛsa líte bekyuli bammɔ nnini,

english_verse: “Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
translation_verse: “Bina ɔdi biala use kɔtu na unu! Uwi ɔdi návi kemmo ni, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, ɔ́su-mii kpakplaa ka ɔdubɔya na ɔgbankpi ubo Yerusalem lɛlɔ ku lɛma lɛni na amadɔ mmɔ ƒui. Nsu bɛbla atuɔkplu na bíbulo-nwu litemi bunu. Na ɔƒaani ni, Unwoti ɔdubo bɔya na ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ ɔlɛ aani kalɛ na úse kenye úse.”

english_verse: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said,
translation_verse: Amu na Immer ubidi Pasur ɔni ndi ɔkpane ku kakpakɔ bagyumanane unengu únu lɛla lɛni na lɛ́su mmɔ.

english_verse: and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ya na bébo-mi kaduɛ na ɔ́ya na béƒie-mi na bebo-mi kɔgba bákya kakpakɔ ɔtɔ kemmo na kesii kani na baalɔ Benyamin ɔban kayakun.

english_verse: The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said: No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything.
translation_verse: Kadi kegye uwi ɔni na Pasur ɔ́nyonu-mi na mɔɔtɔlɔ mmɔ ni, lɛ́su-nwu nnini, “Unwoti ɔnii, ‘Nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-ɔ bɔlɔ nnii Pasur, mmomu ndubɔlɔ-ɔ nnii Uƒuluƒuluti.

english_verse: You will be afraid, and you will bring fear to your friends as well. You will see enemies kill them in battle. Then I will let the king of Babylonia take everyone in Judah prisoner, killing some and dragging the rest away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Liƒu kani ndubo-ɔ butaada na adubuti liƒu lɛmmɔ akya ƒula bekyuli lɛlɔ. Na adubɔnu kalɛ na bekisine badubo-ma bɔdu na kekpokɔ. Na ndubɔya na Babilon ɔga uƒie ukyuli biala na Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ ɔtɔlɔku na binwini-nwu bekyuli beƒiedi na ɔdu badi.

english_verse: He will clean out the royal treasury and take everything else of value from Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubugyingya lɛla biala na ubo-ni unwini na ɔga kesii egulabi kavumi kesekɔ mmɔ na uti lɛla biala na lɛ́ƒɔ kuye na mmɔ ɔtɔlɔku Yerusalem.

english_verse: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried. Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Pasur, áƒiɔ-mi na uwi ɔni na enye aanyi ɔkɔ, nsu aasu taatina ka ami mina kenye na aasu bekyuli. Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu na ndubɔya na Babilonƒuɔ betiku-ɔ ku ƒula kaduli bekyuli ku bakpana ƒui batɔlɔku aani bekyuli beƒiedi besienku Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ kesii kani na bɛdubo bukpi na bava-mii mmɔ.’ ” Yeremia Ɔ́kyaku Unwoti Unyeƒi

english_verse: You tricked me, Lord, and I was really fooled. You are stronger than I am, and you have defeated me. People never stop sneering and insulting me.
translation_verse: Unwoti átɔlɔ-mi na ábu-mi kɔdɔlɔ. Na ebo ɔyikun etulo-mi ɔsu ádi-mi lɛlɔ. Na bekyuli benye beedumi-mi uwi ndi uwi na baapii-mi.

english_verse: You have let me announce only injustice and death. Your message has brought me nothing but insults and trouble.
translation_verse: Ala bubile ku kukpi lɛsa kani na áya na mɔɔkɔ́ teete bekyuli bammɔ. Na ƒula kenye kani na mɔɔsu mmɔ káya na edumi ku lɛbibo kani na mɔɔsiáku uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Sometimes I tell myself not to think about you, Lord, or even mention your name. But your message burns in my heart and bones, and I cannot keep silent.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔbla-mi uwi ɔdi aani nda ƒula lɛlɔ kasusu buti iye ƒula lɛnyi muedi bɔlɔ nnya. Nsu ƒula litemi lɛɛdu-mi lɛlɔ kemmo aani ogya na naaakana na libile kenye lɛsɔ lilie kpoo.

english_verse: I heard the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid. Now's our chance to accuse Jeremiah!” All of my so-called friends are just waiting for me to make a mistake. They say, “Maybe Jeremiah can be tricked. Then we can overpower him and get even at last.”
translation_verse: Muunú ka bekyuli bammɔ baatɛmi kabɛnsɛ banini, “Ukyuli biala ɔɔyia na uwi ɔmɛni geen na ɔlɛka budie Yeremia bɔƒiɔ na bɔdu-nwu kɔtɔ!” Na bekyuli bani ƒui na mɔɔlɔ nnii mina bakpana ƒui benye kagyumana ka banu mina likpidi lɛdi na bakɛ kasiakɔ. Na baasu banini, “Ɔƒɛni kalɛ Yeremia ɔdubɔƒiɔ ɔbla lɛla lɛdi na ɔnu-bu kakpagyuɛ na bɔsia ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ bɔkɛ-nwu.”

english_verse: But you, Lord, are a mighty soldier, standing at my side. Those troublemakers will fall down and fail— terribly embarrassed, forever ashamed.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, awɔ Unwoti, adi mina ukpone ɔyikune ɔni na enye-mi kama ɔsu ni, bekyuli bani mɔɔwia bakya-ma lɛsɛ mmɔ ƒui badubo bubuli na balakana-mi mmomu anumi adubuwi-ma kalɔ na beƒu na kɔƒa kukpo-ma uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.
translation_verse: Unwoti awɔ mɔɔkɔ́ku bekyuli bani mɔɔbla lɛbuni ƒui taanu na agyi ukyuli biala kayi ku kasusu kemmo ƒui. Lɛ́su-ɔ ala ani muukpóku-mi. Anwuɔsu ya na lɛnu kalɛ na adubudie mina bekisine kasi.

english_verse: I sing praises to you, Lord. You rescue the oppressed from the wicked.
translation_verse: Unwoti muudie lɛnu teemwi-ɔ, ɔsika awɔ muudie bekyuli bani na baanya taakya taalɛku balalane enu kemmo.

english_verse: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.
translation_verse: Taya na kusɛ ɔsiaku limeyi lɛni néti-mi líboku kayawi. Na taya na kuse kusɛ ɔsiaku mina uni lɛnɔ!

english_verse: Put a curse on the man who told my father, “Good news! You have a son.”
translation_verse: Na ɔnana ɔni nésie útásu mina ɔti ɔnini, “Mbo! Ákɛ ɔnanabi” ni, kusɛ kusɛ utasiaku-nwu.

english_verse: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔmmɔ keyi kabla aani lɛma lɛni na ábwɛ na átanu-ni kɔnyana mmɔ. Na aya na uteenu kɔnu kenye ɔtanta biala ku kekpo kɔku na ɔƒiiwi.

english_verse: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka nka bukpi na anwu lɛnɔ ukpi na ɔni na úni na útadu-mi asa na lɛlɛ mbewi kalɔ banii ubi na báwɔ ɔsu. Nka mina uni kaƒɔ kemmo ndubunwini mina kaƒiɔtɔ.

english_verse: Why did I have to be born? Was it just to suffer and die in shame?
translation_verse: Bi geen ɔsu na ɔlɛka bawɔ-mi? Lɛbibo lɛmɛni kani ɔsu na likpi ku kɔƒa?

english_verse: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
translation_verse: Ɔga Sedekia, Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga, ɔ́tala ɔnii batálɔ Malkia ubidi ɔnanabi ɔni baalɔ banii Pasur ku ɔkpane ɔni baalɔ banii Seƒania na ɔdi Maseya ubidi beboku. Mmɔ na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛtɛmiku Yeremia bite-mi.” Amu na bébo-mi kudɔ na bábasu-mi banini,

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: “Babilonƒuɔ ɔga ɔni baalɔ banii Nebukadnesar úbo uukpóku Yuda, anwuɔsu vele Unwoti na ɔbla akɔla budie taatina adi ute bula bekyuli aani kalɛ na ɔ́bla úte-bu kuuku uwi ɔni návi kemmo na Nebukadnesar ɔda-bu ɔnyonu.”

english_verse: I told them that the Lord God of Israel had told me to say to King Zedekiah: The Babylonians have surrounded Jerusalem and want to kill you and your people. You are asking me to save you, but you have made me furious. So I will stretch out my mighty arm and fight against you myself. Your army is using spears and swords to fight the Babylonians, but I will make your own weapons turn and attack you. I will send a horrible disease to kill many of the people and animals in Jerusalem, and there will be nothing left to eat. Finally, I will let King Nebuchadnezzar and his army fight their way to the center of Jerusalem and capture everyone who is left alive, including you and your officials. But Nebuchadnezzar won't be kind or show any mercy—he will have you killed! I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́su bekyuli bammɔ ka Unwoti Israel Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nya na Ɔga Sedekia ɔti ɔnini, “Babilonƒuɔ báka bámana Yerusalem ɔma ɔmmɔ na baawia ka badu-ɔ ku ƒula kadi bekyuli ƒui. Na ɔƒaani eevele-mi anii nƒɔ-mii, nsu bɛ́kya-mi kɔnyi geen. Anwuɔsu ami ɔlati ndubo-mii bukpo. Ƒula bekpone bada atula ku kuwii beekpó Babilonƒuɔ, nsu ndubɔya na amii alati bina ekpola enwini ekpo-mii. Na lɛya na lɛlɛ likpidi libo-mii lɛlɔ na amii ku bina bebuo pii bekpi na Yerusalem. english_verse: I'll send troops to tear it apart, and its beautiful cedar beams will be used for firewood.

english_verse: That's what it means to truly know me. So he lived a comfortable life and always had enough to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni mɔɔtina geen ka ukyuli ɔgyi-mi na lɛdi mmɔ. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na úlie ngba ku atu bɔyɔ na ubo ala na édu-nwu na ɔdi na ɔni lɛnɔ uwi biala.

english_verse: But all you think about is how to cheat or abuse or murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ ƒula kasusu kani ndi kalɛ na abla na anya bekyuli akya iye akɛ-ma lɛlɔ kɔsia kɔdi iye adu bekyuli bani na bátabla-a lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Jehoiakim, no one will mourn at your funeral. They won't turn to each other and ask, “Why did our great king have to die?”
translation_verse: “Yehoiakim, ukyuli biala ɔɔɔdubo buwulo na ƒula kukpi kalɔ. Na baaadubo bunwini na beye lɛlɔ muedi banini, ‘Bi ɔsu na ɔga ɔbune ɔmɛni úkpi?’

english_verse: You will be given a burial fit for a donkey; your body will be dragged outside the city gates and tossed in the dirt. I, the Lord, have spoken. King Jehoiachin and the People of Jerusalem The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Bɔva kani na badubo-ɔ aani kalɛ na ɔ́manku ebuo ala utine ɔni nékpi. Ɔsika bɔkpɛ na badubo ƒula ɔlɔna basiku ɔma kemmo balɛku ɔma ɔban kenye bebo batáva alakpi akɔ na kebu. Ami Unwoti násu.” Ɔga Yehoiakim Ku Yerusalem Kadi Bekyuli Lɛlɔ Kɔtɔ

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, the nations you trusted have been crushed. Go to Lebanon and weep; cry in the land of Bashan and in Moab.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Amii Yerusalemƒuɔ, kadi bani bekyuli lɛlɔ na bíti anu bɛ́sia ni, bana lɛma na bábwɛ mɛni. Bisie Lebanon na bitéwulo kɔnyana na bisie Basan kalɔ lɛlɔ na Moabƒuɔ kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ bitéwulo keku.

english_verse: When times were good, I warned you. But you ignored me, just as you have done since Israel was young.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ala adianku-mii ni, lɛ́lɛ-mii lɛ́nɔ na bítenu na bíni aani kalɛ kani na bɛ́bla ɔ́si uwi ɔni na bítalɛ tɔ lili.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced because of your sins. Your leaders will be swept away by the wind, and the nations you trusted will be captured and dragged to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani ni, kɔƒa kɔdubo-mii bukpo na bina ekpidi ɔsu. Na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔdubo butiku bina batɔnkune batɔlɔku ƒui. Na kadi bani bekyuli lɛlɔ na bíti bina anu bɛ́sia ni, badubo-ma buƒie bɔtɔlɔku ƒui busienku kalɔ bamba na kaƒɔ.

english_verse: Those who live in the palace paneled with cedar will groan with pain like women giving birth.
translation_verse: Amii bani nli baga kesii kani na béti Lebanon egyii kpakplaa bábla lɛtalagyii na béti ligyii lɛmmɔ bákya kayakun kɔlɛmikɔ kɔmmɔ ƒui akya ni, bɛdubo buteedumo na biteewulo kɔnyana aani uleku ɔni ntɛ kɔwɔ.

english_verse: King Jehoiachin, son of Jehoiakim, even if you were the ring I wear as the sign of my royal power, I would still pull you from my finger.
translation_verse: “Ɔga Yekonia, Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga Yehoiakim ubidi, ina awɔ ndi kakwɛnimi kani nkya-mi kɔnu aani likposela úte mina lɛgadi ɔyikun muedi ni, ndubɔni-ka lidie mina kɔnu.

english_verse: I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you.
translation_verse: Na ndubuti-ɔ lɛkya Ɔga Nebukadnesar ku nwuna bekpone bani mɔɔwia-a badu na badi ƒula bekisine bani na aayia enu kemmo.

english_verse: You and your mother were born in Judah, but I will throw both of you into a foreign country, where you will die,
translation_verse: Awɔ ku ƒ'ini ƒui nka Yuda na báwɔ-mii, nsu ndubo-mii bɔbɔku butákya baƒɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ kesii kani na bɛdubusie bitékpi,

english_verse: longing to return home.
translation_verse: ina ka ɔma bubo bɔdubɔda-mii ɔkwɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiachin, you are unwanted like a broken clay pot. So you and your children will be thrown into a country you know nothing about.
translation_verse: “Yekonia, ukyuli biala údie-ɔ atu na basɔ balayɔ-ɔ aani libui lɛni nábwɛ. Anwuɔsu awɔ ku ƒula bebi ƒui na badubo bɔbɔku butákya kalɔ kani na bɛɛɛgyi-ka lɛlɔ lɛla lɛdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Land of Judah, I am the Lord. Now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Na awɔ Yuda kalɔ kemodi kammɔ ƒui ni, se kɔtu na enu lɛla lɛni na ami Unwoti mɔɔsu!

english_verse: Erase the names of Jehoiachin's children from the royal records. He is a complete failure, and so none of them will ever be king. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Nine Yekonia ku nwuna bebi ƒui die bagadine ɔku ɔmmɔ kemmo, ɔsika anwu úse úbo kalɔ ƒui na útakana lɛla lɛla bɔbla. Anwuɔsu nwuna bebi ɔkɔ ɔdi biala uladi lɛga kudii. Ami Unwoti násu.”

english_verse: You leaders of my people are like shepherds that kill and scatter the sheep.
translation_verse: “Amii bani ntɔnku mina kadi bekyuli bise aani baƒonu badane bani mɔɔdú baƒonu bammɔ na beegyingya-ma.

english_verse: You were supposed to take care of my people, but instead you chased them away. So now I'll punish you severely and make you pay for your crimes!
translation_verse: Amii na nka ɔlɛka bɛnu mina bekyuli lɛlɔ, nsu bunwini na bínwini bɛ́bi bɛsiaku-ma na bɛɛbɔku-ma taatɔlɔku mmomu. Anwuɔsu ami ɔlati ndubo-mii bɔda ɔƒɛni amu na mɔɔsu-mii geen ka bɛdubo bina ekpidi biala kayu bɔƒɔ!

english_verse: I will bring the rest of my people home from the lands where I have scattered them, and they will grow into a mighty nation.
translation_verse: “Ndubɔkpanku mina kadi bekyuli bakladi bani nébu bɔsiku kɔlɔ kɔni na lígyingya-ma lɛ́kya buboku ɔma na basɔ benwini kadi bekyuli bayikune bonwu.

english_verse: I promise to choose leaders who will care for them like real shepherds. All of my people will be there, and they will never again be frightened.
translation_verse: Na muusé kenye ka ndubɔƒuna batɔnkune bani manu-ma lɛlɔ kaduɛ aani baƒonu badane babuni lite-ma. Na mina bekyuli bammɔ badubɔsa belie mmɔ na basɔ balayia lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Someday I will appoint an honest king from the family of David, a king who will be wise and rule with justice.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛdi ni, ndubɔƒuna ɔga ɔni mɔɔsu litemi geen lɛsiku Dawid kaduli. Na ɔdubɔbla ɔga ɔni náda anu na ɔdubɔdi bekyuli lɛlɔ na ɔtɛ litemi na ulu siin ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: As long as he is king, Israel will have peace, and Judah will be safe. The name of this king will be “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni ƒui na ɔdubulie ɔdi lɛga lɛmmɔ ni, Israel ɔdubulie ku keyi buɛɛ. Na lɛla biala lise kpoo na Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na lɛnyi lɛni na ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔdi ndi Unwoti Uute Litemi Bɔtɛ Ulu Siin Lɛlɔ.

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living God who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔdubo ɔni na bɛsɔ bɛdubo-mi bɔkpa, nsu bɛsɔ bɛɛɛdubo-mi bɔlɔ bɛnii Ngba ƒui Katɔti ɔni nédie-bu ɔ́lɛku Egyipteƒuɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living God who rescued you from the land in the north and from all the other countries where I had forced you to go. And you will once again live in your own land. Jeremiah Thinks about Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: Mmomu bɛdubɔlɔ-mi bɛnii Ngba ƒui Katɔti ɔni nédie-bu ɔ́lɛku kalɔ kani nkya katɔ kakɛ bekyuli enu kemmo ku kɔlɔ kɔni lɛlɔ na ɔ́bɔku-bu útákya enu kemmo. Na bɛdubɔsɔ bibelie amii alati kalɔ lɛlɔ.” Yeremia Ɔ́bla Kasusu Ɔ́siku Ɔkɔ Kenye Bediene Lɛlɔ

english_verse: When I think of the prophets, I am shocked, and I tremble like someone drunk, because of the Lord and his sacred words.
translation_verse: Si lɛ́kali kenye bediene bamɛni litemi lɛ́nu ni, kayi keesé taakpulu-mi geen na anu ka lɛlɔ lɛɛtɔ́-mi aani ukyuli ɔni na úkpi ntɛ na Unwoti ku nwuna etemila ani nse kedee ɔsu.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: You prophets and priests think so little of me, the Lord, that you even sin in my own temple!
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Amii kenye bediene ku bakpane bɛsɔ bilábla kasusu gyɔlɔɔ kadi taasiku-mi lɛlɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na bɛɛkana na bɛɛbla likpidi na mina anumi na ami ɔlati kakpakɔ kemmo muedi!

english_verse: Now I will punish you with disaster, and you will slip and fall in the darkness. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani ni, ndubo-mii kɔtu bɔni ku ɔgbankpi ɔdi. Na bɛdubo bugyiile na bibuli na kasuudikɔ. Ami Unwoti násu.

english_verse: The prophets in Samaria were repulsive to me, because they preached in the name of Baal and led my people astray.
translation_verse: “Samariaƒuɔ kenye bediene beesé-mi lɛlɔ, ɔsika Baal baƒiɔ etemila kenye na beedie. Na bátɔnku mina kadi bekyuli na báya na báyii ulu.

english_verse: And you prophets in Jerusalem are even worse. You're unfaithful in marriage and never tell the truth. You even lead others to sin instead of helping them turn back to me. You and the people of Jerusalem are evil like Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: Na amii kenye bediene bani nkya Yerusalem ɔdi ɔsɔ utulo bana ɔdi ƒui. Bɛɛlɛ́-mi kama taatásiaku ala bamba kama na bilásu litemi geen lɛdi. Na bɛɛtɔnku bekyuli bamba muedi na baabla likpidi na uwi ɔni na nka bibunku-ma na benwini na bana ekpidi kama na bebo-mi kudɔ. Amii ku Yerusalemƒuɔ ƒui bɛdi bekyuli bekpidi aani Sodom ku Gomora kadi bekyuli.

english_verse: You prophets in Jerusalem have spread evil everywhere. That's why I, the Lord, promise to give you bitter poison to eat and drink. The Lord Gives a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Amii kenye bediene bani nkya Yerusalem bɛ́ɛgyingya likpidi bɛ́kya kesi kesii. Anwuɔsu na ami Unwoti líse kenye ka ndubute-mii likpila na bɛdi na bɛni.” Unwoti Ɔ́lɛ Bekyuli Bammɔ Kpakplaa

english_verse: Don't listen to the lies of these false prophets, you people of Judah! The message they preach is something they imagined; it did not come from me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini, “Amii Yudaƒuɔ! Bitenu ɔkɔ kenye bediene bamɛni ɔkɔ etemila ani na baasu. Ɔsika ama alati bana kasusu kani na belie beeti etemila na adi na ɔɔɔdi ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui kudɔ na ási.

english_verse: These prophets go to people who refuse to respect me and who are stubborn and do whatever they please. The prophets tell them, “The Lord has promised everything will be fine.”
translation_verse: Kenye bediene bamɛni beesié batuɔkplune bani néni banii balabla-mi kabla na benye baabla ala ani na baayɔ́ kudɔ. Na beesié taatásu-ma banini, ‘Unwoti ɔ́su úse ka lɛla biala lɛdubo bɔtɛ ɔsu lɛla lɛdi liiibo.’

english_verse: But I, the Lord, tell you that these prophets have never attended a meeting of my council in heaven or heard me speak.
translation_verse: Nsu ami Unwoti mɔɔyá na bɛti ka ami ku kenye bediene bamɛni akɔ ɔdi bútelie bútadi kasusu na ami ku mina kɔtɔ kabla bablane badi kelisa kadi kemmo kudii iye benu ka bɔɔsu lɛla lɛdi kudii.

english_verse: They are evil! So in my anger I will strike them like a violent storm.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi na badi! Na ndubo-ma bubo bɔƒiɛmi kalɔ aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uubó ala teewi kalɔ.

english_verse: I won't calm down, until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday you will understand exactly what I mean.
translation_verse: “Na mina kɔnyi kɔɔɔdubo-mi bɔyɔ wetédu uwi ɔni na lɛ́bla lɛla lɛni na lɛ́lɛ ugyii ka mabla lɛ́wɔlɔ. Na limeyi lɛdubo lɛni na bɛdubunu lɛla lɛni geen na mɔɔsu mɛni kalɔ.

english_verse: I did not send these prophets or speak to them, but they ran to find you and to preach their message.
translation_verse: Ńtatala kenye bediene bamɛni na ńtasu-ma lɛla lɛdi lɛnɔ, nsu bakɛ usi bébo-mii kudɔ bébo baakɔ́ ama alati bana etemila lɛsa teete-mii.

english_verse: If they had been in a meeting of my council in heaven, they would have told you people of Judah to give up your sins and come back to me.
translation_verse: Si bɔkya na bákya katɔ mmɔ na mina kelisa kasusu betine akɔ ni, nka badubɔsu amii Yudaƒuɔ na binwini kama bɛkya bina ekpidi na binwini bibo-mi kudɔ.

english_verse: I am everywhere— both near and far,
translation_verse: Ami nkya kesi kesii na kagyudikɔ ku kani nátagyu ƒui.

english_verse: in heaven and on earth. There are no secret places where you can hide from me.
translation_verse: Na abɛla iye kabɛkɔ kadi keeebo katɔ ku kalɔ kesii kadi na bina lɛla lɛdi lɛdubɔbɛ-mi.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim that I have given them a dream or a vision, and then they tell lies in my name.
translation_verse: “Kenye bediene bani nálɛ-mii kama mɛni baasu taatina ka ami náya na bégye ana iye ami nédie lɛla lɛdi lɛ́tina-ma na kɔyu kemmo na benye-mi lɛnyi lɛlɔ baanyi ɔkɔ.

english_verse: But everything they say comes from their own twisted minds. How long can this go on?
translation_verse: Nsu ala ani ƒui na baasu ási bana kasusu kani néƒu na bénwini ala bálɛ kemmo. Na uwi ɛlɛ na badubunye bataabla lɛla lɛmɛni udu?

english_verse: They tell each other their dreams and try to get my people to reject me, just as their ancestors left me and worshiped Baal.
translation_verse: Baasu lɛlɔ ana ani na bégye na baada bekyuli kasusu teedie-mi lɛlɔ kalɛ na beni-mi aani kalɛ kani na bana bati kuuku béni-mi na bésie baakpá Baal baƒiɔ.

english_verse: Their dreams and my truth are as different as straw and wheat. But when prophets speak for me, they must say only what I have told them.
translation_verse: Kavumana bonwu kakya bana ana ani na bégye ku mina litemi geen ntɛ aani kamu ku keti. Anwuɔsu si kenye udiene ɔdi úsie utásu mina kenye bɔdi ni, ɔlɛka ɔsu litemi geen lɛni na lɛ́su mmɔ kani.

english_verse: My words are a powerful fire; they are a hammer that shatters rocks.
translation_verse: Mina etemila ebo ɔyikun aani ogya. Na ese aani lɛbuala bonwu lɛni na beeti teebo atakpɛ teegyingya.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim I give them their dreams, but it isn't true. I didn't choose them to be my prophets, and yet they babble on and on, speaking in my name, while stealing words from each other. And when my people hear these liars, they are led astray instead of being helped. So I warn you that I am now the enemy of these prophets. I, the Lord, have spoken. News and Nuisance The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: “Kenye bediene bani nálɛ-mi kama mɛni baasu taatina ka ami náya na bégye ana, nsu ɔmmɔ ɔɔɔdi litemi geen. Ɔsika ami ńtaƒuna-ma nnii babla mina kenye bediene, nsu bakɛ baaká ala taavi na mina lɛnyi kemmo taasia kama na beeyú bana bakpana etemila taasɔku taasu bekyuli. Na si mina bekyuli bénu ɔkɔ etemila amɛni lɛnɔ ni, elébunku-ma ulu biala lɛlɔ mmomu bɔda na aada-ma kasusu teedie-mi lɛlɔ mmomu na baayii ulu. Anwuɔsu mɔɔsu-mii kpakplaa ɔƒɛni ka línwini kenye bediene bamɛni ukisine. Ami Unwoti násu.” Linyesia Na Ala Ani Muukpóku Unwoti Lɛla

english_verse: Jeremiah, when a prophet or a priest or anyone else comes to you and asks, “Does the Lord have news for us?” tell them, “You people are a nuisance to the Lord, and he will get rid of you.”
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Yeremia, si kenye udiene ɔdi iye ɔkpane ɔdi iye ukyuli bamba ɔdi biala úbo na úbeye-ɔ ɔnini, ‘Bi kenye na Unwoti ubo ute-bu ni?’ na asu-ma anini, ‘Bɛdi bekyuli bani lɛlɔ mɔɔdá Unwoti ɔƒɛ geen na, anwuɔsu na ɔdubo-mii udu bɔyila.’

english_verse: If any of you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” I will punish you and your families, even if you are a prophet or a priest.
translation_verse: “Na si bina akɔ ɔdi ɔsɔku litemi lɛmɛni utásu ukyuli ɔdi ɔnii ami Unwoti násu-nwu nnii ɔkɔ lɛsa ute ukyuli ɔdi ni, ndubo ukyuli ɔmmɔ ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli ƒui bɔdu ina kenye udiene na ɔnii ɔdi iye ɔkpane na ɔdi.

english_verse: Instead, you must ask your friends and relatives, “What answer did the Lord give?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Mmomu buye na ɔdi ka biye lɛlɔ ku bina bakpana binu bɛnini, ‘Bi kenye na Unwoti údie? Iye dɛ na ɔ́su?’

english_verse: It seems that you each have your own news! So if you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” you are twisting my words into a lie. Remember that I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Use aani ka bina akɔ ɔdi biala ubo lɛla lɛni na ɔsu! Anwuɔsu si bɛsɔ bɛɛlɔ-mi lɛnyi taasu lɛla lɛdi bɛnii lɛni na ami Unwoti mɔɔsu ni, na bɛɛtu-mi etemila teenwini ɔkɔ. Na binyimo ka ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui.

english_verse: If you go to a prophet, it's all right to ask, “What answer did the Lord give to my question?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: “Si ɔdi ése kenye udiene kudɔ ni, ɔdia si éye-nwu anini, ‘Bi kenye na Unwoti údie iye bi na ɔ́su ɔ́siku litemi lɛni na búye-nwu lɛlɔ?’

english_verse: But if you disobey me and say, “Here is news from the Lord,”
translation_verse: Nsu si bítenu ɔmɛni na ɔdi ɔ́ta ɔnii lɛsa na utátaakɔ ka ami nátala-nwu ni,

english_verse: I will pick you up and throw you far away. And I will abandon this city of Jerusalem that I gave to your ancestors.
translation_verse: ndubo ukyuli ɔmmɔ bɔbɔku budie mina anumi ƒui kede kede busienku ɔgyu kakaaka. Na lini Yerusalem ɔma unengudi ɔni na líti líte bina bati kuuku mɛni ƒui.

english_verse: You will never be free from your shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Na bina anumi adubuwi kalɔ na kɔƒa kɔmmɔ kulálɛ-mii lɛlɔ kudii.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in a vision after King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had come to Judah and taken King Jehoiachin, his officials, and all the skilled workers back to Babylonia. In this vision I saw two baskets of figs in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́tɛmiku-mi na kɔyu kemmo uwi na Babilonƒuɔ ɔga ɔni baalɔ Nebukadnesar úbo Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ kama. Ɔga ɔmɛni úbo úbekpo na úƒie Yuda Ɔga Yehoiakim ubidi ɔni baalɔ Yekonia ku nwuna lɛku batine ku kabla bablane bani mbo kasusu geen ɔ́tɔlɔku úsienku Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na kɔyu kemmo ala bɔnu bɔmɛni kemmo ni, lɛ́nu kɔgyigyɛ inyɔ ku egyiibi tɛtɛɛtɛ ka alɛ Katɔti kakpakɔ kammɔ anumi.

english_verse: One basket was full of very good figs that ripened early, and the other was full of rotten figs that were not fit to eat.
translation_verse: Na kagyigyɛ kenwi kemmo ni, egyiibi ani négyie kaduɛ na adia bɔdi néyi-ka kemmo. Na kanyɔdi aka ni, egyiibi ebudi ani naaadi bɔdi sɔɔn néyi-ka kemmo.

english_verse: “Jeremiah,” the Lord asked, “what do you see?” “Figs,” I said. “Some are very good, but the others are too rotten to eat.”
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́kpali-mi úye ɔnini, “Yeremia, bi na aanu?” Amu na lɛ́su nnini, “Mɔɔnu egyiibi adi na adi adia bɔdi geen, nsu akladi anya ébun na aaadia bɔdi.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nsu-ma nnini,

english_verse: People of Judah, the good figs stand for those of you I sent away as exiles to Babylonia,
translation_verse: “Yuda kadi bekyuli, egyiibi abuni ammɔ enye ete bina akɔ bekyuli babuni bani na lɛ́ya na béƒie bátɔlɔku bésienku Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: where I am watching over them. Then someday I will bring them back to this land. I will plant them, instead of uprooting them, and I will build them up, rather than tearing them down.
translation_verse: Na mmɔ na mɔɔnu-ma lɛlɔ. Na limeyi lɛdi ni, ndubɔsɔku-ma liboku kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ mbalɛ aani kugyii kalɛ na lɛɛɛdubo-ma bɔgyu budie. Ndubɔya na balɛ lili na naaada-ma neeewi kalɔ nnii bayii udu.

english_verse: I will give them a desire to know me and to be my people. They will want me to be their God, and they will turn back to me with all their heart.
translation_verse: Ndubuti mina lɛlɔ ebiti bɔkya-ma kayi kemmo na bati-mi na benwini mina kadi bekyuli. Na badubɔwia ka lɛbla bana Katɔti na benwini bebo-mi kudɔ ku bana kayi ƒui.

english_verse: The rotten figs stand for King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, and all the others who were not taken away to Babylonia, whether they stayed here in Judah or went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: “Na egyiibi ebudi akladi ni, enye ete Yuda ɔga ɔni baalɔ Sedekaia ku nwuna lɛku batine ku bakladi bani ƒui na béteƒie bátatɔlɔku bétesienku Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ na báƒɔ lɛlɔ bakya mɛni iye bátɔlɔ bésie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will punish them with a terrible disaster, and everyone on earth will tremble when they hear about it. I will force the people of Judah to go to foreign countries, where they will be cursed and insulted.
translation_verse: Ndubo bɔya na ɔgbankpi bonwu ɔdi ubo-ma lɛlɔ na liti lɛni-ma kɔtu. Na lɛlɔ litaatɔ ukyuli biala menu lɛla lɛmmɔ ku lɛlɔ bɔtɔ ku bɔyia geen. Na ndubo Yudaƒuɔ lɛlɔ bunye na batɔlɔ beteesie kalɔ bamba lɛlɔ na kaƒɔ kesii kani na badubo-ma buteeyuda na beteedumi-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: War and hunger and disease will strike them, until they finally disappear from the land that I gave them and their ancestors.
translation_verse: Kekpo ku kɔka ku lɛlɛ lidu lidu lɛdubo-ma lɛlɔ buti butédu ka bayii udu ƒui na kalɔ kani na líti líte ama ku bana bati kuuku ƒui lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: In the fourth year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, which was the first year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylonia, the Lord told me to speak to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. So I told them:
translation_verse: Na lɛkwa linedi kemmo uwi ɔni na Ɔga Yehoiakim ɔɔdi lɛga na Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, Ɔga Nebukadnesar lɛnɔ úse kalɔ ɔɔdi lɛga lɛkwa lideedi na Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nkɔ lɛsa nte Yuda kadi bekyuli ku Yerusalemƒuɔ. Anwuɔsu lɛ́su-ma nnini,

english_verse: The Lord has sent prophets to you time after time, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́tala kenye bediene ɔ́kya-mii kɔlɛ kɔlɛ, nsu bíni na bítenu-nwu litemi.

english_verse: They told you that the Lord had said: Change your ways! If you stop doing evil, I will let you stay forever in this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Básu-mii ka Unwoti ɔsu ɔnini, ‘Bɛvumana bina ngba uliedu! Na si bɛ́bla lɛni na bɛda likyulikpi ala bɔbla bɛ́ya ni, ndubɔya na bilie kalɔ kani na líti líte bina bati kuuku mɛni lɛlɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: I don't want to harm you. So don't make me angry by worshiping idols and other gods.
translation_verse: Naaayɔ nnii mɔɔbla-mii likpidi lɛdi. Anwuɔsu bitakya-mi kɔnyi na bina baƒiɔ ku ala bamba adi bɔkpa ɔsu.’

english_verse: But you refused to listen to my prophets. So I, the Lord, say that you have made me angry by worshiping idols, and you are the ones who were hurt by what you did.
translation_verse: “Nsu bíbulo ɔmɛni ƒui na bítenu mina kenye bediene etemila ani na básu-mii. Anwuɔsu ami Unwoti lɛ́su ka bɛ́kya-mi kɔnyi na ɔni na bɛkya bɛɛkpá baƒiɔ ɔsu na amii náƒɔ ɔlɛ na bina ɔbladu ɔsu.

english_verse: You refused to listen to me,
translation_verse: Bíbulo na bítenu-mi litemi.

english_verse: and now I will let you be attacked by nations from the north, and especially by my servant, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. You and other nearby nations will be destroyed and left in ruins forever. Everyone who sees what has happened will be shocked, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani ni, ndubo bɔya na kadi bekyuli bani nási kalɔ kammɔ katɔ kakɛ bebékpo-mii na ɔni ntulo ƒui ndi mina kabla ɔblane Nebukadnesar ɔni ndi Babilonƒuɔ ɔga. Amii ku bina liku bekyuli kɔlɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli ƒui bɛdubo bukpi na bina lɛma ku kɔlɔ ƒui kɔdubɔsɔ kuwi ukpludi na lɛla biala lɛyii udu. Na ɔtɔtɔ bonwu ɔdubɔgyu ukyuli biala manu ɔmɛni, nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui kama bɔma kani na badubo-mii na beteedumi-mii.

english_verse: I will put an end to your parties and wedding celebrations; no one will grind grain or be here to light the lamps at night.
translation_verse: Ndubɔya na bina emeyi bɔdi ku beleku bɔwɛɛ ƒui kenye kekulo. Na ɔdi ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdubo ɔlaaƒɔ bɔkɔ na mɛni iye ɔkya mɛni na ɔtu lɛsogya lɛdi usien.

english_verse: This country will be as empty as a desert, because I will make all of you the slaves of the king of Babylonia for
translation_verse: Kalɔ kamɛni ƒui kadubɔta kenwini aani kɔnwinimi kalɔ kakwiidi, ɔsika ndubɔya na bina ƒui binwini Babilonƒuɔ Ɔga Nebukadnesar kabla bablane akwa liti ku aavlanyɔ sɔɔn.

english_verse: When that time is up, I will punish the king of Babylonia and his people for everything they have done wrong, and I will turn that country into a wasteland forever.
translation_verse: “Na si bɛ́kya mmɔ na uwi ɔmmɔ údu ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ndubɔni Babilonƒuɔ ɔga ku nwuna bekyuli ƒui kɔtu na ala ƒui na badubɔbla na aaakɛnku ulu ɔbuni ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu na lɛya na bana kalɔ kammɔ kenwini kalɔ kani nsɔ naaadubo bɔdia lɛla lɛdi bɔbla kudii.

english_verse: My servant Jeremiah has told you what I said I will do to Babylonia and to the other nations, and he wrote it all down in this book. I will do everything I threatened.
translation_verse: Mina kabla ɔblane Yeremia ɔ́ɔsu-mii lɛla lɛni na lɛ́su ka mabla Babilonƒuɔ ku kɔlɔ bamba ƒui. Na únweni ala ammɔ ƒui ɔ́kya ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo úse. Liƒu lɛla biala na lɛ́su-ma líse ka mabla-ma ni, ndubo-ni bɔbla.

english_verse: I will pay back the Babylonians for every wrong they have done. Great kings from many other nations will conquer the Babylonians and force them to be slaves. The Cup Full of God's Anger
translation_verse: Likpidi biala na Babilonƒuɔ bábla ni, ndubo-ma lɛla lɛmmɔ kayu bɔƒɔ. Na baga bayikune badubɔsi kɔlɔ pii lɛlɔ bebo babadi Babilonƒuɔ lɛlɔ na benye-ma lɛlɔ na benwini bana kabla bablane.” Yeremia Ɔ́nu Ɔƒɛɛ Ɔni Na Katɔti Kɔnyi Kúyi Aani Ntɛ

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel showed me a vision in which he said, “Jeremiah, here is a cup filled with the wine of my anger. Take it and make every nation drink some.
translation_verse: Unwoti Israel Katɔti údie lɛla lɛdi ɔ́tina-mi na kɔyu kemmo na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Yeremia, aanu ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔdi mɛni ɔni kemmo na ntɛ bɔni nnye nte mina kɔnyi kúyi tɛtɛɛtɛ. Ƒɔ na aya na kadi biala bekyuli bani bɔdi.

english_verse: They will vomit and act crazy, because of the war this cup of anger will bring to them.”
translation_verse: Badubo bɔdala na bataabla gyegyengye na kekpo kani na ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔmɛni ɔdanku ɔduboku-ma lɛlɔ ɔsu.”

english_verse: I took the cup from the Lord's hand, and I went to the kings of the nations and made each of them drink some.
translation_verse: Amu na lɛ́ƒɔ ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ lɛ́siku Unwoti kɔnu kemmo na lɛ́tɔlɔ lísie kadi baga bammɔ kudɔ na lɛ́ya na ɔdi biala ɔ́ni bɔdi.

english_verse: I started with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and the king and his officials were removed from power in disgrace. Everyone still makes insulting jokes about them and uses their names as curse words.
translation_verse: Na líse kalɔ lɛ́si Yerusalem lɛlɔ ku lɛma lɛni na Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na sɔsɔ békpeli baga bammɔ ku bana lɛku batine ƒui bébo kalɔ ɔ́siku bana kunyekɔ ku agaboku lɛlɔ ku kɔƒa. Na ukyuli biala ɔda-ma lɛnyi ku lɛma na kesi kesii na beeti-ma anyi teewida bekyuli ka bana ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ udu ɔdubɔlɛku bekyuli bani na beeyuda mmɔ.

english_verse: The second place I went was Egypt, where everyone had to drink from the cup, including the king and his officials, the other government workers, the rest of the Egyptians,
translation_verse: Kesii kanyɔdi kani na lísie ndi Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na mmɔ ni, lɛ́ya na ukyuli biala ɔ́ni ntɛ ku ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ. Baga ku bana bakutine ku aban ɔmmɔ kabla bablane bamba ƒui ku bekyuli bammɔ ƒui báni-mu.

english_verse: and all the foreigners who lived in the country. Next I went to the king of Uz, and then to the four kings of Philistia, who ruled from Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and what was left of Ashdod.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na baƒɔ bani ƒui nkya kalɔ kammɔ kemmo lɛnɔ báni-mu. Ɔmmɔ kama ni, lísie Us ɔma ɔga kudɔ ku Ƒilistiƒuɔ baga ine bani mɔɔdi Askelon ku Gasa ku Ekron ku ɛlɛɛ bani nébu na Asdod lɛlɔ mmɔ lɛnɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: Then I went to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon,
translation_verse: Na lísie Edom ku Moab ku Amonƒuɔ baga lɛnɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: and to the kings of Tyre, Sidon, and their colonies across the sea.
translation_verse: Lísie Tiro ku Sidon ku baga kudɔ ku bana kɔlɛkɛ bamba kɔni nkya-ma kalɔ ka baanu-ku lɛlɔ si ávia ɛpu lɛnɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: After this, I went to the kings of Dedan, Tema, Buz, the tribes of the Arabian Desert,
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, lísie Dedan ku Tema ku Bus adua ani bekyuli nási Arabia kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo baga kudɔ ku

english_verse: Zimri, Elam, Media,
translation_verse: Simri ku Elam ku Media.

english_verse: and the countries in the north, both near and far. I went to all the countries on earth, one after another, and finally to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Na lísie kɔlɔ kɔni nde na kɔkya katɔ kakɛ ku ɔgyu ƒui kemmo. Nkɛ lɛ́vi kayawi kɔlɔ kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ƒui atɔ asia na ntédu Babilon na kɔwɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: The Lord had said to tell each king, “The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, commands you to drink from this cup that is full of the wine of his anger. It will make you so drunk that you will vomit. And when the Lord sends war against the nations, you will be completely defeated.”
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nsu bekyuli bammɔ nnini, “Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, uubó-mii ɔda ɔnii ɔga biala ɔni ntɛ ku ɔɔƒɛɛ keyile bɔmɛni bɔni nnye nte nwuna kɔnyi mɛni. Na bɔdubo-mii bɔda butédu ka bɛdubɔdala muedi. Na si uwi ɔni na Unwoti ɔ́ya na kekpo kébo-mii lɛlɔ ni, badubɔdi-mii lɛlɔ ƒui kede kede.”

english_verse: The Lord told me that if any of them refused to drink from the cup, I must tell them that he had said, “I, the Lord All-Powerful, command you to drink.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii si ukyuli ɔdi úni ɔnii uláni na ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, na lɛsu-nwu nnini, “Ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui muudie lɛdi teete-ɔ nnii ni ntɛ bɔmmɔ!

english_verse: Starting with my own city of Jerusalem, everyone on earth will suffer from war. So there is no way I will let you escape unharmed.”
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔdubo abi bubo na kekpo kani ndubo mmɔ ɔsu na ɔdubuse kalɔ ɔsi mina kadi bekyuli lɛlɔ na Yerusalem. Anwuɔsu lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na ɔdi ɔkɛ kuƒi kɔdi ukeli na lɛbibo lɛmɛni kenye na lɛla lɛdi lilákɛku-nwu.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: From my sacred temple I will roar like thunder, while I trample my people and everyone else as though they were grapes.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔsɔ ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nsu bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini, “Ndubo bɔkwanyi momoomo aani kalɛ na katɔ keedu bɔsiku mina kakpakɔ kedee kemmo uwi ɔni na ndubo-ma butaanya teesusu aani kalɛ na baamana kutu.

english_verse: My voice will be heard everywhere on earth, accusing nations of their crimes and sentencing the guilty to death. Disaster Is Coming
translation_verse: Na bekyuli ƒui badubunu-mi lɛdi na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ kesi kesii ka mɔɔdu-ma kɔtɔ na bana likyulikpi ala bɔbla ɔsu. Na ndubɔdu badi kukpi kɔtɔ muedi ka badu-ma.” Ɔgbankpi Ɔdubo Bekyuli Lɛlɔ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: You can see disaster spreading from far across the earth, from nation to nation like a horrible storm.
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bɛdubɔnu ka ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ úse kakɔ uugyingya ɔ́si kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ na ɔgyu kakaaka ɔ́si kalɔ úsie kalɔ aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔdi uukpó.

english_verse: When it strikes, I will kill so many people that their bodies will cover the ground like manure. No one will be left to bury them or to mourn. The Leaders of Judah Will Be Punished
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔni na ala amɛni adubuse kalɔ ataalɛ ni, ndubo bekyuli pii bɔdu buwi kalɛ aani kalɛ na beebó alakpi teewi kalɔ na kakya kalɔ kammɔ lɛmwi. Na ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ ulébu na wava ɔkpanadi iye uwulo-nwu lɛnɔ.” Unwoti Ɔdubɔni Yudaƒuɔ Batɔnkune Kɔtu

english_verse: The Lord's people are his flock, and you leaders were the shepherds. But now it's your turn to be butchered like sheep. You'll shatter like fine pottery dropped on the floor. So roll on the ground, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Unwoti bekyuli bese bete-nwu aani nwuna baƒonu kalɛ na amii bana batɔnkune nádi nwuna baƒonu bammɔ lɛlɔ banune. Nsu ɔƒaani ni, bina lɛlɔ na údu ka bebeyi-mii badu aani baƒonu bammɔ kalɛ. Na bɛdubo bɔbwɛ bugyingya aani kalɛ na lɛkyami lɛbwɛdi lɛni mɔɔdia bɔnu lɛɛlɛ́ teebo teegyingya kɔkɛ kɔkɛ. Anwuɔsu bɛyu bɛtɛ kalɔ na biteewulo na biteebo teeminime na lɛti akɔ.

english_verse: You have nowhere to run, nowhere to hide. *
translation_verse: Biiibo kesii kadi na bɛdubo bukeli busie iye bitábɛ.

english_verse: Listen to the cries of the shepherds, as the Lord's burning anger turns peaceful meadows into barren deserts.
translation_verse: uwi ɔni na Unwoti kɔnyi kɔ́ya na bekisine beekpó teebile ala na kalɔ kammɔ káta keenwíni kalɔ kakwiidi kani nsɔ naaadubo lɛla lɛdi bɔdia bɔbla.

english_verse: Like a lion leaving its den, the Lord has abandoned his people to the destruction of war.
translation_verse: Unwoti úni nwuna bekyuli na báda bana kɔduli béwi aani kalɛ na gyata ɔɔlɛ́ nwuna lɛtabi ubu taatɔlɔ na ɔda ubu ɔmmɔ uwi.

english_verse: The priests, the prophets, and everyone else in the temple heard what I said,
translation_verse: Kenye bediene ku bakpane ku bekyuli bani ƒui nkya kakpakɔ mmɔ bénu lɛla lɛni na lɛ́su.

english_verse: Soon after Jehoiakim became king of Judah, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ka bése Yehoiakim lɛga na Yuda uwi klukwii ɔdi kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́su ɔnini,

english_verse: But if you put me to death, you and everyone else in Jerusalem will be guilty of murdering an innocent man, because everything I preached came from the Lord.
translation_verse: Nsu si bɛ́du-mi ni, bɛti ka bina akɔ ɔdi biala na Yerusalem ɔ́bla likpidi na bɛ́du ukyuli ɔni na útabla lɛla lɛdi. Ɔsika lɛla biala na mɔɔsu ni, Unwoti kudɔ na lɛ́si.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, I have a message for everyone who comes from the towns of Judah to worship in my temple. Go to the temple courtyard and speak every word that I tell you.
translation_verse: “Yeremia, mbo litemi lɛdi nte ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔsí Yuda lɛma kemmo teebo taabakpa na mina kakpakɔ. Anwuɔsu sie mina kakpakɔ kaduli kemmo mmɔ na atásu-ma litemi biala na ndubɔsu-ɔ.

english_verse: Maybe the people will listen this time. And if they stop doing wrong, I will change my mind and not punish them for their sins.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni kalɛ badubunu ɔƒaamu. Na si báda ekpidi bɔbla báya ni, ndubɔvumana mina kasusu na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-ma kɔtu bɔni.

english_verse: Tell them that I have said: You have refused to listen to me and to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Su-ma anii ami násu nnini, ‘Bíni bɛnii bilenu-mi litemi na ala ani mɔɔtina-mii ku mina ɔda bubo ƒui bíni na biladi-nya lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Again and again I have sent my servants the prophets to preach to you, but you ignored them as well. Now I am warning you that if you don't start obeying me at once,
translation_verse: Lɛ́sia kama lɛ́tala mina kenye bediene bani mɔɔbla-mi kabla lɛ́kya-mii kɔlɛ kɔlɛ ka babakɔ lɛsa bete-mii, nsu bíni ama lɛnɔ. Na ɔƒaani ni, mɔɔlɛ-mii kpakplaa ka si bítavumana udu na bise kalɔ bitaadi mina etemila lɛlɔ ɔƒaani ni,

english_verse: I will destroy this temple, just as I destroyed the town of Shiloh. Then everyone on earth will use the name “Jerusalem” as a curse word. Jeremiah on Trial
translation_verse: ndubo kakpakɔ kamɛni bɔbwɛ aani kalɛ na lɛ́bwɛ Siloa ɔma. Mmɔ mina kevo kedee kénye dii. Na Yerusalem ɔdubunwini kesii kani na ukyuli biala ɔdubɔkpali uwida ɔnii ɔdubɔlɛku-ɔ aani Yerusalem.’ ” Yerusalem Kadi Bekyuli Bíkpoku Yeremia

english_verse: and as soon as I finished, they all crowded around me and started shouting, “Why did you preach that the Lord will destroy this temple, just as he destroyed Shiloh? Why did you say that Jerusalem will be empty and lie in ruins? You ought to be put to death for saying such things in the Lord's name!” Then they had me arrested.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔni na lɛ́wɔlɔ butemi kani na bana ƒui báta bébewi-mi lɛlɔ na baava teeye-mi banini, “Bi ɔsu na ákɔ lɛsa ásu anii Unwoti ɔdubo kakpakɔ kamɛni bɔbwɛ aani kalɛ na Siloa? Ɔlɛka badu-ɔ na kenye kani na ásu mɛni ɔsu.” Anwuɔsu báya na béƒie-mi.

english_verse: The royal officers heard what had happened, and they came from the palace to the new gate of the temple to be the judges at my trial.
translation_verse: Ɔga kesii bakutine bénu lɛla lɛni nálɛ na bási ɔga kesii mmɔ bébo kakpakɔ ɔban kayakun kawɔdi kammɔ kenye aani bekyuli bani ndubukulo litemi lɛni na baatɛku-mi na mmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: While they listened, the priests and the prophets said to the crowd, “All of you have heard Jeremiah prophesy that Jerusalem will be destroyed. He deserves the death penalty.”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bekyuli bása na beli beenú ni, bakpane ku kenye bediene bammɔ básu kasalakɔ bekyuli bammɔ banini, “Bina ƒui bínu ka Yeremia ɔ́su úse ka badubɔbwɛ Yerusalem. Na ɔmɛni ɔsu ɔlɛka badu-nwu aani nwuna kɔtu bɔni.”

english_verse: Then I told the judges and everyone else: The Lord himself sent me to tell you about the terrible things he will do to you, to Jerusalem, and to the temple. But if you change your ways and start obeying the Lord, he will change his mind.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, lɛ́su litemi batɛne bammɔ ku ukyuli biala ɔni na ɔkya mmɔ nnii, “Unwoti ɔlati nátala-mi ɔnii mbasu-mii agyala ani na ɔdubo-mii bɔbla ku Yerusalem ku kakpakɔ kammɔ ƒui. Nsu si bɛ́vumana udu na biinú Unwoti litemi ni, ɔdubɔvumana nwuna kasusu.

english_verse: You must decide what to do with me. Just do whatever you think is right.
translation_verse: Amii alati bɛlɛ ugyii lɛla lɛni na bɛdubo-mi bɔbla. Na mɔɔsu-mii nnii bɛbla lɛla lɛni na amii bɛ́nu ka lɛdia-mii.

english_verse: The judges and the other people told the priests and prophets, “Since Jeremiah only told us what the Lord our God had said, we don't think he deserves to die.”
translation_verse: Litemi batɛne ku bekyuli bakladi bammɔ ƒui básu kenye bediene bammɔ banini, “Ka Unwoti bula Katɔti kenye kani na ɔ́su Yeremia kani na anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́sɔku úbasu-bu ni, utalɛka ka bɔbla kasusu bɔnii lɛla lɛni námanku-nwu ndi kukpi.”

english_verse: Then some of the leaders from other towns stepped forward. They told the crowd that
translation_verse: Amu na benengu bani nási lɛma bamba bébo mmɔ badi bálɛ bébo anumi na básu kasalakɔ bekyuli bammɔ banini,

english_verse: years ago when Hezekiah was king of Judah, a prophet named Micah from the town of Moresheth had said: “I, the Lord All-Powerful, say Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.”
translation_verse: “Kuuku uwi ɔni kemmo na Hesekia útaadi lɛga na Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti kenye udiene ɔdi baalɔ banii Mika ɔ́kya na ɔ́si ɔma ɔnii baalɔ banii Moreset kemmo. Anwu násu ɔnini, ‘Ami Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui mɔɔsu ka bekisine badubo Yerusalem bɔtu bunwini bubi aani kalɛ na beeti anwami teegulu kalɔ na ɔma ɔmmɔ ubie ɔyii udu. Na liyu alakpi kani ndubo bɔkwɛ bɔƒɔ abi ammɔ lɛlɔ kesii kani na kakpakɔ kammɔ kenye ɔƒɛni.’ ”

english_verse: Then the leaders continued: No one put Micah to death for saying that. Instead, King Hezekiah prayed to the Lord with fear and trembling and asked him to have mercy. Then the Lord decided not to destroy Jerusalem, even though he had already said he would. People of Judah, if Jeremiah is killed, we will bring a terrible disaster on ourselves.
translation_verse: Amu na benengu bammɔ bésie anumi banini, “Ukyuli ɔdi útadu Mika na lɛla lɛmmɔ bɔsu ɔsu. Mmomu Ɔga Hesekia ɔ́kpali Katɔti ku bɔyia na lɛlɔ lɛnɔ lɛɛtɔ́-nwu na úvele-nwu ɔnii ɔnu-ma kɔnyana. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Unwoti ɔ́bla kasusu ka ɔsɔ ulayila Yerusalem ɔma ɔmmɔ udu ina ka lɛni na nka ɔ́ɔsu ka wabla. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, Yudaƒuɔ kadi bekyuli, bɔdubuti ɔgbankpi bonwu buboku lɛlɔ si bɔ́du Yeremia.”

english_verse: After these leaders finished speaking, an important man named Ahikam son of Shaphan spoke up for me as well. And so, I wasn't handed over to the crowd to be killed. Uriah the Prophet While Jehoiakim was still king of Judah, a man named Uriah son of Shemaiah left his hometown of Kiriath-Jearim and came to Jerusalem. Uriah was one of the Lord's prophets, and he was saying the same things about Judah and Jerusalem that I had been saying. And when Jehoiakim and his officials and military officers heard what Uriah said, they tried to arrest him, but he escaped to Egypt. So Jehoiakim sent Elnathan son of Achbor and some other men after Uriah, and they brought him back. Then Jehoiakim had Uriah killed and his body dumped in a common burial pit.
translation_verse: Ka benengu bamɛni báwɔlɔ bɔtɛmi lɛni ni, unengu ɔdi na baabu-nwu geen na baalɔ-nwu banii Ahikam ɔni na ɔdi Saƒan ubidi ɔnanabi lɛnɔ ɔ́tɛmi údie-mi kenye. Anwuɔsu béteti-mi bétete kasalakɔ bekyuli bammɔ na badu-mi. Kenye Udiene Uria Lɛlɔ Kɔtɛ Uwi ɔni kemmo na Yehoiakim ɔmu ɔɔdi lɛga na Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, Semaia ubidi ɔnanabi ɔni baalɔ banii Uria ɔ́tɔlɔ nwuna ɔma ɔni baalɔ Kiriat-Yearim úbo Yerusalem. Na Uria ɔmɛni ɔdi Katɔti Kenye bediene akɔ unwi. Na lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu mɛni ni, lɛla linwi pɛ lɛmmɔ kani na anwu lɛnɔ útaasu taasiku Yerusalem ku Yuda lɛlɔ. Na uwi ɔni na Yehoiakim ku nwuna bakutine benengu bénu lɛla lɛni na Uria ɔ́su ni, báyɔ ka beƒie-nwu, nsu úkeli ɔ́tɔlɔ-ma kudɔ úsie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu Yehoiakim ɔ́tala Akbor ubidi ɔnanabi ɔni baalɔ Elnatan ku banana bamba badi ɔnii basia Uria kama. Na ama lɛnɔ bététiku-nwu béboku. Na Ɔga Yehoiakim ɔ́ya na bádu Uria na bébo-nwu bátákya ubu ɔni kemmo na baavá bekpine bamba lɛnɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Not long after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me: Jeremiah, make a wooden yoke with leather straps, and place it on your neck.
translation_verse: Ka Sedekaia úbenwini Yudaƒuɔ ɔga uwi gyɔlɔɔ ɔdi na nwuna kama ƒui ni, Unwoti ɔ́kpali-mi ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Yeremia, bla bebuo kɔbuli kɔdi da ɔmantɛ bakɔ amɔ abalala ani beegúlu kalɔ mmɔ na eti abala awɔ ɔlati ƒula limɔ.

english_verse: Then send a message to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon. Some officials from these countries are in Jerusalem, meeting with Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama na akya Edom ku Moab ku Amon ku Tiro ku Sidom baga ɔtu. Kɔlɔ kɔmɛni benengu bakya Yerusalem baabla kelisa kadi ku Ɔga Sedekaia.

english_verse: So have them tell their kings that I have said: I am the All-Powerful Lord God of Israel,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu sia-ma lɛlɔ na ama bete bana kɔlɔ baga bɔti anii ami ndi Israel Katɔti Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui.

english_verse: and with my power I created the earth, its people, and all animals. I decide who will rule the earth,
translation_verse: Na ami nédie kalɔ ku kana bekyuli ku bebuo bammɔ ƒui ɔkɛnku mina ɔyikun lɛlɔ. Na ami mɔɔtina ukyuli ɔni madi kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and I have chosen my servant King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to rule all nations, including yours. I will even let him rule the wild animals. All nations will be slaves of Nebuchadnezzar, his son, and his grandson. Then many nations will join together, and their kings will make slaves of the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Na ami náƒuna mina kabla ɔblane Ɔga Nebukadnesar ka ɔdi kadi bekyuli kɔlɔ kɔmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ ku amii kadi lɛnɔ. Na ndubo bɔya na ɔdi lɛku kemmo bebuo bammɔ ƒui lɛnɔ lɛlɔ. Na kadi bekyuli ƒui badubunwini kabla bablane bete Ɔga Nebukadnesar ku ubibidi ku nwuna uwɔ lɛnɔ útédu uwi ɔni na bana uwi wedu na kadi bamba baga basala lɛlɔ na bakɛ ɔyikun na badi Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ na ama lɛnɔ benwini bana kabla bablane.

english_verse: This yoke stands for the power of King Nebuchadnezzar, and I will destroy any nation that refuses to obey him. Nebuchadnezzar will attack, and many will die in battle or from hunger and disease.
translation_verse: “Limɔ abalala amɛni enye ete Ɔga Nebukadnesar ɔyikun ɔni na ɔdubo bɔkɛ. Na ndubɔyila kalɔ kani bekyuli naaadubo-nwu litemi bunu. Ɔga Nebukadnesar ɔdubo-ma bukpo na ɔdu bekyuli pii iye kɔka ku ɔlɛ ɔdu-ma.

english_verse: You might have people in your kingdom who claim they can tell the future by magic or by talking with the dead or by dreams or messages from a god. But don't pay attention if any of them tell you not to obey Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni kalɛ bibo bekyuli badi na bina lɛga kɔdikɔ bani mɔɔsu ka ama baanu taati ala ani ndububo abalɛ na bana evo ɔsu iye ka baakpali bekpine iye beegyé ana adi iye baƒiɔ badi baatɛmiku-ma ɔsu. Nsu si bana ɔdi ɔɔsu-mii ɔnii bitenu Nebukadnesar litemi ni, bitakpete-ma.

english_verse: If you listen to such lies, I will have you dragged far from your country and killed.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si bínu bana ɔkɔ etemila ammɔ udu ni, ndubɔya na bakpɛ-mii kalɔ batɔlɔku bina kalɔ lɛlɔ besienku ɔgyu kaaka na batádu-mii na mmɔ.

english_verse: But if you and your nation are willing to obey Nebuchadnezzar, I will let you stay in your country, and your people will continue to live and work on their farms.
translation_verse: Nsu si amii ku bina kadi bekyuli bɛdubunu kalɔ na binu Ɔga Nebukadnesar litemi ni, ndubɔya na bɛsɔ bɛkya bina kalɔ na bina kadi bekyuli bataatuma ama alati bana mmo.”

english_verse: After I had spoken to the officials from the nearby kingdoms, I went to King Zedekiah and told him the same thing. Then I said: Zedekiah, if you and the people of Judah want to stay alive, you must obey Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Kama ɔni na lɛ́tɛmiku benengu bani nási amadɔ mmɔ lɛ́wɔlɔ ni, lɛ́tɔlɔ lísie Ɔga Sedekaia kudɔ na ńtásɔku lɛla lɛmmɔ kani lɛ́su-nwu anwu lɛnɔ nnini, “Sedekaia, si awɔ ku Yudaƒuɔ ƒui bɛɛwia ka bilie ngba ni, binu Ɔga Nebukadnesar ku Babilonƒuɔ litemi.

english_verse: But if you refuse, then you and your people will die from war, hunger, and disease, just as the Lord has warned.
translation_verse: Nsu si bíni bɔdi ni, na awɔ ku ƒula kadi bekyuli ƒui bɛdubo bukpi na kekpokɔ na kɔka lɛnɔ kɔdu-mii ku lɛlɛ lidu lidu ƒui kalɛ kani na Unwoti úte-mii bɔti úse.

english_verse: Your prophets have told you that you don't need to obey Nebuchadnezzar, but don't listen to their lies.
translation_verse: Bina kenye bediene básu-mii banii utalɛka binu Nebukadnesar litemi, nsu bitenu bana ɔkɔ ala kenye budie bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Those prophets claim to be speaking for the Lord, but he didn't send them. They are lying! If you do what they say, he will have both you and them dragged off to another country and killed. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Kenye bediene bammɔ baatina ka Unwoti nátala-ma na anwu nwuna etemila kenye na beedie, nsu Unwoti útatala-ma. Ɔkɔ na baanyi! Anwuɔsu si bínu-ma kenye kammɔ ni, ndubɔya na bani amii ku-ma ƒui batɔlɔku besienku kaƒɔ kalɔ ɔgyu kakaaka na badu-mii. Unwoti násu.”

english_verse: When I finished talking to the king, I told the priests and everyone else that the Lord had said: Don't listen to the prophets when they say that very soon the Babylonians will return the things they took from my temple. Those prophets are lying!
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na lɛ́wɔlɔ ɔga ɔmmɔ bɔtɛmiku ni, lɛ́tɔlɔ mmɔ lísie bakpane bammɔ lɛnɔ kudɔ na ńtásu-ma ka Unwoti ɔnini, “Bitenu kenye bediene bammɔ ala ani kenye na beedie taasu-mii banii uwi ɔsɔ uletu asa na Babilonƒuɔ badubo ala ani na béti bátɔlɔku mina kakpakɔ mmɔ bɔnyonu bute-mii. Ɔkɔ na baanyi!

english_verse: If you choose to obey the king of Babylonia, you will live. But if you listen to those prophets, this whole city will be nothing but a pile of rubble.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́tunaku lɛlɔ ka binu Babilonƒuɔ ɔga litemi ni, bɛdubɔkɛ bina ngba bilie. Nsu si kenye bediene bammɔ mmomu litemi na bíti bɔdi ni, ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ ƒui ɔdubunwini kebu alakpi litili bonwu.

english_verse: If I really had spoken to those prophets, they would know what I am going to do. Then they would be begging me not to let everything else be taken from the temple and the king's palace and the rest of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si ami geen nátɛmiku-ma nka ɔlɛka bati lɛla lɛni na lɛ́lɛ ugyii ka ndubo bɔbla. Na bataakpali-mi teevele kalɛ na lɛya na Babilonƒuɔ basɔ beleti lɛla lɛdi balálɛku mina kakpakɔ iye ɔga kesii ku Yerusalem ɔma ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: After all, when Nebuchadnezzar took King Jehoiachin to Babylonia as a prisoner, he didn't take everything of value from Jerusalem. He left the bronze pillars, the huge bronze bowl called the Sea, and the movable bronze stands in the temple, and he left a lot of other valuable things in the palace and in the rest of Jerusalem. But now I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, say that all these things
translation_verse: “Na ala ani ƒui nálɛ na uwi ɔni na Nebukadnesar úƒie Yuda Ɔga Yehoiakim ubidi Yekonia ɔ́tɔlɔku úsienku Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, Nebukadnesar úteti lɛla lɛni na lɛ́ƒɔ kuye lɛdi útatɔlɔku Yerusalem. Ɔ́nyonu abuala egyiedi akpa ku abuala egyiedi akyami bonwu ani baalɔ banii ɛpu mmɔ béwi. Na báda abuala egyiedi ligyii ala kɔsiakɔ kɔni nse kakpakɔ mmɔ ƒui úse ku ala bamba pii ani na áƒɔ kuye mmɔ lɛnɔ úse ɔga kesii ku Yerusalem ɔma umodi ɔmmɔ kemmo. Nsu ɔƒaani ni, ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, mɔɔsu nnii ala amɛni ƒui ni,

english_verse: Later that same year, in the fifth month of the fourth year that Zedekiah was king, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur from Gibeon came up to me in the temple. And while the priests and others in the temple were listening,
translation_verse: Lɛkwa linedi kuna kɔbuli kɔlɔndi kemmo ka Sedekaia ɔɔdi lɛga ni, Asur ubidi Hanania ɔni ndi kenye udiene na ɔ́si Gibeon úbo-mi kudɔ na Katɔti kakpakɔ na úbasu kenye kadi lɛbo lɛni na bakpane ku bekyuli bamba ƒui benye beenú.

english_verse: he told me that the Lord had said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I will smash the yoke that Nebuchadnezzar put on the necks of the nations to make them his slaves.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-mi ka Unwoti násu ɔnini, “Ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, na ndubo lɛbibo etila ani na Nebukadnesar ɔ́ya na ada kadi bekyuli ammɔ mmɔ aani kɔgba kalɛ na uti-ma unwini nwuna kabla bablane bɔƒɛ budie-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: And within two years, I will bring back to Jerusalem everything that he took from my temple and carried off to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Na lɛya na basɔku ala ani na béti básiku Yerusalem bátɔlɔku bésienku Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ beboku na akwa anyɔ kemmo.

english_verse: King Jehoiachin and the other people who were taken from Judah to Babylonia will be allowed to come back here as well. All this will happen because I will smash the power of the king of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Na Ɔga Yekonia ku bekyuli bani ƒui na béƒie bátɔlɔku lɛnɔ badubo-ma bɔnyonu na benwini bebo. Na ala amɛni ƒui adubɔlɛ lɛni, ɔsika ndububile Babilonƒuɔ ɔga ɔyikun ɔni na ubo na bayii udu!”
