english_verse: The priests and the others were still standing there, so I said:
translation_verse: Na bakpane ku bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bamu benye mmɔ uwi ɔmmɔ asa na lɛ́su nnini,

english_verse: Hananiah, I hope the Lord will do exactly what you said. I hope he does bring back everything the Babylonians took from the temple, and that our people who were taken to Babylonia will be allowed to return home.
translation_verse: “Hanania, nka ɔdi-mi lɛnunsia ka Unwoti ɔbla lɛla lɛni na ásu mɛni lɛni kani. Na ɔya na basɔku lɛla biala na béti kakpakɔ mɛni bátɔlɔku beboku na bekyuli bani na béƒie lɛnɔ benwini bebo ɔma.

english_verse: But let me remind you and everyone else
translation_verse: Nsu ya na linyimene awɔ ku bekyuli bani nnye mɛni ƒui nnii,

english_verse: that long before we were born, prophets were saying powerful kingdoms would be struck by war, disaster, and disease.
translation_verse: kuuku uwi ɔni návi asa na badubɔwɔ ami ku-ɔ ni, kenye bediene ƒui baasu taatina ka lɛga kɔdikɔ kunengudi kɔni mbo ɔyiku bonwu ƒui badubo-ku bɔbwɛ na kekpo ku ɔgbankpi bamba lidu ku lɛlɛ ɔsu.

english_verse: Now you are saying we will have peace. We will just have to wait and see if that is really what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani awɔ aasu ka bɔdubɔkɛ keyii buɛɛ. Anwuɔsu bunye na bɔdubunye butaanu ulu si sɔsɔ na Unwoti násu kenye kamɛni.”

english_verse: Hananiah grabbed the wooden yoke from my neck and smashed it.
translation_verse: Amu na Hanania ɔ́ni ligyii kɔgba kɔni nda-mi limɔ mmɔ údie na úbo-ku ɔ́ƒɛ.

english_verse: Then he said, “The Lord says this is the way he will smash the power Nebuchadnezzar has over the nations, and it will happen in less than two years.” I left the temple,
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Unwoti ɔnii ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na ndubo Nebukadnesar ɔyikun ɔni na ɔda ɔɔdi kadi bekyuli lɛlɔ udu bɔyila. Na ɔɔɔdubo akwa anyɔ budu bɔwɔlɔ asa na webo-nwu kemmo lɛni.” Amu na Yeremia ɔ́vi ɔ́lɛ kakpakɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: and a little while later, the Lord told me
translation_verse: Na uwi klukui ɔdi kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini,

english_verse: to go back and say to Hananiah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You smashed a wooden yoke, but I will replace it with one made of iron. I will put iron yokes on all the nations, and they will have to do what King Nebuchadnezzar commands. I will even let him rule the wild animals.
translation_verse: “Sɔ nwini sie na atásu Hanania kenye kadi nnii ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti. Áƒɛ ligyii kɔgba, nsu ndubɔsɔku abuala kɔdi lɛkya kadi bekyuli ƒui ɔkuɛ. Na ɔlɛka babla lɛla lɛni na Ɔga Nebukadnesar ɔ́su-ma. Na ndubɔya na ɔdi lɛku kemmo bebuo ƒui lɛnɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Hananiah, I have never sent you to speak for me. And yet you have talked my people into believing your lies and rebelling against me. So now I will send you—I'll send you right off the face of the earth! You will die before this year is over.
translation_verse: Na ńtatala awɔ Hanania uwi ɔdi nnii tédie-mi litemi lɛdi kenye. Nsu éesie átábla kenyemini na átɔlɔ mina bekyuli na báƒɔ-ɔ ɔkɔ kenye budie bádi na baata teenye-mi lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu ndubɔda-a lidie kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui kula kula na ekpi asa na lɛkwa lɛmɛni lɛsa.”

english_verse: Two months later, Hananiah died.
translation_verse: Abuli anyɔ kama ni, Hanania úkpi.

english_verse: I had been left in Jerusalem when King Nebuchadnezzar took many of the people of Jerusalem and Judah to Babylonia as prisoners, including King Jehoiachin, his mother, his officials, and the metal workers and others in Jerusalem who were skilled in making things. So I wrote a letter to the priests, the prophets, the leaders, and the rest of our people in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Bébu ami bákya Yerusalem uwi ɔni na Ɔga Nebukadnesar úƒie Ɔga Yekonia ku Yerusalemƒuɔ ku Yudaƒuɔ ɔ́tɔlɔku úsienku Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na úƒie Yekonia uni ku nwuna bakutine ku ala bakywɛne bani na ala lidu lidu bɔbla bɔ́ma-ma enu geen bátɔlɔku. Ɔmɛni ɔsu línweni ɔku ɔdi límene bula kenye bediene ku bakpane ku bula batɔnkune ku Yerusalemƒuɔ bakladi ƒui bani nkya Babilon mmɔ.

english_verse: I gave the letter to Elasah and Gemariah, two men that King Zedekiah of Judah was sending to Babylon to talk with Nebuchadnezzar. In the letter, I wrote
translation_verse: Na líti ɔku ɔmmɔ líte Saƒan ubidi ɔnanabi ɔni baalɔ Elasa ku Hilkia ubidi ɔnanabi ɔni baalɔ banii Gemaria. Nkyuli inyɔ bamɛni na Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga Sedekia ɔ́tala ɔnii besie Babilon na batátɛmiku Nebukadnesar. Na ɔku ɔmmɔ ɔdanku kenye kadi ka,

english_verse: that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. Now I tell you
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, ɔnini, “Lɛ́ya na béti-mii bátɔlɔku Yerusalem bésienku Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na ɔƒaani ni, mɔɔsu-mii nnii

english_verse: to settle there and build houses. Plant gardens and eat what you grow in them.
translation_verse: bilie mmɔ na bɛtu lɛtɔ na bisie mmo na bɛdi lɛla lɛni bɛ́tuma na mmo bɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Get married and have children, then help your sons find wives and help your daughters find husbands, so they can have children as well. I want your numbers to grow, not to get smaller.
translation_verse: Biti lɛlɔ na bɛwɔ na bɛwia beleku ku bagya bite bina bebi kalɛ na ama lɛnɔ bawɔ. Ɔsika naaawia ka bɛsa mmomu kalɛ na bimomo.

english_verse: Pray for peace in Babylonia and work hard to make it prosperous. The more successful that nation is, the better off you will be.
translation_verse: “Bɛkpali katɔ ka keyi kayɔku Babilon mmɔ, na bɛda bina kabla kaduɛ kalɛ na káyu. Ɔsika si ala átɛku bekyuli na kalɔ kammɔ kemmo ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔku-mii na mmɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Some of your people there in Babylonia are fortunetellers, and you have asked them to tell you what will happen in the future. But they will only lead you astray with their dreams. And don't let the prophets fool you, either. They speak in my name, but they are liars. I have not spoken to them.
translation_verse: “Bina bekyuli badi bakya Babilon mmɔ na badi like bebone na bɛ́ɛsu-ma ka bebo like na basu-mii lɛla lɛni ndubo libalɛ uwi ɔni mebo kemmo. Nsu bɔkpanku kani na badubo-mii bɔkpanku butáyila. Na bina kenye bediene bammɔ lɛnɔ ni, bitaya na bese-mii lisusu. Ɔsika ina ka beedie ala kenye teete-mii na mina lɛnyi kemmo ni, ɔkɔ banyine na badi ɔsiku ńtasu-ma lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: I will bless you with a future filled with hope—a future of success, not of suffering.
translation_verse: Lɛ́lɛ ugyii ka ndubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ bitaasia ala abuni anu na bina ngba bɔni na bɛdubulie uwi ɔni mebo kemmo ƒui na ala adianku-mii, na lɛbibo lɛdi lɛsɔ lilebo-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You will turn back to me and ask for help, and I will answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubo bunwini kama bubo-mi kudɔ na bivele-mi bɛnii mbunku-mii na ndubunu-mii bɔkpali biala na lɛbla lɛla lɛni na bɛɛwia lite-mii.

english_verse: You will worship me with all your heart, and I will be with you
translation_verse: Bɛdubɔkya-mi lili kalɔ bɛkpa-mi ku bina kayi ƒui. Na ami lɛnɔ ndubɔsiaku-mii.

english_verse: and accept your worship. Then I will gather you from all the nations where I scattered you, and you will return to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Bina bɔkpa bɔdubɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ, na ndubɔsala-mii ƒui lɛsiku lɛkɔkɔ lɛni kemmo na bɛkya na kadi bekyuli bani akɔ na lɛ́bɔku-mii ńtákya lɛsɔku liboku Yerusalem.

english_verse: You feel secure, because you think I have sent prophets to speak for me in Babylonia.
translation_verse: “Bɛɛnu bɛnii bilie kpli na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-mii, ɔsika bɛɛkali bɛnii ami néti kenye bediene badi límene-mi kalɛ na bebedie-mi kenye na Babilon mmɔ.

english_verse: But I have been sending prophets to the people of Judah for a long time, and the king from David's family and the people who are left in Jerusalem and Judah still don't obey me. So I, the Lord All-Powerful, will keep attacking them with war and hunger and disease, until they are as useless as rotten figs. I will force them to leave the land, and all nations will be disgusted and shocked at what happens to them. The nations will sneer and make fun of them and use the names “Judah” and “Jerusalem” as curse words. And you have not obeyed me, even though
translation_verse: “Nsu ni, ɔ́si kukuuku ni, mɔɔtala kenye bediene na Yudaƒuɔ akɔ ku Dawidi ɔtɔ kemmo ɔga ɔni na uli liboku ku Yerusalem ku Yuda bekyuli ƒui, nsu béni na belenu-mi litemi. Anwuɔsu ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ndubo bɔya na kekpo ku kɔka ku lɛlɔ lidu lidu liteekpoku-ma wetédu uwi ɔni na báyii udu aani egyiibi ani nébu ewi kalɔ. Ndubo-ma lɛlɔ bunye na lɛbɔku-ma lɛlɛku kalɔ kammɔ kemmo na kadi bekyuli bani manu-ma ƒui bana lɛlɔ lɛdubɔbɔ-ma na liƒu bonwu lɛnɔ lɛda-ma lɛnɔ na lɛla lɛni ndubɔlɛku-ma ɔsu. Na badubo-ma budumi na bama-ma lɛnɔ. Na badubo bekyuli buwida basu banii ɔdubɔlɛku-ɔ aani Yerusalem ku Yuda. “Na sɔsɔ béni na belenu-mi litemi.

english_verse: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. But you had better listen to me now.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́ya na bákpanku-mii bátɔlɔku Yerusalem bésienku Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ na si bɛ́vumana na biinú-mi mmomu ɔ́si ɔƒɛni ni, ɔdia-mii utulo.

english_verse: You think Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah are prophets because they claim to speak for me. But they are lying! I haven't told them anything. They are also committing other horrible sins in your community, such as sleeping with the wives of their friends. So I will hand them over to King Nebuchadnezzar, who will put them to death while the rest of you watch. And in the future, when you want to put a curse on someone, you will say, “I pray that the Lord will kill you in the same way the king of Babylonia burned Zedekiah and Ahab to death!” A Message for Shemaiah
translation_verse: Bɛɛkali ka Kolia ubidi Ahab ku Manase ubidi Sedekia badi-mi kenye bediene ka baasu ka ami mina kenye na beedie ɔsu. Nsu ɔkɔ na baanyi! Ńtasu-ma lɛla lɛdi. Na benye baabla ekpidi bonwu bonwu abambadi adi aani bana bakpana beleku bɔtɛnku. Anwuɔsu ndubo-ma budie bute Ɔga Nebukadnesar ɔni ndubo-ma bɔdu na bakladi benye bataanu. Na si uwi ɔdi úbebo na ɔdi uuwida ɔdi ni, na basu banini, ‘Unwoti ɔkyula-a aani kalɛ na Babilonƒuɔ ɔga ɔ́kyula Ahab ku Sedekia!’ ” Unwoti Ɔ́ya Na Básu Semia Kenye Kadi

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, told me what would happen to Shemaiah, who was one of our people in Babylonia. After my letter reached Babylonia, Shemaiah wrote letters to the people of Jerusalem, including the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and the other priests. The letter to Zephaniah said:
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, ɔ́su-mi lɛla lɛni ndubo Semaia ɔni nási ɔma ɔni baalɔ Nehelam bɔbla. Anwu lɛnɔ ɔdi bula kadi bekyuli akɔ unwi na ɔ́kya Babilon mmɔ. Na uwi ɔni na mina ɔku útuku-ma lɛkɔkɔ na Babilon mmɔ ni, Semaia ɔmɛni únweni ɔku úmene Yerusalemƒuɔ ku Ɔkpane Seƒania ɔni na ɔdi Manase ubidi úbunku bakpane bamba lɛnɔ. Na ɔku ɔmmɔ kenye kaatina ɔnini,

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the Lord chose you to be the priest in charge of the temple security force. You know that anyone who acts crazy and pretends to be a prophet should be arrested and put in chains and iron collars.
translation_verse: “Na ɔkpane Yehoiada kukpi kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́ƒuna-a aani ɔkpane ɔni ndubo nwuna kakpakɔ bagyumanane lɛlɔ butaanu. Na agyi lɛnɔ ka si ukyuli ɔdi úbo ɔɔbla libuokpi ala na ɔɔtina lɛlɔ ka Katɔti kenye udiene na ɔdi ni, ɔlɛka beƒie ukyuli ɔmmɔ na bebo-nwu kɔgba.

english_verse: Jeremiah from the town of Anathoth is pretending to be a prophet there in Jerusalem, so why haven't you punished him?
translation_verse: Na Yeremia ɔni nási Anatos ɔma kemmo ɔkya ɔɔbla udu ɔdi na ɔɔtina lɛlɔ na Yerusalem mmɔ aani kenye udiene ɔdi. Na lɛɛɛgyi lɛla lɛni ɔsu na átakana tɔ na ani-nwu kɔtu kɔdi.

english_verse: He even wrote a letter to the people here in Babylonia, saying we would be here a long time. He told us to build homes and to plant gardens and grow our own food.
translation_verse: Únweni ɔku ɔdi muedi úmene bula kadi bekyuli bani na bɔkya Babilon mɛni na ɔɔsu ka bɔdubo mɛni bɔkya na uwi utu. Na ɔɔsu-bu ku bɔsu ɔnii bɔtu lɛtɔ na busie mmo bɔni kemmo na bɔdubo bula lɛdila butaakɛ.”

english_verse: When Zephaniah received Shemaiah's letter, he read it to me.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Seƒania ɔ́ƒɔ Semaia ɔkɔ ɔmɛni ni, ɔ́ka-nwu úte-mi.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me what to write in a second letter
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi lɛla lɛni na linweni na mina ɔku unyɔdi kemmo

english_verse: to the people of Judah who had been taken to Babylonia. In this letter, I wrote that the Lord had said: I, the Lord, have not chosen Shemaiah to be one of my prophets, and he has misled you by telling lies in my name.
translation_verse: liti lite Yuda kadi bekyuli bani na béƒie bátɔlɔku bésienku Babilon. Na ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo ni, línweni ka Unwoti ɔnini, “Ami Unwoti ńtaƒuna Semaia ka unwini mina kenye bediene akɔ ɔdi. Na ɔ́kpanku-mii útáyila na nwuna ɔkɔ ala ani na ɔɔsu ɔsu ɔnii mina kenye na uudie.

english_verse: He has even talked you into disobeying me. So I will punish Shemaiah. He and his descendants won't live to see the good things I will do for my people. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na ala ani na ɔ́ɔsu-mii bɔsu bɔsu ɔsu bínwini batuɔkplune na bɛsɔ bilenu-mi litemi. Anwuɔsu ndubo-nwu kɔtu bɔni geen na anwu ku nwuna bawɔ ɔdi biala ɔɔɔdubo ngba bulie bɔnu lɛbuni lɛni na ndubo bɔbla bute mina kadi bekyuli.”

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel said, “Jeremiah, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you.
translation_verse: Unwoti, Israel Katɔti, ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Yeremia, ti kugyii akpa ɔku kakunkɛ iye bebuo ɔku kakunkɛ ɔni lɛlɔ na beenweni ala taasia na enweni ala ani ƒui na lɛ́su-ɔ asia-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Someday I will let my people from both Israel and Judah return to the land I gave their ancestors.”
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛdi lɛdubo na ndubɔya na Israel ku Yuda ƒui basɔ babasala na kalɔ kani na líti líte bana bati kuuku mmɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to Israel and Judah: Screams of terror are heard, with no word of peace.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́tala-mi ɔ́kya Israelƒuɔ ku Yudaƒuɔ ɔnini, “Ami Unwoti muunú kɔvanu kɔni ndanku ayiala na ɔɔɔdi keyi buɛɛ kɔvanu.

english_verse: Can men give birth? Then why do I see them looking so pale and clutching their stomachs like women in labor?
translation_verse: Bɔkana na banana badubɔkana na bawɔ? Na bi ɔsu na mɔɔnu-ma ƒuƒuu lɛni na bada bana nƒɔ beesusu ani beleku bani na kawɔƒɔ kaadu?

english_verse: My people, soon you will suffer worse than ever before, but I will save you.
translation_verse: Mina kadi bekyuli, blii kani nébu na bɛdubo abi bubo geen butulo ala ani náalɛku-mii ábavi. Nsu ndubo-mii budie ƒui.

english_verse: Now you are slaves of other nations, but I will break the chains and smash the yokes that keep you in slavery.
translation_verse: “Ɔƒaani ni, bɛdi bekyuli bani mɔɔbla kadi bamba bekyuli kabla. Nsu ndubo ala nda-mii mmɔ ƒui bɔƒɛ budie-mii lɛlɔ. Na ndubɔƒɛ katuma kɔgba kɔni nda-mii mmɔ ɔsu na binye bɛɛbla bekyuli bamba kabla budie-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then you will be my servants, and I will choose a king for you from the family of David. *
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama na binwini mina kabla bablane na lɛƒuna ɔga lite-mii lɛsiku Dawid ɔtɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Israel, you belong to me, so don't be afraid. You deserved to be punished; that's why I scattered you in distant nations. But I am with you, and someday I will destroy those nations.
translation_verse: “Amii, mina bekyuli bani nkya katɔ ku kada ƒui, bɛsɔ bitayia. Ami ɔdi na bɛdi bɛ́manku ka lɛni-mii kɔtu, anwuɔsu na lígyingya-mii lɛ́kya kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ na ɔlɔgyu kakaaka. Nsu nsiaku-mii na ndubɔyila kadi bamba bakyuli bammɔ udu.

english_verse: Then I will bring you and your descendants back to your land, where I will protect you and give you peace. Then your fears will be gone. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Heal Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Na ndubɔsɔku-mii ku bina bawɔ liboku bina kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na mɔɔgyumana-mii na mɔɔnu-mii lɛlɔ na mɔɔyá na keyi kaayɔ́ku-mii lɛlɔ. Na liƒu biala lɛsɔ lilakya-mii kemmo. Ami Unwoti násu.” Unwoti Ɔdubɔbwi Israel Ku Yuda Bekyuli Bana Lɛlɛ Lɛni Na Beeƒi

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, you are wounded and near death.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Mina kadi bekyuli, bɛ́ƒɔ ɔlɛ na bɛɛyɔ́ bikpi.

english_verse: You are accused of a crime with no one to defend you, and you are covered with sores that no medicine can cure. *
translation_verse: Bádu-mii likpidi bonwu lɛdi kɔtɔ na ukyuli ɔdi uuubo ukpo ute-mii. Na alɛbi lɛnɔ áƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kesii biala ɔni na kuvo kɔdi kuuubo na kɔbwi-mii.

english_verse: Your friends have forgotten you; they don't care anymore. Even I have acted like an enemy. And because your sins are horrible and countless, I will be cruel as I punish you.
translation_verse: Na bina bakpana lɛnɔ báyiƒala-mii na basɔ baaadaku-mii lɛda lɛnɔ. Na ami muedi mina ɔbladu ɔ́tina ka línwini-mii ukisine. Na ka bina ekpidi ébomo na emomo ɔsu ni, ndubo-mii ulikplu bɔbla si mɔɔní-mii kɔtu.

english_verse: So don't bother to cry out for relief from your pain.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔdia-mii utulo ka bíbile kenye kpoo na bɛ́sɔ bítewulo bɛnii ɔdi ubaƒɔ-mii na bina ɔlɛ bunu kemmo.

english_verse: But if your enemies try to rob or destroy you, I will rob and destroy them, and they will be led as captives to foreign lands.
translation_verse: “Nsu si bina bekisine bákɛ kenyekɔ na banii bɛɛyú-mii iye bayila-mii udu ni, ami lɛnɔ ndubo-ma buyu iye lɛyila-ma udu. Na badubuƒie ama lɛnɔ besienku kaƒɔ ɔlɔgyu.

english_verse: No one wants you as a friend or cares what happens to you. But I will heal your injuries, and you will get well. The Lord Will Rescue Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ulawia ka udie-ɔ kakpana na ɔɔɔdaku-ɔ lɛda lɛnɔ si lɛla lɛdi mɔɔlɛ́ku-ɔ. Nsu ndubo-mii bɔbwi ƒui bɔsiku bina lɛlɛ lɛni nda-mii kudɔ na lɛlɔ lɛsɔ lɛbla-mii sɛɛn na bɛsɔ bɛkɛ bina ɔlɔkplu.” Unwoti Ɔdubudie Israel Ku Yuda

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I will be kind to you and let you come home. Jerusalem now lies in ruins, but you will rebuild it, complete with a new palace.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Israel ndubo-ɔ kɔnyana bɔnu na asɔ enwini ebo ɔma. Yerusalem, ɔƒaani ni, ɔma ɔmmɔ ɔ́bwɛ na uwi aani kebu, nsu badubo-ɔ bɔsɔku bɔtu ƒui kede kede ku baga kesii kawɔdi na bina kɔduli kɔdubunye kesii kani kúnye dii kúbavi.

english_verse: Other nations will respect and honor you. Your homes will be filled with children, and you will celebrate, singing praises to me.
translation_verse: Kadi bamba bekyuli badubo-mii bɔnu bɔƒalɛ na babu-mii. Na bebi badubɔƒɔ-mii kɔduli kemmo pii geen. Na bɛdubo limeyi bɔdi na bɛkɛ ebiti na bimwi-mi ku lɛlɔyɔ lɛnu.

english_verse: It will be just like old times. Your nation will worship me, and I will punish anyone who abuses you.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubuse aani kuuku kalɛ kani pɛpɛɛpɛ. Bina kadi bekyuli badubo-mi bɔkpa. Na ndubɔni ukyuli biala medumi-mii kɔtu.

english_verse: One of your own people will become your ruler. And when I invite him to come near me at the place of worship, he will do so. No one would dare to come near without being invited.
translation_verse: Na bina akɔ kani na bɛdubɔkɛ bina ɔtɔnkune bɛsiku. Na si lɛ́lɔ-nwu nnii ubo-mi kudɔ na mina kakpakɔ ni, ɔdubɔni ude-mi na mina lɛkpabi lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ɔdi ulakana-mi bɔni bude si ɔɔɔdi bɔlɔ na lɛ́lɔ-nwu.

english_verse: You will be my people, and I will be your God. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Bɛdubo mina bekyuli bunwini na ami lɛnɔ linwini bina Katɔti. Ami Unwoti násu.

english_verse: I am furious! And like a violent storm I will strike those who do wrong.
translation_verse: “Líti kɔnyi geen aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni kenye mbo ɔkplu na ndubo bekyuli bani mɔɔbla likpidi butiku.

english_verse: I won't calm down until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday, you will understand what I mean.
translation_verse: Na mina kɔnyi kenye kaaadubo bɔyɔ wetédu uwi ɔni na lɛ́bla lɛni mɔɔyɔ́ lɛ́wɔlɔ. Na limeyi lɛdi ni, bɛdubunu lɛla lɛni na ndanku mɛni kalɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I promise that someday all your tribes will again be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Israel, líse kenye ka Limeyi lɛdi lɛdubo ni, ƒula adua ƒui bekyuli badubɔsɔ benwini mina badi na ami lɛdi bina Katɔti.

english_verse: In the desert I was kind to those who escaped death. I gave them peace, and when the time is right, I'll do the same for you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Rebuild Israel
translation_verse: “Na ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo ni, lɛ́bla bani ka kukpi kútadu lɛƒɔndia. Na lɛ́ya na bákɛ keyi buɛɛ. Na si uwi ɔmmɔ údu ni, ndubɔbla lɛni kani lite amii lɛnɔ. Ami Unwoti násu lɛni.” Unwoti Ɔdubɔsɔku Israel Ɔtu

english_verse: Some time ago, the Lord appeared to me and told me to say: Israel, I will always love you; that's why I've been so patient and kind.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdi návi ni, Unwoti údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina-mi na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Israel, ndubo butaayɔ-ɔ uwi ndi uwi, anwuɔsu na lɛ́kɛku-ɔ kayi buɛɛ na muuwiku-ɔ lɛlɔ ku kɔnyana bɔnu.

english_verse: You are precious to me, and so I will rebuild your nation. Once again you will dance for joy and play your tambourines.
translation_verse: Bɛ́ƒɔ-mi uye geen. Anwuɔsu ndubɔsɔku bina kalɔ lɛtu. Na bɛdubo bɔsɔ bɔtɔ ku ebiti na bɛgya bina lɛbentaa.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria and enjoy the grapes.
translation_verse: Bɛdubusie adingyii mmo na Samaria abi lɛlɔ. Na bɛdubɔdi egyiibi ammɔ ku lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: Someday those who guard the hill country of Ephraim will shout, “Let's go to Zion and worship the Lord our God.” Israel Will Return to Its Own Land
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔdubo ɔni na bagyumane bani mɔɔnu Eƒraim abi kalɔ lɛlɔ badubo kudu bubo momoomo na basu banini, ‘Bɛya na buteesie Sion na butákpa Unwoti bula Katɔti na mmɔ.’ ” Israel Ɔdubɔsɔ Unwini Usie Anwu Ɔlati Nwuna Kalɔ Lɛlɔ

english_verse: The Lord says: Celebrate and sing for Israel, the greatest of nations. Offer praises and shout, “Come and rescue your people, Lord! Save what's left of Israel.”
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Amii kadi bekyuli bani náƒɔ kuye bitulo ƒui, lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii na bɛtɔ ku ebiti. Bibo kudu ku bina bumwi akpala na bɛsu bɛnini, ‘Unwoti bo, na ebedie ƒula kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ bani nébu!’

english_verse: I, the Lord, will bring my people back from Babylonia and everywhere else on earth. The blind and the lame will be there. Expectant mothers and women about to give birth will come and be part of that great crowd.
translation_verse: Ami Unwoti ndubɔsɔku mina bekyuli lɛsiku Babilon ku kalɔ kadi bekyuli ƒui akɔ liboku ɔma. Na banumbwɛne ku bekpulone ƒui badubɔkya mmɔ. Na baƒɔndane ku bani na uwi úudu-ma ka bawɔ ƒui badubɔkya kasala kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: They will weep and pray as I bring them home. I will lead them to streams of water. They will walk on a level road and not stumble. I am a father to Israel, my favorite children.
translation_verse: Badubo buteewulo na baatákpali-mi teevele uwi ɔni na bakɛ ulu badubo ɔma. Na ndubo-ma bɔkpanku busienku abiɔ ani kemmo na ntu bɔbuni bɔkya na bani. Na badubɔsia ulu ɔni ntɛ kalɔ ƒiaa lɛlɔ na beletulo iye bagbanta. Ɔti na ndi nte Eƒraim mina kaƒɔ ubi udeedi ku nwuna badi.

english_verse: Listen to me, you nations nearby or across the sea. I scattered the people of Israel, but I will gather them again. I will protect them like a shepherd guarding a flock;
translation_verse: “Amii kadi bekyuli ƒui binu, amii bani na amadɔ ku bani na ɛpu ɔvi ƒui. Lígyingya Israel kadi bekyuli lɛ́kya. Nsu nsɔ ndubo-ma bɔsala ƒui. Na ndububo-ma bɔgyumana aani kalɛ na baƒonu ɔdane ɔɔgyumana nwuna baƒonu.

english_verse: I will rescue them from enemies who could overpower them.
translation_verse: Ndubo-ma budie bɔsiku bana bekisine bani ndubɔkana na badi-ma lɛlɔ enu kemmo.

english_verse: My people will come to Mount Zion and celebrate; their faces will glow because of my blessings. I'll give them grain, grapes, and olive oil, as well as sheep and cattle. Israel will be prosperous and grow like a garden with plenty of water.
translation_verse: Mina bekyuli badubo-mi kudɔ na Sion Kɔbi lɛlɔ na babadi limeyi na bana anumi ekeye, ɔsika ndubute-ma kusɛ kusɛ. Na ndubute-ma antabi ku egyiibi ku nnɔ. Na lite-ma baƒonu ku ɔmantɛ bakɔ. Ala adubo-ma bɔdianku na balɛ lili aani kemo kani edula nákɛ ntu kaduɛ.

english_verse: Young women and young men, together with the elderly, will celebrate and dance, because I will comfort them and turn their sorrow into happiness.
translation_verse: Na bakloƒu ku begblebi ku benengu ƒui lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma na batɔ ku ebiti. Ɔsika ndubɔsia-ma kɔnu na lɛya na bana kɔnyana buwulo bunwini ebiti.

english_verse: I will bless my people with more food than they need, and the priests will enjoy the choice cuts of meat. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Offers Hope
translation_verse: Ndubute mina bekyuli kusɛ kusɛ na lɛya na bakɛ edula pii betulo kalɛ na baawia muedi. Na bakpane badubɔkɛ bebuo bani na badubɔdu kɔdikɔ kɔbuni. Ami Unwoti násu. Unwoti Ɔ́ya Na Bekyuli Bákɛ Lɛnunsia

english_verse: In Ramah a voice is heard, crying and weeping loudly. Rachel mourns for her children and refuses to be comforted, because they are dead. *
translation_verse: “Bekyuli bénu kɔku kɔdi na Rama ka beewulo momoomo. Rahel bawɔ beewulo bana bebi. Na belenu kɔnu bɔsia, ɔsika bebi bammɔ békpi.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, say to dry your tears. Someday your children will come home from the enemy's land. Then all you have done for them will be greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: “Nsu ami Unwoti mɔɔsu-mii nnii bini bina imii biala na bina anumi. Ɔsika uwi ɔdubo ɔni na bina bebi badubɔsi bana bekisine kɔlɔ lɛlɔ bebo ɔma. Na ala ani na bɛ́bla bíte-ma ƒui ni, bɛdubɔkɛ-nya lɛlɔ kɔsia.

english_verse: So don't lose hope. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bitayila lɛnunsia. Ami Unwoti násu.

english_verse: The people of Israel moan and say to me, “We were like wild bulls, but you, Lord, broke us, and we learned to obey. You are our God— please let us come home.
translation_verse: “Eƒraim úwulo ɔ́kpali-mi ku kɔnyana ɔnini, ‘Unwoti buse aani alakpi akɔ bakɔ bani na átina lɛnunda na kalɛ na ésusu-bu ɔsu na bɔ́tɛya kalɛ na bunu-ɔ litemi. Awɔ ndi bula Katɔti. Buvele na bɔda-a. Ya na bunwini bubo ɔma.

english_verse: When we were young, we strayed and sinned, but then we realized what we had done. We are ashamed and disgraced and want to return to you.”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bɔmu bɔdi banamu ni, bɔ́yii ulu na bɔ́bla likpidi bɔ́ƒiɔ-ɔ. Nsu bɔ́nu lɛla lɛni na bɔ́bla-a mɛni bɔ́ti. Kɔƒa kuukpó-bu na bɔɔwia ku bunwini bubo-ɔ kudɔ.’

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my own dear children. Don't I love you best of all? Though I often make threats, I want you to be near me, so I will have mercy on you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Israel kadi bekyuli, ami ɔlati mina bebi bani mɔɔyɔ́ geen na bɛdi. Ɔɔɔdi ami na mɔɔyɔ́ teetulo ƒui na kadi bekyuli akɔ yoo? Ina ka muubó-mii lɛnimi enwu ku kɔnyi taasu ka ndubo-mii bɔtina ni, bɔyɔ na mɔɔyɔ́ ka bɛni bide-mi na lɛnu-mii kɔnyana. Ami Unwoti násu.

english_verse: With rock piles and signposts, mark the road well, my dear people. The road by which you left by will now lead you home.
translation_verse: “Bɛsala atabi bɛlɛ esu esu na ulu lɛlɔ ku likpose kɔlɛkɛ na biti bɛnu bina kasiakɔ bɛti si bɛdubo ɔma. Ulu ɔmmɔ kani lɛla na bɛ́sia bɛ́tɔlɔ.

english_verse: Will you ever decide to be faithful? I will make sure that someday things will be different, as different as a woman protecting a man. The Lord Will Bring Judah Home
translation_verse: Bɛɛbla kasusu ka bɛvumana na binwini bɛsiaku-mi kama siin na bɛsɔ bilálɛ-mi kama? Limeyi lɛdi lɛdubo ni, ndubɔnu ka lɛ́vumana ala lɛ́siaku ulu bamba lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na uleku uunwíni taawia ɔnana.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I promise to set the people of Judah free and to lead them back to their hometowns. And when I do, they will once again say, “We pray that the Lord will bless his home, the sacred hill in Jerusalem where his temple stands.”
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, ɔ́su ɔnini, “Líse kenye ka ndubɔya na Yudaƒuɔ bakɛ bɔnwuna na lɛtɔnku-ma liboku bana lɛma. Na si uwi ɔni na lɛ́bla ɔmɛni ni, badubɔsɔ basu banini, ‘Buuvele Unwoti bɔnii ute nwuna ɔma ɔni ndi Yerusalem Kɔbi kedee lili kesii kani na nwuna kakpakɔ kenye mmɔ kusɛ kusɛ.’

english_verse: The people will live in Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah. Some will be farmers, and others will be shepherds.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ badubɔkya Yerusalem ku Yuda lɛma bamba kemmo. Na badi badubɔbla bemonsene na badi badi bebuo badane.

english_verse: Those who feel tired and worn out will find new life and energy,
translation_verse: Bani na lɛlɔ lítu-ma na bábla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ni, badubo ɔyikun ku ngba ɔwɔdi bɔkɛ.

english_verse: and when they sleep, they will wake up refreshed.
translation_verse: Na si bátɛ bálɛɛ ni, badubɔgyinya ku ɔlɔkplu ɔwɔdi.

english_verse: Someday, Israel and Judah will be my field where my people and their livestock will grow.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔdubo ɔni na Israel ku Yuda ƒui badubo bunwini mina kemo kesii kani na mina bekyuli badubulie babi lɛlɔ ku bana bebuo ƒui.

english_verse: In the past, I took care to uproot them, to tear them down, and to destroy them. But when that day comes, I will take care to plant them and help them grow.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni návi kemmo ni, lɛ́sia ulu biala lɛlɔ nnii mɔɔgyú-ma lidie ku ligyiitu na lɛbwɛ-ma na lɛyila-ma udu ƒui. Nsu si uwi ɔmmɔ úbedu ni, ndubo anu bɔsia na lɛlɛ-ma aani kugyii na balɛ lili.

english_verse: No longer will anyone go around saying, “Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a sour taste in the mouths of their children.”
translation_verse: “Na ɔ́si uwi ɔmmɔ úsela ni, ɔdi ɔsɔ ulakana bɔsu ɔnini, ‘Kugyii ebi nyanyaanya ani na bawɔne badi ni, bana bebi kenye kemmo na ɔdu ɔmmɔ úbaƒɔ lɛlɔ ɔkya.’

english_verse: When that day comes, only those who eat sour grapes will get the sour taste, and only those who sin will be put to death. The New Agreement with Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ɔsika si limeyi lɛmmɔ lídu sɔsɔ ni, ama bani nádi egyiibi nyanyaanya ni, ama kani bana inye na ɔdu ɔmmɔ ɔdubo bɔkya. Na bani lɛnɔ nábla ekpidi ama kani na badubo bɔdu.” Katɔti Únyimiku Israel Ku Yuda Bunyimi Bɔwɔdi Bɔdi

english_verse: The Lord said: The time will surely come when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Ami Unwoti mɔɔsu ka ni, uwi ɔdubo ɔni na ndubo lɛla lɛwɔdi bunyimiku Israel kadi bekyuli ku Yuda kadi bekyuli.

english_verse: It will be different from the agreement I made with their ancestors when I led them out of Egypt. Although I was their God, they broke that agreement.
translation_verse: Na ulése aani kalɛ na línyimiku bana bati kuuku na uwi ɔni na lɛ́da-ma kɔnu kɔnu na lɛ́tɔnku-ma lɛ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na ina ami ndi bana Katɔti muedi ni, bátadi bunyimi bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Here is the new agreement that I, the Lord, will make with the people of Israel: “I will write my laws on their hearts and minds. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: “Bunyimi bɔni na ami Katɔti mɔɔsu ka ndubo bunyimiku-ma na uwi ɔni ndubo kemmo ndi ɔmɛni. Ndubuti mina ɔda bubo lɛkya-ma kayi kemmo. Na ndubunweni-mu lɛsia-ma kasusu lɛlɔ Ndubɔbla bana Katɔti na ama lɛnɔ babla mina bekyuli.

english_verse: “No longer will they have to teach one another to obey me. I, the Lord, promise that all of them will obey me, ordinary people and rulers alike. I will forgive their sins and forget the evil things they have done.”
translation_verse: “Na ɔ́si ɔƒɛni ni, ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ ulatina ɔkpanadi iye ɔnwani ka ɔti Blɔti. Ɔsika bana ƒui badubo-mi bɔti ɔ́si ubliidi ƒui útálɛ unengudi lɛlɔ. Na ɔ́si ɔƒɛni ni, ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ ulatina ɔkpanadi iye ɔnwani ka ɔti Blɔti. Ɔsika bana ƒui badubo-mi bɔti ɔ́si ubliidi ƒui útálɛ unengudi lɛlɔ. Na ndubuti bana alaekpidi ani ƒui bábla lɛkyiɛ-ma. Na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo bana ekpidi bunyimo kudii.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. I command the sun to give light each day, the moon and stars to shine at night, and ocean waves to roar.
translation_verse: Ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui na ami nédie lɛdi líte ɔƒɛ ka uteete bukeye limeyi ndi limeyi. Na kɔbuli ku ayabi lɛnɔ eteekeye usien na ɛpu avlɔvɔ eteeto taabla kudu.

english_verse: I will never forget to give those commands, and I will never let Israel stop being a nation. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Naaayiƒala ɔdi lɛdi lɛmmɔ budie bute uwi ɔdi. Lɛni kani na naaada Israel kadi bɔda bɔnyonu nnii basɔ betenwini kadi bekyuli kudii. Ami Unwoti násu.

english_verse: Can you measure the heavens? Can you explore the depths of the earth? That's how hard it would be for me to reject Israel forever, even though they have sinned. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt
translation_verse: “Ɔdi ɔdubɔka kayaa bɔkɔku bɔnu? Na kalɔ nɔɔ ɔdi ɔdubɔkana ka ɔkɔku-ka bɔgyu ɔnu? Lɛni na ubo-mi ɔkplu ka lɛda Israel bekyuli lɛnyonu uwi ƒui ina ka bábla likpidi. Ami Unwoti násu.” Badubɔsɔku Yerusalem Batu

english_verse: The Lord said: Someday, Jerusalem will truly belong to me. It will be rebuilt with a boundary line running from Hananel Tower to Corner Gate.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Limeyi lɛdi lɛdubo ɔni Yerusalem ɔdubunwini ami ɔdi geen geen. Badubo-nwu bɔsɔku bɔtu na nwuna ɔmii ɔsia ɔsi Hananel Kagyumanakɔ kpakplaa utédu kesii kani baalɔ banii Ɔkodo Ɔban Kayakun.

english_verse: From there, the boundary will go in a straight line to Gareb Hill, then turn toward Goah.
translation_verse: Na ɔmii ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔsia mmɔ ligeen usie Gareb kɔbi lili. Na unwini ɔyu usie Goa.

english_verse: Even that disgusting Hinnom Valley will be sacred to me, and so will the eastern slopes that go down from Horse Gate into Kidron Valley. Jerusalem will never again be destroyed.
translation_verse: Na Hinmn Kɔwɛ kesii kani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ muedi ɔdubo bunwini kesii kani ndubɔbla kedee ute-mi. Na ɔdanku kesii kani baalɔ Bapɔnkɔ Ɔban Kenye na ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ ɔ́yu útéduo Kidron Kɔwɛ kemmo. Na basɔ baaadubo Yerusalem bɔbwɛ lɛnɔ kudii.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in the tenth year that Zedekiah was king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylonia.
translation_verse: Na lɛkwa leevudi kemmo uwi ɔni na Sedekia ɔɔdi lɛga na Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, Unwoti údie lɛla lɛdi ɔ́tina-mi.

english_verse: At that time, the Babylonian army had surrounded Jerusalem, and I was in the prison at the courtyard of the palace guards.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Babilonƒuɔ bekpone báka bámana Yerusalem. Na ami lɛnɔ ntɛ aban ɔtɔ na ɔga kesii kaduli bagyumane enu kemmo na Yerusalem mmɔ.

english_verse: Zedekiah had ordered me to be held there because I told everyone that the Lord had said: I am the Lord, and I am about to let the king of Babylonia conquer Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Sedekia údie lɛdi ɔnii bebo-mi lɛkpu bakya mmɔ, ɔsika lɛ́su ukyuli biala ka Unwoti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ami ndi Unwoti, na ndubo bɔya na Babilon ɔga ɔdi Yerusalem lɛlɔ.

english_verse: King Zedekiah will be captured and taken to King Nebuchadnezzar, who will speak with him face to face.
translation_verse: Na badubuƒie Ɔga Sedekia batɔlɔku besienku Ɔga Nebukadnesar na ɔtɛmiku-nwu anumi ku anumi.

english_verse: Then Zedekiah will be led away to Babylonia, where he will stay until I am finished with him. So, if you people of Judah fight against the Babylonians, you will lose. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na bakpanku-nwu na utákya Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ wetédu uwi ɔni na mawɔlɔ lɛla lɛni na nnii mɔɔblaku-nwu. Anwuɔsu si amii Yudaƒuɔ bɛ́kali ka binye bɛsiaku Babilonƒuɔ na kekpokɔ ni, badubo-mii lɛlɔ bɔdi. Ami Unwoti násu.”

english_verse: Later, when I was in prison, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Kama ƒui uwi ɔni na ntɛ aban ɔtɔ ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: Jeremiah, your cousin Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, will visit you. He must sell his field near the town of Anathoth, and because you are his nearest relative, you have the right and the responsibility to buy it and keep it in the family.
translation_verse: “Yeremia, ƒ'ɔnwani Hanamel ɔni na ɔdi ƒ'ɔti ɔnwani Salum ubidi, ɔdubo ubawia-a ɔnu. Úbebo úte ka uti nwuna kalɔ kadi na kewi kede Anatos ɔma mmɔ uye. Na kalɛ na bina kɔna kuse ɔsu ni, awɔ ebo kuƒi ka eye-ka na kataakya bina ɔtɔ kemmo.”

english_verse: Hanamel came, just as the Lord had promised. And he said, “Please buy my field near Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. You have the right to buy it, and if you do, it will stay in our family.” The Lord had told me to buy it
translation_verse: Hanamel úbo aani kalɛ kani na Unwoti úse kenye na úbasu ɔnini, “Buvele, ye mina kalɔ kani na kewi kede Anatos na Benyamin kalɛkɛ kemmo na kadubɔsɔ kakya bula ɔtɔ kemmo si ákana-ka buye ɔsi awɔ mbo kuƒi kɔmmɔ.” Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nye kalɔ kammɔ

english_verse: Lord God, you stretched out your mighty arm and made the sky and the earth. You can do anything.
translation_verse: “Unwoti Katɔti, awɔ nédie ƒula kɔnu kɔni na eeti taabla ɔyiku ala na édie katɔ ku kalɔ. Na aakana na aabla lɛla biala.

english_verse: I had two copies of the bill of sale written out: an official copy containing the details of our agreement and another copy, without the details. Some witnesses and I signed the official copy, which was folded and tied, before being sealed shut with hot wax. Then I gave Hanamel the silver.
translation_verse: Na ɔku kakunkɛ kani mɔɔtina ka kalɔ kammɔ kadi keyedi ni, lɛ́ya na bédie-ka kunweni kɔkunkɛ inyɔ na kadi biala kadanku bunyimi bɔni nkɛnku kalɔ kammɔ buye lɛlɔ. Na ami ku bamanyene bɔ́kya ɔku kakunkɛ kedeedi kɔnu. Na bákono-ka na béti kɔma ku ogya bábala-ka kenye asa na líti sika ɔƒualadi ɔmmɔ líte Hanamel.

english_verse: And while he, the witnesses, and all the other Jews sitting in the courtyard were still watching, I gave both copies to Baruch son of Neriah.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na anwu Hanamel ku bamanyene ku Yudaƒuɔ babambadi bani nli kasakɔ kaduli mmɔ bamu benye baanu ni, líti lɛku inyɔ bɔmmɔ lɛ́kya Baruk ɔni ndi Neria ubidi kɔnu kemmo.

english_verse: I told Baruch that the Lord had said: Take both copies of this bill of sale, one sealed shut and the other open, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.
translation_verse: Amu na lɛ́su Baruk ka Unwoti násu ɔnini, “Ƒɔ kɔkunkɛ inyɔ bɔni ndanku kalɔ kamɛni buye bunyimi lɛlɔ. Bábala unwi kenye ku kɔma na ɔkladi use ukpludi na eti akya kavɔ ɔsii kemmo kalɛ na wetu uwi.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I promise you that people will once again buy and sell houses, farms, and vineyards in this country. Jeremiah Questions the Lord
translation_verse: Ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, na muusé-mii kenye ka bekyuli badubo lɛtɔ ku edula mmo ku adingyii mmo bɔsɔ buye na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ.” Yeremia Úye Unwoti Kenye Kadi Únu

english_verse: Then I prayed:
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́kpali Katɔti lívele nnini,

english_verse: You show kindness for a thousand generations, but you also punish people for the sins of their parents. You are the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Aanu kaba bekyuli mpim mpim kɔnyana. Na lɛni kani na aaní bekyuli kɔtu na bana bawɔne ekpidi ani na bábla ɔsu. Awɔ ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui.

english_verse: With great wisdom you make plans, and with your great power you do all the mighty things you planned. Nothing we do is hidden from your eyes, and you reward or punish us as we deserve.
translation_verse: Aata ala ani na aayɔ́ abla kɔkwɛ teese ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛnunda bonwu lɛlɔ. Na lɛla bula lɛla biala lɛni na bɔɔbla lɛdi lítabɛ-ɔ.

english_verse: You are famous because you worked miracles in Egypt, and you are still working them in Israel and in the rest of the world as well.
translation_verse: “Áƒɔ lɛnyi na akɔla budie taatina ani na ábla na Egyipte ɔsu. Amu enye aabla akɔla budie taatina ammɔ na Israelƒuɔ akɔ ku kayawi ekpo ƒui lɛnɔ.

english_verse: You terrified the Egyptians with your miracles, and you reached out your mighty arm and rescued your people Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Na ábla akɔla budie taatina amɛni éti ákya Egyipteƒuɔ liƒu geen. Na awɔ ɔlati édie ƒula kɔnu na ábla ɔyikun ala na édie ƒula kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ na Egyipteƒuɔ enu kemmo.

english_verse: Then you gave Israel this land rich with milk and honey, just as you had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Na éti kalɔ kani egyiibi ntu mɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii mɛni éte bula bati kuuku aani kalɛ kani na ése-ma kenye ése.

english_verse: But when our ancestors took over the land, they did not obey you. And now you have punished Israel with disaster.
translation_verse: “Nsu ka kalɔ kamɛni kétuku bula bati kuuku lɛkɔkɔ ni, bétenu ƒula litemi na badi-ni lɛlɔ. Na ɔƒaani ni, áni Israel kalɔ kemodi kammɔ kɔtu ku ɔgbankpi lidu.

english_verse: So why did you tell me to get some witnesses and buy a field with my silver, when Jerusalem is about to be captured by the Babylonians? The Lord Explains about the Field
translation_verse: “Na bi ɔsu na aasu-mi anii nti mina sika ɔƒualadi na liye kalɔ na lɛkɛ bamanyene ka Yerusalem ɔmmɔ na Babilonƒuɔ baayɔ́ beeƒie baƒɔ?” Unwoti Údie Kalɔ Keyedi Kammɔ Litemi Kalɔ

english_verse: The Lord explained:
translation_verse: Unwoti údie kalɔ ɔnini,

english_verse: Jeremiah, I am the Lord God. I rule the world, and I can do anything!
translation_verse: “Yeremia, ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti. Na ami mɔɔdi kayawi ƒui lɛlɔ na lɛkana na lɛbla lɛla biala na mɔɔyɔ́!

english_verse: It is true that I am going to let King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Sɔsɔ geen na ɔdi ka ndubɔya na Babilonƒuɔ Ɔga Nebukadnesar uƒie Yerusalem ɔƒɔ.

english_verse: The Babylonian army is already attacking, and they will capture the city and set it on fire. The people of Jerusalem have made me angry by going up to the flat roofs of their houses and burning incense to Baal and offering wine sacrifices to other gods. Now these houses will be burned to the ground!
translation_verse: Na Babilonƒuɔ bekpone báata kekpo sɔsɔ na badubo ɔma ɔmmɔ bɔbwɛ na batu ogya bakya-nwu. Yerusalemƒuɔ bákya-mi kɔnyi geen na uwi ɔni na bákɔ bésie bana asa eli bátakyula oloƒui béte Baal baƒiɔ na beewi ntɛ kalɔ teete baƒiɔ bamba. Ndubo bɔya na bakyula lɛtɔ lɛmmɔ bewi kalɔ ɔƒaani!

english_verse: The kings and the officials, the priests and the prophets, and everyone else in Israel and Judah have turned from me and made me angry by worshiping idols. Again and again I have tried to teach my people to obey me, but they refuse to be corrected. I am going to get rid of Jerusalem, because its people have done nothing but evil.
translation_verse: “Baga ku bana bakutine ku bakpane ku kenye bediene ku bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bénwini kama bákya-mi bésie baakpá baƒiɔ na bákya-mi kɔnyi. Lɛ́ɛtina-ma kɔlɛ kɔlɛ, nsu bébulo banii ntenwini-ma na benu-mi litemi na bataadi-ni lɛlɔ. “Ndubo Yerusalem udu bɔyila ƒui, ɔsika bekyuli bammɔ balabla lɛbuni lɛdi teetulo likyulikpi ala bɔbla.

english_verse: They have set up repulsive idols in my temple, and now it isn't a fit place to worship me.
translation_verse: Bávɔ baƒiɔ lidu lɛni muusé lɛlɔ bálɛ-mi kakpakɔ na mmɔ kásɔ kátamanku ka babla lɛkpa lɛdi bete-mi.

english_verse: And they led Judah into sin by building places to worship Baal in Hinnom Valley, where they also sacrificed their sons and daughters to the god Molech. I have never even imagined they would commit such disgusting sins.
translation_verse: Na báya na Yuda lɛnɔ únwini alaekpidi ɔblane, ɔsika bátu ekpo ekpo bálɛ Ben-Hinom Kɔwɛ kemmo ka bataakpa Baal baƒiɔ. Na béti mmɔ bénwini kesii kani na baadú bana bebi bananabi ku belekubi taakyula taakpa Molek baƒiɔ. Na ami ńtabla kasusu kamɛni udu kudii muedi ka babla ɔmɛni udu bete-mi.

english_verse: Jeremiah, what you said is true. The people of Jerusalem are suffering from hunger and disease, and so the king of Babylonia will be able to capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Yeremia, lɛla lɛni na ásu mɛni ndi litemi geen. Yerusalem bekyuli bebo abi ku ɔlɛ bunu. Na kɔka kɔɔda-ma. Ulu ɔdi use ute Babilon Ɔga ka ubeƒie-ma.

english_verse: I am angry with the people of Jerusalem, and I will scatter them in foreign countries. But someday I will bring them back here and let them live in safety.
translation_verse: “Líti kɔnyi geen lɛ́kya Yerusalemƒuɔ na ndubɔya na begyingya-ma bakya kaƒɔ kɔlɔ lɛlɔ. Nsu ndubo-ma bɔsɔku buboku mɛni limeyi lɛdi na belie ku keyi buɛɛ na lɛla lɛdi lɛsɔ lilékpoku-ma.

english_verse: They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Badubɔbla mina bekyuli na ami lɛbla bana Katɔti.

english_verse: I will make their thoughts and desires pure. Then they will realize that, for their own good and the good of their children, they must worship only me. They will even be afraid to turn away from me. I will make an agreement with them that will never end, and I won't ever stop doing good things for them. With all my heart I promise that they will be planted in this land once again.
translation_verse: Na ndubo bɔbla na bana kayi ayɔla ku bana kasusu kemmo kabla sɛɛn. Na badubo bɔnu bɔti ka na bana bɔdia ku bana bebi bɔdia ɔsu ni, ami lɛti pɛ kani na ɔlɛka bakpa. Na liƒu muedi lɛdubo-ma bɔda ka basɔ benwini kama bakya-mi. Na ndubo bunyimi bɔdi bunyimiku-ma na buuubo kawɔlɔkɔ kadi kudii. Na lɛɛɛdubo lɛbuni lɛnɔ bɔda bɔbla bute-ma bɔya kudii. Na muusé kenye ku mina kayi ƒui ka ndubo bɔya na basɔ benwini bebelie kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ kpi.

english_verse: Even though I have brought disaster on the people, I will someday do all these good things for them.
translation_verse: “Ina ka lɛ́ya na ɔgbankpi ɔ́siaku-ma ni, limeyi lɛdi lɛdubo lɛni na ndubo ala abuni amɛni ƒui bɔbla bute-ma.

english_verse: Jeremiah, when you bought the field, you showed that fields will someday be bought and sold again. You say that this land has been conquered by the Babylonians and has become a desert, emptied of people and animals.
translation_verse: “Yeremia, uwi ɔni na éye kalɔ kammɔ ni, ɔ́tina ka limeyi lɛdi lɛdubo ɔni na basɔ badubɔkana na beye kɔlɔ bete lɛlɔ. Aasu anii bádi kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ na bekyuli ku bebuo ƒui bása-ka lɛlɔ na kenwini ketele kalɔ kakwiidi.

english_verse: But someday, people will again spend their silver to buy fields everywhere—in the territory of Benjamin, the region around Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and in the hill country, the foothills to the west, and the Southern Desert. Buyers and sellers and witnesses will sign and seal the bills of sale for the fields. It will happen, because I will give this land back to my people. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Nsu limeyi lɛdi ni, bekyuli badubo bana sika ɔƒualadi buti buboku bubeye kɔlɔ na mɛni kesii biala na Benyamin kalɛkɛ ku Yerusalem kalɔ ku Yuda lɛma kemmo ƒui ku abi ammɔ lɛlɔ. Na beye abi kɔƒɔna mmɔ bene úti úsie ɔƒɛ kanukɔ ku kalɔ kakwiidi kani na kada kakɛ. Na kalɔ balati ku beyene ƒui badubɔbla lɛku basia kɔlɔ kuyedi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na bamanyene bakya kɔnu na lɛla lɛni na bényi na kɔlɔ kɔmmɔ buye lɛlɔ na benyimi lɛku lɛmmɔ kenye ku ekposela. Na ɔdubo bɔlɛ lɛni, ɔsika ndubɔsɔ kalɔ kamɛni lite mina bekyuli. Ami Unwoti násu.”

english_verse: I was still being held prisoner in the courtyard of the palace guards when the Lord told me: I am the Lord, and I created the whole world.
translation_verse: Bagyumanane bammɔ bámu bábala-mi bákya ɔga kaduli mmɔ aani ɔtɔntɛne kalɛ asa na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ami ndi Unwoti, na ami nédie kayawi kemodi kammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will tell you things that you don't know and can't find out.
translation_verse: Ala ani na aaagyi ƒui ku ani kalɔ na alakana bɔwia bɔti ni, ye-mi na lɛsu-ɔ nya.

english_verse: Many of the houses in Jerusalem and some of the buildings at the royal palace have been torn down to be used in repairing the walls to keep out the Babylonian attackers. Now there are empty spaces where the buildings once stood. But I am furious, and these spaces will be filled with the bodies of the people I kill. The people of Jerusalem will cry out to me for help, but they are evil, and I will ignore their prayers.
translation_verse: “Yerusalem lɛtɔ pii lɛ́kya ku baga kesii muedi lɛni na bébo báƒɛ na béti báklibi awodu bonwu ani na bátu bámana Yerusalem kalɛ na Babilonƒuɔ bekpone balakana buduo bubile ala. Anwuɔsu kesii kani na lɛtɔ lɛmɛni línye únwini kalɔ kekpludi na kewi. Nsu lɛ́kɛ kɔnyi lɛ́kya Yerusalem geen na bekyuli bani na ndubo bɔya na badu ni, badubɔƒɔ mmɔ ƒui. Yerusalemƒuɔ badubo buwulo bakpali-mi bevele, nsu lɛɛɛdubo-ma bɔkpete na bana likyulikpi ɔsu, ɔsika ndubudie-ma atu.

english_verse: Then someday, I will heal this place and my people as well, and let them enjoy unending peace.
translation_verse: “Kama ƒui na limeyi lɛdi lɛlɔ ni, ndubo mɛni bɔklibi na lɛbwi bekyuli bammɔ ƒui na lɛya na belie ku keyi buɛɛ kani neeebo kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: I will give this land to Israel and Judah once again, and I will make them as strong as they were before.
translation_verse: Ndubɔsɔku kalɔ kamɛni lite Israel ku Yuda na lɛya na basɔ bakɛ ɔyikun ɔni nákya-ma kudeedi.

english_verse: They sinned and rebelled against me, but I will forgive them and take away their guilt.
translation_verse: Bábla alaekpidi na báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ, nsu ndubuti lɛkyiɛ-ma na lidie bana bɔƒiɔ ƒui bana lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When that happens, all nations on earth will see the good things I have done for Jerusalem, and how I have given it complete peace. The nations will celebrate and praise and honor me, but they will also tremble with fear because of the powerful things I have done.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na ala amɛni álɛ lɛni ni, kalɔ lɛlɔ kadi bekyuli ƒui badububo ala abuni ani na lɛ́bla líte Yerusalem bɔnu ku kalɛ na lɛ́ya na ɔ́kɛ keyi buɛɛ geen. Na lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-ma na batɔ ku ebiti na bemwi-mi na bataabu-mi lɛnɔ. Nsu liƒu bonwu lɛdubo-ma bɔda na lɛlɔ litaatɔ-ma.

english_verse: Jeremiah, you say that this land is a desert without people or animals, and for now, you are right. The towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem are deserted, and people and animals are nowhere to be seen. But someday you will hear
translation_verse: “Yeremia, aasu anii kalɔ kamɛni kadi ketele kalɔ kakwiidi na bekyuli ku bebuo ƒui basɔ beeebo-ka lɛlɔ. Sɔsɔ na ásu na use lɛni ɔƒɛni. Yuda lɛma ku Yerusalem lɛblɔnu ƒui liwi ukpludi na bekyuli ku bebuo badi basɔ beeebo kesii kadi na anu. Nsu limeyi lɛdi ni, adubunu

english_verse: happy voices and the sounds of parties and wedding celebrations. And when people come to my temple to offer sacrifices to thank me, you will hear them say: “We praise you, Lord All-Powerful! You are good to us, and your love never fails.” The land will once again be productive.
translation_verse: lɛlɔyɔ kɔvanu ku ebiti kasala lidu lidu. Na adubunu ka beeti beleku taawɛɛ-ma ku ebiti katɔ. Na si bekyuli bébo-mi kudɔ na mina kakpakɔ banii beeti etela babakpa bete-mi ni, adubunu ka baasu banini, “ ‘Buumwi-ɔ, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui! Bɛgya Unwoti enu, ɔsika ɔdia na ɔɔyɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.’ Na kalɔ kammɔ kadubɔsɔ kadia edula.

english_verse: Now it is empty, without people or animals. But when that time comes, shepherds will take care of their flocks in pastures near every town in the hill country, in the foothills to the west, in the Southern Desert, in the land of the Benjamin tribe, and around Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord's Wonderful Promise
translation_verse: “Ɔƒaani ni, kewi ukpludi na bekyuli iye bebuo badi beeebo-ka lɛlɔ. Nsu si uwi ɔmmɔ úbedu ni, baƒonu badane ku bana baƒonu badubɔƒɔ lɛma lɛmmɔ ƒui adɔ na abi kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ na benye bataanu-ma lɛlɔ na kadikɔ mmɔ. Na badubɔƒɔ abi kɔƒɔna mmɔ bene ƒui úti úsie ɔƒɛ kanukɔ na ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kani na kada kakɛ na Benyamin kɔdua kalɔ kemmo ku Yerusalem amadɔ ku Yuda lɛma amadɔ ƒui. Ami Unwoti násu.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I made a wonderful promise to Israel and Judah, and the days are coming when I will keep it.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Líse Israel ku Yuda kenye kabuni kadi. Na uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ɔni na ndubɔdi linyese lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I promise that the time will come when I will appoint a king from the family of David, a king who will be honest and rule with justice.
translation_verse: Líse kenye ka ndubɔƒuna ɔga ɔdi lɛsiku Dawid ɔtɔ kemmo si uwi ɔdi úbedu. Na ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔsu litemi geen na ɔdi bekyuli lɛlɔ na ɔtɛ litemi ulu siin lɛlɔ.

english_verse: In those days, Judah will be safe; Jerusalem will have peace and will be named, “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Yuda ɔdubulie ƒaa na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛdubo-nwu bukpoku. Na Yerusalem ɔdubulie ku keyi buɛɛ na bekyuli badubɔsia-nwu lɛnyi banii ‘Unwoti ɔɔtɛ litemi siin.’

english_verse: The king of Israel will be one of David's descendants,
translation_verse: “Na uwi biala ni, Israel ɔga ɔdubɔsi Dawid bawɔ kemmo.

english_verse: and there will always be priests from the Levi tribe serving at my altar and offering sacrifices to please me and to give thanks.
translation_verse: Na uwi biala kemmo ni, bakpane badubɔsi Lewi kɔdua kemmo na benye bataabla kabla bete-mi na mina lɛkpabi lɛlɔ na bataakyula akpala ani ndubɔyɔ-mi kaƒɔ teete-mi beti bataagya-mi enu.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me:
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: I, the Lord, have an agreement with day and night, so they always come at the right time. You can't break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: “Ami Unwoti línyimi lɛla lɛdi líse líte usien ku ɔƒɛ na ɔɔlɛ́ lɛni na uwi lɛlɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ uwi ndi uwi. Na ɔdi ulakana na webile lɛla lɛni na línyimi líte-ma mmɔ.

english_verse: and you can't break the agreements I have made with David's family and with the priests from the Levi tribe who serve at my altar. A descendant of David will always rule as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni na línyimiku Dawid ɔtɔ bekyuli ku Lewi kɔdua bekyuli bani mɔɔkpá na mina lɛkpabi lɛlɔ ni, ɔdi ulakana na webile-mu. Dawid bawɔ akɔ na ukyuli ɔdubɔsi utaadi Israel lɛga uwi biala.

english_verse: and there will be more descendants of David and of the priests from the Levi tribe than stars in the sky or grains of sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Na Dawid ku bakpane bani nási Lewi kɔdua kemmo badubɔkɛ bawɔ pii betulo kayaa ayabi iye ɛpu kɔnwinimi.”

english_verse: The Lord also said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: You've heard foreigners insult my people by saying, “The Lord chose Israel and Judah, but now he has rejected them, and they are no longer a nation.”
translation_verse: “Baƒɔ benye beedumi mina kadi bekyuli taasu banini, ‘Unwoti ɔ́ƒuna Israel ku Yuda aani nwuna bekyuli, nsu ɔƒɛni amu úni-ma na basɔ beenye aani kadi bekyuli.’

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will never break my agreement with the day and the night or let the sky and the earth stop obeying my commands.
translation_verse: “Yeremia, lɛɛɛdubo lɛla lɛni na línyimi líte usien ku ɔƒɛ kama bɔlɛ na libile-mu kudii iye lɛya na kalɔ ku kayaa bada-mi ɔda ɔni na líbo-ma lɛlɔ bɔdi baya kudii.

english_verse: In the same way, I will never reject the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob or break my promise that they will always have a descendant of David as their king. I will be kind to my people Israel, and they will be successful again.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na lɛɛɛdubo Abraham ku Isak ku Yakob bawɔ buni iye libile kenye kani na líse-ma ka nwuna bawɔ ndubo lɛga butaadi uwi biala kudii. Ndubo mina kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ lɛƒɔndia lɛdi bɔbla na ala asɔ adianku-ma.”

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar had a large army made up of people from every kingdom in his empire. He and his army were attacking Jerusalem and all the nearby towns, when the Lord told me
translation_verse: Nebukadnesar ubo bekpone lisu bonwu lɛdi na bakya nwuna lɛga kadikɔ. Na ɔ́ƒuna-ma ɔ́siku kɔlɛkɛ kɔni lɛga kɔdikɔ nkya-nwu kalɔ kemmo. Anwu ku nwuna bekpone bamɛni bakya beekpóku Yerusalem ku kɔlɔ kɔni na amadɔ mmɔ asa na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii

english_verse: to say to King Zedekiah: I am the Lord, and I am going to let Nebuchadnezzar capture this city and burn it down.
translation_verse: ntásu Ɔga Sedekia ɔnini, “Ami ndi Unwoti na ndubo bɔya na Nebukadnesar ɔka ɔma ɔmɛni ɔkya na ɔkyula-nwu.

english_verse: You will be taken prisoner and brought to Nebuchadnezzar, and he will speak with you face to face. Then you will be led away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Kekpo kadubo-ɔ buƒie na beti-ɔ bete Nebukadnesar na bɛtɛmi anumi ku anumi. Na ɔmmɔ kama na beti-ɔ besienku Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Zedekiah, I promise that you won't die in battle.
translation_verse: “Sedekia, líse kenye ka baaadubo-ɔ bɔdu na kekpokɔ.

english_verse: You will die a peaceful death. People will mourn when you die, and they will light bonfires in your honor, just as they did for your ancestors, the kings who ruled before you.
translation_verse: Awɔ ɔlati adubo bukpi buɛɛ na bekyuli bewulo-ɔ na ƒula kukpi kalɔ. Na badubo agyavonku bɔsala beti bete ƒula lɛnyi ɔbu aani kalɛ na bábla bete ƒula bati kuuku bani nádi lɛga asa na úbedu-ɔ.”

english_verse: I went to Zedekiah and told him what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Amu na lísie Sedekia kudɔ na ńtásɔku ala ani ƒui na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi mɛni lɛ́su-nwu.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the king of Babylonia was trying to break through the walls of Lachish, Azekah, and Jerusalem, the only three towns of Judah that had not been captured. The People Break a Promise
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ƒui ni, na Babilon ɔga unye momoomo ɔɔwia kuƒi kɔni na ɔbwɛ Lakis ku Aseka ku Yerusalem lɛma awodu na uduo-ma lɛlɔ. Na lɛma ɛtɛ lɛmɛni kani ndi Yudaƒuɔ lɛma lɛni nébu na útabwɛ tɔ. Ɔga Sedekia Ku Anwu Badi Bátadi Bana Linyese Lɛlɔ

english_verse: King Zedekiah, his officials, and everyone else in Jerusalem made an agreement to free all Hebrew men and women who were slaves. No Jew would keep another as a slave. And so, all the Jewish slaves were given their freedom.
translation_verse: Ɔga Sedekia ku nwuna bakutine benengu ku Yerusalemƒuɔ bammɔ ƒui bényimi bunyimi bɔdi ka badubute bana Hebriƒuɔ banwani bani mɔɔbla bekyuli bamba kabla bɔnwuna.

english_verse: But those slave owners changed their minds and forced their former slaves back into slavery.
translation_verse: Nsu batɔlati bani mbo kabla bablane bamɛni bávumana bana kasusu na básɔ béténye-ma lɛlɔ na bénwini bébo baabla-ma kabla.

english_verse: That's when the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nsu bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini,

english_verse: I am the Lord God of Israel, and I made an agreement with your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, where they had been slaves.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi Unwoti, Israel Katɔti, na línyimi bunyimi bɔdi ku bina bati kuuku uwi ɔni na lɛ́kpanku-mii lɛ́siku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ kesii kani na nka badi bekyuli bamba kabla bablane.

english_verse: As part of this agreement, you must let a Hebrew slave go free after six years of service. Your ancestors did not obey me,
translation_verse: Na aani bunyimi bɔmɛni kakɛ kadi ni, ɔlɛka amii lɛnɔ bɛya na Hebrini ɔnwa ɔni na ɔdi ƒula kabla ɔblane ni, ete-nwu bɔnwuna na ulie ute lɛlɔ na akwa aku kama. “Bina bati kuuku betenu-mi litemi na badi-ni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: but you decided to obey me and do the right thing by setting your Hebrew slaves completely free. You even went to my temple, and in my name you made an agreement to set them free. But you have abused my name, because you broke that agreement and forced your former slaves back into slavery.
translation_verse: Nsu amii bɛ́lɛ ugyii ka bɛdubunu-mi litemi na bɛbla lɛla lɛni na lɛ́manku bite bina banwani bammɔ na bite-ma bɔnwuna ƒui kede kede. Na ɔɔɔdi kesii bamba kadi na bínye bɛ́su ɔmɛni mmomu mina kakpakɔ kemmo geen na bíduo bísie bítálɛ ɔmɛni ugyii na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ. Nsu bítabu-mi lɛnyi munu munu mmomu bíbile bunyimi bɔmmɔ na bɛ́sɔ bísie bítenye bina kabla bablane bammɔ lɛlɔ na básɔ bénwini bébo baabla-mii kabla.

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by not giving your slaves their freedom. So I will give you freedom—the freedom to die in battle or from disease or hunger. I will make you disgusting to all other nations on earth.
translation_verse: “Ka bítete bina kabla bablane bɔnwuna ɔsu ni, bítadi mina litemi lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu ami ndubute-mii bɔnwuna ƒaa na bɛƒuna ka bikpi na kekpokɔ iye ɔlɛ ukpidi ubo-mii iye kɔka kɔdu-mii. Na ndubɔya na binwini lɛla lɛni muusé lɛlɔ na kadi bekyuli ƒui anumi na kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni.

english_verse: You asked me to be a witness when you made the agreement to set your slaves free. And as part of the ceremony you cut a calf into two parts, then walked between the parts. But you people of Jerusalem have broken that agreement as well as my agreement with Israel. So I will do to you what you did to that calf.
translation_verse: “Na bunyimi bɔmɛni ɔdi bɔbla kemmo ni, bɛ́du ɔmantɛ akɔ ubi na bɛ́bwɛ-nwu kemmo akpa anyɔ. Na bisie bɛ́vi kɔkɛ kɔmmɔ ntɛ na bɛ́su bɛnii ami nnye bina bunyimi bɔmɛni kama ka bɛdubute bina banwani bɔnwuna. Nsu amii Yerusalemƒuɔ bíni na bítadi bunyimi bɔmɛni iye ami bɔdi bɔni na línyimiku Israel lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu lɛla lɛni na bɛ́bla ɔmantɛ akɔ ubi ɔmɛni ni, ani kani na ndubo-mii bɔbla.

english_verse: I will let your enemies take all of you prisoner, including the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the royal officials, the priests, and everyone else who walked between the two parts of the calf. These enemies will kill you and leave your bodies lying on the ground as food for birds and wild animals.
translation_verse: Ndubo bɔya na bina bekisine beƒie-mii ƒui batɔlɔku. Amii Yudaƒuɔ batɔnkune bammɔ ku baga kesii bakutine ku bakpane ku bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bani nésie bávi ɔmantɛ akɔ ubi kɔkɛ kɔmmɔ ntɛ. Bina bekisine bamɛni badubo-mii bɔdu na bada-mii bewi kalɔ ntɛ ute baasɛ ku alakpi akɔ bebuo na bakun.

english_verse: These enemies are King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia and his army. They have stopped attacking Jerusalem, but they want to kill King Zedekiah and his high officials. So I will command them to return and attack again. This time they will conquer the city and burn it down, and they will capture Zedekiah and his officials. I will also let them destroy the towns of Judah, so that no one can live there any longer.
translation_verse: “Na bekisine bamɛni ndi Ɔga Nebukadnesar ku nwuna bekpone bani nási Babilon. Báada Yerusalem bukpoku baya na baawia Ɔga Sedekia ku nwuna bakutine kani badu. Nsu ndubo lɛdi budie bute-ma na basɔ benwini bebekpoku Yerusalem. Na ɔƒaani ni, badubɔka Yerusalem ɔma ɔmmɔ bakya na badi-nwu lɛlɔ na bakyula lɛla biala. Na beƒie Ɔga Sedekia ku nwuna bakutine bammɔ. Na ndubɔya na babwɛ Yuda lɛma lɛmmɔ ƒui na ɔdi ɔsɔ ulelie mmɔ.”

english_verse: When Jehoiakim was king of Judah, the Lord told me,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Ɔga Yehoiakim ɔdi ɔga na Yuda ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: “Go to the Rechabite clan and invite them to meet you in one of the side rooms of the temple. When they arrive, offer them a drink of wine.”
translation_verse: “Sie na atásu Rekabiƒuɔ kɔdua bekyuli anii bebo na bɛsa na kakpakɔ lɛtɔ lɛni na ɔƒɛnyi mmɔ ɔdi kemmo. Na si bébo ni, na ete-ma ntɛ bɔdi na bani.”

english_verse: So I went to Jaazaniah, the leader of the clan, and I invited him and all the men of his clan.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu lísie kɔdua kɔmmɔ unengu ɔni baalɔ banii Yaasania kudɔ na ńtálɔ-nwu ku nwuna kɔdua kɔmmɔ banana ƒui.

english_verse: I brought them into the temple courtyard and took them upstairs to a room belonging to the prophets who were followers of Hanan son of Igdaliah. It was next to a room belonging to some of the officials, and that room was over the one belonging to Maaseiah, a priest who was one of the high officials in the temple.
translation_verse: Lɛ́kpanku-ma líboku kakpakɔ kaduli kemmo na lítiku-ma lísienku ɔtɔ ɔni mma batɛyane bani nsiaku Igdalia ubidi Kenye Udiene Hana ɔdi lɛlɔ. Ɔtɔ ɔmɛni ɔdi katu taasia ɔtɔ ɔni nsia kakpakɔ kammɔ bakpane benengu akɔ unwi ɔni baalɔ Maaseia ɔdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I set out some large bowls full of wine together with some cups, and then I said to the Rechabites, “Have some wine!”
translation_verse: Amu na lɛ́gyu ntɛ ku lɛkyami bonwu lɛdi lɛ́lɛ-ma anumi na liti lɛɛƒɛɛ lɛnɔ líse-mu kudɔ na lɛ́su Rekabiƒuɔ bammɔ nnini, “Bɛni ntɛ bɔmmɔ bɔdi.”

english_verse: But they answered: No! The ancestor of our clan, Jonadab son of Rechab, made a rule that we must obey. He said, “Don't ever drink wine
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bédie kenye banini, “Oowo! Bula kɔdua ɔti kuuku ɔni ndi Rekab ubidi Yonadab úbo-bu ɔda ɔdi ɔnini, ‘Ɔdi utani ntɛ bɔdi kudii,’ na ɔdi ka bɔdi-mu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: or build houses or plant crops and vineyards. Instead, you must always live in tents and move from place to place. If you obey this command, you will live a long time.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-bu lɛnɔ ɔnini, ‘Bitatu lɛtɔ na bitesie adingyii mmo bɔdi lɛnɔ. Mmomu biteelie taata ɔ́si likpo linwi úsie likpo bamba. Na si bɛ́di ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni, bɛdubulie ngba gyɔlɔɔ.’

english_verse: Our clan has always obeyed Jonadab's command. To this very day, we and our wives and sons and daughters don't drink wine or build houses or plant vineyards or crops. And we have lived in tents,
translation_verse: Na bula kɔdua bɔɔdi Yonadab ɔda bubo bɔmɛni lɛlɔ uwi biala. Na úti úbalɛ ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ni, abu ku bula beleku ku bebi bananabi ku belekubi ƒui bulani ntɛ na bulatu lɛtɔ lɛnɔ teelie-ni kemmo na bulesie adingyii mmo lɛnɔ. Na adi kevo kemmo kani na buulie uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: except now we have to live inside Jerusalem because Nebuchadnezzar has taken over the countryside with his army from Babylonia and Syria.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmɛni kemmo kani na úbebo úte ka bulie Yerusalem, ɔsika Ɔga Nebukadnesar ku nwuna bekpone béƒie aku kalɔ kani náka kámana ƒui báƒɔ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, want you to learn a lesson
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nsu Yudaƒuɔ ku Yerusalemƒuɔ ɔnini, “Ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti, mɔɔwia ka bɛtɛya lɛla lɛdi

english_verse: from the Rechabite clan. Their ancestor Jonadab told his descendants never to drink wine, and to this very day they have obeyed him. But I have spoken to you over and over, and you haven't obeyed me!
translation_verse: bɛsiku Rekabiƒuɔ kɔdua bekyuli lɛlɔ. Bana ɔti kuuku Yonadab ɔ́su nwuna bawɔ ɔnii batani ntɛ bɔdi kudii. Na úti úbalɛ ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ni, baadi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Nsu amii amu ni, lɛ́ɛtɛmiku-mii kɔlɛ kɔlɛ, nsu bíni bɛnii bilenu na bɛdi mina etemila lɛlɔ!

english_verse: You refused to listen to my prophets, who kept telling you, “Stop doing evil and worshiping other gods! Start obeying the Lord, and he will let you live in this land he gave your ancestors.”
translation_verse: Bíni bɛnii bilenu mina kenye bediene bani mɔɔsu-mii uwi ndi uwi banini, ‘Bɛda alaekpidi bɔbla bɛya na bɛda baƒiɔ lɛnɔ bɔkpa bɛya! Na bise kalɔ biteenu Unwoti litemi na bitaadi-ni lɛlɔ na ɔdubɔya na bilie kalɔ kani na úti úte bina bati kuuku mɛni lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: The Rechabites have obeyed the command of their ancestor Jonadab, but you have not obeyed me,
translation_verse: Rekabiƒuɔ bénu bana ɔti kuuku Yonadab ɔda ɔni na úbo-ma na baadi-nwu lɛlɔ. Nsu amii bítenu mina litemi na bɛdi-ni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: your God. I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warned you about the terrible things that would happen to you if you did not listen to me. But you have ignored me, so now disaster will strike you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Makes a Promise to the Rechabites
translation_verse: Ami ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui, na mɔɔsu-mii kpakplaa ka si bítenu-mi litemi na binwini kayi ni, ɔgbankpi bonwu ɔdi ɔdubo-mii lɛlɔ. Na ka bíni-mi ɔsu ni, ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ ɔdubo-mii buyu bɔtu. Ami Unwoti násu.” Unwoti Úse Rekabiƒuɔ Kenye Kadi

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the Rechabite clan: “I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You have obeyed your ancestor Jonadab,
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nsu Rekabiƒuɔ kɔdua bekyuli ɔnini, “Ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, Israel Katɔti. Ka bínu bina ɔti Yonadab litemi na bɛ́di-ni lɛlɔ ɔsu ni,

english_verse: so I promise that your clan will be my servants and will never die out.”
translation_verse: líse-mii kenye ka bina kɔdua bekyuli badubo mina kabla bablane bunwini na bilekpi bilása kudii.”

english_verse: During the fourth year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah, the Lord said to me, “Jeremiah,
translation_verse: Lɛkwa linedi kemmo ka Yosia ubidi Yehoiakim ɔɔdi lɛga na Yuda ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Yeremia,

english_verse: since the time Josiah was king, I have been speaking to you about Israel, Judah, and the other nations. Now, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you,
translation_verse: uwi ɔni na Yosia ɔɔdi lɛga ƒui na líse kalɔ mɔɔsu-ɔ ala taasiku Israel ku Yuda ku kadi bamba bekyuli lɛlɔ. Ɔƒaani ni, wia ɔku kakunkɛ na enweni ala ani ƒui na lɛ́su-ɔ ese.

english_verse: then read it to the people of Judah. Maybe they will stop sinning when they hear what terrible things I plan for them. And if they turn back to me, I will forgive them.”
translation_verse: Na aka ala ammɔ ƒui atina Yudaƒuɔ. Ɔƒɛni kalɛ si bénu ɔgbankpi ɔni na lɛ́su ka ɔdubɔlɛku-ma si betenwini kayi ni, ɔdubɔya na bada alaekpidi bɔbla baya na si bénwini bébo-mi kudɔ ni, ndubuti lɛkyiɛ-ma.”

english_verse: I sent for Baruch son of Neriah and asked him to help me. I repeated everything the Lord had told me, and Baruch wrote it all down on a scroll.
translation_verse: Amu na lɛ́ya na bátálɔ Neria ubidi Baruk béte-mi na lívele-nwu nnii ubunku-mi na bunweni ala ammɔ ƒui buse. Anwuɔsu lɛ́sɔku ala ani na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ƒui lɛ́ka na Baruk únweni-nya ƒui ɔ́sia ɔku kakunkɛ lɛlɔ úse.

english_verse: Then I said, Baruch, the officials refuse to let me go into the Lord's temple,
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́lɔ-nwu nnini, “Baruk, benengu bammɔ béni banii nteduo Unwoti kakpakɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: so you must go instead. Wait for the next holy day when the people of Judah come to the temple to pray and to go without eating. Then take this scroll to the temple and read it aloud.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu awɔ mmomu teesie. Nsu ya na udu limeyi bamba lɛni lɛlɔ na Yudaƒuɔ beesié taatákpali katɔ na beenyimi kenye. Na eti ɔku kakunkɛ kamɛni na esie atáka ala amɛni ƒui momoomo na ɔdi biala unu.

english_verse: The Lord is furious, and if the people hear how he is going to punish them, maybe they will ask to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni kalɛ si bénu lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su ka wabla-ma na bana ekpidi ɔsu ni, badubo bunwini na bevele Unwoti banii uti bana bɔƒiɔ ɔkyiɛ-ma, ɔsika úti kɔnyi geen.”

english_verse: In the ninth month of the fifth year that Jehoiakim was king, the leaders set a day when everyone who lived in Jerusalem or who was visiting there had to pray and go without eating. So Baruch took the scroll to the upper courtyard of the temple. He went over to the side of the courtyard and stood in a covered area near New Gate, where he read the scroll aloud. This covered area belonged to Gemariah, one of the king's highest officials.
translation_verse: Na Ɔga Yehoiakim lɛga bɔdi lɛkwa lɛlɔndi kemmo na kɔbuli yaalenwidi kɔni baalɔ Kislev na Hebriƒuɔ abuli bɔka kenye ni, Yudaƒuɔ batɔnkune bása na bálɛ limeyi lɛdi ugyii bése ka bekyuli bani ƒui nkya Yerusalem ku bani na ɔgbami na bávi bébo mmɔ ƒui ɔlɛka benyimi kenye na bakpali Katɔti. Anwuɔsu Baruk úti ɔku kakunkɛ kammɔ na úsie kakpakɔ kaduli kemmo mmɔ kesii kani baalɔ banii Ɔban Kayakun Kawɔdi kenye na úténye mmɔ ɔ́ka ɔku ɔmmɔ kemmo etemila ƒui momoomo úte bekyuli bammɔ. Likpo lɛmɛni lɛdi kesii kani na bébi na báklibi bése kaduɛ na ɔdi unengu ɔni baalɔ Gemaria kadi na ɔdi Seƒan ubidi.

english_verse: Gemariah's son Micaiah was there and heard Baruch read what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Gemaria ɔmɛni ubidi ɔni baalɔ Mikaia lɛnɔ ɔ́kya mmɔ na únu ka Baruk ɔ́ka lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su.

english_verse: When Baruch finished reading, Micaiah went down to the palace. His father Gemariah was in the officials' room, meeting with the rest of the king's officials, including Elishama, Delaiah, Elnathan, and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Baruk ɔ́ka ala amɛni ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, Gemaria únwini úsie ɔga lɛgbanya mmɔ na útásiaku ɔti Gemaria ku bakutine bamba na bana ɔku unwenine ɔtɔ ka anwu ku ɔga bakutine bakladi beli baabla kelisa kadi, na bana akɔ bani ndi Elisama ku Delaia ku Elnatan ku Sedekaia.

english_verse: Micaiah told them what he had heard Baruch read to the people.
translation_verse: Mikaia ɔ́sɔku ala ani na únu ka Baruk ɔ́ka úte bekyuli bammɔ ƒui mmɔ ɔ́su-ma.

english_verse: Then the officials sent Jehudi and Shelemiah to tell Baruch, “Bring us that scroll.” When Baruch arrived with the scroll,
translation_verse: Mmɔ na benengu bammɔ bátala Yehudi ku Selemia bákya Baruk banii batásu-ma banini, “Ti ɔku kakunkɛ kani na áka mmɔ boku-bu.” Amu uwi ɔni na Baruk úti ɔku kakunkɛ kammɔ úboku ni,

english_verse: the officials said, “Please sit down and read it to us,” which he did.
translation_verse: benengu bammɔ básu-nwu banini, “Buvele, lie kalɔ na aka ɔku ɔmmɔ ete-bu.” Na anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́ka-nwu úte-ma sɔsɔ.

english_verse: After they heard what was written on the scroll, they were worried and said to each other, “The king needs to hear this!” Turning to Baruch, they asked,
translation_verse: Ɔku ɔmmɔ kenye kékpoku-ma ka bénu ala ani na ɔ́ka mmɔ. Anwuɔsu básu lɛlɔ banini, “Ɔlɛka bula ɔga lɛnɔ unu ɔku ɔmɛni kenye!” Na bénwini bésie Baruk kudɔ na béye-nwu banini,

english_verse: “Did someone tell you what to write on this scroll?”
translation_verse: “Ukyuli ɔdi násu-ɔ lɛla lɛni na enweni akya ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo?”

english_verse: “Yes, Jeremiah did,” Baruch replied. “I wrote down just what he told me.”
translation_verse: Amu na Baruk údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɛɛn, Yeremia násu-mi lɛla lɛmmɔ. Na lɛla lɛni kani na ɔ́su-mi na línweni.”

english_verse: The officials said, “You and Jeremiah must go into hiding, and don't tell anyone where you are going.”
translation_verse: Amu na benengu bammɔ básu Baruk banini, “Ɔdi ka awɔ ku Yeremia ƒui bikeli bitábɛ na kesii kadi na ukyuli biala ɔsɔ utanu-mii iye ɔdi ɔti kesii kani na bɛkya.”

english_verse: The officials put the scroll in Elishama's room and went to see the king, who was in one of the rooms where he lived and worked during the winter. It was the ninth month of the year, so there was a fire burning in the fireplace, and the king was sitting nearby. After the officials told the king about the scroll, he sent Jehudi to get it. Then Jehudi started reading the scroll to the king and his officials.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama benengu bammɔ beti ɔku kakunkɛ kammɔ bétése Elisama ɔtɔ kemmo na bátɔlɔ bésie ɔga kudɔ na lɛtɔ lɛmmɔ akɔ unwi kemmo. Kesii kammɔ na ɔɔkya taabla kabla na kɔyɔ uwi na ɔdi kɔbuli yaalenwidi kemmo, anwuɔsu básala ogya bákya lɛyu lɛdi kemmo bálɛ mmɔ na ɔga ɔmmɔ ulie ɔɔwaa. Ka bakutine bammɔ básu-nwu ɔku kakunkɛ kammɔ lɛlɔ kɔtɛ báwɔlɔ ni, ɔga mmɔ ɔ́tala Yehudi ɔnii utéti-ka uboku. Anwu lɛnɔ útéti-ka úboku na úbo uli ɔɔká-ka etemila teete ɔga ku nwuna benengu bammɔ.

english_verse: But every time Jehudi finished reading three or four columns, the king would tell him to cut them off with his penknife and throw them in the fire. Elnathan, Delaiah, and Gemariah begged the king not to burn the scroll, but he ignored them, and soon there was nothing left of it. The king and his servants listened to what was written on the scroll, but they were not the least bit afraid, and they did not tear their clothes in sorrow.
translation_verse: Nsu uwi biala na Yehudi ɔ́wɔlɔ bɔka likuku lɛdi ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, na ɔga ɔsu-nwu ɔnii uti nwuna kewii blii kani na ɔda na ukulo mmɔ udie na uti ubo ɔkya ogya kemmo. Na Elnatan ku Delaia ku Gemaria bévele ɔga banii ɔda kakunkɛ kammɔ bɔkyula lɛni ɔya, nsu útaƒɔ-ma kasusu kani na baakya-nwu mmɔ. Anwuɔsu kawɔlɔkɔ ni, kakunkɛ kammɔ lɛla lɛdi lɛ́sɔ lítebu na ukyuli ɔnu.

english_verse: The king told his son Jerahmeel to take Seraiah and Shelemiah and to go arrest Baruch and me. But the Lord kept them from finding us. Jeremiah's Second Scroll
translation_verse: Amu na ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔ́su ubidi Yeramel ɔnii ɔkpanku Seraia ku Selemia ɔda na bebeƒie ami ku Baruk beboku. Nsu Unwoti útaya na banu-bu. Yeremia Únweni Ɔku Kakunkɛ Kanyɔdi

english_verse: I had told Baruch what to write on that first scroll, but King Jehoiakim had burned it. So the Lord told me
translation_verse: Baruk na lɛ́su lɛla lɛni na únweni ɔsia ɔku kakunkɛ kedeedi lɛlɔ. Nsu Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii

english_verse: to get another scroll and write down everything that had been on the first one.
translation_verse: nwia ɔku kakunkɛ bamba na linweni ala ani ƒui na nsia ɔku kakunkɛ kedeedi lɛlɔ mmɔ nsia kanyɔdi kamɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then he told me to say to King Jehoiakim: Not only did you burn Jeremiah's scroll, you had the nerve to ask why he had written that the king of Babylonia would attack and ruin the land, killing all the people and even the animals.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nsu Ɔga Yehoiakim ɔnini, “Ɔɔɔdi ɔku kakunkɛ kammɔ lɛti kani na ákyula, mmomu ése kayi na éye anini, ‘Bi ɔsu na Yeremia únweni ɔnii Babilonƒuɔ ɔga ɔdubo ubekpo ɔma ɔmɛni na ubile ala na ɔdu bekyuli ku bebuo bamɛni ƒui?’

english_verse: So I, the Lord, promise that you will be killed and your body thrown out on the ground. The sun will beat down on it during the day, and the frost will settle on it at night. And none of your descendants will ever be king of Judah.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ami Unwoti muusé kenye ka badubo-ɔ bɔdu na bebo-ɔ ɔlɔna batáva kalɔ. Na ɔƒɛ ɔdubuƒi-nwu ɔƒiiwi na amii ayu wi-nwu lɛlɔ usien. Na ƒula ɔtɔ kemmo ku bawɔ ɔdi biala ɔsɔ uladi lɛga na Yuda kudii.

english_verse: You, your children, and your servants are evil, and I will punish everyone of you. I warned you and the people of Judah and Jerusalem that I would bring disaster, but none of you have listened. So now you are doomed!
translation_verse: Awɔ ku ƒula bebi ku ƒula kabla bablane ƒui bibo likyulikpi. Anwuɔsu ndubo bina ƒui kɔtu bɔni. Lɛ́lɛ awɔ ku Yudaƒuɔ ku Yerusalemƒuɔ ƒui kpakplaa ka ɔgbankpi ɔdubo-mii lɛlɔ, nsu ɔdi útabu-mi litemi. Anwuɔsu ɔƒaani, amii ɔdi ɔ́sa!”

english_verse: After the Lord finished speaking to me, I got another scroll and gave it to Baruch. Then I told him what to write, so this second scroll would contain even more than was on the scroll Jehoiakim had burned.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ka Unwoti ɔ́wɔlɔ-mi bɔtɛmiku ni, líti ɔku kakunkɛ bamba líte Baruk, na lɛ́su-nwu lɛla lɛni na unweni ɔsia-ka lɛlɔ. Na ala ammɔ étulo ani nákya ɔku udeedi ɔni na Ɔga Yehoiakim ɔ́kyula kemmo muedi.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had removed Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim from being the king of Judah and had made Josiah's son Zedekiah king instead.
translation_verse: Babilonƒuɔ Ɔga Nebukadnesar ɔ́bɔku Yehoiakim ubidi Yekonia ɔni ndi Yudaƒuɔ ɔga ɔ́talaku liboku lɛlɔ na úti Yosia ubidi Sedekia únwini Yudaƒuɔ ɔga.

english_verse: But Zedekiah, his officials, and everyone else in Judah ignored everything the Lord had told me.
translation_verse: Nsu Sedekia ɔmɛni ku nwuna benengu ƒui bétenu Unwoti ala ani ƒui na ɔ́su-mi mɛni.

english_verse: Later, the Babylonian army attacked Jerusalem, but they left after learning that the Egyptian army was headed in this direction.
