translation_verse: Ngba bulie na ɔma unegudi kemmo bubo ɔkplu geen, na ɔni na bebi beni béƒulo ama alati bebi bákun.

english_verse: The Lord was so fiercely angry that he burned the city of Zion to the ground.
translation_verse: Unwoti úti kɔnyi kpakplaa ɔ́kya Sion geen ɔni na ɔ́ya na bekisine bákyula ɔma ɔmmɔ béwi kalɔ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: Not a king on this earth or the people of any nation believed enemies could break through her gates.
translation_verse: Na ɔga ɔdi uuubo kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ iye kadi badi bátati banii bekisine badi badubɔkana na babwɛ beduo ɔma ɔmɛni lɛban kayakun kemmo kudii.

english_verse: Jerusalem was punished because her prophets and her priests had sinned and caused the death of innocent victims.
translation_verse: Yerusalem Katɔti kenye bediene ku bakpane bábla ekpidi bonwu bonwu geen ɔni náya na bekyuli bani nátabla lɛla lɛdi muedi békpi, anwuɔsu na Unwoti ɔ́ni ɔma ɔmmɔ kɔtu lɛni.

english_verse: Yes, her prophets and priests were covered with blood; no one would come near them, as they wandered from street to street.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ geen na ɔdi ka bekyuli ubugya ɔ́ƒɔ kenye bediene bammɔ ku bakpane bammɔ enu. Na ukyuli biala ɔsɔ ulayɔ ka ɔni ude-ma uwi ɔni na bakɛ beesié taasɔ na lɛblɔnu ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Instead, everyone shouted, “Go away! Don't touch us! You're filthy and unfit to belong to God's people!” So they had to leave and become refugees. But foreign nations told them, “You can't stay here!”
translation_verse: Mmomu bekyuli ƒui baava taabɔku-ma banini, “Bɛgyu-bu lɛlɔ mɛni biteesie, na bitetuku-bu! Ɔsika biisé lɛlɔ, na bítamanku ka amii lɛnɔ bɛbla Katɔti bekyuli akɔ badi.” Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔlɛka batɔlɔ mmɔ na beténwini baƒɔ na kalɔ bamba. Nsu mmɔ lɛnɔ ni, kalɔ kammɔ bekyuli básu-ma banini, “Bilakana bula kalɔ mɛni lɛnɔ bulie!”

english_verse: The Lord is the one who sent them scattering, and he has forgotten them. No respect or kindness will be shown to the priests or leaders.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔlati nábɔku úgyingya-ma lɛni, na ɔ́da-ma údie nwuna kasusu. Na ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ uleboku lili kalɔ ulete-ma na babla bakpane ku kenye bediene bammɔ lɛƒɔndia lɛdi.

english_verse: Our eyes became weary, hopelessly looking for help from a nation that could not save us.
translation_verse: Anumi kani mɔɔkpulu-bu ka bɔ́ɔnu ulu bɔ́nɔ ka nka kadi kadi kebebunku-bu na bekpo bula bekisine ku-bu, nsu bétebo.

english_verse: Enemies hunted us down on every public street. Our time was up; our doom was near.
translation_verse: Bekisine báka-bu bákya na lɛblɔnu linengudi ƒui lɛlɔ, na bɔsɔ buuubo kasiakɔ. Bula uwi údu ka bɔyii udu.

english_verse: They swooped down faster than eagles from the sky. They hunted for us in the hills and set traps to catch us out in the desert.
translation_verse: Bátu bási bébo-bu lɛlɔ ku usi ɔni ntulo kalɛ na kɔdigbo aasɛ ɔɔyu teebo kalɔ. Na bábwi-bu bási abi lɛlɔ, na bákywɛ-bu kɔkpagyuɛ bése ka beƒie-bu na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord's chosen leader was our hope for survival! We thought he would keep us safe somewhere among the nations, but even he was caught in one of their traps.
translation_verse: Ɔtɔnkune ɔni na Unwoti ɔ́ƒuna úte-bu kani nsɔ ndi-bu lɛnunsia ka anwu ndubɔƒɔ ute-bu na bɔkɛ keliekɔ kadi na kadi bamba bekyuli bammɔ akɔ, nsu anwu muedi bana kɔkpagyuɛ kɔmmɔ kɔdi kani nédie anwu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: You people of Edom can celebrate now! But your time will come to suffer and stagger around naked.
translation_verse: Amii Edomƒuɔ, bɛkana na bɛdi limeyi na bɛkɛ ebiti ɔƒɛni amu ƒaa. Nsu amii lɛnɔ bɛdubo bibebo abi na bɛkɛ bitaagbanta taavi ku kasɔngya.

english_verse: The people of Zion have paid for their sins, and the Lord will soon let them return home. But, people of Edom, you will be punished, and your sins exposed.
translation_verse: Sion kadi bekyuli báaƒɔ bana ekpidi ani na bábla kayu, na badubo bɔsɔ bunwini buteesie bana ɔma. Nsu amii Edomƒuɔ ni, Unwoti ɔdubo-mii kɔtu bɔni na udie bina alaekpidi keyi.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget how we have suffered and been disgraced.
translation_verse: O bula Unwoti, tayiƒala bula lɛbibo ku kalɛ na béwi-bu anumi kalɔ.

english_verse: Foreigners and strangers have taken our land and our homes.
translation_verse: Baƒɔ bébeti-bu kɔlɔ ku bula kɔduli bénwini bana ɔdi.

english_verse: We are like children whose mothers are widows.
translation_verse: Na búnwini aani bekpinebi, na bula beni bénwini bekpinele.

english_verse: The water we drink and the wood we burn cost far too much.
translation_verse: Na ntu bɔni na bɔni ku ekyweni ani na bɔsala ɔgya muedi áƒɔ kuye geen ɔni ntulo bɔsu.

english_verse: We are terribly mistreated; we are worn out and can find no rest.
translation_verse: Na baabla-bu kalala taasia kama ɔni na bula ɔyikun ɔ́sa, na buuubo bɔnwuna bɔdi.

english_verse: We had to surrender to Egypt and Assyria because we were hungry.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka bɔkya lili kalɔ na bɔblaku Egyipteƒuɔ ku Asiriaƒuɔ unwi asa na bɔkɛ lɛla lɛni na bɔdi na kɔka ɔsu.

english_verse: Our ancestors sinned, but they are dead, and we are left to pay for their sins.
translation_verse: Bula bati bene nábla likpidi na ama béekpi, nsu abu nnye mɔɔƒɔ bana ekpidi ammɔ kayu.

english_verse: Slaves are now our rulers, and there is no one to set us free.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔbla bula bekisine kabla mmomu mɔɔdi-bu lɛlɔ ɔƒaani, na ukyuli ɔdi uuubo na ɔƒɔ-bu na bɔkɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: We are in danger from brutal desert tribes; we must risk our lives just to bring in our crops.
translation_verse: Bɔkya ɔgbankpi kemmo na balalane bani nkya kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ ɔsu. Na kalɛ na busie butáƒɛ bula edula buboku ɔma muedi litemi lɛdi na bana lɛkɔkɔ.

english_verse: On Zion and everywhere in Judah our wives and daughters are being raped.
translation_verse: Bekisine bekpone bammɔ béƒie-bu beleku ku begblebi báyɔ na Yerusalem ku Yuda lɛma lɛmmɔ kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: Our rulers are strung up by their arms, and our nation's advisors are treated shamefully.
translation_verse: Béƒie bula batɔnkune bényimi, na bábla bula benengu kɔƒa ala na kadi anumi.

english_verse: Young men are forced to do the work of slaves; boys must carry heavy loads of wood.
translation_verse: Na bénye bakloƒu lɛlɔ na baabla-ma kabla. Na bananabi bammɔ beeti egyuku bonwu bonwu.

english_verse: Our leaders are not allowed to decide cases in court, and young people no longer play music.
translation_verse: Na básɔ bétete kuƒi na bula litemi batɛne basu litemi lɛdi litemi katɛkɔ. Na bakloƒu basɔ beeebo kuƒi na bataagya agyala adi teedie lɛnu.

english_verse: Our hearts are sad; instead of dancing, we mourn.
translation_verse: Kɔnyana kɔ́ƒɔ-bu kayi kemmo ƒui. Na ɔni na buteedie lɛnu taatɔ ni, kɔnyana mmomu na bulie buuwulo.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared! And we are doomed because of our sins.
translation_verse: Yerusalem ɔ́yila nwuna bukeye! Na abu ɔdi ɔ́sa, na bɔ́yii udu na bula ekpidi ɔsu.

english_verse: We feel sick all over and can't even see straight;
translation_verse: Búnwini aani balɛne bɔkɛ na bɔsɔ bulánu ligeen muedi.

english_verse: our city is in ruins, overrun by wild dogs.
translation_verse: Bula ɔma ɔ́bwɛ na lɛku kemmo begidi sɔɔn náƒɔ-nwu kemmo beli.

english_verse: You will rule forever, Lord! You are King for all time.
translation_verse: Awɔ Unwoti kani ndubo lɛlɔ bɔdi úsela uwi ƒui! Awɔ ndi Ɔga uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Why have you forgotten us for so long?
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na áyiƒala-bu uwi gyɔlɔɔ lɛni?

english_verse: Bring us back to you! Give us a fresh start.
translation_verse: Sɔku-bu boku ƒula kudɔ! Na aya na lɛla biala lɛsɔ lise kalɔ ɔwɔdi.

english_verse: Or do you despise us so much that you don't want us?
translation_verse: Munuu, buni na éni-bu ƒui lɛni na asɔ aláwia-bu ka bubo-ɔ kudɔ?

english_verse: I am Ezekiel—a priest and the son of Buzi. Five years after King Jehoiachin of Judah had been led away as a prisoner to Babylonia, I was living near the Chebar River among those who had been taken there with him. Then on the fifth day of the fourth month of the thirtieth year, the heavens suddenly opened. The Lord placed his hand upon me and showed me some visions.
translation_verse: Ami ndi Esekiel, Busi ubidi, na ndi ɔkpane. Uwi ɔni na béƒie Ɔga Yekonia bátɔlɔku bésienku Babilon aani bana ɔtɔntɛne kalɛ úbunku abu bakladi, ɔbla akwa alɔ kama ni, lɛ́kya kesii kadi na kede ketu kani baalɔ banii Keba. Na ami ku bani na béti bátɔlɔku mmɔ nkya mmɔ. Amu na kɔbuli kunedi limeyi lɛlɔndi lɛlɔ na lɛkwa leevu-lɛtɛdi kemmo ni, kayaa kálɛmi kɔnakunwi. Na Unwoti úti nwuna enu ɔ́sia-mi lɛlɔ na údie kɔyu kemmo ala adi ɔ́tina-mi.

english_verse: I saw a windstorm blowing in from the north. Lightning flashed from a huge cloud and lit up the whole sky with a dazzling brightness. The fiery center of the cloud was as shiny as polished metal,
translation_verse: Amu na lɛ́nu ka ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔdi úse kalɔ úkpo kpakplaa ɔ́si katɔ kakɛ ɔdubo. Na kayaa kaabwɛ ogya taasi liƒlukutu bonwu lɛdi kemmo na kayaa kana ƒui keekeye na ɔɔtu anumi. Na liƒlukutu lɛmmɔ ntɛ kesii kani na ogya ɔmɛni ɔɔbwɛ taasi ni, use aani lɛbuala lɛni na békuo-ni suɛlɛ suɛlɛ na uukeye geen.

english_verse: and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans,
translation_verse: Na ntɛ mmɔ na lɛ́nu aani si bebuo ine badi ku ngba ku ngba benye. Na bana bɔnu bɔɔtina lɛnɔ aani bekyuli

english_verse: except that each one had four faces and four wings.
translation_verse: si ɔɔɔdi ɔni na bana ƒui ɔdi biala ubo anumi akpa ene ku avwi ene ɔsu.

english_verse: Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze.
translation_verse: Bana lɛgba líne na línye ligeen, nsu bana kɔnitɔ kuse aani ɔmantɛ bakɔ lɛgbanvuo na liikeye aani abuala egyiedi.

english_verse: Under each of their wings, these creatures had a human hand.
translation_verse: Na bana avwi amɛni ɔdi biala kemmo ni, bebo anumi aani bekyuli anumi kalɛ.

english_verse: The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.
translation_verse: Bebweyi ine bamɛni bénwini kama bákya lɛlɔ na bana avwi eli eetúku lɛlɔ. Na bana ƒui beesié taamana lɛƒɛnyi ƒui lɛlɔ, nsu alanu ka beenwíni lɛlɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Each creature had the face of a human in front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of a bull on the left, and the face of an eagle in back.
translation_verse: Kebweyi biala kebo ukyuli ɔyawine anumi na lɛtɔtɔ, na ubo gyata anumi na kɔdianu kakɛ, na ubo akɔ anumi na kɔmiinu, na ubo kɔdigbo aasɛ anumi na kama.

english_verse: Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi biala úbimi nwuna avwi anyɔ úwi na eetúku bakladi adi. Na ɔ́ƒɛ anyɔ akladi ɔ́mana lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The four living creatures went wherever the Spirit led them, and they moved together without turning their bodies, because each creature faced straight ahead.
translation_verse: Na kesii biala na bebweyi bamɛni bésela ni, beesié taasala na belenwini bana lɛlɔ, ɔsika ɔdi biala ɔɔnu nwuna anumi ligeen.

english_verse: The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up.
translation_verse: Bebweyi bamɛni baatina liwulu ogya ɔdi aani ogya agyabi. Na lɛla lɛdi lɛkya-ma ntɛ na lɛɛda teesie taasɔ aani ukpo. Na uwi biala na ukpo ɔmɛni údie ogya unyemi ni, na lɛla lɛdi lɛbwɛ ogya aani kalɛ na kayaa kaabwɛ ogya.

english_verse: The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.
translation_verse: Na bebweyi bamɛni alati busie bɔɔbabla aani kalɛ na lɛgyakpabi liitulo taalɛ ogya kemmo.

english_verse: I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel,
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́nu lɛ́ti ka na bebweyi bamɛni ɔdi biala lɛgba kalɔ na kɔmadɔ ni, lɛla lɛdi lɛtɛ aani kɛɛkɛ libi.

english_verse: shining like chrysolite. Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Na use aani liseebi lɛni náƒɔ kuye geen na libo evete awɔdi bukeye na baalɔ-ni Krisolit. Na kɛɛkɛ ebi amɛni bubomo ku udu bɔdi unwi na kɛɛkɛ libi libliidi bamba lɛdi lɛnɔ lɛkya ɔdi biala ntɛ.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu baakana na besie kesii biala ɔni na belénwini lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them.
translation_verse: Abuala ani nkya ebi amɛni ntɛ na ana lɛlɔ na ebi ammɔ ada ni, ébomo na ebo anumi kemmo ku kama.

english_verse: The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.
translation_verse: Bebweyi bamɛni ndanku ebi amɛni si bakɛ. Na si uwi ɔni na bebweyi bamɛni bédi bénye ni, na ebi ammɔ lɛnɔ édi énye. Na si ina buveyi na bada ni, ebi amɛni lɛnɔ akɛnku-ma na kayaa mmɔ.

english_verse: Above the living creatures, I saw something that was sparkling like ice, and it reminded me of a dome. Each creature had two of its wings stretched out toward the creatures on either side, with the other two wings folded against its body.
translation_verse: Na bebweyi bamɛni eli ni, lɛ́nu ka lɛla lɛdi libi aani ligegu na nwuna kemmo keekeye aani ntu bɔni nába búnwini atabi. Na bebweyi bamɛni bénene bana avwi anyɔ anyɔ bákywɛ lɛlɔ na lɛƒɛnyi ƒui lɛlɔ asa na ɔdi biala avwi anyɔ akladi ebi-nwu ɔlɔna lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
translation_verse: Si uwi ɔni na bebweyi bamɛni beeveyi ni, bana avwi aabla kɔku bonwu aani kalɛ na ɛpu ɔɔbla kɔku iye aani bekpone lisu bonwu lɛdi iye aani Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui muudie lɛdi. Na si uwi ɔni na bédi bénye na báda buveyi báya ni, na baƒɛ bana avwi bébi bana ɔlɔna lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na basɔ belebo bana avwi ni, línu kɔku kɔdi lɛ́siku lɛla lɛni mbi-ma eli aani ligegu mmɔ katɔ.

english_verse: I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama lɛ́nu lɛla lɛdi aani lɛgaboku lɛni nse aani liseebi buni lɛni náƒɔ kuye na liikeye aani ɛpu ntu na baalɔ-ni Saƒira, na lɛ́nu aani si ukyuli na ɔdi nli-ni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light,
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si ukyuli ɔmmɔ kavobi úti ɔ́kɔ úsie-nwu lili kakɛ keekeye aani lɛbuala lɛni na bákya ogya lɛyu kemmo na lígyie muaa. Na ɔ́si kavobi mmɔ ɔ́yu ubo nwuna lɛgba kakɛ ni, ɔɔda aani ogya unyemi. Na ogya bukeye bonwu bɔ́ka bɔ́mana ukyuli umodi ɔmmɔ ƒui

english_verse: as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm. I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
translation_verse: na uudie kunweni lidu lidu aani kalɛ na kɔdigye kɔɔlɛ́ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔdi bukpo kama. Na lɛ́nu lɛ́ti ka Unwoti bukeye ɔsu na mɔɔnu mmɔ nwaa ƒui lɛni! Ɔmmɔ ɔsu líboku lɛlɔ kalɔ buɛɛ lɛ́yu líbi anumi kalɔ. Na kɔnakunwi ni, línu ka lɛdi lɛdi lɛɛtɛmiku-mi.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.”
translation_verse: Na lɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛ́kpali-mi lɛnini, “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, ta nye na ese atu na enu.”

english_verse: After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ka ɔ́su lɛni ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, nwuna Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo na kɔ́tala-mi kúnyene mina lɛgba lɛlɔ na línu ka kɔɔtɛmiku-mi.

english_verse: Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Esekiel, mɔɔtala-a na Israelƒuɔ kadi bekyuli kudɔ. Kadi batuɔkplune bani na ama ku bana bati kuuku bani náta bénye-mi lɛlɔ na béni banii belénwini kayi úbedu ku ɔmwi kadi kamɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say.
translation_verse: Bebo atuɔkplu na kayi kebo-ma ɔkplu. Nsu ami Unwoti Katɔti lɛ́ƒuna-a ka esie atásu-ma lɛla lɛni na masu-ɔ.

english_verse: Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
translation_verse: Na si batuɔkplune bammɔ bénu iye bétenu ni, badubɔnu bati ka kenye udiene ɔdi úbo úbatɛmi úte-ma.

english_verse: Don't be afraid of them or of anything they say. You may think you're in the middle of a thorn patch or a bunch of scorpions. But be brave
translation_verse: Tayia-ma iye lɛla lɛni na badubo-ɔ bɔsu. Ɔdubo-ɔ bɔbla aani si lɛnyɛ livongu kemmo na báyula-a bákya iye batamlukpa akɔ na atɛ. Nsu se kayi ina ka batuɔkplune na badi.

english_verse: and preach my message to them, whether they choose to listen or not.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ka asu-ma mina kenye si ina baayɔ́ ka benu iye balayɔ ɔsika batuɔkplune na badi.

english_verse: Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you. And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ ɔyawine ubi ni, tata tenye-mi lɛlɔ aani batuɔkplune bɔmmɔ kalɛ. Mmomu nu-mi litemi biala na masu-ɔ. Na ɔƒaani ni, Esekiel, bimi kenye na aƒɔ lɛla lɛni na mete-ɔ mɛni ákun.”

english_verse: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.
translation_verse: Mmɔ mmɔ ni, lɛ́nu ka kɔnu kɔdi kúnene kɔ́kywɛ-mi anumi na ɔda ebuo ɔku kakunkɛ kadi.

english_verse: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_verse: Kɔnu kɔmmɔ kúbimi kakunkɛ kammɔ na kana kemmo ku kama ƒui kadanku kɔnyana ku buwulo ku kayi bɔkpulu etemila sɔɔn.

english_verse: He handed me the scroll and said, “Eat this and fill up on it.” So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.
translation_verse: Úti kakunkɛ kammɔ úte-mi na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Kun kakunkɛ kamɛni na emo.” Na ami lɛnɔ lɛ́kun-ka na káyu-mi emini na kenye kemmo aani uwɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, I am sending you to your own people.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́nini, “Esekiel, awɔ ɔlati ƒula bekyuli kudɔ na mɔɔtala-a.

english_verse: They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you.
translation_verse: Na Israelƒuɔ na badi. Baaadi baƒɔ bani mɔɔtɛmi lɛdi bamba lɛni na alakana bunu. Si baƒɔ kudɔ na lɛ́tala-a ni, nka badubunu-ɔ litemi.

english_verse: But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded,
translation_verse: Nsu Israel kadi bekyuli badubo buni na belénu litemi, ɔsika béni na bétenu-mi litemi. Bana ƒui bebo atuɔkplu na kayi kétitili-ma,

english_verse: so I will make you as stubborn as they are.
translation_verse: anwuɔsu ndubo bɔya na awɔ lɛnɔ abla atuɔkplu akya-ma na kayi ketitili-ɔ bana kalɛ.

english_verse: Listen carefully to everything I say and then think about it.
translation_verse: “Se atu na enu lɛla biala na ndubo-ɔ bɔsu kaduɛ na abla kasusu asiku-nya lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kana na esie bekyuli bani na awɔ ku-ma na béti béboku Babilon mɛni kudɔ na asu-ma ka adanku linyesia lɛdi ásiku ami Unwoti Katɔti kudɔ éboku-ma. Beenú o-o, belenu o-o ni, awɔ bla kalɛ na lɛ́su-ɔ.”

english_verse: The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me.
translation_verse: Amu na Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kúti-mi uwi ɔni kani na Unwoti bukeye bɔmmɔ búse kalɔ bɔɔyii taakya-mi anumi na línu lɛdi bonwu lɛdi na mina kama ku budu momoomo.

english_verse: It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them.
translation_verse: Na kɔku kɔmmɔ kɔdi bebweyi ine bammɔ avwi ani muukuo lɛlɔ ku kɛɛkɛ ebi ammɔ bunwini.

english_verse: Then the Spirit carried me away. The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kúti-mi kɔ́tɔlɔku. Na Unwoti ɔyikun ɔ́ƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui na líti kɔnyi na livo lɛnɔ liiƒí-mi geen.

english_verse: When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me. The Lord Appoints Ezekiel To Stand Watch (Ezekiel
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na línwini líbo mina badi bani nli kɔbi kɔni baalɔ banii Abib na ude Keba Ketu kudɔ mmɔ ni, lɛ́kya-ma kudɔ mmɔ emeyi maatɛ na mina kasusu kábla-mi kalɛ kadi ku liƒu na lɛla lɛni nálɛku-mi mmɔ ɔsu. Unwoti Údie Esekiel Úse Ka Utaasia Ala Anu

english_verse: Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ka lɛ́nu Unwoti Bukeye emeyi maatɛ kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, lídie-ɔ líse ka ataasia Israelƒuɔ anu. Anwuɔsu se atu na enu lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu-ɔ na alɛ-ma kpakplaa ete-mi.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways so they won't be punished. If you refuse, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Si lɛ́su balalane nnii badubo bukpi na bana ekpidi ɔsu ni, ɔlɛka alɛ-ma kpakplaa anii bada bana ekpidi bɔbla baya na benwini kayi kalɛ na baláni-ma kɔtu. Na si éni na átabla lɛni ni, bana kukpi kɔkɛ-ɔ.

english_verse: However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
translation_verse: Nsu si álɛ-ma na bamu benye baabla bana ekpidi bɔdi ni, badubo bukpi na ekpidi ammɔ ɔsu, nsu awɔ édie lɛlɔ na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-a.

english_verse: Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death.
translation_verse: “Ɔƒɛni si bekyuli babuni lɛnɔ bése kalɔ baabla ekpidi na lɛ́ya na ala aabala-ma na bana ngba keliela ulu lɛlɔ na ala asɔ alátɛku-ma ni, bámanku ka bekpi. Anwuɔsu si ébulo na átalɛ-ma ni, ndubo bɔyiƒala uwi ɔni na básiaku-mi kama siin na bekpi, nsu bana kukpi kɔsia-a lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent. Ezekiel Cannot Talk
translation_verse: Nsu si álɛ-ma na bénu na bénwini kayi ni, ndubɔya na belie ngba. Na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda awɔ lɛnɔ.” Unyemi Kabuli Káƒɛ Esekiel Na Ulakana Butemi

english_verse: The Lord took control of me and said, “Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.”
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔyikun ɔ́ƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ta nye! Teesie kɔwɛ kemmo ngye na ndubo-ɔ bɔtɛmiku na mmɔ.”

english_verse: I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Amu na lɛ́ta lísie kɔwɛ kemmo mmɔ kɔnakunwi kesii kani na ńtánu Unwoti bukeye aani kalɛ na lɛ́nu ḿbavi na Keba Ketu kɔtu mmɔ na lɛ́yu líbi anumi kalɔ.

english_verse: His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said: Go back and lock yourself in your house!
translation_verse: Nwuna Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo na kɔ́tala-mi kúnyene mina lɛgba lɛlɔ. Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Nwini sie na atákalɛ lɛlɔ akya ƒula ɔtɔ kemmo!

english_verse: You will be tied up to keep you inside,
translation_verse: Badubo-ɔ bunyimi kalɛ na asɔ akya mmɔ na alálɛ.

english_verse: and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Na ndubo bɔya na alakana bɔtɛmi iye alɛ bekyuli bani náta benye-mi lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ɔni na ndubɔtina-a lɛla lɛni na adubo bɔsu na adubo bɔkana na asɔ atɛmi na uwi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na asu bekyuli bammɔ mina litemi. Badi badubo bunu na badi lɛnɔ beni na belénu.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it.
translation_verse: “Ɔƒɛni ni, Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, wia lɛtabi lɛni lɛlɔ na beenweni ala taasia na ata Yerusalem asia-ni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then prepare to attack the brick as if it were a real city. Build a dirt mound and a ramp up to the top and surround the brick with enemy camps. On every side put large wooden poles as though you were going to break down the gate to the city.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama na aklibi lɛlɔ aani bukpoku na adubo lɛtabi lɛmmɔ aani si ɔma geen na ɔdi. Na asia ubili aka amana lɛtabi lɛmmɔ ku bekpone kunyekɔ kɔliku sia lɛlɔ amana lɛtabi lɛmmɔ. Na abla bekisine kɔkyakɔ lɛnɔ aka amana lɛtabi lɛmmɔ. Na awia lɛtalagyii bonwu bonwu ekpo kakɛ biala aani si bubo na adubo ɔban kayakun kammɔ abwɛ eduoku ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Set up an iron pan like a wall between you and the brick. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ti lɛbuala libui lɛdi se awɔ ku lɛtimbɔ lɛmmɔ ntɛ na ɔbla aani kowodu. Na ɔdubɔbla aani bɔlɛ kpakplaa ute Israel kadi bekyuli.

english_verse: After that, lie down on your left side and stay there for
translation_verse: “Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, na asɔ atɛ ƒula kɔmiinu ɔƒɛnyi unwi mmɔ laa útédu emeyi eti maatɛ ku aavlene (

english_verse: days you are lying down.
translation_verse: ) ani na adubo kalɔ mmɔ bɔtɛ.

english_verse: Then turn over and lie on your right side
translation_verse: “Na atu enwini na atɛ kɔdianu ɔƒɛnyi lɛnɔ emeyi

english_verse: more days. That will be a sign of Judah's punishment—one day for each year of its suffering.
translation_verse: na ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ɔtina kalɛ na Yuda ɔdubo abi bubo limeyi linwi biala lɛkwa linwi.

english_verse: The brick stands for Jerusalem, so attack it! Stare at it and shout angry warnings.
translation_verse: Lɛtabi lɛmmɔ lílieku Yerusalem, anwuɔsu taanu-ni ɔnusɛ asa na alɛ-nwu kpakplaa anii,

english_verse: I will tie you up, so you can't leave until your attack has ended.
translation_verse: ‘Ndubo-ɔ bunyimi buse liku linwi na alakana mmɔ bɔtɔlɔ útédu uwi ɔni na ƒula lɛtuni lɛ́sa.’

english_verse: Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the
translation_verse: “Wia lɛkyami bonwu lɛdi na eti edula lidu ɔlaaƒɔ aani kakpa ebi ku ana lidu bamba pii ɔlaaƒɔ asala na abla bodobodo. Na anwu na adubo bɔdi emeyi eti maatɛ ku aavlene (

english_verse: Eat only a small loaf of bread each day
translation_verse: Na kakɛ blii kadi kani na adubo bɔdi limeyi biala.

english_verse: and drink only two large cups of water.
translation_verse: Na ani ntu lɛɛƒɛɛ bonwu inyɔ kani.

english_verse: Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you.
translation_verse: Na eti ukyuli kuvodɔ kɔni nákwii asala ogya na eƒi bodobodo ɔmmɔ nwuna lɛlɔ na bekyuli bammɔ anumi na eti akun.

english_verse: When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ndububo Israel kadi bekyuli bugyingya bɔ́kya kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ ni, lɛni kani na ama lɛnɔ badubo adila ani muusé lɛlɔ bɔdi aani kalɛ na ábla mɛni na bánu.”

english_verse: I said, “Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́su nnini, “Unwoti Katɔti, buvele kemmo, taya na lɛbla ɔmmɔ udu! Ɔsika ńtabla lɛla lɛni na lise lɛni kudii na mina ngba kemmo na lɛdi lɛla lɛni ndubɔya na nteese-ɔ lɛlɔ. Na ńtadi lɛla lɛni nékpi ani ɔlati iye ebuo ɔni na eƒiebuo ɔdi ɔ́du ɔ́va iye lɛla lɛni na ásu ka liisé lɛlɔ lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti údie kenye ɔnini, “Na ukyuli kuvodɔ kɔkwiidi kenye ni, ndubɔya na eƒi bodobodo ɔmmɔ na ɔmantɛ akɔ kuvodɔ kɔkwiidi lɛlɔ mmomu.

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Jerusalem will starve. They will have so little food and water that they will be afraid and hopeless.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, Yerusalem bekyuli badubo kɔka bukpi. Adila blii kani na ndubo-ma buse, anwuɔsu badubo bɔyia geen na bata babla bekyuli bani lɛlɔ nsɔ neeebo kɔsia kɔdi.

english_verse: Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.”
translation_verse: Ɔtɔtɔ ukpidi ɔdubo ukyuli biala bɔgyu na lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ ɔsu. Na badubo buteekpi lɛnɔ buɛɛ na bana ekpidi ɔsu.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, wia kewii kani na kebo ɔbi kaduɛ na ekulo ƒula lili linwini lɛmmɔ na ekpeyi ƒula keduo kalɔ linwini lɛmmɔ ƒui. Ti linwini lɛmmɔ na átákɔku-ni unu anu na ele-ni kemmo akpa atɛ likeke.

english_verse: After you attack the brick that stands for Jerusalem, burn one pile of your hair on the brick. Chop up the second pile and let the small pieces of hair fall around the brick. Throw the third pile into the wind, and I will strike it with my own sword.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na ékpoku lɛtabi lɛni nnye nte Yerusalem mmɔ áwɔlɔ ni, na akyula linwini lɛmmɔ lɛkpa linwi na lɛtabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na eti lɛkpa linyɔdi na ekulo-ni wɛlɛ wɛlɛ ewi aka amana lɛtabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na lɛkpa lɛtɛdi ni, bo-ni kɔliku kayaa na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kemmo na ami ndubo-ni bukulo ku mina kewii.

english_verse: Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.
translation_verse: Bu linwini lɛmmɔ blii lɛdi se na eti ebo likpo akya ƒula awu kɔtu.

english_verse: Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama na ada lɛdi edie na ebo akya ogya kemmo na lɛkywi. Na ogya ɔmɛni ɔdubo bɔkywi usie amadɔ kama kama ƒui na ɔkyula ukyuli biala na Israel.

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti na lɛ́bla na Yerusalem ɔdi ɔma ɔni na ɔ́ƒɔ kuye geen utulo ƒui na kayawi ku kadi bamba kɔlɔ ƒui akɔ na ɔɔda bekyuli kubiti.

english_verse: But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.
translation_verse: Nsu Yerusalemƒuɔ báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ na banii belenu-mi litemi. Béni mina ɔda bubo na bénwini alaekpidi bablane bonwu betulo kadi bamba bekyuli bani náka bámana-ma muedi.

english_verse: So tell the people of Jerusalem: I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them!
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu na mɔɔsu Yerusalemƒuɔ nnini, ‘Ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti! Na bíni na biládi mina litemi ku ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Mmomu kadi bamba bekyuli bani na bina amadɔ ɔda bubo lɛlɔ na bɛɛdi na bɛ́ta bínye-mi lɛlɔ na bɛɛbla alaekpidi ani na etulo ama adi ƒui!’

english_verse: Now all those nations will watch as I turn against you and punish you
translation_verse: “Na ɔƒaani ni, kadi bekyuli bammɔ badubunye banu kalɛ na mɔɔní-mii kɔtu

english_verse: for your sins. Your punishment will be more horrible than anything I've ever done or will ever do again.
translation_verse: na bina alaekpidi ɔsu. Na bina kɔtu bɔni bɔmmɔ bɔdubo ɔkplu bɔyu geen na butulo lɛla biala na lɛ́ɛbla ḿbavi iye lɛni na nsɔ mabla lɛnɔ uwi ɔni mebo ƒui kemmo na uladia bɔnu.

english_verse: Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.
translation_verse: Lɛdila lɛni na bamini bakya kenye muedi ɔdubo ubenwini lɛnungyiela geen lite bebi bati ku bebi beni ɔni na badubuti ama alati bebi muedi bakun. Na bebi lɛnɔ bakun bana bawɔne. Na bekyuli bani ndubɔlɛ ɔgbankpi ku liƒu ala ani ndubɔlɛ mɛni kemmo muedi badubo-ma bɔbɔku bugyingya bɔkya ekpo ekpo na lɛƒɛnyi ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity.
translation_verse: Bina alaekpidi ani na bɛɛbla na eesé lɛlɔ mmɔ áya na mina kakpakɔ kasɔ kaaadi kesii kani námanku ka bakpa-mi. Anwuɔsu na lɛ́kpali lɛlɔ líse kenye ka ndubo kama bunwini bɔkya-mii na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-mii kɔnyana kɔdi bɔnu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
translation_verse: Bina kadi ƒui lɛkpa lɛtɛdi bekyuli badubo bukpi na Yerusalem mɛni na kɔka iye ɔlɛ ɔsu. Na lɛkpa lɛtɛdi bamba lɛnɔ bekpi na kekpokɔ. Na lɛbɔku lɛkpa lɛtɛdi lɛkladi lɛkya kadi bamba bekyuli ƒui akɔ lɛmana. Na badubɔsia-mii anumi na bedie-mii balɛku na badu-mii ƒui.

english_verse: You will feel my fierce anger until I have finished taking revenge. Then you will know that I, the Lord, was furious because of your disobedience.
translation_verse: “Bɛdubo mina kɔnyi kpakplaa kɔni na líti lɛ́kya-mii ablala ɔlɛ bunu kaduɛ geen butédu uwi ɔni na medie-mii kasi mawɔlɔ. Na bɛdubo bɔnu bɔti ka kɔnyi kukpidi kɔ́kɔ ami Unwoti na bina litemi tenu ɔsu.

english_verse: Every passerby will laugh at your destruction. Foreign nations
translation_verse: “Ukyuli biala ndubɔsi mmɔ ɔlɛ ɔdubo-mii bɔma na kalɛ na lɛ́yila-mii udu ɔsu. Na kadi bamba bekyuli

english_verse: will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger.
translation_verse: badubo-mii budumi na bakya-mii lɛlɔ lɛma, nsu liƒu lɛnɔ lɛdubo-ma bɔda geen na ala ani na lɛ́bla-mii ɔsu.

english_verse: I will destroy your crops until you starve to death, and disasters will strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: Ndubo-mii edula bubile butédu ka kɔka kɔ́du-mii na ɔgbankpi lidu lɛnɔ lɛdubo-mii butaalɛku aani kalɛ na beebó atula taalɛ ukyuli.

english_verse: Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Kɔka ku beƒiebuo ndubo bina bebi bɔdu. Na ndubo-mii kɔtu bɔni ku lɛlɛ likpidi na bina bekisine lɛnɔ bekpo-mii na badu-mii ku bana kuwii. Ami Unwoti násu.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, nwini anumi tina Israel abi lɛlɔ na asu-ma anii,

english_verse: Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord, am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped.
translation_verse: amii abi ku ana kɔka ku awɛ ƒui binu! Ndubo bunwini bunye bɔsiaku-mii na lɛgyingya ekpo ani ƒui na bɛ́tu kadi bamba baƒiɔ biala bɛ́lɛ na baakpá.

english_verse: Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them.
translation_verse: Ndubo lɛbi biala bɔbwɛ na lɛdu bekyuli bani mɔɔkpá baƒiɔ na baƒiɔ bani na bávɔ iye bánwi bése baakpá mmɔ anumi.

english_verse: Dead bodies and bones will be lying around the idols and the altars.
translation_verse: Na bekpine ku bana ekubi adubuwi aka amana baƒiɔ bammɔ ku bana abi ammɔ ƒui amadɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Every town in Israel will be destroyed to make sure that each shrine, idol, and altar is smashed—everything the Israelites made will be a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Na Israel lɛma ƒui lɛdubo bɔbwɛ na lɛnu ka bana baƒiɔ bammɔ ku baƒiɔ lɛtɔ ku abi ammɔ ku ala avɔdi ku anwidi ammɔ ƒui áyii udu.

english_verse: All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord, did these things.
translation_verse: Bina bekyuli ƒui badubo bukpi na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na bani mebu badubo bɔnu bɔti ka ami Unwoti nábla ala amɛni udu.

english_verse: I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations,
translation_verse: “Ndubo bɔya na bekyuli badi belie banu kɔtu bɔni bɔmɛni ƒui bɔlɛ atɔ asia bétédu kawɔlɔkɔ. Nsu ndubo-ma bugyingya bɔkya kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ

english_verse: where they will be prisoners. And when they think of me, they will realize that they disgraced me by rebelling and by worshiping idols. They will hate themselves for the evil things they did,
translation_verse: na beténwini batɔntɛne bete-ma na mmɔ. Na si bábla kasusu básiku-mi lɛnɔ ni, badubo bunyimo ka bákya-mi kɔƒa na báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ na baƒiɔ bani na bákpa ɔsu. Na badubɔyɔ ka beni bana lɛlɔ na alaekpidi ani na bábla ɔsu.

english_verse: and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
translation_verse: Na badubɔti lɛnɔ ka ami ndi Unwoti na ɔlɛka bekyuli benu mina bɔlɛ bɔni na mɔɔlɛ-ma kpakplaa mmɔ na badi-mu lɛlɔ lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord God then said: Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Esekiel, gya enukpɛ na etu ɔgba kalɔ momoomo ku lɛƒɛda! Wulo kɔnyana geen, ɔsika Israelƒuɔ bábla ala ani muusé lɛlɔ na ɔlɛka bekpi na bana bekisine bekpone lɛkɔkɔ iye kɔka ku ɔlɛ ɔdu-ma.

english_verse: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani na bakya ɔgyu ni, ɔlɛ ukpidi ɔdubo-ma bubo na bekpi na bani na bede ni, badubukpi na kekpokɔ. Na bani mebu lɛnɔ ni, kɔka kɔdubo-ma bɔdu. Kalɛ na líti kɔnyi ńtédu ni, lɛni kani na ndubo-ma kɔnyi kɔmmɔ ala bɔbla butédu!

english_verse: These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Oloƒui na bekyuli bamɛni bátaakyula na abinkpo ku abi enengudi eli teete baƒiɔ bani abi na bátu bényene mmɔ na egyii enengudi kpakplaa amɔ kalɔ. Nsu si uwi ɔni na bánu ka bekpine bewi báka bámana mmɔ bene ƒui ni, badubɔnu bati ka ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Ndubo bɔya na bana kalɔ ƒui kenwini kakɔ kagyani kani nsɔ naaadubo lɛla lɛdi bɔdia bɔbla ɔ́si kɔnwinimi kalɔ kakwiidi kani na kada kakɛ útédu ɔma ɔni baalɔ Dibla na katɔ kakɛ. Na badubo bɔnu bɔti ka ami Unwoti nábla ala amɛni.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying: Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, su Israelƒuɔ anii ami násu nnini, úwi ɔsɔ uletu asa na Israelƒuɔ ɔdi ɔdubo bɔsa na bawɔlɔ! Ɔsika badubo kalɔ kammɔ ƒui bɔbwɛ na uwi klukwii ɔdi kemmo

english_verse: as punishment for your disgusting sins. I, the Lord, am so angry
translation_verse: aani lɛtuni ute bina ekpidi ani na bɛɛbla na eesé lɛlɔ ɔsu. Ami Unwoti líti kɔnyi geen

english_verse: that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: ɔni na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo ɔdi kɔnyana kɔdi bɔnu lɛnɔ. Ndubo-mii kɔtu bɔni na likpidi lɛni na bɛ́bla ɔsu na bɛnu bɛti ka ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: There's never been anything like the coming disaster.
translation_verse: “Lɛla lɛdi lítalɛ tɔ kudii aani ɔgbankpi ɔni udu nsia ulu ɔdubo mɛni kalɛ.

english_verse: And when it comes, your life will be over.
translation_verse: Na si úbeduo lɛnɔ ni, bina ngba amu bɔ́sa.

english_verse: You people of Israel are doomed! Soon there will be panic on the mountaintops instead of celebration.
translation_verse: Amii Israelƒuɔ ɔdi ɔ́sa! Kébu blii na bɛdubɔnu liƒu ala na abi lɛlɔ na bɛbla gyuma gyuma mmomu na ɔɔɔdi limeyi bɔdi ku lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Ndubo mina kɔnyi ala bɔbla ƒui na lɛni-mii kɔtu kɔni námanku-mii na bina likyulikpi ala bɔbla kenye.

english_verse: Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have punished you.
translation_verse: Bina ekpidi ávi ntu na etulo bɔsu, anwuɔsu nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-mii kɔnyana kɔdi bɔnu lɛnɔ. Na bɛdubo bɔnu bɔti ka sɔsɔ ami Unwoti náni-mii kɔtɔ lɛni.

english_verse: Disaster is near! Injustice and arrogance are everywhere,
translation_verse: Ɔgbankpi úude! Litemi tatɛ ulu siin lɛlɔ ku lɛlɔ katɔ bɔtalaku bɔ́ƒɔ kesi kesii.

english_verse: and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered.
translation_verse: Na balalane bakantankpine baalɛ́ enu na balábla-ma lɛla lɛdi. Anwuɔsu ɔdi ɔɔɔdubo bɔlɛ ɔgbankpi ɔmɛni kemmo. Na bina ala ani na bibo ƒui na áƒɔ-mii kuye geen mmɔ badubo-nya bubile.

english_verse: The time is coming when everyone will be ruined. Buying and selling will stop,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdubo ɔni na ukyuli biala ɔdubo udu bɔyii. Na liyedi teete lɛlɔ kenye kadubo buklo.

english_verse: and people who sell property will never get it back, because all of you must be punished for your sins. And I won't change my mind!
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani néti bana nlɔ ku kese kadi béye lɛnɔ ni, balasɔku ala ammɔ belete-ma. Ɔsika ɔlɛka bani bina ƒui kɔtu na bina alaekpidi ɔsu.

english_verse: A signal has been blown on the trumpet, and weapons are prepared for battle. But no one goes to war, because in my anger I will strike down everyone in Israel. Israel Is Surrounded The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Bávwi lise béte-mii bɔti ka báaklibi ekpola bése béte kekpo. Nsu bina ɔdi ɔɔɔdubo kekpo kammɔ busie ɔsika lɛ́kɛku Israelƒuɔ ƒui kɔnyi.

english_verse: War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases.
translation_verse: “Kekpo ku lɛlɛ ku kɔka kɔ́ƒɔ kesi kesii! Na badubo bekyuli bani nkya akpaklɔ bɔdu na kekpokɔ. Na bani nli lɛma kemmo badubo bukpi na kɔka ɔsu iye lɛlɛ likpidi ɔsu.

english_verse: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.
translation_verse: Na bani na ndubo bubu bulie ngba lɛnɔ badubo bukeli busie abi lɛlɔ aani babloduma bani mɔɔtɔlɔ kɔwɛ kemmo taatáwia kabɛkɔ kesii kani na bakɛ bɔƒɔ. “Na bina ƒui bɛdubo kɔnyana buwulo na bina ekpidi ɔsu.

english_verse: Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp.
translation_verse: Bina enu adubo butaatɔ na bina akɔnkɔ ayɔ.

english_verse: You will put on sackcloth to show your sorrow, but terror will overpower you. Shame will be written all over your faces, and you will shave your heads in despair.
translation_verse: Na kɔnyana adala na bɛdubo butaada biti bɛtina kalɛ na bɛkya lɛƒɛda kemmo. Nsu liƒu ala sɔɔn ndubɔƒɔ-mii keliela kemmo. Na kɔƒa ala lɛnɔ sɔɔn bekyuli badubo butaanu taati na bina anumi lɛlɔ na bɛdubukpeyi bina kuduo linwini ƒui ka bɛ́yila lɛnunsia biala ɔsu.

english_verse: Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food.
translation_verse: Bɛdubo bina sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ƒui bubo buwi kuyeya aani kebu alakpi, ɔsika ɔmmɔ ndi alakpa anyɔ ani nákpanku-mii átákya likpidi kemmo na asɔ alakana-mii bɔƒɔ ɔƒɛni bɔsiku mina kɔnyi kudɔ. Na ala ammɔ asɔ eeebo kuye kɔni na akana na eye bina lɛdila lɛdi muedi.

english_verse: You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
translation_verse: Bɛ́talaku lɛlɔ katɔ laa na bíti bina sika asɛɛ ebi ani náƒɔ kuye geen bɛ́bɔ kadi bamba baƒiɔ bani muusé lɛlɔ bíte lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu ndubo bɔya na sika asɛɛ ebi ammɔ asɔ alálɛ kuye lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Wicked foreigners will rob and disgrace you.
translation_verse: Kadi bamba bekyuli bani ndi baƒɔ badubo bebeyu-mii na bakya-mii kɔƒa.

english_verse: They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
translation_verse: Badubo bɔbwɛ búduo mina kakpakɔ kemmo na babla-ka kesii kani muusé lɛlɔ na kasɔ kalamanku ka bakpa-mi na mmɔ. Nsu ndubɔda anumi lidie na ubo ute lɛni.

english_verse: Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel,
translation_verse: “Ala ƒui adubo buƒu na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui kemmo. Na bekyuli bɔdu ku kalala bɔbla bɔdubɔƒɔ Israel ƒui.

english_verse: so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubo ɔmii ɔni bekyuli mbo kalala geen bɔsu na bebo bebeti bina kɔduli ƒui benwini bana ɔdi. Na lɛmɛnɛ lɛni na bɛɛkun na bina bekpone kpakplaa bani na bibo lɛlɔ ni, nwuna kenye kekulo. Na badubɔbla bina kɔkpakɔ ƒui na kuteese lɛlɔ na kɔsɔ kulamanku bɔkpa bɔdi.

english_verse: You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace.
translation_verse: Badubo-mii liƒu bɔkya ɔni na bɛdubuti lɛnungyie kemmo bɛwia keyi kayɔdi, nsu bilákɛ bɔdi.

english_verse: One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice.
translation_verse: Ɔgbankpi ɔdubo butaalɛ taasia kama na biteenu kenye kekpidi uwi ndi uwi. Na bekyuli badubusie kenye bediene kudɔ betéye-ma si mbo kenye kadi ntɛ-ma. Bakpane badubo mina ɔda bubo bɔtina bɔda bɔya. Na batɔnkune basɔ baaadubo kasusu kadi bɔkɛ butaakya bekyuli.

english_verse: Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear. I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Na bina baga ku bana benengu muedi badubo buteewulo ka basɔ beeebo lɛnunsia lɛdi ɔsu. Na bina enu ataatɔ kpakpaakpa ku liƒu bonwu. Ndubo-mii kɔtu bɔni na lɛbla-mii aani kalɛ na amii lɛnɔ bɛ́bla bekyuli bamba. Na bɛdubɔnu bɔti ka ami ndi Unwoti.”

english_verse: Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na béti Ɔga Yehoiakim ku abu bakladi bésienku Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ kama akwa aku ni, Yudaƒuɔ batɔnkune béteebo-mi kudɔ na mina kesii taabasiaku-mi na mmɔ. Na kɔbuli kɔkundi limeyi lɛlɔndi lɛlɔ ni, Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikun ɔ́ƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui

english_verse: and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up.
translation_verse: na lɛ́nu lɛla lɛdi aani ukyuli ɔyawine. Na ɔ́si nwuna kavobi mmɔ ɔ́yu ubo nwuna lɛgba kakɛ ni, use aani ogya. Na ɔ́si-nwu kavobi úti ɔ́kɔ úsie nwuna lili kakɛ use aani lɛbuala lɛni na békuo-ni kede kede na liikeye geen.

english_verse: It reached out what seemed to be a hand and grabbed my hair. Then in my vision the Lord's Spirit lifted me into the sky and carried me to Jerusalem. The Spirit took me to the north gate of the temple's inner courtyard, where there was an idol that disgusted the Lord and made him furious.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́nu aani si kɔnu na údie na ɔ́da-mi linwini. Na mina kɔyu kemmo ala bɔnu bɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Unwoti Kɔyu kútiku-mi kúsienku kayaa na úti-mi úsienku Yerusalem. Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kúti-mi kúsienku kakpakɔ kaduli geen kemmo na ɔban kayakun kani nkya kɔtɔ kakɛ mmɔ. Na lɛ́nu ka bávɔ baƒiɔ badi bálɛ bani muusé Unwoti lɛlɔ na ɔ́ya na úti kɔnyi kpakplaa geen.

english_verse: Then I saw the brightness of the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, lɛ́nu ka Israel Katɔti bukeye bɔ́ƒɔ mmɔ aani kalɛ na lɛ́nu na Keba Ketu kɔtu.

english_verse: God said to me, “Ezekiel, son of man, look north.” And when I did, I saw that repulsive idol by the altar near the gate.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, nwini nu katɔ kakɛ.” Amu ka línwini lɛ́nu ni, lɛ́nu baƒiɔ bani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ ka balɛ bede lɛkpabi lɛni nlɛ katɔ kakɛ mmɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: God then said, “Do you see the terrible sins of the people of Israel? Their sins are making my holy temple unfit as a place to worship me. Yet you will see even worse things than this.”
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ánu kɔbɔ ala ani muusé lɛlɔ ani na Israelƒuɔ baabla? Bana alaekpidi amɛni aayá na mina kakpakɔ keesé lɛlɔ na mmɔ kasɔ kaaadia keeete ka bakpa-mi. Na adubo ala ani nébie étulo amɛni muedi bɔnu.”

english_verse: Next, I was taken to the entrance of the courtyard, where I saw a hole in the wall.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, béti-mi bésienku kaduli kammɔ ɔban kenye na lɛ́nu ka báƒuaala liƒi lɛdi na kowodu kɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: God said, “Make this hole bigger.” And when I did, I realized it was a doorway.
translation_verse: Amu na Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Bla liƒi lɛmmɔ na libomo libu.” Na ka lɛ́bla lɛni ni, lɛ́nu ka kayakun na kadi.

english_verse: “Go in,” God said, “and see what horrible and evil things the people are doing.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Sia duo mmɔ na anu kɔbɔ ala ku alaekpidi ani udu na bekyuli baabla mmɔ.”

english_verse: Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping.
translation_verse: Na ka líduo ni, lɛ́nu ka bátaa ala lidu lɛni mɔɔkpɛ́ kaƒɔ kalɔ ku bebuo babambadi bani neeese sɛɛn na beesé lɛlɔ lɛnɔ básia awodu ammɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ. Na bátaa baƒiɔ bamba bani na Israelƒuɔ baakpá lɛnɔ básia mmɔ.

english_verse: Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.
translation_verse: Ɔnana ɔni baalɔ Yaasania na ɔdi Saƒan ubidi ɔnanabi ku Israelƒuɔ batɔnkune bamba bani ndubɔbla nkyuli liti ku aavlanyɔ benye mmɔ na ɔdi biala ɔda oloƒui bɔkyula kɔlɛkɛ unye na ɔnyi ɔmmɔ ɔ́ƒɔ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel.
translation_verse: Amu na Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Esekiel, aanu kɔbɔ alaekpidi ani udu na Israel kadi batɔnkune bɔmmɔ benye baabla taabɛ? Bávɔ baƒiɔ béyile bana lɛtɔ kemmo bálɛ na baasu banii lɛɛɛdubo-ma bɔnu, ɔsika baakali banii líidie Israel atu kukuuku.

english_verse: But I will show you something even worse than this.”
translation_verse: Nsu nsɔ ndubo-ɔ lɛla lɛni návi ntu litulo amɛni bɔtina.”

english_verse: He took me to the north gate of the temple, where I saw women mourning for the god Tammuz.
translation_verse: Ɔ́kpanku-mi úsienku ɔban kayakun kani na katɔ kakɛ na ńtanu ka beleku badi belie beewulo Tamus baƒiɔ.

english_verse: God asked me, “Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.”
translation_verse: Katɔti úye-mi ɔnini, “Áƒɔ adi anii Israel beleku ndubɔbla lɛmɛni udu? Nsu awɔ bo na abanu ani násɔ ébie étulo ɔmmɔ.”

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, it's bad enough that the people of Judah are doing these disgusting things. But they have also spread violence and injustice everywhere in Israel and have made me very angry. They have disgraced and insulted me in the worst possible way.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ɔdi likpidi geen ka Yuda kadi bekyuli benye baabla ala ani muuƒí livo mɛni udu. Na ɔɔɔdi amɛni lɛti mmomu etemila tatɛ ulu lɛlɔ ku kalala káaƒɔ Israel kalɔ kemodi kammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui kesi kesii na bákya-mi kɔnyi geen. Na ulu ukpidi ƒui ɔni lɛlɔ na badubɔsia na bakya-mi kɔƒa na bedumi-mi na ɔdi mɛni.

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish them without mercy and refuse to help them when they cry out to me.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ami lɛnɔ kɔnyi kpakplaa kemmo na ndubo-ma kɔtu bɔni na lɛɛɛdubo-ma kɔnyana bɔnu munu munu. Na si ina baava taakpali-mi teevele muedi lɛɛɛdubo bunu bute-ma.”

english_verse: After that, I heard the Lord shout, “Come to Jerusalem, you men chosen to destroy the city. And bring your weapons!”
translation_verse: Na ala amɛni kama ni, línu ka Unwoti údie lɛdi momoomo ɔnini, “Amii bani na báƒuna bése ka bɛkyula ɔma unengudi ɔmɛni ni, bibo Yerusalem mɛni ku bina ekpola!”

english_verse: I saw six men come through the north gate of the temple, each one holding a deadly weapon. A seventh man dressed in a linen robe was with them, and he was carrying things to write with. The men went into the temple and stood by the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Amu na lɛ́nu banana ɛku badi ka bási kayakun katɔdi kammɔ bálɛ na bada ekpola ekpidi. Na ukyuli maatɛdi ɔdi ɔsiaku-ma na ɔkya awu ƒuala ƒuala gyɔlɔɔ na ɔda ala ani na ɔkana na uti unweni ala. Na bekyuli bammɔ béduo bésie kakpakɔ kemmo na béténye lɛbuala ligyiedi lɛbi lɛmmɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: The brightness of God's glory then left its place above the statues of the winged creatures inside the temple and moved to the entrance. The Lord said to the man in the linen robe,
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Katɔti bukeye bɔmmɔ bɔ́ta bebweyi bani na bávɔ bényene kakpakɔ mmɔ na bebo avwi mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na búnwini búsie kayakun mmɔ. Na Unwoti ɔ́su ukyuli ɔni na ɔkya awu gyɔlɔɔ mmɔ ɔnini,

english_verse: “Walk through the city of Jerusalem and mark the forehead of anyone who is truly upset and sad about the terrible things that are being done here.”
translation_verse: “Sie vi ɔma Yerusalem ɔmmɔ ƒui kemmo na abla likposela asia ukyuli biala geen na alaekpidi ani na baabla na ɔma ɔmɛni kemmo aadá-nwu ɔƒɛ lɛtɛntɛ.”

english_verse: He turned to the other six men and said, “Follow him and put to death everyone who doesn't have a mark on their forehead. Show no mercy or pity! Kill men and women, parents and children. Begin here at my temple, but be sure not to harm those who are marked.” The men immediately killed the leaders who were standing there.
translation_verse: Amu na únwini na ɔ́su nkyuli ɛku bakladi ɔnini, “Bɛsiaku-nwu kama na bɛdu ukyuli biala na uuubo likposela lɛmmɔ na nwuna lɛtɛntɛ. Na bitanu ɔdi biala kɔnyana! Bɛdu banana ku beleku ku bawɔne ku bana bebi. Bise kalɔ bɛsiku mina kakpakɔ kemmo mɛni, nsu bɛsia anumi kaduɛ na biládu ukyuli ɔni na ubo likposela lɛmmɔ na nwuna lɛtɛntɛ.” Kɔnakunwi ni, banana bammɔ bádu batɔnkune bani nnye kakpakɔ ɔtɔ kemmo mmɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Pollute the temple by piling the dead bodies in the courtyards. Now get busy!” They left and started killing the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bibile kakpakɔ kammɔ ekisila na bɛla bekpine bammɔ bɛsiaku lɛlɔ na kakpakɔ kaduli geen kammɔ kemmo mmɔ. Bɛsɔ bitebile uwi ɔdi bise kabla kalɔ!” Bátɔlɔ mmɔ na bése kalɔ baadú Yerusalemƒuɔ bammɔ.

english_verse: I was then alone, so I bowed down and cried out to the Lord, “Why are you doing this? Are you so angry with the people of Jerusalem that everyone must die?”
translation_verse: Na ami lɛti nébu mmɔ na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo, anwuɔsu líbo kalɔ na lívele Unwoti nnini, “Bi ɔsu na aabla ala amɛni udu? Bubo na ƒula kɔnyi kúbo kɔ́vi kútédu kesii kani na ɔya na Yerusalemƒuɔ ƒui bekpi?”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “The people of Israel and Judah have done horrible things. Their country is filled with murderers, and Jerusalem itself is filled with violence. They think that I have deserted them, and that I can't see what they are doing.
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti údie kenye ɔnini, “Israel ku Yuda kadi bekyuli bábla ekpidi ani ndi ekisila geen. Na bekyuli badune béyii kalɔ kammɔ kemmo na Yerusalem alati ni, kalala kábɔ mmɔ geen na baakali ka lídie-ma atu ɔsu naaanu ala ani na baabla.

english_verse: And so I will not have pity on them or forgive them. They will be punished for what they have done.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu lɛɛɛdubo-ma kɔnyana bɔnu iye liti lɛkyiɛ-ma lɛnɔ. Ndubo-ma kɔtu bɔni na ala ani na bábla kenye.”

english_verse: Just then, the man in the linen robe returned and said, “I have done what you commanded.”
translation_verse: Uwi útetu asa na ukyuli ɔni nkya awu gyɔlɔɔ mmɔ únwini úbo na úbasu ɔnini, “Lɛ́bla lɛla lɛni na ásu-mi anii mbla.”

english_verse: I saw the dome that was above the four winged creatures, and on it was the sapphire throne.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, lɛ́nu lɛla lɛni mbi bebweyi ine ku ngba ku ngba bammɔ eli. Na lɛla lɛni na nse aani lɛgaboku lɛni nse aani Saƒira lɛtabi lɛni muukeye mmɔ lɛlɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, “Walk among the four wheels beside the creatures and pick up as many hot coals as you can carry. Then scatter them over the city of Jerusalem.” I watched him as he followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su ukyuli ɔni na ɔkya awu gyɔlɔɔ mmɔ ɔnini, “Sie vi kɛɛkɛ ebi ene ani nkya bebweyi bammɔ kalɔ mmɔ akɔ na edie ogya agyabi ani na adubɔkana bɔda. Na egyingya-nwu ewi Yerusalem ɔma enengudi ɔmmɔ ƒui.” Na nnye mɔɔnu kalɛ na ɔɔbla lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́tina-nwu ɔnii ɔbla mmɔ.

english_verse: The winged creatures were standing south of the temple when the man walked among them. A cloud filled the inner courtyard,
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, bebweyi bani mbo avwi mmɔ benye kakpakɔ kammɔ kada kakɛ ka asa na ukyuli ɔmmɔ úsie ɔ́vi-ma ntɛ. Na ulɔyɔ ɔdi ɔ́ƒɔ kakpakɔ kaduli geen kebliidi kammɔ kemmo mmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: and the brightness of the Lord's glory moved from above the creatures and stopped at the entrance of the temple. The entire temple was filled with his glory, and the courtyard was dazzling bright.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti bukeye bɔni mɔɔtu anumi mmɔ bɔ́ta bebweyi bammɔ lɛlɔ na bútédi búnye kakpakɔ kammɔ kayakun. Na kakpakɔ kammɔ ƒui keekeye na bukeye bɔni mɔɔtu anumi mmɔ bɔ́ƒɔ kaduli kammɔ kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: The sound of the creatures' wings was as loud as the voice of God All-Powerful and could even be heard in the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Na kɔku kɔni na bebweyi bammɔ avwi aabla aaku momoomo aani Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui lɛdi, na kɔɔku teesie kaduli kamaadi kemmo muedi.

english_verse: The man in the robe was now standing beside a wheel.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni na nkya awu gyɔlɔɔ mmɔ úubo úbedi unye kɛɛkɛ libi lɛdi kudɔ.

english_verse: One of the four creatures reached its hand into the fire among them and gave him some of the hot coals. The man took the coals and left.
translation_verse: Na bebweyi ine bammɔ akɔ unwi únene kɔnu na usienku ogya ɔni nnye mɔɔda na kɛɛkɛ ebi ammɔ ntɛ na údie ogya agyabi adi úte ukyuli ɔmmɔ na ɔ́tɔlɔ.

english_verse: I noticed again that each of the four winged creatures had what looked like human hands under their wings,
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́nu lɛti ka bebweyi ine bani mbo avwi mmɔ ɔdi biala ubo enu aani bekyuli adi kalɛ na bana avwi ammɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: and I saw the four wheels near the creatures. These wheels were shining like chrysolite.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́nu ebi ammɔ lɛnɔ ka ede bebweyi bammɔ. Na ebi amɛni eekeye aani sika atabi bamba ani baalɔ Krisolit.

english_verse: Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Ebi ammɔ ƒui udu élieku lɛlɔ asa na ebi bamba éƒie ammɔ ntɛ ékulo na ɔdi biala ntɛ.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning. The wheels moved together whenever the creatures moved.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu aakana na eesié lɛƒɛnyi ƒui lɛlɔ, nsu balatu teenwini. Na ebi ammɔ ƒui eesié ku lɛlɔ uwi biala na bebweyi bammɔ beeveyi.

english_verse: I also noticed that the wheels and the creatures' bodies, including their backs, their hands, and their wings, were covered with eyes.
translation_verse: Lɛ́nu lɛnɔ ka ebi ammɔ ku bebweyi bammɔ ɔlɔna kesii biala ku bana kama ku enu ku avwi ƒui ni, anumi áka ámana.

english_verse: And I heard a voice calling these “the wheels that spin.”
translation_verse: Na línu ka lɛdi lɛdi lɛɛkpali taasu lɛnini, “Ebi ani muunwíni lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Each of the winged creatures had four faces: the face of a bull, the face of a human, the face of a lion, and the face of an eagle.
translation_verse: Bebweyi ine bammɔ ɔdi biala ubo anumi na lɛƒɛnyi ine bɔmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Ɔmantɛ akɔ anumi ku ukyuli anumi ku gyata anumi ku kɔdigbo aasɛ anumi.

english_verse: These were the same creatures I had seen near the Chebar River. They controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels stayed beside them.
translation_verse: Na bebweyi bamɛni badi bani kani na lɛ́nu ka Kedar Ketu kudɔ mmɔ. Na anya mɔɔtina ebi ammɔ uwi ku kesii kani na ɔlɛka esie. Na si bebweyi bammɔ báta ni, ama ku ebi ammɔ mɔɔkɛ na si édi énye lɛnɔ na edi enye. Lɛni kani na si kayaa na béveyi baaví lɛnɔ na ebi ammɔ asiaku-ma.

english_verse: Then I watched the brightness of the Lord's glory move from the entrance of the temple and stop above the winged creatures.
translation_verse: Amu na nnye mɔɔnu uwi ɔni na Unwoti bukeye bɔmmɔ bɔ́sɔ bɔ́gyu kakpakɔ kayakun mmɔ bɔ́tɔlɔ búsie bútédi búnye bebweyi ine bammɔ eli.

english_verse: They spread their wings and flew into the air with the wheels at their side. They stopped at the east gate of the temple, and the Lord's glory was above them.
translation_verse: Na bénene bana avwi na béveyi bésie kayaa na ebi ammɔ akɛ-ma kɔmadɔ. Bétédi bénye kakpakɔ kammɔ ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ. Na Unwoti bukeye bɔmmɔ bɔkɛ-ma eli.

english_verse: I knew for sure that these were the same creatures I had seen beneath the Lord's glory near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́bla-mi nwaa ka bebweyi bamɛni kani na lɛ́nu na Kedar Ketu kɔmadɔ ka Unwoti bukeye bɔsiaku-ma na bana eli mmɔ.

english_verse: They had four wings with hands beneath them, and they had the same four faces as those near the River. Each creature moved straight ahead without turning.
translation_verse: Bana ɔdi biala ubo avwi ene na bekyuli enu akya-nya kalɔ na bebo na anumi ene na lɛƒɛnyi ine bɔmmɔ aani bani na ketu kɔtu mmɔ. Na ɔdi biala ɔɔtɔ nwuna anumi siin na ulenwiniku lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit lifted me up and took me to the east gate of the temple, where I saw
translation_verse: Unwoti Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kútiku-mi kúsienku kakpakɔ kammɔ kayakun na ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ kesii kani na lɛ́nu banana aavlanyɔ-ɛlɔ úbunku Yaasania ku Asur ku Benaia ubidi ɔnanabi ɔni baalɔ banii Pealatia.

english_verse: and I told them everything the Lord had shown me.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́sɔku ala ani ƒui na Unwoti údie ɔ́tina-mi ƒui lɛ́su-ma.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, these men are making evil plans and giving dangerous advice to the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, bekyuli bamɛni bakya beeti kasusu kekpidi na baakya Yerusalemƒuɔ kasusu kekpidi kammɔ.

english_verse: They say things like, ‘Let's build more houses. This city is like a cooking pot over a fire, and we are the meat, but at least the pot keeps us from being burned in the fire.’
translation_verse: Na ala ani bene na baasu adi ndi ɔnini, ‘Bɛya na bɔtu lɛtɔ na limomo libu. Bula ɔma unengudi ɔmɛni use aani libui lɛni nsia ogya. Na abu ndi lɛna lɛni nkya libui lɛmmɔ kemmo ɔni na libui lɛmmɔ liitile ogya ɔmmɔ kuƒi ka ɔkyula-bu.’

english_verse: So, Ezekiel, condemn them!”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, Esekiel, du-ma kukpi kɔtɔ!”

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit took control of me and told me to tell these leaders: I, the Lord God, know what you leaders are saying.
translation_verse: Unwoti Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo na ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nsu batɔnkune bammɔ, “Ami Unwoti ngyi ala ani na amii batɔnkune bammɔ bɛɛsu.

english_verse: You have murdered so many people that the city is filled with dead bodies!
translation_verse: Bɛ́ɛdu bekyuli pii ɔni na bekpine báƒɔ ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ ƒui!

english_verse: This city is indeed a cooking pot, but the bodies of those you killed are the meat. And so I will force you to leave Jerusalem,
translation_verse: “Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka ɔma unengudi ɔmɛni ɔdi libui, nsu bekyuli bani na bɛ́du ɔlɔna ndi lɛna lɛmmɔ. Anwuɔsu ndubo-mii lɛlɔ bunye na lɛbɔku-mii lɛlɛku Yerusalem.

english_verse: and I'll send armies to attack you, just as you fear.
translation_verse: Na ndubuti bekpone kasala limene na bekpo-mii kalɛ kani na amii alati bíise kalɔ bɛɛyia kukuuku mmɔ.

english_verse: Then you will be captured and punished by foreign enemies.
translation_verse: Na kadi bamba bekpone badubo-mii buƒie na bani-mii kɔtu.

english_verse: You will be killed in your own country, but not before you realize that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Badubo-mii bɔdu na amii alati bina kalɔ lɛlɔ, nsu ndubo bɔya na bɛnu bɛti ka ami Unwoti nábla ala amɛni nwaa asa na badu-mii.

english_verse: You leaders claim to be meat in a cooking pot, but you won't be protected by this city. No, you will die at the border of Israel.
translation_verse: Amii batɔnkune bammɔ bɛɛsu taatina ka lɛna na bɛdi bɛkya libui lɛmmɔ kemmo, nsu ɔma unengudi ɔmɛni ɔɔɔdubo-mii bɔgyumana. Kudii, bɛdubo bukpi na Israel ɔmii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You will realize that while you were following the laws of nearby nations, you were disobeying my laws and teachings. And I am the Lord!
translation_verse: Bɛdubo bɔnu bɔti ka uwi ɔni na bɛsiaku kadi bamba bekyuli bani nde-mii mmɔ ɔda bubo kama mmɔ ni, bíni ami bɔdi ku ala ani na mɔɔtina. Nsu ami ndi Unwoti!”

english_verse: Before I finished speaking, Pelatiah dropped dead. I bowed down and cried out, “Please, Lord God, don't kill everyone left in Israel.” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ntaawɔlɔ bɔtɛmi kani na Petalia úbuli úbi kalɔ na úkpi. Líboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na lɛ́va ku lɛdi momoomo lɛ́su nnini, “Unwoti buvele bekyuli bani nébu bakya Israel ni, tadu bana ƒui.” Linyese Lɛni Ndanku Lɛnunsia

english_verse: The Lord replied:
translation_verse: Amu na Unwoti údie kenye ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in Jerusalem claim that you and the other Israelites who were taken to Babylonia are too far away to worship me. They also claim that the land of Israel now belongs only to them.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, bekyuli bani nkya Yerusalem baasu ka awɔ ku bekyuli bani ƒui na béƒie béboku Babilon mɛni bɛ́gyu kakyakɔ bɛ́gya, anwuɔsu bilakana-mi bɔkpa. Ɔƒɛni lɛnɔ ni, Israel kalɔ kénwini ama lɛti ɔdi.

english_verse: But here is what I want you to tell the Israelites in Babylonia: It's true that I, the Lord God, have forced you out of your own country and made you live among foreign nations. But for now, I will be with you wherever you are, so that you can worship me.
translation_verse: “Nsu se atu na enu lɛla lɛni na mɔɔwia ka lɛsu Israelƒuɔ bani na nkya Babilon. Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka ami Unwoti Katɔti nábɔku-mii lɛ́lɛku amii alati bina kalɔ lɛlɔ nnii bitélie kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ. Nsu ɔƒaani ndubulieku-mii kesii biala na bɛkya kalɛ bɛkana na bɛkpa-mi.

english_verse: And someday, I will gather you from the nations where you are scattered and let you live in Israel again.
translation_verse: “Na limeyi lɛdi ni, ndubo-mii bɔsala bɔsiku kɔlɔ kɔni lɛlɔ na bígyingya bɛkya na lɛya na bɛsɔ bibelie Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When that happens, I want you to clear the land of all those idols I hate so much.
translation_verse: “Na si uwi ɔni na ala amɛni álɛ ni, ndubɔyɔ ka ada baƒiɔ ala ani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ ƒui edie kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then I will take away your stubbornness and make you eager to be completely faithful to me. You will want to obey me
translation_verse: Na ndubɔda bina atuɔkplu bɔbla ƒui lidie-mii lɛlɔ na lɛya na anumi eteegyie-mii kalɛ na bɛsiaku-mii kama siin na biteenu-mi litemi

english_verse: and all my laws and teachings. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: na bitaadi mina ɔda bubo ku mina ala ani mɔɔtina-mii lɛlɔ. Na bɛdubɔbla mina kadi bekyuli na ami lɛbla bina Katɔti.

english_verse: But those who worship idols will be punished and get what they deserve. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord's Glory Leaves Jerusalem
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bani mɔɔkpá baƒiɔ ni, ndubo-ma kɔtɔ kɔni námanku-ma bɔni. Ami Unwoti Katɔti násu.” Katɔti Bukeye Bɔ́tɔlɔ Yerusalem

english_verse: After the Lord had finished speaking, the winged creatures spread their wings and flew into the air, and the wheels were beside them. The brightness of the Lord's glory above them
translation_verse: Amu ka Unwoti ɔ́wɔlɔ bɔtɛmi ni, bebweyi ine bammɔ bégyingya bana avwi na béveyi bésie kayaa na kɛɛkɛ ebi ammɔ akɛ-ma kɔmadɔ na Unwoti bukeye bɔkɛ-ma katɔ.

english_verse: left Jerusalem and stopped at a hill east of the city.
translation_verse: Na bɔ́tɔlɔ Yerusalem búsie bútédi búnye abi adi eli na unengudi ɔmmɔ ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ.

english_verse: Then in my vision, the Lord's Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to the other exiles in Babylonia. The vision faded away,
translation_verse: Na mina kɔyu kemmo ala bɔnu uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Katɔti Kɔyu kútiku-mi na kɔ́sɔku-mi kúboku Babilon na mina bakpana bakladi bani na abu ku-ma na béƒie mmɔ kudɔ. Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, ala bɔnu bɔmmɔ bɔ́yii bɔ́kya.

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes, but refuse to see; they have ears, but refuse to listen.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, bekyuli bani mɔɔkya lɛsɛ akɔ na akya. Bebo anumi, nsu béni banii balanu baláti. Na bebo atu, nsu béni banii belese atu na benu.

english_verse: So before it gets dark, here is what I want you to do. Pack a few things as though you were going to be taken away as a prisoner. Then go outside where everyone can see you and walk around from place to place. Maybe as they watch, they will realize what rebels they are.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu asa na ɔƒɛ wasa ni, si atu na enu lɛla lɛni na mɔɔyɔ́ ka abla. Bo ƒula ala alɛɛ ani obo aani si buti bada-a batɔlɔku aani ɔtɔntɛne kalɛ. Na alɛ eténye kesii kani na ukyuli biala wanu-ɔ kaduɛ na akɛ eteesie taavi. Ɔƒɛni kalɛ si benye baanu lɛla lɛni na aabla ni, badubo bɔnu bɔti lɛsɛ bakyane bani udu na badi.

english_verse: After you have done this, return to your house. Later that evening leave your house as if you were going into exile.
translation_verse: Si uwi ɔni na ábla ɔmɛni áwɔlɔ ni, na enwini esie ƒula kaduli. Na ɔmmɔ kama si uwi ɔni na ɔ́bla usien ni, na avi alɛ kaduli aani si buƒie na béƒie-ɔ bátɔlɔku béselaku kalɔ bamba kadi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Dig through the wall of your house and crawl out, carrying the bag with you. Make sure everyone is watching.
translation_verse: Ya na ukyuli biala unye utaanu-ɔ asa na edie liƒi na ƒula ɔtɔ kowodu kɔdi kemmo na eti ƒula obo ada na akpɛ alɛ kowodu liƒi lɛmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Lift the bag to your shoulders, and with your face covered, take it into the darkness, so that you cannot see the land you are leaving. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Gyu ƒula obo ɔmmɔ sia ƒula amangba na eti lɛla lɛdi ebi anumi na alɛ eduo lɛdisa lɛmmɔ kemmo kalɛ na alanu ɔmii ɔni kemmo na ésela aláti. Na ala amɛni ƒui enwini Israelƒuɔ kati bute kpakplaa.”

english_verse: I did everything the Lord had said. I packed a few things. Then as the sun was going down, and while everyone was watching, I dug a hole through one of the walls of my house. I pulled out my bag, then lifted it to my shoulders and left in the darkness.
translation_verse: Amu na lɛ́bla ala ani ƒui na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnii mbla mmɔ. Lɛ́sala ala alɛɛ adi. Na uwi ɔni na ɔƒɛ úsela bɔni ni, na ukyuli biala lɛnɔ unye ɔɔnu-mi ni, lídie liƒi lɛdi na mina ɔtɔ kowodu kemmo. Na lɛ́ni mina obo lɛ́lɛku lɛ́sia mina lɛmangba na liduo kadi suu kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: The next morning, the Lord
translation_verse: Kadi kegye ɔtanta ni, Unwoti

english_verse: reminded me that those rebellious people didn't even ask what I was doing.
translation_verse: únyimene-mi ka lɛsɛ bakyane bammɔ ɔdi biala utakana na uye lɛla lɛni na mɔɔbla mmɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: So he sent me back to tell them: The Lord God has a message for the leader of Jerusalem and everyone living there!
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔ́sɔku-mi ɔ́tala ɔnii ntásu-ma ɔnini, “Unwoti ubo kenye kadi na ɔsu Yerusalem ɔtɔnkune ku bani na ɔtɔnku mmɔ ƒui!

english_verse: I have done these things to show them what will happen when they are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Lɛ́bla ala amɛni lɛ́tina-ma kalɛ na banu bati ala ani ndubo-ma bɔlɛku uwi ɔni na badubuti-ma batɔlɔku aani bekyuli beƒiedi kalɛ.

english_verse: The leader of Jerusalem will lift his own bag to his shoulders at sunset and leave through a hole that the others have dug in the wall of his house. He will cover his face, so he can't see the land he is leaving.
translation_verse: Na Yerusalem ɔtɔnkune ɔdubuti nwuna obo ɔsia lɛmangba useyi uwi na ɔsia kowodu liƒi lɛni na bekyuli bamba bédie na nwuna ɔtɔ awodu kemmo. Na ɔdubuti lɛla lɛdi ubi nwuna anumi na uláti ɔmii ɔni lɛlɔ na úsela.

english_verse: The Lord will spread out a net and trap him as he leaves Jerusalem. He will then be led away to the city of Babylon, but will never see that place, even though he will die there.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔla ndubo nwuna asawu bubo na udie-nwu uwi ɔni na ɔ́si ɔɔlɛ́ Yerusalem ɔma kemmo. Na ɔmmɔ kama na bakpanku-nwu besienku Babilon, nsu ɔɔɔdubo mmɔ bɔnu ku nwuna anumi kudii.

english_verse: His own officials and troops will scatter in every direction, and the Lord will track them down and put them to death.
translation_verse: Na badubo nwuna benengu alati ku nwuna bekpone bɔgyingya bɔkya kesii biala na Unwoti ɔdubo-ma budie ƒui bute unwi unwi na badu.

english_verse: The Lord will force the rest of the people in Jerusalem to live in foreign nations, where they will realize that he has done all these things.
translation_verse: “Na Unwoti ɔdubo bekyuli bani nébu bakya Yerusalem lɛlɔ bunye na babɔku-ma batákya kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ kesii kani na badubusie batánu bati ka ami nábla ala amɛni ƒui.

english_verse: Some of them will survive the war, the starvation, and the deadly diseases. That way, they will be able to tell foreigners how disgusting their sins were, and that it was the Lord who punished them in this way. A Sign of Fear
translation_verse: Badi badubɔlɛ kekpo ku kɔka ku lɛlɛ likpidi enu kemmo. Na ama ndubo baƒɔ bammɔ bɔsu kalɛ na bábla ekpidi ani ndi ekisila bonwu bonwu ɔsu na Unwoti ɔ́ni-ma kɔtu lɛni.”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, shake with fear when you eat, and tremble when you drink.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, ya na lɛlɔ litaatɔ-ɔ na kadikɔ ku liƒu na ƒula enu eteeboku lɛlɔ si aaní ntu.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that I, the Lord, say that someday everyone in Jerusalem will shake when they eat and tremble when they drink. Their country will be destroyed and left empty, because they have been cruel and violent.
translation_verse: Su Israel kadi bekyuli anii ami Unwoti násu nnii limeyi lɛdi lɛdubo ɔni na lɛlɔ lɛdubo-ma butaatɔ si baadi na bana enu eteeboku lɛlɔ di baaní ntu. Na badubo kalɔ kammɔ ƒui udu bɔyila na ɔsɔ uwi ukpludi, ɔsika bábla ulikplu ku kalala geen.

english_verse: Every town will lie in ruins, and the land will be a barren desert. Then they will know that I am the Lord. The Words of the Lord Will Come True
translation_verse: Badubo ɔma biala bubo bɔbwɛ na lɛla biala lɛsɔ liladia na ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo, ɔsika kalɔ kammɔ kadubunwini kɔnwinimi kalɔ kakwiidi. Na badubo bɔti ka ami ndi Unwoti.” Unwoti Etemila Adubudie Lɛlɔ Atina Ka Adi Etemila Geen

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you've heard people in Israel use the saying, “Time passes, and prophets are proved wrong.”
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, eenú ka bekyuli beebó lɛgba lɛmɛni na Israel bubo bubo banini, ‘Lɛla biala uwi ɔɔví, na kenye bediene ala ani baanu muedi asɔ alalɛ kalɛ na básu.’

english_verse: Now tell the people that I, the Lord, am going to prove that saying wrong. No one will ever be able to use it again in Israel, because very soon everything I have said will come true!
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani ni, ya na kadi bekyuli bammɔ bati ka ni, ami Unwoti ndubo-ma ɔkɔ bɔsia ka lɛsugba lɛmmɔ lɛɛɛdi litemi geen na ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdubo bunwini lɛla lɛni na bataasu na Israel. Ɔsika uwi klukwii kemmo ni, mina etemila ani ƒui na lɛ́su adubo ete lɛni!

english_verse: The people will hear no more useless warnings and false messages.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ basɔ baaadubo etemila keeke ku ɔkɔ bɔlɛ bɔdi bunu.

english_verse: I will give them my message, and what I say will certainly happen. Warn those rebels that the time has come for them to be punished. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Ndubute-ma mina linyesia na ala ani na masu adubo bɔlɛ lɛni kani. Tɛmiku lɛsɛ bakyane bammɔ kpakplaa ka uwi údu ka bani-ma kɔtu. Ami Unwoti muusé kenye kamɛni.

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are also saying that your visions and messages are only about things in the future.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, Israel kadi bekyuli baasu lɛnɔ banii ƒula etemila ku kɔyu kemmo ala bɔnu ƒui bɔdanku uwi ɔni mebo kama kama.

english_verse: So tell them that my words will soon come true, just as I have warned. I, the Lord, have spoken.
