translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu su-ma anii mina etemila amɛni adubo-nwu kemmo lɛni uwi klukwii ɔmɛni kemmo kani aani kalɛ na lɛ́su-ma kpakplaa líse. Ami Unwoti násu.”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the prophets of Israel who say they speak in my name, but who preach messages that come from their own imagination. Tell them it's time to hear my message.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, du Israel kenye bediene kɔtɔ. Bekyuli bani na banii mina kenye na beedie na baasu ala na mina lɛnyi kemmo, nsu ama alati ala ani na baakali taanu ku kasusu etemila kudu na beebó. Na asu-ma ku uwi údu ka benu-mi litemi.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, say those lying prophets are doomed! They don't see visions—they make up their own messages!
translation_verse: “Ami Unwoti Katɔti mɔɔsu ka ɔkɔ kenye bediene bammɔ ɔdi ɔ́sa ɔƒaamu. Ɔsika ɔɔɔdi mina kɔyu kemmo ala na baanu mmomu bana kasusu kemmo ala kenye na beedie!

english_verse: Israel's prophets are no better than jackals that hunt for food among the ruins of a city.
translation_verse: Israel kenye bediene bátavumanaku beƒukutu bani mɔɔkɛ taawia adila na ɔma ɔni nábwɛ únwini aani kebu alakpi akɔ.

english_verse: They don't warn the people about coming trouble or tell them how dangerous it is to sin against me.
translation_verse: Balálɛ bekyuli bammɔ kpakplaa taasu-ma ɔgbankpi ɔni ndubo-ma lɛlɔ iye lɛbibo lɛni na ekpidi ani na baabla taaƒiɔ-mi adanku.

english_verse: Those prophets lie by claiming they speak for me, but I have not even chosen them to be my prophets. And they still think their words will come true.
translation_verse: Kenye bediene bammɔ baanyi ɔkɔ taasu ka mina lɛnyi kemmo na baasu etemila, nsu ɔɔɔdi ami náƒuna-ma muedi. Na baakali ka bana etemila ammɔ adububo-nwu kemmo ete-ma kalɛ na básu.

english_verse: They say they're preaching my messages, but they are full of lies—I did not speak to them!
translation_verse: Baasu ka mina etemila lɛsa na baakɔ́, nsu ɔkɔ etemila sɔɔn na adi na ɔɔɔdi ami mɔɔsu-ma lɛla lɛdi!

english_verse: So I am going to punish those lying prophets for deceiving the people of Israel with false messages.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu ndubo ɔkɔ kenye bediene bammɔ kɔtu bɔni, ɔsika baatɔ́lɔ Israel kadi bekyuli bammɔ ku ɔkɔ etemila.

english_verse: I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people. They will not be allowed to call themselves Israelites or even to set foot in Israel. Then they will realize that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ndubɔta linye-ma lɛlɔ na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na babla mina bekyuli lɛnɔ. Na basɔ baaadubo lɛnyi bɔdi muedi banii Israelƒuɔ lɛnɔ iye bakya kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ muedi. Na badubɔnu bati ka ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti.

english_verse: Those prophets refuse to be honest. They tell my people there will be peace, even though there's no peace to be found. They are like workers who think they can fix a shaky wall by covering it with paint.
translation_verse: “Kenye bediene bammɔ béni banii balasu litemi geen lɛdi. Na baasu mina bekyuli ka badubɔkɛ keyi buɛɛ ina ka balanu keyi lɛla lɛdi na bana akɔ. Bese aani kabla bablane bani mɔɔkali banii si béti kɔba bákwaa kowodu kɔni ndaku bɔƒɛ ni, na kɔwodu kɔmmɔ kɔdubo bunye kpakplaa.

english_verse: But when I send rainstorms, hailstones, and strong winds, the wall will surely collapse.
translation_verse: Nsu si uwi ɔni na lɛ́ya na ɔnantu ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ku etubankɛ ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa úbo uukpó ni, ɔ́bla bi ɔ́bla dɛ ni, ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ɔdubo bɔƒɛ.

english_verse: People will then ask the workers why the paint didn't hold it up.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bekyuli badubo buye lɛla lɛni ɔsu na kɔba kɔmmɔ kútakana kowodu kɔmmɔ bɔda buse na kulabwɛ.

english_verse: That wall is the city of Jerusalem. And I, the Lord God, am so angry that I will send strong winds, rainstorms, and hailstones to destroy it.
translation_verse: “Kowodu kɔmmɔ ndi Yerusalem, na ami Unwoti Katɔti ndubo ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ku ɔnantu ku etubankɛ ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa bumene na ubaƒɛ kowodu kɔmmɔ ubi kalɔ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: The lying prophets have tried to cover up the evil in Jerusalem, but I will tear down the city, all the way to its foundations. And when it collapses, those prophets will be killed, and everyone will know that I have done these things.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ kenye bediene bammɔ baakya ɔkplu ka beti ala bebi ekpidi ani nkya Yerusalem, nsu ndubo ɔma ɔmmɔ bubo bɔbwɛ butálɛ ɔka ɔni a bákya ɔma ɔmmɔ kalɔ muedi. Na si uwi ɔni na ɔma ɔmmɔ ɔ́bwɛ ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, kenye bediene bammɔ bekyuli ƒui badubɔti ka ami nábla ala ammɔ.

english_verse: The city of Jerusalem and its lying prophets will feel my fierce anger. Then I will announce that the city has fallen and that the lying prophets are dead,
translation_verse: “Yerusalem ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ ku nwuna ɔkɔ kenye bediene bammɔ ƒui badubo mina kɔnyi ala bɔbla bɔnu. Na lɛkɔ lɛsa lite bekyuli ƒui ka Yerusalem ɔdi ɔ́sa na nwuna kenye bediene lɛnɔ békpi.

english_verse: because they promised my people peace, when there was no peace. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Women Who Wear Magic Charms The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɔsika bése keyi buɛɛ kenye béte mina bekyuli na uwi ɔni na beeebo keyi buɛɛ kadi. Ami Unwoti násu.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, now condemn the women of Israel who preach messages that come from their own imagination.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, du Israel beleku kɔtɔ. Ama bani mɔɔkɔ́ lɛsa na ala ani na ama alati bana kasusu kátina-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Tell them they're doomed! They wear magic charms on their wrists and scarves on their heads, then trick others into believing they can predict the future. They won't get away with telling those lies.
translation_verse: Ya na bati anii ama ɔdi ɔ́sa! Baakya evo ala na kavobi na baamána lɛduku eli lɛni lɛlɔ na evo ala ada. Na baatɔ́lɔ bekyuli na baaƒɔ́ taadi ka badubɔkana na basu ala ani ndubo bɔlɛ uwi ɔni mebo. Nsu baaadubo ɔkɔ ɔmɛni ƒui bɔnyi na balɛ sɛɛn na lɛla lɛdi lilálɛku-ma.

english_verse: They charge my people a few handfuls of barley and a couple pieces of bread, and then give messages that are insulting to me. They use lies to sentence the innocent to death and to help the guilty go free. And my people believe them!
translation_verse: Baayá na mina bekyuli beete-ma antabi ku bodobodo blii ɔdi kani na beedumi-mi na bana linyesia lɛni na bebo kemmo. Na baasia ɔkɔ etemila ammɔ lɛlɔ na baadú bekyuli bani na nka bátabla lɛla lɛdi na beebunku bekyuli bani na nka báƒiɔ na baatɔlɔ kɔtu tani tani. Na mina bekyuli baaƒɔ́-ma taadi.

english_verse: I hate the magic charms they use to trick people into believing their lies. I will rip those charms from their wrists and set free the people they have trapped like birds.
translation_verse: “Nkisi evo ala ani na baabla teeti taatɔlɔ bekyuli na baaƒɔ́ bana ɔkɔ etemila taadi. Ndubo lɛbuli lɛni nda-ma kuvobi mmɔ bukulo budie-ma egu na lɛya na bekyuli bani na bana evo ala éƒie aani baasɛ na kɔkpagyuɛ kemmo bakɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: I will tear the scarves from their heads and rescue my people from their power once and for all. Then they will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ndubudie ala ani na beeti teebile-ma anumi, na lidie bana ɔyikun ɔmmɔ na bekyuli bani na béƒie lɛlɔ kalɛ na ɔsɔ uladi-ma lɛlɔ. Mmɔ na badubɔti ka ami Unwoti nábla ala amɛni.

english_verse: They do things I would never do. They lie to good people and encourage them to do wrong, and they convince the wicked to ruin their own lives by not turning from sin.
translation_verse: “Baabla ala ani na ami lɛɛɛdubo bɔbla kudi kudii. Baatɔ́lɔ bekyuli babuni na baakya-ma ogya ka babla likpidi na baayá na kayi keelie bekyuli bekpidi kalɔ ka bataabla bana ekpidi na bayila bana ngba bumodi bɔmmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: I will no longer let these women give false messages and use magic, and I will free my people from their control. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na beleku bamɛni bataasu bana ɔkɔ kenye kadi. Na lɛya na mina bekyuli balɛ bana lɛlɔ bɔdi kalɔ. Na badubɔti ka ami Unwoti nábla ala amɛni.”

english_verse: One day, some of Israel's leaders came to me and asked for a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Limeyi linwi ni, Israel kadi batɔnkune badi bébo-mi kudɔ bébeye-mi si Unwoti ubo kenye kadi ute-ma.

english_verse: While they were there, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na bakya-mi kudɔ mmɔ ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, these men have started worshiping idols, though they know it will cause them to sin even more. So I refuse to give them a message!
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, bekyuli bamɛni béese kalɔ baakpá baƒiɔ ina ka bagyi nwaa ka ɔmmɔ adubɔya na beduo ekpidi pii bamba bɔbla kemmo. Anwuɔsu líni nnii lɛɛɛdubo-ma kenye kadi bɔkya!

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that if they sin by worshiping idols and then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will give them the answer their sins deserve.
translation_verse: Su Israel kadi bekyuli anini, ‘Si baaƒiɔ́-mi na bana baƒiɔ bɔkpa kemmo asa na básɔ báta bésie kenye udiene ɔdi kudɔ banii betéye-nwu si mbo kenye kadi nte-ma ni, ndubo-ma kenye kani na bana ekpidi ani na bábla bɔ́manku búte.

english_verse: When they hear my message, maybe they will see that they need to turn back to me and stop worshiping those idols.
translation_verse: Na si bénu-mi kenye kamɛni ni, ɔƒɛni kalɛ badubo kasusu bɔsɔku bɔbla na bada baƒiɔ bammɔ bɔkpa baya na benwini bebo-mi kudɔ.’

english_verse: Now, Ezekiel, tell everyone in Israel: I am the Lord God. Stop worshiping those idols I hate so much and come back to me.
translation_verse: “Ɔƒɛni ni, Esekiel, su Israelni biala anini, ‘Ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti. Bɛda bina baƒiɔ bani muusé-mi lɛlɔ mmɔ bɔkpa bɛya.

english_verse: Suppose one of you Israelites or a foreigner living in Israel rejects me and starts worshiping idols. If you then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will answer
translation_verse: “ ‘Si amii Israelƒuɔ iye baƒɔ bani na bakya-mii kudɔ ɔdi úni-mi na úse kalɔ ɔɔkpá baƒiɔ ɔmmɔ kama na ɔ́sɔ úsie kenye udiene ɔdi kudɔ ɔnii mina kenye kadi na ɔɔwia unu ni, kenye kani na ndubo-nwu budie ndi ka

english_verse: by turning against you. I will make you a warning to anyone who might think of doing the same thing, and you will no longer belong to my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord and that you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: ndubo bunwini bunye bɔsiaku-nwu na liti-nwu linwi lɛla lɛni na bakladi bani makali banii ama lɛnɔ baabla lɛni banu batɛya. Na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔsɔ ulabla mina kadi bekyuli akɔ unwi. Na ɔdubɔnu ɔti ka ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti na ɔ́bla likpidi ɔ́ƒiɔ-mi sɔsɔ.

english_verse: If a prophet gives a false message, I am the one who caused that prophet to lie. But I will still reject him and cut him off from my people,
translation_verse: “ ‘Si kenye udiene ɔdi ɔ́su ɔkɔ kenye kadi ni, ami náya na ɔ́nyi ɔkɔ. Nsu ina amu ni, ndubuni-nwu na likulo kɔna kɔni nkya anwu ku mina kadi bekyuli ntɛ.

english_verse: and anyone who goes to that prophet for a message will be punished in the same way.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni mesie kenye udiene ɔmmɔ kudɔ ɔnii utáƒɔ mina linyesia lɛdi lɛnɔ ni, ndubo-nwu kɔtu kɔmmɔ udu kani bɔni.

english_verse: I will do this, so that you will come back to me and stop destroying yourselves with these disgusting sins. So turn back to me! Then I will be your God, and you will be my people. I, the Lord God, make this promise. Judgment on a Sinful Nation
translation_verse: Ɔsika mɔɔwia ka binwini bibo-mi kudɔ na bɛsɔ bilayila lɛlɔ udu na ekpidi ani muusé-mi lɛlɔ mɛni bɔbla kemmo. Anwuɔsu binwini bibo-mi kudɔ! Na lɛbla bina Katɔti na amii bɛbla mina kadi bekyuli. Ami Unwoti Katɔti muusé-mii kenye kamɛni.’ ” Unwoti Ɔ́tɛku Kadi Bani Mɔɔbla Likpidi Kɔtu

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, suppose an entire nation sins against me, and I punish it by destroying the crops and letting its people and livestock starve to death.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, si úbo úte ka kadi ƒui bekyuli badi báƒiɔ-mi ni, ndubo-ma kɔtu bɔni na bana edula áyii udu na lɛ́ya na kɔka kɔ́du bekyuli bammɔ ku bana bebuo ƒui.

english_verse: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living in that nation, their faithfulness would not save anyone but themselves.
translation_verse: Ina Noa ku Daniel ku Hiob bakya kalɔ kammɔ kemmo ni, kalɛ na basiaku-mi kama siin ɔɔɔdubo kalɔ kammɔ bɔƒɔ, mmomu ama alati kani ndubɔkɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: Or suppose I punish a nation by sending wild animals to eat people and scare away every passerby, so that the land becomes a barren desert.
translation_verse: “Na lɛnɔ ni, ndubɔkana na lɛni kadi bekyuli badi kɔtu si báƒiɔ-mi na lɛya na beƒiebuo beduo-ma lɛlɔ na bakun-ma na babɔku belusiene bani ƒui nkɛ mmɔ kalɛ na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui kenwini kalɔ kakwiidi kani kemmo lɛla lɛdi liiibo.

english_verse: As surely as I live, I promise that even if these three men lived in that nation, their own children would not be spared. The three men would live, but the land would be an empty desert.
translation_verse: Na muusé kenye ka ɔni na ami Unwoti nli uwi ƒui mɛni ni, ina nkyuli ɛtɛ bani na lɛ́su mɛni bakya mmɔ ni, bana babi muedi balákɛ bɔƒɔ. Na nkyuli ɛtɛ bammɔ ama badubulie ngba, nsu kalɔ kammɔ aka kadubɔyii udu kenwini kalɔ kakwiidi.

english_verse: Or suppose I send an enemy to attack a sinful nation and kill its people and livestock.
translation_verse: “Na lɛkana na limene bekisine bekpone na bebekpo ɔmii ɔni bekyuli mɔɔbla ekpidi mmɔ na badu bekyuli bammɔ ku bana bebuo ƒui.

english_verse: If these three men were in that nation when I punished it, not even their children would be spared. Only the three men would live.
translation_verse: Na si nkyuli ɛtɛ bamɛni bakya mmɔ ni, bana bebi muedi ɔdi ulálɛ-nwu kemmo, mmomu ama alati kani.

english_verse: And suppose I am so angry that I send a deadly disease to wipe out the people and livestock of a sinful nation.
translation_verse: “Na kɔnyi kɔkana na kɔkɔ-mi na lɛya na ɔlɛ ukpidi ɔkyula kadi bani náƒiɔ-mi mmɔ bekyuli ku bebuo ƒui.

english_verse: Again, even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living there, I, the Lord, promise that the children of these faithful men would also die. Only the three of them would be spared.
translation_verse: Na lɛni kani na si Noa ku Daniel ku Hiob bakya mmɔ ni, ami Unwoti muusé kenye ka bana bebi muedi badubo bukpi na balákɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I promise to punish Jerusalem severely. I will send war, starvation, wild animals, and deadly disease to slaughter its people and livestock.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti na muusé kenye ka ndubo Yerusalem kɔtɔ bɔni geen. Ndubo bɔya na kekpo ku kɔka ku lɛlɛ likpidi ku beƒiebuo bebo babadu bekyuli ku bebuo bammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: And those who survive will be taken from their country and led here to Babylonia. Ezekiel, when you see how sinful they are, you will know why I did all these things to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na bani na bétekpi na ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, ndubo bɔya na bakpanku-ma batɔlɔku mmɔ aani bekyuli beƒiedi beboku Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni. Na awɔ Esekiel ɔlati adubɔnu ati lɛla lɛni ɔsu na lɛ́bla Yerusalem ala amɛni ƒui si banii ánu alaekpidi ani udu na baabla taaƒiɔ-mi.

english_verse: You will be convinced that I, the Lord God, was right in doing what I did.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubo-ɔ bɔbla nwaa na atunaku-mi ka lɛla lɛni na ami Unwoti Katɔti lɛ́bla lɛdi ulu lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔdi kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, what happens to the wood of a grapevine after the grapes have been picked? It isn't like other trees in the forest,
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, bi mɔɔlɛ́ku atoo kabuli si béde ebi bédie-ka lɛlɔ ƒui báwɔlɔ? Kabuli kammɔ keeese aani lɛku kemmo egyii bamba.

english_verse: because the wood of a grapevine can't be used to make anything, not even a small peg to hang things on.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kabuli kammɔ kaaadi kugyii kɔni na kubo ɔkplu na ɔdia lɛla lɛdi bɔbla. Na nwuna kɔgba lɛnɔ kuladia bukulo bɔbla ewele na bebo balɛ kesii kadi na baƒala ala.

english_verse: It can only be used as firewood. But after its ends are burnt and its middle is charred, it can't be used for anything.
translation_verse: Bɔmɛnɛ kani na bakana bamɛnɛ-ku bakya ogya. Na si ekuku ammɔ ákywi áwɔlɔ na énwini ntɔ ni, ɔsɔ uuubo kɔsia kɔdi.

english_verse: The wood is useless before it is burned, and afterwards, it is completely worthless.
translation_verse: Kabuli kammɔ keeebo kɔsia kɔdi asa na badubo bɔkyula-ka muedi. Na si bákyula-ka báwɔlɔ lɛnɔ ni, ɔsɔ uuubo lɛblakula lɛdi munu munu.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise that just as the wood of a grapevine is burned as firewood,
translation_verse: “Ami Unwoti Katɔti muusé kenye nnii kalɛ na baakyula atoo kabuli aani ekyweni kalɛ ni,

english_verse: I will punish the people of Jerusalem with fire. Some of them have escaped one destruction, but soon they will be completely burned. And when that happens, you, Ezekiel, will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: lɛni na ndubo ogya buti bɔkyula Yerusalem bekyuli. Na si uwi ɔni na ala amɛni álɛ ni, awɔ Esekiel adubɔnu ati ka ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: I will make their country an empty wasteland, because they have not been loyal to me. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ndubo bɔya na bana kalɔ kenwini kalɔ kekpludi kani neeebo kɔsia kɔdi, ɔsika kaladia lɛla lɛdi bɔbla na ɔni na baládi litemi geen lɛlɔ teete-mi ɔsu. Ami Unwoti Katɔti násu.”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, remind the people of Jerusalem of their disgusting sins
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, nyimene Yerusalemƒuɔ bana ekpidi ani na baabla na eesé-mi lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: and tell them that I, the Lord God, am saying: Jerusalem, you were born in the country where Canaanites lived. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite.
translation_verse: Na asu-ma anii ami Unwoti Katɔti mɔɔsu nnini, “ ‘Yerusalem, ɔmii ɔni kemmo na Kanaanƒuɔ bélie ni, mmɔ na báwɔ-ɔ. Na Amorini na ƒ'ɔti ɔdi, na ƒ'ini ɔdi Hitini.

english_verse: When you were born, no one cut you loose from your mother or washed your body. No one rubbed your skin with salt and olive oil, and wrapped you in warm blankets.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na báwɔ-ɔ ni, ukyuli ɔdi útekulo ƒula lɛkun kabuli útada-a útamami ƒ'ini lɛlɔ iye ɔkpila-a ntu bɔdi. Na ɔdi lɛnɔ úteti mma iye nnɔ útesusu-ɔ ɔlɔna na uti-ɔ ɔkya adi bonwu ani nábɛla-a kɔyɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Not one person loved you enough to do any of these things, and no one even felt sorry for you. You were despised, thrown into a field, and forgotten.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔdi útatina-a bɔyɔ bɔni udu náya na ɔbla ala amɛni ɔdi ute-ɔ. Na ɔdi muedi útanu ƒula kɔnyana na unuku-ɔ ɔlɛ ɔdi. Mmomu béni-ɔ na bébo-ɔ bátákya alakpi akɔ na báyiƒala-a.

english_verse: I saw you lying there, rolling around in your own blood, and I couldn't let you die.
translation_verse: “ ‘Lɛ́nu uwi ɔni na atɛ ƒula ubugya kemmo eebó teeminime na ńtakana na linye lɛnu na ekpi.

english_verse: I took care of you, like someone caring for a tender, young plant. You grew up to be a beautiful young woman with mature breasts and hair, but you were still naked.
translation_verse: Lɛ́nu-ɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na baanu kugyii blii kɔdi lɛlɔ na kɔɔlɛ́ lili. Na ébenwini ugblebi ɔkɔdi ɔni nákɔ anyii na ubo lili linwini gyɔlɔɔ, nsu kasɔngya kani na amu akɛ aaví.

english_verse: When I saw you again, you were old enough to have sex. So I covered your naked body with my own robe. Then I solemnly promised that you would belong to me and that I, the Lord God, would take care of you.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na uwi ɔni na lɛsɔ lɛnu-ɔ na ɔmmɔ kama ni, na éedu kalɛ na ati ɔnana. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu líti mina awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔmmɔ kakɛ kadi líbi-ɔ lɛlɔ na lɛ́bɛla-a kasɔngya líti lɛ́tina-a ka ndubo-ɔ bɔgyumana. Na líse-ɔ kenye kpakplaa na búnyimi ka enwini Unwoti Katɔti ami ɔdi na ntaanu-ɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Now tell me, Ezekiel, do you think this grapevine will live? Or will the first eagle pull it up by its roots and pluck off the grapes and let its new leaves die? The eagle could easily kill it without the help of a large and powerful army.
translation_verse: “Na ɔƒɛni ni, Esekiel, su-mi ƒula kasusu. Aabu ka kugyii kabuli kamɛni kadubo ngba bulie? Munuu kɔdigbo aasɛ udeedi ɔmmɔ ɔdubo-ku bɔgyu budie mmɔ na ude ebi ammɔ udie-ku lɛlɔ na evete ani ƒui na ɔdaku budie mmɔ ayɛyɛ? Ɔsika kɔdigbo aasɛ ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔkana na ɔdu-ku kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ɔni na ɔɔɔdi bekpone pii badi na ɔdubo busie butétiku.

english_verse: The grapevine is strong and healthy, but as soon as the scorching desert wind blows, it will quickly wither. The Lord Explains the Story
translation_verse: Kugyii kabuli kammɔ kebo ɔkplu na kálɛ lili kaduɛ, nsu uwi ɔni na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔkula ala ɔdubuse kalɔ uteekpo ɔ́si kakɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ kani ni, ɔdubo bɔyɛyɛ na ukpi.” Unwoti Údie Litemi Lɛmmɔ Kalɔ

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, ask the rebellious people of Israel if they know what this story means. Tell them that the king of Babylonia came to Jerusalem, then he captured the king of Judah and his officials, and took them back to Babylon as prisoners.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ye Israelƒuɔ lɛsɛ bakyane bammɔ si bagyi lɛla lɛni na litemi lɛmɛni lɛdanku. Su-ma anii Babilon ɔga úbo Yerusalem na úbeƒie Yuda ɔga ɔ́tɔlɔku ku nwuna benengu lɛnɔ aani batɔntɛne kalɛ.

english_verse: He chose someone from the family of Judah's king and signed a treaty with him, then made him swear to be loyal. He also led away other important citizens,
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ƒuna ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́siku Yuda ɔga kaduli bekyuli akɔ na bényi lɛla lɛdi anwu ku-nwu

english_verse: so that the rest of the people of Judah would obey only him and never gain control of their own country again.
translation_verse: kalɛ na Yudaƒuɔ bakladi ƒui bataabu ukyuli ɔmɛni kani na ama alati beeebo kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ɔyikun ɔni na bataadi-ka lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But this new king of Judah later rebelled against Babylonia and sent officials to Egypt to get horses and troops. Will this king be successful in breaking the treaty with Babylonia? Or will he be punished for what he's done?
translation_verse: “Nsu ukyuli ɔni na bése lɛga mɛni ɔ́ta únye Babilon lɛlɔ na ɔ́tala nwuna benengu bamba ɔnii besie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ na betétiku bapɔnkɔ ku bekpone basiku mmɔ beboku. Aabu anii ɔga ɔmɛni kasusu kani na ɔ́bla mɛni kadubo-nwu bɔsia na ɔkana na ɔbwɛ lɛla lɛni na bényimiku Babilon mɛni bubile? Munuu kɔtu na badubo-nwu bɔni na lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla ɔsu?

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, I swear that the king of Judah will die in Babylon, because he broke the treaty with the king of Babylonia, who appointed him king.
translation_verse: “Ɔni na ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti ɔni na uli ngba uwi ƒui mɛni ni, muusé kenye ka Yuda ɔga ɔdubo bukpi na Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika úbile lɛla lɛni na anwu ku Babilonƒuɔ ɔga ɔni náƒuna-nwu úse mmɔ bényimi.

english_verse: Even the king of Egypt and his powerful army will be useless to Judah when the Babylonians attack and build towers and dirt ramps to destroy the cities of Judah and its people.
translation_verse: Na Egyipteƒuɔ ɔga ku nwuna bekpone kpakplaa bani na Yudaƒuɔ bamɛni bététiku muedi baaadubo kɔsia kɔdi bɔlɛ bute Yudaƒuɔ si uwi ɔni na Babilonƒuɔ bábasi libili bámana Yuda lɛma linengudi ka benye bekpo lɛma linengudi lɛmmɔ na badu bekyuli bammɔ.

english_verse: The king of Judah broke his own promises and ignored the treaty with Babylonia. And so he will be punished!
translation_verse: Yudaƒuɔ ɔga útadi nwuna linyese lɛlɔ na útabu lɛla lɛni na únyimiku Babilonƒuɔ. Anwuɔsu badubo-nwu kɔtu bɔni!

english_verse: He made a promise in my name and swore to honor the treaty. And now that he has broken that promise, my name is disgraced. He must pay for what he's done.
translation_verse: “Úse kenye na mina lɛnyi kemmo na ɔ́kpali-mi lɛnɔ ɔ́su ka ɔdubɔdi-ka lɛlɔ. Nsu úbile linyese lɛmmɔ na útadi-ka lɛlɔ. Na ɔ́kpali-mi lɛnyi keeke na úwi-mi anumi kalɔ. Anwuɔsu ɔlɛka bani-nwu kɔtu na lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla ɔsu.

english_verse: I will spread out a net to trap him. Then I will drag him to Babylon and see that he is punished for his unfaithfulness to me.
translation_verse: Ndubo-nwu kakpagyuɛ kadi bɔkywɛɛ na lidie-nwu. Na ndubɔni-nwu lisienku Babilon na bani-nwu kɔtu, ɔsika ɔ́lɛmi kama na útasiaku-mi kama siin.

english_verse: His best troops will be killed in battle, and the survivors will be scattered in every direction. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Badubo nwuna bekpone babuni ƒui bɔdu na kekpokɔ na babɔku bani nébu ƒui begyingya bakya lɛƒɛnyi ƒui lɛlɔ. Ami Unwoti násu.

english_verse: Someday, I, the Lord, will cut a tender twig from the top of a cedar tree, then plant it on the peak of Israel's tallest mountain,
translation_verse: “Limeyi lɛdi ni, ami Unwoti ndubo kugyii kpakplaa kɔni kagba mɔɔlɛ́ ɔwɔdi bukulo na liti-ku lɛlɛ Israel Kɔbi kɔni nákuku kutulo ƒui lili. Na kɔdubunye mmɔ kɔbi lɛlɔ kunwini kugyii bonwu kpakplaa na kɔnwu ebi bonwu bonwu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: where it will grow strong branches and produce large fruit. All kinds of birds will find shelter under the tree, and they will rest in the shade of its branches.
translation_verse: Baasɛ lidu ƒui badubɔkɛ kabɛkɔ na kugyii kɔmmɔ kemmo. Na badubɔkya-ku kɔgba akɔ bakɛ bɔnwuna ku ɔyuli.

english_verse: Every tree in the forest will know that I, the Lord, can bring down tall trees and help short ones grow. I dry up green trees and make dry ones green. I, the Lord, have spoken, and I will keep my word.
translation_verse: Na lɛku kemmo kugyii biala kɔdubɔti ka ami Unwoti ndubɔkana na liboku egyii kangyaa ƒui kalɔ na lɛya na ani na átakuku alɛ lili. Na mɔɔyá na egyii ɔwɔdi eenwíni akwiidi Na mɔɔyá na ani na ákwii lɛnɔ eenwíni awɔdi. Ami Unwoti násu na ndubo mina litemi lɛlɔ bɔdi.”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, I hear the people of Israel using the old saying, “Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a sour taste in the mouths of their children.”
translation_verse: “Esekiel, muunú Israelƒuɔ lɛsugba kukuuku lɛdi lɛni na ɔdi biala ɔɔsu ɔnini, ‘Ebi ekpidi ani na bawɔne bádi ni, nyana ɔdu mɔɔƒɔ́ lɛlɔ taakya bana bebi nnye kemmo.’

english_verse: Now tell them that I am the Lord God, and as surely as I live, that saying will no longer be used in Israel.
translation_verse: “Nsu su-ma ɔƒaani anii ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti na ɔni na ami nli ngba uwi ƒui mɛni ni, lɛsugba lɛmmɔ kenye kadubo bukulo na basɔ baaadubo-ni butaasu na Israel.

english_verse: The lives of all people belong to me—parents as well as children. However, only those who sin will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ngba bɔni na bawɔne ku bebi bammɔ ƒui belie ni, ami na belie-mu bete. Na bani nábla likpidi lɛdi kani ndubo bukpi.

english_verse: Suppose there is a truly good man who always does what is fair and right.
translation_verse: “Ɔƒɛni kalɛ ukyuli ɔbuni ɔdi ɔkya ɔni na use siin na lɛbuni kani na ɔɔbla.

english_verse: He refuses to eat meat sacrificed to foreign gods at local shrines or to worship Israel's idols. He doesn't have sex with someone else's wife or with a woman having her monthly period.
translation_verse: Na úni ka ɔkun lɛna lɛni na béti bákpa béte kadi bamba baƒiɔ na ɔƒiɔtɔ kesii kani na Israelƒuɔ báƒɔ-ma bábakya mmɔ kemmo. Na úni lɛnɔ ka ɔkpa Israel baƒiɔ badi. Na ulesie bekyuli bamba beleku kudɔ iye beleku bani nánu kɔbuli lɛnɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: He never cheats or robs anyone and always returns anything taken as security for a loan; he gives food and clothes to the poor
translation_verse: Na ulanya ukyuli taakya iye uyu ɔdi lɛnɔ. Na lɛla biala na ukyuli ɔdi úti úse lɛlɔ kama úte-nwu asa na úvo lɛla lɛdi ni, ɔɔsɔku-ni teete-nwu. Na uleyu bekyuli. Na uute bawabane adila. Na bani nkɛ ku kasɔngya ni, uute-ma adala.

english_verse: and doesn't charge interest when lending money. He refuses to do anything evil; he is fair to everyone
translation_verse: Ulevo ala teete bekyuli na ɔƒɔ-ma lɛla lɛdi uye, iye ɔƒɔ kuvonsia kunengudi kɔdi. Na ulayɔ ka ɔbla ukyuli ɔdi likpidi lɛdi. Na si litemi líbo badi ntɛ ni, ɔɔtɛ-ma ntɛ litemi ulu siin lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and faithfully obeys my laws and teachings. This man is good, and I promise he will live.
translation_verse: Na ulalɛ mina ɔda bubo ku etemila kama. Mmomu ɔɔsia-mu kama siin. Ukyuli ɔmɛni udu ɔdi ukyuli ɔbuni. Na muusé kenye ka ɔdubulie ngba.

english_verse: But suppose this good man has an evil son who is violent and commits sins
translation_verse: “Nsu ɔƒɛni kalɛ ukyuli ɔmɛni ubo ubi ukpidi ɔni mɔɔdú bekyuli na ɔɔbla ekpidi bamba,

english_verse: his father never did. He eats meat at local shrines, has sex with someone else's wife,
translation_verse: ina ka ɔti útabla ala ammɔ udu kudii. “Na ɔkɛ aƒiodu ɔɔkun lɛna, na ɔɔtɛnku bekyuli beleku.

english_verse: cheats the poor, and robs people. He keeps what is given to him as security for a loan. He worships idols, does disgusting things,
translation_verse: Na ɔɔnya bawabane taakya, na uuyú bekyuli. Ɔƒɛni lɛnɔ ni, ala ani na bekyuli béti bése lɛlɔ kama béte-nwu ni, ulásɔku teete-ma. Na ɔɔkpá baƒiɔ, na ɔɔbla ala ani muusé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and charges high interest when lending money. An evil man like that will certainly not live. He is the one who has done these horrible sins, so it's his own fault that he will be put to death.
translation_verse: Na uuvó ala teete bekyuli na ɔɔƒɔ́-ma ala teeye na ɔɔƒɔ́ kuvonsia pii lɛnɔ. Ukyuli ukpidi ɔni na use lɛni ni, ulakana na welie ngba bukpi kani na ɔdubo bukpi na anwu ɔlati ɔdubuti nwuna etila.

english_verse: But suppose this evil man has a son who sees his father do these things and refuses to act like him.
translation_verse: “Nsu ɔƒɛni kalɛ ukyuli ukpidi ɔdi lɛnɔ ubo ubi ɔni mɔɔnu ka ɔti ɔɔbla udu ɔmɛni na anwu úni na ulabla lɛni.

english_verse: He doesn't eat meat at local shrines or worship Israel's idols, and he doesn't have sex with someone else's wife.
translation_verse: “Ɔɔɔkɛ ulakun lɛna taavi na aƒiodu. Na ulakpa Israel baƒiɔ badi lɛnɔ. Na ulatɛnku bekyuli bamba beleku.

english_verse: He never cheats or robs anyone and doesn't even demand security for a loan. He gives food and clothes to the poor
translation_verse: Ulanya bekyuli taakya. Na ulaƒɔ lɛla lɛdi teese kama si bévo-nwu lɛla lɛdi. Uleyu bekyuli. Uute bawabane adila. Na bani nkɛ ku kasɔngya ni, uute-ma adala.

english_verse: and refuses to do anything evil or to charge interest. And he obeys all my laws and teachings. Such a man will live. His own father sinned, but this good man will not be put to death for the sins of his father.
translation_verse: Na ulevo ala teete bekyuli na ɔƒɔ-ma ala uye, iye ɔƒɔ-ma kuvonsia kunengudi kɔdi. Ɔɔdi mina litemi ku ɔda bubo lɛlɔ siin. Ukyuli ɔmɛni udu ulekpi na ɔti likpidi ɔsu, mmomu ɔdubulie ngba.

english_verse: It is his father who will die for cheating and robbing and doing evil.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔti ɔmmɔ ndubo bukpi na bekyuli bɔnya taakya ku kuyu ku likyulikpi ala bɔbla ɔsu.

english_verse: You may wonder why a son isn't punished for the sins of his father. It is because the son does what is right and obeys my laws.
translation_verse: “Ngyi ka lɛla lɛni ɔsu na balani ubi kɔtu na ɔti alaekpidi lili ɔdi lɛla lɛni ndubo-ɔ bɔbla kalɛ kadi. Na ani ndi ka ubi ɔmmɔ ɔɔbla lɛla lɛni ndi ulu na ɔɔdi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Only those who sin will be put to death. Children won't suffer for the sins of their parents, and parents won't suffer for the sins of their children. Good people will be rewarded for what they do, and evil people will be punished for what they do.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muulie taabla likpidi kani na badubo bɔdu. Bebi baaadubo abi adi bubo na bana bawɔne ablala ɔsu. Na lɛni kani na bawɔne lɛnɔ baaadubo abi bubo na bana bebi ablala kenye. Mmomu bekyuli bani nábla likpidi kani na badubo bɔdu. Bebi baaadubo abi bubo na bana bati ekpidi ɔsu. Na bawɔne lɛnɔ baaadubo abi bubo na bana bebi ekpidi ɔsu. Na badubo kayu kabuni bɔƒɔ bute bekyuli babuni na ala ani na bábla ɔsu.

english_verse: Suppose wicked people stop sinning and start obeying my laws and doing right. They won't be put to death.
translation_verse: “Na si bekyuli bekpidi báda bana ekpidi bɔbla báya na bése kalɔ baabla lɛbuni na baadi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni, baaadubo-ma bɔdu.

english_verse: All their sins will be forgiven, and they will live because they did right.
translation_verse: Badubuti bana ekpidi ƒui bakyiɛ-ma na belie ngba, ɔsika bábla lɛbuni.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, don't like to see wicked people die. I had much rather see them turn back from their sins and live.
translation_verse: Ami Unwoti Katɔti naaayɔ ka lɛnu ka ukyuli ukpidi ukpi. Mmomu ɔɔda-mi kubiti ka lɛnu ka únwini kama ɔ́kya nwuna ekpidi bɔbla na ulie ngba.

english_verse: But when good people start sinning and doing disgusting things, will they live? No! All their good deeds will be forgotten, and they will be put to death because of their sins.
translation_verse: “Nsu si bekyuli bekpidi bése kalɔ ku ngba bukpidi bulie na baabla ala ani muusé lɛlɔ ni, ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔya na belie ngba? Oowo! Mmomu bana lɛbuni lɛni na bábla bávi ƒui lɛdubo bɔyii na bayiƒala-nya. Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu badubo-ma bɔdu na bana ekpidi ɔsu.

english_verse: You people of Israel accuse me of being unfair! But listen—I'm not unfair; you are!
translation_verse: “Amii Israelƒuɔ bɛɛdú-mi kɔtɔ ka naaatɛ litemi ulu siin lɛlɔ! Nsu ni, binu, ɔɔɔdi lɛni na use!

english_verse: If good people start doing evil, they must be put to death, because they have sinned.
translation_verse: Si bekyuli babuni bese likpidi bɔbla kalɔ ni, ɔlɛka badu-ma, ɔsika bábla likpidi.

english_verse: And if wicked people start doing right, they will save themselves from punishment.
translation_verse: Na si alaekpidi bablane bése kalɔ ku lɛbuni bɔbla ni, badubudie lɛlɔ kɔtu bɔni kemmo.

english_verse: They will think about what they've done and stop sinning, and so they won't be put to death.
translation_verse: Badubo bana alaekpidi ani na bábla bávi bɔkali bɔnu na bada-nya bɔbla baya kalɛ na baládu-ma.

english_verse: But you still say that I am unfair. You are the ones who have done wrong and are unfair!
translation_verse: Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui kama bɛmu binye bɛɛsu bɛnii naaatɛ litemi ulu siin lɛlɔ. Nsu ami mmomu nábla likpidi na bina ablala eeese siin!

english_verse: I will judge each of you for what you've done. So stop sinning, or else you will certainly be punished.
translation_verse: “Ndubo ɔdi biala litemi bɔtɛku na lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla kenye. Anwuɔsu bɛda likpidi bɔbla bɛya. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, ɔ́bla bi ndubo-mii kɔtɔ bɔni.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and start thinking pure thoughts. And be faithful to me! Do you really want to be put to death for your sins?
translation_verse: Bini bina alaekpidi lilu lɛni ƒui lɛlɔ na bɛsia na bise kalɔ bitaabla kasusu kabuni na bɛsiaku-mi kama siin! Munuu bɔyɔ geen na bɛɛyɔ́ ka badu-mii na bina ekpidi bɔbla ɔsu?

english_verse: I, the Lord God, don't want to see that happen to anyone. So stop sinning and live!
translation_verse: Ami Unwoti Katɔti naaayɔ ka lɛmmɔ udu lɛlɛku bina akɔ ɔdi. Anwuɔsu bɛda ekpidi bɔbla bɛya na bilie ngba!”

english_verse: Ezekiel, sing a funeral song for two of Israel's leaders:
translation_verse: “Esekiel, die ɔkwanu ɔkɛnku Israel bagabi lɛlɔ

english_verse: Your mother was a brave lioness who raised her cubs among lions.
translation_verse: na asu anini, “ ‘Ƒ'ini ɔdi gyata uni ɔdi udu. Na ɔ́kya bagyata bamba akɔ! Ɔɔyu taatɛ bagyatabi bammɔ akɔ na ɔɔnyuɛ nwuna bebi.

english_verse: When the nations heard of him, they trapped him in a pit, then they used hooks to drag him to Egypt.
translation_verse: Kadi bekyuli ƒui bénu-nwu kɔku kɔmɛni. Na béku ubu bonwu ɔdi bákywɛ-nwu kakpagyuɛ na úbanu-ka. Na bábala-nwu abuala na báni-nwu bésienku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: His mother waited for him to return. But soon she lost all hope and raised another cub, who also became fierce.
translation_verse: “ ‘Uni únye utaanu-nwu ulu ka unwini ubo, nsu únye ɔ́nɔ. Ka ɔ́yila lɛnunsia ɔsu ni, ɔ́ƒuna nwuna ubi bamba na ɔ́nyuɛ-nwu na ɔɔbla ogya geen.

english_verse: Nations plotted to kill him, and people came from all over to spread out a net and catch him in a trap.
translation_verse: Kadi ƒui bekyuli bábata bénye-nwu lɛlɔ. Na bási kɔlɛkɛ bonwu bonwu kɔni na amadɔ mmɔ ƒui kemmo bébo bébeku ubu bákywɛ-nwu kakpagyuɛ. Na kakpagyuɛ kammɔ kédie-nwu.

english_verse: They put him in a cage and took him to Babylonia. The lion was locked away, so that his mighty roar would never again be heard on Israel's hills.
translation_verse: Bábala-nwu abuala adi na báni-nwu bákya lɛyu lɛdi kemmo na béti-nwu bésienku Babilonƒuɔ ɔga kudɔ. Mmɔ na bátábala-nwu bákya ɔtɔ katɛnkɔ kadi. Anwuɔsu ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ ulenu-nwu bɔkwanyi na Israel abi lɛlɔ mmɔ bene ƒui.

english_verse: Your mother was a vine like you, growing near a stream. There was plenty of water, so she was filled with branches and with lots of fruit.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ƒ'ini ɔdi kɔdingyii kabuli kani na kenye ketu kɔtu. Na ka kɔɔƒɔ́ ntu pii na mmɔ ɔsu ni, kúdie kɔgba ku ligyiitu pii.

english_verse: Her strong branches became symbols of authority, and she was taller than all other trees— everyone could see how strong and healthy she was.
translation_verse: Nwuna kɔgba kpakplaa kɔmmɔ kunye kute kenyekɔ ɔyikun na kɔ́kuku kutulo egyii ƒui. Na kalɛ na kɔ́lɛ lili na kubo ɔkplu ni, ukyuli biala ɔɔnu taati.

english_verse: But in anger, I pulled her up by the roots and threw her to the ground, where the scorching desert wind dried out her fruit. Her strong branches wilted and burned up.
translation_verse: Nsu na kɔnyi ɔsu ni, lɛ́gyu-ku lídie mmɔ ku lidu ku lidu lɛ́va kalɔ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔkula ala ɔ́si kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ úbo úbakula-ku ku ebi ani na asia-ku lɛlɔ ƒui na kɔ́yɛyɛ.

english_verse: Then she was planted in a hot, dry desert,
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama béti-ku bátálɛ kalɔ kakwiidi kani náƒɔ ogya lɛlɔ.

english_verse: where her stem caught fire, and flames burned her branches and fruit. Not one strong branch is left; she is stripped bare. This funeral song must be sung with sorrow.
translation_verse: Na mmɔ ni, kugyii kɔmmɔ ntɛ kɔ́ƒɔ ogya na ɔ́da úsie kuna kɔgba akɔ na kɔ́kyula-ku ku ebi ammɔ ƒui na kagba kadi kásɔ kétebu ɔni na kugyii kɔmmɔ kɔ́sɔ kunye salalaa.’ “Ɔkwanu ɔmɛni ni, budie na ɔlɛka bedie-nwu ku kɔnyana.”

english_verse: Seven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, some of Israel's leaders came to me on the tenth day of the fifth month. They sat down and asked for a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Na akwa maatɛ kama ka béƒie Ɔga Yekonia ku abu bakladi aani batɔntɛne kalɛ bésienku Babilon ni, Israelƒuɔ batɔnkune badi bébo-mi kudɔ na kɔbuli kɔlɔndi limeyi leevudi kemmo. Bébelie kalɔ na béye-mi bénu si Unwoti ubo linyesia lɛdi ute-ma.

english_verse: Just then, the Lord God said:
translation_verse: Mmɔ kani na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, these leaders have come to find out what I want them to do. As surely as I live, I will not give them an answer of any kind.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, batɔnkune bamɛni bébo banii bebenu si mbo lɛla lɛdi na masu-ma, nsu ɔni na nli uwi ƒui mɛni ni, lɛɛɛdubo-ma kenye biala udu budie bute.

english_verse: Are you willing to warn them, Ezekiel? Then remind them of the disgusting sins of their ancestors.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, énu kalɔ ka esie atálɛ-ma kpakplaa? Amu ya na benyimo bana bati kukuuku ekpidi ani na bábla na eesé-mi lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Tell them that long ago I, the Lord God, chose Israel to be my own. I appeared to their ancestors in Egypt and made a solemn promise that I would be their God and the God of their descendants.
translation_verse: “Na asu-ma ka ami Unwoti Katɔti náƒuna Israel ɔ́si kukuuku ka benwini mina kadi bekyuli. Na lídie lɛlɔ lɛ́tina bana bati kuuku na Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ na líse kenye kpakplaa líte-ma ka ami ndubɔdi bana ama ku bana bawɔ lɛnɔ Katɔti.

english_verse: I swore that I would rescue them from Egypt and lead them to a land I had already chosen. This land was rich with milk and honey and was the most splendid land of all.
translation_verse: Na líse kenye ka ndubudie-ma lɛlɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ na lɛtɔnku-ma lisienku ɔmii ɔni na lɛ́ɛƒuna líse lɛlɔ. Na kalɔ kammɔ kadi kalɔ kani egyiibi ntu mɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii teetulo kɔlɔ kɔkladi ƒui.

english_verse: I told them to get rid of their disgusting idols and not to sin by worshiping the gods of Egypt. I reminded them that I was the Lord their God,
translation_verse: Lɛ́su-ma nnii bebo baƒiɔ bani na bada baavínku na beesé lɛlɔ mmɔ bevaakun na bada Egyipteƒuɔ baƒiɔ bammɔ bene bɔkpa baya. Na línyimene-ma lɛnɔ ka ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti ɔni kani nátɔnku-ma mmɔ.

english_verse: but they still rebelled against me. They refused to listen and kept on worshiping their idols and foreign gods. In my anger, I decided to punish the Israelites in Egypt.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui kama ni, bámu báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ. Na béni banii baaadubo-mi litemi bunu na kadi bamba ala anwidi ku avɔdi baƒiɔ bɔkpa bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kani na benye. “Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na lɛ́kɛku-ma kɔnyi geen na lɛ́lɛ ugyii ka nka mɔɔní-ma kɔtu na Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: But that would have made me look like a liar, because I had already promised in front of everyone that I would lead them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Nsu lɛ́nu ka si lɛ́bla lɛni ni, ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔtina aani si ɔkɔ ɔnyine na ndi, ɔsika bana anumi na líse kenye ka ndubo-ma bɔkpanku bɔlɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: So I brought them out and led them into the desert.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na lɛ́ya na bálɛ mmɔ na lɛ́tɔnku-ma lísienku kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: I gave them my laws and teachings, so they would know how to live right.
translation_verse: Lɛ́tina-ma mina ɔda bubo kalɛ na bati kalɛ na belie ngba ulu lɛlɔ siin.

english_verse: And I commanded them to respect the Sabbath as a way of showing that they were holy and belonged to me.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́su-ma kpakplaa nnii bataadi Lɛnwunameyi lɛmmɔ kaduɛ kalɛ na batina lɛlɔ ka bese kedee na ami badi na badi.

english_verse: But the Israelites rebelled against me in the desert. They refused to obey my laws and teachings, and they treated the Sabbath like any other day. Then in my anger, I decided to destroy the Israelites in the desert once and for all.
translation_verse: Nsu Israelƒuɔ báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ na ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ. Na béni banii baaadubo-mi litemi bunu na badi mina ɔda bubo ku ala ani mɔɔtina-ma mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na baabla Lɛnwunameyi lɛmmɔ kalɛ kalɛ aani limeyi keeke bamba biala kalɛ. “Mmɔ na lɛ́lɛ ugyii ka nka mɔɔyila Israelƒuɔ bammɔ ƒui udu na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ kɔnakunwi kani na ɔsa.

english_verse: But that would have disgraced me, because many other nations had seen me bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ami ɔla kɔƒa na kɔdi. Ɔsika kadi bamba bekyuli pii bánu ka ami nákpanku Israelƒuɔ lɛ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Instead, I told them in the desert that I would not lead them into the beautiful, fertile land I had promised.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, lɛ́su-ma na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo mmɔ nnii lɛɛɛdubo-ma bɔtɔnku busienku kalɔ kani kenye na líse-ma mmɔ lɛlɔ, kalɔ kani egyiibi ntu mɔɔyu emini aani uwɔ na kana lɛlɔ bebuo baayu anyi ntu pii mmɔ.

english_verse: I said this because they had not only ignored my laws and teachings, but had disgraced my Sabbath and worshiped idols.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi ɔni na béni na baládi mina ala ani na lɛ́tina-ma ku mina ɔda bubo lɛnɔ lɛti pɛ ɔsu. Mmomu ka bákya mina Lɛnwunameyi kɔƒa na baakpá baƒiɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Yet, I felt sorry for them and could not let them die in the desert.
translation_verse: “Nsu bana lɛlɔ lɛ́sɔ lɛ́bla-mi kɔnyana ka lɛya na bekpi na kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo lɛni.

english_verse: So I warned the children not to act like their parents or follow their evil ways or worship their idols.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na lɛ́lɛ bana bebi bammɔ kpakplaa nnii ama batalɛ bana bati na basiaku bana ɔbladu buɛ ɔmmɔ kama iye bakpa baƒiɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I reminded them that I was the Lord their God and that they should obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Línyimene-ma ka ami kani ndi bana Unwoti Katɔti ɔni ndanku-ma mmɔ na ɔdi ka benu-mi ala bɔtina na badi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I told them to respect my Sabbath to show that they were my people and that I was the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Lɛ́su nnii bataabu mina Lɛnwunameyi na ɔtina ka badi mina bekyuli ɔ́si kuuku na ami lɛnɔ ndi-ma Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́si kukuuku.

english_verse: But the children also rebelled against me. They refused to obey my laws and teachings, and they treated the Sabbath as any other day. I became angry and decided to punish them in the desert.
translation_verse: Nsu bana bebi lɛnɔ báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ. Na béni banii belenu mina ala bɔtina ku ɔda bubo lɛlɔ na badi-mu lɛlɔ. Na baabla mina Lɛnwunameyi kalɛ kalɛ aani limeyi keeke biala kalɛ. “Amu na ḿbeti kɔnyi geen na lɛ́su kpakplaa nnii ndubo-ma kɔtu bɔni na kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo mmɔ.

english_verse: But I did not. That would have disgraced me in front of the nations that had seen me bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Nsu ńtabla ńtasiaku lɛni. Ɔsika nka ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔbla-mi kɔƒa na kadi bekyuli bani nánu-mi ka lɛ́kpanku Israelƒuɔ lɛ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ kemmo.

english_verse: So I solemnly swore that I would scatter the people of Israel across the nations,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na lɛ́kanku mina lɛlɔ kpakplaa ka ndubo Israelƒuɔ bugyingya bɔkya kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ,

english_verse: because they had disobeyed my laws and ignored my teachings; they had disgraced my Sabbath and worshiped the idols their ancestors had made.
translation_verse: ɔsika béni na bátadi mina ɔda bubo ku ala bɔtina lɛlɔ na bákya mina Lɛnwunameyi kɔƒa na bakya baakpá kadi bamba baƒiɔ bani na bávɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: I gave them laws that bring punishment instead of life,
translation_verse: Líte-ma ɔda bubo kpakplaa bɔni ndanku kɔtu bɔni na lɛla lɛni nebunku-ma na bakɛ ngba kenye.

english_verse: and I let them offer me unacceptable sacrifices, including their first-born sons. I did this to horrify them and to let them know that I, the Lord, was punishing them.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́ya na baabla akpala ani nátamanku na beeti bana bebi bananabi bedeedi muedi taakpa. Nsu lɛ́bla-ma ala amɛni kalɛ na liƒu lɛƒɔ bana keliela ƒui kemmo na bati lɛnɔ ka ami Unwoti mɔɔní-ma kɔtu.

english_verse: Ezekiel, tell the people of Israel that their ancestors also rejected and insulted me
translation_verse: “Esekiel, su Israelƒuɔ anii lɛni na bana bati kuuku lɛnɔ béni-mi na bédumi-mi

english_verse: by offering sacrifices, incense, and wine to gods on every hill and under every large tree. I was very angry, because they did these things in the land I had given them!
translation_verse: na uwi ɔni na béteeti akpala ku oloƒui ku ntɛ teete baƒiɔ lidu na abi ammɔ lɛlɔ na egyii enengudi ammɔ kalɔ. Na lɛ́kɛ kɔnyi geen, ɔsika ɔmii ɔni na líti líte-ma lɛlɔ na baabla ala amɛni udu!

english_verse: I asked them where they went to worship those gods, and they answered, “At the local shrines.” And those places of worship are still called shrines.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na líye-ma línu kesii kani na bátákpa baƒiɔ bammɔ na bédie kenye banini, ‘Baƒiɔ kɔdu.’ Na bamu baalɔ kesii kani na baakpá baƒiɔ bamɛni banii aƒiodu.

english_verse: Then ask the Israelites why they are following the example of their wicked ancestors
translation_verse: “Ɔmmɔ kama ni, ye Israelƒuɔ lɛla lɛni ɔsu na basiaku bana bati kuuku ulikplu ɔbladu ɔmmɔ kama,

english_verse: by worshiping idols and by sacrificing their own children as offerings. They commit these sins and still think they can ask me for a message. As surely as I am the living Lord God, I will give them no answer.
translation_verse: na baakpá baƒiɔ na beeti ama alati bana bebi taabla akpala teete baƒiɔ bammɔ. Ala ekpidi amɛni udu na benye baabla na basɔ baakali ka bebenu-mi kenye kadi. Nsu ɔni na ndi Unwoti Katɔti na nli uwi ƒui mɛni ni, lɛɛɛdubo-ma kenye kadi budie bute.

english_verse: They may think they can be like other nations and get away with worshiping idols made of wood and stone. But that will never happen! The Lord Promises To Restore Israel The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Baakali ka badubuti lɛlɔ benwini aani kadi bamba bekyuli na bataakpa ala ani na béti ligyii ku atabi bánwi na balɛ-mi enu sɛɛn na balákɛ kɔtu bɔni. Nsu ɔkɔ na ɔdi batatɔlɔ lɛlɔ! Unwoti Úse Kenye Ka Ɔdubɔya Na Israel Ɔsɔ Ubese Kalɛ Na Úse

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, I will rule over you with my powerful arm. You will feel my fierce anger
translation_verse: “Ɔni na ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti ɔni na nli ngba uwi ƒui ɔsu ni, ndubo-mii lɛlɔ bɔdi ku ɔyikun kpakplaa. Na bɛdubo mina kɔnyi ala bɔbla bɔnu.

english_verse: and my power, when I gather you from the places where you are scattered
translation_verse: Na bɛdubo mina ɔyikun lɛnɔ bɔnu bɔti si uwi ɔni na lɛ́sala-mii lɛ́siku kesii biala na bígyingya bɛkya.

english_verse: and lead you into a desert surrounded by nations. I will meet you there face to face. Then I will pass judgment on you
translation_verse: Na ndubo-mii bɔkpanku busienku kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ kesii kani na kadi bamba bekyuli lidu lidu badubɔka bamana-mii. Na ami ku-mii bɔdubɔsa anumi ku anumi. Na nwuna kama na lɛtɛku-mii litemi na lɛdu-mii kɔtɔ.

english_verse: and punish you, just as I punished your ancestors in the desert near Egypt.
translation_verse: Na ndubo-mii kɔtu bɔni kalɛ kani na lɛ́ni bina bati kuuku kɔtu na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo kesii kani nde Egyipte kalɔ.

english_verse: I will force each of you to obey the regulations of our solemn agreement.
translation_verse: Ndubo-mii lɛlɔ bunye kpakplaa na bɛdi ɔda bubo bɔni nkɛnku lɛla kedee lɛni na búnyimi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will separate the sinful rebels from the rest of you, and even though I will bring them from the nations where they live in exile, they won't be allowed to return to Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ndubo bekyuli bekpidi bani mɔɔta teenye bekyuli lɛlɔ bule bɔsiku bina bakladi kudɔ. Nsu ina ka ndubo-ma bɔkpanku bɔsiku kesii kani na bákpanku-mii bésienku aani bekyuli beƒiedi kalɛ muedi ni, lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na beduo Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na mmɔ na bɛdubo-mi bɔnu bɔti ka ami ndi Unwoti.

english_verse: Go ahead and worship your idols for now, you Israelites, because soon I will no longer let you dishonor me by offering gifts to them. You will have no choice but to obey me!
translation_verse: “Amii Israelƒuɔ bɛsɔ binye bina baƒiɔ bɔkpa lɛlɔ kani, ɔsika lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na binye biteedie-mi lɛlɔ ɔbu na biteeti etela teete baƒiɔ bammɔ lɛni, ɔsika biiibo lɛla bamba lɛdi na bɛƒuna bite lɛlɔ utulo ka binu-mi litemi!

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone in Israel will worship me on Mount Zion, my holy mountain in Jerusalem. I will once again call you my own, and I will accept your sacred offerings and sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na si limeyi lɛmmɔ lídu ni, ukyuli biala na Israel ɔdubo-mi bɔkpa na Sion Kɔbi kedee kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na Yerusalem. Na ndubɔsɔ lɛlɔ-mii mina kadi bekyuli na ndubɔƒɔ bina akpala ku etela ani ndubɔbla kedee mmɔ.

english_verse: When I bring you home from the places where you are now scattered, I will be pleased with you, just as I am pleased with the smell of the smoke from your sacrifices. Every nation on earth will see that I am holy,
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na ndubo-mii bɔkpanku bɔsiku kesii kani na bígyingya bɛkya liboku ɔma ni, bina ala adubɔda-mi kubiti na bina ala ani na bɛdubo bɔkyula bute-mi ɔnyi lɛnɔ ɔdubɔbla-mi ƒɛƒɛɛ. Na kadi biala bekyuli badubɔnu ka nsi kedee.

english_verse: and you will know that I, the Lord, am the one who brought you back to Israel, the land I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Amii lɛnɔ bɛdubo bɔnu bɔti ka ami ndi Unwoti ɔni nákpanku-mii úboku Israel ɔmii ɔni kenye na lɛ́su bina bati kuuku líse.

english_verse: Then you will remember your wicked sins, and you will hate yourselves for doing such horrible things. They have made you unacceptable to me,
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bɛdubo bina alaekpidi ku kalala kani na bɛ́bla bunyimo na bina lɛlɔ lɛdubo-mii lɛlɔ buse na kɔbɔ ala ani na bɛ́bla na aladia bɔnu munu munu ɔsu. Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bítamanku ka lɛƒɔ-mii,

english_verse: so you deserve to be punished. But I will treat you in a way that will bring honor to my name, and you will know that I am the Lord God. Fire from the South
translation_verse: anwuɔsu na bɛ́manku kɔtu bɔni. Nsu ndubo-mii buti bɔsiaku ulu ɔdi lɛlɔ kalɛ na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bekyuli beti ɔbu bete-mi. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔya na bɛti ka ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti.” Katɔti Ɔdubɔya Na Ogya Ubebile Ala

english_verse: The Lord said,
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: “Ezekiel, son of man, turn toward the south and warn the forests
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, nwini anumi tina kada kakɛ na ete aku ani nwi mmɔ bɔti kpakplaa

english_verse: that I, the Lord God, will start a fire that will burn up every tree, whether green or dry. Nothing will be able to put out the blaze of that fire as it spreads to the north and burns everything in its path.
translation_verse: anii ami Unwoti Katɔti ndubo ogya ɔdi bɔtu bɔkya lɛku lɛmmɔ na ɔkyula kugyii kɔwɔdi ku kɔkwiidi biala. Na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛdubo ogya ɔmmɔ bɔkana bunine. Na ɔdubo bɔkywi busie katɔ kakɛ na ɔkyula lɛla biala na kesii kani na ɔ́sia úsela mmɔ.

english_verse: Everyone will know that I started it, and that it cannot be stopped.”
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔdubo bɔnu bɔti ka ami náya na ogya ɔmmɔ ɔɔda lɛni na ɔdi biala ulakana-nwu kenye bukulo.”

english_verse: But I complained, “Lord God, I don't want to do that! People already say I confuse them with my messages.”
translation_verse: Nsu lɛ́kya unyeƒi na lɛ́su nnini, “Unwoti Katɔti, naaayɔ ka lɛbla lɛla lɛmmɔ udu! Bekyuli ƒui baasu ɔ́si kukuuku banii muuƒú-ma taakya ku mina linyesia lɛni na muuti teeboku-ma.”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the places in Jerusalem where people worship. Warn everyone in Israel
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, tɛmiku Israelƒuɔ ƒui kpakplaa na adu-ma kukpi kɔtɔ ka ekpo ani ƒui na bekyuli baakpá na Yerusalem kátamanku.

english_verse: that I am about to punish them. I will pull out my sword and have it ready to kill everyone, whether good or evil.
translation_verse: Na ndubo-ma kɔtu bɔni. Ndubo mina kewii bɔni bɔkpa na lɛdu ukyuli biala babuni ku bekpidi ƒui.

english_verse: From south to north, people will die,
translation_verse: Na bekyuli badubo bukpi bɔsi kada kakɛ butédu katɔ kakɛ

english_verse: knowing that my sword will never be put away.
translation_verse: na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-ka bɔsɔku bɔkya livuo kemmo.

english_verse: Ezekiel, groan in sorrow and despair so that everyone can hear you.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, teedumo ku kɔnyana geen na bekyuli ƒui benu-ɔ kɔku.

english_verse: When they ask why you are groaning, tell them you have terrifying news that will make them faint and tremble in fear and lose all courage. These things will happen soon. I, the Lord God, make this promise! A Sword Is Ready To Attack Israel
translation_verse: Na si béye-ɔ lɛla lɛni ɔsu na eedumo lɛni ni, su-ma anii énu kenye kekpidi kani mɔɔda liƒu geen na kadubɔya na ukyuli biala nénu-ka ɔtɔtɔ ɔgyu-nwu na utaatɔ ku liƒu kpakpaakpa. Na uwi ɔsɔ uletu asa na ala amɛni adubo bɔlɛ. Ami Unwoti muusé kenye kamɛni!” Bádɔ Kewii Kadi Bése Ka Badu Israelƒuɔ

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Jerusalem: I have sharpened my sword to slaughter you; it is shiny and will flash like lightning! Don't celebrate— punishment is coming, because everyone has ignored my warnings.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, ya na Yerusalemƒuɔ bati anini, ‘Lɛ́ɛdɔ mina kewii kani na ndubo buti bɔdu-mii líse kese yayaaya na keekeye na kadubo-ma akɔ bɔvi aani kalɛ ka katɔ kaabwɛ ogya! Kɔtu bɔni ndubo, anwuɔsu bɛsɔ bitadi limeyi lɛdi, ɔsika bina akɔ ɔdi biala úni mina bɔlɛ.

english_verse: My sword has been polished; it's sharp and ready to kill.
translation_verse: Bésusu mina kewii nnɔmii kaduɛ na kebo ɔbi na kenye kagyumana lɛnɔ ka uwi ubugya kalɔ.

english_verse: Groan in sorrow, Ezekiel; the sword is drawn against my people and their leaders. They will die! So give up all hope.
translation_verse: Esekiel, teedumo ku kɔnyana momoomo, ɔsika báani kewii kammɔ bákpa béte mina kadi bekyuli ku bana batɔnkune bammɔ bɔdu. Na badubo bukpi sɔsɔ, anwuɔsu sɔ tasia lɛla lɛdi anu.

english_verse: I am testing my people, and they can do nothing to stop me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “ ‘Nnye mɔɔkɔ́ku mina bekyuli taanu na baaadubo lɛla lɛdi bɔkana bɔbla na babala-mi. Ami Unwoti násu.’

english_verse: Ezekiel, warn my people, then celebrate my victory by clapping your hands. My vicious sword will attack again and again, killing my people with every stroke.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, tɛmiku mina bekyuli kpakplaa na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-ɔ na agya enukpɛ ka lɛ́di lɛlɔ ɔsu. Mina kewii kani muubile ala kadubo bekyuli bɔdu buwi kalɔ bɔsia kama kalɛ kani na mɔɔmɛnɛ na kayaa mmɔ.

english_verse: They will lose all courage and stumble with fear. My slaughtering sword is waiting at every gate, flashing and ready to kill.
translation_verse: Ɔtɔtɔ ƒui ɔdubo-ma bɔgyu na beteebuli ku liƒu bonwu. Na mina kewii kadubo bunye butaakywɛɛ-ma na ɔban kayakun biala kenye. Na kadubo ogya buteedie na kenye kagyumana ka kadu bekyuli.

english_verse: It will slash right and left, wherever the blade is pointed.
translation_verse: Kadubo butaamɛnɛ teesie kɔmii ku kɔdianu na kesii kani na ɔ́tina.

english_verse: Then I will stop being angry, and I will clap my hands in victory. I, the Lord, have spoken. The King of Babylonia and His Sword
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama mina kɔnyi kɔdubɔyɔ-mi na lɛgya enukpɛ ka lɛ́di lɛlɔ. Ami Unwoti násu.” Babilon Ɔga Ɔdanku Nwuna Kewii

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, mark two roads for the king of Babylonia to follow when he comes with his sword. The roads will begin at the same place, but be sure to put up a signpost where the two roads separate and go in different directions.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, die kuƒi siaku lilu inyɔ lɛlɔ na atina Babilon Ɔga kesii kani na ɔdubo bɔsia si úbeduo ku nwuna kewii. Na lilu lɛmmɔ lise kalɔ lɛsi likpo linwi, nsu sia anumi na alɛ likpose kɔlɛkɛ na kesii kani na lilu lɛmmɔ líle lɛlɔ lɛ́tina lɛƒɛnyi bamba.

english_verse: Clearly mark where the two roads lead. One goes to Rabbah, the capital of Ammon, and the other goes to Jerusalem, the fortified capital of Judah.
translation_verse: Na atina-nwu nwaa kesii kani na lilu lɛmmɔ líti lísela. Unwi úsela Raba ɔni ndi Amon kalɛkɛ ɔma unengudi. Na unyɔdi úsela Yerusalem, Yudaƒuɔ ɔma unengudi ɔni na bátu kɔgyumanakɔ bámana.

english_verse: When the Babylonian king stands at that signpost, he will decide which way to go by shaking his arrows, by asking his idols, and by carefully looking at the liver of a sacrificed animal.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na Babilonƒuɔ ɔga úbedu mmɔ ni, anwu ɔlati ɔdubɔlɛ ugyii kesii kani na ɔdubo bɔsia si ɔ́kunku nwuna atula iye unye ɔ́nu ebuo ɔni na bádu bákpa bete bana baƒiɔ ɔni ndi ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na baasia teebo like teeye bana baƒiɔ ala teenu.

english_verse: His right hand will pull out the arrow marked “Jerusalem.” Then he will immediately give the signal to shout the battle cry, to build dirt ramps up to the top of the city walls, to break down its walls and gates with large wooden poles, and to kill the people.
translation_verse: Nwuna kɔdianu kɔnu kɔdubo lɛtula lɛni lɛlɔ na bénweni básia banii Yerusalem bɔni bɔlɛku. Na mmɔ ni, ɔdubo kati bute na bavwi kekpo lise na basia ubili bakɔliku ɔma ɔmmɔ awodu etédu ana lili na benye mmɔ babwɛ awodu ammɔ bewi kalɔ ku ɔban kɔyakun kɔmmɔ kɔni na bánwi ku akpa bonwu ani na ebo ɔkplu geen mmɔ na badu bekyuli bammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem had promised to be loyal to Babylonia, and so none of them will believe that this could happen to them. But Babylonia's king will remind them of their sinful ways and warn them of their coming captivity.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala na ɔkya Yerusalem úse kenye ka ɔdubɔdi Babilonƒuɔ ɔga litemi lɛlɔ, anwuɔsu bana ɔdi ɔsɔ ɔɔɔsia lɛnu ka lɛla lɛmɛni udu lɛdubɔlɛku-ma. Nsu Babilon ɔga ɔdubo-ma bunyimene ekpidi bɔbla ngba bɔni na belie na ɔlɛ-ma use kpakplaa kalɛ na badubo-ma buƒie bɔtɔlɔku.

english_verse: Ezekiel, tell the people of Jerusalem and their ruler that I, the Lord God, am saying: Everything you do is wicked and shows how sinful you are. You are guilty and will be taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, su Yerusalemƒuɔ ku bana ɔtɔnkune anii ami Unwoti Katɔti mɔɔsu nnii, ‘Bina ala ani ƒui na bɛɛbla adi kalala ala bɔbla na eedie-mii taatina kalɛ na bibo likyulikpi. Bɛ́ƒiɔ na ɔmmɔ ɔsu na badubo-mii bɔkpanku bɔtɔlɔku aani batɔntɛne.

english_verse: And now, you evil and wicked ruler of Israel, your day of final punishment is almost here.
translation_verse: Na awɔ Israel ɔtɔnkune ni, ƒula ekpidi ku kalala ala bɔbla ɔsu ni, ƒula limeyi líidu lɛ́wɔlɔ ka akɛ ƒula kɔtu bɔni.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, command you to take off your royal turban and your crown, because everything will be different. Those who had no power will be put in charge, and those who now rule will become nobodies.
translation_verse: Ami Unwoti Katɔti muudie lɛdi taakya-a ka edie ƒula ɔyikun lɛduni lɛni nda-a lɛlɔ ku ƒula kagabwa ƒui ese, ɔsika lɛla biala lɛdubo bɔvumana ɔ́si ɔƒɛni. Na bani ƒui na beeebo ɔyikun kenyekɔ kadi kuuku ni, ama ndubo kunyekɔ kɔmmɔ bunye ɔƒaamu. Na bani na nka baadi lɛlɔ mmɔ ni, badubo bekyuli keeke bani lɛlɔ neeebo kɔsia bunwini.

english_verse: I will leave Jerusalem in complete ruins like no one has ever seen until my chosen one comes to punish this city. Judgment against Ammon
translation_verse: Ndubo bɔya na Yerusalem ɔbwɛ unwini atɔnku ɔma uwi ɔni na mina kabla ɔblane ɔni na lɛ́ƒuna ɔdubo bɔda bɔlɛ na ubani ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kɔtu.’ ” Amonƒuɔ Kɔtɔ Bɔdu

english_verse: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, the Ammonites have insulted Israel, so condemn them and tell them I am saying: A sword is drawn, ready to slaughter; it is polished and prepared to kill as fast as lightning.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́nini, “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, Amonƒuɔ bédumi Israelƒuɔ, anwuɔsu du-ma kukpi kɔtɔ na asu-ma anini, ‘Báni kewii bákpa livuo kemmo bada benye ka bewi ubugya kalɔ. Bésusu-ka nnɔmii na keekeye kaduɛ ka kenye kagyumana ka ɔdu bekyuli aani kalɛ na katɔ kaava taayu bekyuli na beekpi.

english_verse: You wicked Ammonites see false visions and believe untrue messages. But your day of punishment is coming soon, and my sword will slaughter you!
translation_verse: Amonƒuɔ balalane, ɔkɔ kɔyu kemmo ala na bɛɛnu na ɔkɔ kenye na bɛɛƒɔ́ taadi. Nsu bina kɔtu bɔni limeyi líide suɛlɛ suɛlɛ na mina kewii kadubo-mii bɔdu ƒui!

english_verse: Your days to punish others are over, so put your swords away. You will be punished in the land of your birth.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na amii mɔɔní bekyuli bamba kɔtu ɔ́vi, anwuɔsu bɛbɛla bina kuwii.

english_verse: My furious anger will scorch you like fire, and I will hand you over to cruel men who are experts in killing.
translation_verse: Mina kɔnyi kpakplaa kɔdubo-mii buƒi aani ogya. Na ndubo-mii buti bɔkya balalane bani na bagyi bekyuli bɔdu kabla kaduɛ enu kemmo.

english_verse: You will be burned and will die in your own land. Then you will be forgotten forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Badubo-mii bɔkyula ƒui na bikpi na amii alati bina kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na bekyuli badubo-mii bɔyiƒala ƒui. Ami Unwoti násu.’ ”

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdi kama ƒui ni, Unwoti ɔ́su ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, are you ready to condemn Jerusalem? That city is filled with murderers, so remind the people of their sins
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, enye kagyumana ka esie atádu Yerusalemƒuɔ kɔtɔ? Bekyuli badune sɔɔn néyi ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo, anwuɔsu tényimene-ma bana likyulikpi ala ani na baabla

english_verse: and tell them I am saying: Jerusalem, you have murdered many of your own people and have worshiped idols. You will soon be punished!
translation_verse: na asu-ma anii ami násu nnini, ‘Yerusalem, awɔ nádu bekyuli pii na ákpa baƒiɔ. Kébu blii na badubo-ɔ kɔtu bɔni!

english_verse: Those crimes have made you guilty, and the idols have made you unacceptable to me. So your final punishment is near. Other nations will laugh at you and make insulting remarks,
translation_verse: Ekpidi ammɔ áya na áƒiɔ baadú-ɔ kɔtɔ. Na baƒiɔ bammɔ lɛnɔ báya na asɔ átamanku ka bada-a bakya-a lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu na ɔlɛka bani-ɔ kɔtu na kawɔlɔkɔ kamɛni. Kadi bamba bekyuli badubo-ɔ bɔma na bataalɔ-ɔ anyikpi.

english_verse: and people far and near will make fun of your misery.
translation_verse: Na ƒula liku bekyuli ku bani nási ɔlɔgyu ƒui badubuti ƒula ɔgbankpi benwini lɛmala na bataama-a.

english_verse: Your own leaders use their power to murder.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bina batɔnkune béti bana kenyekɔ ɔyikun ɔni na bebo baadú bekyuli.

english_verse: None of you honor your parents, and you cheat foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Bina akɔ ɔdi biala ulabu nwuna bawɔne. Na bɛɛnya bekyuli bani ndi baƒɔ lɛnɔ taakyaku bekpinebi ku bekpinele.

english_verse: You show no respect for my sacred places and treat the Sabbath just like any other day.
translation_verse: Na kesii kani bene na nka bédie bése sɛsɛɛ ka use kedee ute-mi ni, biládi mmɔ lɛlɔ lɛni. Na mina Lɛnwunameyi lɛnɔ bɛɛbla-ni aani limeyi keeke bamba biala kalɛ.

english_verse: Some of your own people tell lies, so that others will be put to death. Some of you eat meat sacrificed to idols at local shrines, and others never stop doing vulgar things.
translation_verse: Bina badi baanyi ɔkɔ taada bana bakpana kenye kalɛ na badu-ma. Na badi lɛnɔ baakun lɛna lɛni na béti bákpa béte baƒiɔ na aƒiodu lidu lidu. Na badi lɛnɔ bana ɔlɔna ɔkwɛ adala ekpidi kama kani na basia baabla ƒui.

english_verse: Men have sex with their father's wife or with women who are having their monthly period
translation_verse: Na badi baatɛnku bana bati ku beleku bani náƒɛ kɔnu.

english_verse: or with someone else's wife. Some men even sleep with their own daughter-in-law or half sister.
translation_verse: Na baatɛnku bana bakpana beleku na bani lɛnɔ baatɛnku bebi bele iye batibi muedi.

english_verse: Others of you accept money to murder someone. Your own people charge high interest when making a loan to other Israelites, and they get rich by cheating. Worst of all, you have forgotten me, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Bina badi bɛɛƒɔ́ egulabi ka bɛdu ukyuli. Na biivó egulabi teete bina Israelƒuɔ banwani taaƒɔ́ kuvonsia bonwu na bɛɛsia ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ taawia lɛkɛ teese lɛlɔ. Na ɔni nébie utulo ƒui ndi ka bɛ́yiƒala ami Unwoti Katɔti.

english_verse: When I'm finished with you, your courage will disappear, and you will be so weak that you won't be able to lift your hands. I, the Lord, have spoken and will not change my mind.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na lɛ́wɔlɔ lɛla lɛni na mɔɔyɔ́ lɛbla ni, bina ɔtɔtɔ ɔni na bibo ƒui ɔdubɔyii ɔkya na bɛbla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ɔni na kɔnu muedi bɛsɔ bilakana-ku katɔ bɔkɔliku. Ami Unwoti násu na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo lɛla lɛdi bɔvumana.

english_verse: I will scatter you throughout every nation on earth and put a stop to your sinful ways.
translation_verse: Ndubo-mii bugyingya bɔkya kadi bamba bekyuli kɔlɔ ƒui lɛlɔ na kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni, lɛya na bɛda bina alaekpidi bɔbla ngba bɔni udu na bilie mmɔ bɛya.

english_verse: You will be humiliated in the eyes of other nations. Then you will know that I, the Lord God, have done these things. Jerusalem Must Be Purified
translation_verse: Bɛdubo udu bɔyii ƒui na bekyuli anumi. Na bɛdubɔnu bɔti ka ami Unwoti Katɔti nábla lɛla lɛmmɔ.’ ” Ndubo Likpidi Biala Budie Yerusalem Lɛlɔ Na Ɔbla Sɛɛn

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I consider the people of Israel as worthless as the leftover metal in a furnace after silver has been purified.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, mɔɔnu Israelƒuɔ aani bekyuli bani lɛlɔ neeebo kɔsia kɔdi aani abuala ekuku ani muubú teewi lɛyu kemmo si uwi ɔni bákya sika ɔƒualadi ogya kemmo na báƒɔ-nwu báwɔlɔ.

english_verse: So I am going to bring them together in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubo-ma bɔkpanku bubasala na Yerusalem.

english_verse: I will be like a metalworker who collects that metal from the furnace and melts it down. I will collect the Israelites and blow on them with my fiery anger. They will melt inside the city of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Na ndubɔbla aani abuala lɛlɔ kabla ɔblane ɔni mɔɔla abuala ekuku ani na lɛyu kemmo na ntánwamana abuala ammɔ lise. Ndubo Israelƒuɔ bɔsala na liti mina kɔnyi kɔni nse aani ogya lɛnwamana-ma. Na badubo bɔyɛɛlɛ ƒui bewi kalɔ na Yerusalem ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo

english_verse: like silver in a furnace. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have punished them in my anger. Everyone in Jerusalem Is Guilty
translation_verse: aani sika ɔƒualadi na lɛyu kemmo. Na badubɔti ka ami Unwoti náni-ma kɔtu lɛni na mina kɔnyi kemmo.” Ukyuli Biala Na Yerusalem Ɔ́ƒiɔ

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that their country is full of sin, and that I, the Lord, am furious!
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, su Israelƒuɔ anii ekpidi bɔbla búyi bana kalɛ kemodi kammɔ, anwuɔsu ami Unwoti líti kɔnyi lɛ́kya-ma geen!

english_verse: Their leaders are like roaring lions, tearing apart their victims. They put people to death, then steal everything of value. Husbands are killed, and many women are left as widows.
translation_verse: Bana batɔnkune bese aani bagyata bani mɔɔkwanyi na baaduli ebuo ɔni béƒie teegyingya kɔkɛ kɔkɛ. Baadú bekyuli. Na beeyú ala ani na bánu ka áƒɔ kuye na bekyuli kudɔ. Na baadu beleku bagya na bana beleku baaƒɔ́ lɛlɔ teelie aani bekpinele.

english_verse: The priests of Israel ignore my Law! Not only do they refuse to respect any of my sacred things, but they don't even teach the difference between what is sacred and what is ordinary or between what is clean and what is unclean. They treat my Sabbath like any other day, and so my own people no longer honor me.
translation_verse: “Israel bakpane bédie mina ɔda bubo atu! Na ɔɔɔdi buni kani na béni na balábu mina ala ani na ese kedee mmomu béni na balátina bekyuli bammɔ kavumana kani na kakya ala ani na ese kedee mmɔ ku ala keeke ntɛ iye ala ani nse sɛɛn ku ani neeese sɛɛn ntɛ. Na baabla mina Lɛnwunameyi kalɛ kalɛ aani limeyi keeke biala kalɛ kani na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ ɔsu mina kadi bekyuli basɔ balabu-mi.

english_verse: Israel's officials are like ferocious wolves, ripping their victims apart. They make a dishonest living by injuring and killing people.
translation_verse: “Israel kadi benengu bese aani beƒukutu bani anumi négyie na ebuo ɔni na beƒie lɛlɔ na baaduli-nwu teegyingya si báda-nwu. Na beelie ngba ngba bukpidi taakya bekyuli ɔlɛ na baadú-ma.

english_verse: And then the prophets in Israel cover up these sins by giving false visions. I have never spoken to them, but they lie and say they have a message from me.
translation_verse: “Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, Israelƒuɔ kenye bediene lɛnɔ beeti ala teebi bekyuli bamɛni ekpidi ani na bábla mɛni. Na baasu ɔkɔ ala ani na banii ami násu-ma.

english_verse: The people themselves cheat and rob; they abuse the poor and take advantage of foreigners.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bammɔ beeyu ama alati bana lɛlɔ na baanya bekyuli taakya. Na beedumi bawabane na baanya bawabane ku baƒɔ taakya taakɛ-ma lɛlɔ kɔsia.

english_verse: I looked for someone to defend the city and to protect it from my anger, as well as to stop me from destroying it. But I found no one.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́sia anu nnii makɛ ukyuli ɔni medie ɔma unengudi ɔmɛni na ɔgyumana-nwu kalɛ na naaakyula-nwu na mina kɔnyi ɔsu. Nsu ńtakɛ ukyuli ɔdi.

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish the Israelites for what they have done, and they will know that I am furious. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu líti kɔnyi kpakplaa lɛ́kya Israelƒuɔ na ala ani na bábla ɔsu na ndubo-ma kɔtu bɔni geen na bati ka livo geen muuƒí-mi. Ami Unwoti násu.”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, listen to this story about two sisters.
translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, se atu na enu banwani beleku inyɔ badi lɛlɔ litemi.

english_verse: While they were young and living in Egypt, they became prostitutes.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bétedu tɔ begblebi na bákya Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, bénwini bayalɛ.

english_verse: The older one was named Oholah, which stands for Samaria; the younger one was Oholibah, which stands for Jerusalem. They became my wives and gave birth to my children.
translation_verse: Unengudi baalɔ Ohola na unye ute Samaria na ɔnamudi baalɔ Oholibama na anwu lɛnɔ unye ute Yerusalem. Beleku inyɔ bamɛni ƒui bébenwini mina beleku na báwɔ bebi béte-mi.

english_verse: Even though Oholah was my wife, she continued to be a prostitute and chased after Assyrian lovers.
translation_verse: “Na ina ka Ohola ɔdi mina uleku muedi ni, ɔmu ɔkya ɔɔdi kɔsɔnɔ taabla nwuna lɛyalɛ ala. Na ɔkɛ ɔsiaku nwuna Asiriaƒuɔ basɔnɔ kama.

english_verse: She had sex with all the important Assyrian officials and even worshiped their disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Ɔ́tɛ bekpone bani náƒɔ lɛnyi mmɔ ƒui kudɔ na ɔsia ɔɔkpá bana baƒiɔ bani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Once she started doing these things in Egypt, she never stopped. Men slept with her, and she was always ready for sex.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si ɔni kani na úse lɛla lɛmɛni kalɔ na Egyipte ni, anwu kani na ɔmu unye-nwu lɛlɔ mɛni na útada útaya tɔ kudii. Banana bátɛnku-nwu kalɛ kalɛ, nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui útedu-nwu ɔkwɛ na ɔmu unye ɔɔnu ulu teete bamamba uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: So I gave Oholah to the Assyrian lovers she wanted so badly.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu lídie Ohola atu líte nwuna Asiriaƒuɔ bayɔne bani na ɔɔyɔ́ geen mmɔ.

english_verse: They ripped off her clothes, then captured her children and killed her. Women everywhere talked about what had happened to Oholah.
translation_verse: Na bédie-nwu lɛlɔ ala na béƒie-nwu bebi na bádu anwu ɔlati. Na beleku bani nkya kesii biala bátɛmi Ohola lɛlɔ ala ani nálɛ mɛni.

english_verse: Oholibah saw all this, but she was more sinful and wanted sex more than her sister Oholah ever did.
translation_verse: “Oholiba ɔ́nu ala amɛni ƒui, nsu ɔƒɛni mmomu na nwuna ekpidi bɔbla bɔ́kɔ katɔ búbu na banana kudɔ bɔtɛ bɔɔda-nwu ɔkwɛ teetulo ɔnwani Ohola ɔdi ɔni na ɔ́bla muedi ƒui.

english_verse: Just like her sister, she did vulgar things.
translation_verse: Na alaekpidi bonwu bonwu ani udu na ɔnwani ɔ́bla kani lɛlɔ na anwu lɛnɔ unye.

english_verse: But Oholibah behaved worse than her sister. Oholibah saw images of Babylonian men carved into walls and painted red.

translation_verse: “Esekiel, ɔyawine ubi, du Amonƒuɔ kɔtɔ

translation_verse: na asu-ma anini, ‘Lɛlɔ lɛ́yɔ-mii na bɛ́kɛ ebiti uwi ɔni na bábwɛ mina kakpakɔ ku uwi na bádi Israelƒuɔ lɛlɔ na béti-ma bátɔlɔku aani bekyuli beƒiedi kalɛ.

english_verse: Now I am going to let you be conquered by tribes from the eastern desert. They will set up their camps in your land and eat your fruit and drink your milk.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔƒɛni ni, ndubo bɔya na adua bamba bekyuli bani nási ɔƒɛ katukɔ kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo bebo na badi-mii lɛlɔ. Na badubɔbla kuliekɔ na bina kalɔ kemmo na badi bina egyiibi na bani bina bebuo anyi ntu.

english_verse: Your capital city of Rabbah will be nothing but pastureland for camels, and the rest of the country will be pastures for sheep. Then you will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Bina Rama ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ ni, ɔdubo udu bɔyii na livo sɔɔn ndubo mmɔ bɔkwɛ bunwini bebuo ala betine adila kadikɔ. Na kalɔ kakladi ƒui kenwini baƒonu adila kadikɔ. Na bɛdubo bɔnu bɔti ka ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti.

english_verse: You hated Israel so much that you clapped and shouted and celebrated.
translation_verse: Biikisi Israelƒuɔ ɔni ɔsu na enukpɛ kani na bɛ́gya na bɛ́va ku lɛlɔyɔ na lɛla lɛni nálɛku-ma ɔsu.

english_verse: And so I will hand you over to enemies who will rob you. I will completely destroy you. There won't be enough of your people left to be a nation ever again, and you will know that I, the Lord, have done these things. Judgment on Moab
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubo-mii buti bute bina bekisine bani ndubo-mii ala ƒui buƒie bɔƒɔ na bayila-mii udu ƒui. Na bina kadi bekyuli badubɔsa ɔni na bɛsɔ bɛɛɛdubo lɛla lɛdi budu na balɔ-mii banii kadi. Na bɛdubɔti ka ami Unwoti nábla ɔmɛni.’ ” Unwoti Ɔ́tɛku Moab Litemi

english_verse: The Lord God said, “The people of Moab thought Judah was no different from any other nation.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Moab kadi bekyuli bákali ka Yudaƒuɔ bátavumana ku kadi bamba bekyuli.

english_verse: So I will let Moab's fortress towns along its border be attacked, including Beth-Jeshimoth, Baal-Meon, and Kiriathaim.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubɔya na bekpo Moabƒuɔ lɛma lɛni na nnye ɔmii lɛlɔ na bátu kɔgyumanakɔ bámana ƒui úbunku Bet Yesimot ku Baal-Meon ku Kiriataim.

english_verse: The same eastern desert tribes that invade Ammon will invade Moab, and just as Ammon will be forgotten forever,
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛ katukɔ kalɔ kakwiidi kani bekyuli nékpo Amonƒuɔ ni, ama kani ndubo amii Moabƒuɔ lɛnɔ bukpo. Na bayiƒala amii lɛlɔ kede kede ƒui aani kalɛ na bekyuli báyiƒala Amonƒuɔ.

english_verse: Moab will be punished. Then the people there will know that I am the Lord.” Judgment on Edom
translation_verse: Ndubɔya na bani Moabƒuɔ kɔtu geen na bekyuli bani nkya mmɔ bati ka ami ndi Unwoti.” Unwoti Ɔ́tɛku Edomƒuɔ Litemi

english_verse: The Lord God then said, “The people of Edom are guilty of taking revenge on Judah.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Edom kadi bekyuli báƒiɔ na bedie Yudaƒuɔ kasi kadi.

english_verse: So I will punish Edom by killing all its people and livestock. It will be an empty wasteland all the way from Teman to Dedan.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubo Edom kɔtu bɔni na lɛdu bana bekyuli ku bebuo ƒui. Na ɔ́si Teman ɔma útédu Dedan ɔmii ɔni nwi mmɔ ƒui kadubɔbla kalɔ kekpludi kani kemmo na lɛla lɛdi lɛsɔ lilakya.

english_verse: I will send my own people to take revenge on the Edomites by making them feel my fierce anger. And when I punish them, they will know that I am the Lord God.” Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Ndubo ami ɔlati mina kadi bekyuli bɔtala bɔkya-ma na betédie-ma kasi kalɛ na Edomƒuɔ banu mina kɔnyi kpakplaa ablala bati na bana akɔ. Na badubɔnu bati ka ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti si lɛ́ni-ma kɔtu lɛni.” Unwoti Ɔ́ni Ƒilistiƒuɔ Kɔtu

english_verse: The Lord God said, “The cruel Philistines have taken revenge on their enemies over and over and have tried to destroy them.
