translation_verse: Na lɛɛɛdubo mina litemi kama bɔlɛ kudii. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔya na ɔnu ami nwuna Unwoti ɔti.

english_verse: I will command the sky to send rain on the earth,
translation_verse: “Ndubɔtuna lite-nwu limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na lɛlɛmi kayaa na kayaa lɛnɔ kenu-mi lɛdi na kete ntu na kalɔ kayɔ.

english_verse: and it will produce grain, grapes, and olives in Jezreel Valley.
translation_verse: Na si Yesreel ɔ́kpali-mi ni, ndubɔya na antabi ku egyiibi lidu adia na ɔkwalɛ ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: I will scatter the seeds and show mercy to Lo-Ruhamah. I will say to Lo-Ammi, “You are my people,” and they will answer, “You are our God.”
translation_verse: Na ndubɔnu-nwu kɔnyana anwu ɔni na nka lɛ́lɔ nnii kɔnyana tanu. Na ama banii na nka nnii baaadi mina badi ni, badubunwini mina badi. Na ama lɛnɔ badubɔsu banii, ‘Awɔ ndi bula Katɔti.’ ”

english_verse: Once again the Lord spoke to me. And this time he said, “Hosea, fall in love with an unfaithful woman who has a lover. Do this to show that I love the people of Israel, even though they worship idols and enjoy the offering cakes made with fruit.”
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́tɛmiku-mi uwi bamba. Na uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ni, bɔsu na ɔ́su-mi ndi ɔnii, “Hosea, ya na ƒula bɔyɔ bɔsɔ bunwini butásia uleku ɔni nálɛ-ɔ kama lɛlɔ, na úudie ɔsɔnɔ ɔni ndi-nwu ɔyɔne. Bla ɔmɛni na eti atina ka mɔɔyɔ́ Israel kadi bekyuli, ina ka bakya baakpá baƒiɔ na adila ani na bábla béte-ma ku egyiibi mmɔ aada-ma ebiti.”

english_verse: Then I said, “Now you are mine! You will have to remain faithful to me, though it will be a long time before we sleep together.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama lɛ́su-nwu nnini, “Ɔƒaani énwini ami ɔdi. Na ɔlɛka asia lɛlɔ anu na asɔ alálɛ-mi kama ina uwi ɔdubo butu asa na ami ku-ɔ bɔtɛ bɔsala.”

english_verse: It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na uwi ɔdubo butu asa na Israel kadi bekyuli basɔ bakɛ ɔga iye asa na basɔ babla akpala na Katɔti kakpakɔ iye Katɔti ɔtina-ma ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na basia babla lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.
translation_verse: Nsu kama ƒui ni, Israel ɔdubɔsɔ unwini usie nwuna Unwoti Katɔti ku nwuna Ɔga Dawid kudɔ. Badubusie Unwoti kudɔ ku bɔyia ku ɔbu. Na emeyi ekplodi ammɔ kemmo ni, badubɔnu nwuna lɛƒɔndia.

english_verse: Israel, listen as the Lord accuses everyone in the land! No one is faithful or loyal or truly cares about God.
translation_verse: Bise atu na binu kɔtɔ kɔni na Unwoti Katɔti ɔɔdú amii Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui! Unwoti uudie bina ƒui bɔƒiɔ na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ka ɔdi uládi-nwu litemi lɛlɔ siin na bɛɛɛdaku-nwu lɛda lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Cursing, dishonesty, murder, robbery, unfaithfulness— these happen all the time. Violence is everywhere.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ buwida ku ɔkɔ bɔnyi ku bekyuli bɔdu ku kuyu ku lɛsɔnɔdi lɛlɔ kani na binye uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: And so your land is a desert. Every living creature is dying— people and wild animals, birds and fish. The Lord Warns the Priests
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bina kalɔ ƒui kénwini ketele kalɔ kakwiidi na káyii udu, na bekyuli ku bebuo ku baasɛ bani nkya-ka kemmo ƒui lɛnɔ beekpi.

english_verse: Don't accuse just anyone! Not everyone is at fault. My case is against you, the priests.
translation_verse: “Nsu ni, bitadu ukyuli ndi ukyuli kɔtɔ, ɔsika ɔɔɔdi bana ƒui náƒiɔ. Amii bakpane bammɔ na mɔɔdú kɔtɔ.

english_verse: You and the prophets will stumble day and night; I'll silence your mothers.
translation_verse: Na amii ku kenye bediene bammɔ ƒui bɛdubo butaabla gyuma gyuma usien ku ɔƒɛ. Na ndubo bina beni udu bɔyila.

english_verse: You priests have rejected me, and my people are destroyed by refusing to obey. Now I'll reject you and forget your children, because you have forgotten my Law.
translation_verse: Amii bani na bɛdi bakpane bíni-mi, na mina bekyuli baayii udu ka béni mina ɔda bubo ɔsu. “Na ɔƒaani ni, ami lɛnɔ ndubo-mii buni na lɛyiƒala bina bebi ɔsika amii bɛ́yiƒala mina ɔda bubo.

english_verse: By adding more of you priests, you multiply the number of people who sin. Now I'll change your pride into shame.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na biimomo teebu ni, lɛni kani na bina alaekpidi lɛnɔ eemomo teebu. Na kenyekɔ ku ɔbu ɔni na bibo ni, bɛ́vumana-nwu bíte kɔƒa ala bɔbla.

english_verse: You encourage others to sin, so you can stuff yourselves on their sin offerings.
translation_verse: Na likpidi lili buvele akpala ani na mina bekyuli baabla lɛlɔ na amii bɛɛsia teenwini balakɛne, anwuɔsu na bɛɛkya-ma ogya ka bataabla-nya teebu.

english_verse: That's why I will punish the people for their deeds, just as I will punish you priests.
translation_verse: Na lɛlakpa linwi ndubɔlɛku bakpane ku bekyuli bammɔ ƒui, ɔsika ndubɔni bana ƒui kɔtu na bana ablala ɔsu, na lɛƒɔ-ma kayu kani námanku ala ani na bábla kenye.

english_verse: Their food won't satisfy, and having sex at pagan shrines won't produce children. My people have rebelled
translation_verse: “Badubo bɔdi bɔsia kama, nsu baaadubo bumo. Na basiaku lɛsɔnɔdi kama, nsu baaadubo bebi bɔwɔ na bemomo. Ɔsika béni Unwoti na basiaku ala bamba kama. Katɔti Ukisi Na Úni Lɛƒiɔkpa

english_verse: and have been unfaithful to me, their Lord. God Condemns Israel's Idolatry My people, you are foolish because of too much pleasure and too much wine.
translation_verse: “Ntɛ bɔnani ku bɔwɔdi bɔ́ya na mina bekyuli kasusu kékpi-ma na basɔ belenu lɛla lɛdi kalɔ!

english_verse: You expect wooden idols and other objects of wood to give you advice. Lusting for sex at pagan shrines has made you unfaithful to me, your God.
translation_verse: Na bakɛ beebó like na egyiiku kudɔ ka bati lɛla lɛni na babla! Na egyiiku ammɔ lɛnɔ aasu-ma lɛla lɛni na baawia bati! Bányonu-mi aani uleku ɔni nányonu ɔnana na únwini ɔyalɛ, na bakɛ basiaku ala bamba kama.

english_verse: You offer sacrifices on mountaintops and hills, under oak trees, and wherever good shade is found. Your own daughters and daughters-in-law sell themselves for sex.
translation_verse: Bakɛ abi eli baabla akpala na beeti etela teesienku abi eli mmɔ na egyii enengudi lidu ƒui kalɔ, kesii kani na ɔyuli ɔkya kaduɛ na ɔdia bulie na egyii ammɔ kɔgba ku evete ɔsu. Anwuɔsu na bina bebi belekubi bénwini bayalɛ, na bina bebi bele bénwini basɔnɔdine.

english_verse: But I won't punish them. You men are to blame, because you go to prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them at pagan shrines. Your own foolishness will lead to your ruin.
translation_verse: “Na lɛɛɛdubo-ma kɔtu bɔni na ɔmɛni ɔsu, ɔsika amii alati kakpakɔ bayalɛ bɔmmɔ kama na bɛsia, na amii ku-ma bɛɛsála taabla akpala teete baƒiɔ. Na ɔmmɔ geen na lɛsugba lɛmɛni lɛɛtina lɛnini, ‘Bɔyii na bekyuli bani na beeebo kasusu badubo bɔyii ku udu.’

english_verse: Israel, you are unfaithful, but don't lead Judah to sin. Stop worshiping at Gilgal or at sinful Bethel. And quit making promises in my name—the name of the living Lord.
translation_verse: “Israel, ina ka aadi kɔsɔnɔ ni, taya na Yuda ɔbla likpidi. “Na teduo Gilgal ɔma kemmo iye esie Bet Awen lɛnɔ na enye mmɔ ese kenye kadi na Unwoti ɔni nli ngba uwi ƒui lɛnyi kemmo!

english_verse: You are nothing more than a stubborn cow— so stubborn that I, the Lord, cannot feed you like lambs in an open pasture.
translation_verse: Israelƒuɔ atu ebo ɔkplu aani ebuo ala utine ɔni mbo atuɔkplu na ulenu lɛla lɛdi kalɔ. Dɛ na Unwoti ɔdubɔkana bekyuli bamɛni adila buteete aani baƒonubi na kesii kani na livo lɛbuni lɛkya na bataakun?

english_verse: You people of Israel are charmed by idols. Leave those people alone!
translation_verse: Eƒraim kaba kemmo bekyuli bamɛni béti lɛlɔ bátámana lɛƒiɔkpa, anwuɔsu bɛnyonu bana keyi bite-ma!

english_verse: And so you will be swept away in a whirlwind for sacrificing to idols.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔni mɔɔkya ligede ɔdubo ubékpo na ɔkpala-ma ku bana akpala ƒui ɔtɔlɔku, na akpala ammɔ eti kɔƒa kuboku-ma lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Listen, you priests! Pay attention, Israel! Listen, you members of the royal family. Justice was your duty. But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor you trapped the people.
translation_verse: “Amii bakpane binu! Amii bani ndi Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui bibimi atu na binu! Amii bani na bɛ́si ɔga kesii! Ami mɔɔtɛ litemi lɛmɛni lɛdu kɔtɔ. Bínwini kakpagyuɛ bíte Mispa ɔma bekyuli na lɛni kani na bise na Tabor Kɔbi lili.

english_verse: At the place of worship you were a treacherous pit, and I will punish you.
translation_verse: Na bina ekpidi áya na Sitim ɔma únwini ubu gbion, nsu ndubo-mii kɔtu bɔni ƒui kede kede.

english_verse: Israel, I know all about you, and because of your unfaithfulness, I find you unacceptable.
translation_verse: Ngyi Eƒraim kaba bekyuli bani ndi Israelƒuɔ ablala ƒui kede kede, na ɔdi útabɛ-mi. Ɔƒaani bénwini basɔnɔdine na baabla lɛyalɛ ala, na bébile lɛlɔ, na beesé lɛlɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Your evil deeds are the reason you won't return to me, your Lord God. And your constant craving for sex keeps you from knowing me.
translation_verse: “Na bana ekpidi áya na basɔ balakana na benwini bebo ami bana Katɔti kudɔ, ɔsika lɛsɔnɔdi kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui, na baaagyi ami bana Unwoti.

english_verse: You offer sheep and cattle as sacrifices to me, but I have turned away and refuse to be found.
translation_verse: Na badubuti bana bebuo lidu lidu bada na babawia ami bana Katɔti ulu, nsu balanu-mi, ɔsika línwini kama lɛ́kya-ma.

english_verse: You have been unfaithful to me, your Lord; you have had children by prostitutes. So at the New Moon Festival, you and your crops will be destroyed. The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Bátadi Unwoti litemi lɛlɔ, na bátáwɔ basɔnɔbi béyile kɔduli. Anwuɔsu kɔbuli kɔwɔdi limeyi kadikɔ na ama ku bana mmo ƒui bɔdubo udu bɔyii kede kede ƒui. Yuda Ku Israel Badubukpoku Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!
translation_verse: “Vwi kakpɛɛ na alɛ-ma kpakplaa ete-ma bɔti na benu kekpo kɔku na Gibea kalɔ lɛlɔ ku Rama ku Betel kesii kani na likpidi bɔbla bɔ́ƒɔ mmɔ ƒui. Na bibo kudu na Benyamin kadi bekyuli bavi batɔ!

english_verse: I, the Lord, will punish and wipe out Israel. This is my solemn promise to every tribe of Israel.
translation_verse: Ami Unwoti ndubo mbani Israel kɔtu na lɛyila-ma udu ƒui. Na ɔmɛni ɔdi kenye kpakplaa kani na muusé teete Israel adua ammɔ ɔdi biala.

english_verse: Judah's leaders are like crooks who move boundary markers; that's why I will flood them with my anger.
translation_verse: Yudaƒuɔ batɔnkune bese aani bekyuli bani benye baavumana lɛmingyii kɔlɛkɔ uwi biala. Na ndubo kɔnyi buti bɔkya-ma geen.

english_verse: Israel was brutally crushed. They got what they deserved for worshiping useless idols.
translation_verse: Baƒiɔ bani na Israel kadi bekyuli basiaku baakpá nénwini kɔtɔ bɔdu úte-ma, anwuɔsu na ala enye eekpóku-ma na beesusu-ma lɛni uwi biala.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord, will fill Israel with maggots and make Judah rot.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani ni, ami Unwoti ndubɔya na beklubi baƒɔ Israel kadi bekyuli lɛlɔ kemmo na bebun.

english_verse: When Israel and Judah saw their sickness and wounds, Israel asked help from Assyria and its mighty king. But the king cannot cure them or heal their wounds.
translation_verse: “Na uwi ɔni na Israel ku Yuda bekyuli bánu bana ɔlɛ ɔni nda-ma báti ni, békeli bésie Asiria ɔga unengudi kudɔ banii ubunku-ma. Nsu útakana-ma kebunku kadi bute na ɔbwi-ma.

english_verse: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubo-ma lɛlɔ aani gyata ɔni na anumi égyie-nwu geen ku kɔnyi na lɛduli-ma ligyingya kɔkɛ kɔkɛ lɛtɔlɔku. Na ɔdi uuubo na ɔkana-mi lɛla lɛdi buye iye utile-mi kuƒi.

english_verse: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔsɔ linwini ntélie mina keliekɔ wetédu uwi ɔni na ama alati báƒɔ enu ka bábla ekpidi na benwini babawia-mi kama ulu. Na ɔkɛnku bana lɛbibo ɔsu ni, badubunwini kayi na basiaku-mi kpakplaa.”

english_verse: Let's return to the Lord. He has torn us to shreds, but he will bandage our wounds and make us well.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Israel kadi bekyuli bammɔ básu banini, “Bɛya na bɔsɔ bunwini busie Unwoti Katɔti kudɔ. Anwu nébo-bu ɔ́kya ɔlɛ, nsu anwu kani ndubo-bu bɔbwi. Ɔ́ya na bɔ́ƒɔ lɛlɛ, nsu ɔdubo-ni bunyimi bute-bu na likpi ƒui.

english_verse: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.
translation_verse: Ɔdubo bɔya na bɔsɔ bɔta na abu ku-nwu bɔsɔ bulie bɔsala na emeyi anyɔ ku atɛ kama.

english_verse: Let's do our best to know the Lord. His coming is as certain as the morning sun; he will refresh us like rain renewing the earth in the springtime. The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛya na bɔkya ɔkplu biala na bɔnu bula Unwoti bɔti. Nwuna bɔda bɔlɛ bɔdi litemi geen aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛ ɔɔtu ɔtanta na ɔkɔ uuubo-nwu kemmo. Na ɔdubo ubaya na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-bu aani kalɛ na ketudi ɔnantu ɔɔna na kalɔ ku lɛla biala lɛɛyɔ́ buɛɛ.”

english_verse: People of Israel and Judah, what can I do with you? Your love for me disappears more quickly than mist or dew at sunrise.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Amii Israelƒuɔ ku Yudaƒuɔ, bi na bɛnii mblaku-mii? Bina bɔyɔ bɔni na bibo bite-mi ni, buse kani buse aani ulɔyɔ iye ɔtanta amii ani mɔɔyii taakya si ɔƒɛ ɔ́tu na kadi kaata.

english_verse: That's why I slaughtered you with the words of my prophets. That's why my judgments blazed like the dawning sun.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na lɛ́ya na mina kenye bediene béti litemi lɛni muukúlo kayi aani kewii béboku-mii na litemi bɔtɛ bɔni náƒɔ ogya aani ɔƒɛ bɔsia-nwu kama ku kɔtɔ bɔdu.

english_verse: I'd rather for you to be faithful and to know me than to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Kɔnyana bɔnu na mɔɔwia, na ɔɔɔdi bebuo buti taakpa. Na bekyuli banu-mi bati utulo bebuo buti taakpa.

english_verse: At a place named Adam, you betrayed me by breaking our agreement.
translation_verse: “Nsu aani Adam ni, bíbile mina bunyimi bɔni na línyimiku-mii. Na bítadi mina litemi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.
translation_verse: Na Gilead kalɔ kemmo ni, alaekpidi bonwu bablane ku bekyuli badune báƒɔ-ka tɛtɛɛtɛ. Na bekyuli bani na bɛ́du mmɔ ubugya ɔ́ƒɔ-mii enu ƒui.

english_verse: You priests are like a gang of robbers in ambush. On the road to Shechem you murder and commit other horrible crimes.
translation_verse: Bina bakpane bénwini beyune kasala na batɛ kuludɔ baatú bekyuli. Bádu bekyuli na Sekem ulu lɛlɔ na baabla alaekpidi lidu bamba lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́nu lɛla likpidi lɛdi geen na Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ ka bɛ́lɛ-mi kama bɛsiaku ala bamba bɛɛkpá-nya na biisé lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu na bítamanku ka bɛkpa-mi.

english_verse: People of Judah, your time is coming too. The Lord Wants To Help Israel I, the Lord, would like to make my nation prosper again
translation_verse: “Na amii Yudaƒuɔ lɛnɔ ni, bina limeyi lɛsia ulu lɛdubo ɔni na ndubo-mii kɔtu bɔni. Na mɔɔwia ka lɛsɔku mina kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ mbenyene bana kenyekɔ.”

english_verse: and to heal its wounds. But then I see the crimes in Israel and Samaria. Everyone is deceitful; robbers roam the streets.
translation_verse: “Na uwi biala na nnii mɔɔbwi mina kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ lɛsiku bana lɛlɛ lɛni na beeƒi kudɔ ni, kalala ku ɔkɔ bɔnyi ku ekpidi lidu bamba kani na mɔɔnu. Na beyune baabwɛ teeduo bekyuli kɔduli na bakɛ lilu lɛlɔ ƒui baaví.

english_verse: No one realizes that I have seen their sins surround them like a flood.
translation_verse: Na bana ɔdi ulakali taanu ɔnii mɔɔnu kalɛ na bana ekpidi áka ámana-ma aani kalɛ na beenyimi lɛla lɛdi, nsu mɔɔnu ɔmɛni ƒui.

english_verse: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.
translation_verse: “Na bana ɔbladu ɔmɛni ɔdi bana benengu bammɔ ƒui lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: Everyone burns with desire— they are like coals in an oven, ready to burst into flames.
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na balɛ-mi kama ɔɔda-ma ɔkwɛ aani ogya ku lɛyu lɛni náabi lise úte bodobodo buƒi.

english_verse: On the day their king was crowned, his officials got him drunk, and he joined in their foolishness.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛni na beesé ɔga ni, anwu ku nwuna benengu ƒui báni ntɛ békpi na baabla adɔlɔla.

english_verse: Their anger is a fire that smolders all night, then flares up at dawn.
translation_verse: Kɔnyi kukpidi kɔ́ƒɔ-ma kayi kemmo aani kalɛ na ogya ɔɔkya taada na bodobodo lɛyu kemmo ɔni na asa kadi keteegye ni, na ogya ɔmmɔ uudie linyemi!

english_verse: They are flames destroying their leaders. And their kings are powerless; none of them trust me.
translation_verse: Kɔnyi kɔmmɔ kɔ́ya na báƒɔ ogya bakɛ aani ogya ku lɛyu na bádu bana batɔnkune ƒui unwi unwi. Na bana ɔdi útabla kasusu ɔnii ɔɔkpali-mi uvele kebunku kadi.

english_verse: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
translation_verse: “Israel kadi bekyuli bani násalaku kadi bamba bese aani bodobodo ɔni na béƒi na ɔ́bi kakɛ ku kakɛ.

english_verse: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.
translation_verse: Bányonu lɛlɔ béte baƒɔ na bana ɔyikun ƒui ɔ́yii udu na balanu taati. Na bana lili linwini lɛ́ta lɛɛƒuala, nsu balanu ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ taati.

english_verse: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
translation_verse: Israelƒuɔ lɛlɔ katɔ bɔkɔliku muudie-ma teete, na balatuna banii beenwíni bebo ami bana Unwoti Katɔti kudɔ iye bawia-mi kama ulu na lɛƒɔ-ma.

english_verse: Israel is a senseless bird, fluttering back and forth between Egypt and Assyria.
translation_verse: “Israelƒuɔ báta bénwini aani bakpaƒɛɛlɛ bani nkɛ esu esu beeveyi teesie taasɔ, na Egyipteƒuɔ ku Asiriaƒuɔ ntɛ baawia kabɛkɔ.

english_verse: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
translation_verse: Nsu ndubo-ma budie na mina asawu kemmo aani kalɛ na ɔgbini uudie aasɛ na kamia kemmo na lɛni-ma kɔtu kalɛ na lɛ́su ka ndubo bɔbla kalɛ.

english_verse: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ muute-ma, ɔsika ala adubo-ma bukpoku na bayii udu aani bana lɛyuƒɔla ka béni-mi ɔsu. Nsu lɛ́yɔ ka nka lidie-ma.

english_verse: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
translation_verse: Belewulo taakpali-mi geen taasiku bana kayi kemmo, mmomu bebi bana kɔtɛnkɔ beewulo kɔnyana, na baabla lɛlɔ ulikplu ala ani na basiaku ala bamba baabla na basia anu ka ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔya na bakɛ kebunku na wete-ma kusɛ kusɛ na bakɛ edula pii ani na baawia.

english_verse: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
translation_verse: Ina ka ami náda-ma na lɛ́tina-ma ala ɔsu na bagyi lɛla lɛni na bagyi ni, báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_verse: “Béni banii belenwini belebo-mi kudɔ na basia Baal baƒiɔ anu bani neeebo ɔyikun ɔdi. Anwuɔsu na bese aani kataminta kani naaadia, na bana batɔnkune ƒui badubo kuwii kenye bɔtɛ na ukyuli tabu ku enyekpi ani na baatɛmi ɔsu. Na Egyipteƒuɔ badubo-ma buti bunwini lɛmala.”

english_verse: Sound a warning! Israel, you broke our agreement and ignored my teaching. Now an eagle is swooping down to attack my land.
translation_verse: “Vwi kakpɛɛ na ebo Israelƒuɔ ɔda na ete-ma bɔti anii bekisine bakɛ bana eli baatú-ma na badubo bebéyu-ma batu aani kasangbii ka bébile mina bunyimi na báta bénye mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Israel, you say, “We claim you, the Lord, as our God.”
translation_verse: Baava taakpali-mi banii bagyi-mi aani bana Unwoti ku Katɔti!

english_verse: But your enemies will chase you for rejecting our good agreement.
translation_verse: Nsu bina bekisine badubo-mii bɔbɔku ka bíni bunyimi bɔbuni bɔni na ami ku-mii búnyimi ɔsu.

english_verse: You chose kings and leaders without consulting me; you made silver and gold idols that led to your downfall.
translation_verse: Bɛ́ƒuna baga ku batɔnkune bíte lɛlɔ, na bíteye-mi kasusu. Na bíti sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi bɛ́bla baƒiɔ bíte lɛlɔ, na ama nákpanku-mii bátákya bɔkywi kemmo.

english_verse: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
translation_verse: Na líti kɔnyi lɛ́kya awɔ Samaria ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ na ƒula baƒiɔ bani na ávɔ na ɔmantɛ akɔ ubi udu kenye mmɔ ɔsu. Uwi ɔmani na aakali ka adubɔsɔ abla sɛɛn na mina anumi?

english_verse: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Na Israelni ɔdi nébo úbavɔ baƒiɔ bammɔ úte-ɔ. Nsu ami kani ndi Katɔti unwi ɔmmɔ, anwuɔsu baƒiɔ bammɔ badubo bɔbwɛ bugyingya.

english_verse: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.
translation_verse: “Ɔsika si ágya ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ni, ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔkya ligede na adubo bɔnu. Na kamu kani nátakya ebi kalayu taabla ligyie na bekulo-ka bababla lɛdila lɛdi. Na si ina kákya ebi muedi ni, bekisine badubo-ka buyu bɔtɔlɔku-mii kudɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.
translation_verse: Israel amii ɔdi ɔ́sa, na kadi bamba bekyuli badubo-mii bɔnu ka bɛɛɛdi lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
translation_verse: Na bílieku ebuo atuɔkplune aani akwa. Anwuɔsu na bíkeli bísie Asiriaƒuɔ kudɔ bɛnii bitáblaku-ma unwi na bɛwia kebunku.

english_verse: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Ngyi kesii kani na ndubo-mii bɔkɛ, ina bi kuye na amii ku kalɔ bamba bekyuli bammɔ bɛ́kya ka bɛƒɔ bite-ma, ɔsika bana baga ku benengu bammɔ kani ndubo-mii bususu.

english_verse: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
translation_verse: “Israelƒuɔ, bɛ́tu akpabi pii bíte lɛlɔ kesii kani na bɛɛkpá bina ekpidi bɔbla akpala. Na akpabi ammɔ énwini ekpidi kablakɔ akpabi.

english_verse: My instructions for sacrifices were written in detail, but you ignored them.
translation_verse: Na ka mɔɔwia ka bɛbla akpala bite-mi ɔsu ni, lɛ́ya na bénweni-nya nwaa bése béte-mii, nsu bíni-nya aani lɛla lɛni naaakɛ-mii.

english_verse: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
translation_verse: Bɛɛdú bina bebuo babuni ƒui taabla akpala na bɛɛdi akpala ammɔ lɛnɔ, nsu ami Unwoti anwu muuní bina akpala ammɔ. Mina anumi adubɔsia bina ekpidi lɛlɔ na lɛni-mii kɔtu na bɛsɔ binwini bisie Egyipte.

english_verse: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
translation_verse: Israelƒuɔ, ami nédie-mii, nsu bɛ́yiƒala-mi. Na awɔ ku Yuda ƒui bɛ́tu baga kuliekɔ bonwu bonwu ku lɛma linengudi pii lɛni mbo kɔgyumanakɔ bíte lɛlɔ. Nsu ndubo bɔya na ogya ubo ubakyula lɛma lɛmmɔ ku kɔgyumanakɔ kɔmmɔ ƒui na ubile lɛla biala.”

english_verse: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
translation_verse: Israelƒuɔ, lɛlɔ litayɔ-ɔ munu munu! Na tebimi lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na kadi bamba bekyuli baadi bana emeyi kalɛ, ɔsika ádi lɛyalɛ ágya na álɛ ƒula Unwoti Katɔti kama. Na akɛ eebi taata na kesii biala na beewiile edula, na aaƒɔ́ lɛla lɛdi biala na bɛ́di kuye ka bete-ɔ.

english_verse: But you will run short of grain and wine,
translation_verse: Nsu binyimo ka kamu ku antabi ammɔ adubo abasa na ntɛ bɔmmɔ lɛnɔ bɔsa.

english_verse: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubo bɔtɔlɔ na Unwoti kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ. Na bina badi badubo bɔtɔlɔ busie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ, na badi lɛnɔ besie Asiria kalɔ lɛlɔ na bitádi bana adila ani muusié lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Bɛɛɛdubo bɔkana ntɛ kalɔ buwi bɔbla akpala adi bute Unwoti na mmɔ. Na bina akpala adi lɛnɔ aaadubo-nwu kubiti bɔda, ɔsika adubo lɛlɔ buteese aani kekwa kalɔ akpala adila. Na aaadubo bɔni bude Unwoti kakpakɔ munu munu, mmomu ama alati adi na adi.

english_verse: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord.
translation_verse: Na bi na adubɔsɔ akana bɔbla lɛnɔ na Unwoti emeyi buni bɔdi lɛlɔ si uwi údu ka asɔ alakana-nya bɔdi?

english_verse: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
translation_verse: Na si ina badi bákana ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ bukeli ni, Egyipte na badubusie batáwɔlɔ, na bava-ma na Memƒis ɔma unengudi kemmo. Na bina sika ɔƒualadi akɛla ƒui adubɔyii akya liyu alakpi akɔ na livo lɛkwɛ lɛƒɔ ekpo ani ƒui na bina nvo búnye ƒui.

english_verse: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
translation_verse: Israelƒuɔ, bina kɔtu bɔni uwi údu ka bɛƒɔ ala ani ƒui na bɛ́bla kayu na amii alati bɛdubɔnu bɔti. Amii mɔɔsu bɛnii, “Katɔti kenye bediene bádɔlɔ na nwuna batu beekpi libuo.” Na bina ekpidi pii ani na bɛɛbla áya na bíti-mi bukisi geen.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
translation_verse: Israelƒuɔ, ami na Katɔti úti úmene-mii aani nwuna kenye udiene ɔni mataanu-mii lɛlɔ, nsu bɛ́kywɛ-mi kɔkpagyuɛ na mina lilu ƒui lɛlɔ, na bɛdanku bina bukisi ku ulikplu ala bíbedu Katɔti kakpakɔ kemmo muedi.

english_verse: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
translation_verse: Bibo kalala na ɔkɔ ala bɔbla bɔ́ƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui aani Gibea ɔma bekyuli. Nsu Unwoti anu asia bina ekpidi ƒui lɛlɔ na ɔdubo-mii kɔtu bɔni.

english_verse: Israel, when I, the Lord, found you long ago it was like finding grapes in a barren desert or tender young figs. Then you worshiped Baal Peor, that disgusting idol, and you became as disgusting as the idol you loved.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Bɔnu na lɛ́nu amii Israelƒuɔ lídie aani kɔdingyii ebi na kalɔ kakwiidi kadi kemmo, na lɛ́nu bina bati kuuku aani kɔnwingyie ebi edeedi ani náka bɔnwu. Nsu Baal-Peor baƒiɔ bani muusé lɛlɔ na bísie bɛɛkpá. Anwuɔsu na amii lɛnɔ biisé lɛlɔ aani baƒiɔ bani na bɛɛyɔ́ mmɔ kalɛ.

english_verse: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
translation_verse: “Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, amii Israelƒuɔ bɛdubo bina bukeye bɔyila aani kalɛ na aasɛ uuveyi taatɔlɔ kesii kadi. Na bina beleku basɔ baaadubo kaƒɔ bɔda na bawɔ.

english_verse: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
translation_verse: Na si ina bɛ́wɔ muedi ni, ndubɔkpanku-ma ƒui, na kebu amii lɛti. Bɛdubulie biteewulo kɔnyana uwi ɔni na línwini kama lɛ́kya-mii na ala ekpoku-mii na bɛyii udu ƒui kede kede.

english_verse: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
translation_verse: Lɛ́nu-mii aani bekyuli bani nákɛ kenyekɔ kabuni na bɛdubɔlɛ lili, nsu amii alati nákpanku bina bebi bíselaku na badu.”

english_verse: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Unwoti, bi na ɔlɛka livele lite bekyuli bamɛni udu utulo ka aya na bana beleku bada kɔwɔ na basɔ belete bebiwɔ badi lɛnyii lɛnɔ?

english_verse: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Bana ulikplu ala ani na bábla na Gilgal na lɛ́nu ɔsu muukisi-ma geen. Na bana alaekpidi ɔsu ndubo-ma bɔbɔku budie mina kaduli na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-ma bɔyɔ, ɔsika bana batɔnkune bálɛ-mi kama.

english_verse: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
translation_verse: Israel kadi bekyuli bese aani kugyii kɔni kuna ligyiitu lɛ́kwii na kuna kɔgba kɔsɔ kulákana ebi bɔnwu. Na si ina bɛ́sɔ bɛ́wɔ bebi na bɛɛyɔ́-ma dɛ muedi ni, ndubo-ma bɔdu ƒui.”

english_verse: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
translation_verse: Israel ka étenu Katɔti litemi ɔsu ni, ɔdubo-ɔ buni na akɛ ataavi na kadi bekyuli ƒui akɔ.

english_verse: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
translation_verse: Nka ntɛ kugyii kɔbuni kɔni mɔɔnwu ebi na adi. Nsu kalɛ kani na aanwu ebi pii ni, lɛni kani na aatú akpabi pii teete lɛlɔ. Na kalɛ kani na keyi kaadianku-ɔ ni, lɛni kani na aatú aƒiodu ani mɔɔdia-a bɔnu teete ƒula baƒiɔ.

english_verse: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ ɔnyine bonwu na adi na aládi litemi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu adubo ƒula ekpidi lili kayu bɔƒɔ, ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubo ƒula akpabi ku baƒiɔ bani na ávɔ mmɔ bɔbwɛ na ɔyila-ma udu.

english_verse: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
translation_verse: Bɛdubo bɔsu bɛnini, “Buuubo ɔga ɔdi na bɔɔɔdaku Unwoti ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ lɛda. Na ina bubo baga muedi ni, bi kɔsia na bɔdubɔkɛ?”

english_verse: Israel, you break treaties and don't keep promises; you turn justice into poisonous weeds where healthy plants should grow.
translation_verse: Israelƒuɔ, biinyimi ala ani neeebo kɔsia na biládi bina linyese biala lɛlɔ, na biinwíni litemi geen taatɛ na ulu ukpidi lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na livo likpidi lɛɛkwɛ́ taaƒɔ kemo kani kemmo na ɔlɛka edula enye.

english_verse: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
translation_verse: Na liƒu bonwu lɛdubo bekyuli bani nkya Samaria ƒui buƒie na bewulo kɔnyana na baƒiɔ bani na bátu bényene Bet-Awen. Baƒiɔ bammɔ na bana bakpane baabu na baakun lɛmɛnɛ ka baanu kalɛ na uukeye ku sika ugyiedi ɔsu. Nsu kekpo kadubo-ma buƒie na beti-ma bɔtɔlɔku na unwini-ma kɔƒa na ukyuli biala uteewulo.

english_verse: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
translation_verse: Badubo-ma buti busienku Asiria kalɔ lɛlɔ aani ɔga unengudi ɔmmɔ litela. Na kɔƒa kukpo Israelƒuɔ ka bákya bátaakpa baƒiɔ bammɔ udu ɔsu.

english_verse: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
translation_verse: Na badubuti Samaria kadi bekyuli ku bana ɔga batɔlɔku aani kalɛ na ketu keetiku kegyiimi na ɔɔgbála-nwu taatɔlɔku na ntu anumi.

english_verse: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Na akpabi ani na abi eli mmɔ ƒui adubɔyii udu ka ɔkɛnku bana lɛlɔ ɔsu na Israel ɔ́bla likpidi. Na liyu alakpi ku livo bamba ndubo bɔkwɛ na mmɔ ƒui. Na liƒu ɔsu ni, bekyuli bammɔ badubɔkpali basu abi ammɔ banini, “Bɛbɛla-bu!” Na badubɔsu abinkpo lɛnɔ banini, “Bibebi-bu lɛlɔ!”

english_verse: Israel, you have never stopped sinning since that time at Gibeah. That's why you will be attacked at Gibeah.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Israelƒuɔ, bítada bina ekpidi ani na bɛ́bla na Gibea mmɔ dii bɔbla bítaya tɔ? Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na ala adubo-mii bukpoku na Gibea mmɔ.

english_verse: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
translation_verse: Bina ekpidi bɔbla ásɔ ásia kama ébu, anwuɔsu lɛ́lɛ ugyii ka ndubo bɔya na kadi bamba bekyuli bebékpo-mii na bakya-mii abuli batɔlɔku.

english_verse: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔdi kemmo ni, na nka Israelƒuɔ bese aani ɔmantɛ akɔ ɔkɔdi ɔni nse buɛɛ na uunú kalɔ taabla mina kabla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. Nsu ɔƒɛni amu ndubo anwu ku Yudaƒuɔ ƒui amɔ bunyimi bɔda anwami bonwu lɛlɔ na bataabla kabla kpakplaa.

english_verse: Plow your fields, scatter seeds of justice, and harvest faithfulness. Worship me, the Lord, and I will send my saving power down like rain.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu lɛ́su-ma nnii, ‘Biteegulu kalɔ na bɛgya edula buni ulu lɛlɔ siin na bɛƒɛ kɔnyana bɔnu ebi. Ɔsika uwi údu ka bɛkya lili kalɔ bite ami, bina Unwoti. Na ndubɔya na bɛnu kalɛ na mbo ɔyikun na mɔɔƒɔ́ bekyuli aani kalɛ na ɔnantu ɔɔna teewi kalɔ lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
translation_verse: “Nsu bɛ́va likpidi bɔbla ebi na bɛ́ƒɛ ala ani naaakɛ ulu siin lɛlɔ. Na bɛdubɔdi bina ɔkɔ bɔnyi ebi. Ɔsika bɛ́sia amii alati ɔyikun anu ɔni na bɛ́nu ka amii ku bina bekpone nkya ɔsu.

english_verse: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
translation_verse: Kekpo kadubo bɔlɛ, na bina lɛma kɔgyumanakɔ kɔni na bɛ́tu ƒui kɔdubo bɔbwɛ. Na bina bekisine badubo-mii lɛla lɛni na Ɔga Salman ɔ́bla Bet-Arbel bɔbla. Na badubuti bebi ku bana beni ƒui baƒiɛmi atakpɛ lɛlɔ badu.

english_verse: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
translation_verse: Betel ƒula lilikpi ku lilidia lɛni nse nte-ɔ na lɛdi mɛni na ƒula ekpidi ɔsu. Na ɔtanta tutuutu ni, badubo ƒula ɔga bɔdu.”

english_verse: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́yɔ Israel uwi ɔni na ɔdi ɔnamu na lɛ́lɔ mina ubi lɛ́siku Egyipte.

english_verse: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
translation_verse: Nsu kɔlɛ kɔlɛ kɔni na mɔɔlɔ-nwu teeboku lɛlɔ aani ubi kalɛ ni, kɔlɛ kɔmmɔ na uusié kama na mina kudɔ. Na baabla akpala teete Baal baƒiɔ na baakyula oloƒui teete ala ani na bávɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
translation_verse: Ami náda Israelƒuɔ kɔnu na lɛ́tina-ma kalɛ na beesié. Nsu bátanu bátati banii ami nábwi-ma.

english_verse: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.
translation_verse: Ka bana lɛlɔ lɛɛda-mi kubiti na mɔɔyɔ́-ma ɔsu ni, lɛ́da-ma lɛ́kya lɛlɔ. Lɛ́gyu-ma, na lɛ́da-ma lɛ́mana mina kayi, na líbo kalɔ buɛɛ na lɛ́kya-ma adila na bádi.

english_verse: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
translation_verse: “Béni ka bani bede-mi, anwuɔsu ɔlɛka basɔ benwini besie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ, na Asiria ɔdubɔdi-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
translation_verse: Mɔɔnu ka mina bekyuli bálɛ ugyii ka bada lɛlɔ bamami-mi lɛlɔ. Na baawia ka beti lɛlɔ bete baƒiɔ bani na baakali ka bebo ɔyikun bétulo-mi, nsu balakana-ma kebunku kadi bute.

english_verse: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
translation_verse: “Israelƒuɔ, naaakana-mii bɔnyonu lɛni iye lidie-mii atu. Na naaakana makyula-mii aani kalɛ na lɛ́bla Adma ku Seboim. Oowo, uladia-mi bɔbla lɛni, ɔsika mina kayi kelete-mi kuƒi na kalɛ na mɔɔyɔ́-mii ɔsu.

english_verse: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
translation_verse: Nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-mii kɔtu bɔni na kalɛ na mina kɔnyi kɔ́kɔ katɔ kútédu kenye, na lɛyila-mii udu, ɔsika ami ndi bina Katɔti ɔni nse kedee, na ɔɔɔdi ukyuli ɔyawine na ndi na nli-mii akɔ. Anwuɔsu nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo ku kɔnyi.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
translation_verse: “Mina kadi bekyuli badubɔsi ɔƒɛ kanukɔ bebo na babasiaku ami bana Unwoti kama ku bɔyia si lɛ́kwanyi aani gyata.

english_verse: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
translation_verse: Na badubɔsi Egyipte bebo aani baasɛ bani muuveyi ku usi, na bakɛ ligeen aani babloduma bani nási Asiria na lɛsɔku-ma liboku bana kesii. Ami Unwoti násu lɛni!”

english_verse: Israel is deceitful to me, their loyal and holy God; they surround me with lies, and Judah worships other gods.
translation_verse: Israelƒuɔ baanyi ɔkɔ taatɔlɔ bana Unwoti Kedee ɔni mɔɔdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ uwi biala teete bekyuli ku bana ɔkɔ etemila pii ammɔ. Na Yuda lɛnɔ unye nwuna lɛƒiɔkpa lɛlɔ.

english_verse: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kama kani na Israelƒuɔ basia uwi ndi uwi. Na ɔkɔ bɔnyi ku ala bubile ku bekyuli lɛlɔ bɔta teenye kani náƒɔ-ma keliela kemmo na kesi kesii. Ama ku Asiriaƒuɔ muunyimi ala, na ama ku Egyipteƒuɔ baadi nnɔ kuye.

english_verse: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
translation_verse: Unwoti údie Yudaƒuɔ bani ndi Yakob kaba bebi bɔƒiɔ. Na ɔdubo-ma kɔtu bɔni na bana ala bɔbla ɔsu.

english_verse: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.
translation_verse: Kaƒɔ kemmo ƒui na Yakob úse kalɔ uukpóku ɔnwani. Na ɔni na ɔ́bi lɛlɔ lɛnɔ ni, anwu ku Katɔti bása kayi na békpoku lɛlɔ.

english_verse: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
translation_verse: Na Betel lɛnɔ ni, anwu ku Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi bása kayi na ɔ́di-nwu lɛlɔ, na ɔda imii blabla úvele-nwu ɔnii ute-nwu kusɛ kusɛ. Mmɔ na ɔ́tɛmiku-nwu,

english_verse: God's name is the Lord, the Lord God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: anwu ɔni ndi Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui. Na Unwoti ndi lɛnyi lɛni na bekyuli baabu.

english_verse: You say to yourself, “I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.” The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
translation_verse: Na biiti ɔmmɔ taakun lɛmɛnɛ taasu bɛnii, “Ɔlakɛne na ndi, na ami ɔlati néti mina enu lɛ́bla kabla na lɛ́kɛ egulabi ammɔ, na ńtabla ukyuli ɔdi lɛla lɛdi!”

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
translation_verse: “Israelƒuɔ, bɛnu bɛti ka ami Unwoti mmu ndi bina Katɔti kalɛ kani na úse kukuuku uwi ɔni na bɛ́kya Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na ɔƒaani ni, ndubo-mii lɛlɔ bunye na bɛsɔ bitélie nvo kemmo kalɛ na bílie na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo bíbavi.

english_verse: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
translation_verse: Lɛ́tɛmiku mina kenye bediene na lɛ́ya na bánu kɔyu kemmo ala. Na lɛ́sia-ma lɛlɔ líbo-mii agba na líte-mii bɔti na ala pii lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
translation_verse: Alaekpidi ani na baabla na Gilgal ábɔ ágya na badubo babayii udu na kawɔlɔkɔ. Baadú ɔmantɛ bakɔ taakpa na bana akpabi ani na béti atabi bátu mmɔ lɛlɔ. Nsu badubo atabi ammɔ ƒui bugyingya bɔ́kya alakpi akɔ na kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Jacob escaped to Syria where he tended sheep to earn himself a wife.
translation_verse: Yakob úkeli úsie Mesopotamia kalɔ lɛlɔ kesii kani na útánu baƒonu lɛlɔ asa na ɔdubɔkɛ uleku uti na mmɔ.

english_verse: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́tala mina Kenye Udiene Mose nnii ɔtɔnku Israelƒuɔ ɔsiku Egyipte na ɔda-ma kɔkɔɔkɔ na lɛla lɛdi litabla-ma.

english_verse: Israel, I will make you pay for your violent crimes and for insulting me.
translation_verse: Nsu bɛ́kya-mi kɔnyi na bɛ́nu-mi anumi, anwuɔsu ndubo-mii kɔtu bɔni na bina ekpidi bonwu ani na bɛ́bla ɔsu.”

english_verse: When your leaders spoke, everyone in Israel trembled and showed great respect. But you sinned by worshiping Baal, and you were destroyed.
translation_verse: Si bina batɔnkune baatɛmi ni, lɛlɔ lɛɛtɔ́ ukyuli biala ku liƒu na bɛɛbu-ma geen. Nsu bɛ́bla likpidi na ɔni na bísie bɛɛkpá Baal baƒiɔ ɔsu na báyii udu.

english_verse: Now you continue to sin by designing and making idols of silver in the shape of calves. You are told to sacrifice to these idols— yes, even to kiss them.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani ni, bɛmu binye likpidi lɛmmɔ kani bɔbla lɛlɔ, na bíti sika ɔƒualadi bɛ́vɔ ɔmantɛ bakɔ bebi udu baƒiɔ bíte lɛlɔ, na básu-mii banii bitaakyula akpala teete-nwu na bɛɛkya-ma kɔgbu taaƒuƒuɛ muedi.

english_verse: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bɛdubo udu bɔyii ƒui kede kede aani kalɛ na ulɔyɔ ɔɔyii taakya, na amii aakwii na ala lɛlɔ, na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uuti aƒaƒaa na kemo taatɔlɔku, na uyɔ lɛnɔ ɔɔyii taakya na asi kemmo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti ɔni nédie-mii ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na Katɔti ɔbambadi ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo. Ami lɛti ndi anwu ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́ bekyuli.

english_verse: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
translation_verse: Lɛ́nu-mii lɛlɔ na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo kesii kani na ntu buuubo mmɔ.

english_verse: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.
translation_verse: Nsu ka bíbeduo kalɔ kabuni kemmo kesii kani na ntu ku adila akya na bɛɛní na bɛɛdi teemo ni, bɛ́yiƒala-mi na bíse kalɔ bɛɛtina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
translation_verse: “Ɔƒaani ni, ndubo-mii bukpoku aani gyata, na libi kesii kadi ntaatu-mi aani ebuoƒuala.

english_verse: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
translation_verse: Na lɛduli-mii ligyingya aani kegidi kani bebi na béƒie bátɔlɔku. Na ndubo-mii ekubi bɔbwɛ aani eƒiebuo bamba ɔdi kalɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.
translation_verse: “Israel, awɔ ɔdi ɔ́sa. Sɔ tasia lɛnu anii adubɔkɛ kebunku kadi asiku-mi kudɔ.

english_verse: You wanted a king and rulers. Where is your king now? What cities have rulers?
translation_verse: Aasu anii ɔga ku lɛlɔ badine na aawia ɔƒaani ka lise lite-ɔ. Ama nɔɔ? Lɛma lɛmani kemmo na bakya na bebebunku-ɔ?

english_verse: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kɔnyi kemmo na líte-ɔ ɔga ɔni na aawia na líti-nwu lɛ́tɔlɔku na livoƒi kemmo. Israel Úduo Ɔgbankpi Kemmo

english_verse: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.
translation_verse: “Israel, bénweni ƒula alaekpidi bonwu bonwu ammɔ bése, na báklibi-nya buse béte-ɔ.

english_verse: You are like a senseless child who refuses to be born at the proper time.
translation_verse: Adi ubi ɔdɔlɔdi ɔni néni ɔnii batawɔ-nwu uwi ɔni na nka údu bɔwɔ.

english_verse: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
translation_verse: “Ami Unwoti ndubɔƒɔ-mii na lidie-mii kukpi kemmo na bileduo kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo. O kukpi, wɛ na ƒula ɔlɛ ɔni na aakya bekyuli lɛlɔ ɔkya? O kukpi, wɛ na ƒula ala bubile bɔkya? “Na líni nnii lɛɛɛdubo-mii kɔnyana bɔnu.

english_verse: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
translation_verse: Ina bi lɛkɛ na bɛ́kɛ na lɛ́kɔ katɔ dɛ ni, ami Unwoti ndubo-ni kemmo bubile ƒui na lɛyila-ni aani kalɛ na kaƒɛndi ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔkula ala na kalɔ kakwiidi kemmo ɔɔkula ntukpa. Ndubuƒie bina lɛkɛ lɛmmɔ lɛƒɔ-mii kudɔ.

english_verse: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.
translation_verse: Ndubo Samaria kɔtu bɔni geen na ɔni na ɔ́ta únye-mi lɛlɔ ɔsu. Na bayila-nwu udu na kekpokɔ. Na bebo-nwu bebi baƒiɛmi atakpɛ lɛlɔ na bekpi. Na bawawa bana baƒɔndane.”

english_verse: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
translation_verse: Israel, sɔ nwini bo ƒula Unwoti Katɔti kudɔ. Ɔsika likpidi lɛ́ya na ébuli.

english_verse: Return to the Lord and say, “Please forgive our sins. Accept our good sacrifices of praise instead of bulls.
translation_verse: Nwini sie ƒula Unwoti Katɔti kudɔ na etévele-nwu na asu anini, “Ti bula ekpidi kyiɛ-bu, na aƒɔ bula linugya bumwi bɔni ndi akpala ani na búti buute-ɔ.

english_verse: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
translation_verse: Asiria ulakana-bu bɔƒɔ, na kekpo bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ lɛnɔ ulakana-bu bubunku. Anwuɔsu bɔsɔ bulákpa baƒiɔ bani na bɔ́vɔ, ɔsika awɔ Unwoti mɔɔnu bekpinebi kɔnyana.” Unwoti Úse Kenye Ka Ɔdubuti Ekpidi Ɔkyiɛ

english_verse: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
translation_verse: “Israelƒuɔ, amii néni-mi, nsu mina kɔnyi kɔ́yɔ-mi. Ndubo-mii bɔbwi na lɛyɔ-mii na bɔyɔ bɔmmɔ buuubo kawɔkɔ.

english_verse: I will be like the dew— then you will blossom like lilies and have roots like a tree.
translation_verse: Na ndubuse lite-mii aani amii ani mɔɔyu na bɛlɛ lili aani egyii anwula ani muubimi na bidie ligyiitu aani kugyii kalɛ.

english_verse: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubudie kɔgba na kusie ɔgyu na kɔdia bɔnu aani ntɛ kugyii kalɛ. Na ɔnyi ɔni na egyii ammɔ anwula adubudie ni, adubunwenyi ƒɛƒɛɛ aani Lebanon lɛku kemmo egyii kalɛ.

english_verse: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Bɛdubɔkɛ ɔƒɛ na mina ɔyuli kalɔ. Na bina edula alɛ lili. Bɛdubuwi anwula pii aani ntɛ adingyii kemo na bɛƒɔ lɛnyi aani ntɛ bɔni nási Lebanon.

english_verse: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
translation_verse: Israel, die ƒula lɛƒiɔkpa atu na ndubunu ƒula buvele na lɛnu-ɔ lɛlɔ. Ami ɔlati ndi kugyii kɔni muukeye mmɔ. Na ami ndubɔya na bɛnwu ebi pii.

english_verse: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
translation_verse: “Si bɛdi banundane ni, bɛdubunu ala ani mɔɔsu-mii mɛni kalɔ. Ami ndi bina Unwoti ɔni ndanku-mii mɔɔsiaku ulu ɔbuni lɛlɔ. Na si bínu-mi litemi ni, bɔdubusie aani bavinkpana. Nsu si bɛɛbla ulikplu ala ni, bɛdubo butulo na bibuli.”

english_verse: Tell our children! Let it be told to our grandchildren and their children too.
translation_verse: Bɛsu bina bebi na ama lɛnɔ basɔku basu bana kaba kemmo bebi bani mebo.

english_verse: Swarm after swarm of locusts has attacked our crops, eating everything in sight.
translation_verse: Baalɔlɔ esu esu bonwu badi beebo taatɔlɔ na bébebile-bu edula ƒui na bádi lɛla biala bédie kede kede.

english_verse: Sober up, you drunkards! Cry long and loud; your wine supply is gone.
translation_verse: Bɛta na biteewulo amii ntɛ bekpine bani mɔɔyɔ́ ntɛ mini mini ku bani na mɔɔyɔ́ ntɛ kpakplaa ƒui, ɔsika békpeli lɛla biala báƒɔ-mii kenye.

english_verse: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kadi bayikune badi bébo na bébekpo bula kalɔ. Badi bayikune bani ukyuli ulakana bɔka. Na bebo anyi aani bagyata adi. Na bana abatayɛ ese yayaaya etulo gyata uwele adi.

english_verse: Our grapevines and fig trees are stripped bare; only naked branches remain.
translation_verse: Bébile anwingyie ku adingyii ana ƒui. Na báyalɛ egyii ammɔ evuo bédie, na kɔgba kukpludi kani nébu kɔtɛ.

english_verse: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.
translation_verse: Biwulo keku geen aani ugblebi ɔni náyila ɔnana ɔni na ɔdubo bulieku.

english_verse: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
translation_verse: Edula ku ntɛ lɛkpa etela ƒui kenye kékulo na Unwoti kaduli. Na amii bakpane bani ndi Unwoti kenye benyene ƒui bíduo kɔnyana.

english_verse: Mourn for our farms and our vineyards! There's no wheat or barley growing in our fields.
translation_verse: Biteewulo kɔnyana momoomo amii bemonsene ku adingyii lɛlɔ banune ƒui. Anta ku kakpa ƒui káyii udu na mmo ƒui lɛlɔ ɔni na edula adi asɔ eeenye na baƒɛ.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away. Return to God
translation_verse: Adingyii ku anwingyie ƒui áyɛyɛ na éwile enye ukpludi. Na bekyuli báyila lɛlɔyɔ biala. Binwini Kayi

english_verse: Mourn, you priests who serve at the altar of my God. Spend your days and nights wearing sackcloth. Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Biti adikpi bɛda bɛtina ka biiwulo kɔnyana na biteewulo, amii bakpane bani ndi Unwoti kenye benyene na bɛɛbla-nwu kabla na lɛkpabi lɛlɔ. Bɛtɛ adikpi ammɔ kemmo usien umodi amii bani muunye-nwu anumi taabla-nwu kabla, ɔsika etela lidu ku ntɛ etela ammɔ ƒui kenye kékulo na Unwoti kaduli.

english_verse: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
translation_verse: Bɛlɔ benengu bammɔ ku bekyuli bani ƒui nkya kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ na bɛsa bɔsa kedee na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ na Unwoti kakpakɔ na ete-ma bɔti na benyimi kenye ku lɛlɔ kalɔ buboku ku lɛlɔ bɔti bɔda sɛɛn. Na bewulo bakpali Unwoti bevele-nwu.

english_verse: We are in for trouble! Soon the Lord All-Powerful will bring disaster.
translation_verse: Bɔ́nu lɛla lɛni na balanu! Unwoti limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛ́tua-bu na nwuna kɔtu bɔni bonwu bɔmmɔ bɔ́da-bu bɔ́kya.

english_verse: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Bula adila ƒui áyii udu, na limeyi lɛdi bɔdi bɔsɔ buuubo na Katɔti kakpakɔ.

english_verse: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
translation_verse: Edula ákwii akya kalɔ kemmo na adi asɔ eeebo na baƒɛ. Na bula linwu ƒui lɛdaku bɔbwɛ na anta iye kamu kadi kasɔ keeewi-ni kemmo.

english_verse: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.
translation_verse: Bula bebuo nkɛ mɔɔví taakɔ taayu mɛni na baava ka balakɛ livo lɛni na bakun ɔsu. Na baƒonu bammɔ beebó abi geen.

english_verse: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
translation_verse: O Unwoti, muuwulo taakpali-ɔ, ɔsika livo ƒui líkpi na bula bebuo kadikɔ, na egyii lɛnɔ ákwii enye aani si ogya nákwii ɔ́vi.

english_verse: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
translation_verse: Alakpi akɔ bebuo lɛnɔ muedi basɔ beeebo ntu bɔni na bani na baava taakpali-ɔ, ɔsika ntukpa ƒui bɔ́kwii na aku ƒui áyɛyɛ na livo lɛsɔ liiibo-ni kemmo.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.
translation_verse: Vwi kekpo kakpɛɛ na ete bɔti na Sion, na mina kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ, na liƒu litaada bekyuli ƒui na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ, ɔsika Unwoti limeyi lɛni na ɔtɛ litemi lɛ́si lɛdubo.

english_verse: It will be dark and gloomy with storm clouds overhead. Troops will cover the mountains like thunderclouds. No army this powerful has ever been gathered before or will be gathered again.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdubo bɔbla suu, na liƒlukutu suu lɛdi lɛƒɔ kayaa ku abi lɛlɔ. Na bekpone lisu bonwu lɛdi lɛdubɔda lɛlɛ bani udu nétedie tɔ lɛlɔ kudii na badi lɛnɔ basɔ belebo kudii.

english_verse: They look like horses and charge like cavalry.
translation_verse: Bana bɔnu buse aani bapɔnkɔ bani nkɛ mɔɔƒulu taavi.

english_verse: They roar over mountains like noisy chariots, or a mighty army ready for battle. They are a forest fire that feasts on straw.
translation_verse: Na bana bɔƒulu bɔmmɔ bɔɔku aani bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ pii ɔdi na bada baaní na abi eli mmɔ ku kɔku aani ogya mɔɔda taakyula lɛku na ala eetulo.

english_verse: The very sight of them is frightening.
translation_verse: Na bana bɔnu lɛti lɛti muedi bɔɔda liƒu geen.

english_verse: They climb over walls like warriors; they march in columns and never turn aside.
translation_verse: Bakɛ lɛnungyie kemmo aani bekpone sɔsɔ na baakɔ́ awodu taayu ɔni na beledeyi na bana ulu lɛlɔ munu munu.

english_verse: They charge straight ahead, without pushing each other; even arrows and spears cannot make them retreat.
translation_verse: Baata ku usi kɔnakunwi, nsu balatuaku lɛlɔ. Na atula ku kɔtaminta kɔni mɔɔsiáku-ma kulaya na benwini kama.

english_verse: They swarm over city walls and enter our homes; they crawl in through windows, just like thieves.
translation_verse: Bábuma lɛlɔ bétéwi ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo na bakɛ awodu eli na béduo kɔduli kemmo na badi bakɛ ƒansili aani beyune kalɛ.

english_verse: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
translation_verse: Na kalɔ ƒui kaagyú taawɔ na kayaa kaakunku. Na ɔƒɛ ku kɔbuli ƒui kɔ́bla suu na ayabi lɛnɔ áda bukeye áya.

english_verse: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti mɔɔtɔnku bekpone lisu bonwu bamɛni na beenú-nwu lɛdi. Katɔti litemi bɔtɛ limeyi lɛdi liƒu limeyi bonwu geen na ukyuli biala ulakana-ni kenye bunye. Unwoti Ɔ́siaku Bekyuli Ɔnii Bebo-nwu Kudɔ

english_verse: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Útakpɛ tɔ kama útavili. Bɛkana na binwini bibo-mi kudɔ ku bina kayi ƒui. Bise keku kalɔ ku buwulo ku kɔnyana! Na binyimi kenye.

english_verse: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi bina lɛwu na bɛɛní bɛbwɛ biti bɛtina ka biiwulo kɔnyana. Mmomu binwini bibo-mi kudɔ ku kayi kani muunú ɔlɛ na bina ekpidi ani na bɛ́bla lili. Mɔɔnu kɔnyana na mbo lɛƒɔndia na ndaku ukyuli lɛda. Neeeti kɔnyi buti buti. Na naaayɔ ka ntaani kɔtu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti na ɔƒɛni kalɛ ndubɔvumana mina kasusu na lɛnu-mii kɔnyana. Na kusɛ kusɛ ɔdubɔsiaku-mii na bɛkɛ edula pii ku ntɛ na biti bɛbla lɛkpa etela bite-mi.”

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
translation_verse: Vwi kakpɛɛ na Sion! Na alɔ bekyuli bammɔ ƒui na bɛsa bɔsa kedee na mina lɛnyi lɛlɔ bɛtina kalɛ na biiwulo kɔnyana na bina kenye kani na biinyimi kemmo.

english_verse: Make sure that everyone is fit to worship me. Bring adults, children, babies, and even bring newlyweds from their festivities.
translation_verse: Na asia anu ka ukyuli biala ɔ́klibi lɛlɔ kaduɛ na ɔ́manku ka ɔkpali-mi. Na aya na benengu ku banamu ku bagya ku bele ƒui bata bana emeyi kadikɔ bebo.

english_verse: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
translation_verse: Su mina bakpane bani nnye kakpakɔ kayakun ku lɛkpabi ntɛ mmɔ na bewulo bakpali-mi banini, “Unwoti, ƒɔ ƒula kadi bekyuli! Na taya na kadi bamba bekyuli beti ƒula bekyuli benwini lɛƒiankula na bataama-ma teeye banini, ‘Wɛ na bana Unwoti ɔkya?’ ” Unwoti Ɔdubute Nwuna Bekyuli Kusɛ Kusɛ

english_verse: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti anumi égyie na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ, anwuɔsu ɔ́nu bekyuli bammɔ kɔnyana.

english_verse: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
translation_verse: Unwoti údie kenye na ɔ́su nwuna bekyuli ɔnini, “Bɛnu, líti edula ku ntɛ ku nnɔ muumene-mii na ala ammɔ emo-mii. Na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na kadi bamba bekyuli beteedumi-mii taama.

english_verse: An army attacked from the north, but I will chase it into a scorching desert. There it will rot and stink from the Dead Sea to the Mediterranean.” The Lord works wonders
translation_verse: Bekpone badi bási kalɔ kammɔ katɔ kakɛ na bébekpo-mii, nsu ndubo-ma bɔbɔku butákya kalɔ kakwiidi kani náƒɔ ogya kemmo. Na bani ntɔ batáyii udu na ɛpu ɔmmɔ ɔƒɛ katukɔ na babambadi bawɔlɔ na ɛpu ɔmmɔ ɔƒɛ kanukɔ na bebun beteenwenyi.” Na Katɔti nábla ala enengudi amɛni.

english_verse: and does great things. So tell the soil to celebrate
translation_verse: Bɛya na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui kakɛ lɛlɔyɔ na ebiti ada-ka, ɔsika Unwoti ɔɔbla akɔla ala budie taatina.

english_verse: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
translation_verse: Amii alakpi akɔ bebuo lɛnɔ ƒui bɛda bɔyia bɛya, ɔsika livo buni lɛ́sɔ línwini líbo liiwi bina kɔdikɔ ƒui. Na egyii ammɔ lɛnɔ ése kalɔ adaku bɔnwu ku anwingyie ammɔ ƒui ku adingyii lidu bamba ƒui ásɔ énwini ébo ana udu kenye.

english_verse: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
translation_verse: Amii bani nkya Sion ƒui lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii na ebiti ada-mii na Unwoti bina Katɔti lɛlɔ, ɔsika ɔ́ya na ɔƒɔwi ɔnantu ku ketudi ɔnantu ɔ́na úte-mii kaduɛɛ aani kuuku kalɛ.

english_verse: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Na kamu ku anta adubɔƒɔ bina nkpa bɔni na biibó edula ebi teewi kaduɛ. Na bina akpambui adubuyi ku ntɛ ku nnɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.
translation_verse: “Ami bina Unwoti Katɔti ndubɔsɔku ala ani na bɛ́yila lite-mii. Ala ani na lɛ́tala baalɔlɔ esu esu ammɔ na bébekpoku-mii na bébile mmɔ.

english_verse: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na bɛdubɔkɛ bɛdi bimo na udu-mii ɔkwɛ na bɛdubumwi ami bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔni nábla akɔla ala amɛni udu úte-mii. Na bɛdubɔti ka ami nlieku-mii, na ndi bina Unwoti Katɔti. Ɔbambadi ɔsɔ uuubo! Na kɔƒa kɔsɔ kulékpo amii mina kadi bekyuli kudii.

english_verse: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.
translation_verse: “Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, ndubuti mina Kɔyu lite bina akɔ ɔdi biala na bina bebi bananabi ku belekubi badubo-mi kenye budie. Na bina benengu badubo ana buteegye. Na bina bakloƒu lɛnɔ banu kɔyu kemmo ala budie taatina.

english_verse: In those days I will even give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women.
translation_verse: Na emeyi amɛni kemmo ni, ndubuti mina Kɔyu lite mina kabla bablane banana ku beleku muedi.

english_verse: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔya akɔla budie taatina ataalɛ na kayaa ku kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui. Bɛdubɔnu ubugya ku ogya ku uyɔ pii.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before that great and terrible day when I appear.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛ ɔdubɔbla suu, na kɔbuli anumi adubugyie aani ubugya, asa na Katɔ Ɔyikune limeyi bonwu lɛmmɔ lɛdubo na kɔbuli anumi adubugyie aani ubugya, asa na Katɔ Ɔyikune limeyi bonwu lɛmmɔ lɛdubo.

english_verse: Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, ukyuli biala ɔni makpali Blɔti na wevele-nwu kɔnyana bɔnu ni, ɔdubɔkɛ ngba. Unwoti úse kenye úse ka badi badubo bubu bulie ngba na Sion ku Yerusalem na nwuna bekyuli baƒunadi badubɔkya-ma akɔ.”

english_verse: At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, ami Unwoti ndubo bɔya na ala asɔ atɛnku Yuda ku Yerusalem.

english_verse: Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land
translation_verse: Ndubɔkpanku kadi bamba bekyuli liboku ɔkwalɛ ɔni baalɔ Yehosaƒat na nwuna kalɔ ndi litemi bɔtɛ na lɛtɛku-ma litemi. Ɔsika ama négyingya mina kadi bekyuli bákya kayawi kesi kesii. Ama néle-ma

english_verse: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
translation_verse: na bátu akunkpa bánu bana ɔni meti mina bekyuli menwini anwu badi. Na béti bananabi bávumanaku bayalɛ na béti belekubi béye báƒɔ ntɛ báni.

english_verse: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.
translation_verse: “Amii Tiro ku Sidon kadi bekyuli ku Ƒilistiƒuɔ, bi ɔsu na bɛɛkɔ́ku-mi na bɛɛbla ala amɛni udu, munuu lɛla lɛdi na lɛ́bla-mii na biidie-mi kasi? Bɔdubo bɔnu ɔni muudie ɔkpanadi kasi.

english_verse: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
translation_verse: Bíti mina ala ani náƒɔ-mi kuye ƒui ku sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi bɛ́tɔlɔku bísienku bina aƒiodu.

english_verse: You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
translation_verse: Na bíƒie Yudaƒuɔ ku Yerusalemƒuɔ bíye bíte kadi bamba bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ na bɛ́bɔku-ma bɛ́tɔlɔku bana lɛma kakaaka ƒui.

english_verse: But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you.
translation_verse: “Bɛnu! Ndubo bɔya na benwini basi kesii kani na bíye-ma bímene mmɔ ƒui bebo bana lɛma. Na lɛla lɛni na bɛ́bla-ma mmɔ na ndubɔya na lɛlɛku-mii.

english_verse: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment in Judgment Valley
translation_verse: Ndubuti bina bebi buye bute Yudaƒuɔ ku Yerusalemƒuɔ na beti-ma beye bete Sebaƒuɔ kadi bekyuli bani nkya ɔlɔgyu kakaaka mmɔ. Ami Unwoti násu.”

english_verse: Say to the nations: “Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔ ɔmɛni lɛsa bite kadi bekyuli ƒui. Na bɛklibi lɛlɔ bite kekpo! Bitiku bekpone benengudi bammɔ na bebo bebékpo na benye basiaku-mi!

english_verse: Make swords out of plows and spears out of garden tools. Strengthen every weakling.”
translation_verse: Bɛla bina anwami ku asaaka bɛkywɛɛ kuwii ku atula. Na bani na beeebo ɔlɔkplu ƒui bata ku kayi na basu banii, “Bananabi ku bekpone na bɔdi.”

english_verse: Hurry, all you nations! Come quickly. Ask the Lord to bring his warriors along.
translation_verse: Amii kadi bekyuli bɛbabla na bibo pla! Na bɛya na ami lɛnɔ litiku mina bekpone liboku.

english_verse: You must come now to Judgment Valley, where the Lord will judge the surrounding nations.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔnini, “Amii kadi bekyuli, bɛta ku ogya na butása na Litemi Bɔtɛ Ɔkwalɛ. Mmɔ na ami Unwoti ndubɔtɛku kadi bani náka bámana ƒui litemi.

english_verse: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛku bina asaaka na bikulo-ma ƒui biwi kalɔ aani kamu kani négyie. Na bɛnya-ma bisusu aani kalɛ na baamana egyiibi ntu teeyile ntɛ kebulokɔ. Bana ulikplu ala bɔbla bɔ́bɔ bɔ́gya.”

english_verse: Crowds fill Decision Valley. The judgment day of the Lord will soon be here—
translation_verse: Bekyuli mpim mpim báƒɔ Litemi Bɔtɛ Ɔkwalɛ ɔmmɔ! Na Unwoti Limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛnɔ líidu lɛ́wɔlɔ.

english_verse: no light from the sun or moon, and stars no longer shine.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛ iye kɔbuli iye ayabi adi asɔ elekeye.

english_verse: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel. God Will Bless His People
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔɔkwanyi taasiku Sion Kɔbi lili ku lɛdi momoomo, na katɔ ku kalɔ ƒui kaakunku. Nsu Unwoti ɔmmɔ kani ndubɔbla katamikukɔ ku kagyumanakɔ kpakplaa ute nwuna kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ. Unwoti Ɔdubute Nwuna Bekyuli Kusɛ Kusɛ

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. And you will know I live on Zion, my sacred hill, because Jerusalem will be sacred, untouched by foreign troops.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi Unwoti bina Katɔti na bɛdubo bɔnu bɔti ka nli Sion Kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ. Na baƒɔ bekpone badi basɔ baaadubo Yerusalem butuku, ɔsika use kedee.

english_verse: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.
translation_verse: “Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, adingyii ani nánwu ebi kaduɛ adubɔƒɔ kɔbi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ƒui. Na bina bebuo badubɔƒɔ abi ammɔ lɛlɔ na bakɛ badi na bete-mii bebuo anyi ntu pii. Na ntukpa bɔni nkya Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ ƒui bɔdi bɔsɔ bulakwii kudii. Na ketu kadi kadubɔlɛ kasi Unwoti kaduli mmɔ na kagba kavi Sitim Ɔkwalɛ.

english_verse: Egypt and Edom were cruel and brutal to Judah, without a reason. Now their countries will become a barren desert,
translation_verse: Egyipte ku Edom kɔlɔ kɔdububie kunwini kɔlɔ kɔkwiidi kɔni nsɔ naaadubo lɛla lɛdi bɔdia na kɔsɔ kuwi ukpludi na kalala kani na bábla Yudaƒuɔ ku bekyuli bani na bádu, nsu bátabla lɛla lɛdi ɔsu.

english_verse: but Judah and Jerusalem will always have people.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli badubɔƒɔ Yuda ku Yerusalem lɛma uwi ƒui ɔ́si kaba úsie kaba.

english_verse: I, the Lord, live on Mount Zion. I will punish the guilty and defend the innocent.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani ƒui na bádu ni, ndubo bana badune ƒui bɔdu budie kasi. Ami Unwoti nli Sion.”

english_verse: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel,
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su Amos kenye kadi uwi ɔni na útaanu baƒonu lɛlɔ na Tekoa. Na kenye kammɔ kadanku Israel na uwi ɔni na Usia ɔɔdi lɛga na Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ, na Yeroboam Yoas ubidi ɔɔdi lɛga na Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ akwa anyɔ kama asa na kalɔ kadubɔkunku.

english_verse: and I said: When the Lord roars from Jerusalem, pasturelands and Mount Carmel dry up and turn brown. Judgment on Syria
translation_verse: Nwuna kenye kammɔ ndi ɔnini, “Unwoti ɔɔkwanyi taasiku Sion na kudu kɔni mɔɔsí Yerusalem mmɔ kɔ́ya na bebuo kadikɔ livo lɛmmɔ ƒui lɛ́yɛyɛ. Na livo lɛni na liwi Karmel Kɔbi lɛlɔ ƒui líkpi.” Katɔti Ɔ́tɛku Siria Litemi

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Ndubo Siriaƒuɔ kɔtu bɔni na bana ekpidi pii ɔsu na lɛɛɛdubo mina kasusu bɔvumana. Ɔsika béminime ligyigba lɛni lɛlɔ na bébo kɔbwɛlɛ bálɛ bávinku Gileadƒuɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubɔya na ogya ubakyula Ɔga Hasael kesii ku kagyumanakɔ kani na Ɔga Ben-Hadad ɔ́tu.

english_verse: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Na ndubɔƒɛ Damasko ɔma ɔban kayakun lɛbuala lɛni baabala-ka. Na lɛyila Awen Kɔwɛ bekyuli udu ku Bet-Eden ɔga. Na ndubɔya na bekpo na beƒie Siriaƒuɔ ƒui batɔlɔku besienku Kir kalɔ lɛlɔ. Ami Unwoti násu.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ndubo Gasaƒuɔ kɔtu bɔni na bana ekpidi pii ɔsu na lɛɛɛdubo mina kasusu bɔvumana. Bétiku mina bekyuli ɔ́si ɔma útédu ɔma na béti-ma béye béte Edomƒuɔ aani bana kabla bablane.

english_verse: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu ndubo bɔya na ogya ubakyula Gasa awodu na ubile bana ɔma kɔgyumanakɔ kɔni na bátu ƒui.

english_verse: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
translation_verse: Na lɛyila Asdod ɔma udu ku Askelon ɔga na lɛdu Ekronƒuɔ na Ƒilistiƒuɔ ɔdi ɔ́sa. Ami Unwoti násu!”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Ndubo Tiroƒuɔ kɔtu bɔni na bana ekpidi pii ɔsu, na lɛɛɛdubo mina kasusu bɔvumana. Bétiku mina bekyuli ɔ́si ɔma útédu ɔma na béti-ma béye béte Edomƒuɔ aani bana kabla bablane na bátadi bana unwi bɔbla bunyimi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubɔya na ogya ubakyula Tiro ɔma na ubile bana ɔma kɔgyumanakɔ kɔni na bátu.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Ndubo Edomƒuɔ kɔtu bɔni na bana ekpidi pii ani na ɔ́bla ɔsu, na lɛɛɛdubo mina kasusu bɔvumana. Bádu ama alati bana lɛlɔ bekyuli ku lɛnungyie lɛni ɔsu na bátakana na banu-ma kɔnyana ina blii suɛ.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubɔya na ogya ubakyula Teman ɔma na ubile nwuna kɔgyumanakɔ kɔni na ɔ́tu na Bosra.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Ndubo Amonƒuɔ kɔtu bɔni na bana ekpidi pii ɔsu na lɛɛɛdubo mina kasusu bɔvumana. Ɔ́wawa baƒɔndane ɔ́du na Gilead kalɛ na uti kalɔ kammɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah. Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubɔya na ogya ubakyula Raba ɔma na ubile nwuna kɔgyumanakɔ kɔni na ɔ́tu. Na bekisine badubo kudu butaabla na bebekpo-ma aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔni mɔɔkya ligede.

english_verse: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Na bani Amon ɔga ku nwuna benengu batɔlɔku. Ami Unwoti násu!”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Ndubo Moabƒuɔ kɔtu bɔni na bana ekpidi pii ɔsu na lɛɛɛdubo mina kasusu bɔvumana. Bákyula Edom ɔga ekubi bénwini ntɔ na bátabu-nya.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubɔya na ogya ubakyula Keriot kɔgyumanakɔ kɔni na ɔ́tu. Na bekyuli badubunu kekpo kɔvanu ku ese ani na baavwi si uwi ɔni na mɔɔkyula Moab ɔma

english_verse: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: ku nwuna baga ku batɔnkune bammɔ. Ami Unwoti násu!”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Ndubo Yudaƒuɔ kɔtu bɔni na bana ekpidi pii ɔsu, na lɛɛɛdubo mina kasusu bɔvumana. Béni mina ala ani mɔɔtina-ma na banii baladi mina litemi lɛlɔ. Na baƒiɔ bani na bana bati kuuku bákpa na baaadi lɛla lɛdi bákpanku-ma na báyii ulu.

english_verse: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubɔya na ogya ubakyula Yuda ɔma na ubile kɔgyumanakɔ kɔni na bátu na Yerusalem.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Ndubo Israelƒuɔ kɔtu bɔni na bana ekpidi pii ani ɔsu na lɛɛɛdubo mina kasusu bɔvumana. Béti mina bekyuli babuni bani mɔɔdi mina litemi lɛlɔ béye báƒɔ egulabi. Na béye bani mɔɔyaki ala na lɛgbanvuo kuye kenye.

english_verse: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
translation_verse: Na bébo bawabane báva kalɔ na bédi bani na mɔɔwia kebunku bése kɔmadɔ. Na báya na bekyuli balábu mina lɛnyi lɛni nse kedee, ɔsika ubi ku ɔti ƒui baatɛ ugblebi unwi kudɔ na baayá na mina lɛnyi liisé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
translation_verse: Na adala ani na báƒɔ ɔkpa básiku bekyuli kudɔ na kayu kenye na baavá taatɛ na kakpakɔ biala. Na kɔyu kɔni na bákya bekyuli ni, beeti egulabi ammɔ teeye ntɛ na baaní-mu muedi na Unwoti kakpakɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
translation_verse: “Israel, Amoriƒuɔ lɛnɔ benye mmɔ uwi ɔni na bíduo Kanaan. Bekyuli bammɔ badi bekyuli bani na bákuku aani egyii enengudi ani na ebo ɔkplu geen. Nsu lɛ́bɔku-ma lídie mmɔ ƒui lidu ku lidu.

english_verse: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́ƒɔ-mii lɛ́siku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ, na akwa aavlene sɔɔn na lɛ́da-mii na lɛ́nu-mii lɛlɔ na ketele kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ kemmo. Na líti Amoriƒuɔ kalɔ líte-mii.

english_verse: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Lɛ́bla bina bebi bananabi badi na badi mina kenye bediene. Na lídie bana badi líse sɛsɛɛ úte mina kabla na baalɔ-ma Nasareƒuɔ. Ala amɛni ƒui amii Israelƒuɔ bɛgyi ka adi litemi geen. Ami Unwoti násu!

english_verse: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
translation_verse: Nsu bítile kenye bediene bammɔ kuƒi ka batasu mina kenye. Na bínye Nasareƒuɔ bammɔ lɛlɔ ka bataani ntɛ bɔni na lítile-ma kuƒi ka batani.

english_verse: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu ndubo-mii etila butile na bɛƒɛ biwi kalɔ aani kalɛ na baatɛ ala teetuloku kɛɛkɛ na ɔɔƒɛ teewi kalɔ.

english_verse: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
translation_verse: Ina dɛ na bina lɛgba lɛɛta ni, bilakana bukeli. Na ina dɛ na bibo ɔlɔkplu ni, ndubutile-mii ala na libile-mii ɔlɔkplu ɔmmɔ na bikpi muedi, na ina dɛ na adi ukpone ni, alakana lɛlɔ budie.

english_verse: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ina dɛ na kataminta ku atula bubo bɔ́ma-mii ni, bilakana kekpo kammɔ kenye bunye. Nsu bilakana bukeli bɔtɔlɔ lɛnɔ ku lɛgba iye bapɔnkɔ na ɔdi ɔkɛ ngba.

english_verse: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ina dɛ na bibo kayi ku ɔlɔkplu ni, badubo-mii bɔbɔku bɔtɔlɔku na bedie-mii kasɔngya kede kede. Ami Unwoti násu!”

english_verse: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.
translation_verse: “Israelƒuɔ, ami nékpo na lɛ́ƒɔ-mii lɛ́siku Egyipteƒuɔ enu kemmo. Nsu bise atu na binu bɔdɔnku bɔni na mɔɔdɔnku-mii.
