translation_verse: Bɛdubo bɔdi bɔsia kama, nsu bilémo. Na bɛdubɔklibi ala abuni bise lɛlɔ, nsu aaadubo ami adi bunwini. Ɔsika kuwii kenye na ndubɔya na beƒie-nya baƒɔ batɔlɔku na kekpo kemmo.

english_verse: You won't harvest what you plant or use the oil from your olive trees or drink the wine from grapes you grow.
translation_verse: Bɛdubo bɔtuma, nsu bɛɛɛdubo edula ammɔ bɔƒɛ. Na ndubɔya na bidie nnɔ kaduɛ, nsu amii alati bileti-mu bilabla lɛla lɛdi. Na bɛdubo egyiibi bubulo na bidie ntɛ, nsu bilákɛ-mu biláni.

english_verse: Jerusalem, this will happen because you followed the sinful example of kings Omri and Ahab. Now I will destroy you and your property. Then the people of every nation will make fun and insult you.
translation_verse: “Ala amɛni ndubo-mii bɔlɛku na ɔni na bɛsiaku Ɔga Omri ku ubidi Ɔga Ahab likyulikpi ala bɔbla kama ɔsu. Anwuɔsu ndubo-mii udu bɔyila ku bina akɛla ƒui na kadi bamba bekyuli ƒui bataama-mii na bedumi-mii.”

english_verse: No one is loyal to God; no one does right. Everyone is brutal and eager to deceive everyone else.
translation_verse: Naaanu ukyuli ɔdi na ɔsiaku Katɔti kama siin. Na ɔdi lɛnɔ ulábla lɛla lɛbuni lɛdi. Ulikplu ku kalala kani nkya ukyuli biala na kalɛ na bebile bana bakpana ngba lɛlɔ kagyumana kani na ɔdi biala unye.

english_verse: The most honest of them is worse than a thorn patch. Your doom has come! Lookouts sound the warning, and everyone panics.
translation_verse: Bekyuli babuni ƒui bani na bakya-ma akɔ muedi betulo liyu alakpi ani náka ámana lɛla lɛdi. Kenye bediene ku bani mɔɔnu bana ablala taasu béte bɔti ka bana bɔkyula uwi údu na bábla gyuma gyuma na béƒu ku bɔyia.

english_verse: Don't trust anyone, not even your best friend, and be careful what you say to the one you love.
translation_verse: Uuubo ɔni na ɔdi ɔsɔ ɔƒɔ ɔkpanadi ɔdi ina dɛ na biidúku. Anwuɔsu si ɔdi aatɛmiku ƒula ɔyɔne muedi ntu ánu kaduɛ.

english_verse: Sons refuse to respect their own fathers, daughters rebel against their own mothers, and daughters-in-law despise their mothers-in-law. Your family is now your enemy.
translation_verse: Bebi bananabi béni na basɔ balábu bana bati, na belekubi lɛnɔ báta bénye bana beni lɛlɔ. Na bebi bele béni bana begyieni. Na ukyuli ukisine geen ni, ɔdubɔsi anwu ɔlati nwuna kaduli kemmo.

english_verse: But I trust the Lord God to save me, and I will wait for him to answer my prayer. The Nation Turns to God
translation_verse: Nsu mina anu ƒui asia Unwoti Katɔti lɛlɔ ka ɔƒɔ-mi ngba, na anwu kani na ndubunye ntaanu ulu teete ka unu-mi bɔkpali na ubunku-mi. Israelƒuɔ Kayi Bunwini

english_verse: My enemies, don't be glad because of my troubles! I may have fallen, but I will get up; I may be sitting in the dark, but the Lord is my light.
translation_verse: Mina bekisine, bitakun tɔ lɛmɛnɛ na mina lɛlɔ. Use ka líbuli bɔdi, nsu nsɔ ndubo bɔta. Ina ka ɔƒɛ ɔ́sa ɔ́kya-mi ni, Unwoti ndi mina bukeye.

english_verse: I have sinned against the Lord. And so I must endure his anger, until he comes to my defense. But I know that I will see him making things right for me and leading me to the light.
translation_verse: Lɛ́bla likpidi lɛ́ƒiɔ Unwoti, anwuɔsu na lɛkana libo abi si nwuna kɔnyi kúbo-mi lɛlɔ wetédu uwi ɔni na ɔ́nu-mi kɔnyana na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́klibi ami ku-nwu ntɛ na ɔ́ƒɔ-mi. Na ngyi ka ɔdubɔsɔku-mi ubenyene mina kenyekɔ kabuni kammɔ lɛlɔ na lɛnu nwuna bukeye na udie-mi.

english_verse: You, my enemies, said, “The Lord God is helpless.” Now each of you will be disgraced and put to shame. I will see you trampled like mud in the street. A Bright Future
translation_verse: Amii mina bekisine bani mɔɔsu bɛnii, “Unwoti ɔɔɔdubo-nwu bɔkana bubunku” ni, bɛdubɔnu ɔmɛni na kɔƒa kukpo-mii. Na ami mmomu ndubo bɔnu kalɛ na bɛdubo bubuli na banya-mii bavi aani ulu ntɛ aba.

english_verse: Towns of Judah, the day is coming when your walls will be rebuilt, and your boundaries enlarged.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdubo ɔni na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na basɔku amii Yuda lɛma awodu ƒui batu na ɔya na bina lɛmii lɛnɔ lisie kama na bina kalɔ kabɛbɛ kebu.

english_verse: People will flock to you from Assyria and Egypt, from Babylonia and everywhere else.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badubɔta na bana limomo kemmo basi Asiria ku Egyipte ku Babilon kɔlɔ lɛlɔ ku kesii bamba ƒui bebo-mii kudɔ.

english_verse: Those nations will suffer disaster because of what they did. Micah's Prayer and the Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku ala ani na bábla-mii ɔsu ni, kɔlɔ kɔmɛni bekyuli badubo abi bubo na ɔgbankpi lidu lidu kemmo. Unwoti Ɔ́nu Israelƒuɔ Kɔnyana

english_verse: Lead your people, Lord! Come and be our shepherd. Grasslands surround us, but we live in a forest. So lead us to Bashan and Gilead, and let us find pasture as we did long ago.
translation_verse: Unwoti, tɔnku ƒula kadi bekyuli bani nlie lɛti na lɛku kemmo, na ada ama bani na áƒuna éte lɛlɔ aani baƒonu ɔdane kalɛ asiaku kalɔ kabuni kemmo kesii kani na badubɔkɛ livo lɛbuni na Basan ku Gilead kalɔ kemmo aani kalɛ na úse kuuku.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will work miracles just as I did when I led you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: “Ami Unwoti ndubo akɔla budie taatina bɔbla aani kalɛ na lɛ́bla uwi ɔni na bɛ́si bɛ́lɛ Egyipte kalɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Nations will see this and be ashamed because of their helpless armies. They will be in shock, unable to speak or hear,
translation_verse: Kadi bamba bekyuli badubo ɔmɛni bɔnu na beti enu bebi kenye na betile bana atuƒi ku kɔƒa geen, ɔsika bana bekpone badi balakana lɛla lɛni udu na lise lɛni bɔbla.”

english_verse: because of their fear of me, your Lord and God. Then they will come trembling, crawling out of their fortresses like insects or snakes, lapping up the dust. No One Is Like God The people said:
translation_verse: Badubɔdi lɛti na bakɛ bataakpɛ taavi kalɔ aani balakpi ku bana udu bamba. Na badubo bukeli bɔsi bana kɔkyakɔ na balɛ basi bana kɔbɛkɔ kpakplaa ƒui bebo ku liƒu kpakpaakpa na Unwoti bula Katɔti bɔyia ɔsu.

english_verse: Our God, no one is like you. We are all that is left of your chosen people, and you freely forgive our sin and guilt. You don't stay angry forever; you're glad to have pity
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti, beleti baƒiɔ badi balákɔku-ɔ, ɔsika eeti likpidi taakyiɛ abu ƒula bekyuli baƒunadi ɛlɛɛ bani nébu, na eléti kɔnyi taakya-bu uwi ƒui, mmomu aayɔ́-bu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: and pleased to be merciful. You will trample on our sins and throw them in the sea.
translation_verse: Ɔdubɔyɔ-ɔ kaƒɔ ka asɔ anu-bu kɔnyana na anya bula ekpidi esusu kalɔ na ebo-nya ƒui avaakun atákya ɛpu kemmo.

english_verse: You will keep your word and be faithful to Jacob and to Abraham, as you promised our ancestors many years ago.
translation_verse: Adubo ƒula litemi kama bɔsia siin na alálɛ bula Nana Yakob ku Abraham kama kudii aani kalɛ na ése bula bati kuuku kenye ése uwi ɔni návi kukuuku kemmo.

english_verse: I am Nahum from Elkosh. And this is the message that I wrote down about Nineveh. The Fierce Anger of the Lord
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su kenye kadi ɔ́siku Niniwe lɛlɔ na údie ɔ́tina Nahum ɔni nási Elkosi. Unwoti Úti Kɔnyi Kpakplaa Ɔ́kya Niniwe

english_verse: The Lord God demands loyalty. In his anger, he takes revenge on his enemies.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdi Katɔti ɔni naaawia ka ukyuli ɔdi ukpoku-nwu kogyulo, mmomu ɔɔwia ka badi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ siin. Na ɔɔƒɔ nwuna bekisine kayu teedie-ma kasi na kɔnyi kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord is powerful, yet patient; he makes sure that the guilty are always punished. He can be seen in storms and in whirlwinds; clouds are the dust from his feet.
translation_verse: Unwoti use buɛɛ na uleyile kɔnyi buti, nsu ubo ɔyikun. Anwuɔsu bani ƒui mɔɔƒiɔ́-nwu ni, ɔɔnu ka ɔ́ni-ma kɔtu, na ɔdi ulekeli lɛtuni lɛmmɔ. Nwuna ablala eedie lɛlɔ keyi na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔni mɔɔkya ligede kemmo. Na nwuna lɛgba kalɔ ɔtumu ndi liƒlukutu lɛni bɔɔnu.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, oceans and rivers dry up. Bashan, Mount Carmel, and Lebanon wither, and their flowers fade.
translation_verse: Si Unwoti údie lɛdi ni, ɛpu ku ntukpa ƒui bɔɔkwii, na aku ani nkya Basan ku Karmel ku Lebanon abi lɛlɔ ƒui egyii ku anwula aayɛyɛ.

english_verse: At the sight of the Lord, mountains and hills tremble and melt; the earth and its people shudder and shake.
translation_verse: Na si ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ ni, abi ammɔ aagyú taawɔ, na abinkpo eegyingya aani kalɛ na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛyɛlɛ, na kalɔ kammɔ ku kana lɛlɔ bekyuli ƒui baatɔ́ kpakpaakpa na nwuna anumi.

english_verse: Who can stand the heat of his furious anger? It flashes out like fire and shatters stones. The Power of Assyria Will Be Broken
translation_verse: Ɔma ndubɔkana Unwoti kɔnyi kpakplaa kɔmmɔ kenye bunye? Nwuna kɔnyi kuubile ala aani kalɛ na ogya ɔɔda taakyula ala, na atabi muedi aabwɛ. Unwoti Ɔdubo Asiriaƒuɔ Ɔyikun Bubile

english_verse: The Lord is good. He protects those who trust him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdia, na ɔɔgyumana bekyuli bani néti bana anu básia-nwu lɛlɔ, na uudie-ma na lɛbibo uwi.

english_verse: But like a roaring flood, the Lord chases his enemies into dark places and destroys them.
translation_verse: Nsu nwuna bekisine ama ni, ɔɔbɔku-ma taatákya kasuudikɔ aani kalɛ na ketu kani néyi kaagbála ala ku kɔku momoomo taatɔlɔku, na ɔyila-ma udu.

english_verse: So don't plot against the Lord! He wipes out his enemies, and they never revive.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu kayi katatɔlɔ ɔdi na anwu ku ɔdi babla kasusu kekpidi na Unwoti lɛlɔ, ɔsika Unwoti uléti kɔnyi taaní bekyuli kɔtu na bakali banii basɔ bebo ngba bɔdi!

english_verse: They are like drunkards overcome by wine, or like twisted thornbushes burning in a fire.
translation_verse: Mmomu ala adubo-ma bunyimi aani kalɛ na liyu alakpi eedie bekyuli iye ntɛ bɔɔda-ma. Ogya ɔdubɔkyula-ma kede kede aani alakpi ani nákwii kalɛ.

english_verse: Assyria, one of your rulers has made evil plans against the Lord.
translation_verse: Asiria, bina batɔnkune akɔ unwi ɔ́ya na bása lili bábla kasusu kekpidi na Unwoti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Assyria, no matter how strong you are, you will be cut down! My people Judah, I have troubled you before, but I won't do it again.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ndi lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔɔsu ɔnii, “Ina dɛ na Asiriaƒuɔ bemomo na bábla unwi na bebo ɔyikun ni, badubo udu bɔyii! Na awɔ Yuda ina ka lɛ́ya na ébo abi dii muedi ni, nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na ɔmmɔ udu ɔsɔ ɔlɛku-ɔ.

english_verse: I'll snap your chains and set you free from the Assyrians.”
translation_verse: Ndubɔƒɛ bina kɔgba kɔni nda-mii na lɛya bɛkɛ bɔnwuna bɛsiku Asiriaƒuɔ kudɔ.”

english_verse: Assyria, this is what else the Lord says to you: “Your name will be forgotten. I will destroy every idol in your temple, and I will send you to the grave, because you are worthless.”
translation_verse: Na amii Asiriaƒuɔ ni, Unwoti ɔ́su lɛnɔ na bina lɛlɔ ɔnii, “Bina anyi adubɔyii ƒui kede kede, na bebi badi basɔ balakya-mii kama na bakɔliku-mii lɛnyi katɔ. Na ndubɔbwɛ bina baƒiɔ bani na bɛ́vɔ ku bani na bɛ́nwi bíse bina aƒiodu ƒui. Na bina likyulikpi ɔsu ni, ndubo-mii kɔƒiɔtɔ budie buse.

english_verse: Look toward the mountains, people of Judah! Here comes a messenger with good news of peace. Celebrate your festivals. Keep your promises to God. Your evil enemies are destroyed and will never again invade your country.
translation_verse: “Amii Yudaƒuɔ, bɛɛnu ka ɔtalane ɔdi ɔ́si abi lɛlɔ ɔdubo ku keyi buɛɛ linyesia lɛbuni. Bɛdi bina emeyi abuni ku lɛlɔyɔ na bɛbla bɛsiaku kenye kani na bíse Unwoti lɛlɔ. Ɔsika lɛ́yila bina bekisine ƒui udu, na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo bɔya na basɔ bebekpo-mii.”

english_verse: Nineveh, someone is coming to attack and scatter you. Guard your fortresses! Watch the road! Be brave! Prepare for battle!
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ɔdubo ubekpo awɔ Niniwe, na ugyingya-a kede kede. Anwuɔsu nye ƒula kɔgyumanakɔ kpakplaa kɔmmɔ kemmo kaduɛ na ataanu ulu! Na aklibi lɛlɔ ete kekpo na atina ƒula lɛnanabi!

english_verse: Judah and Israel are like trees with branches broken by their enemies. But the Lord is going to restore their power and glory. *
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔsɔku Israel kadi kani na bana bekisine báƒɛ béwi kalɔ ku bana adingyii kɔgba, na bébile-ma ƒui unyene bana kenyekɔ na basɔ beteekeye.

english_verse: Their horses prance, and their armored chariots dart around like lightning or flaming torches.
translation_verse: Na bapɔnkɔ bammɔ badanku kɛɛkɛ lɛmmɔ beekeliku taavinku ɔma ɔmmɔ lɛblɔnu lɛlɔ ƒui teesie taasɔ ku usi momoomo na liikeye taabwɛ ogya aani kalɛ na kayaa kaabwɛ ogya.

english_verse: An officer gives a command. But his soldiers stumble, as they hasten to build a shelter to protect themselves against rocks thrown down from the city wall.
translation_verse: Na bana bekpone unengu ɔdi údie lɛdi úte bekpone bani na ɔ́ƒuna mmɔ, na békeli bésela ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kowodu kudɔ, nsu bakɛ beetulo. Na atakpɛ ani na beebó taavialaku kowodu kɔmmɔ eli taabayula ɔsu ni, báwia ala bagyumana lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Nineveh is disgraced. The queen is dragged off. Her servant women mourn; they moan like doves, and they beat their breasts in sorrow.
translation_verse: Niniwe anumi éwi kalɔ, na báni beleku ɔga ɔmmɔ bátɔlɔku, na nwuna lɛlɔ banune belekubi bammɔ beewulo kɔnyana taabla aani kalɛ na babloduma beedumo, na béƒie eli bada ku kɔnyana.

english_verse: Nineveh is like a pond with leaking water. Shouts of “Stop! Don't go!” can be heard everywhere. But everyone is leaving.
translation_verse: Niniwe use aani libiɔ lɛni na bátu na lɛ́bwɛ na nina ntu bɔɔlɛ́ taatɔlɔ, ɔsika kɔvanu kɔda kesi kesii banini, “Bitatɔlɔ! Bitatɔlɔ!” Nsu lɛni kani na ukyuli biala ɔ́vi ɔɔlɛ́ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers shout, “The city is full of treasure and all kinds of wealth. Steal her silver! Grab her gold!”
translation_verse: Na bekisine bekpone bammɔ baava taasu banini, “Akɛla lidu lidu lɛ́ƒɔ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo tɛtɛɛtɛ. Bíyu nwuna sika ɔƒualadi bɛ́tɔlɔku, na bíƒie nwuna sika ugyiedi bɛƒɔ!

english_verse: Nineveh is doomed! Destroyed! Her people tremble with fear; their faces turn pale.
translation_verse: Niniwe ɔdi ɔ́sa ɔƒɛni amu! Bábwɛ ɔma ɔmmɔ, na liƒu bonwu líƒie bekyuli bammɔ na benye baatɔ́ kpakpaakpa, na bana anumi ábla ƒuƒuu na bɔyia ɔsu.”

english_verse: What happened to this city? They were safer there than powerful lions in a den, with no one to disturb them.
translation_verse: Bi nálɛku ɔma ɔmɛni lɛni? Kuuku ni, na nka beli-nwu ƒaa betulo bagyata bayikune bani ntɛ bana atabi libu kemmo na balayia ku lɛla, ɔsika ɔdi ulakana-ma bɔni bude.

english_verse: These are the same lions that ferociously attacked their victims, then dragged away the flesh to feed their young.
translation_verse: Ama nse aani bagyata bammɔ bani muuƒie bana bebuokpana taatɔlɔku teetéte bana bebi na bakun.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is against you, Nineveh. God will burn your chariots and send an army to kill those young lions of yours. You will never again make victims of others or send messengers to threaten everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Niniwe, Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́ta únye-ɔ lɛlɔ na ɔdubo ƒula bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ lɛmmɔ ƒui bɔkyula ku ogya. Na bina bebi bani nási baakɔ́ aani bagyata bebi bina kalɛ kani ni, ɔdubɔya na bekpone badi bebo babadu-ma ƒui kede kede. Na bɛsɔ biladi bekyuli badi lɛlɔ iye bɛtala batu badi bɛkya-ma na bitaakya-ma liƒu lɛdi na kalɔ lɛlɔ kesii kadi.

english_verse: cavalry attacking, swords and spears flashing; soldiers stumbling over piles of dead bodies.
translation_verse: Na bekpone bani nli bapɔnkɔ lɛlɔ beeƒwimi bana kuwii na baatu bana atula. Na bekpone bani nkɛ lɛgba baanya bekpine bani nwi esu esu taagbanta.

english_verse: You were nothing more than a prostitute using your magical charms and witchcraft to attract and trap nations.
translation_verse: Bítavumana ku bayalɛ bani na uwi ɔni na bɛkya biidie bekyuli anumi ku bina evo ekpidi ku mbɔ bɔni na bɛda, na bɛɛkywɛ kadi bekyuli ƒui kɔkpagyuɛ ka bɛni-ma biboku lɛlɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, am now your enemy. I will pull up your skirt and let nations and kingdoms stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: Nsu ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, línwini bina ukisine ɔƒɛni amu. Ndubo bina lɛwuku bɔni budie-mii lɛlɔ, na lɛya na kadi bekyuli ƒui ku lɛga kadikɔ ƒui banu bina kasɔngya.

english_verse: I will cover you with garbage, treat you like trash, and rub you in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ndubo kebu alakpi bɔbuma buwi-mii lɛlɔ, na ntaanu amii ku ala ammɔ ƒui aani kebu alakpi, na lisusu-mii lɛkya alakpi ammɔ akɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who sees you will turn away and shout, “Nineveh is done for! Is anyone willing to mourn or to give her comfort?” Nineveh's Fate Is Sealed
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni manu ɔmɛni ɔdubudie lili na ɔva ɔsu ka Niniwe ɔdi ɔ́sa! Na beye si ukyuli ɔdi ɔdubuwulo-nwu kɔnyana na ubunku-nwu iye ɔsia-nwu kɔnu? Bálɛ Niniwe Lɛtuni Lɛmɛni Ugyii

english_verse: Nineveh, do you feel safer than the city of Thebes? The Nile River was its wall of defense.
translation_verse: “Niniwe, aabu anii awɔ ɔdi adubuse-ɔ buɛɛ utulo Tebes ɔma unengudi ɔdi? Nil Ketu bonwu nwi ɔ́ka ɔ́mana-nwu aani kɔwodu kɔni mɔɔgyumana-nwu.

english_verse: Thebes trusted the mighty power of Ethiopia and Egypt; the nations of Put and Libya were her allies.
translation_verse: Tebes úti nwuna anu ƒui ɔ́sia Kus kalɛkɛ kani nkya Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ bekpone ɔyikun bonwu lɛlɔ ku Put ku Libia kɔlɔ bekpone bani násala lɛlɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But she was captured and taken to a foreign country. Her children were murdered at every street corner. The members of her royal family were auctioned off, and her high officials were bound in chains.
translation_verse: Nsu béƒie-nwu na béti-nwu bésienku kaƒɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na bádu nwuna bebi béwi lɛblɔnu lɛkɔkɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na bekyuli bani ndi bagadine ƒui ni, bádi-ma kuye na kadi bekyuli anumi. Na bakutine benengu ƒui bébo-ma kɔgba enu ku lɛgba.

english_verse: Nineveh, now it's your turn! You will get drunk and try to hide from your enemy.
translation_verse: “Niniwe, awɔ lɛnɔ ƒula uwi údu. Adubo ntɛ bukpi na awia ulu ka abɛla lɛlɔ asiku ƒula bekisine kudɔ.

english_verse: Your fortresses are fig trees with ripe figs. Merely shake the trees, and fruit will fall into every open mouth.
translation_verse: Bina kɔgyumanakɔ kpakplaa kɔni na bibo kuse aani anwingyie ani ebi négyie. Si bɛ́kunku-nya ni, ebi ammɔ adubɔnu eduo-mii nnye bɔni na bíbimi bíwi kemmo.

english_verse: Your army is weak. Fire has destroyed the crossbars on your city gates; now they stand wide open to your enemy.
translation_verse: Ƒula bekpone bese aani beleku, na ogya ɔ́kyula ƒula ɔban kayakun lɛbalala, na kayakun kammɔ kálɛmi kewi kéte ƒula bekisine ka beduo.

english_verse: Your city is under attack. Haul in extra water! Strengthen your defenses! Start making bricks! Stir the mortar!
translation_verse: “Báka ƒula ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ bákya, na bekisine badubo-nwu bukpoku. Bidu ntu, na bumomo bubu na bɛsɔku bina ɔma kɔgyumanakɔ kɔmmɔ bɛtu. Na bɛnwu lɛti na bikulo atimbɔ.

english_verse: You will still go up in flames and be cut down by swords that will wipe you out like a field attacked by grasshoppers. So, go ahead and increase like a swarm of locusts!
translation_verse: Nsu ina amu badubo-mii bɔkyula ku ogya na badu-mii ku kuwii na bayila-mii udu, na bewiile-mii bewi kalɔ aani kalɛ na bakpɔtilikpɔ beebile edula. Anwuɔsu amii bidie atu na bitaawɔ teemomo aani baalɔlɔ.

english_verse: More merchants are in your city than there are stars in the sky— but they are like locusts that eat everything, then fly away.
translation_verse: Beyedine báƒɔ-mii ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo betulo ayabi ani nkya kayaa. Nsu buse kani na bese aani baalɔlɔ bani mɔɔdi ala teedie na beveyi batɔlɔ.

english_verse: Your guards and your officials are swarms of locusts. On a chilly day they settle on a fence, but when the sun comes out, they take off to who-knows-where.
translation_verse: Bina bagyumanane ku bakutine ƒui bátavumana ku baalɔlɔ. Ɔsika si kɔyɔ kɔkya ni, baayu teelie ɔban ligyii lɛlɔ. Na si ɔƒɛ úse kalɔ ɔɔbi ni, beeveyi taatɔlɔ, na ukyuli ɔdi ulati kesii kani na bésie.

english_verse: King of Assyria, your officials and leaders are sound asleep, while your people are scattered in the mountains. Yes, your people are sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: “Asiriaƒuɔ ɔga, ƒula bakutine ku benengu ƒui bálɛɛ lɛlɛɛ linwi ɔni na basɔ baaadubo bɔta. Na ƒula kadi bekyuli bakladi ama bégyingya-ma bákya abi lɛlɔ. Na bekyuli bammɔ bese aani baƒonu bani neeebo ɔdane.

english_verse: You're fatally wounded. There's no hope for you. But everyone claps when they hear this news, because your constant cruelty has caused them pain.
translation_verse: Bɛ́ƒɔ lɛlɛ bonwu lɛni naaadia bɔnu, na bɛsɔ biiibo lɛnunsia lɛdi. Anwuɔsu bekyuli ƒui bágya enukpɛ uwi ɔni na bénu ƒula lɛlɔ litemi lɛmɛni, ɔsika bina kalala kani na bítaabla taasia kama ɔ́ya na bébo abi pii.”

english_verse: I am Habakkuk the prophet. And this is the message that the Lord gave me. Habakkuk Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Unwoti údie lɛla lɛdi ɔ́tina Kenye Udiene Habakuk. Habakuk Úwulo Kɔnyana Ɔ́kya Unwoti

english_verse: Our Lord, how long must I beg for your help before you listen? How long before you save us from all this violence?
translation_verse: Unwoti, uwi ɛlɛ sɔɔn na ndubunye nteevele-ɔ nnii bunku-bu ntédu asa na enu ete-mi? Na uwi ɛlɛ kama asa na adububo ebedie-bu alɛku kalɛ na bekyuli báta benye beekpóku-bu mɛni kemmo?

english_verse: Laws cannot be enforced; justice is always the loser; criminals crowd out honest people and twist the laws around. The Lord Answers Habakkuk
translation_verse: Belenye bekyuli lɛlɔ na badi ƒula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Na litemi bɔtɛ ulu siin lɛlɔ amu bɔ́yii udu kula kula. Bakantankpine báka ƒula bekyuli babuni bákya na bátu ƒula ɔda bubo bénwini kalɛ kalɛ na ama baayɔ́. Unwoti Údie Habakuk Lɛla Lɛni Na Úye-nwu Kenye

english_verse: Look and be amazed at what's happening among the nations! Even if you were told, you would never believe what's taking place now.
translation_verse: “Nwini na anu ala ani mɔɔlɛ́ na kadi bekyuli ƒui akɔ na ɔdubɔbla-a kalɛ kadi! Ɔsika ndubo lɛla lɛdi bɔbla na bina uwi lɛni na si ina bínu ka baasu-ni muedi ni, biláƒɔ biladi.

english_verse: I am sending the Babylonians. They are fierce and cruel— marching across the land, conquering cities and towns.
translation_verse: Ndubo Babilonƒuɔ bɔtala na babwɛ bavi kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ ku kɔnyi na badi lɛma linengudi ku libliidi ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: How fearsome and frightening. Their only laws and rules are the ones they make up.
translation_verse: Bana lɛlɔ libo liƒu na bekyuli baayia-ma geen. Na ama alati bana ɔda bubo bɔni na bényimi béte lɛlɔ kani lɛlɔ na baanu bana bɔdia.

english_verse: Then suddenly they disappear like a gust of wind— those sinful people who worship their own strength. Habakkuk Complains Again
translation_verse: Na si bekyuli bekpidi bani mɔɔkun lɛmɛne mɛni na baanu bana ɔyikun teetulo lɛla biala báwɔlɔ lɛni ni, na batɔlɔ mmɔ kɔnakunwi aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔdi uukpó taavi ku usi.” Habakuk Ɔ́sɔ Úwulo Kɔnyana

english_verse: Holy Lord God, mighty rock, you are eternal, and we are safe from death. You are using those Babylonians to judge and punish others.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti Kedee, adi mina katamikukɔ lɛtakpɛ bonwu, na eli ésela uwi ƒui na aaadubo bɔya na likpi. Áya na Babilonƒuɔ bénwini bayikune na baatɛku bekyuli bamba litemi na bani-ma kɔtu.

english_verse: But you can't stand sin or wrong. So don't sit by in silence while they gobble up people who are better than they are.
translation_verse: Nsu alatunaku likpidi munu munu. Anwuɔsu tasɔ tenye tanu bekyuli bamɛni kpoo lɛni na beteebile bekyuli bamba bani na nka badia betulo-ma kukuuku ƒui ngba lɛni.

english_verse: The people you put on this earth are like fish or reptiles without a leader.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani na édie ákya kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ ni, bese aani ketu kemmo kɔbɛ iye bebuo bamba bani mɔɔkpɛ́ bana kaƒɔ lɛlɔ na beeebo batɔnkune.

english_verse: Then an enemy comes along and takes them captive with hooks and nets. It makes him so happy
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ukisine uuti nwuna lɛsawu ku lɛdaliwa na ubeƒie-ma ɔtɔlɔku ƒui na bekisine bammɔ bataakɛ ebiti.

english_verse: that he offers sacrifices to his fishing nets, because they make him rich and provide choice foods.
translation_verse: Na beesié taatákpa ala na baanwá teete bana lɛsawu ku lɛdaliwa lɛmmɔ bɔdi ka bákɛ lɛla lɛni na baawia ɔsu.

english_verse: While standing guard on the watchtower, I waited for the Lord's answer, before explaining the reason for my complaint.
translation_verse: Ndubunye kesii kani na nnye mɔɔgyumana mmɔ ntaanu ulu lite lɛla lɛni na mina Unwoti ɔdubo-mi bɔsu na kɔnyana kɔni na muuwulo taakpali-nwu kenye.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: “I will give you my message in the form of a vision. Write it clearly enough to be read at a glance.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ndubuti lɛla lɛni na mbo na masu-ɔ lɛsia kɔyu kemmo ala bɔnu na kɔna kemmo lɛlɔ lite-ɔ. Nweni ala ammɔ se nwaa kalɛ na ukyuli ɔnu-nya ɔka kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: At the time I have decided, my words will come true. You can trust what I say about the future. It may take a long time, but keep on waiting— it will happen!
translation_verse: Na adubunu ala ammɔ na uwi ɔni na ami ɔlati lɛ́lɛ ugyii líse lɛlɔ, na ubo-nwu kemmo lɛnɔ lɛni kani. Na mɔɔsu-ɔ nnii ɔlɛka aƒɔ ala ani na masu-ɔ ka adubɔlɛ uwi ɔni mebo kemmo mmɔ adi. Na si ina uwi uutu muedi ni, awɔ nye taanu ulu ka adububo abálɛ lɛni kani.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, refuse to accept anyone who is proud. Only those who live by faith are acceptable to me.” Trouble for Evil People
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala na ɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ ulelie ngba. Nsu bani mɔɔsiaku-mi kama siin ni, badubulie ngba na bana bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo. Ɔgbankpi Ɔdubɔsiaku Bekyuli Bekpidi

english_verse: Wine is treacherous, and arrogant people are never satisfied. They are no less greedy than death itself— they open their mouths as wide as the world of the dead and swallow everyone.
translation_verse: “Ntɛ buubile ukyuli, na ulabla ala siin. Na bekyuli bani mɔɔnu lɛlɔ katɔ katɔ ni, ala elemo-ma na bátavumana ku kukpi kɔni mɔɔdú bekyuli na kulemo. Ɔsika lɛni na bana nnye búbimi buwi ka bebweli ukyuli biala.

english_verse: But they will be mocked with these words: You're doomed! You stored up stolen goods and cheated others of what belonged to them.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli badubo-ma bɔma na basu-ma banini, ‘Bɔbuɛ ute-mii! Bɛ́nya bekyuli bɛ́kya na bíyu-ma ala ani na bebo bíti bínwini amii adi bɛ́tɛ bíse lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: But without warning, those you owe will demand payment. Then you will become a frightened victim.
translation_verse: “Nsu bɛɛɛdubo bɔti buse asa na bekyuli bani na bɛda kɔyu badubɔta bebenye-mii lɛlɔ banii bɛƒɔ-ma bana kɔyu na binwini bekeline bani ndubo butaayia.

english_verse: You robbed cities and nations everywhere on earth and murdered their people. Now those who survived will be as cruel to you.
translation_verse: Bíyu ala na lɛma linengudi ku kɔlɔ ƒui kemmo na kesi kesii, na bɛ́du bana bekyuli lɛnɔ. Na ɔƒaani ni, bani nébu badubo amii lɛnɔ kalala kani udu na bɛ́bla bekyuli bɔbla.

english_verse: You're doomed! You made your family rich at the expense of others. You even said to yourself, “I'm above the law.”
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ ute-mii! Ɔsika amii nénye bekyuli lɛlɔ na bíƒie-ma ala bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́bla lɛkɛ bíse bina bebi. Na bɛ́su ku bɔsu muedi bɛnini, ‘Ɔda bubo bɔdi buladi-bu lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: But you will bring shame on your family and ruin to yourself for what you did to others.
translation_verse: Nsu bɛ́ya na kɔƒa bonwu kɔdubo bina bekyuli bukpo na bina ala ayii udu na ala ani na bɛ́bla bekyuli ɔsu.

english_verse: The very stones and wood in your home will testify against you.
translation_verse: Bina kaduli atabi ku ligyii muedi badubo kenye budie bɔsiku bina ablala lɛlɔ beti badu-mii kɔtɔ.

english_verse: You're doomed! You built a city on crime and violence.
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ ute-mii! Ɔsika alaekpidi bonwu bɔbla ku lɛsɛ bɔkya ku bekyuli bɔdu lɛlɔ na bɛ́da bina ɔma unengudi bɛ́sia.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful sends up in flames what nations and people work so hard to gain.
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔɔkyula ala ani na kayawi bekyuli bébo abi kpakplaa bábla bése.

english_verse: Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na ɛpu ɔɔƒɔ́ ntu na uuyi ni, lɛni kani na bekyuli bani mɔɔbu na baayia Unwoti badubɔƒɔ kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: You're doomed! You get your friends drunk, just to see them naked.
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ ute amii bani muute bina bakpana ntɛ bɛnii bani bekpi na bɛnu-ma kasɔngya.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced instead of praised. The Lord will make you drunk, and when others see you naked, you will lose their respect.
translation_verse: Kɔƒa kɔdubo-mii bukpo na basɔ belemwi-mii. Ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubɔya na bɛni ntɛ bikpi na bina bakpana banu-mii kasɔngya na bɛyila ɔbu biala na bana anumi.

english_verse: You destroyed trees and animals on Mount Lebanon; you were ruthless to towns and people everywhere. Now you will be terrorized. Idolatry Is Foolish
translation_verse: Bɛ́yila egyii ku bebuo ƒui udu na Lebanon Kɔbi lɛlɔ. Na bɛ́bla kalala kani udu naaadia na lɛma kemmo ku bekyuli lɛlɔ na kesi kesii. Na ɔƒaani ni, amii na badubo liƒu bɔkya na bitaayia geen. Lɛƒiɔkpa Lɛdi Kɔdɔlɔ Ala Bɔbla

english_verse: What is an idol worth? It's merely a false god. Why trust a speechless image made from wood or metal by human hands?
translation_verse: “Kɔsia kɔmani na baƒiɔ bebo? Ala avɔdi ku anwidi ekpludi ani na bekyuli béti bana enu bábla bálɛku ligyii ku abuala kemmo kani na adi. Na bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka ukyuli uti anu ɔsia ala ani naaatɛmi mɛni lɛlɔ?

english_verse: What can you learn from idols covered with silver or gold? They can't even breathe. Pity anyone who says to an idol of wood or stone, “Get up and do something!”
translation_verse: Bi ndi lɛla lɛni na ukyuli ɔdubɔkana na ɔtɛya ɔsiku baƒiɔ bani na béti sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi bákwaa kemmo? Ala amɛni alanwuna muedi. Kɔnyana litemi bonwu lɛdi lite ukyuli ɔni ndubɔta na ɔsu baƒiɔ bamɛni ɔnini, ‘Ta nye, na abla lɛla lɛdi ete-mi.’

english_verse: Let all the world be silent— the Lord is present in his holy temple.
translation_verse: Bɛya na kayawi bekyuli ƒui babla kpoo, ɔsika Unwoti ɔkya nwuna kakpakɔ kedee kemmo.”

english_verse: This is my prayer:
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ndi Habakuk katɔ bɔkpali bɔni nkɛnku agyala.

english_verse: I know your reputation, Lord, and I am amazed at what you have done. Please turn from your anger and be merciful; do for us what you did for our ancestors.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ngyi kalɛ na áƒɔ lɛnyi, anwuɔsu na ɔ́bla-mi kalɛ kadi ka lɛ́nu ala ani na ábla. Buvele, ya na ƒula kɔnyi kɔyɔ-ɔ, na anu-bu kɔnyana. Na abla ete-bu kalɛ na ábla éte bula bati kuuku.

english_verse: You are the same Holy God who came from Teman and Paran to help us. The brightness of your glory covered the heavens, and your praises were heard everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔni nse kedee, ɔ́si Teman kalɔ lɛlɔ na Paran Kɔbi lɛlɔ. Na kalɛ na nwuna bukeye bɔɔtu anumi ni, ɔ́ƒɔ kayaa ƒui. Na bekyuli beemwi-nwu na kalɔ lɛlɔ kesi kesii.

english_verse: Your glory shone like the sun, and light flashed from your hands, hiding your mighty power.
translation_verse: Nwuna bukeye buse aani ɔƒɛ, na nwuna enu aabwɛ ogya taasi kesii kani na nwuna ɔyikun ɔkya mmɔ.

english_verse: Dreadful diseases and plagues marched in front and followed behind.
translation_verse: Lɛlɛ buɛ lɛni mɔɔdú bekyuli ntɔ-nwu anumi ku kama ƒui.

english_verse: When you stopped, the earth shook; when you stared, nations trembled; when you walked along your ancient paths, eternal mountains and hills crumbled and collapsed.
translation_verse: Si údi únye ni, kalɔ kammɔ ƒui kaakunku. Na si ɔ́nu ɔnusɛ ni, kadi bekyuli ƒui baatɔ́ kpakpaakpa. Na si ɔ́sia nwuna lilu kuuku lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔɔví ni, abi ku abinkpo ani nnye uwi ƒui mmɔ aanyonu lɛlɔ na aabwɛ.

english_verse: The tents of desert tribes in Cushan and Midian were ripped apart.
translation_verse: Lɛ́nu ka Israel bekisine Kus ku Midian bani nli nvo kemmo na kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ béƒu.

english_verse: Our Lord, were you angry with the monsters of the deep? You attacked in your chariot and wiped them out.
translation_verse: Unwoti, ketu bebweyi bammɔ nákya-a kɔnyi ɔni na ási aaví ku ƒula bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ na ɛpu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ? Oowo, mmomu bɔvi kani na ada ku usi ka atádi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Your arrows were ready and obeyed your commands. You split the earth apart with rivers and streams;
translation_verse: Ƒula atula énye kagyumana na bábla lɛla lɛni na bénu ka édie lɛdi éte-ma. Éti ntukpa bunengudi ku bubliidi ƒui na éle kalɔ kammɔ ntɛ akpa anyɔ.

english_verse: mountains trembled at the sight of you; rain poured from the clouds; ocean waves roared and rose.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na áda álɛ ni, abi ammɔ aatɔ́ kpakpaakpa, na ɔnantu ɔɔna taasi liƒlukutu kemmo, na ɛpu uubó avlɔvɔ taakɔ taayu na ɔɔkwanyi ku kɔku bonwu.

english_verse: The sun and moon stood still, while your arrows and spears flashed like lightning.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛ ku kɔbuli ƒui bédi bénye liku linwi kpoo uwi ɔni na aatu ƒula kɔtaminta ku abuala atula taavinku aani kalɛ na kayaa kaabwɛ ogya.

english_verse: In your furious anger, you trampled on nations
translation_verse: Na ánya kadi bekyuli ƒui ábwɛ ávi na kɔnyi kemmo

english_verse: to rescue your people and save your chosen one. You crushed a nation's ruler and stripped his evil kingdom of its power.
translation_verse: kalɛ na etékpo aƒɔ ƒula ɔga ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ. Na kalɔ kani bekyuli mbo kalala mmɔ ni, ádu bana ɔtɔnkune na égyiile-nwu lɛlɔ ala éwi ɔ́si lili úbedu lɛgba.

english_verse: His troops had come like a storm, hoping to scatter us and glad to gobble us up. To them we were refugees in hiding— but you smashed their heads with their own weapons.
translation_verse: Bekisine bammɔ bébo aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ku kasusu ka begyingya-bu. Na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-ma ka badubo-bu bɔyila aani kalɛ na baada lɛla lɛdi teedie na ɔsa. Buse na buse búte-ma aani banyanane bani mɔɔbɛ́. Nsu ama alati bana ekpola kani na éti ábwɛ-ma eli.

english_verse: Then your chariots churned the waters of the sea. Habakkuk's Response to God's Message
translation_verse: Na ƒula kɛɛkɛ úbwiile ɛpu ntu bɔmmɔ ƒui kalɔ ɔ́vi. Habakuk Údie Unwoti Lɛla Lɛni Na Ɔ́su Kenye

english_verse: When I heard this message, I felt weak from fear, and my lips quivered. My bones seemed to melt, and I stumbled around. But I will patiently wait. Someday those vicious enemies will be struck by disaster. Trust in a Time of Trouble
translation_verse: Ka lɛ́nu kɔyu kemmo ala budie taatina bɔmɛni ɔ́siku Unwoti linyesia lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ni, liƒu lɛni náda-mi ɔ́ya na lɛ́bla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ na mina enyekuli kani mɔɔtɔ́ kpakpaakpa. Na ɔ́bla-mi aani bɔyɛɛlɛ na mina ekubi ada na mina lɛlɔ kemmo, na ɔɔbla-mi gbanta gbanta. Nsu ndubɔkɛ kayi na linye kpoo ntaanu ulu teete limeyi lɛni na Unwoti ɔdubɔkyula bekisine bekpidi bamɛni. Nye Kpakplaa Na Lɛbibo Kemmo

english_verse: Fig trees may no longer bloom, or vineyards produce grapes; olive trees may be fruitless, and harvest time a failure; sheep pens may be empty, and cattle stalls vacant—
translation_verse: Ina adingyii lidu ƒui líbulo bɔnwu, na lɛla lɛdi liiibo na edula ɔƒɛwi na bekyuli baƒɛ bakya linwu, iye bebuo ayu ƒui ese ukpludi na baƒonu iye ɔmantɛ bɔkɔ beeebo-ni kemmo,

english_verse: but I will still celebrate because the Lord God is my Savior.
translation_verse: iye edula ebi adi eeebo muedi ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-mi na ebiti ada-mi geen na mina Unwoti ɔni ndi mina ɔƒɔne lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord gives me strength. He makes my feet as sure as those of a deer, and he helps me stand on the mountains. To the music director: Use stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui mɔɔyá na mɔɔkɛ́ ɔyikun. Na mina lɛgba lɛɛyu ɔkplu, na lɛɛta aani kaƒɛ lɛdi, na mɔɔkɛ́ kenyekɔ ƒaa na abi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I am Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the grandson of Gedaliah, the great-grandson of Amariah, and the great-great-grandson of Hezekiah. When Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah, the Lord gave me this message. Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su Seƒania kenye kadi uwi ɔni na Yosia, Amon ubidi, ɔɔdi lɛga na Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na Seƒania ɔti ndi Kusi ɔni ɔti ndi Gedalia ɔni ɔti ndi Amaria ɔni ɔti ndi Hesekia. Unwoti Ɔ́tɛku Yuda Litemi

english_verse: I, the Lord, now promise to destroy everything on this earth—
translation_verse: “Ami Unwoti líse kenye ka ɔƒɛni amu ni, ndubo lɛla biala bɔkyula na kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: people and animals, birds and fish. Everyone who is evil will crash to the ground, and I will wipe out the entire human race.
translation_verse: Bekyuli ku bebuo ku baasɛ ku kɔbɛ bamɛni akɔ ɔni lɛlɔ na likpidi lɛkya ni, ndubo-nwu udu bɔyila na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ. Na lɛkyula bekyuli bammɔ ƒui lidie kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will reach out to punish Judah and Jerusalem— nothing will remain of the god Baal; nothing will be remembered of his pagan priests.
translation_verse: Ndubo mbani Yuda ku Yerusalem kɔtu na lɛla biala lɛsɔ lilébu na banu bati na Baal baƒiɔ lɛlɔ. Na bana bakpane ƒui ɔdi ɔsɔ ulenyimo-ma.

english_verse: Not a trace will be found of those who worship stars from their rooftops, or bow down to the god Milcom, while claiming loyalty to me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Na bani ƒui muulie bana lɛtɔ katɔ taakpali ayabi iye baakya lili kalɔ teete Milkom baƒiɔ, nsu baanyi ɔkɔ ka basiaku-mi kama siin ni, ndubo bana ƒui udu bɔyila.

english_verse: Nothing will remain of anyone who has turned away and rejected me.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ƒui nénwini kama bákya-mi na basɔ balani teede-mi ka bebenu-mi litemi ni, ndubo-ma lɛla biala bɔyila kede kede.

english_verse: Be silent! I am the Lord God, and the time is near. I am preparing to sacrifice my people and to invite my guests.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi Unwoti Katɔti, anwuɔsu bibile bina inye kpoo! Ɔsika uwi ɔmmɔ úude. Na ndaku lɛlɔ bɔklibi ka liti mina bekyuli aani lɛkpa na lɛlɔ mina bekyuli ƒui bani lɛ́klibi líse.

english_verse: On that day I will punish national leaders and sons of the king, along with all who follow foreign customs.
translation_verse: Na ndubo batɔnkune ku bagabi ƒui kɔtu bɔni na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ku bani ƒui nsiaku kadi bamba ɔdi bɔbla kama.

english_verse: I will punish worshipers of pagan gods and cruel palace officials who abuse their power.
translation_verse: Amii bani nsiaku kadi bamba baƒiɔ kama bɛɛkpá-ma, na bɛsiaku baga kesii bakutine belikplune bani néti bana kenyekɔ baabla likyulikpi ala kama ni, ndubo-mii kɔtu bɔni.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that on that day noisy crying will be heard from Fish Gate, New Town, and Upper Hills.
translation_verse: “Ami Unwoti líse kenye ka limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, bekyuli badubo keku buteewulo momoomo geen bɔsi ɔma ɔmmɔ kesii kani baalɔ banii Kɔbɛ Ɔban Kayakun ku Ɔma Ɔwɔdi na beteebuli taaƒɛ lɛlɔ ɔ́si abi atɔdi ammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in Lower Hollow will mourn loudly, because merchants and money changers will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni nli kuye kemmo badubo kanyana buteewulo momoomo, ɔsika Unwoti ɔdubo beyedine ku egulabi bavumanane ƒui udu bɔyila.

english_verse: I'll search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those people who sit there unworried while thinking, “The Lord won't do anything, good or bad.”
translation_verse: Ndubo asogya buti na lɛwia Yerusalem ƒui lɛvi na lɛni bekyuli kɔtu, bani nli ƒaa na balábla kasusu kadi taasiku ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na baakali mmomu banini, ‘Unwoti ɔɔɔdubo lɛla lɛdi bɔbla na lɛdi likpidi iye lɛbuni.’

english_verse: Their possessions will be taken, their homes left in ruins. They won't get to live in the houses they build, or drink wine from the grapes in their own vineyards. A Terrible Day
translation_verse: Badubo-ma ala buƒie bɔƒɔ na bana kɔduli kɔbwɛ kɔbla aani kebu alakpi. Na baaadubo lɛtɔ lɛni na bátu kemmo bɔkɛ bulie. Na adingyii ani mmo bése lɛnɔ ni, baaadubo ebi bude babla ntɛ bani.” Ɔgbankpi Limeyi

english_verse: The great day of the Lord is coming soon, very soon. On that terrible day, fearsome shouts of warriors will be heard everywhere.
translation_verse: Unwoti limeyi linengudi lɛmmɔ lɛdubo na uwi ɔsɔ uletu. Na ɔgbankpi limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, bekyuli badubunu bekpone bani lɛlɔ mbo liƒu kɔku ku lɛsɛ yoo na kesi kesii.

english_verse: It will be a time of anger— of trouble and torment, of disaster and destruction, of darkness and despair, of storm clouds and shadows,
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdubɔbla kɔnyi ku lɛbibo ku ɔlɛ bunu pii, ɔsika limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdanku ɔgbankpi ɔni ndubo bekyuli bɔyila. Na lɛdisa lɛdubɔƒɔ lɛla biala na bekyuli bayila lɛnunsia biala. Na liƒlukutu lɛdubɔya na ɔyuli ubi lɛla biala na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa uteekpo.

english_verse: of trumpet calls and battle cries against fortified cities and mighty fortresses.
translation_verse: Na badubo kekpo kɔkpɛɛ butaavwi na beteedie kekpo lɛnu taaka taamana lɛma lɛni na bátu awodu bámana ku kɔgyumanakɔ kpakplaa bényene.

english_verse: The Lord warns everyone who has sinned against him, “I'll strike you blind! Then your blood and your insides will gush out like vomit.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ƒui nábla likpidi báƒiɔ Unwoti ni, uubó-ma ɔda teese ɔnini, “Ndubo-mii bubo bɔbwɛ na bɛkɛ biteebo enu aani banumbwɛne na ubugya ɔdubo-mii lɛƒɛnyi butaalɛ aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔdala na bina ɔlɔna unwini adila ute kalɔ.

english_verse: Not even your silver or gold can save you on that day when I, the Lord, am angry. My anger will flare up like a furious fire scorching the earth and everyone on it.”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ami, Unwoti, ndubɔkɛ kɔnyi na mbada lɛlɛ-mii lɛlɔ mmɔ ni, bina sika ɔƒualadi ku sika ugyiedi ƒui muedi ulakana-mii bɔƒɔ na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Ndubo kɔnyi bɔkɛ geen na libile ala aani kalɛ na ogya ɔɔda momoomo teekeyi lɛla biala ku bekyuli.”

english_verse: before it's too late. The Lord has set a time when his fierce anger will strike like a storm and sweep you away.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti úuse uwi úse ɔni na ɔdubo ku kɔnyi kpakplaa na ubébo-mii uwi kalɔ aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa na ɔkpala-mii ƒui ɔtɔlɔku.

english_verse: If you humbly obey the Lord, then come and worship him. If you do right and are humble, perhaps you will be safe on that day when the Lord turns loose his anger. Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Na si biiboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na biinú Unwoti litemi bɔdi ni, amu bibo na bibakya-nwu lili kalɔ. Na si bíboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na bɛɛbla ala siin ni, ɔƒɛni kalɛ bɛdubɔkɛ bɔƒɔ na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ uwi ɔni na Unwoti ɔdubudie nwuna kɔnyi keyi. Unwoti Ɔ́tɛku Ƒilistia Litemi

english_verse: Gaza and Ashkelon will be deserted and left in ruins. Ashdod will be emptied in broad daylight, and Ekron uprooted.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badubɔda Gasa ku Askelon lɛma bewi na lɛbwɛ. Na badubɔbɔku bekyuli balɛku Asdod ɔma asa na ɔƒɛ welie ntɛ. Na bagya Ekron bekyuli balɛku ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: To you people of Philistia who live along the coast, the Lord has this to say: “I am now your enemy, and I'll wipe you out!”
translation_verse: Amii Ƒilistiƒuɔ bani nli ɛpu ulu lɛlɔ ku amadɔ mmɔ bene, binu Unwoti linyesia lɛni na ubo ute-mii. Unwoti ɔnini, “Ɔƒaani línwini bina ukisine na ndubo-mii udu bɔyila budie ƒui kede kede.

english_verse: Your seacoast will be changed into pastureland and sheep pens.
translation_verse: Na ƒula ɛpu kalɔ ku amadɔ ƒui adubunwini bebuo kadikɔ ku bebuo ayu.

english_verse: The Lord God hasn't forgotten those survivors in Judah, and he will help them— his people will take your land to use for pasture. And when evening comes, they will rest in houses at Ashkelon. Judgment on Moab and Ammon *
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nébu bakya Yuda ni, Unwoti Katɔti útayiƒala-ma. Ɔdubɔya na nwuna bekyuli beti Askelon kalɔ kammɔ benwini bana bebuo kadikɔ. Na si useyi uwi údu ni, na beduo bana lɛtɔ kemmo batɛ banwuna.” Unwoti Ɔ́tɛku Moab Ku Amon Litemi

english_verse: This is how Moab and Ammon will at last be repaid for their pride— and for sneering at the nation that belongs to me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na ndubo Moab ku Amon kɔtu bɔni na bana lɛlɔ katɔ bɔkɔliku ku kalɛ na bédumi mina kadi bekyuli bani na lɛ́ƒuna na badi ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, badi ɔsu.

english_verse: I will fiercely attack. Then every god on this earth will shrink to nothing, and everyone of every nation will bow down to me, right where they are. Judgment on Ethiopia
translation_verse: Ndubo-ma bukpo ku kɔnyi geen kalɛ na baƒiɔ bani ƒui nkya kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni bayii bakya na basɔ baladi lɛla lɛdi belete bekyuli, mmomu kadi biala bekyuli ɔdi biala ɔdubɔkya lili kalɔ ute-mi na kesi kesii na belie.” Unwoti Ɔ́tɛku Kus Litemi

english_verse: People of Ethiopia, the sword of the Lord will slaughter you! Judgment on Assyria
translation_verse: Unwoti kewii kadubo amii Kus bekyuli bɔdu! Unwoti Ɔ́tɛku Asiria Litemi

english_verse: The Lord will reach to the north to crush Assyria and overthrow Nineveh.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubo busie butédu kalɔ kammɔ katɔ kakɛ na utábwɛ Asiria, na unwini Niniwe ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ ubi.

english_verse: Herds of wild animals will live in its rubble; all kinds of desert owls will perch on its stones and hoot in the windows. Noisy ravens will be heard inside its buildings, stripped bare of cedar.
translation_verse: Na baƒonu ku alakpi akɔ bebuo pii badubɔƒɔ kalɔ kani nébie mmɔ belie. Na bekuku lidu lidu bebelie atabi ammɔ lɛlɔ, na bana bɔyoli butaabla kɔku taasia kama. Na atɔnku kɔyakun kɔdubo kalɔ, na ligyii lɛsɔ lilasia-ni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: This is the glorious city that felt secure and said, “I am the only one!” Now it's merely ruins, a home for wild animals. Every passerby simply sneers and makes vulgar signs.
translation_verse: Ɔma ɔni néteekeye na baasu banini, “Abu kani na bɔdi” ni, ɔƒɛni amu únwini atɔnku na lɛla biala líbie na únwini bebuo keliekɔ, na bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔví taanu bɔpii kani na baapii taakywɛ-nwu anumi.

english_verse: Forever rebellious and rejecting correction, Jerusalem refuses to trust or obey the Lord God.
translation_verse: Yerusalem úni ɔnii ulénu Unwoti Katɔti litemi na uti anu ɔsia-nwu lɛlɔ. Na bɔta kani na ɔɔta teenye-nwu lɛlɔ, na úni lɛnɔ ɔnii batalɛ-nwu na baklibi-nwu.

english_verse: Its officials are roaring lions, its judges are wolves; in the evening they attack, by morning nothing is left.
translation_verse: Nwuna bakutine ƒui bénwini bagyata bani mɔɔkwanyi, na nwuna litemi batɛne lɛnɔ bénwini bebuo bani muuƒie bana bakpana taakun usien na asɔ alanu lɛla lɛdi si kadi kégye.

english_verse: Jerusalem's prophets are proud and not to be trusted. The priests have disgraced the place of worship and abused God's Law.
translation_verse: Kenye bediene bani nkya Yerusalem baakɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ na baaadi bekyuli bani lɛlɔ na beti anu basia. Bana bakpane lɛnɔ béwi kakpakɔ kammɔ anumi kalɔ na bébile Katɔti Ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: All who do evil are shameless, but the Lord does right and is always fair. With the dawn of each day, God brings about justice.
translation_verse: Alaekpidi bablane bammɔ basɔ baaagyi kɔƒa, nsu Unwoti ɔɔbla ala siin uwi biala. Na ɔɔnu ka kadi biala negye ni, ɔɔtɛ litemi ulu lɛlɔ siin.

english_verse: The Lord wiped out nations and left fortresses crumbling in the dirt. Their streets and towns were reduced to ruins and emptied of people.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́bɔku kadi bekyuli údie bana lɛma na kɔgyumanakɔ kpakplaa kɔni bátu kúbie na kɔ́ƒɔ lɛlɔ kɔkya alakpi akɔ. Na bana lɛblɔnu ku lɛma ƒui línwini alakpi akɔ lɛti lɛti ɔni na bekyuli basɔ beeebo-ni kemmo.

english_verse: God felt certain that Jerusalem would learn to respect and obey him. Then he would hold back from punishing the city and not wipe it out. But everyone there was eager to start sinning again. Nations Will Turn to the Lord
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́bla kasusu ka Yerusalem ɔdubɔtɛya kalɛ na babu-nwu na beteenu-nwu litemi na ɔda ɔma ɔmmɔ kɔtu bɔni ɔya na ulayila-ma udu uledie mmɔ. Nsu likpidi bɔbla atu kani na beesé na mmɔ. Kadi Bekyuli Ƒui Badubo Bunwini Bubo Unwoti Kudɔ

english_verse: The Lord said: Just wait for the day when I accuse you nations. I have decided on a day, when I will bring together every nation and kingdom and punish them all in my fiery anger. I will become furious and destroy the earth.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnini, “Amii bɛsɔ binye, limeyi lɛni na ndubo amii kadi bekyuli ƒui kɔtɔ bɔdu lɛdubo. Lɛ́ɛlɛ limeyi lɛdi ugyii líse ɔni na ndubo bina kadi bekyuli ku lɛga kɔdikɔ ƒui bɔsala na lɛni-mii kɔtu kaduɛ na mina kɔnyi kpakplaa kemmo. Na kɔnyi kɔmmɔ kɔdubɔkɔ-mi katɔ útédu ka lɛkyula kalɔ kammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: I will purify each language and make those languages acceptable for praising me. Then, with hearts united, everyone will serve only me, the Lord.
translation_verse: “Ndubo adi biala batɛmine bɔbla sɛɛn na bamanku kalɛ na bemwi-mi lɛnyi. Na bana ƒui badubɔsala babla unwi, na babla ami, Unwoti, kabla.

english_verse: From across the rivers of Ethiopia, my scattered people, my true worshipers, will bring offerings to me.
translation_verse: Mina bekyuli bani mɔɔbu-mi geen na bégyingya bakya ni, badubɔsi ketu kani nkya Kusi kalɔ kama kakɛ bebo-mi kudɔ ku etela.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't rebel against me and be put to shame. I'll do away with those who are proud and arrogant. Never will any of them strut around on my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Si uwi ɔmmɔ údu ni, bɛsɔ bilata bilenye-mi lɛlɔ na lɛkya-mii kɔƒa. Ɔsika bekyuli bani na bebo lɛkantakpi na baatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ mmɔ ni, ndubudie-ma ƒui na bina akɔ, na basɔ beléteetu lɛgba taanya taavi mina kɔbi kedee kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kudii.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, won't destroy any of your people who are truly humble and turn to me for safety.
translation_verse: Nsu bina akɔ bani muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ buɛɛ na biibo-mi kudɔ bɛnii mbunku-mii ni, amii ɔsu naaayila-mii udu.

english_verse: The people of Israel who survive will live right and refuse to tell lies. They will eat and rest with nothing to fear. A Song of Celebration
translation_verse: Israel kadi bekyuli bani nébu ni, badubulie ngba siin na beni ɔkɔ bɔnyi. Badubɔdi na batɛ banwuna, na balayia lɛla biala.” Bɛtu Lɛnu Bɛdi Limeyi

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem and Judah, celebrate and shout with all your heart!
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala na Yerusalem ku Yuda bɛtu lɛnu na bɛva momoomo ku bina kɔyi ƒui na bɛdi limeyi!

english_verse: Zion, your punishment is over. The Lord has forced your enemies to turn and retreat. Your Lord is King of Israel and stands at your side; you don't have to worry about any more troubles.
translation_verse: Sion, ƒula lɛtuni lɛ́sa. Unwoti ɔ́bɔku ƒula bekisine na básɔ bénwini na ƒula kama. Bina Unwoti ɔni ndi Israel Ɔga unye-mii kudɔ, anwuɔsu ɔ́sɔ útalɛka bɛyia ɔgbankpi ɔdi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, the time is coming, when it will be said to you: “Don't be discouraged or grow weak from fear!
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ubédu ɔni na badubɔsu awɔ Yerusalem banini, “Sɔ tayia, na enu ataƒɛ-ɔ!

english_verse: The Lord your God wins victory after victory and is always with you. He celebrates and sings because of you, and he will refresh your life with his love.” The Lord's Promise to His People
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti unye-mii kudɔ uwi ndi uwi. Ubo ɔyikun ka udie-mii. Na kalɛ na ɔɔyɔ́-mii ɔsu ni, ɔdubɔya na bɛkɛ bɔnwuna. Na amii ɔsu ni, uudie nwuna lɛlɔyɔ keyi ku lɛnu bɔtu.” Unwoti Úse Nwuna Bekyuli Kenye

english_verse: The Lord has promised: Your sorrow has ended, and you can celebrate.
translation_verse: Unwoti úse kenye ɔnini, “Bina kɔnyana buwulo kenye kadubukulo na bɛkana na bɛdi limeyi ku lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: I will punish those who mistreat you. I will bring together the lame and the outcasts, then they will be praised, instead of despised, in every country on earth.
translation_verse: Bɛnu! Ndubo bina bekisine kɔtu bɔni geen, na lɛsala bekpulone ku bani na bédie-ma atu na lɛya bana kɔƒa kɔni na bákya-ma kunwini na baƒɔ lɛnyi na kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will lead you home, and with your own eyes you will see me bless you with all you once owned. Then you will be famous everywhere on this earth. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na ndubo-mii bɔsala mmɔ ni, ndubɔsɔku-mii liboku ɔma na lɛya na bɛƒɔ lɛnyi, na lɛsɔku bina lɛkɛ lite-mii na anumi ku anumi. Lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su.”

english_verse: On the first day of the sixth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak his message to the governor of Judah and to the high priest. So Haggai told Governor Zerubbabel and High Priest Joshua
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su Kenye Udiene Hagai kenye kadi ka utásu aban ɔgadine unengu na Yuda ku ɔkpane unengudi ɔmmɔ uwi ɔni na Ɔga Unengudi Dario ɔɔdi lɛga na Persia kalɔ lɛlɔ na lɛkwa linyɔdi kɔbuli kɔkundi kuna limeyi lideedi lɛlɔ. Amu na Hagai úsie Sealtiel ubidi ɔnanabi ɔni baalɔ Serubabel ɔni ndi aban ɔgadine unengu ku Yehosadak ubidi ɔnanabi ɔni baalɔ Yosua ɔni ndi ɔkpane unengudi ku kenye kammɔ.

english_verse: You harvest less than you plant, you never have enough to eat or drink, your clothes don't keep you warm, and your wages are stored in bags full of holes.
translation_verse: Bɛɛkya edula, nsu biláƒɛ-nya kalɛ na bɛ́kya-nya kenye. Na bilakɛ taadi teemo, na bilakɛ ntɛ lɛnɔ taani na budu-mii ɔkwɛ. Na bina adala lɛnɔ elebunku-mii na lɛlɔ lɛbla-mii gugungu. Na bina lɛyuƒɔla lɛni na bɛɛkɛ́ ni, kɔvumi kɔni náƒuala kemmo na bɛɛkya bina egulabi ammɔ.

english_verse: Think about what I have said!
translation_verse: “Bɛbla kasusu bɛsiku ala ani na lɛ́su-mii mɛni lɛlɔ!

english_verse: But first, go to the hills and get wood for my temple, so I can take pride in it and be worshiped there.
translation_verse: Bɛka abi lɛlɔ busie na bitáwia ligyii lɛni na bɛdubuti bɛtu mina kakpakɔ kani námanku-mi na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mi na bitaakpa-mi na mmɔ.

english_verse: You expected much, but received only a little. And when you brought it home, I made that little disappear. Why have I done this? It's because you hurry off to build your own houses, while my temple is still in ruins.
translation_verse: Bɛsia ala pii anu, nsu alɛɛ kani muutúku-mii lɛkɔkɔ. Na si bíti alɛɛ ammɔ bíboku kaduli lɛnɔ ni, mɔɔyá na aayii-mii lɛkɔkɔ. Bi ɔsu na mɔɔbla ɔmɛni? Ɔsika bɛɛbabla taatu bina kuliekɔ na bɛ́da mina kakpakɔ aka bíse aani kebu.

english_verse: That's also why the dew doesn't fall and your harvest fails.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na amii aláyu teemomo aani ɔnantu teewi bina edula lɛlɔ na eebie.

english_verse: And so, at my command everything will become barren—your farmland and pastures, your vineyards and olive trees, your animals and you yourselves. All your hard work will be for nothing.
translation_verse: Na líbo ɔda ka bina ala ƒui asɔ aaadubo bɔbla kaduɛ. Bina mmo ku bebuo kadikɔ ku adingyii mmo ku nnɔ egyii mmo ku bebuo ku amii alati ku bina kabla biala kadubɔbla keeke.”

english_verse: Zerubbabel and Joshua, together with the others who had returned from exile in Babylonia, obeyed the Lord's message spoken by his prophet Haggai, and they started showing proper respect for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Serubabel ku Yosua ku bani ƒui nénwini bási Babilon kalɔ kesii kani na béƒie-ma bésienku bébo ni, bése kalɔ beenú Unwoti litemi na baadi-ni lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na Kenye Udiene Hagai ɔ́su-ma, na baabu Unwoti kalɛ na ɔ́manku.

english_verse: Haggai then told them that the Lord had promised to be with them.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Hagai ɔ́su-ma ɔnii Unwoti úse kenye ka ɔdubulieku-ma.

english_verse: So the Lord God All-Powerful made everyone eager to work on his temple, especially Zerubbabel and Joshua.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́ya na ogya úduo ukyuli biala na bénye kpakplaa na bábla kabla na nwuna kakpakɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ. Na Serubabel ku Yosua nényeku-ma geen.

english_verse: And the work began on the twenty-fourth day of that same month.
translation_verse: Na kabla kammɔ kése kalɔ kási kɔbuli kɔkundi kuna limeyi aavlanyɔ-lideedi lɛlɔ na Ɔga Dario lɛga bɔdi lɛkwa linyɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: On the twenty-first day of the next month, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak this message to Governor Zerubbabel, High Priest Joshua, and everyone else:
translation_verse: Na kɔbuli kɔni nsia kɔmmɔ kama na limeyi aavlanyɔ-lideedi lɛlɔ ni, Unwoti ɔ́su Kenye Udiene Hagai ɔnii ɔtɛmiku aban ɔgadine unengu Serubabel ku ɔkpane unengudi Yosua ku kadi bekyuli bammɔ ƒui na uye-ma ɔnini,

english_verse: Does anyone remember how glorious this temple used to be? Now it looks like nothing.
translation_verse: “Bina ɔdi uunyimo kalɛ na kakpakɔ kedeedi kammɔ kéteekeye? Nsu ɔƒaani ni, bɔnu na bɛɛnu ka kadi lɛla lɛdi?

english_verse: But cheer up! Because I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be here to help you with the work,
translation_verse: Nsu amii ni, bɛkya ɔkplu na binye kabla kammɔ lɛlɔ! Ɔsika ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, ndubɔkya-mii akɔ mɛni, na libunku-mii na kabla kammɔ kemmo

english_verse: just as I promised your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt. Don't worry. My Spirit is right here with you.
translation_verse: aani kalɛ na líse bina bati kuuku kenye uwi ɔni na lɛ́kpanku-ma lɛ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Bitekpoku lɛlɔ. Nkya-mii akɔ mɛni!

english_verse: Soon I will again shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
translation_verse: Na uwi uletu nsɔ ndubo katɔ ku kalɔ ku ɛpu ku kalɔ kakwiidi kammɔ ƒui bɔkunku.

english_verse: I will shake the nations, and their treasures will be brought here. Then the brightness of my glory will fill this temple.
translation_verse: Ndubo kadi bekyuli ƒui bɔkunku ku bana akɛla ani náƒɔ-ma kuye na beti-nya beboku mɛni. Mmɔ na kalɛ na mina bukeye bɔɔtu anumi bɔdubɔƒɔ kakpakɔ kammɔ kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: All silver and gold belong to me,
translation_verse: Sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi ƒui ami ɔdi na ɔdi,

english_verse: and I promise that this new temple will be more glorious than the first one. I will also bless this city with peace. The Past and the Future
translation_verse: na muusé-mii kenye ka kakpakɔ kamɛni kadubo bukeye butulo kedeedi. Na ndubo ɔma ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ kusɛ kusɛ bute na keyi buɛɛ kaƒɔ-nwu kemmo.” Uwi Ɔni Návi Ku Ɔni Mebo Lɛlɔ Kɔtɛ

english_verse: to ask the priests for their opinion on the following matters:
translation_verse: ɔnii uye bakpane kasusu ɔ́siku lɛla lɛni ndubo mɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Suppose meat ready to be sacrificed to God is being carried in the folds of someone's clothing, and the clothing rubs against some bread or stew or wine or olive oil or any other food. Would those foods that were touched then become acceptable for sacrifice? “Of course not,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Si úbo úte ka ukyuli ɔdanku lɛna lɛni na béti béte ati na lɛkya lɛdiku lɛdi kemmo lítuku bodobodo iye kutu ntɛ iye nnɔ iye adila bamba adi ni, ala ammɔ akana na enwini ala ani na béti anya lɛnɔ béti béte Unwoti? Mmɔ na bakpane bammɔ bédie kenye banini, “Kudi kudii.”

english_verse: Then Haggai said, “Suppose someone has touched a dead body and is considered unacceptable to worship God. If that person touches these foods, would they become unclean?” “Of course they would,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Amu na Hagai úye ɔnini, “Na si úbo úte ka ukyuli ɔdi útuku ukpine na ɔda bubo bɔɔtina ka útamanku ka ɔkpa Unwoti ni, si ukyuli ɔmɛni útuku adila amɛni ni, ɔɔtina ka ala ammɔ lɛnɔ eesé lɛlɔ?” Amu na bakpane bammɔ bédie kenye banini, “Unyeƒi biala uuubo ka ala ammɔ eesé lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: So the Lord told Haggai to say: That's how it is with this entire nation. Everything you do and every sacrifice you offer is unacceptable to me.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti ɔ́su Hagai ɔnii ɔsu bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini, “Lɛni geen na kadi bekyuli bamɛni ƒui bese ɔƒaani. Na lɛla biala na bɛɛbla ku akpala biala na bɛɛbla ni, eesé-mi lɛlɔ na naaaƒɔ-nya.

english_verse: But from now on, things will get better. Before you started laying the foundation for the temple,
translation_verse: Nsu ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ni, bɛbla kasusu bɛsiku ala ani ndubo abalɛ lɛlɔ asa na bise kalɔ bitaakya kowodu kalɔ ɔka ute Katɔti kakpakɔ kammɔ bɔtu.

english_verse: That same day the Lord spoke to Haggai again and said:
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su Hagai kunyɔdi na limeyi lɛmmɔ kani lɛlɔ ɔnini,

english_verse: I made all of your hard work useless by sending mildew, mold, and hail—but you still did not return to me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Ami nébo-mii na líbile-mii kabla ƒui lɛni ɔni na liwulu ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ku etubankɛ áya na bina edula ákwɛ kuyii na ébulo bɔdia. Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui bíni ka binwini bibo-mi kudɔ.

english_verse: Today you have completed the foundation for my temple, so listen to what your future will be like.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si ɔmwi kɔbuli yaalenwidi limeyi aavlanyɔ-linedi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ɔni na bákya Unwoti kakpakɔ kowodu kalɔ ɔka mɛni úsela ni, bitaabla kasusu na biye lɛlɔ bɛnii,

english_verse: Although you have not yet harvested any grain, grapes, figs, pomegranates, or olives, I will richly bless you in the days ahead. God's Promise to Zerubbabel
translation_verse: ‘Edula adi asɔ ewi linwu? Na nnɔ egyii ku anwingyie ku adingyii egyii lidu lɛmmɔ ɔdi ɔ́nwu ɔsia?’ Oowo. “Nsu ɔ́si ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ úsela ni, ndubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ.”

english_verse: Tell Governor Zerubbabel of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth
translation_verse: “Su aban ɔgadine unengudi Serubabel ku ɔkpane unegudi Yosua anini, ‘Ndubo katɔ ku kalɔ kammɔ bɔkunku.

english_verse: But tell my servant Zerubbabel that I, the Lord All-Powerful, have chosen him, and he will rule in my name.
translation_verse: Na Kadi Ƒui Unwoti ɔnini, ‘Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ndubuti awɔ Serubabel, mina kabla ɔblane Sieltel ubidi ɔnanabi, lɛbla aani ɔgagyii, ɔsika awɔ na lɛ́ƒuna.’ Lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su.”

english_verse: I am the prophet Zechariah, the son of Berechiah and the grandson of Iddo. In the eighth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Dario ɔɔdi lɛga lɛkwa linyɔdi kɔbuli maanedi kemmo ni, Unwoti ɔ́su Kenye Udiene Sakaria kenye kadi. Na ɔti ndi Berekaia ɔni ɔti ndi Ido.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord All-Powerful, was very angry with your ancestors. But if you people will return to me, I will turn and help you.
translation_verse: Nsu si amii bɛdubunwini bibo-mi kudɔ ni, ami lɛnɔ nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo kama bunwini bɔkya-mii.”

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. They were warned by the earlier prophets to give up their evil and turn back to me, but they paid no attention.
translation_verse: Amii bitabla atu ɔkplu aani bina bati kuuku kalɛ. Kenye bediene bedeedi bani nélie bábavi bálɛ-ma kpakplaa geen ka bada bana ɔbladu buɛ baya na benwini bebo-mi kudɔ, nsu béni.

english_verse: Where are your ancestors now? Not even prophets live forever.
translation_verse: Na wɛ na bina bati kuuku bammɔ bakya ɔƒaani? Na kenye bediene badi muedi belélie ngba uwi ƒui.

english_verse: But my warnings and my words spoken by the prophets caught up with your ancestors. So they turned back to me and said, “Lord All-Powerful, you have punished us for our sins, just as you had planned.” First Vision: Horses and Riders
translation_verse: Nsu ka béni mina etemila ku bɔlɛ bɔni na mina kenye bediene bálɛ-ma ɔsu ni, básiaku lɛla lɛni na baawia. Anwuɔsu bénwini bébevele-mi banini, “Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, áni-bu kɔtu kɔni námanku bula ekpidi ani na bɔ́bla aani kalɛ na ásu ése.” Ala Bɔnu Budeedi Bɔkɛnku Bapɔnkɔ Ku Bana Beliene

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of Shebat, which was the eleventh month of that same year, the Lord spoke to me in a vision during the night: In a valley among myrtle trees, I saw someone on a red horse, with riders on red, brown, and white horses behind him.
translation_verse: Usien ɔmmɔ ni, lɛ́nu ka ukyuli ɔdi ulie ɔpɔnkɔ ugyiedi ɔdi lɛlɔ na kɔwɛ lɛku lɛdi kemmo. Na babambadi badi lɛnɔ belie bapɔnkɔ begyiedi ku bani nse ƒuƒuu ku baƒualadi bamba lɛlɔ na nwuna kama.

english_verse: An angel was there to explain things to me, and I asked, “Sir, who are these riders?” “I'll tell you,” the angel answered.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi unye mmɔ kalɛ na udie ala kalɔ ute-mi. Anwuɔsu líye-nwu nnini, “Ati, ɔma bene ndi bapɔnkɔ beliene bamɛni?” Mmɔ na ɔtu ɔmɛni údie kenye ɔnini, “Ndubo-ɔ bɔsu.”

english_verse: At once, the man standing among the myrtle trees said, “These are the ones the Lord has sent to find out what's happening on earth.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ kani na ukyuli ɔni nnye lɛku lɛmmɔ kemmo mmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Bekyuli bamɛni na Unwoti ɔ́tala ɔnii bebo babanu lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ na kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni.”

english_verse: Then the riders spoke to the Lord's angel, who was standing among the myrtle trees, and they said, “We have gone everywhere and have discovered that the whole world is at peace.”
translation_verse: Amu na bapɔnkɔ beliene bammɔ básu Katɔti ɔtu ɔni nnye egyii ammɔ akɔ mmɔ banini, “Búsie bɔ́vi kesii biala na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ na bɔ́nu ka keyi buɛɛ káƒɔ kayawi kammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui.”

english_verse: So the angel told me to announce: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am very protective of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-mi ɔnii nkɔ lɛla lɛmɛni lɛsa nte bekyuli na lɛsu-ma ka Unwoti ɔnini, “Ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui mɔɔyɔ́ Yerusalem mina ɔma kedee na nwuna lɛlɔ ala eegyie-mi anumi geen.”

english_verse: For a while I was angry at the nations, but now I am furious, because they have made things worse for Jerusalem and are not the least bit concerned.
translation_verse: Lɛ́kɛ kɔnyi lɛ́kya kadi bekyuli bani nlie lɛlɔyɔ kemmo na ala adianku-ma. Ɔsika uwi na líti kɔnyi lɛ́kya Yerusalem ni, bébile ala na mmɔ bétulo kalɛ na ɔ́manku na baaadaku-ma lɛda munu munu.

english_verse: And so, I will have pity on Jerusalem. The city will be completely rebuilt, and my temple will stand again.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubɔnu Yerusalem kɔnyana. Na ndubɔya na basɔku ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ batu ƒui na basɔku mina kakpakɔ batu benyene kana kenyekɔ.

english_verse: I also promise that my towns will prosper—Jerusalem will once again be my chosen city, and I will comfort the people of Zion. Second Vision: Animal Horns
translation_verse: Líse kenye lɛnɔ ka ala adubɔsɔ atɛku mina lɛma lɛmmɔ. Na Yerusalem ɔsɔ unwini mina ɔma ɔƒunadi, na lɛsia mina ɔma kedee ɔmmɔ bekyuli kɔnu. Ala Bɔnu Bunyɔdi Bɔkɛnku Bebuo Ese

english_verse: Next, I saw four animal horns.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, lɛ́nu bebuo ese ene adi.

english_verse: The angel who was sent to explain was there, and so I asked, “What do these mean?” His answer was, “These horns are the nations that scattered the people of Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem, and took away their freedom.” Then the Lord showed me four blacksmiths, and I asked, “What are they going to do?” He replied, “They are going to terrify and crush those horns.”
translation_verse: Na ɔtu ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́tala ka ubedie ala ammɔ kalɔ unye mmɔ. Anwuɔsu líye-nwu nnini, “Ala ani na mɔɔnu mɛni kalɔ ndi bi?” Amu na údie kenye ɔnini, “Ese amɛni enye ete kadi bekyuli bani négyingya Yuda ku Israel ku Yerusalem bekyuli na báya na basɔ beeebo keyi buɛɛ kadi.” Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti údie ala bakywɛne ine badi ɔ́tina-mi na líye-nwu nnini, “Bi na ama badubo bɔbla?” Údie kenye ɔnini, “Badubo ese ammɔ liƒu bɔkya na bebo-nya babwɛ na bebile bekisine bammɔ ɔyikun ƒui.”

english_verse: This time I saw someone holding a measuring line,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ni, lɛ́nu ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔda kabuli kani na baakɔ́ku ala.

english_verse: and I asked, “Where are you going?” “To measure Jerusalem,” was the answer. “To find out how wide and long it is.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na líye-nwu nnini, “Wɛ na ésela?” Amu na údie kenye ɔnini, “Ntákɔku Yerusalem na lɛnu-nwu bune ku bɔbɛbɛ.”

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me came toward me, when another angel came up to him
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Katɔti ɔtu ɔni nnye mɔɔtɛmiku-mi mmɔ ɔ́bla aani bɔgyu na ɔda kani na ɔtu ɔbambadi ɔ́si úbalɛ-nwu kudɔ,

english_verse: and said, “Hurry! Tell that man with the measuring line that Jerusalem won't have any boundaries. It will be too full of people and animals even to have a wall.
translation_verse: na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Babla na asu ukyuli ɔni nda kabuli kammɔ anii ɔmii ɔdi biala ɔɔɔdubo Yerusalem bɔsia, ɔsika bekyuli ku bebuo badubo bumomo butulo-nwu ɔni na awodu muedi aaadubo bɔdia bɔtu bɔmana-nwu.

english_verse: The Lord himself has promised to be a protective wall of fire surrounding Jerusalem, and he will be its shining glory in the heart of the city.” A Call to Action
translation_verse: Unwoti úse kenye ka anwu ɔlati ndubo kowodu kɔni maka mamana Yerusalem bunwini na utaagyumana-nwu, na anwu kani ndubulie ɔma ɔmmɔ ntɛntɛ na uteekeye na ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo.”

english_verse: The Lord says to his people, “Run! Escape from the land in the north, where I scattered you to the four winds.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su nwuna bekyuli ɔnini, “Bikeli na bɛtɔlɔ kalɔ kani nkya katɔ kakɛ mmɔ kemmo kesii kani na lígyingya-mii lɛ́kya na lɛƒɛnyi ine bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Leave Babylonia and hurry back to Zion.”
translation_verse: Bɛtɔlɔ Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ na bɛbla binwini bibo Sion.”

english_verse: Then the glorious Lord All-Powerful ordered me to say to the nations that had raided and robbed Zion: Zion is as precious to the Lord as are his eyes. Whatever you do to Zion, you do to him.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔni muukeye údie lɛdi úte-mi ɔnii nsu kadi bekyuli bani nékpo Sion na béyu-nwu ala bátɔlɔku nnini, “Sion ɔ́ƒɔ ami Katɔti kuye geen aani mina lɛnumi. Anwuɔsu lɛla biala na bɛ́bla ɔma ɔmmɔ ni, anwu na bɛ́bla.

english_verse: And so, he will put you in the power of your slaves, and they will raid and rob you. Then you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔdubo amii lɛnɔ budie bute na bina kabla bablane badubo-mii bukpoku na beyu-mii ala batɔlɔku. Na ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔya na bɛnu-nwu bɛti ka Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui nátala-mi.”

english_verse: City of Zion, sing and celebrate! The Lord has promised to come and live with you.
translation_verse: Amii Sion ɔma unengudi bekyuli, bidie lɛnu na bɛdi limeyi! Ɔsika Unwoti úse kenye ka ɔdubo ubelieku-mii.

english_verse: When he does, many nations will turn to him and become his people. At that time you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na úbo-nwu kemmo lɛni ni, kadi bekyuli pii badubunwini bebo Unwoti kudɔ na benwini nwuna bekyuli na uwi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ, na badubɔnu bati ka Unwoti kenye udiene na ɔdi sɔsɔ.

english_verse: Then Judah will be his part of the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his chosen city.
translation_verse: Na Yuda lɛnɔ ɔdubunwini kalɔ kedee kammɔ kakɛ kadi, na Yerusalem ɔsɔ unwini Unwoti ɔma unengudi ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Everyone, be silent! The Lord is present and moving about in his holy place.
translation_verse: Ɔdi biala ɔbla kpoo na baba lɛsɛ! Ɔsika Unwoti ɔkya-mii akɔ na uusié taasɔ na nwuna kakpakɔ kedee kemmo.

english_verse: I was given another vision. This time Joshua the high priest was standing in front of the Lord's angel. And there was Satan, standing at Joshua's right side, ready to accuse him.
translation_verse: Bédie lɛla bamba bátina-mi. Na uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ni, lɛ́nu ka ɔkpane unengudi Yosua unye Katɔti ɔtu ɔmmɔ anumi, na Satan lɛnɔ unye kagyumana na Yosua kɔdianu kakɛ ka ɔdu-nwu kɔtɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Satan, you are wrong. Jerusalem is my chosen city, and this man was rescued like a stick from a flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Nsu Unwoti ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Satan, awɔ ɔdi mmomu nátatɛ. Mina ɔma unengudi ɔƒunadi ndi Yerusalem. Na ukyuli ɔmɛni ni, budie na bédie-nwu aani ugyii bálɛku ogya livongu kemmo.”

english_verse: So the angel told some of the people to remove Joshua's filthy clothes. Then he said to Joshua, “This means you are forgiven. Now I will dress you in priestly clothes.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Katɔti ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su bekyuli badi ɔnii bada-nwu adala ani nánwu ammɔ bedie-nwu lɛlɔ. Na únwini na ɔ́su Yosua ɔnini, “Ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka béti ƒula ekpidi bákyiɛ-ɔ. Na ɔƒɛni ni, ndubɔkya-a ɔkpane bɔdi lɛwu.”

english_verse: I spoke up and said, “Also put a clean priestly turban on his head.” Then they dressed him in priestly clothes and put the turban on him, while the Lord's angel stood there watching.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ami lɛnɔ lɛ́kya litemi lɛmmɔ kenye na lɛ́su nnini, “Biti bakpane lɛdune lɛni nse sɛɛn mmɔ lɛnɔ bibi-nwu lili.” Anwuɔsu bákya-nwu ɔkpane lɛwu lɛmmɔ na béti lɛdune lɛmmɔ lɛnɔ bébi-nwu lili uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔtu ɔmmɔ unye ɔɔnu.

english_verse: After this, the angel encouraged Joshua by telling him that the Lord All-Powerful had promised:
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́kya Yosua ɔkplu na ɔ́su kenye kani na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui úse ɔnini,

english_verse: If you truly obey me, I will put you in charge of my temple, including the courtyard around it, and you will be allowed to speak at any time with the angels standing beside me.
translation_verse: “Si ádi mina litemi lɛlɔ geen ni, ndubuti-ɔ linyene mina kakpakɔ kammɔ kenye na ataanu-ka lɛlɔ ku kana kaduli kammɔ ƒui. Na adubɔkɛ kuƒi ka atɛmiku mina batu bani nnye-mi kudɔ uwi biala kemmo.

english_verse: Listen carefully, High Priest Joshua and all of you other priests. You are a sign of things to come, because I am going to bring my servant, the Chosen King.
translation_verse: “Ɔkpane Unengudi Yosua, se kɔtu kaduɛ na enu ku amii bakpane bamba ƒui lɛnɔ. Amii ndi likposela lɛni nnye ala ani ndubo abalɛ uwi ɔni mebo kenye ɔƒaani. Ɔsika ndubɔsɔku mina kabla ɔblane, Ɔga Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ, ɔni baalɔ banii kugyii kagba liboku.

english_verse: Joshua, I have placed in front of you a stone with seven sides. I will engrave something on that stone, and in a single day I will forgive this guilty country.
translation_verse: Yosua, líti lɛtabi lɛdi lɛ́va-a anumi na lɛtabi lɛmmɔ libo lɛƒɛnyi maatɛ. Na ndubo lɛla lɛdi bunweni bɔsia lɛtabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na limeyi linwi lɛdi lɛlɔ kani na ndubo kalɔ kamɛni bekyuli ekpidi ani na bábla báƒiɔ-mi buti bɔkyiɛ-ma.

english_verse: Then each of you will live at peace and entertain your friends in your own vineyard and under your own fig trees.
translation_verse: “Na bina akɔ ɔdi biala ɔdubɔlɔ nwuna bakpana uboku na bilie bina mmo adingyii egyii kalɔ bɛkya lɛlɔ ebiti.”

english_verse: The angel who explained the visions woke me from what seemed like sleep.
translation_verse: Ɔtu ɔni nnye muudie ala amɛni kalɔ teete-mi ɔ́kunku-mi na lɛ́ta na ɔ́bla-mi aani si bɔlɛɛ na nda.

english_verse: Then he asked, “What do you see?” “A solid gold lampstand with an oil container above it,” I answered. “On the stand are seven lamps, each with seven flames.
translation_verse: Amu na úye-mi ɔnini, “Bi na ánu?” Mmɔ na lídie kenye nnini, “Asogya kasiakɔ sika ugyiedi ugyii na kalɛkɛ kani kemmo na beewi nnɔmii bɔsia-nwu katɔ kakɛ. Na ugyii ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, lɛsogya maatɛ lise lɛɛda, na asogya biala uudie ogya linyemi maatɛ.

english_verse: One olive tree is on the right side and another on the left of the oil container.
translation_verse: Nnɔ kugyii kunwi kunye nnɔ kalɛkɛ kammɔ kɔdianu kakɛ na kunwi lɛnɔ kunye kɔmiinu kakɛ.

english_verse: But, sir, what do these mean?”
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Ati, bi na ala ani mɔɔnu mɛni adanku?”

english_verse: Then he asked, “Don't you know?” “No sir,” I replied.
translation_verse: Amu na anwu lɛnɔ únwini na úye-mi ɔnini, “Aaagyi lɛla lɛni na adanku?” Amu na lídie kenye nnii, “Oowo.”

english_verse: So the angel explained that it was the following message of the Lord to Zerubbabel: I am the Lord All-Powerful. So don't depend on your own power or strength, but on my Spirit.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-mi ɔnii, “Lɛla lɛmmɔ lɛdanku kenye kani na Unwoti ɔ́su Serubabel ɔnini, ‘Ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui. Utalɛ ka eti ƒula anu asia ƒula ɔyikun iye kenyekɔ kadi lɛlɔ, mmomu mina kɔyu ɔyikun lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: Zerubbabel, that mountain in front of you will be leveled to the ground. Then you will bring out the temple's most important stone and shout, “God has been very kind.”
translation_verse: “Na kɔbi kɔni na aanu na ƒula anumi mmɔ ni, badubo-ku bɔbwɛ búwi kalɔ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. Na edie kakpakɔ lɛtabi lɛni náƒɔ kuye geen litulo ƒui mmɔ alɛku, na bɛdububo kudu momoomo bɛnini, ‘Unwoti ɔ́bla-bu lɛƒɔndia, na lɛtabi lɛmmɔ lɛdia geen!’ ”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́tɛmiku-mi na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: Zerubbabel laid the foundation for the temple, and he will complete it. Then everyone will know that you were sent by me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: “Serubabel nákya kakpakɔ kammɔ kowodu ɔka kalɔ buse, na anwu kani ndubo-nwu bɔwɔlɔ. Na ɔmmɔ ndubɔya na bekyuli ƒui banu bati ka ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, nátala-a lɛ́kya-ma.

english_verse: Those who have made fun of this day of small beginnings will celebrate when they see Zerubbabel holding this important stone. Those seven lamps represent my eyes—the eyes of the Lord—and they see everything on this earth.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani ƒui nátanu limeyi lɛmɛni bátabu na kalɛ na ala amɛni eesié kalɔ blii mɛni ɔsu ni, ama ndubo babadi limeyi uwi ɔni na badubɔnu ka Serubabel ɔda lɛtabi lɛni náƒɔ kuye geen mɛni. Na lɛsogya maatɛ lɛmmɔ linye lite ami Unwoti anumi ani náka ámana kalɔ kammɔ ƒui, na aanu lɛla biala kemmo nwaa.”

english_verse: Then I asked the angel, “What about the olive trees on each side of the lampstand? What do they represent?
translation_verse: Mmɔ na líye ɔtu ɔmmɔ nnini, “Na nnɔ egyii ani nnye mmɔ anya nɔɔ? Bi na enye ete?

english_verse: And what is the meaning of the two branches from which golden olive oil flows through the two gold pipes?”
translation_verse: Na bi na egyii kɔgba kɔni kemmo na nnɔgyie bɔni nse aani sika ugyiedi bɔɔgbá taalɛ lɛkpɛmii kemmo mmɔ aku kunye kute?”

english_verse: “Don't you know?” he asked. “No sir, I don't,” was my answer.
translation_verse: Amu na úye-mi ɔnini, “Aaagyi lɛla lɛni na kunye kute?” Amu na lídie kenye nnini, “Oowo, Ati, lɛɛɛgyi.”

english_verse: Then he told me, “These branches are the two chosen leaders who stand beside the Lord of all the earth.”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Kɔgba kɔmɛni kunye kute batɔnkune inyɔ bani na béwi-ma lili nnɔmii na báƒuna-ma mmɔ na benye bayawine ƒui Unwoti kudɔ.”

english_verse: When I looked the next time, I saw a flying scroll,
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, lɛ́nu ka ebuo ɔku kakunkɛ kadi kéveyi kaaví.

english_verse: and the angel asked, “What do you see?” “A flying scroll,” I answered. “About nine meters long and four and a half meters wide.”
translation_verse: Na ɔtu ɔmmɔ úye-mi ɔnini, “Bi na aanu mmɔ?” Amu na lídie kenye nnini, “Mɔɔnu ka ebuo ɔku kakunkɛ kani bune mabla aani lɛgba avlaatɛ na kana bɔbɛbɛ bɔbla aani lɛgba leevu-ɛlɔ kéveyi kaaví.”

english_verse: Then he told me: This scroll puts a curse on everyone in the land who steals or tells lies. The writing on one side tells about the destruction of those who steal, while the writing on the other side tells about the destruction of those who lie.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Kakunkɛ kamɛni muuwida ukyuli biala ɔni muuyú iye ɔɔnyi ɔkɔ taatɔlɔ bekyuli na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ. Ala ani na bénweni básia kakɛ kenwi kaatɛmi taasiku kalɛ na badubo beyune udu bɔyila lɛlɔ. Na ala ani na bénweni básia kakɛ kakladi lɛlɔ ɔɔtɛmi taasiku kalɛ na badubo bekyuli bani mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ lɛnɔ udu bɔyila lɛlɔ.
