english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has said, “I am sending this scroll into the house of everyone who is a robber or tells lies in my name, and it will remain there until every piece of wood and stone in that house crumbles.” Seventh Vision: A Woman in a Basket
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔnini, ‘Líti kakunkɛ kamɛni muumene ukyuli biala na ɔdi uyune kaduli iye ɔda-mi lɛnyi na ɔkɛ ɔɔnyi ɔkɔ taavi. Na kakunkɛ kamɛni kadubɔƒɔ lɛlɔ kakya kaduli kammɔ kemmo útédu uwi ɔni na ligyiiku iye lɛtabi biala lɛ́bwɛ lɛ́yii udu.’ ” Ala Bɔnu Maatɛdi Bɔkɛnku Uleku Ɔni Nkya Kagyigyɛ Kemmo

english_verse: Now the angel who was there to explain the visions came over and said, “Look up and tell me what you see coming.”
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔtu ɔni nnye mmɔ na uudie ala budie taatina bɔmɛni kalɔ mmɔ ɔ́ni úde-mi, na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Nwini na anu kayaa, na asu-mi lɛla lɛni na aanu.”

english_verse: “I don't know what it is,” was my reply. “It's a big basket,” he said. “And it shows what everyone in the land has in mind.”
translation_verse: Amu na lɛ́su-nwu nnii lɛɛɛgyi lɛla lɛni na lɛdi. Mmɔ na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Kagyigyɛ bonwu kadi na kadi, na kayawi kamɛni bekyuli ƒui ekpidi ani na baabla nkya-ka kemmo.”

english_verse: The lead cover of the basket was opened, and in the basket was a woman.
translation_verse: Bébimi kagyigyɛ kammɔ abuala libila, na uleku ɔdi nkya-ka kemmo.

english_verse: “This woman represents evil,” the angel explained. Then he threw her back into the basket and slammed the heavy cover down tight.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Uleku ɔmɛni unye ute likpidi lɛni nkya kayawi.” Ɔmmɔ kama ni, ɔ́sɔ údi uleku ɔmmɔ útákya kagyigyɛ kammɔ kemmo, na ɔ́sɔku abuala libila lɛmmɔ úbi kagyigyɛ kammɔ kenye kpakplaa.

english_verse: Right after this I saw two women coming through the sky with wings outstretched like a stork in the wind. Suddenly they lifted the basket into the air,
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi na ɔmmɔ kama ni, lɛ́nu beleku inyɔ badi ka béveyi bakɛ kayaa aani baƒiɔlɔƒiɔ na bébimi bana avwi bɛbɛɛbɛ na bakya ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kemmo. Kɔnakunwi ni, bágyu kagyigyɛ kamɛni bákɔliku kayaa.

english_verse: and I asked the angel, “Where are they taking the basket?”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na líye ɔtu ɔmmɔ nnini, “Wɛ na béti kagyigyɛ kammɔ béselaku?”

english_verse: “To Babylonia,” he answered, “where they will build a house for the basket and set it down inside.”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Babilon. Mmɔ na bésela batátu ɔtɔ ɔdi bete-ka na beti-ka bese mmɔ.”

english_verse: Finally, I looked up and saw four chariots coming from between two bronze mountains.
translation_verse: Kawɔlɔkɔ ni, lɛ́nu katɔ na lɛ́nu bapɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ ine lɛdi ka lɛ́si lɛdubo na abuala egyiedi abi anyɔ adi ntɛ.

english_verse: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, and the second by black horses;
translation_verse: Kɛɛkɛ udeedi ni, bapɔnkɔ begyiedi badi mɔɔní-nwu. Na unyɔdi ni, bapɔnkɔ batondi mɔɔní-nwu.

english_verse: the third chariot was pulled by white horses, and the fourth by spotted gray horses.
translation_verse: Na ɔtɛdi ni, bapɔnkɔ baƒualadi mɔɔní anwu. Na unedi ni, bapɔnkɔ bani nse nwana nwana mɔɔní anwu lɛnɔ. Na bapɔnkɔ bammɔ ƒui bebo ɔlɔkplu.

english_verse: “Sir,” I asked the angel. “What do these stand for?”
translation_verse: Amu na líye ɔtu ɔmmɔ nnini, “Ati, bi na ala amɛni ƒui enye ete?”

english_verse: Then he explained, “These are the four winds of heaven, and now they are going out, after presenting themselves to the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na údie kalɔ ɔnini, “Ayu ene ani nási katɔ béti lɛlɔ atátina Unwoti ɔni mɔɔdi kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ asa na badubusie batávi na badi.

english_verse: The chariot with black horses goes toward the north, the chariot with white horses goes toward the west, and the one with spotted horses goes toward the south.”
translation_verse: Kɛɛkɛ ɔni na bapɔnkɔ batondi baaní ni, úti úsela katɔ kakɛ. Na kɛɛkɛ ɔni na bapɔnkɔ baƒualadi baaní ni, úti úsela ɔƒɛ kanukɔ. Na bani nse nwana nwana ni, ama lɛnɔ báni ama ɔdi bésela kada kakɛ.”

english_verse: The horses came out eager to patrol the earth, and the angel told them, “Start patrolling the earth.” When they had gone on their way,
translation_verse: Na bapɔnkɔ bayikune bammɔ bálɛ bébo, na bana atu áta enye ka baayɔ́ ka besie bavi kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Amu na ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bise kalɔ na bisie bɛsɔ kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ.” Na béti bana ulu bésela.

english_verse: he shouted to me, “Those that have gone to the country in the north will do what the Lord's Spirit wants them to do there.” The Chosen Leader
translation_verse: Na ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́va momoomo na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Nu! Bani nétiku lɛlɔ bésela kalɔ na katɔ kakɛ ni, badubo Unwoti Kɔyu lɛyɔla lɛni na ɔɔwia bɔbla.” Báƒuna Ɔtɔnkune Ɔdi

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah have returned from Babylonia. Collect enough silver and gold from them to make a crown. Then go with them to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah and put the crown on the head of the high priest Joshua son of Jehozadak.
translation_verse: “Sie na atáƒɔ sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi asiku Heldai ku Tobia ku Yedaia bani nénwini bási Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ bébo na eti abla kagabwa. Na bɛsiaku lɛlɔ bisie Seƒania ubidi Yosia kaduli na eti kagabwa kammɔ ebi Yehosadak ubidi Yosua ɔni ndi ɔkpane unengudi lili.

english_verse: Tell him that I, the Lord All-Powerful, say, “Someone will reach out from here like a branch and build a temple for me. I will name him ‘Branch,’ and he will rule with royal honors. A priest will stand beside his throne, and the two of them will be good friends.
translation_verse: Na asu-nwu ka ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui násu nnii, ‘Ukyuli ɔdi ɔdubɔkɔ ɔlɛ mɛni aani kugyii kagba kalɛ na ɔtu mina kakpakɔ ute-mi. Na ndubɔlɔ-nwu nnii Kugyii Kagba na anwu ndubo bekyuli lɛlɔ bɔdi aani ɔga ɔni mbo ɔbu kalɛ. Na ɔkpane ɔdi ɔdubunye-nwu kɔmadɔ na nwuna lɛgaboku kudɔ. Na bana inyɔ badubɔbla kabla basala ku ebiti ku keyi buɛɛ.’

english_verse: This crown will be kept in my temple as a reminder and will be taken care of by Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah.”
translation_verse: Na kagabwa kammɔ kadubuse mina kakpakɔ aani likposela ute Heldai ku Tobia ku Yedaia ku Seƒania ubidi Yosia.

english_verse: When people from distant lands come and help build the temple of the Lord All-Powerful, you will know that the Lord is the one who sent me. And this will happen, if you truly obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “Na si bekyuli bani nási ɔlɔgyu bébo na bébebunku na bɛ́tu Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui kakpakɔ kammɔ ni, bɛdubɔti ka Unwoti ndi ukyuli ɔni nátala-mi ɔ́kya-mii. Na ɔmɛni ɔdububo-nwu kemmo lɛni si bínu na bɛ́di Unwoti bina Katɔti litemi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: On the fourth day of Chislev, the ninth month of the fourth year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord again spoke to me.
translation_verse: Na Ɔga Dario lɛga bɔdi lɛkwa linedi nwuna kɔbuli kunedi kɔni baalɔ banii Kislev kemmo ni, Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-mi lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: It happened after the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer with Regem-Melech and his men to ask the priests in the Lord's temple and the prophets to pray for them. So they prayed, “Should we mourn and go without eating during the fifth month, as we have done for many years?”
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛmɛni lɛ́lɛ na uwi ɔni na Betelƒuɔ bekyuli bátala Sareser ku Regem Melek ku bana bekyuli banii betévele bakpane na Katɔti kakpakɔ ku Katɔti kenye bediene na beye-ma benu banini, “Bunyimi na ɔ́lɛka bunyimi kenye na kɔbuli kɔlɔndi kemmo kalɛ na bɔ́bla akwa pii ani návi?”

english_verse: And when you eat and drink, isn't it for your own enjoyment?
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́di na bɛ́kɛ bɛɛní lɛnɔ ni, ɔɔɔdi amii bina ebiti ku lɛlɔyɔ kani na ɔdi?

english_verse: My message today is the same one I commanded the earlier prophets to speak to Jerusalem and its villages when they were prosperous, and when all of Judah, including the Southern Desert and the hill country, was filled with people.
translation_verse: Mina kenye kani na mbo nte-mii ɔmwi ni, aka kani na líbo kenye bediene bakukudi bammɔ ɔda ka basu Yerusalem ku nwuna akpaklɔ lɛma lɛmmɔ uwi ɔni na ala átɛnku-ma, na bekyuli báƒɔ Yuda ƒui ku Negev. Yuda Bekyuli Bábla Atu Ɔkplu

english_verse: So once again, I, the Lord All-Powerful, tell you, “See that justice is done and be kind and merciful to one another!
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, nsɔ mɔɔsu-mii nnii bɛnu ka bɛ́tɛ etemila ulu siin lɛlɔ. Na bɛbla lɛƒɔndia na bɛnu lɛlɔ kɔnyana lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Don't mistreat widows or orphans or foreigners or anyone who is poor, and stop making plans to hurt each other.”
translation_verse: Bɛsɔ bitabla bekpinele iye bekpinebi iye baƒɔ iye bawabane ulikplu. Na bɛsɔ bitelie bitataakya likpidi bɔbla kɔkwɛ na bina bakpana lɛlɔ ka bɛbla-ma kalala.

english_verse: But everyone who heard those prophets, stubbornly refused to obey. Instead, they turned their backs on everything my Spirit had commanded the earlier prophets to preach. So I, the Lord, became angry
translation_verse: “Nsu bekyuli bani ƒui nénu kenye bediene bammɔ ala bɔsu bábla atuɔkplu na béni litemi lɛmmɔ bunu. Mmomu bénwini kama bákya lɛla biala na mina kɔyu kɔ́tɔnku kenye bediene kuuku bammɔ na bákɔ-ni lɛsa béte bekyuli. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na ami Unwoti lɛnɔ lɛ́kɛ kɔnyi geen!

english_verse: and said, “You people paid no attention when I called out to you, and now I'll pay no attention when you call out to me.”
translation_verse: “Na lɛ́su nnini, ‘Uwi ɔni na lɛ́kpali-mii límene ni, bina akɔ ɔdi biala útenu-mi litemi. Anwuɔsu ami lɛnɔ lɛɛɛdubo bina litemi bunu.

english_verse: That's why I came with a whirlwind and scattered them among foreign nations, leaving their lovely country empty of people and in ruins.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na líbo na ndaku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔni mɔɔkya ligede na ḿbegyingya bana ƒui lɛ́kya kaƒɔ kɔlɔ ƒui lɛlɔ, na báda bana ɔma ɔbuni ɔmmɔ béwi, na bekyuli bása-nwu kemmo na bébile ala lɛnɔ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me:
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́su-mi ɔnini,

english_verse: I love Zion so much that her enemies make me angry.
translation_verse: “Mɔɔyɔ́ Sion geen ɔni na nwuna bekisine baakya-mi kɔnyi.

english_verse: I will return to Jerusalem and live there on Mount Zion. Then Jerusalem will be known as my faithful city, and Zion will be known as my holy mountain.
translation_verse: “Ndubɔsɔ linwini lisie Yerusalem na ntélie Sion Kɔbi kedee lɛlɔ. Na bekyuli ƒui badubɔnu Yerusalem bati aani mina ɔma ɔni nsiaku-mi kama siin. Na basu ka Sion ndi mina kɔbi kedee.

english_verse: Very old people with walking sticks will once again sit around in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: “Na benengu bani na bábi lɛlɔ geen na bada ligyii lɛdadi badubɔsɔ belie bamana Yerusalem.

english_verse: while boys and girls play in the streets.
translation_verse: Na bananabi ku belekubi bataaƒia na kuyeya.

english_verse: This may seem impossible for my people who are left, but it isn't impossible for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli anumi ni, ɔmɛni ɔdi lɛla lɛni na baanu ka libo ɔkplu na liladia bɔbla. Nsu na ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui kudɔ ni, ese-mi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: I will save those who were taken to lands in the east and the west,
translation_verse: “Ndubudie bekyuli bani na béti bátɔlɔku bésienku kɔlɔ kɔni nkya ɔƒɛ katukɔ ku kanukɔ

english_verse: and I will bring them to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, faithful to bring about justice.
translation_verse: na basɔ benwini bebelie Yerusalem. Badubunwini mina bekyuli, na ami lɛbla bana Katɔti, na lɛsia mina litemi kama siin, na lɛtɛ bana etemila ulu siin lɛlɔ lite-ma.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! So don't give up. Think about the message my prophets spoke when the foundation of my temple was laid.
translation_verse: “Na enu ataƒɛ-mii, ɔsika Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui na ndi. Bɛbla kasusu bɛsiku etemila ani na mina kenye bediene básu-mii uwi ɔni na baakya mina kakpakɔ kowodu kalɔ ɔka.

english_verse: Before that time, neither people nor animals were rewarded for their work, and no one was safe anywhere, because I had turned them against each other.
translation_verse: Kuuku asa na uwi ɔmmɔ úbedu ni, nka ukyuli ɔyawine iye ebuo ɔdi uuubo lɛyuƒɔla lɛdi na nwuna kabla kani na ɔ́bla ɔsu. Na keyi buɛɛ kadi lɛnɔ keeebo na ɔdi ulie na atu bɔyɔ kemmo, ɔsika lɛ́ya na bana ƒui báta bénye lɛlɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My people, only a few of you are left, and I promise not to punish you as I did before.
translation_verse: Mina bekyuli, bɛɛnu ka bina ɛlɛɛ kani nébu, na muudie-mii kenye ka nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-mii kɔtu bɔni aani kalɛ na lɛ́bla ḿbavi kuuku kalɛ.

english_verse: Instead, I will make sure that your crops are planted in peace and your vineyards are fruitful, that your fields are fertile, and the dew falls from the sky.
translation_verse: “Mmomu ni, ndubɔnu ka bɛkya bina edula ɔƒaamu na atu bɔyɔ kemmo, na bina adingyii mmo lɛnɔ adubɔbla kaduɛ na anwu ebi pii. Na bina katumalɔ kadubulie lɛmwi, na amii ayu ewi bina edula lɛlɔ.

english_verse: People of Judah and Israel, you have been a curse to the nations, but I will save you and make you a blessing to them. So don't be afraid or lose courage.
translation_verse: Amii Yuda ku Israel kadi bekyuli, bínwini lɛla lɛni na beewida taakya kadi ƒui bekyuli banii ɔdubɔlɛku-ma aani amii. Nsu ndubɔƒɔ-mii na binwini kusɛ kusɛ bite-ma ɔƒɛni amu. Anwuɔsu bitayila bina lɛnunsia na enu aƒɛ-mii.

english_verse: When your ancestors made me angry, I decided to punish you with disasters, and I didn't hold back.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔni na bina bati kuuku bákya-mi kɔnyi ni, lɛ́lɛ ugyii ka lɛya na ɔgbankpi ubo-mii lɛlɔ liti lɛni-mii kɔtu na ńteni ɔmɛni bɔbla.

english_verse: Now you no longer need to be afraid. I have decided to treat Jerusalem and Judah with kindness.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒaani ni, ɔ́sɔ útalɛka bɛyia. Ɔsika lɛ́lɛ ugyii ka lɛda amii Yerusalem ku Yudaƒuɔ ƒui kɔkɔɔkɔ.

english_verse: But you must be truthful with each other, and in court you must give fair decisions that lead to peace.
translation_verse: Nsu bɛsu lɛlɔ litemi geen lɛmmɔ, na bɛnu ka bɛɛtɛ etemila na ulu lɛlɔ siin teete bekyuli kalɛ na uboku keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't ever plan evil things against others or tell lies under oath. I, the Lord, hate such things. A Time of Celebration
translation_verse: Bitakya likpidi kɔkwɛ na bina bakpana lɛlɔ kudii na bitakpali ala bitanyi ɔkɔ bitasia bina bekyulikpana. Ɔsika ami, Unwoti, nkisi ala ammɔ udu.” Bɛdi Limeyi Na Uwi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful told me to say:
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́su-mi ka nsu-mii nnini,

english_verse: People of Judah, I, the Lord, demand that whenever you go without food as a way of worshiping me, it should become a time of celebration. No matter if it's the fourth month, the fifth month, the seventh month, or the tenth month, you should have a joyful festival. So love truth and live at peace.
translation_verse: “Amii Yuda kadi bekyuli, ami Unwoti mɔɔwia ka uwi biala na bɛnii biinyimi kenye na biti bɛkpali-mi ni, ɔlɛka uwi ɔmmɔ unwini limeyi bɔdi uwi. Kɔbuli kunedi kɔdi o-o, kɔbuli kɔlɔndi kɔdi o-o, kɔbuli maatɛdi o-o, leevudi kɔdi o-o ni, ɔlɛka bɛdi limeyi ku lɛlɔyɔ. Anwuɔsu bɛyɔ litemi geen kama bɔsia na bilieku lɛlɔ ku keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: I tell you that people will come here from cities everywhere.
translation_verse: “Na mɔɔsu-mii geen ka bekyuli badubɔsi lɛma linengudi ku kesii bamba ƒui bebo mɛni.

english_verse: Those of one town will go to another and say, “We're going to ask the Lord All-Powerful to treat us with kindness. Come and join us.”
translation_verse: Na ɔma unwi ɔdubɔsu ɔma bamba ɔnini, ‘Búsela butákpali Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui na ɔnu-bu ku lɛƒɔndia, anwuɔsu bibo bibebunku-bu na busie.’

english_verse: Many people from strong nations will come to Jerusalem to worship me and to ask me to treat them with kindness.
translation_verse: Kadi bayikune pii badubɔsi bana kɔlɔ bebo Yerusalem babakpali-mi na bevele-mi banii nnwini nnu-ma ku lɛƒɔndia.

english_verse: When this happens, ten people from nations with different languages will grab a Jew by his clothes and say, “Let us go with you. We've heard that God is on your side.” I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na ala amɛni adubo butaalɛ lɛni ni, kadi bamba bekyuli adi batɛmine aani leevu badubuƒie Yudani adala ani na ɔkya bada momoomo na basu-nwu banini, ‘Ya na bɔsiaku-ɔ busie bina ɔma, ɔsika búnu ka Katɔti unye-mii kama geen.’ Ami Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui násu!”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord: His eyes are on everyone, especially the tribes of Israel. So he pronounces judgment against the cities of Hadrach and Damascus.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔnii nwuna anumi asia ukyuli biala lɛlɔ, na bani ɔdi mbo ɔkplu utulo ƒui ndi Israel adua ammɔ. Na ɔ́tɛ litemi ɔ́du Hadrak ku Damasko lɛma linengudi lɛmmɔ kɔtɔ.

english_verse: Judgment will also fall on the nearby city of Hamath, as well as on Tyre and Sidon, whose people are clever.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na ɔdubɔtɛ litemi na ɔdu Hamat ɔma unengudi ɔni na ude mmɔ kɔtɔ ku Tiro ku Sidon lɛma bekyuli bani náda anu mmɔ.

english_verse: Tyre has built a fortress and piled up silver and gold, as though they were dust or mud from the streets.
translation_verse: Tiro ɔ́tu kagyumanakɔ kpakplaa na ɔ́buma sika ɔƒualadi ku ugyiedi úyile mmɔ kalɛ na basu banii ulu ntɛ lɛti na lɛdi.

english_verse: Now the Lord will punish Tyre with poverty; he will sink its ships and send it up in flames.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani ni, Unwoti ɔdubɔni Tiro kɔtu na ɔya na kɔwaba kuƒie-nwu. Nwuna lɛkɔlɔ libendi lɛdubɔnu ntu na lɛdi lɛnɔ lɛda ogya.

english_verse: Both Ashkelon and Gaza will tremble with fear; Ekron will lose all hope. Gaza's king will be killed, and Ashkelon emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Na Askelon ku Gasa lɛma ƒui litaatɔ kpakpaakpa na liƒu ɔsu. Na Ekron anwu ɔyila lɛnunsia biala. Badubɔdu Gasa ɔga na bayila Askelon bekyuli ƒui udu.

english_verse: A mob of half-breeds will settle in Ashdod, and the Lord himself will rob Philistia of pride.
translation_verse: Baƒɔ bebi badubɔsi ekpo ekpo bebeti Asdod ɔma ɔmmɔ benwini ama ɔdi. Na Unwoti ɔlati ɔdubukpeli Ƒilisti ubo na nwuna lɛlɔ katɔ bɔtalaku ɔsu.

english_verse: No longer will the Philistines eat meat with blood in it or any unclean food. They will become part of the people of our God from the tribe of Judah. And God will accept the people of Ekron, as he did the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Na Ƒilistiƒuɔ basɔ baaadubo lɛna ku ubugya bɔkun iye adila bamba ani muusé lɛlɔ. Mmomu badubunwini Yuda kakɛ kadi na basɔ balakun lɛna ku ubugya. Ama lɛnɔ badubunwini bula Katɔti bekyuli aani kɔdua na Yuda adua akladi akɔ. Na Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ Ekron ɔma bekyuli aani kalɛ na ɔ́bla Yebusiƒuɔ.

english_verse: God says, “I will stand guard to protect my temple from those who come to attack. I know what's happening, and no one will mistreat my people ever again.” The Lord Tells about the Coming King
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔnini, “Ndubo lɛlɔ bɔklibi buse na lɛgyumana mina kakpakɔ na bekyuli bani muubo banii bebekpo babwɛ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ɔsu. Ngyi ala ani ƒui mɔɔlɛ́, na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo kuƒi bute na ɔdi ubabla mina kadi bekyuli kalala kadi lɛnɔ.” Unwoti Ɔ́su Ka Badubɔwɔ Ɔga

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! Your king has won a victory, and he is coming to you. He is humble and rides on a donkey; he comes on the colt of a donkey.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔni nkya Sion ɔdi limeyi na ɔva momoomo ku ebiti banini, “Bɛnu! Bina ɔga ɔdubo-mii kudɔ. Use siin na ɔdanku bɔƒɔ. Uboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na ulie ebuo ala utine ubi lɛlɔ ɔdubo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will take away war chariots and horses from Israel and Jerusalem. Bows that were made for battle will be broken. I will bring peace to nations, and your king will rule from sea to sea. His kingdom will reach from the Euphrates River across the earth. The Lord Promises To Rescue Captives
translation_verse: Ami, Unwoti, ndubɔda kekpo kɛɛkɛ ku bana bapɔnkɔ lɛlɛku Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na kɔtaminta kɔni na bényimi bése béte kekpo ni, ndubɔƒɛ-ku ƒui. Ndubuti keyi buɛɛ liboku kadi bekyuli. Na ƒula ɔga ɔdubɔdi lɛlɔ ɔ́si ɛpu ɔvi unwi úsie ɔvi ɔkladi. Na nwuna lɛga kadikɔ kadubɔsi Euƒrate Ketu bonwu kɔtu na kavia kalɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Unwoti Úse Kenye Ka Ɔdubudie Bekyuli Bani Ƒui Na Béƒie

english_verse: When I made a sacred agreement with you, my people, we sealed it with blood. Now some of you are captives in waterless pits, but I will come to your rescue
translation_verse: “Kenye kani na línyimi ku amii mina bekyuli ni, ubugya na búti buse-ka likpo. Na ɔƒaani ni, amii badi bɛdi bekyuli bani na béƒie bákya libiɔ lɛni kemmo na ntu buuuwi kemmo. Nsu ndubo mbedie-mii na lɛƒɔ-mii,

english_verse: and offer you hope. Return to your fortress, because today I will reward you with twice what you had.
translation_verse: na lɛya na bɛsɔ bɛkɛ lɛnunsia. Binwini bisie bina kagyumanakɔ kpakplaa kammɔ. Ɔsika ɔmwi ni, ndubo-mii kayu bɔƒɔ akpa anyɔ na kabla ala ani nése-mii dii ɔsu.

english_verse: I will use Judah as my bow and Israel as my arrow. I will take the people of Zion as my sword and attack the Greeks. The Lord Will Protect His People
translation_verse: Na ndubuti Yuda lɛbla aani mina kataminta na liti Israel lɛbla atula. Na ndubuti Sion bekyuli lɛbla aani mina kewii na likpoku Grikiƒuɔ.” Unwoti Ɔdubɔgyumana Nwuna Bekyuli

english_verse: Like a cloud, the Lord God will appear over his people, and his arrows will flash like lightning. God will sound his trumpet and attack in a whirlwind from the south.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubɔda ɔlɛ kayaa na bana eli, na nwuna atula adubo butaatu taavi kayaa aani kalɛ na kayaa kaabwɛ ogya. Katɔti ɔdubɔya na bavwi nwuna kɔkpɛɛ, na ɔdubukpoku nwuna bekisine na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔni mɔɔkya ligede kemmo ɔsi kada kakɛ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will protect his people, and they will trample down the sharpshooters and their slingshots. They will drink and get rowdy; they will be as full as a bowl at the time of sacrifice.
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔdubo nwuna bekyuli bɔgyumana, na ɔya na bani muuƒwimi kavwinvwi ku atabi bubo geen banya bana bekisine besusu kalɔ. Badubo butaabɔku-ma ku kɔvanu aani bekyuli bani na békpi ntɛ na bana ɔyikun umo-ma aani ubugya akpala kalaku kani néyi tɛtɛɛtɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God will save them on that day, because they are his people, and they will shine on his land like jewels in a crown.
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubudie-ma limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ, ɔsika nwuna bekyuli na badi. Na badubo buteekeye aani asɛɛ ebi ani náƒɔ kuye geen na akya kagabwa kemmo.

english_verse: How lovely they will be. Young people will grow there like grain in a field or grapes in a vineyard.
translation_verse: Na badubɔdia bɔnu geen. Na bakloƒu ku begblebi badubɔlɛ lili na mmɔ aani kalɛ na kamu kaalɛ teenye kemo iye egyiibi ani nánwu asia na adingyii kemo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am the one who sends storm clouds and showers of rain to make fields produce. So when the crops need rain, you should pray to me.
translation_verse: “Ami, Unwoti, na ɔlɛka bɛkpali bivele ɔnantu si bina edula aawia ntu. Ɔsika ami ndi ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyá na liƒlukutu kemmo ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uukpó, na mɔɔyá na ɔnantu ɔɔna teewi kemo edula lɛlɔ na aadia.

english_verse: You can't believe idols and fortunetellers, or depend on the hope you receive from witchcraft and interpreters of dreams. But you have tried all of these, and now you are like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Bilakana baƒiɔ ku like bebone bɔƒɔ bɔdi, na bilakana bevone ku bani muudie ana kalɔ bɔƒɔ bɔdi. Nsu bɛ́ɛbla ala amɛni ƒui bɛ́nu. Na ɔƒɛni amu bínwini aani baƒonu bani neeebo ɔdane.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am fiercely angry with you leaders, and I will punish you. I care for my people, the nation of Judah, and I will change this flock of sheep into charging war horses.
translation_verse: “Ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, lɛ́kɛ kɔnyi geen lɛ́kya amii batɔnkune bammɔ na ndubo-mii kɔtu bɔni. Mina kadi bekyuli, Yudaƒuɔ, lɛlɔ libo-mi ɔlɛ geen, na ndubɔya na baƒonu lisu lɛni nkɛ mɛni benwini kekpo bapɔnkɔ bani nkɛ ku usi geen bésela kekpokɔ.

english_verse: From this flock will come leaders who will be strong like cornerstones and tent pegs and weapons of war.
translation_verse: “Na baƒonu bamɛni kemmo na ndubo ɔtɔnkune bɔƒuna bani ndubo ɔkplu bɔyu geen aani atabi kpakplaa ani na béti bábala kowodu ekpo iye kevo abuli ewele iye ekpola.

english_verse: They will join in the fighting, and together they will trample their enemies like mud. They will fight, because I, the Lord, will be on their side. And they will crush the enemy cavalry.
translation_verse: Badubo bubunku na kekpo kammɔ kemmo na badubɔsala lɛlɔ na badi bana bekisine lɛlɔ na besusu-ma bakya lɛgba kalɔ aani aba. Badubo bukpo, ɔsika ami Unwoti ndubunye-ma kama na besusu bana bekisine bekpone bapɔnkɔ beliene bammɔ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.

english_verse: I will strengthen the kingdoms of Judah and Israel. And I will show mercy because I am the Lord, their God. I will answer their prayers and bring them home. Then it will seem as though I had never rejected them.
translation_verse: “Ndubɔkya Yudaƒuɔ ku Israelƒuɔ lɛga kɔdikɔ kɔmmɔ ɔyikun. Na ndubɔnu-ma kɔnyana, ɔsika ami ndi Unwoti, bana Katɔti. Ndubunu-ma buvele na lɛkpanku-ma liboku ɔma na ɔbla aani si buni na ńteni-ma kudii.

english_verse: Israel will be like a tribe of warriors celebrating with wine. When their children see this, they will also be happy because of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Israel ɔdubɔbla aani bekpone bani mbo ogya geen, na lɛlɔ lɛdubo-ma butaayɔ aani bekyuli bani na báni ntɛ. Na si bana bebi lɛnɔ bánu ɔmɛni ni, ebiti adubo-ma bɔda geen na ami, Unwoti, ɔsu.

english_verse: I will give a signal for them to come together because I have rescued them. And there will be as many as ever before.
translation_verse: “Ndubo-ma kɔnu bubo na babasala, ɔsika ndubukpo lídie-ma na lɛya na basɔ bemomo aani kalɛ na bése dii.

english_verse: Although I scattered my people in distant countries, they won't forget me. Once their children are raised, they will return—
translation_verse: Ina ka lígyingya mina bekyuli lɛ́kya kaƒɔ kalɔ ɔlɔgyu muedi ni, baaadubo-mi bɔyiƒala. Ama ku bana bebi ƒui badubɔkɛ ngba na benwini bebo.

english_verse: I will bring them home from Egypt and Assyria, then let them settle as far as Gilead and Lebanon, until the land overflows with them.
translation_verse: Ndubo-ma bɔkpanku bɔsiku Egyipte ku Asiria kalɔ lɛlɔ liboku ɔma, na lɛya na belie Gilead ku Lebanon na bemomo baƒɔ kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My people will go through an ocean of troubles, but I will overcome the waves and dry up the deepest part of the Nile. Assyria's great pride will be put down, and the power of Egypt will disappear.
translation_verse: “Lɛbibo lɛdubo mina bekyuli butulo aani kalɛ na baanú teeduo ɛpu kemmo. Nsu ndubo ɛpu avlɔvɔ ammɔ kenye butile, na lɛya na Nil Ketu kakwii ketédu nwuna ligyu kalɔ kalɔ ƒui. Na lɛya na Asiriaƒuɔ lɛmɛnɛ bɔkun ku Egyipte ɔyikun ƒui ubo kalɔ na ɔyii udu.

english_verse: I'll strengthen my people because of who I am, and they will follow me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ndubo mina bekyuli ɔyikun bɔkya na ukyuli ɔni udu na ndi ɔsu, na lɛya na basiaku-mi. Ami Unwoti násu!”

english_verse: Lebanon, open your gates! Let the fire come in to destroy your cedar trees.
translation_verse: Lebanon, lɛmi ƒula ɔban kɔyakun wi na ogya uduo-ku kemmo na ɔkyula ƒula egyii enengudi kpakplaa ammɔ.

english_verse: Cry, you cypress trees! The glorious cedars have fallen and are rotting. Cry, you oak trees of Bashan! The dense forest has been chopped down.
translation_verse: Na amii egyii lidu bamba lɛnɔ biteewulo, ɔsika egyii enengudi kpakplaa ammɔ atɛ kalɔ eebun. Lɛni kani na amii Basan kalɔ egyii enengudi kpakplaa ammɔ lɛnɔ biteewulo, ɔsika bina lɛkumiɔ lɛmmɔ lɛ́yii udu.

english_verse: Listen! Shepherds are crying. Their glorious pastures have been ruined. Listen! Lions are roaring. The forests of the Jordan Valley are no more to be found. Worthless Shepherds
translation_verse: Bise atu na binu! Baƒonu badane beewulo ka bana bebuo kadikɔ ƒui káyii udu ka livo buni lɛsɔ liiibo ɔsu. Binu! Bagyata baakwanyi, ɔsika Yordan Ɔkwalɛ aku ƒui áyii udu na asɔ eeebo na ukyuli ɔnu. Baƒonu Badane Inyɔ Badi Lɛlɔ Kɔtɛ

english_verse: The Lord my God said to me: Tend those sheep doomed for slaughter!
translation_verse: Mina Unwoti Katɔti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Baƒonu bani na nka béedie bése ka badu mmɔ ni, nu-ma lɛlɔ!

english_verse: The people who buy and butcher them go unpunished, while everyone who sells them says, “Praise the Lord! I'm rich.” Not even their shepherds have pity on them.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muuyé-ma taatádu bakɛ ƒaa ɔni na balani ɔdi kɔtu. Na bani lɛnɔ muuti-ma teeye mmɔ ama enu na baakɔliku katɔ taasu banini, ‘Bɔɔgyá Unwoti enu ka bɔ́kɛ egulabi.’ Na baƒonu bammɔ baládu bana badane muedi kaƒɔ.

english_verse: Tend those sheep because I, the Lord, will no longer have pity on the people of this earth. I'll turn neighbor against neighbor and make them slaves of a king. They will bring disaster on the earth, and I'll do nothing to rescue any of them.
translation_verse: Nu baƒonu bammɔ lɛlɔ, ɔsika ami Unwoti nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ bekyuli kɔnyana bɔnu. Mmomu ndubɔya na bata benye lɛlɔ lɛlɔ na benwini kabla bablane bete ɔga ɔdi. Badubuti ɔgbankpi bonwu beboku kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ, na lɛɛɛdubo lɛla lɛdi bɔbla na likpo lidie-ma.”

english_verse: So I became a shepherd of those sheep doomed to be slaughtered by the sheep dealers. And I gave names to the two sticks I used for tending the sheep: One of them was named “Mercy” and the other “Unity.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu baƒonu bani na balati bédie bése ka badu mmɔ ni, línwini bana lɛlɔ ɔnune. Na ligyii inyɔ lɛni nda mɔɔkpanku-ma mmɔ ni, lɛ́sia-ni anyi. Na unwi mɔɔlɔ nnii Kɔnyana Bɔnu, na unyɔdi mɔɔlɔ nnii Unwi Bɔbla.

english_verse: In less than a month, I became impatient with three shepherds who didn't like me, and I got rid of them.
translation_verse: Útedu kɔbuli kunwi asa na lɛ́ya na baƒonu badane ɛtɛ badi bátɔlɔ. Na lɛ́nu ka baƒonu balayɔ-mi litemi, na ńsɔ ńtakɛ kayi ńtete-ma.

english_verse: Then I said, “I refuse to be your shepherd. Let the sheep that are going to die, go on and die, and those that are going to be destroyed, go on and be destroyed. Then let the others eat one another alive.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́su nnini, “Líni na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-mii bɔda aani baƒonu ɔdane kalɛ. Si baƒonu bani na bukpi na badubo ni, bakana na beteekpi. Na bani na badubo-ma udu bɔyila lɛnɔ ni, bakana na bataayila-ma udu. Na bakladi lɛnɔ bakana na bataakun lɛlɔ ku ngba ku ngba.”

english_verse: On that same day, I broke the stick named “Mercy” to show that the Lord had canceled his agreement with all people.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛmmɔ kani lɛlɔ na lɛ́ƒɛ ugyii ɔni na nka mɔɔlɔ nnii Kɔnyana Bɔnu líti mɔɔtina ka Unwoti úbile bunyimi bɔni na únyimi ku bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: The sheep dealers who saw me knew at once that this was a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na úbile bunyimi bɔmmɔ ni, bekyuli bani mɔɔdi baƒonu bamɛni kuye bani nánu-mi ni, báti kɔnakunwi ka linyesia lɛmɛni lɛ́si Unwoti kudɔ.

english_verse: Then I broke the stick named “Unity” and canceled the ties between Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama lɛ́ƒɔ ugyii ɔni na mɔɔlɔ nnii Unwi Bɔbla, na ɔ́tina ka líkulo kɔna kɔni nkya Yudaƒuɔ ku Israelƒuɔ ntɛ.

english_verse: Next, the Lord said to me, “Act like a shepherd again—this time a worthless shepherd.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Sɔ taabla ƒula baƒonu ɔdane kabla aani baƒonu ɔdane ɔni lɛlɔ neeebo kɔsia kɔdi.

english_verse: Once more I am going to let a worthless nobody rule the land—one who won't care for the strays or search for the young or heal the sick or feed the healthy. He will just dine on the fattest sheep, leaving nothing but a few bones.”
translation_verse: Na nsɔ ndubo bɔya na ukyuli keeke ɔni naaadaku unwini baƒonu bammɔ ɔdane. Ukyuli ɔni naaadubo bɔdaku baƒonu bani mɔɔyii ulu ulakpete bani muuƒi na ɔbwi-ma iye ute-ma adila muedi na badi. Mmomu anwu ɔlati ɔdubɔkun baƒonu bani nélie lɛmwi mmɔ ƒui, na kebu ekubi ekubi.

english_verse: You worthless shepherd, deserting the sheep! I hope a sword will cripple your arm and blind your right eye.
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ ute awɔ baƒonu ɔdane keeke ɔni neeebo kɔsia na eedie baƒonu atu! Mɔɔwia ka nka kewii kekulo-ɔ kɔnu na ɔbla lɛnuku, na ƒula kɔdianu lɛnumi lɛnɔ lɛbwɛ.”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord about Israel: I am the Lord! I stretched out the heavens; I put the earth on its foundations and gave breath to humans.
translation_verse: Linyesia lɛmɛni lɛdanku Israel na lɛ́si Unwoti kudɔ lɛnini, “Ami ndi Unwoti! Na ami nébimi kayaa lɛ́ƒala katɔ, na lɛ́ya na kalɔ kenye kana ɔka lɛlɔ, na líti ɔƒɛƒɛɛ líte ukyuli na ɔɔnwuna.

english_verse: I have decided that Jerusalem will become a bowl of wine that makes the neighboring nations drunk. And when Jerusalem is attacked, Judah will also be attacked.
translation_verse: Ami náya na Yerusalem únwini aani ntɛ ku kalaku bonwu na liku bekyuli kɔlɔ bekyuli baaní-mu teekpi. Na si békpoku Yerusalem ni, na badubo Yuda lɛnɔ bukpoku.

english_verse: But I will turn Jerusalem into a heavy stone that crushes anyone who tries to lift it. When all nations on earth surround Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Nsu ndubo Yerusalem bɔbla na unwini lɛtabi bonwu lɛni na ukyuli biala makali ɔnii ɔɔgyú-ni ni, lɛdubɔyu-nwu na ukpi.

english_verse: I will blind every horse and make them panic, and every rider will be confused. But at the same time, I will watch over Judah.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔya na ɔtɔtɔ ɔgyu ɔpɔnkɔ biala na bana beliene lɛnɔ beƒu. Nsu na uwi ɔmmɔ kani lɛlɔ ni, ndubo Yuda lɛlɔ butaanu. Na ndubɔya na bekisine bammɔ bapɔnkɔ anumi abwɛ na basɔ balakana bɔnu.

english_verse: Then every clan in Judah will realize that I, the Lord All-Powerful, am their God, and that I am the source of their strength.
translation_verse: Na kɔdua biala na Yuda mmɔ badubɔnu ka ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔni ndi bana Katɔti ɔni kudɔ na baakɛ́ bana ɔyikun ƒui taasiku.

english_verse: At that time I will let the clans of Judah be like a ball of fire in a wood pile or a fiery torch in a hay stack. Then Judah will send the surrounding nations up in smoke. And once again the city of Jerusalem will be filled with people.
translation_verse: “Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, ndubɔya na Yuda adua ammɔ enwini aani ogya agyabi bonwu bonwu na egyuku livongu kemmo, iye ogya ɔni mɔɔkya keti litili bonwu lɛdi kemmo. Na ndubɔya na bakya kadi bamba bekyuli bani náka bámana-ma ƒui ogya. Na bekyuli basɔ baƒɔ Yerusalem ɔma pii geen.

english_verse: But I will first give victory to Judah, so the kingdom of David and the city of Jerusalem in all of their glory won't be thought of more highly than Judah itself.
translation_verse: “Nsu ni, ndubɔya na Yuda ɔ́ka lɛlɔ bɔdi kalɛ na bekyuli balanu Ɔga Dawid lɛga kadikɔ ku Yerusalem ku nwuna bukeye ƒui beletulo Yuda.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will protect Jerusalem. Even the weakest person there will be as strong as David, and David's kingdom will rule as though my very own angel were its leader.
translation_verse: Ami Unwoti Katɔti ndubo Yerusalem bɔgyumana na ukyuli ɔni na use kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ utulo ƒui muedi ni, ɔdubɔyu ɔkplu aani Dawid. Na Dawid ɔmmɔ ɔlati lɛga kadikɔ kadubɔbla aani si ami ɔlati mina ɔtu mɔɔdi kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I am determined to wipe out every nation that attacks Jerusalem. Mourning for the One Pierced with a Spear
translation_verse: Lɛ́lɛ ugyii geen ka libile na lɛyila kadi kani mekpoku Yerusalem. Béwulo Kɔnyana Na Ukyuli Ɔni Na Bátu Lɛtula Ɔsu

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the descendants of David and the people of Jerusalem feel deep sorrow and pray when they see the one they pierced with a spear. They will mourn and weep for him, as parents weep over the death of their only child or their first-born.
translation_verse: “Ami Unwoti ndubɔya na Yerusalem bebi ku bawɔ ƒui beduo kɔnyana bonwu kɔdi kemmo na bakpali-mi bevele uwi ɔni na bánu ukyuli ɔni na bátu lɛtula lɛdi. Na badubo-nwu buwulo aani kalɛ na bawɔne badi beewulo bana ubi unwi pɛ ɔni na báwɔ na úkpi iye ubi udeedi ɔni na báyila.

english_verse: On that day the people of Jerusalem will mourn as much as everyone did for Hadad Rimmon on the flatlands near Megiddo.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛmmɔ ni, Yerusalem kadi bekyuli badubo buwulo aani kalɛ na ukyuli biala úwulo Hadad Rimon na kesii kani baalɔ Megido.

english_verse: Everyone of each family in the land will mourn, and the men will mourn separately from the women. This includes those from the family of David, and the families of Nathan,
translation_verse: “Ukyuli biala na kaduli biala kemmo na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ɔdubo kɔnyana buwulo na banana ku bana beleku badubudie lɛlɔ lɛti na betéwulo. Na Dawid kaduli bekyuli babla lɛni, na Natan badi lɛnɔ babla lɛni.

english_verse: and all other families as well.
translation_verse: Na adua akladi bekyuli ƒui lɛnɔ ku bana beleku lɛnɔ badubɔbla lɛni.”

english_verse: In the future there will be a fountain, where David's descendants and the people of Jerusalem can wash away their sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Libiɔ lɛdi lɛdubo bɔkya na uwi ɔni mebo kemmo, na nina kemmo na Dawid bebi ku bawɔ badubɔkana na baƒɔ bana ekpidi ku bɔƒiɔ ƒui bedie lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: When that time comes, I will get rid of every idol in the country, and they will be forgotten forever. I will also do away with their prophets and those evil spirits that control them.
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔnini, “Si uwi ɔmmɔ úbedu ni, ndubo baƒiɔ ƒui udu biala bɔyila na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ, na bekyuli bayiƒala-ma ƒui úti úsela uwi ƒui kemmo. Na ndubo bana kenye bediene ku ayu ekpidi ani na atɔnku-ma mmɔ ƒui udu bɔyila.

english_verse: If any such prophets ever appear again, their own parents must warn them that they will die for telling lies in my name—the name of the Lord. If those prophets don't stop speaking, their parents must then kill them with a sword.
translation_verse: Na si kenye bediene bammɔ udu ɔdi ɔ́sɔ ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ ni, bana bawɔne ɔlɛka babala-ma na basu-ma ka badubo bukpi na ɔkɔ ala ani na baasu na ami Unwoti lɛnyi kemmo ɔsu. Na si bátada bátaya na ɔmɛni lɛnɔ kama ni, ɔlɛka bana bawɔne badu-ma ku kuwii.

english_verse: Those prophets will be ashamed of their so-called visions, and they won't deceive anyone by dressing like a true prophet.
translation_verse: “Na kɔƒa kɔdubukpo kenye bediene bammɔ na bana ɔkɔ kɔyu kemmo ala ani na ama alati banii baanu ɔsu, na basɔ balakya bana adala na batɔlɔ ka badi kenye bediene badi.

english_verse: Instead, they will say, “I'm no prophet. I've been a farmer all my life.”
translation_verse: Mmomu badubɔsu banini, ‘Lɛɛɛdi kenye udiene, mmomu umonsene kani na ndi mina ngba emeyi ƒui kemmo.’

english_verse: And if any of them are asked why they are wounded, they will answer, “It happened at the house of some friends.” A Wounded Shepherd and Scattered Sheep
translation_verse: Na si béye bana akɔ ɔdi banii, ‘Bi alɛbi nsia-a lɛlɔ lɛni’ ni, badubo kenye budie banini, ‘Mina ɔkpana ɔdi kesii na ɔmɛni ɔ́lɛ.’ ” Bébo Baƒonu Ɔdane Na Baƒonu Bégyingya

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: My sword, wake up! Attack my shepherd and friend. Strike down the shepherd! Scatter the little sheep, and I will destroy them.
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔnini, “Ya liti mina kewii na likpoku mina baƒonu ɔdane ku mina ɔkpana. Du baƒonu ɔdane ɔmmɔ na baƒonu bammɔ badubugyingya, na ndubudie banamudi bammɔ atu.

english_verse: Nowhere in the land will more than a third of them be left alive.
translation_verse: Na si béle-ma kemmo akpa atɛ ni, lɛkpa linwi kani na basɔ badubɔnu na kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Then I will purify them and put them to the test, just as gold and silver are purified and tested. They will pray in my name, and I will answer them. I will say, “You are my people,” and they will reply, “You, Lord, are our God!”
translation_verse: Na ndubɔƒɔ bani nébu mmɔ lɛlɔ na lɛbla-ma kedee na lɛkɔku-ma lɛnu aani kalɛ na baaƒɔ sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi taanu nwuna bɔdia. Na badubo-mi bɔkpali buvele ala na linu na libunku-ma. Na ndubɔsu nnii, ‘Mina bekyuli na bɛdi,’ na ama lɛnɔ badubɔsu banii, ‘Awɔ Unwoti ndi bula Katɔti.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord will have his day. And when it comes, everything that was ever taken from Jerusalem will be returned and divided among its people.
translation_verse: Unwoti ubo nwuna limeyi. Na si limeyi lɛmɛni lídu ni, badubuti lɛla biala bátɔlɔku Yerusalem na bele-ni bete lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But first, he will bring many nations to attack Jerusalem—homes will be robbed, women raped, and half of the population dragged off, though the others will be allowed to remain.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔdubo bɔya na baka Yerusalem bubekpoku na beyu bekyuli kɔduli ala na beƒie beleku batɛ-ma kudɔ ku ɔkplu, na betiku ɔma ɔmmɔ bekyuli kakɛ kenwi ƒui batɔlɔku ina ka badubɔya na badi bebu bakya kama.

english_verse: The Lord will attack those nations like a warrior fighting in battle.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubo kadi kammɔ bukpoku aani kalɛ na ukpone uukpó na kekpokɔ.

english_verse: He will take his stand on the Mount of Olives east of Jerusalem, and the mountain will split in half, forming a wide valley that runs from east to west.
translation_verse: Ɔdubusie utáwia kenyekɔ na Nnɔ Egyii Kɔbi lili na Yerusalem ɔƒɛ katukɔ kakɛ. Na kɔbi kɔmmɔ kɔdubɔbwɛ kemmo kule akpa anyɔ usie ɔvi ɔni ku ɔni, na ɔdubɔbla kɔwɛ bonwu ɔsi ɔƒɛ katukɔ úsie ɔƒɛ kanukɔ.

english_verse: Then you people will escape from the Lord's mountain, through this valley, which reaches to Azal. You will run in all directions, just as everyone did when the earthquake struck in the time of King Uzziah of Judah. Afterwards, the Lord my God will appear with his holy angels.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubukeli bɛsia kɔwɛ kɔmmɔ kemmo útédu Asal. Na bɛdubɔwia kasiakɔ kesii biala aani kalɛ na ɔ́bla uwi ɔni na kalɔ kákunku na Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga Usia uwi. Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubɔda ɔlɛ ku nwuna batu.

english_verse: It will be a bright day that won't turn cloudy or cold.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdubɔbla nwaa na liƒlukutu lɛdi lilakya kayaa.

english_verse: And the Lord has decided when it will happen—this time of unending day.
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔlati ɔ́ɔlɛ-ni ugyii úse na ɔƒɛ ulása ulakya-ni uwi ɔdi.

english_verse: In both summer and winter, life-giving streams will flow from Jerusalem, half of them to the Dead Sea in the east and half to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
translation_verse: Na liwulu uwi ku kɔyɔ uwi ƒui ni, ntukpa bɔni mbo ntu buni bɔdubo butaagba taasi Yerusalem, na kakɛ kenwi kadubusie ketéduo Ɛpugyie kemmo na ɔƒɛ katukɔ na kakɛ kenwi ketéduo Mediterenia Ɛpu kemmo na ɔƒɛ kanukɔ.

english_verse: Then there will be only one Lord who rules as King and whose name is worshiped everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, Unwoti unwi pɛ kani ndubo bɔkya aani lɛlɔ ɔdine ɔni mɔɔdi kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na nwuna lɛnyi lɛti na bekyuli ƒui badubɔkya lili kalɔ bete na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ kesii biala.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord will do to those who attack Jerusalem: While they are standing there, he will make their flesh rot and their eyes fall from their sockets and their tongues drop out.
translation_verse: Binu lɛla lɛni na Unwoti ɔdubo bekyuli bani mekpoku Yerusalem bɔbla. Ɔdubɔya na bana ɔlɔna ubu uwi ɔni na bamu benye bana lɛgba lɛlɔ, na bana anumi akpa álɛ ébo ási ana evuo kemmo, na bana linyemi lɛnɔ libun na bana inye kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord will make them go into a frenzy and start attacking each other,
translation_verse: Na Unwoti ɔdubɔya na bataayia lɛlɔ ɔni na badubɔta beteekpoku lɛlɔ lɛlɔ taabla lɛlɔ kalala

english_verse: until even the people of Judah turn against those in Jerusalem. This same terrible disaster will also strike every animal nearby, including horses, mules, camels, and donkeys. Finally, everything of value in the surrounding nations will be collected and brought to Jerusalem—gold, silver, and piles of clothing.
translation_verse: útédu ka Yudaƒuɔ bata na benye Yerusalemƒuɔ kama na bekpoku bekisine bammɔ. Na ɔgbankpi ɔmɛni kani ndububo bebuo bani nlie amadɔ mmɔ ƒui lɛnɔ lɛlɔ bani ndi bapɔnkɔ ku bebuo ala betine beblidi ku benengudi ku baƒlumu lɛnɔ lɛlɔ. Na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, lɛla biala na lɛ́ƒɔ kadi kani náka bámana mmɔ kuye ni, ku bana sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ku adala esu esu ammɔ ƒui ni, badubɔla-nya beboku Yerusalem.

english_verse: Afterwards, the survivors from those nations that attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, bekyuli bani nébu na kadi kani nékpoku Yerusalem mmɔ ni, badubusie Yerusalem mmɔ lɛkwa ndi lɛkwa batákya lili kalɔ Ɔga ɔni ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui na badi Kevo Kemmo Bulie Emeyi na mmɔ.

english_verse: No rain will fall on the land of anyone in any country who refuses to go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Na kadi kani bekyuli ndubuni ka besie Yerusalem mmɔ na batákpali Ɔga Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ni, ɔnantu ɔɔɔdubo bɔna na bana ɔdi kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: This horrible disaster will strike the Egyptians and everyone else who refuses to go there for the celebration.
translation_verse: Na ɔgbankpi bonwu ɔmɛni ɔdubɔlɛku Egyipteƒuɔ na ama lɛnɔ baaadubo ɔnantu bɔkɛ. Lɛni na Unwoti ɔdubo bekyuli bamba biala na baaadubo mmɔ busie butádi Kevo Kemmo Bulie Emeyi lɛnɔ kɔtu bɔni.

english_verse: At that time the words “Dedicated to the Lord” will be engraved on the bells worn by horses. In fact, every ordinary cooking pot in Jerusalem will be just as sacred to the Lord All-Powerful as the bowls used at the altar. Any one of them will be acceptable for boiling the meat of sacrificed animals, and there will no longer be a need to sell special pots and bowls.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, bekyuli badubo etemila adi bunweni bɔsia abontolobi ani nda bapɔnkɔ bammɔ ɔkwɛ banini, “Ɔmɛni na búdie sɛsɛɛ búse búte Unwoti.” Na geen ni, libui lɛnwandi biala na Yerusalem ni, lɛdubɔbla kedee lite Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui aani akpala ebui ani nsia lɛkpabi lɛlɔ kalɛ. Na bakana beti lɛdi biala beƒulo ebuo biala na béti bákpa béte Unwoti. Na ɔɔɔdi banii ntu libui lɛƒunadi bamba na béye béte ukyuli ɔni mɔɔwia ɔbla akpala adi. Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, ama bani naaaƒɔ taadi basɔ baaadubo Unwoti Katɔti kakpakɔ bɔkya.

english_verse: I am Malachi. And this is the message that the Lord gave me for Israel. The Lord's Love for Israel
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔ́su Malakai kenye kadi na kadanku Israel kalɔ. Unwoti Ɔɔyɔ́ Israel

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, have loved you. And yet you ask in what way have I loved you. Don't forget that Esau was the brother of your ancestor Jacob, but I chose Jacob
translation_verse: “Israel, ami Unwoti lɛ́yɔ-ɔ geen, nsu ɔmmɔ ƒui kama buye na eeye anii ulu ɔmani lɛlɔ na líti lɛ́yɔ-ɔ. Tayiƒala ka ƒula ɔti kuuku ndi Yakob na ɔnwani ndi Esau, nsu Yakob na lɛ́ƒuna

english_verse: instead of Esau. And I turned Esau's hill country into a barren desert where jackals roam.
translation_verse: nsu líni Esau. Lɛ́bla nwuna abi lɛlɔ kalɔ na kénwini kalɔ kakwiidi kesii kani na beƒiebuo beelie.

english_verse: Esau's descendants may say, “Although our nation Edom is in ruins, we will rebuild it.” But I, the Lord All-Powerful, promise to tear down whatever they build. Then everyone will know that I will never stop being angry with them as long as they are so sinful.
translation_verse: “Esau bebi ku bawɔ badubɔkana na basu banini, ‘Ina ka bula Edom kalɔ káyii udu ni, bɔdubɔsɔku-ka bɔtu.’ “Nsu ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, líse kenye ka lɛla biala na bátu ni, ndubudi-ni lɛbwɛ liwi kalɔ na bekyuli ƒui banu ka lɛɛɛdubo kɔnyi bɔda buti taakya-ma bɔya na uwi ɔni kemmo na bamu benye bana ekpidi bɔbla lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Israel, when you see this, you will shout, “The Lord's great reputation reaches beyond our borders.” Judgment against Priests
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na ánu ɔmɛni ni, adubo bɔva na asu anini, ‘Unwoti ɔ́ƒɔ lɛnyi ɔ́kɔ úbo ɔ́vi Israel lɛmii ƒui.’ Unwoti Ɔ́du Bakpane Kɔtɔ

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something to say to you priests. Children respect their fathers, and servants respect their masters. I am your father and your master, so why don't you respect me? You priests have insulted me, and now you ask, “How did we insult you?”
translation_verse: “Ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, mbo lɛla lɛdi na lɛsu amii bakpane. Bebi baabu bana bawɔne, na kabla bablane baabu bana batɔlati. Na ami ndi Ati ku bina ɔti. Na bi ɔsu na bilábu-mi? Amii bakpane bídumi-mi. “Nsu biiye ɔƒɛni bɛnini, ‘Dɛ na búdumi-ɔ?’

english_verse: You embarrass me by offering worthless food on my altar. Then you ask, “How have we embarrassed you?” You have done it by saying, “What's so great about the Lord's altar?”
translation_verse: “Biidumi-mi na ɔni na biiti adila ani nátamanku taabasia mina lɛkpabi lɛlɔ ɔsu. “Nsu biiye bɛnini, ‘Bi na bɔ́bla na útamanku ƒula lɛkpabi?’ “Bɛɛbla ɔmɛni na ɔni na bilanu lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ taakya lɛla lɛdi kemmo.

english_verse: But isn't it wrong to offer animals that are blind, lame, or sick? Just try giving those animals to your governor. That certainly wouldn't please him or make him want to help you.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, bɔnu bilánu ka útamanku ka biti ebuo ɔni na lɛnumi lɛ́bwɛ-nwu iye ɔ́sɔ na nwuna lɛlɔ ekpo étedu bɛkpa bite-mi? Amii biti ebuo ɔmmɔ udu bisienku bina aban ɔgadine unengu na bɛnu si kaƒɔ kadubɔyɔ-nwu na ubunku-mii lɛla lɛdi!

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful, and you had better try to please me. You have sinned. Now see if I will have mercy on any of you.
translation_verse: “Ngba bukpidi bɔmɛni na bilie, nsu bɛɛkpali teevele kusɛ kusɛ. Amii alati bɛnu si ndubɔnu-mii kɔnyana na ɔbladu ɔmɛni ɔsu. Lɛni na Unwoti ɔ́su.”

english_verse: I wish someone would lock the doors of my temple, so you would stop wasting time building fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you priests, and I refuse to accept any more of your offerings.
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔnii, “Mɔɔyɔ́ geen si nka ukyuli ɔdi ɔkalɛ mina kakpakɔ kammɔ na bɛda uwi bubile bɛya bɛnii ogya na bɛɛsala na mina lɛkpabi lɛlɔ bite akpala adi bɔbla. Amii bakpane bammɔ lɛlɔ liláda-mi kubiti, anwuɔsu na líni nnii nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo bina akpala adi bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: From dawn until dusk my name is praised by every nation on this earth, as they burn incense and offer the proper sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si ɔƒɛ katukɔ útédu ɔƒɛ kanukɔ ni, bekyuli badubumwi-mi lɛnyi na bakyula oloƒui na kadi biala bekyuli akɔ na kalɔ lɛlɔ, na badubɔbla akpala ani námanku bete-mi.

english_verse: But even you priests insult me by saying, “There's nothing special about the Lord's altar, and these sacrifices are worthless.”
translation_verse: “Nsu amii bakpane muedi muudumi-mi taasu bɛnini, ‘Bulánu lɛla lɛni náƒɔ kuye na Unwoti lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ, na akpala ammɔ lɛnɔ eesé-bu lɛlɔ!’

english_verse: You get so disgusted that you even make vulgar signs at me. And for an offering, you bring stolen animals or those that are lame or sick. Should I accept these?
translation_verse: Bina ala bɔbla bɔɔtina ka bɛ́ɛnɔnku ala ammɔ bɔbla na biidie enu taakywɛ-nya ku lɛlɔ bɔtina. “Na si bíti bebuo bani na básɔ bíboku bɛnii bibakpa bite-mi ni, bɔƒɔ na ɔlɛka lɛƒɔ-ma?

english_verse: Instead of offering the acceptable animals you have promised, you bring me those that are unhealthy. I will punish you for this, because I am the great King, the Lord All-Powerful, and I am worshiped by nations everywhere.
translation_verse: Biisé-mi kenye ka bɛdububoku-mi bebuo bani námanku, nsu bɛɛvumana teeti bebuo bekpidi mmomu teeboku-mi si uwi údu. Na ndubo ɔgbankpi buti buboku-mii lɛlɔ na ɔmɛni ɔsu, ɔsika ami ndi Ɔga Unengudi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔni na kadi bekyuli ƒui baayia na kesi kesii.”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something else to say to you priests.
translation_verse: “Ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, mbo lɛla bamba na lɛsu amii bakpane.

english_verse: You had better take seriously the need to honor my name. Otherwise, when you give a blessing, I will turn it into a curse. In fact, I have already done this, because you haven't taken to heart your duties as priests.
translation_verse: Si bɛ́vumana na bɛɛsia anu teete-mi ɔbu ɔni námanku-mi ni, ɔdia-mii utulo. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, ina kusɛ kusɛ ɔdi bina ɔdi ni, ndubɔya na unwini ewida. Na geen ni, líise kalɔ ndaku ɔmɛni bɔbla, ɔsika bíteti bina bakpane kabla bítakya kayi kalɛ na bɛbla bina kabla ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will punish your descendants and rub your faces in the manure from your animal sacrifices, and then be done with you.
translation_verse: “Ndubo bina bebi ku bawɔ kɔtu bɔni. Na ala ani na bɛ́kpɛ bídie bebuo bani na bíbakpa bíte-mi livo kemmo ni, ndubuti-ni lisusu-mii anumi na lidie-mii atu na bɛyii udu.

english_verse: I am telling you this, so I can continue to keep my agreement with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mi ɔmɛni kalɛ na lɛkana kenye kani na líse bina ati kuuku Lewi lɛlɔ butaadi.

english_verse: I blessed him with a full life, as I had promised, and he kept his part of the agreement by honoring me and respecting my name.
translation_verse: Líte-nwu kusɛ kusɛ ka ulie ngba gyɔlɔɔ aani kalɛ na líse-nwu kenye líse. Na ɔ́bla nwuna kakɛ, na ɔ́di bunyimi bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔni na ɔ́bu-mi na úmwi-mi lɛnyi.

english_verse: He taught the truth and never told lies, and he led a lot of people to turn from sin, because he obeyed me and lived right.
translation_verse: Ɔ́tina litemi geen lɛmmɔ na útanyi ɔkɔ útatɔlɔ bekyuli. Ɔ́tɔnku bekyuli pii na bénwini kama bákya bana ekpidi, ɔsika únu-mi litemi na úlie ngba bɔbuni.

english_verse: You priests should be eager to spread knowledge, and everyone should come to you for instruction, because you speak for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: “Amii bakpane, ɔlɛka bina inye bugyingya lɛlati, na ukyuli biala ubo-mii kudɔ ubenu bɔlɛ, ɔsika amii mɔɔtɛmi teete ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui.

english_verse: But you have turned your backs on me. Your teachings have led others to do sinful things, and you have broken the agreement I made with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Nsu bínwini kama bɛ́kya-mi. Na bina ala ani bɛɛtina mmomu mɔɔkpanku bekyuli na beesié taatábla ala ekpidi. Na bíbile bunyimi bɔni na línyimiku bina ati kuuku Lewi.

english_verse: So I caused everyone to hate and despise you, because you disobeyed me and failed to treat all people alike. A Broken Agreement
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na lɛ́ya na ukyuli biala uukisi-mii na béni-mii. Ɔsika bítenu-mi litemi na bɛɛnu bekyuli anumi taatɛ etemila.” Bekyuli Bébile Unwoti Bunyimi

english_verse: Don't you know that we all have God as our Father? Didn't the one God create each of us? Then why do you cheat each other by breaking the agreement God made with your ancestors?
translation_verse: Bɛɛɛgyi bɛnii bula ƒui ɔti ndi Katɔti? Na ɔɔɔdi Katɔti unwi ɔmmɔ kani nédie bula ƒui? Na bi ɔsu na bɛɛnya lɛlɔ taakya na bilábu bunyimi bɔni na Katɔti únyimi ku bina bati kuuku?

english_verse: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord. You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.
translation_verse: Amii bani nkya Yuda ku Yerusalem kalɔ lɛlɔ bilásiaku Unwoti kama siin. Na bíbile kakpakɔ kani na Unwoti ɔɔyɔ́ mmɔ ekisila na bɛɛbla ala ani muusé-nwu lɛlɔ na amii ku baƒiɔkpane biiti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will no longer let those who are guilty belong to his people, even if they eagerly decide to offer the Lord a gift.
translation_verse: Muuvele nnii Unwoti ɔsɔ utaya na bekyuli bani na báƒiɔ ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ basɔ babla nwuna bekyuli akɔ badi lɛnɔ si ina baawia kpakplaa ka beti etela adi beboku-nwu.

english_verse: And what else are you doing? You cry noisily and flood the Lord's altar with your tears, because he isn't pleased with your offerings and refuses to accept them.
translation_verse: Na lɛla bamba lɛni na bɛsɔ bɛɛbla ndi keku kani na biiwulo teewi nwuna lɛkpabi ka Unwoti úni ɔnii uláƒɔ bina akpala ka átaƒɔ-nwu anu ɔsu.

english_verse: And why isn't God pleased? It's because he knows that each of you men has been unfaithful to the wife you married when you were young. You promised that she would be your partner, but now you have broken that promise.
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na akpala ammɔ átayɔ-nwu kaƒɔ? Ɔsika ɔgyi ka bina akɔ ɔdi biala ɔɔɔsiaku lɛkloƒu uwi uleku ɔni na úti kama siin, mmomu bɛ́lɛ-ma kama ina ka bíse kenye ka ama kani ndubɔbla bina beleku na bilálɛ-ma kama, nsu bíbile linyese lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: Didn't God create you and your wife to become like one person? And why did he do this? It was so you would have children, and then lead them to become God's people. Don't ever be unfaithful to your wife.
translation_verse: Budie na Katɔti údie awɔ ku ƒ'ulekudi ka bɛbla aani ukyuli unwi. Na bi ɔsu na ɔ́bla lɛni? Ɔdi ka bɛwɔ bebi na bɛtɔnku-ma na benwini Katɔti bekyuli. Anwuɔsu bɛda bina ngba kaduɛ, na bitalɛ bina lɛkloƒu uwi uleku kama kudii.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful of Israel hates anyone who is cruel enough to divorce his wife. So take care never to be unfaithful!
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ukisi ukyuli ɔni nábla ulikplu ɔni udu na ɔ́kana na ɔ́nyonu ulekudi. Anwuɔsu bɛda bina ngba kaduɛ, na bitalɛ lɛlɔ kama.

english_verse: You have worn out the Lord with your words. And yet, you ask, “How did we do that?” You did it by saying, “The Lord is pleased with evil and doesn't care about justice.”
translation_verse: Bɛ́ɛya na Unwoti ɔ́nɔ-mii lɛlɔ ku bina etemila. Nsu bɛmu biiye bɛnini, “Ulu ɔmani lɛlɔ na bɔ́sia bɔ́bla ala ammɔ?” Ulu ɔmmɔ ndi ɔni na bɛɛsu bɛnini, “Likpidi bablane baada Unwoti kubiti, na ɔɔɔdaku-ni ka ɔtɛ litemi lɛmɛni ani.”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will appear in his temple. The messenger you desire is coming with my promise, and he is on his way. A Day of Change
translation_verse: “Ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, ndubɔtala ɔtu ɔdi na ɔklibi ulu use ute-mi. Na kɔnakunwi Unwoti ɔni ulu na binye bɛɛnu ni, ɔdubɔda ɔlɛ na nwuna kakpakɔ kemmo. Ɔtu ɔni na bɛɛwia mmɔ ɔ́si ɔdubo ku mina linyese. Na ɔkɛ ulu ɔdubo ɔƒaani.” Ala Ƒui Adubɔbla Awɔdi

english_verse: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛni na Unwoti webo ni, ɔdubuse aani ogya lɛyu lɛni kemmo na baaƒɔ sika, iye ɔkwayɛ ɔni mbo ɔbi. Na ukyuli biala ɔɔɔdubo bɔkana na unye-nwu anumi iye unye ɔsiaku-nwu.

english_verse: The Lord will purify the descendants of Levi, as though they were gold or silver. Then they will bring the proper offerings to the Lord,
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubo Lewi bebi ku bawɔ lɛlɔ bɔƒɔ na babla sɛɛn aani sika ɔƒualadi iye ugyiedi. Na ɔmmɔ kama na beti akpala ani nse sɛɛn beboku Unwoti.

english_verse: and the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem will please him, just as they did in the past. Don't Cheat God
translation_verse: Na Yudaƒuɔ ku bani nkya Yerusalem ƒui akpala adubɔƒɔ-nwu anu aani kalɛ kani na úse uwi ɔni nábavi. Biteyu Katɔti Na Lɛkwɛ Kemmo

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: I'm now on my way to judge you. And I will quickly condemn all who practice witchcraft or cheat in marriage or tell lies in court or rob workers of their pay or mistreat widows and orphans or steal the property of foreigners or refuse to respect me.
translation_verse: Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔnini, “Lɛ́ɛsi ndubo mbatɛku-mii litemi na lɛdu kɔtɔ kɔnakunwi. Ama ndi bani mɔɔdú kabɔ, na baalɛ́ bana bagya ku bele kama, iye baanyi ɔkɔ na litemi katɛkɔ, iye beeyú bana kabla bablane na baláƒɔ-ma kayu ulu lɛlɔ, na baabla bekpinebi ku bekpinele kalala, iye beeyú baƒɔ bani nkya-ma kudɔ ala, na béni banii balabu-mi ƒui.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out,
translation_verse: Yakob bebi ku bawɔ, ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔni naaavumana uwi ɔdi. Anwuɔsu na ńtayila-mii udu ńtedie ƒui

english_verse: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, “How can we return?”
translation_verse: ina ka bíni na bilenu-mi litemi ɔ́si bina bati kuuku uwi ƒui. Nsu si bínwini bíbo-mi kudɔ ni, ami lɛnɔ ndubunwini libo-mii kudɔ. Nsu buye na biiye bɛnini, ‘Dɛ na bɔdubɔkana na bunwini bubo-ɔ kudɔ?’

english_verse: You people are robbing me, your God. And, here you are, asking, “How are we robbing you?” You are robbing me of the offerings and of the ten percent that belongs to me.
translation_verse: Amii bekyuli bamɛni ni, biiyú ami, bina Katɔti. “Nsu mɛni lɛnɔ buye na biiye bɛnini, ‘Dɛ na buuyú-ɔ?’ “Na bɛgyi nwaa ka akpala ani na beeti teeboku-mi ku ala lɛkpa leevudi lɛni ndi ami ɔdi ni, biiyú-nya.

english_verse: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ ɔsu na ewida asiaku kalɔ kammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I challenge you to put me to the test. Bring the entire ten percent into the storehouse, so there will be food in my house. Then I will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessing after blessing.
translation_verse: Ami ndi Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, na nnye-mii anumi mɔɔsu-mii nnii bɛkɔku-mi bɛnu na biti ala lɛkpa leevudi lɛmmɔ ƒui bibese-mi kaduli ala kesekɔ, na adila emomo-mi kɔduli. Na ndubɔlɛmi kayaa na mina kusɛ kusɛ ubo-mii lɛlɔ ɔsia kama aani kalɛ na ɔnantu ɔɔna.

english_verse: I will also stop locusts from destroying your crops and keeping your vineyards from producing.
translation_verse: Ndubutile baalɔlɔ kuƒi na basɔ belebile-mii ala na ada bɔnwu aya.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Na kɔlɔ ƒui bekyuli ɔdi biala ɔdubɔsu kalɛ na líte-mii kusɛ kusɛ ku kalɛ na bina kalɔ kadia.

english_verse: You have said horrible things about me, and yet you ask, “What have we said?”
translation_verse: “Bɛ́tɛmi enyekpi bonwu bonwu bɛ́siku-mi lɛlɔ, nsu ɔƒaani buye na biiye bɛnini, ‘Bi na bɔ́su o-o?’

english_verse: Here is what you have said: “It's foolish to serve the Lord God All-Powerful. What do we get for obeying God and from going around looking sad?
translation_verse: “Binu lɛla lɛni na bɛ́su bɛnini, ‘Kɔdɔlɔ na kɔdi-bu ka bunye butaakpali Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui. Bi kɔsia geen na bɔɔkɛ́ si bunye bɔɔbu-nwu na bɔkɛ ku kɔnyana bɔɔví uwi biala?

english_verse: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.” Faithfulness Is Rewarded
translation_verse: Bɛnu kalɛ na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ bekyuli bani náta bénye-nwu lɛlɔ. Na ala aatɛku ukyuli biala na unye ɔɔbla likpidi na ina békpoku Katɔti bánu muedi na lɛla lɛdi lilábla-ma.’ ” Unwoti Kama Bɔsiaku Siin Ɔdanku Lɛyuƒɔla

english_verse: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔsiaku Unwoti ulu siin lɛlɔ bése kalɔ baatɛmi taasiku litemi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ. Na ka Unwoti ɔ́nu lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ ni, ɔ́ya na bénweni-ma anyi bákya nwuna ɔku kemmo.

english_verse: Then the Lord All-Powerful said: You people are precious to me, and when I come to bring justice, I will protect you, just as parents protect an obedient child.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔ́su ɔnini, “Amii bekyuli bamɛni bɛ́ƒɔ-mi kuye geen, na si uwi ɔni na líbo mbatɛ litemi ni, ndubo-mii bɔgyumana kalɛ kani na bawɔne baagyumana bana ubi ɔni muunú-ma litemi.

english_verse: Then everyone will once again see the difference between those who obey me by doing right and those who reject me by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli badubɔnu kavumana kani nkya bekyuli bani muunú-mi litemi na baabla ala ulu siin lɛlɔ ku bani néni-mi na baabla ekpidi ntɛ.”

english_verse: The day of judgment is certain to come. And it will be like a red-hot furnace with flames that burn up proud and sinful people, as though they were straw. Not a branch or a root will be left. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Litemi Bɔtɛ Limeyi lɛdubo ɔni na lɛla lɛdi liletile kuƒi kɔmmɔ. Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdubuse aani lɛyu lɛni náƒɔ ogya ku ogya livongu bonwu lɛni muudie ogya linyemi lɛni ndubo alaekpidi bablane ƒui bɔkyula kede kede aani livo. Na kegyigba iye ugyitu ɔdi ulébu. Ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, násu!

english_verse: But for you that honor my name, victory will shine like the sun with healing in its rays, and you will jump around like calves at play.
translation_verse: Nsu amii bani mɔɔbu-mi ni, bina lɛlɔ bɔdi bɔdubɔbla aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛ uukeye na bukeye bɔmmɔ buute ɔlɔkplu. Na amii bɛdubo butaaƒulu taavi taaƒia aani ɔmantɛ bakɔ bebi.

english_verse: When I come to bring justice, you will trample those who are evil, as though they were ashes under your feet. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ndububo mbatɛ litemi mmɔ ni, bɛdubɔnya bɛvi bekyuli bekpidi lɛlɔ bisusu aani si ntɔ na badi na bina lɛgba kalɔ. Ami, Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui, násu!

english_verse: Don't ever forget the laws and teachings I gave my servant Moses on Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: “Bitayiƒala mina ɔda bubo ku ala bɔtina bɔni na líte mina kabla ɔblane Mose na Sinai kɔbi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to send the prophet Elijah before that great and terrible day comes.
translation_verse: “Ami, Unwoti, líse kenye ka ndubɔya na Kenye Udiene Elia ɔsɔ ubo asa na ɔgbankpi limeyi lɛmmɔ libedu.

english_verse: He will lead children and parents to love each other more, so that when I come, I won't bring destruction to the land.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔtɔnku bebi ku bawɔne na bataayɔ lɛlɔ teetulo ɔƒɛni, kalɛ na si líbo ni, na neeebo naaabayila kalɔ kammɔ ƒui udu.”

english_verse: “A virgin will have a baby boy, and he will be called Immanuel,” which means “God is with us.”
translation_verse: “Adagyaa ɔdi ɔdubɔda kaƒɔ na ɔwɔ ubi ɔnanabi. Na bekyuli badubɔlɔ-nwu banii Imanuel.” Na nwuna kalɔ budie ndi Katɔti ulieku-bu.

english_verse: This is how Jesus Christ was born. A young woman named Mary was engaged to Joseph from King David's family. But before they were married, she learned that she was going to have a baby by God's Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ndi kalɛ na ɔ́bla asa na badubɔwɔ Yesu Kristo. Bévele Maria béte Yoseƒ, nsu asa na badubuti lɛlɔ ni, Maria ɔ́nu ɔ́ti ka ɔda kaƒɔ. Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun náya na úbo úte lɛni.

english_verse: Joseph was a good man and did not want to embarrass Mary in front of everyone. So he decided to quietly call off the wedding.
translation_verse: Yoseƒ ɔdi ukyuli ɔni nse siin na Katɔti anumi. Nsu ka útayɔ ka uwi Maria anumi kalɔ na kadi akɔ ɔsu ni, ɔ́bla kasusu ɔnii ɔɔnyonu-nwu kpoo.

english_verse: While Joseph was thinking about this, an angel from the Lord appeared to him in a dream. The angel said, “Joseph, the baby that Mary will have is from the Holy Spirit. Go ahead and marry her.
translation_verse: Ka ɔ́bla kasusu kamɛni na útátɛ ni, Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina-nwu na kɔna kemmo, na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Yoseƒ, Dawid kaba kemmo ubi, tayia ka eti Maria aani ƒ'ulekudi kalɛ. Ɔsika kaƒɔ kani na ɔda mɛni ni, Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun kemmo na ɔ́si.

english_verse: Then after her baby is born, name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔwɔ ɔnanabi. Na awɔ Yoseƒ asia-nwu lɛnyi anii Yesu, ɔsika anwu ndubudie nwuna bekyuli ɔlɛku bana ekpidi kemmo.”

english_verse: After Joseph woke up, he and Mary were soon married, just as the Lord's angel had told him to do.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu uwi ɔni na Yoseƒ ɔ́gyinya ni, úti Maria ɔ́bla ulekudi aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-nwu.

english_verse: But they did not sleep together before her baby was born. Then Joseph named him Jesus.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Yoseƒ ku Maria baaagyi lɛlɔ aani ɔnana ku uleku kalɛ útédu uwi ɔni na ɔ́wɔ ubidi ɔnanabi ɔmmɔ. Na Yoseƒ ɔ́sia-nwu lɛnyi ɔnii Yesu.

english_verse: When Jesus was born in the village of Bethlehem in Judea, Herod was king. During this time some wise men from the east came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Herode ɔɔdi lɛga ni, báwɔ Yesu na ɔma ɔni baalɔ Betlehem na Yudea kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na uwi ɔmmɔ kani kemmo ni, benengu bani mɔɔtɛya ala ani mɔɔlɛ́ na ayabi lɛlɔ taati badi bási ɔƒɛ katukɔ bébo Yerusalem.

english_verse: and said, “Where is the child born to be king of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him.”
translation_verse: Na béye banini, “Wɛ na báwɔ ubi ɔni ndubɔdi lɛga na Yudaƒuɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ? Bɔ́nu nwuna lɛyabi na ɔƒɛ katukɔ. Na búbo bɔnii bubemwi-nwu.”

english_verse: When King Herod heard about this, he was worried, and so was everyone else in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Ɔga Herode únu litemi lɛmɛni ni, ɔƒɛ ɔ́da anwu ku bekyuli bani nkya Yerusalem mmɔ ƒui geen.

english_verse: Herod brought together the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses and asked them, “Where will the Messiah be born?”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔ́lɔ Katɔti bakpane benengu bammɔ ƒui ku ɔda bubo ala batinane ɔ́sala na úye-ma ɔnini, “Wɛ na badubɔwɔ Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ?”

english_verse: They told him, “He will be born in Bethlehem, just as the prophet wrote,
translation_verse: Amu na básu-nwu banini, “Betlehem na badubɔwɔ-nwu na Yudea kalɔ lɛlɔ, ɔsika lɛni na Katɔti kenye udiene ɔdi únweni ɔnii,

english_verse: ‘Bethlehem in the land of Judea, you are very important among the towns of Judea. From your town will come a leader, who will be like a shepherd for my people Israel.’ ”
translation_verse: “ ‘Awɔ Betlehem, bekyuli baasu ka adi ɔma ubliidi na Yuda kalɔ lɛlɔ. Nsu uuuse lɛni! Ɔsika ƒula kemmo na ɔtɔnkune ubendi ɔdi ɔdubɔlɛ ɔsi na watɔnku mina kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Herod secretly called in the wise men and asked them when they had first seen the star.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Herode ɔ́lɔ baƒɔ bani nási ɔƒɛ katukɔ mmɔ úsienku kɔƒɛlɛ, na úye-ma únu uwi ɔni geen bánu ka lɛyabi lɛmmɔ lɛ́lɛ.

english_verse: He told them, “Go to Bethlehem and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, let me know. I also want to go and worship him.”
translation_verse: Amu na údie-ma ulu ɔnii beteesie Betlehem. Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bisie na bitáwia ɔnamu ɔmmɔ kaduɛ. Na si bɛnu-nwu ni, bɛsɔ binwini bibasu-mi na ami lɛnɔ ntémwi-nwu.”

english_verse: When the men went into the house and saw the child with Mary, his mother, they knelt down and worshiped him. They took out their gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh and gave them to him.
translation_verse: Na ka béduo ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo na bánu ubi ɔmmɔ ku uni Maria ni, bálɛ akɔnkɔ na bémwi-nwu. Na báƒɛnimi bana kɔvumi na béte-nwu ala abuni adi ani ndi sika ugyiedi ku oloƒui ku klobo.

english_verse: Later they were warned in a dream not to return to Herod, and they went back home by another road. The Escape to Egypt
translation_verse: Nwuna kama ni, Katɔti ɔ́lɛ-ma na kɔna kemmo ɔnii basɔ batasia Herode kudɔ. Anwuɔsu básia ulu ɔbambadi lɛlɔ bésie bana kalɔ lɛlɔ. Yoseƒ Úkeliku Maria Ku Yesu Úsienku Egyipte Kalɔ Lɛlɔ

english_verse: After the wise men had gone, an angel from the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Get up! Hurry and take the child and his mother to Egypt! Stay there until I tell you to return, because Herod is looking for the child and wants to kill him.”
translation_verse: Ka baƒɔ bammɔ bátɔlɔ kama ni, Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina Yoseƒ na kɔna kemmo. Na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Herode ɔdubɔya na bawia ubi ɔmmɔ kama ulu na badu-nwu. Anwuɔsu ta, na eti ubi ɔmmɔ ku uni na bikeli bisie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na bitélie mmɔ utédu uwi ɔni na masu-ɔ nnii, ‘Sɔ nwini bo.’ ”

english_verse: That night, Joseph got up and took his wife and the child to Egypt,
translation_verse: Usien ɔmmɔ kani na Yoseƒ útiku ubi ɔmmɔ ku uni na békeli bésie Egyipte.

english_verse: where they stayed until Herod died. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “I called my son out of Egypt.” The Killing of the Children
translation_verse: Na bélie mmɔ útédu uwi ɔni na Herode úkpi. Kalɛ na bákya mmɔ ɔ́ya na ala ani na Katɔti ɔ́su úse ɔkɛ nwuna kenye bediene lɛlɔ ébo éte lɛni ɔnii, “Lɛ́lɔ mina ubi lɛ́siku Egyipte.” Herode Ɔ́ya Na Bádu Bebi Bananabi Ƒui Na Betlehem

english_verse: When Herod found out that the wise men from the east had tricked him, he was very angry. He gave orders for his men to kill all the boys who lived in or near Bethlehem and were two years old and younger. This was based on what he had learned from the wise men.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Herode úti-nwu ka baƒɔ bani nási ɔƒɛ katukɔ mmɔ bátɔlɔ-nwu ni, úti kɔnyi geen. Anwuɔsu ɔ́ya na nwuna bekpone bésie Betlehem ku amadɔ mmɔ ƒui. Na bátádu bebi bananabi bani náaƒɔ akwa anyɔ ku bani nétedu tɔ lɛni aani kalɛ na baƒɔ bammɔ béti bátina ka lɛyabi lɛmmɔ lɛ́lɛ kenye.

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet Jeremiah had said,
translation_verse: Banamu bamɛni bɔdu bɔ́ya na lɛla lɛni na Katɔti Kenye Udiene Yeremia ɔ́su úse líbo líte lɛni sɔsɔ ɔnii,

english_verse: “In Ramah a voice was heard crying and weeping loudly. Rachel was mourning for her children, and she refused to be comforted, because they were dead.” The Return from Egypt
translation_verse: “Bekyuli bénu kɔku kɔdi na Rama ka beewulo momoomo. Rahel bawɔ beewulo bana bebi. Na belenu kɔnu bɔsia, ɔsika bebi bammɔ békpi.” Yoseƒ Ku Maria Ku Yesu Bénwini Bási Egyipte

english_verse: After King Herod died, an angel from the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph while he was still in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ka Herode úkpi ni, Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina Yoseƒ na kɔna kemmo na Egyipte.

english_verse: The angel said, “Get up and take the child and his mother back to Israel. The people who wanted to kill him are now dead.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ta, na eti ubi ɔmmɔ ku uni na asɔ enwini esie Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ. Bekyuli bani náwia ka badu ubi ɔmmɔ béekpi.”

english_verse: Joseph got up and left with them for Israel.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yoseƒ ɔ́ta na úti ubi ɔmmɔ ku uni na bátɔlɔ bésie Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But when he heard that Herod's son Archelaus was now ruler of Judea, he was afraid to go there. Then in a dream he was told to go to Galilee,
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔni na Yoseƒ únu ɔnii Arkelao ɔni ndi Herode ubidi nébo úbelie ɔti kenye aani Yudea ɔga ni, ɔ́yia mmɔ busie. Na ka Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi úbo-nwu ɔda na kɔna kemmo ɔnii utesie mmɔ ni, údeyi úsie Galilea kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and they went to live there in the town of Nazareth. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “He will be called a Nazarene.”
translation_verse: Na ka úduo mmɔ ni, útélie ɔma ɔni baalɔ banii Nasaret. Na bana mmɔ bulie ɔ́ya na Katɔti kenye udiene litemi lɛni na ɔ́su úse ɔnii, “Bekyuli badubɔlɔ-nwu banii Nasareni,” úbo úte lɛni sɔsɔ.

english_verse: Do something to show you have really given up your sins.
translation_verse: Bɛtina na bina ɔbladu kemmo ka bínwini kama bɛ́kya bina alaekpidi.

english_verse: He said, “Turn back to God! The kingdom of heaven will soon be here.”
translation_verse: ɔnini, “Binwini kama bɛkya bina ekpidi, ɔsika uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔdi lɛga na bula kɔyi kemmo úude.”

english_verse: John wore clothes made of camel's hair. He had a leather strap around his waist and ate grasshoppers and wild honey.
translation_verse: Na awu ɔni na Yohane ɔkya ni, ɔƒlumu linwini na béti bédi-nwu. Na ebuo ɔku kabuli kada-nwu kavobi. Na nwuna adila ani na ɔɔdi ndi uwɔ ku baalɔlɔ bani muubile edula.

english_verse: From Jerusalem and all Judea and from the Jordan River Valley crowds of people went to John.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bási Yerusalem ku Yudea kalɛkɛ ku Yordan Ketu amadɔ ƒui bébo-nwu kudɔ.

english_verse: They told how sorry they were for their sins, and he baptized them in the river.
translation_verse: Bédie bana ala ekpidi kalɔ na Yohane ɔ́kpila-ma ntu na Yordan Ketu kemmo.

english_verse: Many Pharisees and Sadducees also came to be baptized. But John said to them: You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yohane ɔ́nu Ƒarisiƒuɔ ku Sadukiƒuɔ pii ka badubo na ɔkpila-ma ntu ni, ɔ́su-ma ɔnii, “Amii bani mbo likyulikpi aani balakpi! Bitatɔlɔ lɛlɔ bɛnii si bákpila-mii ntu kani ni, ɔ́sa na bɛ́lɛ Katɔti kɔtu kɔni na ɔdubɔni bekyuli bekpidi kemmo.

english_verse: An ax is ready to cut the trees down at their roots. Any tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into a fire.
translation_verse: Bɛɛnu ka bada kadadi benye kugyii lɛlɔ na bada-ku ku ligyiitu. Kugyii biala naaanwu ebi buni ni, badubɔmɛnɛ-ku bakya lɛgyavonku kemmo.

english_verse: His threshing fork is in his hand, and he is ready to separate the wheat from the husks. He will store the wheat in a barn and burn the husks in a fire that never goes out. The Baptism of Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: Ɔda nwuna kɔɔlɛ kɔni na ɔdubɔƒɛ nwuna edula udie na uti uwi unwu kemmo. Nsu ɔdubɔkyula aƒaƒa ku lɛmuyɔ lɛkladi na ogya ɔni naaadubo buni kudii kemmo!” Yohane Ɔ́kpila Yesu Ntu

english_verse: Jesus left Galilee and went to the Jordan River to be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Yesu ɔ́si Galilea úbo Yohane kudɔ na Yordan Ketu kɔtu ɔnii Yohane ɔkpila-nwu ntu.

english_verse: But John kept objecting and said, “I ought to be baptized by you. Why have you come to me?”
translation_verse: Nsu ka Yohane ɔ́yɔ ka Yesu ɔvumana nwuna kasusu kammɔ ɔsu ni, ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Ami mmomu na ɔlɛka libo-ɔ kudɔ, na ɔɔɔdi awɔ na ɔlɛka ebo-mi kudɔ anii nkpila-a ntu!”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “For now this is how it should be, because we must do all God wants us to do.” Then John agreed.
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Awɔ nu kalɔ na bɔbla-nwu lɛni ɔƒɛni asa. Ɔsika ɔmɛni ndubɔya na bɔbla Katɔti lɛƒɔyɔ.” Anwuɔsu Yohane únu kalɔ.

english_verse: So Jesus was baptized. And as soon as he came out of the water, the sky opened, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down on him like a dove.
translation_verse: Amu ka Yohane ɔ́kpila Yesu ntu na ɔ́nya ɔ́lɛ ntu bɔmmɔ kemmo kani na katɔ kálɛmi na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́si kɔɔyu aani abloduma kalɛ, na kúbelie-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then a voice from heaven said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Na bénu Katɔti lɛdi ka lɛ́si katɔ lɛnini, “Ɔmɛni ndi mina Ubi Ɔyɔne ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mi anu geen.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu únu ka béƒie Yohane bákya ɔtɔ ni, ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie Galilea.

english_verse: But instead of staying in Nazareth, Jesus moved to Capernaum. This town was beside Lake Galilee in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Útelie Nasaret, mmomu úsie útélie Kapernaum, ɔma ɔni na uwi Galilea Ɛpu kudɔ na Sebulon ku Naƒtali kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then the devil came to him and said, “If you are God's Son, tell these stones to turn into bread.”
