translation_verse: Amu na ukisine ɔmmɔ úbo-nwu kudɔ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Si Katɔti ubidi na adi ni, su atabi amɛni na enwini adila.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The Scriptures also say, ‘Don't try to test the Lord your God!’ ”
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Nsu Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔmmɔ ɔɔsu ɔnii, ‘Takɔku ƒula Unwoti Katɔti tanu.’ ”

english_verse: Finally, the devil took Jesus up on a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms on earth and their power.
translation_verse: Amu na ukisine ɔmmɔ úti Yesu úsienku kɔbi kangyaa kɔdi lili. Mmɔ na ɔ́tina-nwu kayawi agala ku ana bukeye ƒui.

english_verse: The devil said to him, “I will give all this to you, if you will bow down and worship me.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Si álɛ akɔnkɔ na émwi-mi ni, ndubuti ala amɛni ƒui lite-ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Go away Satan! The Scriptures say: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve only him.’ ”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Satan, gyu-mi lɛlɔ! Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔnii, ‘Ƒula Unwoti Katɔti kani na ɔlɛka alɛ akɔnkɔ emwi.’ ”

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said,
translation_verse: Úlie mmɔ kalɛ na Katɔti Kenye Udiene Yesaia kenye kani na ɔ́su úse kebo kete lɛni ɔnini,

english_verse: Right then the two brothers dropped their nets and went with him.
translation_verse: Mmɔ kani na báda bana lɛsawu béwi na básiaku-nwu kama.

english_verse: While Jesus was walking along the shore of Lake Galilee, he saw two brothers. One was Simon, also known as Peter, and the other was Andrew. They were fishermen, and they were casting their net into the lake.
translation_verse: Na ka Yesu ɔkɛ Galilea Ɛpu kɔtu ni, ɔ́nu banwani inyɔ badi bani ndi asawu bewine. Ama ndi Simon ɔni baalɔ Petro ku ɔnwani Andrea ka bada asawu beedie lɛna na Ɛpu ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Jesus walked on until he saw James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in a boat with their father, mending their nets. Jesus asked them to come with him.
translation_verse: Amu ka úsie blii ni, ɔ́sɔ ɔ́nu banwani inyɔ badi bani baalɔ Yakobo ku Yohane bani ndi Sebedeo bebi. Ama ku bana ɔti Sebedeo ɔmɛni bakya ɔkɔlɔ kemmo baaklibi bana lɛsawu asa na Yesu ɔ́lɔ-ma.

english_verse: At once they left the boat and their father and went with Jesus. Jesus Teaches, Preaches, and Heals (Luke
translation_verse: Mmɔ kani na báda bana ɔti bákya ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo na ama lɛnɔ básiaku-nwu kama. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Lɛlɛ Lidu Lidu Ƒui Na Bana Akɔ

english_verse: Jesus went all over Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the good news about God's kingdom. He also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́vi Galilea kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui na ɔ́tina ala na Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ. Na ɔ́kɔ lɛsa na Katɔti lɛgadi litemi buni lɛlɔ. Na ɔ́bwi bekyuli bani muuƒi lɛlɛ lidu lidu ƒui.

english_verse: News about him spread all over Syria, and people with every kind of sickness or disease were brought to him. Some of them had a lot of demons in them, others were thought to be crazy, and still others could not walk. But Jesus healed them all.
translation_verse: Nwuna lɛlɔ litemi lígyingya na Siria kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui. Anwuɔsu bekyuli bákpanku balɛne bani na lɛlɛ lidu lidu liikpóku-ma béboku. Na badi ni, ayu ekpidi elie-ma lɛlɔ eekpóku-ma. Na badi beeƒi kalɛ teebo. Badi lɛnɔ lɛlɔ kakɛ kékpi-ma. Na Yesu ɔ́bwi-ma ƒui.

english_verse: Large crowds followed Jesus from Galilee and the region around the ten cities known as Decapolis. They also came from Jerusalem, Judea, and from across the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Bekyuli pii bási Galilea ku lɛma linengudi leevu lɛdi kemmo ku Yerusalem ku Yudea kalɔ ku Yordan Ketu ɔvi ƒui bábasiaku Yesu kama.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the crowds, he went up on the side of a mountain and sat down. Blessings (Luke
translation_verse: Na ka Yesu ɔ́nu bekyuli pii bani nsiaku-nwu ni, úsie kɔbi kɔdi lili na úlie kalɔ. Mmɔ na nwuna basiakune bákpɛ béde-nwu.

english_verse: You must obey God's commands better than the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law obey them. If you don't, I promise you will never get into the kingdom of heaven. Anger
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu mɔɔsu-mii nwaa nnii asa na bɛdubɔkana na biduo Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ni, ɔdi ka bilie siin kalɛ na Katɔti ɔɔwia bitulo ɔda bubo ala batinane ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ. Yesu Ɔ́tina Ala Na Kɔnyi Buti Lɛlɔ

english_verse: So if you are about to place your gift on the altar and remember that someone is angry with you,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si anii eeti etela esienku Katɔti na nwuna lɛkpabi lɛlɔ na ényimo ka ƒ'ɔnwani ɔda-a kaƒɔ ni,

english_verse: God blesses those people who depend only on him. They belong to the kingdom of heaven!
translation_verse: “Lɛlɔ litaayɔ bekyuli bani nánu báti ka Katɔti lɛti lɛlɔ na basia anu. Ama ndubuduo Katɔti Lɛga Kadikɔ.

english_verse: God blesses those people who grieve. They will find comfort!
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ litaayɔ bekyuli bani muuwulo kɔnyana. Katɔti ɔdubɔsia-ma kɔnu.

english_verse: God blesses those people who are humble. The earth will belong to them!
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ litaayɔ bekyuli bani muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ. Ama badubɔdi kayawi lɛlɔ ala aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔ́su úse.

english_verse: God blesses those people who are merciful. They will be treated with mercy!
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ litaayɔ bekyuli bani mɔɔnu bana bekyulikpana kɔnyana. Katɔti ɔdubɔnu-ma kɔnyana.

english_verse: God blesses those people whose hearts are pure. They will see him!
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ litaayɔ bekyuli bani kayi kemmo nse nwaa. Ama ndubunye Katɔti anumi.

english_verse: You are the light for the whole world. A city built on top of a hill cannot be hidden,
translation_verse: “Amii nse aani bukeye bite kayawi ƒui. Ɔma ɔni nsia kɔbi lili ni, ulabɛ.

english_verse: But I tell you not to swear by anything when you make a promise! Heaven is God's throne, so don't swear by heaven.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, ami mɔɔsu-mii nnii bitakpali ala si biisé kenye kadi. Bitakpali ala bitalɔ katɔ, ɔsika mmɔ ndi Katɔti lɛgaboku.

english_verse: The earth is God's footstool, so don't swear by the earth. Jerusalem is the city of the great king, so don't swear by it.
translation_verse: Bitakpali ala bitalɔ kalɔ, ɔsika aka ndi Katɔti lɛgba kanyakɔ. Na bitakpali ala bitalɔ Yerusalem, ɔsika mmɔ ndi Katɔ Ɔga Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔma.

english_verse: You are the salt for everyone on earth. But if salt no longer tastes like salt, how can it make food salty? All it is good for is to be thrown out and walked on.
translation_verse: “Amii nse aani mma bite bekyuli ƒui. Nsu si mma bɔmmɔ emini ása ni, ulu ɔdi uuubo ɔni na basɔ bakya-mu emini. Na ka kɔsia kɔdi kuuubo-mu lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, beebó-mu teewiakun na bekyuli banya-mu bavi.

english_verse: and no one lights a lamp and puts it under a clay pot. Instead, it is placed on a lampstand, where it can give light to everyone in the house.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ulátu asogya teebi-nwu ala. Mmomu uuti taaƒala katɔ kalɛ na ɔdi biala nédu mmɔ ɔnu bukeye.

english_verse: Don't suppose I came to do away with the Law and the Prophets. I did not come to do away with them, but to give them their full meaning.
translation_verse: “Bitakali bɛnii líbo nnii mbada Mose ɔda bubo ku ala ani na Katɔti kenye bediene bátina lidie. Ńtebo nnii mbada-nya lidie munu munu. Mmomu ni, líbo kalɛ na ala ani bátina mmɔ ebo ete lɛni.

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Do not murder” and “A murderer must be brought to trial.”
translation_verse: “Kuuku ni, bínu ka básu bekyuli banii, ‘Tadu ukyuli.’ Na ukyuli ɔni mabla lɛni ni, ɔlɛka batɛku-nwu litemi.

english_verse: But I promise you if you are angry with someone, you will have to stand trial. If you call someone a fool, you will be taken to court. And if you say that someone is worthless, you will be in danger of the fires of hell.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, ami mɔɔsu-mii nnii ukyuli ɔni meti kɔnyi makya ɔnwani ni, badubɔtɛku-nwu litemi. Na ukyuli ɔni lɛnɔ masu ɔnwani ɔnii, ‘Aaadi ukyuli ɔdi’ ni, badubɔlɔ-nwu benengu anumi. Na ukyuli ɔni masu ɔnwani ɔnii, ‘Ɔdɔlɔdi na adi’ ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔni-nwu kɔtu na lɛgyavonku lɛmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: leave your gift there in front of the altar. Make peace with that person, then come back and offer your gift to God.
translation_verse: da etela ammɔ se lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ anumi na esie kɔnakunwi na awɔ ku ƒ'ɔnwani biwi kenye ntu asa na ebo ebeti etela ammɔ akpa ete Katɔti.

english_verse: Before you are dragged into court, make friends with the person who has accused you of doing wrong. If you don't, you will be handed over to the judge and then to the officer who will put you in jail.
translation_verse: “Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔnii uuti-ɔ usienku litemi katɛkɔ ni, wia uwi na awɔ ku-nwu bɛka-ni bɔklibi. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni asa na bísie bítéduo litemi katɛkɔ mmɔ ni, ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔdubuti-ɔ ute litemi ɔtɛne. Na anwu lɛnɔ ɔdubuti-ɔ ute beƒiene na bakya-a ɔtɔ.

english_verse: I promise you will not get out until you have paid the last cent you owe. Marriage
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-ɔ nwaa nnii adubɔkya mmɔ utálɛ uwi ɔni na áƒɔ kayu kani na ada ƒui áwɔlɔ. Bagya Ku Bele Batadi Kɔsɔnɔ

english_verse: You have been taught that a man who divorces his wife must write out divorce papers for her.
translation_verse: “Básu banii, ‘Ɔnana biala ɔni manyonu ulekudi ni, ute-nwu ɔku ka ɔ́nyonu-nwu.’

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Don't use the Lord's name to make a promise unless you are going to keep it.”
translation_verse: “Kuuku ni, bínu lɛnɔ ka básu bekyuli banii, ‘Bitalɛ kenye kani bíse kama. Na bɛbla bɛsia kenye kani na bise bite Blɔti lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: When you make a promise, say only “Yes” or “No.” Anything else comes from the devil. Revenge (Luke
translation_verse: Bɛya na bina ɛɛn ɔbla ɛɛn, na bina oowo ɔbla oowo. Si bíti lɛla bamba bíbunku ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni, na ɔmmɔ ɔdi ukisine ɔmmɔ ablala. Yesu Ɔ́tina-bu Ɔnii Butabla Butasia

english_verse: You know you have been taught, “An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.”
translation_verse: “Bínu ka básu banii, ‘Si ábwɛ ƒula ukyulikpana lɛnumi ni, babwɛ awɔ lɛdi lɛnɔ. Na si áƒɛ ƒula ukyulikpana lɛnyi ni, baƒɛ awɔ lɛdi lɛnɔ.’

english_verse: But I tell you not to try to get even with a person who has done something to you. When someone slaps your right cheek, turn and let that person slap your other cheek.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, ami mɔɔsu-mii nnini, bitedie bina bakpana ekpidi ani na bábla-mii kasi. Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́ƒiɛmi-ɔ kɔdianu ɔtugya ni, nwini kɔmii ɔdi lɛnɔ te-nwu.

english_verse: If someone sues you for your shirt, give up your coat as well.
translation_verse: Na si ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔwia-a katɛ ɔnii ɔɔƒɔ́ ƒula awu ɔtɔdi ni, die ɔni na akya ewi-nwu lɛlɔ lɛnɔ te-nwu.

english_verse: If a soldier forces you to carry his pack one kilometer, carry it two kilometers.
translation_verse: Na si bekpone akɔ ɔdi únye-ɔ lɛlɔ ɔnii tiku-nwu etila na bisie liluku linwi ni, awɔ sie anyɔ.

english_verse: When people ask you for something, give it to them. When they want to borrow money, lend it to them. Love (Luke
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔdi úye-ɔ lɛla lɛdi ni, te-nwu. Na si kevokɔ na ɔdi lɛnɔ uye-ɔ ni, na ete-nwu. Yesu Ɔ́tina-bu Ɔnii Bɔyɔ Bula Bekisine

english_verse: You have heard people say, “Love your neighbors and hate your enemies.”
translation_verse: “Bínu ka básu banii, ‘Bɛyɔ bina bekyulikpana na bini bina bekisine!’

english_verse: But I tell you to love your enemies and pray for anyone who mistreats you.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, ami mɔɔsu-mii nnii bɛyɔ bina bekisine na bɛkpali katɔ bite bekyuli bani muukpóku-mii.

english_verse: Then you will be acting like your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both good and bad people. And he sends rain for the ones who do right and for the ones who do wrong.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubunwini Katɔti ɔni nkya katɔ bebi geen. Ɔsika ɔɔyá na nwuna ɔƒɛ ɔɔlɛ́ teewi bekyuli bekpidi ku babuni ƒui lɛlɔ likeke. Na ɔnantu lɛnɔ ɔɔna teete bekyuli bani mɔɔbla ala abuni ku bani mɔɔbla ekpidi.

english_verse: If you love only those people who love you, will God reward you for this? Even tax collectors love their friends.
translation_verse: Si bekyuli bani mɔɔyɔ́-mii kani na amii lɛnɔ bɛɛyɔ́ ni, Katɔti ɔɔɔdubo-mii kayu kadi bɔƒɔ. Lɛni kani na kuyi baƒɔne lɛnɔ baabla.

english_verse: If you greet only your friends, what's so great about this? Don't even unbelievers do that?
translation_verse: Na si bina bakpana lɛti na biigyele ni, bítabla lɛla lɛdi bítagya. Ama bani naaadi baƒɔtaadine muedi ni, baabla lɛni.

english_verse: But you must always act like your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Bɛbla sɛɛn aani kalɛ na bina Ɔti ɔni nkya katɔ use sɛɛn.

english_verse: When you do good deeds, don't try to show off. If you do, you won't get a reward from your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: “Bɛnu kaduɛ kalɛ na bilabla lɛbuni bɛnii bekyuli banu-mii. Ɔsika si bɛ́bla lɛni ni, Katɔti ulaƒɔ-mii kayu kadi na Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma.

english_verse: When you give to the poor, don't let anyone know about it.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si eebunku ukyuli ɔdi ni, bunku-nwu kalɛ na ƒula ɔkpana ɔbuni ƒui muedi uláti lɛla lɛni na ábla.

english_verse: When you pray, don't be like those show-offs who love to stand up and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners. They do this just to look good. I can assure you that they already have their reward.
translation_verse: “Na si bɛɛkpali katɔ ni, bitabla ala aani anumi lɛlɔ bekyuli kalɛ. Ama baayɔ́ ka bata benye Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ ku ɔma kemmo ekpo ekpo asa bakpali katɔ kalɛ na bekyuli ƒui banu-ma. Mɔɔsu-mii geen nnii báakɛ bana lɛyuƒɔla biala ƒui.

english_verse: When you pray, go into a room alone and close the door. Pray to your Father in private. He knows what is done in private and will reward you.
translation_verse: Na si aakpali katɔ ni, duo ƒula katɔma na akalɛ ɔtɔ, na akpali ƒ'ɔti ɔni na balanu. Na anwu ɔni mɔɔnu-ɔ uwi ɔni na bekyuli bamba balánu-ɔ ni, ɔdubɔƒɔ-ɔ kayu.

english_verse: When you pray, don't talk on and on as people do who don't know God. They think God likes to hear long prayers.
translation_verse: “Na si bɛɛkpali katɔ ni, bitasu etemila keeke bitasia kama aani kalɛ na ama bani naaadi baƒɔtaadine baabla. Ama baakali banii bana butemi pii bɔdubɔya na bakɛ lɛla lɛni na baawia.

english_verse: Don't be like them. Your Father knows what you need even before you ask.
translation_verse: Bitalɛ-ma, ɔsika bina Katɔti ɔgyi ala ani na bɛɛwia asa na biiye-nwu.

english_verse: You should pray like this: Our Father in heaven, help us to honor your name.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu lɛni na ɔlɛka bɛkpali katɔ bɛsu bɛnii, “ ‘Bula Ɔti ɔni nkya katɔ, balɔ-ɔ lɛnyi buni.

english_verse: Come and set up your kingdom, so that everyone on earth will obey you, as you are obeyed in heaven.
translation_verse: Ƒula lɛga kadikɔ kebo-bu akɔ. Babla ƒula lɛƒɔyɔ na kalɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na use na katɔ.

english_verse: If you forgive others for the wrongs they do to you, your Father in heaven will forgive you.
translation_verse: “Na si bíti bina bekyulikpana bɔƒiɔ bɛkyiɛ-ma ni, bina Katɔti lɛnɔ ɔdubuti bina ɔdi ɔkyiɛ amii lɛnɔ.

english_verse: But if you don't forgive others, your Father will not forgive your sins. Worshiping God by Going without Eating
translation_verse: Nsu si bíteti bina bekyulikpana bɔƒiɔ bitakyiɛ-ma ni, bina Katɔti lɛnɔ uleti bina bɔƒiɔ ulakyiɛ-mii. Yesu Ɔ́tina Kalɛ Na Bulie Kɔka

english_verse: Instead, comb your hair and wash your face.
translation_verse: Si biilie kɔka ni, bɛƒɔ anumi na bigyeli lili.

english_verse: Then others won't know you are going without eating. But your Father sees what is done in private, and he will reward you. Treasures in Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na bekyuli baláti banii biilie kɔka. Mmomu ƒ'ɔti ɔni nkya kesii biala ndubɔti. Na anwu ɔni mɔɔnu ala ani na bekyuli balánu ni, anwu kani ndubɔƒɔ-mii kayu. Yesu Ɔ́tina Ala Na Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma Lɛlakɛ Lɛlɔ

english_verse: But more than anything else, put God's work first and do what he wants. Then the other things will be yours as well.
translation_verse: Mmomu anumi egyie-mii na Katɔ Ɔga ala lɛlɔ na kalɛ na bɛbla lɛlɔ siin utulo. Na Katɔti wabla ala abambadi ƒui lɛnɔ wete-mii.

english_verse: Don't worry about tomorrow. It will take care of itself. You have enough to worry about today.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu biteti kasusu pii na kadi kani nétegye tɔ lɛlɔ. Limeyi lɛmmɔ alatidi lɛdanku nina etila. Útalɛka biti etila bamba bibunku limeyi lɛmmɔ adi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't store up treasures on earth! Moths and rust can destroy them, and thieves can break in and steal them.
translation_verse: “Bitatɛ akɛla bitese bitete lɛlɔ na kayawi kamɛni kemmo. Kayawi mɛni ni, kubweyi kɔdububile-nya na etili, na beyune lɛnɔ beduo beyu-nya.

english_verse: Instead, store up your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy them, and thieves cannot break in and steal them.
translation_verse: Mmomu ni, bɛbla ala abuni ani menwini lɛyuƒɔla mete-mii na katɔ. Mmɔ ni, kubweyi kulebile-nya na eletili, na beyune lɛnɔ beleduo beletéyu-nya.

english_verse: Your heart will always be where your treasure is. Light (Luke
translation_verse: Ɔsika kesii kani na ƒula akɛla ese ni, mmɔ na aasia lɛnu. Yesu Ɔ́tina Ɔnii Anumi Ndi Bukeye Ute Ɔlɔna

english_verse: But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark. If the light inside you is dark, you surely are in the dark. Money (Luke
translation_verse: Nsu si ƒula anumi alánu nwaa ni, lɛdisa lɛdubɔƒɔ-ɔ lɛlɔ ƒui. Anwuɔsu si ƒula bukeye búnwini lɛdisa ni, na ɔdubɔbla-a suu geen. Yesu Ɔ́tina Ala Na Katɔti Ku Lɛlakɛ Kama Bɔsiaku Lɛlɔ

english_verse: You cannot be the slave of two masters! You will like one more than the other or be more loyal to one than the other. You cannot serve both God and money. Worry (Luke
translation_verse: “Ukyuli biala ulákana na wabla benwoti inyɔ kabla. Ɔdubukisi unwi na ɔyɔ ɔkladi litemi. Na ɔdubɔdi unwi etemila lɛlɔ, na ɔta unye ɔkladi etemila lɛlɔ. Alakana Katɔti ku lɛlakɛ kabla bɔsala.

english_verse: Don't worry and ask yourselves, “Will we have anything to eat? Will we have anything to drink? Will we have any clothes to wear?”
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu bɛsɔ biteti kasusu bɛnii, ‘Wɛ na bɔdubɔkɛ lɛla lɛdi bɔdi? Iye lɛdi bɔni? Iye lɛdi bɔkya?’

english_verse: I tell you not to worry about your life. Don't worry about having something to eat, drink, or wear. Isn't life more than food or clothing?
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu mɔɔsu-mii nnii biteti kasusu pii na bɔdi ku bɔni iye bina adala lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ngba bɔƒɔ kuye butulo adila. Na ɔlɔna lɛnɔ ɔ́ƒɔ kuye utulo adala.

english_verse: Look at the birds in the sky! They don't plant or harvest. They don't even store grain in barns. Yet your Father in heaven takes care of them. Aren't you worth much more than birds?
translation_verse: Bɛnu baasɛ ka balátuma na baláklibi edula teese teete lɛlɔ na linwu kemmo, nsu bina Katɔti ɔɔnu-ma lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubɔnu amii lɛlɔ utulo-ma, ɔsika bɛ́ƒɔ kuye bítulo-ma.

english_verse: Why worry about clothes? Look how the wild flowers grow. They don't work hard to make their clothes.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu bɛsɔ biteti kasusu pii na adala lɛlɔ. Bɛnu kalɛ na egyii anwula aalɛ́ lili. Alábla kabla kadi na beledi adi lɛnɔ teete lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But I tell you that Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of them.
translation_verse: Nsu mɔɔsu-mii nnii Ɔga Salomo ku nwuna lɛlakɛ muedi ni, nwuna adala átadia bɔnu aani anwula amɛni kemmo ɔdi.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. God will surely do even more for you! Why do you have such little faith?
translation_verse: Katɔti muute eveteli amɛni bɔdia lɛni. Na eveteli amɛni ni, bɔkana bɔnu-nya ɔmwi. Na kɔnaadi asɔ eeebo, ɔsika bákyula-nya na ogya kemmo. Katɔti ɔdubɔsia-mii anu na ute-mii adala utulo eveteli amɛni. Bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɔsɔ.

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father in heaven knows you need all of these.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni lɛlɔ na ama bani naaadi baƒɔtaadine beeti kasusu pii. Bina Ɔti ɔni nkya katɔ ɔgyi ka bɛɛyaki ala amɛni ƒui.

english_verse: Don't condemn others, and God won't condemn you.
translation_verse: “Bitatɛku bekyuli litemi kalɛ na Katɔti lɛnɔ ulatɛku-mii litemi.

english_verse: God will be as hard on you as you are on others! He will treat you exactly as you treat them.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti ɔdubɔtɛku-mii litemi aani kalɛ kani na amii lɛnɔ bɛɛtɛku bekyuli litemi. Na ulu ɔni lɛlɔ bɛ́sia bɛ́tɛku-ma litemi ni, ulu ɔmmɔ kani lɛlɔ na ɔdubɔsia ɔtɛku amii lɛnɔ litemi.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu ni, tanu alakpi ani nkya ƒula ɔnwani anumi. Mmomu ka ligyuku lɛni nkya-a anumi bɔnu asa.

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye?
translation_verse: Tasu ƒula ɔnwani anii, ‘Ya na lidie-ɔ alakpi lɛnumi’ na uwi ɔni na ligyuku lɛkya awɔ ɔlati lɛnumi.

english_verse: You're nothing but show-offs! First, take the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye.
translation_verse: Awɔ, anumi lɛlɔ ukyuli, ka ligyuku lɛni nkya-a lɛnumi budie na ɔbla-a nwaa. Na anu edie alakpi ani nkya ƒula ɔnwani lɛnumi.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give good things to people who ask.
translation_verse: Ina ka bɛdi alaekpidi bablane muedi ni, bɛgyi kalɛ na biti ala abuni bite bina bebi. Anwuɔsu geen ni, Katɔti ɔni nse kedee ɔgyi kalɛ na uti ala abuni ute bekyuli bani muuvele-nwu utulo.

english_verse: Would any of you give your hungry child a stone, if the child asked for some bread?
translation_verse: “Ubi ɔti ɔdi uleti lɛtabi ulete ubidi si úye-nwu bodobodo.

english_verse: Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: “Bivele Katɔti ala, na ɔdubuti-nya ute-mii. Bɛwia nwuna ala, na ɔdubɔya na bɛkɛ-nya. Bibo Katɔti kegbuta kɔnu na ɔdubɔlɛmi ute-mii.

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive. Everyone who searches will find. And the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli biala ɔni muuvele Katɔti ala ni, ɔdubute-nwu. Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔwia ni, ɔɔkɛ́. Na ukyuli biala ɔni muubó Katɔti kegbuta kɔnu ni, ɔɔlɛmi teete-nwu.

english_verse: Would you give your child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Na uleti kɔlakpi ulete-nwu si úye-nwu kabɛ.

english_verse: Treat others as you want them to treat you. This is what the Law and the Prophets are all about. The Narrow Gate (Luke
translation_verse: Ala ani na aayɔ́ ka bekyuli bamba babla bete-ɔ ni, bla-nya te ama lɛnɔ lɛni kani. Ɔmɛni ndi Mose ɔda bubo ku Katɔti kenye bediene ala ani bátina kalɔ budie. Bɛsia Kayakun Kani Nse Blii Suɛ

english_verse: Anyone who hears and obeys these teachings of mine is like a wise person who built a house on solid rock.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu ni, ukyuli ɔni muunú mina etemila amɛni na ɔɔdi-nya lɛlɔ ni, ɔdi ɔnundane. Use aani ukyuli ɔni nátu nwuna ɔtɔ na lɛtakpɛ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But the gate to life is very narrow. The road that leads there is so hard to follow that only a few people find it. A Tree and Its Fruit (Luke
translation_verse: Nsu kayakun kani ulu ntɛ késela ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii kemmo ni, kese blii suɛ. Na ulu ɔni ntɛ úsela mmɔ uudé busie. Na bani mɔɔnu ulu ɔmmɔ beeemomo. Kugyii Biala Kubo Kuna Ebi

english_verse: Watch out for false prophets! They dress up like sheep, but inside they are wolves who have come to attack you.
translation_verse: “Bɛnu kaduɛ na ɔkɔ banyine bani nábla lɛlɔ aani Katɔti kenye bediene. Beebo-mii kudɔ aani baƒonu bani nse buɛɛ. Nsu na bana lɛlɔ kemmo geen ni, badi begiti.

english_verse: You can tell what they are by what they do. No one picks grapes or figs from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Bana udu na bɛdubuti bɛti-ma. Lɛnyɛ kɔbuli kulánwu atoo. Na liyu kugyii kulánwu kɔyaka ebi.

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit.
translation_verse: Kugyii kɔni nédie evete kaduɛ ni, kɔɔnwu ebi abuni. Na kugyii kɔni nátakana evete budie ni, kɔɔnwu ebi ekpidi.

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: Kugyii kɔbuni kulánwu ebi ekpidi, na kugyii kukpidi kulánwu ebi abuni.

english_verse: Every tree producing bad fruit will be chopped down and burned.
translation_verse: Kugyii kɔdi biala na kulánwu ebi abuni ni, baadá-ku na beeti-ku taakya ogya.

english_verse: You can tell who the false prophets are by their deeds. A Warning (Luke
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, ala ani na ɔkɔ banyine bani nábla lɛlɔ aani Katɔti kenye bediene baabla ndubɔya na bɛti-ma. Bitaabla Katɔti Lɛyɔla

english_verse: Anyone who hears my teachings and doesn't obey them is like a foolish person who built a house on sand.
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli ɔni muunú mina etemila na uládi-nya lɛlɔ ni, ɔdi ɔdɔlɔdi. Use aani ukyuli ɔni nátu nwuna ɔtɔ na kɔnwinimi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and the winds blew and beat against that house. Finally, it fell with a crash.
translation_verse: Ɔnantu ɔ́na na ntukpa búyi, na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ úkpo momoomo ɔ́siaku ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ, na ɔ́ƒɛ butu butu.” Yesu Ɔ́tina Ala Ku Ɔyikun

english_verse: Not everyone who calls me their Lord will get into the kingdom of heaven. Only the ones who obey my Father in heaven will get in.
translation_verse: “Ɔɔɔdi ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔlɔ-mi ɔnii, ‘Blɔti, Blɔti,’ ndubuduo Katɔti Lɛga Kadikɔ. Mmomu bekyuli bani mɔɔbla mina Ɔti ɔni nkya katɔ lɛyɔla ndubuduo mmɔ.

english_verse: On the day of judgment many will call me their Lord. They will say, “We preached in your name, and in your name we forced out demons and worked many miracles.”
translation_verse: Na Katɔti litemi bɔtɛ limeyi ni, bekyuli pii badubɔsu-mi banii, ‘Blɔti! Bɔ́su ƒula kenye na bɔ́gya ayu ekpidi na ƒula lɛnyi kemmo. Na bɔ́bla akɔla budie taatina lidu lidu lɛnɔ na ƒula lɛnyi kemmo.’

english_verse: But I will tell them, “I will have nothing to do with you! Get out of my sight, you evil people!” Two Builders (Luke
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ndubɔsu-ma nnii, ‘Lɛɛɛgyi-mii kula kula! Bɛtɔlɔ-mi kudɔ, amii bekyuli bekpidi.’ Yesu Ɔ́tina Ala Na Lɛtɔ Lidu Inyɔ Batune Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and winds beat against that house. But it was built on solid rock, and so it did not fall.
translation_verse: Ɔnantu ɔ́na na ntukpa búyi, na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ úkpo momoomo ɔ́siaku ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ. Nsu útaƒɛ, ɔsika ɔ́tu-nwu ɔ́lɛ lɛtakpɛ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, the crowds were surprised at his teaching.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́su ala amɛni ƒui ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, nwuna ala bɔtina bɔ́bla-ma dɛye dɛye.

english_verse: He taught them like someone with authority, and not like their teachers of the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na ɔ́tina ala uuuse aani ɔda bubo ala batinane bani na bɔtɛya na bátɛya-nya kalɛ. Mmomu ɔ́tina ala ku ɔyikun aani ukyuli ɔni ndanku litemi lɛmmɔ úboku kalɛ.

english_verse: But the ones who should have been in the kingdom will be thrown out into the dark. They will cry and grit their teeth in pain.”
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti ɔdubɔbɔku Yudaƒuɔ badi bani nka badi bagadine mmɔ utákya kasuudikɔ. Mmɔ na badubuwulo na badu bana anumi.”

english_verse: That evening many people with demons in them were brought to Jesus. And with only a word he forced out the evil spirits and healed everyone who was sick.
translation_verse: Na useyi uwi ni, béti bekyuli pii bani na ayu ekpidi eekpóku-ma béboku Yesu. Na ɔ́su lɛlakpa linwi na ɔ́bɔku-nya ɔ́lɛku-ma lɛlɔ kemmo. Na ɔ́bwi bani muuƒi mmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Suddenly a man with leprosy came and knelt in front of Jesus. He said, “Lord, you have the power to make me well, if only you wanted to.”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔnana ɔdi muuƒi ɔlɛgyie úbo úbalɛ akɔnkɔ na nwuna anumi na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Blɔti! Si aayɔ́ ni, akana na abla-mi sɛɛn.”

english_verse: Jesus put his hand on the man and said, “I want to! Now you are well.” At once the man's leprosy disappeared.
translation_verse: Yesu únene kɔnu útuku-nwu, na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Mɔɔyɔ́. Lɛlɔ lɛbla-a sɛɛn.” Mmɔ kani ni, ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́ba ɔnana ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ndubusie ntábwi-nwu.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, “I tell you in all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith!
translation_verse: Ka Yesu únu ɔmɛni ni, ɔ́bla-nwu kalɛ kadi na ɔ́su bekyuli bani nsiaku-nwu mmɔ ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka na Israelƒuɔ akɔ muedi ni, ńtanu tɔ bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmɛni udu.

english_verse: “Lord, my servant is at home in such terrible pain that he can't even move.”
translation_verse: “Blɔti! Mina kabla ɔblane uuƒi kpakplaa na ɔ́tɛ kaduli ɔni na ulakana bɔta.”

english_verse: Many people will come from everywhere to enjoy the feast in the kingdom of heaven with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka bekyuli pii badubɔsi ɔƒɛ katukɔ ku kanukɔ bebo Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma limeyi kadikɔ. Badubulie kalɔ na badi ku Abraham ku Isak ku Yakob na mmɔ.

english_verse: Then Jesus said to the officer, “You may go home now. Your faith has made it happen.” Right then his servant was healed. Jesus Heals Many People (Mark
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su bekpone unengu ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Teesie kaduli. Kalɛ na áƒɔ ádi ni, ɔdububo ute-ɔ lɛni.” Na bekpone unengu kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ ɔlɛ ɔ́ba-nwu uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo kani. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Bekyuli Pii

english_verse: Suddenly they shouted, “Jesus, Son of God, what do you want with us? Have you come to punish us before our time?”
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, báva ku lɛdi momoomo na béye-nwu banii, “Bi na awɔ Katɔti Ubidi aawia-bu kudɔ mɛni? Ébo anii abaka-bu kɔtu bɔni asa na uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔdubɔtɛku-bu litemi wedu?”

english_verse: Everyone in town came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged him to leave their part of the country.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔma ɔmmɔ bekyuli ƒui bésie banii batásiaku Yesu. Na ka bánu-nwu ni, bévele-nwu ka ɔtɔlɔ bana kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Jesus went to the home of Peter, where he found that Peter's mother-in-law was sick in bed with fever.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu úsie Petro kaduli ni, ɔ́nu ka Petro uleni ɔtɛ uuƒi kpakplaa ɔni na lɛlɔ lɛ́ƒɔ-nwu ogya.

english_verse: He took her by the hand, and the fever left her. Then she got up and served Jesus a meal.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úƒie-nwu kɔnu ɔ́da na ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́ba-nwu kɔnakunwi, na ɔ́ta na ɔ́bla-nwu lɛƒɔ.

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said, “He healed our diseases and made us well.” Some Who Wanted To Go with Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla ɔmɛni kalɛ na kenye kani na Katɔti Kenye Udiene Yesaia ɔ́su úse ubo ute lɛni ɔnini, “Anwu ɔlati ɔ́bwi-bu lɛlɛ lɛni na buuƒi ƒui.” Nkyuli Inyɔ Báyɔ Ka Basiaku Yesu Kama

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses came up to him and said, “Teacher, I'll go anywhere with you!”
translation_verse: Ɛpu ɔvi mmɔ ni, ɔda bubo ala ɔtinane ɔdi úbo-nwu kudɔ. Na ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Ala ɔtinane, kesii biala na adubusie ni, ndubɔsiaku-ɔ kama.”

english_verse: Another disciple said to Jesus, “Lord, let me wait till I bury my father.”
translation_verse: Na ukyuli bamba ɔdi ɔ́su ɔnini, “Blɔti, masiaku-ɔ. Nsu ya na lɛka busie ntáva mina ɔti.”

english_verse: After Jesus left in a boat with his disciples,
translation_verse: Yesu úduo ɔkɔlɔ ɔdi kemmo na nwuna batɛyane lɛnɔ básiaku-nwu kama.

english_verse: a terrible storm suddenly struck the lake, and waves started splashing into their boat. Jesus was sound asleep,
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔdi úse kalɔ uukpó na ɛpu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na uubó ntu teewi ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo, na ɔɔyɔ́ ɔnyi. Nsu uwi ɔmmɔ ƒui ni, na Yesu anwu ɔtɛ ɔlɛɛ.

english_verse: The men in the boat were amazed and said, “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him.” Two Men with Demons in Them (Mark
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́bla ukyuli biala kalɛ kadi. Na béye lɛlɔ banini, “Bi? Bútanu ukyuli ɔmɛni udu kudii! Ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ku ntu bɔni mɔɔnwanɛ lɛlɔ muedi buunú-nwu litemi!” Yesu Ɔ́bwi Nkyuli Inyɔ Badi Na Ayu Ekpidi Eekpóku

english_verse: After Jesus had crossed the lake, he came to shore near the town of Gadara and started down the road. Two men with demons in them came to him from the tombs. They were so fierce that no one could travel that way.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu útéduo Gadara kalɛkɛ na ɛpu ɔvi ni, nkyuli inyɔ badi na ayu ekpidi eekpóku-ma bási bekyuli kavakɔ mmɔ bábasiaku-nwu. Na ka bana lɛlɔ lɛɛda liƒu geen ɔsu ni, ukyuli ɔdi ulásia ulu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Not far from there a large herd of pigs was feeding.
translation_verse: Amu na amadɔ mmɔ ni, baplakuo pii badi benye baadi.

english_verse: So the demons begged Jesus, “If you force us out, please send us into those pigs!”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ayu ekpidi ammɔ évele Yesu anini, “Si anii aabɔku-bu alɛku ni, na abɔku-bu atákya baplakuo pii bammɔ kemmo.”

english_verse: Jesus told them to go, and they went out of the men and into the pigs. All at once the pigs rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Yesu ɔ́bɔku-ma ɔnii, “Bɛvi bɛlɛ-ma kemmo.” Anwuɔsu bálɛ-ma kemmo bétéduo baplakuo bammɔ kemmo. Na baplakuo bammɔ békeli báyu kɔbi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ bátánu béduo ɛpu ɔmmɔ kemmo na békpi.

english_verse: The people taking care of the pigs ran to the town and told everything, especially what had happened to the two men.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, baplakuo lɛlɔ banune bammɔ békeli bátɔlɔ bésie ɔma kemmo. Na bátásu ala ani ƒui na alɛku baplakuo bammɔ ku bekyuli bani na ayu ekpidi eekpóku mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Jesus got into a boat and crossed back over to the town where he lived.
translation_verse: Yesu úduo ɔkɔlɔ kemmo na bénwini básia ɛpu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ bésie nwuna ɔma.

english_verse: Jesus heard them and answered, “Healthy people don't need a doctor, but sick people do.
translation_verse: Yesu únu lɛla lɛni na básu na údie kenye ɔnini, “Balɛne mɔɔwia ɔbwine, na ɔɔɔdi bani na beléƒi.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined. New wine must be put into new wineskins. Both the skins and the wine will then be safe. A Dying Girl and a Sick Woman (Mark
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na beleti ntɛ bɔwɔdi teewi ɔku koƒo kɔkukudi kɔni kemmo béewi ntɛ dii. Si ɔɔdi lɛni ni, ɔku koƒo kɔkukudi kɔmmɔ kɔdubɔbwɛ na ntɛ bɔmmɔ lɛnɔ bɔdubuwiakun. Nsu beeti ntɛ bɔwɔdi beewi ɔku koƒo kɔwɔdi kemmo. Na bana anyɔ ƒui badubɔdia.” Yesu Úbunku Uleku Ɔdi Ku Yairo Ubidi

english_verse: News about this spread all over that part of the country. Jesus Heals Two Blind Men
translation_verse: Litemi lɛmɛni lígyingya na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ kesi kesii. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Banumbwɛne Inyɔ Badi

english_verse: Some teachers of the Law of Moses said to themselves, “Jesus must think he is God!”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔda bubo ala batinane badi bakya baasu lɛlɔ banii, “Ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔɔkɔ́ kakɔ na uutemi enyekpi.”

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their minds, and he said, “Why are you thinking such evil things?
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́nu bana kasusu kamɛni ɔ́ti na úye-ma ɔnini, “Bi ɔsu na biiti kasusu kekpidi kamɛni udu?

english_verse: But I will show you that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” So Jesus said to the man, “Get up! Pick up your mat and go on home.”
translation_verse: Ndubudie lɛtina-mii ka Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ubo ɔyikun na uti ekpidi ɔkyiɛ na kayawi mɛni.” Anwuɔsu ɔ́su ukyuli ɔni náƒɛ uwi kalɔ mmɔ ɔnini, “Ta nye, na eti ƒula atɛla na eteesie kaduli.”

english_verse: The man got up and went home.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔ́ta na úti nwuna lɛtɛla na ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie kaduli.

english_verse: Go and learn what the Scriptures mean when they say, ‘Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others.’ I didn't come to invite good people to be my followers. I came to invite sinners.” People Ask about Going without Eating (Mark
translation_verse: Bitáwia lɛla lɛni nkya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo kalɔ binu ka ni, ‘Lɛƒɔndia na Katɔti ɔɔwia, na ɔɔɔdi bebuo buti taakpa.’ Ńtebo nnii mbawia bekyuli babuni, mmomu bekyuli bekpidi ɔsu na líbo.” Béye Yesu Ala Na Kɔka Bulie Lɛlɔ

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving that place, two blind men began following him and shouting, “Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Amu ka Yesu ɔ́si mmɔ úsela ni, banumbwɛne inyɔ badi báta básiaku-nwu kama ku kɔvanu banii, “Ɔga Dawid uwɔ! Nu-bu kɔnyana.”

english_verse: As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, some people brought to him a man who could not talk because a demon was in him.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bási baalɛ́ ni, bekyuli badi béti ɔnana ɔdi ɔni na kɔyu kukpidi kɔ́ya na ulakana butemi béboku Yesu kudɔ.

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving, he saw a tax collector named Matthew sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.” Matthew got up and went with him.
translation_verse: Amu ka Yesu ɔ́si mmɔ úsela ni, ɔ́nu kuyi ɔƒɔne ɔdi na baalɔ banii Mateo ka ɔ́kya nwuna kabla kablakɔ. Na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Siaku-mi kama.” Mmɔ kani na Mateo ɔ́ta na ɔ́siaku-nwu kama.

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples were having dinner at Matthew's house. Many tax collectors and other sinners were also there.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ulie ɔɔdi na Mateo kaduli ni, kuyi baƒɔne pii ku alaekpidi bablane babambadi bébo babadiku Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane na mmɔ.

english_verse: Some Pharisees asked Jesus' disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and other sinners?”
translation_verse: Amu na Ƒarisiƒuɔ bani nánu ɔmɛni ni, béye nwuna batɛyane banii, “Bi ɔsu na bina ala ɔtinane ku bekyuli bamɛni udu baadi?”

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking, an official came and knelt in front of him. The man said, “My daughter has just now died! Please come and place your hand on her. Then she will live again.”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ɔɔtɛmiku-ma ni, Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ lɛlɔ ɔnune ɔdi úbo-nwu kudɔ na ɔ́lɛ akɔnkɔ úvele-nwu ɔnini, “Mina ubi ulekubi úkpi ɔƒaani, nsu bo na eti ƒula enu asia-nwu lɛlɔ na ɔdubɔta.”

english_verse: Jesus turned. He saw the woman and said, “Don't worry! You are now healed because of your faith.” At that moment she was healed.
translation_verse: Yesu únwini na ɔ́nu uleku ɔmmɔ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Kɛ kayi, mina ubi ulekubi! Ƒula bɔƒɔtaadi bɔ́bwi-ɔ.” Mmɔ kani ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́ba-nwu.

english_verse: After Jesus had forced the demon out, the man started talking. The crowds were so amazed they began saying, “Nothing like this has ever happened in Israel!”
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́gya kɔyu kukpidi kɔmmɔ ɔ́lɛku-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo. Mmɔ kani na ukyuli ɔmmɔ úse kalɔ uutemi. Ɔmɛni ɔ́bla bekyuli bani nnye mmɔ kalɛ kadi, na básu banii, “Bútanu ɔmɛni udu kudii na Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ!”

english_verse: Some followers of John the Baptist came and asked Jesus, “Why do we and the Pharisees often go without eating, while your disciples never do?”
translation_verse: Amu na Ntu Ɔkpilane Yohane basiakune bébo bébeye Yesu banini, “Bi ɔsu na abu ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ buulie kɔka uwi uwi, na ƒula batɛyane ama belemonku kɔka bulie?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: The friends of a bridegroom aren't sad while he is still with them. But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Bɛɛƒɔ́ taadi ka bekyuli bani na bálɔ béboku uleku ketikɔ badubo kɔnyana buteewulo na uwi ɔni na uleku ɔgya ɔmmɔ ɔkya-ma kudɔ? Ulebo ulete lɛni kudii! Nsu limeyi lɛdi lɛdububo ɔni na badubuti uleku ɔgya ɔmmɔ na bana kudɔ. Na uwi ɔmmɔ na badubulie kɔka.

english_verse: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and tear a bigger hole.
translation_verse: “Ukyuli biala uléti lɛdiku lɛwɔdi taaka taada lɛkukudi lɛlɔ. Ɔsika lɛdiku lɛwɔdi lɛmmɔ lɛdubɔduli kɔkukudi kɔmmɔ na ɔya na liƒi lɛmmɔ libomo libu.

english_verse: She had said to herself, “If I can just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla lɛni ɔsika ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di ka si ɔ́nya útuku-nwu awu kɔtu ni, ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔba-nwu.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples got up and went with the man.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yesu ɔ́ta ɔ́siaku-nwu ku nwuna batɛyane lɛnɔ.

english_verse: A woman who had been bleeding for twelve years came up behind Jesus and barely touched his clothes.
translation_verse: Na ka Yesu úsela ni, uleku ɔdi ɔni na ubugya uuwi akwa leevu-anyɔ úbasia Yesu kama na útuku-nwu awu kɔtu.

english_verse: When Jesus went into the home of the official and saw the musicians and the crowd of mourners,
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu útéduo Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ lɛlɔ ɔnune ɔmmɔ kaduli kemmo, na ɔ́nu lɛkwanu bediene ku bani muuwulo.

english_verse: he said, “Get out of here! The little girl isn't dead. She is just asleep.” Everyone started laughing at Jesus.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ukyuli biala ɔlɛ keyi. Ulekubi ɔmmɔ útekpi, mmomu bɔlɛɛ kani ɔda.” Amu na bése kalɔ baamá-nwu.

english_verse: But after the crowd had been sent out of the house, Jesus went to the girl's bedside. He took her by the hand and helped her up.
translation_verse: Amu ka bágya bekyuli bammɔ bálɛku ni, Yesu úduo ulekubi ɔmmɔ ɔtɔ kemmo, na ɔ́da-nwu kɔnu. Na ɔ́ta ulie.

english_verse: After Jesus had gone indoors, the two blind men came up to him. He asked them, “Do you believe I can make you well?” “Yes, Lord,” they answered.
translation_verse: Amu uwi ɔni na Yesu útéduo kaduli kemmo ni, banumbwɛne inyɔ bammɔ bébo-nwu kudɔ. Na Yesu úye-ma ɔnini, “Bɛɛƒɔ́ taadi ka ndubɔkana-mii bɔbwi?” Mmɔ na bédie kenye banii, “Bɔ́ƒɔ bɔ́di!”

english_verse: Jesus touched their eyes and said, “Because of your faith, you will be healed.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu útuku bana anumi na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ubo ute-mii kalɛ kani na bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́di.”

english_verse: They were able to see, and Jesus strictly warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: Mmɔ kani na anumi álɛmi-ma. Na Yesu úbo-ma ɔda kpakplaa ɔnini, “Bitasu ukyuli ɔdi lɛla lɛmɛni.”

english_verse: But they left and talked about him to everyone in that part of the country. Jesus Heals a Man Who Could Not Talk
translation_verse: Nsu ka bási mmɔ ni, bébo litemi lɛmɛni kudu na kalɛkɛ kammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui ɔ́si Yesu lɛlɔ. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Ukyuli Ɔni Naaakana Butemi

english_verse: But the Pharisees said, “The leader of the demons gives him the power to force out demons.” Jesus Has Pity on People
translation_verse: Nsu Ƒarisiƒuɔ badi básu banii, “Ayu ekpidi ɔga néte-nwu ɔyikun ɔni na ɔda ɔɔgyá ayu ekpidi ammɔ.” Bekyuli Bákywi Yesu Kaƒɔ

english_verse: Jesus went to every town and village. He taught in their synagogues and preached the good news about God's kingdom. Jesus also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
translation_verse: Yesu úsie ɔ́vi lɛma ku akpaklɔ ani nkya amadɔ mmɔ kemmo. Ɔ́tina ala na Yudaƒuɔ kɔsakɔ. Na ɔ́kɔ litemi buni lɛsa lɛni nkɛnku Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ lɛlɔ. Na ɔ́bwi lɛlɛ lidu lidu.

english_verse: When he saw the crowds, he felt sorry for them. They were confused and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Na ka ɔ́nu bekyuli esu esu ammɔ ni, bákywi-nwu kaƒɔ ɔsika béƒu na beeebo bebunkune. Na bese aani baƒonu bani neeebo ɔdane.

english_verse: He said to his disciples, “A large crop is in the fields, but there are only a few workers.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu únwini na úbo nwuna batɛyane bammɔ lɛgba ɔnini, “Edula ani néedu ka baƒɛ ni, emomo. Nsu bekyuli bani maƒɛ-nya beeemomo.

english_verse: Ask the Lord in charge of the harvest to send out workers to bring it in.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bivele edula ɔlati ɔmmɔ na uti kabla bablane badi ubebunku kabla kammɔ kemmo.”

english_verse: Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew the tax collector, James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus were also apostles.
translation_verse: ku Ƒilipo ku Bartolomeo ku Toma ku kuyi ɔƒɔne Mateo ku Yakobo ɔni ndi Alƒeo ubidi ku Tadeo

english_verse: Go only to the people of Israel, because they are like a flock of lost sheep.
translation_verse: Mmomu bisie Israelƒuɔ bani nse aani baƒonu bani náyii ulu mmɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: I am sending you like lambs into a pack of wolves. So be as wise as snakes and as innocent as doves.
translation_verse: “Bɛnu! Mɔɔtala-mii aani baƒonu lɛkya begiti akɔ. Binye kagyumana aani balakpi kalɛ, nsu bɛda lɛlɔ aani babloduma.

english_verse: The others were Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas Iscariot, who later betrayed Jesus. Instructions for the Twelve Apostles (Mark
translation_verse: ku Simon ɔni nási Kana ku Yuda Iskariot ɔni ndubo Yesu kakya bɔkya. Bisie Na Bitákɔ Lɛsa

english_verse: Jesus sent out the twelve apostles with these instructions: Stay away from the Gentiles and don't go to any Samaritan town.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́tala banana leevu-inyɔ bamɛni na úbo-ma ɔda ɔnini, “Bitesie bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na bitesie Samariaƒuɔ ɔma ɔdi lɛnɔ kemmo.

english_verse: And don't carry a traveling bag or an extra shirt or sandals or a walking stick. Workers deserve their food.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi biala uteti koƒo utada aani ala bevelene kalɛ. Biteti awu iye lɛgbanvuo lɛbambadi lɛdi iye ugyii ɔdadi. Kabla ɔblane biala ni, nwuna kabla kemmo na ɔdubɔdi.

english_verse: So when you go to a town or a village, find someone able and willing to have you as their guest and stay with them until you leave.
translation_verse: “Si biduo ɔma iye lɛkpaklɔ lɛdi kemmo ni, bɛwia ukyuli ɔbuni ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔƒɔ-mii. Na biduo-nwu kudɔ na bɛkya mmɔ utédu uwi ɔni na bɛdubɔtɔlɔ.

english_verse: I promise you the day of judgment will be easier for the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah than for that town. Warning about Trouble (Mark
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka limeyi lɛni na Katɔti ɔdubɔtɛku bayawine litemi ni, ɔdubɔnu lɛma likpidi aani Sodom ku Gomora kɔnyana utulo ɔma ɔmmɔ. Bekyuli Badi Badubukpoku-mii

english_verse: Brothers and sisters will betray one another and have each other put to death. Parents will betray their own children, and children will turn against their parents and have them killed.
translation_verse: “Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, bekyuli badi badubuti bana banwa alati bete na badu na ami ɔsu. Na bebi bati badi lɛnɔ badubɔbla lɛni na bana bebi lɛlɔ. Bebi badubɔta benye bana bawɔne lɛlɔ na bakya-ma kakya kalɛ na badu-ma.

english_verse: Watch out for people who will take you to court and have you beaten in their synagogues.
translation_verse: Bɛsia lɛlɔ anu, ɔsika bekyuli badubudie-mii bete na beƒie-mii besienku litemi katɛkɔ. Na badubo-mii bubo lɛnɔ na Yudaƒuɔ kɔsakɔ.

english_verse: Because of me, you will be dragged before rulers and kings to tell them and the Gentiles about your faith.
translation_verse: Na ka bɛdi mina batɛyane ɔsu ni, badubɔtɛku-mii litemi na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ badine ku baga anumi. Na bɛsu ama bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: But you will not really be the one speaking. The Spirit from your Father will tell you what to say.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti ndubute-mii etemila ani na bɛdubɔsu. Katɔti Kɔyu kɔdubɔtɛmi kɔsiaku-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Everyone will hate you because of me. But if you remain faithful until the end, you will be saved.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔdubukisi-mii na ami ɔsu. Nsu si bínye bina bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo kpakplaa bitédu kawɔlɔkɔ ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ-mii ngba.

english_verse: When people mistreat you in one town, hurry to another one. I promise you before you have gone to all the towns of Israel, the Son of Man will come.
translation_verse: Si beekpóku-mii na ɔma unwi kemmo ni, bikeli bisie ɔbambadi kemmo. Na mɔɔsu-mii geen ka bilawɔlɔ bina kabla na Israel lɛma ƒui kemmo asa na ami, Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi, masɔ mebo.

english_verse: Students are not better than their teacher, and slaves are not better than their master.
translation_verse: “Ɔtinane ɔ́ƒɔ lɛnyi útulo nwuna ɔtɛyane. Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi ukyuli lɛlɔ lɛnɔ ni, útulo ukyuli ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔɔdi.

english_verse: It is enough for students to be like their teacher and for slaves to be like their master. If people call the head of the family Satan, what will they say about the rest of the family? The One To Fear (Luke
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, ɔtɛyane biala ɔbla kalɛ na ɔlɛ nwuna ala ɔtinane. Na ukyuli ɔni na baadi lɛlɔ lɛnɔ ni, ɔbla kalɛ na ɔlɛ nwuna Unwoti. Na si bekyuli beedumi ɔtɔlati ɔdi banii ayu ekpidi ɔtɔnkune na ɔdi ni, na badubɔlɔ kaduli kammɔ bekyuli ƒui anyikpi betulo ɔtɔlati ɔmmɔ. Bitayia Bekyuli

english_verse: Don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but they cannot harm your soul. Instead, you should fear God who can destroy both your body and your soul in hell.
translation_verse: Bitayia bekyuli bani na ɔlɔna kani na badubɔkana bɔdu na balakana ukyuli kɔyu aku bɔdu. Mmomu bɛyia Katɔti ɔni ndubɔkana na ɔdu ukyuli kɔyu ku ɔlɔna na lɛgyavonku kemmo.

english_verse: Aren't two sparrows sold for only a penny? But your Father knows when any one of them falls to the ground.
translation_verse: Baasɛ wɛlɛ wɛlɛ bani na akana eye bana inyɔ ku kaplɛ unwi muedi ni, ɔdi ulekpi na Katɔti kama.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted.
translation_verse: Na amii bina lili linwini muedi ni, Katɔti ɔgyi nwuna bumomo ƒui.

english_verse: So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Luke
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bitayia, ɔsika bɛ́ƒɔ kuye bítulo baasɛ pii. Bidie Yesu Kenye Na Kadi Anumi

english_verse: If you tell others you belong to me, I will tell my Father in heaven you are my followers.
translation_verse: “Si ukyuli ɔdi udie lɛlɔ kenye na kadi anumi ka ɔdi mina ɔdi ni, ami lɛnɔ ndubudie-nwu kenye na mina Ɔti anumi na katɔ.

english_verse: But if you reject me, I will tell my Father in heaven you don't belong to me. Not Peace, but Trouble (Luke
translation_verse: Nsu si ukyuli ɔdi úni-mi na kadi anumi ni, ami lɛnɔ ndubuni-nwu na mina Ɔti anumi. Bekyuli Badubule Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Don't think I came to bring peace to the earth! I came to bring trouble, not peace.
translation_verse: “Bitakali bɛnii mina bubo búti keyi kayɔdi búboku kayawi. Oowo! Bekyuli badubɔdɔ na ami ɔsu!

english_verse: I came to turn sons against their fathers, daughters against their mothers, and daughters-in-law against their mothers-in-law.
translation_verse: “Bebi bananabi badubɔta benye bana bati lɛlɔ. Na bebi belekubi badubɔta benye bana beni lɛlɔ. Na bebi bele badubɔta benye bana begyieni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Your worst enemies will be in your own family.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ukisine geen ni, ɔdubɔsi anwu ɔlati nwuna kaduli kemmo.

english_verse: If you love your father or mother or even your sons and daughters more than me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: “Na ukyuli biala ɔni mayɔ ɔti iye uni metulo-mi ni, útamanku ka ɔbla mina ɔtɛyane. Lɛni kani na ukyuli ɔni mayɔ ubidi ɔnanabi iye ulekubi metulo-mi lɛnɔ ni, útamanku ka ɔbla mina ɔtɛyane.

english_verse: And unless you are willing to take up your cross and follow me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala na ulayɔ ka ɔsiaku-mi kama na ubo abi aani ami kalɛ ni, útamanku ka ɔbla mina ɔtɛyane.

english_verse: If you try to save your life, you will lose it. But if you give it up for me, you will surely find it. Rewards (Mark
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔwia ka ulie ngba ute nwuna lɛlɔ ni, ɔdubɔyila-mu. Na ukyuli ɔni nányonu nwuna ngba na ɔsiaku-mi kama ni, ɔdubɔkɛ ngba geen. Katɔti Ɔdubɔƒɔ Kayu Ute Bekyuli Bani Mɔɔƒɔ́ Yesu Basiakune

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes a prophet, just because that person is a prophet, will be given the same reward as a prophet. Anyone who welcomes a good person, just because that person is good, will be given the same reward as a good person.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔni maƒɔ Katɔti kenye udiene ka ɔdi kenye udiene ute Katɔti ɔsu ni, anwu ku kenye udiene ɔmmɔ badubɔkɛ lɛyuƒɔla linwi na Katɔti kudɔ. Na ukyuli ɔni maƒɔ ukyuli ɔni nse siin ka use siin ɔsu ni, anwu ku ukyuli ɔmmɔ badubɔkɛ lɛyuƒɔla linwi na Katɔti kudɔ.

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes you welcomes me. And anyone who welcomes me also welcomes the one who sent me.
translation_verse: “Ukyuli biala ɔni maƒɔ-mii ni, ɔ́ƒɔ ami lɛnɔ. Na ukyuli biala maƒɔ-mi ni, ɔ́ƒɔ Katɔti ɔni nátala-mi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: And anyone who gives one of my most humble followers a cup of cool water, just because that person is my follower, will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Binu ɔmɛni kaduɛ ka ukyuli biala meti ntu ɔɔƒɛɛ mete mina basiakune bamɛni akɔ ubliidi ƒui ka ɔsiaku-mi ɔsu ni, nwuna lɛyuƒɔla lilabɔ-nwu.”

english_verse: As John's followers were going away, Jesus spoke to the crowds about John: What sort of person did you go out into the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yohane batɛyane bammɔ baatɔlɔ mmɔ ni, Yesu ɔ́su Yohane lɛlɔ litemi ɔ́tina bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini, “Ka bísie ketele kemmo ni, bi na bísie bitánu? Evete ani na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uubó taavinku?

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “That man has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: Ɔsika uwi ɔni na Yohane úbo ni, úlie kɔka na útani ntɛ. Na ukyuli biala ɔ́su ɔnii uukpi libuo.

english_verse: After Jesus had finished instructing his twelve disciples, he left and began teaching and preaching in the towns.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni Yesu údie nwuna batɛyane leevu-inyɔ bammɔ ulu ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔ́ta mmɔ na úsie utátina ala na utákɔ lɛsa ute lɛma lɛni nkya amadɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: John was in prison when he heard what Christ was doing. So John sent some of his followers
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Ntu Ɔkpilane Yohane ɔtɛ aban ɔtɔ. Únu kabla kani na Kristo ɔɔbla, na ɔ́tala nwuna batɛyane badi ɔ́kya Yesu.

english_verse: to ask Jesus, “Are you the one we should be looking for? Or must we wait for someone else?”
translation_verse: Na bétéye Yesu banii, “Awɔ ndi ukyuli ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka ɔdubo, munuu butaanu ukyuli bamba ulu?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Go and tell John what you have heard and seen.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Binwini bisie na bitásu Yohane ala ani na biinú ku ani na bɛɛnu ka mɔɔbla.

english_verse: The blind are now able to see, and the lame can walk. People with leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.
translation_verse: Banumbwɛne baanu, na bani náƒɛ bewi kalɔ beesié. Ama bani muuƒi ɔlɛgyie lɛlɔ lɛɛbla sɛɛn na batutine beenú. Bekpine baata na mɔɔkɔ́ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa teete bawabane.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.”
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ litaayɔ bekyuli bani na bana kasusu kalabla inyɔ inyɔ na mina ala ani mɔɔbla ɔsu.”

english_verse: What kind of man did you go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who dress like that live in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Munuu bi na bísie bitánu? Ɔnana ɔni nkya lɛwu lɛni mɔɔdia bɔnu? Oowo, bekyuli bammɔ udu ni, ɔga kesii na beelie.

english_verse: What did you really go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was. I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Bɛsu-mi ukyuli ɔni udu na bísie bítánu! Katɔti kenye udiene ɔdi munuu dɛ? Ɛɛn, na sɔsɔ na ɔdi. Nsu mɔɔsu-mii ka bɛ́nu ukyuli ɔni ntulo kenye udiene muedi.

english_verse: I tell you no one ever born on this earth is greater than John the Baptist. But whoever is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than John.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-mii geen ka Ntu Ɔkpilane Yohane ɔ́ƒɔ kuye utulo ukyuli ɔni nélie kayawi kamɛni úbavi. Nsu ni, ukyuli ɔni nátaƒɔ lɛnyi na Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma muedi ni, ɔ́ƒɔ kuye útulo Yohane ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: From the time of John the Baptist until now, violent people have been trying to take over the kingdom of heaven by force.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si Ntu Ɔkpilane Yohane uwi úbalɛ ɔmwi ni, bekyuli pii báta ku lɛnungyie batáwia Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ɔmmɔ beduo. Nsu bekyuli bani anumi egyie-ma geen lɛti na baanwanɛ lɛlɔ ni, ama ndubuduo mmɔ.

english_verse: And if you believe them, John is Elijah, the prophet you are waiting for.
translation_verse: Na si bɛɛyɔ́ ka bɛƒɔ bana litemi bɛdi ni, Yohane ndi Elia ɔni na básu bése ka webo.

english_verse: You people are like children sitting in the market and shouting to each other,
translation_verse: “Ɔƒɛni ni, bi na ndubuti ɔmwi kadi bekyuli lɛkɔku? Bese aani banamu bani mɔɔƒia na kuye. Na bana bakpana baakpali-ma taasu banii,

english_verse: “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not mourn!”
translation_verse: “ ‘Búdie uleku buti agya búte-mii, nsu bítatɔ. Búdie lɛkwanu búte-mii, nsu bítewulo.’

english_verse: But the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, and you say, “That man eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.” Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what it does. The Unbelieving Towns (Luke
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔni na ami ɔni ndi Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi líbo ni, lɛ́di na lɛ́ni. Na ukyuli biala ɔ́su ɔnii, ‘Bɛnu ɔdivone ɔmɛni! Uukpi ntɛ! Anwu ku kuyi baƒɔne ku bekyuli bekpidi muusié.’ Nsu takpete-ma. Katɔti lɛnunda lɛdubudie lɛlɔ keyi na lɛla lɛni na ukyuli ɔɔbla kemmo.” Lɛma Lɛdi Bekyuli Bátaƒɔ Yesu Bátadi

english_verse: In the towns where Jesus had worked most of his miracles, the people refused to turn to God. So Jesus was upset with them and said:
translation_verse: Na lɛma lɛni kemmo na Yesu ɔ́bla akɔla pii ni, bekyuli bammɔ bétenwini kama bátakya bana ekpidi. Anwuɔsu úse kalɔ na ɔɔdɔnku-ma.

english_verse: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? You will go down to hell! If the miracles that took place in your town had happened in Sodom, it would still be standing.
translation_verse: Na awɔ Kapernaum ni, aakali ka Katɔti ɔdubɔtalaku-ɔ katɔ? Oowo! Katɔti ɔdubɔyulaku-ɔ kalɔ usienku lɛgyavonku kemmo. Ɔsika akɔla budie taatina ani lɛ́bla na bina akɔ ni, si Sodom na lɛ́bla-nya ni, nka ɔmu ɔdi ɔma úbalɛ ɔmwi.

english_verse: So I tell you on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than you. Come to Me and Rest (Luke
translation_verse: Bɛnu ɔmɛni bɛti geen ka limeyi lɛni na Katɔti ɔdubɔtɛku bayawine litemi ni, ɔdubɔnu Sodom kɔnyana utulo awɔ.” Yesu Ɔ́lɔ Bekyuli Ɔnii Babanwuna Na Nwuna Kudɔ

english_verse: At that moment Jesus said: My Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I am grateful that you hid all this from wise and educated people and showed it to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́kpali katɔ ɔnini, “Ati, katɔ ku kalɔ Unwoti, mɔɔgyá-a enu. Éti ala amɛni ábɛla banundane ku bakutine, na édie-nya átina bani nétesie anumi na lɛlati lɛdi kemmo.

english_verse: Yes, Father, this is what pleased you.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ Ati, lɛni na aayɔ́ ka ɔlɛ.”

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who truly knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Mina Ɔti úti ala ƒui úte-mi. Na anwu lɛti ngyi ukyuli ɔni udu na ndi. Na ami lɛti ngyi ukyuli ɔni na mina ɔti lɛnɔ ɔdi. Na mɔɔƒuna bekyuli badi bani na medie-nwu matina.

english_verse: If you are tired from carrying heavy burdens, come to me and I will give you rest.
translation_verse: “Amii bani nti etila bonwu na lɛlɔ líitu-mii ni, bibo-mi kudɔ na ndubɔya na bɛnwuna.

english_verse: Take the yoke I give you. Put it on your shoulders and learn from me. I am gentle and humble, and you will find rest.
translation_verse: Bibo bɔda kɔda, na bɛtɛya bɛsiku-mi kudɔ. Nse buɛɛ na muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ, na bɛdubɔkɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: This yoke is easy to bear, and this burden is light.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kabla kani na mete-mii ni, keeebo ɔkplu. Na mina etila lɛnɔ ese ƒaa ƒaa.”

english_verse: Some Pharisees noticed this and said to Jesus, “Why are your disciples picking grain on the Sabbath? They are not supposed to do this!”
translation_verse: Ƒarisiƒuɔ badi bánu ɔmɛni na básu Yesu banii, “Ƒula batɛyane baabla lɛla lɛni na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bútile kuƒi ka babla na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: The crowds were so amazed they asked, “Could Jesus be the Son of David?”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔ́bla bekyuli bammɔ kalɛ kadi. Na béye banii, “Ɔga Dawid Uwɔ Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ na ɔdi mɛni?”

english_verse: But when I force out demons by the power of God's Spirit, it proves that God's kingdom has already come to you.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi Beelsebul ɔyikun na ɔdi. Mmomu Katɔti Kɔyu néte-mi ɔyikun ɔni na muuti taagya ayu ekpidi taalɛku bekyuli lɛlɔ kemmo. Na ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ kéebo-mii akɔ.

english_verse: Haven't you read in the Law of Moses that the priests are allowed to work in the temple on the Sabbath? But no one says they are guilty of breaking the law of the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ngyi ka bɛ́ka lɛnɔ na ɔda bubo ɔku kemmo ka ina ka bulabla kabla kadi na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ ni, bakpane bani nkya Katɔti kakpakɔ mmɔ beeti bebuo taakpa. Na baladu-ma kɔtɔ.

english_verse: He went into the house of God, and then they ate the sacred loaves of bread that only priests are supposed to eat.
translation_verse: Útéduo Katɔti ɔtɔ kemmo na úti adila ani na béti bákpa béte Katɔti úboku na bádi. Ɔ́bla lɛni ina ka bakpane lɛti pɛ na ɔlɛka badi adila ammɔ.

english_verse: Don't you know what the Scriptures mean when they say, “Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others?” If you knew what this means, you would not condemn these innocent disciples of mine.
translation_verse: Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔsu ɔnii, ‘Kɔnyana bɔnu na ami Katɔti mɔɔwia, na ɔɔɔdi bebuo lɛkpa.’ Si biinú ala amɛni kalɔ ni, nka biládu bekyuli bani na bátaƒiɔ-mii kɔtɔ.

english_verse: Jesus left and went into one of their synagogues,
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ kadi.

english_verse: Then Jesus told the man, “Hold out your hand.” The man did, and it became as healthy as the other one.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su ɔnana ɔni na kɔnu kɔ́gogolo-nwu mmɔ ɔnini, “Nene ƒula kɔnu.” Na únene-ku. Kɔnakunwi ni, kɔnu kɔmmɔ kɔ́sɔ kɔ́bla aani kalɛ na kunyɔdi kɔmmɔ kuse.

english_verse: When Jesus found out what was happening, he left there and large crowds followed him. He healed all of their sick,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu únu ka Ƒarisiƒuɔ beeti-nwu lɛlɔ kasusu kekpidi ni, ɔ́tɔlɔ-ma kudɔ mmɔ, na bekyuli pii badi básiaku-nwu. Ɔ́bwi bani muuƒi ƒui na bana akɔ.

english_verse: but warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́bala-ma ɔnii betedie-nwu keyi.

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as Isaiah the prophet had said,
translation_verse: Ɔ́su lɛni kalɛ na lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́su úse ɔkɛnku nwuna Kenye Udiene Yesaia lɛlɔ ebo ete lɛni sɔsɔ. Ɔ́su ɔnini,

english_verse: “Here is my chosen servant! I love him, and he pleases me. I will give him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: “Ɔmɛni ndi mina kabla ɔblane ɔni na lɛ́ƒuna, na mɔɔyɔ́-nwu. Na mina kayi kasia-nwu lɛlɔ geen. Ndubuti mina Kɔyu lɛkya-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo na wedie litemi bɔtɛ siin keyi watina kadi ƒui.

english_verse: If you are not on my side, you are against me. If you don't gather in the harvest with me, you scatter it.
translation_verse: “Ukyuli ɔni naaasiaku-mi ni, ɔ́ta únye-mi lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli ɔni naaani teede-mi ni, na uukeli-mi.

english_verse: Some people brought to Jesus a man who was blind and could not talk because he had a demon in him. Jesus healed the man, and then he was able to talk and see.
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli badi béti ɔnana ɔdi ɔni na kɔyu kukpidi kuukpóku-nwu na ulákana bɔnu iye ulétemi béboku Yesu kudɔ. Na Yesu ɔ́bɔku kɔyu kɔmmɔ na ɔlɛne ɔmmɔ ɔ́kana na uutemi na ɔɔnu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he said to them: Any kingdom where people fight each other will end up ruined. And a town or family that fights will soon destroy itself.
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́ti bana kasusu na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Lɛga kadikɔ kani néle lɛlɔ akpa akpa ni, kelénye. Na ɔma iye kaduli kani muule lɛlɔ akpa akpa na beekpóku lɛlɔ ni, kaabwɛ.

english_verse: If I use the power of Beelzebul to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? Your followers are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: Na bi ɔsu na bɛɛsu bɛnii Beelsebul ɔyikun kemmo na mɔɔgyá ayu ekpidi taalɛku bekyuli lɛlɔ kemmo? Si use lɛni ni, bɛɛkali ka nwuna ɔyikun kemmo na bina basiakune ama beeti taagya ayu ekpidi taalɛku bekyuli lɛlɔ kemmo? Oowo! Ala ani na bina basiakune baabla mɔɔtina ka bina kakali kaaadia!

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when the demon doesn't find a place,
translation_verse: “Mɔɔsu-mii ka uwi ɔni na bágya kɔyu kukpidi bálɛku ukyuli lɛlɔ kemmo ni, kuusié taavi kesii kani nákwii taawia keliekɔ. Na si útakɛ kadi ni,

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and the person ends up in worse shape than before. That's how it will be with you evil people of today. Jesus' Mother and Brothers (Mark
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, ɔɔsɔ teenwini teesie na utákpanku ayu ekpidi maatɛ ani ntulo-nwu, na bebo bebelie mmɔ. Na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ ablala eebie teetulo kalɛ na ése kudeedi muedi. Ɔmɛni ndububo kaba kekpidi kamɛni lɛlɔ.” Ɔma Ndi Yesu Kaduli Bekyuli Geen?

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit. You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces.
translation_verse: “Ɔdi ka bɛti ka kugyii kɔbuni kɔɔnwu ebi abuni, na kugyii kɔni naaadia kɔɔnwu ebi ani naaadia. Kugyii biala ebi na beeti taanu kugyii kɔmmɔ udu taati.

english_verse: You are a bunch of evil snakes, so how can you say anything good? Your words show what is in your hearts.
translation_verse: Bɛdi bekyuli bekpidi geen aani balakpi! Na ala abuni adi alalɛ-mii kenye! Ala ani nkya ukyuli kasusu kemmo kani na uudie keyi.

english_verse: I promise you on the day of judgment, everyone will have to account for every careless word they have spoken.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyá na ɔbla-mii nwaa ka litemi bɔtɛ limeyi ni, ukyuli biala ɔdubudie lɛlɔ kenye na etemila keeke biala nálɛ-nwu kenye lɛlɔ.

english_verse: On that day they will be told they are either innocent or guilty because of the things they have said. A Sign from Heaven (Mark
translation_verse: Na amii alati etemila na Katɔti ɔdubuti ɔtɛku-mii litemi na ɔdu-mii kɔtɔ iye ute-mii ubo.” Yesu Úni Ɔnii Ulabla Akɔla Budie Taatina Adi

english_verse: Some Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses said, “Teacher, we want you to show us a sign from heaven.”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔda bubo ala batinane ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ badi básu Yesu banii, “Ala ɔtinane, bɔɔwia ka abla akɔla budie taatina adi atina-bu kalɛ na bɔƒɔ-ɔ bɔdi.”

english_verse: But Jesus replied: You want a sign because you are evil and won't believe! But the only sign you will get is the sign of the prophet Jonah.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Bɛnu kalɛ na ɔmwi limeyi kaba bekyuli bebo likyulikpi na balayia Katɔti. Bɛɛwia bɛnii mbla akɔla budie taatina adi, nsu lɛɛɛdubo bɔbla. Akɔla budie taatina ani kani na bɛdubɔnu ndi ani ndaku Katɔti Kenye Udiene Yona.

english_verse: He was in the stomach of a big fish for three days and nights, just as the Son of Man will be deep in the earth for three days and nights.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na Yona ɔ́kya kabɛ kebendi kaƒɔ kemmo emeyi atɛ usien ku ɔƒɛ ni, lɛni kani na Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi lɛnɔ ɔdubɔkya kalɔ kemmo emeyi atɛ usien ku ɔƒɛ.

english_verse: On the day of judgment the people of Nineveh will stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah.
translation_verse: Na litemi bɔtɛ limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Niniweƒuɔ badubɔta bebebo-mii lɛnimi enwu, ɔsika bénwini kama bákya bana ekpidi uwi ɔni na Yona ɔ́kɔ lɛsa úte-ma. Na mɔɔsu-mii ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔkya-mii akɔ mɛni na utulo Yona.

english_verse: The Queen of the South will also stand there with you and condemn you. She traveled a long way to hear Solomon's wisdom, and yet here is something much greater than Solomon. Return of an Evil Spirit (Luke
translation_verse: Na litemi bɔtɛ limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Uleku Ɔga ɔni nási kada kakɛ lɛnɔ ɔdubɔta unye na ubo-mii lɛnimi enwu, ɔsika ɔ́si ɔgyu kakaaka na úsie Ɔga Salomo kudɔ úténu-nwu lɛnunda ala bɔtina. Na mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ukyuli ɔni ntulo Salomo ɔkya mɛni. Kɔyu Kukpidi Kɔɔsɔ Taabawia Keliekɔ

english_verse: it says, “I will go back to the home I left.” When it gets there and finds the place empty, clean, and neat,
translation_verse: kɔɔsu lɛlɔ kɔnii, ‘Ndubɔsɔ linwini nteesie mina kaduli kakukudi kammɔ.’ Na ɔɔsɔ teesie taatánu ka lɛla lɛdi liiibo ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo, nsu bákpala mmɔ na lɛdi biala lise sɛɛn.

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking to the crowds, his mother and brothers came and stood outside because they wanted to talk with him.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ɔkya uutemiku bekyuli bammɔ ni, nwuna banwani ku uni bébo bébenye keyi banii baawia ka batɛmiku-nwu.

english_verse: Someone told Jesus, “Your mother and brothers are standing outside and want to talk with you.”
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli bani nnye mmɔ akɔ unwi útásu Yesu ɔnii, “Nu, ƒ'ini ku ƒula banwani benye keyi ngye baawia ka batɛmiku-ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Who is my mother and who are my brothers?”
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɔma ndi mina uni na ɔma bene ndi mina banwani?”

english_verse: Then he pointed to his disciples and said, “These are my mother and my brothers!
