english_verse: Then he went up on a mountain where he could be alone and pray. Later in the evening, he was still there.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama ni, anwu lɛti ɔ́kɔ úsie kɔbi lili na útákpali katɔ. Na usien ɔmmɔ ƒui ni, anwu lɛti pɛ kani nkya mmɔ.

english_verse: By this time the boat was a long way from the shore. It was going against the wind and was being tossed around by the waves.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ni, na ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ úusie ɔgyu. Na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ubendi ɔni muukpó taasiaku-nwu ɔsu ni, ntu bɔmmɔ buubó ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ taavinku.

english_verse: A little while before morning, Jesus came walking on the water toward his disciples.
translation_verse: Na lɛdigye aani lɛdɔ ɛtɛ ku lɛdɔ ɛku ntɛ ni, Yesu úsie ntu anumi na úbo nwuna batɛyane bammɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: When they saw him, they thought he was a ghost. They were terrified and started screaming.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bánu ka ɔkɛ ntu anumi mmɔ ni, ɔ́gyu-ma ɔtɔtɔ na banii, “Ukpine na ɔdi!” Anwuɔsu bése kalɔ baava momoomo!

english_verse: At once, Jesus said to them, “Don't worry! I am Jesus. Don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu útemiku-ma kɔnakunwi ɔnii, “Bɛkɛ kayi! Ami na ɔdi! Bitayia!”

english_verse: Peter replied, “Lord, if it really is you, tell me to come to you on the water.”
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́su ɔnini, “Si awɔ geen na ɔdi ni, su-mi anii ami lɛnɔ nsie ntu bɔmmɔ anumi na libo-ɔ kudɔ.”

english_verse: At once, Jesus reached out his hand. He helped Peter up and said, “You surely don't have much faith. Why do you doubt?”
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi Yesu únine kɔnu ɔ́da-nwu na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ƒula bɔƒɔtaadi na mina lɛlɔ bútedu! Bi ɔsu na ƒula kasusu kaabla inyɔ inyɔ?”

english_verse: When Jesus and Peter got into the boat, the wind died down.
translation_verse: Na bana inyɔ ƒui bétéduo ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo, na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́da bukpo ɔ́ya.

english_verse: The men in the boat worshiped Jesus and said, “You really are the Son of God!” Jesus Heals Sick People in Gennesaret (Mark
translation_verse: Amu na batɛyane bammɔ bábu-nwu geen. Na básu-nwu banini, “Katɔti Ubidi geen na adi!” Yesu Ɔ́bwi Balɛne Na Genesaret

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples crossed the lake and came to shore near the town of Gennesaret.
translation_verse: Ka bétédu ɛpu ɔmmɔ ɔvi ngye ni, bátáyu na Genesaret kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The people found out he was there, and they sent word to everyone who lived in this part of the country. So they brought all the sick people to Jesus.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, bekyuli bammɔ bánu Yesu báti. Na bébo-nwu kudu kaduɛ. Anwuɔsu bekyuli pii bététiku balɛne bani nkya amadɔ mmɔ ƒui béboku Yesu kudɔ.

english_verse: They begged him just to let them touch his clothes, and everyone who did was healed.
translation_verse: Na balɛne bammɔ bévele-nwu banii ɔya na betuku nwuna awu kɔtu. Na bani ƒui nétuku-nwu awu kɔtu ni, bana lɛlɛ lɛ́ba-ma.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Every plant that my Father in heaven did not plant will be pulled up by the roots.
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Mina ɔti ɔni nkya katɔ ɔdubɔgyu kugyii biala na útalɛ ɔvaakun.

english_verse: “Why don't your disciples obey what our ancestors taught us to do? They don't even wash their hands before they eat.”
translation_verse: “Bi ɔsu na ƒula batɛyane balásiaku bula bati kuuku ɔda bubo kama? Baláƒɔ bana enu kalɛ na bula ɔdi ɔɔtina asa na baadi.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: Why do you disobey God and follow your own teaching?
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Na bi ɔsu na biiní na biládi Katɔti ɔda bubo lɛlɔ na bɛsiaku bina bati kuuku ala bɔtina kama?

english_verse: But you let people get by without helping their parents when they should. You let them say that what they have has been offered to God.
translation_verse: Nsu bɛɛtina ka ukyuli ɔni mbo lɛla lɛni na ɔkana na uti ubunku ɔti iye uni nsu ɔ́su ɔnii, ‘Líti lɛla lɛmɛni líse kenye lite Katɔti’ ni,

english_verse: Is this any way to show respect to your parents? You ignore God's commands in order to follow your own teaching.
translation_verse: ɔ́kɛ kenyekɔ kalɛ na uni na ulabu na ulebunku nwuna bawɔne lɛnɔ. Ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na bɛɛsia teeni Katɔti ɔda bubo kalɛ na bɛsia bina bati bammɔ ala bɔtina kama.

english_verse: It is useless for you to worship me, when you teach rules made up by humans.” What Really Makes People Unclean (Mark
translation_verse: Keeke kani na baabla-mi kabla. Baatina kayawi lɛlɔ ala aani si mina ɔda bubo bɔdi.’ ” Ala Ani Nási Kayi Kemmo Aayá Na Ukyuli Uusé Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Stay away from those Pharisees! They are like blind people leading other blind people, and all of them will fall into a ditch.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bitakpete-ma. Bese aani banumbwɛne bani mɔɔtɔnku banumbwɛne bamba. Na si ɔnumbwɛne ɔtɔnku nwuna ɔkpana ɔnumbwɛne ni, bana inyɔ ƒui badubɔnu beduo ubu kemmo.”

english_verse: Jesus did not say a word. But the woman kept following along and shouting, so his disciples came up and asked him to send her away.
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu útakpete-nwu. Amu na nwuna batɛyane bébo bábasu-nwu banini, “Bɔku-nwu, ɔsika ɔsiaku-bu uutile-bu atu.”

english_verse: The food you put into your mouth doesn't make you unclean and unfit to worship God. The bad words that come out of your mouth are what make you unclean.”
translation_verse: Adila ani muuduo ukyuli kaƒɔ ni, ɔɔɔdi anya mɔɔyá na uusé lɛlɔ. Mmomu etemila ani mɔɔlɛ́ taasi-nwu kenye kemmo mɔɔyá na uusé lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Then his disciples came over to him and asked, “Do you know you insulted the Pharisees by what you said?”
translation_verse: Amu na nwuna batɛyane bammɔ bébo-nwu kudɔ na bábasu-nwu banini, “Agyi ka ala ani na ásu mɛni éduo Ƒarisiƒuɔ bammɔ geen?”

english_verse: Peter replied, “What did you mean when you talked about the things that make people unclean?”
translation_verse: Petro ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Die adila ani muusé lɛlɔ lɛgba lɛmɛni kalɔ tina-bu.”

english_verse: Jesus then said: Don't any of you know by now what I am talking about?
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɔmu use amii lɛnɔ susuusu aani bana kalɛ kani?

english_verse: Don't you know that the food you put into your mouth goes into your stomach and then out of your body?
translation_verse: Binu ɔmɛni kalɔ ka ni, lɛla ndi lɛla lɛni muuduo ukyuli kenye kemmo ni, liiduo kaƒɔ kemmo. Na kama ni, uudie-ni teewiakun.

english_verse: But the words that come out of your mouth come from your heart. And they are what make you unfit to worship God.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, etemila ani mɔɔlɛ́ kenye kemmo ni, ási kayi kemmo. Na anya mɔɔyá na ukyuli uusé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Out of your heart come evil thoughts, murder, unfaithfulness in marriage, vulgar deeds, stealing, telling lies, and insulting others.
translation_verse: Na kasusu kekpidi kani mɔɔyá na bekyuli baadú bekyuli, na baadi kɔsɔnɔ, na baabla lɛyalɛ ala, na beeyú, na baadá bekyuli kenye, na baalɔ bekyuli anyikpi ni, ana ƒui aasí kayi kemmo.

english_verse: These are what make you unclean. Eating without washing your hands will not make you unfit to worship God. A Woman's Faith (Mark
translation_verse: Ala amɛni udu mɔɔyá na ukyuli uusé lɛlɔ. Nsu si ukyuli ɔdi útaƒɔ kɔnu aani kalɛ na Ƒarisiƒuɔ baatina kalɛ asa na ɔ́di ni, ɔmmɔ ulaya na uusé lɛlɔ.” Yesu Ɔ́bwi Uleku Ɔdi Ubidi

english_verse: Jesus said, “I was sent only to the people of Israel! They are like a flock of lost sheep.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Israelƒuɔ bese aani baƒonu bani náyii kalɛ. Na bana kudɔ kani na Katɔti ɔ́tala-mi.”

english_verse: Large crowds came and brought many people who were paralyzed or blind or lame or unable to talk. They placed them, and many others, in front of Jesus, and he healed them all.
translation_verse: Bekyuli pii bébo-nwu kudɔ na badanku balɛne bani ndi bekyuli bani náƒɛ béwi kalɔ ku bani na lɛlɔ ekpo átasa-ma ku banumbwɛne ku bamumu ku bani muuƒi lɛlɛ bamba ƒui bébewi Yesu anumi na ɔ́bwi-ma.

english_verse: Jesus left and went to the territory near the towns of Tyre and Sidon.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́si mmɔ na úsie kalɛkɛ kani nde lɛma linengudi lɛni ndi Tiro ku Sidon.

english_verse: Suddenly a Canaanite woman from there came out shouting, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on me! My daughter is full of demons.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, kalɛkɛ kammɔ uleku ɔdi úbo Yesu kudɔ. Na úvele-nwu ɔnini, “Blɔti, Ɔga Dawid Uwɔ, nu-mi kɔnyana! Kɔyu kukpidi kɔdi kuukpóku mina ubi ulekubi na uubó abi geen!”

english_verse: The woman came closer. Then she knelt down and begged, “Please help me, Lord!”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na uleku ɔmɛni ɔ́lɛ-nwu akɔnkɔ kalɔ na úvele-nwu ɔnini, “Ati, bunku-mi.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “It isn't right to take food away from children and feed it to dogs.”
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɔɔɔdia ka beti bebi adila bebo bewi bana bakpɛwe.”

english_verse: “Lord, this is true,” the woman said, “but even puppies get the crumbs that fall from their owner's table.”
translation_verse: Uleku ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Ati, sɔsɔ na ɔdi. Nsu bakpɛwe lɛnɔ baadi adila kɔkɛ kɔni mɔɔsí bana unwoti kadikɔ teewi kalɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Dear woman, you really do have a lot of faith, and you will be given what you want.” At that moment her daughter was healed. Jesus Heals Many People
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu údie kenye ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Adi uleku ɔni náƒɔ ɔ́di geen! Ákɛ lɛla lɛni na aawia.” Anwuɔsu uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo kani ni, ubidi ulekubi ɔmmɔ ɔlɛ ɔ́ba-nwu. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Bekyuli Pii

english_verse: From there, Jesus went along Lake Galilee. Then he climbed a hill and sat down.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́tɔlɔ mmɔ na ɔkɛ Galilea Ɛpu ɔmmɔ kɔtu útákɔ lɛbinkpo lɛdi na ɔ́yu úlie kalɔ.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed at what they saw and heard. People who had never spoken could now speak. The lame were healed, the paralyzed could walk, and the blind were able to see. Everyone was praising the God of Israel. Jesus Feeds Four Thousand (Mark
translation_verse: Ɔni na bekyuli bammɔ bánu ka bamumu beetemi, na bani na lɛlɔ ekpo átasa-ma ása-ma, na bani náƒɛ bewi kalɔ beesié, na banumbwɛne lɛnɔ baanu ni, ɔ́bla-ma kalɛ kadi. Na bémwi Israel Katɔti. Yesu Úte Nkyuli Mpim Ine Adila Na Bádi

english_verse: Jesus called his disciples together and told them, “I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat. I don't want to send them away hungry. They might faint on their way home.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́lɔ nwuna batɛyane úboku nwuna kudɔ na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Kaƒɔ kaakywí-mi teete bekyuli bamɛni, ɔsika báakya-mi kudɔ emeyi atɛ sɔɔn. Na ɔƒaani ni, basɔ beeebo lɛla lɛdi na badi. Naaayɔ nnii muudie-ma ulu ku kɔka. Anumi adubɔvinku-ma si bakɛ ulu.”

english_verse: His disciples said, “This place is like a desert. Where can we find enough food to feed such a crowd?”
translation_verse: Nwuna batɛyane béye-nwu banini, “Wɛ na bɔdubɔkɛ adila na ketele kemmo mɛni bute bekyuli pii bamɛni na udu-ma?”

english_verse: Jesus asked them how much food they had. They replied, “Seven small loaves of bread and a few little fish.”
translation_verse: Yesu úye-ma ɔnii, “Adila adi ese?” Na básu-nwu banii, “Bodobodo maatɛ ku kɔkpaku blii suɛ kani nse.”

english_verse: After Jesus had told the people to sit down,
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su bana ƒui ɔnii basɔ belie kalɔ.

english_verse: he took the seven loaves of bread and the fish and gave thanks. He then broke them and handed them to his disciples, who passed them around to the crowds.
translation_verse: Na úti bodobodo maatɛ ku kɔkpaku kɔmmɔ na ɔ́gya Katɔti enu, na ɔ́bwɛ ɔdi biala kɔkɛ kɔkɛ na úti úte nwuna batɛyane. Na ama lɛnɔ béle-nwu béte bekyuli bammɔ.

english_verse: Everyone ate all they wanted, and the leftovers filled seven large baskets.
translation_verse: Na bana ƒui bádi na bémo. Amu na batɛyane bamɛni básala adila kɔkɛ kɔni na bádi bébu ƒui na kúyi kɔgyigyɛ maatɛ.

english_verse: After Jesus had sent the crowds away, he got into a boat and sailed across the lake. He came to shore near the town of Magadan.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie bekyuli bammɔ ulu na úduo ɔkɔlɔ kemmo na ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie Magadan kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't you know by now that I am not talking to you about bread? Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees!
translation_verse: Dɛ na ɔ́bla na bilenu kalɔ bɛnii ɔɔɔdi adila lɛlɔ litemi na mɔɔsu uwi ɔni na lɛ́su nnii, ‘Bɛnu kaduɛ na Ƒarisiƒuɔ ku Sadukiƒuɔ bɔnyii bɔni baakya ala kemmo na uuƒu lɛlɔ’?”

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples were near the town of Caesarea Philippi, he asked them, “What do people say about the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane bésie kalɛkɛ kani nde Kaesarea Ƒilipi amadɔ. Mmɔ na úye nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Ɔma na bekyuli baasu banii ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ndi?”

english_verse: Finally, the disciples understood that Jesus wasn't talking about the yeast used to make bread, but about the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees. Who Is Jesus? (Mark
translation_verse: Mmɔ asa na ɔ́bla batalane bammɔ nwaa ka ɔɔɔdi bɔnyii bɔni baakya ala kemmo na uuƒu lɛlɔ ɔda na uubó-ma. Mmomu ni, ala ani na Ƒarisiƒuɔ ku Sadukiƒuɔ baatina na ɔda. Petro Údie Kenye Ka Yesu Ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi Ɔmmɔ

english_verse: He told them: If the sky is red in the evening, you say the weather will be good.
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Si ɔƒɛ úsela kanukɔ na kayaa kégyie ni, bɛɛsu bɛnii kadi kadubo bɔdia kɔnaadi.

english_verse: But if the sky is red and gloomy in the morning, you say it is going to rain. You can tell what the weather will be like by looking at the sky. But you don't understand what is happening now.
translation_verse: Na ɔtanta tutuutu si ɔƒɛ ɔ́tu ɔdubo na kadi kese suu ni, bɛɛsu bɛnii ɔnantu ɔdubo bɔna. Bɛɛkana na bɛɛtí kalɛ na kadi kadubo buse si bɛ́nu kayaa. Nsu bilákana na bɛnu ala ani mɔɔtina uwi ɔni na Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ ɔdububo bɛti!

english_verse: The disciples answered, “Some people say you are John the Baptist or maybe Elijah or Jeremiah or some other prophet.”
translation_verse: Bédie kenye banii, “Badi banii awɔ ndi Ntu Ɔkpilane Yohane. Na badi lɛnɔ banii awɔ ndi Katɔti Kenye Udiene Elia. Na babambadi lɛnɔ baasu banii awɔ ndi Yeremia iye Katɔti kenye bediene bammɔ akɔ ɔbambadi ɔdi.”

english_verse: From then on, Jesus began telling his disciples what would happen to him. He said, “I must go to Jerusalem. There the nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses will make me suffer terribly. I will be killed, but three days later I will rise to life.”
translation_verse: Ɔ́si uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Yesu úse kalɔ ɔɔsu nwuna batɛyane bammɔ nwaa ɔnii, “Ɔlɛka lisie Yerusalem na ntébo abi na kadi benengu ku bakpane benengu ku ɔda bubo ala batinane enu kemmo. Badubɔdu-mi. Nsu limeyi lɛtɛdi lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔgyila-mi ɔlɛku kekpine na nsɔ mbelie ngba.”

english_verse: Jesus then warned them, “Watch out! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛnu kaduɛ na Ƒarisiƒuɔ ku Sadukiƒuɔ bɔnyii bɔni baakya ala kemmo na uuƒu lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: The disciples talked this over and said to each other, “He must be saying this because we didn't bring along any bread.”
translation_verse: Amu na bése kalɔ beeye lɛlɔ banii, “Ɔni na búteti adila adi bɔɔɔda ɔsu na ɔɔsu ɔmɛni?”

english_verse: The Son of Man will soon come in the glory of his Father and with his angels to reward all people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ami ɔni ndi Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ndububo ku Katɔti batu na Katɔti ɔyikun kemmo. Na ndubɔƒɔ ukyuli biala kayu na nwuna kabla kenye.

english_verse: So I will call you Peter, which means “a rock.” On this rock I will build my church, and death itself will not have any power over it.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu mɔɔsu-ɔ ka awɔ ndi Petro ɔni kalɔ ndi lɛtakpɛ. Na lɛtakpɛ lɛmɛni lɛlɔ na ndubuti mina baƒɔtaadine lɛtu linyine aani ɔtɔ kalɛ. Na kukpi ɔyikun muedi ulakana-ma lɛlɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “But who do you say I am?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye-ma ɔnini, “Na amii nɔɔ? Ɔma na bɛɛsu ka ami ndi?”

english_verse: Simon Peter spoke up, “You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Simon Petro údie kenye ɔnini, “Awɔ ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ. Na adi Katɔti ɔni nli ngba uwi ƒui Ubidi.”

english_verse: Jesus told him: Simon, son of Jonah, you are blessed! You didn't discover this on your own. It was shown to you by my Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Lɛlɔ litaayɔ awɔ, Simon, Yona ubidi. Ɔsika ɔɔɔdi ɔyawine nédie litemi geen lɛmɛni ɔ́tina-a. Mmomu mina Ɔti ɔni nkya katɔ nédie ɔ́tina-a.

english_verse: I will give you the keys to the kingdom of heaven, and God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth. But he will not allow anything you don't allow.
translation_verse: Na ndubuti Katɔti lɛga bɔdi ɔyikun lite-ɔ. Na lɛla lɛni na bɛdubɔƒɛnimi na kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔsia-ni kɔnu. Na lɛla lɛni na bɛdubɔnyonu na kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔsia ani lɛnɔ kɔnu.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples not to tell anyone he was the Messiah. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Mark
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úbo nwuna batɛyane ɔda ɔnii, “Bitasu ukyuli ɔdi bɛnii ami ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ.” Yesu Ɔ́tɛmi Ɔ́siku Nwuna Lɛbibo Ku Kukpi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that. He said, “God would never let this happen to you, Lord!”
translation_verse: Petro ɔ́da-nwu úsienku kɔmadɔ na ɔ́dɔnku-nwu. Na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Pɛ kuse Blɔti! Tuo lisuo lɛmmɔ wiakun! Ɔmmɔ utebo-ɔ lɛlɔ kudii!”

english_verse: Jesus turned to Peter and said, “Satan, get away from me! You're in my way because you think like everyone else and not like God.”
translation_verse: Yesu únwini kɔnakunwi ɔ́su Petro ɔnini, “Satan! Gyu tɔlɔ-mi lɛlɔ! Éti lɛlɔ eenwíni ukisine na mina lɛlɔ. Aayɔ́ akpanku-mi atákya likpidi kemmo! Kasusu kani na éti mɛni kátasi Katɔti kudɔ. Mmomu bekyuli kasusu kadi.”

english_verse: Then Jesus said to his disciples: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔwia ka ɔsiaku-mi kama ni, ɔlɛka udie nwuna lɛlɔ atu na ubo abi na ɔsiaku-mi kama.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will find it.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔwia ka ɔƒɔ nwuna lili ngba ute lɛlɔ ni, ɔdubɔyila-mu. Na ukyuli biala ɔni nányonu nwuna ngba ka ɔsiaku-mi kama ni, ɔdubɔkɛ ngba geen.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself? What would you give to get back your soul?
translation_verse: Bi kɔsia na ukyuli ɔdubɔkɛ si ɔ́kɛ kayawi ala ƒui na ɔ́yila ngba geen bɔmmɔ. Munuu bi na ukyuli ubo na uti ɔvumana na ɔkɛ ngba geen bɔmmɔ?

english_verse: I promise you some of those standing here will not die before they see the Son of Man coming with his kingdom.
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii nwaa ka ni, bekyuli badi bakya mɛni ɔni na belekpi watálɛ uwi ɔni na bánu ka Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi úbo aani ɔga kalɛ.”

english_verse: There in front of the disciples, Jesus was completely changed. His face was shining like the sun, and his clothes became white as light.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ka baanu ni, kavumana kadi kébo Yesu lɛlɔ. Nwuna anumi eekeye aani ɔƒɛ, na nwuna adala lɛnɔ eekeye na aatu anumi.

english_verse: Then the disciples understood Jesus was talking to them about John the Baptist. Jesus Heals a Boy (Mark
translation_verse: Mmɔ na batɛyane bammɔ báti ka Ntu Ɔkpilane Yohane na ɔda. Yesu Ɔ́bɔku Kɔyu Kukpidi Kɔdi Ɔ́lɛku Ɔnanabi Ɔdi Lɛlɔ Kemmo

english_verse: Six days later Jesus took Peter and the brothers James and John with him. They went up on a very high mountain where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Emeyi aku kama ni, Yesu útiku Petro ku Yakobo ku ɔnwani Yohane úsienku kɔbi kɔdi nákuku lili. Na bátákya mmɔ ama lɛti.

english_verse: All at once Moses and Elijah were there talking with Jesus.
translation_verse: Amu na batɛyane ɛtɛ bamɛni bánu Mose ku Elia ka baatɛmiku Yesu.

english_verse: So Peter said to him, “Lord, it is good for us to be here! Let us make three shelters, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
translation_verse: Na Petro ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Blɔti, ɔdia si bɔ́sɔ bɔkya mɛni! Si átuna ni, ndubɔtu nvo ɛtɛ. Ƒula kadi kenwi ku Mose kadi kenwi ku Elia lɛnɔ kadi kenwi.”

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the shadow of a bright cloud passed over them. From the cloud a voice said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ɔɔsu ɔmɛni ni, ulɔyɔ ɔni muukeye úbewi-ma lɛlɔ. Na bénu Katɔti lɛdi na ulɔyɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo na lɛ́su lɛnini, “Ɔmɛni ndi mina ubi ɔyɔne unwi pɛ ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mi anu geen. Binu-nwu litemi.”

english_verse: When the disciples heard the voice, they were so afraid they fell flat on the ground.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na batɛyane ɛtɛ bamɛni bénu lɛdi lɛmɛni ni, liƒu lɛ́da-ma geen na báyu bébi kalɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus came over and touched them. He said, “Get up and don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Yesu úbo-ma kudɔ na úbetuku-ma na ɔ́su-ma ɔnii, “Bɛta binye. Bɛsɔ bitayia.”

english_verse: When they opened their eyes, they saw only Jesus.
translation_verse: Amu ka bákɔliku anumi katɔ ni, bátanu ukyuli ɔdi ntu Yesu kani.

english_verse: The disciples asked Jesus, “Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say Elijah must come before the Messiah does?”
translation_verse: Amu na batɛyane bammɔ béye Yesu banii, “Bi ɔsu na ɔda bubo ala batinane baasu banii ɔlɛka Elia ɔka bubo asa na ala amɛni abalɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Elijah certainly will come and get everything ready.
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka Elia ɔka bubo na ubaklibi lɛla biala use.

english_verse: In fact, he has already come. But the people did not recognize him and treated him just as they wanted to. They will soon make the Son of Man suffer in the same way.”
translation_verse: Nsu mɔɔsu-mii nnii Elia úubo, nsu bekyuli bátanu-nwu bátati. Na bábla-nwu kalala kalɛ na baayɔ́. Lɛni kani na badubɔbla ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi lɛnɔ kalala.”

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples returned to the crowd. A man knelt in front of him
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane báyu bébo bekyuli pii bammɔ kudɔ ni, ɔnana ɔdi úbo Yesu kudɔ na úbalɛ-nwu akɔnkɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: and said, “Lord, have pity on my son! He has a bad case of epilepsy and often falls into a fire or into water.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ati, nu mina ubi ɔnanabi ɔmɛni kɔnyana. Uuƒi kalɛ teebo na uubó abi geen. Uwi pii ni, uubuli teeduo ɔgya kemmo ku ntu kemmo lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I brought him to your disciples, but none of them could heal him.”
translation_verse: Líti-nwu líboku ƒula batɛyane, nsu bátakana na babwi-nwu.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You people are too stubborn to have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy here.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Amii, ɔmwi limeyi bekyuli, bi ɔsu na bilaƒɔ-mi taadi na bɛɛyu atu ɔkplu? Uwi ɛlɛ sɔɔn na ndubɔkɛku-mii kayi? Naaakana na makya-mii kudɔ uwi biala! Biti ɔnamu ɔmmɔ biboku-mi mɛni!”

english_verse: Then Jesus spoke sternly to the demon. It went out of the boy, and right then he was healed.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́bɔku kɔyu kukpidi kɔni nli ɔnamu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kemmo na kɔ́lɛ! Na ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́ba-nwu kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: Later the disciples went to Jesus in private and asked him, “Why couldn't we force out the demon?”
translation_verse: Amu na batɛyane bammɔ bébo Yesu kudɔ na bébeye-nwu banii, “Bi ɔsu na bútakana kɔyu kukpidi kɔmmɔ bɔbɔku bɔlɛku?”

english_verse: While Jesus and his disciples were going from place to place in Galilee, he told them, “The Son of Man will be handed over to people
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na batɛyane bammɔ ƒui bábasa na Galilea ni, Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Badubo ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi buti bɔkya bekyuli enu kemmo,

english_verse: who will kill him. But three days later he will rise to life.” All of this made the disciples very sad. Paying the Temple Tax
translation_verse: na badu-mi. Na emeyi atɛ kama ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔgyila-mi ɔsiku bekpine akɔ.” Mmɔ ni, batɛyane bammɔ enu áƒɛ-ma. Béyi Kuyi Na Katɔti Kakpakɔ

english_verse: When Jesus and the others arrived in Capernaum, the collectors for the temple tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your teacher pay the temple tax?”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane bébo bébeduo Kapernaum ni, Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ kuyi baƒɔne bébeye Petro banii, “Bina ala ɔtinane lɛnɔ uuyi kakpakɔ kuyi kɔmmɔ?”

english_verse: “Yes, he does,” Peter answered. After they had returned home, Jesus went up to Peter and asked him, “Simon, what do you think? Do the kings of this earth collect taxes and fees from their own people or from foreigners?”
translation_verse: Petro údie kenye ɔnii, “Uuyi nii!” Amu ka Petro útéduo bana kaduli ni, mmɔ kani na Yesu ɔ́ka-nwu buye ɔnini, “Simon, bi ndi ƒula kasusu? Ɔma bene na ɔlɛka baƒɔ kuyi bete baga na kayawi kamɛni? Kalɔ kammɔ bekyuli munuu baƒɔ?”

english_verse: Peter answered, “From foreigners.” Jesus replied, “Then their own people don't have to pay.
translation_verse: Na Petro údie kenye ɔnini, “Baƒɔ.” Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka kalɔ kammɔ bekyuli ama útalɛka baƒɔ ɔdi.

english_verse: But we don't want to cause trouble. So go cast a line into the lake and pull out the first fish you hook. Open its mouth, and you will find a coin. Use it to pay your taxes and mine.”
translation_verse: Nsu ka bulayɔ bɔnii bɔɔƒiɔ́ ukyuli ɔdi ɔsu ni, teesie ɛpu kɔtu na atátu ɔdaa. Na kabɛ kedeedi kani na adubɔni alɛku ni, adubɔnu ligulabi lɛdi na nwuna kenye lɛni ndubudu ami ku-ɔ kakpakɔ kuyi bɔƒɔ. Die-ni, na atáƒɔ-ma bula kuyi kayu.”

english_verse: If your eye causes you to sin, poke it out and get rid of it. You would be better off to go into life with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fires of hell. The Lost Sheep (Luke
translation_verse: Na si ƒula lɛnumi mɔɔyá-a na aabla likpidi ni, die-ni vaakun. Ɔdia ute-ɔ si ebo lɛnumi linwi na akɛ ngba ƒui utulo ka Katɔti uti-ɔ utákya lɛgyavonku kemmo. Yesu Ɔ́tina Ala Na Koƒonu Kɔni Náyii Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Don't you think you should show pity to someone else, as I did to you?”
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na ɔdi ka awɔ lɛnɔ anu ƒula ɔkpana kɔnyana aani kalɛ na lɛ́nu-ɔ kɔnyana.’

english_verse: But if you are as humble as this child, you are the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni náƒɔ kuye utulo ƒui na Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ni, anwu ndi ukyuli ɔni néboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na únwini aani ɔnamu ɔmɛni udu.

english_verse: And when you welcome one of these children because of me, you welcome me. Temptations To Sin (Mark
translation_verse: “Na ukyuli ɔni maƒɔ ɔnamu blii suɛ aani ɔmɛni udu na mina lɛnyi kemmo ni, ɔ́ƒɔ ami lɛnɔ.

english_verse: If the follower refuses to listen to them, report the matter to the church. Anyone who refuses to listen to the church must be treated like an unbeliever or a tax collector. Allowing and Not Allowing
translation_verse: Na si mmɔ lɛnɔ útenu kalɔ ni, ya na baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ bati. Na si mmɔ lɛnɔ útenu lɛlɔ kalɔ ni, die-nwu atu aani ukyuli ɔni na útaƒɔ útadi iye likpidi ɔblane ɔni na útenwini kayi.

english_verse: It will be terrible for people who cause even one of my little followers to sin. Those people would be better off thrown into the deepest part of the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their necks!
translation_verse: Nsu si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́ya na banamu bamɛni akɔ ɔdi únwini kama ɔ́kya nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi na mina lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔni-nwu kɔtu geen utulo si béti kukɔ bonwu báƒala-nwu ɔkwɛ na bátányina-nwu ɛpu kemmo.

english_verse: If your hand or foot causes you to sin, chop it off and throw it away! You would be better off to go into life paralyzed or lame than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into the fire that never goes out.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si ƒula kɔnu iye ƒula ɔgba mɔɔyá na aabla likpidi ni, kulo-ku vaakun. Ɔdia ute-ɔ si ebo kɔnu kunwi iye ɔgba unwi na ákɛ ngba ƒui utulo ka ebo enu ku lɛgba na Katɔti uti-ɔ ɔkya lɛgyavonku kemmo.

english_verse: If one of my followers sins against you, go and point out what was wrong. But do it in private, just between the two of you. If that person listens, you have won back a follower.
translation_verse: “Si ɔƒɔtaadine ɔkpana ɔ́ƒiɔ-ɔ ni, sie-nwu kudɔ na etédie atina-nwu ka ɔ́ƒiɔ-ɔ. Na ya na ɔmɛni ɔbla bina inyɔ ntɛ lɛti kɔtɛ. Si únu kalɔ ni, awɔ ku-nwu bɛsɔ bilie kɔnwa ku kɔnwa.

english_verse: Don't be cruel to any of these little ones! I promise you their angels are always with my Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi úbo ɔnii ubaƒɔ bekyuli bani náyii ngba geen ulu ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: I am sure that finding it would make you happier than having the
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-mii nnii si ɔ́nu-ku ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-nwu na kuna lɛlɔ utulo baƒonu liti ku aavlene-yaalenwi bani nátayii mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: That's how it is with your Father in heaven. He doesn't want any of these little ones to be lost. When Someone Sins (Luke
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na bina ɔti ɔni nkya katɔ ulawia ka banamu wɛlɛ wɛlɛ bamɛni ɔdi ɔyii. Ɔƒɔtaadine Ɔkpana Ɔni Náƒiɔ-ɔ Ni, Vinku-nwu Ulu Lɛlɔ

english_verse: But if that one refuses to listen, take along one or two others. The Scriptures teach that every complaint must be proven true by two or more witnesses.
translation_verse: Nsu si útenu lɛlɔ kalɔ ni, ya na ukyuli unwi iye ɛlɛɛ benuku-ɔ litemi lɛmmɔ aani kalɛ na bénweni na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ka akɛ nkyuli inyɔ iye ɛtɛ na benye-ɔ litemi kama.

english_verse: I promise you God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth, but God will not allow anything you don't allow.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu mɔɔsu bina ƒui nnii lɛla lɛni lɛlɔ na bitile kuƒi na kayawi mɛni ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔsia ani lɛnɔ kɔnu. Na lɛla lɛni lɛlɔ na bite kuƒi na kayawi mɛni ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔsia-ni kɔnu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I promise that when any two of you on earth agree about something you are praying for, my Father in heaven will do it for you.
translation_verse: “Na nsɔ mɔɔsu-mii lɛnɔ nnii si bina inyɔ bɛ́bla kenye kenwi na kayawi mɛni na bɛ́sala bivele lɛla lɛdi ni, mina ɔti ɔni nkya katɔ ɔdubɔbla-ni ute-mii.

english_verse: Whenever two or three of you come together in my name, I am there with you. An Official Who Refused To Forgive
translation_verse: Ɔsika kesii kani na nkyuli inyɔ iye ɛtɛ bása na mina lɛnyi kemmo ni, ami lɛnɔ nkya-ma akɔ.” Ɔlɛka Buteeti Bula Baƒɔtaadine Bakpana Bɔƒiɔ Taakyiɛ-ma Uwi Biala

english_verse: Peter came up to the Lord and asked, “How many times should I forgive someone who does something wrong to me? Is seven times enough?”
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́kpɛ úde Yesu na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Blɔti, si mina ɔƒɔtaadine ɔkpana ɔɔƒiɔ́-mi ni, kɔlɛ na ɔdi ka liti lɛkyiɛ-nwu? Nti nkyiɛ-nwu laa maatɛ?”

english_verse: This story will show you what the kingdom of heaven is like: One day a king decided to call in his officials and ask them to give an account of what they owed him.
translation_verse: “Ɔmɛni ɔsu na Katɔti lɛga bɔdi buse aani ɔga ɔni náwia ka ɔbuku nwuna bekyuli bani mɔɔbla-nwu kabla akunta.

english_verse: As he was doing this, one official was brought in who owed him
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na úse kalɔ kani na béti ɔnana ɔdi ɔni nda-nwu lɛlakɛ bonwu kayu béboku.

english_verse: But he didn't have any money to pay what he owed. The king ordered him to be sold, along with his wife and children and all he owned, in order to pay the debt.
translation_verse: Na ka ɔnana ɔmmɔ uuubo lɛla lɛni na ɔkana kayu kammɔ bɔƒɔ ɔsu ni, ɔga ɔmmɔ údie lɛdi ɔnii beti anwu ku ulekudi ku nwuna bebi ku ala ani ƒui na ubo beye na baƒɔ kayu kammɔ.

english_verse: The official got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you every cent I owe!”
translation_verse: “Mmɔ na ɔnana ɔmɛni ɔ́lɛ ɔga ɔmmɔ akɔnkɔ kalɔ na úvele-nwu ɔnini, ‘Kɛku-mi kayi na ndubɔƒɔ-ɔ kana ƒui!’

english_verse: The king felt sorry for him and let him go free. He even told the official that he did not have to pay back the money.
translation_verse: Ɔnana ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ lɛ́kywi ɔga ɔmmɔ kaƒɔ, anwuɔsu úti kayu kammɔ ƒui ɔ́kyiɛ-nwu na ɔ́nyonu-nwu na ɔ́tɔlɔ.

english_verse: The man got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you back.”
translation_verse: “Na nwuna ɔkpana ɔmmɔ úvele-nwu ɔnini, ‘Kɛku-mi kayi na ndubɔƒɔ-ɔ kana ƒui!’

english_verse: But the first official refused to have pity. Instead, he went and had the other official put in jail until he could pay what he owed.
translation_verse: “Nsu úbulo na ɔ́ya na bákya-nwu ɔtɔ watálɛ uwi ɔni na wakana kayu kammɔ ƒui bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: When some other officials found out what had happened, they felt sorry for the man who had been put in jail. Then they told the king what had happened.
translation_verse: Na ka nwuna kabla bablane bakpana bánu lɛla lɛni nálɛ ni, kasusu kékpoku-ma na bésie bátásu ɔga ɔmmɔ ala ani ƒui nébo.

english_verse: The king called the first official back in and said, “You're an evil man! When you begged for mercy, I said you did not have to pay back a cent.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔ́tala na bátálɔ kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ béboku na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Ukyuli ukpidi na adi. Ka évele-mi anii nti nkyiɛ-ɔ ni, líti lɛla lɛdi biala lɛ́kyiɛ-ɔ.

english_verse: The king was so angry that he ordered the official to be tortured until he could pay back everything he owed.
translation_verse: Na ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔ́kɛ kɔnyi geen na úti-nwu úte ɔnii bakya-nwu ɔtɔ na bani-nwu kɔtu utédu uwi ɔni na waƒɔ kayu kammɔ ƒui.”

english_verse: That is how my Father in heaven will treat you, if you don't forgive each of my followers with all your heart.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́wɔlɔ kɔtɛ kɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Lɛni kani na mina Ɔti ɔni nkya katɔ ɔdubɔbla bina akɔ ɔdi biala si biléti taakyiɛ bina baƒɔtaadine bakpana ɔ́si bina kayi kemmo ƒui.”

english_verse: When Jesus finished teaching, he left Galilee and went to the part of Judea east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́su ala amɛni ƒui ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔ́tɔlɔ Galilea na úsie Yudea kalɛkɛ na Yordan Ketu ɔvi.

english_verse: Some people are unable to marry because of birth defects or because of what someone has done to their bodies. Others stay single in order to serve God better. Anyone who can accept this teaching should do so.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Mark
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛla lɛni ɔsu na banana beléti beleku lɛdanku kasusu lidu lidu. Badi ni, lɛni na báwɔ-ma. Na badi ama ni, bekyuli nábla-ma lɛni. Na badi lɛnɔ ni, beléti beleku ɔsika baawia ka belie ngba bataabla Katɔti lɛga bɔdi kabla ɔsu. Si bɛkana ni, bitaabla lɛla lɛni na lɛ́su mɛni.” Béti Banamu Béboku Yesu Kudɔ

english_verse: Large crowds followed him, and he healed their sick.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli pii badi básiaku-nwu kama na ɔ́bwi-ma lɛlɛ na mmɔ.

english_verse: Some Pharisees wanted to test Jesus. They came up to him and asked, “Is it right for a man to divorce his wife for just any reason?”
translation_verse: Amu na Ƒarisiƒuɔ badi bésie-nwu kudɔ banii bétéwi-nwu kenye benu. Na béye-nwu banini, “Mose ɔda bubo úte kuƒi ka ɔnana ɔsia kasusu biala lɛlɔ na ɔnyonu ulekudi?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Don't you know in the beginning the Creator made a man and a woman?
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Bítaka na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ka kalɔ kesekɔ ni, Katɔti údie ɔnana ku uleku?

english_verse: That's why a man leaves his father and mother and gets married. He becomes like one person with his wife.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, ‘Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, ɔnana ɔdubɔmami ɔti ku uni lɛlɔ na uti lɛlɔ utámana ulekudi na bana inyɔ babla ɔlɔna unwi.’

english_verse: Then they are no longer two people, but one. And no one should separate a couple God has joined together.”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, basɔ baaadi nkyuli inyɔ. Mmomu bénwini ukyuli unwi. Anwuɔsu útalɛka ukyuli ugyingya lɛla lɛni na Katɔti úti ɔ́sala.”

english_verse: The Pharisees asked Jesus, “Why did Moses say a man could write out divorce papers and send his wife away?”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Ƒarisiƒuɔ bammɔ básu-nwu banii, “Amu na bi ɔsu na Mose úte kuƒi ɔnii ɔnana ute ulekudi ɔku ka ɔnyonu-nwu na udie-nwu ulu?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You are so heartless! That's why Moses allowed you to divorce your wife. But from the beginning God did not intend it to be that way.
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Mose úte-mii kuƒi ɔnii bɛnyonu bina beleku na bina atu ɔkplu ɔsu. Nsu ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ ni, na uuuse lɛni.

english_verse: I say if your wife has not committed some terrible sexual sin, you must not divorce her to marry someone else. If you do, you are unfaithful.”
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, mɔɔsu-mii nnii si ɔnana ɔdi ɔ́nyonu ulekudi na ɔɔɔdi kɔsɔnɔ na ɔ́di asa na útéti uleku ɔbambadi ni, ɔ́di kɔsɔnɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Only those people who have been given the gift of staying single can accept this teaching.
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɔɔɔdi ukyuli biala ndubɔkana na ɔbla ala ani na bɛɛsu mɛni, amu ntu bekyuli bani na Katɔti úte-ma kani.

english_verse: Some people brought their children to Jesus, so he could place his hands on them and pray for them. His disciples told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badi béti banamu béboku Yesu kudɔ banii uti enu ɔsia-ma lɛlɔ na ɔkpali katɔ ute-ma. Nsu ni, nwuna batɛyane bádɔnku bekyuli bammɔ.

english_verse: A man came to Jesus and asked, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Na uwi bamba kemmo ni, okloƒu ɔdi úbo Yesu kudɔ na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Ɔtinane, bi ndia na ɔlɛka lɛbla asa na Katɔti ute-mi ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii?”

english_verse: “Which ones?” the man asked. Jesus answered, “Do not murder. Be faithful in marriage. Do not steal. Do not tell lies about others.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔnana ɔmmɔ úye-nwu ɔnini, “Ɔda bubo bɔmani?” Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Tadu ukyuli, tadi kɔsɔnɔ, teyu, tada ƒula ukyulikpana kenye,

english_verse: After Jesus had placed his hands on the children, he left. A Rich Young Man (Mark
translation_verse: Yesu úti nwuna enu ɔ́sia-ma lɛlɔ na ɔ́kpali katɔ úte-ma. Nwuna kama ni, ɔ́tɔlɔ. Ɔdubɔyu Balakɛne Ɔkplu Asa Na Beduo Katɔti Lɛga Kadikɔ

english_verse: Jesus said to him, “Why do you ask me about what is good? Only God is good. If you want to have eternal life, you must obey his commandments.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Lɛla lɛni ndia na ɔlɛka babla lɛlɔ litemi na eeye-mi? Katɔti lɛti pɛ ndia. Na si aayɔ́ anii Katɔti ute-ɔ ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii ni, di nwuna ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Let the children come to me, and don't try to stop them! People who are like these children belong to God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su batɛyane bammɔ ɔnini, “Bɛya na banamu bammɔ bebo-mi kudɔ na bitetile-ma kuƒi. Ɔsika Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ kese kete bekyuli bani néboku lɛlɔ kalɔ aani banamu bamɛni udu kalɛ.”

english_verse: But many who are now first will be last, and many who are last will be first.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, bekyuli pii bani ntɔ ɔƒɛni ni, badubɔvi bakpɛ kama. Na bani nkpɛ kama ɔƒɛni ni, badubɔvi batɔ.”

english_verse: Respect your father and mother. And love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: bu ƒula ɔti ku ƒula uni, na ayɔ ƒula ukyulikpana aani ƒula lɛlɔ kalɛ.”

english_verse: The young man said, “I have obeyed all of these. What else must I do?”
translation_verse: Amu na okloƒu ɔmɛni údie kenye ɔnini, “Lɛ́ɛdi ɔmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Bi lɛnɔ násɔ ébu na lɛbla?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If you want to be perfect, go sell everything you own! Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come and be my follower.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Si aayɔ́ anii aabla sɛɛn awɔlɔ ƒui ni, sie na etéti ala ani ƒui na ébo eye. Na eti egulabi ammɔ ete bawabane, na adubɔkɛ lɛyuƒɔla na katɔ. Ɔmmɔ kama asa na ebo abasiaku-mi kama.”

english_verse: When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Nsu ka okloƒu ɔmmɔ únu lɛla lɛmɛni ni, ebiti átada-nwu na ɔ́gyu ɔ́tɔlɔ, ɔsika ubo egulabi pii.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “I tell you, it's terribly hard for rich people to get into the kingdom of heaven!
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-mii nwaa nnii ɔdubɔyu balakɛne ɔkplu asa na beduo Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ.

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Nsɔ mɔɔsia kama lɛsu-mii nnii úse ubo ɔlakɛne ɔkplu geen asa na wakana na weduo Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ utulo kalɛ na ebuo ɔni nébomo utulo ƒui ɔvi udila liƒi.”

english_verse: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly surprised and asked, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na batɛyane bammɔ bénu ɔmɛni ni, ɔ́bla-ma dɛye dɛye. Anwuɔsu béye banii, “Amu si use lɛni ni, ɔma ndubɔkana na ɔkɛ ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii?”

english_verse: Jesus looked straight at them and said, “There are some things people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́nu-ma anumi na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɔyawine biala ulakana ɔmɛni bɔbla. Nsu Katɔti anwu ni, ɔɔkana lɛla biala bɔbla.”

english_verse: Peter replied, “Remember, we have left everything to be your followers! What will we get?”
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Nu! Bɔ́da lɛla lɛdi biala búse na bɔsiaku-ɔ kama. Bi na bɔdubo bɔkɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: Yes, all of you have become my followers. And so in the future world, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, I promise you will sit on twelve thrones to judge the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Amii bɛkɛ kayi. Uwi ɔni na ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi mebo na mina lɛlɔyɔ kemmo na nlie mina lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na kayawi kawɔdi kammɔ kemmo ni, bina leevu-inyɔ bani nsiaku-mi lɛnɔ bɛdubulie agaboku lɛlɔ na bɛdi Israelƒuɔ adukpa leevu-inyɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: All who have given up home or brothers and sisters or father and mother or children or land for me will be given
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni néni nwuna kaduli iye banwani bananabi iye banwani belekubi iye uni iye bebi iye mmo ka ɔsiaku-mi ɔsu ni, ɔdubɔkɛ-nya akpa eti anyɔ utulo. Na Katɔti ɔdubute-nwu ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii.

english_verse: As Jesus was telling what the kingdom of heaven would be like, he said: Early one morning a man went out to hire some workers for his vineyard.
translation_verse: “Katɔti lɛga bɔdi buse aani ɔmɛni kalɛ. Uwi ɔdi ni, ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́ta ɔtanta tutuutu ɔnii utáwia bekyuli badi na batuma nwuna kemmo bete-nwu na limeyi lɛyuƒɔla kenye.

english_verse: After he had agreed to pay them the usual amount for a day's work, he sent them off to his vineyard.
translation_verse: Kemo ɔlati ku kabla bablane bénu lɛlɔ kalɔ ka badubɔƒɔ limeyi lɛyuƒɔla, na bátɔlɔ bésie-nwu kemo.

english_verse: About nine that morning, the man saw some other people standing in the market with nothing to do.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔni na úbo lɛdɔ yaalenwi ni, ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔ́sɔ úsie kuyeya na útánu banana badi ka benye ukpludi.

english_verse: He promised to pay them what was fair, if they would work in his vineyard.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, ‘Amii lɛnɔ biteesie mina kemo bitátuma na ndubɔƒɔ-mii kayu kani námanku bina kabla kammɔ.’

english_verse: So they went. At noon and again about three in the afternoon he returned to the market. And each time he made the same agreement with others who were loafing around with nothing to do.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bésie kemo kammɔ. “Na ɔ́sɔ úsie kuyeya mmɔ útábla lɛni kani lɛdɔ leevu-inyɔ ku lɛdɔ ɛtɛ kemmo.

english_verse: Finally, about five in the afternoon the man went back and found some others standing there. He asked them, “Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na lɛdɔ ɛlɔ líbo ni, ɔ́sɔ úsie kuyeya mmɔ na útánu banana babambadi ka bénye mmɔ. Na úye-ma ɔnini, ‘Bi nébo ɔsu na amii bilie mɛni ɔmwi limeyi limodi na bítabla kabla kadi?’

english_verse: “Because no one has hired us,” they answered. Then he told them to go work in his vineyard.
translation_verse: “Bédie kenye banii, ‘Ukyuli ɔdi útete-bu kabla kadi ɔnii bɔbla.’ “Anwuɔsu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, ‘Amu biteesie mina kemo.’

english_verse: That evening the owner of the vineyard told the man in charge of the workers to call them in and give them their money. He also told the man to begin with the ones who were hired last.
translation_verse: “Amu uwi ɔni na lɛdɔ ɛku líbo ni, kemo ɔlati ɔmmɔ ɔ́su batumane bammɔ lɛlɔ ɔnune ɔnini, ‘Lɔ batumane bammɔ ƒui na aƒɔ-ma kayu. Na ese kalɔ asi bekyuli bekplodi lɛlɔ atálɛ bedeedi lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: When the workers arrived, the ones who had been hired at five in the afternoon were given a full day's pay.
translation_verse: “Amu na báƒɔ limeyi lɛyuƒɔla kayu béte bekyuli bani nébo useyi lɛdɔ ɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: they began complaining to the owner of the vineyard.
translation_verse: Na ka báƒɔ egulabi ammɔ ni, bése kalɔ baadɔnku kemo ɔlati ɔmmɔ banii,

english_verse: They said, “The ones who were hired last worked for only one hour. But you paid them the same that you did us. And we worked in the hot sun all day long!”
translation_verse: ‘Bekyuli bani nábla kabla ɔdɔ unwi ku abu bani nénye ɔƒɛ lɛlɔ limeyi limodi ƒui bɔ́ƒɔ lɛyuƒɔla linwi!’

english_verse: The owner answered one of them, “Friend, I didn't cheat you. I paid you exactly what we agreed on.
translation_verse: “Amu na kemo ɔlati ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, ‘Bakpana, binu kalɔ. Ńtaƒiɔ-mii. Ami ku-mii ƒui búnu kalɔ bɔnii limeyi kenye kayu ndi bina lɛyuƒɔla.

english_verse: Take your money now and go! What business is it of yours if I want to pay them the same that I paid you?
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛƒɔ bina lɛyuƒɔla na biteesie kaduli. Mɔɔyɔ́ ka lite bekyuli bekplodi bamɛni lɛyuƒɔla lɛni kani na líte-mii.

english_verse: Don't I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Why should you be jealous, if I want to be generous?”
translation_verse: Mbo kuƒi na lɛblaku mina egulabi kalɛ na mɔɔyɔ́. Anwuɔsu ɔƒɛ utada-mii na mina lɛƒɔndia lɛlɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “So it is. Everyone who is now last will be first, and everyone who is first will be last.” Jesus Again Tells about His Death (Mark
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́wɔlɔ ɔnini, “Lɛni geen na bekyuli bani ntɔ badubɔvi bakpɛ kama, na bani nkpɛ kama bavi batɔ.” Yesu Ɔ́sɔ Ɔ́su Nwuna Kukpi Lɛlɔ Litemi

english_verse: When Jesus heard them, he stopped and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”
translation_verse: Yesu údi únye na ɔ́lɔ-ma úboku na úye-ma ɔnini, “Bi na bɛɛwia bɛnii mbla nte-mii?”

english_verse: Jesus felt sorry for them and touched their eyes. At once they could see, and they became his followers.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́nu-ma kɔnyana na útuku bana anumi. Na kɔnakunwi ni, bákana na baanu, na básiaku-nwu kama.

english_verse: The crowd told them to be quiet, but they shouted even louder, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ básu banumbwɛne bammɔ banii baba lɛsɛ. Nsu ni, báva momoomo bébu banii, “Blɔti, Ɔga Dawid Uwɔ! Nu-bu kɔnyana!”

english_verse: As Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem, he took his twelve disciples aside and told them in private:
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane bákɔ bésela Yerusalem ni, úti-ma úsienku kɔƒɛlɛ.

english_verse: and then they will hand him over to foreigners who will make fun of him. They will beat him and nail him to a cross. But on the third day he will rise from death. A Mother's Request (Mark
translation_verse: Na ama bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ badubuti-mi babla lɛmala, na bebo-mi, na bakana-mi bamana ugyii lɛlɔ na likpi. Nsu emeyi atɛ kama ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔgyila-mi ɔlɛku bekpine akɔ.” Yakobo Ku Yohane Uni Úye Yesu Ɔnii Ubunku Nwuna Bebi

english_verse: The mother of James and John came to Jesus with her two sons. She knelt down and started begging him to do something for her.
translation_verse: Amu na Sebedeo ulekudi útiku nwuna bebi inyɔ úsienku Yesu kudɔ ɔnii útevele-nwu kebunku.

english_verse: Jesus asked her what she wanted, and she said, “When you come into your kingdom, please let one of my sons sit at your right side and the other at your left.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu úye-nwu ɔnini, “Bi na aawia?” Amu na uleku ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Mɔɔwia ka ese-mi kayi na si éduo ƒula lɛga kadikɔ ni, na ete kuƒi na mina bebi bananabi inyɔ bamɛni belie ƒula kɔdianu kakɛ ku ƒula kɔmii kakɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Not one of you knows what you are asking. Are you able to drink from the cup that I must soon drink from?” James and John said, “Yes, we are!”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛɛɛgyi lɛla lɛni geen na biiye. Lɛbibo lɛni ndubo buti ni, amii lɛnɔ bɛdubɔkana-nya buti?” Amu na bedie kenye banii, “Ɛɛn, bɔdubɔkana.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You certainly will drink from my cup! But it isn't for me to say who will sit at my right side and at my left. This is for my Father to say.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka bɛdubɔkana-nya buti. Nsu liiibo kuƒi ka lidie ukyuli ɔdi nnii ulie-mi kɔdianu ku kɔmii. Kuliekɔ kɔmɛni kuse kute bekyuli bani na mina ɔti ɔ́klibi-ku úse.”

english_verse: When the ten other disciples heard this, they were angry with the two brothers.
translation_verse: Amu uwi ɔni na batɛyane leevu bakladi bénu ka banwani bammɔ baayɔ́ ka badi-ma lɛlɔ ni, béti kɔnyi geen!

english_verse: But Jesus called the disciples together and said: You know foreign rulers like to order their people around. And their great leaders have full power over everyone they rule.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yesu ɔ́lɔ-ma ɔ́sala na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛgyi ka lɛlɔ badine bani mɔɔdi bekyuli bani nátaƒɔ bátadi lɛlɔ ni, bebo ɔyikun biala na bana lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But don't act like them. If you want to be great, you must be the servant of all the others.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔɔɔdi lɛni na ɔlɛka use na amii baƒɔtaadine akɔ. Si bina akɔ ɔdi ɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔƒɔ lɛnyi ku ɔbu ni, ɔlɛka unwini kabla ɔblane ute bakladi.

english_verse: And if you want to be first, you must be the slave of the rest.
translation_verse: Na si bina akɔ ɔdi ɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔbla udeedi ni, ɔlɛka ɔbla lɛlɔ aani ukyuli uyedi ute bakladi ƒui.

english_verse: The Son of Man did not come to be a slave master, but a slave who will give his life to rescue many people. Jesus Heals Two Blind Men (Mark
translation_verse: Lɛni na ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi lɛ́bla. Ńtebo nnii babla mina kabla. Mmomu líbo mbabla kabla na liti mina ngba lɛƒɔ bekyuli pii lili kayu.” Yesu Ɔ́bwi Banumbwɛne Inyɔ

english_verse: Jesus was followed by a large crowd as he and his disciples were leaving Jericho.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane bátɔlɔ Yeriko ni, bekyuli pii badi basiaku-ma.

english_verse: Two blind men were sitting beside the road. And when they heard that Jesus was coming their way, they shouted, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Na banumbwɛne inyɔ badi belie ulu kudɔ na bénu ka Yesu ɔ́si ɔɔví. Amu na bése kalɔ baava banii, “Blɔti, Ɔga Dawid Uwɔ! Nu-bu kɔnyana!”

english_verse: They answered, “Lord, we want to see!”
translation_verse: Amu na bédie kenye banini, “Ati, bɔɔyɔ́ ka aya na butaanu.”

english_verse: Jesus said: I will tell you a story about a man who had two sons. Then you can tell me what you think. The father went to the older son and said, “Go work in the vineyard today!”
translation_verse: “Dɛ na bɛɛkali taasiku litemi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ? Ɔnana ɔdi ɔ́kya na ubo bebi bananabi inyɔ. Ɔ́su unengudi ɔnini, ‘Ubi, teesie tátuma na mina kemo ɔmwi.’

english_verse: But when they saw the man's son, they said, “Someday he will own the vineyard. Let's kill him! Then we can have it all for ourselves.”
translation_verse: “Nsu uwi ɔni na lɛlɔ banune bamɛni bánu ubidi ɔmɛni ni, básu lɛlɔ banini, ‘Aanu kemo ɔlati ubidi ɔni ndi nwuna ala ɔdine. Bɛya na bɔdu-nwu na buƒie nwuna ala bɔƒɔ.’

english_verse: If anyone asks why you are doing this, just say, ‘The Lord needs them.’ He will at once let you have the donkeys.”
translation_verse: Na si ukyuli ɔdi úye-mii lɛla lɛdi ni, bɛsu-nwu bɛnii, ‘Blɔti mɔɔwia-ma.’ Na badubɔnyonu-ma bete-mii kɔnakunwi.”

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet had said,
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔ́lɛ lɛni aani kalɛ na Katɔti kenye udiene ɔdi ɔ́su úse ɔnii,

english_verse: “Announce to the people of Jerusalem: ‘Your king is coming to you! He is humble and rides on a donkey. He comes on the colt of a donkey.’ ”
translation_verse: “Bɛsu Sion bekyuli bɛnii, ‘Bɛnu! Bina ɔga ɔdubo-mii kudɔ. Úboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na ulie ebuo ala utine ubi lɛlɔ ɔdubo.’ ”

english_verse: The disciples left and did what Jesus had told them to do.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu batɛyane inyɔ bammɔ bésie na bátábla aani kalɛ na Yesu ɔ́tala-ma ɔnii batábla.

english_verse: They brought the donkey and its colt and laid some clothes on their backs. Then Jesus got on.
translation_verse: Na béti ebuo ala utine ɔmmɔ ku ubi béboku, na béti bana adi béwi-ma lɛlɔ, na Yesu ɔ́kɔ úlie ubi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When Jesus came to Jerusalem, everyone in the city was excited and asked, “Who can this be?”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu úduo Yerusalem ni, nwuna lɛlɔ litemi lɛ́ƒɔ ɔma ɔmmɔ ƒui. Na bekyuli béye lɛlɔ banii, “Ɔma na ɔdi?”

english_verse: But the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses were angry when they saw his miracles and heard the children shouting praises to the Son of David.
translation_verse: Na ka bakpane benengu ku ɔda bubo ala batinane bánu akɔla ani na Yesu ɔdaku bɔbla ku banamu bani mɔɔva taasu banii, “Bimwi Ɔga Dawid Uwɔ” mmɔ ni, béti kɔnyi geen.

english_verse: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard these stories, they knew Jesus was talking about them.
translation_verse: Na ka bakpane benengu ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ bénu Yesu agba amɛni ni, báti ka ama na ɔda.

english_verse: He told them, “The Scriptures say, ‘My house should be called a place of worship.’ But you have turned it into a place where robbers hide.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bénweni na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ka Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, ‘Badubɔlɔ mina kaduli banii kesii kani na badubɔkpali katɔ.’ Nsu amii bíti-ka bínwini beyune kabɛkɔ!”

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray, you will be given whatever you ask for.” A Question about Jesus' Authority (Mark
translation_verse: Na lɛla biala lɛni na bɛdubuye Katɔti na bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo ni, bɛdubɔkɛ-ni.” Béye Yesu Kenyekɔ Kani Na Ubo

english_verse: The men said to Jesus, “Don't you hear what those children are saying?” “Yes, I do!” Jesus answered. “Don't you know that the Scriptures say, ‘Children and infants will sing praises’?”

translation_verse: “Binu lɛgba lɛbambadi lɛdi. Ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́kya dii ɔni mbo adingyii kemo kani na ɔ́tu awodu ɔ́mana. Ɔ́bla ntɛ kebulokɔ na ɔ́tu ɔgyumanane keliekɔ. Amu na úti kemo kamɛni úte bekyuli badi ɔnii bataanu-ka lɛlɔ, na ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie ulu.

english_verse: Jesus had gone into the temple and was teaching when the chief priests and the leaders of the people came up to him. They asked, “What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu únwini úbo Katɔti kakpakɔ mmɔ. Na ka ɔɔtina ala ni, Katɔti bakpane benengu ku Yudaƒuɔ benengu bammɔ bébeye-nwu banii, “Kenyekɔ kamani na ebo asa na aabla ala amɛni udu? Na ɔma néte-ɔ kenyekɔ kammɔ?”

english_verse: On the other hand, these people think John was a prophet, and we are afraid of what they might do to us. That's why we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize.”
translation_verse: Nsu si bɔ́su bɔnii ukyuli kudɔ na ɔ́kɛ-ka ɔ́siku ni, bɔɔyia ka bekyuli badubɔbla-bu lɛla lɛdi, ɔsika bana ƒui báƒɔ bádi banii Katɔti kenye udiene na ɔdi.”

translation_verse: Ntu Ɔkpilane Yohane úbo úbatina-mii ulu buni ɔni lɛlɔ na bɛsia, nsu bítaƒɔ-nwu bítadi. Nsu beyune ku bayalɛ ama báƒɔ bádi. Na ina ka bɛ́nu ɔmɛni muedi ni, bítavumana bina kasusu na bɛƒɔ-nwu bɛdi.

english_verse: When it was harvest time, the owner sent some servants to get his share of the grapes.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na egyiibi ammɔ édu bude ni, kemo ɔlati ɔmɛni ɔ́tala nwuna kabla bablane ɔnii batáƒɔ nwuna kadikɔ beboku-nwu.

english_verse: But the renters grabbed those servants. They beat up one, killed one, and stoned one of them to death.
translation_verse: “Kemo lɛlɔ banune bamɛni béƒie kabla bablane bamɛni na bébo unwi na bádu unwi, na bébo unwi lɛnɔ atabi bádu.

translation_verse: Amu na kemo ɔlati ɔmmɔ ɔ́sɔ ɔ́tala kabla bablane babambadi bani mmomo ntulo bedeedi. Na bábla ama lɛnɔ aani kalɛ na bábla bedeedi bammɔ.

english_verse: Finally, the owner sent his own son to the renters, because he thought they would respect him.
translation_verse: Kawɔlɔkɔ ni, ɔ́tala ubidi ɔlati ɔ́kya-ma. Na ɔ́su ɔnii, ‘Lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di ka badubɔbu mina ubidi anwu.’

english_verse: So they grabbed him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “When the owner of that vineyard comes, what do you suppose he will do to those renters?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye-ma ɔnini, “Ɔƒɛni ni, bi na bɛɛbu ka kemo ɔlati ɔmmɔ ɔdubo kemo lɛlɔ banune bammɔ bɔbla si ɔ́si úbo?”

english_verse: The chief priests and leaders answered, “He will kill them in some horrible way. Then he will rent out his vineyard to people who will give him his share of grapes at harvest time.”
translation_verse: Bédie kenye banini, “Ɔdubɔdu bekyuli bekpidi bammɔ ulikplu kemmo na uti kemo kammɔ ute lɛlɔ banune babambadi bani ndubuti edula beboku-nwu si údu edula ɔƒɛwi.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You surely know that the Scriptures say, ‘The stone the builders tossed aside is now the most important stone of all. This is something the Lord has done, and it is amazing to us.’
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bínu na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ka ni, “ ‘Lɛtabi lɛni na batune béni báva banii lɛɛɛdia ni, ani mmomu nébenwini lɛtabi lɛni náƒɔ kuye litulo na atabi ƒui akɔ. Katɔti nábla lɛla bonwu lɛmɛni. Na lɛ́ƒɔ-bu anu geen!’ ”

english_verse: I tell you God's kingdom will be taken from you and given to people who will do what he demands.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Anwuɔsu mɔɔsu-mii nnii Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ nwuna lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ na bina kudɔ bileduo-ka! Na ɔdubuti ute bekyuli bamba bani ndubɔbla nwuna lɛyɔla.

english_verse: Anyone who stumbles over this stone will be crushed, and anyone it falls on will be smashed to pieces.”
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni mebuli mayu lɛtabi lɛni béni báva mmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔdubɔdu lɛlɔ. Na si lɛtabi lɛmmɔ lɛnɔ lɛ́lɛ líbo ɔdi lɛlɔ ni, lɛdubutu-nwu lɛbwɛ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.”

translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́tina bekyuli ala na agba kemmo ɔnii,

translation_verse: “Katɔti lɛga bɔdi buse aani ɔmɛni. Uwi ɔdi ni, ɔga ɔdi ɔ́di uleku buti limeyi lɛdi úte ubidi.

english_verse: He sent other servants to say to the guests, “The banquet is ready! My cattle and prize calves have all been prepared. Everything is ready. Come to the banquet!”
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu ɔ́tala kabla bablane babambadi ɔnii batásu bekyuli bammɔ banii, ‘Limeyi lɛni bɔdubo bɔdi lídu! Bɔ́ɔdu bebuo bani ƒui na bɔdubuti bútaanu-mii kama. Na báaklibi lɛla biala bése. Anwuɔsu biteebo uleku ketikɔ!’

english_verse: But the guests did not pay any attention. Some of them left for their farms, and some went to their places of business.
translation_verse: “Nsu bana ɔdi biala útabu nwuna bɔlɔ bɔmmɔ. Mmomu bátɔlɔ bésie kesii kani na ɔdi biala ɔɔyɔ́. Ɔdi ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie nwuna kemo. Na ɔdi lɛnɔ úsie kuye kadikɔ.

translation_verse: Ɔda bubo inyɔ bɔmɛni lɛlɔ na Mose ɔda bubo ku Katɔti kenye bediene ala bɔtina ƒui bɔsia.” Ɔma Ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi Ɔmmɔ?
