translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔdubudie ɔma ɔmɛni atu na ɔyii udu.

english_verse: Whoever is the greatest should be the servant of the others.
translation_verse: Bina kemmo ɔni mɔɔwia ka ɔƒɔ lɛnyi ku ɔbu ni, ɔlɛka ɔbla aani kabla ɔblane.

english_verse: Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Your people have killed the prophets and have stoned the messengers who were sent to you. I have often wanted to gather your people, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But you wouldn't let me.
translation_verse: “Yerusalem, Yerusalem! Awɔ muubó Katɔti kenye bediene ku bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔ́tala ɔ́kya-mii atabi taadu. Kɔlɛ kɔlɛ sɔɔn mɛni na líbimi mina enu nnii mɔɔsála-mii aani kalɛ na akɔkɔ uledi uuti nwuna avwi teebi nwuna bebi lɛlɔ, nsu étenu kalɔ!

english_verse: Anyone who swears by the altar also swears by everything on it.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́kpali ala ɔ́lɔ lɛkpabi úse kenye ni, na linyese lɛmmɔ lɛdanku lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ ku ala ani nsia-ni lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama ni, Yesu ɔ́tɛmiku bekyuli lisu lɛmmɔ ku nwuna batɛyane.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law are experts in the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɔda bubo ala batinane ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ ama ni, benye Mose kenye na bebo kuƒi kɔni na bedie Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: So obey everything they teach you, but don't do as they do. After all, they say one thing and do something else.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔlɛka bɛbla lɛla biala na básu-mii kaduɛ. Nsu ni, bitasiaku ala ani na baabla kama, ɔsika baládi ala ani baasu mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Everything they do is just to show off in front of others. They even make a big show of wearing Scripture verses on their foreheads and arms, and they wear big tassels for everyone to see.
translation_verse: “Baabla lɛla biala kalɛ na bekyuli banu-ma aani Katɔti kabla bablane geen. Bɛnu ala ani na bébo báda bana atɛntɛ ku enubɔ na Bunweni Kedee etemila asia-nya lɛlɔ, ku kalɛ na bákya-nya na ébomo. Na bɛnu kakpakɔ ala ani na báta bámana ala abuni lidu lɛni bákya mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They love the best seats at banquets and the front seats in the synagogues.
translation_verse: Baayɔ́ kuliekɔ kɔbuni bulie na emeyi kadikɔ ku kuliekɔ kunengudi bulie na Yudaƒuɔ kɔsakɔ.

english_verse: And when they are in the market, they like to have people greet them as their teachers.
translation_verse: Baayɔ́ banii bekyuli beteebo kalɔ teegyele-ma na kuyeya na bataalɔ-ma banii Ala Ɔtinane.

english_verse: But none of you should be called a teacher. You have only one teacher, and all of you are like brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: “Na bɔƒɔtaadi ulu lɛlɔ ni, bitaya na bekyuli balɔ-mii Unwoti, ɔsika banwa na bɛdi bite lɛlɔ. Na Unwoti unwi pɛ kani na bibo.

english_verse: Don't call anyone on earth your father. All of you have the same Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Na bina akɔ ni, bitalɔ ukyuli ɔdi na kayawi mɛni bɛnii Blɔti, ɔsika Blɔti unwi pɛ na bibo. Na ɔkya katɔ.

english_verse: None of you should be called the leader. The Messiah is your only leader.
translation_verse: Na bitalɔ ɔdi bɛnii Ɔtinane, ɔsika bina Ɔtinane unwi pɛ ɔni kani na bibo ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You lock people out of the kingdom of heaven. You won't go in yourselves, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ muute amii Katɔti ɔda bubo ala batinane ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ! Anumi lɛlɔ bekyuli bɛdi! Biisié bekpinele kudɔ ka bitébunku-ma, nsu bɛɛtɔ́lɔ-ma taaƒɔ-ma ala. Na bɛɛkpali katɔ gyɔlɔɔ taabu-ma kɔdɔlɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bina kɔtu bɔni bɔdubɔkɔ katɔ bubu!

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You travel over land and sea to win one follower. And when you have done so, you make that person twice as fit for hell as you are.
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ muute amii Katɔti ɔda bubo ala batinane ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ! Anumi lɛlɔ bekyuli bɛdi! Bɛkɛ kayawi ekpo ekpo ƒui biitú lɛlɔ kalɛ na bɛkɛ ina ɔƒɔtaadine unwi bite Katɔti. Na si bɛ́kɛ ɔdi ni, bɛɛtina-nwu kalɛ na ubie na uduo lɛgyavonku lɛmmɔ kemmo utulo amii alati ƒui!

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You are supposed to lead others, but you are blind. You teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the temple. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gold in the temple.
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ muute amii banumbwɛne ulu batinane bani anumi nábwɛ! Bɛɛtina bɛnii, ‘Si ukyuli ɔ́kpali ala ɔ́lɔ Katɔti kakpakɔ úse kenye kadi ni, linyese lɛmmɔ liiibo ɔkplu. Nsu si ɔ́kpali ala ɔ́lɔ sika ugyiedi ani nsia Katɔti kakpakɔ mmɔ úse kenye kadi ni, linyese lɛmmɔ lɛdubɔyu ɔkplu geen.’

english_verse: You blind fools! Which is greater, the gold or the temple that makes the gold sacred?
translation_verse: Banumbwɛne badɔlɔdi! Bi náƒɔ kuye útulo, sika ugyiedi ɔmmɔ munuu Katɔti kakpakɔ kani mɔɔyá na sika ugyiedi ɔmmɔ ɔɔbla kedee?

english_verse: You also teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the altar. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gift on the altar.
translation_verse: Bɛɛtina lɛnɔ bɛnii, ‘Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́kpali ala ɔ́lɔ Katɔti lɛkpabi úse kenye kadi ni, linyese lɛmmɔ liiibo ɔkplu. Nsu si ɔ́kpali ala ɔ́lɔ ala ani na béti básia lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ úse kenye ni, linyese lɛmmɔ lɛdubɔyu ɔkplu geen.’

english_verse: Are you blind? Which is more important, the gift or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
translation_verse: Banumbwɛne geen na bɛdi! Bi náƒɔ kuye útulo, ala ani nsia lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ munuu lɛkpabi lɛni mɔɔyá na ala ammɔ aabla kedee?

english_verse: And anyone who swears by the temple also swears by God, who lives there.
translation_verse: Na si ɔ́kpali ala ɔ́lɔ Katɔti kakpakɔ úse kenye ni, na linyese lɛmmɔ lɛdanku kakpakɔ kammɔ ku Katɔti ɔni keliekɔ ndi kakpakɔ kammɔ.

english_verse: To swear by heaven is the same as swearing by God's throne and by the one who sits on that throne.
translation_verse: Na si ukyuli ɔ́kpali ala ɔ́lɔ katɔ úse kenye ni, nwuna linyese lɛmmɔ lɛdanku Katɔti lɛgaboku ku Katɔti ɔlati ɔni nlie lɛgaboku lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your garden, such as mint, dill, and cumin. Yet you neglect the more important matters of the Law, such as justice, mercy, and faithfulness. These are the important things you should have done, though you should not have left the others undone either.
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ muute amii Katɔti ɔda bubo ala batinane ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ! Anumi lɛlɔ bekyuli bɛdi! Biiti kevoma kemo kutu akyala ƒɛƒɛɛ ani bɛ́bla muedi lɛkpa leevudi teete Katɔti, nsu bíni na biládi ɔda bubo bɔni náƒɔ kuye geen butulo lɛlɔ. Na muna lɛlɔ bɔdi ndi kalɛ na bilanu bekyuli anumi bilabla lɛla lɛdi. Na bɛnu bekyuli kɔnyana. Na bɛdi lɛla biala ulu lɛlɔ bite bekyuli. Ala amɛni lɛnɔ na ɔlɛka bɛbla, na bitada ɔdi bitese.

english_verse: You blind leaders! You strain out a small fly but swallow a camel.
translation_verse: Batɔnkune banumbwɛne bɛɛsia bina ɔdi anu na bɛɛtimi alɔlɔ blii suɛ na ntɛ anumi. Nsu bina ablala aatina ka biibweli kubweyi kɔni ntulo balɔlɔ bammɔ ƒui!

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You wash the outside of your cups and dishes, while inside there is nothing but greed and selfishness.
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ muute amii Katɔti ɔda bubo ala batinane ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ! Anumi lɛlɔ bekyuli bɛdi! Bɛɛƒɔ bina lɛɛƒɛɛ ku akyami kama na eekeye, nsu ana kemmo eesé lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na bíyi ku ɔdivo ku ami lɛti lɛkɛ.

english_verse: You blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of a cup, and then the outside will also be clean.
translation_verse: Awɔ Ƒarisini ɔnumbwɛne! Ka ƒula ɔɔƒɛɛ kemmo bɔƒɔ, na nwuna kama lɛnɔ kadubukeye.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You're like tombs that have been whitewashed. On the outside they are beautiful, but inside they are full of bones and filth.
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ muute amii Katɔti ɔda bubo ala batinane ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ! Anumi lɛlɔ bekyuli bɛdi! Bise aani kɔƒiɔtɔ kɔni na bákwa-ku kama na kɔɔdia bɔnu. Nsu nwuna kemmo ɔdi ukpine ɔni nébie na úbu ekubi ekubi.

english_verse: That's what you are like. Outside you look good, but inside you are evil and only pretend to be good.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na bɛɛbla lɛlɔ aani bekyuli babuni na bekyuli anumi, nsu bíyi ku kenwini ku ekpidi lidu.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are nothing but show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You build monuments for the prophets and decorate the tombs of good people.
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ muute amii Katɔti ɔda bubo ala batinane ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ! Anumi lɛlɔ bekyuli bɛdi! Bɛɛtú kɔƒiɔtɔ kɔbuni teete Katɔti kenye bediene bani nélie siin, na bɛɛklibi-ku kaduɛ.

english_verse: And you claim you would not have taken part with your ancestors in killing the prophets.
translation_verse: Na bɛɛsu ka, ‘Si bula bati kuuku uwi na bulie ni, nka abu bulasiaku-ma kama na bɔdu Katɔti kenye bediene bammɔ.’

english_verse: But you prove you really are the relatives of the ones who killed the prophets.
translation_verse: Nsu bina ala ani bɛɛbla mɔɔtina geen ka bekyuli bani nádu Katɔti kenye bediene bammɔ kaba bebi na bɛdi.

english_verse: So keep on doing everything they did.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, bisie anumi na bɛwɔlɔ lɛla lɛni na bina bati kuuku bése kalɔ.

english_verse: You are nothing but snakes and the children of snakes! How can you escape going to hell?
translation_verse: “Bekyuli bekpidi bɛdi! Bise aani balakpi ku bana bebi! Anwuɔsu ni, bɛɛɛdubo bɔkana na bikeli Katɔti kɔtu kɔni na ɔdubɔni-mii na lɛgyavonku kemmo!

english_verse: I can promise that you people living today will be punished for all these things! Jesus Loves Jerusalem (Luke
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ubugya buwiakun bɔmɛni bɔsia amii bani nlie ngba mɛni lɛlɔ. Kaƒɔ Kákywi Yesu Na Yerusalem Lɛlɔ

english_verse: You won't see me again until you say, “Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ni, ɔ́si ɔƒaani ni, bɛsɔ bɛɛɛdubo-mi bɔnu wetédu ka bɛdubɔsu bɛnii, ‘Bimwi anwu ɔni ndubo na Blɔti lɛnyi kemmo!’ ”

english_verse: After Jesus left the temple, his disciples came over and said, “Look at all these buildings!”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́lɛ ɔ́si Katɔti kakpakɔ mmɔ ɔɔtɔlɔ ni, nwuna batɛyane bébo-nwu kudɔ na bakya baatina-nwu kakpakɔ lɛtɔ lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Do you see these buildings? They will certainly be torn down! Not one stone will be left in place.” Warning about Trouble (Mark
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛsia-ni anumi kaduɛ. Ɔsika mɔɔsu-mii nnii badubɔƒɛ lɛtɔ lɛmɛni ƒui, ɔni na lɛtabi lɛdi lilébu lilasia lɛkpanadi lɛlɔ muedi. Badubugyingya ana ƒui bewi kalɔ.” Yesu Ɔ́su Nwuna Basiakune Ka Badubo Abi Bubo

english_verse: Many will come and claim to be me. They will say they are the Messiah, and they will fool many people.
translation_verse: Bekyuli pii badubuti mina lɛnyi bebo babasu-mii banini, ‘Ami ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ’ na batɔlɔ bekyuli pii.

english_verse: You will soon hear about wars and threats of wars, but don't be afraid. These things will have to happen first, but that isn't the end.
translation_verse: Bɛdubunu kekpo ku kekpo etemila. Nsu bitaya na ɔtɔtɔ ɔgyu-mii. Ɔdi ka ala amɛni ƒui udu alɛ, nsu ulátina ka kawɔlɔkɔ kammɔ kéedu tɔ.

english_verse: Later, as Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, his disciples came to him in private and asked, “When will this happen? What will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the world?”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu úsie útélie Inɔ Egyii Kɔbi lɛlɔ ni, nwuna batɛyane bébo-nwu kudɔ na básu-nwu banii ɔtina-ma uwi ɔni na ala amɛni adubɔlɛ ku ala abambadi ani lɛnɔ ndubɔlɛ na watina ka kawɔlɔkɔ kani na ɔdubɔsɔ ubo uwi údu.

english_verse: Nations and kingdoms will go to war against each other. People will starve to death, and in some places there will be earthquakes.
translation_verse: Kalɔ kadi bekyuli badubɔta na bekpoku babambadi. Na lɛga kadikɔ kadubukpoku kabambadi. Na kɔka kɔdububo na ekpo ekpo. Na kalɔ lɛnɔ kadubo butaakunku na ekpo ekpo.

english_verse: It will be a terrible time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children.
translation_verse: Na baƒɔndane ku bebi beni bani nda bebi bani mɔɔnyimi ni, bana lɛlɔ lɛdubɔbla kɔnyana geen.

english_verse: Jesus answered: Don't let anyone fool you.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛsia anu kaduɛ na ukyuli ɔdi ulátɔlɔ-mii.

english_verse: But this is just the beginning of troubles.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni ndubuse kalɔ aani kalɛ na kawɔƒɔ keesé uleku kalɔ ku bɔdu.

english_verse: You will be arrested, punished, and even killed. Because of me, you will be hated by people of all nations.
translation_verse: “Bina bekisine badubɔya na beƒie-mii bete ɔma benengu na batɛku-mii litemi. Na bani-mii kɔtu na badu-mii. Kadi ƒui bekyuli badubukisi-mii, ɔsika bɛdi mina batɛyane.

english_verse: Many will give up and will betray and hate each other.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani náƒɔ-mi bádi pii badubunwini kama bakya-mi uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na badubɔkya bana bakpana kakya na beteekisi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Many false prophets will come and fool a lot of people.
translation_verse: Bekyuli pii badubɔta banyi ɔkɔ banii ama ndi Katɔti kenye bediene na batɔlɔ bekyuli pii.

english_verse: Someone may say, “Here is the Messiah!” or “There he is!” But don't believe it.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́su ɔnii, ‘Nu! Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔkya mɛni,’ iye si badi básu banii, ‘Ɔkya ngye’ ni, bitaƒɔ-nwu bitadi.

english_verse: And pray that you won't have to escape in winter or on a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Bivele Katɔti bɛnii bukeli bɔmɛni butebo na kɔyɔ uwi iye lɛnwunameyi lɛdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Someday you will see that “Horrible Thing” in the holy place, just as the prophet Daniel said. Everyone who reads this must try to understand!
translation_verse: “Na bɛdubɔnu lɛla lɛni na Katɔti uukisi na liisé lɛlɔ ka unye nwuna likpo kedee kalɛ na Katɔti Kenye Udiene Daniel únweni úse. Na amii bani mɔɔká ɔku ɔmmɔ ni, biduo-nwu kemmo kaduɛ na binu-nwu kalɔ.

english_verse: If you are living in Judea at that time, run to the mountains.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, amii bani nkya Yudea ni, ɔdi ka bikeli bisie abi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you are out in the field, don't go back for your coat.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni nkya kemo ɔsɔ utenwini utesie kaduli ɔnii utéti nwuna kɔdi.

english_verse: If God doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of God's chosen ones, he will make the time shorter.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Katɔti ɔ́ɔƒana emeyi ammɔ. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ uuubo ngba. Nsu bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna úse ɔsu na ɔdubɔƒana emeyi ammɔ.

english_verse: So when you see all these things happening, you will know the time has almost come.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na si bɛnu ala amɛni ƒui ni, bɛti ka uwi ɔni na Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ ubo úude, na unye kayakun.

english_verse: When the Son of Man appears, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.
translation_verse: Ami, Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi, ndubo buse aani kalɛ na ɔ́lɛ na Noa uwi.

english_verse: No one knows the day or hour. The angels in heaven don't know, and the Son himself doesn't know. Only the Father knows.
translation_verse: “Ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔɔgyi limeyi iye uwi ɔni kemmo na ami, Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi, nsɔ ndubo. Katɔti batu baaagyi, na ami lɛnɔ lɛɛɛgyi. Ati lɛti kani ngyi.

english_verse: People were eating, drinking, and getting married right up to the day the flood came and Noah went into the big boat.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ asa na ɔnantu wana waƒɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui ni, bekyuli bákya bátaadi taani. Na banana ku beleku beeti lɛlɔ útálɛ limeyi lɛni na Noa útéduo ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: They didn't know anything was happening until the flood came and swept them all away. This is how it will be when the Son of Man appears.
translation_verse: Nsu bátati lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ úti útédu uwi ɔni na ɔnantu ɔ́na ɔ́gbala-ma ƒui. Lɛni kani na Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi bubo lɛnɔ bɔdubɔbla.

english_verse: Two men will be in the same field, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Na banana inyɔ badubunye kemo na, Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ unwi na ɔda unwi use.

english_verse: Two women will be together grinding grain, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Na beleku inyɔ badubɔkya ɔlaaƒɔ kakɔkɔ, na Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ unwi na ɔda unwi use.

english_verse: So be on your guard! You don't know when your Lord will come.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu bilie kagyumana, ɔsika bɛɛɛgyi limeyi lɛni na bina Unwoti ɔdububo.

english_verse: Homeowners never know when a thief is coming, and they are always on guard to keep one from breaking in.
translation_verse: Si kaduli ɔlati ɔgyi uwi ɔni na uyune ɔdububo ni, nka ɔdubulie kagyumana. Na uláya na uyune ɔmmɔ wabwɛ weduo-nwu ɔtɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come. Faithful and Unfaithful Servants (Luke
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na ɔlɛka amii lɛnɔ bilie kagyumana, ɔsika ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ndububo mbeyu-mii lɛtu. Ɔlɛka Kabla Ɔblane Ɔbla Ala Ulu Lɛlɔ

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks the master won't return until late.
translation_verse: Nsu si ɔdi kabla ɔblane ukpidi ni, ɔdubɔsu na nwuna kayi kemmo ɔnini, ‘Mina unwoti ɔdubutu uwi geen!’

english_verse: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: “Kabla Ɔblane ɔni náda anu na ɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ ni, anwu na nwuna unwoti uuti teenye kabla bablane bakladi kenye. Na uunye-ma kenye teete-ma adila na uwi ɔbuni kemmo.

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master comes and finds them doing their job.
translation_verse: Kubiti geen ndubo kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ bɔda si nwuna unwoti ɔ́si úbo úbanu ka ɔɔbla lɛla lɛni na ɔ́su.

english_verse: You may be sure a servant who is always faithful will be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka unwoti ɔmɛni ɔdubuti kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ ɔbla nwuna ala ƒui lɛlɔ ɔnune.

english_verse: Suppose this evil servant starts beating the other servants and eats and drinks with people who are drunk.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔdubuse kalɔ uteebo nwuna kabla ɔblane bakpana bammɔ. Na anwu ku ntɛ bekpine bataadi na bataani.

english_verse: If that happens, the master will surely come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him.
translation_verse: Na unwoti ɔmmɔ ɔdububo uwi ɔni na kabla ɔblane ɔmɛni ulásia-nwu anu ku uwi ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔɔɔgyi uuuse.

english_verse: This servant will then be punished and thrown out with the ones who only pretended to serve their master. There they will cry and grit their teeth in pain.
translation_verse: Na unwoti ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔni kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ kɔtu geen. Na nwuna kɔtu bɔni kɔdubɔyu ɔkplu aani anumi lɛlɔ bekyuli bɔdi kalɛ! Mmɔ na keku ku animi bɔdu bɔdubɔkya!”

english_verse: The foolish ones took their lamps, but no extra oil.
translation_verse: Badɔlɔdi bammɔ béti bana lɛsogya, nsu béteti nnɔmii bɔdi bétebunku-ni.

english_verse: The ones who were wise took along extra oil for their lamps.
translation_verse: Na banundane bammɔ ama béti nnɔmii bébunku bana lɛsogya báda.

english_verse: Then in the middle of the night someone shouted, “Here's the groom! Come to meet him!”
translation_verse: “Ɔbla usientɛ asa bénu kɔvanu ka ni, ‘Bɛɛnu uleku ɔgya ɔmmɔ o-o! Bɛta bɛlɛ bibo na butásiaku-nwu!’

english_verse: When the women got up and started getting their lamps ready,
translation_verse: “Amu na begblebi leevu bammɔ báta na bátu bana lɛsogya.

english_verse: the foolish ones said to the others, “Let us have some of your oil! Our lamps are going out.”
translation_verse: Na badɔlɔdi bammɔ básu banundane bammɔ banii, ‘Bite-bu bina nnɔmii bɔmmɔ bɔdi, ɔsika bula lɛsogya lɛdaku buni.’

english_verse: Those who were wise answered, “There's not enough oil for all of us! Go and buy some for yourselves.”
translation_verse: “Na banundane bammɔ básu-ma banini, ‘Bula nnɔmii bulédu abu ku-mii, anwuɔsu biteesie beyene kudɔ na bitéye bina bɔdi.’

english_verse: But the groom replied, “I don't even know you!”
translation_verse: “Na uleku ɔgya ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, ‘Kudi kudii! Lɛɛɛgyi-mii.’ ”

english_verse: So, my disciples, always be ready! You don't know the day or the time when all this will happen. A Story about Three Servants (Luke
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́wɔlɔ lɛgba lɛmmɔ ɔnini, “Anwuɔsu bilie kagyumana, ɔsika bɛɛɛgyi limeyi iye uwi ɔni na masɔ mebo.” Ɔdi Ka Bɔda Ala Ani Na Katɔti Úti Ɔ́kya-bu Lɛkɔkɔ Kaduɛ

english_verse: Some time later the master of those servants returned. He called them in and asked what they had done with his money.
translation_verse: “Na emeyi pii adi kama ni, kabla bablane bamɛni unwoti ɔmmɔ únwini úbo na anwu ku-ma bábu akunta.

english_verse: You could have at least put my money in the bank, so I could have earned interest on it.”
translation_verse: Amu bi ɔsu na éteti mina egulabi étetése egulabi kesekɔ, na si líbo ni, na mbaƒɔ mina egulabi ku kuvonsia?’

english_verse: The kingdom is also like what happened when a man went away and put his three servants in charge of all he owned.
translation_verse: “Na uwi ɔni na Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ɔdubo ni, Katɔti lɛga bɔdi bɔdubuse aani ɔmɛni lɛnɔ. Uwi ɔdi kemmo ni, unengu ɔdi ɔ́ta na ɔ́bla kasusu ka usie ulu ɔdi. Ɔ́lɔ nwuna kabla bablane na úti nwuna ala ɔ́kya-ma lɛkɔkɔ.

english_verse: As soon as the man had gone, the servant with the
translation_verse: Kabla ɔblane ɔni náƒɔ aƒo alɔ amɛni úsie kalɔ kɔnakunwi na útébo egulabi ammɔ únwini na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́kɛ aƒo alɔ ɔ́sia.

english_verse: “Wonderful!” his master replied. “You are a good and faithful servant. I left you in charge of only a little, but now I will put you in charge of much more. Come and share in my happiness!”
translation_verse: “Nwuna unwoti ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-nwu ɔnii, ‘Kabla ɔblane ɔbuni, ábla lɛla biala ulu lɛlɔ geen! Ka ásia ala blii suɛ amɛni anu kaduɛ ɔsu ni, ndubuti-ɔ linyene ala enengudi kenye. Bo butaadi na butaani na butaakɛ ebiti!’

english_verse: “Wonderful!” his master replied. “You are a good and faithful servant. I left you in charge of only a little, but now I will put you in charge of much more. Come and share in my happiness!”
translation_verse: “Nwuna unwoti ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-nwu ɔnii, ‘Kabla ɔblane ɔbuni, ábla lɛla biala ulu lɛlɔ geen! Ka ásia ala blii suɛ amɛni anu kaduɛ ɔsu ni, ndubuti-ɔ linyene ala enengudi kenye. Bo butaadi na butaani na butaakɛ ebiti!’

english_verse: I was frightened and went out and hid your money in the ground. Here is every single coin!”
translation_verse: Na ka mɔɔyia ɔsu ni, líti ƒula egulabi ammɔ ńtéku lɛ́kya kalɔ. Anwuɔsu aanu ƒula egulabi ƒui mɛni.’

english_verse: The master of the servant told him, “You are lazy and good-for-nothing! You know I harvest what I don't plant and gather crops where I haven't scattered seed.
translation_verse: “Nwuna unwoti ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Kabla ɔblane ukpidi ku ɔkɔsɔne na adi. Agyi ka muudé edula na kesii kani na ńtava adi, na mɔɔƒɛ edula kesii kani na ńtagya lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Then the master said, “Now your money will be taken away and given to the servant with
translation_verse: “Amu na unwoti ɔmmɔ ɔ́su kabla ɔblane bamba ɔnini, ‘Bɛƒɔ egulabi ammɔ na nwuna kudɔ na biti-nya bite ukyuli ɔni nda aƒo leevu mmɔ.’

english_verse: Everyone who has something will be given more, and they will have more than enough. But everything will be taken from those who don't have anything.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni mbo lɛla lɛdi ni, anwu kani na basɔ badubo bute na ɔsɔ ɔkɛ ubu. Na ukyuli ɔni neeebo ɔdi anwu ni, ubliidi ɔni nse-nwu muedi ni, badubɔƒɔ balɛku-nwu lɛkɔkɔ.

english_verse: You are a worthless servant, and you will be thrown out into the dark where people will cry and grit their teeth in pain.” The Final Judgment
translation_verse: Na kabla ɔblane ɔni na nwuna lɛlɔ liiibo kɔsia kɔdi mɛni anwu ni, bibo-nwu bɛlɛku bitákya kasuudikɔ. Mmɔ na keku ku animi bɔdu bɔdubɔkya. Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi Ɔmmɔ Ndi Bekyuli Ƒui Litemi Ɔtɛne

english_verse: When the Son of Man comes in his glory with all his angels, he will sit on his royal throne.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔni na Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ɔmmɔ ɔdububo na nwuna lɛga bɔdi kemmo ni, Katɔti batu ƒui badubɔka bamana-nwu. Na ɔdubo ubelie nwuna lɛgaboku lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The people of all nations will be brought before him, and he will separate them, as shepherds separate their sheep from their goats.
translation_verse: Na kadi ƒui bekyuli badubɔsala bebenye-nwu anumi. Mmɔ na ɔdubule-ma kemmo aani kalɛ na baƒonu lɛlɔ ɔnune ɔɔƒuna baƒonu taalɛku bese akɔ.

english_verse: He will place the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.
translation_verse: Ɔdubɔya na bekyuli babuni bebenye-nwu kudɔ. Na ɔdubɔya na bekyuli bekpidi bammɔ besie kama.

english_verse: Then the king will say to those on his right, “My father has blessed you! Come and receive the kingdom that was prepared for you before the world was created.
translation_verse: “Na Ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔsu bekyuli bani nnye-nwu kudɔ ɔnini, ‘Amii ndi bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔni ndi mina Ɔti ɔ́ya na lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-mii kaduɛ. Anwuɔsu bibo na bibeduo lɛga kadikɔ kani na Katɔti ɔ́klibi úse úte-mii ɔ́si kayawi kalɔ kesekɔ ƒui.

english_verse: When I was hungry, you gave me something to eat, and when I was thirsty, you gave me something to drink. When I was a stranger, you welcomed me,
translation_verse: Mɔɔƒɔ-mii kayu kamɛni ɔsika uwi ɔni na kɔka kɔ́da-mi ni, bíte-mi adila. Ka utukwɛ ɔ́da-mi ni, bíte-mi ntu. Ka ndi ɔƒɔ ni, bígyingya enu bɛ́ƒɔ-mi na ḿbeduo-mii kudɔ.

english_verse: and when I was naked, you gave me clothes to wear. When I was sick, you took care of me, and when I was in jail, you visited me.”
translation_verse: Na ka nkɛ kasɔngya ni, bíte-mi adala. Na uwi ɔni na muuƒi ni, bɛ́nu-mi lɛlɔ. Ka bákya-mi ɔtɔ ni, bíbo bíbanu-mi.’

english_verse: Then the ones who pleased the Lord will ask, “When did we give you something to eat or drink?
translation_verse: “Mmɔ ni, bekyuli babuni bamɛni badubuye-nwu banini, ‘Ati, uwi ɔmani na bɔ́nu-ɔ ka kɔka kɔɔda-a na búte-ɔ adila, iye utukwɛ ɔɔda-a búte-ɔ ntu?

english_verse: When did we welcome you as a stranger or give you clothes to wear
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmani na adi ɔƒɔ ébeduo-bu na bɔ́ƒɔ-ɔ, iye akɛ kasɔngya na búte-ɔ adala?

english_verse: or visit you while you were sick or in jail?”
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmani na búnu ka eeƒi iye bákya-a ɔtɔ na búbo búbanu-ɔ?’

english_verse: The king will answer, “Whenever you did it for any of my people, no matter how unimportant they seemed, you did it for me.”
translation_verse: “Amu na Ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔdubudie kenye ɔnini, ‘Mɔɔsu-mii nnii uwi ɔni na bíbunku ukyuli ɔni na bilábu ƒui na mina badi akɔ ni, ami na bɛ́bla bíte.’

english_verse: Then the king will say to those on his left, “Get away from me! You are under God's curse. Go into the everlasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels!
translation_verse: “Amu na ɔdubɔsu bani na ɔ́ya na bésie kama ɔnini, ‘Bɛkpɛ bɛlɛ-mi lɛlɔ, amii bani na Katɔti úwida! Biteesie lɛgyavonku lɛni neeeni kudii na Katɔti ɔ́klibi úse úte ukisine ɔmmɔ ku nwuna ayu ekpidi kemmo!

english_verse: I was hungry, but you did not give me anything to eat, and I was thirsty, but you did not give me anything to drink.
translation_verse: Kɔka kɔ́da-mi na bítete-mi adila na lɛdi. Utukwɛ ɔ́da-mi na bítete-mi ntu na lɛni.

english_verse: Then the people will ask, “Lord, when did we fail to help you when you were hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in jail?”
translation_verse: “Amu na ama lɛnɔ badubuye-nwu banini, ‘Ati, uwi ɔmani na bɔ́nu ka kɔka kɔɔda-a, iye utukwɛ ɔɔda-a, iye adi ɔƒɔ, iye ákɛ kasɔngya, iye eeƒi, iye bákya-a ɔtɔ na bútebo na bubebunku-ɔ?’

english_verse: The king will say to them, “Whenever you failed to help any of my people, no matter how unimportant they seemed, you failed to do it for me.”
translation_verse: “Mmɔ na Ɔga ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔsu-ma ɔnini, ‘Mɔɔsu-mii ka ni, uwi ɔni na bítabla lɛbuni bítete ukyuli ɔni na balábu ƒui na mina badi akɔ ni, ami na bítabla bítete!’ ”

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “Those people will be punished forever. But the ones who pleased God will have eternal life.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́wɔlɔ ɔnini, “Bekyuli bamɛni na badubuti batákya lɛbibo lɛni naaadubo bɔsa kudii kemmo. Na bekyuli babuni bammɔ badubɔkɛ ngba bɔni naaadubo bɔsa kudii.”

english_verse: “You know two days from now will be Passover. This is when the Son of Man will be handed over to his enemies and nailed to a cross.”
translation_verse: “Bɛgyi ka kébu emeyi anyɔ na bɔdi limeyi lɛni bɔɔlɔ Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi. Na badubuti ami, Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi, bete na bakana-mi bamana ugyii lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Finally, Jesus returned to his disciples and said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? The time has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to sinners.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́sɔ úbo batɛyane bammɔ kudɔ na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɔsu bɔtɛ na bɛmu bɛtɛ bɛɛnwuna lɛni? Ɔƒɛni na uwi ɔmmɔ údu ka beti Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ɔmmɔ bakya bekyuli bekpidi enu kemmo.

english_verse: They planned how they could sneak around and have Jesus arrested and put to death.
translation_verse: Na béti kasusu kalɛ na beƒie Yesu na bɔbɛ kemmo na badu-nwu.

english_verse: But they said, “We must not do it during Passover, because the people will riot.” At Bethany (Mark
translation_verse: Nsu básu lɛnɔ banii, “Buleƒie-nwu na limeyi bɔdi kemmo, ɔsika bekyuli badubɔta babakyaku-bu unyeƒi.” Uleku Ɔdi Úwilimi Nnɔmii Ƒɛƒɛɛ Úwi Yesu Lɛlɔ

english_verse: We could have sold this perfume for a lot of money and given it to the poor.”
translation_verse: Ɔdubɔkana na uti nnɔmii bɔmɛni uye kuye bonwu na uti egulabi ammɔ ute bawabane.”

english_verse: But when his disciples saw this, they became angry and complained, “Why such a waste?
translation_verse: Ka nwuna batɛyane bánu ɔmɛni ni, útayɔ-ma kaƒɔ. Béye lɛlɔ banii, “Bi ɔsu na uubile nnɔmii bɔmɛni lɛni?

english_verse: Then they sang a hymn and went out to the Mount of Olives. Peter's Promise (Mark
translation_verse: Amu na bátu ɔnu ɔdi béti bemwi Katɔti, na bávi bálɛ bésie Inɔ Egyii Kɔbi lɛlɔ. Yesu Ɔ́su Úse Ka Petro Ɔdubuni-nwu

english_verse: and from then on he started looking for a good chance to betray Jesus. Jesus Eats the Passover Meal with His Disciples (Mark
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si uwi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ úsela ni, úse kalɔ ɔkya ɔɔwia uwi ɔbuni ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔsia na udie Yesu ute-ma. Yesu Ku Nwuna Batɛyane Bádi Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi Bɔdi Adila

english_verse: When Jesus was eating with his twelve disciples that evening, he said, “One of you will surely hand me over to my enemies.”
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na belie baadi ni, Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-mii ka ni, bina kemmo unwi ɔdubɔkya-mi kakya.”

english_verse: On the first day of the Festival of Thin Bread, Jesus' disciples came to him and asked, “Where do you want us to prepare the Passover meal?”
translation_verse: Amu na limeyi lideedi lɛni lɛlɔ na baadi Bodobodo Ɔni Néteƒu Limeyi ni, batɛyane bammɔ bébo Yesu kudɔ banii, “Wɛ na aayɔ́ ka butáklibi Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi bɔdi adila bute-ɔ?”

english_verse: During the meal Jesus took some bread in his hands. He blessed the bread and broke it. Then he gave it to his disciples and said, “Take this and eat it. This is my body.”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane belie baadi ni, úti bodobodo. Na ka ɔ́gya Katɔti enu ni, ɔ́bwɛ-nwu kɔkɛ kɔkɛ na úle-ku úte-ma. Ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bɛƒɔ ɔmɛni na bɛdi. Ɔmɛni ndi mina ɔlɔna.”

english_verse: This is my blood, and with it God makes his agreement with you. It will be poured out, so that many people will have their sins forgiven.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ndi mina ubugya ɔni na líti muusé kenye kani na Katɔti únyimi ku nwuna bekyuli likpo. Na ndubuti-nwu liwi kalɔ na bekyuli pii lili, kalɛ na Katɔti uti ekpidi ɔkyiɛ-ma.

english_verse: From now on I am not going to drink any wine, until I drink new wine with you in my Father's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ni, nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo ntɛ bɔmɛni udu bɔdi bɔni ntu limeyi lɛni na ami ku-mii bɔdubɔni ntɛ bɔwɔdi na Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “During this very night, all of you will reject me, as the Scriptures say, ‘I will strike down the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Bina ƒui bɛdubukeli-mi kudɔ, na kebu ami lɛti. Ɔsika Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔsu ɔnini, “ ‘Katɔti ɔdubɔdu baƒonu ɔdane ɔmmɔ na nwuna baƒonu begyingya.’

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I promise you before a rooster crows tonight, you will say three times that you don't know me.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su Petro ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-ɔ ka usien ɔmɛni asa na akɔkɔ wete kenye muedi ni, adubɔsu kɔtɛ ƒui ka aaagyi-mi.”

english_verse: Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane. When they got there, he told them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane bammɔ bésie kesii kani baalɔ Getsemane, na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛsɔ bilie mɛni na lisie ngye ntákpali katɔ.”

english_verse: and he said to them, “I am so sad that I feel as if I am dying. Stay here and keep awake with me.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Muunú ɔlɛ na mina kɔyu kemmo geen aani si bukpi nda. Bɛsɔ binye mɛni na bitaagyumanaku-mi.”

english_verse: Peter spoke up, “Even if all the others reject you, I never will!”
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Si ina bakladi ƒui béni-ɔ muedi ni, ami lɛɛɛdubo-ɔ kama bɔlɛ kudii!”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never say I don't know you.” All the others said the same thing. Jesus Prays (Mark
translation_verse: Petro údie kenye ɔnini, “Si ina ɔlɛka badu ami ku-ɔ muedi ni, lɛɛɛdubo bɔsu nnii lɛɛɛgyi-ɔ.” Na lɛni kani na nwuna batɛyane bammɔ ƒui básu. Yesu Ɔ́kpali Katɔ Na Getsemane

english_verse: Again Jesus went to pray and said, “My Father, if there is no other way, and I must suffer, I will still do what you want.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie kunyɔdi na ɔ́kpali ɔnini, “Mina Ɔti, si lɛbibo lɛni ndubo buti mɛni lilávi-mi lɛlɔ na ɔdi-ɔ lɛƒɔyɔ ka liti-ni ni, ya na ɔlɛ lɛni.”

english_verse: Jesus walked on a little way. Then he knelt with his face to the ground and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, don't make me suffer by drinking from this cup. But do what you want, and not what I want.”
translation_verse: Amu ka úsie lɛtɔtɔ blii ni, ɔ́yu úbi kalɔ na ɔ́kpali katɔ ɔnini, “Mina Ɔti, si wadia ni, na aƒɔ lɛbibo ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔmɛni na mina kudɔ. Nsu ni, tabla mina lɛyɔla, mmomu bla ƒula lɛdi.”

english_verse: Get up! Let's go. The one who will betray me is already here.” Jesus Is Arrested (Mark
translation_verse: Bɛta na buteesie. Bɛnu, kakya ɔkyane ɔmmɔ úude.” Yudaƒuɔ Benengu Béƒie Yesu

english_verse: Jesus took along Peter and the two brothers, James and John. He was very sad and troubled,
translation_verse: Úti ku Petro ku Sebedeo bebi inyɔ bammɔ ɔ́da. Na ka bákɛ ni, kɔyɔ kúwi-nwu na lɛƒɛda lɛ́ƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: He came back and found his disciples sleeping. So he said to Peter, “Can't any of you stay awake with me for just one hour?
translation_verse: Ka ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie batɛyane ɛtɛ bammɔ kudɔ ni, ɔ́nu ka baalɛɛ. Na úye Petro ɔnini, “Bítakana na binyeku-mi kagyumana ɔdɔ unwi pɛ?

english_verse: Stay awake and pray that you won't be tested. You want to do what is right, but you are weak.”
translation_verse: Bɛsɔ bilie kagyumana na bɛkpali katɔ kalɛ na bileduo bukpoku taanu kpakplaa kemmo. Kɔyu kɔɔyɔ́ ka kɔbla, nsu ɔlɔna use kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ.”

english_verse: He left them and prayed the same prayer once more.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́da-ma úse na ɔ́sɔ úsie kɔtɛdi na ɔ́kpali katɔ kalɛ na ɔ́kpali úbavi.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “My friend, do what you came for.” The men grabbed Jesus and arrested him.
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɔkpana, bi na aawia mɛni?” Amu na bekyuli bammɔ bébo Yesu kudɔ na béƒie-nwu na báda-nwu kpakplaa.

translation_verse: Yesu ɔmu unye ɔɔtɛmiku-ma asa na Yuda ɔni ndi leevu-inyɔ bammɔ akɔ unwi ɔ́da úbalɛ. Ɔdanku bekyuli lisu lɛni na bakpane benengu ku batɔnkune bédie. Na bada lɛkɛɛ ku ligyii.

english_verse: Judas had told them ahead of time, “Arrest the man I greet with a kiss.”
translation_verse: Kakya ɔkyane ɔmmɔ ɔ́ya na báti bése ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔni na makya kɔgbu ni, anwu ndi ukyuli ɔni na bɛɛwia. Biƒie-nwu.”

english_verse: Judas walked right up to Jesus and said, “Hello, teacher.” Then Judas kissed him.
translation_verse: Ka Yuda ɔ́nya ɔ́nu Yesu kani na úsie-nwu kudɔ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ala ɔtinane, keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-ɔ.” Amu na ɔ́kya-nwu kɔgbu.

english_verse: One of Jesus' followers pulled out a sword. He struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his ear.
translation_verse: Na bani nsiaku Yesu mmɔ kemmo unwi ɔ́ni nwuna ɔkɛɛ ɔ́kpa na úbeyi ɔkpane unengudi kabla ɔblane kɔtu úkulo.

english_verse: But Jesus told him, “Put your sword away. Anyone who lives by fighting will die by fighting.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ti ƒula ɔkɛɛ kya nwuna kakyakɔ. Bekyuli bani mɔɔgyumana lɛlɔ ku lɛkɛɛ ni, lɛkɛɛ kenye na beekpi.

english_verse: But Jesus did not answer. So the high priest said, “With the living God looking on, you must tell the truth. Are you the Messiah, the Son of God?”
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu úbile kenye na útasu lɛla lɛdi. Ɔkpane unengudi ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Lɛ́kpali Katɔti mɔɔkya-a nnii su-bu si awɔ ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔni ndi Katɔti Ubidi ɔmmɔ.”

english_verse: When Peter had gone out to the gate, another servant girl saw him and said to some people there, “This man was with Jesus from Nazareth.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́tɔlɔ mmɔ úténye kaduli kammɔ kayakun. Ulekubi kabla ɔblane ɔbambadi lɛnɔ ɔ́nu Petro na ɔ́su bani nnye mmɔ ɔnii, “Anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́siaku Yesu Nasareni ɔmmɔ.”

english_verse: After Jesus had been arrested, he was led off to the house of Caiaphas the high priest. The nation's leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses were meeting there.
translation_verse: Amu na ama bani néƒie Yesu mmɔ bétiku-nwu bésienku Ɔkpane Unengudi Kaiaƒa kaduli, kesii kani na bakpane benengu ku ɔma benengu ku ɔda bubo ala batinane bása belie.

english_verse: But Peter followed along at a distance and came to the courtyard of the high priest's palace. He went in and sat down with the guards to see what was going to happen.
translation_verse: Petro anwu ɔkpɛ kama buɛɛ na úbavi útéduo kaduli kammɔ kemmo. Útélie kalɔ na bagyumanane bammɔ kudɔ na ɔnu kalɛ na litemi lɛmmɔ lɛdubɔwɔ.

english_verse: The chief priests and the whole council wanted to put Jesus to death. So they tried to find some people who would tell lies about him in court.
translation_verse: Bakpane benengu bamɛni ku litemi batɛne bani nlie mmɔ ƒui báyɔ ka bawiaku Yesu litemi lɛdi lɛni lɛlɔ na basia na bakɛ-nwu badu.

english_verse: But they could not find any, even though many did come and tell lies. At last, two men came forward
translation_verse: Nsu ina ka bekyuli pii bébo bábada-nwu kenye muedi ni, bátakɛ lɛla lɛdi. Nkyuli inyɔ badi bébo

english_verse: “That is what you say!” Jesus answered. “But I tell all of you, ‘Soon you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right side of God All-Powerful and coming on the clouds of heaven.’ ”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɛɛn. Awɔ násu, na use lɛni sɔsɔ. Na mɔɔsu-mii nnii uwi klukui kemmo ni, bɛdubɔnu Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ɔmmɔ ka ulie Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui kɔdianu. Na bɛdubɔnu ka ɔ́si katɔ ɔdubo na ulɔyɔ kemmo!”

english_verse: Then they spit in his face and hit him with their fists. Others slapped him
translation_verse: Amu na bétuo lisuo béwi-nwu anumi na bébo-nwu. Na badi lɛnɔ báƒiɛmi-nwu lɛtugya.

translation_verse: Na béye-nwu banii, “Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ na adi? Su-bu ukyuli ɔni nébo-ɔ!” Petro Ɔ́su Kɔtɛ Ƒui Ɔnii Ɔɔɔgyi Yesu

translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́sɔ ɔ́tuala na ɔ́kpali ala ɔnini, “Lɛɛɛgyi ukyuli ɔmmɔ!”

english_verse: While Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, a servant girl came up to him and said, “You were with Jesus from Galilee.”
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔmu ulie keyi mmɔ asa na ɔkpane unengudi kabla ɔblane ɔni ndi ulekubi úbo mmɔ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ lɛnɔ ásiaku Yesu ɔni nási Galilea kalɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: But in front of everyone Peter said, “That isn't so! I don't know what you are talking about!”
translation_verse: Nsu Petro ɔ́tuala na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui anumi ɔnii, “Ńtenu lɛla lɛni na aasu mɛni kalɔ.”

english_verse: A little while later some people standing there walked over to Peter and said, “We know you are one of them. We can tell it because you talk like someone from Galilee.”
translation_verse: Uwi útetu asa na bani nnye mmɔ bébo bábasu Petro banii, “Útalɛka eni anii aaadi-ma akɔ unwi. Ɔsika ƒula butemi buudie-ɔ keyi nwaa.”

english_verse: Peter began to curse and swear, “I don't know that man!” Right then a rooster crowed,
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́sɔ ɔ́kpali ala momoomo ɔnini, “Katɔti ɔni-mi kɔtu si ɔkɔ na mɔɔnyi nnii lɛɛɛgyi ukyuli ɔmmɔ.” Kɔnakunwi ni, akɔkɔ úte kenye.

english_verse: and Peter remembered that Jesus had said, “Before a rooster crows, you will say three times you don't know me.” Then Peter went out and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Na Petro únyimo lɛla lɛni Yesu ɔ́su ɔnini, “Asa na akɔkɔ ɔdubute kenye ni, adubɔsu kɔtɛ sɔɔn ka aaagyi-mi.” Anwuɔsu ɔ́lɛ keyi na útéwulo geen.

english_verse: Pilate knew the leaders had brought Jesus to him because they were jealous.
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla lɛni ɔsika ɔgyi ka lɛnungyie ɔsu na Yudaƒuɔ benengu bammɔ bédie-nwu béte.

english_verse: On the way they met a man named Simon who was from Cyrene, and they forced him to carry Jesus' cross.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bási ɔma kemmo bakɛ bésela ni, básiaku ɔnana ɔdi ɔni nási Kirene na baalɔ-nwu banii Simon. Bekpone bammɔ béƒie-nwu banii ɔlɛka ubunku Yesu ugyii ɔmmɔ buti.

english_verse: and said, “I have sinned by betraying a man who has never done anything wrong.” “So what? That's your problem,” they replied.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Lɛ́bla likpidi ka lɛ́kya ukyuli ɔni nátaƒiɔ ɔmmɔ kakya nnii badu-nwu.” Na bédie kenye banini, “Ɔmɛni anwu ɔɔɔkɛ-bu. Ƒula litemi na lɛdi!”

english_verse: Then they had a meeting and decided to buy a field that belonged to someone who made clay pots. They wanted to use it as a graveyard for foreigners.
translation_verse: Na ka básala eli ni, bálɛ-nwu ugyii banii badubuti egulabi amɛni betéye kalɔ kani baalɔ banii Ɔvɔne Kalɔ, na bataava baƒɔ na mmɔ.

english_verse: This is why people still call that place “Field of Blood.”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, baalɔ kalɔ kammɔ banii Ubugya Kalɔ úbalɛ ɔmwi.

translation_verse: bétéye ɔvɔne kalɔ aani kalɛ na Unwoti ɔ́su-mi.” Pilato Úye Yesu Etemila

english_verse: Jesus was brought before Pilate the governor, who asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?” “Those are your words!” Jesus answered.
translation_verse: Na béti Yesu bényene Romaƒuɔ aban unengu Pilato anumi. Na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ ndi Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga?” Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Awɔ mɔɔsu.”

english_verse: And when the chief priests and leaders brought their charges against him, he did not say a thing.

translation_verse: Nsu ɔ́bla aban unengu ɔmmɔ kalɛ kadi geen ka Yesu útakya-nwu kenye muedi. Pilato Ɔ́du Yesu Kukpi Kɔtɔ

translation_verse: Amu na Pilato ɔ́nyonu Baraba úte-ma. Na ka ɔ́ya na béti kɔbuli kɔni na bélii básala na bébo Yesu kaduɛ ni, ɔ́nyonu-nwu úte aban bekpone ɔnii bakana-nwu bamana ugyii lɛlɔ. Romaƒuɔ Bekpone Béwi Yesu Anumi Kalɔ

translation_verse: Bekyuli bani návi mmɔ ƒui bákunku bana eli na bédumi Yesu.

english_verse: Pilate saw that there was nothing he could do and that the people were starting to riot. So he took some water and washed his hands in front of them and said, “I won't have anything to do with killing this man. You are the ones doing it!”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Pilato ɔ́nu ka ɔ́sɔ ulakana lɛla lɛdi bɔbla, na mmomu unyeƒi kpakplaa ndubo bɔlɛ ni, úti ntu na ɔ́ƒɔ enu na bekyuli bammɔ anumi na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔmɛni kukpi kɔɔɔsia-mi lɛlɔ! Bina litemi na lɛdi.”

english_verse: Everyone answered, “We and our own families will take the blame for his death!”
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli lisu lɛmmɔ ƒui bédie kenye banii, “Nwuna kukpi kɔsia abu ku bula bebi lili!”

english_verse: They made a crown out of thorn branches and placed it on his head, and they put a stick in his right hand. The soldiers knelt down and pretended to worship him. They made fun of him and shouted, “Hey, you king of the Jews!”
translation_verse: Na bédi liyu kabwa bébi-nwu lili asa na béti ugyii bákya-nwu kɔdianu lɛkɔkɔ. Bábla-nwu ala amɛni ƒui aani ɔga kalɛ. Na bálɛ akɔnkɔ na nwuna anumi, na baamá-nwu taasu banii, “Yiidu! Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga ulie ngba gyɔlɔɔ!”

english_verse: When the soldiers had finished making fun of Jesus, they took off the robe. They put his own clothes back on him and led him off to be nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na báma-nwu lɛni báwɔlɔ ni, bédie-nwu awu ugyiedi ɔmmɔ na básɔku nwuna lɛwu bákya-nwu. Amu na bétiku-nwu bátɔlɔku banii batákana-nwu bamana ugyii lɛlɔ. Bákana Yesu Bámana Ugyii Lɛlɔ

english_verse: There they gave Jesus some wine mixed with a drug to ease the pain. But when Jesus tasted what it was, he refused to drink it.
translation_verse: Béte Yesu ntɛ bɔni na básala ku kuvo kɔni mbo ɔdu kati kati banii ɔni. Nsu ka útu-mu ɔnu ni, útani.

english_verse: The soldiers nailed Jesus to a cross and gambled to see who would get his clothes.
translation_verse: Amu na bekpone bammɔ bákana-nwu bámana ugyii lɛlɔ na bátu egulabi asa na béti nwuna lɛwu béle béte lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then they sat down to guard him.
translation_verse: Nwuna kama ni, básɔ bélie kalɔ na bágyumana-nwu.

english_verse: Above his head they put a sign that told why he was nailed there. It read, “This is Jesus, the King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Na bébo kegyiikɛ kadi bámana-nwu eli. Na bénweni lɛla lɛni ɔsu na bádu-nwu básia-ka lɛlɔ banii, “Yesu, Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga, mɛni.”

english_verse: shouted, “So you're the one who claimed you could tear down the temple and build it again in three days! If you are God's Son, save yourself and come down from the cross!”

english_verse: Others said, “Wait! Let's see if Elijah will come and save him.”

translation_verse: Bana akɔ unwi úkeli útéti unwo ɔni na béti bákya ntɛ bɔni nányi kemmo na úti ɔ́tu ugyii ɔdi lɛlɔ úboku-nwu ɔnii ɔni.

english_verse: Graves opened, and many of God's people were raised to life.

translation_verse: Na ka bávi bálɛ bana kɔƒiɔtɔ kemmo na Yesu bɔsɔ bɔta kama ni, bésie Yudaƒuɔ ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ kemmo, na bédie bana lɛlɔ keyi bátina bekyuli pii.

english_verse: Many women had come with Jesus from Galilee to be of help to him, and they were there, looking on at a distance.

translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na useyi uwi údu ni, ɔnana ɔlakɛne ɔdi baalɔ Yoseƒ na ɔdi Yesu ɔtɛyane ɔ́si Arimatea úbo.

english_verse: They said, “Sir, we remember what this liar said while he was still alive. He claimed in three days he would come back from death.
translation_verse: Na básu-nwu banini, “Unengu, uwi ɔni na ɔkɔ ɔnyine ɔmmɔ úlie ngba ni, ɔ́su ɔnini, ‘Si líkpi ni, nsɔ ndubɔta lɛlɛ bekpine akɔ emeyi atɛ kama.’

english_verse: So please order the tomb to be carefully guarded for three days. If you don't, his disciples may come and steal his body. They will tell the people he has been raised to life, and this last lie will be worse than the first one.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu su kpakplaa anii bagyumanane banu kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ kaduɛ utálɛ limeyi lɛtɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ kalɛ na nwuna batɛyane bammɔ beléyu ukpine ɔmmɔ na basu banii ɔ́ta ɔ́lɛ bekpine akɔ. Ɔsika buláwia ka katɔlɔ kani masia ketulo kedeedi.”

english_verse: Pilate said to them, “All right, take some of your soldiers and guard the tomb as well as you know how.”
translation_verse: Amu na Pilato ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Biti bekpone bisienku na bitágyumana kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ kalɛ biala bɛdubɔkana.”

english_verse: Jesus' eleven disciples went to a mountain in Galilee, where Jesus had told them to meet him.
