translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bitayia. Biteesie na bitásu mina banwa bɛnii beteesie Galilea. Mmɔ na badubɔnu-mi.” Bekpone Bagyumanane Bammɔ Básu Lɛla Lɛni Na Bánu

english_verse: Suddenly a strong earthquake struck, and the Lord's angel came down from heaven. He rolled away the stone and sat on it.
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, kalɔ kákunku momoomo geen. Na Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi ɔ́yu ɔ́si katɔ úbo na úbeminime lɛtakpɛ lɛmmɔ, na úlie-ni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The angel looked as bright as lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
translation_verse: Nwuna lɛlɔ liikeye aani ɔƒɛ na nwuna awu use ƒututuu.

english_verse: The guards shook from fear and fell down, as though they were dead.
translation_verse: Liƒu lɛ́da bagyumanane bammɔ na lɛlɔ lɛ́tɔ-ma geen, na básinsi bátɛ aani bekpine.

english_verse: The angel said to the women, “Don't be afraid! I know you are looking for Jesus, who was nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Amu na Katɔti ɔtu ɔmmɔ útemiku beleku bammɔ na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bitayia. Ngyi ka bɛɛwia Yesu ɔni na bákana bámana ugyii lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Now hurry! Tell his disciples he has been raised to life and is on his way to Galilee. Go there, and you will see him. This is what I came to tell you.”
translation_verse: Bisie pla na bitásu nwuna batɛyane bɛnii ɔ́ta ɔ́lɛ bekpine akɔ ulie ngba, na ɔtɔ-mii anumi úsela Galilea. Mmɔ na bɛdubɔnu-nwu. Ɔmɛni ɔsu nkɛ.”

english_verse: Suddenly Jesus met them and greeted them. They went near him, held on to his feet, and worshiped him.
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, ama ku Yesu bása na ulu lɛlɔ. Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Lígyele-mii.” Mmɔ na bákpɛ béde-nwu na béboku lɛlɔ kalɔ báda-nwu lɛgba na bémwi-nwu.

english_verse: While the women were on their way, some soldiers who had been guarding the tomb went into the city. They told the chief priests everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na beleku bammɔ bénwini bésela ni, bekpone bammɔ badi bésie ɔma kemmo na bátásu Yudaƒuɔ bakpane benengu bammɔ ala ani nálɛ mmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: They said to the soldiers, “Tell everyone that Jesus' disciples came during the night and stole his body while you were asleep.
translation_verse: na básu-ma banini, “Bɛsu bɛnii usien uwi ɔni na bɛɛlɛɛ ni, nwuna batɛyane bébo na bébeyu ukpine ɔmmɔ bátɔlɔku.

english_verse: The soldiers took the money and did what they were told. The people of Judea still tell each other this story. What Jesus' Followers Must Do (Mark
translation_verse: Bagyumanane bammɔ báƒɔ egulabi ammɔ na bábla aani kalɛ na básu-ma. Na Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ bégyingya Yesu ukpine buyu litemi lɛmmɔ na bana akɔ úbalɛ ɔmwi. Yesu Údie Lɛlɔ Ɔ́tina Nwuna Batɛyane

english_verse: Jesus came to them and said: I have been given all authority in heaven and on earth!
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́kpɛ úde-ma na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Katɔti úti katɔ ku kalɔ ɔyikun ƒui úte-mi.

english_verse: Go to the people of all nations and make them my disciples. Baptize them in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu biteesie kayawi kadi biala bekyuli akɔ na bɛtina-ma ala kalɛ na benwini mina batɛyane. Na bɛkpila-ma ntu na Ati ku Ubi ku Katɔti Kɔyu lɛnyi kemmo.

english_verse: They saw him and worshiped him, but some of them doubted.
translation_verse: Na ka bánu-nwu ni, bana badi bémwi-nwu. Nsu badi lɛnɔ kasusu kábla-ma inyɔ inyɔ.

english_verse: Right then the two brothers dropped their nets and went with him.
translation_verse: Na kɔnakunwi ni, báda bana lɛsawu béwi na báta básiaku-nwu.

english_verse: Jesus walked on and soon saw James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in a boat, mending their nets.
translation_verse: Úsie anumi blii úbu na ɔ́nu banwani inyɔ badi bani ndi Sebedeo bebi Yakobo ku Yohane. Na belie bana ɔkɔlɔ kemmo baaklibi bana lɛsawu.

english_verse: News about Jesus quickly spread all over Galilee. Jesus Heals Many People (Matthew
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yesu lɛlɔ litemi lígyingya na Galilea kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Bekyuli Pii

english_verse: It began just as God had said in the book written by Isaiah the prophet, “I am sending my messenger to get the way ready for you.
translation_verse: Kukuuku ni, Katɔti Kenye Udiene Yesaia únweni úse ka Katɔti ɔ́su Ubidi ɔnini, “Ndubɔtala ɔtu ɔdi na wagyu watɔ-ɔ, kalɛ na ɔklibi bekyuli ute ƒula bubo.

english_verse: John wore clothes made of camel's hair. He had a leather strap around his waist and ate grasshoppers and wild honey.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ni, Yohane ɔkya ɔƒlumu linwini awu, na úti ebuo ɔku kabuli ɔ́da kavobi. Nwuna adila ani na ɔɔdi ndi uwɔ ku baalɔlɔ bani muubile edula.

english_verse: John also told the people, “Someone more powerful is going to come. And I am not good enough even to stoop down and untie his sandals.
translation_verse: Nwuna linyesia lɛni lɛlɔ na ɔɔkɔ́ lɛsa ndi ɔnii, “Ukyuli ɔni nkpɛ-mi kama ɔdubo ni, anwu utulo-mi ƒui. Ńtedu ka lɛbla kabla kadi lite-nwu muedi.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples went to the town of Capernaum. Then on the next Sabbath he went into the synagogue and started teaching.
translation_verse: Yesu ku nwuna basiakune bamɛni bésie bétéduo ɔma ɔni baalɔ Kapernaum. Na lɛnwunameyi lɛni nébo na bana mmɔ busie kama ni, Yesu úsie bana kasalakɔ na úsie ɔkya ɔɔsu litemi buni.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed at his teaching. He taught with authority, and not like the teachers of the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla bekyuli bani nénu nwuna ala bɔtina kalɛ kadi, ɔsika uuuse aani ama bani baatina ɔda bubo. Mmomu ni, ɔɔtina ala ku ɔyikun taasiku nwuna kayi kemmo.

english_verse: About that time Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee, and John baptized him in the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Uwi útetu asa na Yesu ɔ́si ɔma ɔni baalɔ Nasaret na Galilea kalɔ lɛlɔ úbo, na ɔ́ƒɔ Yohane ntu bɔkpila ɔdi na Yordan kemmo.

english_verse: As soon as Jesus came out of the water, he saw the sky open and the Holy Spirit coming down to him like a dove.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́nya ɔ́lɛ ntu bɔmmɔ kemmo ni, ɔ́nu ka katɔ kébimi na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́si kɔɔyu-nwu lɛlɔ aani aasɛ.

english_verse: A man with leprosy came to Jesus and knelt down. He begged, “You have the power to make me well, if only you wanted to.”
translation_verse: Ɔnana ɔdi muuƒi ɔlɛgyie úbo Yesu kudɔ. Ɔ́lɛ akɔnkɔ, na úvele-nwu ɔnii ubunku-nwu. Ɔ́su Yesu ɔnii, “Si aayɔ́ ni, akana na abwi-mi na lɛlɔ lɛbla-mi sɛɛn.”

english_verse: He said, “The time has come! God's kingdom will soon be here. Turn back to God and believe the good news!” Jesus Chooses Four Fishermen (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɔkya ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Uwi ɔbuni ɔmmɔ úudu. Katɔti lɛga bɔdi uwi úude. Binwini kama bɛkya bina ekpidi na bɛƒɔ litemi buni lɛmɛni bɛdi!”

english_verse: At once Jesus asked them to come with him. They left their father in the boat with the hired workers and went with him. A Man with an Evil Spirit (Luke
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́nu-ma kani na ɔ́lɔ-ma. Ama lɛnɔ báta kɔnakunwi na báda bana ɔti Sebedeo ku nwuna kabla bablane lɛti pɛ bákya ɔkɔlɔ kemmo, na básiaku Yesu. Yesu Ɔ́gya Kɔyu Kukpidi Ɔ́lɛku Ɔnana Ɔdi Kemmo

english_verse: Jesus went to her. He took hold of her hand and helped her up. The fever left her, and she served them a meal.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yesu úsie útéduo-nwu kudɔ, na úƒie-nwu kɔnu ɔ́da na ɔ́tala-nwu únyene. Kɔnakunwi na nwuna ɔlɛ ɔ́da-nwu ɔ́ya, na ɔ́ta na úte-ma adila.

english_verse: And when they found him, they said, “Everyone is looking for you!”
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni bánu-nwu ni, básu-nwu banini, “Bekyuli pii bakya baawia-a!”

english_verse: Suddenly a man with an evil spirit in him entered the synagogue and yelled,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kani kemmo ni, ɔnana ɔdi ɔni na kɔyu kukpidi kulie-nwu lɛlɔ ɔkya kasalakɔ mmɔ na ɔ́va momoomo ɔnini,

english_verse: “Jesus from Nazareth, what do you want with us? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are! You are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: “Yesu Nasareni, bi na aawia asiku bula kudɔ? Bubo na ébo anii abakyula-bu? Ngyi ukyuli ɔni na adi. Awɔ ndi Katɔti Ɔtalane Kedee!”

english_verse: Jesus told the evil spirit, “Be quiet and come out of the man!”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́bala kɔyu kɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Da bɔtɛmi ya! Na avi alɛ ɔnana ɔmmɔ kemmo.”

english_verse: The spirit shook him. Then it gave a loud shout and left.
translation_verse: Kɔyu kɔmɛni kɔ́kunku ɔnana ɔmɛni momoomo na kɔ́ya-nwu na ɔ́va asa na kɔ́vi kɔ́lɛ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Everyone was completely surprised and kept saying to each other, “What is this? It must be some new kind of powerful teaching! Even the evil spirits obey him.”
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla bekyuli bani nnye ƒui yaa na béye lɛlɔ banii, “Bi litemi lɛdi mɛni? Bi bɔkpa bɔwɔdi udu na bɔmɛni bɔdi? Ukyuli ɔmɛni ubo ɔyikun ɔni na ɔɔtɛmi ku ayu ekpidi na eenú-nwu litemi!”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “We must go to the nearby towns, so that I can tell the good news to those people. This is why I have come.”
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛya na busie lɛma lɛbambadi lɛnɔ. Ɔlɛka lɛsu ama lɛnɔ litemi buni lɛmɛni, ɔsika ɔmɛni ndi mina kabla kani na líbo mabla na kayawi kemmo.”

english_verse: Jesus felt sorry for the man. So he put his hand on him and said, “I want to! Now you are well.”
translation_verse: Nwuna lɛlɔ lɛ́kywi Yesu kaƒɔ, anwuɔsu únene kɔnu na útuku-nwu. Amu na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Mɔɔyɔ́. Lɛlɔ lɛbla-a sɛɛn ƒui!”

english_verse: As soon as Jesus left the synagogue with James and John, they went home with Simon and Andrew.
translation_verse: Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane ku Yakobo ku Yohane bálɛ kasalakɔ mmɔ, na bátɔlɔ bésie Simon ku Andrea kaduli.

english_verse: When they got there, Jesus was told that Simon's mother-in-law was sick in bed with fever.
translation_verse: Ka bétéduo mmɔ ni, bekyuli badi básu Yesu ka Simon ulekudi uni uuƒi ɔtɛ ɔni na lɛlɔ lɛbi-nwu.

english_verse: That evening after sunset, all who were sick or had demons in them were brought to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka useyi uwi údu ni, bekyuli béti balɛne pii ku bekyuli bani na ayu ekpidi asiaku-ma béboku Yesu banii ɔbwi-ma.

english_verse: In fact, the whole town gathered around the door of the house.
translation_verse: Na ɔma ɔmmɔ bekyuli ƒui bébenye kayakun mmɔ baanu.

english_verse: Jesus healed all kinds of terrible diseases and forced out a lot of demons. But the demons knew who he was, and he did not let them speak.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́bwi bekyuli pii bani muuƒi lɛlɛ lidu lidu na ɔ́gya ayu ekpidi pii lɛnɔ ɔ́lɛku bekyuli bani na ayu ekpidi asiaku-ma lɛlɔ. Ka Yesu ɔgyi ɔnii ayu amɛni agyi ukyuli ɔni na ɔdi ɔsu ni, útatuna ka ayu ammɔ asu lɛla lɛdi asiku nwuna lɛlɔ. Yesu Ɔ́kɔ Litemi Buni Lɛmmɔ Lɛsa Na Galilea

english_verse: Very early the next morning before daylight, Jesus got up and went to a place where he could be alone and pray.
translation_verse: Ɔtanta tutuutu asa na kadi kadubɔda ni, Yesu ɔ́ta ɔ́lɛ kaduli mmɔ. Na ɔ́lɛ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo úsie kesii kani na ukyuli ɔdi biala uuude, na útákpali katɔ.

english_verse: Simon and the others started looking for him.
translation_verse: Kama ni, Simon ku nwuna bakpana bésie bakya baawia Yesu.

english_verse: Then Jesus went to their synagogues everywhere in Galilee, where he preached and forced out demons. Jesus Heals a Man (Matthew
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu úsie ɔ́vi Galilea kalɔ kesii biala. Ɔkɛ ɔɔsu litemi buni na kasalakɔ, na ɔɔgyá ayu ekpidi taalɛku bekyuli lɛlɔ lɛnɔ. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Ɔnana Ɔdi

english_verse: After Jesus strictly warned the man, he sent him on his way.
translation_verse: Mmɔ kani na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ka ɔtɔlɔ mmɔ, na úbo-nwu ɔda kpakplaa ɔnini,

english_verse: He said, “Don't tell anyone about this. Just go and show the priest that you are well. Then take a gift to the temple as Moses commanded, and everyone will know that you have been healed.”
translation_verse: “Tedi tenye ulu lɛlɔ na asu bekyuli lɛla lɛni nébo. Mmomu teesie na eti lɛlɔ atátina ɔkpane. Na ete akpala ani na Mose ɔda bubo bɔ́tina. Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔtina bakpane bammɔ ka ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́ba-a na ábla sɛɛn.”

english_verse: The man talked about it so much and told so many people, that Jesus could no longer go openly into a town. He had to stay away from the towns, but people still came to him from everywhere.
translation_verse: Nsu ka ukyuli ɔmɛni úsela ni, úse kalɔ ɔɔva taasu kalɛ na Yesu ɔ́bwi-nwu. Na ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, Yesu útakana na uduo ɔma ɔdi kemmo, ɔsika bekyuli pii beebo-nwu kudɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu Yesu ɔ́ƒɔ lɛlɔ ɔkya alakpi akɔ. Nsu bekyuli básɔ bási ekpo ekpo bébo-nwu kudɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Then so many of them came to the house that there wasn't even standing room left in front of the door. Jesus was still teaching
translation_verse: Uwi útetu asa na bekyuli bébeyi kesii kani na úduo mmɔ na kaduli ku keyi ƒui. Na ɔkya ɔɔsu-ma litemi buni lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: when four people came up, carrying a man on a mat because he could not walk.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na nkyuli ine béti ɔlɛne ɔdi náƒɛ uwi kalɔ béboku-nwu.

english_verse: But because of the crowd, they could not get him to Jesus. So they made a hole in the roof above him and let the man down in front of everyone.
translation_verse: Na ka bátakɛ kavinkɔ na kayakun ɔ́si bekyuli bumomo ɔsu ni, bátákɔ ɔtɔ katɔ na báyula ɔlɛne ɔmmɔ ku nwuna atɛla báva Yesu anumi.

english_verse: “Why would he say such a thing? He must think he is God! Only God can forgive sins.”
translation_verse: “Bi ɔsu na ɔɔtɛmi lɛni? Katɔti lɛti mɔɔkana ekpidi buti taakyiɛ!”

english_verse: I will show you that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” So Jesus said to the man,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu kalɛ na bɛƒɔ bɛdi ka ami ɔni ndi Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi mbo kuƒi ka liti ekpidi lɛkyiɛ bekyuli na kayawi kamɛni kemmo ɔsu ni, bɛnu!”

english_verse: “Get up! Pick up your mat and go on home.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Yesu ɔ́sɔ únwini anumi ɔ́tina ɔlɛne ɔmmɔ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ta, na eti ƒula lɛtala na eteesie kaduli.”

english_verse: Once again, Jesus went to the shore of Lake Galilee. A large crowd gathered around him, and he taught them.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie Galilea Ɛpu kudɔ na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bébo nwuna kudɔ mmɔ, na ɔ́su-ma litemi buni.

english_verse: Jesus finished by saying, “People were not made for the good of the Sabbath. The Sabbath was made for the good of people.
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Katɔti úse lɛnwunameyi úte ukyuli lɛbuni. Na ɔɔɔdi ukyuli na úse úte lɛnwunameyi.

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples were having dinner at Levi's house. Many tax collectors and other sinners had become followers of Jesus, and they were also guests at the dinner.
translation_verse: Useyi uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane ku bekyuli pii bani nsiaku-nwu bébo Lewi kesii banii babadiku-nwu. Na basiakune bammɔ akɔ ni, badi badi kuyi baƒɔne ku alaekpidi bablane. Amu na ɔda bubo ala batinane bani nkya Yudaƒuɔ lɛkpa linwi lɛni baalɔ Ƒarisiƒuɔ kemmo lɛnɔ bébo mmɔ.

english_verse: Some of the teachers of the Law of Moses were Pharisees, and they saw Jesus eating with sinners and tax collectors. So they asked his disciples, “Why does he eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu uwi ɔni na ɔda bubo ala batinane bani nási Ƒarisiƒuɔ lɛkpa lɛmmɔ kemmo bánu ka Yesu ulie ɔɔdiku bekyuli bani lɛlɔ neeebo ɔbu mɛni ni, béye nwuna batɛyane banii, “Dɛ na ɔ́bla na anwu ku bekyuli bamɛni udu nlie mɔɔdi?”

english_verse: The followers of John the Baptist and the Pharisees often went without eating. Some people came and asked Jesus, “Why do the followers of John and those of the Pharisees often go without eating, while your disciples never do?”
translation_verse: Amu uwi ɔdi ka Yohane ku nwuna batɛyane ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ beelie kɔka na bana katɔ bɔkpali ɔsu ni, bekyuli badi bébo Yesu kudɔ bébeye-nwu banii, “Bi ɔsu na ƒula batɛyane ama belélie kɔka aani kalɛ na Yohane badi ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ beelie kɔka?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: The friends of a bridegroom don't go without eating while he is still with them.
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye na úbo-ma lɛgba ɔnii, “Uleku ɔgya bakpana beení adila na uleku ketikɔ? Munuu útalɛka ebiti ada-ma ka uleku ɔgya ɔkya-ma akɔ?

english_verse: But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.
translation_verse: Nsu limeyi lɛdi ni, badubuti-nwu bɔtɔlɔku nwuna bakpana kudɔ na bakpana bammɔ badubunyimi kenye ku kɔnyana.

english_verse: No one patches old clothes by sewing on a piece of new cloth. The new piece would shrink and tear a bigger hole.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ulétile kɔdi kɔkukudi liƒi ku lɛdiku lɛwɔdi. Lɛdiku lɛwɔdi lɛmmɔ lɛdubɔni kɔkukudi kɔmmɔ kugyingya si báƒɔ-ku. Na ɔdubɔya na liƒi lɛkukudi lɛmmɔ liibómo litulo kalɛ na lise kudeedi.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined. New wine must be put into new wineskins. A Question about the Sabbath (Matthew
translation_verse: Na lɛnɔ ni, beléti ntɛ bɔwɔdi teewi ɔku koƒo kɔkukudi kɔni kemmo béewi ntɛ dii. Ntɛ bɔwɔdi bɔdubuƒuƒuo na bɔya ɔku koƒo kɔkukudi kɔmmɔ kɔbwɛ na ntɛ ku koƒo lɛnɔ kulálɛ kɔsia. Mmomu ni, ntɛ bɔwɔdi beeti teewi ɔku koƒo kɔwɔdi kemmo.” Ƒarisiƒuɔ Bákyaku Yesu Unyeƒi Na Kalɛ Na Badi Lɛnwunameyi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: One Sabbath Jesus and his disciples were walking through some wheat fields. His disciples were picking grains of wheat as they went along.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdi ka Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane bási baaví anta kemo kadi kemmo na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ ni, báƒɛ anta amɛni adi na baakun.

english_verse: Some Pharisees asked Jesus, “Why are your disciples picking grain on the Sabbath? They are not supposed to do that!”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Ƒarisiƒuɔ badi básu Yesu banii, “Bi ɔsu na ƒula batɛyane baabla lɛni? Bula ɔda bubo útete kuƒi ka babla lɛni na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: So the Son of Man is Lord over the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ndi lɛnwunameyi lɛnɔ Unwoti.”

english_verse: The Pharisees wanted to accuse Jesus of doing something wrong, and they kept watching to see if Jesus would heal him on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Ƒarisiƒuɔ badi bakya kasalakɔ kammɔ. Na benye baanu si ɔdubɔbwi ɔnana ɔmmɔ na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ na bawia-nwu litemi.

english_verse: Jesus told the man to stand up where everyone could see him.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́lɔ ɔnana ɔni na kɔnu kunwi kɔ́gogolo-nwu mmɔ ɔnii ubenye bekyuli ƒui anumi.

english_verse: Jesus was angry as he looked around at the people. Yet he felt sorry for them because they were so stubborn. Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his bad hand was healed.
translation_verse: Yesu únwini ɔ́nu bana ƒui na kɔnyi kemmo, ɔsika livo líƒi-nwu na bana ukyulikpana kebunku tete ɔsu. Amu na ɔ́su ɔlɛne ɔmɛni ɔnii, “Nene kɔnu boku.” Únene kɔnu. Na kɔnakunwi ni, nwuna kɔnu kɔ́ba-nwu.

english_verse: Jesus decided to ask some of his disciples to go up on a mountain with him, and they went.
translation_verse: Nwuna kama ni, Yesu úsie kɔbi kɔdi lɛlɔ. Na mmɔ ni, ɔ́lɔ nwuna basiakune bani na ɔɔwia.

english_verse: and to force out demons.
translation_verse: Bɛdubɔgya ayu ekpidi bɔlɛku bekyuli lɛlɔ kemmo.”

english_verse: Some teachers of the Law of Moses came from Jerusalem and said, “This man is under the power of Beelzebul, the ruler of demons! He is even forcing out demons with the help of Beelzebul.”
translation_verse: Na ɔda bubo ala batinane bani nási Yerusalem básu banii, “Kɔyu kukpidi kɔkya Yesu lɛlɔ kemmo. Na ayu ekpidi ɔtɔnkune Beelsebul néte-nwu ɔyikun asa na ɔɔkana ayu ammɔ bɔbɔku taalɛku bekyuli lɛlɔ kemmo!”

english_verse: The crowd sitting around Jesus told him, “Your mother and your brothers and sisters are outside and want to see you.”
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli bani náka bámana-nwu mmɔ básu Yesu banini, “Nu, ƒ'ini ku ƒula banwani benye keyi baawia-a banii bo!”

english_verse: Jesus told the people to gather around him. Then he spoke to them in riddles and said: How can Satan force himself out?
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yesu ɔ́lɔ-ma na ɔ́tɛmiku-ma na lɛgba kemmo ɔnini, “Dɛ na wabla asa na Satan wabɔku anwu ɔlati walɛku ukyuli lɛlɔ kemmo?

english_verse: Jesus went back home, and once again such a large crowd gathered that there was no chance even to eat.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́si mmɔ ni, ɔ́tɔlɔ úbo kaduli kadi. Na bekyuli pii badi básɔ bébo-ma kudɔ mmɔ. Anwuɔsu ɔ́yu Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane ɔkplu ka bakɛ kuƒi badi muedi.

english_verse: A nation whose people fight each other won't last very long.
translation_verse: Si lɛga kadikɔ kadi kéle lɛlɔ akpa akpa na akpa ammɔ eekpóku lɛlɔ ni, lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ kalakana bunye.

english_verse: And a family that fights won't last long either.
translation_verse: Si ɔtɔ ɔdi bekyuli béle lɛlɔ ati ati na beekpóku lɛlɔ ni, ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ulakana bunye.

english_verse: So if Satan fights against himself, that will be the end of him.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si Satan ɔ́ta unye uukpóku lɛlɔ na nwuna lɛga kadikɔ kéle lɛlɔ akpa akpa ni, lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ kadubɔbwɛ, na nwuna lɛga bɔdi bubo kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: How can anyone break into the house of a strong man and steal his things, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can take everything.
translation_verse: “Na sɔsɔ geen ni, ukyuli ɔdi ulakana na weduo ukyuli ɔni mbo ɔyikun ɔtɔ kemmo na uti nwuna ala ɔtɔlɔku. Amu ntu ɔ́ka ɔyikune ɔmɛni buƒie bunyimi asa na wakana-nwu ɔtɔ kemmo buduo buti nwuna ala.

english_verse: I promise you that any of the sinful things you say or do can be forgiven, no matter how terrible those things are.
translation_verse: “Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka Katɔti ɔdubuti alaekpidi biala na bekyuli bábla ku anyikpi biala ani na bálɔ Katɔti ɔkyiɛ-ma.

english_verse: But if you speak against the Holy Spirit, you can never be forgiven. That sin will be held against you forever.
translation_verse: Nsu anyikpi ani na ukyuli ɔdi ɔdubɔlɔ Katɔti Kɔyu ni, Katɔti uleti ulakyiɛ-nwu kudi kudii. Ɔsika ɔdubuti likpidi lɛmɛni aani likpidi lɛni na ulayiƒala kudii.”

english_verse: Jesus said this because the people were saying that he had an evil spirit in him. Jesus' Mother and Brothers (Matthew
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su ɔmɛni ɔsika bekyuli bammɔ básu banii kɔyu kukpidi kɔkya anwu Yesu lɛlɔ kemmo. Ɔma Ndi Yesu Banwani Geen?

english_verse: Jesus' mother and brothers came and stood outside. Then they sent someone with a message for him to come out to them.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Yesu banwani ku nwuna uni bébo mmɔ. Kalɛ bekyuli bemomo mmɔ ɔsu ni, bátala ɔtu na nwuna kudɔ ka baawia-nwu.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “Who is my mother and who are my brothers?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye-ma ɔnini, “Ɔma ndi mina uni? Ɔma bene ndi mina banwani?”

english_verse: Then he looked at the people sitting around him and said, “Here are my mother and my brothers.
translation_verse: Amu na únwini ɔ́nu bekyuli bani nlie bámana-nwu mmɔ na ɔ́su ɔnii, “Bɛnu, bamɛni ndi mina uni iye mina banwani!

english_verse: Anyone who obeys God is my brother or sister or mother.”
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔbla Katɔti lɛƒɔyɔ ni, anwu ndi mina ɔnwani ɔnanabi iye mina ɔnwani ulekubi iye mina uni.”

english_verse: The next time Jesus taught beside Lake Galilee, a big crowd gathered. It was so large that he had to sit in a boat out on the lake, while the people stood on the shore.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́sɔ úsie Galilea Ɛpu kudɔ na úsie ɔɔtina litemi buni lɛmmɔ. Na bekyuli pii bani nábaka bámana-nwu bumomo ɔsu ni, úduo ɔkɔlɔ ɔdi nsia ntu anumi kemmo na úlie kalɔ. Na bekyuli bammɔ bébenye utubili na Yesu ɔɔtɛmiku-ma.

english_verse: While the farmer was scattering the seed, some of it fell along the road and was eaten by birds.
translation_verse: Ka ɔkya ɔɔgya edula amɛni ni, adi álɛ ébo kuludɔ, na baasɛ bébo na bála-nya bádi.

english_verse: He used stories to teach them many things, and this is part of what he taught:
translation_verse: Uwi pii na nwuna ala bɔtina kemmo ni, agba na uubó teeti teedie lɛla lɛni na ɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔsu kalɔ taatina-ma. Ala ani na ɔ́tina-ma ndi amɛni.

english_verse: Now listen! A farmer went out to scatter seed in a field.
translation_verse: Ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Binu! Uwi ɔdi ni, ɔnana ɔdi úsie kemo ɔnii utágya edula adi.

english_verse: Other seeds fell on thin, rocky ground and quickly started growing because the soil wasn't very deep.
translation_verse: Adi álɛ ébo atabi lɛlɔ, kesii kani na lɛti liiibo pii. Anwuɔsu edula amɛni ákwɛ pla.

english_verse: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched and dried up, because they did not have deep roots.
translation_verse: Nsu ka ɔƒɛ ɔ́sia ni, áyɛyɛ na ékpi. Ɔsika ana lidu lítakɛ adila ɔ́si atabi ammɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Some other seeds fell where thornbushes grew up and choked out the plants. So they did not produce any grain.
translation_verse: Edula ammɔ adi álɛ ébo liyu akɔ. Na liyu lɛmmɔ líyi lɛ́da-nya na átakɛ lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu átama bebi.

english_verse: Finally, Jesus said: What is God's kingdom like? What story can I use to explain it?
translation_verse: Yesu úye ɔnini, “Bi na ndubuti Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ bɔkɔku? Bi lɛgba na meti medie-ni kalɔ?

english_verse: When Jesus was alone with the twelve apostles and some others, they asked him about these stories.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu lɛti ulie ni, bekyuli bani nénu nwuna lɛgba lɛmmɔ badi ku nwuna leevu-inyɔ bammɔ bébo-nwu kudɔ na béye-nwu banii udie lɛgba lɛmmɔ kalɔ ute-ma.

english_verse: But they don't have roots, and they don't last very long. As soon as life gets hard or the message gets them in trouble, they give up.
translation_verse: Nsu litemi lɛmmɔ lidu lítada kalɔ kaduɛ. Báƒɔ bádi uwi blii suɛ kani. Nsu si lɛsɛ lɛdi iye bukpoku bɔdi búbo-ma lɛlɔ na litemi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, baasɔ teenwini teesie kama.

english_verse: The reason is, “These people will look and look, but never see. They will listen and listen, but never understand. If they did, they would turn to God and be forgiven.” Jesus Explains the Story about the Farmer (Matthew
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu úbo aani kalɛ na Katɔti kenye udiene ɔdi únweni úse ɔnii, “ ‘Badubo bɔnu, nsu balanu baláti. Badubo bunu, nsu belénu kalɔ. Ɔsika si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, nka badubunu kalɔ na benwini bebo-mi kudɔ na liti bana alaekpidi lɛkyiɛ-ma.’ ”

english_verse: The seeds that fell along the road are the people who hear the message. But Satan soon comes and snatches it away from them.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badi bese aani ebi ani nálɛ ébo na kuludɔ. Ka bánya bénu kani na Satan ɔ́da-ni údie-ma kuli kemmo ɔ́tɔlɔku.

english_verse: What the farmer is spreading is really the message about the kingdom.
translation_verse: Ala ɔgyane ɔmɛni ɔɔgya Katɔti litemi.

english_verse: Jesus also said: You don't light a lamp and put it under a clay pot or under a bed. Don't you put a lamp on a lampstand?
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́sɔ úye-ma úsienku anumi ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔtu asogya taakya kagyigyɛ iye nwuna atɛla kalɔ? Ɔɔɔdi asogya kasiakɔ na beeti asogya taasia?

english_verse: Listen carefully to what you hear! The way you treat others will be the way you will be treated—and even worse.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bise atu kaduɛ na lɛla lɛni biinú lɛlɔ! Ɔsika kalɛ na aakɔ́ku bekyuli bamba taanu ni, lɛni kani na Katɔti ɔdubɔkɔku-ɔ bɔnu, utulo muedi!

english_verse: Again Jesus said: God's kingdom is like what happens when a farmer scatters seed in a field.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ kese aani ɔnana ɔni nágya egyiibi.

english_verse: It is the ground that makes the seeds sprout and grow into plants that produce grain.
translation_verse: Kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na báva ala kani mɔɔtumini ebi ammɔ lɛni. Kudeedi, si kɔ́kwɛ ni, kɔdubudie lili asa na nwuna kugyii kɔlɛ. Na si kɔɔlɛ́ lili ni, na kɔɔnwu ebi pii.

english_verse: Then when harvest season comes and the grain is ripe, the farmer cuts it with a sickle. A Mustard Seed (Matthew
translation_verse: Si ebi ammɔ ábi lɛlɔ ni, na béede-nya. Ɔsika na edula udewi úudu.” Lɛgba Na Kegyiibi Blii Suɛ Kadi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: But once it is planted, it grows larger than any garden plant. It even puts out branches that are big enough for birds to nest in its shade. The Reason for Teaching with Stories (Matthew
translation_verse: Uwi uletu asa na kaakwɛ́ na kaabla kugyii. Na kugyii kɔmɛni muubómo teetulo na lɛku egyii ƒui akɔ. Kɔɔta kɔgba pii na kɔɔbla ɔyuli. Na baasɛ baabla ayu taakya kugyii kɔmmɔ lili.”

english_verse: He did not tell them anything without using stories. But when he was alone with his disciples, he explained everything to them. A Storm (Matthew
translation_verse: Útetemi útete-ma ɔni na útebo agba. Nsu si uwi ɔni na anwu ku nwuna batɛyane lɛti belie ni, na uudie-nya kalɔ taatina-ma. Yesu Ɔ́bala Ɔƒɛƒɛɛ Kenye

english_verse: That evening, Jesus said to his disciples, “Let's cross to the east side.”
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛmmɔ kani useyi uwi ni, Yesu ɔ́lɔ nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Bɛya na busie ɛpu ɔmɛni ɔvi ɔni ngye.”

english_verse: Jesus used many other stories when he spoke to the people, and he taught them as much as they could understand.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-ma etemila buni na agba amɛni udu kemmo kalɛ na baakana kalɔ bunu.

english_verse: So they left the crowd, and his disciples started across the lake with him in the boat. Some other boats followed along.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bátɔlɔ bekyuli lisu lɛmɛni kudɔ na bétéduo ɔkɔlɔ ɔdi kemmo na Yesu úuduo úlie kalɔ kemmo, na bétiku-nwu báviaku. Lɛkɔlɔ lɛbambadi lɛnɔ lisie mmɔ.

english_verse: Suddenly a storm struck the lake. Waves started splashing into the boat, and it was about to sink.
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ubendi ɔdi úse kalɔ uukpó, na uubó ntu teewi ɔkɔlɔ lɛlɔ na buuduo-nwu kemmo ɔni na ubu blii na nka ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ uyi na ɔnyi.

english_verse: Jesus was in the back of the boat with his head on a pillow, and he was asleep. His disciples woke him and said, “Teacher, don't you care that we're about to drown?”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ na Yesu ulie ɔkɔlɔ kama na úti lili ɔ́sia ɔsiadi lɛlɔ ɔɔlɛɛ. Amu na nwuna bakpana bágyila-nwu na básu-nwu banini, “Ala ɔtinane, ulekpoku-ɔ ka bɔdaku bukpi?”

english_verse: Jesus got up and ordered the wind and the waves to be quiet. The wind stopped, and everything was calm.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́ta únye na údie lɛdi na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɔƒɛƒɛɛ, da bukpo ya!” Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ntu lɛnɔ ɔnini, “Ntu, bla buɛɛ.” Amu na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔ́da bukpo ɔ́ya, na ntu anumi ƒui bɔ́bla kpoo.

english_verse: Jesus asked his disciples, “Why were you afraid? Don't you have any faith?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu uuye nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Bi ɔsu na bibo liƒu lɛni? Bitakɛ tɔ bɔƒɔtaadi?”

english_verse: Now they were more afraid than ever and said to each other, “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him!”
translation_verse: Nsu liƒu lɛni mɔɔda-ma ɔsu ni, bakya beeye lɛlɔ banii, “Ɔma geen na ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔdi? Na ntu ku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ƒui beenú-nwu litemi!”

english_verse: She had said to herself, “If I can just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”
translation_verse: Na ɔɔsu nwuna lɛlɔ ka, “Si bɔ́kana makana-nwu awu butuku ni, nka lɛlɔ lɛdubɔba-mi.”

english_verse: Jesus said to the woman, “You are now well because of your faith. May God give you peace! You are healed, and you will no longer be in pain.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Mina ubi ulekubi, ƒula bɔƒɔtaadi bɔ́bwi-ɔ. Teesie ku keyi buɛɛ. Na ƒula lɛbibo lɛmmɔ lɛsɔ lilebo-ɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Then Jesus went inside and said to them, “Why are you crying and carrying on like this? The child isn't dead. She is just asleep.”
translation_verse: úduo úsie-ma kudɔ na úye-ma ɔnini, “Bi néboku lɛsɛ lɛmɛni? Bi ɔsu na biiwulo? Ɔnamu ɔmɛni útekpi. Bɔlɛɛ na ɔda!”

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples crossed Lake Galilee and came to shore near the town of Gerasa.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama ni, Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane bammɔ bétéduo Galilea Ɛpu ɔvi ɔni ngye na Geraseƒuɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: from the graveyard where he had been living. No one was able to tie the man up anymore, not even with a chain.
translation_verse: Ɔnana ɔmɛni ɔ́si bekyuli kavakɔ kadi nde mmɔ, ɔsika mmɔ na uli.

english_verse: He had often been put in chains and leg irons, but he broke the chains and smashed the leg irons. No one could control him.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni návi ni, bekyuli ƒui balákana-nwu lɛkpu bubo. Uwi pii ni, baakana na benyimi-nwu enu ku lɛgba. Nsu uukúlo kɔgba kɔni bébo-nwu mmɔ. Ukyuli ɔmɛni ubo ɔkplu geen ɔni na ukyuli biala ulákana-nwu bɔda.

english_verse: Night and day he was in the graveyard or on the hills, yelling and cutting himself with stones.
translation_verse: Usien ku ɔƒɛ ƒui na ɔkɛ ɔɔví bekyuli kavakɔ mmɔ ku abi lɛlɔ, na ɔkɛ ɔɔva taavi na ɔda atabi uukúlo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When the man saw Jesus in the distance, he ran up to him and knelt down.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔmɛni unye ɔgyu asa na ɔ́nu Yesu. Anwuɔsu úkeli úbalɛ akɔnkɔ na Yesu anumi.

english_verse: He shouted, “Jesus, Son of God in heaven, what do you want with me? Promise me in God's name that you won't torture me!”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́va momoomo ɔ́su ɔnini, “Yesu, katɔ ku kalɔ Ɔyikune Ƒui Ubi! Buvele, su-mi se ka aláni-mi kɔtu!”

english_verse: He then begged Jesus not to send them away.
translation_verse: Na kɔyu kɔmmɔ kɔ́sia kama kúvele Yesu ka utabɔku ayu amɛni utalɛku kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Over on the hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, baplakuo pii badi benye baadi na kataku kadi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: So the evil spirits begged Jesus, “Send us into those pigs! Let us go into them.”
translation_verse: Amu na ayu amɛni évele Yesu anii, “Bɔku-bu tákya baplakuo bani nnye ngye akɔ na butéduo-ma kemmo.”

english_verse: The men taking care of the pigs ran to the town and the farms to spread the news. Then the people came out to see what had happened.
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli bani mɔɔnu-ma lɛlɔ mmɔ békeli bésie ɔma kemmo ku amadɔ mmɔ, na bátásu bekyuli ƒui lɛla lɛni nébo.

english_verse: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had once been full of demons. He was sitting there with his clothes on and in his right mind, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: Bekyuli békeli bésie mmɔ banii batánu lɛla lɛni nébo. Na ka bésie Yesu kudɔ ni, bánu ukyuli ɔni na nka ayu ekpidi pii akya-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo mmɔ. Na ulie kalɔ, na ubi kɔdi lɛlɔ, na nwuna kasusu kese nwaa. Na liƒu lɛda bana ƒui!

english_verse: Everyone who had seen what had happened told about the man and the pigs.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nánu-nwu kudeedi ni, básu lɛla lɛni nálɛ ƒui na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ku baplakuo bammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then the people started begging Jesus to leave their part of the country.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bévele Yesu banii ɔtɔlɔ na bana kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus would not let him. Instead, he said, “Go home to your family and tell them how much the Lord has done for you and how good he has been to you.”
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu útatuna. Mmomu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Sɔ teesie ƒula lɛlɔ bekyuli kudɔ na atásu-ma kalɛ na Unwoti úbunku-ɔ ku kalɛ na ɔ́nu-ɔ kɔnyana.”

translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔnana ɔmɛni ɔ́tɔlɔ na útávi lɛma leevu kemmo, na ɔ́su bekyuli bammɔ lɛla lɛni ƒui na Yesu ɔ́bla úte-nwu. Na ɔ́bla bani nénu ƒui kalɛ kadi. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Yairo Ubidi Ulekubi Ku Uleku Ɔlɛne Ɔdi

english_verse: Once again Jesus got into the boat and crossed Lake Galilee. Then as he stood on the shore, a large crowd gathered around him.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́sɔ únwini úse ɛpu ɔmmɔ ɔvi ɔni ngye. Ka údu ketudɔ mmɔ ni, bekyuli pii badi bábaka bámana-nwu.
