translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni baalɔ Yairo na ɔkya ɔma ɔmmɔ kasalakɔ batɔnkune akɔ ni, úbo mmɔ. Ka ɔ́nu Yesu ni, úboku lɛlɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: and started begging him for help. He said, “My little daughter is about to die! Please come and touch her, so she will get well and live.”
translation_verse: Na úvele-nwu kpakplaa ɔnini, “Buvele nda-a! Mina ubi ulekubi blii ɔdi uuƒi geen. Anwuɔsu bo na ebeti ƒula enu asia-nwu lɛlɔ kalɛ na wakɛ ɔlɔkplu na welie ngba.”

english_verse: Jesus went with Jairus. Many people followed along and kept crowding around.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́ta na ɔsiaku-nwu. Bekyuli bani nsiaku Yesu bemomo ɔsu ni, báka-nwu bakya ntɛ uwi ɔni na úsela.

english_verse: In the crowd was a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years.
translation_verse: Na uleku ɔdi ɔkya-ma akɔ ɔni na ubugya uuwi-nwu lɛlɔ akwa leevu-anyɔ sɔɔn, ina ka bevone baabla-nwu evo.

english_verse: The woman had heard about Jesus, so she came up behind him in the crowd and barely touched his clothes.
translation_verse: Únu Yesu lɛlɔ litemi, anwuɔsu úbasiaku bekyuli bani nkpɛ Yesu kama.

english_verse: As soon as she touched them, her bleeding stopped, and she knew she was healed.
translation_verse: Amu ka útuku Yesu awu ni, nwuna ubugya buwi bɔmmɔ kenye kékulo kɔnakunwi! Na ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di na nwuna lɛlɔ kemmo ka nwuna ɔlɛ ɔ́ba-nwu na ɔ́lɛ nwuna lɛbibo kemmo.

english_verse: At that moment Jesus felt power go out from him. He turned to the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, Yesu ɔ́ti ka ɔyikun ɔdi ɔ́lɛ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo. Anwuɔsu ɔ́tu únwini na úye bekyuli bani nsiaku-nwu ɔnii, “Ɔma nétuku mina awu?”

english_verse: His disciples said to him, “Look at all these people crowding around you! How can you ask who touched you?”
translation_verse: Nwuna batɛyane básu-nwu banini, “Aanu kalɛ na bekyuli bamɛni báka bámana-bu. Bi ɔsu na eeye anii ɔma nétuku-ɔ?”

english_verse: But Jesus turned to see who had touched him.
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu ɔ́mu unye ɔɔtɛ anu ɔnu si wanu ukyuli ɔni nétuku-nwu.

english_verse: The woman knew what had happened to her. So she came trembling with fear and knelt down in front of Jesus. Then she told him the whole story.
translation_verse: Uleku ɔmmɔ ɔ́nu ɔ́ti lɛla lɛni nábla-nwu. Anwuɔsu na liƒu ku lɛlɔ bɔtɔ kemmo ni, úbalɛ akɔnkɔ na Yesu lɛgba akɔ. Na ɔ́su-nwu lɛla lɛni nébo nwaa.

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking, some people came from Jairus' home and said, “Your daughter has died! Why bother the teacher anymore?”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ɔɔsu ɔmɛni ni, batu badi bási Yairo kesii bébo bábasu-nwu banini, “Ƒ'ubidi úukpi. Bi ɔsu na ásɔ aakya ala ɔtinane ɔmɛni bɔnɔ lɛnɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus heard what they said, and he said to Jairus, “Don't worry. Just have faith!”
translation_verse: Yesu útakpete litemi lɛni na básu mmɔ. Mmomu ɔ́su Yairo ɔnini, “Tayia, awɔ ƒɔ di kani!”

english_verse: Jesus did not let anyone go with him except Peter and the two brothers, James and John.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu útiku Petro ku Yakobo ku ɔnwani Yohane lɛti pɛ na bátɔlɔ bésie mmɔ.

english_verse: They went home with Jairus and saw the people crying and making a lot of noise.
translation_verse: Na ka bédu Yairo kaduli na Yesu ɔ́nu kalɛ na benye baabla lɛlɔ ku keku kani na benye beewulo ni,

english_verse: He took the twelve-year-old girl by the hand and said, “Talitha, koum!” which means, “Little girl, get up!” The girl got right up and started walking around. Everyone was greatly surprised.
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ulekubi ɔni náaƒɔ akwa leevu-anyɔ mɛni ɔ́ta únye na ɔkɛ uusié taavi. Ka lɛla lɛmɛni líbo lɛni ni, ɔ́bla bana ƒui yaa!

english_verse: But Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened. Then he said, “Give her something to eat.”
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu úbo-ma ɔda kpakplaa ka batasu ukyuli ɔdi biala. Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bite-nwu lɛla lɛdi na ɔdi.”

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples crossed the lake and brought the boat to shore near the town of Gennesaret.
translation_verse: Ka bétédu ɛpu ɔmmɔ ɔvi ngye ni, bátáyu na Genesaret. Na mmɔ na bényimi bana ɔkɔlɔ bényene.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Prophets are honored by everyone, except the people of their hometown and their relatives and their own family.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Katɔti kenye udiene ubo ɔbu na kesi kesii. Nsu na nwuna ɔma ku nwuna lɛlɔ bekyuli ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli anumi ni, uuubo ɔbu.”

english_verse: But when Herod heard about Jesus, he said, “This must be John! I had his head cut off, and now he has come back to life.”
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔni na Herode únu etemila amɛni ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Yohane ɔni kuli na lɛ́ya na békulo ni, anwu násɔ ɔ́ta úbo uli ngba!”

english_verse: The next Sabbath he taught in the synagogue. Many of the people who heard him were amazed and asked, “How can he do all this? Where did he get such wisdom and the power to work these miracles?
translation_verse: Na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ ni, úsie ɔkya ɔɔtina litemi buni na kasalakɔ mmɔ. Amu ka nwuna ɔma bekyuli pii bésie béténu-nwu ala bɔtina ni, ɔ́bla-ma kalɛ kadi. Beeye lɛlɔ banii, “Wɛ na ɔ́tɛya ɔmɛni udu ɔ́siku? Bi lɛlati udu béte-nwu asa na ɔɔkana akɔla amɛni udu bɔbla?

english_verse: Isn't he the carpenter, the son of Mary? Aren't James, Joseph, Judas, and Simon his brothers? Don't his sisters still live here in our town?” The people were upset because of what he was doing.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi anwu ndi Maria ubidi ɔni ndi ligyii ɔnwine? Munuu ɔɔɔdi Yakobo ku Yose ku Yuda ku Simon banwani na ɔdi? Na nwuna banwani belekubi lɛnɔ nkya mɛni!” Anwuɔsu bekyuli bamɛni béni-nwu.

english_verse: He told them, “You may take along a walking stick. But don't carry food or a traveling bag or any money.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́bala-ma ɔnii, “Ɔdi uteti lɛla lɛdi utada na nwuna ulu busie kemmo, ntu ugyii ɔdadi lɛti pɛ. Biteti adila iye koƒo aani kalɛ na ala bevelene baada. Bitada egulabi na bina aƒo kemmo.

english_verse: If any place won't welcome you or listen to your message, leave and shake the dust from your feet as a warning to them.”
translation_verse: Si bídu ɔma ɔdi na bekyuli bammɔ bátaƒɔ-mii iye banii belenu bina litemi ni, bɛtɔlɔ na biveli bina lɛgba kalɔ ɔtumu bíwi-ma. Ɔmɛni ɔdubɔtina ka ɔma ɔmmɔ bekyuli béni-mii. Anwuɔsu lɛla lɛdi biala mebo ni, bana litemi lɛdi.”

english_verse: Herodias had a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she could not do it
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yohane lɛlɔ litemi líteekpoku Herodia, na uukisi-nwu. Na ɔ́wia ka ɔdu-nwu.

english_verse: because Herod was afraid of John and protected him. He knew that John was a good and holy man. Even though Herod was confused by what John said, he was glad to listen to him. And he often did.
translation_verse: Nsu ulákana na Herode ɔsu. Ɔsika Herode útaayia Yohane, na ɔgyi ka Yohane ɔdi ukyuli ɔni nse siin na use kedee. Anwuɔsu útaagyumana-nwu. Ɔ́yɔ ka uteenu-nwu ala bɔtina uwi ndi uwi ina ka nwuna litemi líteekpoku-nwu kayi si únu-ni.

english_verse: I swear that I will give you as much as half of my kingdom, if you want it.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-nwu lɛnɔ ɔnini, “Lɛka ku mina lɛgaboku ka ndubute-ɔ lɛla biala lɛni na adubuye-mi, ina mina lɛga kadikɔ kakɛ muedi!”

english_verse: The girl left and asked her mother, “What do you think I should ask for?” Her mother answered, “The head of John the Baptist!”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ugblebi ɔmɛni ɔ́ta ɔ́lɛ na útéye uni ɔnini, “Bi na liye?” Amu na uni ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ye-nwu Ntu Ɔkpilane Yohane kuli.”

english_verse: The girl hurried back and told Herod, “Here and now on a serving plate I want the head of John the Baptist!”
translation_verse: Ugblebi ɔmɛni ɔ́babla útéduo ɔtɔ kemmo na ɔ́su Herode ɔnini, “Mɔɔwia ka eti Ntu Ɔkpilane Yohane kuli akya lɛkyami kemmo ete-mi ɔƒɛni kani!”

english_verse: Herod was very sorry for what he had said. But he did not want to break the promise he had made in front of his guests.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔ́bla Ɔga Herode kɔnyana, nsu ulakana ɔda budie na ala ani na ɔ́kpali na bekyuli benengudi bamɛni anumi ɔsu.

english_verse: The guard put the head on a serving plate and took it to the girl. Then she gave it to her mother.
translation_verse: Kama ni, úti kuli kɔmmɔ ɔkya lɛkyami kemmo na úti úboku ulekubi ɔmmɔ. Na anwu lɛnɔ úti-ku úte uni.

english_verse: When John's followers learned that he had been killed, they took his body and put it in a tomb. Jesus Feeds Five Thousand (Matthew
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yohane batɛyane bénu litemi lɛmɛni ni, bésie bététi nwuna ukpine ɔmmɔ na bátáva-nwu. Yesu Úte Nkyuli Mpim Ɛlɔ Adila

english_verse: But so many people were coming and going that Jesus and the apostles did not even have a chance to eat. Then Jesus said, “Let's go to a place where we can be alone and get some rest.”
translation_verse: Nsu likpo lɛni na Yesu ku ama belie ni, bekyuli bani muuduo-ma kudɔ mmɔ taalɛ bemomo. Na Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane balakɛ uwi ɔni na beti badi munu munu. Anwuɔsu Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛya na abu lɛti buteesie kesii kani nse kpoo na butélie mmɔ bɔnwuna blii.”

english_verse: They left in a boat for a place where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Amu na bésie bétéduo ɔkɔlɔ kemmo banii beteesie kesi kani na bekyuli beeebo.

english_verse: That evening the disciples came to Jesus and said, “This place is like a desert, and it's already late.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na useyi uwi úudu ni, nwuna batɛyane bákpɛ béde-nwu na básu-nwu banini, “Kadi káasa káwɔlɔ. Na kalɛ na mɛni kese ɔsu ni, balákɛ lɛla lɛdi baladi. Anwuɔsu ya na bana ƒui beteesie.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You give them something to eat.” But they asked him, “Don't you know it would take almost a year's wages to buy all of these people something to eat?”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Amii bite-ma lɛla lɛdi na badi.” Amu na básu-nwu banini, “Ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔƒɔ aani ukyuli abuli maane lɛyuƒɔla! Aayɔ́ ka bubile ɔmɛni na bodobodo lɛti pɛ lɛlɔ bute bana bɔdi?”

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “How much bread do you have? Go and see!” They found out and answered, “We have five small loaves of bread and two fish.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye-ma ɔnini, “Bodobodo ɛlɛ nkya-mii ala akɔ? Bisie bitánu.” Amu ka bésie bátánu ni, básu-nwu ka, “Bodobodo ɛlɔ ku kɔkpaku inyɔ lɛti pɛ nse.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples to tell the people to sit down on the green grass.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su nwuna batɛyane ɔnii baya na bekyuli bamɛni ƒui belie kalɔ esu esu na livo lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: All of them saw him and were terrified. But at this same time he said, “Don't worry! I am Jesus. Don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Ɔ́gyu bana ƒui ɔtɔtɔ ka bánu-nwu na ntu bɔmɛni anumi. Nsu Yesu útemiku-ma kɔnakunwi ɔnini, “Bitayia! Ami mmɔ. Bɛkɛ kayi!”

english_verse: Jesus took the five loaves and the two fish. He looked up toward heaven and blessed the food. Then he broke the bread and handed it to his disciples to give to the people. He also divided the two fish, so everyone could have some.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úti bodobodo ku kɔkpaku kɔmɛni na ka ɔ́nu katɔ laa ni, ɔ́gya Katɔti enu na ɔ́bwɛ bodobodo ku kɔkpaku kɔmɛni. Na úti úte nwuna batɛyane ɔnii bele bete esu esu ammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: After everyone had eaten all they wanted,
translation_verse: Bana akɔ ɔdi biala ɔ́di na úmo, ɔsika Yesu ɔ́ya adila amɛni émomo ébu.

english_verse: Jesus' disciples picked up twelve large baskets of leftover bread and fish.
translation_verse: Na ka nwuna batɛyane bála adila ani nébu básala ni, úyi kɔgyigyɛ leevu-inyɔ.

english_verse: At once, Jesus made his disciples get into the boat and start back across to Bethsaida. But he stayed until he had sent the crowds away.
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, Yesu ɔ́ya na nwuna batɛyane bákɔ béduo ɔkɔlɔ kemmo ɔnii bataatɔ ɔma ɔni baalɔ Betsaida na ɛpu ɔmmɔ ɔvi ngye kemmo. Na anwu ɔ́ya na bekyuli pii bamɛni lɛnɔ bégyingya.

english_verse: Then he told them goodbye and went up on the side of a mountain to pray.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie kɔbi kɔdi lili útákpali katɔ.

english_verse: Later in the evening he was still there by himself, and the boat was somewhere in the middle of the lake.
translation_verse: Ka useyi údu ni, ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ údu ɛpu ɔmmɔ ntɛ, na Yesu lɛti pɛ unye ɔvi ɔmɛni.

english_verse: He could see that the disciples were struggling hard, because they were rowing against the wind. Not long before morning, Jesus came toward them. He was walking on the water and was about to pass the boat.
translation_verse: Ɔ́nu ka nwuna bekyuli benye beebó abi na bana ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ bɔka lɛlɔ, ɔsika ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uukpó taasiaku-ma. Anwuɔsu asa na ɔtanta lɛdɔ ɛlɔ libo ni, Yesu ɔkɛ ntu anumi na úbo-ma kudɔ. Ka ɔ́kpɛ úde-ma ni,

english_verse: He then got into the boat with them, and the wind died down. The disciples were completely confused.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́kɔ úduo-ma kudɔ na ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo, na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔmɛni ɔ́da bukpo ɔ́ya. Ɔmɛni ɔ́bla nwuna batɛyane dɛye dɛye!

english_verse: Their minds were closed, and they could not understand the true meaning of the loaves of bread. Jesus Heals Sick People in Gennesaret (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɔsika bátati kalɛ geen na ɔ́bla asa na úte nkyuli mpim ɛlɔ bamɛni adila na bádi bébu. Bana kasusu kátabla-ma nwaa na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ka bátaƒɔ bátadi ɔsu. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Balɛne Na Genesaret

english_verse: As soon as they got out of the boat, the people recognized Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka báyu na bana ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo kani ni, bekyuli bánu Yesu báti.

english_verse: So they ran all over that part of the country to bring their sick people to him on mats. They brought them each time they heard where he was.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bekyuli bammɔ békeli bámana bana kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ batásu ukyuli biala. Na kesi kesii kani na bénu ka Yesu ɔkya ni, béti balɛne béboku-nwu.

english_verse: In every village or farm or marketplace where Jesus went, the people brought their sick to him. They begged him to let them just touch his clothes, and everyone who did was healed.
translation_verse: Na ekpo ani ƒui na Yesu úsie ni, ɔma na ɔdi o-o, lɛkpaklɔ na lɛdi o-o ni, bekyuli beeti balɛne teesienku kuyeya na beevele-nwu ka ɔya na betuku nwuna awu kɔtu. Na bani nétuku-nwu ni, lɛlɔ lɛ́yu-ma ɔkplu.

english_verse: Some Pharisees and several teachers of the Law of Moses from Jerusalem came and gathered around Jesus.
translation_verse: Ƒarisiƒuɔ ku ɔda bubo ala batinane badi bási Yerusalem bébo bábaka bámana Yesu.

english_verse: You are good at rejecting God's commands so that you can follow your own teachings!
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bibo kakwɛ kani lɛlɔ bɛɛsia taanyonu Katɔti ɔda bubo taava kalɛ na bɛsiaku bina bati kuuku ɔdi ala bɔbla kama.

english_verse: They noticed that some of his disciples ate without first washing their hands.
translation_verse: Bánu ka nwuna batɛyane belie baadi, na badi bátaƒɔ bana enu aani kalɛ na ama Ƒarisiƒuɔ baatina bekyuli ka bataaƒɔ.

english_verse: The Pharisees and many others obey the teachings of their ancestors. They always wash their hands in the proper way before eating.
translation_verse: Bánu ɔmɛni báti ɔsika Ƒarisiƒuɔ ku Yudaƒuɔ babambadi ƒui baasiaku bana bati kuuku ɔdi ala bɔbla bɔni na báda bése-ma. Amu ntu báƒɔ bana enu kalɛ na bátina-ma asa badi.

english_verse: None of them will eat anything they buy in the market until it is washed. They also follow a lot of other teachings, such as washing cups, pitchers, and bowls.
translation_verse: Na si béye lɛla lɛdi básiku kuye lɛnɔ ni, ɔlɛka baƒɔ bana enu asa na badi. Na baasiaku ɔda bubo pii lɛnɔ lɛni na bálɛ lili bábanu aani kalɛ na baaƒɔ lɛɛƒɛɛ ku kutubui ku ebwi.

english_verse: The Pharisees and teachers asked Jesus, “Why don't your disciples obey what our ancestors taught us to do? Why do they eat without washing their hands?”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Ƒarisiƒuɔ ku ala batinane bammɔ béye Yesu banini, “Bi ɔsu na ƒula basiakune balásiaku bula bati kuuku ɔdi ala bɔbla kama? Na ama baadi si bátaƒɔ enu muedi!”

english_verse: Jesus replied: You are nothing but show-offs! The prophet Isaiah was right when he wrote that God had said, “All of you praise me with your words, but you never really think about me.
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Anumi lɛlɔ bekyuli bɛdi! Yesaia únweni ɔ́su ala ɔ́siku-mii lɛlɔ na úbo lɛni sɔsɔ! Ɔ́su-bu ka Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnii, “ ‘Bekyuli bamɛni bada bana kenye kani baabu-mi, nsu balayɔ-mi na bana kayi kemmo.

english_verse: It is useless for you to worship me, when you teach rules made up by humans.”
translation_verse: Keeke kani na baabla-mi kabla. Baatina kayawi lɛlɔ ala aani si mina ɔda bubo bɔdi.’

english_verse: You disobey God's commands in order to obey what humans have taught.
translation_verse: Ɔɔtina ka bɛ́da Katɔti ɔda bubo bɛ́va, na bíti bayawine ɔda bubo ɔni bátina-mii bɛda.”

english_verse: But you let people get by without helping their parents when they should. You let them say that what they own has been offered to God.
translation_verse: Nsu bɛɛsu ka, si ukyuli ɔdi ubo lɛla lɛdi lɛni na ɔkana na uti ubunku nwuna bawɔne ni, ɔkana ɔsu ka úse lɛla lɛmɛni kenye ɔni kalɔ ndi ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔ́da litela lɛmmɔ úse ka uti ɔkpa ute Katɔti.

english_verse: You won't let those people help their parents.
translation_verse: Na bítete-nwu ulu ka ɔka litela lɛmɛni buti bubunku nwuna bawɔne muedi!

english_verse: And you ignore God's commands in order to follow your own teaching. You do a lot of other things just as bad. What Really Makes People Unclean (Matthew
translation_verse: Lɛni na biiti bina bati kuuku ɔdi ala bɔbla teebile Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ. Na bɛɛbla ala abambadi pii lɛnɔ aani ɔmɛni udu.”

english_verse: Then Jesus said: What comes from your heart is what makes you unclean.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́sɔ úsie anumi na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Lɛla lɛni nálɛ ukyuli kayi kemmo ni, ani mɔɔyá na uusé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Jesus called the crowd together again and said, “Pay attention and try to understand what I mean.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́lɔ bekyuli lisu lɛmmɔ ɔnii bakpɛ bede-nwu. Amu na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bina ƒui bise atu na binu.

english_verse: The food that you put into your mouth doesn't make you unclean and unfit to worship God. The bad words that come out of your mouth are what make you unclean.”
translation_verse: Mmomu ni, lɛla lɛni nálɛ-nwu kayi kemmo ni, ani ndi lɛla lɛni mɔɔyá na uusé lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: After Jesus and his disciples had left the crowd and gone into the house, they asked him what these sayings meant.
translation_verse: Nwuna kama uwi ɔni na ɔ́tɔlɔ bana kudɔ na úsie kaduli ni, nwuna batɛyane béye-nwu banii udie litemi lɛmmɔ kalɔ ɔtina-ma.

english_verse: He answered, “Don't you know what I am talking about by now? You surely know that the food you put into your mouth cannot make you unclean.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Si bítenu litemi lɛmɛni kalɔ ni, na bina kasusu kalákana ala buƒie! Use nwaa ka lɛla biala lɛni muuduo ukyuli lɛlɔ kemmo ni, lilaya na ukyuli uusé lɛlɔ. Ɔsika líteduo-nwu kayi kemmo.

english_verse: It doesn't go into your heart, but into your stomach, and then out of your body.” By saying this, Jesus meant that all foods were fit to eat.
translation_verse: Mmomu nwuna kaƒɔ kemmo na líduo, na lɛɛsɔ taalɛ-nwu ɔlɔna kemmo aani lɛla lɛni nébie.” Na lɛla lɛni na Yesu ɔ́su mɛni ni, ɔ́tina ka adila biala adia éte bɔdi.

english_verse: All of these come from your heart, and they are what make you unfit to worship God. A Woman's Faith (Matthew
translation_verse: Ala ekpidi amɛni ƒui ási ukyuli lɛlɔ kemmo na aayá na uusé lɛlɔ.” Uleku Ɔni Nási Ƒoinike Ɔ́ƒɔ Yesu Ɔ́di

english_verse: The woman replied, “Lord, even puppies eat the crumbs that children drop from the table.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na uleku ɔmɛni lɛnɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Ao, Ati, bakpɛwe bani mbi kalɔ na kadikɔ mmɔ ni, bebo kuƒi ka badi adila ani na banamu baadi teewi kalɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus left and went to the region near the town of Tyre, where he stayed in someone's home. He did not want people to know he was there, but they found out anyway.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama ni, Yesu ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie kalɔ kani nde ɔma ɔni baalɔ Tiro kemmo. Úsie kaduli kadi na útayɔ ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔti ka ɔkya mmɔ, nsu útakana bɔbɛ.

english_verse: A woman whose daughter had an evil spirit in her heard where Jesus was. And at once she came and knelt down at his feet.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ka uleku ɔdi na kɔyu kukpidi kɔsiaku ubidi únu ɔnii Yesu ɔkya mmɔ ni, úbo-nwu kudɔ na úbalɛ akɔnkɔ na nwuna anumi. Uleku ɔmɛni ɔdi ɔƒɔ ɔni na Yudaƒuɔ balayɔ. Báwɔ-nwu na ɔma ɔni baalɔ Ƒoinike na Siria kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “The children must first be fed! It isn't right to take away their food and feed it to dogs.”
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Ya bɔka banamu adila bute asa. Ɔɔɔdia ka buti banamu adila bubo buwi bana bakpɛwe.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “That's true! You may go now. The demon has left your daughter.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Na ƒula kenye kani nédie mɛni ɔsu ni, teesie kaduli. Na adubɔnu ka kɔyu kɔmmɔ kɔ́tɔlɔ ƒ'ubidi lɛlɔ!”

english_verse: When the woman got back home, she found her child lying on the bed. The demon had gone. Jesus Heals a Man Who Was Deaf and Could Hardly Talk
translation_verse: Amu na uleku ɔmɛni úsie kaduli. Na mmɔ ni, útánu ka ubidi ɔtɛ nwuna katɛnkɔ na kɔyu kukpidi kɔmmɔ kɔsɔ kuuulie-nwu lɛlɔ. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Ɔnana Ɔni Neeenu Na Ulétemi

english_verse: Jesus left the region around Tyre and went by way of Sidon toward Lake Galilee. He went through the land near the ten cities known as Decapolis.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́tɔlɔ Tiro amadɔ mmɔ, na ɔkɛ Sidon ɔ́vi úsie Galilea Ɛpu kudɔ na ɔvi ɔni nésie lɛma leevu kakɛ mmɔ.

english_verse: Some people brought to him a man who was deaf and could hardly talk. They begged Jesus just to touch him.
translation_verse: Na mmɔ ni, bekyuli badi béti ukyuli ɔni na atu éti-nwu na ulakana butemi lɛnɔ béboku-nwu, na bévele-nwu ka uti enu ɔsia-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: After Jesus had taken him aside from the crowd, he stuck his fingers in the man's ears. Then he spit and put it on the man's tongue.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yesu ɔ́kpanku-nwu úsienku kɔƒɛlɛ kesii kani na bekyuli beeebo, na úti nwuna animi ɔ́kya-nwu atuƒi kemmo. Útuo lisuo na útuku ɔnana ɔmmɔ unyemi.

english_verse: Jesus looked up toward heaven, and with a groan he said, “Effatha!” which means “Open up!”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́talaku anumi ɔ́nu katɔ na údumo geen, na ɔ́su ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Heƒata,” ɔni kalɔ ndi “Lɛmi!”

english_verse: At once the man could hear, and he had no more trouble talking clearly.
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, ɔnana ɔmɛni atu álɛmi, na nwuna unyemi kabuli lɛnɔ káƒɛnimi-nwu na ɔ́kana butemi!

english_verse: Jesus told the people not to say anything about what he had done. But the more he told them, the more they talked about it.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́bala bekyuli bani nnye mmɔ ka batasu ukyuli ɔdi lɛla lɛdi batasiku lɛla lɛni na bánu mɛni lɛlɔ. Nsu ɔ́bala-ma keeke, ɔsika bana ƒui bakɛ baasu lɛla lɛmɛni taavi.

english_verse: They were completely amazed and said, “Everything he does is good! He even heals people who cannot hear or talk.”
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani ƒui nénu ala ammɔ ni, ɔ́bla-ma yaa! Na básu lɛlɔ banini, “Ɔɔbla ala ani ƒui kaduɛ sɔsɔ! Ɔɔyá na bamumu baatɛmi, na batutine lɛnɔ beenú!”

english_verse: Jesus warned them, “Watch out! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and of Herod.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Binye kagyumana na bɛnu kaduɛ na Ɔga Herode ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ bɔnyii bɔni na baakya bodobodo kemmo na uuƒu lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Then Jesus explained clearly what he meant. Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that.
translation_verse: Ɔ́su-ma ɔmɛni nwaa, na bénu kalɔ. Amu na Petro ɔ́kpanku-nwu úsienku kɔƒɛlɛ na ɔ́dɔnku-nwu.

english_verse: “I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat.
translation_verse: “Bekyuli bamɛni lɛlɔ lɛɛkywí-mi kaƒɔ, ɔsika báakya-mi kudɔ emeyi atɛ sɔɔn. Na ɔƒɛni ni, balakɛ lɛla lɛni badi.

english_verse: Some of them live a long way from here. If I send them away hungry, they might faint on their way home.”
translation_verse: Si lɛ́nyonu-ma na bátɔlɔ ni, badubusie batátaayila na ulu. Ɔsika bana badi bási kesii kani nágyu.”

english_verse: After Jesus told the crowd to sit down, he took the seven loaves and gave thanks. He then broke the loaves and handed them to his disciples, who passed them out to the crowd.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su bana ƒui ɔnii basɔ belie kalɔ. Amu na úti bodobodo maatɛ ɔmmɔ, na ɔ́gya Katɔti enu, na ɔ́bwɛ-nwu kɔkɛ kɔkɛ, na úti úte nwuna batɛyane ɔnii beti bete bekyuli bamɛni ƒui. Ama lɛnɔ béti béle béte-ma.

english_verse: They also had a few little fish, and after Jesus had blessed these, he told the disciples to pass them around.
translation_verse: Ka bánu banii kɔkpaku blii kɔdi lɛnɔ kuse ni, Yesu úti aku lɛnɔ na ɔ́gya enu. Na úti-ku úte nwuna batɛyane ɔnii bele aku lɛnɔ bete-ma.

english_verse: he got into the boat with the disciples and crossed to the territory near Dalmanutha. A Sign from Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane béduo ɔkɔlɔ kemmo na bátɔlɔ bésie Dalmanuta kalɔ lɛlɔ. Ƒarisiƒuɔ Beeye Akɔla Budie Taatina

english_verse: The Pharisees came out and started an argument with Jesus. They wanted to test him by asking for a sign from heaven.
translation_verse: Ƒarisiƒuɔ badi bébo Yesu kudɔ na bakya beeye-nwu etemila taakɔku-nwu taanu. Anwuɔsu básu-nwu banii ɔbla akɔla adi na banu ka Katɔti kudɔ na ɔ́si.

english_verse: The disciples had forgotten to bring any bread, and they had only one loaf with them in the boat.
translation_verse: Nwuna batɛyane bamɛni báyiƒala bodobodo ɔdi bɔwia bɔda, anwuɔsu bodobodo unwi pɛ na bada na ɔkɔlɔ kemmo mmɔ.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, “Why are you talking about not having any bread? Don't you understand? Are your minds still closed?
translation_verse: Nsu ka Yesu ɔ́ti litemi lɛni na baasu ɔsu ni, úye-ma ɔnini, “Bi ɔsu na bɛɛtɛmi taasiku bodobodo tada lɛlɔ? Ku ɔƒɛni ni, bilánu na bilenu tɔ kalɔ? Bina atu ebo ɔkplu bɔdi!

english_verse: Jesus took him by the hand and led him out of the village, where he spit into the man's eyes. He placed his hands on the blind man and asked him if he could see anything.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́da ukyuli ɔmmɔ kɔnu na útiku-nwu ɔ́lɛku ɔma kemmo. Ka útuo lisuo úwi ukyuli ɔmmɔ anumi lɛlɔ na úti enu ɔ́sia-nwu lɛlɔ ni, úye-nwu ɔnini, “Aanu lɛla lɛdi?”

english_verse: The man looked up and said, “I see people, but they look like trees walking around.”
translation_verse: Amu na ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔ́talaku anumi ɔ́nu katɔ na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɛɛn, mɔɔnu bekyuli, nsu bese aani egyii. Nsu akɛ eesié taavi.”

english_verse: Once again Jesus placed his hands on the man's eyes, and this time the man stared. His eyes were healed, and he saw everything clearly.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́sɔ útuku-nwu anumi. Uwi unyɔdi ɔmɛni kemmo ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ úbimi anumi kaduɛ na nwuna anumi ábla-nwu nwaa na ɔɔnu lɛla biala kaduɛ!

english_verse: Jesus said to him, “You may return home now, but don't go into the village.” Who Is Jesus? (Matthew
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie-nwu ulu ɔnii uteesie kaduli, nsu ɔsɔ utavi ɔma ɔni kemmo na bási bébo mmɔ. Petro Ɔ́tina Ukyuli Ɔni Udu Na Yesu Ɔdi

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “But who do you say I am?” “You are the Messiah!” Peter replied.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́sɔ úye-ma ɔnini, “Na amii nɔɔ? Ɔma na bɛɛkali ka ami ndi?” Petro ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ ndi Kristo ɔmmɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus warned the disciples not to tell anyone about him. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úbo-ma ɔda ka batasu ukyuli ɔdi biala lɛla lɛni bagyi básiku-nwu lɛlɔ mɛni. Yesu Ɔ́tɛmi Ɔ́siku Nwuna Kukpi Ku Bɔsɔ Bɔta Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Jesus began telling his disciples what would happen to him. He said, “The nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses will make the Son of Man suffer terribly. He will be rejected and killed, but three days later he will rise to life.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úse kalɔ ɔɔtina nwuna batɛyane ala adi. Ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɔlɛka Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ubo abi pii na ɔma benengu ku bakpane benengu ku ɔda bubo ala batinane enu kemmo na bedumi-nwu. Badubɔdu-nwu, nsu na limeyi lɛtɛdi lɛlɔ ni, ɔdubɔta ulie ngba.”

english_verse: But when Jesus turned and saw the disciples, he corrected Peter. He said to him, “Satan, get away from me! You are thinking like everyone else and not like God.”
translation_verse: Nsu ka Yesu úbo únwini na ɔ́nu nwuna batɛyane ni, ɔ́dɔnku Petro ɔnini, “Satan, gyu lɛgba na mina kudɔ!” Ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Aláwia ala ani na Katɔti ɔɔwia, mmomu aawia bayawine ayɔla kani!”

english_verse: Jesus then told the crowd and the disciples to come closer, and he said: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Amu ka Yesu ɔ́lɔ bekyuli lisu lɛmmɔ ku nwuna batɛyane úboku nwuna kudɔ ni, ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔsiaku-mi kama sɔsɔ ni, ɔlɛka udie nwuna lɛlɔ atu, na ubo abi na ɔsiaku-mi kama.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me and for the good news, you will save it.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔwia ka ɔƒɔ nwuna lili ngba ute lɛlɔ ni, ɔdubɔyila-mu. Na ukyuli biala ɔni nányonu nwuna ngba na ami ɔsu ku litemi buni lɛmɛni ɔsu ni, ɔdubɔkɛ ngba geen.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself?
translation_verse: Bi kɔsia na ukyuli ɔdubɔkɛ si ɔ́kɛ kayawi ala ƒui na ɔ́yila ngba geen bɔmmɔ?

english_verse: What could you give to get back your soul?
translation_verse: Munuu bi na ukyuli ubo uti ɔvumana na ɔkɛ ngba geen bɔmmɔ?

english_verse: Don't be ashamed of me and my message among these unfaithful and sinful people! If you are, the Son of Man will be ashamed of you when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ni, bekyuli pii baabla ekpidi na beenwíni kama taakya Katɔti. Anwuɔsu si ami ku mina ala ani mɔɔtina ƒui ékpo ukyuli ɔdi kɔƒa ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔdubukpo ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi kɔƒa uwi ɔni na mebo ku Katɔti batu kedee na Katɔti ɔmmɔ bukeye ƒui kemmo.”

english_verse: I can assure you that Elijah has already come. And people treated him just as they wanted to, as the Scriptures say they would. Jesus Heals a Boy (Matthew
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii ka Elia ɔmmɔ úubo. Nsu bekyuli bátabu-nwu kaduɛ. Mmomu bábla-nwu kalɛ na ama baayɔ́. Lɛla lɛmɛni líbalɛ aani kalɛ na Katɔti kenye bediene bénweni bése na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo básiku-nwu lɛlɔ.” Yesu Ɔ́bwi Ɔnanabi Ɔni Lɛlɔ Na Kɔyu Kukpidi Kulie

english_verse: After Jesus and the disciples had gone back home and were alone, they asked him, “Why couldn't we force out that demon?”
translation_verse: Nwuna kama uwi ɔni na Yesu útéduo kaduli ni, nwuna batɛyane béye-nwu buɛɛ banini, “Bi ɔsu na abu bútakana kɔyu kɔmɛni bɔbɔku bɔlɛku ɔnamu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kemmo?”

english_verse: Then Jesus asked a child to stand near him. He put his arm around the child and said,
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́ya na ɔnamu ɔdi úbenye bana anumi. Na ɔ́gyu ɔnamu ɔmɛni ɔ́sia nwuna lɛgba lɛlɔ na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini,

english_verse: And his clothes became much whiter than any bleach on earth could make them.
translation_verse: Na nwuna awu uukeye na ɔ́ƒuala ƒututuu ɔni na uukeye teetulo kalɛ na ukyuli ɔyawine ɔdubɔkana lɛla lɛdi bɔƒɔ na ntu kemmo na ukeye.

english_verse: Then Elijah and Moses appeared and were talking with Jesus.
translation_verse: Amu na nwuna batɛyane ɛtɛ bamɛni bánu ka Mose ku Elia báda bálɛ na baatɛmiku Yesu.

english_verse: The shadow of a cloud passed over and covered them. From the cloud a voice said, “This is my Son, and I love him. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔdi úbewi bana ƒui lɛlɔ, na lɛdi lɛdi lɛ́su lɛnini, “Ɔmɛni ndi mina ubi ɔyɔne. Bise atu na binu-nwu litemi!”

english_verse: At once the disciples looked around, but they saw only Jesus.
translation_verse: Bátɛ anu bámana, nsu bátanu ukyuli ɔdi ntu Yesu ɔni nnye-ma kudɔ kani.

english_verse: So they kept it to themselves. But they wondered what he meant by the words “raised from death.”
translation_verse: Bábala etemila amɛni na bana akɔ, nsu si ama lɛti belie ni, na beeye bana lɛlɔ banii, “Kekpine bɔta taasi bɔmmɔ kalɔ ndi dɛ?”

english_verse: The disciples asked Jesus, “Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say that Elijah must come before the Messiah does?”
translation_verse: Amu na béye Yesu banini, “Bi ɔsu na ɔda bubo ala batinane básu ka Elia na ɔlɛka ɔka Kristo bubo?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: Elijah certainly will come to get everything ready. But don't the Scriptures also say that the Son of Man must suffer terribly and be rejected?
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnii, “Sɔsɔ na básu. Elia na ɔlɛka ɔka bubo kalɛ na wabaklibi lɛla biala wese. Nsu Bunweni Kedee Ɔku lɛnɔ ɔ́su ka Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ɔdububo abi pii na badubudumi-nwu. Dɛ bɛɛkali ka ɔmɛni lɛnɔ kalɔ kaatina?

english_verse: When Jesus and his three disciples came back down, they saw a large crowd around the other disciples. The teachers of the Law of Moses were arguing with them.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ku Petro bene bénwini bébo batɛyane bakladi kudɔ ni, bábanu ka bekyuli pii badi benye bámana-ma, na ama ku ɔda bubo ala batinane badi benye baaní litemi lɛdi teenene.

english_verse: They brought the boy, and as soon as the demon saw Jesus, it made the boy shake all over. He fell down and began rolling on the ground and foaming at the mouth.
translation_verse: Amu na béti-nwu béboku Yesu. Na ka kɔyu kɔmɛni kɔ́nya kɔ́nu Yesu ni, kɔ́kunku ɔnamu ɔmmɔ na kɔ́ya na úbuli ɔ́tɛ kalɔ uubó teeminime, na avlɔvɔ aalɛ́-nwu kenye.

english_verse: “When you welcome even a child because of me, you welcome me. And when you welcome me, you welcome the one who sent me.” For or against Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: “Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́ ɔnamu na ami ɔsu ni, ami na ɔ́ƒɔ. Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mi ni, ɔɔɔdi ami lɛti na ɔ́ƒɔ. Mmomu ɔ́ƒɔ mina Ɔti ɔni nátala-mi lɛnɔ.” Ukyuli Biala Neeekisi-ɔ Ni, Ɔdi Ƒula Ubunkune

english_verse: The crowd was really surprised to see Jesus, and everyone hurried over to greet him.
translation_verse: Ka bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bánu ka Yesu ɔdubo ni, ɔ́bla-ma yaa, na békeli bátasiaku-nwu na bakya-nwu kenye.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “What are you arguing about?”
translation_verse: Yesu úye nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Bi lɛlɔ lɛsɛ na amii ku-ma binye bɛɛní?”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You people don't have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy to me.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Eei! Ɔmwi keyi kamɛni bekyuli, bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɔ́sɔ! Uwi ɛlɛ na ɔlɛka lɛkya-mii kudɔ ntédu asa na bɛƒɔ bɛdi? Munuu uwi ɔmani na ndubɔda-mii asa na binu ala kalɔ? Biti ɔnamu ɔmmɔ biboku-mi!”

english_verse: Jesus asked the boy's father, “How long has he been like this?” The man answered, “Ever since he was a child.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye ɔti ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Ka úse kalɔ ɔɔbla-nwu lɛni ni, uwi úutu?” Ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Úse kalɔ úti ɔ́si uwi ɔni na ɔdi ɔnamu.

english_verse: At once the boy's father shouted, “I do have faith! Please help me to have even more.”
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, ubi ɔti ɔmmɔ ɔ́va momoomo ɔ́su ɔnini, “Mbo bɔƒɔtaadi, nsu buuumomo. Bunku-mi na lɛkɛ bɔƒɔtaadi libu!”

english_verse: When Jesus saw that a crowd was gathering fast, he spoke sternly to the evil spirit that had kept the boy from speaking or hearing. He said, “I order you to come out of the boy! Don't ever bother him again.”
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔni na Yesu ɔ́nu ka bekyuli pii bammɔ baaní teede-ma ni, útemi úte kɔyu kɔmɛni ɔnini, “Kɔyu kukpidi kɔni neeenu na kulétemi, mɔɔsu-ɔ ka vi lɛ ɔnamu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ kemmo, na sɔ teduo-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo kudi kudii lɛnɔ!”

english_verse: The spirit screamed and made the boy shake all over. Then it went out of him. The boy looked dead, and almost everyone said he was.
translation_verse: Kɔyu kɔmɛni kɔ́va momoomo, na kúdi ɔnamu ɔmɛni kúbo kalɔ na kɔ́lɛ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo kɔ́tɔlɔ. Ɔnamu ɔmɛni ɔ́tɛ mmɔ aani si bukpi na úkpi. Na ukyuli biala ɔni nnye mmɔ ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Úkpi!”

english_verse: But Jesus took hold of his hand and helped him stand up.
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu ɔ́da ɔnamu ɔmɛni kɔnu na ɔ́ta únye.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Only prayer can force out this kind of demon.” Jesus Again Speaks about His Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ntu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔkpali katɔ uwi ndi uwi na uulie kɔka kani ndubɔkana kɔyu kɔmɛni udu bɔbɔku bɔlɛku ukyuli lɛlɔ kemmo.” Yesu Ɔ́sɔ Ɔ́tɛmi Ɔsiku Nwuna Kukpi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Jesus left with his disciples and started through Galilee. He did not want anyone to know about it,
translation_verse: Yesu ku nwuna bakpana bátɔlɔ mmɔ na bátávi Galilea. Yesu útayɔ ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔti kesii kani na ɔkya,

english_verse: because he was teaching the disciples that the Son of Man would be handed over to people who would kill him. But three days later he would rise to life.
translation_verse: ɔsika ɔkya ɔɔtina nwuna batɛyane ala. Ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔdi ɔdubo Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi kakya bɔkya na uti-nwu ute bekyuli na badu-nwu. Na limeyi lɛtɛdi lɛlɔ ni, ɔsɔ ɔdubɔta na ulie ngba.”

english_verse: The disciples did not understand what Jesus meant, and they were afraid to ask. Who Is the Greatest? (Matthew
translation_verse: Nsu bétenu lɛla lɛni na ɔɔsu-ma mɛni kalɔ, na baayia ka beye-nwu litemi lɛmɛni kalɔ benu. Ukyuli Ɔni Ntulo

english_verse: If your foot causes you to sin, chop it off. You would be better off to go into life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.
translation_verse: Na si ƒula ɔgba muubile ƒula bɔƒɔtaadi ni, ɔlɛka ekulo ɔgba ɔmmɔ edie. Ɔdia si ebo ɔgba unwi na ákɛ ngba ƒui utulo si ebo lɛgba inyɔ na bébo-ɔ bátákya ogya kemmo.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples went to his home in Capernaum. After they were inside the house, Jesus asked them, “What were you arguing about along the way?”
translation_verse: Amu ka bésie bétédu Kapernaum ni, bétéduo kaduli kadi kemmo. Mmɔ ni, Yesu úye nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Bi litemi na bɛda bɛɛní teenene bina akɔ ka bɔdubo?”

english_verse: They had been arguing about which one of them was the greatest, and so they did not answer.
translation_verse: Nsu bátakana kenye budie. Ɔsika ɔni badubo ni, bakɛ baaní lɛsɛ ka bati ukyuli ɔni ntulo ƒui na bana akɔ.

english_verse: After Jesus sat down and told the twelve disciples to gather around him, he said, “If you want the place of honor, you must become a slave and serve others!”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úlie kalɔ na ɔ́lɔ nwuna batɛyane leevu-inyɔ bammɔ, na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bina akɔ ukyuli ɔni mɔɔwia ka bakladi bete-nwu ɔbu ni, ɔlɛka uti lɛlɔ ɔbla aani si uuubo kenyekɔ biala na bina ƒui akɔ na ɔbla bina ƒui kabla.”

english_verse: Salt is good. But if it no longer tastes like salt, how can it be made salty again? Have salt among you and live at peace with each other.
translation_verse: “Mma bɔdia. Nsu si buuubo emini ni, alakana-mu emini bɔsɔ bɔkya lɛnɔ. Anwuɔsu ni, binye lɛbibo biala kenye kpakplaa. Na bilieku lɛlɔ na bɔyɔ kemmo.”

english_verse: John said, “Teacher, we saw a man using your name to force demons out of people. But he wasn't one of us, and we told him to stop.”
translation_verse: Nwuna kama ni, ɔtɛyane ɔni baalɔ Yohane ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Ala ɔtinane, bɔ́nu ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔkya ɔɔbɔku ayu ekpidi na ƒula lɛnyi kemmo. Na bɔ́su-nwu bɔnii ɔda ɔya, ɔsika uuubo-bu akɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: Don't stop him! No one who works miracles in my name will soon turn and say something bad about me.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bitetile-nwu kuƒi, ɔsika ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla akɔla budie taatina na mina lɛnyi kemmo ni, ulásu lɛla likpidi taasiku-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Anyone who isn't against us is for us.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni nétenye útetile-bu ni, abu ku-nwu bɔdi benwi.

english_verse: And anyone who gives you a cup of water in my name, just because you belong to me, will surely be rewarded. Temptations To Sin (Matthew
translation_verse: “Na muute-mii bɔti ka ukyuli biala ɔni ndubute-mii ntu ɔnii bɛni ka mina badi na bɛdi ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ-nwu kayu. Ta Ya Na Ɔdi Unwini Kama Ɔkya Bɔƒɔtaadi

english_verse: It will be terrible for people who cause even one of my little followers to sin. Those people would be better off thrown into the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their necks.
translation_verse: “Nsu si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́ya na banamu bani náƒɔ bádi mɛni ɔdi únwini kama ɔ́kya nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi ni, ɔdububo abi geen! Si béti kabuli bényimi báda lɛtabi bonwu lɛdi na béti báƒala-nwu limɔ, na bébo-nwu bákya ɛpu kemmo ni, ɔdia-nwu utulo.

english_verse: So if your hand causes you to sin, cut it off! You would be better off to go into life paralyzed than to have two hands and be thrown into the fires of hell that never go out.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu si ƒula kɔnu kunwi kuubile ƒula bɔƒɔtaadi ni, tuna na ekulo-ku edie! Ɔdia ka ebo kɔnu kunwi pɛ na eli ngba uwi ɔni ƒui utulo ka ebo enu anyɔ na Katɔti ɔdububo-ɔ ɔvaakun na kebu kani na baakyula ala ani naaadia kemmo.

english_verse: If your eye causes you to sin, get rid of it. You would be better off to go into God's kingdom with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell.
translation_verse: Na si ƒula lɛnumi lɛɛkpanku-ɔ taatákya likpidi kemmo ni, da-ni die. Ɔdia si ebo lɛnumi linwi na éduo Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ utulo si ebo anumi anyɔ na bébo-ɔ bátákya kebu

english_verse: After Jesus left, he went to Judea and then on to the other side of the Jordan River. Once again large crowds came to him, and as usual, he taught them.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́tɔlɔ mmɔ úsie Yudea kalɔ lɛlɔ, na útávia Yordan Ketu. Bekyuli pii básɔ bébo bábaka bámana-nwu mmɔ lɛnɔ, na ɔkya ɔɔtina-ma litemi buni aani kalɛ na ɔɔyɔ́ bɔbla kalɛ.

english_verse: A woman who divorces her husband and marries again is also unfaithful.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Matthew
translation_verse: Lɛni kani si uleku ɔ́nyonu ɔgyani na ɔ́sɔ útélie kɔgya kɔbambadi lɛnɔ ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́di kɔsɔnɔ ɔ́ƒiɔ ɔgyani ɔkukudi ɔmmɔ.” Yesu Úti Kusɛ Kusɛ Úte Banamu

english_verse: Some Pharisees wanted to test Jesus. So they came up to him and asked if it was right for a man to divorce his wife.
translation_verse: Ƒarisiƒuɔ badi bébo-nwu kudɔ na nka báyɔ ka bakywɛ-nwu kakpagyuɛ. Béye Yesu banini, “Katɔti ɔda bubo uute kuƒi ka ɔnana ɔnyonu ulekudi?”

english_verse: Jesus asked them, “What does the Law of Moses say about this?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu lɛnɔ údie kenye na úye-ma ɔnini, “Bi ɔda bubo na Mose úte-mii?”

english_verse: They answered, “Moses allows a man to write out divorce papers and send his wife away.”
translation_verse: Bédie kenye banini, “Mose úte kuƒi ka ɔnana ɔni nsɔ naaayɔ ulekudi unweni ɔku na uti ute bɔti asa na ɔnyonu-nwu.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Moses gave you this law because you are so heartless.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Mose únweni ɔmɛni úte-mii lɛni ɔsika biidé ala bɔtina.

english_verse: But in the beginning God made a man and a woman.
translation_verse: Na kalɔ kesekɔ na kayawi budie kemmo ni, Katɔti údie ɔnana ku uleku.

english_verse: That's why a man leaves his father and mother and gets married.
translation_verse: Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔsu ɔnini, ‘Na ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, ɔnana ɔdubɔmami ɔti ku uni lɛlɔ, na anwu ku ulekudi belie basala.

english_verse: He becomes like one person with his wife. Then they are no longer two people, but one.
translation_verse: Na bana inyɔ badubɔbla ɔlɔna unwi.’ Na Katɔti anumi ni, ukyuli unwi na ɔɔnu. Na ɔɔɔdi inyɔ!

english_verse: And no one should separate a couple that God has joined together.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bekyuli bani na Katɔti úti ɔ́sala ni, ukyuli ɔyawine biala utegyingya-ma ntɛ!”

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples were back in the house, they asked him about what he had said.
translation_verse: Kama, uwi ɔni na bésie kaduli ni, nwuna batɛyane béye-nwu etemila básiku lɛla lɛni na ɔ́su na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: He told them, “A man who divorces his wife and marries someone else is unfaithful to his wife.
translation_verse: Yesu údie kalɔ ɔnini, “Ɔnana ɔni nányonu ulekudi na ɔ́sɔ úti ɔbambadi ni, ɔ́di kɔsɔnɔ ɔ́ƒiɔ ulekudi ɔkukudi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Some people brought their children to Jesus so he could bless them by placing his hands on them. But his disciples told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kani ni, bekyuli badi béti bana bebi béboku Yesu banii uti nwuna enu ɔsia-ma lɛlɔ. Nsu nwuna batɛyane bádɔnku-ma.

english_verse: I promise you that you cannot get into God's kingdom, unless you accept it the way a child does.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ukyuli ɔni naaadubo Katɔti lɛga bɔdi bɔƒɔ aani kalɛ na ɔnamu blii suɛ uuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ ni, uleduo Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ kudii.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw this, he became angry and said, “Let the children come to me! Don't try to stop them. People who are like these little children belong to the kingdom of God.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́nu lɛni ni, úbeti kɔnyi na ɔ́su nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Bɛya na banamu bebo-mi kudɔ, na bitetile-ma kuƒi. Ɔsika Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ kese kete bekyuli bani néboku lɛlɔ kalɔ aani banamu wɛlɛ wɛlɛ bamɛni udu kalɛ.

english_verse: Jesus looked closely at the man. He liked him and said, “There's one thing you still need to do. Go sell everything you own. Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come with me.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́nu-nwu ku bɔyɔ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Lɛlakpa linwi kani nébu-ɔ bɔbla. Teesie na etéti ala ani na ebo ƒui eye na eti egulabi ammɔ ete bawabane, na adubunwini ɔlakɛne na katɔ. Ɔmɛni kama ni, na ebo abasiaku-mi kama ƒui!”

english_verse: When the man heard Jesus say this, he went away gloomy and sad because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Ka ɔnana ɔmɛni únu litemi lɛmɛni ni, enu áƒɛ-nwu na ɔ́tɔlɔ ku kɔnyana, ɔsika ubo ala pii.

english_verse: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “It's hard for rich people to get into God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Yesu únwini ɔ́nu nwuna batɛyane ɔ́mana na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ubo ɔkplu geen asa na balakɛne badubɔkana na beduo Katɔti lɛga bɔdi kemmo.”

english_verse: The disciples were shocked to hear this. So Jesus told them again, “It's terribly hard to get into God's kingdom!
translation_verse: Litemi lɛmɛni lɛ́bla nwuna batɛyane bamɛni kasusu dɛye dɛye. Nsu Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Mina banamu, bɛnu kalɛ na ubo ɔkplu ute balakɛne ka bakɛ kuƒi na Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ!

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Bana mmɔ buduo ubo ɔkplu utulo kalɛ na ebuo ala utine ubendi ƒui ɔvi udila liƒi!”

english_verse: Jesus' disciples were even more amazed. They asked each other, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: Ka ɔ́su-ma litemi lɛmɛni ni, ɔ́ya na bana kasusu kásɔ kábla kalɛ kadi kébu! Na bakya beeye bana lɛlɔ banini, “Na ɔma geen ndubɔkɛ bɔƒɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus looked at them and said, “There are some things that people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie ɔmɛni kalɔ ɔnini, “Ɔyawine biala ulakana ɔmɛni bɔbla. Nsu Katɔti anwu ni, ɔɔkana lɛla biala bɔbla.”

english_verse: The disciples were confused as Jesus led them toward Jerusalem, and his other followers were afraid. Once again, Jesus took the twelve disciples aside and told them what was going to happen to him. He said:
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bákɛ ulu lɛlɔ bésela Yerusalem ni, Yesu ɔtɔ asa na nwuna batɛyane basia. Na ɔtɔtɔ ɔɔgyú batɛyane bammɔ, na liƒu lɛɛda bekyuli bani nsiaku-ma lɛnɔ. Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́lɔ nwuna batɛyane úsienku kɔƒɛlɛ na ɔ́su-ma ala ani ndubo bɔlɛku-nwu.

english_verse: We are now on our way to Jerusalem where the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses. They will sentence him to death and hand him over to foreigners,
translation_verse: Ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Binu! Búsela Yerusalem kesii kani na badubuti ami, ɔni ndi Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi, bakya bakpane benengudi ku ɔda bubo ala batinane enu kemmo. Badubɔdu-mi kukpi kɔtɔ na beti-mi bakya Romaƒuɔ lɛkɔkɔ.

english_verse: Jesus asked them what they wanted,
translation_verse: Yesu úye-ma ɔnini, “Bi na ɔdi?”

english_verse: and they answered, “When you come into your glory, please let one of us sit at your right side and the other at your left.”
translation_verse: Básu-nwu banini, “Si ésie Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma etélie lɛga bɔdi liboku lɛlɔ ni, abu lɛnɔ bɔɔyɔ́ ka bubelie-ɔ kudɔ na mmɔ. Na bula akɔ unwi ulie-ɔ kɔdianu kakɛ, na unwi lɛnɔ ulie-ɔ kɔmiinu kakɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “You don't really know what you're asking! Are you able to drink from the cup that I must soon drink from or be baptized as I must be baptized?”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛɛɛgyi lɛla lɛni na biiye! Bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́di ka bɛdubɔkana na bɛni lɛbibo ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔni na mɔɔní? Na bɛdubɔkana na bɛƒɔ bɔkpila ɔdi ɔni na mɔɔƒɔ́ na kayawi mɛni?”

english_verse: “Yes, we are!” James and John answered. Then Jesus replied, “You certainly will drink from the cup from which I must drink. And you will be baptized just as I must!
translation_verse: Amu na bédie kenye banini, “Bɔdubɔkana.” Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɛɛn, bɛdubɔni ɔɔƒɛɛ ukpidi ɔni udu na mɔɔní, na bɛdubɔƒɔ bɔkpila ɔdi ɔni udu na mɔɔƒɔ́ mɛni.

english_verse: But it isn't for me to say who will sit at my right side and at my left. This is for God to decide.”
translation_verse: Nsu liiibo kuƒi ka lidie ukyuli ɔni ndubulie-mi kɔmiinu iye kɔdianu. Mina Ɔti ndubuti ute bekyuli bani na ɔ́klibi mmɔ úse úte.”

english_verse: When the ten other disciples heard this, they were angry with James and John.
translation_verse: Ka batɛyane leevu bakladi bénu etemila amɛni ni, béti kɔnyi bakya Yakobo ku Yohane.

english_verse: But Jesus called the disciples together and said: You know that those foreigners who call themselves kings like to order their people around. And their great leaders have full power over the people they rule.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yesu ɔ́lɔ bana ƒui ɔ́sala lisu na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bina ƒui bɛgyi ka aban lɛlɔ badine benengudi bebo ɔyikun na kalɔ bamba bekyuli lɛlɔ. Na lɛlɔ badine benengu bammɔ baanya-ma taamana na bana lɛlɔ bɔtina kemmo.

english_verse: And if you want to be first, you must be everyone's slave.
translation_verse: Na si bina akɔ ɔdi ɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔƒɔ lɛnyi ni, ɔlɛka uti lɛlɔ ɔbla aani ukyuli ɔni neeebo kenyekɔ biala na bakladi ƒui akɔ.

english_verse: The Son of Man did not come to be a slave master, but a slave who will give his life to rescue many people. Jesus Heals Blind Bartimaeus (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɔsika Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi muedi útebo ɔnii babla-nwu kabla. Bubo na anwu ɔlatidi úbo ubabla kabla ute bekyuli na uti nwuna ngba ute na ɔƒɔ kayu na bekyuli pii ekpidi lili.” Yesu Ɔ́bwi Ɔnumbwɛne Bartimeo

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples went to Jericho. And as they were leaving, they were followed by a large crowd. A blind beggar by the name of Bartimaeus son of Timaeus was sitting beside the road.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane bésie bétéduo Yeriko. Na ɔni na baatɔlɔ ɔma ɔmmɔ ni, bekyuli pii badi básiaku-ma. Amu ka bákɛ ulu ni, bávi ɔnumbwɛne ɔdi baalɔ Bartimeo ɔni kalɔ ndi Timeo ubidi. Na ulie uuvele ala.

english_verse: When he heard that it was Jesus from Nazareth, he shouted, “Jesus, Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Ka únu ɔnii Yesu Nasareni mɔɔví ni, ɔ́va ɔ́su ɔnini, “Yesu! Dawid kaba kemmo ubi! Nu-mi kɔnyana!”

english_verse: Many people told the man to stop, but he shouted even louder, “Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Bekyuli pii bani mɔɔví mmɔ bábɔku-nwu banii ɔba lɛsɛ. Nsu ɔƒɛni geen na ɔ́sɔ ɔɔva momoomo taasu ɔnini, “Dawid kaba kemmo ubi! Nu-mi kɔnyana!”

english_verse: Jesus stopped and said, “Call him over!” They called out to the blind man and said, “Don't be afraid! Come on! He is calling for you.”
translation_verse: Amu ka Yesu únu-nwu butemi ni, údi únye na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bɛlɔ-nwu bite-mi.” Anwuɔsu bálɔ ɔnumbwɛne ɔmɛni banini, “Kɛ kubiti! Ta pla, ɔsika ɔɔlɔ-ɔ.”

english_verse: The man threw off his coat as he jumped up and ran to Jesus.
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, údie nwuna kɔdi úwi na ɔ́ba lɛgyu úsie Yesu kudɔ.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man answered, “Master, I want to see!”
translation_verse: Yesu úye-nwu ɔnini, “Bi na aawia ka lɛbla lite-ɔ?” Ɔnumbwɛne ɔmɛni ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Unwoti, ya mina anumi alɛmi na ntaanu!”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “You may go. Your eyes are healed because of your faith.” At once the man could see, and he went down the road with Jesus.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Teesie. Ƒula bɔƒɔtaadi bɔ́bwi-ɔ.” Na kɔnakunwi ni, nwuna anumi ébimi na úse kalɔ ɔɔnu. Amu na ɔ́siaku Yesu, na bana ƒui bátɔlɔ bésie bana ulu.

english_verse: After Jesus had gone to Jerusalem, he went into the temple and looked around at everything. But since it was already late in the day, he went back to Bethany with the twelve disciples. Jesus Puts a Curse on a Fig Tree (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɔni na úduo Yerusalem ni, Yesu úsie Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ. Na ɔ́nu mmɔ ku lɛla biala ɔ́mana. Nsu ka kadi káayu ɔsu ni, ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie Betania ku nwuna batɛyane na bátátɛ mmɔ. Yesu Úwida Kɔdingyii Kɔdi

english_verse: That evening, Jesus and the disciples went outside the city. A Lesson from the Fig Tree (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɔni na useyi uwi údu ni, Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane bátɔlɔ na ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo. Bánu Ka Kɔdingyii Kɔni Na Yesu Úwida Kúkpi

english_verse: They asked, “What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
translation_verse: Na bébeye-nwu banini, “Ɔma ɔyikun na aabla ala amɛni? Na ɔma lɛnɔ néte-ɔ ulu?”

english_verse: If anyone asks why you are doing this, say, ‘The Lord needs it and will soon bring it back.’ ”

translation_verse: Na si béƒie kɔlakpi báda iye báni ugyulo ukpidi ɔdi biala ni, ulabla-ma lɛla lɛdi. Si béti bana enu básia balɛne lɛlɔ ni, badubɔkɛ lɛlɔ ɔkplu.” Katɔti Úti Yesu Úsienku Katɔ

english_verse: But when these disciples told what had happened, the others would not believe either. What Jesus' Followers Must Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Nsu kama ka bábati ni, básɔ bénwini bátásu bakladi. Nsu bakladi bammɔ bátaƒɔ-ma bátadi. Yesu Údie Lɛlɔ Ɔ́tina Batɛyane Leevu-unwi Bammɔ

english_verse: Anyone who believes me and is baptized will be saved. But anyone who refuses to believe me will be condemned.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni náƒɔ litemi buni lɛmɛni ɔ́di na ɔ́ƒɔ ntu bɔkpila ni, Katɔti ɔdubudie-nwu ɔlɛku ekpidi kɔtu bɔni kemmo. Na ukyuli ɔni nátaƒɔ útadi ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔdu-nwu kɔtɔ.

english_verse: After the Lord Jesus had said these things to the disciples, he was taken back up to heaven where he sat down at the right side of God.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Blɔti Yesu ɔ́tɛmiku-ma mmɔ kama ni, Katɔti úti-nwu úsienku katɔ na útélie keliekɔ kenengudi kani nsiaku Ɔti kadi.

english_verse: Afterwards, Jesus appeared to his eleven disciples as they were eating. He scolded them because they were too stubborn to believe the ones who had seen him after he had been raised to life.
translation_verse: Kukplodi ni, Yesu údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina nwuna batɛyane leevu-unwi uwi ɔni na belie baadi. Nsu ɔ́dɔnku-ma ɔsika beeebo bɔƒɔtaadi, na bábla atu ɔkplu bágya, na bátaƒɔ bekyuli bani nánu-nwu ka ɔ́ta ɔ́sɔ úbo uli ngba bátadi.

english_verse: Then he told them: Go and preach the good news to everyone in the world.
translation_verse: Ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Biteesie kayawi ƒui na bitákɔ Katɔti litemi buni lɛmɛni lɛsa na bekyuli ƒui akɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who believes me will be able to do wonderful things. By using my name they will force out demons, and they will speak new languages.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔdubute baƒɔtaadine ɔyikun na babla akɔla lidu lidu. Badubɔgya ayu ekpidi na mina lɛnyi kemmo. Badubutemi adi lidu lidu.

english_verse: Many people have tried to tell the story of what God has done among us.
translation_verse: Ati Tioƒilo, bekyuli pii bákya ɔkplu na bábla kalɛ na bakana bɔbla na bénweni ala ani ƒui nálɛ na bula akɔ bése.

english_verse: They wrote what we had been told by the ones who were there in the beginning and saw what happened.
translation_verse: Bénweni-nya aani kalɛ na bekyuli bani nánu ala amɛni ɔ́si nyana kalɔ kesekɔ básu-bu na bákɔ-nya lɛsa lɛnɔ.

english_verse: So I made a careful study of everything and then decided to write and tell you exactly what took place. Honorable Theophilus,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, Ɔbune Tioƒilo, ka ami líwi lɛlɔ lɛ́tɛya ala amɛni ƒui ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ ɔsu ni, lɛ́bla kasusu ka ɔdia ka línweni kalɛ na ala amɛni álɛ nwaa lite-ɔ.

english_verse: I have done this to let you know the truth about what you have heard. An Angel Tells about the Birth of John
translation_verse: Mɔɔbla ɔmɛni kalɛ na anu litemi geen lɛmmɔ ati ƒui ɔ́si ala ani na bátina-a lɛlɔ. Yohane Bɔwɔ Linyese

english_verse: When Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest by the name of Zechariah from the priestly group of Abijah. His wife Elizabeth was from the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Herode ɔɔdi lɛga na Yudea kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti ɔkpane ɔdi ɔkya ɔni baalɔ Sakaria. Ɔ́si ɔkpane bɔdi ulu ɔni nkɛ ɔkpane ɔni baalɔ Abia ulu lɛlɔ. Sakaria ɔmɛni ulekudi baalɔ Elisabet na anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́si Katɔti ɔkpane ɔni baalɔ Aaron kaba kemmo.

english_verse: Both of them were good people and pleased the Lord God by obeying all that he had commanded.
translation_verse: Ɔgya ku ule bamɛni bélie ngba bɔbuni na Katɔti anumi. Na bádi nwuna ɔda bubo ƒui lɛlɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: But they did not have children. Elizabeth could not have any, and both Zechariah and Elizabeth were already old.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni beeebo bebi badi, ɔsika Elisabet ɔdi udinkɔ. Na bana inyɔ lɛnɔ báabi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: One day Zechariah's group of priests were on duty, and he was serving God as a priest.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛdi ni, Sakaria ɔkya Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ ɔɔbla nwuna ɔkpane kabla ɔsika nwuna lɛlɔ na údu.

english_verse: According to the custom of the priests, he had been chosen to go into the Lord's temple that day and to burn incense,
translation_verse: Ɔsika na bana bakpane ɔdi bɔbla kemmo ni, bátu egulabi bánu na Sakaria ɔmmɔ ɔdi nénwini úwi. Anwuɔsu anwu na báƒuna ka ɔkyula oloƒui ute Katɔti na nwuna lɛkpabi lɛlɔ. Amu na úduo úsie Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: All at once an angel from the Lord appeared to Zechariah at the right side of the altar.
translation_verse: Amu na Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina-nwu na unye use kesii kani na oloƒui ɔmmɔ ɔɔkywí kɔdianu kakɛ.

english_verse: Zechariah was confused and afraid when he saw the angel.
translation_verse: Na ɔni na Sakaria ɔ́nu-nwu ni, liƒu lɛ́da-nwu geen.

english_verse: But the angel told him: Don't be afraid, Zechariah! God has heard your prayers. Your wife Elizabeth will have a son, and you must name him John.
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Sakaria, tayia! Katɔti únu ƒula bɔkpali, na ƒula ulekudi Elisabet ɔdubɔwɔ ɔnanabi ute-ɔ. Na adubɔsia-nwu lɛnyi anii Yohane.

english_verse: His birth will make you very happy, and many people will be glad.
translation_verse: Si báwɔ-nwu ni, adubɔkɛ kubiti geen. Lɛni kani na bekyuli pii lɛnɔ badubɔkɛ kubiti.

english_verse: Your son will be a great servant of the Lord. He must never drink wine or beer, and the power of the Holy Spirit will be with him from the time he is born.
translation_verse: Ɔdubo ukyuli ubendi bɔbla na Katɔti anumi. Útalɛka ɔni ntɛ kpakplaa iye bɔbambadi bɔdi udu lɛnɔ. Na ɔ́si nwuna bɔwɔ uwi ni, Katɔti kɔyu kɔdubɔƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: John will lead many people in Israel to turn back to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Na anwu ndubo Israel bekyuli pii bɔsɔku buboku bana Unwoti Katɔti kudɔ.

english_verse: He will go ahead of the Lord with the same power and spirit that Elijah had. And because of John, parents will be more thoughtful of their children. And people who now disobey God will begin to think as they ought to. This is how John will get people ready for the Lord.
translation_verse: Anwu ndubɔka Blɔti bubo na ɔyikun ku kayi buse kemmo aani kalɛ na Katɔti Kenye Udiene Elia úse kalɛ. Na anwu ndubo bebi ku bati bɔsɔku bɔsala. Na ɔdubunwini batuɔkplune kasusu úboku kasusu kedee bɔbla lɛlɔ. Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na Blɔti bekyuli benye kagyumana bete-nwu.”

english_verse: Zechariah said to the angel, “How will I know this is going to happen? My wife and I are both very old.”
translation_verse: Amu na Sakaria úye ɔtu ɔmɛni ɔnini, “Bi ndubɔya na lɛƒɔ ɔmɛni lɛdi? Ɔsika lɛ́ɛbla unengu na mina ulekudi lɛnɔ ɔ́ɔbi.”

english_verse: The angel answered, “I am Gabriel, God's servant, and I was sent to tell you this good news.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔtu ɔmɛni údie kenye ɔnini, “Ami ndi Gabriel ɔni muunye Katɔti anumi. Anwu nátala-mi ɔnii mbasu-ɔ kenye kabuni kamɛni.

english_verse: You have not believed what I have said. So you will not be able to say a thing until all this happens. But everything will take place when it is supposed to.”
translation_verse: Nsu átaƒɔ-mi kenye kamɛni átadi. Ina ka átaƒɔ-ka átadi ni, kadubo bɔlɛ na uwi ɔni na Katɔti úse-ka úse lɛlɔ. Na ɔmɛni ɔsu adububo limu wetédu limeyi lɛni na kenye kamɛni kébo kéte lɛni sɔsɔ.”

english_verse: The crowd was waiting for Zechariah and kept wondering why he was staying in the temple so long.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ala amɛni ƒui aalɛ́ ni, ɔ́bla bekyuli bani nnye bagya Sakaria na keyi mmɔ kalɛ kadi, ɔsika balati lɛla lɛni ɔsu na uutu uwi na Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ mmɔ lɛni.

english_verse: When he did come out, he could not speak, and they knew he had seen a vision. He motioned to them with his hands, but did not say a thing.
translation_verse: Ka ɔ́lɛ úbo ni, ɔsɔ ulákana-ma butemiku. Anwuɔsu bánu báti ka ɔ́nu budie bɔtina bɔdi na Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ mmɔ. Na ka ulákana butemi ɔsu ni, enu kani na uudie taatɛmiku-ma ala.

english_verse: When Zechariah's time of service in the temple was over, he went home.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na nwuna lɛkpa kabla kása na Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ mmɔ ni, Sakaria ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie kaduli.

english_verse: Soon after this, his wife was expecting a baby, and for five months she did not leave the house. She said to herself,
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni kama ni, Elisabet úbada kaƒɔ ɔni na ɔsɔ ulalɛ. Na ɔ́bɛla lɛlɔ abuli alɔ sɔɔn.

english_verse: “What the Lord has done for me will keep people from looking down on me.” An Angel Tells about the Birth of Jesus
translation_verse: Amu na Elisabet ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɔƒɛni ni, Katɔti ɔ́bla ɔmɛni úte-mi, na ɔ́tala mina kɔƒa na kadi anumi.” Yesu Bɔwɔ Linyese

english_verse: One month later God sent the angel Gabriel to the town of Nazareth in Galilee
translation_verse: Na Elisabet kaƒɔ bɔda kɔbuli kɔkundi kemmo ni, Katɔti ɔ́tala nwuna ɔtu Gabriel ɔnii usie ɔma ɔni baalɔ Nasaret na Galilea kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: with a message for a virgin named Mary. She was engaged to Joseph from the family of King David.
translation_verse: Ɔtu ɔmɛni úti kenye úsienku ulekubi ɔni na bévele béte ɔnana ɔni baalɔ banii Yoseƒ na ɔ́si Ɔga Dawid kaba kemmo. Ulekubi ɔmmɔ lɛnyi ndi Maria.

english_verse: The angel greeted Mary and said, “You are truly blessed! The Lord is with you.”
translation_verse: Ɔtu ɔmmɔ úbo Maria kudɔ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Mɔɔkɔ́-ɔ lɛlɔ buɛɛ! Blɔti ɔsiaku-ɔ na úte-ɔ kusɛ kusɛ.”

english_verse: Mary was confused by the angel's words and wondered what they meant.
translation_verse: Ɔtu ɔmɛni kenye kani na ɔ́su ɔ́ya na Maria kasusu kéƒu, ɔsika útenu kenye kammɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: Then the angel told Mary, “Don't be afraid! God is pleased with you,
translation_verse: Amu na ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Maria, tayia. Ƒula lɛlɔ lɛ́da Katɔti kubiti geen.

english_verse: and you will have a son. His name will be Jesus.
translation_verse: Adubo kaƒɔ bɔda na awɔ ɔnanabi, na adubɔsia-nwu lɛnyi anii Yesu.

english_verse: He will be great and will be called the Son of God Most High. The Lord God will make him king, as his ancestor David was.
translation_verse: Ɔdubo lɛnyi bɔƒɔ geen na badubɔlɔ-nwu banii Katɔti ɔni ndi Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔlati Ubidi. Na Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubɔya na ubi ɔmmɔ ɔdi lɛga aani nwuna Nana Dawid kalɛ.

english_verse: He will rule the people of Israel forever, and his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: Na ɔdubo lɛga bɔdi na Yakob kaba kemmo uwi ƒui. Na nwuna lɛga kadikɔ kalása kudii.”

english_verse: Mary asked the angel, “How can this happen? I am not even married!”
translation_verse: Amu na Maria úye-nwu ɔnini, “Dɛ na ɔmɛni webo wete lɛni ka adagyaa na ndi?”

english_verse: The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come down to you, and God's power will come over you. So your child will be called the holy Son of God.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔtu ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔmmɔ Kɔyu kɔdubo-ɔ lɛlɔ na nwuna ɔyikun ɔƒɔ-ɔ lɛlɔ kemmo. Anwuɔsu ubi kedee ɔni na adubo bɔwɔ ni, badubɔlɔ-nwu banii Katɔti Ubidi.

english_verse: Your relative Elizabeth is also going to have a son, even though she is old. No one thought she could ever have a baby, but in three months she will have a son.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni mɔɔyá-a na ati ka ni, ƒula ɔtɔ kemmo uleku ɔni ndi Elisabet na baalɔ-nwu udinkɔ ni, ɔ́ɔda kaƒɔ ina ka nwuna akwa éesie lɛtɔtɔ geen. Na nwuna kɔbuli kɔkundi kemmo na ɔkya mɛni.

english_verse: Nothing is impossible for God!”
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛla lɛdi liiibo Katɔti ɔkplu.”

english_verse: Mary said, “I am the Lord's servant! Let it happen as you have said.” And the angel left her. Mary Visits Elizabeth
translation_verse: Amu na Maria ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Nu, Blɔti kabla ɔblane na ndi. Ɔbla ute-mi aani kalɛ na ásu.” Amu na Katɔti ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́tɔlɔ. Maria Úsie Elisabet Kudɔ

english_verse: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, her baby moved within her. The Holy Spirit came upon Elizabeth.
translation_verse: Na ka Elisabet únu Maria kegye ni, ubi ɔni nkya-nwu kaƒɔ kemmo úkpo, na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ Elisabet lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: Then in a loud voice she said to Mary: God has blessed you more than any other woman! He has also blessed the child you will have.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́su ku lɛdi momoomo ɔnini, “Béte-ɔ kusɛ kusɛ na beleku ƒui akɔ, na béte ƒula kaƒɔ ubi lɛnɔ kusɛ kusɛ!

english_verse: Why should the mother of my Lord come to me?
translation_verse: Ɔma na ndi ɔsu na Blɔti uni ɔɔkɔ́-mi lɛlɔ?

english_verse: As soon as I heard your greeting, my baby became happy and moved within me.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni kani na ƒula kegye kánya kéduo-mi atu kemmo ni, mmɔ kani na ubi ɔni nkya-mi kaƒɔ kemmo úkpo na lɛlɔyɔ kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed you because you believed that he will keep his promise. Mary's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Na lɛlɔ litaayɔ-ɔ geen, ɔsika áƒɔ ádi ka kenye kani na Katɔti ɔ́su ɔ́siku-ɔ lɛlɔ kadububo kete lɛni.” Maria Ɔ́tu Linugya Ɔnu

english_verse: Mary said: With all my heart I praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Amu na Maria ɔ́su ɔnini, “Mina kayi keemwi Blɔti.

english_verse: and I am glad because of God my Savior.
translation_verse: Na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́ mina kɔyu na Katɔti ɔni ndi mina Ɔƒɔne lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God cares for me, his humble servant. From now on, all people will say God has blessed me.
translation_verse: Ɔsika únyimo ami, nwuna kabla ɔblane ɔni naaadi lɛla lɛdi. Na ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ni, kaba ƒui badubo-mi bɔlɔ banii ukyuli ɔni na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi.

english_verse: God All-Powerful has done great things for me, and his name is holy.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Ɔyikune Ƒui nábla ala ebendi amɛni úte-mi, na nwuna lɛnyi nse kedee.

english_verse: He always shows mercy to everyone who worships him.
translation_verse: Nwuna kɔnyana bɔnu kuse kute kaba ƒui bekyuli bani mɔɔbu-nwu.

english_verse: The Lord has used his powerful arm to scatter those who are proud.
translation_verse: Údie nwuna ɔyikun keyi, na úgyingya bekyuli bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ.

english_verse: God drags strong rulers from their thrones and puts humble people in places of power.
translation_verse: Úboku baga benengudi ƒui kalɔ, na ɔ́kɔliku bani néboku lɛlɔ kalɔ katɔ.

english_verse: God gives the hungry good things to eat, and sends the rich away with nothing.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ya na bekyuli bani na kɔka kɔɔda ƒui bémo ku ala abuni sɔɔn, na balakɛne bénwini ku enukplu.

english_verse: God helps his servant Israel and is always merciful to his people.
translation_verse: Nwuna anumi asia kenye kani na ɔ́su bula bati kuuku úse lɛlɔ, na úbo ɔnii ubebunku Israel kadi bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord made this promise to our ancestors, to Abraham and his family forever!
translation_verse: Únyimo ka uti kɔnyana bɔnu ute Abraham ku nwuna bawɔ úsela ƒui!”

english_verse: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months. Then she went back home. The Birth of John the Baptist
translation_verse: Amu na Maria ɔ́sɔ ɔkya Elisabet kudɔ aani abuli atɛ sɔɔn asa na ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie ɔma. Yohane Ntu Ɔkpilane Bɔwɔ

english_verse: When Elizabeth's son was born,
translation_verse: Uwi úbedu Elisabet ka ɔwɔ. Na ɔ́wɔ ɔnanabi.

english_verse: her neighbors and relatives heard how kind the Lord had been to her, and they too were glad.
translation_verse: Na Elisabet liku bekyuli ku banwa ƒui bénu akɔla ebendi ani na Katɔti ɔ́bla úte-nwu. Na bana ƒui bákɛku-nwu ebiti kaduɛ.

english_verse: Eight days later they did for the child what the Law of Moses commands. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.
translation_verse: Ka ɔnamu ɔmmɔ ɔ́ƒɔ emeyi maane ni, bébo banii bebekulo-nwu lego na báwia ka basia-nwu ɔti lɛnyi banii Sakaria.

english_verse: But Elizabeth said, “No! His name is John.”
translation_verse: Nsu uni útatunaku-ma na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛsia-nwu lɛnyi bɛnii Yohane.”

english_verse: The people argued, “No one in your family has ever been named John.”
translation_verse: Amu na bákyaku-nwu unyeƒi banii, “Na ka balálɔ ƒula ɔtɔ kemmo ukyuli ɔdi banii Yohane nɔɔ?”

english_verse: So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.
translation_verse: Amu na bébo ɔti enu béye-nwu bénu lɛnyi lɛni na ɔɔwia ka basia ubidi.

english_verse: Zechariah asked for a writing tablet. Then he wrote, “His name is John.” Everyone was amazed.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Sakaria ɔ́ƒɔ lɛla lɛni lɛlɔ na beenweni ala taasia na únweni ɔnii, “Nwuna lɛnyi ndi Yohane.” Na ɔ́bla bana ƒui dɛye dɛye.

english_verse: At once, Zechariah started speaking and praising God.
translation_verse: Mmɔ kani na Sakaria úse kalɔ ku butemi na uumwi Katɔti.

english_verse: All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things.
translation_verse: Liƒu bonwu lɛdi lɛ́da nwuna liku bekyuli ɔni náya na litemi lɛmɛni lígyingya lɛ́kya lɛma lɛni nkya Yudea abi lɛlɔ ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him. Zechariah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ƒui nénu ala amɛni béti kasusu kadi na béye lɛlɔ banii, “Bi ukyuli udu na ɔnamu ɔmɛni ɔdubo bunwini geen tɔ?” Béye lɛlɔ lɛni ɔsika use nwaa ka Katɔti ɔyikun ɔsiaku-nwu. Sakaria Údie Katɔti Kenye

english_verse: The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ ubi ɔmmɔ ɔti Sakaria lɛlɔ kemmo na ɔ́su úse ɔnini,

english_verse: Praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to save his people.
translation_verse: “Bɛya na bumwi Blɔti, Israel Unwoti, ɔsika úbo úbebunku nwuna kadi na ɔƒɔ-ma na bakɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.
translation_verse: Úti Ɔƒɔne Ɔyikune ɔdi úte-bu ɔni na ɔdi anwu ɔlati kabla ɔblane Dawid kaba kemmo ubi.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets
translation_verse: Úse kenye kamɛni úse kukuuku ɔkɛ nwuna kenye bediene kedee lɛlɔ ka ni,

english_verse: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.
translation_verse: ɔdubudie-bu ɔlɛku ekpidi bablane ku ama bani na muukisi-bu ƒui enu kemmo.

english_verse: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.
translation_verse: Ɔ́su ka ɔdubɔnu bula bati kuuku kɔnyana na wenyimo bunyimi kedee bɔni nkya ama ku-nwu ntɛ.

english_verse: that he would rescue us from our enemies. Then we could serve him without fear,
translation_verse: ɔdubudie-bu na bula bekisine enu kemmo, na ɔdubɔya na bɔbla-nwu kabla na liƒu lɛsɔ lɛɛɛdubo-bu bɔda.

english_verse: by being holy and good as long as we live.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔbla-bu kedee na buse siin na nwuna anumi na bula ngba emeyi kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.
translation_verse: Na awɔ, mina ubi ni, badubɔlɔ-ɔ banii Katɔti Ɔni Ntulo Ƒui Kenye Udiene. Awɔ ndubo bɔgyu bɔtɔ na Blɔti lɛtɔtɔ kalɛ na aklibi ulu ese ete nwuna bubo.

english_verse: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Na aya nwuna bekyuli bati ka badubɔkɛ bɔƒɔ na bana ekpidi buti taakyiɛ ɔsu.

english_verse: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.
translation_verse: Bula Katɔti use buɛɛ, na ɔɔnu kɔnyana. Ɔdubɔtala Ɔƒɔne ɔkya-bu ɔni muukeye aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛ ɔɔtu.

english_verse: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.
translation_verse: Na ɔya na bukeye bɔmɛni bɔsi katɔ buwi bekyuli bani nli kasuudikɔ na kukpi liƒu lɛɛda-ma kalɛ na ɔkpanku-bu ɔvinku keyi buɛɛ ulu lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Amu na ubi ɔmmɔ ɔ́lɛ lili na nwuna kayi kasia Katɔti lɛlɔ kpakplaa. Na ketele ntɛ kani na úlie úti útédu uwi ɔni na ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ Israel kadi anumi.

english_verse: About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Ɔga Unengudi Kaesare Augusto úte ɔyikun ɔnii benweni bekyuli bani ƒui nkya Roma lɛga bɔdi kalɔ anyi.

english_verse: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, ɔnana ɔdi baalɔ banii Simeon ɔkya Yerusalem. Na ɔdi ukyuli ɔbuni ɔni na ɔɔyia Katɔti na unye ɔɔnu ulu ute Israel bɔƒɔ. Na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔsiaku-nwu

english_verse: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli anyi bunweni budeedi bɔmɛni kemmo ni, aban unengu ɔni baalɔ banii Kirenio mɔɔdi Siria kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Everyone had to go to their own hometown to be listed.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ukyuli biala úsie nwuna ɔma úténweni lɛnyi.

english_verse: So Joseph had to leave Nazareth in Galilee and go to Bethlehem in Judea. Long ago Bethlehem had been King David's hometown, and Joseph went there because he was from David's family.
translation_verse: Amu na Yoseƒ lɛnɔ ɔ́ta ɔ́si Nasaret ɔma na Galilea kalɔ lɛlɔ úsie Betlehem na Yudea kalɔ lɛlɔ kesii kani na báwɔ Ɔga Dawid. Yoseƒ úsie mmɔ ɔsika ɔdi Dawid kaba kemmo ubi.

english_verse: Mary was engaged to Joseph and traveled with him to Bethlehem. She was soon going to have a baby,
translation_verse: Útiku Maria ɔni na bévele béte-nwu na ɔda kaƒɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: she gave birth to her first-born son. She dressed him in baby clothes and laid him on a bed of hay, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds
translation_verse: Ɔ́wɔ nwuna ubi ɔnanabi udeedi na ɔtɔ kakɛ kani na bebuo batɛ. Na únyimi-nwu ɔ́kya kɔdi kemmo, na úti-nwu ɔ́va lɛla lɛni kemmo na bebuo bammɔ baadi, ɔsika kakyakɔ kadi kasɔ keeebo na baƒɔ keduokɔ. Katɔti Batu Béboku Baƒonu Badane Linyesia Lɛbuni

english_verse: That night in the fields near Bethlehem some shepherds were guarding their sheep.
translation_verse: Amu na likpo lɛmmɔ na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ni, baƒonu badane badi bakya baanu bana bebuo lɛlɔ usien ƒui.

english_verse: All at once an angel came down to them from the Lord, and the brightness of the Lord's glory flashed around them. The shepherds were frightened.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ-ma lɛlɔ na Unwoti bukeye bɔdi búkeye búbewi-ma lɛlɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu báyia geen,

english_verse: But the angel said, “Don't be afraid! I have good news for you, which will make everyone happy.
translation_verse: nsu Katɔti ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bitayia. Líboku-mii linyesia lɛbuni lɛni ndubuti lɛlɔyɔ ku ebiti geen ute bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni kani lɛlɔ ni, báwɔ Ɔƒɔne ɔni ndi Blɔti Kristo béte-mii na Ɔga Dawid ɔma kemmo.

english_verse: You will know who he is, because you will find him dressed in baby clothes and lying on a bed of hay.”
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni na bɛdubuti bɛnu bɛti ni, ani ndi ka bɛdubɔnu ubiwɔ ɔni bényimi bákya kɔdi kemmo na ɔtɛ bebuo kadikɔ.”

english_verse: Suddenly many other angels came down from heaven and joined in praising God. They said:
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, Katɔti batu lɛkpa bonwu lɛdi lɛ́si kayaa lɛ́da lɛ́lɛ-ma lɛlɔ na líbebunku ɔtu ɔmɛni na bakya beemwi Katɔti banii,

english_verse: “Praise God in heaven! Peace on earth to everyone who pleases God.”
translation_verse: “Ɔbu ku bumwi ute Katɔti na katɔ kakaaka ƒui, na keyi buɛɛ kasiaku bayawine ƒui bani na Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́!”

english_verse: After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, “Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.”
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na Katɔti batu bamɛni bátɔlɔ-ma kudɔ na básɔ bénwini bésie katɔ ni, baƒonu badane bamɛni básu lɛlɔ banii, “Bɛya na busie Betlehem butánu ala ani nálɛ na Unwoti údie ɔ́tina-bu mɛni.”

english_verse: They hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and they saw the baby lying on a bed of hay.
translation_verse: Amu na bábabla bésie na bátánu Maria ku Yoseƒ ku ubiwɔ ɔni ntɛ bebuo kadikɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: When the shepherds saw Jesus, they told his parents what the angel had said about him.
translation_verse: Na ka bánu-nwu lɛni ni, básu ala ani ƒui na Katɔti ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔ́si ubi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But Mary kept thinking about all this and wondering what it meant.
translation_verse: Nsu Maria únyimo ala amɛni ƒui, na úti-nya lɛlɔ kasusu úsie ɔgyu.

english_verse: As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.
translation_verse: Amu na baƒonu badane bammɔ básɔ bénwini na beemwi Katɔti na ala ani ƒui na bánu ku ani bénu lɛnɔ lɛlɔ, ɔsika ana ƒui ese pɛpɛɛpɛ kalɛ kani na Katɔti ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-ma. Básia Ubiwɔ Lɛnyi

english_verse: Eight days later Jesus' parents did for him what the Law of Moses commands. And they named him Jesus, just as the angel had told Mary when he promised she would have a baby. Simeon Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Na emeyi maane kama ka uwi úbedu ka bekulo ubi ɔmmɔ lego ni, básia-nwu lɛnyi banii Yesu aani kalɛ kani na Katɔti ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su úse asa na badubɔda-nwu kaƒɔ. Béti Yesu Bésienku Yudaƒuɔ Kakpakɔ
