english_verse: The time came for Mary and Joseph to do what the Law of Moses says a mother is supposed to do after her baby is born. They took Jesus to the temple in Jerusalem and presented him to the Lord,
translation_verse: Amu na uwi úbedu ka Yoseƒ ku Maria babla lɛlɔ bɔbla sɛɛn ɔdi aani kalɛ na Mose ɔda bubo bɔɔtina kenye. Na béti ubiwɔ ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ bésienku Yerusalem banii beeti-nwu bete Unwoti.

english_verse: just as the Law of the Lord says, “Each first-born baby boy belongs to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Lɛni na bénweni bákya Katɔti ɔda bubo ɔku kemmo banii, “Ɔnanabi udeedi biala ku ebuo ɔgyani udeedi biala ni, ɔdi ka bedie-nwu bese bete Unwoti.”

english_verse: The Law of the Lord also says parents have to offer a sacrifice, giving at least a pair of doves or two young pigeons. So that is what Mary and Joseph did.
translation_verse: Na bésie bátábla akpala béte Unwoti, ɔsika ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔ́tina ka beti babloduma inyɔ iye bamangbɛ inyɔ bakpa bete-nwu.

english_verse: and told him that he would not die until he had seen Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: na kúse-nwu kayi ka ulekpi wetédu lebo lɛni na ɔ́nu ka báwɔ Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔni kenye na Katɔti ɔ́su úse.

english_verse: When Mary and Joseph brought Jesus to the temple to do what the Law of Moses says should be done for a new baby, the Spirit told Simeon to go into the temple.
translation_verse: Amu na Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kɔ́tɔnku Simon kúsienku Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ mmɔ. Na ka bawɔne bamɛni béti Yesu ubiwɔ béboku banii bababla ala ani ƒui na ɔdi ka babla bete-nwu na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kenye ni,

english_verse: Simeon took the baby Jesus in his arms and praised God,
translation_verse: Simon ɔ́ƒɔ ubiwɔ ɔmmɔ ɔ́da, na ɔ́gya Katɔti enu ɔnini,

english_verse: “Lord, I am your servant, and now I can die in peace, because you have kept your promise to me.
translation_verse: “Unwoti, ɔƒɛni ni, ka ásia ƒula linyese anu ɔsu ni, akana na edie ami, ƒula kabla ɔblane, ulu na nteesie ku keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: and foreign nations will also see this.
translation_verse: ɔni na áya na úbo na kadi bekyuli ƒui anumi.

english_verse: Your mighty power is a light for all nations, and it will bring honor to your people Israel.”
translation_verse: Ɔdi bukeye bɔni ndubudie ƒula lɛyɔla keyi ute bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ. Na ɔdubuti ɔbu uboku ƒula kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ akɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus' parents were surprised at what Simeon had said.
translation_verse: Ala ani na Simon ɔ́su mɛni áya na ɔ́bla Yoseƒ ku Maria dɛye dɛye.

english_verse: Then he blessed them and told Mary, “This child of yours will cause many people in Israel to fall and others to stand. The child will be like a warning sign. Many people will reject him,
translation_verse: Na Simon úte-ma kusɛ kusɛ na ɔ́su Maria ɔnini, “Ubi ɔmɛni ɔdi Katɔti Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi. Na ɔdi bɔƒɔ iye bɔyii ute Israelƒuɔ pii na kalɛ na báƒɔ-nwu kenye. Ɔdi bɔnu bɔti bɔni nási Katɔti kudɔ na bekyuli pii badubɔta benye-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and you, Mary, will suffer as though you had been stabbed by a dagger. But all this will show what people are really thinking.” Anna Speaks about the Child Jesus
translation_verse: Na ɔdubo bekyuli bamɛni kasusu kani nábɛ keyi budie. Na ɔkɛ ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, adubunu ɔlɛ aani kalɛ na kewii kaatu ukyuli kayi.”

english_verse: At this time Anna came in and praised God. She spoke about the child Jesus to everyone who hoped for Jerusalem to be set free. The Return to Nazareth
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kani kemmo ni, anwu lɛnɔ úbo na úti linugya úte Katɔti, na útemi ɔ́siku ubi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ úte bekyuli bani ƒui nnye baanu Katɔti ulu ka waƒɔ Yerusalem. Bénwini Bésie Nasaret

english_verse: After Joseph and Mary had done everything that the Law of the Lord commands, they returned home to Nazareth in Galilee.
translation_verse: Na ka Yoseƒ ku Maria báwɔlɔ bana ɔdi bɔbla aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔda bubo ɔku ɔ́tina kalɛ ni, bénwini bésie bana ɔma Nasaret na Galilea kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The child Jesus grew. He became strong and wise, and God blessed him. The Boy Jesus in the Temple
translation_verse: Ubi ɔmmɔ ɔ́lɛ lili na ɔ́kɛ lɛlɔ ɔkplu, na ɔ́da anu geen. Na nwuna lɛlɔ lɛ́da Katɔti kubiti. Yesu Úsie Yudaƒuɔ Kakpakɔ

english_verse: Every year Jesus' parents went to Jerusalem for Passover.
translation_verse: Lɛkwa ndi lɛkwa ni, Yesu bawɔne beesié Yerusalem taatádi limeyi lɛni baalɔ banii Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi.

english_verse: And when Jesus was twelve years old, they all went there as usual for the celebration.
translation_verse: Amu ka Yesu ɔ́ƒɔ akwa leevu-anyɔ ni, básɔ bésie Yerusalem aani kalɛ na baabla kukuuku kalɛ.

english_verse: After Passover his parents left, but they did not know that Jesus had stayed on in the city.
translation_verse: Na ka limeyi lɛmmɔ bɔdi lɛ́sa na básɔ bénwini bésela ɔma ni, Yesu anwu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́kya kama na Yerusalem mmɔ. Na nwuna bawɔne bátati lɛni.

english_verse: They thought he was traveling with some other people, and they went a whole day before they started looking for him.
translation_verse: Ama bábu banii ɔkya bekyuli bammɔ akɔ ɔsu bésie ɔƒɛ umodi ulu asa na bése kalɔ baawia-nwu na bakpana ku nwuna lɛlɔ bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: When they could not find him with their relatives and friends, they went back to Jerusalem and started looking for him there.
translation_verse: Na ka bátanu-nwu ɔsu ni, básɔ bénwini bésie Yerusalem bakɛ baawia-nwu.

english_verse: Three days later they found Jesus sitting in the temple, listening to the teachers and asking them questions.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛtɛdi lɛlɔ ni, bátánu-nwu na Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ ka anwu ku Yudaƒuɔ ala batinane badi belie. Mmɔ na ɔkya uunú bana ala ani na baasu na uuye-ma etemila ekpo ekpo teenu.

english_verse: Everyone who heard him was surprised at how much he knew and at the answers he gave.
translation_verse: Na bani nénu-nwu ala kenye budie ni, ɔ́bla-ma dɛye dɛye na lɛlati bonwu lɛni udu na ɔda uudie ala ani beeye-nwu kenye ɔsu.

english_verse: When his parents found him, they were amazed. His mother said, “Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been very worried, and we have been searching for you!”
translation_verse: Ɔtɔtɔ ɔ́gyu nwuna bawɔne ka bánu-nwu lɛni. Na uni úye-nwu ɔnini, “Ubi, bi ɔsu na ábla-bu lɛmɛni udu? Ami ku ƒula ɔti ƒui búduo lɛƒɛda kemmo na bɔkɛ bɔɔví taawia-a.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Why did you have to look for me? Didn't you know that I would be in my Father's house?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Bi ɔsu na bɛkɛ bɛɛwia-mi taavi? Bɛɛɛgyi bɛnii mina Ɔti kesii na ɔlɛka lɛkya yoo?”

english_verse: But they did not understand what he meant.
translation_verse: Nsu ama bétenu lɛla lɛni na ɔ́su-ma mɛni kalɔ.

english_verse: Jesus went back to Nazareth with his parents and obeyed them. His mother kept on thinking about all that had happened.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́siaku-ma na bátɔlɔ bésie Nasaret, na úboku lɛlɔ kalɔ úte-ma. Na ala amɛni ƒui éduo uni kasusu kemmo úsie ɔgyu.

english_verse: Jesus became wise, and he grew strong. God was pleased with him and so were the people.
translation_verse: Na Yesu úbalɛ lili na lɛnunda ku ɔlɔna kemmo, na ɔ́ƒɔ lɛnyi na bekyuli ku Katɔti ƒui anumi.

english_verse: When tax collectors came to be baptized, they asked John, “Teacher, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Kuyi baƒɔne badi lɛnɔ bébo banii ɔkpila-ma ntu. Ama béye-nwu banini, “Ala ɔtinane, bi na ɔlɛka bɔbla?”

english_verse: Do something to show that you really have given up your sins. Don't start saying you belong to Abraham's family. God can turn these stones into children for Abraham.
translation_verse: Bɛtina na bina ɔbladu kemmo ka bínwini kama bɛ́kya bina alaekpidi. Na bitakali ka Abraham kaba kemmo bebi bɛdi ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔɔɔdubo-mii kɔtu bɔni. Mɔɔsu-mii nnii Katɔti ɔkana udie kaba ɔsiku atakpɛ amɛni kemmo ute Abraham.

english_verse: But to Herod the ruler, he said, “It was wrong for you to take Herodias, your brother's wife.” John also said Herod had done many other bad things.
translation_verse: Na ka aban lɛga ɔdine Herode úƒie ɔnwani ulekudi ɔni baalɔ Herodia ɔ́ƒɔ ku udunkpi ala bamba pii ani na ɔ́bla ɔsu ni, Yohane ɔ́dɔnku-nwu.

english_verse: Everyone became excited and wondered, “Could John be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni lɛnunsia lɛ́kɔ katɔ líbu na bákali ka Yohane ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔni na benye bagya.

english_verse: Isaiah the prophet wrote about John when he said, “In the desert someone is shouting, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord! Make a straight path for him.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti Kenye Udiene Yesaia ɔku kemmo ni, lɛni na bénweni bákya banini, “Ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔva na ketele kemmo ɔnini, ‘Binye kagyumana bite Blɔti. Bɛklibi bina lɛlɔ kaduɛ bite nwuna bubo.

english_verse: Fill up every valley and level every mountain and hill. Straighten the crooked paths and smooth out the rough roads.
translation_verse: Biyile lɛbonka na bɛbwɛ abi ku abinkpo ƒui na atɛ kalɔ. Na binyene lilu lɛni nábu. Na kesii kani nse kpukplo kpukplo ni, bɛbla-nwu suɛlɛ suɛlɛ.

english_verse: Then everyone will see the saving power of God.’ ”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bekyuli ƒui badubɔnu Ɔƒɔne ɔni na ɔ́tala!’ ”

english_verse: Crowds of people came out to be baptized, but John said to them, “You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?
translation_verse: Bekyuli pii bálɛ bébo banii Yohane ɔkpila-ma ntu. Nsu Yohane ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bibo likyulikpi aani balakpi! Bitatɔlɔ lɛlɔ bɛnii si bákpila-mii ntu kani ni, ɔ́sa na bɛ́lɛ Katɔti kɔtu kɔni na ɔdubɔni bekyuli bekpidi kemmo.

english_verse: The crowds asked John, “What should we do?”
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli bammɔ béye-nwu banii, “Na bi na ɔlɛka bɔbla ɔƒɛni?”

english_verse: Some soldiers asked him, “And what about us? What do we have to do?” John told them, “Don't force people to pay money to make you leave them alone. Be satisfied with your pay.”
translation_verse: Bekpone badi lɛnɔ béye-nwu banini, “Na abu nɔɔ? Bi na ɔlɛka bɔbla?” Amu na ɔ́su ama lɛnɔ ɔnini, “Bɛya na bina lɛyuƒɔla lɛda-mii ebiti. Na bɛsɔ bitasia ɔmɛni kama bitanya ukyuli ɔdi bitamana na bɛƒɔ-nwu egulabi adi iye bitadu ukyuli ɔdi kɔtɔ na ulu ukpidi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: John said, “I am just baptizing with water. But someone more powerful is going to come, and I am not good enough even to untie his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yohane ɔ́su bana ƒui ɔnini, “Ntu na ami líti mɔɔkpila-mii. Nsu ukyuli ɔdi ɔsia-mi kama ɔdubo ɔni na utulo-mi ƒui! Ńtedu ka lɛbla kabla kadi lite-nwu muedi. Na ukyuli ɔmɛni ndubuti Katɔti Kɔyu ku ogya ɔkpila-mii.

english_verse: In many different ways John preached the good news to the people.
translation_verse: Na Yohane ɔ́su Katɔti litemi na lilu pii lɛlɔ úte bekyuli, na ɔ́su-ma geen ka bavumana udu ku bana ngba bulie.

english_verse: Finally, Herod put John in jail, and this was the worst thing he had done. The Baptism of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu Herode ɔ́sɔ ɔ́bla lɛla lɛni návi ntu lítulo ƒui ɔni na ɔ́ya na béti Yohane bátákya ɔtɔ kemmo. Yohane Ɔ́kpila Yesu Ntu

english_verse: While everyone else was being baptized, Jesus himself was baptized. Then as he prayed, the sky opened up,
translation_verse: Ka Yohane ɔ́kpila bekyuli ƒui ntu ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔ́kpila Yesu lɛnɔ ntu. Na uwi ɔni na Yesu ɔkya ɔɔkpali katɔ ni, katɔ kálɛmi.

english_verse: and the Holy Spirit came down upon him in the form of a dove. A voice from heaven said, “You are my own dear Son, and I am pleased with you.” The Ancestors of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́yu kúbo kúbelie-nwu lɛlɔ aani abloduma kalɛ. Amu na bénu Katɔti lɛdi ka lɛ́si katɔ lɛnini, “Awɔ ndi mina Ubi Ɔyɔne. Aaƒɔ́-mi anu geen.” Yesu Kaba Bekyuli Ndi Bamɛni

english_verse: Enosh, and Seth. The family of Jesus went all the way back to Adam and then to God.
translation_verse: ɔni ɔti ɔdi Enos ɔni ɔti ɔdi Set ɔni ɔti ɔdi Adam ɔni ɔti ɔdi Katɔti.

english_verse: After the sun had set, people with all kinds of diseases were brought to Jesus. He put his hands on each one of them and healed them.
translation_verse: Na ka kadi kábla buɛɛ ni, bekyuli bani ƒui na lɛlɛ lidu lidu lɛda bana bakpana ni, béti-ma béboku Yesu kudɔ. Na úti enu ɔ́sia-ma lɛlɔ unwi unwi na ɔ́bwi-ma ƒui.

english_verse: The devil said to Jesus, “If you are God's Son, tell this stone to turn into bread.”
translation_verse: Amu na Satan ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Si Katɔti ubi na adi ni, na asu lɛtabi lɛmɛni na linwini adila.”

english_verse: Then the devil led Jesus up to a high place and quickly showed him all the nations on earth.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Satan ɔ́sɔ útiku-nwu útényene kesii kani nákuku. Na ɔ́tina-nwu kayawi ala ku kana lɛga kadikɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Just worship me, and you can have it all.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ala amɛni ƒui adubunwini awɔdi si ákya lili kalɔ ete-mi.”

english_verse: Finally, the devil took Jesus to Jerusalem and had him stand on top of the temple. The devil said, “If you are God's Son, jump off.
translation_verse: Nwuna kama ni, Satan útiku Yesu úsienku Yerusalem na Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ ɔtɔ katɔ ƒui, na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Si Katɔti ubi na adi ni, da lɛlɔ nyonu siku mɛni na atáƒiɛmi kalɔ.

english_verse: He taught in the Jewish synagogues, and everyone praised him. The People of Nazareth Turn against Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɔ́tina ala na Yudaƒuɔ kɔsakɔ na ukyuli biala úmwi-nwu ala bɔtina. Béni Yesu Na Nasaret

english_verse: Jesus went back to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and as usual he went to the synagogue on the Sabbath. When he stood up to read from the Scriptures,
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu úsie Nasaret kesii kani na bátumini-nwu ɔ́si lɛnamu uwi. Na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ ni, úsie Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ aani kalɛ kani na ɔɔyɔ́ bɔbla. Na ɔ́ta únye ka utaaka Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ala.

english_verse: “The Lord's Spirit has come to me, because he has chosen me to tell the good news to the poor. The Lord has sent me to announce freedom for prisoners, to give sight to the blind, to free everyone who suffers,
translation_verse: “Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui, ɔsika Katɔti náƒuna-mi ɔnii nti litemi buni lɛmɛni mboku bawabane. Na ɔ́tala-mi ɔnii nkɔ lɛsa nte bekyuli bani na béƒie kalɛ na bakɛ bɔnwuna. Na bani na anumi ábwɛ-ma ni, bataanu. Na bekyuli bani na baanya taakya ku lɛbibo ni, bakɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: and to say, ‘This is the year the Lord has chosen.’ ”
translation_verse: Na lɛya bati ka Katɔti uwi ɔni na weti waƒɔ nwuna bekyuli údu.”

english_verse: Jesus closed the book, then handed it back to the man in charge and sat down. Everyone in the synagogue looked straight at Jesus.
translation_verse: Na Yesu únyimi kakunkɛ kammɔ na ɔ́sɔku-nwu úte ala ammɔ lɛlɔ ɔnune, na ɔ́yu úlie kalɔ. Bekyuli bammɔ ƒui béti anumi bálɛ-nwu lɛlɔ, na benye baanu-nwu kpoo.

english_verse: All the people started talking about Jesus and were amazed at the wonderful things he said. They kept on asking, “Isn't he Joseph's son?”
translation_verse: Na nwuna etemila ani na ɔɔsu áda-ma kayi geen, na kalɛ na unyemi lɛnɔ ɔɔta-nwu útakɔsi na ɔ́bla-ma dɛye dɛye. Na béye lɛlɔ banini, “Ɔɔɔdi Yoseƒ ubidi ɔmmɔ na ɔdi mɛni yoo?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: You will certainly want to tell me this saying, “Doctor, first make yourself well.” You will tell me to do the same things here in my own hometown that you heard I did in Capernaum.
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ngyi ka bɛdubo-mi lɛgba lɛmɛni bunyimene bɛnii, ‘Uvone, bwi awɔ ɔlati ƒula lɛlɔ.’ Na bɛsɔ bɛdubo-mi bɔsu lɛnɔ bɛnii, ‘Ala ani udu na búnu ka ábla na Kapernaum ni, bla-nya na awɔ ɔlati ƒula ɔma.’ ”

english_verse: But you can be sure that no prophets are liked by the people of their own hometown.
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Nsu mɔɔsu-mii ka ni, balábu Katɔti kenye udiene ɔdi na anwu ɔlati nwuna ɔma.

english_verse: Once during the time of Elijah there was no rain for three and a half years, and people everywhere were starving. There were many widows in Israel,
translation_verse: Ɔdi litemi geen ka bekpinele pii bákya Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ na lebo lɛni na Elia ɔ́kya. Na ɔnantu úbada akwa atɛ ku kakɛ. Na kɔka bonwu kɔdi kúbo kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: but Elijah was sent only to a widow in the town of Zarephath near the city of Sidon.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Katɔti útatala Elia ɔnii utébunku Israel ukpinele ɔdi. Mmomu ɔ́tala-nwu ɔ́kya ukpinele ɔdi na Sarep na Sidon kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: During the time of the prophet Elisha, many men in Israel had leprosy. But no one was healed, except Naaman who lived in Syria.
translation_verse: Lɛnɔ ni, bekyuli pii bákya béteeƒi ɔlɛgyie na Israel kalɔ na Katɔti Kenye Udiene Elisa uwi. Nsu ɔɔɔdi bana akɔ ɔdi na bábwi, amu ntu Naaman ɔni nási Siria kalɔ lɛlɔ lɛti pɛ.”

english_verse: But Jesus slipped through the crowd and got away. A Man with an Evil Spirit (Mark
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu úsie ɔ́vi-ma ntɛ na ɔ́tɔlɔ. Yesu Ɔ́gya Kɔyu Kukpidi Ɔ́lɛku Ukyuli Ɔdi Lɛlɔ Kemmo

english_verse: Jesus went to the town of Capernaum in Galilee and taught the people on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie Kapernaum ɔma kemmo na Galilea kalɔ lɛlɔ. Mmɔ ni, úse kalɔ ɔ́tina bekyuli ala na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: His teaching amazed them because he spoke with power.
translation_verse: Na nwuna butemi ku ɔyikun ɔsu ni, nwuna ala bɔtina bɔ́bla bekyuli bammɔ dɛye dɛye.

english_verse: There in the synagogue was a man with an evil spirit. He yelled out,
translation_verse: Amu na ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́kya Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ mmɔ ɔni lɛlɔ na kɔyu kukpidi kulie. Na ɔ́va ku lɛdi momoomo ɔ́su ɔnini,

english_verse: Jesus ordered the evil spirit to be quiet and come out. The demon threw the man to the ground in front of everyone and left without harming him.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́bɔku kɔyu kɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Ba lɛsɛ! Na avi alɛ ukyuli ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kemmo!” Amu na kɔyu kukpidi kɔmmɔ kúƒwimi ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔ́ƒiɛmi kalɔ na bana anumi, na kɔ́vi kɔ́lɛ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo kɔ́tɔlɔ. Nsu ukyuli ɔmmɔ útaƒɔ ɔlɛ ɔdi.

english_verse: They all were amazed and kept saying to each other, “What kind of teaching is this? He has power to order evil spirits out of people!”
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla bekyuli bammɔ ƒui yaa na béye lɛlɔ banii, “Bi etemila udu na adi mɛni? Ukyuli ɔmɛni ubo kuƒi na uuti ɔyikun taabɔku ayu ekpidi na aaví taalɛ bekyuli lɛlɔ kemmo.”

english_verse: News about Jesus spread all over that part of the country. Jesus Heals Many People (Matthew
translation_verse: Na ala ani baasu taasiku Yesu lɛlɔ mɛni égyingya ákya ekpo ani ƒui na amadɔ mmɔ. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Bekyuli Pii

english_verse: Jesus left the synagogue and went to Simon's home. When Jesus got there, he was told that Simon's mother-in-law was sick with a high fever.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́lɛ Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ mmɔ na ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie Simon kesii. Na Simon ɔmɛni uleni ɔtɛ ɔlɛ ɔni na lɛlɔ lɛ́ƒɔ ogya geen. Na báya na Yesu ɔ́ti.

english_verse: So Jesus went over to her and ordered the fever to go away. Right then she was able to get up and serve them a meal.
translation_verse: Amu na úsie uténye-nwu kudɔ na kesii kani na ɔtɛ, na ɔ́bɔku ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ. Na kɔnakunwi ni, ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́ba-nwu na ɔ́ta únye na úsie kalɔ ɔɔnwá teete-ma.

english_verse: Demons went out of many people and shouted, “You are the Son of God!” But Jesus ordered the demons not to speak because they knew he was the Messiah.
translation_verse: Ayu ekpidi lidu pii lɛnɔ lɛ́vi lɛ́lɛ bekyuli kemmo na baava taasu banii, “Awɔ ndi Katɔti Ubidi!” Nsu Yesu ɔ́bala ayu ekpidi ammɔ na útete-ma ulu ka basu lɛla lɛdi, ɔsika báti ka anwu ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ. Yesu Ɔ́tina Ala Na Yudaƒuɔ Kasalakɔ

english_verse: The next morning Jesus went out to a place where he could be alone, and crowds came looking for him. When they found him, they tried to stop him from leaving.
translation_verse: Kadi kégye ni, Yesu ɔ́tɔlɔ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo úsie kesii kani nábɛ. Amu na bekyuli bammɔ bése kalɔ baawia-nwu taavi. Na ka bánu-nwu ni, bákya ɔkplu ka betile-nwu kuƒi kalɛ na ulatɔlɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “People in other towns must hear the good news about God's kingdom. This is why I was sent.”
translation_verse: Nsu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɔlɛka lisie ntásu Katɔti lɛga bɔdi litemi buni lɛmɛni na lɛma bamba lɛnɔ kemmo, ɔsika ɔmɛni na Katɔti ɔ́tala-mi ɔnii mbabla.”

english_verse: So he kept on preaching in the synagogues in Judea.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔ́su Katɔti litemi na Yudaƒuɔ kɔsakɔ ƒui na kalɔ kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: But Jesus would often go to some place where he could be alone and pray. Jesus Heals a Man Who Could Not Walk (Matthew
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ndi uwi ni, ɔɔlɛ́ teesie kesii kani nábɛ taatákpali katɔ. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Lɛlɔ Kakɛ Kenwi Ukpine

english_verse: When Jesus saw how much faith they had, he said to the man, “My friend, your sins are forgiven.”
translation_verse: Na ka Yesu ɔ́nu bana bɔƒɔtaadi ɔsu ni, ɔ́su ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Ɔnana, ákɛ ƒula ekpidi buti taakyiɛ!”

english_verse: Jesus got into the boat that belonged to Simon and asked him to row it out a little way from the shore. Then Jesus sat down in the boat to teach the crowd.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́kɔ úduo unwi kemmo ɔni ndi Simon ɔdi, na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnii udi ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ usienku ntu anumi blii. Ɔkɔlɔ kemmo mmɔ na úlie ɔ́tina bekyuli bammɔ ala.

english_verse: “Master,” Simon answered, “we have worked hard all night long and have not caught a thing. But if you tell me to, I will let the nets down.”
translation_verse: Na Simon údie kenye ɔnini, “Ati, usien umodi ɔmɛni bɔ́bla kabla ku lɛnungyie na bútedie lɛla lɛdi. Nsu ni, ndubɔya na buwi lɛsawu lɛmmɔ aani kalɛ na ásu.”

english_verse: They did this and caught so many fish that their nets began ripping apart.
translation_verse: Béwi lɛsawu lɛmmɔ na bédie lɛna pii ɔni náya na bana lɛsawu líse kalɔ liikúlo.

english_verse: Then they signaled for their partners in the other boat to come and help them. The men came, and together they filled the two boats so full that they both began to sink.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bébo bana bakpana enu na ɔkɔlɔ unyɔdi kemmo banii bebo bebebunku-ma. Bébo na bédie lɛna béwi lɛkɔlɔ inyɔ lɛmɛni kemmo tɛtɛɛtɛ ɔni blii nébu na lɛkɔlɔ lɛmmɔ lɛnyi ntu kemmo.

english_verse: His partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee, were surprised too. Jesus told Simon, “Don't be afraid! From now on you will bring in people instead of fish.”
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na ɔ́bla Simon bakpana Yakobo ku Yohane bani ndi Sebedeo bebi lɛnɔ. Amu na Yesu ɔ́su Simon ɔnini, “Tayia. Ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ni, bɛdubuteedie bekyuli teete Katɔti.”

english_verse: The men pulled their boats up on the shore. Then they left everything and went with Jesus. Jesus Heals a Man (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, báni lɛkɔlɔ lɛmmɔ ƒui bétéwi utubili na bányonu lɛla biala béwi na bésie bátásiaku Yesu kama. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Ɔlɛne Ɔdi

english_verse: News about Jesus kept spreading. Large crowds came to listen to him teach and to be healed of their diseases.
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu lɛlɔ kɔtɛ kuugyingya teesie ɔgyu kakaaka. Na bekyuli pii beebo kalɛ na benu-nwu ala bɔtina na ɔbwi-ma lɛlɛ lɛni nda-ma.

english_verse: But because of the crowd, they could not get him to Jesus. So they went up on the roof, where they removed some tiles and let the mat down in the middle of the room.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bumomo ɔsu ni, bátakana ulu bɔkɛ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu béti-nwu bákɔliku lɛsa. Na bátu liƒi na kugyiikɛ akɔ mmɔ na báyula-nwu ku nwuna atɛla bátáva Yesu anumi na bekyuli bammɔ ntɛntɛ na ɔtɔ kemmo mmɔ.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the experts began arguing, “Jesus must think he is God! Only God can forgive sins.”
translation_verse: Amu na Ƒarisiƒuɔ ku ɔda bubo ala batinane bákya anumi ku lɛlɔ buye banii, “Ɔma na ɔdi mɛni na úti lɛlɔ ɔɔkɔ́ku Katɔti lɛni! Katɔti lɛti pɛ kani ndubɔkana na uti ukyuli ekpidi ɔkyiɛ-nwu!”

english_verse: Is it easier for me to tell this man that his sins are forgiven or to tell him to get up and walk?
translation_verse: Ɔmani bɔsu mbo ɔkplu ntulo na amɛni kemmo, ‘Ákɛ ƒula ekpidi buti taakyiɛ’ munuu ‘Ta nye na esie’?

english_verse: But now you will see that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” Jesus then said to the man, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk home.”
translation_verse: Ndubudie lɛtina-mii ka Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ubo kuƒi na kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ na uti ekpidi ɔkyiɛ.” Anwuɔsu únwini na ɔ́su lɛlɔ kakɛ kenwi ukpine ɔmɛni ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-ɔ nnii ta na eti ƒula atɛla na eteesie kaduli!”

english_verse: At once the man stood up in front of everyone. He picked up his mat and went home, giving thanks to God.
translation_verse: Mmɔ kani ni, ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔ́ta únye bekyuli bammɔ anumi na úti nwuna atɛla ani lɛlɔ na ɔtɛ na ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie kaduli na uumwi Katɔti.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed and praised God. What they saw surprised them, and they said, “We have seen a great miracle today!” Jesus Chooses Levi (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔ́bla bekyuli bammɔ ƒui dɛye dɛye! Na ka liƒu lɛ́ƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui ɔsu ni, bémwi Katɔti na básu banii, “Bi akɔla budie taatina adi na bɔ́nu mɛni ɔmwi?” Yesu Ɔ́lɔ Lewi

english_verse: Later, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu ɔ́vi ɔ́lɛ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo na útánu kuyi ɔƒɔne ɔdi baalɔ banii Lewi ka ɔkya nwuna kabla kablakɔ. Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ta, na asiaku-mi.”

english_verse: Levi left everything and went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Lewi ɔ́ta na ɔ́siaku-nwu na ɔ́da lɛla biala úwi.

english_verse: In his home Levi gave a big dinner for Jesus. Many tax collectors and other guests were also there.
translation_verse: Lewi ɔ́ya na bánwa adila abuni ɔnii uuti ɔkya Yesu kubiti na nwuna kaduli. Na bekyuli pii bébo mmɔ ku kuyi baƒɔne bamba lɛnɔ.

english_verse: The Pharisees and some of their teachers of the Law of Moses grumbled to Jesus' disciples, “Why do you eat and drink with these tax collectors and other sinners?”
translation_verse: Ƒarisiƒuɔ ku ɔda bubo ala batinane bani nkya kasalakɔ mmɔ bákyaku Yesu basiakune unyeƒi banii, “Bi ɔsu na bɛɛdi na bɛɛní ku kuyi baƒɔne ku alaekpidi bablane babambadi bamɛni?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Healthy people don't need a doctor, but sick people do.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Bekyuli bani mbo lɛlɔ ɔkplu baláwia uvone, amu ntu balɛne lɛti.

english_verse: I didn't come to invite good people to turn to God. I came to invite sinners.” People Ask about Going without Eating (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi bekyuli bani nse siin na líbo mbalɔ nnii benwini kayi, mmomu alaekpidi bablane.” Yesu Ɔ́tɛmi Na Kɔka Bulie Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Some people said to Jesus, “John's followers often pray and go without eating, and so do the followers of the Pharisees. But your disciples never go without eating or drinking.”
translation_verse: Bekyuli badi béye Yesu banii, “Dɛ na ɔ́bla na Yohane basiakune béteelie kɔka bulie bulie na baakpali katɔ, na Ƒarisiƒuɔ basiakune lɛnɔ baabla lɛni, nsu ƒula badi ama bɔdi kani na baadi na baaní?”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “The friends of a bridegroom don't go without eating while he is still with them.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Bɛɛkali ka bekyuli bani na bálɔ béboku uleku ketikɔ badubulie kɔka lebo lɛni na uleku ɔgya ɔmmɔ ɔmu ɔkya-ma kudɔ? Kudi kudii! Ulakana bubo bute lɛni!

english_verse: But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.”
translation_verse: Nsu ni, limeyi lɛdi lɛdubo lɛni na badubuti uleku ɔgya ɔmmɔ batɔlɔku-ma kudɔ. Na mmɔ ni, ɔɔɔdi ukyuli ɔdi nsɔ ndubo-ma bɔsu asa na badubulie kɔka.”

english_verse: Jesus then told them these sayings: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and make the hole even bigger.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu ɔ́sɔ úbo-ma lɛgba lɛmɛni ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔdi ulabwɛ awu awɔdi taaka taada ɔkukudi liƒi. Si ɔdi ɔ́bla lɛni ni, agyi anii úbile awu ɔwɔdi ɔmmɔ. Na ɔkukudi ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ku ɔwɔdi ɔmmɔ ulamanku lɛlɔ.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The new wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined.
translation_verse: Na beleti ntɛ bɔwɔdi teewi ɔku koƒo kɔkukudi kɔni kemmo béewi ntɛ dii. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, ntɛ bɔwɔdi bɔmmɔ bɔdubuƒuƒuo na bɔya ɔku koƒo kɔkukudi kɔmmɔ kɔbwɛ, na ntɛ bɔmmɔ lɛnɔ buwiakun.

english_verse: New wine must be put only into new wineskins.
translation_verse: Nsu beeti ntɛ bɔwɔdi teewi ɔku koƒo kɔwɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: No one wants new wine after drinking old wine. They say, “The old wine is better.”
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni lɛnɔ ni, ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́sɔ uláwia ntɛ bɔwɔdi si ɔ́ɔni bɔkukudi úmo. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, bɔsu na ɔdubɔsu ɔnii, ‘Budeedi bɔdia butulo bɔmɛni!’ ”

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he told the man to stand up where everyone could see him. And the man stood up.
translation_verse: Nsu ka Yesu ɔ́nu bana kasusu ɔ́ti ɔsu ni, ɔ́su ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Ta nye, na alɛ ebo anumi mɛni.” Na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔ́ta úbenye-ma anumi.

english_verse: Some Pharisees said, “Why are you picking grain on the Sabbath? You're not supposed to do that!”
translation_verse: Amu na Ƒarisiƒuɔ badi béye-ma banini, “Bi ɔsu na bɛɛbla lɛla lɛni na bula ɔda bubo bútete-bu kuƒi ka bɔbla na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ?”

english_verse: Long ago your own people did these same things to the prophets. So when this happens to you, be happy and jump for joy! You will have a great reward in heaven.
translation_verse: “Bɛkɛ ebiti si amɛni ƒui aalɛ́ na bɛtɔ ku ebiti, ɔsika Katɔti ɔdubute-mii lɛyuƒɔla bonwu na katɔ. Ɔsika ala amɛni udu na béti bábla Katɔti kenye bediene bani nákya ƒui.

english_verse: Ask God to bless anyone who curses you, and pray for everyone who is cruel to you.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔkpali ala taakya-mii ni, bite-ma kusɛ kusɛ. Na bekyuli bani mɔɔbla-mii kalala ni, bɛkpali katɔ na bana lili.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “On the Sabbath should we do good deeds or evil deeds? Should we save someone's life or destroy it?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye-ma ɔnini, “Bi na bula ɔda bubo búte-bu ulu ka bɔbla na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ? Ɔdia ka bɔbla lɛbuni na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ munuu ka bɔbla likpidi? Iye ni, ɔdia ka bɔƒɔ bekyuli ngba munuu bɔyila-mu?”

english_verse: One was Simon, and Jesus named him Peter. Another was Andrew, Peter's brother. There were also James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,
translation_verse: Ama ndi Simon ɔni na ɔ́sia lɛnyi ɔnii Petro ku ɔnwani Andrea ku Yakobo ku Yohane ku Ƒilipo ku Bartolomeo

english_verse: On another Sabbath Jesus was teaching in a synagogue, and a man with a paralyzed right hand was there.
translation_verse: Na lɛnwunameyi lɛbambadi lɛlɔ ni, Yesu úsie Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ na útátina ala. Na mmɔ ni, ukyuli ɔdi ɔkya ɔni na nwuna kɔdianu kɔ́gogolo-nwu.

english_verse: The teachers and the Pharisees were furious and started saying to one another, “What can we do about Jesus?” Jesus Chooses His Twelve Apostles (Matthew
translation_verse: Kɔnyi kɔ́kɔ bana ƒui ɔsu bése kalɔ beeti kasusu na lɛla lɛni na badubɔkana Yesu bɔbla lɛlɔ. Yesu Ɔ́ƒuna Batalane Leevu-inyɔ

english_verse: The next morning he called his disciples together and chose twelve of them to be his apostles.
translation_verse: Ka kadi kégye ni, ɔ́lɔ nwuna basiakune ƒui úbasala nwuna kudɔ na ɔ́ƒuna leevu-inyɔ bani na ɔ́sia-ma lɛnyi ɔnii nwuna batalane.

english_verse: Everyone was trying to touch Jesus, because power was going out from him and healing them all. Blessings and Troubles (Matthew
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bákya ɔkplu ka betuku Yesu na bana lɛlɛ lɛba-ma, ɔsika ɔyikun ɔdi udu útaalɛ Yesu lɛlɔ kemmo na ɔɔbwi bekyuli ƒui. Lɛlɔ Lɛdubɔyɔ Badi Na Badi Bebo Abi

english_verse: Matthew, Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus. The rest of the apostles were Simon, known as the Eager One,
translation_verse: ku Mateo ku Toma ku Alƒeo ubidi Yakobo ku Simon ɔni bátaalɔ banii ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ nwuna ɔma

english_verse: Jude, who was the son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who later betrayed Jesus. Jesus Teaches, Preaches, and Heals (Matthew
translation_verse: ku Yakobo ubidi Yuda ku Yuda Iskariot ɔni nébenwini kakya ɔkyane. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Bekyuli Pii

english_verse: You well-fed people are in for trouble. You will go hungry! You people who are laughing now are in for trouble. You are going to cry and weep!
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ muute amii bani némo ɔƒɛni, ɔsika kɔka kɔdubo-mii bɔda! Bɔbuɛ muute amii bani mɔɔmá ɔƒɛni, ɔsika bɛdubo kɔnyana ku keku buwulo!

english_verse: These people had come to listen to Jesus and to be healed of their diseases. All who were troubled by evil spirits were also healed.
translation_verse: Bébo banii bebenu ala ani na Yesu ɔɔtina na ɔbwi-ma lɛlɛ lidu lɛni na beeƒi. Bekyuli bani na ayu ekpidi eekpóku lɛnɔ bébo na ɔ́bwi-ma.

english_verse: God will bless you hungry people. You will have plenty to eat! God will bless you people who are now crying. You will laugh!
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ litaayɔ amii bani na kɔka kɔɔda ɔƒɛni, ɔsika amii ndubumo! Lɛlɔ litaayɔ amii bani muuwulo ɔƒɛni, ɔsika bɛdubɔma!

english_verse: You are in for trouble when everyone says good things about you. That is what your own people said about those prophets who told lies. Love for Enemies (Matthew
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ muute amii bani na bekyuli ƒui beemwi ɔƒɛni, ɔsika lɛni kani na bana bati kuuku bémwi bekyuli bani nátɔlɔ bekyuli ka badi Katɔti kenye bediene. Yɔ Ƒula Bekisine

english_verse: If you give to others, you will be given a full amount in return. It will be packed down, shaken together, and spilling over into your lap. The way you treat others is the way you will be treated.
translation_verse: Bite bekyuli ala, na Katɔti lɛnɔ wete-mii ala. Geen ni, Katɔti ɔdubuyile-mii kɔvumi tɛtɛɛtɛ na nwuna lɛƒɔndia kenye. Keyile kani udu na ákɔku éte ukyuli ni, kana udu kani na Katɔti ɔdubɔkɔku ute-ɔ.”

english_verse: is like someone who dug down deep and built a house on solid rock. When a flood came and the river rushed against the house, it was built so well that it didn't even shake.
translation_verse: Use aani ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtú ɔtɔ na ɔ́ka awodu libu budie, na ɔ́nwu lɛti ku atabi kpakplaa úti ɔ́kya ɔka kalɔ na lɛtakpɛ lɛlɔ asa na ɔ́tu ɔtɔ ɔ́sia-nwu lɛlɔ. Ka ketu kéyi na kágba kávi awodu ammɔ kalɔ ni, ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ útabla lɛla lɛdi, ɔsika ɔ́kɛ kenyekɔ kabuni.

english_verse: If someone slaps you on one cheek, don't stop that person from slapping you on the other cheek. If someone wants to take your coat, don't try to keep back your shirt.
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi ɔƒiɛmi-ɔ kɔnu ɔtugya unwi ni, ya na ɔƒiɛmi-ɔ ɔtugya unyɔdi lɛnɔ. Na si ukyuli ɔdi úti ƒula awu ɔni na aakya taasia ɔtɔdi lɛlɔ ni, ya na uti ɔtɔdi lɛnɔ si ɔɔyɔ́.

english_verse: Give to everyone who asks and don't ask people to return what they have taken from you.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔni mevele-ɔ lɛla lɛdi ni, te-nwu. Na si ɔdi úti-ɔ lɛla lɛdi ni, tasu anii aasia-ni kama.

english_verse: Treat others just as you want to be treated.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na aayɔ́ anii babla bete-ɔ ni, ani kani na awɔ lɛnɔ ɔlɛka abla ete bekyuli.

english_verse: If you love only someone who loves you, will God praise you for that? Even sinners love people who love them.
translation_verse: “Si bekyuli bani mɔɔyɔ́-ɔ kani na awɔ lɛnɔ aayɔ́ ni, bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka bemwi-ɔ? Alaekpidi bablane muedi ni, baayɔ́ bekyuli bani mɔɔyɔ́-ma.

english_verse: If you are kind only to someone who is kind to you, will God be pleased with you for that? Even sinners are kind to people who are kind to them.
translation_verse: Na si bekyuli bani nábla-a lɛbuni kani na awɔ lɛnɔ aabla lɛbuni teete ni, bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka bemwi-ɔ? Alaekpidi bablane lɛnɔ baabla lɛni.

english_verse: Have pity on others, just as your Father has pity on you. Judging Others (Matthew
translation_verse: Bitaanu kɔnyana aani kalɛ kani na bina Katɔti ɔɔnu kɔnyana. Yesu Ɔ́tina Ala Ɔ́si Ukyulikpana Litemi Bɔtɛku Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Jesus said: Don't judge others, and God won't judge you. Don't be hard on others, and God won't be hard on you. Forgive others, and God will forgive you.
translation_verse: “Bitababla bitatɛku bekyuli litemi, na Katɔti lɛnɔ ulatɛku-mii litemi. Bitadu bekyuli kɔtɔ, na Katɔti lɛnɔ uládu-mii kɔtɔ. Biti bɛkyiɛ bekyuli, na Katɔti lɛnɔ weti wakyiɛ-mii.

english_verse: Jesus also used some sayings as he spoke to the people. He said: Can one blind person lead another blind person? Won't they both fall into a ditch?
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úbo-ma lɛgba ɔnini, “Ɔnumbwɛne ulakana ɔnumbwɛne ɔkpana bɔtɔnku. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, bana inyɔ ƒui badubɔnu beduo ubu kemmo.

english_verse: Are students better than their teacher? But when they are fully trained, they will be like their teacher.
translation_verse: Ala ɔtɛyane biala uletulo nwuna ɔtinane. Nsu si uwi ɔni na ɔtɛyane ɔmmɔ ɔ́wɔlɔ ala bɔtɛya ni, ɔɔbla aani nwuna ala ɔtinane kalɛ.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: “Bi ɔsu na aanu lɛlakpi lɛni nkya ƒula ɔnwani lɛnumi na alánu kegyiikɛ kani nsia-a lɛnumi aka?

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye? You show-offs! First, get the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye. A Tree and Its Fruit (Matthew
translation_verse: Dɛ na ɔ́bla na aasu ƒula ukyulikpana anii, ‘Buvele, ya na lidie-ɔ lɛlakpi lɛnumi.’ Na átakana na anu kegyiikɛ kani nsia-a lɛnumi? Anumi lɛlɔ ukyuli na adi! Ka kegyiikɛ kani nsia-a lɛnumi bɔtimi asa na anu nwaa na edie ƒ'ɔnwani lɛlakpi lɛnumi. Kugyii Biala Ku Kuna Ebi

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: “Kugyii kɔbuni kulánwu ebi ekpidi, na kugyii kukpidi lɛnɔ kulanwu ebi buni.

english_verse: You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces. You cannot pick figs or grapes from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Kugyii biala ni, kuna ebi lɛlɔ na baanu-ku taati. Belede kɔnwingyie ebi na liyu kugyii lɛlɔ, na belede atoo na lɛnyɛ kɔbuli lɛnɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Good people do good things because of the good in their hearts, but bad people do bad things because of the evil in their hearts. Your words show what is in your heart. Two Builders (Matthew
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔbuni ni, ala abuni na uudie taalɛku nwuna akɛla abuni ani nkya nwuna kayi kemmo. Na ukyuli ukpidi lɛnɔ uuboku akɛla ekpidi ani nkya-nwu kayi kemmo. Ɔsika ala ani néyi ukyuli kayi kemmo ni, anya na nwuna kenye kaasu. Nu Yesu Litemi Na Abla Asiaku-ni Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Why do you keep on saying that I am your Lord, when you refuse to do what I say?
translation_verse: “Bi ɔsu na bɛɛlɔ-mi bɛnii Blɔti, nsu bilábla taasiaku lɛla lɛni na lɛ́su-mii lɛlɔ?

english_verse: But anyone who hears what I say and doesn't obey me is like someone whose house wasn't built on solid rock. As soon as the river rushed against that house, it was smashed to pieces!
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli biala ɔni muunú-mi litemi na uleti-ni taada ni, use aani ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtú ɔtɔ na ɔtɔ kalɔ katayu ɔkplu. Ɔsu si uwi ɔni na ketu kéyi na kágba kávi ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kalɔ ni, ɔɔƒɛ teewi kalɔ ku kɔku bonwu!”

english_verse: I have officers who give orders to me, and I have soldiers who take orders from me. I can say to one of them, ‘Go!’ and he goes. I can say to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes. I can say to my servant, ‘Do this!’ and he will do it.”
translation_verse: Ami lɛnɔ ndi unengu ɔdi ɔni na nsɔ nkya benengu betulone bamba ɔyikun kalɔ. Na mbo bekpone na bakya-mi kalɔ. Mɔɔsu ɔdi nnii, ‘Sie mɛni’ na uusié. Na mɔɔsu ɔbambadi lɛnɔ nnii, ‘Bo mɛni’ na uubo. Na mɔɔsu mina kabla ɔblane nnii, ‘Bla lɛni’ na ɔɔbla.”

english_verse: He loves our nation and even built us a synagogue.”
translation_verse: ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́ bula kadi. Na anwu ɔlati ɔ́tu Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ úte-bu.”

english_verse: When the Lord saw the woman, he felt sorry for her and said, “Don't cry!”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́nu uleku ɔmɛni ni, nwuna lɛlɔ lɛ́bla-nwu kɔnyana. Amu na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Da buwulo ya.”

english_verse: The leaders went to Jesus and begged him to do something. They said, “This man deserves your help!
translation_verse: Bébo Yesu kudɔ na bébevele-nwu kpakplaa banii, “Ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔ́manku ka ete-nwu kebunku,

english_verse: Simon answered, “I suppose it would be the one who had owed more and didn't have to pay it back.” “You are right,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: Amu na Simon ɔnini, “Mɔɔbu nnii ukyuli ɔni na úti kayu kenengudi ɔ́kyiɛ.” Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ásu na ɔ́tɛ.”

english_verse: In this town an army officer's servant was sick and about to die. The officer liked his servant very much.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Romaƒuɔ bekpone unengu ɔdi ɔ́kya ɔni mbo kabla ɔblane ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́ geen. Kabla ɔblane ɔmɛni úbo uuƒi kpakplaa ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́ ukpi muedi.

english_verse: And when he heard about Jesus, he sent some Jewish leaders to ask him to come and heal the servant.
translation_verse: Amu ka unengu ɔmɛni únu Yesu kɔku ni, ɔ́tala Yudaƒuɔ benengu badi ɔnii batásu-nwu na ubo, na ubabwi nwuna kabla ɔblane ɔmɛni ute-nwu.

english_verse: So Jesus went with them. When Jesus wasn't far from the house, the officer sent some friends to tell him, “Lord, don't go to any trouble for me! I am not good enough for you to come into my house.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu Yesu ɔ́ta ɔ́siaku-ma. Yesu útagyunku kaduli kammɔ pii ɔdi asa na unengu ɔmɛni ɔ́tala nwuna bakpana ɔnii batásu-nwu banii, “Ati, sɔ tebo abi. Ami ni, ńtamanku ka awɔ ebo-mi kudɔ na mina kaduli.

english_verse: And I am certainly not worthy to come to you. Just say the word, and my servant will get well.
translation_verse: Na ńtamanku lɛnɔ ka ami lɛda lɛlɛ-ɔ anumi. Anwuɔsu su ƒula kenye litemi kani, na mina kabla ɔblane lɛlɔ lɛyu ɔkplu.

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, “In all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith!”
translation_verse: Ka ɔ́su lɛni ni, ɔ́bla Yesu kalɛ kadi. Amu na únwini na ɔ́su bekyuli lisu lɛni nsiaku-nwu ɔnini, “Mɔɔyá-mii bɛti ka ni, ńtanu bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmɛni udu na Israelƒuɔ akɔ muedi dii!”

english_verse: The officer's friends returned and found the servant well. A Widow's Son
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli bani na bátala mmɔ básɔ bénwini bésie kaduli na bátánu ka kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ ɔlɛ ɔ́ba-nwu. Yesu Ɔ́gyila Ukpinele Ɔdi Ubidi

english_verse: As they came near the gate of the town, they saw people carrying out the body of a widow's only son. Many people from the town were walking along with her.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na údu ɔma ɔmmɔ kabanye ni, ɔ́siaku kekwa bablane otogyi ɔdi ka ɔ́si ɔɔlɛ́. Ukpinele ɔdi ubi ɔnanabi unwi pɛ ndi ukpine ɔni na beti béselaku. Na ɔma ɔmmɔ bekyuli pii báka bámana ukpinele ɔmɛni.

english_verse: Jesus went over and touched the stretcher on which the people were carrying the dead boy. They stopped, and Jesus said, “Young man, get up!”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úsie ɔ́vi-ma ntɛ na útétuku ukpine adaka ɔmmɔ. Amu na bekyuli bani nti ukpine ɔmmɔ bédi bénye. Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su ɔnini, “Okloƒu! Mɔɔsu-ɔ nnii ta nye!”

english_verse: The boy sat up and began to speak. Jesus then gave him back to his mother.
translation_verse: Na ukpine ɔmmɔ ɔ́ta úlie na úse kalɔ ku butemi. Amu na Yesu úti-nwu úte uni.

english_verse: Everyone was frightened and praised God. They said, “A great prophet is here with us! God has come to his people.”
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ ƒui báyia geen, na bémwi Katɔti. Ɔmɛni ɔsu básu banini, “Katɔti kenye udiene ɔni náƒɔ kuye geen ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ-bu akɔ! Katɔti ɔ́yu úbo ɔnii ubedie nwuna bekyuli!”

english_verse: News about Jesus spread all over Judea and everywhere else in that part of the country. John the Baptist (Matthew
translation_verse: Yesu lɛlɔ litemi lɛmɛni lɛ́ku lɛ́vi Yudea kalɔ kammɔ ku amadɔ ƒui. Yohane Ɔ́tala Batu

english_verse: When these messengers came to Jesus, they said, “John the Baptist sent us to ask, ‘Are you the one we should be looking for? Or are we supposed to wait for someone else?’ ”
translation_verse: Amu ka bébo Yesu kudɔ ni, básu banini, “Ntu Ɔkpilane Yohane nátala-bu ɔnii bubeye-ɔ bɔnii, ‘Awɔ ndi ukyuli ɔni na ndububo munuu butaanu ukyuli bamba ulu?’ ”

english_verse: At that time Jesus was healing many people who were sick or in pain or were troubled by evil spirits, and he was giving sight to a lot of blind people.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kani kemmo ni, Yesu ɔ́bwi bekyuli pii lɛlɛ na ɔ́gya ayu ekpidi, na ɔ́ya na banumbwɛne pii bánu.

english_verse: Jesus said to the messengers sent by John, “Go and tell John what you have seen and heard. Blind people are now able to see, and the lame can walk. People who have leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can now hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.
translation_verse: Amu na údie kenye na ɔ́su Yohane batalane ɔnini, “Bɛsɔ binwini na bitásu Yohane ala ani na bɛ́nu na bínu bɛnii banumbwɛne baanu, bani na báƒɛ bewi kalɔ beesié, ɔlɛgyie beƒine lɛlɛ lɛ́ba-ma, batutine beenú, bekpine baata teelie ngba, na mɔɔsu bawabane Katɔti litemi buni.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.”
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni nátanu linyeyɔla lɛdi na mina lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: After John's messengers had gone, Jesus began speaking to the crowds about John: What kind of person did you go out to the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?
translation_verse: Ka Yohane batu bátɔlɔ kama ni, Yesu úse kalɔ uutemi taasiku Yohane lɛlɔ teete kasalakɔ bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini, “Uwi ɔni na bɛ́lɛ bísie Yohane kudɔ na ketele kemmo ni, bi na bɛ́sia anu ka bɛdubo bɔnu? Ukyuli ɔni nse aani livete lɛni na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uubó taavinku?

english_verse: What kind of man did you really go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who wear expensive clothes and live in luxury are in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Bi geen ndi lɛla lɛni na bɛ́lɛ bísie bitánu? Ukyuli ɔni nálɛ bɔkpi ku adala? Bekyuli bani na báda lɛlɔ lɛni na belie ebiti kemmo ni, bagadine lɛgbanya na beelie.

english_verse: What then did you go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was! I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Bɛsu-mi lɛla lɛni na bísie bitánu! Katɔti kenye udiene ɔdi bɔnu na bísie? Sɔsɔ na ɔdi, na mɔɔsu-mii nnii utulo Katɔti kenye udiene.

english_verse: In the Scriptures, God calls John his messenger and says, “I am sending my messenger ahead of you to get things ready for you.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika Yohane lɛlɔ litemi na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔnii, “ ‘Ndubɔtala ɔtu ɔdi na ƒula lɛtɔtɔ, na ɔdubɔgyu ɔtɔ-ɔ ɔni ndubɔklibi ulu use ute-ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: No one ever born on this earth is greater than John. But whoever is least important in God's kingdom is greater than John.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Yohane utulo ukyuli biala ɔni na báwɔ na kayawi kamɛni kemmo. Nsu ukyuli ɔni na uuubo lɛnyi lɛdi muedi na Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ni, utulo Yohane.”

english_verse: Everyone had been listening to John. Even the tax collectors had obeyed God and had done what was right by letting John baptize them.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bénu Yohane litemi buni bɔsu, na ama ku kuyi baƒɔne muedi báƒɔ lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔɔwia taasiku-ma kudɔ ku bana kɔyi kemmo, na ɔ́kpila-ma ntu.

english_verse: But the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses refused to obey God and be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Nsu Ƒarisiƒuɔ ku ɔda bubo ala batinane béni lɛla lɛni ndi Katɔti lɛyɔla, na bátatuna ka Yohane ɔkpila-ma ntu.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say: What are you people like? What kind of people are you?
translation_verse: Yesu úsie anumi ku nwuna butemi na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɔƒɛni ni, bi na ɔlɛka liti ɔmwi limeyi bekyuli lɛkɔku geen tɔ? Dɛ na bese?

english_verse: You are like children sitting in the market and shouting to each other, “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not cry!”
translation_verse: Bese aani banamu wɛlɛ wɛlɛ bani mɔɔƒia na kuyeya. Badi baava taasu bakpanadi banini, “ ‘Búdie uleku buti lɛnu búte-mii, nsu bítatɔ! Búdie lɛkwanu búte-mii, na bítewulo.’

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “John has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: Ntu Ɔkpilane Yohane úbo na anwu úlie kɔka, na ntɛ lɛnɔ bútetuku-nwu kenye, nsu bɛnii, ‘Kɔyu kukpidi kɔsiaku-nwu!’

english_verse: But because the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, you say, “Jesus eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.”
translation_verse: Ka Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi úbo ni, anwu ɔ́di na ɔ́ni ntɛ. Na bɛnii, ‘Bɛnu ɔdivone ku ntɛkpine ɔmɛni! Ɔdi kuyi baƒɔne ku alaekpidi bamba lidu bablane ɔkpana!’

english_verse: Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what its followers do. Simon the Pharisee
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bani ƒui nsiaku Katɔti lɛnunda kama ni, beedie taatina ka lɛdi lɛnunda geen.” Yesu Úsie Simon Kesii

english_verse: A Pharisee invited Jesus to have dinner with him. So Jesus went to the Pharisee's home and got ready to eat.
translation_verse: Ƒarisini ɔdi ɔ́lɔ Yesu ɔnii ubadi na nwuna kesii. Na Yesu úsie na útádi.

english_verse: When a sinful woman in that town found out that Jesus was there, she bought an expensive bottle of perfume.
translation_verse: Uleku ɔyalɛ ɔdi ɔkya ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo. Amu ka únu banii Yesu úbo Ƒarisini ɔmmɔ kesii ɔnii ubadi ni, úti ɔsii ku nnɔmii ƒɛƒɛɛ bɔdi úboku.

english_verse: Then she came and stood behind Jesus. She cried and started washing his feet with her tears and drying them with her hair. The woman kissed his feet and poured the perfume on them.
translation_verse: Úbenye Yesu kudɔ na uuwulo teewi-nwu lɛgba lɛlɔ. Na uleku ɔmmɔ úti nwuna lili linwini úni imii bɔni néwi Yesu lɛgba mmɔ, na ɔ́dada-nwu lɛgba. Na úti nnɔmii bɔmmɔ úwi Yesu lɛgba lɛnɔ.

english_verse: The Pharisee who had invited Jesus saw this and said to himself, “If this man really were a prophet, he would know what kind of woman is touching him! He would know that she is a sinner.”
translation_verse: Ka Ƒarisini ɔni nálɔ Yesu bɔdi ɔ́nu ɔmɛni ni, ɔ́bla kasusu ɔnii, “Si ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔdi Katɔti kenye udiene geen ni, nka ɔlɛka ɔnu ɔti uleku ɔni udu nébo uutuku-nwu mɛni, na ɔti lɛyalɛ ngba bɔni lɛnɔ na ulie!”

english_verse: Jesus said to the Pharisee, “Simon, I have something to say to you.” “Teacher, what is it?” Simon replied.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie ɔ́lɛ-nwu na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Simon, mbo lɛla lɛdi na ndubo-ɔ bɔsu.” Amu na Simon ɔnini, “Ala ɔtinane, taasu-mi lɛla lɛmmɔ.”

english_verse: But Jesus told the woman, “Because of your faith, you are now saved. May God give you peace!”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su uleku ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Ƒula bɔƒɔtaadi búdie-ɔ, ɔsu teesie ku keyi buɛɛ.”

english_verse: Since neither of them could pay him back, the moneylender said that they didn't have to pay him anything. Which one of them will like him more?”
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni ƒui ɔdi útakana na ɔƒɔ-nwu kayu kamɛni. Anwuɔsu úti kayu kɔmmɔ ƒui ɔ́kyiɛ-ma. Na nkyuli inyɔ bamɛni kemmo ni, ɔmani na aabu anii ɔdubɔyɔ ɔlakɛne ɔmɛni utulo?”

english_verse: He turned toward the woman and said to Simon, “Have you noticed this woman? When I came into your home, you didn't give me any water so I could wash my feet. But she has washed my feet with her tears and dried them with her hair.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu únwini útánu uleku ɔmmɔ na ɔ́su Simon ɔnini, “Aanu uleku ɔmɛni? Ka líbo-ɔ kudɔ ni, étete-mi ntu anii nƒɔ lɛgba. Nsu uleku ɔmɛni úti nwuna imii ɔ́ƒɔ-mi lɛgba, na úti nwuna lili linwini úni-ni.

english_verse: You didn't greet me with a kiss, but from the time I came in, she has not stopped kissing my feet.
translation_verse: Átaƒɔ-mi ku kubiti na akya-mi kɔgbu. Nsu ɔ́si uwi ɔni mbeduo ni, anwu útada tɔ mina lɛgba bɔdada útaya.

english_verse: You didn't even pour olive oil on my head, but she has poured expensive perfume on my feet.
translation_verse: Awɔ étete-mi nnɔmii bɔdi anii nkya lili. Nsu anwu úti nnɔmii ƒɛƒɛɛ úwi-mi lɛgba ƒui.

english_verse: So I tell you that all her sins are forgiven, and that is why she has shown great love. But anyone who has been forgiven for only a little will show only a little love.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu mɔɔsu-ɔ ka ni, na bɔyɔ bɔni na údie ɔ́tina-mi ɔsu ni, ɔ́kɛ nwuna ekpidi pii ani na ɔ́bla ƒui buti taakyiɛ. Na ukyuli ɔni na blii na béti bákyiɛ-nwu ni, nwuna bɔyɔ lɛnɔ buse blii.”

english_verse: Then Jesus said to the woman, “Your sins are forgiven.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su uleku ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Ákɛ ƒula ekpidi buti taakyiɛ.”

english_verse: Some other guests started saying to one another, “Who is this who dares to forgive sins?”
translation_verse: Ka bekyuli bani lɛnɔ nlie kadikɔ mmɔ bénu Yesu lɛla lɛni na ɔ́su ni, béye lɛlɔ banii, “Ɔma na ɔdi mɛni ɔni mɔɔkana na uuti bekyuli ekpidi muedi taakyiɛ-ma?”

english_verse: and so were some women who had been healed of evil spirits and all sorts of diseases. One of the women was Mary Magdalene, who once had seven demons in her.
translation_verse: Beleku bani na Yesu ɔ́bwi na bana lɛlɛ lidu ku bani na ɔ́gya ayu ekpidi ɔ́lɛku-ma lɛlɔ kemmo badi lɛnɔ basiaku-nwu. Na bana akɔ ɔdi ndi Maria ɔni bátaalɔ banii Magdalene ɔni lɛlɔ kemmo na Yesu ɔ́gya ayu ekpidi maatɛ ɔ́lɛku.

english_verse: The seeds that fell on rocky ground are the people who gladly hear the message and accept it. But they don't have deep roots, and they believe only for a little while. As soon as life gets hard, they give up.
translation_verse: Na ani nálɛ ébo atakpɛ lɛlɔ ni, ese aani bekyuli bani na bénu litemi lɛmmɔ na báƒɔ-ni ku ebiti mmɔ kani, nsu líteduo-ma lɛlɔ kemmo geen. Anwuɔsu baaƒɔ́ taadi uwi klukui kemmo kani. Na si uwi ɔni na bukpoku taanu bɔdi búbo ni, baayuɛ.

english_verse: Other seeds fell on rocky ground and started growing. But the plants did not have enough water and soon dried up.
translation_verse: Adi álɛ ébo atakpɛ lɛlɔ. Na ka ákwɛ ni, átakɛ ntu ku lɛti buni. Anwuɔsu ákwii na ékpi.

english_verse: Some other seeds fell where thornbushes grew up and choked the plants.
translation_verse: Edula ammɔ adi éduo liyu livo akɔ. Na livo lɛ́tu libi edula ammɔ lɛlɔ, na ényimi-nya ƒui.

english_verse: So he answered: I have explained the secrets about God's kingdom to you. But for others I use stories, so they will look, but not see, and they will hear, but not understand. Jesus Explains the Story about a Farmer (Matthew
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Katɔti úti nwuna lɛga bɔdi lɛnunda abɛla ɔ́tina-mii. Nsu bekyuli bakladi ama ni, agba na muubó-ma kalɛ na “ ‘si ina baanu ni, balanu baláti. Na ina beenú ni, belénu kalɔ.’

english_verse: There is nothing hidden that will not be found. There is no secret that will not be well known.
translation_verse: Lɛla biala lɛni na bábala bákya kesii biala ni, lɛdubɔda lɛlɛ keyi. Na lɛla lɛni na bébi ala ni, badubudie-ni beboku bukeye kemmo.

english_verse: and while they were sailing across, he went to sleep. Suddenly a storm struck the lake, and the boat started sinking. They were in danger.
translation_verse: Ka bakɛ ntu anumi bésela ni, Yesu ɔ́lɛɛ. Na kɔnakunwi ni, ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔdi úbo uukpó na ntu anumi mmɔ ɔni na ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo ƒui kadaku ntu bɔƒɔ ɔsu bakya kukpi ku ngba ntɛ.

english_verse: This is what the story means: The seed is God's message,
translation_verse: “Lɛgba lɛni na líbo kalɔ bunu ndi ɔmɛni. Edula ammɔ ndi Katɔti litemi.

english_verse: The seeds that fell among the thornbushes are also people who hear the message. But they are so eager for riches and pleasures that they never produce anything.
translation_verse: Edula ani nálɛ ébo liyu livo akɔ ni, ese aani bekyuli bani muunú litemi lɛmmɔ, nsu kayawi lɛƒɛda ku lɛlakɛ ku kayawi kamɛni ebiti aatú taabali-ma, na alaya na ebi ammɔ egyie na baƒɛ-nya.

english_verse: Those seeds that fell on good ground are the people who listen to the message and keep it in good and honest hearts. They last and produce a harvest. Light (Mark
translation_verse: Na edula ani nálɛ ébo kalɔ kabuni lɛlɔ ni, ese aani bekyuli bani muunú litemi lɛmmɔ teeti-ni taada ku kayi nwaa. Na beeboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na beenye momoomo teetédu kawɔlɔkɔ kalɛ na banwu ebi pii. Ya Na Asogya Ukeye Ute Bekyuli

english_verse: Then Jesus asked the disciples, “Don't you have any faith?” But they were frightened and amazed. They said to each other, “Who is this? He can give orders to the wind and the waves, and they obey him!” A Man with Demons in Him (Matthew
translation_verse: Na úye batɛyane bammɔ ɔnini, “Bi ɔsu na biiibo bɔƒɔtaadi?” Nsu bunye kani na benye yaa, na liƒu lɛnɔ lɛ́da-ma. Na béye lɛlɔ banini, “Ukyuli ɔmani na ɔdi mɛni bɔdi? Ɔɔtɛmi teete ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ku ɛpu ntu bɔni mɔɔnwanɛ lɛlɔ na beenú-nwu litemi!” Yesu Ɔ́gya Ayu Ekpidi Ɔ́lɛku Ukyuli Ɔdi Lɛlɔ Kemmo

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and puts it under a bowl or under a bed. A lamp is always put on a lampstand, so people who come into a house will see the light.
translation_verse: “Ukyuli ɔdi ulátu asogya teebi-nwu ala iye uti-nwu utábɛla ɔkya lɛla lɛdi kalɔ. Mmomu ɔɔkɔliku asogya ɔmmɔ taasia katɔ likpo lɛni maya na wekeye wewi kesii biala. Na ukyuli biala ɔni muuduo ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo ɔnu nwaa.

english_verse: But Jesus answered, “Someone touched me, because I felt power going out from me.”
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu ɔ́su ɔnini, “Lɛ́ti ka ukyuli ɔdi útuku-mi, ɔsika ɔyikun ɔdi ɔ́vi ɔ́lɛ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he told Jairus, “Don't worry! Have faith, and your daughter will get well.”
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu únu litemi lɛmmɔ na ɔ́su Yairo ɔnini, “Tayia. Awɔ ƒɔ di ka ubi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyu ɔkplu.”

english_verse: They begged Jesus not to send them to the deep pit, where they would be punished.
translation_verse: Amu na ayu ammɔ évele Yesu anii utabɔku-ma utatákya ayu ekpidi abi kebokɔ.

english_verse: The people went out to see what had happened, and when they came to Jesus, they also found the man. The demons had gone out of him, and he was sitting there at the feet of Jesus. He had clothes on and was in his right mind. But the people were terrified.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bammɔ bálɛ bésie banii batánu lɛla lɛni nálɛ. Amu ka bébedu Yesu kudɔ ni, bánu ɔnana ɔni lɛlɔ kemmo na Yesu ɔ́bɔku ayu ekpidi ɔ́lɛku mmɔ ka ulie Yesu lɛgba akɔ ku kasusu sɛɛn na ɔda adala na ulie kpoo. Amu na bana ƒui báyia.

english_verse: Jesus' mother and brothers went to see him, but because of the crowd they could not get near him.
translation_verse: Yesu banwani ku bana uni bébo-nwu kudɔ, nsu bátakana Yesu bɔkpɛ bude ɔkɛnku bekyuli bammɔ bumomo ɔsu.

english_verse: As Jesus was getting out of the boat, he was met by a man from this town. The man had demons in him. He had gone naked for a long time and no longer lived in a house, but in the graveyard.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́si ɔɔlɛ́ ɔkɔlɔ kemmo kani na ukyuli ɔdi na ayu ekpidi eli-nwu lɛlɔ úsie úbasiaku-nwu. Na ɔdi ukyuli ɔni na ɔ́si ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo. Ɔbla uwi pii ɔdi mɛni ni, kasɔngya kani na ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔɔkɛ. Na ulátuna ɔnii uulie nwuna kaduli amu ntu bekyuli kɔƒiɔtɔ akɔ.

english_verse: Just then the man in charge of the synagogue came and knelt down in front of Jesus. His name was Jairus, and he begged Jesus to come to his home
translation_verse: Amu na ɔnana ɔni baalɔ Yairo na ɔdi Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ benengu akɔ unwi ɔ́da úbalɛ. Na ɔ́yu ɔ́tɛ Yesu lɛgba kalɔ na úvele-nwu ɔnii ɔsiaku-nwu na besie nwuna kaduli,

english_verse: One day, Jesus and his disciples got into a boat, and he said, “Let's cross the lake.” They started out,
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛdi ni, Yesu úduo ɔkɔlɔ kemmo ku nwuna batɛyane. Amu na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛya na bɔvia busie ɛpu ɔvi ɔni ngye.” Anwuɔsu ama lɛnɔ bése kalɔ ku ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ buku.

english_verse: So they went to Jesus and woke him up, “Master, Master! We are about to drown!” Jesus got up and ordered the wind and waves to stop. They obeyed, and everything was calm.
translation_verse: Batɛyane bammɔ bésie na bátágyila Yesu na básu-nwu banini, “Ati! Bɔdaku bukpi!” Amu na Yesu ɔ́ta únye na údie lɛdi ɔ́bɔku ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ku ntu bɔni mɔɔnwanɛ lɛlɔ mmɔ, na ana ƒui kenye káyɔ na ɔ́bla buɛɛ.

english_verse: The man saw Jesus and screamed. He knelt down in front of him and shouted, “Jesus, Son of God Most High, what do you want with me? I beg you not to torture me!”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ɔ́nu Yesu ni, ɔ́va momoomo na úƒwimi lɛlɔ ɔ́va kalɔ na Yesu lɛgba kudɔ. Na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Yesu, Katɔti Ɔni Ntulo Ƒui Ubi! Bi na aawia mina kudɔ mɛni? Buvele nda-a, tani-mi kɔtu.”

english_verse: When the men taking care of the pigs saw this, they ran to spread the news in the town and on the farms.
translation_verse: Ka bekyuli bani mɔɔnu baplakuo bammɔ lɛlɔ bánu ala ani nálɛ ni, békeli bésie ɔma kemmo na bátásu bekyuli bávi ku akpaklɔ lɛnɔ ƒui.

english_verse: He said this because Jesus had already told the evil spirit to go out of him. The man had often been attacked by the demon. And even though he had been bound with chains and leg irons and kept under guard, he smashed whatever bound him. Then the demon would force him out into lonely places.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔ́su ɔmɛni, ɔsika Yesu ɔ́bɔku kɔyu kɔni nlie-nwu lɛlɔ mmɔ, na ɔ́su-ku ɔnii, “Vi lɛ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo!” Uwi pii kɔyu kɔmmɔ kɔɔdi ukyuli ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔni na si ina bényimi-nwu enu na bébo-nwu kɔgba muedi ni, ɔɔƒɛ abuala ammɔ na kɔyu kɔmmɔ kuukeliku-nwu taatákya ketele kemmo.

english_verse: Jesus asked the man, “What is your name?” He answered, “My name is Lots.” He said this because there were “lots” of demons in him.
translation_verse: Yesu úye-nwu ɔnini, “Dɛ na baalɔ-ɔ lɛnyi?” Amu na údie kenye ɔnini, “Ami baalɔ banii Lisu.” Ɔ́su lɛni ɔsika ayu ekpidi pii néduo akya-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: A large herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside. So the demons begged Jesus to let them go into the pigs, and Jesus let them go.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, baplakuo pii badi bakɛ kataku kadi lɛlɔ baadi. Amu na ayu ekpidi ammɔ évele Yesu anii ɔya na betéduo baplakuo bammɔ lɛlɔ kemmo. Amu na Yesu úte-ma kuƒi.

english_verse: Then the demons left the man and went into the pigs. The whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bávi bálɛ ɔnana ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kemmo bétéduo baplakuo bammɔ kemmo. Na bana ƒui békeli báyu kataku kammɔ lɛlɔ na bátányina lɛlɔ bákya ɛpu kemmo na báyii ku udu.

english_verse: Everyone from around Gerasa begged Jesus to leave, because they were so frightened. When Jesus got into the boat to start back,
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu Gerase kalɔ kammɔ ku kana amadɔ bekyuli básu Yesu banii ɔtɔlɔ bana kalɔ lɛlɔ, ɔsika baayia. Anwuɔsu Yesu úduo ɔkɔlɔ kemmo ka ɔtɔlɔ.

english_verse: the man who had been healed begged to go with him. But Jesus sent him off and said,
translation_verse: Amu na ukyuli ɔni na Yesu ɔ́bwi mɛni úvele Yesu ɔnii, “Ya na lɛsiaku-ɔ.” Nsu Yesu útatuna na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini,

english_verse: “Go back home and tell everyone how much God has done for you.” The man then went all over town, telling everything that Jesus had done for him. A Dying Girl and a Sick Woman (Matthew
translation_verse: “Teesie kaduli na atásu lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́bla úte-ɔ.” Amu na ukyuli ɔmɛni úsie útávi ɔma kemmo na ɔ́su ɔ́vi ƒui lɛla lɛni na Yesu ɔ́bla úte-nwu. Yesu Ɔ́bwi Yairo Ubi Ulekubi Ku Uleku Ɔdi

english_verse: In the crowd was a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years. She had spent everything she had on doctors, but none of them could make her well.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bamɛni akɔ ni, uleku ɔni na ubugya uuwi na ɔbla akwa leevu-anyɔ sɔɔn lɛnɔ ɔ́kya-ma akɔ. Uleku ɔmɛni úubile nwuna egulabi ƒui ɔnii ɔɔbwi ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ, nsu úutuku ɔ́nɔ.

english_verse: Everyone had been waiting for Jesus, and when he came back, a crowd was there to welcome him.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie ɛpu ɔvi ɔni ngye ni, bekyuli bammɔ báƒɔ-nwu kaduɛ, ɔsika bana ƒui benye bagya-nwu.

english_verse: because his twelve-year-old child was dying. She was his only daughter. While Jesus was on his way, people were crowding all around him.
translation_verse: ɔsika ubidi ulekubi unwi ɔni na ɔdubɔƒɔ aani akwa leevu-anyɔ ni, ɔtɛ ɔlɛ ɔdaku bukpi. Ka Yesu ɔkɛ úsela ni, lɛni na bekyuli baanwanɛ lɛlɔ ka bani bede-nwu.

english_verse: As soon as she came up behind Jesus and barely touched his clothes, her bleeding stopped.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔkɛ buɛɛ útávi Yesu kama na bekyuli akɔ na útuku-nwu awu kɔtu. Mmɔ kani ni, ubugya ɔmmɔ kenye kékulo.

english_verse: “Who touched me?” Jesus asked. While everyone was denying it, Peter said, “Master, people are crowding all around and pushing you from every side.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye ɔnii, “Ɔma nétuku-mi?” Nsu ukyuli biala úni. Amu na Petro ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ati, nu kalɛ na bekyuli ƒui bɛ́mu basiaku-ɔ!”

english_verse: The woman knew that she could not hide, so she came trembling and knelt down in front of Jesus. She told everyone why she had touched him and that she had been healed at once.
translation_verse: Ka uleku ɔmmɔ ɔ́nu ɔ́ti ka ulakana bɔbɛ ɔsu ni, lɛlɔ lɛɛtɔ́-nwu na ɔ́yu ɔ́tɛ Yesu lɛgba kalɔ. Amu na ɔ́sɔku lɛla biala kalɔ údie na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui anumi. Na údie ɔ́su lɛla lɛni ɔsu na útuku-nwu awu ku kalɛ na ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔ́ba-nwu kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: Jesus said to the woman, “You are now well because of your faith. May God give you peace!”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Mina ubi uleku, ƒula bɔƒɔtaadi bɔ́bwi-ɔ. Teesie ku keyi buɛɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus went into the house, but he did not let anyone else go with him, except Peter, John, James, and the girl's father and mother.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bétéduo Yairo kaduli mmɔ ni, útete kuƒi na ukyuli ɔdi uduo ɔtɔ kemmo ntu Petro ku Yohane ku Yakobo ku ulekubi ɔmmɔ ɔti ku uni kani.

english_verse: Everyone was crying and weeping for the girl. But Jesus said, “The child isn't dead. She is just asleep.”
translation_verse: Na bekyuli pii benye mmɔ beewulo kɔnyana ku keku na ubi ɔmmɔ ɔsu. Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛsɔ bitewulo. Ubi ɔmmɔ útekpi. Bɔlɛɛ na ɔda.”

english_verse: The people laughed at him because they knew she was dead.
translation_verse: Amu na bana ƒui béti-nwu báma, ɔsika ama bagyi ka úkpi.

english_verse: Jesus took hold of the girl's hand and said, “Child, get up!”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úƒie-nwu kɔnu ɔ́da na ɔ́kpali-nwu ɔnini, “Ubi, ta nye!”

english_verse: She came back to life and got right up. Jesus told them to give her something to eat.
translation_verse: Ulekubi ɔmmɔ ɔ́sɔ únwini úbo ngba na ɔ́ta kɔnakunwi. Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnii bawia lɛla lɛdi bete ulekubi ɔmmɔ na ɔdi.

english_verse: Her parents were surprised, but Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni ƒui ábla nwuna bawɔne dɛye dɛye, nsu Yesu úbo-ma ɔda ɔnii batasu ukyuli ɔdi lɛla lɛni nálɛ mɛni.

english_verse: The apostles came back and told Jesus everything they had done. He then took them with him to the village of Bethsaida, where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Batɛyane bammɔ bénwini bébo na bábasu Yesu ala ani ƒui na bábla. Amu na útiku-ma na bátɔlɔ bésie ɔma ɔni baalɔ banii Betsaida kakɛ.

english_verse: They did this, and all the people sat down.
translation_verse: Na ka batɛyane bábla lɛni ni,

english_verse: Herod the ruler heard about all that was happening, and he was worried. Some people were saying John the Baptist had come back to life.
translation_verse: Ka Herode ɔni mɔɔdi Galilea lɛlɔ únu ala ani ƒui mɔɔlɛ́ mɛni ni, úbeƒu ɔsika bekyuli badi baasu ka Ntu Ɔkpilane Yohane násɔ ɔ́ta úbo uli ngba.

english_verse: He told them, “Don't take anything with you! Don't take a walking stick or a traveling bag or food or money or even a change of clothes.
translation_verse: Asa na badubɔgyu ni, Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Biteti lɛla lɛdi bitada na bina ulu busie kemmo aani ugyii ɔdadi iye ala bevelene koƒo iye adila iye egulabi. Na awu ɔbambadi muedi ni, bitasu bɛnii biiti ɔdi.

english_verse: When you are welcomed into a home, stay there until you leave that town.
translation_verse: Kesii biala na báƒɔ-mii ni, bɛsɔ bɛkya kaduli kammɔ kemmo utédu uwi ɔni na ɔlɛka bɛtɔlɔ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Late in the afternoon the twelve apostles came to Jesus and said, “Send the crowd to the villages and farms around here. They need to find a place to stay and something to eat. There is nothing in this place. It's like a desert!”
translation_verse: Lebo lɛni na ɔƒɛ úsela bɔnu ni, Batɛyane leevu-inyɔ bammɔ bébo Yesu kudɔ na básu-nwu banini, “Ya na bekyuli bamɛni batɔlɔ na beteesie akpaklɔ ani nde amadɔ mɛni kemmo, kalɛ na bakɛ adila ku keduokɔ, ɔsika mɛni ɔdi ketele ntɛ.”

english_verse: While he was praying, his face changed, and his clothes became shining white.
translation_verse: Ka ɔdaku katɔ bɔkpali ni, nwuna anumi bɔnu bɔ́vumana na nwuna adala eekeye na aatu anumi.

english_verse: Jesus strictly warned his disciples not to tell anyone about this. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úbo-ma ɔda kpakplaa ɔnii batasu ukyuli ɔdi kenye kamɛni.

english_verse: “Pay close attention to what I am telling you! The Son of Man will be handed over to his enemies.”
translation_verse: “Bitayiƒala lɛla lɛni na líse kalɔ ndaku-mii bɔsu! Badubo Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi buti bɔkya bekyuli enu kemmo.”

english_verse: But a lot of people found out about this and followed him. Jesus welcomed them. He spoke about God's kingdom and healed everyone who was sick.
translation_verse: Ka bekyuli pii bénu lɛni ni, básia-nwu kama bésie mmɔ. Yesu lɛnɔ ɔ́ƒɔ-ma na ɔ́tɛmi úte-ma ɔ́si Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ ala lɛlɔ, na ɔ́bwi bani na ɔlɛ ɔda.

english_verse: “Don't stop him!” Jesus said. “Anyone who isn't against you is for you.” A Samaritan Village Refuses To Receive Jesus
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Bitabala-nwu. Ɔsika si ukyuli ɔdi útata útenye-mii lɛlɔ ni, bɛti bɛnii unye-mii kama.” Samaria Bekyuli Badi Béni Yesu

english_verse: About eight days later Jesus took Peter, John, and James with him and went up on a mountain to pray.
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla aani Kwasida unwi ɔni na Yesu ɔ́su ala amɛni kama ni, útiku Petro ku Yohane ku Yakobo na bákɔ bésie kɔbi lili batákpali katɔ.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will save it.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔwia ka ɔƒɔ nwuna lili ngba ute lɛlɔ ni, ɔdubɔyila-mu. Na ukyuli biala ɔni nányonu nwuna ngba ka ɔsiaku-mi ɔsu ni, ɔdubɔkɛ ngba geen.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself or waste your life?
translation_verse: Bi kɔsia na ukyuli ɔdubɔkɛ si ɔ́kɛ kayawi ala ƒui na ɔ́yila ngba geen bɔmmɔ?

english_verse: If you are ashamed of me and my message, the Son of Man will be ashamed of you when he comes in his glory and in the glory of his Father and the holy angels.
translation_verse: Si ami ku mina ala ani mɔɔtina ƒui ékpo ukyuli ɔdi kɔƒa ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔdubukpo ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi kɔƒa uwi ɔni na mebo na mina bukeye ku Katɔti ku nwuna batu kedee ƒui bukeye kemmo.

english_verse: They appeared in heavenly glory and talked about all that Jesus' death in Jerusalem would mean.
translation_verse: Báda bálɛ na Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma bukeye kemmo na bátɛmi ku Yesu na ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔdubɔsia na ɔwɔlɔ lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔɔwia na nwuna kukpi na Yerusalem kemmo.

english_verse: ) While everyone was still amazed at what Jesus was doing, he said to his disciples,
translation_verse: Petro ku nwuna bakpana béduo lɛlɛɛ kemmo geen, nsu bágyinya bábanu lɛlɔyɔ bukeye bɔni kemmo na Yesu ɔkya ku nkyuli inyɔ bani nnye-nwu kudɔ.

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, a shadow from a cloud passed over, and they were frightened as the cloud covered them.
translation_verse: Lebo lɛni na ɔmu unye ɔɔtɛmi ni, ɔdi ɔ́yu úbewi-ma lɛlɔ. Na batɛyane bammɔ báyia uwi ɔni na ɔmɛni ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: From the cloud a voice spoke, “This is my chosen Son. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Amu na bénu Katɔti lɛdi na ɔmmɔ kemmo ka lɛɛsu lɛnini, “Ɔmɛni ndi mina Ubi Ɔƒunadi. Binu-nwu litemi!”

english_verse: After the voice had spoken, Peter, John, and James saw only Jesus. For some time they kept quiet and did not say anything about what they had seen. Jesus Heals a Boy (Matthew
translation_verse: Amu ka lɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛ́da bɔtɛmi lɛ́ya ni, bánu ka Yesu lɛti nébu unye. Amu na batɛyane bammɔ béti ala ani na bánu mmɔ bábala, na bátasu-nya ukyuli ɔdi uwi ɔmmɔ. Yesu Ɔ́gya Kɔyu Kukpidi Ɔ́lɛku Ɔnanabi Ɔdi Lɛlɔ Kemmo

english_verse: A demon often attacks him and makes him scream. It shakes him until he foams at the mouth, and it won't leave him until it has completely worn the boy out.
translation_verse: Kɔyu kukpidi kɔdi kuukpóku-nwu na kɔɔyá na ɔɔva momoomo kɔnakunwi. Ɔɔsinsi lɛlɔ na uuti lɛlɔ taaƒiɛmi kalɔ na avlɔvɔ aalɛ́-nwu kenye. Lɛni na ɔɔbla-nwu laa ɔkplu kemmo asa na kɔyu kɔmmɔ kɔɔnyonu-nwu.

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You people are stubborn and don't have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you?” Then Jesus said to the man, “Bring your son to me.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Amii, ɔmwi limeyi bekyuli, bi ɔsu na bilaƒɔ-mi taadi na bɛɛyu atu ɔkplu? Uwi ɛlɛ sɔɔn na ndubɔkɛku-mii kayi? Na uwi ɔmani na ndubɔda-mii ntálɛ?” Amu na ɔ́su ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Ti ƒ'ubidi boku mɛni.”

english_verse: While the boy was being brought, the demon attacked him and made him shake all over. Jesus ordered the demon to stop. Then he healed the boy and gave him back to his father.
translation_verse: Ka ɔnamu ɔmmɔ ɔ́si ɔdubo ni, anwu kani na kɔyu kɔmmɔ kúbo-nwu kɔ́va kalɔ na ɔ́sinsi. Amu na Yesu ɔ́bɔku kɔyu kukpidi kɔmmɔ na ɔ́bwi ɔnamu ɔmmɔ, na ɔ́sɔku-nwu úte ɔti.

english_verse: But the disciples did not know what he meant. The meaning was hidden from them. They could not understand it, and they were afraid to ask. Who Is the Greatest? (Matthew
translation_verse: Nsu batɛyane bammɔ bétenu ɔmɛni kalɔ. Ɔdi lɛla lɛni na béti bábala-ma, nsu baayia-nwu lɛla lɛdi buye bɔsiku litemi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Yesu Údie Ukyuli Ɔni Ntulo Ɔ́tina

english_verse: Jesus' disciples were arguing about which one of them was the greatest.
translation_verse: Unyeƒi ɔdi úbeduo batɛyane bammɔ ntɛ ɔni ndi bana akɔ ɔni náƒɔ kuye utulo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he had a child stand there beside him.
translation_verse: Amu ka Yesu ɔ́ti-ma kasusu ɔsu ni, úti ɔnamu ɔdi úbenyene-ma anumi na nwuna kudɔ.

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “When you welcome even a child because of me, you welcome me. And when you welcome me, you welcome the one who sent me. Whichever one of you is the most humble is the greatest.” For or against Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́su-ma ɔnii, “Ukyuli ɔni náƒɔ ɔnamu ɔmɛni na mina lɛnyi kemmo ni, ɔ́ƒɔ ami lɛnɔ. Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mi ni, ɔ́ƒɔ ukyuli ɔni nátala-mi. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni néboku lɛlɔ kalɔ ƒui na bina akɔ ni, anwu ndi ukyuli ɔni náƒɔ kuye utulo ƒui.” Ukyuli Ɔni Neeekisi-ɔ Ni, Unye-ɔ Kama

english_verse: John said, “Master, we saw a man using your name to force demons out of people. But we told him to stop, because he isn't one of us.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yohane ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ati, bɔ́nu ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔkya ɔɔgyá ayu ekpidi na ƒula lɛnyi kemmo na bɔ́su-nwu bɔnii ɔda ɔya, ɔsika ɔɔɔdi bula akɔ unwi.”

english_verse: Not long before it was time for Jesus to be taken up to heaven, he made up his mind to go to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amu ka uwi ɔni na ɔlɛka Katɔti uti Yesu usienku katɔ ɔdaku budu ni, ɔ́lɛ ugyii ka uteesie Yerusalem.

english_verse: He sent some messengers on ahead to a Samaritan village to get things ready for him.
translation_verse: Ɔ́tala batu badi ɔnii bagyu batɔ lɛkpaklɔ lɛdi kemmo na Samaria na batáklibi lɛla biala bese bete-nwu.

english_verse: But he was on his way to Jerusalem, so the people there refused to welcome him.
translation_verse: Nsu ka ɔma ɔmmɔ bekyuli báti ka bɔvi na ɔ́vi úsela Yerusalem ɔsu ni, bétenu kalɔ.

english_verse: When the disciples James and John saw what was happening, they asked, “Lord, do you want us to call down fire from heaven to destroy these people?”
translation_verse: Amu na ka batɛyane bani ndi Yohane ku Yakobo bánu lɛni ni, béye Yesu banii, “Ati, aawia ka bɔkpali ogya bɔsi katɔ bubewi-ma lɛlɔ na ɔkyula-ma?”

english_verse: Then they all went on to another village. Three People Who Wanted To Be Followers (Matthew
translation_verse: Na anwu ku batɛyane bammɔ bébo bávi bésie lɛkpaklɔ bamba. Bekyuli Badi Báyɔ Ka Basiaku Yesu Kama

english_verse: Along the way someone said to Jesus, “I'll follow you anywhere!”
translation_verse: Ka bakɛ bésela ni, ɔnana ɔdi ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Ndubɔsiaku-ɔ kesii biala na ésela.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Foxes have dens, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man doesn't have a place to call his own.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Beƒiebuo bebo libu lɛni kemmo na baatɛ, na baasɛ lɛnɔ bebo ayu. Nsu Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ni, anwu uuubo katɛnkɔ muedi.”

english_verse: Jesus told someone else to come with him. But the man said, “Lord, let me wait until I bury my father.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́su ukyuli bamba ɔnini, “Siaku-mi.” Nsu ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Ati, ya na lɛka mina ɔti busie butáva asa.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Let the dead take care of the dead, while you go and tell about God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ya na ama bani neeebo Katɔti ngba geen bɔmmɔ bataava bana bekpine. Na awɔ eteesie na atásu Katɔti lɛga bɔdi litemi.”

english_verse: Then someone said to Jesus, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first let me go back and take care of things at home.”
translation_verse: Ukyuli bamba lɛnɔ ɔnii, “Blɔti, masiaku-ɔ. Nsu ya-mi lɛka mina lɛlɔ bekyuli busie butákada asa.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Anyone who starts plowing and keeps looking back isn't worth a thing to God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔni naaabla nwuna kabla ku kayi ƒui ni, útamanku Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma.”

english_verse: He said to them: A large crop is in the fields, but there are only a few workers. Ask the Lord in charge of the harvest to send out workers to bring it in.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Edula pii éedu bɔƒɛ, nsu nkyuli ɛlɛɛ badi kani nnye kabla kamɛni lɛlɔ. Bɛkpali katɔ na bivele kemmo ɔlati na umene bekyuli bani maƒɛ-nya masala.

english_verse: Don't take along a moneybag or a traveling bag or sandals. And don't waste time greeting people on the road.
translation_verse: Na biteti egulabi kavumi iye koƒo iye lɛgbanvuo, na bitedi bitenye ulu bɛnii biigyele ukyuli ɔdi.

english_verse: As soon as you enter a home, say, “God bless this home with peace.”
translation_verse: “Kaduli biala na bítéduo ni, bɛka bɔsu bɛnii, ‘Keyi buɛɛ kasiaku kaduli kamɛni bekyuli.’

english_verse: If the people living there are peace-loving, your prayer for peace will bless them. But if they are not peace-loving, your prayer will return to you.
translation_verse: Na si ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ keyi buɛɛ ɔdi ɔkya mmɔ ni, bɛya na bina keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-nwu. Nsu si ɔdi uuubo ni, bɛsɔku bina keyi buɛɛ kegye bɛtɔlɔku.

english_verse: Stay with the same family, eating and drinking whatever they give you, because workers are worth what they earn. Don't move around from house to house.
translation_verse: Bɛsɔ bɛkya kaduli kani kemmo na báƒɔ-mii. Na lɛla biala lɛni na badubuti bete-mii ni, bɛdi na bɛni-ni. Ɔsika kabla ɔblane biala ni, ɔlɛka bete-nwu nwuna lɛyuƒɔla. Bitatáka bitamana ɔ́si kaduli kani úsie kani.
