english_verse: If the people of a town welcome you, eat whatever they offer.
translation_verse: “Na ɔma biala ɔni kemmo na báƒɔ-mii ni, bɛdi lɛla biala na bákɛ béte-mii.

english_verse: But if the people of a town refuse to welcome you, go out into the street and say,
translation_verse: Nsu si bísie ɔma ɔdi kemmo na bátaƒɔ-mii ni, bɛlɛ bisie kuyeya na bɛsu bɛnii,

english_verse: I tell you that on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than the people of that town! The Unbelieving Towns (Matthew
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-mii kede kede nnii na litemi bɔtɛ limeyi ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔnu Sodom ɔma kɔnyana utulo ɔma ɔmmɔ! Lɛma Lɛdi Lítaƒɔ Yesu Litemi

english_verse: But don't be happy because evil spirits obey you. Be happy that your names are written in heaven! Jesus Thanks His Father (Matthew
translation_verse: Nsu ni, lɛlɔ litayɔ-mii ka ayu ekpidi eenú-mii litemi ɔsu. Mmomu ebiti ada-mii ka Katɔti únweni-mii anyi ɔ́kya Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma.” Yesu Úmwi Katɔti

english_verse: Many prophets and kings were eager to see what you see and to hear what you hear. But I tell you they did not see or hear.” The Good Samaritan
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii ka ni, Katɔti kenye bediene pii ku baga lɛnɔ báwia ka banu lɛla lɛni bɛɛnu ɔƒɛni, nsu bátanu. Na báwia ka benu lɛla lɛni na amii biinú mɛni, nsu bétenu.” Yesu Ɔ́su-ma Samariani Kaƒɔbuni Ɔblane Ɔdi Lɛlɔ Litemi

english_verse: On the day of judgment the people of Tyre and Sidon will get off easier than you will.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔdubɔnu Tiro ku Sidon lɛma kɔnyana butulo amii na litemi bɔtɛ limeyi.

english_verse: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? Well, you will go down to hell!
translation_verse: Na awɔ Kapernaum ni, bɔkali na bɛda bɛnii bɛdubɔkɔliku lɛlɔ bitédu katɔ? Badubɔyula-mii na bɛyii udu!”

english_verse: Jesus told them: I saw Satan fall from heaven like a flash of lightning.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Lɛ́nu Satan ka ɔ́si katɔ úbanu aani ogya bɔtu kalɛ.

english_verse: I have given you the power to trample on snakes and scorpions and to defeat the power of your enemy Satan. Nothing can harm you.
translation_verse: Binu kaduɛ! Líte-mii ɔyikun ɔni na bɛkana na bɛkɔ bɛnya balakpi ku batamlukpa lɛlɔ. Na bɛkana bɛdi ukisine ɔmmɔ ɔyikun ƒui lɛlɔ ɔni na lɛla lɛdi lilabla-mii.

english_verse: An expert in the Law of Moses stood up and asked Jesus a question to see what he would say. “Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔda bubo ala ɔtinane ɔdi úbo ku kasusu ka ɔkɔku Yesu ɔnu. Na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Ala ɔtinane, bi na ɔlɛka lɛbla asa lɛkɛ ngba ƒui?”

english_verse: The man replied, “The Scriptures say, ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, strength, and mind.’ They also say, ‘Love your neighbors as much as you love yourself.’ ”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔnana ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnii, “Yɔ Unwoti Katɔti ku ƒula kayi ƒui, ku ƒula kɔyu ƒui ku ƒula ɔyikun ƒui ku ƒula kasusu ƒui lɛnɔ, na ayɔ ƒula ukyulikpana aani ƒula lɛlɔ kalɛ.”

english_verse: At that same time, Jesus felt the joy that comes from the Holy Spirit, and he said: My Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I am grateful that you hid all this from wise and educated people and showed it to ordinary people. Yes, Father, this is what pleased you.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti Kɔyu ebiti áƒɔ Yesu lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ati, katɔ ku kalɔ Unwoti, mɔɔgyá-a enu ɔsika lɛla lɛni na éti ábɛla bakutine ku banundane ni, ani na éti átina bekyuli bani na baaagyi lɛku ku badɔlɔdi. Sɔsɔ na ɔdi, Ati, lɛni geen na aayɔ́ anii ɔlɛ.”

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who really knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Mina Ɔti úti ala ƒui úte-mi. Ɔdi biala ɔɔɔgyi ukyuli ɔni na Katɔti Ubi ɔmmɔ ɔdi, ntu Katɔti lɛti pɛ. Na ɔdi lɛnɔ ɔɔɔgyi ukyuli ɔni na Katɔti ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ɔdi, ntu Ubidi ɔmmɔ lɛti pɛ ku bekyuli bani na Ubi ɔmmɔ ɔ́ƒuna ka udie Ɔti ɔmmɔ ɔtina kani.”

english_verse: Jesus then turned to his disciples and said to them in private, “You are really blessed to see what you see!
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu únwini útánu nwuna batɛyane bammɔ na ɔ́su-ma na bɔbɛ kemmo ɔnini, “Lɛlɔ litaayɔ-mii geen ka bɛɛnu ala ani na bɛdaku bɔnu mɛni!

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is written in the Scriptures? How do you understand them?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Bi na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔsu? Na dɛ na awɔ eenú litemi lɛmmɔ kalɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You have given the right answer. If you do this, you will have eternal life.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ásu na ɔ́tɛ. Bla lɛni na adubɔkɛ ngba ƒui.”

english_verse: But the man wanted to show that he knew what he was talking about. So he asked Jesus, “Who are my neighbors?”
translation_verse: Nsu ka ɔda bubo ala ɔtinane ɔmɛni ɔɔwia ka ute lɛlɔ ubo ɔsu ni, ɔ́sɔ úye Yesu ɔnini, “Ɔma ndi mina ukyulikpana?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: As a man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, robbers attacked him and grabbed everything he had. They beat him up and ran off, leaving him half dead.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Dii ni, ɔnana ɔdi ɔ́kya ɔni nási Yerusalem úsela Yeriko, na beyune bátáda-nwu ulu. Na bébo-nwu na bédie-nwu lɛlɔ ala na bányonu-nwu báva na ɔɔyɔ́ ukpi.

english_verse: A priest happened to be going down the same road. But when he saw the man, he walked by on the other side.
translation_verse: Úbebo úte ka Katɔti ɔkpane ɔdi úbo ɔɔví ulu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Nsu ka ɔ́nu ukyuli ɔmɛni na kuludɔ ni, ɔ́sia ɔvi ɔbambadi ɔ́tɔlɔ.

english_verse: Later a temple helper came to the same place. But when he saw the man who had been beaten up, he also went by on the other side.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na Lewini ɔdi lɛnɔ úbo ɔɔví. Na ka ɔ́nu ɔnana ɔmmɔ ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́sia ɔvi ɔbambadi ɔ́tɔlɔ.

english_verse: A man from Samaria then came traveling along that road. When he saw the man, he felt sorry for him
translation_verse: Nsu Samariani ɔdi ɔni nábasia mmɔ úsela ulu ɔdi ni, úbasiaku ukyuli ɔmmɔ. Na ka ɔ́nu-nwu ni, kaƒɔ kákywi-nwu.

english_verse: and went over to him. He treated his wounds with olive oil and wine and bandaged them. Then he put him on his own donkey and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.
translation_verse: Amu na úsie útédu-nwu kudɔ na úti nnɔmii ku ntɛ úwi-nwu lɛlɛ lɛmmɔ kemmo na únyimi-ni ƒui. Na ɔ́gyu ɔnana ɔmmɔ útásia anwu ɔlati ebuo lɛlɔ. Na úti-nwu úsienku baƒɔ keduokɔ na ɔ́nu-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The next morning he gave the innkeeper two silver coins and said, “Please take care of the man. If you spend more than this on him, I will pay you when I return.”
translation_verse: Kadi kégye ni, údie egulabi adi úte keduokɔ lɛlɔ ɔnune ɔmmɔ ɔnii, ‘Taanu-nwu lɛlɔ. Na si lɛ́si líbo mɔɔví mɛni ni, ndubɔƒɔ-ɔ lɛla biala lɛni na adubɔsɔ ebile na nwuna lɛlɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “Which one of these three people was a real neighbor to the man who was beaten up by robbers?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye ɔda bubo ala ɔtinane ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Na ƒula kasusu kenye ni, nkyuli ɛtɛ bamɛni akɔ ɔmani nátina lɛlɔ aani ukyulikpana na ukyuli ɔni néduo beyune enu kemmo mɛni lɛlɔ?”

english_verse: The expert in the Law of Moses answered, “The one who showed pity.” Jesus said, “Go and do the same!” Martha and Mary
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔda bubo ala ɔtinane ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔni nánu-nwu kɔnyana.” Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ lɛnɔ teesie na atábla lɛni.” Yesu Úsie Marta Ku Maria Kudɔ

english_verse: The Lord and his disciples were traveling along and came to a village. When they got there, a woman named Martha welcomed him into her home.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔni na Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane básia bana ulu bátɔlɔ bésela ni, bébedu ɔma ɔdi. Mmɔ na uleku ɔdi baalɔ Marta ɔ́ƒɔ-nwu úsienku nwuna kaduli.

english_verse: She had a sister named Mary, who sat down in front of the Lord and was listening to what he said.
translation_verse: Marta ɔmɛni ubo ɔnwani ulekubi ɔni baalɔ Maria. Anwu ɔ́yu úlie Yesu kudɔ na uunú-nwu ala ani na ɔɔtina.

english_verse: Martha was worried about all that had to be done. Finally, she went to Jesus and said, “Lord, doesn't it bother you that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself? Tell her to come and help me!”
translation_verse: Kaduli ablala ani nsia Marta lɛti pɛ lɛlɔ ékpoku-nwu kayi. Ɔmɛni ɔsu úbo na úbasu Yesu ɔnini, “Blɔti, ulábla-a lɛla lɛdi ka mina ɔnwani ulekubi ɔ́da kaduli ablala amɛni ƒui ɔ́sia-mi lɛlɔ? Su-nwu na ubo ubebunku-mi!”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Martha, Martha! You are worried and upset about so many things,
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Marta! Nu kalɛ na eekpóku lɛlɔ na ala pii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: but only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen what is best, and it will not be taken away from her.”
translation_verse: Nsu lɛlakpa linwi kani námanku ka bawia. Na lɛbuni lɛmmɔ na Maria ɔ́ƒuna. Na basɔ baláƒɔ-ni na nwuna kudɔ.”

english_verse: So I tell you to ask and you will receive, search and you will find, knock and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu mɔɔsu-mii nnii bivele Katɔti na ɔdubuti ute-mii, bɛwia na bɛdubɔkɛ, bibo kɔnu kegbuta na ɔdubɔlɛmi ute-mii.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give the Holy Spirit to anyone who asks. Jesus and the Ruler of Demons (Matthew
translation_verse: Ina ka bɛdi alaekpidi bablane ni, bɛgyi kalɛ na biti ala abuni bite bina bebi. Amu na Ati ɔni nkya katɔ nɔɔ? Bi ɔsu na uleti nwuna Kɔyu ulete bekyuli bani muuvele-nwu?” Bekyuli Badi Bákya Unyeƒi Na Yesu Ku Beelsebul Ɔyikun Lɛlɔ

english_verse: And suppose your friend answers, “Don't bother me! The door is bolted, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you something.”
translation_verse: “Na banii ƒula ɔkpana ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-ɔ ɔnii, ‘Tebete-mi lɛƒɛda lɛdi! Ami ku mina bebi bɔ́ɔtɛ na bɔ́kalɛ ɔtɔ. Nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo bɔkana bɔta ɔƒɛni bubete-ɔ lɛla lɛdi.’

english_verse: Which one of you fathers would give your hungry child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: “Na amii bani ndi bebi bati ni, bute na ɔdi ɔdubuti kɔlakpi ute ubidi si úye-nwu kabɛ?

english_verse: So Jesus told them, “Pray in this way: ‘Father, help us to honor your name. Come and set up your kingdom.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Si bɛɛkpali katɔ ni, na bɛsu bɛnii, “ ‘Ati, balɔ-ɔ lɛnyi buni. Ƒula lɛga kadikɔ kebo-bu akɔ. Babla ƒula lɛƒɔyɔ na kalɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na use na katɔ.

english_verse: Forgive our sins, as we forgive everyone who has done wrong to us. And keep us from being tempted.’ ”
translation_verse: Na eti bula alaekpidi akyiɛ-bu, ɔsika abu lɛnɔ buuti taakyiɛ ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔƒiɔ́-bu. Na taya na buduo bukpoku taanu kemmo. Na edie-bu alɛku alaekpidi akɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive, everyone who searches will find, and the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli biala ɔni muuvele Katɔti ni, uute-nwu. Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔwia lɛla lɛdi ni, ɔɔkɛ́-ni. Na ukyuli biala ɔni muubó kɔnu kegbuta ni, Katɔti ɔɔlɛmi teete-nwu.

english_verse: Just as Jonah was a sign to the people of Nineveh, the Son of Man will be a sign to the people of today.
translation_verse: Kalɛ kani na Katɔti Kenye Udiene Yona ɔdi likposela ute Niniweƒuɔ ni, lɛni kani na Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi lɛnɔ wenwini likposela wete ɔmwi limeyi bekyuli.

english_verse: While Jesus was still talking, a woman in the crowd spoke up, “The woman who gave birth to you and nursed you is blessed!”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ɔ́su ala amɛni ni, uleku ɔdi ɔ́va ku lɛdi momoomo na bekyuli akɔ mmɔ na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Lɛlɔ lɛyɔ uleku ɔni náwɔ-ɔ na úte-ɔ lɛnyi na ányimi!”

english_verse: Jesus forced a demon out of a man who could not talk. And after the demon had gone out, the man started speaking, and the crowds were amazed.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdi ni, Yesu ɔkya ɔɔgyá kɔyu kɔdi na kulákana butemi. Amu ka kɔyu kɔmmɔ kɔ́vi kɔ́lɛ ukyuli ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kemmo ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ úse kalɔ ku butemi. Ɔmɛni ɔ́bla bekyuli bani nnye mmɔ dɛye dɛye.

english_verse: Others wanted to put Jesus to the test. So they asked him to show them a sign from God.
translation_verse: Na babambadi lɛnɔ báyɔ ka bakywɛ Yesu kakpagyuɛ ɔsu básu-nwu banii ɔbla akɔla adi na uti udie ɔtina ka Katɔti náƒuna-nwu.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said: A kingdom where people fight each other will end up in ruin. And a family that fights will break up.
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu ɔ́ti lɛla lɛni na badanku na bana kasusu kemmo. Anwuɔsu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Kalɔ kani muule lɛlɔ akpa akpa na beenye teekpoku lɛlɔ ni, kalɔ kammɔ kelétu uwi. Na kaduli kenwi bekyuli bani muule lɛlɔ na beekpóku lɛlɔ ni, bugyingya na beegyingya.

english_verse: If Satan fights against himself, how can his kingdom last? Yet you say that I force out demons by the power of Beelzebul.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si Satan lɛga kadikɔ kebo akpa akpa ani muukpóku lɛlɔ ni, dɛ na lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ kadubunye? Bɛɛsu ka mɔɔgyá ayu ekpidi taalɛku ka Beelsebul uute-mi ɔyikun ɔnii mbla lɛni ɔsu.

english_verse: If I use his power to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? They are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: Na si Beelsebul lɛlɔ na mɔɔgyá-ma ni, ɔma lɛlɔ na bina basiakune ama baasia taagya ayu ekpidi taalɛku bekyuli lɛlɔ kemmo? Amii alati bina basiakune muudie taatina-mii ka bɛɛnyi ɔkɔ.

english_verse: When a strong man arms himself and guards his home, everything he owns is safe.
translation_verse: “Si ɔyikune ɔdi ɔ́klibi nwuna ekpola na unye ɔɔgyumana nwuna kaduli ni, agyi anii nwuna akɛla adi alayii.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You love the front seats in the synagogues, and you like to be greeted with honor in the market.
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ muute amii Ƒarisiƒuɔ! Ɔsika bɛɛwia ka bilie kuliekɔ kunengudi na bina kasalakɔ. Na bɛɛwia ka bekyuli bataakya-mii kenye ku ɔbu na kuyeya.

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses spoke up, “Teacher, you said cruel things about us.”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔda bubo ala batinane akɔ unwi ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ala ɔtinane, si ásu ɔmɛni ni, eedumi abu lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when it doesn't find a place, it says, “I will go back to the home I left.”
translation_verse: “Si kɔyu kukpidi kɔ́vi kɔ́lɛ ukyuli lɛlɔ kemmo ni, kɔɔkɛ taavi ekpo ekpo ani nákwii taawia kesii kani na kulie. Na si útakɛ kadi ni, ɔɔsu lɛlɔ ɔnii, ‘Ndubɔsɔ linwini lisie mina kaduli kani na lɛ́tɔlɔ mmɔ.’

english_verse: When it gets there and finds the place clean and fixed up,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔɔsɔ teesie taatánu ka bákpala ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo sɛɛn na béni ala ƒui.

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and that person ends up in worse shape than before. Being Really Blessed
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, ɔɔsɔ teenwini teesie na utákpanku ayu ekpidi maatɛ ani mbo kalala ntulo-nwu na bebo bebelie mmɔ. Na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ ablala eebie teetulo kalɛ na úse kudeedi muedi.” Yesu Ɔ́tina Ala Ɔ́siku Ukyuli Ɔni Mbo Ebiti Geen Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Jesus replied, “That's true, but the people who are really blessed are the ones who hear and obey God's message!” A Sign from God (Matthew
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Bekyuli bani muunú Katɔti litemi na baabla taasiaku-ni lɛlɔ mmomu na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ!” Yesu Úni Ɔnii Uledie Akɔla Ulatina

english_verse: The Pharisee was surprised that he did not wash his hands before eating.
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla Ƒarisini ɔmmɔ dɛye dɛye ka ɔ́nu ka Yesu útaƒɔ kɔnu kalɛ na ɔdi ɔmmɔ ɔɔtina asa na úse kalɔ ku bɔdi.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your gardens, such as mint and rue. But you cheat people, and you don't love God. You should be fair and kind to others and still give a tenth to God.
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ muute amii Ƒarisiƒuɔ! Biiti bina edula lɛkpa leevudi ku kevoma kutu akyala ƒɛƒɛɛ aani evete lidu lidu teete Katɔti. Nsu biiní ka utalɛka bɛnu bekyuli anumi bɛbla ala, na bilayɔ Katɔti lɛnɔ. Amɛni na ɔdi ka bɛbla bibunku ala ani na bɛdaku, na ɔɔɔdi ka bɛda ɔdi bise.

english_verse: As crowds were gathering around Jesus, he said: You people of today are evil! You keep looking for a sign from God. But what happened to Jonah is the only sign you will be given.
translation_verse: Amu ka bekyuli bammɔ beemomo Yesu kudɔ teebu ni, úsie anumi na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛnu kalɛ na ɔmwi limeyi bekyuli bebo likyulikpi! Akɔla budie bɔtina na baawia banu, nsu balanu budie bɔtina bɔdi uti utulo Yona bɔdi.

english_verse: When the judgment comes, the Queen of the South will stand there with you and condemn you. She traveled a long way to hear Solomon's wisdom, and yet here is something far greater than Solomon.
translation_verse: Na litemi bɔtɛ limeyi ni, Uleku Ɔga ɔni nási kada kakɛ ɔdubɔta unye na ubo-mii lɛnimi enwu, ɔsika ɔ́ta ɔ́si nwuna kalɔ úsie ɔgyu kakaaka ɔnii úténu Ɔga Salomo lɛnunda ala bɔtina. Nsu mɔɔsu-mii nnii ukyuli ɔni ntulo Salomo ɔkya mɛni.

english_verse: The people of Nineveh will also stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah. Light (Matthew
translation_verse: Niniweƒuɔ badubɔta benye na bebo-mii lɛnimi enwu na litemi bɔtɛ limeyi. Ɔsika uwi ɔni na Yona ɔ́su-ma Katɔti litemi ni, bávumana udu na bénwini bana ekpidi kudɔ. Nsu mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ni, ukyuli ɔdi ɔkya-mii akɔ mɛni na utulo Yona! Yesu Údie Lɛla Lɛni Muute Ukyuli Bukeye Ɔ́tina

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a clay pot. A lamp is put on a lampstand, so everyone who comes into the house can see the light.
translation_verse: “Ukyuli ɔdi ulátu asogya na uuti taabɛla iye ubi-nwu ala. Mmomu buti na uuti taasia likpo lɛni na bekyuli bani muuduo mmɔ banu nwaa.

english_verse: Your eyes are the lamp for your body. When your eyes are good, you have all the light you need. But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark.
translation_verse: Buse na ukyuli anumi ese aani asogya ute nwuna ɔlɔna. Si anumi aanu-ɔ kaduɛ ni, awɔ ukyuli umodi ɔmmɔ ni, use-ɔ nwaa ɔ́ka ɔ́mana. Nsu si ƒula anumi aaadia ni, agyi anii awɔ ukyuli ɔmmɔ akya lɛdisa kemmo.

english_verse: You fools! Didn't God make both the outside and the inside?
translation_verse: Badɔlɔdi! Ɔɔɔdi Katɔti ɔmmɔ kani na ábla ala ƒui kemmo ku kama yoo?

english_verse: Yes, you are really in for trouble. You build monuments to honor the prophets your own people murdered long ago.
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ muute-mii geen, ɔsika bɛɛtú kɔƒiɔtɔ kɔbuni teete Katɔti kenye bediene. Nsu Katɔti kenye bediene bammɔ geen na bina bati kuuku bádu.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him home for a meal. Jesus went and sat down to eat.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ɔ́wɔlɔ butemi ni, Ƒarisini ɔdi ɔ́lɔ-nwu bɔdi na nwuna kaduli. Amu na úsie útélie kalɔ na ɔtɔ kemmo na baadi.

english_verse: So the Lord said to him: You Pharisees clean the outside of cups and dishes, but on the inside you are greedy and evil.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Blɔti ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ɔƒaani ni, amii Ƒarisiƒuɔ bɛɛƒɔ bina akyami ku lɛɛƒɛɛ kama, nsu bina lɛlɔ kemmo geen anwu ni, likyulikpi ku kalala bɔbla bɔ́ƒɔ-ni ƒui.

english_verse: If you would only give what you have to the poor, everything you do would please God.
translation_verse: Biti ala ani ƒui nkya bina akyami ku lɛɛƒɛɛ kemmo mmɔ bite bawabane kalɛ na bina lɛla biala lɛbla sɛɛn.

english_verse: But you are in for trouble! You are like unmarked graves that people walk on without even knowing it.
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ muute-mii, ɔsika bise aani kɔƒiɔtɔ kɔni na bétese-ku likpo, na bekyuli beesié taavi-ku lɛlɔ ɔsika baaagyi.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: You teachers are also in for trouble! You load people down with heavy burdens, but you won't lift a finger to help them carry the loads.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu údie kenye ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Bɔbuɛ muute amii ɔda bubo ala batinane lɛnɔ. Etila ani na bekyuli balakana buti ni, anya bɛɛtɛ taasia bekyuli kama. Na bilábla kasusu bɛnii biibunku-ma na bakana etila ammɔ buti.

english_verse: You must think that was the right thing for your people to do, or else you would not have built monuments for the prophets they murdered.
translation_verse: Na amii alati bɛɛƒɔ́ ɔmɛni enu ka lɛla lɛni na bina bati bammɔ bábla lɛdia-mii. Ama bádu Katɔti kenye bediene na amii bɛ́tu bana kɔƒiɔtɔ.

english_verse: Because of your evil deeds, the Wisdom of God said, “I will send prophets and apostles to you. But you will murder some and mistreat others.”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na Katɔti lɛnunda lɛ́su lɛnii, ‘Ndubɔtala Katɔti kenye bediene ku batu lɛkya-ma na badubɔdu badi na badubukpoku bakladi.’

english_verse: You people living today will be punished for all the prophets who have been murdered since the beginning of the world.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔmwi limeyi bekyuli ƒui ni, badubo-ma kɔtu bɔni na Katɔti kenye bediene bani ƒui na bádu ɔ́si kayawi kamɛni kalɔ kesekɔ ƒui ɔsu.

english_verse: This includes every prophet from the time of Abel to the time of Zechariah, who was murdered between the altar and the temple. You people will certainly be punished for all of this.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si ɔni bádu Abel úbedu Sakaria ɔni na bádu na lɛkpabi ku kesii kani na baalɔ banii likpo kedee ntɛ. Lɛni geen mɔɔsu-mii ka ni, Katɔti ɔdubo ɔmwi limeyi bekyuli kɔtu bɔni na bana ƒui ɔsu!

english_verse: You teachers of the Law of Moses are really in for trouble! You carry the keys to the door of knowledge about God. But you never go in, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: “Bɔbuɛ muute amii ɔda bubo ala batinane! Ɔsika ɔtɔ ɔni kemmo na lɛnunda lɛkya ni, bɛ́kalɛ kayakun kammɔ bíse. Nsu amii alati bini bɛnii bileduo. Na biitile bekyuli bamba bani mɔɔwia beduo lɛnɔ kuƒi.”

english_verse: Jesus was about to leave, but the teachers and the Pharisees wanted to get even with him. They tried to make him say what he thought about other things,
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́tɔlɔ likpo lɛmmɔ ni, Ƒarisiƒuɔ ku ɔda bubo ala batinane bese kalɔ ku Yesu litemi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ kɔnyi buti, na beedie-ni bɔƒiɔ taasu ala lidu lidu.

english_verse: so they could catch him saying something wrong.
translation_verse: Na bakya baawia ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na basia bakya-nwu litemi kenye na ɔbla likpidi lɛdi.

english_verse: As thousands of people crowded around Jesus and were stepping on each other, he told his disciples: Be sure to guard against the dishonest teaching of the Pharisees! It is their way of fooling people.
translation_verse: Ka bekyuli mpim mpim badi bábasa mmɔ ɔni na baanya lɛlɔ muedi ni, Yesu ɔ́ka nwuna batɛyane bɔsu ɔnini, “Binye kagyumana kaduɛ na Ƒarisiƒuɔ ɔkɔ ablala ani muuƒú bekyuli mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. Won't he do even more for you? You have such little faith!
translation_verse: Katɔti muute livo lɛmɛni bɔdia bɔmɛni udu. Livo lɛmɛni linye ɔmwi na uwi bamba na bekulo-ni bakya ogya na bakyula-ni na livongu kemmo. Bute na Katɔti ɔmmɔ ulete-mii adala uletulo livo lɛmmɔ? Bi ɔsu na bina bɔƒɔtaadi buse blii suɛ lɛni?

english_verse: But put God's work first, and these things will be yours as well. Treasures in Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: Mmomu ni, biteeti kasusu na Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ lɛlɔ na ɔdubuti ala amɛni ƒui ute-mii. Bɛsia Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma Akɛla Anu

english_verse: My friends, don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but after that, there is nothing else they can do.
translation_verse: “Bakpana, mɔɔsu-mii ka ni, bitayia bekyuli bani na ɔlɔna kani na badubɔkana bɔdu na ɔmmɔ kama na basɔ balakana lɛla lɛdi bɔbla.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted. So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Matthew
translation_verse: Bula lili linwini muedi ni, Katɔti ɔgyi-ni bumomo. Anwuɔsu ni, bɛda bɔyia bɛya ɔsika bɛ́ƒɔ kuye bitulo baasɛ pii. Binye Yesu Kama Kpakplaa

english_verse: My little group of disciples, don't be afraid! Your Father wants to give you the kingdom.
translation_verse: “Mina basiakune lisu libliidi, bitayia. Ɔsika ɔdi Katɔti lɛƒɔyɔ ka ute-mii nwuna lɛga kadikɔ.

english_verse: Sell what you have and give the money to the poor. Make yourselves moneybags that never wear out. Make sure your treasure is safe in heaven, where thieves cannot steal it and moths cannot destroy it.
translation_verse: Biti bina lɛlɔ ala biye na bile egulabi ammɔ bite bawabane. Na bɛwia egulabi kɔvumi kɔni na bɛgyi ka kulatɔ bise katɔ bite lɛlɔ. Mmɔ na bina akɛla adubuse kpoo na alaƒana kudii. Ɔsika uyune ɔdi ulakana mmɔ buduo, na kubweyi kɔni muubile ala lɛnɔ kulakana-nya bubile.

english_verse: At that time the Holy Spirit will tell you what to say. A Rich Fool
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti Kɔyu kɔdubɔtina-mii na uwi ɔmmɔ kani lɛlɔ lɛla lɛni na bɛdubo bɔsu.” Ɔlakɛne Ɔdɔlɔdi Ɔdi Lɛlɔ Kɔtɛ

english_verse: But God said to him, “You fool! Tonight you will die. Then who will get what you have stored up?”
translation_verse: “Nsu Katɔti anwu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Awɔ ɔdɔlɔdi! Usien ɔmɛni kani na adubo ƒula ngba bɔda buse. Na ɔma ndubɔdi ala ani na áwia ése éte lɛlɔ mɛni?’ ”

english_verse: If you tell others that you belong to me, the Son of Man will tell God's angels that you are my followers.
translation_verse: “Mɔɔsu-mii nwaa ka ni, ukyuli ɔni masu na kadi anumi ka ɔdi mina ɔdi ni, Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi lɛnɔ ɔdubɔsu lɛni kani na Katɔti batu anumi na nwuna lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But if you reject me, you will be rejected in front of them.
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli ɔni meni-mi na kadi anumi ni, Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi lɛnɔ weni-nwu na Katɔti batu ƒui anumi.

english_verse: When you are brought to trial in the synagogues or before rulers or officials, don't worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say.
translation_verse: “Si bákpanku-mii bésienku Yudaƒuɔ kɔsakɔ iye batɔnkune iye bagadine anumi banii baatɛku-mii litemi ni, ɔƒɛ utada-mii bɛnii bi na bɛdubo bɔsu iye dɛ na bɛdubudie lɛlɔ kenye.

english_verse: A man in a crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, tell my brother to give me my share of what our father left us when he died.”
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ɔkya bekyuli akɔ mmɔ na ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Ala ɔtinane, su mina ɔnwani na ule bula ɔti kadikɔ kani na ɔ́da úse-bu ute-mi.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Who gave me the right to settle arguments between you and your brother?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɔnana, ɔma néte-mi kuƒi ɔnii nle ala iye ntɛ litemi na bina inyɔ ntɛ?”

english_verse: Then he said to the crowd, “Don't be greedy! Owning a lot of things won't make your life safe.”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su bana ƒui ɔnini, “Bɛsia lɛlɔ anu na binye lɛlɔ kagyumana na ɔdivo udu biala bɔdi lɛlɔ, ɔsika ukyuli ngba geen bɔɔɔkɛnku ala ani nse-nwu lɛlɔ ina dɛ na ɔdi ɔlakɛne.”

english_verse: and he said to himself, “What can I do? I don't have a place large enough to store everything.”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ɔ́bla kasusu ɔnii, ‘Ka liiibo kesii kani makya mina edula amɛni ni, bi na ɔlɛka lɛbla?

english_verse: Later, he said, “Now I know what I'll do. I'll tear down my barns and build bigger ones, where I can store all my grain and other goods.
translation_verse: “ ‘Lɛla lɛni ndubɔbla ndi ɔnii ndubugyingya mina edula kakyakɔ kakukudi na lɛbla kawɔdi kani na kébomo kétulo kamɛni. Mmɔ na ndubɔkɛ kesii kani na makya mina edula ƒui.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I tell you not to worry about your life! Don't worry about having something to eat or wear.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Anwuɔsu na mɔɔsu-mii nnii bitekpoku lɛlɔ na lɛla lɛni na bɛdi bilie ngba lɛlɔ iye ɔlɔna adala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Life is more than food or clothing.
translation_verse: Ngba bɔ́ƒɔ kuye butulo adila, na ɔlɔna lɛnɔ ɔ́ƒɔ kuye utulo adala.

english_verse: Look how the wild flowers grow! They don't work hard to make their clothes. But I tell you Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of these flowers.
translation_verse: “Bɛnu kalɛ na anwula ani mɔɔdia bɔnu aalɛ́ lili. Balábla kabla kadi iye beledi adi teete lɛlɔ. Nsu mɔɔsu-mii nnii Ɔga Salomo muedi ku nwuna lɛkɛ ƒui ni, útakɛ adala ani ndia édu anwula amɛni.

english_verse: Don't keep worrying about having something to eat or drink.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bitayia na anumi eteegyie-mii na biteeye bɛnii bi na bɔdubɔdi iye bi na bɔdubɔni.

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father knows what you need.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bani nátaƒɔ Katɔti bátadi ni, ama mɔɔsia ala amɛni anu uwi ndi uwi. Bina Ɔti ɔgyi ka ala amɛni ƒui adi ala ani na bɛɛwia.

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks that the master won't return until late. Suppose that servant starts beating all the other servants and eats and drinks and gets drunk.
translation_verse: Nsu si kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ ɔ́su ɔnii, ‘Mina Unwoti úsela útákya ulu na uwi utu,’ ɔsu na úse kalɔ ɔɔdi na ɔɔní ntɛ teekpi na uubó kabla bablane bakladi bani ndi banana ku beleku ƒui na ɔɔbla-ma kalala ni,

english_verse: Do you think that I came to bring peace to earth? No indeed! I came to make people choose sides.
translation_verse: Bɔkali bɛda bɛnii keyi buɛɛ na líti líboku kayawi? Oowo! Ɔɔɔdi keyi buɛɛ, mmomu lɛlɔ bugyingyaku na bɔdi.

english_verse: Be ready and keep your lamps burning
translation_verse: “Bɛklibi lɛlɔ bise bite lɛla biala mebo, na bɛtu akpagya. Na bina likpo liteni.

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master finds them awake and ready when he comes! I promise you he will get ready and let his servants sit down so he can serve them.
translation_verse: Kabla bablane bammɔ badubɔkɛ ebiti geen si bana Unwoti úbanu-ma ka benye kagyumana bete nwuna bɔsɔ bubo! Mɔɔsu-mii ka ni, ɔdubɔsabla kɔdi lɛlɔ use, na ɔya na belie kalɔ na anwu alati ute-ma adila na badi.

english_verse: Those servants are really fortunate if their master finds them ready, even though he comes late at night or early in the morning.
translation_verse: Na ina usientɛ iye kadi ƒulu ƒulu na webo na wabanu-ma ka benye kagyumana ni, nu ebiti ani udu na wabla-ma!

english_verse: You would surely not let a thief break into your home, if you knew when the thief was coming.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ni, bɛdubɔnu bɛti ka si bɔti na kaduli ɔlati wati uwi ɔni na uyune webeyu-nwu ni, nka ulete-nwu kuƒi na wabwɛ weduo-nwu ɔtɔ.

english_verse: So always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na ɔlɛka amii lɛnɔ binye kagyumana, ɔsika ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ndububo mbeyu-mii lɛtu.” Ɔdi Ka Kabla Ɔblane Ɔbla Ukyuli Ɔni Muunú Litemi

english_verse: Peter asked Jesus, “Did you say this just for us or for everyone?”
translation_verse: Amu na Petro úye Yesu ɔnini, “Blɔti, abu na lɛgba lɛmɛni lɛdanku, munuu ukyuli biala na ada?”

english_verse: The Lord answered: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Kabla ɔblane ɔni náda anu na ɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ ni, anwu na nwuna Unwoti uuti teenyene kabla bablane bakladi kenye. Na anwu ndubute kabla bablane bakladi bana lɛdila kalɛ na ɔ́manku na uwi ɔbuni kemmo.

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master comes and finds them doing their job.
translation_verse: Nu, si kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ ɔ́kana na ɔɔbla ɔmɛni kaduɛ asa na nwuna Unwoti úbo ni, ɔdubɔbla ebiti bonwu geen ute kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ!

english_verse: A servant who is always faithful will surely be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: Geen geen ni, mɔɔsu-mii nnii Unwoti ɔmmɔ ɔdubuti kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ unyene nwuna ala ƒui kenye.

english_verse: If that happens, the master will come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him. That servant will then be punished and thrown out with the servants who cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: nwuna Unwoti ɔdububo ubeyu-nwu ɔtu ɔni na ɔɔɔgyi uuuse. Mmɔ ni, Unwoti ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔni-nwu kɔtu kpakplaa kɔni námanku batuɔkplune bammɔ udu.

english_verse: If servants are not ready or willing to do what their master wants them to do, they will be beaten hard.
translation_verse: “Kabla ɔblane ɔni ngyi lɛla lɛni na nwuna Unwoti ɔɔwia ka nka ɔbla ute-nwu nsu uuní-ni bɔbla ka útada lɛlɔ útese ɔsu ni, bubo na badubo-nwu bubo na ebola eduo-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But servants who don't know what their master wants them to do will not be beaten so hard for doing wrong. If God has been generous with you, he will expect you to serve him well. But if he has been more than generous, he will expect you to serve him even better. Not Peace, but Trouble (Matthew
translation_verse: Nsu kabla ɔblane ɔni naaagyi lɛla lɛni na nwuna Unwoti ɔɔwia ka ɔbla nsu ɔ́bla lɛla lɛni na bani-nwu kɔtu ni, nwuna kɔtu bɔni bɔɔbla blii suɛ. Si ukyuli ɔni na béte-ɔ ala pii ni, lɛni kani na ɔlɛka abla ala pii. Na ukyuli ɔni na béte-ɔ ala pii betulo ni, lɛni kani na ɔlɛka abla kabla pii etulo. Bekyuli Badubule Lɛlɔ Na Yesu Ɔsu

english_verse: I came to set fire to the earth, and I wish it were already on fire!
translation_verse: “Líti Katɔti kɔtu bɔni líboku bekyuli akɔ ɔni nse aani ogya kalɛ. Na mɔɔwia geen ka nka ogya ɔmmɔ úuse kalɔ ɔdaku bɔda.

english_verse: I am going to be put to a hard test. And I will have to suffer a lot of pain until it is over.
translation_verse: Lɛƒɛda bonwu lɛdi lɛdubo-mi lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na ketu keeti ukyuli. Na liiibo bɔnwuna bɔdi úti utédu uwi ɔni na lɛƒɛda lɛmɛni líbo líbavi.

english_verse: A family of five will be divided, with two of them against the other three.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ni, kaduli kani kemmo na nkyuli ɛlɔ bakya ni, badubo lɛlɔ bule. Inyɔ bata benye ɛtɛ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Fathers and sons will turn against one another, and mothers and daughters will do the same. Mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law will also turn against each other. Knowing What To Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Ubi ɔti wata wenye bananabi lɛlɔ, na bananabi bata benye bana ɔti lɛlɔ. Bebi beni badubɔta benye bana belekubi lɛlɔ, na belekubi lɛnɔ bata benye bana beni lɛlɔ. Na begyieni badubɔta benye bana bebi bele lɛlɔ, na bebi bata benye bana begyieni lɛlɔ.” Yesu Úbo Bekyuli Bani Na Ɔ́tɛmiku Ɔda

english_verse: Jesus said to all the people: As soon as you see a cloud coming up in the west, you say, “It's going to rain,” and it does.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su bekyuli bammɔ lɛnɔ ɔnini, “Si bɛ́nu ka úminime lɛlɔ ɔ́si ɔƒɛ kanukɔ na kayaa ni, bɛɛsu kɔnakunwi ka ɔnantu ɔdubo bɔna. Na ɔɔlɛ́ lɛni.

english_verse: When the south wind blows, you say, “It's going to get hot,” and it does.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́nu bɛ́ti ka kada kakɛ ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uukpó ni, bɛɛsu ka liwulu lɛdubo. Na ɔɔlɛ́ lɛni.

english_verse: Are you trying to fool someone? You can predict the weather by looking at the earth and sky, but you don't really know what's going on right now.
translation_verse: Anumi lɛlɔ bekyuli, ka bɛɛnu kalɔ ku kayaa na bɛɛtí uwi taatina ni, bi ɔsu na bilenu uwi ɔmɛni anwu kalɔ? Yesu Ɔ́tina Kalɛ Na Baaklibi Nkyuli Inyɔ Ntɛ

english_verse: Why don't you understand the right thing to do?
translation_verse: “Bi ɔsu na bileduo ala kemmo taanu lɛbuni lɛni na ɔlɛka bɛbla bɛti?

english_verse: When someone accuses you of something, try to settle things before you are taken to court. If you don't, you will be dragged before the judge. Then the judge will hand you over to the jailer, and you will be locked up.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́lɔ-ɔ katɛ na litemi katɛkɔ ka awɔ ku-nwu bɛ́kɛ lɛla lɛdi ni, sia ulu biala lɛlɔ na bɛklibi litemi lɛmmɔ asa na biduo litemi katɛkɔ. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, ɔdubuti-ɔ ute litemi batɛne ku beƒiene na bakya-a ɔtɔ.

english_verse: You won't get out until you have paid the last cent you owe.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔyá-a na ati ka mmɔ na adubo bɔkya wetédu uwi ɔni na áƒɔ ƒula kɔtu bɔni kayu étédu kawɔlɔkɔ.”

english_verse: About this same time Jesus was told that Pilate had given orders for some people from Galilee to be killed while they were offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Lebo lɛmmɔ ni, bekyuli badi bakya mmɔ bani násu Yesu kalɛ na Pilato ɔ́du Galileaƒuɔ badi uwi ɔni na bákya bátaabla akpala teete Katɔti.

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you think that these people were worse sinners than everyone else in Galilee just because of what happened to them?
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye-ma ɔnini, “Bɛɛbu bɛnii ka bádu Galileaƒuɔ bammɔ lɛni ɔsu ni, ama ndi alaekpidi bablane benengudi ntulo Galileaƒuɔ bakladi ƒui?

english_verse: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also be killed.
translation_verse: Oowo, ɔɔɔdi lɛni kudii! Nsu bɔsu nda-mii nnii si bítada bina ala ekpidi bɔbla bítaya ni, lɛni kani na amii lɛnɔ bɛdubo bukpi.

english_verse: Jesus said, “What is God's kingdom like? What can I compare it with?
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye-ma ɔnini, “Bɛgyi kalɛ na Katɔti lɛga bɔdi litemi bugyingya buse? Na bi na ɔlɛka buti-mu bɔmanku?

english_verse: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also die. A Story about a Fig Tree
translation_verse: Oowo, ɔɔɔdi lɛni kudii! Mɔɔsu-mii ka si bítavumana udu ni, lɛni kani na bina ƒui bɛdubo bukpi aani ama kalɛ.” Yesu Úbo Lɛgba Na Kɔdingyii Kɔni Naaanwu Ebi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Jesus then told them this story: A man had a fig tree growing in his vineyard. One day he went out to pick some figs, but he didn't find any.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úbo-ma lɛgba lɛmɛni ɔnini, “Uwi ɔdi kemmo ni, ɔnana ɔdi ɔ́kya ɔni na ubo kɔdingyii kɔdi na nwuna kemmo. Úsie ɔnii utáwia kugyii kɔmɛni ebi, nsu útakɛ adi.

english_verse: The gardener answered, “Master, leave it for another year. I'll dig around it and put some manure on it to make it grow.
translation_verse: “Nsu kemo lɛlɔ ɔnune ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, ‘Ati, nyonu-ku na kɔsɔ kunye lɛkwa linwi pɛ bɔnu. Ndubuku-ku kalɔ na lɛkya-ku ala ani ndubɔya na kalɔ kammɔ kelie lɛmwi na bɔnu.

english_verse: Maybe it will have figs on it next year. If it doesn't, you can have it cut down.” Healing a Woman on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Na si kɔ́kana ebi bonwu ni, ɔdia. Nsu si útakana bɔnwu ni, akana na ada-ku ava kalɔ.’ ” Unyeƒi Ɔbambadi Bɔkya Na Lɛnwunameyi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: One Sabbath, Jesus was teaching in a synagogue,
translation_verse: Na lɛnwunameyi lɛdi lɛlɔ ni, Yesu ɔkya ɔɔtina ala na Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ kadi.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the woman, he called her over and said, “You are now well.”
