translation_verse: Yesu úsie anumi na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɔnana ɔdi ɔ́kya ɔni mbo bebi bananabi inyɔ.

english_verse: Not long after that, the younger son packed up everything he owned and left for a foreign country, where he wasted all his money in wild living.
translation_verse: “Na emeyi alɛɛ adi kama ni, ɔnamudi ɔmmɔ úti nwuna ala ammɔ ƒui úye na úti egulabi ammɔ na ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie ɔlɔgyu kakaaka kesii kani na útélie ngba basa basa na úbile egulabi ammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: He went to work for a man in that country, and the man sent him out to take care of his pigs.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu úti lɛlɔ útése ɔkpa úte ɔnana ɔdi ɔnii utaabla kabla udu biala na wakɛ ute-nwu. Na ɔnana ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ úti-nwu útákya nwuna baplakuo kanyuɛkɔ na nwuna lɛkpaklɔ lɛdi.

english_verse: He would have been glad to eat what the pigs were eating, but no one gave him a thing.
translation_verse: Kɔka ɔsu ni, ɔ́yɔ ka nka ɔkɛ baplakuo adila ani na beete-ma mmɔ adi ɔdi, ɔsika ɔ́nu aani bekyuli lɛnɔ bakana-nya bɔdi, nsu ukyuli ɔdi útete-nwu adi.

english_verse: Finally, he came to his senses and said, “My father's workers have plenty to eat, and here I am, starving to death!
translation_verse: “Kawɔlɔkɔ ni, ɔ́sɔ únwini úbo lɛlɔ kemmo na ɔ́su lɛlɔ ɔnii, ‘Bekyuli bani nése lɛlɔ ɔkpa béte mina ɔti na baabla nwuna kabla ni, baakɛ́ adila taadi na eebú muedi. Na ami nlie mɛni na kɔka kɔdubo-mi bɔdu!

english_verse: I am no longer good enough to be called your son. Treat me like one of your workers.’ ”
translation_verse: Ńsɔ ńtamanku ka alɔ-mi anii ƒula ubi. Mmomu bla-mi aani bekyuli bani néti lɛlɔ bése ɔkpa béte-ɔ akɔ ɔdi.” ’

english_verse: The younger son got up and started back to his father. But when he was still a long way off, his father saw him and felt sorry for him. He ran to his son and hugged and kissed him.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́ta kɔnakunwi na úti ala na ɔ́yu ulu úsela ɔti kudɔ. “Ka ɔti ɔ́nu-nwu ɔ́ti ɔni na ubidi ɔmɛni ɔmu ɔkɛ ɔgyu ɔdubo ni, ubidi lɛlɔ lɛ́bla-nwu kɔnyana, na úkeli útátu ɔda-nwu ku kubiti.

english_verse: The son said, “Father, I have sinned against God in heaven and against you. I am no longer good enough to be called your son.”
translation_verse: “Mmɔ na ubidi ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Ati, lɛ́bla likpidi lɛ́ƒiɔ Katɔti, na lɛ́ƒiɔ awɔ lɛnɔ. Na ńsɔ ńtamanku ka alɔ-mi anii ubi lɛnɔ!’

english_verse: But his father said to the servants, “Hurry and bring the best clothes and put them on him. Give him a ring for his finger and sandals for his feet.
translation_verse: “Nsu ni, ɔti ɔ́kpali nwuna kabla bablane ɔnii, ‘Bɛbabla na biti adala abuni bibakya-nwu. Na biti asɛɛ ku lɛgbanvuo lɛbuni lɛnɔ bɛkya-nwu enu ku lɛgba.

english_verse: Get the best calf and prepare it, so we can eat and celebrate.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama ni, bisie na bitéƒie ebuo ɔni nélie lɛmwi kaduɛ na bɛdu-nwu. Na bɛya na bɔdi limeyi.

english_verse: This son of mine was dead, but has now come back to life. He was lost and has now been found.” And they began to celebrate.
translation_verse: Ɔsika mina ubi ɔmɛni ni, búti-nwu bɔnii úkpi. Nsu ɔ́sɔ únwini úbo ngba. Ɔ́yii na bɔ́sɔ bɔ́nu-nwu.’ Ɔmɛni ɔsu bése kalɔ ku limeyi bɔdi.

english_verse: The older son had been out in the field. But when he came near the house, he heard the music and dancing.
translation_verse: “Amu na uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ƒui ni, ubidi unengudi úsie ɔɔví taanu bana mmo. Ka ɔ́si ɔdubo na ɔ́kpɛ uudé kaduli ni, únu kɔgya ku katɔ kani nda.

english_verse: So he called one of the servants over and asked, “What's going on here?”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́kpali kabla bablane bammɔ akɔ unwi na úye-nwu ɔnini, ‘Bi mɔɔlɛ́ kaduli?’

english_verse: The servant answered, “Your brother has come home safe and sound, and your father ordered us to kill the best calf.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, ‘Ƒ'ɔnwani násɔ únwini úbo ɔma na ƒ'ɔti ɔ́ya na bádu ebuo ɔni nélie lɛmwi, ɔsika ɔ́sɔ únwini úbo úbeduo ɔni na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-nwu.’

english_verse: The older brother got so angry that he would not even go into the house. His father came out and begged him to go in.
translation_verse: “Ɔmɛni ɔ́ya na livo líƒi ɔnwani unengudi ɔmmɔ kaduɛ ɔni na úni ɔnii ɔsɔ uleduo kaduli muedi. Ɔmɛni ɔsu ɔti ɔ́vi ɔlɛ úbo-nwu kudɔ mmɔ, na úbevele-nwu ɔnii ubo ubeduo kaduli.

english_verse: But he said to his father, “For years I have worked for you like a slave and have always obeyed you. But you have never even given me a little goat, so that I could give a dinner for my friends.
translation_verse: Nsu ubidi ɔmmɔ únwini na ɔ́su ɔti kɔnakunwi ɔnii, ‘Bi ɔsu na nnye mɔɔbla kabla akwa pii amɛni kemmo teete-ɔ aani ƒula kabla ɔblane na ńtata ńtenye ƒula ɔda bubo ɔdi lɛlɔ kudii, na étete-mi lɛla lɛdi ina ese muedi étete-mi anii ndi limeyi ku mina bakpana.

english_verse: This other son of yours wasted your money on prostitutes. And now that he has come home, you ordered the best calf to be killed for a feast.”
translation_verse: Nsu ka ƒ'ubidi ɔni nébile ƒula lɛkɛ na ɔkɛ ɔsiaku bayalɛ mɛni ɔ́sɔ únwini úbo ɔma ni, ádu ebuo ɔni nélie lɛmwi éte-nwu!’

english_verse: His father replied, “My son, you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.
translation_verse: “Mmɔ na ɔti ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Mina ubi, awɔ akya-mi kudɔ uwi biala na ala ani na mbo ƒui ni, awɔ adi na adi.

english_verse: But we should be glad and celebrate! Your brother was dead, but he is now alive. He was lost and has now been found.”
translation_verse: Nsu ni, ɔlɛka bɔdi limeyi na bɔkɛ ebiti, ɔsika búti-nwu bɔnii bukpi na ƒ'ɔnwani úkpi na ɔ́sɔ únwini úbo ngba. Bɔyii na ɔ́yii na bɔ́sɔ bɔ́nu-nwu.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: A rich man once had a manager to take care of his business. But he was told that his manager was wasting money.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Dii ni, ɔlakɛne ɔdi ɔ́kya ɔni mbo kabla ɔblane ɔni mɔɔnu-nwu ala lɛlɔ. Amu na bábasu ɔlakɛne ɔmmɔ ka nwuna ala lɛlɔ ɔnune ɔmɛni uubile-nwu egulabi.

english_verse: So the rich man called him in and said, “What is this I hear about you? Tell me what you have done! You are no longer going to work for me.”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ɔlakɛne ɔmmɔ ɔ́lɔ nwuna ala lɛlɔ ɔnune ɔmɛni na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Bi ndi lɛla lɛni udu na línu lɛ́siku-ɔ lɛlɔ mɛni? Bu akunta na kalɛ na éti aanu mina ala lɛlɔ ƒui boku-mi, ɔsika asɔ alakana mina ala lɛlɔ bɔsɔ bɔnu lɛnɔ.’

english_verse: The manager said to himself, “What shall I do now that my master is going to fire me? I can't dig ditches, and I'm ashamed to beg.
translation_verse: “Mmɔ na kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ ɔ́su lɛlɔ ɔnii, ‘Mina Unwoti ɔdubo-mi bɔgya na mina kabla kemmo. Bi na ndubo bɔbla? Liiibo ɔyikun na makana kalɔ bubeyi. Na ala buvele lɛnɔ buukpó-mi kɔƒa.

english_verse: I know what I'll do, so that people will welcome me into their homes after I've lost my job.”
translation_verse: Ɛhɛɛn! Lɛ́ɛti lɛla lɛni mabla! Na si mina kabla kálɛ-mi enu kemmo muedi ni, na mina bakpana baƒɔ-mi na banu-mi lɛlɔ na bana kɔduli.’

english_verse: “A hundred barrels of olive oil,” the man answered. So the manager said, “Take your bill and sit down and quickly write ‘
translation_verse: “Ɔyune ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, ‘Inɔ kutubui bonwu eti anyɔ.’ “Amu na ala lɛlɔ ɔnune ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Aanu ƒula kayu ɔku mɛni. Sɔ lie kalɔ na enweni liti kani ese.’

english_verse: The manager asked someone else who was in debt to his master, “How much do you owe?” “A thousand sacks of wheat,” the man replied. The manager said, “Take your bill and write ‘
translation_verse: “Lɛni kani na úye ɔyune ɔbambadi ɔnii, ‘Awɔ nɔɔ? Ɛlɛ kayu na ada?’ “Ɔyune ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ɔnini, ‘Ɔbla aani antabi aƒo apim unwi.’ “Mmɔ na ala lɛlɔ ɔnune ɔmɛni ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Aanu ƒula kayu ɔku mɛni. Nweni eti leevu-maane se.’

english_verse: The master praised his dishonest manager for looking out for himself so well. That's how it is! The people of this world look out for themselves better than the people who belong to the light.
translation_verse: “Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, Unwoti ɔmmɔ úmwi kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ na lɛkwɛ lɛni na ɔ́bla mmɔ ɔsu. Sɔsɔ ni, bekyuli bani nli nte kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ ala ni, baasia anu taabla bana lɛlɔ ala teetulo ama bani mɔɔsia Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ anu.”

english_verse: My disciples, I tell you to use wicked wealth to make friends for yourselves. Then when it is gone, you will be welcomed into an eternal home.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu úsie anumi na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Biti bina kayawi lɛlakɛ bibunku bekyuli. Na si lɛkɛ lɛmmɔ lɛ́sa ni, na Katɔti waƒɔ-mii wakya nwuna ɔma kemmo.

english_verse: So Abraham said, “If they won't pay attention to Moses and the prophets, they won't listen even to someone who comes back from the dead.”
translation_verse: “Nsu Abraham ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Si bétenu Mose ku Katɔti kenye bediene litemi ni, si ina ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́ta ɔ́si kekpine mɛni úsie-ma kudɔ muedi ni, baláƒɔ-nwu litemi!’ ”

english_verse: The Pharisees really loved money. So when they heard what Jesus said, they made fun of him.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Ƒarisiƒuɔ bénu ala ani na Yesu ɔ́su ni, báma-nwu ɔsika baayɔ́ egulabi geen.

english_verse: But Jesus told them: You are always making yourselves look good, but God sees what is in your heart. The things that most people think are important are worthless as far as God is concerned.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Amii ndi bekyuli bani mɔɔtina lɛlɔ aani bekyuli babuni na bakladi anumi. Nsu Katɔti ɔgyi bina ƒui kayi kemmo. Ɔsika ala ani náƒɔ kuye na bekyuli anumi ni, aaadi lɛla lɛdi na Katɔti anumi.

english_verse: Until the time of John the Baptist, people had to obey the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets. But since God's kingdom has been preached, everyone is trying hard to get in.
translation_verse: “Mose ɔda bubo ɔku ku Katɔti kenye bediene ala ani na bénweni bése ni, ábla kabla ábawɔ Ntu Ɔkpilane Yohane lebo. Na ɔ́si uwi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, biinú ka baasu litemi buni lɛni nkɛnku Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli biala ɔɔnwanɛ lɛlɔ ka ɔkɛ nwuna ulu uduo Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will disappear before the smallest letter of the Law does.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, use kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ka katɔ ku kayawi kakana na kavi utulo ɔni na bada ɔda bubo bɔmɛni litemi blii suɛ lɛdi muedi bedie.

english_verse: It is a terrible sin for a man to divorce his wife and marry another woman. It is also a terrible sin for a man to marry a divorced woman. Lazarus and the Rich Man
translation_verse: “Ɔnana biala ɔni manyonu ulekudi na weti ɔbambadi ni, ɔ́di kɔsɔnɔ. Na ɔnana ɔni meti uleku ɔni na bányonu mmɔ ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́di kɔsɔnɔ. Yesu Ɔ́su Ɔlakɛne Ɔdi Ku Lasaro Lɛlɔ Kɔtɛ

english_verse: There was once a rich man who wore expensive clothes and every day ate the best food.
translation_verse: “Dii ni, ɔnana ɔlakɛne ɔdi ɔkya ɔni mɔɔda adala ani náƒɔ kuye, na ebiti kemmo sɔɔn na ɔ́kya nwuna ngba emeyi kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: But a poor beggar named Lazarus was brought to the gate of the rich man's house.
translation_verse: Na ɔwabane ɔdi na baalɔ banii Lasaro lɛnɔ ɔ́kya. Alɛbi áƒɔ ɔwabane ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ƒui ɔni na béteeti-nwu taabava ɔlakɛne ɔmmɔ ɔtɔ kayakun.

english_verse: He was happy just to eat the scraps that fell from the rich man's table. His body was covered with sores, and dogs kept coming up to lick them.
translation_verse: Ubo lɛnunsia ka si ɔlakɛne ɔmmɔ ɔɔdi ni, kɔkɛ wɛlɛ wɛlɛ kɔni muuwi kalɔ kɔdubudu-nwu na ɔ́la ɔdi. Bakpɛwe muedi beebo taabayalɛ-nwu alɛbi ammɔ.

english_verse: The poor man died, and angels took him to the place of honor next to Abraham. The rich man also died and was buried.
translation_verse: “Ɔwabane ɔmmɔ úbekpi na Katɔti batu bébetiku-nwu bétésie Abraham kudɔ, na baadi limeyi na katɔ. Ɔlakɛne ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ úbekpi na báva-nwu.

english_verse: He went to hell and was suffering terribly. When he looked up and saw Abraham far off and Lazarus at his side,
translation_verse: Na kekpine mmɔ ni, ɔ́nu ka ɔkya abi kebokɔ. Mmɔ ka ɔ́talaku anumi katɔ ni, ɔ́nu Abraham na katɔ kakaaka ka Lasaro ulie-nwu kudɔ.

english_verse: he said to Abraham, “Have pity on me! Send Lazarus to dip his finger in water and touch my tongue. I'm suffering terribly in this fire.”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́kpali ɔnii, ‘Ati Abraham! Nu-mi kɔnyana na aya na Lasaro uti lɛnimi ɔkya ntu bɔdi kemmo na udu ubo-mi unyemi lɛlɔ na lɛlɔ lɛbla-mi buɛɛ. Ɔsika lɛlɔ lɛɛkywí-mi na ogya ɔmɛni kemmo!’

english_verse: Abraham answered, “My friend, remember that while you lived, you had everything good, and Lazarus had everything bad. Now he is happy, and you are in pain.
translation_verse: “Nsu Abraham ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Ubi, nyimo ka na ƒula ngba bɔni na élie kemmo ni, ala abuni sɔɔn na áƒɔ. Na Lasaro anwu ni, ala ekpidi sɔɔn na ɔ́ƒɔ. Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, ɔɔkɛ́ ebiti na awɔ eebó abi.

english_verse: But the rich man said, “Abraham, then please send Lazarus to my father's home.
translation_verse: “Mmɔ ni, ɔlakɛne ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Ati Abraham, buvele nda-a nnii tala Lasaro na usie mina ɔti kesii.

english_verse: Let him warn my five brothers, so they won't come to this horrible place.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, mbo banwani bananabi ɛlɔ. Ya na utébo-ma ɔda kaduɛ kalɛ na ama belebo likpo lɛni na lɛbibo lɛkya mɛni.’

english_verse: Abraham answered, “Your brothers can read what Moses and the prophets wrote. They should pay attention to that.”
translation_verse: “Amu na Abraham ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Ƒula banwani bebo ala ani na Mose ku Katɔti kenye bediene bénweni bése. Na ɔdi ka benu na badi-nya lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: Then the rich man said, “No, that's not enough! If only someone from the dead would go to them, they would listen and turn to God.”
translation_verse: “Mmɔ na ɔlakɛne ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, ‘Ati Abraham, belénu-ma litemi! Nsu si banii ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́si kekpine mɛni úsie-ma kudɔ ni, badubunu-nwu litemi na benwini kama bakya bana ekpidi.’

english_verse: Why was this foreigner the only one who came back to thank God?”
translation_verse: Dɛ na ɔ́bla asa na ukyuli ɔni naaadi Yudani ɔmɛni kani násɔ únwini úbo ɔnii ubagya Katɔti enu?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If you had faith no bigger than a tiny mustard seed, you could tell this mulberry tree to pull itself up, roots and all, and to plant itself in the ocean. And it would!
translation_verse: Amu na Blɔti ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Si bibo bɔƒɔtaadi na búdu aani lɛla lɛdi kebi kani nse blii suɛ ntulo ƒui ni, nka bɛdubɔkana na bɛsu kugyii kɔmɛni bɛnii, ‘Gyu likpo lɛmɛni na etéduo ɛpu kemmo ngye.’ Na kɔdubɔbla lɛni kani. Yesu Ɔ́su Kalɛ Na Kabla Ɔblane Ɔbuni Ɔɔbla Kabla

english_verse: If your servant comes in from plowing or from taking care of the sheep, would you say, “Welcome! Come on in and have something to eat”?
translation_verse: “Bɛbu ɔmɛni bɛnu. Si bina ɔdi ubo kabla ɔblane ɔni mɔɔtuma kemmo teete-nwu iye ɔɔnu-ɔ baƒonu lɛlɔ na ɔ́si kemmo úbeduo ni, bɔsu na adubɔsu-nwu anii ɔbabla na utélie kalɔ utaadi nwuna adila?

english_verse: There is no use saying, ‘Look! Here it is’ or ‘Look! There it is.’ God's kingdom is here with you.”
translation_verse: Ɔdi ulasu ɔnii, ‘Bɛnu! Aanu-ka mɛni,’ iye ‘Aanu-ka ngye’. Ɔsika Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ kakya bina akɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: The time will come when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ɔni na bɛdubɔwia bɛnii bɛɛnu limeyi lɛni na ami, Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi, mebo. Nsu bilanu!

english_verse: Servants don't deserve special thanks for doing what they are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Útalɛka agya-nwu enu ka ɔ́bla nwuna kabla ɔblane kabla ɔsu.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: There will always be something that causes people to sin. But anyone who causes them to sin is in for trouble. A person who causes even one of my little followers to sin
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Ala ani mɔɔyá na ukyuli ɔɔbla likpidi ni, adubo bɔkya. Nsu bɔbuɛ muute ukyuli ɔni lɛlɔ na ala amɛni adubɔsia asa na eduo bekyuli akɔ!

english_verse: would be better off thrown into the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their neck.
translation_verse: Si béti kukɔ bonwu kɔdi báƒala-nwu ɔkwɛ na bányina-nwu bákya ɛpu kemmo muedi ni, ɔdia-nwu utulo kɔtu kɔni na Katɔti ɔdubɔni anwu ɔni maya na likpidi lɛsia-nwu lɛlɔ liduo mina banamu akɔ.

english_verse: So be careful what you do. Correct any followers of mine who sin, and forgive the ones who say they are sorry.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛsia ala ani na bɛɛbla anu. “Na si ƒula ɔkpana ɔ́bla-a likpidi lɛdi ni, dɔnku-nwu. Na si úkpi kɔtɔ ni, na eti akyiɛ-nwu.

english_verse: Even if one of them mistreats you seven times in one day and says, “I am sorry,” you should still forgive that person.
translation_verse: Si ɔ́bla lɛla lɛdi ɔ́ƒiɔ-ɔ maatɛ na limeyi linwi kemmo na ɔ́sɔ únwini úbo ubekpi-ɔ kɔtɔ maatɛ ɔmmɔ ni, ti kyiɛ-nwu.” Bévele Yesu Bɔƒɔtaadi Ɔyikun Bébu

english_verse: The apostles said to the Lord, “Make our faith stronger!”
translation_verse: Yesu batalane bévele Yesu banii, “Blɔti, ya na bula bɔƒɔtaadi bumomo bubu.”

english_verse: No, you wouldn't say that. You would say, “Prepare me something to eat. Get ready to serve me, so I can have my meal. Then later on you can eat and drink.”
translation_verse: Oowo! Mmomu adubɔsu-nwu anii, ‘Klibi lɛlɔ na asabla kɔdi, na anwa, na eti mina adila ese-mi na lɛdi lɛwɔlɔ asa na awɔ lɛnɔ adi.’

english_verse: And that's how it should be with you. When you've done all you should, then say, “We are merely servants, and we have simply done our duty.” Ten Men with Leprosy
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na use ute amii lɛnɔ. Si bɛ́bla ala ani ƒui na lɛ́su-mii nnii bɛbla ni, bɛsu bɛnii, ‘Kabla bablane kani na bɔdi. Na bɔ́bla lɛla lɛni kani na ɔdi ka bɔbla.’ ” Yesu Ɔ́bwi Banana Leevu Badi

english_verse: On his way to Jerusalem, Jesus went along the border between Samaria and Galilee.
translation_verse: Amu ka Yesu ɔkɛ úsela Yerusalem ni, ɔ́vi Samaria ku Galilea ɔmii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: As he was going into a village, ten men with leprosy came toward him. They stood at a distance
translation_verse: Na ka ɔdaku lɛkpaklɔ lɛdi buduo ni, banana leevu badi na beeƒi ɔlɛgyie bábasiaku-nwu. Balɛne bamɛni bénye ɔgyu.

english_verse: and shouted, “Jesus, Master, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Na báva ku lɛdi momoomo banii, “Ati Yesu, nu-bu kɔnyana!”

english_verse: Jesus looked at them and said, “Go show yourselves to the priests.” On their way they were healed.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́nu-ma na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Biteesie na biti bina lɛlɔ bitátina Katɔti bakpane na banu-mii kaduɛ.” Ka bakɛ bésela ni, bánu báti ka bana ɔlɛ ɔ́ba-ma.

english_verse: When one of them discovered that he was healed, he came back, shouting praises to God.
translation_verse: Nsu ka bana unwi ɔ́nu ɔ́ti ka nwuna ɔlɛ ɔ́ba-nwu ni, ɔ́sɔ únwini na uumwi Katɔti ku lɛdi momoomo.

english_verse: He bowed down at the feet of Jesus and thanked him. The man was from the country of Samaria.
translation_verse: Na úbo úbalɛ akɔnkɔ na Yesu anumi na ɔ́gya-nwu enu. Na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔdi Samariani.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “Weren't ten men healed? Where are the other nine?
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu úye ɔnini, “Ɔɔɔdi banana leevu na lɛ́bwi yoo? Wɛ na yaalenwi bakladi básia?

english_verse: Then Jesus told the man, “You may get up and go. Your faith has made you well.” God's Kingdom (Matthew
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ta nye, na eteesie. Ƒula bɔƒɔtaadi náya na ƒula ɔlɛ ɔ́ba-a.” Yesu Ɔ́su Kalɛ Na Katɔti Lɛga Kadikɔ Kadubo

english_verse: The day of the Son of Man will be like lightning flashing across the sky.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kalɛ na kayaa kaabwɛ ogya taasi ɔƒɛnyi unwi teesie ɔkladi ni, lɛni geen na Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdubo buse.

english_verse: When people say to you, “Look there,” or “Look here,” don't go looking for him.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badi badubo-mii akɔ bɔkya bani ndubɔsu-mii banii, ‘Bɛnu-nwu ngye,’ iye ‘Bɛnu-nwu mɛni!’ Nsu bitesie bitatáwia-mi mmɔ!

english_verse: When Lot lived, people were also eating and drinking. They were buying, selling, planting, and building.
translation_verse: “Lɛni na ɔdubo buse aani kalɛ na úse na Lot uwi lɛnɔ. Bekyuli baadi na baaní, na baadi kuye lɛnɔ. Badi benye baakya edula, na badi benye baatú lɛtɔ.

english_verse: Then Jesus' disciples spoke up, “But where will this happen, Lord?” Jesus said, “Where there is a corpse, there will always be vultures.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na batɛyane bammɔ béye Yesu banini, “Blɔti, na wɛ?” Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Kesii kani na lɛla líkpi lɛ́tɛ ni, mmɔ na begbini baasa.”

english_verse: Some Pharisees asked Jesus when God's kingdom would come. He answered, “God's kingdom isn't something you can see.
translation_verse: Amu na Ƒarisiƒuɔ badi béye Yesu banii baawia bati uwi ɔni geen na Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ kadububo. Mmɔ na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ kelebo na ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na bekyuli bakana-ka bɔnu.

english_verse: But first he must suffer terribly and be rejected by the people of today.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, ɔlɛka lɛka abi bubo geen na ɔmwi limeyi bekyuli beni-mi.

english_verse: When the Son of Man comes, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.
translation_verse: “Ala ani nálɛ na Noa uwi ni, anya kani ndubo bɔlɛ na uwi ɔni na ami, Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi, masɔ mebo.

english_verse: People were eating, drinking, and getting married right up to the day when Noah went into the big boat. Then the flood came and drowned everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Bekyuli baadi na baaní. Na banana ku beleku beeti lɛlɔ úti útédu limeyi lɛni lɛlɔ na Noa úduo ɔkɔlɔ ubendi ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na ɔnantu ɔ́na na ntukpa búyi bɔ́ƒɔ kalɔ ƒui na ɔ́du bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: But on the very day Lot left Sodom, fiery flames poured down from the sky and killed everyone.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛni na Lot ɔ́vi ɔ́lɛ Sodom ni, ogya ku agyabi ani muunwenyi ku ɔnyi gbagbangba ási katɔ ébewi ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo na ɔ́kyula-ma ƒui.

english_verse: The same will happen on the day when the Son of Man appears.
translation_verse: “Lɛni kani na ɔdubo buse na limeyi lɛni lɛlɔ na ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ndubɔda lɛlɛ.

english_verse: At that time no one on a rooftop should go down into the house to get anything. No one in a field should go back to the house for anything.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ukyuli ɔni nnye nwuna ɔtɔ lɛsa ni, ɔsɔ utayu ɔnii utéduo ɔtɔ kemmo uti nwuna ala adi. Lɛni kani si kemmo na ɔdi ɔkya ni, ɔsɔ utasu ɔnii uunwíni usie kaduli.

english_verse: Remember what happened to Lot's wife.
translation_verse: Binyimo lɛla lɛni nálɛku Lot ulekudi!

english_verse: People who try to save their lives will lose them, and those who lose their lives will save them.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔwia ka ɔƒɔ nwuna lili ngba ute lɛlɔ ni, ɔdubɔyila-mu. Na ukyuli biala ɔni nányonu nwuna ngba ni, ɔdubɔsɔ ɔkɛ-mu.

english_verse: On that night two people will be sleeping in the same bed, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Na usien ɔmmɔ ni, nkyuli inyɔ badubɔtɛ lɛtala linwi lɛlɔ, na Katɔti ɔdubuti unwi na ɔda ɔkladi ɔva.

english_verse: Two women will be together grinding wheat, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Banana inyɔ badubunye bataatuma na ɔkpanku unwi ɔtɔlɔku na ɔnyonu ɔkladi unyene.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples a story about how they should keep on praying and never give up:
translation_verse: Yesu úbo nwuna batɛyane lɛgba lɛdi ɔ́tina-ma ɔnii ɔlɛka bataakpali katɔ uwi biala na ɔɔɔdi ka enu aƒɛ-ma.

english_verse: In a town there was once a judge who didn't fear God or care about people.
translation_verse: Ɔ́su ɔnini, “Litemi ɔtɛne ɔdi ɔ́kya ɔma ɔdi kemmo ɔni na uláyia Katɔti na uláƒalɛ ukyuli lɛnɔ.

english_verse: In that same town there was a widow who kept going to the judge and saying, “Make sure that I get fair treatment in court.”
translation_verse: Na ɔma ɔmmɔ kani kemmo ni, ukpinele ɔdi ɔ́kya ɔni muusié teebo-nwu kudɔ teebevele-nwu ɔnii, ‘Bunku-mi na mina ukisine ɔsu.’

english_verse: For a while the judge refused to do anything. Finally, he said to himself, “Even though I don't fear God or care about people,
translation_verse: “Ɔbla uwi pii ni, litemi ɔtɛne ɔmmɔ úni na útabla lɛla lɛdi na litemi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Nsu kawɔlɔkɔ ni, ɔ́su nwuna lɛlɔ ɔnini, ‘Ina ka naaayia Katɔti na naaaƒalɛ ukyuli ni,

english_verse: I will help this widow because she keeps on bothering me. If I don't help her, she will wear me out.”
translation_verse: na lɛƒɛda lɛni na ukpinele ɔmɛni uute-mi ɔsu ni, ndubɔnu ka líkpo nwuna ukisine líte-nwu. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, ulada bubo uláya na ulete-mi bɔnwuna.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said: Think about what that crooked judge said.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Blɔti úsie anumi na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Binu lɛla lɛni na litemi ɔtɛne ukpidi ɔmmɔ ɔ́su.

english_verse: Won't God protect his chosen ones who pray to him day and night? Won't he be concerned for them?
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, bɔtɛ na Katɔti ulatɛ litemi uledie nwuna bekyuli bani muuwulo taakpali-nwu usien ku ɔƒɛ banii ubunku-ma? Munuu bɛɛkali bɛnii ɔdubɔkpɛ kama ku bana bɔƒɔ?

english_verse: He will surely hurry and help them. But when the Son of Man comes, will he find on this earth anyone with faith? A Pharisee and a Tax Collector
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii geen nnii Katɔti ɔdubɔtɛ litemi na ute-ma ubo kɔnakunwi. Nsu ni, si Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi úbo ni, ɔdubɔnu bekyuli bani mbo bɔƒɔtaadi?” Yesu Úbo Ƒarisini Ɔdi Ku Kuyi Ɔƒɔne Ɔdi Lɛlɔ Lɛgba

english_verse: Jesus told a story to some people who thought they were better than others and who looked down on everyone else:
translation_verse: Yesu úbo lɛgba lɛmɛni úte bekyuli bani mɔɔkali banii ama bana udu kani ndia na basɔ balánu ukyuli bamba ɔdi aani bana kalɛ.

english_verse: The Pharisee stood over by himself and prayed, “God, I thank you that I am not greedy, dishonest, and unfaithful in marriage like other people. And I am really glad that I am not like that tax collector over there.
translation_verse: Ƒarisini ɔmmɔ ɔ́ta anwu lɛti na útákpali katɔ ɔnini, ‘Katɔti mɔɔgyá-a enu, ɔsika liiibo egulabi lɛnungyie, na liiibo likyulikpi, na naaadi kɔsɔnɔ aani bekyuli bakladi kalɛ. Na mɔɔgyá-a enu lɛnɔ, ɔsika liiise aani kuyi ɔƒɔne ɔni ngye lɛnɔ kalɛ.

english_verse: I go without eating for two days a week, and I give you one tenth of all I earn.”
translation_verse: Muulie kɔka emeyi anyɔ na Kwasida unwi kemmo. Na muuti mina lɛkɛ lɛkpa leevudi teeboku-ɔ.’

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “When the two men went home, it was the tax collector and not the Pharisee who was pleasing to God. If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Matthew
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-mii nnii ka básɔ bénwini bésie kaduli ni, kuyi ɔƒɔne ɔmmɔ ɔ́bla sɛɛn na Katɔti anumi na ɔɔɔdi Ƒarisini ɔmmɔ. Ɔsika ukyuli biala ɔni na ɔ́bla nwuna lɛlɔ ukyuli ubendi ni, Katɔti ɔdububoku-nwu kalɔ. Na ukyuli biala ɔni na weboku lɛlɔ kalɔ ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔkɔliku-nwu katɔ.” Yesu Ɔɔyɔ́ Banamu Litemi Geen

english_verse: Some people brought their little children for Jesus to bless. But when his disciples saw them doing this, they told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badi béti bana bebi béboku Yesu banii uti nwuna enu ɔsia-ma eli. Ka Yesu batalane bánu ɔmɛni ni, bádɔnku bekyuli bammɔ na ɔmmɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: will be given much more in this life. And in the future world they will have eternal life.” Jesus Again Tells about His Death (Matthew
translation_verse: ɔdubɔkɛ ala ammɔ udu ɔsia kama na ngba bɔmɛni kemmo ku ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii na uwi ɔni mebo lɛnɔ kemmo.” Yesu Ɔ́sɔ Ɔ́su Nwuna Kukpi Lɛlɔ Litemi

english_verse: Jesus took the twelve apostles aside and said: We are now on our way to Jerusalem. Everything that the prophets wrote about the Son of Man will happen there.
translation_verse: Yesu útiku batɛyane leevu-inyɔ bammɔ úsienku kɔmadɔ na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Binu! Búsela Yerusalem, kesii kani na ala ani na Katɔti kenye bediene bénweni básiku ami, Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi, lɛlɔ adububo ete lɛni.

english_verse: An important man asked Jesus, “Good Teacher, what must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Yudani ɔtɔnkune ɔdi úye Yesu ɔnini, “Ala ɔtinane buni, bi na ɔlɛka lɛbla asa na lɛkɛ ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii?”

english_verse: He told Jesus, “I have obeyed all these commandments since I was a young man.”
translation_verse: Amu na ukyuli ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɔ́si mina lɛnamu uwi ƒui ni, mɔɔdi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ kaduɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he said, “There is one thing you still need to do. Go and sell everything you own! Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come and be my follower.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu únu-nwu litemi lɛmmɔ ni, ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Lɛla linwi lɛ́sɔ líbu-ɔ na abla. Ti ala ani nse-ɔ ƒui ye, na eti egulabi ammɔ ete bawabane. Ɔmɛni ndubɔya-a na akɛ akɛla ese ete lɛlɔ na katɔ. Ɔmmɔ kama na ebo abasiaku-mi.”

english_verse: When the man heard this, he was sad, because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔni na ɔnana ɔmmɔ únu lɛla lɛmɛni ni, lɛlɔ lɛ́yuɛ-nwu ɔsika ubo lɛlakɛ geen.

english_verse: Jesus saw how sad the man was. So he said, “It's terribly hard for rich people to get into God's kingdom!
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́nu kalɛ na lɛlɔ lɛ́yuɛ-nwu na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ubo ɔlakɛne ɔkplu asa na weduo Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ!

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na ɔlakɛne uduo Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ ni, ubo ɔkplu utulo kalɛ na ebuo ɔni nébomo utulo ƒui ɔvili udila liƒi.”

english_verse: When the crowd heard this, they asked, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bekyuli bani nénu lɛla lɛmɛni béye Yesu banii, “Na ɔma geen ndubɔkɛ bɔƒɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “There are some things that people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Lɛla lɛni na ukyuli ulakana bɔbla kudii ni, lise Katɔti anwu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ka ɔbla-ni.”

english_verse: Peter said, “Remember, we left everything to be your followers!”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Petro ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Nu, abu bɔ́da bula kɔduli ala ƒui búwi na búbo bɔsiaku-ɔ.”

english_verse: He will be handed over to foreigners, who will make fun of him, mistreat him, and spit on him.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badubuti-mi bakya bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ enu kemmo na beti-mi babla lɛmala. Badubo-mi budumi na betuo lisuo bewi-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They will beat him and kill him, but three days later he will rise to life.
translation_verse: Badubo-mi bubo na badu-mi. Nsu na emeyi atɛ kama ni, ndubɔsɔ lɛta lɛsi bekpine akɔ.”

english_verse: When Jesus was coming close to Jericho, a blind man sat begging beside the road.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ɔ́kpɛ úde Yeriko ni, ɔnumbwɛne ɔdi ulie ulu kɔtu mmɔ uuvele ala.

english_verse: The man heard the crowd walking by and asked what was happening.
translation_verse: Ka únu bekyuli pii bani mɔɔví kɔku ni, úye ɔnii, “Bi na ɔdi mɔɔlɛ́?”

english_verse: Some people told him that Jesus from Nazareth was passing by.
translation_verse: Amu na básu-nwu banii, “Yesu Nasareni nási ɔɔví.”

english_verse: So the blind man shouted, “Jesus, Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́va momoomo ɔnii, “Yesu, Ɔga Dawid Uwɔ! Nu-mi kɔnyana!”

english_verse: The people who were going along with Jesus told the man to be quiet. But he shouted even louder, “Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli bani ntɔ lɛtɔtɔ bádɔnku-nwu banii ɔba ku lɛsɛ. Nsu ɔƒɛni geen na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́talaku lɛdi katɔ úbu ɔnii, “Dawid Uwɔ, nu-mi kɔnyana!”

english_verse: Jesus stopped and told some people to bring the blind man over to him. When the blind man was getting near, Jesus asked,
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Yesu údi únye na ɔ́su ɔnii bakpanku ɔnumbwɛne ɔmmɔ beboku-nwu kudɔ. Ka úbedu-nwu kudɔ ni, Yesu úye-nwu ɔnini,

english_verse: “What do you want me to do for you?” “Lord, I want to see!” he answered.
translation_verse: “Bi na aawia-mi anii mbla nte-ɔ?” Ɔnumbwɛne ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Ati, mɔɔyɔ́ ka lɛsɔ ntaanu.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Look and you will see! Your eyes are healed because of your faith.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Amu sɔ taanu! Ƒula bɔƒɔtaadi bɔ́bwi-ɔ.”

english_verse: At once the man could see, and he went with Jesus and started thanking God. When the crowds saw what happened, they praised God.
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, ɔ́sɔ ɔ́kana na ɔɔnu na ɔ́siaku Yesu na ɔkɛ uumwi Katɔti. Na ka bekyuli pii bammɔ bánu ɔmɛni ni, bana ƒui bémwi Katɔti.

english_verse: Jesus was heading his way, and Zacchaeus wanted to see what he was like. But Zacchaeus was a short man and could not see over the crowd. So he ran ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu úkeli ɔtɔ bekyuli bammɔ lɛtɔtɔ na útákɔ kugyii kɔni nákuku kalɛ na ɔnu Yesu, ɔsika ɔgyi ɔnii ɔdubo ubasia mmɔ.

english_verse: When Jesus got there, he looked up and said, “Zacchaeus, hurry down! I want to stay with you today.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu úbedu kugyii kɔmmɔ kalɔ ni, údi únye na ɔ́kɔliku anumi katɔ na ɔ́su Sakeo ɔnini, “Sakeo, babla na ayu ebo kalɔ, ɔsika ƒula kudɔ na ndubo buduo ɔmwi.”

english_verse: Zacchaeus hurried down and gladly welcomed Jesus.
translation_verse: Sakeo ɔ́babla ɔ́yu úbo kalɔ na úte Yesu eduo ku ebiti geen.

english_verse: Everyone who saw this started grumbling, “This man Zacchaeus is a sinner! And Jesus is going home to eat with him.”
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ ƒui bése kalɔ beetemi na Yesu lɛlɔ kalɔ kalɔ banii, “Ɔnana ɔmɛni úsela utéduo ukyuli ɔni ndi alaekpidi ɔblane ɔmɛni kudɔ.”

english_verse: Later that day Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, “I will give half of my property to the poor. And I will now pay back four times as much to everyone I have ever cheated.”
translation_verse: Amu na Sakeo ɔ́ta únye na ɔ́su Blɔti ɔnini, “Ati! Buvele, nu! Ndubuti mina lɛkɛ kakɛ kenwi ƒui lite bawabane. Na bekyuli bani ƒui na líti lɛnungyie kemmo lɛ́ƒɔ-ma ala litulo kalɛ na ɔdi ka lɛƒɔ ni, ndubɔƒɔ-ma kayu kammɔ akpa ene.”

english_verse: Jesus said to Zacchaeus, “Today you and your family have been saved, because you are a true son of Abraham.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ɔmwi ni, ngba bɔƒɔ búbo búbedu kaduli kamɛni kemmo. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔmɛni lɛnɔ ɔdi Abraham kaba kemmo ubi.

english_verse: The Son of Man came to look for and to save people who are lost.” A Story about Ten Servants (Matthew
translation_verse: Na ami, Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi, líbo nnii mbedie bekyuli bani ƒui náyii ulu geen ɔmmɔ.” Yesu Úbo Sika Ugyiedi Lɛlɔ Lɛgba

english_verse: But they said, “Sir, he already has ten times as much!”
translation_verse: “Nsu bekyuli bammɔ básu-nwu banini, ‘Ati, kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ anwu ubo egulabi aƒo leevu use!’

english_verse: But the people of his country hated him, and they sent messengers to the foreign country to say, “We don't want this man to be our king.”
translation_verse: “Nsu ɔnana ɔmɛni ɔma bekyuli béteekisi-nwu, anwuɔsu bátala batu badi na básia-nwu kama banii batásu Ɔga Unengudi banii, ‘Bulayɔ ka ɔnana ɔmɛni unwini-bu ɔga.’

english_verse: He told them, “Go into the next village, where you will find a young donkey that has never been ridden. Untie the donkey and bring it here.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Biteesie ɔma ɔni nkya-mii lɛtɔtɔ mmɔ kemmo. Na si biiduo-nwu kemmo ni, bɛdubɔnu ebuo ala utine ubi ɔdi ka bébo-nwu báda mmɔ. Na ukyuli ɔdi útelie-nwu lɛlɔ kudii. Bɛƒɛnimi-nwu na biti-nwu biboku mɛni.

english_verse: The first servant came and said, “Sir, with the money you gave me I have earned ten times as much.”
translation_verse: “Kabla ɔblane udeedi úbo na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Ati, lɛ́kɛ egulabi aƒo leevu lɛ́sia unwi ɔni na éte-mi mmɔ lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: The second one came and said, “Sir, with the money you gave me, I have earned five times as much.”
translation_verse: “Kabla ɔblane unyɔdi lɛnɔ úbo na úbasu-nwu ɔnini, ‘Ati, lɛ́kɛ egulabi aƒo alɔ lɛ́sia unwi ɔni néte-mi lɛlɔ!’

english_verse: Another servant came and said, “Sir, here is your money. I kept it safe in a handkerchief.
translation_verse: “Kabla ɔblane ɔbambadi úbo na anwu ɔnini, ‘Ati, aanu ƒula egulabi koƒo kunwi kɔni néte-mi. Líti-ku lɛ́bɛla na mina lɛdiku kemmo.

english_verse: Why didn't you put my money in the bank? On my return, I could have had the money together with interest.”
translation_verse: Na si agyi lɛni ni, bi ɔsu na éteti mina egulabi átatákya egulabi kesekɔ? Mmɔ ni, ngyi ka nka ndubɔkɛ kɔsia lɛsia-nwu lɛlɔ si lɛ́si líbo.’

english_verse: Then he said to some other servants standing there, “Take the money away from him and give it to the servant who earned ten times as much.”
translation_verse: “Amu na ɔ́su bekyuli bani nnye mmɔ ɔnii, ‘Bɛda egulabi ammɔ bɛƒɔ-nwu kudɔ bite kabla ɔblane ɔni mbo egulabi aƒo leevu.’

english_verse: The king replied, “Those who have something will be given more. But everything will be taken away from those who don't have anything.
translation_verse: “Amu na Unwoti ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, ‘Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ni, ukyuli ɔni mbo lɛla lɛdi ni, anwu na Katɔti ɔdubute ɔsia. Na ukyuli ɔni neeebo lɛla lɛdi ni, libliidi lɛni na úbo muedi ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ-ni na nwuna kudɔ.

english_verse: Now bring me the enemies who didn't want me to be their king. Kill them while I watch!” Jesus Enters Jerusalem (Matthew
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, mina bekisine bani na banii nka baláwia ka bese-mi lɛga ni, bɛkpanku-ma biboku mɛni na bɛdu-ma na mina anumi.’ ” Yesu Úduo Yerusalem

english_verse: When Jesus had finished saying all this, he went on toward Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́su-ma ala amɛni ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔ́gyu ɔ́tɔ-ma Yerusalem.

english_verse: As he was getting near Bethphage and Bethany on the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples on ahead.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ɔ́kpɛ uudé Betƒage ku Betania na Inɔ Egyii Kɔbi kudɔ ni, ɔ́tala nwuna batɛyane inyɔ ɔnii bataatɔ.

english_verse: If anyone asks why you are doing this, just say, ‘The Lord needs it.’ ”
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔdi úye-mii lɛla lɛni ɔsu na bɛɛƒɛnimi-nwu ni, bɛsu-nwu bɛnii, ‘Blɔti mɔɔwia-nwu.’ ”

english_verse: They went off and found everything just as Jesus had said.
translation_verse: Batɛyane bammɔ báyu ulu bésie na bátánu lɛla biala aani kalɛ kani na Yesu ɔ́su-ma.

english_verse: While they were untying the donkey, its owners asked, “Why are you doing that?”
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na benye baaƒɛnimi ebuo ɔmmɔ ni, ebuo ɔmmɔ balati béye-ma banii, “Bi ɔsu na bɛɛƒɛnimi-nwu?”

english_verse: They answered, “The Lord needs it.”
translation_verse: Amu na batɛyane bammɔ bédie kenye banii, “Blɔti mɔɔwia-nwu.”

english_verse: Then they led the donkey to Jesus. They put some of their clothes on its back and helped Jesus get on.
translation_verse: Na béti ebuo ɔmmɔ béboku Yesu. Mmɔ na béti bana adi béwi ebuo ɔmmɔ kama na bébunku Yesu na ɔ́kɔ úlie-nwu kama.

english_verse: And as he rode along, the people spread clothes on the road in front of him.
translation_verse: Ka ulie-nwu lɛlɔ na bésela ni, bekyuli badi béti bana adi béwi kalɔ na ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When Jesus started down the Mount of Olives, his large crowd of disciples were happy and praised God because of all the miracles they had seen.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ɔ́kpɛ úde Yerusalem na likpo lɛni na ulu ɔmmɔ úti ɔ́yu Inɔ Egyii Kɔbi lɛlɔ ni, nwuna batɛyane pii bammɔ bése kalɔ baagyá Katɔti enu na beete yiidu ku kɔvanu momoomo na ala ebendi ani na bánu ɔsu.

english_verse: They shouted, “Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven and glory to God.”
translation_verse: Na básu banii, “Bimwi Ɔga ɔni nási ɔdubo na Blɔti lɛnyi kemmo! Na keyi buɛɛ kaƒɔ Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ƒui! Hosiana!”

english_verse: Some Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, make your disciples stop shouting!”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Ƒarisiƒuɔ bani nkya otogyi ɔmmɔ kemmo básu Yesu banini, “Ala ɔtinane, bɔku ƒula batɛyane na baba ku lɛsɛ!”

english_verse: But Jesus answered, “If they keep quiet, these stones will start shouting.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-mii geen nnii si bába lɛsɛ ni, atabi amɛni alati adubuse kalɔ ataava.”

english_verse: When Jesus came closer and could see Jerusalem, he cried
translation_verse: Ɔni na Yesu ɔ́ni úde Yerusalem úbu na ɔ́nu ɔma ɔmmɔ ni, úwulo na nwuna lili.

english_verse: and said: It is too bad that today your people don't know what will bring them peace! Now it is hidden from them.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Mɔɔyɔ́ geen ka nka bɛnu bɛti ɔmwi limeyi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ lɛla lɛni námanku-mii asa bɛkɛ keyi buɛɛ! Nsu ku ɔƒɛni ni, bilánu taati!

english_verse: Jerusalem, the time will come when your enemies will build walls around you to attack you. Armies will surround you and close in on you from every side.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ɔni na bina bekisine badubɔka-mii bakya ekpo ekpo ƒui. Na badubutile eƒi ƒui na lɛla biala lɛsɔ lilakana buduo iye lɛlɛ keyi.

english_verse: They will level you to the ground and kill your people. Not one stone in your buildings will be left on top of another. This will happen because you did not see that God had come to save you. Jesus in the Temple (Matthew
translation_verse: Bekyuli badubo ɔma ɔmɛni bɔyila ku udu na badu bekyuli bani nkya-nwu kemmo ƒui. Na lɛtabi lɛdi muedi lɛsɔ lilése nina keliekɔ. Ɔsika bíni na bítanu bítati uwi ɔni na Katɔti úbo ɔnii ubedie-mii!” Yesu Úsie Katɔti Kakpakɔ

english_verse: When Jesus entered the temple, he started chasing out the people who were selling things.
translation_verse: Yesu úsie útéduo Katɔti kakpakɔ na úse kalɔ ɔɔgyá beyedine bani nkya mmɔ taalɛku.

english_verse: He told them, “The Scriptures say, ‘My house should be a place of worship.’ But you have made it a place where robbers hide!”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bénweni bákya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ka Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, ‘Mina kaduli ni, bekyuli badubɔlɔ-ka banii kaduli kani bekyuli baakpali katɔ.’ Na amii bíti mmɔ bínwini beyune kabɛkɔ!”

english_verse: Each day, Jesus kept on teaching in the temple. So the chief priests, the teachers of the Law of Moses, and some other important people tried to have him killed.
translation_verse: Limeyi ndi limeyi ni, Yesu ɔ́tina ala na Katɔti kakpakɔ mmɔ. Katɔti bakpane benengu ku ɔda bubo ala batinane ku bekyuli batɔnkune báwia ka badu-nwu.

english_verse: But they could not find a way to do it, because everyone else was eager to listen to him.
translation_verse: Nsu bátakɛ ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na basia, ɔsika bekyuli pii bakya mmɔ na bana atu asia nwuna etemila ammɔ lɛlɔ kpakplaa.

english_verse: The spies said to him, “Teacher, we know you teach the truth about what God wants people to do. And you treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu kenye bewine bamɛni bésie Yesu kudɔ. Na béye-nwu banini, “Ɔtinane, bɔgyi ka ala ani na aasu ku ani na aatina ƒui adi etemila geen. Na bɔgyi lɛnɔ ka alánu ukyuli anumi taabla ala. Mmomu aatina litemi geen lɛni na Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́ ka bekyuli babla.

english_verse: The Sadducees did not believe that people would rise to life after death. So some of them came to Jesus
translation_verse: Amu na Sadukiƒuɔ bani mɔɔsu banii ukpine ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdubo bɔta ni, bébo Yesu kudɔ na bábasu-nwu banini,

english_verse: When God raises people from death, whose wife will this woman be? All seven brothers had married her.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, limeyi lɛni lɛlɔ na bekpine badubɔsɔ bata ni, ɔmani uleku na uleku ɔmmɔ wenwini ka bana ƒui béti-nwu dii?”

english_verse: asked him, “What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
translation_verse: Amu na bábasu-nwu banini, “Su-bu kenyekɔ kani na ebo asa na aabla ala amɛni udu? Na ɔma néte-ɔ kenyekɔ kammɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I want to ask you a question.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Bɛya na liye-mii lɛla lɛdi linu na bɛsu-mi.

english_verse: Who gave John the right to baptize? Was it God in heaven or merely some human being?”
translation_verse: Kenyekɔ kani na Yohane ɔ́kɛ asa na ɔ́bla ntu bɔkpila ɔdi úte bekyuli ni, Katɔti kudɔ na kási munuu ukyuli kudɔ na kási?”

english_verse: They talked this over and said to each other, “We can't say God gave John this right. Jesus will ask us why we didn't believe John.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bese kalɔ ku unyeƒi bɔkya ama alati bana akɔ banii, “Bi na ɔlɛka bɔsu? Si bɔ́su bɔnii Katɔti kudɔ na ɔ́kɛ kenyekɔ kammɔ ɔ́siku ni, ɔdubuye-bu ɔnii, ‘Bi ɔsu na bítaƒɔ Yohane bítadi?’

english_verse: And we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize. The crowd will stone us to death, because they think John was a prophet.”
translation_verse: Na si bɔ́su bɔnii ukyuli kudɔ na ɔ́kɛ-ka ɔ́siku ni, kasalakɔ bekyuli bamɛni ƒui badubo-bu atabi bubo, ɔsika bana ƒui báƒɔ bádi ka Katɔti kenye udiene na Yohane ɔdi.”

english_verse: So they told Jesus, “We don't know who gave John the right to baptize.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bédie kenye banii, “Bɔɔɔgyi kesii kani na ɔ́kɛ kenyekɔ kammɔ ɔ́siku.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Then I won't tell you who gave me the right to do what I do.” Renters of a Vineyard (Matthew
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu lɛnɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Lɛni kani na ami lɛnɔ lɛɛɛdubo-mii bɔsu kenyekɔ kani mbo asa na mɔɔbla ala amɛni udu.” Yesu Úbo Lɛgba Na Kemo Lɛlɔ Banune Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Guard against the teachers of the Law of Moses! They love to walk around in long robes, and they like to be greeted in the market. They want the front seats in the synagogues and the best seats at banquets.
translation_verse: “Binye kagyumana bite lɛlɔ kaduɛ na ɔda bubo ala batinane lɛlɔ. Bekyuli bamɛni baayɔ́ busie taavi na bakya bana lɛwu bonwu bonwu. Na baayɔ́ ka bekyuli beteebo kalɔ teegyele-ma na kuyeya. Ama mɔɔyɔ́ kuliekɔ kunengudi bulie na Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ ku kuliekɔ kɔbuni na emeyi kadikɔ.

english_verse: Jesus told the people this story: A man once planted a vineyard and rented it out. Then he left the country for a long time.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úbo bekyuli bammɔ lɛgba lɛmɛni ɔnini, “Dii ni, ɔnana ɔdi ɔ́bla adingyii kemmo kadi. Ka úsela ulu ɔdi utákya na uwi utu ɔsu ni, úti-ka ɔ́kya bekyuli badi enu ɔnii bataanu-ka lɛlɔ teete-nwu.

english_verse: When it was time to harvest the crop, he sent a servant to ask the renters for his share of the grapes. But they beat up the servant and sent him away without anything.
translation_verse: Ka uwi údu ka bese kalɔ ku ebi ammɔ bude ni, ɔ́tala nwuna kabla ɔblane ɔdi ɔnii usie na utáƒɔ nwuna kadikɔ na kemmo kammɔ lɛlɔ banune kudɔ uboku. Nsu kemmo lɛlɔ banune bammɔ bébo kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ na bábɔku-nwu, na bétete-nwu lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: When the renters saw the owner's son, they said to one another, “Someday he will own the vineyard. Let's kill him! Then we can have it all for ourselves.”
translation_verse: “Nsu ka kemmo lɛlɔ banune bammɔ bánu ubi ɔmmɔ ni, básu lɛlɔ banii, ‘Aanu kemmo ɔlati ɔmmɔ ubi geen mɛni. Bɛya na bɔdu-nwu na nwuna ala amɛni ƒui enwini abu adi!’

english_verse: I'll tell you what. He will come and kill those renters and let someone else have his vineyard.” When the people heard this, they said, “This must never happen!”
translation_verse: Mɔɔyá na bɛti ka ɔdububo ubadu kemmo lɛlɔ banune bammɔ ƒui na uti kemmo kammɔ ɔkya lɛlɔ banune babambadi lɛkɔkɔ.” Ka bekyuli bammɔ bénu lɛni ni, básu banii, “Oowo! Utebo lɛni!”

english_verse: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses knew that Jesus was talking about them when he was telling this story. They wanted to arrest him right then, but they were afraid of the people. Paying Taxes (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɔda bubo ala batinane ku Katɔti bakpane benengu bákya ɔkplu banii beeƒie Yesu na mmɔ, ɔsika bánu báti ka bana lɛlɔ geen ɔsu na úbo lɛgba lɛmmɔ. Nsu baayia bekyuli bammɔ.

english_verse: Jesus' enemies kept watching him closely, because they wanted to hand him over to the Roman governor. So they sent some men who pretended to be good. But they were really spies trying to catch Jesus saying something wrong.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, báwia ulu ɔbambadi ɔni lɛlɔ basia na beƒie-nwu. Béte bekyuli badi ala na bɔbɛ kemmo. Na bása ku-ma lili banii besie Yesu kudɔ. Na babla lɛlɔ aani si litemi lɛmmɔ geen na ama alati baawia bati bete lɛlɔ. Na bátala-ma banii batákywɛ Yesu kakpagyuɛ ku etemila adi. Na bakɛ ulu ɔni na beti-nwu bakya Roma aban unengu enu kemmo.

english_verse: “Show me a coin.” Then he asked, “Whose picture and name are on it?” “The Emperor's,” they answered.
translation_verse: “Biti sika ɔƒualadi ubi ɔmmɔ bɛtina-mi. Ɔma bɔtaa ku lɛnyi nsia mɛni?”

english_verse: Jesus' enemies could not catch him saying anything wrong there in front of the people. They were amazed at his answer and kept quiet. Life in the Future World (Matthew
translation_verse: Na bekyuli anumi mmɔ ni, bátakana na beƒie-nwu na lɛla lɛdi lɛlɔ. Bana kenye kékpi-ma na bábla yaa na kenye kani na Yesu údie ɔsu. Yesu Ɔ́tɛmi Ɔ́siku Bekpine Bɔsɔ Taata Lɛlɔ

english_verse: and said: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and has no children, his brother should marry the widow. Their first son would then be thought of as the son of the dead brother.
translation_verse: “Ala ɔtinane, Mose únweni ɔda bubo bɔmɛni úte-bu ɔnini, ‘Si ɔnana ɔdi úkpi na ɔ́da ulekudi úse na beeebo bebi ni, na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔnwani uti uleku ɔmmɔ. Na anwu ku ukpinele ɔmmɔ bawɔ. Na bebi bammɔ ni, bekyuli badubɔnu-ma aani ɔnana ɔni nsɔ neeebo mmɔ bebi.’

english_verse: There were once seven brothers. The first one married, but died without having any children.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔdi ni, banwani banana maatɛ bákya. Ɔnanabi unengudi úbeti uleku na úbekpi na anwu ku ulekudi bátawɔ.

english_verse: The same thing happened to the third one. Finally, all seven brothers married this woman and died without having any children.
translation_verse: Ɔtɛdi lɛnɔ lɛni kani. Na lɛla lɛmmɔ kani nálɛku banwani maatɛ bamɛni ƒui. Bana ƒui békpi ɔni na ɔdi útawɔ.

english_verse: At last the woman died.
translation_verse: Kawɔlɔkɔ ƒui ni, uleku ɔmmɔ ɔlati úbekpi.

english_verse: Jesus answered: The people in this world get married.
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Ngba bɔmɛni kemmo kani na banana ku beleku beeti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Some of the teachers of the Law of Moses said, “Teacher, you have given a good answer!”
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, ɔda bubo ala batinane bammɔ badi bédie kenye banini, “Ala ɔtinane, édie kenye kammɔ geen!”

english_verse: Jesus asked, “Why do people say that the Messiah will be the son of King David?
translation_verse: Yesu úye-ma ɔnini, “Dɛ na ɔ́bla asa na bekyuli básu banii Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔsi Dawid kaba kemmo?

english_verse: In the book of Psalms, David himself says, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right side
translation_verse: Na Dawid ɔmmɔ ɔlati ɔ́su na kɔgya ɔku kemmo ɔnini, “ ‘Unwoti ɔ́su mina Ɔti ɔnii, “Sɔ lie-mi kɔdianu kakɛ

english_verse: until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.’
translation_verse: wetédu uwi ɔni na meti ƒula bekisine makya-a lɛgba kalɔ.” ’

english_verse: David spoke of the Messiah as his Lord, so how can the Messiah be his son?” Jesus and the Teachers of the Law of Moses (Matthew
translation_verse: Na si Dawid ɔ́lɔ-nwu ɔnii Ɔti ni, dɛ na ɔ́bla na Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ ɔɔbla Dawid kaba kemmo ubi?” Yesu Úbo Nwuna Batɛyane Ɔda Na Ɔda Bubo Ala Batinane Lɛlɔ

english_verse: While everyone was listening to Jesus, he said to his disciples:
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bekyuli ƒui benye beenú ala ani na Yesu ɔɔsu ni, ɔ́su nwuna batɛyane ɔnini,

english_verse: But they cheat widows out of their homes and then pray long prayers just to show off. These teachers will be punished most of all.
translation_verse: Beesié bekpinele kudɔ ka betébunku-ma, nsu baatɔ́lɔ-ma taaƒɔ-ma ala. Na baakpali katɔ gyɔlɔɔ taabu bekyuli kɔdɔlɔ. Anwuɔsu bana kɔtu bɔni bɔdubɔkɔ katɔ butulo ƒui!”

english_verse: Before all this happens, you will be arrested and punished. You will be tried in your synagogues and put in jail. Because of me you will be placed on trial before kings and governors.
translation_verse: “Na asa na ala amɛni adububo abalɛ ni, bekyuli badubo-mii buƒie na bekpoku-mii. Bekyuli badubuti-mii bete na batɛku litemi na Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ na bakya-mii ɔtɔ. Na badubo-mii buti buboku baga ku lɛlɔ badine anumi na batɛku-mii litemi na ami ɔsu.

english_verse: Everyone else gave what they didn't need. But she is very poor and gave everything she had.” The Temple Will Be Destroyed (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɔsika bakladi ama ni, lɛla lɛni kani na baayɔ́ na bana lɛkɛ kemmo kani na béte. Nsu uleku ɔmmɔ ku nwuna kɔwaba ni, lɛla lɛni ƒui na nse-nwu na nka wadi ni, ani na úti úte mɛni.” Yesu Ɔ́su Ka Bekyuli Badubɔbwɛ Katɔti Kakpakɔ

english_verse: Some people were talking about the beautiful stones used to build the temple and about the gifts that had been placed in it. Jesus said,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmɛni ni, batɛyane badi bakya baatɛmi taasiku Katɔti kakpakɔ lɛlɔ. Na básu kalɛ na kakpakɔ kammɔ kaadia bɔnu ku kalɛ na atabi ammɔ aadia bɔnu ku etela ani na bekyuli béti báklibi Katɔti kakpakɔ kammɔ. Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini,
