translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na kadi káda ni, kadi benengu ku Katɔti bakpane benengu ku ɔda bubo ala batinane bábasa lisu. Na béti Yesu béboku bana anumi.

english_verse: Peter replied, “I don't know what you are talking about!” Right then, while Peter was still speaking, a rooster crowed.
translation_verse: Nsu Petro údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɔnana, lɛɛɛgyi lɛla lɛni na aasu mɛni kula kula!” Kɔnakunwi ni, ɔni na ɔ́mu unye ɔɔtɛmi ni, akɔkɔ úte kenye.

english_verse: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. And Peter remembered that the Lord had said, “Before a rooster crows tomorrow morning, you will say three times that you don't know me.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Blɔti únwini na ɔ́nu Petro ɔnusɛ. Amu na Petro únyimo ka Blɔti ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Asa na akɔkɔ wete kenye usien ɔmɛni ni, adubɔsu kɔtɛ ƒui ka aaagyi-mi.”

english_verse: The men who were guarding Jesus made fun of him and beat him.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔgyumana Yesu na mmɔ ni, bákya-nwu lɛlɔ lɛma na bébo-nwu.

english_verse: They kept on insulting Jesus in many other ways. Jesus Is Questioned by the Council (Matthew
translation_verse: Na bédumi-nwu na lilu bamba pii lɛnɔ lɛlɔ. Yesu Unye Litemi Batɛne Anumi

english_verse: And if I asked you a question, you wouldn't answer.
translation_verse: Na si líye-mii litemi lɛdi ni, bɛɛɛdubo kenye budie bɔsu-mi lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right side of God All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Nsu ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ni, Katɔti ɔdubuse ami, Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi, liboku na nwuna kɔdianu.”

english_verse: Then they asked, “Are you the Son of God?” Jesus answered, “You say I am!”
translation_verse: Amu na bana ƒui béye-nwu banini, “Amu ni, Katɔti Ubidi na adi?” Amu na údie kenye ɔnini, “Amii alati mɔɔsu bɛnii anwu na ndi.”

english_verse: They replied, “Why do we need more witnesses? He said it himself!”
translation_verse: Amu na básu banini, “Bɔsɔ buláwia ka ukyuli bamba ɔdi udie kenye kadi na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ. Abu alati búnu ala ani na ɔ́su!”

english_verse: Everyone in the council got up and led Jesus off to Pilate.
translation_verse: Amu na bana ƒui báta na bétiku Yesu bésienku Pilato kudɔ.

english_verse: They started accusing him and said, “We caught this man trying to get our people to riot and to stop paying taxes to the Emperor. He also claims that he is the Messiah, our king.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bése baadá-nwu kenye banini, “Búƒie ukyuli ɔmɛni ka ɔ́kpanku bula kadi ɔɔvínku ulu ukpidi lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔsu-ma ɔnii basɔ bataƒɔ kuyi betete Romaƒuɔ Ɔga Unengudi. Na ɔ́su lɛnɔ ɔnii anwu ndi Katɔti Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi na ɔnii ɔdi ɔga lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: Herod and his soldiers made fun of Jesus and insulted him. They put a fine robe on him and sent him back to Pilate.
translation_verse: Herode ku nwuna bekpone báma Yesu na bédumi-nwu. Na béti awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔbuni ɔdi bákya-nwu aani ɔga kalɛ, na básɔku-nwu bémene Pilato.

english_verse: He told them, “You brought Jesus to me and said he was a troublemaker. But I have questioned him here in front of you, and I have not found him guilty of anything that you say he has done.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛ́kpanku ukyuli ɔmɛni biboku-mi bɛnii ɔɔkpanku bekyuli taavinku ulu ukpidi lɛlɔ. Na ɔƒɛni ni, líye-nwu ala na amii alati anumi. Na ńtanu lɛla likpidi lɛdi na nwuna lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na amii bɛ́da-nwu kenye.

english_verse: But they all kept on saying, “He has been teaching and causing trouble all over Judea. He started in Galilee and has now come all the way here.” Jesus Is Brought before Herod
translation_verse: Nsu bénye kpakplaa bébu na básu banii, “Nwuna ala ani na ɔɔtina éti lɛsɛ éboku Yudea bekyuli ƒui akɔ. Úse ɔmɛni kalɔ na Galilea, na úubo úbedu mɛni lɛnɔ.” Herode Úye Yesu Etemila

english_verse: But the whole crowd shouted, “Kill Jesus! Give us Barabbas!”
translation_verse: Amu na bana ƒui báva momoomo banii, “Du-nwu! Na anyonu Baraba ete-bu!”

english_verse: Pilate asked Jesus, “Are you the king of the Jews?” “Those are your words,” Jesus answered.
translation_verse: Amu na Pilato úye-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ ndi Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga?” Na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Awɔ mɔɔsu.”

english_verse: Pilate told the chief priests and the crowd, “I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Pilato ɔ́su bakpane benengu ku bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini, “Ńtanu lɛla lɛdi na ukyuli ɔmɛni lɛlɔ kalɛ na lɛdu-nwu kɔtɔ kɔdi.”

english_verse: After Pilate learned that Jesus came from the region ruled by Herod, he sent him to Herod, who was in Jerusalem at that time.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka ɔ́ti ka Yesu ɔ́si Galilea kalɛkɛ kani lɛlɔ na Herode ɔɔdi ɔsu ni, úti-nwu úmene Herode. Na Herode ɔmɛni úsie ɔkya Yerusalem uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: For a long time Herod had wanted to see Jesus and was very happy because he finally had this chance. He had heard many things about Jesus and hoped to see him work a miracle.
translation_verse: Ebiti áda Herode geen uwi ɔni na ɔ́nu Yesu, ɔsika úunu-nwu kɔku na ɔɔwia ka ɔnu-nwu ɔ́si kukuuku ƒui. Na ubo lɛnunsia ka ɔdubɔnu Yesu na ɔbla akɔla budie taatina bɔdi.

english_verse: Herod asked him a lot of questions, but Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Herode úye Yesu etemila pii, nsu Yesu útedie lɛdi kenye.

english_verse: Then the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses stood up and accused him of all kinds of bad things.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bakpane benengu ku ɔda bubo ala batinane bálɛ bébo animi na báda kenye bonwu bonwu básia Yesu.

english_verse: That same day Herod and Pilate became friends, even though they had been enemies before this. The Death Sentence (Matthew
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛmmɔ kani na Herode ku Pilato bénwini bakpana, na nka badi bekisine. Pilato Ɔ́du Yesu Kukpi Kɔtɔ

english_verse: As Jesus was being led away, some soldiers grabbed hold of a man named Simon who was from Cyrene. He was coming in from the fields, but they put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.
translation_verse: Bekpone bákpanku Yesu bátɔlɔku. Na ɔni bakɛ ulu bésela ni, bátásiaku Kireneni ɔdi baalɔ Simon ka ɔ́si lɛkpaklɔ lɛdi ɔdubo Yerusalem. Bédi-nwu bényene na bénye-nwu lɛlɔ banii ɔƒɔ ugyii ɔni na Yesu uti mmɔ uti na ɔsiaku-nwu kama.

english_verse: One of the criminals hanging there also insulted Jesus by saying, “Aren't you the Messiah? Save yourself and save us!”
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi bani lɛnɔ na bákana bámana ligyii lɛlɔ mmɔ akɔ unwi ɔkya uudumi Yesu ɔnini, “Ɔɔɔdi awɔ ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ? Kpo die lɛlɔ, na edie abu lɛnɔ!”

english_verse: Pilate called together the chief priests, the leaders, and the people.
translation_verse: Pilato ɔ́lɔ bakpane benengu ku batɔnkune ku bekyuli bammɔ ɔ́sala.

english_verse: Pilate wanted to set Jesus free, so he spoke again to the crowds.
translation_verse: Na ka Pilato ɔ́yɔ ka ɔnyonu Yesu ɔsu ni, ɔ́sɔ útemi úte bekyuli bammɔ.

english_verse: Pilate spoke to them a third time, “But what crime has he done? I have not found him guilty of anything for which he should be put to death. I will have him beaten with a whip and set free.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Pilato ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma kɔtɛdi ɔnini, “Na bi likpidi na ɔ́bla? Ńtanu lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla na mɔɔdú-nwu kukpi kɔtɔ! Ndubɔya na bebo-nwu kugyiimi na lɛnyonu-nwu.”

english_verse: The people kept on shouting as loud as they could for Jesus to be put to death.
translation_verse: Nsu bunye kani na benye baava momoomo banii, “Ɔdi ka aya na bɔkana Yesu bɔmana ugyii lɛlɔ.” Na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, bádi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: He freed the man who was in jail for rioting and murder, because he was the one the crowd wanted to be set free. Then Pilate handed Jesus over for them to do what they wanted with him. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Na ɔ́nyonu ukyuli ɔni na baayɔ́ úte-ma. Na ɔdi ukyuli ɔni na litemi batɛne bákya ɔtɔ na lɛsɛ ku ukyuli bɔdu ɔsu. Na ɔ́nyonu Yesu ɔ́kya-ma enu kemmo na batáblaku-nwu kalɛ na baayɔ́. Bekpone Bákana Yesu Bámana Ugyii Lɛlɔ

english_verse: If this can happen when the wood is green, what do you think will happen when it is dry?
translation_verse: Ɔsika si bákana na báni ukyuli ɔni na útabla lɛla lɛdi kɔtu lɛni ni, bɛti bɛnii bekyuli bekpidi kɔtu bɔni bɔdubutulo ɔmɛni ƒui.”

english_verse: Around noon the sky turned dark and stayed that way until the middle of the afternoon.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ka ɔ́bla aani ɔƒiiwi lɛdɔ leevu-inyɔ ni, ɔƒɛ ɔ́da bɔlɛ ɔ́ya na kadi kábla suu na kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ úti útédu lɛdɔ ɛtɛ kemmo.

english_verse: Two criminals were led out to be put to death with Jesus.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, bekpone bétiku banana bekpidi inyɔ badi bésela batádu ku Yesu.

english_verse: Jesus said, “Father, forgive these people! They don't know what they're doing.” While the crowd stood there watching Jesus, the soldiers gambled for his clothes. The leaders insulted him by saying, “He saved others. Now he should save himself, if he really is God's chosen Messiah!”
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, bekyuli bammɔ ƒui benye mmɔ baanu. Na Yudaƒuɔ batɔnkune bammɔ benye baamá Yesu taasu banini, “Ɔ́ƒɔ bekyuli bamba ngba, anwuɔsu ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ anwu ɔlati bɔdi lɛnɔ si anwu ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔni na Katɔti úse likpo úse na bɔnu ɛ-ɛ!”

english_verse: The soldiers made fun of Jesus and brought him some wine.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na bekpone bammɔ lɛnɔ báma Yesu. Na bésie-nwu kudɔ na béti ntɛ bɔni nányi béte-nwu banii ɔni.

english_verse: They said, “If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself!”
translation_verse: Na básu-nwu banini, “Si Yudaƒuɔ ɔga na adi ni, na ekpo aƒɔ lɛlɔ!”

english_verse: But the other criminal told the first one off, “Don't you fear God? Aren't you getting the same punishment as this man?
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ukyuli unyɔdi ɔ́dɔnku-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ aláyia Katɔti yoo? Kɔtu bɔni bunwi pɛ na bekpone béti béte awɔ ku anwu ƒui.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I promise that today you will be with me in paradise.” The Death of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-ɔ geen nnii ɔmwi ɔmɛni kani ni, ami ku awɔ ƒui bɔdubo buduo Paradiso kemmo.” Bádu Yesu

english_verse: The sun stopped shining, and the curtain in the temple split down the middle.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti kakpakɔ kɔdi kɔni nƒa mmɔ kɔ́bwɛ na kúle akpa anyɔ.

english_verse: Then they went to prepare some sweet-smelling spices for his burial. But on the Sabbath they rested, as the Law of Moses commands.
translation_verse: Na básɔ bénwini bésie kaduli na bátákɔ ala ƒɛƒɛɛ ani na beeti taawɛɛ ukpine lɛlɔ bése. Amu na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ ni, bánwuna aani kalɛ na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔɔtina.

english_verse: Jesus shouted, “Father, I put myself in your hands!” Then he died.
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́va ku lɛdi momoomo ɔnini, “Ati, líti mina kɔyu lɛ́kya-a enu kemmo.” Ka ɔ́su ɔmɛni ni, ɔ́yula.

english_verse: A crowd had gathered to see the terrible sight. Then after they had seen it, they felt brokenhearted and went home.
translation_verse: Ka bekyuli bani nébo banii babanu ala ani mɔɔlɛ́ bánu lɛla lɛni nálɛ ni, bénwini bésie kɔduli na béti enu béwi lili.

english_verse: All of Jesus' close friends and the women who had come with him from Galilee stood at a distance and watched. Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani ƒui ngyi Yesu ku beleku bani nsiaku-nwu bási Galilea ni, bédi bénye ɔgyu sɛsɛɛ baanu ala amɛni. Yoseƒ Arimateani Ɔ́va Yesu

english_verse: Joseph went to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body.
translation_verse: Úsie Pilato anumi na útévele-nwu Yesu ukpine.

english_verse: He took the body down from the cross and wrapped it in fine cloth. Then he put it in a tomb that had been cut out of solid rock and had never been used.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́ƒami ukpine ɔmmɔ na úti kɔdi kɔƒualadi únyimi-nwu lɛlɔ ƒui. Na úti-nwu útáva lɛtabi ubu kaƒiɔtɔ kadi kemmo ɔni bátava ukyuli ɔdi kana kemmo kudii.

english_verse: It was Friday, and the Sabbath was about to begin.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdi limeyi lɛni na baaklibi lɛlɔ asa na lɛnwunameyi kadi kegye.

english_verse: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph and watched how Jesus' body was placed in the tomb.
translation_verse: Na beleku bani nsiaku Yesu ɔ́si Galilea ni, básiaku Yoseƒ bésie kaƒiɔtɔ kudɔ kesii kani na báva Yesu ukpine ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and some other women were the ones who had gone to the tomb. When they returned, they told the eleven apostles and the others what had happened.
translation_verse: Beleku bammɔ ndi Maria Magdalene ku Yohana ku Maria ɔni ndi Yakobo uni. Ama ku beleku babambadi násu batalane bammɔ ala amɛni.

english_verse: When they found the stone rolled away from the entrance,
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, bánu ka kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ kenye kewi na lɛtabi bonwu lɛni na béti bákalɛ mmɔ lɛlɛ kɔmadɔ.

english_verse: they went in. But they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu béduo bésie kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ kemmo, nsu bátanu Blɔti Yesu ukpine ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: and they did not know what to think. Suddenly two men in shining white clothes stood beside them.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔ́bla-ma dɛye dɛye. Na kɔnakunwi ni, nkyuli inyɔ badi báda bálɛ-ma lɛlɔ. Na bakya lɛwu lɛni muukeye na lɛɛtu anumi.

english_verse: The women were afraid and bowed to the ground. But the men said, “Why are you looking in the place of the dead for someone who is alive?
translation_verse: Liƒu lɛ́da-ma geen ɔni na béboku lɛlɔ kalɔ béte bekyuli bammɔ. Na bekyuli bammɔ béye-ma banini, “Bi ɔsu na bɛɛwia ukyuli ɔni nli ngba na bekpine akɔ?

english_verse: ‘The Son of Man will be handed over to sinners who will nail him to a cross. But three days later he will rise to life.’ ”
translation_verse: ɔlɛka bekyuli beti Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi bakya bekyuli bekpidi enu kemmo. Na bakana-nwu bamana ugyii lɛlɔ. Na emeyi atɛ kama ni, ɔdubɔsɔ ɔta ɔlɛ bekpine akɔ.”

english_verse: That same day two of Jesus' disciples were going to the village of Emmaus, which was about eleven kilometers from Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛmmɔ kani lɛlɔ ni, Yesu basiakune inyɔ badi bakɛ ulu bésela lɛkpaklɔ lɛdi baalɔ banii Emaus kemmo. Na ɔdubɔbla aani eluku maatɛ ɔ́si mmɔ útédu Yerusalem.

english_verse: Jesus came near and started walking along beside them.
translation_verse: Ka bakɛ baatɛmi na béduo atɛ amɛni kemmo ni, Yesu ɔlati úsie útásiaku-ma na anwu ku-ma bakɛ.

english_verse: Jesus asked them, “What were you talking about as you walked along?” The two of them stood there looking sad and gloomy.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye-ma ɔnini, “Bi na bɛkɛ bɛɛsu na ulu na kɔnyana kúƒie-mii lɛni?” Mmɔ na bédi bénye, na bana anumi aatina ka bana lɛlɔ lɛ́ɛkywi kaƒɔ.

english_verse: We had hoped that he would be the one to set Israel free! But it has already been three days since all this happened.
translation_verse: Nsu abu bɔ́kya bútaasia anu bɔnii anwu ndi ukyuli ɔni ndubɔƒɔ Israel bekyuli ƒui. Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, ɔmwi ndi limeyi lɛtɛdi ka ala amɛni álɛ.

english_verse: Some women in our group surprised us. They had gone to the tomb early in the morning,
translation_verse: Bula lɛkpa lɛmɛni akɔ beleku badi báya na bula kayi kábla kalɛ kadi. Ɔsika bésie nwuna kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ kudɔ ɔtanta tutuutu ɔmɛni.

english_verse: Some men from our group went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said. But they didn't see Jesus either.
translation_verse: Bula badi akɔ badi bésie kaƒiɔtɔ kudɔ mmɔ na bátánu kalɛ na beleku bammɔ básu pɛpɛɛpɛ, nsu bátanu-nwu.”

english_verse: Then Jesus asked the two disciples, “Why can't you understand? How can you be so slow to believe all that the prophets said?
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛ́dɔlɔ! Na bina bɔƒɔtaadi na ala ani na Katɔti kenye bediene básu-mii lɛlɔ bɔba!

english_verse: Didn't you know that the Messiah would have to suffer before he was given his glory?”
translation_verse: Bɛɛɛgyi bɛnii ɔlɛka Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ ubo abi amɛni udu asa na uduo nwuna lɛga bɔdi bukeye kemmo?”

english_verse: Jesus then explained everything written about himself in the Scriptures, beginning with the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets.
translation_verse: Na Yesu údie ala ammɔ kalɔ úte-ma ɔ́si ala ani na bénweni bákya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ɔ́si Mose ɔku ku ala ani ƒui na Katɔti kenye bediene bénweni ɔkɛnku anwu Yesu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They begged him, “Stay with us! It's already late, and the sun is going down.” So Jesus went into the house to stay with them.
translation_verse: Nsu bábala-nwu básu banini, “Kadi káasa ɔsu ni, sɔ kya-bu kudɔ mɛni.” Anwuɔsu úsie útéduo-ma kudɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: After Jesus sat down to eat, he took some bread. He blessed it and broke it. Then he gave it to them.
translation_verse: Úlie kalɔ ɔnii ɔɔdiku-ma. Na úti bodobodo na ɔ́gya Katɔti enu, na ɔ́bwɛ-nwu kemmo na úti úte-ma.

english_verse: At once they knew who he was, but he disappeared.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bana anumi ébimi na bánu-nwu báti. Nsu ɔ́yii-ma anumi.

english_verse: They said to each other, “When he talked with us along the road and explained the Scriptures to us, didn't it warm our hearts?”
translation_verse: Amu na básu lɛlɔ banii, “Uwi ɔni na ɔkya ɔɔtɛmiku-bu na uudie Bunweni Kedee Ɔku etemila kalɔ teete-bu na ulu lɛlɔ ni, ebiti adi udu áda-bu kayi kemmo.”

english_verse: So they got up and returned to Jerusalem. The two disciples found the eleven apostles and the others gathered together.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na báta kɔnakunwi na básɔ bénwini bésie Yerusalem. Na bátánu batalane leevu-unwi bammɔ ka básala lɛlɔ ku bekyuli bamba lɛnɔ.

english_verse: And they learned from the group that the Lord was really alive and had appeared to Peter.
translation_verse: Na básu-ma banini, “Blɔti ɔ́ta ɔ́lɛ kekpine sɔsɔ, na údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina Simon.”

english_verse: Then the disciples from Emmaus told what happened on the road and how they knew he was the Lord when he broke the bread. What Jesus' Followers Must Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Amu na nkyuli inyɔ bammɔ lɛnɔ bédie kalɔ básu-ma ala ani nálɛ na ulu lɛlɔ ku kalɛ na bánu-nwu báti uwi ɔni na ɔ́bwɛ bodobodo ɔmmɔ úte-ma. Yesu Údie Lɛlɔ Ɔ́tina Nwuna Batɛyane

english_verse: While Jesus' disciples were talking about what had happened, Jesus appeared and greeted them.
translation_verse: Ka nkyuli inyɔ bamɛni badaku bana litemi bɔsu ni, kɔnakunwi Yesu úbo úbenye-ma ntɛ. Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-mii.”

english_verse: They were frightened and terrified because they thought they were seeing a ghost.
translation_verse: Liƒu lɛ́da-ma geen, na básu banii ukpine kɔyu na baanu.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Why are you so frightened? Why do you doubt?
translation_verse: Nsu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Liƒu litada-mii lɛni! Na bina kasusu lɛnɔ keteƒu.

english_verse: Look at my hands and my feet and see who I am! Touch me and find out for yourselves. Ghosts don't have flesh and bones as you see I have.”
translation_verse: Bɛnu-mi enu ku lɛgba. Na bituku-mi na bɛnu bɛti ka ami na ɔdi. Ɔsika ukpine kɔyu kuuubo ɔlɔna ku ekubi aani kalɛ na bɛɛnu-mi ka mbo mɛni.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
translation_verse: Ka ɔ́su lɛni ni, úti nwuna enu ku lɛgba ɔ́tina-ma.

english_verse: The disciples were so glad and amazed that they could not believe it. Jesus then asked them, “Do you have something to eat?”
translation_verse: Ebiti áda-ma geen na ɔ́bla-ma kalɛ kadi ɔni na bátati kalɛ baƒɔ badi muedi! Mmɔ na Yesu úye-ma ɔnini, “Adila adi ese?”

english_verse: They gave him a piece of broiled fish.
translation_verse: Amu na béti kakpaku keƒidi kadi béte-nwu.

english_verse: He took it and ate it as they watched.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ƒɔ-ka ɔ́kun na bana anumi.

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “While I was still with you, I told you that everything written about me in the Law of Moses, the Books of the Prophets, and in the Psalms had to happen.”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ala amɛni lɛlɔ kɔtɛ geen na lɛ́tɛmiku-mii ɔni na lɛ́kya-mii kudɔ. Ala ani ƒui na bénweni na Mose ɔda bubo ɔku kemmo ku Katɔti kenye bediene ala ani bénweni ku kɔgya ɔku kemmo ni, ɔlɛka ebo-nwu kemmo lɛni.”

english_verse: Then he helped them understand the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́lɛmi-ma kasusu kalɛ na benu Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo etemila ammɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: He told them: The Scriptures say that the Messiah must suffer, then three days later he will rise from death.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Lɛni na bénweni banii Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ ɔdububo abi na ɔdubɔta ɔlɛ bekpine akɔ limeyi lɛtɛdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They also say that all people of every nation must be told in my name to turn to God, in order to be forgiven. So beginning in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Na nwuna basiakune badubɔkɔ lɛsa na nwuna lɛnyi kemmo bete kalɔ ƒui bekyuli banii benwini kayi kalɛ na Katɔti uti bana ekpidi ɔkyiɛ-ma. Na lɛsa bɔkɔ bɔmmɔ bɔdubuse kalɔ bɔsi Yerusalem.

english_verse: you must tell everything that has happened.
translation_verse: Amii na ɔlɛka bidie litemi lɛmɛni kenye kesii biala.

english_verse: I will send you the one my Father has promised, but you must stay in the city until you are given power from heaven. Jesus Returns to Heaven (Mark
translation_verse: Na ami ɔlati ndubuti lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́su-mii úse limene-mii. Nsu ɔlɛka binye bɛgya Katɔti ɔyikun ɔmɛni na Yerusalem wetédu uwi ɔni na ɔyikun ɔmmɔ ɔsi katɔ ubeduo-mii lɛlɔ kemmo.” Katɔti Úti Yesu Úsienku Katɔ

english_verse: Jesus led his disciples out to Bethany, where he raised his hands and blessed them.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́tɔnku-ma na bálɛ Yerusalem ɔma kemmo bésie Betania. Mmɔ na ɔ́kɔliku nwuna enu katɔ na úte-ma kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: As he was doing this, he left and was taken up to heaven.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni kani na uute-ma kusɛ kusɛ mɛni ni, ɔ́tɔlɔ-ma kudɔ na Katɔti úti-nwu úsienku katɔ.

english_verse: After his disciples had worshiped him, they returned to Jerusalem and were very happy.
translation_verse: Amu na bémwi-nwu na bénwini bésie Yerusalem ku ebiti sɔɔn.

english_verse: They spent their time in the temple, praising God.
translation_verse: Na beesié Katɔti kakpakɔ busie busie taatágya Katɔti enu uwi biala.

english_verse: From the very beginning the Word was with God.
translation_verse: Anwu ku Katɔti nli uwi ƒui.

english_verse: received its life from him, and his life gave light to everyone.
translation_verse: Na Litemi lɛmmɔ kemmo na ngba geen bɔɔsí. Na ngba bɔmɛni muute bekyuli Katɔti bukeye geen.

english_verse: The light keeps shining in the dark, and darkness has never put it out.
translation_verse: Bukeye bɔmɛni muukeye na bɔ́ɔyila lɛdisa. Na lɛdisa lítakana na linye bukeye bɔmɛni kenye.

english_verse: who came to tell about the light and to lead all people to have faith.
translation_verse: Úbo ɔnii ubedie kenye na ukyuli ɔni ndi bukeye bɔmɛni lɛlɔ kalɛ na ukyuli biala unu linyesia lɛmɛni na ɔƒɔ ukyuli ɔni ndi bukeye mmɔ ɔdi.

english_verse: The true light that shines on everyone was coming into the world.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, bukeye geen bɔni muuti bukeye teete ukyuli biala bɔ́si bɔdubo kayawi.

english_verse: The Word was in the world, but no one knew him, though God had made the world with his Word.
translation_verse: Nsu geen ni, ɔkya kayawi. Na ina ka nwuna lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔ́kɛ asa na údie kayawi ni, bekyuli bátanu-nwu bátati.

english_verse: He came into his own world, but his own nation did not welcome him.
translation_verse: Úbo anwu badi akɔ, nsu bétegyingya enu bátaƒɔ-nwu.

english_verse: They were not God's children by nature or because of any human desires. God himself was the one who made them his children.
translation_verse: Na ubi bɔdi bɔmɛni bɔɔɔkɛnku kaba kemmo kɔwɔ lɛlɔ. Na bɔɔɔdi ɔnana ku uleku kɔwɔ kemmo na bɔ́si. Na bútasi ɔnana ubi bɔwia kasusu kemmo lɛnɔ. Mmomu ni, Katɔti ubi bunwini bɔmɛni bɔ́si Katɔti ɔlati kudɔ.

english_verse: The Word became a human being and lived here with us. We saw his true glory, the glory of the only Son of the Father. From him the complete gifts of undeserved grace and truth have come down to us.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti Litemi lɛmɛni líbo aani ukyuli ɔyawine, na úlie kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni na bula akɔ. Na Katɔti lɛƒɔndia ku litemi geen lɛ́ƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui. Na abu bɔ́nu kalɛ na uukeye ka ɔdi Katɔti ubidi unwi pɛ ɔsu.

english_verse: Because of all that the Son is, we have been given one blessing after another.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti lɛƒɔndia ku litemi geen lɛni náƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui ɔsu ni, ɔ́bla bula ƒui lɛƒɔndia ɔ́sia kama.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. The only Son, who is truly God and is closest to the Father, has shown us what God is like. John the Baptist Tells about Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi útanu Katɔti nwaa dii. Nsu Katɔti ubidi unwi pɛ ɔni mma-nwu lɛlɔ ni, anwu nédie-nwu nwaa ɔ́tina bekyuli. Yohane Úni Ka Ɔɔɔdi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi

english_verse: The religious authorities in Jerusalem sent priests and temple helpers to ask John who he was. He told them plainly, “I am not the Messiah.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yohane údie ala kalɔ úte-ma mmɔ kani ɔnini, “Lɛɛɛdi Katɔti Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔni na básu bése ka webo.”

english_verse: Then when they asked him if he were Elijah, he said, “No, I am not!” And when they asked if he were the Prophet, he also said “No!”
translation_verse: Bakpane bammɔ básɔ béye-nwu banini, “Amu ɔma na adi? Katɔti Kenye Udiene Elia na adi?” Údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɔɔɔdi anwu na ndi.” Béye-nwu banii, “Na awɔ ndi Kenye Udiene ɔni básu bése ka ɔdubo?” Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Oowo.”

english_verse: Finally, they said, “Who are you then? We have to give an answer to the ones who sent us. Tell us who you are!”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu básu-nwu banini, “Su-bu lɛla lɛdi kalɛ na bɔkana kenye budie bute bekyuli bani nátala-bu! Ɔma na adi? Bi na aasu taasiku ƒula lɛlɔ?”

english_verse: John answered in the words of the prophet Isaiah, “I am only someone shouting in the desert, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord!’ ”
translation_verse: Údie kenye ɔ́su-ma aani kalɛ na Kenye Udiene Yesaia únweni úse ɔnini, “Ami ndi ukyuli ɔni mɔɔva na ketele kemmo nnii bɛklibi ulu bise bite Blɔti bubo.”

english_verse: Some Pharisees had also been sent to John.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani na bátala mɛni ni, bási Yudaƒuɔ lɛkpa lɛni baalɔ banii Ƒarisiƒuɔ kemmo.

english_verse: They asked him, “Why are you baptizing people, if you are not the Messiah or Elijah or the Prophet?”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu béye-nwu banini, “Si aaadi bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka badubo akɔ unwi aani Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi, iye Elia, iye Kenye Udiene ɔmmɔ ni, bi ɔsu na aabla ketu kemmo ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmɛni?”

english_verse: John told them, “I use water to baptize people. But here with you is someone you don't know.
translation_verse: Yohane ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ntu kani na muuti taabla bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmɛni. Nsu ukyuli ɔdi ɔkya bina akɔ na bɛɛɛgyi-nwu.

english_verse: Even though I came first, I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Anwu ndi ukyuli ɔni nkpɛ-mi kama ɔdubo, na ami ńtedu ka lɛbla kabla kadi lite-nwu muedi.”

english_verse: John said this as he was baptizing east of the Jordan River in Bethany. The Lamb of God
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛmɛni lɛ́lɛ na ɔma ɔni baalɔ banii Betania na Yordan Ketu ɔvi. Mmɔ na Yohane útaabla ketu kemmo ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmɛni. Yesu Ndi Katɔti Lɛkpa Koƒonu Ubi

english_verse: The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said: Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
translation_verse: Kadi kégye ni, Yohane ɔ́nu ka Yesu ɔ́si ɔdubo. Amu na ɔ́su bani nnye-nwu kudɔ mmɔ ɔnini, “Bɛnu! Ɔmɛni ndi Katɔti Lɛkpa Koƒonu Ubi ɔni ndubo bayawine ekpidi buni budie-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: He is the one I told you about when I said, “Someone else will come, who is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.”
translation_verse: Anwu ndi ukyuli ɔni lɛlɔ na ńtaatɛmi taasiku uwi ɔni na lɛ́su nnii ukyuli ɔdi ɔkpɛ-mi kama ɔdubo ɔni ntulo-mi ƒui, ɔsika ɔkya kukuuku asa na báwɔ-mi.

english_verse: I didn't know who he was. But I came to baptize you with water, so that everyone in Israel would see him.
translation_verse: Ami lɛnɔ lɛɛɛgyi nnii anwu ndi ukyuli ɔmmɔ. Nsu nwuna bubo ɔsu na líbo mɔɔbla bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmɛni kalɛ na lidie-nwu lɛtina bula kadi bekyuli Israelƒuɔ.”

english_verse: I was there and saw the Spirit come down on him like a dove from heaven. And the Spirit stayed on him.
translation_verse: Amu na Yohane ɔ́sɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Lɛ́nu ka Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́yu kɔ́si katɔ aani kalɛ na abloduma ɔɔyu, na kúbelie-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Before this I didn't know who he was. But the one who sent me to baptize with water had told me, “You will see the Spirit come down and stay on someone. Then you will know that he is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Kudeedi ni, ńtati-nwu. Nsu uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́tala-mi ɔnii ntaabla bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmɛni ni, ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, ‘Si ánu ka mina Kɔyu kɔ́yu kuulie ukyuli ɔdi lɛlɔ ni, adubɔnu ati ka anwu ndi ukyuli ɔni muuti Katɔti Kɔyu taabla bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmmɔ.’

english_verse: I saw this happen, and I tell you that he is the Son of God. The First Disciples of Jesus
translation_verse: Na lɛ́nu ka ɔ́lɛ lɛni na ukyuli ɔmɛni lɛlɔ. Na mɔɔsu-mii geen ka anwu ndi Katɔti Ubidi ɔmmɔ.” Bekyuli Bedeedi Básiaku Yesu Kama

english_verse: The next day, John was there again, and two of his followers were with him.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛni nsɔ nsia ni, ka Yohane ku nwuna basiakune inyɔ benye ni,

english_verse: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Here is the Lamb of God!”
translation_verse: Yesu úsie úbavi. Amu ka Yohane ɔ́nu-nwu ni, ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bɛnu! Ɔmɛni ndi Katɔti Lɛkpa Koƒonu Ubi!”

english_verse: When Jesus turned and saw them, he asked, “What do you want?” They answered, “Rabbi, where do you live?” The Hebrew word “Rabbi” means “Teacher.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bédie kenye banini, “Rabi,” ɔni kalɔ ndi ala ɔtinane, “Buvele, wɛ na eli?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Come and see!” It was already about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him and saw where he lived. So they stayed on for the rest of the day.
translation_verse: Ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bibo na bibanu.” Anwuɔsu anwu ku-ma bakɛ bétédu kesii kani na ɔ́kya, na bélie-nwu kudɔ useyi uwi ɔmmɔ ƒui ɔ́si lɛdɔ ine.

english_verse: One of the two men who had heard John and had gone with Jesus was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bamɛni akɔ unwi ɔdi Andrea ɔni ndi Simon Petro ɔnwani.

english_verse: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother and tell him, “We have found the Messiah!” The Hebrew word “Messiah” means the same as the Greek word “Christ.”
translation_verse: Lɛla lideedi lɛni na Andrea ɔ́bla ndi ka úsie útáwia ɔnwani Simon na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Abu bɔ́nu Mesia ɔmmɔ,” iye Kristo. Na anyi ammɔ kalɔ budie ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi.

english_verse: Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, he said, “Simon son of John, you will be called Cephas.” This name can be translated as “Peter.” Jesus Chooses Philip and Nathanael
translation_verse: Na Andrea ɔ́tɔnku Simon úsienku Yesu kudɔ. Na ka Yesu ɔ́nu Simon ni, ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ ndi Yohane ubidi Simon, nsu bekyuli badubɔlɔ-ɔ banii Keƒas,” iye Petro. Na anyi ammɔ kalɔ budie ndi lɛtakpɛ. Yesu Ɔ́lɔ Ƒilipo Ku Natanael

english_verse: Philip then found Nathanael and said, “We have found the one that Moses and the Prophets wrote about. He is Jesus, the son of Joseph from Nazareth.”
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ni, Ƒilipo ɔ́gyu ɔ́tɔlɔ útáwia Natanael. Na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Abu bɔ́nu ukyuli ɔni geen lɛlɔ na Mose ku kenye bediene bénweni ala básiku-nwu lɛlɔ bése na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo! Anwu ndi Yoseƒ ubidi Yesu ɔni nási Nasaret!”

english_verse: Nathanael asked, “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Philip answered, “Come and see.”
translation_verse: Natanael údie kenye ɔnini, “Dɛ! Bɔsi na lɛla lɛbuni lɛdi lɛdubɔsi Nasaret ntu?” Ƒilipo ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ bo, na abanu!”

english_verse: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said, “Here is a true descendant of our ancestor Israel. And he isn't deceitful.”
translation_verse: Ka bákpɛ beedé na Yesu ɔ́nu ka Natanael ɔdubo ni, ɔ́su-nwu lɛlɔ kɔtɛ ɔnini, “Bɛɛnu ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔdubo na ulatɔlɔ bekyuli. Ɔdi Israelni geen!”

english_verse: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
translation_verse: Natanael úye-nwu ɔnini, “Dɛ na ábla na agyi ukyuli ɔni udu na ndi?” Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Mɔɔnu-ɔ kukuuku na kɔdingyii kɔni kalɔ na eli asa na Ƒilipo úbo úbalɔ-ɔ.”

english_verse: Nathanael said, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Natanael ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Rabi, awɔ ndi Katɔti Ubidi. Awɔ ndi Israelƒuɔ Ɔga.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye-nwu ɔnini, “Áƒɔ ala amɛni ƒui ádi ɔsika lɛ́su-ɔ nnii lɛ́nu-ɔ na kɔdingyii kɔmmɔ kalɔ ɔsu? Adubɔnu budie bɔtina bunengudi butulo bɔmɛni.

english_verse: I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.”
translation_verse: Litemi geen na mɔɔsu-ɔ ka ni, adubɔnu ka katɔ kálɛmi na Katɔti batu baakɔ́ teesie katɔ taayu teebo ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Three days later Mary, the mother of Jesus, was at a wedding feast in the village of Cana in Galilee.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛtɛdi lɛni nsia ni, bekyuli badi baawɛɛ uleku ɔdi na ɔma ɔni baalɔ Kana na Galilea kalɔ lɛlɔ. Mmɔ ni, Yesu uni Maria lɛnɔ ɔ́kya bebunkune bammɔ akɔ.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples had also been invited and were there.
translation_verse: Na bálɔ Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane lɛnɔ banii bebo uleku ketikɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: When the wine was all gone, Mary said to Jesus, “They don't have any more wine.”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ntɛ bɔni básala bɔ́sa ni, Yesu uni úbo Yesu kudɔ úbasu-nwu lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ mɛni ɔnini, “Ntɛ bɔmmɔ bútedu.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Mother, my time hasn't yet come! You must not tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Uleku, ɔɔɔdi awɔ masu-mi lɛla lɛni mabla. Uwi ɔni na mete kebunku útedu tɔ.”

english_verse: Mary then said to the servants, “Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu uni ɔ́su kabla bablane bani nnye mmɔ ɔnini, “Binye kagyumana na bɛbla lɛla lɛni na wasu-mii ɔnii bɛbla.”

english_verse: At the feast there were six stone water jars that were used by the people for washing themselves in the way that their religion said they must. Each jar held about
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, atabi kutubui bonwu aku alɛ mmɔ. Na kadi biala kadubɔƒɔ aani alɔkumbui ene iye aku. Aku na Yudaƒuɔ béteeti taabla bana lɛlɔ bɔƒɔ ɔdi.

english_verse: Jesus told the servants to fill them to the top with water. Then after the jars had been filled,
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su kabla bablane bammɔ ɔnii bedu ntu bewi-ku kemmo. Anwuɔsu bédu ntu béyile-ku tɛtɛɛtɛ utédu atu.

english_verse: he said, “Now take some water and give it to the man in charge of the feast.” The servants did as Jesus told them,
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bidu bɔdi bisienku ukyuli ɔni muubo ntɛ ɔda.” Na bédu-mu bésienku-nwu.

english_verse: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over
translation_verse: Ka unengu ɔmɛni útu ntu bɔni nénwini ntɛ mɛni ɔ́nu ni, útati kesii kani na ntɛ bɔmmɔ bɔ́si. Nsu kabla bablane bani nédu ntu bɔmmɔ ama báti. Anwuɔsu unengu ɔmmɔ ɔ́lɔ uleku ɔgya,

english_verse: and said, “The best wine is always served first. Then after the guests have had plenty, the other wine is served. But you have kept the best until last!”
translation_verse: na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Bi na ábla mɛni? Ntɛ bɔbuni na bekyuli pii beeti teese kalɔ na si uwi ɔni na báani na búdu-ma ɔkwɛ asa beeti bukpidi teeboku. Nsu awɔ ni, ɔƒɛni na édie ntɛ bɔbuni keyi!”

english_verse: But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple.
translation_verse: Nsu bátati ka Yesu ɔ́tɛmi ɔ́siku nwuna ɔlɔna lɛlɔ aani Katɔti kakpakɔ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Lebo lɛmmɔ ni, uwi ɔdaku budu ka badi Yudaƒuɔ Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi, na Yesu lɛnɔ úsie Yerusalem.

english_verse: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yesu úlii kɔbuli kɔdi ɔ́sala na ɔ́bɔku-ma ku baƒonu ku ɔmantɛ bakɔ bammɔ ɔ́lɛku mmɔ. Amu na úgyingya egulabi ammɔ úwi kalɔ na únwini bana ala kasiakɔ úbi kalɔ.

english_verse: The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, “My love for your house burns in me like a fire.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, nwuna batɛyane bényimo lɛla lɛni nkya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ka Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔ́su Katɔti ɔnini, “Ƒula ɔtɔ lɛlɔ bɔnu anumi adubo-mi bugyie aani ogya ɔni mɔɔda na mina lɛlɔ kemmo.”

english_verse: “Destroy this temple,” Jesus answered, “and in three days I will build it again!”
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Bɛƒɛ Katɔti ɔtɔ ɔmɛni, na ndubɔtalaku-nwu linyene limeyi lɛtɛdi lɛlɔ!”

english_verse: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.
translation_verse: Ka údu Katɔti kakpakɔ ɔtɔ anumi ni, ɔ́nu ka beyedine belie beeyé ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku baƒonu ku babloduma bete lɛkpa. Na egulabi bavumanane lɛnɔ belie bana egulabi kasiakɔ.

english_verse: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”
translation_verse: Amu na úsie bekyuli bani muuyé babloduma kudɔ na ɔ́bɔku-ma ɔnini, “Bɛda ala amɛni bidie mɛni, na biteti mina Ɔti ɔtɔ bitenwini kuye kadikɔ!”

english_verse: The Jewish leaders asked Jesus, “What miracle will you work to show us why you have done this?”
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, Yudaƒuɔ batɔnkune bádɔnku Yesu banini, “Ɔma nátala-a lɛla lɛmɛni udu bɔbla? Akɔla budie bɔtina bɔmani na adubɔbla na eti atina-bu kenyekɔ kani na ebo ɔsu na aabla lɛni?”

english_verse: And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus. Jesus Knows What People Are Like
translation_verse: Kama ƒui ka Katɔti ɔ́gyila-nwu ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ úboku ngba ni, asa na nwuna batɛyane bényimo ka ɔ́su lɛni. Anwuɔsu báƒɔ ala ani na bénweni na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ku ala ani na Yesu ɔ́su mmɔ bádi. Yesu Ɔgyi Ukyuli Ɔyawine Udu Nwaa

english_verse: In Jerusalem during Passover many people put their faith in Jesus, because they saw him work miracles.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ɔ́kya Yerusalem na Kukpi Lili Bɔvia uwi kemmo ni, bekyuli pii bánu akɔla lidu lidu lɛni na ɔ́bla na báƒɔ-nwu bádi ka ubo Katɔti ɔyikun.

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him.
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu útanyonu lɛlɔ útete bekyuli bammɔ, ɔsika ɔgyi bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: No one had to tell him what people were like. He already knew.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu uláwia ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔtina-nwu lɛla lɛdi na ukyuli lɛlɔ, ɔsika anwu ɔlati ɔgyi ukyuli ɔyawine udu geen.

english_verse: There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Yudaƒuɔ ɔtɔnkune ɔdi ɔkya ɔni nkya lɛkpa lɛni baalɔ Ƒarisiƒuɔ akɔ, na baalɔ-nwu banii Nikodemo.

english_verse: One night he went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.”
translation_verse: Ɔ́bɛ úbo Yesu kudɔ usien na úbeye-nwu ɔnini, “Ala ɔtinane, buvele, bula ƒui bɔgyi ka awɔ nási Katɔti kudɔ ébo abatina-bu ala, ɔsika ukyuli biala ɔdi ulakana akɔla budie bɔtina bɔmɛni udu bɔbla amu ntu Katɔti uliku-nwu.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-ɔ geen ka ni, si bátasɔku ukyuli bátawɔ ni, Katɔti ulakana lɛga bɔdi na nwuna kayi kemmo.”

english_verse: Nicodemus asked, “How can a grown man ever be born a second time?”
translation_verse: Amu na Nikodemo úye-nwu ɔnini, “Bi na aasu? Dɛ na ukyuli ɔni náabi lɛlɔ wasɔ wetéduo uni kaƒɔ kemmo na basɔku-nwu bawɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-ɔ geen ka ni, si bátawɔ ukyuli bátalɛku ntu ku kɔyu kemmo ni, ulakana Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ mmɔ buduo.

english_verse: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni na ɔlɔna kemmo na básia báwɔ-nwu ni, ɔdi ɔlɔna kani. Nsu Katɔti Kɔyu kɔdubɔwɔ kɔyu kemmo bekyuli.

english_verse: Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu utabla-a dɛye dɛye si mɔɔsu nnii ɔlɛka basɔku-mii bawɔ.

english_verse: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uukpó teesie kesii kani na ɔɔyɔ́. Nsu alakana bɔti kesii kani na ɔɔsí iye kesii kani na úsela ina ka eenú-nwu kɔku. Lɛni kani na aláti kalɛ na Kɔyu kemmo kabla keeti ngba bɔwɔdi teete ukyuli.”

english_verse: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
translation_verse: Amu na Nikodemo úye-nwu ɔnini, “Dɛ na ɔmɛni udu ɔɔlɛ́?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Adi bula kadi Israelƒuɔ ala ɔtinane kemmo ɔdi. Bi ɔsu na elenu ala amɛni kalɔ?

english_verse: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-ɔ geen ka bɔɔtɛmi taasiku ala ani na bɔgyi lɛlɔ, na buudie ani na bɔ́nu kenye teete-mii. Nsu bilaƒɔ ala ani kenye na buudie teete-mii taadi.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: Na si mɔɔsu-mii ala ani mɔɔlɛ́ bina akɔ na kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni na bilaƒɔ-mi taadi ni, dɛ na bɛdubɔkana na bɛƒɔ-mi bɛdi si lɛ́su-mii lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ na katɔ?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi útesie katɔ utatáwia ala amɛni udu ntu ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi kani. Na ami kani nási katɔ líbo kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.
translation_verse: “Bínu na Mose ɔku kalɛ na ɔ́kana kɔlakpi kɔni bávɔ ku lɛbuala ɔ́mana ugyii lɛlɔ, na ɔ́kɔliku-ku katɔ na ketele kukuuku kalɛ na bekyuli bammɔ bakɛ ngba. Lɛni kani na ɔlɛka bakɔliku ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi katɔ,

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: kalɛ na ukyuli biala ɔni maƒɔ-mi madi ni, ɔkɛ ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii.

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: “Ka Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́ bayawine geen ɔsu ni, úti Ubidi unwi pɛ ɔmmɔ úte. Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-nwu taadi ni, ulayii. Mmomu ɔdubɔkɛ ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti útatala Ubidi ɔnii ubadu bekyuli bayawine kɔtɔ. Mmomu ɔkɛnku Ubidi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ubedie-ma na bakɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: “Bekyuli bani mɔɔƒɔ́-nwu taadi ni, Katɔti uládu-ma kɔtɔ. Nsu bekyuli bani naaadubo-nwu bɔƒɔ bɔdi ni, Katɔti ɔ́ɔtɛku-ma litemi kukuuku na ɔ́ɔdu-ma kɔtɔ ka bátaƒɔ Katɔti Ubidi unwi pɛ bátadi ɔsu.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni ɔsu na ɔ́du-ma kɔtɔ ndi ka bukeye bɔ́si katɔ búbo kayawi, nsu bekyuli báyɔ lɛdisa bétulo bukeye bɔmmɔ. Ɔsika bana ablala adi likyulikpi ala.

english_verse: People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔbla likyulikpi ala ni, ukisi bukeye na ulakpɛ teede-mu. Ɔsika ɔɔyia ka nwuna ablala adubɔlɛ keyi na Katɔti ɔdubɔni-nwu kɔtu.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli biala ɔni nda nwuna ngba na ulu lɛlɔ geen ni, ɔɔkpɛ́ teede bukeye. Ɔsika ɔɔwia ka bukeye bɔmmɔ budie nwuna Katɔti bɔsiaku ablala atina.” Yohane Ɔ́tɛmi Ɔ́siku Yesu Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama ni, Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane bátɔlɔ Yerusalem bésie likpo bamba na Yudea kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ bátákya emeyi alɛɛ adi. Na bákya mmɔ bátaabla ketu kemmo ntu bɔkpila ɔdi teete bekyuli.

english_verse: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.
translation_verse: Limeyi linwi lɛdi ni, Yohane batɛyane ku Yudani ɔdi bése kalɔ baakya unyeƒi na ntu bɔkpi ɔdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bébo Yohane kudɔ na béye-nwu banini, “Ala ɔtinane, buvele, ukyuli ɔni na átina-bu na Yordan Ketu ɔvi ngye na édie-nwu kenye ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔɔbla ketu kemmo ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmɛni. Ɔdia kalɛ na bula bekyuli ƒui békeli bésela-nwu kudɔ mɛni?”

english_verse: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.
translation_verse: Yohane údie kenye ɔnini, “Ukyuli biala ulakɛ lɛla lɛdi si ɔɔɔdi Katɔti néte-nwu lɛla lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Amii alati bɛdubudie-mi kenye ka lɛ́su-mii nwaa nnii ɔɔɔdi ami ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ. Nsu Katɔti ɔ́tala-mi ka lɛgyu lɛtɔ-nwu.

english_verse: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, anwu ɔni ndi uleku ɔgya ɔmmɔ mbo uleku. Na uleku ɔgya ɔkpana ɔni nnye uleku buti kabla kamɛni kenye ni, si uwi ɔni na uleku ɔgya ku uleku ɔmmɔ bása baatɛmi bana lɛlɔyɔ atɛ ni, uunye teenu-nya ku ebiti. Lɛni kani na ami lɛnɔ ebiti aada-mi geen aani uleku ɔgya ɔkpana ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important. The One Who Comes from Heaven
translation_verse: Nwuna lɛnyi ɔlɛka lɛkɔ katɔ, na mina lɛdi lɛyii lɛkya.

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: “Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔni na katɔ na ɔ́si ni, utulo ukyuli biala. Na ukyuli ɔni nási kalɔ lɛnɔ ni, kalɔ ukyuli kani na ɔdi. Na ɔɔtɛmi ala taasiku kalɔ lɛlɔ. Anwu ɔni nási Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ni, utulo ukyuli biala.

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: Na anwu muudie ala ani na ɔ́nu ku ani na únu mmɔ kalɔ. Nsu ɛlɛɛ kani mɔɔƒɔ́-nwu taadi.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Bani mɔɔƒɔ́-nwu taadi ni, beedie taatina nwaa ka ala ani na Katɔti ɔɔsu ni, anya ndi litemi geen.

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́tala ni, anwu mɔɔsu Katɔti etemila. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔ́tala nwuna Kɔyu ɔnii kubelie ukyuli ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ku kuna ɔyikun ƒui.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́ Ubidi na úti lɛla biala ɔ́kya nwuna enu kemmo.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: “Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́ Ubidi ɔmɛni taadi ni, ubo ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii. Na ukyuli ɔni muuní ka ɔdi Ubidi litemi lɛlɔ ni, ulákɛ ngba bɔmmɔ. Mmomu Katɔti kɔnyi kɔdubo butaasiaku-nwu.”

english_verse: But Jesus' disciples were really the ones doing the baptizing, and not Jesus himself. Jesus and the Samaritan Woman
translation_verse: ina ka ɔɔɔdi anwu ɔlati nátaabla ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmɛni, mmomu nwuna batɛyane nátaabla-mu.

english_verse: Jesus left Judea and started for Galilee again.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́ti ka Ƒarisiƒuɔ bénu ɔmɛni ni, ɔ́tɔlɔ Yudea kalɔ lɛlɔ únwini úsie Galilea.

english_verse: This time he had to go through Samaria,
translation_verse: Na nwuna ulu busie kemmo ni, ɔlɛka ɔsia Samaria kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
translation_verse: Uleku ɔmɛni úye-nwu ɔnini, “Bi ɔsu na awɔ Yudani eevele ami Samariani ntu?” Ɔ́su ɔmɛni ɔsika Yudaƒuɔ balákya Samariaƒuɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Uleku ɔmmɔ úye-nwu ɔnini, “Ɔbune, na ka eeebo lɛla lɛni na eti edu-mu edie na libiɔ lɛmɛni lɛnɔ lɛ́gyu ni, wɛ na adubo ntu bɔni mɔɔgbá na buute ngba mmɔ bɔkɛ?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: Munuu butulo na etulo bula Nana Yakob ɔni néku libiɔ lɛmɛni? Ntu bɔmmɔ na anwu ku nwuna bebi ku bebuo ƒui báni.”

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: Nsu ntu bɔni na ndubute ni, utukwɛ ɔsɔ ulada ukyuli ɔni mani-mu. Mmomu bɔdubunwini libiɔ lɛni mɔɔyu na bana lɛlɔ kemmo, na ɔdubute-ma ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii.”

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu uleku ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ati, buvele nda-a, te-mi ntu bɔmmɔ bɔdi na utukwɛ ɔsɔ ulada-mi kudii, na nsɔ neeeteebo mɛni limeyi ndi limeyi.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Teesie na atákpanku ƒ'ɔgyani eboku.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, uleku ɔmɛni údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɔbune, mɔɔtí ka Katɔti kenye udiene na adi!

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Abu Samariaƒuɔ bɔgyi ka kɔbi kɔmɛni lɛlɔ kani na bula nana bene bábla lɛkpa. Nsu bi náya na amii Yudaƒuɔ bɛɛsu bɛnii Yerusalem kani ndi likpo lɛni na ɔlɛka bɔɔkpá?”

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Uleku, ƒɔ-mi litemi lɛni mɔɔsu-ɔ mɛni di ka ni, uwi ɔdubo ɔni na ɔɔɔdi kɔbi kɔmɛni lɛlɔ iye Yerusalem na ɔlɛka bɛkpa Katɔti.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni amii Samariaƒuɔ ni, bɛɛkpá lɛla lɛni bɛɛɛgyi. Nsu abu Yudaƒuɔ ni, abu bɔgyi ala bɔ́siku-nwu lɛlɔ. Ɔsika bekyuli budie na likpidi kemmo ni, Yudaƒuɔ akɔ na bɔ́si bubo.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔdubo na úudu lɛnɔ ɔni na bekyuli bani nsiaku Katɔti na ulu geen lɛlɔ ni, badubɔkɔliku-nwu lɛnyi katɔ ku Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun na litemi geen kemmo. Ɔsika ama ndi basiakune bani na Katɔti ɔɔwia.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Ka Katɔti ɔdi Kɔyu ɔsu ni, ɔlɛka bekyuli bani nsiaku-nwu ƒui bakɔliku-nwu lɛnyi katɔ ku nwuna Kɔyu ɔyikun na litemi geen kemmo.”

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Amu na uleku ɔmmɔ ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Ngyi ka Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔni baalɔ Kristo ɔdubo. Na si úbo ni, ɔdubo lɛla biala kalɔ budie bute-bu.”

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Ami ɔni mɔɔtɛmiku-ɔ mɛni ndi Anwu ɔmmɔ.”

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, nwuna batɛyane bási bébeduo, na ɔ́bla-ma dɛye dɛye ka bánu ka ɔɔtɛmiku uleku ɔmɛni. Nsu ɔdi úteye Yesu ɔnini, “Bi na aawia?” iye “Bi ɔsu na aatɛmiku-nwu?”

english_verse: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmɛni ni, uleku ɔmmɔ ɔ́da nwuna ketubui úse libiɔ lɛmmɔ kɔtu na únwini úsie ɔma kemmo na útásu ukyuli biala ɔnini,

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: “Bibo na bibanu ukyuli ɔni násu-mi ala ani ƒui na lɛ́bla na ngba kemmo! Ɔdubɔkana na wadi Katɔti Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ?”

english_verse: Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bekyuli bammɔ bási ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo bésie banii batánu-nwu.

english_verse: While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Yesu batɛyane bévele-nwu banii, “Ala ɔtinane, di lɛla lɛdi.”

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ami mbo adila ani na mɔɔdi, na bɛɛɛgyi-nya.”

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu béye lɛlɔ banini, “Ukyuli ɔdi néboku-nwu adila?”

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Mina adila ndi ka lɛbla anwu ɔni nátala-mi lɛƒɔyɔ na lɛwɔlɔ kabla kani na úte-mi ka mbabla.

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: Bɔgyi ka baasu banii si ákya edula ni, abuli ene kama asa bɔɔƒɛ-nya. Nsu ndaku-mii bɔsu nnii útalɛka bunye butédu uwi ɔmmɔ. Edula ammɔ áabi! Bɛtalaku anumi na bɛnu ka edula ammɔ éegyie ka baƒɛ.

english_verse: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔɔƒɔ edula ɔƒɛne biala kayu kabuni na edula ani na ɔdaku bɔsala teewi linwu lɛni nnye Katɔti kudɔ kemmo ute ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii ɔsu. Na ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, edula ɔkyane ku edula ɔƒɛne ƒui badubɔkɛ ebiti geen.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu lɛsugba lɛmɛni lɛdi litemi geen ka ni, ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔkya edula, na ukyuli ɔbambadi mɔɔƒɛ-nya.

english_verse: I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.
translation_verse: Lɛ́tala-mii nnii bitáƒɛ edula ani na ɔɔɔdi amii nákya-nya. Bekyuli bamba nábla kabla kpakplaa kamɛni na edula amɛni bɔƒɛ kɔsia kani na amii bíbakɛ.” Samariaƒuɔ Pii Báƒɔ Yesu Bádi

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Samariaƒuɔ bénu ka uleku ɔmmɔ ɔ́su ɔnii, “Yesu ɔ́su-mi lɛla lɛni na lɛ́bla na mina ngba kemmo” ni, bana akɔ pii bése kalɔ baaƒɔ́ Yesu taadi.

english_verse: They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.
translation_verse: Ka bálɛ bébo bábanu Yesu na libiɔ lɛmɛni kudɔ ni, bévele-nwu banii ɔkya-ma kudɔ.

english_verse: Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́tuna na ɔ́kya-ma kudɔ emeyi anyɔ. Na bekyuli babambadi pii lɛnɔ bani nénu ala ani na ɔɔsu ni, báƒɔ-nwu bádi.

english_verse: They told the woman, “We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world!” Jesus Heals an Official's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: Kama ni, bekyuli bammɔ básu uleku ɔmmɔ banini, “Ɔƒɛni bɔdaku bɔƒɔ taadi, ɔsika abu alati búnu nwuna etemila, na ɔɔɔdi lɛla lɛni na ásu lɛti pɛ ɔsu. Sɔsɔ na ɔdi, bɔ́ti ka anwu ndi bekyuli bayawine Ɔƒɔne.”

english_verse: Jesus had said, “Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country.” Then two days later he left
translation_verse: Na ina ka Yesu ɔ́su dii ɔnii Katɔti kenye udiene ɔdi biala uuubo ɔbu na anwu ɔlati nwuna kalɔ lɛlɔ ni,

english_verse: and went to Galilee. The people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he had done.
translation_verse: Galileaƒuɔ bégyingya enu báƒɔ-nwu. Ɔsika bésie Yerusalem uwi ɔni na baadi Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi, na bánu lɛla biala lɛni na ɔ́bla.

english_verse: Jesus told the official, “You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders!”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Si bítanu ka lɛbla akɔla budie taatina ni, biláƒɔ-mi biladi.”

english_verse: The man replied, “Lord, please come before my son dies!”
translation_verse: Unengu ɔmɛni úvele-nwu ɔnini, “Ɔbune, buvele nda-a, bo na abanu mina ubi kalɛ na ulekpi.”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “Your son will live. Go on home to him.” The man believed Jesus and started back home.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Teesie. Ƒ'ubidi uli ngba.” Unengu ɔmɛni ɔ́ƒɔ lɛla lɛni na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔ́di na ɔ́sɔ únwini úsela ɔma.

english_verse: Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, “Your son is better!”
translation_verse: Ka ɔkɛ ulu ni, nwuna kabla bablane badi bébo bábasiaku-nwu na básu-nwu banii ubidi ɔ́ta.

english_verse: He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, “The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.”
translation_verse: Úye-ma uwi ɔni geen na ubi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ líse kalɔ lɛɛbla-nwu buɛɛ. Na bédie kenye banini, “Kamaadi ɔƒiiwi aani ɔdɔ unwi kemmo na ogya bɔƒɔ bɔmmɔ bɔ́nyonu-nwu.”

english_verse: The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́nu ɔ́ti ka uwi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ geen na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ƒ'ubidi uli ngba.” Na unengu ɔmɛni ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli ƒui báƒɔ Yesu bádi.

english_verse: This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ndi akɔla budie bɔtina kunyɔdi bɔni na Yesu ɔ́bla na Galilea ka ɔ́si Yudea kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for another Jewish festival.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie Yerusalem na Yudaƒuɔ limeyi lɛdi bɔdi ɔsu.

english_verse: In the city near the sheep gate was a pool with five porches, and its name in Hebrew was Bethzatha.
translation_verse: Na ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo kesii kani nde likpo lɛni baalɔ Baƒonu Kayakun kudɔ ni, lɛba blii lɛdi lɛ́kya mmɔ lɛni baalɔ Betesda na Hebri butemi kemmo. Bábla kɔgbakɛ ɛlɔ báka bamana lɛba lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: Beside the pool was a man who had been sick for
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ɔtɛ mmɔ ɔni náatɛ ɔlɛ akwa avlaatɛ-maane sɔɔn.

english_verse: You have not believed his message, because you refused to have faith in the one he sent.
translation_verse: Nsu biláda-nwu litemi kaduɛ, ɔsika bíni na bítaƒɔ bítadi ka ami ndi ukyuli ɔni na ɔ́tala ɔ́kya-mii.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the man and realized that he had been crippled for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be healed?”
translation_verse: Na ka Yesu ɔ́nu-nwu ka ɔtɛ mmɔ na ɔ́ti ka úuƒi akwa pii ni, úye-nwu ɔnini, “Aayɔ́ ka ƒula ɔlɛ ɔba-a?”

english_verse: The man answered, “Sir, I don't have anyone to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up. I try to get in, but someone else always gets there first.”
translation_verse: Ɔlɛne ɔmɛni údie kenye ɔnini, “Ati, liiibo ukyuli ɔni mebunku-mi na liduo lɛba lɛmmɔ kemmo si uwi ɔni na ntu bɔmmɔ bɔɔkunku. Si uwi ɔni na mɔɔkya ɔkplu ka liduo ni, ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́ɔka bɔgyu bɔtɔ butéduo kukuuku.”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Pick up your mat and walk!”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ta nye! Ti ƒula lɛtala na eteesie.”

english_verse: Right then the man was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking around. The day on which this happened was a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Mmɔ mmɔ ni, ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔlɛ ɔ́ba-nwu! Na úti nwuna lɛtala na úsie. Na limeyi lɛni na ala amɛni álɛ ni, ɔdi lɛnwunameyi.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders saw the man carrying his mat, they said to him, “This is the Sabbath! No one is allowed to carry a mat on the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka Yudaƒuɔ benengu bánu ɔnana ɔmɛni ku nwuna lɛtala ni, básu-nwu banini, “Ɔɔɔdi ulu ka agyu ƒula atɛla eti lɛni na ɔmwi lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ. Áta énye bula ɔda bubo lɛlɔ!”

english_verse: But he replied, “The man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and walk.”
translation_verse: Nsu ɔnana ɔmɛni údie kenye ɔnini, “Lɛni na ukyuli ɔni nábwi-mi ɔ́su-mi ɔnii, ‘Ti ƒula lɛtala na eteesie.’ ”

english_verse: They asked him, “Who is this man that told you to pick up your mat and walk?”
translation_verse: Amu na béye-nwu banini, “Ɔma ndi ukyuli ɔni násu-ɔ ɔnii ɔlɛka eti-ni na esie?”

english_verse: But he did not know who Jesus was, and Jesus had left because of the crowd.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔnana ɔmmɔ útati lɛla lɛdi útásu na Yesu lɛlɔ. Na Yesu lɛnɔ ɔ́ɔyii ɔ́kya bekyuli bammɔ akɔ.

english_verse: Later, Jesus met the man in the temple and told him, “You are now well. But don't sin anymore or something worse might happen to you.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu ɔ́nu-nwu na Katɔti kakpakɔ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Nu! Ɔƒɛni lɛlɔ lɛ́sɔ lɛ́yu-ɔ ɔkplu. Na tasɔ telie ataabla likpidi! Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, lɛla lɛni ntulo lɛmɛni lɛdubo-ɔ bɔbla!”

english_verse: The man left and told the leaders that Jesus was the one who had healed him.
translation_verse: Amu na ukyuli ɔmɛni úsie útánu Yudaƒuɔ benengu na ɔ́su-ma ka Yesu ndi ukyuli ɔni nábwi-nwu.

english_verse: They started making a lot of trouble for Jesus because he did things like this on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bése kalɔ ku Yesu bukpoku, ɔsika lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ na ɔ́bwi-nwu.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “My Father has never stopped working, and this is why I keep on working.”
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Mina Ɔti uubunku bekyuli limeyi ndi limeyi, na ɔlɛka ami lɛnɔ lɛbla lɛni kani.”

english_verse: Now the leaders wanted to kill Jesus for two reasons. First, he had broken the law of the Sabbath. But even worse, he had said God was his Father, which made him equal with God. The Son's Authority
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni bɔsu ɔsu ni, Yudaƒuɔ benengu básɔ báwia ulu bébu ka badu-nwu. Ɔsika na lɛnwunameyi ɔda bubo lɛlɔ tadi kama ni, ɔ́sɔ ɔ́tɛmi ɔ́siku Katɔti lɛlɔ aani Ɔti kalɛ. Na ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka anwu ku Katɔti bese likeke.

english_verse: Jesus told the people: I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-mii geen nnii ami Katɔti Ubidi naaakana lɛla lɛdi bɔbla na ami ɔlati ɔyikun kemmo. Mmomu lɛla lɛni na mɔɔnu ka mina Ɔti ɔɔbla ni, ani kani na ami lɛnɔ mɔɔbla. Anwuɔsu mina Ɔti ablala kama na ami Ubi lɛnɔ nsia.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Ati ɔɔyɔ́ ami Ubidi na ɔɔtina-mi lɛla biala lɛni na ɔɔbla. Na ɔdubɔtina-mi ala ani na lɛbla litulo ɔmɛni na ɔdubo-mii bɔbla kalɛ kadi.

english_verse: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kalɛ na mina Ɔti ɔɔgyila bekpine na beelie ngba ni, lɛni kani na ami Ubidi lɛnɔ muuti ngba teete bani na mɔɔyɔ́ ka lite ngba.

english_verse: The Father doesn't judge anyone, but he has made his Son the judge of everyone.
translation_verse: Na lɛnɔ ni, mina Ɔti ɔlati ulatɛku ukyuli ɔdi litemi. Mmomu ɔ́ɔnyonu likpidi biala litemi bɔtɛ úte ami Ubidi,

english_verse: The Father wants all people to honor the Son as much as they honor him. When anyone refuses to honor the Son, this is the same as refusing to honor the Father who sent him.
translation_verse: kalɛ na ukyuli biala utaabu Ubidi aani kalɛ kani na baabu Ɔti. Nsu si bíni na bilábu ami Katɔti Ubidi ɔni na ɔ́tala ɔ́kya-mii ni, bilábu Ɔti lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who hears my message and has faith in the one who sent me has eternal life and will never be condemned. They have already gone from death to life.
translation_verse: “Na mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ni, ukyuli ɔni muunú-mi litemi na ɔɔƒɔ́ Katɔti ɔni nátala-mi taadi ni, uli ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii. Na Katɔti uládu-nwu kɔtɔ na nwuna ekpidi ɔsu. Mmomu ɔ́ɔvia kukpi ntu úduo ngba bɔwɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live!
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-mii geen ka uwi ɔdubo na úudu lɛnɔ ɔni na bekyuli bani nékpi ni, badubunu Katɔti Ubi lɛdi. Na bekyuli bani ndubunu-ni na baƒɔ litemi lɛmmɔ ni, badubulie ngba geen.

english_verse: The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na ngba ƒui bɔɔsí mina Ɔti kudɔ ni, lɛni kani na ɔ́ya na ngba ƒui bɔɔsí ami Ubidi lɛnɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Na úte-mi ɔyikun ɔni na lɛtɛku kayawi ƒui litemi, ɔsika ami ndi Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi.

english_verse: Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man,
translation_verse: “Ɔmɛni utabla-mii kalɛ kadi. Ɔsika uwi ɔdubo ɔni na bekyuli bani nékpi ƒui badubunu-mi lɛdi.

english_verse: and they will come out of their graves. Everyone who has done good things will rise to life, but everyone who has done evil things will rise and be condemned.
translation_verse: Na bana ƒui badubo bɔta balɛ bana kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo. Na bani nábla lɛbuni ni, badubɔta bebelie ngba. Na bani nábla likpidi ni, badubɔta bebeduo kɔtɔ bɔdu kemmo.

english_verse: I cannot do anything on my own. The Father sent me, and he is the one who told me how to judge. I judge with fairness, because I obey him, and I don't just try to please myself. Witnesses to Jesus
translation_verse: “Lɛɛɛdubo lɛla lɛdi bɔkana bɔbla na ami ɔlati ɔyikun kemmo. Mmomu ndubɔtɛku bekyuli litemi aani kalɛ na mina Ɔti ɔ́su-mi. Anwuɔsu mina litemi bɔtɛ buse siin, ɔsika naaabla mina lɛƒɔyɔ. Mmomu Katɔti ɔni nátala-mi ni, nwuna lɛƒɔyɔ na mɔɔbla. Yohane Údie Yesu Kenye

english_verse: If I speak for myself, there is no way to prove I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: “Si muudie mina lɛlɔ kenye ni, bɛgyi bɛnii kenye budie bɔmmɔ buuubo ɔkplu.

english_verse: But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true.
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli ɔdi lɛnɔ ɔkya ɔni muudie-mi kenye, na ngyi ka lɛla lɛni na ɔɔsu libo ɔkplu.

english_verse: You sent messengers to John, and he told them the truth.
translation_verse: “Bɛ́tala bekyuli bɛnii betéye Yohane ala basiku-mi lɛlɔ, na ɔ́su-ma lɛla lɛni ndi litemi geen lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved.
translation_verse: Nsu útalɛka ukyuli ɔyawine udie-mi kenye. Mmomu mɔɔsu-mii ɔmɛni kalɛ na bɛƒɔ-mi bɛdi na bɛkɛ ngba bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.
translation_verse: Yohane úkeye aani ogya ɔni mɔɔda. Na nwuna bukeye bɔmmɔ bɔ́da-mii ebiti uwi klukui ɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.
translation_verse: “Nsu kenye kani na mbo na medie ni, ketulo Yohane ɔdi ƒui. Kabla lidu lɛni na Ati úte-mi ka mbawɔlɔ na kana lɛlɔ na nnye ni, aka muudie taatina ka Anwu nátala-mi.

english_verse: The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face.
translation_verse: Na mina Ɔti ɔni nátala-mi lɛnɔ údie kenye ɔ́tina-mii ɔ́si mina lɛlɔ ina ka bítenu-nwu lɛdi iye útedie lɛlɔ útatina-mii anumi ku anumi.

english_verse: You search the Scriptures, because you think you will find eternal life in them. The Scriptures tell about me,
translation_verse: Bɛɛtɛya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ala uwi biala ku kakali ka si bɛ́bla lɛni ni, bɛdubɔkɛ ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadu bɔsa kudii. Na ɔku ɔmmɔ geen muudie kenye taasiku-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: but you refuse to come to me for eternal life.
translation_verse: Nsu biiní ka bibo-mi kudɔ na lɛya na bɛkɛ ngba bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: I don't care about human praise,
translation_verse: “Naaawia bekyuli bayawine bumwi.

english_verse: but I do know that none of you love God.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ngyi-mii kaduɛ ka bilayɔ Katɔti.

english_verse: I have come with my Father's authority, and you have not welcomed me. But you will welcome people who come on their own.
translation_verse: Ngyi ɔmɛni ɔsika líbo-mii kudɔ nnye na mina Ɔti kenyekɔ, nsu bítegyingya enu bítaƒɔ-mi. Na binye kagyumana ka bɛƒɔ ukyuli ɔni nnye anwu ɔlati kenye mmomu.

english_verse: How could you possibly believe? You like to have your friends praise you, and you don't care about praise that the only God can give!
translation_verse: Dɛ na ɔdubɔbla asa na bɛƒɔ-mi bɛdi ka bilie bɛɛwia bumwi taasiku bina lɛlɔ kudɔ, na biláwia ka Anwu ɔni lɛti pɛ ndi Katɔti umwi-mii?

english_verse: Don't think that I will be the one to accuse you to the Father. You have put your hope in Moses, yet he is the very one who will accuse you.
translation_verse: “Nsu bitakali bɛnii ami ndubo-mii kɔtɔ bɔdu na mina Ɔti kudɔ! Mose ɔni ɔda bubo lɛlɔ na bibo katɔ busie lɛnunsia ni, anwu mmomu ndubo-mii kɔtɔ bɔdu!

english_verse: Moses wrote about me, and if you had believed Moses, you would have believed me.
translation_verse: Si bɔƒɔ na bɛ́ƒɔ Mose bɛ́di ni, nka bɛdubɔƒɔ-mi bɛdi! Ɔsika únweni ala ɔ́siku-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But if you don't believe what Moses wrote, how can you believe what I say?
translation_verse: Nsu ka bilaƒɔ ala ani na únweni taadi ni, dɛ bɛdubɔkana na bɛƒɔ lɛla lɛni mɔɔsu-mii bɛdi?”

english_verse: The disciples gathered them up and filled twelve large baskets with what was left over from the five barley loaves.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu básala kakpa bodobodo kɔkɛ kɔmmɔ ƒui na kúyi kɔgyigyɛ leevu-inyɔ.

english_verse: The disciples wanted to take him into the boat, but suddenly the boat reached the shore where they were headed. The Bread That Gives Life
translation_verse: Amu na lɛlɔ lɛ́yɔ-ma! Na ka Yesu ɔ́kɔ úduo ɔkɔlɔ kemmo ni, bánu ka béduo likpo lɛni bésela kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: They replied, “What miracle will you work, so that we can have faith in you? What will you do?

english_verse: No one can come to me, unless the Father who sent me makes them want to come. But if they do come, I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ulakana-mi kudɔ bubo si ɔɔɔdi Ati ɔni nátala-mi náya na ɔ́ni úde-mi. Na ndubɔgyila-nwu na limeyi likplodi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: “There is a boy here who has five small loaves of barley bread and two fish. But what good is that with all these people?”
translation_verse: “Okloƒu ɔdi ulie mɛni na ɔda kakpa bodobodo ɛlɔ ku kɔkpaku inyɔ. Nsu bi na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔbla bekyuli pii bamɛni?”

english_verse: The ground was covered with grass, and Jesus told his disciples to tell everyone to sit down. About
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Bɛya na bekyuli bammɔ bayu belie kalɔ.” Na livo pii liwi mmɔ, na bana ƒui báyu bélie kalɔ. Na banana lɛti bumomo bɔbla aani mpim ɛlɔ.

english_verse: They got into a boat and started across for Capernaum. Later that evening Jesus had still not come to them,
translation_verse: Na bákɔ béduo ɔkɔlɔ kemmo, na bávia bésela Kapernaum, ɔsika kadi kása na Yesu útebo-ma tɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: Jesus crossed Lake Galilee, which was also known as Lake Tiberias.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu ɔ́via ɛpu ɔni baalɔ banii Galilea Ɛpu na básɔ baalɔ-nwu Tiberia Ɛpu úsie nwuna ɔvi unyɔdi.

english_verse: A large crowd had seen him work miracles to heal the sick, and those people went with him.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli pii badi basiaku-nwu, ɔsika bánu akɔla budie bɔtina bɔni na Yesu ɔ́bla na uwi ɔni na ɔ́bwi balɛne ɔsu.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Jewish festival of Passover, and Jesus went up on a mountain with his disciples and sat down.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Yudaƒuɔ Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi bɔdi uwi ɔdaku budu.

english_verse: Philip answered, “Don't you know that it would take almost a year's wages just to buy only a little bread for each of these people?”
translation_verse: Amu na Ƒilipo údie kenye ɔnini, “Nkyuli eti ene limeyi lɛyuƒɔla muedi nwuna bodobodo uledu na bekyuli bamɛni ƒui bakɛ badi blii blii!”

english_verse: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the disciples. He spoke up and said,
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu batɛyane akɔ unwi ɔni ndi Andrea na ɔdi Simon Petro ɔnwani ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini,

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave thanks to God. Then he passed the bread to the people, and he did the same with the fish, until everyone had plenty to eat.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úti bodobodo ɔmmɔ na ka ɔ́gya Katɔti enu ni, úle-nwu úte bani ƒui nlie kalɔ mmɔ. Lɛni kani na úti kɔkpaku lɛnɔ úle úte-ma kalɛ na baawia na bádi bémo.

english_verse: The people ate all they wanted, and Jesus told his disciples to gather up the leftovers, so that nothing would be wasted.
translation_verse: Ka bádi bémo báwɔlɔ ni, Yesu ɔ́su nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Bɛsala kɔkɛ kɔni nébu lisu kalɛ na ɔdi ulebie.”

english_verse: Jesus realized that they would try to force him to be their king. So he went up on a mountain, where he could be alone. Jesus Walks on the Water (Matthew
translation_verse: Na ka Yesu ɔ́nu ɔ́ti ka báyɔ ka beƒie-nwu ɔkplu bɔdi bese lɛga ɔsu ni, ɔ́sɔ ɔ́kpɛ ɔ́lɛ-ma akɔ úsie abi lɛlɔ anwu lɛti. Yesu Úsie Ɔ́vi Na Ɛpu Lɛlɔ

english_verse: The people who had stayed on the east side of the lake knew that only one boat had been there. They also knew that Jesus had not left in it with his disciples. But the next day
translation_verse: Ka kadi kégye ni, bekyuli bani náƒɔ lɛlɔ bátɛ ɛpu ɔvi ɔmmɔ ni, bánu ka nka ɔkɔlɔ unwi pɛ ntɛ ɛpu kɔtu mmɔ. Na uwi ɔni na Yesu batɛyane bammɔ béduo ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo na baavia ketu ni, nka Yesu ɔɔɔsiaku-ma.

english_verse: Don't work for food that spoils. Work for food that gives eternal life. The Son of Man will give you this food, because God the Father has given him the right to do so.”
translation_verse: Bitekpoku lɛlɔ bitawia adila ani muubie kama ulu. Mmomu bɛwia adila ani neeebie na ese ésela uwi ƒui. Adila ammɔ udu na ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ndubo-mii bute. Ɔsika ami na Katɔti ɔ́sia kɔnu úse.”

english_verse: One of the prophets wrote, “God will teach all of them.” And so everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him will come to me.
translation_verse: Katɔti kenye udiene ɔdi únweni ɔnii, ‘Katɔti ndubɔtina bana ƒui ala.’ Anwuɔsu ukyuli biala ɔni nénu na ɔ́tɛya ala ɔ́siku Ati kudɔ ni, anwu muubo-mi kudɔ.

english_verse: They started arguing with each other and asked, “How can he give us his flesh to eat?”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ bésie kalɔ baakya unyeƒi kpakplaa na ama alati akɔ banini, “Dɛ na ukyuli ɔmɛni wakana-bu nwuna ɔlɔna buti bute ɔnii bɔdi?”

english_verse: That evening, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake.
translation_verse: Na useyi uwi ɔmmɔ ni, nwuna batɛyane báyu bésie ɛpu kɔtu.

english_verse: and a strong wind was making the water rough.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa ɔdi úbo uukpó ɔni náya na ɛpu ɔmmɔ uukpóku lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When the disciples had rowed for five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He kept coming closer to the boat, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na béesie ɔgyu na ntu bɔmmɔ anumi aani eluku atɛ iye ene ni, bánu ka Yesu úsie ɔdubo ntu anumi na ɔ́kpɛ úde ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu ɔtɔtɔ ɔ́gyu-ma!

english_verse: But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Nsu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bitayia! Ami na ɔdi.”

english_verse: some boats from Tiberias sailed near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread for which the Lord had given thanks.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, lɛkɔlɔ bamba lɛni nási Tiberia líbo líbedi línye-ma kudɔ na kesii kani na Yesu úti bodobodo úte-ma na bádi mmɔ uwi ɔni na Blɔti ɔ́gya Katɔti enu ɔ́wɔlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: They saw that Jesus and his disciples had left. Then they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka bekyuli bammɔ bánu ka Yesu iye nwuna batɛyane beeenye mmɔ ɔsu ni, ama alati bákɔ béduo lɛkɔlɔ lɛmmɔ kemmo na bátɔlɔ bésie Kapernaum batáwia Yesu. Yesu Ndi Adila Ani Muute Ngba

english_verse: They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
translation_verse: Ka bánu Yesu na ɛpu ɔvi ɔmmɔ ni, béye-nwu banini, “Ala ɔtinane, uwi ɔmani na ébo mɛni?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ni, bodobodo ɔni na bɛ́kɛ bɛ́di bímo ɔsu na bɛɛwia-mi. Na ɔɔɔdi ɔni na bínu akɔla budie taatina ani na lɛ́bla kalɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: “What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bekyuli bammɔ béye Yesu banini, “Bi na ɔlɛka bɔbla si bɔnii bɔɔbla kabla kani na Katɔti ɔɔwia?”
