english_verse: Jesus answered, “God wants you to have faith in the one he sent.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔɔwia ka bɛbla ndi ka bɛƒɔ ukyuli ɔni na ɔ́tala bɛdi.”

english_verse: For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
translation_verse: Bula bati kuuku bádi adila ani baalɔ banii manna na ketele kemmo aani kalɛ na ɔkya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo banii, ‘Úte-ma adila ɔ́siku katɔ na bádi.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-mii geen nnii ɔɔɔdi Mose néte-mii adila ani nási katɔ. Mmomu mina Ɔti ni, anwu muute adila geen ani nási katɔ ébo.

english_verse: And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti adila geen ani na uute bekyuli ndi ami ɔni mɔɔyá na bekyuli beelie ngba.”

english_verse: The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu básu-nwu banini, “Ati, teete-bu adila ɔmɛni uwi biala.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ami ndi adila ani mɔɔyá na bekyuli beelie ngba. Na ukyuli ɔni muubo-mi kudɔ ni, kɔka kɔsɔ kulada-nwu. Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mi taadi ni, utukwɛ ɔsɔ ulada-nwu kudi kudii.

english_verse: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.
translation_verse: Nsu lɛ́su-mii nnii ina ka bɛ́ɛnu-mi ni, bilaƒɔ-mi taadi.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ƒui na Ati úte-mi ni, badubo-mi kudɔ. Na bani muubo-mi kudɔ mmɔ ni, lɛɛɛdubo-ma buni.

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: Ɔsika ńtasi katɔ ńtebo nnii mɔɔbla ami ɔlati lɛƒɔyɔ. Mmomu líbo nnii mbabla anwu ɔni nátala-mi lɛƒɔyɔ.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni nátala-mi lɛƒɔyɔ ndi ka bekyuli bani ƒui na úte-mi ni, naaayila bana akɔ ɔdi, mmomu kalɛ na lɛgyila-ma na bana ƒui basɔ bata bebelie ngba na limeyi likplodi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛla lɛni na mina Ɔti ɔɔwia ndi ka ukyuli biala ɔni muuti anu taasia ami Katɔti Ubidi lɛlɔ na ɔ́ƒɔ-mi ɔ́di ni, ɔdubɔkɛ ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii na lɛgyila-nwu na limeyi likplodi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔsɔ ubelie ngba.”

english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.
translation_verse: Amu na Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ bése kalɔ baatɛmi teewi-nwu, ɔsika ɔ́su ɔnii, “Ami ndi adila ani nási katɔ líbo” ɔsu.

english_verse: They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu béye banii, “Ɔɔɔdi Yesu ɔmɛni ndi Yoseƒ ubidi yoo? Bɔgyi ɔti ku uni. Dɛ na ɔ́bla na ɔɔsu ɔnii, ‘Katɔ na lɛ́si líbo’?”

english_verse: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ulátina ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́ɔnu Ati ɔmmɔ. Mmomu ami ɔni lɛti nási Katɔti kudɔ ni, ami lɛti náanu-nwu.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ukyuli ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mi taadi ni, uulie ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Ami ndi adila ani muute ngba.

english_verse: Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, and later they died.
translation_verse: Bina bati kuuku bádi adila ani baalɔ banii manna na ketele kemmo, nsu békpi.

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.
translation_verse: Nsu adila ani nási katɔ áyu ébo ni, adi adila ani udu na ukyuli biala ɔni madi-nya ni, ulekpi.

english_verse: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
translation_verse: Ami ndi adila ani muute ngba. Na lɛ́si katɔ lɛ́yu líbo. Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔdi adila amɛni adi ni, ɔdubo ngba bulie uwi ƒui. Na adila ani ndubute bekyuli ni, anya ndi mina ɔlɔna.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ni, si bítadi ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ɔlɔna na bɛni mina ubugya ni, biiibo ngba bɔdi na bina lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi mina ɔlɔna na ɔɔní mina ubugya ni, anwu muulie ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii. Na ndubɔgyila-nwu na limeyi likplodi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: Ɔsika mina ɔlɔna ɔdi adila geen na mina ubugya lɛnɔ ɔdi lɛla lɛnidi geen.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi mina ɔlɔna na ɔɔní mina ubugya ni, ɔɔblaku-mi unwi, na ami lɛnɔ mɔɔblaku-nwu unwi.

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na Ati ɔni nli ngba ɔ́tala-mi na ɔkɛnku anwu ɔsu na nli ngba ni, lɛni kani na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi mina ɔlɔna lɛnɔ welie ngba ɔkɛnku ami ɔsu.

english_verse: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔmɛni ndi adila ani nási katɔ áyu ébo. Na aaadi ani udu na bina bati kuuku bádi nsu békpi. Ukyuli ɔni madi adila ani mɔɔsu mɛni ni, ɔdubulie ngba uwi ƒui.”

english_verse: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
translation_verse: Ala amɛni na Yesu ɔ́tina-ma na Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ na Kapernaum.

english_verse: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
translation_verse: Ka nwuna basiakune pii bénu ɔmɛni ni, básu banii, “Litemi lɛmɛni kalɔ bunu bubo ɔkplu geen, énu! Ɔma ndubɔkana na use atu unu lɛmɛni?”

english_verse: Jesus knew that his disciples were grumbling. So he asked, “Does this bother you?
translation_verse: Nsu ina ka ukyuli ɔdi útasu Yesu lɛla lɛdi ni, únu ka baadɔ na bana lɛlɔ kemmo na úye-ma ɔnini, “Lɛla lɛmɛni lɛtu-mii atu?

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: Amu dɛ na wabla-mii si banii bɛ́nu ka ami Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi lɛ́kɔ lísela katɔ kesii kani na nka nli?

english_verse: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
translation_verse: Katɔti Kɔyu muute ngba. Na ukyuli ɔlɔna ɔɔɔdi lɛla lɛdi. Ala ani ƒui na mɔɔsu-mii ni, ndanku Katɔti Kɔyu kɔni muute ngba líboku-mii.

english_verse: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
translation_verse: Nsu bina akɔ badi balaƒɔ-mi taadi.” Yesu ɔ́su ɔmɛni ɔsika ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ ƒui ni, ɔ́ti bekyuli bani naaadubo-nwu bɔƒɔ bɔdi ku ukyuli ɔni ndububo-nwu kakya bɔkya.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɔmɛni ɔsu na lɛ́su-mii nnii ukyuli ɔdi ulakana-mi kudɔ bubo si ɔɔɔdi Ati náya na ɔ́kɛ ulu ɔmmɔ.”

english_verse: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni kama ni, nwuna basiakune pii bénwini kama na básɔ bátasiaku-nwu.

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye nwuna batalane leevu-inyɔ bammɔ ɔnini, “Amii lɛnɔ bɛɛwia ka bɛsɔ binwini yoo?”

english_verse: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
translation_verse: Amu na Simon Petro údie kenye ɔnini, “Blɔti, ɔma kudɔ na búnwini búsela? Awɔ nda ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii etemila.

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: Na abu bɔ́ɔƒɔ bɔdi na bɔ́ɔnu bɔ́ti ka awɔ ndi Katɔti Ubidi Kedee ɔmmɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Ami náƒuna bina leevu-inyɔ bamɛni ina ka bina akɔ unwi ɔdi ukisine.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su ɔmɛni ɔ́siku Yuda ɔni ndi Simon Iskariot ubidi lɛlɔ. Ɔsika na bana leevu-inyɔ akɔ ni, anwu ndubo-nwu kakya bɔkya.

english_verse: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni kama ni, Yesu útaavi na Galilea kalɔ lɛlɔ na útayɔ ka usie Yudea kalɔ lɛlɔ ka Yudaƒuɔ bakya baawia ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na basia na badu-nwu ɔsu.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters,
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Yudaƒuɔ ketele kemmo Kevo Kemmo Bulie Emeyi bɔdi uwi úudu.

english_verse: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yesu banwani básu-nwu banini, “Tɔlɔ mɛni teesie Yudea kesii kani na ƒula basiakune badubɔnu ƒula ablala.

english_verse: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni mɔɔwia ka bati-nwu ni, ulabɛ taabla lɛla lɛdi. Ka aakana ala amɛni udu bɔbla ni, ya na kayawi bekyuli ƒui banu ƒula ablala bati!”

english_verse: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
translation_verse: Básu-nwu lɛni ɔsika nwuna banwani muedi bátaƒɔ-nwu bátadi.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Mina uwi útedu tɔ. Nsu amii ni, uwi biala use ute-mii.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
translation_verse: Kayawi kalakana amii bukisi. Nsu keekisi ami, ɔsika muudie taasu kede kede ka bayawine ablala adi likpidi.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
translation_verse: Amii biteesie bina limeyi lɛmmɔ kadikɔ. Ami ńtesela emeyi ammɔ kadikɔ, ɔsika mina uwi útedu tɔ ƒui.”

english_verse: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Ka ɔ́su lɛni ɔsu ni, ɔ́ƒɔ lɛlɔ ɔ́kya Galilea mmɔ.

english_verse: After Jesus' brothers had gone to the festival, he went secretly, without telling anyone.
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔni na nwuna banwani bátɔlɔ bésie emeyi ammɔ kadikɔ kama ƒui ni, anwu lɛnɔ úbesie na bɔbɛ kemmo.

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Na Yudaƒuɔ bákya béteeye-nwu lili banii, “Anwu nɔɔ, anwu nɔɔ?”

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Na lɛni kani na nwuna lɛlɔ atɛ ada na bana akɔ mmɔ. Badi baasu banii, “Ukyuli ɔbuni na ɔdi.” Na babambadi lɛnɔ banini, “Oowo! Bekyuli na uuƒú taakya!”

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Nsu Yudaƒuɔ bɔyia ɔsu ni, ukyuli ɔdi útakana na ɔsu lɛla lɛdi ɔlɛku ƒui na nwuna lɛlɔ. Yesu Ɔ́tina Ala Na Limeyi Kadikɔ

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Ka emeyi ani baadi mmɔ éle ntɛ ni, Yesu úsie útéduo Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ na ɔ́tina ala.

english_verse: The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
translation_verse: Ala bɔtina bɔmɛni bɔ́bla Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ dɛye dɛye, na baasu banii, “Wɛ na kebi kamɛni kásiku lɛlati lɛmɛni udu ka útesie ala katɛyakɔ kadi?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Mina ala bɔtina bɔɔɔdi ami alati bɔdi. Mmomu ukyuli ɔni nátala-mi ala bɔtina na bɔdi.

english_verse: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔbla lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔɔwia ni, ɔdubɔti si ala ani na mɔɔtina ási Katɔti kudɔ iye ami ɔlati ɔyikun kemmo na muutemi.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtɛmi na anwu ɔlati ɔyikun kemmo ni, nwuna lɛlɔ bumwi na ɔɔwia. Nsu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔwia ka umwi ukyuli ɔni nátala-nwu ni, ɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ na ulányi ɔkɔ.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi Mose néte-mii ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ yoo? Nsu bina akɔ ɔdi uládi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Bi ɔsu na bɛɛwia ka bɛdu-mi?”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bekyuli bammɔ bédie kenye básu-nwu banini, “Kɔyu kukpidi kɔsiaku-ɔ! Ɔma mɔɔwia ka ɔdu-ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Lɛla linwi pɛ na lɛ́bla, na ɔ́bla bina ƒui kalɛ kadi.

english_verse: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
translation_verse: Mose úbo-mii ɔda ɔnii bikulo bina bebi ago. Nsu ɔɔɔdi anwu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na ago bukulo búse kalɔ bɔ́si. Mmomu ɔ́si bati kuuku uwi ƒui. Na biikúlo ago na lɛnwunameyi muedi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?
translation_verse: Na si bakana bekulo ukyuli lego na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ na bátata bétenye ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔdi bɔƒiɔ si ami lɛ́bwi ukyuli ɔdi na lɛlɔ ƒui lɛ́yu-nwu ɔkplu?

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli badi bási Yerusalem ɔma na béye banii, “Ɔɔɔdi ukyuli ɔmɛni na Yudaƒuɔ batɔnkune baawia badu yoo?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Na aanu-nwu! Unye mɛni ɔɔtɛmi na kadi anumi! Na balakana-nwu lɛla lɛdi bɔsu! Munuu bɔti na báti geen ka anwu ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ?

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Si Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ úbo ni, ukyuli ɔdi uláti kesii kani na ɔ́si. Nsu ukyuli ɔmɛni anwu ni, bɔgyi kesii kani na ɔ́si.”

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na Yesu ɔɔtina ala na kakpakɔ mmɔ ni, úye-ma ku lɛdi momoomo ɔnini, “Bɛɛbu bɛnii bɛgyi-mi ku kesii kani na lɛ́si? Ńtebo mɛni na ami ɔlati ɔyikun kemmo! Ukyuli ɔni nátala-mi ni, ulányi ɔkɔ. Na amii bɛɛɛgyi-nwu.

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: Nsu ami ngyi-nwu. Ɔsika anwu nátala-mi, na nwuna kudɔ na lɛ́si.”

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, báwia ka beƒie-nwu. Nsu ukyuli ɔdi útakana-nwu butuku, ɔsika nwuna uwi útedu tɔ.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Nsu bana akɔ pii báƒɔ-nwu bádi na béye banii, “Na si Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ úbo ni, ɔdubɔbla akɔla budie bɔtina butulo ani na ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔ́ɔbla?”

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Amu ka Yudaƒuɔ lɛkpa lɛni baalɔ bani Ƒarisiƒuɔ bénu ka nwuna lɛlɔ atɛ ada bekyuli bammɔ akɔ lɛni ɔsu ni, ama ku bakpane benengu bása lili na bátala kakpakɔ bagyumanane badi banii betéƒie Yesu.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ndubɔsɔ lɛkya-mii kudɔ libu uwi klukui ɔdi kani na lɛtɔlɔ nteesie Anwu ɔni nátala-mi kudɔ.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Bɛdubo-mi bɔwia na bilanu-mi. Ɔsika kesii kani na ndubɔkya ni, bilakana mmɔ bubo.”

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: Amu na Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ béye lɛlɔ banini, “Wɛ na ukyuli ɔmɛni úsela tɔ ɔsu na bulanu-nwu? Munuu ɔɔkali ka usie Helaƒuɔ lɛma kesii kani na bula kadi bekyuli badi bégyingya bakya na utátina-ma ala na mmɔ?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: Bi na ɔdanku ɔni na ɔɔsu ɔnii, ‘Bɛdubo-mi bɔwia na bilanu-mi,’ na ‘Kesii kani na ndubɔkya ni, bilakana mmɔ bubo’?”

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Na limeyi likplodi lɛlɔ na emeyi ammɔ bɔdi kemmo ɔni ndi limeyi linengudi ni, Yesu ɔ́ta únye na ɔ́su ku lɛdi momoomo ɔnini, “Si utukwɛ ɔɔda ukyuli ɔdi ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔtɔlɔ ubo-mi kudɔ na ubani ntu.

english_verse: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Lɛni na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔ́siku ukyuli ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mi taadi lɛlɔ ɔnini, ‘Abiɔ ani naaakwii na aayá na ukyuli uulie ngba ntu bɔdubo butaagba taasiku-nwu kayi kemmo.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Mɛni ni, Kɔyu kɔni ndubɔƒɔ bekyuli bani náƒɔ-nwu bádi lɛlɔ kemmo litemi na ɔɔsu. Ɔsika úti úbedu ɔƒɛni ni, Katɔti útatala tɔ Kɔyu kɔmmɔ ɔnii kutáƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo. Ɔsika Yesu úteduo tɔ nwuna lɛga bɔdi bukeye kemmo.

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Ka bénu etemila amɛni ni, bana badi básu banii, “Sɔsɔ ukyuli ɔmɛni ndi Katɔti Kenye Udiene ɔmmɔ.”

english_verse: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” Others even said, “Can the Messiah come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Na babambadi lɛnɔ banini, “Ɔmɛni ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi.” Nsu badi ama ni, béye banini, “Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ ni, Galilea na ɔdubo bɔsi?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi bɔsu na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ka Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ wasi Ɔga Dawid kaba kemmo na Betlehem ɔma kesii kani na Dawid ɔ́si yoo?”

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku Yesu ɔsu ni, bekyuli bammɔ ƒui béle lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Ka kakpakɔ bagyumanane bani na bátala bénwini bésie Ƒarisiƒuɔ ku bakpane benengu bammɔ kudɔ ni, béye-ma banini, “Bi ɔsu na bítakpanku-nwu bíteboku?”

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Amu na ama bédie kenye banini, “Bútenu ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔtɛmi aani ukyuli ɔmɛni kudii!”

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Amu na Ƒarisiƒuɔ bammɔ béye-ma banini, “Amii lɛnɔ ukyuli ɔmɛni úƒu-mii kasusu?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Bíinu dii si benengu badi iye Ƒarisiƒuɔ badi báƒɔ-nwu bádi?

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: Kudii! Nsu otogyi bekyuli bamɛni ƒui baaagyi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ. Anwuɔsu na ewida asiaku-ma!”

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Amu na Nikodemo ɔni ndi benengu bammɔ akɔ unwi na úusie Yesu kudɔ uwi ɔdi ni, úye-ma ɔnini,

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: “Bula ɔda bubo búte-bu ulu ka bɔdu ukyuli kɔtɔ si bútenu-nwu kenye litemi na bɔti lɛla lɛni na ɔdanku iye ɔɔbla?”

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
translation_verse: Nsu bédie kenye béye-nwu banini, “Awɔ lɛnɔ Galilea na ási yoo? Duo lɛku kemmo na anu ati ka Katɔti kenye udiene ɔdi ulási Galilea.”

english_verse: Everyone else went home,
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, ukyuli biala ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie kaduli.

english_verse: but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives.
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu anwu ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie kɔbi kɔni baalɔ Inɔ Egyii Kɔbi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
translation_verse: Kadi kégye ɔtanta tutuutu ni, ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ. Na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui báka bámana-nwu, na anwu úlie-ma ntɛ na úsie kalɔ ɔɔtina-ma ala.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔda bubo ala batinane ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ bákpanku uleku ɔdi béƒie kɔnu ku kɔnu na kɔsɔnɔ kadikɔ béboku. Amu na báya na ɔ́sɔ únye bana ƒui anumi.

english_verse: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.
translation_verse: Amu na béye Yesu banini, “Ala ɔtinane, uleku ɔmɛni ni, béƒie-nwu kɔnu ku kɔnu ka ɔɔdi kɔsɔnɔ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni na bula ɔda bubo kenye aani kalɛ na Mose ɔ́tina ni, ɔlɛka bubo-nwu atabi bɔdu. Na dɛ na awɔ aasu?”

english_verse: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
translation_verse: Béye-nwu ɔmɛni banii beti bakywɛ-nwu kakpagyuɛ kalɛ na si ɔ́nu-ka kemmo ni, na bakɛ kasiakɔ na beƒie-nwu. Nsu Yesu ɔ́yu ɔ́ƒa na únweni ala na ɔtumu akɔ ku nwuna lɛnimi.

english_verse: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!”
translation_verse: Amu ka básɔ benye mmɔ beeye-nwu etemila ni, ɔ́talaku lɛlɔ na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bina akɔ ɔni nátabla likpidi lɛdi kudii ni, anwu ɔka-nwu lɛtabi bubo.”

english_verse: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.
translation_verse: Amu na anwu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́yu ɔ́ƒa na únweni ala ɔ́sia kalɔ ku lɛnimi.

english_verse: The people left one by one, beginning with the oldest. Finally, Jesus and the woman were there alone.
translation_verse: Ka benengu bammɔ bénu lɛni ni, bágyu bátɔlɔ unwi unwi ɔ́si unengudi lɛlɔ. Na báda Yesu ku uleku ɔmmɔ lɛti bényene bekyuli bammɔ ntɛ.

english_verse: Jesus stood up and asked her, “Where is everyone? Isn't there anyone left to accuse you?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́talaku lɛlɔ na úye uleku ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Uleku, ńtɛlɛ-ma? Ɔdi biala útadu-ɔ kɔtɔ?”

english_verse: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
translation_verse: Amu na uleku ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Oowo, Ati.” Anwuɔsu Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Lɛni kani na ami lɛnɔ naaadu-ɔ kɔtɔ. Anwuɔsu teesie. Mmomu tasɔ telie ataabla likpidi.” Yesu Kenye Budie Bubo Unu

english_verse: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́tɛmiku bekyuli bammɔ na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ami ndi kayawi kamɛni bukeye. Na ukyuli ɔni nsiaku-mi kama ni, ɔdubɔkɛ bukeye bɔni muute ukyuli ngba geen, na ulese ulávi lɛdisa kemmo kudii.”

english_verse: The Pharisees objected, “You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true!”
translation_verse: Amu na Ƒarisiƒuɔ básu-nwu banini, “Awɔ ɔlati muudie ƒula lɛlɔ kenye. Anwuɔsu ƒula kenye budie buuubo unu.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Si ina muudie lɛlɔ kenye ni, mina kenye budie bubo unu, ɔsika ngyi kesii kani na lɛ́si, na ngyi kesii kani na lísela. Nsu amii bɛɛɛgyi kesii kani na lɛ́si iye kesii kani na lísela.

english_verse: You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone.
translation_verse: Kayawi kasusu kemmo na bɛɛtɛ litemi. Nsu ami ni, naaatɛku ɔdi litemi.

english_verse: If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me.
translation_verse: Si banii bɔtɛ na ntɛ litemi muedi ni, nka mina litemi bɔtɛ bɔkɛ ulu lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ɔɔɔdi ami lɛti mɔɔtɛ litemi lɛmmɔ. Mmomu Katɔti ɔni nátala-mi unye-mi kama.

english_verse: Your Law requires two witnesses to prove that something is true.
translation_verse: Na bina ɔda bubo kemmo ni, bénweni banii nkyuli inyɔ lɛla kenye budie bubo unu.

english_verse: I am one of my witnesses, and the Father who sent me is the other one.
translation_verse: Na ami ndi bana akɔ unwi ɔni muudie lɛlɔ kenye. Na Ati ɔni nátala-mi ndi unyɔdi.”

english_verse: “Where is your Father?” they asked. “You don't know me or my Father!” Jesus answered. “If you knew me, you would know my Father.”
translation_verse: Amu na béye-nwu banini, “Ńtɛlɛ ƒ'ɔti ɔmmɔ?” Yesu údie kenye na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛɛɛgyi-mi iye mina Ɔti. Ɔsika si bɔgyi na bɛgyi-mi ni, nka bɛdubɔti mina Ɔti lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said this while he was still teaching in the place where the temple treasures were stored. But no one arrested him, because his time had not yet come. You Cannot Go Where I Am Going
translation_verse: Kenye kamɛni na ɔ́su-ma na kesii kani nde egulabi kesekɔ na kakpakɔ kemmo mmɔ. Nsu ukyuli ɔdi útakana-nwu buƒie, ɔsika nwuna uwi ɔmmɔ útedu tɔ.

english_verse: Jesus also told them, “I am going away, and you will look for me. But you cannot go where I am going, and you will die with your sins unforgiven.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ndubo bɔtɔlɔ na bɛdubo-mi bɔwia na bikpi bɛkya bina ekpidi kemmo. Na kesii kani lísela ni, bilakana mmɔ bubo.”

english_verse: The people asked, “Does he intend to kill himself? Is that what he means by saying we cannot go where he is going?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ béye lɛlɔ banini, “Bɔdu na ɔdubo lɛlɔ ka ɔ́su ɔnii, ‘Kesii kani na lísela ni, bilakana bubo’?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You are from below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I don't.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Amii ni, kalɔ mɛni na bɛ́si. Na ami ni, lɛ́si katɔ. Kayawi kamɛni ɔdi na bɛdi. Na ami ni, ɔɔɔdi kayawi kamɛni ɔdi na ndi.

english_verse: This is why I said you will die with your sins unforgiven. If you don't have faith in me for who I am, you will die, and your sins will not be forgiven.”
translation_verse: Lɛ́su-mii ka bɛdubo bukpi bɔkya bina ekpidi kemmo. Na si bítaƒɔ bítadi ka ami ndi Anwu ɔmmɔ ni, bɛdubo bukpi bɔkya bina ekpidi kemmo sɔsɔ.”

english_verse: “Who are you?” they asked Jesus. Jesus answered, “I am exactly who I told you at the beginning.
translation_verse: Amu na béye-nwu banini, “Awɔ ndi ɔma?” Amu na údie kenye ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Lɛla lɛni na lɛ́su-mii ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ kani na ndi.

english_verse: There is a lot more I could say to condemn you. But the one who sent me is truthful, and I tell the people of this world only what I have heard from him.”
translation_verse: Mbo ala pii na lɛsu lɛsiku-mii lɛlɔ na lɛdu-mii kɔtɔ na bina ɔbladu ɔsu. Nsu ukyuli ɔni nátala-mi ni, ulányi ɔkɔ. Na ala ani na línu lɛ́siku-nwu kudɔ ni, anya muuti taasu kayawi bekyuli.”

english_verse: No one understood that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, bétenu kalɔ banii Ɔti lɛlɔ na ɔɔtɛmi taasiku.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, you will know who I am. You will also know that I don't do anything on my own. I say only what my Father taught me.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Si uwi ɔni na bɛ́kɔliku Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi katɔ ni, mmɔ na bɛdubɔti ka ami ndi Anwu ɔmmɔ. Na naaabla lɛla lɛdi na ami ɔlati ɔyikun kemmo. Mmomu mɔɔtɛmi kalɛ kani na mina Ɔti ɔ́tina-mi.

english_verse: The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him, and he will never leave me.”
translation_verse: Na anwu ɔni nátala-mi ni, unyeku-mi. Na útada-mi útese, ɔsika mɔɔbla lɛla lɛni mɔɔyɔ́-nwu kaƒɔ uwi biala.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, many of the people put their faith in him. The Truth Will Set You Free
translation_verse: Na ka ɔ́tɛmi lɛni ni, bekyuli pii báƒɔ-nwu bádi. Yesu Údie Bekyuli Bani Ndi Abraham Bebi Ɔ́tina

english_verse: Jesus told the people who had faith in him, “If you keep on obeying what I have said, you truly are my disciples.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su Yudaƒuɔ bani náƒɔ-nwu bádi mmɔ ɔnini, “Si bɛɛbla taasiaku mina ala ani na lɛ́tina-mii lɛlɔ ni, na bɛdi mina basiakune sɔsɔ.

english_verse: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
translation_verse: Na bɛdubɔti litemi geen, na litemi lɛmmɔ lɛya na bɛkɛ bɔnwuna.”

english_verse: They answered, “We are Abraham's children! We have never been anyone's slaves. How can you say we will be set free?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ básu-nwu banini, “Abraham kaba bebi na bɔdi, na bɔɔɔkya ukyuli ɔdi kalɔ! Dɛ na ɔ́bla na aasu anii bɔdubɔkɛ bɔnwuna?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I tell you for certain that anyone who sins is a slave of sin!
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ni, ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔbla likpidi ni, ɔkya likpidi kalɔ.

english_verse: And slaves don't stay in the family forever, though the Son will always remain in the family.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla ukyuli bamba kabla ni, ulénwini kaduli kammɔ ala ɔdine geen. Mmomu ubi ɔni na ɔtɔlati ɔ́wɔ na kaduli kammɔ kemmo geen ni, anwu mɔɔdi kaduli kammɔ ala uwi ƒui.

english_verse: If the Son gives you freedom, you are free!
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si ami Katɔti Ubidi lɛ́ya na ákɛ bɔnwuna ni, na ebo bɔnwuna geen sɔsɔ.

english_verse: I know that you are from Abraham's family. Yet you want to kill me, because my message isn't really in your hearts.
translation_verse: Ngyi ka Abraham kaba bebi na bɛdi. Nsu bɛɛwia ka bɛdu-mi, ɔsika bilaƒɔ mina ala ani na mɔɔtina-mii taadi.

english_verse: I am telling you what my Father has shown me, just as you are doing what your father has taught you. Your Father Is the Devil
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na mina Ɔti ɔ́tina-mi ni, ani na mɔɔsu. Na amii lɛnɔ bɛɛbla lɛla lɛni na bínu bɛ́siku bina ɔti kudɔ.”

english_verse: The people said to Jesus, “Abraham is our father!” Jesus replied, “If you were Abraham's children, you would do what Abraham did.
translation_verse: Amu na Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ básu-nwu banini, “Abraham ndi bula ɔti.” Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Si Abraham bebi na bɛdi geen ni, bɛdubɔbla ala ani na Abraham ɔ́bla.

english_verse: Instead, you want to kill me for telling you the truth that God gave me. Abraham never did anything like that.
translation_verse: Nsu ami ɔni mɔɔsu-mii litemi geen lɛni na línu lɛ́siku Katɔti kudɔ ni, ami mmomu na bɛɛwia bɛdu. Ɔɔɔdi ɔmɛni udu na Abraham ɔ́bla.

english_verse: But you are doing exactly what your father does.” “Don't accuse us of having someone else as our father!” they said. “We just have one father, and he is God.”
translation_verse: Ala ani na ukyuli ɔni ndi bina ɔti ɔ́bla ni, anya na bɛɛbla.” Amu na básu-nwu banini, “Ɔɔɔdi kɔsɔnɔ bebi na bɔdi! Ɔti unwi na bubo, na anwu ndi Katɔti!” Yesu Údie Bekyuli Bani Ndi Ukisine Bebi Ɔ́tina

english_verse: Jesus answered: If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and now I am here. He sent me. I did not come on my own.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Si Katɔti ndi bina ɔti ni, bɛdubɔyɔ-mi. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔmmɔ kudɔ geen na lɛ́si líbo mɛni. Ńtebo na ami ɔlati bɔyɔ kemmo. Mmomu anwu ɔmmɔ nátala-mi.

english_verse: Why can't you understand what I am talking about? Can't you stand to hear what I am saying?
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na bilenu-mi kalɔ? Ngyi ka bilátuna bɛnii biisé atu na binu lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu.

english_verse: Your father is the devil, and you do exactly what he wants. He has always been a murderer and a liar. There is nothing truthful about him. He speaks on his own, and everything he says is a lie. Not only is he a liar himself, but he is also the father of all lies.
translation_verse: Bina ɔti ndi ukisine ɔmmɔ, na bɛwia ka bɛbla nwuna lɛƒɔyɔ. Bekyuli ɔdune kani na ɔdi ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ ƒui. Na ulayɔ litemi geen lɛmmɔ, ɔsika ulasu lɛla siin lɛdi kudii. Si ɔ́nyi ɔkɔ ni, nwuna udu na uudie taatina na bɔtɛmi kemmo. Ɔsika ɔkɔ ɔnyine na ɔdi, na anwu ndi ɔkɔ bɔnyi ƒui ɔti.

english_verse: Everything I have told you is true, and you still refuse to have faith in me.
translation_verse: Nsu ka mɔɔsu-mii litemi geen lɛmɛni ɔsu ni, bilaƒɔ-mi taadi.

english_verse: Can any of you accuse me of sin? If you cannot, why won't you have faith in me? After all, I am telling you the truth.
translation_verse: Bina akɔ ɔmani na madu-mi likpidi lɛdi kɔtɔ? Si mɔɔsu-mii litemi geen ni, bi ɔsu na bilaƒɔ-mi taadi.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to God will listen to his message. But you refuse to listen, because you don't belong to God. Jesus and Abraham
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni ndi Katɔti ɔdi ni, anwu muunú ala ani na Katɔti ɔɔsu. Na lɛla lɛni ɔsu na bilabla taasiaku mina litemi lɛlɔ ndi ka bɛɛɛdi Katɔti ɔdi.” Yesu Údie Lɛlɔ Kenye Ɔ́tina Yudaƒuɔ

english_verse: The people told Jesus, “We were right to say that you are a Samaritan and that you have a demon in you!”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yudaƒuɔ básu Yesu banini, “Ɔdi litemi geen ka bɔ́su-ɔ ka Samariani ukpidi na adi, na kɔyu kukpidi kɔsiaku-ɔ!”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I don't have a demon in me. I honor my Father, and you refuse to honor me.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Kɔyu kukpidi kɔdi kɔɔɔsiaku-mi. Ami mɔɔtalaku mina Ɔti lɛnyi katɔ, nsu amii biibile-mi lɛnyi.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you obey my words, you will never die.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii geen nnii ukyuli ɔni madi ala ani na mɔɔtina mɛni lɛlɔ ni, ulekpi kudi kudii!”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Now we are sure that you have a demon. Abraham is dead, and so are the prophets. How can you say that no one who obeys your words will ever die?
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ básu-nwu banini, “Ɔƒɛni na bɔti nwaa ka kɔyu kukpidi kɔsiaku-ɔ! Abraham úkpi, na Katɔti kenye bediene lɛnɔ békpi, nsu awɔ aasu ka ukyuli biala ɔni madi ƒula ala ani na aatina lɛlɔ ulekpi kudi kudii!

english_verse: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?”
translation_verse: Bulaƒɔ taadi ka bɔsu na ada anii etulo bula ɔti Abraham, munuu lɛni na aasu? Anwu úkpi, na Katɔti kenye bediene lɛnɔ békpi. Ɔma na aabu ka adi tɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If I honored myself, it would mean nothing. My Father is the one who honors me. You claim that he is your God,
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Si banii mina lɛlɔ na muumwi ni, nka bumwi bɔmmɔ bɔɔɔdi lɛla lɛdi. Nsu ukyuli ɔni muumwi-mi ni, anwu ndi mina ɔti. Anwu ndi ɔni na bɛnii anwu ndi bina Katɔti.

english_verse: even though you don't really know him. If I said I didn't know him, I would be a liar, just like all of you. But I know him, and I do what he says.
translation_verse: Amii bɛɛɛgyi-nwu. Nsu ami ngyi-nwu. Na ndubunwini ɔkɔ ɔnyine bina kalɛ si líni ɔmɛni. Ɔsika ngyi-nwu geen, na mɔɔdi nwuna etemila lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Your father Abraham was really glad to see me.”
translation_verse: Ebiti áda bina ɔti Abraham ka ɔ́ti ka ndubo. Anwuɔsu úti anu ɔ́sia mina bubo lɛlɔ ku lɛlɔyɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that even before Abraham was, I was, and I am.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-mii geen nnii asa badubɔwɔ Abraham ni, Ami nli.”

english_verse: The people picked up stones to kill Jesus, but he hid and left the temple.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ka ɔ́su lɛni ni, bála atabi banii beebó-nwu, nsu Yesu ɔ́bɛla lɛlɔ na ɔ́vi ɔ́lɛ-ma akɔ na kakpakɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: As Jesus walked along, he saw a man who had been blind since birth.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔkɛ ɔɔví ni, útánu ɔnana ɔdi na anumi ábwɛ ɔ́si uwi ɔni na báwɔ-nwu ƒui.

english_verse: Jesus' disciples asked, “Teacher, why was this man born blind? Was it because he or his parents sinned?”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na nwuna basiakune béye-nwu banini, “Ala ɔtinane, ɔma ekpidi náya na ɔnana ɔmɛni anumi ábwɛ asa na báwɔ-nwu? Anwu ɔlati ekpidi ɔsu, munuu nwuna bawɔne ekpidi ɔsu?”

english_verse: “No, it wasn't!” Jesus answered. “But because of his blindness, you will see God work a miracle for him.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɔnana ɔmɛni anumi ani nábwɛ-nwu ni, aaadanku nwuna ekpidi iye nwuna bawɔne ekpidi ani na bábla ɔsu. Mmomu anumi ábwɛ-nwu kalɛ na bekyuli banu Katɔti ɔyikun bati na ukyuli ɔmɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: As long as it is day, we must do what the one who sent me wants me to do. When night comes, no one can work.
translation_verse: Si uwi ɔni na kadi kátasa tɔ ni, ɔdi ka butaabla Katɔti ɔni nátala-mi kabla. Ɔƒɛ ɔdubo bɔsa ɔni na ukyuli biala ɔsɔ ulakana lɛla lɛdi biala bɔbla.

english_verse: While I am in the world, I am the light for the world.”
translation_verse: Na lebo lɛni kemmo na nkya bayawine akɔ ni, ami ndi bana bukeye.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he spit on the ground. He made some mud and smeared it on the man's eyes.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́su lɛni ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, útuo lisuo úwi kalɔ na úti ɔ́sala ku lɛti, na úti-ni úsusu ɔnana ɔmmɔ anumi.

english_verse: Then he said, “Go wash off the mud in Siloam Pool.” The man went and washed in Siloam, which means “One Who Is Sent.” When he had washed off the mud, he could see.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Teesie na atáƒɔ anumi na lɛba blii lɛni baalɔ banii Siloa kemmo.” Na Siloa kalɔ ndi bátala-nwu. Anwuɔsu ɔnana ɔmmɔ úsie na útáƒɔ nwuna anumi. Na nwuna anumi álɛmi na ɔɔnu, na ɔ́sɔ únwini úbo kaduli.

english_verse: The man's neighbors and the people who had seen him begging wondered if he really could be the same man.
translation_verse: Amu na nwuna bakpana ku bekyuli bani ƒui nánu-nwu uwi ɔni na úteevele ala béye lɛlɔ banini, “Ɔɔɔdi ɔnana ɔmɛni néteelie mɛni teevele ala mmɔ, iye?”

english_verse: Some of them said he was the same beggar, while others said he only looked like him. But he told them, “I am that man.”
translation_verse: Badi banii anwu na ɔdi. Nsu babambadi ama banii, “Oowo, ɔɔɔdi anwu na ɔdi. Bɔlɛ kani na ɔ́lɛ-nwu.” Amu na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔlati ɔnini, “Ami na ɔdi!”

english_verse: “Then how can you see?” they asked.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na béye-nwu banini, “Dɛ na ɔ́bla asa na aakana bɔnu?”

english_verse: He answered, “Someone named Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. He told me to go and wash it off in Siloam Pool. When I did, I could see.”
translation_verse: Amu na údie kenye ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔni baalɔ Yesu ni, anwu nábla aba úsusu-mi anumi. Na ɔ́su-mi ɔnii ntésie na ntáƒɔ mina anumi na Siloa lɛba kemmo. Anwuɔsu lísie. Na ka lɛ́nya lɛ́ƒɔ anumi lɛ́wɔlɔ kani na líse kalɔ mɔɔnu.”

english_verse: “Where is he now?” they asked. “I don't know,” he answered. The Pharisees Try To Find Out What Happened
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, béye-nwu banii, “Ńtɛlɛ ukyuli ɔmmɔ?” Amu na údie kenye ɔnini, “Lɛɛɛgyi.” Ƒarisiƒuɔ Béye Ɔnumbwɛne Ɔmmɔ Kalɛ Na Béti Bábwi-nwu

english_verse: The day when Jesus made the mud and healed the man was a Sabbath. So the people took the man to the Pharisees.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛni lɛlɔ na Yesu úti aba úsusu ɔnana ɔmmɔ anumi na ɔ́bwi-nwu ni, ɔdi lɛnwunameyi.

english_verse: They asked him how he was able to see, and he answered, “Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. Then after I washed it off, I could see.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Ƒarisiƒuɔ bammɔ lɛnɔ básɔ béye-nwu kalɛ na ɔ́bla asa na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́kana na ɔɔnu. Na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔmmɔ úti aba adi úsusu-mi anumi. Na lɛ́ƒɔ mina anumi. Na ɔƒɛni ni, mɔɔkana mɔɔnu.”

english_verse: Some of the Pharisees said, “This man Jesus doesn't come from God. If he did, he would not break the law of the Sabbath.” Others asked, “How could someone who is a sinner work such a miracle?” Since the Pharisees could not agree among themselves,
translation_verse: Amu na Ƒarisiƒuɔ bammɔ badi básu banini, “Ukyuli ɔni nábla lɛla lɛmɛni ni, ɔɔɔdi Katɔti nátala-nwu! Ɔsika uládi lɛnwunameyi ɔda ɔni na Katɔti úbo-bu lɛlɔ.” Na babambadi ama banini, “Dɛ na ukyuli ɔni na ɔdi alaekpidi ɔblane wakana na wabla akɔla budie taatina amɛni udu?” Mmɔ ni, bekyuli bammɔ béle lɛlɔ akpa anyɔ.

english_verse: they asked the man, “What do you say about this one who healed your eyes?” “He is a prophet!” the man told them.
translation_verse: Amu na Ƒarisiƒuɔ bammɔ básɔ béye ɔnana ɔmmɔ banini, “Ka aasu anii anwu nábwi-ɔ lɛnumbwɛ ni, bi na awɔ ɔlati aasu taasiku ukyuli ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ?” Amu na ɔnana ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Katɔti kenye udiene na ɔdi.”

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders would not believe that the man had once been blind. They sent for his parents
translation_verse: Ina amu ni, Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ bátaƒɔ bátadi ka sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka ɔnana ɔmmɔ anumi ábwɛ-nwu asa na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́kana na ɔɔnu úti útédu uwi ɔni bálɔ nwuna bawɔne.

english_verse: and asked them, “Is this the son that you said was born blind? How can he now see?”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na béye-ma banini, “Bina ubi na ɔdi mɛni? Na ka bɛɛsu bɛnii bɛ́wɔ-nwu na ɔdi ɔnumbwɛne ni, dɛ na ɔ́bla asa na ɔɔkana bɔnu ɔƒɛni?”

english_verse: The man's parents answered, “We are certain that he is our son, and we know that he was born blind.
translation_verse: Amu na nwuna bawɔne bédie kenye banini, “Bɔgyi ka bula ubi na ɔdi. Na bɔgyi lɛnɔ ka ɔni na bɔ́wɔ-nwu ni, ulánu.

english_verse: But we don't know how he got his sight or who gave it to him. Ask him! He is old enough to speak for himself.”
translation_verse: Nsu kalɛ na ɔ́bla asa na ɔ́kana na ɔɔnu ni, bulákana bɔti. Na bɔɔɔgyi ukyuli ɔni nábwi-nwu lɛnumbwɛ lɛmmɔ lɛnɔ. Biye-nwu na anwu ɔlati ɔdubudie lɛlɔ kenye, ɔsika ɔ́ɔbi lɛlɔ kanaalɛ!”

english_verse: The leaders called the man back and said, “Swear by God to tell the truth! We know that Jesus is a sinner.”
translation_verse: Benengu bammɔ básɔ bálɔ ɔnana ɔni na nka anumi ábwɛ-nwu mmɔ, na básu-nwu banini, “Yia Katɔti, na asu-bu litemi geen lɛmmɔ! Abu bɔgyi ka ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔdi alaekpidi ɔblane!”

english_verse: The man replied, “I don't know if he is a sinner or not. All I know is that I used to be blind, but now I can see!”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔnana ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Ami lɛɛɛgyi si ɔdi alaekpidi ɔblane iye ɔɔɔdi. Lɛla linwi lɛni kani na ngyi ndi ka anumi ábwɛ-mi dii. Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, mɔɔnu!”

english_verse: “What did he do to you?” they asked. “How did he heal your eyes?”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na benengu bammɔ béye-nwu banini, “Bi na ɔ́bla-a, na dɛ na ɔ́bwi ƒula lɛnumbwɛ lɛmmɔ?”

english_verse: The man answered, “I have already told you once, and you refused to listen. Why do you want me to tell you again? Do you also want to become his disciples?”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔnana ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Lɛ́ɛsu-mii ḿbavi, nsu bilayɔ ka binu. Na bi ɔsu na bɛsɔ bɛɛyɔ́ binu ɔƒɛni? Bɛɛwia ka binwini nwuna basiakune lɛnɔ?”

english_verse: The leaders insulted the man and said, “You are his follower! We are followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na benengu bammɔ bábɔku-nwu banii, “Awɔ ndi ukyuli ɔmmɔ kama ɔsiakune. Abu Mose basiakune na bɔdi.

english_verse: We are sure God spoke to Moses, but we don't even know where Jesus comes from.”
translation_verse: Bɔgyi ka Katɔti ɔ́tɛmiku Mose. Na ukyuli ɔmmɔ anwu ni, bɔɔɔgyi kesii kani na ɔ́si muedi!”

english_verse: “How strange!” the man replied. “He healed my eyes, and yet you don't know where he comes from.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Bi litemi lɛdi mɛni? Bɔsu bɛda bɛnii bɛɛɛgyi kesii kani na ɔ́si, nsu anwu nábwi-mi lɛnumbwɛ!

english_verse: We know that God listens only to people who love and obey him. God doesn't listen to sinners.
translation_verse: Bɔgyi ka Katɔti ulenu alaekpidi bablane katɔ bɔkpali. Na bekyuli babuni bani mɔɔbu-nwu na baabla nwuna lɛƒɔyɔ mmomu katɔ bɔkpali na uunú.

english_verse: And this is the first time in history anyone has ever given sight to someone born blind.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si kayawi kalɔ kesekɔ ƒui ni, ɔma nénu ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́ya na ɔnumbwɛne ɔni na báwɔ-nwu lɛni ɔkana bɔnu?

english_verse: Jesus could not do anything unless he came from God.”
translation_verse: Na si ɔɔɔdi Katɔti kudɔ na ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔ́si ni, nka ulakana lɛla lɛdi bɔbla.”

english_verse: The leaders told the man, “You have been a sinner since the day you were born! Do you think you can teach us anything?” Then they said, “You can never come back into any of our synagogues!”
translation_verse: Amu na benengu bammɔ banini, “Awɔ ɔni na likpidi kemmo na báwɔ-ɔ bákya na lɛni kani na éti ábi lɛlɔ ni, awɔ mɔɔwia ka atina-bu ala?” Mmɔ ni, bábɔku-nwu bédie Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ mmɔ. Bekyuli Badi Baakali Banii Baanu Ala Nwaa

english_verse: When Jesus heard what had happened, he went and found the man. Then Jesus asked, “Do you have faith in the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu únu ka bábɔku-nwu bédie mmɔ ni, ɔ́wia ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔ́nu. Na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Áƒɔ Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ádi?”

english_verse: He replied, “Sir, if you will tell me who he is, I will put my faith in him.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Ati, tina-mi ukyuli ɔmmɔ na makana-nwu bɔƒɔ bɔdi.”

english_verse: “You have already seen him,” Jesus answered, “and right now he is talking with you.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Áanu ukyuli ɔmmɔ ábavi. Na ami ɔmmɔ ndi ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtɛmiku-ɔ ɔƒɛni.”

english_verse: The man said, “Lord, I put my faith in you!” Then he worshiped Jesus.
translation_verse: Mmɔ kani na ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Blɔti, lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di!” Na ɔ́lɛ akɔnkɔ na Yesu anumi na úmwi-nwu.

english_verse: Jesus told him, “I came to judge the people of this world. I am here to give sight to the blind and to make blind everyone who can see.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su ɔnini, “Líbo kayawi kamɛni mbatɛku bekyuli litemi kalɛ na banumbwɛne bataanu, na bani mɔɔnu ni, anumi abwɛ-ma.”

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard Jesus say this, they asked, “Are we blind?”
translation_verse: Ka Ƒarisiƒuɔ bani nkya-ma akɔ bénu lɛla lɛni na Yesu ɔ́su ni, béye-nwu banini, “Bi na aasu? Abu lɛnɔ banumbwɛne na bɔdi?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “If you were blind, you would not be guilty. But now that you claim to see, you will keep on being guilty.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Si banii anumi nábwɛ-mii ni, nka bítaƒiɔ. Nsu ka amii alati bɛnii bɛɛnu ɔsu ni, ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka bɛ́ƒiɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain only thieves and robbers climb over the fence instead of going in through the gate to the sheep pen.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ni, ukyuli ɔni naaadubo kayakun kammɔ kenye bɔsia buduo lɛƒonuyu lɛmmɔ kemmo mmomu ɔba kama na ɔdubɔkɔ uduo ni, ɔdi uyune ku ala ubilene.

english_verse: But the gatekeeper opens the gate for the shepherd, and he goes in through it. The sheep know their shepherd's voice. He calls each of them by name and leads them out.
translation_verse: Kayakun kenye ɔgyumanane ɔɔlɛmi kayakun kammɔ teete anwu. Na baƒonu bammɔ beenú-nwu lɛdi si ɔɔkpali-ma kalɛ na ɔ́sia-ma anyi na ɔɔtɔnku-ma taalɛku.

english_verse: When he has led out all of his sheep, he walks in front of them, and they follow, because they know his voice.
translation_verse: Na si ɔ́kpanku-ma ɔ́lɛku ni, ɔɔtɔ-ma lɛtɔtɔ na baƒonu bammɔ baasiaku-nwu kama ɔsika bagyi-nwu lɛdi.

english_verse: The sheep will not follow strangers. They don't recognize a stranger's voice, and they run away.
translation_verse: Baaadubo ukyuli bamba bɔsiaku. Mmomu badubukeli batɔlɔ ukyuli ɔbambadi kudɔ, ɔsika baaagyi-nwu lɛdi.”

english_verse: Jesus told the people this story. But they did not understand what he was talking about. Jesus Is the Good Shepherd
translation_verse: Yesu úbo-ma lɛgba lɛmɛni, nsu bétenu lɛla lɛni na ɔ́su-ma kalɔ.

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain that I am the gate for the sheep.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ni, ami ndi ɔba kayakun ute baƒonu bammɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who came before me was a thief or a robber, and the sheep did not listen to any of them.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ƒui nágyu bátɔ-mi lɛtɔtɔ na bébo aani si ami na ɔdi ni, badi beyune ku ala bebilene. Nsu baƒonu bammɔ bétenu-ma litemi.

english_verse: I am the gate. All who come in through me will be saved. Through me they will come and go and find pasture.
translation_verse: Ami ndi kayakun kammɔ. Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔsia-mi lɛlɔ teeduo ɔba ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, ndubɔƒɔ-nwu ngba. Ɔdubuduo mmɔ utaalɛ na utaakɛ adila abuni taadi.

english_verse: A thief comes only to rob, kill, and destroy. I came so everyone would have life, and have it fully.
translation_verse: Buyu kani na uyune uubo teebeyu na ɔdu bebuo na ubile ala lɛnɔ. Na ami ni, líbo kalɛ na lɛya na bekyuli belie ngba geen na bakɛ bɔnwuna ƒui.

english_verse: I am the good shepherd, and the good shepherd gives up his life for his sheep.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi baƒonu ɔdane ɔbuni ɔni nátuna ka ukpi na baƒonu bammɔ lili.

english_verse: Hired workers are not like the shepherd. They don't own the sheep, and when they see a wolf coming, they run off and leave the sheep. Then the wolf attacks and scatters the flock.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni na kayu kenye na béti-nwu na úbo ɔɔbla kabla ni, uukeli si ɔ́nu ka kegiti kɔdubo. Na ɔda baƒonu bammɔ unyene. Ɔsika ɔɔɔdi baƒonu ɔdane. Na baƒonu bammɔ lɛnɔ baaadi nwuna badi. Anwuɔsu kegiti kammɔ keeƒie baƒonu bammɔ na kegyingya-ma ƒui.

english_verse: Hired workers run away because they don't care about the sheep.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔmɛni uukeli, ɔsika kayu kenye na béti-nwu na úbo ɔɔbla kabla. Na ɔɔɔdaku baƒonu bammɔ lɛda.

english_verse: Just as the Father knows me, I know the Father, and I give up my life for my sheep.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi baƒonu ɔdane ɔbuni. Na aani kalɛ na Ati ɔgyi-mi na ami lɛnɔ ngyi-nwu ni, lɛni kani na ngyi mina baƒonu, na ama lɛnɔ bagyi-mi. Na lɛ́tuna ka likpi na bana lili.

english_verse: I have other sheep that are not in this sheep pen. I must also bring them together, when they hear my voice. Then there will be one flock of sheep and one shepherd.
translation_verse: Mbo baƒonu babambadi na beeebo lɛƒonuyu lɛmɛni kemmo tɔ. Na ɔlɛka lɛkpanku ama lɛnɔ liboku. Na badubunu-mi lɛdi. Na bana ƒui badubunwini baƒonu lisu linwi na baƒonu ɔdane unwi kalɔ.

english_verse: The Father loves me, because I give up my life, so I may receive it back again.
translation_verse: Na Ati ɔɔyɔ́-mi, ɔsika lɛ́tuna ka likpi na bana lili. Ɔmmɔ kama na lɛsɔ linwini libo mbelie ngba.

english_verse: No one takes my life from me. I give it up willingly! I have the power to give it up and the power to receive it back again, just as my Father commanded me to do.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi ukyuli ɔdi ndubo-mi bɔkana bɔdu. Mmomu ami ɔlati nénu kalɔ ka likpi. Mbo ɔyikun na lɛkana likpi lɛni. Na mbo ɔyikun lɛnɔ na lɛkana na lɛsɔ linwini libo mbelie ngba. Ɔmɛni ndi lɛla lɛni na Ati úbo-mi ɔda ka mbabla.”

english_verse: The people took sides because of what Jesus had told them.
translation_verse: Na Yesu etemila amɛni ɔsu ni, bule bɔ́sɔ búduo Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ ƒui ntɛ.

english_verse: Many of them said, “He has a demon in him! He is crazy! Why listen to him?”
translation_verse: Na bana akɔ pii básu banini, “Kɔyu kukpidi kɔsiaku ukyuli ɔmɛni, na uukpi libuo! Bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka binye biteenu ala ani na ɔɔsu?”

english_verse: But others said, “How could anyone with a demon in him say these things? No one like this could give sight to a blind person!” Jesus Is Rejected
translation_verse: Nsu babambadi lɛnɔ básu banini, “Ukyuli ɔni na kɔyu kukpidi kɔsiaku ni, ulakana na wetemi lɛni! Dɛ na kɔyu kukpidi kɔdubɔya na ɔnumbwɛne ɔsɔ utaanu?” Yudaƒuɔ Bátaƒɔ Yesu Bátadi

english_verse: One day he was walking in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch,
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔkɛ uusié taavi na kakpakɔ kaduli mmɔ kesii kani baalɔ Salomo lɛgbanya.

english_verse: and the people gathered all around him. They said, “How long are you going to keep us guessing? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly!”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ bábaka bámana-nwu, na béye-nwu banini, “Uwi ɛlɛ geen na adubunye etédu asa na asu-bu nwaa si awɔ ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I have told you, and you refused to believe me. The things I do by my Father's authority show who I am.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Lɛ́ɛsu-mii ɔmɛni ḿbavi, nsu bilaƒɔ-mi taadi. Na ala ani mɔɔbla ɔkɛnku mina Ɔti ɔyikun lɛlɔ muudie-mi kenye.

english_verse: But since you are not my sheep, you don't believe me.
translation_verse: Nsu bilaƒɔ taadi, ɔsika bɛɛɛdi mina baƒonu bammɔ akɔ badi.

english_verse: My sheep know my voice, and I know them. They follow me,
translation_verse: Mina baƒonu beenú-mi lɛla lɛni mɔɔsu-ma. Na ngyi-ma. Na ama lɛnɔ basiaku-mi.

english_verse: and I give them eternal life, so that they will never be lost. No one can snatch them out of my hand.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyá na beelie ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii, na balayii ku udu. Na ukyuli biala ulakana-ma buƒie bɔƒɔ na mina kɔnu kemmo.

english_verse: My Father gave them to me, and he is greater than all others. No one can snatch them from his hands,
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔni néti-ma úte-mi ni, úbomo útulo lɛla biala na ukyuli biala ulakana-ma buƒie bɔƒɔ na nwuna kɔnu kemmo kudii.

english_verse: and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Ati ku ami ƒui ni, bekyuli benwi na bɔdi.”

english_verse: Once again the people picked up stones in order to kill Jesus.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ básɔ bála atabi banii beebó Yesu.

english_verse: But he said, “I have shown you many good things my Father sent me to do. Which one are you going to stone me for?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye-ma ɔnini, “Lɛ́bla kabla kabuni pii na bina akɔ, na amii alati bɛ́nu na adi kabla kani na Ati úti ɔ́kya-mi enu kemmo ka mbabla. Na ala amɛni akɔ ɔmani lili ɔsu na bɛɛwia ka bibo-mi atabi?”

english_verse: They answered, “We are not stoning you because of any good thing you did. We are stoning you because you did a terrible thing. You are just a man, and here you are claiming to be God!”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ básu banini, “Ɔɔɔdi ala abuni adi ɔsu na bɔɔwia ka buubó-ɔ atabi. Mmomu ɔni na eedumi Katɔti ɔsu! Ukyuli kani na adi, nsu aawia ka eti lɛlɔ enwini Katɔti!”

english_verse: Jesus replied: In your Scriptures doesn't God say, “You are gods”?
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Bénweni na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ka Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, ‘Bise aani Katɔti.’

english_verse: So why do you accuse me of a terrible sin for saying that I am the Son of God? After all, it is the Father who prepared me for this work. He is also the one who sent me into the world.
translation_verse: Nsu ami ni, bɔƒuna na Ati ɔ́ƒuna-mi ka libo kayawi kamɛni kemmo. Na bi ɔsu na bɛɛsu bɛni muudumi Katɔti ka lɛ́su nnii ami ndi Katɔti Ubidi ɔsu?

english_verse: If I don't do as my Father does, you should not believe me.
translation_verse: Na si ɔɔɔdi mina Ɔti kabla na mɔɔbla ni, bitaƒɔ-mi bitadi.

english_verse: But if I do what my Father does, you should believe because of that, even if you don't have faith in me. Then you will know for certain that the Father is one with me, and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Nsu si anya na mɔɔbla bɔdi ni, si ina bilaƒɔ ami ɔlati taadi ni, ɔdi ka bɛƒɔ ala ani na mɔɔbla anya bɛdi. Na si bɛ́bla lɛni ni, bɛdubɔnu bɔti kɔnakunwi ka Katɔti uliku-mi na ami lɛnɔ nliku-nwu.”

english_verse: Again they wanted to arrest Jesus. But he escaped
translation_verse: Mɛni lɛnɔ ni, Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ básɔ báyɔ ka beƒie-nwu, nsu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́lɛ-ma enu kemmo.

english_verse: and crossed the Jordan to the place where John had earlier been baptizing. While Jesus was there,
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́tɔlɔ-ma kudɔ ni, ɔ́sɔ ɔ́via Yordan Ketu na úsie útélie kesii kani na Yohane ɔ́kya útaakpila bekyuli ntu dii.

english_verse: many people came to him. They were saying, “John didn't work any miracles, but everything he said about Jesus is true.”
translation_verse: Na bekyuli pii bébo-nwu kudɔ. Na básu lɛlɔ banini, “Yohane útabla akɔla budie taatina bɔdi. Nsu lɛla biala na Yohane ɔ́su na ukyuli ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni, líbo-nwu kemmo lɛni.”

english_verse: A lot of those people also put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli pii báƒɔ Yesu bádi.

english_verse: The sisters sent a message to the Lord and told him that his good friend Lazarus was sick.
translation_verse: Lasaro banwani belekubi bamɛni básia Yesu kenye banini, “Blɔti ƒula ɔkpana ɔyɔne uuƒi.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he said, “His sickness won't end in death. It will bring glory to God and his Son.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu únu kenye kamɛni ni, ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɔlɛ ɔni na Lasaro uuƒi mɛni ni, ɔɔɔdi kukpi ndubɔdi-nwu kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: But he stayed where he was for two more days.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔni na kenye kamɛni kédu-nwu ni, ɔ́ƒɔ lɛlɔ ɔ́kya mmɔ emeyi anyɔ úbu.

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “Now we will go back to Judea.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, ɔ́su nwuna batɛyane ɔnini, “Bɛya na bɔsɔ bunwini busie Yudea.”

english_verse: “Teacher,” they said, “the people there want to stone you to death! Why do you want to go back?”
translation_verse: Amu na bédie kenye banini, “Nsu ala ɔtinane, uwi klukui ɔdi kani návi mɛni ka bekyuli bani nkya mmɔ báwia ka bebo-ɔ atabi! Amu na asɔ aakali ka bɔsɔ busie kama?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Aren't there twelve hours in each day? If you walk during the day, you will have light from the sun, and you won't stumble.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Si kadi kégye ni, limeyi lɛdanku uwi akpa akpa leevu-inyɔ, munuu ɔkɔ mɔɔnyi? Anwuɔsu kadi bukeye bɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, ukyuli ɔni nkɛ ni, uletulo.

english_verse: But if you walk during the night, you will stumble, because you don't have any light.”
translation_verse: Nsu si usien na ɔkɛ bɔdi ni, ɔdubo butulo ɔsika bukeye bɔdi buuubo.”

english_verse: Then he told them, “Our friend Lazarus is asleep, and I am going there to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́su ɔmɛni ni, ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su úbunku ɔnini, “Bula ɔkpana Lasaro ɔ́ɔlɛɛ, nsu muusié ntágyila-nwu.”

english_verse: They replied, “Lord, if he is asleep, he will get better.”
translation_verse: Ka batɛyane bammɔ bénu lɛni ni, básu Yesu banini, “Blɔti, si bɔlɛɛ na ɔ́nya ɔda ni, ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔsa-nwu.”

english_verse: Jesus really meant that Lazarus was dead, but they thought he was talking only about sleep.
translation_verse: Nsu bɔsu na Yesu ɔda ɔnii Lasaro úkpi, nsu nwuna batɛyane bákali ka lɛlɛɛ geen na ɔɔlɛɛ.

english_verse: I am glad I wasn't there, because now you will have a chance to put your faith in me. Let's go to him.”
translation_verse: Nsu amii ɔsu ni, ɔdia-mi ka liiibo mmɔ asa na úkpi kalɛ na ɔkɛnku ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni, na bɛƒɔ-mi bɛdi. Anwuɔsu bɛya na buteesie-nwu kudɔ mmɔ.”

english_verse: Thomas, whose nickname was “Twin,” said to the other disciples, “Come on. Let's go, so we can die with him.” Jesus Brings Lazarus to Life
translation_verse: Amu na Toma ɔni baalɔ Nta Ubi mmɔ ɔ́su nwuna banwani batɛyane bakladi ɔnini, “Bɛya na bula ƒui bɔsiaku ala ɔtinane kalɛ na abu lɛnɔ bukpiku-nwu!” Yesu Ɔ́sia Lasaro Banwani Bammɔ Kɔnu

english_verse: When Jesus got to Bethany, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu útédu mmɔ ni, únu ka báava Lasaro na limeyi lɛmmɔ ndi limeyi linedi.

english_verse: Bethany was less than three kilometers from Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ɔ́si Yerusalem úsie Betania mmɔ ni, ɔbla eluku anyɔ.

english_verse: and many people had come from the city to comfort Martha and Mary because their brother had died.
translation_verse: Na Yudaƒuɔ pii bésie mmɔ bátásia Maria ku Marta kɔnu ka bana ɔnwani úkpi ɔsu.

english_verse: When Martha heard that Jesus had arrived, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed in the house.
translation_verse: Ka Marta únu ka Yesu ɔ́si ɔdubo ni, úsie útásiaku-nwu. Na Maria anwu ɔkya ɔtɔ.

english_verse: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Marta ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Blɔti, si bɔkya na akya mɛni ni, nka mina ɔnwani útekpi!

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Your brother will live again!”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ƒ'ɔnwani ɔdubɔta ulie ngba.”

english_verse: Martha answered, “I know he will be raised to life on the last day, when all the dead are raised.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Marta údie kenye ɔnini, “Ngyi ka ɔdubɔta uwi ɔni na bekpine badubɔsɔ bata na limeyi likplodi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “I am the one who raises the dead to life! Everyone who has faith in me will live, even if they die.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ami mɔɔyá na bekyuli basɔ baata teebelie ngba. Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mi taadi ɔdubulie ngba si ina úkpi muedi.

english_verse: “Yes, Lord!” she replied. “I believe you are the Christ, the Son of God. You are the one we hoped would come into the world.”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu úye-nwu lɛni ni, Marta údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɛɛn, Blɔti, lɛ́ƒɔ-ɔ lɛ́di ka awɔ ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔni ndi Katɔti Ubidi ɔni na básu bése ka ɔdubo kayawi.”

english_verse: After Martha said this, she went and privately said to her sister Mary, “The Teacher is here, and he wants to see you.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ ka Marta ɔ́su lɛni ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, únwini úsie na útálɔ ɔnwani Maria úsienku kɔmadɔ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ala ɔtinane ɔmmɔ úubo mɛni na uuye-ɔ lili.”

english_verse: As soon as Mary heard this, she got up and went out to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka Maria únu ɔmɛni ni, ɔ́babla ɔlɛ úsie utásiaku-nwu.

english_verse: He was still outside the village where Martha had gone to meet him.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Yesu úteduo tɔ ɔma ɔmmɔ. Mmomu ɔ́mu unye likpo lɛni na Marta úbasiaku-nwu mmɔ.

english_verse: Many people had come to comfort Mary, and when they saw her quickly leave the house, they thought she was going out to the tomb to cry. So they followed her.
translation_verse: Na Yudaƒuɔ bani nlie Maria kudɔ baasia-nwu kɔnu ni, ama lɛnɔ báta básiaku Maria kama uwi ɔni na ɔ́babla ɔ́lɛ mmɔ. Ɔsika bábu ka kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ kudɔ na ɔ́sɔ úsela utéteewulo.

english_verse: Mary went to where Jesus was. Then as soon as she saw him, she knelt at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni, Maria úubo úbedu Yesu kudɔ. Na uwi ɔni na ɔ́nu Yesu ni, mmɔ kani na ɔ́yu úwi Yesu lɛgba akɔ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Blɔti, si bɔkya na akya mɛni ni, nka mina ɔnwani útekpi.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw that Mary and the people with her were crying, he was terribly upset
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́nu kalɛ na Maria uuwulo na bekyuli bani nsiaku-nwu lɛnɔ beewulo. Nwuna kayi kékpoku-nwu na údumo. Na úye bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini,

english_verse: and asked, “Where have you put his body?” They replied, “Lord, come and you will see.”
translation_verse: “Wɛ na bɛ́va-nwu?” Amu na bédie kenye banini, “Blɔti, bo, na abanu.”

english_verse: Jesus started crying,
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Yesu úwulo.

english_verse: and the people said, “See how much he loved Lazarus.”
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli bammɔ básu lɛlɔ banini, “Bɛnu kalɛ na ɔɔyɔ́-nwu!”

english_verse: Some of them said, “He gives sight to the blind. Why couldn't he have kept Lazarus from dying?”
translation_verse: Nsu bádi básu lɛlɔ banini, “Ɔ́bwi banumbwɛne na básɔ baanu. Nsu bi ɔsu na waya na Lasaro wekpi?”

english_verse: Jesus was still terribly upset. So he went to the tomb, which was a cave with a stone rolled against the entrance.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́sɔ údumo geen, na úsie utédu kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ kudɔ. Kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ kadi lɛtabi ubu ɔni na béti lɛtabi bamba bábala-nwu kenye.

english_verse: Then he told the people to roll the stone away. But Martha said, “Lord, you know that Lazarus has been dead four days, and there will be a bad smell.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini, “Biliiku lɛtabi lɛmmɔ bidie ubu ɔmmɔ kenye.” Mmɔ ni, Lasaro ɔmmɔ ɔnwani Marta ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Blɔti, ɔdubo buteenwenyi ɔƒɛni, ɔsika ɔmwi limeyi linedi ka báva-nwu!”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Didn't I tell you that if you had faith, you would see the glory of God?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su Marta ɔnini, “Ńtasu-ɔ nnii si áƒɔ-mi ádi ni, adubɔnu ɔyikun ɔni na Katɔti ubo ati?”

english_verse: After the stone had been rolled aside, Jesus looked up toward heaven and prayed, “Father, I thank you for answering my prayer.
translation_verse: Amu na Bekyuli bammɔ béliiku lɛtabi lɛmmɔ bédie ubu ɔmmɔ kenye. Na Yesu ɔ́nu katɔ na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ati, mɔɔgyá-a enu, ɔsika aatuna teete-mi si lɛ́kpali-ɔ.

english_verse: I know that you always answer my prayers. But I said this, so the people here would believe you sent me.”
translation_verse: Na ngyi ka aatuna teete-mi uwi biala kemmo. Nsu bekyuli bani nnye mɛni ɔsu na nsɔ mɔɔsu ɔmɛni kalɛ na baƒɔ badi ka awɔ nátala-mi.”

english_verse: When Jesus had finished praying, he shouted, “Lazarus, come out!”
translation_verse: Ka ɔ́kpali katɔ ɔ́wɔlɔ lɛni ni, ɔ́va ɔ́kpali ɔnini, “Lasaro, lɛ bo mɛni!”

english_verse: The man who had been dead came out. His hands and feet were wrapped with strips of burial cloth, and a cloth covered his face. Jesus then told the people, “Untie him and let him go.” The Plot To Kill Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Na ukpine ɔmmɔ ɔ́ta úsie úbo-ma kudɔ mmɔ, na ukpine kɔvadi kɔmmɔ kúnyimi kɔda-nwu enu ku lɛgba. Na béti kɔ́di kɔdi bényimi-nwu anumi. Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛƒɛnimi adi ammɔ ƒui na nwuna lɛlɔ.” Yudaƒuɔ Bása Lili Ka Badu Yesu

english_verse: Many of the people who had come to visit Mary saw the things Jesus did, and they put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ka Yudaƒuɔ pii bani nébo Maria kudɔ mmɔ bánu lɛla lɛni na Yesu ɔ́bla ni, báƒɔ-nwu bádi.

english_verse: Others went to the Pharisees and told what Jesus had done.
translation_verse: Nsu badi bénwini bésie Ƒarisiƒuɔ kudɔ, na bátásu-ma lɛla lɛni na Yesu ɔ́bla.

english_verse: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called the council together and said, “What should we do? This man is working a lot of miracles.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Ƒarisiƒuɔ ku bakpane benengu bása ku Yudaƒuɔ batɔnkune bammɔ na béye lɛlɔ banini, “Bi na ɔlɛka bɔbla? Bɛnu akɔla budie taatina ani udu na ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔdaku bɔbla!

english_verse: If we don't stop him now, everyone will put their faith in him. Then the Romans will come and destroy our temple and our nation.”
translation_verse: Si bunye bɔɔnu-nwu na ɔdaku ɔmɛni lɛni ni, ukyuli biala ɔdubo-nwu bɔƒɔ bɔdi. Na Romaƒuɔ lɛlɔ badine badubɔta na bebebo bula kakpakɔ kamɛni babwɛ na bekpo bula kalɔ ƒui.”

english_verse: One of the council members was Caiaphas, who was also high priest that year. He spoke up and said, “You people don't have any sense at all!
translation_verse: Amu na bana akɔ unwi ɔni ndi ɔkpane unengudi na lɛkwa lɛmmɔ kemmo na baalɔ-nwu Kaiaƒa ni, ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Amii bɛɛɛgyi lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ mɛni kalɔ!

english_verse: Don't you know it is better for one person to die for the people than for the whole nation to be destroyed?”
translation_verse: Bɛɛɛgyi bɛnii ɔdia ka ukyuli unwi ukpi na kadi ƒui lili utulo ka kadi ƒui bekyuli bayii ku udu?”

english_verse: Yet Jesus would not die just for the Jewish nation. He would die to bring together all of God's scattered people.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi ama lɛti. Mmomu ku kalɛ na ɔsala Katɔti bekyuli bani négyingya bakya kayawi ekpo ekpo ƒui lɛlɔ na ɔbla-ma unwi.

english_verse: From that day on, the council started making plans to put Jesus to death.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́si limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Yudaƒuɔ batɔnkune bammɔ bése kalɔ baawia lilu lɛni lɛlɔ na beƒie Yesu na badu-nwu.

english_verse: Because of this plot against him, Jesus stopped going around in public. He went to the town of Ephraim, which was near the desert, and he stayed there with his disciples.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, Yesu ɔsɔ ulavi ɔgbami na Yudaƒuɔ akɔ. Mmomu ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie utélie ɔma blii ɔdi nde ketele na baalɔ-nwu banii Eƒraim. Na anwu ku nwuna batɛyane bákya mmɔ.

english_verse: It was almost time for Passover. Many of the Jewish people who lived out in the country had come to Jerusalem to get themselves ready for the festival.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Yudaƒuɔ Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi bɔdi ɔ́ɔkpɛ úde. Na bekyuli pii bási kalɔ kammɔ ekpo ƒui bésie Yerusalem bátátaabla lɛlɔ bɔƒɔ ɔdi ɔmmɔ batáklibi lɛlɔ bete limeyi lɛmmɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: They looked around for Jesus. Then when they were in the temple, they asked each other, “You don't think he will come here for Passover, do you?”
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bammɔ bákya bátaatɛ Yesu anu kpakplaa na kakpakɔ mmɔ ɔni na bábasa. Na beeye lɛlɔ banini, “Dɛ na awɔ aakali? Ami ngyi ka ulakana limeyi lɛmɛni kalɔ bubo. Munuu dɛ?”

english_verse: The chief priests and the Pharisees told the people to let them know if any of them saw Jesus. This is how they hoped to arrest him.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, bakpane benengu ku Ƒarisiƒuɔ béte bɔti ka si ɔdi ɔgyi kesii kani na Yesu ɔkya ni, na ubo ubasu-ma kalɛ na besie betéƒie-nwu.

english_verse: If you serve me, you must go with me. My servants will be with me wherever I am. If you serve me, my Father will honor you.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔwia ka ɔbla-mi kabla ni, ɔdi ka ɔsiaku-mi. Na kesii kani na nlie ni, mmɔ na mina kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ welie. Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔbla-mi kabla ni, mina Ɔti ɔdubute-nwu ɔbu. Yesu Ɔ́su Nwuna Kukpi Lɛlɔ Litemi

english_verse: Judas did not really care about the poor. He asked this because he carried the moneybag and sometimes would steal from it.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔɔɔdi ɔni na bawabane baakywí-nwu kaƒɔ ɔsu na úye ɔmɛni. Mmomu ka ɔdi uyune na anwu kani mɔɔda bana kavumi, na ɔɔyɔ́ ka nka utaaƒana egulabi ammɔ adi teedie taabla nwuna lɛlɔ ala ɔsu.

english_verse: they took palm branches and went out to greet him. They shouted, “Hooray! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! God bless the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu béti kuke na bálɛ bésie bátásiaku-nwu. Na baava taasu banini, “Hosiana! Bimwi anwu ɔni ndubo na Blɔti lɛnyi kemmo! Bimwi Israelƒuɔ Ɔga!”

english_verse: Jesus found a donkey and rode on it, just as the Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́nu ebuo ala utine ubi ɔdi na ulie-nwu lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔnini,

english_verse: Mary took a very expensive bottle of perfume and poured it on Jesus' feet. She wiped them with her hair, and the sweet smell of the perfume filled the house.
translation_verse: Amu na Maria úti nnɔmii ƒɛƒɛɛ bɔdi bɔni náƒɔ kuye geen na baalɔ-mu nard úwi Yesu lɛgba, na ɔ́da nwuna lili linwini úni-nwu lɛgba. Na ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔ́ƒɔ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: A lot of people came when they heard that Jesus was there. They also wanted to see Lazarus, because Jesus had raised him from death.
translation_verse: Ka Yudaƒuɔ pii bénu ka Yesu úsie ɔkya Betania ni, bésie mmɔ. Na ɔɔɔdi Yesu lɛti pɛ ɔsu. Mmomu kalɛ na banu Lasaro ɔni na Yesu ɔ́gyila ɔ́siku kekpine lɛnɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: A meal had been prepared for Jesus. Martha was doing the serving, and Lazarus himself was there.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, bánwa Yesu ebiti bɔkya adila na anwu ku nwuna badi bádi. Na Marta néti adila ammɔ útése-ma. Lasaro lɛnɔ ɔ́kya Yesu ku bani mɔɔdi mmɔ akɔ.

english_verse: A disciple named Judas Iscariot was there. He was the one who was going to betray Jesus, and he asked,
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Yesu batɛyane akɔ unwi ɔni ndi Yuda Iskariot ɔni ndubɔkya Yesu kakya ni, útayɔ-nwu kaƒɔ na úye ɔnini,

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Leave her alone! She has kept this perfume for the day of my burial.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Nwuna lɛla biala litekpoku-ɔ. Ya na ɔbla lɛla lɛni na ubo use ute mina kukpi.

english_verse: You will always have the poor with you, but you won't always have me.” A Plot To Kill Lazarus
translation_verse: Bawabane bammɔ bakya-mii kudɔ uwi biala. Nsu ami lɛɛɛdubo-mii kudɔ bɔkya uwi biala.” Yudaƒuɔ Bása Lili Likpidi Na Lasaro Lɛlɔ

english_verse: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bakpane benengu bábla kasusu ka badu Lasaro lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Philip from Bethsaida in Galilee was there too. So they went to him and said, “Sir, we would like to meet Jesus.”
translation_verse: Amu na bésie Ƒilipo kudɔ ɔni nási Betsaida na Galilea kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na básu-nwu banini, “Ati, bɔɔwia ka bɔnu Yesu.”

english_verse: But the Pharisees said to each other, “There is nothing we can do! Everyone in the world is following Jesus.” Some Greeks Want To Meet Jesus
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Ƒarisiƒuɔ bammɔ básu lɛlɔ banini, “Bɛnu ka bekyuli bammɔ bálɛ-bu kama! Kayawi bekyuli ƒui bétiku lɛlɔ bésie basiaku-nwu kama!” Yesu Ɔ́su Ka Ɔdubo Bukpi

english_verse: So Father, bring glory to yourself. A voice from heaven then said, “I have already brought glory to myself, and I will do it again!”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu mɔɔsu nnii, ‘Ati, ya na bekyuli bakɔliku ƒula lɛnyi katɔ.’ ” Mmɔ ni, bénu butemi bɔdi básiku kayaa ka bɔɔsu bɔnini, “Lɛ́ɛya na bekyuli bákɔliku mina lɛnyi katɔ. Na nsɔ ndubo bɔya na bakɔliku-mi lɛnyi katɔ bebu.”

english_verse: “The Lord has blinded the eyes of the people, and he has made the people stubborn. He did this so that they could not see or understand, and so that they would not turn to the Lord and be healed.”
translation_verse: “Ami Katɔti lɛ́bala-ma anumi kalɛ na balanu lɛla lɛdi balati. Na lɛ́ya na bádɔlɔ kalɛ na belénu ala kalɔ. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu belénwini belebo-mii kudɔ kalɛ na lɛbwi-ma.”

english_verse: The next day a large crowd was in Jerusalem for Passover. When they heard that Jesus was coming for the festival,
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛni nsia ni, bekyuli lisu bonwu lɛni nébo Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi kadikɔ ni, bénu ka Yesu ɔ́si ɔdubo Yerusalem.

english_verse: “People of Jerusalem, don't be afraid! Your King is now coming, and he is riding on a donkey.”
translation_verse: “Amii, Sion bekyuli, bitayia lɛla lɛdi! Bɛɛnu bina ɔga ka ulie ebuo ala utine ubi lɛlɔ ɔdubo!”

english_verse: At first, Jesus' disciples did not understand. But after he had been given his glory, they remembered all this. Everything had happened exactly as the Scriptures said it would.
translation_verse: Na nka Yesu batɛyane bétenu lɛla lɛmɛni kalɔ kudeedi. Nsu uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́gyila-nwu ɔ́siku kekpine na úte-nwu ɔbu ni, mmɔ na bényimo ka Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔmɛni ɔ́siku-nwu lɛlɔ ka bekyuli bábla ala amɛni ƒui béte-nwu.

english_verse: A crowd had come to meet Jesus because they had seen him call Lazarus out of the tomb. They kept talking about him and this miracle.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bekyuli pii bammɔ bésie bátásiaku-nwu, ɔsika bénu akɔla budie taatina bɔni na ɔ́bla.

english_verse: Some Greeks had gone to Jerusalem to worship during Passover.
translation_verse: Helaƒuɔ badi bakya bekyuli bani nésie Yerusalem batákpa na limeyi lɛmmɔ bɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: Philip told Andrew. Then the two of them went to Jesus and told him. The Son of Man Must Be Lifted Up
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Ƒilipo úsie útásu Andrea, na bana inyɔ bakɛ bésie bátásu Yesu.

english_verse: Jesus said: The time has come for the Son of Man to be given his glory.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Uwi údu ka Katɔti ɔkɔliku ami nwuna Ubidi lɛnyi katɔ na bekyuli anumi.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that a grain of wheat that falls on the ground will never be more than one grain unless it dies. But if it dies, it will produce lots of wheat.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ni, lɛntabi lilemomo teetulo linwi lɛni kani na lɛdi, amu ntu béti-ni bákya kalɔ na libu. Na si líbu lɛni ni, uwi ɔmmɔ kama asa na liimomo teenwini antabi pii.

english_verse: If you love your life, you will lose it. If you give it up in this world, you will be given eternal life.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni na nwuna bɔdia lɛti pɛ na ulie ute na ngba bɔmɛni kemmo ni, ɔdubɔyila lɛla biala. Nsu ukyuli ɔni néni anwu ɔlati lɛkɛ na uulie ngba taawia bekyuli bamba bɔdia ni, ɔɔkɛ́ ngba bɔmmɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Now I am deeply troubled, and I don't know what to say. But I must not ask my Father to keep me from this time of suffering. In fact, I came into the world to suffer.
