translation_verse: “Ɔƒɛni ni, kayi keekpóku-mi. Nsu bi na ɔlɛka lɛsu? Bɔsu na lɛsu nnii, ‘Ati, taya na lɛbibo lɛmɛni udu lɛsiaku-mi’? Oowo! Ɔmmɔ ɔsu geen na líbo kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ kalɛ na libo abi amɛni udu.

english_verse: When the crowd heard the voice, some of them thought it was thunder. Others thought an angel had spoken to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka bekyuli bani nnye mmɔ bénu lɛdi lɛmmɔ ni, básu ka ɔnantu muudu. Na babambadi banini, “Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi násu-nwu lɛla lɛdi.”

english_verse: Then Jesus told the crowd, “That voice spoke to help you, not me.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɔɔɔdi ami ɔsu na lɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛɛku, mmomu amii ɔsu.

english_verse: This world's people are now being judged, and the ruler of this world is already being thrown out!
translation_verse: “Ɔƒɛni na uwi údu ka Katɔti ɔdu kayawi kamɛni bekyuli kɔtɔ. Na Katɔti ɔdubɔbɔku kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ ɔdine ɔlɛku nwuna lɛga kadikɔ.

english_verse: If I am lifted up above the earth, I will make everyone want to come to me.”
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na bekyuli bákɔliku-mi katɔ ni, ndubɔya na bekyuli ƒui bebo-mi kudɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the way he would be put to death.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́su ɔmɛni ni, ɔ́tina ka badubo-nwu katɔ bɔkɔliku na ugyii lɛlɔ na ukpi.

english_verse: The crowd said to Jesus, “The Scriptures teach that the Messiah will live forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli lisu lɛmmɔ básu banini, “Na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ni, básu ka Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔsɔ ɔkya ngba uwi ƒui. Na dɛ na ɔ́bla na aasu ka bekyuli badubɔkɔliku Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ɔmmɔ katɔ lɛni? Ɔma ndi Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ɔmmɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The light will be with you for only a little longer. Walk in the light while you can. Then you won't be caught walking blindly in the dark.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Uwi klukui ɔdi kani na bɛdubɔsɔ bɛnu Katɔti bukeye bɔmmɔ. Anwuɔsu ni, uwi ɔni na kadi kammɔ kamu keekeye ni, bɛkya ɔkplu na bisie anumi kalɛ na kadi kalása kalakya-mii. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni nkɛ na lɛdisa kemmo ni, ɔɔɔgyi kesii kani na úsela.

english_verse: Have faith in the light while it is with you, and you will be children of the light.” The People Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus After Jesus had said these things, he left and went into hiding.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, biti bina anu ƒui bɛsia bukeye bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ uwi ɔni na bɛ́mu bɛɛnu bukeye. Na ɔmmɔ ndubɔya na binwini bukeye bɔmmɔ bekyuli.” Ka Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔmɛni ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔ́gyu ɔ́tɔlɔ-ma kudɔ. Na ɔ́bɛla lɛlɔ na básɔ bátanu-nwu. Yudaƒuɔ Bátina Ka Bátaƒɔ Yesu Bátadi

english_verse: He had worked a lot of miracles among the people, but they were still not willing to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Na ina ka Yesu ɔ́bla akɔla budie taatina amɛni ƒui na bana anumi ni, bátaƒɔ-nwu bátadi.

english_verse: This happened so that what the prophet Isaiah had said would come true, “Lord, who has believed our message? And who has seen your mighty strength?”
translation_verse: Nsu ɔmɛni ɔ́lɛ lɛni kalɛ na Katɔti Kenye Udiene Yesaia lɛla lɛni na ɔ́su ka lɛdubɔlɛ libo-nwu kemmo lɛni ɔnini, “Blɔti, ka búdie ƒula kenye kammɔ ni, ɔma náƒɔ-bu ɔ́di? Na ɔma bene na Blɔti údie nwuna ɔyikun ɔ́tina?”

english_verse: The people could not have faith in Jesus, because Isaiah had also said,
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bátakana bɔƒɔ bɔdi, ɔsika Yesaia ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini,

english_verse: Isaiah said this, because he saw the glory of Jesus and spoke about him.
translation_verse: Yesaia ɔ́nu ɔ́ti Yesu kenyekɔ ku ɔbu. Anwuɔsu na ɔ́su lɛla lɛmɛni ɔ́siku-nwu lɛlɔ ka badubuni-nwu.

english_verse: Even then, many of the leaders put their faith in Jesus, but they did not tell anyone about it. The Pharisees had already given orders for the people not to have anything to do with anyone who had faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Nsu ina ka use lɛni ni, Yudaƒuɔ batɔnkune pii báƒɔ Yesu bádi. Mmomu ka baayia lɛla lɛni na Ƒarisiƒuɔ badubo-ma bɔbla ɔsu ni, bátakana na basu ɔmɛni nwaa. Ɔsika badubɔgya-ma balɛku bana kasala kemmo.

english_verse: And besides, the leaders liked praise from others more than they liked praise from God. Jesus Came To Save the World
translation_verse: Na baayɔ́ ɔbu ɔni nási bekyuli kudɔ teetulo ɔni nási Katɔti kudɔ.

english_verse: In a loud voice Jesus said: Everyone who has faith in me also has faith in the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su ku lɛdi momoomo ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mi taadi ni, ɔɔɔdi ami lɛti na ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di. Mmomu ɔ́ƒɔ anwu ɔni nátala-mi lɛnɔ ɔ́di.

english_verse: And everyone who has seen me has seen the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnu-mi ni, ɔɔnu anwu ɔni nátala-mi.

english_verse: I am the light that has come into the world. No one who has faith in me will stay in the dark.
translation_verse: Líbo kayawi kamɛni kemmo aani ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyá na bekyuli baanu bukeye kalɛ na ukyuli biala ɔni náƒɔ-mi ɔ́di ni, uláƒɔ lɛlɔ ulakya lɛdisa kemmo.

english_verse: I am not the one who will judge those who refuse to obey my teachings. I came to save the people of this world, not to be their judge.
translation_verse: “Si ukyuli ɔdi uunú litemi lɛni na mɔɔsu nsu uládi-ni lɛlɔ ni, lɛɛɛdubo-nwu kɔtɔ bɔdu. Ɔsika ńtebo nnii mbadu kayawi bekyuli kɔtɔ. Mmomu líbo nnii mbaƒɔ-ma ngba.

english_verse: But everyone who rejects me and my teachings will be judged on the last day by what I have said.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔni muuní-mi ni, na ulaƒɔ mina litemi taadi ni, lɛla lɛni madu-nwu kɔtɔ linye lɛgya-nwu. Na etemila ani na lɛ́su anya ndubo-nwu kɔtɔ bɔdu na limeyi likplodi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I don't speak on my own. I say only what the Father who sent me has told me to say.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔɔɔdi ami ɔlati ɔyikun kemmo na lɛ́tɛmi. Mmomu mina Ɔti ɔni nátala-mi nátina-mi lɛla lɛni na ɔdi ka lɛsu ku kalɛ na lɛsu-ni.

english_verse: I know that his commands will bring eternal life. This is why I tell you exactly what the Father has told me.
translation_verse: Na ngyi ka lɛla lɛni na ɔ́tala-mi ka mbasu mmɔ ni, ani mɔɔyá na bekyuli beelie ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii. Anwuɔsu lɛla lɛni na Ati ɔ́su-mi ka masu ni, ani kani na mɔɔsu.”

english_verse: It was before Passover, and Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and to return to the Father. He had always loved his followers in this world, and he loved them to the very end.
translation_verse: Amu na limeyi lɛni na kadi kégye ndi Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi lɛmmɔ ni, Yesu ɔ́ti ka uwi údu ka ɔtɔlɔ kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ uteesie ɔti kudɔ. Na ka ɔɔyɔ́ ama bani náƒɔ-nwu bádi ƒui na kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, ɔɔwia ka ɔtina-ma kalɛ na ɔɔyɔ́-ma geen.

english_verse: Even before the evening meal started, the devil had made Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, decide to betray Jesus.
translation_verse: Na useyi ɔmmɔ ka Yesu ku nwuna batɛyane bésie belie kadikɔ badaku bɔdi ni, ukisine ɔmmɔ ɔ́ɔya na kasusu kekpidi kéduo Yuda ɔni ndi Simon Iskariot ubidi lili kemmo kalɛ na ɔkya Yesu kakya.

english_verse: Jesus knew he had come from God and would go back to God. He also knew that the Father had given him complete power.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔgyi nwaa ka Ɔti úti ɔyikun úte-nwu ka ɔdi ala ƒui lɛlɔ. Na ɔgyi ka Katɔti ɔmmɔ kudɔ na ɔ́si, na nwuna kudɔ kani na ɔdubɔsɔ unwini usie.

english_verse: So during the meal Jesus got up, removed his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔ́ta únye na kadikɔ mmɔ, na údie nwuna awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔmmɔ úwi, na úti ɔsa ɔ́sabla kavobi.

english_verse: He put some water into a large bowl. Then he began washing his disciples' feet and drying them with the towel he was wearing.
translation_verse: Na údu ntu bɔdi úwi lɛkpibui lɛdi kemmo, na úse kalɔ ɔɔƒɔ nwuna batɛyane bammɔ lɛgba, na uuni-ma ku ɔsa ɔni ɔ́sabla mmɔ.

english_verse: But when he came to Simon Peter, this disciple asked, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu úbo úbedu Simon Petro kudɔ ni, Petro úye-nwu ɔnini, “Blɔti, bɔƒɔ na adubo-mi lɛgba?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You don't really know what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Elénu tɔ lɛla lɛni na mɔɔbla ɔƒɛni mɛni kalɔ. Nsu kama ni, adubunu-ni kalɔ.”

english_verse: “You will never wash my feet!” Peter replied. “If I don't wash you,” Jesus told him, “you don't really belong to me.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Petro úni na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Kudii! Lɛɛɛdubo kalɔ bunu na aƒɔ-mi lɛgba uwi ɔdi.” Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Si étenu kalɔ na lɛƒɔ-ɔ lɛgba ni, agyi anii bɔsɔ buuubo kɔna kɔdi.”

english_verse: Peter said, “Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.”
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛmmɔ lɛ́gyu Petro ɔtɔtɔ! Anwuɔsu ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Blɔti, si use lɛni ni, ɔɔɔdi mina lɛgba lɛti! Mmomu adubɔƒɔ mina enu ku lili lɛnɔ!”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “People who have bathed and are clean all over need to wash just their feet. And you, my disciples, are clean, except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔni náakpi ntu ni, ɔ́lɛ bɔkpi. Anwuɔsu lɛgba kani na ɔlɛka ɔƒɔ. Bina ƒui bɛ́lɛ bɔkpi, amu ntu ukyuli unwi pɛ kani.”

english_verse: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́su ɔmɛni ɔsika ɔ́ɔti ukyuli ɔni ndubo-nwu kakya bɔkya. Anwuɔsu na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bina ƒui bɛ́lɛ bɔkpi, amu ntu ukyuli unwi pɛ kani.”

english_verse: After Jesus had washed his disciples' feet and had put his outer garment back on, he sat down again. Then he said: Do you understand what I have done?
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́ƒɔ-ma lɛgba ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔ́sɔku nwuna awu ɔmmɔ ɔ́kya, na ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie útélie kalɔ. Amu na úye nwuna basiakune ɔnini, “Bínu lɛla lɛni na lɛ́bla mɛni kalɔ?

english_verse: You call me your teacher and Lord, and you should, because that is who I am.
translation_verse: Bɛɛlɔ-mi bɛnii ala ɔtinane ku Blɔti, na ɔdi lɛni sɔsɔ. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔmmɔ na ndi.

english_verse: I have set the example, and you should do for each other exactly what I have done for you.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na bɛnu bɛtɛya na bitaabla lɛnɔ ni, ani na lɛ́bla lɛ́tina-mii mɛni.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them.
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ni, kabla ɔblane ɔdi biala uletulo nwuna unwoti. Lɛni kani na ukyuli ɔni bátala uletulo ukyuli ɔni nátala-nwu.

english_verse: I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, “The man who ate with me has turned against me!”
translation_verse: “Ɔɔɔdi bina ƒui litemi na ndaku bɔsu ɔƒaani. Ngyi bina akɔ bani na lɛ́ƒuna. Nsu ɔlɛka Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo etemila ebo-nwu kemmo lɛni kalɛ na bénweni bése banini, ‘Ukyuli ɔni nákyaku-mi kɔnu lɛkyami kemmo na bɔ́di ni, anwu nénwini únye-mi lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am.
translation_verse: “Na mɔɔsu-mii ɔmɛni lise asa ubo ubalɛ, kalɛ na si úbo úbalɛ lɛni sɔsɔ ni, na bɛti ka ami ndi Anwu ɔni nkya ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ.

english_verse: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́bu úsie Yesu kudɔ na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Blɔti, ɔma na ɔdi?”

english_verse: After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, “I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu ɔ́su ɔmɛni ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, kayi kékpoku-nwu geen. Amu na ɔ́su-ma nwaa ɔnini, “Mɔɔsu-mii geen ka bina akɔ unwi ɔdubɔkya-mi kakya.”

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal,
translation_verse: Na batɛyane bammɔ akɔ unwi ɔni na Yesu ɔɔyɔ́ ni, úlie ude Yesu.

english_verse: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Simon Petro ɔ́su ɔtɛyane ɔmmɔ kabɛsɛ kemmo ɔnini, “Ye-nwu ukyuli ɔni na ɔda.”

english_verse: No one at the meal understood what Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Nsu bakladi bani nlie kadikɔ mmɔ bétenu kalɔ lɛla lɛni ɔsu na Yesu ɔ́su Yuda lɛni.

english_verse: But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor.
translation_verse: Na ka Yuda ɔmɛni nda bana kavumi ɔsu ni, batɛyane bammɔ badi bákali ka bɔsu na Yesu ɔ́ɔsu-nwu ɔnii utéye ala ani na badubuti badi limeyi uboku iye utéte bawabane ala adi.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Amu ka Yuda ɔ́ƒɔ bodobodo ɔmmɔ ni, ɔ́vi ɔ́lɛ kɔnakunwi. Na kadi káasa uwi ɔmmɔ. Yesu Úbo Ɔda Ɔwɔdi Úte Nwuna Batɛyane

english_verse: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
translation_verse: Na si ɔkɛnku Ubi lɛlɔ na bekyuli bákɔliku Ɔti lɛnyi katɔ ni, Katɔti lɛnɔ ɔdubɔya na bekyuli bakɔliku Ubi ɔmmɔ katɔ na nwuna anumi. Na ɔdubɔya na babla lɛni kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: “Mina bebi, uwi blii ɔdi kani nébu na lɛkya-mii kudɔ. Bɛdubo-mi bɔwia, nsu mɔɔsu-mii lɛla lɛni na lɛ́su Yudaƒuɔ benengu nnii, ‘Kesii kani na lísela ni, bilakana mmɔ bubo.’

english_verse: Simon Peter asked, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “You can't go with me now, but later on you will.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Simon Petro úye-nwu ɔnini, “Blɔti, wɛ na ésela?” Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Kesii kani na lísela ni, alakana-mi bɔsiaku ɔƒaani. Nsu nwuna kama ni, adubɔsia-mi kama ebo mmɔ.”

english_verse: Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
translation_verse: Amu na Petro úye-nwu ɔnini, “Blɔti, bi ɔsu na naaakana-a bɔsiaku ɔƒaani? Nnye kagyumana ka likpi na ƒula lili!”

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Aaƒɔ́ taadi geen ka enye kagyumana ka ekpi na mina lili? Mɔɔsu-ɔ litemi geen nnii asa na akɔkɔ wete kenye ni, adubɔsu kɔtɛ sɔɔn anii aaagyi-mi.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛda kayi bukpoku bɛya. Kalɛ kani na bɛɛƒɔ́ Katɔti taadi ni, bɛƒɔ ami lɛnɔ bɛdi.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: Kuduokɔ pii kɔkya mina Ɔti kesii. Na lísela ntáklibi kuduokɔ kɔmmɔ lise-mii. Na si buse na uuuse lɛni ni, nka naaasu ɔmɛni.

english_verse: After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si lísie ńtáklibi-ku lɛ́wɔlɔ ni, ndubɔsɔ linwini libo na mbakpanku-mii ntése mina kudɔ na amii lɛnɔ bilie mmɔ.

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Amu na Toma ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Blɔti, bɔɔɔgyi kesii kani na ésela. Anwuɔsu bulati ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na bɔdubɔsia asa na bubo-ɔ kudɔ.”

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Ami ndi ulu ɔmmɔ ku litemi geen lɛmmɔ ku ngba bɔmmɔ. Na ɔdi ulakana Katɔti kudɔ buduo, amu ntu mina lɛlɔ na ɔ́sia.

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: Na si bɛgyi-mi sɔsɔ ni, bɛdubɔti mina Ɔti lɛnɔ. Anwuɔsu ɔƒɛni ni, bɛgyi Katɔti ɔmmɔ na bɛ́ɛnu-nwu lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Amu na Ƒilipo ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Blɔti, lɛla lɛni kani na bɔɔwia ndi ka edie Ƒ'ɔti ɔmmɔ atina-bu.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu údie kenye na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Ɔ́si uwi gyɔlɔɔ ɔni ƒui na lɛ́ɛkya-mii kudɔ mɛni ni, bɔsu na amu ada anii aaagyi-mi? Ƒilipo, ukyuli ɔni náanu-mi dii ni, ɔ́ɔnu Ati lɛnɔ. Na bi ɔsu na asɔ aasu-mi anii, ‘Tina-bu Ati ɔmmɔ’?

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Átaƒɔ átadi ka ami nliku Katɔti, na anwu lɛnɔ uliku-mi? Ala ani ƒui na lɛ́su-mii ni, aaadi ami ɔlati etemila kani na adi. Mmomu adi Katɔti ɔni nliku-mi na ɔɔbla nwuna kabla ɔdi.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Bɛƒɔ-mi bɛdi si lɛ́su-mii nnii ami nliku Katɔti, na anwu lɛnɔ uliku-mi. Si alakana ɔmɛni bɔbla ni, ɔlɛka bɛƒɔ mina ala ani na mɔɔbla lɛti bɛdi.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii geen nnii ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mi taadi ni, ɔdubɔbla ala ani na mɔɔbla. Na ɔdubɔbla-nya utulo kalɛ na lɛ́bla. Ɔsika bɔtɔlɔ nda nteesie mina Ɔti kudɔ.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: Na lɛla biala na bivele si bɛ́kpali-mi lɛnyi ni, ndubɔbla-ni lite-mii. Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na ɔkɛnku-mi lɛlɔ ni, bekyuli badubɔkɔliku mina Ɔti lɛnyi katɔ.

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Bɛkpali-mi lɛnyi bivele lɛla biala, na ndubɔbla-ni lite-mii. Yesu Ɔ́su Nwuna Batɛyane Ka Ɔdubute-ma Katɔti Kɔyu

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
translation_verse: “Si bɛɛyɔ́-mi ni, bɛdubɔdi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: Na ndubuvele mina Ɔti na ute-mii Ubunkune ɔbambadi ɔni ndubulie-mii kudɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: Anwu ndi Kɔyu kɔni muudie litemi geen lɛni ndanku Katɔti lɛlɔ taatina. Nsu kayawi bekyuli balakana enu bugyingya bɔƒɔ-nwu. Ɔsika balanu-nwu balati. Nsu amii ni, Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kuliku-mii na kɔdubɔƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
translation_verse: Si lɛ́tɔlɔ-mii kudɔ ni, naaada-mii neeese aani bekpinebi. Mmomu ndubɔsɔ linwini libo-mii kudɔ.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: Kébu blii na kayawi bekyuli basɔ balanu-mi. Nsu amii bɛdubo-mi bɔnu. Na ka nli ngba ɔsu ni, amii lɛnɔ bɛdubulie ngba.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Si limeyi lɛmmɔ lídu ni, bɛdubɔti ka ami nliku mina Ɔti, na amii biliku-mi aani kalɛ na ami lɛnɔ nliku-mii.

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: “Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔdi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni, anwu mɔɔyɔ́-mi. Na mina Ɔti ɔdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyɔ́-mi. Na ami lɛnɔ ndubɔyɔ-nwu na lidie lɛlɔ lɛtina-nwu na ɔnu-mi.”

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Amu na Yuda ɔni naaadi Iskariot ubidi ɔmmɔ úye Yesu ɔnini, “Blɔti, dɛ na ɔdubɔbla na abu kani na adubudie lɛlɔ atina, na bayawine balanu-ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔyɔ́-mi ni, ɔdubɔdi mina ala ani mɔɔtina lɛlɔ. Na mina Ɔti ɔdubɔyɔ-nwu. Na ami ku mina Ɔti bɔdububo-nwu kudɔ na abu ku-nwu bɔsɔ bulie.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni naaayɔ-mi ni, uladi mina ala ani mɔɔtina lɛlɔ. Na ala ani bínu ka lɛ́su mɛni ni, ɔɔɔdi ami ɔlati kani náta mɔɔsu-nya. Mmomu mina Ɔti ɔni nátala-mi kudɔ na ási.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: “Ala amɛni ƒui na lɛ́ɛsu-mii uwi ɔni na nkya-mii kudɔ.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Katɔti Kɔyu kɔni ndi Ubunkune ɔni na Katɔti ɔdubɔtala ɔkya-mii na mina lɛnyi kemmo ni, anwu ndubɔtina-mii lɛla biala. Na ɔdubɔya na binyimo ala ani ƒui na lɛ́su-mii.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: “Keyi buɛɛ na lɛ́da muusé-mii. Na mina keyi buɛɛ na líti muute-mii. Ɔɔɔdi aani kalɛ na bayawine beete ukyuli keyi buɛɛ kalɛ. Kayi ku kasusu ketekpoku-mii na ala ani ndubo bɔlɛ lɛlɔ. Na bitayia.

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: Bínu ka lɛ́su-mii nnii, ‘Bɔtɔlɔ nda bina kudɔ, na ndubɔsɔ linwini libo-mii kudɔ.’ Si bɛgyi ka bɛɛyɔ́-mi geen ni, kubiti kɔdubɔda-mii ka lísela Ati kudɔ. Ɔsika anwu utulo-mi.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́ɛsu-mii ɔmɛni líse asa na ala ammɔ ebo abalɛ kalɛ na si uwi ɔni na álɛ sɔsɔ ni, na bɛƒɔ bɛdi.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: Nsɔ naaakana-mii bɔtɛmiku gyɔlɔɔ. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ ni, ɔ́si ɔdubo. Na uuubo ɔyikun ɔdi na mina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔlɛka bayawine bati ka mɔɔyɔ́ Ati, na mɔɔbla lɛla biala kalɛ kani na úbo-mii ɔda. “Amu bibo, na bɔgyu.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: Ami ndi kɔdingyii kɔbuni, na mina Ɔti ndi kugyii kɔmɛni lɛlɔ ɔnune.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: Ɔɔmɛnɛ kagba biala kani naaakana bɔnwu teedie kɔgba kɔkladi akɔ. Na ɔɔƒiala kɔgba kɔni mɔɔnwu lɛnɔ kemmo kalɛ na kuna akɔ kɔbla nwaa na kɔkana kutaanwu kaduɛ.

english_verse: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na lɛ́ya na amii lɛnɔ bɛ́bla sɛɛn ɔkɛnku ala ani na lɛ́su-mii ɔsu.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Bɛsɔ biliku-mi, na ami lɛnɔ ndubuliku-mii. Kugyii kagba kadi kalatɛ sɛsɛɛ taanwu ebi aka lɛti. Ɔlɛka kada kugyii kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Lɛni kani na amii lɛnɔ bilakana ebi adi bɔnwu, amu ntu bɛsɔ biliku-mi.

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
translation_verse: “Ami ndi kɔdingyii kɔmmɔ, na amii ndi kuna kɔgba. Ukyuli ɔni nliku-mi na ami lɛnɔ nliku-nwu ni, ɔɔnwu ebi pii. Ɔsika bilakana lɛla lɛdi bɔbla si liiibo-mii kemmo.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔni neeeliku-mi ni, use aani kugyii kagba kani békulo bávaakun na kákwii. Na kɔgba kɔmmɔ udu ni, bɔsala na baasála-ku taakya ogya na kɔkywi.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Si biliku-mi na mina etemila ákɛ keliekɔ na bina lɛlɔ kemmo ni, bivele lɛla biala na bɛɛwia, na ndubute-mii.

english_verse: When you become fruitful disciples of mine, my Father will be honored.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́nwu ebi pii ni, ɔmɛni ɔɔyá na bekyuli baakɔliku mina Ɔti lɛnyi katɔ. Na ɔmmɔ ɔɔtina lɛnɔ ka bɛdi mina batɛyane.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyɔ́-mii kalɛ kani na mina Ɔti ɔɔyɔ́-mi. Anwuɔsu bɛsɔ biliku-mii na ntaayɔ-mii uwi biala.

english_verse: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
translation_verse: Si bɛɛdi mina ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni, bɛdubulieku-mi na ndubɔyɔ-mii uwi ƒui. Lɛni kani na lɛ́di mina Ɔti ɔda bubo lɛlɔ na nliku-nwu, na ɔɔyɔ́-mi uwi ƒui.

english_verse: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́ɛsu-mii ala amɛni ƒui kalɛ na ebiti ani na mɔɔkɛ́ ni, amii lɛnɔ bɛkɛ-nya na edu awɔlɔ.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: Na ɔda ɔni na líbo-mii ndi ɔmɛni. Bɛyɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ kani na ńtaayɔ-mii.

english_verse: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
translation_verse: Na bɔyɔ bunengudi bɔni kani na ukyuli ɔdubɔkana na ɔyɔ nwuna bakpana ndi ka uti nwuna ngba ute na bana lili.

english_verse: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
translation_verse: Na amii ndi mina bakpana si bɛɛdi mina ɔda ɔni na líbo-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: Nsɔ naaalɔ-mii mina kabla bablane ɔƒɛni, ɔsika ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla ukyuli bamba kabla ni, ɔɔɔgyi lɛla lɛni na nwuna unwoti ɔɔbla. Mmomu mɔɔlɔ-mii nnii bakpana. Ɔsika lɛla biala na línu lɛ́siku mina Ɔti kudɔ ni, ani na lɛ́su-mii.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi amii náƒuna-mi. Mmomu ami náƒuna-mii. Na lɛ́ƒuna-mii lise ka bisie bitátaabla kabla kabuni kani ndi ebi pii ani na bɛdubɔnwu. Na abla ebi ani ndubutu uwi na elebie. Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔdubute-mii lɛla biala na bivele-nwu si bɛ́kpali-mi lɛnyi.

english_verse: So I command you to love each other. The World's Hatred
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔda ɔni muubo-mi ndi ɔmɛni. Bɛyɔ lɛlɔ. Kayawi Bekyuli Beekisi Yesu Batɛyane

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: “Si kayawi bekyuli beekisi-mii ni, bɛti kɔnakunwi ka ami na báka bukisi lɛni.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Si bɛ́bla unwi ku kayawi bekyuli na bana ablala kemmo ni, badubɔyɔ-mii aani bana badi. Nsu ami lɛ́ƒuna-mii lɛ́lɛku kayawi bekyuli bammɔ akɔ, na bɛsɔ bɛɛɛdi bana badi. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na beekisi-mii.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Binyimo ka lɛ́su-mii nnii, ‘Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla ukyuli bamba kabla ni, uletulo nwuna unwoti.’ Si bekyuli békpoku-mi ni, bɛti ka badubo amii lɛnɔ bukpoku. Si bádi ala ani na lɛ́tina-ma lɛlɔ ni, badubɔdi amii adi lɛnɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Nsu kayawi bekyuli badubo-mii bukpoku, ɔsika binye na mina lɛnyi kemmo. Na baaagyi anwu ɔni nátala-mi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: Si bubo na ńtebo ńtabasu-ma lɛla lɛdi ni, nka ukyuli ɔdi uládu-ma kɔtɔ ka bábla likpidi lɛdi. Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, basɔ balakana bɔsu banii bátati asa na bábla likpidi.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni muukisi-mi ni, uukisi mina Ɔti lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: Na si bubo na ńtebo ńtababla ala ani udu na ɔdi útabla kudii na bana akɔ ni, nka ukyuli ɔdi uládu-ma kɔtɔ ka bábla likpidi lɛdi. Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, bánu ala ani na lɛ́bla, nsu beekisi ami ku mina Ɔti.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Na ala amɛni ƒui ni, ɔlɛka ebo-nwu kemmo lɛni kalɛ kani na bénweni bése na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo banini, ‘Beekisi-mi keeke.’

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: “Katɔti Kɔyu kɔni ndi Ubunkune ɔ́si Katɔti kudɔ ɔdubo. Na anwu muudie litemi geen lɛni ndanku Katɔti lɛlɔ taatina. Ami ndubɔtala-nwu lɛsiku Katɔti kudɔ lɛkya-mii. Na ɔdubɔsu-mii ala ɔsiku-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: Na amii lɛnɔ bɛsu bekyuli ala bɛsiku-mi lɛlɔ, ɔsika bɛ́ɛsiaku-mi kama ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ ƒui.”

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́ɛsu-mii ɔmɛni kalɛ na enu alaƒɛ-mii na bina bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo.

english_verse: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
translation_verse: Badubo-mii bɔgya bɔlɛku Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ. Na uwi ɔdi lɛnɔ ɔdubo ubedu ɔni na bekyuli badubɔdu-mii. Na bani ndubɔbla lɛni ni, badubɔkali banii Katɔti kabla na baabla.

english_verse: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badubo-mii ɔmɛni bɔbla, ɔsika baaagyi ami iye Katɔti.

english_verse: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
translation_verse: Mmomu lɛ́su-mii ɔmɛni kalɛ na si uwi ɔni na bábla ala amɛni údu ni, na binyimo lɛla lɛni na lɛ́su-mii. “Ńtasu-mii ala amɛni ńtasiku kalɔ kesekɔ, ɔsika nkya-mii kudɔ uwi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒaani ni, bɔtɔlɔ na nda. Lísela mina Ɔti ɔni nátala-mi kudɔ. Nsu bina ɔdi úteye-mi ɔnii, ‘Wɛ na ésela?’

english_verse: You are very sad from hearing all of this.
translation_verse: Na ka lɛ́ɛya na bɛ́ti ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bina lɛlɔ lɛ́bla-mii kɔnyana.

english_verse: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
translation_verse: Nsu mɔɔsu-mii geen ka ni, si lɛ́tɔlɔ-mii kudɔ ni, ɔdia-mii utulo. Ɔsika si ńtatɔlɔ ni, Ubunkune ɔmmɔ ulebo-mii kudɔ. Nsu si lɛ́tɔlɔ ni, ndubɔtala-nwu lɛkya-mii.

english_verse: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
translation_verse: Na si úbo ni, ɔdubo ubedie ɔtina kayawi bekyuli ƒui nwaa ka baabla likpidi, na baaasiaku ulu siin ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ, na benye Katɔti anumi kalɛ na ɔtɛku-ma litemi.

english_verse: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
translation_verse: Na badubɔnu ka baaasiaku ulu siin ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ, ɔsika lísela mina Ɔti kudɔ na bɛsɔ bɛɛɛdubo-mi bɔnu.

english_verse: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
translation_verse: Na badubɔnu ka Katɔti ɔɔtɛku bekyuli litemi, ɔsika Katɔti ɔ́ɔtɛku ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ litemi kukuuku na ɔ́ɔdu-nwu kɔtɔ.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
translation_verse: “Mbo ala pii na lɛsu-mii. Nsu adubo bumomo butulo-mii ɔƒɛni.

english_verse: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Nsu si uwi ɔni na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔni muudie litemi geen lɛni ndanku Katɔti lɛlɔ mmɔ úbo ni, ɔdubo-mii bɔtɔnku kalɛ na bɛnu litemi geen lɛmmɔ ƒui bɛti. Na ulatɛmi na anwu ɔlati ɔyikun kemmo. Mmomu lɛla lɛni na únu ni, ɔdubo-mii bɔsu na ɔsu-mii ala ani ndubo bɔlɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
translation_verse: Ɔdubɔya na bekyuli bakɔliku-mi lɛnyi katɔ, ɔsika lɛla lɛni na masu-nwu ni, ani na ɔdubuti ubasu-mii.

english_verse: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
translation_verse: Ala ani ƒui nse Katɔti ni, adi ami adi. Anwuɔsu na lɛ́su nnii ala ani nse-mi ni, Katɔti Kɔyu kɔdubuti-nya ɔtina-mii. Batɛyane Kɔnyana Kɔdubunwini Lɛlɔyɔ

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
translation_verse: “Kébu uwi blii ɔdi na bɛsɔ bilanu-mi. Na ɔmmɔ kama blii lɛnɔ ni, bɛdubɔsɔ bɛnu-mi.”

english_verse: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
translation_verse: Amu na nwuna batɛyane badi béye lɛlɔ banini, “Lɛla lɛni na ɔɔsu kalɔ ndi bi? Ɔnii kébu uwi blii ɔdi na bɔsɔ bulanu-nwu. Na ɔmɛni kama blii lɛnɔ bɔdubɔsɔ bɔnu-nwu. Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-bu lɛnɔ ɔnii, ‘Ɔsika lísela mina Ɔti kudɔ.’

english_verse: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na ɔ́su ɔnii kébu uwi blii kalɔ ndi bi? Bɔɔɔgyi lɛla lɛni lɛlɔ na ɔɔtɛmi taasiku!”

english_verse: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́ti ka nwuna batɛyane bammɔ baayɔ́ beye-nwu lɛla lɛdi basiaku ɔmɛni lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu na úye-ma ɔnini, “Lɛ́su nnii kébu uwi blii ɔdi na bɛsɔ bilanu-mi. Na ɔmmɔ kama blii lɛnɔ na bɛdubɔsɔ bɛnu-mi. Ɔmɛni lɛlɔ litemi na biiye lɛlɔ teenu?

english_verse: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii geen nnii bɛdubo kɔnyana buwulo na biwulo keku. Nsu kayawi bekyuli badubo ebiti bɔkɛ mmomu. Na amii ni, bɛdubɔbla kɔnyana, nsu bina kɔnyana kɔdubunwini lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
translation_verse: Si uleku ɔɔyɔ́ ɔwɔ ni, ubo kɔnyana, ɔsika uwi ɔni na uubo abi údu. Nsu si uwi ɔni na ɔ́wɔ ubi ɔmmɔ ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔɔyiƒala abi ani na úbo. Ɔsika ɔɔkɛ́ ebiti ka ɔ́wɔ ubi ɔ́kya kayawi.

english_verse: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
translation_verse: Lɛni geen na use ute amii lɛnɔ. Ɔƒaani ni, bina lɛlɔ libo kɔnyana. Nsu ndubɔsɔ mbanu-mii. Na mmɔ ni, lɛlɔyɔ lɛdubɔƒɔ-mii kayi kemmo ƒui. Lɛlɔyɔ lɛmɛni udu na ukyuli ɔdi biala ulakana bɔƒɔ bɔsiku-mii kudɔ kudii!

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: “Si uwi ɔni na limeyi lɛmmɔ líbo líbedu ni, bileye-mi lɛla lɛdi. Ɔsika mɔɔsu-mii geen ka lɛla biala na bɛdubɔkpali-mi lɛnyi bivele mina Ɔti ni, ɔdubute-mii.

english_verse: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
translation_verse: Úti úbedu uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ni, bítakpali-mi lɛnyi bítevele tɔ Katɔti lɛla lɛdi. Bivele-nwu na ɔdubute-mii, na bina ebiti adubudu awɔlɔ.

english_verse: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
translation_verse: “Agba kemmo sɔɔn na lɛ́su-mii ala amɛni ƒui. Nsu uwi ɔdubo ɔni na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo agba bubo. Mmomu ndubo-mii bɔtɛmiku nwaa bɔsiku mina Ɔti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
translation_verse: Na si limeyi lɛmmɔ lídu ni, bɛdubo-mi lɛnyi bɔkpali bivele-nwu ala. Naaasu nnii ami ndubo-nwu ala buvele bute-mii.

english_verse: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Ati ɔlati ɔɔyɔ́-mii. Ɔɔyɔ́-mii ɔsika amii lɛnɔ bɛɛyɔ́-mi, na bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́di ka Katɔti kudɔ na lɛ́si líbo.

english_verse: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka Ati kudɔ na lɛ́si líbo kayawi. Na ɔƒɛni mɔɔtɔlɔ kayawi kamɛni kemmo nteesie Ati kudɔ.”

english_verse: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu batɛyane bammɔ básu-nwu banini, “Ɔƒɛni na aatɛmi nwaa, na asɔ elebo lɛgba.

english_verse: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni na bɔ́ti ka agyi lɛla biala, na ɔ́sɔ útalɛka ukyuli ɔdi uye-ɔ litemi lɛdi. Ɔmɛni lɛti pɛ ɔ́ya na bɔ́ti ka Katɔti kudɔ na ási ébo.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu úye-ma ɔnini, “Bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́di ɔƒɛni kani?

english_verse: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdubo, na úudu lɛnɔ ɔni na bɛdubo bugyingya bɛtɔlɔ-mi kudɔ, na ɔdi biala uteesie nwuna kaduli na bɛda ami lɛti binyene. Nsu geen ni, ɔɔɔdi ami lɛti nnye. Ɔsika mina Ɔti unye-mi kudɔ.

english_verse: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni na lɛ́su-mii kalɛ na kayi kasɔ kelékpoku-mii si biliku-mi. Kayawi bekyuli badubo bɔya na bibo abi. Nsu binye kpakplaa! Ɔsika lɛ́ɛdi kayawi kamɛni lɛbibo biala lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́su-ma ala amɛni ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔ́kɔliku anumi ɔ́nu katɔ na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ati, uwi ɔmmɔ údu. Kɔliku ami ƒ'ubidi katɔ kalɛ na ami lɛnɔ lɛ́kɔliku ƒula lɛnyi katɔ.

english_verse: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.
translation_verse: Ɔsika éti ɔyikun unengudi éte-mi na kayawi bekyuli ƒui akɔ kalɛ na lɛya na bani ƒui na éti éte-mi ni, belie ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii.

english_verse: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
translation_verse: Na ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii mɛni kalɔ ndi ka bekyuli bamɛni bati awɔ, na bati ka awɔ lɛti pɛ ndi Katɔti geen ɔmmɔ, na bati ami Yesu Kristo ɔni na átala.

english_verse: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
translation_verse: Lɛ́kɔliku ƒula lɛnyi katɔ na bekyuli akɔ na kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na lɛ́wɔlɔ kabla kani na éte-mi ka mbabla.

english_verse: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ni, Ati, sɔ kɔliku mina lɛnyi katɔ na ƒula anumi aani kalɛ na nse ɔni na lɛ́kya-a kudɔ asa na édie kayawi. Yesu Ɔ́kpali Katɔ Na Nwuna Batɛyane Lili

english_verse: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
translation_verse: “Lɛ́ɛya na bekyuli bani na áƒuna álɛku kayawi bekyuli akɔ éte-mi báti-ɔ. Awɔ ɔdi na badi, na éti-ma éte-mi. Bádi ƒula etemila ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They know that you gave me everything I have.
translation_verse: Na bagyi ɔƒɛni ka lɛla biala na éte-mi ni, ƒula kudɔ na lɛ́si.

english_verse: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Kenye kani na ásu-mi ka mabasu-ma ni, bégyingya enu báƒɔ-ka. Na bagyi ka sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka ƒula kudɔ na lɛ́si, na awɔ nátala-mi.

english_verse: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
translation_verse: Mɔɔkpali katɔ na bana lili, na ɔɔɔdi kayawi bekyuli ƒui lili. Mmomu bani na éti éte-mi lili, ɔsika awɔ ɔdi na badi.

english_verse: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine, and they will bring glory to me.
translation_verse: “Bani ƒui na mbo ni, awɔ badi na badi. Na bani ƒui na ebo ni, ami badi na badi. Na bekyuli baakɔliku-mi lɛnyi katɔ ɔkɛnku ama ɔsu.

english_verse: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, lɛ́tɔlɔ ndubo-ɔ kudɔ. Na nsɔ lɛɛɛkya kayawi kamɛni kemmo. Nsu ama bamu bakya kayawi. Ati Kedee, gyumana-ma ɔkɛnku ɔyikun ala ani mɔɔlɛ́ si bákpali-ɔ lɛnyi. Na lɛnyi lɛmmɔ kani na éti éte-mi. Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na babla unwi aani kalɛ na ami ku awɔ bɔdi benwi.

english_verse: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na nkya-ma kudɔ ni, lɛ́da-ma kɔkɔɔkɔ na lɛ́gyumana-ma ɔkɛnku ɔyikun ɔni nkya lɛnyi lɛni na éte-mi kemmo. Ńtayila bana akɔ ɔdi, amu ntu anwu ɔni básu bese ka ayila-nwu udu. Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo etemila ebo-nwu kemmo kalɛ na básu.

english_verse: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
translation_verse: “Na ɔƒaani ni, lɛ́tɔlɔ ndubo-ɔ kudɔ na muuvele-ɔ ɔmɛni lite-ma na kayawi kalɛ na mina ebiti aƒɔ-ma kayi kemmo ƒui na edu awɔlɔ.

english_verse: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
translation_verse: Líboku-ma ƒula linyesia na kayawi bekyuli békisi-ma, ɔsika ɔɔɔdi kayawi kamɛni ɔdi na badi kalɛ kani na ami lɛnɔ lɛɛɛdi kayawi kamɛni ɔdi.

english_verse: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
translation_verse: “Na ɔɔɔdi buvele na nda-a nnii da-ma die kayawi kamɛni kemmo. Mmomu buvele na nda-a ka agyumana-ma alɛku ukisine ɔmmɔ enu kemmo.

english_verse: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
translation_verse: Kalɛ kani na lɛɛɛdi kayawi kamɛni ɔdi ni, lɛni kani na ama lɛnɔ baaadi kayawi kamɛni badi.

english_verse: Your word is the truth. So let this truth make them completely yours.
translation_verse: Bla-ma kedee te ƒula lɛlɔ ɔkɛnku ƒula etemila geen ani na bénu lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ƒula litemi lɛdi litemi geen.

english_verse: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
translation_verse: Lɛ́tala-ma mɔɔkya kayawi bekyuli aani kalɛ kani na átala-mi ákya kayawi bekyuli.

english_verse: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
translation_verse: Na ama ɔsu ni, lɛ́bla lɛlɔ kedee lite-ɔ kalɛ na akana abla ama lɛnɔ kedee. Yesu Ɔ́kpali Katɔ Na Baƒɔtaadine Ƒui Lili

english_verse: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.
translation_verse: “Ɔɔɔdi ama lɛti lili na mɔɔkpali-ɔ teevele lɛla lɛdi. Mmomu ku bekyuli bani ƒui ndubɔƒɔ-mi badi ɔkɛnku ƒula litemi buni lɛni badubɔsu-ma kemmo lili lɛnɔ na muuvele.

english_verse: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
translation_verse: Ati, muuvele ka aya na bana ƒui babla unwi aani kalɛ kani na awɔ eliku-mi na ami lɛnɔ nliku-ɔ. Ya na belieku-bu kalɛ na kayawi bekyuli baƒɔ badi ka awɔ nátala-mi.

english_verse: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
translation_verse: “Líte-ma lɛnyi buni lɛni na éte-mi kalɛ na bana ƒui babla unwi kalɛ kani na ami ku-ɔ bɔdi unwi.

english_verse: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
translation_verse: Ami nliku-ma, na awɔ eliku-mi. Ya na babla unwi bawɔlɔ kalɛ na kayawi bekyuli banu bati ka awɔ nátala-mi, na aayɔ́-ma kalɛ kani na aayɔ́-mi.

english_verse: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
translation_verse: “Ati, awɔ néti-ma éte-mi. Na mɔɔwia ka belie-mi kudɔ na kesii kani na nkya kalɛ na banu kalɛ na ákɔliku-mi lɛnyi katɔ. Ɔmɛni ndi lɛnyi lɛni na éte-mi. Ɔsika aayɔ́-mii kukuuku asa na édie kayawi ku kana lɛla biala.

english_verse: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
translation_verse: “Ati, ese siin. Na kayawi bekyuli baaagyi-ɔ, nsu ami ngyi-ɔ. Na ƒula badi lɛnɔ bagyi ka awɔ nátala-mi.

english_verse: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
translation_verse: Lídie-ɔ lɛ́tina-ma. Na ndubo butaabla lɛni kalɛ na bati ka aayɔ́-ma aani kalɛ na aayɔ́-mi, na bati ka nliku-ma.”

english_verse: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, “Didn't I see you in the garden with that man?”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔkpane unengudi nwuna kabla ɔblane ɔdi ɔni na ɔnwani ndi okloƒu ɔni kɔtu na Petro ɔ́nwi ɔ́mami ni, úye Petro ɔnini, “Ɔɔɔdi awɔ na lɛ́nu na nnɔ egyii kemmo mmɔ ka enye-nwu kudɔ iye?”

english_verse: Jesus again asked, “Who are you looking for?” “We are looking for Jesus from Nazareth,” they answered.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́sɔ úye-ma kunyɔdi ɔnini, “Ɔma na bɛɛwia?” Na ama lɛnɔ básɔ bédie kenye banini, “Yesu Nasareni.”

english_verse: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Lɛ́ɛsu-mii nnii bɛɛnu-mi mɛni.” Na Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Si ami na bɛɛwia bɔdi ni, bɛya na bekyuli bakladi bamɛni batɔlɔ.”

english_verse: Then everything will happen, just as I said, ‘I did not lose anyone you gave me.’ ”
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́su ɔmɛni kalɛ na ala ani na ɔ́su úbavi ebo ete lɛni uwi ɔni na ɔ́su ɔnii, “Ati, bekyuli bani ƒui na éte-mi ni, ńtayila bana akɔ ɔdi.”

english_verse: Simon Peter had brought along a sword. He pulled it out and struck at Malchus, the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
translation_verse: Na mmɔ ni, Simon Petro ɔda kewii kadi. Amu na ɔ́ni-ka ɔ́kpa livuo kemmo, na ɔ́nwi ɔkpane unengudi kabla ɔblane kɔdianu kɔtu úkulo. Na kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ baalɔ Malkus.

english_verse: The Roman officer and his men, together with the temple police, arrested Jesus and tied him up.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Romaƒuɔ bekpone ku bana ɔtɔnkune ku Yudaƒuɔ bagyumanane badi béƒie Yesu, na bényimi-nwu.

english_verse: Peter stayed outside near the gate. But the other disciple came back out and spoke to the girl at the gate. She let Peter go in,
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔmmɔ ni, Petro anwu ɔsɔ unye kayakun. Amu na ɔtɛyane ɔmmɔ ɔ́sɔ únwini úbo úbatɛmiku ulekubi ɔni nnye ɔba kenye mmɔ, na ɔ́ya na Petro lɛnɔ uduo kaduli kammɔ.

english_verse: but asked him, “Aren't you one of that man's followers?” “No, I am not!” Peter answered.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ulekubi ɔmmɔ úye Petro ɔnini, “Ɔɔɔdi ɔnana ɔmmɔ batɛyane akɔ unwi na adi?” Amu na Petro údie kenye ɔnini, “Oowo, lɛɛɛdi bana akɔ ɔdi.”

english_verse: It was cold, and the servants and temple police had made a charcoal fire. They were warming themselves around it, when Peter went over and stood near the fire to warm himself. Jesus Is Questioned by the High Priest (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ni, ka kɔyɔ kɔɔda-ma ɔsu ni, kabla bablane bammɔ ku bagyumanane bammɔ básala ogya ɔdi na benye baawaa. Na Petro lɛnɔ ɔ́gyu úsie unye-ma kudɔ mmɔ ɔɔwaa ogya ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: The high priest questioned Jesus about his followers and his teaching.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ni, ɔkpane unengudi ɔkya uuye Yesu ala taasiku nwuna basiakune ku ala ani na ɔɔtina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Why are you questioning me? Why don't you ask the people who heard me? They know what I have said.”
translation_verse: Na bi ɔsu na eeye-mi lɛla lɛdi na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ? Ye bekyuli bani nénu-mi bɔtɛmi. Ama ngyi ala ani na lɛ́su-ma.”

english_verse: Jesus was still tied up, and Annas sent him to Caiaphas the high priest. Peter Again Denies that He Knows Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Hana úti Yesu ɔni na bámu bényimi bada úmene Ɔkpane Unengudi Kaiaƒa.

english_verse: It was early in the morning when Jesus was taken from Caiaphas to the building where the Roman governor stayed. But the crowd waited outside. Any of them who had gone inside would have become unclean and would not be allowed to eat the Passover meal.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔtanta tutuutu ni, bákpanku Yesu básiku Kaiaƒa kudɔ mmɔ, na béti-nwu bésienku Romaƒuɔ aban unengudi kaduli. Nsu Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ béteduo mmɔ, ɔsika na bana ɔda bubo kenye ni, bátayɔ ka beduo mmɔ na ɔya bana lɛlɔ lise lɛlɔ ka badubo Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi bɔdi ɔsu.

english_verse: Pilate came out and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Pilato ɔ́lɛ úbo-ma kudɔ na ɔba kenye mmɔ, na úye-ma ɔnini, “Likpidi lɛmani na ɔ́bla?”

english_verse: They answered, “He is a criminal! That's why we brought him to you.”
translation_verse: Amu na bédie kenye banini, “Si ɔɔɔdi likpidi bonwu lɛdi na ɔ́bla ni, nka bulakpanku-nwu buleboku ƒula kudɔ.”

english_verse: And so what Jesus said about his death would soon come true.
translation_verse: Na ala amɛni álɛ lɛni kalɛ na litemi lɛni na Yesu ɔ́su ɔ́siku kukpi kɔni udu na ɔdubo bukpi lɛlɔ ubo ute lɛni sɔsɔ.

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Amu na Pilato únwini útéduo kaduli mmɔ, na ɔ́lɔ Yesu na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ ndi Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Yesu únwini na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ ɔlati muuye-mi kenye kamɛni, munuu bekyuli bamba násu-ɔ banii ye-mi nu?”

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: Amu na Pilato údie kenye ɔnini, “Aabu anii Yudani na ndi? Awɔ ɔlati ƒula kadi bekyuli ku bakpane benengu néti-ɔ bábakya-mi kɔnu. Bi na ábla?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Mina lɛga bɔdi bútasi kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ. Si banii kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ lɛga bɔdi na lɛdi ni, nka mina basiakune badubukpo bete-mi kalɛ na neeeduo Yudaƒuɔ benengu enu kemmo. Nsu ni, ɔɔɔdi lɛni na use. Mina lɛga bɔdi lɛ́si kesii bamba.”

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Ka ɔ́su-nwu lɛni ni, Pilato úye-nwu ɔnini, “Anwuɔsu ɔga na adi?” Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ mɔɔsu ka ɔga na ndi. Na ɔmɛni ɔsu geen na báwɔ-mi. Na líbo kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ kalɛ na mbedie litemi geen lɛtina. Na ukyuli biala ɔni nkɛnku litemi geen lɛmmɔ ni, uunú lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu.”

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Nsu na bina ɔda bubo bɔni na bibo kenye ni, si údu Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi bɔdi uwi ni, uwi biala mɔɔnyonu batɔntɛne akɔ unwi. Anwuɔsu ni, bɛɛwia ka lɛnyonu Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga?”

english_verse: They shouted, “No, not him! We want Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a terrorist.
translation_verse: Amu na bana ƒui báva básu banini, “Oowo! Ɔɔɔdi anwu, mmomu Baraba!” Na Baraba ɔmɛni ɔdi bekyuli ɔdune.

english_verse: Pilate gave orders for Jesus to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, Pilato ɔ́ya na bagyumanane béti kɔbuli kɔni na bélii básala na bébo Yesu kaduɛ.

english_verse: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.
translation_verse: Na bekpone bammɔ béti liyu kagba bédi kabwa na béti bébi-nwu lili. Na béti awu ugyiedi gyɔlɔɔ ɔdi aani ɔga kalɛ bákya-nwu.

english_verse: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
translation_verse: Na beesié teebo-nwu kudɔ taabasu-nwu banini, “Yiidu! Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga ɔ́si ɔdubo o-o!” Na si básu-nwu lɛni ni, na bébo-nwu kɔnu ɔtugya.

english_verse: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Pilato ɔ́sɔ ɔ́lɛ úbo bekyuli lisu lɛmmɔ kudɔ úbasu-ma ɔnini, “Bɛnu! Ndubo-nwu bɔkpanku buboku bina anumi na mbatina-mi ka ńtanu likpidi lɛdi na nwuna lɛlɔ kalɛ na lɛdu-nwu kukpi kɔtɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yesu ɔ́lɛ úbo keyi mmɔ, na liyu kabwa kammɔ kebi-nwu lili na ɔkya awu ugyiedi gyɔlɔɔ ɔmmɔ. Mmɔ ni, Pilato ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bɛnu! Ukyuli ɔmmɔ na ɔdi mɛni!”

english_verse: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔni na bakpane benengu ku Yudaƒuɔ benengu bammɔ bánu-nwu ni, báva básu banini, “Kana-nwu mana ugyii lɛlɔ! Kana-nwu mana ugyii lɛlɔ!” Mmɔ ni, Pilato ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Amii biti-nwu na bitákana-nwu bɛmana ugyii lɛlɔ. Ami ńtanu likpidi lɛdi na nwuna lɛlɔ kalɛ na lɛdu-nwu kɔtɔ.”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli lisu lɛmmɔ básu banini, “Bubo ɔda bubo bɔni mɔɔtina ka ɔlɛka ukpi. Ɔsika ɔ́su ɔnii ɔdi Katɔti Ubidi.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he was terrified.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Pilato únu-ma kenye kamɛni ni, liƒu lɛ́sɔ lɛ́da-nwu libu.

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, ɔ́sɔ únwini útéduo kaduli mmɔ na úye Yesu ɔnini, “Wɛ na ási?” Nsu Yesu útedie kenye kadi.

english_verse: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
translation_verse: Amu na Pilato úye-nwu ɔnini, “Eledie lɛla lɛdi kenye alasu-mi? Aaagyi ka mbo kenyekɔ na lɛnyonu-ɔ, na mbo kenyekɔ na lɛya na bakana-a bamana ugyii lɛlɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Yesu údie kenye ɔnini, “Nka alákɛ ɔyikun ɔdi na mina lɛlɔ si ɔɔɔdi Katɔti néte-ɔ kuƒi kɔmmɔ. Anwuɔsu ukyuli ɔni néti-mi ɔ́kya-a kɔnu kemmo ni, ɔ́bla likpidi útulo-ɔ.”

english_verse: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Ka Pilato únu lɛla lɛmɛni ni, ɔ́wia ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔsia na ɔnyonu Yesu. Nsu bekyuli bammɔ bakya baava taasu banini, “Si ányonu-nwu ni, asɔ aaadi Ɔga Unengudi Kaesare kabla ɔblane! Na ukyuli biala ɔni meti lɛlɔ mabla ɔga ni, ɔ́ta únye Kaesare ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ!”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as “The Stone Pavement.” In Aramaic this pavement is called “Gabbatha.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ka Pilato únu etemila amɛni ni, ɔ́kpanku Yesu ɔ́lɛku na útélie litemi bɔtɛ liboku lɛlɔ kesii kani baalɔ banii Atabi Kasalakɔ. Na Hebri lɛdi kemmo banii Gabata.

english_verse: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, “Look at your king!”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ ɔbla aani ɔƒiiwi. Na lɛdi limeyi lɛni kadi kegye ndi Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi lɛmmɔ. Na Pilato ɔ́su bekyuli bammɔ ɔnini, “Bɛɛnu bina Ɔga!”

english_verse: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Ka básu lɛni ni, Pilato úti Yesu úte-ma ɔnii batákana-nwu bamana ugyii lɛlɔ. Bekpone Bákana Yesu Bámana Ugyii Lɛlɔ

english_verse: The soldiers first broke the legs of the other two men who were nailed there.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bekpone bammɔ bésie na nkyuli inyɔ bani na bákana bámana ugyii lɛlɔ bébunku Yesu mmɔ ni, bébo-ma lɛgba báƒɛ.

english_verse: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, “Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, ‘He claimed to be King of the Jews.’ ”
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛmɛni lítayɔ Yudaƒuɔ bakpane benengu bammɔ kaƒɔ. Anwuɔsu bátásu Pilato banini, “Útalɛka enweni anii Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga, mmomu ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔ́su ɔnii ɔdi Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́nu uni ku nwuna ɔtɛyane ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́ geen ka benye. Anwuɔsu ɔ́su uni ɔnini, “Nna, aanu ƒ'ubidi.”

english_verse: and he carried his cross to a place known as “The Skull.” In Aramaic this place is called “Golgotha.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bekpone bammɔ bákpanku Yesu bátɔlɔku. Na báya na anwu ɔlati uti ugyii ɔni lɛlɔ na badubo-nwu bɔkana bɔmana mmɔ. Na báyu ulu bésie kesii kani baalɔ banii Opokuo kalɔ. Na Hebri lɛdi kemmo ndi Golgota.

english_verse: There Jesus was nailed to the cross, and on each side of him a man was also nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bákana-nwu bámana ugyii lɛlɔ. Na mmɔ lɛnɔ ni, bákana nkyuli inyɔ bamba badi bámana ligyii lɛlɔ na Yesu kɔmii ku kɔdianu.

english_verse: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Pilato ɔ́ya na bénweni ala adi básia kalɛkɛ kadi lɛlɔ na úti-ka ɔ́mana Yesu ugyii ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na etemila ammɔ ndi amɛni. Yesu Nasareni, Yudaƒuɔ Ɔga.

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Yudaƒuɔ pii báka ala amɛni, ɔsika kesii kani na bákana Yesu bámana ugyii lɛlɔ mmɔ ude ɔma unengudi ɔmmɔ. Na Pilato únweni ala ammɔ lɛnɔ na Hebri ku Roma ku Griki lɛdi kemmo.

english_verse: But Pilate told them, “What is written will not be changed!”
translation_verse: Amu na Pilato údie kenye ɔnini, “Lɛla lɛni na línweni ni, líinweni lɛ́wɔlɔ.”

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: Na bekpone bammɔ básu lɛlɔ banini, “Buláni awu ɔmɛni bulabwɛ. Mmomu bɛya na bɔtu egulabi bɔnu bula akɔ ɔni menwini mewi na buti awu ɔmmɔ bute-nwu.” Na ɔkɛnku ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo etemila ébo éte lɛni sɔsɔ uwi ɔni na básu bése banii, “Béle-mi lɛlɔ ala béte lɛlɔ. Na bátu egulabi na mina awu lɛlɔ.” Na lɛni geen lɛnɔ na bekpone bammɔ bábla.

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Na Yesu ugyii ɔmmɔ kalɔ ni, Yesu uni ku uni ɔnwani ulekubi ku Klopa ulekudi Maria ku Maria Magdalene benye.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: Nsu ka bébedu Yesu kudɔ ni, bánu ka úukpi. Anwuɔsu anwu ni, bátaƒɛ-nwu lɛgba.

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: Na kesii kani na bádu Yesu mmɔ ni, likpo blii lɛdi lɛkya mmɔ. Na mmɔ ni, béku kaƒiɔtɔ kawɔdi kadi bése na bátava tɔ ukyuli kana kemmo kudii.

english_verse: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, “I am thirsty!”
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́ti ka ɔƒaani ni, ɔ́ɔwɔlɔ lɛla biala na ɔlɛka ɔbla. Na kalɛ na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ala ani bénweni bése ebo ete lɛni ɔsu ni, Yesu ɔ́su ɔnini, “Utukwɛ ɔɔda-mi.”

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Amu na kesii kani na ala amɛni aalɛ́ mmɔ ni, kalaku bonwu kadi kese na ntɛ bɔni nányi buwi. Anwuɔsu béti unwo bátu ugyii ɔdi baalɔ banii hisope lɛlɔ na bánwu bákya ntɛ bɔmmɔ kemmo, na bákɔliku bátu-nwu kenye.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́ni ntɛ bɔmmɔ ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɔƒɛni amu ɔ́sa!” Ka ɔ́su lɛni ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔ́kya lili kalɔ na ɔ́yula.

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Amu na Yudaƒuɔ benengu bammɔ básu Pilato banii ute-ma kuƒi na bekyuli bani na bákana bámana ugyii lɛlɔ mmɔ ni, na bebo-ma lɛgba ekubi baƒɛ na baƒami-ma na ugyii lɛlɔ mmɔ. Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ báwia ka babla ɔmɛni ɔsika limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdi Ƒida. Na bátayɔ ka bekyuli bammɔ ɔlɔna ɔƒa ligyii lɛlɔ mmɔ utédu kadi kégye kani ndi bana lɛnwunameyi. Na lɛnwunameyi lɛni ndubo mmɔ lɛnɔ lɛdi limeyi linengudi geen lɛni nse kedee ƒui lite-ma.

english_verse: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.
translation_verse: Mmomu ukpone unwi ɔ́tu-nwu ɔƒɛnyi ɔ́ƒuala ku nwuna lɛtula. Na mmɔ mmɔ ni, ubugya ku ntu bɔ́lɛ.

english_verse: We know this is true, because it was told by someone who saw it happen. Now you can have faith too.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni nánu ala amɛni ni, anwu muunweni-nya kalɛ na amii lɛnɔ bɛƒɔ bɛdi. Na lɛla lɛni na ɔ́su lɛnɔ ni, sɔsɔ na ɔdi. Na ɔgyi nwaa ka litemi geen na ɔɔsu.

english_verse: All this happened so that the Scriptures would come true, which say, “No bone of his body will be broken”
translation_verse: Bábla ala amɛni ƒui kalɛ na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo etemila ebo ete lɛni ɔni na bénweni banini, “Nwuna likubi linwi muedi balaƒɛ-ni.”

english_verse: and “They will see the one in whose side they stuck a spear.” Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Na bénweni lɛla bamba lɛnɔ banini, “Bekyuli badubɔnu anwu ɔni na bátu-nwu lɛtula ɔƒɛnyi mmɔ.” Báva Yesu

english_verse: The tomb was nearby, and since it was the time to prepare for the Sabbath, they were in a hurry to put Jesus' body there.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ka kadi kegye kani ndi lɛnwunameyi na kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ lɛnɔ kede mmɔ ɔsu ni, béti Yesu bátáva mmɔ.

english_verse: Joseph from Arimathea was one of Jesus' disciples. He had kept it secret though, because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. But now he asked Pilate to let him have Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, and Joseph took it down from the cross.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yoseƒ ɔni nási ɔma ɔni baalɔ banii Arimatea ni, úvele Pilato ɔnii ɔnyonu Yesu ukpine ute-nwu. Na Yoseƒ ɔmɛni ɔdi Yesu kama basiakune akɔ unwi. Nsu útabla na bekyuli bati, ɔsika ɔɔyia Yudaƒuɔ benengu bammɔ ɔsu. Na ka Pilato ɔ́tuna ni, úbo úbaƒɔ ukpine ɔmmɔ ɔ́tɔlɔku.

english_verse: The two men wrapped the body in a linen cloth, together with the spices, which was how the Jewish people buried their dead.
translation_verse: Amu na nkyuli inyɔ bamɛni béti Yesu ukpine ɔmmɔ na bátáwɛɛ-nwu evogyii ammɔ ƒui na béti adi aƒualadi abuni bényimi bada-nwu lɛlɔ ƒui aani kalɛ na Yudaƒuɔ baaklibi ukpine asa na baavá-nwu.

english_verse: Thomas replied, “You are my Lord and my God!”
translation_verse: Ka Yesu ɔ́su-nwu lɛni ni, Toma údie kenye ɔnini, “Mina Ati ku Katɔti!”

english_verse: On Sunday morning while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.
translation_verse: Na Kwasida ɔtanta tutuutu uwi ɔni kemmo na kadi kátabla tɔ nwaa ni, Maria Magdalene úsie kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ kudɔ na útánu ka lɛtabi lɛni na béti bébi ubu ɔmmɔ kenye lɛsɔ liiibi.

english_verse: The disciple who got there first then went into the tomb, and when he saw it, he believed.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, ɔtɛyane ɔbambadi ɔni náka bukeli butédu kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ kɔtu lɛnɔ úduo ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na útánu ala ammɔ lɛni kani, na ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di.

english_verse: Although Thomas the Twin was one of the twelve disciples, he wasn't with the others when Jesus appeared to them.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu úbo-ma kudɔ mmɔ ni, batɛyane leevu-inyɔ bammɔ akɔ unwi ɔni baalɔ Toma na basɔ baalɔ-nwu Nta Ubi ni, uuubo-ma akɔ.

english_verse: and saw two angels inside. They were dressed in white and were sitting where Jesus' body had been. One was at the head and the other was at the foot.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, ɔ́nu Katɔti batu inyɔ badi ka bakya lɛwu lɛƒualadi belie mmɔ. Unwi ulie kesii kani na Yesu ɔ́tɛ lili kakɛ, na ɔkladi lɛnɔ ulie úsie lɛgba kakɛ.

english_verse: She ran to Simon Peter and to Jesus' favorite disciple and said, “They have taken the Lord from the tomb! We don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu úkeli úsie Simon Petro ku ɔtɛyane ɔni na Yesu ɔɔyɔ́ mmɔ kudɔ. Na útásu-ma ɔnini, “Bekyuli badi bétédie Blɔti na kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ kemmo bátɔlɔku. Na bɔɔɔgyi kesii kani na béti-nwu bétése!”

english_verse: Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ku ɔtɛyane ɔbambadi ɔmmɔ bátɔlɔ bésie kaƒiɔtɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: They ran side by side, until the other disciple ran faster than Peter and got there first.
translation_verse: Bana inyɔ ƒui bakɛ beekeli usi, nsu ɔtɛyane ɔbambadi ɔmmɔ ɔ́vi Petro na ɔ́ka-nwu kaƒiɔtɔ kudɔ mmɔ budu.

english_verse: He bent over and saw the strips of linen cloth lying inside the tomb, but he did not go in.
translation_verse: Úbo kalɔ na ɔ́nu adi aƒualadi abuni ammɔ, nsu úteduo kaƒiɔtɔ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: When Simon Peter got there, he went into the tomb and saw the strips of cloth.
translation_verse: Simon Petro ɔni nkpɛ kama lɛnɔ úubo úbeduo, na anwu ɔ́vi úduo kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ kemmo na ɔ́nu adi aƒualadi ammɔ ka ewi.

english_verse: He also saw the piece of cloth that had been used to cover Jesus' face. It was rolled up and in a place by itself.
translation_verse: Na kɔdi kɔni na béti bamana Yesu lili lɛnɔ kɔtɛ mmɔ. Nsu kɔɔɔtɛ adi aƒualadi ammɔ kudɔ. Mmomu báƒɛ aku lɛti báva kɔmadɔ.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene stood crying outside the tomb. She was still weeping, when she stooped down
translation_verse: Nsu Maria úbo unye kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ anumi na uuwulo. Nsu uwi ɔni na unye uuwulo ni, ɔ́sɔ úbo kalɔ ɔ́nu kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: The angels asked Mary, “Why are you crying?” She answered, “They have taken away my Lord's body! I don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Amu na béye-nwu banini, “Uleku, bi ɔsu na eewulo?” Mmɔ ni, Maria lɛnɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Bekyuli badi bébeti mina Ati bátɔlɔku. Na lɛɛɛgyi kesii kani na béti-nwu bésienku!”

english_verse: Jesus asked her, “Why are you crying? Who are you looking for?” She thought he was the gardener and said, “Sir, if you have taken his body away, please tell me, so I can go and get him.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu lɛnɔ úye-nwu ɔnini, “Uleku, bi ɔsu na eewulo? Ɔma na aawia?” Nsu Maria ɔ́kali ɔnii anwu mɔɔnu kaƒiɔtɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ati, buvele, si awɔ nédie-nwu átɔlɔku mɛni ni, na atina-mi kesii kani na éti-nwu étése, na lisie ntéti-nwu mmɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Don't hold on to me! I have not yet gone to the Father. But tell my disciples I am going to the one who is my Father and my God, as well as your Father and your God.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Tatu tada-mi, ɔsika ńtenwini tɔ ńtesie Katɔti kudɔ. Mmomu teesie mina banwani kudɔ na atásu-ma anii línwini lísela mina Ɔti ɔni ndi Katɔti kudɔ. Na anwu ndi amii lɛnɔ Ɔti ku bina Katɔti.”

english_verse: and showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they became very happy.
translation_verse: Ka ɔ́su-ma ɔmɛni ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, Yesu úti nwuna enu ku ɔƒɛnyi ɔ́tina-ma. Na lɛlɔ lɛ́yɔ batɛyane bammɔ ka bánu Blɔti ɔsu.

english_verse: The disciples were afraid of the Jewish leaders, and on the evening of that same Sunday they locked themselves in a room. Suddenly, Jesus appeared in the middle of the group. He greeted them
translation_verse: Na Kwasida kadi kammɔ useyi ni, batɛyane bammɔ básala na bákalɛ lɛlɔ bákya ɔtɔ kemmo ka baayia Yudaƒuɔ benengu bammɔ ɔsu. Amu na Yesu úbo úbenye-ma ntɛ, na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-mii.”

english_verse: After Jesus had greeted them again, he said, “I am sending you, just as the Father has sent me.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-mii. Kalɛ na Ati ɔ́tala-mi ni, lɛni kani na ami lɛnɔ mɔɔtala-mii.”

english_verse: Then he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, ɔ́nwuna úwi-ma na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛƒɔ Katɔti Kɔyu.

english_verse: If you forgive anyone's sins, they will be forgiven. But if you don't forgive their sins, they will not be forgiven.” Jesus and Thomas
translation_verse: Na si bíti bekyuli ekpidi bɛ́kyiɛ-ma ni, ɔɔtina ka Katɔti lɛnɔ úti ɔ́kyiɛ-ma. Nsu si bíteti bítakyiɛ-ma ni, ɔɔtina ka Katɔti lɛnɔ úteti útakyiɛ-ma.” Yesu Údie Lɛlɔ Ɔ́tina Toma

english_verse: So they told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But Thomas said, “First, I must see the nail scars in his hands and touch them with my finger. I must put my hand where the spear went into his side. I won't believe unless I do this!”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka úbebo ni, batɛyane bakladi bammɔ básu-nwu banini, “Abu bɔ́ɔnu Blɔti!” Amu na Toma ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Si ńtanu kɔbwɛlɛ eƒi lɛtaala na nwuna enu na liti mina lɛnimi lɛkya-nya kemmo na liti mina kɔnu lɛkya-nwu ɔƒɛnyi ni, lɛɛɛdubo bɔƒɔ bɔdi.”

english_verse: A week later the disciples were together again. This time, Thomas was with them. Jesus came in while the doors were still locked and stood in the middle of the group. He greeted his disciples
translation_verse: Amu na Kwasida unwi kama ni, batɛyane bammɔ básɔ bása belie ɔtɔ kemmo, na Toma lɛnɔ ɔkya-ma akɔ. Básɔ bákalɛ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ lɛni kani. Nsu Yesu úbo na úbenye-ma ntɛ, na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-mii.”

english_verse: and said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at my hands! Put your hand into my side. Stop doubting and have faith!”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su Toma ɔnini, “Bo, na ebeti ƒula lɛnimi akya mɛni. Na anu mina enu. Na eti ƒula kɔnu akya-mi ɔƒɛnyi. Na ada ƒula taƒɔ tadi aya. Na aƒɔ adi ɔƒɛni kani!”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Thomas, do you have faith because you have seen me? The people who have faith in me without seeing me are the ones who are really blessed!” Why John Wrote His Book
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Áƒɔ ádi ka ánu-mi ɔsu. Bekyuli bani nátanu-mi tɔ asa báƒɔ bádi ni, badubɔkɛ lɛlɔyɔ betulo!”

english_verse: Jesus worked many other miracles for his disciples, and not all of them are written in this book.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́bla akɔla budie taatina pii na nwuna batɛyane anumi. Nsu ńtenweni-nya ńtakya ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo.

english_verse: But these are written so that you will put your faith in Jesus as the Messiah and the Son of God. If you have faith in him, you will have true life.
translation_verse: Na amɛni kani na línweni líse kalɛ na bɛƒɔ bɛdi ka Yesu ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ. Na anwu ndi Katɔti Ubidi ɔni na si bɛ́ƒɔ-nwu bɛ́di ni, na ɔya na bilie ngba na nwuna ɔyikun kemmo.

english_verse: Jesus later appeared to his disciples along the shore of Lake Tiberias.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu ɔ́sɔ údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina nwuna batɛyane kunwi na Tiberia Ɛpu kudɔ. Na kalɛ na úbalɛ na ndubo bɔsu mɛni.

english_verse: Simon Peter, Thomas the Twin, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, and the brothers James and John, were there, together with two other disciples.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛdi ni, Simon Petro ku Toma ɔni baalɔ Nta Ubi ku Natanael ɔni nási Kana na Galilea kalɔ lɛlɔ ku Sebedeo bebi ku Yesu batɛyane inyɔ babambadi badi benye.

english_verse: Simon Peter said, “I'm going fishing!” The others said, “We will go with you.” They went out in their boat. But they didn't catch a thing that night.
translation_verse: Amu na Simon Petro ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Lísela ntédie kɔbɛ.” Mmɔ kani na ama lɛnɔ básu-nwu banini, “Abu lɛnɔ bɔdubo-ɔ bɔsiaku.” Anwuɔsu bana ƒui béduo ɔkɔlɔ kemmo na bátɔlɔ. Nsu usien umodi ɔmmɔ ni, bétedie kɔbɛ kɔdi.

english_verse: Early the next morning Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize who he was.
translation_verse: Amu uwi ɔni na ɔƒɛ ɔ́tu ɔdubo ni, batɛyane bammɔ bánu ukyuli ɔdi ka unye ɛpu kɔtu. Nsu bátati banii Yesu na ɔdi.

english_verse: Jesus shouted, “Friends, have you caught anything?” “No!” they answered.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́kpali-ma ɔnini, “Bakloƒu, bítedie kɔbɛ kɔdi?” Mmɔ na ama bédie kenye banii, “Oowo!”

english_verse: So he told them, “Let your net down on the right side of your boat, and you will catch some fish.” They did, and the net was so full of fish that they could not drag it up into the boat.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Biwi bina asawu ɔmmɔ na ɔkɔlɔ ɔmmɔ kɔdianu kakɛ. Na bɛdubɔkɛ lɛla lɛdi.” Anwuɔsu béwi asawu ɔmmɔ. Na bátakana-nwu bɔni bɔlɛku, ɔsika bédie kɔbɛ pii.

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple told Peter, “It's the Lord!” When Simon heard it was the Lord, he put on the clothes he had taken off while he was working. Then he jumped into the water.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔtɛyane ɔni na Yesu ɔɔyɔ́ mmɔ ɔ́su Petro ɔnini, “Blɔti na ɔdi!” Ka Simon Petro únu ka ɔtɛyane ɔmmɔ ɔ́su ɔnii Blɔti na ɔdi ni, Petro úti nwuna awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔ́bala lɛlɔ, ɔsika ɔ́da-nwu údie. Na ɔ́ƒulu úduo ntu bɔmmɔ kemmo, na úti úsela Blɔti kudɔ.

english_verse: When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it.
translation_verse: Ka báyu ɔkɔlɔ kemmo bébo kalɔ ni, bánu aƒɛ ogya ɔdi na ɔdaku bɔda. Na kɔbɛ kɔdi kɔsia ogya ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ, na bodobodo ɔdi lɛnɔ use mmɔ.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “Bring some of the fish you just caught.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Biti bina kɔbɛ kɔni na bídie ɔƒaani mmɔ kɔdi biboku.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Come and eat!” But none of the disciples dared ask who he was. They knew he was the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bibo bibadi.” Nsu ɔni na ala amɛni ƒui aalɛ́ ni, ɔdi útakana kayi buse na uye-nwu ɔnii, “Ɔma na adi?” Ɔsika báti ka Blɔti na ɔdi.

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave some of it to his disciples. He did the same with the fish.
translation_verse: Na ka Yesu ɔ́lɔ-ma ɔnii babadi ni, ɔ́kpɛ úde adila ammɔ na úti bodobodo ɔmmɔ na úti úte-ma. Lɛni kani na ɔ́bla kabɛ kammɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from death. Jesus and Peter
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ndi kɔtɛdi kɔni na Yesu údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina nwuna batɛyane ɔni na ɔ́ta ɔ́lɛ kekpine.

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples had finished eating, he asked, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than the others do?” Simon Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I do!” “Then feed my lambs,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bádi báwɔlɔ ni, Yesu úye Simon Petro ɔnini, “Simon, Yohane ubi, aayɔ́-mi geen teetulo batɛyane bakladi bamɛni?” Amu na údie kenye ɔnini, “Blɔti, ɛɛn! Awɔ ɔlati agyi ka mɔɔyɔ́-ɔ.” Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Taanu mina baƒonubi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you!” “Then take care of my sheep,” Jesus told him.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu ɔ́sɔ úye-nwu ɔnini, “Simon, Yohane ubidi, aayɔ́-mi geen?” Na Petro lɛnɔ ɔ́sɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Blɔti, agyi ka mɔɔyɔ́-ɔ.” Mmɔ ni, Yesu ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Taanu mina baƒonu lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, “Lord, you know everything. You know I love you.” Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep.
