translation_verse: Kɔtɛdi ni, Yesu ɔ́sɔ úye Petro ɔnini, “Simon, Yohane ubidi, aayɔ́-mi?” Amu ka Yesu ɔ́sɔ úye-nwu kɔtɛdi ɔnii, “Aayɔ́-mi?” ɔsu ni, Petro lɛlɔ lɛ́bla anwu ɔlati kɔnyana, na ɔ́su Yesu ɔnini, “Blɔti, agyi lɛla biala. Na agyi lɛnɔ ka mɔɔyɔ́-ɔ!” Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Taanu mina baƒonu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that when you were a young man, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will hold out your hands. Then others will wrap your belt around you and lead you where you don't want to go.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-ɔ litemi geen ka ni, uwi ɔni kemmo na adi ɔnamu ni, aata na aklibi lɛlɔ na esie kesii biala na aayɔ́. Nsu si uwi ɔni na ábi lɛlɔ ni, adubo enu bunene na ukyuli bamba maklibi-ɔ na ɔkpanku-ɔ usienku kesii kani na alawia ka esie.”

english_verse: Jesus said this to tell how Peter would die and bring honor to God. Then he said to Peter, “Follow me!” Jesus and His Favorite Disciple
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu mɛni ni, bɔtina na ɔda Petro kukpi kɔni udu na ɔdubo bukpi na uti ɔkɔliku Katɔti lɛnyi katɔ. Amu na Yesu ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Taasiaku-mi.”

english_verse: Peter turned and saw Jesus' favorite disciple following them. He was the same one who had sat next to Jesus at the meal and had asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
translation_verse: Amu ka Petro ɔ́tu únwini ni, ɔ́nu ɔtɛyane ɔni na Yesu ɔɔyɔ́ mmɔ. Anwu ndi ɔtɛyane ɔni nábu úsie Yesu kudɔ uwi ɔdi návi ɔni na baadiku-nwu adila ekplodi na úye Yesu ɔnini, “Blɔti, ɔma ndubo-ɔ kakya bɔkya?”

english_verse: When Peter saw this disciple, he asked Jesus, “Lord, what about him?”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu uwi ɔni na Petro ɔ́nu-nwu ni, úye Yesu ɔnini, “Blɔti, na bi ndubo ƒula ɔtɛyane ɔmɛni anwu bɔlɛku?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return? You must follow me.”
translation_verse: Amu na Yesu údie kenye na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Si mɔɔyɔ́ nnii anwu ɔsɔ ɔkya ngba wetédu uwi ɔni na masɔ mebo ni, bi nkɛ-ɔ? Awɔ ni, taasiaku-mi.”

english_verse: So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return?”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, litemi lɛmɛni lígyingya lɛ́vi Yesu basiakune ƒui akɔ ka ɔnii ɔtɛyane ɔmɛni anwu ulekpi. Nsu ɔɔɔdi bɔsu na Yesu ɔ́su ɔnii ulekpi. Mmomu bɔsu na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Si mɔɔyɔ́ nnii anwu ɔsɔ ɔkya ngba wetédu uwi ɔni na masɔ mebo ni, bi nkɛ-ɔ?”

english_verse: This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.
translation_verse: Ɔtɛyane ɔni lɛlɔ litemi na bɔɔsu mɛni ndi ami ɔni násu ala amɛni. Na línweni-nya líse lɛnɔ. Na baƒɔtaadine ƒui bagyi ka ala ani kenye na muudie mɛni adi litemi geen.

english_verse: Jesus did many other things. If they were all written in books, I don't suppose there would be room enough in the whole world for all the books.
translation_verse: Na ala pii abambadi akya ani na Yesu ɔ́bla. Na si banii bénweni ala ani ƒui na ɔ́bla bése unwi unwi ni, nka kayawi bekyuli balákɛ lɛku lɛmmɔ kesekɔ.

english_verse: until he was taken up to heaven. But before he was taken up, he gave orders to the apostles he had chosen with the help of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ɔnwa Tioƒilo, na mina ɔku udeedi kemmo ni, línweni lɛ́su ala ani ƒui na Yesu ɔ́bla na ɔ́tina úti ɔ́si uwi ɔni na úse nwuna kabla kalɔ úti útédu uwi ɔni na Katɔti úti-nwu úsienku katɔ. Asa na ɔdubuti-nwu usienku katɔ ni, Yesu ɔkɛ Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun lɛlɔ ɔ́tina nwuna batalane ala.

english_verse: While he was still with them, he said: Don't leave Jerusalem yet. Wait here for the Father to give you the Holy Spirit, just as I told you he has promised to do.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bábasa lisu ni, úbo-ma ɔda ɔnini, “Bitatɔlɔ Yerusalem, mmomu binye bɛgya Katɔti Kɔyu bubo bɔni lɛlɔ na lɛ́su-mii lɛ́siku ka mina Ɔti ɔ́su úse ka wete-mii.

english_verse: John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit. Jesus Is Taken to Heaven
translation_verse: Ɔsika Yohane anwu ni, ntu na úti ɔ́bla Katɔti ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmmɔ úte bekyuli. Nsu na emeyi klukui adi kemmo ni, Katɔti ɔdubuti nwuna Kɔyu ɔkpila-mii.” Katɔti Úti Yesu Úsienku Katɔ

english_verse: While the apostles were still with Jesus, they asked him, “Lord, are you now going to give Israel its own king again?”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ka batalane bamɛni ku Yesu básɔ bása ni, béye-nwu banini, “Unwoti, ɔƒaani na aawia ka asɔku Israel lɛga kadikɔ ese yoo?”

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You don't need to know the time of those events that only the Father controls.
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Útalɛka bɛti uwi iye emeyi ani na mina Ɔti ɔ́su úse ka lɛla lɛdi lɛdubɔlɛ.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come upon you and give you power. Then you will tell everyone about me in Jerusalem, in all Judea, in Samaria, and everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: Nsu si uwi ɔni na Katɔti Kɔyu kúbo-mii kudɔ ni, kɔdubɔƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui na kɔdubɔkya-mii ɔyikun na bɛdubɔsu-mi lɛlɔ litemi na Yerusalem ku Yudea ku Samaria wetéduku kalɔ kawɔkɔ.”

english_verse: After Jesus had said this and while they were watching, he was taken up into a cloud. They could not see him,
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni bɔ́su kama ni, Katɔti úti-nwu ɔ́kɔliku katɔ na benye baanu-nwu útédu ka úduo kemmo na ɔ́yii-ma anumi.

english_verse: but as he went up, they kept looking up into the sky. Suddenly two men dressed in white clothes were standing there beside them.
translation_verse: Na ɔni benye baanu kayaa ni, kɔnakunwi nkyuli inyɔ badi bani nnyimi ala aƒualadi bédie lɛlɔ bátina-ma,

english_verse: They said, “Why are you men from Galilee standing here and looking up into the sky? Jesus has been taken to heaven. But he will come back in the same way you have seen him go.” Someone To Take the Place of Judas
translation_verse: na básu-ma banini, “Galileaƒuɔ, bi ɔsu na binye bɛɛnu katɔ lɛni? Yesu ɔni na Katɔti úti ɔ́siku-mii kudɔ úsienku katɔ mɛni ni, ɔsɔ ɔdubɔsi katɔ ubo-mii kudɔ aani kalɛ na bɛ́nu ka ɔ́si bina kudɔ úsie katɔ kalɛ kani.” Matia Úti Yuda Keliekɔ

english_verse: The Mount of Olives was about a kilometer from Jerusalem. The apostles who had gone there were Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas the son of James. After the apostles returned to the city, they went upstairs to the room where they had been staying.
translation_verse: Ka bétéduo ɔma kemmo ni, bésie bétéduo bana kakyakɔ. Na bekyuli bani nli mmɔ ndi Petro ku Yohane ku Yakobo ku Andrea ku Ƒilipo ku Toma ku Bartolomeo ku Mateo ku Yakobo ɔni ndi Alƒeo ubidi ku Simon ɔni basɔ baalɔ Selote ku Yakobo ubidi Yuda.

english_verse: The apostles often met together and prayed with a single purpose in mind. The women and Mary the mother of Jesus would meet with them, and so would his brothers.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni bátaasala lɛlɔ taakpali katɔ uwi biala ku beleku badi ku Yesu uni Maria ku Yesu banwani bananabi.

english_verse: Then Judas bought some land with the money he was given for doing that evil thing. He fell headfirst into the field. His body burst open, and all his insides came out.
translation_verse: “Nsu ɔ́bla likpidi na ɔ́ƒɔ egulabi ani na béti bétéye kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na útékpi. Mmɔ ka úbuli ni, ɔ́bwɛ na nwuna aƒɔla ƒui álɛ éwi keyi.

english_verse: When the people of Jerusalem found out about this, they called the place Akeldama, which in the local language means “Field of Blood.”
translation_verse: Nwuna kukpi kɔmɛni litemi líbegyingya na Yerusalem, na ukyuli biala únu nwuna kukpi kɔmɛni lɛlɔ litemi. Anwuɔsu ni, kesii kani na úkpi mmɔ na baalɔ Hakeldamak ɔni kalɔ ndi Ubugya Lɛku.”

english_verse: In the book of Psalms it says, “Leave his house empty, and don't let anyone live there.” It also says, “Let someone else have his job.”
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́su lɛnɔ ɔnini, “Bénweni na Dawid kɔgya ɔku kemmo banini, “ ‘Bɛsia nwuna liku kɔnu bise, na ɔdi biala utelie mmɔ.’ Básɔ bénweni banii, “ ‘Bɛya na ukyuli bamba unye nwuna kalabla kenye.’

english_verse: So we need someone else to help us tell others that Jesus has been raised from death. He must also be one of the men who was with us from the very beginning. He must have been with us from the time the Lord Jesus was baptized by John until the day he was taken to heaven.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, ɔlɛka ukyuli ɔdi uduo-bu akɔ aani litemi kama unyene kalɛ ute Blɔti Yesu bɔta bɔlɛ bekpine akɔ. Na ɔlɛka ɔbla ukyuli ɔni nákya bula lɛkpa lɛmɛni kemmo na uwi ɔni kemmo ƒui na abu ku Yesu bɔkɛ, na ɔ́si uwi ɔni na Yohane ɔ́kɔ lɛsa na Katɔti ntu bɔkpila ɔdi lɛlɔ útédu uwi ɔni na Katɔti úti Yesu úsienku katɔ.”

english_verse: Two men were suggested: One of them was Joseph Barsabbas, known as Justus, and the other was Matthias.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bédie nkyuli inyɔ bani ndi Matia ku Yoseƒ ɔni baalɔ Barsaba na basɔ baalɔ-nwu Yusto.

english_verse: They drew names, and Matthias was chosen to join the group of the eleven apostles.
translation_verse: Na ka bátu egulabi bánu na nkyuli inyɔ bamɛni lɛlɔ ni, Matia ɔdi nénwini úwi na béti-nwu bébunku nkyuli leevu-unwi bammɔ.

english_verse: On the day of Pentecost all the Lord's followers were together in one place.
translation_verse: Amu ka limeyi lɛni baalɔ Pentekoste limeyi lídu ni, baƒɔtaadine bammɔ ƒui bátása na likpo linwi pɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, bénu kɔku kɔdi aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ubendi ɔdi muukpó. Na kɔku kɔmɛni kúbeyi ɔtɔ ɔni kemmo na bákya mmɔ.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui, na bése kalɔ baasu bumwi etemila na adi lidu kemmo aani kalɛ na kúte-ma kalɛ.

english_verse: Many religious Jews from every country in the world were living in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔmɛni kemmo kani ni, Yudaƒuɔ bani nási kayawi ekpo ƒui ni, bébo bakya Yerusalem.

english_verse: And when they heard this noise, a crowd gathered. But they were surprised, because they were hearing everything in their own languages.
translation_verse: Amu ka bénu kɔku bonwu kɔmɛni ni, bekyuli pii békeli bésie mmɔ. Na ka bénu ka baƒɔtaadine bamɛni benye beetemi kadi biala ɔma lɛdi ɔsu ni, ɔ́bla-ma dɛye dɛye!

english_verse: They were excited and amazed, and said: Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, ɔtɔtɔ ɔ́gyu-ma, na béƒu na bése kalɔ beeye lɛlɔ banini, “Bekyuli bamɛni ƒui ni, ɔɔɔdi Galileaƒuɔ badi yoo?

english_verse: Then why do we hear them speaking our very own languages?
translation_verse: Na dɛ na ɔ́bla na buunú bana butemi na bula kɔlɔ adi kemmo?

english_verse: Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.
translation_verse: ku Kretaƒuɔ ku Arabiƒuɔ. Na bula ƒui buunú ka beebó Blɔti ablala ebendi kudu na bula adi kemmo.”

english_verse: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
translation_verse: Amu ka béƒu benye mmɔ ni, bakya beeye lɛlɔ banini, “Bi litemi lɛdi mɛni?”

english_verse: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.” Peter Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Amu na ama bani nnye mmɔ badi básu banini, “Ntɛ mɔɔda-ma, ɔɔɔdi lɛla lɛdi biala lɛdi.” Petro Útemi Úte Yudaƒuɔ

english_verse: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Petro ɔ́ta únye na bana leevu-unwi bammɔ akɔ na ɔ́talaku lɛdi katɔ ɔnini, “Amii Yudaƒuɔ ku amii bani nli Yerusalem ƒui, mɔɔyɔ́ ka lidie ala amɛni ƒui kalɔ, anwuɔsu binu kaduɛ.

english_verse: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi ntɛ mɔɔda bekyuli bamɛni. Amii ɔlati bɛɛnu ka ɔtanta lɛdɔ yaalenwi kemmo kani bɔkya mɛni.

english_verse: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
translation_verse: Mmomu lɛla lɛni na bɛɛnu mɛni ni, ani ndi lɛla lɛni na Katɔti Kenye Udiene Yoel ɔ́su úse kukuuku.

english_verse: “When the last days come, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.
translation_verse: Ɔ́su ɔnini, “Na emeyi ekplodi kemmo ni, ndubuti mina Kɔyu lite bina akɔ ɔdi biala na bina bebi bananabi ku belekubi badubo-mi kenye budie. Na bina benengu badubo ana buteegye. Na bina bakloƒu lɛnɔ banu kɔyu kemmo ala budie taatina.

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: Na emeyi amɛni kemmo ni, ndubuti mina Kɔyu lite mina kabla bablane banana ku beleku muedi, na badubudie-mi kenye.

english_verse: “I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Na ndubɔya akɔla budie taatina ataalɛ na kayaa ku kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui. Bɛdubɔnu ubugya ku ogya ku uyɔ pii.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛ ɔdubɔbla suu, na kɔbuli anumi adubugyie aani ubugya, asa na Katɔ Ɔyikune limeyi bonwu lɛmmɔ lɛdubo.

english_verse: Then the Lord will save everyone who asks for his help.”
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔkpali Blɔti lɛnyi ni, ɔdubɔkɛ bɔƒɔ.”

english_verse: Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this.
translation_verse: “Ati bene biinú? Yesu Nasareni ɔdi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔni lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔkɛ údie nwuna ɔyikun ku akɔla bɔbla keyi ɔ́tina-mii aani kalɛ na amii alati lɛnɔ bɛgyi.

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Nsu na Ɔti bɔyɔ ku kakali kemmo ni, ɔ́nyonu-nwu úte-mii na bɛ́kɛ ekpidi bablane lɛlɔ na bɛ́du-nwu uwi ɔni na bɛ́kana-nwu bɛ́mana ugyii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́gyila-nwu ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ na ɔ́lɛ kukpi enu kemmo, ɔsika kukpi kulakana-nwu lɛkpu bubo buse.

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: Na Ɔga Dawid ɔ́su úse ɔ́siku-nwu lɛlɔ ɔnini, “ ‘Lɛ́nu ka Unwoti unye-mi anumi uwi ƒui. Na ka unye-mi kɔdianu aani mina lɛkpa kalɛ ɔsu ni, lɛɛɛdubo bɔgbanta.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, mina kayi kemmo kéyi ku lɛlɔyɔ, na ndubuti kenye nteemwi-ɔ uwi ƒui! Ina ka ɔlɔna ndi muedi ni, ndubulie na lɛnunsia kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: Na alanyonu mina kɔyu alakya kekpine. Na lɛnɔ ni, alaya ƒula Ubi Kedee ɔlɔna webu.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: Átina-mi ƒula ngba lilu, na ƒula kudɔ bɔkya bɔ́ya na mɔɔkɛ́ ebiti geen.’

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu ni, banwa, mɔɔsu-mii nwaa ka ni, bula Nana Dawid úkpi, na báva-nwu, na nwuna kaƒiɔtɔ kamu kakya bula akɔ mɛni ɔmwi ɔmwi.

english_verse: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔdi Katɔti kenye udiene. Na Unwoti úse kenye úse ka wabla Dawid kaba kemmo ubi na wadi lɛga aani Dawid ɔmmɔ kalɛ kani.

english_verse: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.
translation_verse: Ka Dawid ɔgyi ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, ɔ́su úse ka ni, Kristo ɔdubɔta ɔlɛ bekpine akɔ. Ɔ́su ɔnii balada-nwu balakya kekpine, na nwuna ɔlɔna lɛnɔ ulebu na kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo.

english_verse: All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!
translation_verse: Yesu ɔmɛni na Katɔti ɔ́gyila ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ, na litemi geen lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ɔsu na bɔdi kenye bediene.

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani ni, Katɔti úte-nwu kenyekɔ kenengudi na nwuna kɔdianu, na úti nwuna Kɔyu úte-nwu aani kalɛ na ɔ́su úse. Lɛni na anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́tala-ku ɔ́kya-bu. Anwuɔsu na bɛɛnu na biinú lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ mɛni.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu mɔɔyá na amii Israelƒuɔ bɛti ka ni, Katɔti nábla Yesu ɔni na amii bɛ́du mɛni ɔnii unwini Blɔti ku Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi.”

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Amu ka bekyuli bamɛni bénu Petro etemila amɛni ni, ékpoku-ma na kayi kemmo. Anwuɔsu béye-nwu ku batalane bakladi banii, “Banwa, bi na ɔlɛka bɔbla?”

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ɔlɛka bina akɔ ɔdi biala ɔda ekpidi bɔbla ɔya na unwini ubo Blɔti kudɔ, na ɔƒɔ ntu bɔkpila ɔdi na Yesu Kristo lɛnyi kemmo kalɛ na Katɔti uti nwuna ekpidi ɔkyiɛ-nwu, na ukyuli ɔmmɔ wakɛ Katɔti Kɔyu aani kalɛ na Blɔti ɔ́su úse.

english_verse: This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika linyese lɛmɛni lise lite amii ku bina bebi ku bani nási ɔgyu ku bekyuli bani ƒui na Katɔti walɔ weboku nwuna kudɔ.”

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́tɛmiku-ma laa na ɔ́lɛ-ma ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bɛda lɛlɔ bidie kɔtu bɔni bɔmɛni kemmo, bɔni mebo bekyuli bekpidi bamɛni ɔnwa lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: They spent their time learning from the apostles, and they were like family to each other. They also broke bread and prayed together. Life among the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Amu na béti bana uwi ƒui béte batalane bammɔ, na baatina-ma ala, na baakpali katɔ, na baadi taasala lɛnɔ. Baƒɔtaadine Bammɔ Bádi Kɔnwa

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Amu na ka batalane bammɔ bábla akɔla budie taatina pii ɔsu ni, ɔ́bla bekyuli bammɔ ƒui yaa na béti ɔbu béte Unwoti.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
translation_verse: Na baƒɔtaadine bamɛni bátaasa uwi ndi uwi na beele bana lɛlɔ ala.

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: Na si béti bana lɛlɔ ala adi béye ni, beeti egulabi ammɔ teele kalɛ na ɔdi biala ɔɔwia.

english_verse: Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely,
translation_verse: Na béteesie Katɔti kakpakɔ limeyi ndi limeyi, na bátaasa esu esu lɛnɔ taadi na bana kɔduli na kubiti ku lɛlɔyɔ kemmo.

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_verse: Na baagyá Blɔti enu na beemwi-nwu lɛnɔ. Na bekyuli ƒui baabu-ma. Na limeyi biala ni, Unwoti uuti bekyuli babambadi bani na ɔɔƒɔ́ teebunku-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛdi ni, Petro ku Yohane bésie Katɔti kakpakɔ uwi ɔni na Yudaƒuɔ beesié taatákpali katɔ. Ɔbla aani lɛdɔ ɛtɛ kemmo.

english_verse: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
translation_verse: Ka bédu kakpakɔ mmɔ na kayakun kani baalɔ banii Kayakun Buni kenye ni, mmɔ na bánu ɔnana ɔdi, ɔni náƒɛ uwi kalɔ ɔ́si nwuna bɔwɔ. Na nwuna bekyuli beeti-nwu taabava mmɔ limeyi ndi limeyi kalɛ na uteevele bekyuli bani muusié mmɔ egulabi.

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: Ɔni na Petro ku Yohane bási baaví ni, úye-ma ɔnii bete-nwu egulabi adi.

english_verse: But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
translation_verse: Amu na bédi bénye na bánu-nwu kpoo, na Petro ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Nu mɛni!”

english_verse: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.
translation_verse: Amu na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔ́talaku anumi ɔɔnu-ma, na ɔ́bla kasusu ka badubo-nwu lɛla lɛdi bute.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ami liiibo egulabi adi na mete-ɔ! Nsu ni, ndubute-ɔ lɛla lɛni nse-mi! Mɔɔsu-ɔ na Yesu Kristo Nasareni lɛnyi kemmo ka ni, ta na esie!”

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Na Petro ɔ́da ukyuli ɔmɛni kɔdianu na ɔ́ya na ɔ́ta únye. Amu na nwuna lɛgba ku kasoma ekubi ƒui áyu ɔkplu!

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ba lɛgyu ɔ́kɔ katɔ na úbenye lɛgba lɛlɔ. Na úse kalɔ uusié taavi na ɔɔba agyu na uumwi Blɔti. Na ɔ́siaku-ma útéduo kakpakɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Everyone saw him walking around and praising God.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani nkya mmɔ ni, bánu-nwu na bénu kalɛ na ɔkya uumwi Unwoti.

english_verse: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man. Peter Speaks in the Temple
translation_verse: Ka bábanu-nwu báti ka anwu mɔɔyɔ́ Kayakun Buni kudɔ bulie mmɔ ni, útakɔsi na ɔ́bla-ma dɛye dɛye. Petro Údie Yesu Ɔyikun Kenye Na Kakpakɔ

english_verse: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli pii békeli bésie-ma kudɔ na kesii kani baalɔ banii Ɔga Salomo lɛgbanya kemmo na Katɔti kakpakɔ mmɔ. Bébo bábanu ka ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔ́tu ɔda Petro ku Yohane kpakplaa na nwuna bɔbwi bɔ́bla-ma kalɛ kadi!

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Amu ka Petro ɔ́nu bekyuli bammɔ ni, ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Israelƒuɔ, bi mɔɔbla-mii dɛye dɛye pii taasiku lɛla lɛmɛni lɛlɔ lɛni? Na bi ɔsu na bɛɛnu-bu aani bekyuli kedee badi na bɔdi? Bitakali bɛnii abu alati ɔyikun kemmo na búti bɔ́bwi ukyuli ɔmɛni!

english_verse: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Unwoti úti ɔbu úte Ubidi Yesu. Na Unwoti ɔmɛni ndi Abraham ku Isak ku Yakob lɛnɔ Ɔti. Na anwu kani ndi bula bati kuuku lɛnɔ Unwoti. Ubidi Yesu ɔmmɔ na amii bíti bíte bɛnii badu. Na bíni-nwu na Pilato anumi bɛnii bɛɛɛgyi-nwu ina ka Pilato ɔ́yɔ ka ɔnyonu-nwu.

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Bíni ukyuli ɔbuni mmomu, na bɛ́tuna bɛnii ɔnyonu bekyuli ɔdune na ukyuli ɔbuni ɔmmɔ kenye.

english_verse: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.
translation_verse: Amii bɛ́ya na bádu ukyuli ɔni muute bekyuli ngba. Nsu Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́gyila-nwu ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ! Na abu alati bɔ́nu-nwu ku bula anumi!

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku Yesu lɛnyi kemmo ɔsu na ɔnana ɔni na bɛgyi na bɛɛnu mɛni ɔ́kɛ lɛlɔkplu. Na ka ɔ́ƒɔ Yesu ɔ́di ɔsu ni, Blɔti ɔ́bwi-nwu na bina anumi.”

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: “Banwa, ngyi ka tati tati ɔsu na amii ku bina benengu bɛ́bla lɛla lɛmɛni udu.

english_verse: But God had his prophets tell that his Messiah would suffer, and now he has kept this promise.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Unwoti ɔ́su ka nwuna Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi webo abi lɛni. Na ɔmɛni ndi kalɛ na ɔ́ya na nwuna kenye bediene linyese líbo líte.

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, binwini kama bɛkya ekpidi bɔbla na biti anumi bɛsia Unwoti lɛlɔ, kalɛ na waƒɔ bina ekpidi wedie-mii lɛlɔ na bɛkɛ bɔnwuna buɛɛ na Blɔti kudɔ, kalɛ watala Kristo Yesu wakya-mii aani bina Ɔƒɔne kalɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka Yesu ɔƒɔ lɛlɔ ɔkya katɔ mmɔ wetédu uwi ɔni na Ɔti wasɔku lɛla biala webese ligeen aani kalɛ na nwuna kenye bediene básu bése.

english_verse: Moses said, “The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Mose ɔ́su ɔnini, ‘Bina Unwoti Katɔti ɔdubudie kenye udiene ɔdi ɔlɛku bina akɔ aani ami kalɛ. Anwuɔsu binu litemi biala lɛni na wasu-mii.

english_verse: No one who disobeys this prophet will be one of God's people any longer.”
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni naaadubo nwuna litemi bunu ni, badubukulo kɔna kɔni nkya anwu ku Blɔti bekyuli ntɛ ƒui.’

english_verse: Samuel and all the other prophets who came later also spoke about what is now happening.
translation_verse: “Sɔsɔ geen ni, Katɔti kenye bediene ƒui ɔ́si Samuel úsela ni, básu ala ani mɔɔlɛ́ ɔmwi mɛni bése kukuuku.

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
translation_verse: Unwoti nényimi kenye kamɛni ku bina bati ɔkɛ nwuna kenye bediene lɛlɔ. Na amii ndi bunyimi bɔmɛni ala badine. Ɔ́su Abraham ɔnini, ‘Na ɔkɛ ƒula kaba kemmo na ndubute kayawi ƒui bekyuli kusɛ kusɛ.’

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka Katɔti údie nwuna kabla ɔblane keyi ni, ɔ́tala-nwu ɔnii ɔka-mii kudɔ bubo bubebunku-mii kalɛ na bɛkana kama bunwini bɔkya bina ekpidi.”

english_verse: The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived.
translation_verse: Amu uwi ɔni na Petro ku Yohane benye baatɛmi ku bekyuli bammɔ ni, Yudaƒuɔ bakpane badi ku kakpakɔ bagyumanane benengu ku Sadukiƒuɔ lɛnɔ bébo mmɔ.

english_verse: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Ka bénu ka Petro ku Yohane bakya baasu ala taasiku Yesu bɔta lɛlɔ ɔni mɔɔtina ka ukpine ɔdubo bɔta bulie ngba ni, béti kɔnyi geen!

english_verse: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu béƒie-ma. Na ka kadi kábɔyu ɔsu ni, bákya-ma ɔtɔ útédu lɛdigye.

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli pii bani nénu bana etemila amɛni kemmo ni, báƒɔ litemi buni lɛmɛni bádi. Na bana bumomo bɔbla aani banana mpim ɛlɔ.

english_verse: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amu ka kadi kégye ni, úbebo úte ka Yudaƒuɔ kadi lɛlɔ badine ku kadi benengu ku ɔda bubo ala batinane badi bása na Yerusalem.

english_verse: The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family.
translation_verse: Bábasala ku Ɔkpane Unengudi Hana ku Kaiaƒa ku Yohane ku Aleksandro ku Ɔkpane Unengudi lɛlɔ bekyuli badi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: Na bédie batalane bamɛni béboku bana anumi mmɔ. Na béye-ma banini, “Ulu ɔmani lɛlɔ na bɛ́bla ɔmɛni? Ɔma lɛnyi ku ɔyikun kemmo na bɛ́bla ala amɛni udu?”

english_verse: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
translation_verse: Mmɔ kani ni, Petro ɔ́ta na Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun kemmo na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bula batɔnkune ku ɔma benengu,

english_verse: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.
translation_verse: si bɛɛwia kenye budie na lɛla lɛbuni lɛni na bɔ́bla búte ukyuli ɔni náƒɛ uwi kalɔ mɛni ku kalɛ na búti bɔ́bwi-nwu ni,

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: bite-mi kuƒi na lɛsu amii ku Israel kalɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli ƒui lɛla lɛdi. Ɔkɛ Yesu Kristo ɔni nási Nasaret lɛnyi kemmo ɔni na amii bɛ́ya na bákana bámana ugyii lɛlɔ na Unwoti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́gyila-nwu ɔ́lɛku kekpine ɔsu na ukyuli ɔmɛni lɛlɔ lɛ́yu ɔkplu.

english_verse: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na Bunweni Kedee bɔɔsu taasiku bɔnii, “ ‘Lɛtabi lɛni na amii batune bíni bɛ́va ni, ani nébo líbenwini lɛtabi lɛni náƒɔ kuye lítulo na atabi ƒui akɔ.’

english_verse: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
translation_verse: Anwu lɛti ndi bekyuli Ɔƒɔne, ɔsika anwu kani na Unwoti úte lɛnyi ku ɔyikun na bekyuli ƒui akɔ ɔni makana waƒɔ-bu ngba.”

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Ka lɛlɔ badine ku benengu bammɔ bánu kalɛ na Petro ku Yohane bábla kayi ku ɔtɔtɔ ku kalɛ na lɛkpaklɔ bekyuli badi na beeebo kenyekɔ kadi lɛnɔ na kadi akɔ ɔsu ni, ɔ́bla-ma kalɛ kadi. Na bánu báti ka ama ku Yesu ni, bavinkpana na badi.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: Nsu ka bánu ukyuli ɔni na bábwi na bana anumi mmɔ ɔsu ni, bátakana lɛla lɛdi bɔsu.

english_verse: The officials commanded them to leave the council room. Then the officials said to each other,
translation_verse: Amu na báda-ma bédie kasalakɔ mmɔ, na ama lɛti lɛti bakya beeye lɛlɔ kasusu.

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: Badi béye banii, “Bi na ɔlɛka bɔbla ku bekyuli bamɛni? Bulakana buni bɔnii lɛla lɛni na bábla mɛni lɛɛɛdi akɔla budie taatina, ɔsika ukyuli biala na Yerusalem ɔgyi na únu litemi lɛmɛni.

english_verse: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.”
translation_verse: Mmomu bɛya bubo-ma ɔda na bada litemi lɛmɛni bugyingya baya kalɛ na basɔ balasu ukyuli ɔdi litemi lɛdi na Yesu lɛnyi kemmo.”

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Na básɔ bálɔ-ma béboku bana kasalakɔ mmɔ na bábala-ma ka ɔ́si ɔƒɛni ni, basɔ batasu ukyuli ɔdi litemi na Yesu lɛnyi kemmo.

english_verse: Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ku Yohane bédie kenye banini, “Amii alati bɛbu bɛnu. Bi mada Unwoti kubiti? Si bunu bina ɔda bubo munuu Unwoti bɔdi?

english_verse: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na bɔ́nu na búnu ni, bulakana kenye bubile na bɔsɔ bulie kpoo.”

english_verse: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bánya báda-ma bányonu ni, Petro ku Yohane bésie bana badi bammɔ kudɔ na básu-ma kalɛ na kasalakɔ kammɔ bekyuli básu-ma.

english_verse: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: Amu na baƒɔtaadine bamɛni ƒui bása lisu na bákpali Unwoti banii, “O Ati, awɔ nédie katɔ ku kalɔ ku ɛpu ku ala ani ƒui nkya-nya kemmo.

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: Akɛnku Katɔti Kɔyu lɛlɔ na étemi ásiaku ƒula kabla ɔblane Dawid lɛlɔ anini, “ ‘Bi ɔsu na bayawine baakya lɛsɛ, na bekyuli baasa lili kekeeke?

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Kayawi baga bábla unwi na benye beekpóku awɔ ku ƒula Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi.’

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Ɔdi litemi geen ka Herode ku Pontio Pilato ku Israelƒuɔ ku bani naaadi Israelƒuɔ básala lɛlɔ na ɔma ɔmɛni kemmo, na báta bénye ƒ'ubidi Yesu ɔni ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi Kedee ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.
translation_verse: Nsu, awɔ, na ƒula ɔyikun ku lɛnunda kemmo ni, énye ánu na básala bábla ala ani na ásu ése.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani ni, O Ati, nu liƒu lɛni na badaku-bu bɔkya, na ete abu, ƒula kabla bablane, kayi buse na bɔkana litemi buni lɛmɛni bɔsu.

english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: Tuku bekyuli na abwi-ma, na abla akɔla pii ebu na ƒ'ubidi Yesu Kedee lɛnyi kemmo.”

english_verse: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message. Sharing Possessions
translation_verse: Ka bévele Unwoti ɔmɛni báwɔlɔ ni, ɔtɔ ɔni kemmo na bakya mmɔ ɔ́kunku na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ bana ƒui lɛlɔ kemmo, na bése kalɔ baasu litemi buni lɛmɛni ku kayi buse. Baƒɔtaadine Bébunku Lɛlɔ

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Na emeyi amɛni kemmo ni, baƒɔtaadine bamɛni ƒui bábla unwi na udu ku kasusu kemmo, na bana akɔ ɔdi biala útasusu anwu lɛti lɛkɛ. Mmomu ni, bana lɛla biala lɛdi bana ƒui lɛdi.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: Na batalane bamɛni bákɔ Unwoti litemi lɛsa ku kayi geen básiku Blɔti Yesu bɔta bɔlɛ bekpine akɔ lɛlɔ. Na Unwoti keyi buɛɛ ku kusɛ kusɛ ɔkya-ma akɔ.

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Na ɔdi biala ɔɔɔdi ɔwabane, ɔsika ama bani mbo lɛtɔ ku kɔlɔ ni, béti ala amɛni béye.

english_verse: to the apostles. Then they would give the money to anyone in need.
translation_verse: Na béti egulabi amɛni bátákya batalane bammɔ lɛkɔkɔ na béle-nya béte bana akɔ ɔdi biala kalɛ na ɔɔwia.

english_verse: Ananias and his wife Sapphira also sold a piece of property.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔnana ɔdi lɛnɔ ɔ́kya ɔni baalɔ Anania, na ulekudi ndi Saƒira. Ama lɛnɔ béti bana kalɔ kadi béye.

english_verse: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles,
translation_verse: Na béti egulabi ammɔ adi bábala, na béti akladi béboku batalane bammɔ. Na ulekudi Saƒira lɛnɔ ɔgyi, na ɔ́tuna ka babla lɛni. Na Anania úti egulabi amɛni úboku úbakya batalane lɛkɔkɔ.

english_verse: Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Anania, bi ɔsu na áya na Satan ɔdi-ɔ lɛlɔ, na ɔ́ya-a na aanyi ɔkɔ taatɔlɔ Katɔti Kɔyu? Na ébu ƒula kalɔ kani na éti éye mmɔ egulabi adi ése éte lɛlɔ?

english_verse: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
translation_verse: Awɔ mbo kalɔ kammɔ asa néti-ka éye, na egulabi ani na báƒɔ-ɔ kayu mmɔ lɛnɔ adi ƒ'ɔdi. Bi náya-a na ábla kakali kekpidi kamɛni udu? Ɔɔɔdi abu bekyuli na ányi ɔkɔ átina, mmomu Katɔti!”

english_verse: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.
translation_verse: Amu ka Anania ɔ́nya únu litemi lɛmɛni ni, anwu kani na úbuli ɔ́tɛ kalɔ, na úkpi! Na ɔmɛni ɔ́da bekyuli bani nánu ƒui liƒu.

english_verse: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
translation_verse: Amu na bakloƒu bani nkya-ma akɔ mmɔ béti kɔdi bébi-nwu lɛlɔ na bágyu-nwu bátáva.

english_verse: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.
translation_verse: Amu na uwi klukui ɔdi kama ni, ulekudi lɛnɔ ɔ́da úbalɛ mmɔ ɔni na anwu ɔɔɔgyi lɛla lɛni nálɛ.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Amu na Petro úye-nwu ɔnini, “Ɔni na awɔ ku ƒ'ɔgyani bíti bina kalɔ bíye ni, egulabi ani na báƒɔ-mii kayu ƒui na adi mɛni?” Amu na uleku ɔmmɔ údie kenye ɔnini, “Ɛɛn, ana ƒui mmɔ.”

english_verse: Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!”
translation_verse: Petro ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Bi ɔsu na awɔ ku ƒ'ɔgyani bɛ́kana bɛ́sa kenye bɛnii bɛɛsɔ Blɔti Kɔyu bɛnu? Aanu bakloƒu bani néti ƒ'ɔgyani bátáva. Ama kani ndubo-ɔ bɔgyu bɔlɛku.”

english_verse: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, anwu lɛnɔ úbuli ɔ́tɛ kalɔ, na úkpi. Amu ka bakloƒu bammɔ bébo bábanu ka úkpi ɔ́tɛ ni, bágyu anwu lɛnɔ bálɛku bátáva ɔgyani kudɔ mmɔ kani.

english_verse: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu liƒu líduo baƒɔtaadine bammɔ ku bekyuli bani nénu lɛla lɛni nálɛ na mmɔ ƒui akɔ. Batalane Bábla Akɔla Lidu Lidu

english_verse: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔmɛni ƒui ni, batalane bamɛni bátaabla akɔla pii na bekyuli bammɔ akɔ. Baƒɔtaadine bamɛni ƒui baasa na Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ na kesii kani baalɔ banii Salomo lɛgbanya kemmo.

english_verse: No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.
translation_verse: Nsu anumi lɛlɔ baƒɔtaadine babambadi bátakana-ma kudɔ bɔkpɛ bude, ina ka baabu baƒɔtaadine bammɔ.

english_verse: Many men and women started having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli pii, banana ku beleku, bénwini kama bákya bana alaekpidi bɔbla na báƒɔ Blɔti lɛnyi bádi.

english_verse: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
translation_verse: Na bana badi béti balɛne bátáva atala lɛlɔ na keyi, kesii kani na báƒɔ bádi ka si Petro ɔ́si ɔɔví na nwuna kɔyu kúwi balɛne bamɛni lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛ ɔni beeƒi waba-ma!

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Amu na béti balɛne ku bekyuli bani na ayu ekpidi eekpóku-ma ƒui básiku lɛma lɛni nkya Yerusalem amadɔ béboku-ma kudɔ na bábwi-ma ƒui. Yudaƒuɔ Batɔnkune Békpoku Yesu Batalane

english_verse: The high priest and all the other Sadducees who were with him became jealous.
translation_verse: Amu na Yudaƒuɔ ɔkpane unengudi ku nwuna lɛlɔ bekyuli bani nási lɛkpa lɛni baalɔ banii Sadukiƒuɔ kemmo ni, bése kalɔ beekpóku batalane bammɔ kogyulo.

english_verse: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, béƒie-ma na béti-ma bátákya ɔtɔ.

english_verse: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
translation_verse: Nsu usientɛ ni, Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi úbalɛmi ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kayakun na ɔ́da-ma údie.

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Biteesie Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ na bitátaasu etemila taasiku ngba bɔwɔdi bɔmɛni lɛlɔ!”

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Amu ka kadi kégye ni, bésie bétéduo kakpakɔ mmɔ na bése kalɔ ku ala bɔtina. Anwuɔsu uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, ɔkpane unengudi ku nwuna babune bálɔ lɛlɔ ku Yudaƒuɔ kadi benengu ƒui básala, na bátala bagyumanane banii betédie batalane bammɔ na ɔtɔ katɛnkɔ beboku.

english_verse: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔni na bésie mmɔ ni, bátatánu-ma! Anwuɔsu básɔ bénwini bábasu-ma banini,

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: “Ka búsie ni, bábala ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ bényene, na bagyumanane benye kayakun. Nsu ka bálɛmi ni, ukyuli biala uuubo ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo!”

english_verse: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na kakpakɔ bagyumanane unengu ku bakpane benengu bamɛni bénu litemi lɛmɛni ni, ɔƒɛ ɔ́da-ma geen sɔsɔ, ɔsika baaagyi lɛla lɛni nsɔ mebo.

english_verse: Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!”
translation_verse: Amu na ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́si úbo na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bekyuli bani na béƒie bákya ɔtɔ ni, aanu-ma nkya kakpakɔ baatina ala.”

english_verse: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
translation_verse: Mmɔ mmɔ na bagyumanane unengu ku nwuna badi báta bésie kakpakɔ mmɔ bétéƒie-ma béboku. Nsu ka baayia ka bekyuli badubo-ma atabi bubo ɔsu ni, bátani-ma ku ɔkplu.

english_verse: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
translation_verse: Amu ka béti batalane bammɔ bébenyene-ma anumi ni,

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: ɔkpane unengudi úye-ma ɔnini, “Bútasu-mii bɔnii bɛsɔ bitasu litemi lɛdi bitasiku Yesu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ iye? Nsu bíigyingya etemila amɛni bíyile Yerusalem ƒui. Na bɛɛwia ka biti nwuna kukpi kɔtu bɔni bɛsia-bu lɛlɔ!”

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Petro ku batalane bammɔ bédie kenye banini, “Ɔlɛka bɔka Unwoti bɔbu asa bɔbu bekyuli bayawine.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: Yesu ɔni na amii bɛ́ya na bákana bámana ugyii lɛlɔ na úkpi ni, bula bati kuuku Katɔti ɔ́gyila-nwu ɔ́lɛku kekpine na ɔ́sɔ úbo uli ngba.

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: Katɔti úte-nwu kenyekɔ kenengudi na nwuna kɔdianu. Na úti-nwu ɔ́bla Ɔgadine ku Ɔƒɔne kalɛ na Israelƒuɔ bakɛ kuƒi benwini bana kɔyi, na bakɛ ekpidi butitaakyiɛ.

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: Na abu ku Katɔti Kɔyu kɔni na Katɔti uuti teete bekyuli bani mɔɔbu-nwu ni, abu ndi ala amɛni kenye bediene.”

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Ka bénu kenye kamɛni ni, ɔ́ya na básɔ bákɛ kɔnyi geen, na bábla kasusu ka badu batalane bammɔ.

english_verse: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
translation_verse: Nsu Ƒarisiƒuɔ bammɔ kemmo unwi ɔni na baalɔ Gamaliel ɔ́bala-ma. Baaƒalɛ ukyuli ɔmɛni kaduɛ, ɔsika ɔdi Mose ɔda bubo ala ɔtinane. Anwu náta únye na ɔ́su ɔnii bada-ma bedie mmɔ asa na ama bakladi bataatɛmi.

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔ́tɛmi úte-ma ɔnini, “Israelƒuɔ, bɛnu kaduɛ na ala ani na bɛɛyɔ́ ka bɛbla bekyuli bamɛni lɛlɔ!

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, na bekyuli bɔka lebo ni, Yuda ɔni nási Galilea ɔ́kpanku bekyuli badi úbunku lɛlɔ aani nwuna kama basiakune. Na anwu lɛnɔ úbekpi na nwuna kama basiakune bamɛni bégyingya.

english_verse: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu lɛla lɛni na ami mɔɔsu-mii ndi ka ni, bɛnyonu bekyuli bamɛni. Si ala ani baatina ku ala ani baabla adi ama ɔlati adi ni, uwi uletu asa na ala amɛni adubugyingya.

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: Nsu si Katɔti ablala na adi ni, bulakana-ma bɔbala. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, diɛdi bɛdubɔnu ka bunye buukpóku Katɔti ɔlati!”

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: Na kasalakɔ bekyuli bammɔ báƒɔ Gamaliel litemi lɛmɛni. Anwuɔsu ni, bálɔ batalane bamɛni béboku bana akɔ, na bébo-ma. Na básu-ma banii basɔ batasu litemi biala batasiku Yesu lɛlɔ kudii. Amu na bányonu-ma.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Na ka bésela ni, kubiti kɔ́da-ma kaduɛ, ɔsika bánu ka Katɔti ɔ́ka-ma ɔ́kya bekyuli bani muubó abi ku kɔƒa na Yesu ɔsu.

english_verse: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni kama ni, limeyi biala bátaasu ka Yesu ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi na Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ ku bekyuli kɔduli.

english_verse: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ɔni na batɛyane bamɛni beemomo teebu ni, unyeƒi úbebo Yudaƒuɔ bani na beetemi Griki lɛdi ku Yudaƒuɔ bammɔ geen ntɛ. Ɔsika si béle adila ni, eledu Grikiƒuɔ bekpinele.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu leevu-inyɔ bammɔ bálɔ batɛyane bammɔ ƒui na básu-ma banini, “Ɔlɛka buti bula uwi bute litemi buni bɔsu, na ɔɔɔdi adila bɔdi etemila lɛlɔ.

english_verse: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
translation_verse: Litemi lɛmɛni lɛ́dia bana ƒui bunu, anwuɔsu bédie Steƒano ɔni ndi ukyuli ɔni mbo bɔƒɔtaadi na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui. Na bédie Ƒilipo ku Prokoro ku Nikanor ku Timon ku Parmena ku ɔƒɔ ɔni nénwini Yudani ɔni baalɔ Nikolao ɔni nási Antiokia lɛnɔ bébunku-nwu.

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: Nkyuli maatɛ bamɛni na bédie bátina batalane bamɛni. Na ama lɛnɔ bákpali katɔ na bana lili. Na béti enu básia-ma lɛlɔ bévele keyi buɛɛ béte-ma.

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli pii báƒɔ Katɔti litemi buni. Na baƒɔtaadine lɛnɔ bémomo na Yerusalem bébu. Na Yudaƒuɔ bakpane pii badi lɛnɔ bénwini basiaku bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ kama. Yudaƒuɔ Batɔnkune Béƒie Steƒano

english_verse: God gave Stephen the power to work great miracles and wonders among the people.
translation_verse: Amu na Steƒano ɔni na Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun ɔ́ƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui mɛni ni, ɔ́bla akɔla budie taatina pii na bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Amu na Yudaƒuɔ bani nálɛ bekyuli bamba kabla bɔbla kalɔ na bási Kirene ku Aleksandria ku bani nási Kilikia ku Asia bákya ku Steƒano unyeƒi.

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: Nsu bana akɔ ɔdi biala útakana-nwu kenye bunye ɔ́si nwuna lɛnunda ku litela lɛni na Katɔti Kɔyu kúte-nwu ɔsu.

english_verse: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bátása lili ku bekyuli badi banii babanyi ɔkɔ basia-nwu basu banii, “Búnu ka Steƒano uutemi taata teenye Mose ku Katɔti lɛnɔ muedi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Linyeda lɛmɛni lɛ́ya na bekyuli bamɛni bébeti kɔnyi geen. Na ɔmɛni ɔsu Yudaƒuɔ batɔnkune béƒie-nwu na béti-nwu bésienku bana kasalakɔ.

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli bani náda-nwu kenye mɛni básɔ bábada Steƒano kenye ka ni, “Uutemi teewi kakpakɔ kamɛni uwi biala ku Mose ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: Na búnu ka ɔ́su lɛnɔ ɔnii ukyuli ɔni nási Nasaret na baalɔ-nwu banii Yesu mmɔ ni, ɔdubɔƒɛ Katɔti ɔtɔ ɔmɛni na wavumana Mose ɔda bubo bɔni na úte-bu.”

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, bekyuli bani nnye mmɔ bánu ka Steƒano anumi eekeye aani Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi kalɛ.

english_verse: The high priest asked Stephen, “Are they telling the truth about you?”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔkpane unengudi úye Steƒano ɔnini, “Ala ani na básu básiku-ɔ lɛlɔ mɛni ni, sɔsɔ na adi?”

english_verse: Stephen answered: Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran.
translation_verse: Amu na Steƒano údie kenye ɔnini, “Ati bene ku mina banwa, binu kaduɛ ka ni, Katɔti údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina bula Nana Abraham na Mesopotamia kalɔ lɛlɔ asa na ɔ́ta mmɔ úsie kalɔ kani baalɔ Haran lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Ta na atɔlɔ ƒula bekyuli akɔ ku ƒula kalɔ lɛlɔ na eteesie kalɔ kani na matina-a!’

english_verse: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu ɔ́ta ɔ́lɛ Kaldea kalɔ lɛlɔ na úsie útélie Haran útédu uwi ɔni na ɔti úkpi. Amu na Katɔti útiku-nwu úboku kesii kani bilie ɔmwi mɛni.

english_verse: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
translation_verse: Katɔti útete Abraham kadikɔ kadi mmɔ, ina kalɔ blii suɛ muedi. Nsu ni, ɔ́su-nwu úse ka kalɔ kammɔ kadubɔbla anwu ku nwuna kaba kemmo bebi kadi ina ka útawɔ tɔ ubi ɔdi úti úbedu ku uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo!

english_verse: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
translation_verse: Lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-nwu úse ka ni, nwuna bawɔ ƒui badubo baƒɔ bunwini na kadi bamba kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na badubo bunwini bekyuli bammɔ kabla bablane. Na badubo-ma kalala bɔbla na bebo abi akwa eti maane sɔɔn.

english_verse: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Nsu kalɔ kani bekyuli ndubuti ƒula bebi benwini bana kabla bablane ni, ndubo-ma kɔtu bɔni geen. Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, badubɔlɛ kalɔ kammɔ kemmo na badubɔkpa-mi na kalɔ kani bilie mɛni lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
translation_verse: “Amu na Katɔti úti lego bukulo linyese úte Abraham uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo aani lɛla lɛni makya anwu Katɔti ku Abraham bawɔ ntɛ. Na Abraham úbawɔ Isak na úkulo-nwu lego uwi ɔni na ɔ́ƒɔ emeyi maane. Isak lɛnɔ úbawɔ Yakob, na Yakob lɛnɔ ɔ́wɔ bebi leevu-inyɔ bani nábawɔ Yudaƒuɔ adua leevu-anyɔ ammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: These men were our ancestors. Joseph was also one of our famous ancestors. His brothers were jealous of him and sold him as a slave to be taken to Egypt. But God was with him
translation_verse: “Yakob bebi bamɛni anumi égyie na bana ɔnwani Yoseƒ lɛlɔ. Na béƒie-nwu béye béte bekyuli bani néti-nwu bésienku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Nsu ni, Katɔti ɔ́siaku-nwu,

english_verse: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: na únyeku-nwu na ɔ́da-nwu údie nwuna lɛbibo ku kɔnyana buwulo kemmo. Katɔti úte-nwu lɛnunda bonwu. Anwuɔsu Egyipte Ɔga Ƒarao ɔ́yɔ-nwu litemi na úti-nwu ɔ́bla Egyipte kalɔ ƒui lɛlɔ ɔnune ku nwuna kaduli ƒui ala lɛlɔ ɔnune lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔdi kemmo ni, kɔka kubendi kɔdi kɔ́kya na Egyipte ku Kanaan kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui, na kɔnyana buwulo geen búbo bula bati bene lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bana adila áasa ƒui ni, Yakob únu ka adila adi akya Egyipte, anwuɔsu ɔ́tala nwuna bebi ɔnii besie betéye adi beboku-nwu.

english_verse: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
translation_verse: Na ka Yakob bebi básɔ bésie mmɔ kunyɔdi banii betéye adila ni, Yoseƒ údie nwuna lɛlɔ ɔ́tina-ma, na údie-ma ɔ́tina Ɔga Ƒarao.

english_verse: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Yakob ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie Egyipte na úlie mmɔ útédu uwi ɔni na úkpi. Na nwuna bebi bananabi lɛnɔ bélie mmɔ bétédu uwi ɔni na békpi.

english_verse: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
translation_verse: Na básɔku bana ƒui bésienku ɔma ɔni baalɔ Sekem. Na bátáva-ma mmɔ na kaƒiɔtɔ kani na Abraham úye ɔ́siku Hamor kaba kudɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔni na linyese lɛni na Katɔti úse úte Abraham lɛdaku budu ni, bula kadi bekyuli béemomo na Egyipte.

english_verse: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
translation_verse: Úbebo lɛnɔ ka Ɔga Ƒarao ɔwɔdi ɔni mɔɔdi Egyipte lɛlɔ ni, ɔɔɔgyi Yoseƒ.

english_verse: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
translation_verse: Ƒarao ɔmɛni ɔ́bla bula kadi bekyuli bamɛni kalala na únye-ma lɛlɔ na beeti bana bebiwɔ teetévaakun na beekpi.

english_verse: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo kani na báwɔ Mose. Na bánu ka ɔdi ubi ɔni ndia geen. Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, nwuna bawɔne béti-nwu bábala na kaduli abuli atɛ sɔɔn.

english_verse: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na basɔ balákana-nwu bɔbala ni, ɔlɛka bada-nwu bedie bana kudɔ. Amu na Ƒarao ubidi ulekubi útákɛ-nwu na úti-nwu ɔ́bla aani nwuna kaƒɔ ubi.

english_verse: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
translation_verse: Ɔ́da-nwu na ɔ́tina-nwu Egyipteƒuɔ ala bɔbla ku bana kɔkwɛ ƒui, na ɔ́lɛ lili úbabla ukyuli geen na butemi ku kabla lidu pii kemmo.

english_verse: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔni na úsie mmɔ ni, ɔ́nu Egyipteni ɔdi ka ɔkya ɔɔbla Israelni ɔdi kalala. Na Mose ɔ́du Egyipteni ɔmɛni.

english_verse: Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.
translation_verse: Mose ɔ́kali ka nwuna banwani badubɔkali banii Katɔti nátala-nwu ɔni ubebunku-ma, nsu bátakali lɛni.

english_verse: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
translation_verse: Amu ka kadi kégye ni, ɔ́sɔ úsie-ma kudɔ na útánu Israelƒuɔ inyɔ ka bakya beekpó. Úsie útáda-ma na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, ‘Ati bene, banwani na bɛdi, anwuɔsu útalɛka biteekpoku lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, “Who made you our ruler and judge?
translation_verse: “Nsu ukyuli ɔni náƒiɔ na nkyuli inyɔ bamɛni kemmo ni, údi Mose na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Taatɛku awɔ lɛdi! Ɔma nédie-ɔ bula lɛlɔ ɔdine ku bula litemi ɔtɛne?

english_verse: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
translation_verse: Munuu aayɔ́ ka adu-mi aani kalɛ na ádu Egyipteni ɔni kamaadi kalɛ?’

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: Ka Mose únu litemi lɛmɛni ni, liƒu lɛ́da-nwu geen. Anwuɔsu úkeli útábɛ na Midian kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na mmɔ na ɔ́wɔ nwuna bebi bananabi inyɔ.

english_verse: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: “Akwa aavlene kama ni, Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina-nwu na ogya ɔni mɔɔda na liyu kugyii blii kɔdi lɛlɔ na Sinai Kɔbi ketele kemmo.

english_verse: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said,
translation_verse: Ka Mose ɔ́nu ɔmɛni ni, útati lɛla lɛni na lɛdi. Na uwi ɔni na úsela ɔnii utánu lɛla lɛni lɛdi ni, Unwoti ɔ́lɔ-nwu na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini,

english_verse: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
translation_verse: ‘Ami ndi ƒula bati kuuku Abraham ku Isak ku Yakob bene Unwoti.’ Amu na lɛlɔ lɛ́tɔ Mose ku bɔyia ɔni na ɔsɔ útakana mmɔ bɔnu.

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
translation_verse: “Amu na Unwoti ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Da ƒula lɛgbanvuo die! Ɔsika kalɔ kedee lɛlɔ na enye.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ ni, lɛ́nu lɛbibo lɛni kemmo na mina bekyuli bakya na Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na muunú bana keku kani na beewulo taakpali-mi. Anwuɔsu lɛ́yu líbo nnii medie-ma. Bo, na lɛtala-a Egyipte.’

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: “Mose ɔmɛni ndi ukyuli ɔni na bátu kenye banii, ‘Ɔma nédie-ɔ bula lɛlɔ ɔdine ku bula litemi ɔtɛne?’ Anwu Mose ɔmmɔ kani na Katɔti ɔ́tala ɔnii usie na utábla bana lɛlɔ ɔdine ku bana ɔƒɔne ɔkɛnku Katɔti ɔtu ɔni na ɔ́nu na ketele kemmo mmɔ kebunku lɛlɔ.

english_verse: In Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the desert, Moses rescued the people by working miracles and wonders for
translation_verse: Anwu nédie-ma na Egyipte ɔkɛ akɔla budie taatina pii kemmo ani na ɔ́bla na Egyipte mmɔ ku Ɛpugyie kɔtu ku uwi ɔni na bakɛ ketele kemmo akwa aavlene sɔɔn.

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: “Mose ɔmmɔ ɔlatidi násu Israelƒuɔ ɔnini, ‘Katɔti ɔdubudie kenye udiene ɔdi aani ami kalɛ, na ɔdubudie-nwu ɔlɛku bina kaba kemmo.’

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: Mose ndi ukyuli ɔni násala bula bati kuuku uwi ɔni na Israelƒuɔ bákya ketele mmɔ. Na anwu ndi ukyuli ɔni na Katɔti ɔtu ɔ́tɛmiku na Sinai Kɔbi lɛlɔ. Na anwu náƒɔ Unwoti litemi lɛni muute ngba úboku-bu.

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: “Nsu ni, bula bati bénwini kama bákya Mose ɔni na báyɔ ka basɔ benwini beteesie Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bábla baƒiɔ badi aani akɔ ubi, na baakpá-nwu, na bádi limeyi ku ebiti na lɛla lɛni na bábla mɛni ɔsu.

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na Katɔti únwini kama ɔ́kya-ma, na ɔ́nyonu-ma. Na bákya bátaakpa ɔƒɛ ku kɔbuli ku ayabi. Ɔmɛni ndi lɛla lɛni na Katɔti kenye bediene bénweni bákya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo banini, “ ‘Israelƒuɔ, ɔɔɔdi ami na bíti bebuo ku baƒonu bɛ́bla akpala bíte akwa aavlene ani na bɛ́kya ketele kemmo mmɔ

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Mmomu bɛ́gyu Molek lɛbi ku Romƒa ayabi ani ndi baƒiɔ bani na bɛ́vɔ bíse bɛnii bitaakpa bíti. Anwuɔsu ndubɔya na beƒie-mii besienku ɔgyu kakaaka na Babilon kama ngye ƒui.’

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: “Bula bati kuuku bágyu Katɔti kevo béti na ɔ́tɔnku-ma na ketele kemmo. Bátu ɔtɔ ɔmɛni aani kalɛ na Katɔti údie ɔ́tina Mose mmɔ kalɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: Na akwa pii kama ni, Yosua ɔ́tɔnku bula bati bani nágyu kevo kamɛni béti na bétékpo-ku bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔ́bɔku ɔ́lɛku kɔlɔ kɔmɛni lɛlɔ. Mmɔ na kevo kamɛni káƒɔ lɛlɔ kése úti útédu Ɔga Dawid uwi.

english_verse: He pleased God and asked him if he could build a house of worship for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Katɔti úbunku Dawid kaduɛ. Anwuɔsu Dawid úye Unwoti ɔnii nka ute-nwu kuƒi na ɔtu keliekɔ geen use ute anwu ɔni ndi Yakob Katɔti.

english_verse: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Salomo geen nátu keliekɔ kammɔ.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
translation_verse: “Nsu Katɔti ulélie ɔtɔ ɔni na bekyuli bayawine bátu kemmo. Unwoti ɔ́kɛnku nwuna kenye bediene lɛlɔ ɔ́su ɔnini,

english_verse: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: “ ‘Katɔ ndi mina lɛgaboku, na kalɔ ndi mina lɛgba kanyakɔ. Na bi ɔtɔ udu na bɛdubɔkana-mi bɔtu bute, munuu mɔɔyaki keliekɔ kadi?

english_verse: I have made everything.”
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi ami nédie ala amɛni ƒui yoo?’ ”

english_verse: You stubborn and hardheaded people! You are always fighting against the Holy Spirit, just as your ancestors did.
translation_verse: Amu na Steƒano ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Batuɔkplune geen bɛdi! Amii lɛnɔ bɛɛda atu teedie Katɔti litemi lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na bina bati bábla kalɛ. Uwi ndi uwi bɛɛta teenye Katɔti Kɔyu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him.
translation_verse: Katɔti kenye udiene ɔmani na bina bati kuuku bátawia ka badu? Bádu Katɔti kenye bediene bani muedi násu ka Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔni nse siin webo. Na Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ bídie-nwu bíte na bádu.

english_verse: Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it. Stephen Is Stoned to Death
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka bɛgyi ƒui na bíni Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔni na bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́siku Unwoti ɔtu enu kemmo.” Bébo Steƒano Atabi

english_verse: When the council members heard Stephen's speech, they were angry and furious.
translation_verse: Ka bénu etemila ani na Steƒano ɔ́su ɔ́siku-ma lɛlɔ ni, ɔƒɛ ɔ́da-ma geen na ɔ́ya bákya baadu anyi ku kɔnyi.

english_verse: But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side.
translation_verse: Nsu ka Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ Steƒano lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui ɔsu ni, ɔ́talaku anumi ɔ́nu katɔ laa, na ɔ́nu Katɔti bukeye ku Yesu ɔni nnye-nwu kɔdianu.

english_verse: Then Stephen said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God!”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛnu! Mɔɔnu ka katɔ kébimi na Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi unye Katɔti kɔdianu!”

english_verse: The council members shouted and covered their ears. At once they all attacked Stephen
translation_verse: Amu na báyoli momoomo na bétile bana atuƒi, na békeli bétéƒie-nwu.

english_verse: and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translation_verse: Na bákpɛ-nwu bálɛku ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo, na bákya-nwu anumi ku atabi bubo. Na bekyuli bani nákpɛ-nwu bálɛku ni, bédie bana lɛwu béti béwi okloƒu ɔkɔdi ɔni baalɔ Saulo lɛgba lɛlɔ.

english_verse: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!”
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na bakya beebó-nwu atabi ni, Steƒano ɔ́kpali katɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Blɔti Yesu, ƒɔ mina kɔyu.”

english_verse: He knelt down and shouted, “Lord, don't blame them for what they have done.” Then he died.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́lɛ akɔnkɔ na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́kpali katɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Unwoti, teti bɔƒiɔ bɔmɛni tete-ma, énu!” Na ka útemi ɔ́su lɛni ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, ɔ́lɛ úbo kalɔ na ɔ́yula.

english_verse: Saul started making a lot of trouble for the church. He went from house to house, arresting men and women and putting them in jail. The Good News Is Preached in Samaria
translation_verse: Amu na Saulo úti ɔ́sia lɛlɔ na uukpóku baƒɔtaadine bammɔ na ɔkɛ kɔduli uuƒie banana ku beleku taavinku-ma taatákya ɔtɔ. Ƒilipo Ɔ́kɔ Litemi Buni Lɛsa Na Samaria

english_verse: The Lord's followers who had been scattered went from place to place, telling the good news.
translation_verse: Nsu baƒɔtaadine bani nékeli bási Yerusalem mɛni ni, bakɛ baaví kesii biala taasu Blɔti litemi buni.

english_verse: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told the people about Christ.
translation_verse: Na Ƒilipo anwu ni, úsie Samaria útásu bekyuli litemi buni lɛmmɔ ɔ́siku Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They crowded around Philip because they were eager to hear what he was saying and to see him work miracles.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli pii bénu etemila ani na ɔɔsu ɔ́si akɔla budie taatina pii ani na ɔ́bla na bánu ɔsu.

english_verse: Many people with evil spirits were healed, and the spirits went out of them with a shout. A lot of paralyzed and lame people were also healed.
translation_verse: Ɔ́bɔku ayu ekpidi pii ɔ́lɛku bekyuli lɛlɔ kemmo, na ayu ekpidi amɛni áva momoomo asa na ávi álɛ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo. Amu na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́bwi bani na lɛlɔ kakɛ kenwi kékpi-ma ku ama bani náƒɛ bewi kalɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in that city was very glad because of what was happening.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, kubiti kɔ́kya Samaria ɔma ɔmɛni kemmo geen!

english_verse: For some time a man named Simon had lived there and had amazed the people of Samaria. He practiced witchcraft and claimed to be somebody great.
translation_verse: Ɔnana ɔdi ɔ́kya Samaria ɔni baalɔ Simon, na ɔdi ukyuli ɔni mɔɔƒɛ evo. Na nwuna evo bɔbla útaabla bekyuli kalɛ kadi. Na úteeƒu ɔnii ɔdi ukyuli ɔdi na nwuna ala bɔnu taasu ɔsu.

english_verse: Everyone, rich and poor, crowded around him. They said, “This man is the power of God called ‘The Great Power.’ ”
translation_verse: Samariaƒuɔ banana ku beleku ƒui baabu-nwu ɔ́si nwuna lɛlɔ bɔtina kabla kamɛni ɔsu. Anwuɔsu básu básiku-nwu lɛlɔ banini, “Anwu ndi katɔ ɔyikun ɔni baalɔ banii Ɔyikun Unengudi.”

english_verse: For a long time, Simon had used witchcraft to amaze the people, and they kept crowding around him.
translation_verse: Amu ka nwuna evo bɔbla áƒɔ-ma anu ɔsu ni, béteenu-nwu litemi.

english_verse: But when they believed what Philip was saying about God's kingdom and about the name of Jesus Christ, they were all baptized.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒaani ni, báƒɔ Ƒilipo kenye bɔsu mmomu bádi ɔ́si Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ ku Yesu lɛlɔ. Na banana ku beleku pii báƒɔ ntu bɔkpila ɔdi na Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛnyi kemmo.

english_verse: Even Simon believed and was baptized. He stayed close to Philip, because he marveled at all the miracles and wonders.
translation_verse: Amu na Simon ɔmɛni ɔlati lɛnɔ ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di. Na ka ɔ́ƒɔ ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmɛni ni, útaasiaku Ƒilipo kesii biala na úsela. Na ɔkɛnku akɔla budie taatina ani na ɔ́bla ɔsu ni, ɔ́bla-nwu dɛye dɛye!

english_verse: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that some people in Samaria had accepted God's message, and they sent Peter and John.
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔni na batalane bani nkya Yerusalem bénu ka Samariaƒuɔ báƒɔ Katɔti litemi bádi ni, bátala Petro ku Yohane na bana kudɔ.

english_verse: When the two apostles arrived, they prayed that these people would be given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ka bétéduo ni, bákpali katɔ béte Kristoƒuɔ bawɔdi bamɛni kalɛ na baƒɔ Katɔti Kɔyu.

english_verse: Before this, the Holy Spirit had not been given to any of them, though some of them had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɔsika úbalɛ uwi ɔmmɔ ni, bátaƒɔ tɔ Katɔti Kɔyu. Na ntu kani na bákpila-ma na Blɔti Yesu lɛnyi kemmo.

english_verse: Peter and John then placed their hands on everyone who had faith in the Lord, and they were given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, Petro ku Yohane béti enu básia-ma eli, na ama lɛnɔ báƒɔ Katɔti Kɔyu.

english_verse: Simon noticed that the Spirit was given only when the apostles placed their hands on the people. So he brought money
translation_verse: Ka Simon ɔ́nu ka si batalane bamɛni béti enu básia-ma eli na baaƒɔ́ Katɔti Kɔyu ni, úti egulabi ɔnii uute batalane bamɛni na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini,

english_verse: and said to Peter and John, “Let me have this power too! Then anyone I place my hands on will also be given the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: “Bɛya na ami lɛnɔ lɛkɛ ɔyikun ɔmɛni ɔdi kalɛ na si líti enu lɛ́sia ɔdi biala lɛlɔ ni, na ɔƒɔ Katɔti Kɔyu.”

english_verse: Peter said to him, “You and your money will both end up in hell if you think you can buy God's gift!
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ ku ƒula egulabi ƒui bɛdubɔnuku-ni. Takali anii adubɔkana Unwoti litela buye ku egulabi.

english_verse: You don't have any part in this, and God sees that your heart isn't right.
translation_verse: Alakana kalabla kamɛni kemmo bɔkya, ɔsika ƒula kayi keeese siin na Katɔti anumi.

english_verse: Get rid of these evil thoughts and ask God to forgive you.
translation_verse: Da anumi die kasusu kekpidi kamɛni lɛlɔ na akpali katɔ. Ɔƒaalɛ Katɔti ɔdubuti ƒula likpidi ɔkyiɛ-ɔ na ƒula kasusu kekpidi kamɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I can see that you are jealous and bound by your evil ways.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika ni, mɔɔnu ka ebo lɛnungyie likpidi, na likpidi bɔbla lɛnɔ lɛ́di-ɔ lɛlɔ!”

english_verse: Simon said, “Please pray to the Lord, so that what you said won't happen to me.”
translation_verse: Amu na Simon ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Biveleku-mi kalɛ na ɔgbankpi ubendi ɔmɛni udu ulálɛku-mi.”

english_verse: After Peter and John had preached about the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem. On their way they told the good news in many villages of Samaria. Philip and an Ethiopian Official
translation_verse: Amu uwi ɔni na Petro ku Yohane bédie Unwoti kenye na básu-ma litemi buni lɛmmɔ na Samaria ni, básɔ bénwini bésie Yerusalem, na bakɛ beedí teenye na lɛma lɛni nde Samaria kemmo taasu-ma litemi buni. Ƒilipo Ɔ́tɛmiku Etiopiani Unengu

english_verse: The Lord's angel said to Philip, “Go south along the desert road that leads from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
translation_verse: Nsu Ƒilipo anwu ni, Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi úbasu-nwu ɔnini, “Teesie na atásia ketele ulu ɔni nási Yerusalem ɔ́yu úsie Gasa mmɔ.”

english_verse: So Philip left. An important Ethiopian official happened to be going along that road in his chariot. He was the chief treasurer for Candace, the Queen of Ethiopia. The official had gone to Jerusalem to worship
translation_verse: Na ɔ́ta útásia ulu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Ka úsela ni, útásiaku ukyuli ɔdi ka ɔ́si ɔdubo. Ukyuli ɔmɛni ndi egulabi lɛlɔ ɔnune unengudi na Etiopia Ɔga Uleku ɔni baalɔ Kandake lɛga kadikɔ. Unengu ɔmɛni ɔ́si Yerusalem kesii kani na útákpali katɔ.

english_verse: and was now on his way home. He was sitting in his chariot, reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.
translation_verse: Na únwini ɔdubo na ɔpɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ kemmo, na ɔkɛ ɔɔká Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔni na Katɔti Kenye Udiene Yesaia únweni.

english_verse: The Spirit told Philip to catch up with the chariot.
translation_verse: Amu na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́su Ƒilipo ɔnini, “Teesie na atásiaku ɔpɔnkɔ kɛɛkɛ ɔmɛni.”

english_verse: Philip ran up close and heard the man reading aloud from the book of Isaiah. Philip asked him, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translation_verse: Ƒilipo úkeli úsie-nwu kudɔ na uunú ka unengu ɔmmɔ ɔɔká Yesaia ɔku. Amu na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Eenú lɛla lɛni na aaká mɛni kalɔ?”

english_verse: The official answered, “How can I understand unless someone helps me?” He then invited Philip to come up and sit beside him.
translation_verse: Amu na unengu ɔmɛni údie kenye ɔnini, “Oowo, dɛ na mabla asa na menu kalɔ ka ukyuli ɔdi uuubo na udie kalɔ ɔtina-mi?” Amu na úvele Ƒilipo ɔnii ubeduo kɛɛkɛ kemmo na ɔsɔ ulie-nwu kudɔ.

english_verse: The man was reading the passage that said, “He was led like a sheep on its way to be killed. He was silent as a lamb whose wool is being cut off, and he did not say a word.
translation_verse: Na etemila ani na ɔkya ɔɔká na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ndi ɔnii, “Báda-nwu béselaku aani koƒonu kɔni béti batádu. Na ɔkɛ aani koƒonu kɔni naaadaku-ni si beekúlo-ku linwini, na útebimi kenye lɛnɔ.

english_verse: He was treated like a nobody and did not receive a fair trial. How can he have children, if his life is snatched away?”
translation_verse: Bákya-nwu kɔƒa na útakɛ ukyuli ɔni náƒɔ-nwu kenye. Údie kaba kadi? Bi na ɔ́bla úse asa baadú-nwu na kayawi kamɛni kemmo?”
