english_verse: The official said to Philip, “Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or about someone else?”
translation_verse: Amu na unengu ɔmmɔ úye Ƒilipo ɔnini, “Yesaia ni, anwu ɔlati lɛlɔ na uutemi taasiku, munuu ukyuli bamba ɔdi lɛlɔ na uutemi taasiku?”

english_verse: So Philip began at this place in the Scriptures and explained the good news about Jesus.
translation_verse: Amu na Ƒilipo úse kalɔ na úti Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔmmɔ na uudie litemi buni lɛmmɔ kalɔ taatina-nwu ɔ́si Yesu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: As they were going along the road, they came to a place where there was some water. The official said, “Look! Here is some water. Why can't I be baptized?”
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔni na bakɛ bésela ni, bátánu ntu bɔdi ka bunye likpo lɛdi na ulu kudɔ mmɔ. Na unengu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su Ƒilipo ɔnini, “Aanu ntu bɔdi. Bi ɔsu na naaakana Katɔti ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmmɔ bɔƒɔ?” Amu na Ƒilipo ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Si áƒɔ ádi ku ƒula kayi ƒui ni, adubɔkana.”

english_verse: After they had come out of the water, the Lord's Spirit took Philip away. The official never saw him again, but he was very happy as he went on his way.
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔni na bávi bálɛ ntu bɔmɛni kemmo ni, Katɔti Kɔyu kúti Ƒilipo kɔ́tɔlɔku, na unengu ɔmɛni ɔ́sɔ útanu-nwu. Na anwu lɛti ɔ́tɔlɔ ku kubiti.

english_verse: Philip later appeared in Azotus. He went from town to town, all the way to Caesarea, telling people about Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama ni, Ƒilipo ɔ́nu ɔ́ti ka unye Asoto ɔma kemmo. Na ɔ́su litemi buni lɛmɛni na mmɔ bene ku lɛma lɛni nkya ulu lɛlɔ ƒui. Na úsie laa útédu Kaesarea ɔma lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Saul preached with such power that he completely confused the Jewish people in Damascus, as he tried to show them that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Amu na Saulo úsie anumi geen na nwuna litemi bɔsu kemmo. Na Yudaƒuɔ bani nkya Damasko mmɔ ɔdi biala útakana lɛla lɛdi bɔsu. Na údie kalɔ ɔ́tina-ma ka Yesu ndi Kristo.

english_verse: Now get up and go into the city, where you will be told what to do.”
translation_verse: Ɔƒaani ni, ta na eteesie ɔma kemmo. Badubɔsu-ɔ lɛla lɛni na ɔlɛka abla.”

english_verse: I will show him how much he must suffer for worshiping in my name.”
translation_verse: Na ndubɔtina-nwu kalɛ na ɔlɛka ubo abi na ami ɔsu.”

english_verse: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the followers. But they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe he was a true follower.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔni na útéduo Yerusalem ni, ɔ́wia ka nka uduo baƒɔtaadine bani nkya mmɔ akɔ. Nsu ama lɛnɔ báyia-nwu. Bábu ka bɔtɔlɔ na ɔda-ma.

english_verse: and he has seen a vision. He saw a man named Ananias coming to him and putting his hands on him, so he could see again.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika líidie lɛ́tina-nwu ka ukyuli ɔni baalɔ Anania ɔdubo ubeti enu ɔsia-nwu lɛlɔ na ɔsɔ utaanu.”

english_verse: Suddenly something like fish scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see. He got up and was baptized.
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, ɔ́bla Saulo aani si akpa adi ámami ási nwuna anumi lɛlɔ na ɔ́sɔ ɔɔnu. Na ɔ́ta na ɔ́ya na bákpila-nwu ntu.

english_verse: Saul kept on threatening to kill the Lord's followers. He even went to the high priest
translation_verse: Lebo lɛmmɔ kemmo ƒui ni, Saulo ɔ́bi ɔ́siaku Blɔti basiakune bammɔ ku lɛnungyie ɔnii ɔɔdú-ma. Na ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie Yudaƒuɔ ɔkpane unengudi kudɔ.

english_verse: and asked for letters to the leaders of the synagogues in Damascus. He did this because he wanted to arrest and take to Jerusalem any man or woman who had accepted the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na úvele-nwu ɔnii ute-nwu ɔku na uti usienku Yudaƒuɔ kɔsakɔ na Damasko kalɛ na ɔkɛ ɔyikun na uƒie banana ku beleku bani ƒui nsiaku bɔƒɔtaadi bɔwɔdi bɔmmɔ usienku Yerusalem.

english_verse: When Saul had almost reached Damascus, a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔni na ɔ́kpɛ uudé Damasko na kasusu kamɛni lɛlɔ ni, kɔnakunwi bukeye bɔdi búkeye bɔ́si katɔ na búbewi-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, “Saul! Saul! Why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́lɛ úbo kalɔ na únu ka lɛdi lɛdi lɛɛsu-nwu lɛnini, “Saulo, Saulo, bi ɔsu na eekpóku-mi lɛni?”

english_verse: “Who are you?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus,” the Lord answered. “I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: Amu na Saulo úye ɔnini, “Ati, ɔma na adi?” Amu na lɛdi lɛmɛni lídie kenye ɔnini, “Ami ndi Yesu ɔni na eekpóku kpakplaa.

english_verse: The men with Saul stood there speechless. They had heard the voice, but they had not seen anyone.
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli bani na ama ku Saulo bakɛ mmɔ bágyini. Bénu butemi bɔmɛni, nsu bátanu ukyuli ɔdi.

english_verse: Saul got up from the ground, and when he opened his eyes, he could not see a thing. Someone then led him by the hand to Damascus,
translation_verse: Amu ka Saulo ɔ́ta únye na úbimi anumi ni, ɔ́sɔ ulanu. Amu na bákpanku-nwu bétéduoku Damasko ɔma kemmo.

english_verse: and for three days he was blind and did not eat or drink.
translation_verse: Na úlie mmɔ emeyi atɛ ɔni na ulánu, uládi na ulani lɛnɔ.

english_verse: A follower named Ananias lived in Damascus, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision. Ananias answered, “Lord, here I am.”
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, ɔƒɔtaadine ɔdi ɔkya Damasko ɔni baalɔ Anania. Na Blɔti údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina-nwu na ɔ́lɔ-nwu ɔnii, “Anania!” Amu na ɔ́tuna-nwu ɔnini, “Ati, ami mɛni!”

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. When you get there, you will find a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. Saul is praying,
translation_verse: Amu na Blɔti ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ta, na asia ulu ɔni baalɔ banii Ligeen lɛlɔ, na esie Yuda kesii na etéye Tarsoni ɔni baalɔ Saulo lɛlɔ. Ɔkya mmɔ ɔɔkpali katɔ teevele-mi.

english_verse: Ananias replied, “Lord, a lot of people have told me about the terrible things this man has done to your followers in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Anania údie kenye ɔnini, “Blɔti, línu na kesii biala kalala kani udu na ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔɔbla baƒɔtaadine na Yerusalem!

english_verse: Now the chief priests have given him the power to come here and arrest anyone who worships in your name.”
translation_verse: Na búunu ka ɔ́ƒɔ ɔku ɔ́siku ɔkpane unengudi kudɔ banii ubeƒie baƒɔtaadine bani nkya Damasko ƒui!”

english_verse: The Lord said to Ananias, “Go! I have chosen him to tell foreigners, kings, and the people of Israel about me.
translation_verse: Nsu Blɔti ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Teesie, na atábla kalɛ na lɛ́su-ɔ. Ɔsika ami lɛ́ɛƒuna Saulo aani mina ukyuli ɔni meti mina litemi buni lɛmɛni mesienku ama bani naaadi Israelƒuɔ ku baga anumi ku Israelƒuɔ ƒui kudɔ.

english_verse: Ananias left and went into the house where Saul was staying. Ananias placed his hands on him and said, “Saul, the Lord Jesus has sent me. He is the same one who appeared to you along the road. He wants you to be able to see and to be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Anania úsie na útánu Saulo na úti enu ɔ́sia-nwu lɛlɔ, na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ɔnwa Saulo, Blɔti Yesu ɔni nédie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina-a na ulu lɛlɔ ni, anwu nátala-mi ɔ́kya-a kalɛ na asɔ ataanu na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔƒɔ-ɔ lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui.”

english_verse: Then he ate and felt much better. Saul Preaches in Damascus For several days Saul stayed with the Lord's followers in Damascus.
translation_verse: Na ka ɔ́di adila adi ni, ɔ́sɔ ɔ́kɛ ɔyikun. Saulo Ɔ́kɔ Litemi Buni Lɛmmɔ Lɛsa Na Damasko Amu na Saulo úlie baƒɔtaadine bani nkya Damasko mmɔ kudɔ emeyi adi.

english_verse: Soon he went to the synagogues and started telling people that Jesus is the Son of God.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kani na úsie Yudaƒuɔ kɔsakɔ útásu Yesu lɛlɔ litemi ka Katɔti Ubidi na ɔdi.

english_verse: Everyone who heard Saul was amazed and said, “Isn't this the man who caused so much trouble for those people in Jerusalem who worship in the name of Jesus? Didn't he come here to arrest them and take them to the chief priests?”
translation_verse: Amu na bekyuli bani ƒui nénu-nwu litemi lɛmɛni ni, ɔ́bla-ma dɛye dɛye. Na béye lɛlɔ banini, “Ɔɔɔdi ukyuli ɔmɛni nkɛ mɔɔdú Yesu kama basiakune na Yerusalem uwi ɔni yoo? Na búnu lɛnɔ ka nka baƒɔtaadine na úbo úbeƒie úsienku bakpane benengu.”

english_verse: Later some of them made plans to kill Saul,
translation_verse: Emeyi adi kama ni, Yudaƒuɔ bása na bábla kasusu ka badubɔdu-nwu.

english_verse: but he found out about it. He learned that they were guarding the gates of the city day and night in order to kill him.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli badi bábasu Saulo ka baawia-nwu badu. Ɔmɛni ɔsu bekisine bamɛni baagyumana kɔyakun kɔni baasia taalɛ na beeduo ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo kalɛ na bakɛ-nwu badu.

english_verse: Then one night his followers let him down over the city wall in a large basket. Saul in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Amu na nwuna badi bani ndi baƒɔtaadine mmɔ béti-nwu bákya kagyigyɛ kemmo na báyula-nwu básiku kowodu liƒi na ɔ́lɛ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo usientɛ! Saulo Útéduo Yerusalem

english_verse: Then Barnabas helped him by taking him to the apostles. He explained how Saul had seen the Lord and how the Lord had spoken to him. Barnabas also said when Saul was in Damascus, he had spoken bravely in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Amu na Barnaba útiku-nwu úsienku batalane bamɛni kudɔ na ɔ́su-ma kalɛ na Saulo ɔ́nu Blɔti ɔni na úsela Damasko. Ɔ́su-ma litemi lɛni na Blɔti ɔ́su-nwu ku litemi buni lɛni na ɔ́su ku kayi buse na Yesu lɛnyi kemmo na Damasko.

english_verse: Saul moved about freely with the followers in Jerusalem and told everyone about the Lord.
translation_verse: Amu na báƒɔ-nwu bákya bana akɔ. Na ɔ́si uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, ɔ́kya-ma akɔ uwi biala na ɔɔsu Blɔti lɛlɔ litemi na Yerusalem.

english_verse: He was always arguing with the Jews who spoke Greek, and so they tried to kill him.
translation_verse: Amu na Yudaƒuɔ bani muutemi Griki na baalɔ-ma banii Helaƒuɔ badi ku Saulo bákya unyeƒi ɔdi na báyɔ ka badu-nwu.

english_verse: But the followers found out about this and took Saul to Caesarea. From there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔni na baƒɔtaadine bamɛni badi bénu ka bekyuli bamɛni baawia-nwu badu ni, bétiku-nwu bésienku Kaesarea na bávinku-nwu bésienku nwuna ɔma ɔni ndi Tarso.

english_verse: The church in Judea, Galilee, and Samaria now had a time of peace and kept on worshiping the Lord. The church became stronger, as the Holy Spirit encouraged it and helped it grow. Peter Heals Aeneas
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, baƒɔtaadine bani nkya Yudea ku Galilea ku Samaria kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, bákɛ bɔnwuna na basɔ balayia. Bákɛ kayi buse ku ɔkplu bɔkya ɔkɛnku Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun lɛlɔ. Na bémomo bébu na béteeti ɔbu teete Blɔti. Petro Úsie Lida Ku Yopa

english_verse: While Peter was traveling from place to place, he visited the Lord's followers who lived in the town of Lydda.
translation_verse: Amu ka Petro ɔkɛ ɔɔví taatánu Kristoƒuɔ ƒui na nwuna bɔvi kemmo ni, úsie útánu baƒɔtaadine bani nkya ɔma ɔni baalɔ Lida.

english_verse: There he met a man named Aeneas, who for eight years had been sick in bed and could not move.
translation_verse: Amu na útánu ɔnana ɔdi na ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo ɔni baalɔ Enea ka ɔ́ƒɛ uwi kalɔ akwa maane sɔɔn.

english_verse: Peter said to Aeneas, “Jesus Christ has healed you! Get up and make up your bed.” At once he stood up.
translation_verse: Na ka Petro ɔ́nu-nwu ni, ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Enea, nu! Yesu Kristo ɔ́bwi-ɔ! Ta nye! Na abuma ƒula atɛla.” Na mmɔ kani na ɔ́ta únye ku ɔlɔkplu.

english_verse: Many people in the towns of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and became followers of the Lord. Peter Brings Dorcas Back to Life
translation_verse: Na ka bánu ka Enea ɔkɛ uusié taavi ɔsu ni, Lida ku Saron lɛma kemmo bekyuli ƒui béti lɛlɔ béte Blɔti.

english_verse: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means “deer.” She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama ni, uleku ɔdi ɔkya Yopa ɔni baalɔ Tabita. Na Griki lɛdi kemmo ni, anwu baalɔ banii Dorka na nwuna kalɔ ndi kaƒɛ. Ɔdi ɔƒɔtaadine ɔni na útaabla lɛƒɔndia teete nwuna bakpana uwi pii.

english_verse: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔlɛ úbebo-nwu na úkpi. Amu na nwuna bakpana bákpila-nwu na báklibi-nwu béti bétése katu taasia ɔtɔ ɔtɔdi ɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, “Please come with us as quickly as you can!”
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔni na bénu ka Petro úbo ɔkya Lida ni, na ka Lida ude Yopa ɔsu ni, bátala nkyuli inyɔ badi banii betévele-nwu na ɔsiaku-ma lɛgba lɛgba na ubo Yopa.

english_verse: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.
translation_verse: Amu na anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́ta ɔ́siaku-ma, na ka ɔ́nya úbeduo ni, bétiku-nwu bésienku kesii kani na Dorka ɔtɛ. Na bekpinele bani nkya mmɔ ƒui bábaka bámana-nwu na beewulo. Na bada lɛwu lɛni na Dorka ɔ́ka úte-ma baatina Petro.

english_verse: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, “Tabitha, get up!” The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́su bana ƒui ɔnii bavi balɛ ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo, na ɔ́lɛ akɔnkɔ na ɔ́kpali katɔ. Amu na únwini anumi ɔ́tina Dorka na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Dorka, ta!” Mmɔ kani na úbimi anumi. Na ka ɔ́nya ɔ́nu Petro ni, ɔ́ta úlie.

english_verse: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Amu na Petro úte-nwu kɔnu na anwu lɛnɔ úƒie-ku ɔ́da na ɔ́ta únye. Amu na Petro ɔ́sɔ ɔ́lɔ baƒɔtaadine ku bekpinele bammɔ ƒui úboku. Na úti-nwu ɔ́kya-ma lɛkɔkɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Amu na litemi lɛmɛni lígyingya lɛ́kya ɔma kemmo ƒui, na bekyuli pii báƒɔ Blɔti bádi.

english_verse: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Petro úlie Yopa ɔma ɔmɛni kemmo útu uwi na Simon ɔni mɔɔbla bebuo lɛku lɛlɔ kabla mmɔ kudɔ.

english_verse: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, who was the captain of a group of soldiers called “The Italian Unit.”
translation_verse: Lebo lɛmmɔ ni, ɔnana ɔdi úlie Kaesarea ɔma kemmo ɔni baalɔ banii Kornelio. Ɔdi unengu úte Romaƒuɔ bekpone.

english_verse: Cornelius was a very religious man. He worshiped God, and so did everyone else who lived in his house. He had given a lot of money to the poor and was always praying to God.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ukyuli ɔbuni, na anwu ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli ƒui beeti ɔbu teete Katɔti. Ukyuli ɔmɛni úteete bekyuli ala ku nwuna kayi ƒui, na ɔɔyɔ́ katɔ bɔkpali lɛnɔ.

english_verse: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.
translation_verse: Limeyi lɛdi ɔƒiiwi lɛdɔ ɛtɛ kemmo ni, ɔ́nu budie bɔtina bɔdi. Na budie taatina bɔmɛni kemmo ni, ɔ́nu ka Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi ɔ́si úbo-nwu kudɔ. Na ɔ́lɔ-nwu ɔnini, “Kornelio.”

english_verse: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, “What is this all about?” The angel answered, “God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: Amu ka Kornelio ɔ́nu-nwu ni, liƒu lɛ́da-nwu geen. Amu na úye-nwu ɔnini, “Ati, bi na aawia?” Amu na Katɔti ɔtu ɔmɛni ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ƒula bekyuli ala bute ku ƒula katɔ bɔkpali ni, búduo Katɔti kudɔ.

english_verse: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Tala bekyuli badi na besie Yopa na batákpanku ɔnana ɔni baalɔ Simon Petro beboku.

english_verse: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.”
translation_verse: Uli Simon ɔni nli ɛpu kudɔ na ɔɔbla bebuo lɛku lɛlɔ kabla mmɔ kudɔ.”

english_verse: After saying this, the angel left. Cornelius called in two of his servants and one of his soldiers who worshiped God.
translation_verse: Amu ka Katɔti ɔtu ɔmɛni ɔ́tɔlɔ ni, Kornelio ɔ́lɔ nwuna kaduli nkyuli inyɔ ku bekpone bani mɔɔgyumana-nwu mmɔ akɔ unwi ɔni lɛnɔ ndi ukyuli ɔbuni.

english_verse: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-ma lɛla lɛni nálɛ, na ɔ́tala-ma ɔnii beteesie Yopa.

english_verse: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray
translation_verse: Amu ka kadi kégye na bakɛ bésela na badaku ɔma ɔmɛni bɔkpɛ bude ni, Petro ɔ́kɔ úsie nwuna lɛsa lili ɔnii utákpali katɔ ɔƒiiwi.

english_verse: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.
translation_verse: Kɔka kúbo kɔɔda-nwu, nsu uwi ɔmmɔ na benye baanwá adila. Amu na ɔ́bla aani lɛlɛɛ kemmo na úduo.

english_verse: He saw heaven open, and something came down like a huge sheet held up by its four corners.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́nu ka kayaa kébimi, na ɔ́nu kɔdi bonwu kɔdi ka bada kuna ekpo ene ani ƒui na kɔ́si kɔɔyu kalɔ.

english_verse: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Na kɔdi kɔmɛni kemmo ni, bebuo lidu lidu pii ku balakpi ku baasɛ lɛnɔ bakya.

english_verse: A voice said to him, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Amu na únu ka lɛdi lɛdi lɛɛsu-nwu lɛnini, “Petro, ta, na adu akun.”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́su ɔnini, “Oowo! Kudi kudii! Blɔti, ńteti bebuo bani abu Yudaƒuɔ bukisi ńtetuku kenye kudii!”

english_verse: The voice spoke to him again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Lɛdi lɛmɛni lɛ́sɔ lɛ́su-nwu lɛnini, “Lɛla lɛni lɛlɔ na Katɔti úveli ɔ́bla kede kede ni, tasu anii liisé lɛlɔ!”

english_verse: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.
translation_verse: Ɔ́nu búdie bɔtina bɔmɛni kɔtɛ sɔɔn. Na kɔtɛdi kɔmɛni kama ni, béti kɔdi kɔmɛni bésienku katɔ.

english_verse: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔmmɔ ni, lɛla lɛmɛni lɛkya lɛɛbla Petro dɛye dɛye, na úye lɛlɔ ɔnii, “Bi na ɔmɛni ɔɔtina?” Mmɔ kani na bekyuli bani na Kornelio ɔ́tala mmɔ bébeduo ɔma ɔmɛni kemmo. Na ka bánu kaduli kani baawia ni, bébo bébenye kayakun.

english_verse: and were asking if Simon Peter was staying there.
translation_verse: Na benye beeye kesii kani na Simon Petro uli.

english_verse: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, “Three men are here looking for you.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔni na Petro ulie ɔɔkali nwuna budie bɔtina bɔmɛni lɛlɔ na ulati lɛla lɛni na lɛdi ni, Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́su-nwu kɔnini, “Nkyuli ɛtɛ bébo baawia-a.

english_verse: Hurry down and go with them. Don't worry, I sent them.”
translation_verse: Ta, na esie atánu-ma. Tayia ka asiaku-ma eteesie. Ami nátala-ma.”

english_verse: Peter went down and said to the men, “I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translation_verse: Amu na Petro úsie útánu-ma na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Ami ndi ukyuli ɔni na bɛɛwia. Bi nébo?”

english_verse: They answered, “Captain Cornelius sent us. He is a good man who worships God and is liked by the Jewish people. One of God's holy angels told Cornelius to send for you, so he could hear what you have to say.”
translation_verse: Amu na básu-nwu banini, “Batu na bɔdi, bɔ́si Kornelio ɔni ndi Romaƒuɔ kekpo unengu kudɔ. Ɔdi ukyuli ɔbuni na ɔɔbu Katɔti. Na Yudaƒuɔ ƒui baayɔ́-nwu litemi geen. Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi násu-nwu ɔnii ɔtala na babalɔ-ɔ na unu ƒula kenye kemmo litemi.”

english_verse: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Petro ɔ́ya bébeduo-nwu kudɔ na ɔ́ƒɔ-ma aani nwuna baƒɔ kalɛ. Ka kadi kégye ni, anwu ku baƒɔtaadine badi bani nási Yopa básiaku-ma bátɔlɔ.

english_verse: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.
translation_verse: Amu na bétéduo Kaesarea limeyi lɛmmɔ kadi kegye. Amu na uwi ɔmɛni ni, Kornelio ɔ́sala nwuna kaduli bekyuli lisu ku nwuna bakpana badi na belie bagya Petro bubo.

english_verse: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.
translation_verse: Amu ka Petro ɔ́nya úbeduo nwuna kaduli ni, Kornelio ɔ́lɛ akɔnkɔ na Petro anumi na úboku lili kalɔ.

english_verse: But Peter took hold of him and said, “Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.”
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ta nye! Ami lɛnɔ ukyuli na ndi.”

english_verse: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there,
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, ɔ́ta únye. Na ka bátɛmi blii ni, Kornelio útiku-nwu úsienku kesii kani na bekyuli bakladi bása belie.

english_verse: and Peter said to them, “You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.
translation_verse: Na Petro ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Bɛgyi ka bula Yudaƒuɔ ɔda bubo útete-mi kuƒi ka nka liduo ukyuli ɔni naaadi bula kadi ukyuli ɔdi kesii iye liti lɛlɔ lɛmana-nwu lɛlɔ. Nsu Katɔti údie ɔ́tina-mi ka ntanu ukyuli ɔdi aani ukyuli keeke.

english_verse: I agreed to come here, but I want to know why you sent for me.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka bánya bábalɔ-mi kani na lɛ́ta líbo. Na bi ɔsu na bɛɛwia-mi?”

english_verse: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, Kornelio ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ɔbla emeyi ene mɛni aani uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ka nkya mɔɔkpali katɔ ɔƒiiwi aani kalɛ na mɔɔyɔ́ bɔbla uwi ndi uwi. Na kɔnakunwi ni, ɔnana ɔdi ɔ́si úbenye-mi anumi, na ɔkya awu ɔni muukeye na ɔɔtu anumi!

english_verse: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.”
translation_verse: Ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, ‘Kornelio, ƒula lɛƒɔndia ku ƒula katɔ bɔkpali ƒui uudú Katɔti kudɔ! Na ɔƒaani ni, tala bekyuli badi na besie Yopa na batálɔ Simon Petro ɔni nli Simon ɔni mɔɔbla bebuo lɛku kabla na uli ɛpu kudɔ.’

english_verse: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na lɛ́tala lɛni babalɔ-ɔ, na awɔ lɛnɔ ábla kaduɛ ka áta lɛgba lɛgba ébo. Anwuɔsu na bulie bɔgya-a na Unwoti anumi ka abasu-bu litemi lɛni na ɔ́su-ɔ ɔnii su-bu.” Petro Údie Litemi Buni Kalɔ Úte-ma

english_verse: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.
translation_verse: Amu na Petro ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Lɛ́nu lɛ́ti nwaa ka Blɔti ulánu bekyuli anumi.

english_verse: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.
translation_verse: Mmomu kalɔ biala lɛlɔ ukyuli ɔni muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ teete-nwu na ɔɔbla nwuna lɛyɔla ni, anwu na ɔɔƒɔ́.

english_verse: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.
translation_verse: Lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di ka bínu litemi buni lɛni na básu béte Israelƒuɔ ka ni, ɔkɛ Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ ni, badubɔkɛ keyi buɛɛ. Na anwu ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔni lɛnɔ ndi bayawine ƒui Ɔti.

english_verse: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.
translation_verse: Na bɛgyi ala enengudi ani nálɛ na Yudea kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui ani nése kalɔ ási Galilea kalɔ lɛlɔ uwi ɔni na Yohane ɔ́kɔ lɛsa ɔ́si ntu bɔkpila ɔdi lɛlɔ kama.

english_verse: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Na bínu lɛnɔ kalɛ na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna Yesu ɔni nási Nasaret ɔni na úti nwuna Kɔyu úse-nwu likpo na úti ɔyikun lɛnɔ úte-nwu. Na ɔ́kɛ útaavi taabla lɛbuni na útaabwi bani ƒui na ayu ekpidi eekpóku, ɔsika Katɔti ɔsiaku-nwu.

english_verse: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.
translation_verse: “Abu muudie kenye na ala ani na úbabla na Israel ku Yerusalem. Mmɔ na bádu-nwu na ugyii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Katɔti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́ya na ɔ́ta ɔ́si kekpine na limeyi lɛtɛdi lɛlɔ, na ɔ́ya na bekyuli bánu-nwu.

english_verse: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, ɔɔɔdi bekyuli ƒui nánu-nwu. Mmomu abu bani na ɔ́ƒuna ni, abu bɔ́nu-nwu. Na bɔ́di na bɔ́niku-nwu lɛnɔ na nwuna bɔsɔ bɔta kama.

english_verse: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Na abu na ɔ́tala ɔnii bɔsu litemi buni lɛmɛni na kesi kesii. Na budie kenye ka ni, Katɔti néti Yesu ɔ́bla bekpine ku bayawine ƒui litemi ɔtɛne.

english_verse: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti kenye bediene bénweni básiku-nwu lɛlɔ ka ukyuli biala ɔni maƒɔ-nwu madi ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ nwuna ekpidi udie-nwu lɛlɔ na anwu Yesu lɛnyi kemmo.” Katɔti Kɔyu Kɔ́ƒɔ Bani Naaadi Yudaƒuɔ Lɛnɔ Lɛlɔ Kemmo

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔni na Petro unye ɔɔsu etemila amɛni ni, Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́yu na kɔ́ƒɔ bani nlie muunú Petro litemi mmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ kemmo!

english_verse: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.
translation_verse: Yudaƒuɔ baƒɔtaadine bani násiaku Petro bébo mmɔ ni, litemi lɛmɛni lítakɔsi na lɛ́bla-ma dɛye dɛye! Ɔsika Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́yu kubo bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ lɛnɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Now they were hearing Gentiles speaking unknown languages and praising God. Peter said,
translation_verse: Nsu balakana ɔkɔ bɔsia, ɔsika beenú ka beetemi adi lidu lidu na beemwi Blɔti. Amu na Petro úye ɔnini,

english_verse: “These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.”
translation_verse: “Ka báƒɔ Katɔti Kɔyu aani kalɛ na abu lɛnɔ bɔ́ƒɔ ni, bulakana buni bɔnii bulakpila-ma ntu.”

english_verse: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔ́ya na bákpila-ma ntu na Yesu Kristo lɛnyi kemmo. Ɔmɛni kama ni, bévele Petro banii ulie-ma kudɔ emeyi adi.

english_verse: The apostles and the followers in Judea heard that Gentiles had accepted God's message.
translation_verse: Uwi útetu asa na batalane ku baƒɔtaadine bakladi na Yudea bénu ka kadi bamba bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ lɛnɔ báƒɔ Blɔti litemi lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka Petro únwini úsie Yerusalem ni, Yudaƒuɔ baƒɔtaadine bani nkya mmɔ bátatunaku-nwu, na básu-nwu banini,

english_verse: they said, “You stayed in the homes of Gentiles, and you even ate with them!”
translation_verse: “Awɔ ábla unwi ku baƒɔ bani naaasiaku Yudaƒuɔ ala bɔtina, na bɛ́kya kɔnu bɛ́di na lɛkyami linwi kemmo!”

english_verse: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened:
translation_verse: Amu na Petro údie etemila amɛni ƒui kalɔ ɔ́tina-ma na ɔ́su ɔnini,

english_verse: I was in the town of Joppa and was praying when I fell sound asleep and had a vision. I saw heaven open, and something like a huge sheet held by its four corners came down to me.
translation_verse: “Uwi ɔni na nkya Yopa na mɔɔkpali katɔ ni, lɛ́nu ala budie bɔtina bɔdi. Mmɔ na lɛ́nu kɔdi bonwu kɔdi ka báda kuna ekpo ene na kɔ́si katɔ kúbayu.

english_verse: When I looked in it, I saw animals, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Bebuo lidu lidu ƒui bakya kɔdi bonwu kɔmɛni kemmo, bebuo bani mbo agyobi ku bebuo bani mɔɔkpɛ́ kalɔ ku baasɛ bekpidi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I heard a voice saying to me, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Na línu ka lɛdi lɛdi lɛɛsu-mi lɛnii, ‘Petro! Du bana akɔ ɔdi biala na akun.’

english_verse: But I said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: “Amu na lídie kenye nnini, ‘Oowo! Kudi kudii! Ńtakun lɛla lɛni na Yudaƒuɔ bukisi kudii.’

english_verse: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: “Nsu lɛdi lɛmɛni lɛ́sɔ lɛ́su lɛnini, ‘Lɛla lɛni na Katɔti úveli ɔ́bla kede kede ni, tasu anii liisé lɛlɔ.’

english_verse: Suddenly three men from Caesarea stood in front of the house where I was staying.
translation_verse: “Na uwi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kani ni, nkyuli ɛtɛ bani bátala banii bebetiku-mi besienku Kaesarea mmɔ bébeduo kaduli kani kemmo nli.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man
translation_verse: Amu na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́su-mi kɔnii nsiaku-ma nteesie, na ntayia. Mina banwani ɛku bamɛni básiaku-mi, na búsie bútéduo ɔnana ɔni nátala batu ɔ́kya-mi mɛni kudɔ.

english_verse: who told us that an angel had appeared to him. The angel had ordered him to send to Joppa for someone named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́su-bu kalɛ na Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina-nwu na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, ‘Wia Simon Petro.

english_verse: Then Peter would tell him how he and everyone in his house could be saved.
translation_verse: Na anwu matina kalɛ na wabla na awɔ ku ƒula kaduli bekyuli ƒui bɛdubɔkɛ bɔƒɔ.’

english_verse: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.
translation_verse: “Na ɔmɛni kama ni, líse kalɔ mɔɔsu-ma litemi buni lɛmɛni. Nsu asa na meduo litemi buni lɛmɛni ɔlati kemmo ni, Katɔti Kɔyu kúbo na kɔ́ƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui aani kalɛ na kɔ́ƒɔ abu lɛnɔ lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui na kalɔ kesekɔ!

english_verse: I remembered that the Lord had said, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Amu na líti kasusu lísienku uwi ɔni na Blɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, ‘Sɔsɔ ni, Yohane úti ntu ɔ́kpila bekyuli. Nsu ni, Katɔti ɔdubuti nwuna Kɔyu ɔkpila-mii.’

english_verse: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?
translation_verse: Na ka Unwoti néte bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ litela lɛmɛni aani kalɛ na úti úte-bu uwi ɔni na bɔ́ƒɔ Blɔti Yesu Kristo bɔ́di ni, naaakana Katɔti ulu butile.”

english_verse: When they heard Peter say this, they stopped arguing and started praising God. They said, “God has now let Gentiles turn to him, and he has given life to them!” The Church in Antioch
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bénu etemila amɛni ni, báda bana unyeƒi báya na bése kalɔ beemwi Unwoti. Na básu banini, “Sɔsɔ ni, Katɔti úte bekyuli bamba lɛnɔ kuƒi ka benwini bebo-nwu kudɔ na bakɛ ngba.” Antiokia Baƒɔtaadine Bémomo Bébu

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers had been scattered because of the terrible trouble that started when Stephen was killed. They went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, but they told the message only to the Jews.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na ala amɛni aalɛ́ ni, baƒɔtaadine bani nékeli na lɛbibo lɛni nébo-ma lɛlɔ na Steƒano bɔdu ɔsu ni, bésie bétédu Ƒoinike ku Kipro ku Antiokia lɛma kemmo. Na bakɛ baasu litemi buni lɛmmɔ, nsu ɔɔɔdi bekyuli ƒui, mmomu Yudaƒuɔ lɛti.

english_verse: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, baƒɔtaadine bani nási Kipro ku Kirene bésie Antiokia bátásu Blɔti Yesu lɛlɔ litemi béte Grikiƒuɔ.

english_verse: The Lord's power was with them, and many people turned to the Lord and put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Na ka Blɔti ɔyikun ɔkya-ma akɔ ɔsu ni, baƒɔtaadine bammɔ bémomo bébu.

english_verse: News of what was happening reached the church in Jerusalem. Then they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na baƒɔtaadine bani nkya Yerusalem bénu lɛla lɛni nébo na mmɔ ni, bátala Barnaba banii uteesie Antiokia.

english_verse: When Barnabas got there and saw how God had blessed them with undeserved grace, he was very glad. So he begged them to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Ka útéduo mmɔ na ɔ́nu kalɛ na Katɔti úbunku-ma ni, ebiti áda-nwu geen na ɔ́kya-ma ogya úbu ɔnii benye Blɔti kama kpakplaa ku bana kayi ƒui.

english_verse: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.
translation_verse: Barnaba ɔdi ukyuli ɔbuni ɔni mbo bɔƒɔtaadi, na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui. Nwuna kebunku ɔsu ni, baƒɔtaadine bammɔ bémomo bébu.

english_verse: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.
translation_verse: Amu na Barnaba úsie Tarso ɔnii utáwia Saulo na mmɔ.

english_verse: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ɔ́nu-nwu ni, úti-nwu úboku Antiokia na bana inyɔ ƒui bélie mmɔ lɛkwa limodi. Mmɔ na bakya baatina bekyuli pii ala. Amu na Antiokia mmɔ ni, bése kalɔ baalɔ baƒɔtaadine banii Kristoƒuɔ.

english_verse: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmɛni kani kemmo ni, Katɔti kenye bediene badi bási Yerusalem bébo Antiokia.

english_verse: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.
translation_verse: Amu na bana akɔ unwi ɔni baalɔ Agabo ni, ɔ́ta únye na Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun kemmo na ɔ́su ɔnii kɔka kubendi kɔdi kɔdubo kayawi ƒui lɛlɔ. Ɔmɛni úbebo uwi ɔni na Klaudio ɔɔdi lɛga.

english_verse: The followers in Antioch decided to send whatever help they could to the followers in Judea.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu baƒɔtaadine bamɛni bábla kasusu ka beyi ala bemene banwa bani nkya Yudea. Na bana akɔ ɔdi biala úte kalɛ na wakana.

english_verse: So they appointed Barnabas and Saul to take their gifts to the church leaders in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ka béyi ala amɛni ni, béti-nya béte Barnaba ku Saulo na béti bésienku Yudea baƒɔtaadine benengu bammɔ.

english_verse: At that time King Herod caused terrible suffering for some members of the church.
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Ɔga Herode úƒie baƒɔtaadine badi kalɛ na ɔdu-ma.

english_verse: He ordered soldiers to cut off the head of James, the brother of John.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́ya na békulo Yakobo lili ɔni ndi Yohane ɔnwani.

english_verse: When Herod saw that this pleased the Jewish people, he had Peter arrested during the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Na ka ɔ́nu ɔ́ti ka ebiti áda Yudaƒuɔ na lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla mɛni ɔsu ni, úƒie Petro lɛnɔ na uwi ɔni kemmo na baadi Bodobodo Ɔni Néteƒu Limeyi.

english_verse: He put Peter in jail and ordered four squads of soldiers to guard him. Herod planned to put him on trial in public after the festival.
translation_verse: Na béti-nwu bákya ɔtɔ kesii kani na bagyumanane ine akpa ene baavumanaku lɛlɔ na baagyumana-nwu. Herode kasusu ndi ka nka udie-nwu ute kadi na bana limeyi bamba lɛni baalɔ Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi bɔdi kama.

english_verse: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him. Peter Is Rescued
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bagyumanane bamɛni bágyumana-nwu na ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ kemmo kaduɛ. Nsu ni, baƒɔtaadine bákpali katɔ na bévele nwuna lili kpakplaa. Katɔti Údie Petro Ɔ́lɛku Kɔgba Kemmo

english_verse: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔni na Herode ɔ́kali ka ɔdubudie Petro ute kadi si kadi kégye ni, Petro ɔtɛ ɔɔlɛɛ na bagyumanane inyɔ ntɛ. Na bébo-nwu kɔgba báda-ma. Na bagyumanane babambadi benye baagyumana kayakun.

english_verse: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, “Quick! Get up!” The chains fell off his hands,
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, bukeye bɔdi búbewi ɔtɔ mmɔ. Na Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi úbenye Petro kudɔ. Amu na ɔ́lɛ-nwu kɔnu lɛmangba buɛɛ, na ɔ́gyila-nwu ɔnini, “Babla, na ata!” Na kɔgba kɔmmɔ kɔ́lɛ-nwu enu kúwi kalɔ.

english_verse: and the angel said, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, “Now put on your coat and follow me.”
translation_verse: Amu na ɔtu ɔmɛni ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ti ƒula lɛwu ku lɛgbanvuo kya.” Amu na Petro ɔ́bla lɛni. Na ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ti kɔdi bi lɛlɔ, na asiaku-mi.”

english_verse: Peter left with the angel, but he thought everything was only a dream.
translation_verse: Na Petro ɔ́ta ɔ́siaku-nwu, na ɔ́vi ɔ́lɛ ɔtɔ ɔmɛni kemmo. Uwi ɔmɛni ƒui kemmo ni, ɔ́kali ɔnii kɔna na uugyé.

english_verse: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.
translation_verse: Amu na bávi bálɛ kayakun kedeedi ku kanyɔdi lɛnɔ. Na ka bétédu lɛbuala kayakun kenengudi kani nkya késie ɔma kakɛ ni, aka ɔlatidi kálɛmi. Na bávi aka lɛnɔ. Na ka bésie anumi blii ni, Katɔti ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́da-nwu ɔ́nyonu.

english_verse: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, “I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.”
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, Petro úbati lɛla lɛni nébo. Na ɔ́su lɛlɔ ɔnini, “Sɔsɔ geen na ɔdi ka ni, Unwoti nátala ɔtu ɔmɛni ɔnii ubedie-mi ɔsiku Herode enu kemmo ku ala ani na Yudaƒuɔ baasusu ka badubɔbla-mi lɛnɔ kemmo!”

english_verse: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.
translation_verse: Na ka úti kasusu blii ni, ɔ́tɔlɔ úsie Maria ɔni ndi Yohane Marko uni kesii. Mmɔ na baƒɔtaadine pii bása bewi baakpali katɔ.

english_verse: Peter knocked on the gate, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer.
translation_verse: Amu ka únye kayakun kani nkya ulu kenye mmɔ ɔ́kpali ni, ulekubi ɔni baalɔ Rode úbo ɔnii ubalɛmi.

english_verse: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.
translation_verse: Na ka únu Petro lɛdi ɔ́ti ni, ebiti áda-nwu ávili! Útalɛmi ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ, mmomu úkeli úsie nwuna badi akɔ na útásu-ma ka Petro úbo unye kegbuta kama.

english_verse: “You are crazy!” everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, “It must be his angel.”
translation_verse: Nsu bátaƒɔ bátadi na básu-nwu banini, “Tabatɔlɔ-bu mɛni!” Amu na ɔ́mu unye kpakplaa ka sɔsɔ na ɔdi. Amu na básu lɛlɔ banini, “Ɔƒaalɛ nwuna ukpine nébo unye mmɔ.”

english_verse: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.
translation_verse: Amu na uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ƒui ni, Petro ɔ́mu unye uubó kegbuta kɔnu. Na ka bésie bátálɛmi na bánu-nwu ni, ebiti átakɔsi na áda-ma.

english_verse: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, “Tell James and the others what has happened.” After that, he left and went somewhere else.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́ya na bába lɛsɛ. Na ɔ́su-ma ala ani nébo ku kalɛ na Unwoti úbedie-nwu ɔ́lɛku ɔtɔ kemmo. Na ɔ́su-ma ɔnii basu Yakobo ku bakladi lɛla lɛni nálɛ. Ɔmɛni kama ni, ɔ́tɔlɔ mmɔ úsie kesii bamba.

english_verse: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.
translation_verse: Amu na kadi bugye kemmo ni, owogyo ubendi ɔdi ɔ́ƒɔ bagyumanane ɔtɔ katɛnkɔ mmɔ. Na béye lɛlɔ banii, “Wɛ geen na Petro ɔ́vi ɔƒɛni?”

english_verse: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while. Herod Dies
translation_verse: Amu uwi ɔni na Herode ɔ́wia Petro bɔyii kalɔ na útabla-nwu nwaa ni, ɔ́ya na bétéƒie bagyumanane leevu-ɛku bammɔ béboku. Na ɔ́tɛku-ma litemi na ɔ́du-ma kukpi kɔtɔ, na bádu-ma. Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, Herode ɔ́tɔlɔ Yudea úsie Kaesarea útélie mmɔ uwi ɔdi. Ɔga Herode Úkpi

english_verse: Herod and the people of Tyre and Sidon were very angry with each other. But their country got its food supply from the region that he ruled. So a group of them went to see Blastus, who was one of Herod's high officials. They convinced Blastus that they wanted to make peace between their cities and Herod,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ni, Herode úti kɔnyi kati kati kɔdi ɔ́kya Tiro ku Sidonƒuɔ. Amu na batu badi bási Tiro ku Sidon mmɔ bébo-nwu kudɔ banii babanu-nwu. Amu na békeli bátátua Blasto ɔni ndi Herode kaduli lɛlɔ ɔnune banii utévele Herode na ɔya na unwi bɔbla bubo bana lɛma inyɔ bɔmɛni ku Herode ntɛ. Ɔsika Herode kalɔ lɛlɔ na baakɛ́ bana adila taasiku.

english_verse: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.
translation_verse: Amu na limeyi lɛni na Ɔga Herode úte-ma ni, ɔ́kya nwuna agala na útélie nwuna lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na úse kalɔ ku butemi.

english_verse: The people shouted, “You speak more like a god than a man!”
translation_verse: Na nwuna butemi bɔwɔlɔ ni, bekyuli bamɛni bémwi-nwu ku bɔva na básu banini, “Unwoti Ɔyikune geen muutemi! Na ɔɔɔdi ukyuli ɔyawine!”

english_verse: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.
translation_verse: Kɔnakunwi ni, Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi úbo Herode ɔ́ƒiɛmi kalɔ, ɔsika anwu úteti bumwi útete Katɔti. Na beklubi béyi-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui, na úkpi.

english_verse: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Amu uwi ɔni na Barnaba ku Saulo báwɔlɔ bana kabla kani bátala-ma bɔbla ni, bénwini bási Yerusalem na béti Yohane ɔni mɔɔdi ɔti lɛnyi Marko bébunku lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The church at Antioch had several prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon, also called Niger, Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen, who was Herod's close friend, and Saul.
translation_verse: Na Antiokia ni, Blɔti kenye bediene ku ala batinane badi bakya baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ kemmo. Na ama ndi Barnaba ku Simeon ɔni bátaalɔ Ukyuli Otondi ku Lukio ɔni nási Kirene ku Manaen ɔni ndi Ɔga Herode ɔvinkpana ɔ́si lɛnamu uwi ku Saulo.

english_verse: While they were worshiping the Lord and going without eating, the Holy Spirit told them, “Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do the work for which I have chosen them.”
translation_verse: Amu ka bakya beemwi Blɔti na beelie kɔka ni, Katɔti Kɔyu kútemiku-ma na kɔ́su kɔnini, “Bidie Barnaba ku Saulo bise bite kabla kani ɔsu na lɛ́lɔ-ma.”

english_verse: Everyone prayed and went without eating for a while longer. Next, they placed their hands on Barnabas and Saul to show that they had been appointed to do this work. Then everyone sent them on their way. Barnabas and Saul in Cyprus
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ka benengu bammɔ bélie kɔka na bákpali katɔ na bana lili ni, béti enu básia-ma lɛlɔ na bédie-ma ulu. Barnaba Ku Saulo Bésie Kipro

english_verse: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.
translation_verse: Na ka Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́tina-ma ulu ni, bésie ɔma ɔni baalɔ Seleukia. Mmɔ na béti ɔkɔlɔ bávia bésie ntuntɛ kalɔ kani baalɔ Kipro.

english_verse: They arrived at Salamis and began to preach God's message in the synagogues. They also had John as a helper.
translation_verse: Na ka bétéduo ɔma ɔni baalɔ Salami kemmo ni, bésie Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ bátásu Blɔti litemi. Na Marko Yohane lɛnɔ ɔ́siaku-ma aani bana ubunkune kalɛ.

english_verse: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni kama ni, bávi bétédu ɔma ɔni baalɔ Paƒo. Na mmɔ bátánu Yudani ɔni mɔɔƒɛ evo na úti lɛlɔ ɔ́bla ɔkɔ kenye udiene ɔni baalɔ Bar-Yesu.

english_verse: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.
translation_verse: Na uvone ɔmɛni ku aban ɔgadine ɔnundane ɔni baalɔ Sergio Paulo badi bakpana. Na ɔgadine ɔmɛni ɔ́lɔ Barnaba ku Saulo ɔnii bebo babanu-nwu, ɔsika ɔɔwia ka unu Blɔti litemi.

english_verse: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nsu ka bésie ni, uvone ɔmmɔ ɔni na baalɔ lɛnɔ banii Elima na Griki lɛdi kemmo ni, ɔ́kyaku-ma unyeƒi. Na ɔ́wia ka unwini ɔgadine ɔmɛni kasusu udie litemi lɛni na Saulo ku Barnaba baasu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and said, “You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?
translation_verse: Nsu Saulo ɔni lɛnɔ baalɔ banii Paulo ni, ɔ́nu uvone ɔmɛni ku livoƒi, na údie lɛdi ɔ́kya-nwu ku Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun ɔnini, “Awɔ Satan ubidi, éyi ku katɔlɔ ku lɛkwɛnkpi, na ekisi lɛbuni bɔbla, na aatu Blɔti litemi teenwini. Adubɔnuku-ni!

english_verse: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while.” Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔdubɔya na anumi abwɛ-ɔ, na asɔ alanu ɔƒɛ weti wetédu uwi ɔdi!” Mmɔ kani na nwuna anumi ábla suu, na ɔsɔ ulánu. Na úse kalɔ ɔɔka taamana mmɔ, na uuvele bekyuli ɔnii bada-nwu kɔnu.

english_verse: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord. Paul and Barnabas in Antioch of Pisidia
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na aban ɔgadine ɔmɛni ɔ́nu lɛla lɛmɛni ni, ɔ́bla-nwu kalɛ kadi, na ɔ́ƒɔ Blɔti litemi lɛmɛni ɔ́di. Barnaba Ku Saulo Bésie Antiokia Na Perge

english_verse: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Paulo ku bani nsiaku-nwu béduo ɔkɔlɔ kemmo na bátɔlɔ Paƒo bésie Perge ɔni nkya Pamƒilia. Mmɔ na Marko Yohane ɔ́da-ma ɔ́nyonu, na ɔ́sɔ únwini úsie Yerusalem.

english_verse: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.
translation_verse: Ka bási Perge ni, bátɔlɔ bésie Antiokia na Pisidia ɔmii lɛlɔ. Na lɛnwunameyi lɛlɔ ni, bésie Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ na betélie kalɔ na bekyuli bammɔ akɔ.

english_verse: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, “Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.”
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na báka ala básiku Mose ɔda bubo ɔku ku Katɔti Kenye bediene bunweni kemmo bawɔlɔ ni, kasalakɔ batɔnkune bammɔ básu banini, “Banwa, si bina akɔ ɔdi ubo litemi lɛni mɔɔkya ɔkplu na wasu ni, na ubo ubasu.”

english_verse: Paul got up. He motioned with his hand and said: People of Israel, and everyone else who worships God, listen!
translation_verse: Amu na Paulo ɔ́ta na ɔ́talaku kɔnu na ɔ́su-ma ɔnii baba lɛsɛ, na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Israelƒuɔ ku amii bani naaadi Israelƒuɔ ƒui na bɛnii bɛɛbu Katɔti ni, bise atu na binu!

english_verse: The God of Israel chose our ancestors, and he let our people prosper while they were living in Egypt. Then with his mighty power he led them out,
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔni na Israelƒuɔ baabu ni, ɔ́ƒuna bula bati kuuku na úte-ma kusɛ kusɛ. Na anwu ɔlati ɔ́tɔnku-ma ɔ́lɛku bekyuli kalɔ bɔkya kemmo na Egyipte ku nwuna ɔyikun.

english_verse: Make sure what the prophets have said doesn't happen to you. They said,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛnu kaduɛ! Bitaya na Katɔti kenye bediene etemila ani básu alɛku-mii.

english_verse: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to our people.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́kyula kɔlɔ akpa maatɛ bekyuli na Kanaan, na úti bana kɔlɔ kɔmɛni úte Israelƒuɔ aani bana kadikɔ.

english_verse: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, “David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.”
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti ɔ́da-nwu údie liboku lɛlɔ na úti Dawid úse lɛgaboku lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Dawid ɔmɛni ɔdi ukyuli ɔni lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, ‘Lɛ́ƒuna Yese ubidi Dawid líse. Ɔdi ukyuli ɔni na mina kayi kaayɔ́, ɔsika anwu ɔdubɔbu-mi.’

english_verse: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.
translation_verse: “Na ɔ́si Dawid kaba kemmo ni, Katɔti údie Ɔƒɔne ɔni ndi Yesu úte Israelƒuɔ aani kalɛ na úse-bu kenye.

english_verse: But before Jesus came, John was telling everyone in Israel to turn back to God and be baptized.
translation_verse: Na asa na Yesu webo ni, Ntu Ɔkpilane Yohane úbo úbasu ukyuli biala ka unwini kama ɔkya nwuna ekpidi na uti anumi ɔsia Katɔti lɛlɔ na bakpila-nwu ntu.

english_verse: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, “Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yohane kabla kadaku kawɔlɔkɔ budu ni, úye ɔnii, ‘Bɛɛbu ka ami ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ? Oowo! Nsu ni, ɔkpɛ-mi kama ɔdubo, na ami ńtedu ka lɛbla kabla kadi lite-nwu muedi.’

english_verse: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.
translation_verse: “Banwa, amii bani ndi Abraham bebi ku amii bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ nsu bɛɛbu Katɔti ni, bɔƒɔ bɔmɛni búse búte bula ƒui!

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem and their leaders didn't realize who Jesus was. And they didn't understand the words of the prophets they read each Sabbath. So they condemned Jesus just as the prophets had said.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nkya Yerusalem ku bana benengu bátanu Yesu bátati banii anwu ndi Ɔƒɔne ɔmmɔ. Nsu na nwuna bɔdu kemmo ni, báya na Katɔti kenye bediene linyese lɛni na baaká na lɛnwunameyi biala lɛlɔ líbo lɛni.

english_verse: They did exactly what the Scriptures said they would. Even though they couldn't find any reason to put Jesus to death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed. After Jesus had been put to death, he was taken down from the cross and placed in a tomb.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bábla ala ani na Katɔti Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su na nwuna kukpi lɛlɔ báwɔlɔ ni, bámami-nwu básiku ugyii lɛlɔ bátáva na kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo.

english_verse: But God raised him from death!
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti ɔ́gyila-nwu ɔ́lɛku kekpine na ɔ́sɔ úbo uli ngba.

english_verse: Then for many days Jesus appeared to his followers who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. Now they are telling our people about him.
translation_verse: Emeyi ammɔ kemmo ni, bekyuli bani na anwu ku-ma bási Galilea bésie Yerusalem ni, bánu-nwu uwi pii. Na ama ndi bekyuli bani muudie-nwu kenye na Israelƒuɔ anumi.

english_verse: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, “I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.”
translation_verse: Na Katɔti úse kenye úse ɔnii wagyila-nwu wasiku kekpine na wasɔ webelie ngba na ɔsɔ ulekpi kudii. Bénweni ɔmɛni bákya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo na kesii kani na Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “ ‘Ndubute-ɔ kusɛ kusɛ kedee ɔni na líse kenye ka mete Dawid.’

english_verse: And in another psalm it says, “God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su na Dawid kɔgya kɔbambadi kemmo lɛnɔ ɔnini, “ ‘Aláya na ƒula ukyuli kedee ɔmɛni webu na kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo.’

english_verse: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.
translation_verse: “Litemi lɛmɛni lɛɛɛdanku Dawid, ɔsika úlie ɔ́bla Unwoti kabla na nwuna ngba bulie uwi ƒui aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔlati ɔɔyɔ́, na úbekpi na báva-nwu na úbu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́gyila ɔ́siku kekpine anwu ni, nwuna ɔlɔna útebu.

english_verse: My friends, the message is that Jesus can forgive your sins! The Law of Moses could not set you free from all your sins.
translation_verse: “Banwa, binu! Na Yesu ɔmɛni lɛnyi kemmo ni, Katɔti ɔdubuti bina ekpidi ɔkyiɛ-mii.

english_verse: “Look, you people who make fun of God! Be amazed and disappear. I will do something today that you won't believe, even if someone tells you about it!”
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “ ‘Amii bani naaabu mina litemi ni, bɛnu kaduɛ! Ɔsika ndubo lɛla lɛdi bɔbla na bina uwi lɛni na si ina bínu ka baasu-ni muedi ni, biláƒɔ biladi.’ ”

english_verse: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people begged them to say more about these same things on the next Sabbath.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bási baalɛ kasalakɔ mmɔ ni, bekyuli bamɛni básu Paulo ku Barnaba banii si ɔbla na basɔ bebo bebetemi bete-ma na lɛnwunameyi lɛni nsia lɛlɔ.

english_verse: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Na ka bégyingya ni, Yudaƒuɔ pii ku bani nénwini Yudaƒuɔ na baayia Katɔti na kasalakɔ mmɔ básiaku Paulo ku Barnaba, na bákɛ beenú batalane bamɛni bɔlɛ ka benye lɛƒɔndia lɛni na Katɔti úti uute-ma mɛni kemmo kpakplaa.

english_verse: The next Sabbath almost everyone in town came to hear the message about the Lord.
translation_verse: Lɛnwunameyi lɛni násia lɛmmɔ kama ni, kebu blii nka ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo bekyuli ƒui bésie kasalakɔ mmɔ béténu Blɔti litemi lɛni na baasu.

english_verse: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na Yudaƒuɔ benengu bánu bekyuli lisu lɛni nébo kasalakɔ mmɔ ni, anumi égyie-ma, na bákyaku Paulo unyeƒi na bédumi-nwu.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Amu na Paulo ku Barnaba bése kayi na básu-ma banini, “Ɔlɛka bɔsu Katɔti litemi buni lɛmɛni buti bute Yudaƒuɔ kudeedi. Na ka bíni litemi lɛmɛni na bɛ́su bɛnii bilayɔ ngba bɔƒɔ bɔmɛni ɔsu ni, búti-ni búselaku bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has given us this command, “I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ndi bɔkada bɔni na Katɔti úti úte-bu ɔnii, “ ‘Lɛ́bla-mii aani bukeye líte bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ kalɛ na biti bɔƒɔ biboku kayawi ɔkɔkɔ biala.’ ”

english_verse: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Amu ka bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ bénu lɛla lɛni básu mmɔ ni, kubiti kɔ́da-ma, na bémwi Katɔti. Na bani ƒui na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna úte ngba bɔƒɔ ni, bénwini baƒɔtaadine.

english_verse: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti litemi lígyingya lɛ́kya kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders went to some of the important men in the town and to some respected women who were religious. They turned them against Paul and Barnabas and started making trouble for them. They even chased them out of this part of the country.
translation_verse: Amu na Yudaƒuɔ batɔnkune bénwini bekyuli badi kasusu na Paulo ku Barnaba lɛlɔ. Na beleku bani lɛlɔ mbo ɔbu ku ɔma benengu ƒui bétiku otogyi na báta békpoku-ma na bágya-ma bálɛku ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔni na baalɛ́ ɔma ɔmɛni kemmo ni, béveli bana lɛgba kalɔ ɔtumu béwi ɔma ɔmmɔ béti bátina ka ɔma ɔmmɔ bekyuli béni-ma. Ɔmɛni kama ni, bátɔlɔ bésie Ikonion.

english_verse: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Na bana kama basiakune ama ni, bákɛ lɛlɔyɔ básiku Katɔti Kɔyu kudɔ geen!

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue in Iconium, just as they had done at Antioch, and many Jews and Gentiles put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Amu ka bédu Ikonion lɛnɔ ni, Paulo ku Barnaba bésie kasalakɔ mmɔ. Na ka básu Yudaƒuɔ ku Grikiƒuɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ ni, bana akɔ pii báƒɔ bádi.

english_verse: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Amu na Yudaƒuɔ bani nátaƒɔ Blɔti litemi lɛmɛni bátadi ni, béti unyeƒi ɔdi bákya bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ ku Paulo ku Barnaba ntɛ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.
translation_verse: Nsu batalane bammɔ bákya ɔma ɔmɛni kemmo bétu uwi básu litemi buni lɛmɛni ku ogya. Na Blɔti lɛnɔ údie nwuna bɔyɔ ɔ́tina geen na akɔla pii ani na bábla kemmo.

english_verse: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo bekyuli béle akpa anyɔ, na badi básiaku Yudaƒuɔ kama, na badi lɛnɔ básiaku batalane bammɔ kama.

english_verse: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.
translation_verse: Ka bésie Listra ni, bátánu ɔnana ɔni náƒɛ uwi kalɔ ɔ́si uwi ɔni na báwɔ-nwu. Na útata útesie kudii.

english_verse: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man
translation_verse: Úlie mmɔ uunú litemi buni lɛni na Paulo unye ɔɔsu. Na ka Paulo ɔ́nu-nwu ɔ́ti kaduɛ ka ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di ka nwuna ɔlɛ ɔdubɔba-nwu ɔsu ni,

english_verse: and shouted, “Stand up!” The man jumped up and started walking around.
translation_verse: Paulo ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Ta nye ƒula lɛgba lɛlɔ!” Na ɔnana ɔmɛni úmi ɔ́ta na úse kalɔ ɔkɛ uusié.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us!”
translation_verse: Ka bekyuli bani nnye beenú litemi mɛni bánu lɛla lɛni na Paulo ɔ́bla ni, báva momoomo na Likaonia lɛdi kemmo básu banini, “Baƒiɔ badi! Bébo-bu kudɔ aani bekyuli kalɛ!”

english_verse: The people then gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and they gave Paul the name Hermes, because he did the talking.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu básia Barnaba lɛnyi banii Seus. Na básia Paulo lɛnɔ banii Herme, ɔsika anwu nnye muutemi.

english_verse: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.
translation_verse: Amu na Seus ɔkpane ɔni koƒiodu nde kabanye mmɔ ni, úti ɔmantɛ bakɔ ku anwula úboku ɔnii anwu ku kadi baakpá bete batalane bammɔ.

english_verse: When the two apostles found out about this, they tore their clothes in horror and ran to the crowd, shouting:
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na Paulo ku Barnaba bénu lɛla lɛni na báyɔ ka babla ni, báni bana lɛwu bábwɛ, ɔsika bátayɔ ka bekyuli bammɔ babla lɛni. Anwuɔsu békeli béduo bekyuli bammɔ akɔ. Mmɔ na báva

english_verse: Why are you doing this? We are humans just like you. Please give up all this foolishness. Turn to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: básu banini, “Ati bene, bi na bɛɛbla mɛni? Abu lɛnɔ bekyuli bayawine kani na bɔdi aani amii kalɛ. Búbo mɛni bɔnii buuti litemi buni lɛmɛni buboku-mii. Bɛda ala keeke amɛni udu kama bɔsiaku bɛya na binwini biteemwi Blɔti ɔni mbo ngba. Anwu nédie katɔ ku kalɔ ku ɛpu ku ala ani nkya-nya kemmo ƒui!

english_verse: In times past, God let each nation go its own way.
translation_verse: Kukuuku ni, údie bayawine ƒui atu na baabla lɛla lɛni na baayɔ́.

english_verse: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.
translation_verse: Nsu úteedie lɛlɔ taatina-bu na nwuna ala abuni bɔbla ani mɔɔtina ka ɔkya sɔsɔ. Na uwi ndi uwi ni, ubo lɛla lɛni muunyimene-bu na nwuna ala abuni lɛlɔ. Uute-bu ɔnantu uwi ndi uwi ku edula abuni ku adila ku ebiti lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: Even after Paul and Barnabas had said all this, they could hardly keep the people from offering a sacrifice to them.
translation_verse: Na ina ka básu ala amɛni ƒui ni, úde bekyuli bamɛni asa báda bana akpala amɛni buti bɔkpa bute-ma báya.

english_verse: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
translation_verse: Na Yudaƒuɔ badi bási Antiokia na Pisidia ɔmii lɛlɔ ku Ikonion bébo bábavumana bekyuli bamɛni kasusu, na báya bébo Paulo atabi na bákpɛ-nwu kalɔ bálɛku ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo, na bákali banii úkpi.

english_verse: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe. Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Nsu ka baƒɔtaadine bani nkya mmɔ bátáka bámana-nwu mmɔ ni, ɔ́ta na ɔ́sɔ únwini úbeduo ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na ka kadi kégye ni, anwu ku Barnaba bátɔlɔ bésie Derbe. Paulo Ku Barnaba Bénwini Bésie Antiokia Ɔni Nkya Siria

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas preached the good news in Derbe and won some people to the Lord. Then they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia.
translation_verse: Amu na bátásu litemi buni lɛmɛni na Derbe. Na ka bákɛ baƒɔtaadine badi na mmɔ ni, básɔ bénwini bésie Listra ku Ikonion ku Antiokia.

english_verse: They encouraged the followers and begged them to remain faithful. They told them, “We have to suffer a lot before we can get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bákya baƒɔtaadine bani nkya mmɔ ɔkplu banii benye kpakplaa na bana bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo. Na básu-ma lɛnɔ banini, “Ɔlɛka bubo abi pii asa na bɔkɛ lɛlɔyɔ na Blɔti lɛga bɔdi kemmo.”

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.
translation_verse: Amu na Paulo ku Barnaba lɛnɔ bédie batɔnkune béte baƒɔtaadine akpa akpa ƒui, na bákpali katɔ na bélie kɔka na béti-ma bákya Blɔti ɔni na báƒɔ bádi lɛkɔkɔ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia,
translation_verse: Na ka bási lɛma lɛni nkya Pisidia ni, básɔ bébo Pamƒilia kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia
translation_verse: Na básu litemi buni na Perge asa na bávi bésie Atalia.

english_verse: and sailed to Antioch in Syria. It was there that they had been placed in God's care for the work they had now completed.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na básia ntu anumi bávi bésie Antiokia, na béti-ma bákya Blɔti lɛkɔkɔ ute kabla kani na bábla báawɔlɔ.

english_verse: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.
translation_verse: Ka bánya bétéduo Antiokia ni, bálɔ baƒɔtaadine bani nkya mmɔ ƒui básala lisu na bédie bana ulu busie kemmo bátina-ma. Na básu-ma ala ani ƒui na Blɔti ɔ́kɛ-ma lɛlɔ ɔ́bla ku kalɛ na ɔ́lɛmi bɔƒɔtaadi ulu úte bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ.

english_verse: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.
translation_verse: Amu na bélie Antiokia baƒɔtaadine bamɛni kudɔ bétu uwi.

english_verse: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Paulo ku Barnaba bakya Antiokia ni, bekyuli badi bási Yudea bébo na bátina baƒɔtaadine bani nkya mmɔ ala básu banini, “Amu ntu ukyuli biala ɔ́ƒɔ lego bukulo ɔdi ɔmmɔ aani kalɛ na Mose ɔda bubo bɔɔtina asa na wakɛ bɔƒɔ.”

english_verse: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders. The Church Leaders Meet in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Nsu Paulo ku Barnaba ku bekyuli bamɛni báni litemi lɛmɛni bénene kaduɛ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, báya na baƒɔtaadine badi básiaku-ma na bésie Yerusalem kalɛ na ama ku baƒɔtaadine bani nkya Yerusalem mmɔ batátɛmi basiku ɔlɔna bukulo kɔtɛ kɔmɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka baƒɔtaadine bamɛni ƒui bésie-ma ulu bétédu kabanye ni, bátɔlɔ bésie Ƒoinike ku Samaria lɛma kemmo na bátávi baƒɔtaadine bani nkya mmɔ lɛlɔ. Na básu-ma ka ɔƒaani ni, ama bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ lɛnɔ béti lɛlɔ béte Blɔti. Na litemi lɛmɛni lɛ́ya na bana ƒui bákɛ ebiti geen.

english_verse: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.
translation_verse: Amu ka bétédu Yerusalem ni, baƒɔtaadine ku batalane ku bana benengu ƒui báƒɔ-ma kaduɛ. Na Paulo ku Barnaba béti bana ulu busie litemi báva-ma anumi ɔ́si ala ani ƒui na Katɔti ɔ́bla ɔ́kɛnku-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, “Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.”
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Ƒarisiƒuɔ lɛkpa lɛni nénwini kayi mmɔ badi báta bénye-ma akɔ na básu banii, “Ɔlɛka banwa bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ na bakya-bu akɔ mɛni lɛnɔ bekulo lego na basiaku Mose ɔda bubo kama.”

english_verse: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bana benengu ku batalane bátásala lisu na béti litemi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ kasusu.

english_verse: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.
translation_verse: Na kasalakɔ kamɛni kalɔ ni, uwi ɔni na báatɛmi na ala pii lɛlɔ ni, Petro ɔ́ta únye na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Banwa, amii alati bɛgyi ka Katɔti náƒuna-mi ɔ́siku bina akɔ ɔnii mbasu bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ lɛnɔ litemi buni lɛmɛni kalɛ na ama lɛnɔ baƒɔ badi.

english_verse: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔni ngyi bekyuli kɔyi kemmo ni, údie ɔ́tina ka ɔ́ƒɔ-ma na úte-ma nwuna Kɔyu aani kalɛ na úti úte abu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.
translation_verse: Útakya kavumana kadi na abu ku-ma ntɛ, ɔsika ɔ́ƒɔ-ma na bana bɔƒɔtaadi ɔsu. Na úti bana ekpidi ɔ́kyiɛ-ma aani abu kalɛ.

english_verse: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani ni, bi ɔsu na bɛɛkɔ́ku Blɔti lɛni? Abu ku bula bati kuuku bútakana etila amɛni udu buti! Bi ɔsu na biiti-nya taasia baƒɔtaadine bamɛni lɛlɔ?

english_verse: But we believe that we will be saved by the gift of undeserved grace from our Lord Jesus Christ, just as the Gentiles are.
translation_verse: Oowo! Bɔƒɔ bɔni na bɔ́ƒɔ bɔ́di ɔsu na Katɔti úti Blɔti Yesu kɔnyana bɔnu ɔ́ƒɔ-bu ngba aani kalɛ kani na ama lɛnɔ báƒɔ bádi.”

english_verse: Everyone kept quiet and listened as Barnabas and Paul told how God had given them the power to work a lot of miracles and wonders for the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Amu na bana ƒui báda butemi báya na bélie beenú akɔla ani na Paulo ku Barnaba baasu ka Blɔti ɔkɛ bana lɛlɔ ɔ́bla úte ama bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ.

english_verse: After they had finished speaking, James said: My friends, listen to me!
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ama báwɔlɔ ni, Yakobo lɛnɔ ɔ́ta únye na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Banwa, bɛkywɛ atu na binu.

english_verse: Simon Peter has told how God first came to the Gentiles and made some of them his own people.
translation_verse: Simon Petro únyimene-bu kudeedi kɔni na Katɔti údie nwuna bɔyɔ ɔ́tina bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ na ɔ́ƒuna bana akɔ badi.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will return and rebuild David's fallen house. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again.
translation_verse: “ ‘Nwuna kama ni, ndubɔsɔ libo na mbasɔku Dawid lɛga kadikɔ lise na lɛklibi ala ani néebie mmɔ, na asɔ atɛ kaduɛ.

english_verse: Then other nations will turn to me and be my chosen ones. I, the Lord, say this.
translation_verse: Mmɔ asa na bekyuli bani nébu ku ama bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ ƒui bani na lɛ́lɔ aani mina badi badubɔwia-mi kama ulu. Lɛni na Unwoti ɔni mɔɔbla ala amɛni ƒui ɔ́su úse.

english_verse: I promised it long ago.”
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔgyi nwuna ablala ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ ƒui.’

english_verse: And so, my friends, I don't think we should place burdens on the Gentiles who are turning to God.
translation_verse: “Anwuɔsu ami Yakobo mɔɔsu-mii ka bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ mɛni na béti lɛlɔ béte Katɔti ni, utalɛka butile-ma ala bɔgya.

english_verse: We should simply write and tell them not to eat anything that has been offered to idols. They should be told not to eat the meat of any animal that has been strangled or that still has blood in it. They must also not commit any terrible sexual sins.
translation_verse: Mmomu bɛya bunweni-ma ɔku na bada ala aani béti bákpa béte baƒiɔ na aayá na beesé lɛlɔ bɔbla baya ku kɔsɔnɔ bɔdi ku bebuo bani bélii-ma amɔ bádu bɔkun ku ubugya bɔni baya.

english_verse: We must remember that the Law of Moses has been preached in city after city for many years, and every Sabbath it is read in our synagogues. A Letter to Gentiles Who Had Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔ́si kuuku ni, ala ani na Mose únweni úse mɛni ni, anya na baaká na baasu na Yudaƒuɔ kasalakɔ na lɛnwunameyi biala na lɛma biala kemmo.” Bénweni Ɔku Béte Baƒɔtaadine Bani Naaadi Yudaƒuɔ

english_verse: The apostles, the leaders, and all the church members decided to send some men to Antioch along with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Silas and Judas Barsabbas, who were two leaders of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Amu na batalane ku benengu bani nábasa mmɔ ƒui bátuna, na bédie bekyuli badi banii basiaku Paulo ku Barnaba na besie Antiokia. Nkyuli inyɔ bani na bédie mmɔ badi baƒɔtaadine bammɔ benengu inyɔ. Ama ndi Yuda ɔni na basɔ baalɔ Barsaba ku Silas.

english_verse: They wrote a letter that said: We apostles and leaders send friendly greetings to all of you Gentiles who are followers of the Lord in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Na ɔku ɔni na bada bésienku mmɔ kemmo etemila aasu anii, Ɔmɛni ɔ́si abu batalane ku benengu ku banwa bani nkya Yerusalem kudɔ. Bɔnii buugyele amii banwa bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ na bɛ́si Antiokia ku Siria ku Kilikia.

english_verse: We have heard that some people from here have terribly upset you by what they said. But we did not send them!
translation_verse: Búnu ka baƒɔtaadine badi bási bula akɔ mɛni, na bébo mmɔ bábakyaku-mii unyeƒi na bula Yudaƒuɔ ɔlɔna bukulo ɔdi lɛlɔ. Nsu ni, bútatala-ma bɔnii babasu-mii ala amɛni udu.

english_verse: We are also sending Judas and Silas, who will tell you in person the same things that we are writing.
translation_verse: Yuda ku Silas ni, ama lɛnɔ badubɔsu-mii ala ani na búnweni mɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit has shown us that we should not place any extra burden on you.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔdi Katɔti Kɔyu lɛƒɔyɔ ku abu lɛnɔ ka utalɛka buti Yudaƒuɔ ɔda bubo etila butile-mii bɔgya butulo ala amɛni.

english_verse: But you should not eat anything offered to idols. You should not eat any meat that still has the blood in it or any meat of any animal that has been strangled. You must also not commit any terrible sexual sins. If you follow these instructions, you will do well. We send our best wishes.
translation_verse: Bini ala ani na béti bákpa béte baƒiɔ ku ubugya bɔni ku bebuo bani na bélii-ma amɔ bádu bɔkun ku kɔsɔnɔ bɔdi. Si bɛda lɛlɔ lɛni ni, keyi kadubɔyɔku-mii. Bɛkya kpoo.

english_verse: The four men left Jerusalem and went to Antioch. Then they called the church members together and gave them the letter.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu batu bamɛni ƒui bátɔlɔ bésie Antiokia. Na bana mmɔ buduo ni, bálɔ baƒɔtaadine bamɛni ƒui na bábasa. Na béti ɔku ɔni bada básiku Yerusalem mmɔ béte-ma.

english_verse: When the letter was read, everyone was pleased and greatly encouraged.
translation_verse: Na ama bani nkya mmɔ ƒui bákɛ ebiti ɔ́si etemila ani na báka na ɔku ɔmmɔ kemmo ɔsu.

english_verse: Judas and Silas were prophets, and they spoke a long time, encouraging and helping the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Amu ka Yuda ku Silas ƒui badi Katɔti kenye bediene ɔsu ni, bédie ala kalɔ béte-ma bébu uwi gyɔlɔɔ, na bákya-ma ogya ku ɔyikun.

english_verse: The men from Jerusalem stayed on in Antioch for a while. And when they left to return to the ones who had sent them, the followers wished them well.
translation_verse: Amu ka bélie mmɔ emeyi alɛɛ adi ni, bédie Yuda ku Silas ulu ka basɔ benwini besie Yerusalem.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas stayed on in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached about the Lord. Paul and Barnabas Go Their Separate Ways
translation_verse: Amu na Paulo ku Barnaba básɔ bákya Antiokia mmɔ, na ama ku badi pii bakya baatina ala na baasu litemi buni lɛmmɔ. Paulo Ku Barnaba Bégyingyaku Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Sometime later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let's go back and visit the Lord's followers in the cities where we preached his message. Then we will know how they are doing.”
translation_verse: Amu na emeyi adi kama ni, Paulo ɔ́su Barnaba ɔnini, “Ya na bɔsɔ butánu bula banwa bani nkya lɛma lɛni kemmo na bɔ́su litemi buni lɛmɛni bɔ́vi, na bɔnu kalɛ na badaku.”

english_verse: Barnabas wanted to take along John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Barnaba ɔ́tuna na ɔ́wia ka nka utiku Yohane ɔni baalɔ Marko ɔda.

english_verse: But Paul did not want to, because Mark had left them in Pamphylia and had stopped working with them.
translation_verse: Nsu Paulo anwu útayɔ lɛni munu munu! Ɔsika uwi ɔni na ama ku-nwu bésie Pamƒilia ni, Marko Yohane útáda-ma ɔ́nyonu na mmɔ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas argued, then each of them went his own way. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus,
translation_verse: Amu na bana inyɔ bamɛni báni Marko Yohane lɛlɔ litemi lɛmɛni bénene laa ɔni náya na bégyingyaku lɛlɔ. Barnaba útiku Marko na básia ntu anumi na bátɔlɔ bésie Kipro.

english_verse: but Paul took Silas and left after the followers had placed them in God's care.
translation_verse: Nsu Paulo anwu útiku Silas, na baƒɔtaadine bani nkya mmɔ béti-ma bákya Blɔti lɛkɔkɔ na bátɔlɔ.

english_verse: They traveled through Syria and Cilicia, encouraging the churches.
translation_verse: Amu na bátásia Siria ku Kilikia na bákya baƒɔtaadine bani nkya mmɔ bene ɔkplu.

english_verse: Paul and Silas went back to Derbe and Lystra, where there was a follower named Timothy. His mother was also a follower. She was Jewish, and his father was Greek.
translation_verse: Amu na Paulo ku Silas bátɔlɔ bésie ɔma ɔni baalɔ Derbe, na bákɛ mmɔ bávi bésie Listra. Na mmɔ na bésie bátánu ɔƒɔtaadine ɔni baalɔ Timoteo. Na uni ɔdi Yudani, na anwu lɛnɔ ɔ́ƒɔ Kristo ɔ́di. Nsu ɔti ɔdi Grikini.

english_verse: The Lord's followers in Lystra and Iconium said good things about Timothy,
translation_verse: Na baƒɔtaadine bani ƒui nkya Listra ku Ikonion ni, baabu Timoteo kaduɛ.

english_verse: and Paul wanted him to go with them. But Paul first had him circumcised, because all the Jewish people around there knew that Timothy's father was Greek.
translation_verse: Anwu geen na Paulo ɔ́wia ka utiku na ɔsiaku-nwu. Anwuɔsu ɔ́bla-nwu Yudaƒuɔ ɔlɔna bukulo ɔdi, ɔsika Yudaƒuɔ bani nkya amadɔ mmɔ ƒui bagyi ka ɔti ɔdi Grikini.

english_verse: As Paul and the others went from city to city, they told the followers what the apostles and leaders in Jerusalem had decided, and they urged them to follow these instructions.
translation_verse: Na ka báta ni, bakɛ baaví lɛma lɛni ƒui kemmo, na baasu lɛla lɛni na Yerusalem benengu básu. Na básu-ma banii badi-nya lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The churches became stronger in their faith, and each day more people put their faith in the Lord. Paul's Vision in Troas
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bekyuli bammɔ bémomo bébu, na lɛni kani na bana bɔƒɔtaadi lɛnɔ bɔ́yu ɔkplu búbu. Paulo Ɔ́nu Budie Bɔtina Na Troa

english_verse: Paul and his friends went through Phrygia and Galatia, but the Holy Spirit would not let them preach in Asia.
translation_verse: Na nwuna kama ni, bávi bésie Ƒrigia ku Galatia, ɔsika Katɔti Kɔyu kútete-ma kuƒi ka basu litemi buni na Asia kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: After they arrived in Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not let them.
translation_verse: Na ka bétédu Misia ni, báwia ka batávi Bitinia kalɔ lɛlɔ. Nsu mɛni lɛnɔ ni, Katɔti Kɔyu kútatuna ka besie mmɔ.

english_verse: So they went on through Mysia until they came to Troas.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu básɔ bénwini básia Misia kalɔ na bétédu ɛpu kudɔ na ɔma ɔni baalɔ Troa.

english_verse: During the night, Paul had a vision of someone from Macedonia who was standing there and begging him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us!”
