translation_verse: Nsu na Katɔti kudɔ ni, ukyuli ɔni néteti anu útasia nwuna kabla lɛlɔ mmomu na úti nwuna anu ɔ́sia Katɔti lɛƒɔndia lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti ɔɔnu ukyuli ukpidi ɔmmɔ ka use siin.

english_verse: In the Scriptures David talks about the blessings that come to people who are acceptable to God, even though they don't do anything to deserve these blessings. David says,
translation_verse: Na Ɔga Dawid ɔ́su lɛni kani ka lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́nu ka use siin. Na ɔɔɔdanku nwuna kabla kani na ɔ́bla ɔsu. Dawid ɔ́su ɔnini,

english_verse: Are these blessings meant for circumcised people or for those who are not circumcised? Well, the Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.
translation_verse: Na lɛlɔyɔ lɛni lɛlɔ litemi na Dawid ɔ́su mɛni ni, bani nékulo ago kani ndubɔkɛ-ni? Kudii! Lɛdanku bani nétekulo ago lɛnɔ, ɔsika Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Abraham ɔ́ƒɔ Katɔti ɔ́di ɔsu na Katɔti ɔ́bu-nwu aani ukyuli ɔni use siin.”

english_verse: But when did this happen? Was it before or after Abraham was circumcised? Of course, it was before.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmani na Katɔti ɔ́nu-nwu ka use siin lɛni? Uwi ɔni kemmo na Abraham útekulo tɔ lego munuu uwi ɔni na úukulo lego? Ɔɔɔdi uwi ɔni na úkulo lego. Mmomu asa na wetékulo lego.

english_verse: Abraham let himself be circumcised to show he had been accepted because of his faith even before he was circumcised. This makes Abraham the father of all who are acceptable to God because of their faith, even though they are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Lego bukulo ɔdi ɔni na Abraham ɔ́bla mɛni ni, anwu ndi likpo buse bɔni mɔɔtina ka Katɔti ɔ́ƒɔ-nwu. Ɔsika nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi náya na Katɔti ɔ́ƒɔ-nwu ka use siin asa na úkulo lego. Na bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmɛni ɔsu ni, Abraham únwini baƒɔtaadine ƒui ɔti. Na Katɔti ɔkɛnku Abraham lɛlɔ ɔ́ƒɔ-ma ka bese siin ina ka bétekulo tɔ lego muedi.

english_verse: This also makes Abraham the father of everyone who is circumcised and has faith in God, as Abraham did before he was circumcised. The Promise Is for All Who Have Faith
translation_verse: Abraham ɔdi ɔti ute bani na békulo ago lɛnɔ. Nsu ɔɔɔdi ɔni na békulo ago ɔsu, mmomu ka bélie ngba na bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo aani kalɛ na bula ɔti Abraham úlie asa na úkulo lego ɔsu. Katɔti Úse Kenye Úte Abraham

english_verse: God promised Abraham and his descendants that he would give them the world. This promise wasn't made because Abraham had obeyed a law, but because his faith in God made him acceptable.
translation_verse: Katɔti úse kenye úte Abraham ku nwuna bawɔ ka badubɔdi kayawi kamɛni ala. Nwuna kenye kani na úse mɛni kaaakɛnku kalɛ na Abraham ɔ́siaku ɔda bubo bɔdi kama ɔsu. Mmomu ni, úse-nwu kenye kamɛni ɔsika ɔ́ƒɔ Abraham ka use siin ɔkɛnku nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi ɔsu.

english_verse: If Abraham and his descendants were given this promise because they had obeyed a law, then faith would mean nothing, and the promise would be worthless.
translation_verse: Na si kayawi kamɛni ala bɔdi linyese lise lite bekyuli bani mɔɔdi ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni, na bɔƒɔtaadi bɔɔɔdi lɛla lɛdi. Na Katɔti linyese lɛdi kɔtɛ keeke.

english_verse: God becomes angry when his Law is broken. But where there isn't a law, it cannot be broken.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔda bubo buudie Katɔti kɔnyi taatina-bu. Nsu si ɔda bubo buuubo ni, ukyuli lɛla lɛdi lilédie bula bɔƒiɔ taatina-bu.

english_verse: Everything depends on having faith in God, so that God's promise is assured by his gift of undeserved grace. This promise isn't only for Abraham's descendants who have the Law. It is for all who are Abraham's descendants because they have faith, just as he did. Abraham is the ancestor of us all.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, linyese lɛmɛni lɛdanku bɔƒɔtaadi, na ɔdi kama kekpokɔ ute bekyuli na Katɔti kaƒɔbuni kani na ɔ́bla bekyuli bani ƒui ndi Abraham bawɔ. Na ɔɔɔdi bani na Katɔti úte ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛti pɛ ndi-nwu bawɔ. Mmomu bani nsiaku Abraham bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ kama lɛnɔ. Ɔsika ni, Abraham ɔdi baƒɔtaadine ƒui ɔti.

english_verse: The Scriptures say that Abraham would become the ancestor of many nations. This promise was made to Abraham because he had faith in God, who raises the dead to life and creates new things.
translation_verse: Na lɛni na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔnini, “Líti-ɔ lɛ́bla kadi bekyuli pii ɔti.” Na Abraham ndi bula ɔti ɔni náƒɔ ɔ́di na Katɔti anumi. Katɔti ɔyikun ɔni na úbo ɔsu ni, ɔ́gyila bekpine na básɔ bébo beli ngba. Na ɔkɛnku ɔyikun ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, útemi na ala ani nátakya kudii áda álɛ!

english_verse: God promised Abraham a lot of descendants. And when it all seemed hopeless, Abraham still had faith in God and became the ancestor of many nations.
translation_verse: Kesii kani na lɛnunsia liiibo muedi ni, Abraham únye bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ kpakplaa. Anwuɔsu úbabla kadi bekyuli pii ɔti aani kalɛ na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ƒula bawɔ lɛnɔ badubo bumomo lɛni kani.”

english_verse: But Abraham never doubted or questioned God's promise. His faith made him strong, and he gave all the credit to God.
translation_verse: Nsu ala amɛni átaƒɛ-nwu enu na nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo. Mmomu úƒie Katɔti linyese ɔ́da kpakplaa, na nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmɛni bɔ́kya-nwu ɔkplu na úti bumwi úte Katɔti.

english_verse: Abraham was certain that God could do what he had promised.
translation_verse: Na ɔgyi nwaa ka Katɔti ubo ɔyikun na ɔbla lɛla lɛni na ɔ́su úse.

english_verse: just as we read in the Scriptures. But these words were not written only for Abraham.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi anwu lɛti pɛ lɛlɔ bénweni etemila amɛni basiku banii, “Katɔti ɔ́nu-nwu ka use siin.”

english_verse: They were written for us, since we will also be accepted because of our faith in God, who raised our Lord Jesus to life.
translation_verse: Mmomu ɔdanku abu bani lɛnɔ na Katɔti ɔdubɔnu ka buse siin ɔkɛnku kalɛ na bɔ́ƒɔ Katɔti ɔni nágyila Blɔti Yesu ɔ́lɛku kekpine mmɔ bɔ́di lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God gave Jesus to die for our sins, and he raised him to life, so that we would be made acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Katɔti úte kuƒi na bekyuli bádu Kristo ɔ́si bula ekpidi ani bɔ́bla ɔsu. Na Katɔti ɔ́gyila-nwu ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ kalɛ na Katɔti ɔnu ka buse siin.

english_verse: By faith we have been made acceptable to God. And now, thanks to our Lord Jesus Christ, we have peace with God.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, ka Katɔti ɔ́bla-bu siin ɔkɛnku bula bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, Katɔti úte-bu keyi buɛɛ ɔkɛnku Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Christ has also introduced us to God's gift of undeserved grace on which we now take our stand. So we are happy, as we look forward to sharing in the glory of God.
translation_verse: Na ka bɔ́ƒɔ Kristo bɔ́di ɔsu ni, ɔ́ya na bɔ́kɛ Katɔti lɛƒɔndia lɛni kemmo na bɔkya ɔƒɛni. Na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-bu geen, ɔsika bubo lɛnunsia ka bɔdubulieku Kristo na Katɔti lɛgadi bukeye bɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: But that's not all! We gladly suffer, because we know that suffering helps us to endure.
translation_verse: Na lɛnɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-bu si buubó abi, ɔsika bɔgyi ka lɛbibo lɛmɛni udu lɛɛyá na buunye kpakplaa.

english_verse: And endurance builds character, which gives us a hope
translation_verse: Na bula bunye kpakplaa ni, bɔɔyá na bɔɔkɛ́ udu ɔbuni. Na ɔmmɔ ndubɔya na bɔkɛ lɛnunsia.

english_verse: that will never disappoint us. All of this happens because God has given us the Holy Spirit, who fills our hearts with his love.
translation_verse: Na lɛnunsia lɛmɛni liláya bula anumi ewi kalɔ. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔkɛnku nwuna Kɔyu kɔni na úte-bu lɛlɔ na ɔ́ya na nwuna bɔyɔ bɔ́ƒɔ-bu lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: No one is really willing to die for an honest person, though someone might be willing to die for a truly good person.
translation_verse: Ubo ɔkplu ka ukyuli ɔdi ukpi na ukyuli ɔni nse siin lili. Nsu ɔƒaalɛ ukyuli ɔdi ɔkana na use kayi na ukpi na ukyuli ɔbuni lili.

english_verse: But God showed how much he loved us by having Christ die for us, even though we were sinful.
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti údie ɔ́tina-bu kaduɛ kalɛ na ɔɔyɔ́-bu. Ɔsika uwi ɔni na bɔkya bula ekpidi kemmo ni, ɔ́ya na Kristo úkpi na bula lili.

english_verse: But there is more! Now that God has accepted us because Christ sacrificed his life's blood, we will also be kept safe from God's anger.
translation_verse: Na si ɔkɛnku nwuna kukpi kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu na bɔ́bla siin na Katɔti anumi ni, kukpi kɔmmɔ kɔdubudie-bu kɔlɛku Katɔti kɔnyi bonwu kemmo utulo!

english_verse: Even when we were God's enemies, he made peace with us, because his Son died for us. Yet something even greater than friendship is ours. Now that we are at peace with God, we will be saved by the life of his Son.
translation_verse: Na si Katɔti ɔ́sɔku abu ku-nwu ntɛ ɔ́klibi ɔkɛnku ubidi kukpi lɛlɔ na uwi ɔni kemmo na nka bɔdi-nwu bekisine mmɔ ni, na uwi ɔni na abu ku-nwu ntɛ bɔdia mɛni ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔnu-bu kɔnyana utulo ƒui na bɔkɛ ngba bɔƒɔ ɔkɛnku Kristo ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: And in addition to everything else, we are happy because God sent our Lord Jesus Christ to make peace with us. Adam and Christ
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi ɔmɛni lɛti, mmomu lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-bu geen na Katɔti lɛlɔ ɔkɛnku Blɔti Yesu Kristo ɔni lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔ́sia na ɔ́sɔku abu ku-nwu ntɛ ɔ́klibi ɔsu. Kavumana Kadi Kakya Adam Ku Kristo Ntɛ

english_verse: Adam sinned, and that sin brought death into the world. Now everyone has sinned, and so everyone must die.
translation_verse: Likpidi lɛ́sia ukyuli unwi lɛlɔ na líbo kayawi, na likpidi lɛmmɔ lɛdanku kukpi líboku kayawi. Ɔmɛni ɔsu kukpi kúbo ukyuli biala lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ukyuli biala ɔ́bla likpidi.

english_verse: Sin was in the world before the Law came. But no record of sin was kept, because there was no Law.
translation_verse: Likpidi lɛkya kayawi kemmo asa na Katɔti úte-bu Mose ɔda bubo. Nsu kesii kani na ɔda bubo buuubo ni, Katɔti ulábu ukyuli bɔƒiɔ teese.

english_verse: Yet death still had power over all who lived from the time of Adam to the time of Moses. This happened, though not everyone disobeyed a direct command from God, as Adam did. In some ways Adam is like Christ who came later.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔ́si Adam uwi úbalɛ Mose uwi ni, kukpi kɔ́di bayawine ƒui lɛlɔ ku bani na bátabla likpidi lɛdi muedi aani kalɛ na Adam útadi Katɔti ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Na Adam ɔmɛni unye ute ukyuli ɔni mebo.

english_verse: But the gift of God's undeserved grace was very different from Adam's sin. That one sin brought death to many others. Yet in an even greater way, Jesus Christ alone brought God's gift of undeserved grace to many people.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, bana inyɔ beeese unwi. Ɔsika Katɔti lɛƒɔndia lɛni na ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔdanku liiise aani ala ani na Adam bɔƒiɔ bɔmmɔ bɔdanku. Adam ɔdi ukyuli unwi ɔni bɔƒiɔ ɔsu na bekyuli pii békpi. Nsu Katɔti ɔdubɔya na ngba bɔƒɔ lɛƒɔndia lɛni nkɛnku Yesu unwi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ libo lite bekyuli pii litulo na nwuna kaƒɔ buni ɔsu.

english_verse: There is a lot of difference between Adam's sin and God's gift. That one sin led to punishment. But God's gift made it possible for us to be acceptable to him, even though we have sinned many times.
translation_verse: Nsɔ mɔɔsu ka Katɔti lɛƒɔndia lɛmmɔ liiise aani ala ani nkɛnku likpidi lɛni na ukyuli unwi ɔmmɔ ɔ́bla. Ɔsika likpidi lɛmmɔ líboku litemi bɔtɛ ku kɔtɔ bɔdu. Nsu bɔƒiɔ pii bɔmmɔ kama ni, Yesu lɛƒɔndia lɛmmɔ lɛ́ya na bekyuli bábla siin.

english_verse: Death ruled like a king because Adam had sinned. But that cannot compare with what Jesus Christ has done. God has treated us with undeserved grace, and he has accepted us because of Jesus. And so we will live and rule like kings.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku ukyuli unwi lɛlɔ ɔsu na kukpi kɔ́di bekyuli lɛlɔ ɔ́si ukyuli ɔmmɔ likpidi ɔsu. Anwuɔsu ɔkɛnku Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ ni, bekyuli bani ƒui nákɛ Katɔti lɛƒɔndia na ɔ́bla-ma siin badubuduo ngba bɔwɔdi bɔmmɔ lɛga bɔdi kemmo butulo ƒui.

english_verse: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, kalɛ kani na ɔkɛ likpidi linwi lɛlɔ na bekyuli ƒui bákɛ kɔtɔ bɔdu ni, lɛni kani na ɔkɛ lɛbuni linwi lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔdubute bekyuli ƒui ubo.

english_verse: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku kalɛ na ukyuli unwi ɔmmɔ ɔ́ta únye Katɔti litemi lɛlɔ na bekyuli ƒui bénwini alaekpidi bablane ni, lɛni kani na Katɔti ɔkɛnku kalɛ na ukyuli unwi ɔ́di nwuna litemi lɛlɔ ɔsu na Katɔti ɔdubɔya na bekyuli pii babla siin.

english_verse: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.
translation_verse: Ka ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ búbo ni, bɔ́ya na bekyuli bánu bana ekpidi báti bébu. Na si bɔ́nu bula alaekpidi pii ani na bɔ́bla bɔ́ti ni, mmɔ kani na bɔdubɔnu Katɔti kɔnyana kɔni na ubo úte-bu lɛnɔ bɔti bubu.

english_verse: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu kalɛ na likpidi lɛ́ya na kukpi kɔ́di bekyuli lɛlɔ ni, lɛni kani na Katɔti lɛƒɔndia lɛdubɔya na bɔbla siin na buduo ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubɔsa kudii lɛga bɔdi kalɔ ɔkɛnku Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bi na ɔdi ka bɔsu? Buusié anumi butaabla likpidi kalɛ na Katɔti lɛƒɔndia limomo libu?

english_verse: No, we should not! If we are dead to sin, how can we go on sinning?
translation_verse: Oowo! Kudii! Ɔsika búkpi, na likpidi lɛsɔ liládi-bu lɛlɔ! Na bi ɔsu na ɔ́sɔ ɔlɛka bulie butaabla ala ekpidi?

english_verse: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bákpila-bu ntu ɔkɛnku Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ na abu ku-nwu bɔ́bla unwi ni, bɛgyi ka ntu bɔni na bákpila-bu mmɔ bɔ́ya na bɔ́blaku-nwu unwi útédu nwuna kukpi kemmo lɛnɔ.

english_verse: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku ntu bɔkpila bɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, ɔɔtina ka abu lɛnɔ búkpi na báva abu ku-nwu. Na Katɔti ɔkɛnku nwuna bukeye ku ɔyikun lɛlɔ ɔ́gyila Kristo ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ kalɛ na abu lɛnɔ bɔta bubelieku-nwu ngba bɔwɔdi bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: If we shared in Jesus' death by being baptized, we will be raised to life with him.
translation_verse: Na si abu ku-nwu bɔ́bla unwi na nwuna kukpi kemmo ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔya na bɔblaku-nwu unwi na nwuna bɔsɔ bɔta kemmo.

english_verse: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.
translation_verse: Na bɔgyi ka bula udu ɔkukudi ɔmmɔ ku Kristo na bákana bámana ugyii lɛlɔ kalɛ na likyulikpi lɛyii udu na bula lɛlɔ, na bula ɔlɔna ɔsɔ ulenye ulátaabla likpidi kabla.

english_verse: We know sin doesn't have power over dead people.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si ukyuli úkpi ni, likpidi lɛsɔ liiibo ɔyikun ɔdi na nwuna lɛlɔ.

english_verse: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.
translation_verse: Na si abu ku Kristo búkpi ni, bɔɔƒɔ́ taadi ka abu ku-nwu bɔdubulie ngba.

english_verse: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.
translation_verse: Na bɔgyi ka Katɔti ɔ́gyila Kristo ɔ́lɛku kekpine ɔni na ɔsɔ ulekpi. Na kukpi kɔsɔ kuuubo ɔyikun ɔdi na nwuna lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.
translation_verse: Kristo kukpi kɔni na úkpi ni, úkpi kunwi pɛ na likpidi lɛsɔ liládi-nwu lɛlɔ. Na ngba bɔni na uli ɔƒɛni ni, uli-mu úte Katɔti.

english_verse: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.
translation_verse: Na lɛni kani na ɔlɛka amii lɛnɔ bitaanu lɛlɔ ka bíkpi na likpidi lɛsɔ liládi-mii lɛlɔ. Na ɔlɛka bilie ngba bite Katɔti na amii ku Kristo Yesu unwi bɔbla kemmo.

english_verse: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bitaya na likpidi lɛdi bina ɔlɔna ɔni ndubukpi mɛni lɛlɔ, kalɛ na bilanyonu lɛlɔ bilete ɔlɔna ɔkwɛ adala ekpidi.

english_verse: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.
translation_verse: Iye bitete kuƒi na likpidi lɛƒɔ bina ɔlɔna kemmo kesii biala na bitaabla likyulikpi. Mmomu biti bina lɛlɔ bite Katɔti aani bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔ́gyila ɔ́lɛku kukpi kemmo úboku ngba kemmo. Na bɛnyonu bina lɛlɔ ekpo ƒui bite Katɔti aani ala ani nse siin na uti ɔbla nwuna kabla.

english_verse: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
translation_verse: Ɔsika likpidi liiibo ɔyikun na bina lɛlɔ ka biiibo ɔda bubo kalɔ ɔsu. Mmomu bɛkya Katɔti lɛƒɔndia kalɔ. Biti Lɛlɔ Bite Ala Siin Bɔbla

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Na bi na bɔdubo bɔsu? Ka bɔɔɔkya ɔda bubo kalɔ na Katɔti lɛƒɔndia kalɔ mmomu na bɔkya ɔsu ni, ɔlɛka butaabla ekpidi? Oowo. Kudii!

english_verse: Don't you know that you are slaves of anyone you obey? You can be slaves of sin and die, or you can be obedient slaves of God and be acceptable to him.
translation_verse: Bɛgyi geen ka ni, si bínu lɛlɔ kalɔ na bíti bina lɛlɔ bɛ́kya ukyuli ɔni kabla na bɛɛbla kalɔ ni, na bɛdi ukyuli ɔmmɔ kabla bablane. Anwuɔsu bɛkana binwini kabla bablane bite likpidi lɛni mɔɔkpanku ukyuli taatákya kukpi kemmo. Na bɛkana binwini kabla bablane bite lɛbuni lɛni mɔɔkpanku ukyuli taatákya siin bɔbla kemmo.

english_verse: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
translation_verse: Nsu bɔɔgyá Katɔti enu, ɔsika uwi ɔdi kemmo ni, bɛdi kabla bablane bite likpidi. Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, bíti bina kayi ƒui bɛɛdi litemi geen lɛni lɛ́tina-mii mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
translation_verse: Na bɛ́lɛ likpidi enu kemmo, na bínwini kabla bablane bíte ala siin bɔbla.

english_verse: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyɔ́ ka lɛsia kalɛ na bekyuli baatɛmi kenye na lidie ɔmɛni kalɔ lite-mii na ɔbla-mii kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. Na uwi ɔni nábavi kemmo ni, bɛ́nyonu lɛlɔ ƒui bíte alaekpidi bɔbla ku ala ani muusé lɛlɔ ku likyulikpi ala bɔbla. Lɛni kani na ɔlɛka biti lɛlɔ ƒui bite siin bɔbla na bɛbla kedee.

english_verse: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na bɛdi kabla bablane bite likpidi ni, siin bɔbla uládi-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
translation_verse: Na bi kɔsia na bɛ́kɛ bɛ́siku ala ani bɛ́bla bɛ́vi na eekpó-mii kɔƒa ɔƒɛni lɛlɔ? Ala ammɔ ƒui kɔsia ndi kukpi.

english_verse: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, bɛ́lɛ ekpidi enu kemmo na bɛ́kɛ bɔnwuna. Na bínwini Katɔti kabla bablane. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu kɔsia kɔni na bɛɛkɛ́ ndi ɔni na bíti lɛlɔ bíte-nwu ƒui na bɛɛbla kedee kalɛ na bɛkɛ ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii.

english_verse: Sin pays off with death. But God's gift is eternal life given by Jesus Christ our Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔsika likpidi lɛyuƒɔla ndi kukpi. Nsu Katɔti lɛƒɔndia lɛni na úte-bu ndi ngba bɔni naaadubo bɔsa kudii ɔkɛnku abu ku Kristo Yesu ɔni ndi Blɔti unwi bɔbla ɔsu.

english_verse: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.
translation_verse: Geen ni, banwa, binu lɛla lɛni na ndubo bɔsu mɛni kalɔ, ɔsika bina ƒui bɛgyi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ. Ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔɔdi ukyuli lɛlɔ uwi ɔni kemmo na ulie ngba kani.

english_verse: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free
translation_verse: Muuti ɔmɛni lɛtina-mii. Uleku ɔni nli kɔgya ni, ɔgya ku ule ɔda bubo búnyimi-nwu bɔ́mana ɔgyani lɛlɔ uwi ɔni na ɔnana ɔmmɔ uli ngba. Nsu si ɔnana ɔmmɔ úkpi ni, uleku ɔmmɔ ɔ́lɛ ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: to marry someone else. However, if she goes off with another man while her husband is still alive, she is said to be unfaithful.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si uleku ɔmɛni úsie útélieku ɔnana ɔbambadi uwi ɔni na ɔgyani ɔmu ulie ngba ni, bekyuli badubɔlɔ-nwu banii ɔsɔnɔdine. Nsu si ɔgyani ɔmɛni úkpi ni, ɔ́lɛ ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kalɔ. Na ubo kuƒi ka ulie kɔgya kɔbambadi ɔni na ɔɔɔdi ɔsɔnɔdine.

english_verse: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
translation_verse: Mina banwa, lɛni kani na use ute amii lɛnɔ. Ɔsika na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kenye ni, ɔɔtina aani si bíkpi uwi ɔni na Kristo úkpi. Na bɛkana bilieku ukyuli bamba. Anwuɔsu bínwini ukyuli ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́gyila ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ mmɔ kalɛ na bula kelie kalɛ ku ala abuni keyi ete Katɔti.

english_verse: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni kemmo na ɔda bubo búdie bula ukyuli udu ɔkukudi kelie kani ndanku likpidi bɔbla bɔ́tina-bu ni, ablala ammɔ ákɔ katɔ ébu. Na ala ani na bɔ́lɛku keyi na kelie kammɔ kemmo adanku kukpi.

english_verse: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, ka búkpi na bɔ́lɛ ala ani nényimi-bu mmɔ kalɔ ɔsu ni, ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔsɔ buládi-bu lɛlɔ. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bɔsɔ bulábla lɛla lɛdi na ulu ɔkukudi lɛlɔ. Mmomu ulu ɔwɔdi ɔni nkɛnku Katɔti Kɔyu lɛlɔ na bɔɔbla kabla. Ɔda Bubo Bɔ́ya Na Bɔ́ti Likpidi

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bi na ɔdi ka bɔsu? Bɔsu na bɔsu bɔnii Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔdi likpidi? Kudii! Geen ni, ɔkɛnku ɔda bubo bɔmɛni lɛlɔ na bɔɔtí lɛla lɛni ndi likpidi. Si ɔda bubo bɔmɛni bútasu bɔnii, “Taya na anumi egyie-ɔ na ukyuli ɔdi ala lɛlɔ” ni, na nka lɛɛɛgyi lɛla lɛni ndi lɛnungyie likpidi.

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, likpidi bɔbla bɔ́kɛ kuƒi ɔkɛnku ɔda bubo lɛlɔ na bɔ́ya na lɛnungyie lidu lidu lɛ́kɔ katɔ na mina lɛlɔ kemmo. Na si ɔda bubo bɔdi buuubo ni, likpidi bɔbla lɛnɔ búkpi.

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: Na ɔda bubo bɔni na nka bɔya na lɛkɛ ngba ni, amu néboku-mi kukpi mmomu.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Na bɔkɛnku ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni, likpidi bɔbla bɔ́kɛ ulu na bɔ́tɔlɔ-mii na bɔ́du-mi.

english_verse: Still, the Law and its commands are holy and correct and good.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ buse kedee, na ala ani na bɔɔtina lɛnɔ ese kedee, na asia ulu siin lɛlɔ, na adia.

english_verse: Am I saying something good caused my death? Certainly not! It was sin that killed me by using something good. Now we can see how terrible and evil sin really is.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɔtina na ɔmɛni ɔda ɔnii lɛla lɛni ndia néboku-mi kukpi? Kudii! Mmomu kalɛ na bɔnu likpidi bɔbla bɔti ka bɔdi likpidi ɔsu ni, likpidi bɔbla bɔkɛnku lɛla lɛni ndia lɛlɔ na búti kukpi búboku-mi. Na ɔkɛnku ɔda bubo bɔmɛni lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, likpidi bɔbla buudie muna udu geen keyi. Ɔlɔna Ku Kɔyu Kemmo Ala Eekpóku Lɛlɔ Na Ukyuli Ɔlɔna Kemmo

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: Bula ƒui bɔgyi ka ɔda bubo bɔdanku kɔyu kemmo ala. Nsu ami nli ngba aani ɔyawine, na likpidi bɔbla bɔɔdi-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: Neeenu ala ani na mɔɔbla kalɔ. Ɔsika si lɛla lɛni na lɛ́kali ka mɔɔyɔ́ lɛbla ni, ɔɔɔdi ani na mɔɔbla. Mmomu ala ani geen na nkisi ni, anya na mɔɔbla.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: Na si ala ani na naaayɔ ka lɛbla na mɔɔbla ni, na ɔɔtina ka lɛ́tuna ka ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔdia.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, ɔɔtina ka ɔɔɔdi ami ɔlati mɔɔbla lɛla lɛmɛni, mmomu likpidi lɛni nkya-mi kemmo mɔɔbla lɛla lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: Na ngyi ka na mina lɛlɔ kemmo ni, lɛla lɛbuni lɛdi biala liiibo. Na mɔɔsu ɔmɛni taasiku mina ɔlɔna udu ɔkukudi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika mɔɔyɔ́ geen ka nka lɛbla lɛbuni, nsu naaakana-ni bɔbla.

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si mɔɔbla ala ani na naaayɔ ka lɛbla ni, ɔɔɔdi ami ɔlati mɔɔbla-nya. Mmomu ni, likpidi lɛni nkya-mi kemmo mɔɔbla-nya.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, mɔɔnu lɛla lɛni mɔɔlɛ́ na mina lɛlɔ kemmo taati. Si mɔɔwia ka lɛbla lɛbuni ni, likpidi lɛsiaku-mi kpakplaa.

english_verse: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
translation_verse: Nka na mina kayi kemmo geen ni, Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔɔda-mi ebiti geen.

english_verse: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.
translation_verse: Nsu mɔɔnu ka ala bamba ani mɔɔlɛ́-mi lɛlɔ kemmo eekpóku lɛla lɛni na mina kasusu kaatina-mi ka lɛdia. Na áya na likpidi bɔbla búnyimi-mi na bɔ́bala-mi aani ɔtɔntɛne.

english_verse: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
translation_verse: Mina lɛlɔ libo kɔnyana geen. Na ɔma ndubo-mi budie bɔlɛku ɔlɔna udunkpi ɔkukudi ɔni néti-mi úsela kukpi kemmo mɛni?

english_verse: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
translation_verse: Mɔɔgyá Katɔti enu, ɔsika ɔkɛnku Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ ni, ndubɔkɛ bɔƒɔ! Na ɔƒɛni ni, na mina kasusu kemmo ni, ndi Katɔti ɔda bubo kabla ɔblane. Nsu mina ukyuli udu ɔɔbla likpidi kabla.

english_verse: If you belong to Christ Jesus, you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, kɔtɔ bɔdu bɔdi buuubo buuute bani nábla unwi ku Kristo Yesu na bana ngba bulie kemmo.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔkɛnku Kristo Yesu lɛlɔ ni, ɔda bubo bɔni nkɛnku Katɔti Kɔyu kɔni muute bekyuli ngba bɔ́ya na lɛ́lɛ ɔda bubo bɔni ndanku likpidi bɔbla ku kukpi kalɔ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔni na úti úte Mose bútakana bɔbla ka bekyuli bátakana-mu lɛlɔ bɔdi ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔ́bla-ni. Ɔ́tala Ubidi aani ukyuli ɔni mbo ɔlɔna ɔni na likpidi liikpóku. Úbo úbabla bekyuli ekpidi lili buvele akpala, na ɔ́du likpidi kɔtɔ na ɔ́yila likpidi ɔyikun ɔni mɔɔdi-bu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: He did this, so that we would do what the Law commands by obeying the Spirit instead of our own desires.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́bla ɔmɛni úte abu bani nli aani kalɛ na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔɔyɔ́, na ɔɔɔdi kalɛ na ɔlɔna udu ɔkukudi ɔɔyɔ́. Ɔ́bla ala amɛni ƒui na ulu siin lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na nwuna ɔda bubo bɔɔtina.

english_verse: People who are ruled by their desires think only of themselves. Everyone who is ruled by the Holy Spirit thinks about spiritual things.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nli na bana ɔlɔna udu ɔkukudi bɔyɔ kenye ni, bana kasusu kaasia ala ani na bana ɔlɔna ɔɔyɔ́ lɛlɔ. Nsu bani nli ɔkɛnku Katɔti Kɔyu lɛlɔ ni, bana kasusu kaasia lɛla lɛni na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔɔyɔ́ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni kasusu mɔɔsia ɔlɔna ala lɛlɔ ni, ɔɔkɛ́ kukpi. Nsu ukyuli ɔni kasusu mɔɔsia Katɔti Kɔyu lɛlɔ ni, ɔɔkɛ́ ngba ku keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: If we follow our desires, we cannot please God.
translation_verse: Bani náya na bana ɔlɔna ɔɔdi-ma lɛlɔ ni, balakana Katɔti lɛyɔla bɔbla.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: Si Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ni, biiilie na bina ɔlɔna udu ɔkukudi bɔyɔ kenye, mmomu kalɛ na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔɔyɔ́. Na si Kristo Kɔyu kútaƒɔ ukyuli ɔdi lɛlɔ kemmo ni, ɔɔɔdi Kristo ɔdi.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Ina Kristo ɔkya-mii kemmo ni, bina ɔlɔna ɔdubo bukpi na likpidi ɔsu. Nsu bina kɔyu kɔdubɔsɔ kɔkya ngba, ɔsika Katɔti ɔ́bla-mii siin.

english_verse: Yet God raised Jesus to life! God's Spirit now lives in you, and he will raise you to life by his Spirit.
translation_verse: Na si Katɔti Kɔyu kɔni nágyila Yesu ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ kɔkya-mii kemmo ni, anwu ɔni nágyila Kristo Yesu ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ mɛni ndubute bina ɔlɔna ɔni ndubukpi mɛni ngba ɔkɛnku nwuna Kɔyu kɔni nli-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ɔsu.

english_verse: My dear friends, we must not live to satisfy our desires.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, banwa, ɔɔɔdi ɔlɔna ɔmɛni na bɔda kayu ka bulie ngba na nwuna ɔkwɛ adala kenye.

english_verse: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
translation_verse: Si bɛsiaku likyulikpi udu ala bɔbla kama ni, bɛdubo bukpi. Nsu si bɛkɛnku Katɔti Kɔyu lɛlɔ na bɛ́du bina ɔlɔna udu ukpidi ɔmmɔ ni, bɛdubɔkɛ ngba.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bani na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔtɔnku ni, ama ndi Katɔti bebi.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make us slaves who are afraid of him. Instead, we become his children and call him our Father.
translation_verse: Katɔti útete-mii kɔyu kɔni náya na binwini liƒu ala kabla bablane. Mmomu úte-mii Kɔyu kɔni náya na binwini nwuna bebi. Na ɔkɛnku Kɔyu kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu na bɔɔkpali Katɔti bɔnii, “Abba” ɔni kalɔ ndi mina Ati.

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us sure that we are his children.
translation_verse: Katɔti Kɔyu ku bula ayu ƒui eedie ɔmɛni kenye taatina ka bɔdi Katɔti bebi.

english_verse: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
translation_verse: Na si bɔdi nwuna bebi ni, na bɔdi nwuna ala badine. Na abu ku Kristo bɔdubɔdi Katɔti ala bɔsala. Na bɔdubukeye lɛnɔ aani nwuna kalɛ si búbo abi aani kalɛ na Kristo úbo abi. Bɔdubo Ebiti Bɔkɛ

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: Mɔɔnu taati geen ka abi ani na buubó ɔƒaani ni, aaadi lɛla lɛdi na kalɛ na Katɔti ɔdubɔya na bukeye kudɔ.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Ala ani na Katɔti údie ƒui aanu ulu kpakplaa teete uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔdubudie nwuna bebi ɔtina.

english_verse: Meanwhile, creation is confused, but not because it wants to be confused. God made it this way in the hope
translation_verse: Na ala ediedi amɛni ƒui ni, éduo lɛbibo kemmo. Nsu ɔɔɔdi ala ammɔ alati mɔɔyɔ́ lɛni, mmomu Katɔti ɔlati néte kuƒi lɛni. Na ɔ́ya na ebo lɛnunsia ka

english_verse: that creation would be set free from decay and would share in the glorious freedom of his children.
translation_verse: ɔdubudie ala ammɔ ƒui ɔlɛku kukpi enu kemmo na anwuna, na ɔya na ekeye aani nwuna bebi kalɛ.

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Na bɔgyi ka úti úbedu uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ni, ala ani na Katɔti údie ƒui eedumo geen aani uleku ɔni ntɛ kɔwɔ.

english_verse: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi ala ammɔ lɛti, mmomu ku abu bani na Katɔti ɔ́ka nwuna Kɔyu buti bute lɛnɔ buudumo na bula lɛlɔ kemmo, na bɔsia anu kpakplaa ka Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ-bu ekpidi lili kayu na bɔnwuna aani nwuna bebi.

english_verse: And this hope is what saves us. But if we already have what we hope for, there is no need to keep on hoping.
translation_verse: Na ka bubo lɛnunsia lɛmɛni ɔsu ni, bɔ́kɛ bɔƒɔ. Nsu lɛnunsia lɛla lɛni na bɔɔnu ku bula anumi ni, lɛsɔ lɛɛɛdi lɛnunsia. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ ulasia ala ani na ɔɔnu anu.

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Nsu si bula anumi asia ala ani na bula anumi alanu lɛlɔ ni, na bɔɔkɛ́ kayi buɛɛ taanu-nya ulu.

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: Na ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na Katɔti Kɔyu kuute-bu kebunku, ɔsika buse kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ, na bɔɔɔgyi kalɛ bɔkpali Katɔti bɔvinku. Nsu nwuna Kɔyu kɔmmɔ ɔlati kuuvele na kuudumo teete-bu kalɛ udu na abu bulaka budie bɔtina.

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔni ngyi bekyuli kayi kemmo ni, ɔgyi lɛla lɛni nkya nwuna Kɔyu kasusu kemmo lɛnɔ. Ɔsika Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kuuvele Katɔti na nwuna badi lili kalɛ na Katɔti ɔmmɔ ɔɔyɔ́.

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: Bɔgyi ka lɛla biala na Katɔti ɔɔbla ni, lɛdi lɛbuni lite bekyuli bani mɔɔyɔ́-nwu na ɔ́lɔ-ma ka babla nwuna kabla.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔgyi use ni, úse-ma likpo na ɔ́ya bálɛ Ubidi kalɛ na Ubidi ɔbla udeedi na nwuna banwa pii bammɔ akɔ.

english_verse: God then accepted the people he had already decided to choose, and he has shared his glory with them. God's Love
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bani na Katɔti úse-ma likpo ni, ama na ɔ́lɔ. Na bani na ɔ́lɔ ni, ɔ́bla-ma siin. Na bani na ɔ́bla siin mmɔ ni, ɔ́ɔkɔliku-ma lɛnyi katɔ. Bɔɔdi Lɛbibo Biala Lɛlɔ

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bi na ɔdi ka bɔsu? Si Katɔti unye-bu kama ni, ɔma ndubɔkana na ukpoku-bu?

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Na si Katɔti útenye útada Ubidi mmomu úti-nwu ɔkpa na bula lili ni, bi ɔsu na ulete-bu ala ƒui ku kaƒɔ ƒaa ɔkɛnku Ubidi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ?

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Na ɔma ndubɔwia Katɔti bekyuli baƒunadi litemi? Katɔti ɔlati uudie-ma kenye ka bɔƒiɔ bɔdi buuubo-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Na ɔma ndubɔkana na ɔdu-ma kɔtɔ? Kristo Yesu ndi ukyuli ɔni nékpi, na ɔni nsɔ nsia ndi ka Katɔti ɔ́gyila-nwu ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ na ɔ́sɔ úbo uli ngba na ulie Katɔti kɔdianu na uuvele-nwu teete-bu.

english_verse: Can anything separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, suffering, and hard times, or hunger and nakedness, or danger and death?
translation_verse: Na ɔma ndubɔkana na ukulo abu ku Kristo bɔyɔ bɔni nkya-bu ntɛ kemmo? Lɛbibo, munuu ɔlɛ bunu, munuu bukpoku, munuu kɔka, munuu kasɔngya, munuu ɔgbankpi, munuu kukpi na kewii kenye?

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Ɔkya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ka, “Na awɔ ɔsu ni, bɔkya kukpi ɔgbankpi kemmo limeyi ndi limeyi. Na baabla-bu aani kalɛ na baabla baƒonu bani na béti-ma bésela batádu.”

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ƒui kemmo ni, butulo lɛlɔ badine ɔkɛnku Kristo ɔni mɔɔyɔ́-bu ɔsu.

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na ndubo-mii bɔsu mɛni ni, ɔɔɔdi ɔkɔ na mɔɔnyi, ɔsika ndi Kristo ɔdi. Mina kayi kani lɛlɔ na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔɔdi mɔɔtina-mi geen ka naaanyi ɔkɔ.

english_verse: my heart is broken and I am in great sorrow.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyá na bɛti ka kayi kaakpulu-mi na muunú ɔlɛ geen na mina lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: I would gladly be placed under God's curse and be separated from Christ for the good of my own people.
translation_verse: Ɔsika mɔɔyɔ́ ka libunku mina kadi bekyuli. Si banii nka Katɔti ɔtuna na ɔmami-mi Kristo lɛlɔ na ɔvumana mina bɔƒɔ ute mina kadi bekyuli ni, nka ndubunu kalɔ na ɔyila-mi udu.

english_verse: They are the descendants of Israel, and they are also God's chosen people. God showed them his glory. He made agreements with them and gave them his Law. The temple is theirs and so are the promises that God made to them.
translation_verse: Ɔsika badi bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna. Na úti-ma ɔ́bla nwuna bebi. Na údie nwuna lɛga bɔdi bukeye ɔ́tina-ma. Na ɔ́tina-ma lɛla lɛni na únyimi. Na úti nwuna ɔda bubo úte-ma. Ama na Katɔti ɔ́tina kalɛ na ɔdi ka bakpa-nwu. Na ama na úse kenye.

english_verse: They have those famous ancestors, who were also the ancestors of the Christ. I pray that God, who rules over all, will be praised forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ama mbo Israel ɔtɔ eƒi benengu bani na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna. Na bana akɔ na Kristo ɔni nébo aani ukyuli ɔyawine ɔ́lɛ ɔ́si. Bɛya na bumwi Katɔti ɔni mɔɔdi ala ƒui lɛlɔ ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ƒui. Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi bɔsu na nda nnii Katɔti kenye kani na úse ni, útadi-ka lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ɔɔɔdi Yudaƒuɔ ƒui ndi bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna aani nwuna badi.

english_verse: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka ni, ɔɔɔdi Abraham bebi bani ƒui na ɔ́wɔ ndi Katɔti bebi. Mmomu Katɔti bebi ndi bani mɔɔƒɔ́-nwu linyese lɛmmɔ taadi. Na ama na ɔɔnu aani Abraham bebi geen.

english_verse: Sarah, “At this time next year I will return, and you will already have a son.”
translation_verse: Na etemila ani na Katɔti ɔ́su na nwuna linyese kemmo ndi ɔnii, “Ndubunwini libo na uwi ɔni námanku lɛlɔ. Na Sara ɔdubɔwɔ ɔnanabi.”

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to the twin sons of Isaac and Rebekah.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi ɔmɛni lɛti. Nsu Rebeka ɔ́wɔ nta na badi bananabi ɔ́siku ɔti unwi pɛ kudɔ ɔni ndi bula Nana Isak.

english_verse: Even before they were born or had done anything good or bad, the Lord told Rebekah that her older son would serve the younger one. The Lord said this to show he makes his own choices and it wasn't because of anything either of them had done.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Katɔti ubo ulu ɔni na ɔɔsia taaƒuna bekyuli. Na kalɛ na ubo-nwu kemmo lɛni ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔ́su lɛla lɛdi úse asa na badubɔwɔ nta bamɛni iye asa na nta bammɔ bati lɛbuni ku likpidi. Na ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔɔsia mmɔ ɔɔɔkɛnku bana kabla kadi lɛlɔ. Mmomu ɔ́su Rebeka ɔnini, “Ubi unengudi ɔdubunwini ɔnamudi kabla ɔblane.”

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: Use aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔ́su na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ɔnini, “Yakob na lɛ́ƒuna, na líni Esau.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses that he has pity and mercy on anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔ́su Mose ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ka lɛnu kɔnyana ni, ndubɔnu-nwu kɔnyana. Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ka nwuna lɛlɔ lɛkywi-mi kaƒɔ ni, nwuna lɛlɔ lɛdubɔkywi-mi kaƒɔ.”

english_verse: Everything then depends on God's mercy and not on what people want or do.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu kalɛ na Katɔti ɔɔnu ukyuli kɔnyana ni, ɔɔɔkɛnku ukyuli ɔmmɔ kabla bɔbla iye tabla lɛlɔ. Mmomu ni, ɔkɛnku kalɛ na Katɔti ɔlati ɔɔnu kɔnyana lɛlɔ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: Na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ni, Katɔti ɔ́su Ɔga Ƒarao ɔnini, “Kasusu kamɛni geen ɔsu na líse-ɔ lɛga kalɛ na lidie mina ɔyikun lɛtina bekyuli ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛlɔ, na bebo-mi lɛnyi kudu bete kayawi bekyuli ƒui.”

english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔɔnu ukyuli ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́ kɔnyana. Na uudie ɔbambadi lɛnɔ atu na ɔɔbla atuɔkplu. Katɔti Ɔɔkɛ́ku-bu Kɔnyi Na Ɔɔnu-bu Kɔnyana Lɛnɔ

english_verse: Someone may ask, “How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to?”
translation_verse: Bina akɔ ɔdi ɔdubo-mi buye ɔnini, “Si use lɛni ni, dɛ na ɔ́bla na Katɔti ɔ́sɔ uudie ukyuli bɔƒiɔ bɔdi? Ɔsika ukyuli ɔdi ulakana na wata wenye Katɔti lɛyɔla lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: But, my friend, I ask, “Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?
translation_verse: Na awɔ ndi ɔma geen na eetemi asiaku Katɔti? Libwi liléye ukyuli ɔni návɔ-ni ɔnini, “Bi ɔsu na ávɔ-mi lɛni?”

english_verse: Doesn't a potter have the right to make a fancy bowl and a plain bowl out of the same lump of clay?”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama ni, ukyuli ɔni mɔɔvɔ́ ebwi ubo kuƒi na ɔbla lɛvɔti lɛmmɔ kalɛ biala na ɔɔyɔ́. Na ɔkana na ɔvɔ ebwi anyɔ ɔlɛku lɛvɔti linwi lɛmmɔ kemmo, kalɛ na uti libwi linwi use ute limeyi bɔdi. Na uti libwi linyɔdi utaaƒuƒwɛ.

english_verse: God wanted to show his anger and reveal his power against everyone who deserved to be destroyed. But instead, he patiently put up with them.
translation_verse: Na lɛni kani na Katɔti lɛnɔ ɔ́bla. Ɔɔyɔ́ ka udie nwuna kɔnyi keyi na banu nwuna ɔyikun bati. Nsu ɔ́kɛ kayi geen úte bani mɔɔkya-nwu kɔnyi ina ka ɔ́ɔlɛ-ma ugyii úse ka ɔyila-ma udu.

english_verse: He did this by showing how glorious he is when he has pity on the people he has chosen to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Na lɛni kani na ɔ́yɔ ka údie ala abuni ani nkya nwuna bukeye bonwu kemmo keyi ɔtina bani na wanu kɔnyana. Na abu ndi bekyuli bani na ɔ́klibi úse ka bɔdubo bukeye.

english_verse: Whether Jews or Gentiles, we are those chosen ones,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na ɔ́ƒuna abu lɛnɔ, na ɔɔɔdi Yudaƒuɔ lɛti. Mmomu ku bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, “Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.
translation_verse: Na lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́su na Kenye Udiene Hosea ɔku kemmo ɔnini, “Bekyuli bani na nka baaadi mina badi ni, ndubɔlɔ-ma mina bekyuli. Na bekyuli bani na nka baaadi mina bayɔne ni, ndubɔlɔ-ma mina bayɔne.

english_verse: “Once they were told, ‘You are not my people.’ But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.”
translation_verse: Na kesii kani geen na lɛ́su nnii, ‘Bɛɛɛdi mina bekyuli’ ni, mmɔ na bekyuli badubɔlɔ-ma Katɔti Ɔni Nli Ngba Uwi Ƒui bebi.”

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.
translation_verse: Katɔti Kenye Udiene Yesaia úbo kudu úte Yudaƒuɔ ɔnini, “Si ina Yudaƒuɔ bemomo aani ɛpu kɔnwinimi muedi ni, bana akɔ ɛlɛɛ badi kani ndubo bubu na bakɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will be quick and sure to do on earth what he has warned he will do.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika Blɔti ɔdubɔni bayawine ƒui kɔtu kɔnakunwi na ɔsa.”

english_verse: Isaiah also said, “If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.” Israel and the Good News
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔlɛ aani kalɛ na Yesaia ɔ́su dii ɔnini, “Si Blɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui útebu bula bawɔ badi útese kama ni, bɔdubo udu bɔyii aani kalɛ na Sodom ku Gomora lɛma lɛ́yii udu!” Litemi Buni Lɛmɛni Lɛnɔ Lɛdanku Yudaƒuɔ

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bi na ɔdi ka bɔsu? Bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ na bátasiaku lɛlɔ bɔbla siin kama ni, bénwini bekyuli bani nse siin ɔƒɛni na Katɔti anumi ka báƒɔ-nwu bádi ɔsu.

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bétulo Kristo ɔni nse aani lɛtabi lɛni náda-ma ulu aani kalɛ na ɔkya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo banini, “Binu! Lɛ́ƒuna lɛtabi lɛdi na Sion lɛni ndubɔya na bekyuli betulo. Na ani kani ndubɔya na begyiile bebuli. Nsu ukyuli biala ɔni maƒɔ-nwu madi ni, kɔƒa kulékpo-nwu kudii.”

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
translation_verse: Mina banwa, ɔdi mina bɔyɔ bɔni nási-mi kayi kemmo ku mina katɔ bɔkpali kemmo ka Yudaƒuɔ bakɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: what makes people acceptable to him. So they refuse to trust God, and they try to be acceptable by obeying the Law.
translation_verse: Ɔsika baaagyi ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́ ka ukyuli ɔsia na ɔbla siin na nwuna anumi. Mmomu ama alati báwia ulu bamba béte lɛlɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu béteboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bétete Katɔti kalɛ na ɔtina-ma ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na basia na ɔbla-ma siin.

english_verse: But Christ makes the Law no longer necessary for those who become acceptable to God by faith. Anyone Can Be Saved
translation_verse: Ɔsika Kristo ndi Mose ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ ƒui kawɔlɔkɔ. Na ukyuli biala ɔni maƒɔ Kristo madi ni, ɔ́bla siin na Katɔti anumi. Ukyuli Biala Ɔkana Ɔya Na Katɔti Ɔƒɔ-nwu Ngba

english_verse: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, “If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.”
translation_verse: Mose únweni ɔ́siku kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔbla siin ɔkɛnku ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ɔnini, “Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔdi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔda bubo ulu ɔmmɔ ɔdubute-nwu ngba.”

english_verse: But people whose faith makes them acceptable to God will never ask, “Who will go up to heaven to bring Christ down?”
translation_verse: Nsu Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔ́siku kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔbla siin na Katɔti anumi ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ ɔnini, “Teye lɛlɔ anii, ‘Ɔma ndubusie katɔ?’ ” Nwuna kalɔ ndi, ɔma makɔ katɔ matákpanku Kristo meboku?

english_verse: Neither will they ask, “Who will go down into the world of the dead to raise him to life?”
translation_verse: “Na teye lɛlɔ anii, ‘Ɔma ndubuduo usie kalɔ kemmo ƒui?’ ” Nwuna kalɔ ndi, ɔma mesie kekpine matákpanku Kristo meboku?

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Mmomu lɛla lɛni na ɔɔtina ndi ka, “Katɔti litemi lɛmmɔ lɛ́ɛni líde-ɔ, na lɛkya-a kenye ku ƒula kayi kemmo.” Na ani ndi bɔƒɔtaadi litemi lɛni lɛsa na bɔɔkɔ́.

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: Na si ébimi kenye na ásu anii Yesu ndi Blɔti, na áƒɔ ádi na ƒula kayi kemmo ka Katɔti nágyila-nwu ɔ́lɛku kekpine ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ-ɔ ngba.

english_verse: God will accept you and save you, if you truly believe this and tell it to others.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ƒula kayi kemmo na aaƒɔ́ taadi na aabla siin na Katɔti anumi. Na ƒula kenye kani na éti eedie ɔmɛni taatina, na aakɛ́ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛni na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔnii, “Ukyuli biala ɔni maƒɔ-nwu madi ni, kɔƒa kulékpo-nwu kudii.”

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka ni, kavumana kadi keeebo Yudaƒuɔ ku bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ ntɛ. Na Blɔti ɔdi bula ƒui Ɔti, na uute bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔkpali-nwu ala abuni.

english_verse: All who call out to the Lord will be saved.
translation_verse: Lɛni na ɔkya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ɔnii, “Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔkpali Blɔti lɛnyi ni, ɔdubɔkɛ bɔƒɔ.”

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli biala ɔni na útaƒɔ útadi ni, dɛ na ɔdubɔkana na ɔkpali-nwu uvele lɛla lɛdi? Na ukyuli ɔni lɛlɔ lɛsa na bátakɔ bétete-ma kudii ni, dɛ na badubɔkana na baƒɔ-nwu badi? Na si ɔdi útatákɔ lɛsa lɛmmɔ útete-ma dii ni, dɛ na badubunu-ni?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Na si bátatala bekyuli nɔɔ? Dɛ na ɔdubɔbla na bakɔ lɛsa lɛmmɔ? Anwuɔsu na bénweni banii, “Binu bekyuli bani ndubo babakɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa kalɛ na bana bubo kɔku kɔɔda kubiti!”

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Nsu ni, ɔɔɔdi Yudaƒuɔ ƒui náƒɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ. Ɔsika Yesaia ɔ́su ɔnini, “Blɔti, ɔma náƒɔ bula litemi ɔ́di?”

english_verse: No one can have faith without hearing the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, bɔƒɔtaadi bunye litemi lɛmmɔ bunu lɛlɔ. Na litemi lɛmmɔ bunu lɛkɛnku Kristo litemi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Nsu lɛla lɛni muuye ɔƒɛni ndi ka ni, bunu na Yudaƒuɔ bétenu Katɔti litemi lɛmmɔ? Oowo! Bénu-ni aani kalɛ na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bénu-ma kɔku na kayawi ekpo ƒui, na bana etemila égyingya ésie kayawi kawɔlɔkɔ ƒui.”

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: Na nsɔ muuye nnii na bunu na bétenu-ni kalɔ? Mose ɔlati ndi ukyuli udeedi ɔni náka kenye budie na ɔ́su ka Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ndubɔya na anumi egyie-mii na bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ lɛlɔ. Na ndubuti bekyuli bani anumi nétebimi lɛkya-mii kɔnyi.”

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Na Yesaia úse kayi na ɔ́su-ma nwaa ka Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bekyuli bani na nka baláwia-mi ni, ɔƒɛni bánu-mi. Na lídie lɛlɔ lɛ́tina bekyuli bani néteye-mi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Nsu na Yudaƒuɔ lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Lígyingya enu líse limeyi limodi ka lɛƒɔ-ma. Nsu bátakpete-mi, ɔsika badi bekyuli bani naaabu lɛla lɛdi na báta bénye-mi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu muuye ɔƒɛni nnii Katɔti úni nwuna bekyuli? Oowo. Kudi kudii! Ami ɔlati Yudani na ndi na Abraham kaba kemmo, na lɛ́si Benyamin ɔtɔ kemmo.

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?
translation_verse: Katɔti úteni nwuna bekyuli bani na ɔgyi use. Na bɛgyi lɛla lɛni na bénweni bákya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo uwi ɔni na Kenye Udiene Elia úvele Katɔti úte Yudaƒuɔ na ɔ́su ɔnini,

english_verse: He said, “Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.”
translation_verse: “Blɔti, bekyuli bammɔ bádu ƒula kenye bediene na bábwɛ ƒula akpabi ammɔ ƒui. Na ami lɛti pɛ ndi ukyuli ɔni nébu, na baawia ka badu-mi!”

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,
translation_verse: Geen ni, lɛla lɛni na Yudaƒuɔ básia anu kpakplaa ni, bátakɛ-ni. Nsu bani na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna ama bákɛ-ni. Na bakladi báyu atuɔkplu.

english_verse: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na use ɔƒɛni. Nkyuli ɛlɛɛ badi bébu bani na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna úse úte lɛlɔ ɔkɛnku nwuna lɛƒɔndia ɔsu.

english_verse: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Nwuna lɛƒɔndia lɛlɔ na ɔkɛ ɔ́ƒuna-ma, na ɔɔɔdi bana lɛla lɛni bábla ɔsu na ɔ́ƒuna-ma. Na si Katɔti ɔɔƒuna bekyuli na bana kabla bɔbla kenye ni, na nwuna lɛƒɔndia lɛɛɛdi lɛƒɔndia geen.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “God made them so stupid that their eyes are blind, and their ears are still deaf.”
translation_verse: Lɛni na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔnini, “Katɔti ɔ́nyonu-ma na kɔdɔlɔ kɔ́ƒɔ-ma kayi ku kasusu ƒui. Na úti úbalɛ ku ɔmwi kadi ni, belenu na balánu lɛla lɛdi taati.”

english_verse: Then David said, “Turn their meals into bait for a trap, so that they will stumble and be given what they deserve.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Ɔga Dawid ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ya na bana limeyi kadikɔ kenwini kubu kubi-ma lɛlɔ, na betulo na bebuli beduo ɔgbankpi kemmo.

english_verse: Blindfold their eyes! Don't let them see. Bend their backs beneath a burden that will never be lifted.” Gentiles Will Be Saved
translation_verse: Na ɔya na bana anumi abwɛ na batanu lɛla lɛdi batati, na ɔya na bana lɛbibo linwini etila asia-ma lɛlɔ uwi biala.”

english_verse: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.
translation_verse: Na muuye lɛnɔ nnii uwi ɔni na Yudaƒuɔ bétulo na bébuli ni, báyii ku udu na basɔ balakana bɔta? Oowo! Kudii! Mmomu ɔ́si bana bɔƒiɔ ɔsu ni, ngba bɔƒɔ búbedu bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ kalɛ na ɔya anumi egyie Yudaƒuɔ.

english_verse: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.
translation_verse: Na amii bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ ni, mɔɔsu-mii nnii uwi ɔni kemmo na ami ndi ɔtalane nte-mii mɛni ni, muubo mina kabla kudu.

english_verse: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.
translation_verse: Na nsia lɛnu ɔkɛnku ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ka ni, anumi adubugyie mina bekyuli, na badi bakɛ ngba bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.
translation_verse: Ɔsika uwi ɔni na Katɔti údie-ma atu ni, Katɔti ɔ́sɔku anwu ku kayawi bekyuli ntɛ ɔ́klibi. Anwuɔsu bi na ndubo bɔlɛ si uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́ƒɔ-ma? Ɔdubuse aani kalɛ na ukpine ɔɔsɔ taata teebelie ngba.

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si bodobodo kakɛ kedeedi kani na bábwɛ bákpa béte Katɔti use kedee ni, na bodobodo ɔkladi lɛnɔ use kedee. Na si kugyii kɔdi ugyiitu use kedee ni, na kugyii kɔmmɔ kɔgba lɛnɔ kuse kedee.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Na si kɔgba kɔdi kɔ́ƒɛ kɔ́lɛ kugyii kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na békulo-mii aani lɛku kemmo kugyii kagba blii kadi bébenyimi báda kesii kani na kugyii kɔmmɔ ntu bɔɔyu na ɔ́kun ɔ́da ni, bɛɛní ntu taasiku kugyii kɔmmɔ ligyiitu kudɔ.

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bitakun lɛmɛnɛ na kugyii kɔmmɔ kɔgba kɔni náƒɛ kɔ́lɛ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika si bɛ́bla lɛni ni, bɛnu bɛti ka ɔɔɔdi amii nda ligyiitu lɛmmɔ. Mmomu ligyiitu lɛmmɔ nda-mii.

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.
translation_verse: Bɛdubɔkana na bɛsu bɛnii, “Kɔgba kɔmmɔ kɔ́ƒɛ kalɛ na beti abu bamana kuna kenye.”

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: Na use lɛni. Nsu bɛti ka bana taƒɔ tadi ɔsu na bámami. Na amii bɛ́kɛ kamakɔ ka bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́di ɔsu. Nsu ɔmmɔ ulátina ka ɔlɛka biteeƒu, mmomu bitaayia.

english_verse: If God cut away those natural branches, couldn't he do the same to you?
translation_verse: Ɔsika si Katɔti útenye útada Yudaƒuɔ bani nse aani kugyii kɔmmɔ ɔlati kɔgba bɔƒɛ ni, bɛɛkali ka ɔdubunye ɔda amii amu?

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔɔtina-bu kalɛ na Katɔti ɔɔnu kɔnyana ku kalɛ na nwuna litemi libo ɔkplu. Ɔ́yu bekyuli bani nébo kalɔ ɔkplu, na ɔdi lɛƒɔndia ute amii si binye bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kpakplaa uwi ƒui. Si bítabla lɛni ni, Katɔti ɔdubukulo-mii udie kugyii kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Na si Yudaƒuɔ lɛnɔ báda bana taƒɔ tadi báya ni, Katɔti ɔdubuti ama lɛnɔ ubamana kugyii kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔlati ubo ɔyikun na ɔsɔku kagba ɔmana kugyii lɛlɔ na ɔkun ɔda.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Úse ɔdi lɛla lɛni na balakya unyeƒi ka si bákana na békulo kugyii kɔdi udu basiku lɛku kemmo bábamana kɔni bálɛ ɔmantɛ lɛlɔ na ɔ́kun ɔ́da ɔni na nka útamanku ka babla ni, na ɔmantɛ kugyii kɔmmɔ ɔlati kɔgba ni, kɔdubɔkana na kɔkun kɔda kugyii kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ pla utulo. Katɔti Bekyuli Ƒui Badubɔkɛ Bɔƒɔ

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: Banwa, ala abɛdi adi akya ɔ́si kukuuku ani na naaayɔ nnii abɛ-mii ƒui kalɛ na bilátaakun lɛmɛnɛ na bina kasusu kenye. Anwu ndi ka ni, Yudaƒuɔ badi atuɔkplu ani baabla ni, ɔɔɔdubo buse lɛni uwi ƒui. Mmomu atuɔkplu ammɔ kenye kadubukulo uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́sala bumomo bɔni na ɔɔwia na bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ akɔ ɔ́wɔlɔ.

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: Na ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na Yudaƒuɔ ƒui badubɔkɛ bɔƒɔ aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔ́su na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ɔnini, “Ɔƒɔne ɔdubɔsi Sion na ɔdubo ubedie likyulikpi na Yakob kaba kemmo.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: Na bunyimi bɔmɛni ndubɔkya ami ku-ma ntɛ si uwi ɔni na lídie ekpidi bana lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: Yudaƒuɔ badi Katɔti bekisine, ɔsika bátaƒɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ bátadi. Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, amii bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ bɛ́kɛ kenyekɔ. Nsu ka Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna-ma ɔsu ni, ɔɔyɔ́-ma na bana bati kuuku ɔsu.

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si ɔ́ƒuna ukyuli ɔdi iye ɔ́bla-nwu lɛƒɔndia lɛdi ni, ulávumana-ni.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Na amii bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ ni, kalɛ na bɛ́ƒiɔ Katɔti uwi ɔdi nábavi kemmo nsu ɔƒɛni Katɔti ɔ́nu-mii kɔnyana na Yudaƒuɔ atuɔkplu ɔsu ni,

english_verse: And because of the mercy shown to you, they will also be shown mercy.
translation_verse: lɛni kani na ɔkɛnku kalɛ na Katɔti ɔ́nu-mii kɔnyana ɔsu na ama lɛnɔ bénwini batuɔkplune kalɛ na Katɔti ɔnu ama lɛnɔ kɔnyana.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́nyonu bekyuli ƒui, na bana atuɔkplu ábala-ma aani batɔntɛne kalɛ na ɔnu bana ƒui kɔnyana. Bɛya Na Bumwi Katɔti

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: Lɛni na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Ɔma náti Blɔti kasusu dii? Na ɔma mɔɔkya-nwu kasusu?

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Ɔma néte Katɔti lɛla lɛdi dii na ɔlɛka Katɔti ɔƒɔ-nwu kayu ɔsia?”

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ala ani ƒui nási Katɔti kudɔ, na anwu ɔlati lɛlɔ na ɔkɛ údie-nya, na adi anwu adi. Bɛya na bɔkɔliku-nwu lɛnyi katɔ ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ƒui. Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, mina banwa, ka Katɔti ɔ́bla-bu kaƒɔ buni geen ɔsu ni, muuvele-mii geen nnii biti bina lɛlɔ bite Katɔti aani akpala ani nse kedee na aayɔ́-nwu kaƒɔ lɛnɔ bɛda na bina ngba bulie kemmo mɛni. Ɔmmɔ ndi bina kɔyu kemmo akpala kabla.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Bɛsɔ bitabla unwi ku kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ ala bɔbla. Mmomu bɛya na Katɔti ɔvumana-mii kasusu ƒui na binwini bekyuli bawɔdi. Ɔmmɔ ndubɔya na bɛnu lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́ bɛti, na bɛbla lɛla lɛni ndia na lɛɛyɔ́-nwu kaƒɔ na lise sɛɛn lɛ́wɔlɔ.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku kabla kani na úte-mi na nwuna lɛƒɔndia ɔsu ni, mɔɔsu bina ƒui nnii bitatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ bitetuloku kalɛ na bise. Mmomu ni, bina kasusu katina ka bíboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na ɔdi biala utaakɔku lɛlɔ taanu na nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi bɔni na ubo kenye.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na bula ƒui bubo lɛlɔ ugyii unwi ɔni mbo ɔlɔna ekpo pii ani naaabla kabla kenwi ni,

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: lɛni kani na bɔdi bekyuli pii na Kristo kemmo nsu bɔ́sala bɔ́bla unwi aani lɛlɔ ugyii unwi ɔni ndanku lɛlɔ ekpo pii.

english_verse: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, bɛya na buti kɔyu kemmo etela lidu lidu ani na Katɔti ɔkɛnku nwuna lɛƒɔndia kemmo na úte-bu bɔbla kabla. Si ukyuli ɔdi litela lɛdi Katɔti kenye budie ni, ɔdi ka udie-ni kenye ku bɔƒɔtaadi bɔni na ubo.

english_verse: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔdi litela lɛdi bekyuli kabla bɔbla ni, ɔdi ka utaabla kabla lɛni kani. Si ɔdi ala bɔtina ni, ɔdi ka ɔtina ala ammɔ lɛni kani.

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Si ɔdi bekyuli ɔkplu bɔkya ni, ɔdi ka ɔkya bekyuli ɔkplu. Si bekyuli na ɔdi ka ute ala ni, na ute ku kaƒɔ ƒaa. Na si bekyuli bɔtɔnku lɛnɔ na ɔdi ni, ɔdi ka uti nwuna anu ƒui ɔsia kabla kammɔ lɛlɔ na ɔtɔnku-ma. Si kɔnyana bɔnu na ɔdi ni, na ɔnu kɔnyana ku kayi ƒui.

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bina bekyuli bɔyɔ bɔbla bɔyɔ geen. Bikisi likpidi na biƒie lɛla lɛbuni bɛda.

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: Biti bɔyɔ bite lɛlɔ ku kayi ƒaa aani banwa baƒɔtaadine. Na bɛbu bina bakpana bitulo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Bitabla kɔkɔsɔ, mmomu bɛya na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui na bitaabla Blɔti kabla.

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ litaayɔ-mii na bina lɛnunsia kemmo. Na binye kpakplaa na lɛbibo biala kemmo. Na bitaakpali katɔ na ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.
translation_verse: Bile bina lɛlɔ ala bite Katɔti bekyuli bani neeebo lɛla lɛdi. Na bɛgyingya enu na bɛƒɔ baƒɔ.

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muukpóku-mii ni, bite-ma kusɛ kusɛ. Bite-ma kusɛ kusɛ na bitewida-ma.

english_verse: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
translation_verse: Bɛkɛ lɛlɔyɔ ku bani na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́. Na biwuloku bani muuwulo.

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Bɛbla unwi ku bina bakpana na bina ngba bulie kemmo. Bitatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ, mmomu bɛtuna na bɛsala ku bani neeebo kenyekɔ kadi na bekyuli anumi. Na bitanu lɛlɔ bitetulo bakladi.

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: Biteti likpidi bitaƒɔ likpidi kayu. Bɛnu kaduɛ na bitaabla ala ani na ukyuli biala ɔɔnu ka adia.

english_verse: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
translation_verse: Bɛsia ulu biala lɛlɔ na bɛya na keyi buɛɛ kakya amii ku bekyuli ƒui ntɛ.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I am the one to take revenge and pay them back.”
translation_verse: Banwa, bitedie ukyuli likpidi kasi kudii, mmomu bite Katɔti kuƒi na ɔbla nwuna kɔnyi kabla na ukyuli ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ni, Katɔti ɔ́su na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ɔnini, “Ami Unwoti muudie kasi, na ami ndubɔƒɔ kayu.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: Mmomu na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ni, básu-bu banii, “Si kɔka kɔɔda ƒula ukisine ni, te-nwu adila na ɔdi. Si utukwɛ mɔɔda-nwu ni, te-nwu ntu na ɔni. Ɔsika si ábla lɛni ni, édie ogya ku agyabi éwi-nwu lili.”

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: Bitaya na likpidi lɛdi-mii lɛlɔ, mmomu biti lɛbuni bɛdi likpidi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka ukyuli biala uti ɔbu ute kalɔ lɛlɔ batɔnkune. Ɔsika ɔtɔnkune ɔdi uuubo ɔyikun ɔdi si ɔɔɔdi Katɔti kudɔ na ɔ́si. Na batɔnkune bani nli ɔƒɛni ni, Katɔti néti-ma úse mmɔ.

english_verse: People who oppose the authorities are opposing what God has done, and they will be punished.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔ́di ɔ́ta únye batɔnkune badi lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti lɛla lɛni na úse úse lɛlɔ na ɔ́ta únye. Na bekyuli bani mabla lɛni ni, baawia litemi bɔtɛ teete lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔbla lɛbuni ni, batɔnkune bammɔ baaadi lɛyiala beeete-ma, mmomu bekyuli bekpidi na badi lɛyiala bete. Si bɛɛyɔ́ ka bɛda ɔtɔnkune bɔyia bɛya ni, bɛbla lɛla biala ulu lɛlɔ na ɔdubumwi-mii.

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti kabla ɔblane na ɔdi, na ɔɔbla kabla kalɛ na ɔdianku-ɔ. Nsu si bɛɛbla likpidi ni, na ɔdi ka bɛyia-nwu. Ɔsika ɔɔɔdi keeke ɔsu na béte-nwu ɔyikun! Katɔti kabla ɔblane na ɔdi. Na ɔdi ukyuli ɔni mɔɔnu ka bábla lɛla biala ulu lɛlɔ na ɔni likpidi ɔblane biala kɔtu.

english_verse: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na ɔdi ka biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bite batɔnkune. Na ɔɔɔdi Katɔti kɔnyi kɔni mebo-mii lɛlɔ ɔsu, mmomu ka biinú bina kayi bɔlɛ ɔsu.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu lɛnɔ na ɔdi ka bɛƒɔ kuyi bite bina kalɔ lɛlɔ batɔnkune, ɔsika Katɔti kabla na baabla. Na béti bana uwi ƒui béte ka bátaatɔnku bekyuli.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Ɔda ɔni bébo-bu banii, “Tadi kɔsɔnɔ, tadu ukyuli, teyu, taya na anumi egyie-ɔ na ukyuli ɔdi ala lɛlɔ,” ku ɔda bubo biala nsɔ nkya ɔmɛni kama ni, ɔna ƒui ɔdanku lɛlakpa linwi lɛni ndi, “Yɔ ƒula ukyulikpana aani ƒula lɛlɔ kalɛ.”

english_verse: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Bɔyɔ bulábla nwuna ukyulikpana likpidi. Anwuɔsu bɔyɔ ndi lɛla lɛni na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ ƒui bɔdanku.

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛgyinya! Na bɛsia ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ. Ɔsika bɛgyi uwi ɔni kemmo na bɔkya. Uwi ɔni kemmo na Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ-bu úude útulo uwi ɔni na bɔ́ƒɔ Kristo bɔ́di kalɔ kesekɔ.

english_verse: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
translation_verse: Usien ɔmmɔ ɔ́ɔvi ɔ́wɔlɔ, na kadi ndaku bugye. Anwuɔsu bɛya na bɔda lɛdisa kemmo ala bɔbla bɔya, na bɛkya kekpo awu ɔni námanku bekyuli bani nkya bukeye kemmo.

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bɔda bula lɛlɔ kaduɛ aani bekyuli bani nkɛ mɔɔví bukeye kemmo. Na ɔɔɔdi adikpi emeyi bɔdi ku ntɛ bukpi ku lɛyalɛ ala ku likyulikpi ala ku lɛlɔ ntɛ bule ku lɛnungyie.

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Mmomu biti Blɔti Yesu Kristo bɛkya aani awu, na bɛda kasusu bidie ɔlɔna ala keeke ani mɔɔda-mii ɔkwɛ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Bigyingya enu na bɛƒɔ bina bakpana bani bɔƒɔtaadi nátayu tɔ ɔkplu. Bitakyaku-ma unyeƒi na ala ani lɛlɔ na amii ku-ma kasusu kátabla kenwi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi buute-nwu kuƒi ka ɔdi adila biala. Nsu ɔbambadi ɔni na nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi buuubo tɔ ɔkplu ni, adila ani kemmo na bátakya lɛna kani na ɔɔdi.

english_verse: But you should not criticize others for eating or for not eating. After all, God welcomes everyone.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi lɛla biala mɛni ni, utanu ɔnwani ɔni mɔɔdi ala aƒunadi ka ɔ́sɔ. Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi ala aƒunadi lɛnɔ utadu ɔni mɔɔdi lɛla biala kɔtɔ. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔ́ƒɔ anwu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Kenyekɔ kamani na ebo na aatɛku ukyuli ɔdi kabla ɔblane litemi? Nwuna unwoti ɔlati ndubɔnu bɔti si unye ute-nwu kpakplaa iye uuunye. Na kabla ɔblane ɔmmɔ lɛnɔ ɔdubunye kpakplaa, ɔsika Blɔti ɔdubɔkana na ɔya na unye ute-nwu kpakplaa.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔbu limeyi lɛdi ka lise kedee litulo lɛbambadi. Na ɔdi lɛnɔ ɔɔnu emeyi ƒui ka ese unwi. Lɛla lɛni kani námanku ndi ka ɔdi biala ɔƒɔ lɛla lɛni na ɔɔbla ɔdi kaduɛ.

english_verse: Any followers who count one day more important than another day do it to honor their Lord. And any followers who eat meat give thanks to God, just like the ones who don't eat meat.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbu limeyi lɛdi ni, Blɔti na uute ɔbu. Na ukyuli ɔni na adila adi lɛnɔ na ɔɔdi ni, Blɔti na uute ɔbu, ɔsika ɔ́gya Katɔti enu na ana lili. Na ukyuli ɔni néni na uládi adila adi lɛnɔ ni, ɔɔbla lɛni teeti taabu Blɔti. Na ɔɔgyá Katɔti enu.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: Bula akɔ ɔdi uuulie ngba uuute nwuna lɛlɔ. Na lɛni kani na bula akɔ ɔdi lɛnɔ ulekpi ulete lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Si buli ngba ni, bulie bute Blɔti. Na si búkpi lɛnɔ ni, búkpi búte Blɔti. Anwuɔsu si buli o-o iye búkpi o-o ni, Blɔti ɔdi kani na bɔdi.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔmɛni ɔsu geen na Kristo úkpi na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́ta úbo uli ngba kalɛ na unwini Blɔti ute bekpine ku bayawine ƒui.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na aadú ƒ'ɔnwani kɔtɔ? Iye ni, bi ɔsu na aanu ƒ'ɔnwani aani si ɔ́sɔ? Bula ƒui bɔdubunye Katɔti lɛgaboku lɛmmɔ anumi na ɔtɛku-bu litemi.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name!”
translation_verse: Ɔsika bénweni banii, “Blɔti ɔnini, ‘Ka lɛnya nli ngba mɛni ni, mɔɔsu-mii kpakplaa ka ɔdi biala ɔdubɔlɛ-mi akɔnkɔ kalɔ. Na ukyuli biala ɔdubɔkɔliku Katɔti lɛnyi katɔ.’ ”

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, bula akɔ ɔdi biala ɔdubɔbu nwuna ngba nkunta bute Katɔti.

english_verse: We must stop judging others. We must also make up our minds not to upset anyone's faith.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu bɛya na bɔda lɛlɔ kɔtɔ bɔdu bɔya. Mmomu bɛlɛ ugyii ka bɛɛɛdubo lɛla lɛdi bɔbla na lɛbala ɔdi bɔƒɔtaadi ulu na wetulo na weduo likpidi kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: Ka nliku Blɔti Yesu ɔsu ni, ngyi geen na mina kayi kemmo ka adila adi eeebo na eesé lɛlɔ na anya alati udu kemmo. Nsu si ɔdi ɔ́nu lɛla lɛdi aani lɛla lɛni muusé lɛlɔ ni, lɛla lɛmmɔ lɛdubuse-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Si aadi lɛla lɛdi na agyi ka liikpóku ƒula ukyulikpana ni, ɔɔɔdi bɔyɔ na eedie taatina-nwu. Taya na lɛla lɛni na aadi libile ƒula ukyulikpana bɔƒɔtaadi, ɔsika Kristo úkpi na anwu lɛnɔ lili.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni na awɔ aanu ka lɛdia ni, taya na ala ammɔ eti unyeƒi ákya Katɔti badi akɔ.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
