translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ni, ɔɔɔdanku bɔdi ku bɔni. Mmomu ɔdanku lɛlɔ bɔbla siin ku keyi buɛɛ ku lɛlɔyɔ na Katɔti Kɔyu kemmo.

english_verse: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla Kristo kabla na ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni, ɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti kaƒɔ na bekyuli lɛnɔ baabu-nwu.

english_verse: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛya na bɔkya ɔkplu biala na bɔbla lɛla lɛni muuboku bekyuli keyi buɛɛ na lɛɛyá na bekyuli baalɛ́ lili na kɔyu kemmo.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Bitebile Katɔti kabla na adila ɔsu. Lɛdila biala lise sɛɛn, nsu ɔɔɔdia si lɛla lɛni na aadi lɛdubɔya na ukyuli ɔdi utulo na ubuli uduo ɔgbankpi kemmo.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Si alákun lɛna iye alani ntɛ iye alábla lɛla lɛni maya na ƒ'ɔnwani weduo ɔgbankpi kemmo ni, ɔdia.

english_verse: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si lɛla lɛni na áƒɔ ádi na ala amɛni lɛlɔ ni, ya na asɔ akya awɔ ku Katɔti ntɛ kani. Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni na nwuna kayi kaladu-nwu kɔtɔ na lɛla lɛni na ɔɔnu ka lɛdia lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Nsu si ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔdi lɛla lɛdi na nwuna kayi kalátunaku-nwu ni, báadu-nwu kɔtɔ kukuuku, ɔsika uládi lɛla lɛmmɔ na bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo. Na lɛla biala na ukyuli ɔɔbla na ɔɔɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ ni, ɔdi-nwu likpidi.

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: Abu bani na bula bɔƒɔtaadi bɔ́ɔyu ɔkplu ni, ɔlɛka bɔkɛ kayi bute ala ani na bekyuli bani na bana bɔƒɔtaadi bútayu tɔ ɔkplu baabla na bubunku-ma. Na ɔɔɔdi ka bɔbla lɛla lɛni mayɔ-bu kaƒɔ lɛti.

english_verse: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ka bula akɔ ɔdi biala ɔbla lɛla lɛni mayɔ nwuna ukyulikpana kaƒɔ kalɛ na ɔdia ute-nwu na ɔya na ɔlɛ lili na kɔyu kemmo.

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika Kristo muedi ni, ɔɔɔdi lɛla lɛni mayɔ-nwu kaƒɔ kani na ɔ́bla. Mmomu bénweni ka Kristo ɔmmɔ ɔ́su Katɔti ɔnini, “Edumi ani na bekyuli bédumi-ɔ ni, ana ƒui ébo ábasia-mi lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: Muuvele Katɔti ɔni muubunku-bu na bɔɔkana lɛbibo biala kenye bunye kpakplaa na ɔɔkya-bu ogya nnii ɔya na unwi bɔbla bɔkya-mii akɔ uwi ɔni na bíti bɛsiaku Kristo Yesu mɛni.

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: Na bina ƒui kayi kasala kabla kenwi ku bina etemila, na bimwi Katɔti ɔni ndi Blɔti Yesu Kristo Ɔti.

english_verse: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu bigyingya enu na bɛƒɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ kani na Kristo úgyingya enu na ɔ́ƒɔ-mii. Ɔmɛni uuti ɔbu teete Katɔti.

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: Ɔsika mɔɔsu-mii nwaa nnii Kristo únwini Yudaƒuɔ ubunkune kalɛ na udie ɔtina ka kenye kani na Katɔti ɔ́su Yudaƒuɔ ɔtɔ eƒi benengu úse ni, ɔ́di-ka lɛlɔ na kébo kete lɛni sɔsɔ.

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: Na Katɔti kenye kammɔ kadubɔya na bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ lɛnɔ bemwi Katɔti na nwuna kɔnyana bɔnu ɔsu. Katɔti kenye udiene ɔdi ɔ́su Katɔti na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ɔnii, “Ɔmɛni ɔsu ndubumwi-ɔ na bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ akɔ. Na ndubudie bɔƒɔtaadi lɛnu limwi ƒula lɛnyi.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: Na básɔ básu banii, “Amii bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ bɛkɛku Katɔti bekyuli ebiti.”

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: Básɔ básu lɛnɔ banii, “Amii bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ ƒui bimwi Blɔti. Na amii kadi ƒui bekyuli bidie lɛnu bimwi-nwu.”

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Yesaia lɛnɔ ɔ́sɔ únweni ɔnini, “Yese kugyii ugyiitu ɔdubɔta. Na ɔdi ukyuli ɔni ndubɔta na ɔdi kadi ƒui bekyuli lɛlɔ. Na bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ ƒui badubɔkɛ lɛnunsia na nwuna lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: Muuvele nnii Katɔti ɔni ndi bula lɛnunsia ɔya na lɛlɔyɔ lɛƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui, na bɛkɛ keyi buɛɛ aani kalɛ na bíti bina lɛlɔ bɛ́sia-nwu lɛlɔ kenye, kalɛ na Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun ɔya na bina lɛnunsia lɛƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: Banwa, ami ɔlati lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di geen ka ala abuni bɔbla bɔ́ƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui. Na bɛgyi ala ƒui kalɛ na biti ala ammɔ bɛtina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!
translation_verse: Líse kayi geen na línweni ɔku na ala adi bene lɛlɔ aani si bunyimene na nsɔ nda-mii ala ammɔ ɔkɛnku lɛƒɔndia lɛni na Katɔti úte-mi kenye.

english_verse: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔ́bla-mi ɔnii nnwini Kristo kabla ɔblane nte bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ. Na mɔɔbla ɔkpane kabla kani ndi ka lɛkɔ Katɔti litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa lite bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ kalɛ na lɛkpanku-ma liboku Katɔti aani akpala ani Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́bla kedee na adubɔƒɔ Katɔti anu.

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na lɛla lɛni na Yesu Kristo ɔ́bla ɔkɛnku kabla kani na mɔɔbla teete Katɔti ɔsu.

english_verse: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.
translation_verse: Lɛɛɛdubo bɔyii bɔsu lɛla lɛdi na lɛla bamba lɛdi lɛlɔ ntu lɛla lɛni na Kristo ɔ́bla ɔkɛnku-mi lɛlɔ kani. Ɔ́ya na lɛ́kpanku bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ, kalɛ bebo na badi Katɔti litemi lɛlɔ ɔkɛnku lɛla lɛni na lɛ́su-ma na lɛ́bla lɛnɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: Na badubɔbla lɛni ɔkɛnku ɔyikun ala ani na bánu ku akɔla budie taatina ani na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ya na lɛ́bla ɔsu. Anwuɔsu ɔ́si Yerusalem ɔkɛ útávi Iliriko amadɔ ni, lɛ́kɔ Kristo litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa.

english_verse: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
translation_verse: Ɔ́si kukuuku ƒui ni, ɔdi-mi lɛnungyie ka lɛkɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa na kesii kani na baaagyi Kristo. Na ɔɔɔdi banii ntátu lɛsia ɔdi kowodu kalɔ lɛtabi lɛni na ɔ́ɔkya úse lɛlɔ.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: Mmomu lɛla lɛni na bénweni bése na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo líbo-nwu kemmo lɛni banii, “Bekyuli bani na bátasu-ma nwuna lɛlɔ litemi dii ni, badubɔnu-nwu bati. Na bani lɛnɔ nétenu lɛla lɛdi dii ni, badubunu kalɔ.”

english_verse: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
translation_verse: Kabla kamɛni ndi lɛla lɛni neeete-mi kuƒi ɔsu na naaakana-mii kudɔ bubo.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ka kabla kadi kasɔ keeebo-mi mɛni na kalɛkɛ kamɛni lɛlɔ ku ka lɛ́kya ńtaawia ulu akwa pii mɛni ka lɛnu-mii ɔsu ni,

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: lɛ́bla kasusu ka lɛsia-mii kudɔ si lɛ́vi lísela Spania. Mɔɔwia ka lɛsia-mii kudɔ si mɔɔví na bibunku-mi na mina mmɔ busie kemmo si lɛ́kya-mii kudɔ na bɔ́kya lɛlɔ ebiti uwi klukui ɔdi.

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔ́yɔ baƒɔtaadine bani nkya Makedonia ku Akaia kaƒɔ ka beyi egulabi adi bete baƒɔtaadine bawabane bani nkya Yerusalem mmɔ.

english_verse: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ɔ́yɔ-ma kaƒɔ ka babla lɛni. Na badi-ma bayune sɔsɔ! Ɔsika si bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ bákɛ kadikɔ ku Yudaƒuɔ kɔyu kemmo ala abuni ni, agyi anii ama lɛnɔ ɔlɛka bebunku Yudaƒuɔ ku bana akɛla.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si lɛ́bla kabla kamɛni lɛ́wɔlɔ na bákɛ ala ani na béyi mmɔ ni, ndubusie Spania na ndubɔsia-mii kudɔ mmɔ si lísela.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: Ngyi ka ɔni na ndubo-mii kudɔ ni, ndanku Kristo kusɛ kusɛ ƒui ndububoku-mii.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: Banwa, muuvele-mii kpakplaa na Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛnyi kemmo ku Katɔti Kɔyu bɔyɔ kemmo nnii bibunku-mi na bukpo kekpo kani kenye na nnye na bina Katɔti bɔkpali teete-mi kemmo.

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: Bɛkpali katɔ bivele Katɔti na udie-mi na Yudea bekyuli bani nátaƒɔ bátadi enu kemmo kalɛ na mina kabla na Yerusalem mmɔ kaƒɔ Katɔti bekyuli bammɔ anu.

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: Na si Katɔti ɔ́tuna ni, ndububo mbeduo-mii kudɔ ku ebiti, na bula ƒui bɔkɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔni muute keyi buɛɛ ɔsiaku bina ƒui. Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: Muudie bula ɔnwani uleku Ƒoibe lɛtina-mii. Ɔdi ubunkune na Kenkrea baƒɔtaadine akɔ.

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: Na muuvele-mii nnii bigyingya enu na bɛƒɔ-nwu na Blɔti lɛnyi kemmo na ulu ɔni námanku Katɔti bekyuli lɛlɔ. Bite-nwu kebunku biala na wawia wasiku-mii kudɔ, ɔsika úte bekyuli pii kebunku ku ami lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: Bigyele Priska ku Akwila bani ndi mina kabla bablane bakpana na Kristo Yesu kemmo.

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: Bénye kagyumana ka bekpi na mina lili muedi. Na ɔɔɔdi ami lɛti mɔɔgyá-ma enu, mmomu ku bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ baƒɔtaadine akpa ammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Na bigyele baƒɔtaadine bani mɔɔsa na bana kaduli mmɔ lɛnɔ. Bigyele mina ɔkpana Epaineto ɔni náka kayi bunwini ɔ́ƒɔ Kristo na Asia kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: Na bigyele Maria ɔni nábla kabla kpakplaa úte bina lɛkpa lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: Bigyele Androniko ku Yunia bani ndi mina kadi bekyuli bani na ami ku-ma na bákya aban ɔtɔ mmɔ. Bekyuli bagyi-ma geen na batalane bammɔ akɔ. Na ama báka-mi Kristo ɔmmɔ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: Bigyele Amplia ɔni na mɔɔyɔ́ geen na Blɔti lɛnyi kemmo bite-mi.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: Na bigyele Urbana ɔni ndi bula kabla ɔblane ɔkpana na Kristo kemmo. Na bigyele mina ɔkpana ɔyɔne Staki.

english_verse: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
translation_verse: Bigyele Apele ɔni na bɔ́kɔku-nwu bɔ́nu na bɔ́nu ka ɔdia na Kristo kemmo mmɔ. Na bigyele Aristobulo kaduli bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Bigyele Herodion mina kadi ukyuli bite-mi. Na bigyele Narkiso kaduli bekyuli bani néti lɛlɔ béte Blɔti mmɔ.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: Bigyele beleku bani ndi Triƒaina ku Triƒosa bani nábla kabla na Blɔti kemmo. Na bigyele mina ɔkpana ɔyɔne Persi ɔni ndi uleku ɔbambadi ɔni lɛnɔ nábla kabla kpakplaa na Blɔti kemmo.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: Bigyele Ruƒo ɔni náƒɔ lɛnyi na Blɔti kemmo ku uni ɔni náda ami lɛnɔ aani mina uni kalɛ.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: Bigyele Asinkrito ku Ƒlegon ku Herme ku Patroba ku Herme ku bana banwa baƒɔtaadine bani nkya-ma kudɔ.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: Bigyele Ƒilologo ku Yulia ku Nereo ku ɔnwani uleku ku Olimpa ku Katɔti bekyuli bani nkya-ma kudɔ.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Bigyele lɛlɔ na bɛkya lɛlɔ kɔgbu na lɛlɔ bɔbla kedee kemmo. Kristo baƒɔtaadine akpa ammɔ ƒui na Kreta banii beegyele-mii o-o.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: Banwa, mɔɔlɛ-mii kpakplaa nnii binye kagyumana na bekyuli bani muuti bule taakya bekyuli ntɛ lɛlɔ. Na beeti ala bamba ani náta énye bula ala ani na bɔɔtina lɛlɔ teetile-mii kuƒi. Bɛda lɛlɔ bɛmami-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bammɔ udu ni, balábla Blɔti Yesu Kristo kabla. Mmomu ama alati bana ayɔla na baabla. Na bada kenye emini atɛ ku katɔlɔ beeƒú bekyuli bani naaagyi lɛla lɛdi kasusu.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala únu kalɛ na bɛɛdi litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ, anwuɔsu lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi geen na bina lɛlɔ. Nsu mɔɔwia ka bɛda anu na lɛla lɛni ndi lɛbuni lɛlɔ. Na binwini bekyuli bani naaagyi lɛla lɛdi na likpidi ani kudɔ.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔni muute keyi buɛɛ ɔdubususu ukisine ɔmmɔ kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ na ɔya na bɛdi-nwu lɛlɔ na uwi klukui kemmo. Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛƒɔndia lɛsiaku-mii.

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: Timoteo ɔni ndi mina kabla ɔblane ɔkpana uugyele-mii. Na lɛni kani na Lukio lɛnɔ ku Yason ku Sosipatro bani ndi mina kadi bekyuli beegyele-mii.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Ami Tertio ɔni nénweni ɔku ɔmɛni líse lɛnɔ muugyele-mii na Blɔti lɛnyi kemmo.

english_verse: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani ni, bɛya bumwi Katɔti. Anwu ndubɔkana na ɔda-mii na binye kpakplaa aani kalɛ na mɔɔsu na litemi buni lɛni kudu na muubó kemmo ɔkɛnku Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ. Litemi buni lɛmɛni nkɛnku ala abɛdi ani na Katɔti údie keyi na ábɛ-bu na akwa pii ani návi kemmo.

english_verse: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, bédie ala ammɔ keyi béte kalɔ ƒui bekyuli aani kalɛ na nwuna kenye bediene bénweni bése. Katɔti ɔni nli ngba úsela ƒui lɛƒɔyɔ ndi ka ɔlɛka bakɔ litemi buni lɛmɛni lɛsa na kadi ƒui baƒɔ-nwu badi na badi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔni lɛti ndi ɔnundane ni, anwu na ɔlɛka bumwi ka ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui na Yesu Kristo lɛnyi kemmo! Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Ami Paulo ɔni nkɛnku Katɔti lɛƒɔyɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu na ndi Yesu Kristo ɔtalane ku bula ɔnwa Sostene muunweni-mii ɔku ɔmɛni.

english_verse: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
translation_verse: Búnweni ɔku ɔmɛni buute Korintoƒuɔ baƒɔtaadine bani na ɔkɛnku Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ na Katɔti údie úse na ɔ́lɔ-ma ɔnii babla nwuna bekyuli kedee. Lɛni na ɔ́bla bekyuli bani ƒui lɛnɔ mɔɔkpali Blɔti Yesu Kristo. Anwu ndi Blɔti ute abu ku-ma ƒui.

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Buuvele bɔnii bula Unwoti Katɔti ku Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛƒɔndia ku keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-mii. Katɔti Uute-bu Ala Abuni Ɔ́si Yesu Kristo Ɔsu

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Mɔɔgyá Katɔti enu uwi biala na bina lili ɔkɛnku lɛƒɔndia lɛni na úte-mii ɔ́siaku Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ litemi lɛmɛni lɛ́kɛ keliekɔ na bina akɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bilayaki litela lɛdi ɔni na binye bɛgya ka Katɔti ɔya na Blɔti Yesu Kristo ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ.

english_verse: And until the day Christ does return, he will keep you completely innocent.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔgyumana-mii na bɛda bina bɔƒɔtaadi kaduɛ utédu kawɔlɔkɔ. Anwu ndubɔya na si Blɔti Yesu Kristo úbo ubatɛku bayawine litemi ni, kɔtɔ bɔdu bɔdi bulebo-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔni nálɔ-mii ɔnii bɛbla unwi ku Ubidi Blɔti Yesu Kristo ni, ɔdi ukyuli ɔni lɛlɔ na bɛkada bikpo. Bɛnu Lɛlɔ Kemmo Kaduɛ Kalɛ Na Lɛlɔ Bule Bɔdi Bulakya-mii Akɔ

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: Na kenyekɔ kani na Blɔti Yesu Kristo úte-mi kenye ni, mɔɔsu-mii kpakplaa aani mina banwa baƒɔtaadine kalɛ nnii bina ƒui binu lɛlɔ kalɔ kalɛ na lɛlɔ bule bɔdi bulakya-mii akɔ. Na bɛbla unwi na ala ani na bɛɛkali ku ala ani na bɛwia lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ni, banwa, bekyuli badi bási Klo kaduli na básu-mi nwaa banii kadɔ kakya-mii ntɛ.

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Muuye-mii nnii Kristo ule lɛlɔ kemmo akpa akpa? Munuu ni, Paulo nékpi na ugyii lɛlɔ na bina lili? Iye bákpila ɔdi ntu na Paulo lɛnyi kemmo? Oowo!

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: Mɔɔgyá Katɔti enu ka ńtabla ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmmɔ ńtete bina akɔ ɔdi ntu Krispo ku Gaio lɛti pɛ.

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ukyuli ɔdi ulakana bɔsu ɔnii mina lɛnyi kemmo na bákpila-nwu ntu bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: Línyimo ka Steƒana lɛ́bla ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmmɔ líte ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli na nsɔ neeenyimo si lɛ́kpila ukyuli ɔbambadi ɔdi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
translation_verse: Kristo útatala-mi ɔnii mbo mbataabla ntu bɔkpila ɔdi teete bekyuli. Mmomu ɔ́tala-mi ɔnii mbakɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa nte bekyuli. Na naaasu-ni na kayawi lɛnunda ulu ɔdi lɛlɔ. Ɔsika naaayɔ ka ɔyikun ɔni nkɛnku kalɛ na Yesu Kristo úkpi na ugyii lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔyii udu na ɔbla keeke. Kristo Lɛlɔ Litemi Lɛdi Katɔti Ɔyikun Ku Lɛnunda

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani na bana ɔbladu ɔ́ya na badaku bukpi na kɔyu kemmo ni, Kristo kukpi na ugyii lɛlɔ kɔtɛ kɔdi adɔlɔla kute-ma. Nsu abu bani na Katɔti ɔɔyá na bɔɔkɛ́ bɔƒɔ ni, bɔgyi ka Katɔti litemi lɛmmɔ lɛdi Katɔti ɔyikun ɔni na úte-bu.

english_verse: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
translation_verse: Na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ni, Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ndubo banundane lɛnunda udu bɔyila. Na lídie lɛ́tina ka bakutine lɛnunda lɛɛɛdi lɛla lɛdi.”

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔkɛnku nwuna lɛnunda lɛlɔ na ɔ́bla bekyuli lɛni kalɛ na balasia bana kayawi lɛnunda lɛlɔ na bati-nwu. Na nwuna litemi lɛni lɛsa na bɔɔkɔ́ mɛni lɛdi badi adɔlɔla. Nsu Katɔti ɔɔsia-ni lɛlɔ na ɔɔƒɔ́ bekyuli bani na báƒɔ bádi ngba.

english_verse: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
translation_verse: Yudaƒuɔ baawia akɔla budie taatina. Na Helaƒuɔ ama kayawi lɛnunda kani na ama baawia bati.

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: Nsu abu ni, Yesu ɔni na bákana bámana ugyii lɛlɔ litemi na bɔɔsu. Na litemi lɛmɛni lɛɛtu Yudaƒuɔ kayi. Na bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ lɛnɔ ni, beenú-ni aani adɔlɔla.

english_verse: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna ɔ́lɛku bani ndi Yudaƒuɔ ku Helaƒuɔ akɔ ni, Kristo ɔni lɛlɔ litemi na bɔɔsu mɛni ɔdi Katɔti ɔyikun ku nwuna lɛnunda.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛla lɛni na bekyuli baanu banii ɔdi Katɔti kɔdɔlɔ ni, lɛdi lɛnunda litulo bekyuli lɛdi. Na Katɔti bɔbla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ni, bubo ɔyikun butulo bekyuli lɛlɔ ɔkplu.

english_verse: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
translation_verse: Banwa, asa na Katɔti waƒuna-mii ni, binyimo kalɛ na bíse na bekyuli anumi! Bina pii biiibo lɛnunda ku ɔyikun. Iye bítasi kaba kani náƒɔ kuye kadi kemmo.

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: Mmomu Katɔti úse ɔ́ƒuna bekyuli badɔlɔdi na bayawine anumi kalɛ na uti-ma ɔkya kayawi kamɛni banundane kɔƒa. Na ɔ́ƒuna bekyuli bani neeebo ɔyikun ɔdi na bayawine anumi kalɛ na uti ɔkya kayawi kamɛni bayikune kɔƒa.

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna bekyuli bani neeebo kenyekɔ kadi na bayawine anumi, na balábu-ma lɛnɔ taakya lɛla lɛdi kemmo kalɛ na uti ɔyila bekyuli bani na bayawine baabu na báƒɔ kuye udu.

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na ukyuli biala ulakana lɛlɔ katɔ bɔtalaku na Katɔti anumi.

english_verse: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔsu ɔnii, “Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ ni, ɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na lɛla lɛni na Blɔti ɔ́bla lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: Banwa, uwi ɔni na líbo-mii kudɔ na ḿbakɔ Katɔti etemila geen abɛdi lɛsa líte-mii ni, ɔɔɔdi kenyemini iye kayawi lɛlati lɛdi kemmo na líti lɛ́tɛmiku-mii.

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na ḿbakya-mii kudɔ ni, lɛ́tɛmiku-mii na Yesu Kristo ɔmmɔ lɛti pɛ lɛlɔ. Na ɔni ntulo ƒui ndi nwuna kukpi na ugyii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.
translation_verse: Na ka líbo-mii kudɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛ́bla-mi kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. Na liƒu lɛ́da-mi. Na lɛlɔ lɛnɔ lɛ́tɔ-mi.

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: Na bɛdubɔnu ka mina ala ani na lɛ́tina ƒui ni, eeese aani ukyuli ɔni na kenye káda-nwu na úbo lɛnunda. Mmomu mina etemila bɔsu búdie bɔ́tina geen kalɛ na Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun use.

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, ɔɔɔdi ɔyawine lɛnunda lɛlɔ na bɛ́sia bɛ́ƒɔ Kristo bɛ́di, mmomu Katɔti ɔyikun lɛlɔ. Katɔti Kɔyu Kɔgyi Lɛla Biala Na Katɔti Lɛlɔ

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, mina kenye kani na mɔɔsu ni, kadanku bekyuli bani náda anu na béesie anumi na kɔyu kemmo ala kalɔ bunu kemmo. Na kaaadanku kayawi kamɛni kemmo lɛnunda iye bayikune bani mɔɔdi kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ na baayii ku udu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
translation_verse: Lɛnunda lɛni kenye na muudie mɛni ni, lɛdi Katɔti lɛnunda lɛni nábɛ bekyuli. Nsu Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna-ni úse kukuuku ka lɛƒɔ-bu asa na údie kayawi.

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: Kayawi kamɛni bayikune ɔdi biala útati lɛnunda lɛmɛni. Ɔsika si bɔti na báti-ni ni, nka bátakana Blɔti bátamana ugyii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: Nsu Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔsu ɔnii, “Lɛla lɛni na ɔdi útanu iye útenu, na ɔdi útakali lɛnɔ ka lɛdubɔlɛ ni, ani geen ndi lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́klibi úse úte bekyuli bani mɔɔyɔ́-nwu.”

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Nsu abu ɔsu na Katɔti údie nwuna abɛla amɛni keyi ɔkɛnku nwuna Kɔyu lɛlɔ. Katɔti Kɔyu kɔɔwia lɛla biala kemmo ɔti, na ɔgyi Katɔti abɛla muedi.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na ukyuli kɔyu kɔni nkya-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo kɔgyi lɛla biala na nwuna lɛlɔ ni, lɛni kani na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔgyi lɛla biala na Katɔti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Na abu ni, ɔɔɔdi kɔyu kɔni mɔɔdi alaekpidi bablane lɛlɔ nkya-bu lɛlɔ kemmo. Mmomu Katɔti Kɔyu kɔni ndubɔya na bɔti etela ani na bɔ́kɛ bɔ́siku-nwu kudɔ ku kaƒɔ ƒaa ni, aku nkya-bu lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, ɔɔɔdi kayawi kammɔ lɛnunda ala ani bekyuli baatina kemmo na búti bɔɔtɛmiku-mii. Mmomu buudie ala amɛni kalɔ teete-mii aani kalɛ na Katɔti Kɔyu kúdie ala ammɔ kalɔ kɔ́tina-bu.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo ni, ɔɔkana na ɔɔnu lɛla biala taati. Nsu anwu ni, bekyuli balakana-nwu bɔnu bɔti.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔɔgyi Katɔti lili kemmo. Na ɔdi lɛnɔ ulakana-nwu lɛla lɛdi bɔtina.” Nsu abu ni, Kristo kakali kakya-bu lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: Banwa, na litemi geen bɔsu kenye ni, naaakana na matɛmiku-mii aani kalɛ na mɔɔtɛmiku bekyuli bani na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo. Mmomu ndubɔtɛmiku-mii aani bekyuli bani na bana anu amu asia kayawi ala lɛlɔ. Na bɛmu bɛdi banamu wɛlɛ wɛlɛ na Kristo bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
translation_verse: Mina ala ani matina-mii ni, ɔlɛka ese kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ aani kalɛ na lɛnyintu lɛ́manku líte ubiwɔ. Na ɔɔɔdi ala ani kalɔ bunu mbo ɔkplu aani kalɛ na ukyuli ɔni nálɛ lili ɔɔdi ala ani mbo unu kalɛ.

english_verse: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bɛmu bilie ngba aani bekyuli bani néti bana kasusu básia kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ ala lɛti pɛ lɛlɔ. Na si lɛnungyie lɛkya-mii akɔ na bɛɛdɔ ni, ɔmmɔ lɛti muedi ɔɔtina ka kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ ala na bilie bite.

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Si bina akɔ ɔdi ɔ́su ɔnii, “Ami Paulo kama nsia,” na ɔbambadi lɛnɔ ɔnii, “Ami Apolo kama nsia” ni, bɛɛbla ala aani bekyuli bani na kayawi kasusu kani ńaƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
translation_verse: Na amɛni ƒui kama ni, ɔma ndi Apolo? Na ɔma ndi Paulo? Katɔti kabla bablane kani na bɔdi. Na bula lɛlɔ na bɛ́sia bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́di. Na bula akɔ ɔdi biala ɔdanku kabla kani na Katɔti úte-nwu ɔnii ɔbla.

english_verse: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
translation_verse: Ami nése kabla kammɔ kalɔ aani kalɛ baavá kugyii kebi. Na Apolo néwi-ka ntu. Nsu Katɔti náya na kálɛ lili.

english_verse: What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, ukyuli ɔni náva ku ukyuli ɔni néwi ntu ni, bana ƒui baaadi lɛla lɛdi. Na mmomu Katɔti ɔdi nda, ɔsika anwu náya na kálɛ lili.

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Kavumana kadi keeebo ukyuli ɔni náva ku ɔni néwi-ka ntu kemmo. Katɔti kani ndubɔƒɔ bana ƒui kayu na bana kabla kenye.

english_verse: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
translation_verse: Ɔsika bɔdi bakpana na kabla kenwi kemmo. Na bɔ́sala bɔɔbla-ka teete Katɔti. Na amii bise aani Katɔti kemmo kani lɛlɔ na bunye bɔɔtuma. Na bise lɛnɔ aani ɔtɔ ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́tu.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: Na Katɔti lɛla lɛni na úte-mi kenye ni, lɛ́bla kabla aani ɔtɔ ɔtune ɔbuni kalɛ. Na lɛ́kya ɔtɔ kalɔ lɛtabi. Na ukyuli bamba úbo ɔɔtú taasia. Nsu ɔdi ka ɔdi biala ɔnu kaduɛ kalɛ na ɔɔtú taasia ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: Nsu si ɔtɔ ɔni na ɔdi biala ɔ́tu ɔdia iye ɔɔɔdia ni, Kristo limeyi bonwu lɛmmɔ ndubudie bana kabla bɔtina. Ɔsika limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ogya ndubo ɔdi biala kabla keyi budie. Ogya ɔmɛni ndubo kabla biala bɔkɔku bɔnu na ɔnu si kabla kammɔ kadia.

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: Nsu si ɔdi atula ani na úti ɔ́tu ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ákywi ni, ulákɛ lɛyuƒɔla lɛdi. Nsu anwu ɔlati ɔdubɔkɛ bɔƒɔ aani si úkeli ɔ́lɛ ogya ɔmmɔ kemmo. Amii Alati Ndi Katɔti Kakpakɔ Kedee

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Bɛti nwaa ka amii alati ndi Katɔti kakpakɔ. Na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔkya-mii lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti kakpakɔ kese kedee, na amii ndi nwuna kakpakɔ kammɔ. Anwuɔsu si ɔdi úgyingya Katɔti kakpakɔ kammɔ ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔyila-nwu udu.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: Bina akɔ ɔdi utatɔlɔ lɛlɔ. Si bina akɔ ɔdi ɔɔnu lɛlɔ aani kayawi kamɛni ɔnundane ni, ɔbla lɛlɔ ɔdɔlɔdi mmomu na bekyuli anumi kalɛ na wenwini ɔnundane geen sɔsɔ na Katɔti anumi.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛla lɛni na bayawine baanu aani lɛnunda na kayawi ni, ani ndi kɔdɔlɔ na Katɔti anumi. Na lɛni na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔnini, “Banundane kakwɛ na Katɔti uuti taakywɛ ama alati kakpagyuɛ.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: Na básɔ bénweni banii, “Katɔti ɔgyi ka banundane kasusu kaaadi lɛla lɛdi.”

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: Paulo iye Apolo iye Petro iye kayawi kamɛni o-o iye kukpi ku ngba o-o iye ɔƒɛni ku uwi ɔni mebo ni, ala ammɔ ƒui adi amii adi.

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: Na Kristo ɔdi na bɛdi. Na Kristo lɛnɔ ɔdi Katɔti ɔdi.

english_verse: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Bitaanu-bu aani Kristo kabla bablane bani mɔɔnu Katɔti etemila geen ani na útedie keyi dii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Na lɛlakpa linwi lɛni kani na Unwoti ɔɔwia taasiku nwuna ala lɛlɔ ɔnune ɔmɛni udu kudɔ ndi ka ɔ́bla kabla kammɔ ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ni, lɛɛɛdaku-ni si ɔdi ɔɔtɛku-mi litemi iye ɔdi ɔkɛnku kayawi lɛnunda lɛdi kenye ɔɔnu ɔnii lɛ́ƒiɔ. Naaatɛku ami ɔlati lɛlɔ muedi litemi.

english_verse: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
translation_verse: Mina kayi kaladu-mi kɔtɔ kɔdi. Nsu ɔmɛni uléte-mi ubo ɔnii lɛ́ɛlɛ sɛɛn na likpidi ku litemi bɔtɛ kemmo. Ɔsika Blɔti ndubɔtɛku-mi litemi.

english_verse: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, ɔdi utatɛku ɔkpanadi litemi wetédu ka uwi ɔbuni ɔmmɔ webo. Si uwi ɔni na Blɔti úbo ni, anwu ndubɔtɛku ukyuli biala litemi na limeyi likplodi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na anwu ndubudie kasuudikɔ ala abɛdi keyi na ɔdubudie ala ani na bekyuli kakali kadanku ɔtina. Mmɔ na Katɔti ɔdubumwi ukyuli biala kalɛ na ɔ́bla nwuna kabla ɔ́vinku.

english_verse: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
translation_verse: Banwa, kalɛ na binu ala ani na mɔɔsu kalɔ ɔsu na líti ami ku Apolo línwini lɛla lɛni na bɛnu bɛtɛya. Na bɛtɛya ala ani kalɔ na etemila amɛni eedie taatina ɔni na bénweni banii, “Bɛbla ala bɛsiaku ulu lɛlɔ.” Ɔmɛni ɔsu bitatalaku ukyuli ɔdi katɔ bitetulo ɔbambadi.

english_verse: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
translation_verse: Ɔma nédie-ɔ na áƒɔ kuye étulo ƒula ɔkpana? Ala ani na ebo ƒui ni, Katɔti néti-nya úte-ɔ. Na si lɛni na ɔdi ni, bi ɔsu na aakun lɛmɛnɛ aani si ɔɔɔdi Katɔti néte-ɔ ala ani na ébo?

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: Bɔsa na ala ani ƒui na bɛɛwia áasa-mii? Munuu balakɛne na biinwíni? Bɛ́ɛta bínwini baga ina ka bɔɔɔdi baga? Awo! Mɔɔyɔ́ si nka banii baga na bíinwini. Na abu lɛnɔ bunwini baga aani bina kalɛ!

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: Ɔsika use-mi aani si abu batalane ni, keliekɔ kekplodi na Katɔti úti ute-bu. Na buse aani bekyuli bani na bádu-ma kukpi kɔtɔ ka badu-ma na kadi anumi. Na kayawi ƒui ku Katɔti batu benye banu.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Bɔdi badɔlɔdi na Kristo ɔsu. Nsu amii bɛdi banundane ka bɛ́bla unwi ku Kristo ɔsu. Abu buse aani bekyuli bani na ekubi eeebo-ma lɛlɔ kemmo. Nsu amii ni, lɛlɔ lɛ́sa-mii. Bɔɔɔdi lɛla lɛdi na bekyuli anumi. Nsu amii ni, bibo ɔbu.

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: Úti úbalɛ ku ɔƒɛni ni, bɔkɛ ku kɔka ku utukwɛ. Na buuubo adala abuni adi. Na bekyuli beebó-bu. Na buuubo keliekɔ kadi.

english_verse: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
translation_verse: Na bɔɔbla kabla kpakplaa na buutú lɛlɔ. Si bekyuli béwida-bu ni, abu buute-ma kusɛ kusɛ. Ina dɛ na basiaku-bu beekpóku-bu ni, bɔɔkya ɔkplu.

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: Si bédumi-bu ni, kayi buɛɛ etemila na buuti teedie lɛlɔ kenye. Bɔɔɔdi lɛla lɛdi buuutulo kayawi kamɛni kebu. Kalɔ kamɛni alaekpidi kewiakunkɔ na bɔdi úti úbalɛku ɔƒɛni.

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi kɔƒa na nnii mɔɔkya-mii ɔsu na muunweni-mii ɔku ɔmɛni udu. Mmomu mɔɔlɛ-mii aani mina bebi bayɔne kalɛ.

english_verse: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Ɔsika si ina bibo bekyuli mpim leevu muedi bani mɔɔnu-mii lɛlɔ na bina bɔƒɔtaadi ngba bɔni na bilie kemmo ni, ɔɔɔdi bati pii náwɔ-mii. Ɔsika kalɛ na bilie ngba na bɛ́bla unwi ku Kristo ɔsu ni, ami nénwini bina ɔti na ɔni na lɛ́ka litemi buni lɛmmɔ buti buboku-mii ɔsu.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, muuvele-mii nnii bɛsiaku mina ɔbladu kama.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni lɛlɔ geen ɔsu na mɔɔtala Timoteo lɛkya-mii. Ɔdi-mi ubi ɔyɔne geen ɔni mɔɔbla Blɔti kabla ulu lɛlɔ. Ɔdubo ubenyimene-mii Kristo ngba bɔwɔdi ulu ɔni kama na nsia. Na ɔmmɔ na mɔɔtina baƒɔtaadine ƒui na kesii biala.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: Bina akɔ badi báta bénwini bekyuli bani mɔɔtina lɛlɔ teetulo bakpanadi, ɔsika bákali banii nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo naaabanu-mii.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: Na si Blɔti ɔ́tuna ni, ndubo mbanu-mii na uwi klukui ɔdi kemmo. Na ami ɔlati ndubɔnu ɔyikun ɔni na bekyuli bani mɔɔtina lɛlɔ mɛni bebo, na lɛnu si ɔɔɔdi atɛ keeke kani na baatɛmi.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti lɛga bɔdi bɔɔɔdanku atɛ keeke bɔtɛmi. Mmomu bɔdanku ɔyikun.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Bɛɛyɔ́ ka libo-mii kudɔ na mbani-mii kɔtu, munuu mbo-mii kudɔ ku anumi buɛɛ na bɔyɔ kemmo?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, bekyuli baasu nwaa ka ni, bina akɔ badi baadi kɔsɔnɔ kɔni ntulo bɔsu. Na bekyuli bani naaadi baƒɔtaadine muedi balakana ɔmmɔ udu bɔbla. Básu-mi banii ɔnana ɔdi ku ɔti ulekudi baatɛ!

english_verse: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
translation_verse: Na bi ɔsu na bɛɛtina lɛlɔ? Ɔlɛka biteewulo kɔnyana mmomu. Na ukyuli ɔni nábla lɛla lɛmɛni udu ni, ɔdi ka bɛda-nwu bidie bina baƒɔtaadine akɔ.

english_verse: I am with you only in my thoughts. But in the name of our Lord Jesus I have already judged this man, as though I were with you in person. So when you meet together and the power of the Lord Jesus is with you, I will be there too.
translation_verse: na Blɔti Yesu Kristo ɔyikun kemmo. Si bɛ́sala lɛlɔ ni, na ɔbla-mii ka ami lɛnɔ nkya-mii akɔ na kɔyu kemmo. Na Blɔti Yesu Kristo ɔyikun ɔdubɔkya-bu akɔ.

english_verse: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ka bɛnyonu ukyuli ɔmmɔ bite Satan na nwuna ɔyikun ususu-nwu ɔlɔna. Na ina úkpi muedi ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ kɔyu kɔkɛ bɔƒɔ na limeyi lɛni lɛlɔ na Yesu watɛku kayawi bekyuli ƒui litemi.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: Útalɛka bitaatina lɛlɔ. Bɛɛɛgyi bɛnii bɔnyii blii mɔɔsálaku ɔlaaƒɔ ɔni na bánwu na ɔɔyá na ɔna ƒui uuƒu?

english_verse: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.
translation_verse: Bɛda bɔnyii biala bɔni ndi likpidi bidie bina akɔ. Na bɛbla aani ɔlaaƒɔ ɔwɔdi ɔni na bánwu, na bɔnyii bɔdi buuubo-nwu kemmo aani kalɛ na ngyi ka bise sɔsɔ kalɛ. Ɔsika bula Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi líidu. Na ɔƒɛni ni, báadu bula Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Lɛkpa Koƒonu Ubi ɔni ndi Kristo.

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, bitaya na bɔdi bula Kukpi Lili Bɔvia Limeyi ku bodobodo ɔni kemmo na bɔnyii bɔkukudi bɔni ndi likpidi ku likyulikpi ala ani bɔɔbla akya. Mmomu bɔɔdi limeyi lɛmɛni ku bodobodo ɔni kemmo na bɔnyii buuubo na bɔɔtina ka bɔɔɔdi anumi lɛlɔ bekyuli. Mmomu bɔkɛnku litemi geen lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: Na ɔku ɔni na línweni-mii kemmo ni, lɛ́su-mii nnii bitasala lɛlɔ ku bekyuli bani mɔɔdi kɔsɔnɔ.

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ni, ɔɔɔdi bekyuli bani naaadi baƒɔtaadine na nda. Badi bekyuli bani mɔɔdi kɔsɔnɔ na bebo lɛnungyie ku bani muuti bekyuli egulabi taadi, na baakpá baƒiɔ lɛnɔ. Na si bɛnii bɛɛmami-ma lɛlɔ bɔdi anwu ni, ɔdi ka bɛvi bɛlɛ kayawi kemodi kammɔ ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: I was talking about your own people who are immoral or greedy or worship idols or curse others or get drunk or cheat. Don't even eat with them!
translation_verse: Mmomu lɛla lɛni mɔɔtina ndi ka ukyuli ɔni na ɔɔlɔ lɛlɔ ɔnii ɔnwa ɔƒɔtaadine nsu ɔɔdi kɔsɔnɔ iye ubo lɛnungyie iye ɔɔkpá baƒiɔ iye ɔɔlɔ bekyuli anyikpi iye uukpi ntɛ iye uuyú ni, awɔ ku-nwu bitabla lɛla lɛdi bitasala. Na bitakya kɔnu lɛkyami linwi kemmo bitadi muedi.

english_verse: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
translation_verse: Si bina akɔ ɔdi ɔ́kɛku ɔƒɔtaadine ɔkpana litemi ni, útalɛka uti litemi lɛmmɔ usienku bekyuli bani naaadi baƒɔtaadine kudɔ ka basu-ni bete-nwu. Mmomu bina akɔ ɔdi ɔlɛka ɔsu-ni.

english_verse: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
translation_verse: Bɛgyi ka Katɔti bekyuli ndubɔtɛku kayawi bekyuli litemi. Na si bɛgyi ka amii ndubɔtɛku kayawi bekyuli litemi ni, ɔdi ka bɛkana na bɛtɛ etemila wɛlɛ wɛlɛ.

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Bɛgyi nwaa ka abu baƒɔtaadine ndubɔtɛku katɔ batu litemi. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na útalɛka kayawi etemila wɛlɛ wɛlɛ amɛni étulo-bu.

english_verse: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si etemila amɛni udu akya bina akɔ ni, ina bekyuli bani na bilábu na bina akɔ muedi na bɛƒuna ka basu-ni muedi ni, nka ɔdia utulo ka bisie ɔgbami.

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii ɔmɛni na kɔƒa kukpo-mii. Ukyuli unwi pɛ ɔdi anwu ɔkya bina akɔ ɔni ndubɔkana na ɔklibi etemila amɛni na baƒɔtaadine ntɛ.

english_verse: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
translation_verse: Nsu ɔnwa ɔƒɔtaadine uuti ɔkpanadi teesienku bekyuli bani naaadi baƒɔtaadine kudɔ banii batɛ bana etemila.

english_verse: But instead, you cheat and rob other followers.
translation_verse: Nsu amii alati mmomu mɔɔƒiɔ́ lɛlɔ. Na biiyú bina banwa baƒɔtaadine ala muedi.

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: Lɛni na nka amii badi bíse. Nsu Blɔti ɔ́ƒɔ-mii ekpidi údie-mii lɛlɔ kemmo na ɔ́bla-mii kedee úte Katɔti. Na amii ku Katɔti ntɛ bɔ́sɔ bɔ́dia ɔkɛ Blɔti Yesu Kristo ku Katɔti Kɔyu ɔsu. Bɛda Bina Ɔlɔna Kedee Na Bite Katɔti Ɔbu

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
translation_verse: Bina akɔ ɔdi ɔdubɔsu ɔnii, “Mbo kuƒi ka lɛbla lɛla biala.” Sɔsɔ na ɔdi. Nsu lɛla biala lɛɛɛdia liiite-ɔ. Lɛkana na lɛsu nnii, “Mbo kuƒi na lɛbla lɛla biala.” Nsu útalɛka lɛla biala lɛdi-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: Ukyuli bamba lɛnɔ ɔdubɔkana na ɔsu ɔnii, “Kaƒɔ ɔsu na bédie adila, na kaƒɔ na adila ese ete.” Sɔsɔ na ɔdi, nsu Katɔti ɔdubɔya na ana ƒui uwi ubavi. Na ɔɔɔdi ka buti bula ɔlɔna butaabla kɔsɔnɔ bɔdi ala. Mmomu ɔdi ka buti butaabla Blɔti kabla. Na anwu ɔdubute ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ lɛla lɛni námanku-nwu.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́gyila Blɔti ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ, na ɔdubɔgyila abu lɛnɔ ku nwuna ɔyikun.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Bɛgyi ka bina ɔlɔna ɔdi Kristo ɔlɔna kakɛ kadi. Na útamanku ka eti Kristo ɔlɔna kakɛ kadi atámanaku ukyuli ɔni ndi lɛyalɛ ala ɔblane lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Bɛgyi lɛnɔ ka si ukyuli úti nwuna ɔlɔna útámanaku ɔyalɛ ɔdi lɛlɔ ni, ɔ́blaku-nwu unwi na ɔlɔna kemmo. Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su nwaa ɔnii, “Bana inyɔ badubɔbla ɔlɔna unwi.”

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli ɔni na úti lɛlɔ ɔ́mana Blɔti lɛlɔ ni, ɔ́blaku-nwu unwi na kɔyu kemmo.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Bɛsɔ bitabla kɔsɔnɔ ala. Likpidi bamba udu biala na ukyuli ɔ́bla ni, lɛɛɛdanku nwuna ɔlɔna. Nsu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi kɔsɔnɔ ni, ɔɔbla nwuna ɔlɔna ɔlati likpidi.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Bɛgyi nwaa ka ni, bina ɔlɔna ɔdi kakpakɔ ute Katɔti Kɔyu kɔni na Katɔti úti úte-mii na kulie-mii lɛlɔ kemmo. Ɔɔɔdi amii alati mbo bina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti ɔ́ƒɔ kayu bonwu na bina lili. Anwuɔsu biti bina ɔlɔna bɛbla ala ani muute Katɔti ɔbu.

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku ɔku ɔni na bínweni-mi etemila lɛlɔ ni, mɔɔsu-mii nnii si ɔnana ɔdi elie na átawia anii eeti uleku ni, agyi anii ábla-nwu kaduɛ.

english_verse: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
translation_verse: Nsu ka lɛsɔnɔdi lɛ́bɔ ɔsu ni, ɔlɛka ɔnana biala ɔkɛ nwuna uleku. Na uleku biala lɛnɔ ɔkɛ nwuna ɔgya.

english_verse: Husbands and wives should be fair with each other about having sex.
translation_verse: Útalɛka ɔnana uni ulekudi kudɔ buse. Na útalɛka uleku lɛnɔ uni ɔgyani kudɔ bɔtɛ.

english_verse: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
translation_verse: Ɔsika uleku ɔlɔna ɔɔɔdi anwu lɛti ɔdi. Mmomu ɔdi ɔgyani lɛnɔ ɔdi. Na lɛni kani na ɔnana ɔlɔna lɛnɔ ɔɔɔdi anwu lɛti ɔdi. Mmomu ulekudi lɛnɔ ɔdi na ɔdi.

english_verse: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Si bana akɔ ɔdi ɔɔda ɔdi ɔkwɛ ni, ɔtuna ute-nwu amu ntu bɔka na bɛ́ka lɛlɔ kalɔ bunu ka bɛbla lɛni na biti uwi ɔmmɔ bite katɔ bɔkpali. Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, ɔdi ka bɛsɔ bilie kalɛ kani na bilie kukuuku. Si bɛ́bla lɛni ni, bileduo ukisine ɔmmɔ kakpagyuɛ kemmo. Ɔsika bilakana lɛlɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi na bɛsɔ bilie lɛni ƒui.

english_verse: I wish all of you were like me, but God has given different gifts to each of us.
translation_verse: Geen geen ni, ɔdia ute-mii si banii ɔdi biala use aani kalɛ na ami nse. Nsu ni, ɔdi biala ku lɛla lɛni na Katɔti úte-nwu. Ukyuli ɔdi ubo litela lɛdi, na ɔdi lɛnɔ ubo lɛbambadi.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Amu na bakinsi ku bekpinele ni, mɔɔsu-mii ka si bɛ́ƒɔ lɛlɔ bíse na bítelie agya iye bíteti beleku aani mina kalɛ ni, ɔdia utulo.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Nsu si bilakana lɛlɔ bɔda ɔ́si ala ani mɔɔda-mii ɔkwɛ ɔsu ni, bɛkana na bilie agya iye biti beleku. Ɔsika si bɛ́bla lɛni ni, ɔdia utulo ɔni na bitaabla lɛyalɛ ala taavi.

english_verse: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
translation_verse: Na bagya ku bele ni, muubó-ma ɔda ɔni naaadi mina ɔdi. Mmomu Blɔti muubó-ma ɔda ɔmɛni. Ɔɔɔdi ka uleku ɔlɛ ɔgyani kesii.

english_verse: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
translation_verse: Na si ɔ́lɛ ni, ɔdi ka anwu lɛti pɛ ɔsɔ ulie iye anwu ku ɔgyani ɔmmɔ basɔ babla unwi. Na utalɛka ɔnana lɛnɔ ɔnyonu ulekudi.

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
translation_verse: Na amii bakladi ni, mɔɔsu-mii ɔmɛni, nsu ɔɔɔdi Blɔti ɔda bubo. Si ɔƒɔtaadine ɔdi ubo uleku ɔni naaadi ɔƒɔtaadine na uleku ɔmmɔ ɔ́tuna ka basɔ belie ni, tanyonu-nwu.

english_verse: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani si uleku ɔƒɔtaadine ɔdi úlieku ɔnana ɔni naaadi ɔƒɔtaadine na ɔnana ɔmmɔ únu kalɔ ka basɔ belie ni, uleku ɔmmɔ utalɛ-nwu kesii.

english_verse: Your husband or wife who isn't a follower is made holy by having you as a partner. This also makes your children holy and keeps them from being unclean in God's sight.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔgyani ɔni nátaƒɔ útadi mmɔ ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔbla-nwu kedee ɔkɛnku uleku ɔni náƒɔ ɔ́di mmɔ ɔsu. Na lɛni kani na Katɔti ɔdubɔbla uleku ɔni nátaƒɔ útadi mmɔ kedee na awɔ ɔnana ɔni náƒɔ ádi mmɔ ɔsu. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, bana bebi balabla kedee. Nsu kalɛ na use ni, Katɔti ɔɔbla bebi bamɛni kedee.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Nsu si ukyuli ɔni naaadi ɔƒɔtaadine mmɔ ɔɔwia ka ɔtɔlɔ ɔni ndi ɔƒɔtaadine ɔmmɔ kudɔ ni, ɔkana na ɔtɔlɔ ƒaa. Na ulu ɔmɛni udu lɛlɔ ni, uleku ɔƒɔtaadine ɔmmɔ iye ɔnana ni, ubo kuƒi ka ɔbla lɛla lɛni na ɔɔyɔ́. Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-bu ɔnii bubelie ngba ku keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower? Obeying the Lord at All Times
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu awɔ uleku ɔƒɔtaadine si élieku ƒ'ɔgyani lɛni ni, ɔƒaalɛ adubudie-nwu alɛku ekpidi kemmo. Lɛni kani na awɔ ɔnana ɔƒɔtaadine lɛnɔ ni, si awɔ ku ƒ'ulekudi bílie lɛni ni, ɔƒaalɛ adubudie-nwu alɛku ekpidi kemmo. Lie ngba ku kuƒi kɔni na ebo asa na Katɔti úte-ɔ ƒula uleku.

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na mɔɔtina na baƒɔtaadine akpa ƒui akɔ ni, anwu ndi ka ɔdi biala usie anumi na ulie ngba na kuƒi kɔni na Blɔti úte-nwu ɔkɛnku nwuna kenyekɔ lɛlɔ uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-nwu.

english_verse: If you are already circumcised, don't try to change it. If you are not circumcised, don't get circumcised.
translation_verse: Si ékulo lego asa na Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-ɔ ni, na eti-nwu lɛni kani. Na si étekulo tɔ lego asa na Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-ɔ ni, awɔ lɛnɔ sɔ tasu anii etékulo lego.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si ɔdi ékulo lego iye étekulo lego ni, ɔmmɔ ɔɔɔda. Mmomu kalɛ na abla lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́su-bu ka bɔbla ni, anwu nda.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu kuƒi kɔni na ebo na ƒula kenyekɔ uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-ɔ ni, da-nwu lɛni kani.

english_verse: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli bamba kabla na aabla asa Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-ɔ ni, ɔmmɔ utekpoku-ɔ. Nsu si ákɛ ulu ɔni na ada ukyuli bamba kabla bɔbla aya na akɛ bɔnwuna ni, sia ulu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
translation_verse: Si aabla ukyuli bamba kabla asa na Blɔti ɔ́lɔ-ɔ ni, énwini ukyuli ɔni na ebo bɔnwuna na Blɔti kudɔ. Na lɛni kani na si aabla awɔ ɔlati kabla asa na Blɔti ɔ́lɔ-ɔ ni, énwini ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla Blɔti kabla.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔ́ƒɔ kayu bonwu na bina lili. Anwuɔsu bɛsɔ bitenwini bekyuli bamba kabla bablane.

english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni na lɛla lɛni na bíye na bakinsi lɛlɔ ni, ńtaƒɔ ɔda bubo bɔdi ńtasiku Blɔti kudɔ. Nsu ka Blɔti ɔ́nu-mi kɔnyana na ndi ukyuli ɔni na lɛ́manku ɔsu ni, mina kasusu ndi kamɛni.

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ábu ánu kalɛ na beekpóku bekyuli uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ni, mɔɔbu nnii ɔdia ute ɔnana utulo si ɔdi ɔkinsi.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Na si éti uleku ni, tasu anii aanyonu-nwu. Na si eeeti ni, tasu anii atáwia uleku ɔdi eti.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, si éti uleku ni, átabla likpidi lɛdi. Na si uleku ɔni na nka uuulie kɔgya úlie kɔgya ni, útabla likpidi lɛdi. Nsu mɔɔyɔ́ ka lɛda-mii lidie abi ani na ɔgya ku ule beebó na bana ngba kemmo.

english_verse: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu-mii ni, ani ndi ka uwi ɔ́sɔ útene. Na ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ni, ɔdi ka amii beleku bagya bilie ngba aani bakinsi.

english_verse: It will be all the same if you are crying or laughing, or if you are buying or are completely broke.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani muuwulo ni, babla aani si bana lɛlɔ liiibo kɔnyana. Na bani mɔɔmá ni, babla aani si kubiti kuláda-ma. Na bekyuli bani muuyé ala ni, babla aani si ala ani na béye ƒui aaadi bana ɔdi.

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: Na bani nnye kayawi kamɛni akɛla kenye ni, beteti anu batasia-nya lɛlɔ. Ɔsika kalɛ na bɔɔnu kayawi kamɛni ɔƒɛni ni, ɔɔɔdi lɛni na kadubo buse na uwi klukui ɔdi kama.

english_verse: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɔɔwia ka bɛda kasusu bidie lɛla biala lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ɔnana ɔkinsi ni, uuti nwuna kasusu taasia Blɔti kabla lɛlɔ na ɔɔkya ɔkplu ka ɔbla lɛla lɛni mayɔ Blɔti kaƒɔ.

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔnana ɔni nti uleku anwu ni, nwuna kasusu kaasia kayawi ala lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ɔɔwia ka ɔbla lɛla lɛni mayɔ ulekudi kaƒɔ.

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, ala ammɔ aaní-nwu teenene ɔƒɛnyi ɔni ku ɔni ƒui. Na uleku ɔkinsi iye adagyaa ni, uuti nwuna kasusu taasia Blɔti kabla lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ɔɔwia ka uti lɛlɔ ƒui ute na kɔyu ku ɔlɔna kemmo. Na uleku ɔni na ulie kɔgya ni, nwuna kasusu kaasia kayawi ala lɛlɔ, ɔsika ɔɔwia ka ɔbla lɛla lɛni mayɔ ɔgyani kaƒɔ.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Mɔɔwia ka libunku-mii. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na mɔɔsu-mii ala amɛni. Neeenyimi-mii ku ɔda bubo bɔdi. Mmomu mɔɔyɔ́ ka bilie ngba na ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na bɛkana na biti lɛlɔ bite Blɔti lɛti ƒui kede kede ku bina kayi ƒui.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Na si ɔnana ku uleku ɔni na bálɛ lɛlɔ kegye bánu ka basɔ balakana bulie kpoo na betu uwi kalɛ na nka bákali ni, bakana na beti lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔdi likpidi.

english_verse: But it is better to have self-control and to make up your mind not to marry.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔnana ɔni nábla kasusu kpakplaa ka uleti-nwu na wakana na wada lɛlɔ lɛni ni, ɔkana na ɔda-nwu buti ɔya. Ɔnana ɔmɛni lɛnɔ ɔ́bla kaduɛ.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, ɔnana ɔni néti uleku mmɔ ni, ɔ́bla kaduɛ. Nsu ɔni néteti uleku mmɔ ni, ɔ́bla kaduɛ útulo.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Uleku ɔni na ulie kɔgya ni, uuubo kuƒi ka ulie kɔgya bamba na uwi ɔni na ɔgyani ɔmu uli ngba. Na si ɔgyani ɔmmɔ úkpi ni, mmɔ asa na ɔdubɔkana na ulieku ɔnana ɔbambadi biala na ɔɔyɔ́. Nsu ɔdi ka ɔnana ɔmmɔ ɔbla ɔƒɔtaadine.

english_verse: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
translation_verse: Na si ɔ́kana na ɔ́sɔ útelie kɔgya ni, ɔdubɔkɛ ebiti utulo. Ɔmɛni na mina kasusu kaatina-mi, na lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di ka ɔdi Katɔti Kɔyu lɛƒɔyɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, mɔɔyɔ́ ka lɛsu-mii lɛla lɛdi na adila ani na béti bákpa na baƒiɔ abi lɛlɔ. Bɔɔsu bɔnii bula ƒui bubo lɛlati. Nsu bɔgyi lɛnɔ ka lɛlati lɛmɛni lɛɛyá na ukyuli uuƒu na ɔɔtina lɛlɔ. Nsu lɛla lɛni mɔɔkya-bu ogya ni, ani ndi si aayɔ́ bekyuli.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔkali ɔnii ɔgyi lɛla lɛdi ni, geen geen ni, ɔɔɔgyi-ni kalɛ na ɔlɛka ɔti.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti ni, Katɔti ɔgyi-nwu.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ndi lɛla lɛni mɔɔsu-mii na adila ani na béti bákpa na baƒiɔ abi lɛlɔ bɔdi lɛlɔ. Bɔgyi ka ala ani na bekyuli bábla bése baakpá ni, aaadi lɛla lɛdi na kayawi kamɛni kemmo. Ɔsika bɔgyi ka Katɔti unwi pɛ kani nkya.

english_verse: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
translation_verse: Ina bekyuli baasu banii baƒiɔ bakya katɔ iye kalɔ mɛni na ina ka baƒiɔ bamɛni lidu limomo ku kalɔ benwoti muedi ni,

english_verse: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
translation_verse: abu bɔgyi ka Katɔti unwi pɛ na bubo. Anwu ndi Ati ɔni nédie ala ana ƒui. Na anwu na bulie ngba bute. Na Blɔti unwi pɛ kani nkya, na anwu ndi Yesu Kristo ɔni lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔkɛ údie ala ƒui. Na ɔkɛ anwu ɔsu na buli ngba.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi ukyuli biala ngyi litemi geen lɛmɛni. Ala ani na bekyuli bábla bése baakpá ni, ése áƒɔ badi lɛlɔ kemmo ɔni na úbedu ɔmwi kadi si bádi adila amɛni udu ni, baabu banii baƒiɔ adila na adi. Na bana kasusu kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ kaadú-ma kɔtɔ ka adila ammɔ aayá beesé lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi adila adi bɔdi ndubɔya na abu ku Katɔti ntɛ bɔdia bubu. Na bulayila lɛla lɛdi si bútadi. Na lɛni kani na bulákɛ lɛla lɛdi si bɔdi adila adi.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
translation_verse: Bɛnu kaduɛ na bina kuƒi kɔni na bibo lɛlɔ kalɛ na uleboku ukyuli ɔni na nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi buuubo ɔkplu kalɔ na wabla likpidi lɛdi.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Kali nu si ukyuli ɔni na nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi buuubo ɔkplu ɔnu-ɔ aani ukyuli ɔni na ƒula lɛnunda lísie anumi ka aadi adila ani bákpa béte baƒiɔ na nwuna ɔtɔ. Anwu lɛnɔ ɔdubɔkɛ ɔyikun na ɔdi adila ani na béti bákpa béte baƒiɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si adila ani na mɔɔdi adubɔya na mina ɔnwani ɔbla likpidi ni, nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo adila ani na béti bákpa béte baƒiɔ bɔdi kudii kalɛ na mina ɔnwani weduo likpidi kemmo.

english_verse: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Bɛɛbu bɛnii liiibo kuƒi na lɛbla lɛla lɛni mɔɔyɔ́? Munuu lɛɛɛdi ɔtalane na ńtanu Blɔti Yesu? Na ɔɔɔdi amii ndi mina ebi ani na lɛ́nwu na mina kabla kani na lɛ́bla líte Blɔti kemmo?

english_verse: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
translation_verse: Si ina badi balaƒɔ-mi aani Blɔti ɔtalane ni, amii bɛ́ƒɔ-mi lɛni. Na kalɛ na bɛ́bla unwi ku Blɔti ni, ɔmmɔ lɛti pɛ ɔ́ya na amii alati biidie ɔmɛni taatina nwaa ka ndi Blɔti ɔtalane.

english_verse: When people question me, I tell them
translation_verse: Na si bekyuli baakyaku-mi ɔmɛni lɛlɔ unyeƒi ni, lɛni na muudie mina lɛlɔ kenye.

english_verse: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
translation_verse: Bubo kuƒi kɔni na bete-bu adila ku ntu na bula kabla kenye.

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Bubo kuƒi ka abu lɛnɔ buti bula beleku bɔda aani kalɛ na batalane bakladi ku Blɔti banwani ku Petro lɛnɔ baabla.

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Munuu ami ku Barnaba lɛti kani nálɛka bɔnu bula lɛlɔ lɛlɔ?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Ukpone ɔdi biala uláƒɔ nwuna lili kayu na bekpone kakyakɔ. Na umonsene biala ni, ubo kuƒi ka ɔdi nwuna kemmo edula. Na bebuo lɛlɔ ɔnune biala ubo kuƒi na uti bebuo bammɔ anyi ntu ɔbla lɛdila.

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: Bɔ́ka na Mose ɔda bubo ɔku kemmo ka ni, ebuo ɔni na biiti teesienku katumakɔ ni, tenyimi-nwu kenye si unye kabla lɛlɔ. Nsu ni, ɔɔɔdi bebuo bamɛni geen lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔɔtɛmi taasiku.

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: Bula lɛlɔ litemi na Katɔti ɔɔsu. Na sɔsɔ ni, abu ɔsu na bénweni litemi lɛmɛni. Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtuma ku ukyuli ɔni mɔɔƒɛ edula ni, ɔdi ka babla kabla kammɔ ku lɛnunsia ka ɔdi biala wakɛ edula ammɔ adi.

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Bɔ́va kɔyu kemmo ebi bɔ́kya-mii akɔ. Na si amii lɛnɔ bíte-bu ɔlɔna lɛlɔ ala ni, úbie?

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Si bekyuli bamba bébo kuƒi ka bakɛ kɔsia kɔdi basiku-mii kudɔ ni, na abu bubo kuƒi kɔmmɔ udu butulo-ma muedi. Nsu abu búteti kuƒi kɔmmɔ bútablaku lɛla lɛdi. Mmomu abu búti lɛla biala bɔ́sia lɛlɔ kalɛ na Kristo litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛkɛ ulu na ligyingya lisie kesii biala.

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: Bɛgyi kede kede ka bekyuli bani mɔɔbla kabla na Katɔti kakpakɔ ni, mmɔ na baakɛ́ bana lɛdila. Na bekyuli bani muuti akpala taatásia lɛkpabi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, beete-ma bana kadikɔ.

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani geen na Blɔti úbo ɔda ɔnii bekyuli bani mɔɔkɔ́ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa teete bekyuli ni, lɛsa lɛni baakɔ́ kemmo na ɔlɛka badi.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: Nsu ńtablaku kuƒi kɔmɛni lɛla lɛdi. Munuu muunweni-mii ɔku ɔmɛni na lɛwia lɛla lɛdi lɛsiku-mii kudɔ? Si ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, si líkpi muedi ɔdia-mi utulo. Ɔsika naaawia nnii lɛla lɛni lɛlɔ na mbo kuƒi ka lɛkun lɛmɛnɛ ni, ukyuli ɔdi uti-ni unwini etemila keeke.

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: Liiibo kuƒi kɔni na ntaakun lɛmɛnɛ ka mɔɔkɔ́ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa ɔsu. Blɔti ɔdubɔni-mi kɔtu si ńtakɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa ńtete bekyuli!

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: Si banii ami ɔlati náƒuna kabla kamɛni na mina bɔyɔ kenye ni, nka ndubɔsia anu ka baƒɔ-mi kayu. Nsu ɔdi kabla kani na Blɔti nnye-mi lɛlɔ ɔnii mbla. Ɔsika Katɔti néti-mi únyene-ka kenye.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: Na bi kayu baaƒɔ-mi? Lɛyuƒɔla lɛni na mbo ndi ka lɛkɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa ku kaƒɔ ƒaa. Na lɛɛɛdubo mina kadikɔ ƒui kama bɔsia na litemi buni lɛni mɔɔsu mɛni kemmo.

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: Mbo mina lɛlɔ kuƒi biala ɔni na lɛɛɛkya ukyuli bamba ɔdi kalɔ. Nsu lɛ́bla lɛlɔ aani ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla bekyuli ƒui kabla kalɛ na lɛƒɔ bekyuli pii lite Blɔti.

english_verse: When I am with the Jews, I live like a Jew to win Jews. They are ruled by the Law of Moses, and I am not. But I live by the Law to win them.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na mɔɔbla kabla na Yudaƒuɔ akɔ ni, lílie ngba aani Yudani kalɛ na lɛkana lɛƒɔ-ma lite Blɔti. Na ina ka lɛɛɛkya Mose ɔda bubo kalɔ muedi ni, lílie ngba lɛni ku bani mɔɔdi nwuna ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ uwi ɔni na lɛ́kya-ma akɔ kalɛ na lɛkana na lɛƒɔ-ma lite Blɔti.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na mɔɔbla ku bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ lɛnɔ. Na lílie-ma akɔ aani ukyuli ɔni naaadi Yudani. Na naaadi Yudaƒuɔ ɔda bubo bɔdi lɛlɔ kalɛ na lɛƒɔ-ma lite Blɔti. Ɔmɛni ulátina ɔnii lɛ́ta línye Katɔti ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Ɔsika geen ni, Kristo ɔda bubo lɛlɔ na mɔɔdi.

english_verse: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
translation_verse: Si nkya bani na bana bɔƒɔtaadi buse kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ akɔ ni, mɔɔbla lɛlɔ aani ama kani kalɛ na lɛkana lɛƒɔ-ma lite Blɔti. Ɔmɛni ɔsu lɛ́manku-ma na línwini bekyuli ƒui ɔkpana kalɛ na lɛsia ulu biala lɛlɔ na lɛƒɔ bekyuli badi lite Blɔti.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Ala amɛni ƒui na mɔɔbla na litemi buni lɛmmɔ ɔsu kalɛ na ami lɛnɔ lɛkɛ lɛlɔyɔ lɛni nkɛnku kabla kammɔ kemmo.

english_verse: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
translation_verse: Bɛgyi nwaa ka bekyuli pii muusié usi kekelikɔ. Nsu ukyuli unwi pɛ mɔɔdi lɛlɔ taaƒɔ lɛyuƒɔla. Anwuɔsu bikeli usi ɔmmɔ kalɛ na bɛdi lɛlɔ na bɛkɛ lɛyuƒɔla.

english_verse: Athletes work hard to win a crown that cannot last, but we do it for a crown that will last forever.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔklibi lɛlɔ ka úsela utékeli usi ni, uuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na baatina-nwu kɔkwɛ kɔna ƒui kalɛ na ɔƒɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi kabwa kani neeetu uwi asa na keebie. Nsu abu ni, bɔɔsa lɛlɔ bute kabwa kani na kelebie kudii.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na muukeli siin kalɛ na ntékulo kabuli. Na nse aani ukyuli ɔni muukpó lɛvu ɔni na ulébeyi nwuna lɛvu na kayaa ukpludi.

english_verse: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_verse: Lɛ́ya na lɛvu lɛma-mi kalɛ na mina ɔlɔna ɔkana na ɔƒɔ lɛbibo biala. Ɔsika si lɛ́kɔ litemi buni lɛmɛni lɛsa líte bekyuli bamba na búbasa bɔnii bɔɔkɔ́ku lɛlɔ ni, naaawia ka bada-mi bedie na lɛyuƒɔla lɛmmɔ kenye!

english_verse: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
translation_verse: Banwa, mɔɔwia ka binyimo lɛla lɛni nálɛku bula bati kuuku bani násiaku Mose. Ulɔyɔ ɔ́tɔnku-ma, na ɔ́gyumana-ma ƒui. Na bávi Ɛpugyie ntɛ.

english_verse: This was like being baptized and becoming followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Katɔti úti ku Ɛpugyie ɔmmɔ ɔ́bla-ma ntu bɔkpila ɔdi aani bekyuli bani nsiaku Mose kama.

english_verse: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
translation_verse: Bana ƒui bádi Kɔyu kemmo adila enwi pɛ ammɔ.

english_verse: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
translation_verse: Na báni Kɔyu kemmo ntu bunwi pɛ bɔmmɔ. Báni ntu básiku Kɔyu kemmo lɛtakpɛ lɛni nkɛ nsiaku-ma mmɔ kemmo. Na lɛtakpɛ lɛmmɔ lɛdi Kristo ɔmmɔ ɔlati.

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ muedi kemmo ni, lɛlɔ lítayɔ Katɔti na bana ketulodikɔ ɔbladu lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu ni, békpi ketele kemmo.

english_verse: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔdi ala ani na bɔnu bɔtɛya kalɛ na alaekpidi emini asɔ alátaada-bu ɔkwɛ aani bana kalɛ,

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: iye buti lɛlɔ bute lɛƒiɔkpa ala bɔbla aani bana kalɛ. Lɛni na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bekyuli bammɔ bádu bebuo na báni ntɛ na badi adikpi limeyi, na bátɔ béte baƒiɔ.”

english_verse: Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about
translation_verse: Útalɛka butaabla kɔsɔnɔ bɔdi ala aani kalɛ na bana badi bábla, na nkyuli mpim aavlanyɔ-ɛtɛ békpi limeyi linwi.

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
translation_verse: Bubo lɛsugba banii, “Kuƒi kɔtɛ na bɔbla lɛla biala.” Sɔsɔ na ɔdi. Nsu ɔɔɔdi lɛla biala ndia. Kuƒi kɔtɛ na bɔbla lɛla biala, nsu ɔɔɔdi lɛla biala mbo kɔsia lite-bu.

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi ka bɔkɔku Blɔti bɔnu. Lɛni na bana badi bábla, na balakpi bádu-ma na békpi.
