english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi ka butaata teenye Katɔti lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na bana badi bábla ɔsu, na Katɔti ɔtu ɔni nda kukpi ɔyikun ɔ́kyula-ma.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni ƒui álɛku-ma kalɛ na abu bɔnu bɔtɛya. Na bénweni-nya bése kalɛ na buti-nya bɔlɛ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika bula uwi ɔni kemmo na bɔkya mɛni ni, úudu kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: Ɔdi biala ɔni mɔɔkali ɔnii unye kpakplaa ni, ɔnu kaduɛ kalɛ na ulebuli.

english_verse: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
translation_verse: Lɛla biala lɛni nékpoku-ɔ lɛ́nu ni, nina udu lɛɛkana na liibo ukyuli biala lɛlɔ. Nsu ni, Katɔti ɔɔdi nwuna linyese lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubute-ɔ ɔyikun ɔni na eti enye lɛla lɛni mekpoku-ɔ manu kenye, na liletulo ƒula ɔyikun kalɛ na enye kpakplaa ete-nwu. Uwi ɔni kemmo na lɛla lɛdi liikpóku-ɔ taanu ni, Katɔti ɔdubute-ɔ ɔyikun ɔni na eti enye ala ammɔ ƒui kenye, na ɔtina-a ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na asia na alɛ-nwu kemmo.

english_verse: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, banwa, bɛda lɛlɔ bidie lɛƒiɔkpa biala kemmo.

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: Mɔɔtɛmiku-mii aani bekyuli bani náda anu. Anwuɔsu bɛbu ala ani na mɔɔsu-mii mɛni kemmo bɛnu.

english_verse: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
translation_verse: Ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔni na buuti taagya Katɔti enu ni, unye ute Blɔti ubugya. Na bodobodo ɔni na bɔɔbwɛ si bɔɔdi Blɔti adila kedee ni, ɔɔtina ka abu ku Kristo bɔɔbla unwi.

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: Na ina ka bumomo ni, bɔdi ɔlɔna unwi pɛ. Ɔsika bodobodo unwi kani na bula ƒui bɔɔdi.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Bɛbu bɛnu Israelƒuɔ ka ni, bekyuli bani mɔɔdi adila ani na béti bákpa béte Katɔti ni, báblaku Katɔti unwi. Ɔsika anwu na bákpa ala ammɔ béte na nwuna lɛkpabi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: Oowo! Lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu-mii ni, ani ndi ka ala ani na béti bákpa na akpabi amɛni lɛlɔ ni, béti-nya bákpa béte ayu ekpidi, na ɔɔɔdi Katɔti. Na naaawia-mii nnii bɛbla unwi ku ayu ekpidi amɛni.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdia ka ani asiku Blɔti ɔɔƒɛɛ kemmo na asɔ atáni asiku ayu ekpidi lɛnɔ ɔɔƒɛɛ kemmo. Útalɛka adi adila na Blɔti kakpakɔ na asɔ atádi adila na ayu ekpidi kakpakɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Munuu bɛɛyɔ́ ka Blɔti uti nwuna kɔnyi ɔkya-bu? Bitaya bɔkali bɔnii bubo ɔyikun butulo-nwu.

english_verse: We should think about others and not about ourselves.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɔtaadine ɔdi utawia anwu lɛti bɔdia, mmomu ɔwia lɛla lɛni madia mete nwuna ɔkpana lɛnɔ.

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Ebo kuƒi na eye lɛna lɛdi biala na beeyé na kuye na akun. Na ɔɔɔdi ka eye lɛla lɛdi enu na ati si lɛna lɛmmɔ lise kedee iye liiise.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔsu ɔnii, “Kalɔ ku kana ala ani nkya-nya kemmo ƒui ni, adi Blɔti adi.”

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔni naaadi ɔƒɔtaadine ɔdi ɔ́lɔ-ɔ ɔnii baadiku-nwu na átuna na ésie ni, lɛla biala na úte-ɔ ɔnii di ni, di na teye lɛla lɛdi enu ati si adila ammɔ ese kedee iye eeese.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔɔɔdi awɔ ɔni nádi adila ammɔ na kayi kadubo bukpoku. Mmomu ukyuli ɔni nánu ɔ́su-ɔ na kayi kadubo bukpoku. Ukyuli ɔdi ɔdubɔkana na uye ɔnii, “Bi ɔsu na si mbo kuƒi na lɛbla lɛla lɛdi na ukyuli bamba kayi kani mekpoku-nwu ɔsu na ɔdi ka lɛda lɛla lɛmmɔ bɔbla lɛya?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: Si lɛ́gya Katɔti enu na lɛdila lɛni na úte-mi ɔsu ni, bi ɔsu na ukyuli ɔdi ɔnu ɔnii lɛ́ƒiɔ na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ka lɛ́ɛgya Katɔti enu?”

english_verse: When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God.
translation_verse: Nsu nyimo ka lɛla biala na ɔdi aabla iye aadi iye aaní ni, ɔlɛka abla ana ƒui kalɛ na eti ɔbu ete Katɔti.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: Bitabla lɛla lɛni maya na Yudaƒuɔ iye bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ iye baƒɔtaadine belebo Katɔti kudɔ.

english_verse: I always try to please others instead of myself, in the hope that many of them will be saved.
translation_verse: Bɛbla kalɛ kani na mɔɔbla lɛla biala. Mɔɔsia anu kalɛ na naaata neeenye ɔdi lɛlɔ. Naaakali taanu mina lɛkɛ, mmomu lɛla lɛni madia mete ɔdi biala kalɛ na bakɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Bɛnu mina ɔbladu bɛtɛya aani kalɛ na ami lɛnɔ mɔɔnu Kristo ɔdi taatɛya. Kristo Ɔdi Ukyuli Biala Lili

english_verse: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
translation_verse: Muumwi-mii ɔsika bina anu asia-mi lɛlɔ uwi biala na biinyimo ala ani na lɛ́tina-mii na bɛɛbla taasiaku-nya lɛlɔ uwi biala.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: Nsu mɔɔwia ka binu kalɔ nwaa ka ni, Kristo ɔdi ukyuli biala lili. Na ɔgya lɛnɔ ɔdi uleku lili. Na Katɔti ndi Kristo lili.

english_verse: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔnana ɔni mɔɔkpali katɔ iye ɔɔkɔ́ Katɔti litemi buni lɛsa na Katɔti kakpakɔ na úti lɛla lɛdi úbi lili ni, ɔɔkya Kristo kɔƒa.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Na uleku ɔni mɔɔkpali katɔ iye ɔɔkɔ́ Katɔti litemi buni lɛsa na kakpakɔ na útamana lɛdiku lili ni, ɔɔkya ɔgyani kɔƒa. Na kavumana kadi keeebo anwu ku uleku ɔni nékpeyi lili na ɔɔɔda lɛlɔ ntɛ.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Si uleku ɔmmɔ útamana lɛdiku lili ni, na ɔlɛka ɔkpɛ lili linwini. Na ka ɔdi lɛla lɛni muuwi uleku anumi kalɔ si úkpeyi lili iye ɔ́kpɛ lili ɔsu ni, ɔdi ka ɔmana lɛdiku lili.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: Útalɛka ɔnana ubi lɛla lɛdi lili, ɔsika Katɔti údie ɔnana na nwuna udu kenye. Na uudie Katɔti ɔbu keyi. Nsu ulekudi anwu uudie ɔnana ɔbu keyi.

english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti útaka ɔnana budie bɔlɛku uleku kemmo. Mmomu uleku na údie ɔ́lɛku ɔnana kemmo.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi uleku ɔsu na Katɔti údie ɔnana. Mmomu ɔnana ɔsu na Katɔti údie uleku.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: Na kayaa batu ɔsu ni, ɔlɛka uleku ɔmana lɛdiku lili uti ɔtina ka ɔkya ɔnana kalɔ.

english_verse: As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other.
translation_verse: Na bula baƒɔtaadine ngba bulie kemmo ni, uleku ulesie taaya ɔnana, na ɔnana lɛnɔ ulesie taaya uleku.

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kalɛ na bábla uleku bálɛku ɔnana kemmo ni, lɛni kani na uleku lɛnɔ ɔ́wɔ ɔnana. Nsu lɛla biala ni, Katɔti kudɔ kani na lɛɛsí.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Amii alati bɛbu bɛnu si ɔ́manku uleku ka unye utaakpali katɔ ɔni na útamana lɛla lɛdi lili?

english_verse: But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head.
translation_verse: Nsu si uleku linwini ani líne-nwu lɛni ni, ɔdi-nwu ɔbu. Ɔsika Katɔti úte-nwu linwini gyɔlɔɔ lɛmmɔ aani lɛla lɛni nébi-nwu lili.

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Nsu si ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔkya unyeƒi na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni, lɛla lɛni kani na ami masu-nwu ndi ka abu ku Katɔti baƒɔtaadine akpa ƒui bɔsɔ buuubo ulu ɔbambadi ɔdi na bula bɔsala bɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Nsu na ala ani ndubo bɔtina mɛni kemmo ni, ɔɔɔdi bumwi na nda-mii. Ɔsika si uwi ɔni na bíbasala ni, ɔɔɔdi lɛbuni mɔɔlɛ́ taasiku bina bɔsa bɔmmɔ kemmo. Mmomu ala muubie teebu.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kudeedi ni, línu ka si bɛ́sala aani baƒɔtaadine ni, biile lɛlɔ kemmo akpa akpa. Na use-mi ka sɔsɔ na ɔdi.

english_verse: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
translation_verse: Unyeƒi ɔdi uuubo ka ɔdi ka kavumana kadi kakya-mii akɔ uti ɔtina bani ndi baƒɔtaadine geen kalɛ na bekyuli banu-ma bati.

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si bɛɛdi ni, bilénye taagya lɛlɔ asa na ɔdi biala uti nwuna adila ɔdi. Ɔmɛni ɔɔyá na kɔka kɔɔda badi na badi ama baaní ntɛ teekpi.

english_verse: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka uwi biala na bɛɛdi iye bɛɛní na ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔmɛni kemmo ni, biibó Blɔti kukpi kudu wetédu uwi ɔni na wasɔ webo.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si útanu lɛla lɛni na Blɔti ɔlɔna ɔmɛni ɔdanku útati uwi ɔni na ɔɔdi bodobodo ɔmmɔ iye ɔɔní na ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, ɔɔdi na ɔɔní na uuti litemi bɔtɛ teewi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na adila ammɔ kama ni, úti ɔɔƒɛɛ na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔmɛni ndi Katɔti bunyimi bɔwɔdi bɔni na úti mina ubugya úse likpo. Na uwi biala na bɛdubɔni-nwu ni, bɛni na biti biteenyimo-mi.”

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛla lɛni na lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́siku Blɔti kudɔ ni, ani kani na lɛ́tina-mii. Na usien ɔmmɔ asa na badubɔkya-nwu kakya ni, úti bodobodo,

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: na ka ɔ́gya Katɔti enu ni, ɔ́ƒɛ-nwu kemmo na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɔmɛni ndi mina ɔlɔna ɔni na ndubuti lɛkpa lite Katɔti na bina lili. Bɛƒɔ bɛdi na biti biteenyimo-mi.”

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ukyuli biala madi Blɔti adila amɛni iye wani na ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔmɛni kemmo na ulu ɔni nátamanku lɛlɔ ni, ɔdubɔtina ka ɔ́bla likpidi ka útabu Blɔti ɔlɔna ku ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, ɔdi biala ɔka nwuna lɛlɔ kemmo buduo asa na ɔdi bodobodo na ɔni na Blɔti ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ náya na bina akɔ pii biiƒi na lɛlɔ liiibo-mii ɔkplu. Na pii lɛnɔ békpi.

english_verse: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.
translation_verse: Na si bɔdubɔsia anu na bɔka lɛlɔ kemmo buduo bɔnu ni, nka Katɔti ulatɛku-bu litemi.

english_verse: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
translation_verse: Nsu Blɔti ɔɔtɛku abu litemi na ɔɔní-bu kɔtu kalɛ na Katɔti ulayila-bu udu ku bekyuli bani nátaƒɔ bátadi.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, banwa, si bɛ́sala bɛnii bɛɛdi Blɔti adila ni, binye bɛgya lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: Na si kɔka mɔɔda ɔdi ni, ɔlɛka ɔdi na nwuna kaduli kalɛ na Katɔti ulatɛku-mii litemi si bɛ́sala aani lɛkpa linwi kalɛ. Na etemila akladi anya ni, si líbo mmɔ ni, bɔdubɔda-nya bɔnu.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: Bɛgyi nwaa ka uwi ɔni na bɛɛɛgyi tɔ Katɔti ni, bɛ́ya na ala ani neeebo ngba átaadi-mii lɛlɔ na bitaakpa-nya na bɛ́yii ulu ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi ka bɛnu bɛti ka ukyuli biala na Katɔti Kɔyu mɔɔdi-nwu lɛlɔ ni, ulakana na wasu ɔnii, “Yesu ɔdubɔnuku-ni.” Lɛni kani na ukyuli ɔdi lɛnɔ ulakana na wasu ɔnii, “Yesu ndi Blɔti,” si ɔɔɔdi Katɔti Kɔyu mɔɔdi-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Katɔti Kɔyu kuute etela pii, nsu Kɔyu kunwi kɔmmɔ kani na kɔdi.

english_verse: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
translation_verse: Lilu pii lɛkya na bɔɔbla kabla teete Katɔti, nsu Katɔti unwi ɔmmɔ kani na ɔdi.

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: Na kabla lidu lidu lɛnɔ lɛkya, nsu Katɔti unwi ɔmmɔ kani mɔɔtina ɔdi biala nwuna kabla.

english_verse: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
translation_verse: Litela lɛni na ɔdi biala ubo ni, Katɔti Kɔyu néte-nwu litela lɛmmɔ kalɛ na bekyuli ƒui bakɛ-nwu lɛlɔ kɔsia.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Ɔdi anwu ni, Katɔti Kɔyu kúte-nwu litela lɛni náya na ɔti butemi ku lɛnunda ɔkɛnku Kɔyu kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na ɔdi lɛnɔ ni, Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kúte-nwu litela lɛni náya na ɔti butemi ku lɛlati ɔkɛnku Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kani lɛlɔ.

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: Na ɔbambadi ubo bɔƒɔtaadi ɔkɛnku Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kani lɛlɔ. Na ɔdi ni, ubo litela lɛni na uti ɔbwi ɔlɛ ɔkɛnku Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kani lɛlɔ.

english_verse: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Ukyuli bamba ni, ɔɔkana na ɔɔbla akɔla budie taatina. Na ɔdi ni, kalɛ na ɔsu Katɔti litemi. Na ɔbambadi ni, ayu lidu bɔnu taati. Na ɔdi ni, adi lidu bɔtɛmi. Na ɔbambadi ni, adi lidu kalɔ budie.

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: Ala amɛni ƒui ni, adi Katɔti Kɔyu kunwi kɔmmɔ ablala. Na kuule ala ammɔ teete ɔdi biala kalɛ kani na kɔɔyɔ́.

english_verse: The body of Christ has many different parts, just as any other body does.
translation_verse: Kristo use aani ukyuli ugyii ɔni mbo lɛlɔ ekpo pii. Ɔlɔna unwi kani na ɔdi ina ka lɛlɔ ekpo pii násala.

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na use na abu bani ndi Yudaƒuɔ ku kadi bamba bekyuli akɔ ku bani mɔɔbla bekyuli bamba kabla ku bani mɔɔbla ama alati kabla lɛnɔ akɔ. Kɔyu kunwi kɔmmɔ kani na béti bábla-bu ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmmɔ na bɔdi ɔlɔna unwi. Na Kɔyu kunwi kɔmmɔ na béte bula ƒui na bɔ́ni.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ ɔlati ni, ɔɔɔdi lɛlakpa linwi kani na lɛdi. Mmomu lɛlɔ ekpo pii násala ɔ́bla-nwu unwi.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Si ɔgba ɔ́su ɔnii, “Ka ami lɛɛɛdi kɔnu ɔsu ni, ami lɛɛɛkɛ ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ kemmo” ni, ɔmmɔ ulátina ka sɔsɔ na anwu ɔɔɔdi ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ kakɛ kadi.

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Na si kɔtu lɛnɔ kɔnii, “Ka ami lɛɛɛdi lɛnumi ɔsu ni, ami lɛɛɛkɛ ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ kemmo” ni, ɔmmɔ ulátina ka sɔsɔ na ɔɔɔdi ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ kakɛ kadi.

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Na si ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ ƒui ɔdi lɛnumi kani ni, dɛ na wabla asa na wenu lɛla lɛdi? Na si kɔtu lɛti lɛnɔ na ɔdi ni, dɛ na wabla asa na wenu ɔnyi?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Nsu si bɔ́sia anumi ni, bɔdubɔnu ka Katɔti úti lɛlɔ ekpo bun bun ɔ́bla ɔlɔna umodi ɔmmɔ kalɛ na anwu ɔlati ɔɔyɔ́ ka use.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ ugyii ɔdi uuubo si ɔna ƒui ɔdi likpo linwi!

english_verse: It takes many parts to make a single body.
translation_verse: Nsu kalɛ na bɔɔnu-nwu ni, ɔdi ekpo pii. Nsu ɔdi lɛlɔ ugyii unwi.

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na lɛnumi lilakana kɔnu bɔsu ɔnii, “Naaawia-a na mina lɛla lɛdi kemmo.” Na lɛni kani na lili lɛnɔ lilakana lɛgba bɔsu lɛnii, “Naaawia-a na mina lɛla lɛdi kemmo.”

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ ekpo ani nse kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ntulo ni, anya mmomu na si eeebo-bu lɛlɔ na bulakana lɛla lɛdi bɔbla.

english_verse: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
translation_verse: Na ekpo ani na bulábu ni, anya na bɔɔtí bɔda kaduɛ mmomu. Na ekpo ani naaadia ka budie keyi ni, anya na bɔɔda buɛɛ.

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: Na bulábla ɔmmɔ udu teete ekpo ani na bekyuli baanu uwi biala. Nsu Katɔti násala lɛlɔ ekpo lɛni na ɔ́ya na buuti ɔbu teete ekpo ani mmomu na bɔɔnu ka átaƒɔ kuye.

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu bule bɔdi buuubo lɛlɔ ekpo ntɛ. Mmomu ekpo ƒui adanku kɔsia ete lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Na si lɛlɔ kakɛ kadi kakya lɛbibo kemmo ni, ɔlɔna ugyii ɔmmɔ ƒui uunú ɔlɛ na lɛlɔ ekpo akladi lɛnɔ eebó abi. Na si beemwi kakɛ kadi ni, lɛlɔ ekpo ana ƒui aakɛ́ ebiti ammɔ.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bina ƒui násala bɛ́bla Kristo ɔlɔna ugyii ɔmmɔ na bɛdi-nwu lɛlɔ ekpo unwi unwi.

english_verse: First, God chose some people to be apostles and prophets and teachers for the church. But he also chose some to work miracles or heal the sick or help others or be leaders or speak different kinds of languages.
translation_verse: Na baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa kemmo ni, Katɔti úti bula ƒui úse ekpo ani námanku-bu. Udeedi ni, batalane. Na unyɔdi ni, kenye bediene. Na ɔtɛdi ni, ala batinane, asa na bani mɔɔbla akɔla budie taatina. Na bani mbo ɔyikun ɔni na babwi lɛlɛ iye bebunku bekyuli iye banu kabla lɛlɔ iye batɛmi adi lidu lidu lɛnɔ basia-ma kama.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi bekyuli ƒui ndi batalane iye kenye bediene iye ala batinane. Na ɔɔɔdi ɔdi biala mbo ɔyikun ɔni na uti ɔbla akɔla budie taatina.

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi ɔdi biala mbo ɔyikun ɔni na uti ɔbwi lɛlɛ iye ɔtɛmi adi lidu iye udie ala ani básu kalɔ.

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, biti bina kayi bɛsia etela ani náƒɔ kuye etulo lɛlɔ. Ala ani náƒɔ kuye etulo ƒui ndi ani na ndubo-mii bɔtina mɛni.

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: Si lɛ́kana na mɔɔtɛmi adi lidu lidu ani na bekyuli ku Katɔti batu ƒui bebo na naaayɔ bekyuli ni, mina kenye kani mɔɔsu ƒui kadi lɛsɛ likpludi aani kalɛ na lebomo iye kabontobi kaaku.

english_verse: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Na si muudie Katɔti kenye na muunú abɛla ku lɛlati ƒui kalɔ, na mbo bɔƒɔtaadi bɔni na lɛkana na lɛ́gyu abi muedi na ana kenyekɔ nsu naaayɔ bekyuli ni, lɛɛɛdi lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Na si ina líti mina ala ani nse-mi ƒui líte bawabane na lɛ́ya na bekyuli muedi bakyula-mi nsu naaayɔ bekyuli ni, lɛɛɛdi lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Love is patient and kind, never jealous, boastful, proud, or
translation_verse: Bɔyɔ bɔɔkɛ́ kayi na bɔɔbla kaƒɔ buni. Buuubo lɛnungyie na bulákun lɛmɛnɛ iye bɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ.

english_verse: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Bɔyɔ bulábla atu ɔkplu na bulánwanɛ ala teete lɛlɔ iye buléti kɔnyi. Na bɔyɔ buléti likpidi taakya kasusu kemmo.

english_verse: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
translation_verse: Na lɛlɔ lilayɔ-nwu na likpidi lɛlɔ. Mmomu ɔɔkɛ́ lɛlɔyɔ na lɛbuni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Love is always supportive, loyal, hopeful, and trusting.
translation_verse: Enu aláƒɛ bɔyɔ, na nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi ku lɛnunsia ku nwuna bunye kpakplaa buláyuɛ.

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Bɔyɔ buuubo kawɔkɔ. Katɔti ala kenye budie bɔkya, nsu bɔdubo bɔwɔ ulu. Adi lidu lidu bɔtɛmi lɛnɔ bɔkya, nsu anwu lɛnɔ ɔdubo ulu bɔwɔ. Lɛlati lɛkya bɔdi, nsu nwuna uwi ɔdubo bɔvi.

english_verse: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛlati ku kenye budie litela lɛni na Katɔti úte-bu ni, útedu útawɔlɔ.

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Nsu si lɛla lɛni nédu lɛ́wɔlɔ lɛ́da lɛ́lɛ ni, lɛni nétedu mmɔ lɛyii taakya.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ndi ɔnamu ni, kalɛ na mɔɔtɛmi ku kalɛ na muunú ala kɔku na mina ɔlɔna kemmo ku kalɛ na mɔɔbla kasusu ni, adi anamula bɔbla. Ɔƒɛni ka línwini ɔnana ni, anamula ammɔ asɔ eeebo-mi kɔsia kɔdi.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
translation_verse: Ala ani na bɔɔnu ɔƒɛni ni, ese aani kalɛ na baanu lɛla lɛdi ƒlu ƒlu na asogya kemmo. Na kama asa na bɔdubɔnu-ni nwaa anumi ku anumi. Na lɛla lɛni na ngyi ɔƒɛni ni, lítedu lítawɔlɔ. Nsu kama ni, lɛdubo libedu lɛwɔlɔ na ɔbla nwaa aani kalɛ kani na Katɔti ɔgyi-mi ƒui.

english_verse: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
translation_verse: Geen ni, alakpa atɛ amɛni kani ndubɔkya. Na anya ndi bɔƒɔtaadi ku lɛnunsia ku bɔyɔ. Nsu nwuna unengudi ƒui ndi bɔyɔ.

english_verse: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, bɔyɔ na ɔdi ka bina ƒui bɛwia kpakplaa na bɛkɛ. Na biti bina anu ƒui bɛsia Kɔyu kemmo etela lɛlɔ. Na litela lɛni ntulo ƒui ndi ka bidie Katɔti litemi kenye.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni muutemi adi lidu ni, ulátɛmiku bekyuli, mmomu Katɔti na ɔɔtɛmiku. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔdi ulenu-ni kalɔ, na bɔsu na ɔɔsu ala abɛdi ɔkɛnku Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli ɔni muudie Katɔti litemi kenye teete bekyuli ni, uubunku-ma na ɔɔkya-ma ogya na ɔɔsia-ma kɔnu.

english_verse: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtɛmi adi ani kalɔ na bekyuli belenu ni, anwu lɛti pɛ lɛlɔ kani na uubunku. Nsu ukyuli ɔni muudie Katɔti litemi kenye ni, uubunku baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyɔ́ si bina ƒui bɛɛkana na bɛɛtɛmi adi lidu. Nsu si bɛ́kana na biidie Katɔti litemi kenye teete bekyuli ni, ɔdia-mi utulo. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni muudie Katɔti litemi kenye teete bekyuli ni, ubo kɔsia utulo ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtɛmi adi lidu lidu, amu ntu ukyuli ɔni makana nwuna ala ani na ɔɔsu kalɔ budie ɔkya-ma akɔ mmɔ, kalɛ na baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ lɛkɛ kebunku.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu, banwa, si líbo-mii kudɔ na mɔɔtɛmi adi lidu lɛni na ɔdi ulenu kalɔ ni, bi kɔsia na bɛdubɔkɛ na ɔmmɔ kemmo? Bilákɛ kɔsia kɔdi munu munu, amu ntu lídie lɛla lɛdi kalɔ líte-mii ɔ́si Katɔti kudɔ, iye lɛ́ya na bɛ́ti lɛla lɛdi, iye lídie Katɔti litemi lɛdi kenye, iye lɛ́tina-mii ala adi.

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Na si ukyuli ɔni mɔɔvwi kakpɛɛ ulávwi-ka taalɔ ala ammɔ kaduɛ ni, dɛ na wabla asa na bekyuli baklibi lɛlɔ bete kekpo?

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na use ka ukyuli ɔni muudie lɛla lɛdi kenye na adi lidu lidu kemmo ni, bekyuli belénu lɛla lɛni na ɔɔsu mmɔ kalɔ. Mmomu ɔdubo bunwini ɔƒɛƒɛɛ na ɔyii ɔkya kayaa.

english_verse: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
translation_verse: Nsu si ɔdi ulénu lɛdi lɛni na mɔɔtɛmi kalɔ ni, na línwini ɔƒɔ na nwuna kudɔ, na anwu lɛnɔ únwini ɔƒɔ na mina kudɔ.

english_verse: If you really want spiritual gifts, choose the ones that will be most helpful to the church.
translation_verse: Ka bina ƒui anumi égyie ka bɛkɛ Kɔyu kemmo etela ni, bɛya na anumi egyie-mii na bɛkɛ etela ani mebunku baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ lɛtɔtɔ busie mmomu utulo.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtɛmi na adi lidu lidu kemmo ni, uvele Katɔti na ute-nwu litela lɛni na uti udie ala ani na ɔɔsu mmɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si lɛ́sia ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ lɛ́kpali katɔ ni, mina kɔyu aku kɔɔkpali katɔ bɔdi, nsu ɔɔɔdi ku mina kasusu.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bi na ɔdi ka lɛbla? Ndubɔkpali katɔ ku mina kɔyu bɔdi, nsu ndubɔkpali katɔ ku mina kasusu lɛnɔ. Na ndubudie lɛnu ku mina kɔyu, nsu ndubudie lɛnu ku mina kasusu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
translation_verse: Na si enye aagyá Katɔti enu na ƒula kɔyu kemmo kani ni, dɛ na wabla asa na ukyuli ɔni nkya-a kudɔ unu lɛla lɛni na aasu asa na wasu ɔnii ƒula katɔ bɔkpali bɔsia lɛni aani kalɛ na aagyá Katɔti enu ka ulenu lɛla lɛni geen na aasu mmɔ kalɔ?

english_verse: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
translation_verse: Na si ina ƒula enu ani na aagyá Katɔti adia muedi ni, bekyuli bamba balákɛ kɔsia kɔdi munu munu.

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: Mɔɔgyá Katɔti enu ka mɔɔtɛmiku-nwu na adi lidu lidu kemmo teetulo bina akɔ ɔdi biala.

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: Nsu na bula kasalakɔ ni, ndubɔyɔ ka lɛsu etemila alɔ ani kalɔ na bekyuli badubunu na liti lɛtina bekyuli bamba ala litulo ka ntaasu etemila pii na adi lidu lidu kemmo.

english_verse: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
translation_verse: Banwa, bitabla lɛlɔ aani banamu na bina kasusu kemmo. Mmomu bɛbla lɛlɔ aani benengu si biiti kasusu. Nsu na likpidi lilu lɛlɔ ni, bɛbla lɛlɔ aani banamu.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: Na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ni, Blɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ndubɔtɛmiku mina kadi bekyuli ɔkɛnku bekyuli bani mɔɔtɛmi na adi lidu lidu kemmo. Na ndubɔtɛmi lɛsiaku baƒɔ kenye kemmo, nsu belénu-mi lɛdi.”

english_verse: Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, adi lidu bɔtɛmi ɔdi lɛla lɛni nse nte bani nátaƒɔ bátadi. Nsu Katɔti litemi kenye budie ni, ɔdi lɛla lɛni nse nte baƒɔtaadine na ɔɔɔdi bani nátaƒɔ bátadi.

english_verse: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu si baƒɔtaadine bammɔ ƒui bása na ɔdi biala úse kalɔ ɔɔtɛmi na adi lidu lidu kemmo na banii ukyuli bamba ɔdi ɔkya-mii akɔ iye bekyuli bani naaadi baƒɔtaadine badi bébo-mii akɔ ni, bilánu ka badubɔsu banii biikpi libuo yoo?

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Nsu si bina akɔ ɔdi biala uudie Katɔti litemi kenye na ukyuli keeke iye ukyuli ɔni nátaƒɔ útadi ɔdi úbo-mii akɔ ni, ɔdubɔnu nwuna likpidi ɔti ɔkɛnku lɛla lɛni na uunú ɔsu. Ala ani na uunú adubɔtina-nwu ka Katɔti ɔɔtɛku-nwu litemi.

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: Na anwu ɔlati ndubudie nwuna ala abɛdi keyi na ɔdubɔyu ɔtɛ kalɔ na umwi Katɔti na udie kenye ɔnini, “Sɔsɔ ni, Katɔti ɔkya-mii akɔ!”

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: Banwa, mɔɔwia ka liti lɛla lɛdi libunku ɔmɛni na bina bɔsa kemmo. Si uwi ɔni na bɛ́sa bɛnii bɛɛkpali katɔ ni, ɔdi ubo ɔnu ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́ ka udie, na ɔdi lɛnɔ ubo lɛla lɛdi na ɔɔyɔ́-ka ɔtina. Na ɔdi lɛnɔ ɔɔyɔ́ ka udie Katɔti lɛla lɛdi ɔtina. Na ɔdi lɛnɔ ɔdanku kenye kadi na adi lidu lidu kemmo, na ɔdi lɛnɔ kalɛ na udie ala ammɔ kalɔ. Nsu ɔlɛka bɛbla ala amɛni ƒui kalɛ na ute baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ kebunku.

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Si ɔdi ubo kenye kadi na ɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔsu na adi lidu lidu kemmo ni, nkyuli aani inyɔ iye ɛtɛ si bémomo bágya basu bana kenye kani badanku atɔ asia. Na bakɛ ukyuli bamba ɔni lɛnɔ medie ala ani básu mmɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi uuubo na wedie ala ammɔ kalɔ bɔdi ni, ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtɛmi na adi lidu lidu kemmo mmɔ ɔda ɔya na anwu ku Katɔti kani batɛmiku lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Two or three persons may prophesy, and everyone else must listen carefully.
translation_verse: Nkyuli inyɔ iye ɛtɛ bani ndanku kenye kadi ɔ́si Katɔti kudɔ basu bana kenye na bakladi bawia etemila ammɔ kemmo banu kaduɛ.

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Na si bani nlie kasalakɔ mmɔ ɔdi ɔ́ƒɔ linyesia lɛdi ɔ́siku Katɔti kudɔ ni, ɔdi ka ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtɛmi na adi lidu lidu kemmo mmɔ ɔda nwuna kenye bɔsu ɔya na ute ukyuli ɔmmɔ kuƒi.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Bina ƒui bɛkana na bɛsu bina kenye kani bɛda unwi unwi kalɛ na ɔdi biala ɔtɛya lɛla lɛdi na ɔkɛ ɔyikun bɔkya.

english_verse: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani muudie Katɔti kenye baakana bana lɛlɔ bɔda na kenye kani na baasu kemmo.

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti ɔɔwia ka bɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔyɔ́ ka amanku keyi buɛɛ. Na lɛni na ɔlɛka use na Katɔti baƒɔtaadine akpa ƒui akɔ.

english_verse: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ka beleku baba lɛsɛ na ɔɔɔdi ka beteetemi na kasalakɔ. Mmomu ɔdi ka beboku lɛlɔ kalɔ aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔɔtina. Na beeebo kuƒi ka batɛmi.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Na si baawia ka beye lɛla lɛdi kalɔ benu ni, bana bagya na ɔlɛka beye na kaduli. Ɔsika ɔdi kɔƒa ka uleku unye utaatɛmi na baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ anumi.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Munuu ni, bɔsu bɛda bɛnii bina kudɔ na Katɔti litemi lɛmmɔ lɛ́kwɛ lɛ́si? Munuu bina kudɔ kani na litemi lɛmmɔ líbedu?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Si bina akɔ ɔdi ɔɔkali ɔnii Katɔti kenye udiene na ɔdi iye ubo Kɔyu kemmo litela lɛdi ni, ɔdi ka ɔnu ɔti ka lɛla lɛni na muunweni-mii lɛdi ɔda ɔni na Katɔti úbo.

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: Na si ukyuli ɔmmɔ uuní litemi lɛmɛni ni, ɔdi ka amii lɛnɔ bini-nwu.

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, banwa, biti bina anu ƒui bɛsia Katɔti litemi kenye budie lɛlɔ. Nsu bitetile adi lidu bɔtɛmi ulu.

english_verse: But do everything properly and in order.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi ka bɛbla lɛla biala na ulu ɔbuni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
translation_verse: Banwa, ɔƒɛni ni, mɔɔyɔ́ ka binyimo litemi buni lɛni lɛsa na lɛ́kɔ líte-mii. Litemi lɛmɛni na bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́di na binye bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kpakplaa.

english_verse: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
translation_verse: Na ani ndi litemi buni lɛmmɔ na nina lɛsa na lɛ́kɔ líte-mii. Litemi lɛmmɔ ndubɔƒɔ-mii ngba si bɛ́da-ni kpakplaa amu ntu ukpludi na bɛnii bɛ́ƒɔ-ni bɛ́di.

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́siku Blɔti kudɔ ni, ani kani na líti muute-mii. Na ani ndi lɛla lɛni náƒɔ kuye lítulo ƒui, ka Kristo úkpi úte-bu na bula alaekpidi ɔsu aani kalɛ na bénweni bákya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo.

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Na báva-nwu, na Katɔti ɔ́gyila-nwu ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ emeyi atɛ kama, na úbo uli ngba aani kalɛ na ɔkya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo.

english_verse: Christ appeared to Peter, then to the twelve.
translation_verse: Na údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina Petro ku batalane leevu-inyɔ bammɔ.

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina nwuna basiakune bani ntulo nkyuli eti leevu na mmɔ. Na bana akɔ badi bamu belie ngba ɔmwi, ina ka badi béekpi.

english_verse: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina Yakobo ku batalane bammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Na kekplokɔ ni, údie lɛlɔ ɔ́tina ami lɛnɔ ina ka lɛlɛ ukyuli ɔni na nwuna bɔwɔ bɔ́bla kekuma.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ami ndi batalane bammɔ akɔ ubliidi ƒui. Na ńtamanku ka balɔ-mi banii ɔtalane muedi, ɔsika ami líkpoku Katɔti baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔkɛnku Katɔti lɛƒɔndia ɔsu ni, ndi ukyuli ɔni ndi ɔƒɛni. Na nwuna kaƒɔbuni ala ani na úte-mi ni, ánwu ebi. Na lɛ́bla kabla kpakplaa lítulo batalane bakladi ɔni na bekyuli baaasia anu ina ka ɔɔɔdi ami ɔlati ɔyikun kemmo na ɔdi. Mmomu Katɔti ɔyikun nkɛ-mi lɛlɔ na lɛ́bla ɔmɛni.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si ami násu-mii lɛla lɛdi o-o, iye ama násu-mii o-o ni, lɛlakpa linwi lɛmɛni kani na bɔɔsu. Na ani na bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́di. Katɔti Ɔ́gyila Kristo Ɔ́lɛku Bekpine Akɔ

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ka kenye kani na bɔɔsu ndi ka Katɔti ɔ́gyila Kristo ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ ni, bi ɔsu na bina badi bɛɛsu bɛnii Katɔti ulágyila bekpine na basɔ bebelie ngba?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Si sɔsɔ na use lɛni ni, na ɔɔtina ka Katɔti útagyila Kristo útalɛku bekpine akɔ.

english_verse: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
translation_verse: Na si Katɔti útagyila Kristo útalɛku bekpine akɔ bɔdi ni, na lɛsa lɛdi liiibo na bɔɔkɔ́ bute-mii. Na lɛla lɛdi lɛnɔ liiibo na bɛƒɔ bɛdi.

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: Na ɔni nsɔ mbo ɔkplu ntulo ndi ka ɔɔtina ka bɔɔnyi ɔkɔ taasia Katɔti ka anwu nágyila Yesu ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ. Nsu si sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka bekpine baláta teelie ngba ni, na útagyila Yesu.

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka ulágyila bekpine taasiku kekpine ni, na bɛgyi bɛnii útagyila Yesu útalɛku bekpine akɔ.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Na si Katɔti útagyila Yesu útalɛku bekpine akɔ bɔdi ni, na bina bɔƒɔtaadi buuubo kɔsia kɔdi, na bɛmu bɛkya bina ekpidi kemmo.

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: Na nwuna kalɔ ndi ka Kristo baƒɔtaadine bani nékpi lɛnɔ báyii.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: Na si kayawi kamɛni ngba bulie kani ɔsu na bula anu aasia Kristo lɛlɔ ni, na bula lɛlɔ libo kɔnyana litulo bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
translation_verse: Nsu litemi geen lɛmmɔ ndi ka Katɔti ɔ́gyila Kristo ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ. Na ɔmɛni ndi bula kama kekpokɔ ka bani ƒui ntɛ kekpine badubɔsɔ bɔta.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kalɛ na kukpi kɔkɛnku ukyuli lɛlɔ na kúduo bekyuli akɔ ni, lɛni kani na bekpine badubo bɔsɔ bɔta ɔkɛnku ukyuli kani lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti ɔdubɔgyila ɔdi biala na ulu ɔni na Katɔti ɔlati úse úse lɛlɔ. Na Kristo ndi udeedi. Na uwi ɔni lɛlɔ na wasɔ webo ni, bani na béti lɛlɔ béte Kristo ɔmmɔ na ɔdubɔsɔ ɔgyila.

english_verse: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, kawɔlɔkɔ kammɔ kadububo. Na Kristo ɔdubɔyila bayikune ku kenyekɔ ku ɔyikun ƒui udu. Na Kristo ɔdubuti lɛga kadikɔ kammɔ ɔkya Katɔti ɔni ndi Ɔti enu kemmo.

english_verse: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
translation_verse: Ɔsika Kristo ɔdubo lɛlɔ butaadi wetédu ka Katɔti úti nwuna bekisine ƒui ɔ́kya Yesu lɛgba kalɔ.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: Na ukisine ukplodi ɔni udu na ɔdubɔyila ndi kukpi.

english_verse: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔnini, “Katɔti úti ala ƒui ɔ́kya-nwu lɛgba kalɔ.” Na use nwaa ka si básu banii ala ƒui ni, ɔmmɔ ulátina ka Katɔti ɔni néti ala ammɔ ɔ́kya Kristo lɛgba kalɔ lɛnɔ ubunku.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na Katɔti úti ala ƒui ɔ́kya Kristo kalɔ ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, anwu Kristo ɔni ndi Katɔti Ubidi ɔmmɔ ɔdubuti lɛlɔ ɔkya Katɔti ɔmmɔ kalɔ na Katɔti ɔmmɔ ɔdi ala ƒui lɛlɔ kede kede.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ni, na bekyuli bani mɔɔƒɔ́ ntu bɔkpila ɔdi na bekyuli bani néekpi lili ni, bi na ɔbladu ɔmmɔ ɔdanku? Na bi mɔɔlɛ́ taasiku ɔmmɔ kemmo. Si sɔsɔ na ɔdi kalɛ na badi baasu banii basɔ balata balálɛ kekpine na bebelie ngba ni, bi ɔsu na baakpila bekyuli bammɔ ntu na bani néekpi lili?

english_verse: And why do we always risk our lives
translation_verse: Na abu batalane nɔɔ? Bi ɔsu na bula ngba bɔkya ɔgbankpi kemmo uwi biala?

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: Banwa, kukpi ɔgbankpi ɔsiaku-mi kadi biala megye! Na mɔɔkɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ na amii ɔsu ɔkɛnku kalɛ na bɔ́bla unwi ku Kristo ɔsu. Anwuɔsu na muudie ɔmɛni keyi nwaa.

english_verse: What do you think I gained by fighting wild animals in Ephesus? If the dead are not raised to life, “Let's eat and drink. Tomorrow we die.”
translation_verse: Nsu si kayawi kamɛni kasusu kani ɔsu na líkpoku bekyuli bani nse aani beƒiebuo na Eƒeso ni, bi kɔsia na lɛ́kɛ? Na si bekyuli basɔ balata balálɛ kekpine na bebelie ngba bɔdi ni, na bɛgyi bɛnii ɔlɛka bɔbla aani kalɛ na lɛsugba lɛdi lɛɛsu lɛnii, “Bɛya bɔdi na bɔni, ɔsika kɔnaadi bɔdubo bukpi.”

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you.
translation_verse: Bitabla susuusu. Kɔkpana kukpidi kuubile udu buni.

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Bɛsɔku kasusu buni bɛbla, na bɛda bina ekpidi lilu bɛva. Mɔɔsu-mii nwaa kalɛ na kɔƒa kukpo-mii ka bina badi bɛɛɛgyi Katɔti. Paulo Ɔ́tɛmi Ɔ́siku Ɔlɔna Bɔsɔ Taata Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ɔdubuye ɔnii, “Dɛ na baasɔ taagyila bekpine na baasɔ teebelie ngba? Na ɔlɔna ɔmani udu ndubo-ma bɔkya?”

english_verse: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
translation_verse: Bekyuli susuusu! Si bɛ́va edula kebi bɛ́kya kalɔ ni, lilakwɛ teenwini lɛla lɛni mbo ngba si útebu.

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: Katɔti muute kebi kammɔ ugyii udu ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́. Uute kebi biala ku kana kugyii udu ɔni námanku-ka.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Katɔ ala akya. Na kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ ala lɛnɔ akya. Katɔ ala bɔdia bɔvumana ku kalɔ lɛlɔ ɔlɔna bɔdia.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛ ɔdanku nwuna bukeye, na kɔbuli lɛnɔ kɔdanku bukeye bɔbambadi. Na ayabi lɛnɔ ana bukeye buse bun. Na ayabi ammɔ akɔ muedi kavumana kakya ana bukeye kemmo.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na ɔdubo buse uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔdubɔgyila bekpine na basɔ bebelie ngba. Si báva ukyuli ɔlɔna ni, ɔdi lɛla lɛni muubie taayii udu. Na si bágyila-nwu ni, ɔsɔ ulekpi.

english_verse: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na báva-nwu ni, ɔdi kayawi ɔlɔna ɔni muukpi. Na si bágyila-nwu ni, únwini kɔyu kemmo ɔlɔna. Si kayawi ɔlɔna ɔkya ni, na bɛgyi bɛnii kɔyu kemmo ɔlɔna lɛnɔ ɔkya.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔkya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ka ni, “Ukyuli udeedi ɔni ndi Adam ni, Katɔti nédie-nwu na úte-nwu ngba aani ɔyawine.” Na Adam ukplodi ɔmɛni anwu ni, ɔdi Kɔyu kɔni muute ngba geen.

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi kɔyu kemmo lɛla mɔɔgyú taatɔ. Mmomu ɔlɔna kemmo lɛla mɔɔtɔ. Kama asa na kɔyu kemmo lɛdi lɛɛsia.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Adam udeedi ɔni na Katɔti úti lɛti ɔ́vɔ ni, kalɔ lɛlɔ na ɔ́si. Na Adam unyɔdi ni, katɔ na ɔ́si.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani na kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni na bási ni, bese aani ukyuli ɔni na béti lɛti bávɔ-nwu. Na bani na katɔ na bási ni, ama lɛnɔ bese aani ukyuli ɔni nási katɔ.

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Kalɛ kani na bubo ukyuli ɔni nási kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni udu ni, lɛni kani na ukyuli ɔni nási katɔ ɔdubɔya na bɔkɛ nwuna udu.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: Banwa, lɛla lɛni kalɔ na muudie ndi ɔmɛni. Lɛla lɛni ndi ɔlɔna ku ubugya ni, lilakana Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ ala bɔdi. Na lɛla lɛni muubie taayii udu ni, lilakana na lɛkya kesii kani na lɛla lɛni neeebie taayii udu lɛkya.

english_verse: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
translation_verse: Binu lɛbɛla lɛmɛni. Ɔɔɔdi bula ƒui ndubukpi. Nsu si kakpɛɛ kekplodi káku ni, Katɔti ɔdubo bula ƒui udu bɔvumana kɔnakunwi.

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔbla aani kalɛ na beebó anumi. Ɔsika si kakpɛɛ kammɔ káku ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔgyila bekpine ɔni na basɔ belekpi kudii. Na ɔdubo bula ƒui udu bɔvumana.

english_verse: Our dead and decaying bodies will be changed into bodies that won't die or decay.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛla lɛni muubie taayii udu ni, badubo-ni bɔvumana bunwini lɛla lɛni nsɔ neeebie taayii udu. Na lɛla lɛni muukpi lɛnɔ ni, ɔdubo-ni bɔvumana bunwini lɛla lɛni nsɔ naaadubo bukpi.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si ala amɛni álɛ na bávumana ala ebiedi na énwini ani nsɔ neeebie ni, na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo etemila ani mɔɔsu anii, “Ɔ́yila kukpi udu na ɔ́di-ku lɛlɔ,” ébo éte lɛni sɔsɔ.

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Kukpi kɔɔkɛ́ ɔyikun ɔni na ɔda ɔɔta-bu taasiku likpidi kudɔ. Na likpidi lɛnɔ lɛɛkɛ́ nwuna ɔyikun taasiku ɔda bubo kudɔ.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Nsu bɔɔgyá Katɔti enu. Anwu náya na bɔ́di lɛlɔ ɔkɛnku Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ!

english_verse: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, banwa, binye kpakplaa na bitagbanta. Na binye Blɔti kabla lɛlɔ uwi biala. Ɔsika bɛgyi ka lɛla lɛdi liiibo na bɛdubɔbla na Blɔti kabla kemmo na wabla keeke.

english_verse: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ni, bínweni lɛla lɛdi bɛ́siku egulabi ani na bɛɛyɔ́ ka biyi bɛsala na biti bibunku Katɔti bekyuli bani nkya Yudea kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na ɔdi ka bɛbla lɛla lɛni na lɛ́su Galatiƒuɔ baƒɔtaadine nnii babla.

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Na Kwasida limeyi biala ni, ɔdi biala ɔklibi lɛla lɛdi use sɛsɛɛ na kalɛ na ɔ́kɛ kenye na ɔklibi-nya use kalɛ na ɔ́sɔ ulabla egulabi adi buyi si líbo-mii kudɔ.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: Na si líbo ḿbeduo ni, ndubute bekyuli bani na amii alati bɛ́ƒuna kakunkɛ kani na badubuti bada asa beti bina etela ammɔ beteesienku Yerusalem.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: Na si ɔ́manku ka ami lɛnɔ lisie ni, na bɔsiaku lɛlɔ. Muuvele-mii Ala Amɛni

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: Ndubɔsia Makedonia asa na mebedu-mii kudɔ, ɔsika ɔdi ka lɛka mmɔ bɔsia.

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: Use-mi aani ndubɔdi emeyi alɛɛ adi na bina kudɔ mmɔ. Ɔƒɛni kalɛ kɔyɔ uwi ɔmmɔ ƒui ni, ndubɔkya-mii kudɔ. Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, bɛdubudie-mi ulu na lisie kesii biala na ɔ́manku ka lisie.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: Naaawia ka likeli mbavi-mii kudɔ kani. Mmomu mɔɔyɔ́ ka lɛkya-mii kudɔ na uwi utu blii si Blɔti úte kuƒi kɔmmɔ.

english_verse: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
translation_verse: Ndubo Eƒeso mɛni bɔkya butédu Pentekoste limeyi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: Kuƒi kɔbuni kɔkya mɛni geen ute kabla kenengudi kani náƒɔ kuye geen, ina ka bekyuli bani mɔɔta teenye-mi lɛlɔ na kabla kani mɔɔbla na mɛni bemomo.

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Si Timoteo úbeduo-mii kudɔ ni, na bɛƒɔ-nwu kaduɛ. Ɔsika ɔɔbla kabla teete Blɔti aani kalɛ kani na ami lɛnɔ mɔɔbla.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Ɔdi biala utanu-nwu anumi klukui. Mmomu bibunku-nwu na usie anumi na nwuna ulu busie kemmo ku keyi buɛɛ kalɛ na wasɔ wenwini webo-mi kudɔ. Ɔsika mɔɔnu-nwu anumi ka unwini ubo ku nwuna banwa baƒɔtaadine.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni na bula ɔnwa Apolo litemi lɛlɔ ni, lɛ́ɛkya-nwu ogya kɔlɛ kɔlɛ ka ubo-mii kudɔ ku banwa badi. Nsu útenu tɔ kalɔ kaduɛ ka ubo uwi ɔmɛni kemmo. Nsu lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di ka si kuƒi kɔ́tɛ ni, ɔdububo. Bɔkada

english_verse: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.
translation_verse: Binye kagyumana na binye kpakplaa na bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ kemmo. Bise kayi na bɛyu ɔkplu.

english_verse: Show love in everything you do.
translation_verse: Na bɛbla bina kabla ƒui na bɔyɔ kemmo.

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: Bɛgyi Steƒana ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli. Ama ndi bekyuli bedeedi bani nénwini kayi na Akaia kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ mmɔ. Na béti lɛlɔ béte ka beteebunku Katɔti bekyuli. Banwa, muuvele-mii nnii,

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: biti ɔbu bite batɔnkune bamɛni ku babambadi bani muubunku-ma kabla kammɔ.

english_verse: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi ka Steƒana ku Ƒotunato ku Akaiko bébeduo, na ɔ́bla-mi aani amii na lɛ́nu.

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: Báya na lɛ́sɔ lɛ́kɛ ɔkplu aani kalɛ kani na bákya-mii ɔkplu. Na bekyuli bamɛni udu bámanku ka babu-ma geen.

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Baƒɔtaadine bani nkya Asia kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ ƒui beegyele-mii o-o! Akwila ku Priskila ku lɛkpa lɛni mɔɔsa na bana kaduli beegyele-mii kaduɛ na Blɔti lɛnyi kemmo.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Banwa bani nkya mɛni ƒui beegyele-mii o-o! Bɛkya lɛlɔ kɔgbu na bigyele lɛlɔ aani banwa kalɛ.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
translation_verse: Ami ɔlati mina kɔnu na líti muunweni ɔmɛni nnii, “Ami Paulo muugyele-mii o-o!”

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛƒɔndia lɛsiaku-mii.

english_verse: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Líti bɔyɔ geen muute-mii na Yesu Kristo lɛnyi kemmo. Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Ami Paulo ɔni nkɛnku Katɔti lɛƒɔyɔ lɛlɔ na ndi Blɔti Yesu Kristo ɔtalane ni, ami ku Ɔnwa Timoteo muunweni ɔku ɔmɛni bute amii Korintoƒuɔ bani néti lɛlɔ bíte Katɔti ku bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔbla Katɔti kabla na Akaia kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: Buuvele bɔnii Unwoti Katɔti ku Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛƒɔndia ku keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-mii. Katɔti Ɔɔsia-bu Kɔnu Na Bula Lɛbibo Biala Kemmo

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bɔgya Katɔti ɔni ndi Blɔti Yesu Kristo Ɔti enu. Anwu ndi Ati ɔni mɔɔnu-bu kɔnyana, na nwuna kudɔ na kebunku kaasí.

english_verse: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.
translation_verse: Anwu mɔɔsia-bu kɔnu na bula lɛbibo biala kemmo, kalɛ na abu lɛnɔ bɔkana na bubunku bula bekyulikpana na bana lɛbibo biala kemmo. Na kalɛ na Katɔti uubunku-bu ni, lɛni na abu lɛnɔ buubunku bekyuli.

english_verse: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kalɛ na buubó abi geen ani udu na Kristo lɛnɔ úbo na Katɔti ɔ́sia-nwu kɔnu ni, lɛni kani na ɔkɛ bula unwi bɔbla ku Kristo na Katɔti lɛnɔ ɔɔsia-bu kɔnu geen.

english_verse: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
translation_verse: Uwi biala si ami ku mina banwani buubó abi ni, bɔɔkana na bɔkya-mii ogya na bɛkɛ bɔƒɔ lɛnɔ. Katɔti ɔɔsia-bu kɔnu uwi ɔni na buubó abi biala. Lɛni kani na ɔdubɔsia amii lɛnɔ kɔnu uwi biala kemmo na biisé kayi teebo abi.

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Bubo lɛnunsia lɛni naaayuɛ na bina lɛlɔ, ɔsika bɔgyi ka kalɛ na biibó abi ani udu na abu lɛnɔ buubó mɛni ni, lɛni kani na Katɔti ɔdubɔsia-mii kɔnu aani kalɛ na ɔɔsia abu lɛnɔ kɔnu.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: Banwa, bɔɔwia ka bɔsu-mii abi ani udu na búbo na Asia kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ. Lɛbibo lɛmmɔ línwini etila líte-bu ɔni na bɔsɔ buuubo lɛnunsia lɛdi bɔnii bɔdubɔkɛ ngba muedi.

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla-bu aani si kukpi kɔtɔ na bádu-bu! Nsu ɔmɛni úbo úte lɛni kalɛ na buti bula anu bɔsia Katɔti ɔni mɔɔgyila bekpine na baasɔ teebelie ngba lɛlɔ. Ɔɔɔdi abu alati bula lɛlɔ na buti anu bɔsia.

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: Údie-bu ɔ́lɛku kukpi ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na ɔdubudie-bu lɛnɔ. Sɔsɔ ni, nwuna lɛlɔ na bɔɔsia anu ka ɔdubo-bu buteedie lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka amii lɛnɔ bibunku-bu na bɛkpali katɔ bite-bu. Ɔsika si bekyuli pii bákpali katɔ na Katɔti úbunku-bu ni, bekyuli pii badubɔgya Katɔti enu na kalɛ na úbunku-bu ɔsu. Paulo Ɔ́su Lɛla Lɛni Ɔsu Na Ɔ́vumana Nwuna Kasusu

english_verse: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni ɔsu na bɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ ndi ka bula kayi kaladu-bu kɔtɔ, ɔsika bɔ́da bula lɛlɔ kaduɛ na bekyuli ƒui akɔ. Na abu ku-mii kelie kakɛ Katɔti ulu lɛlɔ, na katɔlɔ keeebo-nwu kemmo. Ɔɔɔdi kayawi kamɛni kemmo lɛnunda na búti bulieku-mii lɛni, mmomu Katɔti lɛƒɔndia ku nwuna ɔyikun lɛlɔ na bɔ́sia.

english_verse: I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely,
translation_verse: Ala ani na bɛkana bɔka na binu kalɔ ni, anya lɛti na buunweni teete-mii. Na lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di ka bɛdubunu ala amɛni kalɔ ƒui,

english_verse: just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
translation_verse: aani kalɛ na bínu ekpo adi kalɔ. Na bɛdubunu kalɔ ka bɛkana bɛkun lɛmɛnɛ na bula lɛlɔ, na abu lɛnɔ bɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na bina lɛlɔ na limeyi lɛni na Blɔti Yesu Kristo wasɔ webo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
translation_verse: Ka lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di ka bɛ́ƒɔ-mi ku kayi ƒui ɔsu ni, lɛ́bla kasusu kudeedi ka lɛka-mii kudɔ bubo bubavi na Makedonia asa na linwini libo kalɛ na bibunku-mi si lísela Yudea. Nka ɔmmɔ ndubɔya na bɛkɛ ebiti kunyɔ kunyɔ.

english_verse: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na lɛ́bla mina kasusu ka lɛvumana bina kudɔ bubo ni, ɔmmɔ ulátina ɔnii mina ablala eeese siin. Na ɔɔɔdi kayawi kamɛni ala kakali kenye na líti mɔɔbla mina kasusu kammɔ aani ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbabla taasu ɔnii ɛɛn ku oowo.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Mmomu kalɛ na Katɔti ɔɔdi nwuna etemila lɛlɔ geen ni, lɛni kani na lɛla biala na búnweni búmene-mii lise. Na lɛɛɛdi kalɛ na ukyuli ɔɔbabla taasu ɔnii ɛɛn ku oowo na ɔdi.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Katɔti Ubidi Yesu Kristo ɔni lɛlɔ litemi lɛsa na ami ku Silivano ku Timoteo bɔɔkɔ́ teete-mii ni, ɔɔɔdi ɛɛn ku oowo ukyuli. Mmomu ɔdi ukyuli ɔni litemi ndi ɛɛn uwi biala.

english_verse: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti kenye biala na úse-bu úse ni, kébo kéte lɛni na Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bɔɔsu na nwuna lɛnyi kemmo bɔnii, “Ɔsia lɛni.” Na buti bumwi bute Katɔti.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́ya na abu ku-mii ƒui bɔ́bla unwi ku Kristo, na anwu ɔlati náƒuna-bu úse ka butaabla nwuna kabla.

english_verse: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔlati ɔgyi ka naaayɔ ka libo mbani-mii kɔtu. Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na lɛla lɛdi lɛsɔ lilékpoku-mii ka ɔɔɔdi ɔmɛni ɔsu na lɛ́bla kasusu nnii neeebo Korinto tɔ.

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi banii bɔɔdi-mii lɛlɔ na ala amɛni kemmo. Bɔgyi geen kalɛ na bɛda bina bɔƒɔtaadi kpakplaa. Anwuɔsu abu ku-mii bɔɔsála taabla kabla na bɛkɛ ebiti.

english_verse: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu lɛ́bla kasusu ka nsɔ neeebo-mii kudɔ na enu aƒɛ-mii.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: Ɔsika si lɛ́ya na enu áƒɛ-mii ni, ɔdi lɛnɔ ɔ́sɔ uuubo na waya na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mi, amu ntu amii bani na lɛ́ya na enu áƒɛ mmɔ kani.

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: Na línweni ɔku kpakplaa ɔmmɔ límene-mii ɔsika si bubo na líbo-mii kudɔ uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, nka bɛdubɔya na enu aƒɛ-mi. Nsu amii ndi bekyuli bani nálɛka bɛya na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mi. Na lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di ka si lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi ni, amii lɛnɔ lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-mii.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ ni, ɔku ɔni na línweni-mii mmɔ ni, línweni-nwu na kayi ɔlɛ bunu ku enuƒɛ ku keku buwulo kemmo. Na ɔɔɔdi ka mɔɔwia nnii amii lɛnɔ binu ɔlɛ ɔdi, mmomu kalɛ na bɛnu bɛti ka mɔɔyɔ́-mii geen ɔsu. Paulo Úti Ala Ekpidi Ɔblane Bɔƒiɔ Ɔ́kyiɛ

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ukyuli ɔni bɔƒiɔ lɛlɔ litemi línweni-mii ni, ɔɔɔdi ami lɛti na ɔ́ƒiɔ. Mmomu bɔkana bɔsu bɔnii ɔ́ƒiɔ bina ƒui. Nsu naaayɔ ka bɔdɔnku-nwu bɔgya.

english_verse: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli ɔmmɔ ni, kɔtu kɔni na bina akɔ pii bɛ́ni-nwu mmɔ ni, ɔmmɔ kani ɔbɔ.

english_verse: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, biti bɛkyiɛ-nwu na bɛkya-nwu ɔkplu kalɛ na lɛlɔ lilayuɛ-nwu na enu aƒɛ-nwu ƒui.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bise-nwu kayi na bidie bɛtina-nwu ka bɛmu bɛɛyɔ́-nwu.

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na línweni-mii ɔku na lɛ́wia nnii mɔɔtí kalɛ na binye kpakplaa na bɛda mina ala ani ƒui na lɛ́tina-mii kaduɛ uwi biala.

english_verse: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Si bíti ukyuli ɔmmɔ bɔƒiɔ bɛ́kyiɛ-nwu ni, ami lɛnɔ líti lɛ́kyiɛ-nwu. Na si bɔƒiɔ bɔdi bɔkya bɔni na ɔlɛka liti lɛkyiɛ-nwu ni, líti lɛ́kyiɛ-nwu na Kristo anumi kalɛ na bɛbla unwi.

english_verse: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na butile ukisine ɔmmɔ kuƒi na ulákɛ kasiakɔ kadi na bula lɛlɔ, ɔsika bɔgyi-nwu kɔkwɛ. Paulo Ɔ́kya Troia Uwi Klukui Ɔdi

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na líbo ḿbakɔ Kristo litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa na Troia ni, Blɔti ɔ́lɛmi kuƒi ka lɛbla nwuna kabla na mmɔ.

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: Nsu mina kasusu kétete-mi bɔnwuna bɔdi, ɔsika ńtanu mina ɔnwani Tito na mmɔ ka línu-mii kɔku. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu lívele ulu na lɛ́tɔlɔ lísie Makedonia. Kristo Ɔ́ya Na Bɔ́di Lɛlɔ

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, bɔ́gya Katɔti enu! Na bula unwi bɔbla ku Kristo ni, Katɔti ɔɔtɔnku-bu uwi biala na bɔkɛ bekyuli bani muusié taavi na Kristo lɛlɔ bɔdi kemmo. Na Katɔti ɔsia-bu lɛlɔ na udie Kristo ɔtina kayawi ƒui aani kalɛ na ɔnyi ƒɛƒɛɛ ɔɔƒɔ́ likpo lɛdi ƒui.

english_verse: In fact, God thinks of us as a perfume that brings Christ to everyone. For people who are being saved, this perfume has a sweet smell and leads them to a better life. But for people who are lost, it has a bad smell and leads them to a horrible death. No one really has what it takes to do this work.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani naaadubo bɔkɛ ngba bɔƒɔ ni, ɔnyi ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka badubɔyii ku udu. Na bekyuli bani ndubɔkɛ ngba bɔƒɔ ama ni, ɔnyi ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka badubɔkɛ ngba ƒui. Na ɔma geen ndubɔkana na ɔbla kabla kamɛni si ɔɔɔdi kuƒi na béte-ɔ?

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Abu buuuse aani bekyuli babambadi pii bani nkɛ bada litemi lɛmmɔ baadi kuye. Mmomu Katɔti úte-bu kenyekɔ na bɔɔkɔ́ litemi lɛmmɔ lɛsa na nwuna anumi aani Kristo kabla bablane kalɛ. Bulatɔlɔ bekyuli.

english_verse: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ulátina ka buukú lɛlɔ aani si bɔdi lɛla lɛdi. Buuuse aani bekyuli bamba bani mɔɔwia kakunkɛ kani medie-bu matina-mii. Na lɛni kani na buláwia ka bɔsu-mii bɔnii binweni kakunkɛ kadi na bidie-bu bɛtina bekyuli bamba badi.

english_verse: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
translation_verse: Ɔsika amii alati ndi bula kakunkɛ kani na Katɔti únweni ɔ́sia-mii kayi lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli biala ɔdubɔnu bula udu ɔti na bina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: Use nwaa ka Kristo ɔlati ɔ́sia-bu lɛlɔ na ɔ́ya na bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́di. Anwuɔsu bise aani ɔku ɔni na únweni. Ɔɔɔdi unwenigyii na úti únweni ala ammɔ. Mmomu Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun na úti na únweni-nya ɔsia. Na ɔɔɔdi atabi lɛlɔ na únweni ɔ́sia aani kalɛ na ɔ́bla kukuuku, mmomu bekyuli kayi. Katɔti Úte-bu Ngba Na Bunyimi Bɔwɔdi Kemmo

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Bɔ́kana bɔɔsu ɔmɛni na kenyekɔ kani na Katɔti úte-bu na Kristo ɔsu.

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: Buuubo kenyekɔ kadi na abu alati lɛlɔ ka bɔbla kabla kamɛni. Mmomu Katɔti kudɔ na kási.

english_verse: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
translation_verse: Anwu úte-bu kenyekɔ ka bɔtina bekyuli kalɛ na badi bunyimi bɔwɔdi bɔni na Katɔti únyimi ku bekyuli mɛni lɛlɔ. Na bunyimi bɔwɔdi bɔmɛni bɔɔɔdanku ɔda bubo bɔkukudi bɔni na bénweni. Mmomu bɔdanku Katɔti Kɔyu. Ɔsika ɔda bubo bɔkukudi bɔmmɔ ni, bɔɔdú-bu kukpi kɔtɔ. Nsu Katɔti Kɔyu muute-bu ngba.

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔni na bénweni kukuuku mmɔ ni, bɔdi etemila ani na bánwi bámana atabi lɛlɔ. Na uwi ɔni na béti-nya béte bekyuli ni, Katɔti bukeye bɔ́ya na Mose anumi eekeye. Na ina ka bukeye bɔmmɔ bɔɔƒana na Mose anumi muedi ni, Israelƒuɔ bátakana na benye bataanu-nwu anumi. Na si ɔda bubo bɔni mɔɔdú-bu kukpi kɔtɔ bɔ́da bɔ́lɛ uwi ɔmmɔ ku Katɔti bukeye bɔmmɔ udu ni,

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: nwuna Kɔyu ablala bɔdubɔda bɔlɛ ku bukeye bɔni ntulo budeedi bɔmmɔ ƒui!

english_verse: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
translation_verse: Na si ɔda bubo bɔkukudi bɔni muuti kɔtɔ bɔdu teete ukyuli bɔdanku bukeye bɔmɛni udu ni, ɔlɛka bɔti ka litemi buni lɛni mɔɔbla-bu siin ni, nina bukeye butulo budeedi ƒui.

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Bɔɔsu ɔmɛni ɔsika bukeye bunengudi ƒui bɔni kemmo na bɔkya ɔmwi mɛni ni, bɔ́ƒɔ bukeye bɔkukudi bɔmmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Na si lɛla lɛni na nina uwi ɔ́vi líkeye lɛni uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, bɛgyi bɛnii lɛla lɛwɔdi lɛni neeebo kawɔkɔ ni, nina bukeye butulo bɔmmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: Na abu buuuse aani Mose ɔni néti lɛdiku úbi anumi kalɛ na Israelƒuɔ balanu baláti ka Katɔti bukeye bɔni na nsia-nwu anumi bɔɔƒana.

english_verse: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka bana kasusu kalánu ɔmɛni taati. Use aani si lɛdiku lɛmmɔ udu kani lɛmu libi-ma kasusu lɛlɔ si baaká bunyimi bɔkukudi ɔku ɔmmɔ kemmo etemila. Ɔsika lɛla lɛni kani na ndubɔya na lɛdiku lɛmmɔ lɛmami ndi si ukyuli úti lɛlɔ ɔ́mana Kristo.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, Blɔti ɔni na bɔɔlɔ mɛni ni, anwu ndi Katɔti Kɔyu. Na kesii kani na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔkya ni, lɛla lɛdi lɛsɔ lilényimi ukyuli.

english_verse: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
translation_verse: Na abu baƒɔtaadine bani na lɛla lɛdi liiibi-bu anumi ni, bɔɔnu Blɔti bukeye nwaa. Na Blɔti ɔni ndi Katɔti Kɔyu mɛni ni, anwu mɔɔvumana-bu udu taabla nwuna udu kalɛ na buteekeye teebu.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́nu-bu kɔnyana na úti kabla kamɛni ɔ́kya-bu enu kemmo. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na enu aláƒɛ-bu.

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
translation_verse: Búdie abɛla ku kɔƒa ala bɔbla atu. Na bulányi ɔkɔ taabla kabla kadi na bulátu Katɔti litemi lɛmmɔ teenwini. Bɔɔsu litemi buni lɛmmɔ nwaa na Katɔti anumi kalɛ na ukyuli biala ɔdubɔnu bula ɔbladu buni ɔti.

english_verse: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
translation_verse: Na si litemi buni lɛni lɛsa na bɔɔkɔ́ mɛni lɛmu lise bekyuli badi suu ni, bɛgyi bɛnii bekyuli bani ndaku bɔyii na use ute lɛni.

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bammɔ ni, ukisine ɔmmɔ ɔ́bwɛ ama bani naaaƒɔ taadi anumi. Na uutile-ma kuƒi kalɛ na balanu bukeye bɔmmɔ. Na bukeye bɔmɛni bɔɔsí litemi buni lɛni nkɛnku Kristo bukeye bɔni ndi Katɔti ɔmmɔ ɔlati udu geen kemmo.

english_verse: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
translation_verse: Bulakɔ abu alati lɛlɔ lɛsa teete-mii, mmomu Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ lɛsa na bɔɔkɔ́ teete-mii ka ɔdi Blɔti. Na abu bɔdi kabla bablane bute-mii na Kristo ɔsu.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Katɔti násu na kalɔ kesekɔ ɔnii, “Bukeye bɔƒɔ kasuudikɔ.” Na anwu kani náya na bukeye bɔmmɔ búkeye na bula kɔyi kemmo. Na bukeye bɔmmɔ náya na bɔ́nu Katɔti bukeye bɔni muukeye na Kristo anumi bɔ́ti.

english_verse: We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us.
translation_verse: Na abu bani mbo Kɔyu kemmo akɛla enengudi amɛni ni, buse aani ebwi avɔdi ani nátamanku ala ammɔ bɔkya. Na ɔmmɔ mɔɔtina geen ka ɔɔɔdi bula kudɔ na ɔyikun ɔmmɔ ɔ́si, mmomu Katɔti kudɔ na ɔ́si.

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: Buubó abi uwi ndi uwi, nsu lɛbibo lɛmmɔ lítetulo-bu. Kasusu keekpóku-bu, nsu enu átaƒɛ-bu.

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
