translation_verse: Bekisine pii basiaku-bu, nsu Katɔti útedie-bu atu. Ina ka bébo-bu banii baadú-bu muedi ni, bútekpi.

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ na bula ngba bulie kemmo ƒui ni, bɔkya kukpi ɔgbankpi kemmo na Yesu ɔsu. Nsu ɔyikun ɔni na úte-bu na bula ɔlɔna kemmo ɔsu ni, ɔdubɔya na bekyuli banu nwuna ngba bati.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu bɔkya ɔgbankpi lɛbibo kemmo uwi biala, na amii bɛɛkɛ́ kɔyu kemmo ngba.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: Bénweni na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo banii, “Lɛ́ƒɔ Katɔti lɛ́di, anwuɔsu na lɛ́kɔ-nwu lɛlɔ lɛsa.” Na lɛni kani na abu lɛnɔ bɔ́ƒɔ bɔ́di ɔsu na bɔɔkɔ́ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa.

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: Na bɔgyi ka Katɔti ɔni ńagyila Yesu ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ ni, lɛni kani na ɔdubɔgyila abu lɛnɔ na uti abu ku-mii ƒui usienku Katɔti anumi.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Bina kadia ɔsu na ala amɛni ƒui aalɛ́ lɛni. Na si bekyuli pii baakɛ́ bɔƒɔ teebu ɔkɛnku Katɔti lɛƒɔndia ɔsu ni, lɛni kani na badubo-nwu enu lɛnɔ butaagya teebu si beeti ɔbu teete Katɔti. Bɔdubɔkɛ Ɔbu Ku Lɛlɔyɔ Bonwu

english_verse: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
translation_verse: Kasusu kamɛni ɔsu na enu aláƒɛ-bu si ina bula ɔlɔna ugyii ɔmɛni ɔɔyii udu muedi ni, bɔgyi ka bula kɔyu kemmo ngba bulie bɔɔbla ɔwɔdi uwi biala.

english_verse: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
translation_verse: Na abi blii suɛ ani na buubó na uwi klukui ɔmɛni kemmo na kayawi mɛni ni, adubɔya na bɔkɛ ɔbu ku lɛlɔyɔ bonwu lɛni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii na katɔ. Na lɛdubutulo abi ani na búbo ƒui.

english_verse: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Ɔsika búti bula anu bɔ́sia ala ani na bula anumi alakana bɔnu lɛlɔ, na ɔɔɔdi ala ani na bula anumi aakana bɔnu. Na ala ani na bula anumi aakana bɔnu ni, uwi klukui ɔdi kani na anya aakya. Na ani na bula anumi alakana bɔnu ni, ese ésela uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: Na si bula ɔlɔna ɔni nse aani kevo kani kemmo bulie na kayawi kamɛni kemmo kébie ni, bubo ɔtɔ na Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma. Na ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ ni, anwu ɔlati néti nwuna enu ɔ́tu-nwu, na ɔdubunye uwi ƒui.

english_verse: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni kemmo na bɔmu bɔkya kayawi kamɛni ɔlɔna kemmo ni, buuubo bɔnwuna bɔdi. Na bɔɔnu ulu kpakplaa ka bɔkɛ Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ɔlɔna.

english_verse: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
translation_verse: Na si bɔ́kɛ ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ ni, ulabla-bu aani si bɔkɛ kasɔngya.

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni bɔmu bulie kayawi kamɛni ɔlɔna kemmo ni, bɔɔnu taati ka búmii na buuubo bɔnwuna. Na ɔɔɔdi ka bɔɔwia bɔnii bɔɔnyonu kayawi ɔlɔna ɔmɛni. Mmomu bɔɔwia ka bɔkya Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ɔlɔna kemmo kalɛ na ɔlɔna ɔni nsɔ naaadubo bukpi ɔƒɔ ɔni muukpi mmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
translation_verse: Katɔti náklibi-bu úse úte ka bɔvumana lɛni. Na úti nwuna Kɔyu úte-bu aani lɛla lɛni na buti butaanu ulu bute ala ani ƒui na ɔ́klibi úse úte-bu.

english_verse: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na bɔɔkɛ́ kayi. Na bɔgyi ka si bɔkya ɔlɔna ɔmɛni kemmo ni, na bulanu Blɔti ku anumi.

english_verse: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɔɔkɛ́ kayi geen na bɔɔyɔ́ teetulo si bɔ́nyonu ɔlɔna ɔmɛni búse na bútánu Blɔti ku anumi mmomu.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni na bɔɔwia teetulo ndi ka si mɛni na bɔkya o-o iye Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma o-o ni, na bɔbla Blɔti lɛƒɔyɔ.

english_verse: After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies. Bringing People to God
translation_verse: Ɔsika bula ƒui bɔdubɔda bɔlɛ Kristo anumi na ɔtɛku-bu litemi. Na ɔdi biala ɔdubɔƒɔ nwuna lɛyuƒɔla lɛni námanku nwuna kabla. Lɛbuni lɛdi o-o iye likpidi o-o, ɔdubɔƒɔ nwuna lɛyuƒɔla ɔkɛnku ngba bɔni na búlie na kayawi kamɛni kemmo. Bɛya Na Katɔti Ɔklibi Amii Ku-nwu Ntɛ

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Ka bɔgyi kalɛ na ɔlɛka bɔyia Blɔti ɔsu ni, bunye bekyuli lɛlɔ ka benu-bu kalɔ. Katɔti ɔgyi-bu kede kede na mɔɔsia anu ka amii lɛnɔ bɛti bula udu kaduɛ.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi banii lɛlɔ na bɔ́sɔ buukú bɔtina-mii, mmomu bɔɔwia ka bɛkɛ kasusu kabuni na bula lɛlɔ. Mɔɔwia ka bɛkɛ kenyekɔ kabuni na abu ɔsu kalɛ na bidie kenye bɛtina bekyuli bani mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na bekyuli lɛlɔ, na ɔɔɔdi ka bánu bana udu buni ɔdi báti ɔsu.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Si ina bɛɛnu-bu aani bekyuli bani na muukpi libuo na kabla kani na bɔɔbla ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔni na bɔɔyɔ́ ɔsu na use-bu lɛni. Nsu si bulékpi libuo ni, ɔdi bina kɔsia.

english_verse: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
translation_verse: Kristo bɔyɔ bɔni na ubo ute-bu mɔɔdi-bu lɛlɔ. Ɔƒɛni ka bɔ́nu bɔ́ti ka ukyuli unwi nékpi na bekyuli ƒui lili ɔsu ni, ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka bula ƒui bútu kukpi kɔmmɔ kenye bɔ́nu.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: Kristo nékpi na bekyuli ƒui lili kalɛ na bekyuli bani nli ngba ni, basɔ belelie ngba belete bana lɛlɔ. Mmomu belie ngba bete Kristo. Ɔsika ama ɔsu na Kristo úkpi na Katɔti ɔ́gyila-nwu ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ.

english_verse: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si ɔmɛni kama ni, bɔsɔ bulátɛku ɔdi litemi na kayawi kamɛni kasusu kenye. Lɛni na bɔ́tɛku Kristo litemi dii. Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, bɔsɔ bulánu-nwu lɛni.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si ukyuli ɔdi ku Kristo bábla unwi ni, ɔgyi ɔnii únwini ukyuli ɔwɔdi. Na nwuna ukyuli udu ɔkukudi ɔmmɔ ɔ́vi. Na ɔwɔdi ɔ́ƒɔ ɔmmɔ kenye.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Katɔti nábla ala amɛni ƒui. Na údie lɛla lɛni nébile abu ku-nwu ntɛ kalɛ na bɔblaku-nwu unwi ɔkɛnku Kristo lɛlɔ. Na anwu kani néti kabla kamɛni ɔ́kya-bu enu kemmo ɔnii bɔkpanku bekyuli bamba buboku na ɔklibi ama ku-nwu ntɛ.

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: Na lɛsa lɛmɛni ndi ka Katɔti ɔkɛ Kristo lɛlɔ na ɔ́klibi anwu ku bekyuli ƒui ntɛ. Na údie atu na bana ekpidi ƒui lɛlɔ. Na kenye kani na ɔda úte-bu ndi ka ɔɔwia ka bɔsu bekyuli ƒui ntɛ bɔklibi litemi lɛmɛni.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: Na abu nnye Kristo kenye. Na Katɔti ɔlati nkɛ-bu lɛlɔ na ɔɔsu-mii lɛla lɛni geen na ɔɔwia taasiku-mii kudɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu bunye Kristo kenyekɔ buuvele-mii bɔnii bɛya na Katɔti ɔklibi amii ku-nwu ntɛ.

english_verse: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Kristo útabla likpidi lɛdi. Nsu bula alaekpidi lili ɔsu na Katɔti úti-nwu ɔ́bla alaekpidi ɔblane. Na ɔmɛni maya na abu bani mablaku-nwu unwi ni, bɔbla siin na Katɔti anumi.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ka bunye bɔɔblaku Katɔti kabla ɔsu ni, buuvele-mii bɔnii bitebile Katɔti kɔnyana bɔnu.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: Na ka limeyi lɛni na lɛƒɔ-mii lɛnɔ lídu ni, líbunku-mii.” Binu! Mɔɔsu-mii ka ɔƒaani ndi uwi ɔni námanku na Katɔti ɔnu-mii kɔnyana. Na ɔmwi ndi limeyi lɛni na Katɔti ɔƒɔ-mii. Paulo Ɔ́siaku Lɛbibo

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: Bulayɔ ka ɔdi udie-bu bɔƒiɔ bɔdi na bula kabla kemmo. Ɔmɛni ɔsu bulabla lɛla lɛni maya na bekyuli belebo Katɔti kudɔ.

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: Mmomu ni, lɛla biala lɛni na bɔɔbla kemmo ni, buudie taatina nwaa ka Katɔti kabla bablane na bɔdi. Bunye kpakplaa na lɛƒɛda ku lɛbibo ku bukpoku kemmo.

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bébo-bu na bákya-bu aban ɔtɔ na báyoli-bu. Na bɔ́bla kabla bútulo lɛlɔ, na bútatɛ bútalɛɛ, na kɔka lɛnɔ kɔ́da-bu.

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: Búdie lɛlɔ bɔ́tina ka bɔdi kabla bablane babuni na kalɛ na bɔda lɛlɔ sɛɛn ku kalɛ na bɔgyi Katɔti litemi buni lɛmmɔ. Buuwi lɛlɔ buɛɛ ku bula ablala na bekyuli akɔ, na bɔɔbla lɛƒɔndia. Katɔti Kɔyu kɔɔkya-bu lɛlɔ kemmo, na bɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli ku kaƒɔ nwaa.

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: Bulatɔlɔ bekyuli ku bula lɛsa bɔkɔ. Na Katɔti ɔyikun ɔni nsiaku-bu ɔɔtina lɛnɔ ka bɔdi nwuna kabla bablane. Na bula ngba siin bulie ndi bula lɛla biala na kabla kamɛni kemmo. Buse aani ekpola ani ukpone ɔda uukpó.

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badi baabu-bu, na badi lɛnɔ beewi-bu anumi kalɔ. Badi beedumi-bu na babambadi lɛnɔ beemwi-bu. Bekyuli baanu-bu aani ɔkɔ banyine, nsu litemi geen lɛmmɔ na bɔɔsu.

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: Bekyuli balákpete-bu, nsu bagyi-bu kesii biala. Uwi ndi uwi bɔkya kukpi ɔgbankpi kemmo, nsu bɛnu! Bɔmu buli ngba! Báni-bu kɔtu geen, nsu bútekpi.

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: Ina ka bula lɛlɔ lɛɛkywí kaƒɔ ni, lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-bu uwi biala. Baanu-bu aani bawabane, nsu bɔɔyá na bekyuli beenwíni Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma balakɛne. Baanu-bu aani bekyuli bani neeebo lɛla lɛdi. Nsu geen ni, ala ƒui ása-bu.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: Mɔɔtɛmiku-mii aani kalɛ na ubi ɔti ɔɔtɛmiku nwuna bebi. Na kalɛ na buugyingya enu teete-mii ni, amii lɛnɔ bigyingya enu bite-bu lɛni kani. Ɔƒɔtaadine Ku Ukyuli Ɔni Nátaƒɔ Útadi Beeebo Kɔna

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Bɛnu ka amii ku bekyuli bani naaadi baƒɔtaadine bítabla unwi na lɛla lɛni naaasia bula ulu lɛlɔ. Ɔsika lɛla lɛni nse siin ku lɛla lɛni neeese siin lilábla unwi. Na bukeye ku lɛdisa lilákya liku linwi.

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Kristo ku ɔbɔnsamu balatunaku lɛlɔ. Lɛni kani na ɔƒɔtaadine ku ukyuli ɔni nátaƒɔ útadi beeebo kɔna.

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Baƒiɔ ku kesii kani na Katɔti uulie ni, katamanku lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu abu lɛnɔ bútamanku baƒiɔ, ɔsika abu ndi Katɔti ɔni neeekpi keliekɔ. Aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔlati ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ndubɔkya-ma akɔ na lilieku-ma, na ndubɔbla bana Katɔti, na ama lɛnɔ babla mina bekyuli.”

english_verse: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Blɔti ɔɔsu nwuna bekyuli ɔnini, “Bɛlɛ-ma akɔ, na bɛda lɛlɔ bɛmami bekyuli bani mɔɔbla lɛƒiɔkpa ala lɛlɔ. Bitetuku bana ala ani muusé lɛlɔ mmɔ, na ndubɔƒɔ-mii.

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Na ami ndubɔbla bina Ɔti, na amii lɛnɔ bɛbla mina bebi banana ku belekubi. Lɛni na Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui ɔɔsu.”

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
translation_verse: Banwa, ka Katɔti úse-bu kenye na ala amɛni ƒui lɛlɔ úse ɔsu ni, bɛya na bɔbla lɛlɔ sɛɛn na bɔda lɛlɔ budie ala ani ƒui mɔɔyá na bula ɔlɔna ku kɔyu kuusé lɛlɔ kudɔ. Na bɛya na buti lɛlɔ ƒui bute Katɔti ka bɔɔbu-nwu na bɔɔyia-nwu ɔsu. Paulo Ɔ́kɛ Ebiti Ka Korintoƒuɔ Bávumana Udu Ɔsu

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Bigyingya bina enu bite-bu. Bútaƒiɔ bina akɔ ɔdi, na bútakpanku ɔdi lɛnɔ bútavinku ulu ukpidi ɔdi lɛlɔ iye bɔnya ɔdi bɔkya.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: Naaasu ɔmɛni líti lɛkya-mii kɔƒa. Ɔsika lɛ́su ḿbavi nnii bɛ́ƒɔ-bu kuye ɔni na kukpi kemmo o-o, ngba kemmo o-o ni, lɛla bamba lɛdi muedi lilakana-bu ntɛ bule.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: Mina anu asia-mii lɛlɔ geen! Na mɔɔtina lɛlɔ na amii ɔsu. Na kaƒɔ kaayɔ́-mi ɔsika ina ka buubó abi ni, ebiti áƒɔ-mi kayi kemmo ƒui na amii ɔsu.

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: Ka búbeduo Makedonia muedi ni, bútakɛ bɔnwuna bɔdi. Mmomu ɔgbankpi sɔɔn na bekyuli bada baasiaku-bu kesii biala. Na bekyuli beekpóku-bu na liƒu lɛkya-bu lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti ɔni mɔɔsia bekyuli bani muuwulo kɔnyana kɔnu ni, ɔ́ya na kaƒɔ káyɔ-bu ɔni na Tito ɔ́si-mii kudɔ úbo.

english_verse: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi Tito bubo bɔmmɔ lɛti náya na bɔ́kɛ kubiti. Mmomu ɔ́su-bu ɔnii ala ani náyɔ-nwu kaƒɔ ni, anya ndi ka bɛɛyɔ́ ka bigyingya bina enu na bɛƒɔ-mi, na bina bɔƒiɔ búduo-mii, na binye-mi kama kpakplaa. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na ebiti ásɔ áda-mi étulo.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: Ɔku ɔni na línweni-mii ni, úkpoku-mii sɔsɔ. Nsu lɛni kani na ɔdi ka linweni-nwu. Lɛ́ti ka ɔku ɔmmɔ úduo-mii, nsu uwi klukui ɔdi kani na ɔdi.

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: Kalɔ kesekɔ ni, útayɔ-mi kaƒɔ ka úduo-mii lɛni. Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, mɔɔkɛ́ ebiti. Ɔɔɔdi ɔni na ɔku ɔmmɔ úduo-mii ɔsu, mmomu ka ɔ́ya na bina bɔƒiɔ búduo-mii na bíni-mu bɔbla ɔsu. Ɔsika Katɔti ala lɛlɔ ɔsu na ala ammɔ éduo-mii lɛni. Anwuɔsu lɛla lɛdi lítebie na ɔdi lɛlɔ na abu ɔsu.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Na si Katɔti ala lɛlɔ ɔsu na ukyuli alaekpidi ani na ɔ́bla éduo-nwu ni, uunwíni kama taakya ekpidi bɔbla na ɔɔkɛ́ bɔƒɔ ɔni na ɔsɔ ulenu ɔlɛ ɔdi. Nsu si kayawi ala lɛlɔ ɔsu na lɛla lɛdi liiduo-ɔ ni, ɔɔyá na aayila ngba geen bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
translation_verse: Bɛnu kalɛ binye kpakplaa ka ala ammɔ éduo-mii na Katɔti ala lɛlɔ ɔsu. Bɛɛwia kpakplaa ka bidie lɛlɔ na likpidi kemmo na bilie sɛɛn. Ɔsika ala ammɔ eeƒí-mii livo na ana bɔbla bɔɔda-mii liƒu. Nu kalɛ na bígyingya enu ka bɛƒɔ-mi, na binye-mi kama kpakplaa. Na anumi égyie-mii ka bɛni likpidi ɔblane ɔmmɔ kɔtu. Na bidie lɛlɔ bɛtina na ulu biala lɛlɔ ka bɛɛɛkɛnku ɔbladu ukpidi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ɔku ɔni na línweni límene-mii ni, ɔɔɔdi ukyuli ɔni náƒiɔ lɛlɔ litemi kani na lɛdi iye ukyuli ɔni na báƒiɔ lɛti ɔsu. Mmomu línweni-nwu kalɛ na bɛti na Katɔti anumi kalɛ na bɛɛbu-bu geen.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ƒui ɔsu kaƒɔ kaayɔ́-bu. Na lɛla lɛni náya na ebiti ásɔ aada-bu geen teetulo ndi lɛla lɛni náyɔ Tito kaƒɔ. Ɔsika bɛ́ya na nwuna kasusu kábla-nwu buɛɛ.

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: Bítakya-mi kɔƒa na nwuna anumi ka lɛ́kun lɛmɛnɛ na bina lɛlɔ. Na ala ani ƒui na bɔɔsu-mii uwi biala kemmo ni, adi etemila geen. Na lɛni kani na lɛmɛnɛ lɛni na bɔ́kun na Tito anumi lɛnɔ ɔdi ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na ɔɔyɔ́-mii teebu si uunyimo kalɛ bina ƒui bínye kagyumana na bínu ala ani na bɔ́tina-mii ku kalɛ na bɛ́ƒɔ-nwu na bíboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bíte-nwu na bɛɛbu-nwu ɔsu.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi ɔsika ɔƒɛni lɛkana na liti mina anu lɛsia-mii lɛlɔ na lɛla biala kemmo.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Banwa ɔlɛka bɛti lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́bla na baƒɔtaadine akpa ani ƒui nkya Makedonia akɔ na nwuna lɛƒɔndia ɔsu.

english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: Béte bekyuli ala kalɛ na bakana. Na mɔɔsu-mii geen ka béte bétulo kalɛ bebo muedi na ama alati bɔyɔ kemmo.

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: Ama bévele-bu banii bute-ma kuƒi na bebunku bekyuli bani mɔɔbla Katɔti kabla na Yudea kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
translation_verse: Na ala ani na bábla mɛni ni, étulo ala ani na abu alati bɔ́sia anu ka bakana bɔbla. Kudeedi ni, béti lɛlɔ béte Blɔti na béti lɛlɔ béte abu lɛnɔ aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔɔwia.

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na búvele Tito ɔni nése kabla kamɛni kalɔ na amii lɛnɔ akɔ bɔnii usie anumi na ubunku-mii na bɛkana na bɛwɔlɔ bina bawabane ala bute bɔni kalɔ na bíse mɛni.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ni, bɛtɔ bekyuli ƒui na lɛla biala kemmo. Sɔsɔ bɛtɔ na bina bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo ku bina bɔtɛmi ku litemi lɛmmɔ bɔti kemmo ku kalɛ na bɛɛwia ka bɛsiaku Katɔti kpakplaa ku kalɛ na bɛɛyɔ́-bu lɛnɔ kemmo. Nsu ɔlɛka bɛkya ɔkplu na bɛtɔ na bina lɛƒɔndia ala bute kemmo lɛni kani.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi ɔda na muubó-mii, mmomu líti ogya ɔni nkya badi lɛlɔ kemmo mɔɔkɔ́ku amii bɔdi kalɛ na bɔnu si bina bekyuli bɔyɔ lɛnɔ bɔdi bɔyɔ geen.

english_verse: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bɛgyi kalɛ na Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛƒɔndia lise. Na ina ka ɔdi Katɔ Ɔga Ubi muedi ni, ɔ́nyonu lɛla biala na bina bɔdia ɔsu kalɛ na ɔkɛ nwuna lɛwaba kemmo na amii bínwini Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ala bakɛne.

english_verse: A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku kebunku kani na biite bawabane mɛni litemi lɛlɔ ni, mina kasusu kani muute-mii ndi ka ɔdia ka bɛwɔlɔ lɛla lɛni kalɔ na bíse ɔ́si lɛkwa lɛni návi kemmo. Amii ndi bekyuli bedeedi bani nábla ɔmɛni kasusu. Na bíse-ni kalɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na bíti bɔyɔ bísie lɛla lɛmɛni kalɔ ni, bisie anumi na bɛwɔlɔ-ni aani kalɛ na amii alati bíti-nwu lɛlɔ kasusu. Na biti lɛla lɛni na bibo bɛbla ɔmɛni.

english_verse: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
translation_verse: Si ɔdi bina bɔyɔ ka bíte bekyuli ala ni, ɔdubɔƒɔ Katɔti anu ɔkɛnku lɛla lɛni nse-mii kenye. Na ɔɔɔdi lɛla lɛni na biiibo.

english_verse: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi etila na liti mɔɔsia-mii lɛlɔ na lɛtimi adi na bakladi lɛlɔ, mmomu kalɛ na bɛbla likeke.

english_verse: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
translation_verse: Na bana bɔyaki bɔmɛni kemmo ni, bina ala pii ani bibo adubo-ma bubunku. Na uwi bamba bana ala pii lɛnɔ adububunku bina bɔyaki. Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na bɛbla likeke.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: Lɛni na bénweni bákya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo banii, “Ukyuli ɔni násala adila pii ni, uuubo-nya utuloku kalɛ na ɔmanku-nwu. Na ukyuli ɔni lɛnɔ na adi blii suɛ kani na ɔ́sala ni, ulayaki.”

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: Na bɔɔgyá Katɔti enu, ɔsika ɔ́ya na anumi eegyie Tito lɛnɔ ka ubunku-mii aani abu kalɛ.

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔyɔ́ ka ubunku-mii na ɔɔɔdi ɔni na búvele-nwu na únu kalɔ kani ɔsu, mmomu ka ɔdi anwu ɔlati bɔyɔ lɛnɔ ka ubunku-mii ɔsu. Anwuɔsu na ɔ́bla kasusu ka ubo-mii kudɔ.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Na lɛnɔ ni, búti ɔnwa ɔni na baabu geen na baƒɔtaadine akpa ƒui akɔ ku kalɛ na ɔɔsu litemi buni lɛmmɔ ɔsu buumene-mii ku Tito.

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama lɛnɔ ni, ɔdi ukyuli ɔni na baƒɔtaadine akpa ammɔ báƒuna ka ɔsiaku-bu na bula bawabane ala bute kabla kani na bɔɔbla kemmo. Kabla kamɛni kadubɔya na bekyuli badubumwi Blɔti Yesu Kristo, na kaatina lɛnɔ ka ɔdi bula bɔyɔ ka bute baƒɔtaadine bakpana kebunku.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
translation_verse: Na etela ani na bekyuli béte ku kaƒɔ ƒaa mɛni ni, bɔda-nya kaduɛ kalɛ na ukyuli ɔdi ulakyaku-bu unyeƒi ɔdi ɔnii bɔda egulabi ammɔ bɔɔdi.

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔɔɔdi Katɔti anumi lɛti na bɔɔyɔ́ geen ka bɔbla lɛla lɛni ndia, mmomu ku bekyuli ƒui anumi.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, bɔ́sɔ búti ɔnwa ɔbambadi búbunku banwa inyɔ bammɔ buumene-mii. Bɔ́kɔku-nwu bɔ́nu na lilu pii lɛlɔ na bɔ́nu bɔ́ti ka ubo kogyoklo geen. Na ka úti kayi ɔ́sia-mii lɛlɔ lɛni ɔsu ni, ɔsia anu kpakplaa ka ubete-mii kebunku.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Na nkyuli ɛtɛ bamɛni kemmo ni, Tito ndi mina ɔvinkpana ɔni mɔɔblaku-mi kabla teebunku-mii. Na banwa bakladi bani nsiaku-nwu ama ni, baƒɔtaadine akpa ammɔ kenye na benye. Na bana ɔbladu uuti bumwi teete Kristo.

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: Bɛyɔ-ma kalɛ na baƒɔtaadine bakladi ƒui banu bati ka sɔsɔ ni, ɔdi ulu lɛlɔ ka bɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na amii ɔsu.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
translation_verse: Geen ni, útalɛka linweni-mii lɛla lɛdi lɛsiku kalɛ na biibunku Katɔti bekyuli bani ndi bawabane na Yudea kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: Ngyi ka bɛɛyɔ́ geen ka bite bekyuli bamɛni kebunku. Na mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ uwi biala taatina baƒɔtaadine bani nkya Makedonia. Lɛ́su nnii banwa bani nkya Akaia kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, báklibi lɛlɔ bése ɔ́si lɛkwɛni ka bete kebunku kamɛni. Na bina kebunku ogya bɔkya nágyila bana akɔ pii.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, líti banwa bamɛni muumene-mii kalɛ na bula lɛmɛnɛ lɛni na bɔɔkun na bina lɛlɔ ni, lɛ́bla sɔsɔ. Na aani kalɛ na mɔɔsu uwi biala ni, ngyi ka bɛ́klibi bina ala ani na biti bite kebunku kammɔ bíse.

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: Na si nka banwa bani nkya Makedonia badi básiaku-mi bébo-mii kudɔ na bábanu ka bítaklibi lɛla lɛdi bítese aani kalɛ na lɛ́su ni, abu ku amii lɛnɔ geen anumi adubuwi-bu kalɔ. Na buláwia kɔƒa kɔdi na kalɛ na búti anu bɔ́sia-mii lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na lɛ́bla kasusu ka banwa bamɛni bagyu batɔ-mi bina kudɔ. Na bebunku-mii na bɛsala etela ani na bɛ́su ka bɛdubute mmɔ bise. Na bulayɔ ka ɔbla aani si ukyuli ɔdi nénye-mii lɛlɔ asa na bɛ́bla lɛni. Mmomu ɔdi kaƒɔ ƒaa ala bute. Katɔti Ɔɔyɔ́ Ukyuli Ɔni Muute Ala Ku Kaƒɔ Ƒaa

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Bɛya na ɔbla-mii nwaa ka ni, si ágya edula blii suɛ ni, adubɔƒɛ-nya blii suɛ lɛni kani. Na si ágya-nya pii ni, adubɔƒɛ-nya pii lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Bina akɔ ɔdi biala ute lɛla lɛni na anwu ɔlati ɔ́lɛ ugyii ka wete ku lɛlɔyɔ. Na utabla aani si ukyuli ɔdi nnye-nwu lɛlɔ asa na uute. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́ ukyuli ɔni muute ala ku kaƒɔ ƒaa.

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔkana na ute-ɔ lɛla biala kalɛ na akɛ ala ani ƒui na aawia uwi biala. Na akana ebunku na kabla kabuni biala kemmo kaduɛ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
translation_verse: Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su na ukyuli ɔni nse siin lɛlɔ ɔnini, “Uute bekyuli bani mɔɔyaki ala ku kaƒɔ ƒaa, na uláda lɛbuni bɔbla taaya kudii.”

english_verse: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔni muute umonsene edula ani na ɔɔgya na uute-nwu adila na ɔɔdi ni, anwu ndubute-nwu edula agyadi ani ƒui na ɔɔwia. Lɛni kani na ɔdubɔya ukyuli siin ala ani na uute ɔya na nwuna kabla buni kanwu ebi pii na bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔdubɔya na bɛkɛ ala pii na lilu pii lɛlɔ kalɛ na amii lɛnɔ biteete bekyuli bamba ala pii. Na bekyuli bammɔ badubɔgya Katɔti enu na bina etela ani na búti búsienku-ma ɔsu.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kabla kani na bɔɔbla teete baƒɔtaadine bani mɔɔyaki ala mɛni ni, uubunku-ma geen. Nsu ɔɔɔdi ɔmmɔ lɛti, mmomu ɔdubɔya na bekyuli pii bagya Katɔti enu uwi biala.

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: Bina kaƒɔ ƒaa kebunku kani biite bekyuli mɛni mɔɔtina ka bɛɛdi Kristo litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ geen. Na kalɛ na biidie bina bɔƒɔtaadi keyi ku kalɛ na biile ala ani nse-mii teete lɛlɔ ku bekyuli bamba lɛnɔ ɔsu ni, bekyuli pii badubuti ɔbu bete Katɔti.

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: Na badubɔkpali katɔ na bina lili ku bɔyɔ geen na Katɔti lɛƒɔndia libendi lɛni na údie ɔ́tina ɔkɛ bina lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Bɛya na bɔgya Katɔti enu na litela libendi geen lɛni na úti úte-bu ɔsu. Bulakana litela lɛmɛni kalɔ budie.

english_verse: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ami Paulo ɔlati líti Kristo kayi buɛɛ ku lɛlɔ kalɔ buboku muuvele-mii geen nnii bise atu na binu. Muunú ka bekyuli badi baasu banii mina lɛku lɛni muunweni libo ogya si liiibo-mii kudɔ, nsu lɛ́ba na mina butemi kemmo si nkya-mii kudɔ.

english_verse: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
translation_verse: Muuvele-mii nnii bitaya na libo-mii kudɔ mbatɛmiku-mii ku ogya. Ɔsika nsia ulu ndubo ku ogya mbadɔnku bina akɔ badi bani mɔɔnu-bu anumi banii kayawi kamɛni kasusu na bɔda bɔɔbla ala.

english_verse: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka kayawi kamɛni kemmo na bɔkya bɔdi, nsu ɔɔɔdi kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ kekpo udu na buukpó.

english_verse: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
translation_verse: Ɔsika ekpola ani na bɔda buukpó ni, aaadi kayawi kamɛni ekpola. Mmomu Katɔti ɔyikun na ɔdi na buti bɔɔdi ukisine ɔmmɔ kama kekpokɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
translation_verse: Bɔɔdi unyeƒi ku lɛla biala mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ na liitile bekyuli kuƒi ka bati Katɔti lɛlɔ. Na buƒie kasusu biala na kasia Kristo ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Na si uwi ɔni na bídie bɛ́tina ka bɛdi Kristo etemila lɛlɔ ƒui ni, ɔmmɔ kama ukyuli biala ɔni mata menye litemi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ni, bɔdubɔni-nwu kɔtu.

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Ɔlɔna lɛlɔ kasusu kani na biiti. Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́ƒɔ lɛlɔ ɔ́di ka ɔdi Kristo ɔdi ni, ɔlɛka ɔnu-bu ɔti aani nwuna lɛlɔ kalɛ ka abu lɛnɔ bɔdi Katɔti ɔdi.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: Na si lɛ́kun lɛmɛnɛ líbu na kenyekɔ kani na bubo lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, Katɔti ulálɛ-mi kama. Ɔsika anwu néte-bu kenyekɔ kamɛni kalɛ na bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɔkɔ katɔ bubu. Na ɔɔɔdi kani maya na bina bɔƒɔtaadi bubo kalɔ.

english_verse: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
translation_verse: Naaawia ka bɛkali bɛnii liƒu na mɔɔkya-mii na mina lɛku lɛni na muunweni-mii kemmo.

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: Bina akɔ ɔdi ɔdubɔsu ɔnii muunweni lɛku kpakplaa lɛni etemila mbo unu. Nsu si nkya-mii kudɔ ni, lɛ́ba na mina etemila eeyile atu.

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyá na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔti ka ni, lɛla lɛni na bɔɔsu na lɛku kemmo uwi ɔni na buuubo-mii kudɔ ni, ani kani na bɔɔbla si bɔkya-mii kudɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: We won't dare compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. But they are foolish to compare themselves with themselves.
translation_verse: Bulábabla taakɔku bula kenyekɔ taanu aani bekyuli bani mɔɔnu lɛlɔ katɔ katɔ. Bɔɔɔdi bana udu. Ama alati kasusu kenye na bada baanu lɛlɔ na bana akɔ ka badia. Nsu baaagyi lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Abu bubo ekpo ani na bɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ taatáwɔ. Na bula lɛmɛnɛ bɔkun bɔɔwɔ́ ekpo ani na Katɔti ɔ́kɔku úte-bu. Na kesii kani na Katɔti ɔ́kɔku úte-bu kadanku amii lɛnɔ.

english_verse: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
translation_verse: Na ka bɛkya ekpo ani na Katɔti úti úte-bu kemmo ɔsu ni, bútavia bula kenyekɔ. Ɔsika abu náka-mii kudɔ bubo ku Kristo litemi buni lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bulákun lɛmɛnɛ na ukyuli bamba kabla lɛlɔ ɔni na ɔɔɔdi bula ekpo ani na Katɔti úte-bu. Mmomu bula anu asia ka bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɔkɔ katɔ bubu kalɛ na bɔkana na bɔbla ala enengudi na bina akɔ na kesii kani na Katɔti úte-bu kabla.

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama bɔkana na bɔsu litemi buni lɛmmɔ na ekpo bamba ani nkya bina kama lɛnɔ kemmo. Na bulakun lɛmɛnɛ na kabla kani na ukyuli bamba ɔdi ɔ́bla na nwuna kakɛ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
translation_verse: Lɛni na bénweni bákya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo banii, “Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ ni, ɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́bla lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni na Katɔti uumwi ni, anwu ndi lɛla lɛdi, na ɔɔɔdi ukyuli ɔni muumwi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Please put up with a little of my foolishness.
translation_verse: Mɔɔwia ka bigyingya enu na bɛƒɔ-mi si ina bɛnu bɛnii lɛ́dɔlɔ. Buvele na nda-mii!

english_verse: I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ.
translation_verse: Muukpó-mii lɛlɔ kogyulo teete Katɔti. Lívele-mii líte Kristo aani kalɛ na beevele adagyaa ɔni nse sɛɛn teete kɔgya.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: Nsu mɔɔyia ka ukisine ɔmmɔ ɔdububile-mii kasusu na bɛsɔ bilése sɛɛn na bɛsiaku Kristo lɛti kama. Lɛni na kɔlakpi kɔmmɔ kúti nwuna kɔkwɛ kukpidi kúbile Eva kasusu na ɔ́ya na ɔ́bla likpidi.

english_verse: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
translation_verse: Lɛni na bɛɛbabla teegyingya enu taaƒɔ ukyuli biala ɔni muubo taabasu-mii litemi lɛbambadi lɛni mɔɔvumana Yesu ɔni lɛlɔ lɛsa na bɔ́kɔ búte-mii udu. Na bɛɛƒɔ́ kɔyu ku litemi lɛni naaadi Katɔti Kɔyu ku bula litemi buni lɛmmɔ taadi.

english_verse: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
translation_verse: Nsu lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di ka lɛ́ƒɔ kuye ntulo bekyuli bani na biigyingya enu taaƒɔ aani si badi batalane babuni sɔsɔ.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Ina kenye kátada-mi muedi ni, ɔɔɔdi Katɔti litemi na lɛɛɛgyi. Bɔ́ya na ɔmɛni ɔ́bla-mii nwaa na ulu biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na lɛ́ka litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa bɔkɔ bute-mii ni, ńtakya-mii kayu kadi. Mmomu líboku lɛlɔ kalɔ kalɛ na lɛtalaku-mii katɔ. Na ɔni na lɛ́bla ɔmɛni ɔsu na lɛ́bla likpidi lɛdi?

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na lɛ́kya-mii kudɔ ni, mina lɛlɔ bɔnu bútasia-mii lɛlɔ si mɔɔyaki lɛla lɛdi. Banwa bani nási Makedonia néteete-mi kebunku na lɛla biala kemmo. Na ńteti etila abambadi ńtasia-mii lɛlɔ na lɛɛɛdubo adi lɛnɔ buti bɔsia-mii lɛlɔ kudii.

english_verse: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
translation_verse: Nnye Kristo litemi geen lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ mɔɔsu nwaa ka naaayila kuƒi kɔni ɔsu na mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na Akaia kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ kudii!

english_verse: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
translation_verse: Na bi ɔsu na nnii naaaƒɔ lɛla lɛdi na bina kudɔ? Ɔɔɔdi ɔni na naaayɔ-mii ɔsu. Katɔti ɔlati ɔgyi ka mɔɔyɔ́-mii.

english_verse: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
translation_verse: Ndubusie anumi na naaaƒɔ bina kebunku. Ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na bani mɔɔlɔ lɛlɔ banii batalane ni, balákɛ kuƒi na bakun lɛmɛnɛ na basu banii ama lɛnɔ baabla kabla aani bula kalɛ.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bammɔ baaadi batalane geen. Ɔkɔ batalane na badi, na baanyi ɔkɔ na bana kabla kemmo. Bávumana bana lɛlɔ kalɛ na bekyuli banu-ma aani si Kristo batalane na badi sɔsɔ.

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔɔɔdi lɛla lɛwɔdi, ɔsika Satan ɔɔvumana lɛlɔ na ɔɔbla aani Katɔti ɔtu ɔni ndanku Katɔti bukeye.

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔmɛni ɔɔɔdi lɛla lɛwɔdi uuute nwuna kama basiakune ka bavumana lɛlɔ babla aani Katɔti kabla bablane bani nse siin. Nsu kawɔlɔkɔ ni, Katɔti ɔdubo-ma kɔtu bɔni kalɛ na ɔ́manku. Paulo Ɔ́kun Lɛmɛnɛ Na Ala Ani Muudie Taatina Kalɛ Na Ɔ́sɔ Lɛlɔ

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: Nsɔ mɔɔsia kama lɛsu-mii nnii ɔdi utakali ɔnii lɛ́dɔlɔ. Nsu ina ɔdi wakali lɛni ni, amii biti-nwu lɛni kani kalɛ na ɔdia-mi na lɛkun lɛmɛnɛ blii.

english_verse: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni mɔɔsu mɛni ni, lɛɛɛdi lɛla lɛni na Blɔti úbo-mi ɔda ɔnii nsu. Ɔsika lɛmɛnɛ bɔkun litemi lɛmɛni kemmo ni, ɔdubɔbla-mii aani ɔdɔlɔdi kalɛ.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Nsu ka bekyuli pii baakun lɛmɛnɛ na kayawi ala lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, bɛya na ami lɛnɔ lɛkun lɛmɛnɛ lɛdi blii.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Ka amii alati bɛ́da anu geen ɔsu na bɛɛtunaku badɔlɔdi bamɛni.

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: Na bɛɛtunaku-ma si ɔdi úti-mii ɔ́bla nwuna kabla ɔblane iye ɔ́kɛ-mii lɛlɔ kɔsia kɔdi iye ɔ́kywɛ-mii kakpagyuɛ kadi iye baanu-mii kalɔ kalɔ iye ɔ́ƒiɛmi-mii ɔtugya muedi.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: Nsu abu ni, bɔɔyia ka bɔbla ala ammɔ udu. Munuu bɛɛbu bɛnii kɔƒa muukpó-bu? Nsu si ɔdi ɔkana kayi buse na ɔkun lɛmɛnɛ ni, ami lɛnɔ mbo kuƒi kɔmmɔ udu. Ala amɛni ƒui ese aani kɔnamutɛ, nsu ɔlɛka lɛsu.

english_verse: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
translation_verse: Si Hebriƒuɔ na badi ni, ami lɛnɔ anwu ndi. Na si Israelƒuɔ badi ni, ami lɛnɔ anwu ndi. Na si Abraham bawɔ lɛnɔ na badi ni, ami lɛnɔ anwu ndi.

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Kristo kabla bablane na badi? Ndi Kristo kabla ɔblane ntulo-ma. Báya na mɔɔtɛmi aani ukyuli ɔni muukpi libuo, nsu ɔdi litemi geen ka lɛ́bla Kristo kabla lítulo-ma. Bekyuli bani muukisi Kristo ni, bákya-mi aban ɔtɔ kɔlɛ kɔlɛ. Na bébo-mi lɛnɔ kɔlɛ kɔlɛ. Na líduo kukpi ku ngba ntɛ uwi pii.

english_verse: Five times my own people gave me
translation_verse: Kɔlɔ sɔɔn na Yudaƒuɔ bámii kɔbuli bébo-mi bɔka avlaatɛ-yaalenwi.

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: Na kɔtɛ na Romaƒuɔ bébo-mi kugyiimi. Na kunwi na bébo-mi atabi. Na kɔtɛ na ɔkɔlɔ bonwu ɔ́bwɛku-mi na lɛ́nu líduo ɛpu kemmo. Na ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, kunwi na ɛpu ntu bútiku-mi usien ku ɔƒɛ ƒui.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Na mina ulu busie pii kemmo ni, líduo ɔgbankpi lidu lidu kemmo. Ketu keyi káda-mi kɔlɛ kɔlɛ, na líduo beyune enu kemmo. Líduo ɔgbankpi kemmo na mina kadi bekyuli Yudaƒuɔ enu kemmo ku bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ lɛnɔ enu kemmo. Líduo ɔgbankpi na lɛma linengudi kemmo ku ketele kemmo. Líduo ɔgbankpi na ntu anumi ku ɔkɔ baƒɔtaadine enu kemmo.

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: Lɛ́bla kabla kpakplaa lítu lɛlɔ kaduɛ. Ńtatɛ ńtalɛɛ usien pii. Na kɔka ku utukwɛ ɔ́da-mi, na adila ábɔ-mi uwi pii. Na kɔyɔ kɔda-mi, na ńtakɛ lɛla lɛni na libi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
translation_verse: Na ala pii amɛni kama ni, mina kasusu kalakɛ bɔnwuna ɔ́si baƒɔtaadine akpa ani nkya ekpo ekpo ɔsu.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: Si ɔdi ɔbla kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ na kalɛ na ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di ɔsu ni, ɔɔyá na enu aaƒɛ-mi. Na si likpidi kemmo na ɔdi úduo ni, ɔɔyá na ɔƒɛ ɔɔdá-mi.

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Si ɔdi ka lɛkun lɛmɛnɛ ni, nka ndubɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na ala ani muudie taatina kalɛ na lɛ́sɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔni ndi Blɔti Yesu Kristo Ɔti, na anwu na buumwi uwi ƒui ni, anwu ngyi geen ka ala ani mɔɔsu mɛni ni, sɔsɔ na adi.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na lɛ́kya Damasko ni, aban unengu ɔni nákya Ɔga Areta kalɔ ɔ́wia ka uƒie-mi. Anwuɔsu úti bagyumanane útényene kowodu kɔni na bátu báka bámana ɔma ɔmmɔ kɔyakun.

english_verse: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, kowodu kɔmmɔ ƒansili na báyula-mi básiaku na kagyigyɛ kemmo, na lɛ́lɛ-nwu enu kemmo.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ka lɛkun lɛmɛnɛ ina ka kɔsia kɔdi kuuubo-nwu kemmo. Na amii ɔsu na ndubusie anumi ntaasu ala ani na Blɔti údie ɔ́tina-mi.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: Kɔtɛdi mɛni ka lɛ́klibi lɛlɔ na ndubo-mii kudɔ, nsu naaawia kebunku kadi. Amii alati na mɔɔwia, na ɔɔɔdi bina egulabi. Ɔsika ɔɔɔdi bebi mɔɔklibi ala teese ka banu bawɔne lɛlɔ. Mmomu bawɔne mɔɔklibi ala teese na banu bebi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni kani ngyi ndi ka Katɔti útiku ukyuli ɔmɛni úsienku Paradiso na katɔ mmɔ. Nsu mɔɔsu-mii nnii lɛɛɛgyi si ɔlɔna kemmo na útiku-nwu iye kɔyu kemmo. Katɔti lɛti pɛ kani ngyi.

english_verse: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
translation_verse: Na únu ala ani na ukyuli ulakana na wasɔku wasu na buláti-nya kalɔ budie.

english_verse: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
translation_verse: Mɔɔtɛmi aani si ukyuli bamba na nda. Na mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na nwuna lɛlɔ, ɔsika naaakun lɛmɛnɛ na ami ɔlati lɛlɔ, amu ntu lɛla lɛni muudie mina bɔsɔ taatina-mi lɛlɔ lɛti pɛ.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: Na ina nnii mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ ni, lɛɛɛdubo ɔdɔlɔdi bɔbla. Ɔsika litemi geen lɛmmɔ na ndubo bɔsu. Nsu líni lɛmɛnɛ bɔkun, ɔsika naaayɔ ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔnu-mi utulo kalɛ nse na ala ani mɔɔbla ku ani mɔɔsu kemmo.

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: Nsu kalɛ na ulabla aani lɛlɔ na mɔɔtalaku katɔ na ala ebendi ani na lɛ́nu lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, Katɔti úte kuƒi na ɔ́ya na ɔlɛ ɔdi úbo-mi lɛlɔ. Satan ɔ́tala nwuna ɔtu ɔdi na ɔ́bla ɔmɛni ɔni na ɔɔyá na muunú ɔlɔna ɔlɛ ɔdi kalɛ na naaatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́kpali katɔ lívele Blɔti kɔtɛ sɔɔn na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ nnii ɔbwi-mi ɔlɛ ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Mmomu ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Mina lɛƒɔndia lɛdubɔda-a, ɔsika mina ɔyikun ɔɔbla ala ebendi na bekyuli bani násɔ lɛlɔ teetulo.” Ɔmɛni ɔsu lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-mi litulo si mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na mina bɔsɔ lɛlɔ kalɛ na Kristo ɔyikun ɔƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: Si Kristo ɔsu na ɔlɛ úbo-mi lɛlɔ, na bekyuli beedumi-mi, na muubó abi, na bekyuli beekpóku-mi, na ɔgbankpi ɔɔsiáku-mi ni, kaƒɔ kadubɔyɔ-mi. Ɔsika uwi ɔni na lɛ́sɔ ni, mɔɔkɛ́ Kristo ɔyikun. Kayi Kékpoku Paulo Na Korintoƒuɔ Baƒɔtaadine Lɛlɔ

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu ala aani ɔdɔlɔdi kalɛ, nsu amii náya na úbo úte lɛni. Ɔsika amii na ɔlɛka nka bimwi-mi. Ina lɛɛɛdi lɛla lɛdi muedi ni, ńtasɔ na ulu biala lɛlɔ ku bekyuli bani mɔɔnu lɛlɔ aani batalane babuni.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: Lɛ́bla ala pii ku kayi buɛɛ na bina akɔ ani mɔɔtina ka ndi ɔtalane geen. Katɔti ɔ́sia-mi lɛlɔ na ɔ́bla akɔla budie taatina lidu lidu ku ala ebendi bamba lɛnɔ.

english_verse: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
translation_verse: Ńtanu lɛla lɛni na baƒɔtaadine akpa adi bákɛ bétulo-mii ntu ɔni na ńtaƒɔ-mii egulabi adi na liti libunku lɛlɔ kani ɔsu. Na muuvele-mii nnii biti bɛkyiɛ-mi ka ńtabla lɛni!

english_verse: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ndububile mina ala ani nse-mi na liti mina lɛlɔ muedi lite ku ebiti na bina lili. Anwuɔsu ka mɔɔyɔ́-mii pii lɛni ni, bi ɔsu na ɔlɛka bina bɔyɔ bɔƒana na mina lɛlɔ?

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: Bɛdubo bɔtunaku-mi ka ni, ńtenwini etila ńtasia-mii lɛlɔ. Nsu badi badubo bɔsu banii lɛkwɛ likpidi na lɛ́bla na lɛ́kɛ-mii lɛlɔ kɔsia na ulu ɔdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani na lɛ́tala lɛ́kya-mii lɛlɔ ni, lɛ́kɛ-mii lɛlɔ kɔsia kɔdi ɔkɛnku-ma lɛlɔ?

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: Lívele Tito na lɛ́tala-nwu lɛ́kya-mii, na lɛ́tala bula ɔnwa bamba lɛnɔ nnii bebo-mii kudɔ. Bɔsu bɛda bɛnii Tito ɔ́kɛ-mii lɛlɔ kɔsia kɔbambadi kɔdi na ulu bamba lɛlɔ? Ɔɔɔdi kasusu kenwi na ami ku-nwu bɔda bɔɔbla kabla na bɔda lɛlɔ na ulu unwi lɛlɔ lɛnɔ yoo?

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Bɛɛbu uwi ɔmɛni ƒui bɛnii lɛlɔ kenye na buudie na bina anumi? Oowo! Katɔti ɔ́bla-bu unwi ku Kristo na bɔɔsu lɛla biala na nwuna anumi. Banwa, na lɛla biala na bɔɔsu-mii ni, kalɛ kani na bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɔkɔ katɔ bubu ɔsu.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyia ka si líbo mmɔ ni, ndububo mbanu ka bɛ́vumana kalɛ na mɔɔwia-mii lɛnu. Na lɛni kani na amii lɛnɔ bɛdubɔnu ka lɛ́vumana kalɛ na amii lɛnɔ bɛɛwia ka bɛnu. Mɔɔyia ka ndububo mbanu ka bɛɛdɔ, na bɛɛbla lɛnungyie likpidi, na biiti kɔnyi taakya lɛlɔ, na bɛɛwia kalɛ na ɔdia ute amii lɛti pɛ, na biidumi lɛlɔ, na bɛɛlɔ lɛlɔ anyikpi, na bɛɛtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ, na biiƒú na lɛla biala kemmo.

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyia ka uwi ɔni na nsɔ mebo mmɔ ni, mina Katɔti ɔdubɔya na enu aƒɛ-mi na bina anumi. Na ndubuwulo na bekyuli pii lili, ɔsika bétenwini kayi na bana alaekpidi ani na bábla bábavi ɔsu. Báabla ala ani muusé lɛlɔ, na bádi kɔsɔnɔ, na baaadaku-ni na ulu biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ndi kɔtɛdi kɔni na ndubo-mii kudɔ mbanu-mii. Na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ni, bénweni banini, “Ɔdi ka nkyuli inyɔ iye ɛtɛ benye-nwu litemi kama.”

english_verse: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
translation_verse: Muubó bekyuli bani nábla ekpidi bábavi ɔda ku babambadi ƒui lɛnɔ uwi ɔni na lɛɛɛkya-mii kudɔ mɛni. Lɛ́ɛsu-mii ɔmɛni ḿbavi na kunyɔdi kɔni na líbo-mii kudɔ. Na nsɔ mɔɔsu-mii ɔni na liiibo-mii kudɔ mɛni nnii si lɛ́sɔ líbo-mii kudɔ ni, ndubɔni bani ƒui mɔɔbla ekpidi kɔtu.

english_verse: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
translation_verse: Ka bɛɛwia bɛnu bɛti geen ka Kristo nkɛ-mi lɛlɔ ɔɔtɛmiku-mii ɔsu ni, bɛdubɔnu lɛla lɛni na bɛɛwia! Ulése buɛɛ ulete-mii si Katɔti ɔɔní-mii kɔtu. Na bɛdubɔti ka ubo ɔyikun na bina akɔ sɔsɔ.

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: Ina ka bákana Yesu bámana ugyii lɛlɔ na úkpi uwi ɔni kemmo na use kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ni, Katɔti ɔyikun kemmo na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́ta uli ngba. Na ka abu-ku Yesu bɔ́bla unwi ɔsu ni, buse kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ aani kalɛ na anwu lɛnɔ use kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ. Nsu bubo Katɔti ɔyikun ka bɔbla lɛla lɛni na ɔlɛka bɔbla na bina akɔ, ɔsika abu ku-nwu bulie na nwuna ɔyikun kemmo.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Amii alati biduo bina lɛlɔ kemmo na bɛkɔku lɛlɔ bɛnu. Na bɛti si bɛkya bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ kemmo. Bɛɛɛgyi ka Yesu Kristo ɔkya-mii lɛlɔ kemmo? Bɛgyi nii! Ntu bɔnu na bɛ́nu bɛ́ti ka bina lɛlɔ bɔkɔku bútedu.

english_verse: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di ka bɛdubɔnu bɔti ka abu búdu.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Buuvele Katɔti bɔnii ɔda-mii na bilabla likpidi lɛdi. Na bulévele ɔmɛni kalɛ na buti bɔtina ka abu búdu na bula batalane kabla bɔbla kemmo ɔsu. Mmomu bɔɔwia ɔmɛni kalɛ na amii bitaabla lɛla lɛni ndia si ina ɔ́lɛ aani abu bútabla bula kabla na kedu.

english_verse: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bulakana bɔta bunye litemi geen lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na ulu biala lɛlɔ, mmomu na bɔda-ni na lisie lɛtɔtɔ libu.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-bu si bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɔɔyu ɔkplu, na use aani si bula ɔyikun ɔɔƒana na bina lɛlɔ. Na lɛla lɛni na buuvele ndi ka bɛlɛ lili bɛwɔlɔ.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: Muunweni-mii ɔku ɔmɛni uwi ɔni na liiibo-mii kudɔ mɛni, kalɛ na si líbo ḿbeduo-mii kudɔ ni, na naaani-mii kɔtu kpakplaa na kenyekɔ kani na Blɔti úte-mi kenye. Úte-mi kenyekɔ kamɛni kalɛ na bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɔkɔ katɔ bubu, na ɔɔɔdi kani maya na bɔyu kalɔ.

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: Banwa, na kawɔlɔkɔ mɛni ni, binye momoomo na bɛlɛ lili bɛwɔlɔ. Na binu ala ani ƒui na lívele-mii na ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo. Bɛbla unwi na bilieku lɛlɔ ku keyi buɛɛ, na Katɔti ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli na ɔɔyá na keyi kaayɔ́ku-ma ni, ɔdubɔsiaku-mii.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Bɛkya lɛlɔ kɔgbu aani banwa kalɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Na buuvele bɔnii Katɔti ku Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛƒɔndia ku keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-mii.

english_verse: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
translation_verse: Kristo ɔmmɔ néti lɛlɔ ɔ́kpa na bula lili kalɛ na udie-bu ɔlɛku bula ekpidi kemmo na ɔƒɔ-bu ɔlɛku uwi ukpidi ɔni kemmo na ekpidi bɔbla bɔ́ƒɔ kayawi kemmo mɛni. Na ɔ́ƒɔ-bu lɛni ɔkɛnku Katɔti ɔni ndi bula Ɔti lɛƒɔyɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛya na bumwi Katɔti ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui! Ɔsia lɛni. Katɔti Litemi Buni Linwi Pɛ Kani Nkya

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: Bina lɛlɔ lɛ́bla-mi kalɛ kadi geen, ɔsika ńtaƒɔ ńtadi nnii bɛdubɔlɛ Katɔti ɔni nálɔ-mii ɔkɛnku Kristo Yesu kaƒɔ buni kani na ɔ́bla-mii kama na bɛsiaku litemi bamba kama.

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka litemi buni bamba lɛdi liiibo. Nsu mɔɔsu ɔmɛni ɔsika bekyuli badi bakya beeƒú-mii kasusu, na baayɔ́ ka bavumana Kristo litemi buni lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-mii nnii si abu iye kayaa na ɔtu ɔdi ɔ́si úbo úbasu-mii litemi lɛbambadi lɛdi na lɛɛɛdi litemi buni lɛni na bɔ́su-mii mmɔ ni, Katɔti ɔyila-nwu udu ƒui.

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: Bɔ́ɔsu-mii búbavi na lɛni kani na nsɔ mɔɔsu-mii ɔƒɛni lɛnɔ ka ni, si ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔsu-mii litemi lɛdi na lɛɛɛdi litemi buni lɛni bínu na bɛ́ƒɔ-ni bɛ́di mmɔ ni, Katɔti ɔyila ukyuli ɔmmɔ udu ƒui kede kede.

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: Na kabla kani na mɔɔbla mɛni ni, bɛɛkali bɛnii bekyuli bumwi na mɔɔwia? Munuu Katɔti bumwi na mɔɔwia? Munuu mɔɔbla-ka kalɛ na kaƒɔ kayɔ bekyuli? Na si bekyuli lɛyɔla kabla na mɔɔbla ni, nka lɛɛɛdi Kristo kabla ɔblane. Katɔti Ɔ́ƒuna Paulo Úte Nwuna Kabla

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: Banwa, mɔɔyɔ́ ka lɛsu-mii ka ni, litemi lɛni mɔɔsu mɛni ni, lítasi ukyuli ɔdi kudɔ.

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi ukyuli ɔdi kudɔ lɛnɔ na lɛ́ƒɔ-ni lɛ́siku iye ɔdi nátina-mi lɛla lɛmmɔ lɛnɔ. Mmomu Yesu Kristo ɔlati nédie nwuna ablala etemila ammɔ ɔ́tina-mi.

english_verse: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bínu ngba bɔni na lílie lɛ́vi uwi ɔni nsiaku Yudaƒuɔ bɔkpa ulu kama kpakplaa ku kalɛ na líti lɛnungyie kemmo líkpoku Katɔti baƒɔtaadine akpa ammɔ, na lɛ́yɔ ka lɛyila-nya udu muedi.

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: Na anumi égyie-mi étulo mina ligyekpa na ntɔ-ma na Yudaƒuɔ bɔkpa ulu ɔmmɔ kemmo. Na mina bati kuuku ɔdi kama kani na mina kasusu kasia kpakplaa ka lɛbla.

english_verse: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
translation_verse: Nsu na Katɔti kɔnyana bɔnu ɔsu ni, ɔ́ƒuna-mi úte nwuna kabla asa na badubɔwɔ-mi. Ka uwi údu-nwu ni, údie Ubidi ɔmmɔ ɔ́tina-mi kalɛ na lɛkana na lɛkɔ-nwu lɛlɔ lɛsa na amii bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ akɔ. Na ńtatádiku ɔdi kasusu na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ,

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: iye lisie Yerusalem ntánu bani ndi batalane asa Katɔti úbaƒuna-mi. Mmomu lɛ́tɔlɔ lísie Arabia kɔnakunwi. Kama asa na línwini líbo Damasko.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Na akwa atɛ kama asa na lísie Yerusalem ńtánu Petro, na lílie-nwu kudɔ emeyi leevu-alɔ.

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama lɛ́sɔ ńtanu ɔtalane ɔdi lɛnɔ, amu ntu Yakobo ɔni ndi Blɔti ɔnwani kani.

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Na sɔsɔ ni, litemi geen na muunweni-mii mɛni, na Katɔti ɔlati ɔgyi ka naaanyi ɔkɔ.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama lɛnɔ ni, lísie Siria ku Kilikia.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, baƒɔtaadine akpa ani nkya Yudea kalɔ lɛlɔ na Kristo kemmo bátanu-mi anumi kudii tɔ.

english_verse: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni kani na bénu na mina lɛlɔ ndi ka, “Ukyuli ɔni na nka ɔ́kya úteekpoku-bu mmɔ ni, ɔƒɛni amu ɔkya ɔɔkɔ́ bɔƒɔtaadi bɔni na ɔ́yɔ ka nka ubile mmɔ lɛsa.”

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu beemwi Katɔti ɔkɛnku ami ɔsu.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: Na akwa leevu-ene kama ni, lɛ́sɔ línwini lísie Yerusalem ku Barnaba. Na líti Tito lɛ́da.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: Lísie mmɔ ɔsika Katɔti nédie ɔ́tina-mi. Na lídie ala kalɔ lɛ́tina-ma ɔkɛnku litemi buni lɛni lɛ́sa na lɛ́kɔ líte bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ. Nsu ami ku batɔnkune bani ntɔnku baƒɔtaadine akpa ammɔ lɛti nása. Ɔsika naaayɔ nnii ɔkɛnku batɔnkune bammɔ ɔsu na mina kabla kani mɔɔbla mɛni iye kani na lɛ́bla lɛ́vi kabla keeke.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Tito ɔni na líti nda ni, ina ka ɔdi Grikini ni, ukyuli ɔdi útenye-nwu lɛlɔ ka ukulo lego.

english_verse: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔkɔ banyine bani néti lɛlɔ bénwini banwa badi béyu béduo-bu akɔ, na bábɛ baatú-bu kalɛ na bati bɔnwuna bɔni na bubo na Kristo Yesu kemmo na baya na bɔsɔ bunwini kabla bablane bute Yudaƒuɔ ɔdi ala bɔbla.

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: Nsu abu lɛnɔ bútete-ma kuƒi kɔdi munu munu kalɛ na litemi geen lɛmmɔ lɛkana-mii akɔ bɔkya ɔsu.

english_verse: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani na bɛɛnu ka ama badi batɔnkune ni, ina ka ami naaanu-ma kavumana kadi ina bi na badi ɔsika Katɔti ulánu ukyuli anumi asa na ɔɔtɛku-nwu litemi ni, ama lɛnɔ béteti lɛla lɛdi bétebunku mina litemi lɛni na mɔɔsu ka mbasu-mii.

english_verse: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
translation_verse: Mmomu bánu báti ka Katɔti néti kabla kamɛni ɔ́kya-mi enu kemmo ka lɛkɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa lite bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ, aani kalɛ na úti ɔ́kya Petro enu kemmo na ɔkɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa ute Yudaƒuɔ.

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku Katɔti ɔyikun lɛlɔ na ndi ɔtalane nte bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ, aani kalɛ Petro lɛnɔ ɔdi ɔtalane ute Yudaƒuɔ.

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: Na ka Yakobo ku Petro ku Yohane bani nnye baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ kenye geen aani batɔnkune kalɛ bánu Katɔti kabla kani na úti ɔ́kya-mi enu kemmo mɛni báti ni, bégyingya enu na báƒɔ ami ku Barnaba. Na bénu kalɔ ka abu buteesie butásu litemi buni lɛmmɔ bute bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ, na ama lɛnɔ bataasu-ni teete Yudaƒuɔ.

english_verse: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni básu-bu ndi ka bunyimo na butaanu bawabane kɔnyana. Na ɔmɛni ndi lɛla lɛni na lɛ́sia anu na mɔɔbla geen. Paulo Ɔ́ta Únye Petro Lɛlɔ Na Antiokia

english_verse: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Petro úbo Antiokia ni, lɛ́ta línye-nwu lɛlɔ, ɔsika ɔ́bla lɛla lɛni naaadia.

english_verse: He used to eat with Gentile followers of the Lord, until James sent some Jewish followers. Peter was afraid of the Jews and soon stopped eating with Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ɔsika asa na bekyuli bani na Yakobo ɔ́tala bɔdububo bebeduo ni, Petro ku banwa bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ básala baadi. Nsu uwi ɔni kani na ɔ́nu batalane bamɛni ni, ɔ́da bɔdi ɔ́ya na ɔ́ta-ma kudɔ. Ɔsika ɔɔyia kasusu kani na bekyuli bani nékulo ago na badi Yudaƒuɔ mmɔ badubuti bɔsiku-nwu lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Amu ka lɛ́nu lɛ́ti ka baaakɛ litemi geen lɛmmɔ ulu lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, lɛ́su Petro na bekyuli bammɔ ƒui anumi nnii, “Yudani na adi, nsu eelie aani ukyuli ɔni naaadi Yudani, na ɔɔɔdi aani kalɛ na Yudaƒuɔ beelie kalɛ. Anwuɔsu dɛ na ɔbla asa na éti ƒula ɔbladu eenye bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ lɛlɔ ka basia Yudaƒuɔ ɔdi bɔbla kama? Yudaƒuɔ Ku Bani Naaadi Yudaƒuɔ Bákɛ Bɔƒɔ Ɔkɛnku Bɔƒɔtaadi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles.
translation_verse: “Abu bani na báwɔ-bu na bɔdi Yudaƒuɔ ni, buuuse aani bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ na bɔɔlɔ-ma ala ekpidi bablane.

english_verse: But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
translation_verse: Nsu bɔgyi ka Katɔti ɔɔsɔku anwu ku ukyuli ntɛ taaklibi ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi bɔni na ukyuli ubo na Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ kani ɔsu. Na ɔɔɔdi ɔda bubo bɔkukudi bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi ɔsu. Abu lɛnɔ bɔ́ƒɔ Kristo Yesu bɔ́di ɔsu na Katɔti ɔ́klibi abu ku-nwu ntɛ ɔkɛnku bula bɔƒɔtaadi na Kristo kemmo ɔsu. Na ɔɔɔdi ɔni na bɔɔdi ɔda bubo bɔkukudi bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu. Ɔsika Katɔti útaklibi anwu ku ukyuli ɔdi ntɛ na ɔda bubo bɔkukudi bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi ɔsu.

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: “Bɔɔwia ka Katɔti ɔklibi abu ku-nwu ntɛ ɔkɛnku Kristo lɛlɔ. Nsu si ɔni na bɔɔbla lɛni badi baanu-bu aani ala ekpidi bablane ka buládi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, ɔɔtina ka Kristo mɔɔkya likpidi bɔbla ogya? Oowo, kudii!

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: Si nka ami ɔlati lɛ́sɔku lɛla lɛni na lɛ́bwɛ mmɔ udu mɔɔtú ni, nka ɔdubɔtina ka lɛ́ta línye ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ aani ala ekpidi ɔblane sɔsɔ.

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: Mmomu nse aani ukyuli ɔni nélie ngba ɔkɛnku ɔda bubo bɔkukudi bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na úkpi ɔsu ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛnɔ búkpi kalɛ na lilie ngba lite Katɔti.

english_verse: I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me.
translation_verse: Ami ku Kristo na bákana bámana ugyii lɛlɔ. Ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdi ami nli ngba, mmomu Kristo nli ngba na mina kemmo. Na ngba bɔni na nli ɔƒɛni ni, nli-mu ɔkɛnku ɔyikun ɔni na lɛ́kɛ ka lɛ́ƒɔ Katɔti Ubidi ɔmmɔ lɛ́di ɔsu. Anwu néti nwuna ngba ɔ́kpa na mina lili, ɔsika ɔɔyɔ́-mi.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: Lɛɛɛdubo Katɔti kɔnyana kɔni na ɔɔnu bekyuli kama bɔlɛ kudii. Ɔsika si ɔda bubo bɔkukudi bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔɔsɔku anwu ku ukyuli ntɛ taaklibi ni, na Kristo úkpi keeke.”

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: Amii Galatiƒuɔ alati bilákali ɔmɛni bilanu! Ɔma néƒie-mii kasusu úbo likpo lɛni? Ɔsika bina anumi na lɛ́su-mii Kristo kukpi na ugyii lɛlɔ litemi.

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: Bɛya na liye-mii ɔmɛni linu. Katɔti Kɔyu kɔni na úte-mii mmɔ ni, ɔkɛnku ɔda bubo bɔni lɛlɔ na bɛɛdi ɔsu munuu ɔkɛnku litemi lɛni na bínu na bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́di ɔsu?

english_verse: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
translation_verse: Bi ɔsu na bɛɛbla ala susuusu lɛni? Ka bíse bina ngba bɔmɛni bulie kalɔ ku Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun ni, bɛɛyɔ́ ka bɛwɔlɔ ku bayawine ɔyikun?

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Na abi ani na bíbo ni, bɛɛyɔ́ ka abla ukpludi? Nsu nka ɔɔɔdi ukpludi nɔɔ!

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: Katɔti Kɔyu kɔni na úte-mii mmɔ ku akɔla lidu lidu ani na ɔ́bla na bina akɔ mmɔ ni, ɔkɛnku kalɛ na bɛɛdi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ ɔsu na ɔ́bla-nya munuu ka bínu litemi buni lɛmmɔ na bɛ́ƒɔ-ni bɛdi ɔsu?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith.
translation_verse: Bɛnu Abraham. Bénweni banii, “Ka ɔ́ƒɔ Katɔti ɔ́di ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔ́bu-nwu aani ukyuli ɔni nse siin.”

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛnu bɛti ka bekyuli bani mbo bɔƒɔtaadi ni, ama ndi Abraham bebi.

english_verse: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
translation_verse: Na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo básu bése ka ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔklibi anwu ku bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ ƒui ntɛ ɔkɛnku bana bɔƒɔtaadi na Kristo lɛlɔ ɔsu. Anwuɔsu Katɔti ɔ́su litemi buni lɛmɛni úte Abraham kukuuku ɔnini, “Ndubute kadi ƒui bekyuli kusɛ kusɛ ɔkɛnku awɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bani mbo bɔƒɔtaadi ni, Katɔti úte ama ku Abraham ɔni mbo bɔƒɔtaadi ƒui kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
translation_verse: Na bani na ama béti bana anu básia ɔda bubo bɔkukudi bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ewida asiaku-ma. Ɔsika bénweni bése banii, “Ukyuli biala ɔni naaadubo etemila ani ƒui na bénweni bése na Ɔda Bubo Ɔku kemmo lɛlɔ bɔdi ni, ewida adubɔsiaku-nwu kama.”

english_verse: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka Katɔti uláklibi anwu ku ɔdi ntɛ ɔkɛnku ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Ɔsika bénweni banii, “bani mɔɔsiaku-mi kama siin ni, badubulie ngba na bana bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo.”

english_verse: The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔda bubo bɔɔɔdanku bɔƒɔtaadi. Mmomu bénweni banii, “Ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔdi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔda bubo ulu ɔmmɔ ɔdubute-nwu ngba.”

english_verse: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
translation_verse: Na Kristo nébo úbada-bu údie ewida kemmo. Na anwu nébenwini ewidala úte-bu. Ɔsika bénweni banii, “Ewida asiaku ukyuli ɔni na badubuti baƒala ugyii lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: Na Kristo ɔ́bla ɔmɛni kalɛ na kusɛ kusɛ ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka wasiaku Abraham mmɔ ɔsiaku bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ lɛnɔ kama ɔkɛnku Kristo Yesu lɛlɔ. Na ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, na abu lɛnɔ bɔkɛ Katɔti linyese lɛni ndi nwuna Kɔyu. Kavumana Kadi Kakya Ɔda Bubo Ku Linyese Ntɛ

english_verse: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
translation_verse: Banwa, lɛla lɛni mɔɔsu mɛni ni, bɛya na liti lɛkɔku bula limeyi biala ngba bulie. Si nkyuli inyɔ bénu lɛlɔ kalɔ na lɛla lɛdi lɛlɔ na bényimi-ni lɛlɔ ni, bana kemmo ɔdi uuubo kuƒi ka ɔsɔ unweni iye ɔda lɛla lɛdi udie bunyimi bɔmmɔ kemmo. Lɛni kani na use na mɛni lɛnɔ.

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Linyese lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́su úse mmɔ lise lite Abraham ku ubidi. Na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Katɔti útasu ɔnii, “Abraham ku nwuna bebi.” Si ɔ́su ɔnii, “ku nwuna bebi” ni, na ɔɔtina ka bebi bammɔ bemomo. Mmomu bɔsu na ɔ́su ɔnii ku ubidi. Na ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka ukyuli unwi pɛ. Na ukyuli ɔmmɔ ndi Kristo.

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Na si lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka wete mmɔ lɛkɛnku ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni, na agyi anii ɔsɔ ɔɔɔdi linyese. Nsu ɔɔɔdi lɛni. Mmomu ɔkɛnku Katɔti ɔlati nwuna lɛƒɔndia ɔsu na úti-ni úte Abraham na nwuna linyese ɔsu.
