english_verse: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
translation_verse: Na bi na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔdanku nɔɔ? Búbebunku na bɔnu likpidi bɔti. Na bɔdubɔkya utédu uwi ɔni na Abraham ubi ɔmmɔ webo. Anwuɔsu na Katɔti úse kenye kammɔ. Katɔti batu béti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ béboku-bu ɔkɛnku ukyuli unwi ɔni nkya Katɔti ku bekyuli ntɛ.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Nsu ka Katɔti ɔlati mɔɔbla lɛla lɛmɛni ɔƒɛni ɔsu ni, utáwia ntɛ ɔkyane ɔbambadi. Ɔda Bubo Mɔɔtɔnku-bu Na Bɔɔnu Kristo

english_verse: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
translation_verse: Bɔtina na ɔmɛni ɔda ka ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔ́ta bunye Katɔti linyese lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ? Oowo, kudii! Ɔsika si béti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ béte ukyuli kalɛ na ɔkɛ ngba ni, na agyi anii ukyuli ɔdubɔbla siin ku Katɔti si ɔ́di ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nsu Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔmmɔ ɔ́su ka kayawi kemodi kénwini kabla ɔblane kéte likpidi. Na kenye kani na Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka wete bekyuli ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi na Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ kadububo kete bani náƒɔ-nwu bádi.

english_verse: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
translation_verse: Asa na bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ bɔdububo ni, ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔ́bala-bu aani batɔntɛne kalɛ úti útédu ka bédie bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ keyi.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ mɔɔgyumana-bu kalɛ na ɔtɔnku-bu na bɔnu Kristo, kalɛ na Katɔti ɔklibi abu ku-nwu ntɛ ɔkɛnku Kristo bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ɔni na bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ búubo ni, ɔɔɔdi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ nsɔ mɔɔnu-bu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku Kristo bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo ɔsu na bina ƒui bɛdi Katɔti bebi.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: Ɔsika amii bani ƒui náƒɔ ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmmɔ na Kristo kemmo ni, bíti Kristo bɛ́kya aani awu kalɛ.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu kavumana kadi kasɔ keeebo Yudani iye Helani iye ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla ukyuli ɔdi kabla iye ɔni nli nte lɛlɔ iye ɔnana iye uleku ɔdi ntɛ. Ɔsika bina ƒui bɛ́bla ku Kristo Yesu unwi.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si bɛdi Kristo ɔdi ni, na bɛdi Abraham kaba bebi, na bɛdi Katɔti linyese lɛmmɔ ala badine.

english_verse: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na mɔɔsu ndi ka uwi ɔni na ɔnamu ɔni mɔɔdi ɔti ala ɔmu use blii suɛ ni, ɔnamu ɔmmɔ use aani ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla ukyuli ɔdi kabla. Ina ka anwu mbo lɛla biala.

english_verse: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ɔmu ɔdi ɔnamu mɛni ni, ubo bekyuli bani mɔɔnu anwu ku nwuna ala lɛlɔ úti útédu uwi ɔni na ɔti úse úse.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na use abu lɛnɔ uwi ɔni na bɔdi banamu. Na ala ani na baatina na kayawi mɛni nátaadi-bu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
translation_verse: Nsu ka uwi ɔni na Katɔti úse mmɔ geen údu ni, ɔ́tala Ubidi ɔ́kya-bu. Na ɔ́ya na uleku ɔdi ɔ́wɔ-nwu ɔ́kya kadi kadi akɔ na bana ɔda bubo bɔdi-nwu lɛlɔ

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: kalɛ na ɔda bani nkya ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kalɔ udie na benwini Katɔti bebi geen.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: Ka bɔdi Katɔti bebi ɔsu ni, ɔ́tala Ubi ɔmmɔ Kɔyu ɔ́kya bula kayi kemmo. Na Kɔyu kɔmmɔ mɔɔkpali katɔ taalɔ ɔnini, “Abba” ɔni kalɔ ndi mina Ati.

english_verse: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, bɛsɔ bɛɛɛdi bekyuli bani mɔɔbla kabla teete bekyuli badi lɛnɔ. Mmomu bɛdi nwuna bebi. Na ka amii lɛnɔ bɛdi nwuna bebi mɛni ni, Katɔti ɔ́bla-mii nwuna ala badine. Paulo Kasusu Kékpoku-nwu Na Galatiƒuɔ Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni návi kemmo ni, na nka bɛɛɛgyi Katɔti. Anwuɔsu ɔyikun ɔni naaadi Katɔti ɔdi nátaadi-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers?
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ɔni na bɛgyi Katɔti mɛni iye lɛsu nnii Katɔti ɔgyi-mii mɛni ni, bi ɔsu na bɛ́sɔ bíti lɛlɔ biite ɔyikun ɔmmɔ bene udu? Munuu bɛɛyɔ́ ka ɔda bubo bɔdi bɔsɔ butaadi-mii lɛlɔ?

english_verse: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
translation_verse: Na bɛ́sɔ bínwini kama bísie bɛɛdi emeyi ku abuli ku uwi ku akwa adi udu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: Liƒu lɛɛda-mi na bina lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔbla-mi aani ka kabla kani na lɛ́bla líte-mii ƒui kadi kabla keeke.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
translation_verse: Banwa, muuvele-mii nnii bɛtɛya-mi na bɛlɛ-mi. Ɔsika ami lɛnɔ ukyuli ndi aani bina kalɛ. Na ɔdi útabla-mi likpidi lɛdi.

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: Binyimo kudeedi kɔni na lɛ́ka litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa bɔ́kɔ bute-mii mmɔ, ɔsika na lɛlɔ kemmo kaaadia-mi.

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: Ina ka udu ɔni kemmo na nkya na mina ɔlɛ ɔsu ɔdi bɔkɔku taanu ute-mii muedi ni, bítanu-mi kalɛ kadi iye bini-mi. Mmomu bɛ́ƒɔ-mi aani kalɛ na bɛdubɔƒɔ Katɔti ɔtu, na bɛ́ƒɔ-mi lɛnɔ aani kalɛ na bɛdubɔƒɔ Kristo Yesu ɔmmɔ ɔlati.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: Wɛ na lɛlɔyɔ lɛni náƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo mmɔ ƒui lɛ́vi? Lɛla lɛni lɛlɔ na ami ɔlati muedi lɛkana na lidie-mii kenye ka nka bɛkana bɛkpa bina anumi ani na bɛda bɛɛnu muedi bite-mi.

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: Munuu línwini-mii ukisine na litemi geen lɛni na lɛ́su-mii ɔsu?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Anumi eegyie bekyuli bani muubo-mii kudɔ ka benwini-mii kasusu basia bana lɛlɔ. Nsu ɔɔɔdi kasusu kabuni na bada. Mmomu kalɛ na bamami-mii bula lɛlɔ na baya bina anumi eteegyie bana lɛlɔ ɔsu kani.

english_verse: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
translation_verse: Ɔdia ka ukyuli anumi eteegyie na lɛla lɛbuni lɛlɔ. Na ɔdi ka use lɛni uwi biala, na ɔɔɔdi uwi ɔni na nkya-mii kudɔ kani.

english_verse: My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you.
translation_verse: Mina bebi bayɔne, nsɔ muunú-mii lɛlɔ ɔlɛ aani uleku ɔni ntɛ kɔwɔ úti utédu uwi ɔni na manu ka Kristo udu ɔ́ƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
translation_verse: Na mɔɔyɔ́ geen ka nka lɛkya-mii kudɔ ɔƒɛni na liboku mina lɛdi kalɔ, ɔsika bina ablala ese-mi kalɛ kadi! Hagar Ku Sara Lɛlɔ Litemi

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: Mɔɔyɔ́ ka liye amii bani mɔɔyɔ́ ka bɛsɔ bɛkya ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kalɔ nnii lɛla lɛni na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔdanku ni, biinú-mu kalɔ geen?

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔɔtina ka ni, Abraham ɔ́wɔ bebi inyɔ. Na ubi udeedi ni, uleku ɔni mɔɔbla-nwu kaduli kabla náwɔ-nwu úte-nwu. Na ubi unyɔdi anwu ni, nwuna kɔduni náwɔ-nwu úte-nwu.

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni adi lɛsugba. Na beleku inyɔ bamɛni benye bete bunyimi bɔkukudi ku bɔwɔdi. Na bebi bani na ɔda bubo búnyimi-ma aani bekyuli bani mɔɔbla bekyuli bamba kabla kalɛ ni, badi Hagar bebi. Na ama nnye nte bunyimi bɔni na Katɔti únyimi ku bekyuli na Sinai kɔbi lili.

english_verse: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
translation_verse: Hagar ɔni nnye nte Sinai kɔbi na Arabia kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔdi lɛgba lɛni mɔɔtina kalɛ na Yerusalem ɔni nkya ɔƒɛni ku nwuna bebi bakya lɛbibo kemmo ɔmwi na bénwini bekyuli bamba kabla bablane.

english_verse: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
translation_verse: Nsu Yerusalem ɔni nkya katɔ ni, lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-nwu, na anwu ndi kɔduni ɔni ndi bula uni.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika bénweni bákya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo banii, “Lɛlɔ litaayɔ awɔ udinkɔ. Bo kudu momoomo ku lɛlɔyɔ, awɔ ɔni na kawɔƒɔ kátadu-ɔ kudii. Ɔsika uleku ɔni na ɔgyani údie-nwu atu ni, anwu ndubo bɔwɔ butulo.”

english_verse: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, mina banwa, amii bílieku Isak na bɛdi Katɔti bebi ɔkɛnku nwuna linyese lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, ubi ɔni na uleku ɔni mɔɔbla kaduli kabla mmɔ ɔ́wɔ ni, úkpoku ubi ɔni na ɔkɛnku Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun lɛlɔ na kɔduni ɔ́wɔ-nwu. Na lɛni kani na ɔɔlɛ́ ɔmwi.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: Nsu bi na bénweni bákya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo? Bénweni banii, “Bɔku uleku ɔni mɔɔbla kaduli kabla mmɔ ku ubidi na batɔlɔ kaduli mmɔ, ɔsika uleku ɔni mɔɔbla kaduli kabla ubi ku kɔduni ubi balakana bana ɔti ala bule bɔdi.”

english_verse: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, mina banwa, abu bɔɔɔdi kaduli kabla ɔblane bebi, mmomu kɔduni bebi na bɔdi.

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Kristo úte-bu bɔnwuna kalɛ na bɔkɛ bɔnwuna sɔsɔ. Anwuɔsu binye kpakplaa na bɛsɔ bitete kuƒi na ɔdi unye-mii lɛlɔ na bitaabla ukyuli ɔdi kabla lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised.
translation_verse: Bise ɔmɛni likpo! Ami Paulo mɔɔsu-mii ka si bíte kuƒi na békulo-mii ago ni, na Kristo ɔsɔ uuubo kɔsia kɔdi uuute-mii.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Na amii bani mɔɔkali bɛnii amii ku Katɔti ntɛ bɔdubɔdia ɔkɛnku ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi ɔsu ni, bɛgyi bɛnii bɛ́da lɛlɔ bɛ́mami Kristo lɛlɔ. Na bɛsɔ bilákɛ Katɔti lɛƒɔndia.

english_verse: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Na abu ni, ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi ku Katɔti ɔyikun lɛlɔ ni, bɔsia anu kpakplaa ka Katɔti ɔdubɔnu-bu aani bekyuli bani nse siin. Na ɔmɛni na bunye bɔgya.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
translation_verse: Na si bɔ́bla unwi ku Kristo ni, lego bukulo ku tekulo ɔsɔ uuubo kɔsia kɔdi. Lɛla lɛni bɔɔwia ndi bɔƒɔtaadi bɔni mɔɔtina kalɛ na bɔɔyɔ́ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: Na nka binye kabla kammɔ lɛlɔ kaduɛ! Na ɔma náya na bɛ́da bɛ́ya, na ɔ́ya na bɛ́da litemi geen lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi bɛ́ya?

english_verse: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
translation_verse: Bɔnyii blii suɛ mɔɔyá na ɔlaaƒɔ ɔni bánwu ƒui uuƒu.

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: Lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di na Blɔti lɛnyi kemmo ka bɛsɔ bileti kasusu kabambadi. Na ukyuli ɔni muuƒú-mii kasusu mmɔ ni, ɔdubɔkɛ nwuna kɔtu bɔni kalɛ na ɔ́manku-nwu si ina bi ukyuli na ɔdi.

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Banwa, na mina kakɛ ni, si bɔsu na mmu mɔɔsu bekyuli ka ɔlɛka bekulo ago ni, na nka bi ɔsu na bekyuli beekpóku-mi? Na ɔɔtina ka nka Kristo kukpi na ugyii lɛlɔ lɛsa lɛni mɔɔkɔ́ ni, ɔsɔ ulékpoku Yudaƒuɔ.

english_verse: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani muuƒú-mii kasusu mɛni ama ni, ndubɔyɔ ka besie anumi utédu ka bekulo lɛlɔ bedie bina akɔ ƒui.

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: Banwa, bɔlɔ na Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-bu ɔnii bɔkɛ bɔnwuna. Nsu utalɛka buti bɔnwuna bɔkɛ bɔmɛni butaabla ala ekpidi. Mmomu ɔlɛka buti-mu buteebunku lɛlɔ na bɔyɔ kemmo.

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ ƒui kalɔ budie bɔdanku lɛla linwi pɛ. Na ani ndi ka, “Yɔ ƒula ukyulikpana aani ƒula lɛlɔ kalɛ.”

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Nsu si bɛɛtu lɛlɔ akpɛlɛ ka bibile lɛlɔ ni, na bɛti ka lɛkpa lɛmmɔ lɛdubo udu bɔyii ƒui. Kavumana Kadi Kakya Katɔti Kɔyu Ku Ukyuli Udu Kemmo

english_verse: If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni mɔɔsu-mii ndi ka bɛya na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔtɔnku-mii na bina ngba bulie kemmo. Na bitaya na bina ɔlɔna ɔkwɛ adala adi-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
translation_verse: Na ala ani na bula ɔlɔna ɔɔyɔ́ ni, aata teenye ala ani na Kɔyu kɔɔyɔ́ lɛlɔ. Lɛni kani na ala ani na Kɔyu lɛnɔ kɔɔyɔ́ aata teenye ala ani na ɔlɔna ɔɔyɔ́ lɛlɔ. Na ɔlɔna ku Kɔyu kɔmɛni badi bekisine bete lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu bɛsɔ bilakana na bitaabla lɛla biala mɔɔda-mii ɔkwɛ.

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Na si Kɔyu kɔ́tɔnku-mii ni, na biiibo ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kalɔ.

english_verse: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
translation_verse: Na ala ani na ɔlɔna ɔɔbla ni, aalɛ́ keyi nwaa na anya ndi lɛyalɛ ku kɔbɔ ala bɔbla ku adɔlɔla bɔbla

english_verse: They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are
translation_verse: ku lɛƒiɔkpa ku kabɔ bɔdu ku bekyuli bukisi ku kekpo ku bekyuli bani muukpó kogyulo ku kɔnyi buti ku awɔ lɛti lɛkɛ ku unyeƒi ku lɛlɔ bule akpa akpa

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: ku lɛnungyie ku ntɛ bukpi ku adikpi emeyi bɔdi ku ana udu. Na muubó-mii ɔda na ana lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na lɛ́ɛsu-mii ḿbavi ka bekyuli bani mɔɔbla ala ammɔ udu ni, baladi Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ala!

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: ku lɛlɔ buwi buɛɛ ku lɛlɔ bɔti bɔda. Na ɔda bubo bɔdi bulétile ala amɛni kuƒi.

english_verse: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani ndi Kristo Yesu badi ni, bákana bana ɔlɔna udu ɔkukudi ɔmmɔ ku nwuna ɔkwɛ adala ekpidi ƒui bámana ugyii lɛlɔ ku Kristo.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Na ka ɔkɛnku Kɔyu kɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu na bulie ngba ni, bɛya na Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kɔtɔnku-bu.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Na bitaya na bɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ iye butaakya lɛlɔ kɔnyi iye buteekpoku lɛlɔ kogyulo.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: Banwa, si ɔdi ɔ́bla likpidi lɛdi ni, amii bani na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ni, binwini-nwu buɛɛ na ɔda likpidi lɛmmɔ bɔbla ɔya. Nsu bɛnu kaduɛ kalɛ na bina akɔ ɔdi uleduo ɔgbankpi ɔmmɔ udu kemmo.

english_verse: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
translation_verse: Bibunku lɛlɔ si ɔdi ɔkya lɛbibo lɛdi kemmo. Na si bɛɛbla ɔmɛni ni, na bɛɛdi Kristo ɔda bubo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi ɔɔnu lɛlɔ ka ɔdi lɛla lɛdi nsu ɔɔɔdi lɛla biala ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔɔtɔ́lɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔkɔku nwuna lɛlɔ udu ɔnu. Na si ɔ́nu ɔ́ti ka ɔdia ni, na ɔkana na ɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na nwuna ablala lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔɔdi ɔni na uti lɛlɔ ɔkɔku ukyuli bamba.

english_verse: We each must carry our own load.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔdi ka ukyuli biala uti anwu ɔlati etila.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni na bátina-nwu bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo etemila ni, anwu lɛnɔ ule nwuna akɛla ku ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtina-nwu ala mmɔ.

english_verse: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
translation_verse: Ɔdi utatɔlɔ lɛlɔ, ɔsika ukyuli ɔdi ulakana na wavi Katɔti kekuma. Ɔsika lɛla lɛni na áva ni, ani kani na adubo bude.

english_verse: If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life.
translation_verse: Si aavá ala ani mɔɔda ɔlɔna ɔkwɛ ebi ni, kukpi na adubɔkɛ. Nsu si aavá ala ani mɔɔda Kɔyu ɔkwɛ ebi ni, ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii na adubɔkɛ.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Bitaya na enu aƒɛ-bu ku lɛbuni bɔbla. Ɔsika si enu átaƒɛ-bu ni, uwi ɔdubo ɔni na bɔdubɔkɛ edula ani na bɔ́va ebi.

english_verse: We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord. Final Warnings
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu uwi biala na kuƒi kɔtɛ-bu ni, bɛya na butaabla lɛbuni teete ukyuli biala. Ɔni ntulo ndi ka bɛbla bite banwa baƒɔtaadine. Lɛla Lɛni Na Bɔɔwia Ndi Ngba Bɔwɔdi Bulie

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: Amii alati bɛdubɔnu kunweni bonwu kɔni na ami ɔlati líti mina kɔnu línweni mɛni.

english_verse: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
translation_verse: Bani nnye-mii lɛlɔ na baayɔ́ ka bikulo ago mmɔ ni, ama ndi bekyuli bani mɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ na ɔlɔna lɛlɔ. Baabla ɔmɛni kalɛ na bekyuli belékpoku-ma na Kristo kukpi na ugyii lɛlɔ litemi ɔsu.

english_verse: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
translation_verse: Bani muedi nékulo ago mmɔ ni, baládi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Nsu baayɔ́ ka amii lɛnɔ bikulo ago na bataakun lɛmɛnɛ na bina ɔlɔna bukulo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Ami ni, mina lɛmɛnɛ lɛni ndubɔkun kani ndi kukpi kɔni na Yesu Kristo úkpi na ugyii lɛlɔ. Na ɔkɛnku nwuna kukpi na ugyii lɛlɔ ɔsu use aani si líkpi na kayawi ala kudɔ aani kalɛ kani na kayawi ala ékpi na mina anumi.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi lego bukulo iye ago tekulo na bɔɔwia, mmomu lɛla lɛni na bɔɔwia ndi ngba bɔwɔdi bulie.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Na ama bani mɔɔsia ala amɛni anu na bana ngba bulie kemmo ni, keyi buɛɛ ku kɔnyana bɔnu kɔsiaku-ma kama, ama ku Katɔti bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: Ukplodi ni, nsɔ naaayɔ ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ ute-mi lɛƒɛda lɛdi. Ɔsika lɛtaala lɛni mma-mi lɛlɔ mɛni ɔɔtina ka ndi Yesu kabla ɔblane.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: Banwa, muuvele nnii Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛƒɔndia lɛsiaku-mii na lɛkya bina kɔyu ɔkplu. Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Ami, Paulo ɔni nkɛnku Katɔti lɛƒɔyɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu na ndi Kristo Yesu ɔtalane ni, ami muunweni ɔku ɔmɛni lite amii Katɔti baƒɔtaadine bani nkya Eƒeso na bɛ́blaku Kristo unwi na bɛɛdi nwuna etemila lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: Muuvele Katɔti ku Blɔti Yesu Kristo nnii nwuna lɛƒɔndia lɛkya-mii ɔkplu na ute-mii keyi buɛɛ. Katɔti Muute-bu Kusɛ Kusɛ Na Kristo Ɔsu

english_verse: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
translation_verse: Bɔɔgyá Katɔti ɔni ndi Blɔti Yesu Kristo Ɔti enu. Anwu muute-bu kɔyu kemmo kusɛ kusɛ ƒui ɔ́siku katɔ mmɔ ɔkɛnku Kristo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔkɛnku Kristo ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna-bu úse asa na údie kayawi kalɛ na bɔlɛ sɛɛn na nwuna anumi na bɔƒiɔ bɔdi bulakya-bu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́lɛ ugyii úse na nwuna kaƒɔ ƒaa bɔyɔ kemmo ka ɔdubɔsia Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ na ɔbla-bu nwuna bebi.

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛya na bumwi Katɔti na nwuna lɛƒɔndia libendi lɛni na ɔ́bla úte-bu ɔkɛnku Ubidi ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́ geen lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Christ sacrificed his life's blood to set us free, which means our sins are now forgiven. Christ did this because of God's gift of undeserved grace to us. God has great wisdom and understanding,
translation_verse: Lɛƒɔndia lɛni neeebo bɔkɔku bɔdi. Ɔkɛnku nwuna lɛnunda ku kalɛ na nwuna kasusu kagyi lɛla biala ɔsu ni,

english_verse: and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways.
translation_verse: kaƒɔ káyɔ-nwu ka údie nwuna kasusu kemmo abɛla ƒui ɔ́tina-bu. Ani na ɔ́su úse ka ɔdubɔbla ɔkɛnku Kristo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
translation_verse: Na kasusu kammɔ kadububo kete lɛni na kawɔlɔkɔ uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́su úse lɛlɔ. Ɔdubɔsala ala ani ƒui nkya katɔ ku kalɔ na uti-nya ɔkya lɛlɔ ɔdine unwi ɔni ndi Kristo kalɔ.

english_verse: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bɛya na abu bani ndi bekyuli bedeedi bani nákɛ lɛnunsia na Kristo kemmo mɛni ni, bumwi Katɔti ka ɔdia geen ɔsu.

english_verse: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na béti amii lɛnɔ bébunku Kristo badi akɔ ɔkɛnku litemi geen lɛni na bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́di ɔsu. Na litemi buni lɛmmɔ néti ngba bɔƒɔ búboku-mii. Na ka bɛ́ƒɔ Kristo bɛ́di ɔsu ni, Katɔti úti nwuna Kɔyu kɔni na ɔ́su úse ka wete-bu mmɔ úse-bu likpo.

english_verse: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
translation_verse: Katɔti Kɔyu kɔmɛni na úti únyene kama úte ala ani ƒui na bɔdubɔkɛ wetédu uwi ɔni na wawɔlɔ anwu badi bɔƒɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na bemwi nwuna lɛnyi bonwu lɛmmɔ. Paulo Ɔ́kpali Katɔ Úte Ɔku Ɔmɛni Baƒɔne

english_verse: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, ɔ́si uwi ɔni na línu kalɛ na bɛ́ƒɔ Blɔti Yesu bɛ́di na bɛɛyɔ́ Katɔti bekyuli ni,

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: ńtada linugya buti teete Katɔti na bina lili ńtaya. Na uwi biala na mɔɔkpali katɔ ni, muuvele na bina lili.

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: Muuvele nnii Katɔti ɔni ndi Blɔti Yesu Kristo Ɔti na ɔdi bula Ɔti Buni geen ute-mii nwuna Kɔyu kɔni ndubɔya na bɛda anu na udie Katɔti ɔmmɔ ɔtina-mii. Na ɔya na bɛti-nwu kaduɛ bibu.

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
translation_verse: Na muuvele Katɔti nnii bina kasusu kabla nwaa na bɛnu nwuna bukeye bɛti kalɛ na biti bina anu bɛsia ala ani ɔsu na ɔ́lɔ-mii ku ala bonwu ani na bɔɔkɛ́ taadi na nwuna baƒɔtaadine akɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: Na bɛnu lɛnɔ kalɛ na Katɔti ɔyikun ɔɔbla kabla geen kani neeebo bɔkɔku bɔdi na nwuna baƒɔtaadine akɔ bɛti. Na ɔyikun ɔni nkya-bu lɛlɔ kemmo mɛni ni, útavumanaku ɔyikun unengudi

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: ɔni na Katɔti úti ɔ́talaku Kristo ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ na úti-nwu útése nwuna kɔdianu na katɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Kristo ulie ɔɔdi bayikune ku kenyekɔ biala ku kɔyu ɔyikun ku bagadine ƒui lɛlɔ. Na nwuna lɛnyi litulo lɛga bɔdi ɔyikun lɛnyi biala na kayawi kamɛni ku kani mebo lɛnɔ ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: Katɔti úti lɛla biala ɔ́kya Kristo lɛgba kalɔ na úti-nwu ɔ́bla baƒɔtaadine ƒui lili.

english_verse: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_verse: Baƒɔtaadine bamɛni badi Kristo ɔlɔna na beedie-nwu keyi na ulu biala lɛlɔ ka anwu ndi ukyuli ɔni náƒɔ lɛla biala kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdi návi kemmo ni, bíse aani bekyuli bani nékpi na kɔyu kemmo, ɔsika bítaabla atuɔkplu ku ekpidi.

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: Na bɛ́siaku kayawi ala ekpidi kama ku ukisine ɔni mɔɔdi ayu ekpidi ƒui lɛlɔ na kayaa, na anwu kani mɔɔdi batuɔkplune ƒui lɛlɔ ɔƒɛni.

english_verse: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
translation_verse: Lɛni geen na abu lɛnɔ búlie ngba aani bana kalɛ na bɔ́siaku bula ɔlɔna ɔkwɛ adala kama na bɔ́bla ala ani na bula ɔlɔna ku kasusu kaayɔ́. Na ka bula ukyuli udu útavumanaku bani mɔɔbla ala ammɔ udu ɔsu ni, bɔ́manku ka Katɔti ɔni abu lɛnɔ kɔtu aani bekyuli bakladi kalɛ.

english_verse: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
translation_verse: uwi ɔni na búkpi na kɔyu kemmo ɔ́si bula alaekpidi bɔbla ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔ́ya na bɔ́sɔ búnwini búbo bulie ngba ku Kristo. Na ɔkɛnku Katɔti lɛƒɔndia ɔsu na bɔ́kɛ ngba bɔƒɔ bɔmɛni.

english_verse: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ ɔɔtina ka abu ku Yesu Kristo na Katɔti ɔ́gyila ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ kalɛ na bɔdiku-nwu lɛga na katɔ.

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́bla ɔmɛni úti ɔ́tina bekyuli na uwi ɔni ndububo ƒui kemmo kalɛ na banu nwuna lɛƒɔndia lɛni na ubo ute-bu ka liiibo bɔkɔku bɔdi ɔkɛnku bɔyɔ bɔni na ɔɔyɔ́-bu na Yesu Kristo ɔsu.

english_verse: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti lɛƒɔndia ɔsu na bɛ́kɛ ngba bɔƒɔ. Na útasi amii alati kudɔ. Mmomu ɔ́si Katɔti bɔƒɔtaadi litela lɛni na úte-mii ɔsu.

english_verse: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
translation_verse: Na útasi bina kabla kadi lɛnɔ kemmo kalɛ na ɔdi ɔkun lɛmɛnɛ lɛdi.

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔkɛnku Kristo Yesu lɛlɔ na údie-bu kalɛ na bɔbla ala abuni ani na anwu ɔlati ɔ́klibi úse úte-bu ka bɔbla. Kristo Úti Bekyuli Ƒui Ɔ́sala

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: Binyimo ka uwi ɔmmɔ ni, amii ku Kristo bɛɛɛdi unwi, na bɛdi baƒɔ bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ bani na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna. Na biiibunku kenye kani na Katɔti úse úte nwuna bekyuli na kenye kani na únyimiku-ma kemmo. Na biiibo lɛnunsia lɛdi na ngba bɔni na bilie kemmo. Na bítenu Katɔti lɛnɔ kɔku kudii na bina ngba kemmo.

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, amii bani na nka bɛ́gyunku Kristo Yesu ni, ɔkɛnku nwuna ubugya ɔni na úti úwi kalɔ na bina lili ɔsu ni, bɛ́kpɛ bíde-nwu.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: Ɔsika Kristo ɔlati úte-bu bɔnwuna uwi ɔni na úti Yudaƒuɔ ku bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ ƒui ɔ́sala. Na údie bukisi bɔni nse anii kowodu na ɔkya bana ntɛ.

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: Úti nwuna ɔlɔna ɔ́kpa úte Katɔti aani ala ani na beti bakpa bedie ekisila ani na Yudaƒuɔ ɔda bubo ƒui bɔdanku. Lɛla lɛni ɔsu na úti lɛlɔ ɔ́kpa ndi ka uti bana akpa anyɔ bammɔ ɔsala na babla benwi na nwuna kemmo, na keyi buɛɛ kebo-ma akɔ.

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: Na lɛnɔ ni, Kristo kukpi na ugyii lɛlɔ ɔ́klibi bana inyɔ ƒui ku Katɔti ntɛ, na ɔ́da bukisi ala ani ƒui ńkya-ma ntɛ údie, na bábla unwi ku Katɔti.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu Kristo úbo úbakɔ keyi buɛɛ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa úte bekyuli bani nágyunku-nwu ku bani nákpɛ béde-nwu ƒui.

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku Kristo lɛlɔ na bula akpa anyɔ ƒui, Yudaƒuɔ ku bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ, bɔkɛ Katɔti Kɔyu kunwi lɛlɔ búbo Katɔti anumi.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu amii bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ mɛni bɛsɔ bɛɛɛdi baƒɔ iye belusiene keeke. Mmomu ɔƒɛni ni, bɛdi Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma bekyuli akɔ badi ku Katɔti bebi geen.

english_verse: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
translation_verse: Amii lɛnɔ bise aani kowodu kɔni na bátu bálɛ kpakplaa kɔni na batalane ku kenye bediene bammɔ bátu. Na Kristo ɔlati ndi kowodu kalɔ lɛtabi lɛni nda kowodu kɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: Na anwu ndi ukyuli ɔni náda ɔtɔ ɔni na bátu mmɔ ɔ́sala na ɔ́ya na únwini Katɔti kakpakɔ kedee.

english_verse: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_verse: Na Kristo ɔmmɔ kemmo na baatú abu lɛnɔ aani ɔtɔ kalɛ na bunwini keliekɔ bute Katɔti na kɔyu kemmo.

english_verse: Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, ami Paulo ɔni ntɛ aban ɔtɔ ka mɔɔbla Kristo Yesu kabla na bina lili ɔsu ni,

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di ka bínu ka Katɔti úti kabla kamɛni ɔ́kya-mi lɛkɔkɔ ka lɛbla na bina akɔ na nwuna lɛƒɔndia lɛni na ubo ute-mii ɔsu.

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Línweni ɔku klukui ɔdi límene-mii ɔ́siku kalɛ na Katɔti údie nwuna ala ani nábɛ ukyuli ɔ́tina-mi.

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́ka-nwu ni, bɛdubɔnu kalɛ na muunú Kristo abɛla amɛni kalɔ.

english_verse: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
translation_verse: Kuuku ni, ɔyawine ɔdi ɔɔɔgyi abɛla amɛni. Nsu ɔƒɛni kani ni, Katɔti ɔ́ya na nwuna Kɔyu kúdie ala amɛni keyi ɔ́tina nwuna batalane ku kenye bediene kedee.

english_verse: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
translation_verse: Na lɛbɛla lɛmmɔ ndi ka bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ lɛnɔ benwini Katɔti ala badine aani bekyuli bani na ɔ́ƒuna kalɛ na babla ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ kakɛ kadi. Na ɔkɛnku Kristo Yesu lɛlɔ ni, badubɔkɛ ala ani na Katɔti ɔ́su nwuna bekyuli úse.

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́bla-mi nwuna litemi buni lɛmɛni kabla ɔblane ɔkɛnku litela lɛni na úti úte-mi ɔ́siaku nwuna ɔyikun lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Ami ɔni ndi Katɔti baƒɔtaadine ƒui akɔ ubliidi ni, Katɔti úti litela lɛmɛni úte-mi ka lɛkɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa na lɛƒɔndia bonwu lɛni na bekyuli badubɔkɛ ɔkɛnku Kristo lɛlɔ lite bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ.

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: Na lɛya bekyuli bati kalɛ na Katɔti abɛla ammɔ ani na anwu ɔni nédie ala ƒui úti ɔ́bɛla bekyuli uwi ɔni návi kemmo adubo kabla bɔbla na bekyuli akɔ.

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛ nwuna baƒɔtaadine lɛlɔ ni, bayikune ku kenyekɔ biala kani mbo ɔyikun na kayaa batɛya Katɔti lɛnunda bonwu lɛni mɔɔbla kabla na lilu pii lɛlɔ na nwuna baƒɔtaadine akɔ.

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: Na ala amɛni ƒui akɛnku kalɛ na Katɔti ɔlati ɔ́su úse ka ɔbla ɔsiaku Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, enu ataƒɛ-mii ka muubó abi lɛni na amii ɔsu. Amii ndubɔkɛ lɛbibo lɛmmɔ kɔsia. Kristo Ɔɔyɔ́-bu

english_verse: I kneel in prayer to the Father.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu mɔɔlɛ akɔnkɔ teevele Katɔti.

english_verse: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
translation_verse: Anwu mɔɔyá na lɛla biala lɛni nkya katɔ ku kalɔ ƒui libo lɛnyi na nina udu kenye.

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: Muuvele Katɔti na nwuna lɛƒɔndia bukeye pii kemmo nnii ɔkya-mii ɔkplu na nwuna Kɔyu kute-mii ɔyikun na bina kayi kemmo.

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: Na muuvele nnii Kristo ɔsia bina bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ na ulie-mii kayi kemmo kalɛ na si bina bɔyɔ bɔni na bibo búdie litu na bɔda kalɔ kpakplaa aani kugyii kalɛ ni,

english_verse: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
translation_verse: amii ku Katɔti baƒɔtaadine ƒui bɛdubɔti kalɛ na Kristo bɔyɔ bɔ́bɛbɛ na búne ku kalɛ na bɔ́kuku na bɔgyu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: Na bɛnu Kristo bɔyɔ bonwu bɔni kalɔ na ukyuli ulakana bunu bɔwɔlɔ mɛni bɛti na Katɔti ɔƒɔ bina ƒui lɛlɔ kemmo aani kalɛ kani na anwu ɔlati use. Paulo Uumwi Katɔti

english_verse: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_verse: Bimwi-nwu na baƒɔtaadine akɔ ɔkɛnku Kristo Yesu lɛlɔ na kadi bekyuli ƒui akɔ ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela uwi ƒui. Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka mɔɔbla Blɔti kabla na ntɛ ɔtɔ na anwu ɔsu ni, mɔɔlɛ-mii nnii bilie ngba bɔni námanku bɔlɔ bɔni na Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-mii.

english_verse: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
translation_verse: Biteeboku lɛlɔ kalɔ uwi biala kemmo na bɛda lɛlɔ buɛɛ na bɛyala lɛkɔ na biteebunku lɛlɔ biti bɛtina ka bɛɛyɔ́ lɛlɔ sɔsɔ.

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: Bɛbla lɛla biala kalɛ na bɛkana na bilie na unwi bɔbla kemmo aani kalɛ na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́da-mii kɔ́sala na kúte-mii keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: Ɔlɔna unwi pɛ ku Kɔyu kunwi pɛ nkya aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-bu na bubo lɛnunsia linwi pɛ na bɔlɔ bɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.
translation_verse: Blɔti unwi nkya ku bɔƒɔtaadi bunwi, na ntu bɔkpila ɔdi unwi lɛnɔ nkya.

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani bubo Katɔti unwi ɔni ndi bula ƒui Ɔti ɔni ndi ala ƒui Unwoti, na ɔɔbla kabla na bula kemmo, na ulie bula ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us.
translation_verse: Na Kristo ɔkɛ nwuna lɛƒɔndia bonwu lɛmmɔ kemmo úte bula kemmo ɔdi biala litela lɛni námanku-nwu.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: Aani kalɛ na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔtina ɔnii, “Uwi ɔni na ɔ́kɔ úsie katɔ ƒui ni, úti bekyuli bani na úkpo ɔ́ƒɔ ƒui ɔ́tɔlɔku. Na úte-ma etela.”

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Na si bunweni bɔmmɔ bɔɔtina ka ɔ́kɔ úsie katɔ ni, bi kalɔ na uudie si ɔɔɔdi bɔka na ɔ́ka bɔyu bubo kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ?

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Na anwu ɔni náyu úbo kalɔ ni, anwu kani násɔ ɔ́kɔ úsie katɔ mmɔ ƒui kalɛ na ɔƒɔ lɛla biala kemmo ƒui na katɔ ku kalɔ.

english_verse: so his people would learn to serve and his body would grow strong.
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla ɔmɛni úti ɔ́klibi Katɔti bekyuli úse kalɛ na beti bebunku baƒɔtaadine na banyuɛ-ma aani Kristo ɔlɔna unwi pɛ ɔmmɔ na ɔlɛ lili.

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: Ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na bɔdubo bɔsia na bɔsala bɔbla unwi na bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo na bɔti Katɔti Ubidi ɔmmɔ. Ɔmmɔ ndubɔya na bɔbi lɛlɔ budu likpo lɛni na bekyuli banu kalɛ geen na Kristo use bati ƒui na bula lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.
translation_verse: Na bɔsɔ bulése aani banamu bani kasusu bada baatu teenwini na ala bɔtina biala kemmo ɔkɛnku ala ani na ɔkɔ ala batinane bánwi na beeti bekyuli taatákya likpidi kemmo ɔkɛ bana kakwɛ kekpidi kani na bada ɔsu.

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: Mmomu si bɔ́su litemi geen na bɔyɔ kemmo ni, bɔdubɔlɛ lili aani Kristo ɔni ndi bula ƒui lili mmɔ ɔlati na ulu biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
translation_verse: Anwu náya na ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ kɔkɛ ƒui kɔ́sala. Na ɔlɔna umodi ɔmmɔ ɔdanku lɛlɔ na ɔlɔna ekpo ani násala ɔsu. Anwuɔsu si ɔlɔna kakɛ biala kábla kaduɛ kalɛ na ɔ́manku ni, ɔlɔna umodi ɔmmɔ ɔɔyu ɔkplu na bɔyɔ kemmo. Bilie Aani Katɔti Bebi Kalɛ

english_verse: As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu mɔɔlɛ-mii na Blɔti lɛnyi kemmo nnii bɛsɔ bitelie ngba aani bekyuli bani naaagyi Katɔti na beeti kasusu kekpludi,

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: na bana ala kalɔ bunu bɔkya lɛdisa kemmo. Na ka baaagyi lɛla lɛdi na balayɔ banii beenú lɛla lɛdi lɛnɔ ɔsu ni, beeebo kadikɔ kadi na ngba bɔni na Katɔti uute nwuna bekyuli kemmo.

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: Use nwaa ka bɛgyi Kristo lɛlɔ litemi. Na aani nwuna kama basiakune ni, bátina-mii ala geen ani nkya Yesu ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
translation_verse: Bátina-mii lɛla lɛdi na bina ngba bɔkukudi bulie lɛlɔ. Ani ndi ka bɛda udu ɔkukudi ɔni mɔɔtɔ́lɔ-mii teesienku ɔlɔna ɔkwɛ adala ekpidi kemmo mmɔ bɛya.

english_verse: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
translation_verse: Na bɛya na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔsɔku-mii kakali ɔbla ɔwɔdi.

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: Na biti udu ɔni mɔɔtina ka bise siin bɛda. Ɔsika Katɔti údie-mii ka bɛbla kedee aani anwu kalɛ.

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛda ɔkɔ bɔnyi bɛya. Na ukyuli ɔdi biala ɔsu nwuna ɔkpanadi litemi geen. Ɔsika bula ƒui bɔdi Kristo lɛlɔ ekpo bute lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry
translation_verse: Si bíti kɔnyi ni, bitaya na bina kɔnyi kɔya na bɛbla likpidi. Na bitaya na ɔƒɛ ɔ́nu ɔkya-mii na bina kɔnyi kemmo.

english_verse: and don't give the devil a chance.
translation_verse: Bitete ukisine ɔmmɔ kuƒi.

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni muuyú ni, ɔda buyu ɔya na uti nwuna enu ɔbla kabla kabuni na ɔkɛ ala na anwu lɛnɔ ubunku bawabane.

english_verse: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
translation_verse: Bitasu etemila ani muusé lɛlɔ, mmomu bɛsu etemila ani mɔɔkya ukyuli ɔkplu kalɛ na ɔ́manku. Na si bekyuli bénu bina etemila ni, na bakɛ kɔsia.

english_verse: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
translation_verse: Na bitaya na Katɔti Kɔyu kúduo kɔnyana kemmo. Ɔsika Kɔyu kɔmmɔ nése-mii likpo kúse ka bɛdi Katɔti bekyuli bani ngba na ɔdubɔƒɔ na limeyi likplodi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Livo lɛda-mii buƒi lɛya na bekyuli lɛlɔ. Bɛya na bekyuli ala ada-mii kayi bɔtu aya. Na bɛda kɔnyi buti bɛya. Na bɛda kadɔ bɔdɔ bɛya. Na bɛsɔ bitalɔ lɛlɔ anyikpi. Na bɛsɔ biteti lɛlɔ kasusu biala.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_verse: Mmomu ni, bitaanyuɛ lɛlɔ, na bina lɛlɔ litaakywi-mii kaƒɔ. Na biteeti bina bɔƒiɔ taakyiɛ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na Katɔti úti ɔ́kyiɛ-mii ɔkɛnku Kristo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: Ka bɛdi Katɔti bebi bani na ɔɔyɔ́ ɔsu ni, amii lɛnɔ bɛkya ɔkplu na bɛlɛ-nwu.

english_verse: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Na bɛsiaku Kristo ɔbladu kama na bɛyɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na ɔɔyɔ́-bu na úti lɛlɔ ɔ́kpa na bula lili aani akpala ƒɛƒɛɛ úte Katɔti. Na adi akpala ani mɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti kaƒɔ.

english_verse: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
translation_verse: Ka Katɔti bebi bɛdi ɔsu ni, bɛda lɛlɔ bidie lɛsɔnɔdi ku lɛyalɛ ku lɛnungyie ƒui kemmo. Ɔsika ala amɛni udu átamanku ka balɔ-nya anyi muedi na Katɔti bekyuli kedee akɔ.

english_verse: Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na utalɛka bitatɛmi kɔyalɛtɛ, ɔsika atɛ ekpidi ku adɔlɔla na adi. Mmomu biti linugya biteete Katɔti.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Ɔsika amii alati bɛgyi bise ka ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla lɛnungyie lɛni ndi lɛƒiɔkpa iye ɔni mɔɔbla lɛsɔnɔdi iye lɛyalɛ ni, uuubo kadikɔ kadi na Kristo ku Katɔti lɛgadi kemmo.

english_verse: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
translation_verse: Bitaya na ukyuli ɔdi uti etemila ekpludi adi ɔtɔlɔ-mii. Ɔsika ala ammɔ udu lɛlɔ ɔsu na Katɔti kɔnyi kuubo bekyuli bani mbo atuɔkplu mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu amii ku-ma bitadi kɔnwa kɔdi.

english_verse: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
translation_verse: Ɔsika kudeedi ni, na bɛkya lɛdisa kemmo. Nsu ɔƒɛni ka bínwini Blɔti badi ɔsu ni, bɛkya bukeye kemmo. Anwuɔsu bilie ngba aani bekyuli bani nlie bukeye kemmo.

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bani nli bukeye kemmo ni, ebi ani na baanwu ndi ebi abuni. Baasu etemila geen na beelie siin.

english_verse: as you try to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Na lɛnɔ ni, bɛtɛya lɛla lɛni mɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti kaƒɔ.

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: Amii ku bekyuli bani na bana ablala akya lɛdisa kemmo ni, bitasala lɛlɔ bitabla bana ɔbladu ukpidi ɔdi. Mmomu bidie-ma keyi.

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ala ani na baabɛ́ taabla mmɔ adi kɔƒa ka balɔ-nya anyi muedi.

english_verse: But the light will show what these things are really like.
translation_verse: Na ala ani ƒui bédie keyi ni, adubɔda bɔlɛ keyi nwaa.

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛla lɛni na bédie keyi líduo bukeye kemmo. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na básu banii, “Awɔ ɔni mɔɔlɛɛ ni, gyinya na ata alɛ bekpine akɔ, na Kristo ɔdubukeye uwi-ɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: These are evil times, so make every minute count.
translation_verse: Bɛda bina lɛlɔ kaduɛ, ɔsika likyulikpi ala bɔbla bɔ́ƒɔ uwi ɔni kemmo bɔkya mɛni.

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bitabla lɛlɔ aani bekyuli badɔlɔdi. Mmomu bɛwia na bɛti ala ani geen na Blɔti ɔɔyɔ́ ka bɛbla.

english_verse: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
translation_verse: Bitekpi ntɛ, ɔsika ɔmɛni mɔɔyá na bɛɛyii udu. Mmomu Katɔti Kɔyu kɔƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart.
translation_verse: Na biti Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo lɛnu etemila bɛtɛmiku lɛlɔ, na bidie bɔƒɔtaadi lɛnu ku lɛnu lɛni ndanku Katɔti Kɔyu ala. Bɛtu lɛnu ku agyala biti bimwi Blɔti na bina kayi kemmo.

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: Na bɛgya Katɔti ɔni ndi bula Ɔti enu na Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛnyi kemmo uwi biala na lɛla biala ɔsu. Ɔgya Ku Ule Belie Aani Baƒɔtaadine Kalɛ

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Amii beleku biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bite bina bagya aani kalɛ na biiboku lɛlɔ kalɔ teete Blɔti.

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: Ɔsika uleku ɔgya ɔdi lili ute ulekudi aani kalɛ na Kristo ɔdi lili ute baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛni ndi nwuna ɔlɔna. Anwuɔsu na úti lɛlɔ ɔ́kpa na bana lili kalɛ na bakɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na baƒɔtaadine beeboku lɛlɔ kalɔ teete Kristo ni, lɛni kani na ɔlɛka beleku lɛnɔ beteeboku lɛlɔ kalɔ teete bana bagya na lɛla biala kemmo.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Bagya, amii lɛnɔ bɛyɔ bina beleku aani kalɛ kani na Kristo ɔ́yɔ baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ ɔsu na úti lɛlɔ ɔ́kpa na bana lili.

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla ɔmɛni kalɛ na ɔbla nwuna ɔyɔne ɔmmɔ kedee. Na etemila ani na ɔ́su-nwu ɔsu ni, ɔ́bla-nwu sɛɛn aani kalɛ na beeti ntu taakpila ukyuli.

english_verse: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́klibi anwu ɔni ndi nwuna baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa kedee lɛni muukeye na bɔƒiɔ bɔdi buuubo-ni lɛlɔ, ɔsika likpidi iye bɔsɔ bɔdi bɔɔɔma-ni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na ɔlɛka bagya bayɔ bana beleku aani kalɛ na baayɔ́ ama alati bana ɔlɔna. Na ɔnana ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ulekudi ni, ɔɔyɔ́ anwu ɔlati ɔlɔna.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli ɔdi uuubo ɔni na uukisi nwuna ɔlɔna. Mmomu ni, ɔɔnu-nwu lɛlɔ na ɔɔbla-nwu kaduɛ, aani kalɛ na Kristo ɔɔbla teete nwuna baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bɔdi nwuna lɛlɔ kakɛ kadi.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔsu ɔnii, “Ɔmɛni ɔsu na ɔnana ɔdubɔmami ɔti ku uni lɛlɔ na uti lɛlɔ utámana ulekudi na bana inyɔ badubɔbla ɔlɔna unwi.”

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: Litemi lɛmɛni lɛdi abɛla ebendi. Na mɔɔsu-mii nnii etemila ammɔ ese ete Kristo ku baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, akɛnku amii lɛnɔ lɛlɔ. Anwu ndi ka ɔlɛka ɔgya biala ɔyɔ ulekudi aani nwuna lɛlɔ, na uleku biala lɛnɔ ɔbu ɔgyani.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Amii bebi bɛbu bina bawɔne na Kristo ulu lɛlɔ, ɔsika ɔmɛni ndi lɛla lɛbuni lɛni na ɔlɛka bɛbla.

english_verse: and you will have a long and happy life.”
translation_verse: Búsie anumi bɔnii, “Kalɛ na keyi kayɔku-ɔ na elie ngba gyɔlɔɔ na kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni.”

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
translation_verse: Na amii bawɔne lɛnɔ ni, bitabla ala ani makya bina bebi kɔnyi. Mmomu bɛtumini-ma na bɛlɛ-ma bɛsiaku bɔƒɔtaadi ulu lɛlɔ. Kabla Bablane Belieku Bana Benwoti Kaduɛ

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: Amii bani mɔɔbla ukyuli bamba kabla ni, biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na binu bina benwoti litemi ku ɔbu ɔsiku kayi ƒui aani kalɛ na bɛdubunu Kristo litemi.

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Ka bɛdi Kristo kabla bablane ɔsu ni, biti bina ɔyikun ƒui bɛbla lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔɔwia. Na ɔɔɔdi bana anumi na ɔdi ka bɛbla lɛla lɛdi biti bɛtina bekyuli kalɛ na bemwi-mii.

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: Bɛbla bina kabla kaduɛ aani si Katɔti na bɛɛbla bite na ɔɔɔdi bekyuli.

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔbla ukyuli bamba kabla iye ɔɔbla anwu ɔlati kabla ni, ɔlɛka ɔbla-ka kaduɛ. Ɔsika ɔdubɔƒɔ lɛyuƒɔla ɔsiku Blɔti kudɔ.

english_verse: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
translation_verse: Na amii benwoti lɛnɔ ni, bɛbla lɛni kani bite bekyuli bani mɔɔbla-mii kabla. Bitakya-ma liƒu, ɔsika bɛgyi ka amii ku-ma ƒui lɛnɔ bibo Unwoti unwi na katɔ ɔni naaanu bekyuli anumi taatɛ litemi. Biti Kɔyu Kemmo Ekpola Bɛda

english_verse: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
translation_verse: Na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, bɛya na Katɔti ɔyikun ɔkya-mii ɔkplu.

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Biti Katɔti ala ani ƒui na úte-mii bɛkya aani ukpone adala ani mɔɔgyumana-nwu na bɛkana binye bitile ukisine ɔmmɔ kakwɛ kekpidi biala.

english_verse: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔɔɔdi abu ku bekyuli muukpó. Mmomu abu ku bayikune ku kenyekɔ biala ku kayawi kamɛni lɛdisa ku kayaa bayikune bekpidi ƒui muukpó.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bɛkya Katɔti adala ani mɔɔgyumana lɛlɔ mmɔ ƒui, kalɛ na bɛkana na binye kpakplaa na limeyi lɛni na likpidi lɛdi lɛdubɔsiaku-mii lɛlɔ. Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, binye kpakplaa uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu binye kagyumana na biti Katɔti litemi geen binwini aani kabuli bɛda kavobi, na biti lɛlɔ bɔbla siin binwini aani lɛgyumanala bɛbala kayi.

english_verse: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
translation_verse: Na binye kagyumana na biti keyi buɛɛ litemi buni lɛmmɔ bɔsu binwini aani agbanvuo bɛkya lɛgba.

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama ni, biti bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɛda kɔnu aani bina lɛgyumanala. Ɔsika amu ndubo-mii bɔgyumana si ukisine ɔmmɔ ɔɔtu nwuna ɔkɔ ala taalɛ-mii aani kɔtaminta kɔni mɔɔda ogya.

english_verse: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
translation_verse: Na biti bina ngba bɔƒɔ bibi lili aani kekpo kabwa na biti Katɔti litemi lɛni nse aani kewii kani na Katɔti Kɔyu kuute-mii bɛda kɔnu kɔkladi.

english_verse: Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔkya-mii lɛlɔ kemmo na bitaakpali katɔ uwi biala teevele Katɔti kebunku aani kalɛ na Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kɔ́tina-mii. Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, binye kagyumana na enu ataƒɛ-mii. Na bitaakpali katɔ teete Katɔti bekyuli ƒui lili.

english_verse: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
translation_verse: Bivele na ami lɛnɔ lili na Katɔti ɔya na kenye kada-mi kalɛ na makana menye kpakplaa na medie litemi lɛmmɔ abɛla matina bekyuli na ɔyikun kemmo.

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Na litemi lɛmmɔ ɔtalane na ndi, ina ka nkya kɔgba kemmo mɛni. Bivele na mina lili na lɛsu litemi lɛmmɔ kalɛ na ɔ́manku ku kayi buse! Bɔɔkada-mii

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Banwa, Unwoti Katɔti ku Blɔti Yesu Kristo ute-mii keyi buɛɛ ku bɔyɔ ku bɔƒɔtaadi.

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Katɔti lɛƒɔndia lɛsiaku bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔyɔ́ Blɔti Yesu Kristo ku kayi ƒui.

english_verse: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
translation_verse: Ami, Paulo ku Timoteo bani ndi Kristo Yesu kabla bablane ni, abu nénweni ɔku ɔmɛni. Na búti buute amii Kristo Yesu badi ƒui ku baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa batɔnkune ku bebunkune bani ƒui nkya Ƒilipi.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: Na buuvele bɔnii lɛƒɔndia ku keyi buɛɛ kani nási Katɔti ɔni ndi bula Ɔti ku Blɔti Yesu Kristo kudɔ kasiaku-mii. Paulo Ɔ́kpali Katɔ Úte Baƒɔtaadine Bani Nkya Ƒilipi

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: Uwi biala na bina kasusu kébo-mi lili ni, mɔɔgyá Katɔti enu na bina lili.

english_verse: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
translation_verse: Na uwi biala na mɔɔkpali katɔ na bina lili ni, mɔɔkpali ku lɛlɔyɔ

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: ɔ́si kalɛ na bíbunku-mi ɔ́si limeyi lideedi lɛni na líti litemi buni lɛmmɔ líboku-mii úbedu ɔƒɛni ɔsu.

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di ka Katɔti ɔni nése kabla kabuni kamɛni kalɔ na bina akɔ ni, ɔdubɔnu ka kabla kamɛni katáwɔlɔ na uwi ɔni na Kristo Yesu wasɔ webo.

english_verse: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
translation_verse: Bina ala akya-mi kayi kemmo geen uwi biala na ɔdi ulu lɛlɔ lɛnɔ ka use-mi lɛni. Ɔsika kuƒi kɔni na Katɔti úte-mi na ɔ́ya lɛ́kɛ nwuna litela ni, amii lɛnɔ bɛ́kɛ-nwu lɛlɔ kɔsia na uwi ɔni na ntɛ ɔtɔ mɛni ku uwi ɔni na mbo bɔnwuna ka likpo lite litemi lɛmmɔ na lidie-ni kenye lite bekyuli na baƒɔ-ni kpakplaa.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔlati nnye-mi kama ka litemi geen na mɔɔsu nnii bina ala akya-mi kayi kemmo geen aani kalɛ kani na Yesu Kristo ɔɔyɔ́-mii kalɛ.

english_verse: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand
translation_verse: Muuvele Katɔti nnii ɔya na bina bɔyɔ bɔni na bibo butaakɔ katɔ teebu na bɛkɛ lɛlati lɛni na biti bɛnu ala kemmo kaduɛ,

english_verse: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
translation_verse: kalɛ na bidie lɛla lɛni ndia ntulo. Mmɔ na bɛdubudie lɛlɔ na ala ani muusé lɛlɔ ƒui kudɔ na baládu-mii kɔtɔ na uwi ɔni kemmo na Kristo wasɔ webo.

english_verse: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
translation_verse: Na bɛnwu ebi ani mɔɔtina ka bise siin na bina ngba bulie kemmo ka bɛ́ƒɔ Blɔti Yesu Kristo bɛ́di ɔsu, na biti ɔbu ku bumwi bite Katɔti. Ukyuli Ɔni Mɔɔbla Yesu Kabla Mbo Ngba

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Banwa, mɔɔyɔ́ ka lɛ́su-mii ka ala ani nálɛku-mi ni, ébunku na litemi buni lɛmmɔ lísie anumi líbu.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi sɔsɔ ka badi baasu Kristo litemi lɛmmɔ ɔsika beekpó kogyulo na baawia lɛnyi ɔsu. Nsu badi ama baasu-ni taasiku kasusu kabuni kemmo.

english_verse: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
translation_verse: Na bani mɔɔsu-ni ku kasusu kabuni mmɔ ni, baasu-ni ku bɔyɔ. Ɔsika bagyi ka Katɔti néti kabla kamɛni ɔ́kya-mi lɛkɔkɔ ka likpo na lɛgyumana litemi buni lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: Nsu badi balásu Kristo litemi lɛmmɔ taasiku bana kayi kemmo ƒui, mmomu ama alati bana lɛkɛ ɔsu. Na baakali ka baya na mina lɛbibo litaakɔ katɔ teebu ɔni na ntɛ aban ɔtɔ mɛni.

english_verse: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
translation_verse: Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui ɔɔɔda! Lɛla lɛni kani mɔɔda-mi kubiti ndi ka Kristo lɛlɔ litemi na baasu. Na si baasu-ni taasiku kasusu kabuni iye kekpidi kemmo ni, ami lɛlɔ lɛdubo-mi butaayɔ.

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ngyi ka ɔkɛnku bina katɔ bɔkpali na mina lili ku Katɔti Kɔyu kebunku kani nási Yesu Kristo kudɔ ɔsu ni, ndubɔkɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni mɔɔwia na mina anu lɛnɔ asia kpakplaa ndi ka kabla kani mɔɔbla mɛni ni, kɔƒa kulekpo-mi. Mmomu na uwi biala kemmo ku ɔƒɛni muedi ni, lɛkya ɔkplu na liti bumwi lite Kristo na mina ngba bulie ƒui kemmo. Si ina nli ngba iye líkpi.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Na bi ndi ngba? Na mina kakɛ ni, anwu ndi si eli aabla kabla teete Kristo. Na kukpi ndububoku kɔsia utulo.

english_verse: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
translation_verse: Na si bani nsie anumi na lɛsɔ lɛkya ngba bɔmɛni kemmo ni, ndubɔkana na lɛbla ala abuni libu. Nsu ɔmani na ɔlɛka lidie? Naaati!

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: Mina kasusu kéƒu na ala akpa anyɔ amɛni lɛlɔ. Ndubɔyɔ si lɛ́tɔlɔ na lísie nkya Kristo kudɔ. Nka ɔmɛni ɔdia-mi utulo.

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: Nsu ngyi ka ndubulie kayawi kamɛni kemmo ku-mii na liti libunku bina anumi busie na bɛkɛ kubiti na bina bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo.

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na si nkya-mii kudɔ ni, lɛlɔyɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-mii na Kristo kemmo geen ɔkɛnku ami ɔsu.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni lɛla lɛni ntulo ndi ka bina ngba bulie bɔbla aani kalɛ na litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛɛtina ɔsika ɔmɛni na Kristo ɔɔwia. Na si líbo ḿbanu-mii iye línu-mii kɔku ni, ndubunu ka binye kpakplaa na kɔyu kemmo biikpó ku kasusu kenwi na bina bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo teete litemi buni lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: Bitayia bina bekisine. Mmomu binye kpakplaa uwi biala kemmo. Na ɔmɛni ndubɔtina-ma ka Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ-mii na ɔyila-ma udu. Ɔsika Katɔti muukpó bina kekpo teete-mii na anwu mɔɔyá na bɛɛdi kekpo kammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: Na úte-mii kuƒi ka bimwi Kristo, na ɔɔɔdi ka bɛƒɔ-nwu bɛdi ɔsu kani na ɔ́sa. Mmomu ɔdi ka amii lɛnɔ bibo abi na anwu ɔsu.

english_verse: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_verse: Kekpo kani nnye muukpó mɛni ni, amii lɛnɔ bibunku-mi. Kekpo kamɛni kani na bɛ́nu ka lɛ́kya ńteekpo. Na aani kalɛ na bínu ni, aka kani na mmu nnye muukpó.

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: Na si use lɛni sɔsɔ ni, na mɔɔkya-mii ogya ka bɛya na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mi lɛwɔlɔ, na biti bɛtina ka biiti kasusu kenwi na bɛɛyɔ́ lɛlɔ na bɛdi benwi na kɔyu ku kasusu kemmo.

english_verse: Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves.
translation_verse: Bitabla lɛla lɛdi bitasiaku amii lɛti lɛkɛ lɛlɔ iye bɛbla na biti bɛtina lɛlɔ. Mmomu biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bite lɛlɔ. Na uwi biala ni, ɔdi biala utaabu ɔkpanadi teetulo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Care about them as much as you care about yourselves
translation_verse: Na bɛwia bina bakpana bɔdia na ɔɔɔdi awɔ kani ɔdi.

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: Bina kasusu ɔlɛka kabla kenwi ku Kristo Yesu kadi.

english_verse: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
translation_verse: Anwu nkɛnku Katɔti ukyuli udu uwi biala kemmo. Nsu útata útenye ɔnii nwuna udu ɔmmɔ ute-nwu kuƒi kɔdi.

english_verse: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
translation_verse: Mmomu ɔ́bla lɛlɔ aani si ɔɔɔdi lɛla biala. Ɔ́bla lɛlɔ aani ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla ukyuli bamba kabla. Ɔsika úbo aani ukyuli ɔyawine kalɛ.

english_verse: Christ was humble. He obeyed God and even died on a cross.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, úboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na únu Katɔti litemi utédu ka úkpi ugyii lɛlɔ kukpi muedi.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔ́talaku-nwu katɔ na úte-nwu kenyekɔ kenengudi ƒui. Na úte-nwu lɛnyi lɛni ntulo na anyi ƒui akɔ.

english_verse: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
translation_verse: Na si bálɔ Yesu lɛnyi ni, ɔlɛka ɔdi biala ɔlɛ akɔnkɔ kalɔ, ama bani nkya katɔ ku kayawi ku kalɔ kemmo ƒui!

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔdubudie kenye ɔnii Yesu Kristo ndi Blɔti. Na beti bumwi bete Unwoti Katɔti. Bikeye Aani Ayabi Na Kayawi Mɛni

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, mina bakpana bayɔne, aani kalɛ na bɛɛdi mina litemi lɛlɔ si nkya-mii kudɔ ni, lɛni kani na ɔdi ka bɛdi-nya lɛlɔ bitulo si uwi ɔni na liiibo-mii kudɔ lɛnɔ. Bise anumi na bitaabla ala ani mɔɔtina ka Yesu ɔ́ƒɔ-mii ngba, na biti ɔbu geen bite Katɔti.

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti ɔkya-mii akɔ ɔɔbla kabla na bina akɔ uwi biala kalɛ na ɔbla-mii na bɛkana na bɛdi ala ani na ɔ́su-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bɛdubɔlɛ kɔtɔ bɔdu biala kemmo na bɛbla sɛɛn aani Katɔti bebi bani na likpidi liiibo-ma lɛlɔ. Na ka bilieku bekyuli bekpidi bani nkya kayawi kani nébie mɛni kemmo ɔsu ni, bikeye na bana akɔ aani kalɛ na ayabi eekeye na kayaa.

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: Na bɛda ngba litemi lɛmmɔ kaduɛ. Na si bɛ́kana na bɛ́bla ɔmɛni ni, ndubɔkɛ kenyekɔ na lɛkun lɛmɛnɛ na limeyi lɛni lɛlɔ na Yesu wada walɛ. Ɔsika ɔdubɔtina ka ńtekeli usi ɔmmɔ keeke iye ńtebo abi ńtewiakun.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Nsu si ina mina ubugya na bada beewi kalɔ aani kalɛ baabla akpala na bina lili kalɛ na bina bɔƒɔtaadi busie anumi ni, lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ-mi na kubiti kɔda-mi na bina ƒui ɔsu.

english_verse: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na ɔdi ka lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii na bɛya na ebiti ada ami ku-mii ƒui. Ɔmɛni Nkɛnku Timoteo Ku Epaƒrodito Lɛlɔ

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Si Katɔti ɔ́tunaku-mi ni, uwi klukui kama ndubɔtala Timoteo lɛkya-mii, kalɛ na lɛkɛ ɔlɔkplu si línu bina lɛlɔ lɛla lɛdi lɛsiku-nwu kudɔ.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: Liiibo ukyuli ɔdi liiitulo anwu ɔni na ami ku-nwu kasusu kaabla kenwi. Ɔsika kalɛ na use-mi na bina lɛlɔ ni, lɛni kani na ɔɔbla-nwu.

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli bamba biala ni, anwu ɔlati bɔdia lɛlɔ na nwuna kasusu kasia na kaaakɛnku Yesu Kristo ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Nsu Timoteo anwu ni, amii alati bɛgyi kalɛ na nwuna udu buni ɔmmɔ use. Ɔsika aani kalɛ na ubi ku ɔti baabla kabla taasala ni, lɛni geen na úbunku-mi na litemi buni lɛmmɔ bɔsu kemmo.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu mbo lɛnunsia ka ndubɔtala-nwu lɛkya-mii kɔnakunwi si lɛ́nu kalɛ na ala aavínku-mi.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di na Blɔti lɛnyi kemmo ka ni, uwi uletu ami lɛnɔ ndububo-mii kudɔ.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: Nsu lɛ́nu ka ɔlɛka lɛtala Epaƒrodito na ubo-mii kudɔ. Ɔdi mina ɔnwani ɔni nényeku-mi aani ukpone na bɔ́bla Katɔti kabla. Na ɔdi bina ukyuli ɔni na bɛ́tala ka ubo ubanu-mi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: Anwu lɛnɔ unye kpakplaa ka ɔnu-mii. Na ɔdi lɛla lɛni muukpóku-nwu geen ɔsika ɔ́ti ka bínu ka úbeƒi.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ úbeƒi geen na úbu blii suɛ nka úkpi. Nsu Katɔti ɔ́nu-nwu kɔnyana. Na ɔɔɔdi anwu lɛti na ɔ́nu kɔnyana, mmomu ami lɛnɔ. Si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, nka mina lɛlɔ lɛdubɔkywi kaƒɔ geen.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na mɔɔwia geen ka lidie-nwu ulu kalɛ na si bɛ́nu-nwu ni, na kubiti kɔsɔ kɔda-mii. Na ami lɛnɔ mina kɔnyana buwulo bubo kalɔ.

english_verse: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bigyingya enu na bɛƒɔ-nwu ku kubiti na Blɔti lɛnyi kemmo. Na biti ɔbu bite bekyuli bani ƒui nse aani kalɛ na use.

english_verse: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_verse: Ɔsika úti nwuna ngba ɔ́kpa na úbu blii suɛ nka úkpi ɔ́si Kristo kabla ɔsu. Na úte-mi kebunku kani amii alati bítakana-mi bute.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: Ukplodi ni, mina banwa, bɛya na lɛlɔ litaayɔ-mii na Blɔti kemmo. Lɛɛɛdaku-ni si nsɔ mɔɔsia kama teenweni-mii ala ani na líinweni ḿbavi. Na si ina lɛ́bla lɛni muedi ni, ɔdi bina kebunku.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Bɛnu ala ekpidi bablane bani mɔɔbla ala aani bakpɛwe bebuo bekpine mmɔ bɛti. Badi bekyuli bani nnye-mii lɛlɔ ka ɔlɛka bikulo bina ago.

english_verse: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
translation_verse: Abu ndi bekyuli bani mmomu nékulo ago, ɔsika buumwi Katɔti ɔkɛnku nwuna Kɔyu lɛlɔ na bɔɔkɛ́ ebiti ka abu ku Kristo Yesu bɔ́bla unwi ɔsu. Na búteti lɛlɔ bútasia ɔlɔna lɛlɔ ɔdi ala bɔbla lɛlɔ.

english_verse: although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else.
translation_verse: Na si ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔkali ka ɔkana uti lɛlɔ ɔsia ɔlɔna lɛlɔ ɔdi ablala lɛlɔ ni, na nka ami mbo kuƒi kɔmmɔ ntulo.
