english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na lɛ́kɛ Kwasida unwi ka báwɔ-mi kani na békulo-mi lego. Na ami lɛnɔ ndi Israelni. Na lɛ́si Benyamin kaba kemmo. Na mina bati kuuku badi Hebriƒuɔ geen. Na si Mose ɔda bubo lɛti pɛ lɛlɔ bɔdi ɔsu ni, na nka Ƒarisini na ndi.

english_verse: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
translation_verse: Na nnye ɔda bubo bɔmɛni lɛlɔ kaduɛ. Na ɔkɛnku ɔmɛni ɔsu líkpoku Kristo baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ. Na si banii ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛti pɛ lɛlɔ bɔdi na baanu ukyuli ɔni nse siin ni, na nka likpidi lɛdi liiibo-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔni na nka ɔlɛka lɛnu ala ammɔ aani kɔsia kɔdi ni, ɔƒɛni mɔɔnu-nya aani ala keeke ɔ́si Kristo ɔsu.

english_verse: Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi ɔmmɔ lɛti. Mɔɔnu lɛla biala aani lɛla keeke si líti mɔɔkɔ́ku lɛla lɛni náƒɔ kuye geen mɛni, na ani ndi ka lɛ́ti Kristo Yesu ɔni ndi mina Ɔti. Na anwuɔsu ni, líbo lɛla biala líwiakun. Na lɛ́nu-nya aani kebu alakpi kalɛ na ami ku Kristo bɔbla unwi.

english_verse: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔwia ka liti mina lɛlɔ ƒui lite-nwu. Ɔmɛni ɔdubɔtina ka mina siin bɔbla útasi ami ɔlati kudɔ aani bɔni udu na bekyuli baakali ka baakɛ́ ɔkɛnku ɔda bubo lɛlɔ bɔdi kemmo, mmomu bɔkɛnku Kristo bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo. Na siin bɔbla bɔmɛni nási Katɔti kudɔ na bɔdanku bɔƒɔtaadi.

english_verse: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni kani na mɔɔwia ndi ka lɛti Kristo. Na ɔyikun ɔni náya na ɔ́ta ɔ́lɛ bekpine akɔ ɔkya-mi lɛlɔ kemmo. Na liboku-nwu abi na lɛblaku-nwu unwi na nwuna kukpi kemmo.

english_verse: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
translation_verse: Na ntaasia anu ka ami lɛnɔ mata malɛ kekpine na ulu ɔmmɔ kani lɛlɔ. Paulo Ɔ́su Kalɛ Wabla Na Wakɛ Lɛyuƒɔla

english_verse: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi bɔsu na nda nnii lɛ́ɛdi lɛlɔ iye ami lɛ́ɛbla sɛɛn lɛ́wɔlɔ. Mmomu nnye kpakplaa ka lɛkɛ lɛyuƒɔla lɛni na Kristo Yesu ubo ute-mi. Na ani ndi ka ɔya na línwini nwuna ɔdi.

english_verse: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.
translation_verse: Banwa, ɔɔɔdi bɔkɛ na lɛ́ɛkɛ lɛyuƒɔla lɛmmɔ. Mmomu lɛla linwi lɛni na mɔɔbla ndi ka lɛyiƒala ala ani na lɛ́bla lɛ́vi. Na lɛkya ɔkplu na likpo ntédu kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu muukeli usi na likulo kabuli kalɛ na lɛkɛ lɛyuƒɔla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-mi ka libo mbaƒɔ na katɔ na Kristo Yesu ɔsu.

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: Na abu bani ƒui nésie anumi na bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo ni, ɔlɛka bɔkɛ kasusu kamɛni. Nsu si badi bebo kasusu kabambadi ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔya na ɔmɛni ɔbla-mii nwaa.

english_verse: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni námanku ndi ka bɛya na bula ngba bulie bɔ́manku kesii kani na búusie anumi búbedu.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: Banwa, bisie anumi na bitaatɛya mina udu, na bɛtɛya udu ɔbuni bɛsiaku bani nli ngba bɔbuni bɔni na búlie bɔtina-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
translation_verse: Lɛ́ɛsu-mii kɔlɛ kɔlɛ ḿbavi, na ɔƒɛni nsɔ mɔɔsu-mii ku keku buwulo ka bekyuli pii bakya-mii akɔ ɔni na bana ngba bulie bɔ́ya na bénwini bekisine béte Kristo kukpi kɔni na úkpi na ugyii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔwɔlɔku-ma na bakywi na lɛgyavonku kemmo. Ɔsika bana kaƒɔ kani na beemwi. Na baatina lɛlɔ na ala ani na nka ɔlɛka ekpo-ma kɔƒa lɛlɔ. Na kayawi ala lɛlɔ kasusu kani na beeti.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Nsu abu ni, bula ɔma ndi Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma. Na bunye bɔgya bula Ɔƒɔne ɔni ndi Blɔti Yesu Kristo.

english_verse: has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔvumana bula kayawi ɔlɔna kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ ɔmɛni na ɔbla-nwu aani nwuna ɔlɔna ɔni muukeye mmɔ kalɛ ɔkɛnku ɔyikun ɔni na ubo na ɔɔyá na lɛla biala liiboku lɛlɔ kalɔ teete-nwu kenye.

english_verse: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, mina banwa bayɔne ɔni na naaanu-mii ni, kɔyɔ kúwi-mi! Bɛɛkya-mi kubiti geen na mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ na amii ɔsu. Banwa bayɔne geen, lɛni na ɔdi ka binye kpakplaa na Kristo kemmo.

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Muuvele Euodia ku Sinteke lɛnɔ ka benu lɛlɔ kalɔ na basɔ belie aani banwa belekubi na Blɔti kemmo.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: Na amii lɛnɔ aani mina kabla bablane bakpana ni, mɔɔyɔ́ ka bibunku beleku bamɛni. Ɔsika báblaku-mi kabla na bɔ́kana na búgyingya litemi buni lɛmmɔ. Bɔ́bla ala amɛni ku Klement lɛnɔ ku banwa kabla bablane bakladi bani anyi na bénweni bakya Katɔti Ngba Ɔku kemmo.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-mii nnii bɛya na lɛlɔ litaayɔ-mii na Blɔti kemmo. Na nsɔ mɔɔsia kama nnii bɛya na lɛlɔ litaayɔ-mii.

english_verse: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
translation_verse: Bɛya na ukyuli biala ɔnu ɔti kalɛ na bɛda lɛlɔ buɛɛ. Ɔsika Blɔti bɔsɔ bubo bɔmmɔ búude.

english_verse: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
translation_verse: Ɔdi biala utekpoku lɛlɔ na lɛla biala lɛlɔ, mmomu bitaakpali Katɔti uwi biala kemmo, na bitaasu-nwu ala ani bɛɛwia. Na si bɛɛkpali-nwu ni, na bitaagya-nwu enu.

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔni muute keyi buɛɛ bɔni ntulo ɔyawine kalɔ bunu ɔdubɔgyumana bina kayi ku kasusu ƒui ɔni na biliku Kristo Yesu.

english_verse: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Na ukplodi ni, banwa, biti bina kasusu bɛsia ala ani ndi etemila geen lɛlɔ ku ala ani mbo ɔbu ku ala ani nse siin ku ala ani nse sɛɛn ku ala ani mɔɔdia bɔnu ku ala ani náƒɔ lɛnyi ku ala ani ndia geen ku ala ani námanku bumwi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Biti mina ɔbladu ku mina etemila ani ƒui na bínu na bɛ́tɛya bɛsiku-mi kudɔ bɛkya kabla bɔbla kemmo. Na Katɔti ɔni muute keyi buɛɛ ni, ɔdubulieku-mii. Lɛ́tɛya Kalɛ Na Lɛla Biala Na Lɛ́kɛ Liduku-mi

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi geen na Blɔti kemmo ka bɛ́sɔ bɛ́bla kasusu kawɔdi na mina lɛlɔ bɔnu lɛlɔ. Ɔɔɔdi ɔni na bilánu-mi lɛlɔ ɔsu. Mmomu kuƒi nátatɛ ka bɛbla lɛni bite-mi.

english_verse: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi bɔsu na mɔɔsu nnii mɔɔyaki lɛla lɛdi, mmomu ka lɛ́tɛya kalɛ na lɛla biala na lɛ́kɛ liduku-mi ɔsu.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: Na ngyi kalɛ na lɛwaba ku lɛlakɛ lise na lɛla biala kemmo. Na lɛ́tɛya lɛbɛla lɛni mɔɔtina-mi kalɛ na lɛti lɛlɔ bɔda na kesii biala ku uwi biala kemmo. Na kɔka kemmo o-o, bumo o-o, lɛkɛ o-o, iye ayaki kemmo o-o ni, nnye nte ana ƒui.

english_verse: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
translation_verse: Mɔɔkana na mɔɔbla lɛla biala ɔkɛnku Kristo ɔyikun ɔni na úte-mi ɔsu.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Nsu bɛ́bla-nwu kaduɛ ka bíbunku-mi na mina lɛbibo kemmo.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Na amii Ƒilipiƒuɔ ni, amii alati bɛgyi geen ka uwi ɔni na lɛ́tɔlɔ Makedonia na líse kalɔ mɔɔkɔ́ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa ni, amii kani ndi baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛni néte-mi kebunku na lɛla lɛni na lɛ́bla líte-mii kenye.

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: Na ɔni lɛ́kya Tesalonika muedi ni, ka mɔɔwia kebunku ni, bíbunku-mi bítulo kunwi.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi etela na mɔɔwia lite lɛlɔ, mmomu lɛla lɛni mete-mii kɔsia na katɔ na mɔɔsia anu.

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Na bɛ́ƒɔ-mi kabla kayu ƒui. Na kayu kammɔ kétulo kalɛ na ɔ́manku muedi. Etela ani ƒui bíti bímene Epaƒrodito mɛni ni, émo-mi! Etela ammɔ ese aani akpala ƒɛƒɛɛ ani béti bákpa béte Katɔti, na áyɔ-nwu kaƒɔ, na aada-nwu kubiti.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: Na mina Katɔti ɔdubute-mii etela ani ƒui bɛɛwia ɔkɛnku Kristo Yesu lɛkɛ ku bukeye kemmo.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Bɛya bumwi Bula Ɔti Katɔti ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ƒui. Ɔsia lɛni. Bɔkada

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Mɔɔkya Katɔti bebi bani ndi Kristo Yesu badi ƒui kenye o-o! Na banwa bani nkya-mi kudɔ mɛni lɛnɔ begyele-mii o-o!

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Katɔti bekyuli bani ƒui nkya mɛni beegyele-mii. Ɔni ntulo ndi bekyuli bani nkya Kaesare kaduli. Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Ami Paulo ɔni nkɛnku Katɔti lɛƒɔyɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu na ndi Yesu Kristo ɔtalane ni, ami ku bula ɔnwa Timoteo muunweni ɔku ɔmɛni.

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: Na búti buute amii, bula banwa kedee, bani lɛnɔ náƒɔ Kristo bɛ́di geen na bɛkya Kolose. Buuvele Katɔti bɔnii nwuna lɛƒɔndia ku keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-mii. Bɔɔgyá Katɔti Enu

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Uwi biala si bɔɔkpali katɔ ni, bɔɔgyá Katɔti ɔni ndi Blɔti Yesu Kristo Ɔti enu na bina lili.

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: Ɔsika búnu kalɛ na bɛda bina bɔƒɔtaadi na Yesu Kristo kemmo ku kalɛ na bɛɛyɔ́ bina banwa baƒɔtaadine ƒui.

english_verse: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na básu-mii litemi geen lɛni ndi litemi buni lɛmmɔ kudeedi ni, bínu ala abuni ani nse nte-mii na katɔ. Na ka bɛsia-nya anu ɔsu ni, bina bɔƒɔtaadi ku bina bɔyɔ bunye ala ani bɛsia anu mɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: Litemi buni lɛmɛni ala abuni amu aalɛ́ku bekyuli na liigyingya na kayawi ekpo ƒui aani kalɛ na ɔ́lɛku-mii uwi ɔni na bínu Katɔti kɔnyana bɔnu litemi geen lɛmmɔ kudeedi, na bɛ́nu bɛ́ti kalɛ na Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́-mii.

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: Bula ɔnwa Epaƒra ɔni náƒɔ-bu kuye na anwu lɛnɔ ɔdi kabla ɔblane geen ute Kristo na bula kabla kamɛni kemmo nábasu-mii Katɔti kɔnyana bɔnu litemi lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
translation_verse: Ɔ́su-bu kalɛ na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ya na bibo bɔyɔ bite bina baƒɔtaadine bakpana.

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔ́si uwi ɔni na búnu-mii kɔku ni, bútada Katɔti bɔkpali na bina lili bútaya. Na buuvele Katɔti bɔnii ubimi bina kasusu kemmo na ɔya na bɛti nwuna lɛyɔla. Na nwuna Kɔyu kute-mii lɛnunda ku ala kalɔ bunu kalɛ na bɛti ala ani na ɔɔyɔ́ ka bɛbla.

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na bɛti bina lɛlɔ bɔda na bilie ngba bɔni na Blɔti ɔɔwia. Na bina ngba bulie ɔbladu biala ɔbla ɔbuni. Na ɔdubo-mii bubunku na bitaati Katɔti teebu.

english_verse: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
translation_verse: Muuvele-nwu nnii ɔya na nwuna ɔyikun ɔni nási nwuna bukeye kemmo ɔƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui kalɛ na bɛkana bunye kpakplaa na ala ani muukpóku-mii kenye ku kayi buɛɛ. Bɛgya Katɔti enu ku lɛlɔyɔ, ɔsika anwu náya na bínwini ala badine na Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma kesii kani na muukeye.

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: Na anwu náda-bu údie ukisine ɔmmɔ enu kemmo na kasuudikɔ mmɔ, na úti-bu útákya Ubidi ɔni na ɔɔyɔ́ geen mmɔ lɛga bɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: Kristo ukyuli udu ɔni na bɔɔnu muudie Katɔti ɔni ukyuli udu na bulánu taatina. Na anwu ndi Katɔti Ubi udeedi ɔni mɔɔdi nwuna ala ani na údie ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku anwu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na Katɔti údie ala ani ƒui nkya katɔ ku kalɔ kamɛni kemmo, ala ani na bɔɔnu ku ani na bulánu aani lɛgadi ku bagadine ku bayikune ku kenyekɔ biala ƒui lɛlɔ. Ɔkɛnku ubi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na údie ala ƒui, kalɛ na lɛla biala lɛbu Kristo ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
translation_verse: Kristo ɔ́kya asa na Katɔti údie ala ƒui. Na ɔkɛnku-nwu lɛlɔ na ala ƒui eesié kaduɛ.

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: Anwu ndi lili ute nwuna ɔlɔna ɔni ndi baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ. Na ɔdi lɛkpa lɛmɛni kalɔ kesekɔ. Anwu ndi Katɔti Ubi udeedi ɔni na ɔ́gyila ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ, kalɛ na ɔtɔnku lɛla biala.

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: Na nwuna kemmo na Katɔti ɔ́ya na bekyuli bánu nwuna ukyuli udu ƒui báti.

english_verse: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku Ubidi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔ́klibi anwu ku ala ani nkya katɔ ku kalɔ ƒui ntɛ. Na ɔ́ya na bɔ́kɛ keyi buɛɛ ɔkɛnku Ubidi ɔmmɔ ubugya ɔni néwiakun na ugyii ɔni lɛlɔ na bákana-nwu bámana ɔsu.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔdi nábavi kemmo ni, bínwini kama bɛ́kya Katɔti na bíkisi-nwu na bina kasusu kemmo ɔ́si ala ekpidi ku kasusu kekpidi kani na bɛ́bla ɔsu.

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, Katɔti ɔkɛnku nwuna Ubidi kukpi kɔni na úkpi na ugyii lɛlɔ mmɔ ɔsu ni, ɔ́klibi amii ku-nwu ntɛ kalɛ na bɛkana na binye nwuna anumi aani bekyuli bani nse kedee na bátasɔ na beeebo kɔtu bɔni bɔdi.

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔdi ka binye kpakplaa na bina bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo, na bitaya na enu aƒɛ-mii na bɛyila lɛnunsia lɛni bibo ɔ́si uwi ɔni na bínu litemi buni lɛmmɔ. Na ɔdi litemi buni lɛni lɛsa na lɛ́kɔ líte bayawine ƒui. Na ani ɔsu na ami Paulo ḿbenwini Katɔti kabla ɔblane. Paulo Ɔ́bla Katɔti Kabla Na Baƒɔtaadine Lɛkpa Lɛmmɔ Ɔsu

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, ɔdi-mi kubiti ka muubó abi na amii ɔsu. Na mina abi ani na muubó na ɔlɔna kemmo mɛni ni, ɔ́ya na muubunku na libo abi ani na Kristo ɔlɛka ubo na nwuna baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛni ndi nwuna ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ lili lɛwɔlɔ.

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: Baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ ɔsu na ḿbenwini Katɔti kabla ɔblane na kabla kani na úte-mi kenye, kalɛ na lɛkɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ ƒui lɛsa lite-mii nwaa.

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: Na litemi buni lɛni kalɔ mbo ɔkplu ku bunu mɛni ni, Katɔti úti ɔ́bala kuuku bekyuli. Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, údie-ni keyi ɔ́tina nwuna bekyuli.

english_verse: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
translation_verse: Katɔti bɔyɔ ndi ka bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ ƒui bati lɛla libendi lɛni na ɔ́da úse-bu, na lɛ́ƒɔ kuye geen. Na ani ndi Kristo ɔni nkya-bu kayi kemmo. Na anwu ndi bula lɛnunsia ka abu lɛnɔ bubo kadikɔ na Katɔti bukeye kemmo.

english_verse: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔsu na bɔɔsu Kristo lɛlɔ litemi lɛmmɔ teete ukyuli biala. Na bɔɔlɛ-ma na bɔɔtina-ma ala na lɛnunda ƒui kemmo kalɛ na ɔdi biala ɔda ɔlɛ Katɔti anumi na use siin ɔkɛnku lɛla lɛni na Kristo ɔ́bla úte ɔdi biala kenye.

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na muukpóku lɛlɔ ɔkɛnku Kristo ɔyikun ɔni nkya-mi lɛlɔ kemmo ɔɔbla kabla kamɛni kenye.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyɔ́ ka bɛti kalɛ na muukpóku lɛlɔ na amii ku Laodikeaƒuɔ ku bekyuli bani ami ku-ma bútasa tɔ dii ƒui lili.

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: Mɔɔbla ɔmɛni kalɛ na bakɛ ɔkplu bɔkya na bana kayi kemmo na babla unwi lɛnɔ na bɔyɔ kemmo. Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na bakɛ lɛkɛ libendi lɛni nkɛnku ala kalɔ bunu nwaa. Na badubɔti Katɔti lɛbɛla lɛni ndi Kristo.

english_verse: but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him.
translation_verse: Kristo ɔmmɔ kemmo na Katɔti úti nwuna lɛlati ku lɛnunda ƒui ɔ́bɛla ɔ́kya.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii ɔmɛni kalɛ na ukyuli biala uleti kenyemini etemila adi ulakyaku-mii unyeƒi na ɔtɔlɔ-mii.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: Ina ka liiibo-mii kudɔ na ɔlɔna kemmo ni, nkya-mii kudɔ na kɔyu kemmo. Na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi ka lɛ́nu kalɛ na bɛda lɛlɔ na binye na bina bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo kpakplaa bite Kristo ɔsu. Ukyuli Ngba Ƒui Bɔkya Kristo Kemmo

english_verse: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na bɛ́ƒɔ Yesu Kristo ku bina kayi ƒui aani bina Ɔti ni, bɛblaku-nwu unwi lɛni kani.

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Binye kpakplaa na nwuna kemmo aani kalɛ na kugyii ugyiitu ɔɔnyí kalɔ kemmo. Na bina bɔƒɔtaadi buteesie anumi teebu aani kalɛ na bɔ́tina-mii mmɔ. Na bitaagya Katɔti enu uwi ndi uwi.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Bɛnu kaduɛ kalɛ na ukyuli ɔdi uleti nwuna kayawi lɛnunda lɛni neeebo kɔsia kɔdi ulátɔlɔ-mii. Ɔsika lɛnunda lɛmmɔ ni, lɛsiaku bati kuuku ɔdi bɔbla ku kayawi kamɛni ala bɔtina kama na ɔɔɔdi Kristo kudɔ na ɔ́si.

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔɔyá na bɔɔlɛ́ lili taawɔlɔ ɔkɛnku abu ku Kristo unwi bɔbla ɔsu. Na Kristo ɔmɛni mɔɔdi bayikune ku kenyekɔ biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na bɛ́ƒɔ ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmmɔ ni, ɔ́tina ka amii ku Kristo nékpi na báva-mii. Na amii ku-nwu lɛnɔ náta bɛ́lɛ bekpine akɔ ɔkɛ bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɔni bibo kenye.

english_verse: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdi kemmo ni, bíkpi na kɔyu kemmo ɔ́si bina ekpidi ɔsu ku ka bátabla-mii ekpidi bukulo teedie ɔdi ɔmmɔ ɔsu. Nsu Katɔti ɔ́ya na bɔ́sɔ búnwini búbo bulie ngba ku Kristo ka úti bula ekpidi ƒui ɔ́kyiɛ-bu ɔsu.

english_verse: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
translation_verse: Katɔti úkulo lɛla biala nétile-bu ulu na lɛ́bala-bu na bula ngba bulie ablala kemmo ƒui na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ etemila kenye údie-bu lɛlɔ kede kede. Na úti-nya ɔ́kana ɔ́mana ugyii lɛlɔ ku Kristo.

english_verse: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
translation_verse: Na ugyii ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Kristo ɔ́ƒɔ ɔyikun ɔ́lɛku bayikune ku kenyekɔ biala enu kemmo. Na ɔ́kya-ma kɔƒa na bekyuli anumi ka ɔ́di-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bitaya na ukyuli ɔdi ubo-mii ɔda ɔdi na bina bɔdi ku bɔni lɛlɔ, iye emeyi kedee lɛlɔ, iye abuli awɔdi limeyi bɔdi, iye lɛnwunameyi bɔdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
translation_verse: Ɔsika Kristo ndi kebi kani geen na bɔɔwia! Ɔsika ala ammɔ bene ƒui lɛlɔ bɔdi mɔɔtina ka Kristo ɔdubo úbada ɔlɛ.

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Bitaya na anumi lɛlɔ ukyuli ɔni mɔɔsiaku katɔ batu ɔdi ɔtɔlɔ-mii na utile-mii ngba bɔƒɔ kuƒi. Bekyuli bamɛni baakun lɛmɛnɛ ka bánu budie taatina bɔdi bɔni na sɔsɔ ni, bɔɔɔkɛnku Katɔti Kɔyu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu baayiƒala lili lɛni lɛlɔ na ɔlɔna ekpo ƒui adanku asa na Katɔti ɔɔyá na ɔlɔna umodi ɔmmɔ ɔɔlɛ́ lili. Kristo Ɔ́ƒɔ-mii Ɔ́lɛku Kayawi Kamɛni Ala Bɔtina Ulu Lɛlɔ Kemmo

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: Kristo kukpi kɔɔtina ka amii ku-nwu nékpi, na úkpo ɔ́ƒɔ-mii ɔ́lɛku kayawi kamɛni ala bɔtina ulu lɛlɔ kemmo. Na si use lɛni ni, bi ɔsu na bɛɛbla lɛlɔ aani si bɛmu bɛsiaku kayawi kamɛni ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kama, na bɛmu bɛɛdi bana ala ani na bényimi lɛlɔ?

english_verse: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
translation_verse: Banii bitani bitede ala adi iye bitetuku-nya, na bitadi adila adi udu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: Ala ani ƒui bényimi na básu-mii banii bitabla mmɔ ni, asɔ eeebo kɔsia kɔdi uwi ɔni na ana uwi ɔ́vi. Na kasusu kani béti asa na bényimi ala ammɔ ni, kayawi kamɛni kani kemmo na lɛnunda lɛmmɔ lɛ́si.

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: Na bɔgyi ka ala ani baasu mɛni ni, aatina aani si adanku lɛnunda lɛdi bɔdi na Katɔti kabla kani na bánwi bámana-ka lɛlɔ ɔsu ku kalɛ na baabla ala adi na bekyuli anumi na baaní ɔlɔna ɔmmɔ kɔtu. Nsu ala ammɔ eléte kebunku kani maya na ukyuli ɔlɛ nwuna ɔlɔna ɔkwɛ adala kemmo.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: Ka amii ku Kristo na Katɔti ɔ́gyila ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ ɔsu ni, bɛwia ala ani nkya katɔ kama ulu na kesii kani na Kristo ulie ɔɔdiku Katɔti lɛga.

english_verse: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
translation_verse: Na bina kasusu kataasia ala ani nkya katɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ, na ɔɔɔdi kalɔ ala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
translation_verse: Ɔsika use aani bíkpi na bɛkya Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ku Kristo.

english_verse: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
translation_verse: Bina ngba ƒui ndi Kristo. Na si Kristo ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ kayawi kamɛni kemmo ni, amii ku-nwu ƒui bɛdubɔdi lɛga bɛsala ku kubiti. Bínwini Bekyuli Bawɔdi

english_verse: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, bɛdu ɔlɔna kemmo ɔkwɛ adala biala nkya-mii lɛlɔ kemmo. Na bitasiaku-nya kama aani lɛsɔnɔdi ku ala ani muusé lɛlɔ ku ɔlɔna ɔkwɛ adala ani muuti ukyuli teesienku likpidi bɔbla kemmo na aayá na ukyuli uuti kasusu kekpidi ku ɔdivo udu biala ɔni ndi lɛƒiɔkpa.

english_verse: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni udu bɔbla ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔdubo kɔnyi buti bɔkya bani naaabla kalɛ na nwuna litemi lɛɛsu.

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔdi návi kemmo ni, ngba bɔmmɔ udu na bílie.

english_verse: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, ɔlɛka bɛda ala amɛni udu bɔbla bɛya. Anya ndi kɔnyi buti ku ala ani mɔɔtu bekyuli kayi ku bekyuli lɛlɔ kasusu kekpidi buti. Na bitalɔ lɛlɔ anyikpi, na bitaya na etemila ani mɔɔyá na ukyuli uusé lɛlɔ alɛ-mii kenye.

english_verse: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
translation_verse: Bitatɔlɔ lɛlɔ, ɔsika bɛ́da udu ɔkukudi ɔni nákya-mii kemmo mmɔ bídie.

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: Na bínwini bekyuli bawɔdi. Na Katɔti ɔɔyá na bɛɛdia teebu, na bina udu ɔbla aani anwu ɔdi kalɛ na bɛti-nwu geen.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu kavumana kadi keeebo bani ndi Yudaƒuɔ ku bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ ntɛ, iye bani muukúlo ago ku bani neeekulo ntɛ. Lɛni kani na kavumana kadi keeebo bani ndi baƒɔ ku bani nási Sitia ku bekyuli bani mɔɔbla bekyuli bamba kabla ku bani mɔɔbla ama alati kabla ntɛ. Mmomu Kristo ndi-bu lɛla biala, na ulie ɔdi biala lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.
translation_verse: Amii lɛnɔ bɛdi Katɔti bekyuli bani na ɔ́ƒuna mmɔ badi. Ɔmɛni ɔsu bitaabla lɛƒɔndia teete bekyuli, na bitaanu bekyuli kɔnyana, na biteeboku lɛlɔ kalɔ, na bitaanyuɛ lɛlɔ ku kayi buɛɛ.

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: Na biteebunku lɛlɔ. Na si ɔdi ɔ́ƒiɔ ɔdi ni, uti ɔkyiɛ-nwu aani kalɛ na Blɔti úti ɔ́kyiɛ-mii.

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni kama ƒui ni, bɛyɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika bɔyɔ muunyimi ala ƒui taasala na aabla unwi.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Na bɛya Kristo ɔni muute keyi buɛɛ ɔdi lɛga na bina kayi kemmo. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-bu ɔsala ɔnii bula ƒui bɔbla ɔlɔna unwi na bɔkɛ keyi buɛɛ. Na bitaagya enu.

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Bɛya na Kristo litemi buni lilie-mii kayi kemmo kaduɛ. Na bitaatina ala na bitaalɛ lɛlɔ na lɛnunda kemmo. Bitaatu Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo lɛnu ku baƒɔtaadine lɛnu ku lɛnu lɛni nkɛnku Katɔti Kɔyu ala lɛlɔ teeti taagya Katɔti enu ku bina kayi ƒui.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Na lɛla biala lɛni na bɛɛsu iye bɛɛbla kemmo ni, bɛbla-ni na Blɔti Yesu lɛnyi kemmo. Na bitaagya Katɔti enu taasiaku Blɔti Yesu lɛlɔ. Bilie Na Ngba Bɔwɔdi Kemmo Aani Kristo Basiakune Kalɛ

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Amii beleku biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bite bina bagya, ɔsika ɔmɛni námanku-mii aani Kristo kama basiakune.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Amii banana lɛnɔ, biti bɔyɔ bite bina beleku. Na bana lɛlɔ liteteeƒi-mii livo.

english_verse: Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
translation_verse: Na amii bebi ni, binu bina bawɔne litemi, ɔsika ɔmɛni mɔɔda Blɔti ebiti.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Amii bawɔne bitakya bina bebi kɔnyi kalɛ na enu aƒɛ-ma na kabla biala kemmo.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Amii bekyuli bamba kabla bablane binu bina benwoti litemi na ulu biala lɛlɔ. Na bidie kayi na bɛbla kabla uwi biala kemmo, na ɔɔɔdi uwi ɔni na bakya-mii kudɔ lɛti kalɛ bakɛ-mii lɛlɔ kubiti. Mmomu bɛbla kabla ku kayi ƒui na ɔbu ɔni bibo bite Blɔti ɔsu.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Na lɛla biala na bɛɛbla ni, bɛbla-ni ku kaƒɔ nwaa aani si Blɔti na bɛɛbla bite na ɔɔɔdi bekyuli.

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: Bɛgyi ka Blɔti ndubute-mii lɛyuƒɔla lɛni na ɔ́su úse ka wete nwuna bekyuli. Na Kristo ndi Unwoti ɔni geen kabla na bɛɛbla.

english_verse: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala likpidi lɛni na ɔ́bla ni, nina lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔdubo bunye na ɔni-nwu kɔtu. Ɔsika Katɔti ulánu bekyuli anumi si ɔɔní kɔtu.

english_verse: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
translation_verse: Amii benwoti bani mbo kabla bablane ni, bɛda-ma na bɛnu-ma lɛlɔ kaduɛ. Ɔsika amii lɛnɔ bɛgyi ka bibo Unwoti ɔni nkya katɔ. Bitaabla Ala Abambadi Lɛnɔ

english_verse: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
translation_verse: Bitada Katɔti bɔkpali bitaya. Na binye kagyumana, na biteeti linugya teete-nwu.

english_verse: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
translation_verse: Na uwi biala kemmo na bɛɛkpali katɔ ni, bivele Katɔti na ɔlɛmi ulu ute-bu na bɔkana na bɔsu Kristo litemi buni lɛmmɔ abɛla. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na ntɛ aban ɔtɔ.

english_verse: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
translation_verse: Bɛkpaliku-mi katɔ na lɛkana na lɛsu litemi buni lɛmmɔ na benu-ni kalɔ nwaa.

english_verse: When you are with unbelievers, always make good use of the time.
translation_verse: Bɛda anu na bina keliela kemmo na bɛti kalɛ na bilieku bani naaadi baƒɔtaadine. Na kuƒi biala na bɛ́kɛ ni, bɛbla kabla bite Blɔti.

english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Bɛya na bina butemi bɔdia bunu na ɔda kubiti. Bɛya na Katɔti lɛnunda lɛkya-mii kemmo kalɛ na bɛti ala kenye budie bite ukyuli biala. Bɔɔkada-mii

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: Tihiko ɔdubɔsu-mii mina lɛlɔ kɔtɛ. Ɔdi bula ɔnwa ɔni litemi na mɔɔyɔ́ geen na unye Blɔti kabla kammɔ kemmo sɔsɔ uubunku-bu.

english_verse: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na mɔɔtala-nwu lɛkya-mii na ubakya-mii ogya na ɔsu-mii kalɛ na abu lɛnɔ buwi kabla kammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: Ɔdubo-mii kudɔ ku bula ɔnwa Onesimo ɔni litemi na bɔɔyɔ́ geen na bɔ́ƒɔ-nwu bɔ́di na ɔdi bina akɔ unwi. Ama ndubɔsu-mii ala ani ƒui mɔɔlɛ́ mɛni.

english_verse: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
translation_verse: Aristarko ɔni na ami ku-nwu bɔtɛ ɔtɔ mɛni ku Marko ɔni ndi Barnaba ɔnwani banii beegyele-mii o-o! Líte-mii bɔti na Marko ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ka si úbo-mii kudɔ ni, bigyingya enu na bɛƒɔ-nwu ku ebiti.

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: Yosua ɔni na basɔ baalɔ banii Yusto lɛnɔ uugyele-mii. Yudaƒuɔ nkyuli ɛtɛ bamɛni ndi baƒɔtaadine bani nkya-mi kudɔ na bɔɔbla kabla kalɛ na Katɔti lɛga kadikɔ kebo. Kalɛ na benyeku-mi mɛni ni, ɔ́ya na lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-mi geen.

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: Epaƒra ɔni ndi Kristo kabla ɔblane na ɔdi bina lɛkpa lɛmmɔ baƒɔtaadine kemmo unwi lɛnɔ uugyele-mii o-o! Ɔnwa ɔmɛni úti ɔ́sia lɛlɔ kpakplaa na ɔɔkpali katɔ na bina lili kalɛ na binye kpakplaa na bɛlɛ lili bɛwɔlɔ na bina bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo na bɛdi Katɔti litemi biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: Ami ɔlati muudie-nwu kenye ka ɔ́bla kabla kpakplaa úte-mii ku bani nkya Laodikea ku Hierapoli.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Bula ɔkpana ɔyɔne Luka ɔni ndi evogyii ɔblane ku Dema lɛnɔ banii beegyele-mii o-o!

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Bɔɔkya banwa bani nkya Laodikea ku Ɔnwa Uleku Nimƒa ku baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛni mɔɔsa na nwuna kaduli kenye o-o!

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Si bɛ́ka ɔku ɔmɛni ni, biti bimene Laodikea baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa, na ama lɛnɔ baka. Na amii lɛnɔ bɛka ɔku ɔni na línweni líte Laodikea baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
translation_verse: Na bɛsu Arkipo ka ɔkya ɔkplu na ɔwɔlɔ Blɔti kabla kani na úti ɔ́kya-nwu enu kemmo mmɔ.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Ami Paulo ɔlati mina kɔnu na líti muunweni-mii kegye kamɛni. Na bitayiƒala ka ntɛ aban ɔtɔ. Na muuvele Katɔti nnii ɔya na nwuna lɛƒɔndia lɛsiaku-mii.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Ami Paulo ku Silivano ku Timoteo búnweni ɔku ɔmɛni buute amii bani ndi Katɔti ku Blɔti Yesu Kristo badi na Tesalonika. Na bɔɔkpali katɔ bɔnii Blɔti lɛƒɔndia ku keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-mii. Bɔɔgyá Katɔti Enu Ka Bíti Lɛlɔ Bíte-nwu

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: Bɔɔgyá Katɔti enu na bina lili. Na uwi biala si bɔɔkpali katɔ ni, buuvele lɛnɔ na bina lili.

english_verse: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
translation_verse: Na buláyiƒala Katɔti bɔsu kalɛ na bɛda bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɛɛbla kabla. Bɔɔsu lɛnɔ kalɛ na biibunku bekyuli na bɔyɔ kemmo, na bɛsia Blɔti Yesu Kristo anu kpakplaa.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: Banwa, bɔgyi ka Blɔti ɔɔyɔ́-mii geen na ɔ́ƒuna-mii aani nwuna badi.

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: Na litemi buni lɛni búbasu-mii ni, ɔɔɔdi kenyekplu kani na kadi. Mmomu kadanku Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun budie taatina ɔni na bɔ́ya na bɛ́ti ka sɔsɔ na ɔdi. Bɔgyi ka bɛ́nu kalɛ na bɔ́da bula lɛlɔ na bina akɔ, na ɔmɛni ɔdi bina kebunku.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Na sɔsɔ ni, amii lɛnɔ bɛ́tɛya-bu na bɛsiaku Blɔti udu kama. Na ina ka biibó abi muedi ni, bɛ́ƒɔ litemi lɛmɛni ku ebiti ani na Katɔti Kɔyu kúte-mii.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na baƒɔtaadine bani nkya Makedonia ku Akaia kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui ni, baanu-mii taatɛya. Nsu ɔɔɔdi Blɔti litemi lɛmɛni lɛti néegyingya lɛ́si-mii kudɔ lísie Makedonia ku Akaia ƒui. Mmomu bina Katɔti bɔƒɔtaadi lɛnɔ bɔ́ɔƒɔ kesi kesii. Na ɔɔɔdi abu nsɔ masu lɛla lɛdi, ɔsika bekyuli ƒui béenu-ni.

english_verse: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
translation_verse: Na ama alati mɔɔtɛmi taasiku kalɛ na bɛ́ƒɔ-bu uwi ɔni na búbo-mii kudɔ ku kalɛ na bɛ́da baƒiɔ bɔkpa bɛ́ya, na bíti lɛlɔ bíte Katɔti ɔni lɛti mbo ngba.

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: Na binye bɛgya Ubidi Yesu ɔni na ɔ́gyila ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ, na úbo uli ngba ku Katɔti, na ɔsɔ ɔdubɔsi Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma mmɔ ubo. Yesu ɔmɛni kani ndubɔkana na ɔƒɔ-bu ɔlɛku kɔtu bɔni bɔni na Katɔti ɔdubute ekpidi bablane ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Banwa, amii alati bɛgyi ka kabla kani ɔsu na búbo-mii kudɔ ni, kánwu ebi geen.

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: Na bɛgyi kalɛ na búbo abi na béwi-bu anumi kalɔ na Ƒilipi asa na búbedu bina kudɔ na Tesalonika mɛni. Nsu ina ka békpoku-bu mɛni lɛnɔ ni, Blɔti ɔ́kya-bu ɔkplu na bɔ́su-mii nwuna litemi buni.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Na bula bɔlɛ bɔni na bɔɔlɛ-mii ni, bútasi katɔlɔ iye kasusu kekpidi kemmo.

english_verse: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
translation_verse: Bɛgyi kaduɛ ka ɔɔɔdi kenyemini etemila na búti búboku-mii. Na bútasu-mii litemi buni lɛmɛni kalɛ na bɔkɛ kɔsia kɔdi bɔsiku-mii kudɔ. Na Katɔti ɔlati ndubunye-bu litemi lɛmɛni kama.

english_verse: We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us.
translation_verse: Bútawia bumwi bútasiku amii iye bekyuli bamba kudɔ. Ina ka bubo kuƒi aani Kristo batalane kalɛ na bula lɛlɔ bɔnu bunwini etila bɔsia-mii lɛlɔ muedi ni,

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: Ka bɔɔyɔ́-mii ku kaƒɔ nwaa ɔsu ni, bɔɔwia ka amii lɛnɔ binu litemi buni lɛmɛni. Na ɔɔɔdi Katɔti litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛti. Mmomu búti bula ngba lɛnɔ bɔ́kpa na bina lili, ɔsika bɛ́ƒɔ-bu kuye geen.

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: Banwa binyimo ka uwi ɔni na bɔ́kya-mii kudɔ na bɔ́su-mii litemi buni lɛmɛni ni, búni ewulu usien ku ɔƒɛ na bɔ́bla kabla na bútenwini etila bútasia-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Amii alati ku Katɔti ndubunye-bu litemi lɛmɛni kama ka bɔ́da bula lɛlɔ kedee na bina akɔ. Bɔ́bla ala abuni. Na ukyuli ɔdi útanu bɔƒiɔ bɔdi na bula lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: Bɛgyi lɛnɔ ka bɔ́da bina ɔdi biala aani kalɛ na ubi ɔti ɔɔda nwuna bebi.

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: Bɔ́kya-mii ɔyikun ku ogya na bútaalɛ-mii bɔnii bilie ngba bɔni na kaƒɔ kayɔ Blɔti, ɔsika anwu ɔlati nálɔ-mii kalɛ na bɛkɛ bɔƒɔ na nwuna lɛga bɔdi ku bukeye kemmo.

english_verse: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni ɔsu na bɔ́sɔ bɔɔgyá Katɔti enu lɛnɔ ndi ka ni, uwi ɔni na bɔ́su-mii litemi buni lɛmɛni ni, bíteti-ni aani litemi likpludi. Mmomu bɛ́ƒɔ-ni aani Katɔti litemi. Na ɔdi nwuna litemi sɔsɔ. Na líboku kavumana geen lɛnɔ na amii baƒɔtaadine bammɔ ngba bulie kemmo.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Banwa, ala ani mɔɔlɛ́ku-mii mɛni ni, anya kani nálɛku Katɔti bekyuli na Yudea kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na abi ani na amii biibó na bina bekyuli enu kemmo ni, anya kani na Yudea kalɔ bekyuli bani náƒɔ Yesu bádi bébo na Yudaƒuɔ lɛkɔkɔ.

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: Yudaƒuɔ bamɛni nádu Katɔti kenye bediene, na báya na bádu Blɔti Yesu lɛnɔ. Ama kani nsia beekpóku-bu na baawia-bu badu. Bana ablala áta énye Katɔti lɛlɔ na badi liƒula lɛni nétile bekyuli ƒui ulu.

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: Béti básia lɛlɔ banii butasu bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ litemi buni lɛmɛni kalɛ na bakɛ ngba ƒui. Na baatɛ ekpidi etila taasia ekpidi kama teete lɛlɔ ani nédu kesii kani na Katɔti kɔtu bɔni bubo-ma lɛlɔ. Bɛ́ƒɔ-bu Kuye Geen

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Banwa uuduo-bu geen ka bɔ́di emeyi alɛɛ na bɔ́sɔ bútasa tɔ anumi ku anumi. Nsu bɛkya-bu kayi kemmo. Na bɔ́ɔkya kɔkwɛ kɔni ƒui bɔ́nɔ.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɔ́yɔ ka bɔsɔ bubo bubanu-mii. Na ami Paulo geen ni, lɛ́wia ulu kɔlɛ kɔlɛ ka libo. Nsu ukisine ɔmmɔ únye útile ulu.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: Mɔɔwia geen ka mbanu-mii, ɔsika amii ndi bula lɛnumi. Na bɛɛda-bu kubiti, ɔsika amii ku baƒɔtaadine bakladi ndi bula kɔsia kɔni ɔsu na bɔdubuƒu uwi ɔni na Blɔti Yesu wasɔ webo.

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ ni, amii mɔɔyá lɛlɔ lɛɛyɔ́-bu, na buuƒú lɛnɔ na amii ɔsu.

english_verse: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
translation_verse: Na ka bina takana tɔ bɔnu lɛƒɛda lítulo-bu ɔsu ni, bɔ́tuna bɔnii bula inyɔ bɔɔsɔ bɔkya Atene.

english_verse: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
translation_verse: Na bɔtala Timoteo na ubo ubakya-mii ɔkplu, na ubunku-mii na bina bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo. Anwu ndi bula ɔnwa ɔni muubunku-bu na Katɔti kabla ku Kristo litemi buni lɛmɛni bɔsu kemmo.

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: Bɔ́bla lɛni ɔsika buláwia ka bukpoku bɔmɛni bɔƒɛ ɔdi enu. Amii alati bɛgyi bise ka bukpoku bɔmɛni buse bute Kristo kama basiakune ƒui.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: Bɛdubunyimo ka uwi ɔni na bɔkya-mii kudɔ ni, bɔ́lɛ-mii ɔmɛni lɛlɔ búse ka bukpoku bɔmɛni bɔdububo. Na aani kalɛ bɛgyi ni, úbo lɛni sɔsɔ.

english_verse: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni ɔsu na lɛ́tala Timoteo nnii ubanu si bɛmu bɛda bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ kpakplaa. Ɔsika litemi lɛmɛni liléte-mi bɔlɛɛ. Na mɔɔyia ka ɔƒɛni kalɛ ukisine ɔmmɔ úbo úbeƒu-mii kasusu na bula lɛbibo ƒui lɛ́bla keeke. Bina Bɔƒɔtaadi Bɔɔkya-bu Kubiti

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Nsu Timoteo ɔ́sɔ úbo ku kubiti úbasu-bu ka bina bɔƒɔtaadi ku bina bakpana bɔyɔ bútavumana. Mmomu bɛɛkali-bu geen na binye kuƒie bɛɛyɔ́ ka bɛnu-bu aani kalɛ abu lɛnɔ bɔɔwia-mii bɔnu.

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, banwa, ina ka buubó abi na ala amɛni ényimi-bu muedi ni, bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɔɔkya-bu kubiti na kayi kaayɔ́-bu.

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni na bula ngba bulie bɔ́sɔ bɔ́bla ɔwɔdi, ɔsika búnu kalɛ na binye kpakplaa na Blɔti bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Bulakana Katɔti enu bɔgya na bina lili na wedu ebiti ani na úte-bu na amii ɔsu.

english_verse: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
translation_verse: Buuvele Blɔti kpakplaa usien ku ɔƒɛ bɔnii ɔya na bɔsɔ bɔsa na bɔkya-mii bɔƒɔtaadi unu.

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, Unwoti Katɔti ɔlati ku Blɔti Yesu balɛmi ulu bete-bu na bubo-mii kudɔ.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Na Blɔti ɔya na bina bɔyɔ bɔni bibo bite lɛlɔ bumomo bubu. Na bɛyɔ bekyuli bamba lɛnɔ aani kalɛ na bɔɔyɔ́-mii.

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na Unwoti Katɔti ɔkya-mii ɔkplu na uveli-mii lɛlɔ ekpidi ƒui na ɔbla-mii kedee na nwuna anumi ute limeyi lɛni na Blɔti Yesu Kristo wasɔ webo kayawi kamɛni ku nwuna badi kedee.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: Banwa, mina lɛla likplodi lɛni muuvele-mii ndi ka ni, bilie ngba bɔni mɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti kaƒɔ aani kalɛ na bɔ́tina-mii. Bɛdaku ɔkplu bɔkya bɔdi, nsu bɔɔkya-mii ogya na Blɔti Yesu lɛnyi kemmo bɔnii bɛbla bitulo lɛni.

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bɛgyi ala ani na bɔ́tina-mii ɔkɛnku Blɔti Yesu ɔyikun kemmo.

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔɔwia ka bɛbla lɛlɔ kedee na bɛda lɛlɔ bidie lɛsɔnɔdi kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: Na bitasiaku ɔlɔna emini kama aani bekyuli bani naaayia Katɔti kalɛ.

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni, ɔdi biala lɛnumi litegyie na ɔnwani ulekudi lɛlɔ kalɛ na waƒiɔ-nwu. Bɔ́su-mii na bɔ́lɛ-mii na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ búse kpakplaa ka ni, Blɔti ɔdubɔni bani mɔɔbla ala amɛni kɔtu geen.

english_verse: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-bu ka bɔbla bekyuli kedee. Anwuɔsu bɛya bɔda lɛlɔ budie kɔbɔ ala bɔbla kemmo.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si bina akɔ ɔdi útadi ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni, ɔɔɔdi bekyuli lɛlɔ na ɔ́ta únye. Mmomu Katɔti ɔni néti nwuna Kɔyu úte-mii lɛlɔ na ɔ́ta únye.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: Na bina banwa baƒɔtaadine lɛlɔ bɔyɔ ni, útalɛka bunweni-mii lɛla lɛdi na ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔ́tina-mii ɔmɛni ƒui.

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: Na sɔsɔ ni, ɔdi litemi geen ka bɛɛyɔ́ bina banwa baƒɔtaadine bani nkya Makedonia. Nsu bɔsɔ buuvele-mii bɔnii bɛbla bitulo lɛni!

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: Bilie ngba ku lɛlɔ kalɔ buboku, na ɔdi biala anu asia nwuna kabla lɛlɔ, na biti bina enu bɛwia bina lɛdila aani kalɛ kani na bɔ́su-mii.

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na bani nátaƒɔ bátadi bataaƒalɛ-mii na bilayaki lɛla lɛdi. Biteteewulo Kɔnyana Aani Bekyuli Bani Neeebo Lɛnunsia

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Banwa, bɔɔyɔ́ ka bɔsu-mii lɛla lɛni ndubɔlɛku bekyuli bani néekpi, kalɛ na biléteewulo kɔnyana aani bekyuli bani neeebo lɛnunsia.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: Bɔ́ƒɔ bɔ́di ka Yesu úkpi na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́ta uli ngba na ɔdubɔsɔ ɔsi katɔ mmɔ ubo lɛnɔ. Anwuɔsu bɔ́ƒɔ bɔ́di ka baƒɔtaadine bani ƒui nékpi ni, badubɔsɔ bata. Na Katɔti ɔdubɔsia Yesu ɔmmɔ kani lɛlɔ na ɔƒɔ-ma na bebelieku-nwu ngba.

english_verse: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na Blɔti ɔɔtina ni, nina lɛlɔ na bunye bɔɔsu-mii ka ni, abu bani nli ngba na Blɔti bɔsɔ bubo kemmo ni, bulaka bani néekpi katɔ busie.

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, bɔdubunu Blɔti bubo kɔku ku kudu kubendi. Bɔdubunu Katɔti ɔtu unengudi lɛdi. Na Katɔti kakpɛɛ kadubɔku. Na Blɔti ɔlati ɔdubɔda ɔlɛ kayaa. Na bekyuli bani náƒɔ Kristo bádi asa na békpi ni, badubɔka bɔta buli ngba.

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama ni, Katɔti ɔdubutiku abu bani nébu buli ngba na uti-bu utásalaku bekyuli bani náta na butásiaku Blɔti na kayaa. Na bɔdubulieku Blɔti uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Encourage each other with these words.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu biti etemila amɛni bitaasia lɛlɔ kɔnu.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Banwa, útalɛka linweni-mii lɛla lɛdi ɔ́si uwi iye emeyi ani na ala amɛni adubɔlɛ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: Ɔsika amii alati bɛgyi geen ka Blɔti limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛdububo aani kalɛ na uyune uuyú ukyuli taatu usien.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni kemmo na bekyuli baasu banii lɛla biala lɛ́ɛtɛ ni, uwi ɔmmɔ geen na ɔgbankpi adubɔlɛku-ma ɔni na baaagyi beeese. Ɔdububo aani kalɛ na kawɔƒɔ kaadu ɔƒɔndane. Na kekelikɔ kadi keeebo.

english_verse: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, banwa, amii bɛɛɛkya lɛdisa kemmo. Anwuɔsu limeyi libendi lɛmmɔ liléyu-mii lilatu aani uyune kalɛ.

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bina ƒui bɛkya bukeye kemmo. Na bɔɔɔdi aani bekyuli bani náƒɔ lɛlɔ bákya likpidi kemmo na baabla ala taabɛ.

english_verse: Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bitaya na bɔlɛɛ na budie lɛlɔ atu aani ama bani naaagyi Blɔti. Mmomu bɛya bunye kagyumana na bɔda lɛlɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ama bani mɔɔlɛɛ ni, usien na baalɛɛ. Na ama bani muukpi ntɛ ni, usien na beekpi-mu.

english_verse: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
translation_verse: Nsu abu bani nkya bukeye kemmo ni, bɛya na bɔda lɛlɔ kaduɛ. Na buti bula bɔƒɔtaadi ku bula bɔyɔ butaagyumana lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na kekpo adala aagyumana ukpone. Na butaasia anu ka Blɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ-bu, aani kalɛ na kekpo kabwa kaagyumana ukpone lili.

english_verse: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti útedie-bu ɔnii nwuna kɔnyi kubo-bu lɛlɔ. Mmomu ɔnii bɔsia Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ na bɔkɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔmɛni nékpi na bula lili ɔni na si bulie o-o, si bukpi o-o ni, bɔdubulieku Blɔti na nwuna bɔsɔ bubo kemmo.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bitaakya lɛlɔ ogya na biteebunku lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na biwi-nwu lɛlɔ ɔƒaani. Bɛda Lɛlɔ Bidie Likpidi Ulu Biala Lɛlɔ

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: Banwa, buuvele-mii bɔnii biti ɔbu geen bite bina batɔnkune bani mɔɔtina-mii Kristo ngba bulie ala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: Bɛyɔ-ma na bɛbu-ma kaduɛ na bana ulu ɔbuni ɔni na béti-mii baasiaku ɔsu. Na bilieku lɛlɔ ku keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: Lɛnɔ ni, banwa, bɔɔwia kpakplaa ka bɛkɛ litemi bɛsu bakɔsɔne. Na bɛkya bani na liƒu lɛɛda ɔkplu. Na bibunku bani mɔɔwia kebunku. Na bɛkɛ kayi buɛɛ bite ukyuli biala.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Bɛnu kaduɛ na ɔdi uteti likpidi utaƒɔ likpidi kayu. Mmomu uwi biala kemmo ni, bitaabla lɛbuni teete lɛlɔ ku bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: Always be joyful
translation_verse: Bɛya na lɛlɔ litaayɔ-mii uwi biala.

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Bitaya na enu aƒɛ-mii na katɔ bɔkpali kemmo.

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Na biti enugya bite Blɔti na lɛla biala kemmo. Ɔsika amɛni ndi ala ani na Katɔti ɔɔwia taasiku amii bani ƒui nsiaku Yesu Kristo kama.

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Bitetile Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun ulu na bina akɔ.

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: Mmomu bɛwia lɛla biala kalɔ binu na bɛsiaku lɛbuni kama.

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Bɛda lɛlɔ bidie likpidi ulu biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Na buuvele Katɔti ɔni muute-bu keyi buɛɛ bɔnii ɔbla-mii kedee na ulu biala lɛlɔ. Na ɔgyumana bina kɔyu ku kasusu ku ɔlɔna ƒui kalɛ na bɛlɛ kɔtɔ bɔdu kemmo uwi ɔni na Blɔti Yesu Kristo wasɔ webo.

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔni nálɔ-mii ɔnii binwini nwuna bekyuli ni, ɔdububunku-mii utédu kawɔlɔkɔ. Ɔsika lɛla lɛni na ɔ́nya ɔ́su ka wabla ni, ani kani na ɔdubɔbla.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Banwa, bitaakpali katɔ na bula lili.

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Bɛkya lɛlɔ kɔgbu na bigyele lɛlɔ ku kaƒɔ ƒaa.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: Mɔɔsu-mii kpakplaa aani Blɔti Yesu Kristo kenye unyene nnii bɛka ɔku ɔmɛni bite baƒɔtaadine bammɔ ƒui.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Muuvele Blɔti Yesu Kristo nnii ɔda-mii kɔkɔɔkɔ na nwuna lɛƒɔndia kemmo.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ami Paulo ku Silivano ku Timoteo búnweni ɔku ɔmɛni buute amii bani ndi bula Unwoti Katɔti ku Blɔti Yesu Kristo badi na Tesalonika.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Na buuvele bɔnii bɛkɛ Unwoti Katɔti ku Blɔti Yesu Kristo keyi buɛɛ ku lɛƒɔndia. Buuvele Katɔti Bɔnii Bina Ɔbladu Ɔmanku Bɔlɔ Bɔni Na Ɔ́lɔ-mii

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: Banwa, bɔda Katɔti enugya kayu uwi ƒui na amii ɔsu. Na ɔdia ka butaaƒɔ-ka, ɔsika bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɔɔkɔ́ katɔ, na bina lɛlɔ bɔyɔ lɛnɔ buusié anumi teebu ɔsu. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na bɔɔlɔ-mii lɛnyi buni na Katɔti baƒɔtaadine akɔ.

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: Na bɔɔtalaku bina lɛnyi katɔ ɔsika binye bina bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ kpakplaa na bɛɛkya ɔkplu ina ka beekpóku-mii na biibó abi.

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔɔtina-bu ka Katɔti ɔɔtɛ litemi siin. Na ɔdubute-mii keliekɔ na nwuna lɛga kadikɔ kani ɔsu na biibó abi.

english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔdubɔtɛ litemi na ulu lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubɔni bani muukpóku-mii ƒui kɔtu.

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔya na abu ku amii bani ƒui muubó abi bɔkɛ bɔnwuna. Katɔti ɔdubɔbla ala amɛni uwi ɔni na Blɔti Yesu ku Katɔti batu badubɔda bɔlɛ kayaa na ɔyikun kemmo ku ogya.

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani naaabu Katɔti na bátaƒɔ Blɔti Yesu Kristo litemi buni bátadi ni, ɔdubɔni-ma kɔtu na lɛgyavonku kemmo.

english_verse: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
translation_verse: Lɛni na Blɔti ɔdubɔgya-ma ɔlɛku nwuna anumi. Na balanu nwuna bukeye ku ɔyikun. Na ɔdubɔyila-ma ku udu.

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: Ala amɛni adubɔlɛ na limeyi libendi lɛni lɛlɔ na Yesu wasɔ webo. Na limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, nwuna baƒɔtaadine ƒui badubɔsiaku-nwu ku bumwi kudu. Na amii lɛnɔ bɛdubɔkya-ma akɔ, ɔsika bɛ́ƒɔ nwuna litemi buni lɛni bɔ́su-mii mmɔ bɛ́di.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na bɔɔkpali katɔ na bina lili uwi ndi uwi. Na buuvele bula Katɔti bɔnii bina ɔbladu ɔmanku bɔlɔ bɔni na ɔ́lɔ-mii. Na nwuna ɔyikun ubunku-mii na ɔkya bina kasusu buni biala ogya kalɛ na lɛla biala lɛni na bɛdubɔbla na anwu ɔsu lɛtɛ.

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Buuvele ala amɛni teete-mii kalɛ na bakɔliku Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛnyi katɔ na amii ɔsu. Na anwu lɛnɔ wakɔliku-mii lɛnyi katɔ na anwu ku Katɔti lɛƒɔndia ɔsu.

english_verse: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
translation_verse: Banwa, bɔɔyɔ́ ka bɔsu-mii lɛla kpakplaa lɛdi na Blɔti Yesu Kristo bɔsɔ bubo ku bula bɔsala na nwuna kudɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: Si bínu bɛnii Blɔti bubo limeyi lɛmmɔ líbo líbavi ni, buláwia ka bina kasusu keƒu iye ɔtɔtɔ ɔgyu-mii. Ɔƒɛni kalɛ ɔdubɔbla-mii aani ka abu násu ɔmɛni uwi ɔni na buudie Katɔti kenye iye bɔɔkɔ́ litemi lɛmmɔ lɛsa iye búnweni ɔku ɔdi búmene-mii.

english_verse: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.
translation_verse: Bitaya na ukyuli ɔdi ɔtɔlɔ-mii na ulu biala lɛlɔ. Ɔsika Blɔti limeyi lɛmmɔ lilebo tɔ utédu uwi ɔni na bekyuli pii badubuni Katɔti asa na ukyuli ukpidi ɔmmɔ ɔni na Katɔti údie úse ka ɔkyula ɔda ɔlɛ.

english_verse: He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubɔta unye utile kɔyu ɔyikun biala ulu na ɔtina ka anwu lɛti ndi ayu ƒui utulone. Na ɔdubo bɔta muedi butélie Katɔti kakpakɔ na ɔbla lɛlɔ aani anwu ndi Katɔti ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Binyimo ka uwi ɔni na lɛ́kya-mii kudɔ ni, lɛ́su-mii ala amɛni ƒui.

english_verse: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, ɔyikun ɔdi uutile ala ammɔ kuƒi ka alɛ ɔƒɛni. Na amii alati bɛ́gyi lɛla lɛni na lɛdi. Na ukyuli ukpidi ɔmmɔ ɔdubudie lɛlɔ keyi si nwuna uwi údu.

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: Na likyulikpi ala ani baabla taabɛ éese kalɔ aalɛ́. Na ala ani ndubɔlɛ ni, aaadubo bɔlɛ tɔ wetédu ka Katɔti ɔ́da ukyuli ɔni muutile ukyuli ukpidi ɔmmɔ ulu údie.

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni kama ni, Katɔti ɔdubudie ukyuli ukpidi ɔmmɔ keyi ɔtina. Na si uwi ɔni na Blɔti Yesu Kristo úbo ni, ɔdubuti nwuna kenye ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ku bukeye ɔkyula-nwu na ɔyila-nwu udu ƒui.

english_verse: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ukpidi ɔmmɔ ɔdububo ku Satan ɔyikun, na ɔdubudie ɔkɔ akɔla budie taatina lidu lidu ɔtina.

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani ƒui ndubo bɔyii ku udu ni, ɔdubɔsia likyulikpi katɔlɔ ulu biala lɛlɔ na ɔtɔlɔ-ma. Badubo bɔyii ɔsika bátaƒɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ bátadi na Katɔti ɔƒɔ-ma ngba.

english_verse: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na Katɔti ɔdubɔnyonu-ma kalɛ na baƒɔ ɔkɔ badi.

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: Kawɔlɔkɔ ƒui ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔdu-ma kɔtɔ, ɔsika bátaƒɔ litemi buni bátadi. Mmomu bátaakɛ ebiti na ekpidi bɔbla kemmo. Binye Kpakplaa

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, banwa, bɔda Katɔti enugya kayu uwi ƒui na amii ɔsu. Bɔgyi ka ɔɔyɔ́-mii sɔsɔ. Ɔsika ɔ́ƒuna-mii ɔnii bɛkɛ bɔƒɔ. Na ɔ́bla-mii nwuna badi ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ uwi ɔni na Katɔti Kɔyu kúveli bina ekpidi údie-mii lɛlɔ ɔsika bɛ́ƒɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ bɛ́di ɔsu.

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku bula litemi buni lɛmɛni bɔsu kemmo ni, Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-mii ɔnii bibo na bɛƒɔ lɛnyi aani kalɛ na Blɔti Yesu Kristo ubo lɛnyi.

english_verse: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, banwa, binye kpakplaa na biƒie etemila ani na bɔ́tina-mii na bula lɛku bunweni ku bɔtɛmi kemmo bɛda.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: Na buuvele kebunku taasiku Blɔti Yesu Kristo ku bula Unwoti Katɔti kudɔ ɔni mɔɔyɔ́-bu, na úti kayi buse ku lɛnunsia úte-bu ɔ́si nwuna lɛƒɔndia ɔsu.

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: Buuvele-nwu bɔnii, ute-mii ɔyikun na ɔkya-mii kayi ogya kalɛ na bɛsu na bɛbla ala abuni ƒui lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Asa na mawɔlɔ ni, banwa, binyimo na bitaakpali katɔ na bula lili kalɛ na Blɔti litemi lɛmɛni liteegyingya teesie kesi kesii ku ɔbu aani kalɛ na amii lɛnɔ bɛ́ƒɔ-ni.

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: Na bivele lɛnɔ kalɛ Blɔti wada-bu wedie na bekyuli bekpidi enu kemmo, ɔsika ɔɔɔdi bekyuli ƒui náƒɔ nwuna litemi lɛmmɔ bádi.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Nsu Blɔti unye-mii kama, na ɔdubɔkya-mii ɔkplu na wanu-mii lɛlɔ kalɛ na ukisine ɔmmɔ uladi-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
translation_verse: Blɔti ɔ́ya na bubo lɛnunsia na bina lɛlɔ ka bɛɛbla ala ani na bɔ́tina-mii, na bɔgyi ka bɛdubɔkana-nya butaabla.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
translation_verse: Buuvele Blɔti bɔnii ubimi-mii anumi na bɛnu bɛti kalɛ na anwu Kristo ɔɔkɛ́ kayi teete-bu ku kalɛ na Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́-bu. Binye Kabla Lɛlɔ

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Banwa, bɔɔlɛ-mii geen na Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛnyi kemmo bɔnii bɛda lɛlɔ bɛmami baƒɔtaadine bakɔsɔne bani neeeti bula ala bɔtina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Amii alati bɛgyi kaduɛ ka ɔdi ka bɛbla kabla aani kalɛ kani na abu lɛnɔ bɔ́bla, ɔsika bútabla kɔkɔsɔ uwi ɔni na bɔ́kya-mii kudɔ.

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: Búteti bula etila bútasia ɔdi lɛlɔ. Na mmomu bɔ́bla kabla kpakplaa usien ku ɔƒɛ ɔni na ɔdi útebo bula lɛlɔ bɔnu kayu.

english_verse: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
translation_verse: Bubo ɔyikun ka nka buti bula etila bɔsia-mii lɛlɔ. Nsu ka bɔɔyɔ́ ka bɛtɛya kalɛ na beenye kabla lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, bútabla lɛni.

english_verse: We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat.
translation_verse: Bɛdubunyimo ka uwi ɔni na bɔ́kya-mii kudɔ ni, bɔ́su-mii geen bɔnii ukyuli ɔni muuní kabla ni, bitete-nwu lɛla lɛdi na ɔdi.

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: Bɔɔsu ala amɛni ɔsika buunú ka bakɔsɔne badi bakya-mii akɔ na bana bakpana lɛlɔ etemila kani na bakɛ baasu taavi.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Buubó bekyuli bamɛni ɔda kpakplaa na Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛnyi kemmo bɔnii bada ngba kaduɛ na beti bana enu bawia bana lɛdila.

english_verse: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
translation_verse: Nsu amii ni, banwa, bitaya na enu aƒɛ-mii na lɛbuni bɔbla kemmo.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Na si ukyuli ɔdi ulábla taasiaku litemi lɛni na bɔ́su-mii na ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo lɛlɔ ni, bise-nwu likpo na bɛda lɛlɔ bɛmami-nwu lɛlɔ na kɔƒa kukpo-nwu.

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Nsu bitekisi ukyuli ɔmmɔ. Mmomu bɛlɛ-nwu aani bina ɔnwani kalɛ. Bɔɔkada-mii

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: Buuvele Blɔti ɔlatidi ɔni muute keyi buɛɛ bɔnii ute-mii keyi buɛɛ na bina ngba bulie ƒui kemmo. Blɔti ɔda bina ƒui na ulu biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Buuvele bɔnii Blɔti Yesu Kristo ɔda bina ƒui na nwuna lɛƒɔndia kemmo.

english_verse: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
translation_verse: Ami Paulo ɔni ndi Yesu Kristo ɔtalane ɔkɛ bula Ɔƒɔne Katɔti ku Kristo Yesu ɔni lɛlɔ na bɔsia anu na muunweni ɔmɛni.

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: Na líti muute awɔ Timoteo. Agyi ka ubi na adi-mi na bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo. Na muuvele Unwoti Katɔti ku Blɔti Yesu nnii bana lɛƒɔndia lɛsiaku-ɔ na banu-ɔ kɔnyana na bete-ɔ keyi buɛɛ. Paulo Ɔ́lɛ-ma Na Ɔkɔ Ala Batinane Lɛlɔ

english_verse: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, mɔɔwia ka asɔ akya Eƒeso mmɔ aani kalɛ na lɛ́su-ɔ uwi ɔni na lɛ́si mmɔ lísela Makedonia. Ɔsika agyi ka bekyuli badi bakya bani mɔɔtina ala ani muuƒú bula ala bɔtina na Kristo bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ. Ɔlɛka abɔku bekyuli bamɛni na bada udu ɔmmɔ baya.

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: Su-ma na bada kuuku atɛ bɔnwi ku kaba kasikɔ lɛmɛnɛ bɔkun baya. Ala amɛni udu muuti unyeƒi taakya bekyuli akɔ. Na aaakɛnku Katɔti kasusu lɛlɔ. Kasusu kani na ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ kani na bɔdubɔnu bɔti.

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli badi bénwini kama bákya ala amɛni. Anwuɔsu báyila ulu ɔbuni ɔmɛni. Na baakya kɔdɔlɔ unyeƒi.

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: Baawia ka benwini Mose ɔda bubo ala batinane. Nsu ni, belenu ama alati etemila muedi kalɔ. Baasu ala kpakplaa taasiku ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ, nsu ama alati belenu-nya kalɔ.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: Bula ƒui bɔgyi ka Mose ɔda bubo bɔdia, nsu ɔlɛka bɔdi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na bɔɔtina.
