english_verse: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
translation_verse: Na ɔlɛka buteenyimo lɛnɔ ka ni, ɔɔɔdi bekyuli babuni na bébo ɔda béte, mmomu batuɔkplune bani mɔɔƒiɔ́ Katɔti ɔda bubo ku bakantankpine ku bana udu bani ngba néyi ku ekpidi bɔbla. Badi bekyuli bani naaasiaku bɔƒɔtaadi bɔdi kama ku bani mɔɔdú bana bati ku beni ku bekyuli badune babambadi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: Na badi bekyuli bani mɔɔdi kɔsɔnɔ ku banana bani mɔɔtɛnku lɛlɔ. Badi bekyuli bani muuyú bekyuli teetéye ku ɔkɔ banyine ku ama bani mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ taakpali ala. Na ama bani ƒui naaasiaku ala bɔtina bɔbuni kama ni, ama na bébo ɔda ɔmɛni béte.

english_verse: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
translation_verse: Na Katɔti litemi buni lɛni bɔsu na úti ɔ́kya-mi enu kemmo ni, nina kemmo kani na bɔdubɔkɛ ala bɔtina bɔbuni bɔmmɔ bɔni nási Katɔti ɔmmɔ ɔlati bukeye kemmo. Na anwu na bɔɔgyá enu.

english_verse: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
translation_verse: Naaakana Blɔti Yesu Kristo enu bɔgya na ɔyikun ɔni na úte-mi ɔnii ntaabla kabla kamɛni ɔsu. Na sɔsɔ ni, úti-ka ɔ́kya-mi enu kemmo. Ɔsika ɔ́nu-mi ɔ́ti ka naaalɛ-nwu kama.

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: Ina ka líkpoku-nwu na lɛ́tɛmi enyekpi ku edumi na nwuna lɛlɔ dii asa na ḿbenwini kayi ni, Katɔti ɔ́nu-mi kɔnyana. Ɔsika uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, ńtaƒɔ-nwu tɔ ńtadi na ńtati lɛla lɛni lɛnɔ na ńtaabla.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: Mina tati tati ɔ́ya na lɛ́du-nwu kaƒɔ, na ɔ́ya na lɛ́nu Kristo Yesu lɛ́ti na lɛ́ƒɔ-nwu lɛ́di na lɛ́blaku-nwu unwi. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na ami lɛnɔ mɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Kenye kani na ndubo bɔsu mɛni kadi litemi geen, na ɔlɛka ukyuli biala ɔƒɔ-ka ɔdi. Yesu ɔni ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi úbo kayawi kamɛni kemmo ɔnii ubedie bekyuli ɔlɛku bana ekpidi ani na baabla kemmo. Na ala ekpidi bablane bammɔ ƒui akɔ ni, ami ntulo.

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu geen na Katɔti ɔ́nu-mi kɔnyana kalɛ na ɔkɛnku ami ɔni ntulo-ma akɔ ƒui lɛlɔ ni, Kristo Yesu ɔdubɔya na bekyuli banu kalɛ na ubo bɔyɔ bɔni muuti taakyiɛ ute ekpidi bablane bani maƒɔ-nwu madi. Na ɔdubute-ma ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa lɛnɔ kudii.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, bɛya na buteemwi bula Katɔ Ɔga ɔni na bulánu ku bula anumi na uli ngba úsela ƒui. Na butaakɔliku anwu ɔni neeekpi kudii lɛnyi katɔ uwi ƒui. Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: Mina ubi Timoteo, kabla ku ɔda bubo bɔni na líti muute-ɔ mɛni ni, kadanku ala ani na bula kenye bediene básu básiku-ɔ lɛlɔ. Ƒie etemila amɛni da na adubɔdi likpidi lɛlɔ na Blɔti kekpo kamɛni kemmo.

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: Da ƒula bɔƒɔtaadi kaduɛ kalɛ na ƒula kayi kaládu-ɔ kɔtɔ. Ɔsika bekyuli bani na bétenu bana kayi bɔlɛ ni, bayii bana bɔƒɔtaadi ulu.

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: Na bana akɔ badi ndi Himeneo ku Aleksandro. Lɛ́ni-ma kɔtu na líti-ma líte ukisine ɔmmɔ kalɛ na bebo abi na nwuna enu kemmo. Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na batɛya lɛla na bada enyekpi bɔtɛmi taasiku Katɔti lɛlɔ baya.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: Lɛla lideedi lɛni na mɔɔyɔ́ ka bɛti ndi ka bitaakpali katɔ na biteevele na bekyuli ƒui lili. Na biteeti amii ku-ma ƒui awiala taava Katɔti anumi.

english_verse: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
translation_verse: Na bitaakpali katɔ teete baga ku bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔdi bekyuli lɛlɔ kalɛ na bula ƒui bɔkɛ atu bɔyɔ ku keyi buɛɛ. Na buboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bute Katɔti na buti ɔbu bute ukyuli biala.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Katɔ bɔkpali bɔmɛni mɔɔyɔ́ bula Ɔƒɔne Katɔti kaƒɔ.

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔɔwia ka ukyuli biala ɔnu nwuna litemi geen lɛmmɔ ɔti kalɛ na ɔƒɔ-nwu ngba.

english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ ni, Katɔti unwi kani nkya. Na kɔnu ɔsiane lɛnɔ unwi kani nkya. Anwu ndi ukyuli ɔni baalɔ banii Kristo Yesu. Anwu mɔɔklibi abu ku Katɔti ntɛ.

english_verse: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔsu na Katɔti ɔ́bla-mi lɛsa ɔkɔne ku ɔtalane. Na ɔɔɔdi ɔkɔ na mɔɔnyi. Mɔɔsu-mii geen nnii údie-mi aani ala ɔtinane ɔnii mbedie bɔƒɔtaadi kenye ntina bekyuli bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ.

english_verse: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Na baƒɔtaadine kasalakɔ biala ni, mɔɔwia ka banana bataakpali katɔ ku kayi kedee kalɛ na si Katɔti ɔɔnu bina enu katɔ ni, na ɔti ka bɛ́da lɛlɔ bídie likpidi kemmo. Na kɔnyi iye unyeƒi ɔdi uuubo-mii akɔ.

english_verse: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
translation_verse: Mɔɔwia lɛnɔ ka beleku banu kaduɛ na bana adala lɛlɔ, na batina ka beeboku lɛlɔ kalɔ. Ɔɔɔdi ka beteenyimi lili ku kunweni lidu lidu ku sika ugyiedi adala lidu lidu ani náƒɔ kuye na aatina ka baakɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ.

english_verse: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
translation_verse: Mmomu ni, bana ɔbladu ɔbuni udie-ma ɔtina aani beleku bani mɔɔsu banii basiaku Blɔti.

english_verse: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
translation_verse: Na uleku biala uboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na ɔtɛya ala, na utakya lɛsɛ.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: Ńtete-ma kuƒi nnii batina banana ala iye badi banana lɛlɔ. Mmomu ɔlɛka bada bana inye.

english_verse: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
translation_verse: Ɔsika Adam na Katɔti ɔka budie asa na údie Eva.

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdi Adam na ukisine ɔmmɔ ɔ́tɔlɔ, mmomu uleku na ɔ́tɔlɔ. Na ɔ́ya na ɔ́bla likpidi.

english_verse: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_verse: Nsu si uleku wenye kpakplaa na nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo ku bɔyɔ na wada lɛlɔ kedee na weboku lɛlɔ kalɔ ni, ɔdubɔvi nwuna kɔwɔ lɛbibo kemmo buɛɛ.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: Lɛsugba lɛmɛni lɛdi litemi geen ka ni, si ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔwia ka unwini baƒɔtaadine ɔtɔnkune ni, ɔɔwia kabla kabuni.

english_verse: That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach.
translation_verse: Na baƒɔtaadine ɔtɔnkune ni, ɔlɛka ɔbla ukyuli ɔni na litemi lɛdi lɛɛɛda-nwu, na úti uleku unwi, na ɔ́da anu, na ɔda lɛlɔ, na bekyuli baabu-nwu. Ɔɔbla lɛƒɔ na ɔdi ala ɔtinane buni.

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: Útalɛka utaani ntɛ teekpi, na ulekpo udi. Mmomu ɔlɛka ɔbla ukyuli ɔni nse buɛɛ, na ulayɔ kadɔ, na uuubo sika lɛnungyie lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka ɔkana nwuna kaduli bekyuli bɔda, na ɔya na nwuna bebi beteenu litemi na ulu biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: Na si ukyuli ɔdi ɔkya na ulákana nwuna kaduli bekyuli lɛlɔ bɔnu ni, agyi anii ulakana na watɔnku Katɔti baƒɔtaadine.

english_verse: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
translation_verse: Útalɛka ɔbla ɔƒɔtaadine ɔwɔdi kalɛ na ulatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ, na ɔkɛnku lɛlɔ bɔtina bɔmmɔ ɔsu na webuli, na Katɔti wani-nwu kɔtu aani kalɛ na ɔ́ni ukisine ɔmmɔ kɔtu.

english_verse: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka ɔbla ukyuli ɔni na ubo lɛnyi buni na bekyuli bani naaadi baƒɔtaadine lɛnɔ anumi, kalɛ na balasu lɛla likpidi lɛdi na nwuna lɛlɔ na weduo ukisine ɔmmɔ kakpagyuɛ kemmo.

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: Na ɔlɛka bada bɔƒɔtaadi litemi buni lɛni na bédie keyi mɛni kpakplaa ku kayi kani naaadu-ma kɔtɔ.

english_verse: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
translation_verse: Na ɔdi ka bɛka-ma udu bɔkɔku bɔnu. Na si bana lɛlɔ liiibo litemi lɛdi ni, bɛya-na benwini baƒɔtaadine bebunkune.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Bana beleku lɛnɔ ni, ɔlɛka babla beleku bani nda udu buni, na baaadi bekyuli lɛlɔ atɛ batɛmine. Mmomu ɔlɛka babla beleku bani náda anu, na baabla lɛla biala kaduɛ.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: Bɛnu ka bebunkune bamɛni ɔdi biala úti uleku unwi, na ɔɔnu nwuna bebi ku kaduli bekyuli ƒui lɛlɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Na bebunkune bani mɔɔda bana kabla kaduɛ ni, ama alati bebo kenyekɔ kabuni na Katɔti anumi. Na baakana na beesé kayi taasu bana bɔƒɔtaadi etemila ɔ́si Yesu Kristo bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: Na nsia lɛnu ka ndububo uwi klukui kemmo mbanu-ɔ. Nsu muunweni ala amɛni lite-ɔ kalɛ na si mɔɔkpɛ kama ni, na ebunku-ɔ na ati kalɛ na ada ƒula lɛlɔ aani ɔtɔnkune na Katɔti ɔtɔ bebi akɔ. Na ngba ƒui Katɔti ɔtɔ bebi bani ndi baƒɔtaadine kasala ni, baagyumana nwuna litemi geen.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Katɔti litemi kedee lɛni na bédie keyi ni, lɛ́ƒɔ kuye geen na ukyuli biala ulakana na weni-ni. Ani ndi ka, “Blɔti úbo aani ɔyawine ubi. Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́gyila-nwu na kúte-nwu ubo. Na katɔ batu bánu-nwu. Na bekyuli bákɔ-nwu lɛlɔ lɛsa na kadi ƒui akɔ. Bekyuli pii báƒɔ-nwu bádi na kayawi. Na Katɔti úti-nwu úsienku katɔ.”

english_verse: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
translation_verse: Katɔti Kɔyu kuudie taasu-bu nwaa ka ni, asa na emeyi ekplodi adubudu ni, bekyuli badi badubɔlɛ bɔƒɔtaadi litemi geen lɛmɛni kama na basiaku ayu ekpidi katɔlɔ ku bani néti lɛlɔ béte ukisine ɔmmɔ ala bɔtina kama.

english_verse: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni mɔɔtina ɔkɔ ala, na baabɛla ama alati bana likyulikpi, ɔsika bana kayi kaladu-ma kɔtɔ.

english_verse: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.
translation_verse: Na baatina banii utalɛka bekyuli beti beleku. Na baasu banii batadi adila lidu lɛdi bene lɛnɔ. Nsu Katɔti nédie adila ƒui úse kalɛ na bani náƒɔ-nwu litemi geen bádi na basiaku-nwu kama ni, badi-nya ku linugya.

english_verse: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
translation_verse: Na sɔsɔ ni, lɛla biala na Katɔti údie ni, lɛdia. Anwuɔsu útalɛka bekyuli beni lɛdila lɛdi. Mmomu ɔlɛka baka Katɔti enu bɔgya na ana lili.

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti litemi ku bula linugya lɛ́bla adila ammɔ kedee.

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: Si átina ƒula banwa ala amɛni ni, mmɔ na adubɔbla Yesu Kristo kabla ubunkune buni. Na bɔƒɔtaadi etemila amɛni ku bula ala bɔtina bɔni kama na asia ni, anya muute-ɔ kenyekɔ kamɛni.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu da lɛlɔ mami kɔbɔ ala batɛmine ku atɛ keeke ani neeebo kɔsia lɛlɔ. Na ataatɛya Katɔti etemila na asiaku-nya kama kpakplaa, na elie ngba buni aani ɔƒɔtaadine kalɛ.

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na bunye kabla lɛlɔ kpakplaa na buubó abi. Ɔsika bula anu asia ngba ƒui Katɔti ɔni ndi bekyuli ƒui Ɔƒɔne lɛlɔ. Na bani geen na ɔdubo bɔƒɔ ndi bani náƒɔ-nwu bádi.

english_verse: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
translation_verse: Na ala amɛni na ɔlɛka atina-ma.

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Taya na ukyuli ɔdi ɔnu-ɔ ɔnii ásɔ ka adi ɔnamu ɔsu. Mmomu ni, nwini asogya te baƒɔtaadine bammɔ ƒui na ƒula kɔtɛ ku udu ku ƒula bekyuli bɔyɔ ku bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo ku ƒula kedee bulie lɛnɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Nye kpakplaa na ataaka Katɔti litemi lɛmmɔ na ataakɔ-ni lɛsa teete baƒɔtaadine ƒui. Na eteedie-ni kalɔ na ataatina-ma ala ammɔ wetédu uwi ɔni na mebo.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti Kɔyu kemmo kabla etela ani na úti ɔ́kya-a lɛlɔ kemmo ɔkɛnku nwuna kenye bediene ku baƒɔtaadine benengu bani néti enu básia-a lɛlɔ ni, tada-nya taya.

english_verse: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
translation_verse: Ya na ƒula kasusu kasia ɔmɛni lɛlɔ, na ataabla-nya taasia kama kalɛ na bekyuli ƒui banu ƒula ngba buni bulie lɛtɔtɔ busie bati.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Da lɛlɔ kaduɛ ku ala ani na aatina. Nye kabla kammɔ lɛlɔ kpakplaa. Ɔsika si ábla lɛni ni, adubudie awɔ ku bekyuli bani ƒui muunú ƒula litemi lɛmmɔ alɛku kɔtu bɔni kemmo.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Tadɔnku ukyuli ɔni nábi lɛlɔ utulo-ɔ momoomo. Mmomu die ala kalɔ te-nwu ku kayi buɛɛ aani ƒula ɔti kalɛ. Na ada bakloƒu aani banwani kalɛ.

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: Da beleku bani nábi lɛlɔ bétulo-ɔ aani ƒula beni kalɛ. Na ada begblebi lɛnɔ aani ƒula banwani belekubi, na ataabla lɛlɔ kedee.

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Bekpinele bani neeebo bebunkune ni, da-ma kaduɛ ku ɔbu.

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Nsu si ukpinele ɔdi ubo bebi iye bawɔ ni, bebi bammɔ bese kalɔ bataatɛya bana kaduli bekyuli bɔda ku bana bawɔne bɔda aani bana bɔƒɔtaadi kabla kalɛ. Ɔmmɔ mɔɔtina ka beesé bana bawɔne kɔdɛ. Ɔmɛni mɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti kaƒɔ.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Na ukpinele ɔni neeebo ubunkune ni, uuti nwuna anu ƒui taasia Katɔti lɛlɔ na ɔɔkpali Katɔti usien ku ɔƒɛ ka ɔɔwia-nwu kebunku ɔsu.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Nsu ukpinele ɔni mɔɔbla lɛyalɛ ni, uuubo ngba na Katɔti anumi ina ka uli ngba.

english_verse: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
translation_verse: Bo-ma ɔda na ala amɛni lɛlɔ kalɛ na beletemi belewi-ma.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Na si bina akɔ ɔdi úni na uláda nwuna kaduli bekyuli kaduɛ ni, agyi anii ɔɔɔsiaku bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ kama, na nwuna litemi líbie litulo ukyuli ɔni nátaƒɔ útadi.

english_verse: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka bekyuli bataalɔ-nwu lɛnyi lɛbuni na nwuna ala abuni bɔbla ɔsu. Na ɔdi uleku ɔni nányuɛ nwuna bebi kaduɛ na ɔɔƒɔ́ baƒɔ. Ɔlɛka ɔbla uleku ɔni na ubo kɔnu ute nwuna baƒɔtaadine bakpana. Na uute bekyuli ƒui kebunku na bana lɛbibo kemmo. Na sɔsɔ ni, úti nwuna ngba bulie ƒui úte lɛbuni bɔbla.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Bekpinele bani nétedu tɔ akwa liti ku leevu ni, teti bana anyi tebunku bekpinele lɛkpa lɛmɛni. Ɔsika si ɔlɔna kɔgya bulie emini eekpóku-ma ni, badubɔlɛ Kristo kama na betélie agya bamba.

english_verse: and become guilty of breaking their promise to him.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na baƒiɔ linyese lɛni nkya ama ku Katɔti ntɛ na ɔdu-ma kɔtɔ.

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, badububile uwi na bakɛ kɔnu bete bekyuli kɔduli bɔvi bataatɛmi atɛ keeke. Na ukpidi ƒui ndi ka ni, badubutaalɔ bekyuli anyikpi na beteekeyi atɛ. Na bataatɛmi bekyuli lɛlɔ kɔtɛ ku ala abambadi ani na útalɛka basu.

english_verse: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, mɔɔyɔ́ ka bekpinele bamɛni udu belie agya na bawɔ bebi na bataanu bana kɔduli ala lɛlɔ mmomu. Ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na balabla ala ani nátamanku na wete bula bekisine kuƒi na bataasu ala taasiku-bu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Si ukpinele ɔdi ɔkya ɔƒɔtaadine ɔdi kaduli ni, anwu ɔnu-nwu lɛlɔ kalɛ na etila ammɔ asɔ alasia Katɔti baƒɔtaadine lɛlɔ. Na ɔya na baƒɔtaadine bamɛni bataanu bekpinele bakladi bani neeebo bebunkune lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Na baƒɔtaadine batɔnkune bani mɔɔtɔnku bekyuli kaduɛ ni, ɔlɛka bakɛ lɛyuƒɔla lɛni nésie anumi. Na ɔni ntulo ƒui ndi bani mɔɔtina ala na baasu litemi buni lɛnɔ.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika básu na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo banini, “Tenyimi ebuo ɔni muuwile edula teete-ɔ kenye si unye kabla lɛlɔ.” Lɛnɔ ni, “Ɔlɛka kabla biala ɔblane ɔkɛ nwuna kabla lɛlɔ lɛyuƒɔla.”

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔdi úbo ɔɔdá ɔtɔnkune ɔdi kenye ni, taƒɔ taadi si bétedu nkyuli inyɔ ku kama.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani nli nte ekpidi bɔbla ni, ɔlɛka edie alɛ-ma na adɔnku-ma na baƒɔtaadine ƒui anumi. Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔkya bakladi liƒu.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu mɔɔlɛ-ɔ na Katɔti ku Kristo ku Katɔti batu ƒui anumi nnii sia ala amɛni anu kaduɛ na alanu ukyuli ɔdi anumi alabla lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Wi lɛlɔ buɛɛ na tababla eti enu asia ɔdi lɛlɔ na ese-nwu likpo ete Katɔti kabla. Na tenye ekpidi bablane kama, mmomu da lɛlɔ sɛɛn.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: Na ƒula kaƒɔ ɔlɛ ɔsu ni, tasu anii ataani ntu lɛti. Ɔdia ka ataani ntɛ blii blii kuvo kalɛ.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Bekyuli badi ekpidi eeebo ɔbɛ ɔni na anya alati áaka bana litemi kɔtɔ bɔdu budie bɔtina. Nsu badi ama ni, kama kama asa na ama adi lɛnɔ aalɛ́ keyi.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na ala abuni adi bɔbla lɛnɔ eeebo ɔbɛ, na ani nábɛ lɛnɔ adubɔlɛ keyi.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: Su baƒɔtaadine bani mɔɔbla bekyuli bamba kabla ƒui anii ɔlɛka beboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bete bana benwoti na kabla biala kemmo, kalɛ na bekyuli bamba balatɛmi kɔbɔ ala balásiku Katɔti ku bula bɔƒɔtaadi ulu ala bɔtina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔbla kabla teete benwoti bani ndi baƒɔtaadine ni, beteti bana bɔƒɔtaadi kɔnwa bɔdi batata betenye bana benwoti lɛlɔ. Mmomu ɔlɛka beboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na bete-ma kebunku bebu. Ɔsika bekyuli bani na beete kebunku mɛni ni, basiaku Yesu kama. Na ama ku-ma ƒui badi nwuna ala badine bani na ɔɔyɔ́ geen. Ɔmɛni na ɔlɛka atina-ma anii babla na akya-ma ogya. Anumi Egyie-ɔ Na Katɔti Kama Bɔsiaku Kemmo

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔtina ala bamba ani naaasiaku bula bɔƒɔtaadi ulu ɔni nkɛnku Blɔti Yesu Kristo litemi geen lɛlɔ ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ na ɔɔɔgyi lɛla lɛdi. Unyeƒi ukpludi ku kadɔ kani na ɔɔkya. Ɔmɛni ɔɔyá na anumi ekpidi eegyie bekyuli, na baadɔ, na beedumi lɛlɔ, na beeti lɛlɔ kasusu kekpidi.

english_verse: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
translation_verse: Na baaní ala teenene uwi biala. Bekyuli bamɛni kasusu kékpi-ma na báyila litemi geen lɛmmɔ. Baakali banii badubɔsia bɔƒɔtaadi ulu lɛlɔ na beyile bana aƒo.

english_verse: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, si anumi eegyie ukyuli na Katɔti kama bɔsiaku kemmo na ala ani na ubo aaƒɔ́-nwu anu ni, uunwíni ɔlakɛne.

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔni na báwɔ-bu ni, bɔɔɔda lɛla lɛdi búteboku kayawi. Na si búkpi lɛnɔ ni, buleti lɛla lɛdi bulatɔlɔku.

english_verse: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛya na bula adala ku adila ani bubo emo-bu.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bani na anumi eegyie-ma na lɛkɛ lɛlɔ ni, baanú kakpagyuɛ kani na Satan ɔ́kywɛ-ma. Na beeduo adɔlɔla bɔbla kemmo, na ɔlɔna alaekpidi ala bɔbla aada-ma ɔkwɛ na eebile bana ngba keliela na beekpi taayii ku udu.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Ɔsika sika lɛnungyie kemmo na ekpidi lidu lidu lɛɛkwɛ́ taasi. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na bekyuli badi báyila bɔƒɔtaadi ulu geen ɔmmɔ. Na bana ngba ƒui búduo lɛbibo kemmo. Nye Bɔƒɔtaadi Kabla Lɛlɔ Kpakplaa

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Nsu ka adi ukyuli ɔni na éti lɛlɔ éte Katɔti ɔsu ni, die ala amɛni ƒui atu na eti ƒula anu asia lɛbuni bɔbla lɛlɔ. Sia Blɔti kama na bɔƒɔtaadi ku bɔyɔ kemmo. Kɛ kayi na ada bekyuli buɛɛ.

english_verse: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
translation_verse: Nye bɔƒɔtaadi kabla lɛlɔ kpakplaa na adi lɛlɔ na akɛ ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔyii kudii. Ngba bɔmɛni ɔsu na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna-a uwi ɔni na édie ƒula lɛlɔ kalɔ na baƒɔtaadine bakladi anumi.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔni nédie lɛla biala ku Yesu Kristo ɔnii nése kayi na údie nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi keyi na Pontio Pilato anumi muudie-mi kenye ka muute-ɔ ɔda bubo bɔmɛni.

english_verse: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-ɔ nnii da ala amɛni kaduɛ kalɛ na ukyuli ɔdi ulasu lɛla likpidi lɛdi na ƒula lɛlɔ wetédu uwi ɔni na Yesu Kristo wasɔ webo.

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔdubɔya na Yesu Kristo wasɔ webo na uwi ɔni námanku lɛlɔ. Katɔti Ɔyɔne ɔmɛni lɛti mɔɔdi lɛla biala lɛlɔ, na anwu ndi bagadine ƒui Ɔga. Na lɛla biala lɛɛlɔ-nwu lɛnii Unwoti.

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: Anwu lɛti nli ngba ɔni na ulekpi kudi kudii. Na uukeye ɔni na ukyuli ɔdi ulakana-nwu anumi bɔda bɔlɛ. Ukyuli ɔdi útanu-nwu kudii na ɔdi lɛnɔ ulakana-nwu bɔnu. Na bumwi ku ɔyikun ɔdi anwu ɔdi úsela ƒui. Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: Su ama bani mbo kayawi ala pii anii batatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ na beteti bana anu batasia ala ani udu naaakana-ma bɔƒɔ lɛlɔ. Mmomu beti bana anu basia Katɔti lɛlɔ. Anwu muute-bu lɛla biala ku kaƒɔ ƒaa kalɛ na bɔkɛ lɛlɔyɔ.

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: Su-ma anii bataabla lɛbuni kalɛ na benwini balakɛne na lɛƒɔndia bɔbla kemmo. Na beteete bekyuli ala ku kaƒɔ ƒaa.

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: Si bábla lɛni ni, badubɔkɛ ala ani naaayii udu bese lɛlɔ kama. Na badubuƒie ngba geen bɔmmɔ bada.

english_verse: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
translation_verse: Timoteo, nu ka ágyumana ala ani na béti béte-ɔ bɔda kaduɛ. Takya atɛ keeke ku kɔdɔlɔ unyeƒi kenye. Anya na bekyuli badi beeti taatɔlɔ bekyuli banii lɛlati lɛdi kenye.

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Ɔsika badi baasu banii bagyi ala amɛni. Nsu ɔkɛnku ɔmɛni ɔsu na báyila bɔƒɔtaadi ulu ɔmmɔ. Muuvele Katɔti nnii ɔda-mii kaduɛ na nwuna lɛƒɔndia kemmo.

english_verse: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
translation_verse: Ami Paulo ɔni nkɛnku Katɔti lɛƒɔyɔ lɛlɔ na ndi Yesu Kristo ɔtalane ni, ami muunweni-ɔ ɔku ɔmɛni taasiku ngba bɔni na bɔdubɔkɛ na Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ na abu ku-nwu unwi bɔbla kemmo.

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: Mina ubi ɔyɔne Timoteo, muuvele Katɔti ku Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛƒɔndia nnii lɛsiaku-ɔ na lɛnu-ɔ kɔnyana na lite-ɔ keyi buɛɛ. Nye Kpakplaa Na Bɔƒɔtaadi Kemmo

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: Mɔɔgyá Katɔti ɔni na mɔɔkpá enu aani kalɛ kani na mina bati kuuku bátaabla. Na mɔɔbla lɛni na kayi kani naaadu-mi kɔtɔ kemmo. Lɛnɔ ni, mɔɔgyá-nwu enu usien ku ɔƒɛ na muuvele na ƒula lili si mɔɔkpali katɔ.

english_verse: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔkali taanu ƒula keku kani na éwulo na mɔɔwia geen ka lɛnu-ɔ kalɛ na ebiti ada-mi.

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: Mɔɔkali taanu ƒula bɔƒɔtaadi kpakplaa bɔni na ebo. Bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ nákya ƒ'inieku Lois ku ƒ'ini Eunike alati kemmo. Lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di ka awɔ lɛnɔ ebo-mu.

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: Kasusu kamɛni geen ɔsu na muunyimene-ɔ kalɛ na ada litela lɛni na Katɔti úte-ɔ kpakplaa uwi ɔni na líti mina enu lɛ́sia-a lɛlɔ na lɛ́kpali katɔ.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti úteti kɔyu kɔni náya na liƒu litaada-bu útete-bu. Mmomu ni, úte-bu Kɔyu kɔni mɔɔyá na bɔɔkɛ́ ɔyikun, na bɔɔyɔ́ lɛlɔ, na bɔɔkana na bɔɔtí lɛlɔ bɔda lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, taya na kɔƒa kukpo-ɔ ka enye Blɔti litemi kama, iye kɔƒa kukpo-ɔ na mina lɛlɔ aani ɔtɔntɛne kalɛ na Kristo ɔsu. Mmomu ni, awɔ lɛnɔ nye lɛbibo lɛmmɔ kenye kpakplaa na eteedie Blɔti litemi buni lɛmmɔ keyi. Ɔsika Katɔti úte-ɔ ɔyikun kalɛ na akana na abla ɔmɛni.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: Blɔti ɔmmɔ náƒɔ-bu ngba na ɔ́lɔ-bu ɔnii bunwini nwuna bekyuli. Ɔɔɔdi bula lɛbuni lɛni na bɔ́bla ɔsu. Mmomu ni, Katɔti ɔmmɔ ɔlati kasusu ku lɛƒɔndia lɛni na ubo ute-bu ɔsu. Na ɔkɛ Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ na bɔ́kɛ Katɔti lɛƒɔndia lɛmɛni asa na údie kayawi.

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒɛni na Katɔti údie ɔmɛni ɔ́tina-bu nwaa na Ɔƒɔne Yesu Kristo ɔmɛni bubo kemmo. Anwu nádi kukpi ɔyikun lɛlɔ. Na ɔkɛ nwuna litemi buni lɛlɔ ni, údie ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii keyi.

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: Katɔti úti-mi ɔ́bla lɛsa ɔkɔne ku ɔtalane ku nwuna litemi buni lɛmɛni ala ɔtinane.

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛ ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ɔsu muubó abi na kɔƒa kulekpo-mi. Ɔsika lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di geen, na ngyi ukyuli ɔni lɛlɔ na mina anu asia. Na ngyi lɛnɔ ka ɔdubɔgyumana-mi na lɛda lɛla lɛni na úti ɔ́kya-mii enu kemmo kaduɛ wetédu limeyi lɛkladi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Da etemila geen ani na lɛ́tina-a ƒui kaduɛ na abla asiaku-nya lɛlɔ. Nye bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kpakplaa na abla unwi ku Yesu Kristo na bɔyɔ kemmo.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛ Katɔti Kɔyu ɔyikun ɔni nkya-bu lɛlɔ kemmo ɔsu ni, da ala abuni ani ƒui na Blɔti úti ɔ́kya-a enu kemmo kaduɛ.

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: Agyi ka Asiaƒuɔ baƒɔtaadine ƒui bálɛ-mi kama, na Ƒigelo ku Hermegene lɛnɔ báda-mi bése.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Muuvele Katɔti nnii ɔnu Onesiƒoro ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli kɔnyana, ɔsika kɔƒa kútekpo-nwu na mina lɛlɔ aani ɔtɔntɛne kalɛ. Mmomu ɔ́kya-mi lɛlɔ na úbunku-mi kaduɛ.

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na úbo Roma ni, ɔ́wia-mi ɔ́vi laa útédu uwi ɔni na ɔ́nu-mi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Na muuvele Katɔti nnii ɔnu-nwu kɔnyana na Litemi Bɔtɛ Limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Awɔ ɔlati agyi kɔlɛ kɔlɛ kɔni na úbunku-mi na Eƒeso.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Na awɔ, mina ubi, kya ɔkplu na bula unwi bɔbla ku Kristo na nwuna lɛƒɔndia lɛni na ubo ute-bu kemmo.

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: Na ala ani na énu ka lɛ́tina bekyuli pii anumi ni, anya kani na ɔlɛka eti akya bekyuli bani náƒɔ bádi enu kemmo na beti-nya batina bekyuli bamba lɛnɔ.

english_verse: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
translation_verse: Nye lɛbibo lɛmmɔ kenye kpakplaa aani ukpone ɔbuni ɔni nnye ute Yesu Kristo.

english_verse: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukpone ɔni nnye nwuna kabla lɛlɔ geen ni, ɔɔwia ka nwuna ablala ada nwuna ɔtɔnkune ebiti. Anwuɔsu ɔsɔ ulakya bekyuli bani naaadi bekpone ablala kenye.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Umonsene ɔni nábla kogyoklo geen na nwuna kemmo ni, anwu mɔɔka edula ammɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
translation_verse: Kali ala ani mɔɔsu-ɔ mɛni ƒui nu, ɔsika ngyi nnii Blɔti ɔdubɔya na enu ana ƒui kalɔ.

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: Nyimo Yesu Kristo ɔni ndi Dawid kaba kemmo ubi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́gyila ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ aani kalɛ na litemi buni lɛni mɔɔsu mɛni lɛɛtina.

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: Muubó abi na litemi buni lɛni mɔɔsu ɔsu. Na bébo-mi lɛkpu muedi aani ukyuli ɔni na ubo lɛkanta likpidi. Nsu Katɔti litemi ni, bétebo-ni lɛkpu!

english_verse: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na mɔɔƒɔ́ lɛla biala teebweli na Katɔti bekyuli baƒunadi ɔsu, kalɛ na ama lɛnɔ bakɛ bɔƒɔ bɔni na Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ kani na bɔɔsia na buuti ngba ƒui lɛlɔ bɔyɔ teete-bu.

english_verse: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
translation_verse: Kenye kamɛni kadi litemi geen ka ni, “Si bɔ́bla unwi ku Blɔti na nwuna kukpi kemmo ni, bɔdubɔsɔ bɔta buliku-nwu ngba.

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: Si bɔ́kana na bunye kpakplaa na lɛbibo biala kemmo ni, abu ku-nwu bɔdubɔdi lɛga. Na si buuní-nwu ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔdubuni-bu.

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: Si ina bɔlɛ bula bɔƒɔtaadi kama muedi ni, anwu ulálɛ nwuna linyese kama. Ɔsika ulakana na walɛ anwu ɔlati lɛlɔ kama kudii.” Da Lɛlɔ Kaduɛ Na Katɔti Uwi-ɔ Livo

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Ya na beteenyimo ala amɛni na alɛ-ma kpakplaa na Katɔti anumi anii batataakya unyeƒi. Ɔsika kɔsia kɔdi kulálɛ ɔmmɔ kemmo. Mmomu ɔdubɔya na bekyuli bani muunú ala ammɔ bɔƒɔtaadi bɔyuɛ.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Da lɛlɔ kaduɛ na ulu biala lɛlɔ na Katɔti uwi-ɔ livo. Taya na kɔƒa kuteekpo-ɔ na ƒula kabla lɛlɔ. Mmomu bla ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtina Katɔti litemi lɛmmɔ geen.

english_verse: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
translation_verse: Die lɛlɔ na kɔbɔ ala ku kɔdɔlɔ atɛ bɔtɛmi kemmo. Ɔsika bekyuli bani na baabla ala amɛni udu ni, uudie bana kasusu na Katɔti kudɔ teesienku ɔgyu kakaaka.

english_verse: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
translation_verse: Ala ammɔ udu bɔtina ese aani lɛnyama lɛni mɔɔnyi. Na nkyuli inyɔ bani nátina ala ammɔ udu ndi Himeneo ku Ƒileto.

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: Bénwini kama bákya litemi geen lɛmmɔ na bakya beeƒú baƒɔtaadine badi kasusu banii bula ngba bɔsɔ bɔta bubelieku Katɔti búubo búbavi.

english_verse: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Katɔti ɔtɔ kalɔ lɛtabi lɛni na ɔ́kya ni, lɛla biala lilakana-ni bɔkunku. Na lɛtabi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ni, únweni etemila amɛni ɔ́sia ɔnini, “Blɔti ɔgyi bekyuli bani ndi anwu badi,” ku “Ukyuli ɔni masu ɔnii ɔsiaku Blɔti ni, ɔlɛka unwini kama ɔkya ekpidi bɔbla.”

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: Na ɔlakɛne ɔtɔ ni, akyami lidu lidu liisé. Na adi adi sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi. Na adi lɛnɔ adi kavɔ ku kanwi akyami. Na akyami amɛni lɛlɔ kabla ni, adi ese ete emeyi buni bɔdi. Na adi lɛnɔ emeyi keeke bɔƒuƒuɛ na ese ete.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́da lɛlɔ údie likpidi kemmo na ɔ́bla lɛlɔ sɛɛn ni, anwu náƒɔ Blɔti kuye aani akyami ani nse nte emeyi buni bɔdi. Na ɔ́manku ute ka ɔbla kabla kabuni.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Da atu die lɛkloƒu bɔdi ala keeke kama bɔsiaku kemmo. Na abla lɛla biala ulu lɛlɔ, na elie ɔƒɔtaadine ngba buni, na ataayɔ bekyuli, na elieku-ma ku keyi buɛɛ. Siaku ala amɛni ku bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔkpali Blɔti ku kayi sɛɛn kama.

english_verse: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
translation_verse: Da lɛlɔ mami kɔbɔ ala ku kɔdɔlɔ atɛ batɛmine lɛlɔ, ɔsika kadɔ na ala ammɔ udu eeboku.

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: Na utalɛka ukyuli ɔni na ɔɔtɔnku Blɔti bekyuli utaadɔ. Mmomu ɔdi ka utaabla lɛƒɔndia teete ukyuli biala, na ɔkana ala butaatina, na ɔbla ukyuli ɔni na use buɛɛ.

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔta teenye litemi buni lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ni, ɔlɛka udie ala kalɔ ute-ma ku kayi buɛɛ. Na ɔƒɛni kalɛ Katɔti ɔdubɔya na benwini kayi na banu litemi geen lɛmmɔ bati.

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu bana kasusu kadubɔlɛmi na balɛ Satan ɔni néti-ma únwini nwuna lɛƒɔyɔ bablane kakpagyuɛ kemmo.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: Se ɔmɛni likpo ka ni, na emeyi ekplodi kemmo ni, likyulikpi lɛdubɔya na keliela kayu ɔkplu.

english_verse: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
translation_verse: Bekyuli badubɔyɔ bana lɛlɔ lɛti bɔdia na bayɔ egulabi. Badubo lɛmɛnɛ butaakun na bataatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ. Ama ndi bekyuli bani muudumi bekyuli, ku bani naaabu bana bawɔne. Na belese kɔdɛ, ku bekyuli bani naaasiaku bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ kama.

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: Badi bekyuli bani na ukyuli bamba lɛlɔ lilakywi-ma kaƒɔ, ku bani naaanu kɔnyana. Badi bekyuli bani mɔɔnyi ɔkɔ taada litemi taasia bekyuli lɛlɔ, ku bekyuli bani mbo kalala. Na bana anumi eeese buɛɛ. Na badi bekyuli bani nkisi lɛla lɛbuni.

english_verse: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
translation_verse: Badi bekyuli bani mɔɔkya bana bakpana kakya. Na badi bekyuli bani nábi basiaku bana lɛnunsia kama, ku bekyuli bani mɔɔkali banii ama kani ntulo ku bekyuli bani mɔɔyɔ́ kayawi ebiti teetulo Katɔti.

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni udu mɔɔtina ku kenyekplu ka badi bekyuli babuni, nsu beení Katɔti ɔyikun ka ɔdi-ma lɛlɔ na bana keliela kemmo. Da lɛlɔ mamiku bekyuli bamɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bamɛni udu ni, baabɛ́ teeduo bekyuli kɔduli na baadi beleku bani naaakana bana lɛlɔ bɔda lɛlɔ, ɔsika ekpidi lidu lidu bɔbla bɔ́ya na beeebo bunwini teewi.

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: Beleku bamɛni baatɛya ala uwi ƒui, nsu belenu etemila geen ammɔ kalɔ kudii.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Na aani kalɛ na Yane ku Yambri báta bénye Mose lɛlɔ dii ni, lɛni kani na ɔkɔ ala batinane bamɛni lɛnɔ baata teenye litemi geen lɛmɛni lɛlɔ. Bekyuli bamɛni badi bekyuli bani na likpidi bɔbla bɔ́ƒɔ-ma kasusu ƒui, na báyila baƒɔtaadine geen bɔmmɔ ulu.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Nsu ni, bekyuli bamɛni belésie ɔgyu, ɔsika bana kɔkwɛ kukpidi kɔdubɔlɛ keyi na bekyuli ƒui anumi aani bani nábla udu ɔmɛni bávi kalɛ kani. Blɔti Ɔdubudie-ɔ Ɔlɛku Ɔgbankpi Biala Kemmo

english_verse: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ ni, áanu mina ala bɔtina áti ku mina ngba keliela ku mina kasusu ku mina bɔƒɔtaadi ku kalɛ na muuwi lɛlɔ ku kalɛ mɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli ku kalɛ na mɔɔkya ɔkplu na lɛbibo kemmo.

english_verse: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.
translation_verse: Agyi kalɛ na básiaku-mi na békpoku-mi ku abi ani na líbo na Antiokia ku Ikonion ku Listra. Kali nu bukpoku bɔni kemmo na línye kpakplaa. Nsu na ɔna ƒui kemmo ni, Blɔti údie-mi.

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka ni, bekyuli bani ƒui melie ngba buni na Kristo kemmo ni, badububo abi na bekpoku-ma.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bekpidi ku ɔkɔ ala batinane ama ni, bubie bɔmmɔ bɔdubɔkɔ-ma katɔ bubu na bataatɔlɔ bekyuli. Na bana ɔbladu ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔtɔlɔ ama alati lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ ni, mɔɔwia ka enye ala ani na atɛya na áƒɔ ádi lɛnɔ lɛlɔ kpakplaa. Ɔsika agyi bekyuli bani kudɔ na átɛya-nya.

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: Ka ɔ́si-ɔ lɛnamu uwi ni, áti Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo etemila ani náya-a na áda anu na ebo ngba bɔƒɔ etemila ɔkɛ Kristo bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔyikun lɛlɔ na bɔ́sia bɔ́kɛ ala ani ƒui bénweni na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo. Na ɔdia ute ala bɔtina ku ukyuli bɔdɔnku ku bɔklibi ku bɔnyuɛ na ngba buni bulie kemmo.

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Bénweni-nya kalɛ na ukyuli biala ɔni néti lɛlɔ úte Katɔti wamanku na ɔklibi-nwu ute ala abuni bɔbla.

english_verse: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
translation_verse: Nnye Katɔti ku Kristo ɔni ndubɔsɔ ubo ubatɛku bayawine ku bekpine litemi anumi. Na ka ɔdubɔsɔ ubo na nwuna lɛga bɔdi kemmo ɔsu ni, mɔɔlɛ-ɔ kpakplaa nnii

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: si bebo kɔnu o-o, iye beeebo kɔnu o-o ni, die litemi buni lɛmmɔ kenye. Klibi-ma, na adɔnku-ma, na akya-ma ogya. Na si eedie ala kalɔ taatina-ma ni, na ewi lɛlɔ na akɛku-ma kayi geen.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Ɔsika uwi ɔdi ɔdubo ɔni na bekyuli basɔ baaadubo litemi buni lɛmɛni bɔda. Mmomu badubɔwia ala bamba batinane bete lɛlɔ na bataasu-ma ala ani udu na baawia beteenu.

english_verse: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
translation_verse: Badubo kama bunwini bɔkya litemi buni lɛmɛni na basiaku etemila anwidi kama.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Na awɔ ni, da lɛlɔ kaduɛ na ulu biala lɛlɔ, na ataakya ɔkplu na lɛbibo biala kemmo. Na abla kabla aani litemi buni lɛmɛni lɛsa ɔkɔne. Na abla ƒula baƒɔtaadine ɔtɔnkune kabla ƒui kaduɛ.

english_verse: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ami ni, mina ngba bɔdaku kalɔ buwi aani ntɛ lɛkpa. Na uwi lɛnɔ úudu ka lɛtɔlɔ kayawi kamɛni kemmo.

english_verse: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
translation_verse: Líkpo kekpo kabuni na lɛ́wɔlɔ mina kabla aani usi ukeline buni kalɛ. Na lɛ́da mina bɔƒɔtaadi na Kristo kemmo útédu kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si ɔƒɛni ni, Katɔti ɔ́ɔklibi mina kabwa kani mɔɔtina ka lílie ɔƒɔtaadine ngba ulu lɛlɔ úse-mi. Ɔdi kabwa kani na Blɔti ɔni mɔɔtɛ bula ƒui litemi ulu lɛlɔ ɔdubo-mi bute limeyi likplodi lɛmmɔ. Na ɔɔɔdi ami lɛti pɛ ndubɔkɛ-ka, mmomu ami ku bani ƒui lɛnɔ nsia anu bete Blɔti bɔsɔ bubo bɔmmɔ. Yile-mi Bubanu

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Sia ulu biala lɛlɔ na eyile-mi bubanu.

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Dema ɔ́tɔlɔ-mi kudɔ na ɔsiaku kayawi ala kama úsie Tesalonika. Na Kreske anwu ni, úsie Galatia, na Tito úsie Dalmatia.

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Luka lɛti nébu ɔkya-mi kudɔ. Anwuɔsu tiku Marko na bibo, ɔsika ɔdi-mi ubunkune geen.

english_verse: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation_verse: Lɛ́tala Tihiko na Eƒeso.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: Na si adubo ni, ti mina kɔyɔ awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔni na lɛ́da líse Karpo kudɔ na Troia boku-mi. Na eti mina lɛku ku kɔkunkɛ kɔni na mɔɔwia teetulo lɛnɔ boku-mi.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Aleksandro ɔni ndi ɔkywɛne ɔ́bla-mi kalala geen. Na Blɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ-nwu lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla kayu.

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu awɔ lɛnɔ nye kagyumana te-nwu, ɔsika ɔ́ta únye bula ala ani na bɔɔtina lɛlɔ geen.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Kudeedi kɔni na bátɛku-mi litemi ni, ɔdi biala útakana na ubo ubenye-mi litemi kama, mmomu béni-mi bése. Nsu muuvele Katɔti nnii utani-ma kɔtu na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, Blɔti únyeku-mi na ɔ́kya-mi ɔyikun na lɛ́kana lɛ́su Blɔti litemi lɛmmɔ kaduɛ lite bani naaadi Yudaƒuɔ na mmɔ. Na Blɔti údie-mi kukpi kemmo.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Blɔti ɔdubudie-mi na ɔgbankpi biala kemmo, na ɔdubo-mi bɔkpanku buɛɛ buɛɛ na liduo Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma. Bumwi na buute Katɔti ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ƒui. Ɔsia lɛni. Bɔɔkada-a

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: Muugyele Priska ku Akwila ku Onesiƒoro kaduli bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Erasto ɔmu ɔkya Korinto, na Troƒimo anwu uuƒi ɔsu lɛ́da-nwu lɛ́kya Mileto.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Kya ɔkplu na ebo ebeduo mɛni asa udu kɔyɔ uwi. Eubulo ku Pude ku Lino ku Klaudia ku baƒɔtaadine banwa bakladi ƒui beegyele-ɔ o-o!

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Blɔti ɔda-a kɔyu, na muuvele-nwu nnii ɔda-mii kaduɛ na nwuna lɛƒɔndia kemmo.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
translation_verse: Ami Paulo ɔni ndi Katɔti kabla ɔblane ku Yesu Kristo ɔtalane ni, ami muunweni-ɔ ɔku ɔmɛni. Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna-mi na ɔ́tala-mi ɔnii mbunku nwuna bekyuli baƒunadi bɔƒɔtaadi na lɛtɔnku-ma na banu litemi geen lɛni na bula bɔƒɔtaadi ulu ɔɔtina bati.

english_verse: Then they will have the hope of eternal life God promised long ago. And God never tells a lie!
translation_verse: Ulu ɔmɛni ndanku ngba ƒui lɛnunsia lɛni bɔƒɔtaadi na bubo lɛlɔ. Na Katɔti ɔni naaanyi ɔkɔ ɔlati nése-bu kenye kamɛni úse asa na údie kayawi.

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: Ɔyɔne Tito, muunweni-ɔ ɔku ɔmɛni ka adi-mi ubi geen na bɔƒɔtaadi bɔni kemmo bɔkya ɔsu. Na muuvele Katɔti ku Yesu Kristo ɔni ndi bula Ɔƒɔne nnii ɔda-a na nwuna lɛƒɔndia kemmo na ute-ɔ keyi buɛɛ. Paulo Úte Tito Kabla Kadi Na Kreta

english_verse: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
translation_verse: Lɛ́ya-a na ásɔ akya Kreta kalɛ na aklibi ala ani nébu bɔklibi. Na ɔma biala kemmo ni, die benengu bani menye baƒɔtaadine kenye aani kalɛ na lɛ́su-ɔ nnii bla.

english_verse: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɔtaadine unengu ni, útalɛka litemi lɛdi lɛda-nwu. Na ɔdi ukyuli ɔni na úti uleku unwi. Na nwuna bebi lɛnɔ badi bebi bani nda bɔƒɔtaadi kaduɛ, na beeebo atuɔkplu, na baabu bana bawɔne.

english_verse: Church officials are in charge of God's work, and so they must also have a good reputation. They must not be bossy, quick-tempered, heavy drinkers, bullies, or dishonest in business.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɔtaadine ɔtɔnkune ɔni mɔɔnu Katɔti kabla lɛlɔ ni, utalɛka litemi lɛdi lɛda-nwu iye utaakɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ iye uteeti kɔnyi buti buti. Na ɔɔɔdi ka utaani ntɛ teekpi, na ulekpo udi, iye anumi lɛnɔ elégyie-nwu na egulabi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka utaaƒɔ baƒɔ na utaayɔ lɛbuni na ɔda lɛlɔ kaduɛ. Na ɔbla ukyuli ɔni na ubo udu, na use kedee, na ɔɔkana anwu ɔlati lɛlɔ lɛnɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: They must stick to the true message they were taught, so their good teaching can help others and correct everyone who opposes it.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ka uƒie litemi geen lɛmmɔ ɔda kpakplaa aani kalɛ na bɔƒɔtaadi ulu ɔmmɔ ɔɔtina. Na ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ kani na ɔdubɔkana bɔsia na ɔkya bekyuli bamba lɛnɔ ogya na udie bani mɔɔta teenye litemi lɛmɛni lɛlɔ bɔƒiɔ ɔtina-ma.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli pii bakya baatɔ́lɔ bekyuli na baata teenye litemi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ku bana kɔdɔlɔ ala. Na bani mɔɔbla ala ammɔ ketulodikɔ badi Yudaƒuɔ.

english_verse: But you must make them be quiet. They are after money, and they upset whole families by teaching what they should not.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ka enye etile bana ala ammɔ udu bɔtina lɛlɔ, ɔsika ala ammɔ mɔɔyá na kɔduli bekyuli ƒui beeƒú bana bɔƒɔtaadi. Na ala batinane bammɔ lɛkɛ likpidi lɛni baawia ɔsu na baatina ala ekpidi amɛni.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Na Kretani ɔdi ɔni ndi kenye udiene ɔ́su ɔnini, “Kretaƒuɔ ni, ɔkɔ kani na baanyi uwi biala na bebo kalala kekpidi, na baadi ɔdivo, na bebo kɔkɔsɔ lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na kenye udiene ɔmmɔ ɔ́su ɔdi sɔsɔ. Anwuɔsu bɔku-ma na bada udu ɔmɛni baya kalɛ na bakɛ bɔƒɔtaadi geen bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na bada atu bedie Yudaƒuɔ atɛ anwidi ku bekyuli bani néni litemi geen lɛmmɔ ala bɔtina kudɔ.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: Lɛla biala lise kedee lite bekyuli bani alati nse kedee. Nsu bekyuli bani ndi bekyuli bekpidi na balaƒɔ taadi ni, lɛla biala liiise kedee, ɔsika bana kasusu kemmo kéyi ku ala ekpidi, na basɔ balanu lɛbuni ku likpidi taati.

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: Ama alati baasu banii baabu Katɔti, nsu bana ablala alátina lɛni. Badi bekyuli bani muusé lɛlɔ na balábu lɛla lɛdi na bátamanku lɛbuni lɛdi lɛnɔ bɔbla.

english_verse: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.
translation_verse: Nsu awɔ ni, tina ala ani nkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi ulu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
translation_verse: Tina benengu bammɔ ƒui anii ɔdi ka babla anumi ku kasusu nwaa uwi biala. Na bada lɛlɔ kaduɛ ku bana bɔƒɔtaadi, na bataayɔ lɛlɔ, na bataakya ɔkplu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na beleku benengu bammɔ lɛnɔ ni, tina-ma anii belie ngba bɔni námanku beleku bani nse kedee ka belie. Na batataalɔ bekyuli anyikpi. Na ntɛ bɔni lɛnɔ butadi-ma lɛlɔ. Mmomu batina bekyuli udu buni.

english_verse: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
translation_verse: Na batina begblebi bani nlie agya ala kalɛ na bataayɔ bana bagya ku bana bebi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: Na bati lɛlɔ bɔda, na babla lɛlɔ kedee, na babla agya beliene babuni bani muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ teete bana bagya. Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na ukyuli ɔdi ulasu lɛla likpidi lɛdi ulásiku linyesia lɛni nási Katɔti kudɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
translation_verse: Ulu ɔmɛni kani lɛlɔ na ɔlɛka eti akya bakloƒu lɛnɔ ɔkplu kalɛ na bada lɛlɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: Always set a good example for others. Be sincere and serious when you teach.
translation_verse: Na ala amɛni ƒui kemmo ni, awɔ ɔlati ɔlɛka enwini ukyuli ɔni na ɔlɛka banu batɛya. Na enye momoomo na atina ala kaduɛ.

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Ti kalɛ na atɛmiku bekyuli ku etemila ani mbo ɔbu kalɛ na beledie-ɔ bɔƒiɔ bɔdi, na ƒula bekisine lɛnɔ balasu lɛla lɛdi balásiku-bu lɛlɔ, mmomu na kɔƒa kukpo-ma.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔbla bekyuli bamba kabla beboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bete bana batɔlati. Na bana ablala ataada bana batɔlati ebiti na lɛla biala kemmo. Na batakyaku-ma unyeƒi.

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: Beteyu-ma lɛnɔ, mmomu batina-ma ka badi bekyuli babuni na baabla ala ulu lɛlɔ teete-ma. Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na banu bati ka bula ala ani na bɔɔtina na Blɔti ɔni ndi bula Ɔƒɔne lɛlɔ ni, adi ala abuni.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti údie nwuna lɛƒɔndia ɔ́tina-bu na ngba bɔƒɔ bɔni na ubo ute bekyuli bayawine ɔsu.

english_verse: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.
translation_verse: Lɛƒɔndia lɛmmɔ mɔɔtina-bu ka ɔlɛka bɔda atu budie ngba bukpidi bulie kemmo ku kayawi ala keeke kama bɔsiaku. Na bɔda lɛlɔ kaduɛ, na bulie ngba bɔbuni, na bɔbla lɛlɔ kedee na kayawi kamɛni kemmo.

english_verse: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Lɛni na bɔdubuti butaanu ulu bute limeyi libendi lɛni lɛlɔ na bɔsia anu. Limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na Utulone Blɔti, bula Ɔƒɔne, Yesu Kristo bukeye bɔdubɔda bɔlɛ.

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: Úti lɛlɔ úte na bula lili kalɛ na udie-bu na likpidi biala kemmo na bɔbla bekyuli kedee bani ndi nwuna badi kani, na baawia ka bataabla lɛbuni.

english_verse: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
translation_verse: Tina ala amɛni ku kenyekɔ kani na Katɔti úte-ɔ, na akya bekyuli bani ƒui muunú-ɔ litemi ɔkplu, na abɔku bani naaabla taasiaku ulu lɛlɔ lɛnɔ. Na taya na ɔdi ɔnu-ɔ ɔnii ásɔ.

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Na aya na bana ƒui benyimo na beboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bete bana batɔnkune ku lɛlɔ badine, na benu-ma litemi, na bataabla lɛbuni na ulu biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.
translation_verse: Na asu-ma anii batalɔ ukyuli ɔdi lɛnyikpi. Mmomu badi kɔnwa na belie ku keyi buɛɛ. Na bataabu bekyuli na ulu biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: Ɔsika abu alati lɛnɔ bɔ́bla adɔlɔla ku atuɔkplu, na bɔ́ƒiɔ dii. Na ɔlɔna kemmo ala ekpidi áda-bu ɔkwɛ lɛnɔ dii. Na búti bula uwi búte kalala bɔbla ku lɛnungyie, na bekyuli békisi-bu na abu lɛnɔ búkisi-ma.

english_verse: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔni na Blɔti, bula Ɔƒɔne, údie nwuna lɛƒɔndia ku bɔyɔ ɔ́tina-bu ni,

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: ɔ́ƒɔ-bu. Ɔɔɔdi banii bula lɛbuni lɛni na bɔ́bla ɔsu, mmomu Katɔti ɔkɛ anwu ɔlati kɔnyana bɔnu ɔsu na ɔ́ya na nwuna Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-bu. Kɔyu kɔmmɔ mɔɔsɔku-bu taawɔ na kuute-bu ngba bɔwɔdi, na kɔɔyá na bɔɔbla kedee.

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: Katɔti úti nwuna Kɔyu úte-bu ku kuna ɔyikun pii ɔ́siaku bula Ɔƒɔne Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛ nwuna lɛƒɔndia ɔsu ni, abu ku-nwu ntɛ bɔ́dia kalɛ na abu lɛnɔ bɔ́kɛ ngba ƒui bɔni lɛlɔ na bula anu asia.

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Litemi lɛmmɔ lɛdi litemi geen. Na mɔɔwia ka asia-ni lɛkpuna. Na bekyuli bani náƒɔ Katɔti bádi ni, ɔdi ka beti bana uwi bete na bataabla lɛbuni lɛni malɛ kɔsia mete bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Na takyaku ukyuli ɔdi kɔdɔlɔ unyeƒi. Tebile uwi tete kaba bekyuli bɔka bɔdi, tadɔ na ataakya Mose ɔda bubo etemila lɛlɔ unyeƒi ɔdi. Ala amɛni ƒui eeebo kɔsia kɔdi.

english_verse: Warn troublemakers once or twice. Then don't have anything else to do with them.
translation_verse: Bɔku ukyuli ɔni muuƒú bekyuli kasusu na bɔƒɔtaadi litemi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ kunyɔ. Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, na ada atu edie-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Agyi anii ukyuli ɔmmɔ udu ni, likpidi lɛdi-nwu lɛlɔ na nwuna ekpidi muudie nwuna kɔtɔ bɔdu taatina. Kawɔlɔkɔ Kɔtɛ Ku Bɔkada

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: Si lɛ́tala Artema iye Tihiko lɛ́kya-a ni, kya ɔkplu na ebo-mi kudɔ na Nikopoli. Ɔsika mmɔ na lɛ́bla kasusu ka ndubɔkya na kɔyɔ uwi.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Kya ɔkplu na ebunku Sena ɔni mɔɔtɛ litemi teedie bekyuli ku Apolo na bataaklibi lɛlɔ teete bana ulu busie. Na anu ka bákɛ lɛla biala lɛni baawia.

english_verse: Our people should learn to spend their time doing something useful and worthwhile.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ka baƒɔtaadine batɛya kalɛ na beeti bana uwi ƒui taabla lɛbuni lɛni malɛ kɔsia. Na bakana bekyuli bamba lɛnɔ buteebunku na ɔɔɔdi ka bataabla kɔkɔsɔ.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Banwa bani nkya-mi kudɔ mɛni ƒui banii beegyele-mii o-o! Awɔ lɛnɔ gyele banwa baƒɔtaadine bani nkya mmɔ te-bu. Katɔti ɔda bina ƒui na nwuna lɛƒɔndia kemmo.

english_verse: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
translation_verse: Ami Paulo ɔni ntɛ aban ɔtɔ ka mɔɔkɔ́ Kristo Yesu lɛsa ɔsu ku Ɔnwa Timoteo muunweni ɔku ɔmɛni. Na líti muumene awɔ Ƒilemon bula kabla kamɛni ɔblane ɔkpana ɔni na bɔɔyɔ́ geen.

english_verse: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
translation_verse: Buugyele baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛni mɔɔsa na ƒula kaduli ku Ɔnwa Uleku Apia ku Arkipo ɔni nnyeku-bu na Blɔti kabla kamɛni kenye kpakplaa aani ukpone kalɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Na buuvele Katɔti ɔni ndi bula Ɔti ku Blɔti Yesu Kristo bɔnii lɛƒɔndia ku keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-mii. Lɛlɔ Lɛɛyɔ́-mi Na Ƒula Bekyuli Bɔyɔ Ɔsu

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: Ɔnwa Ƒilemon, uwi biala na mɔɔkpali katɔ ni, muunyimo taalɔ-ɔ lɛnyi na mɔɔgyá Katɔti enu na ƒula lili.

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Ɔsika muunú kalɛ na aayɔ́ Katɔti bekyuli ku kalɛ na áƒɔ Blɔti Yesu ádi.

english_verse: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
translation_verse: Bubo ala abuni ani na Kristo ɔsu. Na mɔɔkpali katɔ nnii Katɔti ɔya na ama bani náƒɔ Kristo bádi aani ƒula kalɛ ni, benu ala amɛni kalɔ kaduɛ ɔkɛnku ƒula lɛlɔ.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: Ɔnwa, lɛlɔ lɛ́yɔ-mi geen na ákya-mi ogya na ƒula bekyuli bɔyɔ ɔsu. Ɔsika ánu Katɔti bekyuli lɛlɔ. Paulo Úvele Ka Ƒilemon Ɔsɔ Ɔƒɔ Onesimo

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: Muuvele-ɔ na Onesimo lili ɔni nébenwini mina ubidi na Kristo kemmo uwi ɔni na nkya kɔgba kemmo.

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: Ina ka nwuna lɛnyi kalɔ ndi ubunkune ni, kebunku kani na ɔlɛka ute-ɔ ni, áyila-ka ka úkeli-ɔ kudɔ ɔsu. Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, úbo-mi kudɔ na ɔ́sɔ únwini ami ku awɔ ƒui ubunkune.

english_verse: Sending Onesimus back to you makes me very sad.
translation_verse: Lɛ́sɔku-nwu muumene-ɔ na anwu ndi mina lɛnumi.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒaani ɔni na ntɛ kɔgba kɔmɛni kemmo na litemi buni ɔsu ni, mɔɔyɔ́ ka nka ɔsɔ ɔkya-mi kudɔ na unye-ɔ kenye uteebunku-mi.

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, naaayɔ ka lɛlɛ-ɔ kama lɛbla lɛla lɛdi kalɛ na kebunku biala na eete-mi ni, ulabla aani si bɔnya na nda-a lɛmana, mmomu kalɛ na abla-ni ku kaƒɔ ƒaa.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Ɔƒaalɛ Katɔti ɔ́ya na Onesimo ɔ́tɔlɔ-ɔ kudɔ uwi klukui ɔmɛni kemmo kalɛ na ɔsɔ unwini ubo ubakya-a kudɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, ɔɔɔdubo-ɔ kudɔ aani ukyuli bamba kabla ɔblane kani. Mmomu ɔdi bula ɔnwa ɔyɔne na Kristo kemmo. Ɔ́ƒɔ-mi kuye geen! Nsu awɔ ni, ɔdubɔƒɔ-ɔ kuye utulo-mi. Ɔsika ɔdubo aani ƒula kabla ɔblane ku ƒula ɔnwani na Blɔti kemmo lɛnɔ.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si aanu-mi aani ƒula kabla ɔblane ɔkpana ni, gyingya enu na aƒɔ-nwu aani kalɛ na adubɔƒɔ-mi na ɔsɔ ɔkya-a kudɔ.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: Si ɔ́ƒiɔ-ɔ iye ɔda-a kayu kadi ni, ti-ka kya mina akunta kemmo.

english_verse: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
translation_verse: Ami Paulo ɔlati néti mina kɔnu línweni ɔmɛni. Na ndubɔƒɔ kayu biala nkya. Nsu ni, ɔɔɔdi bɔsu nda-a nnii awɔ ada-mi ƒula ngba kayu na Kristo kemmo.

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔnwa, mɔɔwia ka ete-mi kebunku kamɛni na Blɔti ɔsu. Bla ɔmɛni kalɛ na kubiti kɔda-mi na mina kayi kemmo.

english_verse: I am sure you will do all I have asked, and even more.
translation_verse: Líti ɔku ɔmɛni muumene-ɔ na lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di ka adubɔbla lɛla lɛni na muuye-ɔ mɛni. Na ngyi geen ka adubɔbla etulo kalɛ na muuye-ɔ mɛni muedi.

english_verse: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
translation_verse: Lɛnɔ ni, klibi keduokɔ kadi se-mi. Ɔsika mɔɔƒɔ́ taadi ka Katɔti ɔdubunu ƒula katɔ bɔkpali na banyonu-mi na lɛsɔ libo-ɔ kudɔ. Kawɔlɔkɔ Litemi

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Epaƒra, ɔni na ami ku-nwu bɔtɛ aban ɔtɔ na Kristo Yesu ɔsu, ɔɔkya-a kenye o-o!

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: Marko ku Aristarko ku Dema ku Luka bani ndi mina bebunkune na kabla kamɛni kemmo lɛnɔ beegyele-ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛƒɔndia lɛsiaku-ɔ na ƒula kayi kemmo.

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni návi kemmo ni, Katɔti ɔ́sia nwuna kenye bediene lɛlɔ ɔ́tɛmiku bula bati kuuku kɔlɛ kɔlɛ na lilu bun bun lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: Nsu na uwi ukplodi ɔmɛni kemmo ni, Katɔti ɔ́tɛmiku-bu ɔ́siaku Ubidi lɛlɔ. Ubi ɔmmɔ na ɔ́ƒuna úse ka ɔbla nwuna ala ƒui ɔdine. Na nwuna lɛlɔ kani na ɔ́sia údie kayawi ƒui.

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: Ubi ɔmmɔ ndi Katɔti bukeye bɔni mɔɔsí Katɔti ɔni nse kede kede lɛlɔ. Na ɔdi Katɔti ukyuli udu ɔmmɔ geen. Na ɔkɛnku nwuna litemi lɛni mbo ɔyikun lɛlɔ ɔsu na lɛla biala linye nina kenyekɔ na kayawi. Na uwi ɔni na úti lɛlɔ ɔ́kpa kalɛ na Katɔti uti bayawine ekpidi ɔkyiɛ-ma ni, úsie útélie keliekɔ kenengudi ƒui na Katɔti kɔdianu kakɛ.

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na ubo kenyekɔ utulo Katɔti batu. Na lɛni kani na lɛnyi lɛni na ubo lɛnɔ lɛ́ƒɔ kuye litulo ama lɛdi.

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Ɔsika ni, Katɔti útasu nwuna ɔtu ɔdi dii ɔnini, “Awɔ ndi mina ubi. Na ɔmwi ni, línwini-ɔ ɔti.” Na ɔ́sɔ útasu ɔtu ɔdi ɔnini, “Ami madi-nwu kɔti, na anwu wadi mina ubi.”

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Katɔti Ubi ɔni ntɔ ala ƒui úbo kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bɛya na Katɔti batu ƒui bakɔliku-nwu lɛnyi katɔ.”

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Na etemila ani ndanku Katɔti batu lɛlɔ ni, ɔ́su ɔnini, “Lɛ́bla mina batu na bese aani ɔƒɛƒɛɛ. Na ama bani mɔɔbla mina kabla ni, lɛ́bla-ma na bese aani ogya linyemi.”

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Nsu na Ubidi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ati, awɔ ni, ƒula lɛga kadikɔ kadubo buse uwi ƒui. Na adubɔdi ƒula bekyuli lɛlɔ na ulu siin lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: Awɔ mɔɔyɔ́ lɛla lɛni nse siin, na ekisi ala ani naaakɛ ulu lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu ni, ami ƒula Katɔti lɛ́ƒuna awɔ, Ati, ka akɛ kenyekɔ etulo na bakladi ƒui akɔ. Na lɛ́ya-a na ákɛ lɛlɔyɔ na uwi ɔni na líti nnɔmii líwi-ɔ aani likposela.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “O Blɔti, na kalɔ kesekɔ ni, awɔ nédie kayawi kamɛni ƒui, na éti ƒula enu ábla kayaa.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
