translation_verse: Ala amɛni ƒui adubɔyii udu. Nsu awɔ ni, adubulie uwi ƒui. Ala ammɔ ƒui adubɔtɔ aani adala kuuku kalɛ.

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: Adubɔƒɛ-nya asala aani kalɛ na baaƒɛ awu. Na aani kalɛ na baavumana adala ni, lɛni kani na Katɔti ɔdubo ala ammɔ bɔvumana. Nsu kalɛ kani na awɔ ese ni, lɛni na adubo buse. Na ƒula akwa alása kudii.”

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi na Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Sɔ lie keliekɔ kani náƒɔ kuye ketulo ƒui na mina kɔdianu kakɛ wetédu uwi ɔni na meti ƒula bekisine makya-a lɛgba kalɔ.”

english_verse: Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.
translation_verse: Na nwuna batu ƒui ama ni, ɔɔɔdi ayu ani muusié-nwu bɔtala ka beteebunku bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔdubɔya na bakɛ bɔƒɔ na badi yoo?

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na ɔdi ka bɔbla bɔsiaku ala ani na búnu lɛlɔ kaduɛ na bɔda-nya kpakplaa kalɛ na bulayii ulu geen ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, si kenye kani na Katɔti batu básu bula bati kuuku kábala-ma na Katɔti ɔ́ni ɔdi biala kɔtu kɔni námanku si báƒiɔ ni,

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: dɛ na bɛɛkali bɛnii bɔdubɔkana na bukeli kɔtu bɔni bɔni nse nte-bu si búni ngba bɔƒɔ bonwu bɔmɛni? Bɔƒɔ bɔmɛni lɛsa na Blɔti ɔ́ka bɔkɔ bute-bu. Na bekyuli bani ƒui nénu lɛsa lɛmɛni ni, básia kama na bédie-ni básu-bu nwaa.

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔlati lɛnɔ údie ɔ́tina-bu nwaa ka litemi lɛmɛni lɛdi litemi geen ɔkɛnku akɔla budie taatina lidu lidu ku Katɔti Kɔyu etela lidu lɛni na úle ɔ́kya bekyuli kemmo na nwuna bɔyɔ kenye.

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi Katɔti batu na Katɔti ɔ́su ka badubɔdi kayawi kani litemi na bɔɔsu ka kadububo mɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Nsu likpo lɛdi lɛkya na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo na básu Katɔti banii, “Bi na ukyuli ɔdi, ɔsu na aasia-nwu anu lɛni? Na bi na Ukyuli Ɔyawine Ubi ɔdi, ɔsu na aanu-nwu lɛlɔ lɛni?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Na áya na úbo úbenye kenyekɔ kani náyu kalɔ blii kétulo Katɔti batu bammɔ kadi. Na áya na uukeye na bekyuli baabu-nwu.

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: Na éti lɛla biala ákya-nwu kalɔ.” Ka Katɔti úti lɛla biala ɔ́kya-nwu kalɔ ɔsu ni, lɛla lɛdi lɛsɔ liiibo na lɛɛɛkya-nwu kalɔ. Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, bulánu taati si lɛla biala lɛkya-nwu kalɔ.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Nsu bɔɔnu Yesu ɔni na úbenye kenyekɔ kani náyu kalɔ blii kétulo batu bammɔ kadi ka uukeye na bekyuli baabu-nwu ɔƒɛni, ɔsika úbo kukpi abi. Na Katɔti úte-nwu ɔyikun ka ukpi na bekyuli ƒui lili.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Ɔdi lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔni nédie ala ƒui na ɔɔnu-nya lɛlɔ ɔ́nu ka lɛdia ka ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtɔnku bekyuli pii teeduoku bukeye kemmo ni, ɔka abi bubo kalɛ na ɔwɔlɔ nwuna kabla na ɔƒɔ-ma.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Anwu ɔni nábla bekyuli kedee ku bekyuli bani na ɔ́bla kedee ƒui ni, badi bekyuli benwi. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na kɔƒa kulekpo Yesu ka ɔlɔ-ma ɔnii banwa.

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: Ɔɔsu Katɔti ɔnini, “Ndubo ƒula lɛnyi kudu bubo bute mina banwa. Na ndubumwi-ɔ lɛnyi kedee na baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa ƒui anumi.”

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: Na ɔɔsu lɛnɔ ɔnini, “Ndubuti mina anu ƒui lɛsia Katɔti lɛlɔ.” Na ɔsɔ ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Aanu ami ku bebi bani na Katɔti úti úte-mi.”

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Ka bekyuli bamɛni badi ɔlɔna ku ubugya ɔsu ni, anwu lɛnɔ úti ukyuli udu kalɛ na ɔkɛnku nwuna kukpi lɛlɔ ni, na wadi ukyuli ɔni nda kukpi ɔyikun lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli ɔmɛni ndi ukisine ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na udie bani ƒui na kukpi liƒu líbo-ma lɛkpu líse bana ngba ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Ɔsika geen ni, ɔɔɔdi Katɔti batu na uubunku, mmomu Abraham kaba kemmo bebi.

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na Katɔti ɔ́bla-nwu aani nwuna banwa kalɛ na ulu biala lɛlɔ. Ɔ́bla lɛni kalɛ na unwini ɔkpane unengudi ɔni mɔɔnu kɔnyana na ɔɔbla lɛla biala ulu lɛlɔ teete Katɔti, na uti nwuna ngba ɔkpa kalɛ na Katɔti uti bekyuli ekpidi ɔkyiɛ-ma.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Na ka ala lidu lidu ékpoku anwu ɔlati na úbo abi ɔsu ni, ɔɔkana na uubunku bekyuli bani ƒui na ala ammɔ eekpóku.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, banwa kedee bani na Katɔti ɔ́lɔ ka bɛdi Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ala, biti bina anu bɛsia Yesu ɔni ndi ɔtalane ku ɔkpane unengudi ɔni kenye na buudie lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla ala ulu lɛlɔ úte ukyuli ɔni náƒuna-nwu úse aani kalɛ na Mose ɔ́bla ala ulu lɛlɔ na Katɔti kaduli.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔ́manku ɔbu útulo Mose aani kalɛ kani na ukyuli ɔni nátu ɔtɔ ɔ́ƒɔ lɛnyi útulo ɔtɔ ɔni na ɔ́tu mmɔ.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔtɔ biala ubo ukyuli ɔni nátu-nwu. Nsu Katɔti nátu lɛla biala.

english_verse: Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future.
translation_verse: Mose ɔ́bla lɛla biala ulu lɛlɔ na Katɔti kaduli aani kabla ɔblane. Na údie ala ani na Katɔti ɔdubo ubasu ɔ́tina.

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: Nsu Kristo anwu ni, ɔ́bla ala ulu lɛlɔ aani ubi ɔni ntɔnku Katɔti kaduli. Na abu ndi nwuna ɔtɔ ɔmmɔ si búse kayi na búƒie lɛnunsia lɛni kudu na buubó bɔ́da kpakplaa.

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́su kɔnini, “Si bínu Katɔti lɛdi ɔmwi ni,

english_verse: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *
translation_verse: bitabla atuɔkplu aani kalɛ na bɛ́bla uwi ɔni kemmo na bɛ́ta bínye-mi lɛlɔ na bɛ́kɔku-mi bɛ́nu na ketele mmɔ.

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na bina bati kuuku bákɔku-mi bánu banii baanu lɛla lɛni mabla ina ka bánu ala ani na lɛ́bla na akwa aavlene kemmo.

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na líti kɔnyi lɛ́kya kaba kammɔ. Na lɛ́su nnini, ‘Bana kayi ƒui kakɛ ulu bamba lɛlɔ, na bátanu mina lilu bátati kudii.’

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu na lɛ́kpali lɛlɔ lɛ́su na mina kɔnyi kemmo nnii baláni beléde-mi na bakɛ bɔnwuna kudii!”

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: Banwa, bɛnu lɛlɔ kemmo kaduɛ kalɛ na ɔdi uleti likpidi kasusu na kayi kemmo na unwini ukyuli ɔni naaaƒɔ taadi na walɛ Katɔti ɔni muute ngba kama.

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: Mmomu bɛkya lɛlɔ ogya limeyi ndi limeyi si kadi biala kégye-mii na baalɔ-ka banii ɔmwi. Ɔmmɔ ndubɔya na likpidi lilátɔlɔ ɔdi na wenwini ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla atuɔkplu.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Bubo kadikɔ ɔkɛnku Kristo lɛlɔ si búƒie-nwu bɔ́da kpakplaa na búti bula lɛlɔ ƒui bɔ́sia-nwu lɛlɔ útédu kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn like those who rebelled.”
translation_verse: Lɛni na básu bábavi ɔƒɛni banini, “Si bínu Katɔti lɛdi ɔmwi ni, bitabla atuɔkplu aani kalɛ na bɛ́bla uwi ɔni na bɛ́ta binye Katɔti lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: Na ɔma bene na bɛɛkali ka ama nénu na báta bénye Katɔti lɛlɔ mmɔ? Ɔɔɔdi bekyuli bani ƒui na Mose ɔ́tɔnku ɔ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ mmɔ badi yoo?

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Na ɔma bene na Katɔti ɔ́kpali lɛlɔ ɔ́su ka baláni beléde-nwu na bakɛ bɔnwuna si ɔɔɔdi bekyuli bani nétenu-nwu litemi mmɔ?

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɔ́nu bɔ́ti ka ɔni na bátaƒɔ-nwu bátadi ɔsu na bátakana-nwu bɔni bude na bakɛ bɔnwuna.

english_verse: The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka linyese lɛni na úte-bu ka buduo nwuna bɔnwuna ƒui kemmo kamu kese kéte-bu ɔsu ni, bɛya na bɔnu lɛlɔ kemmo kaduɛ kalɛ na ɔdi ulásɔ na kenye kammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Ɔsika básu abu lɛnɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ aani kalɛ kani na básu ama lɛnɔ. Nsu litemi lɛni bénu kátalɛ kɔsia kɔdi kétete-ma. Ɔsika ama bani nénu kenye kammɔ ni, bátaƒɔ-ka bátadi.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: Nsu abu bani mɔɔƒɔ́ taadi ni, bɔdubɔkɛ bɔnwuna bɔmmɔ. Na bani nátaƒɔ bátadi ni, bátakɛ-mu aani kalɛ kani na Katɔti ɔ́su lebo lɛni na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Anwuɔsu lɛ́kpali lɛlɔ lɛ́su na kɔnyi kemmo nnini, ‘Baláni beléde-mi na bakɛ bɔnwuna kudii!’ ” Katɔti ɔ́su ɔmɛni ina ka úte kuƒi úse uwi ɔni na ɔ́wɔlɔ kayawi budie.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Ɔsika na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ni, bénweni lɛla lɛdi na limeyi maatɛdi lɛlɔ banini, “Na limeyi maatɛdi lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti ɔ́da kabla ƒui ɔ́ya na ɔ́nwuna.”

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: Na litemi lɛni bɔ́su bɔ́vi mɛni kemmo ni, Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Baláni beléde-mi na bakɛ bɔnwuna kudii!”

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: Litemi lɛmɛni lɛmu lise lɛni ka badi badubɔkɛ bɔnwuna bɔmmɔ. Na bani náka lɛsa bɔkɔ bɔmmɔ bunu ni, ama mmomu néteduo bɔnwuna bɔmmɔ kemmo ɔ́si bana atuɔkplu ɔsu.

english_verse: Much later God told David to make the promise again, just as I have already said, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn!”
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na Katɔti ɔ́sɔ úse limeyi lɛbambadi lɛni na ɔɔlɔ ɔnii ɔmwi úse uwi ɔni na ɔ́tɛmiku kuuku bekyuli ɔkɛnku Ɔga Dawid lɛlɔ lɛni na bɔ́su búbavi bɔnini, “Si bínu Katɔti lɛdi ɔmwi ni, bitabla atuɔkplu.”

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si bɔya na Yosua ɔ́ya na bákɛ bɔnwuna ni, nka Katɔti ɔ́sɔ útasu lɛla lɛdi útasiku limeyi lɛbambadi lɛdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na lɛnwunameyi lɛmu lise lite Katɔti bekyuli.

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli biala ɔni muuduo Katɔti bɔnwuna kemmo ni, ɔɔda nwuna kabla ƒui taaya na ɔɔnwuna aani kalɛ kani na Katɔti ɔ́bla.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛya bɔkya ɔkplu biala na buduo bɔnwuna bɔmmɔ kemmo. Na ɔdi biala uláwɔ ulu ka ɔsiaku bana atuɔkplu bɔbla kama ɔsu.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Katɔti litemi lɛdi lɛla lɛni mbo ngba na lɛɛbla kabla pla pla teetulo kewii kani na bádɔ-ka lɛvi inyɔ. Na liiduo ukyuli kasusu ku kɔyu ntɛ. Na lɛɛbla lɛni aani kalɛ na kewii keele ɔlɔna ku ekubi ntɛ. Litemi lɛmmɔ lɛɛnu lɛla biala lɛni nkya ukyuli kasusu ku kayi kemmo taatina-nwu.

english_verse: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth. Jesus Is the Great High Priest
translation_verse: Ala ani ƒui na Katɔti údie lítabɛ-nwu. Na ɔɔnu lɛla biala kalɛ na lise. Na nwuna anumi na bɔdubo bula akunta ƒui bɔbu. Yesu Ɔdi Bula Ɔkpane Unengudi Ɔbune Ƒui

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka bubo ɔkpane unengudi ɔbuni ƒui ɔni ndi Katɔti Ubidi Yesu ɔni nkya-nwu kudɔ na katɔ mmɔ ɔsu ni, bɛya na buƒie bɔƒɔtaadi bɔni kenye na buudie mɛni bɔda kpakplaa.

english_verse: Jesus understands every weakness of ours, because he was tempted in every way that we are. But he did not sin!
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi ɔkpane unengudi ɔni na bula lɛlɔ lilakywi-nwu kaƒɔ na bula kpɛtɛ kpɛtɛ bɔbla kemmo. Mmomu ɔdi ukyuli ɔni na ala ékpoku-nwu ánu na ulu biala lɛlɔ aani bula kalɛ kani. Nsu útabla likpidi lɛdi.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛya na buti bula lɛlɔ ƒui bute-nwu na bɔkpɛ bude-nwu na nwuna lɛgaboku kudɔ ku kayi buse ka ubo lɛƒɔndia ɔsu. Na ɔkɛnku nwuna lɛƒɔndia ɔsu ni, ɔdubɔnu-bu kɔnyana na ubunku-bu uwi biala na búvele-nwu lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Every high priest is appointed to help others by offering gifts and sacrifices to God because of their sins.
translation_verse: Ɔkpane unengudi biala ni, bekyuli akɔ na baaƒuna-nwu taalɛku. Na anwu muunye bekyuli bammɔ kenye na ala ani ƒui ndanku Katɔti lɛlɔ. Na uuti etela ku akpala teete Katɔti na bana ƒui ekpidi lili.

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani naaagyi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ na báyii ulu ni, ɔkpane ɔmmɔ ɔgyi kalɛ na ɔbla bana litemi buɛɛ. Ɔsika anwu lɛnɔ ulákana ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: Lɛni ɔsu na ɔlɛka ɔbla akpala na anwu ɔlati ekpidi ku bekyuli bammɔ ƒui ekpidi lili.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi ulakana ɔkpane unengudi kenyekɔ kamɛni bɔƒuna bute lɛlɔ. Mmomu ɔdi ka Katɔti náƒuna-nwu aani kalɛ na ɔ́ƒuna Aaron.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na Kristo lɛnɔ útaƒuna ɔkpane unengudi kenyekɔ kamɛni útete lɛlɔ kalɛ na bekyuli babu-nwu. Mmomu Katɔti ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Awɔ ndi mina ubi. Na ɔmwi ni, línwini-ɔ ɔti.”

english_verse: In another place, God says, “You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Na likpo bamba ni, ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Adi ɔkpane úsela uwi ƒui na Melkisedek ɔkpane bɔdi ulu lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Yesu úlie ngba na kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ ni, ɔ́kpali katɔ úvele Katɔti ɔni kani ndubɔkana na udie-nwu na kukpi kemmo ku kɔvanu momoomo ku imii. Na Katɔti únu-nwu bɔkpali, ɔsika úboku lɛlɔ kalɔ úte-nwu na ɔɔbu-nwu ɔsu.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: Na ina ka ubidi na ɔdi ni, ɔ́tɛya abi ani na ɔdi ka ukyuli ubo si uunú Katɔti litemi.

english_verse: Suffering made Jesus perfect, and now he can save forever all who obey him.
translation_verse: Na ka Katɔti ɔ́ya na ɔ́bla nwuna kabla ɔ́wɔlɔ ni, únwini ukyuli ɔni lɛlɔ na bekyuli bani muunú-nwu litemi ƒui baasia taakɛ ngba bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: Na Katɔti nédie-nwu ka unwini ɔkpane unengudi na Melkisedek ɔkpane bɔdi ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Bubo ala pii na bɔsu bɔsiku ɔmɛni lɛlɔ, nsu ka bilákana ala buƒie taakya lili kemmo pla pla ɔsu ni, nwuna kalɔ budie bubo ɔkplu.

english_verse: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ ni, ɔƒɛni kalɛ bene nka bɛdi ala batinane muedi. Nsu bɛsɔ bɛɛwia ukyuli ɔni nsɔ medie Katɔti litemi buni lɛmmɔ ala kalɔ kesekɔ mete-mii. Ɔni na bɛwia adila geen kama ni, bɛɛwia lɛnyi ntu mmomu.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni na lɛnyi ntu kani na ɔɔnyimi ni, ɔmu ɔdi ɔnamu na útedu ka unu ala bɔtina bɔni ndanku ukyuli lɛlɔ bɔbla siin kalɔ.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bɛya na busie anumi, na bulasɔ bulakya lɛnamu uwi kalɔ kesekɔ ala ani na bɔ́tɛya na Kristo mmɔ kani lɛlɔ kemmo. Bitaya na bɔsɔ butése kalɔ kesekɔ ala bɔtɛya kalɔ. Ala amɛni adanku kayi bunwini na ala ekpidi lɛlɔ ku kalɛ na bɔƒɔ Katɔti bɔdi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment.
translation_verse: Na adanku lɛla lɛni ɔsu na beeti ntu taabla ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ku enu lili bɔsia ku kalɛ na bekpine badubɔsɔ bata balɛ bekpine akɔ ku Katɔti litemi lɛni na ɔdubɔtɛku-bu na ɔsɔ ulavumana-ni kudii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Kalɔ kani mɔɔƒɔ́ ntu si ɔnantu ɔ́na na kaadia edula abuni teete bemonsene ni, Katɔti kusɛ kusɛ ɔɔsiáku-ka.

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: Nsu kalɔ kani na liyu alakpi mɔɔkwɛ́-ka lɛlɔ ni, kadanku ewida na keeebo kɔsia kɔdi. Na kasɔ kaladia lɛla lɛdi bɔbla lɛnɔ. Na kawɔlɔkɔ ni, kadubɔkywi.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: Bayɔne, ina ka bɔɔsu ala amɛni ƒui ni, bɔsia anu ka ala abuni ani ndanku ngba bɔƒɔ adubɔsiaku amii ƒui.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔɔbla lɛla biala ulu lɛlɔ. Na uláyiƒala bina ala ani na bɛ́bla. Ɔgyi ka bɛɛyɔ́-nwu ɔkɛnku kalɛ na bíbunku nwuna bekyuli. Na bɛmu biibunku-ma úbedu ɔƒɛni.

english_verse: We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is.
translation_verse: Lɛni na bɔɔwia ka bina akɔ ɔdi biala ɔda lɛlɔ ku udu buni ɔmɛni kaduɛ utédu kawɔlɔkɔ kalɛ na bina lɛnunsia lɛlɛ-mii kɔsia.

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: Buláwia ka bitaabla kɔkɔsɔ. Mmomu bɛtɛya bekyuli bani nákɛ kayi buɛɛ na báƒɔ bádi ɔsu na kɔnu kútuku-ma linyese lɛni na Katɔti úse-ma mmɔ. Kenye Kani Na Katɔti Úse Ɔdi Litemi Geen

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Katɔti úse Abraham kenye ni, ɔ́kpali lɛlɔ úse kenye kammɔ, ɔsika lɛla lɛdi liiibo na litulo anwu Katɔti.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will bless you with many descendants!”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Geen ni, ndubute-ɔ kusɛ kusɛ. Na ndubɔya na edie kaba pii.”

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama ka Abraham ɔ́kɛ kayi buɛɛ na ɔ́sia Katɔti anu ɔsu ni, kɔnu kútuku-nwu kenye kani na Katɔti úse-nwu mmɔ.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Bekyuli baakpali ala ani ntulo-ma teese kenye taatina ka lɛla lɛni baasu lɛdi litemi geen, na unyeƒi ɔdi uuubo-nwu kemmo.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Na ka Katɔti ɔɔwia ka bekyuli bani na úse kenye ƒui bati nwaa ka kavumana kadi kelebo nwuna linyese kemmo ɔsu ni, ɔ́kpali lɛlɔ úse kenye kammɔ.

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́bla ɔmɛni ɔkɛnku alakpa anyɔ ani naaavumana lɛlɔ. Na Katɔti lɛnɔ ulakana ɔkɔ bɔnyi. Na ɔmɛni ɔdubɔya na abu bani nékeli bɔ́tamiku-nwu ni, enu alaƒɛ-bu na lɛnunsia lɛni na úti ɔ́kya-bu lɛlɔ kemmo ɔsu.

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Bula lɛnunsia lɛmɛni mɔɔyá na bɔda Katɔti kpakplaa na bula kayi kemmo aani kalɛ na kugyii lidu lɛɛda kalɔ geen. Na bɔsia Yesu anu. Anwu néduo katɔma kedee kani kenye na lɛdiku lɛƒa kemmo.

english_verse: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Yesu ɔ́gyu ɔtɔ útéduo na abu ɔsu. Na únwini ɔkpane unengudi úte uwi ƒui na Melkisedek ɔkpane bɔdi ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: Melkisedek ɔmɛni ɔ́di lɛga na Salem, na ɔ́bla ɔkpane kabla úte Katɔti ɔni ntulo ƒui. Uwi ɔni na Abraham ɔ́si kekpokɔ útádi baga bani nkya amadɔ mmɔ lɛlɔ ɔdubo ni, Melkisedek ɔmɛni útásiaku-nwu na úte-nwu kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: Na Abraham úti nwuna ala ƒui lɛkpa leevudi úte-nwu. Kudeedi ni, Melkisedek lɛnyi kalɔ ndi Siin Bɔbla Ɔga. Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, Salem Ɔga kalɔ budie ndi Keyi Buɛɛ Ɔga.

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: Na bétenweni lɛla lɛdi bátasiku ɔti iye uni, iye kaba lɛlɔ, iye nwuna bɔwɔ iye kukpi lɛlɔ. Na Katɔti ɔ́ya na use aani anwu Katɔti Ubidi, ɔsika ɔdi ɔkpane ute uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Bɛnu kalɛ na Melkisedek ɔmɛni ɔ́ƒɔ kuye geen. Abraham ɔni ndi bula nana ɔni nédie bula kaba kamɛni muedi úti ala ani na úkpo ɔ́ƒɔ na kekpokɔ mmɔ lɛkpa leevudi úte-nwu!

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ búte Lewi kaba kemmo bebi bani nébenwini bakpane ka baƒɔ ala lɛkpa leevudi basiku bekyuli kudɔ ina ka bekyuli bamɛni badi bana banwani bani nási Abraham ɔmmɔ kaba kemmo.

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: Melkisedek ɔmɛni útasi Lewi kaba kemmo, nsu ɔ́ƒɔ ala lɛkpa leevudi ɔ́siku Abraham ɔni na Katɔti úse-nwu kenye úse mmɔ kudɔ, na Melkisedek ɔmmɔ úte-nwu kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔ ɔdi uuubo-nwu kemmo ka ni, ukyuli ɔni muute kusɛ kusɛ utulo ukyuli ɔni na béte kusɛ kusɛ mmɔ.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔƒɔ́ ala lɛkpa leevudi ni, badi bakpane bani muukpi. Nsu na Melkisedek kakɛ anwu ni, ɔ́ƒɔ lɛkpa leevudi lɛmmɔ aani ɔkpane ɔni nli ngba aani kalɛ na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔsu.

english_verse: Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth.
translation_verse: Na bɔkana na bɔsu muedi bɔnii Lewi ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́ ala lɛkpa leevudi lɛnɔ ɔ́sia Abraham lɛlɔ úte Melkisedek ala lɛkpa leevudi lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: This is because Levi was born later into the family of Abraham, who gave a tenth to Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Ɔsika uwi ɔni na Abraham ɔ́siaku Melkisedek na uute-nwu ala lɛkpa leevudi lɛmɛni ni, na Lewi ɔmu ɔkya bana nana bene ubugya kemmo.

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Katɔti úte kadi ƒui bekyuli ɔda bubo bɔni nkɛnku Lewi ɔkpane bɔdi kabla ulu lɛlɔ. Na si bɔbla na bábla bana kabla na kédu káwɔlɔ ni, bi ɔsu na Katɔti ɔ́sɔ ɔ́ƒuna ɔkpane ɔbambadi ka ubo ɔsiaku Melkisedek ɔkpane bɔdi ulu lɛlɔ na ɔɔɔdi aani kalɛ na ɔ́ƒuna Lewi bebi bani ndi Aaron kaba?

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si kavumana kadi kébo na ɔkpane bɔdi ulu ɔdi lɛlɔ ni, na agyi anii ɔdi ka kavumana kadi kebo na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛnɔ kemmo.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni lɛlɔ na básu ala amɛni ƒui básiku ni, ɔ́si kaba bekyuli babambadi akɔ. Na kaba kammɔ bekyuli akɔ ɔdi útabla ɔkpane kabla na lɛkpabi lɛlɔ kudii.

english_verse: Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bɔgyi kede kede ka Yesu ni, Yuda kaba kemmo na báwɔ-nwu básiku. Na kaba kammɔ lɛlɔ ni, Mose útasu lɛla lɛdi útasiku bakpane lɛlɔ.

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ɔni na ɔkpane ɔbambadi ɔdi ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ aani Melkisedek kalɛ ni, lɛla lɛni na bɔ́su mɛni lɛdubɔbla-mii nwaa libu.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti ɔ́su nwaa ɔnini, “Adi ɔkpane úsela uwi ƒui na Melkisedek ɔkpane bɔdi ulu lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside,
translation_verse: Béliiku ɔda bubo bɔkukudi bése kɔmadɔ, ɔsika buuubo ɔyikun na buuubo kɔsia kɔdi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔda bubo bɔni na Katɔti úte-bu ɔkɛnku Mose lɛlɔ ni, bútabla Katɔti kabla bútawɔlɔ. Na ɔƒɛni ni, bɔ́kɛ lɛnunsia lɛni ndia ntulo na lɛɛyá na bɔɔní teede Katɔti.

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu úbenwini ɔkpane ɔkɛnku Katɔti linyese lɛlɔ uwi ɔni na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Unwoti úse kenye kpakplaa kadi na ulavumana-ka kudii ɔnini, ‘Adi ɔkpane úsela uwi ƒui.’ ”

english_verse: This means that Jesus guarantees us a better agreement with God.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku Katɔti linyese lɛmɛni lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, Yesu ndi bula kama kekpokɔ na bunyimi bɔni ndia ntulo mɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: There have been a lot of other priests, and all of them have died.
translation_verse: Kavumana kabambadi kadi lɛnɔ kakya kani ndi ka bakpane bakukudi bammɔ bémomo, ɔsika ɔdi útakana nwuna kabla kenye bunye uwi ƒui ɔ́si kalɛ na beekpi ɔsu.

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: Nsu Yesu anwu uli úsela uwi ƒui, na ulavumana nwuna ɔkpane kabla ulete ɔdi kudii.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, ukyuli biala ɔni muubo Katɔti kudɔ ɔkɛnku-nwu lɛlɔ ni, Yesu ɔmmɔ ɔɔkana na ɔɔƒɔ́-ma ngba uwi ƒui ɔsika ɔdubo buteevele teete-ma na Katɔti kudɔ.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, Yesu ɔmɛni ndi ɔkpane unengudi ɔni kani ndubɔbla lɛla lɛni na bɔɔwia ute-bu. Na use kedee, na lɛla lɛdi lɛɛɛda-nwu. Use sɛɛn na Katɔti údie-nwu ɔ́lɛku alaekpidi bablane akɔ, na ɔ́kɔliku-nwu útése sɛsɛɛ na katɔ kakaaka ƒui.

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: Na uuuse aani bakpane benengudi babambadi bammɔ kalɛ bani nálɛ ka bataabla akpala na ama ku bekyuli bakladi lili taasia kama limeyi ndi limeyi. Mmomu kunwi kɔni na anwu úti lɛlɔ ɔ́kpa na bekyuli ƒui lili ni, ɔ́kpa kunwi pɛ kɔmmɔ kani na ɔ́sa.

english_verse: The Law appoints priests who have weaknesses. But God's promise, which came later than the Law, appoints his Son. And he is the perfect high priest forever.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ni, ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔɔƒuna bakpane bani naaakana bunye kpakplaa ama alati. Nsu linyese lɛni nébo na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kama ni, bɔ́ƒuna Ubi ɔmmɔ na ɔ́ya na ɔ́wɔlɔ nwuna kabla úte uwi ƒui.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni geen na bɔɔyɔ́ budie bɔtina na litemi lɛmɛni kemmo ndi ka ni, bubo ɔkpane unengudi ɔmɛni ɔni nlie kesii kani náƒɔ kuye na Katɔti lɛgaboku kudɔ na katɔ.

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔbla Katɔti kabla na kakpakɔ kedee kani ndi kakpakɔ geen kani na Katɔti ɔlati úti nwuna enu ɔ́bla. Na ɔɔɔdi bekyuli nábla-ka.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na si nka kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni na ɔkya ni, nka ulabla ɔkpane kabla kulaa. Ɔsika bakpane bakya bani mɔɔbla akpala kalɛ na ɔda bubo bɔni ntɛ nse bɔɔtina.

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: Baabla kabla na bana kakpakɔ kani nálɛ kani geen nkya katɔ. Ɔmmɔ geen ɔsu na Katɔti úbo Mose ɔda uwi ɔni na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnii ɔtu bana kakpakɔ. Na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnini, “Nu kaduɛ na atu kakpakɔ kammɔ na kamanku ulu ɔni na lɛ́tina-a na kɔbi lili mmɔ lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Now Christ has been appointed to serve as a priest in a much better way, and he has given us much assurance of a better agreement.
translation_verse: Nsu kabla kani na Katɔti úti ɔ́kya Yesu enu kemmo ni, káƒɔ kuye ketulo bana ɔdi ƒui. Lɛni na bunyimi bɔwɔdi bɔni kenye na Yesu unye ni, bɔ́ƒɔ kuye butulo bunyimi bɔkukudi bɔmmɔ ƒui. Ɔsika bése bunyimi bɔmɛni bése na linyese lɛni ndia ntulo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Si lɛla lɛdi nétebie na bunyimi bɔkukudi lɛlɔ ni, na nka ɔ́sɔ útamanku na ulu biala lɛlɔ ka basɔ bete-bu bunyimi bɔwɔdi bɔbambadi bɔdi.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti ɔ́nu ka bekyuli báƒiɔ, na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ami Unwoti mɔɔsu ka ni, uwi ɔdubo ɔni na ndubo lɛla lɛwɔdi bunyimiku Israel kadi bekyuli ku Yuda kadi bekyuli.

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: Na ulése aani kalɛ na línyimiku bana bati kuuku na uwi ɔni na lɛ́da-ma kɔnu kɔnu na lɛ́tɔnku-ma lɛ́lɛku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika bátadi lɛla lɛni na línyimiku-ma lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu línwini kama lɛ́kya-ma.

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Bunyimi bɔni na ami Katɔti mɔɔsu ka ndubo bunyimiku Israel kadi bekyuli uwi ɔni ndubo kemmo ndi ɔmɛni. Ndubuti mina ɔda bubo lɛkya-ma kasusu kemmo. Na ndubunweni-mu lɛkya-ma kayi kemmo. Ndubɔbla bana Katɔti na ama lɛnɔ babla mina bekyuli.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si ɔƒɛni ni, ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ ulatina ɔkpanadi iye ɔnwani ka ɔti Blɔti. Ɔsika bana ƒui badubo-mi bɔti ɔ́si ubliidi ƒui útálɛ unengudi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Na ndubuti bana alaekpidi ani ƒui bábla lɛkyiɛ-ma. Na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo bana ekpidi bunyimo kudii.”

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Na ka Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnii ɔdubuse bunyimi bɔwɔdi ni, na budeedi bɔ́bla bɔkukudi. Na lɛla lɛkukudi lɛni néetu uwi ni, lɛdubo bɔyii uwi klukui kemmo.

english_verse: The first promise included rules for worship and a tent for worship here on earth.
translation_verse: Bunyimi budeedi bɔmmɔ ni, bɔdanku ulu ɔni beeti taakpa ku kesii kani na baakpá na kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: Bátu kakpakɔ kani na béle ɔtɔ ku katɔma. Na ɔtɔ udeedi kemmo ni, ligyii lɛni lɛlɔ na baatu asogya taasia lɛlɛ. Na ala kasiakɔ kani lɛlɔ na bodobodo ɔni na béti bákpa bete Katɔti ɔsia lɛnɔ use. Mmɔ baalɔ banii kakpakɔ kedee.

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na sika ugyiedi lɛbi lɛni lɛlɔ na baakyula oloƒui lɛlɛ ku sika ugyiedi adaka ɔni kemmo na Katɔti bunyimi bɔkya. Na adaka ɔmɛni kemmo ni, atabi kɔlɛkɛ kɔni lɛlɔ bénweni bunyimi bɔmmɔ basia kɔkya. Na Aaron ugyii ɔdadi ɔni nédie evete lɛnɔ ɔkya-nwu kemmo ku sika ugyiedi lɛkyami lɛdi. Na nina kemmo ni, Katɔti adila ani baalɔ manna akya.

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: Na adaka ɔmmɔ katɔ ni, bávɔ Katɔti batu badi udu mbo avwi na baalɔ-ma Kerub bényene. Na ama mɔɔtina ka Katɔti ɔkya mmɔ. Na bana avwi ebi likpo lɛni na beeti bekyuli ekpidi taakyiɛ mmɔ. Nsu bulakana kɔtɛ kɔmmɔ kemmo buduo busie ɔgyu ɔƒɛni tɔ.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Lɛni na bábla ala amɛni bése mmɔ. Na bakpane béteeduo ɔtɔ udeedi kemmo mɛni buduo buduo taatábla bana bakpane kabla.

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: Na katɔma kammɔ kemmo aka ni, ɔkpane unengudi kani néteeduo mmɔ kunwi na lɛkwa kemmo. Na ntu úti ebuo ɔni na béeti bákpa ubugya ɔ́da na weti wakpa na anwu ɔlati ku bekyuli ekpidi ani bátati asa na bábla lili.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: Katɔti Kɔyu kɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ kɔɔtina-bu nwaa ɔ́si uwi ɔmmɔ ka ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na bɔdubɔsia buduo Katɔti katɔma geen kammɔ kemmo ni, útedie-nwu tɔ keyi uwi ɔni na kakpakɔ kedeedi kammɔ kamu kenye.

english_verse: This also has a meaning for today. It shows we cannot make our consciences clear by offering gifts and sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mmomu ɔmmɔ ɔdi lɛla lɛni mɔɔtina ka etela ku akpala ani ƒui na bada baabla akpala ammɔ ni, elédie bɔƒiɔ na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla akpala ammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ala ammɔ ƒui adanku bɔdi ku bɔni ku lɛlɔ bɔƒɔ ɔdi na lilu bun bun lɛlɔ. Na adi ɔlɔna lɛlɔ ɔda bubo bɔni ndubɔbla kabla ɔƒɛni wetédu ka ulu ɔwɔdi ɔmmɔ úbo. Kristo Ubugya Uudie Alaekpidi Taawɔlɔ Na Bekyuli Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Kristo úbo aani ɔkpane unengudi kalɛ úte ala abuni ani náada alɛ ni, ɔ́vi úduo kakpakɔ kani náƒɔ kuye na kadia ketulo ƒui kemmo. Na ɔɔɔdi ukyuli enu na béti bátu-ka. Na bɔkana budie kalɔ bɔnii ɔɔɔkɛnku kalɛ na bédie kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ ala kalɛ.

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔɔdanku bese iye bakɔ bebi ubugya útetéduo mmɔ. Mmomu anwu ɔlati ubugya na úti útéduo likpo lɛni nse kedee ntulo ƒui mmɔ kunwi pɛ kani, na ɔ́ƒɔ-bu lili kayu úte uwi ƒui.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani nábla ala ani náya na beesé lɛlɔ na ɔdi ala bɔbla kenye ni, baakana na beeti bese ku bakɔ ubugya ku bebuo bamɛni ntɔ teewi-ma lɛlɔ na bana lɛlɔ lɛɛsɔ taabla sɛɛn ute ɔdi ala bɔbla.

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: Na si ɔbladu ɔmɛni ɔɔyá na ukyuli ɔɔbla sɛɛn ni, na Kristo ubugya ɔɔkana na ɔɔbla ukyuli sɛɛn teetulo. Ɔkɛnku Katɔti Kɔyu kɔni nli uwi ƒui lɛlɔ ni, Kristo úti lɛlɔ ɔ́bla akpala ani nédu áwɔlɔ úte Katɔti na lɛla lɛdi lítebie-mu lɛlɔ. Nwuna ubugya ɔdubɔbla bina kayi sɛɛn bɔsiku ɔdi bɔbla bɔni nsɔ neeebo kɔsia ƒui kudɔ kalɛ na bɔbla Katɔti ɔni nli kabla.

english_verse: Christ died to rescue those who had sinned and broken the old agreement. Now he brings his chosen ones a new agreement with its guarantee of God's eternal blessings!
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu na Kristo ndi ukyuli ɔni nnye bunyimi bɔwɔdi bɔmɛni kenye kalɛ na bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔ́lɔ ka babla anwu badi ni, bana kɔnu kutuku linyese lɛni ndi ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii. Ɔmɛni uubo teete lɛni, ɔsika Kristo kukpi ɔsu na Katɔti uuti ekpidi ani na bekyuli bábla na bunyimi bɔkukudi kemmo taakyiɛ-ma.

english_verse: In fact, making an agreement of this kind is like writing a will. This is because the one who makes the will must die before it is of any use.
translation_verse: Si bédie ɔku ɔni mɔɔtina kalɛ na beele ukyuli ɔdi ala keyi ni, ɔlɛka batina ka ukyuli ɔni nénweni ɔku ɔmmɔ úukpi.

english_verse: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔku ɔmɛni uuubo tɔ ɔyikun ɔdi si ukyuli ɔni nénweni-nwu mmɔ ɔmu uli ngba. Amu ntu nwuna kukpi kama kani asa na ɔku ɔmmɔ wabla kabla.

english_verse: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ni, asa na bunyimi bɔkukudi bɔbala ukyuli ni, ubugya néwi kalɔ.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Kudeedi ni, Mose úbo ɔda ute bekyuli na ala ani mɔɔbala na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kenye. Ɔmmɔ kama ni, úti bese ku bakɔ ubugya ɔ́salaku ntu na úti ɔ́kuna ubugya ɔmmɔ úwi ɔda bubo ɔku ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ku bekyuli bammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na úti unwo ugyiedi únyimi evete ani baalɔ bani hisope na úti ɔ́bla ɔdi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɔmɛni ndi ubugya ɔni na Katɔti úti úse nwuna bunyimi bɔmɛni likpo. Na ɔ́su-mii ka bɛdi-mu lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani Mose ɔ́kuna ubugya úwi kakpakɔ kammɔ ku ala ani na beeti taabla lɛkpa lɛmmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered. Christ's Great Sacrifice
translation_verse: Geen ni, ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔɔtina na bɔkana na bɔsu bɔnii ala ƒui aabla sɛɛn ɔkɛnku ubugya lɛlɔ. Na ɔkɛnku ubugya kalɔ buwi kemmo na Katɔti uuti bula ekpidi taakyiɛ-bu. Kristo Lɛlɔ Lɛni Na Úti Ɔ́kpa Muudie Ekpidi Na Bula Lɛlɔ

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Ɔ́manku úte ka ekposela ani baabla na kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni na katɔ adi udu kenye ni, babla-nya sɛɛn ku akpala amɛni udu. Nsu katɔ adi alati anya ni, ɔlɛka beti akpala ani ndia ntulo ammɔ babla-nya sɛɛn.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔɔɔdi kakpakɔ kani na bekyuli bayawine béti enu bábla básiaku katɔ ɔdi kenye kemmo na Kristo úduo. Mmomu Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma geen kadi kemmo na úduo ɔkya ɔƒɛni na Katɔti anumi na bula lili.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: Na uléti lɛlɔ taakpa lɛkwa ndi lɛkwa aani kalɛ na ɔkpane unengudi uuduo kesii kani nse kedee ntulo ƒui mmɔ ku ubugya ɔni naaadi anwu ɔlati ɔdi kalɛ.

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: Si lɛni na use ni, ɔlɛka nka Yesu ɔsɔ ubebo abi ɔsia kama kɔlɛ kɔlɛ ɔ́si kayawi kalɔ kesekɔ ƒui. Nsu kalɛ na use ni, kunwi pɛ kani na úbo kayawi kamɛni kemmo úbedie-bu na ekpidi ƒui kemmo ku nwuna ubugya ɔni na úti ɔ́kpa na bula lili. Na ɔdanku uwi ƒui utédu kayawi kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: We die only once, and then we are judged.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́lɛ ugyii úse ka ukyuli ukpi kunwi pɛ kani, na ɔmmɔ kama na ɔtɛku-nwu litemi.

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na Kristo lɛnɔ úti lɛlɔ ɔ́kpa kunwi pɛ kani na údie bekyuli pii na bana ekpidi kemmo. Na ɔdubɔsɔ ubo kunyɔdi. Na ɔɔɔdi ɔni na ɔsɔ ubebo abi na ekpidi ɔsu. Mmomu kalɛ na uti ngba bɔƒɔ uboku bekyuli bani na benye bagya-nwu.

english_verse: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.
translation_verse: Ɔda bubo ndi ekposela úte ala abuni ani ndubo. Na ɔɔɔdi ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ ndanku ala abuni ammɔ alati geen tɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, akpala ani nkɛnku ɔda bubo bɔmɛni ani na baabla lɛkwa ndi lɛkwa ni, alakana bekyuli bani mɔɔwia ka bakpa Katɔti bɔbla sɛɛn bɔwɔlɔ.

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na si bɔkana na akpala ammɔ adubɔkana-ma bɔbla sɛɛn bɔwɔlɔ ni, nka báada bɔkpa báya na bana kayi kasɔ kaladu-ma kɔtɔ kɔdi.

english_verse: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, “Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na asa na Kristo webo kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ ni, ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ati, akpala ku etela alaƒɔ-ɔ anu. Mmomu ɔlɔna ɔni na éti éte-mi ka liti lɛkpa lite-ɔ mɔɔda-a kubiti.

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: Na akpala ani na bákyula ku ekpidi lili buvele akpala aláda-a kubiti.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na lɛ́su nnini, ‘Ati, aanu-mi. Líbo nnii mbabla ƒula lɛƒɔyɔ aani kalɛ na bénweni básiku-mi lɛlɔ na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo.’ ”

english_verse: The Law teaches that offerings and sacrifices must be made because of sin. But why did Christ mention these things and say that God did not want them?
translation_verse: Kudeedi ni, ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ala ani na béti béboku na bábla akpala ku ani na béti bákyula ku ala ekpidi lili buvele akpala ni, átada-a kubiti. Na útayɔ-ɔ kaƒɔ lɛnɔ,” ina ka ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ nátina ka babla lɛni.

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔ́su ɔnini, “Aanu-mi. Líbo nnii mbabla ƒula lɛƒɔyɔ.” Katɔti údie akpala edeedi úse kɔmadɔ. Na úse Kristo ɔdi na ana kenye.

english_verse: So we are made holy because Christ obeyed God and offered himself once for all.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔ́bla-bu kedee na nwuna bɔyɔ kenye ɔkɛnku kalɛ na Yesu Kristo úti nwuna ɔlɔna ɔ́kpa úte-nwu kunwi pɛ kani úte uwi ƒui ɔsu.

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Limeyi ndi limeyi ni, Yudani ɔkpane biala uunye taabla nwuna ɔkpane kabla kani ndanku bɔkpa ulu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔɔbla akpala ammɔ udu kani limeyi ndi limeyi ani naaadubo bɔkana na udie likpidi na ukyuli lɛlɔ kudii.

english_verse: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side,
translation_verse: Nsu uwi ɔni na Kristo anwu úbo úbeti lɛlɔ ɔ́kpa kunwi úte bekyuli ƒui ekpidi lili ɔni ndanku utédu kayawi kawɔlɔkɔ ni, ɔ́yu úlie Katɔti kɔdianu kesii kani náƒɔ kuye.

english_verse: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, Kristo unye ɔgya uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔdubuti nwuna bekisine ɔkya-nwu lɛgba kalɔ.

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔkɛnku kunwi kɔni na úti lɛlɔ ɔ́kpa mmɔ ɔsu ni, ɔ́wɔlɔ nwuna kabla úte bekyuli uwi ƒui kalɛ na babla kedee.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Katɔti Kɔyu ɔlati údie ɔmɛni ɔ́tina-bu nwaa ɔnini,

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: “Bunyimi bɔni na ami Katɔti mɔɔsu ka ndubo bunyimiku-ma na uwi ɔni ndubo kemmo ndi ɔmɛni. Ndubuti mina ɔda bubo lɛkya-ma kayi kemmo. Na ndubunweni-mu lɛsia-ma kasusu lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo bana ekpidi ku bana likyulikpi bunyimo.”

english_verse: When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices. Encouragement and Warning
translation_verse: Na ka Katɔti úti ala amɛni ɔ́kyiɛ ni, ala ekpidi lili buvele akpala adi asɔ eeebo. Ɔlɛka Bɔkya Ɔkplu Na Bɔni Bude Katɔti

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, banwa, ulu ɔtɛ ute-bu ka bɔkana na buduo katɔma kani nse kedee ntulo ƒui mmɔ kemmo ɔkɛnku Yesu ubugya lɛlɔ.

english_verse: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
translation_verse: Ɔsika úti nwuna ɔlɔna úte na bula lili na ɔ́lɛmi ngba bɔni naaadubo bɔsa ulu ɔwɔdi úte-bu. Ɔ́bla ɔmɛni kalɛ na bɔkana bɔvi kayakun kɔdi kɔni nnye nte nwuna ɔlɔna, na bɔda bɔlɛ Katɔti anumi.

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: Na ka bubo ɔkpane unengudi na Katɔti kakpakɔ kani na katɔ mmɔ ɔsu ni,

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: bɛya na bɔni bude Katɔti ku kayi kani naaatɔlɔ-bu na bɔda bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ kpakplaa. Yesu ɔ́kuna nwuna ubugya ɔmmɔ úwi-bu lɛlɔ kalɛ na bula kayi kaládu-bu kɔtɔ. Na úti ntu bɔni nse sɛɛn ɔ́ƒɔ-bu lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: Na bɛya na bunye bɔƒɔtaadi bɔni kenye na buudie lɛlɔ kpakplaa. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni nése-bu kenye kammɔ ni, ɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Na butaabu taanu ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na bɔdubɔkana na bɔkya lɛlɔ ogya, na butaayɔ bekyuli, na butaabla ala abuni.

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: Bitaya na bɔda bɔsa bɔya aani kalɛ na badi badaku lɛlɔ bɔda teedie. Mmomu bɛya na bɔkya lɛlɔ ogya, na bɔbla lɛni butulo na uwi ɔni kemmo na limeyi linengudi lɛmmɔ lɛdaku bɔni teede geen mɛni kemmo.

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Nsu si bɔgyi ƒui na búti bɔ́sia lɛlɔ na bɔɔbla ala ekpidi na uwi ɔni na bédie litemi geen lɛmmɔ ala bátina-bu ni, na likpidi buti taakyiɛ akpala adi asɔ eeebo na babla lɛnɔ.

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: Mmomu ɔlɛka bunye butaanu ulu ku liƒu ka badubɔtɛku-bu litemi. Ɔsika ogya bonwu ɔni muubile ala ubakyula Katɔti bekisine ƒui.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala ɔni néni Mose ɔda bubo na nkyuli inyɔ iye ɛtɛ bédie kenye ka use lɛni ni, bekyuli baadú ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔni na balánu-nwu kɔnyana.

english_verse: But it is much worse to dishonor God's Son and to disgrace the blood of the promise that made us holy. And it is just as bad to insult the Holy Spirit, who shows us mercy.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani manu Kristo ubugya aani lɛla lɛni neeese kedee ni, bɔgyi ka Katɔti ɔdubo-ma kɔtu bɔni geen! Ɔsika beedumi Katɔti Kɔyu kɔni mɔɔbla-bu lɛƒɔndia na baanu Katɔti Ubidi aani ɔɔɔdi lɛla lɛdi. Nsu ubugya ɔmmɔ na Katɔti úti ɔ́ƒɔ ekpidi údie-ma lɛlɔ, na ubugya ɔmmɔ kani na úti úse bunyimi bɔmmɔ likpo.

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bɔgyi anwu ɔni násu ɔnini, “Ami ndubudie ukyuli likpidi lɛni na ɔ́bla kasi na lɛƒɔ-nwu kayu na nwuna kayu kenye.” Anwu kani násɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ami Katɔti ndubɔtɛku mina bekyuli litemi.”

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Liƒu lɛla bonwu lɛdi si Katɔti ɔni nli ngba uwi ƒui ɔ́da-a na kɔnyi kemmo.

english_verse: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.
translation_verse: Binyimo uwi ɔni na bɛ́nu Katɔti bukeye na bínwini nwuna badi ku bukpoku bɔni kemmo na bɛ́sia bɛ́lɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdi ni, beedumi-mii na beekpóku-mii na kadi anumi. Na uwi bamba kemmo lɛnɔ ni, bɛɛnu kalɛ na baabla bekyuli bamba lɛnɔ aani kalɛ na bábla-mii.

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: Biiwuloku bani na batɛ aban ɔtɔ kɔnyana. Na bɛɛkɛ́ kayi ƒaa si ina béƒie-mii ala báƒɔ, ɔsika bɛgyi ka bibo akɛla ani ndia ntulo ammɔ na elébie kudii.

english_verse: Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bitaya na enu áƒɛ-mii na kalɛ na biisé kayi kemmo. Ɔsika bɛdubɔkɛ lɛyuƒɔla bonwu geen.

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: Ɔdi ka binye kpakplaa kalɛ na si bɛ́bla lɛla lɛni mɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti kaƒɔ bɛ́wɔlɔ ni, na bina kɔnu kutuku linyese lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔnini, “Kébu blii na ukyuli ɔni ndubo mmɔ ɔda ɔlɛ ɔni na ɔsɔ uletu uwi.

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Mina bekyuli bani mɔɔsiaku-mi kama siin ni, badubulie ngba na bana bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo. Nsu bani menwini kama makya-mi ni, lɛlɔ liláyɔ-mi na bana lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Nsu abu ni, bɔɔɔdi bekyuli bani muunwíni bula bɔƒɔtaadi kama na bɔyii udu. Mmomu bɔ́ƒɔ bɔ́di, na Katɔti ɔ́ƒɔ-bu.

english_verse: Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see.
translation_verse: Si ebo bɔƒɔtaadi ni, ɔɔtina ka ebo lɛnunsia kpakplaa na ala adi lɛlɔ. Na agyi geen ka adubɔkɛ ala adi ina ka alánu-nya.

english_verse: It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ na bekyuli bani nákya kuuku ni, Katɔti úmwi-ma ka badi bekyuli babuni.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ na búnu kalɔ ka Katɔti úti nwuna kenye litemi údie kayawi ƒui. Na lɛla lɛni na bula anumi aakana bɔnu mɛni ni, Katɔti údie-nya ɔ́siku lɛla lɛni na bulákana bɔnu kemmo.

english_verse: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ na Abel úti akpala ani ndia ntulo Kain akpala ɔ́kpa úte Katɔti. Na ɔkɛnku nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ ɔsu na Katɔti úmwi-nwu na ɔ́nu-nwu ka ɔdi ukyuli ɔni nse siin. Ɔsika nwuna akpala áyɔ Katɔti kaƒɔ. Ina ka Abel úkpi ni, ɔkɛnku nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ ɔsu na nwuna ablala amu aatɛmiku-bu.

english_verse: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku Enok bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ na Katɔti útiku-nwu ɔ́tɔlɔku ngba bɔmɛni kemmo ɔni na útekpi. Ɔdi biala útanu-nwu kesii kadi, ɔsika Katɔti útiku-nwu ɔ́tɔlɔku. Na asa na ɔdubutiku-nwu ɔtɔlɔku ni, ɔdi ukyuli ɔni na bémwi na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ka nwuna lɛlɔ lɛ́da Katɔti kubiti.

english_verse: But without faith no one can please God. We must believe that God is real and rewards everyone who searches for him.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔdi lɛlɔ liláda Katɔti kubiti si uuubo bɔƒɔtaadi. Ɔsika ukyuli biala ɔni muubo Katɔti kudɔ ni, ɔdi ka ɔƒɔ ɔdi ka Katɔti ɔkya na ɔɔƒɔ kayu buni teete bekyuli bani mɔɔwia-nwu kama ulu kpakplaa.

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́lɛ Noa kpakplaa na ala ani na útanu tɔ lɛlɔ ni, Noa ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di. Anwuɔsu ɔ́nwi ɔkɔlɔ ubendi ɔni kemmo na anwu ku nwuna kaduli bekyuli béduo bákɛ bɔƒɔ na bɔyia bɔni na úti úte Katɔti ɔsu. Noa bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmɛni búnwini kɔtɔ bɔdu úte kayawi bekyuli ƒui. Na ka Noa ɔ́ƒɔ Katɔti ɔ́di ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔ́su ka Noa ɔdi ukyuli ɔni nse siin.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ ɔsu na Abraham únu Katɔti litemi uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-nwu ka uteesie kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔ́su ka ɔdubuti ute-nwu lɛlɔ. Únu kalɔ na úsie ina ka ɔɔɔgyi likpo lɛni na úsela.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ na úlie kalɔ kani na Katɔti ɔ́su ka ɔdubute-nwu mmɔ kemmo. Na ɔ́kya mmɔ aani ɔƒɔ na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ. Kevo lɛtɔ kemmo kani na ɔ́kya. Na lɛni kani na Isak ku Yakob lɛnɔ bebelie. Ama lɛnɔ badi Katɔti ala badine aani anwu Abraham kalɛ úte ala ani na Katɔti ɔ́su úse.

english_verse: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Abraham unye ɔɔnu ulu ute ɔma unengudi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́da na use uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ ɔsu na ina ka Abraham ɔ́ɔbi ɔ́vili na Sara ɔlati muedi ɔ́vi kɔwɔ ni, Katɔti ɔ́ya na úbenwini ubi ɔti. Ɔsika Abraham ɔgyi ka Katɔti ɔni násu lɛla lɛmɛni úse ni, ɔɔdi nwuna etemila lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ina ka use aani si kaƒiɔtɔ kɔtu na unye muedi ni, údie kaba kani mmomo aani kayaa ayabi. Na bemomo aani ɛpu kɔnwinimi kɔni na balakana bɔka.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni ƒui ni, bélie ngba ku bɔƒɔtaadi útédu uwi ɔni na békpi. Ala ani kenye na Katɔti ɔ́su-ma úse ni, étetuku-ma kɔnu. Nsu ni, bánu-nya ɔ́gyu kakaaka na bégyingya enu bése ka baƒɔ linyese lɛmmɔ. Na básu nwaa ka badi baƒɔ na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bani mɔɔsu ala amɛni ni, baatina ka baanu ulu teete ama alati bana kalɔ.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Na si kalɔ kani lɛlɔ na bátɔlɔ lɛlɔ kasusu na beeti ni, nka bákɛ ulu ɔni na basɔ benwini besie mmɔ.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Mmomu ni, baanu ulu teete kalɔ kani ndia ntulo kammɔ. Na aka ndi Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma kadi. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu ulekpo Katɔti lɛnɔ kɔƒa ka balɔ-nwu banii bana Katɔti. Ɔsika ɔ́ɔda ɔma unengudi ɔdi úse-ma.

english_verse: Abraham had been promised that Isaac, his only son, would continue his family. But when Abraham was tested, he had faith and was willing to sacrifice Isaac,
translation_verse: Ɔ́bla lɛni ina ka ɔkɛnku ubidi Isak ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɔkɛnku Isak lɛlɔ na adubudie kaba aani kalɛ na lɛ́su-ɔ líse.”

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: Abraham kasusu klukui ndi ka Katɔti ɔɔkana na ɔɔgyila bekpine na baasɔ teebelie ngba. Na sɔsɔ ni, bɔkana bɔsu ka bɔƒɔ na Katɔti ɔ́ƒɔ Isak ɔ́siku kekpine na úbo uli ngba.

english_verse: Isaac had faith, and he promised blessings to Jacob and Esau.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ na Isak úte Yakob ku Esau ku bana bawɔ ƒui kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ ni, uwi ɔni na Yakob ɔ́ɔbi na ɔ́bu ɔƒa nwuna ugyii ɔdadi lɛlɔ na ɔɔyɔ́ ukpi ni, úte Yoseƒ bebi ɔdi biala kusɛ kusɛ, na úmwi Katɔti.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ na uwi ɔni na Yoseƒ ɔ́nu ka ɔdubo bukpi ni, ɔ́su kalɛ na Israelƒuɔ badubo bɔtɔlɔ Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na ɔ́tina kalɛ na babla nwuna ekubi ani ndubuwi kaƒiɔtɔ kemmo uwi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ ɔsu na Mose bawɔne béti-nwu bábɛla abuli atɛ ɔni na báwɔ-nwu. Ɔsika bánu-nwu báti ka ɔɔɔdi ubi keeke na ɔdi na báwɔ. Na bátayia ɔda ɔni na kalɔ kammɔ ɔga úbo bawɔne ƒui lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ ɔsu na Mose úni ɔnii batalɔ-nwu banii Ɔga Ƒarao ulekubi ubidi uwi ɔni na ɔ́lɛ lili.

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: Únu kalɔ ka babla anwu lɛnɔ kalala aani nwuna badi bani ndi Katɔti bekyuli utulo ɔni na wasiaku ala ekpidi bablane kama na ɔkɛ ebiti uwi klukui ɔdi kemmo.

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: Ɔ́nu ka si bákya-nwu kɔƒa na Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔni lɛlɔ na nwuna anu asia lɛlɔ ni, ɔ́ƒɔ-nwu kuye utulo ka ɔsiaku Egyipteƒuɔ akɛla kama. Ɔsika unye ɔɔnu ulu ute lɛyuƒɔla lɛni na Katɔti ɔdubute-nwu.

english_verse: Because of his faith, Moses left Egypt. Moses had seen the invisible God and wasn't afraid of the king's anger.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ ɔsu na ɔ́tɔlɔ Egyipte ɔni na útayia kɔnyi kɔni na ɔga ɔmmɔ wakɛ. Na únye kpakplaa aani si bɔnu na ɔ́ɔnu Katɔti ɔni na bula anumi alákana bɔnu tɔ.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ na ɔ́bla Kukpi Lili Bɔvia ɔdi ku ubugya ɔni na ɔ́kuna úwi kayakun biala. Na ɔkɛnku ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti ɔtu ɔni nébo úbadu ubi ɔnanabi udeedi biala na Egyipte mmɔ ni, útetuku Israel bebi ama.

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ na Israel bekyuli bakɛ kalɔ kakwiidi lɛlɔ bávia Ɛpugyie. Nsu Egyipteƒuɔ ama ni, ɛpu ɔmmɔ úti-ma ɔni na baavia-ka.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ ɔsu na awodu bonwu ani na bátu bámana Yeriko ɔma ɔmmɔ áƒɛ ewi kalɔ ɔni na Israelƒuɔ bésie báka bámana-nya lɛlɔ emeyi maatɛ.

english_verse: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ ɔsu na bátadu Rahab ɔni ndi ɔyalɛ mmɔ aani kalɛ na bádu bakladi bani nátaƒɔ Katɔti bátadi. Ɔsika Rahab úgyingya enu na ɔ́ƒɔ Israelƒuɔ batu bani nésie baatú kalɔ kammɔ.

english_verse: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
translation_verse: Bi lɛnɔ na nsɔ nsu-mii? Uwi uuubo ka lɛtɛmi lɛsiku Gideon ku Barak ku Simson ku Yeƒta ku Dawid ku Samuel ku Katɔti kenye bediene lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Their faith helped them conquer kingdoms, and because they did right, God made promises to them. They closed the jaws of lions
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ ni, bana badi békpo na bádi lɛga kadikɔ lɛlɔ. Na badi báya na bekyuli baabla ala ulu lɛlɔ. Na badi kɔnu kútuku Katɔti linyese lɛmmɔ. Na badi bákalɛ bagyata inye.

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: Na badi benine lɛgyavonku bonwu lɛni mɔɔkywí teebile ala. Na badi bálɛ bekyuli bani mɔɔwia-ma badu ku kuwii enu kemmo. Na ina ka bekyuli bamɛni ƒui beeebo ɔyikun ɔdi ni, Katɔti ɔ́ya na bénwini bayikune! Na bénwini bekpone bani mbo ɔyikun geen na bádi kadi bamba bekpone ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Na beleku bani na bana bebi békpi ni, bana bebi bammɔ básɔ báta. Na babambadi ni, bátatuna ka bekyuli besusu-ma na kalala kemmo na bekpi. Ɔsika bátatuna ka balɛ bana Katɔti kama na bakɛ bɔnwuna na bekyuli bammɔ kemmo. Mmomu básu banii badubɔkɛ ngba bɔwɔdi bɔni ndia ntulo bɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Bekyuli béwi badi anumi kalɔ na bébo-ma. Na badi lɛnɔ ni, bébo-ma kɔgba na bákya-ma aban ɔtɔ.

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: Bébo badi atabi na bábwɛ badi lɛnɔ kemmo inyɔ. Na bádu badi ku kewii. Na badi béteenyimi baƒonu ku bese lɛku taavi, ɔsika beeebo lɛla lɛdi. Na bekyuli bábla-ma kalala, na bébo abi geen!

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: Bátakɛ keliekɔ na bekyuli bayawine akɔ. Na bakɛ baaví ketele kemmo ku abi akɔ na bélie atakpɛ ku kalɔ libu kemmo. Nsu bekyuli bamɛni badia betulo kayawi bekyuli.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛnku bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ ɔsu na Katɔti ɔ́lɔ bekyuli bamɛni ƒui anyi buni. Nsu ɔmɛni ƒui kama ni, bana akɔ kɔnu kútetuku linyese lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: Katɔti nábla ɔmɛni úse lɛni ka benye bagya-bu útédu ka abu ku-ma ƒui bɔ́kɛ lɛla lɛni na ɔ́su úse ka lɛdia litulo na mɛni na ɔbla bula ƒui ngba bɔƒɔ kabla ɔwɔlɔ.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka bubo bekyuli pii bamɛni udu bani muudie bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmɛni kenye ni, bɛya buti ala ani muutile-bu kuƒi mmɔ ku ekpidi ani mɔɔbala-bu uwi pii buvaakun. Na bukeli usi ɔni ntɛ-bu anumi ku lɛnungyie.

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: Na bɛya na butaanu Yesu lɛti pɛ anumi. Anwu ntɔnku-bu na anwu kani ndubɔya na bula bɔƒɔtaadi bɔbla bɔƒɔtaadi geen bɔwɔlɔ. Ka ɔgyi lɛlɔyɔ lɛni na Katɔti ɔdubɔya na ɔkɛ ɔsu ni, ɔ́kya ɔkplu na úbo abi na ugyii lɛlɔ. Na útakpete edumi ku kɔƒa kɔni bákya-nwu. Na ɔmmɔ kama ni, útélie lɛgaboku lɛlɔ na Katɔti kɔdianu kesii kani náƒɔ kuye ketulo.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Bɛtɛya Yesu ɔni nákya ɔkplu na úbo abi na ala ekpidi bablane bamɛni enu kemmo, kalɛ na enu alaƒɛ-mii na binwini kama.

english_verse: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛni na biikpóku kalɛ na bɛdi likpidi lɛlɔ ni, útedu tɔ kalɛ na bina ubugya uwi kalɔ.

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: Munuu bɛ́ɛyiƒala Katɔti etemila ani na ɔ́su-mii úti ɔ́kya-mii ogya aani bebi kalɛ? Ɔ́su ɔnini, “Mina ubi, teti Katɔti kɔtu bɔni tabla lɛla keeke. Na enu ataƒɛ-ɔ si ɔɔdɔnku-ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́ ni, ama na ɔɔlɛ kpakplaa. Na bani lɛnɔ na ɔɔƒɔ́ ka badi anwu badi ni, ama na ɔɔní kɔtu.”

english_verse: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
translation_verse: Binye lɛbibo biala kenye aani kɔtu bɔni bɔni na ubi ɔti uute ubi. Na ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka Katɔti mɔɔní-mii kɔtu lɛni aani nwuna bebi. Ɔsika ubi ɔti ɔdi uuubo ɔni na ulani ubidi kɔtu.

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Si balani-ɔ kɔtu aani kalɛ na bɔgyi ka baaní ɔdi biala kɔtu ni, na ɔgbami na báwɔ-ɔ básiku na aaadi kaduli kammɔ kemmo ubi.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama bubo bati bani náwɔ-bu na kalɔ kamɛni lɛlɔ na baaní-bu kɔtu na bɔɔbu-ma lɛnɔ na ɔmɛni ɔsu. Anwuɔsu ɔlɛka buboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bute Katɔti ɔni ndi bula kɔyu kemmo Ɔti kalɛ na bulie ngba.

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: Bula bati bani na bubo mɛni baaní-bu kɔtu uwi klukui ɔdi kemmo kani kalɛ na bánu ka ɔ́manku-bu. Nsu Katɔti ɔɔní-bu kɔtu kalɛ na ɔdia ute-bu na abu lɛnɔ bɔbla kedee aani kalɛ na use.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Kɔtu bɔni biala buláyu ukyuli emini na uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo. Mmomu bɔɔyu ɔlɛ. Nsu ɔmmɔ kama ni, bani na báni-ma kɔtu lɛni ni, baabla ala abuni na ulu siin lɛlɔ, na baakɛ́ keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: Now stand up straight! Stop your knees from shaking
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bina akɔnkɔ ku enu ani mɔɔtɔ́-mii ni, bɛya na ɔyikun ɔwɔdi uduo-ni kemmo.

english_verse: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse. Warning against Turning from God
translation_verse: Bɛbwɛ bina kɔvinkɔ ƒui na kɔdia bɔvi kalɛ na bani neeebo ɔlɔkplu ni, balakpa balaƒɛ belewi kalɔ, mmomu basia-mii kama na bakɛ ɔlɔkplu bawɔlɔ.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛsia ulu biala lɛlɔ na keyi buɛɛ kakya amii ku bekyuli ƒui ntɛ na bɛbla kedee. Ɔsika ɔdi biala ulakana na wanu Katɔti si uuuse kedee.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Bɛnu kaduɛ kalɛ na ɔdi ulayii Katɔti lɛƒɔndia ulu ɔmmɔ, kalɛ na ulénwini ligyukui likpidi ulakya bakladi akɔ na weboku ɔgbankpi na webile bekyuli pii.

english_verse: Watch out for immoral and ungodly people like Esau, who sold his future blessing for only one meal.
translation_verse: Bɛnu kaduɛ kalɛ na lɛyalɛ ala elebile ɔdi kasusu iye ɔsɔ ulayia Katɔti aani kalɛ na Esau útayia ɔsu na úti nwuna linengu kadikɔ úye ɔ́vumanaku adila bɔdi kunwi pɛ.

english_verse: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ kama aani kalɛ na bɛgyi ni, uwi ɔni na ɔɔwia ka ɔti use-nwu kama ku kusɛ kusɛ ni, úni-nwu. Na Esau ɔ́sɔ útakana lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla bɔvumana ina ka ɔ́wia kusɛ kusɛ ɔmmɔ ku keku.

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: Amii biiise aani Israelƒuɔ bani nébenye lɛla lɛni na bakana bɔnu bɔti iye betuku kudɔ ɔni ndi Sinai kɔbi kɔni mɔɔda ku ogya bonwu na lɛdisa ku kesii kani nse suu na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kpakplaa kemmo.

english_verse: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
translation_verse: Bítenu tɔ kakpɛɛ kani náku momoomo iye lɛdi lɛni etemila na bani nénu bévele ka basɔ baláwia belénu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.
translation_verse: Ɔsika balákana ala ani na ɔ́su-ma lɛlɔ bɔdi ɔni na ɔ́su-ma ɔnini, “Si ina ebuo ɔdi nétuku kɔbi kɔmmɔ ni, ɔdi ka bebo-nwu atabi badu.”

english_verse: The sight was so frightening that Moses said he shook with fear.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni bánu mmɔ lɛdi liƒu lɛla libendi lɛni náya na Mose ɔ́su ɔnini, “Liƒu lítulo-mi, na lɛlɔ lɛɛtɔ́-mi!”

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Biiise aani Israelƒuɔ bammɔ. Mmomu amii ni, Sion Kɔbi kudɔ na bíbo bínye ɔni ndi Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma Yerusalem ɔni ndi Katɔti ɔni nli ngba uwi ƒui ɔma unengudi. Katɔti batu mpim mpim kasala bani na lɛlɔyɔ lɛ́ƒɔ-ma kemmo na bíbo bíbasiaku.

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
