translation_verse: Na bíbo bíbasiaku Katɔti bekyuli bani nse aani nwuna bebi bedeedi bani anyi na bénweni bése katɔ. Katɔti ɔni ndubɔtɛku bayawine ƒui litemi anumi na bíbo bínye na bekyuli babuni bani nékpi na Katɔti ɔ́bla bana ayu sɛɛn ɔ́wɔlɔ akɔ.

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: Na bíbo bíbasiaku Yesu ɔni ndi bunyimi bɔwɔdi bɔmɛni kenye unyene. Na ɔ́kuna nwuna ubugya ɔni mɔɔsu etemila ani mbo ɔyikun etulo Abel ɔdi úwi-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: Bɛnu kaduɛ na biléni anwu ɔni mɔɔtɛmiku-mii. Ɔsika si bekyuli bani nénu anwu ɔni nálɛ-ma kpakplaa na kayawi kamɛni lɛlɔ batakana na bekeli bana kɔtu bɔni ni, bɛti ka ulése abu lɛnɔ buɛɛ uletulo ama si búni anwu ɔni nási katɔ úbalɛ-bu.

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔmmɔ kemmo ni, nwuna lɛdi lɛkunku kayawi. Nsu ɔƒɛni ni, ɔ́su-bu úse ɔnini, “Nsɔ ndubo kayawi kammɔ bɔkunku kunwi. Na ɔɔɔdi aka lɛti, mmomu ku katɔ lɛnɔ.”

english_verse: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
translation_verse: Etemila ani na ɔ́su ɔnii, “Nsɔ ndubo bɔkunku kunwi” ni, ɔɔtina ka Katɔti ɔdubɔda ala ani na údie na aakunku mmɔ budie ana kenyekɔ. Na ani na balákana bɔkunku asɔ akya.

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ka lɛga kadikɔ kani kemmo na bɔdubuduo kalákunku ɔsu ni, bɛya na bɔgya Katɔti enu na bumwi-nwu na ulu ɔni námanku lɛlɔ ku ɔbu ku bɔyia.

english_verse: Our God is like a destructive fire!
translation_verse: Ɔsika bula Katɔti use aani ogya ɔni mɔɔkyula ala.

english_verse: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
translation_verse: Bitaayɔ lɛlɔ uwi biala kemmo aani banwa kalɛ.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Na bitayiƒala baƒɔ bɔƒɔ, ɔsika badi báƒɔ Katɔti batu na béduo-ma kudɔ ɔni na baaagyi.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Na binyimo bani lɛnɔ ntɛ aban ɔtɔ aani si amii lɛnɔ na bákya ɔtɔ ku-ma ku bekyuli bani na baabla-ma kalala aani si amii muubó abi.

english_verse: Have respect for marriage. Always be faithful to your partner, because God will punish anyone who is immoral or unfaithful in marriage.
translation_verse: Ɔgya ku ule ngba bulie ni, ɔdi ka bite-mu ɔbu geen. Na ɔdi utalɛ ɔkpanadi kama. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔdubɔtɛku ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi kɔsɔnɔ litemi ku bani na lɛyalɛ ala áƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: Anumi asɔ etegyie-mii na egulabi lɛlɔ. Mmomu bɛya na lɛla lɛni bibo limo-mii. Ɔsika Katɔti ɔ́su ɔnini, “Lɛɛɛdubo-mii bɔnyonu kudii, na neeedie-mii atu lɛnɔ kudii.”

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɔɔsu ku kayi ƒui bɔnini, “Blɔti ndi mina ubunkune, anwuɔsu lɛɛɛdubo bɔyia. Bi na ukyuli ɔdubɔkana-mi bɔbla?”

english_verse: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
translation_verse: Binyimo bina batɔnkune bani násu-mii Katɔti litemi. Na bɛbu bɛnu kɔsia kɔni na bákɛ na ulu ɔni na béti bélie ngba kemmo. Na bɛnu bana bɔƒɔtaadi bɛtɛya.

english_verse: Jesus Christ never changes! He is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo ulávumana. Kalɛ kani na úse uwi ɔni návi kemmo ni, lɛni kani na use ɔƒɛni ku uwi ɔni mebo ƒui lɛnɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: Bitaƒɔ lɛla bamba lɛni na ukyuli ɔdi watina-mii bitadi. Katɔti lɛƒɔndia mɔɔyá na bɛɛkya kayi ɔkplu, na ɔɔɔdi ɔda bubo bɔni ndanku adila bɔdi kama bɔsia. Bekyuli bani mɔɔsia ala ammɔ kama ni, balakɛ kɔsia kɔdi.

english_verse: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.
translation_verse: Abu ni, bubo lɛkpabi lɛni lɛlɔ ala na ama bani mɔɔkpá na Yudaƒuɔ kakpakɔ kammɔ kemmo beeebo kuƒi ka badi.

english_verse: After the high priest offers the blood of animals as a sin offering, the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.
translation_verse: Mmɔ na ɔkpane unengudi uuti bebuo ubugya teeduoku kesii kani nse kedee ntulo ƒui mmɔ. Na uusié mmɔ taatákpa teevele ala na bekyuli ekpidi lili. Nsu baakyula bebuo bammɔ na kabanye.

english_verse: Jesus himself suffered outside the city gate, so his blood would make people holy.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na Kristo lɛnɔ úbo abi na ɔma kabanye kalɛ na ɔbla nwuna badi kedee ɔkɛnku nwuna ubugya lɛlɔ.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, bɛya na busie butásiaku-nwu na kabanye mmɔ na bakya-bu kɔƒa kɔni bákya anwu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: Ɔsika na kayawi mɛni ni, buuubo ɔma ɔni ndubuse buteesie uwi ƒui. Mmomu bunye bɔɔnu ulu teete ɔma ɔni mebo.

english_verse: Our sacrifice is to keep offering praise to God in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, bɛya na bɔsia Kristo lɛlɔ na buteeti linugya akpala teete Katɔti. Na akpala ammɔ ndi kalɛ na buubó nwuna lɛnyi kedee kudu ku bula kenye.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Na bitayiƒala ka bɛbla lɛbuni bite lɛlɔ, na bite lɛlɔ ala. Ɔsika akpala ammɔ udu mɔɔda Katɔti kubiti.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Binu bina batɔnkune litemi na biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bite-ma na badi-mii lɛlɔ. Ama mɔɔnu-mii lɛlɔ aani bekyuli bani na ɔlɛka babu akunta bete Katɔti. Bɛbu-ma kalɛ na bana kabla kenwini lɛlɔyɔ na ulabla-ma etila. Ɔsika ɔmmɔ ulete-mii kenyekɔ kabuni kadi.

english_verse: Pray for us. Our consciences are clear, and we always try to live right.
translation_verse: Bɛkpali katɔ na bula lili. Bɔgyi nwaa ka bula kayi kaladu-bu kɔtɔ kɔdi. Na bɔɔyɔ́ ka butaabla lɛla lɛni ndia uwi biala.

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: Na ɔni ntulo ndi ka muuvele-mii geen nnii bɛkpali katɔ na mina lili, kalɛ na Katɔti ɔya na lɛsɔ libo-mii kudɔ pla.

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: Na muuvele keyi buɛɛ Katɔti ɔni nkɛnku bunyimi bɔwɔdi bɔni nse úsela ƒui ɔsu na ɔ́gyila Yesu Kristo ɔni ndi baƒonu ɔdane buni ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ nnii

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: ute-mii ala abuni ani ƒui na bɛkana biti bɛbla nwuna lɛyɔla. Na muuvele-nwu nnii ɔbla lɛla lɛni na ɔɔyɔ́ na bula lɛlɔ kemmo ɔkɛnku Yesu Kristo ɔni námanku úte bumwi uwi ƒui lɛlɔ. Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Banwa, muuvele-mii geen nnii binu-mi ala ani na mɔɔsu-mii ku ogya ɔni mɔɔkya-mii. Ɔsika ɔku klukui ɔdi kani na línweni-mii.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyɔ́ ka lɛya bɛti ka bányonu bula ɔnwa Timoteo na aban ɔtɔ. Na si úyile mɛni búbeduo ni, ami ku-nwu bɔdubo bubanu-mii.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Bigyele bina batɔnkune ƒui bite-bu ku Katɔti bekyuli bammɔ ƒui. Banwa bani nkya Italia ƒui beegyele-mii.

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Ami Yakobo ɔni ndi Katɔti ku Blɔti Yesu Kristo kabla ɔblane muugyele amii Katɔti bekyuli ƒui bani négyingya bakya kayawi ekpo ekpo ƒui. Si Ala Eekpóku-mii Ni, Lɛlɔ Litaayɔ-mii

english_verse: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Banwa, lɛlɔ litaayɔ-mii si ala lidu lidu eekpóku-mii.

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Bɛya na kalɛ na binye kpakplaa mɛni usie anumi ubu na ɔlɛ-mii kɔsia ɔwɔlɔ. Na bɛbla baƒɔtaadine babuni bani na lɛbuni bɔbla bɔ́ƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui.

english_verse: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
translation_verse: Si bina akɔ ɔdi ɔɔyaki lɛnunda ni, ɔlɛka uvele Katɔti na ɔdubuti-ni ute-nwu, ɔsika Katɔti uuti-ni teete ukyuli biala ku kaƒɔ ƒaa.

english_verse: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
translation_verse: Nsu si biivele-nwu lɛla lɛdi ni, ɔlɛka bɛƒɔ bɛdi ka ɔdi-nwu bɔyɔ ka ute-mii. Na bina kasusu ketenwini. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni na nwuna kasusu keenwíni ni, use aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ uuƒwi ɔnantu ntu taavinku.

english_verse: If you are that kind of person, you can't make up your mind, and you surely can't be trusted. So don't expect the Lord to give you anything at all. Poor People and Rich People
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni na nwuna kasusu kese inyɔ inyɔ na nwuna ablala eeese siin ni, utasia anu ɔnii ɔdubɔkɛ lɛla lɛdi ɔsiku Blɔti kudɔ.

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Si Katɔti ɔ́talaku ɔƒɔtaadine ɔni ndi ɔwabane katɔ ni, ɔya na lɛlɔ litaayɔ-nwu.

english_verse: But any who are rich should be glad when God makes them humble. Rich people will disappear like wild flowers
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na si Katɔti úboku ɔƒɔtaadine ɔni ndi ɔlakɛne kalɔ ni, anwu lɛnɔ ɔya na lɛlɔ litaayɔ-nwu. Ɔsika ɔlakɛne biala uwi ɔdububo ubavi aani kalɛ na lɛku kemmo kugyii kuuwiile kuna anwula teewi kalɔ.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Aanu si ɔƒɛ ɔ́tu na ɔɔbi ni, ɔɔyá na eveteli aayɛyɛ na ana anwula eewiile teewi kalɔ. Na ana bɔdia lɛnɔ bɔɔyii udu. Lɛni kani na ɔlakɛne kabla lɛnɔ kadububo kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni náƒɔ ɔ́di na unye kpakplaa na ɔɔsiáku ala ani ƒui muukpóku-nwu. Ɔsika si enu átaƒɛ-nwu ni, ɔdubɔkɛ ngba ƒui lɛyuƒɔla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka ɔdubute bekyuli bani mɔɔyɔ́-nwu.

english_verse: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
translation_verse: Si lɛla lɛdi liikpóku ukyuli ɔdi taanu ni, utasu ɔnii Katɔti muukpóku-nwu taanu. Ɔsika lɛla lɛdi lilekpoku Katɔti taanu. Anwuɔsu anwu lɛnɔ ulekpoku ukyuli ɔdi ɔnii ɔbla likpidi.

english_verse: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
translation_verse: Mmomu ɔlɔna alaekpidi ani mɔɔda ukyuli ɔkwɛ ni, anya muunwíni teekpoku-nwu.

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: Na ala ani mɔɔda-nwu ɔkwɛ mmɔ ni, aaƒɔ́-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo na ɔɔyá na ɔɔbla likpidi. Na uwi ɔni na likpidi lɛmmɔ lɛnɔ lɛ́di-nwu lɛlɔ ƒui ni, ɔdubukpi ɔkya likpidi kemmo.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: Banwa bayɔne, bitaya na ukyuli ɔdi ɔtɔlɔ-mii.

english_verse: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
translation_verse: Ala abuni ani ƒui na bubo na bɔɔnu ka adia geen sɔsɔ ni, Katɔti kudɔ na aasí. Na ulávumana iye udie-bu atu aani ɔƒɛ ku kɔbuli kɔni nédie kuse na buduo lɛdisa kemmo.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔkɛ ngba bɔƒɔ litemi geen lɛlɔ na ɔ́ya na bɔ́kɛ kɔyu kemmo ngba. Ɔ́bla ɔmɛni ɔ́siaku nwuna lɛƒɔyɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ɔɔwia ka bɔbla bedeedi na nwuna ala ani na údie ƒui akɔ. Bitaabla Taasiaku Blɔti Litemi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: My dear friends, you should be quick to listen and slow to speak or to get angry.
translation_verse: Banwa bayɔne, binyimo na ukyuli biala use atu unu lɛla biala. Na uwi lɛlɔ na ɔkɔsi bɔtɛmi. Na uteteeti kɔnyi pla pla.

english_verse: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli kɔnyi kulábla ala abuni ani na Katɔti ɔɔwia taasiku-nwu kudɔ.

english_verse: You must stop doing anything immoral or evil. Instead be humble and accept the message planted in you to save you.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛda lɛlɔ bidie ala ani naaadia bɔnu ku ekpidi udu biala kudɔ. Na biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bite Katɔti. Na biƒie nwuna litemi buni lɛni na úti ɔ́kya bina kayi kemmo bɛda. Ani ndubɔya na bɛkɛ bɔƒɔ.

english_verse: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
translation_verse: Litemi buni lɛmmɔ ndi Katɔti ɔda ɔni na úbo-bu geen. Na ani mɔɔyá bekyuli baakɛ́ bɔnwuna. Si ukyuli únu na úduo etemila ammɔ kemmo kaduɛ na útayiƒala ka ɔbla ɔsiaku-nya lɛlɔ ni, ala ani na ɔɔbla ƒui adubɔtɛ ete-nwu.

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔkali ɔnii ɔdi ɔƒɔtaadine buni na ulákana nwuna unyemi bɔda ni, ɔɔtɔ́lɔ lɛlɔ na nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ buuubo kɔsia kɔdi.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Bɔƒɔtaadi ulu ɔni na Katɔti ɔɔnu ka use sɛɛn na bɔƒiɔ bɔdi buuubo-nwu kemmo ndi ɔmɛni. Ɔlɛka ukyuli ubunku bekyuli bani muubó abi aani bekpinebi ku bekpinele kalɛ. Na ɔda lɛlɔ udie kayawi ekpidi biala kemmo.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: Banwa, ka bɛ́ƒɔ Blɔti Yesu Kristo ɔni ndi Bula Ɔbune bɛ́di ɔsu ni, bitanu anumi bitabla lɛla lɛdi.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: Bɛkali nkyuli inyɔ badi bɛnu bɛnii bébo bina kasalakɔ. Unwi ɔdi ɔlakɛne ɔni nda lɛlɔ ku sika ugyiedi ala. Na unyɔdi ɔdi ɔwabane na unyimi adikpi.

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: Na bina akɔ ɔdi ɔ́su ɔlakɛne ɔmmɔ ɔnini, “Ƒula keliekɔ ndi kabuni kamɛni.” Na ɔ́su ɔwabane anwu ɔnini, “Táwia kesiadi lie, iye ténye ngye.”

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛmani na bɛdaku bɔbla mɛni? Bɛɛƒuna bekyuli kemmo na biilii bakladi teekpo na bina akɔ. Kasusu kekpidi kadi na bɛda bɛɛbla ala amɛni.

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Banwa, binu! Bɛgyi geen ka Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna kayawi kamɛni bawabane ka babla nwuna badi. Na ka báƒɔ Blɔti Yesu Kristo bádi ɔsu ni, bénwini kɔyu kemmo ala bakɛne. Na ama ndubuduo Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔ́su bekyuli bani mɔɔyɔ́-nwu úse.

english_verse: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
translation_verse: Nsu bilábu bawabane. Na balakɛne bamɛni mɔɔdi-mii lɛlɔ. Na beeti-mii teesienku litemi katɛkɔ.

english_verse: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
translation_verse: Na ama ndi bekyuli bani muutemi enyekpi taasiku lɛnyi lɛni na baalɔ-mii na lɛ́ƒɔ-mii kuye lɛnɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́di Katɔti ɔda bubo bunengudi bɔmɛni lɛlɔ ni, bɛ́bla-nwu kaduɛ. Ɔkya Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ka, “Yɔ ƒula ukyulikpana aani ƒula lɛlɔ kalɛ.”

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Nsu si anumi lɛlɔ na bɛɛnu taabla ala ni, na bɛɛbla likpidi. Na ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔɔdú-mii kɔtɔ ka bɛdi alaekpidi bablane.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni na ɔ́ta únye Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ ɔdi lɛlɔ ni, ɔ́ta únye ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ bɔɔsu bɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔdi utadi kɔsɔnɔ.” Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ukyuli ɔdi utadu ɔkpanadi.” Anwuɔsu si aládi kɔsɔnɔ nsu ádu ƒula ɔkpana ni, áta énye ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Speak and act like people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.
translation_verse: Ka Katɔti ɔdubɔtɛku-bu litemi ɔkɛnku ɔda bubo bɔni muute-bu bɔnwuna lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, bɛnu kaduɛ na lɛla lɛni na bɛɛsu ku lɛla lɛni bɛɛbla lɛnɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Ɔsika si Katɔti ɔɔtɛku ɔdi litemi ni, ɔɔɔdubo-nwu kɔnyana bɔnu si ukyuli ɔmmɔ ulánu kɔnyana. Nsu si ɔdi ɔɔnu kɔnyana ni, Katɔti uládu-nwu kɔtɔ. Bɛbla Ala Ani Mɔɔtina Ka Bɛ́ƒɔ Bɛ́di

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: Mina banwa, si ɔdi ɔ́su ɔnii ubo bɔƒɔtaadi geen na uléti-mu taabla kabla kadi ni, na nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ udu buuubo kɔsia kɔdi. Na bulakana na bɔƒɔ-nwu ngba lɛnɔ.

english_verse: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
translation_verse: Biboku kasusu na banwa bani neeebo lɛwu lɛni bakya iye adila ani na badi lɛnɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: Si éni na étete-ma ala ani na baawia ni, na kɔsia kɔdi kuuubo-nwu kemmo ka asu-ma anii, “Biteesie na Katɔti ɔsiaku-mii. Na bɛdubɔkɛ lɛwu bɛkya na bɛkɛ adila bɛdi.”

english_verse: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si ɔdi ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di na uléti nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ taabla kabla ni, na bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ bɔdi bɔƒɔtaadi bukpludi.

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Nsu ɔdi ɔdubɔsu ɔnii, “Ukyuli ɔdi ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di, na ɔbambadi lɛnɔ ɔɔbla kabla.” Ami mɔɔsu ukyuli ɔmmɔ nnini, “Udie ɔtina-mi kalɛ na ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔƒɔ́ taadi na ulábla kabla. Na ami ndubɔtina-nwu kalɛ na lɛ́ƒɔ lɛ́di na mina kabla kani na mɔɔbla kemmo.”

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: Áƒɔ ádi ka Katɔti unwi pɛ nkya, na use lɛni sɔsɔ. Nsu nyimo ka ayu ekpidi lɛnɔ áƒɔ ádi lɛni, na baayia. Anwuɔsu na lɛlɔ lɛɛtɔ́-ma.

english_verse: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?
translation_verse: Ɔdɔlɔdi! Bɔtina na nsɔ ndubo-ɔ bɔtina nnii bɔƒɔtaadi bɔni lɛlɔ na kabla keeebunku ni, bɔdi bɔƒɔtaadi bukpludi?

english_verse: Well, our ancestor Abraham pleased God by putting his son Isaac on the altar to sacrifice him.
translation_verse: Dɛ na ɔ́bla asa na Katɔti ku bula ɔti Abraham ntɛ bɔ́dia? Ɔ́si lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla ɔsu. Ɔsika úti ubidi Isak ɔ́sia lɛkpabi lɛlɔ ka uti-nwu ɔkpa ute Katɔti.

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: Bilánu taati ka nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi úti ɔ́salaku lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla? Na kabla kammɔ náya na nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ bɔ́bla bɔbuni bɔ́wɔlɔ?

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: Na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo etemila ébo éte lɛni anini, “Abraham ɔ́ƒɔ Katɔti ɔ́di. Na ɔkɛnku nwuna bɔƒɔtaadi ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔ́bu-nwu aani ukyuli ɔni nse siin.” Na anwuɔsu Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-nwu ɔnii mina ɔkpana.

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Bɛnu bɛti ka asa na Katɔti ku ukyuli ntɛ bɔdubɔdia ni, ɔkɛnku kabla kani na ɔɔbla ɔsu. Na ɔɔɔdi kalɛ na ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di lɛti pɛ ɔsu.

english_verse: For example, Rahab had been a prostitute. But she pleased God when she welcomed the spies and sent them home by another way.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na ɔ́lɛku Rahab ɔyalɛ ɔmmɔ. Anwu ku Katɔti ntɛ bɔ́dia ɔkɛnku kalɛ na ɔ́ƒɔ Israel batu bani na bátala ɔsu. Úbunku-ma na bábɛ básia ulu bamba bálɛ bana bekisine enu kemmo.

english_verse: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, kalɛ na ɔlɔna ɔni kemmo na kɔyu kuuubo ɔdi ukpine ni, lɛni kani na si áƒɔ ádi na ƒula bɔƒɔtaadi bulábla kabla kadi ni, bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ búkpi.

english_verse: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
translation_verse: Banwa, bina pii bitenwini litemi buni ala batinane. Bɛgyi ka abu bani mɔɔtina ala ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔtɛku-bu litemi utulo bakladi.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bula ƒui bɔɔƒiɔ́. Nsu si ukyuli ɔdi ulaƒiɔ na lɛla lɛni na ɔɔsu kemmo ni, na ukyuli ɔmmɔ use siin na ɔda lɛlɔ lɛnɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
translation_verse: Beeti kabuli taabala ɔpɔnkɔ kenye kalɛ na beti-nwu besienku kesii biala na baayɔ́.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔlɔ ubendi ɔni nkɛ ɛpu anumi na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ubendi muudí-nwu ni, ugyii blii ɔdi kani na beti taaka-nwu taavinku. Na baakana na beeti-nwu teesienku kesii kani na baayɔ́ ka besie.

english_verse: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na unyemi lɛnɔ use. Ina ka use blii suɛ na ɔlɔna ekpo ƒui akɔ ni, anwu na ukyuli uuti taakun lɛmɛnɛ na ala ebendi lɛlɔ. Nu kalɛ na lɛku líbomo, nsu lɛgyakpabi lɛɛkana na lɛɛkyula-ni.

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na unyemi use aani ogya kalɛ. Use aani kayawi kani na alaekpidi áƒɔ-ka ƒui. Na ɔkya-bu ɔlɔna kemmo uubile ɔlɔna umodi ɔmmɔ ƒui ku nwuna enyekpi. Ɔɔyila-bu udu na ngba bɔmɛni kemmo. Na nwuna enyekpi ási ukisine ɔmmɔ ɔyikun kemmo na ɔdubuti ɔkyula kayawi kamɛni ku kana ala ƒui.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔɔkana na ɔbla bebuo bebendi ku baasɛ ku balakpi ku kɔkpaku na beteenu-nwu lɛdi. Na bábla lɛni sɔsɔ.

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: Nsu unyemi kani ndi lɛla lɛni na ɔdi útakana na ɔbla-nwu na uteenu lɛdi. Ɔdi lɛla likpidi lɛni na balakana bɔbala. Ɔkana ɔdu ukyuli aani kalɛ na kɔlakpi kɔni mbo ugyulo ukpidi kuse kalɛ.

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Libiɔ lɛdi biala liláyu ntu buni ku mma ntu na ubu unwi ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: Mina banwani, kugyii kulátu ebeli na aƒoƒoli alánwu kugyii ebi lɛnɔ. Lɛni kani na libiɔ lɛbuni lilakana na lɛyu mma ntu. Katɔti Lɛnunda Lɛdanku Lɛlɔ Kalɔ Buboku

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔnu lɛlɔ aani ɔnundane na bina akɔ ni, ɔlɛka uboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na ɔbla ala buni uti ɔtina ka ɔ́da anu.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Nsu si ebo lɛnungyie na ƒula kayi kemmo ku enyekpi na aawia awɔ lɛti lɛkɛ ni, takun lɛmɛnɛ ka áda anu. Ɔsika aanyi ɔkɔ, na alásu litemi geen lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Lɛnunda lɛmmɔ udu lítasi Katɔti kudɔ. Kayawi mɛni na lɛ́si, na lɛɛɛkɛnku ngba buni bulie ulu lɛlɔ. Mmomu lɛdi lɛnunda likpidi.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Na kasalakɔ kani na lɛnungyie ku ukyuli unwi lɛkɛ kani nkya mmɔ ni, bekyuli bammɔ beeƒú na alaekpidi lidu lidu mɔɔkya-ma akɔ.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Bi muuti kekpo ku kadɔ teeboku bina akɔ? Bina kayawi ebiti ani kama na bɛsiaku na eekpóku-mii na bina lɛlɔ kemmo ni, ana kudɔ na ɔɔsí.

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Bɛɛwia kayawi ala, nsu bilakɛ-nya. Anwuɔsu na bɛɛdú lɛlɔ. Anumi eegyie-mii na ana lɛlɔ geen, nsu bilakɛ-nya. Anwuɔsu bɛɛdɔ na biikpóku lɛlɔ. Bɛɛwia-nya nsu kɔnu kuletuku-mii, ɔsika bilévele Katɔti na ute-mii.

english_verse: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
translation_verse: Si ina bívele Katɔti muedi ni, ulákpete-mii. Ɔsika ɔɔɔdi kasusu kabuni kemmo na biiye-nwu ala ammɔ. Na lɛla lɛni kani na bɛɛwia ka biti lɛlakɛ lɛmmɔ bɛbla ndi ka biti-nya bɛsiaku kayawi ebiti ekpludi kama.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: Bɛdi bekyuli bani na biládi Katɔti ɔda bubo lɛlɔ. Bɛɛɛgyi ka si bɛ́bi bɛsiaku kayawi ala ni, bíti lɛlɔ bínwini Katɔti bekisine? Na ukyuli biala ɔni meti kayawi ala aani nwuna ɔkpana ni, ɔdi ukisine ute Katɔti.

english_verse: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi keeke na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔnini, “Katɔti uukpó kogyulo geen na kɔyu kɔni nkya-bu lɛlɔ kemmo ɔsu.”

english_verse: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
translation_verse: Nsu ka Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́-bu ɔsu ni, ɔɔkya-bu ɔkplu kalɛ na bɔkana bunye kpakplaa. Ɔmɛni ɔsu Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Katɔti ulátunaku bekyuli bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ, mmomu uubunku bani muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ.”

english_verse: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bite Katɔti. Bitatunaku ukisine ɔmmɔ, na ɔdubukeli-mii kudɔ.

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Bɛni bide Katɔti, na anwu lɛnɔ ɔdubɔni ude-mii. Amii alaekpidi bablane, bɛƒɔ bina enu! Na amii bani bina kasusu kese inyɔ inyɔ ni, bɛvumana bɛsia Blɔti lɛti kama!

english_verse: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
translation_verse: Na biteewulo kɔnyana. Amii bani mɔɔmá ni, bina lɛma linwini keku. Na bina lɛlɔyɔ linwini kɔnyana buwulo.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bite Blɔti, na ɔdubɔtalaku-mii katɔ.

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: Banwa, bitalɔ lɛlɔ anyikpi. Si ɔdi ɔ́bla lɛni iye ɔ́tɛku ɔnwani ɔdi litemi ni, na ulábu ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ na ɔ́ta únye-mu lɛlɔ lɛnɔ. Si bɛ́ta bínye ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, na ɔɔtina ka bɛ́da ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi bɛ́ya. Na bínwini bɛɛtɛku ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ litemi.

english_verse: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
translation_verse: Katɔti muute-bu ɔda bubo bɔmɛni, na anwu kani ndi Litemi Ɔtɛne ɔmmɔ. Anwu kani ndubɔkana na ɔƒɔ-bu ngba. Na anwu kani ndubɔkana na ɔyila-mu. Anwuɔsu buuubo kuƒi ka bɔtɛku bula banwani litemi. Bitatina Lɛlɔ

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Binu, amii bani mɔɔsu bɛnini, “Ɔmwi iye kɔnaadi bɔdubusie ɔma ɔdi butádi kuye, na bɔdubɔkya mmɔ lɛkwa linwi na bɔbla egulabi pii.”

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: Nsu bɛɛɛgyi kɔnaadi lɛla lɛni malɛku-mii. Bise aani uyɔ ɔni na si ɔƒɛƒɛɛ úduo-nwu akɔ pɛ na ɔɔyii taakya.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: Lɛla lɛni na ɔlɛka bɛsu ndi ɔnini, “Si Blɔti úte kuƒi na bútekpi ni, bɔdubɔbla kabla kamɛni iye kani ngye.”

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔƒaani ni, bɛɛtina lɛlɔ na bɛɛkun lɛmɛnɛ lɛnɔ. Na lɛmɛnɛ bɔkun biala bɔɔɔdia.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ukyuli ɔni ngyi lɛla lɛbuni bɔbla nsu ulábla-ni ni, ɔdi likpidi ute-nwu.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: Ɔƒɛni ni, amii balakɛne, biteewulo geen na lɛbibo lɛni ndubo-mii lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: Bina akɛla adubutili na ayii udu. Na bina adala lɛnɔ kubweyi kɔdububile-nya.

english_verse: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
translation_verse: Bina sika ugyiedi ku ɔƒualadi ɔni na bibo ni, ɔdubo bɔnyi bukpi. Na ɔmmɔ ndubudie-mii ute na Katɔti Litemi Bɔtɛ Limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na ala ani nétili mmɔ adubɔkun buduo-mii ɔlɔna kemmo aani kalɛ na ogya ɔɔkyula ukyuli. Na bɛ́ɛtɛ-nya bíse bíte lɛlɔ na bina uwi ukplodi ɔmɛni kemmo.

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Bɛnu! Kabla bablane bani nkya bina mmo ni, bíni na bítaƒɔ-ma kayu. Binu kalɛ na beewulo kɔnyana momoomo. Na bana keku kédu Katɔti, Bula Unwoti Ɔyikune Ƒui kudɔ.

english_verse: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
translation_verse: Ngba bɔni na bílie na kayawi mɛni ni, bɛ́kɛ kayawi kamɛni kemmo ebiti ku lɛlɔyɔ biala. Na bílie lɛmwi kalɛ na badu-mii na Litemi Bɔtɛ Limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
translation_verse: Bɛ́du bekyuli bani na bátaƒiɔ-mii kɔtɔ. Na bɛ́du-ma ina ka bátata bétenye-mii lɛlɔ. Bɛkɛ Kayi, Na Bitaasia Blɔti Bɔsɔ Bubo Anu

english_verse: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
translation_verse: Banwa, kalɛ na umonsene ɔɔkɛ́ kayi teete kaƒendi ɔnantu ku ketudi ɔnantu ute nwuna edula ani na ɔ́va bɔdia ɔsu ni, lɛni kani na ɔlɛka bɛkɛ kayi utédu uwi ɔni na Blɔti wasɔ webo.

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu amii lɛnɔ bɛkɛ kayi. Na enu ataƒɛ-mii, ɔsika Blɔti bɔsɔ bubo bɔmmɔ búude.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: Banwa, bitadɔnku lɛlɔ, kalɛ na Katɔti lɛnɔ ulatɛku-mii litemi. Ɔsika Litemi Ɔtɛne ɔmmɔ úude na ɔ́ɔklibi lɛlɔ ka ɔda ɔlɛ.

english_verse: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
translation_verse: Mina banwa, bɛnu Katɔti kenye bediene bani násu Katɔti litemi buni ku kalɛ bákɛ kayi na bénye bébo abi biala. Bɛnu-ma bɛtɛya.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Bɔɔlɔ-ma bekyuli bani lɛlɔ lɛ́yɔ-ma ka bénye lɛbibo biala kenye ɔsu. Bínu kalɛ na Hiob ɔ́kɛ kayi ku kalɛ na Katɔti ɔ́ƒɔ-nwu kayu na kawɔlɔkɔ. Ɔsika Blɔti ubo kaƒɔ buni na ɔɔnu kɔnyana.

english_verse: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
translation_verse: Mina banwani, ɔmɛni ndi lɛla lɛni náƒɔ kuye lítulo. Bitakpali ala na bɛlɔ katɔ iye kalɔ iye lɛla lɛdi biala. Bɛya na bina ɛɛn ɔbla ɛɛn, na bina oowo ɔbla oowo. Na si bɛɛbla lɛni ni, Katɔti ɔɔɔdubo-mii kɔtɔ bɔdu.

english_verse: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
translation_verse: Si bina ɔdi ɔkya lɛbibo kemmo ni, ɔlɛka ɔkpali Katɔti na ɔdububunku-nwu. Na si lɛlɔ mɔɔyɔ́ ɔdi lɛnɔ ni, utaatu lɛnu teemwi Katɔti.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Na si bina kemmo ɔdi uuƒi ni, ɔtala na balɔ baƒɔtaadine benengu na bebo babakpali katɔ bete-nwu na bawɛɛ-nwu nnɔmii na Blɔti lɛnyi kemmo.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: Na si baƒɔtaadine bammɔ bákpali Katɔti na bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo ni, ɔlɛne ɔmmɔ ɔlɛ ɔdubɔba-nwu na ɔkɛ ɔlɔkplu. Na si ɔ́bla likpidi lɛdi ni, Katɔti ɔdubuti ɔkyiɛ-nwu.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bidie bina alaekpidi ani na bɛ́bla kalɔ bite lɛlɔ. Na bitaakpali katɔ teete lɛlɔ kalɛ na Katɔti wabwi-mii lɛlɛ lɛni na biiƒi. Ukyuli ɔni nse sɛɛn ni, nwuna katɔ bɔkpali bubo ɔyikun geen.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: Elia úse kalɛ kani na abu lɛnɔ buse. Ɔ́kpali Katɔti kpakplaa na ɔ́su-nwu ɔnii utaya na ɔnantu ɔna. Na sɔsɔ ni, ɔnantu útana útewi kalɔ akwa atɛ ku abuli aku.

english_verse: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
translation_verse: Uwi ɔni na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́kpali Katɔ úye ɔnantu ni, ɔ́sɔ úse kalɔ ɔɔna na edula ásɔ ébo.

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Mina banwa, si bina akɔ ɔdi údeyi bɔƒɔtaadi ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na ɔkpanadi ɔ́sɔku-nwu úboku ni, ɔ́ya na ukyuli ukpidi ɔmmɔ kɔyu kɔ́lɛ kukpi kemmo. Na Katɔti ɔdubuti ekpidi pii ɔkyiɛ-nwu.

english_verse: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
translation_verse: Ami Petro ɔni ndi Blɔti Yesu Kristo ɔtalane muunweni ɔku ɔmɛni lite Katɔti baƒɔtaadine bani nátɔlɔ bana lɛma bésie belie Romaƒuɔ kɔlɔ kɔni ndi Ponto ku Galatia ku Kapadokia ku Asia ku Bitinia lɛlɔ.

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: Unwoti Katɔti ɔlati náƒuna-mii na nwuna bɔyɔ kenye. Na ɔ́ya na nwuna Kɔyu kɔ́bla-mii nwuna bekyuli kedee ka bɛ́di Yesu Kristo litemi lɛlɔ ɔsu. Na nwuna ubugya ɔ́bla-mii lɛlɔ sɛɛn. Muuvele nnii Katɔti lɛƒɔndia ku keyi buɛɛ kasiaku bina ƒui uwi biala kemmo. Baƒɔtaadine Bebo Lɛnunsia Lɛni Naaayii Udu Kudii

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bɔgya Katɔti ɔni ndi Blɔti Yesu Kristo Ɔti enu. Ka Katɔti ɔɔnu-bu kɔnyana geen ɔsu ni, ɔ́ya na bɔdubulie ngba bɔwɔdi na kɔyu kemmo, ɔsika ɔ́gyila Yesu Kristo ɔ́lɛku kekpine. Anwuɔsu na bubo lɛnunsia lɛni naaayii udu kudii.

english_verse: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
translation_verse: Na bɔɔnu anumi ka bɔdubɔdi ala ani na Katɔti ɔ́klibi úse na katɔ, na adi ala ani neeebie na alanyi taakpi iye ayii udu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: Amii ndubo ala ammɔ bɔdi, ɔsika Katɔti ɔɔgyumana-mii teete ngba bɔƒɔ limeyi lɛni ndububo ka bɛ́ƒɔ Blɔti Yesu Kristo bɛ́di ɔsu.

english_verse: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ litaayɔ-mii na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ina ka bɛdubo abi buteebo uwi uwi na bekpoku-mii lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Ala ani ndubɔsiaku-mii ndubɔtina kalɛ na bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́di geen. Sika ugyiedi ɔni muubie muedi ni, ogya kemmo na beeti-nwu taakya taanu-nwu taati kalɛ na ɔdia. Anwuɔsu bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɔni náƒɔ kuye butulo sika ugyiedi ɔmɛni ni, ɔlɛka bakɔku-mu banu asa na bɔkana bunye kpakplaa. Na si bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɔmmɔ bɔ́kana na búnye ni, Katɔti ɔdubumwi-mii na ɔtalaku-mii katɔ, na ɔbu-mii na Yesu bɔsɔ bubo limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: Bítanu-nwu kudii, nsu bɛɛyɔ́-nwu. Na bilánu-nwu ɔƒɛni lɛnɔ, nsu bɛɛƒɔ́-nwu taadi. Anwuɔsu bɛya na lɛlɔyɔ lɛni náƒɔ kuye geen na ukyuli ɔdi biala ulakana-ni kalɔ budie lɛnɔ ni, lɛkya-mii kemmo.

english_verse: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kalɛ na bɛ́ƒɔ Kristo bɛ́di ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔya na bina ayu akɛ ngba.

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: Katɔti kenye bediene béwi lɛlɔ báwia kalɛ na Katɔti ɔdubɔƒɔ-bu ngba kemmo, na béduo-nwu kemmo kaduɛ na básu-bu bése kalɛ na Katɔti lɛƒɔndia lɛdubɔsiaku-bu.

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: Básia ulu biala lɛlɔ ka bati uwi ku ukyuli ɔni lɛlɔ na ala amɛni adubɔlɛ. Na Kristo Kɔyu náƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo na kɔ́ya na básu-bu ala bése. Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kɔ́su kúse kalɛ na Kristo ɔdubo abi bubo ku kalɛ na lɛlɔ lɛdubo-nwu bɔyɔ na ɔmmɔ kama.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Katɔti údie ɔ́tina kenye bediene bammɔ ka etemila ani na baasu mɛni aaadi bana uwi lɛlɔ litemi, mmomu ɔdi bina ɔdi. Na ala ani na básu mmɔ ni, abu ndi nwuna batalane na bɔdanku litemi buni lɛmmɔ bɔɔkɔ́ lɛsa teete-mii nwaa. Na bɔɔsu ala amɛni ɔkɛnku Katɔti Kɔyu kɔni na ɔ́tala ɔ́kya-bu ɔyikun kemmo. Na anumi eegyie ayu muedi ka nka beduo ala amɛni kemmo bati. Ɔlɛka Baƒɔtaadine Belie Ngba Bɔni Nse Kedee

english_verse: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, bɛda lɛlɔ bise bite kabla. Na binye kagyumana na bitaanu ulu teete lɛbuni lɛni na Katɔti ɔdubɔbla ute-mii lɛlɔ uwi ɔni na Yesu wasɔ webo wabaƒɔ-mii ngba.

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: Binu Katɔti litemi, na bɛda udu ukpidi ɔni kemmo na bɛ́kya uwi ɔni na bítenwini tɔ baƒɔtaadine mmɔ bɛya.

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: Na aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔni nálɔ-mii use kedee ni, amii lɛnɔ bɛbla lɛlɔ kedee na bina ablala ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: Na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo ni, bénweni ka Katɔti ɔ́su nwuna bekyuli ɔnini, “Bɛbla lɛlɔ kedee, ɔsika ami nse kedee.”

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Bɛɛsu bɛnii, “Bula Ɔti” si bɛɛkpali katɔ. Anwuɔsu binyimo ka anwu ndubɔtɛku ukyuli biala litemi na ala ani na ɔɔbla kenye. Na ulanu bekyuli anumi asa na watɛku-mii litemi. Lɛni ɔsu ni, biti bina uwi ɔkladi ɔni nébu na bilie ngba mɛni aani baƒɔ kalɛ bitaabu-nwu.

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bɛgyi ka kayu kani na Katɔti ɔ́ƒɔ na bina lili asa na údie-mii ɔ́lɛku ngba bukpidi bɔni na bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́siku bina bati kuuku kudɔ ni, ɔɔɔdi sika ugyiedi iye ɔƒualadi ɔni muutili na ɔdi.

english_verse: You were rescued by the precious blood of Christ, that spotless and innocent lamb.
translation_verse: Mmomu Kristo ubugya ɔni náƒɔ kuye na ɔdi. Anwu ndi Koƒonu Ubi ɔni námanku lɛkpa na bina lili.

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna Kristo úse asa na údie kayawi. Na amii ɔsu na Katɔti údie-nwu keyi na uwi ukplodi ɔmɛni kemmo.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku Kristo ɔmɛni lɛlɔ ɔsu na bɛ́ƒɔ Katɔti bɛ́di. Na anwu nágyila-nwu ɔ́lɛku kekpine na úte-nwu keliekɔ kenengudi geen. Ɔmmɔ geen ɔsu na bɛ́ƒɔ Katɔti bɛ́di na bɛsia-nwu anu.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Ka bɛɛdi litemi geen lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ na bɛ́bla lɛlɔ sɛɛn ka Katɔti úti bina ekpidi ɔ́kyiɛ-mii na bɛɛyɔ́ lɛlɔ ɔƒɛni ɔsu ni, bɛya na bina baƒɔtaadine bakpana bɔyɔ bɔkɔ katɔ bubu ku kayi ƒui.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Na aani kalɛ na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔmmɔ ɔɔsu ɔnii, “Bekyuli ƒui bese aani lɛku kemmo alakpi, na ukyuli bɔdia buse aani alakpi anwula. Alakpi aayɛyɛ na anwula aanú.

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti litemi ani lise lite uwi ƒui.” Na ɔmɛni ndi litemi buni lɛni lɛsa na bákɔ béte-mii.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛda kasusu kekpidi ƒui buti na bekyuli lɛlɔ bɛya. Na bɛsɔ bitanyi ɔkɔ iye bɛtɔlɔ bekyuli. Anumi etegyie-mii bekyuli ala lɛlɔ. Na bitalɔ lɛlɔ anyikpi.

english_verse: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
translation_verse: Bɛya na anumi egyie-mii na Kɔyu kemmo etemila geen amɛni lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na ɔkaƒɔ ɔɔwia lɛnyi ntu. Ɔmmɔ ndubɔya na bɛlɛ lili bɛwɔlɔ kalɛ na Katɔti ɔɔwia.

english_verse: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.
translation_verse: Ɔsika amii alati bɛ́ɛnu bɛ́ti kalɛ na Blɔti kaƒɔ kadia.

english_verse: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
translation_verse: Bibo Blɔti kudɔ. Anwu ndi lɛtabi lɛni mbo ngba, nsu batune béni-ni. Na anwu na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna na ɔ́ƒɔ-nwu kuye geen.

english_verse: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
translation_verse: Biti lɛlɔ bite Katɔti na ɔtu Kɔyu kemmo kakpakɔ aani kalɛ na ɔtune uuti atabi taatu ɔtɔ. Bɛdubɔbla bakpane kedee bani muuti Kɔyu kemmo akpala ani námanku teete Katɔti ɔkɛnku Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔ́su ɔnini, “Binu! Lɛ́ƒuna lɛtabi lɛni náƒɔ kuye, na líti mɔɔbala Sion kowodu likpo. Na ukyuli biala ɔni maƒɔ-nwu madi ni, kɔƒa kulékpo-nwu kudii.”

english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: Na lɛtabi lɛmɛni lɛ́ƒɔ kuye geen líte amii bani náƒɔ-nwu bɛ́di. Nsu bekyuli bani nátaƒɔ-nwu bátadi ni, bati banii, “Lɛtabi lɛni na batune béni báva ni, ani mmomu nébenwini lɛtabi lɛni náƒɔ kuye litulo ƒui.”

english_verse: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Nsu amii ni, bɛdi bekyuli bani na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna. Na bɛdi bakpane bani muumwi Katɔti ɔni ndi Ɔga. Bɛdi Katɔti bekyuli kedee bani na ɔ́lɔ ɔnii binwini anwu badi. Na amii ndubo nwuna ablala ebendi kudu bubo. Ɔsika anwu geen nálɔ-mii ɔ́lɛku likpidi lɛdisa kemmo úsienku ngba bɔƒɔ bukeye kemmo.

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: Uwi ɔdi kemmo ni, bɛɛɛdi Katɔti bekyuli. Anwuɔsu Katɔti útanu-mii kɔnyana. Nsu ɔƒɛni ka bɛdi nwuna bekyuli ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔɔnu-mii kɔnyana. Bilie Ngba Na Biteemwi Katɔti

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: Bayɔne, mɔɔlɛ-mii aani si baƒɔ ku belusiene na bɛdi na kayawi mɛni nnii bɛda lɛlɔ bidie ɔlɔna ɔkwɛ adala ani muukpóku-mii kudɔ.

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: Na bilie ngba bɔni nse sɛɛn na bani naaadi baƒɔtaadine akɔ. Na ina baasu-mii lɛlɔ litemi likpidi muedi ni, badubɔnu bina ablala bati ka bɛdi bekyuli babuni. Na badubɔgya Katɔti enu na litemi bɔtɛ limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to obey all human authorities, especially the Emperor, who rules over everyone.
translation_verse: Unwoti ɔni na biimwi ɔsu ni, biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bite bina lɛlɔ badine ƒui ku Roma aban ɔgadine unengu na kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ

english_verse: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
translation_verse: ku Roma aban benengu bani na béte kenyekɔ ka bani bekyuli bani mɔɔƒiɔ́ kɔtu na bemwi bani mɔɔbla lɛbuni lɛnɔ.

english_verse: God wants you to silence stupid and ignorant people by doing right.
translation_verse: Ɔsika lɛni na Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́ ɔnii bɛbla lɛbuni na biti bɛdu ala ani na badɔlɔdi baasu kɔƒa ka baaagyi lɛla lɛdi ɔsu.

english_verse: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Bilie aani bekyuli bani naaakya bekyuli bamba kalɔ. Nsu bitabla likpidi ka bilie bite lɛlɔ ɔsu. Mmomu bilie ngba aani Katɔti kabla bablane.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Bɛbu bekyuli ƒui. Bɛyɔ bina banwani. Na bɛyia Katɔti. Na bɛbu Ɔga Unengudi lɛnɔ. Biboku Lɛlɔ Kalɔ Bite Bina Benwoti

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Amii kabla bablane, biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bite bina benwoti na bitaabu-ma kaduɛ. Na ɔɔɔdi benwoti bani mɔɔnu-mii kɔnyana na baayɔ́-mii lɛti, mmomu ku bani mɔɔbla-mii ulikplu lɛnɔ.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔdi use kayi na úbo abi ani na utalɛka ubo na bekyuli lɛkɔkɔ ka ɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti ɔsu ni, Katɔti ɔdubumwi-nwu.

english_verse: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
translation_verse: Nsu si ƒula ekpidi ɔsu na bekyuli báni-ɔ kɔtu ni, ɔɔɔdi-ɔ bumwi. Nsu si bítabla likpidi asa na biibó abi ni, Katɔti ɔdubute-mii kusɛ kusɛ.

english_verse: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni na Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-mii ɔnii bibabla. Ɔsika Kristo ɔlati úbo abi na bina lili na ɔ́tina-mii ɔnii bɛsia nwuna kasiakɔ.

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: “Anwu útabla likpidi lɛdi, na útanyi ɔkɔ ɔdi lɛnɔ kudii.”

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: Bédumi-nwu, nsu anwu útedumi ɔdi. Úbo abi, nsu útewida nwuna bekisine. Mmomu úti lɛla biala úte Katɔti ɔni mɔɔtɛ litemi na ulu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
translation_verse: Kristo ɔlati náƒɔ bula ekpidi lɛbibo ɔ́sia lɛlɔ útédu ka bákana-nwu bámana ugyii lɛlɔ na bádu-nwu. Ɔ́bla ɔmɛni kalɛ na bɔlɛ likpidi kemmo kalɛ na likpidi lɛsɔ liladi-bu lɛlɔ. Na bulie ngba na butaabla ala ani mɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti kaƒɔ. Abi ani na Kristo úbo na bula lili mɛni náya na abu bɔ́yu ɔkplu na kɔyu kemmo.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Bílie ngba dii ani baƒonu bani náyii ulu. Nsu ɔƒaani ni, Katɔti ɔ́sɔku-mii úboku bina ɔdane ɔni mɔɔgyumana-mii kɔyu kudɔ.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: Na amii beleku lɛnɔ ni, ɔlɛka biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bite bina bagya. Ɔmɛni ndubɔya na si ɔdi útaƒɔ útadi ni, ɔdubuti lɛlɔ ute Katɔti ɔkɛnku bina udu buni ɔsu. Na ɔɔɔdi ɔni na bitemi bite-ma.

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: Mmomu ama alati badubɔnu kalɛ na bina udu use sɛɛn ku lɛlɔ kalɔ buboku.

english_verse: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
translation_verse: Bitatina bina bɔdia na ala ani na bɛɛda ku kalɛ na biinyimi lili linwini iye asɛɛ ku adala ani bɛɛkya kemmo.

english_verse: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
translation_verse: Mmomu ni, bɛya na kalɛ na bɛda lɛlɔ ku udu buɛɛ udie bina bɔdia ɔtina. Ɔmɛni ndi udu ɔni mɔɔda kubiti uwi biala na ɔ́ƒɔ Katɔti kuye geen.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na kuuku beleku bani néti lɛlɔ básia Katɔti lɛlɔ báda bana adala, na béboku lɛlɔ kalɔ béte bana bagya.

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: Sara ɔ́bla lɛni, ɔsika únu Abraham litemi na ɔ́lɔ-nwu ɔnii, “Mina unwoti.” Bɛdubunwini Sara ɔmɛni bebi belekubi geen si bilie ngba bɔbuni na enu aláƒɛ-mii si lɛla lɛdi liikpóku-mii.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Amii bagya lɛnɔ ni, bɛya ala kalɔ bunu bɔkya amii ku bina beleku ntɛ, ɔsika beeebo ɔyikun aani bina kalɛ. Biti ɔbu bite-ma, ɔsika amii ku-ma ƒui na Katɔti ɔ́su úse ka ɔdubuti ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii ute. Na si amii bagya bɛ́bla ɔmɛni ni, Katɔti ɔdubunu bina ƒui katɔ bɔkpali. Biteti Likpidi Bitaƒɔ Likpidi Kayu

english_verse: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni kawɔlɔkɔ ni, bina ƒui bɛkɛ kɔyu kemmo kasusu kenwi bɛyɔ lɛlɔ aani banwani kalɛ na bɛnu ɔdi biala kɔnyana, na biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bite lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Biteti likpidi bitaƒɔ bani mɔɔbla-mii ekpidi kayu, iye bidumi bani muudumi-mii. Na mmomu bivele Katɔti na ute-ma keyi buɛɛ. Ɔsika ɔmɛni na Katɔti ɔɔwia ka bɛbla. Na ɔ́su bula ƒui úse ka ɔmɛni ɔsu na ɔdubute-bu keyi buɛɛ.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔtina ɔnii, “Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔwia ka ulie ngba ngba gyɔlɔɔ na keyi kayɔku-nwu ni, ɔlɛka ɔda nwuna unyemi kaduɛ na ulatɛmi enyekpi iye utaanyi ɔkɔ lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛka ɔda likpidi bɔbla ɔya na utaabla lɛbuni, na ɔsia ulu biala lɛlɔ na nwuna kayi kabla ƒaa ku bekyuli ƒui.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti ɔɔnu bekyuli bani nse siin lɛlɔ, na uunú bana bɔkpali. Nsu bekyuli bani mɔɔbla likpidi ni, bana lɛlɔ liláda Katɔti ebiti.”

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: Si anumi eegyie-mii ka bɛbla lɛbuni uwi biala kemmo ni, ɔma ndubukpoku-ɔ?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: Nsu si eebó abi adi na lɛbuni lɛni na aabla ɔsu ni, ya na lɛlɔ litaayɔ-ɔ. Tayia bekyuli bammɔ, na kayi lɛnɔ ketekpoku-ɔ.

english_verse: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
translation_verse: Mmomu bitaabu Kristo aani Blɔti. Na si ukyuli ɔdi uuye-mii lɛla lɛni lɛlɔ na bɛsia anu lɛni ni, binye kagyumana na bidie lɛlɔ kenye. Nsu bɛbla ɔmɛni ku udu buɛɛ ku lɛlɔ kalɔ buboku.

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bina kayi kemmo keteese ƒaa uwi biala kalɛ na si beedumi-mii ka bɛsiaku Kristo kama ni, na kɔƒa kukpo bekyuli bani mɔɔlɔ-mii anyikpi mmɔ.

english_verse: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ɔdia si biibó abi na lɛbuni lɛni bɛɛbla ɔsu si Katɔti lɛnɔ ɔ́tuna lɛni utulo si biibó abi na ala ekpidi ani na bɛɛbla ɔsu.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Kristo ɔni nse siin ni, úkpi na bekyuli bani neeese siin lili. Na kunwi kɔni kani na úkpi mmɔ ni, ɔ́ƒɔ ala ekpidi ƒui kayu na ɔ́klibi abu ku Katɔti ntɛ. Bekyuli bádu Kristo. Nsu ɔkɛnku Katɔti Kɔyu lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti ɔ́sɔku-nwu úboku ngba.

english_verse: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
translation_verse: Na Kɔyu kemmo na Yesu úsie útébo nwuna lɛlɔ bɔdi kudu úte ayu ani nkya kekpine.

english_verse: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
translation_verse: Ama ndi bani nétenu Katɔti bɔlɛ uwi ɔni na ɔ́kɛku-ma kayi na Noa ɔkya ɔɔnwí nwuna ɔkɔlɔ ubendi ɔmmɔ. Nkyuli ɛlɛɛ bani bumomo mabla aani nkyuli maane kani nákɛ ngba na ntu búteti-ma.

english_verse: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
translation_verse: Na ɔmmɔ mɔɔtina-bu lɛla lɛni na bula ngba bɔƒɔ ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ɔmɛni ɔdanku. Ɔɔɔdi ɔlɔna lɛlɔ bɔkpi na ɔdi, mmomu ɔkɛnku kenye kani na búse búte Katɔti ku kayi kani nse sɛɛn lɛlɔ na ɔdi. Katɔti ɔɔƒɔ́-bu ɔkɛnku kalɛ na bɔ́ƒɔ Yesu Kristo bɔsɔ bɔta bɔlɛ bekpine akɔ bɔ́di ɔsu.

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: Kristo ɔmɛni nésie katɔ na ulie Katɔti kɔdianu. Na katɔ batu ku lɛlɔ badine ku kayaa bayikune ƒui bakya-nwu kalɔ.

english_verse: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́si ɔni na Kristo úbo abi na ɔlɔna kemmo na bula lili ɔsu ni, amii lɛnɔ bɛda lɛlɔ bise na biti kasusu kammɔ udu kani bɛda. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni muubó abi na ɔlɔna kemmo ni, ɔɔɔda likpidi bɔbla taaya.

english_verse: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Na si bɛ́da lɛlɔ bíse lɛni ni, ɔdubɔya na bilie ngba ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela bitaabla lɛla lɛni mɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti kaƒɔ. Na ɔlɔna kemmo ala asɔ alátaada-mii ɔkwɛ.

english_verse: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Bɛya na kalɛ na bílie ngba bítaabla ala ekpidi uwi pii ɔni návi ɔwɔ ɔƒɛni. Bɛ́bla likyulikpi ku lɛyalɛ, na bítaani ntɛ teekpi. Bɛ́kpa baƒiɔ bɛ́vili ntu, na bɛ́di kɔkpana kukpidi, na bɛ́bla ala ekpidi lidu lidu aani bekyuli bani naaasiaku Katɔti.

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: Na ka bɛsɔ biláblaku-ma unwi na bitaabla ala ammɔ udu ɔsu ni, ɔ́bla-ma kalɛ kadi! Anwuɔsu na beetemi teewi-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Nsu badubudie lɛlɔ kenye na Katɔti ɔni ndubɔtɛku ngba beliene ku bekpine ƒui litemi anumi na ala ammɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔmɛni ɔsu na Yesu Kristo ɔ́kɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa úte bekyuli bani nékpi lɛnɔ. Katɔti úti kukpi ɔ́ni-ma kɔtu aani kalɛ na ɔdubɔlɛku bekyuli ƒui. Nsu Yesu Kristo ɔ́kɔ litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa úte-ma kalɛ na baƒɔ-ni na bakɛ kɔyu kemmo ngba aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔɔwia. Ɔlɛka Baƒɔtaadine Ƒui Buteebunku Lɛlɔ

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Kawɔlɔkɔ kammɔ kéede. Anwuɔsu bɛya na ukyuli biala kasusu kemmo kabla nwaa, na ɔda lɛlɔ use utaakpali katɔ.

english_verse: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
translation_verse: Na ɔni ntulo ƒui ni, bitaayɔ lɛlɔ ku kaƒɔ nwaa. Ɔsika si bɛɛyɔ́ lɛlɔ ni, bɛsɔ bilátaanu bina banwa ekpidi pii.

english_verse: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
translation_verse: Bɛbla lɛƒɔ bite bina bakpana na bɛƒɔ-ma na beduo-mii kudɔ ƒaa na bitakyaku-ma unyeƒi.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Katɔti úte-ma etela lidu lidu na ukyuli biala ɔda nwuna lɛdi kaduɛ na uti ubunku nwuna bakpana ƒui.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Lɛsa ɔkɔne biala ni, utaakɔ Katɔti litemi buni lɛmmɔ lɛsa. Na ukyuli ɔni muubunku bekyuli ni, uti ɔyikun ɔni na Katɔti úte-nwu ƒui uteebunku-ma. Na bekyuli basia Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ bemwi Katɔti na ulu biala lɛlɔ. Bumwi ku ɔyikun ɔdi Yesu Kristo ɔdi uwi ƒui. Ɔsia lɛni. Biibó Abi Aani Kristo Kalɛ

english_verse: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
translation_verse: Banwa bayɔne, abi kpakplaa ani na biibó mɛni ni, anya ndubɔya na bɛkana binye kpakplaa. Na utabla-mii kalɛ kadi ka lɛla lɛni nétebo tɔ dii mɔɔlɛ́ku-mii.

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: Mmomu ni, bɛya na lɛlɔ litaayɔ-mii ka amii lɛnɔ biibó abi aani Kristo kalɛ. Ɔsika ebiti adubɔda-mii na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii geen uwi ɔni na wasɔ webo na nwuna bukeye bonwu kemmo.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ litaayɔ-mii si bekyuli beedumi-mii ka bɛsiaku Kristo ɔsu. Ɔsika Katɔti Kɔyu nsiaku-mii ku nwuna bukeye.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Bitaya na bina kemmo ɔdi ubo abi aani bekyuli ɔdune iye uyune, iye likpidi ɔblane, iye ukyuli ɔni neeete bekyuli bɔnwuna kalɛ.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, si eebó abi ka adi ɔƒɔtaadine ɔsu ni, taya na kɔƒa kukpo-ɔ. Mmomu gya Katɔti enu ka akya nwuna badi akɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Litemi bɔtɛ limeyi lɛmmɔ líide, na Katɔti ɔdubɔka nwuna bekyuli litemi bɔtɛku. Na si abu nwuna bekyuli lɛlɔ na wese kalɔ lɛni ni, dɛ na ɔdubɔwɔlɔku bekyuli bani na bétemonku nwuna litemi buni lɛmmɔ bɔƒɔ bɔdi.

english_verse: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
translation_verse: Bénweni na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo banii, “Si ɔdubɔyu bekyuli babuni muedi ɔkplu geen asa na Katɔti waƒɔ-ma ni, bi malɛku ala ekpidi bablane ama?”

english_verse: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, bɛya na bekyuli bani muubó abi kalɛ na Katɔti uute kuƒi beti bana ayu bakya bana Ɔƒɔne ɔni mɔɔdi nwuna linyese lɛlɔ uwi ƒui lɛkɔkɔ.

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: Muuvele amii bani ndi baƒɔtaadine benengu na bina akɔ, ɔsika ami ɔlati lɛ́nu kalɛ na Kristo úbo abi na muudie ɔmmɔ kenye. Na mina anu asia ka ami ku-nwu bɔdubɔdi lɛga na nwuna bukeye bɔmmɔ kemmo na uwi ɔni na wasɔ webo.

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔsu-mii nnii bɛda bina baƒɔtaadine bani na Katɔti úti úte-mii kaduɛ aani kalɛ na baƒonu ɔdane ɔɔnu nwuna baƒonu lɛlɔ. Bɛda-ma aani kalɛ na Katɔti ɔɔwia, na utabla aani si ukyuli ɔdi nnye-mii lɛlɔ. Na bitabla kabla kammɔ na lɛyuƒɔla ɔsu, mmomu ka bɛɛyɔ́ ka bibunku bekyuli ɔsu.

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: Bitanya bekyuli bani lɛlɔ bɛɛnu bitamana, mmomu bɛbla bekyuli bani na banu-mii udu batɛya.

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: Na uwi ɔni na Kristo ɔni ndi Baƒonu Ɔdane Unengudi ƒui wada walɛ ni, na wete-mii kagabwa kani muukeye na kana udu ulávumana.

english_verse: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na ɔlɛka amii bani ndi baƒɔtaadine bawɔdi lɛnɔ biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ bite baƒɔtaadine benengu bammɔ. Na bina ƒui bɛda lɛlɔ na biboku lɛlɔ kalɔ na biteebunku lɛlɔ. Ɔsika Bunweni Kedee Ɔku ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Katɔti uléte bekyuli bani mɔɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ kuƒi. Mmomu uubunku bani muuboku lɛlɔ kalɔ.”

english_verse: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛya na Katɔti ɔyikun utaadi-mii lɛlɔ. Na watalaku-mii katɔ na uwi ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔɔyɔ́.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Biti bina ala ani muukpóku-mii ƒui bɛkya Katɔti enu kemmo, ɔsika anwu uuti-mii lɛlɔ kasusu uwi biala.

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: Bɛda kayi bɛva kalɔ buɛɛ na binye kagyumana! Ɔsika bina ukisine ɔni ndi ɔbɔnsamu mmɔ ɔsiaku-mii aani gyata ɔni nkɛ mɔɔva taavi na ɔɔwia ukyuli ɔni na uƒie.

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: Binye kpakplaa na bina bɔƒɔtaadi kemmo na bitile-nwu kuƒi, ɔsika abi amɛni udu kani na bina bakpana baƒɔtaadine bani nkya kayawi mɛni ƒui beebó.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Na si bíbo abi ammɔ uwi klukui ɔdi kama ni, Katɔti ɔni kaƒɔ ndia geen na ɔ́lɔ-mii ɔnii bibelie ngba ƒui na nwuna bukeye kemmo ɔkɛ Blɔti Yesu Kristo ɔsu ni, ɔsɔ ɔdubɔbla-mii kedee, na ute-mii ɔyikun, na bɛsɔ binye kpakplaa.

english_verse: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Anwu mbo ɔyikun úsela ƒui. Ɔsia lɛni. Bɔɔkada-mii

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: Silivano ɔni na mɔɔbu aani ɔƒɔtaadine ɔnwa ɔni mɔɔdi bɔƒɔtaadi bammɔ lɛlɔ geen ni, anwu nébunku-mi na búnweni ɔku klukui ɔmɛni buute-mii. Na mɔɔwia ka lɛkya-mii ogya na lidie kenye lɛsu-mii ka ni, ala ani lɛlɔ na línweni ɔku ɔmɛni lɛ́siku ni, adi kalɛ na Katɔti kaƒɔ kadia kete-bu. Anwuɔsu binye kpakplaa.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Bina baƒɔtaadine bakpana bani lɛnɔ na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna na Babilon kalɔ lɛlɔ ku Marko banii beegyele-mii o-o.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Bɛkya lɛlɔ kɔgbu bɛtina ka bɛɛyɔ́ lɛlɔ na bigyele lɛlɔ. Keyi buɛɛ kasiaku amii bani ƒui náblaku Kristo unwi.

english_verse: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
translation_verse: Ami Simon Petro ɔni ndi Yesu Kristo kabla ɔblane ku ɔtalane ni, ami muunweni ɔku ɔmɛni lite amii baƒɔtaadine ƒui bani na abu ku-mii ƒui bɔdi benwi ku Katɔti. Na ɔ́ya na bula ƒui bɔ́ƒɔ bula Ɔti ku Ɔƒɔne Yesu Kristo ɔni nse siin bɔ́di.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Muuvele Katɔti nnii nwuna lɛƒɔndia ku keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-mii kebu uwi biala kemmo ɔkɛnku kalɛ na bɛgyi-nwu ku Yesu ɔni ndi Blɔti lɛlɔ ɔsu.

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: Blɔti Yesu Kristo ɔkɛ Katɔti ɔyikun lɛlɔ úte-bu lɛla biala na bɔɔwia kalɛ na bulie ngba sɛɛn aani baƒɔtaadine. Úte-bu ala amɛni, ɔsika bɔgyi-nwu geen ka anwu nálɔ-bu ɔnii bula ukyulidu ɔbla kedee na buteekeye aani nwuna kalɛ.

english_verse: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku ala amɛni lɛlɔ ɔsu ni, Katɔti úti nwuna kaƒɔ buni ala enengudi ani náƒɔ kuye úte-bu na kenye kani na úse ɔsu. Na ɔkɛ etela ammɔ lɛlɔ ni, na bɛkana bɛlɛ ɔlɔna ala ani mɔɔda-mii ɔkwɛ na kayawi kamɛni kemmo na bɛbla kedee aani nwuna kalɛ.

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Ɔsika si ala amɛni ƒui ásadi éte-mii na bítayuɛ ni, adubɔya na bɛkana bitaabla kabla na bɛnwu ebi buni ka bɛ́ti Blɔti Yesu Kristo ɔmmɔ ƒui ɔsu.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Na si ɔdi ɔɔyaki ala amɛni adi ni, na ukyuli ɔmmɔ use aani ukyuli ɔni na ulánu ɔgyu. Na ɔ́yiƒala lɛnɔ ka Katɔti úti nwuna ekpidi ani na ɔ́ɔbla ƒui ɔ́kyiɛ-nwu.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Banwa, ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, binye kpakplaa bibu. Na lɛla lɛni na Katɔti ɔ́lɔ-mii na ɔ́ƒuna-mii ɔnii bɛbla ni, bɛkya-ni ɔyikun uwi biala kalɛ na bina bɔƒɔtaadi bulayuɛ.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: Si bɛ́bla lɛni ni, bɛdubɔkɛ kuƒi biala biduo Blɔti ku Ɔƒɔne Yesu Kristo ngba ƒui lɛga kadikɔ.

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: Ina ka bɛgyi ala amɛni na éedie litu na bina lɛlɔ kemmo muedi ni, ndubɔsɔ lɛya na biteenyimo-nya na ɔmɛni ɔsu.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: Mɔɔnu ka ɔlɛka ntaalɛmi-mii kasusu na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ uwi ɔni na nli ngba mɛni.

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: Ngyi ka kébu blii na linwini kama aani kalɛ na Blɔti Yesu Kristo ɔ́su-mi nwaa kalɛ.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: Na ndubɔnu ka mina kekpima ni, bɛdubɔkana na biteenyimo ala amɛni uwi biala kemmo. Abu Alati Bɔ́nu Yesu Bukeye Ku Bula Anumi

english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: Ɔɔɔdi kɔtɛ keeke na bɔ́nwi búti bɔ́tina-mii ka Blɔti Yesu Kristo ɔsɔ ɔdububo na ɔyikun kemmo. Bɔgyi lɛla lɛni na bɔ́su-mii. Ɔsika abu alati bɔ́nu-nwu ku bula anumi kalɛ na use kedee na ɔdi Ɔga.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Na bunye mmɔ uwi ɔni na Katɔti úti ɔbu úte-nwu na ɔ́ya na uukeye ku uwi ɔni na Katɔti ɔmmɔ lɛdi lɛ́si katɔ na nwuna lɛgadi bukeye kemmo lɛnini, “Ɔmɛni ndi mina Ubi ɔni mɔɔƒɔ́-mi anu.”

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: Na búnu lɛdi lɛni nási katɔ uwi ɔni abu ku-nwu bunye kɔbi kedee kɔmmɔ lili.

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu bɔ́sɔ bɔ́ƒɔ kenye bediene linyese lɛmmɔ bɔ́di geen búbu. Na ɔlɛka amii lɛnɔ bise atu geen na binu-ni. Ɔsika lise aani ogya ɔni mɔɔda na kesii kani nse suu utálɛ uwi ɔni na kadi kadubugye. Na kadi bugye bɔmmɔ ndi Kristo bukeye bɔni ndubukeye na bula kayi kemmo aani kalɛ na ɔtanta ayabi eekeye lɛdigye.

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Lɛla lideedi lɛni nálɛka lɛbla-mii nwaa ni, ani ndi ka ukyuli ɔdi ulakana na wedie Katɔti kenye bediene ala ani na básu bése na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo kalɔ.

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: Ɔsika kenye bediene bátasia lɛla lɛni na ukyuli ɔɔyɔ́ kenye bátasu lɛla lɛdi bétese. Mmomu Katɔti Kɔyu náƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui na kɔ́ya na básu kenye kani nási Katɔti ɔlati kudɔ bése.

english_verse: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na ɔkɔ kenye bediene bákya uwi ɔni návi ni, lɛni kani na ɔkɔ ala batinane bammɔ udu badubɔkya-mii akɔ. Badubo ɔkɔ bɔnyi bɔtina ala na ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔdi ka bekyuli basia bada bana ngba lɛlɔ. Nsu ɔmmɔ ɔdubɔya na bekyuli bayii. Na badubuni ala ƒui lɛlɔ ɔdine Blɔti ɔni nédie-ma ɔ́lɛku bana ekpidi kemmo. Na ɔmmɔ ndubɔyila-ma udu.

english_verse: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
translation_verse: Baƒɔtaadine pii lɛnɔ badubɔbla ala ekpidi ani na ɔkɔ ala batinane bamɛni baabla. Na si bani nátaƒɔ bátadi bánu lɛla lɛni baƒɔtaadine bamɛni baabla ni, ama lɛnɔ badubɔtɛmi enyekpi na Kristo bɔƒɔtaadi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
