translation_verse: Ɔkɔ ala batinane bamɛni bɔdubɔkɛ egulabi kɔsia na bina lɛlɔ na ɔkɔ ala ani na badubɔnwi basu-mii ɔsu, ɔsika baayɔ́ ama lɛti lɛkɛ geen. Ukyuli ɔni ndubɔtɛku-ma litemi ɔ́ɔklibi lɛlɔ úse-ma kuuku. Na ukyuli ɔmɛni ɔni ndubo-ma bɔkyula ni, ɔɔnu-ma nwaa.

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Katɔti útenye útanu batu bani náƒiɔ-nwu. Mmomu úbo-ma útákya abi kebokɔ. Na ɔ́ya na bébo-ma kɔgba bákya kasuudikɔ mmɔ wetédu limeyi lɛni na ɔdubɔtɛku-ma litemi.

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na ɔ́bla bekyuli bani nákya kukuuku lɛnɔ. Nsu Noa ɔni násu bekyuli kalɛ na Katɔti ɔɔwia ka bekyuli belie ngba ku nwuna badi maatɛ kani na údie. Na ntu bɔ́ƒɔ kayawi ƒui na bɔ́nyina bekyuli bakladi na békpi.

english_verse: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
translation_verse: Na Sodom ku Gomora lɛnɔ ni, Katɔti ɔ́du-ma kɔtɔ na ɔ́kyula-ma ku ogya úti-ma ɔ́tina-bu na bɔnu bɔtɛya lɛla lɛni ndubo bekyuli bani naaabu Katɔti lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
translation_verse: Bana ala ekpidi ani na bataabla na ukyuli ɔbuni ɔmɛni útaanu uwi ɔni na ɔ́kya-ma akɔ ƒui ni, átaada-nwu ɔƒɛ geen.

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔɔtina ka Katɔti ɔgyi kalɛ na udie bekyuli babuni ɔlɛku ala ani muukpóku-ma kemmo na ɔda bekyuli bekpidi use ute uwi ɔni na ɔdubɔni-ma kɔtu na litemi bɔtɛ limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: Na bani geen na ɔdubɔni kɔtu utulo ndi bani na ɔlɔna ala aada-ma ɔkwɛ na balábu Katɔti munu munu. Bekyuli bamɛni ni, beesé kayi kekpidi muedi teedumi kayaa bayikune.

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nsu Katɔti batu muedi bani mbo ɔyikun ku ɔkplu betulo bekyuli bamɛni ni, balakana Katɔti anumi bunye na bedumi kayaa bayikune bamɛni.

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bamɛni udu ni, baabla ala aani kalɛ na bebuo bani nnye nte ka beƒie-ma badu bese. Lɛlɔ kemmo kani na beenú ala kɔku taati. Bekyuli bamɛni baata teenye taatɛmi enyekpi na lɛla biala lɛni na bétenu kalɔ lɛlɔ. Na Katɔti ɔdubɔyila-ma udu aani kalɛ baadú beƒiebuo teevaakun.

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: Katɔti ɔdubɔya na bebo abi aani kalɛ na ama báya na bekyuli bébo abi kalɛ. Bana ebiti ndi ka badi lɛla biala ɔdivo ku ɔƒiiwi nwaa muedi. Ɔdi kɔƒa litemi ka basalaku-mii si bɛɛdi. Na bana ɔkɔ ala kani mɔɔda-ma kubiti.

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: Lɛsɔnɔdi lɛ́ƒɔ-ma anu ƒui, na likpidi ala ɔkwɛ uláda-ma bɔda taaya kudii. Baatɔ́lɔ bekyuli bani bɔƒɔtaadi nátayu tɔ ɔkplu. Na baabla ekpidi. Na ama alati bébimi bana kaƒɔ bése ka beteemu ala taadi. Katɔti úwida bekyuli bamɛni geen.

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: Bédeyi bɔƒɔtaadi ulu ɔmmɔ ƒui, na báyii ulu. Basiaku Boer ubidi Bileam ɔbladu kama ɔni mɔɔbla ala ekpidi teeti taakɛ egulabi.

english_verse: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ ɔsu Katɔti ɔ́dɔnku Bileam na nwuna likpidi lɛmmɔ ɔsu. Nwuna ebuo ɔni muuti-nwu ala útemiku-nwu ukyuli butemi na ɔ́bala-nwu ɔnii ɔda adɔlɔla ammɔ ɔya.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni bese aani abiɔ ani nákwi, iye ɔni na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ ɔda ɔɔvínku. Ama na Katɔti ɔ́da kesii kani nse suu mmɔ úse.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Baasu etemila keeke taatalaku lɛlɔ katɔ. Na bada ɔlɔna ɔkwɛ adala baatɔ́lɔ bani nétetu tɔ uwi ka báda ngba bukpidi bulie báya.

english_verse: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ ala batinane bamɛni beesé kenye ka badubɔbla bana kama basiakune na bakɛ bɔnwuna uwi ɔni na ama alati bénwini kabla bablane béte ekpidi ani ndubo-ma bɔkyula. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔdi kabla ɔblane ute lɛla lɛni nádi-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Si bekyuli bávumana kayi na Katɔti údie-ma ɔ́lɛku ala ani muukpóku-ma ƒui kudɔ ka báƒɔ Blɔti ku Ɔƒɔne Yesu Kristo asa na básɔ bénwini bésie belie bana ngba kuuku bɔmmɔ ni, bana ablala eebie teetulo kalɛ na úse kalɔ kesekɔ ƒui.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Si nka bétenu ngba siin bulie lɛlɔ litemi kudii muedi ni, nka ɔdia-ma utulo. Nsu bénu-ni asa na básɔ bédeyi ulu ɔmmɔ, na baládi ɔda bubo kedee bɔni na béte-ma lɛlɔ.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Sɔsɔ na ɔdi ka agba ani na bébo ébo éte lɛni na bana lɛlɔ ka akpewe ɔsɔ uuti nwuna kɔdala taadi, na ɔplakuo ɔni na bákpila-nwu ɔsɔ uunwíni taatákpi aba.

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: Mɔɔyɔ́ ka binyimo ala ani na Katɔti kenye bediene kedee básu dii ku ala ani na batalane bátina na Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Kudeedi ni, bɛya na ɔbla-mii nwaa ka na emeyi ekplodi ammɔ kemmo ni, bekyuli bani nsiaku bana ɔlɔna ala ɔkwɛ adala kama badububo-mii kudɔ na bama-mii.

english_verse: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
translation_verse: Na badubuye-mii banii, “Wɛ na ukyuli ɔni ndubo mmɔ ɔkya? Ɔsika ɔ́si uwi ɔni na bula bati békpi ni, lɛla lɛdi biala lɛmu lise aani uwi ɔni na bédie kayawi kalɛ!”

english_verse: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
translation_verse: Na bagyi ƒui nsu béni kalɛ na Katɔti útemi na úti údie katɔ ku kalɔ. Ɔ́bla na kalɔ kákɔ kálɛ ntu kemmo.

english_verse: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɛnku ntu bɔmmɔ kani lɛlɔ ni, ɔ́ya na ntu búyi bɔ́ƒɔ kalɔ kammɔ lɛlɔ ƒui, na ɔ́du kuuku bekyuli bammɔ.

english_verse: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Na litemi lɛni lɛlɔ na ɔkɛ údie katɔ ku kalɔ ƒui ni, litemi lɛmmɔ kani na úti ɔda kayawi kammɔ use ute uwi ɔni na ɔdubɔkyula-ka ku ogya. Na Katɔti ɔ́bla lɛni úse úte limeyi lɛni na ɔdubɔtɛku bekyuli bekpidi litemi na ɔkyula-ma.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't forget that for the Lord one day is the same as
translation_verse: Banwa bayɔne, ɔƒɛni ni, bitayiƒala lɛnɔ ka na Katɔti anumi ni, kavumana kadi keeebo limeyi linwi ku akwa apim ntɛ. Ɔsika ɔna ƒui use-nwu likeke.

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
translation_verse: Katɔti uuuse nyɔɔ ka ɔbla lɛla lɛni kenye na ɔ́su úse aani kalɛ na badi baakali. Mmomu ni, ɔɔkɛ́ kayi teete-bu. Ɔsika ulayɔ ɔnii ɔdi ɔyii. Mmomu ɔɔyɔ́ ka bula ƒui bɔda bula ekpidi bɔbla bɔya.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Nsu Blɔti limeyi likplodi lɛmmɔ ni, lɛdubo-bu buyu bɔtu. Na bɔdubunu kɔku bonwu kɔdi. Na kayaa kadubo bɔyii udu. Na ala ani ƒui nkya kayaa mmɔ ni, adubɔkywi kede kede! Na kalɔ ku kana ala ƒui adubo bɔyii.

english_verse: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.
translation_verse: Na si ala amɛni ƒui adubɔkywi lɛni ni, dɛ na ɔlɛka bɛda bina lɛlɔ? Ɔdi ka bɛda ngba bɔni nse kedee na biti lɛlɔ bite Katɔti.

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na bíti bilie siin bɛgya Blɔti limeyi lɛmmɔ ni, anwu ndubɔya na limeyi lɛmmɔ libo pla. Limeyi lɛmmɔ na kayaa kadubo bɔkywi, na ogya liwulu lɛdubɔya na ala ani nkya kayawi ƒui ayɛɛlɛ.

english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Nsu abu bunye bɔgya Katɔti kenye kani na úse-bu úse kani ndi katɔ kawɔdi ku kalɔ kawɔdi kani kemmo na ala bɔbla siin sɔɔn ndubɔkya.

english_verse: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, mina banwa, bina ƒui anu asia Blɔti limeyi lɛmmɔ bubo lɛlɔ. Na uwi ɔni binye bɛgya-nwu ni, bɛya na amii ku Katɔti ntɛ bɔdia na bilabla likpidi iye biláƒiɔ-nwu.

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: Na bɛbu bɛnu kalɛ na Katɔti ɔɔkɛ́ku-mii kayi. Ɔmmɔ ndi kuƒi kɔni na úte-bu ka bɔkɛ ngba bɔƒɔ. Lɛni kani na Ɔnwa Paulo ɔkɛnku lɛlati lɛni na Katɔti úte-nwu kenye únweni ɔku úte-mii.

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni lɛlɔ kɔtɛ kani na ɔɔtɛmiku-mii si uunweni nwuna lɛku. Ɔƒɛni ni, nwuna ala adi bene kalɔ bunu bɔɔyu ɔkplu teete bekyuli bani néteduo tɔ litemi lɛmmɔ kemmo kaduɛ ku bani naaasia ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Lɛni kani na Bunweni Kedee Ɔku kemmo etemila lɛnɔ ese ete-ma. Anwuɔsu beedie-nya kalɔ na ulu bamba lɛlɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔsu na badubo bɔyii ku udu.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, mina bayɔne, bɛgyi ɔmɛni bise. Anwuɔsu bɛti lɛlɔ bɔda kalɛ na bekyuli bekpidi balátɔlɔ-mii ku bana ekpidi ablala na bideyi ulu geen ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Naaawia ka bina bɔƒɔtaadi bɔyuɛ!

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Bisie anumi na Katɔti lɛƒɔndia ku kalɛ na bɛ́ƒɔ Blɔti Yesu Kristo ɔni ndi bula Ɔƒɔne bɛ́di kemmo. Anwu na buute ɔbu ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ƒui! Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Katɔti ngba litemi ndi anwu ɔni nkya ɔ́si kayawi kalɔ kesekɔ. Na ngba litemi lɛmmɔ lɛsa na bɔɔkɔ́. Búnu-nwu ala bɔsu na bɔ́nu-nwu ku anumi. Na sɔsɔ ni, búti bula enu bútuku-nwu. Uwi ɔni na ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ ni, abu bɔ́nu-nwu bɔ́ti.

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: Ngba litemi lɛmɛni ndi anwu ɔni náda ɔ́lɛ-bu anumi, na buudie-nwu kenye. Na anwu ɔni ndi ngba bɔni naaadubo bɔsa kudii mɛni lɛsa na bɔɔkɔ́ teete-mii. Na anwu ku Katɔti nkya asa na Katɔti údie-nwu keyi ɔ́tina-bu.

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Na ala ani na bɔ́nu na búnu ni, ani na buudie kenye bute-mii mɛni, kalɛ na amii lɛnɔ bɛdiku-bu kɔkpana. Na bula kɔkpana bɔdi bɔkya abu ku Katɔti ku ngba litemi lɛni ndi Ubidi Yesu Kristo ntɛ.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Buunweni-mii ɔmɛni kalɛ na bula ebiti edu-bu ɔkwɛ. Ɔlɛka Bɔbla Ala Na Bukeye Kemmo

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Na lɛla lɛni na búnu bɔ́siku Kristo ɔmɛni kudɔ na ani na bɔɔyɔ́ ka budie kenye mɛni ni, ani ndi ka Katɔti ɔdi bukeye. Na lɛdisa lɛdi liiibo-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo na ulu biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu si bɔnii abu ku-nwu bɔɔdi kɔkpana nsu bɔkɛ na lɛdisa ngba bukpidi bulie kemmo ni, na bɔɔnyi ɔkɔ na bɔɔɔsiaku litemi geen lɛmmɔ kama.

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: Nsu si bɔkɛ na bukeye kemmo aani kalɛ na anwu ɔkya bukeye kemmo ni, ɔɔtina ka bɔɔdiku lɛlɔ kɔkpana. Na Ubidi Yesu ubugya ɔɔbla-bu lɛlɔ sɛɛn taalɛku ekpidi biala kemmo.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Si búni bɔnii bulábla likpidi ni, na bɔɔtɔ́lɔ lɛlɔ, na litemi geen lɛmmɔ lítaƒɔ-bu lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
translation_verse: Nsu ka Katɔti use siin na ɔdi bula kama kekpokɔ ɔsu ni, si búdie bula alaekpidi kalɔ bɔ́tina-nwu ni, ɔdubɔnu-bu kɔnyana na uti bula alaekpidi ɔkyiɛ-bu na ɔbla-bu sɛɛn ɔlɛku ala ani mɔɔyá na buusé lɛlɔ ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nsu si búni bɔnii bútabla likpidi lɛdi ni, buudie-nwu taatina aani ɔkɔ ɔnyine, na nwuna litemi lítáƒɔ-bu lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: Mina bebi bayɔne, muunweni ɔmɛni lite-mii kalɛ na bilabla ekpidi. Nsu si ɔdi ɔ́bla likpidi lɛdi ni, bubo ukyuli ɔni nnye-bu kenye uuvele Katɔti teete-bu. Na anwu ndi Yesu Kristo ɔni nse siin.

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: Na Kristo ɔmmɔ ɔlati úti nwuna ngba ɔ́kpa na bula lili, kalɛ na ɔklibi abu ku Katɔti ntɛ. Nsu ɔɔɔdi abu lɛti ekpidi lili, mmomu ku bayawine ƒui ekpidi lili.

english_verse: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
translation_verse: Si bɔɔdi Katɔti ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni, bɔgyi nwaa ka bɔ́ti-nwu.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Si ɔdi ɔ́su ɔnii, “Ngyi-nwu,” nsu uládi nwuna etemila lɛlɔ ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔɔnyi ɔkɔ. Na litemi geen lɛmmɔ lítaƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ kemmo.

english_verse: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔdi nwuna litemi lɛlɔ ni, bɔyɔ bɔni na ubo ute Katɔti búdu bɔ́wɔlɔ. Bɛya na lɛsu-mii kalɛ na bɔɔnu taati ka buliku Katɔti.

english_verse: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mɔɔsu ɔnii uliku Katɔti ni, ɔlɛka ulie ngba aani kalɛ na Yesu Kristo úlie. Bilie Ngba Na Bukeye Kemmo

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: Mina bayɔne, ɔɔɔdi ɔda bubo bɔwɔdi na muunweni lite-mii. Mmomu ɔdi bɔni na bɛ́ƒɔ bɛ́si kalɔ kesekɔ. Ɔda bubo bɔkukudi bɔmɛni ndi lɛla lɛni na bɛ́ka bunu.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔda bubo bɔni na muunweni lite-mii ɔƒɛni ni, bɔmu bɔdi bɔwɔdi. Na ɔkɛnku Kristo ku amii lɛnɔ lɛlɔ ni, bekyuli badubɔnu bati litemi geen lɛni nkya ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kemmo. Ɔsika kayawi kamɛni lɛdisa uwi ɔdaku bɔvi, na litemi geen bukeye bɔmmɔ búuse kalɔ bɔdaku bukeye.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni masu ɔnii ɔkya bukeye kemmo nsu uukisi nwuna ɔƒɔtaadine ɔkpana ni, ɔmu ɔkya lɛdisa kemmo.

english_verse: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ɔƒɔtaadine ɔkpana ni, uli ngba na bukeye kemmo, na lɛla lɛdi liiibo-nwu lɛlɔ lɛni maya na weduo likpidi kemmo.

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli ɔni muukisi ɔƒɔtaadine ɔkpana ni, ɔkya lɛdisa kemmo ku nwuna ablala ƒui. Na ɔɔɔgyi likpo lɛni na úsela, ɔsika lɛdisa ablala ammɔ áya na use aani ɔnumbwɛne.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: Mina bebi bayɔne, muunweni-mii ɔmɛni ɔsika mɔɔwia ka bɛti ka Katɔti úti bina ekpidi ɔ́kyiɛ-mii na Yesu Kristo ɔsu.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Na amii bati ni, muunweni-mii ɔmɛni ɔsika mɔɔwia ka bɛti ka bɛgyi Kristo ɔni nkya ɔ́si kayawi kalɔ kesekɔ. Na amii bakloƒu ni, muunweni-mii ɔmɛni ɔsika mɔɔwia ka bɛti ka bɛ́di ukisine ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ. Na amii, mina bebi bayɔne ni, muunweni-mii ɔku ɔmɛni ɔsika bɛ́ɛti Katɔti.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Amii bebi bati ni, muunweni-mii ɔku ɔmɛni ɔsika bɛgyi Kristo ɔni nkya ɔ́si kayawi kalɔ kesekɔ. Na amii bakloƒu ni, muunweni-mii ɔku ɔmɛni ɔsika bibo ɔyikun na Katɔti litemi lɛmmɔ lɛ́ƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo, na bɛ́ɛdi ukisine ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
translation_verse: Bitayɔ kayawi ku kana lɛlɔ ala ani náta énye Katɔti lɛlɔ. Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ kayawi lɛni ni, ulayɔ Katɔti geen.

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ala amɛni udu ani nkya kayawi ni, átasi Katɔti kudɔ. Adi ala ani mɔɔda bula likyulikpi ɔlɔna ɔmɛni ɔkwɛ, ku adikpi bɔdi ala ani na bɔɔnu na aada-bu ɔkwɛ, ku kayawi ala ani kemmo na ukyuli ɔɔkun lɛmɛnɛ. Ana akɔ lɛla lɛdi lítasi Katɔti kudɔ. Mmomu kayawi udunkpi kemmo na ana ƒui aasí.

english_verse: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
translation_verse: Kayawi ku kana lɛlɔ ɔkwɛ adala ƒui adaku bɔvi. Nsu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla Katɔti lɛƒɔyɔ ni, ɔdubulie ngba ku Katɔti uwi ƒui. Bina Ƒui Bɛgyi Katɔti Litemi Geen

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: Mina bebi bayɔne, mɔɔsu-mii nnii kayawi kadaku kawɔlɔkɔ budu. Na aani kalɛ na bínu ka Kristo ukisine ɔmmɔ ɔdububo ni, ɔƒɛni muedi Kristo bekisine pii béebo bakya. Na ɔmmɔ ndi kalɛ na búti bɔ́ti ka kayawi kawɔlɔkɔ kammɔ kéede.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bamɛni bálɛ bula lɛkpa lɛmɛni kemmo, ɔsika baaadi bula badi. Na si bula bekyuli na badi ni, nka bamu bakya-bu akɔ. Nsu bana bɔtɔlɔ bɔmmɔ bɔ́tina geen ka bana akɔ ɔdi biala ɔɔɔdi bula badi.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: Nsu amii ni, Kristo ɔ́ya na nwuna Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo, na bina ƒui bɛgyi Katɔti litemi geen.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Ńtenweni-mii ɔmɛni ka bɛɛɛgyi litemi geen lɛmmɔ ɔsu, mmomu ka bɛgyi-ni ɔsu. Na bɛgyi lɛnɔ ka ɔkɔ ɔdi ulasi litemi geen lɛmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Na ɔma ndi ɔkɔ ɔnyine? Ɔkɔ ɔnyine ɔmmɔ ndi ukyuli ɔni muuní ka Yesu ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ. Ukyuli ɔmmɔ udu ndi ukisine ute Kristo. Na ukyuli ɔmmɔ úni Katɔti ku Ubidi ɔmmɔ ƒui.

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni muuní Ubi ɔmɛni taasu ka ɔɔɔdi Katɔti Ubidi ni, anwu ku Katɔti beeebo kɔna. Na ukyuli ɔni muudie kenye taasu ka ɔ́ƒɔ Ubi ni, ɔ́ƒɔ Katɔti lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
translation_verse: Bɛnu kaduɛ na bɛya na ala ani na bínu ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ mmɔ áƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui. Na si bɛda-nya kaduɛ ni, bɛdubulieku Ubidi ku Ɔti ɔmmɔ ƒui uwi biala.

english_verse: The Son has promised us eternal life.
translation_verse: Na ngba bɔni naaadubo bɔsa ndi kenye kani na Kristo úse úte-bu.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔkya ɔkplu ka batɔlɔ-mii ɔsu na muunweni-mii ɔmɛni.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Nsu amii ni, Kristo Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo, na Kɔyu kɔmɛni kɔmu kɔkya-mii lɛlɔ kemmo. Anwuɔsu ni, bɛsɔ biláwia ka ukyuli ɔdi ɔsɔ ɔtina-mii ala adi lɛnɔ. Ɔsika nwuna Kɔyu kɔɔtina-mii ala amɛni ƒui. Na ala ani na kɔɔtina adi litemi geen lɛmmɔ, na ɔɔɔdi ɔkɔ. Anwuɔsu biliku Kristo aani kalɛ na Kɔyu kɔmmɔ kɔ́tina-mii.

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: Mina bebi bayɔne, biliku Kristo kalɛ na si uwi ɔni na ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ ni, bɔdubɔkana na bunye-nwu anumi ku kaƒɔ ƒaa na kɔƒa kulékpo-bu limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: Si bɛgyi ka Kristo use siin ni, ɔlɛka bɛti ka ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla ala ani nse siin ni, ɔdi Katɔti ubidi aani Kristo kalɛ.

english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Bɛnu kalɛ sɔɔn na Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́ abu bani mɔɔƒɔ́ Yesu taadi. Anwuɔsu na ɔɔlɔ-bu ɔnii nwuna bebi. Na búnwini Katɔti bebi sɔsɔ! Na lɛla lɛni ɔsu na kayawi bekyuli balánu-bu taati ndi ka baaagyi Katɔti.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: Mina banwa bayɔne, ɔƒɛni ni, búnwini Katɔti bebi. Nsu bekyuli bani udu na bɔdubo bunwini ni, Katɔti útedie-nwu tɔ keyi. Nsu bɔgyi ka si lebo lɛni na Kristo ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ ni, bɔdubo bɔbla aani nwuna kalɛ. Ɔsika bɔdubo-nwu bɔnu kalɛ geen na use.

english_verse: This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔsia Kristo bubo anu ni, ɔɔklibi lɛlɔ teese sɛɛn aani kalɛ na Kristo lɛnɔ use sɛɛn.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Ukyuli biala mɔɔbla likpidi ni, ɔɔƒiɔ́ Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ. Ɔsika likpidi ndi Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔƒiɔ.

english_verse: You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful,
translation_verse: Na bɛgyi ka Kristo úbo kalɛ na ubada-bu udie ekpidi kemmo. Na anwu ni, likpidi lɛdi lɛɛɛma-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ukyuli ɔni nliku Kristo ni, ulélie taabla likpidi. Nsu ukyuli ɔni muulie taabla likpidi ni, ɔɔtina ka útati Kristo kudii, na ɔƒaani muedi ɔɔɔgyi-nwu.

english_verse: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.
translation_verse: Bitaya na ukyuli ɔdi ɔtɔlɔ-mii! Mina bebi bayɔne, ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla ala ulu lɛlɔ ni, ɔdi ukyuli ɔni nse siin aani kalɛ na Kristo use siin.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni muulie taabla likpidi ni, ɔdi Satan ɔdi. Ɔsika Satan nli mɔɔbla likpidi ɔ́si kayawi kalɔ kesekɔ. Na lɛla lɛni ɔsu na Katɔti Ubidi ɔmmɔ úbo ni, ani ndi ka ɔyila Satan ablala.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Ama bani ndi Katɔti bebi ni, belélie taabla likpidi. Ɔsika Katɔti udu nkya-ma lɛlɔ kemmo ɔƒaani. Na ka Katɔti ndi-ma Ɔti ɔsu ni, balakana bulie butaabla likpidi.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Bɛya na lɛtina-mii kalɛ na bɔɔnu taati kavumana kani nkya Katɔti bebi ku Satan bebi ntɛ. Ukyuli biala ɔni naaabla ala siin ni, iye ulayɔ nwuna ɔnwa ɔƒɔtaadine ni, ɔɔɔdi Katɔti ubidi. Bɛyɔ Lɛlɔ

english_verse: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ndi kenye kani na bínu bɛ́si kalɔ kesekɔ ƒui, na ani ndi ka ɔlɛka bɛyɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: Na utalɛka bɔbla lɛlɔ aani Kain kalɛ. Ɔsika anwu ɔdi Satan ɔdi, na ɔ́du ɔnwani. Na bi ɔsu na Kain ɔ́du-nwu? Ɔsika uukisi ɔnwani ka nwuna ablala ese siin ɔsu. Na anwu Kain adi eeese siin.

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, banwa, utabla-mii dɛye dɛye si kayawi bekyuli beekisi-mii.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: Na bɔgyi ka bɔ́ɔlɛ kukpi enu kemmo, na búbo buli ngba geen, ɔsika bɔɔyɔ́ bula banwa baƒɔtaadine. Na ukyuli biala ɔni naaayɔ bekyuli ni, úkpi na kɔyu kemmo.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni muukisi nwuna ukyulikpana ni, ɔdi bekyuli ɔdune. Na amii alati bɛgyi ka ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔdú bekyuli ni, uuubo ngba bɔni naaadubo bɔsa kudii.

english_verse: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
translation_verse: Kalɛ na Yesu Kristo úti nwuna ngba ɔ́kpa na bula lili ni, ɔmmɔ mɔɔtina-bu lɛla lɛni ndi bɔyɔ. Anwuɔsu na abu lɛnɔ ɔlɛka buti lɛlɔ bɔkpa bula banwa baƒɔtaadine lili.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔdi ubo ala adi na ɔɔnu ka ɔnwani ɔɔyaki nsu útete-nwu kebunku kadi mmomu ɔ́da anumi údie ɔnwani ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, dɛ na wakana bɔsu ɔnii ɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti?

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: Mina bebi bayɔne, bitaya na bɔyɔ lɛlɔ ku kenyekplu. Mmomu biteebunku lɛlɔ geen.

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni bɔbla kemmo na bɔdubɔti ka bɔgyi litemi geen lɛmmɔ na bɔkɛ kayi ƒaa na Katɔti anumi.

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: Na si ina bula kayi kaadú-bu kɔtɔ muedi ni, enu ataƒɛ-bu. Bɔgyi ka Katɔti ɔɔtɛ litemi biala ulu lɛlɔ teetulo-bu, na ɔgyi lɛla biala.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ni, banwa bayɔne, si bula kayi kaladu-bu kɔtɔ ni, na bɔdubɔkana na bunye Katɔti anumi ku kayi buse.

english_verse: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
translation_verse: Na lɛla biala na buuvele-nwu ni, bɔɔkɛ́-ni ɔsika bɔɔdi nwuna ɔda bubo lɛlɔ na bɔɔbla lɛla lɛni mɔɔyɔ́-nwu kaƒɔ.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Ɔda bubo bɔni na úse úte-bu ndi ka bɔƒɔ Ubidi Yesu Kristo ɔmmɔ bɔdi, na bɔyɔ bula lɛlɔ aani kalɛ kani na úbo-bu ɔda úbavi.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔdi Katɔti ɔda bubo lɛlɔ ni, beliku Katɔti. Na Katɔti lɛnɔ uliku-ma. Na Kɔyu kɔni na Katɔti úti úte-bu ɔsu ni, bɔgyi ka Katɔti uliku-bu.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: Banwa bayɔne, bitaƒɔ kɔyu biala muulie ukyuli lɛlɔ bitadi. Mmomu bɛkɔku ɔdi biala bɛnu si kɔyu kɔmmɔ kɔ́si Katɔti kudɔ. Ɔsika ɔkɔ kenye bediene béegyingya bakya kayawi ekpo ƒui.

english_verse: and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni muudie kenye taasu ɔnii Kristo Yesu úbo aani ɔyawine kalɛ ni, ukyuli ɔmmɔ ubo Kɔyu kɔni nási Katɔti kudɔ. Na ɔmɛni ndi ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na bɛdubɔsia bɛti Katɔti Kɔyu.

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli biala ɔni meni ka ɔsu ɔnii Yesu úbo aani ɔyawine kalɛ ni, kɔyu kɔni na ubo mmɔ kútasi Katɔti kudɔ. Kɔyu kɔmɛni kɔdi Kristo ukisine. Na bínu ka kɔyu kɔmmɔ kɔdububo kayawi, na kúubo kɔkya ɔƒaani muedi.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: Nsu amii bebi bayɔne ni, bɛ́si Katɔti kudɔ, na bɛ́ɛdi ɔkɔ kenye bediene bammɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika Kɔyu kɔni náƒɔ-mii lɛlɔ kemmo ni, kubo ɔyikun kutulo kɔyu kɔni nlie ama bani ndi kayawi badi mmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
translation_verse: Kayawi lɛlɔ bekyuli kani na badi. Na baatɛmi taasiku kayawi ala lɛlɔ. Na kayawi bekyuli lɛnɔ beenú-ma litemi.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Nsu abu ni, bɔdi Katɔti badi. Na ukyuli biala ɔni ngyi Katɔti ni, uunú-bu litemi. Na ukyuli biala ɔni nátasi Katɔti kudɔ ni, ulenu-bu litemi. Ɔmɛni buuti taanu taati Kɔyu kɔni mɔɔtina litemi geen lɛmmɔ ku kɔyu kɔni mɔɔtɔ́lɔ bekyuli. Ɔmɛni Muudie Bɔyɔ Keyi

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: Banwa bayɔne, bɛya na bɔyɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔsika bɔyɔ bɔ́si Katɔti kudɔ. Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ bekyuli ɔdi Katɔti ubi, na ɔgyi Katɔti.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli biala ɔni naaayɔ bekyuli ni, ɔɔɔgyi Katɔti. Ɔsika Katɔti ablala ƒui adi bɔyɔ.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Ka Katɔti ɔ́yɔ ka udie nwuna bɔyɔ ɔtina-bu ɔsu ni, ɔ́tala Ubidi unwi pɛ ɔnii ubo kayawi, kalɛ na ɔkɛnku Ubidi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ na bɔkɛ ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Bɛya na lɛsu-mii lɛla lɛni geen muudie bɔyɔ keyi. Ɔɔɔdi kalɛ na bɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti muudie bɔyɔ keyi. Mmomu Katɔti ɔ́yɔ-bu, na úti Ubidi ɔ́kpa na bula ekpidi lili kalɛ na ɔklibi abu ku-nwu ntɛ.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: Banwa bayɔne, ka Katɔti ɔ́yɔ-bu geen lɛni ɔsu ni, ɔlɛka abu lɛnɔ butaayɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔdi útanu Katɔti kudii. Nsu si bɔɔyɔ́ lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti uliku-bu, na bɔyɔ bɔni bubo bute-nwu búdu bɔ́wɔlɔ.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Bɔgyi ka buliku Katɔti geen, na anwu lɛnɔ uliku-bu, ɔsika anwu ɔlati Kɔyu na úti úte-bu.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: Bɔ́nu bɔ́ti nwaa na buudie kenye ka Katɔti ɔ́tala Ubidi ka ubedie bayawine ɔlɛku ekpidi kemmo.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Si ukyuli biala údie ɔ́su ɔnii Yesu ndi Katɔti Ubidi ni, ɔɔtina ka Katɔti uliku-nwu, na anwu lɛnɔ uliku Katɔti.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Na abu alati bɔgyi na bɔ́ƒɔ bɔ́di ka Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́-bu. Katɔti ablala ƒui adi bɔyɔ. Na ukyuli biala ɔni muulie taayɔ bekyuli ni, uliku Katɔti, na Katɔti lɛnɔ uliku-nwu.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Na ulu ɔmɛni lɛlɔ na bɔyɔ búdu bɔ́wɔlɔ na bula akɔ. Ɔmmɔ ɔsu na bɔdubɔkana na bunye Katɔti anumi na litemi bɔtɛ limeyi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ku kayi buse. Ɔsika kalɛ na Kristo use ni, lɛni kani na buse na kayawi kamɛni kemmo.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Liƒu lɛdi liiibo bɔyɔ kemmo. Mmomu bɔyɔ bɔni nédu bɔ́wɔlɔ bɔɔgyá liƒu biala. Ɔsika liƒu ku kɔtu bɔni nkɛ. Na ukyuli ɔni mbo liƒu ni, nwuna bɔyɔ bútedu bútawɔlɔ.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Bɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti ku bekyuli ɔsika Katɔti náka-bu bɔyɔ.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Si ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔsu ɔnii ɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti nsu uukisi nwuna ɔnwa ɔƒɔtaadine ni, ɔkɔ ɔnyine na ɔdi. Ɔsika ukyuli biala ɔni naaayɔ ɔnwani ɔni na ɔɔnu ku nwuna anumi ni, dɛ na wakana na wayɔ Katɔti ɔni na ulánu ku anumi?

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Na ɔda ɔni na Kristo úbo-bu ndi ka ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti ni, ɔlɛka ɔyɔ nwuna ɔnwa ɔƒɔtaadine lɛnɔ.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ƒui náƒɔ bádi ka Yesu ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔmmɔ ni, badi Katɔti bebi. Na alakana ubi ɔti bɔyɔ na ekisi nwuna bebi! Anwuɔsu si aayɔ́ Katɔti ni, aayɔ́ nwuna bebi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
translation_verse: Na dɛ na bɔdubɔnu bɔti ka bɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti bebi? Bɔɔnu ɔmɛni taati si bɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti na bɔɔdi nwuna etemila lɛlɔ.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Na dɛ na bɔɔnu taati ka bɔɔyɔ́ Katɔti? Bɔɔnu ɔmɛni taati si bɔɔdi nwuna etemila lɛlɔ. Na nwuna etemila eeese aani etila ani nétulo-bu.

english_verse: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti ubi biala ɔɔkana na ɔɔdi kayawi lɛlɔ. Na bɔƒɔtaadi ndi lɛla lɛni na buuti taadi kayawi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Nsu ukyuli ɔdi ulakana kayawi lɛlɔ bɔdi amu ntu ɔ́ƒɔ ɔ́di ka Yesu ndi Katɔti Ubidi ɔmmɔ. Kenye Budie Akpa Atɛ Nkya

english_verse: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
translation_verse: Yesu ɔmɛni ndi Ukyuli Ɔƒunadi ɔni nébo kayawi, na bɔ́nu-nwu bɔ́ti ɔkɛnku ntu bɔkpila ɔdi ɔni na ɔ́ƒɔ ku nwuna ubugya ɔni néwi kalɔ lɛlɔ ɔsu. Na ɔɔɔdi ntu lɛti pɛ lɛlɔ na ɔkɛ úbo, mmomu ntu ku ubugya ƒui lɛlɔ. Na Katɔti Kɔyu muudie-nwu kenye na ulu lɛlɔ. Ɔsika Kɔyu kɔmmɔ ablala ƒui adi litemi geen.

english_verse: In fact, there are three who tell about it.
translation_verse: Ala ani muudie-nwu kenye mmɔ ebo atɛ. Na anya ndi

english_verse: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
translation_verse: Katɔti Kɔyu ku ntu ku ubugya ɔni lɛlɔ na ɔ́sia úbo mmɔ. Na kenye budie ɛtɛ bɔmɛni ƒui buse unwi.

english_verse: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
translation_verse: Bɔɔƒɔ́ ukyuli kenye budie taadi bɔdi. Nsu Katɔti kenye budie na ulu ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, bɔdia butulo. Ɔsika kenye budie bɔmmɔ bɔdi Katɔti ɔlati bɔdi na Ubidi lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ukyuli ɔni náƒɔ Katɔti Ubidi ɔmmɔ ɔ́di ni, ɔgyi geen na nwuna kayi kemmo ka kenye budie bɔmmɔ bɔdi litemi geen. Nsu ukyuli ɔni nátaƒɔ Katɔti útadi ni, ɔɔnu Katɔti aani ɔkɔ ɔnyine, ɔsika útaƒɔ ala ani na Katɔti ɔ́su ɔ́siku Ubidi ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ útadi.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Na kenye budie bɔni na bubo ni, amu ndi ka Katɔti úte-bu ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii. Na uute-bu ngba bɔmɛni ɔkɛnku Ubidi kudɔ.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni mbo kɔna ku Ubidi ɔmmɔ ni, ubo ngba bɔmɛni. Na ukyuli ɔni neeebo kɔna ku Katɔti Ubidi ɔmmɔ ni, uuubo ngba bɔmmɔ. Bibo Ngba Bɔni Nsɔ Naaadubo Bɔsa Kudii

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: Muunweni ɔku ɔmɛni lite amii bani mbo ngba bɔƒɔ lɛnunsia na Katɔti Ubidi Yesu lɛnyi kemmo kalɛ na bɛti ka bibo ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii.

english_verse: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
translation_verse: Bɔgyi nwaa ka si buuvele Katɔti lɛla biala na nwuna bɔyɔ kenye ni, uunú-bu bɔkpali.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: Na si bɔgyi ka uunú-bu lɛla biala na buuvele-nwu ni, bɔgyi geen ka ala ani buuvele taasiku-nwu kudɔ mmɔ éenwini bula ɔdi.

english_verse: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
translation_verse: Si ɔdi ɔ́nu ka nwuna ɔnwa ɔƒɔtaadine ɔ́bla likpidi lɛdi lɛni na lilákpanku-nwu taatákya kukpi ƒui kemmo ni, ɔkpali katɔ na nwuna lili na Katɔti ɔdubute-nwu ngba. Na ɔmɛni use ute bekyuli bani na bana ekpidi alákpanku-ma taatákya kukpi ƒui kemmo. Nsu likpidi lɛdi lɛkya lɛni mɔɔkpanku bekyuli taatákya kukpi ƒui kemmo. Na naaasu nnii bɛkpali katɔ na likpidi lɛmɛni lili.

english_verse: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
translation_verse: Lɛla biala naaakɛ ulu siin lɛlɔ ni, ɔdi likpidi. Nsu ekpidi adi akya ani naaakpanku ukyuli taatákya kukpi ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: Bɔgyi ka ukyuli ɔni ndi Katɔti Ubi ni, ulélie taabla likpidi. Ɔsika Katɔti Ubidi ɔɔgyumana-nwu kalɛ na uleduo ukisine ɔmmɔ enu kemmo.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Abu bɔgyi ka bɔdi Katɔti badi geen, na kayawi bekyuli bakladi ƒui bakya ukisine ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ bɔdi kalɔ.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: Na abu bɔgyi lɛnɔ ka Katɔti Ubidi úbo kayawi kamɛni úbedie ala kalɔ úte-bu kalɛ na bɔti anwu ɔni geen ndi Katɔti. Na ɔƒaani ni, buliku anwu ɔni geen ndi Katɔti ɔmmɔ ku nwuna Ubidi Yesu Kristo lɛnɔ. Na anwu geen ndi Katɔti ɔmmɔ ɔni ndi ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii.

english_verse: Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu, mina bebi bayɔne, bɛda lɛlɔ bidie lɛƒiɔkpa kemmo.

english_verse: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
translation_verse: Ami baƒɔtaadine unengu muunweni ɔku ɔmɛni lite awɔ uleku ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna aani nwuna ɔdi ku ƒula bebi. Mɔɔyɔ́-mii na litemi geen lɛmmɔ kemmo. Na ɔɔɔdi ami lɛti mɔɔyɔ́-mii, mmomu ami ku bani ƒui ngyi litemi geen lɛmmɔ.

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: Ɔsika litemi geen lɛmmɔ lɛ́ƒɔ abu ku-mii ƒui lɛlɔ kemmo na lɛdubulie-bu kudɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: Na si bulie na litemi geen lɛmmɔ ku bɔyɔ kemmo ni, lɛƒɔndia ku kɔnyana bɔnu ku keyi buɛɛ kadubɔsiaku-bu ɔ́si Katɔti ɔni ndi bula Ɔti Ku Yesu Kristo ɔni ndi Katɔti Ubidi kudɔ. Bɛsiaku Kristo Ala Bɔtina Kama

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: Kubiti kɔ́da-mi geen ka lɛ́nu ka ƒula bebi badi bamu basiaku litemi geen lɛmmɔ kama aani kalɛ kani na Katɔti úbo-bu ɔda.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛni ni, uleku ɔyɔne, muuvele-ɔ ka aya na bula ƒui bɔyɔ lɛlɔ. Ɔmɛni ɔɔɔdi ɔda bubo bɔwɔdi na muunweni lite-ɔ. Mmomu ɔdi ɔda bubo bɔni nkya ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ.

english_verse: Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
translation_verse: Na bɔgyi ka bɔɔyɔ́ lɛlɔ si bɔsiaku Katɔti ɔda bubo bɔmmɔ kama. Na ɔda bubo bɔmɛni ndi ka bulie ngba na bɔyɔ kemmo aani kalɛ na bínu ɔ́si kalɔ kesekɔ mmɔ.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani mɔɔtɔ́lɔ bekyuli béebo bakɛ baaví kayawi. Bekyuli bamɛni muuní ka basu banii Yesu Kristo úbo kayawi aani ukyuli ɔyawine kalɛ. Na ukyuli ɔmɛni udu ni, unye ute ɔkɔ ɔnyine ɔni ndi Kristo ukisine ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu binye kagyumana kalɛ na bilatuma bilewiakun, mmomu na bina katuma kalɛ-mii kɔsia na kudu kɔwɔlɔ.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni náda ɔ́via Kristo ala bɔtina na ulásia-nya kama ni, uuubo kɔna ku Katɔti. Nsu ukyuli ɔni nsiaku Kristo ala bɔtina bɔmmɔ kama ni, uliku Katɔti ku Ubidi lɛnɔ.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu si ukyuli ɔdi úbo-mii kudɔ na ɔɔɔda Kristo ala bɔtina bɔmɛni ni, bitegyingya enu bitaƒɔ-nwu na uduo-mii kaduli.

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ɔsika ukyuli ɔni megyingya enu waƒɔ-nwu ni, ɔ́blaku-nwu unwi na nwuna udunkpi ala bɔbla kemmo. Yohane Ɔ́kada-ma

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: Mbo ala pii na lɛsu-mii, nsu naaayɔ ka linweni ala ammɔ limene-mii. Mmomu mɔɔwia kuƒi ka libo-mii kudɔ na bɔtɛmi anumi ku anumi kalɛ na bula ebiti edu-bu ɔkwɛ.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: Ƒula ɔnwani ulekubi ɔni lɛnɔ na Katɔti ɔ́ƒuna bebi beegyele-ɔ kaduɛ.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: Ɔkpana ɔyɔne Gaio, ami baƒɔtaadine unengu muunweni ɔku ɔmɛni lite-ɔ. Mɔɔyɔ́-ɔ na litemi geen lɛmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: Ɔkpana ɔbuni, mɔɔkpali katɔ nnii lɛla biala lɛtɛ lite-ɔ kaduɛ na akɛ ɔlɔkplu aani kalɛ na ebo ɔlɔkplu na kɔyu kemmo.

english_verse: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛ́yɔ-mi geen uwi ɔni na banwani badi bébo na bábasu-mi kalɛ na aadi litemi geen lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na ngyi ka asiaku-ni kama.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Lɛla biala lilayɔ-mi kaƒɔ teetulo ɔni na muunú ka mina bebi basiaku litemi geen lɛmmɔ kama. Baƒɔtaadine Bémwi Gaio

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: Mina ɔkpana buni, ka aanu banwa baƒɔtaadine ina ka badi badi baƒɔ bani na aaagyi muedi ɔsu ni, aabla ala ulu lɛlɔ teete Katɔti.

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: Baƒɔ bammɔ bábasu baƒɔtaadine bani nkya mɛni kalɛ na aayɔ́-ma. Anwuɔsu muuvele-ɔ nnii bunku-ma na bakɛ ala ani ƒui na baawia na bana ulu busie kemmo aani kalɛ na ɔ́manku-ma aani Katɔti kabla bablane.

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: Ɔsika bése bana ulu busie kalɔ na Kristo kabla bɔbla kemmo, na bátaƒɔ kebunku kadi bátasiku bekyuli bani nátaƒɔ bátadi kudɔ.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, abu Kristoƒuɔ ɔlɛka bubunku bekyuli bamɛni udu kalɛ na bunyeku-ma na bugyingya Kristo litemi geen lɛmmɔ. Yohane Ɔ́su Lɛla Lɛdi Na Diotreƒe Ku Demetrio Lɛlɔ

english_verse: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
translation_verse: Línweni ɔku ɔdi líte ƒula baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ. Nsu ka Diotreƒe ɔɔyɔ́ ka ɔtalaku lɛlɔ katɔ aani ɔtɔnkune na mmɔ ɔsu ni, ulábu lɛla lɛni na abu batalane bɔɔsu.

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: Si líbo ni, ndubudie-nwu keyi na lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla lɛlɔ ku ala ekpidi ani na ɔɔsu tasiku-bu lɛlɔ ku ɔkɔ ɔni na ɔ́nyi ɔ́sia-bu. Nsu ɔmmɔ lɛti bɔbla bútabɔ-nwu. Ɔsika ulátuna ɔnii ɔɔƒɔ́ banwa si bébo. Na uutile bekyuli bamba bani mɔɔyɔ́ ka baƒɔ-ma lɛnɔ kuƒi, na ɔɔbɔku-ma teedie lɛkpa lɛmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: Mina ɔkpana ɔyɔne, tasiaku likpidi bɔbla kama. Mmomu siaku lɛbuni bɔbla kama. Na ukyuli biala ɔni mɔɔbla lɛbuni ni, ɔdi Katɔti ɔdi. Nsu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla ala ekpidi ni, ɔɔɔgyi Katɔti.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Na Demetrio anwu ni, ukyuli biala ɔɔlɔ-nwu lɛnyi buni. Na kalɛ na bɔɔnu litemi geen lɛmmɔ na nwuna lɛlɔ kemmo ni, úte-nwu lɛnyi buni. Na abu lɛnɔ bɔɔlɔ-nwu lɛnyi buni. Na bɛgyi ka lɛla lɛni na bɔɔsu lise lɛni. Yohane Ɔ́kada-ma

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: Mbo ala pii na lɛsu-mii, nsu naaayɔ ka linweni ala ammɔ limene-ɔ.

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: Mɔɔwia ka libo-ɔ kudɔ uwi klukui kemmo na bɔtɛmi anumi ku anumi.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: Lɛ́wɔ mɛni. Keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-ɔ. Bakpana bani nkya mɛni ƒui beegyele-ɔ kaduɛ. Lɔ bakpana bani nkya mmɔ anyi unwi unwi na egyele-ma ete-mi.

english_verse: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ami Yuda ɔni ndi Yesu Kristo kabla ɔblane na ndi Yakobo ɔnwani ni, muunweni ɔku ɔmɛni lite amii bani nénu Katɔti bɔlɔ. Na ka bɛ́siaku-nwu ɔsu ni, ɔɔyɔ́-mii. Na Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛnɔ ɔɔgyumana-mii geen.

english_verse: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
translation_verse: Muuvele Katɔti nnii ɔnu-mii kɔnyana na nwuna keyi buɛɛ kasiaku-mii, na nwuna bɔyɔ butaakɔ katɔ teebu na bina akɔ. Ɔgbankpi Ɔdubɔsiaku Ala Batinane Bani Mɔɔnyi Ɔkɔ

english_verse: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
translation_verse: Banwa bayɔne, ɔdi lɛla lɛni na mɔɔyɔ́-mii kaƒɔ geen ka linweni-mii ɔku ɔ́si ulu unwi pɛ ɔni lɛlɔ na Katɔti ɔdubɔsia ɔƒɔ-bu ngba lɛlɔ. Na ɔƒɛni ni, lɛ́nu ka ɔlɛka lɛkya-mii ogya na kalɛ na bɛ́ƒɔ Kristo bɛ́di lɛlɔ na bɛda-nwu kpakplaa. Ɔsika ɔmmɔ ndi bɔƒɔtaadi ulu unwi pɛ ɔni na Katɔti úti úte-bu na ulakana na wavumana kudii lɛnɔ.

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bekpidi bani naaayia Katɔti bábɛ béduo-mii akɔ. Na Katɔti ɔ́lɛ ugyii úse ɔ́si kukuuku ƒui ka ɔdubɔdu-ma kɔtɔ na ɔyila-ma udu. Badi bekyuli bekpidi bani nákɛ kasiakɔ na bánu kalɛ na Katɔti ubo lɛƒɔndia úte-bu, na bátu ala bénwini kalɛ na bakɛ kuƒi bataabla bana lɛyalɛ ku likyulikpi ala na béni bula ɔga unengudi ƒui ɔni kani ndi Blɔti Yesu Kristo.

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
translation_verse: Bɛgyi ɔmɛni, nsu nsɔ mɔɔsu-mii ka uwi ɔni na Katɔti údie Israelƒuɔ ɔ́siku Egyipte kalɔ lɛlɔ ni, ɔ́du bani nátaƒɔ-nwu bátadi ƒui.

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti batu bani nátakana na benye bana kenyekɔ na ɔyikun ɔni na Katɔti úte-ma kenye ni, Katɔti úbo-ma kɔgba ɔ́kya kasuudikɔ wetédu limeyi lɛni na watɛku-ma litemi na limeyi likplodi lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Na Sodom ku Gomora ku lɛma lɛni náka lɛ́mana-ma lɛnɔ ni, bátakana lɛlɔ bɔda na bábla lɛyalɛ ku ala ekpidi bamba. Katɔti úti ogya ɔ́kyula-ma kalɛ na abu bɔnu bɔtɛya.

english_verse: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani na ala ani na bekyuli bekpidi bani na bébeduo-mii akɔ baanu na ana ani na baatɛ teegye kemmo ni, áya na baabla alaekpidi ani mɔɔyá bana ɔlɔna uusé lɛlɔ. Báta bénye Katɔti lɛlɔ na baatɛmi enyekpi na bagadine lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Na Katɔti ɔtu unengudi ɔni ndi Mikael muedi ka kadɔ kéduo anwu ku Satan ntɛ na baakya unyeƒi na Mose ɔlɔna lɛlɔ ni, úteti anwu ɔlati kenyekɔ ɔyikun útabɔku Satan. Mmomu ɔ́su ɔnini, “Blɔti ɔbɔku-ɔ!”

english_verse: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bamɛni udu ama ni, lɛla biala kalɔ na bétenu ni, beewida na beedumi. Na ala ani kalɔ na bénu ni, beléti kasusu mmomu baabla-nya aani bebuo kalɛ. Na anya geen mɔɔyila-ma udu.

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Bɔbuɛ muute-ma! Ɔsika ulu ɔni lɛlɔ na Kain ɔ́vi ni, nwuna lɛlɔ kani na ama lɛnɔ bakɛ. Na bányonu lɛlɔ na belie ngba bukpidi bɔni na ukyuli ɔni baalɔ Bileam úlie ka baawia kayawi lɛkɛ ɔsu. Báta bénye Katɔti ɔda bubo lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na Koran ɔ́bla. Na badubɔyii udu aani Koran ɔmmɔ kalɛ.

english_verse: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
translation_verse: Badi bekyuli bani ablala mɔɔyá na bina kasala keesé lɛlɔ si bɛ́sala bɛɛdi Blɔti adila ammɔ. Beedie lɛlɔ na ama lɛti baadi teemo kalɛ na baayɔ́. Bese aani ɔnantu ɔni nánwu, nsu ulána kudii, na ɔƒɛƒɛɛ kani muubó-nwu taavinku. Na bese lɛnɔ aani egyii ani naaanwu ina egyiibi bɔnwu uwi muedi. Bese aani egyii ani na bágyu-nya ku ligyiitu na ékpi ƒui.

english_verse: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
translation_verse: Bese aani ɛpu ntu bɔni mɔɔnwanɛ lɛlɔ ku avlɔvɔ. Bana kɔƒa ala na bada baatina lɛlɔ aani kalɛ na avlɔvɔ aata. Na bese aani ayabi ani mɔɔkpa na kayaa na aayii. Bekyuli bamɛni udu geen na Katɔti ɔ́klibi kasuudikɔ kammɔ úse ka uti-ma ɔkya mmɔ uwi ƒui.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni lɛlɔ litemi geen na Henok ɔni ndi kaba maatɛdi ubi ɔ́si Adam lɛlɔ ɔ́su úse ɔnini, “Katɔti ku nwuna batu ƒui bumomo báyu bébo kalɔ lɛlɔ.

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: Bébo banii babatɛku bekyuli ƒui litemi. Na bekyuli bani ƒui na balábla Katɔti lɛƒɔyɔ ku ala ani ƒui na bábla ka baláyia Katɔti ɔsu ni, bátɛmi enyekpi na nwuna lɛlɔ. Anwuɔsu Katɔti ɔ́ni-ma kɔtu.”

english_verse: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
translation_verse: Bekyuli bamɛni baadɔ na bana lɛlɔ kemmo. Na beedie bekyuli bamba bɔƒiɔ. Baakun lɛlɔ lɛmɛnɛ, na bekyuli bamba ala alaƒɔ-ma anu amu ntu uwi ɔni na bákɛ-ma lɛlɔ kɔsia kani. Bana likyulikpi ala ani mɔɔda-ma ɔkwɛ kani na baabla uwi biala. Biti Lɛlɔ Bɛsia Kristo Lɛlɔ

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, mina banwa, bɛkali etemila ani na Yesu Kristo batalane básu-mii.

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: Básu banini, “Emeyi ekplodi ammɔ kemmo ni, bekyuli badubo-mii buti bɔbla lɛmala na ala ani baasu taasiku-mii lɛlɔ ɔsu. Na basiaku bana udunkpi ala ani na Katɔti ulayɔ kama.”

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Ama mɔɔyá na bekyuli beele lɛlɔ akpa akpa. Na Katɔti Kɔyu kuuubo-ma lɛlɔ kemmo, anwuɔsu bakɛ basiaku bana ɔlɔna kemmo ala ani mɔɔda-ma ɔkwɛ kani.

english_verse: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
translation_verse: Nsu ni, mina banwa, biti lɛlɔ bɛsia Kristo kalɛ na bina bɔƒɔtaadi kedee bɔyu ɔkplu, na bitaakpali katɔ na Kɔyu kemmo na ɔkya-mii ɔyikun.

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: Bɛda lɛlɔ na bitaayɔ Katɔti uwi ɔni na binye bɛɛnu ulu ka Yesu Kristo wanu-mii kɔnyana na bɛkɛ ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii.

english_verse: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni ɔsu ni, bekyuli bani na bana bɔƒɔtaadi bútayu tɔ ɔkplu ni, bɛnu-ma kɔnyana.

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Na bidie babambadi lɛnɔ ɔkplu kemmo na beleduo lɛgyavonku lɛmmɔ kemmo. Na bakladi ni, bitaanu-ma kɔnyana. Nsu bɛgyumana bina lɛlɔ kalɛ na bana lɛyalɛ udunkpi ɔni náƒɔ-ma lɛlɔ aani adala kalɛ alávi-mii. Mɔɔkpali Katɔ Na Bina Lili

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: Anwu ɔmmɔ ndi Katɔti unwi pɛ ɔni náƒɔ-bu ngba ɔkɛ Blɔti Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ. Anwu na buumwi, ɔsika anwu mɔɔdi lɛga na ɔɔdi ala ƒui lɛlɔ ku ɔyikun ɔ́si kukuuku ku uwi ɔmɛni kemmo ku ɔni mebo lɛnɔ kemmo. Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
translation_verse: Ɔku ɔmɛni ndi ala ani na Katɔti údie ɔ́tina nwuna kabla bablane ɔkɛnku Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ ka adubo bɔlɛ na uwi klukui kemmo. Báti ɔmɛni ɔkɛnku Katɔti ɔtu ɔni na Kristo ɔ́tala ɔ́kya nwuna kabla ɔblane Yohane na ala ani na údie ɔ́tina-nwu kemmo.

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: Ami Yohane línweni ala ani ƒui na línu ku ani na lɛ́nu. Na lídie kenye na linyesia lɛni nási Katɔti kudɔ ku litemi geen lɛni na Yesu Kristo údie ɔ́tina lɛlɔ.

english_verse: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
translation_verse: Ami Yohane muunweni ɔku ɔmɛni lite amii baƒɔtaadine akpa maatɛ ani nkya Asia kalɛkɛ lɛlɔ. Bɛkɛ lɛƒɔndia ku keyi buɛɛ bɛsiku Katɔti ku nwuna Kɔyu ku Yesu Kristo kudɔ. Katɔti ndi anwu ɔni nli ɔ́si kukuuku, na ulie ɔƒɛni, na ɔdubo bulie uwi ɔni mebo ƒui. Na Katɔti Kɔyu ndi anwu ɔni mbo ɔyikun maatɛ ɔni nnye Katɔti lɛgaboku anumi.

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Na Yesu Kristo ndi anwu ɔni muudie lɛla lɛdi biala kenye ulu lɛlɔ. Ɔdi ukyuli udeedi ɔni na Katɔti ɔ́gyila ɔ́lɛku bekpine akɔ na ɔsɔ ulekpi kudii. Yesu ɔmɛni mɔɔdi kayawi baga ƒui lɛlɔ. Na ɔɔyɔ́-bu. Na úti nwuna ubugya ɔ́kpa na bula lili, na ɔ́ƒɔ-bu ɔ́lɛku bula ekpidi kemmo.

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́bla-bu baga ku bakpane bani mɔɔkpanku bekyuli teeboku Ɔti ɔni ndi Katɔti. Uukeye, na ubo ɔyikun ɔ́si ɔƒɛni úsela ƒui! Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
translation_verse: Bɛnu! Aanu-nwu ka ɔ́si kayaa ɔdubo na kemmo! Ukyuli biala ɔdubo-nwu bɔnu ku bani ƒui nábla-nwu kalala. Kayawi bekyuli ƒui badubuwulo kɔnyana ku keku. Ɔsia lɛni.

english_verse: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
translation_verse: Blɔti ɔni mbo ɔyikun ƒui mɔɔsu ɔnini, “Ami ndi kalɔ kesekɔ ku kawɔlɔkɔ. Ami nli, na lílie, na ndubo bulie uwi ɔni ndubo ƒui.” Yesu Ubo Ɔyikun Na Kukpi Ku Kekpine Lɛlɔ

english_verse: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
translation_verse: Banwa, bɔdi bavinkpana ka buliku Yesu ɔsu. Na ami ku-mii ƒui bunye lɛbibo kenye kpakplaa na kayawi kamɛni kemmo, na bɔɔdi Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ala. Ńtaakɔ Katɔti litemi buni lɛni nkɛnku Yesu Kristo lɛlɔ lɛsa na ulu lɛlɔ. Nsu ka bekyuli balayɔ lɛni ɔsu ni, béti-mi bétése ntuntɛ kalɔ kani baalɔ Patmo.

english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: Na limeyi lɛni lɛlɔ na baƒɔtaadine baasa teemwi Blɔti ni, Katɔti Kɔyu kɔ́ƒɔ-mi lɛlɔ kemmo ƒui na línu ka lɛdi lɛdi lɛ́ku momoomo aani kakpɛɛ na lɛɛtɛmi na mina kama.

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: Lɛdi lɛmmɔ lɛ́su lɛnini, “Nweni lɛla lɛni na ánu se na eti-ni esienku baƒɔtaadine akpa maatɛ na lɛma linengudi lɛdi kemmo. Ani ndi Eƒeso ku Smirna ku Pergamo ku Tiatira ku Sardi ku Ƒiladelƒia ku Laodikea.”

english_verse: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
translation_verse: Amu ka lɛ́tu línwini nnii mɔɔnu ukyuli ɔni mɔɔtɛmiku-mi ni, lɛ́nu sika ugyiedi ligyii maatɛ lɛni lɛlɔ na asogya ɔɔsia.

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
translation_verse: Na ligyii lɛmmɔ akɔ ni, lɛla lɛdi linye aani ukyuli kalɛ. Na ɔkya awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔni néne útédu-nwu kanintɔ. Na sika ugyiedi kabuli káda kámana-nwu kayi.

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: Nwuna lili linwini lɛ́ƒuala aani unwo na úlieku etubankɛ. Na nwuna anumi aada aani ogya.

english_verse: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
translation_verse: Na nwuna lɛgba lise aani lɛbuala lɛni bédie na ogya kemmo, na lígyie na liikeye. Nwuna lɛdi lɛɛku aani ketu kani mɔɔgbá taasi taayu lɛtabi lɛni nákuku lɛdi lili ku kɔku bonwu.

english_verse: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔmmɔ ɔda ayabi maatɛ na nwuna kɔdianu. Na litemi geen lɛni nse aani kewii kani na bádɔ-ka lɛvi inyɔ lɛɛlɛ́-nwu kenye. Na nwuna anumi eekeye aani kalɛ na ɔƒɛ ɔɔbi.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Ka lɛ́nu-nwu ni, líbuli ńtáyu kalɔ aani ukpine na nwuna anumi. Nsu ukyuli ɔmɛni úti nwuna kɔdianu ɔ́sia-mi lɛlɔ na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Sɔ tayia! Ami ndi Udeedi ku Ukplodi.

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ami ndi Ukyuli Ɔni Nli Ngba! Líkpi, nsu ɔƒɛni ni, nli ngba. Na nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo bukpi kudii. Mbo ɔyikun na kukpi ku kekpine lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ala ani na ánu ku ala ani nkya ɔƒɛni ku ani ndubo bɔlɛ lɛnɔ ni, nweni-nya se.

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: Ayabi maatɛ ani na ánu na mina kɔdianu ku sika ugyiedi ligyii lɛmmɔ enye ete lɛla lɛdi. Na ana kalɔ na ndubo budie mɛni. Ayabi maatɛ ammɔ ndi Katɔti batu maatɛ ute baƒɔtaadine akpa maatɛ ammɔ. Na sika ugyiedi ligyii lɛmmɔ ndi baƒɔtaadine akpa maatɛ ammɔ.”

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su ami Yohane ɔnini, “Nweni ɔku te Eƒeso baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa ɔtu anii, “Ami Yesu nda ayabi maatɛ na mina kɔdianu na muusié teebo na sika ugyiedi ligyii maatɛ lɛni lɛlɔ na asogya ɔɔsia mmɔ ntɛ. Na ami mɔɔsu kenye kamɛni.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: “Ngyi lɛla lɛni na bɛɛbla. Na ngyi kalɛ na binye kabla kammɔ lɛlɔ kpakplaa ku kalɛ na bɛ́kya ɔkplu. Ngyi ka biléte bekyuli bekpidi kuƒi ku kalɛ na bɛ́kɔku-ma bɛ́nu. Ama ndi bani mɔɔtɔ́lɔ bekyuli banii badi batalane, nsu baaadi batalane. Na bɛ́nu-ma bɛ́ti ka badi ɔkɔ banyine.

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: Ngyi ka binye lɛbibo lɛmmɔ kenye kpakplaa na bɛɛkya ɔkplu na ami ɔsu, na enu átaƒɛ-mii.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: “Nsu bɔƒiɔ bɔni muudie-mii lɛlɔ ndi ka bɛsɔ bilayɔ-mi aani kalɛ na bítaayɔ-mi kudeedi.

english_verse: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu bɛkali bina kenyekɔ kedeedi kani bínye asa na bíbuli bɛnu. Na binwini kama bɛkya bina ekpidi, na bitaabla lɛla lɛni na bítaabla kudeedi. Nsu si bítenwini kama bítakya bina ekpidi ni, ndububo-mii kudɔ na mbada bina sika ugyiedi ugyii ku nwuna asogya ɔmmɔ lɛgyu nwuna kenyekɔ.

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Nsu lɛla lɛni mɔɔda-mi kubiti na bina lɛlɔ ndi ka ala ani na bekyuli bani nsiaku Nikolatia kama baabla ni, biikisi-nya. Na ami lɛnɔ nkisi-nya.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: “Si bibo atu ni, na binu lɛla lɛni na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔɔsu baƒɔtaadine akpa ammɔ. Anwu ɔni madi ekpidi lɛlɔ ni, ndubute-nwu ulu na ɔdi ngba kugyii kɔni nnye Katɔti Paradiso kemmo mmɔ ebi.” Ɔku Ɔni Na Únweni Úte Smirna Baƒɔtaadine Lɛkpa

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Nweni te Smirna baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa ɔtu anii, “Ami Yesu ndi Udeedi ku Ukplodi. Na líkpi, nsu lɛ́sɔ lɛ́ta líbo nli ngba. Na ami mɔɔsu kenye kamɛni.

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: “Ngyi ka biibó abi na bɛɛyaki ala. Nsu geen ni, bibo ala ƒui. Ngyi enyekpi ani na bekyuli bani mɔɔlɔ lɛlɔ banii Yudaƒuɔ básu básiku-mii lɛlɔ. Nsu ni, baaasiaku Katɔti. Mmomu badi kasala kani ndi Satan badi.

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: Bitayia lɛbibo biala lɛni mebo-mii lɛlɔ. Bise atu na binu! Ukisine ɔmmɔ ɔdubo bina akɔ badi bukpoku bɔnu na ɔya na bakya-mii ɔtɔ na bekpoku-mii emeyi leevu. Ɔlɛka bɛbla ala ulu lɛlɔ bite-mi si ina úbo úte ka bikpi muedi. Na ami ndubuti ngba bɔni nsɔ naaadubo bɔsa kudii lɛƒɔ-mii kayu.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: “Si bibo atu ni, na binu lɛla lɛni na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔɔsu baƒɔtaadine akpa ammɔ. Anwu ɔni madi ekpidi lɛlɔ ni, uleduo kukpi kunyɔdi ɔgbankpi kemmo.” Ɔku Ɔni Na Únweni Úte Pergamo Baƒɔtaadine Lɛkpa

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Nweni ɔku te Pergamo baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa ɔtu anii, “Ami Yesu mbo kewii kani bádɔ-ka lɛvi inyɔ mmɔ. Na ami mɔɔsu kenye kamɛni.

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: “Ngyi ka ɔma ɔni na bilie ndi likpo lɛni na Satan úse nwuna lɛga kadikɔ. Bɛ́siaku-mi kama kpakplaa. Na bítedie bina bɔƒɔtaadi atu na mina lɛlɔ ina uwi ɔni na bádu Antipa ɔni lɛnɔ nédie-mi litemi kenye ulu lɛlɔ na likpo lɛni na Satan ulie mmɔ.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: “Nsu alakpa alɛɛ adi ábala-mii. Bibo bekyuli badi na bina akɔ mmɔ bani mɔɔsiaku Bileam ala bɔtina kama. Ukyuli ɔmɛni nátina Balak kalɛ na ɔtɔlɔ Israelƒuɔ. Na ɔ́kpanku-ma útákya likpidi kemmo. Baadi adila ani na béti bákpa béte baƒiɔ, na bábla lɛyalɛ ala.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Lɛni kani bibo bekyuli badi na mmɔ bani mɔɔsiaku Nikolatia ala bɔtina kama.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: Binwini kama bɛkya bina ekpidi! Na si ɔɔɔdi lɛni ni, ami ndubo-mii kudɔ uwi klukui ku litemi geen lɛni mɔɔtu aani kewii kani mɔɔlɛ́-mi kenye na mbekpoku bekyuli bani nsiaku ala bɔtina bɔmmɔ kama.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
translation_verse: “Si bibo atu ni, na binu lɛla lɛni na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔɔsu baƒɔtaadine akpa ammɔ. Anwu ɔni madi ekpidi lɛlɔ ni, ndubo-nwu adila ani na Katɔti ɔ́bala úse adi bute. Na ndubute-nwu lɛtabi lɛƒualadi lɛdi lɛnɔ lɛni lɛlɔ na bénweni lɛnyi lɛwɔdi básia lɛni na ukyuli ɔmmɔ kani ndubɔti-ni.” Ɔku Ɔni Na Únweni Úte Tiatira Baƒɔtaadine Lɛkpa

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Nweni ɔku te Tiatira baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa ɔtu anii, “Ami Yesu ndi Katɔti Ubidi. Na mina anumi aada aani ogya na mina lɛgba liikeye aani lɛbuala lɛni bákya ogya na lígyie. Ami mɔɔsu kenye kamɛni.

english_verse: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
translation_verse: “Ngyi lɛla lɛni na bɛɛbla. Na ngyi kalɛ na bɛɛyɔ́-mi na bɛɛƒɔ́-mi taadi ku kalɛ na bɛɛbla-mi kabla na binye lɛbibo kenye kpakplaa. Na ngyi ka kabla kabuni kani bɛɛbla ɔƒɛni ketulo kalɛ na bítaabla kudeedi.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: “Nsu bɔƒiɔ bɔni muudie-mii ndi ka biite uleku Isebel ɔni mɔɔlɔ lɛlɔ ɔnii Katɔti kenye udiene kuƒi. Nsu uleku ɔmmɔ ala ani na ɔɔtina aayá na mina kabla bablane bayii ulu na baabla lɛyalɛ ala, na baadi adila ani na béti bákpa béte baƒiɔ.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: Líte-nwu uwi ɔni na uti ɔvumana na ɔda ekpidi bɔbla ɔya, nsu ulenu kalɔ.

english_verse: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ndubɔya na ɔlɛ ubo-nwu ɔva lɛtala lɛlɔ. Na bani na anwu ku-ma badi kɔsɔnɔ badububo abi geen, amu ntu bada-nwu kama bɔsiaku báya.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: Lɛnɔ ni, ndubo uleku ɔmɛni basɔnɔbi ƒui bɔdu. Na mmɔ ni, baƒɔtaadine lɛkpa lɛmmɔ ƒui badubɔti ka ami ndi ukyuli ɔni ngyi ukyuli biala kayi ku lili kemmo. Ndubo bina akɔ ɔdi biala kayu bɔƒɔ na lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla kenye.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: “Nsu amii bakladi bani nkya Tiatira na bɛɛɛsiaku nwuna ala bɔtina kama na bítatɛya Satan ala abɛdi ani baasu ka ana kemmo ágyu mmɔ ni, mɔɔsu-mii ka nsɔ lɛɛɛdubo etila abambadi adi buti bɔsia-mii lɛlɔ.

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: Nsu biƒie bɔƒɔtaadi bɔni na bibo bɛda kpakplaa úti útédu uwi ɔni na mebo.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: “Si bibo atu ni, na binu lɛla lɛni na Katɔti Kɔyu kɔɔsu baƒɔtaadine akpa ammɔ.”
