english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Baga leevu bamɛni ƒui bada kasusu kenwi, na beeti bana ɔyikun ku kenyekɔ teete eƒiebuo ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Na badubɔta na bekpoku Koƒonu Ubi ɔmmɔ. Nsu Koƒonu Ubi ɔmmɔ ku nwuna bekyuli baƒunadi ku nwuna baƒɔtaadine geen badubo-ma lɛlɔ bɔdi. Ɔsika anwu ndi Blɔti ɔni ndi Bati Ƒui Ɔti ku Baga Ƒui Ɔga.”

english_verse: The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ntukpa bɔni kudɔ na ánu ka ɔyalɛ ɔmmɔ ulie ni, amu nnye nte kalɔ ƒui bekyuli ku bani nkya kaba ku kadi ku kalɔ ku adi ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Ese leevu ani nnye nte baga bani na ánu ku eƒiebuo ɔmmɔ ni, badubukisi ɔyalɛ ɔmmɔ. Na badubo ala ani nse-nwu ƒui bɔƒɔ bɔsiku-nwu kudɔ na ɔsɔ ɔkɛ utaavi kasɔngya. Badubo-nwu lɛna bɔkun na bakyula lɛni nébu.

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
translation_verse: Ɔsika Katɔti úti ɔ́kya-ma kayi kemmo kalɛ babla lɛla lɛni na anwu Katɔti ɔɔwia. Na bénu lɛlɔ kalɔ ka beti bana ɔyikun bete eƒiebuo ɔmmɔ na ɔdi lɛga uti utédu ka Katɔti etemila ani na ɔ́su úse ébo-nwu kemmo lɛni.

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Uleku ɔni na ánu mmɔ ni, anwu unye ute ɔma unengudi ɔni mbo ɔyikun na kayawi baga ƒui lɛlɔ.”

english_verse: I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, lɛ́nu Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi ka ɔ́si katɔ mmɔ ɔɔyu ɔdubo kalɔ. Na ubo kenyekɔ geen, na nwuna bukeye bɔ́ƒɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ ƒui.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́va ku lɛdi momoomo ɔnini, “Úbuli o-o! Babilon ɔni náƒɔ lɛnyi geen mmɔ úbuli! Na ɔ́ta únwini ayu ekpidi ƒui kabɛkɔ. Mmɔ na ayu ekpidi ku begbini ku baasɛ bani muusé lɛlɔ ƒui bakya.

english_verse: Babylon's evil and immoral wine has made all nations drunk. Every king on earth has slept with her, and every merchant on earth is rich because of her evil desires.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika Kayawi bekyuli ƒui báni ɔma ɔmmɔ alaekpidi bɔbla békpi aani ntɛ. Na ɔ́tɔlɔ-ma aani kalɛ na ɔyalɛ ɔɔtɔ́lɔ bekyuli taatákya likpidi kemmo. Kalɔ lɛlɔ baga ƒui beesié ɔma ɔmmɔ teebo aani kalɛ na banana beesié ɔyalɛ kudɔ. Na kalɔ ƒui beyedine benengudi bénwini balakɛne ɔkɛnku bana liyedi na ɔma ɔmmɔ ɔni néyi ku akɛla ani ndanku adikpi bɔdi.”

english_verse: Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, “My people, you must escape from Babylon. Don't take part in her sins and share her punishment.
translation_verse: Na línu lɛdi bamba ka lɛ́si katɔ mmɔ na lɛɛsu lɛnini, “Mina bekyuli, bɛvi bɛlɛ ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo kalɛ na bilabla ekpidi ani na ɔɔbla, na ɔgbankpi ɔni mebo nwuna bekyuli lɛlɔ ulebo amii lɛnɔ lɛlɔ!

english_verse: Her sins are piled as high as heaven. God has remembered the evil she has done.
translation_verse: Ɔsika ɔma ɔmmɔ ekpidi éemomo na ákuku étédu katɔ, na Katɔti únyimo udunkpi ala ani ƒui na nwuna bekyuli bábla.

english_verse: Treat her as she has treated others. Make her pay double for what she has done. Make her drink twice as much of what she mixed for others.
translation_verse: Amii Katɔti batu ni, bɛƒɔ-ma kayu na lɛla lɛni na bábla Katɔti kenye. Na bɛƒɔ-ma kayu kammɔ akpa anyɔ na bana ablala kenye. Ala ani na ɔma ɔmmɔ ɔ́sala aani ɔdu ala na ɔɔƒɛɛ kemmo úte bekyuli na báni ni, bɛsala ɔdu ɔmmɔ akpa anyɔ na ɔɔƒɛɛ ɔmmɔ kani kemmo na bite nwuna bekyuli na bani!

english_verse: That woman honored herself with a life of luxury. Reward her now with suffering and pain. “Deep in her heart Babylon said, ‘I am the queen! Never will I be a widow or know what it means to be sad.’
translation_verse: Na kalɛ na ɔma ɔmmɔ ɔ́kɔliku lɛlɔ katɔ na nwuna adikpi bɔdi akɛla kenye ni, bɛya na ubo abi na uwulo utédu ekpidi ammɔ kenye. Ɔsika ɔma ɔmmɔ use aani uleku ɔni násu na nwuna kayi kemmo ɔnini, ‘Uleku Ɔga na ndi, na nlie mina lɛgaboku lɛlɔ. Lɛɛɛdi ukpinele, na lɛɛɛdubo kɔnyana kɔdi lɛnɔ buwulo kudii!’

english_verse: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.”
translation_verse: Anwuɔsu ɔgbankpi ɔdubuƒie-nwu ɔva limeyi linwi. Na ɔdubuduo ɔlɛ ku kɔnyana buwulo ku kɔka lɛnɔ kemmo. Na ogya ɔdubo-nwu bɔkyula, ɔsika Katɔti úbomo na anwu ndubɔtɛku-nwu litemi.

english_verse: Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire.
translation_verse: “Na kalɔ lɛlɔ baga bani muusié ɔma ɔmmɔ teebo taabla ekpidi na békeli basiaku adikpi bɔdi akɛla kama na mmɔ ni, badubo keku ku kɔnyana buwulo na ɔma ɔmmɔ lili si bánu uyɔ ka ɔɔkɔ́ katɔ uwi ɔni na ɔɔkywí.

english_verse: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, “Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.”
translation_verse: Baga bamɛni badubunye ɔgyu kakaaka bataanu ala amɛni, ɔsika baayia ka ɔma ɔmmɔ lɛbibo lɛmmɔ udu lɛdububo-ma lɛlɔ. Na badubɔsu banini, “ ‘Bɔbuɛ! Bɔbuɛ! Ɔma ɔni mbo ɔyikun! Babilon, ɔma bonwu ɔmmɔ! Ɔdɔ bubo unwi kemmo kani na ƒula kɔtu bɔni kɔ́da kɔ́lɛ-ɔ lɛlɔ!’

english_verse: Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods.
translation_verse: “Mmɔ ni, kalɔ ƒui beyedine benengudi béwulo keku ku kɔnyana, ɔsika basɔ beeebo ukyuli ɔni meye-ma ala.

english_verse: Babylon, the things your heart desired have all escaped from you. Every luxury and all your glory will be lost forever. You will never get them back.
translation_verse: “Na básu banini, ‘Babilon! Ala abuni ani ƒui na áyɔ ka akɛ ni, anya nálɛ-ɔ enu kemmo mɛni. Na ƒula ebiti akɛla ku lɛkɛ ni, áyila-nya na asɔ aaadubo-nya bɔnu kudii.’

english_verse: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Beyedine bani mbo eyedila ani na beeti taakɛ lɛkɛ taasiku ɔma ɔmmɔ kudɔ mɛni ni, badubunye ɔgyu kakaaka na bewulo keku ku kɔnyana momoomo banini,

english_verse: Then they shouted, “Pity the great city of Babylon! She dressed in fine linen and wore purple and scarlet cloth. She had jewelry made of gold and precious stones and pearls.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɔbuɛ! Bɔbuɛ! Uwi ɔdi kemmo ni, ɔma bonwu ɔmmɔ úyi ku adiƒuala abuni ku adi ani nse ƒuƒuu ku egyiedi. Na báklibi ɔma ɔmmɔ ku sika ugyiedi ku aseebi ku asɛɛ ani náƒɔ kuye éyi tɛtɛɛtɛ!

english_verse: Yet in a single hour her riches disappeared.” Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔdɔ bubo unwi kemmo kani na akɛla amɛni ƒui ébie!’ “Na lɛkɔlɔ libendi bakane ku bekyuli bani ngyi ketu lɛlɔ kabla kaduɛ ku bani ƒui mɔɔdi kuye na ntu anumi mmɔ bénye ɔgyu kakaaka.

english_verse: When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, “This was the greatest city ever!”
translation_verse: Na báva momoomo uwi ɔni na bánu uyɔ ɔni mɔɔkɔ́ katɔ taasi ɔma bonwu ɔni mɔɔkywí mmɔ kemmo banini, ‘Ɔma bonwu ɔmani nsɔ nse aani ƒula kalɛ?’

english_verse: They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said, “Pity the great city of Babylon! Everyone who sailed the seas became rich from her treasures. But in a single hour the city was destroyed.
translation_verse: Amu na béti enu béwi lili na béwulo kɔnyana geen na básu banini, “ ‘Bɔbuɛ, bɔbuɛ na buute ɔma unengudi ɔmɛni. Kesii kani na bekyuli bani mbo lɛkɔlɔ bonwu na beesiénku-ni ntu anumi bákɛ bana lɛkɛ! Ɔdɔ bubo unwi kemmo kani ni, lɛla biala líbie!

english_verse: The heavens should be happy with God's people and apostles and prophets. God has punished her for them.”
translation_verse: Amii bani nkya katɔ ƒui lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii. Na amii Katɔti bekyuli ƒui ku batalane ku Katɔti kenye bediene ni, lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-mii! Ɔsika Katɔti ɔ́tɛku ɔma ɔmmɔ litemi na lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla-mii ɔsu!’ ”

english_verse: A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said, “This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to rise again.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Katɔti ɔtu ɔyikune ɔdi úti lɛtabi lɛdi nse aani kukɔ bonwu kɔdi úbo ɔ́kya ɛpu kemmo na ɔɔsu ɔnini, “Lɛni na Katɔti ɔdubo Babilon ɔma bonwu ɔmɛni bubo butáƒiɛmi kalɔ momoomo ɔni na basɔ balanu-nwu kudii.

english_verse: The music of harps and singers and of flutes and trumpets will no longer be heard. No workers will ever set up shop in that city, and the sound of grinding grain will be silenced forever.
translation_verse: Na ɔbentaa ku lɛnu bediene ku atoloyii ku kɔkpɛɛ bavwine ni, basɔ belénu-ma kɔku kudii na ƒula kemmo. Enu kabla ɔblane biala ɔ́sɔ ulabla nwuna kabla na ƒula kemmo. Na basɔ belénu kukɔ kɔdi kɔku na ƒula kemmo.

english_verse: Lamps will no longer shine anywhere in Babylon, and couples will never again say wedding vows there. Her merchants ruled the earth, and by her witchcraft she fooled all nations.
translation_verse: Na basɔ balanu asogya bukeye bɔdi na ƒula kemmo kudii. Na basɔ belénu uleku buti lɛnu lɛdi lɛnɔ. Ƒula beyedine bani néteeti ala teebeye ni, bekyuli bánu-ma aani bekyuli benengudi ƒui na kalɔ lɛlɔ mɛni. Na ɔkɛnku ƒula evo ani na aaƒɛ teete bekyuli ɔsu ni, áya na kalɔ ƒui bekyuli báyii ulu.

english_verse: On the streets of Babylon is found the blood of God's people and of his prophets, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: Na Katɔti kenye bediene ku Katɔti bekyuli ku bekyuli bamba bani ƒui na bádu na kayawi mɛni ni, bana ubugya ɔsiaku-ɔ!”

english_verse: After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting, “Praise the Lord! To our God belongs the glorious power to save,
translation_verse: Ɔmɛni kama ni, línu kɔku bonwu kɔdi na katɔ aani bekyuli lisu bonwu lɛdi. Na báva momoomo básu banini, “Aleluya! Ngba bɔƒɔ ku bukeye ku ɔyikun ɔdi bula Katɔti ɔdi.

english_verse: because his judgments are honest and fair. That filthy prostitute ruined the earth with shameful deeds. But God has judged her and made her pay the price for murdering his servants.”
translation_verse: Ɔsika nwuna litemi bɔtɛ buse siin. Na nwuna etemila adi litemi geen. Ɔma ɔni nébile kayawi ku nwuna alaekpidi bɔbla aani ɔyalɛ ni, Katɔti nátɛku-nwu litemi. Na Katɔti kabla bablane bani ubugya na béwi kalɔ ni, údie ɔma ɔmɛni bekyuli kasi na ubugya ɔmmɔ ɔsu.”

english_verse: Then the crowd shouted, “Praise the Lord! Smoke will never stop rising from her burning body.”
translation_verse: Básɔ báva básu banini, “Aleluya! Uyɔ ɔni mɔɔkɔ́ katɔ mɛni ni, utaakɔ lɛni usela ƒui.”

english_verse: From the throne a voice said, “If you worship and fear our God, give praise to him, no matter who you are.”
translation_verse: Na lɛdi lɛdi lɛ́si lɛgaboku lɛmmɔ kudɔ mmɔ na lɛɛsu lɛnini, “Bimwi bula Katɔti amii nwuna kabla bablane bani mɔɔyia-nwu, benengu ku banamu ƒui.”

english_verse: Then I heard what seemed to be a large crowd that sounded like a roaring flood and loud thunder all mixed together. They were saying, “Praise the Lord! Our Lord God All-Powerful now rules as king.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, línu kɔku bonwu aani bekyuli lisu lɛdi na ɔ́lɛ aani ntukpa pii bɔku ku katɔ budu taasia kama. Na baasu banini, “Aleluya! Ɔsika Blɔti ɔni mbo ɔyikun ƒui ni, bédie nwuna lɛga bɔdi keyi!

english_verse: So we will be glad and happy and give him praise. The wedding day of the Lamb is here, and his bride is ready.
translation_verse: Bɛya na bula ƒui bɔkɛ ebiti na lɛlɔ lɛyɔ-bu na bɔkɔliku-nwu lɛnyi katɔ. Ɔsika Katɔti Koƒonu Ubi ɔmmɔ limeyi libendi lɛmmɔ lídu aani kalɛ na beeti uleku. Na Katɔti bekyuli báaklibi lɛlɔ bése aani uleku ɔmmɔ kalɛ.

english_verse: She will be given a wedding dress made of pure and shining linen. This linen stands for the good things God's people have done.”
translation_verse: Blɔti úte-ma kɔdi kɔbuni kɔni muukeye sɛɛn ka beti benyimi.” Na kɔdi kɔbuni kɔmmɔ ndi ala siin ani na Katɔti bekyuli bammɔ bábla.

english_verse: Then the angel told me, “Put this in writing. God will bless everyone who is invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” The angel also said, “These things God has said are true.”
translation_verse: Mmɔ na Katɔti ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Nweni ala amɛni. Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ama bani na badubɔlɔ beboku uleku ketikɔ adila kadikɔ.” Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Etemila amɛni adi Katɔti ɔlati etemila geen.”

english_verse: I knelt at the feet of the angel and began to worship him. But the angel said, “Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you and everyone else who tells about Jesus. Don't worship anyone but God. Everyone who tells about Jesus does it by the power of the Spirit.” The Rider on the White Horse
translation_verse: Mmɔ ni, lɛ́yu líbi kalɔ na nwuna lɛgba akɔ na límwi-nwu aani Katɔti kalɛ. Nsu ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Tabla lɛni! Ami lɛnɔ kabla ɔblane ɔkpana na ndi aani ƒula kalɛ ku ƒula banwa bakladi bani nsiaku Blɔti Yesu ala bɔtina kama. Katɔti kani na ɔlɛka emwi lɛni. Ɔsika ala ani na Yesu ɔ́tina ni, ana kenye budie ndi Kɔyu ɔyikun ɔni nákya Katɔti kenye bediene lɛlɔ kemmo.” Yohane Ɔ́nu Anwu Ɔni Nlie Ɔpɔnkɔ Ɔƒualadi Lɛlɔ

english_verse: I looked and saw heaven was open, and a white horse was there. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he is always fair when he judges or goes to war.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, lɛ́nu ka kayaa kálɛmi na ɔpɔnkɔ ɔƒualadi ɔdi ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ. Na ukyuli ɔni nlie-nwu lɛlɔ ni, baalɔ-nwu banii Kama Kekpokɔ ku Litemi Geen. Na ɔɔtɛ litemi siin na uukpó kekpo lɛnɔ siin.

english_verse: He had eyes like flames of fire, and he was wearing a lot of crowns. His name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew what the name meant.
translation_verse: Nwuna anumi ese aani ogya na kɔgabwa pii kubi-nwu lili. Na bénweni lɛnyi lɛdi básia-nwu lɛlɔ lɛni na ukyuli ɔdi ɔɔɔgyi ntu anwu kani.

english_verse: The rider wore a robe that was covered with blood, and he was known as “The Word of God.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkya awu gyɔlɔɔ ɔni na báka bɔnyina bɔkya ubugya kemmo. Na lɛnyi lɛni kani na bagyi-nwu ndi Katɔti Litemi.

english_verse: He was followed by armies from heaven that rode on white horses and were dressed in pure white linen.
translation_verse: Na katɔ bekpone ƒui bakya lɛwu lɛbuni lɛƒualadi lɛni nse sɛɛn, na belie bapɔnkɔ baƒualadi lɛlɔ na basiaku ukyuli ɔmmɔ kama.

english_verse: From his mouth a sharp sword went out to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod and will show the fierce anger of God All-Powerful by trampling the grapes in the pit where wine is made.
translation_verse: Na litemi geen lɛni nse aani kewii kani bádɔ-ka lɛvi inyɔ lɛɛlɛ́-nwu kenye kani na ɔdubuti ukpo kalɔ ƒui bekyuli, na uti nwuna ɔyikun utaadi-ma lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubɔni-ma kɔtu kpakplaa ku Katɔti Ɔyikune Ƒui kɔnyi geen aani kalɛ na baaka ntu teedie ebi kemmo kpakplaa na ntɛ kablakɔ.

english_verse: On the part of the robe that covered his thigh was written, “KING OF KINGS AND Lord OF LordS.”
translation_verse: Na bénweni lɛnyi lɛdi básia nwuna awu lɛlɔ ku nwuna libuili kakɛ banii BAGA ƑUI ƆGA KU BATI ƑUI ƆTI

english_verse: I then saw an angel standing on the sun, and he shouted to all the birds flying in the sky, “Come and join in God's great feast!
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, lɛ́nu Katɔti ɔtu ɔdi ka unye ɔƒɛ kemmo na ɔ́kpali baasɛ bani ƒui muuveyi taavi kaya ku lɛdi momoomo ɔnini, “Bibo bibasala na bɛdi Katɔti adila enengudi ani na ɔ́klibi úse-mii.

english_verse: I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́nu ka eƒiebuo ɔmmɔ ku kayawi baga ku bana bekpone ƒui básala ka betékpo Anwu ɔni nlie ɔpɔnkɔ ɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ku nwuna bekpone.

english_verse: But the beast was captured and so was the false prophet. This is the same prophet who had worked miracles for the beast, so he could fool everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol. The beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into a lake of burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Nsu béƒie eƒiebuo ɔmmɔ ku eƒiebuo ɔni néti lɛlɔ ɔ́bla ɔkɔ kenye udiene. Anwu ndi ɔni nábla akɔla budie taatina na eƒiebuo udeedi ɔmmɔ kenye, na úti akɔla budie taatina ammɔ ɔ́tɔlɔ bekyuli bani na bése likpo ku eƒiebuo ɔmmɔ likpose na bémwi eƒiebuo ɔmmɔ baƒiɔ. Na bekpone bammɔ béti eƒiebuo ɔmmɔ ku bekyuli bamɛni ƒui na bébo-ma bátákya ogya livongu lɛni nse bonwu aani ɛpu kalɛ, na ɔɔda ku ogya atabi kemmo.

english_verse: But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.
translation_verse: Na bekyuli bakladi ni, ukyuli ɔni nlie ɔpɔnkɔ lɛlɔ na kewii katu-nwu kenye mmɔ ɔ́du-ma ku kewii kammɔ, na baasɛ bammɔ báduli-ma ɔlɔna ƒui bébweli na bémo.

english_verse: He chained the dragon for
translation_verse: Na únyimi-ku úse akwa apim unwi.

english_verse: I saw thrones, and sitting on those thrones were the ones who had been given the right to judge. I also saw the souls of the people who had their heads cut off because they had told about Jesus and preached God's message. They were the same ones who had not worshiped the beast or the idol, and they had refused to let its mark be put on their foreheads or hands. They will come to life and rule with Christ for
translation_verse: Na ɔmɛni kama ni, lɛ́nu agaboku adi. Na bekyuli bani na Katɔti úte ɔyikun ka batɛku bekyuli litemi ni, belie-nya lɛlɔ. Na lɛ́nu bekyuli babambadi ayu. Ama ndi bani nédie Blɔti Yesu kenye na básu Katɔti litemi. Anwuɔsu kayawi bekyuli békulo-ma eli. Ama ndi bani nétemwi eƒiebuo ɔmmɔ iye eƒiebuo ɔmmɔ baƒiɔ bani bése béte lɛlɔ ka bataakpa. Na bátasia-ma nwuna likpose lɛdi na bana atɛntɛ iye enu lɛlɔ. Bekyuli bamɛni básɔ báta bébelie ngba na bádiku Kristo lɛga akwa apim unwi.

english_verse: These people are the first to be raised to life, and they are especially blessed and holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests for God and Christ and will rule with them for
translation_verse: Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bekyuli kedee bani na Katɔti ɔdubɔgyila na bekpine bɔgyila kudeedi kemmo. Na bekyuli bammɔ ni, kukpi kunyɔdi kɔ́sɔ kulákɛ ɔyikun na bana lɛlɔ. Mmomu badubo bakpane bunwini na bataakpanku bekyuli teete Katɔti ku Kristo. Na badubɔdiku-nwu lɛga akwa apim unwi. Bádi Satan Lɛlɔ

english_verse: He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach,
translation_verse: Na ɔdubo ubatɔlɔ kalɔ lɛlɔ bekyuli bani nkya kayawi ekpo ƒui, na baalɔ-ma na lɛsugba kemmo banii Gog ku Magog. Na ɔdubɔsala-ma kalɛ na betékpo. Na bana bumomo bɔdubɔbla aani ɛpu kɔnwinimi.

english_verse: and they will march all the way across the earth. They will surround the camp of God's people and the city God loves. But fire will come down from heaven and destroy the whole army.
translation_verse: Otogyi ɔmɛni ɔkɛ ɔɔví kalɔ kammɔ ƒui lɛlɔ. Na úbo úbaka ɔ́mana ɔma ɔni na Katɔti ɔɔyɔ́ na nwuna bekyuli kedee belie-nwu kemmo mmɔ. Nsu ogya ɔ́si katɔ na úbo úbakyula-ma ƒui.

english_verse: Then the devil who fooled them will be thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. He will be there with the beast and the false prophet, and they will be in pain day and night forever and ever. The Judgment at the Great White Throne
translation_verse: Na bébo ukisine ɔni nátɔlɔ-ma mmɔ bátákya lɛgyavonku bonwu lɛni mɔɔda ku ogya atabi mmɔ kemmo kesii kani na eƒiebuo ɔmmɔ ku ɔkɔ kenye udiene bakya, na badubo abi buteebo usien ku ɔƒɛ usela uwi ƒui. Katɔti Ɔ́tɛku Bekpine Ƒui Litemi

english_verse: I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, lɛ́nu lɛgaboku bonwu ƒuala ƒuala lɛdi ka Katɔti ulie-ni lɛlɔ. Na ka ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ ni, kalɔ ku katɔ ƒui káyii na asɔ alánu-ka lɛla lɛdi na kesii kadi.

english_verse: I also saw all the dead people standing in front of that throne. Every one of them was there, no matter who they had once been. Several books were opened, and then the book of life was opened. The dead were judged by what those books said they had done.
translation_verse: Na lɛ́nu ka bekpine ƒui benye lɛgaboku lɛmɛni anumi, banamu ku benengu, na bébimi lɛku lɛdi béwi. Na básɔ bébimi ɔku ɔbambadi ɔni ndi ngba ɔku lɛnɔ béwi. Na lɛku lɛmɛni kemmo na baanu taatɛku bekpine ƒui litemi ɔkɛnku ala ani na bábla na bénweni bákya lɛku lɛmmɔ kemmo lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done.
translation_verse: Bekyuli bani ƒui nékpi ɛpu kemmo bási bálɛ. Na bekpine ƒui lɛnɔ báta bálɛ kekpine ku kɔƒiɔtɔ kemmo. Na Katɔti ɔ́tɛku ɔdi biala litemi ɔkɛnku ala ani na ɔ́bla lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
translation_verse: Béti kukpi ku kekpine kammɔ ƒui bébo bátákya lɛgyavonku kemmo. Na ɔmɛni ndi kukpi kunyɔdi.

english_verse: Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
translation_verse: Na ukyuli ɔni na bétenweni-nwu lɛnyi bátakya ngba ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo ni, béti-nwu bébo bákya lɛgyavonku lɛmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and so had the sea.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, lɛ́nu katɔ ku kalɔ kawɔdi. Ɔsika katɔ ku kalɔ kedeedi aka káyii, na ɛpu lɛnɔ ɔsɔ uuubo.

english_verse: I heard a loud voice shout from the throne: God's home is now with his people. He will live with them, and they will be his own. Yes, God will make his home among his people.
translation_verse: Na línu lɛdi bonwu lɛdi ɔ́si lɛgaboku lɛmmɔ kudɔ ka lɛɛsu lɛnini, “Bɛnu! Katɔti keliekɔ káyu kébo bekyuli akɔ. Ɔdubulie-ma kudɔ na ama benwini-nwu bekyuli. Na Katɔti ɔlati ɔkya-ma akɔ na ɔdi-ma Kɔti.

english_verse: He will wipe all tears from their eyes, and there will be no more death, suffering, crying, or pain. These things of the past are gone forever.
translation_verse: Na ɔdubuni-ma imii biala na bana anumi. Na kukpi kɔsɔ kulakya lɛnɔ. Na keku ku kɔnyana buwulo ku ɔlɛ bunu lɛnɔ bɔdi bɔsɔ bulakya, ɔsika ala akukudi ƒui ávi.”

english_verse: Then the one sitting on the throne said: I am making everything new. Write down what I have said. My words are true and can be trusted.
translation_verse: Amu na anwu ɔni nlie lɛgaboku lɛmmɔ lɛlɔ ɔ́su ɔnini, “Bɛnu! Lɛ́sɔku ala ƒui lɛ́bla ɔwɔdi.” Na ɔ́sɔ ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Nweni ala amɛni se, ɔsika adi etemila ani ndi ukyuli kama kekpokɔ, na adi etemila geen.”

english_verse: Everything is finished! I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will freely give water from the life-giving fountain to everyone who is thirsty.
translation_verse: Na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Ɔ́sa! Ami ndi Alƒa ku Omega ɔni ndi lɛla biala kalɔ kesekɔ ku kawɔlɔkɔ. Na bani na utukwɛ ɔɔda ni, ndubute-ma ntu ƒaa na bani basiku libiɔ lɛni muute ngba ƒui kemmo.

english_verse: All who win the victory will be given these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni madi ekpidi lɛlɔ ni, ɔdubɔkɛ kadikɔ kamɛni. Na ami lɛdi-nwu Kɔti, na anwu wadi mina ubi.

english_verse: But I will tell you what will happen to cowards and to everyone who is unfaithful or dirty-minded or who murders or is sexually immoral or uses witchcraft or worships idols or tells lies. They will be thrown into that lake of fire and burning sulfur. This is the second death. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Nsu bekyuli bani mbo liƒu ku bani nátaƒɔ bátadi ku bani muusé lɛlɔ ku bekyuli badune ku bayalɛ ku evo baƒɛne ku bani mɔɔkpá baƒiɔ ku ɔkɔ banyine ku bana udu ƒui ni, badubuduo lɛgyavonku lɛni mɔɔda ku ogya atabi mmɔ kemmo. Na ɔmmɔ madi kukpi kunyɔdi kɔmmɔ.”

english_verse: I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, “Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, Katɔti batu maatɛ bani náda kɔlaku maatɛ kɔni néyi ku lɛbibo kpakplaa maatɛ mmɔ akɔ unwi ɔ́da ɔ́lɛ na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Bo, na ndubɔtina-a Katɔti bekyuli bani nse aani Koƒonu Ubi ɔmmɔ uleku ɔni na ɔdubo buti mmɔ.”

english_verse: Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.
translation_verse: Na útiku-mi na kɔyu kemmo ɔ́tɔlɔku úsienku kɔbi bonwu kɔni nákuku lili. Na ɔ́tina-mi Yerusalem ɔma unengudi kedee ɔni náyu ɔ́si Katɔti kudɔ na kayaa ɔdubo.

english_verse: The glory of God made the city bright. It was dazzling and crystal clear like a precious jasper stone.
translation_verse: Na Katɔti bukeye bɔ́ƒɔ-nwu lɛlɔ ƒui. Na uukeye aani liseebi lɛni náƒɔ kuye geen na baalɔ-ni yaspa, na lise kede kede aani asogya atabi.

english_verse: The city had a high and thick wall with twelve gates, and each one of them was guarded by an angel. On each of the gates was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Bátu kowodu kangyaa kɔdi báka bámana-nwu, na bakya-ku kɔyakun leevu-inyɔ. Na Katɔti batu leevu-inyɔ benye-ku kenye. Na bénweni Israelƒuɔ kaba leevu-inyɔ bammɔ bebi anyi básia kadi biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west.
translation_verse: Na ɔƒɛ katukɔ ni, kɔyakun ɛtɛ kɔkya. Na katɔ kakɛ ni, kɔyakun ɛtɛ kɔkya. Na kada kakɛ ni, kɔyakun ɛtɛ kɔkya. Na ɔƒɛ kanukɔ ni, kɔyakun ɛtɛ kɔkya.

english_verse: The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
translation_verse: Na kowodu kalɔ atabi ani bákya kowodu kɔmmɔ kalɔ ebo atabi leevu-anyɔ. Na bénweni Koƒonu Ubi ɔmmɔ batalane anyi leevu-anyɔ básia kadi biala lɛlɔ.

english_verse: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔtu ɔni nnye mɔɔtɛmiku-mi mmɔ ni, ɔda lɛbuala lɛkɔkula lɛni béti sika ugyiedi bábla ka ɔkɔku ɔma ɔmmɔ ku kɔyakun kɔmmɔ ku awodu ammɔ.

english_verse: The city was shaped like a cube, because it was just as high as it was wide. When the angel measured the city, it was about
translation_verse: Na ɔma ɔmmɔ ɔtɛ lɛƒɛnyi ine bɔmmɔ ƒui lɛlɔ ɔni na nwuna bune ku bɔbɛbɛ ƒui bɔdi unwi. Na ɔ́kɔku ɔma ɔmmɔ ku nwuna lɛkɔkula. Na ubo liluku bɔkɔku apim unwi ku eti leevu. Na nwuna linene ku bɔbɛbɛ ku bɔkuku ƒui búlieku lɛlɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Then the angel measured the wall, and by our measurements it was about
translation_verse: Ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́kɔku kowodu kɔmmɔ butigbli, na kubo lɛgba eti ene ku leevu-ɛku aani kalɛ na bekyuli baakɔ́ku ala.

english_verse: The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Yaspa aseebi bonwu ani náƒɔ kuye na béti bátu awodu ammɔ. Na ɔma ɔmmɔ ɔlati ɔdi sika ugyiedi na use kede kede aani asogya.

english_verse: Each of the twelve foundations was a precious stone. The first was jasper, the second was sapphire, the third was agate, the fourth was emerald,
translation_verse: Na awodu ammɔ kalɔ atabi ani lɛlɔ na bátu awodu ammɔ basia ni, bákya-nya akya ku aseebi abuni lidu lidu ani náƒɔ kuye geen. Udeedi ɔdi liseebi lɛni baalɔ yaspa, na unyɔdi baalɔ sapir. Ɔtɛdi baalɔ yalkedon, na unedi baalɔ smardo.

english_verse: the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst.
translation_verse: Ɔlɔndi baalɔ sardonik, na ɔkundi baalɔ sardis. Maatɛdi baalɔ krisolit, na maanedi baalɔ beril. Yaalenwidi baalɔ topas, na leevudi baalɔ krisopras. Leevu-unwidi baalɔ yiakint, na leevu-unyɔdi baalɔ ametist.

english_verse: Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Kɔyakun leevu-inyɔ kɔmmɔ kɔdi aseebi leevu-anyɔ ani náƒɔ kuye geen, na ɔdi biala ɔdi liseebi libendi linwi. Na ɔma ɔmmɔ ɔblɔnu ɔdi sika ugyiedi ɔni na akana na anu avinku-nwu kemmo aani asogya.

english_verse: I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple.
translation_verse: Na ńtanu kakpakɔ kadi na ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo, ɔsika Unwoti Katɔti ɔni ndi Ɔyikune Ƒui ku Koƒonu Ubi ɔmmɔ alati ndi ɔma ɔmmɔ kakpakɔ.

english_verse: And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.
translation_verse: Na ɔma ɔmmɔ uláwia ɔƒɛ ɔdi iye kɔbuli ka ute bukeye bɔdi, ɔsika Katɔti bukeye ndi-nwu bukeye, na ɔma ɔmmɔ asogya ndi Koƒonu Ubi ɔmmɔ.

english_verse: Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there.
translation_verse: Na bukeye bɔmɛni na kadi ƒui bekyuli badubɔnu busie. Na kalɔ lɛlɔ baga badubuti bana agala beboku ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes.
translation_verse: Na balakalɛ kɔyakun kɔmɛni kɔdubuwi uwi biala, ɔsika lɛdisa liiibo mmɔ.

english_verse: The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city.
translation_verse: Na kadi bekyuli ƒui badubuti bana akɛla ku ɔbu bebeduo mmɔ.

english_verse: But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
translation_verse: Nsu lɛla biala muusé lɛlɔ lileduo mmɔ kudii. Na bani ƒui mɔɔbla ala ani muusé lɛlɔ iye ala ani muukpó kɔƒa iye ala ani mɔɔtɔ́lɔ bekyuli ni, beleduo mmɔ. Mmomu bani anyi na bénweni bákya Koƒonu Ubi ɔmmɔ ngba ɔku kemmo kani ndubuduo mmɔ.

english_verse: The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated.
translation_verse: Ɔmmɔ kama ni, ɔ́tina-mi ketu kani ntu muute ngba. Ketu kammɔ kaagbá taasi Katɔti ku Koƒonu Ubi ɔmmɔ lɛgaboku kudɔ. Na buukeye aani asogya.

english_verse: Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
translation_verse: Na ketu kammɔ kaagbá taavi ɔma ɔmmɔ ɔblɔnu ntɛ. Na kana lɛvi inyɔ bɔmmɔ lɛlɔ ni, kugyii kɔni muute ngba kunye ku kuna ebi lidu leevu-inyɔ bɔmmɔ, na kɔɔnwu ebi ammɔ kɔbuli biala. Na kugyii kɔmmɔ evete adi kuvo kɔni na beti babwi kalɔ ƒui bekyuli.

english_verse: God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God
translation_verse: Ewida eeebo mmɔ. Mmomu Katɔti ku Koƒonu Ubi ɔmmɔ lɛgaboku lɛdubuse mmɔ na nwuna kabla bablane badubo-nwu lɛnyi buteemwi.

english_verse: Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever. The Coming of Christ
translation_verse: Lɛdisa lɛsɔ lilakya mmɔ. Na baláwia bukeye bɔdi taasiku asogya iye ɔƒɛ kudɔ, ɔsika Unwoti Katɔti ɔlati ndi bana bukeye na badubɔdi lɛga usela uwi ƒui. Yesu Ɔ́si Ɔdubo

english_verse: Then I was told: These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon.
translation_verse: Amu na Katɔti ɔtu ɔmmɔ ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Etemila amɛni adi ukyuli kama kekpokɔ na adi etemila geen. Na Unwoti Katɔti ɔni muuti nwuna Kɔyu teete nwuna kenye bediene ni, anwu nátala nwuna ɔtu ɔnii ubatina nwuna kabla ɔblane ala ani ndubo abalɛ na uwi klukui kemmo.”

english_verse: Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
translation_verse: “Bɛnu! Ami Yesu ndubo uwi klukui kemmo! Na lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ ukyuli ɔni mada linyese lɛmɛni etemila ani nkya ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo.”

english_verse: My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
translation_verse: Ami Yohane ni, ami ndi ukyuli ɔni nénu na lɛ́nu ala amɛni ƒui. Na uwi ɔni na línu na lɛ́nu-nya ni, lɛ́yu líbi kalɔ na Katɔti ɔtu ɔni nédie ala amɛni ɔ́tina-mi lɛgba akɔ na límwi-nwu aani Katɔti.

english_verse: But the angel said, Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
translation_verse: Nsu ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Tabla lɛni! Ami lɛnɔ kabla ɔblane ɔkpana na ndi aani ƒula kalɛ ku ƒula banwa kenye bediene babambadi ku bakladi bani mɔɔda etemila ani nkya ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo ƒui kaduɛ. Katɔti kani na ɔlɛka emwi lɛni!”

english_verse: Don't keep the prophecies in this book a secret. These things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Amu na ɔ́su-mi ɔnini, “Teti kenye kani na Katɔti údie na ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo etemila tabɛla, ɔsika uwi ɔmmɔ úude.

english_verse: Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
translation_verse: Ukyuli ɔni na likpidi na ɔɔyɔ́ ka utaabla ni, usie anumi utaabla likpidi. Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔyɔ́ ka utaabla ala ani muusé lɛlɔ ni, usie anumi utaabla ala ani muusé lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli ɔni mɔɔbla ala siin ni, usie anumi utaabla ala ulu lɛlɔ. Na ukyuli ɔni nse kedee ni, usie anumi na ɔda lɛlɔ kedee.”

english_verse: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.
translation_verse: “Bɛnu! Ami Yesu ndubo uwi klukui! Na ndanku lɛyuƒɔla lɛni námanku kabla biala ndububoku, na mbaƒɔ ɔdi biala kayu na lɛla lɛni na ɔ́bla kenye.

english_verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
translation_verse: Ami ndi Alƒa ku Omega, Udeedi ku Ukplodi, Kalɔ Kesekɔ ku Kawɔlɔkɔ.

english_verse: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.
translation_verse: “Lɛlɔ lɛdubɔyɔ bekyuli bani náklibi lɛlɔ bése aani kalɛ na baaƒɔ lɛwu sɛɛn. Ama ndubɔkɛ kuƒi ka badi kugyii kɔni muute ngba mmɔ ebi. Na badubɔsia kayakun mmɔ beduo Katɔ Ɔga Ɔma ɔmmɔ kemmo.

english_verse: But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
translation_verse: Na bani ndubunye ɔba kama aani bakpɛwe ni, ama ndi bekyuli bani mɔɔƒɛ evo ku bani mɔɔbla lɛyalɛ ala ku bani mɔɔdú bekyuli ku bani mɔɔkpá baƒiɔ ku bekyuli bani ƒui mɔɔyɔ́ ka batɔlɔ bekyuli na ɔkɔ bɔnyi bɔɔda-ma ɔkwɛ.

english_verse: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
translation_verse: “Ami Yesu nátala mina ɔtu lɛ́kya-a nnii ubedie ala amɛni kenye ute awɔ, Yohane, kalɛ na eti asu baƒɔtaadine akpa ammɔ ƒui. Ami ndi Kugyii Ugyiitu ɔmmɔ ɔni ndi Ɔga Dawid kaba kemmo ubi. Ami ndi ɔtanta lɛyabi lɛni muukeye mmɔ.”

english_verse: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
translation_verse: Katɔti Kɔyu kɔmmɔ ku Yesu bayɔne banii, “Bo!” Na ɔlɛka ukyuli biala ɔni muunú ɔmɛni lɛnɔ ɔsu ɔnii, “Bo!” Na bani ƒui na utukwɛ ɔɔda ni, bebo. Na bani ƒui mɔɔyɔ́ ni, babani ngba ntu bɔmmɔ ƒaa. Kayu kadi taƒɔ taƒɔ.

english_verse: Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book: If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book.
translation_verse: Mɔɔlɛ ukyuli biala ɔni muunú kenye kani na Katɔti údie na ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo ka si úti lɛla lɛdi úbunku ala amɛni lɛlɔ ni, Katɔti ɔdubɔya na ɔgbankpi ɔni lɛlɔ kɔtɛ na bɔ́tɛmi na ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo ubo-nwu lɛlɔ.

english_verse: If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
translation_verse: Na si lɛla lɛdi na ɔ́da údie na kenye budie ɔku ɔmɛni kemmo lɛnɔ ni, Katɔti ɔdubudie ukyuli ɔmmɔ kadikɔ na ngba kugyii kɔmmɔ ebi lɛlɔ. Na ɔdubutile-nwu kuƒi ka uduo ɔma kedee ɔmmɔ kemmo na katɔ.

english_verse: The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!” So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
translation_verse: Yesu ɔni muudie ala amɛni kenye ni, ɔ́su ɔnini, “Ɛɛn, ndubo na uwi klukui kemmo!” Amu na ami lɛnɔ lɛ́tuna nnii, “Ɔsia lɛni. O Blɔti Yesu, bo!”

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Muuvele nnii lɛƒɔndia lɛni nási Blɔti Yesu kudɔ lɛsiaku Katɔti bekyuli. Ɔsia lɛni.
